text: Exorcizo te creatura salis per Deum vivum per Deum verum et per Deum sanctum per Deum qui te per Elisaeum prophetam in aquam mitti iussit ut sanaretur sterilitas aquae ut efficiaris sal exorcizatum in salutem credentium ut sis omnibus te sumentibus salus mentis et corporis et effugiat atque discedat ab eo loco quo aspersus fueris omnis phantasia et nequitia vel versutia diabolicae fraudis omnisque spiritus immundus adiuratus.
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of salt, in the name of the living God, in the name of the true God, and in the name of the holy God, who commanded you to be thrown into water by the prophet Elisha so that the waters would be healed, that you may become an exorcised salt for the benefit of believers, that you may be salvation for all who consume you, both mentally and physically, and that every evil thought, deceit, diabolical trickery, and any unclean spirit sworn in should depart from the place where you are sprinkled.

text: Immensam clementiam tuam omnipotens aeterne Deus humiliter imploramus ut hanc creaturam salis quam ad usum humani generis tribuisti benedicere et sanctificare pro tua pietate digneris ut sit omnibus sumentibus salus mentis et corporis et quicquid ex eo tactum vel respersum fuerit careat omni immunditia omnique impugnatione spiritalis nequitiae.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your immeasurable clemency, almighty eternal God, to bless and sanctify this creation of salt that you have given for the use of the human race. We ask in your mercy that it be a salvation for both mind and body for those who consume it or come into contact with it in any way. May whatever is touched or sprinkled with it be free from all uncleanness and any spiritual attack by wickedness.

text: Exorcizo te creatura aquae in nomine Dei Patris omnipotentis et in nomine Iesu Christi Filii eiusdem Domini nostri et in virtute Spiritus Sancti ut fias aqua exorcizata ad effugandam omnem potestatem inimici et ipsum inimicum eradicare et explantare valeas cum angelis suis apostaticis.
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of water, in the name of God the Almighty Father and in the name of Jesus Christ, His Son our Lord, and by the power of the Holy Spirit, that you become exorcised water to drive away every power of the enemy and root out, expel and vanquish both him and his apostate angels.

text: Deus qui ad salutem humani generis maxima quaeque sacramenta in aquarum substantia condidisti adesto propitius invocationibus nostris et elemento huic multimodis purificationibus praeparato virtutem tuae benedictionis infunde ut creatura mysterii tui tibi serviens ad abiciendos daemones morbosque pellendos divinae gratiae sumat effectum ut quicquid in domibus vel in locis fidelium haec unda resperserit careat omni immunditia liberetur a noxia non illic resideat spiritus pestilens non aura corrumpens discedant omnes insidiae latentis inimici et si quid est [quod] aut incolumitati habitantium invidet aut quieti aspersione huius aquae effugiat ut salubritas per invocationem tui sancti nominis expetita ab omnibus sit impugnationibus defensa.
translation_en: God, who in the substance of waters established the greatest and every sacrament for the salvation of the human race, be present propitiously to our invocations. And with this element prepared for multimodal purifications, pour out your power that the creature serving your mystery may take effect in casting out demons and diseases by divine grace. May it leave behind all impurity, be freed from harmful influences, and let no pestilential spirit remain or corrupted air dwell within. Let all hidden traps of the enemy depart, and if anything envies those dwelling in safety or disturbance of this water's sprinkling, may health be defended against all attacks by your holy name invoked. May salubrity, sought by all, be protected from assaults.

text: Fiat commixtio salis et aquae pariter in nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti.
translation_en: Let there be a mixing of salt and water equally, in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.

text: Deus invictae virtutis auctor et insuperabilis imperii rex ac semper magnificus triumphator qui adversae dominationis vires reprimis qui inimici rugientis saevitiam superas qui hostiles nequitias potenter expugnas te Domine trementes et supplices deprecamur ac petimus ut hanc creaturam salis et aquae dignanter aspicias benignus illustres pietatis tuae more sanctifices ut ubicumque fuerit aspersa per invocationem tui sancti nominis omnis infestatio immundi spiritus abiciatur terrorque venenosi serpentis procul pellatur et praesentia Spiritus Sancti nobis misericordiam tuam poscentibus ubique adesse dignetur.
translation_en: God, author of invincible virtue and king of unconquerable empire, always magnificently triumphant, who subdues the forces of adversarial dominion, who overcomes the savagery of roaring enemies, who powerfully defeats hostile wickedness, Lord, we tremblingly and humbly beseech you and ask that you graciously look upon this creature of salt and water. May it be sanctified according to your illustrious piety's custom. Wherever it is sprinkled by your invocation, let every infestation of unclean spirits be cast out, and the terror of venomous serpents be driven far away. May the presence of the Holy Spirit always be worthy of our supplication to be with us.

text: Et benedictio Dei Patris omnipotentis et Filii et Spiritus Sancti descendat et maneat super hanc creaturam salis et aquae.
translation_en: And the blessing of God the Father Almighty, and of Jesus Christ His Son, and of the Holy Spirit descend and remain upon this creature of salt and water.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine per hanc sanctificatae aquae aspersionem sanitatem mentis integritatem corporis tutelam salutis securitatem spei corroborationem fidei fructum caritatis hic et in aeterna saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Lord, through this holy sprinkling of water, health of mind, integrity of body, protection of safety, security of salvation, strengthening of hope, fruit of faith, and growth of charity, here and in eternal ages, ages upon ages.

text: Aures tuae pietatis mitissime Deus inclina meis indignis precibus et gratia Spiritus Sancti illumina cor meum ut tuis mysteriis digne tibi ministrare teque aeterna caritate diligere merear.
translation_en: O God, most mercifully, incline your ears to my unworthy prayers and enlighten my heart with the grace of the Holy Spirit, so that I may worthily minister to you in your mysteries, and merit your eternal love.

text: Non de meritorum meorum qualitate confisus praesumo accedere ante sanctum conspectum tuum Domine Deus sed pro tua ineffabili pietate qui dignatus es peccatores ad tuam misericordiam vocare et ad te venientibus dignatus es piissimam indulgentiam et sempiternam gratiam conferre Tu enim a tua pietate nullum repellis sed ad te venientibus tuae pietatis et misericordiae dignanter sinum aperis et ad sacramentum piissimae reconciliationis tuae clementer admittis et gratiae tuae participes efficis qui vocas ea quae non sunt tamquam ea quae sunt qui facis de indignis dignos de peccatoribus iustos de immundis mundos qui iustificas impios et vivificas mortuos et in infirmitate virtutem tribuis Tu ergo Domine fac in me peccatore opus tuae magnae misericordiae tuae pietatis ‹et› immensae tuae gratiae sempiternae non pro meis meritis sed pro tuis miserationibus multis et magnis Mitte tuum Sanctum Spiritum Paraclitum de caelis illuminatorem et sanctificatorem tuae sanctae Ecclesiae quo tu Deus illuminasti et sanctificasti corda sanctorum tuorum apostolorum et ceterorum tuorum fidelium ut ipse tuus Spiritus Sanctus dignanter adveniens cor meum inflammet et expurget et mundum gratiae tuae habitaculum efficiat et omnes sensus meos purificet et clarificet et ministerium servitutis meae faciat in conspectu tuo acceptabile et nobis salutare tua misericordia tribuente tua virtute operante et tua gratia confirmante quia tu es creator omnium et Dominus tibi est omnis honor et gloria.
translation_en: Not relying on the quality of my merits, I presume to approach your holy presence, Lord God. But through your ineffable pity, you have graciously called sinners to your mercy and to those coming to you, you have graciously given most compassionate indulgence and eternal grace. For from your pity, you do not reject but open the door of your mercy and grace to those who come to you. And through your clemency, you make participants of your grace those whom you call what are not as if they were what are. You make the unworthy worthy, the sinners just, the unclean clean, the impious justified, the dead alive, and in weakness you give strength. Therefore, Lord, work in me, a sinner, your great mercy, your pity, and your immeasurable grace - not for my merits but for your many and great mercies. Send your Holy Spirit, the Paraclete from heaven, who enlightens and sanctifies your holy Church, as you, God, have illuminated and sanctified the hearts of your saints, the apostles and all your faithful ones. May your Holy Spirit graciously come upon my heart, purify and cleanse it, make it a dwelling place of your grace, purify and clarify all my senses, and make my service acceptable and salutary in your sight, by your mercy giving strength, operating with your power, and confirming with your grace, for you are the Creator of all things and to you belongs all honor and glory.

text: Oro te sancta Trinitas et inseparabilis Unitas per trophaeum victoriosissimae crucis et merita beatissimae et gloriosissimae Virginis Mariae et omnium sanctorum tuorum et eorum quorum reliquiae hic continentur ut mihi misero et indigno et omni sorde vitiorum interius exteriusque coinquinato manum misericordiae tuae porrigas labentem erigas orantem ne despicias sed pietatis tuae vultu respicias et exaudias fidem adaugeas spem confirmes caritatis tuae in me ardorem accendas Et quia indignus ad sanctum altare tuum accedo non ideo peccatorum recipiam vicem sed indulgentiae tuae piam sentiam bonitatem Praesta hoc Pater omnipotens qui in tantum dilexisti hominem ut ad liberandum eum unicum mitteres Filium Praesta hoc Domine Iesu Christe Fili Dei vivi qui ut a morte eriperes hominem traditus in manus peccatorum non horruisti crucem Tu es ipse qui ovem perditam pio umero ad ovile reportasti Tu es ipse qui ore prophetico dixisti nolo mortem peccatoris sed ut magis convertatur et vivat Praesta hoc Spiritus alme qui procedens ab utroque in me effusus es in baptismo Tu remissio peccatorum Tu illuminator cordium Tu doctrina fidelium Tu unius essentiae unius voluntatis cum Patre et Filio regnas.

Deus qui non mortem sed paenitentiam desideras peccatorum me miserum fragilemque peccatorem a tua non repellas pietate neque aspicias ad scelera mea et immunditias turpesque cogitationes quibus flebiliter a tua disiungor voluntate sed misericordias tuas et fidem devotionemque eorum qui per me peccatorem tuam expetunt misericordiam et quia me medium inter te et populum tuum voluisti fieri fac me talem ut digne possim tuam exorare misericordiam pro me et pro eodem populo tuo Et adiunge voces meas vocibus sanctorum angelorum tuorum ut sicut illi te laudant incessabiliter in aeterna beatitudine ita nos quoque eorum interventu te mereamur laudare inculpabiliter in hac peregrinatione.
translation_en: God, who desires not my death but my penitence, do not drive away from your pity the wretched sinner and fragile transgressor that I am. Neither look upon my sins and foul thoughts which pitifully disunite me from your will, but grant me your mercies and faith, devotion, and those who through me, the sinner, seek your mercy. And since you have wished me to be a medium between you and your people, make me such that I may worthily beseech your mercy for myself and for the same people. Add my voice to the voices of your holy angels, so that, like they laud you without ceasing in eternal beatitude, we too through their intercession may be worthy to praise you blamelessly in this pilgrimage.

text: Lavabo inter innocentes manus meas Et circumdabo altare tuum Domine Ut audiam vocem laudis tuae Et enarrem universa mirabilia tua Amplius lava me Domine ab iniustitia mea Et a peccato meo munda me.
translation_en: I will wash my hands among the innocent, and I will circle your altar, Lord; that I may hear the voice of your praise and declare all your wonders. Cleanse me more thoroughly, Lord, from iniquity, and wash me from my sin.

text: Largire sensibus meis omnipotens Pater ut sicut hic exterius abluuntur inquinamenta manuum mearum sic a te mundentur interius pollutiones mentium et crescat in me augmentum sanctarum virtutum.
translation_en: Generous Father, almighty, may my senses be washed as the stains from my hands are washed here externally, so that within me the pollution of my mind is cleansed, and may an increase of holy virtues grow in me.

text: Da Domine virtutem manibus meis ad abstergendam omnem maculam immundam ut sine pollutione mentis et corporis valeam tibi servire.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, strength to my hands, so that I may cleanse all unclean stain; that without pollution of mind and body I may serve you.

text: Exue me Domine veterem hominem cum actibus meis et indue me novum hominem qui secundum Deum creatus est in iustitia et sanctitate veritatis.
translation_en: Remove from me, Lord, the old man with his deeds and clothe me in a new man who was created according to God in righteousness and holiness of truth.

text: Obumbra Domine caput meum umbraculo sanctae fidei et expelle a me nebulam et caecitatem totius ignorantiae.
translation_en: Lord, cast my head under the shadow of holy faith and drive away from me the mist and blindness of complete ignorance.

text: Umeros meos et pectus meum Sancti Spiritus gratia protege Domine renesque meos vitiis cordis et corporis omnibus expulsis praecinge tibi ad sacrificandum Deo viventi et regnanti in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Lord, protect my shoulders and my chest with the grace of the Holy Spirit. Renew me, and cleanse me from all the vices of heart and body. Adorn me to offer sacrifice to the living and reigning God for eternities upon eternities.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus te suppliciter exoro ut fraudium omnium suffocatione exutus albaque veste indutus te sequi merear ad regna ubi vera sunt gaudia in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, I humbly entreat you that, freed from all fraud, clothed in white garments, I may be worthy to follow you into the realms where true joy is forever and ever.

text: Praecinge lumbos meos Domine Pater clementissime et circumcide vitia cordis et corporis mei.
translation_en: Gird my loins, O most merciful Father, and cut away the vices of my heart and body.

text: Manipulum innocentiae pone Domine super manum meam et appone iustitiam pro iniquitate mea.
translation_en: Place, Lord, a handful of innocence upon my hand, and apply justice for my wickedness.

text: Stola iustitiae circumda Domine cervicem meam et ab omni corruptione peccati purifica mentem meam.
translation_en: Enrobe, Lord, my neck with the robe of justice and purify my mind from all corruption of sin.

text: Indue me Domine ornamento humilitatis et caritatis et castitatis et concede mihi protectionem contra hostem iniquum ut valeam puro corde laudare nomen tuum gloriosum quod est benedictum in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Clothe me, Lord, with the robe of humility and charity and chastity, and grant me protection against the wicked enemy that I may be able to praise your glorious name, which is blessed forever and ever.

text: Deus aeternorum bonorum fidelissime promissor ac rectissime persolutor qui vestimentum salutare et indumentum iucunditatis tuis promisisti fidelibus clementiam tuam suppliciter exoro ut his sacris vestibus me indutum digne tibi servire concedas.
translation_en: God, the most faithful promise-giver and the most righteous fulfiller of eternal goodness, who have promised your robe of salvation and garment of delight to your faithful, I humbly beseech your clemency that you grant me worthy to serve you clothed in these sacred vestments.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus ecce accedo ad sacramentum corporis et sanguinis Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi Accedo tamquam infirmus ad medicum vitae Immundus ad fontem misericordiae Caecus ad lumen claritatis aeternae Egenus ad Dominum caeli et terrae Nudus ad regem gloriae Rogo ergo Domine immensae maiestatis tuae cle[b1v]mentiam quatenus meam digneris curare infirmitatem lavare foeditatem illuminare caecitatem ditare paupertatem vestire nuditatem Ut te panem angelorum regem regum et Dominum dominantium tanta reverentia et tremore tanta contritione suscipiam et amore tanta fide et puritate tali proposito et humilitate sicut expedit saluti animae meae Da mihi quaeso illius dominici corporis et sanguinis non solum suscipere sacramentum sed etiam virtutem sacramenti O mitissime Deus da mihi sic suscipere corpus Unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi quod traxit de beata Maria Virgine ut corpori suo mystico merear incorporari et inter eius membra connumerari O Pater amantissime concede mihi dilectum Filium tuum quem nunc quidem velatum suscipere propono revelata tandem facie contemplari.
translation_en:
Almighty and merciful God, I approach the sacrament of the body and blood of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. I come as a sick person to a physician, as an unclean one to a fountain of mercy, as a blind one to light eternal, as a poor one to the Lord of heaven and earth, as a naked one to the king of glory.
I therefore humbly ask you, immeasurable majesty of yours, that you may deign to care for my infirmity, wash away my filth, illuminate my blindness, clothe my poverty, cover my nakedness. So that I may receive and take him, the bread of angels, king of kings and Lord of lords, with such reverence, fear, contrition, love, faith, and purity, as is suitable for the salvation of my soul.
Grant me, I pray, not only to receive the sacrament of his lordly body and blood, but also the power of the sacrament. O most merciful God, grant that I may receive the body of your only-begotten Son, whom now I propose to accept veiled, that I may one day contemplate him unveiled with his face revealed.
O loving Father, grant me that I may take him, your beloved Son, whom now I propose to receive veiled, that I may one day behold him unveiled. Amen.

text: Summe sacerdos et vere pontifex qui te obtulisti Deo Patri hostiam puram et immaculatam in ara crucis pro nobis miseris peccatoribus et qui dedisti nobis carnem tuam ad manducandum et sanguinem tuum ad bibendum et posuisti mysterium illud in virtute Spiritus Sancti dicens Haec quotienscumque feceritis in mei memoriam facietis Rogo te per sanguinem tuum pretiosum magnum salutis nostrae pretium Rogo per hanc miram et ineffabilem caritatem qua nos miseros sic amare dignatus es ut lavares a peccatis nostris in sanguine tuo Doce me indignum servum tuum quem inter cetera dona tua etiam ad officium sacerdotale vocare dignatus es nullis meis meritis sed sola dignatione misericordiae tuae Doce me quaeso per Spiritum Sanctum tantum tractare mysterium ea reverentia et amore ea devotione et timore quibus oportet et decet Fac me per gratiam tuam semper illud de tanto mysterio credere et intelligere sentire et firmiter tenere dicere et cogitare quod tibi placet et expedit animae meae Intret Spiritus tuus bonus in cor meum qui sonet ibi sine sono et sine strepitu verborum loquatur omnem veritatem tantorum mysteriorum Profunda quippe sunt nimis et sacro tecta velamine Propter magnam clementiam tuam concede mihi missarum sollemnia puro corde et munda mente celebrare Libera Domine cor meum ab immundis et nefandis vanis et noxiis cogitationibus Muni me beatorum angelorum fida et pia custodia ut hostes omnium bonorum confusi discedant.virtutem tanti mysterii et per manum sancti angeli tui repelle a me et a cunctis servis tuis durissimum spiritum superbiae et cenodoxiae invidiae et blasphemiae fornicationis et nequitiae immunditiae dubietatis et diffidentiae Confundantur qui nos persequuntur et pereant illi qui cuncta perdere festinant Rex virginum amator castitatis et integritatis [b2r] Deus caelesti rore tuae benedictionis exstingue in corpore meo totum fomitem ardentis libidinis ut maneat in me tenor totius castitatis corporis et animae Mortifica in membris meis carnis stimulos omnesque libidinosas commotiones et da mihi veram et perpetuam castitatem cum ceteris bonis tuis qui tibi placent in veritate ut sacrificium laudis casto corpore et mundo corde valeam cottidie tibi offerre Quanta enim cordis contritione et lacrimarum fonte quanta reverentia et tremore quanta corporis castitate et animae puritate istud divinum et caeleste sacrificium est celebrandum Domine ubi caro tua in veritate sumitur ubi sanguis tuus in veritate bibitur ubi ima summis coniunguntur ubi tu es sacerdos et sacrificium mirabiliter et ineffabiliter Quis digne hoc celebrare potest nisi tu Deus omnipotens offerentem feceris dignum? Scio et vere scio et id ipsum bonitati tuae confiteor quia non sum dignus accedere ad tantum mysterium propter nimia peccata mea et infinitas negligentias meas Sed scio et veraciter ex toto corde credo ore confiteor quia tu potes me facere dignum qui solus potes facere mundum de immundo conceptum semine et de peccatoribus iustos facis et sanctos.hanc omnipotentiam tuam te rogo concede mihi peccatori hoc caeleste sacrificium celebrare cum timore et tremore cum lacrimarum fonte cum laetitia spirituali et caelesti gaudio Sentiat mens mea dulcedinem beatissimae praesentiae tuae et excubias sanctorum angelorum in circuitu meo Ego memor venerandae passionis tuae accedo ad altare tuum licet peccator ut offeram tibi sacrificium quod instituisti et offerri praecepisti in commemoratione tua pro salute nostra Peto clementiam tuam ut descendat super panem et calicem plenitudo tuae divinitatis descendat etiam Domine illa Sancti Spiritus tui invisibilis et incomprehensibilis maiestas sicut quondam in hostias patrum descendebat qui et oblationes nostras corpus et sanguinem tuum efficiat et me indignum sacerdotem doceat tantum tractare mysterium cum cordis puritate et lacrimarum fonte reverentia et tremore ita ut placide ac benigne suscipias sacrificium de manibus meis ad salutem omnium tam vivorum quam defunctorum Rogo te Domine per ipsum sacrosanctum et vivificum mysterium corporis et sanguinis tui quo cottidie in ecclesia tua pascimur et potamur abluimur et sanctificamur Atque unius supremae divinitatis participes efficimur da mihi virtutes tuas sanctas quibus repletus bona conscientia ad altare tuum accedam ita ut haec caelestia sacramenta efficiantur mihi salus et vita Tu enim dixisti ore sancto tuo et benedicto panis quem ego dabo caro mea est pro mundi vita Qui manducat me vivit propter me et ipse manet in me et ego in eo Ego sum panis vivus qui de caelo descendi si quis manducaverit ex hoc pane vivet in aeternum Panis dulcissime sana palatum cordis mei ut sentiam suavitatem amoris tui Sana eum ab omni languore ut nullam praeter te desideret dulcedinem Panis candidissime habens omne delectamentum et omnem saporem qui nos semper reficis et in te numquam deficis comedat te cor meum et dulcedine saporis tui repleantur viscera animae meae Manducat te angelus pleno ore manducet te peregrinus homo pro modulo suo ne deficiat in via tali recreatus viatico Panis sancte panis vitae panis pulcher panis vivus qui de caelo descendisti et das vitam mundo Veni in cor meum et munda me ab omni inquinamento carnis et spiritus Intra in animam meam et sanctifica eam sana interius et exterius Esto tutamen et continua salus corporis et animae meae Repelle a me insidiantes mihi hostes recedant procul a praesentia potentiae tuae ut foris intusque munitus per te recto tramite ad regnum tuum perveniam ubi non in mysteriis sicut hoc tempore agitur sed facie ad faciem te videbimus cum tra regnum Deo Patri et erit Deus omnia in omnibus Tunc enim me de te satiabis suavitate mirifica ita ut nec esuriam nec sitiam in aeternum.
translation_en:
Supreme priest and truly the pontiff who offered to God the Father a pure and immaculate sacrifice on the altar of the cross for us miserable sinners, and who gave us your flesh to eat and your blood to drink, and placed this mystery in the power of the Holy Spirit, saying: "This as often as you shall do, you will do it in my memory. I ask you by your precious blood, a great price of our salvation. I ask you by this amazing and ineffable love with which you have deigned to love us sinners so much that you wash us from our sins in your blood. Teach me, an unworthy servant whom you have also called to the office of the priesthood without any merits of mine but solely by the mercy of yours, teach me how only to handle this mystery with such reverence and love, devotion, and fear as is fitting and appropriate.
Teach me, I ask, through the Holy Spirit, to always believe, understand, feel, and firmly hold that it pleases and benefits my soul that you offer yourself as a sacrifice for me.
May your good spirit enter into my heart, which speaks there without sound or disturbance of words, declaring all truth about these great mysteries. For indeed, they are too deep and hidden under a veil of sacred mystery.
Grant me, Lord, the solemnity of masses with a pure heart and a clean mind to celebrate. Deliver my heart from filthy and nefarious vain thoughts and keep me safe from corrupting influences.
Free me, Lord, by the faithful and pious custody of blessed angels, that my enemies may be confused and depart. Drive away from me and from all your servants the most stubborn spirit of pride, envy, blasphemy, fornication, and wickedness, doubt, and fear.
Let those who pursue us perish, and let them who hurry to destroy everything vanish. King of virgins, lover of chastity and integrity! God of the heavens, quench in my body the whole spark of burning desire so that the tone of complete chastity remains in me both of body and soul.
Curb in my members all stimuli and lascivious movements, and grant me true and perpetual chastity with other good things that please you in truth. How great is the contrition of heart and the flow of tears when this divine and heavenly sacrifice is celebrated! Where your body is truly taken, where your blood is truly drunk, where the depths unite with the heights, where you are the priest and the sacrifice is wonderfully and ineffably offered. Who can worthily celebrate this except you, God Almighty, offering the worthy? I know and truly confess that I am not worthy to approach such a great mystery because of my many sins and infinite negligences. But I know and truly believe from all my heart, mouth, and conscience that you can make me worthy who alone can make the world clean from impurity conceived by sin and from sinners just and holy.
Grant me this omnipotence, O God, to celebrate this heavenly sacrifice with fear and trembling, with the fountain of tears, with spiritual and heavenly joy, may my mind taste the sweetness of your most blessed presence, may the angels surround me in their circle. I remember the venerable passion of yours, I approach your altar like a sinner to offer you the sacrifice that you instituted and commanded for our salvation.
I ask for your mercy to descend upon bread and cup, and even more, Lord, may the invisible and incomprehensible majesty of your Holy Spirit descend as it once descended upon the sacrifices of the fathers, who made our offerings your body and blood. Teach me how only to handle this mystery with purity of heart and the fountain of tears, with reverence and trembling, so that you may receive the sacrifice peacefully and graciously from my hands for the salvation of all, both living and dead.
I ask you, Lord, by this sacred and vivifying mystery of your body and blood, which we are fed and nourished daily in your church, grant me your holy powers with which I may approach your altar so that these heavenly sacraments become salvation and life for me. For you have said through a holy mouth and blessed bread: "Whatsoever you eat of this bread shall be for eternal life."

text: Gratias tibi ago Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui me miserum et indignum peccatorem nullis meis meritis exigentibus sed per tuam gratiam satiare dignatus es corpore et sanguine Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi Ideo precor ut haec communio salutaris non sit mihi reatus ad poenam sed intercessio salutaris ad veniam sit mihi armatura fidei et scutum bonae voluntatis sit vitiorum meorum evacuatio concupiscentiae et libidinis exterminatio caritatis castitatis humilitatis patientiae et oboedientiae omniumque virtutum ac totius sanctitatis augmentatio Contra insidias inimicorum meorum visibilium et invisibilium firma defensio et omnium motuum meorum tam carnalium quam spiritualium perfecta quietatio In eodem Domino nostro Iesu Christo firma adhaesio atque finis mei felix consummatio Et precor ut ad convivium caelestis gratiae me miserum peccatorem perducere digneris Ubi tu es sanctis tuis lux vera satietas plena iucunditas consummata felicitas perfecta et gaudium sempiternum.
translation_en: I give thanks to you, Lord holy Father almighty eternal God, who have mercy on me, an unworthy sinner, not requiring any merits of mine but satiating me with your grace, body and blood of your Son our Lord Jesus Christ. Therefore I pray that this saving communion not be a burden for me leading to punishment, but a saving intercession for forgiveness be for me, armor of faith, shield of good will, evacuation of my vices, extinction of lust and desire, increase of charity, chastity, humility, patience, obedience, all virtues, and totality of holiness. Against the snares of my enemies, visible and invisible, give me a firm defense and perfect peace in all my movements, both carnal and spiritual. In our Lord Jesus Christ, give me steadfast adhesion, happy completion, and blessed consummation. I pray that you lead me, a wretched sinner, worthy of grace to the feast of celestial grace, where with the saints you are true light, full satisfaction, complete joy, perfect happiness, and eternal joy.

text: Serenissima et inclita Mater Domini nostri Iesu Christi qui Creatorem omnium creaturarum in tuo sanctissimo utero meruisti portare cuius idem veracissimum corpus et sanguinem ego indignus sumere praesumpsi Ad ipsum pro me peccatore intercedere digneris ut quicquid in eius ineffabili sacrificio ignoranter aut negligenter admisi tuis sanctissimis precibus dignetur mihi indulgere.
translation_en: Most serene and glorious Mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, who merited to bear the Creator of all creatures within your most holy womb, I, unworthy, presume to receive his very true body and blood. I dare to intercede for myself, a sinner, that you may be moved to intercede for me. May whatever I ignorantly or negligently admitted in his ineffable sacrifice deign to forgive me through your most holy prayers.

text: Excita quaesumus Domine potentiam tuam et veni ut ab imminentibus peccatorum nostrorum periculis te mereamur protegente eripi et te liberante salvari.
translation_en: Stir up, we ask You, Lord, Your power and come to deliver us from the dangers of our sins, that protected by You, we may be freed and saved by Your liberation.

text: Conscientias nostras quaesumus Domine visitando purifica ut veniens Unigenitus Filius tuus Dominus noster Iesus Christus cum omnibus sanctis suis paratam sibi in nobis inveniat mansionem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to visit and purify our consciences, that when your Only-Begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, comes with all his saints, he may find a prepared dwelling place in us.

text: In mentibus nostris quaesumus Domine verae fidei sacramenta confirma ut qui conceptum de Virgine Deum verum et hominem confitemur per eius salutiferae resurrectionis potentiam ad aeternam mereamur pervenire laetitiam.
translation_en: In our minds, we humbly ask, Lord, that you confirm the sacraments of true faith. May those who confess that God, truly human and divine, was conceived by the Virgin, attain eternal joy through the powerful resurrection of Him.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine celebrandum intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis placatus intende quod et nos a vitiis nostrae condicionis emundet et tuo nomini reddat acceptos.
translation_en: Lord, may the sacrifice be offered to you with all your saints interceding, and may it be favorably directed towards us, that we may be cleansed from our vices through this condition, and render acceptable offerings to your name.

text: Gratiam tuam quaesumus Domine mentibus nostris infunde ut qui angelo nuntiante Christi Filii tui incarnationem cognovimus per passionem eius et crucem ad resurrectionis gloriam perducamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to pour your grace upon our minds so that we who have learned of the incarnation of your Son, Christ, through the announcement of an angel, may be led by his passion and cross to the glory of his resurrection.

text: Animae nostrae quaesumus Domine hoc potiantur desiderio ut a tuo spiritu inflammentur et sicut lampades divino munere satiati ante conspectum venientis Christi Filii tui cum omnibus sanctis velut clara luminaria fulgeamus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that our souls may be strengthened by this desire, so that they may be inflamed by your Spirit. May we be satisfied with the divine gift like lampstands, and may we shine brightly before the coming sight of your Son Christ with all saints, as clear lights.

text: Excita Domine corda nostra ad praeparandas Unigeniti tui vias ut per eius adventum purificatis tibi mentibus servire mereamur.
translation_en: Stir up, Lord, our hearts to prepare the ways of your Only-Begotten Son, that through his coming we may cleanse our minds and be worthy to serve you.

text: Imploramus Domine clementiam tuam ut haec divina subsidia a vitiis expiatos ad festa ventura nos praeparent.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, for your mercy, that these divine aids may prepare us, purified from vices, for the festivals to come.

text: Accepta tibi sint Domine quaesumus nostra ieiunia quae expiando nos tua gratia dignos efficiant et ad sempiterna promissa perducant.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that our fasting be acceptable to you. May it be so that your grace deems us worthy through this penance, and may it lead us to the eternal promises.

text: Indignos famulos tuos quaesumus Domine quos actionis propriae culpa contristat Unigeniti Filii tui nos adventu laetifica.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you may comfort your unworthy servants, whom the fault of their own actions saddens. May the coming of your Only-Begotten Son bring us joy.

text: Excita Domine potentiam tuam et veni et magna nobis virtute succurre ut per auxilium gratiae tuae quod nostra peccata praepediunt indulgentia tuae propitiationis acceleret.
translation_en: Stir up, O Lord, Thy power and come, and help us with great might, so that through the aid of Thy grace, what our sins have hindered may be quickened by Thy clemency's indulgence.

text: Sacrificiis praesentibus Domine placatus intende ut et devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: Lord, pleased with our sacrifices, incline Your attention so that they may benefit our devotion and salvation.

text: Deus qui nos redemptionis nostrae annua exspectatione laetificas praesta ut Unigenitum tuum quem Redemptorem nostrum laeti suscipimus venientem quoque iudicem securi videamus.
translation_en: God who delights us with the annual expectation of our redemption, grant that we may also behold your Only-Begotten Son, whom we joyfully receive as our Redeemer, coming also as a righteous Judge.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut adoranda Filii tui natalicia praevenimus sic eius munera capiamus sempiterna gaudentes.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty God, that just as we have come in advance to honor the birth of your Son, so may we receive his eternal gifts rejoicing.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine nativitatis hodiernae mysteriis apta proveniant ut sicut homo genitus idem refulsit et Deus sic nobis haec terrena substantia conferat quod divinum est.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, on this day of the nativity, that our gifts may be fitting for the mysteries, so that just as the man born reflected both humanity and divinity, may this earthly substance be granted to us, which is divine.

text: Huius nos Domine sacramenti semper novitas natalis instauret cuius nativitas singularis humanam reppulit vetustatem.
translation_en: This, Lord, may the newness of this sacred mystery always renew, whose nativity singularly repulsed human old age.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam muneribus sacris eius quaesumus semper interventione nos refove cuius sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with sacred gifts; we humbly ask that you always restore us through intervention, whose solemnities we are now celebrating.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nos Unigeniti tui nova per carnem nativitas liberet quos sub peccati iugo vetusta servitus tenet.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that through the birth of your Only-Begotten Son in flesh, we may be set free who are held in the old bondage of sin.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut natus hodie Salvator mundi sicut divinae nobis generationis est auctor ita et immortalitatis sit ipse largitor.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that the Savior of the world who was born today may also be for us the author of our divine birth, so that he himself may be the bestower of immortality.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine imitari quod colimus ut discamus et inimicos diligere quia eius natalicia celebramus qui novit etiam pro suis persecutoribus exorare.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that we may imitate what we worship, so that we may learn to love our enemies; for we celebrate the birth of him who knows also how to pray for his persecutors.

text: Suscipe Domine munera pro commemoratione protomartyris tui beati Stephani ut sicut illum passio fecit gloriosum ita nos devotio reddat innocuos.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings for the commemoration of your protomartyr, blessed Stephen, that as his passion made him glorious, so our devotion may make us innocent.

text: Auxilientur nobis Domine sumpta mysteria et intercedente beato Stephano protomartyre tuo sempiterna nos protectione confirment.
translation_en: Lord, help us with your sacred mysteries and with the intercession of your first martyr, Saint Stephen, strengthen us forever with your eternal protection.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui primitias martyrum in beati levitae Stephani sanguine dedicasti tribue quaesumus ut pro nobis intercessor exsistat qui pro suis etiam persecutoribus exoravit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who dedicated the first fruits of the martyrs in the blood of blessed Levite Stephen, we humbly ask that you may grant us a intercessor who, like him, prayed not only for himself but also for his persecutors.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine benignus illustra ut beati Ioannis apostoli tui et evangelistae illuminata doctrinis ad dona perveniat sempiterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to shine upon your church with kindness, that the blessed apostle and evangelist John may arrive at eternal gifts through enlightened teachings.

text: Suscipe munera Domine quae in eius sollemnitate tibi deferimus cuius nos confidimus patrocinio liberari.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings which we bring to you on this solemnity, in whose patronage we trust to be freed.

text: Refecti cibo potuque caelesti Deus noster te supplices deprecamur ut in cuius haec commemoratione percepimus eius muniamur et precibus.
translation_en: We, who have been refreshed with food and drink of celestial bread, humbly pray to our God that we may be fortified within this commemoration, and strengthened by our prayers.

text: Deus cuius hodierna die praeconium innocentes martyres non loquendo sed moriendo confessi sunt omnia in nobis vitiorum mala mortifica ut fidem tuam quam lingua nostra loquitur etiam moribus vita fateatur.
translation_en: God, whose martyrs today made a proclamation not by speaking but by dying, have confirmed all within us the evil of vices be destroyed so that your faith which our tongue speaks may also be proven by our actions and lifestyle.

text: Sanctorum tuorum nobis Domine pia non desit oratio quae et munera nostra conciliet et tuam nobis indulgentiam obtineat.
translation_en: Lord, may not the prayer of your saints cease for us, that it may gather our offerings and obtain your indulgence for us.

text: Votiva Domine dona percepimus quae sanctorum nobis precibus quaesumus et praesentis vitae pariter et aeternae tribuant conferre subsidium.
translation_en: We have perceived, Lord, the vows which we have asked for from the saints through our prayers, and they grant us support both in this life and in the eternal one.

text: Deus pro cuius Ecclesia gloriosus martyr et pontifex Thomas gladiis impiorum occubuit praesta quaesumus ut qui eius implorant auxilium petitionis suae salutarem consequantur effectum.
translation_en: God for whose Church the glorious martyr and pope Thomas was slain by the unholy gladiators, grant us we beseech you, that those who seek his aid may obtain a salutary effect from their petition.

text: Intercedente pro nobis glorioso martyre tuo Thoma nos quaesumus Domine vivificent haec sacra mysteria ut sicut illi contulisti gloriam sempiternam ita nobis eius intercessionibus largiaris indulgentiam.
translation_en: Through the intercession of your glorious martyr Thomas, we humbly ask you, Lord, to enliven these sacred mysteries for us, so that just as you granted him eternal glory, you may grant us through his intercessions indulgence.

text: Caelestibus quaesumus Domine recreati alimentis intercedente pro nobis glorioso martyre tuo Thoma ab universis nos tuere periculis et petitionum nostrarum desiderabilem obtinere concedas effectum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be nourished by celestial provisions through the intercession of your glorious martyr Thomas. Protect us from all dangers and grant us the favorable outcome of our petitions.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut oculis tuae maiestatis munus oblatum et gratiam nobis devotionis obtineat et effectum beatae perennitatis acquirat.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the offering made to your majesty's office may obtain grace in our devotion and acquire the effect of blessed eternal life.

text: Muneribus nostris quaesumus Domine precibusque susceptis intercedente beata Maria Dei Genitrice et caelestibus nos munda mysteriis et clementer exaudi.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, with our offerings and prayers received, through the intercession of the blessed Mary, Mother of God, and of the heavenly ones, cleanse us with holy mysteries and hear us graciously.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et intercedente gloriosa Dei Genitrice Virgine Maria caelestis remedii faciat esse consortes.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, cleanses us from sin; and with the intercession of the glorious Virgin Mary, Mother of God, may it make us participants in heavenly remedy.

text: Corda nostra quaesumus Domine venturae sollemnitatis splendor illustret quo et mundi huius tenebris carere valeamus et perveniamus ad patriam claritatis aeternae.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the brilliance of the approaching solemnity may enlighten our hearts, so that we may be able to live without the darkness of this world and reach the homeland of eternal clarity.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine ut cum praesentibus immolemus sacrificiis et sumamus quem venturae sollemnitatis pia munera praeloquuntur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that we may offer sacrifices with those who are present and take what the pious gifts of the upcoming solemnities proclaim.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quae sollemni celebramus officio purificatae mentis intelligentia consequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that what we celebrate solemnly according to the office of purified mind may be attained by us.

text: Oblatum tibi quaesumus Domine sacrificium vivificet nos semper et muniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offering presented to you may always revive us and protect us.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut quos tuis reficis sacramentis tibi etiam placidis moribus dignanter deservire concedas.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, almighty God, that you who sustain us with your sacred sacraments, also grant us the grace to serve you with peaceful manners.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro nati Filii tui apparitione deferimus suppliciter exorantes ut sicut ipse nostrorum est auctor munerum ita sit ipse misericors et susceptor.
translation_en: We bring to you, Lord, offerings for your Son who has appeared. With humble supplication we ask that, as he is the author of our gifts, so may he be merciful and supportive towards us.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus emundet nostra delicta et ad sacrificium celebrandum subditorum tibi corpora mentesque sanctificet.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we ask You to purify our sins and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the celebration of sacrifice.

text: Quos tantis Domine largiris uti mysteriis quaesumus ut effectibus eorum veraciter aptare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, whom You lavish with such great gifts through these mysteries, we humbly ask that You deign to fit us truly with their effects.

text: Munera tua nos Deus a delectationibus terrenis expediant et caelestibus nos semper instruant alimentis.
translation_en: Your gifts, O God, may deliver us from earthly delights and may always instruct us with heavenly food.

text: Preces populi tui quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi ut qui iuste pro peccatis nostris affligimur pro tui nominis gloria misericorditer liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your mercy, Lord, that you hear the prayers of your people with clemency. May those who are justly afflicted for our sins be mercifully freed for the glory of your name.

text: Muneribus nostris quaesumus Domine precibusque susceptis et caelestibus nos munda mysteriis et clementer exaudi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with our offerings and prayers received, cleanse us with heavenly mysteries and graciously hear us.

text: Exorcizo te cinis in nomine Patris omnipotentis et in nomine Iesu Christi Filii Dei et Spiritus Sancti qui te per ignem in favillam converti praecepit ut sicut in iussione Dei per sanctum famulum eius Moysen cinis vitulae in populo aspersus omnem congregationem filiorum Israel sanctificavit ita et tu exorcizatus sis in nomine Sanctae Trinitatis in terra et in cilicio aspersus in eis qui scrutinia sunt habituri super stantes vel transituros diabolus non lateat sed manifestetur et expellatur ut puri et sinceri inveniantur Te autem petimus et rogamus Pater omnipotens ut sicut Ninivitarum populus ad praedicationem Ionae prophetae misericordiam tuam Domine exorantes suorum veniam meruerunt consequi peccatorum ita et hi qui ad tuam gratiam percipiendam venire desiderant amputatis maculis carnalibus per sacri baptismatis regenerationem suorum finem constituant vitiorum.
translation_en: I exorcise you, ashes, in the name of the Almighty Father and in the name of Jesus Christ, Son of God, and of the Holy Spirit who commanded you to be converted into ashes by fire, just as the assembly of the sons of Israel was sanctified when Moyses scattered ashes from a calf upon them; so may you be exorcised in the name of the Holy Trinity on earth and upon the garment of penance. May the diabolical one not hide but manifest and be expelled, that pure and sincere ones may be found. We ask and we pray to the Almighty Father that, just as the people of Nineveh obtained mercy from Your predication, O Lord, when they besought Your forgiveness through the prophet Jonah; so may those who desire to come to Your grace have their carnal stains cut off by the regeneration of sacred baptism and establish the end of their sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus parce metuentibus propitiare supplicantibus et mittere dignare sanctum angelum tuum de caelis qui benedicat et sanctificet hos cineres ut sint remedium salutare omnibus nomen tuum sanctum humiliter implorantibus ac semet ipsos pro conscientia delictorum suorum accusantibus et ante conspectum divinae maiestatis clementiae tuae facinora sua deplorantibus vel serenissimam pietatem tuam suppliciter obnixeque flagitantibus praesta quaesumus per invocationem sanctissimi nominis tui ut quicumque eos super se asperserint pro redemptione peccatorum corporis sanitatem et animae tutelam percipiant.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, have mercy on the fearful, propitiate the supplicants, and grant that your holy angel from heaven may bless and sanctify these ashes, so that they become a salutary remedy for all who humbly invoke your holy name and confess their own sins before the sight of your divine clemency. May they deeply and earnestly beseech your most serene piety, that you grant them what is asked through the invocation of your most sacred name. That whosoever scatters these ashes over themselves may receive bodily health and protection of their souls for the redemption of sins.

text: Deus qui non mortem sed paenitentiam desideras peccatorum fragilitatem humanae condicionis benignissime respice et hos cineres quos causa proferendae humilitatis atque promerendae veniae capitibus nostris imponi decernimus benedicere pro tua pietate digneris ut qui nos cinerem esse et ob pravitatis nostrae meritum in pulverem reversuros cognoscimus omnium peccatorum veniam et praemia paenitentibus repromissa misericorditer consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God who desires not death but penitence for the frailty of human condition, graciously look upon these ashes which we have decreed to be blessed on our heads for the cause of offering humility and seeking forgiveness. May you deem it worthy of your pity to grant that we who know ourselves to become ashes because of our wickedness, may obtain the forgiveness of all sins and the rewards promised to penitents mercifully.

text: Memento homo quia cinis et pulvis es et in cinerem et in pulverem reverteris.
translation_en: Remember man, you are dust and ashes, and to dust and ashes you shall return.

text: Exauditor omnium Deus exaudi nostrorum fletuum vocem et tribue infirmitatibus nostris perpetuam sospitatem ut dum dignanter gemitum nostri laboris suscipis tua nos misericordia consoleris.
translation_en: God who hears all, hear our weeping voice and grant us a perpetual comfort for our weaknesses, so that while you accept our groaning of labor with dignity, you may console us with your mercy.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine his muneribus offerendis convenienter aptari quibus ipsius venerabilis sacramenti celebramus exordium.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you Lord, to fit ourselves appropriately for these offerings with which we begin the venerable sacrament that we celebrate.

text: Deus qui culpa offenderis paenitentia placaris preces populi tui supplicantis propitius respice et flagella tuae iracundiae quae pro peccatis nostris meremur averte.
translation_en: God, who is offended by sin, is appeased by repentance, hear the prayers of your supplicating people and look upon them kindly. Turn away your rod of anger which we deserve for our sins.

text: Sacrificiis praesentibus quaesumus Domine placatus intende ut devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: With the sacrifices present, we humbly ask you, Lord, that you, being pleased, direct your attention so that our devotion may prosper and our salvation be achieved.

text: Sacrificium Domine observantiae quadragesimalis offerimus praesta quaesumus ut tibi et mentes nostras reddat acceptas et continentiae promptioris nobis tribuat facultatem.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the sacrifice of the Quadragesimal observance. Grant us we ask, that You may deem our minds acceptable and grant us the ability for a quicker response in maintaining self-control.

text: Spiritum nobis Domine tuae caritatis infunde ut quos uno pane caelesti satiasti tua facias pietate concordes.
translation_en: Pour out upon us, Lord, Your Spirit of love, that those whom You have satisfied with the one heavenly Bread, may be united in Your grace.

text: Suscipe Domine sacrificium cuius te voluisti dignanter immolatione placari praesta quaesumus ut huius operatione mundati beneplacitum tibi nostrae mentis offeramus effectum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the sacrifice which you willingly desired to be offered by worthy immolation. We humbly ask that through this act you may grant us cleanliness, so that we can present the result of our minds as a pleasing offering to you.

text: Fideles tui Deus per tua dona firmentur ut eadem in percipiendo requirant et quaerendo sine fine percipiant.
translation_en: Your faithful God, through your gifts may they be strengthened, so that the same ones, in receiving, ask and seek without end, may they continuously perceive.

text: Sacrificium quadragesimalis initii sollemniter immolamus te Domine deprecantes ut cum epularum restrictione carnalium a noxiis quoque voluptatibus temperemur.
translation_en: We solemnly offer the Lenten sacrifice to you, Lord, praying that with the restraint of earthly feasts, we may also be tempered from worldly pleasures.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine oblata sanctifica nosque a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to sanctify these offerings and cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Salutaris tui Domine munere satiati te supplices exoramus ut cuius laetamur gustu renovemur effectu.
translation_en: With your saving grace, Lord, we who are satisfied, humbly entreat you. Renew us in joy, as we partake of that which delights us, through its effective power.

text: Absolve quaesumus Domine nostrorum vincula delictorum ut quicquid pro eis meremur propitiatus averte.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to forgive our sins' bonds, that whatever merits we may have earned for them, You may turn away wrathfully.

text: Sacrificia quaesumus Domine nos ista salvent quae medicinalibus sunt instituta ieiuniis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that these sacrifices save us which have been established by medicinal fasts.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera nostris oblata servitiis et tua propitius dona sanctifica.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, the offerings made by our services, and may Your gracious gifts be made holy by You.

text: Protector noster aspice Deus ut qui malorum nostrorum pondere premimur percepta misericordia libera tibi mente famulemur.
translation_en: Our Protector, look upon us, God, that we, who are pressed by the weight of our sins, may with a mind made free by your mercy, call upon you as servants.

text: Sanctificationibus tuis omnipotens Deus et vitia nostra purgentur et remedia nobis aeterna proveniant.
translation_en: With your sanctifications, Almighty God, may our vices be purged and eternal remedies come to us.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine propitius illustra ut beneplacitis inhaerendo cuncta quae bona sunt mereamur accipere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you graciously enlighten your family, so that by adhering to your pleasures we may deserve to receive all good things.

text: Deus qui conspicis omni nos virtute destitui interius exteriusque custodi ut ab omnibus adversitatibus muniamur in corpore et a pravis cogitationibus mundemur in mente.
translation_en: God, who sees us supported by all virtue within and without, protect us so that we may be fortified against all adversities in body, and purified from evil thoughts in mind.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut quos tuis reficis sacramentis tibi etiam placitis moribus dignanter tribuas deservire.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that you who strengthen us with your sacred mysteries, also grant us worthy to serve you with pleasing manners.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut familia tua quae se affligendo carnem ab alimentis abstinet sectando iustitiam a culpa ieiunet.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that your family who afflicts the flesh by abstaining from food, may be cleansed from guilt by following justice while fasting.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine placationis et laudis quae offerimus tua nos propitiatione dignos efficiat.
translation_en: This offering, we ask you, Lord, may it be pleasing and worthy of praise. May it make us worthy of your propitiation.

text: Adesto supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus et quibus fiduciam sperandae salutis indulges consuetae misericordiae tribue benignus effectum.
translation_en: Omnipotent God, be present to our supplications and grant us your favor as you bestow it upon those who trust in the hope of salvation with your customary mercy.

text: Ut sacris Domine reddamur digni muneribus fac nos quaesumus tuis semper oboedire mandatis.
translation_en: Let us, Lord, be worthy of sacred duties; make us, we pray, always obey your commands.

text: Populum tuum quaesumus Domine propitius respice et quos ab escis carnalibus praecipis abstinere a noxiis quoque vitiis cessare concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, look upon Your people with favor and grant those whom You command to refrain from carnal sins also the strength to cease from other vices as well.

text: Deus innocentiae restitutor et amator dirige ad te tuorum corda fidelium ut spiritus tui fervore concepto et in fide inveniantur stabiles et in opere efficaces.
translation_en: God, restorer and lover of innocence, direct the hearts of your faithful to you, so that they may find a firm stand with the fervor of your spirit conceived within them, and be effective in their works.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine auxilium gratiae tuae ut ieiuniis et orationibus convenienter intenti liberemur ab hostibus mentis et corporis.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, your help, that we who are appropriately focused on our fasting and prayers may be freed from the enemies of mind and body.

text: Praesenti sacrificio nomini tuo quaesumus oblato nos Domine ieiunia votiva sanctificent ut quod observantia nostra profitetur exterius intus operetur effectu.
translation_en: Through this present sacrifice, we humbly ask that Your name be hallowed. May our vow-based fasting consecrate us, Lord, so that what our outward observance profits externally may internally operate with effect.

text: Gratia tua Domine quaesumus non derelinquat quae et sacrae nos deditos faciat servituti et tuam nobis opem semper acquirat.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your grace, Lord, not to forsake us whom You have consecrated. May it make us servants of the sacred, and may Your help always be attained by us.

text: Adesto Domine fidelibus tuis et perpetuam benignitatem largire poscentibus ut hi qui te auctore et gubernatore gloriantur et congregata restaures et restaurata conserves.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your faithful ones and grant them eternal kindness as they ask for it, so that those who glory in you as author and governor may be restored and preserved when gathered together.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacro nos purificante ieiunio sinceris mentibus ad sancta ventura facias pervenire.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that by the sacred cleansing of fasting, with sincere minds, may you lead us to approach the holy things that are about to come.

text: His sacrificiis Domine concede placatus ut qui propriis oramus absolvi delictis non gravemur aeternis.
translation_en: Lord, through these offerings grant us your favor that those who pray for themselves may be forgiven of their sins and not bear the burden of eternal ones.

text: Haec hostia Domine emundet nostra delicta et ad sacrificium celebrandum subditorum tibi corpora mentesque sanctificet.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, may purify our sins and sanctify the bodies and minds of your subjects for the celebration of sacrifice.

text: Cordibus nostris quaesumus Domine gratiam tuam benignus infunde ut sicut ab escis carnalibus abstinemus ita sensus quoque nostros a noxiis retrahamus excessibus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you pour your grace upon our hearts, so that just as we abstain from carnal desires, we may also restrain our senses from harmful excesses.

text: Exaudi nos quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus et continentiae salutaris propitius dona concede.
translation_en: Hear us, we implore you, O almighty and merciful God, and graciously grant us the salutary gift of continence.

text: Per haec veniat quaesumus Domine sacramenta nostrae redemptionis effectus qui nos ab humanis retrahat semper excessibus et ad salutaria cuncta perducat.
translation_en: Through these (sacraments), we humbly ask, Lord, that the effects of our redemption may come to us, drawing us away from the excessive nature of humanity and leading us to all things salvific.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus ut salutaribus ieiuniis eruditi a noxiis quoque vitiis abstinentes propitiationem tuam facilius impetremus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, that educated by salutary fasting, abstaining also from deadly sins, we may more easily obtain your forgiveness.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine preces populi tui cum oblationibus hostiarum et tua mysteria celebrantes ab omnibus nos defende periculis.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the prayers of your people along with the offerings of sacrifices, and protect us from all dangers as we celebrate your mysteries.

text: Sanctificet nos quaesumus Domine qua pasti sumus mensa caelestis et a cunctis erroribus expiatos supernis promissionibus reddat acceptos.
translation_en: Sanctify us, we beseech Thee, Lord, whom Thou hast fed at the banquet of heaven, and make us accepted by all divine promises and cleanse us from all errors.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine ad sancta mysteria purificatis mentibus accedere ut tibi semper competens deferamus obsequium.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, to approach the holy mysteries with minds purified, so that we may always render fitting reverence to you.

text: Subiectum tibi populum quaesumus Domine propitiatio caelestis amplificet et tuis semper faciat inhaerere mandatis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the people subject to you may be enlarged by heavenly mercy and always adhere to your commandments.

text: Ieiunia nostra quaesumus Domine benigno favore prosequere ut sicut ab alimentis abstinemus in corpore ita quoque a vitiis ieiunemus in mente.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, may Your gracious favor follow our fast, so that just as we abstain from food in body, we also fast from vices in mind.

text: Respice Domine propitius ad universa quae sacramus ut et tibi grata sint et nobis salutaria semper exsistant.
translation_en: Look upon us, O Lord, with favor as we offer all that is sacred. May they be pleasing to you, and may these gifts always benefit us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui in tua protectione confidimus cuncta nobis adversantia te adiuvante vincamus.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that we who trust in your protection may overcome all adversities with your help.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut observationes sacras annua devotione recolentes et corpore tibi placeamus et mente.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you almighty God, that remembering the sacred observances annually with devotion, our bodies may please you and our minds.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus mundet nostra delicta et ad sacrificium celebrandum subditorum tibi corpora mentesque sanctificet.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we ask that it purify our sins and sanctify for the sacrifice to be celebrated, the bodies and minds of your subjects.

text: Deus qui et iustis praemia meritorum et peccatoribus per ieiunium veniam praebes miserere supplicibus tuis ut reatus nostri confessio indulgentiam valeat percipere delictorum.
translation_en: God who for the just grants rewards for good works and provides forgiveness for sinners through fasting, have mercy on your suppliants, that the confession of our sins may obtain the pardon of offenses through indulgence.

text: Supplices te rogamus Domine ut his sacrificiis peccata nostra mundentur quia tunc veram nobis tribuis et mentis et corporis sanitatem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our sins may be purified by these sacrifices, for then you grant us both physical and mental health.

text: Sancta tua Domine quaesumus et vivificando nos renovent et renovando vivificent.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your sanctity may renew us and by renewing us, may bring us to life.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine participatio sacramenti et a propriis reatibus clementer expediat et ab omnibus tueatur adversis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that this participation in the sacrament may kindly deliver us from our own sins and protect us from all dangers.

text: Tua nos Domine quaesumus sancta purificent sacramenta et cooperatione sua tibi faciant esse devotos.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your holy purification may cleanse our sacraments and with their help make us devoted to you.

text: Deus qui sperantibus in te misereri potius eligis quam irasci da nobis digne flere mala quae fecimus ut tuae consolationis gratiam invenire valeamus.
translation_en: God, who chooses to show mercy to those who hope in you rather than to be angry, grant us worthily to weep for the evil that we have done, so that we may find the grace of your consolation.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvant et tuae nobis misericordiae dona concilient.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us these gifts and to release us from our bonds of sin, and to bestow upon us your mercy.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris ut quos tuis mysteriis recreasti perpetuis defende subsidiis.
translation_en: Attend to our supplications, Lord, so that you who have restored us through your sacred mysteries may defend us with perpetual aids.

text: Concede nobis Domine Deus noster ut haec hostia salutaris et nostrorum fiat purgatio peccatorum et tuae propitiatio maiestatis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord our God, that this saving sacrifice may become a purification for our sins and a propitiation for your majesty.

text: Sacramenti tui Domine quaesumus participatio salutaris et purificationem nobis tribuat et medelam.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, for your Sacrament's participation. May it grant us a saving partaking and healing.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine perseverantem in tua voluntate famulatum ut in diebus nostris et merito et numero populus tibi serviens augeatur.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, Lord, a servant persisting in Your will, that during our days, both in number and deservingly, the people serving You may be increased.

text: Domine Deus noster qui in his potius creaturis quas ad fragilitatis nostrae subsidium condidisti tuo quoque nomini munera iussisti et dicanda constituisti tribue quaesumus ut vitae nobis praesentis auxilium et aeternitatis efficiant sacramentum.
translation_en: Lord God, our Creator, who in these creatures that you established for our support, you have also commanded offerings to be given and established them to be spoken. We humbly ask you to grant us, that the sacrament of present life and eternal life may be made effective for us.

text: Esto Domine quaesumus propitius plebi tuae ut quae tibi non placent respuens tuorum potius repleatur delectationibus mandatorum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you be merciful to your people, and that those things which do not please you may instead be filled with the delight of your commandments.

text: Cordibus nostris quaesumus Domine gratiam tuam benignus infunde ut peccata nostra castigatione voluntaria cohibentes temporaliter potius maceremur quam suppliciis deputemur aeternis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you pour your grace upon our hearts, so that being mindful of our sins, we may endure temporal penance rather than be subjected to eternal punishments.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens et misericors Deus ut digne semper tuis servire altaribus mereamur et eorum perpetua participatione salvari.
translation_en: Graciously bestow upon us, Almighty and merciful God, that we may always deserve to serve Your altars worthily, and save ourselves through their perpetual participation.

text: Sumpti nos sacrificii Domine perpetua tuitio non derelinquat et noxia semper a nobis cuncta depellat.
translation_en: May the Lord who offers us the sacrifice not forsake us with perpetual protection, and may every harm be always driven away from us.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine plebs tibi dicata piae petitionis affectu ut sacris actionibus erudita quanto maiestati tuae sit gratior tanto donis potioribus augeatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your devoted people, with a pious affection for You, may be proficient in sacred actions. May they become more pleasing to Your majesty and grow more valuable by receiving more generous gifts.

text: A cunctis nos quaesumus Domine reatibus et periculis propitiatus absolve quos tanti mysterii tribuis esse participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that you, being propitious, absolve us from sins and dangers. Those whom you deem worthy to participate in such a great mystery.

text: Divini muneris largitate satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut huius semper participatione vivamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that we may always live through the grace of your divine bounty which satisfies us.

text: Tueatur quaesumus Domine dextera tua populum tuum deprecantem et purificatum dignanter erudiat ut consolatione praesenti ad futura bona proficiat.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, may Your right hand protect Your people who are supplicating and worthily educate those purified, so that they may progress with the present consolation towards future goods.

text: Visita quaesumus Domine plebem tuam et sacris dedicata corda mysteriis pietate tuere pervigili ut remedia salutis aeternae quae te inspirante suscepit te protegente custodiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to visit your people and protect hearts dedicated to the sacred mysteries through constant vigilance. May they keep the remedies of eternal salvation, which you inspire and protect.

text: Adiuva Domine fragilitatem plebis tuae ut ad votivum magnae festivitatis officium intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria et corporaliter gubernata recurrat et ad perpetuam gloriam devota mente perveniat.
translation_en: Help, Lord, the frailty of your people, that they may return to the promised duty of the great festival, through the intercession of the blessed Mother of God and guided corporally, may they reach with devoted mind the eternal glory.

text: Deus qui hodierna die ad insinuandum humilitatis exemplum super asinam sedere et a turbis rex appellari voluisti respice ad devotam populi tui humilitatem ut quicumque palmis et ceteris frondibus laudi tuae dedicatis in memoriam huius venerandae festivitatis devotus occurrerit tibi iudici venienti cum palma victoriae et fructu bonorum operum securus occurra.
translation_en: God who today wished to sit upon an ass and be called king as an example of humility, look upon the devoted humility of your people. So that whoever dedicates palms and other branches in praise of you for this venerable feast day, may appear before you, the coming judge, with a palm of victory and securely with the fruit of good works.

text: Exorcizo te creatura florum et frondium in nomine Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii Dei omnis virtus inimici omnisque incursio daemonum eradicare et explantare ab hac creatura Dei et ut hanc gerentes et ad gratiam Dei festinantes non inquietare non illudere praesumas interdico tibi.
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of flowers and leaves, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God. I command all the power of the enemy and every incursion of demons to be eradicated and expelled from this creation of God. I forbid you, while they are carrying it and hastening towards the grace of God, not to disturb nor mock them.

text: Benedic Domine quaesumus hos palmarum et arborum ramos et praesta ut quod populus tuus pia veneratione hodierna die corporaliter agit hoc spiritaliter suprema devotione perficiat de hoste victoriam reportando et opus misericordiae summopere diligendo humiliter etiam deprecamur ut praedictarum arborum germina ita sanctificare digneris ut loca ad quae portata fuerint sanctificata efficiantur quo iniquitas omnis seu illusio daemonum abscedat et tua nos semper dextera protegere dignetur.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, we ask you, these branches of palms and trees, and grant that what your people today reverently do corporally with these things spiritually and supreme devotion may perform victories against the enemy. We humbly pray that you may especially love the seeds of the aforementioned trees so that they are worthy to be sanctified, so that the places to which they are brought may be sanctified, whereby all iniquity or deception of demons may depart, and that your eternal right hand may always protect us.

text: Deus cuius Filius pro salute humani generis descendit de caelis ad terras et appropinquante passionis suae hora Hierosolymam in asino venire et a turbis rex appellari ac laudari voluit benedicere dignare hos palmarum ceterarumque frondium ramos ut omnes qui eos laturi sunt ita benedictionis tuae dono repleantur ut hic et in futuro cum palma victoriae et fructu bonorum operum valeant apparere.
translation_en: God, whose Son descended from heaven for the salvation of the human race and approached the hour of His passion in Jerusalem, desiring to come riding on an ass and to be called king by the crowd and praised, deigns to bless these branches of palm and other leaves. May all who are about to receive them be filled with Your blessing, so that here and in the future they may appear with a palm of victory and the fruit of good works.

text: Deus qui per olivae ramum pacem terris columbam nuntiare iussisti praesta quaesumus ut hos palmarum vel aliarum arborum ramos tua caelesti benedictione sanctifices ut cuncto populo proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: God who by the olive branch did command a dove to announce peace on earth, grant us your prayer, that you may sanctify these palms or other trees' branches with your heavenly blessing, so that all people may progress towards salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum hodierna die super pullum asinae sedere fecisti et populorum turbas vestimenta vel ramos arborum in via sternere et hosanna decantare in laudem ipsius docuisti da quaesumus ut illorum innocentiam imitari possimus et eorum meritum consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who today made our Lord Jesus Christ sit on the ass's colt and taught the crowds to spread their garments or branches of trees in the way and to sing hosanna in his praise, grant us that we may imitate their innocence and merit to deserve their reward.

text: Deus qui Filium tuum Unigenitum pro redemptione nostra dignatus es mittere in mundum ut populum tuum ab initio in profundum peccati dimersum a morte revocares ad vitam et chirographo letali deleto sanguine Filii tui regnum gentibus invocares Deus qui dispersa congregas et congregata conservas qui populis obviam Christo ramos palmarum portantibus benedixisti benedic etiam et hos ramos palmae et arborum quos famuli tui ad nominis tui benedictionem fideliter suscipiunt ut in quocumque loco introducti fuerint benedictionem tuam consequantur ut omni adversa valetudine effugata dextera tua protegat quos redemit.
translation_en: God, who saw fit to send your only-begotten Son into the world for our redemption, to recall your people from the depth of original sin stained by death and bring them to life. You who wrote off the deadly debt with the blood of your Son, call forth a kingdom for the nations. God, who gathers together that which is scattered and preserves what is gathered, you blessed the branches of palm trees when they were presented to Christ, bless these branches of palms and trees as well. May your blessing follow them wherever your servants may carry them; may they experience your blessing wherever they are introduced so that they may avoid every adversity and ailment. May your protecting hand shield those whom you have redeemed.

text: Mundi conditor omniumque creaturarum dispensator mirabilis Deus qui inter ipsa mundi primordia cum ex nihilo cuncta condideras ligna quoque fructifera et diversa usui congrua terram producere iussisti ac post maledictum interdictae arboris universa nobis per oboedientiam Unigeniti Filii tui in benedictionem convertisti Benedic etiam hos multigenarum arborum ramos inter quas arbor olivae pinguedine cuncta praecellit Per quam etiam cum mundi crimina diluvio quondam expiarentur effuso columba ramum eiusdem deferens pacem terris redditam nuntiavit necnon et innocens turba Spiritu Sancto afflata Unigenito tuo Domino nostro Iesu Christo pro totius mundi salute passuro obviam currens palmarum et huius arboris ramos abscidens ac vestigiis eius substernens iam quasi triumphatorem devicto mortis principe ostendebat Te igitur Domine suppliciter deprecamur ut qui annua devotione eiusdem Redemptoris nostri sacratissimam passionem praevenire nitimur ipso adiuvante palmam victoriae tenentes atque oleo misericordiae intrinsecus refulgentes in eius sancta resurrectione praemium vitae et immortalitatis coronam accipere mereamur.
translation_en: Creator of the world and dispenser of all creatures, wonderful God, who among the first beginnings of the world, when you created everything from nothing, also commanded the fruit-bearing trees to produce various useful types of wood on the earth. After the curse upon the forbidden tree, you converted all things into blessing for us through the obedience of your Only-Begotten Son. Bless also these many-branched trees among which the olive tree excels in all things. By this olive tree, when the world's sins were once purged by the flood, a dove carrying a branch from it announced peace to the earth. Also, an innocent crowd, inspired by the Holy Spirit, ran to meet your Only-Begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, for the salvation of the whole world. They plucked branches from this tree and trampled its footprints, as if they were showing that the conqueror had triumphed over the prince of death. Therefore, Lord, we humbly beseech you that, with annual devotion to our Redeemer, we may merit to receive the crown of life and immortality in his holy resurrection, shining inside with oil of mercy while holding the palm of victory.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Christi Filii tui beata passione nos reparas conserva in nobis opera misericordiae tuae ut in huius celebritate mysterii devotione perpetua vivamus.
