translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who repairs us through the blessed passion of your Son, conserve in us the works of your mercy, that we may live forever in the celebration of this mystery with perpetual devotion.

text: Auge fidem in te sperantium Deus et supplicum preces clementer exaudi ut sicut in figura Ecclesiae multiplicasti Noe egredientem de arca et Moysen exeuntem de Aegypto cum filiis Israel ita et nos cum bonorum operum fructibus occurramus obviam Christo et per ipsum in gaudium introeamus aeternum.
translation_en: Increase faith in you, O God, for those who hope in you, and graciously hear the prayers of supplicants. May it be so that, just as you multiplied Noah coming out of the ark and Moses with the sons of Israel leaving Egypt, thus we too, with the fruits of good works, may approach Christ and enter eternal joy through him.

text: Deus qui miro ordine dispositionis ex rebus etiam insensibilibus dispensationem nostrae salutis ostendere voluisti da quaesumus ut devota tuorum corda fidelium salubriter intelligant quid mystice designetur in facto quod hodie caelesti lumine afflata Redemptori obviam procedens palmarum atque olivarum ramos vestigiis eius turba substravit Palmarum igitur rami de mortis principe triumphos exspectant surculi vero olivarum spiritualem unctionem advenisse clamant Intellexit enim iam tunc illa hominum multitudo beata praefigurari quia Redemptor noster rebus humanis condolens pro totius mundi vita cum mortis principe citius esset pugnaturus ac moriendo triumphaturus et ideo talia obsequens administravit quae in illo et triumphos victoriae et misericordiae pinguedinem declararent Quod nos quoque plena fide et factum et significatum retinentes te Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus. eundem Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum suppliciter exoramus ut in ipso atque per ipsum cuius nos membra fieri voluisti de mortis imperio victoriam reportantes ipsius gloriosae resurrectionis participes esse mereamur.
translation_en: God, who in a wondrous order of disposition showed us the dispensation of our salvation even from insensible things, we humbly ask that your faithful hearts may understand healthily what is mystically signified in the fact that today, being struck by heavenly light, the Redeemer proceeding with palms and olive branches, a crowd has strewed them before his feet. Therefore, the palm branches expect triumphs from the prince of death, while the olive sprigs proclaim the spiritual anointment to have arrived. Indeed, that blessed multitude of people understood then to be prefigured because our Redeemer, condescending to human affairs and quickly fighting against the prince of death and victoriously dying, administered such things which in him declared both the richness of victory and mercy. Therefore, Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, retaining faithfully both the deed and its meaning, we pray you earnestly that in him and through him, whom you willed us to become his members, we may be worthy to become participants in his glorious resurrection.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui humano generi ad imitandum humilitatis exemplum Salvatorem nostrum carnem sumere et crucem subire fecisti concede propitius ut et patientiae ipsius habere documenta et resurrectionis consortia mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who made our Savior take on human flesh and endure the cross for us to imitate humility, mercifully grant that we may deserve both the teachings of his patience and the fellowship of his resurrection.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine ut oculis tuae maiestatis munus oblatum et gratiam nobis devotionis obtineat et effectum beatae aeternitatis acquirat.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask, Lord, that the offering made before Your majesty's eyes may obtain grace for us in devotion and acquire the fruit of blessed eternity.

text: Haec sacrificia nos omnipotens Deus potenti virtute mundatos ad suum faciant puriores venire consortium.
translation_en: These sacrifices, almighty God, with powerful virtue cleanse us and bring us to approach your presence more pure.

text: Praebeant nobis Domine divinum tua sancta fervorem quo eorum pariter et actu delectemur et fructu.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, your divine and holy fervor, that we may be equally pleased with them (the words of the liturgy) and bear fruit from it.

text: Sacrificia nos quaesumus Domine ista propensius restaurent quae medicinalibus sunt instituta ieiuniis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may these sacrifices be more favorably restored, which have been established by the medicinal fasts.

text: Sanctificationibus tuis omnipotens Deus et vitia nostra curentur et remedia nobis sempiterna proveniant.
translation_en: With Your sanctifications, O Almighty God, may our vices be purged and everlasting remedies come to us.

text: Deus a quo et Iudas reatus sui poenam et confessionis suae latro praemium sumpsit concede nobis tuae propitiationis effectum ut sicut in passione sua Iesus Christus Dominus noster diversa utrisque intulit stipendia meritorum ita nobis ablato vetustatis errore resurrectionis suae gratiam largiatur.
translation_en: God, from whom Judas took the penalty for his guilt and the traitor received the reward for his confession, grant us the effect of your propitiation, so that just as in His Passion our Lord Jesus Christ distributed rewards for both sides, may He bestow upon us the grace of His resurrection after removing our error of old age.

text: Ipse tibi quaesumus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens Deus sacrificium nostrum reddat acceptum qui discipulis suis in sui commemorationem hoc fieri hodierna traditione monstravit Iesus Christus Dominus noster Qui tecum vivit
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, holy Father Almighty God, that our sacrifice may be accepted by you, who showed your disciples to do this in remembrance of you today through this present tradition. Jesus Christ, our Lord, who lives with you.

text: Deus cuius sacratissimam cenam veneramur ut ea digni inveniamur munda nos quaesumus a sordibus peccatorum qui ad insinuandum nobis humilitatis exemplum pedes tuorum hodie dignatus es lavare discipulorum.
translation_en: We come before the God whose most sacred supper we venerate, that we may be found worthy of it, we ask that you cleanse us from the stains of our sins. Today you have been gracious enough to wash the disciples' feet as an example of humility.

text: Adesto Domine nostrae servitutis officio et quia tu lavare dignatus es pedes discipulorum tuorum ne despicias opera manuum tuarum quae nobis retinenda mandasti ut sicut abluuntur exteriora pedum inquinamenta sic a te omnium nostrorum interiora laventur peccata. Qui cum Patre
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to our servitude's office, and since you have deigned to wash the feet of your disciples, let not the work of your hands be despised which you have commanded us to hold onto. So as the exterior dirt of the feet is washed away, let the inner stains of all our sins be cleansed by you. Who with the Father

text: Oremus et pro beatissimo papa nostro N ut Deus et Dominus noster qui elegit eum in ordinem episcopatus salvum atque incolumem custodiat Ecclesiae suae sanctae ad regendum populum sanctum Dei.
translation_en: Let us pray for our most blessed Pope N, that God and our Lord who chose him as bishop may keep him safe and sound for the Church's holy flock to govern.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cuius iudicio universa fundantur respice propitius ad preces nostras et electum nobis antistitem tua pietate conserva ut Christiana plebs quae tali gubernatur auctore sub tanto pontifice credulitatis suae meritis augeatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, whose judgment all things are founded upon, look propitiously on our prayers, and by your mercy preserve for us the chosen bishop whom you have graced. May the Christian people who are governed by him under such a pontiff grow in faith through his merits.

text: Oremus pro omnibus episcopis presbyteris diaconibus subdiaconibus acolythis exorcistis lectoribus ostiariis confessoribus virginibus viduis et pro omni populo sancto Dei.
translation_en: Let us pray for all bishops, priests, deacons, subdeacons, acolytes, exorcists, readers, doorkeepers, confessors, virgins, widows and for the whole holy people of God.

text: Oremus et pro Christianissimo rege nostro N. ut Deus et Dominus noster subditas illi faciat omnes barbaras nationes ad nostram perpetuam pacem.
translation_en: Let us pray for our most Christian King N., that God and our Lord may make all barbarous nations subject to him, for our everlasting peace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus in cuius manu sunt omnium potestates et omnia iura regnorum respice ad Christianum benignus imperium ut gentes quae in sua feritate confidunt potentiae tuae dextera comprimantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, in whose hand are all powers and all rights of the kingdoms, look kindly upon the Christian Empire, so that the nations which boastfully trust in your power may be restrained by your right hand.

text: Oremus et pro catechumenis nostris ut Deus et Dominus noster adaperiat aures praecordiorum ipsorum ianuamque misericordiae ut per lavacrum regenerationis accepta remissione omnium peccatorum et ut ipsi digni inveniantur in Christo Iesu Domino nostro.
translation_en: Let us pray for our catechumens, that our God and Lord may open the ears of their hearts, the door of mercy, so that through the washing of regeneration they may receive remission of all sins, and may be found worthy in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam nova semper prole fecundas auge fidem et intellectum catechumenis nostris ut renati fonte baptismatis adoptionis tuae filiis aggregentur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who always make your Church fruitful with a new progeny, increase the faith and understanding of our catechumens, so that they, being reborn at the font of baptism, may be joined to your adoption as your sons.

text: Oremus dilectissimi nobis Deum Patrem omnipotentem ut cunctis mundum purget erroribus morbos auferat famem depellat aperiat carceres vincula dissolvat peregrinantibus reditum infirmantibus sanitatem navigantibus portum salutis indulgeat.
translation_en: Let us pray, dearest to us God the Almighty Father, that He may purify the world of all errors, remove diseases, banish hunger, drive away prisons, dissolve chains, grant a return to the wandering, restore health to the infirm, and grant safe harbor to those sailing.

text: Oremus et pro haereticis et schismaticis ut Deus ac Dominus noster eruat eos ab erroribus universis et ad sanctam matrem Ecclesiam catholicam atque apostolicam revocare dignetur.
translation_en: Let us pray for heretics and schismatics, that God our Lord may free them from all errors and deign to call them back to the holy mother Church Catholic and Apostolic.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui salvas omnes et neminem vis perire respice ad animas diabolica fraude deceptas ut omni haeretica pravitate deposita errantium corda resipiscant et ad veritatis tuae redeant unitatem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who saves all and desires none to perish, look upon the souls deceived by the devil's fraud, so that, leaving behind every heretical wickedness, the erring hearts may repent and return to the unity of Your truth.

text: Oremus et pro perfidis Iudaeis ut Deus et Dominus noster auferat velamen de cordibus eorum ut et ipsi agnoscant Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Let us pray for the faithless Jews, that our God and Lord may remove the veil from their hearts, so that they too may recognize Jesus Christ as our Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui etiam Iudaicam perfidiam a tua misericordia non repellis exaudi preces nostras quas tibi pro illius populi obcaecatione deferimus ut agnita veritatis tuae luce quae Christus est a suis tenebris eruantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who even does not repel the treacherous Jewish unfaithfulness from your mercy, hear our prayers which we bring before you on account of their people's blindness, that they may be enlightened by your truth, which is Christ, and be freed from their own darkness.

text: Oremus et pro paganis ut Deus omnipotens auferat iniquitatem a cordibus eorum ut relictis idolis suis convertantur ad Deum vivum et verum unicum Filium eius Iesum Christum Deum et Dominum nostrum cum quo vivit et regnat cum Spiritu Sancto Deus.
translation_en: Let us pray for the pagans, that the Almighty God may remove wickedness from their hearts, so that abandoning their idols they may convert to the living and true God, and His only Son Jesus Christ, God and our Lord, with whom He lives and reigns with the Holy Spirit, God.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui non mortem peccatorum sed vitam semper requiris suscipe propitius orationem nostram et libera eos ab idolorum cultura et aggrega Ecclesiae tuae sanctae ad laudem et gloriam nominis tui.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who seeks not the death of sinners but their life, graciously receive our prayer and free them from the cult of idols. Gather them to your holy Church for the praise and glory of your name.

text: Domine Iesu Christe Deus verus de Deo vero qui pro redemptione generis humani serpentina suasione decepti mundum erroribus implicatum illuminare et crucis patibulum subire voluisti ut lignum ligno vinceres et peccati hereditariam mortem morte potentissima superares exaudi me miserum et indignum ante oculos tuae benignissimae maiestatis adorantem te et benedicentem nomen tuum sanctum atque terribile et concede mihi misero te puro corde sapere te laudare te praedicare et per vexillum sanctae crucis istius quam hodie in tuo nomine adoraturus adveni mentem meam corpusque sanctifica scuto fidei tuae me circumtege galeam salutis mihi impone gladio spirituali accinge ut contra hostem nequissimum bellaturus et tuae miserationis muniar auxilio et salutiferae crucis vexillo cunctique tuo sancto nomine insigniti ab hostis perfidi sint incursione securi.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, true God from the true God, who for the redemption of the human race, were deceived by a serpent's temptation and entangled the world in errors, chose to suffer on the cross made of wood to overcome sin with wood, and to conquer death's hereditary power with the most powerful death. Hear me, wretch and unworthy, before Your most benevolent majesty adoring You and blessing Your holy and terrible name. And grant me, wretch, a pure heart to understand, praise, and preach You. With this banner of the Holy Cross that I am about to venerate in Your name today, purify my mind and body. Encase me with the shield of Your faith, surround me with the helmet of salvation, arm me with a spiritual sword, equip me with armor, so that fighting against the most wicked enemy, I may be armed with Your mercy's aid and under the banner of the saving Cross, and under all Your holy names, I may be secure from the attack of the treacherous enemy.

text: Deus qui Moysi famulo tuo in via squalentis eremi serpentem aeneum in media populi multitudine ad liberandas letali veneno infectas animas exaltari iussisti ut si quis mortifero vulnere inflictus ad eum respiceret et venenum exitiale evaderet et optatae salutis vitam adipisceretur significans te ipsum futurum post curricula pro tui salute plasmatis crucis extollendum patibulo ut quos diabolus armis invidiae captivaverat tua desiderabilis passio ad patriam revocaret concede mihi misero et peccatori et omnibus tuo cruore mercatis qui hodie sanctam passionem supplices venerantur lignumque vitae adorant ut diaboli insidias te adiuvante vincamus et aeternae vitae participes esse mereamur.
translation_en: God, who commanded Moses Your servant to lift up the bronze serpent in the midst of the multitude of people afflicted with deadly venom, so that whoever was struck by mortal wounds and looked upon it would escape the deadly venom and acquire the desired life of salvation, signifying You Himself to be exalted on the cross after the course of Your suffering for our sake. Grant me, a wretched sinner, and all who are bought with Your precious blood who today humbly come to adore the wood of life, that we may overcome the devil's snares with Your help, and merit to become participants in eternal life.

text: Domine Iesu Christe qui nos per crucis passionem hodierna die a diabolica servitute liberasti ut quo die hominem condideras eodem die et reformares exaudi me miserum et peccatorem coram hoc signaculo crucis confitentem et deprecantem ut huius venerabilis et vitalis ligni tuitione munitus et hostis nequissimi ignea tela repellere et ab inflictis evacuari vulneribus et ad vitam aeternam valeam pervenire.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, who today freed us from the servitude of the devil through your Passion on the cross, hear my wretched and sinful plea before this sign of the cross that I confess and beseech you. May I be protected and armed by the power of this venerable and vital wood, and may I repel the fiery darts of the wicked enemy and be freed from wounds inflicted, so that I may attain eternal life.

text: Domine Sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus in nomine tuo et Filii tui benedicimus hunc ignem cum cera et omnibus alimoniis eius sanctificamus et signo crucis Christi Filii tui vivi altissimi signamus ut intus vel foris accensus quod nocet non incendat sed omnia ad usus hominum necessaria calescat sive illuminet et quae ex hoc igne fuerint conflata vel calefacta sint benedicta et omni humanae saluti utilia ut non cum Dathan et Abiron ignem tibi offerentibus alienum incendamur sed cum Aaron pontifice et filiis eius Eleazaro et Ithamaro hostias tibi pacificas Spiritus Sancti igne assatas immolare valeamus et semper eiusdem Spiritus Sancti igne vitia nostra ure cordaque luce scientiae tuae illumina et animas nostras calore fidei clarifica.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, in your name and that of your Son, we bless this fire with wax and all its provisions, and we sanctify it with the sign of the cross of your living Son. We mark it so that within or without it may be kindled, and whatever harms not but serves the needs of mankind, either heats or lights. And whatever is made from this fire, or heated by it, let it be blessed, and all things useful for human salvation. Let us not be consumed like Dathan and Abiram offering you a strange fire, but rather like Aaron the priest and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, may we offer to you peaceful hosts kindled by the Holy Spirit's flame. May the same Holy Spirit's flame illuminate our hearts with the light of your knowledge, and may our souls be clarified by its heat of faith.

text: Omnipotens Deus mundi conditor luminis siderumque fabricator per cuius ineffabilem potentiam omnis claritas sumpsit exordium te in tuis operibus invocamus aperi nobis quaesumus labia nostra ad confitendum nomini tuo et ad laudem gloriae tuae ut digne celebrare mereamur sacrum officium tuum quia in hac sacratissima noctis vigilia de donis tuis cereum tuae suppliciter offerimus maiestati.
translation_en: Almighty God, Creator of the world and fabricator of stars, through whose ineffable power all brightness began, we invoke you. We humbly ask that you open our lips to confess your name and praise your glory. May we be worthy to celebrate your sacred office fittingly on this most holy night, as we fervently offer the wax of our supplications to your majesty for your gifts.

text: Deus qui per Filium tuum angularem scilicet lapidem caritatis ignem fidelibus contulisti productum ex silice nostris profuturum usibus novum hunc ignem sanctifica et concede nobis ita per haec festa paschalia caelestibus desideriis inflammari ut ad perpetua festa purgatis mentibus pertingere valeamus.
translation_en: God, who through Your Son, the cornerstone, that is, the burning coal of love, have given to faithful people to be poured out for our use from our flint, sanctify this new fire and grant us so, through these Paschal festivals, to be inflamed with celestial desires, that we may be able to reach the perpetual feasts with purified minds.

text: Domine Deus noster Pater omnipotens exaudi nos lumen indeficiens tu sancte conditor omnium luminum benedic quaesumus hoc lumen quod a te sanctificatum atque benedictum est qui illuminas omnem mundum ut ab eo lumine incendamur et illuminemur scilicet igne caritatis tuae quo Moysen illuminasti et hoc lumen tribue cordibus nostris ut ad vitam aeternam pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: Lord God our Father Almighty, hear us, unfailing Light that you are, holy Creator of all lights. We ask that you bless this light which is sanctified and blessed by you, through which you illuminate the entire world. May we be kindled and enlightened by it, indeed with the fire of your love which you shone upon Moses; and may this light be granted to our hearts, so that we may deserve eternal life.

text: Exsultet iam angelica turba caelorum Exsultent divina mysteria et pro tanti regis victoria tuba intonet salutaris. Gaudeat se tellus tantis irradiatam fulgoribus et aeterni regis splendore illustrata totius orbis se sentiat amisisse caliginem Laetetur et mater Ecclesia tanti luminis adornata fulgoribus et magnis populorum vocibus haec aula resultet. Quapropter astantibus vobis fratres carissimi ad tam miram sancti huius luminis claritatem una mecum quaeso Dei omnipotentis misericordiam invocate ut qui me non meis meritis intra Levitarum numerum dignatus est aggregare luminis sui gratiam infundendo cerei huius laudem implere praecipiat Iesus Christus Dominus noster qui cum Patre vivit et regnat Deus in unitate Spiritus Sancti Per omnia saecula saeculorum Amen. Dominus vobiscum. Et cum spiritu tuo. Sursum corda. Habemus ad Dominum. Gratias agamus Domino Deo nostro. Dignum et iustum est. Vere quia dignum et iustum est Invisibilem Deum Patrem omnipotentem Filiumque eius Unigenitum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum toto cordis ac mentis affectu et vocis ministerio personare. Qui pro nobis aeterno Patri Adae debitum solvit et veteris piaculi cautionem pio cruore detersit. Haec sunt enim festa paschalia in quibus verus ille Agnus occiditur eiusque sanguine postes consecrantur. Haec nox est in qua primum patres nostros filios Israel eduxisti de Aegypto quos postea Rubrum Mare sicco vestigio transire fecisti. Haec igitur nox est quae peccatorum tenebras columnae illuminatione purgavit. Haec nox est quae hodie per universum mundum in Christo credentes a vitiis saeculi et caligine peccatorum segregatos reddit gratiae sociatque sanctitati. Haec nox est in qua destructis vinculis mortis Christus ab inferis victor ascendit. Nihil enim nobis nasci profuit nisi redimi profuisset. O mira circa nos tuae pietatis dignatio. O inaestimabilis dilectio caritatis ut servum redimeres Filium tradidisti. O vere beata nox quae sola meruit scire tempus et horam in qua Christus ab inferis resurrexit. Haec nox est de qua scriptum est. Et nox ut dies illuminabitur et nox illuminatio mea in deliciis meis. Huius igitur sanctificatio noctis fugat scelera culpas lavat et reddit innocentiam lapsis et maestis laetitiam. Fugat odia concordiam parat et curvat imperia. Hic pone tus in cereum in modum crucis. Tunc sequitur In huius igitur noctis gaudia suscipe sancte Pater incensi huius sacrificium vespertinum quod tibi in hac cerei oblatione sollemni per ministrorum manus de operibus apum sacrosancta reddit Ecclesia. Sed iam columnae huius praeconia novimus quam in honorem Dei rutilans ignis accendit Hic incendatur cereus et tunc sequitur. Qui licet divisus in partes mutuati luminis detrimenta non novit. Alitur enim liquentibus ceris quas in substantiam pretiosae huius lampadis apis mater eduxit. O vere beata nox quae exspoliavit Aegyptios ditavit Hebraeos. Nox in qua terrenis caelestia iunguntur Oramus ergo te Domine ut cereus iste in honorem nominis tui consecratus ad noctis huius caliginem destruendam indeficiens perseveret In odorem suavitatis acceptus supernis luminaribus misceatur Flammas eius lucifer matutinus inveniat Ille inquam lucifer qui nescit occasum Ille qui regressus ab inferis humano generi serenus illuxit Precamur ergo te Domine ut nos famulos tuos omnemque clerum et devotissimum populum una cum papa nostro N et gloriosissimo rege nostro N eiusque nobilissima prole N et antistite nostro G cum omni familia quiete temporum concessa in his paschalibus gaudiis conservare digneris.
translation_en:
Rejoice now, the angelic host of heaven;
Let divine mysteries rejoice and let the trumpet sound for the victory of such a great king.
Let the earth rejoice, filled with brilliant rays, and let the whole world feel that it has lost its darkness, illuminated by the splendor of the eternal King.
Let the Church rejoice, adorned with bright rays, and let this hall resound with great voices of the people.
Therefore, in your presence, dear brothers, I ask God almighty's mercy that He, who deemed me worthy to be numbered among the Levites, pours out His grace upon this candle, that Jesus Christ, our Lord, may command it to complete the praise due to Him.
God, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, forever and ever. Amen. The Lord be with you. And with your spirit. Lift up your hearts. We have a God. Let us give thanks to the Lord our God. It is truly fitting and just. Indeed, it is truly fitting and just that we should acknowledge the invisible Father almighty, His only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, with all our hearts' affection, minds' thoughts, and voices' service.
Who for us paid the eternal debt to the Father, and wiped away the warning of the old sin with His precious blood. These are the Paschal feasts in which the true Lamb is slain, and the doorposts are consecrated with its blood. This is the night that led our ancestors out of Egypt, and afterwards made them pass through the Red Sea on a dry path. This is the night that purged the darkness of sin with the illumination of the columns. This is the night that today separates believers in Christ from the vices of the world and the gloom of sin. This is the night in which, destroying the bonds of death, Christ arose victorious from the grave. For nothing has been born for us that has not been redeemed. O wondrous kindness of Your pity towards us! O boundless love of charity that You ransomed a servant, and gave Your only Son! O truly blessed night which alone knew the time and hour when Christ rose from the dead. This is the night about which it was written: "And the night shall be as bright as the day; night shall be my light." In this holy night's purification, sins are driven away, faults washed clean, and innocence restored to the penitent and the sorrowful. Hatred gives way to harmony, and empires bow. Here place the taper in the shape of a cross. Then follows: "In this night's joy, accept, holy Father, this evening's incense, which the Church, in this solemn offering of the candle, returns to You from the labor of bees, the mother of this precious lamp."
We already know the preaching of this column, how the shining fire burns in honor of God. Here the taper is burned and then follows: "Although divided into parts, it does not suffer loss of its light; for it is fed by liquefied candles, which the bee mother draws out from its substance." O truly blessed night that stripped the Egyptians and enriched the Hebrews. The night in which earthly things are united with heavenly ones. We pray to You, Lord, that this candle, consecrated in Your honor, may persevere unfailing for destroying the darkness of this night. Accepted as a sweet scent, it may be mixed with the higher lights. May the morning light find it; that is to say, the morning star that knows no setting. That is to say, the morning star which, returning from hell, shone serenely upon the human race. We pray to You, Lord, that You may preserve us Your servants and all the clergy, the devout people, our pope N, the glorious king N and his noble progeny N, our bishop G with his entire family, in peace during these Paschal rejoicings.

text: Deus qui divitias misericordiae tuae in hac praecipue nocte largiris propitiare universo ordini sacerdotalis officii et omnes gradus famulatus nostri perfecta delictorum remissione sanctifica ut ministraturos regeneratrici gratiae tuae nulli esse obnoxios patiaris offensae.
translation_en: God, who in this particular night bestows your riches of mercy, grant propitiation to the entire order of the priesthood and all degrees of our service, that they may be sanctified with the perfect remission of sins. May you allow them to minister without being subject to offense, through the regenerating grace of your mercy.

text: Deus cuius antiqua miracula in praesenti quoque saeculo coruscare sentimus praesta quaesumus ut sicut priorem populum ab Aegyptiis liberasti hoc ad salutem gentium per aquas baptismatis opereris.
translation_en: We ask you, God, whose ancient miracles we still feel resonating in this very age, to grant that just as you once freed the earlier people from Egypt, so too may you operate through the waters of baptism for the salvation of these nations.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam semper gentium vocatione multiplicas concede propitius ut quos aqua baptismatis abluis continua protectione tuearis.
translation_en: God who always multiply your Church through the calling of nations, graciously grant that those whom you cleanse with the water of baptism, you may continually protect with your constant care.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus respice propitius ad devotionem populi renascentis quae sicut cervus aquarum expetit ‹ad› fontem concede propitius ut fidei ipsius sitis baptismatis mysterio animam corpusque sanctificet.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, look upon us graciously as you would a reborn people who, like the deer longing for water, seek you. Grant us gracefully to reach that spring. May it be through the mystery of baptism that the thirst of their faith sanctify their soul and body.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus adesto magnae pietatis tuae mysteriis adesto sacramentis et ad creandos novos populos quos tibi fons baptismatis parturit spiritum adoptionis emitte ut quod humilitatis nostrae gerendum est mysterio tuae virtutis compleatur effectu.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, be present at the great acts of your pity, be present at the sacraments and create new people whom the font of baptism has brought forth the spirit of adoption. Send down upon us the effect of your virtue to complete what our humility is to carry out.

text: Qui invisibili potentia sacramentorum tuorum mirabiliter operaris effectum et licet nos tantis mysteriis exsequendis simus indigni tu tamen gratiae tuae dona non deserens etiam ad preces nostras aures tuae pietatis inclinas Deus cuius Spiritus super aquas inter ipsa mundi primordia ferebatur ut iam tunc virtutem sanctificationis aquarum natura conciperet Deus qui nocentis mundi crimina per aquas abluens regenerationis speciem in ipsa diluvii effusione signasti ut unius eiusdemque elementi mysterio et finis esset vitiis et origo virtutibus Respice Domine in faciem Ecclesiae tuae et multiplica in ea regenerationes tuas qui gratiae tuae affluentis impetu laetificas civitatem tuam fontemque baptismatis aperis toto orbe terrarum gentibus invocandis ut tuae maiestatis imperio sumat Unigeniti tui gratiam de Spiritu Sancto Hic aquam manu tangat in modum crucis. Qui hanc aquam regenerandis hominibus praeparatam arcana sui luminis admixtione fecundet ut sanctificatione concepta ab immaculato divini fontis utero in novam renatam creaturam progenies caelestis emergat Et quos aut sexus in corpore aut aetas discernit in tempore omnes in unam pariat gratiam mater infantiam Procul ergo hinc iubente te Domine omnis spiritus immundus abscedat Procul ergo tota nequitia diabolicae fraudis absistat Nihil hic loci habeat contrariae virtutis admixtio non insidiando circumvolet non latendo subripiat non infitiendo corrumpat Iterum manu tangat aquam in modum crucis. Sit haec sancta et innocens creatura libera ab omni impugnatoris incursu et [70v] totius nequitiae purgata discessu Sitfons vivus aquaregenerans undapurificans Ut omnes hoc lavacro salutifero diluendi operante in eis Spiritu Sancto perfectae purgationis indulgentiam consequantur Unde benedico te creatura aquae perDeum vivum perDeum sanctum per Deum qui te in principio verbo separavit ab arida cuius Spiritus super te ferebatur qui te de paradiso manare praecepit Hic eiciat aquam in modum crucis.et in quattuor fluminibus totam terram rigare praecepit Qui te in deserto aquam amaram suavitate inclita fecit esse potabilem et sitienti populo de petra produxit Benedico te per Iesum Christum Filium eius unicum Dominum nostrum qui te in Cana Galilaeae signo admirabili sua potentia convertit in vinum Qui pedibus super te ambulavit et a Ioanne in Iordane in te baptizatus est Qui te unacum sanguine suo de latere produxit et discipulis suis iussit ut credentes in te baptizarentur dicens Ite docete omnes gentes baptizantes eos in nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti Hic muta vocem quasi legens lectionem. Haec nobis praecepta servantibus tu Deus omnipotens clemens adesto tu benignus aspira Hic suffla in aquam ter in hunc modum videlicet crucis. tu has simplices aquas tuo ore Hic iterum suffla in modum crucis. benedicito ut praeter naturalem emundationem quam lavandis possunt adhibere corporibus sint etiam purificatis mentibus efficaces Hic pone cereum ardentem in aquam dicendo ter (notandum) Descendat in hanc plenitudinem fontis virtus Spiritus Sancti Hic iterum insuffla super fontem tribus vicibus in modum crucis. et totam huius aquae substantiam regenerandi fecundet effectu Hic sume cereum extra aquam et dic Hic omnium peccatorum maculae deleantur hic natura ad imaginem tuam condita et ad honorem sui reformata principii cunctis vetustatis squaloribus emundetur ut omnis homo hoc sacramentum regenerationis ingressus in verae innocentiae novam infantiam renascatur Per Dominum In unitate eiusdem Spiritus Sancti Hic mittatur chrisma a sacerdote in fontem in modum crucis. In nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti Paracliti sanctificetur et fecundetur de hoc oleo salutifero et chrismate fons iste ad abluenda crimina et ad regenerandas animas in vitam aeternam.
translation_en:
Who miraculously operates the effects of Your invisible power in the sacraments, even though we are unworthy to execute such great mysteries, You do not forsake Your grace even for our prayers. God, whose Spirit was borne over the waters among the world's primordial elements, so that the power of sanctification of the waters might conceive its nature from God Himself, who washed away the sins of the world through the waters in the flood and signified the regeneration in the same deluge. Look upon Your Church, Lord, and multiply Your regenerations within it, which bring joy to Your city, and open the source of baptism throughout the whole earth for the peoples summoned. May this water be touched by the hand in the manner of a cross. Who prepares this water for the rebirth of men with the mixture of His secret light, may it conceive sanctification and bring forth from the immaculate womb of the divine source a new-born creature, clothed in celestial progeny. May He who distinguishes by sex or age in time unite one and the same grace for all.
Therefore, let every impure spirit depart from here, Lord, as well as all diabolical wickedness. Let nothing contrary to this power's virtue approach, nor hide to steal, nor falsify to corrupt. May He touch the water again in the manner of a cross.
May this holy and innocent creation be free from any attack of an enemy and purged entirely of all wickedness. May it be a living fountain, purifying water, so that all who are washed by this cleansing laundry may obtain the indulgence of perfect purification through the Holy Spirit. I bless you, creation of water, in the name of God the Living, in the name of God the Holy, in the name of God who separated You from the dry at the beginning, whose Spirit was borne over You, who commanded You to flow from paradise, and who made You drinkable for a thirsty people from a rock.
I bless you through Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord, who changed water into wine with an admirable power in Cana of Galilee, who walked upon You and was baptized by John in the Jordan, who produced blood and water from Your side and commanded His disciples to baptize believers in Your name, saying: "Go and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit." I read as if reading a lesson. These commandments we serve, God Almighty, mercifully be present, kindly inspire. I breathe upon this water three times in the manner of a cross. May Your simple waters receive Your breath. I breathe upon it again in the manner of a cross, and may all the substance of this water be regenerated with effect.
Take a burning candle out of the water and say: "May all the stains of sin be washed away here." May nature, created in Your image and for Your honor, be cleansed of all the dirtiness of ages, so that every man who enters this sacrament of regeneration may be reborn in true innocence to a new infant state.
May the chrism sent from the priest into the font in the manner of a cross be sanctified and rendered fruitful through this healing oil and chrism. May this fountain cleanse sins and regenerate souls for eternal life.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine et plebis tuae et tuorum hostias renatorum ut in confessione tui nominis coadunati et baptismate renovati sempiternam beatitudinem consequantur.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech Thee, O Lord, and Thy people and their offerings of the newly born, that being united in Thy name's confession and renewed by baptism, they may attain everlasting beatitude.

text: Te quidem Domine omni tempore sed in hac potissimum nocte
translation_en: You indeed, Lord, at all times but especially tonight

text: Deus qui humanae substantiae dignitatem mirabiliter condidisti et mirabilius reformasti da nobis quaesumus per huius vini et aquae mysterium eius divinitatis esse consortes qui humanitatis nostrae fieri dignatus [est] particeps.
translation_en: God who wonderfully created and most wonderfully restored the dignity of the human substance, grant us, we ask, through the mystery of this wine and water, to be consorts of his divinity, who deigned to become a participant in our humanity.

text: Ex latere Domini nostri Iesu Christi sanguis et aqua exisse perhibetur ideo utrumque miscetur ut Dominus utrumque dignetur benedicere et in odorem suavitatis accipere.
translation_en: It is said that from the side of our Lord Jesus Christ, both blood and water have come forth. Therefore, both are mixed together so that the Lord may deign to bless both, and receive them into a pleasing aroma.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine hanc oblationem ut nobis Unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi corpus et sanguis fiat
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify this offering, so that for us the body and blood of your Only-Begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, may become a reality.

text: Suscipe sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus hanc immaculatam hostiam quam ego indignus famulus tuus offero tibi Deo meo vivo et vero pro innumerabilibus peccatis et offensis et negligentiis meis et pro omnibus circumstantibus sed et pro omnibus Christianis vivis atque defunctis ut mihi et illis proficiat ad salutem in vitam aeternam.
translation_en: Receive, holy Father almighty, eternal God, this immaculate offering which I, your unworthy servant, present to you, my living and true God, on account of innumerable sins, offenses, and negligences of mine, and on behalf of all those surrounding me, as well as for all Christians living and dead, that it may benefit me and them towards salvation for eternal life.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine calicem salutaris tuam deprecantes clementiam ut in conspectu divinae maiestatis tuae pro nostra et pro totius mundi salute cum odore suavitatis ascendat.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, your chalice of salvation, praying for Your mercy, that in the presence of Your divine majesty it may rise for our and for the whole world's welfare with the fragrance of sweetness.

text: Veni sanctificator omnipotens aeterne Deus et benedic hoc sacrificium ab indignis manibus meis tuo nomini praeparatum.
translation_en: Come, holy, almighty, eternal God, and bless this sacrifice prepared to your name by unworthy hands of mine.

text: Incensum istud a te benedictum ascendat ad te Domine et descendat super nos misericordia tua (Ps. 140 2–4) Dirigatur ad te Domine oratio mea sicut incensum in conspectu tuo Elevatio manuum mearum sacrificium vespertinum Pone Domine custodiam ori meo et ostium circumstantiae labiis meis Et non declines cor meum in verba malitiae ad excusandas excusationes in peccatis.
translation_en:
May this incense, blessed by you, rise to you, Lord, and come down upon us with your mercy (Ps. 140:2-4)
Let my prayer be directed to you, O Lord, like incense before your face.
Raised are my hands as a sacrificial offering at evening.
Lord, set a guard over my mouth and shield the doors of my lips.
And let not my heart incline towards words of wickedness for excusing excuses in sins.

text: Accendat in nobis Dominus ignem sui amoris et flammam aeternae caritatis.
translation_en: May the Lord kindle in us His fire of love and the flame of eternal charity.

text: Suscipe sancta Trinitas hanc oblationem quam tibi offerimus ob memoriam passionis resurrectionis et ascensionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi et in honore beatae Mariae semper Virginis et beati Ioannis Baptistae et sanctorum apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli et istorum et omnium sanctorum ut illis proficiat ad honorem nobis autem ad salutem et ut illi pro nobis intercedere dignentur in caelis quorum memoriam agimus in terris.
translation_en: Receive, Holy Trinity, this offering which we present to you, in memory of the passion, resurrection, and ascension of our Lord Jesus Christ, and in honor of the blessed Virgin Mary, St. John the Baptist, the apostles Peter and Paul, these saints, and all saints. May it profit them for your honor, and us for salvation, and may they deign to intercede on our behalf in heaven whose memory we hold dear on earth.

text: Orate fratres et sorores ut meum ac vestrum sacrificium acceptabile fiat apud Deum Patrem omnipotentem.
translation_en: Pray, brothers and sisters, that my and your sacrifice may be acceptable before the almighty God, the Father.

text: Per quem maiestatem tuam laudant angeli adorant dominationes tremunt potestates Caeli caelorumque virtutes ac beata Seraphim socia exsultatione concelebrant Cum quibus et nostras voces ut admitti iubeas deprecamur supplici confessione dicentes.
translation_en: Through whom your majesty is praised, angels adore, dominions tremble, powers of heaven and the virtues of heavens rejoice along with blessed Seraphim in exultant celebration. With these and our voices, we humbly beseech you to grant us admission; we make supplicant confession.

text: Quia per incarnati Verbi mysterium nova mentis nostrae oculis lux tuae claritatis infulsit Ut dum visibiliter Deum cognoscimus per hunc in invisibilium amorem rapiamur Et ideo cum angelis et archangelis cum thronis et dominationibus Cumque omni militia caelestis exercitus hymnum gloriae tuae canimus sine fine dicentes
translation_en: Since by the mystery of the incarnate Word, your light has shone upon our minds as a new brightness. So while we visibly know God through this, let us be drawn into invisible love. And so, with angels and archangels, with thrones and dominions, with all the heavenly host, we sing without end the hymn of your glory.

text: Quia cum Unigenitus tuus in substantia nostrae mortalitatis apparuit nova nos immortalitatis suae luce reparavit. Et ideo cum angelis et archangelis. Ut supra.
translation_en: Since your Only-begotten appeared in our mortal substance, he renewed us with the light of his own immortality. Therefore, we sing with angels and archangels above.

text: Qui corporali ieiunio vitia comprimis mentem elevas virtutem largiris et praemia per Christum Dominum nostrum Per quem maiestatem tuam laudant angeli Ut supra.
translation_en: Who, by bodily fasting, compresses vices, raises the mind, grants virtue and gives rewards through Christ our Lord. Through whom the angels praise your majesty above.

text: Qui salutem humani generis in ligno crucis constituisti ut unde mors oriebatur inde vita resurgeret Et qui in ligno vincebat in ligno quoque vinceretur per Christum Dominum nostrum Per quem maiestatem tuam laudant angeli adorant dominationes tremunt potestates Ut supra.
translation_en: Who established the salvation of the human race on the wood of the cross, so that where death arose, there life might rise again. And who conquered on the wood, was also conquered on the wood through Christ our Lord. Through Him, angels praise Your majesty, dominions adore it, powers tremble, and potentates are subject to You.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus ob diem in qua Dominus noster tradidit discipulis suis corporis et sanguinis sui mysteria celebranda.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this presentation of our servitude, as well as the entire family yours, which we offer to you on the day when our Lord gave his disciples the mystery to be celebrated, that is, the sacrament of his body and blood.

text: Te quidem Domine omni tempore sed in hoc potissimum die gloriosius praedicare cum pascha nostrum immolatus est Christus Ipse enim verus est agnus qui abstulit peccata mundi Qui mortem nostram moriendo destruxit et vitam resurgendo reparavit Et ideo cum angelis
translation_en: Indeed, Lord, at all times but especially today you are more gloriously proclaimed, for our Passover Lamb, Christ Himself, was immolated. For He is truly the Lamb of God who took away the sins of the world. He destroyed our death by dying and restored life by rising again. And therefore, with angels.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimam celebrantes resurrectionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi secundum carnem.
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day, we commemorate the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ according to the flesh.

text: Qui post resurrectionem suam omnibus discipulis suis manifestus apparuit et ipsis cernentibus est elevatus in caelum ut nos divinitatis suae tribueret esse participes Et ideo cum angelis et archangelis cum thronis et dominationibus Cumque omni militia Ut supra.
translation_en: Who, after his resurrection, appeared manifestly to all his disciples and, while being seen by them, was lifted up into heaven so that we might be partakers of his divinity. And therefore with angels and archangels, with thrones and dominions, with all militia, as above.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimam celebrantes quo Dominus noster Unigenitus Filius tuus unitam [sibi] fragilitatis nostrae substantiam in gloriae suae dextera collocavit.
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day on which Our Only-begotten Son, your Son, placed our fragile substance in his right hand in glory.

text: Communicantes et noctem sacratissimam celebrantes Pentecostes quo Spiritus Sanctus apostolos plebemque credentium praesentia suae maiestatis implevit.
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred night, we celebrate Pentecost, on which the Holy Spirit filled the presence of His majesty upon the apostles and the believing people.

text: Qui ascendens super omnes caelos sedensque ad dexteram tuam promissum Spiritum Sanctum hodierna die in filios adoptionis effudit Quapropter profusis gaudiis totus in orbe terrarum mundus exsultat Sed et supernae virtutes atque angelicae potestates hymnum gloriae tuae concinunt sine fine dicentes.
translation_en: Who, ascending above all heavens, sitting at Your right hand, poured out the promised Holy Spirit today upon the sons of adoption. Therefore, the whole world rejoices everywhere on earth. And the celestial powers and angelic authorities sing a hymn of Your glory without end.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum Pentecosten celebrantes quo Spiritus Sanctus apostolis in igneis linguis apparuit.
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day of Pentecost, on which the Holy Spirit appeared to the apostles in tongues of fire.

text: Qui cum Unigenito Filio tuo et Spiritu Sancto unus es Deus unus es Dominus Non in unius singularitate personae sed in unius Trinitate substantiae Quod enim de tua gloria revelante te credimus hoc de Filio tuo hoc de Spiritu Sancto sine differentia discretionis sentimus Ut in confessione verae sempiternaeque Deitatis et in personis proprietas et in essentia unitas et in maiestate adoretur aequalitas Quam laudant angeli atque archangeli Cherubim quoque et Seraphim qui non cessant clamare cottidie una voce dicentes
translation_en: Who, with your Only-Begotten Son and the Holy Spirit, are one God, one Lord. Not in a single personality's uniqueness but in a single Trinity's substance. For what we believe concerning your glory, this we also believe concerning your Son, this concerning the Holy Spirit; we do not feel any distinction without difference. So in confessing true and eternal Deity, in persons we acknowledge properties, in essence unity, and in majesty equality. This is adored by angels, archangels, cherubim, and seraphim who never cease to cry out daily with one voice saying:

text: Et te in veneratione beatae Mariae semper Virginis exsultantibus animis collaudare benedicere et praedicare Quae et Unigenitum tuum Sancti Spiritus obumbratione concepit et virginitatis gloria permanente huic mundo lumen aeternum effudit Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum Per quem maiestatem Ut supra.
translation_en: And to bless, praise, and proclaim you in the exultation of the blessed Mary, ever Virgin, is the desire of our souls. She conceived Your Only-Begotten Son under the veil of the Holy Spirit and bestowed upon this world the eternal light, Jesus Christ our Lord. Through Him we honor Your majesty as above.

text: Te Domine suppliciter exorare ut gregem tuum pastor aeterne non deseras sed per beatos apostolos tuos continua protectione custodias Ut isdem rectoribus gubernetur quos operis tui vicarios eidem contulisti praeesse pastores Et ideo cum angelis Ut supra. /76r/
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Lord, that Your eternal Shepherd never abandon His flock, but through Your blessed apostles continue to guard them with constant protection. Let the same shepherds govern whom You have appointed as vicars of Your work to preside over them as pastors. And so, together with angels, we ask this of You above all.

text: Te igitur clementissime Pater per Iesum Christum Filium tuum Dominum nostrum supplices rogamus et petimus uti accepta habeas et benedicas haec dona haec munera haec sancta sacrificia illibata Imprimis quae tibi offerimus pro Ecclesia tua sancta catholica quam pacificare custodire adunare et regere digneris toto orbe terrarum una cum famulo tuo papa nostro N et archiepiscopo nostro N et rege nostro N et omnibus orthodoxis atque catholicae et apostolicae fidei cultoribus.
translation_en: Therefore, most merciful Father, through Jesus Christ, your Son, our Lord, we humbly ask and implore you to accept and bless these gifts, these offerings, these holy sacrifices that are undefiled. Firstly, those which we offer on behalf of your Holy Catholic Church, which you deign to pacify, protect, unite, and govern throughout the whole world. Together with your servant our Pope N, our archbishop N, our king N, and all the orthodox and Catholic and apostolic faith worshipers.

text: Communicantes et memoriam venerantes Imprimis gloriosae semperque Virginis Mariae Genitricis Dei et Domini nostri Iesu Christi Sed et beatorum apostolorum ac martyrum tuorum Petri Pauli Andreae Iacobi Ioannis Thomae Iacobi Philippi Bartholomaei Matthaei Simonis et Thaddaei Lini Cleti Clementis Sixti Cornelii Cypriani Laurentii Chrysogoni Ioannis et Pauli Cosmae et Damiani et omnium sanctorum tuorum quorum meritis precibusque concedas ut in omnibus protectionis tuae muniamur auxilio.
translation_en: Communicating and honoring the memory, first of all the glorious and ever-virgin Mother of God and Lord Jesus Christ, our Savior, as well as the blessed apostles and martyrs among your own Peter, Paul, Andrew, James, John, Thomas, James the Lesser, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Simon, Jude Thaddaeus, Linus, Cletus, Clement, Sixtus, Cornelius, Cyprian, Lawrence, Chrysogonus, John and Paul, Cosmas and Damian, and all your saints whose merits and prayers grant us that we may be fortified in all things with the help of your protection.

text: Qui pridie quam pateretur accepit panem in sanctas ac venerabiles manus suas et elevatis oculis in caelum ad te Deum Patrem suum omnipotentem tibi gratias agens benedixit fregit dedit discipulis suis dicens Accipite et manducate ex hoc omnes Hoc est enim corpus meum
translation_en: On the day before He was to suffer, He took bread into His holy and venerable hands, raised His eyes toward heaven to You, God, His almighty Father, giving thanks, blessed it, broke it, gave it to His disciples, saying: "Take and eat from this all of you. For this is My body."

text: Simili modo postquam cenatum est accipiens et hunc praeclarum calicem in sanctas ac venerabiles manus suas Item tibi gratias agens benedixit deditque discipulis suis dicens Accipite et bibite ex eo omnes Hic est enim calix sanguinis mei novi et aeterni testamenti mysterium fidei qui pro vobis et pro multis effundetur in remissionem peccatorum Haec quotienscumque feceritis in mei memoriam facietis.
translation_en: In the same way, after he had eaten, taking and receiving this excellent chalice into his holy and revered hands, giving thanks to you [God], he blessed it and gave it to his disciples, saying: "Take and drink from it all of you. For this is indeed the cup of my new and eternal covenant, the mystery of faith, which will be poured out for you and for many in the remission of sins." Whenever you do this, you will do it in memory of me.

text: Unde et memores Domine nos tui servi sed et plebs tua sancta eiusdem Christi Filii tui Dei et Domini nostri Tam beatae passionis nec non et ab inferis resurrectionis sed et in caelos gloriosae ascensionis offerimus praeclarae maiestati tuae de tuis donis ac datis hostiam puram hostiam sanctam hostiam immaculatam Panem sanctum vitae aeternae et Calicem salutis perpetuae Supra quae propitio ac sereno vultu respicere digneris et accepta habere sicut accepta habere dignatus es munera pueri tui iusti Abel et sacrificium patriarchae nostri Abrahae et quod tibi obtulit summus sacerdos tuus Melchisedech sanctum sacrificium immaculatam hostiam.
translation_en: And remembering, Lord, we your servants and the holy people of the same Christ your Son and our God, we offer to your glorious majesty from your gifts and graces the pure, holy, immaculate offering - the Bread of Eternal Life and the Chalice of Perpetual Salvation. May you deign to look upon them with a favorable and serene countenance, and may you accept them as you were pleased to accept the offerings of your righteous child Abel, and the sacrifice of our patriarch Abraham, and that which your high priest Melchizedek offered - an immaculate holy offering.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus iube haec perferri per manus sancti angeli tui in sublime altare tuum in conspectu divinae maiestatis tuae ut quotquot ex hac Hic osculetur altare. altaris participatione sacrosanctum Filii tui corpus et sanguinem sumpserimus omni Hic signet se ipsum. benedictione caelesti et gratia repleamur.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, Almighty God, command that these be brought by the hands of your holy angel to your lofty altar in the presence of your divine majesty, so that all who participate here in this altar may receive the most sacred body and blood of your Son. Here they sign themselves. May they be filled with celestial blessing and grace.

text: Memento etiam Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum qui nos praecesserunt cum signo fidei et dormiunt in somno pacis Hic recitentur nomina defunctorum. Ipsis Domine et omnibus in Christo quiescentibus locum refrigerii lucis ac pacis ut indulgeas deprecamur.
translation_en: Remember also, O Lord, your servants and the servants of your servants who have gone before us with the sign of faith and sleep in the sleep of peace. Here let their names be read. To these, O Lord, and to all sleeping in Christ, a place of refreshing light and peace, we pray that you may grant forgiveness.

text: Nobis quoque peccatoribus famulis tuis de multitudine miserationum tuarum sperantibus partem aliquam et societatem donare digneris cum tuis sanctis apostolis et martyribus Cum Ioanne Stephano Matthia Barnaba Ignatio Alexandro Marcellino Petro Felicitate Perpetua Agatha Lucia Agnete Caecilia Anastasia et cum omnibus sanctis tuis Intra quorum nos consortium non aestimator meriti sed veniae quaesumus largitor admitte Per Christum Dominum Per quem haec omnia Domine semper bona creas Sanctificas Vivificas Benedicis et praestas nobis.
translation_en: May it also be pleasing to you, our merciful Lord, to grant us sinners, your humble servants, a small part and fellowship with your holy apostles and martyrs: John, Stephen, Matthew, Barnabas, Ignatius, Alexander, Marcellinus, Peter, Felicitas, Perpetua, Agatha, Lucia, Agnes, Cecilia, Anastasia and all your saints. Within their fellowship we ask not to be measured by merit but by mercy. Grant us admittance through Christ our Lord, who through whom you create all things good, sanctify, vivify, bless, and grant these benefits to us.

text: Oremus praeceptis salutaribus moniti et divina institutione formati audemus dicere Pater noster qui es in caelis sanctificetur nomen tuum Adveniat regnum tuum Fiat voluntas tua sicut in caelo et in terra Panem nostrum cottidianum da nobis hodie et dimitte nobis debita nostra sicut et nos dimittimus debitoribus nostris Et ne nos inducas in tentationem Sed libera nos a malo.
translation_en: We dare to say, being reminded by salutary precepts and formed by divine institution, our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.

text: Libera nos quaesumus Domine ab omnibus malis praeteritis praesentibus et futuris et intercedente beata et gloriosa semperque Virgine Dei Genitrice Maria et sanctis apostolis tuis Petro et Paulo atque Andrea et omnibus sanctis.
translation_en: Deliver us, we beseech you, Lord, from all past evils, present and future ones, and through the intercession of the blessed and glorious ever-Virgin Mary, Mother of God, and your apostles Peter, Paul, and Andrew, as well as all saints.

text: Da propitius pacem in diebus nostris ut ope misericordiae tuae adiuti et a peccato simus semper liberi et ab omni perturbatione securi.
translation_en: Grant us your gracious peace in our days, so that we may always be free from sin with the help of your mercy and secure from all disturbance.

text: Domine Iesu Christe qui dixisti apostolis tuis pacem relinquo vobis pacem meam do vobis ne respicias peccata mea sed fidem Ecclesiae tuae eamque secundum voluntatem tuam pacificare custodire et coadunare digneris.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, who said to your apostles, 'I leave you peace, my peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give it to you.' Do you grant us that we may not consider our sins but the faith of your Church and, according to your will, strive to maintain, preserve, and unite it.

text: Domine Iesu Christe Fili Dei vivi qui ex voluntate Patris cooperante Spiritu Sancto per mortem tuam mundum vivificasti libera me per hoc sacrosanctum corpus et sanguinem tuum ab omnibus iniquitatibus meis et universis malis et fac me tuis semper inhaerere mandatis et a te numquam separari permittas Qui cum eodem Patre et Spiritu Sancto vivis et regnas Deus. omnia saecula saeculorum Amen. Perceptio corporis et sanguinis tui Domine Iesu Christe quam ego indignus sumere praesumo non mihi proveniat in iudicium et condemnationem sed pro tua pietate prosit mihi ad tutamentum mentis et corporis et ad medelam percipiendam.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God, who by the will of the Father and with the help of the Holy Spirit gave life to the world through your death, free me through this most holy body and blood from all my sins and every evil. May I always adhere to your commands and may you never permit me to be separated from you. You who live and reign with the same Father and the Holy Spirit forever and ever. Amen. Perceiving the body and blood of you, Lord Jesus Christ, which I presume to receive unworthily, may it not bring judgment and condemnation upon me but rather may it bring protection for my soul and body and healing for me to receive.

text: Quid retribuam Domino pro omnibus quae retribuit mihi Panem caelestem accipiam et nomen Domini invocabo Laudans invocabo Dominum et ab inimicis meis salvus ero.
translation_en: What shall I render to the Lord for all that he has given me, the bread of heaven I will receive and I will call upon the name of the Lord, praising I will call upon the Lord and from my enemies I will be saved.

text: Ave in aeternum sanctissima caro in perpetuum mihi summa dulcedo. Ecce Iesu benignissime quod desideravi iam video quod concupivi iam teneo hic tibi quaeso iungar in caelis.
translation_en: Hail forever, most holy flesh, to me you are the supreme sweetness. Behold, Jesus, most kindly, what I have long desired, I now see what I have long coveted, I now hold. Here I ask you, unite me in heaven.

text: Quid retribuam Domino pro omnibus quae retribuit mihi Calicem salutaris accipiam et nomen Domini invocabo Laudans invocabo Dominum et ab inimicis meis salvus ero.
translation_en: What shall I give to the Lord for all that he has given to me? I will receive the chalice of salvation and invoke his name. I will praise the Lord, and I will be saved from my enemies.

text: Ave in aeternum caelestis potus mihi ante omnia et super omnia dulcis Sanguis Domini nostri Iesu Christi quem vere confiteor de latere eius profluxisse mundet omnes maculas conscientiae meae et sit mihi remissio omnium peccatorum meorum.
translation_en: Hail to thee, eternal heavenly draught, before all things and above all others, sweet Blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, which I truly confess flowed from his side. May it wash away all stains of my conscience and be for me remission of all my sins.

text: Sanguis Domini nostri Iesu Christi custodiat animam meam in vitam aeternam.
translation_en: The blood of our Lord Jesus Christ may keep my soul in eternal life.

text: Quod ore sumpsimus Domine pura mente capiamus et de munere temporali fiat nobis remedium sempiternum Corpus tuum Domine quod sumpsi et sanguis quem potavi adhaereat in visceribus meis et praesta ut in me non remaneat scelerum macula quem tam pura et sancta refecerunt sacramenta.
translation_en: What we have received, Lord, with pure minds, may we comprehend; and let the temporal gift become for us eternal remedy. Your Body, Lord, which I have eaten, and the Blood which I have drunk, may it adhere to my innermost organs, and grant that in me remains not the stain of sins, which so pure and holy sacraments have restored.

text: Placeat tibi sancta Trinitas obsequium servitutis meae et praesta ut quod oculis tuae maiestatis indignus obtuli tibi sit acceptabile mihique et omnibus pro quibus illud obtuli sit te miserante propitiabile.
translation_en: May it please you, Holy Trinity, the obedience of my servitude and grant that what I, unworthy before your majesty's eyes, have offered to you, may be acceptable to me and to all for whom I have offered it. May you, being merciful, find it propitious.

text: Deus qui tribus pueris mitigasti flammas ignium concede propitius per interventum eorum et merita omnium sanctorum ut nos famulos tuos non exurat flamma vitiorum.
translation_en: God, who softened the flames of fire for the three boys, grant us graciously through their intervention and the merits of all saints, that our servants may not be consumed by the flame of vices.

text: Deus universae carnis creator qui agnum in Aegypto Moysi et populo tuo in vigilia Paschae comedere praecepisti in figura Domini nostri Iesu Christi cuius sanguine omnia primogenita tibi de mundo redemisti et in nocte illa omne primogenitum in Aegypto percutere praecepisti servans populum tuum agni sanguine praenotatum dignare quaesumus benedicere et sanctificare has carnes agninas ut quicumque ex fidelibus populis tuis ex eis comederint omni benedictione caelesti et gratia saturati repleantur in bonis.
translation_en: God, creator of all flesh, who commanded Moses and your people in Egypt to eat the lamb on the vigil of Passover as a figure of our Lord Jesus Christ, whose blood you redeemed all the firstborn from the world and on that night commanded the killing of all the firstborn in Egypt while sparing your people by the mark of the lamb's blood. We humbly ask that you bless and sanctify these lamb's flesh, so that whoever among your faithful people consumes them may be filled with every celestial blessing and grace, saturated with good things.

text: Benedic Domine creaturam istam lardi ut sit remedium salutare generi humano et praesta per invocationem tui sancti nominis ut quicumque inde sumpserint corporis sanitatem et animae tutelam percipiant.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this creature of bread, that it may be a salutary remedy for the human race. And grant, through the invocation of your holy name, that whoever takes part of it in bodily health, may perceive protection for their soul.

text: Deus universae creaturae qui inter ceteras diversarum creaturarum species pro humani generis usu etiam volatilium genus ex aqua producere dignatus es ex quibus Noe de arca egrediens holocausta tibi offerens placuit et qui populum tuum ex Aegypto eductum per Moysen servum tuum munda ab immundis segregans edendi praeceptum dedisti te supplices rogamus ut has mundarum avium carnes benedicere et sanctificare digneris ut quicumque ex eis comederint benedictionis tuae abundantia repleantur et ad aeternae vitae gaudia pervenire mereantur.
translation_en: God of all creation, who among other diverse species of creatures deigned to produce the flying kind from water, from which Noah, coming out of the ark, offered a holocaust to you, and who led your people out of Egypt through Moses your servant, separating them from the unclean, and gave them commandment concerning food; we humbly ask that you bless and sanctify these birds' flesh, so that whoever eats them may be filled with the abundance of your blessing and merit to reach the joys of eternal life.

text: Subveniat quaesumus Domine benedictionis tuae gratia huic ovorum creaturae ut cibus salutaris fiat tuis fidelibus in gratiarum actione sumentibus.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to you, Lord, that your blessing's grace comes upon this egg-bearing creature, so that it becomes a wholesome food for your faithful ones, who partake in thanksgiving.

text: Dignare Domine quaesumus omnipotens Deus benedicere et sanctificare hanc creaturam casei quam ex adipe animalium producere dignatus es et concede propitius ut quicumque ex populis tuis fidelibus comederint vel gustaverint omni benedictione caelesti et gratia saturati repleantur in bonis.
translation_en: Grant, we ask, almighty Lord, that you bless and sanctify this creation of cheese which you have deemed worthy to produce from the fat of animals. And graciously bestow that whoever among your faithful people may eat or taste it, they be filled with every celestial blessing and grace, and be replenished with good things.

text: Deus qui resurrectione Filii tui nobis gaudia contulisti auge et sanctifica collata nobis haec dona tuae largitatis mentesque nostras spiritalibus reple deliciis.
translation_en: God, who through the resurrection of your Son has given us joys, increase and sanctify these gifts that you have bestowed upon us. Fill our minds with spiritual delights.

text: Benedictio Dei Patris omnipotentis et Filii et Spiritus Sancti descendat et maneat super has creaturas.
translation_en: The blessing of God the Almighty Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit descend and remain upon these creatures.

text: Deus qui paschale nobis remedium contulisti intercedente beato N populum tuum caelesti dono prosequere ut inde in perpetuum gaudeat unde nunc temporaliter exsultat.
translation_en: God, who provided the paschal remedy for us, through the intercession of the blessed N, grant that your people may follow this celestial gift, so that they may rejoice forever from where they now temporarily exult.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras et per resurrectionem Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi a cunctis malis liberemur et intercedente beato N martyre tuo et muro custodiae hoc sanctum ovile circumda ut omni adversitate depulsa hoc semper domicilium sit incolumitatis et pacis.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, our prayers and may we be freed from all evils through the resurrection of Your Son, Our Lord Jesus Christ. May your blessed martyr N protect us, and may this holy flock be surrounded by the wall of guardianship so that it may always be a dwelling of safety and peace, free from every adversity.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine preces populi tui cum oblationibus hostiarum ut paschalibus initiata mysteriis ad aeternitatis nobis medelam te operante proficiant.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech you, Lord, the prayers of your people along with the offerings of sacrifices, that as we are initiated into the Paschal mysteries, may we progress towards the remedy of eternity through your operation.

text: Te quidem Domine Communicantes Hanc igitur
translation_en: Indeed, Lord, we who communicate with each other

text: Sacrificia Domine quae paschalibus gaudiis immolamus nobis tuae propitiationis munus obtineant quibus Ecclesia tua mirabiliter pascitur et nutritur.
translation_en: Offerings, Lord, which we sacrifice during the joyous feasts, may obtain for us the gift of your propitiation. Through these offerings, your Church is wonderfully fed and nourished.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera populorum tuorum propitius ut in confessione tui nominis et baptismate renovati sempiternam beatitudinem consequantur.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offerings of your people graciously, that in the confession of your name and being renewed by baptism, they may obtain eternal beatitude.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine placatus assume quas et pro renatorum expiatione peccati deferimus et pro acceleratione caelestis auxilii.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept the offerings that we bring for the atonement of the sins of our ancestors and for the hastening of heavenly aid.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine populum tuum et quem aeternis dignatus es revocare mysteriis a temporalibus culpis dignanter absolve.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we entreat you, your people and the one whom you have deemed worthy to recall from earthly sins, graciously forgive through sacred mysteries.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine semper nos per haec mysteria paschalia gratulari ut continua reparationis nostrae operatio et perpetuae nobis fiat causa laetitiae.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, always that through these Paschal mysteries we may continually rejoice and that these works of our repair become a perpetual cause of joy for us.

text: Redemptionis nostrae munere vegetati quaesumus Domine ut hoc perpetuae salutis auxilio fides semper vera proficiat.
translation_en: By the gift of our Redemption, we humbly ask you, Lord, that with the aid of this salvation everlasting, faith may always progress truly.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui festa paschalia peregimus haec te largiente moribus et vita teneamus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who have celebrated the festivals of Easter may lead our lives and behavior in a manner pleasing to you, through your generous provision.

text: Suscipe munera quaesumus Domine exsultantis Ecclesiae et cui causam tanti gaudii contulisti perpetuum fructum concede laetitiae.
translation_en: Receive the offerings, we ask you, Lord, from the rejoicing Church, and to whom you have given cause for such great joy, grant an eternal fruit of happiness.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sacrosancta mysteria quae pro redemptionis nostrae munimine contulisti et praesens nobis remedium esse facias et futurum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the sacred mysteries which you have bestowed as a bulwark for our redemption may be to us now a present remedy, and a future one.

text: Deus qui in Filii tui humilitate iacentem mundum erexisti fidelibus tuis perpetuam concede laetitiam ut quos perpetuae mortis eripuisti casibus gaudiis facias sempiternis perfrui.
translation_en: God, who raised the world in the humility of your Son, grant to your faithful a perpetual joy. May those whom you have snatched away from eternal death through misfortunes, enjoy everlasting delights.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut vivificationis tuae gratiam consequentes in tuo semper munere gloriemur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that following your grace of life, we may always glory in your constant service.

text: His nobis Domine mysteriis conferatur quo terrena desideria mitigantes discamus amare caelestia.
translation_en: Lord, may these mysteries be granted to us so that by lessening our earthly desires, we might learn to love the heavenly things.

text: Sacramenta quae sumpsimus quaesumus Domine spiritualibus nos instruant alimentis et corporalibus tueantur auxiliis.
translation_en: The sacraments we have received, we ask you, Lord, may they instruct us spiritually and protect us physically with your help.

text: Deus qui nos per huius sacrificii veneranda commercia unius summaeque divinitatis participes esse voluisti quaesumus ut sicut tuam cognoscimus veritatem sic eam dignis moribus assequamur.
translation_en: God, who willed us to become participants in this sacrifice through the venerable intercourse of one and the same divinity, we humbly ask that just as we come to know your truth, so too may we strive to live worthy lives in accordance with it.

text: Adesto nobis Domine Deus noster ut per haec quae fideliter sumpsimus et purgemur a vitiis et a periculis omnibus eruamur.
translation_en: Be present with us, Lord our God, that through these things which we have faithfully received, we may be purified from vices and freed from all dangers.

text: Deus a quo bona cuncta procedunt largire supplicibus tuis ut cogitemus te inspirante quae recta sunt et te gubernante eadem faciamus.
translation_en: God from whom all good things proceed, grant your mercy to your suppliants that we may remember you, being guided by you, doing what is right and with you in charge, make the same things happen.

text: Suscipe Domine fidelium preces cum oblationibus hostiarum ut per haec piae placationis officia ad caelestem gloriam transeamus.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers of the faithful along with their offerings, so that through these acts of devout appeasement we may pass over to celestial glory.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nostrae mentis intentio quo sollemnitatis venturae gloriosus auctor ingressus est semper intendat et quo fide pergit conversatione perveniat.
translation_en: Grant us, O almighty God, that our intention, which the glorious Author of the upcoming solemnity has entered, may always be directed, and that, by conduct, it may reach where faith leads.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine supplices pro Filii tui venerabili ascensione deferimus praesta quaesumus ut nos per ipsum his commerciis sacrosanctis ad caelestia consurgamus.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, humbly on behalf of Your beloved Son during His venerable ascent. Grant us, we beseech You, that through Him and these most sacred transactions, we may ascend to heavenly realms.

text: Tribue nobis quaesumus Domine ut per haec sacra quae sumpsimus illuc tendat nostrae devotionis affectus quo tecum est nostra substantia. Iesus Christus Dominus noster
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you Lord, that through these sacred things which we have received, may our affection of devotion tend towards thee with whom our substance is with Jesus Christ our Lord.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui hodierna die Unigenitum tuum Redemptorem nostrum ad caelos ascendisse credimus ipsi quoque mente in caelestibus habitemus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who believe that Your Only-begotten Son, Our Redeemer, has ascended to heaven today, may also have Him in our minds in the heavens.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut quae visibilibus mysteriis sumenda percepimus et invisibili consequamur effectu.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, that what we have received through visible mysteries we may also attain in invisible effects.

text: Repleti Domine muneribus sacris quaesumus ut in gratiarum semper actione maneamus.
translation_en: Lord, who are filled with sacred gifts, we humbly ask that we may always remain in the act of giving thanks.

text: Deus qui in Abrahae famuli tui opere humano generi oboedientiae exempla praebuisti concede nobis et nostrae pravitatis voluntatem frangere et tuorum praeceptorum rectitudinem in omnibus adimplere.
translation_en: God, who in the work of your servant Abraham gave examples of obedience to the human race, grant us to break our willfulness and to fulfill your teachings in all things.

text: Deus qui nos ad celebrandam festivitatem utriusque testamenti paginis instruis da nobis intelligere misericordiam tuam ut ex perceptione praesentium munerum firma sit exspectatio futurorum.
translation_en: God, who instructs us to celebrate the festival of both testaments, grant us to understand your mercy. May the firm expectation of future gifts be established from the perception of the present offerings.

text: Deus incommutabilis virtus et lumen aeternum respice ad totius Ecclesiae mirabile sacramentum et da famulis tuis ut hoc quod devote agimus etiam rectitudine vitae teneamus.
translation_en: God, unchangeable power and eternal light, look upon the wonderful sacrament of the whole Church, and give your servants that what we do with devotion we may also hold with the righteousness of life.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine oblata sanctifica et tuorum corda renatorum Sancti Spiritus virtute confirma.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to sanctify the offerings that have been presented and confirm the hearts of your newborn ones by the power of the Holy Spirit.

text: Sancti Spiritus quaesumus Domine corda nostra mundet infusio et sui roris intima aspersione fecundet.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the Holy Spirit may purify our hearts with his infusion and fertilize them with the inner sprinkling of his dew.
