text: Munera quaesumus Domine oblata sanctifica et corda nostra Sancti Spiritus illustratione emunda.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to sanctify these offerings and purify our hearts by the enlightenment of the Holy Spirit.

text: Deus qui apostolis tuis Sanctum dedisti Spiritum concede plebi tuae piae petitionis effectum ut quibus dedisti fidem largiaris et pacem.
translation_en: God, who gave your holy Spirit to your apostles, grant the effect of our devoted people's petition that you may bestow faith and peace upon those whom you have given faith.

text: Propitius Domine quaesumus haec dona sanctifica et hostiae spiritualis oblatione suscepta nosmet ipsos tibi perfice munus aeternum.
translation_en: Gracious Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify these gifts and accept us, offered spiritually as the host, to fulfill for us an eternal service to you.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine populo tuo et quem mysteriis caelestibus imbuisti ab hostium furore defende.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to be present with Your people, and to protect them from the madness of enemies, whom You have initiated into celestial mysteries.

text: Purificet nos Domine quaesumus praesentis muneris oblatio et dignos sacra participatione efficiat.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, we ask, with the offering of this present service, and make us worthy of sacred participation.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut Spiritus tuus adveniens templum nos gloriae suae dignanter habitando perficiat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, that your Spirit coming may worthily make this temple fit for your glory dwelling in us.

text: Virtute Sancti Spiritus Domine munera nostra continge ut quod sollemnitate praesenti tuo nomini dedicamus et intelligibile nobis fiat et aeternum.
translation_en: Lord, by the power of the Holy Spirit, may our gifts be contained so that what we dedicate to Your name on this solemnity becomes understandable to us and eternal.

text: Sacris caelestibus Domine quaesumus operante Spiritu Sancto vitia nostra purgentur ut muneribus tuis possimus semper aptari.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that with the operation of the Holy Spirit, our faults may be purged so that we may always be fit to serve your gifts.

text: Sacrificia Domine tuis oblata conspectibus ignis ille divinus assumat qui discipulorum Christi Filii tui per Spiritum Sanctum corda succendit.
translation_en: Lord, may Your sacrifices be accepted by the eyes of the divine Fire, who through the Holy Spirit stirs up the hearts of Christ's disciples, His sons.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sacri dona mysterii humiliter deprecantes ut quae in tui commemoratione nos facere praecepisti largiente Spiritu Sancto in nostrae proficiant infirmitatis auxilium.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the holy gifts of the mystery, humbly asking You, that what You commanded us to do in Your remembrance may be accomplished by the assistance of the Holy Spirit.

text: Tuo nos igne quaesumus Domine Spiritus Sanctus inflammet quem Dominus noster Iesus Christus misit in terram et voluit vehementer accendi.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, may the Holy Spirit set ablaze within us, whom Our Lord Jesus Christ sent onto the earth and desired to be intensely kindled.

text: Da Ecclesiae tuae misericors Deus
translation_en: Grant mercy to your church, merciful God

text: Praebeant nobis Domine divinum tua sacramenta fervorem quo eorum pariter et actu delectemur et fructu.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, Your divine sacraments with such warmth that we may delight equally and in action in them, and reap fruit from them.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui dedisti nobis famulis tuis in confessione verae fidei aeternae Trinitatis gloriam agnoscere et in potentia maiestatis adorare unitatem quaesumus ut eiusdem fidei firmitate ab omnibus semper muniamur adversis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has given us, your servants, to recognize the glory of the true faith in eternal Trinity and to adore its power in majesty, we humbly ask that we may always be fortified with the strength of the same faith against all adversities.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine Deus noster per Unigeniti tui nominis invocationem huius oblationis hostiam et cooperante Spiritu Sancto per eam nosmet ipsos tibi perficere munus aeternum.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord our God, to sanctify this offering's hostia through the invocation of your only-begotten Son's name, and by the cooperation of the Holy Spirit, through it may we ourselves be brought to perform an eternal service for you.

text: Proficiat nobis ad salutem corporis et animae Domine Deus huius sacramenti susceptio et sempiterna Sanctae Trinitatis eiusdemque individuae Unitatis confessio.
translation_en: May it profit us for the salvation of body and soul, Lord God. Through the reception of this sacrament and the eternal confession of the Holy Trinity and its individual unity.

text: Sumptis muneribus Domine quaesumus ut cum frequentatione mysterii crescat nostrae salutis augmentum.
translation_en: With these offerings, Lord, we ask that with the increase of participating in the mystery, may also grow our increase in salvation.

text: Sancta tua nos Domine sumpta vivificent et misericordiae sempiternae nos praeparent expiatos.
translation_en: Your Holy one, Lord, revive us and prepare us in everlasting mercy as purified ones.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine ut et mundi cursus pacifice tuo ordine dirigatur et Ecclesia tua tranquilla devotione laetetur.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, Lord, that both the course of the world may be directed in peace according to your order, and your Church may rejoice with peaceful devotion.

text: Quos caelesti Domine dono satiasti praesta quaesumus ut et a nostris mundemur occultis et ab hostium liberemur insidiis.
translation_en: Grant, heavenly Lord, that which you have satisfied, we humbly ask that you may also cleanse us from our hidden sins and free us from the ambushes of our enemies.

text: Deus virtutum cuius est totum quod est optimum insere pectoribus nostris amorem tui nominis et praesta in nobis religionis augmentum ut quae sunt bona nutrias ac pietatis studio quae sunt nutrita custodias.
translation_en: O God of virtues, whose is all that is best, instill into our hearts the love for your name, and grant us an increase in religion within us, so that what is good we may nurture, and what is nurtured we may guard with piety's study.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes populi tui benignus assume et ut nullius sit irritum votum nullius vacua postulatio praesta ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and graciously receive the offerings of your people. Grant that no vow or request be empty, may all we earnestly ask for be effectively obtained.

text: Deus qui legalium differentias hostiarum unius sacrificii perfectione sanxisti accipe sacrificium a devotis tibi famulis et pari benedictione sicut munera Abel sanctifica ut quod singuli obtulerunt ad maiestatis tuae honorem cunctis proficiat ad medelam.
translation_en: God who established the differences of offerings for one sacrifice by perfection, receive the offering from Your devoted servants, and bless it equally, just as the offerings of Abel were sanctified. May what each one offered for the honor of Your majesty benefit all for healing.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus Domine haec frequentare mysteria quia quotiens huius hostiae commemoratio celebratur opus nostrae redemptionis exercetur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that we may often participate in these mysteries, for whenever the remembrance of this altar is celebrated, the work of our redemption is accomplished.

text: Propitiare Domine populo tuo propitiare muneribus ut hac oblatione placatus indulgentiam nobis tribuas et postulata concedas.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your people, grant them grace through these offerings, that appeased, you may bestow mercy and forgiveness upon us, and grant our petitions.

text: Custodi quaesumus Domine Ecclesiam tuam propitiatione perpetua et quia sine te labitur humana mortalitas tuis semper auxiliis et abstrahatur a noxiis et ad salutaria dirigatur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, to guard Your Church with perpetual favor and because without You human frailty wavers; may it always be assisted by Your aid, withdrawn from evil, and directed towards salvation.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus ut haec hostia salutaris et nostrorum fiat purgatio delictorum et tuae propitiatio pietatis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, that this saving Host may become for us the purification of our sins and the propitiation of your mercy.

text: Tua nos quaesumus Domine gratia semper praeveniat et sequatur ac bonis operibus iugiter praestet esse intentos.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may your grace always precede and follow us, and may you continually aid those who are striving to do good works.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populo tuo diabolica vitare contagia et te solum Deum pura mente sectari.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that your people may avoid the contagion of the devil and seek only you, God, with a pure mind.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter deprecamur ut haec sancta quae gerimus et a praesentibus nos delictis exuant et futuris.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that these holy things we are performing may cleanse us from the present sins and prepare us for future ones.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine familiae supplicanti ut dum a cibis corporalibus abstinet a vitiis mente ieiunet.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, to the supplicating family, that while they abstain from physical food, they may fast mentally.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine mundet nostra delicta et ad sacrificium celebrandum subditorum tibi corpora mentesque sanctificet.
translation_en: This offering we ask you, Lord, may purify our sins and sanctify the bodies and minds of your subjects for the celebration of the sacrifice.

text: Sumentes Domine dona caelestia suppliciter deprecamur ut quae servitute donante te gerimus dignis sensibus tuo munere capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we take up the heavenly gifts with humble supplication. We pray that as you give us in servitude, we may worthy sense perceive your gift.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut de perceptis muneribus nomini tuo gratias exhibentes beneficia potiora sumamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God that, offering thanks for the received offerings in Your name, we may obtain greater blessings.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per continentiam salutarem et corporibus mederis et mentibus maiestatem tuam supplices exoramus ut pia ieiunantium deprecatione placatus et praesentia nobis subsidia praebeas et futura.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through your saving continence heals bodies and nourishes minds, we humbly beseech you to be graciously pleased by the devout supplications of those who fast, and grant us assistance in the present and future.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ieiunando gratia tua satiemur et abstinendo cunctis efficiamur hostibus fortiores.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that through fasting we may be filled with your grace and by abstaining, we may become stronger against our enemies.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus universa nobis adversantia propitiatus exclude ut mente et corpore pariter expediti quae tua sunt liberis mentibus exsequamur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, may all our adversities be propitiated so that we, with a mind and body prepared, may carry out Your will with free minds.

text: Tua nos Domine medicinalis operatio et a nostris perversitatibus clementer expediat et tuis faciat inhaerere mandatis.
translation_en: May your Lord, by his medicinal operation, kindly deliver us from our perversities and make us adhere to your commandments.

text: Ut sacris Domine reddamur digni muneribus fac nos tuis oboedire mandatis.
translation_en: May we, Lord, be worthy to render sacred offerings; make us obey your commands.

text: Excita quaesumus Domine tuorum fidelium voluntates ut divini operis fructum propensius exsequentes pietatis tuae remedia maiora percipiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to stir up the minds of your faithful followers so that they may more eagerly carry out the fruits of divine work and receive greater help from your mercy.

text: Propitius esto Domine supplicationibus nostris et populi tui oblationibus precibusque susceptis omnium nostrorum cor ad te converte ut a terrenis cupiditatibus liberi ad caelestia desideria transeamus.
translation_en: Lord, be gracious to us with regard to our supplications, and to your people with their offerings and prayers. Turn the hearts of all of us towards you so that we may pass from earthly desires to heavenly longings.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus ut per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus quicquid in nostra mente vitiosum est tuae medicationis dono curetur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, that through these sacred mysteries which we have received, whatever is corrupt in our minds may be healed by your gift of healing.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum Saturnini Chrysanthi Mauri et Dariae nobis Domine adsit oratio ut quos veneramur obsequio pio iugiter experiamur auxilio.
translation_en: May the prayers of your blessed martyrs Saturninus, Chrysanthus, Maurus, and Daria be with us, Lord, that we may constantly experience their aid through our devout service.

text: Sacrandum tibi Domine munus offerimus quo beati Andreae apostoli sollemnia recolentes purificationem quoque nostris mentibus imploramus.
translation_en: We present to You, Lord, the sacrament that we offer, recalling the solemnity of the blessed Apostle Andrew. We also pray for the purification of our minds.

text: Populi tui Domine quaesumus grata sit hostia quae sanctorum martyrum sollemnitatibus immolatur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offering of your people may be pleasing to you, which is sacrificed in honor of the solemnities of the holy martyrs.

text: Mysteriis Domine repleti corporis et sanguinis tui praesta quaesumus ut per intercessionem sanctorum martyrum tuorum Saturnini Chrysanthi Mauri et Dariae quae temporaliter agimus spiritualiter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, filled with your mysteries and your body and blood, grant us we ask, that through the intercession of your martyr saints Saturninus, Chrysanthus, Maurus and Daria, what we do temporally, we may spiritually achieve.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi quaesumus Domine beati Andreae apostoli precatio sancta conciliet ut cuius honore sollemniter exhibetur eius meritis efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the holy prayer of the blessed Apostle Andrew, that his honor may be solemnly displayed and his merits made acceptable.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria beati Andreae apostoli tui festivitate laetantes quae sicut tuis sanctis est ad gloriam ita nobis quaesumus ad veniam prodesse perficias.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the divine mysteries of your blessed apostle Andrew, rejoicing in his festival as they are to your saints for glory, so we humbly ask that you may complete them for us for forgiveness.

text: Deus qui beatam Barbaram virginem roseo cruore martyrii perfusam in thalamo regni tui collocasti concede propitius ut eadem interveniente suorum apud te veniam obtineant delictorum qui eius supernae claritati humillima devotione congaudent.
translation_en: God who placed the blessed Barbara in Your rose-colored kingdom through martyrdom, graciously grant that they may obtain forgiveness of sins when she intercedes for them before You. May those who rejoice in her supreme brightness with humble devotion.

text: Sanctae virginis tuae Barbarae quaesumus Domine pio interventu haec tibi grata reddatur oblatio pariterque nos et a peccatis omnibus expiet et ad caelestia dona capienda iugiter praeparet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through your pious intervention, this offering to your saint, Barbara, may be pleasing to you. May it also cleanse us and all our sins, and continually prepare us for the heavenly gifts.

text: Corporis sacri et pretiosi sanguinis repleti libamine quaesumus Domine ut sanctae virginis et martyris tuae Barbarae intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos tuearis adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to fill us with the bounty of your sacred and precious blood. May the intercession of your holy virgin and martyr Barbara protect us from all adversities.

text: Deus qui beatum Nicolaum pium pontificem tuum innumeris decorasti miraculis tribue nobis quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus a gehennae incendiis liberemur.
translation_en: God, who adorned the blessed Nicholas, your pious pontiff, with countless miracles, grant us we beseech you, that through his merits and prayers we may be freed from the fires of hell.

text: Protegat nos Domine saepius beati Andreae apostoli tui repetita sollemnitas ut cuius merita debita veneratione recolimus perpetuam ipsius defensionem sentiamus.
translation_en: May the Lord often protect us by the frequent feast of your blessed Apostle, Andrew; so that we may remember his due reverence and feel his perpetual defense.

text: Indulgentiam nobis praebeant Domine quaesumus haec munera largiorem quae venerabilis Andreae apostoli tui suffragiis offeruntur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, this indulgence. These gifts are offered through the intercession of thy venerable Apostle Andrew.

text: Adiuvet Ecclesiam tuam tibi Domine supplicando beatus Andreas apostolus et pius interventor efficiatur qui tui nominis exstitit praedicator.
translation_en: Your church is helped, Lord, by the prayers of blessed Andrew the apostle and the pious intercessor. May he who became a preacher of your name be effective for you.

text: Deus qui beatae Mariae semper Virginis conceptionem angelico vaticinio parentibus praedixisti praesta huic familiae tuae eius praesidiis muniri cuius conceptionis sacra sollemnia congrua frequentatione veneratur.
translation_en: God who foretold to the parents of the Blessed Virgin Mary, ever a virgin, her conception through an angelic proclamation, grant that this family may be protected by such guardians. Whose feast of conception is honored with suitable devotion.

text: Sanctifica Domine muneris oblati libamina et beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae cuius conceptionem celebramus saluberrima interventione nobis salutaria esse concede.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify the offerings we present and grant us through the blessed intervention of God's Mother, Mary, whose conception we celebrate, that they may be healthful and beneficial for us.

text: Repleti Domine vitalibus alimoniis et divinis reparati mysteriis supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut beatae Mariae semper Virginis cuius venerandam colimus conceptionem pia interventione coniungi mereamur civium supernorum.
translation_en: Lord, filled with vital nourishments and restored by the divine mysteries, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that through the pious intervention of the blessed Virgin Mary, to whom we reverently devote ourselves, we may merit the union of her celestial citizenship in her immaculate conception.

text: Misericordiam tuam nobis Domine quaesumus interveniente beato Damaso confessore tuo atque pontifice clementer impende et nobis peccatoribus ipsius propitiare suffragiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your mercy may be extended to us. May it be through the intervention of your confessor and bishop, Blessed Damasus, that you graciously bestow it upon us, and propitiate us, sinners, with his intercessions.

text: Sumpta Domine caelestis remedii sacramenta quaesumus ut ad perpetuam nobis gloriam beatus Damasus obtineat.
translation_en: Graciously bestow upon us, Lord, the sacred remedy of heavenly help, that blessed Damasus may attain eternal glory for us.

text: Accepta sit tibi Domine sacratae plebis oblatio pro tuorum honore sanctorum quorum se meritis percepisse de tribulatione cognoscit auxilium.
translation_en: May this offering of Your sacred people, Lord, be acceptable to You, on behalf of Your honor and the saints, whom they recognize as having received help from their merits in times of trouble.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Maximini confessoris tui meritis semper protegamur et precibus.
translation_en: Grant, we beg you, almighty God, that we may always be protected by the merits of your blessed confessor St. Maximinus, and through his prayers.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine tuis conspectibus oblata beati confessoris tui Maximini meritis tibi fiat accepta.
translation_en: This offering, we ask You, Lord, presented before Your eyes for the merits of Your blessed confessor Maximinus, may it be accepted by You.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut haec dona tua quae sumpsimus beati Maximini precibus in nobis potius augeantur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that these gifts which we have received through the prayers of blessed Maximinus may rather increase within us.

text: Deus qui per Unigenitum Filium tuum beatum Lazarum quadriduanum mortuum resuscitasti a monumento erige nos propitius de tumulis peccatorum ut mereamur adipisci consortium electorum.
translation_en: God, who raised the blessed son Lazarus, your only-begotten Son, from the tomb after four days, have mercy on us and raise us propitiously from the graves of sins that we may deserve to receive the company of the elect.

text: Hanc oblationem Domine propitius respice et meritis famuli tui Lazari qui tibi exstitit dilectus in tanti mysterii sacramento simus idonei et expurgemur a sordibus delictorum.
translation_en: Lord, look favorably upon this offering and deem us worthy through the merits of your servant Lazarus, who stood before you as a beloved one in the great mystery of the sacrament. May we be purified from the stains of our sins.

text: Quibus dignatus es Domine largiri salutiferi corporis et sanguinis tui mysteria interveniente glorioso martyre tuo Lazaro atque pontifice tribue propitius gaudia lucis aeternae.
translation_en: Which you were pleased, Lord, to give the saving mysteries of your body and blood through your glorious martyrdom of Lazarus and the bishop, grant them graciously the joys of eternal light.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus venturam beati apostoli tui Thomae sollemnitatem congruo praevenire honore et venientem digna celebrare devotione.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that the solemnity of your blessed apostle Thomas may be preceded with fitting honor and the one coming may be worthy to celebrate with devotion.

text: Benedictionis tuae Domine gratiam intercedente beato Thoma apostolo tuo suscipiamus ut cuius praeveniendo gloriam celebramus eius supplicando auxilium sentiamus.
translation_en: We receive the blessing of your grace, Lord, through the intercession of blessed Thomas, your apostle. May we celebrate the glory of the one we precede in anticipation, and may we feel his aid by our supplication.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine beati apostoli tui Thomae sollemnitatibus gloriari ut eius semper patrociniis sublevemur et fidem congrua devotione sectemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, the feastdays of your blessed apostle Thomas, that we may rejoice in his solemnities and always be lifted up by his intercession. May we follow a fitting devotion and faith.

text: Debitum tibi Domine nostrae servitutis reddimus officium suppliciter exorantes ut suffragiis beati Thomae apostoli tui tua in nobis munera tuearis cuius honoranda confessione laudis tibi hostias immolamus.
translation_en: We pay to you, Lord, our debt of servitude, humbly performing the office. We implore you that through the intercessions of your apostle, blessed Thomas, you may protect your gifts in us. Whose honor we confess, we offer as sacrifices of praise to you, immolating hostias.

text: Beati Thomae apostoli tui Domine quaesumus intercessione nos adiuva pro cuius sollemnitate percepimus tua sancta laetantes.
translation_en: Blessed are thy apostle Thomas, Lord, we humbly ask that with his intercession you help us. For the solemnity we have perceived, we rejoice in your holy ones.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris ut nos nullis mentis et corporis patiaris subiacere periculis quos beati Silvestri pontificis tui munit gloriosa confessio.
translation_en: Assist us, Lord, in our supplications, that we may not suffer any harm to mind or body from the perils which your blessed Pope Silvester armed himself against with his glorious confession.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut hodiernae sollemnitatis munus acceptum intercedente beato Silvestro confessore tuo atque pontifice et corporibus nostris salutem praestet et mentibus.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that the service of today's solemnity, with the intercession of the blessed Pope and Confessor Silvester, may grant health to our bodies and peace to our minds.

text: Sancti Pauli eremitae tui maiestati tuae nos quaesumus Domine commendet oratio et pro nobis ipso intercedente ad gaudia aeterna perducas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to commend our prayer to the sanctity of Paul the hermit and let him intercede for us. May he guide us to eternal joys.

text: Appositum sacrificium pro laude nominis tui quaesumus Domine suscipe ut quod pro Ecclesia tua offerimus interveniente beato Paulo eremita tuo fiat ei salutiferum remedium.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to accept the offering made for your praise. May it be beneficial to remedy for the church that we offer, with blessed Paul the hermit participating in it.

text: Sumpsimus Domine munus nostrae redemptionis in honore sancti Pauli eremitae tui qui tibi placuit ‹ut› ipso pro nobis te obsecrante ab hoste maligno redde securos.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the pledge of our redemption in honor of your hermit saint Paul, who pleased you, that through him, as we entreat you, you may deliver us safely from the malicious enemy.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum praesta quaesumus ut beati Hilarii confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius celebrandam veneramur festivitatem eius precibus indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: God, rewarder of the souls of faithful people, grant us that we may obtain the indulgence through the prayers as we celebrate the feast day of your confessor and bishop, Blessed Hilary.

text: Sancti Hilarii confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine annua sollemnitas pietati tuae nos reddat acceptos ut per haec piae oblationis officia et illum beata retributio comitetur et nobis gratiae tuae dona conciliet.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the annual solemnity of your confessor and bishop Saint Hilary may return us to your piety, so that through these acts of pious offerings and the blessed reward, it may accompany him and bring together for us the gifts of your grace.

text: Divina Domine libantes mysteria quae in honore sancti confessoris tui atque pontificis Hilarii [tuae] obtulimus maiestati praesta quaesumus ut per ea veniam mereamur peccatorum et caelestis doni gratia reficiamur.
translation_en: Divine Lord, we offer the mysteries that we have presented in honor of your saintly confessor and bishop Hilary [yours]. We humbly ask that through these mysteries, we may deserve forgiveness for our sins and be refreshed with heavenly grace.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ad meliorem vitam sancti Felicis martyris tui exempla nos provocent quatenus cuius sollemnia agimus etiam actus imitemur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the example of Your saintly Martin, the martyr, may provoke us to a better life. May we not only celebrate his feast day, but also emulate his actions.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro commemoratione sancti Felicis martyris tui offerimus suppliciter deprecantes ut sicut illi praebuisti sacrae fidei largitatem sic nobis indulgentiam largiaris et pacem.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, hostias (offerings) in commemoration of Saint Felicus, your martyr, humbly beseeching You. May it be as You granted him generosity in the sacred faith, so You grant us indulgence and peace.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem beati Mauri confessoris tui atque abbatis sacro transitu consecrasti concede propitius in offensis per eius instituta gressibus pergere ut in eiusdem regione viventium mereamur gaudiis admisceri.
translation_en: God, who on this day consecrated the passing of your blessed confessor and abbot St. Maurice, graciously grant that we may walk in his teachings, so that among those living in his region, we may deserve to share in his joys.

text: Oblata nostrae servitutis munera quaesumus Domine ut intercessio beati Mauri confessoris tui tibi reddat accepta.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings of our service may through the intercession of your confessor Saint Maurice return acceptable to you.

text: Sumpta sacramenta quaesumus Domine ut beati Mauri confessoris tui supplicatione placatus et nobis peccatorum indulgentiam et vitam largiaris aeternam.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to bestow upon us the sacred mysteries, that through the intercession of blessed Maurice your confessor, appeased by his prayers, you may grant us forgiveness for our sins and eternal life.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera dignanter oblata et beati Marcelli martyris tui atque pontificis suffragantibus meritis ad nostrae salutis auxilium provenire concede.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offerings graciously bestowed and through the merits of your blessed martyr Marcellus and bishop, grant that they may come to our aid for the help of our salvation.

text: Deus qui per gloriosi confessoris tui Antonii merita ignis [in]visibilis ardorem exstingui voluisti tribue quaesumus ut eius interventione ab aeterno incendio liberemur.
translation_en: God, who willed through the merits of your glorious confessor St. Anthony to extinguish the invisible fire's burning heat, we humbly ask that through his intervention, we may be freed from eternal fire.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod ad laudem et honorem nominis tui deferimus intercedentibus meritis beati Antonii confessoris tui placatus suscipe et eius sanctissimis precibus a nostrorum nos peccatorum vinculis absolve.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, which we bring for the praise and honor of your name, through the merits of blessed Antonius, your pleased one, accept it, and through his most holy prayers release us from our sins' bonds.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quos pane caelesti satiasti precibus et meritis beati Antonii confessoris tui ab hoste maligno defende.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that you, whom we have satisfied with heavenly bread through our prayers and the merits of blessed Anthony, the confessor, defend us from the malevolent enemy.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatae Priscae virginis et martyris tuae natalicia colimus et annua sollemnitate laetemur et tantae fidei proficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that we may celebrate the birthday of your blessed virgin and martyr Prisca with devotion, rejoice on her annual feast day, and advance in faith through her example.

text: Hostias Domine quaesumus quas beatae Priscae virginis et martyris tuae natalicia recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvant et tuae nobis misericordiae dona concilient.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offerings we present in commemoration of the birth of the blessed virgin and martyr Prisca, may loose our bonds of sinfulness and bring us the gifts of your mercy.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum cum sanctorum martyrum tuorum tibi patrocinio supplicantem ut et temporalis vitae nos tribuas pace gaudere et aeternum reperire subsidium.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, your people who are pleading with you through the intercession of your holy martyrs. May you grant us to enjoy peace in this temporal life and find eternal support.

text: Preces tuorum Domine respice oblationesque fidelium et ut tibi grata sint pro tuorum festivitate sanctorum et nobis conferant tuae propitiationis auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, look upon the prayers of your servants and regard their offerings. May they be pleasing to you on account of the feast day of your saints, and may their intercession grant us help from your mercy.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporali celebramus actione perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, through the intercession of your holy martyrs, we humbly ask that what we celebrate temporally may be attained by us in a perpetual action for eternal salvation.

text: Sacro munere satiati supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quod debitae servitutis celebramus officio intercedente beato Sebastiano martyre tuo salvationis tuae sentiamus augmentum.
translation_en: Having been filled by the sacred office, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that through the intercession of your martyr Saint Sebastian, we may feel an increase in your salvation.

text: Sumentes Domine gaudia sempiterna de participatione sacramenti festivitatis sanctae martyris tuae Agnetis suppliciter deprecamur ut quae sedula servitute donante te gerimus dignis sensibus tuo munere capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we take eternal joy from the participation in the festivity of your holy martyr Agnes. Humbly, we beseech you, that since we serve you diligently by giving ourselves to your service, we may, with worthy senses, partake in your gift.

text: Adesto supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus ut qui ex iniquitate nostra reos nos esse cognoscimus beati Vincentii martyris tui intercessione liberemur.
translation_en: Assist our supplications, Almighty God, that we who know ourselves to be guilty according to our iniquity, may by the intercession of your blessed martyr Saint Vincent, be freed.

text: Suscipe Domine munera nostra pro commemoratione beati martyris tui Vincentii ut sicut illum passio fecit gloriosum ita nos devotio reddat innocuos.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our offerings for the commemoration of your blessed martyr Vincent, that just as his passion made him glorious, so may our devotion make us innocent.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia alimenta percepimus intercedente beato Vincentio martyre tuo per haec contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: We ask You, Almighty God, that we who have received celestial nourishment through the intercession of Your blessed martyr Saint Vincent, may be fortified against all adversities through these [sacraments or rituals].

text: Tuam misericordiam omnipotens Deus deprecamur ut sanctae virginis et martyris tuae Emerentianae precibus tuam indulgentiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly implore the almighty God that through the prayers of your holy virgin and martyr Emerentiana, we may deserve to obtain your mercy and indulgence.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine sacrae plebis oblatio pro honore sanctae Emerentianae virginis cuius meritis se percepisse in tribulatione cognoscit auxilium.
translation_en: May this offering of the holy people be accepted by you, Lord, on behalf of the honor of Saint Emerentiana the Virgin. Through her merits, it is known that she received aid during times of trouble.

text: Iugiter nos Domine sanctae Emerentianae virginis vota laetificent et eiusdem nobis patrocinia ipsa semper festivitas exhibeat.
translation_en: May the vows of the ever-blessed Lady St. Emerentiana constantly bring us joy, and may her very self always show us her patronage in festival.

text: Deus qui universum mundum beati Pauli apostoli tui praedicatione docuisti da nobis quaesumus ut cuius hodie conversionem colimus per eius ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God who taught the whole world through the preaching of your apostle Saint Paul, grant us we ask that we may be enriched by whose conversion we celebrate today, through his examples.

text: Apostoli tui Pauli precibus Domine plebis tuae dona sanctifica ut quae tibi tuo grata sunt instituto officio gratiora fiant patrocinio supplicantis.
translation_en: Lord, through the intercessions of your apostle Paul, grant and sanctify to your people what is pleasing to you. May what is already acceptable to you through your institution become even more honorable through their service, and may it be made more pleasing by the petition of the supplicant.

text: Satiati Domine salutari mysterio quaesumus ut pro nobis eius non desit oratio cuius nos dedisti patrocinio gubernari.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, to satisfy us with the saving mystery. May his prayer for us never cease, whose patronage you have given us to govern.

text: Votiva Domine pro beati martyris tui Praeiecti passione dona percepimus quaesumus ut eius precibus et praesentis vitae nobis pariter et aeternae tribue conferre subsidium.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the vows made to Your blessed martyr Praiectus through his passion. We humbly ask You to grant us that he may intercede for us and bestow upon us both in this life and in the eternal one support through his prayers.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus beati Iuliani confessoris tui atque pontificis nos sequi exempla cuius gloriosa celebramus sollemnia.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that we may follow the examples of your blessed confessor and pope, St. Julian, whose glorious feast we are celebrating.

text: Hostias Domine quas tibi offerimus propitius suscipe ut intercedente beato Iuliano confessore tuo atque pontifice per haec piae placationis officia vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolve.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive the offerings we present to you. May they be accepted through the intercession of Blessed Julian, your confessor and pope, that through these holy acts of penance, the bonds of our sins may be forgiven.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut de perceptis muneribus gratias exhibentes intercedente beato Iuliano confessore tuo atque pontifice beneficia potiora sumamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that having offered thanks for the gifts received, with the intercession of your blessed confessed Julien and Pope, we may obtain greater blessings.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatae Agnetis martyris tuae sollemnitate laetificas da ut quam veneramur officio etiam piae conversationis sequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God who delights us with the feast of the blessed Agnes, your martyr, grant that we may not only honor her service in office but also follow her example in pious conduct.

text: Super has quaesumus Domine hostias benedictio copiosa descendat quae et sanctificationem in nobis clementer operetur et de beatae Agnetis martyris tuae sollemnitate laetificet.
translation_en: Upon these, Lord, we humbly ask that a copious blessing descends which not only sanctifies us gently but also fills us with joy from the solemnity of your blessed Martyr Agnes.

text: Sumpsimus Domine celebritatis annuae votiva sacramenta praesta quaesumus ut et temporalis vitae remedia praebeant et aeternae.
translation_en: We have taken up, Lord, the vows of annual solemnity; grant us, we beseech Thee, that temporal aids may be provided and eternal ones as well.

text: Deus qui in beata Brigida et fidei meritum et virginitatis integritatem consecrasti concede propitius ut apud misericordiam tuam eius precibus adiuvemur cuius castitatis irradiamur exemplis.
translation_en: God, who consecrated in blessed Bridget both the merits of faith and the integrity of virginity, graciously grant that we may be helped by her prayers within your mercy. May we be enlightened by examples of her chastity.

text: Hanc Domine quaesumus oblationem pro commemoratione beatae Brigidae virginis tuae maiestati oblatam benigna pietate suscipe et nobis eius suffragantibus meritis ad aeternam salutem provenire concede.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that this offering be made for the commemoration of blessed Brigid, virgin, before your majesty. May it be graciously received by your benevolent pity and grant us, through her intercession, to attain eternal salvation.

text: Quos caelesti Domine refectione satiasti quaesumus beatae Brigidae virginis tuae meritis et intercessionibus a cunctis eripe propitiatus adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord of heaven, who have satisfied the ones with celestial nourishment, that through the merits of your blessed virgin Bridget and her intercessions, You would be gracious to free them from all dangers and adversities.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine plebem tuam ut quae extrinsecus annua devotione tribuis venerari interius assequi gratiae tuae luce concede.
translation_en: Hear us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, Thy people, that those who pay an annual devotion to Thee outwardly may also attain the grace of Thy love inwardly. Grant it through the light of Thy favor.

text: Domine Sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus benedicere et sanctificare digneris ignem istum quem nos indigni suscipimus per invocationem Unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi quem hodie in templo praesentatum iustum Simeonem diu exspectantem in ulnis suscepisse novimus et salutare tuum ante faciem omnium populorum esse lumen scilicet gentibus et gloriam plebis tuae Israel prophetico spiritu docuit Te quaesumus Domine benedicere digneris lumen istud et omnibus illud manu gestantibus verum lumen tuae maiestatis concede ut te agnoscentes te diligentes te quaerentes per viam virtutum ad te valeant pervenire.
translation_en: O Lord, Almighty Father, eternal God, may You deem worthy to bless and sanctify this fire which we, unworthy, receive through the invocation of Your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, whom today they present in the temple just Simeon has long awaited in his arms. We know that Your salvation was a light for all peoples, and by a prophetic spirit You taught that it would be a glory for Your chosen people Israel. Therefore, we humbly ask You, Lord, to bless this light, and may You grant true light of Your majesty to those who carry it, so that recognizing You, loving You, seeking You through the ways of virtues, they may be able to reach You.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodierna die Unigenitum tuum ulnis sancti Simeonis in templo sancto tuo suscipiendum praesentasti tuam deprecamur supplices clementiam ut hos cereos quos nos famuli tui in tui nominis magnificentiam suscipientes gestare cupimus luce accensos benedicere et sanctificare atque lumine supernae benedictionis accendere digneris quatenus eos tibi Domino Deo nostro offerendo digni et sancto igne tuae dulcissimae caritatis accensi in templo sancto gloriae tuae repraesentari mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who today showed yourself in the holy temple presenting your Only-begotten to the hands of Saint Simeon, we humbly beseech you for mercy. Grant that we, your servants, who take up these candles in your glorious name, may bless and sanctify them with light enkindled; and with the radiance of heavenly blessing, enlighten us, that being worthy to offer them to you, our Lord God, we may be found worthy to represent your holy temple with a fire kindled by your most sweet love.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens Creator caeli et terrae rex regum et Dominus dominantium exaudi nos famulos tuos clamantes et orantes ad te Precamur te Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui omnia ex nihilo creasti qui iussu tuo per opera apum hunc liquorem ad perfectionem cerei venire fecisti et qui hodierna die petitionem iusti Simeonis implesti te humiliter deprecamur ut has candelas ad usus hominum et salutem animarum et corporum /119r/ sive in terra sive in aquis per invocationem tui sancti nominis et per intercessionem sanctae Mariae Virginis Genitricis Filii tui cuius hodie festa devoti percolimus et per preces omnium sanctorum tuorum benedicere et sanctificare digneris ut haec plebs tua illas honorifice in manibus portans cantando teque laudando a te pio Domino exaudiatur de caelo sancto tuo et de sede maiestatis tuae propitiusque sis omnibus clamantibus ad te quos redemisti pretioso sanguine Filii tui.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, Creator of heaven and earth, King of kings and Lord of lords, hear us your servants as we call out to you and pray to you. We humbly beseech you, holy Father omnipotent eternal God who created all things from nothing, who caused this oil to come to the perfection of wax by your command, and who fulfilled the petition of the just Simon today, we beseech you humbly to bless and sanctify these candles for use by mankind and for the salvation of souls and bodies, whether on land or in water, through the invocation of your holy name and through the intercession of the Holy Virgin Mary, Mother of your Son, whose feast we are celebrating today, and through the prayers of all your saints. We beseech you to grant that this people carrying them in their hands may sing your praise and be heard by you, the gracious Lord from heaven, and show mercy to all who call out to you whom you have redeemed with the precious blood of your Son.

text: Benedic Domine Iesu Christe hanc creaturam cerae supplicantibus nobis et infunde ei per crucis sanctae virtutem benedictionem caelestem ut qui eam ad repellendas tenebras humano generi tribuisti talem signaculo sanctae crucis tuae fortitudinem et benedictionem accipiat ut in quibuscumque locis accensa sive imposita fuerit discedat et contremescat ille malignus diabolus et fugiat pavidus cum omnibus ministris suis de habitationibus illis nec praesumat amplius inquietare servientes Deo Proinde supplices quaesumus Domine ut emittas angelum tuum Raphaelem ut qui evulsit et expulit a Sara et Tobia daemonem mortiferum et infestantem conterat illum et perdat de cunctis habitationibus colentium Deum de basilicis de domibus de angulis de lectulis de refectoriis de cunctis locis in quibuscumque Deo famulantes habitant et requiescunt dormiunt vigilant ambulant et consistunt non valeat amplius inquietare vel pavorem immittere super illos quos chrismatis tui unctio fecit esse munitos Benedico te creatura cerae in nomine Domini Dei nostri et Sanctae Trinitatis ut sis exterminatio diaboli et omnium contubernalium eius.
translation_en:
Bless, Lord Jesus Christ, this creation of wax before us, supplicating to us, and infuse it with the holy power of the cross so that whoever you gave this sign of holy cross to as a means to repel darkness, may receive your strength and blessing. May it be lit or placed in any place, the wicked devil trembles and flees, along with all his servants, from their dwellings, and presumes no more to disturb those serving God. Therefore, we humbly ask you, Lord, to send your angel Raphael who expelled and cast out the deadly and troublesome demon from Sara and Tobias, to crush and destroy him, and drive him out of all dwellings of those worshiping God - in basilicas, homes, corners, beds, dining rooms, every place where they serve and rest, sleep or wake, walk or stand. May he not be able any longer to disturb or cause fear upon them whom your chrism made secure.
Blessed are you, wax creation, in the name of our Lord God and Holy Trinity. Be an extinction of the devil and all his companions.

text: Qui per serenissimam ac placidissimam stellam Genitricem tuam cuius sacratissimum nomen per ineffabile et inenarrabile meritum stella maris interpretatur humanum genus illuminare dignatus es Pro hoc maximo gaudio hodierna die ovantes et ideo in nostris manibus venerabiliter candelas ferentes et incessabili voce clamantes ut pro dulcissimo amore et clementissima intercessione tuae dignae Genitricis semperque Virginis nos indignos sed tamen pretioso sanguine tuo redemptos te aeterno ac lumine vero facias clementer perfrui.
translation_en: Who, through the most serene and tranquil star, your Mother, whose sacred name is interpreted as the star of the sea by ineffable and indescribable merit, deigned to illuminate the human race on this day. For this greatest joy, we humbly bring candles and unceasingly cry out with a fervent voice that through your sweet love and most merciful intercession, our unworthy selves, yet still redeemed by your precious blood, may be allowed to enjoy you eternally and truly.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per Moysen famulum tuum purissimum olei liquorem ad luminaria ante conspectum tuum iugiter continuanda praeparari iussisti benedictionis tuae gratiam super hos cereos benignus infunde quatenus sic administrent lumen exterius ut te donante lumen Sancti Spiritus in nostris non desit cordibus interius.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through Moses, Your servant, commanded the purest oil liquid to be continuously prepared for the lamps before Your face, pour Your blessing on these candles graciously. May they so administer light externally, that with the light given by You, the Holy Spirit, may not fail in our hearts internally.

text: Illumina quaesumus Domine populum tuum et splendore gratiae tuae cor eius semper accende ut Salvatorem suum incessanter agnoscat et veraciter apprehendat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to enlighten your people and always kindle the heart of one with the splendor of your grace, so that he may continually recognize and truly grasp his Savior.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et ut digna sint munera quae oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus subsidium tuae pietatis impende.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, and let the gifts we present with our eyes to your majesty be worthy of your mercy's support.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacrosancta mysteria quae pro reparationis [nostrae] munimine contulisti intercedente beata et semper Virgine Maria et praesens nobis remedium esse facias et futurum.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, that the most sacred mysteries which you have bestowed upon us for our repentance, with the intercession of the blessed and ever Virgin Mary, may be present to us now as a remedy, and may it also come to pass.

text: Beati Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis intercessione quaesumus omnipotens Deus noxios semper incursus comprime et salutarem temporibus nostris propitius da quietem.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God through the intercession of your blessed martyr and bishop, Blasius, to always crush our harmful attacks and graciously give us peace in our times.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine beati Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis munera nostra tibi commendet nosque tuae maiestati reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We entreat You, Lord, the blessed Martyr and Bishop Basil, to present our offerings to You and to render us acceptable to Your majesty.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis suffragia placare te nobis per haec sumpta sacramenta valeant et nos tibi placere perficiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God that through the intercession of blessed Bishop Blaise, your martyr and pontiff, these received sacraments may be effective for us, and that they may help us to please you.

text: Deus qui inter cetera potentiae tuae miracula etiam in sexu fragili victoriam martyrii contulisti concede propitius ut qui beatae Agathae virginis et martyris tuae natalicia colimus per eius ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God, who among other miracles bestowed victory even in frail sex to the martyrdom, grant us graciously that we who celebrate the natal day of your blessed virgin and martyr Agatha, may be worthy through her examples to approach you.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae in beatae Agathae virginis et martyris tuae sollemnitate deferimus cuius nos confidimus patrocinio liberari.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings that we bring on the solemnity of your blessed virgin and martyr Agatha, whom we trust in for deliverance through her patronage.

text: Auxilientur nobis Domine sumpta mysteria et intercedente beata Agatha virgine et martyre tua sempiterna protectione confirment.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, with your sacred mysteries, and through the intercession of blessed Agatha, virgin and martyr, confirm your eternal protection upon us.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus in cuius nomine gloriosa virgo et martyr Dorothea multorum genera tormentorum superavit te suppliciter exoramus ut eius interventu cuncta pericula corporis et animae devincamus ipsamque in nostris necessitatibus celerem adiutricem adesse sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, in whose name the glorious virgin and martyr Dorothea overcame many kinds of torments, we humbly entreat you that through her intervention we may overcome all dangers of body and soul. May we feel her as a swift helper in our necessities.

text: Hostias Domine beatae virginis et martyris tuae Dorotheae benignus assumas et nos per eam ad tuae benignitatis et perennitatis felicitatem perducas.
translation_en: Lord, graciously accept the offerings of your blessed virgin and martyr Dorothea, and through her may we be led to your benevolence and everlasting happiness.

text: Sacro pignore tuo Domine vegetati concede propicius ut auxiliante nobis beata Dorothea virgine et martyre tua omnium peccatorum nostrorum nexibus liberemur et in tua semper consolatione gratulemur.
translation_en: In your sacred promise, Lord, grant us graciously through the aid of blessed Dorothea, your virgin and martyr, that we may be freed from all our sins' fetters and always rejoice in your consolation.

text: Aeterne ac mitissime Deus qui ad toleranda pro tui nominis gloria carnis tormenta electos tuos spiritu fortitudinis roborare non desistis concede propitius ut qui gloriosissimae virginis ac martyris tuae Apolloniae quam excussis dentibus pro tui nominis confessione morte acerbissima triumphare fecisti martyrium colimus ipsius meritis et precibus a dolore dentium et ab omni languore corporis et animae protegi et liberari mereamur. ... eiusdem
translation_en: Eternally and most merciful God, who do not cease to strengthen your elect with the spirit of fortitude for bearing the torments of flesh for the glory of your name, grant us graciously, that we may be protected from pain in teeth and from all corporal and spiritual suffering, and merit to be freed, through the merits and prayers of the glorious virgin and martyr Apollonia, whom you made triumph over the most bitter death by pulling out her teeth for the confession of your name. ... of the same.

text: Oblata tibi Domine munera quaesumus sanctifica quae in natalicio sanctae Apolloniae virginis tuae recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvant et tuae nobis misericordiae dona concilient.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to sanctify the gifts presented to you, which we offer on the nativity of your virgin Saint Apollonia. May these offerings loosen the bonds of our sinfulness and unite us with your mercy.

text: Perceptis Domine salutaribus sacramentis tuam piissimam suppliciter exoramus clementiam ut beata virgine ac martyre tua Apollonia intercedente quae pro illius veneranda gerimus passione nobis ad medelam corporis et animae proficiant sempiternam.
translation_en: Perceiving, Lord, the salutary sacraments we humbly beseech your greatest clemency that, through the intercession of your blessed virgin and martyr Apollonia, who suffered for Your venerable passion, may there be profit for us in healing both body and soul, forever.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine beatae virginis tuae Scholasticae meritis propitius respice ut sicut ipsius precibus ad obtinendum quod concupivit imbrem caelitus descendere fecisti ita eius supplicationibus ariditatem nostri cordis supernae digneris gratiae rore perfundere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, of your blessed virgin Scholastica, that you, through her merits, may look favorably upon us so that, just as through her prayers you made heavenly rain descend to fulfill her desire, likewise through her supplications, you may deign to sprinkle the dryness of our heart with the dew of your grace.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine ob honorem sanctae virginis tuae Scholasticae munus oblatum et quod nostris non valemus assequi meritis eiusdem suffragantibus meritis largire propitius.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, on account of the honor of your holy virgin Scholastica, the offering brought and what we ourselves are unable to obtain through our merits, grant it graciously through her intercessions.

text: Quos Domine caelesti refectione satiasti quaesumus beatae Scholasticae virginis tuae meritis a cunctis eripe propitiatus adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, who have filled the saints with celestial refreshment according to your mercy, through the merits of Blessed Scholastica, the virgin, free them from all adversities.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Valentini martyris tui natalicia colimus a cunctis malis imminentibus eius intercessionibus liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O Almighty God, that we who celebrate the natal day of your blessed martyr Valentinus, may be freed from all dangers threatening us through his intercessions.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus in festivitate sanctae virginis et martyris tuae Iulianae congrua devotione gaudere ut et potentiam tuam in eius passione laudemus et provisum nobis percipiamus auxilium.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask You, Almighty God, on the feast of Your holy virgin and martyr Julian, that with fitting devotion we may rejoice, so that we may also praise Your power in her passion and receive the help prepared for us.

text: In sanctae Iulianae virginis et martyris tuae passione pretiosa te Domine mirabilem praedicantes munera votiva deferimus praesta quaesumus ut sicut eius grata sunt merita sic nostrae servitutis accepta reddantur officia.
translation_en: In the passion of your Saint Julian, virgin and martyr, you are wondrously proclaimed as precious gifts. We bring our vow-offerings to you. Graciously grant us, we ask, that just as her merits are pleasing to you, so may our services be accepted.

text: Libantes Domine mensae tuae beata mysteria quaesumus ut sanctae Iulianae virginis et martyris tuae intervenientibus gloriosis meritis et praesentem nobis misericordiam conferant et aeternam.
translation_en: Lifting up, Lord, your blessed mysteries, we humbly ask that through the intercession of the glorious merits of Saint Julian the Virgin and Martyr, they may grant us your merciful presence now and eternal salvation.

text: Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus Domine preces et hostias beati Petri apostoli tibi commendet oratio ut quod pro illius gloria celebramus nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the prayers and offerings of the blessed apostle St. Peter may be presented to You by the prayer of Your church. May what we celebrate for his glory benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Laetificet nos Domine munus oblatum ut sicut in apostolo Petro te mirabilem praedicamus sic per illum tuae sumamus indulgentiae largitatem.
translation_en: Let us be uplifted, O Lord, by the offering made to you, that just as we proclaim your marvelous deeds in the apostle Peter, so through him may we receive the abundance of your mercy's indulgence.

text: Deus qui proditoris apostatae ruinam ne apostolorum numerus sacratus perfectione careret beati Matthiae electione supplesti praesentia munera sanctifica et per ea nos gratiae tuae virtute confirma.
translation_en: God, who did not allow the number of apostles to lack perfection by the choice of blessed Matthew in supplying the ruin of the faith-traitor, bestows upon us sacred gifts through His presence and strengthens us with Your grace's power through them.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus interveniente beato Matthia apostolo tuo veniam consequamur et gratiam.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty and merciful God, that through these holy things which we have taken part in, with the intervention of your blessed apostle Matthew, we may obtain forgiveness and grace.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus admitte et dicatum tibi sacrificium beatae Walpurgae virginitas commendet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive our prayers and may the consecrated offering of Blessed Walburga's virginity present them to you.

text: Sanctae Walpurgae precibus confidentes quaesumus Domine ut per ea quae sumpsimus aeterna dona capiamus.
translation_en: With confidence in the prayers of Saint Walpurga, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through what we have received from her, we may obtain eternal gifts.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam beati Thomae confessoris tui mira eruditione clarificas et sancta conversatione fecundas da nobis quaesumus ‹ut› ea quae docuit intellecta conspicere et quae egit imitatione complere.
translation_en: God, who enlightens your Church through the remarkable learning of your confessor Saint Thomas and makes it fruitful through holy living, grant us that we may perceive what he taught with understanding and complete what he did by imitation.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut interveniente beato Thoma confessore tuo in cuius festivitate tua sancta sumpsimus sacramenta per quae in tua misericordia permanentes vitam aeternam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that with the intervention of Blessed Thomas the Confessor, on whose feast day we have taken your sacred sacraments through which we hope to remain in your mercy and merit eternal life.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster sanctarum martyrum tuarum Perpetuae et Felicitatis palmas incessabili devotione venerari et earum iugiter supplicatione muniri.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask You, Lord our God, that we may continually honor with uninterrupted devotion the palms of Your holy martyrs Perpetua and Felicitas, and be always protected by their constant intercession.

text: Intende quaesumus Domine munera altaribus tuis pro sanctarum martyrum tuarum Perpetuae et Felicitatis commemoratione proposita ut sicut per haec beata mysteria illis gloriam contulisti ita nobis indulgentiam largiaris.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, to bestow gifts upon your altars in memory of the holy martyrs Perpetua and Felicitas, that just as through these blessed mysteries you granted them glory, so you may grant us indulgence.

text: Laeti sumpsimus Domine caelestia sacramenta intercedentibus sanctis virginibus tuis Perpetua et Felicitate ad vitam nobis proficiant sempiternam.
translation_en: We have gladly received, Lord, your heavenly sacraments, through the intercession of your holy virgins Perpetua and Felicitas, may they lead us to an eternal life.

text: Annue nobis Domine quaesumus ut intercedente beato Gregorio nobis haec prosit oblatio quam immolando totius mundi tribuisti relaxare delicta.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, that with the intercession of blessed Gregory may this offering benefit us, which You have granted to be offered by the whole world to relieve sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodierna die carnis eductum ergastulo beatissimum confessorem tuum Benedictum sublevasti ad caelum concede quaesumus haec festa tuis famulis celebrantibus cunctorum veniam delictorum ut qui exsultantibus animis eius claritati congaudent ipso apud te interveniente consocientur et meritis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who today lifted up your most blessed confessor Benedict from the prison, we humbly ask that you grant that this feast may be celebrated by your servants with forgiveness of sins for all. May those who rejoice in his clarity also celebrate him, and may they be joined with him before you when he intercedes on their behalf and through his merits.

text: Oblatis Domine ob honorem nominis tui beati confessoris tui Benedicti placare muneribus ut ipsius interventu tuis famulis cunctorum tribuas indulgentiam peccatorum.
translation_en: Lord, on behalf of the honor of your blessed confesor St. Benedict, grant mercy through these offerings so that through his intervention you may bestow forgiveness for the sins of all your servants.

text: Perceptis Domine Deus noster salutaribus sacramentis suppliciter deprecamur ut intercedente beato Benedicto abbate quae pro illius venerando agimus obitu nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord God, we humbly beseech you, receiving your salutary sacraments, that through the intercession of Blessed Benedict, abbot, what we do in honor of his venerable death may profit us for our salvation.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam beati Ambrosii confessoris tui atque pontificis doctrinis et meritis illuminare dignatus es praesta quaesumus ut qui eius sollemnia celebramus etiam patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who has deemed fit to illuminate your Church through the teachings and merits of blessed Ambrose, your confessor and bishop, grant us our prayer, that we, who celebrate his solemnities, may also feel his patronage.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine laudis offerimus pro sancti celebritate pontificis Ambrosii ut propitiationem tuam quam nostris operibus non meremur eius piis intercessionibus assequamur.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, a sacrifice of praise for the holy occasion of Bishop Ambrose. May we, who do not deserve your forgiveness through our own works, obtain it through his pious intercessions.

text: Tua sancta sumentes quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut beati Ambrosii confessoris tui atque pontificis nos foveant continua praesidia.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord our God, that Your holy ones may protect us continuously, as the blessed Ambrose, Your confessioner and bishop, have done.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras quas in sancti Leonis confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnitate deferimus ut qui tibi digne meruit famulari eius intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, our prayers which we present during the solemnity of your confessor and bishop Saint Leonard, that those who have deservedly served you may intercede on our behalf with their merits, and absolve us from all sins.

text: Sancti Leonis confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine annua sollemnitas pietati tuae nos reddat acceptos et per haec piae devotionis officia illum beata retributio comitetur et nobis gratiae tuae dona conciliet.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the annual solemnity of your confessor and bishop Saint Leo brings us acceptance to your piety. May he be accompanied by the blessed reward of his pious devotion, and may the gifts of your grace unite with us.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum praesta ut beati Leonis confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius venerandam celebramus festivitatem eius precibus indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: God, rewarder of the faithful souls, grant that we may attain indulgence through the prayers for your blessed confessor and bishop whose feast day we honor today.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus sanctae martyris tuae Euphemiae exsultare meritis et beneficiorum eius attolli suffragiis.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask You, Almighty God, that through the merits of Your holy martyr Euphrosyne, we may rejoice and raise up our prayers through her intercessions.

text: Muneribus te Domine magnificamus oblatis quibus in sanctae Euphemiae nobis sollemnitatibus et gaudia aeterna concilies et patrocinia largiaris.
translation_en: We magnify you, Lord, with the offerings we bring, by which you unite for us eternal festivities and joys in the feast of Saint Euphemia, and bestow your patronage.

text: Sanctae martyris tuae Euphemiae nos precatio tibi Domine grata comitetur et tuam nobis indulgentiam poscere non desistat.
translation_en: May the prayer to your holy martyr Euphrosyne, Lord, accompany us with pleasant favor, and may it never cease for us to ask for your mercy.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sanctorum martyrum tuorum Tiburtii et Valeriani et Maximi sollemnia colimus eorum etiam virtutes imitemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the solemnities of Your saints Tiburtius, Valerian, and Maximus, may also imitate their virtues.

text: Haec Domine quaesumus hostia quam in sanctorum tuorum nataliciis recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the sacrifice which we offer in remembrance of your saints' birthdays may loose the bonds of our wickedness and bring us together with your mercy.

text: Caelesti munere satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut haec nobis dona sanctorum martyrum tuorum supplicatione beata prodesse proficiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord our God, that those gifts of Your holy martyrs, being satisfied by celestial favor, may indeed profit us through their blessed intercession.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodierna die beatum Adalbertum martyrem tuum atque pontificem merito passionis sanctis tuis coaequasti tribue quaesumus ut meritis ipsius per vitae eius exempla gradiamur et ad aeternam patriam pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day equated your blessed Adalbert, martyr and bishop, with your holy passions, we humbly ask that through the merits of his life, we may be favored by grace according to his examples and may merit to reach eternal life.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beati Adalberti martyris tui atque pontificis dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, graciously accept the offerings dedicated to Your blessed martyr and bishop Saint Adalbert, and grant us that they may continually provide support for us.

text: Beati Adalberti martyris tui atque pontificis intercessione Domine placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporali celebramus actione perpetua capiamus salvatione.
translation_en: Through the intercession of your martyr and bishop, Saint Adalbert, we humbly ask, Lord, that you be pleased. May it be granted that what we celebrate temporarily, we may obtain everlasting salvation.

text: Praefatio de apostolis
translation_en: Preface of the Apostles

text: Tribuant nobis Domine quaesumus continuum tua sancta praesidium quod beati Marci evangelistae tui precibus nos ab omnibus semper tueantur adversis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, a continued protection of your holy presidency, that the blessed Apostle Mark, your evangelist, may always guard us against all dangers through his prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Petri martyris tui fidem congrua devotione sectemur qui pro eiusdem fidei dilatatione martyrii palmam meruit obtinere.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, almighty God, that we may follow the faith of your blessed martyr St. Peter with congruent devotion, who merited to obtain the palm of his martyrdom for the expansion of the same faith.

text: Preces quas tibi Domine offerimus intercedente beato Petro martyre tuo clementer intende et pervigiles fidei sub tua protectione custodi.
translation_en: Prayers which we offer to you, Lord, through your blessed martyr St. Peter, we humbly entreat you to consider favorably. And through your power, keep the vigilant guardians of faith under your protection awake.

text: Fideles tuos Domine custodiant sacramenta quae sumpsimus et intercedente beato Petro martyre tuo contra omnes adversos tueantur incursus.
translation_en: Lord, may your faithful keep the sacraments which we have received, and under the intercession of blessed Peter the Martyr, may they be protected against all attacks.

text: Munera Domine quae pro apostolorum tuorum Philippi et Iacobi sollemnitate deferimus propitius suscipe et mala omnia quae meremur propitiatus averte.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive the offerings we bring for the feast of your apostles Philip and James. Turn away from us all the evils that we deserve to be turned away.

text: Quaesumus Domine salutaribus repleti mysteriis ut quorum sollemnia celebramus eorum orationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, filled with sacred mysteries, that as we celebrate their solemnities, may their prayers assist us.

text: Deus ineffabilis misericordiae qui beatissimo Sigismundo regi et martyri tuo tribuisti pro tuo nomine inimicum moriendo vincere concede huic familiae tuae ut ipso intercedente mereatur in se antiqui hostis incitamenta superando exstinguere.
translation_en: God of ineffable mercy, who granted your most blessed king and martyr Sigismund the victory over his enemy dying for Your name, grant this family of Yours that, with him interceding, they may deserve to extinguish the incentives of the ancient enemy by overcoming them.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sanctorum martyrum tuorum Alexandri Eventii et Theoduli natalicia colimus a cunctis malis imminentibus eorum intercessionibus liberemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the birthdays of your saints Alexander, Eventius and Theodulus, we may be freed from all evils impending upon them by their intercessions.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod immolamus placatus intende ut ab omni nos exuas bellorum nequitia et per vexillum sanctae crucis Filii tui ad conterendas potestatis adversae insidias nos in tuae protectionis securitate custodiant.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, which we offer, may you attend with favor, that from all wars' lawlessness you free us, and through the standard of the holy cross of your Son, may they guard us in your protective custody against the snares of opposing power.

text: Refecti participatione muneris sacri quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut cuius exsequimur cultum intervenientibus beatis martyribus tuis sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: Having been refreshed by the participation in the sacred service, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that as we carry out the worship with your blessed martyrs present, we may feel its effect.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Floriani martyris tui gloriosa merita veneramur eius apud te meritis et precibus semper muniamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, to grant that we may revere the glorious merits of your blessed martyr Florian with you, and may always be protected by his deeds and prayers.

text: Sume sacrificium Domine benignus exhibitum et quod nomini tuo Floriani martyris tui sollemnitate offerimus nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: Accept, Lord, this offering presented with kindness, and what we offer on the solemnity of your martyr Florian may benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Refecti Domine muneribus sacris supplices deprecamur ut indulgentiam tuam nobis intercessio beati Floriani martyris tui imploret semper et impetret.
translation_en: Lord, fed with sacred meals, we humbly beseech You, that the intercession of your blessed martyr St. Florentius may always ask for Your indulgence and request it on our behalf.

text: Deus qui populo tuo sanctum Gothardum dedisti praedicatorem concede quaesumus ut tanti pontificis intercessione et tuae pietatis defensione ab omnibus ubique liberemur adversis et tranquilla prosperitate in tua laude laetemur.
translation_en: God who gave to your holy people of Gothard a preacher, we humbly ask that you grant us through the intercession of such a great bishop and your protection, may we be freed from all adversities everywhere and may we rejoice in your praise with peaceful prosperity.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro commemoratione sancti Gothardi confessoris tui offerimus suppliciter deprecantes ut sicut illi praebuisti sacrae fidei claritatem sic nobis indulgentiam largiaris et pacem.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, hosts (offerings) for the commemoration of Saint Gothard, your confessor, supplicating humbly that just as you granted him clarity in sacred faith, so may you grant us forgiveness and peace.

text: Sancti Gothardi confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine veneranda sollemnitas tuae pietati sacrificium nostrum reddat acceptum ut per hanc salutarem hostiam et veniam consequamur et gratiam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, on the venerable feast of your saint Gothard, confessor and bishop, that our sacrifice be received as acceptable by your piety. May we attain salvation through this holy offering, following forgiveness, and grace.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi Domine quaesumus beati Ioannis apostoli tui precatio sancta conciliet ut cuius honore sollemniter exhibetur meritis eius efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the sacred prayer of your blessed Apostle John may bring our sacrifice to you, so that it may be accepted due to his merits when it is solemnly presented in honor of him.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria beati Ioannis apostoli tui festivitate laetantes quae sicut tuis sanctis ad gloriam ita nobis quaesumus ad veniam prodesse perficias.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the divine mysteries of your blessed apostle John, rejoicing in his festivity. As these mysteries brought glory to your saints, we humbly request that they may bring forgiveness to us as well.

text: Populum tuum Domine intercedente beato Stanislao glorioso martyre tuo atque pontifice ungue tuae virtutis potenter defende et solem tuae maiestatis irreverberato mentis radio glorianter intueri concede.
translation_en: Lord, with the intercession of the glorious martyr and bishop, Saint Stanislaus, powerfully defend your people and grant us the ability to gaze upon the unblemished rays of your majesty in glory.

text: Deus qui beatum Michaelem archangelum electionis tuae populis constituisti principem praesta quaesumus ut quem nobis dedisti salutis ducem contra omnia adversa semper tribuas defensorem.
translation_en: God, who set the blessed Michael, the archangel, as prince for your people, grant us that you always provide us with him as a leader in our salvation. We ask that you continually give him as a defender against all adversities.

text: Oblatis Domine placare muneribus et intercedentibus meritis beati Stanislai gloriosi martyris tui atque pontificis adhibito circa nos pio correctionis remedio praesentibus hostiis a nobis hostes quibus impugnamur potenter expelle.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on the offerings and through the merits of the glorious martyr and bishop, St. Stanislaus, intercede for us. With divine correction as our remedy, present to us powerful weapons with which we are attacked, that you may expel our enemies.

text: Beati archangeli tui Michaelis quaesumus Domine nostras preces et hostias maiestati tuae commendet interventio nobisque salutares ipsius efficiantur patrocinio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our prayers and offerings be committed to your majesty through the intervention of your archangel Michael. May his protection be effective for us.

text: Fideles tuos Domine tui sacramenti perceptio mundet semper et muniat et interventu precum beati Stanislai gloriosi martyris tui atque pontificis piis increpationibus correptos tibi faciat complacere.
