translation_en: Lord, may your faithful always be cleansed and fortified by the reception of your sacrament. May the intervention of the prayers of the glorious martyr and bishop Stanislaus please you, and correct those who are corrected by your pious reproofs.

text: Sumpta mensae caelestis sacramenta quaesumus Domine ut beati Michaelis archangeli interventio et corporibus nostris prodesse perficiat et mentibus.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the sacred mysteries taken from the heavenly table may, through the intervention of the blessed Archangel Michael, benefit our bodies and minds.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beatorum martyrum tuorum Gordiani atque Epimachi dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Accept, O Lord, the offerings given to your blessed martyrs Gordian and Epimachus, and, being gracious, grant that they may continue to provide us with eternal support.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia alimenta percepimus intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis Gordiano atque Epimacho per haec contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask Almighty God that we, who have received heavenly nourishment, may be fortified through the intercession of your holy martyrs Gordian and Epimachus, against all adversities.

text: Semper nos Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum Nerei et Achillei atque Pancratii foveat quaesumus beata sollemnitas et tuo dignos reddat obsequio.
translation_en: Always, Lord, may your holy martyrs Nahor and Achilles, and Pancras protect us. We humbly ask that the blessed solemnity favor us and render worthy ones by their service to you.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut beatorum martyrum tuorum Nerei et Achillei atque Pancratii deprecationibus sancta sacramenta quae sumpsimus ad tuae nobis proficiant placationis augmentum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that through the intercessions of your blessed martyrs Neerius, Achilles and Pancras, the holy sacraments we have received may profit us an increase in reconciliation with you.

text: Deus qui populo tuo sanctum dedisti Servatium praedicatorem concede ut tanti pontificis intercessione et tuae pietatis defensione ab omnibus ubique liberemur adversis et tranquilla pace in tua laude laetemur.
translation_en: God, who gave to your holy people the servant Servatius as a preacher, grant that through the intercession of such a great pontiff and under the protection of your mercy we may be freed from all adversities everywhere and enjoy peaceful joy in your praise.

text: Haec oblatio Domine Deus intercedente beato Servatio pontifice ab omnibus nos emundet delictis et tota virtute tuis faciat servire mandatis.
translation_en: This offering, Lord God, through the intercession of blessed Pope Sylvester, may cleanse us from all sins and make us serve your commandments with all your might.

text: Salutis nostrae laeti libantes mysteria praesta quaesumus ut beati Servatii pontificis tui nos semper adiuvet oratio et tua custodiat protectio.
translation_en: Grant us, we entreat, the mysteries of our salvation, that the prayers and protection of your blessed servant Pope Saint Servatius may always aid and safeguard us.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatae Potentianae martyris tuae sollemnitate laetificas da ut quam veneramur officio etiam piae conversationis consequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God, who delights us in the solemnity of your blessed Potentian's martyrdom, grant that we may follow not only with reverence but also with a devout lifestyle the example we venerate.

text: Hostias quas tibi offerimus quaesumus Domine propitius suscipe et intercessionibus beatae Potentianae virginis vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolve.
translation_en: We humbly offer you, Lord, these gifts we ask that you, gracious one, receive them favorably. May the prayers of Blessed Potentiana, Virgin, free us from the bonds of our sins.

text: Praesta quaesumus Deus noster ut intercessione sanctae Potentianae virginis sacramenta quae sumpsimus ad praesentem nobis perpetuamque proficiant salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask God, that through the intercession of Saint Potentiana, the sacraments we have received may benefit us now and forevermore with eternal salvation.

text: Deus qui inter cetera potentiae tuae miracula sexum etiam fragilem virtute rectae intentionis corroboras praesta ut exemplo sanctae Helenae Christianissimae reginae cuius studio desideratum regis nostri lignum detegere dignatus es recte ea quae Christi sunt iugiter indagare atque consequi te favente mereamur.
translation_en: God, who among other miracles strengthens even the fragile sex with the virtue of right intention, grant that we may merit to investigate and obtain what is Christ's continually, as Saint Helena, most Christian queen, did in her quest to uncover the desired wood of our king. May we deserve it with you favoring.

text: Munera populi tui Domine placabilis dextera tua suscipiat et sanctae Helenae suffragantibus meritis et devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: May the gifts of your people, Lord, be accepted by your gracious right hand, through the merits and intercession of Saint Helena, and may it benefit our devotion and wellbeing.

text: Refecti corporis sacri pretiosique sanguinis libamine quaesumus omnipotens Pater ut intercessione beatae Helenae cuius festivo gratulamur officio cunctis malorum nostrorum sordibus exuamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty Father to cleanse us with the precious gift of the holy body and blood, that through the intercession of blessed Helena whom we gladly celebrate today, may we remove all the filth of our sins from ourselves.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatorum martyrum tuorum Donatiani et Rogatiani sollemnia recensentes meritis ipsorum protegamur et precibus.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the solemnities of your blessed martyrs Donatian and Rogatian, we may be protected by their merits and prayers.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Urbani martyris tui atque pontificis sollemnia colimus eius apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who celebrate the feast of Your blessed martyr and bishop Urban may be helped by his intercessions with You.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato Urbano martyre tuo atque pontifice per eadem nos a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Offerings presented to You, Lord, consecrate them, and through the intercession of the blessed Urban, Your martyr and pope, cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Beati Urbani martyris tui atque pontificis Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quod temporali celebramus actione perpetua capiamus salvatione.
translation_en: Blessed Urban, your martyr and bishop, Lord, may you be appeased by your intercession. We humbly ask that what we celebrate temporarily in this world, we may obtain eternally through salvation.

text: Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hodierna die beati Stephani regis et confessoris tui gloriosam dexteram revelasti da nobis in aeterna laetitia de eius protectione gaudere.
translation_en: God who art the splendid glory of your saints and who on this day revealed the glorious right hand of your blessed King Stephen and confessor, grant us to rejoice in eternal joy through his protection.

text: Munera tibi Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus quae et pro sancti Stephani regis et confessoris tui tibi grata sint honore et nobis salutaria te miserante reddantur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the gifts of our devotedness, which may be pleasing to You in honor for Saint Stephen, Your king and confessor. May they, being mercifully returned to us, bring us salvation.

text: Sumpsimus Domine caelestia sacramenta beati Stephani regis et confessoris tui sollemnia celebrantes praesta quaesumus ut ipso interveniente quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the heavenly sacraments of blessed Stephen, your king and confessor, while we celebrate these solemnities. Grant us, we ask, that with his intervention, what we are temporarily managing may lead to eternal joys.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis digne sanctae virginis tuae Petronellae celebrare sollemnia ut qui eius hic appetunt auxilium aeternis effectibus apprehendant.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, worthy to your faithful ones to celebrate the solemnities of your saint, Petronella, that those who seek her help here may grasp it with eternal effectiveness.

text: Haec dona petimus Domine placatus intende quibus et supremum sacrificium continetur et moribus pretiosis hostiam virginis tuae Petronellae tibi placitam consequamur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, with favor inclined, direct your attention to the offering which contains the supreme sacrifice, and we shall follow a pleasing victim, precious in virtue, to your Virgin daughter Petronella.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine gratia tua semper exerceat et quae sumpsimus divinis instaurent corda mysteriis et sanctae virginis tuae Petronellae commemoratione laetificet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your grace may always be exercised among us. May what we have received from the divine mysteries strengthen our hearts, and may the remembrance of your holy virgin Petronella bring joy.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine quam sanctorum tuorum natalicia recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: This offering we humbly ask you, Lord, as we remember the birthdays of your saints; may it cleanse our bonds of sin and unite us with your mercy.

text: Sacro munere satiati supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quod debitae servitutis celebramus officio intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis Marcellino et Petro salvationis tuae sentiamus augmentum.
translation_en: Having been filled with the sacred duty, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that through the intercession of your holy martyrs Marcellinus and Peter, we may feel an increase in the savior's salvation that we celebrate in our due service.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatorum martyrum tuorum Gentini et Laurentini sollemnia colimus eorum apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of your holy martyrs Genthius and Laurentinus, we may be helped by their intercessions with you.

text: Votiva Domine munera deferentes in tuorum.gentini et Laurentini martyrum passione tuam magnificentiam veneramur et per ea nobis imploramus tuae pietatis auxilium.
translation_en: Bringing to you, Lord, our votive offerings among your people, we venerate your majesty in the passion of the martyrs Votiva and Laurence, and through them we humbly implore your aid from your mercy.

text: Intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis.gentino et Laurentino Domine plebi tuae praesta subsidium ut ab omnibus noxiis expedita cuncta sibi percipiat profutura.
translation_en: With the intercession of your holy martyrs, Genitio and Laurencio, Lord, grant aid to your people. May they receive all things set free from every harm, that they may be profitable.

text: Aurem tuam quaesumus Domine precibus nostris inclina ut qui peccatorum nostrorum flagellis percutimur intercedente beato Quirino martyre tuo tua gratia liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to incline your ear to our prayers, so that through the intercession of your martyr Quirinus, we may be freed by your grace from the scourges of our sins.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam muneribus sacris quaesumus beati Quirini martyris tui interventione nos refove cuius sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with sacred offerings, we humbly ask that through the intervention of your blessed martyr Quirinus, you restore us. Whom we celebrate on his solemnity day.

text: Deus qui multitudinem populorum beati Bonifatii martyris tui atque pontificis instantia ad agnitionem tui sancti nominis vocare dignatus es concede propitius ut cuius sollemnia colimus etiam patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who deemed fitting to call the multitude of people to the recognition of your holy name at the instance of blessed Pope and martyr Boniface, graciously grant that we may not only celebrate his solemnity but also feel his patronage.

text: Fiat Domine quaesumus hostia sacranda placabilis pretiosi martyris tui Bonifatii celebritate quae peccata nostra purificet et famulorum tuorum tibi vota conciliet.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offering be made pleasing to you in honor of your precious martyr Boniface, whose festivity may purify our sins and bring together the vows of your servants to you.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati martyris tui Bonifatii caelestibus mysteriis celebrata sollemnitas indulgentiam nobis tuae propitiationis acceleret.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that the solemnity of your blessed martyr Boniface celebrated in heavenly mysteries may hasten for us the indulgence of your propitiation.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum Primi et Feliciani semper festa sectari quorum suffragiis protectionis tuae dona sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Lord, to always follow the festivals of your holy martyrs Primus and Felician, whose intercessions may we feel the protection of your gifts.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod pro sanctis martyribus tuis Primo et Feliciano proponit nostra devotio quaesumus ut eorum merita nobis augeat te donante suffragium.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, that for your holy martyrs Primo and Felician, our devotion proposes, we humbly ask that their merits may increase us, through you granting them intercession.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum caelestibus mysteriis celebrata sollemnitas indulgentiam nobis tuae propitiationis acceleret.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that the solemnity celebrated in honor of your holy martyrs in heavenly mysteries may hasten to us an indulgence through your propitiation.

text: Sancti apostoli tui Barnabae nos quaesumus Domine tueatur veneranda sollemnitas quia tanto fiducialius tuo nomini supplicamus quanto frequentius apostolorum fovemur exemplis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect the revered solemnity of your Apostle Barnabas, for we trust more strongly in your name as we are more frequently nourished by the examples of the apostles.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi Domine quaesumus beati Barnabae precatio sancta conciliet ut cuius honore sollemniter exhibetur ipsius meritis efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the sacred prayer of blessed Barnabas may bring our sacrifice to you. May it be accepted on account of his merits as he is solemnly honored.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria beati Barnabae apostoli tui festivitate laetantes quae sicut tuis sanctis ad gloriam ita nobis quaesumus ad veniam prodesse perficias.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the divine mysteries of your blessed apostle Barnabas, rejoicing in his feast day. As these mysteries brought glory to your saints, we humbly ask that you may complete them for us as well, for forgiveness.

text: Pro sanctorum tuorum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii sanguine venerando hostiam tibi Domine sollemniter immolamus tua mirabilia pertractantes per quae talis est perfecta victoria praesta quaesumus ut et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, a solemn sacrifice to your holy saints Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor, and Nazarius, venerating their blood. We ponder your marvelous works by which such perfect victory is achieved. Grant us, we ask, that this victory frees us from our bonds of sin and that the gifts of your mercy unite with us.

text: Semper Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii sollemnia celebremus et eorum patrocinia iugiter sentiamus.
translation_en: We always celebrate the festivals of your saints, Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor, and Nazarius, and we continually feel their patronage.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine beati Antonii confessoris tui sollemnitas votiva laetificet ut spiritualibus semper nutriatur auxiliis et gaudiis perfrui mereatur aeternis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the feast of your blessed confessor Saint Anthony may joyfully enliven your church, so that it may always be nourished with spiritual aids and be worthy to enjoy eternal joys.

text: Da Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus Domine sanctis martyribus tuis Vito Modesto atque Crescentia intercedentibus superbe non sapere sed tibi placita humilitate proficere ut proterva despiciens quaecumque matura sunt libera exerceat caritate.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to grant to your Church that, with the intercession of your holy martyrs Vitus, Modestus and Crescentia, it may not be proud but rather advance through humility, contemptuously disregarding all impertinent things, and exercise charity maturely.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine Deus noster per tui nominis invocationem sanctifica et per sanctorum martyrum tuorum Viti et Modesti atque Crescentiae intercessionem nos a peccatis purifica ut tuis digni conspectibus semper assistere mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, through the invocation of your name, to sanctify these gifts. And through the intercession of your saints and martyrs Vitus, Modestus, and Crescentia, purify us from sins so that we may always be worthy to behold you.

text: Refecti Domine benedictione sollemni quaesumus ut intercessione sanctorum martyrum tuorum Viti Modesti atque Crescentiae medicina caelestis sacramenti et corporibus nostris prosit et mentibus.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you bless us with a solemn benediction after our meal. May the intercession of your saintly martyrs Viti, Modestus, and Crescentia provide us with celestial medicine for our bodies and minds.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum Marci et Marcelliani nos Domine natalicia tueantur eorumque supplicatione semper confoveamur.
translation_en: Lord, may your saints Marcius and Marcellianus protect us on their feast days, and may we always be strengthened by their intercession.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicata sanctifica et intercedentibus beatis martyribus Marco et Marcelliano per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, these offerings dedicated to you, and through the intercession of the holy martyrs Marc and Marcellian, may you incline towards us favourably.

text: Salutaris tui Domine munere satiati supplices exoramus ut quorum laetamur gustu renovemur effectu.
translation_en: With your gracious gift, Lord, we who are satisfied, humbly beseech you. Renew us in joy, as we partake, with effective power.

text: Deus qui nos annua sanctorum martyrum tuorum Gervasii et Protasii sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut quorum gaudemus meritis accendamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who delights us in the feast of your saints Gervasius and Protasius, grant us graciously that we may be inflamed with their merits through their examples.

text: Oblatis quaesumus Domine placare muneribus et intercedentibus sanctis tuis Gervasio et Protasio a cunctis nos defende periculis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to appease the offerings and through your saints Gervasius and Proteasius, defend us from all dangers.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et intercedentibus sanctis tuis Gervasio et Protasio caelestis remedii faciat esse consortes.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, purges us from sin and may the saints Gervasius and Proteus, intercessors, make us participants in celestial remedy.

text: Deus qui ad imitandum passionis tuae exemplum decem milia martyrum Acacium Alexandrum Hermolaum cum sociis eorum crucis patibulum subire fecisti tribue quaesumus ut qui passionem eorum veneramur in terris passionis tuae remedia consequamur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who made the ten thousand martyrs Acacius, Alexander, Hermolaus and their companions to suffer the cross, grant us that we who revere their passion on earth may obtain the remedies of your passion in heaven.

text: Votiva Domine mysteria sanctorum tuorum decem milia martyrum Hermolai et Achacii sociorumque eorum sollemnia celebrantes devota mente tractantes quibus nobis quaesumus et praesidium crescat et gaudium.
translation_en: In celebration of the vows, Lord, we honor your ten thousand holy martyrs Hermolai and Achacius, and their companions. We ask that their protection and joy may grow for us.

text: Largire sensibus nostris omnipotens Deus ut per temporalem dilecti filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi pretiosam mortem et per sanctorum martyrum gloriosam passionem quam veneranda mysteria testantur vitam nobis dedisse perpetuam confidamus.
translation_en: Generously bestow upon our senses, Almighty God, that we may believe with confidence in the life eternal given to us through the precious death and glorious passion of your beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, as it is testified by the venerable mysteries, and through the merits of the holy martyrs.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut familia tua per viam salutis incedat et beati Ioannis praecursoris tui hortamenta sectando ad eum quem praedixit secura perveniat.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that your family may walk on the way of salvation and following the exhortations of the blessed John the Baptist, securely reach Him whom you have preached.

text: Beati Ioannis Baptistae nos Domine quaesumus praeclara comitetur oratio et quem venturum esse praedixit poscat nobis fore placatum.
translation_en: Blessed John the Baptist, we humbly ask you, Lord, may a splendid prayer accompany us and grant that the one whom you predicted to come may be pleasing to us.

text: Deus qui praesentem diem honorabilem nobis in beati Baptistae nativitate fecisti da populis tuis spiritualium gratiam gaudiorum et omnium fidelium mentes dirige in viam salutis aeternae.
translation_en: God who made this day honorable for us on the nativity of the blessed Baptist, grant to your people spiritual grace for joy and direct all the minds of the faithful on the way of eternal salvation.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nos geminata laetitia hodiernae festivitatis excipiat quae de beatorum Ioannis et Pauli glorificatione processit quos eadem fides et passio vere fecit esse germanos.
translation_en: We entreat the almighty God that He may receive us with the double joy of today's festivity which has come forth from the glorification of the blessed John and Paul, who were truly made brothers by the same faith and passion.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum Ioannis et Pauli sollemnia celebrantes sacramenta praesta quaesumus ut quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur.
translation_en: We have taken up, Lord, the feasts of your holy martyrs John and Paul. We celebrate their sacred rites. Grant us, we ask, that what we temporally possess may lead to eternal joys.

text: Deus qui beatum Ladislaum regem nostrum et confessorem tuum diversis decorasti miraculis tribue quaesumus ut eius suffragantibus meritis ab omnibus muniamur adversis et gaudiis perfruamur aeternis.
translation_en: God, who adorned our king Blessed Ladislaus and your confessor with various miracles, grant us we beseech you, that through his merits we may be shielded from all adversities and enjoy eternal joys.

text: Sacramenta Domine salutaria sumentes clementiam tuam humiliter exoramus ut intercessione beati Ladislai regis nostri et confessoris tui et praesentibus non destituamur subsidiis et gaudiis perfruamur aeternis.
translation_en: We humbly entreat Your mercy, Lord, as we partake in the saving sacraments. Through the intercession of our King and Confessor, Blessed Ladislaus, and those present with us, may we not be forsaken from assistance, but instead enjoy eternal bliss.

text: Deus qui beatum Leonem pontificem sanctorum tuorum meritis coaequasti concede propitius ut qui commemorationis eius festa percolimus vitae quoque imitemur exempla.
translation_en: God who made the blessed Pope Leo equal to your saints through their merits, graciously grant that we, who celebrate his festival day, may also imitate his examples in our lives.

text: Annue nobis quaesumus Domine ut animae famuli tui Leonis haec prosit oblatio quam immolando totius mundi tribuisti relaxari delicta.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that the offering of your servant Leonard may bring this aid, which you have granted to relieve sins when offering up all the world.

text: Quos Domine caelesti alimento satiasti apostolicis intercessionibus ab omni adversitate custodi.
translation_en: Lord, who have satisfied with heavenly food by your apostolic intercessions, protect them from every adversity.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli nos tuere praesidiis quorum donasti fideles esse doctrinis.
translation_en: Hear nous, O God our Savior, and protect us by the guardianship of Thy apostles Peter and Paul, whom Thou hast made faithful in Thy teachings.

text: Deus qui multitudinem gentium beati Pauli apostoli tui praedicatione docuisti da nobis quaesumus ut cuius natalicia colimus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God who taught the multitude of nations by the preaching of your apostle St. Paul, grant us that we may feel his patronage as we celebrate his birthday among you.

text: Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus Domine preces et hostias apostolica commendet oratio ut quae pro illorum gloria celebramus nobis prosint ad veniam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your prayers and offerings, entrusted by the apostles, may be blessed through your prayer, so that what we celebrate for their glory may also benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis beato apostolo tuo Paulo interveniente deprecamur ut quae pro illius celebrata sunt gloria nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, we perceive the sacred mysteries through your blessed apostle Paul's intercession. We humbly entreat you that what was achieved for his glory may also profit us as a remedy.

text: Tuae sanctificationis arcae Mariae Domine Deus quae te novem mensibus baiulavit fac nos debita veneratione festa peragere in qua ipse dignatus es clausum prophetam in utero Elisabeth visitare.
translation_en: Lord God, grant us the ability to celebrate your feast days with the fitting worship, as Mary, your sanctuary, carried you for nine months and visited Elizabeth while her prophet was still in the womb.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da cordibus nostris illarum tuarum rectitudinem semitarum quam beatus Ioannes Baptista in deserto vox clamantis edocuit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant to our hearts the straightness of Your ways, which the blessed John the Baptist taught by his voice in the wilderness.

text: Sancti Ioannis Baptistae honorabilem nativitatem muneribus o piissime Domine geminatis in octavo namque Ecclesia tua die devotissime quam sequitur deprecans clementiam tuam ut ipso pro ea interveniente id munus salutare penes te fieri mereamur.
translation_en: On the eighth day of your Church, most merciful Lord, we humbly offer honorable gifts to Saint John the Baptist's birth. On this day, which follows with utmost devotion, we beseech your clemency, that through his intervention we may merit that this saving gift be in your presence.

text: Praefatio cottidiana. Communio
translation_en: Daily Preface. Communion

text: Munera tua quae in honore nominis tui in sollemnitate iterata praecursoris ac Baptistae Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi Ioannis sumpta sunt quaesumus omnipotens Deus praestet auxilium ecclesiae tuae ut expiata ab omni immissione insidiatoris te benedicat tibi serviat et te protegente ab omnibus malis semper sit libera.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that the gifts offered in honor of your name during the repeated solemnity of the precursor and Baptist of our Lord Jesus Christ, John, may be beneficial for your church. May it be purified from every attack of the adversary, serve and revere you, and always be free under your protection from all evils.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum martyrum tuorum Processi et Martiniani confessionibus gloriosis circumdas et protegis da nobis et eorum oratione proficere et intercessione gaudere.
translation_en: God who surrounds and protects us through the glorious confessions of your saints, Processius and Martinianus, let us profit from their prayer and rejoice in their intercession.

text: Deus qui in visitatione laetabundae Virginis Mariae Iesu Christi Filii tui gerulae novae laudis praeconiis magnificari voluisti eius meritis et precibus talem nobis quaesumus tuae visitationis gratiam tribue quatenus nunc et semper te magnificare mereamur.
translation_en: God, who willed to be magnified in the joyful visitation of the Virgin Mary, the mother of Jesus Christ, your Son, through the proclamations of the angel announcing a new praise, we humbly ask that you grant us the grace of your visitation, so that now and forevermore we may deserve to magnify you.

text: Salutaris victimae oblationem tibi Deus Pater omnipotens immolamus suppliciter deprecantes ut sicut intemeratae Virginis Mariae viscera Iesu Christi Filii tui gloria illustrasti quod te in spiritu exsultationis et laetitiae magnificaret ita penetralia cordis nostri Spiritus Sancti digneris suavitate perfundere quatenus sacro delibati chrismate veniam consequi peccatorum teque nunc et semper piis mentibus magnificare mereamur.
translation_en: We offer the salutary victim's oblation to you, God the Father Almighty, humbly beseeching you. As your glory shone upon the pure flesh of Jesus Christ, Son of the Immaculate Virgin Mary, we pray that the Holy Spirit may pour his sweetness into the innermost parts of our heart, so that we may worthy obtain forgiveness of sins through the sacred chrism and worthily magnify you with pious minds both now and forever.

text: Hostias tibi Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum Processi et Martiniani dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: I bring to you, Lord, the offerings of your holy martyrs, especially Martinian. May the merciful one accept them by their merits and grant that they may continuously provide us with assistance.

text: Et te in visitatione*
translation_en: And you (God) in visitation

text: Deus qui populo tuo aeternae salutis beatum Martinum ministrum constituisti praesta quaesumus ut quem doctorem vitae habuimus in terris intercessorem semper habere mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: God who appointed the servant of your eternal salvation, blessed Martin as a minister to your people, grant us we pray, that we may always deserve on earth to have had him as our teacher, and in heaven may constantly have him as an intercessor.

text: Deus cuius dextera beatum Petrum apostolum ambulantem in fluctibus ne mergeretur erexit et coapostolum eius Paulum tertio naufragantem de profundo pelagi liberavit exaudi nos propitius et concede ut amborum meritis aeternitatis gloriam consequamur.
translation_en: God, whose right hand walked blessed Peter the apostle through the waves so that he should not be drowned, raised up and who saved his co-apostle Paul for the third time when shipwrecked in the deep sea of the Mediterranean, hear us graciously and grant that we may attain eternal glory by their merits.

text: Protege Domine populum tuum et apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli patrocinio confidentem perpetua defensione conserva.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and confidently defend them under the patronage of your apostles Peter and Paul, with perpetual protection.

text: Sancti Willibaldi confessoris tui atque pontificis nos quaesumus Domine tuere praesidiis et eius semper intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect us by the guardianship of your confessor and bishop, Saint Willibald, and always to assist us through his constant intercessions.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut beati sacerdotis tui et confessoris Willibaldi cuius festivitatem celebramus precibus eius indulgentiam sentiamus.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Lord, that we may feel the indulgence of your blessed priest and confessor Willibald, whose feast day we celebrate.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatorum martyrum tuorum Kiliani Colonati atque Tornati sollemnia recensentes meritis ipsorum protegamur et precibus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we remember the merits of your blessed martyrs Kilian and Kolonat and Tornatus, we may be protected by them and strengthened through their prayers.

text: Respice Domine munera populi tui quaesumus sanctorum martyrum tuorum festivitate votiva et tuae testificatio veritatis nobis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Look down, Lord, upon the offerings of your people, we beseech you. May the feast day's vow of your holy martyrs profit us for salvation, and may your testimony of truth be effective for us.

text: Refecti Domine muneribus sacris in sanctorum celebritate martyrum quaesumus ut te semper in eorum commemoratione laudemus et tuam misericordiam iisdem semper deprecantibus consequamur.
translation_en: Refecti, Lord, with sacred gifts, in the celebration of the saints' feast, we humbly ask that we may always praise you in commemoration of them and that we may continually obtain your mercy as they are constantly pleading for us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui gloriosos martyres Ianuarium Felicem Philippum Silvanum Vitalem Alexandrum Martialem fortes in sua confessione cognovimus pios apud te in nostra intercessione sentiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask the omnipotent God that we, who have known the glorious martyrs Januarius, Felicitas, Philippus, Silvanus, Vitalis, Alexandrus, and Martialis as strong in their confession, may feel them to be devout on our behalf in your presence during our intercession.

text: Sacrificiis praesentibus quaesumus Domine placatus intende et intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis et devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: With the sacrifices present, we humbly ask You, Lord, appeased, to direct Your attention and through Your holy martyrs may it benefit our devotion and salvation.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis illius salutaris capiamus effectum cuius per haec mysteria pignus accepimus.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that we may experience the effect of the salvation for which we have received a pledge through these mysteries, through the intercession of your holy martyrs.

text: Intercessio nos quaesumus Domine beati Benedicti abbatis tibi commendet ut quod nostris meritis non valemus eius patrocinio assequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the blessed Abbot Benedict may present our intercession to you, so that we might attain his patronage, which through our merits we are unable to achieve on our own.

text: Sacris altaribus Domine hostias superpositas sanctus Benedictus in salutem nobis provenire deposcat.
translation_en: Lord, may the blessed Saint Benedict pray that the offerings placed upon Your sacred altars may come forth to our salvation.

text: Protegat nos Domine cum tui sacramenti perceptione beatus Benedictus abbas pro nobis intercedendo ut et conversationis eius experiamur insignia et intercessionis eius percipiamus suffragia.
translation_en: May the Lord protect us with the perception of the blessed Benedict's abbacy, interceding for us so that we may experience the signs of his conduct and receive the aid of his intercession.

text: Deus qui beatam Margaritam virginem hodierna die ad caelos per martyrii palmam venire fecisti concede nobis quaesumus ut eius exempla sequentes ad te pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: God who today brought the blessed Margaret, virgin, into heaven through the palm of martyrdom, grant us that we may be worthy to follow her example and reach you.

text: Haec victima Domine quaesumus pro beatae Margaritae virginis martyrio oblata et mentium nobis sanctitatem et corporum obtineat sanitatem.
translation_en: This victim, Lord, we ask that it be offered for the martyrdom of Blessed Margaret, the Virgin, and grant us holiness of mind and health of body.

text: Deus qui divisionem apostolorum hodierna die fieri in tua praeordinasti providentia ut in una fidei gratia gentium dispersa revocaretur Ecclesia da nobis per supplicationem ipsorum veniam promereri peccatorum per quorum veram praedicationem ad tui nominis pervenimus agnitionem.
translation_en: God, who on this day by your providence have ordained the division of the apostles so that the Church scattered among the nations might be recalled in the unity of faith's grace; grant us through their intercession to earn forgiveness for our sins, through whose true preaching we have come to the acknowledgment of your name.

text: Mitte quaesumus Domine Spiritum tuum Sanctum qui sanctorum apostolorum tuorum linguas ad praedicandum fecit disertas ut et haec sanctificet munera et ad ea percipienda cordium nostrorum purget habitacula.
translation_en: Send, we beseech Thee, Lord, Thy Holy Spirit, who made the tongues of Thy holy apostles eloquent for preaching, that He may also sanctify these gifts and cleanse the dwellings of our hearts for their reception.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beatos apostolos tuos praedicatio sancta in tota Ecclesia fecit gloriosos ita per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus et eorum sequi documenta et gaudia consequi mereamur aeterna.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that just as your holy preaching made the apostles glorious throughout the Church, so through these sacraments which we have received and by following their teachings and joys, we may deserve eternal glory.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine Benedicti atque Andreae natalicia veneranda quaesumus Ecclesia tua devote suscipiat et fiat magnae glorificationis amore devotior.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your Church, Lord, to receive with devotion the feast days of Your saints Benedict and Andrew, and may it be filled with a more devoted love for great glory.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine emundet nostra delicta et intercedentibus sanctis tuis Benedicto atque Andrea subditorum tibi corpora mentesque sanctificet.
translation_en: This offering we ask, Lord, may purify our sins; and through the intercession of your blessed Saints Benedict and Andrew, may You bless their bodies and souls.

text: Protege Domine plebem tuam et quam martyrum tuorum Benedicti et Andreae assidua festivitate facis esse devotam tibi semper placitam fieri precibus concede sanctorum.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and make the congregation of Your blessed Martyrs Benedict and Andrew perpetually devoted to You through frequent celebrations. Grant that this be pleasing to You by their prayers and intercessions of the saints.

text: Deus sanctae humilitatis et devotae paupertatis amator cui beatus Alexius in sua humilitate valde complacuit eius interventu fac nos quaesumus humiles et devotos ut devotis mentibus et piis actibus tibi placere valeamus.
translation_en: We ask you, God of holy humility and devoted poverty, who were greatly pleased by the humility of blessed Alexius; may his intervention make us humble and devoted. May we be able to please you with devout minds and pious actions.

text: Suscipe tibi oblata munera Domine Deus et concede ut beati Alexii confessoris tui cuius celebramus sollemnia nos foveant continuata praesidia.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the gifts offered to Thee, and grant that the continued protection of your blessed confidant, St. Alexander, whose feast we celebrate, may ever be upon us.

text: Mysteria quae sumpsimus omnipotens Deus intercedente beato Alexio confessore tuo nos iugiter ab omni iniquitate custodiant.
translation_en: The mysteries which we have received, O almighty God, with the intercession of blessed Alexander your confessor, may they always keep us from every wickedness.

text: Largire nobis clementissime Pater quod sicut beata Maria Magdalene Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum super omnia diligendo suorum obtinuit veniam peccaminum ita nobis apud misericordiam tuam sempiternam impetret beatitudinem.
translation_en: Grant us, most merciful Father, as the blessed Mary Magdalene obtained forgiveness for all her sins by loving our Lord Jesus Christ above all things, so may she intercede for us before your mercy and ask for eternal happiness for us.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine beatae Mariae Magdalene gloriosis meritis tibi reddantur accepta cuius oblationis obsequium Unigenitus Filius tuus clementer suscipit impensum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the merits of the glorious Blessed Mary Magdalene may render our offerings acceptable to you. To whom the obedience of this offering is presented, Your only-begotten Son graciously receives the effort.

text: Sumpto Domine salutari ac singulari remedio corporis et sanguinis Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi ab omnibus quaesumus maculis vetustatis beatae Mariae Magdalene patrociniis exuamur.
translation_en: With the saving and singular remedy of the body and blood of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask to be freed from all stains of the agedness under the patronage of the blessed Mary Magdalene.

text: Deus qui salutarem nobis hodierna die in beati Apollinaris sacerdotis et martyris tui passione dedisti laetitiam praesta quaesumus ut et conversationis eius insignia experiamur et intercessione tibi placita iugiter gloriemur.
translation_en: God, who on this day bestowed upon us joy through the passion of your servant and martyr Saint Apollinaris, grant us, we pray, that we may experience the insignia of his way of life and continually glorify you through his intercession.

text: Sacrificium nostrum quaesumus Domine et ipsa sit tibi actione placabile et beati Apollinaris sacerdotis et martyris tui intercessione ad nostrae salutis augmentum fiat acceptabile.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that our sacrifice may be acceptable to you, and through the action of the blessed Apostle and Bishop Apollinaris, your priest and martyr, may it become increasingly acceptable for our salvation.

text: Deus qui beatam Christinam virginem et martyrem diversa poenarum genera pro fidei tuae attestatione superare fecisti eius intercessione errantes a suis pravitatibus corrige et in tuis mandatis perseverare concede.
translation_en: God who made the blessed Christian virgin and martyr overcome various kinds of punishment for your testimony, through her intercession correct the erring from their wickedness and grant them to persevere in your commandments.

text: Sanctae Christinae martyris tuae Domine sancta recolentes preces offerimus hostias immolando praesta quaesumus ut cum temporali praesidio et vitam nobis praebeant et incrementa perpetua.
translation_en: Remembering the holy martyr Saint Christina, Lord, we humbly present our prayers and offer sacrifices. Grant us, we entreat you, with temporal protection and bestow upon us life and eternal increase.

text: Deus virtutum caelestium quaesumus ut sacrificia pro sanctae martyris tuae Christinae passione delata desideriorum nos temporalium doceant nos habere contemptum et habere dona caelestium gaudiorum.
translation_en: We ask you, God of heavenly virtues, that the sacrifices offered for the suffering of your holy martyr Christina may teach us to have contempt for temporal desires and to have gifts of celestial joys.

text: Adiuvet nos quaesumus Domine beati Christoferi martyris tui sancta precatio ut a nostris flagitiis liberati ad aeternam gloriam pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: Help us, we beseech You, Lord, by the holy intercession of Your blessed martyr Christopher, that having been freed from our sins, we may merit to attain eternal glory.

text: Oblationes populi tui quaesumus Domine beati apostoli tui Iacobi passio beata conciliet et quae nostris non apta sunt meritis fiant tibi placita eius deprecatione.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, of your blessed apostle James, that his passion may reconcile and whatever is not fitting for our merits may become pleasing to you through his intercession.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine clementer suscipe et intercedente beato Christofero martyre tuo nobis salutaria concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously receive these offerings. And with the intercession of the blessed Christopher your martyr, grant us salutary blessings.

text: Beati apostoli tui Iacobi in cuius hodie festivitate corpore et sanguine tuo nos refecisti quaesumus Domine eius intercessione nos adiuva pro cuius sollemnitate percepimus tua sancta laetantes.
translation_en: Blessed are thy apostles, James, in whose today's feastday thou didst restore us both in body and blood, we beseech Thee, Lord. Through his intercession, help us, for whose solemnity we have perceived Thy holy ones rejoicing.

text: Perceptis Domine muneribus gratias exhibentes beatus Christoferus martyr tuus sit pro nobis quaesumus perpetuus intercessor.
translation_en: With grateful hearts, we present our offerings to You, O Lord. May Your blessed Christopher the martyr be for us a perpetual intercessor.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatae Annae tantam gratiam donare dignatus es ut Mariam Matrem Unigeniti Filii tui in utero suo portare meruerit da nobis per intercessionem matris et filiae tuae propitiationis abundantiam ut quarum memoriam pio amore amplectimur earum precibus ad caelestem Ierusalem pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who deigned to bestow such great grace upon blessed Anne that she merited to carry Mary, the Mother of your Only-begotten Son, in her womb, grant us through the intercession of your mother and daughter, abundant forgiveness. May we be worthy to embrace the memory of these saints with a pious love, and may their prayers help us reach heavenly Jerusalem.

text: Super has quaesumus omnipotens Pater oblationes quae in memoria sanctae Annae genitricis beatissimae Mariae Virginis Matris Unigeniti Domini nostri Iesu Christi consecrantur et tuam effunde benedictionem et per eas nobis tribue cordium purificationem.
translation_en: Upon these [offerings] we humbly ask the omnipotent Father that the oblations which are consecrated in the memory of Saint Anne, the most blessed mother of Mary, Virgin and Mother of the Unigenitus, our Lord Jesus Christ, may receive your blessing and through them grant us the purification of hearts.

text: Sumpta sacramenta quaesumus Domine intercedente beatissima Anna matre gloriosae Genitricis Unigeniti tui nos et ab hostium defendant formidine et aeternae mortis tueantur amaritudine.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the sacraments be taken up with the intercession of the most blessed Anna, mother of the glorious Mother of your Only-begotten. May they defend us from the fear of enemies and protect us from the bitter taste of eternal death.

text: Deus qui in sanctis septem dormientibus tuae virtutis potentiam et resurrectionis testimonium mundo declarasti da nobis quaesumus eorum meritis in caelesti patria cum ipsis perpetuam possidere mansionem.
translation_en: God who in the seven sleeping saints declared your power and witness of resurrection to the world, grant us, we ask, through their merits, that we may possess a permanent dwelling place with them in the heavenly fatherland.

text: Beati Pantaleonis martyris tui intercessio quaesumus Domine nobis peccatorum indulgentiam et tuae reconciliationis gratiam obtineat.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your grace, Lord, that the intercession of the blessed Martyr Pantaleon may grant us forgiveness for our sins and obtain for us the grace of Your reconciliation.

text: Munera tibi Domine nostrae oblationis offerimus quae et pro tui tibi grata sint honore sancti et nobis salutaria te miserante reddantur.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the gifts of our humble offering, which may be pleasing to you by the honor of the saints and may return beneficial to us as you have mercy upon us.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum Domine participatione laetantes suppliciter exoramus ut cuius merita celebrare condonas eius nos facias imitari constantiam.
translation_en: Lord, rejoicing in your sacraments, we humbly ask that you grant us the grace to celebrate worthily. Through whose merits you condone, may you make us imitate their constancy.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sicut populus Christianus beatorum martyrum tuorum Felicis Simplicii Faustini et Beatricis temporali sollemnitate congaudet ita perfruatur aeterna et quod votis celebrat comprehendat effectu.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that just as the Christian people rejoice on earth with the temporal feast of your blessed martyrs Felicitas, Simplicius, Faustinus and Beatrix, so they may also experience eternal fulfillment and what they celebrate in their vows may be achieved in reality.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro sanctorum martyrum Felicis Simplicii Faustini et Beatricis sollemnitate deferimus suppliciter obsecrantes ut et indulgentiam nobis pariter conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, hosts for the solemnity of the holy martyrs Felicitas, Simplicius, Faustinus, and Beatrix, humbly asking that you grant us forgiveness and salvation as well.

text: Deus qui beato Ladislao regi et confessori tuo post terrenae dignitatis fastigium aeternitatis lauream contulisti concede propitius ut qui eius festivitatem devotis mentibus veneramur in terris ipsi quoque in gloria consociemur in caelis.
translation_en: God who bestowed upon the blessed King Ladislaus and confessor Your eternal laurel after the dignity of earthly rank, graciously grant that we who venerate his festival with devoted minds on earth may also be associated with him in glory in heaven.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Germani confessoris tui atque pontificis veneranda sollemnitas et fidei nostrae constantiam operetur et pacem.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you almighty God, that the solemnity of your blessed confessor and bishop Germain may operate upon the veneration of it and strengthen our faith, and bring peace.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato Germano confessore tuo atque pontifice per eadem nos a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Grants offered to you, Lord, consecrate them, and through the intercession of the blessed Germanus, your confessor and bishop, cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Beati Germani confessoris tui atque pontificis Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quod temporali celebramus actione perpetua capiamus salvatione.
translation_en: May the blessing of your confessor and bishop, Germain, Lord, be pleasing through your intervention. We humbly ask that what we celebrate temporarily with our actions, may we possess eternally through salvation.

text: Deus qui multitudinem gentium* Require ante in commemoratione sancti Pauli.
translation_en: God who requires the multitude of nations before, in remembrance of Saint Paul.

text: Oblatum tibi Domine sacrificium intercedente beato Petro apostolo tuo vivificet nos semper et muniat.
translation_en: May the offering presented to You, Lord, through the intercession of your Apostle Saint Peter, revive us always and protect us forever.

text: Corporis sacri et pretiosi sanguinis repleti libamine quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quod pia devotione gerimus per preces beati Petri apostoli tui certa redemptione capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to fill us with the bounty of your sacred and precious blood. May we, who carry it with pious devotion through your prayers, Saint Peter, Apostle of yours, attain certain redemption.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato Stephano martyre tuo atque pontifice per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: Lord, we dedicate these gifts to you; may they be sanctified. Through the intercession of blessed Stephen, your martyr and pope, please attend to us, and through the same, may we find favor with you.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et intercedente beato Stephano martyre tuo atque pontifice caelestis remedii faciat esse consortes.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, purges us from sin, and through the intercession of your blessed martyr Stephen and the celestial bishop, the remedy, makes us co-heirs.

text: Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hodierna die sanctorum tuorum Stephani protomartyris Nicodemi Gamalielis atque Abydon inventionem gloriosam revelasti da nobis in aeterna laetitia de eorum societate gaudere.
translation_en: God who are the marvelous splendor of your saints, who today revealed the glorious discovery of your saints Stephen, the first martyr, Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Abydos, grant us to rejoice in eternal joy with their fellowship.

text: Munera tibi Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus quae et pro tuorum tibi grata sint honore sanctorum et nobis salutaria te miserante reddantur.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the gifts of our devotion, which may be pleasing to you through the honor of the saints, and may they return beneficial to us as you have mercy upon us.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sanctorum tuorum Stephani protomartyris Nicodemi Gamalielis atque Abydon sollemnia celebrantes sacramenta caelestia praesta quaesumus ut quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the relics of your saints: Stephen the Protomartyr, Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Abydos; celebrating their solemnities, we ask that you grant us, that what we temporally possess may lead us to eternal joys.

text: Tua Domine propitiatione et beatae Mariae semper Virginis intercessione ad perpetuam atque praesentem haec nobis oblatio proficiat prosperitatem et pacem.
translation_en: May your, Lord, propitiation and the intercession of blessed Mary ever-virgin profit us with perpetual and present offering, for prosperity and peace.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis nostrae subsidiis da quaesumus beatae Mariae semper Virginis nos patrociniis ubique protegi in cuius veneratione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, with the assistance of our salvation, that we may be protected everywhere by the patronage of the blessed Mary ever Virgin. In whose veneration we offer this to Your majesty.

text: Munera Domine tibi dicata sanctifica et meritis beati Dominici confessoris tui nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings dedicated to you be sanctified, and may the merits of your blessed confessioner profit us towards healing.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da nobis quaesumus sancti Oswaldi martyris tui precibus adiuvari ut cuius festa recolimus auxilium sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly ask that through the prayers of Saint Oswald your martyr, you aid us so that we may feel help from his feast day.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine propitiatus assume et ut tuis digne famulemur altaribus sancti tui Oswaldi intercessione custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you accept our offerings, being graciously disposed, and may we worthily serve your holy altars through the intercession of Saint Oswald.

text: Repleti Domine benedictione caelesti quaesumus clementiam tuam ut intercedente beato Oswaldo martyre tuo quae humiliter gerimus salubriter sentiamus.
translation_en: Filled with heavenly blessings, we ask you, Lord, for your mercy. May it be through the intercession of blessed Osvald, your martyr, that we who humbly carry out our duties feel its benefits.

text: Deus qui fidei sacramenta in Unigeniti tui transfiguratione patrum testimonio roborasti et adoptionem filiorum perfectam voce delapsa in nube lucida mirabiliter praefigurasti concede propitius ut ipsius regis gloriae nos coheredes efficias et eiusdem gloriae tribuas esse consortes.
translation_en: God, who strengthened the sacraments of faith through the transformation of your Unigenitus and miraculously prefigured the perfect adoption of sons by a voice that fell in a shining cloud, graciously make us fellow-heirs to his kingly glory and grant us to be sharers in the same glory.

text: Praefatio de Sancta Trinitate.
translation_en: Praefatio on the Holy Trinity.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacrosancta transfigurationis mysteria quae sollemni celebramus officio purificatae mentis intelligentia consequamur.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Almighty God, that we may attain the understanding of the sacred mysteries of the Transfiguration which we celebrate solemnly with a mind purified.

text: Deus qui nos concedis sanctorum martyrum tuorum Sixti Felicissimi Agapiti Magni et Ianuarii natalicia colere da nobis in aeterna laetitia de eorum societate gaudere.
translation_en: God, who grants us to celebrate the natalicia of your holy martyrs Sixtus, Felicitas, Agapetus, Magnus and Januarius, give us in eternal joy to rejoice with their society.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine intercedentibus sanctis tuis Sixto Felicissimo Agapito Magno et Ianuario ut quae ore contingimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, through your saints Sixtus, Felix, Agatho, Mango and Januarius, that what we touch with our mouth may be received with a pure mind.

text: Deus tuorum gloria sacerdotum praesta quaesumus ut sancti martyris tui et episcopi Donati cuius festa gerimus auxilium sentiamus.
translation_en: God, glory of your priests, we humbly ask that you grant us aid, so that we may feel the help of your saint martyr and bishop Donatus, whose feast day we are celebrating.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui nos sacramentorum tuorum et participes efficis et ministros praesta quaesumus ut intercedente beato martyre tuo atque pontifice et fidei proficiamus augmento et aeternae beatitudinis iungamur consortio.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who makes us participants and ministers of your sacraments, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your blessed martyr and pope, we may progress in faith with increase, and be united in the fellowship of eternal beatitude.

text: Intercessio nos quaesumus Domine sanctae Afrae martyris tuae tibi commendet quae in confessione tibi placere et coronam vitae aeternae meruit percipere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you recommend us to your holy martyr St. Aphraat, who pleased you in her confession and deserved to receive the crown of eternal life.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine ob honorem sanctae Afrae martyris tuae munus oblatum et quod nostris meritis assequi non valemus eius nobis intercessione largire propitius.
translation_en: Receive we beseech you, Lord, on account of the honor of your martyr Saint Aper, the gift presented to you, and what we are not able to obtain through our merits, grant us graciously with his intercession.

text: Sacramentis quaesumus Domine muniamur acceptis ut sanctae Afrae martyris tuae intercessione contra omnes nequitias armis protegamur caelestibus.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, that we may be fortified with the sacraments, so that armed by your acceptance, we may be protected against all wickedness through the intercession of your saint Afra, with heavenly weapons.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Cyriaci martyris tui sociorumque sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut quorum natalicia colimus virtutem quoque passionis imitemur.
translation_en: God who delights us in the solemnity of your blessed Cyril, martyr, and his companions, graciously grant that we may celebrate their natal day, and emulate not only their virtue but also their passion.

text: Refecti participatione muneris sacri quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quorum exsequimur cultum sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: Having been refreshed by the participation in the sacred offering, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that those whom we serve may feel the effect of their devotion.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et intercessione beati Laurentii martyris tui perpetuam misericordiam nobis benignus impende.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and bestow upon us your perpetual mercy through the intercession of your blessed martyr St. Lawrence.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Romani martyris tui natalicia colimus intercessione eius in tui nominis amore roboremur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the birthday of your blessed Roman martyr, through his intercession we may be strengthened in your name.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine clementer suscipe et intercedente beato Romano martyre tuo nobis salutaria concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously receive these gifts and grant us salvation through the intercession of blessed Roman, your martyr.

text: Da nobis Domine Deus noster ut sicut beati Laurentii martyris tui commemoratione temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur aspectu.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord our God, that just as we rejoice in the temporal memory of your blessed martyr Laurence, so may we be continually joyful in the sight of you.

text: Perceptis Domine muneribus sacris [gratias] exhibentes beatus Romanus martyr tuus sit pro nobis quaesumus perpetuus intercessor.
translation_en: With sacred offerings, Lord, expressing our gratitude, blessed Romanus, your martyr, we ask that he may be a perpetual intercessor for us.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus vitiorum nostrorum flammas exstinguere qui beato Laurentio martyri tuo tribuisti tormentorum suorum incendia superare.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, the power to extinguish the flames of our sins, which you granted the blessed Laurence your martyr to overcome the fires of his tortures.

text: Sacro munere satiati supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quod debitae servitutis celebramus officio intercedente beato Laurentio martyre tuo salvationis tuae sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: Having been satisfied by the sacred ministry, we humbly pray to you, Lord, that we may feel the effect of the salvation granted through your intercession with blessed Lawrence, your martyr.

text: Adesto Domine precibus populi tui adesto muneribus ut quae sacris sunt oblata mysteriis beati Tiburtii martyris tui tibi placeant intercessione.
translation_en: Lord, attend to the prayers of your people; attend to the offerings, so that what has been offered in the mysteries of the blessed martyr Tiburtius may find favor with you through his intercession.

text: Sumpsimus Domine pignus redemptionis nostrae sit nobis quaesumus interveniente beato Tiburtio martyre tuo vitae praesentis auxilium pariter et futurae.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the pledge of our redemption. Grant us, we pray, assistance in this present life and the future one, with the help of your martyr Tiburtius.

text: Famulos tuos quaesumus Domine beatae virginis tuae Clarae votiva natalicia recensentes caelestium gaudiorum sua facias interventione participes et simul in unum divitis et pauperis tui Unigeniti coheredes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, of the blessed Virgin Claire, remembering her votive birthday, to make your servants sharers of the celestial joy through your intervention, and at the same time, heirs of both the rich and the poor, your Only Begotten Son's coheirs.

text: Oblata tibi Domine quaesumus dona sanctifica quae maiestati tuae accepta faciat beatae virginis Clarae intercessio veneranda.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings presented to you be sanctified. May they, accepted by your majesty, bring about the blessed intercession of the venerable Virgin Clara.

text: Protegant quaesumus Domine plebem tuam gloriosae virginis tuae Clarae continuata praesidia et sumpta pro illius gloria corporis tui sacri et pretiosi sanguinis sacramenta.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, to protect Your people with the aid of Your glorious Virgin, Claire. Maintain them with her continuous assistance and take up her glory, the sacred body and precious blood, as a sacred sacrament for her.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos sanctorum tuorum intercessione custodis praesta quaesumus ut beati Hippolyti martyris tui et sociorum eius meritis piae confessionis sumamus augmentum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through the intercession of your saints keep us safe, we humbly ask that through the merits of blessed Hippolytus, martyr, and his companions, we may receive an increase in pious confession.

text: Respice Domine munera populi tui sancti Hippolyti sociorumque eius festivitate votiva et tuae testificatio veritatis nobis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, the offerings of your holy people, the church of Saint Hippolytus and his companions, on this votive feast day. May your testimony of truth profit us for our salvation.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum Domine communio sumpta nos salvet et intercedente beato Hippolyto cum sociis suis in tuae veritatis luce confirmet.
translation_en: Lord, as we partake in your sacraments, may they save us and with the blessed Hippolytus and his companions, confirm us in the light of your truth.

text: Munera nostra Domine apud clementiam tuam Dei Genitricis commendet oratio quam idcirco de praesenti saeculo transtulisti ut pro peccatis nostris apud te fiducialiter intercedat.
translation_en: Our gifts, Lord, commend to Your mercy through the kindness of God the Mother. The prayer which You have transferred from this present age for us, that it may confidently intercede on our behalf before You regarding our sins.

text: Laudis tuae Domine hostias immolamus in beati Eusebii confessoris tui commemoratione deferimus quibus nos et praesentibus exui malis confidimus et futuris.
translation_en: We offer up the sacrifices of your praise, Lord, on the commemoration of your blessed martyr Eusebius. We confidently trust that we and those present with us will be freed from present evils and future ones.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus fragilitati nostrae praesidium ut qui sanctissimae Dei Genitricis requiem celebramus intercessionis eius auxilio a nostris iniquitatibus resurgamus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty and merciful God, protection to our frailty, that as we celebrate the rest of the most holy Mother of God, we may rise from our sins with the help of her intercession.

text: Ut nobis Domine tua sacrificia dent salutem beatus Eusebius confessor tuus quaesumus precator accedat.
translation_en: May your sacrifices, Lord, give us salvation, we pray. May your blessed confessor, Eusebius, approach, we entreat.

text: Veneranda nobis Domine huius diei festivitas opem conferat salutarem in qua sancta Dei Genitrix mortem subiit temporalem nec tamen mortis nexibus deprimi potuit quae Filium tuum Dominum nostrum de se genuit incarnatum.
translation_en: O Lord, grant us today this venerable solemnity a saving help, in which the holy Mother of God suffered a temporal death but was not overcome by the bonds of death, who bore Your Son our Lord incarnate from herself.

text: Deus qui beatum Stephanum regem nostrum et confessorem tuum terreni imperii gloria et honore coronasti et sanctorum tuorum societate sublimasti praesta quaesumus ut quem Pannonia habuit divinae religionis doctorem in terris eum modo Ecclesia tua mereatur habere defensorem in caelis.
translation_en: God who crowned our blessed King Stephen and Your confessor with the glory and honor of earthly empire, and exalted him with the fellowship of Your saints, grant us, we pray, that whom Pannonia had as a teacher of divine religion on earth, Your Church may now deserve to have as a defender in heaven.

text: Subveniat Domine plebi tuae haec oblatio et Dei Genitricis oratio quam etsi pro condicione carnis migrasse cognoscimus in caelesti tamen gloria apud te quaesumus pro nobis orare sentiamus.
translation_en: May the Lord come to the aid of his people with this offering, and may we feel that even though the prayers of the Mother of God, whom we know to have migrated according to fleshly condition into heavenly glory, pray for us before you.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine preces nostras et intercedente beato Arnulpho confessore tuo atque pontifice supplicationes nostras placatus intende.
translation_en: Hear us, we implore you, Lord, our prayers and with the intercession of Blessed Arnulf, your confessor and bishop, incline your favor towards our supplications.

text: In tuo conspectu Domine quaesumus talia sint nostra munera quae intercedente beato Arnulpho confessore tuo atque pontifice et placare te valeant et nos tibi placere perficiant.
translation_en: In your presence, Lord, we humbly ask that our gifts may be such, which through the intercession of blessed Arnulf, your confessor and bishop, may appease you and cause us to please you.

text: Repleti sumus Domine muneribus quae de festivitate beati Arnulphi confessoris tui atque pontificis percepimus tribue quaesumus ut eius intercessionis mundemur effectu et muniamur auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, we are filled with the gifts that we have received on the feast of your confessor and bishop, Blessed Arnulf. We humbly ask you to grant us that we may be purified by his intercession and strengthened by his aid.

text: Beati Laurentii nos foveat Domine passio veneranda laetantes et ut eam sufficienter recolamus efficiat promptiores.
translation_en: Blessed Laurence, may the Lord protect us through his venerable passion, and may it make us more eager to remember him sufficiently.

text: Beati Laurentii martyris tui honorabilem passionem muneribus Domine geminatis exsequimur quae licet propriis sit memoranda principiis indesinenter tamen permanet gloriosa.
translation_en: We carry out the honorable Passion of Blessed Laurence, your martyr, with doubled gifts, O Lord. Although it is constantly memorable according to its own principles, yet it remains glorious.

text: Praefatio dicitur de Assumptione.
translation_en: The Preface is called on the Assumption.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae in beati Agapiti martyris tui sollemnitate tibi deferimus cuius nos confidimus patrociniis liberari.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings which we bring on the feast day of your blessed martyr Agapitus, whom we trust to be our advocate for salvation.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam muneribus sacris sancti Agapiti martyris tui quaesumus semper interventione nos refove cuius sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with the sacred offerings of your saintly martyr Agapitus. We humbly ask that you always support us through his intervention, whose feast day we are celebrating.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nostrae humilitatis oblatio et pro sancti Magni martyris tui tibi grata sit honore et nos corpore pariter et mente purificet.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, almighty God, that our humble offering and for the sake of your saint Martin may be pleasing to you in honor, and that we may be cleansed both bodily and spiritually.

text: Tua sancta sumentes quaesumus Domine ut beati Magni martyris tui nos foveant continuata praesidia.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your holy ones may take us, so that the uninterrupted protection of your blessed Great Martyr may warm us.

text: Sacrificium quod tuae Domine maiestati offerimus benigno vultu respice et intercessione beati Stephani regis et confessoris tui nos ab omnium inimicorum insidiis defende et praemia vitae aeternae concede.
translation_en: Sacrifice that we offer to your Lordly majesty, look upon it with a benign face. Through the intercession of blessed Stephen, king and confessor, defend us from the plots of all our enemies and grant us the rewards of eternal life.

text: Et te in assumptione*
translation_en: And you [God] in the Assumption

text: Tuere quaesumus Domine familiam tuam et quam per doctrinam beati Stephani regis et confessoris tui de tenebris ad veram lucem convertisti eam post ipsius temporis decursum oblati sacrificii munimine clementer perducas ad regna caelorum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to guard your family. As you turned it from darkness to true light through the teaching of Blessed Stephen, king and confessor of yours, after the passage of his time, may you kindly lead them under the protection of the offering, to the kingdoms of heaven.

text: Auxilium tuum nobis Domine quaesumus placatus impende et intercedentibus beatis martyribus tuis Timotheo et Symphoriano dexteram super nos tuae propitiationis extende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your aid may be extended to us. May it be bestowed upon us while your blessed martyrs Timothy and Symphorian are interceding for us. Extend the right hand of your propitiation over us.

text: Divini muneris largitate satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedentibus beatis martyribus tuis Timotheo et Symphoriano eorum semper participatione vivamus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, to be filled with the bountiful grace you bestowed upon them, that we may always live with the intercession of your blessed martyrs Timothy and Symphorian.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus venturam beati apostoli tui Bartholomaei sollemnitatem congruo praevenire honore et venientem digna celebrare devotione.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that the upcoming feast of your blessed apostle Bartholomew may be preceded with fitting honor and worthily celebrated with devotion.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatorum martyrum tuorum Timothei et Apollinaris sollemnitatem colimus eorum apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you almighty God, that as we celebrate the solemnity of your blessed martyrs Timothy and Apollinaris, we may be helped by their intercessions with you.

text: Grata tibi sint Domine munera quibus beati Bartholomaei apostoli supervenientem praevenimus festivitatem.
translation_en: Blessed are to You, Lord, the gifts with which we have met the feast of the blessed Apostle Bartholomew before its arrival.

text: Munera Domine pro tuorum commemoratione sanctorum Timothei et Apollinaris sollemnitate oblata propitius suscipe et pia eorum intercessione ad salutem perpetuam nobis provenire concede.
translation_en: Lord, on the solemnity of Saints Timothy and Apollinaris, we offer you gifts for the commemoration of your people. Be propitious and graciously receive them. By their pious intercession, may we obtain eternal salvation.

text: Sanctificati Domine salutari mysterio quaesumus ut pro nobis beati Bartholomaei apostoli tui non desit oratio cuius nos donasti votis praevenire sollemnia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify us through your saving mystery. May the prayer of your blessed apostle Bartholomeus not cease for our sake, whose solemnities you have given us to precede through vows.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum Domine Timothei et Apollinaris intercessione placatus concede quaesumus ut sacramenti tui veneranda perceptio fiat omnium peccatorum nostrorum remissio.
translation_en: Through the intercession of your blessed martyrs, Lord Timothy and Apollinaris, we humbly ask that you grant us, in the reception of your sacred sacrament, the forgiveness of all our sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui huius diei venerandam sanctamque laetitiam beati apostoli tui Bartholomaei festivitate tribuisti da Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus et amare quod credidit et praedicare quod docuit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day bestowed venerable and holy joy upon the feast of your apostle Bartholomew, we ask that you grant to your Church. We pray that they may believe what he believed and preach what he taught.

text: Deus qui perennem gloriam sanctissimi Audoeni confessoris tui atque pontificis animae contulisti tribue quaesumus eius nos apud te ita precibus sublevari ut cum eo vitam possideamus aeternam.
translation_en: God, who granted everlasting glory to the soul of your holy confessor and bishop Saint Audoin, grant us, we entreat you, that we may be uplifted by his prayers so that with him we may possess eternal life.

text: Beati apostoli tui Bartholomaei Domine sollemnia recensentes quaesumus ut eius auxilio tua beneficia capiamus pro quo tibi hostias laudis immolamus.
translation_en: Lord, as we celebrate the feast of your apostle Bartholomew, we humbly ask that through his help, we may receive your blessings. For whom we offer you sacrifices of praise.

text: Grata tibi sint quaesumus Domine munera quae in beati Audoeni confessoris tui atque pontificis commemoratione deferimus obsecrantes ut quae honore prosequimur sinceriter contingere mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the gifts we bring on the commemoration of your confessor and bishop, Saint Audoin, may be pleasing to you. We entreat that as we honor him sincerely, we may deserve to truly encounter what we pursue.

text: Sumpsimus Domine pignus redemptionis aeternae sit nobis quaesumus interveniente beato Bartholomaeo apostolo tuo vitae praesentis auxilium pariter et futurae.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the pledge of eternal redemption. Grant us, we beseech You, help in our present life with the intervention of Your apostle, Blessed Bartholomew, and aid us in the future as well.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut beati Audoeni confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius festivitatem celebramus eius meritis et precibus indulgentiam sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, that we may experience the indulgence through the merits and prayers of the blessed Audoin, your confessor and bishop, whose feast day we celebrate.

text: Da quaesumus Domine ut familia tua beati Genesii martyris tui patrocinio ab omni adversitate liberata te fiat operante devota et te protegente secura.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you Lord, that your family of the blessed martyr Genesis may, under your patronage, be set free from every adversity. May they be devotedly engaged in your service and securely protected by you.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam muneribus sacris sancti Genesii martyris tui quaesumus intercessione nos refove cuius sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with the sacred gifts of Saint Genesius, your martyr, we humbly ask that through his intercession, you restore us. Whose feast day we are celebrating.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris ut beati Rufi martyris tui intercessionibus confidentes nec minis adversantium nec ullo turbemur incursu.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications, that, being confident in the intercessions of your blessed martyr Rufinus, we may not be turned away by the threats of adversity nor disturbed by any onslaught.

text: Oblatis quaesumus Domine placare muneribus et intercedente beato Rufo martyre tuo a cunctis nos defende periculis.
