translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to appease the offerings and, through your martyr Saint Rufus, protect us from all dangers.

text: Caelestibus refecti sacramentis et gaudiis supplices te rogamus Domine Deus noster ut cuius gloriamur triumphis protegamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Having been refreshed with celestial sacraments and joys, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that we may be protected by your aid as we boast in your glory.

text: Adesto supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus et quibus fiduciam sperandae pietatis indulges intercedente beato Augustino confessore tuo atque pontifice consuetae misericordiae tribue benignus effectum.
translation_en: Assist to our supplications, O Almighty God, and grant your accustomed mercy through the intercession of your faithful servant and bishop Saint Augustine. Grant us a kind response.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine laudis offerimus in sancti Hermetis martyris tui commemoratione da quaesumus ut quod illi contulit ad gloriam nobis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, a sacrifice of praise, in the remembrance of your saint Hermes the martyr. Grant us, we ask, that what he achieved for glory may profit us for our salvation.

text: Deus qui inter cetera potentiae tuae miracula etiam in sexu fragili victoriam martyrii contulisti concede propitius ut qui beatae Sabinae martyris tuae natalicia colimus per eius ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God, who among other miracles of your power granted victory in fragile sex to the martyr, graciously grant that we, who celebrate the birthday of your martyr Sabina, may be favored by your examples and merit grace through her.

text: Munera tibi Domine pro sancti martyris tui Ioannis Baptistae passione deferimus qui dum finitur in terris factus est caelesti sede perpetuus quaesumus ut eius obtentu nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: We offer gifts to you, Lord, on behalf of your holy martyr John the Baptist during his passion. As he was finishing his earthly life, he was made a permanent resident of heaven. We humbly ask that through his intercession we may profit for our salvation.

text: Conferat nobis Domine sancti Ioannis Baptistae beata sollemnitas ut magnifica sacramenta quae sumpsimus salubriter veneremur et in nobis potius edita gaudeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the blessed solemnity of Saint John the Baptist, that we may reverently honor the sacred mysteries which we have received and rejoice more in ourselves for their manifestation.

text: Divini muneris largitate satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beata Sabina martyre tua in eius semper participatione vivamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to satisfy us with the generosity of your divine gift. Through the intercession of the blessed martyr Sabina, may we always live in her participation.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut sicut nos iugiter sanctorum martyrum tuorum Felicis et Adaucti commemoratione laetificas ita semper supplicatione defendas.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your Majesty, Lord, that just as we are continually joyed by the remembrance of your holy martyrs Felicitas and Adauctus, so too you may always defend us through our prayers.

text: Hostias Domine tuae plebis intende et quas in honore sanctorum martyrum tuorum Felicis et Adaucti devota mente celebrat proficere sibi sentiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord, direct your attention to the offerings of your people and let those that she offers with a devoted mind in honor of your saintly martyrs Felicitas and Adauctus may find profit for her own salvation.

text: Repleti Domine muneribus sacris quaesumus ut intercedentibus sanctis tuis Felice et Adaucto in gratiarum actione semper maneamus.
translation_en: Lord, filled with sacred gifts, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your saints, Felicitas and Adauctus, we may always remain in the act of giving thanks.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus fortitudo certantium et martyrum palma sollemnitatem hodiernae diei propitius intuere et Ecclesiam tuam continua fac celebritate gaudere ut intercessione beati Prisci martyris tui omnium in te credentium vota perficias.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, graciously look upon the triumph of those who contend and the palm of the martyrs on this day. May Your Church rejoice continually with festive joy, so that through the intercession of Blessed Priscus, Your martyr, You fulfill the vows of all who believe in You.

text: Beati Prisci martyris tui precibus tibi Domine grata reddatur oblatio pro cuius est festivitate immolanda.
translation_en: May your offering, O Lord, be pleasingly received through the prayers of blessed Priscus, for whom a festival is being offered.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia alimenta percepimus intercedente beato Aegidio abbate contra omnia adversa muniamur et ad gaudia aeterna consequenda spes nobis suppetat et facultas.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that, with the intercession of the blessed Abbot St. Gregory, we may be fortified against all adversities by the celestial nourishment we have received, and that hope and ability support us in attaining eternal joys.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sacramenti tui participatione vegetati sancti quoque martyris Prisci precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, our God, that by participating in your sacrament, we may be aided by the prayers of the holy martyr Priscus as well.

text: Deus qui beatum Emericum iuvenili flore nitentem in sanctorum confessorum tuorum consortium sublimasti praesta quaesumus ut quem tibi facis esse devotum eius apud te perpetuum sentiamus auxilium.
translation_en: God who raised the blessed Emeric, shining in the flower of youth, among the fellowship of your saints, we beseech you to grant that we may feel his eternal aid towards him whom you make devoted to you.

text: Oblatio quam tibi offerimus Domine nos purget ab omni crimine quatenus et per intercessionem sancti Emerici confessoris tui cuius sacram recolimus festivitatem sumamus patriae caelestis hereditatem.
translation_en: Offering that we present to You, Lord, may purge us from all sin, so that through the intercession of Your confessor Saint Emericus, whose festival we celebrate today, we may inherit the heritage of the celestial homeland.

text: Plebem tuam Domine a cunctis adversitatibus protege et beato Emerico confessore tuo intercedente et praesentis vitae opportunitatem et futurae sentiamus sempiternitatem.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people from all adversities; and through the intercession of Blessed Emeric, your confessor, may we feel both the opportunity of this present life and the eternity of the future.

text: Deus qui nos beati Antonini martyris tui concedis natalicio perfrui eius nos tribue precibus adiuvari.
translation_en: God who grants us to celebrate the nativity of your blessed martyr St. Anthony, grant us to be helped by his prayers.

text: Sume sacrificium Domine benignus exhibitum et quod nomini tuo Antonini martyris tui sollemnitate offerimus nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: Accept, Lord, the offering presented with kindness and what we offer in solemnity to your martyr Antoninus. May it be beneficial to us for forgiveness.

text: Refecti Domine muneribus sacris supplices deprecamur ut indulgentiam tuam nobis intercessio beati Antonini martyris tui et imploret semper et impetret.
translation_en: Feeded, Lord, with sacred gifts, we humbly pray that your indulgence may always be sought and obtained through the intercession of your blessed martyr St. Anthony.

text: Adesto Domine precibus nostris quas in sancti Evurcii confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnitate deferimus ut qui nostrae iustitiae fiduciam non habemus eius qui tibi placuit precibus et meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, with our prayers which we bring at the solemnity of your Confessor Saint Evurcius and Pope, that he who pleased you may aid us, who have no confidence in our own justice, by his intercessions and merits.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine intercedente beato Evurcio confessore tuo atque pontifice emundet nostra delicta et subditorum tibi corpora mentesque santificet.
translation_en: This offering we ask you, Lord, through the intercession of the blessed Evergius, your confessor and bishop, may purify our sins and sanctify the bodies and minds of your subjects.

text: Repleti Domine muneribus sacris quaesumus ut intercessione sancti Evurcii martyris tui in gratiarum actione semper maneamus.
translation_en: Lord, filled with sacred gifts, we ask that through the intercession of your martyr St. Evurcius, we may always remain in Your gratitude action.

text: Famulis tuis quaesumus Domine caelestis gratiae munus impertire ut quibus beatae Mariae Virginis partus exstitit salutis exordium nativitatis eius votiva sollemnitas pacis tribuat incrementum.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to bestow Your heavenly grace upon Your servants, so that the festive celebration of the birth of blessed Mary Virgin, which marked the beginning of salvation, may grant them increase in peace.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente beato Hadriano martyre tuo per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: Lord, we offer these gifts, sanctify them. Through the intercession of blessed martyr Hadrian, may you consider us favorably.

text: Sumpsimus Domine celebritatis annuae votiva sacramenta praesta quaesumus ut intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Virgine Maria et temporalis nobis vitae remedia praebeant et aeternae.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the vows of annual solemnity; grant us, we pray, that through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, temporal remedies for our lives be provided and eternal ones as well.

text: Beati Hadriani martyris tui quaesumus Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporaliter gerimus perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of Saint Hadrian, the martyr, you may be pleased to grant us, so that what we do temporally may be obtained for us by eternal salvation.

text: Grata tibi sit Domine nostra servitutis oblatio pro qua sanctus Gorgonius martyr interveniat.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to you, Lord, our offering of service. For which Saint Gorgonius the martyr may intercede.

text: Familiam tuam Domine Deus suavitas illa contingat et vegetet quae in martyre tuo Gorgonio Christi tui bono iugiter odore pascatur.
translation_en: May Your family, Lord God, be graced with that sweetness and may they always graze on the good odor of your martyr Gorgonius Christ's.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum Proti et Hyacinthi nos Domine quaesumus foveat pretiosa confessio et ‹et› pia iugiter intercessio tueatur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the confession of your blessed martyrs Protus and Hyacinth may be fostered by a precious continuation, and may their constant holy intercession protect us.

text: Pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum Proti et Hyacinthi commemoratione munera quae debemus Domine tibi exsolvimus praesta quaesumus ut remedium nostrae salutis operentur.
translation_en: For the commemoration of your martyrs Protus and Hyacinth, we pay the duties that we owe to you, Lord. We humbly ask that you grant us, so that the merits may work for our salvation's remedy.

text: Ut percepta nos Domine tua sancta purificent beatorum martyrum tuorum Proti et Hyacinthi quaesumus imploret oratio.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that Your holy purifiers cleanse us as they cleansed Your blessed martyrs Protus and Hyacinth. We humbly request this through Your intercession.

text: Sancti Maurilii confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine muniamur suffragiis cuius te donante laetamur sollemniis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to strengthen us with the intercessions of your Confessor and Bishop Saint Maurilius, whose joy we celebrate in your feast days.

text: Beati Maurilii confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine veneranda sollemnitas tuae pietati sacrificium nostrum reddat acceptum ut per hanc salutarem hostiam et veniam consequamur et gratiam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the venerable solemnity of your piety may make our offering to the blessed confessor and bishop Maurilius acceptable. Through this saving sacrifice, we may obtain forgiveness and grace.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut hodiernae munus sollemnitatis acceptum intercedente beato Maurilio confessore tuo atque pontifice et corporibus nostris salutem praestet et mentibus.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that, through the intercession of Blessed Maurice, your confessioner and pope, the solemnity of today's rite may bring health to our bodies and peace to our minds.

text: Deus qui Unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi pretioso sanguine humanum genus redimere dignatus es concede propitius ut qui ad adorandam vivificam eius crucem adveniunt a peccatorum suorum nexibus liberentur.
translation_en: God, who deemed it worthy to redeem the human race with the precious blood of your Only-Begotten Son our Lord Jesus Christ, grant them mercifully that those who come to adore the life-giving cross of him may be freed from the bonds of their sins.

text: Beatorum martyrum pariterque pontificum Cornelii et Cypriani nos quaesumus Domine festa tueantur et eorum commendet oratio veneranda.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, may the festival of the blessed martyrs Cornelius and Cyprian be kept safe for us, and may their venerable prayer recommend us.

text: Plebis tuae Domine munera benignus intende quae maiestati tuae pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cornelii et Cypriani sollemnitate sint dicata.
translation_en: Lord, with a gracious mind pay attention to the gifts of your people, which on the solemnity of your saintly martyrs Cornelius and Cyprian should be dedicated to your majesty.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quos mysterio sanctae crucis divina tribuis participatione gaudere humanis non sinas subiacere periculis.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God that you who grant us a participation in the mystery of the holy cross, do not allow us to be subjected to human dangers.

text: Suscipe Domine munera propitius oblata quae maiestati tuae beati Nicomedis martyris tui commendet oratio.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings graciously, which are being presented to Your majesty on behalf of the blessed martyr Nicomedes. Prayer does so.

text: Purificent nos Domine sacramenta quae sumpsimus et intercedente beato Nicomede martyre tuo a cunctis efficiant vitiis absolutos.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, from the sacraments which we have received, and through the intercession of your blessed martyr Nicholas, may they make us free from all sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui infirma mundi eligis ut fortia quaeque confundas concede propitius ut qui beatae Euphemiae martyris tuae sollemnia colimus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who chooses the weak of the world to confound the strong, graciously grant that we who celebrate the solemnity of your blessed martyr Euphemia may feel her patronage with you.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut in tuo conspectu mors est pretiosa sanctorum ita eorum merita venerantium intercedente beata Euphemia martyre tua accepta tibi reddatur oblatio.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord our God, that just as death is precious in your sight for the saints, so their merits offered by those approaching may be presented to you through the intercession of Blessed Euphemia, your martyr, accepted by you.

text: Deus qui beatum pontificem et martyrem tuum Lambertum tuo amore inflammasti concede propitius ut qui illis sollemnia celebramus devoti ipso opitulante semper gaudeamus ab omni adversitate securi.
translation_en: God who set your blessed bishop and martyr Lambert on fire with your love, graciously grant that we who celebrate their solemnities with devotion may always rejoice with him interceding, secure from every adversity.

text: Adesto Domine quaesumus famulorum tuorum hostiis adesto muneribus sancti Lamberti pontificis et martyris tui precibus placatus ac meritis eius gaudentes sollemnitate ad hostium infestationibus clementer tuere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, be present at the offerings of your servants. Be present with the gifts of Saint Lambert, bishop and martyr. Delighted by your prayers and his merits, protect us graciously during the solemnity against attacks on the altar.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Matthaei apostoli tui et evangelistae quam praevenimus veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that the venerable feast and devotion of your blessed apostle and evangelist Matthew, which we are about to celebrate, may increase in us, and bring us salvation.

text: Beati Matthaei apostoli tui et evangelistae quaesumus Domine supplicatione placatus et veniam nobis tribue et remedia sempiterna concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercession of your blessed Apostle Matthew and Evangelist, that you grant us forgiveness and everlasting relief.

text: Beati Matthaei apostoli tui et evangelistae quaesumus Domine precibus adiuvemur ut quod possibilitas nostra non obtinet eius nobis intercessione donetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to help us with our prayers that what we are unable to obtain through our own means may be given to us through the intercession of your Apostle and Evangelist Matthew.

text: Supplicationibus apostolicis beati Matthaei apostoli tui et evangelistae quaesumus Domine Ecclesiae tuae tibi commendetur oblatio cuius magnificis praedicationibus eruditur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, that our offering be commended to your Church by the apostolic supplications of blessed Matthias the Apostle and Evangelist, whom you have taught with your magnificent preachings.

text: Annue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nos sanctorum martyrum tuorum Mauritii Exsuperii Candidi Victoris Innocentii et Vitalis ac sociorum eorumdem laetificet festiva sollemnitas et quorum suffragiis nitimur nataliciis eorum gloriemur.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, to bless us so that the festival of your saints Martyrs Mauritius, Exsuperius, Candidus, Victor, Innocent, and Vitalis, along with their companions, may bring us joy. May we rejoice in their natal days through their intercession.

text: Plebis tuae Domine munera benignus intende quae maiestati tuae pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum Mauritii cum sociis suis sollemnitatibus sunt dicata.
translation_en: Lord, with a gracious mind, direct the gifts of your people. Those that are dedicated to Your majesty on the solemnities of Your saints Maurice and his companions have been offered.

text: Caelestibus refecti sacramentis et gaudiis supplices te Domine deprecamur ut qui sanctorum martyrum tuorum Mauritii Exsuperii Candidi Victoris Innocentii et Vitalis gloriamur triumphis et eorum protegamur auxiliis. ... Dominum nostrum
translation_en: Having been refreshed with the sacraments and joys, we humbly entreat you, Lord, that we may rejoice in the triumphs of your holy martyrs Mauritius, Exsuperius, Candidus, Victor, Innocent, and Vitalis, and be protected by their aid. ... Our Lord

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatae Theclae virginis et martyris tuae sollemnia colimus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: We ask You, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of Your blessed Thecla, virgin and martyr, we may feel Your patronage through her intercession.

text: Sanctae virginis et martyris tuae Theclae quaesumus Domine pio interventu haec tibi grata reddatur oblatio pariterque nos et a peccatis omnibus expiet et ad caelestia dona capienda iugiter praeparet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this offering to your holy virgin and martyr Thecla may be pleasing to you. May it also cleanse us from all sins and continually prepare us for the heavenly gifts.

text: Corporis sacri et pretiosi sanguinis repleti libamine quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sanctae virginis et martyris tuae Theclae intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos tuearis adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to protect us with the power of your sacred and precious blood. May the merits of your saint and martyr Thecla intervene on our behalf, shielding us from all dangers.

text: Deus qui beatum Gerardum pontificem agone martyrii et stola immortalitatis coronasti concede propitius ut cuius sollemnitatem devotis mentibus celebramus in terris eius perpetua defensione muniamur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who crowned the blessed Gerard bishop with the martyr's crown and the robe of immortality in heavenly combat, graciously grant that we, who celebrate his solemnity with devoted minds on earth, may be protected by his perpetual defense in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui instituta legalia et sanctorum praeconia prophetarum in diebus conceptionis beati Ioannis Baptistae implesti praesta quaesumus ut cessantibus significationum figuris sui magnificatione eloquatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who filled the prophetic preachings of the saints with legal institutions on the day of the conception of blessed John the Baptist, we humbly ask that you speak, as figures of your own glory cease, through eloquence.

text: Oblata Domine munera tua virtute sanctifica et intercessione beati Gerardi pontificis et martyris ab omnibus nos defende periculis.
translation_en: Lord, by your power sanctify the offerings presented to you and protect us from all dangers through the intercession of Blessed Gerard, bishop and martyr.

text: Tua nos Domine muneribus altaria cumulamus illius conceptionem honore debito celebrantes qui Salvatorem mundi et cecinit affuturum et adesse monstravit.
translation_en: We, Lord, pile up the altars with your offerings, honorably celebrating the conception of him who sang that he would come to save the world and showed that he would appear.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam pretiosissimi corporis et sanguinis Filii tui libamine praesta quaesumus ut intercessione beati Gerardi martyris tui atque pontificis nobis proficiat ad salutem mentis et corporis.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with the most precious body and blood of your Son. We humbly ask that you provide abundantly, so that through the intercession of the blessed Gerard, your martyr and bishop, we may profit for the salvation of mind and body.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus intra sanctae Ecclesiae tuae uterum constitutos eo nos spiritu ab iniquitate nostra iustificari quo beatum Ioannem intra viscera materna docuisti.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God within the womb of your holy Church, to sanctify us with that Spirit whereby we may be justified from our own wickedness, as you taught blessed John within his mother's womb.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatae Cleophae virginis et martyris tuae sollemnia colimus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the solemnity of your blessed servant and martyr Cleophas, we may feel his protection with you.

text: Sanctae virginis tuae Cleophae quaesumus Domine pio interventu haec tibi grata reddatur oblatio pariterque nos et a peccatis omnibus expiet et ad caelestia dona capienda iugiter praeparet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this offering to your holy virgin Cleopha may be pleasing to you through a pious intervention. May it also cleanse us from all sins and continually prepare us for the heavenly gifts to be received.

text: Corporis sacri et pretiosi sanguinis repleti libamine quaesumus Domine ut sanctae virginis et martyris tuae Cleophae intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos tuearis adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to fill us with the blessings of your sacred and precious body and blood. May the merits of your saintly virgin and martyr Cleophas intercede for us, so that they may protect us from all adversities.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui hunc diem passione sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cypriani et Iustinae sacrasti concede quaesumus ut eorum intercessionibus adiuti ad omnibus absolvi mereamur periculis.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who consecrated this day of the passion of your saints and martyrs Cyril and Justin, we humbly ask that you grant us through their intercession to be absolved from all perils as we are helped by them.

text: In tuorum Domine pretiosa morte iustorum sacrificium illud offerimus de quo martyrium sumpsit omne principium quod quaesumus propitiationis tuae nobis munus obtineat.
translation_en: In Your, Lord, the precious death of the righteous we offer that sacrifice, from which the entire principle of martyrdom took its beginning. May we obtain the gift of your propitiations.

text: Sit nobis Domine sacramenti tui certa salvatio quae cum beatorum martyrum tuorum Cypriani et Iustinae meritis imploratur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, certain salvation through your sacrament, which is sought with the merits of your blessed martyrs Cyrus and Justina.

text: Magnificet te Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cosmae et Damiani beata sollemnitas qua et illis gloriam sempiternam et opem nobis ineffabili providentia contulisti.
translation_en: You magnify, Lord, the saints and martyrs Cosmas and Damian, on their blessed feast day you have bestowed upon them eternal glory and an ineffable help through your providence upon us.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cosmae et Damiani nobis Domine pia non desit oratio quae et munera nostra tibi conciliet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper obtineat.
translation_en: Lord, may the prayers of your martyrs Cosmas and Damian not cease for us. May our offerings be pleasing to you, and may we always obtain your indulgence.

text: Protegat Domine quaesumus populum tuum haec participatio caelestis indulta convivii et sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cosmae et Damiani deprecatio collata.
translation_en: May the Lord protect us, we humbly ask, Your people this participation in heavenly gifts bestowed upon the feast, and the prayer of Your saints, the martyrs Cosmas and Damian.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatum Venceslaum martyrem tuum gloria et honore coronasti concede nobis famulis tuis eius precibus et meritis veniam consequi delictorum et perfrui gaudiis beatorum.
translation_en: God, who today crowned your servant the blessed Venceslaus with glory and honor through martyrdom, grant us, your servants, to obtain forgiveness for our sins through his prayers and merits, and to enjoy the joys of the blessed.

text: Gratanter Domine Deus suscipe hoc sacramentum quod in honore sancti Venceslai martyris tui immolamus et ipsius precibus dona nobis indulgentiam et requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: Graciously, Lord God, receive this sacrifice which we offer in honor of Saint Wenceslas, your martyr, and grant us indulgence through his prayers, and eternal rest.

text: Sumpta Domine sacramenta intercedente beato Venceslao martyre tuo proficiant nobis ad salutem et ad aeterna gaudia perducant.
translation_en: Lord, may the sacred mysteries, through the intercession of your blessed martyr St. Wenceslas, bring us to salvation and lead us to eternal joy.

text: Deus qui miro ordine angelorum ministeria hominumque dispensas concede propitius ut a quibus tibi ministrantibus in caelo semper assistitur ab his in terra vita nostra muniatur.
translation_en: God, who in a wondrous order administers the ministries of angels and men, grant us graciously that we may be fortified on earth by those from whom we are ever assisted in heaven.

text: Beati archangeli tui Michaelis et omnium civium supernorum intercessione suffulti supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quos honore prosequimur contingamus et mente.
translation_en: Blessed are the archangels, especially your Michael, and all the heavenly citizens on whose intercession we rely, we humbly beseech You, Lord. May we, whom you honor as we follow, reach and understand with our minds.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine tua miseratione custodi et quam beatissimus sacerdos et confessor tuus Hieronymus a cunctis te praesidiante purgavit haeresibus ipsius orationibus non desinas momentis omnibus adiuvare.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your mercy protects your church. Just as your blessed priest and confessor Jerome, under your watchful eye, purified it from the heresies of that time through his prayers, may you not cease in every moment to help us.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus munera tuae maiestati oblata per intercessionem beati Hieronymi confessoris tui ad perpetuam nobis fac proficere salutem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we offer your gifts to the majesty of your power through the intercession of the blessed Jerome, your confessor. May it make eternal salvation prosper for us.

text: Sacramenta salutis nostrae suscipientes concede quaesumus misericors Deus ut beati Hieronymi confessoris tui nos ubique adiuvet oratio in cuius veneratione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: Granting us, we humbly ask you, merciful God, the sacraments of our salvation, may your blessed confessor Jerome aid us everywhere in his prayers, whose veneration we have offered to Your majesty in this offering.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum et sanctorum confessorum tuorum Remigii Germani et Vedasti sollemnia celebrantem temporalis vitae tribue pace gaudere et aeternum reperire subsidium.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, your people and the confessed saints of yours, Remigius of Germany and Vedastus, celebrating the solemnity of temporal life. Grant them peace to rejoice in and find eternal support.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine et tuorum respice oblationes fidelium ut et tibi gratiae sint in tuorum festivitate sanctorum et nobis conferant tuae propitiationis auxilium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look upon our prayers and the offerings of your faithful. May these be pleasing to you during the feast of your saints, and grant us the aid of your propitiation.

text: Beatorum confessorum tuorum atque pontificum Remigii Germani et Vedasti natalicia celebrantes supplices te Domine rogamus ut quos caelesti gratia sublimasti tuis adesse fidelibus concedas.
translation_en: Celebrating the feast days of your blessed confessors and bishops Remigius of Germany and Vedastus, we humbly ask you, Lord, that those whom you have exalted by heavenly grace, may be present among your faithful.

text: Deus qui beatum Leodegarium martyrem tuum atque pontificem in agone probasti probatumque in dolore sustentasti praesta nobis famulis tuis ut ipso interveniente indulgentiam adipisci mereamur.
translation_en: God who proved your blessed Leodegar, your martyr and bishop, worthy in the contest, and sustained him in suffering, grant to us, your servants, that with his intervention we may merit to obtain indulgence.

text: Offerimus hostias nomini tuo Domine quanto Dominum nostrum merito formidantes tanto de sancti sacerdotis et martyris Leodegarii suffragiis confidentes praesta quaesumus ut nobis veniam conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer sacrifices to Your name, Lord, with as much reverence as our Lord deserves, fearing His might and confident through the intercessions of the holy priest and martyr Leodegar. Grant us, we pray, forgiveness and salvation.

text: Sumptis Domine salutaribus sacramentis quaesumus ut intercedente beato Leodegario martyre tuo ad redemptionis aeternae proficiamus augmentum.
translation_en: With the saving sacrifices, we humbly ask you, Lord, that, with the intercession of your blessed martyr St. Leodegar, we may advance towards an increase in eternal redemption.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato Francisco ab omni labe purifica.
translation_en: Offerings given to you, Lord, sanctify them, and through blessed Francis purify them from all stain.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine gratia caelestis amplificet quam beati Francisci confessoris tui illuminare dignatus es meritis et exemplis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your church may be enlarged by the grace of heaven, as you have been pleased to enlighten with your merits and examples, blessed Francis, your confessor.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine preces nostras et intercedente beato Marco confessore tuo atque pontifice supplicationes nostras placatus intende.
translation_en: Hear us, we implore you, Lord, our prayers and with the intercession of your blessed confidant St. Mark, and as a pleased one, consider our petitions.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine sacrae plebis oblatio pro honore sancti tui Marci cuius se meritis percepisse de tribulatione cognoscit auxilium.
translation_en: May this offering of the sacred people be accepted by you, Lord, in honor of your saint Marc, who has recognized through his merits that he received aid from trouble.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus populis tuis sancti tui Marci semper veneratione laetari et eius perpetua supplicatione muniri.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your faithful people the joy of constant reverence for your saint, Mark, and protect them by his perpetual intercession.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum nos Domine Marci Marcelli Apulei Sergii et Bacchi beata merita prosequantur et tuo semper faciant amore ferventes.
translation_en: May the blessed merits of your martyrs, Lord Marcian, Marcellus, Apuleius, Sergius, and Bachitus, follow us always and may they make us fiercely loving towards you.

text: Oblationes et preces Ecclesiae tuae sanctorum martyrum tuorum Domine Marci Marcelli Apulei Sergii et Bacchi commendet oratio ut et munera nostra tibi reddantur accepta et ab omnibus malis eruamur.
translation_en: Oblations and prayers of your holy martyrs, Lord Mark, Marcellus, Apuleius, Sergius, and Bacchus, may this petition commend our offerings to you, that they may be accepted by you and we may be freed from all evil.

text: Sacramentis Domine muniamur acceptis et sanctorum tuorum Marci et Marcelli Apulei Sergii et Bacchi interventione contra omnes nequitias irruentes armis caelestibus protegamur.
translation_en: Lord, may we be fortified by the sacraments and protected by Your saints Marc, Marcellus, Apuleius Sergius, and Bacchus, through their intercession, against all evil forces that attack us with celestial arms.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatum Dionysium martyrem tuum virtute constantiae in passione roborasti quique illi ad praedicandum gentibus gloriam tuam Rusticum et Eleutherium sociare dignatus es tribue nobis quaesumus ex eorum imitatione pro amore tuo prospera mundi despicere et nulla eius adversa formidare.
translation_en: God, who on this day strengthened your martyr Dionysius with constancy in his passion, and saw fit to associate Rusticus and Eleutherius with him for preaching the glory of you among the nations, grant us, we beseech you, through their example, that we may despise the contempt of the world for your love and fear no adversity thereof.

text: Hostia Domine quaesumus quam in sanctorum tuorum Dionysii Rustici et Eleutherii nataliciis recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offering we present on the birthday of your saints Dionysius Rusticus and Eleutherius may loosen the bonds of our wickedness and unite us with your mercy.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia alimenta percepimus intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis Dionysio Rustico et Eleutherio per haec contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: We entreat the almighty God that we, who have received celestial nourishment through your saints Martyrs Dionysius, Rusticus and Eleutherius, may be fortified against all adversities through these.

text: Deus qui gloriosos martyres Gereonem sociosque eius hodierna die sanguinis sui effusione coronasti praesta quaesumus ut eorum apud te assiduum sentiamus interventum in caelis.
translation_en: God who crowned the glorious martyrs Geronimo and his companions today with the outpouring of their blood, grant us, we pray, that we may experience their constant intercession before you in heaven.

text: Munera Domine tuae largitatis quae in honore sanctorum martyrum Gereonis sociorumque eius tuae offerimus pietati sereno vultu accipe ut eorum interventu tuae inhabitationis templum fieri mereamur.
translation_en: Gracious Lord, we offer to your generosity, in honor of the holy martyrs Geronius and his companions, gifts with a pure face. May you accept them so that through their intervention, we may deserve to have your presence make our temple.

text: Mensae caelestis Domine repleti libamine quaesumus ut intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis quorum sollemnia agimus hoc quod fide contemplamur mente consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the tables of heaven be filled with abundance. May we, while celebrating the solemnities of your holy martyrs whose faith we contemplate in mind, also follow it in spirit.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Colomani martyris tui gloriosa merita veneramur eius apud te precibus et meritis semper muniamur.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Almighty God, so that we who honor the glorious merits of the blessed martyr Coloman, may always be protected by his prayers and merits with you.

text: Munera populi tui quaesumus Domine placatus assume et beati martyris tui Colomani intercessione a cunctis nos peccatorum nexibus propitiatus absolve.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, pleased with your people, to accept the offerings and through the intercession of your blessed martyr Colin, to forgive us from all bonds of sin.

text: Repleti muneribus sacris quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Colomani martyris tui semper adiuvemur meritis in cuius haec veneratione peregimus.
translation_en: Filled with sacred offices, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, to always help us by the merits of your blessed martyr St. Columbanus, in whose veneration we are currently engaged.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et interveniente beato Cerbonio confessore tuo atque pontifice supplicationibus nostris placatus intende.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers, and, with the intervention of your blessed confessor Cerbonius and your bishop, favorably incline to our supplications.

text: In tuo conspectu Domine quaesumus talia sint nostra munera quae intercedente beato Cerbonio confessore tuo atque pontifice et placare te valeant et nos tibi placere perficiant.
translation_en: In your presence, Lord, we humbly ask that our offerings may be such that, through the intercession of Blessed Cerbonius, your confessor and pope, they may appease you and cause us to please you.

text: Repleti sumus Domine muneribus sacris tuis quae de festivitate beati Cerbonii confessoris tui atque pontificis percepimus tribue quaesumus ut eius intercessione mundemur vitiorum effectu et muniamur auxilio.
translation_en: We are filled, Lord, with Your sacred gifts which we have received on the feast of Your confessor and bishop, Blessed Cerbonius. We humbly ask You to grant us that through his intercession we may be cleansed from the effects of sin and strengthened by his aid.

text: Deus qui conspicis nos ex nostra infirmitate deficere ad amorem tuum nos misericorditer per sancti Calixti martyris tui atque pontificis exempla restaura.
translation_en: God, who sees us falter from our weakness in loving you, restore us mercifully through the example of your martyr and pope Saint Calixtus.

text: Mystica nobis Domine prosit oblatio quae nos intercedente beato Calixto martyre tuo atque pontifice et a reatibus nostris clementer expediat et perpetua salvatione confirmet.
translation_en: May, Lord, this mystery offering profit us, which through the intercession of your martyr and bishop St. Calixtus may gently free us from our sins and confirm us with eternal salvation.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut reatum nostrum munera sacrata purificent et intercedente beato Calixto martyre tuo atque pontifice recte vivendi nobis operentur effectum.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that the sacred gifts cleanse our repentance, and through the intercession of the blessed martyr Calixtus, Your bishop who lived righteously, may bring about the effect for us to live righteously as well.

text: Deus dator gratiae et veniae tuae nobis propitius sinum aperi pietatis et praesta ut qui manentem hic non habemus civitatem ad futuram quam quaerimus beatae Hedwigis interveniente suffragio perducamur.
translation_en: God, giver of grace and forgiveness to us, have mercy. Open the bosom of your pity towards us and grant that we who do not have a dwelling here may be led by the intercession of the blessed Hedwig to the future city which we seek.

text: Munera Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus quaesumus ut tibi grata nobisque salutaria beatae Hedwigis pia supplicatione reddantur.
translation_en: We present, Lord, the gifts of our devotion; we ask that through a pleasing offering to You and a beneficial response for us, may the pious petition to the blessed Hedwig be returned.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus ut quos salutaribus dignatus es erudire mysteriis quaesumus beatae Hedwigis intercessio gloriosa caelestibus reficiat alimentis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has deemed us worthy to be instructed in the sacred mysteries, we humbly ask that the intercession of Blessed Hedwig may restore celestial nourishment to us.

text: Da nobis aeternae consolationis Pater per beati Galli confessoris tui preces pacem et salutem mentis et corporis ut eius tota dilectione inhaereamus praeceptis et quae tibi placita sunt tota virtute perficiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, everlasting comfort, Father, through the prayers of your holy confessor Saint Gallus, peace and health for mind and body, so that we may adhere entirely to his love through commandments and complete all things pleasing to you with full virtue.

text: Da nobis famulis tuis Domine Deus omnipotens in festivitate sancti Sigismundi regis et martyris tui dignis eius orationibus delictorum nostrorum indulgentiam adipisci et electorum tuorum numero associari.
translation_en: Grant us, your servants, Lord God Almighty, in the festivity of your saint and martyr King Sigismund, worthy of his prayers, to obtain forgiveness for our sins and to be associated with your chosen ones.

text: Hostias Domine quas nomini tuo sacrandas offerimus sancti Galli confessoris tui prosequatur oratio per quam nos expiari tribuis et defendi.
translation_en: Hostias, Lord, which we offer to be consecrated for your name, may the prayer of Saint Gall, your confessor, follow after. May this prayer cleanse us and protect us.

text: Repleti Domine benedictione caelesti quaesumus clementiam tuam ut intercedente beato Gallo confessore tuo quae humiliter gerimus salubriter sentiamus.
translation_en: Filled, Lord, with heavenly blessing, we ask for your clemency that through the intercession of the blessed Gaul, your confessor, we may healthfully feel what we humbly carry out.

text: Donis caelestibus da quaesumus Domine libera mente nos tibi servire et munera quae deferimus interveniente evangelista tuo Luca et medelam nobis operentur et gloriam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us through your heavenly gifts the freedom of mind to serve you. May the offerings we bring, accompanied by your apostle Luke, be effective and bring healing to us. May this bring glory to you.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut id quod de sancto altari tuo accepimus precibus beati evangelistae tui Lucae sanctificet animas nostras per quod tuti esse possimus.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Almighty God, that what we have received from your holy altar through the prayers of your blessed evangelist Luke, may sanctify our souls, so that we can safely be.

text: Deus qui nos in tantis periculis constitutos pro humana scis fragilitate non posse subsistere da nobis per merita sanctarum virginum castitatem pacem salutem mentis et corporis ut ea quae pro peccatis nostris patimur te adiuvante vincamus.
translation_en: God, who knows that we, placed in such dangers, cannot sustain ourselves due to human frailty, grant us through the merits of the holy virgins, peace and salvation for both mind and body, so that, with your help, we may overcome the sufferings we endure for our sins.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut huius sacrificii munus oblatum fragilitatem nostram ab omni malo purget semper et muniat et sanctarum virginum meritis ac precibus a praeteritis malis exuamur et futuris.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that this offering of the sacrifice may always cleanse our frailty from all evil and protect it. May the merits and prayers of the holy virgins free us from past evils and guard us against future ones.

text: Munera nos tua Deus supplicatione sanctarum virginum a delectationibus terrenis expediant et caelestibus nos semper instruant alimentis.
translation_en: May your God grant us, through the supplications of the holy virgins, to be delivered from earthly delights and always to be instructed with celestial nourishment.

text: Deus qui beatum Severinum confessorem tuum atque pontificem hodierna die suscepisti atque remunerasti concede propitius ut qui eius gaudemus meritis provocemur exemplis et eius intercessione veniam et vitam mereamur aeternam.
translation_en: God, who today received and rewarded your blessed confessor and bishop Severinus, graciously grant that we who rejoice in his merits may be inspired by his examples and through his intercession may merit eternal pardon and life.

text: Haec sacra nos quaesumus Domine quae pro venerandis beati Severini confessoris tui atque pontificis deferimus meritis vincula peccatorum nostrorum solvant et eius obtentu ab omnibus tueantur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us these sacred things that we bring forward in honor of your blessed confessor and bishop Severinus. May his merits dissolve the bonds of our sins and may they be protected from all adversities under his patronage.

text: Munus perpetuae salutis sumentes clementiam tuam omnipotens Deus supplices imploramus ut beato Severino intercedente vitae caelestis praemia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Taking up the office of eternal salvation, we humbly beseech your clemency, O almighty God, that with the intercession of Blessed Severinus, we may be worthy to obtain the rewards of heavenly life.

text: Sancti Maglorii confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine muniamur suffragiis cuius te donante laetamur sollemniis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to be strengthened by the intercession of Saint Maglorius, your confessor and bishop. Through your gift we rejoice in his solemnities.

text: Munera Domine tuae largitatis quae in honore sancti Maglorii confessoris tui atque pontificis tuae offerimus pietati sereno vultu accipe ut eius interventu tuae inhabitationis templum fieri mereamur.
translation_en: Gifts of your generous bounty, which we offer in honor of Saint Maglorius, your confessor and bishop, receive with a serene countenance. May it be through his intercession that we are worthy to have our dwelling become your temple.

text: Mensae caelestis Domine repleti libamine quaesumus ut intercedente beato Maglorio confessore tuo atque pontifice cuius sollemnia agimus hoc quod fide contemplamur mente consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the tables of heaven be filled with abundance, through the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop, St. Maglorius, whose feast day we celebrate today. May our faith enable us to contemplate, and our minds to follow.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sicut beatorum martyrum tuorum Crispini et Crispiniani natalicia colimus sic aures misericordiae tuae pro nobis semper implorent.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask You, almighty and merciful God, that just as we celebrate the nativity of Your blessed martyrs Crispin and Crispinian, so may our ears always be filled with the mercy of Your hearing on our behalf.

text: Deus qui beatum Demetrium martyrem tuum virtutum signis in mundo clarificas eius nos interventu quaesumus a cunctis reatibus et a malis quae pro eis meremur absolve propitius.
translation_en: God, who illuminates your blessed Demetrius the martyr with signs of virtues in the world, we humbly ask through his intercession that you forgive us from all sins and evil deeds which we deserve to be absolved, graciously.

text: Munera nostra Domine meritis beati Demetrii martyris tibi quaesumus reddantur accepta et nosmet ipsi gratum tibi efficiamur sacrificium.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that our offerings may be returned to you because of the merits of blessed Demetrius the martyr. May we ourselves also become a pleasing sacrifice to you.

text: Purificet nos quaesumus Domine caelestis mensae libatio et intercedente beato Demetrio martyre tuo ad vitam nobis proficiat sempiternam.
translation_en: Purify us, we ask you, Lord, the offering on your celestial table, and with the intercession of your martyr Saint Demetrius, may it lead us to eternal life.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut apostolorum tuorum Simonis et Iudae gloriosa natalicia praevenimus sic ad tua beneficia promerenda maiestatem tuam pro nobis ipsi praeveniant.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that just as the glorious birthdays of your apostles Simon and Jude were preceded, so may your majesty be preceded on our behalf for the performance of your benefits.

text: Muneribus nostris quaesumus Domine apostolorum tuorum Simonis et Iudae festa praecedimus ut quae conscientiae nostrae praepediuntur obstaculis illorum meritis tibi grata reddantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with the offerings we bring that on the feast of your apostles Simon and Judas, the obstacles that weigh upon our conscience may be removed through their merits and offered to you as a pleasing gift.

text: Sumpto Domine sacramento suppliciter deprecamur ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis tuis Simone et Iuda quod temporaliter gerimus ad vitam capiamus aeternam.
translation_en: Lord, with the sacrament received we humbly entreat you, through the intercession of your apostles Simon and Jude, that what we temporarily possess may lead us to obtain eternal life.

text: Deus qui nos per beatos apostolos tuos Simonem et Iudam ad agnitionem tui nominis venire tribuisti da nobis eorum gloriam sempiternam et proficiendo celebrare et celebrando proficere.
translation_en: God who through your blessed apostles Simon and Judas brought us to the recognition of Your name, grant us their eternal glory. And as we advance in celebration and celebrate, may we also progress.

text: Gloriam Domine sanctorum apostolorum tuorum Simonis et Iudae perpetuam recensentes quaesumus ut eandem sacris mysteriis expiati dignius celebremus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to remember the glory of your holy apostles, Simon and Judas, and we renew our request for a perpetual remembrance. May we worthily celebrate the same sacred mysteries that have been purified by their intercession.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis supplices te rogamus ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis tuis Simone et Iuda quae pro illorum veneranda gerimus passione nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Perceiving, Lord, Your sacred mysteries, we humbly ask You that through the intercession of Your holy apostles Simon and Jude, what we carry out in reverence for their venerable passion may benefit us towards healing.

text: Sancti martyris tui Quintini nos quaesumus Domine veneranda festivitas muniat et fragilitati nostrae subsidium dignanter exoret.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the honorable feast of your saint Quintinus may protect us and provide fitting help to our frailty.

text: Altare tuum Domine Deus muneribus cumulamus oblatis da quaesumus ut ad salutem nostram omnium sanctorum tuorum precatione proficiant quorum sollemnia ventura praecurrimus.
translation_en: We heap up offerings upon your altar, Lord God. Grant us what we ask, that through the prayers of all your saints, whose feast days we are about to celebrate, they may advance for our salvation.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius orationem nostram cum oblationibus hostiarum superimpositis et martyris tui Quintini deprecatione pietati tuae perfice benignus acceptas et illam quae in eo flagravit fortem dilectionem in nobis aspira benignus.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, graciously our prayer with the offerings of sacrifices laid upon them and through the intercession of your martyr Quintinus, may you complete them kindly. May a strong love for him ignite in us, kindly inspiring it.

text: Sacramentis Domine et gaudiis optata celebritate expletis quaesumus ut omnium sanctorum precibus adiuvemur quorum recordationibus exhibentur.
translation_en: Having completed the Sacraments, Lord, and with the desired festivity, we humbly ask that you assist us with the prayers of all saints, whose remembrance is presented.

text: Votiva Domine pro beati martyris tui Quintini passione dona percepimus quaesumus ut eius precibus et praesentis nobis vitae pariter et aeternae tribuas conferre subsidium.
translation_en: We have perceived, Lord, the vows made in honor of your blessed martyr Quintinus through his passion. We humbly ask that you grant us to receive help both in this life and in eternal life through his intercessions.

text: Deus qui nos beati Caesarii martyris tui annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus etiam actiones imitemur.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the annual solemnity of your martyr Caesar, grant us graciously, that we may not only celebrate his natal day but also imitate his actions.

text: Hostias tibi Domine dicatas beati Caesarii martyris tui meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: May the Hosts offered to You, Lord, through the merits of blessed Caesarius, Your martyr, be graciously received and may they grant us perpetual support as aid.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus populis tuis omnium sanctorum tuorum semper pia veneratione laetari et eorum perpetua supplicatione muniri.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your faithful people of all the saints always to rejoice with pious devotion and to be strengthened by their perpetual intercession.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia alimenta percepimus intercedente beato Caesario martyre tuo per haec contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that we who have received heavenly nourishment through the intercession of blessed Caesar your martyr, may be fortified against all adversities through these.

text: Deus qui sanctorum tuorum actus et certamina mirabiliter disponis beati Eustachii sociorumque eius intercessione vitam nostram ab omni discrimine et adversitate custodi.
translation_en: God, who wonderfully arrange the deeds and contests of your saints, protect our life from every danger and adversity through the intercession of blessed Eustachius and his companions.

text: Munera Domine plebis tuae quaesumus sanctorum martyrum tuorum fiant grata suffragiis et quorum triumphis tuo nomini offeruntur ipsorum digne perficiantur et meritis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the gifts of your people may be pleasing through the intercession of your holy martyrs. May their triumphs bring glory to your name, and may they worthily complete the deeds for which their merits are offered.

text: Adesto Domine precibus populi tui cum sancti Eustachii sociorumque eius patrocinio supplicantis ut quod pro gloria fiducia non praesumit suffragantium meritis consequamur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, with the prayers of your people, under the patronage of Saint Eustachius and his companions, that we may obtain what we humbly hope for through their merits.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatum Adalbertum martyrem tuum atque pontificem gloria et honore coronasti concede nobis famulis tuis eius intercessione et meritis veniam consequi delictorum et perfrui gaudiis beatorum.
translation_en: God who today adorned the blessed Adalbert, your martyr and bishop, with glory and honor, grant to us, your servants, through his intercession and merits, to obtain forgiveness for our sins and to experience the joys of the blessed.

text: Sacrificia Domine quae pro beati Adalberti martyris tui atque pontificis honore tibi sollemniter deferimus ipsius intercessione nobis semper sint salutaria.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, the sacrifices that are solemnly brought for the honor of Blessed Adalbert, Your martyr and bishop. May his intercession always be beneficial to us.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui nos omnium sacramentorum tuorum et participes efficis et ministros praesta quaesumus ut intercedente beato Adalberto martyre tuo atque pontifice et fidei proficiamus augmento et beatitudinis iungamur consortio.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who make us participants and ministers of all your sacraments, we humbly ask that you grant us. Through the intercession of Blessed Adalbert, your martyr and bishop, may we progress in faith and join the consortium of beatitude.

text: Purificet nos Domine semper et muniat tui susceptio sacramenti et intercessione sanctissimi confessoris tui Leonardi perpetuis per eam mereamur gaudiis admisceri.
translation_en: Cleanse us, Lord, always and fortify us through your receiving of the sacrament, and through the intercession of your holy confessor Leonard, may we merit to be admitted to eternal joys perpetually.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus beati Willibrordi confessoris tui atque pontificis nos sequi exempla cuius gloriosa celebramus sollemnia.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that we may follow the examples of your blessed confessor and bishop, St. Willibrord, whose glorious feast days we celebrate.

text: Sit tibi quaesumus Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio acceptabilis ut beato Willibrordo confessore tuo atque pontifice intercedente utrumque et tuae placeat maiestati et nostrae proficiat saluti.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that our offering of devotion may be acceptable to You. Through the intercession of your confessor and bishop, Blessed Willibrord, may it please Your majesty and benefit our salvation.

text: Mysteriis divinis refecti Domine Deus quaesumus ut beati Willibrordi confessoris tui atque pontificis ubique intercessione protegamur pro cuius annua veneratione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: Fed by the divine mysteries, Lord God, we humbly ask that, through the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop Willibrord, everywhere, we may be protected. For whose annual veneration we have offered this to your majesty.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui gloriosos martyres tuos fortes in sua confessione cognovimus pios apud te in nostra intercessione sentiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, almighty God, that we who have come to know Your glorious martyrs as brave in their confession, may feel them as devout on our behalf before You in our intercession.

text: Hostias nostras tibi Domine pro martyrum tuorum coronatorum commemoratione deferimus supplicantes ut indulgentiam nobis pariter conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer our hosts, Lord, to You on behalf of Your crowned martyrs during their remembrance. We humbly ask that You grant us forgiveness and salvation in return.

text: Caelestibus refecti sacramentis et gaudiis supplices te Domine deprecamur ut qui sanctorum martyrum tuorum gloriamur triumphis eorum protegamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Having been refreshed by celestial sacraments and joys, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that we who rejoice in the triumphs of your saints may be protected by their assistance.

text: Deus qui nos beati Theodori martyris tui confessione gloriosa circumdas et protegis praesta nobis ex eius imitatione proficere et oratione fulciri.
translation_en: God who surrounds and protects us by the glorious confession of your blessed martyr Theodore, grant that we may progress through his example and fulfill our prayers through his intercession.

text: Suscipe Domine fidelium preces cum oblationibus hostiarum et intercedente beato Theodoro martyre tuo per haec piae devotionis officia ad caelestem gloriam transeamus.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers of the faithful with their offerings and sacrifices. Through the intercession of your blessed martyr Theodore, may we pass through these holy acts to celestial glory.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Martini martyris tui atque pontificis sollemnia colimus eius apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of your saint and bishop Saint Martin, you may help us through his intercessions with you.

text: Haec sacra nos Domine quaesumus quae pro venerandis beati Martini martyris tui atque pontificis deferimus meritis et vincula peccatorum nostrorum solvant et eius obtentu ab omnibus tueantur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, these sacred offerings that we present on behalf of the venerable martyr and bishop Blessed Martin. By their merits, may his prayers release us from the bonds of our sins and protect us from all adversities under his protection.

text: Munus perpetuae salutis sumentes clementiam tuam omnipotens Deus supplices imploramus ut beato Martino martyre tuo intercedente caelestis vitae praemia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Humbly we ask your almighty God, to take upon us the gift of eternal salvation. Through the intercession of Your blessed martyr Martin, may we deserve the rewards of celestial life.

text: Deus qui conspicis quia ex nulla nostra virtute subsistimus concede propitius ut intercessione beati Martini confessoris tui atque pontificis contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: God, who sees that we are sustained by no power of our own, grant us graciously that we may be fortified against all adversity through the intercession of your blessed martyr and bishop Saint Martin.

text: Da misericors Deus ut haec nos salutaris oblatio intercedente beato Martino et a propriis reatibus indesinenter expediat et ab omnibus tueatur adversis.
translation_en: Have mercy, O merciful God, that this saving offering may, through the intercession of Blessed Martin, deliver us from our sins and protect us from all dangers.

text: Muneribus nostris quaesumus Domine precibusque susceptis intercedente beato Menna martyre tuo et caelestibus nos munda mysteriis et clementer exaudi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with our prayers supported by the intercession of your blessed martyr Menna. Cleanse us, we pray, through these sacred mysteries and graciously hear us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut cuius festivitate votiva sunt sacramenta eius salutaria nobis intercessione reddantur.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the sacred rites of whose feast day are being celebrated may be beneficial to us through his intercession.

text: Da quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut beati Mennae martyris tui commemoratione temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur aspectu.
translation_en: Therefore, as we rejoice in the temporal memory of your blessed martyr Menna, we pray, Lord God, that we may be eternally happy with your sight.

text: Deus qui es tuorum gloria sacerdotum praesta quaesumus ut qui sancti Brictii confessoris tui atque pontificis festa agimus eius intercessione tuum nobis adesse sentiamus auxilium.
translation_en: God who art the glory of your priests, we ask that you grant, that as we celebrate the feast of your confessor and bishop Saint Brictius, we may feel your presence among us, and experience your help through his intercession.

text: Oblata confessoris tui Brictii honore tibi Domine sint grata libamina ut nostrarum supplicationum apud te effectum obtineant.
translation_en: The offerings of your confessee Brictius may be pleasing to you, Lord. May the libations be acceptable to you, so that our supplications may be effective before you.

text: Quos caelestibus Domine recreas alimentis quaesumus intercedente beato confessore tuo Brictio ab universis tuere periculis.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to refresh those in the heavenly realm with celestial food, with your blessed confessor Brictio interceding for them. Protect them from all dangers on behalf of everyone.

text: Populus tuus quaesumus Domine interventu beati Othmari confessoris tui atque abbatis et temporalibus adiuvetur beneficiis et nullis afficiatur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that Your people may be helped by the intervention of Blessed Othmar, your confessor and abbot, as well as by temporal benefits, and may not be affected by any adversities.

text: Magnifica Domine beati Othmari sollemnia recensemus quae promptis cordibus ambientes oblatis muneribus et suscepimus et praeimus.
translation_en: We magnify You, Lord, the blessings of Blessed Othmar we celebrate, who with hearts ready, presenting offerings and receiving them, we have prayed.

text: Sancta tua Domine quae sumpsimus beati Othmari confessoris tui atque abbatis interveniente sollemnitate nos refoveant quibus et iugiter adiuvari et semper desideramus expleri.
translation_en: May your holy self, Lord, which we have received from the blessed Othmar, confessor and abbot, revive us during the solemnity. We continually desire to be assisted and always fulfilled by it.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Aniani confessoris tui atque pontificis veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the venerable festival and devotion of your blessed confessor and bishop, Anianus, may increase in us and bring us salvation.

text: Munera populi tui Domine propitiatus intende et beati Aniani confessoris tui atque pontificis fac nos gaudere suffragiis.
translation_en: Lord, turned towards the gifts of your people, show favor and let us rejoice in the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop, Anianus.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut de perceptis muneribus gratias exhibentes intercedente beato Aniano confessore tuo atque pontifice beneficia potiora sumamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Almighty God, that having presented our offerings from the received gifts, we may receive greater blessings through the intercession of the blessed Anianus, Your confessor and pope.

text: Tuorum corda fidelium Deus miserator illustra et beatae Elisabeth precibus gloriosis fac nos prospera mundi despicere et caelestium bonorum semper participatione gaudere.
translation_en: God, the compassionate one of your faithful hearts, enlighten through the prayers of the blessed Elizabeth and may we always behold prosperity in this world and enjoy the constant participation of heavenly goods.

text: Munera Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus ut tibi grata nobis salutaria quaesumus beatae Elisabeth pia supplicatione reddantur.
translation_en: We present to You, Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that the salutary favors we seek may be favorably granted to us through the pious intercession of the Blessed Elizabeth.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et intercedente beato Columbano confessore tuo atque abbate nullis nos patiaris subiacere periculis.
translation_en: Lord, attend to our supplications, and with the blessed Columbanus, your confessor and abbot, do not allow us to be subjected to any dangers.

text: Hostias Domine quas tibi offerimus propitius respice et intercedente beato Columbano confessore tuo per haec vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolve.
translation_en: Lord, graciously look upon the offerings we present to you. Through the intercession of the blessed Columbanus, your confessor, may you remit the bonds of our sins.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut hodiernae munus sollemnitatis acceptum intercedente beato Columbano confessore tuo atque abbate et corporibus nostris salutem praestet et mentibus.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that the solemnity of today's service, with the intervention of your blessed confessor and abbot Columbanus, grant us health for our bodies and peace for our minds.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatae Caeciliae virginis et martyris tuae sollemnitate laetificas da ut quam veneramur officio etiam piae conversationis sequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God who delights us in the annual feast of the blessed Cecilia, your virgin and martyr, grant that we who revere her, may also follow her example in devout living.

text: Haec hostia Domine placationis et laudis quaesumus interveniente beata Caecilia martyre tua nos propitiatione tua dignos semper efficiat.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, of propitiation and praise, we humbly ask that through the intervention of blessed Cecilia, your martyr, may it always make us worthy in your sight.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam muneribus sacris quaesumus beatae Caeciliae virginis et martyris tuae intercessione nos semper refove cuius sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with sacred gifts, we humbly ask through the intercession of the blessed Cecilia, virgin and martyr, that you always renew us. Whose feast day we celebrate.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine munera populi tui in sanctae Felicitatis votiva festivitate et praesta ut nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, the gifts of your people, on the feast day dedicated to Saint Felicity, and grant that they may profit for our salvation.

text: Corporis sacri et pretiosi sanguinis repleti libamine quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quod pia devotione gerimus intercedente beato Clemente martyre tuo atque pontifice certa redemptione capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to fill us with the precious blood of the holy body, that what we carry out with pious devotion, interceded by the blessed martyr and your bishop Clement, may be assuredly attained through certain redemption.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sacramenti tui participatione vegetati sanctae Felicitatis martyris tuae precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, that with the participation in your sacrament we may be helped by the prayers of your holy martyr Saint Felicity.

text: Populum tuum quaesumus Domine pio favore prosequere et intercessione beati Chrysogoni martyris tui a cunctis adversitatibus custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your people may follow with a pious favor and through the intercession of the blessed martyr Chrysogonus, be protected from all adversities.

text: Oblatis quaesumus Domine placare muneribus et intercedente beato Chrysogono martyre tuo a cunctis nos defende periculis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look favorably upon the offerings and, with the intervention of your martyr Chrysogonus, protect us from all dangers.

text: Tui Domine perceptione sacramenti intercedente beato Chrysogono martyre tuo et a cunctis mundemur occultis et ab hostium liberemur insidiis.
translation_en: By your grace, Lord, may we be purified through the perception of the sacrament, with the intercession of the blessed martyr Chrysogonus. May we be cleansed from all hidden sins and freed from the traps of our enemies.

text: Deus qui dedisti legem Moysi in summitate montis Sinai et in eodem loco corpus beatae Catherinae virginis et martyris tuae per sanctos angelos tuos mirabiliter collocasti tribue quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus ad montem virtutum qui Christus est pervenire valeamus.
translation_en: God, who gave the law to Moses on the summit of Mount Sinai and miraculously placed the body of the blessed Catherine, virgin and martyr, in the same place through your holy angels, grant us that we may be able to reach the mountain of virtues, who is Christ, through her merits and intercessions.

text: Munera Domine sacrificii praesentis quae tibi offerimus in honore sanctae Catherinae virginis et martyris tuae fiant nobis quaesumus eius precibus vita perpetua et te donante salus infinita.
translation_en: Lord, may the gifts of this present sacrifice that we offer to you in honor of Saint Catherine, your virgin and martyr, become for us, we ask, through her prayers, a life everlasting and salvation infinite, given by you.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis aeternae mysteriis suppliciter deprecamur ut sicut liquor qui de membris beatae Catherinae virginis et martyris tuae iugiter manat languidorum corpora sanat sic eius oratio a nobis cunctas iniquitates expellat.
translation_en: Lord, with the mysteries of eternal salvation, we humbly beseech You, just as the liquid from the limbs of the blessed Catherine, virgin and martyr, Your servant, continually heals the weak bodies, so may her prayer expel all iniquities from us.

text: Accepta sit tibi Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio et ad apostolicam puriores nos faciat venire festivitatem.
translation_en: May this offering, Lord, be acceptable to you from our devotedness, and may it bring us closer to the apostolic feast in a more pure state.

text: Praesta nobis aeternae felicitatis largitor ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus eius ubique protegamur auxilio cuius natalicia praevenimus obsequio.
translation_en: Grant us, the bestower of eternal happiness, that we may be protected everywhere by the help of Him whose nativity we are eager to celebrate through our service.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster beati N apostoli tui intercessionibus sublevari et per quem Ecclesiae tuae superni muneris rudimenta donasti per eum subsidia perpetuae salutis impendas.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, through the intercession of your blessed apostle Saint Peter, that we may be raised up and through him, who bestowed the rudiments of your heavenly ministry, bestow upon us means of everlasting salvation.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi Domine quaesumus beati N. apostoli tui precatio sancta conciliet ut cuius honore sollemniter exhibetur meritis ipsius efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the sacred prayer of your blessed apostle N. may reconcile our offering to you, so that through his honor it may be made acceptable due to his own merits.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis clementiam tuam suppliciter exoramus ut intercedente beato N apostolo tuo quae pro illius veneranda gerimus passione nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: We humbly entreat You, Lord, with the senses awakened to Your sacraments, that through the intercession of Blessed Apostle your own, the merits which we carry out in honor of his venerable passion may profit us as a remedy.

text: Deus qui nos beati N martyris tui atque pontificis annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus de eiusdem etiam protectione gaudeamus.
translation_en: God who delights us in the annual feast of your blessed martyr and bishop N, graciously grant that we may not only celebrate his birthday but also rejoice in his protection.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato N martyre tuo atque pontifice per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: Offerings, Lord, dedicated to you, sanctify, and through the intercession of blessed N, your martyr and bishop, we beseech you to turn towards us favorably.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et intercedente beato N martyre tuo atque pontifice caelestis remedii faciat esse consortes.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, cleanses us from sin and through the intercession of blessed N, your martyr and the celestial pontiff, may it make us companions.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati N martyris tui natalicia colimus intercessione eius in tui nominis amore roboremur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the birthday of your blessed martyr N, we may be strengthened by his intercession in your name.

text: Muneribus nostris quaesumus Domine precibusque susceptis caelestibus nos munda mysteriis et intercedente beato N martyre tuo clementer exaudi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with our offerings and prayers accepted by the heavens, to cleanse us through the sacred mysteries, and through the intercession of your blessed martyr N, mercifully hear us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente beato N martyre tuo et a cunctis adversitatibus liberemur in corpore et a pravis cogitationibus mundemur in mente.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that through the intercession of blessed martyr N, we may be freed from all adversities in body and cleansed from evil thoughts in mind.

text: Accepta sit in conspectu tuo Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio et eius nobis fiat supplicatione salutaris pro cuius sollemnitate defertur.
translation_en: May this offering of our devotion be accepted by you, Lord, and may it bring us a saving intercession on behalf of whom it is being brought for this solemnity.

text: Deus qui nos concedis sanctorum martyrum tuorum N et N natalicia colere da nobis in aeterna laetitia de eorum societate gaudere.
translation_en: God, who grants us to celebrate the birthdays of your saints N and N, grant us to enjoy eternal joy with their company.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis N et N ut quae ore contingimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, through the intercession of your holy martyrs N and N, that what touches our lips may be received with a pure mind.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatorum martyrum tuorum N et N sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut quorum gaudemus meritis accendamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who annually delights us with the solemnity of your blessed martyrs N and N, graciously grant that we may be enkindled by their examples through whose merits we rejoice.

text: Oblatis Domine quaesumus placare muneribus et intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis N et N a cunctis nos defende periculis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you be appeased by the offerings and through the intercession of your holy martyrs N and N, defend us from all dangers.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis N et N caelestis remedii faciat esse consortes.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, cleanses us from sin and may the interceding saints and martyrs N and N make us partakers of celestial remedy.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum Domine pariterque pontificum N et N nos quaesumus festa tueantur et eorum commendet oratio veneranda.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the feast days of your saints and martyrs, as well as those of the pontiffs N and N, may be protected. May their revered prayer commend us.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris quas in sanctorum tuorum commemoratione deferimus ut qui nostrae iustitiae fiduciam non habemus eorum qui tibi placuerunt precibus et meritis adiuvemur.
