translation_en: Be present, Lord, to our supplications which we bring before you in the commemoration of your saints, that those who have not faith in our righteousness may be helped by the prayers and merits of those who are pleasing to you.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati N confessoris tui atque pontificis veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the venerable feast and devotion of your blessed confessor and pope may increase in us, and bring us salvation.

text: Sancti N confessoris tui atque pontificis Domine nos quaesumus ubique oratio sancta laetificet ut dum eius merita recolimus patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that everywhere the holy prayer of your confessor and bishop may make us rejoice. So that as we recall his merits, we may feel his patronage.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut de perceptis muneribus gratias exhibentes intercedente beato N confessore tuo atque pontifice beneficia potiora sumamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that as we present our offerings from the received gifts, through the intercession of your blessed confidant and pope Saint N, we may obtain greater blessings.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras quas in sancti N confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine veneranda sollemnitate deferimus ut qui tibi digne meruit famulari eius intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers which we humbly ask on the venerable feast day of your confessor and pope, Saint N. We beseech you, O Lord, that he who has worthily served you may intercede for us with his merits, and that you absolve us from all sins.

text: Sancti N confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine veneranda sollemnitas tuae pietati sacrificium nostrum reddat acceptum ut per hanc salutarem hostiam et veniam consequamur et gratiam.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, on the festival of your holy confessor and bishop, that our sacrifice be acceptable to your venerable solemnity. May we attain salvation through this holy offering and forgiveness, and grace.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum praesta quaesumus ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus et per preces beati N confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius venerandam celebramus festivitatem indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: We ask You, the rewarder of faithful souls, O God, that through these holy things which we have received and through the prayers of Your blessed Confessor and Pope whom we are honoring with a worthy celebration, we may obtain indulgence.

text: Deus qui nos beati N confessoris tui annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus etiam actiones imitemur.
translation_en: God who on the annual feast of your blessed confessor delights us, grant propitiously that we may not only celebrate his birthday but also imitate his actions.

text: Laudis tuae Domine hostias immolamus in tui sancti commemoratione quibus nos et praesentibus exui malis confidimus et futuris.
translation_en: We offer up the sacrifices of your praise, Lord, in remembrance of your saints, upon whom we place our trust, both now and in the future.

text: Intercessio nos quaesumus Domine beati N abbatis tibi commendet ut quod nostris meritis non valemus eius patrocinio assequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the blessed Abbot N recommends us to you. May we be able to attain what, by our own merits, we cannot achieve through his patronage.

text: Sacris altaribus Domine hostias superpositas sanctus N quaesumus in salutem nobis provenire deposcat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you may cause the offerings placed upon the sacred altars (N) to come to our salvation.

text: Protegat nos Domine cum tui perceptione sacramenti beatus N abbas pro nobis intercedendo ut conversationis eius experiamur insignia et intercessionis eius percipiamus suffragia.
translation_en: May the Lord protect us with the blessing of Abbot Blessed N, interceding for us, so that we may experience the signs of his way of life and receive the help of his intercession.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae in beatae N martyris tuae sollemnitate deferimus cuius nos confidimus patrocinio liberari.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings that we bring on the solemnity of your blessed martyr, upon whom we trust for deliverance through their patronage.

text: Auxilientur nobis Domine sumpta mysteria et intercedente beata N martyre tua sempiterna protectione confirment.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, with your sacred mysteries, and confirm us with eternal protection through the intercession of Blessed N, Your martyr.

text: Indulgentiam nobis Domine quaesumus beata N virgo et martyr imploret quae tibi grata semper exstitit et merito castitatis et tuae professione virtutis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the blessed and holy Virgin and Martyr intercede for us. She who always stood pleasing to you, and rightfully so, through her chastity and the virtue of your profession.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beatae N virginis et martyris tuae dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, accept from us the offerings dedicated to your blessed Virgin and martyr, and graciously bestow upon us their merits. Grant us perpetual help through them as support.

text: Divini muneris largitate satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beata N virgine et martyre tua in eius semper participatione vivamus.
translation_en: Filled with the bounty of your divine gifts, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through the intercession of the blessed Virgin and Martyr, may we always live in her constant companionship.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster ut sicut de beatae N virginis et martyris tuae festivitate gaudemus ita piae devotionis erudiamur effectu.
translation_en: Hear nous, O God our Savior, that as we rejoice on the feast of Thy blessed Virgin and martyr, so may we be instructed in pious devotion by its effect.

text: Hostias Domine quas tibi offerimus propitius respice et intercedente beata N virgine et martyre tua vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolve.
translation_en: Lord, graciously look upon the offerings we present to you. Through the intercession of your blessed Virgin and martyr, may you forgive the sins of ours.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster sanctarum virginum ac martyrum tuarum N et N palmas incessabili devotione venerari ut quas digna mente celebrare non possumus humilibus saltem frequentemus obsequiis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord our God, that we may venerate with unceasing devotion the holy virgins and martyrs N and N, that at least we may show our homage through humble obedience, for we are not worthy to celebrate them with a fitting mind.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine ob honorem sanctarum virginum ac martyrum tuarum munus oblatum et quod nostris meritis assequi non valemus earum nobis intercessione largire propitius.
translation_en: Receive we beseech you, Lord, on account of the honor of your holy virgins and martyrs, the offering brought to you in their honor, and what we, unworthy as we are by our merits, are unable to receive; grant us favorably through their intercession.

text: Sacramentis quaesumus Domine muniamur acceptis ut sanctarum virginum ac martyrum tuarum intercessione contra omnes nequitias armis caelestibus protegamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that we may be fortified by the sacraments so that we may be protected with your acceptance, against all wickedness, by the armor of heavenly weapons, through the intercession of your holy virgins and martyrs.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui legalium differentias hostiarum unius sacrificii participatione sanxisti respice propitius de throno gloriae tuae et super hoc altare benedictionis tuae munus effunde et in eo sic temporales hostiae consecrentur ut perpetuae vitae sumentibus curent substantiam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who sanctified the distinctions of offerings for one sacrifice with participation, look upon us graciously from your throne of glory, and pour out your blessing on this altar of yours. May it be so that these temporal offerings are consecrated in it, so that they may provide substance for those who partake of eternal life.

text: Deus qui ex omni coaptatione sanctorum aeternum tibi condis habitaculum da aedificationi tuae incrementa caelestia ut quorum hic reliquias pio amore complectimur eorum semper meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who from the assembly of all saints eternally constructs Your dwelling place, grant building increases to Yours, that we may be encompassed with their holy relics in pious love and always be aided by their merits.

text: Deus cui omne cor patet et omnis voluntas loquitur et quem nullum latet secretum purifica per infusionem Sancti Spiritus cogitationes cordis nostri ut te perfecte diligere et digne laudare mereamur.
translation_en: God, to whom all hearts are open and whose will all minds declare, and before whom no secrets are hidden, purify our thoughts by the infusion of the Holy Spirit, that we may love you more and more perfectly, and praise you worthily.

text: Haec oblatio quaesumus Domine cordis nostri maculas emundet ut Sancti Spiritus digna efficiatur habitatio.
translation_en: This offering we humbly ask, Lord, may cleanse our hearts, so that our dwelling may be worthy of the Holy Spirit.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus Sanctum nobis Spiritum votis promereri sedulis quatenus eius gratia ab omnibus liberemur tentationibus et peccatorum nostrorum indulgentiam percipere mereamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, Your Holy Spirit, to be promised to us through diligent prayers, so that, through His grace, we may be freed from all temptations and deserve the indulgence of our sins.

text: Deus qui Unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi pretioso sanguine vivificae crucis vexillum sanctificare voluisti concede quaesumus eos qui eiusdem sanctae crucis gaudent honore tua quoque facias ubique protectione gaudere.
translation_en: God, who willed to sanctify the flag of your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, by his precious blood on the life-giving cross, grant us that those who rejoice in the honor of the same holy cross may also enjoy your protection everywhere.

text: Haec oblatio quaesumus Domine ab omnibus nos purget offensis quae in ara crucis etiam totius mundi tulit offensam.
translation_en: This offering we humbly ask you, Lord, to cleanse us from all the offenses that were borne on the Cross and for the entire world.

text: Adesto nobis Domine Deus noster et quos sanctae crucis laetari fecisti honore eius quoque perpetuis defende subsidiis.
translation_en: Be present with us, Lord our God, and protect those whom you have made to rejoice in the honor of the holy cross. Defend them also with perpetual aid.

text: Domine Iesu Christe Fili Dei vivi qui de caelis ad terram descendisti de sinu Patris et in ligno crucis quinque plagas sustinuisti et sanguinem tuum pretiosum in remissionem peccatorum nostrorum fudisti te humiliter deprecamur ut in die iudicii ad dexteram tuam audire mereamur venite benedicti Patris mei.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God, who descended from heaven to earth from the bosom of the Father and sustained five wounds on the cross and poured out your precious blood for the remission of our sins, we humbly entreat you. On the day of judgment, may we be worthy to hear you at your right hand; come, blessed of my Father.

text: Domine Iesu Christe Fili Dei vivi qui pro mundi redemptione crucis lignum ascendisti ut universus mundus qui in tenebris erat illuminaretur illam lucem in anima et corpore nostro semper tribue per quam ad aeternam salutem pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God the living One, who ascended on the wood of the cross for the redemption of the world so that all those in darkness might be enlightened with that light in our soul and body; grant us this light always, through which we may merit eternal salvation.

text: Domine Iesu Christe qui hora sexta pro redemptione mundi crucis patibulum ascendisti et sanguinem tuum pretiosum in remissionem peccatorum nostrorum fudisti te humiliter deprecamur ut post obitum nostrum paradisi ianuam nos introire concede gaudenter.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, who at the sixth hour ascended the cross for the redemption of the world and poured out your precious blood for the remission of our sins, we humbly beseech you. After our death, grant us with joy to enter through the gate of Paradise.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui in memoriam Domini nostri Iesu Christi coronam eius spineam veneramur in terris ab ipso gloria et honore coronari mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Almighty God, that we who venerate the crown of thorns in memory of our Lord Jesus Christ on earth, may be worthy to be crowned with glory and honor by Him in heaven.

text: Tuorum militum vota rex omnipotens virtute corrobora ut quos in huius mortalitis stadio Unigeniti Filii tui corona laetificas consummato cursu certaminis immortalitatis bravium apprehendant.
translation_en: O almighty King, strengthen the vows of your soldiers with Your might so that those whom You have crowned in this stage of mortality may be rejoiced by the crown of Your Unigenitus Son, and they may attain the prize of immortality upon completion of the race.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus pro sacrosancta Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi corona cuius hodie recensemus sollemnia nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the sacraments we have received may profit us for the salvation of the most sacred Crown of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, whose feast we celebrate today.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui asperitatem dirae lanceae expiatione tui sacri lateris in nostrae redemptionis convertisti dulcorem concede propitius ut sicut ex illo sacro vulnere nobis undam baptismatis et poculum tui sacri sanguinis tribuisti sic eisdem meritis ad aeternae resurrectionis gaudia facias pervenire.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who transformed the harshness of the dreadful spear's piercing into sweetness during your sacred side's atonement, graciously grant that, as you granted us the water of baptism and the cup of your sacred blood through that sacred wound, so may you bring them to the joys of eternal resurrection through those same merits.

text: Sacrificia Domine tuis oblata conspectibus lanceae consecratio in tuo sacro latere tibi reddat accepta per quae nos lavari et expiari tribuis et defendi.
translation_en: Offerings, Lord, laid before your eyes by the spear's consecration on your sacred side, may be pleasing to you and accepted through which you grant us to be washed, purified, and protected.

text: Sacro poculo tui pretiosi sanguinis recreati te Domine supplices deprecamur ut sicut latus tuum passum est acumine lanceae vulneratum sic cor nostrum perpetuo tui amoris stimulo vulnerare digneris et in tuae passionis merita transformare.
translation_en: In your sacred chalice of precious blood, we humbly pray to you, Lord. May our hearts be pierced like your side was by the point of a spear, and may we be constantly stimulated by your love. Grant that we may deserve to be wounded, and transformed through the merits of your passion.

text: Concede nos famulos tuos quaesumus Domine Deus noster perpetua mentis et corporis sanitate gaudere et gloriosa beatae Mariae semper Virginis intercessione a praesenti liberari tristitia et aeterna perfrui laetitia.
translation_en: Grant to your servants, we humbly ask, Lord our God, perpetual health of mind and body, to rejoice and to be free from present sorrow through the intercession of the glorious blessed Mary, ever Virgin. May we also eternally enjoy happiness.

text: Muneribus nostris quaesumus Domine precibusque susceptis et caelestibus nos munda mysteriis et intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Virgine Maria clementer exaudi.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, with our offerings and prayers received, cleanse us through holy mysteries and hear us graciously with the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Virgine Maria caelestis remedii faciat esse consortes.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, cleanses us from sin, and through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, may it make us sharers of heavenly remedy.

text: Prosit nobis semper omnipotens Pater et praecipue inter haec Filii tui festa paschalia continuata Dei Genitricis semperque Virginis Mariae memoria quae astitit vulnerata caritate in cruce pendenti et astat regina a dextris in caelo regnanti.
translation_en: May it always be favorable to us, Almighty Father, and especially during these days, the festivals of your Son, the Easter celebrations continued, to the memory of God's Ever-Virgin Mother Mary, who stood with wounded heart on the cross and now stands as queen at the right hand in heaven reigning.

text: Propitiare Domine nobis quaesumus illius paschalis agni oblatione acceptissima cum beatissimae Dei Genitricis Virginis Mariae pia interventione quem genuit perpetua virginitate.
translation_en: O Lord, we humbly ask you to propitiate us with the offering of the most acceptable Paschal Lamb, together with the most blessed intervention of the Virgin Mary, the Mother of God, who gave birth in perpetual virginity.

text: Per haec sacramenta paschalia nos tibi clementissime Deus beatae Mariae semper Virginis oratio sancta conciliet quae nobis panem angelorum et caelestem alimoniam generavit Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum
translation_en: Through these Paschal sacraments, most compassionate God, may the holy prayer of the Blessed Virgin Mary, ever a virgin, who has generated for us the bread of angels and heavenly nourishment, bring to us our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Repleti Domine benedictione caelesti suppliciter imploramus ut quod fragili celebramus officio sanctorum angelorum nobis prodesse sentiamus auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, filled with heavenly blessings, we humbly request that we may feel the benefit of what we weakly celebrate through the office of the holy angels, as assistance to us.

text: Infirmitatem nostram respice omnipotens Deus et quia pondus propriae actionis gravat beati Adalberti martyris tui atque pontificis intercessio gloriosa nos protegat.
translation_en: Look upon our infirmity, O almighty God, and since the weight of our own actions burdens the blessed Adalbert, thy martyr and bishop, may his glorious intercession protect us.

text: Deus qui pro nobis sanctam crucem ascendisti et mundi tenebras illuminasti tu corda et corpora nostra per virtutem eiusdem sanctae crucis illuminare dignare.
translation_en: God who for us ascended the holy cross and illuminated the world's darkness, enlighten our hearts and bodies by the same power of the holy cross.

text: Deus qui crucem et sanguinem Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi pacem hominibus et caelestium collegium angelorum dedisti da nobis tuae pacis ubertate repleri et angelicae societatis unitate laetari.
translation_en: God who gave peace to mankind and the celestial community of angels by the cross and the blood of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, grant us abundance of your peace and let us rejoice in the unity of the angelic society.

text: Deus cuius Filius per trophaeum crucis redimere dignatus est mundum concede propitius ut qui in redemptione nostra laetamur aeternis gaudiis te donante perfruamur.
translation_en: God, whose Son was deemed worthy to redeem the world through the triumph of the cross, grant us your mercy. May we who rejoice in our redemption enjoy eternal joys, which you graciously bestow upon us.

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine sperantes in te et effice voluntatem tuam in nobis ut clarificati laetitia resurrectionis Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi mereamur cum omnibus sanctis a dextris tuis delectari.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you conserve those who hope in you, and that your will be done in us, so that we may be made bright with the joy of the resurrection of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, and that we may deserve to be delighted with all the saints at your right hand.

text: Sacris altaribus Domine has nostras hostias superpositas sanctifica quaesumus nobis per resurrectionem Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi omnes sancti tui in salutem provenire deposcant.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you sanctify these offerings placed on your altars. May all your saints invoke through the resurrection of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, that they may come to us for our salvation.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut gaudiis resurrectionis Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi nos fecisti temporaliter gratulari sic in aeterna beatitudine intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis visitationis tuae nutu facias pacifico perfrui.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that just as you made us temporarily rejoice in the resurrection of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, so too in eternal beatitude, through the intercession of all your saints, may you grant us to be filled with peace by your gracious visit.

text: Deus qui nos omnium sanctorum tuorum commemoratione laetificas eorum quaesumus meritis et precibus fac nos aeternae salvationis praesidiis muniri et concede ut eorum beatae societati mereamur coniungi.
translation_en: God who delights us with the commemoration of all your saints, we humbly ask through their merits and prayers, to arm us with the protections of eternal salvation and grant that we may deserve to join their blessed fellowship.

text: Haec oblatio quaesumus Domine omnium sanctorum meritis et precibus suffragantibus tibi grata fiat et nos ab omni reatu tua gratia largiente misericorditer absolvat.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that this offering, supported by the merits and prayers of all saints, may be pleasing to You. And may Your grace mercifully grant us absolution from every guilt.

text: A cunctis nos quaesumus Domine mentis et corporis defende periculis et intercedente gloriosa Virgine Dei Genitrice Maria cum beatis apostolis Petro et Paulo et beato Adalberto martyre tuo atque pontifice et omnibus sanctis salutem nobis tribue benignus et pacem ut destructis adversitatibus et erroribus universis Ecclesia tua secura tibi serviat libertate.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to defend us from perils of mind and body. With the intercession of the glorious Virgin, Mother of God Mary, along with the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, and the blessed martyr Adalberto, your bishop and pontiff, and all saints, grant us peace, kindness and health. May your Church serve you freely and securely, destroyed from all adversities and errors.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster ut huius sacramenti virtute a cunctis nos mentis et corporis hostibus tuearis gratiam tribuens in praesenti et gloriam in futuro.
translation_en: Hear us, O God our Savior, that with the power of this sacrament you may protect us from all enemies, mental and physical, granting us grace now and glory in the future.

text: Mundet et muniat nos quaesumus Domine divini sacramenti munus oblatum et intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Virgine Maria cum beatis apostolis tuis Petro et Paulo et beato Adalberto martyre tuo atque pontifice et omnibus sanctis a cunctis nos reddat et perversitatibus expiatos et adversitatibus expeditos.
translation_en: Cleanse and arm us, we beseech Thee, Lord, with the gift of Thy divine sacrament. Through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, along with your apostles Peter and Paul, and your martyr and bishop Adalbert, may they grant us, free from all faults, absolved from sins, and equipped to face adversities.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui vivorum dominaris simul et mortuorum omniumque misereris quos tuos fide et opere futuros esse praenoscis te supplices exoramus ut pro quibus effundere preces decrevimus quosque vel praesens saeculum adhuc in carne retinet vel futurum iam exutos corpore suscepit intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis pietatis tuae clementia omnium delictorum suorum veniam et gaudia consequi mereantur aeterna.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who governs both the living and the dead, have mercy on all whom you foresee will be yours in faith and deed. We humbly entreat you that for those for whom we pour out our prayers, whether they are still in this world enshrouded by flesh or have already shed their bodies, through the intercession of all your saints, may receive forgiveness for all their sins and attain eternal joy.

text: Purificent nos quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus sacramenta quae sumpsimus intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis et praesta ut hoc tui mysterii sacramentum non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sit intercessio salutaris ad veniam sit ablutio scelerum sit fortitudo fragilium sit contra mundi pericula firmamentum sit vivorum atque mortuorum fidelium remissio omnium delictorum.
translation_en: Purify us, we humbly beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, through the sacraments which we have received, with the intercession of all your saints. And grant that this sacrament of your mystery may not be a burden to us for punishment, but an intercession for forgiveness, a cleansing for sins, a strength for the weak, a fortress against worldly dangers, a remission for the living and the dead faithful of all their offenses.

text: Pietate tua quaesumus Domine nostrorum solve vincula peccatorum et intercedente beata Maria semper Virgine cum omnibus sanctis tuis dominum apostolicum regem nostrum atque reginam cum liberis et omnem populum Christianum in omni sanctitate custodi omnesque affinitate et fraternitate nobis iunctos et omnes Christianos a vitiis purga virtutibus illustra pacem et salutem nobis tribue hostes visibiles et invisibiles remove carnalia desideria repelle aeris temperiem et fruges terrae indulge et iter famulorum tuorum in salutis tuae prosperitate dispone inimicis nostris veram caritatem largire et omnibus fidelibus vivis et defunctis in terra viventium vitam pariter et requiem aeternam concede.
translation_en: Through Your mercy we humbly ask, Lord, that You release the bonds of our sins. With the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary, ever Virgin, and all your saints, protect our apostolic king, queen, children, and the entire Christian people in every sanctity. May you bind us together with affinity and brotherhood, and purify all Christians from their vices. May you illuminate them with virtues, grant them peace and salvation, remove visible and invisible enemies, quench earthly desires, indulge crops and fruits, dispose the journey of Your servants in prosperity, grant true charity to our enemies, and grant eternal life and peace to all faithful, whether living or dead on earth.

text: Deus qui singulari corporis tui hostia totius mundi solvisti delicta hac oblatione placatus maculas scelerum nostrorum absterge dominum apostolicum et archiepiscopum nostrum regem nostrum atque reginam cum liberis et omnem gradum ecclesiasticum in omni sanctitate custodi aeris temperiem et fruges terrae cum pacis tranquillitate largire et iter famulorum tuorum in salutis tuae prosperitate dispone et intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria cum omnibus sanctis tuis omnium Christianorum vivorum atque mortuorum peccata dimitte nobisque praemia aeterna largire.
translation_en: God, who by your unique offering of your body have forgiven the sins of the whole world, we ask that you, being appeased by this offering, wash away the stains of our wicked deeds. Cleanse our lord the apostolic and archbishop, our king and queen with their children, and all ecclesiastical ranks in every holiness. Grant them a temperate air and fruitful earth with peace's tranquility. Dispose the path of your servants for the prosperity of your salvation and through the intercession of the blessed Mother of God, grant us forgiveness of sins, and bestow eternal rewards upon us.

text: Sumpta quaesumus Domine caelestia sacramenta crimina nostra detergant dominum apostolicum regem nostrum atque reginam cum liberis et omnem populum Christianum ab insidiis diaboli custodiant et iter famulorum tuorum in salutis tuae prosperitate disponant aeris temperiem et fruges terrae nobis obtineant omnemque pravitatem et infirmitatem et hostium rabiem atque subitaneam mortem meritis sanctae Dei Genitricis et Virginis Marie et omnium sanctorum tuorum a nobis procul repellant et omnibus fidelibus vivis et defunctis prosint ad veniam pro quorum quarumque tibi sunt oblata salute.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to bestow upon us the heavenly sacraments, may they wash away our sins. Protect our apostolic king and queen, their children, and the entire Christian people from the snares of the devil. May they arrange the course of your servants in the prosperity of your salvation, provide a favorable climate and ripe crops for us, drive away all wickedness, frailty, enemy fury, and sudden death from us with the merits of the holy Mother of God, Mary and all your saints. May they keep us at a distance and benefit all the living and dead faithful with mercy, for their sake whose well-being is offered to you in salvation.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sancta Dei Genitrix Virgo Maria sanctique tui apostoli martyres confessores virgines atque omnes sancti quorum in ista continentur ecclesia reliquiae patrocinia nos ubique adiuvent quatenus hic in illorum praesenti suffragio tranquilla pace in tua laude laetemur.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the holy Virgin Mary, Mother of God, and your saints, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all other saints whose relics are contained in this church, may assist us everywhere with their patronage, so that we may rejoice here in their present intercession with a peaceful tranquility in your praise.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine nobis famulis tuis per sanctorum tuorum merita quorum reliquiae in praesenti requiescunt ecclesia ut eorum pia intercessione ab omnibus semper protegamur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate us, your servants, through the merits of your saints whose relics now rest in this church. May we always be protected from all adversities by their pious intercession.

text: Munera tuae maiestati misericors Deus oblata benigno quaesumus suscipe intuitu ut eorum nobis precibus fiant salutaria quorum gratissimae in hac basilica reliquiae conditae sunt.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, merciful God, to accept the offerings made to your majesty. We pray that through them, your gaze may be upon us so that the prayers of those for whom precious relics have been deposited in this basilica become beneficial for us.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quaesumus Domine ut eorum nos ubique intercessio protegat quorum hic sacra gaudemus haberi patrocinia.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to protect us everywhere by the constant intercession of those whose sacred mysteries we are now celebrating and who are honored as our patronage here.

text: Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus Domine preces placatus admitte ut destructis adversitatibus et erroribus universis secura tibi serviat libertate.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you receive our prayers with favor, so that in destroying all adversities and errors, your church may serve you securely under freedom.

text: Protege nos Domine quaesumus ab omni adversitate ut tuis mysteriis servientes securi et corpore tibi famulemur et mente.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord, we beseech You, from every adversity, that serving Your mysteries, we may be secure and serve You with our body, and with our mind.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut nos quos divina tribuis participatione gaudere humanis non sinas subiacere periculis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that you do not allow us, whom you bestow with the participation of divine joy, to be subjected to human perils.

text: Deus omnium fidelium pastor et rector famulum tuum archiepiscopum nostrum N quem Ecclesiae tuae praeesse voluisti propitius respice da ei quaesumus verbo et exemplo quibus praeest proficere ut ad vitam una cum grege sibi credito perveniat sempiternam.
translation_en: God, shepherd and ruler of all faithful, look upon your servant, our archbishop N, whom you have willed to preside over your Church. Propitiously behold him, we pray, with the words and examples by which he presides, so that he may advance to a life eternal, together with his flock who believe in him.

text: Oblatis Domine placare muneribus et famulum tuum archiepiscopum nostrum N quem pastorem Ecclesiae tuae praeesse voluisti assidua protectione conserva.
translation_en: Lord, grant that our Archbishop N, whom you have wished to shepherd your Church with constant protection, may be favorably regarded by these offerings. Keep him under your continual care.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine divini quaesumus sacramenti perceptio protegat et famulum tuum archiepiscopum nostrum N quem pastorem Ecclesiae tuae esse voluisti una cum grege sibi commisso salvet semper et muniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the perception of this divine sacrament protect and always save and arm your servant, our archbishop N, whom you wished to be a shepherd for your church together with the flock entrusted to him.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut famulus tuus rex noster qui tua miseratione suscepit regni gubernacula virtutum etiam omnium percipiat incrementa quibus decenter ornatus et vitia devitare et hostes superare et ad te qui via veritas et vita es gratiosus valeat pervenire.
translation_en: We beseech You, Almighty God, that Your servant, our king, who has taken up the governance of Your kingdom by Your mercy, may also perceive the increments by which he is fittingly adorned and may avoid vices, overcome enemies, and reach You who are the way, truth, and life with gratitude.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine oblata sanctifica ut nobis Unigeniti tui corpus et sanguis fiant et regi nostro ad obtinendam animae corporisque salutem et ad peragendum sibi iniunctum officium te largiente usquequaque proficiant.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, to sanctify the offerings presented, that your Only-Begotten Son's body and blood may be to us, and that for our soul's and body's salvation, and for our ruler to perform his ordained duty, they may everywhere advance through your generous bestowal.

text: Haec Domine quaesumus oratio salutaris famulum tuum regem nostrum ab omnibus tueatur adversis quatenus et ecclesiasticae pacis obtineat tranquillitatem et post istius temporis decursum ad aeternam perveniat hereditatem.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask this salutary prayer to protect your servant, our king, from all adversities, so that he may maintain the tranquility of ecclesiastical peace and after this time's passage, inherit eternal life.

text: Praesta nobis misericors Deus ut digne tuis servire altaribus mereamur et eorum perpetua participatione salvari.
translation_en: Grant us, O merciful God, that we may worthy serve your altars and be saved through their eternal participation.

text: Suppliciter te Deus Pater omnipotens qui es creator omnium rerum deprecor ut dum me famulum tuum coram omnipotentia maiestatis tuae graviter deliquisse confiteor manum misericordiae tuae mihi porrigas quatenus dum hanc oblationem tuae pietati offero quod nequiter admisi clementer digneris absolvere.
translation_en: Humbly, I, God Almighty Father who is the creator of all things, do beseech You that while I, Your servant, confess before Your omnipotent majesty that I have gravely sinned, You may extend Your hand of mercy to me. So that when I offer this offering to Your piety, may You graciously deign to forgive me for the wrong I have admitted.

text: Deus misericordiae Deus pietatis Deus indulgentiae indulge quaeso et miserere mei sacrificium quoque quod pietatis tuae gratia humiliter offero benigne digneris suscipere et peccata quae labentibus vitiis contraxi pius ac propitius et miseratus indulgeas ut pro tua pietate loco paenitentiae ac flumine lacrimarum mihi concesso veniam a te merear accipere omnium delictorum.
translation_en: God of mercy, God of pity, God of indulgence, I humbly ask and entreat that you deign to forgive my sacrifice, and also the sins which, because of my failing vices, I have contracted. Be gracious, compassionate, and merciful, and grant me pardon. Through your mercy, in place of penitence and as a river of tears granted to me, may I deserve to receive forgiveness from you for all offenses.

text: Deus qui vivorum es Salvator omnium qui non vis mortem peccatoris nec laetaris in perditione morientium te suppliciter deprecor ut concedas mihi veniam delictorum meorum ut admissa defleam et postmodum non admittam ut cum mihi extrema dies finisque vitae advenerit emundatum delictis omnibus me angeli sanctitatis suscipiant.
translation_en: God, who is the Savior of all living beings, who does not wish the death of the sinner nor rejoice in the perdition of the dying, I humbly beseech You to grant me forgiveness for my sins, so that I may weep with regret and not be admitted again. May it be that when the last days and end of my life approach, the angels of sanctity receive me purified of all my sins.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine supplicum preces et confitentium tibi parce peccatis ut pariter nobis indulgentiam tribuas benignus et pacem.
translation_en: Hear us, we humbly ask You, Lord, the prayers of suppliant and confessing ones. Grant us remission for our sins, merciful one, and bestow peace upon us.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine aeterne Salvator ut percipientes hoc munere veniam peccatorum deinceps peccata vitemus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord eternal Savior, that understanding this gift, we may forever avoid the sins of which we have repented.

text: Deus qui credentes in te populos nullis sinis concuti terroribus dignare quaesumus preces et hostias dicatae tibi plebis suscipere ut pax a tua pietate concessa Christianorum fines ab omni hoste faciat esse securos.
translation_en: God, who allows no people to tremble in fear who believe in you, we humbly ask that you receive our prayers and offerings dedicated to you, so that the peace granted by your mercy may make Christians secure from every enemy at their borders.

text: Deus auctor pacis et amator quem nosse vivere cui servire regnare est protege quaesumus ab omnibus impugnationibus supplices tuos ut qui in defensione tua confidimus nullius hostilitatis arma timeamus.
translation_en: We ask you, God, the author of peace and lover, whom it is life to know, service to serve, and reign to protect, that we may be protected from all attacks. With suppliant hearts, we trust in your defense, that we who trust in you may fear no weapons of any hostility.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus in cuius manu sunt omnium potestates et omnium iura regnorum respice in auxilium Christianorum ut gentes paganorum quae in sua feritate confidunt dexterae tuae potentia conterantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, in whose hand are all powers and all rights of kingdoms, look upon the aid of the Christians, so that the pagan nations which in their barbarity trust in your powerful right hand may be crushed.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod immolamus propiciatus intende ut propugnatores tuos ab omni exuas paganorum nequitia et in tuae protectionis securitate constituas.
translation_en: Lord, regard the sacrifice that we offer, and may Your mercy incline so that You protect Your champions from every attack of pagan wickedness and establish them securely under Your protection.

text: Protector noster aspice Deus et propugnatores tuos a paganorum defende periculis ut ab omnibus perturbationibus submoti liberis tibi mentibus serviant.
translation_en: Our protector, look upon us, God, and defend your advocates from the dangers of the pagans so that they may be free from all disturbances and serve you with undisturbed minds.

text: Oblatis quaesumus Domine placare muneribus et opportunum nobis tribue pluviae sufficientis auxilium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept our offerings and grant us a timely help in the form of sufficient rain.

text: Caelestibus refecti alimentis quaesumus Domine ut terram quam nostris videmus iniquitatibus tabescentem congruentium facias irrigari mundatione pluviarum.
translation_en: Having been refreshed with heavenly food, we ask you, Lord, that you make the earth which we see wasting away because of wickedness suitable to be watered by the cleansing rainfall.

text: Praeveniat nos Domine gratia tua semper et sequatur et has oblationes quas pro peccatis nostris nomini tuo consecrandas deferimus benignus assume et per intercessionem omnium sanctorum tuorum cunctis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: May your grace, Lord, always precede us and follow us, and may these offerings that we dedicate to your name for our sins be accepted beneficently. May they advance through the intercession of all your saints to the salvation of all.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et viam famulorum tuorum in salutis tuae prosperitate dispone ut inter omnes viae et vitae huius varietates tuo semper protegantur auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and arrange the way of your servants for prosperity in your salvation, so that they may always be protected by your aid among all paths and the varieties of this life.

text: Famulos tuos quaesumus Domine haec tueantur ubique gradientes oblata sacrificia quae totius mundi in aeterna virtute compescuere naufragium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your servants may everywhere be protected while ascending with the offerings. May those sacrifices which have bound up the shipwreck of the whole world in everlasting power preserve them forever.

text: Sumpta quaesumus Domine caelestis mysteria sacramenti ad prosperitatem itineris famulorum tuorum proficiant et eos ad salutaria cuncta perducant.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the heavenly mysteries of the sacred sacrament may advance for the prosperity of Your servants' journey and lead them to all things beneficial.

text: Deus qui non mortem sed paenitentiam desideras peccatorum quaesumus populum tuum ad te converte propitius ut dum tibi devotus exstiterit iracundiae tuae flagella ab eo amoveas.
translation_en: God who desires not death but penitence for the sins of your people, we humbly ask that you turn them to you mercifully, so that while they are devoted to you, you remove from them the scourges of your anger.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria populum tuum ab iracundiae tuae erroribus libera et misericorditer tua fac libertate securum.
translation_en: Hear us, O God, our savior, and through the intercession of the blessed Mother of God, deliver your people from your wrath's errors, and with mercy grant them freedom securely.

text: Subveniat quaesumus Domine sacri muneris percepti oblatio quae nos ab erroribus universis potenter absolvat et a totius perditionis incursu clementer absolvat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the offering of sacred ministry be present, which may powerfully deliver us from all errors and graciously deliver us from the onslaught of total destruction.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus sub cuius nutibus vitae nostrae momenta decurrunt suscipe preces et hostias pro infirmo famulo tuo N pro quo misericordiam tuam aegrotante imploramus ut de cuius periculo metuimus de eius salute laetemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, under whose protection the moments of our lives flow, receive the prayers and offerings for your sick servant N, for whom we implore your mercy while he is ill. May we rejoice in his safety rather than fear for his peril.

text: Deus infirmitatis humanae singulare praesidium auxilii tui super infirmum famulum tuum N ostende virtutem ut ope misericordiae tuae adiutus Ecclesiae tuae sanctae incolumis repraesentari mereatur.
translation_en: God, unique refuge of human weakness, show your power to help your weak servant N, so that he may be worthy to be represented among the Church's sanctity intact, by the aid of your mercy.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostias placationis et laudis quas ego peccator tibi offerre praesumo ad gloriam et honorem nominis tui sive pro incolumitate famuli tui N ut omnium delictorum suorum veniam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: Receive most mercifully, Father, the offerings of appeasement and praise which I, the sinner, presume to present to you for the glory and honor of your name, or on behalf of the well-being of your servant N, so that he may deserve forgiveness of all his sins.

text: Purificent nos quaesumus Domine sacramenta quae sumpsimus et famulum tuum N ab omni culpa liberum esse concede ut qui reatu conscientiae constringitur de caelestis regni plenitudine glorietur.
translation_en: Purify us, we beseech You, Lord, the sacraments which we have received, and grant Your servant N to be free from all guilt. May he who is constrained by conscience share in the fullness of the heavenly kingdom's glory.

text: Deus qui caritatis dona per gratiam Sancti Spiritus tuorum cordibus fidelium infudisti da famulis et famulabus tuis pro quibus tuam deprecamur clementiam salutem mentis et corporis ut et te tota virtute diligant et quae tibi placita sunt tota dilectione perficiant.
translation_en: God, who has infused the gifts of charity through the grace of the Holy Spirit into the hearts of your faithful, grant to your servants and handmaids for whom we entreat your clemency, health of mind and body. May they love and serve you with all their strength, and perform all that pleases you with wholehearted devotion.

text: Miserere quaesumus Domine famulis ac famulabus tuis pro quibus hoc sacrificium laudis tuae maiestati offerimus ut per haec sancta supernae benedictionis gratiam obtineant et gloriam aeternae beatitudinis acquirant.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, we humbly ask Thee, O Lord, upon Thy servants and handmaids, for whom we offer this sacrifice of praise to Thy majesty. May they obtain through these holy signs the grace of Thy heavenly blessing and acquire the glory of eternal beatitude.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quaesumus Domine ut haec salutaria sacramenta illis proficiant ad prosperitatem et pacem pro quorum quarumque dilectione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to make these divine mysteries profitable for them towards prosperity and peace, for whose love we have offered this before your majesty.

text: Deus qui post baptismi sacramentum secundam abolitionem peccatorum eleemosynis indidisti respice super famulos et famulas tuas pro quorum operibus tibi gratiae referuntur fac eos praemio beatos quos fecisti pietate devotos ut recipiant pro parvis magna pro terrenis caelestia pro temporalibus sempiterna.
translation_en: God, who after the sacrament of baptism bestowed alms upon the remission of sins, look upon your servants and maidservants for whose works gratitude is rendered to you. Make them worthy of blessings, whom you have made devoted by piety, so that they may receive for small things great rewards, for earthly things heavenly ones, for temporal ones eternal ones.

text: Sumentes Domine tua sancta mysteria petimus immensam clementiam tuam ut et nobis proficiant ad medelam et famulis ac famulabus tuis qui nobis largiti sunt bona proveniant eis ad salutem mentis et corporis.
translation_en: Lord, taking Your holy mysteries, we ask for Your immense mercy that it may also profit us to health and to Your servants and handmaids who have given us good things, that it may come upon them for the salvation of mind and body.

text: Omnipotens clementissime Deus respice propitius ad preces nostras et libera cor nostrum de malarum cogitationum tentationibus ut Sancti Spiritus dignum fieri habitaculum mereamur.
translation_en: Most merciful God, look upon us with kindness and consider our prayers. Deliver our hearts from the temptations of evil thoughts, that we may be worthy to become a dwelling for the Holy Spirit.

text: Has tibi Domine Deus oblationes offerimus pro salute animarum nostrarum quatenus eas Spiritus Sancti gratia illustrare digneris.
translation_en: To You, Lord God, we offer these sacrifices for the health of our souls, that you may deign to illuminate them with the grace of the Holy Spirit.

text: Per hoc quaesumus Domine sacrificium quod tuae obtulimus maiestati et te largiente sumpsimus ab omnibus cor nostrum emundetur tentationibus.
translation_en: Through this we humbly ask, Lord, the sacrifice which we have offered to your majesty; and through your generosity, may our whole heart be purified from all temptations.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus clementiam tuam humiliter imploramus pro famulis et famulabus tuis qui mihi confessi sunt sua facinora ut indulgentiam eis largiendo vitam conferas sempiternam.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Almighty everlasting God, for Your mercy, on Your servants and servant-maids who have confessed their wrongdoings to me, grant them pardon, so that by Your indulgence, you bestow eternal life upon them.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut haec oblatio quam tibi pro famulis et famulabus tuis qui mihi confessi sunt propria facinora offero sit in oculis tuis accepta quatenus per haec sacrosancta commercia indulgentiam valeant percipere peccatorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O Almighty and merciful God, that this offering which I present to You on behalf of Your servants and servant-maids who have confessed their sins to me, may be acceptable in Your eyes. May they through these holy transactions merit to perceive the indulgence for their sins.

text: Da quaesumus clementissime Pater indulgentiam perpetuam famulis et famulabus tuis qui mihi confessi sunt propria peccata et concede eis ut in praeceptis tuis iugiter perseverent.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly beseech Thee, O most merciful Father, eternal forgiveness to Thy servants and handmaids who have confessed their own sins to me, and grant them that they may always persevere in Thy commandments.

text: Conspirantes Domine contra tuae plenitudinis firmamentum dextera tuae maiestatis prosterne ut iustitiae non dominetur iniquitas sed semper falsitas subdatur veritati.
translation_en: O Lord, conspiring against Your fullness' firmament with Your right hand, may Your majesty overthrow it so that iniquity does not rule but falsehood is always subdued to truth.

text: Oblatio Domine tuis aspectibus immolanda quaesumus ut nos ab omnibus vitiis potenter absolvat et a cunctis inimicis defendat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offering made before your sight may be acceptable to you. Grant us, we pray, the power to be completely freed from all sins and protect us from all enemies.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus dissimulatis lacerationibus improborum eadem te gubernante quae recta sunt cautius exsequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that through these holy things which we have received, under the guise of the transgressions of wicked people, while you are guiding us, may we more carefully carry out what is right.

text: Deus qui per absolutionem somnii beatum Ioseph de carcere eduxisti et ei per opera misericordiae tuae apud Pharaonem regem gratiam contulisti tribue quaesumus ut per eius interventionem ad gaudia aeterna pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: God, who brought blessed Joseph out of prison through absolution of his dream and granted him favor with Pharaoh the king through your mercy, we ask that through his intercession, we may merit to reach eternal joys.

text: Munera Domine quae in commemoratione beati Ioseph prophetae tuae maiestati deferimus propitius respice et ad perpetuam nobis tribue provenire salutem.
translation_en: Lord, the gifts we bring on the commemoration of your prophet Blessed Joseph, look upon them graciously and grant us everlasting health in return.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quaesumus Domine nos tua misericordia repleat et per preces iusti Ioseph debitas tibi laudes semper referamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your divine mysteries may fill us with your mercy. Through the prayers of the just Joseph, we shall always offer you the debts of praise.

text: Deus qui tres magos orientales Caspar Melchior Balthasar ad tua cunabula ut te mysticis adorarent muneribus sine impedimento duxisti et reduxisti concede famulo tuo N in itinere quo iturus est per eorum trium pias intercessiones viae securitatem pacem prosperitatem et sanitatem quatenus ipso vero sole vera stella vero lumine ducente ad loca destinata pervenire concedas.
translation_en: God, who led the three eastern magi Caspar, Melchior, and Balthasar to your manger so that they might worship you with mystic gifts without hindrance, grant your servant N on the journey he is about to undertake through their trio of holy intercessions, safety, peace, prosperity, and health. May he reach his destined places guided by the true sun, the true star, the true light.

text: Deus qui es conditor sanctorum et dirigis iter iustorum dirige angelum pacis cum famulo tuo N qui eum ad loca destinata cum iucunditate prosperitate et pace sine impedimento salutis animae et corporis perducat et reducat pro quo hanc hostiam tuae maiestati immolamus ut ei nocere non possit antiqui hostis insultus procul ab eo sit omnium malorum accessus et comes dignetur ei semper esse Christus.
translation_en: God who is the creator of saints and guides the way of the righteous, guide the angel of peace with your servant N to the destined places with joy, prosperity, and peace without hindrance to the salvation of his soul and body. May he lead and bring him back for whom we offer this sacrifice to your majesty. May ancient enemy's attacks be far from him, may all evil approaches be distant from him, and may Christ always be his companion.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui misisti Filium tuum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum de summitate caeli in uterum virginis Mariae ut homo fieret et factus est homo passus et sepultus et misisti sanctos angelos tuos ad sepulturam eius non ut custodirent sed ut testimonium perhiberent suae verae resurrectionis precor te piissime Deus ut mittere digneris eosdem angelos tuos ut sint circa famulum tuum N die ac nocte ut sit securus in corpore et rebus in Christo Iesu Domino nostro.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who sent your Son our Lord Jesus Christ from the height of heaven into the womb of the Virgin Mary so that he might become man, suffer, be buried, and raise again; I humbly ask you, most compassionate God, to send those same angels of yours to be around your servant on day and night, so that he may be secure in body and possessions in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui omnia occulta praenoscis exaudi orationem meam et fac furem reverti cum re quam furatus est ut manifestetur nobis sicut manifestasti furtum Achab in Iericho fiat illi contrarium verbum Dei ut confusus reddat et nobis ostendatur et sicut sine te nihil latere potest Domine ita nobis manifestare digneris hanc rem furtam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who discerns all hidden things, hear my prayer and make the thief return with the thing he stole so that it may be revealed to us as you revealed the theft of Ahab in Jericho. May the opposite of your word happen to him, that he may be confounded and show himself to us, and just as nothing can hide from you, Lord, so may you reveal this stolen item to us.

text: Proficiat nobis haec oblatio Domine quam tuae supplices offerimus maiestati ad confitendum /189r/ et revertendum famulum tuum N ut prius requiem non habeat antequam se nobis et rem quam furatus est ostendat ut qui te contemnendo culpam incurrit confitendo veniam persequamur.
translation_en: May this offering, Lord, be profitable to us which as your suppliant we present to Your majesty for confessing and returning our servant N, who beforehand does not have peace, until he shows himself and the thing that he stole to us. Let us pursue forgiveness, confessedly incurring guilt by contempt of You.

text: Haec nos communio purget a crimine et fac furem reverti cum re quam furatus est sicut Iosue furtum Achab absconditum invenit in terra ita patefacere digneris omnia pro quibus petimus tuam clementiam ut non in aeternum abscondas iniquitatem suam si in praesentia denudetur furtum suum et misericordiam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: This communion purges us from sin and makes the thief return with the stolen goods as Joshua uncovered the hidden theft of Ahab, may You deign to open everything for which we ask Your mercy, that You may not forever hide his iniquity. If he exposes his own theft in the present, may he deserve Your mercy.

text: Deus cui proprium est misereri semper et parcere te suppliciter exoramus pro anima famuli tui N quam hodie de hoc saeculo migrare iussisti ut non tradas eam in manus inimici et ne obliviscaris in finem sed iube eam a sanctis angelis suscipi et ad patriam paradisi perduci ut quia in te speravit et credidit non poenas aeternas sustineat sed gaudia sempiterna possideat.
translation_en: We humbly appeal to You, the one who is always merciful and gracious, for the soul of Your servant N whom you have today ordered to leave this world. Do not deliver it into the hands of the enemy and do not forget it in the end. Instead, we pray that it be received by holy angels and guided to the paradise homeland. Since he hoped and believed in You, may he not suffer eternal punishment but instead possess eternal joys.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui N pro qua tibi hostias immolamus maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecantes ut per haec piae placationis officia pervenire mereatur ad requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate the soul of your servant N, for whose sake we offer you our sacrifices, beseeching your majesty with pious supplications. May they merit to attain eternal rest through these acts of holy appeasement.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut animam famuli tui N quae hodie de hoc saeculo migravit his sacrificiis purgatam et a peccatis omnibus exutam ab angelis lucis susceptam in praeparata habitacula deduci facias beatorum ut indulgentiam pariter et vitam capiat sempiternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to grant that the soul of your servant N, who today departs from this world, may be purified and freed from all sins by these sacrifices, and may be received by the angels of light into the prepared dwelling places of the blessed. May they receive both indulgence and eternal life.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut animae famuli tui N cuius diem [obitus] sui commemoramus sanctorum atque electorum tuorum largiri digneris consortium et ei rorem misericordiae tuae perennem infundas.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the soul of your servant N, whose day of death we commemorate among your saints and elect, may be worthy to receive your grace and pour upon him an everlasting drop of your mercy.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et hanc oblationem quam tibi offerimus ob diem depositionis famuli tui N benignus ac placatus assume.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to our supplications and accept this offering which we present to you on the day of the departure of your servant N, gracious and pleased.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus collocare dignare animam famuli tui N cuius diem depositionis celebramus in sinum Abrahae Isaac et Iacob ut cum dies agnitionis advenerit inter sanctos et electos tuos eum resuscitari praecipias.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, deign to place the soul of your servant N, whose day of departure we celebrate among Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, so that when the day of his recognition arrives, you may command him to be resurrected among your saints and chosen ones.

text: Deus indulgentiarum Domine da animae famuli tui N cuius anniversarium depositionis diem commemoramus refrigerii sedem quietis beatitudinem et luminis claritatem.
translation_en: God of mercies, Lord, grant rest to the soul of your servant N, whose anniversary of departure we remember, a seat of refreshment, a place of quietness, a state of beatitude, and the clarity of light.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et animam famuli tui N cuius annua dies agitur pro qua tibi offerimus sacrificium laudis ut eam sanctorum tuorum consortio sociare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate our supplications and the soul of your servant N whose annual day is being celebrated, for whom we offer you a sacrifice of lauds. May you deem worthy to associate him with the fellowship of your saints.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras pro anima famuli tui N cuius annua dies agitur ut si quae ei maculae de terrenis contagiis adhaeserunt remissionis tuae misericordia deleantur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers for the soul of your servant N whose annual day is being celebrated. May any stains from earthly contagions clinging to him be wiped away by your mercy.

text: Deus qui inter apostolicos sacerdotes famulos tuos pontificali seu sacerdotali fecisti dignitate vigere praesta quaesumus ut quorum vicem ad horam gerebat in terris eorum quoque perpetuo aggregentur consortio in caelis.
translation_en: God, who among the apostolic priests made your servants worthy to exercise a pontifical or priestly dignity, we humbly ask that those who for a time filled their role on earth may also be united forever with them in heaven.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus pro animabus famulorum tuorum episcoporum seu sacerdotum quas offerimus hostias ut quibus pontificale donasti meritum dones et praemium.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech you, for the souls of your servants, the bishops or priests whom we offer as sacrifices. May you give to them the merit and reward which you bestowed with the pontifical gifts.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut animae famulorum tuorum episcoporum caelestis gloriae praemia consequantur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Almighty God, that the souls of Your servant bishops may obtain the rewards of heavenly glory.

text: Deus tuorum gloria sacerdotum praesta quaesumus ut anima famuli tui archiepiscopi N in tuorum fulgeat luce sanctorum.
translation_en: God, source of the glory of your priests, we ask that you grant, that the soul of your servant, the archbishop N, may shine in the light of your saints.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater pro anima famuli tui archiepiscopi N hostias placationis et laudis ut praesentis sacrificii oblatio ad refrigerium animae eius te miserante proficiat.
translation_en: Most merciful Father, receive for the soul of your servant, the archbishop N, the offerings of propitiation and praise. May the presentation of this sacrifice, offered on his behalf and by your mercy, bring profit to his soul.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut animam famuli tui archiepiscopi N in congregatione sanctorum aeternae beatitudinis iubeas esse consortem.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that the soul of your servant, Archbishop N, may be allowed to be a companion in the congregation of saints enjoying eternal beatitude.

text: Annue nobis Domine quaesumus ut anima/ae famuli/orum tui/orum N remissionem quam semper optavit/erunt mereatur/antur percipere peccatorum.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, O Lord, that the souls of your servants N may deserve/earn to receive the forgiveness which they have always desired.

text: His sacrificiis quaesumus Domine anima famulae tuae N a peccatis omnibus exuatur sine quibus a culpa nemo liber exstitit ut per haec piae placationis officia perpetuam misericordiam consequatur.
translation_en: Through these sacrifices, we humbly ask You, Lord, that the soul of Your servant N may be cleansed from all sins. No one has been freed from guilt without being cleansed of sin, so that through these acts of pious appeasement, they may attain everlasting mercy.

text: Inveniat quaesumus Domine anima famulae tuae N lucis aeternae consortium cuius perpetuae misericordiae consecuta est sacramentum.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that the soul of your servant N may find participation in the company of eternal light, to whom the perpetual mercy has granted the sacrament.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cui numquam sine spe misericordiae supplicatur propitiare animae famuli tui N ut qui de hac vita in tui nominis confessione decessit sanctorum tuorum numero eum facias aggregari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, to whom no one ever appeals without hope of mercy, propitiate the soul of your servant N. May he who departed from this life in the confession of your name be numbered among your saints, and make him join them.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui N pro qua tibi hostias placationis offerimus ut qui in hac luce in fide permansit catholica in futura vita ei retributio condonetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate the soul of your servant N, for whom we offer these sacrifices of appeasement in this life. May he who lived in faith in this life be granted forgiveness of recompense in the future life.

text: Miserere quaesumus Domine animabus omnium benefactorum nostrorum defunctorum et de beneficiis quae nobis largiti sunt in terris praemia aeterna consequantur in caelis.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, Lord, on the souls of all our benefactors who have died, and may they obtain eternal rewards in heaven for the favors they bestowed upon us on earth.

text: Suscipe Domine haec munera pro animabus omnium benefactorum nostrorum hic et ubique in Christo requiescentium et pro beneficiis eorum quibus sustentamur da eis retributionem in regno caelorum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, these offerings for the souls of all our benefactors here and everywhere in Christ who rest in peace. And grant them recompense in the kingdom of heaven, for the benefits they bestowed upon us that sustain us.

text: Sumpta sacramenta Domine nos abluant a vinculis peccatorum et animabus omnium benefactorum nostrorum defunctorum consortia obtineant spirituum beatorum.
translation_en: May the sacred mysteries, Lord, cleanse us from the bonds of sins and may the souls of all our departed benefactors attain the company of blessed spirits.

text: Deus qui nobis patrem et matrem honorare praecepisti miserere quaesumus animabus patris et matris meae eorumque omnia peccata dimitte meque cum eis in aeternae claritatis gaudio fac vivere.
translation_en: God, who commanded us to honor our father and mother, have mercy on us. We humbly ask that the souls of my father and mother, and all their sins, be forgiven. May we live with them in eternal joy.

text: Suscipe sacrificium Domine quod tibi pro animabus patris et matris meae ego miser peccator praesumo offerre ut mihi proficiat ad salutem eisque gaudium sempiternum in regione vivorum concede meque felicitati sanctorum cum eis coniunge.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the sacrifice that I, a sinner, presume to offer on behalf of the souls of my father and mother. May it bring profit to me for their salvation, and eternal joy to them. Grant me a share in the happiness of the saints with them.

text: Caelestis participatio Domine sacramenti mihi proficiat ad salutem et animabus patris et matris meae requiem et lucem obtineat perpetuam meque cum illis gratia tua coronae tuae coniunget aeternae.
translation_en: May the celestial participation of the Lord bring profit to me for salvation, and may eternal rest and light be obtained by the souls of my father and mother. May your grace unite me with them in your crown of eternity.

text: Deus veniae largitor et humanae salutis amator quaesumus clementiam tuam ut nostrae congregationis fratres et sorores qui ex hoc saeculo transierunt beata Maria semper Virgine intercedente cum omnibus sanctis ad perpetuae beatitudinis consortium pervenire concedas.
translation_en: God, giver of mercy and lover of the human salvation, we humbly ask for your clemency to grant that our congregation's brothers and sisters who have passed from this world through the intercession of blessed Mary, ever-Virgin, may attain the consortium of eternal beatitude with all saints.

text: Praesta misericors Deus ut animae famulorum tuorum pro quibus hoc sacrificium laudis tuae obtulimus maiestati per huius virtutem sacramenti expiatae te miserante recipiant beatitudinem.
translation_en: Gracious God, may you grant that the souls of your servants for whom we offered this sacrifice of your praise through the power of this expiated sacrament, receive blessedness as you show mercy.

text: Deus in cuius miseratione animae fidelium requiescunt famulis et famulabus tuis omnibus hic et ubique in Christo quiescentibus da propitius suorum veniam peccatorum ut a cunctis reatibus absoluti tecum sine fine laetentur.
translation_en: God, in whose mercy the souls of the faithful rest, be gracious to all your servants here and everywhere who are resting in Christ. Grant them forgiveness of their sins so that, absolved from every wrongdoing, they may rejoice with you forever.

text: Pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum hic et ubique omnium catholicorum dormientium hostiam Domine suscipe benignus oblatam ut hoc sacrificio singulari vinculis horrendae mortis exutae vitam mereantur aeternam.
translation_en: For the souls of your servants, the masters and servants alike, here and everywhere, of all Catholic believers who are sleeping, Lord, accept this offering graciously, offered singularly. May they merit eternal life from this sacrifice, being freed from the terrifying bonds of death.

text: Deus fidelium lumen animarum adesto supplicationibus nostris et da omnibus fidelibus in Christo quorum corpora hic et ubique requiescunt refrigerii sedem quietis beatitudinem et luminis claritatem.
translation_en: O God, light of faithful souls, be present to our supplications and grant to all the faithful in Christ whose bodies here and everywhere rest refreshment, a place of peace, the joy of blessedness, and the clarity of light.

text: Animabus quaesumus Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum oratio proficiat supplicantium ut eas et a peccatis omnibus exuas et tuae redemptionis facias esse participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for the souls of your servants and their servants, that their prayer may be successful. May they, through the entreaties of those who supplicate, be freed from all sins and make them sharers in your redemption.

text: Perfice in nobis quaesumus Domine pium religionis sanctae affectum et ad obtinendam tuae gratiae largitatem beatus Bernardus abbas et doctor egregius suis apud te semper meritis et precibus intercedat.
translation_en: Grant in us, we ask you Lord, a pious disposition of the holy religion and may blessed Bernard, the excellent teacher, always through his merits and prayers, intercede for us to obtain your grace's generosity.

text: Grata quaesumus Domine tibi sit huius sacramenti oblatio quam in memoriam dominicae passionis et in honorem beati Bernardi tuae offerimus maiestati.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this offering of the sacrament be pleasing to you, which we present in memory of the Passion of our Lord and in honor of Blessed Bernard before your majesty.

text: Tuus in nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus cibus quem sumpsimus operetur effectum et intercedente beato Bernardo incorporet nos esus edentes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that the food which we have taken may work its effect within us. Through the intervention of Blessed Bernard, may we become incorporated with those whom we eat.

text: Hodie natus de Virgine purget nos a crimine.
translation_en: Today born of the Virgin, purges us from sin.

text: Hodie natus de Virgine purget nos sua benedictione.
translation_en: Today born from the Virgin, purges us with his blessing.

text: Hodie natus de Virgine tribuat nobis dona caelestis gratiae.
translation_en: Today born from the Virgin, grant us the gifts of heavenly grace.

text: Qui natus de Virgine protegat nos Sancti Spiritus obumbratione.
translation_en: Who, born of the Virgin, protects us with the sheltering of the Holy Spirit.

text: Qui hodie descendit de caelis societ nos civibus supernis.
translation_en: Who today descended from heaven, unites us with the citizens above.

text: Qui induitur sacrae Virginis carne induat nos vestimento salutis.
translation_en: Who is clothed in the flesh of the sacred Virgin, may clothe us with the garment of salvation.

text: Filius Dei Patris benedicat nos prece Virginis matris.
translation_en: May the Son of God, bless us by the prayer of the Virgin, his Mother.

text: Per nativitatis Christi gaudium ad supernam perducamur palatium.
translation_en: Through the joy of the birth of Christ, we are led to the heavenly palace.

text: Qui nascitur de sancta Maria salvet nos prece sua pia.
translation_en: Who is born of holy Mary, save us by her devout prayer.

text: Quem magi adorant hodie benedicat nos hic in hac die.
translation_en: May the one whom the Magi adore today bless us here on this day.

text: Qui veneratur a magis benedicat nos benedictionibus aeternis.
translation_en: May he who is worthy of honor bless us with eternal blessings.

text: Stella ducit reges nos Christus suas perducat in heredes.
translation_en: A star guides kings; may Christ lead us as his heirs.

text: Qui hodie baptizatur a Ioanne benedicat nos aeterna salvatione.
translation_en: May he who today is baptized by John bless us with eternal salvation.

text: Qui hodie lavat nos in Iordane muniat nos sua de sede.
translation_en: Who today washes us in the Jordan, arms us with his seat.

text: Super quem Sancti Spiritus hodie hic benedicat nos visus in columbae specie.
translation_en: Today, over whom the Holy Spirit blesses us, appears in the form of a dove.

text: Signum quem monstrat Ioannes benedicat nos Deus venerantes.
translation_en: The sign that John shows, may God bless us, the reverent ones.

text: Agne Dei Patris a malis nos tuearis.
translation_en: Lamb of God, protect us from sins.

text: Qui vinum fecit de aqua eruat nos a morte aeterna.
translation_en: Who made wine from water, deliver us from eternal death.

text: In te Domine speravi non confundar.
translation_en: In you, Lord, I have hoped; I shall not be ashamed.

text: Angelis suis mandavit de te ut custodiant te in omnibus viis tuis.
translation_en: He has commanded his angels concerning you, that they guard you in all your ways.

text: In manibus portabunt te ne umquam offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum.
translation_en: They shall carry you in their hands, so that your foot may never stumble upon a stone.

text: Gressus meos dirige Domine secundum eloquium tuum ut non dominetur omnis iniustitia Domine.
translation_en: Direct my steps, Lord, according to thy word, that wickedness may not rule over me, O Lord.

text: Tu mandasti mandata tua custodiri nimis utinam dirigantur viae meae ad custodiendas iustificationes tuas.
translation_en: You have commanded your commandments to be kept exceedingly, I hope my ways may be directed for the keeping of your justifications.

text: Adonai semel
translation_en: Lord once

text: Adaperiat
translation_en: Approach (him)

text: Vidi Dominum
translation_en: I saw the Lord

text: Exsultet iam angelica turba caelorum exsultent divina mysteria et pro tanti regis victoria tuba intonet salutaris. Gaudeat se tellus tantis irradiatam fulgoribus et aeterni regis splendore illustratam totius orbis se sentiat amisisse caliginem. Laetetur et mater Ecclesia tanti luminis adornata fulgoribus et magnis populorum vocibus haec aula resultet. Quapropter astantes vos fratres carissimi ad tam miram sancti huius luminis claritatem una mecum quaeso Dei omnipotentis misericordiam invocate ut qui me non meis meritis intra levitarum numerum dignatus est aggregare luminis sui gratiam infundendo cerei huius laudem implere praecipiat. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum qui cum eo et Spiritu Sancto vivit et regnat Deus.
translation_en:
Now let the angelic choir of heaven rejoice, and let divine mysteries resound. Let a trumpet sound for the great victory of this king, and a salutary tune echo.
May the earth rejoice in such radiant splendors, and feel illuminated by the eternal light of the kingdom throughout the whole world. May it sense that it has lost its darkness.
Let the Mother Church be filled with joy, adorned with such brilliant rays, and let this assembly resound with great voices of the people. Therefore, I ask you, dear brothers, to invoke the mercy of the almighty God together with me, that He who deemed me worthy of joining the number of heavenly lights, may pour out His grace upon this candle's praise, and command it to be fulfilled. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with Him in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God.

text: Vere quia dignum et iustum est aequum … Invisibilem Deum Patrem omnipotentem Filiumque eius Unigenitum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Sanctum quoque Spiritum toto cordis ac mentis affectu et vocis mysterio personare. Qui pro nobis aeterno Patri Adae debitum solvit et veteris piaculi cautionem pio cruore detersit. Haec sunt enim festa paschalia in quibus verus ille Agnus occiditur eiusque sanguine postes consecrantur. Haec nox est in qua primum patres nostros filios Israël eductos de Aegypto Rubrum mare sicco vestigio transire fecisti. Haec igitur nox est quae peccatorum nostrorum tenebras columnae illuminatione purgavit. Haec nox est quae hodie per universum mundum in Christo credentes a vitiis saeculi et caligine peccatorum segregatos reddit gratiae sociatque sanctitati. Haec nox est in qua destructis vinculis mortis Christus ab inferis victor ascendit. Nihil enim nobis nasci profuit nisi redimi profuisset. O mira circa nos tuae pietatis dignatio. O inaestimabilis dilectio caritatis: ut servum redimeres Filium tradidisti. O beata beata nox quae sola meruit scire tempus et horam in qua Christus ab inferis resurrexit. Haec nox est de qua scriptum est: Et nox ut dies illuminabitur et nox illuminatio mea in deliciis meis. Huius igitur sanctificatio noctis fugat scelera culpas…
translation_en: Verily, since it is fitting and just, equal... the Invisible God, the Almighty Father, and His only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, and also the Holy Spirit, are to be honored with the whole affection of our heart, mind, and voice in the mystery of their persons. Who for us paid the debt to the eternal Father on behalf of Adam, and removed the caution of the old guilt with His holy blood. These are indeed the Paschal feasts, in which the true Lamb is sacrificed, and the gates are consecrated with His blood. This is the night in which our ancestors led the sons of Israel through the Red Sea with a dry path. Therefore this is the night that purged the darkness of our sins with the illumination of the columns.
