This is the night that today separates the believers in Christ from the vices of the world and the darkness of sins. This is the night in which, with the destruction of death's chains, Christ, the victor over death, ascended from the grave. For nothing has been born for us that was not redeemed. O wondrous dignity of Your pity towards us. O inestimable love of charity: You gave Yourself to redeem a servant. O blessed, blessed night, which alone deserved to know the time and hour in which Christ rose from the dead. This is about which it is written: "And the night shall shine like the day, and the night shall be my light." Therefore the sanctification of this night drives away wickedness...

text: Deus venerunt gentes in hereditatem [?]
translation_en: God, nations have come into Your inheritance

text: 〈Exsurgat Deus〉 et dissipentur inimici eius et fugiant.
translation_en: Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered, and let them flee.

text: Deus qui admirabili providentia cuncta disponis: te suppliciter exoramus ut terram quam unigenitus Filius tuus proprio sanguine consecravit de manibus inimicorum Crucis eripiens restituas cultui Christiano vota fidelium ad eius liberationem instantium misericorditer dirigendo in viam pacis aeternae.
translation_en: God, who arranges all things with marvelous providence: we humbly entreat you to restore the land that your only-begotten Son consecrated with his own blood by freeing it from the hands of the enemies of the Cross, and to direct the prayers of the faithful towards its restoration and their liberation mercifully into the path of eternal peace.

text: Ave Maria
translation_en: Hail Mary

text: Missus est Gabriel angelus a Deo in civitatem Nazareth ad virginem desponsatam viro cui nomen erat Ioseph.
translation_en: Gabriel, the angel, was sent from God to the city of Nazareth to the betrothed virgin whose name was Mary, who was espoused to a man named Joseph.

text: Specie tua
translation_en: By Your Self

text: Kyrie eleison. Christe eleison. Kyrie eleison.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy. Lord, have mercy.

text: Diffusa est gratia
translation_en: Grace is scattered around

text: Iube domne benedicere.
translation_en: Command (O Lord), bless.

text: Proferam vobis de historia veteris testamenti necessarium exemplum contra perfidiam Iudaeorum quomodo sonuit auribus nostris. Dominus sancto Moysi praecepit de singulis tribubus virgas afferri. Allataeque sunt duodecim virgae inter quas etiam una erat quae Aaron fuerat sacerdotis positae sunt a sancto Moyse in tabernaculo testimonii. Virga Aaron post alterum diem invenitur produxisse flores et frondes ac peperisse nuces. Tu.
translation_en: I shall present to you an essential example from the history of the Old Testament against the treachery of the Jews, as it sounded in our ears. The Lord commanded Saint Moses that rods be brought from each tribe. Twelve rods were brought and among them was one which had been placed by Saint Moses in the tabernacle of testimony. The rod of Aaron was found to have produced flowers, leaves, and nuts after two days. You.

text: Virga illa Aaron unde agebamus Virgo Maria fuit quae nobis Christum verum sacerdotem concepit et peperit. De quo David cecinit dicens: »Tu es sacerdos in aeternum secundum ordinem Melchisedech.« In superiori versu namque dixerat: »Virgam virtutis tuae emittet Dominus ex Sion.« Et Isaias propheta apertius sanctam Mariam designat dicens: »Exiet virga de radice Iesse et flos de radice eius ascendet et requiescet super eum Spiritus Domini Spiritus sapientiae et intellectus Spiritus scientiae et pietatis et replebit eum Spiritus timoris Domini.«
translation_en: That staff of Aaron, from which we were led by the Virgin Mary, was the one who conceived and bore us the true priest Christ. About whom David sang saying: "You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchisedech." In the previous verse, indeed he said: "The Lord will emit a staff of your power from Zion." And more openly, Isaiah the prophet designates holy Mary, saying: "A shoot shall come out of the root of Jesse, and a branch shall grow from his roots. It shall rest on him: The Spirit of the Lord, the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and the fear of the Lord will fill him."

text: Quomodo fiet istud
translation_en: How is this done

text: Quod autem haec virgo nuces produxit imago dominici corporis fuit. Nux enim in suo corpore trinam habet substantiae unionem: corium testam et nucleum. In corio caro in testa ossa in nucleo interiore anima comparatur. In corio nucis carnem significat Salvatoris quae habuit in se asperitatem vel amaritudinem passionis. In nucleo interiore declaratur dulcedo deitatis quae tribuit pastum et luminis subministrat officium. In testa lignum interferens Crucis quod non discrevit id quod et intus fuit sed quae caelestia et terrena fuerant mediatoris ligni interpositione sociavit dicente apostolo: Quoniam ipse per sanguinem Crucis suae pacificavit omnia quae in caelis et quae in terris sunt Iesus Christus Dominus noster.
translation_en: For indeed, this virgin produced an image of the body of the Lord that was contained within a nut. Now, a nut in its body has a threefold union of substance: the shell, the kernel, and the interior shell. In the shell there is flesh, in the exterior testa there are bones in the interior nut the soul appears. The flesh in the shell signifies the flesh of the Savior which within itself had roughness or bitterness of suffering. The interior nut declares the sweetness of divinity that provided nourishment and performed the duty of light. In the exterior testa interferes the wooden cross which did not separate what was inside but through the mediation of the wood it united what were heavenly and earthly matters, as said by the apostle: For he himself through his blood of the cross pacified all things that are in heaven and on earth, Jesus Christ our Lord.

text: Suscipe Verbum
translation_en: Receive the Word

text: Angelus ergo dixit Mariae: Ecce concipies et paries filium cuius nomen erit Iesus.
translation_en: So, the angel said to Mary: Behold, you will conceive and bear a son whose name will be Jesus.

text: Dominus regnavit
translation_en: The Lord reigns

text: Beata mater munere
translation_en: Blessed mother, bestow [your favor]

text: Spiritus Sanctus in te descendet Maria
translation_en: The Holy Spirit will descend upon you, Mary

text: Christus natus est nobis.
translation_en: Christ was born for us.

text: Virgo Verbo concepit
translation_en: The Virgin conceived by the Word

text: Domine Dominus noster
translation_en: Lord, our Lord

text: Virgo Dei Genitrix quem totus non capit orbis: in tua se clausit viscera factus homo vera fide genitus purgavit crimina mundi et tibi virginitas inviolata mansit.
translation_en: The God's Mother, who the whole world cannot contain: within your womb was enclosed made Man, born with true faith. He purged the sins of the world and your inviolable virginity remained.

text: Caeli enarrant
translation_en: Heavens declare

text: Homo natus est in ea et ipse fundavit eam Altissimus.
translation_en: A man was born in it, and he himself founded it - the Highest One.

text: Fundamenta
translation_en: Foundations

text: Speciosa
translation_en: Beautiful

text: Alma.
translation_en: Soul

text: Natus est nobis fratres ex Maria Virgine Dei Filius ut germanae carnis nostrae conceptione productus creato a se homini et pietatem paternam et fraternum largiretur affectum et natus sane ab intacta est femina ut hominem testaretur partus humanus et Deum probaret aeterna virginitas. Tu.
translation_en: A sister's birth was given to us from the Virgin Mary, the Son of God, so that he might bestow upon us both paternal and brotherly affection through his conception in our flesh. Born indeed by an undefiled woman, he would testify as a man, while proving the eternal virginity of God.

text: Sancta et immaculata
translation_en: Holy and immaculate

text: Quod autem mystico conceptu mundum visitare dignatus est Dei Filius nostrae hoc salutis necessitas flagitabat nimirum ut caelestis tandem generatio repararet quod nativitas terrena perdiderat. Tu.
translation_en: Indeed, the Son of God deigned to visit our world by the mystery of His conception, a necessity for our salvation. Namely, so that the heavenly generation might restore what the earthly birth had lost. You.

text: Continet in gremio caelum terramque regentem Virgo Dei Genitrix proceres comitantur heriles per quos orbis ovans Christo sub principe pollet.
translation_en: In its bosom, the heaven and earth ruling Virgin, Mother of God, is accompanied by angels and archangels. The heroes follow through whom the orbiting world shines with Christ as its prince.

text: Maternis vehitur qui matrem vexerat ulnis angelici proceres quem stipant agmine fido. Per quos.
translation_en: He who had oppressed his mother is borne by angelic princes supported by faithful ranks. Through them.

text: Dum ergo Christus natus praedicatur ex femina dum iacere contentus est in praesepi dum lacrimosis concrepat vagitibus dum maternis lactatur uberibus per haec fratres advertite eum ut hominem infirma pro infirmis pertulisse et ut Deum 〈potentiam〉 exercuisse celestem. Tu.
translation_en: While Christ is being proclaimed as born from a woman, while he lies content in the manger, while he is warmed by weeping and is nourished with maternal milk; through these brothers, pay attention to him: that he carried mankind weakened by infirmity, and that he exercised divine power heavenly. You.

text: Nesciens
translation_en: Unaware

text: Carissime
translation_en: Dearest

text: Enixa
translation_en: <translation>Exi(a) - this Latin word can mean either "Go out" or "Exit", depending on the context in which it is used within a medieval liturgical setting. Without more context, it's difficult to provide a definitive translation.

text: Glorificamus
translation_en: We glorify

text: Maria intacta
translation_en: Mary Immaculate

text: Domine Deus invictae potentiae pietatis immensae peregrinantium refugium totius consolationis auxilium qui famulis tuis invictissima arma tribuis: quaesumus 〈ut〉 has peras devotae humilitatis benedicere digneris ut venerandae Crucis vexillum cuius in eis est designata figura sit invictissimum robur tuorum servorum contra antiqui hostis validissima tentamenta sit in via defensio sit in domo protectio sit ubique praesidium. Per.
translation_en: Lord God of invincible power and immense pity, refuge of pilgrims and aid of all consolation, who grants to your servants the invincible arms: we ask that you deign to bless these devoted persons with humility, so that the banner of the venerable Cross, whose figure is marked on them, may be an invincible strength for your servants against the most powerful attacks of ancient enemies. On the way it may be a defense, in the house protection, and everywhere a stronghold. Through.

text: Accipe peram signum peregrinationis tuae et per viam mandatorum Dei currens angelus Domini bonus comitetur tecum et benedicat munera tua.
translation_en: Receive the apple as a sign of your pilgrimage, and an angel, a good servant of the Lord, will run with you along the way of God's commandments. The Lord's blessing shall be upon your gifts.

text: In nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti.
translation_en: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

text: Accipe baculum consolationis Dei ut possis sustentari atque incedere per viam sapientiae et per semitam iustitiae revertaris ad propriam domum tuam cum gaudio.
translation_en: Receive the staff of God's comfort, so that you may be able to bear up and walk along the way of wisdom and the path of justice, and return to your own home with joy.

text: Non de meritorum meorum qualitate confisus praesumo accedere ante sanctum conspectum tuum Domine Deus sed pro tua ineffabili pietate qui dignatus es peccatores ad tuam misericordiam vocare et ad te venientibus dignatus es piissimam indulgentiam et sempiternam gratiam conferre. Tu enim Domine a tua pietate nullum repellis sed ad te venientibus tuae pietatis et misericordiae dignanter sinum aperis et ad sacramentum piissimae reconciliationis tuae clementer admittis et gratiae tuae participes efficis qui vocas ea quae non sunt tamquam ea quae sunt qui facis de indignis dignos de peccatoribus iustos de immundis mundos qui iustificas impios et vivificas mortuos et in infirmitate virtutem tribuis. Tu ergo Domine fac in me peccatore opus tuae magnae misericordiae tuae pietatis immensae tuae gratiae sempiternae non pro meis meritis sed pro tuis miserationibus multis et magnis. Mitte tuum Spiritum Sanctum Paraclitum de caelis illuminatorem et sanctificatorem tuae sanctae Ecclesiae quo tu Deus illuminasti et sanctificasti et confirmasti corda tuorum sanctorum apostolorum et ceterorum tuorum fidelium ut ipse tuus Spiritus Sanctus dignanter adveniens cor meum inflammet et expurget et mundum tuae gratiae habitaculum efficiat et omnes sensus meos purificet et clarificet et ministerium servitutis meae faciat in conspectu tuo acceptabile et nobis salutare tua misericordia tribuente tua virtute operante tua gratia confirmante quia tu es creator omnium et Dominus tibi est omnis honor et gloria per Iesum Christum Filium tuum Dominum et Deum nostrum. Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate eiusdem Spiritus Sancti per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Not relying on the quality of my merits, I presume to approach before your holy presence, Lord God. Yet, for your ineffable pity, who have graciously called sinners to your mercy and have been gracious to those coming to you by conferring the most compassionate indulgence and eternal grace. For indeed, Lord, from your mercy you do not cast away but rather open your arms of pity and mercy to those coming to you and gently admit them to the sacrament of your most merciful reconciliation, making participants in your grace who call what is not as if it were, making the unworthy worthy, the sinner just, the unclean clean, the impious righteous, the dead living, and in weakness granting strength. Therefore, Lord, work in me, a sinner, your great mercy, your immense pity, your eternal grace, not for my merits but for your numerous and great compassion. Send forth your Holy Spirit, the Paraclete from heaven, the enlightener and sanctifier of your holy Church, so that as you, God, have illuminated, sanctified, and confirmed the hearts of your holy apostles and other faithful ones, may your Holy Spirit worthy come to me, inflame and purify my heart, make it a habitation of your grace, purify and clarify all my senses, and make the service of my slavery acceptable and salutary to you through your mercy giving us life by your power operating, your grace confirming, for you are the creator of all and to you belongs all honor and glory forever and ever through Jesus Christ, your Son, our Lord and God, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the same Holy Spirit.

text: Quam dilecta tabernacula tua
translation_en: How delightful are your tabernacles

text: Benedixisti Domine terram tuam
translation_en: You have blessed, Lord, your land

text: Credidi propter quod locutus sum
translation_en: I believe on account of what I have spoken

text: Laudate Dominum omnes gentes
translation_en: Praise the Lord, all nations

text: Intret in conspectu tuo Domine oratio mea inclina aurem tuam ad precem meam (preces meas).
translation_en: Let my prayer enter into your sight, O Lord; turn your ear to my supplication (my prayers).

text: Kyrie eleison. Christe eleison. Christe audi nos. Salvator mundi
translation_en: Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy. Christ, hear us. Savior of the world

text: Et ne nos inducas 〈in tentationem〉. 〈R. Sed libera nos a malo.〉
translation_en: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.

text: Et veniat super nos misericordia 〈tua Domine〉. 〈R.〉 Salutare tuum secundum eloquium tuum.
translation_en: And may thy mercy come upon us, O Lord. (Response.) Thy salvation according to thy word.

text: Peccavimus cum patribus nostris. 〈R. Iniuste egimus iniquitatem fecimus.〉
translation_en: We have sinned, together with our forefathers. (Response) Unjustly we have done iniquity, we have made.

text: Domine non secundum peccata nostra 〈facias nobis〉. 〈R. Neque secundum iniquitates nostras retribuas nobis.〉
translation_en: Lord, not according to our sins make known to us. (R) Nor according to our wickednesses do you repay to us.

text: Domine ne memineris iniquitatum 〈nostrarum antiquarum〉. 〈R. Cito anticipent nos misericordiae tuae quia pauperes factis sumus nimis.〉
translation_en: Lord, do not remember our ancient sins. (Response) Quickly let your mercy precede us, for we have become too much the poor.

text: Adiuva nos Deus salutaris noster. 〈R. Et propter gloriam nominis tui Domine libera nos.〉
translation_en: Help us, O God our savior. (Response) And for the glory of your name, Lord, deliver us.

text: Repleatur os meum laude 〈tua〉. 〈R. Ut cantem gloriam tuam tota die magnitudinem tuam.〉
translation_en: Fill my mouth with your praise. (Response) That I may sing your glory all day long, the greatness of you.

text: Domine averte faciem tuam a 〈peccatis meis〉. 〈R. Et omnes iniquitates meas dele.〉
translation_en: Lord, turn away your face from my sins. (Response) And delete all my iniquities.

text: Cor mundum crea in me Deus. 〈R. Et spiritum rectum innova in visceribus meis.〉
translation_en: Create in me, O God, a pure heart. (Response) And renew a right spirit within my innermost being.

text: Ne proicias me a facie tua. 〈R. Et spiritum sanctum tuum ne auferas a me.〉
translation_en: Do not cast me away from your face. (Response) And do not take your Holy Spirit away from me.

text: Redde mihi laetitiam salutaris tui. 〈R. Et spiritu principali confirma me.〉
translation_en: Restore to me thy saving joy. [Response] And strengthen me with the holy Spirit.

text: Fiat misericordia tua Domine super nos. 〈R. Quemadmodum speravimus in te.〉
translation_en: May your mercy, Lord, be upon us. [Response] As we have hoped in you.

text: Propitius esto peccatis nostris Domine. 〈R. Propter nomen tuum.〉
translation_en: Lord, be merciful to our sins. (Response) For your name's sake.

text: Exsurge Domine adiuva nos. 〈R. Et libera nos propter nomen tuum.〉
translation_en: Arise, O Lord, help us. (Response) And deliver us for Your name.

text: Domine Deus virtutum converte nos. 〈R. Et ostende faciem tuam et salvi erimus.〉
translation_en: Lord God of powers, convert us. (Response) And show thy face and we shall be saved.

text: Rogo te Deus Sabaoth altissime Pater sancte ut me tunica castitatis digneris accingere et meos lumbos balteo tui timoris et amoris ambire ac renes cordis et corporis mei caritatis igne urere quatenus pro peccatis meis possim digne intercedere et astantis populi peccatorum veniam promereri ac pacificas singulorum hostias immolare me quoque Domine audacter ad te accedentem non sinas perire sed dignare mundare pectinare lavare ornare leniter ac benigne suscipere. Per Unigenitum Filium tuum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum. Qui tecum vivit et regnat.
translation_en: I ask you, God of Sabaoath, most high Father, holy one, that you deign to clothe me in the tunic of chastity, and let my loins be girded with your belt of fear and love, and let the kidneys of my heart and body burn with charity, so that for my sins I may worthily intercede and have forgiveness offered to the repentant people, and let peaceful sacrifices be offered by me also, Lord. Do not let me perish but deign to cleanse, groom, wash, adorn, and gently and kindly receive me. Through your only begotten Son our Lord Jesus Christ, who lives and reigns with you.

text: Oramus te sancta Trinitas et inseparabilis Unitas per trophaeum victoriosissimae crucis et per merita beatae Mariae semper Virginis atque per intercessionem omnium sanctorum tuorum et eorum quorum hic reliquiae continentur vel quorum hodie celebratur festivitas ut mihi miserrimo et indigno peccatori atque omni sorde vitiorum interius exteriusque coinquinato manum misericordiae tuae mihi porrigas labentem erigas orantem ne despicias sed pietatis tuae vultu respicias et exaudias fidem adaugeas spem confirmes caritatis tuae ardorem in me succendas; et quia ad sanctum altare tuum indignus accedo non ideo peccatorum meorum recipiam vicem sed indulgentiae tuae piam sentiam bonitatem. Praesta hoc Pater omnipotens qui tantum dilexisti hominem ut ad liberandum eum unicum mitteres. Praesta hoc Iesu Christe Fili Dei vivi qui ut a morte redimeres hominem traditus in manus peccatorum non horruisti crucem. Tu es ipse qui ovem perditam pio umero ad ovile tuum reportasti. Tu es ipse qui ore prophetico dixisti nolo mortem peccatoris sed ut magis convertatur et vivat. Praesta hoc Sancte Spiritus qui procedens ab utroque in me effusus es in baptismo; tu remissio peccatorum tu illuminator cordium tu doctrina fidelium tu unius essentiae unius potentiae unius voluntatis qui cum Patre et Filio et Spiritu Sancto vivis et regnas.
translation_en: We pray you, Holy Trinity and inseparable Unity, through the trophy of the most victorious cross and through the merits of blessed Mary ever Virgin and through the intercession of all your saints, whose relics are contained here or whose feast is celebrated today, that you extend to me, the wretched and unworthy sinner, stained with all filth of sins inside and outside, the hand of your mercy, support me, raise me up while praying, do not despise but look upon me with the face of your pity and hear me. Increase my faith, confirm my hope, fan into flames the ardor of your charity in me; and because I approach your holy altar unworthy, I do not therefore expect to receive the punishment for my sins, but to feel the kindness of your indulgence. Grant this, Almighty Father, who so loved man that you sent your only-begotten Son. Grant this, Jesus Christ, Son of God living, who though handed over to death for man's redemption, did not shrink back from the cross. You yourself are the one who brought back the lost sheep with a pious arm to your fold. You yourself are the one who said with prophetic mouth: "I do not desire the death of the sinner but that he may turn and live." Grant this, Holy Spirit, who proceeded from both and were poured out upon me in baptism; you are remission of sins, illuminator of hearts, teacher of the faithful, one essence, one power, one will, who with the Father and Son and Holy Spirit, live and reign.

text: Confiteor tibi peccata mea aeterne pontifex et sancte sanctorum magister et veri tabernaculi sacerdos qui semel in anno huius saeculi mystica sancta intrasti atque immaculatum agnum proprii tui hostiam dedisti pro peccatis meis et nunc sedes in dextera Dei Patris semper vivens et interpellans pro peccatis omnium: tibi ego confiteor qui debitor sum non tantum decem milium talentorum meorum criminum sed totius vitae meae ratione scelerum quod in omni vita mea nullum mandatum tuum perfecte a me custoditum scio in quo miser ego sermone visu auditu gustu odoratu et tactu cogitatione locutione opere delectatione pollutione fornicatione adulterio libidine sodomitica luxuria ira invidia ebrietate commessatione maledictione detractione murmuratione furto periurio falso testimonio blasphemia in afflictione populi commissi in negligentia propositi mei vel etiam consensu deliqui. Idcirco nunc praevenio faciem tuam in confessione et in conspectu angelorum atque iustorum et omnium sanctorum confiteor tibi peccata mea aeterne pontifex et veniam rogo de delictis meis atque obsecro ut in hoc tempore accepto exaudias me ut modo possim perfecte intelligere peccata mea et tibi aeterno iudici confiteri et hic veniam promereri omnium delictorum meorum quatenus ad tremendum iudicium tuum liber et securus de omnibus accusationibus inimici pervenire merear. Per te Deum et Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum. Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.
translation_en: I confess to you, eternal priest and master of the saints and true priest of the tabernacle who once a year in this world mystically entered the holy sanctuary and gave as a spotless lamb the offering of your own for my sins; now you sit on the right hand of God the Father always living and interceding for the sins of all: to you I confess who am a debtor, not just ten thousand talents of my sins but of the entire account of my life due to crimes, that in every life of mine I know nothing of your commandment kept perfectly by me; I have spoken, seen, heard, tasted, smelled, touched, thought, spoken, acted, delighted, polluted, fornicated, adulterated, lustfully desired, sodomized, committed luxury, anger, envy, drunkenness, committed adultery in the commission, slander, murmuring, theft, perjury, false testimony, blasphemy in the affliction of the people, committed negligence or even consented to sin. Therefore now I present my face to you in confession and in the sight of angels and the just and all saints: I confess to you, eternal priest, and I ask for forgiveness for my sins and beseech that in this accepted time you may hear me so that I can understand perfectly my sins and confess them to the eternal judge and here merit forgiveness for all my sins as much as is needed for me to approach the terrible judgment of yours freely and secure from all accusations by enemies. Through you, God and our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son who lives and reigns with you in unity.

text: Deus universitatis creator commendo tibi quos ad regendum mihi tradidisti. Domine tibi ministrantium aperi oculos ut ad sacrosancta mysteria celebranda corporis et sanguinis tui tranquilla mente et corpore mundo semper accedant. Non eos iracundia dividat non superbia elevet non avaritia decipiat non immunditia inquinet sed sit potius ipsorum devotio aliorum salutatio. Revela etiam his qui indebite ad hoc accedunt officium tui fontem consilii ut seipsos ad hoc subtrahendo iudicent ne districte iudicentur a te. Commendo nihilominus tibi Domine Deus meus virginum votum ut tua miseratio servetur in eis quod corruptum reparari non potest. Terratenus etiam prostratus Domine clementissime peto ut continentium conversationem in tua dirigas voluntate quatenus innocentiam quam ostendunt in habitu demonstrent in moribus iudicaturique mundum cum Christo veniant ob cuius amorem sua deseruere. Coniugatos etiam committo omnipotentiae tuae misericordissime Pater ut qui pretio sanguinis Unigeniti tui sunt redempti virtute Spiritus Sancti ab omnibus huius saeculi fluctuationibus liberentur. In his quoque tribus ordinibus ante omnia tibi offero hominum Salvator qui in parva aetate sunt id est animas innocentes ne perdantur a perditis ipsique iam perditi alios qui tibi servire poterant ne perdant. Quis vel quantus ego sum tamen precor te Domine ut omnes hos non solum ab insidiis diaboli sed etiam a callidis hominum deceptionibus valeam custodire qui nec mentis meae tenebras queo aliquo modo ut cupio penetrare. Nam mihi qui famem sapientiae salutaris patior non est unde populum pascam. Nimis pertimesco et valde pavesco Domine ne forte sit periculum meum huius plebis interitus quod me caecum et insipientem atque per devia errantem aliorum doctorem atque rectorem vocari voluisti et permisisti et prae multitudine malorum meorum vix sanabor. Quid faciam Domine cum pro tantis animabus quae pendent ad animam meam coepero reddere rationem? Tibi soli Domine notus est numerus illorum qui iam mortui perierunt per negligentiam meam exemplo mihi credito et quia cottidie augetur numerus perditorum non est quid agam nos est quo fugiam nisi ad te. Quapropter doce me facere voluntatem tuam id est ostende mihi quod velis. Si vis ut perseverem in officio credito da vires ut immutabiliter vivam. Da intellectum ut pabulo verbi tui oves tuas salubriter pascam. Tu Domine iustus es et iudicium tuum rectum est. Ego autem peccator sum et ideo non tibi quia omnia iuste disponis sed mihi imputo quod hactenus tepide vivendo et a praedicatione sancta cessando mihi et aliis obfui. Semper enim fui tepidissimus et idcirco da mihi indignissimo accipere gratiam Spiritus tui ad regendum populum tuum quoniam instanter paratus es dare recte poscentibus te. Et quis me ad accipiendum facit capacissimum nisi tu qui semper ad dandum es largissimus? Offero tibi animam meam ut mundes eam a sordibus peccatorum et inferas locis vitiorum virtutes. Offero et os meum ut repleas illud Spiritu sapientiae ut enarrem populo tuo mirabilia de lege tua. Novi enim apostolum tuum dixisse: «Si quis vestrum indiget sapientia postulet a Deo qui dat omnibus affluenter et non improperat sed dabit ei.» Securus igitur sum de miseratione tuae bonitatis et verissimum credo esse quod dixisti: Omnis enim qui petit accipit et qui quaerit invenit et pulsanti aperietur. Quod si non aperueris memor ero illius loci ubi dictum est de Spiritu sapientiae: «In malivolam animam non introibit sapientia nec habitavit in corpore subdito peccatis» et ideo non erubesco in conspectu tuo confiteri peccata mea ut his remissis facias me idoneum doctorem populo tuo. Peccavi Domine et cottidie pecco visu gustu auditu odoratu et tactu. Peccavi in dilectionibus pravis in verbis otiosis et in factis malitiosis. Octo etiam principalibus vitiis obnoxium me esse confiteor id est gulae fornicationi avaritiae irae tristitiae acediae vanae gloriae ac superbiae. Talis sum Domine. Sed sicut meum est confiteri peccata mea mala ita tuum est ex impurissimo facere mundissimum. Tu dixisti: Ego sum qui deleo ut nebulam iniquitatem tuam. Quod si tu a cunctis peccatorum sordibus me mundaveris erit cor meum sedes sapientiae tuae eroque pascens populum tuum docendo praecepta tua. Nam quantum de mea fragilitate diffido tantum de omnipotentia tua praesumo qui aperis os mutorum et linguas infantium facis dissertas atque ex ore infantium et lactantium perficis tuas laudes. Non requiro a te pulchram eloquentiam verborum quia saepissime telo humanae laudis corrumpitur sed simplicem praeceptorum tuorum lucem de qua dictum est: Praeceptum Domini lucidum illuminans oculos. Timens Domine meum et populi periculum accusando me illum tibi singulis horis ac momentis commendo. Item amando te peto ut doceas me qualiter pascam oves tuas et impleatur in me quod primo pastori dixisti per te: Si diligis me pasce oves meas. Da Domine quod iubes et iube quod vis quoniam per te aliquid sum. Da ergo ut mihi et populo tuo prosim qui me non exsistentem creasti et populo tuo praeesse voluisti. Qui vivis et regnas Deus per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en:
I commend to you, God, the stewards whom you have given me to rule over me. Lord, open the eyes of those who are ministering to the sacred mysteries of your body and blood, that they may approach them with a peaceful mind and body always. May neither anger, pride, greed, uncleanliness nor deceit divide them but rather may their devotion and greeting be among them.
Reveal also to those who inappropriately come to this office the source of your counsel so that they may judge themselves lest they be strictly judged by you. I commend to you, Lord, my God, the vow of virgins so that your mercy may be preserved in them which cannot be repaired once it has been corrupted.
Prostrate on earth, Lord most mercifully, I ask you to guide those who are continent in accordance with your will, so that the innocence they show in their behavior is confirmed in their morals and judged worthy by the world along with Christ.
I also entrust to your most compassionate mercy, O Father, those who have been redeemed by the price of your only-begotten Son through the power of the Holy Spirit, that they may be freed from all the fluctuations of this world.
In these three orders especially, before everything, I offer you, O Savior of mankind, those who are young in age, that is, souls, lest they perish among the lost themselves, and those who could serve you but have already perished, lest they perish.
Who or how great I am, I ask you, Lord, to protect these not only from the snares of the devil but also from the crafty deceptions of men, for I cannot feed the people with my hunger for wisdom. I fear greatly and very much fear, Lord, lest the danger of this people's destruction be my own peril, that you have chosen me as a blind and foolish teacher and leader for others, and permitted it, and because of the multitude of my sins I scarcely can heal.
What shall I do, Lord, concerning these many souls who are hanging on my life? To you alone, Lord, is known the number of those who have already perished through my negligence. And since the number of the lost is daily increasing, what am I to do or where to flee except to you?
Therefore, teach me to do your will, that is, show me what you want. If you wish me to persevere in this office, give me the strength to live unchangingly. Give me understanding so that I may feed your sheep healthily with the food of your word. You, Lord, are just and your judgment is righteous. I am a sinner, therefore I do not appeal to you because you arrange everything justly but rather I appeal to you for mercy because up until now, I have lived half-heartedly and abandoned the holy preaching.
I have always been the most lukewarm, therefore give me, unworthy one, the grace of your Spirit to rule over your people, since you are eager to give rightly to those who ask for it. And who makes me worthy to receive this but you, who are always generous in giving? I offer you my soul that you may cleanse it from the stains of sin and instill in me the virtues of vices. I offer also my mouth that you may fill it with the Spirit of wisdom so that I may proclaim to your people the wonderful things about your law.
I know that your apostle said: "If any among you lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives liberally and without reproach; he will provide what is needed." Therefore, I am confident in your mercy and truly believe that you have said: "Everyone who asks receives and the one who seeks finds and to the one who knocks it will be opened." What if you do not open the mouth of the mute or make the tongues of infants articulate or perfect your praises from the mouths of infants and nursing infants? I do not require from you eloquence in words, for human praise is often corrupted with a deadly weapon, but rather simple light of your commandments, about which it is said: "The precepts of the Lord are a light that illuminates the eyes."
Fearing, Lord, my own and the people's danger, I accuse myself before you continually and at each hour and moment commend them to you. Also, loving you, I ask that you teach me how to feed your sheep and let it be fulfilled in me what you first said to the shepherd through you: "If you love me, feed my sheep."
Give me, Lord, what you command and command what you want, for by you something is. Give me so that I may lead and you want me to lead those whom you created not existing and wanted to rule over them.

text: Succurre mihi Deus meus antequam moriar antequam me tenebrae ignis involvant. Subveni mihi priusquam ad tormenta properem priusquam Gehennae igne devorer. Si ergo iustus vix salvabitur ego impius ubi ero? Quid faciam dum venerit tremendi formido iudicii tui {dies}? Quid faciam vel quid dicam quid ero dicturus cum ante tribunal Christi fuero praesentatus? Vae mihi in die illa quando peccavi utinam non illuxisset super me. Melius mihi fuisset ut non fuissem genitus melius ut non fuissem in hoc saeculo procreatus quam aeternos pati cruciatus. Flete me caelum et terra lugete me omnes creaturae Dei. Peccavi enim crudeliter lapsus sum fortiter corrui miserabiliter ante adversarios meos. Nullum invenitur peccatum cuius sordibus non sim coinquinatus. Nullus est morbus vitiorum a quo non contraxi contagium probrosus sceleratus flagitiis cunctis sum obrutus. Ut bene viverem ultro promisi quod pollicitus sum minime servavi sed semper ad peccatum meum redii semper delicta mea iteravi numquam in melius mutavi mores meos numquam a malefactis meis recessi. Plurimos enim maculavi plurimos malis moribus ad iniquitatem perverti scelere meo multae animae perierunt exemplis vitae meae multi perversi sunt. Ego multis causa malorum fui. Orate pro me ad Dominum viri sancti obsecrate pro me plebs omnis sanctorum. Quis miserebitur tui anima? Quis consolabitur tui? Ut quid Domine longe factus es a me consolator animae meae? Revertere iam Deus meus non me obliviscaris in finem non me in perpetuum deseras non me perdendum in potestatem daemonum derelinquas. Peccantes exspectas ut redeant. Quanti enim scelerati luxuriis dediti quanti concupiscentiis huius saeculi saginati bonitate tua ad indulgentiam pervenerunt. Multis non merentibus gratis indulgentiam donasti. Ostende Domine in me clementiam tuam et non abneges uni quod pluribus donasti. Displicet mihi quod feci displicet quod peccavi. Peccavi Domine miserere mei audi vocem clamoris mei. Peccavi Deus meus miserere mei. Parce malis meis indulge sceleribus meis sana animam meam quia peccavi tibi. Et in angelis reperta est pravitas. Memorare Domine quae sit substantia mea memento quia terra sum memento quia pulvis sum et cinis. Operi manuum tuarum porrige mihi dexteram succurre carnalibus infirmitatibus meis. Patent tibi vulnera mea coram te aegritudo mea. Tu vides per quanta sauciatus sum et languidus. Medicina saner tribue medelam qua curer impende. Exstingue in me flammas concupiscentiae ut non exardescant in me ulterius. Tu enim scis tentationes meas quas porto tu scis fluctus quas patior tu nosti tentationes quas tolero. Erue animam meam captivam ab inferis erue me de immanissima abysso non me concludat profundum non mihi deneges exitum quia iam dies ultima venit. Nihil superest mihi nisi tumulus nihil superest nisi sepulcrum. Parce mihi antequam 〈eam〉 munda me antequam ab hac vita egrediar. Solve priusquam moriar peccatorum meorum vincula quia tu es spes mea tu es laus mea tu es pulchritudo mea tu es dulcedo mea. Tibi laus tibi gloria tibi gratiarum actio semper et ubique per infinita saecula sanctorum.
translation_en: Help me, my God, before I die, before the shadows and fire envelop me. Come to my aid before I run towards the torments, before the fires of Hell consume me. If even the righteous will barely be saved, where will an unrighteous one like me be? What shall I do when the day of terrible judgment arrives? What shall I say or what will I be able to say when I am brought before the tribunal of Christ? Woe is me on that day when I have sinned; if only it had not shone upon me. It would have been better for me not to have been born, better not to have been created in this world than to endure eternal torments. Heaven and earth weep for me, all creatures of God mourn for me. For I have cruelly sinned, I have fallen strongly, miserably before my adversaries. No sin is found without my being stained by its filth. No vice has left me uninfected, no crime has not overwhelmed me with wickedness. Although I promised to live well, I did not keep the promise I made; instead, I always returned to my sin, always repeated my transgressions, never did I change my ways, never did I depart from my evil deeds. Many have been defiled by me, many have been led to iniquity by my crime, many souls have perished as a result of my example, many have become corrupt. I have been the cause of much evil. Pray for me to the Lord, holy men, pray for me, all the people of saints. Who will pity your soul? Who will console you? Why, Lord, have You distant Yourself from me, consoler of my soul? Return, my God, do not forget me until the end, do not leave me forever abandoned to demons. Sinners expect You to repent. For how many sinners dedicated to earthly pleasures have arrived at Your indulgence. Many, undeserving, You have given grace freely. Show Your mercy to me, Lord, and do not deny one what You have given to many. I am ashamed of what I have done, I am ashamed of what I have sinned. I have sinned, Lord, have mercy on me, hear the voice of my supplication. I have sinned, God my Savior, have mercy on me. Spare me, forgive my sins, heal my soul because I have sinned against You. And in the angels, wickedness was found. Remember, Lord, what is my substance; remember that I am dust, remember that I am ashes and coal. Extend Your hand to help me with my carnal weaknesses. My wounds are open before You, my sickness is present before You. You see how I have been wounded and weakened. Grant the medicine to heal me, give the remedy to cure me. Extinguish in me the flames of lust so that they do not burn any further. For You know the temptations I bear, You know the storms I suffer, You know the temptations I endure. Deliver my soul captive from Hell, deliver me from the deepest abyss. Do not let the grave be my end, do not deny me exit because the last day has come. Nothing remains for me but a tomb, nothing remains but burial. Spare me before I die, cleanse me before I leave this life. Release me before I die, the chains of my sins before I die, for You are my hope, You are my praise, You are my beauty, You are my sweetness. To You be laud and glory, to You be eternal gratitude from the saints through infinite centuries.

text: Exue me Domine veterem hominem cum actibus suis et indue me novum hominem qui secundum Deum creatus est in iustitia et sanctitate veritatis.
translation_en: Remove from me, Lord, the old man with his deeds and clothe me with a new man who is created according to God in righteousness and holiness of truth.

text: Aufer Domine a corde et corpore meo omnia superflua atque nociva et reple me septiformi gratia Spiritus Sancti.
translation_en: Lord, remove from my heart and body all that is excessive and harmful, and fill me with the sevenfold grace of the Holy Spirit.

text: Ut audiam vocem laudis tuae. 〈R. Et enarrem universa mirabilia tua.〉
translation_en: So that I may hear the sound of your praise. [Response] And declare all your wonders.

text: Domine dilexi decorem domus 〈tuae〉. 〈R. Et locum habitationis gloriae tuae.〉
translation_en: Lord, I love the beauty of your house. (Response) And the place of dwelling of your glory.

text: Ne perdas cum impiis Deus animam meam. 〈R. Et cum viris sanguinum vitam meam.〉
translation_en: Let not God lose my soul with the impious. (Response) And let my life's blood be with men of integrity.

text: Amplius lava me Domine ab iniustitia mea. 〈R.〉 Et a delicto meo 〈munda me〉.
translation_en: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, O Lord. (Response) And cleanse me from my sin.

text: Largire sensibus nostris omnipotens Pater ut sicut exterius abluuntur inquinamenta manuum nostrarum ita a te mundentur interius pollutiones mentium nostrarum et crescat in nobis augmentum sanctarum virtutum. Per Christum Dominum.
translation_en: Almighty Father, enlarge our senses, that as the impurities of our hands are washed off externally, so the inner pollutions of our minds may be cleansed by you, and the increase of holy virtues may grow in us. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Indue me Domine tunica iustitiae et innocentiae et da ut per me verba tua sancta resonantia plebs tua mentis auribus possit percipere et in ipsis et per ipsa ad vitae aeternae fructum gaudeat pervenire. Per Christum.
translation_en: Cloak me, Lord, with the robe of righteousness and innocence, and grant that through me your holy words may resound in the ears of your people, so that they can perceive them in their minds and through them and by them reach the fruit of eternal life. Through Christ.

text: Obumbra Domine caput meum umbraculo sanctae fidei et expelle a me nubila totius ignorantiae. Per Christum.
translation_en: Lord, cast my head into the shadow of holy faith and drive away from me the clouds of all ignorance. Through Christ.

text: Indue me Domine vestimento salutis et circumda lorica fortitudinis tuae.
translation_en: Cover me, Lord, with the garment of salvation, and protect me with your shield of strength.

text: Praecinge lumbos mentis meae clementissime Pater et vitia cordis mei circumcide. Per Christum.
translation_en: Gentle Father, adorn the loins of my mind and cut off the vices of my heart. Through Christ.

text: Accinge gladium tuum Domine super femur meum potentissime ut viriliter possim contra inimicos meos dimicare spe firma caritatis aeternae. Per Christum.
translation_en: Gird on your sword, Lord, upon my mighty thigh, that I may vigorously fight against my enemies. With firm hope of eternal charity. Through Christ.

text: Stolam innocentiae pone Domine super manum meam et appone iustitiam pro iniquitate mea. Per Christum.
translation_en: Place upon me, O Lord, the robe of innocence and lay justice over my sinfulness. Through Christ.

text: Disrumpe Domine vincula omnium peccatorum meorum ut iugo tuae servitutis innexus valeam tibi cum timore et reverentia famulari.
translation_en: Break, Lord, the bonds of all my sins, that bound to your service I may serve you with fear and reverence.

text: O Crux admirabilis evacuatio vulneris restitutio sanitatis: miserere mei per signum sanctae Crucis et libera me Deus meus.
translation_en: O wonderful cross, healing of wounds, restoration of health: have mercy on me through the sign of the holy cross and free me, my God.

text: Invectione istarum cirothecarum subvenire te deprecor ut sic operer in temporali conversatione quatenus exemplo priorum patrum imbutus in futuro merear perenniter gaudere. Per Christum.
translation_en: I humbly implore you to assist these church-adorning (cirothecarum) individuals, so that through their examples, as inspired by the earlier fathers, they may deserve eternal joy in future temporal conversations. Through Christ.

text: Anulum Domine tuae subarrationis infer digito meo pro signaculo tuae sanctissimae defensionis. Per Christum.
translation_en: Lord, place your ring upon my finger as a symbol of your highest defense. Through Christ.

text: Domine Deus indue me quaeso vestimento salutis et indumento iustitiae atque laetitiae sempiternae circumda me semper.
translation_en: Lord God, clothe me I beseech you with the garment of salvation, and with the robe of righteousness and eternal joy, surround me always.

text: Indue me Domine vestimento humilitatis et caritatis et da mihi protectionem contra hostem insidiatorem ut valeam mundo corde et corpore laudare nomen sanctum tuum in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Cloak me, Lord, with the garment of humility and charity, and grant me protection against the cunning enemy, that I may be able to praise your holy name with a pure heart and body forever and ever.

text: Pone Domine galeam salutis in capite meo ad superandas et expugnandas omnes diabolicas catervas.
translation_en: Place, Lord, the helmet of salvation on my head, to overcome and conquer all diabolical hordes.

text: Da Domine baculum iustitiae virgam directionis virgam regni tui ut te feriente quos debeo feriam et te parcente quibus convenit parcam. Per Christum.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, a rod of justice, a scepter of guidance, a scepter of your kingdom, so that with you leading I may strike those I should and spare those whom it is fitting to spare. Through Christ.

text: Vias tuas Domine demonstra mihi. 〈R.〉 Et semitas tuas 〈edoce〉.
translation_en: Show me your ways, Lord. (Response) And teach me your paths.

text: Deduc me Domine in via 〈tua〉. 〈R.〉 Et ingrediar in veritate tua.
translation_en: Lead me, O Lord, in your way. (Response.) And I shall enter into your truth.

text: Et introibo ad altare Dei ad eum qui laetificat iuventutem meam.
translation_en: And I will go to the altar of God, to him who rejoices my youth.

text: Iudica me Deus et discerne causam meam de gente non sancta 〈ab homine iniquo et doloso erue me.〉
translation_en: Judge me, God, and distinguish my cause from an unholy people; Deliver me from a wicked and deceitful man.

text: Confitemini Domino quoniam bonus. 〈R. Quoniam in saeculum misericordia eius.〉
translation_en: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. (Response) For his mercy endures forever.

text: Ego reus et indignus confiteor Deo omnipotenti et sanctae Mariae et omnibus sanctis eius et tibi pater vel frater quia peccavi nimis in vita mea in cogitatione in locutione in superbia in gula in ebrietate in detractione in vana gloria in pollutione mentis et corporis et in quinque sensibus meis videlicet visu auditu gustu odoratu et tactu et in omnibus octo vitiis principalibus quibuscumque humana fragilitas contaminari ac sordidari pollui vel peccare potest. Propterea deprecor beatam Dei Genitricem Mariam et omnes sanctos et electos Dei et te patrem vel fratrem ut ores pro me misero peccatore ad Dominum Deum Patrem omnipotentem.
translation_en: I confess to the Almighty God and to the blessed Virgin Mary, all the saints, and to you, father or brother, that I have greatly sinned in my life, in thought, in speech, in pride, in gluttony, in drunkenness, in slander, in vain glory, in defilement of mind and body, and in the five senses, namely sight, hearing, taste, smell, touch, and in all eight principal vices, by which human frailty can be contaminated, soiled, polluted, or sinned. Therefore I beseech the blessed Mother of God, all the saints and elect of God, and you, father or brother, to pray for me, a miserable sinner, to the Lord, the Almighty God.

text: Misereatur tui omnipotens Deus et dimittat tibi omnia peccata tua praeterita praesentia liberet te Deus ab omni malo conservet et confirmet te in omni opere bono et perducat te Iesus Christus cum gaudio in vitam aeternam.
translation_en: May Almighty God have mercy on you, and forgive you all your sins, past and present. May God free you from all evil, preserve and strengthen you in every good work, and may Jesus Christ lead you to eternal life with joy.

text: Indulgentiam absolutionem et remissionem omnium peccatorum et spatium verae paenitentiae et emendationem vitae tribuat tibi omnipotens pius et misericors Dominus.
translation_en: May the Almighty, gracious and merciful Lord grant you indulgence, absolution, remission of all sins, space for true penitence, and amendment of life.

text: Delictum meum cognitum tibi feci. 〈R.〉 Et iniustitiam meam non 〈abscondi〉.
translation_en: My known sin I have made known to you. (Response) And my unrighteousness I have not hidden.

text: Dixi: Confitebor adversum me iniustitiam 〈meam Domino〉. 〈R.〉 Et tu remisisti impietatem 〈peccati mei〉.
translation_en: I said: I will confess my injustice to the Lord. (Responsorial Psalm) And you have forgiven my lawlessness.

text: Pro hac orabit ad te omnis sanctus. 〈R.〉 In tempore opportuno.
translation_en: For this, all saints will pray to you at an appropriate time. (Response): In a suitable moment.

text: Sacerdotes tui induantur iustitia. 〈R.〉 Et sancti tui exsultent.
translation_en: Your priests be clothed with justice. (Response) And let your saints rejoice.

text: Aufer a nobis quaesumus Domine iniquitates nostras ut ad sancta sanctorum puris mentibus mereamur introire. Salvator mundi qui cum Patre et Spiritu Sancto vivis et regnas.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to lift from us our iniquities that with pure minds we may worthy be to enter the holy of holies. Savior of the world who lives with the Father and the Holy Spirit.

text: Adiutorium nostrum in nomine Domini. 〈R.〉 Qui fecit caelum et terram.
translation_en: Our help is in the name of the Lord. (Response) Who made heaven and earth.

text: Domine exaudi orationem 〈meam〉. 〈R. Et clamor meus ad te veniat.〉
translation_en: Lord, hear my prayer. And let my cry come unto thee.

text: Deus propitius esto mihi peccatori quia tu es immortalis et sine peccato solus; tu Domine Deus indulge mihi famulo tuo indigno et peccatori quia peccator sum et indignus qui praesumo ad sanctum altare tuum accedere et invocare te quia peccavi coram te et coram angelis tuis sed tribue mihi indulgentiam omnium peccatorum meorum et confirma me in sancta Ecclesia tua in fide orthodoxorum et doce me facere voluntatem tuam omnibus diebus vitae meae. Qui vivis et regnas Deus.
translation_en: May God be merciful to me, a sinner, for you are immortal and without sin; you, Lord God, have mercy on me, your unworthy servant and sinner, for I am a sinner and unworthy who presume to approach your holy altar and invoke you, for I have sinned before you and before your angels. But grant me forgiveness for all my sins and strengthen me in your holy Church, in the faith of the orthodox, and teach me to do your will all the days of my life. Who lives and reigns, God.

text: Veni Sancte Spiritus reple tuorum corda fidelium
translation_en: Come Holy Spirit, fill the hearts of faithful ones

text: Emitte Spiritum tuum et creabuntur.
translation_en: Send forth your Spirit, and they shall be created.

text: Deus qui corda fidelium Sancti Spiritus illustratione docuisti.
translation_en: God, who enlightened the hearts of faithful ones by the guidance of the Holy Spirit.

text: Osculato sacro altare divina inspiratione corda nostra Dominus dignetur implere. Per Christum.
translation_en: May our hearts, moved by divine inspiration, be worthy to be filled by the Lord at the sacred altar. Through Christ.

text: Domine labia mea aperies. 〈R.〉 Et os meus annuntiabit laudem tuam.
translation_en: Lord, You will open my lips. (Response) And my mouth will declare Your praise.

text: Incensum istud dignetur Dominus benedicere et accipere in odorem suavitatis. Per Christum.
translation_en: May this incense be worthy for the Lord to bless and receive, in the sweetness of its fragrance. Through Christ.

text: Per intercessionem sancti Gabrielis archangeli stantis a dextris 〈altaris〉 incensi et omnium electorum suorum incensum istud Dominus benedicere dignetur et in odorem suavitatis accipere.
translation_en: May the Lord, through the intercession of St. Gabriel the Archangel standing on the right side of the altar and incensed, deign to bless this incense of all his elect and accept it into a fragrant smell.

text: Accendat in nobis Dominus ignem sui amoris et flammam aeternae dilectionis.
translation_en: May the Lord kindle in us His love's fire, and the flame of eternal love.

text: Pax Christi quam nobis per evangelium suum tradidit conservet et confirmet corda et corpora nostra nunc et in vitam aeternam.
translation_en: May the peace of Christ, which He has given us through His Gospel, preserve and strengthen our hearts and bodies now and forevermore.

text: Descendat quaesumus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus Spiritus Sanctus super hoc altare qui et populi tui dona sanctificet et sumentium corda purificet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, holy Father, almighty God, that the Holy Spirit descend upon this altar, who also consecrates your people and purifies the hearts of those partaking.

text: Dirigatur oratio mea sicut incensum in conspectu tuo. 〈R. Elevatio manuum mearum sacrificium vespertinum.〉
translation_en: Direct my prayer as incense in your sight. [Response] Lift up my hands as the evening sacrifice.

text: Omnis terra adoret te Deus et psallat tibi. 〈R. Psalmum dicat nomini tuo Domine.〉
translation_en: All the earth shall worship you, God, and sing to you. [Responsorial Psalm should be sung to your name, Lord.]

text: Odorem caelestis inspirationis suae accendat Dominus et impleat corda nostra ad audienda evangelii sui praecepta.
translation_en: May the Lord enkindle in us the fragrance of his heavenly inspiration and fill our hearts to hear the commandments of his Gospel.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus Abraham Deus Isaac Deus Iacob immitte in hanc creaturam incensi odoris tui virtutem ut sit servis tuis vel ancillis tuis munimentum tutela defensionis nec hostis intret in viscera eorum aditumque et sedem habere non possit. Per te Christe.
translation_en: We entreat you, almighty God, Abraham's God, Isaac's God, Jacob's God, send upon this creature of your incense-like scent the power of your protection, so that it may be a shield and defense for your servants or maidservants, that no enemy enters their innermost parts, nor may find an entrance or dwelling place. Through you, Christ.

text: Deus qui Moysi famulo tuo per Spiritum Sanctum revelare dignatus es quae ad cultum sanctuarii necessaria decrevisti ex quibus thymiama boni odoris ad opus Ecclesiae tuae ob causam religionis iugiter permanere iussisti ut mystica nobis significatione spiritualium virtutum flagrans ostenderet suavitatem odoris: tu ergo quaesumus omnipotens Deus immensae maiestatis tuae dextera hanc creaturam incensi benedicere ex diversarum rerum commixtione confectam dignare ut virtute sancti nominis tui omnes immundorum spirituum phantasmaticos incursus effugare omnesque morbos reddita sanitate expellere ubique fumus aromatum eius efflaverit mirabiliter possit atque in odore flagrantissimo tibi Domino perpetua redoleat suavitate. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: God, who deigned to reveal to Your servant Moses what You had decreed necessary for the service of the sanctuary, including the incense of good odor for the work of Your Church, which You commanded to perpetually remain - that it might show the mystical significance of spiritual virtues burning with sweetness: we therefore beseech You, Almighty God, of immeasurable majesty, that You bless this creature made from a mixture of diverse things, so that it may drive away all incursions of unclean spirits through the power of Your holy name, and expel all diseases with health wherever the fragrance of its aroma is wafted. May it marvelously fill the air and perpetually emit a most fragrant odor to You, Lord. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens cui astat exercitus angelorum: dignare respicere et benedicere hanc creaturam incensi ut omnes languorum daemonumque insidiae odorem ipsius sentientes fugiant et separentur a blasphemate tuo quod Filii tui pretioso sanguine redemisti ut numquam laedatur a morsu serpentis antiqui. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty to whom the host of angels stand: deign to look upon and bless this incensed creature, so that all the stench of tongues and demons may flee, sensing its smell, and be separated from your blasphemy. For Your Sons were redeemed by their precious blood, lest they ever be harmed by the bite of the ancient serpent. Through the Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui me peccatorem et indignissimum sanctis altaribus tuis astare voluisti et sancti nominis tui laudare potentiam: concede quaeso per tuam magnam misericordiam mihi veniam omnium peccatorum meorum ut mundo corde et corpore et omnibus sensibus meis per tuam gratiam purificatis tuae sanctae maiestati digne ministrare merear.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who willed that I, a sinner and unworthy one, should stand before your holy altars to praise the power of your holy name: grant me, I beg you, through your great mercy, forgiveness for all my sins, so that with a pure heart, body, and all my senses, I may be worthy through your grace to serve your sacred majesty fittingly.

text: Oramus ergo te Domine ut per merita omnium sanctorum tuorum et quorum reliquiae hic sunt ut eorum intercessionibus omnipotens Deus indulgere digneris omnia peccata mea. Per Christum.
translation_en: Therefore we ask you, Lord, that through the merits of all your saints whose relics are here, you may deign to grant through their intercessions that Almighty God will forgive all my sins. Through Christ.

text: sancta Trinitas et indivisa unitas Pater et Filius et Spiritus Sanctus unus omnipotens omnium creator hominum et Dominus qui fecisti caelum et terram mare et omnia quae in eis sunt in cuius manu ac potestate cuncta consistunt: in tuam sanctissimam ac singularem custodiam commendo animam meam et corpus meum et cogitationes et omnes sensus et actus meos ut me a malignis spiritibus et immundis ac pravis et vanis cogitationibus semper potenter eripias emundes et defendas ab omnibus meis peccatis et iniquitatibus misericorditer me purifices et ab omnibus invisibilibus inimicis et periculis in tua virtute permittas neque hic neque in futuro sed misericordiam tuam magnam et sempiternam gratiam in omni loco et in omni tempore adesse mihi clementer et dignanter concedas. Qui vivis.
translation_en: Holy Trinity and indivisible unity, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, one almighty creator of all mankind and Lord who made heaven and earth, sea and all that is in them, in whose hand and power all things consist: into your most holy and singular protection I commend my soul and body, thoughts and all my senses and actions, so that you always powerfully free me from evil spirits, unclean and wicked thoughts, and vanities. Cleanse and defend me from all my sins and iniquities, mercifully purify me, and allow me to be safe from all invisible enemies and perils through your power, neither here nor in the future. Grant me your great and eternal mercy in every place and at every time, that you may appear graciously and worthy to me. Who lives.

text: Conforta me rex sanctorum summum tenens principatum et da sermonem rectum et bene sonantem in os meum ad pronuntiandum sanctum evangelium tuum pacis.
translation_en: Strengthen me, King of the saints, holding the highest principality, and give a right and well-sounding word to my mouth for proclaiming your holy gospel of peace.

text: Altaria tua Domine virtutum rex meus et Deus meus. 〈R.〉 Beati qui habitant in domo tua Domine in saecula saeculorum laudabunt te.
translation_en: Your altars, Lord, my King of virtues and my God. [Response.] Blessed are those who dwell in your house, Lord, forever and ever, they will praise you.

text: Dominus sit in corde tuo et in labiis tuis ut competenter pronunties sanctum evangelium pacis.
translation_en: May the Lord be in your heart and on your lips, that you may proclaim the holy gospel of peace correctly.

text: Per istos sermones sancti evangelii Filii sui Domini nostri Iesu Christi indulgeat nobis Dominus universa delicta nostra concedat nobis implere sua praecepta.
translation_en: May the Lord through these discourses of the holy Gospel of His Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, forgive us all our sins, and grant us the ability to fulfill His commandments.

text: Ex latere Domini exivit sanguis et aqua sic et nos haec pariter commiscentes passionis eiusdem obtineamus salutem. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: From the side of the Lord came forth blood and water; and we, mixing these together in His same passion, obtain salvation. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Deus qui humanae substantiae dignitatem mirabiliter condidisti et mirabilius reformasti: da nobis quaesumus per huius aquae et vini mysterium Christi Filii tui esse consortes qui humanitatis nostrae fieri dignatus est particeps.
translation_en: God, who wonderfully created the dignity of the human substance and wonderfully reformed it: grant us, we ask, through the mystery of this water and wine, to be consorts of Christ Your Son, who was pleased to become a participant in our humanity.

text: In nomine Domini nostri Iesu sit signatum ordinatum et sanctificatum hoc sacrificium.
translation_en: May this sacrifice be signed, ordained, and sanctified in the name of our Lord Jesus.

text: Peto Domine immensam clementiam tuam ut descendat super panem et calicem plenitudo divinitatis tuae.
translation_en: I ask, Lord, for your immense mercy to descend upon bread and cup, the fullness of your divinity.

text: Descendat quaesumus Domine illa Spiritus Sancti tui invisibilis et incomprehensibilis maiestas sicut quondam in patrum hostias descendebat qui oblationes nostras corpus et sanguinem tuum efficiat et me indignum sacerdotem doceat tantum mysterium tractare cum cordis puritate cum lacrimarum fonte cum reverentia et tremore ita ut placide et benigne suscipias hoc sacrificium de manibus meis ad salutem vivorum et mortuorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that Your invisible and incomprehensible majesty of the Holy Spirit descend as it once did upon the offerings of the fathers, and may it transform our offerings into Your body and blood. Teach me, this unworthy priest, to handle such a great mystery with a pure heart, a source of tears, reverence, and trembling, so that You may graciously accept this sacrifice from my hands, for the health of the living and the dead.

text: Rogo etiam per idipsum sacrosanctum et vivificum mysterium corporis et sanguinis tui quo cottidie in Ecclesia tua pascimur et potamur abluimur et sanctificamur atque unius et summae divinitatis participes efficimur da virtutes sanctas quibus repletus bona conscientia altari tuo assistam ut haec caelestia sacramenta mihi efficiantur vita et salus. Per Christum.
translation_en: I also beseech you through the same sacred and life-giving mystery of your body and blood, by which we are daily nourished and refreshed in your Church, washed and sanctified, made partakers of one and the same divinity, that I may be endowed with holy virtues, filled with good conscience, I may assist at your altar. May these heavenly sacraments become life and salvation for me. Through Christ.

text: Suscipe sancta Trinitas hanc oblationem quam tibi offert famulus tuus et praesta ut in conspectum tuum placens ascendat. Per Christum.
translation_en: Receive, Holy Trinity, this offering which your servant presents to you, and grant that it may ascend pleasingly before you. Through Christ.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine hanc oblationem ut nobis Unigeniti tui corpus fiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that You sanctify this offering, so that the body of Your Unigenitus becomes ours.

text: Acceptum sit omnipotenti Deo sacrificium istud altari suo superpositum. Per Christum.
translation_en: May this offering be accepted by Almighty God upon His altar. Through Christ.

text: In nomine Domini nostri Iesu Christi sit signatum sacrificium istud immaculatum et a te Deo vivo et vero adunatum et benedictum.
translation_en: May this immaculate sacrifice be signed in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, and may it be brought to you, the living and true God, and blessed by you.

text: In spiritu humilitatis et in animo contrito suscipiamur Domine a te et sic fiat sacrificium nostrum ut a te suscipiatur hodie et placeat tibi Domine Deus.
translation_en: Receive us, Lord, with a humble spirit and a contrite heart. Let our sacrifice be accepted by You today, and may it please You, Lord God.

text: Suscipe clementissime Deus hoc sacrificium in conspectum tuum cum odore suavitatis ascendat.
translation_en: Receive most graciously, O God, this sacrifice in your sight as it rises with the scent of sweetness.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostiam placationis et laudis quam tibi offero ego indignus famulus tuus et me peccatorem indulgentiam quaerentem placatus suscipe. Per Christum.
translation_en: Receive most merciful Father, the offering of propitiation and praise which I, your unworthy servant, offer to You. I am a sinner seeking mercy; receive me, pleased through Christ.

text: Veni sanctificator omnipotens aeterne Deus et benedic hoc praesens sacrificium ab indignis manibus praeparatum et descende in hanc hostiam invisibiliter sicut in patrum hostias visibiliter descendisti. Per Christum.
translation_en: Come, holy creator of all-powerful and eternal God, and bless this present sacrifice prepared by unworthy hands, and descend upon this offering invisibly as you did visibly on the offerings of your fathers. Through Christ.

text: Suscipe sancta Trinitas hanc oblationem quam tibi offero (offerimus) in memoriam incarnationis apparitionis passionis resurrectionis et ascensionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi et in honore beatae Mariae semper Virginis et quorum reliquiae hic continentur vel quorum festivitas hodie celebratur et omnium sanctorum tuorum qui tibi placuerunt ab initio mundi ut illis omnibus sit ad honorem nobis autem ad salutem et ut illi omnes pro nobis intercedere dignentur in caelis quorum memoriam facimus in terris.
translation_en: Receive, Holy Trinity, this offering which I present (we present) to you in memory of the incarnation, appearance, passion, resurrection, and ascension of our Lord Jesus Christ, and in honor of the blessed Mary, ever Virgin, and of whose relics are contained here or whose feast is celebrated today, and of all your saints who have pleased you from the beginning of the world. May they be to the honor of all, and to us the salvation, and may they all intercede for us in heaven whose memory we make on earth.

text: Suscipe sancta Trinitas hanc oblationem quam tibi offero pro anima famuli tui N. et pro animabus famulorum famularum tuarum N. ut requiem aeternam dones eis inter sanctos et electos tuos quatenus illorum consortio vita fruantur aeterna.
translation_en: Receive, Holy Trinity, this offering that I present to you for the soul of your servant N. and for the souls of the servants and handmaids of yours, N. So that you give them eternal rest among the saints and elect ones of yours, that they may enjoy eternal life with their company.

text: Orate fratres pro me misero peccatore ut meum et vestrum sacrificium acceptum sit Deo omnipotenti ante sanctum conspectum suum. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Brothers, pray for me, a miserable sinner, that my and your sacrifice may be acceptable to the almighty God before his holy sight. Through the Lord.

text: Orent pro te omnes sancti et electi Dei.
translation_en: All saints and chosen of God pray for you.

text: Mittat tibi auxilium de sancto. 〈R. Et de Sion tueatur te.〉
translation_en: Send help to you from the saint. (Response) And from Zion may they destroy you.

text: Memor sit omnis sacrificii tui et holocaustum. 〈R. Et holocaustum tuum pingue fiat.〉
translation_en: May all your sacrifices and holocausts be remembered. (Response) And may your holocaust become fat.

text: Tribuat tibi Dominus secundum cor tuum. 〈R. Et omne consilium tuum confirmet.〉
translation_en: May the Lord grant you according to your heart. [Response] And may all your counsel be confirmed.

text: Exaudiat te Dominus pro nobis orantem et deprecantem.
translation_en: May the Lord hear us while we pray and ask on your behalf.

text: Suscipe sancte Trinitas hanc oblationem quam ego indignus famulus tuus offero tibi Deo meo vivo et vero pro innumerabilibus peccatis offensionibus et negligentiis meis et pro omnibus Christianis fidelibus vivis ac defunctis ut mihi et illis proficiat ad salutem in vitam aeternam.
translation_en: Accept, Holy Trinity, this offering which I, an unworthy servant, present to You, my God, living and true, on behalf of countless sins, offenses, and negligences of mine, and on behalf of all living and deceased Christian faithful, that it may bring us and them salvation to eternal life.

text: In spiritu humilitatis et in animo contrito suscipiamur Domine a te et sic fiat sacrificium nostrum ut a te suscipiatur hodie et placeamus tibi Domine Deus.
translation_en: Receive us, Lord, with a humble spirit and a contrite heart. Let our sacrifice be acceptable to you today, O Lord God.

text: Orate fratres ut meum ac vestrum sacrificium acceptabile fiat apud Deum.
translation_en: Pray, brothers, that my and your sacrifice becomes acceptable before God.

text: Suscipiat Dominus sacrificium de manibus tuis ad gloriam et honorem nominis sui ad utilitatem quoque nostram totiusque Ecclesiae sanctae suae.
translation_en: May the Lord accept your offering to His glory and honor, as well as for our benefit and that of the whole holy Church of Him.

text: VD et iustum est aequum et salutare nos tibi semper et ubique gratias agere Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus per Christum Dominum nostrum. Per quem maiestatem tuam laudant angeli adorant dominationes tremunt potestates. Caeli caelorumque virtutes ac beata Seraphim socia exsultatione concelebrant. Cum quibus et nostras voces ut admitti iubeas deprecamur supplici confessione dicentes:
translation_en: And it is right and just, and salutary for us to praise you always and everywhere, Lord holy Father almighty eternal God, through Christ our Lord. Through whom your majesty is lauded by angels, adored by dominations, trembles by powers, rejoices by virtues of the heavens and other heavens, and blessed Seraphim together with exultation celebrate. With them and our voices, we humbly beseech you to grant that we may be admitted, confessing in supplicating prayer:

text: Sanctus sanctus sanctus. Dominus Deus Sabaoth pleni sunt caeli et terra gloria tua hosanna in excelsis. Benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini hosanna in excelsis.
translation_en: Holy, holy, holy. Lord God of hosts, heaven and earth are full of your glory; Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

text: Omne gaudium existimate fratres mei cum in tentationes varias incideritis scientes quod probatio fidei vestrae patientiam operatur. Patientia autem opus perfectum habeat ut sitis perfecti et integri in nullo deficientes. Si quis autem vestrum indiget sapientia postulet a Deo qui dat omnibus affluenter et non improperat sed dabitur ei. Postulet autem in fide nihil haesitans. Qui autem haesitat similis est fluctui maris qui a vento movetur et circumfertur. Non ergo existimet homo ille quod accipiat aliquid a Domino. Vir duplex animo inconstans est in omnibus viis suis. Glorietur autem frater humilis in exaltatione sua dives autem in humilitate sua quoniam sicut flos feni transibit. Exortus est enim sol cum ardore et arefecit fenum et flos eius decidit et decor vultus eius deperiit ita et dives in itineribus suis marcescet. Beatus vir qui suffert tentationem quia cum probatus fuerit accipiet coronam vitae quam repromisit Deus diligentibus se. In Christo Iesu Domino nostro.
translation_en: Consider all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various trials, knowing that the testing of your faith produces patience. But let patience be complete, so that you may be perfect and lacking in nothing. If any among you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and He will give him what he needs. He must ask in faith without wavering. The one who wavers is like the sea driven by the wind and tossed. Therefore, that man should not think that he will receive something from the Lord. A double-minded man is unstable in all his ways. Let the humble brother rejoice in his exaltation, and let the rich man rejoice in his humiliation, for just as the flower of grass withers, so the rich man will fade away on his journey. Blessed is the man who endures temptation, because when he has been tested, he will receive a crown of life which God promised to those who love Him. In Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: Dixit Iesus discipulis suis. Ego sum vitis vera et Pater meus agricola est. Omnem palmitem in me non ferentem fructum tollet eum et omnem qui fert fructum purgabit eum ut fructum plus afferat. Iam vos mundi estis propter sermonem quem locutus sum vobis. Manete in me et ego in vobis. Sicut palmes non potest ferre fructum a semet ipso nisi manserit in vite sic nec vos nisi in me manseritis. Ego sum vitis vos palmites. Qui manet in me et ego in eo hic fert fructum multum quia sine me nihil potestis facere. Si quis in me non manserit mittetur foras sicut palmes et arescet et colligent eum et in ignem mittent et ardet. Si manseritis in me et verba mea in vobis manserint quodcumque volueritis petetis et fiet vobis.
translation_en: Jesus spoke to his disciples. I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener. Every branch in me that does not bear fruit he will take away; and every one that does bear fruit he will cleanse, so that it may bear more fruit. You are already pruned because of the word that I have spoken to you. Remain in me, and I in you. As branches cannot bear fruit by themselves unless they remain in the vine, neither can you unless you remain in me. I am the vine, you are the branches. Whoever remains in me and I in him will bear much fruit, because without me you can do nothing. He who does not remain in me is thrown away like a branch and withers; and they gather it up and throw it into the fire, and it burns. If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, whatever you ask for, that will be done to you.

text: Te igitur clementissime Pater per Iesum Christum Filium tuum Dominum nostrum supplices rogamus et petimus uti accepta habeas et benedicas haec dona haec munera haec sancta sacrificia illibata. In primis quae tibi offerimus pro Ecclesia tua sancta catholica quam pacificare custodire adunare et regere digneris toto orbe terrarum una cum famulo tuo papa nostro N. et antistite nostro N. et rege nostro N. et omnibus orthodoxis atque catholicae et apostolicae fidei cultoribus.
translation_en: Therefore, most kind Father, through Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, we humbly ask and petition you to accept and bless these gifts, these offerings, these holy sacrifices, which are undefiled. First of all, those that we present to You for Your Holy Catholic Church, which You deign to pacify, protect, unite, and govern throughout the entire world, along with our servant, Pope N., our bishop N., our king N., and all the Orthodox and Catholics who cultivate the apostolic faith.

text: Memento Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum 〈...〉 N. et omnium circumastantium quorum tibi fides cognita est et nota devotio pro quibus tibi offerimus vel qui tibi offerunt hoc sacrificium laudis pro se suisque omnibus pro redemptione animarum suarum pro spe salutis et incolumitatis suae tibique reddunt vota sua aeterno Deo vivo et vero.
translation_en: Remember, Lord, your servants and the servants of your servants; N. and all those standing around whose faith is known to you and devotion is well-known to you, for whom we offer this sacrifice of praise on their behalf or who offer it themselves, for the redemption of their souls, for hope of salvation and incolumity, and they render their vows to the eternal living and true God on their behalf.

text: Aperi quaeso Domine os meum ad benedicendum nomen tuum munda cor meum ab omnibus variis et nequissimis cogitationibus ut a te merear exaudiri deprecans pro populo tuo quem elegisti tibi.
translation_en: I beseech you, Lord, open my mouth to bless your name. Cleanse my heart from all varied and most wicked thoughts, that I may deserve to be heard as I intercede for your people whom you have chosen.

text: Communicantes et memoriam venerantes in primis gloriosae semper Virginis Mariae Genitricis Dei et Domini nostri Iesu Christi sed et beatorum apostolorum ac martyrum tuorum Petri Pauli Andreae Iacobi Ioannis Thomae Iacobi Philippi Bartholomaei Matthaei Simonis et Thaddaei Lini Cleti Clementis Sixti Cornelii Cypriani Laurentii Chrysogoni Ioannis et Pauli Cosmae et Damiani et omnium sanctorum tuorum quorum meritis precibusque concedas ut in omnibus protectionis tuae semper muniamur auxilio. Per eundem Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Communicating and venerating the memory first of all the glorious ever-Virgin Mary, Mother of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, as well as of the blessed apostles and martyrs among yours, Peter, Paul, Andrew, James, John, Thomas, James, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Simon, Jude Thaddaeus, Linus, Cletus, Clement, Sixtus, Cornelius, Cyprian, Lawrence, Chrysogonus, John and Paul, Cosmas and Damian, and all your saints, whose merits and prayers grant that we may always be fortified with the help of your protection. Through the same Christ our Lord.
