And someone standing there said to them: "What are you doing untying the colt?" To which they replied as Jesus had commanded them, and they let him go. And they brought the colt to Jesus and laid their garments on it, and he sat upon it. Many spread their garments in the way, others cut branches from trees and scattered them in the way. And those who went before and those who followed cried out saying: "Hosanna to the Son of David, blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord."

text: Ante sex dies sollemnis Paschae
translation_en: Six days before the solemn Easter

text: Exorcizo te omnis creatura olivarum et frondium in nomine Dei Patris omnipotentis et in nomine Iesu Christi Filii eius Domini nostri et in virtute Spiritus Sancti; omnis virtus adversarii omnisque exercitus diaboli et omnis spiritus inimici omnisque incursio daemonum: eradicare et explantare ab hac creatura florum; ut hanc gerentes et ad Dei gratiam festinantes non inquietare vel illudere praesumas interdico tibi.
translation_en: I exorcise you, every creature of olive trees and leaves, in the name of God the Almighty Father and in the name of Jesus Christ, His Son our Lord, and by the power of the Holy Spirit; every power of the adversary, every army of the devil, every hostile spirit, every incursion of demons: I command you to be uprooted and expelled from this creature of flowers; that those bearing it and hastening towards God's grace presume not to disturb or mock you, I forbid you.

text: Benedic Domine quaesumus hos palmarum et olivarum ramos et praesta ut quod populus tuus pia veneratione hodierna die corporaliter agit hoc spiritualiter summa devotione perficiat de hoste victoriam reportando et opus misericordiae summo opere diligendo; humiliter etiam deprecamur ut praedictarum arborum germina ita sanctificare digneris ut loca ad quae deportata fuerint sanctificata efficiantur quo iniquitas omnis seu illusio daemonum abscedat et tua nos semper dextera protegere dignetur. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, we ask you, these branches of palms and olives, and grant that what your people today physically performs with pious veneration on this day, may it be spiritually accomplished with the utmost devotion for victory over the enemy; humbly we also pray that the seeds of the aforementioned trees may be so sanctified that the places to which they are taken become sanctified, so that all iniquity or demonic illusion departs and your always right hand protects us. Through the Lord.

text: Cum audisset populus quia Iesus venit Hierosolymam
translation_en: When the people heard that Jesus went to Jerusalem

text: Deus cuius Filius pro salute generis humani de caelis descendit ad terras et appropinquante passionis suae hora Hierosolymam in asino sedens venire et a turbis rex appellari ac laudari voluit: benedicere dignare hos palmarum ceterarumque frondium ramos ut omnes qui eos laturi sunt ita benedictionis tuae dono repleantur quatenus in hoc saeculo cum palma victoriae et fructu bonorum operum tibi valeant apparere. Per Dominum.
translation_en: God, whose Son descended from heaven for the salvation of the human race and approached the hour of His passion in Jerusalem, sitting on an ass and wanting to be called King by the crowds and praised: deign to bless these branches of palm and other leaves, so that all who are about to receive them may be filled with Your blessing, to such an extent that in this world they may appear before You with a palm branch of victory and the fruit of good works. Through the Lord.

text: Deus qui per olivae ramum pacem terrae nuntiare iussisti: praesta quaesumus ut hos ramos palmarum vel aliarum arborum tua caelesti benedictione sanctifices ut cuncto populo proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: God, who by the olive branch announced peace to the earth: grant us, we ask, that these palm branches or other trees of yours may be sanctified with your heavenly blessing, so that all people may progress towards salvation through them.

text: Deus qui Filium tuum unigenitum pro redemptione nostri dignatus es dirigere ut populum tuum ab initio peccati profundo dimersum a morte revocares ad vitam et chirographo letali deleto sanguine Filii tui gentibus innovares regnum; Deus qui dispersa congregas et congregata conservas qui populis obviam Christo ramos palmarum portantibus benedixisti: benedic etiam et hos ramos palmae et olivae ceterarumque arborum quos tui famuli ad nominis tui benedictionem fideliter suscipiunt et in quocumque loco introducti fuerint benedictionem tuam consequantur ut omni adversa valetudine effugata dextera tua protegat quos redemit. Qui cum Patre et Spiritu Sancto vivis et gloriaris Deus.
translation_en: God, who deemed it fitting to direct your only-begotten Son for our redemption, that you might recall your people from the beginning of the deep pit of sin and death, and renew their kingdom through the erasure of the deadly charter by the blood of your Son among the nations; God, who gather the scattered and conserve the gathered, who have blessed the peoples with branches of palm as they approached Christ: bless also these branches of palm, olive, and other trees that your servants receive faithfully in your name's blessing, and wherever they are introduced, they will follow your blessing. So that, freed from every adversity of illness, your right hand may protect those whom you have redeemed. Who lives and glorifies with the Father and the Holy Spirit, God.

text: VD et iustum est aequum et salutare nos tibi semper et ubique gratias agere Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus. Mundi conditor omniumque creaturarum mirabilis dispositor; Deus qui inter ipsa mundi primordia cum ex nihilo cuncta conderes ligna quoque fructifera et diverso usui congrua terram producere iussisti ac 〈post〉 maledictum interdictae arboris universa nobis per oboedientiam Unigeniti Filii tui in benedictionem convertisti: benedic etiam et hos multigenarum arborum ramos inter quas praecipue arbor olivae pinguedine cuncta praecellit. Per quam etiam cum mundi crimina diluvio quondam expiarentur effuso columba ramum eiusdem deferens pacem terris redditam nuntiavit. Necnon et innocens turba Spiritu Sancto afflata Unigenito tuo Domino nostro Iesu Christo pro totius mundi salute passuro obviam currens palmarum et huius arboris ramos abscidens et vestigiis eius substernens iam quasi triumphatorem de mortis principe ostendebat. — Te igitur Domine suppliciter deprecamur ut qui annua devotione eiusdem Redemptoris nostri sacratissimam passionem praevenire nitimur ipso adiuvante palmam victoriae tenentes atque oleo misericordiae intrinsecus refulgentes in eius sancta resurrectione praemium vitae et immortalitatis coronam accipere mereamur. Per eundem Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum qui tecum vivit et regnat Deus per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en:
We give thanks to you, Lord, holy Father almighty, eternal God; Creator of the world and ruler of all creation. You who, among the first principles of the world, made fruit-bearing trees and lands suitable for various uses, and later converted the whole universe from the cursed tree by means of the obedience of your Only Begotten Son into a blessing: may you also bless these numerous trees, especially the olive tree, which surpasses all in richness. Through it, when the world's sins were once purified by the flood, a dove bearing a branch from the same tree announced peace returned to the earth. Also, an innocent crowd, filled with the Holy Spirit, running towards your Son Lord Jesus Christ for the salvation of the whole world, plucking branches and stepping in its footsteps, seemed already to be displaying the victor over the prince of death.
So, Lord, we humbly entreat you that, aided by the yearly devotion of our Redeemer, we may merit to receive the palm of victory and shine with the oil of mercy within his holy resurrection, a reward for life and immortality's crown. Through the same Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you God, forever and ever.

text: Benedictio Dei omnipotentis: Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti descendat et maneat super hos flores.
translation_en: The blessing of the Almighty God, Father and Son and Holy Spirit, may descend and remain upon these flowers.

text: Fulgentibus palmis prosternimus
translation_en: We bow down with radiant palms

text: Occurrunt turbae cum floribus et palmis Redemptori Domino.
translation_en: Crowds come with flowers and palms to the Redeemer Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Christi Filii tui passione nos reparas: conserva in nobis opera misericordiae tuae ut in huius celebritate mysterii devotione perpetua vivamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through the passion of your Son, Christ our Lord, repair us: preserve in us the works of your mercy so that we may live perpetually in the devotion of this mystery's celebration.

text: Cum appropinquaret Dominus Hierosolymam misit duos ex discipulis suis dicens
translation_en: When the Lord approached Jerusalem, He sent two of His disciples, saying

text: Gloria laus et honor tibi sit
translation_en: Glory, praise, and honor be to you

text: Pueri Hebraeorum tollentes ramos
translation_en: The boys of the Hebrews lifting branches

text: Pueri Hebraeorum vestimenta sua prosternebant
translation_en: The children of Hebrews laid their garments before them (as a sign of homage or reverence).

text: O Crux ave spes unica
translation_en: Hail, O Cross, our only hope

text: Te summa Deus Trinitas
translation_en: You are the supreme God Trinity

text: Scriptum est enim percutiam pastorem
translation_en: Indeed, it is written that you shall strike the shepherd

text: Hosanna Filio David benedictus
translation_en: Hosanna to the Son of David, blessed

text: Ingrediente Domino in sanctam civitatem
translation_en: The Lord enters into the holy city

text: Turba multa
translation_en: A large crowd

text: Largire sensibus nostris omnipotens Deus ut per temporalem Filii tui mortem quam mysteria veneranda testantur vitam nobis perpetuam dedisse confidamus. Per eundem.
translation_en: Graciously grant to our senses, Almighty God, that we may believe with reverent faith that through the temporal death of Your Son, which mysteries testify to, You have given us eternal life. Through Him.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine super hanc familiam tuam pro qua Dominus noster Iesus Christus non dubitavit manibus tradi nocentium et crucis subire tormentum.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we beseech You, on Your family for which our Lord Jesus Christ did not hesitate to deliver wicked men into the hands of their accusers and suffer the torment of the cross.

text: Convenientibus vobis in unum
translation_en: Coming together as one to you

text: Ante diem festum Paschae
translation_en: Before the day of Easter

text: Dominus vobiscum et Oremus.
translation_en: The Lord be with you, and let us pray.

text: Dextera Domini fecit virtutem.
translation_en: The right hand of the Lord has done valiantly.

text: In tribulatione invocavi Dominum.
translation_en: In tribulation, I have called upon the Lord.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes quo Dominus noster Iesus Christus pro nobis est traditus. Sed et memoriam venerantes.
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day on which our Lord Jesus Christ was delivered for us. But also remembering with reverence.

text: Qui pridie quam pateretur pro nostri salute omnium hoc est hodie accepit panem in sanctas ac venerabiles manus suas.
translation_en: Who on the day before He was to suffer for our salvation, took bread into His holy and revered hands, this is today that He received.

text: Dominus Iesus postquam cenavit
translation_en: The Lord Jesus, after dining

text: Calicem salutaris
translation_en: Chalice of salvation

text: Cum his qui oderunt
translation_en: With those who love

text: Ad Dominum cum tribularer
translation_en: When I cry out to the Lord

text: Ab hominibus iniquis
translation_en: From wicked men

text: Custodi me a laqueo
translation_en: Guard me from the snare

text: Domine clamavi
translation_en: Lord, I have called

text: Considerabam
translation_en: I was considering

text: Voce mea ad Dominum
translation_en: My voice to the Lord

text: Cenantibus autem
translation_en: While they were eating

text: In tribulatione sua mane consurgent ad me
translation_en: In their affliction, they shall rise up to me at dawn

text: Domine audivi
translation_en: Lord, I have heard

text: Dixit Dominus ad Moysen
translation_en: The Lord said to Moses

text: Egressus Iesus trans torrentem Cedron
translation_en: Jesus went over the brook Cedron

text: Partiti sunt vestimenta mea
translation_en: My clothing has been divided

text: Oremus. Flectamus genua.
translation_en: Let us pray. Bend the knee.

text: Oremus et pro beatissimo papa nostro N. ut Deus et Dominus noster qui elegit eum in ordinem episcopatus salvum atque incolumem custodiat Ecclesiae sanctae ad regendum populum sanctum Dei.
translation_en: Let us pray for our most blessed Pope N., that God and our Lord, who has chosen him for the order of episcopate, may keep him safe and healthy, so that he may rule the holy people of God in the Holy Church.

text: Levate. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum.
translation_en: Lift up. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Oremus et pro omnibus episcopis presbyteris diaconibus subdiaconibus acolythis exorcistis lectoribus ostiariis confessoribus virginibus viduis et pro omni populo sancto Dei.
translation_en: Let us pray for all bishops, priests, deacons, subdeacons, acolytes, exorcists, lectors, doorkeepers, confessors, virgins, widows and for the entire holy people of God.

text: Oremus et pro catechumenis nostris ut Deus et Dominus noster adaperiat aures praecordiorum ipsorum ianuam misericordiae ut per lavacrum regenerationis accepta remissione omnium peccatorum et ipsi inveniantur in Christo Iesu Domino nostro.
translation_en: Let us pray for our catechumens, that our God and Lord may open the ears of their hearts, the door of mercy, so that through the washing of regeneration they receive forgiveness of all sins and may be found in Christ Jesus, our Lord.

text: Oremus et pro haereticis et schismaticis ut Deus et Dominus noster eruat eos ab erroribus universis et ad sanctam matrem Ecclesiam catholicam atque apostolicam revocare dignetur.
translation_en: Let us pray for heretics and schismatics that God our Lord may deliver them from all errors and deem fit to recall them to the holy mother Church Catholic and Apostolic.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui etiam Iudaicam perfidiam a tua misericordia non repellis: exaudi preces nostras quas pro illius populi occaecatione deferimus ut agnita veritatis tuae luce quae Christus est a suis tenebris eruantur. Per eundem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who even does not reject the treacherous Jewish unfaithfulness from your mercy: hear our prayers which we bring on account of their people's blindness, that they may be freed from the darkness by recognizing the truth of yours, which is Christ. Through the same.

text: Oremus et pro paganis ut Deus omnipotens auferat iniquitatem a cordibus eorum et relictis idolis suis convertantur ad Dominum Deum vivum et verum et unicum Filium eius Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum cum quo vivit et regnat cum Spiritu Sancto.
translation_en: Let us pray for the pagans, that the Almighty God may remove iniquity from their hearts and, leaving behind their idols, they may convert to the Lord, the living and true God, and his only Son Jesus Christ our Lord, with whom he lives and reigns with the Holy Spirit.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui non vis mortem peccatorum sed vitam semper inquiris: suscipe propitius orationem nostram et libera eos ab idolorum cultura et aggrega Ecclesiae tuae sanctae ad laudem et gloriam nominis tui. Levate. Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who seeks not the death of sinners but their life: receive our prayer graciously and free them from the worship of idols, and gather them to your holy Church for the praise and glory of your name. Lift up. Our Lord.

text: Popule meus
translation_en: My people

text: Hagios ho Theos hagios ischyros
translation_en: Holy is the God, holy is the mighty

text: Sanctus Deus sanctus fortis sanctus et immortalis.
translation_en: Holy God, holy and mighty, holy and immortal.

text: Quia eduxi te
translation_en: Because I brought you out

text: Quid ultra debui
translation_en: What more was due?

text: Ecce lignum crucis
translation_en: Behold the wood of the cross

text: Beati immaculati
translation_en: Blessed are the pure ones

text: Domine Iesu Christe Deus verus de Deo vero qui pro redemptione generis humani serpentina suasione decepti mundum erroribus implicatum illuminare et Crucis patibulum subire voluisti ut et lignum ligno vinceres et peccati hereditariam mortem morte potentissima superares: exaudi me miserum et indignum prostratum ante oculos tuae benignissimae maiestatis et adorantem et benedicentem nomen tuum sanctum atque terribile et concede mihi te puro corde sapere te laudare te praedicare et per vexillum huius sanctae Crucis quam hodie in tuo nomine adoraturus adveni mentem meam corpusque meum sanctifica scuto fidei tuae nos circumtege galeam salutis mihi impone gladio spirituali accinge ut contra hostem nequissimum bellaturus et tuae muniar miserationis auxilio et salutiferae Crucis vexillo cunctique tuo sancto nomine insigniti ab hostis perfidi sint incursione securi. Per te Iesu Christe qui vivis et regnas Deus per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, true God from the true God, who for the redemption of the human race was deceived by a serpent's allure and brought the world entangled in errors, who willingly chose to bear the Cross's instrument to conquer with wood and overcome the powerful death born of sin: hear me, wretched and unworthy, prostrate before your most benevolent majesty, and adoring and blessing your holy and fearsome name. Grant that I may know you with a pure heart, praise you, preach you, and by the banner of this holy Cross, which today is being adored in your name, bring my mind and body to holiness. Encircle me with the shield of your faith; place upon me an helmet of salvation; arm me with a spiritual sword; prepare me for battle against the most wicked enemy. Defend me by your merciful aid and under the standard of the saving Cross and in all your holy name, may I be secure from the attack of the treacherous foe. Through you, Jesus Christ, who live and reign forever as God, amen.

text: Deus qui Moysi famulo tuo squalentis eremi serpentem aeneum in media populi multitudine ad liberandas letali viro infectas animas exaltari iussisti ut si quis mortifero vulnere inflictus ad eum respiceret et venenum exitiale evaderet et optatae salutis vitam adipisceretur significans teipsum futura longe post curricula pro tui salute plasmatis Crucis extollendum patibulo ut quos diabolus armis invidiae captivaverat tua desiderabilis passio ad patriam revocaret: concede tam mihi misero peccatori quam omnibus tuo cruore mercatis qui hodie sanctam passionem tuam supplices venerantur lignumque vitae adorant ut diabolicas insidias te adiuvante vincamus et aeternae vitae participes esse mereamur. Qui tecum.
translation_en: God, who commanded Moses your servant to lift up the bronze serpent in the midst of the crowd's multitude for liberating souls infected with deadly venom, that if anyone struck by a mortal wound looked upon it, they would escape the deadly poison and gain the life desired, thus signifying yourself to be exalted far beyond the curve of the cross formed for your salvation on the cross; grant this to me, the wretched sinner, as well as all who today come before you with prayers for your holy passion, that we may overcome diabolic traps with you assisting us and thus become worthy of eternal life. With you.

text: Domine Iesu Christe qui nos per Crucis passionem hodierna die a diabolica servitute liberasti ut quo die hominem condideras eodem et reformares: exaudi me miserum et peccatorem coram hoc signaculo sanctae Crucis confitentem ut huius venerabilis et vitalis ligni tuitione munitus et hostis nequissimi ignea tela repellere et ab inflictis evacuari vulneribus et ad vitam aeternam valeam pervenire. Per te Salvator.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, who today on the Cross delivered us from devilish servitude, as you created man and reformed him on that same day: hear me, wretched sinner, before this sign of the holy Cross which I confess. With the protection of this venerable and life-giving wood, may I be armed to repel the fiery arrows of the wicked enemy, freed from afflicting wounds, and may I attain eternal life. Through you, Savior.

text: Dum fabricator mundi
translation_en: While the Creator of the world

text: O admirabile pretium
translation_en: Oh, wonderful price

text: Crux fidelis
translation_en: Faithful Cross

text: Pange lingua
translation_en: Sing tongue

text: Laudes omnipotens ferimus tibi
translation_en: We praise you, almighty one

text: Hoc corpus quod pro
translation_en: This body which for

text: Oremus. Praeceptis salutaribus. Pater noster.
translation_en: Let us pray. By healthful precepts. Our Father.

text: Ite in pace.
translation_en: Go in peace.

text: Confitebor tibi Domine quoniam audisti
translation_en: I will praise you, Lord, for you have heard me

text: Cum accepisset acetum
translation_en: When he received vinegar

text: Magnificat
translation_en: Magnificat (a title, usually referring to the Canticle of Mary - Luke 1:46-55)

text: Domine exaudi orationem 〈meam〉 auribus percipe
translation_en: Lord, hear my prayer. Receive it.

text: Levavi oculos
translation_en: I lift up my eyes

text: Laetatus sum
translation_en: I am pleased

text: Nisi quia Dominus
translation_en: Unless the Lord

text: Qui confidunt
translation_en: Who trust

text: In convertendo
translation_en: In converting (or turning)

text: Nisi Dominus aedificaverit
translation_en: Unless the Lord builds,

text: Saepe expugnaverunt
translation_en: They often conquered

text: Domine non est
translation_en: Lord, it is not

text: Memento Domine David
translation_en: Remember, Lord, David

text: Ecce quam bonum
translation_en: Behold how good

text: Ecce nunc benedicite
translation_en: Behold now bless ye

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus in nomine Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi et Spiritus Sancti benedicimus hunc ignem cum cera et omnibus eius alimoniis sanctificamus et signo Crucis Christi Filii tui vivi altissimi signamus ut intus vel foris accensus quod nocet non incendat sed omnia ad usus necessaria hominum calescat sive illuminet et quae ex hoc igne fuerint conflata vel calefacta sint benedicta et omni humanae saluti utilia ut non cum Dathan et Abiron ignem tibi offerentibus alienum incendamur sed cum Aaron pontifice et filiis eius Eleazaro et Ithamaro hostias tibi pacificas Spiritus Sancti igne assatas immolare valeamus et semper eiusdem Sancti Spiritus igne vitia nostra ure cordaque luce scientiae tuae illumina et animas nostras calore fidei clarifica.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, in the name of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, and of the Holy Spirit, we bless this fire with wax and all its provisions. We sanctify it with the sign of the Cross of Christ, your living Son, that within or without kindled, it may harm no one but may warm or light whatever is necessary for man. Whatever shall be melted or heated by this fire, let it be blessed, and let all things useful for human salvation be imbued with it, that we may not be consumed by the fire as Dathan and Abiram offered you a foreign fire, but rather offer to you peaceful sacrifices like Aaron the priest and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, whose hearts were burned with the fire of the Holy Spirit. May this same Holy Spirit's fire illuminate our vices and harden our hearts with the light of your knowledge. May it clarify our souls with the warmth of faith.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus mundi conditor luminis siderumque fabricator per cuius ineffabilem potentiam omnis claritas sumpsit exordium: te in tuis operibus invocamus; aperi quaesumus Domine labia nostra ad confitendum nomini tuo et ad laudem gloriae tuae ut digne celebrare mereamur sacrum officium tuum quia in hac sacratissima noctis vigilia de donis tuis cereum tuae suppliciter offerimus maiestati.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, creator of the world and fabricator of stars, through whose ineffable power all brightness began: we invoke you in your works; we humbly ask, Lord, open our lips to confess your name and to praise your glory, that we may worthy celebrate your sacred office. For on this most holy night's vigil, we offer to your majesty the candles of your gifts with supplication.

text: Veniat ergo Domine super hoc incensum larga tuae benedictionis infusio et hunc nocturnum splendorem invisibilis regnator accende ut non solum sacrificium quod hac nocte litatum est arcana tui luminis admixtione refulgeat sed in quocumque loco ex eo 〈sanctificationis mysterio aliquid〉 deportatum fuerit expulsa diabolicae fraudis nequitia virtus tuae maiestatis assistat.
translation_en: Therefore, O Lord, come upon this incense, pour out your blessing in abundance and ignite this nocturnal splendor of the invisible ruler, so that not only the sacrifice that was offered tonight with a blend of your hidden light may shine brightly, but also wherever something from it [the mystery] of sanctification has been carried, let the power of your majesty drive out the deceit of devilish cunning.

text: Deus qui per Filium tuum angularem scilicet lapidem caritatis ignem fidelibus contulisti: productum ex silice nostris profuturum usibus novum hunc ignem sanctifica et concede nobis 〈ita〉 per haec festa paschalia caelestibus desideriis inflammari ut ad perpetua purgatis sensibus pertingere valeamus. Per eundem Christum.
translation_en: God, who through your Son, the cornerstone of love, kindled the fire of charity for the faithful: sanctify this new fire produced from our flint and grant that we may be inflamed by these Paschal festivals with celestial desires. May we be able to reach perpetual purification with sensations purified through it. Through the same Christ.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus benedicentibus nobis hunc ignem in nomine tuo et Unigeniti Filii tui Dei ac Domini nostri Iesu Christi et Spiritus Sancti cooperari dignare et adiuva nos contra ignita tela inimici et illustra gratia caelesti. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty and eternal God, bless us with this fire in your name, and your only-begotten Son, our God and Lord Jesus Christ, and the Holy Spirit. Deign to cooperate with those who bless us, and help us against the fiery darts of our enemy. Illumine us with celestial grace. Through our Lord.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens lumen indeficiens qui es conditor omnium luminum: benedic hoc lumen quod a te sanctificatum atque benedictum est qui illuminasti omnem mundum ut ab eo lumine accendamur et in eo illuminemur igne caritatis tuae et sicut tuo igne illuminasti Moysen ita illumines corda et sensus nostros ut ad vitam lucemque aeternam pervenire mereamur. Per eundem.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father almighty, eternal light who are the creator of all lights: bless this light which you have sanctified and blessed, that it has illuminated the whole world, so that we may be enkindled by it and be illumined by it with the fire of your love. Just as you illuminated Moses, so may you enlighten our hearts and minds, that we may deserve to attain life and eternal light through it. Through the same.

text: Inventor rutili
translation_en: Golden-haired Creator (referring to God)

text: Exsultet iam angelica turba caelorum exsultent divina mysteria et pro tanti regis victoria tuba intonet salutaris. Gaudeat se tellus tantis irradiatam fulgoribus et aeterni regis splendore illustratam totius orbis se sentiat amisisse caliginem. Laetetur et mater Ecclesia tanti luminis adornata fulgoribus et magnis populorum vocibus haec aula resultet. Quapropter astantibus vobis fratres carissimi ad tam miram sancti huius luminis claritatem una mecum quaeso Dei omnipotentis misericordiam invocate ut qui me non meis meritis intra levitarum numerum dignatus est aggregare luminis sui gratiam infundendo cerei huius laudem implere praecipiat. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum qui cum eo vivit et regnat Deus.
translation_en: Now let the angelic choir of heaven rejoice, and let the divine mysteries be celebrated for the great victory of such a king. Let the trumpet sound salutary music. Let the earth be glad, radiant with brilliant rays, and illuminated by the splendor of the eternal king throughout the entire world; let it feel that it has lost its darkness. Let the Mother Church rejoice, adorned with such brightness and great voices, let this assembly resound. Therefore, in the presence of you, dear brothers, I humbly ask for the mercy of the almighty God to whom He has graciously chosen to number me among the ranks of His light; let Him pour out His grace into this candle's praise and command it to fulfill its purpose. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with Him, God.

text: VD et iustum est invisibilem Deum Patrem omnipotentem Filiumque eius Unigenitum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum toto cordis ac mentis affectu et vocis ministerio personare. Qui pro nobis aeterno Patri Adae debitum solvit et veteris piaculi cautionem pio cruore detersit. Haec sunt enim festa paschalia in quibus verus ille Agnus occiditur eiusque sanguine postes consecrantur. Haec nox est in qua primum patres nostros filios Israël Domine eduxisti de Aegypto quos postea Rubrum mare sicco vestigio transire fecisti. Haec igitur nox est quae peccatorum tenebras columnae illuminatione purgavit. Haec nox est quae hodie per universum mundum in Christo credentes a vitiis saeculi et caligine peccatorum segregatos reddit gratiae sociatque sanctitati. Haec nox est in qua destructis vinculis mortis Christus ab inferis victor ascendit. Nihil enim nobis nasci profuit nisi redimi profuisset. O mira circa nos tuae pietatis dignatio. O inaestimabilis dilectio caritatis ut servum redimeres Filium tradidisti. O vere beata nox quae exspoliavit Aegyptios ditavit Hebraeos. O beata beata nox quae sola meruit scire tempus et horam in qua Christus ab inferis resurrexit. Haec nox est de qua scriptum est: Et nox ut dies illuminabitur et nox illuminatio mea in deliciis meis. Huius igitur sanctificatio noctis fugat scelera culpas lavat et reddit innocentiam lapsis et maestis laetitiam. Fugat odia concordiam parat et curvat imperia. In huius igitur gratia noctis suscipe sancte Pater incensi huius sacrificium vespertinum quod tibi in hac cerei oblatione sollemni per ministrorum manus de operibus apum sacrosancta reddit Ecclesia. Sed iam columnae huius praeconia novimus quam in honorem Dei rutilans ignis accendit. Qui licet divisus in partes mutuati luminis detrimenta non novit. Alitur enim liquentibus cereis quam in substantiam pretiosae huius lampadis apis mater eduxit. O vere beata nox quae exspoliavit Aegyptios ditavit Hebraeos. Nox in qua terrenis caelestia iunguntur. Oramus ergo te Domine ut cereus iste in honorem nominis tui consecratus ad noctis huius caliginem destruendam indeficiens perseveret. In odorem suavitatis acceptus supernis luminaribus misceatur. Flammas eius lucifer matutinus inveniat. Ille inquam lucifer qui nescit occasum. Ille qui regressus ab inferis humano generi serenus illuxit. Precamur ergo te Domine ut nos famulos tuos omnem clerum et devotissimum populum una cum papa nostro N. et gloriosissimo rege nostro N. et antistite nostro N. quiete temporum concessa in his paschalibus festis conservare digneris. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum qui tecum vivit et regnat Deus in unitate Spiritus Sancti per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: And it is just that we, with all our heart and mind and voice, should honor the invisible God the Father almighty, His only-begotten Son our Lord Jesus Christ. Who for us paid the eternal debt to the Father on account of Adam, and removed the warning of the ancient sin with his sacred blood. These are indeed the Paschal feasts in which the true Lamb is sacrificed, and the gates are consecrated by his blood. This is the night that you first led our fathers, the children of Israel, out of Egypt, whom you afterwards made pass through the Red Sea on dry ground. This is the night that purged the darkness of sins with the illumination of columns. This is the night that today in Christ separates the faithful from the vices of the world and the darkness of sin. This is the night in which Christ, victorious over death, ascended from the grave. For nothing profits us if we are not redeemed. O wondrous dignity of your pity! O inestimable love of charity that you ransomed a servant by giving your Son! O truly blessed night that stripped the Egyptians and enriched the Hebrews. O blessed, blessed night that alone merited to know the time and hour in which Christ rose from the dead. This is about which it is written: And the night shall shine as the day; and the night is my light in my rejoicing. Therefore, let the sanctification of this night drive away sins, wash away faults, restore innocence to the fallen and the sorrowful, bring joy to the heart. Let it abolish hatred, prepare harmony, and bend empires. In the grace of this night's sanctity, receive, holy Father, this evening's incense sacrifice which the Church, in this solemn wax offering through the hands of ministers, returns to you from the sacred works of bees. Yet we already know the praises of this column which shines like fire for the honor of God. Although it is divided into parts and suffers loss due to the diminishment of light, it is nourished by liquefied wax, as the mother bee brought forth this precious lamp. O truly blessed night that stripped the Egyptians and enriched the Hebrews. The night in which terrestrial things are joined with heavenly things. Therefore we pray you, Lord, that this candle consecrated in your honor may persevere unfailing in destroying the darkness of this night. May it be mixed among the fragrances of heavenly lights. May the morning star find its flames. That is to say, the morning star which knows no setting. That which returned illuminated man after descending from heaven. We pray you, Lord, that you may preserve your servants, the entire clergy and the devout people, together with our pope N., and the glorious king our N., and our bishop N., in peace during these Paschal feasts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, forever and ever.

text: In principio creavit Deus caelum et terram
translation_en: In the beginning, God created heaven and earth.

text: Factum est in vigilia
translation_en: It happened at vigil (or during the night)

text: Cantemus Domino gloriose enim honorificatus est equum et ascensorem
translation_en: We sing to the Lord, for he is gloriously honored; the horse and the chariot he has elevated.

text: Deus cuius antiqua miracula in praesenti quoque saeculo coruscare sentimus: praesta quaesumus ut mysterium per quod priorem populum ab Aegyptiis liberasti ita hoc ad salutem gentium per aquas baptismatis opereris.
translation_en: God, whose ancient miracles we still feel resonate in the present age: grant us that through the mystery by which you freed the earlier people from Egypt, so may this operate for the salvation of the nations through the waters of baptism.

text: Apprehendent septem mulieres
translation_en: Seven women apprehend (or grasp)

text: Vinea facta est dilecto
translation_en: The vine was made for the beloved

text: Deus qui in omnibus Ecclesiae tuae filiis sanctorum prophetarum voce manifestasti in omni loco dominationis tuae satorem te bonorum seminum et electorum palmitum esse cultorem: tribue quaesumus populis tuis 〈qui〉 et vinearum nomine apud te censetur et segetum ut spinarum et tribulorum squalore resecato digni efficiant fruge fecundi.
translation_en: God who in all the sons of your church, the holy prophets, have manifested yourself with a voice in every place of your dominion, sower of good seeds and elect one as cultivator: grant, we ask, to your people who are counted among vines and grains before you and worthy of the harvest of productive fruit.

text: Scripsit Moyses canticum
translation_en: Moses wrote a song

text: Attende caelum et loquar
translation_en: Look up to heaven and I will speak

text: Deus qui nobis per prophetarum ora 〈praecepisti〉 temporalia relinquere atque ad aeterna festinare: da famulis tuis ut quae a te iussa cognovimus implere caelesti inspiratione valeamus.
translation_en: God who through the prophets' prayers commanded us to leave temporal things and hasten towards the eternal: grant your servants that we may be able to carry out what you have commanded us with heavenly inspiration.

text: Sicut cervus desiderat ad
translation_en: As the deer desires to be at

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: respice propitius ad devotionem populi tui renascentis qui sicut cervus aquarum expetit fontem; concede propitius ut fidei ipsius sitis baptismatis {renovati} mysterio animam corpusque sanctificet. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God: look upon us kindly in the devotion of your renewing people, who long for you like a stag yearns for water. Grant us graciously so that the mystery of the renovated baptism may quench their thirst of faith, and sanctify their soul and body through the Lord.

text: Rex sanctorum angelorum totum mundum adiuva
translation_en: King of all saints, help the whole world

text: Mitte Sanctum nunc amborum Spiritum Paraclitum
translation_en: Send now the Holy Spirit of Paraclete upon both.

text: Deus qui hanc sacratissimam noctem gloria dominicae resurrectionis illustras: conserva in nova familiae tuae progenie adoptionis tuae spiritum quem dedisti ut corpore et mente renovati puram tibi exhibeant servitutem. Per eundem.
translation_en: God who illuminate this most sacred night of the glorious resurrection of our Lord: conserve in your new family's progeny the spirit which you gave, so that they may renewed in body and mind present to you a pure service. Through the same.

text: Si conresurrexistis
translation_en: If you have been raised

text: Iam domus optatas reddit
translation_en: The desired house is returned

text: Vespere autem sabbati
translation_en: In the evening of Saturday

text: VD aequum et salutare. Te quidem Domine omni tempore sed in hoc (hac) potissimum die (nocte) gloriosius praedicare cum Pascha nostrum immolatus est Christus. Ipse enim verus est agnus qui abstulit peccata mundi. Qui mortem nostram moriendo destruxit et vitam resurgendo reparavit. Et ideo cum angelis et archangelis cum thronis et dominationibus cumque omni militia caelestis exercitus hymnum gloriae tuae canimus sine fine dicentes.
translation_en: It is fitting and salutary. Indeed, Lord, at all times, but especially on this day (night), You are most gloriously proclaimed that our Pasch was immolated, Christ. For He truly is the Lamb who took away the sins of the world. Who destroyed our death by dying and restored life by rising again. And therefore with angels and archangels with thrones and dominations and with all the heavenly host we sing the hymn of Your glory without end, saying:

text: Communicantes et noctem sacratissimam (diem sacratissimum) celebrantes resurrectionis Domini Dei nostri Iesu Christi secundum carnem. Sed et memoriam venerantes in primis gloriosae semper Virginis Mariae Genitricis eiusdem Dei.
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred night (day) of the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ, according to the flesh. But also reverently remembering, first and foremost, the memory of the glorious ever-Virgin Mary, the Mother of the same God.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus pro his quoque quos regenerare dignatus es ex aqua et Spiritu Sancto tribuens eis remissionem omnium peccatorum. Quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering of our servitude and that of all your family which we present to you for those whom you have deemed worthy to regenerate with water and the Holy Spirit, granting them forgiveness of all sins. We ask you, Lord, that you may receive us graciously.

text: Alleluia
translation_en: Hallelujah

text: Alleluia alleluia alleluia
translation_en: Hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah

text: Alleluia. Pascha nostrum Christus est alleluia
translation_en: Alleluia. Our Passover is Christ, alleluia

text: Maria Magdalene.
translation_en: Mary Magdalene

text: Alleluia. Venite exsultemus Domino
translation_en: Alleluia. Let us go forth and rejoice in the Lord

text: Ego sum qui sum
translation_en: I am who am

text: Beatus vir qui non abiit
translation_en: Blessed is the man who did not depart (or die)

text: Quem quaeritis in sepulcro o Christicolae?
translation_en: Whom do you seek in the tomb, O Christian?

text: Iesum Nazarenum
translation_en: Jesus of Nazareth

text: Non est hic surrexit
translation_en: He is not risen here

text: Venite et videte locum
translation_en: Come and see the place

text: Te Deum laudamus.
translation_en: We praise you, God.

text: Surrexit Dominus vere
translation_en: The Lord has truly risen

text: Pascha nostrum
translation_en: Our Passover

text: Surrexit Christus et illuxit populo suo
translation_en: Christ has risen and shone upon his people

text: Et valde mane una sabbatorum
translation_en: And very early on the Sabbath day

text: Angelus autem Domini
translation_en: The angel of the Lord

text: Retribue
translation_en: Return

text: Confitemini Domino. Gloria Patri et Filio.
translation_en: Give thanks to the Lord. Glory to the Father and to the Son.

text: Cum rex gloriae
translation_en: With the king of glory

text: O quam pretiosa est
translation_en: How precious it is

text: Deus qui paschale nobis remedium contulisti: intercedente beata Margareta populum tuum caelesti dono prosequere ut inde post in perpetuum gaudeat unde nunc temporaliter exsultet. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: God, who has provided us with the remedy of Easter: through the intercession of blessed Margaret, may your people receive a heavenly gift, so that they may rejoice forever from where they now temporarily exult. Through our Lord.

text: Salve festa dies toto venerabilis.
translation_en: Hail, venerable day in its entirety.

text: Sedit angelus
translation_en: An angel sat

text: Crucifixum Dominum laudate
translation_en: Praise the Lord who has been crucified

text: Nolite metuere
translation_en: Do not fear

text: Recordamini quomodo praedixit
translation_en: Remember how He predicted

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras et per resurrectionem Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi a cunctis malis liberemur; intercedente beata Maria semper Virgine et beato Ioanne Baptista muro custodiae tuae hoc sanctum ovile circumda ut omni adversitate depulsa hoc semper domicilium sit incolumitatis et pacis. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Lord, receive our prayers and, through the resurrection of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, may we be freed from all evils; under the intercession of the blessed Mary, the ever Virgin, and the blessed John the Baptist, may they surround this holy flock as a protective wall. May we always dwell in this house as a sanctuary of safety and peace. Through the Lord.

text: Resurrexi et adhuc tecum sum
translation_en: I have risen and I am still with you

text: Domine probasti me et cognovisti me
translation_en: Lord, you have tested me and known me.

text: Expurgate vetus fermentum
translation_en: Clean out the old leaven

text: Haec dies quam fecit Dominus
translation_en: This day that the Lord has made

text: Epulemur in azymis
translation_en: We eat unleavened bread

text: Laudes Salvatori
translation_en: Praises for the Savior

text: Terra tremuit et quievit dum resurgeret in iudicio Deus
translation_en: The earth shook and quivered while God rose again in judgment.

text: Deus universae carnis conditor qui Noë et filiis suis de mundis et immundis animalibus praecepta dedisti quique ut olera herbarum humano generi quadrupedia munda edere permisisti et in nocte illa qua agnum in Aegypto Moysi 〈et〉 populo tuo in vigilia Paschae comedere praecepisti in figura Domini nostri Iesu Christi cuius sanguine omnia primogenita tibi de mundo redemisti et nocte illa omne primogenitum in Aegypto percutere praecepisti servans populum tuum agni sanguine praenotatum: dignare Domine benedicere et sanctificare has ovium mundarum carnes ut quicumque ex 〈eis de〉 populis tuis fidelibus comederint omni benedictione caelesti et gratia tua saturati repleantur in bonis.
translation_en: God, creator of all flesh, who gave Noah and his sons instructions regarding clean and unclean animals, and permitted the human race to eat edible herbs and pure quadrupeds, and on that night when you commanded Moses to eat the lamb in Egypt with your people during the vigil of Passover as a figure of our Lord Jesus Christ, whose blood redeemed all firstborn from the world, and on that same night you commanded the firstborn in Egypt to be struck down while preserving your people by the mark of the lamb's blood: Lord, deign to bless and sanctify these clean sheep's flesh. May anyone who eats them from among your faithful peoples be filled with every celestial blessing and your grace, satisfied with good things.

text: Creator et conservator humani generis dator gratiae spiritalis largitor aeternae salutis: mitte tu Domine Spiritum Sanctum tuum super hanc creaturam carnis ut armata virtute caelestis defensionis qui ex ea gustaverint proficiat illis ad salutem aeternam.
translation_en: Creator and preserver of the human race, bestower of spiritual grace, giver of eternal salvation: send forth your Holy Spirit upon this creature of flesh, that armed with celestial defense's power, those who taste from it may advance towards eternal salvation.

text: Deus universae conditor creaturae qui inter ceteras diversarum creaturarum species 〈pro〉 humani generis usibus etiam et reptilium genus ex aquis producere dignatus es de quibus Noë egressus ex arca holocaustum tibi offerens placuit qui populo tuo educto ex Aegypto per Moysen servum tuum munda ab immundis segregans edere praecepisti: te supplices rogamus omnipotens Deus ut has creaturas mundarum avium carnes benedicere et sanctificare digneris ut quicumque ex eis comederint benedictionis abundantia repleantur atque ad aeternae vitae pascua pervenire mereantur.
translation_en: God, creator of all, who among other species of creatures chose to produce even the reptile genus from the waters for the use of mankind, and who, pleased with Noah's offering of holocaust from the ark after he was released, commanded that your people separated from the unclean by Moses, your servant, should eat; we humbly ask you, Almighty God, to bless and sanctify these clean birds' flesh so that whoever consumes them may be filled with the abundance of blessing and merit to reach the pastures of eternal life.

text: Dignare Domine Deus omnipotens benedicere et sanctificare hanc creaturam casei quam ex adipe animalium producere dignatus es et concede propitius ut quicumque ex populis tuis fidelibus inde comederint vel gustaverint omni benedictione caelesti et gratia tua saturati repleantur in bonis.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, deign to bless and sanctify this creature of cheese which You have deigned to produce from the fat of animals. Grant graciously that whoever among Your faithful people consumes or tastes it may be filled with every celestial blessing and satisfaction by Your grace.

text: Subveniat quaesumus Domine tuae benedictionis gratia huic ovorum creaturae de qua pullos gallinarum dignatus es procreare ut cibus salubris fiat tuis fidelibus in tuarum gratiarum actione sumentibus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your blessing grace this egg-creature from which you were pleased to create chickens. May it become a healthy food for your faithful who partake of it in the act of your thanksgiving.

text: Deus qui per resurrectionem Filii tui paschalia nobis gaudia contulisti: auge et sanctifica collata nobis haec dona tuae largitatis et mentes nostras pariter spiritualibus reple deliciis. Per eundem.
translation_en: God who through the resurrection of your Son granted us Easter joy, increase and sanctify these gifts bestowed upon us, and fill our minds likewise with spiritual delights. Through the same.

text: Surrexit Dominus de sepulcro. 〈R.〉 Qui pro nobis.
translation_en: The Lord has risen from the tomb. (Response): Who for us.

text: Deus qui omnes in Christo renatos genus regium et sacerdotale fecisti: da nobis et velle et posse quod praecipis ut populo tuo ad aeternitatem vocato una sit fides mentium et pietas actionum.
translation_en: God who made all in Christ the royal and priestly people: grant us both the will and the power to do as you command, so that the faith of minds and the devotion of actions may be one for your called people, unto eternity.

text: Vidi aquam egredientem de templo.
translation_en: I saw water flowing out of the temple.

text: In die resurrectionis meae
translation_en: On the day of my resurrection

text: Prae timore autem eius
translation_en: In fear of Him

text: Laudate pueri Dominum
translation_en: Praise the Lord, children

text: Respondens autem angelus
translation_en: The angel answered

text: In exitu Israël
translation_en: In the departure of Israel

text: Christus resurgens ex mortuis
translation_en: Christ, risen from the dead

text: Alleluia. Surrexit Dominus alleluia sicut dixit vobis alleluia alleluia.
translation_en: Alleluia. The Lord has risen, alleluia, as he said to you, alleluia, alleluia.

text: Deus qui sollemnitate paschali mundo remedia contulisti: populum tuum caelesti pietate prosequere ut et perfectam libertatem consequi valeat et ad vitam proficiat sempiternam.
translation_en: God, who provided the world with remedies during the solemnity of Easter: may your heavenly pity follow your people, so that they may be able to attain complete freedom and progress towards eternal life.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus preces populi tui cum oblationibus. Infra 〈actionem:〉 Communicantes. Sed et memoriam. Hanc igitur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech you, the prayers of your people along with the offerings. Below, [action]: Communicating. Also remember. Therefore this.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut paschalia festa quae venerando colimus etiam vivendo teneamus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who celebrate the Easter festivals with reverence may also live in keeping with them.

text: Sacrificia Domine paschalibus gaudiis immolamus quibus Ecclesia tua mirabiliter et pascitur et nutritur.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, the Paschal sacrifices with joyous feastings, by which Your Church is wonderfully nourished and sustained.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera populorum tuorum propitius ut confessione nominis tui et baptismate renovati aeternam beatitudinem consequantur.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offerings of your people graciously, that they may follow with the confession of your name and being renewed by baptism, eternal beatitude may be attained.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras ut redemptionis nostrae sacrosancta commercia et vitae nobis conferant praesentis auxilium et gaudia nobis sempiterna concilient.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, our prayers, so that the sacred commerce of our redemption and life may grant us present help and eternal joys.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui paschale sacramentum in reconciliationis humano foedere contulisti: da mentibus nostris ut quod professione celebramus imitemur effectu.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who bestowed the Paschal sacrament within the covenant of human reconciliation: grant our minds that we may imitate in deed what we celebrate with profession.

text: Redemptionis nostrae munere vegetati quaesumus Domine ut hoc perpetuae salutis exordium fides semper vera perficiat.
translation_en: By the power of our Redemption, we humbly ask you, Lord, that this beginning of eternal salvation may always be completed by faith true and everlasting.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine semper nos per haec mysteria paschalia gratulari ut continua nostrae reparationis operatio perpetuae nobis fiat causa laetitiae.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask, Lord, that through these Paschal mysteries we may always rejoice, so that the continuous work of our repair becomes a permanent cause of joy for us.

text: Exuberet quaesumus Domine in mentibus nostris paschalis gratia sacramenti ut donis suis ipsa nos dignos efficiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the Paschal grace of the sacrament may abound in our minds, so that by its own gifts it may deem us worthy.

text: Sacramenta quae sumpsimus quaesumus Domine et spiritualibus nos instruant alimentis et corporalibus tueantur auxiliis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the sacraments we have received may instruct us spiritually and protect us physically with your help.

text: Deus qui nos per huius sacrificii veneranda commercia unius summaeque divinitatis participes efficis: praesta quaesumus ut sicut tuam cognovimus veritatem sic eam dignis moribus assequamur.
translation_en: God, who makes us participants of this sacrifice through the venerable intercourse of one and the same divinity: grant us, we pray, that just as we have come to know your truth, so may we attain it through worthy conduct.

text: Adesto nobis Domine Deus noster ut per haec quae fideliter sumpsimus et purgemur a vitiis et a periculis omnibus exuamur.
translation_en: Be present, O Lord our God, that through these things we have faithfully received, we may be purified from vices and freed from all dangers.

text: Tribue nobis Domine quaesumus caelestis mensae virtute satiatis et desiderare quae recta sunt et desiderata percipere.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Lord, as we ask, the power of heavenly feast to satisfy us and to desire what is right and to perceive what is desired.

text: Mentem familiae tuae quaesumus Domine intercedente beato Petro apostolo tuo et munere compunctionis aperi et largitate pietatis exaudi.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that through the intercession of Your apostle Saint Peter and the gift of compunction, may the mind of your family be opened and may Your grace of pity be heard.

text: Sacrificium Domine pro Filii tui supplices venerabili quam praevenimus ascensione deferimus praesta quaesumus ut et nos per ipsum his commerciis sacrosanctis ad caelestia consurgamus. Per eundem.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, for Your Son we humbly offer what we precede in ascension; grant what we ask, that through Him and these most sacred transactions we may ascend to heavenly heights. Through the same.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus illuc tendat nostrae devotionis affectus quo tecum est nostra substantia. Iesus Christus Filius tuus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, that through these holy things which we have taken may the affection of our devotion be directed to where our substance is with you. Jesus Christ your Son.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: deduc nos ad societatem caelestium gaudiorum et gratia tui Spiritus renatos regnum tuum facias introire atque eo perveniat humilitas gregis quo processit celsitudo pastoris. Qui tecum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God: lead us to the society of celestial joys and make your grace renewed flock enter your kingdom, and let humility of the sheep reach the height where the shepherd has gone. Who is with you.

text: Ite in orbem universum
translation_en: Go throughout the whole world

text: Festum nunc celebre
translation_en: Celebrate the festival now

text: Ascendo ad Patrem
translation_en: I ascend to the Father

text: Deus qui nos resurrectionis dominicae et ascensionis eius laetabunda sollemnia celebrare fecisti: da famulis tuis ut venientis Sancti Spiritus gratiam purificatis mentibus suscipere mereamur.
translation_en: God who made us to rejoice in the solemnities of the Lord's resurrection and ascension: grant that we may be worthy to receive the grace of the coming Holy Spirit with purified minds.

text: Viri Galilaei quid admiramini
translation_en: Men of Galilee, why do you marvel

text: Cumque intuerentur
translation_en: When they look

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Per Christum Dominum nostrum. Qui post resurrectionem suam omnibus discipulis suis manifestus apparuit et ipsis cernentibus est elevatus in caelum ut nos divinitatis suae tribueret esse participes. Et ideo cum angelis et archangelis.
translation_en: We beseech you eternally, God through Christ our Lord. Who after his resurrection appeared to all of his disciples and was lifted up into heaven so that we may become participants of his divinity. And therefore with angels and archangels.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens et misericors Deus ut quae visibilibus mysteriis sumenda percepimus invisibili consequamur effectu.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty and merciful God, that what we have received with visible mysteries, we may obtain with invisible effects.

text: Deus qui ad celebranda tuae maiestatis miracula post resurrectionem a mortuis hodie in caelos apostolis astantibus ascendisti: concede nobis tuae pietatis auxilium ut secundum tuam promissionem et tu nobiscum semper in terris et nos tecum in caelo vivere mereamur. Qui vivis et regnas cum Patre.
translation_en: God who on this day ascended into heaven for the celebration of your miracles following the resurrection, with apostles standing by: grant us the help of your mercy, that we may deserve to live according to your promise both with you on earth and with you in heaven. Who lives and reigns with the Father.

text: Deus cuius Filius in alta caelorum potenter ascendens captivitatem nostram sua duxit virtute captivam: tribue quaesumus ut dona quae suis participibus contulit largiatur et nobis Iesus Christus Filius tuus Dominus noster. Qui tecum.
translation_en: God, whose Son ascended in high power in the heavens and led our captivity captive by his might: we ask that you may bestow the gifts which you have given to your participants on us as well, Jesus Christ, your Son, our Lord. Who is with you.

text: Sacrificia nos Domine immolata purificent et mentibus nostris supernae gratiae dent vigorem.
translation_en: Offerings, Lord, burn sacrifices that may cleanse us and grant our minds strength from heavenly grace.

text: Tentavit Deus Abraham
translation_en: God tried Abraham

text: Deus qui nobis per prophetarum ora praecepisti temporalia relinquere atque ad aeterna festinare: da nobis famulis tuis ut quod devote agimus implere caelesti inspiratione valeamus.
translation_en: God who taught us through the prophets to forsake temporal things and hasten towards eternal ones: grant to your servants that we may be able to carry out what we do devoutly with heavenly inspiration.

text: Audi Israël mandata vitae
translation_en: Hear, Israel, the commandments of life

text: Deus incommutabilis virtus et lumen aeternum respice propitius ad preces totius Ecclesiae sacramentum et da famulis tuis ut hoc quod devote agimus etiam rectitudine vitae teneamus.
translation_en: God, unchangeable power and eternal light, look upon us graciously according to the prayers of the whole Church, and grant your servants that what we are doing with devotion, we may also hold with uprightness of life.

text: Ut fontem benedicere et consecrare tunc benedicatur fons
translation_en: In order to bless and consecrate the spring, the spring should first be blessed.

text: Cum Apollo esset Corinthi
translation_en: When Apollo was in Corinth

text: Virtute Spiritus Sancti Domine munera nostra continge ut quod sollemnitate praesenti tuo nomini dedicamus et intelligibile nobis faciat et aeternum. Per eundem.
translation_en: Lord, may the power of the Holy Spirit encompass our gifts, so that what we dedicate to your name on this solemnity becomes understandable to us and eternal. Through the same.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Per Christum Dominum nostrum. Qui ascendens super omnes caelos sedensque ad dexteram tuam promissum Spiritum Sanctum hodierna die in filios adoptionis effudit. Quapropter profusis gaudiis totus in orbe terrarum mundus exsultat. Sed et supernae virtutes atque angelicae potestates hymnum gloriae tuae concinunt sine fine dicentes.
translation_en: We pray ... eternal God, through Christ our Lord. Who ascended above all heavens and sitting at your right hand, today poured out the promised Holy Spirit on the sons of adoption. Therefore, the whole world rejoices with overflowing joy throughout the entire earth. And also the heavenly powers and the angelic authorities sing an endless hymn of your glory.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum (noctem sacratissimam) Pentecostes celebrantes quo Spiritus Sanctus apostolis in igneis linguis apparuit. Sed et memoriam.
translation_en: Communing and celebrating the most sacred day (night) of Pentecost, on which the Holy Spirit appeared to the apostles in tongues of fire. But also remembering.

text: Ultimo festivitatis die
translation_en: On the last day of the festival

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut Spiritus Sanctus adveniens maiestatem nobis Filii tui manifestando clarificet. Qui tecum et cum eodem Domino nostro Iesu Christo Filio tuo vivit et regnat Deus per omnia saecula.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty and merciful God, that the Holy Spirit coming upon us may reveal the majesty of your Son. Who lives with you and with the same Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, forever reigns God throughout all ages.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui paschale sacramentum quinquaginta dierum voluisti mysterio contineri ut gentium facta dispersio divisione linguarum ad unam confessionem tui nominis caelesti munere congregetur. Per eundem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who willed to contain the Paschal sacrament for fifty days in a mystery so that the dispersion of nations, divided by languages, might be gathered together into one confession of your heavenly name by the gift. Through the same.

text: Apparuerunt apostolis
translation_en: They appeared to the apostles

text: Deus qui sacramento festivitatis hodiernae universam tuam Ecclesiam in omni gente et natione sanctificas: intercedente beato (beata) N. in totam mundi latitudinem Spiritus tui dona diffunde. Per Dominum.
translation_en: God who sanctifies your whole Church throughout all peoples and nations on this day of the festival's sacred rite: through the intercession of Blessed N., pour out your Spirit throughout the entire breadth of the world. Through our Lord.

text: Hodie completi sunt
translation_en: Today they are completed

text: Spiritus Domini replevit
translation_en: The Spirit of the Lord has filled

text: Concede nobis misericors Deus ut sicut in nomine Patris et Filii divini generis intelligimus veritatem sic in Spiritu Sancto totius cognoscamus substantiam Trinitatis. Qui vivis et regnas Deus per omnia saecula.
translation_en: Grant us, merciful God, that we may understand truth as we do in the name of the Father and of the Son, a divine nature; so also, through the Holy Spirit, may we know the substance of the Trinity. Who lives and reigns forever, God, throughout all ages.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Qui ascendens super omnes. Infra 〈actionem:〉 Communicantes et diem sacratissimum. Hanc igitur oblationem. Sed et memoriam venerantes.
translation_en: We beseech you, eternal God, who ascends above all, on this most sacred day, we make this offering and remember with reverence.

text: Propitius quaesumus Domine haec dona sanctifica et hostiae et spiritalis oblatione suscepta nosmetipsos tibi perfice munus aeternum.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to make holy these gifts and the spiritual offering received by us. May we fulfill for You an everlasting service.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Spiritus Sanctus adveniens templum nos gratiae suae habitaculo perficiat.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the Holy Spirit coming may complete us as a dwelling place of His grace.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Spiritus Sanctus adveniens templum nos gloriae suae dignanter inhabitando perficiat.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that the Holy Spirit coming upon us may worthily dwell within us and complete us with His glory.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut salutaribus ieiuniis eruditi ab omnibus quoque vitiis abstinentes propitiationem tuam facilius impetremus. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who are instructed by salutary fasting may also be free from all vices, so that we may more easily obtain your forgiveness. Through our Lord.

text: Ut accepta tibi sint Domine nostra ieiunia praesta quaesumus huius munere sacramenti purificatum tibi pectus offerre.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that our fasting be acceptable to you. With this ministry of the sacrament, purify our hearts and offer them to you.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica ut nobis Unigeniti Filii tui corpus et sanguis fiant. Per eundem.
translation_en: Lord, the gifts offered, sanctify them so that for us the body and blood of your Only-begotten Son may become. Through the same.

text: 〈Timentium te Domine Salvator et custos: averte ab Ecclesia tua mundanae〉 sapientiae oblectamenta fallaciae ut spiritus tui eruditione firmandos prophetica et apostolica instituta potius quam philosophiae verba delectent ne vanitas mendaciorum decipiat quos eruditio veritatis illuminat.
translation_en: Lord, Savior and protector, they fear you: turn away from your Church the allurements of worldly wisdom, that the spirit may be strengthened by your teachings - prophetic and apostolic - rather than being delighted by philosophical words. Lest vanity deceives those whom education in truth enlightens.

text: Remotis obumbrationibus carnalium victimarum spiritualem tibi summe Pater hostiam supplici servitute deferimus quae miro ineffabilique mysterio et immolatur semper et eadem semper offertur et devotorum munus et remunerationis est praemium.
translation_en: Removing the shadows of carnal sacrifices, we humbly bring before you, most High Father, a spiritual offering in submissive servitude. This is immolated and continually offered in a wondrous, ineffable mystery, and it serves as a gift from the devoted and is rewarded as a premium.

text: Redemptionis nostrae munere vegetati quaesumus Domine (ut) hoc nobis perpetuae salutis auxilium fides semper vera perficiat.
translation_en: By the power of our redemption, we humbly ask you, Lord (that) this may always be completed in us as an aid for eternal salvation, faith ever true.

text: Hostias Domine tibi dicatas placatus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings that are offered to you be pleasing, accept them and grant us everlasting aid in return.

text: Sumptis Domine muneribus quaesumus ut cum frequentatione mysterii crescat nostrae salutis effectus.
translation_en: Lord, we ask you with these offerings that the effectiveness of our salvation may grow with the frequent participation in the mystery.

text: Sancta tua nos Domine sumpta purificent et misericordiae sempiternae praeparent expiatos.
translation_en: May Your sanctity, Lord, cleanse us and prepare us in eternal mercy for forgiven ones.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine ut et mundi cursus pacifice nobis tuo ordine dirigatur et Ecclesia tua tranquilla devotione laetetur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that the course of the world may be directed peacefully according to your order and your Church rejoices with peaceful devotion.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes fidelium tuorum benignus assume ut quod singuli obtulerunt ad honorem nominis tui cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our petitions and graciously accept these offerings of your faithful ones. May what each one has offered for the honor of your name benefit all for their salvation.

text: Repleti Domine muneribus sacris tribue quaesumus ut eorum et mundemur effectu et muniamur auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, filled with sacred gifts, we ask that you grant us that through their effect we may be purified and that through their aid we may be fortified.

text: Suscipe munera quaesumus Domine quae tibi de tua largitate deferimus ut haec sacrosancta mysteria gratiae tuae operante virtute et praesentis vitae nos conversatione sanctificent et ad gaudia sempiterna perducant.
translation_en: Receive the offerings we ask, Lord, which we bring to you from your bounty, that these most holy mysteries of your grace may be consecrated by the working of your power and the life that is present with us, and may lead us in holiness to eternal joys.

text: Concede nobis Domine saepius haec frequentare mysteria quia quotiens huius hostiae immolatio celebratur opus nostrae redemptionis exercetur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, more frequently to partake in these mysteries, for whenever the offering of this host is celebrated, the work of our redemption is enacted.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus nostram propitius servitutem ut quod offerimus sit tibi munus acceptum sit nostrae fragilitatis subsidium.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we humbly ask, your merciful service. May what we offer be to you an accepted gift, may it be a support for our frailty.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus ut haec hostia salutaris et nostrorum fiat purgatio delictorum et tua propitiatio maiestatis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we ask, that this saving sacrifice may become a purification of our sins and an appeasement of your majesty.

text: Tua nos Domine quaesumus gratia semper praeveniat et sequatur ac bonis operibus iugiter praestet esse intentos.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your grace always precede and follow us, and may you continually aid those who are striving to do good works.

text: Emunda nos Domine sacrificii praesentis effectu et perfice miseratus in nobis ut eius mereamur esse participes.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, by the effectiveness of this sacrifice, and may your mercy be completed in us so that we may deserve to be its participants.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine familiae supplicanti ut dum a cibis corporalibus se abstinent a vitiis mente ieiunent.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech You, Lord, to this supplicating family, that while they abstain from bodily foods, they may fast mentally from vices.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis ut et ieiunio convenienter aptemur et suscepta sollemniter castigatio corporalis ad nostrarum fructum transeat animarum.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech You, to Your faithful ones that they may fittingly prepare themselves during fasting and may the accepted bodily penance pass through for the fruit of our souls.

text: Ut nos Domine sollemne tibi tribuis deferre ieiunium sic nobis quaesumus indulgentiae praesta subsidium. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum. Qui tecum vivit et regnat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly bring before you the solemn fast that we offer to you. Grant us, we beseech you, a helping of mercy as a support. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we humbly ask, may it release us from the bonds of our sinfulness and bestow upon us your mercy.

text: Deus qui nos per huius sacrificii veneranda commercia unius summaeque divinitatis participes efficis: praesta quaesumus ut sicut tuam cognoscimus veritatem sic eam dignis mentibus et moribus assequamur.
translation_en: God who makes us participants of this sacrificial communion through the venerable commerce of one and the same divinity: grant us, we ask, that just as we come to know your truth, so may we attain it with noble minds and virtuous lives.

text: Ut sacris Domine reddamur digni mysteriis fac nos quaesumus tuis oboedire mandatis.
translation_en: That we may be worthy to receive the sacred mysteries, make us obey your commands, Lord, we pray.

text: Sumpsimus Domine dona sacri mysterii humiliter deprecantes ut quae in tui commemorationem nos facere praecepisti in nostrae proficiant infirmitatis auxilium.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the gifts of the sacred mystery, humbly beseeching You. May what You commanded us to do in Your remembrance bring help for our weaknesses.

text: Propitius esto Domine supplicationibus nostris et populi tui oblationibus precibusque susceptis omnium nostrum ad te convertere corda ut a terrenis cupiditatibus liberi ad caelestia desideria transeamus.
translation_en: Lord, be propitious to our supplications and to the people's offerings and prayers received by you. Turn the hearts of all of us towards you so that we may pass from earthly desires to heavenly longings.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus ut quicquid in nostra mente vitiosum est sacramenti quod sumpsimus medicatione curetur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, that whatever in our mind is tainted may be healed by the care of the sacrament we have received.

text: Dicit Dominus
translation_en: The Lord says

text: Sacrificium Domine celebrandum placatus intende quod et nos a vitiis nostrae condicionis emundet et tuo nomini reddat acceptos.
translation_en: Lord, being pleased, direct that the Sacrifice be celebrated which may cleanse us from our condition of vice and render acceptable to Your name.

text: Animae nostrae divino munere satiatae quaesumus omnipotens Deus hoc potiantur desiderio ut a tuo spiritu inflammentur ut ante conspectum venientis Christi Filii tui velut clara luminaria fulgeamus. Per eundem Dominum.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God, by whose divine grace our souls are satisfied, to grant us this desire, that we may be inflamed with Your Spirit, shining like bright lights before the coming of Your Son, Christ. Through the same Lord.

text: Excita Domine potentiam tuam et veni ut ab imminentibus peccatorum nostrorum periculis te mereamur protegente eripi te liberante salvari. Qui tecum.
translation_en: Stir up, O Lord, thy power and come, that from the dangers of our sins we may be saved, delivered, protected, and preserved by thee. Who art with us.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Qui per beatae Mariae Virginis partum Ecclesiae tuae tribuisti celebrare mirabile mysterium et inenarrabile sacramentum. In qua manet intacta castitas pudor integer firma constantia. Quae laetatur quod virgo concepit quod caeli Dominum castis portavit visceribus quod virgo edidit partum. O admirandam divinae dispensationis operationem quae virum non cognovit et mater est et post filium virgo est. Duobus enim gavisa est muneribus: miratur quod virgo peperit laetatur quod Redemptorem mundi edidit Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: We pray ... eternal God. Who through the birth of the blessed Virgin Mary bestowed upon Your Church the privilege to celebrate the wonderful mystery and ineffable sacrament. In which chastity, modesty, integrity, firm constancy remain unchanged. She rejoices because the virgin conceived, she rejoices because she bore the Lord of heaven with pure womb, she rejoices because the virgin gave birth. O wondrous work of divine dispensation, who knew no man and was a mother, and after giving birth, remained a virgin. She is filled with joy by two gifts: she marvels that the virgin bore a child, she rejoices that the Redeemer of the world was born, Jesus Christ our Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: da cordibus nostris illam tuarum rectitudinem semitarum quam beati Ioannis Baptistae in deserto vox clamantis edocuit. Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God: grant to our hearts that straightness of your ways which the voice of blessed John the Baptist taught in the desert, our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son.

text: Conscientias nostras quaesumus Domine visitando purifica ut veniens Filius tuus Dominus noster cum omnibus sanctis paratam sibi in nobis inveniat mansionem. Qui tecum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that by visiting us, you purify our consciences, so that when your Son, our Lord, comes with all the saints, he may find a prepared dwelling place within us. Who is with you.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica nosque a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda ut veniente Filio tuo Salvatore nostro immaculati occuramus illi in eius sanctorum comitatu.
translation_en: Lord, present offerings sanctify us and purify us from the stains of our sins, that we may meet our Savior coming with a pure heart in his company of saints.

text: Perceptis Domine salutaribus sacramentis humiliter deprecamur ut qui de adventu Filii tui secundum carnem laetemur in secundo cum venerit in maiestate sua cum omnibus sanctis suis praemium vitae aeternae percipiamus. Per eundem.
translation_en: Having received the salutary sacraments, we humbly beseech You, Lord, that we who rejoice at the coming of Your Son according to flesh, may receive in the second [coming] in His majesty with all His saints, the reward of eternal life. Through the same.

text: Placare Domine quaesumus humilitatis nostrae precibus et hostiis et ubi nulla suppetunt suffragia meritorum tuis nobis succurre praesidiis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly beseech you to look favorably upon our humble prayers and offerings. And where there are no supporting petitions from good works, come to our aid with your protection.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut redemptionis nostrae ventura sollemnitas et praesentis vitae subsidia conferat et aeternae beatitudinis praemia largiatur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that the approaching solemnity of our redemption may bestow its aid and that the rewards of eternal beatitude be lavished upon us in this present life.

text: Accepta tibi sint Domine quaesumus nostra ieiunia quae et expiando nos tua gratia dignos efficiant et ad sempiterna promissa perducant.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that our fasting be accepted by you. May it, through your grace, make us worthy and lead us to the eternal promises you have promised.

text: Salutaris tui Domine munere satiati supplices te {Domine} deprecamur ut cuius laetamur gustu renovemur effectu. Per Dominum.
translation_en: With your saving grace, Lord, we who are satisfied, humbly entreat you, Lord. Renew us in joy of whom we rejoice, in effect. Through the Lord.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quia sub peccati iugo ex vetusta servitute deprimimur exspectata Unigeniti Filii tui nova nativitate liberemur. Per eundem.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that since we are oppressed by the yoke of sin from our ancient bondage, we may be freed by the expected birth of your Only-Begotten Son. Through the same.
