text: Sanctus Silvester confessor tuus atque pontifex quaesumus Domine nos ubique laetificet ut dum eius merita recolimus per haec sacra munera eius patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that our holy confessor and pope, Saint Silvester, may rejoice us everywhere, so that while we recall his merits through these sacred gifts, we may feel his patronage.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut de perceptis muneribus gratias exhibentes intercedente beato Silvestro confessore tuo atque pontifice beneficia potiora sumamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we offer thanks for the gifts received, through the intercession of your blessed confessor and pope St. Silvester, we may obtain even greater blessings.

text: Sancti Felicis martyris tui atque pontificis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ad meliorem vitam sanctorum tuorum exempla nos provocent quatenus cuius sollemnia agimus etiam actus imitemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God for your saint, Martyr and Bishop, Saint Felicitas, that the examples of your holy ones may lead us to a better life. May we not only celebrate her feast day, but also imitate her actions.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro commemoratione sancti Felicis confessoris tui atque pontificis offerimus suppliciter deprecantes ut sicut illi praebuisti sacrae fidei claritatem sic nobis indulgentiam largiaris et pacem.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, hosts in commemoration of Saint Felicitas, your confessor and bishop, humbly beseeching You. Just as you granted him clarity of sacred faith, so grant us forgiveness and peace.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum Marii et Marthae cum filiis Audifax et Abacuch Domine quorum natalicia colimus quaesumus ut eorum participes gaudiorum effici mereamur.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that on the feast of your martyrs Mary and Martha, along with Audifax and Abacuch, whose birthdays we celebrate, we may be made worthy participants of their joys.

text: Deus qui beatum Sebastianum martyrem tuum virtute constantiae in passione roborasti: ex eius imitatione tribue pro amore tuo prospera mundi despicere et nulla eius adversa formidare.
translation_en: God, who strengthened your blessed martyr Sebastian with constancy in his passion: grant through his imitation that for your love we may scorn the world's troubles and fear no adversity from him.

text: Hodierno die sacrificio laetantes obsequimur quo beatae Agnetis caelestem victoriam recensentes et tua magnalia praedicamus et nos acquisisse gaudemus suffragia.
translation_en: On this day, we joyfully offer the sacrifice, giving thanks for the recent triumph of blessed Agnes in heaven, and we proclaim your great deeds, and we rejoice that we have obtained her intercessions.

text: Sumentes Domine gaudia sempiterna de participatione sacramenti festivitatis sanctae martyris tuae Agnetis suppliciter deprecamur ut quae servitute donante te gerimus dignis sensibus tuo munere capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we take eternal joy from the participation in the sacrament of the feast of your martyr Agnes. Humbly we ask that, given into slavery by you, we may grasp your gift with worthy senses.

text: Adesto Domine quaesumus supplicationibus nostris ut qui ex iniquitate nostra reos nos esse cognoscimus beati Vincentii martyris tui intercessione liberemur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, we implore you, with our petitions, that through the intercession of your blessed martyr St. Vincent, we may be freed from the guilt of our sins.

text: Muneribus nostris quaesumus Domine precibusque susceptis et caelestibus nos munda mysteriis et intercedente beato Vincentio martyre tuo clementer exaudi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with our petitions received and with heavenly mysteries purifying us, grant us favor. With the intervention of your blessed martyr Saint Vincent, may you graciously hear us.

text: Tuere nos misericors Deus et beati Timothei apostoli tui cuius sollemnitatem celebramus semper guberna praesidiis.
translation_en: Guard us, merciful God, and may the blessed apostle Timothy, whose feast we celebrate, always guide us with your protective guidance.

text: Apostoli tui Pauli precibus Domine plebis tuae dona sanctifica ut quae tibi grata sunt instituto gratiora fiant eius patrocinio supplicantis.
translation_en: Lord, through the prayers of your Apostle Paul, grant and make holy your people. May those things that are pleasing to you become more gracious through the institution, and may they be made so by his patronage as they humbly petition.

text: Sanctificati Domine salutari mysterio quaesumus ut pro nobis eius non desit oratio cuius nos donasti patrociniis gubernari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify us with your saving mystery. May his prayer for us never cease, whose patronage you have entrusted to govern us.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatae Agnetis virginis tuae sollemnitate laetificas: da ut quam veneramur officio etiam piae conversationis semper sequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God who delights us with the feast of your blessed servant Agnes, grant that we may not only observe her office with reverence, but also always follow her example in devout living.

text: Grata tibi sint quaesumus Domine munera quibus sanctae Agnetis magnifica sollemnitas recensetur; sic enim ab exordio sui usque in finem exstitit beati certaminis ut eius nec initium debeamus praeterire nec finem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the gifts may be pleasing to You with which the solemnity of Saint Agnes is recently celebrated; for just as from its beginning until its end it has existed in the blessed contest, we ought neither to overlook its beginning nor its end.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus exaudi orationes nostras per intercessionem beatae Brigidae virginis tuae ut per eius interventum et veniam peccatorum et vitam mereamur aeternam.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, hear our prayers through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Brigid that through her intervention we may receive forgiveness for our sins and merit eternal life.

text: Sanctam quaesumus Domine oblationem pro commemoratione beatae Brigidae virginis tuae maiestati oblatam benigna pietate suscipe et nobis eius suffragantibus meritis ad salutem aeternam eam pervenire concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept this holy offering for the commemoration of the blessed Brigid, virgin, and grant that we may reach eternal salvation through her intercession. May your benevolent pity receive this offering made to your majesty.

text: Asperges me Domine hyssopo et
translation_en: Wash me, Lord, with hyssop, and

text: Famulorum tuorum quaesumus Domine delictis ignosce
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, forgive our sins of your servants.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus benedicere et sanctificare digneris ignem istum quem nos indigni suscipimus per invocationem Unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi quem hodie in templo praesentatum iustum Simeonem diu exspectantem in ulnis suscepisse novimus et salutare tuum ante faciem populorum esse lumen scilicet gentibus et gloriam plebis tuae Israël prophetico spiritu docuit. Te quaesumus Domine benedicere digneris lumen istud et omnibus illud manibus gestantibus verum lumen tuae maiestatis concede ut te agnoscentes te diligentes te quaerentes per viam virtutum ad te valeant pervenire. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: O holy Father, almighty eternal God, we beseech You to bless and sanctify this fire that we, unworthy, receive through the invocation of Your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, whom today is presented in the temple, which the just Simeon long expected to take into his arms. We know and your salvation shone as a light for the peoples; indeed, it was taught to be a light for the nations and glory for Your people Israel by a prophetic spirit. Therefore, we ask You, Lord, to bless this light and grant that all who bear it have true knowledge of Your majesty, so that they may love You, seek You on the way of virtues and be able to reach You. Through our Lord.

text: Ave gratia plena Dei Genitrix Virgo
translation_en: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you, Virgin Mary

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus et has candelas tua benedictione perfunde quatenus fidelis populus eas in manibus portans non solum exteriori lumine gaudeat sed caecitate cordis expulsa sic lumen quod in tenebris lucet apprehendat ut nequaquam a via veritatis oberret. Per eundem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present. Almighty God, bestow your blessing upon these candles so that the faithful people carrying them not only rejoice in external light, but also, expelled from the darkness of their hearts, may grasp the light that shines in the darkness, lest they ever stray from the way of truth. Through the same.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodierna die Unigenitum tuum ulnis sancti Simeonis in templo sancto tuo suscipiendum praesentasti: tuam supplices deprecamur clementiam ut has candelas quas nos famuli tui in tui nominis magnificentia suscipientes gestare cupimus luce accensas benedicere et sanctificare atque lumine supernae benedictionis accendere digneris quatenus eos tibi Domino Deo nostro offerendo et sancto igne caritatis tuae 〈accensi in templo sancto gloriae tuae〉 repraesentari mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day appeared before the holy temple with your only-begotten Son in the arms of Saint Simeon: we humbly beseech your clemency to bless and sanctify these candles which we, your servants, take up in your glorious name. We desire to carry them with lit up, to bless and sanctify, and to enlighten them with the light of the supernatural blessing, so that you may deem us worthy to offer them to you, our Lord God, with the holy fire of your love kindled in the temple of your glory.

text: Adorna thalamum tuum Sion
translation_en: Decorate your bridal chamber Zion

text: Domine Deus creator caeli et terrae rex regum et dominus dominantium: exaudi nos famulos tuos clamantes et orantes ad te. Precamur te Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui omnia ex nihilo creasti et iussu tuo per opera apum hunc liquorem ad perfectionem cerae pervenire fecisti et qui hodierna die petitionem iusti Simeonis implesti; te humiliter deprecamur ut has candelas ad usus hominum et sanitatem animarum et corporum sive in terra sive in aquis per invocationem sancti tui nominis et per intercessionem sanctae Mariae Virginis Genitricis tuae cuius hodie festa devote colimus et per preces omnium sanctorum benedicere et sanctificare digneris ut haec plebs tua illas honorifice in manibus portantes cantando teque laudando tu exaudi preces eorum de caelo sancto tuo et de sede maiestatis tuae propitiusque sis omnibus clamantibus ad te quos redemisti pretioso sanguine tuo. Qui tecum vivit.
translation_en: Lord God, creator of heaven and earth, king of kings and lord of lords: hear us, your servants, calling and praying to you. We humbly beseech you, holy Father, almighty, eternal God, who brought all things into existence out of nothing, and caused this wax liquid to reach perfection through the work of bees at your command; who today have fulfilled the petition of the just Simon; we beseech you to graciously bless and sanctify these candles for use by people and for the health of souls and bodies, whether on land or sea, through the invocation of your holy name, through the intercession of Saint Mary, Virgin Mother of yours, whose feast day we devotedly celebrate today, and through the prayers of all saints. May you deign to bless them so that this people, carrying them in their hands and singing your praise, may receive an answer to their prayers from your holy dwelling and seat of majesty, and be gracious to all who call upon you whom you have redeemed with your precious blood. He who lives with you.

text: Responsum accepit Simeon
translation_en: Simeon accepted the response

text: Benedic Domine Iesu Christe hanc creaturam cerae supplicationibus nostris et effunde ei per Crucis tuae sanctae virtutem benedictionem caelestem 〈ut〉 qui eam ad repellendas tenebras humano generi tribuisti taliter signaculo Crucis tuae fortitudinem et benedictionem accipiat ut in quibuscumque locis accensa sive posita fuerit discedat et contremiscat diabolus et fugiat pavidus cum omnibus ministris suis de habitationibus illis nec praesumat amplius inquietare vel illudere servientes Deo. — Proinde supplices quaesumus te Domine ut mittas sanctum angelum tuum Raphaëlem 〈ut〉 qui evulsit et reppulit a Sara et Tobia daemonem mortiferum 〈et〉 infestantem conterat illum et perdat de cunctis habitationibus colentium Deum de basilicis de domibus de angulis de lectulis de refectoriis de universis locis in quibuscumque Deo famulantes habitant et requiescunt dormiunt vigilant ambulant et consistunt nec valeat amplius inquietare vel pavores immittere super illos quos sancti chrismatis tui unctio fecisti esse munitos. — Benedico te cera in nomine Dei nostri et sanctae Trinitatis ut sis exterminatio diaboli et omnium contubernalium eius. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus.
translation_en:
Bless, Lord Jesus Christ, this creation of wax with our supplications and pour upon it the heavenly blessing through your holy virtue of the Cross, so that he who you gave this as a sign to repel darkness to the human race may receive it, and may the cross's strength and blessing depart and tremble the devil and flee in fear along with all his servants from these dwellings, nor dare to bother or mock any longer the servants of God.
Therefore, we humbly ask you, Lord, to send your holy angel Raphael, so that he who expelled and drove away a deadly demon from Sarah and Tobias may crush him and destroy him from all the dwellings of those who worship God - in basilicas, homes, corners, beds, dining rooms, in every place where they who serve God live and rest. They sleep, watch, walk, and stand still; let no fear be able to bother or afflict them anymore, for they have been made secure by your holy anointing of the chrism.
I bless you, wax, in the name of our God and Holy Trinity, that you may be the extinction of the devil and all his companions. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God.

text: VD et iustum est aequum et salutare nos tibi semper et ubique gratias agere Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus. Quia per serenissimam ac placidissimam Genitricem tuam cuius sacratissimum nomen per ineffabile et inenarrabile meritum stella maris interpretatur humanum genus illuminare dignatus es. Pro hoc maximo gaudio ovantes et ideo hodierna die in nostris manibus venerabiliter candelas ferentes et incessabili voce clamantes ut pro dulcissimo amore et clementissima intercessione tuae dignae Genitricis semperque Virginis Mariae nos indignos famulos tuos sed tamen pretioso sanguine tuo redemptos te aeterno ac lumine vero facias clementer perfrui. Qui vivis et regnas Deus.
translation_en: And it is right and just, and fitting and salutary for us always and everywhere to give thanks to you, Lord holy Father almighty eternal God. For through the most serene and peaceful Mother of yours whose most sacred name is interpreted as the star of the sea, which shines upon the human race with ineffable and indescribable merit. Therefore, with the greatest joy we offer candles today in our hands, and with an unceasing voice we cry out that for the sweetest love and most merciful intercession of your worthy Mother, the ever Virgin Mary, you may deign to let us who are unworthy servants, but yet redeemed by your precious blood, enjoy eternal life and true light. Who lives and reigns God.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per Moysen famulum tuum purissimum olei liquorem ad luminaria ante conspectum tuum iugiter consignanda praeparare iussisti: benedictionis tuae gratiam super hos cereos benignus infunde quatenus sic administretur lumen exterius ut te donante lumen Spiritus in nostris non desit mentibus interius. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through Moses Your servant commanded the purest oil liquid to be prepared continually for the lamps before Your face: pour forth Your blessings graciously upon these candles, so that external light may be administered thus, that with the light of the Spirit given by You, internal light may not cease in our minds. Through our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Lumen ad revelationem gentium
translation_en: Light for the revelation of the nations

text: Nunc dimittis servum tuum Domine
translation_en: Now let your servant depart, Lord.

text: Gaude Maria Virgo
translation_en: Rejoice, Mary, Virgin

text: Gabrielem archangelum
translation_en: Gabriel, the archangel

text: Senex puerum portabat
translation_en: A old man was carrying a child

text: Quod chorus vatum
translation_en: The choir of bards

text: Cum inducerent
translation_en: When they were putting on (their clothing)

text: Suscepimus Deus misericordiam tuam. 〈R.〉 In medio templi 〈tui〉.
translation_en: We have taken up, O God, your mercy. (Response.) In the midst of the temple (us).

text: Hodie beata Virgo Maria
translation_en: Today, the blessed Virgin Mary

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine preces nostras et ut digna sint munera quae oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus subsidium nobis tuae pietatis impende.
translation_en: Hear us, we beseech you, Lord, and grant that the gifts we present before your majestic eyes may be worthy. Bestow upon us your mercy's support.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sacrosancta mysteria quae pro reparationis nostrae munimine contulisti intercedente beata Maria semper Virgine et praesens nobis remedium esse facias et futurum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the most holy mysteries which you have bestowed upon us as a safeguard for our repairing, with the intercession of the blessed Mary, ever Virgin, may be present to us and may become a remedy, now and in the future.

text: Deus qui sanctum Filii tui sepulcrum fidelibus tuis per angelicum reserasti ministerium: praesta quaesumus ut omnes qui illud venerantur vitiorum de sepulcris resurgere mereantur. Per eundem.
translation_en: God who, through the ministry of angels, have opened the holy sepulcher for your faithful: grant us that all who visit it may be worthy to rise from the grave of sins. Through the same.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine hoc munus quod tibi ob Salvatoris sepulcri venerationem offerimus nosque per idem a cunctis tuere adversis ac vitiorum resurgere concede sepulcris. Per eundem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify this gift that we offer to you in honor of the Savior's sepulcher. Protect us from all dangers by the same, and grant us to rise above our sins. Through the same.

text: Venerantes quaesumus Domine sanctum Filii tui sepulcrum conserva ut quae requirunt te aspirante remedia consequi mereantur et tuae bonitatis clementia proveniente in te stabiles inveniantur. Per eundem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect the holy sepulcher of your Son, so that those who seek you may deserve to obtain the remedies they are asking for and may find stability through your mercy. Through the same.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: maiestatem tuam suppliciter exoramus ut qui huius diei sollemnitatem gloriosissimi martyris tui Blasii atque pontificis honore fecisti celebrari: fac nos quaesumus eius precibus adiuvari et per intercessionem eius ab omni periculo liberari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech your majesty that you who have made the solemnity of this day, the most glorious martyr and bishop Blaise, be helped by his prayers; and through his intercession, deliver us from all danger.

text: Suscipe Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus munera quae nos famuli tui ad honorem beatissimi Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis offerimus et preces nostras et omnium huc convenientium dignanter exaudi et cunctis nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, holy Father, almighty and eternal God, the gifts which we, your servants, offer to you in honor of the blessed Blaise, your martyr and bishop, and hear our prayers and those of all who have come here graciously. May it profit for salvation for all of us.

text: Protege Domine populum tuum dextera caelestis auxilii et per intercessionem beati Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis cuius hodie sacratissimam celebramus sollemnitatem te deprecamur ut per hoc sacrificium quod fideliter sumimus omnes huc convenientes de quacumque tribulatione ad te clamaverint tua pietate exaudire et adiuvare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people with the power of your heavenly aid. Through the intercession of Blessed Blasius, your martyr and bishop, whose solemnity we are celebrating today, we humbly pray to you that through this sacrifice which we faithfully receive, all those who have come here from whatever tribulation may cry out to you, may you deign to hear and help them with your mercy.

text: Deus qui praesentem diem honorabilem nobis in beati Blasii martyris tui festivitate fecisti: da populis tuis spiritualium munus gaudiorum et omnium fidelium mentes dirige in viam salutis aeternae.
translation_en: God, who have made this present day honorable for us on the festival of your blessed martyr Blasius: grant to your people spiritual gifts of joy, and direct all minds of the faithful on the way to eternal salvation.

text: Hostias Domine quaesumus nomini tuo consecrandas offerimus; beati Blasii martyris tui prosequatur oratio per quam nos expiari tribuas et defendi.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the hostias be consecrated in your name, which we are offering; may the prayer of blessed Basil, your martyr, procure for us forgiveness and protection.

text: Beati Blasii martyris tui quaesumus Domine intercessione nos adiuva pro cuius sollemnitate percepimus tua sancta laetantes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of your blessed martyr Blasius, you help us. We perceive the solemnity of his feast day rejoicing in your holy delight.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae beatae Agathae martyris tuae sollemnitate deferimus cuius nos confidimus patrocinio liberari.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings that we bring on the solemnity of your blessed martyr Agatha, whom we trust in her patronage to deliver us.

text: Deus qui nos devota beati Vedasti confessoris tui atque pontificis instantia ad agnitionem tui sancti nominis vocare dignatus es: concede propitius ut cuius sollemnia colimus etiam patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who deemed fit to call us by your instance to the recognition of your holy name as the devoted confessor and bishop Vedastus; graciously grant that we may not only celebrate his solemnity but also feel his patronage.

text: Hostias Domine laudis tuis altaribus adhibemus quas eius tibi patrocinio credimus commendatas cuius nos voluisti votis ad tuae pietatis pervenire notitiam.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, hosts of praise for your altars, which we believe have been commended to your patronage by whose will we desire to reach the knowledge of your mercy through our vows.

text: Beati Vedasti confessoris tui atque pontificis Domine precibus confidentes quaesumus clementiam tuam ut per ea quae sumpsimus aeterna remedia capiamus.
translation_en: Blessed are you, Vedastus, the confessor and bishop. We humbly ask, Lord, that through your intercession, we may obtain eternal relief.

text: Deus qui omnes sanctos tuos et electos pro suis quosque meritis honorare disponis: praesta quaesumus ut sanctae Helenae reginae cuius religionem et studium in sanctae Crucis manifestationem veneramur apud tuam misericordiam meritis et precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who arranges to honor all your saints and elect according to their respective merits: grant us, we beseech you, that through the merits and prayers we may be aided in venerating Queen Helena, whose religious devotion and study are honored in the manifestation of the Holy Cross in Your mercy.

text: Munera populi tui placabilis dextera tua suscipiat et sanctae Helenae suffragantibus meritis devotioni nostrae proficiant et salutem.
translation_en: May the offerings of your people, accepted by your merciful right hand, advance through the merits of Saint Helena, and grant us peace.

text: Refecti corporis sacri pretiosique libamine sanguinis 〈quaesumus〉 omnipotens Pater ut intercessionibus betae Helenae cuius commemoratione gratulamur officio cunctis malorum nostrorum sordibus exuamur.
translation_en: Nourished with the sacred body and precious garment of the blood, we humbly ask you, Almighty Father, that through the intercessions of Saint Helena, whose memory we rejoice in celebrating, we may be freed from all the filth of our sins.

text: Quos caelesti Domine refectione satiasti beatae quaesumus Scholasticae virginis tuae meritis a cunctis exime propitius adversis.
translation_en: Lord God in heaven, who have filled the blessed Scholastica with celestial food, we humbly ask that, through your mercy, you excuse her from all adversities at the merits of your virgin.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctae Soteris martyris tuae cuius humanitatis celebramus exordia martyris beneficia sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant, we implore you, Almighty God, that we may feel the blessings of the martyrdom of your saint Soteris whose beginnings of humanity we celebrate.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus admitte et dicatum tibi sacrificium beatae martyris Soteris 〈oratio〉 commendet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you graciously receive our prayers and commend the petition to you of the blessed martyr Soteria.

text: Sanctae Soteris precibus confidentes quaesumus Domine ut per ea quae sumpsimus aeterna remedia capiamus.
translation_en: With confidence in the prayers to the Holy Saviour, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through what we have received from her, we may obtain eternal remedies.

text: Sit nobis Domine reparatio mentis et corporis caeleste mysterium ut cuius exsequimur cultum sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, a celestial restoration of mind and body, so that we may feel the effect of him whose worship we perform.

text: Ad martyrum tuorum Valentis Vitalis Feliculae et Zenonis Domine festa venientes cum muneribus nomini tuo dicendis quaesumus ut illis reverentiam deferentes nobis veniam impetremus.
translation_en: Coming to the festival of your martyrs Valentinus, Vitalis, Felicitas, and Zenonis, Lord, we humbly ask that, bringing gifts and offering prayers in your name, they intercede for us so that we may obtain mercy from you.

text: Protege Domine plebem tuam et festivitatem martyrum tuorum Valentis Vitalis Feliculae et Zenonis quam nobis tradis assiduae debitam tibi persolvi precibus concede sanctorum.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and the festivity of your martyrs Valentinus, Vitalis, Felicitas, and Zenon, which we receive continually. Grant that we may discharge to you what is owed to you in fitting prayers through the merits of the saints.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui eligis infirma mundi ut fortia quaeque confundas: da nobis in festivitate sanctae martyris tuae Iulianae congrua devotione gaudere ut et potentiam tuam in eius passione laudemus et provisum nobis percipiamus auxilium.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who chooses the weak of the world to confound the strong: grant us, in the festivity of your holy martyr Julian, fitting devotion, so that we may praise your power in her passion and receive the help prepared for us.

text: In sanctae martyris tuae Iulianae passione pretiosa te Domine mirabilem praedicantes munera votiva deferimus; praesta quaesumus ut sicut eius grata tibi sunt merita sic nostrae servitutis accepta reddantur officia.
translation_en: In the passion of your saintly martyr Julian, you are wonderfully proclaimed by precious gifts offered in votive vows; grant us, we ask, that just as her merits are pleasing to you, so may our service be returned with the duties owed.

text: Libantes Domine mensae tuae beata mysteria quaesumus ut sanctae Iulianae martyris tuae interventionibus et praesentem nobis misericordiam conferant et aeternam.
translation_en: Lifting up to You, O Lord, Your blessed mysteries we humbly ask that through the intercessions of Saint Julian the Martyr and Your merciful presence, You grant us temporary mercy now and eternal grace.

text: Deus qui apostolo tuo Petro collatis clavibus regni caelestis animas ligandi atque solvendi pontificium tradidisti: concede ut intercessionis eius auxilio a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus liberemur.
translation_en: God who gave to your apostle Peter the keys of the kingdom of heaven for binding and loosing souls, grant that through his intercession we may be freed from the bonds of our sins.

text: Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus Domine preces et hostias beati Petri apostoli tibi commendet oratio et quod illius gloria celebramus nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the prayers and offerings of the blessed Apostle Peter may be presented to you by the prayers of your church. May his glory which we celebrate benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Laetificet nos quaesumus Domine munus oblatum ut sicut in apostolo tuo Petro te mirabilem praedicamus sic per illum tuae sumamus indulgentiae largitatem.
translation_en: Let us be cheered, we ask You, Lord, by the offering presented, so that, as in Your apostle Peter we marvelously proclaim You, so through him we may obtain the abundance of Your indulgence's mercy.

text: Deus qui proditoris apostatae ruinam ne apostolorum tuorum numerus sacratus perfectione careret electione beati Matthiae implesti: praesentia munera sanctifica et per ea nos gratiae tuae virtute confirma.
translation_en: God, who did not let the number of your apostles lack perfection by fulfilling the election of the blessed Matthew among those who betray you; through your presence sanctify and strengthen us with these gifts, and confirm us with the power of your grace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus castorum corporum et mentium conservator et custos: piis Ecclesiae tuae precibus adesse dignare et intercedente beata Walpurga virgine tua mentibus nostris pius illabere et spiritualis vitae nobis tribue puritatem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, the conservator and guardian of pure bodies and minds: deign to be present with your church in her prayers, and through the intercession of your blessed Virgin Walpurga, may a pious influence touch our minds, and grant us purity of spiritual life.

text: Da nobis Domine Deus noster sanctarum martyrum tuarum Perpetuae et Felicitatis palmas incessabili devotione venerari ut quas digna mente non possumus celebrare humilibus saltem frequentemus obsequiis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord our God, the palms of your holy martyrs Perpetua and Felicitas to be revered with unceasing devotion, that we who are not able to celebrate them worthily in our minds may at least frequently render them obeisance.

text: Intende quaesumus Domine munera altaribus tuis pro sanctarum tuarum Perpetuae et Felicitatis commemoratione proposita ut sicut per haec beata mysteria illis gratiam contulisti ita nobis indulgentiam largiaris.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to direct your gifts towards your altars in memory of your saints Perpetua and Felicitas. May you grant them grace through these blessed mysteries as you have granted them, so may you also grant us forgiveness.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus intercedentibus sanctis tuis ut quae ore contingimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, through the intercession of your saints, that what we touch with our mouth may be received in a pure mind.

text: Hostias Domine quas nomini tuo sacrandas offerimus sancti Gregorii prosequatur oratio per quas nos et expiari facias et defendi.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, the hosts that we are offering to be consecrated in Your name. May Saint Gregory's prayer follow for us, through which You may make us clean and protect us.

text: Praestent nobis Domine quaesumus tua sancta praesidium quo intervenientibus beati Gregorii meritis ab omnibus nos absolvant peccatis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, your holy protection, so that through the merits of blessed Gregory, they may absolve us from all sins.

text: Deus qui per absolutionem somnii beatum Ioseph de carcere eduxisti et per opera misericordiae tuae apud Pharaonem gratiam contulisti tribue quaesumus ut per eius interventionem ad gaudia aeterna pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: God who through the absolution of Joseph's dream brought him out of prison and through the work of your mercy gained favor with Pharaoh, grant us that we may merit to reach eternal joys through his intercession.

text: Munera Domine quae in commemoratione beati Ioseph prophetae tuae maiestati deferimus placatus respice et ad perpetuam tribue pervenire salutem.
translation_en: Lord, we offer to Your majesty the gifts brought on the commemoration of the prophet Blessed Joseph. Graciously look upon us and grant that we may reach everlasting salvation.

text: Divina libantes quaesumus Domine ne nos tua misericordia derelinquat et per preces iusti Ioseph debitas semper laudes referamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that Your mercy may not forsake us, and through the prayers of the just Joseph, we will always return our promised praises.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodierna die carnis eductum ergastulo beatissimum confessorem tuum Benedictum sublevasti ad caelum: concede quaesumus haec festa tuis famulis celebrantibus suorum veniam delictorum ut qui exsultantibus animis eius claritati congaudent ipso apud te interveniente consocientur et meritis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who today raised your most blessed confessor Benedict from the prison to heaven: grant us, we beseech you, that these feasts may find your servants celebrating pardon for their sins. May those who rejoice in his brilliance be pleased with him himself, and may they, with him intervening, be joined to you through his merits.

text: Paternis intercessionibus magnifici pastoris Benedicti quaesumus familiae tuae omnipotens Deus commendetur oblatio cuius vita caelestibus decoratur exemplis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, through the intercessions of your glorious pastor St. Benedict, that our offering may be commended to you whose life is adorned with heavenly examples.

text: Deus qui hodierna die Verbum tuum beatae Virginis Mariae alvo coadunare voluisti: fac nos incarnationis tuae sacratissimam sollemnitatem ita peragere ut tibi placere valeamus.
translation_en: God who on this day willed to unite Your Word with the womb of the blessed Virgin Mary: help us to celebrate Your incarnation's most sacred solemnity in such a way that we may be pleasing to You.

text: Altari tuo Domine munera superposita Spiritus Sanctus assumat qui hodie beatae Mariae viscera splendoribus suae virtutis replevit. Per Dominum.
translation_en: May the Holy Spirit accept the offerings on your altar, Lord, who today filled the womb of the blessed Mary with his shining virtue. Through the Lord.

text: Sancti Leonis confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine annua sollemnitas pietati tuae nos reddat acceptos ut per haec piae oblationis officia et illum beata retributio comitetur et gratiae tuae nobis dona conciliet.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, for the annual solemnity of your confessor and bishop Saint Leo. May it return us accepted, that through these offices of pious offerings and blessed retribution, it may accompany him and bring together for us the gifts of your grace.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum: praesta ut beati Leonis confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius venerandam celebramus festivitatem precibus indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: God, rewarder of the faithful souls: grant that we may obtain the indulgence through our prayers during the festival of your blessed confessor and pope, Leo, whose venerable feast we celebrate.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus sanctae martyris tuae Euphemiae et exsultare meritis et beneficiis referre suffragia.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that we may rejoice through the merits and benefits of your holy martyr Euphemia, and may present our supplications to you.

text: Muneribus te magnificamus Domine oblatis quibus in sanctae nobis sollemnitatibus Euphemiae et gaudia superna concilies et patrocinia sempiterna largiaris.
translation_en: We magnify You, Lord, with offerings, by which in our holy festivals of Saint Euphemia You convene heavenly joys and bestow everlasting protection.

text: Sanctae nos martyris tuae Euphemiae precatio tibi Domine grata comitetur et tuam nobis indulgentiam poscere non desistat.
translation_en: May your prayer to our holy martyr Euphrosyne, Lord, accompany us graciously, and may it not cease to ask for your mercy on our behalf.

text: Deus qui omnes sanctos tuos require post festum sanctae Agathae.
translation_en: God who requires all of your saints after the feast of Saint Agatha.

text: Sume sacrificium Domine benignus exhibitum et quod nomini tui martyris tui Adalberti sollemnitate deferimus nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: Accept, O Lord, the offering presented with kindness and what we bring for the solemnity of your martyr St. Adalbert may benefit us towards forgiveness.

text: Beati Adalberti episcopi et martyris tui Domine suffragiis exoratus percepta sacramenti tui nos virtute defende.
translation_en: We humbly ask for your intercession, O Lord, for the blessed and martyr Adalbert, bishop. Through the power of your sacrament, protect us.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut quos tuis reficis sacramentis intercedente beato Georgio martyre tuo tibi etiam placitis moribus dignanter deservire concedas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to grant us, who are refreshed by your sacraments with the intercession of Blessed George your martyr, that we may worthily serve you with pleasing behavior as well.

text: Beati Marci evangelistae tui sollemnitate tibi munera deferentes quaesumus Domine ut sicut illum praedicatio evangelica fecit gloriosum ita nos eius intercessio verbo et opere tibi reddat acceptos.
translation_en: On the solemnity of your blessed apostle Mark, we bring gifts to you. We humbly ask, Lord, that just as evangelical preaching made him glorious, so may his intercession through word and deed render us acceptable to you.

text: Satiati cibo spiritali alimoniae quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quod mysterio frequentamus intercedente beato Marco evangelista plena veritate consequamur.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord our God, to satisfy us with spiritual food, that we who are participating in the mystery may follow it, under the intercession of blessed Mark the Evangelist, fully understanding the truth.

text: Deus qui per Unigeniti Filii tui resurrectionem familiam tuam laetificare dignatus es: praesta quaesumus ut per eius venerabilem Genitricem Mariam perpetuae capiamus gaudia vitae. Per eundem.
translation_en: God, who deigned to make your family rejoice through the resurrection of your only-begotten Son: grant us, we pray, that through his venerable Mother Mary, we may partake in the joys of eternal life. Through him.

text: Ego quasi vitis fructificavi suavitatem odoris et flores mei fructus honoris et honestatis. Ego mater pulchrae dilectionis et timoris et agnitionis et sanctae spei. In me gratia omnis vitae et veritatis in me omnis spes vitae et virtutis. Transite ad me omnes qui concupiscitis me et a generationibus meis impleamini. Spiritus enim meus super mel dulcis et hereditas mea super mel et favum. Memoria mea in generationibus saeculorum. Qui edunt me adhuc esurient et qui bibunt me adhuc sitient. Qui audit me non confundetur et qui operantur in me non peccabunt. Qui elucidant me vitam aeternam habebunt.
translation_en: I have produced the sweetness of a fragrant vine and my flowers are the fruit of honor and righteousness. I am the beautiful mother of love, fear, recognition, and holy hope. In me all grace of life and truth, in me all hope of life and virtue. Come to me all who desire me and you shall be filled by my generations. My spirit is sweeter than honey and my inheritance is sweeter than honey and honeycomb. My memory shall endure through the generations of centuries. Those who eat me are still hungry and those who drink me are still thirsty. Those who hear me will not be confounded and those who work in me will not sin. Those who clarify me shall have eternal life.

text: Converti me ad viam portae exterioris sanctuarii quae respiciebat 〈ad orientem et erat clausa et dixit Dominus ad me: porta haec clausa erit non〉 aperietur. Et vir non pertransibit per eam quoniam Dominus Deus Israël ingressus est per eam eritque clausa principi. Princeps ipse sedebit in ea ut comedat panem coram Domino per viam vestibulum portae ingredietur et per viam egredietur.
translation_en: Convert me to the way of the exterior gate of the sanctuary which faced east and was closed, and the Lord said to me: "This closed gate shall be opened; it shall not remain closed." No man shall pass through it, for the Lord God of Israel has entered by it, so it shall remain closed to the ruler. The ruler himself will sit on it to eat bread before the Lord, entering by the way of the vestibule and going out by the way.

text: Stabant autem iuxta crucem Iesu mater eius et soror matris eius Maria Cleophae et Maria Magdalene. Cum vidisset ergo Iesus matrem et discipulum stantem quem diligebat dicit matri suae: Mulier ecce filius tuus. Deinde dicit discipulo: Ecce mater tua. Et ex illa hora accepit eam discipulus in sua.
translation_en: And standing by the cross of Jesus were his mother and his mother's sister, Mary of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene. When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing there, He said to His mother: Woman, behold your son. Then He said to the disciple: Behold your mother. From that hour, the disciple took her into his care.

text: Hostia quaesumus Domine praesentis sacrificii quam per gloriosam resurrectionem Filii tui offerimus intercedente pro nobis beata Maria semper Virgine nostrae devotionis proficiat semper saluti.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the hostia (host) of this present sacrifice, which we offer through the glorious resurrection of your Son, may always benefit our devotion and always bring salvation, with the intercession of blessed Mary, ever Virgin, our devotion profiting continually.

text: Munera divina quae sumpsimus Domine resurrectio Filii tui in nobis compleat quae complendo beatae Mariae semper Virginis precibus nos in melius deducat.
translation_en: The divine gifts which we have received, Lord, may the resurrection of Your Son complete them within us. As they are completed, may they guide us, through the prayers of the Blessed Mary, Ever-Virgin, towards a better state.

text: Deus qui nos exsultantibus animis Pascha tuum celebrare tribuisti: fac nos quaesumus et temporalibus gaudere subsidiis et intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis aeternitatis affectibus gratulari. Per eundem.
translation_en: God, who has granted us to celebrate Your Easter with joyful spirits: grant us, we ask, to enjoy temporal joys and to rejoice in the feelings of eternity through all your saints. Through the same.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui de paschalibus gaudiis nos laetificas: per interventum omnium sanctorum tuorum caelesti clero nobis pietate succurre.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who delights us with the joys of Easter: by the intervention of all your saints, come to our aid with your mercy through the heavenly clergy.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut de paschalibus fecisti temporalibus gratulari sic nos in aeterna beatitudine cum omnibus sanctis tuis visionis tuae facias intuitu pacifico perfrui. Per eundem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that as you have made people rejoice temporally at Easter, so may we in eternal beatitude with all your saints be allowed to contemplate your vision with a peaceful view. Through the same.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente beato Vitale martyre tuo et a cunctis adversitatibus liberemur in corpore et a cunctis cogitationibus mundemur in mente.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty God, that through the intercession of Blessed Vitalis your martyr and be freed from all adversities in body, and be cleansed from all worldly thoughts in mind.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine auxilium validum qui dedisti pro nobis in Cruce pretium magnum ut quos mors Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi redemit eorum vita te digne glorificet.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, powerful aid, which Thou hast given to us in the Cross as a great price, that those whom the death of Thy Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, has redeemed, may glorify Thee worthy of life.

text: Super has hostias quaesumus Domine benedictio copiosa descendat quae et sanctificationem nobis clementer operetur et de martyrum tuorum nos sollemnitate laetificet.
translation_en: Upon these offerings, we humbly ask you, Lord; may a rich blessing descend that also gently sanctifies us and fills us with joy from the feast of your martyrs.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Floriani martyris tui gloriosa sollemnitate laetificas: solita pietatis largitate concede benignus ut cuius famosum victoriae triumphum pio amore veneramur in terris societatis eius laetitiam adipisci te largiente mereamur in caelis. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum qui tecum vivit.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the annual feast of your glorious martyr Florian: grant, according to Your usual generosity, that we may, through our pious love, experience the joy of his society on earth. May we deserve to receive it from You in heaven, by Your grace. Through Our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives with You.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine populo tuo ut beati Gothardi confessoris tui atque pontificis merita praeclara suscipiens ad impetrandam misericordiam tuam semper eius patrociniis adiuvemur et meritis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to be present for Your people. May we be aided in our constant appeal for Your mercy through the intercession of the blessed confessor and bishop, Gothard, and through his outstanding merits.

text: Sancti Gothardi confessoris tui atque pontificis 〈nos〉 quaesumus Domine ubique laetificent ut dum eius merita recolimus patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the merits of your confessor and bishop St. Gothard may everywhere rejoice us, so that as we remember his patronage, we may feel it.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut de perceptis muneribus gratias exhibentes intercedente beato Gothardo confessore tuo atque pontifice beneficia potiora sumamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty God, that, presenting our thanks for the gifts received, through the intercession of the blessed Gothard, your confessor and pope, we may obtain greater blessings.

text: Sancti confessoris tui Iuvenalis nobis Domine quaesumus obtineat suffragium ut nostrae humilitatis obsequium semper fiat acceptum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the prayers of your confessed saint Juvenal may obtain for us a favorable hearing, so that our submission to humility is always accepted.

text: Laeti Domine sumpsimus sacramenta caelestia quae nobis intercedente beato Iuvenali confessore tuo atque pontifice uberius credimus profutura.
translation_en: With joy, we have taken the heavenly sacraments that we more firmly believe, through your blessed Juvenal, our confessor and pope, will bring us greater profit.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia alimenta percepimus intercedentibus sanctis tuis Gordiano atque Epimacho per haec contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that those saints of yours, Gordian and Epimachus, who have received heavenly sustenance, may intercede for us and protect us against all adversities through these [prayers or offerings].

text: Semper nos Domine martyrum tuorum Nerei Achillei atque Pancratii foveat quaesumus beata sollemnitas et tuo dignos reddat obsequio.
translation_en: We beseech you, O Lord, may your blessed solemnity always protect the martyrs Nereus, Achilles, and Pancras. May it grant us worthy service in return.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum Domine Nerei Achillei et Pancratii tibi grata confessio et munera nostra commendet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper obtineat.
translation_en: Lord, the confession and offerings of your saints Nereus, Achilles, and Pancras are dedicated to you. May their devotion always secure your mercy for us.

text: Quaesumus Domine ut beatorum martyrum tuorum Nerei Achillei atque Pancratii deprecationibus sacramenta quae sumpsimus ad tuae nobis proficiant placationis augmentum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of your blessed martyrs, Nereus, Achilleus, and Pancratius, the sacraments we have received may bring about an increase in our reconciliation with you.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine ad eorum nos gaudia aeterna pertingere de quorum nos virtute tribuis annua sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that their eternal joys may reach us, whom we annually rejoice in by their virtue.

text: Deus qui beatum Gengulfum martyrem tuum pro tui nominis amore agonizantem aeterna gloria sublimasti: praesta quaesumus ut pro nobis intercedat in caelis quem pro te veneramur in terris.
translation_en: God, who elevated your blessed servant Gengulf to eternal glory for his love of your name while he was fighting as a martyr: grant us that we may be helped by him in heaven whom we revered on earth, that he may intercede for us.

text: Accepta sit quaesumus in conspectu tuo Domine nostrae humilitatis oblatio sanctique martyris tui Bonifatii atque sacerdotis fiat supplicatione salutaris pro cuius sollemnitate tuae maiestati defertur.
translation_en: May this offering of our humility, Lord, be accepted in your sight, together with the sacred martyr Boniface and the priest. May their prayerful supplication bring a healing salvation, for whose solemnity your majesty is being honored.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut interveniente sancto Bonifatio martyre tuo atque pontifice in cuius festivitate haec caelestia sumpsimus sacramenta et tua in in nobis semper dona multiplices et vitam nostram ab omni adversitate defendas.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, Almighty God, that with the intervention of Saint Boniface, your martyr and bishop, in whose feast day we have received these heavenly sacraments, may your blessings always be multiplied upon us, and protect our life from every adversity.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatae Potentianae virginis tuae sollemnia recensentes meritis ipsius protegamur et precibus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the solemnity of your blessed Potentia, we may be protected by her merits and prayers.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine tibi dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato Urbano martyre tuo per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the offerings dedicated to you. Through the intercession of blessed Urban, your martyr, we pray that you may hear us favorably.

text: Beati Urbani martyris tui atque pontificis Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporali celebramus actione perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, through the intercession of your blessed martyr and bishop Urban, we humbly ask that what we celebrate temporarily in this world may be attained by us eternally with salvation.

text: Hostia haec quaesumus Domine quam sanctorum tuorum nataliciis recensentes offerimus et vincula pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis 〈misericordiae〉 dona conciliet.
translation_en: This host we beseech You, Lord, which remembering the birthdays of Your saints, we offer; may it release us from the bonds of wickedness and may Your mercy reconcile to us.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine sanctorum tuorum Primi et Feliciani semper festa sectari quorum suffragiis protectionis tuae dona sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that we may always follow the festivals of your saints Primus and Felician, whose intercessions we may feel the effects of your protection.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod pro sanctis martyribus tuis Primo et Feliciano proponit nostra devotio eorum merita nobis augeat te donante suffragiis.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, that for your holy martyrs Primus and Felician, our devotion proposes, may their merits increase for us, through you granting us your intercessions.

text: Sumpti Domine sacramenti perpetua nos tuitio non derelinquat et intercedentibus sanctis tuis Primo et Feliciano noxia semper a nobis cuncta depellat.
translation_en: Lord, may the perpetual Sacrament not abandon us to protection and through your saints Primus and Felicianus may every harm be always driven away from us.

text: Deus cuius Spiritu monente beatus Barnabas apostolus una cum sancto Paulo segregatus est electione superna ad praedicandum gentibus evangelium Christi Filii tui: concede propitius ut gentium populus eum pium apud misericordiam tuam sentiat intercessorem quem aeternae vitae te largiente meruit habere praedicatorem.
translation_en: God, whose Spirit prompting, blessed Barnabas the apostle was chosen apart by a supreme election to preach the gospel of Christ Your Son to the gentiles: grant graciously that the people of the nations may feel him a pious intercessor whom You, who bestow eternal life, granted to be the preacher.

text: Praesentia munera quaesumus Domine placido vultu intuere et praesta ut Sancti Spiritus perfundantur benedictione et in nostris cordibus eam dilectionem validius infundant per quam sanctus Barnabas apostolus tuus omnia oblectamenta mundi devicit.
translation_en: In Your gracious presence, we humbly ask, Lord, that You look favorably upon us with a peaceful countenance and grant that the Holy Spirit may be poured out on them with blessings, and that they may more strongly infuse within our hearts that love by which your apostle Saint Barnabas overcame all worldly pleasures.

text: Beati Barnabae apostoli tui nos quaesumus Domine festa tueantur et eius tuae maiestati commendet oratio veneranda.
translation_en: Blessed be your apostle Barnabas, we humbly ask you, Lord. May his feast days protect us and may a reverent prayer commend us to your majesty.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii quaesumus Domine natalicia nobis votiva resplendeant et quod illis contulit excellentia sempiterna fructibus nostrae devotionis accrescat.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the natal feasts of your saints Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor and Nazarius shine upon us with their vowed gifts, and may their eternal excellence increase the fruits of our devotion.

text: Pro sanctorum tuorum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii sanguine venerando hostias tibi sollemniter immolamus tua mirabilia pertractantes per quae talis est perfecta victoria.
translation_en: We offer solemnly to you the sacrifices of our holy ones Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor, and Nazarius, venerating their blood. We recount your wonders through which such a perfect victory is achieved.

text: Sacramentis quaesumus Domine muniamur acceptis et sanctorum tuorum intercessione contra omnes nequitias armis caelestibus protegamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to fortify us with the sacraments and protect us with the arms of heaven through the intercession of your saints against all wickedness.

text: Deus qui beatum Vitum in puerili adhuc aetate triumphantem coronasti et Modestum atque Crescentiam eius meritis coaequasti: concede propitius ut quorum natalicia colimus eorum etiam patrociniis apud te adiuvemur.
translation_en: God who crowned the blessed life, still a child, triumphant Vitus, and made Modestus and Crescentia equal to him through his merits: grant us graciously that we may celebrate their natal days and also be helped by their patronage before you.

text: Haec munera quaesumus omnipotens Deus pro tui nominis invocatione sanctifica et per sanctorum martyrum tuorum Viti Modesti et Crescentiae intercessione contra omnes nequitias armis caelestibus protegamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God, through your invocation, to sanctify these gifts and protect us by the intercession of your saints Vitus, Modestus, and Crescentia against all wickedness, that we may be shielded with heavenly arms.

text: Sit nobis Domine sacramenti tui certa salvatio quae cum beatorum martyrum Viti Modesti et Crescentiae meritis imploratur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, a certain salvation through your sacrament, which is sought with the merits of the blessed martyrs Vitus, Modestus, and Crescentia.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sanctorum martyrum tuorum Marci et Marcelliani natalicia colimus a cunctis malis imminentibus eorum intercessionibus liberemur.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the nativity of your saints Marc and Marcellian, may be freed from all impending dangers through their intercessions.

text: Munera Domine tibi dicata sanctifica et intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis Marco et Marcelliano per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings dedicated to you be sanctified. Through your holy martyrs Mark and Marcellian, we humbly request that you turn towards us.

text: Salutaris tui Domine munere repleti supplices exoramus ut cuius laetamur gustu renovemur effectu.
translation_en: With your gracious gift, Lord, we who are filled with supplication, humbly entreat you. May the one whom we rejoice in taste renew us effectively.

text: Oblatis quaesumus Domine placare muneribus et intercedentibus sanctis tuis 〈a cunctis nos defende periculis.〉
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look favorably upon the offerings and through your saints intervene for us. Defend us all from all dangers.

text: 〈Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et intercedentibus sanctis tuis〉 caelestis remedii faciat esse consortes.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, purges us from sin, and through the intercession of your saints, may make us sharers of heavenly remedy.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut mysteriorum virtute sanctorum et intercessione beatorum martyrum Gervasii et Protasii vita nostra fulciatur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that through the power of the mysteries and the intercession of the blessed martyrs Gervasius and Protasius, our life may be strengthened.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Iacobi apostoli tui cuius doctrina populus ad confessionem deitatis tuae est institutus eius suffragantibus meritis divinae serviat unitati.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to grant that the blessed apostle James whose teaching instigated the people to confess your deity may through his merits serve the unity with divine service.

text: Supplicationibus beati apostoli tui Iacobi Ecclesiae tuae Domine commendetur oblatio cuius magnificis praedicationibus erudiatur.
translation_en: Your Church, Lord, may be commended in supplications to your blessed apostle James. May the offering be educated by his magnificent preachings.

text: Sacris Domine mysteriis expiati quaesumus ut intercedente beato Ioanne Baptista et veniam consequamur et gratiam.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that through the merits of the holy mysteries, with the intercession of blessed John the Baptist, we may obtain forgiveness and grace.

text: Munera populi tui Domine propitiatus intende et beati Ioannis Baptistae cuius nos tribuis praevenire sollemnia fac gaudere suffragiis.
translation_en: Lord, graciously consider the offerings of your people and let blessed John the Baptist, whose feast we are about to celebrate, rejoice with our prayers.

text: Tua Domine muneribus altaria cumulamus sancti Ioannis nativitatem honore debito celebrantes qui Salvatorem mundi et cecinit affuturum et adesse monstravit. Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum.
translation_en: On the altar, Lord, we heap your offerings as we celebrate the nativity of Saint John with fitting honor, who sang about the coming and announced the presence of the Savior of the world, our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son.

text: Divini muneris largitate 〈satiati〉 quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercessione beati Ioannis Baptistae generatione laetitiam per quem suae regenerationis cognovit auctorem. Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord our God, in Your bountiful gift of grace, that through the intercession of blessed John the Baptist, born to rejoice, who came to know the Author of his regeneration through him. Our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son.

text: Hostias tibi Domine sanctorum martyrum Ioannis et Pauli dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Accept, Lord, these offerings dedicated to the holy martyrs John and Paul, and graciously bestow upon us their intercession as perpetual assistance.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sanctorum tuorum Ioannis et Pauli sollemnia celebrantes caelestia sacramenta; praesta quaesumus ut quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the festivities of your saints John and Paul, celebrating celestial sacraments; grant us, we ask, that what we temporarily possess may lead to eternal joys.

text: Deus qui beatum Ladizlaum regem 〈nostrum〉 et confessorem tuum miro miserationis modo delinquentem ad veniam et iustum transtulisti ad gloriam: praesta quaesumus ut quem rectorem habuimus in terris eum modo protectorem sentiamus in caelis.
translation_en: God, who in a wonderful act of mercy transferred our king Saint Ladislaus and your confessor from sin to forgiveness, and from justice to glory: grant us that we may now feel him as a protector in heaven whom we had as a ruler on earth.

text: Hostias piae placationis clementiae tuae offerimus omnipotens Deus ut beati Ladizlai regis nostri et confessoris tui meritis et precibus placatus accipias et clementer dispenses.
translation_en: We offer you, Almighty God, the holy offerings of our devout pleading, that you may be graciously appeased for the merits and prayers of our blessed King Ladislaus and your confessor, and that you may grant us favorably and mercifully.

text: Deus qui beato Ladizlao regi et confessori tuo post terrenae dignitatis fastigium aeternitatis lauream contulisti: concede propitius ut qui eius merita venerantur in terris ipsi quoque in gloria consocientur in caelis.
translation_en: God who bestowed upon the blessed Ladislaus, your king and confessor, the laurel of eternity after the dignity of earthly rule: grant favorably that those who venerate his merits may also be associated with him in glory in heaven.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente beato Ladizlao rege et confessore tuo nos per haec a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, we offer these gifts; sanctify them. Through the intercession of Blessed King Ladislaus and your confessor, cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Sacrificium quod tuae obtulimus maiestati praesta quaesumus ut intercedente beato et glorioso rege et confessore tuo Ladizlao ad nostrarum remedium transeat animarum.
translation_en: We pray that the sacrifice which we have offered to Your majesty may be granted, through the intercession of the blessed and glorious King and Confessor, Ladislaus, for the remedy of our souls.

text: Annue nobis Domine ut animae famuli tui Leonis haec prosit oblatio; quam immolando totius mundi tribuisti relaxari delicta.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the soul of your servant Leo may benefit from this offering; for when it was offered, you granted that sins be released throughout the world.

text: Laeti sumpsimus Domine sacramenta caelestia; quaesumus intercedente beato Leone confessore tuo atque pontifice ad vitam nobis proficiant sempiternam.
translation_en: We have joyfully received, Lord, the heavenly sacraments; we humbly ask, through the intercession of blessed Leo, your confessor and pope, may it lead us to eternal life.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli praedicatione docuisti: da nobis quaesumus ut quorum natalicia colimus eorum apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who taught your Church through the preaching of your apostles Peter and Paul: grant us that we may feel their patronage as we celebrate their nativities.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam apostoli tui Petri fide et nomine consecrasti quique beatum illi Paulum ad praedicandum gentibus gloriam tuam sociare dignatus es: concede ut omnes qui ad apostolorum sollemnia convenerunt spiritali remuneratione ditentur.
translation_en: God, who consecrated Your Church by the faith and name of Your apostle Peter, and who deemed it fitting to associate the blessed Paul with him for preaching among the gentiles: grant that all who have gathered together for the solemnity of the apostles may be enriched spiritually.

text: Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus Domine preces et hostias apostolica commendet oratio ut quod pro illius gloria celebramus nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your church may commend our prayers and offerings to the apostolic prayer, so that what we celebrate for its glory may benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Deus qui beatum Ioannem Baptistam Unigenito tuo in cordibus hominum viam praeparare direxisti: eius quaesumus interventu mansionem tibi placitam in nobis praeparare digneris.
translation_en: God who directed the way in the hearts of men for your beloved John the Baptist, the Unogenito, to prepare: we humbly ask that through his intervention, you would deign to prepare a pleasing dwelling place within us.

text: Beati Ioannis Baptistae precibus et meritis haec oblatio nostrae servitutis tibi quaesumus Domine acceptabilis et nobis efficiatur salutaris.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our offering of service, through the prayers and merits of St. John the Baptist, may be acceptable to you and beneficial for us.

text: Deus qui in beati Ioannis Baptistae commemoratione nos tuis mysteriis refecisti: ipsius quaesumus precibus et meritis omnium criminum nostrorum sordes absterge et tui Spiritus gratiam mentibus nostris dignanter infunde.
translation_en: God, who in the commemoration of the blessed John the Baptist refreshed us through your mysteries: we humbly ask that through his prayers and merits, you wash away all the stains of our sins, and graciously bestow your Spirit upon our minds.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in hac festivitate anniversaria Martinum apostolicum virum innumeris virtutibus declaratum summum pontificem et magnum patronum populo tuo ordinare voluisti: concede propitius ut apud misericordiam paternae pietatis tuae meritis eius et intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who in this festive anniversary have shown Martin the apostolic man to be preeminent in countless virtues and have wished to ordain him as supreme pontiff and great patron for your people: grant us, we beseech you, graciously, that through the merits of his person and the aid of his intercessions, we may be supported under the mercy of your fatherly compassion.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus munera maiestati tuae oblata sanctifica; per intercessionem beati confessoris tui atque pontificis Martini ad perpetuam fac nobis proficere salutem.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, may the gifts presented to your majesty be sanctified; through the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop Martin, may we continually progress in everlasting salvation.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui inter cetera miracula sancti confessoris tui atque pontificis Martini etiam in die translationis sancti corporis illius angelicam revelationem populo tuo demonstrasti: praesta nobis petentibus huius patroni suffragantibus meritis ut ea quae sunt tibi placia digno affectu ac devotis 〈mentibus〉 exsequamur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who among other miracles of your holy confessor and bishop Martin, on the day of his translation, also showed to your people an angelic revelation: grant us, who are asking through the merits of this patron, that we may faithfully and devoutly carry out those things pleasing to you with a worthy affection.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine preces et munera; quae ut tuo digna sint conspectui apostolorum tuorum precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, our prayers and gifts; that they may be worthy of your sight, we are helped by the prayers of your apostles.

text: Protege Domine populum tuum et apostolorum tuorum quaesumus patrocinio confidentem perpetua defensione conserva.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and your apostles, we pray; with their patronage, may you keep them under constant defense.

text: Propitiare Domine populo tuo ut quem in frequentatione beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui Willibaldi tribuis interesse protectione perpetua semper facias esse securum.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your people that you may always grant them to enjoy the perpetual protection of the blessed priest and confessor Willibald, and may they always be secure.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum Domine Kiliani sociorumque eius intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporaliter gerimus perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, through the intercession of your blessed martyrs, St. Kilian and his companions, we humbly ask that you grant us, who are engaged in temporal affairs, eternal salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sanctis tuis Kiliano sociisque eius non solum credere in Filium tuum sed etiam pro eodem pati donasti: nostrae quoque fragilitati divinum praetende subsidium ut misericordiam sempiternam qua illi felices animas exhalarunt nos saltem sincera confessione consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who granted your saints Cyril and his companions not only to believe in your Son, but also to suffer for him: may you extend divine aid to our frailty as well, so that we might deserve at least to obtain eternal mercy which those blessed souls exhaled, through sincere confession.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui gloriosos martyres Ianuarium Felicem Philippum Silvanum Alexandrum Vitalem atque Martialem fortes in sua confessione cognovimus pios apud te in nostra intercessione sentiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that we who have known the glorious martyrs Januarius, Felicitas, Philippus, Silvanus, Alexandrus, Vitalis, and Martialis as brave in their confession, may feel them pious on our behalf in your presence during our intercession.

text: Sacrificiis praesentibus Domine quaesumus intende placatus ut intercedentibus sanctis tuis et devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: With the sacrifices present, Lord, we humbly ask that you attend, pleased, so that through your saints who intercede for us and our devotion, it may profit for our salvation.

text: Deus qui sanctam nobis huius diei sollemnitatem in honore sancti Benedicti confessoris tui atque abbatis consecrasti: adesto familiae tuae precibus et da ut cuius translationem celebramus eius merito et auxilio sublevemur.
translation_en: God who on this day sanctified for us the solemnity of your confessor and abbot Saint Benedict: be present with your family's prayers, and grant that we, whom we celebrate the translation of, may be uplifted by his merit and help.

text: Protegat nos Domine cum tui perceptione sacramenti beatus Benedictus abba pro nobis intercedendo ut et conversationis eius insignia et intercessionis ipsius percipiamus suffragia.
translation_en: May the Lord protect us with the blessing of blessed Benedict, the Abbot, interceding for us, so that we may receive the benefits of his way of life and his intercessions.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus pro beatae virginis Margaritae martyrio oblata et eius nobis sanctitatem et corporum obtineat 〈sanitatem〉.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we beseech You for the martyrdom of the blessed Virgin Margaret; may her holiness and health (or well-being) be granted to us through it.

text: Huius Domine perceptione sacramenti et beatae Margaritae virginis intercessione et tu in nobis manere dignare et nos vicissim in te manere concede.
translation_en: Lord, with the reception of this sacrament and the intercession of blessed Margaret the Virgin, deign to remain with us, and grant that we may remain in you in return.

text: Deus cuius praeconia sancti apostoli confessi sunt per orbem divisi: da nobis famulis tuis quaesumus ut quorum gaudemus doctrinis eorum meritis et precibus adiuvemur in caelis.
translation_en: God, whose praises the holy apostles have confessed throughout the world: grant us, we pray, your servants, that through the merits and prayers of them whom we rejoice in their teachings, we may be helped in heaven.

text: Mitte quaesumus Domine Spiritum tuum Sanctum qui sanctorum tuorum linguas ad praedicandum fecit disertas ut et haec praesentia munera sanctificet et ad haec percipiendum cordium nostrorum purget habitacula.
translation_en: Send we beseech Thee, Lord, Thy Holy Spirit, who hath made the tongues of Thy saints eloquent for preaching, that He may also sanctify these gifts here present and cleanse the dwellings of our hearts to perceive them.

text: Beato confessore tuo Alexio intercedente tibi nos Domine iugiter servire concede et ab omni semper iniquitate custodi.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you to grant that we may always serve you, with your blessed confessor Alexander interceding for us. And guard us forever from every iniquity.

text: Deus qui beatissimum Benedictum confessorem tuum spiritalis disciplinae nobis doctorem dedisti: da quaesumus ipso interveniente ut salutaria eius monita adimplere et ad promissa mereamur praemia pervenire.
translation_en: God who gave us the blessed Benedict as a teacher in the spiritual discipline of your teachings: grant, we ask, through his intervention, that we may fulfill his salutary advice and merit to attain the promised rewards.

text: Deus qui beatum Eliam prophetam martyris virtutibus decoratum igneo curru sublevasti ad caelum: tribue fidelibus tuis ipsius meritis adiuvari et patrociniis communiri.
translation_en: God who adorned the blessed Elijah, the prophet and martyr, with your mighty chariot and lifted him up to heaven: grant assistance to your faithful through his merits, and let them be enfolded in his patronage.

text: Hanc hostiam salutarem Domine quaesumus tuae deitatis virtute sanctifica te beatae Eliae prophetae suffragiis omnibus proficient fidelibus Christianis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that by the power of your divinity, you may sanctify this offering. May it be assisted by the intercession of the blessed prophet Elijah for all progressing faithful Christians.

text: Divino quaesumus Domine reparati mysterio interveniente beato Elia propheta tuo utriusque capiamus incrementum spirituum et corporum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intervention of your prophet Elisha, that we may receive increase in both spiritual and bodily gifts.

text: Hostia Domine quaesumus quam in sanctorum tuorum natalicia recensentes tibi offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offering of a host which we present to you on the feast days of your saints may free us from the bonds of our wickedness and unite us with your mercy.

text: Quaesumus Domine salutaribus repleti mysteriis ut cuius sollemnia colimus eius orationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, filled with salutary mysteries, that as we celebrate the solemnities of the one for whom they are celebrated, may his prayers aid us.

text: Deus qui beatum Felicianum pontificem et martyrem sanctorum tuorum meritis coaequasti: concede propitius ut qui commemorationis eius festa percolimus vitae quoque imitemur exempla.
translation_en: God, who by the merits of the blessed Felician, bishop and martyr, made him equal to your saints: graciously grant that we who celebrate his feast day may also emulate his examples in our lives.

text: Deus qui beatae Mariae Magdalene mentem tanto tuae dilectionis ardore inflammasti ut Iesu Christo Filio tuo obsequia humanitatis impendere sincero festinaret affectu: concede propitius ut apud misericordiam tuam pro nostris reatibus intercedat quae eundem Filium tuum Dominum nostrum prima omnium videre meruit a mortuis resurgentem.
translation_en: God, who inflamed the mind of the blessed Mary Magdalene with such a great fire of your love that she hastened to offer sincere service to Jesus Christ, your Son, in humanity: grant us graciously that she may intercede for us at your mercy for our sins, who was the first among all to see your same Son, our Lord, risen from the dead.

text: Beatae Mariae Magdalene quaesumus Domine suffragiis adiuvemur; cuius precibus exoratus quatriduanum fratrem eius mortuum ab inferis resuscitasti.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to help us through the intercession of Blessed Mary Magdalene; whose prayers, when we were beseeched, raised your brother from the dead after three days in the grave.

text: Sumpto Domine unico ac singulari remedio corpore scilicet et pretioso sanguine tuo ab omnibus malis beatae Mariae Magdalene patrociniis exuamur.
translation_en: With Your unique and precious remedy, Lord, our bodies are freed from all evils by the patronage of blessed Mary Magdalene.

text: Deus qui beatum Apollinarem sacerdotem et martyrem errantibus populis destinare dignatus es veritatis doctorem: eius meritis et intercessione fac nos quaesumus a mundi pravitatibus conversos fidei ac iustitiae operibus tibi devotos.
translation_en: God, who deemed it worthy to destine the blessed Apolinaris, the priest and martyr, as a teacher of truth to wandering people: through his merits and intercession, make us pray, that converted from the wickednesses of the world, we may be devoted to you by works of faith and justice.

text: Hostias exhibentes ad gloriam Domine tui nominis honorem beati Apollinaris martyris tui pro nobis intercedentis venerantes quaesumus ut eiusdem nos continuis facias interventionibus in tua misericordia gratulari.
translation_en: Offering presents to the glory of your name, Lord, we honor the blessed martyr Apollinaris, interceding for us. With reverence, we ask that you make him continually intervene on our behalf in your mercy, so that we may rejoice in his favor.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beati Apollinaris sacerdotis et martyris tui passione salutarem nobis dedisti laetitiam: praesta quaesumus ut conversationis eius insignia sectando intercessione eiusdem iugiter gloriemur.
