translation_en: God, who on this day granted us joy through the saving passion of the blessed Apolinaris, your priest and martyr: grant us, we ask, that we may continually glory in the insignia of his conduct by his same intercession.

text: Sanctae Christinae martyris tuae Domine 〈festa〉 recolentes preces offerimus hostiam immolamus; praesta quaesumus ut cum praesidio temporali et vitam nobis praebeant et incrementa perpetua.
translation_en: Remembering the festival of Saint Christina, Lord, we present our prayers and sacrifice; grant us we beseech you, with temporal protection and bestow life upon us, and everlasting increase.

text: Quaesumus virtutum caelestium Deus ut sacrificia pro sanctae martyris tuae passione delata desideriorum nos temporalium doceant habere contemptum et habere 〈dona faciant caelestium gaudiorum〉.
translation_en: We ask you, God of heavenly virtues, that the sacrifices offered for the sufferings of your holy martyr may teach us to have contempt for temporal desires and grant us the joy of heavenly pleasures.

text: Oblationes populi tui quaesumus Domine apostoli tui Iacobi passio beata conciliet et quae nostris non apta sunt meritis fiant tibi placita eius deprecatione.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through your apostle James, that the blessed passion of your people might be acceptable to you, and that what is not fitting for our merits might become pleasing to you through his intercession.

text: Beati apostoli tui Iacobi in cuius hodie festivitate corpore et sanguine tuo nos refecisti quaesumus Domine intercessione nos adiuva pro cuius sollemnitate percepimus tua sancta laetantes.
translation_en: Blessed are thy apostles Thou James, on whose feast day today Thou hast restored us both in body and blood, we beseech Thee, Lord. Grant us help through his intercession, for whom we have perceived the solemnity, we rejoice in Thy holy joy.

text: Beati Christophori martyris tui quaesumus omnipotens Deus deprecatio apud misericordiam tuam pro nobis interveniat et aeternae beatitudinis praemia nobis obtineat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that the supplication for your martyr Christopher may intervene at your mercy for us, and grant us the rewards of eternal beatitude.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod pro sancto martyre tuo Christophoro celebrat nostra devotio eius meritis nobis augeat te donante suffragium.
translation_en: The sacrifice, Lord, that our devotion offers for your holy martyr Christopher, may through his merits be increased by you granting us your intercession.

text: Adiuvet nos quaesumus Domine beati Christophori martyris tui sancta precatio ut a nostris flagitiis liberati ad aeternam mereamur pervenire gloriam.
translation_en: May your prayer, Lord, for the sake of the blessed Christopher, your martyr, help us; so that, freed from our sins, we may be worthy to attain eternal glory.

text: Deus qui in septem dormientibus tuae virtutis potentiam et resurrectionis testimonium mundo declarasti: da nobis quaesumus eorum meritis in caelestis patriae requiem et cum ipsis perpetuam possidere mansionem.
translation_en: God who, in the seven sleepers, showed the power of your virtue and the testimony of resurrection to the world: grant us, we ask, through their merits, eternal rest in the heavenly fatherland and with them, an everlasting dwelling place.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Pantaleonis martyris tui temporali sollemnitate gaudemus gaudiis etiam aeternae vitae perfruamur.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that we who rejoice in the temporal festival of your blessed martyr Pantaleon, may also experience the joys of eternal life.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro sancti martyris tui commemoratione deferentes suppliciter exoramus ut nobis peccatorum nostrorum indulgentiam pariterque mentis et corporis conferant sanitatem.
translation_en: Bringing before you, Lord, hosts for the remembrance of your holy martyr, we humbly entreat that you grant us forgiveness for our sins and health of both mind and body.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Pantaleonis martyris tui natalicia colimus mysteriis celebrantes pro nostra infirmitate propitiationis tuae medelam nobis acquiramus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, O almighty Lord God, that as we celebrate the feast of your holy martyr Pantaleon, we may acquire a remedy for our infirmities through the mysteries, and receive your mercy.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sicut populus Christianus sanctorum martyrum tuorum Felicis Simplicii Faustini et Beatricis temporali sollemnitate congaudet ita perfruatur aeterna et quod votis celebrat comprehendat effectu.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that as the Christian people rejoice on the temporal feast of your saints Felicitas, Simplicius, Faustinus and Beatrix, they may also experience eternal joy. May what they celebrate with their vows be fulfilled in reality.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro sanctorum martyrum Felicis Simplicii Faustini et Beatricis commemoratione deferimus suppliciter obsecrantes ut et indulgentiam nobis pariter conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, hosts for the remembrance of the holy martyrs Felicitas, Simplicius, Faustinus, and Beatrix, humbly entreating that you grant us forgiveness together with salvation.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum Felicis Simplicii Faustini et Beatricis caelestibus mysteriis celebrata sollemnitas indulgentiam nobis tuae propitiationis acquirat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty God, that the solemnity of your saints Felicitas, Simplicius, Faustinus, and Beatrix celebrated in celestial mysteries may obtain for us indulgence through your propitiation.

text: Munera tibi Domine pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum Abdon et Sennes occisione deferimus qui dum finiuntur in terris facti sunt caelesti luce perpetui.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the gifts for Your saintly martyrs Abdon and Sennen, who, while ending their lives on earth, were made perpetual light in heaven.

text: Sancti martyres Abdon et Sennes temporalem mortem non timuerunt subire; eorum nos meritis quaesumus ab omni periculo mortis eripe et aeternae vitae beatitudinem misericorditer nobis concede.
translation_en: We beseech the holy martyrs Abdon and Sennes, who did not fear to undergo temporal death; by their merits, deliver us from all danger of death, and mercifully grant us the beatitude of eternal life.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem sacratissimam nobis beati Germani confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnitate tribuisti: adesto propitius Ecclesiae tuae precibus ut cuius gloriatur meritis muniatur suffragiis. Per Dominum.
translation_en: God, who on this day bestowed upon us the most sacred in honor of your blessed confessor and bishop Germain: be present propitiously to the prayers of your Church, that he may be strengthened with his merits by our intercessions. Through the Lord.

text: Oblatum tibi Domine sacrificium in commemoratione beati Petri apostoli tui vivificet nos semper et muniat.
translation_en: Offered to You, Lord, this sacrifice, in memory of Your apostle Saint Peter, may it always revive us and protect us.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut 〈qui〉 sancti septem martyres unanimitate et carnali germanitate fratres pro tuo nomine passi sunt et caelesti gloria coronati maiestati tuae a nobis pias preces offerant et beatae immortalitatis coronas nobis acquirant.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that those holy seven martyrs who suffered for your name as brothers in unity and carnal kinship may present to your majesty pious prayers from us, and obtain for us the crowns of blessed immortality.

text: Intemerata mysteria Domine pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum commemoratione devota mente tractamus quibus nobis et praesidium crescat et gaudium.
translation_en: With devoted mind, we approach the unblemished mysteries, Lord, on the commemoration of your holy martyrs. May their protection grow for us and our joy increase.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Stephani pontificis et martyris intercessio qui pretiosam confessionis et martyrii palmam tua gratia contulit maiestatem tuam nobis placabilem reddat et procul a nobis adversantia cuncta repellat.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayers, Almighty God, that through the intercession of blessed Stephen, bishop and martyr, who obtained for himself a precious palm of confession and martyrdom by your grace, may his majesty render us pleasing to you and drive away from us every adversity.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem inventione sanctorum tuorum Stephani protomartyris Nicodemi Gamalielis atque Abibon consecrasti: da nobis salutem mentis et corporis ut et illorum inventioni sit veneratio ex nostra devotione et nobis auxilium proveniat de eorum sanctissima intercessione.
translation_en: God who on this day consecrated the feast of your saints Stephen the first martyr, Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Abibo: grant us health of mind and body, that we may give reverence to their discovery from our devotion, and that we may receive help from their most holy intercession.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sanctorum tuorum Stephani Nicodemi Gamalielis et Abibon sollemnia celebrantes sacramenta caelestia; praesta quaesumus ut quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the sacred vessels of your saints Stephen, Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Abibo, celebrating solemnly the heavenly sacraments; grant us, we pray, that what we temporally hold may lead us to eternal joys.

text: Deus qui tuae ineffabilis magnitudine pietatis beatum Iustinum aetate parvulum magnum fide atque virtute fecisti: da quaesumus ut 〈qui〉 eius passionis gloriam veneramur vitae quoque innocentiam imitemur.
translation_en: God who, in your ineffable greatness of mercy, made blessed Justin small in age but great in faith and virtue: grant that we may ask, that we may venerate the glory of his passion and imitate the innocence of life.

text: Accipe munera misericors Deus quae in honorem et laudem gratiae tuae beato Iustino martyri collata offerimus ut te sanctificante Unigeniti tui corpus et sanguis fiat et per haec nos in eius corporis unitate tribue in perpetuum permanere.
translation_en: Accept, O merciful God, the gifts which we offer to you on behalf of the blessed martyr Justin, in honor and praise of your grace, that by your sanctifying his body and blood, we may be granted to remain forever in the unity of his body.

text: Tui Domine participatione mysterii et beati Iustini sollemnitate laetantes quaesumus ut eius nobis intercessione et mentium maturitatem et corporum indulgeas sospitatem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, participating in your mystery and rejoicing in the solemnity of Blessed Justinian, that through his intercession, you grant us maturity of mind and body, and bestow upon us the grace of salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui iucundam beatamque laetitiam in sancti Osvaldi servi tui sollemnitate consecrasti: da cordibus nostris tui timoris tuaeque caritatis augmentum ut cuius in terris sancti sanguinis effusionem celebramus ipsius patrocinia sentiamus in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who consecrated the pleasant and blessed joy within the feast of your servant Saint Osvald: grant an increase in fear of you and love for you to our hearts, so that as we on earth celebrate the effusion of the saint's holy blood, we may feel his patronage in heaven.

text: Tecum principium
translation_en: With You begins (something, e.g., praise or creation)

text: Iubilate Deo universa terra
translation_en: Shout to God, all the earth

text: In splendoribus
translation_en:
<translation>In splendors (or In splendoribus, depending on context) translates to "In splendors" in English. However, without a complete sentence or more context, it's hard to provide an accurate translation. The Latin word "splendor" means "brilliance" or "splendor," and when used as a plural ("splendoribus"), it refers to "the brilliances" or "splendors."
If the sentence is: "In splendoribus Sancti Michaelis," it would translate to "In the splendors of Saint Michael."

text: Apparuit
translation_en: Appeared

text: Ascendit Iesus in montem et transfiguratus
translation_en: Jesus ascended the mountain and was transfigured

text: Deus qui hodierna die Unigenitum tuum mirabiliter transformatum utriusque testamenti patribus revelasti: da nobis quaesumus beneplacitis tibi actibus ad eius semper contemplandam pervenire gloriam in quo tuae paternitati optimae complacuisse testatus es.
translation_en: God who today revealed Your Only-begotten One miraculously transformed to the fathers of both Testaments: grant us, we ask, pleasing actions to You, so that we may always attain glory in Him, in whom You have been pleased to show perfect complacency.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens hanc oblationem quam tibi deferimus et concede propitius ut per haec et a temporalibus liberemur incommodis et gaudiis connectemur aeternis.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech you, O Lord, almighty and holy Father, this offering which we bring to you, and graciously grant that through it we may be freed from temporal troubles and united with eternal joys.

text: Deus qui hunc diem incarnati Verbi tui transfiguratione tuaque ad eum missa paternitatis voce consecrasti: tribue quaesumus ut divinis pasti alimoniis eius membra mereamur transferri qui haec in sui memoriam fieri praecepit.
translation_en: God, who on this day consecrated this day by the transfiguration of your incarnate Word and spoke to him with the voice of paternal mission, grant us that we may be worthy to be transferred to his divine nourishment, which he commanded to be made in remembrance of himself.

text: Benedic Domine et hos fructus novos uvae quos tu Domine rore caeli et inundantia pluviarum et temporum serenitate atque tranquillitate ad maturitatem perducere dignatus es et dedisti eos ad usus nostros cum gratiarum actione percipere in nomine Domini nostri Iesu Christi. Per quem haec omnia.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, these new fruits of the vine that you, Lord, have brought to maturity with the dew of heaven, the overflowing rain, and the serenity and tranquility of the seasons, and given them for our use with an act of gratitude, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Through whom all these things.

text: Repleti sumus Domine munere sollemnitatis optatae qua beati Sixti et meritis adiuvamur et precibus.
translation_en: We have been filled, Lord, with the bounty of the desired solemnity which we are aided by the merits of blessed Pope Sixtus and by our prayers.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus intercedentibus sanctis tuis Felicissimo et Agapito ut quae ore contingimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, through the intercession of Your saints Felicitas and Agapitus, that what we touch with our mouth, we may receive with a pure mind.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut intercessione sancti confessoris tui et episcopi Donati quem ad laudem nominis tui dicatis muneribus honoramus piae nobis devotionis fructus accrescat.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, that through the intercession of your holy confessor and Bishop Donatus, whom we honor with the rewards we bestow in the name of your glory, may the fruits of our pious devotion grow for us.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui nos sacramentorum tuorum et participes efficis et ministros: praesta quaesumus ut intercedente beato confessore tuo Donato eiusdem proficiamus et fidei consortio et digno servitio.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who makes us participants and ministers of your sacraments: grant us, we beseech you, that with the intercession of your blessed confessor Donatus, we may progress in fellowship of faith and worthy service.

text: Intercessio nos quaesumus Domine sanctae Affrae martyris tuae commendet quae in confessione tibi placere meruit tuamque confessionem in caelis adeptura per aquae mersionem et ignis concremationem coronam vitae est consecuta.
translation_en: We beseech Your intercession, Lord, of the holy martyr Affra. May she whom it was pleasing to you in her confession and who has obtained your confession in heaven through baptism by water and confirmation by fire be crowned with a crown of life.

text: Huius tibi precibus Domine quaesumus reddatur oblatio pro cuius est festivitate immolanda.
translation_en: With these prayers, Lord, we humbly ask that the offering be returned for whose feast day it is to be sacrificed.

text: Adiuvent nos quaesumus Domine et haec mysteria sancta quae sumpsimus et beatae Affrae martyris intercessio veneranda.
translation_en: Assist us, we ask You, Lord, and these holy mysteries which we have received, and the venerable intercession of the blessed African martyr.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Cyriaci martyris tui sociorumque eius sollemnitate laetificas: concede propitius ut quorum natalicia colimus virtutem quoque passionis imitemur.
translation_en: God who delights us on the feast of your blessed martyr Cyrus and his companions: grant us graciously that we may celebrate their birthdays, and imitate their virtue as well as their passion.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut beati Laurentii martyris tui commemoratione temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur aspectu.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord our God, that just as we rejoice on the temporal commemoration of your blessed martyr Laurence, so may we be eternally joyful in your presence.

text: Excita Domine in Ecclesia tua spiritum cui beatus Laurentius servivit ut eodem nos replente studeamus amare quod amavit et opere exercere quod docuit.
translation_en: Stir up, O Lord, within Your church the Spirit that blessed Laurence served, so that filled with the same Spirit we may strive to love what he loved and put into practice what he taught.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi quaesumus Domine beati Laurentii precatio sancta conciliet ut cuius honore sollemniter exhibetur meritis efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, through the holy prayer of blessed Lawrence, that the sacrifice we offer may be united by You so that it is considered acceptable due to his merits and honors for which it is solemnly exhibited.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut quos tuis reficis sacramentis intercedente beato Laurentio martyre tuo perpetua protectione custodias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that you who strengthen us with your sacraments, through the intercession of the blessed Martyr Lawrence, may keep us under your perpetual protection.

text: Sacro munere satiati supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quod debitae servitutis celebramus officio intercedente beato Laurentio martyre tuo salvationis tuae sentiamus augmentum.
translation_en: Having been satisfied with the sacred duty, we humbly entreat you, Lord, that as we celebrate the office in commemoration of your blessed martyr Saint Lawrence, we may feel an increase in your saving grace.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Hippolyti martyris tui sociorumque eius veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that the venerable feast and devotion of the blessed Hippolytus, your martyr, and his companions may increase in us, and bring salvation.

text: Respice Domine munera populi tui sanctorum festivitate votiva et tuae testificatio veritatis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, the offerings of your holy people, given in vow during this festivity, and may your testimony of truth bring about salvation.

text: Laudis tuae Domine hostias immolamus in tuorum commemoratione sanctorum quibus et praesentibus exui malis confidimus et futuris.
translation_en: We offer the sacrifices of praise, Lord, in remembrance of your saints; with confidence we cast off evils present and those yet to come.

text: Deus qui virginalem aulam beatae Mariae in qua habitares eligere dignatus es: praesta quaesumus ut sua nos defensione munitos iucundos faciat suae interesse festivitati. Qui cum Deo vivit.
translation_en: God, who chose to dwell in the virginal chamber of the blessed Mary: grant us that we may be defended by her protection and make us partakers of her joyful festival. Who lives with God.

text: Munera nostra Domine apud clementiam tuam sanctae Mariae festa praecedunt ut quae conscientiae nostrae praepediuntur obstaculis eius meritis grata reddantur.
translation_en: Our offerings, Lord, precede your mercy during the feast of holy Mary, so that what our conscience is weighed down by obstacles may be gratefully returned through her merits.

text: Sacramenta nos Domine sumpta vivificent et intercedente beata et gloriosa semperque Virgine Dei Genitrice Maria continuum nobis tuae pietatis implorent auxilium.
translation_en: The sacraments, Lord, partaken of us, revive and with the intercession of the blessed and glorious ever-virgin Mother of God, Mary, may they continuously plead for us your help.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatae Mariae virginalem uterum Verbi tui incarnatione fecundasti: concede propitius ut cuius assumptionis diem sollemnibus praevenimus officiis eius apud te precibus et meritis commendemur. Per eundem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who made the Virgin Mary's womb fruitful by the incarnation of your Word: grant us your favor so that we may be recommended to you on the day of her Assumption with the solemn liturgies and prayers, and through the same.

text: Subveniat quaesumus Domine plebi tuae Dei Genitricis oratio quam etsi pro condicione carnis migrasse cognoscimus in caelesti gloria apud te pro nobis orare sentiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your prayer for your people, the Mother of God, may reach us, though we know she has moved according to her bodily condition into heavenly glory, yet may we feel that she is praying for us before you there.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Et te in veneratione sacrarum virginum exsultantibus animis laudare benedicere et praedicare. Inter quas intemerata Dei Genitrix Virgo Maria cuius assumptionis diem celebramus gloriosa effulsit. Quae et Unigenitum tuum Sancti Spiritus obumbratione concepit et virginitatis gloria permanente lumen aeternum mundo effudit Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: We call upon you, eternal God. And in the veneration of the sacred virgins, whose spirits rejoice, we praise, bless, and proclaim you. Among whom, the Immaculate Mother of God, Virgin Mary, whose Assumption day we celebrate, shone gloriously. She conceived your only-begotten Son under the veil of the Holy Spirit and, with the glory of virginity preserved, poured out the eternal light of Jesus Christ our Lord upon the world.

text: Caelesti munere satiati omnipotens Deus tua nos protectione custodi et castimoniae pacem mentibus nostris atque corporibus intercedente beata Maria propitiatus indulge ut veniente sponso Unigenito Filio tuo accensis lampadibus eius digni praestolemur occursum.
translation_en: Having been satisfied with heavenly favor, O almighty God, may you guard us by your protection and grant peace to our minds and bodies through the intercession of the blessed Mary, who is propitiated. Indulge us so that we, coming before your Unigenitus Son, are worthy to approach him with enkindled candles.

text: Mensae caelestis participes effecti imploramus clementiam tuam Domine Deus noster ut qui festa Dei Genitricis et Virginis Mariae colimus a malis imminentibus eius intercessionibus liberemur.
translation_en: We who have been made participants of the heavenly table implore your mercy, Lord our God, that we may be freed from impending evils through the intercessions of the holy Virgin Mary, the Mother of God whom we honor in her festive days.

text: Veneranda nobis Domine huius diei festivitas opem ferat sempiternam in qua sancta Dei Genitrix Virgo Maria mortem subiit temporalem nec tamen mortis nexibus deprimi potuit quae Filium tuum Dominum nostrum de se genuit incarnatum; cuius intercessione quaesumus ut mortem evadere possimus animarum.
translation_en: Today's venerable feast may bring us eternal aid, on which the holy Virgin Mary, Mother of God, submitted to temporal death, yet could not be overpowered by the bonds of death, for she gave birth to your Son, our Lord, incarnate. We humbly ask through her intercession that we may escape the death of souls.

text: Deus qui sanctam et intemeratam aeterni Unigeniti tui temporalem matrem hodierna die de mundo ad caelestem migrare fecisti gloriam: concede nobis propitius ipsius meritis a vitiorum nostrorum morte vivificari et aeternae vitae praemiis remunerari. Per eundem.
translation_en: God, who today on this day led your only-begotten Son's holy and immaculate mother from this world to heavenly migration: graciously grant us, through her merits, that we may be revived from the death of our sins and rewarded with the prizes of eternal life. Through the same.

text: Suscipe munera quaesumus Domine quae in eius tibi sollemnitate deferimus cuius nos confidimus patrocinio liberari.
translation_en: Receive the offerings, we ask You, Lord, which we bring to Your solemnity, on whose patronage we trust to be freed.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam muneribus sacris; eius quaesumus semper interventione nos refove cuius sollemnitatem celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with sacred gifts; we entreat that always through your intervention we may be refreshed, whose solemnity we are celebrating.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris et intercedente beato martyre tuo Magno ab hostium nos defende propitiatus incursu.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to attend to our supplications and through your blessed martyr Magnus, defend us from the enemy's attack, appeased by your mercy.

text: In virtute tua
translation_en: In your power

text: Inveni David
translation_en: I found David

text: Beatus servus
translation_en: Blessed servant

text: Iustus cor suum tradet
translation_en: The just shall give his heart

text: Deus qui nobis beatissimum regem Stephanum et confessorem tuum aeternae vitae eruditorem contulisti: concede propitius ut fidem tuam quam ipso docente percepimus eius suffragantibus meritis moribus et vita teneamus.
translation_en: God, who bestowed upon us the blessed king Stephen and your confessor, the teacher of eternal life: grant favorably that we may hold onto your faith which we have received from him through his merits, virtues, and way of life.

text: Intercessio Domine beati Stephani regis et confessoris tui munera nostra tuae maiestati conciliet ut eorum participatione et in fide tui amoris roboremur et ab omni adversitate ipsius precibus liberemur.
translation_en: Lord, we seek the intercession of Blessed Stephen, your king and confessor, that his merits may be offered to Your majesty, so that through their participation, we may be strengthened in Your love's faith, and be freed from all adversity by their prayers.

text: Perceptio sacramenti tui Domine Deus noster interveniente sancto Stephano rege et confessore tuo illius nobis salvationis conferat effectum cuius spem nobis idem beatus contulit sacrae fidei documentis.
translation_en: Through the perception of your sacrament, Lord God, may our Savior Saint Stephen, intervening as your king and confessor, grant us the effect of which he gave us hope through the documents of sacred faith.

text: Deus qui beatum Stephanum regem et confessorem tuum terreni imperii gloria et honore coronasti et sanctorum tuorum societate sublimasti: praesta quaesumus ut quem Pannonia meruit habere divinae religionis doctorem in terris eum modo Ecclesia tua mereatur habere defensorem in caelis.
translation_en: God who crowned your servant King Stephen the Confessor with glory and honor of earthly rule, and exalted him with the fellowship of your saints: grant us, we ask, that just as Pannonia was privileged to have him a teacher of divine religion on earth, so too may your Church be worthy to have him a defender in heaven.

text: Sacrificium quod tuae Domine maiestati offerimus benigno vultu respice et intercessione beati Stephani regis et confessoris tui nos ab omnibus inimicorum insidiis defende et praemia aeternae vitae concede. Per Christum.
translation_en: The sacrifice which we offer to Your majesty, Lord, look upon it with a benign countenance and defend us from all the plots of our enemies through the intercession of blessed Stephen, Your king and confessor. Grant us the rewards of eternal life. Through Christ.

text: Tuere quaesumus Domine familiam tuam et quam per doctrinam beati Stephani regis et confessoris tui de tenebris ad veram lucem convertisti eam post istius temporis decursum clementer perducas ad regna caelorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to guard your family. As you did convert it from the darkness to true light through the doctrine of blessed Stephen, king and confessor of yours, may you gently lead it to the kingdoms of heaven after this time has passed.

text: Concede quaesumus nos omnipotens Deus per interventum beati Stephani gloriosissimi Pannoniorum regis cuius hodierna die translationem celebramus pacifice mundi cursus peragere qui divinitus inspiratus sibi subiectos populos tuae maiestati meruit subicere.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask, Almighty God, through the intervention of the glorious King Stephen of Pannonia, whose today's translation we celebrate peacefully, that the course of the world may be carried out divinely inspired, who has merited to subject his people to your majesty.

text: Placeant munera omnipotens Deus {per interventum beati} quae tuae clementiae deferimus per merita beati Stephani gloriosissimi Pannoniorum regis nosque ab omnibus tueantur adversis quos pro aeterna remuneratione in fide sanctae Trinitatis solidare non distulit.
translation_en: May Almighty God, through the intercession of the blessed, grant his gifts to us, who we humbly bring before him by the merits of the glorious King Saint Stephen of Hungary. May he protect us from all adversities for which he did not shrink back from sharing in faith with the holy Trinity eternally.

text: Sumpta sacrificia nos quaesumus Domine a laqueis inimicorum nostrorum defendant et per merita beati Stephani gloriosissimi Pannoniorum regis ad aeternae patriae claritatem perducant.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the sacrifices taken up protect us from the snares of our enemies and lead us through the merits of the glorious Saint Stephen, king of the Pannonians, to the brilliance of eternal fatherland.

text: Auxilium tuum Domine nobis quaesumus placatus impende et intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis Timotheo et Symphoriano dexteram super nos tuae propitiationis extende.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your aid be extended to us; and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Timothy and Symphorian, may Your right hand be stretched out over us by the merits of Your propitiation.

text: Divini muneris largitate satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedentibus sanctis tuis Timotheo et Symphoriano in eorum semper participatione vivamus.
translation_en: Filled with the generosity of your divine gifts, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through the intercession of your saints Timothy and Symphorian, we may always live.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nobis huius diei venerandam sanctamque laetitiam in beati apostoli tui Bartholomaei festivitate tribuisti: da Ecclesiae tuae et amare quod credidit et praedicare quod docuit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day bestowed upon us the venerable and holy joy in the feast of your apostle Bartholomew: grant to your Church that she may believe what she has learned and preach what she has been taught.

text: Sumpsimus Domine pignus salutis aeternae celebrantes beati Bartholomaei apostoli tui votiva sollemnia et eius perpetua merita venerantes. Per
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the pledge of eternal salvation while celebrating the votive solemnities of your blessed apostle Bartholomew and revering his eternal merits. Through

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris et beati Rufi martyris intercessionibus confidentes nec minis adversantium nec ullo conturbemur incursu.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to attend to our supplications and, with confidence in the intercessions of Blessed Rufus the Martyr, not to be disturbed by the threats of adversaries nor shaken by any onslaught.

text: Deus qui beatum Pelagium martyrem tuum inter vincula liberum inter tormenta securum gratiae tuae ubertate fecisti: quaesumus clementiam tuam ut nobis flammas corporalium passionum per eius intercessionem exstinguas et ignem sanctae caritatis infundas.
translation_en: God who made your blessed Pelagius a martyr, free among chains and secure amidst torments through the abundance of your grace: we entreat your clemency to extinguish for us the flames of bodily sufferings through his intercession and to pour in the fire of holy charity.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine sancti tui Pelagii munera nostra commendet nosque in eius veneratione maiestati tuae reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your holy one, Pelagius, may commend our gifts to you and, through his veneration, may render our offerings acceptable before your majesty.

text: Sumentes Domine sacramenta caelestia in festivitate Pelagii martyris tui suppliciter deprecamur ut quae sedula servitute te donante gerimus per eius intercessionem dignis sensibus tuo munere capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we take up the heavenly sacraments on the feast of your martyr Pelagius. With supplication we beseech you, that what we diligently carry out through your gift with steadfast servitude, may through his intercession we attain with worthy senses by your grace.

text: Deus qui beatum Hermen martyrem tuum virtute constantiae in passione roborasti: ex eius imitatione tribue nobis pro amore tuo prospera mundi despicere et nulla eius adversa formidare.
translation_en: God, who strengthened your blessed Hermen the martyr with constancy in his passion: grant us, through his example, to scorn the world for your love and not fear any of its adversities.

text: Munera nostra Domine quaesumus propitiatus assume et ut tuis digne famulemur altaribus sancti tui Hermetis intercessione custodi.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you accept our offerings. May we worthy serve your altars of Saint Hermetes with your mercy, through his intercession.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus ut quibus fiduciam sperandae pietatis indulges intercedente beato Augustino confessore tuo atque pontifice consuetae misericordiae tribue benignus effectum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you attend to our supplications, Almighty God. Grant us your favor, trusting in the intercession of your Confessor and Pope, Saint Augustine, according to your accustomed mercy. Bestow upon us, gracious God, the desired effect.

text: Sancti Augustini confessoris tui nobis Domine pia non desit oratio quae et munera nostra conciliet et tuam nobis indulgentiam obtineat.
translation_en: Lord, may the prayers to your Saint Augustine, the confessioner, never cease for us. May they unite our offerings and obtain for us your indulgence.

text: Ut nobis Domine percepta sacrificia dent salutem beatus Augustinus confessor tuus atque pontifex precator accedat.
translation_en: May, Lord, the merits of the sacrifices give us salvation; blessed Augustine, your confessor and bishop, may he approach as intercessor on our behalf.

text: Sancti Ioannis Baptistae et martyris tui Domine quaesumus veneranda festivitas salutaris auxilii praestet effectum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the honored feast of Saint John the Baptist and Martyr may bring forth the beneficial effect of its saving help.

text: Munera tibi Domine pro sancti martyris tui Baptistae Ioannis passione deferentes quaesumus ut eius intercessione nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Bringing gifts to you, Lord, on behalf of your saintly martyr John the Baptist at the time of his passion, we humbly ask that through his intercession we may advance towards salvation.

text: Sancti tui nos Domine quaesumus Ioannis Baptistae oratio assequi faciat semper nos mente quae gerimus et debitae servitutis actione permaneat et secure consistat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your saint's prayer (of John the Baptist) may always follow us in mind and actions, and that we may steadfastly persevere and remain secure in our obligatory service.

text: Divini muneris largitate satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beata Sabina martyre tua in huius semper participatione vivamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, our Lord God, that being satisfied by the generosity of Your divine gifts, we may live always participating through the intercession of the blessed Martyr Sabina.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices deprecamur ut sicut nos iugiter sanctorum martyrum tuorum Felicis et Audacti commemoratione laetificas ita semper supplicatione defendas.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that just as we are continually rejoiced by the memory of Your holy martyrs Felix and Audactus, so You may always protect us through our continual prayers.

text: Hostias tibi Domine tuae plebis intende et quas honore sanctorum tuorum devota mente celebrat proficere sibi sentiat ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, direct my host towards your people and may he who offers them with a devoted mind through the honor of your saints feel himself to be advancing towards healing.

text: Praetende Domine nobis quaesumus misericordiae tuae suffragium et beati Aegidii abbatis nos foveat intercessio ut eius feliciter celebramus gloriae triumphum quem mirificatum asscivisti hodierna die civium collegio supernorum.
translation_en: Bend to us, Lord, we humbly ask, the support of your mercy, and may the intercession of blessed Abbot Egidius protect us, that we may joyfully celebrate the triumph of glory which you have marvelously granted today to the citizens of the celestial community.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine beati Aegidii abbatis munera nostra commendet nosque in eius veneratio sancta tuae maiestati reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the intercession of Blessed Abbot St. Giles may recommend us and return our offerings to Your holy majesty in his veneration.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sacramenti tui participatione vegetati sancti quoque martyris Prisci precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that through the participation in your sacrament we may be nourished, and help us also by the prayers of the holy martyr Priscus.

text: Supplicationes servorum tuorum Deus miserator exaudi ut qui in nativitate Dei Genitricis et Virginis Mariae congregamur eius intercessionibus complacatus a te de instantibus periculis eruamur. Per eundem.
translation_en: Supplications of your servants, O merciful God, hear us, that we who gather together in the birth of God's Mother and Virgin Mary, may be released from our urgent dangers through her intercessions. Through the same.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Et praecipue pro meritis beatae Dei Genitricis et perpetuae Virginis Mariae gratia plenae tuam omnipotentiam laudare benedicere et praedicare. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: We pray eternally to God. And especially for the merits of the blessed God's Mother and the perpetual Virgin Mary, full of grace, we praise, bless and proclaim your omnipotence. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Adesto Domine quaesumus fideli populo tuo ut quae sumpsit fideliter et corpore sibi et mente beatae Mariae semper Virginis intercessione custodiat.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, we humbly ask you, for your faithful people, that what they have received faithfully in both body and mind under the intercession of the ever-virgin Blessed Mary, they may keep.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine tibi dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato Hadriano martyre tuo per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the gifts dedicated to you. With the intercession of your martyr Hadrian, we pray that through the same, you may incline towards us with favor.

text: Beati Hadriani martyris tui Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporaliter gerimus perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: Blessed are you, Lord, on account of the martyr Hadrian. Through your intervention, we humbly ask that you grant us, who are living temporarily, to obtain eternal salvation.

text: Deus qui multitudinem populorum beati Corbiniani confessoris tui atque pontificis instantia ad agnitionem tui nominis vocare dignatus es: concede propitius ut cuius sollemnia colimus etiam patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who deigned to call the multitude of the people to the recognition of your name through the urgency of the blessed Corbinian, your confessor and bishop: grant graciously that we may not only celebrate his feast day, but also feel his patronage.

text: Quos caelestibus Domine donis satiasti beati Corbiniani confessoris tui atque pontificis defende praesidiis ut a noxiis omnibus expediti post salutaria tua toto corde curramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied the blessed Corbinian, your confessor and bishop, with heavenly gifts. Defend him with your protective guard, so that we, freed from all evil, may run with a whole heart after your salvation.

text: Grata sit tibi Domine nostra servitutis oblatio pro qua sanctus martyr Gorgonius quaesumus interveniat.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to You, Lord, our offering of service for which we ask the holy martyr Gorgonius to intercede.

text: Familiam tuam Deus suavitas illa contingat et vegetet quae in martyre tuo Gorgonio Christi tui bono iugiter odore pascatur.
translation_en: May your family, O God, be touched by that sweetness and may they be nourished forever with the good odor of your martyr Gorgoion of Christ.

text: Pro sanctorum tuorum Proti et Hyacinthi munera tibi Domine commemoratione quae debemus exsolvimus; praesta quaesumus ut remedium nobis perpetuae salutis operentur.
translation_en: For the sake of your saints Protus and Hyacinth, we offer to you, Lord, the commemoration that is due; grant us, we pray, that they may bring us eternal salvation.

text: Percepta nos Domine tua sancta purificent et beati Proti et Hyacinthi quaesumus imploret oratio.
translation_en: Cleanse us, Lord, with your holy purification, and we ask that the prayers of blessed Protus and Hyacinth may intercede for us.

text: Deus qui nos hodierna die exaltationis sanctae Crucis annua sollemnitate laetificas: praesta quaesumus ut cuius mysterium in terra cognovimus eius redemptionis praemia in caelo consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God, who on this day of the annual feast of the exaltation of the Holy Cross delights us: grant that we may merit to obtain the rewards of whose mystery we have known on earth, in heaven.

text: Deus qui Unigeniti tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi pretioso sanguine humanum genus redimere dignatus es: concede propitius ut qui ad adorandam vivificam eius Crucem adveniunt a peccatorum suorum nexibus liberentur. Per eundem.
translation_en: God, who deemed it fitting to redeem the human race by the precious blood of your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ: grant them graciously that those who come to adore the life-giving Cross may be freed from the bonds of their sins. Through Him.

text: Hoc sentite vobis
translation_en: Hear ye this [plural]

text: Devotas humilitatis nostrae preces et hostias misericordiae tuae praecedat auxilium ut salutem quam per Adam in paradiso ligni clauserat temerata praesumptio ligni rursum fides aperiat.
translation_en: May your mercy precede our humble prayers and offerings, so that the help you provide opens again the salvation which the rash presumption of Adam's sin in paradise had closed with the tree. May faith open it once more.

text: Plebis tuae Domine munera benignus intende quae maiestati tuae pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cornelii et Cypriani sollemnitate sunt dicata.
translation_en: Lord, gracious bestow upon your people, pay attention to the gifts that are dedicated on the solemnity of the holy martyrs Cornelius and Cyprian in honor of your majesty.

text: Sacro munere vegetatos sanctorum martyrum Cornelii et Cypriani natalicio nos tibi Domine quaesumus commendet oratio.
translation_en: On the sacred office, we ask you, Lord, to recommend to you the prayers of those who were revitalized by the ministry, the saints Cornelius and Cyprian, on their feast day.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut in tuo conspectu mors est pretiosa sanctorum ita eorum merita venerantium accepta tibi reddatur oblatio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that just as death is precious in your sight for the saints, so may their merits be accepted by you and the offering of those coming be returned to you.

text: Infirmitatem nostram quaesumus Domine propitius respice et mala omnia quae iuste meremur sanctorum tuorum Lucii et Geminiani intercessione averte.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look upon our infirmity with mercy and turn away from us all the evils which we justly deserve through the intercession of your saints, Lucian and Geminian.

text: Origo et consummatio totius bonitatis Deus qui cor beati pontificis et martyris tui Lamberti tam fortiter in tuo amore flammasti ut non solum pro te terrenam substantiam verum etiam propriam contemneret carnem: concede quaesumus ut qui illius sollemnia celebramus devoti ipso opitulante ab omni adversitate per te semper gaudeamus.
translation_en: The origin and consummation of all goodness is God, who set the heart of your blessed bishop and martyr Lambert aflame so strongly in his love for you that not only did he scorn earthly substance on your account but also his own flesh: grant us, we beseech you, that we who celebrate his solemnities with devotion may always rejoice in him through you, protected from all adversity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sancti episcopi Ianuarii et martyris cum sociis eius in passione largitus es ut omnia tormenta poenarum constanter susciperent et pro persecutoribus supplicarent: pietatem tuam et misericordiam deprecemur ut dum illorum gloriosam passionem colimus pacem et securitatem et peccatorum veniam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who granted strength to St. John the Bishop and Martyr and his companions in their suffering, that they steadfastly bore all torments of punishment and prayed for their persecutors: we entreat Your pity and mercy, that as we celebrate their glorious passion, we may deserve peace, security, and forgiveness of sins.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Matthaei apostoli tui et evangelistae quam praevenimus veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that the venerable feast and devotion of your apostle and evangelist Blessed Matthew may increase for us, and bestow upon us peace.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut beati Matthaei evangelistae suffragiis cuius natalicia praeimus haec plebs tua semper et sua vota depromat et desiderata percipiat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that through the intercession of the blessed apostle Matthew, whose feast day we celebrate, may your people always promote their prayers and receive what they desire.

text: Beati Matthaei apostoli et evangelistae Domine precibus adiuvemur ut quod possibilitas nostra non obtinet eius nobis intercessione donetur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask for Your help that what is beyond our capabilities may be given to us through the intercession of Blessed Matthew, the apostle and evangelist.

text: Supplicationibus apostolicis beati Matthaei evangelistae quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae Domine commendetur oblatio cuius magnificis praedicationibus eruditur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to commit the offering of Your Church to the blessed apostle Matthew, the evangelist, through whose magnificent teachings it is enlightened.

text: Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hunc diem in honore beatorum martyrum tuorum Mauritii Exsuperii Candidi Victoris Innocentii et Vitalis sociorumque eorum martyrio consecrasti: da Ecclesiae tuae de eorum nataliciis in tanta festivitate laetari ut apud misericordiam tuam exemplis eorum et meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God who are the wonderful splendor of your saints, who on this day consecrated for the honor of your blessed martyrs Mauritius, Exsuperius, Candidus, Victor, Innocentius, Vitalis and their companions through their martyrdom: grant to your Church to rejoice on their natal days in such great festivity, that we may be aided by their examples and merits before your mercy.

text: Respice Domine munera quae in sanctorum martyrum tuorum Mauritii Exsuperii Candidi Victoris Innocentii et Vitalis ac sociorum eorundem commemoratione deferimus et praesta ut quorum honore sunt grata eorum nobis fiant intercessione proficua.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, the gifts which we offer in remembrance of your holy martyrs Mauritius, Exsuperius, Candidus, Victorinus, Innocentius, Vitalis, and their companions, and grant that through their honorable intercession, these gifts may be profitable for us.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intervenientibus sanctis tuis sacrosancta mysteria quae sumpsimus fide et actione subsequamur.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord our God, that as Your saints approach us with the sacred mysteries which we have received in faith and action, we may follow them accordingly.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Emmerami martyris tui atque pontificis festivitate laetificas: da nobis eius intervenientibus meritis et perpetua protectione muniri et salutari gaudere profectu.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the feast of your blessed martyr and bishop Emmeram: grant that we may be protected by his merits and shielded forever, and rejoice in salvation through his intercession.

text: Donis caelestibus da quaesumus Domine libera nos mente servire ut munera quae deferimus interveniente beato Emmeramo martyre tuo atque pontifice et medelam nobis operentur et gloriam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to set us free with your heavenly gifts, that we may serve you with a clear mind. May the offerings we bring, through your blessed martyr and bishop Emmeram, be effective for us and bring glory.

text: Repleti alimonia caelesti quaesumus Domine ut intercedente beato Emmeramo martyre tuo atque pontifice misericordiae tuae gratiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Filled with celestial sustenance, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of Blessed Emeramus, your martyr and bishop, we may deserve your grace.

text: Deus qui nos hodie beatae et sanctae Liutrudis virginis annua sollemnitate laetificas: concede propitius ut eius adiuvemur meritis cuius castitatis irradiamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who today on the annual feast of the blessed and holy Virgin Liutrudis delights us: grant graciously that we may be helped by her merits, whose examples enlighten us with her chastity.

text: Muneribus te Domine magnificamus oblatis quibus in sanctae nobis sollemnitatibus Liutrudis et gaudia superna concilies et patrocinia sempiterna largiaris.
translation_en: We magnify you, Lord, with offerings, by which in our holy festivities, Liutrudis and celestial joys are united, and eternal patronage is bestowed.

text: Adiuvent nos quaesumus Domine et haec mysteria sancta quae sumpsimus et beatae virginis Liutrudis intercessio veneranda.
translation_en: Help us, we beseech You, Lord, and these holy mysteries which we have received, and the venerable intercession of the blessed Virgin Liutrudis.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui instituta legalium et sanctorum praeconia prophetarum in diebus conceptionis Ioannis Baptistae implesti: quaesumus ut cessantibus significationum figuris ipsa sui magnificationem Veritas eloquatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who filled the proclamations of the prophets with the institutions and holiness on the day of the conception of John the Baptist: we ask that as figures of meaning cease, Truth itself may speak its own praise.

text: Deus qui beatum Gerardum pontificem agone martyrii et stola immortalitatis coronasti: concede propitius ut cuius festa devotis mentibus celebramus in terris eius perpetua defensione muniamur in caelis.
translation_en: God who crowned the blessed Gerard, the bishop, with the crown of martyrdom and immortality: grant us graciously that we may be protected by his perpetual defense on earth, and enclosed in heaven.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam pretiosissimi corporis et sanguinis tui libamine; praesta quaesumus ut intercessione beati Gerardi martyris tui atque pontificis nobis proficiant ad salutem corporis et animae.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with the precious food of your body and blood. We humbly ask that through the intercession of Blessed Gerard, your martyr and bishop, may it profit us for the health of our soul and body.

text: Deus qui beato Ruthberto sacerdoti tuo et confessori beatae confessionis virtutem tribuisti: praesta quaesumus ut dum eius merita saepius veneramur imitari studia valeamus.
translation_en: God, who granted virtue to your priest and confessor, the blessed Ruthbert: grant us that, as we often approach his merits, we may be able to strive for similar studies.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus munera dignanter oblata et beati Ruthberti suffragantibus meritis ad nostrae salutis auxilium provenire concede.
translation_en: Accept, Lord, as we ask, the offerings presented with due respect, and by the merits of Blessed Ruthbert, grant that help for our salvation may come forth.

text: Sumpta caelestis remedii sacramenta ad caelestem nobis proficiant medicinam quam beatus Ruthbertus sacerdos et confessor obtineat.
translation_en: The sacred remedies taken up for us should lead to the heavenly medicine which the blessed Ruthbert, priest and confessor, obtained for us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sanctorum tuorum Cosmae et Damiani natalicia colimus a cunctis malis imminentibus eorum intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the feast days of your saints Cosmas and Damian, may be helped by their intercessions against all impending evils.

text: Protegat Domine participatio caelestis indulta convivii populum tuum et deprecatio collata sanctorum.
translation_en: May the participation granted by heaven, Lord, protect your people at the feast, and the supplication combined with the saints be heard.

text: Deus qui beati Wencezlai nobilitatem in meliorem mutasti dignitatem et eum per martyrii palmam ad caelestem perduxisti gloriam: eius precibus nos quaesumus ab omni adversitate libera et aeternae beatitudinis concede perfrui gloria.
translation_en: God who changed the nobility of blessed Wenceslaus into a higher dignity and brought him to the celestial glory through the palm of martyrdom: we humbly ask that by his prayers you free us from all adversity and grant us to enjoy eternal beatitude.

text: Hanc Ecclesiae tuae oblationem omnipotens Deus altari tuo suppositam beati Wencezlai martyris tui intercessio tibi reddat acceptam et ex ea nobis aeternae salutis obtineat conferri medicinam.
translation_en: May the almighty God receive this offering of your church placed on your altar, through the intercession of the blessed martyr Wencezlai, and grant us from it the medicine for eternal salvation.

text: Sumpta mensae caelestis sacramenta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente beato Wencezlao martyre tuo nos ab omni peccati macula mundos et tuae maiestati faciant semper esse devotos.
translation_en: We ask You, Almighty God, who have taken the sacrament of the heavenly table, that through the intercession of the blessed martyr Wencezlaus, You cleanse us from all stain of sin and may we always be devoted to Your majesty.

text: Deus qui in auxilium generis humani caelestia simul et terrena dispensas: in inferiore mundi parte laborantes beati archangeli tui Michaëlis omniumque supernorum nos quaesumus precibus et praesidiis refove propitius ministrorum.
translation_en: God who in aid dispenses to the human race both celestial and terrestrial help: in the lower part of the world, we humbly ask you through the prayers and protection of your archangels Michael and all the heavenly ones, to benevolently support the ministers.

text: Hostias tibi Domine laudis offerimus suppliciter deprecantes ut easdem suffragantibus meritis beati archangeli Michaëlis et placatus accipias et ad salutem nostram provenire concedas.
translation_en: We humbly present to you, Lord, offerings of praise. We beseech you that through the merits of the blessed Archangel Michael, pleased may you accept them and grant that they come for our salvation.

text: Repleti Domine benedictione caelesti suppliciter imploramus ut quod fragili celebramus officio sancti Michaëlis archangeli nobis prodesse sentiamus auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, filled with heavenly blessing, we humbly ask that we may feel the benefit of it as we weakly celebrate the office of St. Michael the Archangel, through his assistance.

text: Beati archangeli tui Michaelis omniumque supernorum spirituum intercessione suffulti supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quod honore prosequimur contingamus et mente.
translation_en: Blessed are you, the archangel Michael and all other heavenly spirits, supported by their intercession, we humbly beseech you, Lord. May it be that what we pursue with honor, we may attain, and may our minds be focused.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Ecclesiae tuae beatum Hieronymum confessorem scripturae sanctae et verum interpretem et tractatorem catholicum tribuisti: concede propitius ut eius erudita doctrinis stabili fide in veneratione tui nominis et agnitione proficiat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who granted the blessed Jerome, the confessor, a learned interpreter and treatise author of holy scripture to your Church: grant graciously that he may advance in steadfast faith and veneration of your name, and understanding.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum et sanctorum confessorum tuorum Remigii Germani et Vedasti atque Bavonis antistitum sollemnia celebrantem temporalis vitae tribue pace gaudere et perpetuum reperire subsidium.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, your people and the confessors of your saints Remigius, Germanus, and Bavon, celebrating the solemnity of temporal life. Grant them peace to rejoice and find perpetual support.

text: Repleti sacramento reparationis humanae praesta quaesumus Domine ut per ea quae nobis munere caelesti praebere dignatus es per eadem nobis tribuas inhaerere donis caelestibus.
translation_en: Filled with the sacrament of reparation, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through the gifts bestowed on us by heavenly grace, you grant us to be united with heavenly blessings through them.

text: Offerimus hostias nomini tuo Domine quantum de nostro merito formidantes tantum de sancti sacerdotis et martyris tui Leodegarii suffragiis confidentes; praesta quaesumus ut nobis veniam conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer sacrifices to your name, Lord, as much as from our merit is fitting, but as much as we dare through the intercession of your holy priest and martyr Leodegar. Grant us, we beseech you, forgiveness and salvation.

text: Exsurgat Deus et dissipentur
translation_en: Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered

text: Cantate Domino
translation_en: Sing to the Lord

text: Iusti epulentur
translation_en: The righteous shall feast

text: Laetamini in Domino
translation_en: Rejoice in the Lord

text: Iustorum animae
translation_en: Souls of the righteous

text: Deus qui nos voluisti exemplis patriarcharum tuorum Abraham Isaac et Iacob erudiri: da nobis ipsis intercedentibus eorum documenta in omnibus sequi quatenus illorum meritis mereamur pervenire quo illi gratia tua se pervenisse laetantur.
translation_en: God, who wanted to instruct us by the examples of your patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: grant that we may follow their teachings in all things, so that through their merits we may deserve to reach where they rejoice in Your grace having arrived.

text: Abraham magnus pater multarum gentium et non est inventus similis illi in gloria qui conservaret legem Excelsi et fuit in testamento cum illo. In carne eius stare fecit testamentum et in tentatione inventus est fidelis. Ideo iure iurando dedit illi gloriam in gentem suam crescere illum quasi terrae cumulum et ut stellas exaltare semen eius et hereditare illius a mari usque ad mare et a flumine usque ad terminos terrae. Et Isaac eodem fecit modo propter Abraham patrem ipsius. Benedictionem omnium gentium dedit illi 〈Dominus〉 et testamentum suum super caput Iacob. Cognovit eum in benedictionibus suis et dedit illi hereditatem et divisit eum partem in tribus duodecim. Et conservavit illi homines misericordiae invenientes gratiam in oculis omnis carnis.
translation_en: Abraham, the great father of many nations, was not found equal to him in glory who kept the law of the Exalted. He was in the covenant with him. In his flesh, he made a covenant and was found faithful in temptation. Therefore, by right and oath, he gave him glory for his people to grow, exalting his seed as stars, inheriting him from sea to sea, and from river to the borders of the earth. And Isaac did the same through Abraham, his father. The Lord gave him all nations' blessing, and his covenant upon Jacob's head. He knew him in his blessings and gave him an inheritance, dividing him into tribes among the twelve. And he preserved for him merciful men finding grace in the sight of all flesh.

text: Cum videritis beatos patriarchas Abraham et Isaac et Iacob et omnes prophetas in regno Dei vos autem expelli foras. Et venient ab oriente et occidente et austro et recumbent in regno Dei. Et ecce sunt novissimi qui erant primi et sunt primi qui erant novissimi.
translation_en: When you see the blessed patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, as well as all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are cast out. And they come from east and west, and south, and recline in the kingdom of God. And behold, the last ones were first, and the first ones were last.

text: Sanctificationis omnis sanctificator Deus: oblata et offerentes sanctifica ob merita sanctorum patriarcharum Abraham Isaac et Iacob offerentibusque concede sic oblata sumere sanctificata ut per hanc perceptionem sint tibi accepti.
translation_en: God, who sanctifies all sanctifiers: we present and offer what is offered, and you sanctify it for the merits of the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and those who offer. Grant that this offering, once presented, may be received as sanctified by you, so that through this perception they may be acceptable to you.

text: Perceptio corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi commemoratione sanctorum patriarcharum Abraham Isaac et Iacob obtineat ut sit sumentibus ad remissionem peccatorum et ad consequendam caelestis vitae perpetuitatem.
translation_en: May the reception of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, commemorating the holy patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, bring about that it may be for those partaking, a remission of sins and attainment of the perpetuity of celestial life.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum nos Domine Marcelli et Apulei Sergii et Bacchi beata merita prosequantur et suo semper faciant amore ferventes.
translation_en: May your holy martyrs, Lord Marcellus and Apuleius Sergius and Bacchus, follow us with their blessed merits, and may they always make us fervent in their loving devotion.

text: Sacramentis Domine muniamur acceptis et sanctorum martyrum tuorum Marcelli et Apulei Sergii et Bacchi contra omnes nequitias irruentes armis caelestibus protegamur.
translation_en: Lord, may we be fortified by the sacraments and let us be protected by your saintly martyrs Marcellus, Apuleius Sergius, and Bacchus, against all onslaughts that rush upon us with celestial weapons.

text: Deus tuorum gloria sacerdotum: praesta quaesumus ut 〈qui〉 beati Wolfkangi confessoris tui atque pontificis natalicia praevenimus eius auxilium sentiamus.
translation_en: God, glory of your priests: grant us that we may anticipate the feast days of your blessed confessor and bishop Wolfgang, and feel his assistance.

text: Deus qui beatum Wolfkangum gloriae sanctorum similem fecisti et beata fide munisti: da nobis eius pia merita devote sectari qui pastor noster exstitit et aeternitatis gloriam promeruit.
translation_en: God, who made blessed Wolfgang similar to the glory of saints and fortified him with blessed faith: grant us to follow his pious merits devoutly, who was our shepherd and merited eternal glory.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus quam sanctorum tuorum Dionysii Rustici et Eleutherii natalicia recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we humbly ask, which we present commemorating the nativity of your saints Dionysius Rusticus and Eleutherius, may it loose the fetters of our iniquity and unite us with your mercy.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia alimenta percepimus intercedentibus sanctis tuis Dionysio Rustico et Eleutherio per haec contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Almighty God, that we who have received celestial food through the intercession of Your saints Dionysius, Rusticus and Eleutherius, may be fortified against all adversities through these.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatorum martyrum tuorum Gereonis Victoris Mallusii Cassii atque Florentii cum sociis eorum sollemnitate laetificas: praesta quaesumus ut quorum gaudemus meritis instruamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who enlivens us with the solemnity of your blessed martyrs Gereon, Victor, Mallusius, Cassius and Florentius, together with their companions: grant us, we ask, that we may be instructed by their examples through whom we rejoice.

text: Munera Domine quae pro martyrum tuorum sollemnitate deferimus suscipe propitius et mala omnia quae iuste meremur eorum intercessione averte.
translation_en: Lord, we offer the gifts on behalf of the solemnity of your martyrs. Receive them graciously and turn away from us all evils which we justly deserve through their intercession.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut salutaribus repleti mysteriis {et} quorum sollemnia celebramus eorum orationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We entreat the almighty God that, filled with salvific mysteries, we may be aided by their prayers as we celebrate their solemnities.

text: Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hodierna die corpus beati Stephani regis et confessoris tui consecrasti: da nobis salutem mentis et corporis ut et illius inventioni sit veneratio ex nostra devotione et nobis auxilium proveniat de eius sanctissima intercessione.
translation_en: God who are the marvelous splendor of your saints, and who today consecrated the body of the blessed King Stephen and confessor of yours: grant us salvation for mind and body, so that there may be veneration for his discovery from our devotion, and assistance may come to us from his most holy intercession.

text: Deus qui hodierna die corporis sancti Stephani regis et confessoris tui gloriosam inventionem revelasti: da nobis in aeterna 〈laetitia〉 de eius societate gaudere.
translation_en: God who today revealed the glorious discovery of Your holy body, Stephen the King and Confessor's, grant us eternal joy to rejoice in his company.

text: Deus qui nos conspicis ex nostra infirmitate deficere: ad amorem tuum nos misericorditer per sancti Calixti martyris tui atque pontificis exempla restaura.
translation_en: God, who sees us from our weakness faltering: restore us mercifully to your love through the examples of Your martyr and bishop St. Calixtus.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut reatum nostrum munera sacrata purificent et recte vivendi nobis operentur effectum.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that the sacred gifts may purify our repentance, and may the effects of right living work in us.

text: Deus qui praesentem diem honorabilem nobis in beati Galli confessoris tui sollemnitate fecisti: da populis tuis spiritualium gratiam gaudiorum et omnium fidelium mentes dirige in viam salutis aeternae.
translation_en: God, who made this day honorable for us on the solemnity of your confessor Saint Gall: grant your people spiritual grace of joy and direct all minds of the faithful into the way of eternal salvation.

text: Sancti Galli confessoris tui Domine supplicationibus tribue nos foveri ut cuius venerabilem sollemnitatem praevenimus obsequio eius intercessionibus commendemur et meritis.
translation_en: Lord, through your Saint Gall the confessor, grant us to be protected, so that we who have preceded his venerable solemnity with our obedience may be committed to his intercessions and merits.

text: Deus qui nos beati Galli confessoris tui annua sollemnitate laetificas: concede propitius: ut cuius natalicia colimus eius etiam virtutes imitemur.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the annual solemnity of your blessed confessor Gallus: grant mercifully that we may not only celebrate his birthday, but also emulate his virtues.

text: Deus qui exemplar iustitiae sanctum Sigismundum martyrem beatae passionis gloria coronasti: da nobis eundem apud te patronum quem tua gratia suscepit mortis pretio securum.
translation_en: God who crowned the holy martyr Saint Sigismund with the glory of his blessed passion: grant us the same patron before you whom your grace received secure from death's price.

text: Ad laudem et gloriam nominis tui devotionis nostrae libamina tibi sint grata quae sanctus martyr Sigismundus pertingat suae passionis praerogativa.
translation_en: May the offerings of our devotion be pleasing to your name, which the holy martyr Sigismund brings through the privileges of his passion.

text: Accepto omnipotens Deus divini muneris dono sancti martyris Sigismundi sublevemur auxilio cuius beatitudinis ascribamur consortio.
translation_en: We are raised by the almighty God with the aid of the holy martyr Sigismund, whose blessedness we are part of his fellowship.

text: Da nobis indignis famulis tuis Domine Deus omnipotens in festivitate sancti Sigismundi regis et martyris tui dignis eius orationibus delictorum nostrorum indulgentiam adipisci et electorum tuorum numero associari.
translation_en: Grant, O Lord God Almighty, to us, Your unworthy servants, in the feast of Your saint and martyr King Sigismund, to obtain the indulgence for our sins through his worthy prayers, and to be associated with the chosen ones of Your number.

text: Donis caelestibus da nobis quaesumus Domine libera mente servire et munera quae deferimus interveniente evangelista tuo Luca medelam nobis operentur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us through the celestial gifts, free our minds to serve and may the gifts we bring be effective with your evangelist Luke present among us.

text: Votiva Domine dona mystici libaminis pro sanctarum virginum tuarum veneratione tuae maiestati oblata nostra expurgent facinora et purificatos nos tanti mysterii exsequendi reddant acceptos.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, the offerings of the mystical incense on behalf of the veneration of your holy virgins. May their majesty cleanse our sins and make us worthy participants in such a great mystery.

text: Caelestis Domine alimoniae refecti sacramento quaesumus 〈ut〉 intercedentibus sanctis virginibus ac martyribus quae pro illarum celebramus gloria ad nostrae salutis proficiant incrementum.
translation_en: Heavenly Lord, we beseech you by the sacrament of refreshment, that through the intercession of the holy virgins and martyrs whom we celebrate with glory, it may advance the increase for our salvation.

text: Deus qui sanctam nobis huius diei sollemnitatem pro commemoratione beati martyris tui Demetrii fecisti: adesto familiae tuae precibus et da ut cuius hodie festa celebramus eius meritis et intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who on this day made holy for us the solemnity in commemoration of your blessed martyr Demetrius: be present with your family's prayers and grant that we may be helped by his merits and assisted by his intercessions as we celebrate his feast day.

text: Deus qui nos beati Demetrii martyris tui concedis natalicio perfrui eius nos tribue precibus adiuvari.
translation_en: God, who grants us to celebrate the nativity of your blessed martyr Demetrius, grant us also to be helped by his prayers.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens qui corpore et sanguine Christi Filii tui nos satiare dignatus es: praesta petimus ut beati Demetrii martyris tui cuius in tuo nomine hodie sollemnia celebramus adiuti subsidio aeternis interesse epulis mereamur.
translation_en: Lord God almighty, who deigned to satisfy us with the body and blood of your Son, Christ: we beseech you, that being helped by the eternal assistance of blessed Demetrius your martyr, whom we today solemnly celebrate in your name, we may deserve to be present at his feast.

text: Beatorum confessorum tuorum atque pontificum Vedasti et Amandi natalicia recolentes suppliciter te Domine deprecamur ut quos in caelesti gloria sublimasti nobis tuum iugiter implorent auxilium.
translation_en: Remembering the feast days of your blessed confessors and bishops, Vedastus and Amandus, we humbly beseech you, Lord. May you who have exalted them in celestial glory ever pray for us to grant us assistance.

text: Muneribus nostris Domine apostolorum tuorum Simonis et Iudae festa praecedimus ut quae conscientiae nostrae praepediuntur obstaculis illorum meritis grata reddantur.
translation_en: With the offerings of ours, Lord, we precede the feast of your apostles Simon and Jude, so that what our conscience is hindered by may be made grateful through their merits.

text: Sumpto Domine sacramento suppliciter deprecamur ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis tuis quod temporaliter gerimus ad vitam capiamus aeternam.
translation_en: Lord, with the Sacrament received, we humbly beseech You that, with the intercession of Your blessed apostles, what we temporarily possess may lead us to attain eternal life.

text: Gloriam Domine sanctorum apostolorum perpetuam recensentes quaesumus ut eam sacris mysteriis expiati dignius celebremus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to consider the glory of your holy apostles perpetually, that we may worthily celebrate it with sacred mysteries.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis suppliciter te rogamus ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis tuis quae pro illorum veneranda gerimus passione nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Hearkening to Your sacred mysteries, we humbly entreat You that through the intercession of Your blessed apostles, who for their venerable passion suffer on our behalf, may profit us with healing.

text: Sacramentis Domine et gaudiis optatae celebritatis expletis quaesumus ut eorum precibus adiuvemur quorum recordationibus exhibentur.
translation_en: Lord, having completed the Sacraments and rejoicings of your desired festivity, we humbly ask that you aid us with the prayers of those whose remembrance is being shown.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos omnium sanctorum tuorum multiplici facis celebritate gaudere: concede quaesumus ut sicut illorum commemoratione temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur aspectu.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who makes us all the saints to rejoice with a great festivity: grant us, we ask, that just as we are pleased with their temporal commemoration, so we may always be happy with their sight.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine Deus noster beati confessoris tui Henrici foveri suffragiis et quem diversis miraculis facis clarescere eius nos precibus a peccatis absolutos in tua semper miseratione custodi.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, through the intercession of your blessed confessor Henry, that by his prayers we may be delivered from sins and always protected by your mercy.

text: Deus qui florentem ab adolescentia dilectum tuum Henricum ab omni contagione conversationis humanae mundum reserasti: praesta quaesumus ut sicut ille sola tuae pietatis electione sanctorum tuorum meruit contubernium sic nos tui fideles ipso interveniente solo gratiae tuae respectu nostrorum mereamur indulgentiam peccatorum.
translation_en: God who from youth chose and loved your beloved Henry, and delivered him from all the contagion of human conversation, grant us that, just as he merited the companionship of your saints only by your own divine election, so through your grace alone we may deserve forgiveness for our sins.

text: Beati Henrici confessoris tui oratio tibi Domine munera nostra commendet ut ipso interveniente haec sacramenta nobis salutem conferant et munimen.
translation_en: May the prayer of your confession, Blessed Henry, present our gifts to you, Lord. May it be so that with his intervention, these sacraments grant us salvation and protection.

text: Satiati Domine gratiae tuae muneribus quaesumus ut beatus Henricus confessor tuus sua nos semper intercessione muniat in cuius commemoratione haec sancta tibi libavimus sacramenta.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, to be filled with your grace through the offerings you have bestowed. May blessed Henry, your confessor, always protect us by his intercession, for whom these holy sacrifices are offered on his commemoration.

text: Deus qui in beati Henrici confessoris tui mente tenera adhuc aetate florentem mundum arere fecisti: fac in nobis quaesumus ut tua semper gratia floreat et ab omni discrimine mundi funditus arescat.
translation_en: God, who made the world flourish with tender mind of your saintly servant Henry even in his early years: grant us that your grace may always bloom and completely burn away from every worldly distinction within us.

text: Deus qui populo tuo aeternae salutis beatum Willechadum ministrum tribuisti: praesta quaesumus ut quem doctorem vitae habuimus in terris intercessorem habere mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: God who gave your people the blessed Willichad as a minister of eternal salvation: grant, we ask, that we may deserve to have him as an intercessor in heaven whom we had as a teacher of life on earth.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus munera tuae pietati oblata per intercessionem beati Willechadi confessoris tui atque pontificis ad perpetuam fac nobis proficere salutem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we offer your gifts to the merit of your confessed saint and bishop, Blessed Wilfrid. Through his intercession, may it cause us to advance perpetually in eternal salvation.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis nostrae praesidiis da quaesumus eius nos patrociniis ubique protegi in cuius veneratione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, protection with the shields of our salvation that we may be safeguarded everywhere under his patronage; in whose honor we offer this to your majesty.
