text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui gloriosos martyres Claudium Nicostratum Symphorianum Castorium atque Simplicium fortes in sua confessione cognovimus pios apud te in nostra intercessione sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who have known the glorious martyrs Claudius Nicostratum, Symphorianum, Castorium, and Simplicium to be strong in their confession, may feel them to be pious on our behalf in your intercession.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro martyrum tuorum coronatorum commemoratione deferimus supplicantes ut indulgentiam nobis pariter conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, hosts on behalf of your crowned martyrs in remembrance. We pray that they may grant us forgiveness and salvation.

text: Praetende nobis Domine misericordiam tuam ut sanctus martyr tuus Theodorus cuius nos dedisti patrociniis adiuvari tribue ut maiestatem tuam iugiter exoret pro nobis.
translation_en: Lord, stretch out to us your mercy, so that your holy martyr Theodore, whom you have given as our patronage, may assist us and always intercede on our behalf before your majesty.

text: Sancti nos quaesumus Domine Theodori martyris tui oratio et assequi faciat semper mente quae gerimus et debitae servitutis actione sectari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the prayer of your Saint Theodore, the martyr, may always guide our minds in what we do and follow the actions due to the service required.

text: Deus qui populo tuo aeternae salutis beatum Martinum ministrum constituisti: praesta quaesumus ut qui exsecutor mandatorum tuorum exstitit in terris intercessor noster semper esse dignetur in caelis.
translation_en: God who established your people's blessed Martin as a minister of eternal salvation: grant us, we ask, that he who was an executor of Your commands on earth may always be our intercessor in heaven.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum tota tibi corde subiectum et beati Martini confessoris tui atque pontificis supplicatione custodi ut corde et corpore protectus quod piae credidit appetat et quod iuste sperat obtineat.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, your people who are wholly subject to you with a heart full of devotion, and through the supplication of your blessed martyr and bishop Saint Martin, protect him both in body and soul. May he attain what he believes with piety and may he obtain what he justly hopes for.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Brictii confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnia celebrare concedis: praesta quaesumus ut et devotis eadem mentibus celebremus et eius patrocinio promerente veniam nostrarum adipisci mereamur culparum.
translation_en: God who grants us to celebrate the feast of your blessed confessor and bishop, St. Briccius: grant us, we ask, that with devout minds we may celebrate it as well, and, through his patronage, merit to obtain forgiveness for our sins.

text: Sancti Brictii confessoris tui et episcopi veneranda sollemnitas tuae pietati sacrificium nostrum reddat acceptum et per hanc salutarem hostiam et veniam consequamur et gratiam.
translation_en: May the venerable feast of your confessor and bishop, Saint Brictius, be worthy of your devotion. May our sacrifice be acceptable to it. Through this salvific offering, we may obtain forgiveness and grace.

text: Deprecationem nostram quaesumus omnipotens Deus benignus exaudi ut intercedente beato Brictio confessore tuo atque pontifice a peccatorum perpetuis nexibus liberentur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, O Almighty and gracious God, to hear our prayer. Through the intercession of Blessed Brictio, Your confessor and bishop, may they be freed from the perpetual bonds of sin.

text: Beatus Othmarus confessor tuus et abbas Domine quaesumus pia nos intercessione commendet ut tibi placito fulti suffragio quam precamur indulgentiam peccatorum consequamur.
translation_en: Blessed Othmar, your confessor and abbot, Lord, we humbly ask that with your holy intercession, you commend us so that, filled with the grace for which we pray, we may obtain the indulgence of sins.

text: Grata tibi sint munera Domine quae tuo sunt instituta praecepto et beati Othmari abbatis festivitas gloriosa commendet.
translation_en: May these gifts, Lord, which you have established by your command, be pleasing to you. The festive day of the blessed Abbot Othmar shall recommend his glorious celebration.

text: Semper quaesumus Domine plebs tua ad remedii caelestis dona concurrat et intercessione beati Othmari per eadem sanctificata mundentur. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Always we beseech you, Lord, may your people come together for the gift of celestial remedy, and through the intercession of Blessed Othmar, may they be cleansed by the same [grace]. Through the Lord.

text: Deus qui beatum Anianum pontificem sacerdotali dignitate tibi complacuisse virtutis tuae munere declarasti: eius interventu fac nos quaesumus tibi voluntate et opere acceptabiles et caelestium praemiorum participes.
translation_en: God, who showed favor to the blessed Anianus in the dignity of the priesthood through the gift of your virtue: through his intervention, we humbly ask you to make us acceptable both in your will and deed, and participants of heavenly rewards.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Martini confessoris tui atque pontificis frequentata sollemnitas ad perpetuam populo tuo proficiat salutem et quem saepius veneramur in terris intercessorem semper habere mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that the solemnity of your blessed confessor and pope Martin may profit our people forever with eternal salvation. May we, who venerate him more frequently on earth, always merit to have him as an intercessor in heaven.

text: Haec oblatio Domine Deus quam iterata sancti confessoris tui Martini festivitate tuae offerimus maiestati nobis prosit ad indulgentiam ut per eam a nostris liberemur peccatis et sacris altaribus astare digni efficiamur.
translation_en: This offering, Lord God, which we repeat during the feast of your holy confessor Martin, we present to Your majesty. May it profit us with indulgence so that through it we may be freed from our sins and become worthy to stand before sacred altars.

text: Sacramenta Domine quae sumpsimus beato Martino confessore tuo atque pontifice intercedente ab omni nos adversitate defendant et perpetua prosperitate tibi soli Deo servire concedant.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the sacraments which we have received through your blessed confessor and bishop Martin, and through his intercession defend us from every adversity and grant us eternal prosperity to serve only you, God.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in sanctorum tuorum es virtute mirabilis: dona nobis in beati Clementis annua sollemnitate laetari qui Filii tui martyr et pontifex quod mysterio gessit testimonio comprobavit et quod praedicavit ore confirmavit exemplo.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in the power of your saints are miraculous: grant us to rejoice on the annual feast day of blessed Clement, your son who was a martyr and pope. Through the mystery he performed, he proved his testimony; through his words he confirmed it with example.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente beato Clemente martyre tuo atque pontifice per haec nos a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, we offer these gifts, sanctify them. Through the intercession of the blessed martyr and pope Clement, purify us from the stains of our sins.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris ut qui ex iniquitate nostra reos nos esse cognoscimus beati Chrysogoni martyris tui intercessione liberemur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to our supplications, so that we who know ourselves to be guilty in your righteousness, may be freed through the intercession of the blessed martyr Chrysogonus.

text: Deus qui dedisti legem Moysi in summitate montis Sinai et in eodem loco per angelos tuos corpus beatae Catherinae virginis ac martyris tuae mirabiliter collocasti: tribue quaesumus ut eius meritis et intercessione ad montem qui Christus est valeamus pervenire.
translation_en: God who gave the law to Moses on the summit of Mount Sinai and miraculously placed the body of the blessed Catherine, your virgin and martyr, in the same place through your angels: grant us that we may be able to reach the mountain which is Christ, through her merits and intercession.

text: Deus qui nos beatorum martyrum tuorum Saturnini Chrysanti Mauri et Dariae concedis natalicio perfrui: eorum nos tribue meritis adiuvari.
translation_en: God who allows us to celebrate the nativity of your blessed martyrs Saturninus, Chrysanthus, Maurice, and Daria: grant us through their merits to be assisted.

text: Munera Domine tibi dicata sanctifica et intercedentibus sanctis tuis Saturnino Chrysanto Mauro et Daria per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings dedicated to You be sanctified. Through your saints Saturninus, Chrysanthus, Mauro, and Daria, we humbly request that you turn Your attention to us.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria beati Andreae festivitate laetantes quae sicut tuis sanctis ad gloriam ita nobis quaesumus ad veniam prodesse proficiat.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the divine mysteries of blessed Andrew, rejoicing in his feast, just as they have been a source of glory for your saints, we humbly ask that they may also be profitable to us for forgiveness. May it so prosper.

text: Beati Andreae apostoli Domine quaesumus intercessione nos adiuva pro cuius sollemnitate percepimus tua sancta laetantes.
translation_en: Blessed apostle Andrew, Lord, we humbly ask that with your intercession you help us, for whose solemnity we have perceived your holy rejoicing.

text: Deus qui beatum Nicolaum pium pontificem tuum innumeris decorasti miraculis: tribue nobis quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus a gehennae ignis incendiis liberemur.
translation_en: God, who adorned the blessed Nicholas, your pious priest, with countless miracles: grant us, we ask, that through his merits and prayers, we may be freed from the fires of hell.

text: Sacrificia quae sumpsimus Domine pro commemoratione sancti pontificis tui Nicolai sempiterna nos protectione confirment.
translation_en: The sacrifices which we have taken, Lord, for the commemoration of your saintly bishop Nicholas, may they eternally confirm us under Your perpetual protection.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui famulum tuum Nicolaum pontificem coetibus tuorum dignatus es associare sanctorum: concede nobis supplicantibus quatenus eius intercedentibus meritis indulgentiam exsuperare tribulationum foveas cavere inimicorum probabilem thesaurum congregare virtutum ut quandoque te valeamus regnantem videre inter choros angelorum.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God, who deigned to associate your servant Nicholas, the pope, with your gatherings of saints: grant us, who entreat you, that through his intercession we may surpass the pitfalls of trials, beware the probable treasure of our enemies, collect a worthy store of virtues, so that we may sometimes be able to behold you reigning among the choirs of angels.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine has oblationes 〈quas〉 in honore beatissimi confessoris tui atque pontificis Nicolai offerimus humillime deprecantes quatenus vitae nostrae ubique dirigas via delicta deleas pacem tribuas hostes visibiles et invisibiles procul repellas et nos ubique famulos tuos inter adversa et prospera semper tuis laudibus apertos.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify these offerings which we present in honor of your blessed confessor and pope Nicholas. We implore you to guide our lives everywhere, to forgive our sins, grant peace, both visible and invisible enemies far away, and always keep us open to your praises, amidst adversities and prosperities.

text: Sacri corporis et sanguinis Filii tui Domine Deus 〈munere〉 vegetati te supplices deprecamur ut intercedente beato Nicolao confessore tuo atque pontifice inter adversa huius vitae et prospera nos ubique conserves peccata dimittas pacem tribuas hostes removeas inimicis nostris caritatem largiaris ut sub umbra alarum tuarum protecti mundi mala quandoque transcendendo desideria ad gaudia pervenire mereamur aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord God, by the grace of your Sacred Body and Blood, our Savior, that through the intercession of blessed Nicholas, your confessor and pope, you preserve us in adversity and prosperity throughout life, forgive us our sins, grant us peace, remove our enemies, bestow charity on our adversaries, and that under the protection of your wings we may sometimes transcend worldly desires to reach eternal joys.

text: Protegat nos Domine saepius beati Andreae apostoli repetita sollemnitas ut cuius patrocinia sine intermissione recolimus defensionem sentiamus.
translation_en: May the Lord often protect us, by the repeated solemnity of Blessed Andrew the Apostle; that we may always remember his patronage and feel his defense.

text: Adiuvet familiam tuam Domine tibi supplicando beatus Andreas apostolus et pius interventor efficiatur qui tui nominis exstitit praedicator.
translation_en: Blessed Andrew the Apostle and the pious intercessor may aid your family, Lord, as he who stood as a preacher of your name.

text: Salutarem omnipotens Pater hostiam immolantes exoramus clementiam tuam ut Genitricis Filii tui supplicatione placatus per eam nos et a peccatis absolvas et ad visionem gloriae tuae perducas.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Almighty Father, as we offer the sacrifice, that You would show Your mercy by granting us pardon for our sins and lead us to the sight of Your glory through the intercession of Your Son's Mother.

text: Caelestis libamine vegetati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut nos gloriosae Genitricis semperque Virginis Mariae continuata confirmet protectio cuius nostrae causa salutis exstitit hodierna conceptio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that the heavenly robe of life may strengthen us through the continuous protection of the glorious Ever-Virgin Mother Mary, whose cause for our salvation became today's conception.

text: Sumptum Domine caelestis remedii sacramentum quaesumus ad perpetuam nobis provenire gloriam beatus Damasus pontifex obtineat.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to bestow upon us the sacred remedy of heavenly salvation, that it may bring eternal glory to us. Blessed Damasus, the pope, may obtain this.

text: Intercessio nos quaesumus Domine sanctae Luciae martyris tuae votiva confoveat ut eius sacra natalicia et temporaliter frequentemus et conspiciamus aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the vow of Your saintly martyr Lucy may intercede for us, so that we may both celebrate her sacred birthday and temporarily partake in it, and may behold her eternal glory.

text: Quaesumus virtutum caelestium Deus ut sacrificia pro sanctae tuae Luciae sollemnitate delata desiderium nos temporale doceant habere contemptui et ambire dona faciant caelestium gaudiorum.
translation_en: We entreat you, God of heavenly virtues, that the sacrifices offered on the feast day of your holy Lucia may teach us to have a temporal contempt and make us pursue the joys of heaven.

text: Laeti Domine sumpsimus sacramenta caelestia et intercedente pro nobis beata Lucia martyre tua ad vitam nobis quaesumus proficiant sempiternam.
translation_en: With joy, we have received the celestial sacraments, and with blessed Lucy, the martyr, interceding for us, we humbly ask that they may lead us to eternal life.

text: Deus illuminator omnium gentium qui mirae virtutis tuae potentiam in beata Otilia virgine demonstrasti: immensam pietatis clementiam humiliter imploramus ut sicut in ea nativae caecitatis tenebras tuae virtutis potentiam misericorditer illuminasti ita quoque mihi famulo tuo ipsius suffragantibus meritis et gratiam luminis corporalis et aeternae beatitudinis gloriam largiaris.
translation_en: God, enlightener of all nations, who demonstrated your miraculous power in the blessed Otilia virgin: humbly we implore your immense mercy of piety that, as you mercifully illuminated the darkness of her nativity blindness with your power, so also for me, your servant, through your own merits and grace, grant the light of bodily understanding and the glory of eternal beatitude.

text: Deus qui per Unigenitum Filium tuum Dominum nostrum beatum Lazarum quadriduanum mortuum de monumento suscitasti: erige nos de tumulis peccatorum nostrorum ut mereamur adipisci consortia electorum. Per eundem.
translation_en: God who through Your only-begotten Son, our Lord blessed Lazarus, raised him from the tomb after he had been dead for four days: raise us up from the tombs of our sins that we may deserve to receive the company of the elect. Through Him.

text: Beati Lazari dilecti tui sollemnia celebrantes tibi Domine hostias laudis immolamus cuius precibus a nostris mundemur delictis. Per eundem.
translation_en: Blessed are the Lazarus, your beloved ones, who celebrate your solemnities, Lord; we offer to you hosts of praise that we may be cleansed from our sins through his intercessions. Through the same.

text: Refecti participatione divini muneris quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beato Lazaro dilecto tuo cunctis efficiamur hostibus fortiores. Per eundem.
translation_en: Fed by the participation in Your divine grace, we humbly ask You, Lord our God, that through the intercession of the blessed Lazarus, Your beloved one, may we become stronger against all enemies. Through the same.

text: Sacramenti tui Domine munere vegetati 〈quaesumus〉 ut intercessione beati Thomae apostoli tui bonis operibus quibus per tuam gratiam nunc fovemur perfruamur aeternis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that by the power of your sacrament, we may be enriched through the intercession of your apostle Saint Thomas, and may enjoy eternal rewards for the good works in which we are now nurtured by your grace.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati N. apostoli tui quam praevenimus veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the venerable feast day of your blessed apostle N., which we approach, may increase our reverence and devotion, and bring us peace.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut beati apostoli tui N. suffragiis in nobis tua munera tuearis pro cuius honorabili confessione hostias tibi laudis offerimus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that through the intercession of your blessed apostle N., you may protect us and bestow your gifts upon us. For his honorable confession we offer you sacrifices of praise.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sacramenti tui participatione vegetati sancti quoque apostoli tui N. precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, that with the participation in your sacrament, we may be nourished also by the prayers of your holy apostle N.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum cum sancti apostoli tui N. patrocinio supplicantem ut tuo semper auxilio secura tibi possit devotione servire.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, Your people, with the intercession of Your holy Apostle N., who are beseeching You, so that they may always be able to serve You safely with devotion through Your constant aid.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi Domine quaesumus beati apostoli tui N. precatio sancta conciliet ut cuius honore sollemniter exhibetur meritis efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our sacrifice may please you, through the intercession of your blessed Apostle N., that what is offered with solemn honor may be made acceptable by its merits.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria beati apostoli tui N. festivitate laetantes quae sicut tuis sanctis ad gloriam ita nobis quaesumus ad veniam prodesse facias.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the divine mysteries of your blessed apostle N., rejoicing in his feast, which as it has been a means to glory for your saints, so we humbly ask that it may be a means to forgiveness for us as well.

text: Deus qui nos annua apostolorum tuorum N. sollemnitate laetificas: praesta quaesumus ut quorum gaudemus meritis instruamur exemplis.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the annual feast of your apostles N.: grant us, we ask, that we may be instructed by their examples through whose merits we rejoice.

text: Munera Domine quae pro apostolorum sollemnitate deferimus propitius respice et mala omnia quae iuste meremur averte.
translation_en: Lord, the gifts we bring for the solemnity of the Apostles, look upon them favorably, and turn away from us all evils that we justly deserve.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nostra devotio quae natalicia beati N. martyris tui antecedit patrocinia nobis eius accumulet.
translation_en: We beseech You, almighty God, that the devotion which precedes the patronage of the blessed N. your martyr may accumulate to our benefit.

text: Magnifica Domine beati martyris tui N. sollemnia recensemus quae promptis cordibus ambientes oblatis muneribus et suscipimus et praeimus.
translation_en: We magnify you, Lord, of your blessed martyr N., on the solemn days we remember which, with hearts ready, we offer gifts, receive and pray.

text: Sancta tua Domine de beati N. martyris pretiosa passione quam praeimus nos refoveant quibus et iugiter satiamur et semper desideramus expleri.
translation_en: May the holy passion of your blessed servant N., Lord, revive and sustain us whom we celebrate, and may we ever be satisfied and continually desire to be filled with it.

text: Quaesumus Domine muneribus nostris precibusque susceptis et caelestibus nos munda mysteriis et intercedente beato martyre tuo N. clementer exaudi.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, with our offerings and prayers received, cleanse us with celestial mysteries, and through your blessed martyr N., grant us graciously to hear.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut commemoratione beati martyris tui N. temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur aspectu.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly ask You, Almighty God, that just as we are pleased with the temporal service of Your blessed martyr N. during commemoration, so may we be perpetually joyful in His eternal appearance.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris ut qui ex iniquitate nostra reos nos esse cognoscimus beati N. martyris tui intercessione liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present with our supplications, so that through the intercession of your blessed martyr N., we may be freed from the guilt of our iniquity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in sanctorum martyrum tuorum cordibus flammam tuae dilectionis accendis: da mentibus nostris eandem fidei caritatisque virtutem ut quorum gaudemus triumphis proficiamus exemplis.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who in the hearts of your saints martyrs kindle the flame of your love: grant to our minds the same power of faith and charity, so that we may advance by their examples whom we rejoice in their triumphs.

text: Salutari sacrificio quaesumus Domine populus tuus semper exsultet quo et debitus honor sanctis martyribus exhibetur et sanctificationis munus acquiritur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your people may always rejoice in the saving sacrifice, whereby due honor is shown to the holy martyrs and the office of sanctification is obtained.

text: Celebritatis annuae vota pro martyrum tuorum N. beata passione peregimus; ipsorum nobis Domine quaesumus fiant intercessione salutaria in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter impleta.
translation_en: During the annual festivities, we present our vows for your martyrs N., through their blessed passion. We humbly ask you, Lord, that through their intercession, there may be a beneficial outcome for us in whose natal days their joyful fulfillment is exultantly achieved.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine precibus nostris quas in sancti N. confessoris tui commemoratione deferimus ut qui nostrae iustitiae fiduciam non habemus eius qui tibi placuit precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, to be present with our prayers which we bring before you in the commemoration of your saint N. the confessor, that he who did not have faith in our justice may be helped by his intercessions who pleased you.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et interveniente pro nobis sancto N. confessore tuo iisdem sacramentis caelestibus servientes ab omni culpa liberos esse concede ut purificante nos gratia tua iisdem quibus famulamur mysteriis emundemur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and, with your holy confessor N. interceding for us, grant that we may be freed from all guilt by those same heavenly sacraments. May we be purified by your grace as we serve these mysteries, so that we may be made clean.

text: Ut nobis Domine tua sacrificia dent salutem beatus confessor tuus et pontifex N. quaesumus precator accedat.
translation_en: Lord, may Your sacrifices grant us salvation and bless your confessor and bishop N. as we humbly ask, so let him approach.

text: Misericordiam tuam nobis quaesumus Domine interveniente beato N. confessore tuo atque pontifice clementer impende et nobis peccatoribus ipsius propitiare suffragiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your mercy may be extended to us. May it come through your blessed confessor N., and your merciful bishop, and may they intercede for us sinners, and propitiate us with their prayers.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine semper haec tibi vota gratanter persolvere qui sancti N. confessoris tui atque pontificis depositionem recolimus et praesta ut in eius semper laude tuam gloriam praedicemus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, always to fulfill these vows gratefully, who remember the departure of your confessor and bishop Saint N. And provide that we may always proclaim your glory in his praise.

text: Sumpta Domine caelestis remedii sacramenta ad perpetuam nobis provenire gratiam beatus N. pontifex obtineat.
translation_en: May the sacred remedy of our heavenly Redeemer, blessed Pope N., obtain for us the grace to come perpetually.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras quas in sancti N. confessoris tui sollemnitate deferimus ut qui tibi digne meruit famulari eius intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, our prayers which we bring on the solemnity of your confessed saint N., that those who have deservedly served you may intercede for us with their merits and absolve us from all sins.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro commemoratione santi N. confessoris tui offerimus suppliciter deprecantes ut sicut illi praebuisti sacrae fidei claritatem sic nobis indulgentiam largiaris et pacem.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, hosts in memory of Your saint N., the confessor, with humble supplications. We pray that, as you granted him clarity of sacred faith, you may grant us forgiveness and peace.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum: praesta ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus et per preces beati N. confessoris tui cuius venerandam celebramus festivitatem indulgentiam peccatorum consequamur.
translation_en: God, rewarder of the faithful souls: grant that we may obtain forgiveness for our sins through these holy sacraments and the prayers of your blessed confessor N., whose revered feast day we celebrate.

text: Beatorum confessorum tuorum N. nos quaesumus Domine foveat pretiosa confessio et pia iugiter intercessio tueatur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to protect the precious confession of your blessed confessors N., and may their constant pious intercession shield us.

text: Munera plebis tuae quaesumus Domine sanctorum confessorum N. fiant tibi grata suffragiis et a cunctis nos protegant periculis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings of your people may become pleasing to you through the prayers of the holy confessors N. May they protect us from all dangers.

text: Sumentes gaudia sempiterna de participatione sacramenti et de festivitate beatorum confessorum N. quaesumus Domine ut ad vitam nutriamur aeternam.
translation_en: Taking eternal joy from the participation in the sacrament and the festivity of the blessed confessors N., we humbly ask, Lord, that we may be nourished with an eternal life.

text: Deus qui nos hodie beatae et sanctae N. virginis tuae sollemnitate laetificas: concede propitius ut eius adiuvemur meritis cuius castitatis irradiamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who today delights us on the solemnity of the blessed and holy N. virgin: grant graciously that we may be helped by her merits, whose examples we are enlightened by her chastity.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beatae N. virginis tuae dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Accept, Lord, these offerings dedicated to your blessed Virgin N., and grant us that through her merits they may benefit us eternally and always provide us with aid.

text: Adiuvent nos quaesumus Domine et haec mysteria sancta quae sumpsimus et beatae N. virginis intercessio veneranda.
translation_en: Assist us, we ask you Lord, and these holy mysteries which we have received, through the venerable intercession of the blessed Virgin N.

text: Deus qui inter cetera potentiae tuae miracula 〈etiam in sexu fragili〉 virtutem martyrii contulisti: concede propitius ut qui beatae virginis et martyris tuae N. natalicia colimus per eius ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God, who among other miracles of your power also bestowed virtue in fragile sex upon the martyr: grant favorably that we who celebrate the nativity of your blessed virgin and martyr N., may be worthy through his examples to obtain grace before you.

text: Sanctae virginis et martyris N. precibus confidentes quaesumus Domine ut per ea quae sumpsimus aeterna remedia capiamus.
translation_en: With confidence in the prayers of the holy virgin and martyr N., we humbly ask you, Lord, that through what we have received from her, we may obtain eternal remedies.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: universa nobis adversantia propitiatus exclude ut intercessione sanctae Annae genitricis beatae Mariae matris Filii tui noxia cuncta submoveas et omnia nobis profutura concedas.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, please have mercy on us and remove all adversities from our path through the intercession of the blessed Anne, mother of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Your Son. May You move away all harmful things and grant us every good outcome.

text: Super has quaesumus omnipotens Deus Pater oblationes quae in memoria sanctissimae Annae matris beatissimae Genitricis Unigeniti tui Domini nostri consecrantur et tuam effunde benedictionem et per eas nobis tribue cordium purificationem.
translation_en: For these we humbly ask you, Almighty God, Father, that the offerings which are consecrated in the most holy memory of Anne, the blessed Mother of your only-begotten Son our Lord, may receive your blessing, and through them bestow upon us the purification of hearts.

text: Sumpta sacramenta quaesumus Domine intercedente beatissima Anna matre gloriosae Genitricis Unigeniti tui nos et ab hostium defendant formidine et aeternae mortis amaritudine.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with the intercession of the most blessed Anna, mother of the glorious Mother of your Only-begotten Son, to protect us from the fear of enemies and the bitterness of eternal death.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui infirma mundi eligis ut fortia quaeque confundas: concede propitius ut qui beatarum virginum N. sollemnia colimus earum apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who chooses to humble the world so as to confound the strong: graciously grant that we who celebrate the feast of the blessed virgins N. may feel your patronage with them before you.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus admitte et dicatum tibi sacrificium beatarum virginum N. oratio commendet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you grant us favor and admit our prayers. May the petition to you be recommended by the prayer of the blessed virgins N.

text: Sanctificet nos quaesumus Domine tui perceptio sacramenti et intercessio beatarum virginum N. tibi reddat acceptos.
translation_en: Holy Lord, we humbly ask that your perception of the sacred mystery sanctifies us, and the intercession of the blessed virgins N. may return our offerings to you.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster sanctarum virginum martyrum tuarum palmas incessabili devotione venerari ut quas digna mente non possumus celebrare humilibus saltem frequentemus obsequiis.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, that we may venerate with unceasing devotion the palms of your holy virgin martyrs. May we at least frequently show our obeisance to those whom we are unable to celebrate with worthy mind.

text: Intende quaesumus Domine munera altaribus tuis pro sanctarum virginum et martyrum tuarum commemoratione imposita ut sicut per haec beata mysteria illis gloriam contulisti ita nobis indulgentiam largiaris et pacem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to direct your gifts towards your altars in memory of the holy virgins and martyrs commemorated. Just as through these blessed mysteries you bestowed glory upon them, grant us mercy and peace.

text: Sacramentis quaesumus Domine muniamur acceptis et sanctarum virginum et martyrum tuarum intercessione contra omnes nequitias armis caelestibus protegamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that we may be fortified by your sacraments, and protected through the intercession of your holy virgins and martyrs, against all wickedness, that we may be shielded with celestial arms.

text: Deus qui visibiliter omnia contines et tamen pro salute generis humani signa tuae †inhabitationis illustras ut omnes templum hoc potentia† qui huc deprecaturi conveniunt ex quacumque tribulatione ad te clamaverunt consolationis tuae beneficia consequantur.
translation_en: God, who encompasses all things visibly and yet illuminates the signs of your †dwelling for the salvation of the human race, so that all who come here to petition, whatever tribulation they have called out to you, may receive the benefits of your consolation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus templum hoc nomini tuo dicatum caelestis virtutis benedictione sanctifica et omnibus hic in te sperantibus auxilii tui munus ostende ut hic et sacramentorum virtus et votorum obtineatur effectus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, with the blessing of heavenly virtue, sanctify this temple dedicated to your name and show the aid of your help to all who hope in you here, so that the power of the sacraments and the fulfillment of vows may be obtained here.

text: Multiplica quaesumus Domine per haec divina mysteria misericordiam nobis ut te iugiter in templo sancto tuo adoremus 〈et〉 cum sanctis angelis gloriemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to multiply mercy upon us through these divine mysteries, so that we may continually adore you in your holy temple and rejoice with the holy angels.

text: Deus qui nos ad anniversarium diem consecrationis huius ecclesiae tribuisti venire: concede quaesumus ut quicquid in tuo nomine petituri intraverimus sanctorum tuorum precibus impetremus.
translation_en: God who granted us to come on the anniversary of the consecration of this church, grant us we ask that whatever we enter seeking in your name may we obtain through the prayers of your saints.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut nostra munera quae sacris altaribus inferuntur devotis mentibus ad remedium animarum praeparentur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, that the offerings brought to Your holy altars may be prepared with devoted minds for the salvation of souls.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut in hoc loco qui nomini tuo dedicatus est cunctis petentibus aures tuae pietatis accommodes.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God that in this place dedicated to Your name, Your ears of mercy may be attuned to all who petition.

text: Deus qui sacrandorum tibi auctor es munerum: effunde super hoc altare benedictionem tuam ut ab omnibus hic invocantibus nomen tuum defensionis tuae auxilium sentiatur.
translation_en: God who are the author of sacred offerings: pour upon this altar your blessing, so that help from your defense may be felt by all here invoking your name.

text: Descendat quaesumus Domine Deus noster Spiritus tuus Sanctus super hoc altare qui et populi tui dona sanctificet et sumentium corda purificet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that your Holy Spirit may descend upon this altar. May it sanctify your people and purify the hearts of those who partake.

text: Effunde quaesumus Domine super hoc altare gratiam tuam et omnibus in te sperantibus auxilii tui munus impende.
translation_en: Pour down upon us, Lord, Your grace on this altar and bestow upon all who hope in You the gift of Your help.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam sponsam vocare dignatus es ut quae haberet gratiam per fidei devotionem haberet etiam ex nomine pietatem: da ut omnis haec plebs nomini tuo serviens huius vocabuli consortio digna esse mereatur et Ecclesia tua in templo cuius anniversarius dedicationis dies celebratur tibi collecta te timeat te diligat te sequatur ut dum iugiter per vestigia tua graditur ad caelestia promissa te ducente pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: God, who have deemed fit to call your Church as a bride that she might have grace through the devotion of faith and also piety from her name: grant that this whole people, serving Your name, may be worthy of this association of the name, and that Your Church in the temple whose anniversary of dedication day is celebrated, may be collected to You, may fear You, love You, follow You, so that while continually walking in Your footsteps, they may deserve to reach the heavenly promises led by You.

text: Corda nostra quaesumus Domine sanctus splendor tuae incarnationis nativitatis circumcisionis apparitionis oblationis baptismi transfigurationis beatae passionis et admirabilis resurrectionis ascensionisque atque adventus Spiritus Sancti clementi respectu illustret quo mundi huius tenebris carere valeamus et ipso nos ducente in omnem viam veritatis perveniamus ad patriam claritatis aeternae.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your holy glory of the nativity, circumcision, appearance, offering, baptism, transfiguration, blessed passion, wonderful resurrection, ascension and coming of the Holy Spirit shine upon our hearts. May we be able to live without the darkness of this world, and may you lead us on every path of truth, so that we may reach the eternal land of clarity.

text: In mentibus nostris quaesumus Domine verae fidei sacramenta firmiter confirma ut qui conceptum de virgine Deum verum et hominem confitemur per eius salutiferae incarnationis nativitatis circumcisionis apparitionis oblationis baptismi transfigurationis et beatae passionis et admirabilis resurrectionis ascensionisque atque adventus Spiritus Sancti potentiam ad aeternam mereamur pervenire laetitiam.
translation_en: In our minds, we humbly ask, Lord, that You firmly strengthen the sacraments of true faith. So that we, who confess God truly man and son born from a virgin, may merit to arrive at eternal joy through His salutary incarnation's nativity, circumcision, appearance, offering, baptism, transfiguration, blessed passion, admirable resurrection, ascension, and coming of the Holy Spirit.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi incarnationis nativitatis circumcisionis apparitionis oblationis baptismi transfigurationis beatae passionis et admirabilis resurrectionis ascensionisque atque Paracliti adventus memoriam colimus ipsi per eiusdem Sancti Spiritus gratiam a morte animae resurgamus et in tua semper tecum sanctificatione vivamus. Per eundem.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that we who commemorate the incarnation, nativity, circumcision, appearance, offering, baptism, transfiguration, blessed passion and admirable resurrection, ascension, and coming of your Son our Lord Jesus Christ, may rise from death by the grace of the same Holy Spirit, and live always in your sanctification. Through the same.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cui redditur votum in Ierusalem: per merita et intercessione sancti N. martyris tui exaudi preces famuli tui N. memor esto sacrificii sui et pinguia fiant holocausta eius; tribue ei quaesumus divitias gratiae tuae comple in bonis desiderium eius corona eum in miseratione et misericordia et ut tibi Domino pia devotione iugiter famuletur ignosce ei facinora et ne lugenda committat dono tuae pietatis indulge.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God to whom vows are rendered in Jerusalem: through the merits and intercession of your saint N. martyr, hear the prayers of your servant N., remember him for his sacrifice and may his holocausts be rich. Grant him, we pray, riches of your grace, fulfill his desires with good things, crown him in mercy and compassion, and let him continually serve you with pious devotion. Forgive him, we entreat, his transgressions, and let not mourning be committed for the gift of your pity's indulgence.

text: Exaudi quaesumus omnipotens Deus orationem nostram pro famulo tuo {ut} qui in honore sancti ac beatissimi N. oblationem tibi offert; cuius suffragiis oramus ut eius vota perficias et descendat super eum gratia tua ut sub umbra alarum tuarum protegatur et semper auxilio tuo munitus tibi famulari mereatur.
translation_en: Hear us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, our prayer for your servant, who offers an oblation to you in honor of the holy and most blessed N. We beseech his intercessions that he may fulfill his vows and receive your grace under the shelter of your altars, so that he may always be protected and defended by your help, and worthy to serve you continually.

text: Munere divino refecti quaesumus Domine ut devotionem famuli tui confirmes in bono et mittas ei auxilium de sancto et de Sion tuearis eum.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, with the divine gift refreshed, that you strengthen the devotion of your servant in good things and send him help from the holy and protect him from Zion.

text: Benedicta sit sancta Trinitas atque indivisa Unitas; confitebimur ei quia fecit nobiscum misericordiam suam.
translation_en: Blessed be the holy Trinity and undivided Unity; we confess to it because it has shown us mercy.

text: O altitudo divitiarum sapientiae et scientiae Dei quam incomprehensibilia sunt iudicia eius et investigabiles viae eius. Quis enim cognovit sensum Domini? Aut quis consiliarius eius fuit? Aut quis prior dedit illi et retribuetur ei? Quoniam ex ipso et per ipsum et in ipso sunt omnia. Ipsi gloria et imperium in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: O the height of divine wisdom and knowledge of God, how unsearchable are his judgments and his ways! Who has known the mind of the Lord, or who was his counselor? Who has first given to him, and it shall be repaid to him? For from him and through him and in him are all things. To him be glory forever and ever.

text: Benedictus es Domine qui intueris abyssos et sedes super Cherubim.
translation_en: Blessed are You, Lord, who looks upon the abysses and sits upon the cherubim.

text: Benedictus es in throno regni tui et laudabilis in saecula.
translation_en: Blessed are You on Your throne in Your kingdom, and worthy of praise throughout the ages.

text: Benedictus es Domine Deus patrum nostrorum et laudabilis in saecula.
translation_en: Blessed are you, Lord God, our fathers', and praiseworthy forevermore.

text: Cum venerit Paraclitus quem ego mittam vobis a Patre Spiritum veritatis qui a Patre procedit ille testimonium perhibebit de me. Et vos testimonium perhibebitis quia ab initio mecum estis. Haec locutus sum vobis ut non scandalizemini. Absque synagogis facient vos. Sed venit hora ut omnis qui interficit vos arbitretur obsequium se praestare Deo. Et haec facient vobis quia non noverunt Patrem neque me. Sed haec locutus sum vobis ut dum venerit hora eorum reminiscamini quia ego dixi vobis.
translation_en: When the Paraclete comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me. And you will testify about yourselves that you have been with me from the beginning. This I spoke to you so that you may not be scandalized. Without a synagogue (or community) you will be in the world. But the hour is coming when all who kill you will think they are offering service to God. And this will happen to you because they do not know the Father nor me. But I have spoken these things to you so that when their hour comes, you may remember that I told you about it.

text: Benedictus sit Deus Pater Unigenitusque Dei Filius Sanctus quoque Spiritus quia fecit nobiscum misericordiam suam.
translation_en: Blessed be God, the Father, the Lord Jesus Christ, and the Holy Spirit, for they have shown us mercy.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine Deus per Unigeniti tui invocationem huius oblationis hostiam et cooperante Spiritu Sancto nos per eam tibi perfice munus aeternum. Per eundem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord God, that through the invocation of your Only-Begotten Son you sanctify this offering of bread and wine, and by the cooperation of the Holy Spirit, perfect us in it for an eternal service to you. Through the same.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Qui cum Unigenito Filio tuo et Spiritu Sancto unus es Deus unus es Dominus non in unius singularitate personae sed in unius Trinitate substantiae. Quod enim de tua gloria revelante te credimus hoc de Filio tuo hoc de Spiritu Sancto sine differentia discretionis sentimus ut in confessione verae sempiternaeque Deitatis et in personis proprietas et in essentia unitas et in maiestate adoretur aequalitas. Quam laudant angeli atque archangeli Cherubim quoque ac Seraphim qui non cessant clamare cottidie una voce dicentes.
translation_en: We believe in you, eternal God, who are one with your Unigenitus Son and the Holy Spirit; you are one God, one Lord, not in a singularity of person but in the unity of Trinity in substance. For what we confess about your glory, we also believe about your Son, and about the Holy Spirit without any difference or discretion. In true and eternal confession, we acknowledge properties in the persons, unity in essence, and equality in majesty. The angels, archangels, Cherubim, and Seraphim who never cease to praise you daily, proclaim this with one voice.

text: Benedicite Deum caeli et coram omnibus viventibus confitebimur ei quia fecit nobiscum misericordiam suam.
translation_en: Bless the God of heaven, and before all living beings we will confess to him because he has shown us his mercy.

text: Proficiat nobis quaesumus ad salutem corporis et animae Domine Deus huius sacramenti susceptio et sempiterna sanctae Trinitatis eiusdemque individuae Unitatis confessio.
translation_en: May we be aided, we pray, for the health of both body and soul, Lord God. By receiving this sacrament and the eternal confession of the holy Trinity and its individual unity.

text: Dixit mihi angelus: Scribe: beati qui ad cenam nuptiarum agni vocati sunt. Et dixit mihi: Haec verba Dei vera sunt. Et cecidi ante pedes eius ut adorarem eum et dixit mihi: Vide ne feceris. Conservus enim tuus sum et fratrum tuorum habentium testimonium Iesu. Deum adora.
translation_en: An angel said to me: Write, blessed are those who are called to the marriage supper of the lamb. And he said to me: These words are true from God. And I fell before his feet to worship him, and he said to me: Behold, do not do this. For I am your guardian, and your brothers who have testified to Jesus have God as their God.

text: Benedicite Domino
translation_en: Bless the Lord

text: Concussum est
translation_en: It has been shaken

text: Erat dies festus Iudaeorum et ascendit Iesus Hierosolymam. Est autem Hierosolymis probatica piscina quae cognominatur Hebraice Bethsaida quinque porticus habens. In his iacebat multitudo magna languentium caecorum claudorum aridorum exspectantium aquae motum. Angelus autem Domini secundum tempus descendebat in piscinam et movebatur aqua. Et qui prior descendisset in piscinam post motionem aquae sanus fiebat a quacumque detinebatur infirmitate.
translation_en: It was a feast day for the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. Now, in Jerusalem there is a pool that is called in Hebrew Bethsaida, which has five porticos. A large crowd of lame, blind, and paralyzed people were waiting there for the moving of the water. However, an angel of the Lord would descend into the pool at a certain time and stir up the water. Whoever first entered the pool after the water was stirred up became well from any disease.

text: Stetit angelus iuxta aram
translation_en: An angel stood by the altar

text: Scientes quod probatio fidei vestrae patientiam operatur patientia autem opus perfectum habet ut sitis perfecti et integri in nullo deficientes. Si quis autem vestrum indiget sapientia postulet a Deo qui dat omnibus affluenter et non improperat et dabitur ei. Postulet autem in fide nihil haesitans in Christo Iesu Domino nostro.
translation_en: Knowing that the proof of your faith works through patience, and patience achieves a perfect work so that you may be complete and whole without any lack. If anyone among you lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives generously to all and does not rebuke, and it will be given to him. But let him ask in faith without any doubting, in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: Respondens Iesus dixit: Confiteor tibi Pater caeli et terrae quia abscondisti haec a sapientibus et prudentibus et revelasti ea parvulis. Ita Pater quoniam sic placitum fuit ante te. Omnia mihi tradita sunt a Patre meo et nemo novit Filium nisi Pater neque Patrem quis novit nisi Filius et cui voluerit Filius revelare. Venite ad me omnes qui laborastis et onerati estis et ego reficiam vos. Tollite iugum meum super vos et discite a me quia mitis sum et humilis corde et invenietis requiem animabus vestris. Iugum enim meum suave est et onus meum leve.
translation_en: Jesus replied, "I confess to you, Father in heaven and on earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and the intelligent and revealed them to little ones. So it was pleasing before you. All things have been handed over to me by my Father, and no one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and whoever the Son wishes to reveal. Come to me, all who labor and are burdened, and I will refresh you. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden light."

text: Beata gens
translation_en: Blessed people

text: Unicuique datur manifestatio Spiritus ad utilitatem. Alii quidem per Spiritum datur sermo sapientiae alii autem sermo scientiae secundum eundem Spiritum alteri fides in eodem Spiritu alii gratia sanitatum in uno Spiritu alii operatio virtutum alii prophetia alii discretio spirituum alii genera linguarum alii interpretatio sermonum. Haec autem omnia operatur unus atque idem Spiritus dividens singulis prout vult.
translation_en: To each is given a manifestation of the Spirit for their use. Some, indeed, are given speech of wisdom by the Spirit; others, again, are given speech of knowledge according to the same Spirit. To one faith is given in the same Spirit, to another gifts of healings in one Spirit, to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another discernment of spirits, to another kinds of tongues, to another interpretation of tongues. All these things are worked by one and the same Spirit, distributing to each one as He wills.

text: Si diligitis me mandata mea servate. Et ego rogabo Patrem et alium Paraclitum dabit vobis ut maneat vobiscum in aeternum Spiritum veritatis quem mundus non potest accipere quia non videt eum nec scit eum. Vos autem cognoscetis eum quia apud vos manebit et in vobis erit.
translation_en: If you love me, keep my commandments. And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Paraclete, who will remain with you forever, the Spirit of truth whom the world cannot receive because it neither sees him nor knows him. But you will know him, for he will dwell with you and be in you.

text: Sacrificium salutis nostrae tibi offerentes concede nobis Domine quaesumus purificatis tibi mentibus saepius tuae pietatis celebrare mysterium.
translation_en: Offering the sacrifice of our salvation to you, we humbly ask, Lord, grant us that with purified minds we may more frequently celebrate the mystery of your pity.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus Sanctum nos Spiritum votis promereri sedulis quatenus eius gratia ab omnibus liberemur tentationibus et peccatorum nostrorum indulgentiam consequamur. Per ... eiusdem Spiritus Sancti Deus per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, your Holy Spirit to be promised to us through diligent prayers, so that through his grace we may be freed from all temptations and obtain the forgiveness of our sins. Through... the same Holy Spirit, God for all ages of ages.

text: Cum autem audissent apostoli qui erant Hierosolymis quia recepit Samaria verbum Dei miserunt ad eos Petrum et Ioannem. Qui cum venissent oraverunt pro ipsis ut acciperent Spiritum Sanctum. Nondum enim in quemquam illorum venerat sed baptizati tantum erant in nomine Domini. Tunc imponebant manus super illos et accipiebant Spiritum Sanctum.
translation_en: When the apostles who were in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them. When they arrived, they prayed for them so that they might receive the Holy Spirit. For as yet the Holy Spirit had not come upon any of them; they had been baptized only in the name of the Lord. Then Peter and John laid their hands upon them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

text: Si quis diligit me sermonem meum servabit. Et Pater meus diliget eum et ad eum veniemus et mansionem apud eum faciemus. Qui non diligit me sermones meos non servat. Et sermonem quem audistis non est meus sed eius qui misit me Patris. Haec locutus sum vobis apud vos manens. Paraclitus autem Spiritus Sanctus quem mittet Pater in nomine meo ille vos docebit omnia et suggeret vobis omnia quaecumque dixero vobis. Pacem relinquo vobis pacem meam do vobis. Non quomodo mundus dat ego do vobis. Non turbetur cor vestrum neque formidet. Audistis quia ego dixi vobis: Vado et venio ad vos. Si diligeretis me gauderetis utique quia vado ad Patrem quia Pater maior me est. Et nunc dixi vobis priusquam fiat ut cum factum fuerit credatis. Iam non multa loquar vobiscum venit enim princeps mundi huius et in me non habet quicquam. Sed ut cognoscat mundus quia diligo Patrem. Et sicut mandatum dedit mihi Pater sic facio.
translation_en: Whoever loves me will keep my words, and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our dwelling with him. Whoever does not love me will not keep my words. The word you hear is not mine but that of the one who sent me. I have spoken these things among you while I still remain with you. But the Paraclete, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things and remind you of everything I have said to you. Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give it to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid. You heard me say to you: 'I go away, and I will come to you.' If you loved me, you would rejoice because I am going to the Father. For the Father is greater than I. And now I have told you before it takes place so that when it does occur, you may believe. I do not have much more to say to you, for the prince of this world comes, and he has nothing in me. But so that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father has sent me, so I also do.

text: Caritas Dei
translation_en: Love of God

text: Diligam te
translation_en: I will love you

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui iustitiam tuae legis in cordibus credentium digito tuo scribis: da nobis fidei spei et caritatis augmentum et ut mereamur assequi quod promittis fac nos amare quod praecipis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who writes the justice of your law in the hearts of believers with your finger: grant us an increase of faith and hope, and that we may deserve to attain what you promise; make us love what you command.

text: Caritas patiens est benigna est caritas non aemulatur non agit perperam non inflatur non est ambitiosa non quaerit quae sua sunt non irritatur non cogitat malum non gaudet super iniquitatem congaudet autem veritati. Omnia suffert omnia sperat omnia sustinet caritas autem numquam excidet.
translation_en: Charity is patient, kind; charity does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud, it does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs. It does not delight in evil but rejoices in truth. It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres. Love never fails.

text: Filioli mei adhuc modicum vobiscum sum. Quaeretis me et sicut dixi Iudaeis quo ego vado vos non potestis venire et vobis dico modo. Mandatum novum do vobis ut diligatis invicem sicut dilexi vos. In hoc cognoscent omnes quia mei estis discipuli si dilectionem habueritis ad invicem.
translation_en: My children, I am still with you for a little while. You are looking for me and just as I told the Jews, where I go, you cannot come. And I say to you now in another way: I give you a new commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you. By this everyone will know that you are my disciples if you have love for each other.

text: Mitte Domine quaesumus Spiritum Sanctum qui et haec munera praesentia nostra tuum efficiat sacramentum et ad hoc percipiendum corda nostra purificet.
translation_en: Send forth, Lord, as we ask, the Holy Spirit, who makes these gifts present through our presence and cleanses our hearts to receive them.

text: Nos autem gloriari oportet in cruce Domini nostri Iesu Christi in quo est salus vita et resurrectio nostra per quem salvati et liberati sumus.
translation_en: We ought to glory in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, in whom is our salvation, life, and resurrection. Through Him, we have been saved and set free.

text: Deus misereatur nostri et benedicat nobis.
translation_en: May God have mercy on us and bless us.

text: Deus qui Unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi pretioso sanguine vivificae Crucis vexillum sanctificare voluisti concede quaesumus eos qui eiusdem sanctae Crucis gaudent honore tua quoque ubique protectione gaudere. Per eundem.
translation_en: God, who willed to sanctify the banner of your Unigenitus Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, by his precious blood shed on the Cross, grant that those who rejoice in the honor of the same holy Cross may also rejoice in your protection everywhere. Through the same.

text: Christus factus est pro nobis oboediens Patri usque ad mortem mortem autem crucis. Propter quod et Deus illum exaltavit et donavit illi nomen quod est super omne nomen ut in nomine Iesu omne genu flectatur caelestium terrestrium et infernorum et omnis lingua confiteatur quia Dominus Iesus Christus in gloria est Dei Patris.
translation_en: Christ was made obedient for us unto death, even death on a cross. Therefore, God also exalted him and gave him the name that is above every name, so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven, on earth, and under the earth, and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

text: Christus factus est pro nobis oboediens usque ad mortem mortem autem crucis.
translation_en: Christ was made obedient for us unto death, even death on a cross.

text: Propter quod Deus exaltavit illum et dedit illi nomen quod est super omne nomen.
translation_en: Therefore, God has exalted him and given him a name that is above every name.

text: Dulce lignum dulces clavos dulcia ferens pondera quae sola fuisti digna sustinere regem caelorum et Dominum.
translation_en: Sweet wood bearing sweet nails, carrying weights that were alone worthy to sustain the King of Heaven and the Lord.

text: Salvator mundi salva nos qui per Crucem et sanguinem redemisti nos auxiliare nobis te deprecamur Deus noster. V. Crucem tuam adoramus Domine et sanctam resurrectionem tuam laudamus et glorificamus quia per te redempti sumus. V. Per signum sanctae Crucis de inimicis nostris libera nos Deus noster. V. Salva nos Christe Salvator per virtutem Crucis qui salvasti Petrum in mari miserere nobis.
translation_en: Savior of the world, save us who through the Cross and blood have redeemed us; we humbly entreat you, our God. V. We adore your Cross, Lord, and praise and glorify your holy resurrection because through you we have been redeemed. V. Through the sign of the holy Cross, deliver us from our enemies, our God. V. Save us, Christ Savior, by the power of the Cross who saved Peter in the sea, have mercy on us.

text: Assumpsit Iesus duodecim discipulos suos secreto et ait illis: Ecce ascendimus Hierosolymam et Filius hominis tradetur principibus sacerdotum et scribis et condemnabunt eum morte. Et tradent eum gentibus ad illudendum et flagellandum et conspuendum et crucifigendum. Et postquam flagellaverint occident eum. Et die tertia resurget.
translation_en: Jesus took his twelve disciples aside secretly and said to them: Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death. And they will hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and scourged and spitted upon and crucified. And after they have scourged him, they will kill him. But on the third day he will rise again.

text: Protege Domine plebem tuam per signum sanctae Crucis ab omnibus insidiis inimicorum omnium ut tibi gratam exhibeamus servitutem * et acceptabile tibi fiat sacrificium nostrum.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people by the sign of the holy Cross from all the snares of every enemy, so that we may offer you a grateful service and our sacrifice may be acceptable to you.

text: Te sancta Dei Crux humiliter obsecramus ut tua virtute nostrum pectus munias animas custodias cogitationes sanctifices per Christum Iesum qui pependit in te.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your holy Cross, O God, that through your power you may protect our hearts, guard our souls, and sanctify our thoughts, through Christ Jesus who hung upon you.

text: Haec oblatio nos Domine ab omnibus purget offensis quae in ara Crucis etiam totius mundi tulit offensam. Iesus Christus.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, purges us from all offenses which on the Crossbearing Jesus Christ took upon Himself the offense of the entire world.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Qui salutem humani generis in ligno crucis constituisti ut unde mors oriebatur inde vita resurgeret. Et qui in ligno vincebat in ligno quoque vinceretur. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: O eternal God, who established salvation for the human race on the cross of wood, so that where death arose, life would rise again there. And who conquered on the wood, would also be conquered there. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Repleti cibo potuque caelesti quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ab hostium defendas formidine quos redemisti pretioso sanguine Christi Filii tui Domini nostri. Qui tecum vivit.
translation_en: Filled with heavenly food and drink, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, to protect those whom you have redeemed with the precious blood of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, from the fear of their enemies. Who lives with you.

text: Iesu Christi Domini nostri corpore saginati per quem Crucis est sanctificatum vexillum quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus perennitatis eius gloria salutis potiamur effectu. Per eundem.
translation_en: We ask you, Jesus Christ our Lord, who were nourished by body in whom the Cross was made holy, that through these holy things we have received, we may partake of the everlasting glory of his salvation. Through the same.

text: Salve sancta Parens enixa puerpera regem qui caelum terramque regit in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Hail, holy Mother, who gave birth to the king who governs heaven and earth throughout the ages of ages.

text: Ab initio et ante saecula creata sum et usque ad futurum saeculum non desinam et in habitatione sancta coram ipso ministravi. Et sic in Sion firmata sum et in civitate sanctificata similiter requievi et in Ierusalem potestas mea. Et radicavi in populo honorificato et in partes Dei mei hereditas illius. Et in plenitudine sanctorum detentio mea.
translation_en: From the beginning and before the ages, I was created, and I shall not cease to exist until the future age. And I have served in the holy dwelling in his presence. Thus, I was established in Zion, and in the sanctified city I rested similarly, and my power is in Jerusalem. And I rooted myself in the honored people, and in the parts of my God, his inheritance. And in the fullness of saints, my dwelling place.

text: Fortitudo et decor indumentum eius et ridebit in die novissimo. Os suum aperuit sapientiae et lex clementiae in lingua eius. Consideravit semitas domus suae et panem otiosa non comedit. Surrexerunt filii eius et beatissimam praedicaverunt et vir eius laudavit eam. Multae filiae congregaverunt divitias tu supergressa es universas.
translation_en: His strength and beauty adorn his garment, and he will laugh on the last day. His mouth opened in wisdom, and the law of kindness was in his tongue. He considered the paths of his house and did not eat bread of idleness. His sons arose and proclaimed her most blessed, and his man praised her. Many daughters gathered your riches which you have surpassed all.

text: Benedicta et venerabilis es Virgo Maria quae sine tactu pudoris inventa es mater Salvatoris.
translation_en: Blessed and venerable is the Virgin Mary, who was found to be the Mother of the Savior without the touch of shame.

text: Dulcis mater dulcis virgo dulcia ferens ubera quae sola fuisti digna lactare regem caelorum et Dominum.
translation_en: Sweet mother, sweet virgin, bearing sweet breasts, you alone were worthy to nurse the King of Heaven and the Lord.

text: Mira Mater exstitisti / Virgo Deum peperisti / nullam parem repperisti / fronde flore germine. / Quisquis mente te sincera poscit / quem crux mortifera vexat / illi salus vera sit / in tuo nomine. / Assistentes tuae laudi / O Maria nos exaudi / tua prece ne peccati / servos subdat tui nati / transfer ad palatia. / Regnas domo quae stellata / illuc trahe nos beata / ut te iugiter colamus / et cum iustis pertingamus / sempiterna gaudia.
translation_en: Mary, you have appeared / Virgin, you bore God / no equal have you found / with flowering branch, blooming. / Whoever sincerely asks for you / whom the cruel cross afflicts / may salvation be true / in your name. / Your attendants, to your praise / O Mary, hear us / may your prayer free us from sin / and subject us to your son's service / transfer us to palaces. / You reign in the starry house / draw us there, blessed one / so that we may always adore you / and join with the just / eternal joys.

text: Audi filia et vide et inclina aurem tuam quoniam concupivit rex speciam tuam. 〈V.〉 Vultum tuum deprecabuntur omnes divites plebis filiae regum in honore tuo. 〈V.〉 Adducentur regi virgines postea proximae eius offerentur tibi. 〈V.〉 Adducentur in laetitia et exsultatione adducentur in templum regis.
translation_en: Hear, daughter, and see, and incline your ear, for the king desires your beauty. [V.] All the wealthy women of the people, daughters of kings, will beseech your face in your honor. [V.] Virgins will be brought to the king as bridesmaids; they will be offered to you. [V.] They will be brought with joy and exultation to the temple of the king.

text: Loquente Iesu ad turbas extollens vocem quaedam mulier de turba dixit ad Iesum: Beatus venter qui te portavit et ubera quae suxisti. At ille dixit: Quin immo beati qui audiunt verbum Dei et custodiunt illud.
translation_en: While Jesus was speaking to the crowds, raising his voice, a certain woman from the crowd said to him: "Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts that nursed you." But he said: "Rather, blessed are those who hear the word of God and keep it."

text: Felix namque sacra Virgo Maria et omni laude dignissima quia ex te ortus est sol iustitiae Christus Deus noster.
translation_en: Blessed indeed is the holy Virgin Mary, most worthy of all praise, for from you has risen the sun of righteousness, our God, Jesus Christ.

text: Ora pro populo.
translation_en: Pray for the people.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Et te in veneratione beatae Mariae semper Virginis collaudare benedicere et praedicare. Quae et Unigenitum Sancti Spiritus obumbratione concepit et virginitatis gloria permanente lumen aeternum mundo effudit Iesum Christum.
translation_en: We invoke eternally, God, and we acclaim, bless, and proclaim you in the veneration of the blessed Mary, ever Virgin. She, who conceived the Unigenitus under the veil of the Holy Spirit and poured upon the world the eternal light, Jesus Christ, through perpetual virginity shone forth.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Quem felix Maria et omni laude dignissima. Quem Virgo gloriosa et sublimis sponsa Dominum omnium meruisti portare et regem angelorum sola Virgo lactare. O Virgo Maria virginum corpus intactum virgo animae fidelis incorrupta. Quae Dominum regem caeli caelorum omnibus peperisti et vitam mortalibus edidisti. Caelos innovasti mundum purgasti paradisum aperuisti et omnes animas ab inferis liberasti Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum. Per quem maiestatem tua laudent angeli.
translation_en: We call upon you eternally, God. You, whom blessed Mary and all praise worthy of the highest honor, whom the glorious and exalted Virgin has merited to carry as spouse and nurse the Lord alone among angels. O Virgin Mary, body unviolated, soul faithful, incorruptible spirit. You who have brought forth the King of heaven to all, and given life to mortals. You have renewed the heavens, purified the world, opened paradise, freed all souls from the depths, Jesus Christ our Lord. Through whom the angels praise your majesty.

text: Regina mundi et domina Virgo Maria perpetua intercede pro nostra pace et salute quae genuisti Christum Dominum Salvatorem hominum.
translation_en: Queen of the world and Lady, Virgin Mary, continue to intercede for our peace and salvation, who bore Christ the Lord, Savior of mankind.

text: Auxilientur nobis Domine sumpta mysteria et intercedente beata et gloriosa semperque Virgine Dei Genitrice Maria sempiterna protectione confirment.
translation_en: Lord, help us with these sacred mysteries and with the intercession of the blessed and glorious ever-Virgin Mother of God, Mary, may they be confirmed by eternal protection.

text: Recordare Virgo Mater in conspectu Dei ut loquaris pro nobis bonum et averte indignationem suam a nobis.
translation_en: Remember, Virgin Mother, in the sight of God that you may intercede for us with good words, and turn away His anger from us.

text: Beata viscera Mariae Virginis quae portasti aeterni Patris Filium.
translation_en: Blessed are the womb of the Virgin Mary, which bore the Son of the eternal Father.

text: Oblatis Domine placare muneribus et intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis a cunctis nos defende periculis.
translation_en: Lord, appease our offerings and defend us from all dangers through the intercession of all your saints.

text: Deus qui nos beatae Mariae semper Virginis et beatorum spirituum patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum confessorum virginum omniumque simul sanctorum continua commemoratione laetificas: praesta quaesumus ut quos cottidiano veneramur officio etiam piae conversationis semper sequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God, who continually delight us with the remembrance of the blessed Virgin Mary, the patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all saints: grant, we ask, that we who daily honor you in our liturgical service, may also always follow their example in pious conduct.

text: Munera tibi Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus quae et pro cunctorum tibi grata sint honore sanctorum et nobis salutaria te miserante reddantur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the gifts of our devotion, which may be pleasing to You in honor of the saints and may return salvific to us as You have mercy on us.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine intercedentibus omnium sanctorum tuorum meritis ut quae ore contigimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, through the merits of all your saints, that what we receive with our mouth we may comprehend with a pure mind.

text: Fac nos Domine Deus beatae Mariae semper Virginis subsidiis attolli et gloriosa beatorum apostolorum martyrum confessorum virginum atque omnium simul sanctorum protectione defendi ut dum eorum pariter cottidie festa celebramus eorum pariter cottidie ab omnibus adversis protegamur auxilio.
translation_en: Lord God of the blessed Virgin Mary, ever virgin, help us to be raised up by your assistance and shielded under the protection of the glorious apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all saints together. Defend us so that while we daily celebrate their feasts, we may also daily be protected from all adversities with their aid.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sancta Dei Genitrix Virgo Maria sanctique tui apostoli martyres confessores virgines atque omnes sancti et electi Dei quorum in ista continentur ecclesia patrocinia nos ubique adiuvent quatenus hic in illorum praesenti suffragio tranquilla pace in tua laude laetemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the Holy Mother of God, Virgin Mary, your saints apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins and all the saints and elect of God whose patronage is in this church may assist us everywhere, so that here in their present intercession we may rejoice with a peaceful mind in your praise.

text: Munera tuae misericors Deus maiestati oblata benigno quaesumus suscipe intuitu et eorum nobis precibus fiant salutaria quorum sacratissimae in hac basilica reliquiae sunt reconditae.
translation_en: Gracious God, we humbly ask that you receive the offerings made to your majesty. We pray that, viewing them, they become beneficial for us, whose most sacred relics have been hidden in this basilica.

text: Exaudi Domine Deus clementer in hac domo tua preces servorum tuorum quatenus illorum meritis tuam consequamur gratiam quorum hic sacra patrocinia veneramur.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord God, graciously in this your house, the prayers of your servants, that we may obtain your grace through their merits, for whom here we reverence the sacred patronage.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine (nobis famulis tuis per sanctorum tuorum merita quorum reliquiae in praesenti requiescunt ecclesia ut eorum pia intercessione ab omnibus) semper protegamur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord (for us, your servants, through the merits of your saints whose relics now rest in this church, that they may always protect us from all adversities).

text: Suscipiat clementia tua quaesumus Domine munus oblatum et per sanctorum tuorum quorum reliquiae in praesenti requiescunt ecclesia orationes ab omnibus nos emundet peccatis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your mercy may receive the offering presented and through the intercession of your saints, whose relics rest in this church, cleanse us from all sins.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quae pro sanctorum tuorum quorum patrocinia in praesenti requiescunt ecclesia veneratione tuae obtulimus maiestati quaesumus Domine ut per ea veniam mereamur peccatorum et caelestis gratiae donis reficiamur.
translation_en: We offer to Your divinity the sacred mysteries on behalf of the saints whose patronage we now rely upon. We humbly ask You, Lord, that through these mysteries we may merit forgiveness for our sins and be refreshed by heavenly grace's gifts.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine nobis famulis tuis per sancti N. martyris tui merita gloriosa ut eius pia intercessione ab omnibus protegamur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate us, your servants, through the glorious merits of your saintly martyr N., that we may be protected by his pious intercession from all adversities.

text: Suscipiat clementia tua quaesumus Domine de manibus nostris munus oblatum et per sancti N. martyris tui orationes ab omnibus nos emundet peccatis.
translation_en: May your mercy, we beseech you, Lord, take from our hands the offering presented and through the prayers of your saint N., may he cleanse us from all sins.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quae pro sancti N. veneratione tuae obtulimus maiestati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per ea veniam peccatorum mereamur percipere et ad caelestis gratiae dona pervenire.
translation_en: We, who offer the divine mysteries to your veneration of Saint N., humbly ask you, Lord our God. May we through these mysteries merit forgiveness for our sins and be worthy to receive the gifts of heavenly grace.

text: Da aeternae consolationis Pater per sancti martyris tui N. preces populo tuo pacem et salutem ut tuis tota dilectione inhaereat mandatis et quae tibi placita sint tota perficiat voluntate. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Grant eternal consolation, Father, through the prayers of your saint N., to your people, that they may have peace and salvation. May they adhere with all devotion to your commands and fulfill with wholehearted will what pleases you. Through our Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui semper es mirabilis in tuorum commemoratione sanctorum: pietatem tuam humiliter imploramus ut preces nostras et hostias quas in honore et veneratione sanctae Dei Genitricis et Virginis Mariae sanctorumque apostolorum martyrum confessorum virginum et omnium electorum tuorum tuae pietati devote offerimus placide ac benigne suscipias concedasque nobis obtentu illorum ut et peccatorum remissionem et supernorum civium mereamur adipisci consortium.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who are always wonderful in the commemoration of your saints: we humbly beseech your pity that we may devoutly offer our prayers and sacrifices, which we present in honor and veneration of the holy Mother of God, the Virgin Mary, the apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all the elect of yours, graciously and kindly receive. May you grant us through their intercession to merit the remission of our sins and to deserve the companionship of your heavenly citizens.

text: Hostias tibi Domine laudis offerimus suppliciter deprecantes ut easdem sanctorum tuorum interveniente suffragio placatus accipias.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, hosts of praise humbly beseeching that through the intercession of your saints, you may be appeased and accept them.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis omnibus sanctis tuis intervenientibus deprecamur ut quae pro illorum celebrata sunt gloria nobis proficiant ad medelam.
