translation_en: We perceive, Lord, all Your sacred mysteries with the saints intervening on our behalf. We humbly ask that what was accomplished for their glory may also benefit us for healing.

text: Sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae semperque Virginis gloriosae et beatorum caelestium virtutum angelorum archangelorum patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum confessorum virginum atque omnium sanctorum quaesumus omnipotens Deus meritis ac precibus placatus tribue nobis misericordiam tuam et da populo tuo inviolabilem fidei firmitatem et pacem; repelle a nobis hostem famem et pestem et omnem immunditiam; da nobis in tua virtute constantiam et fortitudinem et valetudinem; retribue omnibus bona facientibus nobis vitae aeternae beatitudinem; da inimicis nostris et persequentibus nos recognitionem et indulgentiam; concede defunctis nostris et omnibus in Christo quiescentibus remissionem peccatorum et requiem aeternam. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, through the merits and prayers of your Blessed Mother Mary, ever Virgin, and all the glorious saints, archangels, patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all the saints, that you grant us your mercy, an inviolable firmness of faith, and peace; drive away from us the enemy, famine, pestilence, and every uncleaness; give us constancy, strength, and health in your power; repay to all those who do good to us the beatitude of eternal life; grant recognition and forgiveness to our enemies pursuing us; grant the deceased among us and all resting in Christ remission of sins and eternal rest. Through our Lord.

text: In conspectu maiestatis tuae quaesumus omnipotens Deus intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis oblationes nostrae et preces acceptabiles ascendant et tua propitiatione veniam nobis et pacem tribue; hostem famem et pestem et omnem immunditiam a nobis repelle; fidem caritatem et spem et humilitatem nobis largire; defensione tua nos semper circumtege; hostium nostrorum superbiam et virtutem contere; omnibus nobis bona facientibus gratiae tuae abundantiam retribue; discordantes ad pacem bonam converte; defunctis nostris requiem concede et omnibus fidelibus tuis vitam sempiternam largire.
translation_en: In the presence of your majesty, we humbly ask, Almighty God, that through the intercession of all your saints, our offerings and acceptable prayers ascend to you; may your forgiveness be granted to us and peace bestowed. Repel from us enemies, famine, pestilence, and every uncleanness. Bestow upon us faith, charity, hope, and humility. Ever surround us with your protection. Crush the pride and power of our enemies. For all good works done by us, return the abundance of your grace. Convert those who are discordant to good peace. Grant rest to our deceased ones, and eternal life to all your faithful followers.

text: Per huius sacramenti mysterium quaesumus Domine Deus noster omnipotens intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis vitiorum nostrorum maculae deleantur et preces nostrae in conspectu maiestatis tuae acceptabiles inveniantur; populus tuus a peccatis et hostibus liberetur et fidei rectitudine roboretur; hostium nostrorum superbia et fortitudo proteratur; pestilentiae et fames et omnis immunditia procul pellatur; bona nobis facientes gratiae tuae abundantia repleantur; discordantes in fraternam pacem revocentur et omnes fideles tui vitam perpetuam adipisci mereantur. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Through the mystery of this sacrament, we humbly ask you, Lord God Almighty, that through the intercession of all your saints our stains of sin may be removed and our prayers found acceptable in your sight; may your people be freed from sins and enemies, and strengthened with the uprightness of faith; may the pride and power of our enemies be brought low; may pestilence, famine, and every uncleanness be driven far away; may the abundance of your grace fill us with good things; may those who are at odds be recalled to brotherly peace and may all your faithful merit eternal life. Through our Lord.

text: Deus qui nos beatae Mariae semper Virginis et beati Michaëlis archangeli et omnium angelorum seu patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum confessorum virginum et omnium sanctorum quorum sanctae reliquiae hic continentur 〈***〉 quaesumus omnipotens Deus per virtutem sanctae Crucis ut eorum intercedentibus nos et seniores nostros amicos et inimicos sanos et infirmos nobis commissos et omnes peccatores et domnum apostolicum et omnem gradum ecclesiasticum regem nostrum episcopos et abbates et me indignum famulum tuum principes et potentes pauperes et divites senes et iuvenes et omnes sperantes in te semper ubique ut pupillam oculi custodias et ab omni laesione diaboli eripias; gratiam et custodiam et misericordiam tuam tribuas et nos omnes pariter cum tuo divino auxilio fideliter perducas in vitam aeternam.
translation_en: God, who are enshrined here in the relics of the blessed Virgin Mary, the ever-virgin, Saint Michael the archangel, all angels and patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all saints, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, through the power of the holy Cross, that they intercede for us and our elders, friends and enemies, healthy and sick, those entrusted to us, all sinners, the holy apostolic see, every grade of the ecclesiastical hierarchy, our king, bishops, abbots, me, your unworthy servant, princes and potentates, the poor and the rich, the old and the young, and all who hope in you, everywhere. That you watch over us as a protective shield, rescue us from every diabolical harm; grant us your grace, protection, mercy, and lead us all faithfully with your divine help to eternal life.

text: Haec oblatio mei indignissimi peccatoris quaesumus omnipotens Deus per mysterium potentiae et magnae misericordiae tuae per virtutem sanctae Crucis intercedentibus omnibus caelestibus virtutibus et omnibus sanctis fiat corpus et sanguis Domini nostri Iesu Christi; fiat nostra et omnium doctorum nostrorum omniumque fidelium viventium et in Christo requiescentium remissio omnium peccatorum; veram innocentiam pro tua clementia et a malis omnibus beata redemptio et laeta perventio in vitam aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, through the mystery of your power and great mercy, by the intervention of all heavenly virtues and all saints, that the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ be made for us, as well as for all our teachers, for all faithful living and resting in Christ, the remission of all sins; may true innocence, through your clemency, be a blessed redemption and joyful arrival into eternal life.

text: Libera nos omnes quaesumus omnipotens Deus ab omni infirmitate et iniquitate diaboli et ab omni persecutione paganorum et de malorum Christianorum et de manu inimicorum nostrorum et ab auditione mala et amara in die magni iudicii venturi tremendi et fac nos omnes misericorditer adiuvari et sanari et salvari per virtutem sanctae Crucis pro nobis intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis ad vitam perpetuam pervenire.
translation_en: Deliver us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, from every infirmity and wickedness of the devil, and from every persecution of pagans and evil Christians, and from the hand of our enemies, and from hearing evil and bitter things on the day of the great judgment to come that is dreadful. And help us all mercifully and heal us and save us through the power of the holy Cross for us, through all your saints interceding, to arrive at eternal life.

text: Veniat dilectus meus in hortum suum ut comedat.
translation_en: My beloved may come into his own garden to eat.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui vivorum dominaris simul et mortuorum omniumque misereris quos tuos fide et opere futuros esse praenoscis: te suppliciter exoramus ut pro quibus effundere preces decrevimus quosque vel praesens saeculum adhuc in carne retinet vel futurum iam exutos corpore suscepit pietatis tuae clementia delictorum suorum omnium veniam et gaudia consequi mereantur aeterna.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who rules over the living as well as the dead and shows mercy to those whom you foresee will be yours in faith and deeds: we humbly entreat you that for those for whom we have decreed to pour out our prayers, whether they are still retained in this world by flesh or have already been received into body by death, may obtain the forgiveness of their sins and the joys of eternal life through your mercy.

text: Deus cui soli cognitus est numerus electorum (in superna) felicitate locandus tribue quaesumus ut per haec sancta quae agimus universorum quos in oratione commendatos suscepimus et omnium fidelium nomina beatae praedestinationis liber ascripta retineat.
translation_en: We ask you, God, whose number of the elect (in heaven) is known, to grant that through these holy actions we perform, may he retain those whom we commend in our prayer and the names of all faithful people whose names are written in the blessed predestination.

text: Purificent nos quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus sacramenta quae sumpsimus et praesta ut hoc tui mysterii sacramentum non sit nobis reatus ad poenam; sit intercessio salutaris ad veniam sit abolitio scelerum sit fortitudo fragilium sit contra mundi pericula firmamentum sit vivorum atque mortuorum fidelium remissio omnium peccatorum.
translation_en: Purify us, we humbly ask You, almighty and merciful God, the sacraments which we have received, and grant that this sacred mystery's sacrament may not be a burden to us for punishment; may it be a saving intercession for forgiveness, may it abolish our sins, may it be strength for the fragile, may it be a firm shield against worldly dangers, may it be the remission of all sins for the living and the dead faithful.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam beati Francisci meritis fetu novae prolis amplificas tribue nobis quaesumus ex eius imitatione terrena despicere et caelestium bonorum semper participatione gaudere.
translation_en: God, who enlarges Your Church through the merits of blessed Francis' new birth, grant us that we may despise earthly things through his imitation and always rejoice in the participation of heavenly goods.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine gratia caelesti amplificet quam beati Francisci illuminare voluisti gloriosis meritis et exemplis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your church may be enriched by celestial grace as you desired to illuminate it with the glorious merits and examples of blessed Francis.

text: Pietate tua quaesumus Domine nostrorum solve vincula omnium peccatorum et intercedente beata Maria semper Virgine cum omnibus sanctis domnum apostolicum episcopos et abbates et omnem gradum ecclesiasticum reges et principes famulos et famulas tuas atque loca nostra una cum omni congretatione et familia beati Ioannis Baptistae in omni sanctitate custodi omnesque affinitate fraternitate familiaritate et confessione nobis iunctos et omnes Christianos a vitiis purga virtutibus illustra pacem et salutem nobis tribue hostes visibiles et invisibiles remove aëris temperiem indulge fruges terrae concede carnalia desideria repelle infirmis nostris sanitatem restitue iter agentibus prosperitatem concede inimicis nostris ac discordantibus et nobis veram caritatem largire incredulos converte errantes corrige simoniacam haeresim et omnes haereses et schismata in Ecclesia catholica destrue et omnibus fidelibus vivis atque defunctis in terra viventium vitam aeternam pariter et requiem concede.
translation_en: By Your mercy, we humbly ask You, Lord, to release the chains of all sins through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, ever virgin, with all the apostolic bishops and abbots, and every ecclesiastical rank, kings and princes, Your servants and handmaids, and our places together with all congregation and family of the blessed John the Baptist. In all holiness, protect us and join those bound to us by affection, fraternity, familiarity, and confession. Purify us from vices, illuminate us with virtues, grant us peace and salvation. Remove visible and invisible enemies from us; indulge us with the temperate weather, bless us with the fruits of the earth, grant us our carnal desires, repel sickness from us, restore health to the infirm, prosper those on their journey, grant prosperity to our enemies and discordants, and give us true charity. Convert unbelievers, correct wandering ones, eradicate simony and all heresies and schisms in the Catholic Church, and grant eternal life and rest to all faithful, both living and dead on earth.

text: Deus qui singulari corporis tui hostia totius mundi delicta solvisti: hac oblatione placatus maculas scelerum nostrorum absterge domnum apostolicum episcopos et abbates et omnem ordinem ecclesiasticum ab omni adversitate custodi cunctisque fidelibus vivis et defunctis in terra viventium vitam aeternam pariter et requiem concede.
translation_en: God who by your unique sacrifice of your body freed the whole world from sin: with this offering, appeased, wipe away the stains of our sins, preserve the lord apostolic bishops and abbots, and all ecclesiastical order from every adversity. Grant eternal life and peace to all faithful, living and dead, on earth.

text: Sumpta quaesumus Domine caelestis sacramenti mysteria crimina nostra detergant domnum apostolicum episcopos et abbates et omnem populum Christianum custodiant aëris temperiem et fruges terrae nobis obtineant omnemque pravitatem et infirmitatem et hosticam rabiem atque subitaneam mortem meritis omnium sanctorum a nobis procul repellant et omnibus fidelibus vivis atque defunctis prosint ad veniam pro quorum tibi sunt oblata salute.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the sacred mysteries of heavenly sacrament may wash away our sins. Protect the lords apostolic, bishops, abbots, and the entire Christian people from the unsteady nature of the air and grant us abundant crops from the earth. May all wickedness, infirmity, hostile rage, and sudden death be kept far from us through the merits of all saints. May they benefit all the living and deceased faithful for their oblations offered to you for their salvation.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus supplicationes et preces quas ego tibi peccator praesumo offerre in honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et in commemorationem beatae Mariae semper Virginis matris Domini nostri Iesu Christi et omnium supernorum civium patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum confessorum ac virginum tuarum pro pace et sanitate populorum tuorum et pro aëris temperie et fructibus terrae et stabilitate Ecclesiae et ordine sanctorum et sanitate regis et episcoporum atque abbatum ac pro cuncta congregatione sancti Ioannis Baptistae ac familia eius et pro me misero famulo tuo et pro omnibus viventibus famulis ac famulabus tuis {vivis} atque defunctis fidelibus tuis et qui propter nomen tuum Domine bona fecerunt et mihi in nomine tuo peccata confessi fuerunt et concede propitius ut intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis ante conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae misericordiam consequamur.
translation_en: Receive most mercifully, Almighty Father, eternal God, the supplications and prayers which I, a sinner, presume to offer in honor of our Lord Jesus Christ and in commemoration of the blessed Mary ever Virgin, mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, and all the heavenly citizens - patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, for the peace and health of your people, for the temperate condition of the earth and its fruits, stability of the Church, order of the saints, sanity of kings and bishops and abbots, and for all the congregation of Saint John the Baptist and his family, and for me, the wretched servant of yours, and for all the living and deceased faithful ones of yours who did good things in your name and confessed their sins to me in your name, and grant us mercifully that we may obtain mercy through the intercession of all your saints before the divine majesty of your mercy.

text: Offerentes tibi Domine hostiam iubilationis pro delictis nostris pietatem tuam exposcimus ut placabili pietate orationibus nostris aurem accommodes votum nostrum pia devotione acceptes tribulationes cordis nostri multiplici miseratione laetifices pacem tribuas aëris temperiem et sanitatem corporum animarumque nobis concedas; quia in oratione lingua nostra exorare non sufficit tu qui cordis cogitationes agnoscis et renum scrutator es praesta propitius ut quae desiderat mens devota perpetua misericordia consequatur.
translation_en: Offering to you, Lord, a sacrifice of jubilation for our sins, we humbly invoke your pity. May your gracious ear be inclined to our prayers, accepting our vows with pious devotion. May you alleviate the tribulations of our heart with abundant mercy, grant peace, temper the air, and bestow health upon our bodies and souls. For in prayer, our language is not enough, you who know the thoughts of the heart and search the kidneys; be propitious, so that what our devoted mind desires may attain perpetual mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: respice propitius ad preces Ecclesiae tuae; da nobis fidem rectam spem certam caritatem perfectam humilitatem veram corporum pacem et cordium aëris temperiem terrae fertilitatem; concede Domine ut sit in nobis simplex affectus patientia fortis oboedientia perseverans pax perpetua mens pura rectum et mundum cor compunctio spiritalis virtus animae vita immaculata consumptio irreprehensibilis ut viriliter currentes in tuum feliciter mereamur regnum introire.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God: look propitiously upon the prayers of your Church; give us a right faith, firm hope, perfect charity, true humility, bodily peace and temperate calmness of spirit, fertility of the earth; Lord, grant that there may be in us simple affection, patient endurance, steadfast obedience, permanent peace, pure mind, upright and clean heart, spiritual strength, immaculate soul's consumption, irreproachable, so that, running manfully, we may worthily merit to enter your kingdom.

text: Sanctorum tuorum intercessionibus quaesumus Domine et nos protege et famulis ac famulabus tuis quorum commemorationem agimus vel quorum eleemosynas suscepimus seu etiam qui nobis familiaritate coniuncti sunt misericordiam tuam ubique praetende ut ab omnibus impugnationibus defensi tua opitulatione salventur et animas famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium videlicet catholicorum orthodoxorum quorum commemorationem agimus et quorum corpora in hoc monasterio requiescunt vel quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum scripta adesse videntur electorum tuorum iungere digneris consortio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercession of your saints that you protect us and those who serve and work for you, whose commemoration we make or whose alms we receive, or even those who are connected to us in familiarity. May your mercy be always present everywhere so that we, defended by your help, may be saved from all attacks and that the souls of all your servants, male and female, whether Catholic and Orthodox, whose commemoration we make and whose bodies rest in this monastery or whose names are written before your holy altar as elect ones, may be united with their company.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes quas pro incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum commemorationem agimus vel quorum eleemosynas recepimus seu etiam his qui nobis familiaritate iuncti sunt et pro animabus omnium fidelium catholicorum quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum scripta adesse videntur nomini tuo consecrandas deferimus benignus assume ut sacrificii praesentis oblatio ad refrigerium animarum eorum te miserante proveniat.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and these offerings which we make for the well-being of your servants and their attendants whom we remember or whose alms we have received, or even those who are joined to us in familiarity, and also for the souls of all Catholic faithful whose names appear written before your holy altar. Mercifully accept them and may the offering of this present sacrifice come to refresh their souls as you have mercy upon them.

text: Purificent nos quaesumus Domine haec divini perceptio sacramenti et gloriosa sanctorum tuorum oratio et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum commemorationem agimus remissionem cunctorum tribue peccatorum.
translation_en: Purify us, we ask you, Lord, with this divine perception of the sacrament and with the glorious prayers of your saints, and to the souls of your servants and handmaids whose commemoration we make, grant the remission of all sins.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam gloriosis sanctorum apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli triumphis multipliciter exornas: eorum quaesumus nos semper et meritis munire et exemplis ad bene agendum digneris informare.
translation_en: God, who adorns your church with numerous triumphs of the glorious apostles Peter and Paul: grant us to be always protected by their merits, and deign to instruct us by their examples for doing good.

text: Deus qui beatos apostolos tuos Petrum et Paulum populorum tuorum pastores constituisti: {eorum} quaesumus intervenientibus sacramentorum tuorum epulis reficere nos digneris.
translation_en: God, who established your blessed apostles Peter and Paul as shepherds of your people: we ask that by their intervention, you deign to refresh us through the sacred banquet of your sacraments.

text: Sumptis gratiae tuae muneribus praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut te semper in beatorum apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli commemorationibus laudemus et tuam misericordiam ipsis intervenientibus percipiamus.
translation_en: With your gifts of grace, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that we may always praise you in the commemoration of your blessed apostles Peter and Paul, and experience your mercy through their intercession.

text: Laetifica animam
translation_en: Cheer up, the soul

text: Domine in virtute
translation_en: Lord, in power

text: Beatus vir qui timet Dominum
translation_en: Blessed is the man who fears the Lord

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut famulus tuus rex noster N. qui tua miseratione suscepit regni gubernacula virtutum etiam omnium percipiat incrementa quibus decenter ornatus et vitia monstra devitare et hostes superare et ad te qui via veritas et vita es gratiosus valeat pervenire.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God that Your servant, our king N., who has taken up the governance of the kingdom through Your mercy, may also receive the enhancements with which he should be fittingly adorned and may turn away from vices, overcome enemies, and approach You, who are the way, truth, and life, graciously. May he be able to reach You.

text: Munera Domine quaesumus oblata sanctifica ut et nobis Unigeniti Filii tui corpus et sanguis fiant et illi regi ad obtinendam animae corporisque sanitatem et peragendum iniunctum officium te largiente usquequaque proficiant.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify the offerings presented, so that both for us, Your Unigenitus Son, His body and blood may become, and for Him, may rule in attaining the health of soul and body, and in fulfilling the duty assigned to him, may progress with your generous aid everywhere.

text: Haec Domine salutaris sacramenti perceptio peccatorum nostrorum maculas diluat et regem nostrum N. ad regendum secundum tuam voluntatem populum idoneum reddat ut hoc salutari mysterio contra visibiles et invisibiles hostes reddatur invictus per quod mundus est divina dispensatione redemptus.
translation_en: O Lord, this saving sacrament received may wash away our sins' stains and grant our king N. to be rendered fit for ruling according to Thy will, so that through this saving mystery he may remain invincible against visible and invisible foes; by whom the world was redeemed by divine dispensation.

text: Obsecro primo omnium fieri obsecrationes et orationes postulantes gratiarum actiones pro omnibus hominibus pro regibus et omnibus qui in sublimitate sunt ut quietam et tranquillam vitam agamus in omni pietate et castitate. Hoc enim bonum et acceptum est coram Salvatore nostro Deo qui omnes homines vult salvos fieri et ad agnitionem veritatis venire.
translation_en: I first ask for all oblations and prayers to be made, seeking the thanksgiving actions for all human beings, for kings and all who are in sublimity, that we may live peacefully and tranquilly in every piety and chastity. For this is good and acceptable before our Savior God, who desires all humans to be saved and to come to the recognition of truth.

text: Abeuntes autem pharisaei consilium faciebant adversus Iesum quomodo eum perderent. Iesus autem sciens secessit inde et secuti sunt multi eum et curavit eos omnes. Et praecepit eis ne manifestum eum facerent ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per Isaiam prophetam dicentem: Ecce puer meus quem elegi dilectus meus in quo complacuit animae meae. Ponam spiritum meum super eum et iudicium gentibus nuntiabit. Non contendet neque clamabit neque audiet aliquis in plateis vocem eius. Harundinem quassatam non confringet et linum fumigans non exstinguet donec eiciat ad victoriam iudicium et in nomine eius gentes sperabunt.
translation_en: The Pharisees, however, were devising a plan against Jesus to find a way to destroy Him. Jesus, knowing this, withdrew from there and many followed Him, and He healed all of them. And He commanded them not to make Him known publicly so that what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled: "Behold, My servant whom I have chosen; My beloved in whom My soul is well pleased. I will put My Spirit upon Him, and He shall declare judgment to the nations. He will not shout nor cry out, nor will His voice be heard in the streets. A broken reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not quench until He brings justice to victory. And in His name the nations will hope."

text: Deus qui conteris bella et impugnatores in te sperantium potentia tuae defensionis expugnas: auxiliare quaesumus famulo tuo regi nostro N. populoque sibi subiecto pro quibus misericordiam tuam suppliciter imploramus ut te parcente remissionem peccatorum percipiant et cuncta sibi adversantia te adiuvante superare valeant.
translation_en: God, who crushes wars and those fighting against you hoping for your power's protection, conquers: we humbly ask that you help your servant, our king N., and the people subject to him. For them, we implore your mercy earnestly that they may receive remission of sins with you gracious, and be able to overcome all adversities with your assistance.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod immolamus propitiatus intende ut ab omni nos exuat bellorum nequitia et in tuae protectionis securitate constituat et famulum tuum regem nostrum N. populumque sibi subiectum et a peccatis absolvas et ab hostium invisibilium insidiis tutum atque securum efficias.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, which we offer, may You attend favorably, so that from all war's wickedness You expel us and in the safety of Your protection establish our King N., his subjects as well, and absolve us from sins and make us secure from the hidden plots of our enemies.

text: Sacrosancti corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi refectione vegetati supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut hoc remedio singulari famulum tuum regem nostrum N. populumque sibi subiectum ab omni purifices contagione peccatorum et a cunctorum munias incursione periculorum.
translation_en: We humbly pray to the almighty God, on behalf of the sacred body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, that He may purify your servant, our king N., and the people subject to him, from all contagion of sins, and protect them from every attack of dangers.

text: Deus regnorum omnium et Christiani maxime protector imperii: da servo tuo regi nostro triumphum virtutis tuae scienter excolere ut qui tua constitutione est princeps tuo semper munere sit potens.
translation_en: God of all kingdoms and chief protector of the Christian empire: grant your servant, our king, to celebrate a triumph of your virtue knowingly, so that he who is a ruler according to your constitution may always be powerful through your continuous blessing.

text: Suscipe Domine preces et hostias Ecclesiae tuae pro salute famuli tui regis nostri N. supplicantis et in protectione fidelium populorum antiqua bracchii tui miracula operare ut superatis pacis inimicis secura tibi serviat Christiana libertas.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers and offerings of Your Church for the salvation of Your servant King N. who is supplicating, and in the protection of the faithful people, may Your ancient miracles operate through the power of Your arm that the Christian liberty may serve You securely after overcoming its enemies.

text: Deus qui praedicando aeterni regni evangelium Christianorum imperium dilatasti: praetende famulo tuo regi nostro N. arma caelestia ut pax ecclesiarum nulla turbetur tempestate bellorum.
translation_en: God who by the preaching of the eternal kingdom's gospel have expanded the empire of Christians: extend help to your servant, our king N., celestial weapons, so that the peace of churches may not be disturbed by any storm of wars.

text: Iustus es Domine
translation_en: You are just, Lord

text: Scapulis suis obumbrabit tibi
translation_en: Your shoulders will shield you.

text: Illumina faciem tuam
translation_en: Shine upon your face

text: Deus omnium fidelium pastor et rector: famulum tuum apostolicum nostrum N. quem Ecclesiae tuae praeesse voluisti propitius respice; da ei quaesumus verbo et exemplo quibus praeest proficere ut ad vitam una cum grege sibi 〈credito〉 perveniat sempiternam.
translation_en: God, shepherd and ruler of all faithful: propitiously look upon your apostolic servant N., whom you wished to preside over your Church. Grant him, we pray, the word and example by which he leads, so that he may prosper in such a way that with his flock he may attain eternal life.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine divini sacramenti perceptio protegat et famulum tuum N. quem pastorem Ecclesiae tuae esse voluisti una cum grege sibi commisso salvet semper et muniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the reception of this divine sacrament protect us, and Your servant N., whom You wished to be a pastor for Your Church, along with the flock committed to him, may always save and fortify.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui facis mirabilia magna solus: praetende super famulum tuum antistitem nostrum N. et super cunctos illi commissos spiritum gratiae salutaris et ut in veritate tibi complaceant perpetuum eis rorem tuae benedictionis infunde.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who performs great wonders alone: stretch over your servant our bishop N., and over all those committed to his care the spirit of saving grace. And may they continually please you in truth; pour upon them the perpetual dew of your blessing.

text: Hostias Domine famulorum tuorum placatus assume et quas in honore nominis tui devota mente pro eis celebramus proficere sibi sentiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, please accept these offerings from your servants, and may those that we celebrate with a devoted mind in honor of your name be beneficial for them as they perceive it to bring healing.

text: Fac quaesumus Domine famulos tuos toto semper ad te corde concurrere et tibi subdita mente servire; tuam misericordiam suppliciter exorare et tuis iugiter beneficiis gratulari.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Lord, and may your servants always strive with their whole heart towards you, submit their mind to you, humbly ask for your mercy, and constantly rejoice in your blessings.

text: Audi Iacob serve meus et Israël quem elegi. Faciens et formans te ab utero auxiliator tuus quia ego sum qui deleo iniquitates tuas propter me et peccatorum tuorum non recordabor. Reduc me in memoriam et iudicemur simul. Dic si quid habes ut iustificeris. Noli timere serve meus Iacob et rectissime quem elegi. Effundam enim aquam super sitientem et fluenta super aridam. Effundam spiritum meum super semen tuum et benedictionem super generationem tuam.
translation_en: Hear my servant Jacob and Israel, whom I have chosen. Creating and forming you from the womb, your helper is indeed I, who will remove your iniquities for my sake, and I will not remember your sins. Remember me and let us be judged together. Speak if you have anything to justify yourself. Fear not, my servant Jacob, whom I have chosen most righteously. For I will pour out water upon the thirsty, and rivers in the desert. I will pour out my spirit upon your offspring and a blessing upon your descendants.

text: Venit ad Iesum leprosus deprecans eum et genu flexo dixit: Domine si vis potes me mundare. Iesus autem misertus est; extendit manum suam et tangens eum ait illi: Volo mundare. Et cum haec dixisset statim discessit ab eo lepra et mundatus est.
translation_en: A leper approached Jesus, imploring him and kneeling down he said: "Lord, if you will, you can make me clean." Jesus moved with compassion; He extended His hand and touching him He said to him: "I want to make you clean." And as soon as He had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine famulo tuo abbati nostro N. ut praedicando et exercendo quae recta sunt exemplo bonorum operum animos suorum instruat subditorum et aeternae remunerationis mercedem cum credito sibi grege a te piissimo pastore percipiat.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, to your servant our abbot N., that he may instruct the minds of his subjects by preaching and performing what is right, as an example of good works. May he receive the reward of eternal remuneration from you, the most compassionate shepherd, with credit being given to him by the flock.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine suscipe placatus et famulum tuum abbatem nostrum N. cum commisso sibi grege semper ubique misericorditer protege.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive our offerings pleasingly and to always protect your servant, our Abbot N., with him and his flock, everywhere mercifully.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et famulum tuum abbatem nostrum N. cum commisso sibi grege benigna pietate conserve.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, purges us from sin and may Your abbot N. with benevolent piety preserve his flock committed to him.

text: Da famulo tuo abbati nostro quaesumus Domine spiritum veritatis et pacis ut te tota virtute cognoscat et quae tibi placita sunt toto corde sectetur.
translation_en: Grant your servant, our abbot, we ask you, Lord, the Spirit of truth and peace, that he may know you in full virtue and follow with his entire heart what pleases you.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine famulo tuo abbati nostro per haec sacramenta suorum veniam delictorum et quod meritis nos praesumit indulgentiae tuae largitate percipiat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, to Your servant, our abbot, through these sacraments forgiveness of sins and that he may receive the grace of Your indulgence by Your generous mercy.

text: Protector in te sperantium Deus: salva famulum tuum abbatem nostrum N. ut per haec sacramenta quae tuae maiestati obtulimus a peccatis liber et ab hostium insidiis securus in tua semper gratia perseveret.
translation_en: In you, the Protector of those hoping in you, God: save your servant, our Abbot N., that he may, through these sacraments which we have offered to your majesty, be free from sins and secure from enemies' plots, and may always persevere in your grace.

text: Domine refugium factus es nobis
translation_en: Lord, you have become our refuge

text: Priusquam montes
translation_en: Before the mountains

text: Sicut in holocaustum
translation_en: As a burnt offering

text: Tu Domine servabis nos
translation_en: You, Lord, will protect us.

text: Defende quaesumus Domine beata Maria semper Virgine 〈intercedente〉 istam ab omni adversitate congregationem et tibi toto corde prostratam ab hostium propitius tuere clementer insidiis.
translation_en: Defend, we ask you, Lord, blessed Mary ever Virgin (with her intercession), protect this assembly from every adversity and keep prostrate before you with a merciful and gracious heart from the plots of the enemy.

text: Suscipe quaesumus omnipotens Deus nostrae devotionis oblationem et per virtutem huius sacramenti tuae maiestatis famulos a cunctis protege adversitatibus.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech you, Almighty God, our offering of devotion and protect your servants from all adversities through the power of this sacred mystery.

text: Copiosa protectionis tuae beneficia quaesumus Domine Deus familia tua consequatur ut quae sacris tibi liminibus devota consistit intercessione beatae Mariae semper Virginis atque omnium sanctorum tuorum et vitae praesentis subsidio gratuletur et gratiam aeternae benedictionis inveniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask for the abundant benefits of Your protection, Lord God, that Your family may follow, so that those who are devoted to the sacred thresholds of Your house through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, ever-virgin, and all Your saints, may be supported in this life, and may find grace for eternal blessing.

text: Familiam huius sacri coenobii quaesumus Domine intercedente beato Benedicto confessore tuo perpetuo guberna moderamine ut assit nobis et in securitate cautela et inter aspera fortitudo.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with the intercession of your blessed confesor, St. Benedict, to govern this family of this sacred monastery perpetually, so that it may assist us, provide safety for us, and in adversity, be a source of strength for us.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine propitius ad hostiam nostrae servitutis tuo conspectui immolandam ut professionis sanctae propositum quod te inspirante suscepimus te gubernante custodiamus.
translation_en: Look upon us, we implore you, Lord, graciously, towards our sacrifice in your sight, which is being offered according to the profession of our servitude. May we who have taken up the vow inspired by you, under your guidance, keep it safe.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras et muro custodiae tuae hoc sanctum ovile circumda ut omni adversitate depulsa sit hoc semper domicilium incolumitatis et pacis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers and enclose this holy flock with your protective wall, so that it may always be a safe haven of security and peace, free from any adversity.

text: Rogamus vos corripite inquietos consolamini pusillanimes suscipite infirmos patientes estote ad omnes. Videte ne quis malum pro malo alicui reddat sed semper quod bonum est sectamini 〈in invicem〉 et in omnes. Semper autem gaudete sine intermissione orate in omnibus gratias agite. Haec est enim voluntas Dei in Christo Iesu in omnibus vobis. Spiritum nolite exstinguere prophetiam nolite spernere. Omnia autem probate quod bonum est tenete ab omni specie mala abstinete vos. Ipse autem Deus pacis sanctificet vos per omnia ut integer spiritus vester et anima corpus sine querela in adventu Domini nostri Iesu Christi servetur.
translation_en: We ask you to comfort the troubled, console the fearful, take up the weak, be patient for all. See that no one gives evil for evil to anyone, but always seek what is good towards everyone. However, always rejoice without ceasing, pray in everything, give thanks in all things. This is indeed the will of God in Christ Jesus for all of you. Do not quench the Spirit, do not despise prophecy. But test all things, hold on to what is good, abstain from every form of evil. May God Himself, the source of peace, sanctify you through and through, that your spirit, soul, and body may be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Respondens Iesus ad discipulos suos dixit Simoni Petro: Si peccaverit in te frater tuus vade et corripe eum inter te et ipsum solum. Si te audierit lucratus es fratrem tuum. Si autem te non audierit adhuc adhibe tecum unum vel duos ut in ore duorum vel trium testium stet omne verbum. Quod si non audierit eos dic ecclesiae. Si autem et ecclesiam non audierit sit tibi sicut ethnicus et publicanus. Amen dico vobis quaecumque alligaveritis super terram erunt ligata et in caelo. Et quaecumque solveritis super terram erunt soluta et in caelo. Iterum dico vobis quia si duo ex vobis consenserint super terram de omni re quamcumque petierint fiet illis a Patre meo qui in caelis est. Ubi enim sunt duo vel tres congregati in nomine meo ibi sum in medio eorum. Tunc accedens ad eum Petrus dixit: Domine quotiens peccaverit in me frater meus dimittam ei usque septies? Dicit illi Iesus: Non dico tibi Petre dimittendi septies sed usque septuagies septies.
translation_en: Jesus replied to his disciples, "Simon Peter, if your brother sins against you, go and rebuke him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother. But if he does not listen, take one or two others along with you, so that every word may be confirmed by the testimony of two or three witnesses. If he still refuses to listen, tell it to the church. If he does not listen even to the church, treat him as a gentile and a tax collector. Amen I say to you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven. Again I say to you that if two of you agree on earth about anything they ask for, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven. For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I among them. Then Peter came up and said to Jesus, 'Lord, how often will my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Jesus said to him, 'I tell you, Peter, not seven times but seventy-seven times.'"

text: Fac mecum Domine
translation_en: Make me, Lord

text: Ab occultis meis
translation_en: From my hidden ones

text: Si mei non
translation_en: If not mine

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui me peccatorem sacris altaribus astare voluisti et sancti nominis tui laudare potentiam: concede quaeso per huius sacramenti mysterium meorum mihi veniam peccatorum ut tuae maiestati digne ministrare merear.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who willed that I, a sinner, should stand before Your holy altars and praise the power of Your holy name: grant me, I pray, through this sacramental mystery, forgiveness of my sins, so that I may worthily serve Your majesty.

text: Da quaeso clementissime Pater per huius oblationis mysterium meorum mihi veniam peccatorum ut non ad iudicium sed ad indulgentiam huius presbyteratus ordo mihi proficiat sempiternam.
translation_en: Grant I beseech thee, most merciful Father, through the mystery of this offering, forgive me my sins, that the order of this priesthood may not lead me to judgment but to eternal mercy.

text: Suscipiat pietas tua Domine Deus humilitatis meae preces et erue me de manibus inimicorum meorum et de carnalibus corporis mei desideriis et de cogitationibus animae meae immundis libera me et de omnibus huius saeculi vanitatibus eripe me quatenus te miserante aeternorum flammas tormentorum evadere valeam atque perpetuam beatitudinem dignus accipere merear.
translation_en: May Your mercy, Lord God, receive my humble prayers and deliver me from the hands of my enemies. Free me from carnal desires of my body, and from impure thoughts of my soul. Deliver me from all vanities of this world, so that I may be able to escape the eternal flames of torment when You have pity on me, and may be worthy of receiving eternal beatitude.

text: Dominus mihi astitit et confortavit me ut per me praedicatio impleatur ut audiant omnes gentes quia liberatus sum de ore leonis. Liberavit me Dominus ab omni opere malo et salvum faciet in regno suo caelesti. Ipsi gloria in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: The Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the preaching may be fulfilled, that all nations may hear, for I have been freed from the lion's mouth. The Lord has saved me from every wicked work and will save me in His celestial kingdom. To Him glory forever and ever.

text: Si manseritis in me et verba mea in vobis manserint quodcumque volueritis petetis et fiet vobis. In hoc clarificatus est Pater meus ut fructum 〈...〉
translation_en: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, whatever you ask for will be granted to you. In this way my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit.

text: Suppliciter te Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui es creator omnium rerum deprecor ut dum me famulum tuum coram omnipotentia maiestatis tuae graviter deliquisse confiteor manum misericordiae tuae mihi porrigas quatenus dum hanc oblationem tuae pietati offero quod nequiter admisi clementissime digneris absolvere.
translation_en: Humbly I beseech You, Lord, holy Father, Almighty God, who are the Creator of all things, that since I, Your servant, have gravely sinned in Your omnipotent presence, I confess. Grant me the hand of Your mercy so that when I offer this sacrifice to Your piety, You, most mercifully, may deign to forgive me for the wrongs I have committed.

text: Deus misericordiae Deus pietatis Deus indulgentiae: indulge quaeso et miserere mei sacrificium quoque quod pietatis tuae gratia humiliter offero benigne dignare suscipere et peccata quae labentibus vitiis contraxi pius et propitius et miseratus indulge ut loco paenitentiae ac flumine lacrimarum concesso a te veniam merear accipere.
translation_en: God of mercy, God of pity, God of forgiveness: I humbly ask and beseech you, graciously accept my sacrifice and deign to forgive the sins that I contracted because of my falling vices. Pious and propitious God, have mercy and be merciful, grant me pardon. Through penitence granted and a stream of tears conceded by you, may I deserve to receive forgiveness.

text: Deus qui vivorum es Salvator omnium qui non vis mortem peccatorum nec laetaris in perditione morientium: te suppliciter deprecor ut concedas mihi veniam peccatorum ut admissa defleam et postmodum flendo non admittam et cum mihi extrema dies finisque vitae advenerit emendatum delictis omnibus me angelus sanctitatis suscipiat.
translation_en: God who is the Savior of all living, who does not wish the death of sinners nor rejoice in the downfall of the dying: I humbly beseech you to grant me pardon for my sins, so that I may weep for my transgressions and afterward not be allowed to weep, and when the end of my days and life comes, may an angel of sanctity take me as one who has made amends for all my sins.

text: Omnipotens mitissime Deus respice propitius preces nostras et libera corda nostra de malarum cogitatione tentationum ut Sancti Spiritus dignum fieri habitaculum mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty God, have mercy upon us and look upon our prayers favorably. Deliver our hearts from the wicked thoughts of temptations, so that we may be worthy to become a dwelling place for the Holy Spirit.

text: Has tibi Domine offerimus oblationes pro salute nostra quatenus animas nostras Sancti Spiritus gratia illuminare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, we present these offerings to you for our salvation, that you may deem worthy to enlighten our souls with the grace of the Holy Spirit.

text: Per hoc quaesumus Domine sacrificium quod tuae obtulimus pietati ab omnibus corda nostra emunda tentationibus.
translation_en: Through this, we humbly ask, Lord, that the sacrifice which we have offered to your piety may cleanse our hearts from all temptations.

text: Laetetur cor quaerentium
translation_en: Let the heart rejoice seeking

text: Confitemini Domino et invocate
translation_en: Give thanks to the Lord and invoke (call upon) Him.

text: In te speravi
translation_en: In you I have hoped

text: Spiritus adiuvat infirmitatem nostram
translation_en: The Spirit helps our weakness

text: Mulier quae erat
translation_en: A woman who was

text: Hanc oblationem quaesumus Domine quam tuae maiestati pro peccatis nostris offerimus propitius respice et produc de oculis nostris lacrimarum flumina quibus debita flammarum incendia valeant exstingui.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive this offering that we present to your majesty for our sins. Be gracious and look upon us with eyes filled with tears, so that the fires of our debts may be extinguished by the floods of tears.

text: Sacrificium quod tuae Domine obtulimus maiestati nobis ad veniam nostrorum proficiat peccatorum et nobis gratiam compunctionis et tuae miserationis semper tribuat solacium.
translation_en: The sacrifice which we, Lord, have offered to Your majesty may profit us for the forgiveness of our sins, and may always grant us the comfort of your compassion and mercy.

text: Deus largitor pacis et amator caritatis: da servis tuis veram cum tua voluntate concordiam ut ab omnibus quae nos pulsant tentationibus et periculis liberemur.
translation_en: God, giver of peace and lover of charity: grant your servants true harmony according to your will, that we may be freed from all temptations and dangers that assail us.

text: His sacrificiis Domine quaesumus concede placatus ut qui propriis oramus absolvi delictis non gravemur aeternis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that through these sacrifices you grant us your favor, so that those who pray to you may be absolved of their sins and not bear the burden of eternal punishment.

text: Spiritum nobis Domine tuae caritatis infunde ut quos uno pane satiasti tua facias pietate concordes.
translation_en: Pour out upon us, Lord, Your loving Spirit, that You who fed us with one bread, may make us united in affection.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus cuius pietatis et misericordiae non est numerus qui simul cuncta creasti qui Verbum tuum pro redemptione humani generis incarnare voluisti qui occulta cordium hominum solus agnoscis: miserere animae meae Domine miserere et delicta iuventutis et ignorantiae ne memineris Deus sed erue eam de manu inimicorum et de profundo laci et de luto faecis; ne derelinquas me Domine Deus meus ne discedas a me et ne tradas me in manus quaerentium animam meam sed libera eam de omni angustia piissime Pater. Per eundem.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, whose pity and mercy have no number, who created all things, who desired to incarnate your Word for the redemption of the human race, who alone understands the secrets of human hearts: have mercy on my soul, Lord. Have mercy, and forget my youthful sins and ignorance. God, save me from the hands of my enemies, from deep trouble, and from the mud of sin. Do not abandon me, Lord God, do not leave me, and do not deliver me into the hands of those seeking my soul. But free me kindly from every distress, Father. Through the same.

text: Exaudi me quaeso omnipotens aeterne Deus qui dixisti caro mea vere est cibus et sanguis vere est potus: et sanctifica hoc sacrificium oblationem tui corporis ut eam sumentes a terrenis desideriis et carnali cupiditate lasciviaque vel immunditia tentatione quoque inimicorum spirituum liberare digneris ut Sancto tuo Spiritu repleri merear. Qui cum Patre et Spiritu Sancto.
translation_en: Hear me, I implore you, almighty eternal God, who said that my flesh is truly food and my blood truly drink: sanctify this sacrifice and offering of your body, so that those partaking may be freed from earthly desires, carnal lust, and lewdness or immorality, even the temptation of evil spirits. May you deem me worthy to be filled by your Holy Spirit. Who with the Father and the Holy Spirit.

text: Misericordiam tuam suppliciter deprecor omnipotens Deus ut me famulum tuum quem divinis sacramentis carne et sanguine Iesu Christi Filii tui Domini mei satiasti ab omnibus inimicorum incursibus liberare et a carnis immunditia seu lascivia animam meam purgare digneris. Per eundem.
translation_en: I humbly beg your mercy, almighty God, that you might free me, your servant, whom you have filled with the flesh and blood of Jesus Christ, your Son and my Lord, from all attacks of my enemies, and cleanse my soul, either from filth or lewdness, through the same.

text: Ure igne Sancti Spiritus renes nostros et cor nostrum Domine ut tibi casto corde serviamus et mundo corde placeamus.
translation_en: Kindle in us, O Holy Spirit, a heart burning with love for you, that we may serve you with a pure heart and please the world with a loving one.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: da capiti nostro abundantiam aquae et oculis nostris fontem lacrimarum ut a peccati macula abluti ultrices poenarum flammas fletus ubertate vincamus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God: grant to our head an abundance of water and to our eyes a fountain of tears, so that we may be cleansed from the stain of sin by the flood of tears and overcome the flames of penance with their abundance.

text: Per has oblationes quaesumus Domine ut non tantum oculis nostris lacrimas infundas sed et cordi nostro debitum peccatorum luctum tribuas.
translation_en: Through these offerings, we humbly ask you, Lord, not only to pour out tears upon our eyes but also to give our heart its due sorrow for sins.

text: Si praeoccupatus fuerit homo
translation_en: If a man has been overtaken (or caught)

text: Ego lux in hunc mundum
translation_en: I am light for this world

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: miserere famulo tuo et dirige eum secundum tuam clementiam in viam salutis aeternae ut te donante tibi placita cupiat et tota virtute perficiat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God: have mercy on your servant and direct him according to your clemency in the way of eternal salvation, that he may desire what pleases you and accomplish it with all his might.

text: In die illa defertur munus duo exercituum et rex fortis dominabitur eorum. In die illa erit altare Domini in medio terrae et cognoscetur Dominus et colent eum in hostiis et muneribus et vota vovebunt Domino et solvent et revertentur ad Dominum et placabitur eis et sanabit eos. In die illa erit Israël benedictio in medio terrae cui benedixit Dominus exercituum dicens: Benedictus populus meus et opus manuum mearum hereditas mea Israël.
translation_en: On that day, the gifts of two armies will be brought, and a strong king will rule over them. On that day there will be an altar of the Lord in the midst of the earth, and the Lord will be known and worshipped in offerings and gifts and vows will be made to the Lord and fulfilled, and they will return to the Lord and he will be pleased with them and heal them. On that day Israel will be a blessing in the midst of the earth, which the Lord blessed through his armies, saying: Blessed is my people and the work of my hands, Israel.

text: Sedens Dominus Iesus contra gazophylacium aspiciebat quomodo turba iactaret aes in gazophylacium et multi divites iactabant multa. Cum venisset autem una vidua pauper misit duo minuta quod est quadrans; et convocans discipulos suos ait illis: Amen dico vobis quoniam vidua haec pauper plus omnibus misit qui miserunt in gazophylacium. Omnes enim ex eo quod abundabat illis miserunt. Haec vero de penuria sua omnia quae habuit misit totum victum suum.
translation_en: Sitting at the Lord Jesus, He looked how the crowd tossed coins into the treasury and many rich people were throwing in much. But when a widow poor came, she put in two small coins, which is a quadrans; and calling his disciples to him, he said to them: Amen I say to you, this poor widow has put in more than all those who were casting into the treasury. For they all out of their abundance have been putting in, but she from her poverty has put in all that she had, even her whole living.

text: Exaudi quaesumus omnipotens Deus preces nostras quas in conspectu pietatis tuae effundere praesumimus suppliciter deprecantes ut famulum tuum N. in tua misericordia confidentem benedicas et omnia eius peccata dimittas tuaque eum protectione conserva ut possit tibi dignus fieri et ad sempiternam beatitudinem pervenire.
translation_en: Hear us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, the prayers that we dare to pour out before your pity. Bless your servant N., confident in your mercy, and forgive all his sins. May you protect him so that he may be worthy for you and reach eternal beatitude.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostias et preces placationis et laudis quas ego peccator et indignus famulus tuus tibi offerre praesumo ad honorem et gloriam nominis tui et pro incolumitate famuli tui N. ut omnium delictorum suorum veniam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: Most merciful Father, receive the offerings and prayers of propitiation and praise which I, a sinner and unworthy servant, presume to bring before You in honor and glory of Your name, and for the wellbeing of Your servant N., that he may be worthy to obtain pardon for all his sins.

text: Purificent nos Domine sacramenta quae sumpsimus et famulum tuum ab omni culpa liberum esse concede ut quia conscientiae reatu constringitur caelestis remedii plenitudine glorietur.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, with the sacraments that we have received, and grant your servant to be free from any guilt. May he, who is pressed by the burden of conscience, rejoice in the fullness of heavenly remedy.

text: Quaesumus Domine tuere famulum tuum N. et salutaribus praesidiis semper adiutum beneficiis attolle continuis et mentis et corporis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to protect your servant N., and always support him with saving guardianship, continual benefits both for mind and body.

text: Misericordiam tuam quaesumus Domine famulus tuus N. percipiat quam deposcit; et indulgentiam quam humiliter precatur consequatur et pacem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, your servant N., may he perceive your mercy as he desires, and may he obtain the forgiveness he humbly seeks and peace.

text: A cunctis Domine quaesumus reatibus et periculis famulum tuum N. propitiatus absolve quem tanti mysterii consortem esse tribuis.
translation_en: From all, Lord, we humbly ask that you forgive your servant N., graciously released from snares and dangers, who you grant to participate in such a great mystery.

text: Converte Domine quaesumus ad te semper cor famuli tui N. et quem patrociniis tantis adiuvari facis gubernare tuis non desinas praesidiis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you turn to us always, the heart of your servant N., and whoever you aid with such great patronage, may you continue to guide. Do not cease from protecting us with your guardianship.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: confitenti tibi famulo tuo N. pro tua pietate peccata relaxa ut non plus ei noceat conscientiae reatus ad poenam quam indulgentia tuae pietatis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God: the servant N. confesses to you because of your mercy, relieve his sins so that his conscience may not suffer more from guilt than your mercy would bring about forgiveness.

text: Sicut oculi servorum
translation_en: As the eyes of servants

text: Ad te levavi oculos
translation_en: To you I lift up my eyes

text: Non cessamus pro vobis
translation_en: We do not cease for you

text: Attendite ne iustitiam vestram
translation_en: Pay attention lest you forget justice

text: Miserere quaesumus Domine famulis et famulabus tuis pro quibus hoc sacrificium laudis tuae offerimus maiestati ut per haec sancta supernae benedictionis gratiam obtineant et gloriam aeternae beatitudinis acquirant.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, Lord, we humbly beseech you, on your servants and handmaids, for whom we offer this sacrifice of your praise, so that through these holy rites they may obtain the grace of your heavenly blessing and acquire the glory of eternal beatitude.

text: Orationem autem faciebant sacerdotes dum offerrent sacrificium pro populo Israël Ionatha inchoante ceteris autem respondentibus et dicentibus: Benefaciat vobis Deus et meminerit testamenti sui quod Abraham et Isaac et Iacob locutus est servorum suorum fidelium ut det vobis cor omnibus ut colatis eum et faciatis eius voluntatem 〈corde magno et animo volenti〉. Adaperiat cor vestrum in lege sua et in praeceptis suis et faciat pacem. Exaudiat orationes vestras et reconcilietur vobis nec vos deserat in tempore malo Dominus Deus noster.
translation_en: The priests made the prayer while offering the sacrifice for the people of Israel, Jonathan beginning, and the others responding and saying: "May God make you prosper and remember his covenant which Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob spoke to his faithful servants, that he may give you a whole heart to worship him and fulfill his will with great courage and willing mind. May your hearts be adapted to his law and his commandments, and may he make peace. May he hear your prayers and reconcile himself to you, lest in a time of trouble our Lord God forsake us."

text: Salus populi
translation_en: Salvation of the people

text: Attendite popule
translation_en: Listen, people

text: Sperent in te omnes
translation_en: They hope in you all

text: Petite et accipietis
translation_en: Ask and you shall receive

text: Orationem faciebant sacerdotes
translation_en: The priests were making the prayer

text: Praetende Domine famulis et famulabus fidelibus tuis dexteram caelestis auxilii ut te toto corde perquirant et quae digne postulant assequantur.
translation_en: Strive, Lord, towards your faithful servants and handmaids, that with all their heart they may seek you and obtain what is fittingly asked.

text: Munus placationis Pater summe suscipe quod tibi a tuis immolandus immolari constituit Christus tuus electus.
translation_en: Receive, O highest Father, the offering of reconciliation which Your chosen Christ has been set to offer up on behalf of His own.

text: Praetende Domine fidelibus tuis omnibus episcopis abbatibus presbyteris monachis canonicis regibus et gubernatoribus atque consanguineis nostris et his qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas seu etiam ceteris fidelibus utriusque sexus dexteram caelestis auxilii ut te toto corde perquirant et quae digne postulant consequi mereantur. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Lord, grant favor to your faithful ones, bishops, abbots, priests, monks, canons, kings, governors, kin, and those who have committed themselves to us through prayers, as well as all others of both sexes. May they find the right hand of heavenly aid seeking you with all their heart, and may they deserve to obtain what is fittingly asked. Through the Lord.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicantibus nostris et has oblationes quas tibi pro incolumitate omnium episcoporum abbatum presbyterorum monachorum canonicorum regum et gubernatorum atque consanguineorum nostrorum et eorum qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas seu etiam ceterorum fidelium utriusque sexus offerimus benignus assume ut nullius sit irritum votum nullius vacua postulatio; praesta quaesumus ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequatur. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplicants and these offerings that we present to You for the safety of all bishops, abbots, priests, monks, canons, kings, governors, relatives, and those who have commended themselves to us through prayers, and those who have given alms or even other things of faith from both sexes. Kindly accept them. May no vow be disregarded, no petition empty; grant what we fervently ask for, that it may effectively come to pass. Through the Lord.

text: Da famulis tuis quaesumus Domine omnibus episcopis abbatibus presbyteris monachis canonicis regibus et gubernatoribus atque consanguineis nostris et his qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas seu etiam ceteris fidelibus utriusque sexus in tua fide et sinceritate constantiam ut in caritate divina firmati nullis tentationibus ab eius integritate vellantur.
translation_en: Grant to your servants, we ask, Lord, to all bishops, abbots, priests, monks, canons, kings, governors, and relatives of ours, and to those who have commended themselves to our prayers, and have given alms to us, or even to other faithful of either sex, that in your faith and sincerity they may maintain constancy, so that being strengthened by divine love, they are not drawn away from their integrity by any temptations.

text: Esto mihi in Deum
translation_en: Be for me as God

text: Deus in te speravi Domine
translation_en: God in you I have hoped, Lord

text: Eripe me Domine
translation_en: Deliver me, Lord

text: Exspectans
translation_en: Expecting

text: Cum invocarem te
translation_en: When I call upon you

text: Quoniam oportet semper
translation_en: It is always necessary

text: Deus qui contritorum non despicis gemitum et maerentium non spernis affectum: adesto propitius precibus nostris quas tuae pietati pro tribulatione nostra offerimus suppliciter implorantes ut eas clementer suscipias et solo bonitatis tuae intuitu tribuas ut quicquid contra illum (nos) diabolicae atque humanae moliuntur adversitates ad nihilum redigas et consilio misericordiae tuae allidas quatenus nullis adversitatibus laesus sed ab omni tribulatione et angustia liberatus gratias tibi in Ecclesia tua referat securus.
translation_en: God, who does not despise the groan of the contrite and does not disdain the affliction of the mourning: be present graciously with our prayers which we humbly offer to your pity for our tribulation. We implore you kindly that you may graciously receive them and bestow them in the sight of your goodness alone, so that whatever adversities, whether diabolical or human, are contrived against us (us), you reduce to nothing and grant consolation by your merciful counsel, so that we, unhurt by any adversity and freed from all tribulation and anguish, may confidently offer thanks to you in your Church.

text: Miserere nostri Deus omnium et respice nos et ostende nobis lucem miserationum tuarum. Et immitte timorem tuum super gentes quae non exquisierunt te et cognoscant quia non est Deus nisi tu et enarrent magnalia tua. Alleva manum tuam super gentes alienas ut videant potentiam tuam. Sicut enim in conspectu eorum magnificatus es in nobis sic in conspectu nostro magnificaberis in illis. Ut cognoscant te sicut et nos cognovimus quoniam non est Deus praeter te Domine. Innova signa et immuta mirabilia. Glorifica manum et bracchium dextrum. Excita furorem et effunde iram. Tolle adversarium et afflige inimicum. Festina tempus et memento finis. Ut enarrent mirabilia tua Domine Deus noster.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, O God, on all; and regard us and show us the light of your mercies. And send forth your fear upon nations that have not sought you, and let them know that there is no God but you and let them declare your great deeds. Raise your hand over foreign nations, so they may see your power. As you were glorified in our sight, so in their sight shall you be glorified. Let them know you as we have known you; for there is no God besides you, O Lord. Renew the signs and change the wonders. Glorify your hand and arm on the right side. Stir up fury and pour out anger. Overthrow the adversary and afflict the enemy. Hasten time and remember the end. So that they may declare your wonders, O Lord our God.

text: Amen dico vobis ne ergo timueritis eos. Nihil enim opertum quod non reveletur et occultum quod non sciatur. Quod dico vobis in tenebris dicite in lumine. Et quod in aure auditis praedicate super tecta. Et nolite timere eos qui occidunt corpus animam autem non possunt occidere. Sed potius eum timete qui potest et animam et corpus perdere in gehennam. Nonne duo passeres asse veneunt et unus ex illis non cadet super terram sine Patre vestro? Vestri autem et capilli capitis omnes numerati sunt. Nolite ergo timere; et multis passeribus meliores estis vos. Omnis ergo qui confitebitur me coram hominibus confitebor et ego eum coram Patre meo qui est in caelis est.
translation_en: Verily I say unto you, fear not them. For there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed, and hidden that shall not be known. What you have spoken in the dark, proclaim on the housetops. And what you have heard whispered in your ear, publish upon the rooftops. Fear not those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul; rather fear Him who can destroy both soul and body in hell. Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them shall fall to the ground without your Father's consent. Your hairs are all numbered. Therefore, do not fear; you are more valuable than many sparrows. So everyone who acknowledges me before men, I also will acknowledge before my Father in heaven.

text: Deus qui tribulatos corde sanas et maestificatos actu laetificas: ad hanc propitius hostiam dignanter attende quam tibi pro nobis famulis offerimus et liberationem tuam nobis benignus tribue et nostra sana discrimina; tribulationis nostrae attende miseriam et angustiarum nostrarum submove pressuram ut exuti omnibus quae patimur malis in tuis semper laetemur praesidiis.
translation_en: God who heals those troubled in heart and makes the mourning rejoice: graciously attend this worthy offering which we, your servants, present to you on our behalf. May you grant us your liberation benevolently and bestow upon us sound discernment; attend to our tribulation and move the pressure of our afflictions, so that, shed of all evils we endure, we may always rejoice in your protective presence.

text: Muneribus tuis muniti quaesumus clementissime Deus dimitte peccata nostra et tribue nobis misericordiam tuam quam oris nostri alloquio deprecamur ut nostram humilitatem attendas vincula solvas tribulationem inspicias adversitatem repellas affectumque petitionis nostrae largiens clementer exaudias.
translation_en: Muneribus tuis muniti, precamur tibi, clementissime Deus, dimitte peccata nostra et tribue nobis misericordiam tuam quam deprecamur oris nostri, ut attendas humilitatem nostram, solvas vincula, inspicias tribulationem, repellas adversitatem, largiens affectumque petitionis nostrae, clementer exaudias.

text: Ineffabilem misericordiam tuam quaesumus Domine nobis clementer ostende ut simul nos et a peccatis exuas et a poenis quas pro his meremur dignanter eripias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to reveal your ineffable mercy towards us, that both you and we may be freed from sins, and graciously release us from the punishments we deserve for them.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus 〈ut〉 ab omnibus peccatis expiati et ab omni flagello liberati ad superni plenitudinem sacramenti cuius libavimus sancta tendamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you may grant us, from all sins purified and freed from every scourge, to strive towards the fullness of the heavenly sacrament which we have consecrated with holy longing.

text: Ecclesiae tuae Domine quaesumus preces placatus admitte ut destructis adversitatibus universis secura tibi serviat libertate.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask your church that you grant our prayers, pleased as you are, so that, destroyed being all adversities, it may serve you securely in freedom.

text: Defende famulum tuum quaesumus Domine ab omni malorum obloquio ut nec terreri nos lacerationibus patiaris iniustis nec adulationibus implicari sed potius amare quae praecipis.
translation_en: Defend your servant, we ask you, Lord, from every evil temptation, that we may not suffer terrors through unjust lacerations nor be entangled in flattery. Rather, let us love what you command.

text: Oblatio Domine tuis aspectibus immolanda quaesumus ut famulum tuum et nos ab omnibus vitiis absolvat potenter et a cunctis defendat inimicis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offering presented before your eyes may be accepted. We beseech you to powerfully free your servant and us from all sins, and protect us against all enemies.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut sancta quae sumpsimus famulum tuum et nos a cunctis improborum lacerationibus muniant ut quae tibi placita sunt tua gratia largiente iugiter exsequamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the holy things which we have received may protect your servant and us from all wicked cuts, so that with your grace continually bestowed upon us, we may always carry out what pleases you.

text: Adiutor meus
translation_en: My helper

text: Domine in auxilium meum
translation_en: Lord, in my help

text: Hostium nostrorum quaesumus Domine elide superbiam et dexterae tuae virtute prosterne ut iustitiae tuae non dominetur iniquitas sed semper subdatur falsitas veritati.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to remove the pride of our enemies and with the strength of your right hand to overthrow them so that injustice may not rule but always yield to truth.

text: Vivificet nos quaesumus Domine participatio tui sancta mysterii et pariter nobis expiationem tribuat et munimen contra adversariorum insidias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the participation in your holy mystery may revive us, and grant us both forgiveness and protection against the treacheries of our adversaries.

text: Amen dico vobis quicquid orantes petitis
translation_en: Truly I say to you, whatever you ask while praying, that will be granted to you.

text: Oravit Ieremias ad Dominum et dixit: Si iniquitates nostrae contenderint contra nos Domine libera nos. Quaesumus fac propter nomen tuum quoniam multae sunt adversiones nostrae. Tibi peccavimus exspectatio Israël Salvator noster in tempore tribulationis. Tu autem in nobis es Domine et nomen sanctum tuum invocatum est super nos. Ne derelinquas nos Domine Deus noster.
translation_en: Jeremiah prayed to the Lord and said: "If our iniquities confront us, Lord, deliver us. We beseech you for your name's sake, for there have been many adversities against us. We have sinned, expectation of Israel, our Savior, in times of tribulation. Yet, you are in us, Lord, and your holy name has been called upon us. Do not abandon us, Lord, our God."

text: Petite et dabitur vobis. Quaerite et invenietis. Pulsate et aperietur vobis. Omnis enim qui petit accipit et qui quaerit invenit et pulsanti aperietur. Quis autem ex vobis patrem petit panem numquid lapidem dabit illi? Aut piscem numquid pro pisce serpentem dabit illi? Aut si petierit ovum numquid porriget illi scorpionem? Si ergo vos cum sitis mali nostis bona data dare filiis vestris quanto magis Pater vester de caelo dabit spiritum bonum petentibus se?
translation_en: Ask, and it will be given to you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it will be opened. Or who among you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, will he give him a serpent? Or if he asks an egg, will he offer him a scorpion? So if you, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!

text: Cum oratis non eritis sicut hypocritae qui amant in synagogis et in angulis platearum stantes orare ut videantur ab hominibus. Amen dico vobis receperunt mercedem suam. Tu autem cum orabis intra in cubiculum et clauso ostio tuo ora Patrem tuum in absconso et Pater tuus qui videt in absconso reddet tibi. Orantes autem nolite multum loqui sicut ethnici. Putant enim quod in multiloquio suo exaudiantur. Nolite ergo assimilari eis. Scit enim Pater vester quod opus sit vobis antequam petatis eum.
translation_en: When you pray, you shall not be like the hypocrites; they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and on street corners so that they may be seen by men. Truly I say to you, they have received their reward. But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father who is in secret, and your Father who sees in secret will reward you. And while you are praying, do not use many words as the Gentiles do; for they think that by their much speaking they will be heard. Do not be like them. For your Father knows what things you have need of before you ask Him.

text: Populum humilem
translation_en: Humble people

text: Pacem meam do vobis
translation_en: I give you my peace

text: Nolite esse prudentes apud vosmetipsos nulli malum pro malo reddentes providentes bona non tantum coram Deo sed etiam coram omnibus hominibus. Si fieri potest quod ex vobis est cum omnibus hominibus pacem habentes.
translation_en: Be not wise among yourselves, returning evil for evil; but rather offer good for evil, both before God and before all men. If it is possible, as much as lies with you, live peaceably with all men.

text: Paraclitus Spiritus Sanctus quem mittet Pater in nomine meo ille vos docebit omnia et suggeret vobis omnia quaecumque dixero vobis. Pacem relinquo vobis pacem meam do vobis. Non quomodo mundus dat ego do vobis. Non turbetur cor vestrum neque formidet.
translation_en: The Paraclete, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things and bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you. Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid.

text: Deus auctor pacis et amator quem nosse vivere cui servire regnare est protege ab omnibus impugnationibus supplices tuos ut qui in defensione tua confidimus nullius hostilitatis arma timeamus.
translation_en: God, the author of peace and lover, whom to know is to live, to serve, and to reign; protect us from all attacks. On behalf of those who trust in your protection, we fear no weapons of any hostility.

text: Deus qui credentes in te populos nullis sinis concuti terroribus: dignare preces et hostias dicatae tibi plebis suscipere ut pax a tua pietate concessa Christianorum fines ab omni hoste faciat esse securos.
translation_en: God who allows no peoples to be shaken by terror who believe in you: grant that you receive the prayers and sacrifices offered to you by the people, so that peace, granted by your mercy, may make the borders of Christians secure against every enemy.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris et viam famuli tui in salutis tuae prosperitate dispone ut inter omnes viae et vitae huius varietates tuo semper protegatur auxilio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present with our supplications and arrange the way of your servant for prosperity in your salvation, that he may always be protected by your aid among all ways and varieties of this life.

text: Locutus est Abraham dicens: Dominus Deus caeli qui tulit me de domo patris mei et de terra nativitatis meae; qui locutus est et iuravit dicens: Semini tuo dabo terram hanc ipse mittet angelum suum coram te.
translation_en: Abraham spoke, saying: "The Lord God of heaven who took me from my father's house and from the land of my birth; who spoke and swore, saying: 'To your seed I will give this land itself. He will send his angel before you.'"

text: Euntes praedicate dicentes quia appropinquavit regnum caelorum. In quamcumque civitatem aut castellum intraveritis interrogate quis in ea dignus sit et ibi manete donec exeatis. Intrantes autem in domum salutate eam dicentes: Pax huic domui. Et si quidem fuerit domus digna veniet pax vestra super eam. Sin autem indigna pax vestra ad vos revertetur. Et quicumque non receperint vos neque audierint sermones vestros exeuntes foras de domo vel de civitate excutite pulverem de pedibus vestris. Amen dico vobis: Tolerabilius erit terrae Sodomorum et Gomorrhaeorum in die iudicii quam illi civitati.
