translation_en: Go, preach, saying that the Kingdom of Heaven is near. In whatever city or castle you enter, ask who is worthy there and stay until you leave. Upon entering a house, greet it by saying: Peace be upon this house. And if the house is worthy, your peace will come upon it. But if it is unworthy, your peace will return to you. And whoever does not receive you or listen to your words, as you go out from the house or city, shake off dust from your feet. I tell you: It will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that city.

text: Sumpta quaesumus Domine caelestis sacramenti mysteria quaesumus ad prosperitatem itineris famuli tui N. proficiant et eum ad salutaria cuncta perducant.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the mysteries of Your heavenly sacrament be bestowed upon us, so that the journey of Your servant N. may prosper and lead him to all things beneficial.

text: Misereris omnium
translation_en: You have pity on all

text: Qui seminant
translation_en: Who sow

text: Erant appropinquantes ad Iesum
translation_en: They were approaching Jesus

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: clementiam tuam humiliter imploramus pro famulis tuis qui nobis confessi sunt sua facinora ut indulgentiam eis conferas sempiternam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech your clemency for your servants who have confessed their sins to us, that you grant them eternal forgiveness.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut haec oblatio quam tibi pro famulis tuis qui nobis propria confessi sunt facinora offerimus sit in oculis tuis accepta quatenus per haec sancta commercia indulgentiam valeant percipere delictorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, almighty God, that this offering which we present to You on behalf of Your servants who have confessed to us their sins, may be acceptable in Your sight. May they through these holy transactions merit to receive forgiveness for their offenses.

text: Da quaesumus clementissime Pater indulgentiam perpetuam famulis tuis qui nobis propria confessi sunt peccata et concede eis ut in praeceptis tuis iugiter perseverent.
translation_en: Grant, most compassionately Father, eternal forgiveness to your servants who have confessed their own sins to us, and grant them that they may always persevere in your commandments.

text: Tuere nos quaesumus Domine tua sancta sumentes et ab omni propitius iniquitate defende.
translation_en: Guard us, we humbly ask you, Lord; may your holy ones take us and defend us graciously from every iniquity.

text: Parce Domine parce peccatis nostris et quamvis incessabiliter delinquentibus continua poena debeatur praesta quaesumus ut quod ad perpetuum meremur exitium transeat ad correctionis auxilium et tentationem illam diabolicam quam pro peccatis nostris super nos cognoscimus praevalere te miserante cognoscamus cessare.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy, Lord, have mercy on our sins. Even though the punishment should continually be due to those who are incessantly sinning, we humbly ask that what we deserve for eternity might pass over to aid of correction, and may that diabolical temptation which we know prevails upon us because of our sins, be known by us through Your mercy to cease.

text: Sacrificia tibi Domine cum Ecclesiae precibus immolanda quaesumus corda nostra purificent ut et indulgentiae tuae nobis dona concilient et de adversis prospera sentire perficiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to offer sacrifices to you along with the prayers of the Church, so that our hearts may be purified. May the gifts of your indulgence align with us, and may it bring us to experience prosperity amid adversities.

text: Exaudi nos quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut quod nostro monstratur officio tua benedictione potius impleatur.
translation_en: Hear us, we humbly ask you, almighty and merciful God, that what is shown to us in our duty may be more fully accomplished through your blessing.

text: Nescitis quoniam corpora vestra membra Christi sunt? Tollens ergo membra Christi et faciam membra meretricis? Absit. An nescitis quoniam qui adhaeret meretrici unum corpus efficitur? Erunt inquit duo in carne una. Qui autem adhaeret Domino unus spiritus est. Fugite fornicationem. Omne peccatum quodcumque fecerit homo extra corpus est. Qui autem fornicatur in corpus suum peccat. An nescitis quoniam membra vestra templum est Spiritus Sancti qui in vobis est quem habetis a Deo et non estis vestri? Empti enim estis pretio magno; glorificate et portate Deum in corpore vestro.
translation_en: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a harlot? God forbid. Do you not know that he who is joined to a harlot becomes one body? It is said, "Two shall become one flesh." But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit. Flee sexual immorality. Every sin that a man commits is outside the body, but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body. Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You were bought at a great price; glorify God in your body.

text: Honor virtus et imperium laus sit et decus et potestas per infinita saecula sanctae Trinitati Patri Nato atque Sancto Spiritui.
translation_en: Honour, virtue and empire, praise be to it, and glory, and majesty, and power, through infinite ages, to the Holy Trinity, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

text: Accesserunt ad Iesum pharisaei tentantes eum et dicentes: Licet homini dimittere uxorem quacumque ex causa? Qui respondens ait illis: Non legistis quia qui fecit ab initio masculum et feminam fecit eos? Et dixit: Propter hoc dimittet homo patrem et matrem et adhaerebit uxori suae et erunt duo in carne una. Itaque iam non sunt duo sed una caro. Quos ergo Deus coniunxit homo non separat. Dicunt ei illi: Quid ergo Moyses mandavit nobis dare libellum repudii et dimittere? Ait illis: Quoniam Moyses ad duritiam cordis vestri permisit vobis dimittere uxores vestras. Ab initio autem non fuit sic. Dico autem vobis quia quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam nisi ob fornicationem et aliam duxerit moechatur 〈et qui dimissam duxerit moechatur.〉 Dicunt ei illi: Si ita est causa hominis cum uxore non expedit nubere. Qui dixit: Non omnes capiunt verbum istud sed et quibus datum est.
translation_en: The Pharisees approached Jesus, testing him and saying, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?" He answered them, "Have you not read that from the beginning, God made man and woman? Therefore a man shall leave father and mother and cling to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh. So they are no longer two but one. What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate." They said to Him, "What then was Moses doing when he commanded us to give a bill of divorce and send her away?" He says to them, "Because Moses allowed you on account of your hardness of heart to divorce your wives; but from the beginning it was not so. I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and whoever marries her who has been sent away commits adultery." They said to Him, "If such is the case of a man with his wife, it is better not to marry." He said to them, "Not everyone receives this statement, but only those to whom it was given."

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Qui foedera nuptiarum blando concordiae iugo et insolubili pacis vinculo nexisti ut multiplicandis adoptionum filiis conubiorum fecunditas pudica servaretur. Tua Domine providentia tuaque gratia ineffabilibus modis utrumque dispensat ut quod generatio ad mundi edit ornatum regeneratio ad Ecclesiae statum. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: We invoke... eternal God. Who bound the covenants of marriage with gentle bond of concord and insoluble tie of peace, so that the fertility of marriage may be kept chaste in multiplying the children of adoption. By your providence, O Lord, and your grace, in ineffable ways, you dispense both, so that what generation prepared for the adornment of the world, regeneration prepares for the state of the Church. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famulorum tuorum quam tibi offerimus Domine pro famula tua quam perducere dignatus es ad statum mensurae et ad diem nuptiarum pro qua tibi supplices preces fundimus ut eam viro suo copulare digneris. Quaesumus ut placatus accipias.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer to you, Lord, this oblation of your servants, for your maidservant whom you have deemed worthy to lead into the state of measurement and the day of marriage. For her, we humbly pour out our prayers before you. We ask that you grant her to be joined with her husband.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: instituta providentiae tuae pio amore comitare ut quos legitima societate connectis longaeva pace custodias. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God: may your providence, with pious love, bring together those whom you have connected by legitimate society, and keep them in eternal peace. Through our Lord.

text: Deus qui potestate virtutis tuae ex nihilo cuncta fecisti qui dispositis universitatis exordiis homini ad imaginem Dei facto ideo inseparabile mulieris adiutorium condidisti ut femineo corpori de virili dares carne principium docens quod ex uno placuisset institui numquam liceret disiungi. Per. Deus qui tam excellenti mysterio coniugalem copulam consecrasti ut Christi sacramentum praesignares in foedere nuptiarum. Per. Deus per quem mulier iungitur viro et societas principaliter ordinata ea benedictione donatur quae sola nec per originalis peccati poenam nec per diluvii est ablata sententiam: respice propitius super hanc famulam tuam quae maritali iungenda {est} consortio tua se expetit protectione muniri. Sit in ea iugum dilectionis et pacis et fidelis et casta nubat in Christo imitatrixque sacrarum permaneat feminarum. Sit amabilis ut Rachel viro sapiens ut Rebecca longaeva et fidelis ut Sara. Nihil in ea ex actibus suis ille auctor praevaricationis usurpet; nexa fidei mandatisque permaneat. Uni toro iuncta contactus illicitos fugiat. Muniat infirmitatem suam robore disciplinae. Sit verecundia gravis pudore venerabilis doctrinis caelestibus erudita. Sit fecunda in subole sit probata et innocens et ad beatorum requiem atque ad caelestia perveniant et videant filios filiorum suorum usque in tertiam et quartam progeniem et ad optatam perveniant senectutem.
translation_en: God, who brought everything into existence by your powerful virtue, and arranged the beginning of the universe for man in the image of God, therefore you established the inseparable help of a woman as an aid to the feminine body from the masculine, teaching that it was never permitted to be instituted from one, but should never be allowed to be divided. Through you, God, who consecrated the conjugal bond with such an excellent mystery, you foreshadowed Christ's sacrament in the covenant of marriage. Through you, God, through whom a woman is united with a man and the principal society is granted by this blessing, which alone neither by the penalty of original sin nor by the flood was removed from its meaning: look upon your servant favorably who seeks to be bound in the marital union with your protection. May there be a yoke of love and peace, and may she marry faithfully and chastely in Christ, imitating the sacred women. May she be pleasing like Rachel, wise like Rebecca, and faithful like Sarah. May no author of transgression usurp anything from her actions; may she remain bound by faith and commands. May she flee illicit contact when joined to one bed. May she strengthen her weakness with the robustness of discipline. May modesty be weighty with reverence, venerable with doctrines of heaven. May she be fruitful in offspring, may she be proven and innocent, and may she reach the beatific rest and the heavens, and may she see her sons' sons up to the third and fourth generation and may she attain old age.

text: Dominus vobiscum. 〈R. Et cum spiritu tuo.〉
translation_en: The Lord be with you. And with your spirit.

text: Creator et conservator generis humani dator aeternae salutis Deus: tu mitte benedictionem tuam super hunc anulum.
translation_en: Creator and preserver of the human race, giver of eternal salvation God: you send your blessing upon this ring.

text: Anulo suae fidei et sanctae religionis subarret te Dominus Iesus Christus.
translation_en: The Lord Jesus Christ envelops you in His faith and holy religion.

text: Benedic Domine hunc anulum quem nos in tuo nomine benedicimus ut qui eum portaverit in tua pace consistat et in tua voluntate permaneat et in amore tuo vivat et senescat et multiplicetur in longitudine dierum.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this ring which we bless in Your name. May he who bears it dwell in Your peace, remain in Your will, live and age in Your love, and multiply in the length of days.

text: Benedicti sitis a Domino qui fecit mundum ex nihilo.
translation_en: Blessed are you who are seated, for you have been created by the Lord from nothing.

text: Manda Deus virtuti tuae confirma hoc Deus 〈quod operatus es in nobis.〉 〈R.〉 A templo tuo in Ierusalem tibi offerent reges munera.
translation_en: I beseech God to strengthen this through Thy power, which Thou hast wrought in us. (Response.) From Thy temple in Jerusalem kings shall bring gifts to Thee.

text: Increpa feras harundinis 〈congregatio taurorum in vaccis populorum.〉 〈R. Qui probati sunt argento.〉
translation_en: Drive away the herds of wild donkeys, congregation of bulls among the people's cattle. [Response] Who have been tested, are silver.

text: Salvos fac servos tuos. 〈R.〉 Domine Deus meus sperantes in 〈te〉.
translation_en: Save your servants. (Response) Lord, my God, I trust in you.

text: Esto eis Domine turris fortitudinis. 〈R. A facie inimici.〉
translation_en: Lord, let Your tower of strength be established. Response: Against the face of the enemy.

text: Benedicat et custodiat vos Deus Pater ostendatque Dominus faciem suam vobis et misereatur vestri convertatque Dominus vultum suum ad vos et det vobis pacem impleatque vos omni benedictione spirituali in remissionem peccatorum ut habeatis vitam aeternam.
translation_en: May God the Father bless and protect you, may the Lord show His face to you and have mercy on you. May the Lord turn His face to you and give you peace. May He fill you with all spiritual blessings for the remission of sins so that you may have eternal life.

text: Beati omnes qui timent Dominum
translation_en: Blessed are all who fear the Lord

text: Deus Abraham Deus Isaac Deus Iacob ipse vos coniungat impleatque benedictionem suam in vobis. Per Christum.
translation_en: May God, Abraham's God, Isaac's God, Jacob's God, himself unite you and fill his blessing upon you. Through Christ.

text: Benedic Domine de caelis hanc conventionem et sicut misisti angelum tuum Raphaëlem ad Tobiam et Saram filiam Raguelis ita digneris Domine mittere benedictionem tuam super hos adolescentes ut in tua caritate consistant et in amore tuo vivant et senescant et multiplicentur in longitudine dierum.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, from heaven this assembly, and as you sent your angel Raphael to Tobias and Sarah, the daughter of Raguel, so may you, Lord, send your blessing upon these young men that they may stand in your love, live and grow old in your love, and multiply in the number of days.

text: Deus Abraham Deus Isaac Deus Iacob: benedic adolescentes istos et semina semen vitae aeternae in mentibus eorum ut quicquid pro utilitate didicerint hoc facere cupiant per Iesum Christum recuperatorem hominum Filium tuum Unigenitum. Qui tecum vivit et regnat in Unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: God of Abraham, God of Isaac, God of Jacob: bless these young men and sow the seed of eternal life within their minds, that whatever they may learn for the benefit of others, they may desire to do so through Jesus Christ, the Recoverer of mankind, Your only-begotten Son. He who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

text: Benedictio Dei omnipotentis Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti descendat et maneat super vos.
translation_en: The blessing of the Almighty God, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit descends upon and remains with you.

text: Benedic Domine thalamum istum et omnes quiescentes in eo ut in tua pace consistant et in amore tuo vivant et senescant et multiplicentur in longitudine dierum.
translation_en: Bless, O Lord, this chamber and all who rest within it, that they may dwell in your peace, live in your love, grow old in you, and multiply in the length of days.

text: Benedicat vos Deus qui trinus est in numero et unus est in nomine. Qui vivit et regnat Deus per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: May God bless you, who is triple in number and one in name. He who lives and reigns, God, for all ages of ages.

text: Dum sanctificatus fuero
translation_en: While I am being sanctified

text: Oculi omnium
translation_en: Eyes of all

text: Super flumina
translation_en: Over rivers

text: Terram tuam Domine quam videmus nostris iniquitatibus tabescentem caelestibus aquis infunde atque irriga beneficiis gratiae sempiternis.
translation_en: Lord, your land that we see decaying due to our iniquities, infuse and irrigate with heavenly waters, and water with everlasting grace's blessings.

text: Locutus est Ieremias ad Dominum dicens: Numquid proiciens abiecisti Iudam aut Sion abominata est anima tua? Quare ergo percussisti nos ita ut nulla sit sanitas? Exspectavimus pacem et non est bonum et tempus curationis et ecce turbatio. 〈Cognovimus Domine impietates nostras iniquitates patrum nostrorum quia peccavimus tibi.〉 Ne nos des in opprobrium propter nomen tuum neque facias nobis contumeliam. Solii gloriae tuae recordare ne irritum facias foedus tuum nobiscum. Numquid sunt in sculptilibus gentium qui pluant aut caeli possunt dare imbres? Nonne tu es Domine Deus noster quem exspectamus? Tu enim fecisti omnia haec Domine Deus noster.
translation_en: Jeremiah spoke to the Lord, saying: "Has thou cast off Judah, or does Zion displease thy soul? Why have you struck us so that there is no healing? We waited for peace and it is not good, and the time of healing is gone, behold, turbulence. (We have known, O Lord, our lawlessness and the iniquities of our fathers because we have sinned against thee.) Let not shame fall upon us because of thy name, nor make us a byword. Remember thy glory's splendor, lest thou make void thy covenant with us. Are there idols among the nations that can rain, or can the heavens give showers? Yet, thou art the Lord our God whom we wait for. For thou, O Lord our God, hast made all these things."

text: Misereor turbae quia triduo iam perseverant mecum et non habent quod manducent. Et dimittere eos ieiunos nolo ne deficiant in via. Et dicunt ei discipuli: Unde {hoc} habes in deserto panes tantos ut saturemus turbam magnam? Et ait illis Iesus: Quot panes habetis? At illi dixerunt: Septem et pisciculos paucos. Et praecepit turbae ut discumberent super terram. Et accipiens septem panes et pisces gratias agens fregit et dedit discipulis suis et discipuli dederunt populo. Et comederunt omnes et saturati sunt. Et quod superfuit de fragmentis tulerunt septem sportas plenas. Erant autem qui manducaverant quasi quattuor milia hominum extra parvulos et mulieres. Et dimissa turba ascendit in naviculam et discipuli eius cum eo.
translation_en: I pity the crowd, for they have been with me for three days now and they do not have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry, lest they faint on their journey. And the disciples said to him: Where are we going to get bread in this desert place to feed such a large crowd? And Jesus said to them: How many loaves do you have? They answered: Seven and a few small fish. He commanded the crowd to lie down on the ground, and taking the seven loaves and the fish, he gave thanks and broke them and gave them to his disciples, who in turn gave them to the people. And all ate and were filled. And what was left of the broken pieces they took seven large baskets full. Now there were about four thousand men who had eaten, besides women and children. And after sending away the crowd, they got into a boat and went to the region of Dalmanutha.

text: Omnia quae fecisti
translation_en: All that you have made

text: Magnus Dominus
translation_en: Great Lord

text: Tollite hostias
translation_en: Lift up the offerings

text: Plebs tua Domine capiat sacrae benedictionis augmentum et aëris serenitate concessa copiosis beneficiorum tuorum sublevetur auxiliis.
translation_en: May your people, Lord, receive an increase of the sacred blessing and, lifted up by the serenity of the air granted to them, may they be exalted with abundant blessings of yours through your aid.

text: Domine Deus qui mysterio aquarum salutis tuae nobis sacramenta sanxisti: exaudi preces populi tui et iube terrores inundantium cessare pluviarum flagellumque huius elementi ad effectum tui converte mysterii ut qui se regenerantibus aquis gaudent renatos gaudeant his castigantibus esse correctos.
translation_en: Lord God, who have sanctified for us the sacraments of your salvation through the mystery of waters: hear the prayers of your people and command the terrors of the flooding to cease, turn the scourge of this element into a means of your will. May those who rejoice in being reborn through water also be corrected by it.

text: Locutus est Ieremias dicens: Consurge lauda in nocte in principio vigiliarum effunde sicut aquam cor tuum ante conspectum Domini. Leva ad eum manus tuas pro animabus parvulorum tuorum qui defecerunt in fame in capite omnium compeditorum. Vide Domine et considera quem vindemiaveris ita. Ergo ne comedant mulieres fructum suum parvulos ad mensuram? Si occidetur in sanctuario Domini sacerdos et propheta? Inundaverunt aquae super caput meum dixi: Perii. Invocavi nomen tuum Domine de lacu novissimo. Vocem meam audisti ne avertas aurem tuam a singultu meo et clamoribus. Appropinquasti in die quando invocavi te dixisti: Ne timeas. Iudicasti Domine causam animae meae redemptor vitae meae Domine Deus noster.
translation_en: Jeremiah spoke, saying: "Arise and praise at night in the beginning of vigils, pour out as water your heart before the sight of the Lord. Lift up to him your hands for the souls of your little ones who have perished from hunger on the head of all the oppressors. Look, O Lord, and consider whom you have harvested so. Therefore, should not women eat their own fruit in due measure? If a priest or prophet is slain in the sanctuary of the Lord? Waters have flowed over my head, I said: 'I am perished.' I invoked your name, O Lord, from the latest pool. You heard my voice, do not turn away your ear from my gasping and cries. You approached on the day when I invoked you, you said: 'Fear not.' The Lord has judged the cause of my soul, my Redeemer, my life, O Lord, our God.

text: Factum est autem in una dierum et Iesus ascendit in naviculam et discipuli eius cum eo. Et ait ad illos: Transfretemus trans stagnum. Et ascenderunt. Navigantibus autem illis obdormivit. Et descendit procella venti in stagnum et complebantur et periclitabantur. Accedentes autem suscitaverunt eum dicentes: Praeceptor perimus. Et ille surgens increpavit ventum et tempestatem aquae et cessavit et facta est tranquillitas. Dixit autem illis: Ubi est fides vestra? Qui timentes mirati sunt dicentes ad invicem: Quis putas hic est? Quia et ventis imperat et mari et oboediunt ei?
translation_en: Now it happened on one day, and Jesus got into a boat along with His disciples. And He said to them: Let us cross the sea. So they got up and started to sail. But while they were sailing, He fell asleep. And a stormy wind blew over the sea and it was being filled and they were in peril. Coming near to them, they woke Him up saying: Master, we are perishing! And He stood up and scolded the wind and the raging sea, and it ceased and there was calm. He said to them: Where is your faith? Those who feared were amazed at each other, asking among themselves: Who is this? For even the winds and the sea obey Him!

text: A domo tua quaesumus Domine spiritales nequitiae repellantur et aeriarum discedat malignitas tempestatum et fulgurum.
translation_en: From your house, we humbly ask, Lord, may spiritual wickedness be driven away and the malice of storms and thunderbolts depart.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos et castigando sanas et ignoscendo conservas: praesta supplicibus tuis et dono tuae pietatis semper utamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who heal us through chastising and conserve us through forgiveness: grant to your suppliant ones the gift of your pity, that we may always use it.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus te supplices deprecamur ut misericordia tua iugiter nobis concessas sufficienter messium copias et fructuum largiter tribuas vinearum quoque substantiam abundantem arborum fetus proventus omnium rerum; atque ab his omnibus pestiferum sidus tempestates universas procellas et grandines amovere digneris.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty and eternal God, we humbly pray to you that your mercy may always be granted to us sufficiently for the harvest of crops and generously bestow upon us the yield of vineyards with an abundance of fruits from all trees; also remove from us all harmful stars, tempests, storms, hailstorms.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus: misericordiam tuam supplices deprecamur ut oblationes populi quas tibi de suis primitiis offerunt benignus suscipere digneris; tribue Domine eis in hoc saeculo abundantiam tritici vini et olei in futuro autem vitam aeternam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God: we humbly ask for your mercy that you might graciously accept the offerings of your people, which they bring from their first fruits; grant them, Lord, abundance of wheat, wine and oil in this world. In the future, grant them eternal life.

text: Sempiternae pietatis tuae abundantiam Domine supplices exoramus ut nos quibus beneficiis non meremur anticipans benefacere cognoscaris indignis.
translation_en: With supplicating hearts, we ask you, Lord, for the abundant goodness of your eternal pity. May you, who are not obliged to bestow on us what we do not deserve, recognize us unworthy ones before bestowing favor upon us.

text: Guberna quaesumus Domine temporalibus adiumentis quos dignatus es aeternis informare mysteriis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you guide those whom you have seen fit to form with eternal mysteries, with temporal assistance.

text: Domine Deus qui ad hoc irasceris ut subvenias ad hoc minaris ut parcas: lapsis manum porrige salutarem et laborantibus multiplici miseratione succurre ut gentem paganam quam pro peccatis nostris super nos cognoscimus praevalere te miserante cognoscamus cessare.
translation_en: Lord God, who are angry enough to help, who threaten to show mercy: extend a saving hand to the fallen and come to the aid of the laboring with manifold mercy. May we, a pagan people whom we know to be over us because of our sins, recognize Your mercy when You show it to us.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod immolamus intende ut ab omni paganorum et ab omni inimicorum nos exuat bellorum nequitia et tuae protectionis securitas constituat.
translation_en: Lord, regard the sacrifice that we offer, and may it be so that from every pagan and every enemy, you free us from the wickedness of wars, and establish for us the security of your protection.

text: Protector noster aspice Deus et paganorum omniumque inimicorum nos defende periculis ut omni perturbatione submota liberis tibi mentibus servire mereamur.
translation_en: Our protector, look upon us, God, and defend us against all the pagans and enemies. May we be worthy to serve you with minds free from every disturbance, through your protection from all perils.

text: Respiciat Deus clementia tua Domine Iesu munera praesentia et per ea {praes} gratiam tuae miserationis servis tuis impende ut quae recta sunt in oculis tuis veraciter intelligant et fiducialiter loquantur.
translation_en: May God look upon his kindness, O Lord Jesus, and bestow his gifts in your presence. Through these, may his grace of mercy be poured out upon your servants, so that what is right before his eyes may truly be understood by them and they may faithfully speak about it.

text: Da quaesumus Domine ut haec sancta tua quae sumpsimus famulos tuos in tua voluntate confirment et veritatis ubique defensores efficiant.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that these your holy things which we have received may confirm your servants in your will and make them defenders of truth everywhere.

text: Benedictionem tuam Domine populus fidelis accipiat qua corpore salvatus ac mente congruam tibi semper exhibeat servitutem et propitiationis tuae beneficia semper inveniat.
translation_en: May the faithful people receive your blessing, O Lord, that with body saved and mind in accord with you they may always show service and may always find the benefits of your propitiation.

text: Verba mea
translation_en: My words

text: Memento verbi tui
translation_en: Remember your word

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus salus aeterna credentium: exaudi nos pro infirmis famulis et famulabus tuis N. pro quibus misericordiae tuae imploramus auxilium ut reddita eis sanitate gratiarum tibi in Ecclesia tua referant actionem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, eternal salvation of the believers: hear us for the infirm servants and servant-maids of yours, N., on whose behalf we implore your mercy, that you may grant them health, so that they may express their gratitude to you in your Church with actions.

text: Deus cuius nutibus vitae nostrae momenta decurrunt: suscipe preces et hostias famulorum famularumque tuarum pro quibus misericordiam tuam aegrotantibus imploramus et de quorum periculo metuimus de eorum salute laetemur.
translation_en: God, whose movements govern the moments of our lives: receive the prayers and offerings of your servants and handmaids for whom we implore your mercy for those who are sick, and whose danger we fear; let us rejoice in their safety.

text: Deus infirmitatis humanae singulare praesidium: auxilii tui super infirmos famulos et famulas tuas ostende virtutem ut ope misericordiae tuae adiuti Ecclesiae tuae sanctae repraesentari mereantur.
translation_en: O God, unique refuge of human frailty: show the power of your aid to your weak servants and maidservants, so that they may deserve to be helped by your mercy and represent your holy Church.

text: Tristatur aliquis vestrum oret aequo animo et psallat. Infirmatur quis in vobis inducat presbyteros ecclesiae et orent super eum ungentes eum oleo in nomine Domini et oratio fidei salvabit infirmum et allevabit eum Dominus et si in peccatis sit dimittentur ei. Confitemini ergo alterutrum peccata vestra et orate pro invicem ut salvemini.
translation_en: Someone among you should sorrowfully pray with a sincere heart and sing psalms. Let one of you who is weak bring forth the presbyters of the church and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord. This prayer of faith will save the sick and alleviate him. The Lord will pardon him if he is in sins. Therefore, confess your sins to one another and pray for each other so that you may be saved.

text: Intravit Iesus Capharnaum centurionis autem cuiusdam servus male habens erat mortuus qui illi erat pretiosus et cum audisset de Iesu misit ad eum seniores Iudaeorum rogans eum ut veniret et salvaret servum eius. At illi cum venissent ad eum rogabant eum sollicite dicentes ei: Quia dignus est ut hoc illi praestes. Diligit enim gentem nostram et synagogam ipse aedificavit nobis. Iesus autem ibat cum illis. Et cum iam non esset longe a domo misit ad eum centurio amicos dicens: Domine noli vexari non enim dignus sum ut intres sub tectum meum. Propter quod et meipsum non sum dignum arbitratus ut venirem ad te sed dic verbo et sanabitur puer meus. Nam et ego homo sum sub potestate constitutus habens sub me milites. Et dico huic: Vade et vadit et alio: Veni et venit et servo meo: Fac hoc et facit. Quo audito Iesus miratus est et conversus sequentibus se turbis dixit: Amen dico vobis nec in Israël tantam fidem inveni. Et reversi qui missi fuerant domum invenerunt servum qui languerat sanum.
translation_en: Jesus entered Capharnaum, and a centurion's servant who was gravely ill was dead; he was precious to the centurion. Upon hearing about Jesus, he sent some of the elders of Israel to him, asking him to come and save his servant. But when they came to him, they begged him urgently, saying to him: "For it is worthy that you should do this for him." Indeed, they loved our nation, and he himself had built our synagogue. Jesus went with them, but already not far from the house, he sent to the centurion his friends, saying: "Lord, trouble yourself not, for I am not worthy that you should come under my roof." Therefore, neither do I consider myself worthy to come to you, but say a word, and my servant will be healed. For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to this one: Go, and he goes; and to another: Come, and he comes; and to my servant: Do this, and it is done. Upon hearing this, Jesus was amazed and turning to the crowd following him, he said: "Truly, I tell you, I have not found such faith in Israel." And those who had been sent back home found the servant ill but alive.

text: Recumbentibus undecim discipuli
translation_en: The eleven disciples lying down

text: Erat quidam regulus
translation_en: There was a certain abbot

text: Cum introisset Iesus
translation_en: When Jesus entered

text: Surgens Iesus de synagoga
translation_en: Jesus rising from the synagogue

text: Gratias tibi agimus omnipotens Deus qui per votiva dona Sigismundi martyris tui nos pane vivo et vino vero laetitiae spiritalis recreare dignatus es; praesta quaesumus ut quicumque in commemoratione eius corpore et sanguine Domini nostri Iesu Christi participatur ad sanitatem pristinam revocetur.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, almighty God, who have deigned to refresh us spiritually with the votive gifts of Saint Sigismund your martyr; grant us that whoever participates in his commemoration corporally and spiritually in the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ may be restored to original health.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus te fideliter deprecamur ut huic famulo tuo sacrosanctum Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi corpus et sanguinem accipienti tam corporis quam animae sit salus.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, we humbly entreat you for this your servant, that the sacred body and blood of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, be to him both in body and soul a source of salvation.

text: Domine Deus salutis meae
translation_en: Lord God of my salvation

text: Redime nos Deus
translation_en: Redeem us, God

text: Dixit Ieremias: Domine omnes qui te derelinquunt
translation_en: Jeremiah said: Lord, all who forsake you

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus conservator animarum qui quos diligis corripis et quos recipis pia emendatione coërces: te invocamus ut famulo tuo qui in corpore patitur membrorum debilitationem vim laboris stimulos infirmitatis gratiam tuam conferre digneris in hora exitus sui de corpore ut absque peccati macula tibi datori proprio per manus sanctorum angelorum repraesentari mereatur eius anima.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, the preserver of souls, who chastises those you love and receives them with pious correction: we call upon you to grant your grace to your servant who suffers weakness of limbs in his body, that he may deserve to be represented before you by the hands of holy angels at the hour of his departure from the body, free from any stain of sin, to his own proper Giver.

text: Adesto Domine pro tua pietate supplicationibus nostris et suscipe hostiam quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo iacente in grabbato non corporis sed animae suae salutem potenti et praesta ei indulgentiam omnium iniquitatum suarum propter immensam misericordiam tuam ut per hoc quod sustinet flagellum a sanctis angelis tuis susceptus ad te pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: Lord, be present to us for your mercy's sake and receive the offering we present to you on behalf of your servant lying in the bed of sickness, not of the body but of the soul. Grant him salvation powerful one and grant him indulgence for all his sins because of your immense mercy, so that through this he who bears the scourge from your holy angels may deserve to reach you.

text: Domine adiutor et protector in tribulationibus Deus misericordiae et pietatis et peccatorum benignus indultor: da quaesumus famulo tuo pro quo hanc oblationem tibi obtulimus suorum remissionem peccaminum ut in hora exitus sui de corpore gaudia vitae aeternae valeat feliciter obtinere.
translation_en: Lord, helper and protector in tribulations, God of mercy and piety, and gracious forgiver of sins: grant, we ask, your servant, for whom we have offered this oblation to you, the remission of his sins, so that he may happily obtain the joys of eternal life at the hour of his departure from the body.

text: Deus qui transtulisti patres nostros per mare Rubrum et transvexisti per aquam nimiam: laudem nomini tuo decantantes supplices deprecamur ut in hac navi famulos tuos repulsis adversitatibus portu semper optabili cursuque tranquillo tuearis.
translation_en: God who led our fathers across the Red Sea and guided them through rough waters: we humbly beseech you to protect your servants on this ship, always in a desirable harbor and with a calm course, from adversities.

text: Sanctificati divino mysterio maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter deprecamur et petimus ut quos donis caelestibus facis interesse per lignum sanctae Crucis et a peccatis abstrahas et a periculis cunctis miseratus eripias.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your majesty, Lord, and we ask that you, by the divine mystery, make us partake through the holy wood of the Cross, and separate us from sins, and rescue us with mercy from all dangers.

text: Sacrosancti corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi refectione vegetati supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut hoc remedio singulari ab omnium peccatorum nos contagione purifices et a peccatorum munias incursione cunctorum.
translation_en: We humbly entreat the almighty God on behalf of the sacred body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is nourished by this refreshment, that you purify us from the contagion of all sins with this unique remedy, and protect us from the incursion of sins upon all.

text: Deus qui post baptismi sacramentum secundam absolutionem peccatorum eleemosynis indidisti: respice propitius super famulos et famulas tuas qui iuste ad hunc locum sanctum seu clero vel pauperibus hic alimoniam accipientibus sua tribuerunt pro quibus maiestati tuae preces fundimus ut eis clementi bonitate succurras libens protegas dignanter exaudias et a peccatorum nexibus et tormentis tartari eruas et ad beatam patriam perducere digneris.
translation_en: God, who after the sacrament of baptism bestowed alms for the remission of sins upon your servants: look favorably upon your servants who are here receiving alms, whether they be clergy or poor. We pour out our prayers before Your majesty on their behalf, that You would graciously succor them, protect them with dignity, hear them attentively, and deliver them from the bonds and torments of sins, and mercifully guide them to the blessed homeland.

text: Deus qui tuorum corda fidelium per eleemosynam dixisti posse mundari: praesta quaesumus ut per haec sancta mysteria quae tibi noster famulatus offert illi qui ad hunc locum sanctum vel clero seu pauperibus sua tribuerunt pro quibus clementiam tuam licitum est exorare in conspectu tuo semper clari consistere et indulgentiam omnium peccatorum a te piissimo largitore mereantur percipere.
translation_en: God, who through charity said that the hearts of your faithful could be cleansed: grant us, we ask, that through these holy mysteries which our servant offers to you, those who have given here, either to the clergy or to the poor, may always dwell before your clear sight and may deserve to receive forgiveness for all their sins from you, the most merciful giver.

text: Ascendant ad te Domine preces nostrae et animabus famulorum famularumque tuis qui hunc locum pauperesque tuos de suis iustis laboribus rebusque ditaverunt pro quibus etiam te licitum est humiliter deprecari misericordiam concede perpetuam accipiantque magna pro parvis caelestia pro terrenis mansura pro caducis.
translation_en: Our prayers ascend to You, Lord, and to the souls of Your servants, the poor ones among them who have given this place from their own just labors and possessions for those whom it is fitting even to humbly ask for mercy. Grant them eternal mercy and let them receive great things in return for small ones, heavenly things for earthly ones, everlasting things for fleeting ones.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui subvenis in periculis et necessitate laborantibus: maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecamur ut mittere digneris sanctum angelum tuum de caelis qui famulum tuum in angustiis et necessitatibus laborantem consolationibus tuis attollat quibus et de praesenti consequatur auxilium et aeterna remedia comprehendat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who comes to the aid of those in peril and need: we humbly beseech your majesty that you may be pleased to send your holy angel from heaven, to uplift your servant laboring in distress and necessity with your consolations. May he obtain immediate help from them, and grasp eternal remedies.

text: Oblationes et hostias pro peccatis atque offensionibus famuli tui in angustia consistentis omnipotens Deus oblata suscipe quem vere credimus per prophetam dixisse: Immola Deo sacrificium laudis et redde Altissimo vota tua et invoca me in die tribulationis tuae; eripiam te et magnificabis me.
translation_en: Offerings and hosts for the sins and offenses of your servant, who is in distress, Almighty God, receive what we truly believe, as the prophet said: Offer a sacrifice to God, a sacrifice of praise, and return your vows to the Most High; call upon me in your day of tribulation; I will rescue you and you will magnify me.

text: Deus qui renuntiantibus saeculo mansionem paras in caelo dilata quaesumus sanctae huius congregationis habitaculum temporale caelestibus bonis ut fraternae teneamus compagine caritatis unanimes continentiae praecepta servemus sobrii simplices et quieti simus gratis nobis datam hanc fuisse gratiam agnoscamus; concordet vita nostra cum nomine professio sentiatur in opere.
translation_en: God who prepares a dwelling in heaven for those renouncing the world, we humbly ask that you provide a temporary home for this holy congregation among celestial goods. May we hold each other firmly with brotherly love, obeying the teachings of continence and simplicity, being sober, peaceful, and quiet. We recognize that this grace has been given to us freely; let our life conform to our profession, and feel it in deed.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine propitius hostiam servitutis nostrae in conspectu tuo immolandam ut professionis sanctae propositum quod te inspirante suscepimus te gubernante custodiamus.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, graciously, as we humbly present the sacrifice of our servitude before you. May we keep the vow we took under your inspiration, guided by you, as we fulfill our commitment.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras et muro custodiae tuae nostrum ovile circumda ut omni adversitate depulsa sit hoc semper domicilium incolumitatis et pacis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers and encompass our sheepfold with your protecting wall, so that it may always be a dwelling of safety and peace, driven away from every adversity.

text: Familiam nostram quaesumus Domine intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria et omnibus sanctis perpetuo guberna moderamine ut assit nobis et in securitate cautela et inter aspera fortitudo.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, with the intercession of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, and all saints, to govern our family perpetually with a gentle guidance. May they assist us in safety, protect us with caution, and be our strength amidst trials.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui peccantium animas non vis perire sed culpas: contine quam meremur iram et quam precamur super nos effunde clementiam ut de maerore in gaudium tua misericordia transferamur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who wills not the death of sinners but their repentance: contain for us the wrath we deserve, and pour out upon us thy clemency, that by thy mercy we may be transferred from mourning to joy.

text: Sit nobis Domine quaesumus medicina mentis et corporis quod de sancti altaris tui benedictione percepimus ut nullis adversitatibus fatigemur qui tanti remedii participatione munimur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you grant us a remedy for both mind and body, which we have received from your holy altar's blessing. May we not be wearied by adversities, being fortified by the participation in such a great remedy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui non mortem peccatorum sed vitam semper inquiris: suscipe propitius orationem nostram et libera gentes ab idolorum cultura et aggrega Ecclesiae tuae sanctae ad laudem et gloriam nominis tui.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who seeks not the death of sinners but their eternal life: receive our prayer graciously and free nations from the worship of idols, gather the Church of your sanctity to the praise and glory of your name.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes quas tibi offerimus pro conversione gentium benignus assume et praesta ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy upon our supplications and these offerings that we present to you for the conversion of the nations. Gracious Lord, accept them and grant that what we earnestly ask may be effectively obtained.

text: Da nobis Domine perseverantem in tua voluntate famulatum ut in diebus nostris et merito et numero populus tibi serviens augeatur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, servants persevering in your will, that in our days and both in merit and number the people serving you may be increased.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui maternum affectum nec (in) ipsa sacra semper Virgine Maria quae Redemptorem nostrum genuit denegasti: concede propitius ut eiusdem Genitricis precibus famula tua N. esse genitrix mereatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who have never denied the maternal affection in the sacred Virgin Mary, who gave birth to our Redeemer: graciously grant that your servant N. may deserve to be called the daughter of the same Mother.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras cum muneribus hostiarum quas pro famula tua clementiae tuae supplici mente deferimus ut quia affectum filiorum maxime in matrum visceribus indidisti maerorem ab ea amoveas et ad concipiendam subolem misericorditer benedicas.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers with the offerings of sacrifices that we bring on behalf of your servant, humbly offering them to your mercy. May you who placed the affection of children especially in their mothers' hearts remove the sorrow from her and may you mercifully bless her to conceive offspring.

text: Caelestis vitae munus accipientes quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut in eo quod 〈pro〉 famula tua N. deprecati sumus clementiam tuae pietatis exaudire mereamur.
translation_en: Receiving the gift of celestial life, we humbly ask Almighty God that in what we have asked on behalf of your servant N., we may deserve the hearing of your clemency and the favor of your mercy.

text: Deus qui per Unigenitum tuum exclusa dominatione diaboli populum tibi Christianum aptasti: expelle quaesumus a famulo tuo cunctas diabolicae illusionis insidias et ab omni eum impugnatione conserva.
translation_en: God, who through Your Unigenitor freed the Christian people from the dominion of the devil: we humbly ask You to drive away all the snares of diabolic illusions and protect them from every attack by him.

text: Munus nostrae humilitatis pro tuitione famuli tui oblatum petimus Domine dignanter assume et ab eius oppressione maligni insidias omnemque potestatem exclude.
translation_en: We humbly request, Lord, to take up the offering made for the protection of your servant. May you graciously free him from his oppression, and exclude all wicked snares and every power from him.

text: Deus pacis caritatisque amator et custos: da omnibus inimicis nostris pacem caritatemque veram cunctorum eius remissionem peccatorum nosque ab eorum insidiis potenter eripe.
translation_en: God, lover and protector of peace and charity: grant peace and true love to all our enemies, the forgiveness of sins for each one of them, and powerfully deliver us from their plots.

text: Oblatis quaesumus Domine placare muneribus et nos ab inimicis nostris clementer eripe eisque indulgentiam tribue delictorum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to look favorably upon the offerings and mercifully deliver us from our enemies, and grant them forgiveness for their sins.

text: Deus qui Moysi Samueli et Stephano protomartyri virtutem patientiae dedisti ut pro suorum delictis inimicorum aequanimiter exorarent: da nobis quaesumus omnium meritis sanctorum ut inimicos nostros verae dilectionis amore diligamus eorumque pro excessibus tota mentis intentione preces assiduas in conspectu maiestatis tuae fundamus.
translation_en: God, who gave strength and patience to Moses, Samuel, and Stephen, the first martyrs, so that they could pray equanimously for their enemies because of their sins: grant us, we ask, through the merits of all saints, that we may love our enemies with the true love of a heart, and offer constant prayers with our whole mind's intention in the sight of your majesty for their excesses.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes quas tibi pro incolumitate et salute omnium fidelium tuorum offerimus benignus assume et ut nullius sit irritum votum nullius vacua postulatio praesta quaesumus ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate our supplications and these offerings which we present to you for the welfare and health of all your faithful. Gracious one, accept them, and so that no one's vow is empty, no request void, we humbly ask that what we fervently pray for may effectively be accomplished.

text: Conserva tuis mysteriis populum tuum Deus ut divinis subiectus officiis et temporalia utiliter et aeterna dona feliciter accipiat.
translation_en: Preserve your people, O God, within your mysteries, so that they may receive the divine offices with utility for the temporal and eternal goods happily under submission.

text: Deus cuius arbitrio omnium saeculorum ordo decurrit: respice propitius ad nostri temporis aetatem ut tibi servitus nostra complaceat et misericordiae tuae in nobis dona conserves.
translation_en: God whose order all ages are subject to your will: look upon us graciously in our time, that our service pleases you and the grace of your mercy abides with us.

text: Purificet nos quaesumus omnipotens Deus caelestis libatio sacramenti et ad tuam magnificentiam capiendam divinis affectibus semper instauret.
translation_en: Purify us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, heavenly libation of the sacrament, and may it always be renewed in your splendor by divine affections.

text: Exsurge Domine fer opem
translation_en: Rise up, O Lord, help us

text: Deus auribus
translation_en: God of ears

text: Erubescant et conturbentur
translation_en: They shall blush and be disturbed

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui occulta omnia praenoscis: exaudi et intende orationem meam et fac furem reverti cum re quam fraudavit ut manifestetur nobis sicut manifestasti Achab in Iericho fiatque illi contrarium verbum Dei ut compulsus redeat et ostendatur nobis et sicut te latere nullum potest ita nobis Domine manifesta hanc rem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who foresees all hidden things: hear and attend to my prayer, and make the thief return with the property he has stolen so that he may be revealed to us as you revealed Ahab in Jericho. Let the opposite of God's word be fulfilled against him, so that he is compelled to return and shown to us. As no one can hide from you, Lord, so reveal this matter to us.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine haec oblatio quam tuae supplices offerimus maiestati ad convertendum et revertendum famulum tuum N. ut prius requiem non habeat antequam se nobis ostendat ut qui te contemnendo reatum incurrit sic te miserante veniam consequatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that this offering which we present to Your majesty as suppliant may serve to convert and return Your servant N. so that he does not have rest before showing himself to us, for he incurs guilt by contempt of You; but through Your mercy, he may attain forgiveness.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et famulum tuum fac reverti et sicut furtum Achab absconditum in terra Iosue invenit ita nobis patefacere digneris omnia; pro quibus petimus divinam clementiam tuam ut non in aeternum abscondas iniquitatem suam sed in praesenti denuda furtum suum ut conversus veniat et paeniteat malum suum et misericordiam tuam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, cleanse us from sin and make your servant return, just as Ahab's hidden sin was found in the land of Joshua, so may you reveal all things to us; for which we ask your divine clemency not to forever hide his wickedness but to expose his wrongdoing in the present, that he may turn back, repent of his evil ways and deserve your mercy.

text: Si enim credimus quod Iesus mortuus fuerat et resurrexit ita et Deus eos qui dormierunt per Iesum adducet cum eo.
translation_en: If indeed we believe that Jesus was dead and resurrected, then God will also bring those who slept with Jesus.

text: Et sicut in Adam omnes moriuntur
translation_en: And just as in Adam all die

text: Si ambulem in medio umbrae mortis non timebo mala quoniam tu mecum es Domine.
translation_en: If I walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me, Lord.

text: Virga tua et baculus tuus ipsa me consolata sunt.
translation_en: Your rod and your staff have comforted me themselves.

text: De profundis clamavi ad te Domine Domine exaudi vocem meam. 〈V.〉 Fiant aures tuae intendentes in orationem servi tui. V. Si iniquitates observaberis Domine Domine qui sustinebit. 〈V.〉 Quia apud te propitiatio est et propter legem tuam sustinui te Domine.
translation_en:
From the depths I cry out to you, Lord, Lord; hear my voice!
(V.) Let your ears be attentive to the prayer of your servant. V. Who will stand if you watch iniquity, Lord?
(V.) Indeed, there is forgiveness with you, and therefore I have hoped in you, Lord.

text: Domine Iesu Christe rex gloriae: libera animas omnium fidelium defunctorum de manu inferni et de profundo lacu; libera eas de ore leonis ne absorbeat eas tartarus ne cadant in obscura sed signifer sanctus Michael repraesentet eas in lucem sanctam. * Quam olim Abrahae promisisti et semini eius.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, King of glory: free the souls of all faithful departed from the hand of hell and from the deep lake; free them from the mouth of the lion, may they not be absorbed by tartarus nor fall into darkness, but may Saint Michael, the standard-bearer, present them in the holy light. * As you once promised Abraham and his descendants.

text: Hostias et preces tibi Domine laudis offerimus; tu suscipe pro animabus illis quarum hodie memoriam facimus; fac eas Domine de morte transire ad vitam.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, hosts and prayers of praise; receive them for the souls for whom we remember today; may, Lord, They pass from death to life.

text: Requiem aeternam dona eis Domine et lux perpetua luceat eis.
translation_en: Grant them eternal rest, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them.

text: Redemptor animarum omnium Christianorum: mitte archangelum sanctum Michaëlem ut ille dignetur eas eripere de regionibus tenebrarum et perducat eas in sinum Abrahae in lucem sempiternam. Quam olim Abrahae.
translation_en: Redemptor of the souls of all Christians: send the holy archangel Michael, that he may deign to deliver them from the regions of darkness and lead them into the bosom of Abraham into eternal light. As once Abraham.

text: Tuam Deus deposcimus pietatem ut eis tribuere digneris lucidas et quietas mansiones pro quorum memoria corpus Christi sumitur; dona eis Domine requiem sempiternam et lux perpetua luceat eis pro quorum memoria sanguis Christi sumitur; dona eis Domine requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: We implore your Godliness to grant them bright and peaceful dwellings, in memory of whom the body of Christ is taken; grant them eternal rest, O Lord, and may a perpetual light shine upon them for whose memory the blood of Christ is taken; grant them eternal rest, O Lord.

text: O pie Deus qui primum hominem ad aeternam gloriam revocasti; pastor bone qui ovem perditam pio umero ad ovile reportasti; iuste iudex: dum veneris iudicare libera de morte animas eorum quas redemisti. * Ne tradas bestiis animas confitentes tibi ne derelinquas eas in finem.
translation_en: O good God, who first called the first man to eternal glory; good shepherd, who brought back the lost sheep with your pious arm to the fold; righteous judge: when you come to judge them free from death, souls that you have redeemed. * Let not beasts take the souls confessing to you, nor leave them until the end.

text: Domine Iesu Christe iudex mortuorum sola spes mortalium qui moriens morientium condoluisti interitum: ne intres in iudicium cum fidelibus tuis ne damnemur cum impiis in adventu tui districti iudicii. Ne tradas bestiis.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, Judge of the dead, sole hope of mortals, who comforted the dying as you died: do not enter into judgment with your faithful ones, lest we be condemned among the wicked in the coming of your terrifying day of judgment. Do not hand us over to beasts.

text: Absolve Domine animas eorum ab omni vinculo delictorum ut in resurrectionis gloria inter sanctos tuos resuscitari respirent.
translation_en: Forgive, Lord, the souls of them from every bond of sins, that in the glory of the resurrection they may breathe among your saints.

text: Amen dico vobis veniet hora quando mortui audient vocem Filii Dei et resurgent qui in monumentis sunt.
translation_en: Indeed I tell you, the hour is coming when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who are in their graves will rise.

text: Deus indulgentiarum Domine: da famulo tuo cuius tertium septimum tricesimum sive anniversarium diem commemoramus refrigerii sedem quietis beatitudinem luminis claritatem.
translation_en: God of mercies, Lord: grant your servant, whose third seventh thirtieth day or anniversary we remember, a place of refreshment, peace, blessedness, and light.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris pro anima famuli tui N. cuius hodie tertius dies septimus tricesimus sive annua dies agitur pro qua tibi offerimus sacrificium laudis ut eam sanctorum tuorum consortio sociare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications for the soul of your servant N., whose third day seventh thirty-third, or annual day is being observed today. For her, we offer you a sacrifice of praise, that you may deem worthy to associate her with the company of your saints.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras pro anima famuli tui N. ut quaecumque ei maculae de terrenis contagiis adhaeserunt remissionis tuae misericordia deleantur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers for the soul of your servant N. May whatever stains on him from earthly contagions be cleansed by your mercy.

text: Inclina Domine quaesumus aurem tuam ad preces nostras quibus misericordiam tuam suppliciter deprecamur ut animam famuli tui quam hodie assumpsisti in pacis ac lucis regione constituas et sanctorum tuorum iubeas esse consortem.
translation_en: Incline, we beseech You, Lord, Your ear to our prayers with which we humbly entreat Your mercy. May the soul of Your servant whom You have today taken into the region of peace and light, You establish. Command it to be a companion of Your saints.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine quae tibi pro anima famuli tui N. quam hodie assumpsisti offerimus placatus intende ut remediis purgata caelestibus in tua pietate requiescat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept the gifts offered for the soul of your servant N., which today you have received. May you be pleased to direct it, so that with celestial remedies purified, may it rest in your mercy.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Per Christum Dominum nostrum. Per quem salus mundi per quem vita omnium per quem resurrectio mortuorum per ipsum te Domine suppliciter deprecamur ut animae famuli tui N. indulgentiam largiri digneris perpetuam atque contagiis mortalitatis exutam in aeternae salvationis partem constituas. Per quem maiestatem tuam.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, eternal God, through Christ our Lord, through whom the salvation of the world, life of all, resurrection of the dead, we ask you, Lord, to grant N., your servant, the grace of perpetual indulgence and to admit them, freed from mortal contagions, into the part of eternal salvation. Through Him may your majesty be praised.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro anima famuli tui N. quam hodie assumpsisti offerimus quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et quicquid humanae condicionis obreptio contraxit expedias ut tuis purificata remidiis ad gaudium sempiternum perveniat. Per Christum. Diesque nostros in tua pace.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering which today we offer for the soul of your servant N., we present to you, Lord. We humbly ask that, being pleased, you may receive it and that whatever has been bound by the condition of humanity, you may release. May they, purified by you, reach eternal joy. Through Christ. May our days be in your peace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus collocare dignare animam famuli tui N. quam hodie assumpsisti in sinibus Abrahae Isaac et Iacob ut cum dies agnitionis tuae advenerit inter sanctos et electos tuos eum resuscitari praecipias.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, deem worthy to place the soul of your servant N., whom today you have taken into the loins of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, so that when the day of your recognition arrives, among the saints and elect ones of yours, you may command his resurrection.

text: Inclina quaesumus Domine precibus nostris aures tuae pietatis et animae famuli tui N. remissionem tribue omnium peccatorum 〈ut his sacrificiis〉 purgata consortio mereatur perfrui beatorum.
translation_en: Incline, we beseech You, Lord, Your ears of mercy towards our prayers, and the soul of Your servant N. grant remission of all sins – that purified by such sacrifices, he may deserve to participate in the fellowship of the blessed.

text: Miserere quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui episcopi N. et quem in corpore constitutum sedis apostolicae gubernacula tenere voluisti in electorum tuorum numero constituas sacerdotum.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, we beseech You, O Lord, the soul of Your servant, bishop N., and the one whom You wanted to hold the governance of the apostolic see in the number of Your elect, You have constituted as a priest.

text: Suscipe Domine {et} hostias quas tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui episcopi N. ut in pontificum tibimet placitorum perpetua sede laetetur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings we present to you on behalf of the soul of your servant bishop N. May he rejoice forever in the eternal seat of pleasing popes.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut animam famuli tui episcopi N. in congregatione iustorum aeternae beatitudinis iubeas esse consortem.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that He may grant the soul of your servant, Bishop N., to be a companion in the congregation of the just for eternal beatitude.

text: Deus qui inter apostolicos sacerdotes famulos tuos episcopos pontificali fecisti dignitate vigere: praesta quaesumus ut quorum vicem gerebant ad horam in terris eorum quoque perpetuo consortio laetentur in caelis. Per Dominum.
translation_en: God, who made your servants bishops among the apostolic priests to be sustained by pontifical dignity: grant us that those who on earth held their office may also rejoice forever in eternal fellowship with them in heaven, through the Lord.

text: Haec oblatio Domine quaesumus animas famulorum tuorum episcoporum ab omnibus vitiis humanae condicionis absolvat quae totius mundi tulit etiam immolata peccatum.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we ask that you forgive the souls of your servants, the bishops, from all the vices of human condition that have affected the whole world, even those sins which were offered as a sacrifice.

text: Da veniam Domine Deus per haec sancta mysteria animabus famulorum tuorum episcoporum ut occursu non terreantur malo sed tuo semper protegantur auxilio.
translation_en: Grant forgiveness, Lord God, through these holy mysteries to the souls of your servants, the bishops, so that they may not be terrified by evil, but may always be protected by your assistance.

text: Deus qui famulum tuum sacerdotem atque abbatem N. sanctificasti vocatione misericordiae et assumpsisti consummatione felici: suscipe propitius preces nostras et praesta ut sicut ille tecum est meritis ita a nobis non recedat exemplis.
translation_en: God who sanctified your servant, the priest and abbot N., with the calling of mercy and took him up in the happy completion: graciously receive our prayers and grant that just as he remains with you through merits, so he may not depart from us by example.

text: Prosit quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui N. sacerdotis atque abbatis misericordiae tuae implorata clementia ut ei in quo speravit et credidit aeternum capiat te miserante consortium.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the soul of your servant N., priest and abbot, may find the favor of your mercy and imploring clemency, so that he who hoped for you and believed in you may eternal union with you receive, while you mercifully grant consortium.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut anima famuli tui sacerdotis N. quem in hoc saeculo commorantem sacris muneribus decorasti in caelesti sede gloriosa semper exsultet.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that the soul of your servant, the priest N., whom you have adorned with sacred duties in this world, may always rejoice in a glorious seat in the heavenly realm.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut anima famuli tui sacerdotis N. per haec sancta mysteria in conspectu tuo clara semper consistat quae tibi in hoc exsilio fideliter ministravit.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the soul of your servant, priest N., through these holy mysteries, may always stand before you clear and steadfast, who faithfully served you in this exile.

text: Prosit quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui sacerdotis N. divini celebratio sacramenti ut eius in quo speravit et credidit aeternum capiat te miserante consortium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, the soul of your servant, the priest N., may the divine celebration of the sacrament bring him eternal life, as he hoped and believed. May you, being merciful, grant him everlasting companionship.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine animabus famulorum tuorum sacerdotum felicitatis aeternae consortium quibus donasti sacri altaris tui consequi ministerium.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, the souls of your servants, the priests, the eternal happiness of fellowship, to whom you have granted to participate in the ministry of your holy altar.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus pro animabus famulorum tuorum sacerdotum quas tibi offerimus hostias ut quibus sacerdotale donasti meritum dones et praemium.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech you, on behalf of the souls of your servants, the priests whom we offer to you. May you give them the reward and payment for which you have given them the priestly dignity.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut animae famulorum tuorum sacerdotum caelestis praemium gloriae consequantur quibus spiritualis gratiae munera contulisti.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the souls of your servants, the priests, may obtain the heavenly reward of glory, to whom you have bestowed the gifts of spiritual grace.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine hostias placationis et laudis et perpetuae quaesumus misericordiae largitate animam famuli tui N. in lucis aeternae facias regione gaudere.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, sacrifices of appeasement and praise, and we humbly ask through your generous mercy, may the soul of your servant N. rejoice in the region of eternal light.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et animam famuli tui N. in vivorum regione aeternis gaudiis iubeas sociari.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and grant that the soul of your servant N. may participate in the eternal joys of the living in the kingdom of heaven.

text: Beati martyris tui N. quaesumus Domine intercessione nos protege et animam famuli tui N. sanctorum tuorum iunge consortiis.
translation_en: Blessed are the martyrs of your servant N., we beseech you, Lord, protect us with their intercession and unite the soul of your servant N. with the fellowship of your saints.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus hostias placationis et laudis quas tibi in honore sancti martyris tui N. consecrandas deferimus et pro requie famuli tui N. tibi suppliciter immolamus.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we pray you, the offerings of appeasement and praise which we bring to you in honor of your holy martyr N., and on behalf of the rest of your servant N., we humbly offer these to you.

text: Ascendant ad te Domine preces nostrae et animam famuli tui gaudia aeterna suscipiant ut quem fecisti adoptionis participem iubeas hereditatis tuae esse consortem.
translation_en: Our prayers rise up to You, Lord, and may the soul of Your servant receive eternal joy. May You command that he be a co-heir to Your inheritance, as one who shares in adoption.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui N. et praesta ut qui de suis donis pervigili cura in nomine tuo cottidiana praeparavit obsequia perpetua cum sanctis tuis mereatur perfrui laetitia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be merciful to the soul of your servant N. And grant that he who has prepared daily offerings for you with vigilant care from his own gifts, may deserve to partake in eternal joy with your saints.

text: Percepta Domine communio singularis sit animae famuli tui salutaris; sit ei Domine salutare remedium quod in hoc tibi loco divini servitii praeparavit obsequium et nobis famulis tuis temporale subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, may this singular communion be a health-giving nourishment for the soul of your servant; may it be, Lord, a saving remedy that in this place of divine service he has prepared obedience, and for us, your servants, a temporal support.

text: Adiuva nos Domine Deus noster omnium sanctorum tuorum precibus exoratus et animam famulae tuae N. in beatitudine sempiternae lucis constitue.
translation_en: Help us, Lord our God, with the prayers of all your saints invoked, and establish the soul of your servant N. in the beatitude of eternal light.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut anima famulae tuae N. his purgata sacrificiis indulgentiam pariter et requiem capiat sempiternam.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that the soul of your servant N. may be purified by these sacrifices and receive at the same time forgiveness and eternal rest.

text: Tibi Domine commendamus animam famulae tuae N. ut defuncta saeculo tibi vivat et quae per fragilitatem mundanae conversationis peccata admisit tu venia misericordissimae pietatis absterge.
translation_en: We commend to You, Lord, the soul of Your servant N. that she who is dead may live with You and that which through the frailty of worldly conversation she admitted sins, may You wipe away by Your most merciful pity.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices exoramus pro spiritibus famularum tuarum ut ab omnibus quae humanitus contraxerunt exutae peccatis in tuorum censeantur sorte iustorum.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, for the spirits of Your servants, that they, free from all sins they have contracted in a human way, may be counted among the fortunate ones by Your just lot.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostiam iubilationis pro commemoratione famularum tuarum ut te miserante eis ad refrigerium proveniat sempiternum.
translation_en: Receive most merciful Father, the offering of exultation in memory of your servants, that they finding mercy from you may reach everlasting refreshment.

text: Animabus quaesumus Domine famularum tuarum requiem sempiternam tribue benignus et sanctorum tuorum coetibus consociare eas dignare propitius.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant eternal rest to your servants. May your kindness bestow it upon them and may you graciously admit them into the company of your saints.

text: Deus aeterne in cuius humana condicio potestate consistit: animam famuli tui N. quaesumus ab omnibus absolve peccatis ut paenitentiae fructum quem voluntas eius optavit praeventus mortalitatis non perdat.
translation_en: Eternal God, in whose human condition power resides: we humbly ask that you forgive the soul of your servant N from all sins, so that the fruit of penitence which his will desired may not be lost because of mortality.

text: Satisfaciat tibi Domine quaesumus pro anima famuli tui N. sacrificii praesentis oblatio et peccatorum veniam quam quaesivit inveniat et quod officio linguae implere non potuit desideratae paenitentiae recompensatione percipiat.
translation_en: May this offering satisfy you, Lord, we entreat. For the soul of your servant N., may the oblation of the present sacrifice grant forgiveness for the sins he has sought, and may he receive the compensation desired for his penitence, which he was unable to fulfill in his duty and with his tongue.

text: Deus a quo inspiratur humano corpori omne quod bonum est: tribue per haec sancta quae sumpsimus ut sicut animae famuli tui N. paenitentiam velle donasti sic indulgentiam tribue miseratus optatam.
translation_en: God, from whom every good thing is breathed into the human body: grant through these holy things which we have received, that as your soul's servants you gave N. the desire for penitence, so may you also grant the desired mercy.

text: Deus cuius misericordiae non est numerus: suscipe propitius preces humilitatis nostrae et animabus quae nobis in orationem commendatae sunt et quarum usitamur eleemosynis aeternae quietis beatitudinem largiaris.
translation_en: God, whose mercy has no number: graciously receive our humble prayers and the souls committed to our prayer, and grant them the eternal peace of beatitude through your alms.

text: Prosit quaesumus Domine haec sancta praesentis sacrificii oblatio animabus quae nobis commendatae sunt in orationem ut per nomen sanctum tuum a perpetui ignis cruciatibus transitum in requiem mereantur aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this holy offering of the present sacrifice may be profitable for the souls commended to us in prayer, so that through your holy name they may merit a transition from the torments of eternal fire to rest eternal.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine ad indulgentiam animabus pro quibus tuam deprecamur clementiam divini celebratio sacramenti ut per haec sancta contagiis terrenae conversationis emundatae ad caelestem mereantur pervenire habitationem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that You may approach for the indulgence of the souls for whom we entreat Your mercifulness. May the divine celebration of the sacrament cleanse them through these holy rites from the contagions of earthly life, so that they may be worthy to reach the celestial dwelling place.

text: Deus qui in te credentibus vitam post mortem promittis et in tribulatione positis ad te clamantibus misericorditer subvenis: exaudi preces nostras quas tuae pietati pro anima famuli tui N. cuius anniversarium diem celebramus 〈***〉 ut ei quietis beatitudinem luminis claritatem largiri digneris.
translation_en: God who promises life after death to those who believe in you and who, in tribulation, call upon you with mercy: hear our prayers which we offer to your mercy for the soul of your servant N. whose anniversary we celebrate *** that you may deem fit to grant him the quiet beatitude of light.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris pro anima famuli tui N. cuius hodie annua dies agitur pro quo tibi offerimus hoc sacrificium laudis ut eum sanctorum tuorum consortio sociare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications for the soul of your servant N., whose annual day is celebrated today. For him we offer this sacrifice of praise, that you may deem fit to associate him with the fellowship of your saints.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras pro anima famuli tui N. cuius anniversarium diem celebramus ut maculae quae ei de terrenis contagiis adhaeserunt remissionis tuae misericordia deleantur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers for the soul of your servant N., whose anniversary we celebrate. May the stains that have attached to him from earthly contagions be washed away by your merciful forgiveness.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut anima famuli tui N. cuius anniversarium depositionis diem commemoramus his purgata sacrificiis indulgentiam pariter et requiem capiat sempiternam.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech Thee, Lord, that the soul of Thy servant N., whose anniversary of departure we commemorate, may be cleansed by these purifying sacrifices and receive both forgiveness and eternal rest.

text: Da Domine Deus effectum salutare precibus quae tibi pro defunctis nostris offeruntur ut ab omnibus quae per terrenam conversationem contraxerunt vitiis his sacrificiis emundentur.
translation_en: Grant, O Lord God, the saving effect of the prayers offered on behalf of our deceased, that they may be purified from all sins which they contracted during their earthly life through these sacrifices.

text: Oblationem quam tibi pro requie animarum fidelium tuorum Domine offerimus propitius intuere et concede ut mortuis prosit ad veniam quod vivis praeparasti ad medelam.
translation_en: The offering we make to you, Lord, for the repose of the souls of your faithful, look upon it kindly and grant that it may benefit the dead, who live through the preparation you have made for salvation, to bring them healing.

text: Sumentes Domine corporis et sanguinis Christi Filii tui remedia obsecramus maiestatis tuae clementiam ut viventibus sint ad tutelam et defunctis peccatorum impetrent veniam.
translation_en: Lord, we take the remedy of your Son Christ's body and blood. We humbly ask for the kindness of your majesty that the living may be protected and the dead may seek forgiveness for their sins.
