text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum N. misericordia sempiterna ut eas mortalibus nexibus expeditas lux aeterna possideat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate the souls of your servants and servants, N., with your eternal mercy, so that they may possess the eternal light free from the bonds of mortality.

text: Hostias tibi Domine humili placatione deferimus ut animae famulorum famularumque tuarum per haec piae placationis officia tuam misericordiam consequantur.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, these humble hostages of penitence, so that the souls and servants of your servants may obtain your mercy through this act of devout supplication.

text: Deus qui nobis patrem et matrem honorare praecepisti: miserere clementer animabus patris et matris meae eorumque peccata dimitte meque eos in aeternae claritatis gaudio fac videre.
translation_en: God who commanded us to honor our father and mother: have mercy kindly on the souls of my father and mother, and forgive their sins; and grant that I may see them in the joy of eternal light.

text: Suscipe Domine sacrificium quod tibi pro animabus patris et matris meae offertur eisque gaudium sempiternum in regione viventium concede meque felicitati sanctorum cum eis coniunge.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the sacrifice that is offered on behalf of the souls of my father and mother. Grant them eternal joy in the region of the living. And join me with the happiness of the saints among them.

text: Caelestis participatio sacramenti Domine animabus patris et matris meae requiem et lucem obtineat perpetuam meque tua gratia cum illis coronae coniungat aeternae.
translation_en: May the heavenly participation of the sacrament, Lord, grant eternal rest and light to the souls of my father and mother. May your grace unite me with them in the crown of eternity.

text: Deus veniae largitor et humanae salutis amator: quaesumus clementiam tuam ut nostrae congregationis fratres et sorores qui ex hoc saeculo transierunt beata Maria semper Virgine intercedente ad perpetuae beatitudinis consortium pervenire concedas.
translation_en: God, giver of grace and lover of the human salvation: we humbly ask for your clemency that you may grant to our congregation's brothers and sisters who have departed from this world, through the intercession of blessed Mary, ever Virgin, that they may arrive at the consortium of eternal beatitude.

text: Deus cuius misericordiae non est numerus: suscipe propitius preces humilitatis nostrae et animabus fratrum nostrorum et sororum quibus tui nominis dedisti confessionem intercedente beata Maria semper Virgine per haec sacramenta salutis nostrae cunctorum tribue remissionem peccatorum.
translation_en: God, whose mercy knows no number: receive favorably our humble prayers and the souls of our brothers and sisters for whom you have given confession through the intercession of Blessed Mary, the ever-Virgin. Grant us all remission of sins through these sacraments of our salvation.

text: Deus vita viventium spes morientium salus omnium in te sperantium: praesta propitius ut animae nostrae congregationis a nostrae mortalitatis tenebris absolutae beata Maria semper Virgine intercedente in perpetua cum sanctis tuis luce laetentur.
translation_en: God, life of the living, hope of the dying, salvation for all who hope in you: grant us graciously that the souls of our congregation, freed from the shadows of our mortality, may rejoice with blessed Mary, ever-Virgin, among your saints forever in eternal light.

text: Deus qui ad caeleste regnum non nisi renatis per aquam et Spiritum Sanctum pandis introitum: multiplica super animam famuli tui N. misericordiam tuam et cui donasti caelestem et incontaminatum transitum post baptismi sacramentum da ei aeternorum plenitudinem gaudiorum.
translation_en: God who opens the entrance to the heavenly kingdom only for those reborn through water and the Holy Spirit: multiply Your mercy upon the soul of Your servant N., and grant him the eternal fullness of joys after the sacrament of baptism.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris pro anima famuli tui N. pro qua tibi offerimus sacrificium laudis ut eam sanctorum tuorum consortio sociare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications for the soul of your servant N. For whom we offer you a sacrifice of praise, that you may deem worthy to associate her with the company of your saints.

text: Propitiare Domine animae famuli tui N. ut quem in fine istius vitae regenerationis fonte baptismatis mundasti ad caelestis regni beatitudinem facias pervenire.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on the soul of your servant N., that you who cleansed him at the end of this life in the font of regeneration through baptism, may bring him to the blessedness of the heavenly kingdom.

text: Deus in cuius miseratione animae fidelium requiescunt: famulis et famulabus tuis omnibus hic et ubique in Christo quiescentibus da propitius veniam peccatorum ut a cunctis reatibus absoluti sine fine laetentur.
translation_en: God, in whose mercy the souls of faithful people rest: grant propitious pardon to your servants and handmaids here and everywhere in Christ who are resting, so that they may be absolved from all offenses forever and rejoice without end.

text: Pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium hic et ubique in Christo quiescentium hostiam Domine suscipe benignus oblatam ut hoc sacrificio singulari vinculis horrendae mortis exutae vitam mereantur aeternam.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive the offering made on behalf of the souls of your servants and their servants, here and everywhere in Christ who are resting. May they merit eternal life with this unique sacrifice, being freed from the dreadful bonds of death.

text: VD ... aeterne Deus. Qui nobis in Christo Unigenito Filio tuo Domino nostro spem beatae resurrectionis concessisti: praesta quaesumus ut animae pro quibus hoc sacrificium redemptionis nostrae tuae offerimus maiestati ad beatae resurrectionis requiem te miserante cum sanctis tuis pervenire mereantur.
translation_en: We beseech you eternally, God, who granted us in Christ your only-begotten Son, our Lord, the hope of blessed resurrection: grant that those souls for whom we offer this sacrifice of our redemption to your majesty may deserve to attain the peace of the blessed resurrection through your mercy with your saints.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quaesumus Domine ut placatus intende quam pro animabus fidelium tuorum tuae supplices pietati offerimus ut per haec sancta mysteria ab omnibus absoluti peccatis aeternae beatitudinis participes efficiantur. Diesque nostros.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly ask You, Lord, that you consider this offering of ours. We present it on behalf of the souls of Your faithful ones to Your mercy. May they, through these sacred mysteries, be absolved from all sins and made worthy participants of eternal beatitude. Grant us these days.

text: Deus fidelium lumen animarum: adesto supplicationibus nostris et da omnibus fidelibus in Christo quorum corpora hic et ubique requiescunt refrigerii sedem quietis beatitudinem luminis claritatem.
translation_en: God, light of faithful souls: be present to our supplications and grant all faithful in Christ whose bodies here and everywhere repose, a seat of rest, a place of peace, the joy of blessedness, the light of clarity.

text: Suscipe Domine haec munera pro animabus omnium benefactorum nostrorum et 〈pro〉 beneficiis eorum quibus sustentamur da quaesumus eis retributionem in regno caelorum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, these gifts on behalf of the souls of all our benefactors, and for their benefits by which we are sustained. Grant us, we ask, that they receive recompense in the kingdom of heaven.

text: Sumpta sacramenta Domine nos absolvant a vinculis peccatorum et animabus omnium benefactorum nostrorum defunctorum consortia obtineant spirituum beatorum.
translation_en: Lord, may the sacred mysteries grant us absolution from the bonds of sin and may the souls of all our deceased benefactors enjoy the company of the blessed spirits.

text: Fidelium Deus omnium conditor et redemptor: animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium fidelium defunctorum remissionem cunctorum tribue peccatorum ut indulgentiam quam semper optaverunt piis supplicationibus consequantur.
translation_en: God, creator and redeemer of all: grant to the souls of your servants and handmaids, all the faithful departed, remission of all their sins; that they may obtain the indulgence which they have always desired with pious supplications.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine quas tibi pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum offerimus intende placatus et quibus fidei Christiani meritum contulisti dones aeternum et praemium.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, the offerings which for the souls of your servants and their servants we present to you, direct your favorable attention. Grant them, whom you have rewarded with the merits of the Christian faith, eternal rewards and a reward.

text: Animabus quaesumus Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum oratio proficiat supplicantium ut eas a peccatis omnibus exuas et tuae redemptionis facias esse participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for the souls of your servants and their servants, that their prayers may be profitable. May they be relieved from all sins and make them participants in your redemption.

text: Deus consolationis et pacis: respice quaesumus ad precem familiae tuae et concede ut animae famulorum famularumque tuarum qui baptizati et confessi in fide catholica perseveraverunt et de suis rebus ecclesias Dei ditaverunt et de quorum eleemosynis sumus consolati quique ab Adam usque in praesentem diem ex hac luce migraverunt mox ut a mortuis resuscitati fuerint in regione vivorum tibi placeant et in sinibus Abrahae Isaac et Iacob feliciter requiescant.
translation_en: God of consolation and peace: look favorably upon the prayer of your family, we ask, and grant that the souls of your servants and handmaids who have persevered in the Catholic faith since their baptism and confession, and have given offerings to the churches of God, and by whose alms we have been comforted, may please you when they are raised from the dead in the land of the living. May they rest happily in the bosom of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

text: Propitiare Domine animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum et per haec sancta mysteria remissionem eis cunctorum tribue peccatorum.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on the souls of your servants and servants' servants, and through these holy mysteries grant them forgiveness for all their sins.

text: Miserere Domine animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum qui singularem apud te non habent intercessorem et quibus non est consolatio in tormentis nec spes ulla nisi quod facti sunt ad tuam imaginem; parce Domine plasmati tuo et gloriam nominis tui ne des alteri opera manuum tuarum ne despicias sed porrige manum tuam et libera animas eorum et perduc eas ad societatem supernorum civium per temetipsum. Qui tecum.
translation_en: Have mercy, Lord, upon the souls of your servants and slaves who have no advocate with you apart from you, and to whom there is no consolation in torments nor any hope except that they were made according to your image; spare, Lord, your molded one, and let not the glory of your name be given to another, lest you despise them. Instead, extend your hand and free their souls, and lead them to the society of heavenly citizens through yourself. Who are with you.

text: Vir fortissimus Iudas collatione facta duodecim milia drachmas argenti misit Hierosolymam offerre ea ibi pro peccatis mortuorum iuste et religiose de resurrectione cogitans. Nisi enim eos qui ceciderant resurrecturos speraret superfluum videretur et vanum orare pro mortuis. Et quia considerabat quod hi qui cum pietate dormitionem acceperant optimam haberent repositam gratiam. Sancta ergo et salubris est cogitatio pro defunctis exorare ut a peccatis solvantur.
translation_en: The very brave Judas, made a collection of twelve thousand drachmas of silver and sent it to Jerusalem to be offered there for the sins of the dead. Thinking justly and religiously about the resurrection, he considered that if one hoped in vain for those who had fallen to rise again, it would seem superfluous and futile to pray for the dead. But since he thought that those who accepted death with piety would have a well-stored grace. Therefore, it is holy and beneficial to meditate on praying for the deceased so that they may be freed from their sins.

text: Nolumus vos ignorare de dormientibus ut non contristemini sicut et ceteri qui spem non habent. Si enim credimus quod Iesus mortuus est et resurrexit ita et Deus eos qui dormierunt per Iesum adducet cum eo. Hoc enim vobis dicimus in verbo Domini quia nos qui vivimus qui residui sumus in adventu Domini non praeveniemus eos qui dormierunt. Quoniam ipse Dominus in iussu et in voce archangeli et in tuba Dei descendet de caelo et mortui qui in Christo sunt resurgent primi. Deinde nos qui vivimus qui relinquimur simul rapiemur cum illis in nubibus obviam Christo in aëra et sic semper cum Domino erimus. Itaque consolamini invicem in verbis istis.
translation_en: We do not want you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning those who are asleep, that you may not sorrow as others who have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with Him those who sleep in Jesus. For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who remain until the coming of the Lord, shall not precede those who are asleep. For the Lord Himself shall descend from heaven with a command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God; and the dead in Christ shall rise first. Then we who are alive, who are left, shall be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air; and so ever we shall be with the Lord. Therefore comfort one another with these words.

text: Audivi vocem de caelo dicentem mihi: Scribe: beati mortui qui in Domino moriuntur. Amodo iam dicit Spiritus ut requiescant singuli a laboribus suis. Opera enim illorum sequuntur illos.
translation_en: I heard a voice from heaven saying to me: Write: blessed are the dead who die in the Lord. Now the Spirit says that each one should rest from their labors. For their works follow them.

text: Christus surrexit a mortuis primitiae dormientium. Quoniam enim per hominem mors et per hominem resurrectio mortuorum et sicut in Adam omnes moriuntur ita et in Christo omnes vivificabuntur unusquisque autem in suo ordine.
translation_en: Christ rose from the dead, first-fruits of those who have fallen asleep. For as all die in Adam, so all will be made alive in Christ. Each one in his own order.

text: Omne quod dat mihi Pater ad me veniet et eum qui venit ad me non eiciam foras quia descendi de caelo non ut faciam voluntatem meam sed voluntatem eius qui misit me. Haec est autem voluntas eius qui misit me Patris ut omne quod dedit mihi non perdam ex eo sed resuscitem illud in novissimo die. Haec est enim voluntas Patris mei qui misit me ut omnis qui videt Filium et credit in eum habeat vitam aeternam. Et ego resuscitabo eum in novissimo die.
translation_en: All that the Father gives to me will come to me, and him who comes to me I will not cast out; for I have descended from heaven, not to do my own will but the will of Him who sent Me. This is the will of Him who sent Me: that I should lose nothing that He has given Me, but raise it up at the last day. This is indeed the will of My Father who sent Me: that every one who sees the Son and believes in Him may have eternal life. And I will raise him up at the last day.

text: Ego sum panis vivus qui de caelo descendi. Si quis manducaverit ex hoc pane vivet in aeternum. Et panis quem ego dabo caro mea est pro mundi vita. Litigabant ergo Iudaei ad invicem dicentes: Quomodo potest hic nobis carnem suam dare ad manducandum? Dixit ergo eis Iesus: Amen amen dico vobis nisi manducaveritis carnem Filii hominis et biberitis eius sanguinem non habebitis vitam in vobis. Qui manducat meam carnem et bibit meum sanguinem habet vitam aeternam. Et ego resuscitabo eum in novissimo die.
translation_en: I am the living bread that has come down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. The bread that I will give is my flesh for the life of the world. So the Jews disputed among themselves, saying: How can this one give us his flesh to eat? Then Jesus said to them: Amen, amen, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in yourselves. Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life. And I will raise him up on the last day.

text: Dixit Martha ad Iesum: Domine si fuisses hic frater meus non fuisset mortuus. Sed et nunc scio quia quaecumque poposceris a Deo dabit tibi Deus. Dicit illi Iesus: Resurget frater tuus. Dicit ei Martha: Scio quia resurget in resurrectione in novissimo die. Dixit ei Iesus: Ego sum resurrectio et vita. Qui credit in me etiam si mortuus fuerit vivet. Et omnis qui vivit et credit in me non morietur in aeternum. Credis hoc? Ait illi: Utique Domine. Ego credidi quia tu es Christus Filius Dei vivi qui in hunc mundum venisti.
translation_en: Martha said to Jesus: Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died. But even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you. Jesus says to him: Your brother will rise again. Martha says to him: I know that he will rise in the resurrection on the last day. Jesus said to him: I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, even if he dies, he will live. And everyone who lives and believes in me will never die eternally. Do you believe this? He says to him: Indeed, Lord. I have believed that you are the Christ, Son of God, who came into this world.

text: Sicut enim Pater suscitat mortuos et vivificat sic et Filius quos vult vivificat. Neque enim Pater iudicat quemquam sed omne iudicium dedit Filio ut omnes honorificent Filium sicut honorificant Patrem. Qui non honorificat Filium non honorificat Patrem qui misit illum. Amen amen dico vobis quia qui verbum meum audit et credit ei qui misit me habet vitam aeternam. Et in iudicium non venit sed transiet a morte in vitam.
translation_en: For just as the Father raises the dead and makes them live, so too the Son makes alive those whom he wishes. Indeed, the Father does not judge anyone, but has given all judgment to the Son, so that all may honor the Son as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent him. Amen, amen I say to you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life. He does not come into judgment but has passed from death to life.

text: Dixit Iesus turbis Iudaeorum: Amen amen dico vobis quia venit hora et nunc est quando mortui audiunt vocem Filii Dei et qui audierint vivent. Sicut enim Pater habet vitam in semetipso sic dedit et Filio vitam habere in semetipso. Et potestatem dedit ei iudicium facere quia Filius hominis est. Nolite mirari hoc quia venit hora in qua omnes qui in monumentis sunt audient vocem eius. Et procedent qui bona fecerunt in resurrectionem vitae qui vero mala egerunt in resurrectionem iudicii.
translation_en: Jesus said to the multitude of the Jews: Amen, amen I say to you, the hour is coming and now is when the dead hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live. Just as the Father has life in himself, he gave also the Son to have life in himself. And he has given him the power to judge because the Son of Man is. Do not marvel at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in the tombs will hear his voice. And those who have done good will come forth to the resurrection of life, but those who have done evil will come forth to the resurrection of judgment.

text: Fidelium Deus omnium conditor et redemptor: animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium episcoporum abbatum presbyterorum clericorum canonicorum monachorum diaconorum subdiaconorum regum ducum principum pauperum divitum mediocrum seu parentum genitorumque nostrorum patris scilicet et matris necnon et eorum qui se in nostras commendaverunt orationes et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas sive omnium utriusque sexus fidelium defunctorum hic et ubique in Christo quiescentium cunctorum remissionem tribue peccatorum ut quorum quarumque commemorationem agimus indulgentiam quam semper optaverunt piis supplicationibus consequantur.
translation_en: God, the creator and redeemer of all faithful: to the souls of your servants, both men and women, bishops, abbots, priests, deacons, subdeacons, kings, dukes, princes, poor, rich, or those of mediocre means, and to our fathers, mothers, and those who have entrusted themselves to our prayers, we have received their prayers and alms. We ask that you grant them the remission of sins for all departed faithful in Christ, whether they be here or elsewhere. May all of them enjoy eternal rest and peace. May those whose memory we recall gain the indulgence which they always longed to attain through their pious petitions.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine quas tibi pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium hic et ubique in Christo quiescentium fidelium Christianorum offerimus propitiatus intende ut quibus fidei Christianae meritum contulisti dones aeternum et praemium.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, the offerings which for the souls of Your servants, both here and everywhere, in Christ resting faithful people and Christians, we present to You. May You, propitiated, direct them, so that those whom You have granted the merit of the Christian faith, may give them an eternal reward.

text: Animabus quaesumus Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium episcoporum abbatum presbyterorum clericorum canonicorum monachorum diaconorum subdiaconorum regum ducum principum divitum pauperum mediocrum genitorum seu parentum nostrorum necnon et eorum qui se in nostras commendaverunt orationes et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas sive omnium utriusque sexus fidelium defunctorum Christianorum hic et ubique in Christo quiescentium quorum vel quarum commemorationem agimus oratio proficiat supplicum ut eas et a peccatis omnibus exuas et tuae redemptionis facias esse participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for the souls of all your servants and handmaids: bishops, abbots, priests, deacons, subdeacons, kings, dukes, princes, rich and poor, parents or relatives of ours, as well as those who have commended themselves to our prayers and have given alms to us. May their prayers benefit us, and may the alms they have given be of help to us. We also pray for all the faithful departed Christians, here and everywhere in Christ, whose memory we hold dear. May this prayer bring prosperity to those who are suffering, and may you free them from all sins and make them partakers of your redemption.

text: Sit nomen Domini benedictum. 〈R.〉 Ex hoc nunc et usque in saeculum.
translation_en: May the Name of the Lord be blessed. [Response] From this moment and forevermore.

text: Deus in adiutorium meum intende. 〈R. Domine ad adiuvandum me festina.〉 Ter. Cum Gloria Patri.
translation_en: God come to my aid. (Response) Lord, hasten to help me. Thirdly, with glory to the Father.

text: Vivet anima mea 〈et laudabit te.〉. 〈R. Et iudicia tua adiuvabunt me.〉
translation_en: My soul shall live and praise you. (Response) And your judgments shall help me.

text: Erravi sicut ovis quae periit. 〈R. Quaere servum tuum quia mandata tua non sum oblitus.〉
translation_en: I have strayed like a sheep that is lost. (Response:) Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commandments.

text: Credo in Deum ... Carnis resurrectionem.
translation_en: I believe in God, in his only Son, and in the Holy Spirit, I confess one Baptism for the forgiveness of sins, and I look forward to the resurrection of the flesh.

text: Exorcizo te creatura salis per Deum vivum per Deum verum et per Deum sanctum per Deum qui te per Elisaeum prophetam in aquam mitti iussit ut sanaretur sterilitas aquae et efficiaris sal exorcizatum in salutem credentium et sis omnibus te sumentibus sanitas animae et corporis et effugiat atque discedat ab eo loco quo aspersus fueris omnis phantasia et nequitia vel versutia diabolicae fraudis omnisque spiritus immundus adiuratus. Per eum qui venturus.
translation_en: I exorcize you, creature of salt, in the name of the living God, in the name of the true God, in the name of the holy God, in the name of the God who commanded Elisha the prophet to cast you into the water to heal the barrenness of the waters and become purified salt. Exorcized salt, be for the sake of all those who consume you a health for soul and body, and let every evil thought, cunning devilish deceit, all unclean spirit summoned, depart from the place where you are sprinkled. Through him who is to come.

text: Immensam clementiam tuam omnipotens aeterne Deus humiliter imploramus ut hanc creaturam salis quam in usum generis humani tribuisti benedicere et sanctificare pro tua pietate digneris ut sit omnibus sumentibus salus mentis et corporis et quicquid ex eo tactum vel respersum fuerit careat omni immunditia omnique impugnatione spiritualis nequitiae. Per Dominum.
translation_en: With humble supplication, we implore your immense clemency, O eternal God, Almighty, that you may bless and sanctify this creature of salt which you have given for the use of the human race. We ask that by your mercy it be a salvation for both mind and body. May whatever is touched or sprinkled with it be free from all impurity and any spiritual attack of wickedness. Through the Lord.

text: Exorcizo te creatura aquae in nomine Dei Patris omnipotentis et in nomine Iesu Christi Filii eius Domini nostri et in virtute Spiritus Sancti ut fias aqua exorcizata ad effugandam omnem potestatem inimici et ipsum inimicum eradicare et explantare digneris cum angelis suis apostaticis. Qui venturus est.
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of water, in the name of God the Almighty Father, and in the name of Jesus Christ, His Son our Lord, and by the power of the Holy Spirit, so that you become exorcised water to drive away every power of the enemy and root out, uproot, and dispel him along with his apostate angels. He who is coming.

text: Deus qui ad salutem humani generis maxima quaeque sacramenta in aquarum substantia condidisti: adesto propitius invocationibus nostris et elemento huic multimodis purificationibus praeparato virtutem tuae benedictionis infunde ut creatura mysterii tui serviens ad abiciendos daemones morbosque pellendos divinae gratiae sumat effectum ut quicquid in domibus vel in locis fidelium haec unda resperserit careat omni immunditia liberetur a noxa. Non illic resideat spiritus pestilens non aura corrumpens. Discedant omnes inimici insidiae latentis et si quid est quod aut incolumitati habitantium invidet aut quieti aspersione huius aquae effugiat ut salubritas per invocationem tui nominis expetita ab omnibus sit impugnationibus defensa. Per Dominum.
translation_en: God who in the substance of water established the greatest and every sacred means for the salvation of the human race: be present propitiously to our invocations, and with this element prepared for multimodal purifications, infuse your power of blessing, so that the creature serving your mystery may take effect from casting out demons and diseases by divine grace. Whatever this wave sprinkles in the houses or places of the faithful may be free from all uncleanness and released from harm. May no pestilential spirit remain there nor corrupt air. Let all enemies of hidden insidiousness depart, and whatever harms the health or peace of the inhabiting ones or flees from the sprinkling of this water may be defeated by your name invoked by all. Through the Lord.

text: Fiat haec commixtio salis et aquae pariter per virtutem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et individuae Trinitatis et per signum sanctae crucis salutifera efficiatur. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Let this mixture of salt and water be effected equally through the power of our Lord Jesus Christ and the undivided Trinity, and let it become a salutary sign through the holy cross. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Vox Domini super aquas. 〈R.〉 Deus maiestatis intonuit.
translation_en: The voice of the Lord is over the waters. (Response) God, in majesty, has thundered.

text: Benedictio Dei omnipotentis: Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti descendat et maneat super hanc aquam.
translation_en: The blessing of the Almighty God, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, may descend and remain upon this water.

text: Miserere mei Deus. Gloria Patri.
translation_en: Have mercy on me, God. Glory to the Father.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine nobis per huius aquae aspersionem sanitatem mentis integritatem corporis tutelam salutis securitatem spei corroborationem fidei fructum caritatis hic et in aeterna saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, through the sprinkling of this water health of mind, integrity of body, protection of safety, security of salvation, strengthening of hope, firmness of faith, fruit of charity, here and in eternal ages upon ages.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus et mittere dignare sanctum angelum tuum de caelis qui custodiat foveat protegat visitet et defendat omnes habitantes in hoc habitaculo. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Hear nos, Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeternus Deus, et mittere dignare sanctum angelum tuum de caelis qui custodiat, foveat, protegat, visitet, et defendat omnes habitantes in hoc habitaculo. Per Dominum nostrum.

text: Quoniam apud te est fons vitae. 〈R.〉 Et in lumine tuo 〈videbimus lumen.〉.
translation_en: Since with you is the source of life. [Response:] And in your light we will see light.

text: Pax huic domui. 〈R.〉 Pax intrantibus et ministrantibus in ea.
translation_en: Peace to this house. [Response] Peace to those entering and serving within it.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui sacerdotum ministerio ad tibi serviendum et supplicandum uti digneris: quaesumus immensam clementiam tuam ut quicquid modo visitamus visites quicquid benedicimus benedicas sitque ad nostrae humilitatis introitum sanctorum tuorum meritis fuga daemonum angelicae pacis ingressus. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who deign to serve and supplicate before you through the ministry of priests: we humbly ask that your boundless mercy visits whatever we visit and blesses whatever we bless. May it be for the entrance of our humility through the merits of your saints, that demons flee and the angelic peace enters. Through our Lord.

text: Miserere mei Deus secundum magnam misericordiam tuam. Requiem aeternam dona eis Domine.
translation_en: Have mercy on me, God, according to your great mercy. Grant them eternal rest, Lord.

text: Benedicere digneris omnipotens Deus piissime consolator vivorum simul et mortuorum in te credentium huius terrae locellum tibi Domino Deo dicatum ut sit coemeterium hoc est dulcis quies et dormitio corporum Christianorum inibi quiescentium et animae fidelium quorum corpora hic sepulta et sepelienda sunt resurrectura quandoque spiritualia in aeterna beatitudine partem et societatem cum sanctis et electis habere mereantur. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: You, the all-powerful God, most merciful Comforter of both living and dead, grant that this piece of land on earth, dedicated to you, Lord God, may be a cemetery – that is, a sweet rest and sleep for the bodies of the Christian faithful resting there, and the souls of those whose bodies are buried or will be buried here, who may merit to receive a part and fellowship with the saints and elect in spiritual resurrection to eternal beatitude. Through our Lord.

text: Pax huic domui. 〈R.〉 Pax intrantibus et habitantibus in ea.
translation_en: Peace to this household. [Response] Peace to those entering and dwelling within it.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus: quaesumus immensam clementiam tuam ut ad introitum humilitatis nostrae in tuo nomine hunc famulum tuum in hoc habitaculo fessum iacentem salutifere visitare digneris et sicut visitasti Domine Tobiam et Saram socrum Petri puerumque centurionis ita et iste pristina sanitate animae corporisque recepta gratiarum tibi in Ecclesia tua referat actionem. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, we humbly ask that your immense mercy visits this, your servant, lying weak in this dwelling at the entrance of our humility in Your name. Just as You visited Tobias, Sarah, the mother-in-law of Peter, and the child centurion, let him also be restored to original health in soul and body, and may he give thanks to You in Your Church for this act. Through the Lord.

text: Pax huic domui. 〈R.〉 Pax intrantibus et paenitentibus in ea.
translation_en: Peace be to this house. [Response] Peace to those entering and repenting within it.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per coaequalem et coaeternam tibi sapientiam perditum hominem ad regna caelestia revocasti: super hanc domum quaesumus copiam tuae benedictionis effunde et meditantes in ea pietatis tuae dono sanctifica ut repleti spiritu humilitatis et de peccatis suis satisfactionis munere careant et sacrae lectionis in ea capiant intellectum. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who by Your coequal and coeternal wisdom called the lost man back to the celestial kingdoms: we ask that You pour out Your blessing upon this house and may those dwelling in it be sanctified with the gift of Your piety, filled with the spirit of humility and free from the burden of their sins. May they comprehend the sacred reading within it. Through the Lord.

text: Pax huic domui. 〈R.〉 Pax intrantibus et dormientibus in ea.
translation_en: Peace be to this house. [Response] Peace to those entering and sleeping within it.

text: Benedic Domine quaesumus hoc famulorum tuorum dormitorium qui non dormis neque dormitas qui custodis Israël; famulos tuos in hac domo quiescentes post laborem custodi ab illusionibus phantasmaticis Satanae ut vigilantes in praeceptis tuis meditentur dormientes 〈te〉 per soporem sentiant hic et ubique defensionis tuae auxilio muniantur. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, we ask you this bedroom of your servants, who neither sleep nor slumber; who guard Israel. May your servants in this house rest peacefully after labor, being kept from the illusions of Satan, so that they may meditate on your commandments while sleeping through sleep. May they here and everywhere be fortified with your aid by their sense of your protection. Through the Lord.

text: Pax huic domui. 〈R.〉 Pax intrantibus et manducantibus et bibentibus in ea.
translation_en: Peace to this house. [Response] Peace to those entering, eating and drinking here.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui famulos tuos in hac domo alis refectione carnali: 〈praesta ut〉 cibum vel potum te benedicente cum gratiarum actione percipiant hic et in aeternum per te semper salvi esse mereantur. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who feeds your servants in this house with corporeal refreshment: grant that they may receive food or drink, blessed by you, with an act of gratitude here and forever through you, so that they may always deserve to be saved. Through the Lord.

text: Pax huic domui. 〈R.〉 Pax intrantibus et pax dormientibus et manentibus in ea.
translation_en: Peace to this house. [Response] Peace to those entering, and peace to those sleeping, and peace to those staying within it.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus cuius sapientia hominem docuit ut domus haec careret aliquando frigore a vicinitate ignis: te quaesumus ut omnes habitantes vel convenientes in ea careant in corde infidelitatis frigore a fervore et igne Spiritus Sancti. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, whose wisdom once taught man that this house should be without cold due to the proximity of fire: we beseech you that all who live or come into it may lack the frost of unfaithfulness in their hearts, but rather be warmed by the fervor and fire of the Holy Spirit. Through the Lord.

text: Pax huic domui. 〈R.〉 Pax intrantibus et coquentibus in ea.
translation_en: Peace be to this house. [Response] Peace to those entering and cooking within it.

text: Deus ante cuius conspectum assistunt angeli et cuius nutu teguntur universa qui etiam necessariis humanae fragilitatis tua pietate consulere non desinis: te suppliciter imploramus ut habitaculum istius officinae illa benedictione perfundas qua per manus Elisaei prophetae in olla eremitica gustus amarissimos dulcorasti ut semper hic tuae benedictionis copia redundante laudes tibi referant servi tui qui das escam omni carni et reples omne animal benedictione. Per Dominum.
translation_en: God before whose presence angels stand and whom with a nod covers all, who even without ceasing consult for the necessities of human frailty through your pity: we humbly beseech you to pour this office's dwelling place with that blessing by which, through the hands of the prophet Elijah, the bitter taste in the hermit's pot was sweetened, so that here your blessings always overflowing may cause your servants to refer lauds to you who give food to every flesh and fill every creature with blessing. Through the Lord.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui ubique praesens es: maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecamur ut huic promptuario gratia tua adesse dignetur qui cuncta adversa ab eo repellat et abundantiam benedictionis tuae in eum largiter infundat. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God who are present everywhere: we humbly beseech your majesty that it may be fitting for your grace to be present in this storehouse, driving away all adversity from him and abundantly pouring out your blessing upon him. Through our Lord.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui benedixisti horrea Ioseph aream Gedeonis et adhuc quod maius est iactata terrae semina surgere facis cum faenore messis: te humiliter quaesumus ut sicut ad petitionem famuli tui non defuit viduae farina ita ad nostrae pravitatis suffragia huic horreo famulorum tuorum non desit benedictionis tuae abundantia. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who blessed the granaries of Joseph, the field of Gideon's, and even more so caused the earth to bring forth grain when it is sown with wheat; we humbly ask you that just as you did not fail to provide flour for your servant's plea, so too may there be no lack of your blessings on this granary of your servants. Through the Lord.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui necessitatem generis humani clementer praevidens adminicula temporalia contulisti: te humiliter imploramus ut benedicere digneris hoc lardarium famulorum tuorum ut quod hic tua misericordia pie contulit nostro merito non depereat. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who, foreseeing with clemency the necessity of the human race, have bestowed temporal aid: we humbly entreat you to deign to bless this altar so that what here your mercy has graciously provided for our merit may not perish. Through our Lord.

text: Introibo in domum tuam Domine. 〈R.〉 Et adorabo ad templum sanctum.
translation_en: I will enter Your house, Lord. (Response) And I will worship at Your holy temple.

text: Domine Iesu Christe qui introitum portarum Ierusalem valvasque sanctificasti dum splendore gemmarum duodecim totidem apostolorum nomina praesignasti et qui per organum propheticum promisisti: Lauda Ierusalem Dominum lauda Deum tuum Sion quoniam confortavit seras portarum tuarum benedixit filiis tuis in te: te quaesumus ut ponas in omnes fines domus istius pacem ut velociter currens interius sermo tuus adipe frumenti satiet eos; Spiritus Sanctus defendat illos ut numquam eis nocere praevaleat inimicus sed omnes habitantes vel convenientes in ea interius corde voce et ore decantent dicentes: Magnus Dominus noster et magna virtus eius et sapientiae eius non est numerus. Qui vivis et regnas cum Patre in unitate eiusdem Spiritus Sancti Deus per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, who opened the gates of Jerusalem and sanctified the doorways while shining with the splendor of twelve gem-like apostles' names, and who through the prophetic organ promised: "Praise Jerusalem, praise the Lord, praise your God, Zion, for He has strengthened the gates of your house, blessed your sons within you." We ask that You place peace in all the corners of this house so that Your word, running swiftly like oil, may fill them. May the Holy Spirit protect them so that the enemy never overpowers them within, but all who dwell or come together in it may sing in their heart, voice, and mouth, saying: "Our Lord is great, and His might is immense, and His wisdom is beyond counting." You who live and reign with the Father, in the unity of the same Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

text: Iniquitates nostras aufer a nobis.
translation_en: Take away our iniquities from us.

text: Benedicamus Patri et Filio cum Sancto Spiritu. 〈R.〉 Laudemus et superexaltemus eum in saecula.
translation_en: Let us bless the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit. (Response.) Let us praise and highly exalt Him forever.

text: Verbo Domini caeli firmati sunt. 〈R. Et spiritu oris eius omnis virtus eorum.〉
translation_en: The heavens were established by the word of the Lord, and all his might through the breath of his mouth.

text: Post partum virgo inviolata permansisti. 〈R. Dei Genitrix intercede pro nobis.〉
translation_en: After childbirth, the Virgin remained undefiled. [Response] Pray for us, Mother of God.

text: Fuit homo missus a Deo. 〈R. Cui nomet etat Ioannes.〉
translation_en: A man was sent by God. [Response:] Whose name was John.

text: Via sanctorum omnium Domine Iesu Christe qui ad te venientibus claritatis aeternae gaudia contulisti: aditum templi istius Spiritus Sancti luce perfunde qui locum istum in honore sanctae Mariae sanctique Ioannis Baptistae consecrasti; praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut omnes istic in te credentes obtineant veniam pro delictis ab omnibus liberentur angustiis impetrent quicquid petierint pro necessitatibus suis placere semper praevaleant coram oculis tuis quatenus per te et per intercessionem sanctae Mariae sanctique Ioannis Baptistae necnon et omnium sanctorum muniti mereantur aulam paradisi introire. Salvator mundi qui cum Patre in unitate eiusdem Spiritus Sancti vivis et regnas Deus per omnia saeculorum.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, who have bestowed upon all the saints the eternal joys of brightness as they come to you: fill with the light of the Holy Spirit the entrance to this temple which you have consecrated in honor of Saint Mary and Saint John the Baptist; we ask you, almighty God, that those who believe in you within this place may obtain forgiveness for their sins and be freed from all anxieties. May whatever they request for their needs always prevail before your eyes, so that through you, and through the intercession of Saint Mary, Saint John the Baptist, as well as all the saints, they may be worthy to enter the paradise's court. Savior of the world, who live and reign with the Father in the unity of the same Holy Spirit forever throughout the ages.

text: Salvum fac servum tuum. 〈R. Deus meus sperantem in te.〉
translation_en: Save your servant. (Response) My God, those hoping in you.

text: Mitte ei Domine auxilium 〈de sancto〉. 〈R. Et de Sion tuere eum.〉
translation_en: Send him, O Lord, aid from the saint. (Response) And from Zion protect him.

text: Dominus custodiat te ab omni malo. 〈R. Custodiat animam tuam Dominus.〉
translation_en: The Lord keep you from all evil. (Response) May the Lord keep your soul.

text: Dominus custodiat introitum tuum et exitum tuum et auferat a te spiritum elationis et ignorantiae ut repletus spiritu humilitatis et scientiae intellectum capias sacrae lectionis.
translation_en: The Lord watch over your coming in and going out, and remove from you the spirit of arrogance and ignorance. May you be filled with a spirit of humility and understanding, so that you may grasp the sacred reading.

text: Benedictus es Domine Deus qui adiuvisti me et consolatus es me. Ter.
translation_en: Blessed are you, Lord God, who have helped me and comforted me. Amen.

text: Convertere Domine usquequo. 〈R. Et deprecabilis esto super servos tuos.〉
translation_en:
Turn, O Lord, when will you turn?
[Response:] And be merciful to your servants.

text: Deus cui semper humilium accepta sunt vota animarum: respice propitius super horum servorum tuorum fratrum nostrorum (huius servi tui fratris nostri) obsequia et ad tuam eos (eum) fac pertingere gratiam ut qui hebdomadae servitium devota mente compleverunt (compleverit) plenissimam atque largissimam veniam consequantur. Salvator mundi qui vivis.
translation_en: God to whom the prayers of the humble have always been accepted: look upon them graciously concerning the service of your servants, our brothers (this servant of yours, our brother). May they (he) reach grace so that those who have completed the devoted service of a week with a full and bountiful penance shall follow. Savior of the world, you who live.

text: Salvos fac servos tuos. 〈R. Deus meus sperantes in te.〉
translation_en: Save your servants. (Response) My God, those who hope in you.

text: Misericors ac piissime Deus qui ubique famulos tuos tueris et adiuvas: huius servi tui fratris nostri (horum servorum tuorum fratrum nostrorum) in bonum accumula votum auge desiderium ut recta fratribus suis impendant servitia. Salvator mundi.
translation_en: Merciful and most pitiful God, who everywhere protects and helps your servants: collect the prayer of this your servant, our brother (these servants of yours, our brothers), for good; increase his desire that he may faithfully render service to his brethren. Savior of the world.

text: Signum salutis Domine Iesu Christe pone in loco isto et non permittas introire angelum percutientem.
translation_en: Place a sign of salvation, Lord Jesus Christ, at this place and do not allow an angel causing harm to enter here.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus fundator omnium creaturarum: benedicere dignare hos lapides sive haec ligna septiformis gratiae tuo dono ad templum construendum nomini tuo ut omnis plebs ad illud conveniens conferat 〈laudes〉 nomini sancto tuo. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God, creator of all creatures: deign to bless these seven-fold stones or wood with your grace, so that they may be used for building a temple in your name, and that all people may come together there, giving praise to your holy name. Through our Lord.

text: Domine Iesu Christe ne despicias desiderium nostrum sed in honore sanctae Genitricis tuae et martyrum confessorumque tuorum * praepara in hoc loco habitationem tuis aptam servitiis.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, do not scorn our desire, but prepare for us in this place a fitting dwelling suitable for Your service, in honor of Your holy Mother and the martyrs, Your confessors.

text: Qui de Virgine nasci pro salute humani generis et mortem subire dignatus es. Praepara.
translation_en: Who, born of the Virgin, deigned to be born for the salvation of the human race and to suffer death. Prepare.

text: Ab oriente portae et tres ab occidente portae et tres a meridiano portae et tres ab aquilone portae et tres.
translation_en: From the eastern gates, and three from the western gates, and three from the southern gates, and three from the northern gates.

text: Esto nobis Domine turris fortitudinis. 〈R. A facie inimici.〉
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, a tower of strength. [Response] Against the face of the enemy.

text: Fiat pax in virtute tua. 〈R. Et abundantia in turribus tuis.〉
translation_en: Let there be peace in your power. [Response] And abundance in your towers.

text: Deus tu conversus vivificabis nos. 〈R. Et plebs tua laetabitur in te.〉
translation_en: God, as you turn towards us, you will revive us. (Response) And your people will rejoice in you.

text: Pretiosa est in conspectu Domini 〈R. Mors sanctorum eius.〉
translation_en: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints (Response: Mourn for the righteous dead.).

text: Domine Deus qui licet caelo et terra non capiaris domum tamen tibi in terra fieri iussisti in qua nomen tuum iugiter invocetur: hunc locum quaesumus beatae Mariae semper Virginis omniumque sanctorum tuorum intercedentibus meritis sereno tuae pietatis intuitu visita et vide et illum ad fabricandum elige per infusionem gratiae caelestis ab omni inquinamento purifica purificatumque conserva ut qui dilecti tui David devotionem in filii sui Salomonis opere complesti tui famuli N. in opere hoc ita precamur vota perfice ut illud te inspirante incipiat te adiuvante perficiat suique laboris praemium in terra consequatur viventium. Effugiant igitur hinc te iubente Domine omnes nequitiae spirituales et cum fraudibus suis cuncta diaboli turma tua virtute depulsa. Resurgat hic tuae Ecclesiae pura simplicitas et amabilis tibi innocentiae candor sicque hunc locum per Unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri dilectionem coaeterni tibi Spiritus Paracliti rore fecunda gratissimo ut quicumque hic pro suis necessitatibus auribus tuae benignitatis ingerit vota votorum suorum consequatur effectu. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en:
Lord God, who can be contained neither in heaven nor on earth, you have nonetheless commanded a dwelling place to be made for you where your name is continually invoked: we humbly ask that this place be visited and chosen by you through the infusion of celestial grace. Purify and consecrate it from all impurity, and preserve the purified for you.
Those who are dear to you, David and his son Solomon, completed their devotion in building this house; we pray that the vows made by your servant N. in this work may be fulfilled as you inspire and help him complete it. May he receive the reward of his labor on earth among the living.
By your command, Lord, let all spiritual wickedness flee from here, and let your power drive away every scheme of the devil's army. Let the purity of this Church rise again, and may the innocent candor that pleases you shine here as well.
May this place be filled with the love of your only-begotten Son, our Lord, and with the dew of the eternal Spirit of Paraclete. May whoever here presents his vows to your benevolence for his own needs achieve their effect.
Through our Lord.

text: Benedictio Dei omnipotentis: Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti descendat et maneat in hoc loco. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Blessing of the Almighty God, Father and Son and Holy Spirit, may descend and remain in this place. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Deus vitae dator et humanorum corporum reparator qui te a peccatoribus exorari voluisti: exaudi preces quas speciali devotione pro anima famuli tui (famulae tuae) tibi lacrimabiliter fundimus ut liberare eum (eam) ab infernorum cruciatibus et collocare inter agmina sanctorum tuorum digneris; veste quoque caelesti et stola immortalitatis indui et paradisi amoenitate confoveri iubeas.
translation_en: God, the giver of life and healer of human bodies, who willed to be invoked from sinners: hear the prayers that we pour out with special devotion for the soul of your servant (your female servant) with tears, so that you may deem it worthy to free him (her) from the torments of hell and place him (her) among the ranks of your saints; clothe him (her) also in celestial robe and garment of immortality, and command that he (she) be sustained by the beauty of paradise.

text: Deus qui humanarum animarum aeternus amator es: animam famuli tui (famulae tuae) quam vera dum in corpore maneret tenuit fides ab omni cruciatu infernorum redde extorrem ut segregata ab infernalibus claustris sanctorum tuorum mereatur adunari consortiis.
translation_en: God, who is the eternal lover of human souls: return the soul of your servant (your female servant) which true faith held in the body, free from all torment of the underworld. May she be separated from the prison of the infernal realms and worthy to join the consortiums of your saints.

text: Subvenite sancti Dei occurrite angeli Domini suscipientes animam eius * offerentes eam in conspectu Altissimi.
translation_en: Come to his aid, holy saints; appear, angels of the Lord, receiving his soul and offering it before the Most High.

text: Suscipiat eam Christus qui vocavit 〈te〉 et in sinum Abrahae angeli deducant. Offerentes.
translation_en: May Christ, who called her (the soul), take her into his arms, and the angels lead her to the bosom of Abraham. Offering.

text: Libera me Domine
translation_en: Free me, Lord

text: Dies illa dies irae
translation_en: That day will be a day of wrath

text: Deus veniae largitor et humanae salutis amator: quaesumus clementiam tuam ut nostrae congregationis fratrem qui ex hoc saeculo transiit beata Maria semper Virgine intercedente cum omnibus sanctis tuis ad perpetuae beatitudinis consortium pervenire concedas.
translation_en: God, bestower of mercy and lover of human salvation: we beseech your clemency that our brother who has passed from this world may, through the intercession of the Blessed Mary, ever Virgin, attain to the company of eternal beatitude with all your saints.

text: Heu mihi Domine quia peccavi nimis in vita mea; quid faciam miser ubi fugiam nisi ad te Deus meus; miserere mei * dum veneris in novissimo die.
translation_en: Alas, Lord, I have sinned greatly in my life; what shall I do, wretched man that I am, except flee to you, my God? Have mercy on me while you come on the last day.

text: Anima mea turbata est valde sed tu Domine succurre ei. Dum veneris.
translation_en: My soul is greatly troubled, but O Lord, help it. While you come.

text: [psalmi in tribus vigiliis]
translation_en: Psalms during the three vigils

text: Non intres in iudicium cum servo tuo Domine quoniam nullus apud te iustificabitur homo nisi per te omnium peccatorum tribuatur remissio; non ergo eum (eam) tua quaesumus Domine iudicialis sententia premat quem tibi vera supplicatio fidei Christianae commendat sed gratia tua illi succurrente mereatur evadere iudicium ultionis qui dum viveret insignitus (insignita) est signaculo Trinitatis. In qua vivis et regnas Deus per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Thou shalt not judge thy servant, Lord, for no man shall be justified before thee except through thee; therefore, we humbly ask thee, Lord, that thy judicial sentence not press upon him (her) whom faithful devotion of the Christian faith commends to thee. But let thy grace assist him (her), that he (she) may deserve to escape the judgment of condemnation, who during his (her) life was marked (marked) with the sign of the Trinity. In which thou livest and reignest, God, for ever and ever.

text: Fac quaesumus Domine hanc cum servo tuo defuncto (serva tua defuncta) misericordiam ut factorum suorum in poenis non recipiat vicem qui tuam in votis tenuit voluntatem et sicut hic eum (eam) vera fides iunxit fidelium turmis ita eum (eam) illic tua miseratio societ angelicis choris.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, mercy upon your servant who has died (your female servant who has died), that he/she who kept your will in vows may not receive the reward of their deeds in punishment, but just as here true faith united him/her with the ranks of the faithful, so may your mercy admit him/her to the company of angelic choirs.

text: Peccantem me cottidie et non me paenitentem timor mortis conturbat me * quia in inferno nulla est redemptio; miserere mei Deus et salva me.
translation_en: My daily sins disturb me with the fear of death, for there is no redemption in hell; have mercy on me, God, and save me.

text: Deus in nomine tuo salum me fac et in virtute tua libera me. Quia.
translation_en: God, in Your name save me, and in Your might set me free. For this reason.

text: Inclina Domine quaesumus aurem tuam ad preces nostras quibus misericordiam tuam supplices deprecamur ut animam famuli tui (famulae tuae) quam de huius saeculi ergastulo migrare iussisti in pacis ac lucis regione constituas et sanctorum tuorum iubeas esse consortem.
translation_en: Bend down, Lord, we humbly ask, your ear to our prayers, with which we suppliantly beseech your mercy. May the soul of your servant (servant) whom you have commanded to depart from this world's prison in the region of peace and light, may you establish it, and command it to be among the saints of yours.

text: Memento mei Deus quia ventus est vita mea nec aspiciat me visus hominis.
translation_en: Remember me, God, for I am life's breath; let not the sight of man turn away from me.

text: Et non revertetur oculus meus ut videat bona. Nec aspiciat.
translation_en: And my eye shall not behold good things. Nor shall it look upon them.

text: In paradisum deducant te angeli in tuo adventu suscipiant te martyres et perducant te in civitatem sanctam Ierusalem.
translation_en:
May angels lead you to Paradise;
at your coming, may the martyrs receive you, and lead you into the holy city of Jerusalem.

text: Aperite illi portas iustitiae et ingressus in eas confitebor Domino; haec porta Domini iusti intrabunt per eam.
translation_en: Open for him the gates of justice, and I will enter them confessing to the Lord; these are the gates of the righteous through which they shall enter.

text: Deus qui fundasti terram formasti caelos qui omnia sidera statuta fixisti qui captivum hominem laqueo mortis alluvione reparasti qui sepultos Abraham Isaac et Iacob in spelunca duplici libro vitae scripsisti atque totius Ecclesiae principes adnotasti benedicendos: benedicere digneris hunc tumulum famuli tui (famulae tuae) N. ut hic eum (eam) requiescere facias et in sinu Abrahae collocare digneris; qui Dominum nostrum ab inferis resuscitasti ad salutem credentium in se; respice quaesumus super hanc fabricam sepulcri et descendat virtus gratiae tuae in ea ut te iubente sit ei in hoc loco quieta dormitio et tempore iudicii cum sanctis omnibus vera resurrectio. Per eundem.
translation_en: God, who founded the earth, formed the heavens, who set the stars in their places, who restored the captive man with the snare of death and flood, who wrote Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the double cave of life, and marked the leaders of the whole Church to be blessed: deign to bless this tomb of your servant (servant) N., so that he may rest here and be placed in the bosom of Abraham; you who raised our Lord from the dead for the salvation of those who believe in him. Look upon this building of the sepulcher, we implore, and let your grace descend into it, so that by your command it is a peaceful sleep for him in this place, and during the time of judgment a true resurrection with all the saints. Through the same.

text: Ingrediar in locum tabernaculi admirabilis usque ad domum Dei.
translation_en: They shall enter into the place of the marvelous tabernacle, even up to the house of God.

text: Quemadmodum
translation_en: The translation of "Quemadmodum" from Medieval Latin to English is "just as."

text: Obsecramus misericordiam tuam omnipotens Deus qui hominem ad imaginem tuam creare dignatus es ut animam famuli tui (famulae tuae) quam hodie rebus humanis eximi et ad te accersiri iussisti blande et misericorditer suscipias; non ei dominentur umbrae mortis nec tegat eum (eam) chaos et caligo tenebrarum sed exutus omnium criminum labe in sinum Abrahae patriarchae collocatus (collocata) locum lucis et refrigerii se adeptum esse gaudeat ut cum magni iudicii dies advenerit cum sanctis et electis tuis eum (eam) resuscitari praecipias.
translation_en: We beseech Your mercy, almighty God, who deemed it worthy to create man in Your image, that You have commanded the soul of Your servant (Your maidservant) whom today You have ordered to be removed from human affairs and called to You tenderly and mercifully receive; may he not be subjected to the shadows of death nor covered by chaos and the gloom of darkness, but having been freed from all sin's stain placed in the bosom of Abraham the patriarch, let him rejoice that he has obtained a place of light and refreshment. May it be his joy that when the day of great judgment arrives with Your saints and elect, You will command him (her) to be raised.

text: Haec requies mea in saeculum saeculi hic habitabo quoniam elegi eam.
translation_en: This shall be my rest for the ages, for all eternity; here I shall dwell, since I have chosen it.

text: Deus apud quem mortuorum spiritus vivunt et in quo electorum animae deposito carnis onere plena felicitate laetantur: praesta supplicantibus nobis ut anima famuli tui (famulae tuae) quae temporali per corpus visionis huius luminis caruit visu aeternae illius lucis solatio potiatur; non eum (eam) tormentum mortis attingat non dolor horrendae visionis afficiat non poenalis timor excruciet non reorum proxima catena constringat sed concessa sibi delictorum omnium venia optatae quietis consequatur gaudia repromissa. Per eum qui venturus est.
translation_en: God in whom the spirits of the dead live, and where the souls of the chosen rejoice with full happiness, having laid aside the burden of the flesh: grant to our suppliants that the soul of your servant (your female servant), who was deprived of the sight of temporal life through this vision's light, may find solace in the eternal light of that sight; let him (her) not be touched by the torment of death, nor be afflicted by the dreadful vision, nor be crucified by fear of punishment, nor be constricted by the immediate chain of guilt, but may achieve the grace desired from all sins, and enjoy the promised joys. Through Him who is to come.

text: [sermo]
translation_en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. This Word was in the beginning with God. All things were made through him, and without him was not any thing made that was made.

text: De terra plasmasti me et in carne induisti me Redemptor meus Domine resuscita me in novissimo die.
translation_en: From the earth you formed me, and in flesh you clothed me, Redeemer of mine, Lord, revive me on the last day.

text: Oremus fratres carissimi pro spiritu cari nostri (carae nostrae) quem (quam) Dominus de laqueo huius saeculi vocare dignatus est cuius corpusculum hodie sepulturae traditur ut eum (eam) pietas Domini immensa in sinum Abrahae Isaac et Iacob collocare dignetur ut cum dies iudicii advenerit inter sanctos et electos suos eum (eam) in parte dextera collocandum (collocandam) resuscitari faciat. Praestante ipso Domino nostro.
translation_en: Let us pray, dear brothers, for the spirit of our beloved (beloved one), whom the Lord has deemed worthy to call out of this world's snare, whose remains are committed to burial today. May His immense mercy place him (her) in the bosom of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, so that when the day of judgment comes, He may place him (her) among the saints and chosen ones on his (her) right hand, and may cause Him (Her) to rise again. In the presence of our Lord Himself.

text: Domine exaudi orationem meam secundum
translation_en: Lord, hear my prayer as I ask

text: Deus qui iustis supplicationibus semper praesto es qui pia vota dignaris intueri: da famulo tuo (famulae tuae) cuius depositionis hodie officia exhibemus cum sanctis atque fidelibus tuis beati muneris portionem. Per Christum.
translation_en: God who is always present to the supplications of the just and who are worthy to look upon pious vows: grant your servant (servant) whose duties we display today among the saints and faithful ones the portion of the blessed gift. Through Christ.

text: Omnis spiritus laudet Dominum.
translation_en: All spirits praise the Lord.

text: Laudate Dominum de caelis
translation_en: Praise the Lord from the heavens

text: Debitum humani corporis sepeliendi officium fidelium more complentes Deum cui omnia vivunt fideliter deprecemur ut hoc corpus cari nostri (carae nostrae) a nobis in infirmitate sepultum in ordine sanctorum tuorum resuscitet ut eius spiritum cum sanctis ac fidelibus suis aggregari iubeat cum quibus inenarrabili gloria et perenni felicitate perfrui mereatur. Praestante ipso Domino nostro.
translation_en: We faithfully complete the duty of burying the human body and humbly ask God, to whom all things live faithfully, to raise this body of our dear one (our dearest) that was buried in weakness among your saints, and command its spirit to be united with the spirits of the holy and faithful with whom it may enjoy inexpressible glory and perpetual happiness. In the presence of our Lord himself.

text: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israel
translation_en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel

text: Tibi Domine commendamus animam famuli tui defuncti (famulae tuae defunctae) ut defunctus (defuncta) saeculo tibi vivat et quae per fragilitatem mundanae conversationis peccata admisit tu veniam misericordissimae pietatis absterge. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: To you, Lord, we commend the soul of your servant (servant) who has died, so that the deceased may live with you in eternity and what sins were admitted through the frailty of worldly life, you wash away by your most merciful pity. Through our Lord.

text: Deus in cuius miseratione animae fidelium requiescunt: famulis et famulabus tuis omnibus hic et ubique in Christo quiescentibus da propitius veniam peccatorum ut a cunctis reatibus absoluti tecum sine fine laetentur. Per Dominum.
translation_en: God, in whose mercy the souls of faithful people rest: may you grant a gracious pardon to your servants who are resting here and everywhere in Christ, so that absolved from all sins they may rejoice with you without end. Through the Lord.

text: Annue nobis Domine ut anima famuli tui (famulae tuae) remissionem quam semper optavit mereatur percipere peccatorum.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the soul of your servant (your servant's soul) may merit to receive the remission which it always desired for the forgiveness of sins.

text: Partem beatae resurrectionis obtineat anima famuli tui (famulae tuae) vitamque aeternam habere mereatur in caelis. Per te Iesu Christe Salvator mundi qui cum Patre et Filio et Spiritu Sancto vivis et regnas Deus.
translation_en: May the soul of your servant (servant of yours) attain the part of blessed resurrection and merit eternal life in heavens. Through you Jesus Christ, Savior of the world, who with the Father and the Holy Spirit lives and reigns, God.

text: Adiuva nos Deus salutaris noster et beati Michaëlis archangeli omniumque sanctorum tuorum precibus exoratus animas famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium in Christo et in circuitu huius ecclesiae quiescentium in beatitudine lucis sempiternae constitue. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Help us, O God our Savior, and through the prayers of the blessed Michael the archangel, as well as all your saints, place the souls of your servants, both men and women, who are resting in Christ and in this church, into eternal happiness and light. Through the Lord.

text: Anima eius et animae omnium fidelium defunctorum hic vel ubique quiescentium in Christi nomine requiescant in pace.
translation_en: May his soul, and the souls of all the faithful departed here or elsewhere resting in Christ's name, rest in peace.

text: Si bona suscepimus
translation_en: If we have received well

text: Nudus egressus sum
translation_en: I have gone forth naked

text: Miserere mei Deus. Requiem aeternam dona.
translation_en: Have mercy on me, God. Grant me eternal rest.

text: Dele Domine iniquitatem meam
translation_en: Deliver, Lord, my iniquity

text: Exauditor omnium Deus exaudi nostrorum fletuum vocem et tribue infirmitatibus nostris perpetuam sospitatem ut dum dignanter gemitum nostri laboris suscipis tua nos semper misericordia consoleris.
translation_en: God, hearer of all, hear our weeping voice and grant us eternal comfort for our infirmities, so that while you graciously receive the groan of our labor, you may always console us with your mercy.

text: Miserere mei Deus miserere mei
translation_en: Have mercy on me, God, have mercy on me.

text: Pio recordationis affectu fratres carissimi commemorationem faciamus cari nostri (carae nostrae) quem (quam) 〈Dominus〉 de tentationibus huius saeculi assumpsit obsecrantes misericordiam Dei nostri ut ipse dignetur ei tribuere placidam et quietam mansionem et remittat omnes lubricae temeritatis offensas ut concessa venia plenae indulgentiae quicquid in hoc saeculo proprio reatu deliquit totum ineffabili pietate ac benignitate sua deleat et abstergat. Quod ipse praestare dignetur qui cum Patre et Filio.
translation_en: With a devout feeling, we make the commemoration for our most dear brothers (sister), whom (whom) the Lord took from the temptations of this world, beseeching the mercy of God that He may grant him a peaceful and quiet dwelling place and remit all offenses of careless temerity. May He forgive whatever in this world he has sinned by his own guilt, with an unfathomable pity and benevolence of His own. May He grant this who is worthy along with the Father and the Son.

text: Requiescant in pace. Amen.
translation_en: May they rest in peace. Amen.

text: A porta inferi
translation_en: At the gate of hell

text: Temeritatis quidem est Domine ut homo hominem mortalis mortalem cinis cinerem tibi Domino Deo nostro audeat commendare sed quia terra suscipit terram et pulvis convertitur in pulverem donec omnis caro in suam redigatur originem inde tuam Deus piissime Pater lacrimabiliter quaesumus pietatem ut huius famuli tui (famulae tuae) animam quam de huius mundi voragine caenulenta supernam ducis ad patriam Abrahae amici tui sinu recipias et refrigerii rore perfundas; sit ab aestuantis Gehenni truci incendio segregatus (segregata) et beatae requiei te donante convinctus (convincta). Et si quae illi sunt Domine dignae cruciatibus culpae tu eas gratiae mitissimae lenitate indulge nec peccati recipiat vicem sed indulgentiae tuae piam sentiat bonitatem cumque finito termino mundi supernum illuxerit regnum omnium sanctorum coetibus aggregatus (aggregata) cum electis resurgat in parte dextera coronandus (coronanda).
translation_en: Lord, it is boldness to assert that a mortal man dares to commend another mortal man's soul to you, our Lord God. But since earth receives earth and dust turns into dust until all flesh returns to its original state, we humbly beseech your mercy, O most compassionate Father, that the soul of your servant (your female servant) whom you have led from the murky abyss of this world to the homeland of Abraham, your friend, may be received in your bosom and bathed in the dew of refreshment. May he or she be separated from the burning, cruel fire of Gehenna and enclosed by the gift of eternal rest that you grant. And if those sins are worthy of punishment, Lord, grant them mercy through the gentle indulgence of your grace, so that they may not experience the penalty of sin but instead feel the goodness of your pardon. When the end of the world comes, may he or she rise again with the chosen in the right hand, crowned among all saints in the kingdom of heaven.

text: Suscipe Domine animam famuli tui et revertentem ad te veste caelesti indue eam et lava eam sancto fonte vitae aeternae ut inter gaudentes gaudeat et inter sapientes sapiat et inter martyres coronatus consedeat et inter patriarchas et prophetas proficiat et inter apostolos Christum sequi studeat et inter angelos et archangelos claritatem Dei semper videat et inter paradisi rutilos lapides gaudium possideat et notitiam mysteriorum Dei agnoscat et inter Cherubim et Seraphim claritatem Dei inveniat et inter vigintiquattuor seniores cantica canticorum audiat et inter lavantes stolas in fonte fluminis vestem lavet et inter pulsantes pulsans portas apertas caelestis Ierusalem reperiat et inter videntes Deum facie ad faciem videat et inter cantantes canticum novum cantet et inter audientes caelestem sonum audiat. Per eum qui.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the soul of your servant and clothe it with a heavenly robe; wash it in the fountain of life eternal that it may rejoice among those who rejoice, be wise among the wise, be crowned among martyrs, advance among patriarchs and prophets, strive to follow Christ among apostles, always see the splendor of God among angels and archangels, possess joy in paradise among radiant stones, recognize the mysteries of God among cherubim and seraphim, find the splendor of God among the twenty-four elders singing the songs of Solomon, wash its robe among those washing robes in the river's font, find open heavenly Jerusalem's doors among those pounding on the gates, see God face to face among those who see Him, sing a new song among those who sing it, hear the celestial sound among those who hear it. Through him who.

text: Suscipe Domine servum tuum in bonum habitaculum aeternum et da ei requiem aeternam et regnum sempiternum id est caelestem Ierusalem et in sinibus patriarcharum tuorum Abrahae Isaac et Iacob eum (eam) collocare digneris et partem habeat in prima resurrectione et inter suscipientes corpora in die resurrectionis corpus suum suscipiat et cum benedictis ad dexteram Dei venientibus veniat et inter possidentes vitam aeternam possideat.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, your servant into the good eternal dwelling and grant him (her) eternal rest and everlasting kingdom, that is celestial Jerusalem. May you deem it worthy to place him (her) among the patriarchs of yours, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. May he (she) have a part in the first resurrection. On the day of resurrection, let his (her) body receive the bodies taken up together. Let him (she) come with the blessed to the right hand of God. And let him (she) possess eternal life among those who possess it.

text: Latiatuc feleym zumtuchel mic vogmuc ýsa pur es chomuv uogmuc. Menýi milostben terumteve eleve mív isemucut adamut es odutta vola neki paradisumut hazóá. Es mend paradisumben uolov gimilcíctul munda nekí elnie. Heon tilutoa wt ig fa gimilce tvl. Ge mundoa nekí meret num eneyc ysa kí nopun emdul oz gimils twl halalnec halaláál holz. Hadlaua choltat terumteve isten tvl ge feledeve. Engede urdung intetvinec es evec oz tiluvt gimilstwl es oz gimilsben halalut evec. Es oz gimilsnec wl keseruv uola vize hug turchucat mige zocoztia vola. Num heon muga nec ge mend w foianec halalut evec. Horoguvec isten es veteve wt ez muncas vilagbele es levn halalnec es puculnec feze es mend w nemenec. Kic ozvc miv vogmuc. Hug es tiv latiatuc szumtuchel isa es num igg ember mulchotia ez vermut ysa mend ozchuz iarov vogmuc. Wímagguc uromc isten kegilmet ez lelic ert hug iorgossun w neki es kegiggen es bulscassa mend w bunet. Es vimagguc szen achscin mariat es bovdug michaël archangelt es mend angelcut hug uimaggonoc erette. Es uimagguc szent peter urot kinec odut hotolm ovdonia es ketnie hug ovga mend w bunet. Es vimagguc mend szentucut hug legenec nekí seged uromc scine eleut hug isten ív uimadsagucmia bulsassa w bunet. Es zoboducha wt urdung ildetuitvl es pucul kinzotviatwl es vezesse wt paradisum nugulmabeli es oggun neki munhi uruzagbele utot es mend iovben rezet. Es keassatuc uromchuz charmul:
translation_en:
Let us all come to the help of our God, who made us at first and has redeemed us from the dust of the earth; and let us pray that He will receive us into Paradise, where He loves the penitent sinner. And we ask Him that, because of His mercy, He will forgive us our sins, both by this life and by the one to come. We acknowledge that we have sinned, and because of His compassion, we implore his mercy.
We invoke the aid of the Blessed Virgin Mary, the Archangel Michael, and all the Angels; Saint Peter, Prince of the Apostles, and all Saints; and we ask for their intercession to help us who are in trouble, and to protect us from all evil and lead us to salvation.
And we beseech Thee, O Lord, that Thou wouldst grant us pardon of our sins, and deliver us from the pains of hell, and admit us into Paradise where Thou art, that our souls may be numbered among Thine elect, and rejoice in everlasting bliss with all the Saints. Amen.

text: Scerelmes bratým uimaggomuc ez scegin ember lilki ert kit vr ez nopun ez homus vilag timnucebelevl mente kinec ez nopun testet tumetívc hug ur uvt kegilmehel abraam ysaac iacob kebeleben helhezie hug birsagnop ívtua mend w szentíí es unuttei cuzicun iov felevl iochtotnia ilezie wt. Es tiv bennetuc.
translation_en: The blessed Trinity, with imagery of the earthly world, illuminates every creature that dwells on it and has not yet reached its end or testified to truth. May Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the saints intercede for us with their prayers before the throne of God, Almighty Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, and may our souls find peace in heaven and eternal rest. Amen.

text: Optime nostis fratres carissimi Dei misericordiam quanta gratia Dominus Deus gratificaverat primum Adam patrem nostrum sed diabolo suadente dum peccavit quid sibi et omnibus suis posteris tunc promeruit ecce fratres videtis oculis vestris. Considerate fratres in quanta beatitudine constabat ille primus Adam quod et eum non mori sed in aeternum vivere creaverat Dominus. Delectabilem domum dederat ei Dominus scilicet paradisum sed eo ibi manente praecepta Domini postposuit postquam a diabolo deceptus de illo vetito fructu comedit et in illo fructu et sibi et omni humano generi mortem comedit. Solus ipse peccavit tunc fratres; utinam soli ipsi suffecisset hoc periculum perpeti. Sed quid per Ezechielem prophetam dicit nobis Dominus consideremus fratres: »Patres inquit tunc comederunt uvam acerbam sed modo dentes filiorum obstupescunt.« Videtis fratres cottidie oculis vestris quomodo cottidie obstupescunt dentes nostri cum et cottidie mortis amaritudine amaricamur. Paradisus erat fratres mansio nostra non ista fovea sed primi parentis nostri transgressio promeruit nobis hanc mansionem. Tunc fratres expulsi sumus ab illa delectabili domo et incidimus in manus diaboli qui et multo tempore detinuit nos sub potestate sua. Tandem misericors Dominus recordatus est quoniam pulvis sumus. Descendit de caelo ad terram ac per multa tempora perditum hominem quaesivit et invenit quem et pretioso sanguine suo redemit sicque gaudens illuc eum reduxit unde et primum corruerat. Igitur fratres non ista fovea est mansio nostra sed sicut beatus Paulus dicit ita est nobis credendum. »Nostra inquit conversatio in caelis est.« Quibus fratres parata est illa caelestis mansio optime nostis. Iustis et omnibus illis qui in hoc saeculo in bono opere perseverant. Debitores sumus fratres ut homo hominem mortalis mortalem sepeliat et pro eo orationem faciat eique a Deo misericordiam imploret. Rogamus igitur vos fratres ut sicut vos a Deo cottidie quaeritis vobismetipsis misericordiam et remissionem similiter quaeratis et huic misero homini hodie a Deo misericordiam et si cui aliquid peccavit omnes pro Deo hodie remissionem faciatis sibi.
translation_en: You know very well, dearest brothers, how great the mercy of God was with which the Lord God gratified our first father Adam, but led astray by the devil, when he sinned, he brought upon himself and all his posterity what you now see with your own eyes. Brothers, consider in what beatitude our first father stood, for even him the Lord had decreed not to die but to live eternally.
