translation_en: God from whom Judas the betrayer took the penalty of his guilt and the reward of his confession, as a thief: grant us the effect of your propitiation, so that just as in His passion, our Lord Jesus Christ distributed rewards for different services, so He may grant us the grace of His resurrection, freeing us from the error of old age.

text: Oremus dilectissimi nobis pro Ecclesia sancta Dei ut eam Deus et Dominus noster pacificare et custodire dignetur toto orbe terrarum subiciens ei principatus et potestates detque nobis quietam et tranquillam vitam degentibus glorificare Deum Patrem omnipotentem.
translation_en: Let us pray, dearest to us, for the Holy Church of God, that our God and Lord may deign to pacify and protect her throughout the whole world, subjecting to her principalities and powers, and grant to those who live a peaceful and tranquil life the ability to glorify the almighty Father God.

text: Oremus et pro beatissimo papa nostro N. ut Deus et Dominus noster qui eligit eum in ordine episcopatus salvum atque incolumem custodiat Ecclesiae tuae sanctae ad regendum populum sanctum Dei.
translation_en: Let us pray for our most blessed Pope N., that God and our Lord who has chosen him for the order of the episcopate may keep him safe and unharmed for the governing of your holy Church.

text: Oremus et pro omnibus episcopis presbyteris diaconibus subdiaconibus acolythis exorcistis lectoribus ostiariis confessoribus virginibus viduis et omni populo sancto Dei.
translation_en: Let us pray for all bishops, priests, deacons, subdeacons, acolytes, exorcists, readers, doorkeepers, confessors, virgins, widows and the entire holy people of God.

text: Oremus et pro Christianissimo imperatore nostro vel rege nostro N. ut Deus et Dominus noster subditas illi faciat omnes barbaras nationes ad nostram perpetuam pacem.
translation_en: Let us pray for our most Christian emperor or king N., that our God and Lord may make all barbarian nations subject to him, for our perpetual peace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus in cuius manu sunt omnium potestates et omnia iura regnorum: respice propitius ad Christianissimum benignus imperium ut gentes quae in sua feritate confidunt potentiae tuae dextera comprimantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, in whose hand are all powers and all rights of kingdoms: look upon it propitiously, O benign, towards the most Christian empire, so that the peoples who trust in their own ferocity may be subdued by your right hand.

text: Oremus et pro catechumenis nostris ut Deus et Dominus noster adaperiat aures praecordiorum ipsorum ianuamque misericordiae ut per lavacrum regenerationis accepta remissione omnium peccatorum et ipsi inveniantur in Christo Iesu Domino nostro.
translation_en: Let us pray for our catechumens, that God our Lord may open the ears of their hearts and the door of his mercy, so that through the washing of regeneration they may receive forgiveness of all sins and find themselves in Christ Jesus, our Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui salvas omnes homines et neminem vis perire: respice ad animas diabolica fraude deceptas ut omni haeretica pravitate deposita errantium corda resipiscant et ad veritatis tuae redeant unitatem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who saves all men and wishes none to perish: look upon the souls deceived by the devil's fraud that, having laid aside every heretical perversion, the wandering hearts may repent and return to the unity of your truth.

text: Oremus et pro paganis ut Deus omnipotens auferat iniquitatem a cordibus eorum et relictis idolis suis convertantur ad Deus vivum et verum et unicum Filium eius Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Let us pray for the pagans, that Almighty God may remove wickedness from their hearts and, leaving behind their idols, they may convert to the true and living God and his only Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui non mortem peccatorum sed vitam semper inquiris: suscipe propitius orationem nostram et libera eos ab idolorum cultura et aggrega Ecclesiae tuae sanctae ad laudem et gloriam nominis tui.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who seeks not the death of sinners but their life: receive our prayer propitiously and free them from the worship of idols and gather them to Your holy Church for praise and glory in Your name.

text: Domine Iesu Christe adoro te in cruce ascendentem deprecor te ut ipsa crux liberet me de angelo percutiente.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, I adore you as you ascend on the cross, I beseech you that the very cross may deliver me from the angel striking me.

text: Domine Iesu Christe adoro te in cruce vulneratum deprecor te ut ipsa vulnera sint remedium animae meae. Domine Iesu Christe adoro te in sepulchro positum deprecor te ut ipsa mors sit vita mea. Domine Iesu Christe adoro te descendentem ad inferos liberantem captivos deprecor te ut non ibi me dimittas introire. Domine Iesu Christe adoro te resurgentem a mortuis ascendentem ad caelos deprecor te miserere mei. Domine Iesu Christe adoro te venturum iudicaturum deprecor te ut in tuo adventu non intres in iudicio cum me peccante sed deprecor te ut ante dimittas quam iudices. Qui cum Domino Patre.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, I adore you wounded on the cross, I implore you that the very wounds be a remedy for my soul. Lord Jesus Christ, I adore you laid in the tomb, I implore you that death itself be life for me. Lord Jesus Christ, I adore you descending to hell releasing captives, I implore you not to leave me there. Lord Jesus Christ, I adore you rising from the dead ascending to heavens, I implore you have mercy on me. Lord Jesus Christ, I adore you coming as a judge, I implore you not to enter judgment with me, sinner, but I implore you to forgive me before you judge. Who with God the Father.

text: Exsultet iam angelica turba caelorum exsultent divina mysteria et pro tanti regis victoria tuba intonet salutaris. Gaudeat se tellus tantis irradiasse fulgoribus et aeterni regis splendore illustrata totius orbis se sentiat amisisse caliginem. Laetetur et mater Ecclesia tanti luminis adornata fulgoribus et magnis populorum vocibus haec aula resultet. Quapropter astantibus vobis fratres carissimi ad tam miram sancti huius luminis claritatem una mecum quaeso Dei omnipotentis misericordiam invocate ut qui me non meis meritis intra Levitarum numerum dignatus est aggregare luminis sui gratiam infundente cerei huius laudem implere perficiat. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus.
translation_en: Now let the angelic choir of heaven rejoice, and let divine mysteries exult! Let a trumpet sound for the great king's victory. Let the earth be glad to shine with such brilliant radiance, and feel illuminated by the eternal king's splendor, causing the whole world to sense it has lost its darkness. Let the mother church rejoice, adorned with such brightness, and let this hall resound with great voices of the people. Therefore, dear brothers, in your presence, I humbly ask God Almighty's mercy. He, who deigned to gather me not by my own merits among the Levites, may this candle's grace complete the fulfillment of its praise. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God.

text: VD Vere quia dignum et iustum est invisibilem Deum Patrem omnipotentem Filiumque eius Unigenitum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum toto cordis ac mentis affectu et vocis ministerio personare. Qui pro nobis aeterno Patri Adae debitum solvit et veteris piaculi cautionem pio cruore detersit. Haec sunt enim festa paschalia in quibus verus ille Agnus occiditur eiusque sanguine postes consecrantur. Haec nox est in qua primum patres nostros filios Israël eduxisti de Ægypto quos postea Mare Rubrum sicco vestigio transire fecisti. Haec nox est quae peccatorum tenebras columnae illuminatione purgavit. Haec nox est quae hodie per universum mundum in Christum credentes a vitiis saeculi segregatos et a caligine peccatorum reddit gratiae sociatque sanctitati. Haec nox est in qua destructis vinculis mortis Christus ab inferis victor ascendit. Nihil enim nobis nasci profuerat nisi redimi profuisset. O mira circa nos tuae pietatis dignatio. O inaestimabilis dilectio caritatis ut servum redimeres Filium tradidisti. O beata nox quae sola meruit scire tempus et horam in qua Christus ab inferis resurrexit. Haec nox est de qua scriptum est: Et nox ut dies illuminabitur et nox illuminatio mea in deliciis meis. Cuius igitur sanctificatio noctis fugat scelera culpas lavat et reddit innocentiam lapsis maestis laetitiam. Fugat odia concordiam parat et curvat imperia. In huius igitur noctis gratia suscipe sancte Pater Hic mutatur thymiama. incensi huius sacrificium vespertinum quod tibi in hac cerei oblatione sollemni per ministrorum manus de operibus apum sacrosancta reddit Ecclesia. Sed iam columnae huius praeconia novimus quam in honorem Dei rutilans Hic cereus accenditur. ignis accendit. O vere beata nox quae exspoliavit Ægyptios ditavit Hebraeos. Nox in qua terrenis caelestia humanis divina iunguntur. Oramus te Domine ut cereus iste in honore nominis tui consecratus ad noctis huius caliginem destruendam indeficiens perseveret. In odorem suavitatis acceptus supernis luminaribus misceatur. Flammas eius lucifer matutinus inveniat. Ille inquam lucifer qui nescit occasum. Ille qui regressus ab inferis humano generi serenus illuxit. Precamur te Domine ut nos famulos tuos omnem clerum et devotissimum populum: una cum beatissimo papa nostro N. et gloriosissimo rege N. eiusque nobilissima prole N. et iamque episcopo nostro N. quiete temporum concessa in his festis paschalibus conservare digneris. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus. Per omnia saecula saeculorum. 〈R.〉 Amen.
translation_en: Indeed, it is truly fitting and just that the invisible Father, Almighty God, and His only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, should be honored with all the affection of our heart and mind, and the service of our voice. He paid the debt owed to the eternal Father on behalf of Adam, and removed the warning of the ancient sin with His precious blood. These are the Paschal feasts in which the true Lamb is slain, and the doors are consecrated with His blood. This is the night in which our ancestors first led the children of Israel out of Egypt, whom You later caused to pass through the Red Sea on dry ground. This is the night that purged the darkness of sin with the light of its pillars. This is the night that separates the faithful from the sins of the world and brings them to the grace and holiness. This is the night in which Christ, victorious over death, ascended from the grave. For nothing could have profited us if He had not been redeemed. O wondrous regard for us of Your mercy! O inestimable love, that You ransomed a servant by giving up Your Son! O blessed night, which alone knew the time and hour when Christ rose from the dead. This is about which it was written: And the night shall be like the day, and the night my light. Therefore, we pray that this candle, consecrated in Your honor, may continue without ceasing to destroy the darkness of this night. Accepted as a sweet fragrance to heavenly lights, may the morning star find its flames. That is to say, the morning star which knows no setting. The morning star which returned from the depths and illuminated mankind with serenity. We pray You, Lord, that You may grant peaceful times to Your servants: the entire clergy, and the most devout people; together with our blessed Pope N., the glorious king N., and his noble progeny N.; and also our bishop N., in these Paschal feasts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever. Amen.

text: Deus qui mirabiliter creasti hominem et mirabilius redemisti da nobis quaesumus contra oblectamenta peccati mentis ratione persistere ut mereamur ad gaudia aeterna pervenire.
translation_en: God, who miraculously created man and even more miraculously redeemed us, grant us that we may steadfastly resist the allurements of sin through reason, so that we may deserve to reach eternal joys.

text: Noë vero cum quingentorum esset*
translation_en: Noah was actually five hundred years old.

text: Deus incommutabilis virtus lumen aeternum respice propitius ad totius Ecclesiae tuae mirabile sacramentum ut opus salutis humanae perpetuae dispositionis effectu tranquillius operare totusque mundus experiatur et videat deiecta erigi inveterata novari et per ipsum redire omnia in integrum a quo sumpsere principium.
translation_en: O unchangeable God, eternal power and everlasting light, look upon us graciously as we perform your marvelous sacrament of the Church. May the work of human salvation be carried out smoothly by its perpetual disposition. May the whole world experience and see the dejected raised, the hardened renewed, and all things return to their original state through you, from whom all things took their beginning.

text: Haec est hereditas*
translation_en: This is the inheritance

text: Omnes sitientes*
translation_en: All thirsty ones

text: Deus qui nos ad celebrandum paschale sacramentum utriusque testamenti paginis instruis da nobis intelligere misericordiam tuam ut ex perceptione praesentium munerum firma sit exspectatio futurorum.
translation_en: God who instructs us for the celebration of the paschal sacrament of both testaments, grant us to understand your mercy. May the certain expectation of future gifts be firm from the perception of present offerings.

text: Et facta est super me*
translation_en: And upon me it was done

text: Vinea mea*
translation_en: My vineyard

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus preces populi tui cum oblationibus hostiarum ut paschalibus initiatae mysteriis ad aeternitatis nobis medelam te operante proficiant.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech you, the prayers of your people with the offerings of sacrifices, so that as we are initiated into the Paschal mysteries, we may progress towards healing for eternity through your action.

text: VD ... aequum et salutare. Te quidem Domine omni tempore sed in hac potissimum nocte gloriosius praedicare.
translation_en: It is fitting and saving. Indeed, Lord, at all times but especially this night, you are more gloriously to proclaim.

text: Communicantes et noctem sacratissimam celebrantes resurrectionis Domini Dei nostri Iesu Christi secundum carnem sed et memoriam venerantes. Imprimis gloriosae semper Virginis Mariae Genitricis eiusdem Dei et Domini nostri Iesu Christi.
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred night, we honor the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ in the flesh, and also remember. First, we venerate the glorious ever-virgin Mary, Mother of the same God and Lord Jesus Christ.

text: VD ... aequum et salutare. Te quidem Domine omni tempore sed in hoc potissimum die gloriosius praedicare cum Pascha nostrum immolatus est Christus. Ipse enim verus est agnus qui abstulit peccata mundi. Qui mortem nostram moriendo destruxit et vitam resurgendo reparavit. Et ideo.
translation_en: Indeed it is fitting and savory for you, Lord, at all times but especially on this glorious day to proclaim that our Passover, Christ, has been sacrificed. He himself is the true Lamb who took away the sins of the world. By dying, he destroyed our death, and by rising, he restored life. And therefore...

text: Sacrificia Domine paschalibus gaudiis immolamus quibus Ecclesia mirabiliter et pascitur et nutritur.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, the Paschal sacrifices with joyful offerings. Through which the Church is wonderfully fed and nourished.

text: Ab omni nos quaesumus Domine vetustate purgatos sacramenti veneranda perceptio in novam transferat creaturam.
translation_en: From every one of us, we humbly ask you, Lord, that by the ancient cleansing of the sacred rite, may the perception be transferred to a new creation.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine placatus assume quas pro renatorum expiatione peccati deferimus et pro acceleratione caelestis auxilii.
translation_en: We beseech Thee, Lord, that Thou wouldst receive the offerings which we present on behalf of the expiration of sins for our offspring. And for the hastening of heavenly aid.

text: Redemptionis nostrae munere vegetati quaesumus Domine ut perpetuae salutis auxilium fidem semper veram perficiat.
translation_en: By the grace of our redemption, we humbly ask you, Lord, that the aid of eternal salvation may always complete our steadfast faith.

text: Deus qui nos per huius sacrificii veneranda commercia unius summae divinitatis participes effecisti: praesta quaesumus ut sicut tuam cognovimus veritatem sic eam dignis moribus assequamur.
translation_en: God, who made us participants of this sacrifice through the venerable exchange of one supreme divinity: grant us that, as we have come to know your truth, so we may attain it with worthy behavior.

text: Adesto nobis Domine Deus noster ut per haec quae sumpsimus et purgemur a vitiis et a periculis omnibus exuamur.
translation_en: Be present among us, Lord our God, so that through what we have received, we may be purified from vices and freed from all dangers.

text: Tribue nobis Domine caelestis mensae virtutis societatem et desiderare quae recta sunt et desiderata percipere.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the fellowship of heavenly power on our table, and to desire what is right and to perceive what is desired.

text: Haec munera Domine et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvant et tuae nobis misericordiae dona concilient.
translation_en: These gifts, Lord, may your mercy grant to us, and may they dissolve our bonds of sin.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Pater ut nostrae mentis intentio quo sollemnitatis hodiernae gloriosus auctor ingressus est semper intendat et quo fide pergit conversatione perveniat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee Almighty Father, that our mind's intention where the glorious Author of today's solemnity entered may always be focused and that in conduct it may reach where faith leads.

text: Sacrificium Domine pro Filii tui supplices venerabili ascensione deferimus praesta quaesumus ut et nos per ipsum his commerciis sacrosanctis ad caelestia consurgamus.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, for Your Son we humbly offer this supplication on venerable ascent. Grant us, we beseech You, that through Him and these most sacred transactions we may ascend to heavenly realms.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine ut per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus illuc tendat nostrae devotionis affectus quo tecum est nostra substantia in caelestibus. Per eundem.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that through these sacraments which we have received may our affection of devotion be directed towards the place where our substance is with you in heaven. Through the same.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae pro Filii tui gloriosa ascensione deferimus concede propitius ut a praesentibus periculis liberemur et ad vitam perveniamus aeternam.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings that we bring for Your glorious Ascension of Your Son. Graciously grant us so that we may be freed from present dangers and reach eternal life.

text: VD ... per Christum. Qui post resurrectionem suam omnibus discipulis suis manifestus apparuit et ipsis cernentibus est elevatus in caelum ut nos divinitatis suae tribueret esse participes.
translation_en: And indeed ... through Christ. Who appeared to all his disciples after his resurrection and, being seen by them, was lifted up into heaven so that we might become participants in his divinity.

text: Repleti muneribus sacris da quaesumus ut in gratiarum semper actione maneamus.
translation_en: Filled with sacred duties, we ask that you remain ever in the act of giving thanks.

text: 〈Lectio libri Genesis〉
translation_en: Reading from the Book of Genesis

text: Deus qui nos ad celebrandam praesentem festivitatem utriusque testamenti paginis instruis: da nobis intelligere misericordiam tuam ut ex perceptione praesentium munerum firma sit exspectatio futurorum.
translation_en: God who instructs us for the celebration of this present feast on the pages of both testaments, grant that we may understand your mercy, so that our firm expectation of the present gifts may be based on the anticipation of future ones.

text: Deus qui incommutabilis virtus et lumen aeternum: respice propitius ad totius Ecclesiae mirabile sacramentum et da famulis tuis ut hoc quod devote agimus etiam rectitudinem vitae teneamus.
translation_en: God, who is the unchangeable power and eternal light: look favorably upon us propitiously regarding the marvelous sacrament of the whole Church, and give to your servants that what we are performing with devotion, we may also hold the integrity of life.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sollemnitatem doni Sancti Spiritus colimus caelestibus desideriis accensi fontem vitae sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who celebrate the solemnity of the Holy Spirit, being inflamed with heavenly desires, may feel the source of life.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum Pentecostes celebrantes praevenientes quo Spiritus Sanctus apostolis innumeris linguis apparuit. Sed et memoriam.
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day of Pentecost, we recall the event preceding which the Holy Spirit appeared to the apostles in countless tongues.

text: Sancti Spiritus Domine corda nostra mundet infusio et sui roris intima aspersione fecundet.
translation_en: Lord, cleanse our hearts with the infusion of the Holy Spirit and fertilize them with the inner sprinkling of its dew.

text: VD ... per Christum Dominum nostrum. Qui ascendens super omnes caelos sedensque ad dexteram tuam promissum Spiritum Sanctum hodierna die in filios adoptionis effudit. Quapropter profusis gaudiis totus in orbe terrarum mundus exsultat. Sed et supernae virtutes atque angelicae potestates hymnum gloriae tuae concinunt sine fine dicentes: Sanctus sanctus sanctus.
translation_en: We come ... through Christ our Lord. Who ascended above all heavens, seated at your right hand, today poured out the promised Holy Spirit upon the sons of adoption. Therefore, the whole world rejoices everywhere on earth. But also the heavenly powers and angelic authorities sing a hymn of Your glory without end, saying: Holy, holy, holy.

text: Purificet nos Domine quaesumus muneris praesentis oblatio ut dignos sacra participatione perficiat.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, we beseech You, by the offering of this present service, that we may be worthy to complete by sacred participation.

text: Accipe quaesumus Domine munus oblatum et dignanter operare ut quod tuis mysteriis agimus piis affectibus celebremus.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offering presented and work worthy of you, so that with pious feelings, we may celebrate what we perform in your mysteries.

text: Sumentes Domine caelestia sacramenta quaesumus clementiam ut quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur. Per eundem.
translation_en: Lord, taking the heavenly sacraments, we humbly ask for Your clemency, that what we temporarily possess may lead us to eternal joy. Through the same.

text: Annue misericors Deus ut qui divina percepta vigilando paradisi felicitate decidimus ad aeternae beatitudinis redeamus accensum per tuorum custodiam mandatorum.
translation_en: Answer gracious God, that we who have descended from divine perception with watchful happiness in paradise, may return by the warmth of your protection to the eternal beatitude of your commandments.

text: Ab omnibus nos quaesumus Domine defende adversis et operante Spiritu Sancto continuis tuere praesidiis.
translation_en: From all we humbly ask you, Lord, protect us from adversities and keep us under the continuous guard of your Holy Spirit.

text: Deus qui tribus pueris mitigasti flammas ignium: concede propitius ut nos famulos tuos non exurat flamma vitiorum sed tui nos bracchii protectio defendat.
translation_en: God who softened the flames of fire for the three boys: grant us graciously that the flame of vices does not burn us, but may your protective arm shield us.

text: Hostias nostras Domine tibi dicatas assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue pervenire subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, receive our offerings that are dedicated to You and grant us perpetually to attain assistance from them.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica ut tui nobis Unigeniti corpus et sanguis fiant redemptio animarum acceptiores.
translation_en: Lord, we offer these gifts, sanctify them so that the body and blood of your Only-Begotten Son may be an acceptable redemption for our souls.

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus ut et mundi cursus pacifice nobis tuo ordine dirigatur et Ecclesia tua tranquilla devotione laetetur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we pray, that the course of the world may be directed peacefully according to Your order and Your Church may rejoice with peaceful devotion.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has populi tui oblationes benignus assume ut et nullius sit irritum votum et nullius vacua postulatio praesta ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate our supplications and graciously accept these offerings of your people, that no one's vow be in vain and no one's petition empty. Grant us that we may effectively attain what we have faithfully asked for.

text: Repleti sumus Domine muneribus tuis tribue quaesumus ut eorum et mundemur effectu et muniamur auxilio. Per Dominum.
translation_en: We have been filled, Lord, with your gifts; grant us that we may be purified by their effect and strengthened by their aid. Through the Lord.

text: Deus qui legalium differentias hostiarum unius sacrificia perfectione sanxisti: accipe sacrificium a devotis tibi famulis et pari benedictione sicut munera Abel sanctifica ut quod singuli obtulerunt ad maiestatis tuae honorem cunctis proficiat ad salutem. Per Christum.
translation_en: God, who sanctified the differences of offerings through the perfection of one sacrifice: receive the offering from your devoted servants and bless it equally, just as the gifts of Abel were sanctified. May what each has offered for the honor of your majesty benefit all for salvation. Through Christ.

text: Largire nobis Domine quaesumus spiritum cogitandi quae recta sunt propitius et agendi ut qui sine te esse non possumus secundum te vivere valeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, the spirit of right thinking, which is pleasing to you, and enable us who cannot exist without you, to live according to you.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine propitius respice quas sacris altaribus exhibemus ut nobis indulgentiam largiendo tuo nomini dent honorem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, look upon favorably these offerings which we present to your sacred altars. May you grant us forgiveness and bestow honor upon your name in return.

text: Concede Domine nobis quaesumus ut haec hostia salutaris et nostrorum fiat purgatio delictorum propitiatio pietatis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we ask, that this saving Host may become for us a purification for our sins, an expiation of our offenses, and an offering of our devotion.

text: Absolve quaesumus Domine tuorum delicta populorum et a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus quae pro nostra fragilitate contraximus tua benignitate liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to forgive the sins of your people and free us from the bonds of our sins which we contracted due to our frailty, with your mercy.

text: Tuere quaesumus Domine familiam tuam ut salutis aeternae remedia quae te inspirante requirimus te largiente consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to protect Your family so that we may obtain the means of eternal salvation which we seek with Your inspiration, and generously grant us these.

text: Perficiant in nobis Domine quaesumus tua sacramenta quod continent ut quae nunc specie gerimus rerum veritate capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your sacraments be completed within us, so that what we now hold in appearance, we may truly receive the substance of things.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter deprecamur ut haec sancta quae gerimus et a praeteritis nos delictis exuant et futuris.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that these sacred things we are performing may cleanse us from the past sins and deliver us from future ones.

text: Gratias tibi referimus sacro munere vegetati tuam misericordiam deprecantes ut dignos nos participatione perficias.
translation_en: We refer our thanks to You in the sacred office of Your life, beseeching Your mercy that You may complete us worthy ones with Your participation.

text: Haec munera Domine quae oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus salutaria nobis esse concede.
translation_en: Lord, these gifts which we present before your majesty's eyes, may they be beneficial to us. Grant it.

text: Tua nos quaesumus Domine medicinalis operatio et a nostris perversitatibus clementer expediat et tuis faciat semper inhaerere mandatis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your curative action may release us from our perversities and may always cause us to adhere to your commands.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius hostias quibus et te placari voluisti et nobis salutem potenti pietate restitui.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, graciously the sacrifices which you wished to be appeased by, and restore us again with powerful mercy our salvation.

text: Propitius esto Domine supplicationibus nostris et populi tui oblationibus precibusque susceptis omnium nostrorum ad te corda convertere ut a terrenis cupiditatibus liberi ad caelestia desideria transeamus.
translation_en: Lord, be propitious to our supplications and to the people of your offerings and prayers received. Turn all our hearts towards you so that we may pass from earthly desires to heavenly longings.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus Domine ut 〈per haec〉 sacramenta quae sumpsimus quicquid in nostra mente vitiosum est ipsius dono curetur. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, that these sacred mysteries which we have received may be purified of whatever is defective within our minds by the gift itself. Through the Lord.

text: Da omnipotens Deus ut beati Silvestri confessoris tui atque pontificis veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant, almighty God, that the venerable solemnity and devotion of your blessed confessor and pope, Silvester, may increase among us and bring us salvation.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente beato Silvestro confessore tuo atque pontifice per haec a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, may the gifts we offer be sanctified, and through the intercession of blessed Pope Saint Silvester, your confessor and pope, may they be purified from our sins' stains.

text: Sancti confessoris tui et episcopi tui Hilarii Domine quaesumus veneranda festivitas salutaris auxilii praestet nobis augmentum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the honorable feast of your confessor and bishop, Hilary, may bestow upon us an increase in salvation's help.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens Deus ut nostrae humilitatis oblatio et pro tuorum tibi grata sit honore sanctorum et nos emundet corpore pariter et mente purificet.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Almighty God, that our humble offering may be pleasing to You through the honor of the saints and that we may be cleansed in body as well as purified in mind.

text: Sumptis Domine sacramentis quaesumus intercedente beato Hilario confessore tuo atque pontifice ad redemptionis aeternae proficiamus augmentum.
translation_en: With the sacred offerings, we humbly ask You, Lord, through the intercession of the blessed Hilario, Your confessor and pope, may we progress towards an increase in eternal redemption.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beati Felicis episcopi et martyris tui dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, may these offerings be pleasing to you for your blessed Bishop and Martyr, St. Felix. May your kindness receive them and grant us eternal support as their benefits continue to come to us.

text: Oblatis Domine ob honorem beati Mauri confessoris tui placare muneribus et ipsius interventu famulis tuis cunctorum tribue indulgentiam peccatorum.
translation_en: Lord, with offerings made for the honor of blessed Maurice, your confesor, we ask that you grant mercy through his intervention and bestow indulgence for sins upon all your servants.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut interveniente beato Mauro confessore tuo atque abbate et tua in nobis dona multiplices et tempora nostra disponas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that with the intervention of Blessed Maurice, your confessor and abbot, you may grant us many blessings and arrange our times.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus munera dignanter oblata et beati Marcelli suffragantibus meritis ad nostrae salutis auxilium provenire concede.
translation_en: Receive graciously, Lord, we entreat, the gifts presented to You and through the merits of blessed Marcel, may aid be granted for our salvation.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam muneribus sacris eius quaesumus interventione nos refove cuius sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with sacred gifts, we humbly ask that through your intervention, we may be refreshed. Whose solemnities we are now celebrating.

text: Hostia haec Domine quaesumus quam in sanctorum tuorum natalicia recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: This host, Lord, we humbly ask, which we are offering in remembrance of the natal days of your saints, may it release us from the bonds of our wickedness and unite us with your mercy.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beati Fabiani martyris tui dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: May the offerings, O Lord, to your blessed martyr Fabian be graciously received, and may they provide us with perpetual aid as support.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui infirma mundi eligis ut fortia quaeque confundas: concede propitius ut qui beatae Agnetis virginis et martyris tuae sollemnia colimus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who chooses to humble the world so that the strong may be confounded: grant us your favor that we may feel your patronage through the solace of the blessed Agnes, virgin and martyr, as we celebrate her feast day with you.

text: Hostias Domine quas tibi offerimus propitius respice et intercedente beata Agnete martyre tua vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolve.
translation_en: Lord, favorably look upon the offerings we present to you. With the intercession of the blessed Martyr Agnes, may your bonds of our sins be loosed.

text: Refecti cibo potuque caelesti Deus noster te supplices exoramus ut in cuius haec commemoratione percepimus eius muniamur et precibus.
translation_en: Fed with earthly food and drink, our God, we humbly beseech you that, in whose memory we have partaken of this food, we may be strengthened and protected through your prayers.

text: Muneribus nostris quaesumus Domine precibusque susceptis et intercedente beato Vincentio martyre tuo et caelestibus nos munda mysteriis et clementer exaudi.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, with our offerings and prayers received, and through the intercession of your blessed martyr Saint Vincent, cleanse us by the sacred mysteries and graciously hear us.

text: Deus qui universum mundum beati Pauli apostoli tui praedicatione docuisti da nobis quaesumus ut qui eius hodie conversionem colimus per eius ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God who taught the whole world through the preaching of your Apostle Blessed Paul, grant us, we ask, that we who today rejoice in his conversion may be enriched by his examples with grace towards you.

text: Apostoli tui Pauli precibus Domine quaesumus plebis tuae dona sanctifica ut quae tibi grata sunt instituta gratiora fiant eius patrocinio supplicantis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercessions of your apostle Paul, grant us that the offerings of your people may be sanctified; and that what pleases you becomes more gracious to them because of his patronage.

text: Refecti Domine salutari mysterio quaesumus ut nobis eius non desit oratio cuius donasti nos patrocinio gubernari.
translation_en: Sustained, Lord, by the saving mystery, we humbly ask that His prayer may not cease for us, whose protection you have entrusted to govern us.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius orationem nostram cum oblationibus hostiarum superimpositis et martyris tui Praeiecti deprecatione pietati tuae perfice benignus acceptam et illam quae in eo flagravit fortem dilectionem in nobis benignus aspira.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayer propitiously with the offerings of sacrifices laid upon them and through the entreaty of your martyr Prejectus. May Your mercy complete it graciously, accept the offered one, and may that strong love which burned in him be inspired within us graciously.

text: Votiva Domine pro beati martyris tui Praeiecti passione dona percepimus quaesumus ut eius precibus praesentis vitae nobis pariter et aeternae tribuas conferre praesidium.
translation_en: We have perceived the vows made to Your blessed martyr Pretextatus in his passion, we beseech You, grant that through his prayers You may bestow upon us protection both in this life and in the eternal one.

text: Super has quaesumus Domine hostias benedictio copiosa descendat quae et sanctificationem nobis clementer operetur et de martyrum sollemnitate laetificet.
translation_en: Upon these, we humbly ask, Lord, that a rich blessing may descend, which not only sanctifies us gently but also rejoices us on the solemnity of the martyrs.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster 〈ut sacrosancta mysteria〉 quae pro reparationis nostrae munimine contulisti intercedente beata et semper Virgine Maria et praesens nobis remedium esse facias et futurum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the sacred mysteries which you have bestowed upon us for the protection of our reparation, with the intercession of the blessed and ever Virgin Mary, be present to us now and in the future.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae in beatae Agathae martyris tuae sollemnitate deferimus cuius nos scimus patrocinio liberari.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings which we bring on the solemnity of your blessed martyr Agatha, knowing that we are freed by her patronage.

text: Auxilientur nobis Domine sumpta mysteria et intercedente beata Agatha martyre tua sempiterna protectione confirment.
translation_en: Lord, help us with the sacred mysteries, and with the intercession of your blessed martyr Agatha, confirm us with your eternal protection.

text: Deus qui nos devota beati Vedasti confessoris tui atque pontificis instantia ad agnitionem tui nominis vocare dignatus es: concede propitius ut cuius sollemnia colimus etiam patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who deemed to call us to the recognition of your name through the urgent plea of your devoted confessor and bishop Saint Vedastus: grant graciously that we may not only celebrate his feast day, but also feel his patronage.

text: Hostias Domine laudis tuis altaribus adhibemus quas eius tibi patrocinio credimus commendandas cuius nos voluisti votis ad te pietatis pervenire notitiam.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the hosts of praise for Your altars, which we believe are worthy of being commended to You through His patronage, whose will it was that we should come to You in devotion by fulfilling our vows.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine beatae virginis tuae Scholasticae meritis propitius respice ut sicut ipsius precibus ad obtinendum quod cupivit imbrem caelitus descendere fecisti ita eius supplicationibus ariditatem nostri pectoris supernae digneris gratiae rore perfundere.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, of your blessed virgin Scholastica, to look upon your family with favor through her merits. Just as you granted rain from heaven in response to her prayers for what she desired, may you deign to pour down the grace of your rain upon our arid hearts through her supplications.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus ob honorem sacrae virginis tuae Scholasticae munus oblatum et quod assequi nostris meritis non valemus eiusdem suffragantibus meritis largire propitius.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we ask you, for the honor of your sacred virgin Scholastica, the offering presented and, since we are unable to obtain it by our own merits, grant it graciously through her merits.

text: Quos caelesti Domine refectione satiasti beatae quaesumus Scholasticae virginis tuae meritis a cunctis exue propitius adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord of heaven, that, by the merits of your blessed Virgin Scholastica, you may release us from all adversities and favorably remove them from everyone.

text: Sit nobis reparatio mentis et corporis caeleste mysterium ut cuius exsequimur actionem sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: May there be for us a heavenly restoration of mind and body, so that we may feel the effect of the mystery whose actions we perform.

text: Deus qui beato Petro apostolo tuo collatis clavibus regni caelestis animas ligandi atque solvendi pontificium tradidisti: concede ut intercessionis eius auxilio a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus liberemur.
translation_en: God, who bestowed upon your apostle Peter the keys of the kingdom of heaven for binding and loosing souls, grant that through his intercession we may be freed from the bonds of our sins.

text: Ecclesiae tuae Domine quaesumus preces et hostias beati Petri apostoli commendet oratio ut quae pro illius gloria celebramus nobis prosint ad veniam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to present the prayers and offerings of the blessed apostle Peter to your church. May the prayer for his glory that we celebrate benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Sancta tua nos Domine quaesumus sumpta vivificent et intercedente beato apostolo tuo Petro misericordiae sempiternae praeparent expiatos.
translation_en: Holy one, we humbly ask you, Lord. By taking us, may you make us alive, and with the intervention of your blessed Apostle Peter, prepare for us eternal mercy for the forgiven.

text: Deus qui proditoris Iudae ruinam ne apostolorum tuorum numerus sacratus perfectione careret beati Matthiae electione supplesti: praesentia munera sanctifica et per ea nos gratiae tuae virtute confirma.
translation_en: God, who through the betrayal of the Jews did not allow the number of your apostles to lack perfection by the election of blessed Matthew, supplies it: through your presence sanctify our gifts and strengthen us with the power of your grace.

text: Da nobis Domine Deus noster sanctarum martyrum palmas incessabili veneratione venerari ut quod digna mente non possumus celebrare humilibus saltem frequentemus obsequiis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord our God, the palm branches of the holy martyrs to be revered with unceasing veneration, so that what we cannot celebrate with worthy mind, at least let us frequently perform our obeisances.

text: Intende Domine quaesumus munera altaribus tuis pro sanctarum tuarum Felicitatis et Perpetuae commemoratione proposita ut sicut per haec beata mysteria illis gratiam contulisti 〈ita〉 nobis indulgentiam largiaris.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you, grant offerings to your altars for the commemoration of your Saints Felicitas and Perpetua, that as through these blessed mysteries you bestowed grace upon them, so you may grant us indulgence.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine sollemne sacrificium pro veneranda festivitate beati Gregorii suppliciter maiestatem tuam deprecantes ut per haec sacrosancta mysteria et hostis temptamenta te triumphante vincamus et aeternae remunerationis emolumenta te largiente lucremur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, a solemn sacrifice for the venerable feast of blessed Gregory, humbly beseeching Your majesty that through these sacred mysteries and our attempts we may triumph over the enemy and, with eternal rewards granted by You, we may prosper.

text: Deus qui nos a delictorum facinoribus castigas nostrorum et tuorum participatione sacramentorum expias: praesta quaesumus ut meritis beati Gregorii a cunctis vitiorum adversitatibus eruamur et caelestis vitae consortia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God, who chastises us from the wicked works of our sins and expiates them through participation in the sacraments: grant us, we ask, that we may be freed from all the adversities of vices through the merits of Blessed Gregory, and may deserve the consortia of heavenly life.

text: Annue tuis famulis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beato confessore tuo Benedicto aquam de rupis largitus es vertice ita nobis eius suffragantibus supernae largiaris fontem pietatis.
translation_en: Answer to your servants we ask, almighty God, as you granted the blessed confessor Benedict water from the rock, so may you bestow upon us, through his intercessions, a fountain of pity from above.

text: Deus qui hodierna die Verbum tuum beatae Virginis alvo coadunare voluisti: fac nos ita dominicae passionis sacramenta peragere ut tibi placere valeamus.
translation_en: God, who willed on this day to join Your Word with the blessed Virgin's womb: grant that we may perform the sacred mysteries of the Lord's Passion in such a way that we may be pleasing to You.

text: Deus qui nos beatorum martyrum tuorum Georgii atque Adalberti meritis et intercessione laetificas: concede propitius ut qui eorum beneficia poscimus dono tuae gratiae consequamur.
translation_en: God who delights us through the merits and intercession of your blessed martyrs George and Adalbert: grant us, in Your mercy, that we may obtain what we ask of You through Your grace.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedentibus beatis martyribus tuis Georgio atque Adalberto nos per haec a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, we offer these gifts; sanctify them, and through the intercession of your blessed martyrs George and Adalbert, cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut quos tuis reficis sacramentis intercedentibus beatis martyribus tuis Georgio et Adalberto tibi etiam placitis moribus dignanter tribuas deservire.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that those whom your sacred sacraments are refreshing through the intercession of your blessed martyrs George and Adalbert, may serve you worthy in pleasing manners as well.

text: Beati evangelistae tui Marci sollemnitate tibi munera deferentes quaesumus Domine ut sicut illum praedicatio evangelica fecit gloriosum ita nos eius intercessio et verbo et opere tibi reddat acceptos.
translation_en: On the solemnity of your evangelist Marc, bringing gifts to you, we humbly ask, Lord, that just as the preaching of the Gospel made him glorious, so may his intercession, through word and deed, make us acceptable to you.

text: Tribuant nos quaesumus Domine continuum tua sancta praesidium quo beati evangelistae tui Marci precibus nos ab omnibus semper tueantur incursus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us your constant holy protection, so that the blessed evangelists of yours, Mark, may always keep us safe from all attacks.

text: Deus qui in praeclara salutiferae crucis inventione passionis tuae miracula suscitasti: concede ut eiusdem vitalis ligni pretio aeternae vitae suffragia consequamur.
translation_en: God, who raised miracles in the glorious finding of the salvation-bearing cross on which your passion was endured: grant that we may obtain the intercession of the same life-giving wood through its price, the eternal life.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod immolamus placatus intende ut ab omni nos exuat bellorum nequitia et per vexillum sanctae crucis Filii tui ad conterendas potestatis et adversariorum insidias nos in tuae protectionis securitate constituat.
translation_en: Lord, we offer this sacrifice, grant that you listen favorably to it. May you free us from all the wickedness of war and by the standard of the holy cross of your Son establish us securely under your protective power against the plots and enemies.

text: VD ... Qui salutem humani generis in ligno crucis contulisti ut unde mors oriebatur inde vita resurgeret. Et qui in ligno vincebat in ligno quoque vinceretur. Per Christum Dominum.
translation_en: Who brought the salvation of the human race upon the wood of the cross, so that where death arose, there life might rise again. And who conquered on the wood, also was to be conquered on the wood. Through Christ the Lord.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatorum martyrum tuorum Gordiani atque Epimachi sollemnia colimus eorum apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of your holy martyrs Gordian and Epimachus, we may be helped by their intercessions with you.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beatorum martyrum Gordiani atque Epimachi dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Accept, Lord, the offerings dedicated to You for the blessed martyrs Gordianus and Epimachus. May Your kindness receive them, and grant us everlasting aid through their intercession.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine Nerei et Achillei atque Pancratii tibi grata confessio et munera nostra commendet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper imploret.
translation_en: Lord, we make grateful confession and offer our gifts to your saints Neerius, Achilles, and Pancras. May they always intercede for us and continually ask for your mercy on our behalf.

text: Quaesumus Domine ut beatorum martyrum tuorum Nerei et Achillei et Pancratii deprecationibus sacramenta sancta quae sumpsimus ad tuae nobis proficiant placationis augmentum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the prayers of your blessed martyrs, Nereus and Achilles, and Pancras may be beneficial for us, so that the sacred sacraments we have received may increase in our favor as a result of their intercession.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ad eorum nos gaudia aeterna pertingere de quorum nos virtute tribuis annua sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that we may participate in their eternal joys of whom we annually rejoice through their power.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui Urbani martyris tui atque pontificis sollemnia colimus eius apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of your martyr and bishop Urbanus, may we be helped by his intercessions with you.

text: Deus qui nos beati Nicomedis martyris tui meritis et intercessione laetificas: concede propitius ut qui eius beneficia poscimus dono tuae gratiae consequamur.
translation_en: God who delights us through the merits of your blessed martyr Nicholas and his intercession, graciously grant that we who ask for his benefits may follow in the grace of your gift.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente beato Nicomede martyre tuo nos per haec a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, we offer these gifts; may You sanctify them. Through the intercession of the blessed martyr Nicholas, cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut quos tuis reficis sacramentis intercedente beato Nicomede martyre tuo tibi etiam placitis moribus dignanter tribuas deservire.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that you who sustain us with your sacred sacraments, through the intercession of the blessed martyr Nicomede, grant us worthy to serve you according to your pleasing habits.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatorum Marcellini et Petri martyrum tuorum sollemnitate laetificas: praesta quaesumus ut quorum gaudemus meritis instruamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who on the feast of your blessed martyrs Marcellinus and Peter delights us: grant, we ask, that we may be instructed by their examples from whom we rejoice with merits.

text: Fac nos Domine quaesumus sanctorum tuorum Primi et Feliciani semper festa sectari quorum suffragiis protectionis tuae dona sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, through the intercession of your saints Primus and Felician, always to celebrate their feasts, whose intercessions may we feel the experience of your protection.

text: Deus cuius Spiritu beatus Barnabas ad praedicandum Evangelium Christi Filii tui est destinatus: concede propitius ut eum apud misericordiam tuam sentiamus intercessorem quem aeternae vitae te largiente meruimus habere praedicatorem.
translation_en: God, whose Spirit blessed Barnabas is appointed for preaching the Gospel of your Son: grant graciously that we may feel him as an intercessor whom we have merited to have as a preacher of eternal life through your generosity.

text: Praesentia munera quaesumus omnipotens Deus Sancti Spiritus perfundantur benedictione et intercedente beato Barnaba apostolo tuo in nostris cordibus tuam infundant dilectionem.
translation_en: In Your presence, we humbly ask, Almighty God, that the gifts may be bestowed by the Holy Spirit, blessed and through the intercession of the blessed Barnabas, your apostle. May Your love be poured into our hearts.

text: Beati Barnabae apostoli tui nos quaesumus Domine festa tueantur et munera quae sumpsimus tuae maiestatis eius commendet oratio veneranda.
translation_en: Blessed be thy Apostle Barnabas, we humbly ask you, Lord. May his feast days protect us and may the gifts we have received be committed to your majesty through a venerable prayer.

text: Sanctorum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii quaesumus Domine natalicia nobis votiva resplendeant et quod illis contulit excellentiam sempiternam fructibus nostrae devotionis accrescat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may the birthdays of Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor and Nazarius shine upon us with their vowed sanctity, and may the eternal excellence they have granted increase our fruitful devotion towards them.

text: Pro sanctorum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii sanguine venerando hostias tibi Domine sollemniter immolamus tua mirabilia pertractantes per quem talis est perfecta victoria.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the sacrifices of Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor and Nazarius, honoring their blood. We celebrate solemnly, contemplating your marvels through whom such a complete victory is achieved.

text: Semper Domine sanctorum martyrum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii sollemnia celebrantes et eorum patrocinia iugiter sentiamus.
translation_en: Always, Lord, let us celebrate the solemnities of the holy martyrs Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor, and Nazarius, and may we always feel their patronage.

text: Da Ecclesiae tuae Domine quaesumus sanctis martyribus tuis Vito Modesto atque Crescentia intercedentibus superbe non sapere sed tibi placita humilitate proficere ut proterva despiciens quaecumque matura sunt libera exerceat caritate.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your Church, through the intercession of your holy martyrs Vito, Modesto, and Crescentia, that it may not be proud but progress by humility, despising what is haughty, and exercise what is mature by love.

text: Refecti Domine benedictione sollemni quaesumus ut per intercessionem sanctorum Viti Modesti atque Crescentiae medicina sacramenti et corporibus nostris prosit et mentibus.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you bless us with a solemn benediction after our meal. May the intercession of Saints Vitus, Modestus, and Crescentia bring healing to our bodies and minds through the sacrament's medicine.

text: Exaudi nos Domine Deus noster cum sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cyriaci et Iulittae matris eius tibi patrocinio supplicantes ut quorum celebramus triumphum poscimus retinere constantiam.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord God our Savior, with the patronage of your holy martyrs Cyrus and Julitta, his mother, we humbly ask that, as we celebrate their triumph, you may grant us to maintain constancy.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine fidelium tuorum dona sollemnia sanctorum martyrum tuorum intercessionibus confitentes ut quod nos exsequimur minus idonea servitute illorum potius meritis efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the solemn gifts of your faithful, acknowledging the intercession of your holy martyrs. We confess that what we are doing is less worthy because of their slavery; rather, let it be accepted through their merits.

text: Quaesumus Domine ut salutaribus repleti mysteriis sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cyriaci et Iulittae quorum sollemnia celebremus eorum orationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that we may be filled with the saving mysteries of Your holy martyrs Cyrus and Julitta, whose feast days we celebrate; help us to be aided by their prayers.

text: Suscipe Domine munera tuorum populorum votiva et sanctorum Marci et Marcelliani precibus esse grata concede pro quorum sollemnitatibus offeruntur.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the gifts of your people, offered in a vow, and be gracious through the prayers of St. Marc and St. Marcellian. Grant this for their solemnities which are being offered.

text: Libantes Domine mensae tuae beata mysteria quaesumus ut beatorum interventione sanctorum Marci et Marcelliani et temporalem nobis misericordiam conferat aeternam.
translation_en: Lifting up, Lord, your blessed mysteries on our tables, we humbly ask that through the intervention of the saints Marc and Marcellian, you grant us temporary mercy here on earth and eternal one.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut his muneribus quae pro sanctorum martyrum Gervasii et Protasii honore deferimus et te placeamus exhibitis et nos vivificemur acceptis.
translation_en: Grant to us, almighty God, that with these offerings we present in honor of the holy martyrs Gervasius and Protasius, may we please you and be revived by your acceptance.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut mysteriorum virtute satiati sanctorum Gervasii et Protasii orationibus vita nostra firmetur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask You, almighty God, that through the power of the mysteries, the lives of the saints Gervasius and Protasius may strengthen our life.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Iacobi apostoli tui sollemnia colimus eius apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask You, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of Your apostle James, may his intercessions with You aid us.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente beato Ioanne Baptista nos per haec a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, we offer these gifts; may they be sanctified. Through the intercession of blessed John the Baptist, purify us through these from the stains of our sins.

text: Deus qui praesentem diem honorabilem nobis in beati Ioannis nativitate fecisti: da populis tuis spiritalium gratiam gaudiorum et omnium fidelium mentes dirige in viam salutis aeternae.
translation_en: God who made this day honorable for us on the nativity of Saint John, grant your people spiritual grace of joy and direct all minds of the faithful into the way of eternal salvation.

text: Sumat Ecclesia tua Deus in beati Ioannis Baptistae generatione laetitiam per quem suae regenerationis cognovit auctorem.
translation_en: Your church takes joy in God during the generation of blessed John the Baptist, through whom He came to know the author of His own re-birth.

text: Hostias tibi Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum Ioannis et Pauli dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, graciously accept the offerings of your holy martyrs John and Paul, and grant us their assistance to come to our aid forever.

text: Deus qui beatum Leonem pontificem sanctorum tuorum meritis coaequasti: concede quaesumus ut qui commemorationis eius festa percolimus vitae quoque imitemur exempla.
translation_en: God, who through the merits of the blessed Pope Leo made him equal to your saints: grant us that we who celebrate his festival may also imitate his examples in life.

text: Annue nobis Domine quaesumus ut animae famuli tui Leonis haec prosit oblatio quam immolando totius mundi tribuisti relaxari delicta.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, that the offering which we present for your servant Leo may profit him, as you have given to relieve sins when offering was made of the whole world.

text: Deus qui animae famuli tui Leonis aeternae beatitudinis praemia contulisti: concede propitius ut qui peccatorum nostrorum pondere premimur eius apud te precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who bestowed upon the soul of your servant Leo the rewards of eternal beatitude: grant us mercifully that we, burdened by the weight of our sins, may be assisted by his prayers before you.

text: VD ... aequum et salutare. Te Domine suppliciter exorare ut gregem tuum pastor aeterne non deseras sed per beatos apostolos tuos continua protectione custodias. Ut iisdem rectoribus gubernetur quos operis tui vicarios eidem contulisti praeesse pastores. Et ideo.
translation_en: It is just and salvific. O Lord, we humbly beseech you that your flock, the eternal shepherd, may never be deserted but may always be protected by your blessed apostles. Let the same shepherds be governed whom you have appointed to preside over your work as vicars, pastors. And therefore.

text: Ecclesiae tuae Domine preces et hostias apostolica commendet oratio ut quod pro illorum gloria celebramus nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: Lord, may your church commit to us through an apostolic prayer the petitions and offerings, so that what we celebrate for their glory may benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis beato Paulo apostolo interveniente deprecamur ut quae pro illius celebrata sunt gloria nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, perceiving the sacraments through blessed Paul the Apostle's intervention, we humbly ask that what was gained for his glory may profit us towards healing.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum martyrum tuorum Processi et Martiniani confessionibus gloriosis circumdas et protegis: da nobis et eorum imitatione proficere et intercessione gaudere.
translation_en: God who surrounds and protects us by the glorious confessions of your saints Processius and Martinianus: grant that we may progress in their example, and rejoice in their intercession.

text: Suscipe Domine preces et munera quae ut tuo sint digna conspectui sanctorum tuorum precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers and offerings, which we present as worthy before the sight of your saints; we are aided by your prayers.

text: Sacramenta salutis nostrae suscipientes concede quaesumus misericors Deus ut beati Martini nos ubique oratio adiuvet in cuius veneratione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: Granting the sacraments of our salvation, we humbly ask you, merciful God, that the prayers of blessed Martin may aid us everywhere, whose veneration we have offered to Your majesty in this presentation.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine preces et munera quae ut tuo sint digna conspectui apostolorum tuorum quaesumus precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, our prayers and gifts, which we ask may be worthy of Your apostles' sight. With our prayers, we are helped.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui gloriosos martyres Felicem Philippum Vitalem Martialem Alexandrum Silvanum et Ianuarium fortes in sua confessione cognovimus pios apud te in nostra intercessione sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that we who have known the glorious martyrs Felicitas, Philip, Vitalis, Martialis, Silvanus, and Januarius to be strong in their confession, may also feel them to be devout on our behalf in your presence.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedentibus sanctis tuis illius salutaris capiamus effectum cuius per haec mysteria pignus accepimus.
translation_en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we may receive the effect of Your salvation through the intercession of Your saints, to whom we have pledged ourselves by these sacraments.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per gloriosa beati Benedicti abbatis exempla humilitatis nobis triumphale iter ostendisti: da quaesumus ut viam tibi placitam oboedientiae per quam venerabilis pater Benedictus illaesus incedebat nos praeclaris eius meritis adiuti sine errore subsequamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through the glorious example of humility shown by blessed Benedict, abbot, have led us triumphantly: grant us, we ask, that we may follow in the way pleasing to you with obedience, as the venerable father Benedict, unharmed, walked. Supported by his great merits, may we follow without error.

text: Paternis intercessionibus magnifici pastoris Benedicti quaesumus Domine familiae tuae commendetur oratio cuius vitalibus decoratur exemplis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercessions of your glorious shepherd St. Benedict, our family may be committed to your prayers, whose life is adorned with his exemplary virtues.

text: Perceptis Domine Deus noster salutaribus sacramentis humiliter te deprecamur ut intercedente beato confessore tuo Benedicto atque abbate quae pro illius venerando agimus translatione nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Humbly we beseech you, Lord our God, through the salutary sacraments perceived, that through the intercession of your blessed confessor Benedict and Abbot, may what we do for his venerable translation profit us to salvation.

text: Deus qui beatam Margaritam virginem hodierna die ad caelos per martyrii palmam venire fecisti: concede nobis quaesumus ut eius exempla sequentes ad tua promissum pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: God who brought the blessed Margaret virgin today to heaven through the palm of martyrdom: grant us, we ask, that following her example, we may merit to reach your promised heaven.

text: Haec victima Domine quaesumus pro beatae virginis Margaritae festivitate oblata et mentium nobis sanctitatem et corporum obtineat sanitatem.
translation_en: This victim, Lord, we ask for the feast of Blessed Virgin Margaret. May it grant us holiness in mind and health in body.

text: Huius Domine sacramenti perceptione et beatae Margaritae virginis intercessione et tu in nobis manere dignare et nos in te iugiter manere concede.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, through the reception of this sacrament and the intercession of blessed Margaret the Virgin, to dwell with you always and constantly grant us to remain in you.

text: Deus qui in tuorum divisione apostolorum gentium multitudinem in unitatem fidei et in agnitionem tui sancti nominis convocasti: quaesumus aures tuae pietatis sanctae matris Ecclesiae precibus inclina et praesta ut quorum te instantia agnovimus horum obtentu in confessione veritatis tuae secure firmiterque maneamus.
translation_en: God, who in your division of the apostles gathered the multitude of nations into unity of faith and recognition of your holy name: we humbly ask that you incline the ears of your gracious mercy towards the prayers of the holy mother Church, and grant that we, for whom we seek your acknowledgment, may firmly and securely remain in confession of your truth.

text: Sumptis Domine donis tuis in sanctorum dispersione apostolorum quaesumus ut sicut illorum fidei vocatione gentium diversitatem in unam sanctae Trinitatis fidem accendisti ita eorum nobis obtentu tua facias prodesse sacramenta.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, with the gifts you have provided for the scattering of the apostles, that just as their call to faith ignited the diversity of nations into one faith in the holy Trinity, so may their intercession make your grace beneficial to us through the sacraments.

text: Deus qui beatum Benedictum martyrii passioni peracta lugubri sessione aquilae declaratum totius nostrae gentis fecisti provisorem: praesta deprecamur ut cuius multimoda miraculorum tuitione gloriamur eum apud te indefessum sentiamus intercessorem. Per Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: God, who made blessed Benedict a provider for our entire people after he was declared a martyr by the mournful session of the eagle in his passion: grant us that we may feel him as an unwavering intercessor through whose numerous miracles we glory. Through our Lord.

text: Praesta quaesumus aeterne Deus ut Benedicto martyre tuo promerente proficiat nobis haec oblatio quae potuit esse totius saeculi delictorum abolitio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, eternal God, that through the intercession of your blessed martyr, this offering may be for us the abolition of all the sins of the entire age.

text: Petimus immensae Deus caelestis mysterii participatione recreasti ut eo quod temporaliter agimus interveniente martyre tuo Benedicto vitamur aeternaliter renovati. Per Dominum.
translation_en: We ask, O God of the immense heavenly mystery, that through Your participation we are restored so that, with the intervention of Your blessed Martyr, we may live eternally renewed. Through the Lord.

text: Suscipe tibi oblata nostra munera Deus et concede ut beati Alexii confessoris tui cuius celebramus sollemnia nos foveant continuata praesidia.
translation_en: Receive, O God, the offerings that we bring to you, and grant that the continued protection of your blessed confessor Saint Alexander, whose feast we celebrate, may sustain us.

text: Deus qui beatum Andream confessorem tuum latentis certamine passionis afflictum consortem esse voluisti beatae immortalitatis: praesta ut cuius meritis corporeis deliberamur languoribus eo intercedente mereamur possidere spiritualem laetitiam iucunditatis.
translation_en: God, who willed that your blessed apostle Andrew, the confessor, afflicted by the hidden struggle of passion, should be a companion of eternal beatitude: grant that we may be delivered from bodily infirmities through his intercession, so that meriting spiritual joy, we may possess the delight of bliss.

text: Offerentes tibi quaesumus Domine Deus in commemoratione beati confessoris tui Andreae salutiferum aeterni nectaris libamen ut eiusdem patroni nostri intercessione nobis condonetur inconcussum defensionis tutamen.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord God, in the commemoration of your blessed confessor Andrew, that you accept from us a salutary eternal offering of incense, so that through the intercession of the same patron saint we may be given unshaken protection.

text: Corpore et sanguine Filii tui Iesu Christi refecti omnipotens Deus tuam deposcimus clementiam ut assidua confessoris tui Andreae supplicatio nobis obtineat ad optandam peccatorum indulgentiam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, through the body and blood of your Son Jesus Christ, that your mercy may always be obtained for us by the constant intercession of your servant Andrew, so that we may receive forgiveness of sins.

text: Exaudi Domine quaesumus preces nostras et interveniente beato Arnulpho confessore tuo atque pontifice supplicationes nostras placatus intende.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, we humbly ask that you consider our prayers, and with the intervention of your confessed servant Saint Arnulf and your bishop, incline to listen to our petitions.

text: In tuo conspectu Domine quaesumus digna nostra sint munera quae intercedente beato Arnulpho confessore tuo atque pontifice et placare te valeant et nos tibi placere perficiant.
translation_en: In your presence, Lord, we humbly ask that our offerings may be worthy in your sight. Through the intercession of Blessed Arnulf, your confessor and bishop, may they have the power to appease you and make us pleasing to you.

text: Conservent nos Domine quaesumus sacramenta quae sumpsimus et intercedente beato Arnulpho confessore tuo atque pontifice vitam nostram nobis tribuant postulantibus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech You, that the sacraments which we have received may preserve us; and through the intercession of the Blessed Arnulf, Your confessor and pope, grant us life, those who ask for it.

text: Os iusti*
translation_en: The mouth of the righteous

text: Lex Dei*
translation_en: Law of God

text: Iste sanctus*
translation_en: This is holy

text: Veritas mea*
translation_en: My truth

text: Domine Deus noster qui nos ineffabilis misericordiae tuae thesauros concedis in utriusque testamenti patribus admirantes contemplari: praesta quaesumus ut qui magni prophetae et beati Eliae hodierna die translationem meruimus venerari eius interventu tua gratia ab angustiis carnis educti tuae dilectionis suaviter mereamur igne comburi.
translation_en: Lord God, our provider of the ineffable treasures of your mercy, who allows us to admire them in both testaments' fathers: we humbly ask that, since we have merited today to venerate the translation of the great prophet Elijah through your grace, we may be freed from earthly distresses and, sweetened by your love, deserve to be burned by fire.

text: In diebus illis. Factum est sermo Domini ad Eliam Thesbiten dicens: Surge et vade.
translation_en: On those days, the Lord spoke to Elijah the Tishbite, saying: "Arise and go."

text: In illo tempore. Dixerunt Pharisaei ad Iesum: Quanta audivimus.
translation_en: At that time, the Pharisees said to Jesus: What have we heard?

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus in translatione sancti Eliae prophetae obsecrantes ut eius meritis et precibus spiritus nostrae carneae corruptionis molestias fastidiat et caelestis amplitudinem gloriae super omnia quae videntur concupiscat et ineffabili pietate tua feliciter obtineat.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, this sacrifice of our devotion on the translation of Saint Elijah the prophet, imploring that through his merits and prayers may our spirit's carnal corruption be relieved from its troubles, and may it eagerly desire the celestial vastness of glory above all things which seem desirable. May it attain eternal happiness in Your ineffable love.

text: Ineffabili dulcedine spiritalis pabuli corporis et sanguinis Filii tui recreati maiestatem tuam Deus piissime deprecamur ut qui hodie magni prophetae beati Eliae translationem colimus corruptibiles nostrae carnis angustias horreamus et semper caelestibus gaudiis inhiantes eius meritis et precibus circa nos gratiae subsidia sentiamus donec ad tuae visionem claritatis pertingere valeamus.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your most merciful majesty, revitalized by the ineffable sweetness of the spiritual food and body and blood of your Son, that we who today celebrate the translation of the great prophet blessed Elijah may be freed from the distresses of our corruptible flesh and always long for heavenly joys through his merits and prayers. May we feel the aid of your graces around us until we are able to approach your vision of clarity.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatae Praxedis martyris tuae natalicia colimus et annua sollemnitate laetemur et tantae fidei perficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the birthday of your blessed martyr Praxedis and rejoice on its annual feast day, may also be perfected in such great faith by her example.

text: Hostias Domine quaesumus quas in sanctorum tuorum nataliciis recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvant et tuae nobis misericordiae dona concilient.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offerings we present during the birthdays of your saints may forgive our wickedness and bring us together with your mercy.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem sacratissimam nobis beati Wandregesilii confessoris tui atque abbatis sollemnitate tribuisti: adesto propitius Ecclesiae tuae precibus ut cuius gloriatur meritis muniamur suffragiis.
translation_en: God who today bestowed upon us the most sacred day of your confessor and abbot, Blessed Wandregisilus: be present propitiously to your Church, that we may be fortified with his merits through your aid.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine laudis offerimus pro sancti celebritate Wandregesilii confessoris tui atque abbatis propitiationem tuam quam nostris operibus non meremur pii suffragatoribus intercessoribus assequamur.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, a sacrifice of praise for the sanctity of Your confessor and abbot Wandregesilius. May we obtain Your favor which our works do not deserve, through Your pious advocates and intercessors.

text: Tua sancta sumentes quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut beati Wandregesilii confessoris tui atque abbatis nos foveant continuata praesidia.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord our God, that the holy ones take up for us, so that they may continue to protect us with the unwavering support of Blessed Wandregisilus, your confessor and abbot.

text: Deus qui beatae Mariae Magdalene cor ad paenitentiam compunxisti et ei flenti sua crimina misericorditer indulsisti ipsius quaesumus meritis corda nostra ad paenitendam dignanter compunge et tuae pietatis indulgentiam nobis misericorditer concede.
translation_en: God, who compassionately softened the heart of the Blessed Mary Magdalene for penitence and mercifully forgave her weeping sins, we humbly ask that through her merits, our hearts may be worthy of sincere repentance and grant us mercifully your pity's indulgence.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine propitius suscipe et beata Maria Magdalene intercedente ab omnibus nos peccatis propitiatus absolve ut percepta venia peccatorum liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously receive our offerings. Through the intercession of the blessed Mary Magdalene, may you forgive us all our sins and absolve us, so that with minds free from sin we may serve you freely because of the grace of forgiven sins.

text: Largire nobis clementissime Pater sacris muneribus satiatis quod sicut beata Maria Magdalene Dominum nostrum super omnia diligendo suorum obtinuit veniam peccaminum ita nobis apud misericordiam tuam culparum indulgentiam ac sempiternam obtineat beatitudinem.
translation_en: Generously grant us, most merciful Father, with holy offerings, satisfaction for what we have done. Just as blessed Mary Magdalene obtained the forgiveness of our sins above all by loving your people deeply, so may we obtain remission of our offenses and eternal beatitude through your mercy.

text: Beati sacerdotis et martyris tui Apollinaris quaesumus Domine sua nos intercessione commendet oratio ut tibi placito fulti suffragio quam precamur indulgentiam peccatorum consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to commend the prayer of your priest and martyr Apollinaris to you, through his intercession. May we who pray be filled with the favor that we are asking for, so that we may deserve the indulgence of sins.

text: Suscipe clementissime omnipotens Deus et sanctifica hoc sacrificium populi tui ut quod in honore sacerdotis et martyris tui Apollinaris offerimus ad gloriam nobis prosit ad veniam.
