translation_en: Receive most mercifully, omnipotent God, and sanctify this sacrifice of your people that what we offer in honor of your priest and martyr Apollinaris may benefit us for glory and grant us forgiveness.

text: Beati sacerdotis et martyris tui Domine Apollinaris annua festivitate clementiam tuam optantes supplices exoramus omnipotens Deus ut sicut illi optanti agone certaminis triumphali redimitus exsultat corona ita et nos orationum eius fulti suffragio temptationum tela superantes bracchio laetemur aeterno.
translation_en: Blessed are the priest and martyr yours, Lord Apollinaris, we humbly ask for your clemency annually during this festivity, O almighty God. May it be that, just as he was victorious in the triumphant contest and crowned after seeking redemption, so too may we rejoice with the victory of his prayers' support over temptations, everlasting joy in our arm.

text: Esto Domine plebi tuae sanctificator et custos ut apostoli tui Iacobi munita praesidiis et conversatione tibi placeat et secura mente deserviat.
translation_en: May, Lord, your people be a sanctifier and protector, that they may be fortified by the guardianship of your apostle James, and please you with their conversation, and may they serve you with a safe mind.

text: Oblationes populi tui Domine quaesumus beati apostoli tui Iacobi passio conciliet et quae nostris non aptae sunt meritis fiant tibi placitae eius deprecatione.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, for the oblations of your people. May the passion of your blessed apostle James bring together what is not fitting for us due to our unworthy merits, and may they become pleasing to you through his intercession.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine clementer suscipe et intercedente beato Christophoro martyre tuo nobis salutaria esse concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously accept these offerings and, through the intercession of blessed Christopher, your martyr, grant us a beneficial outcome.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui in commemoratione beati Christophori martyris tui tua mysteria percepimus ipsius continuo praesidio muniamur. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who have received your mysteries in commemoration of the blessed Christopher the martyr, may be continually protected by his guardianship. Through the Lord.

text: Dispensator Pater optime congregator qui beatum Nazarium et Celsum unum ab oriente et alterum ab extremo terrae in unum congregasti et nobis summos donasti patronos poscimus clementissime Pater ut pro nobis sint intercessores quos credimus in aeternum esse mansuros.
translation_en: Most graciously gathering Father, who gathered the blessed Nazarius and Celsus, one from the east and another from the end of the earth into one, and bestowed upon us the greatest patrons. We most humbly ask you, most merciful Father, that they may be intercessors for us whom we believe will endure forever.

text: Preces nostras Domine tuorum respice oblationesque fidelium ut tibi gratae sint tuorum festivitate sanctorum et nobis conferant tuae propitiationis auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, look upon our prayers and regard the offerings of your faithful, that they may be pleasing to you during the festivity of your saints. May their assistance be granted to us because of your propitiations.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Nazarii et Celsi quaesumus Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporali celebramus actione perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, through the intercession of your saints Nazarius and Celsus, that being pleased, you grant what we ask. We pray that what we celebrate temporarily in this world may be attained by us eternally through salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sanctis praecipue laudaris et mirabiliter praedicaris: tribue nobis quaesumus hodiernam diem in honore sancti Samsonis confessoris tui atque pontificis digne celebrare quia membris exutus corporeis caelestibus meruit exsultare sacramentis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who is especially praised by the saints and wonderfully proclaimed: grant us, we pray, that today we may worthily celebrate the day in honor of your confessor and bishop Saint Samson, since he, stripped of bodily members, merited to rejoice in heavenly sacraments.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine Deus noster quam tibi ad honorem sancti Samsonis confessoris tui atque pontificis immolandam deferimus tuorum nobis tribuat societate gaudere sanctorum.
translation_en: This offering we ask you, Lord our God, that the Hostia (offering) which we bring to honor your confessor and bishop St. Samson, may enjoy the fellowship of saints with us.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sicut populus Christianus martyrum tuorum Felicis Simplicii Faustini et Beatricis temporali sollemnitate congaudet ita perfruatur aeterna et quod votis celebrat comprehendat effectu.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that just as the Christian people rejoice in the temporal feast of Your martyrs Felicitas, Simplicius, Faustinus, and Beatrix, so they may also experience eternal joy, and whatever they celebrate with their vows may be fulfilled with effect.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum Simplicii Faustini et Beatricis commemoratione deferimus simpliciter obsecrantes ut et indulgentiam nobis pariter conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the hosts for the commemoration of your holy martyrs Simplicius, Faustinus, and Beatrix, humbly asking that you grant us forgiveness as well as health.

text: Infirmitatem nostram respice omnipotens Deus et quia pondus propriae actionis gravat beati Felicis martyris tui atque pontificis intercessio gloriosa nos protegat.
translation_en: Look upon our infirmity, O Almighty God, and since the weight of our actions burdens the blessed Felix, your martyr and bishop, may his glorious intercession protect us.

text: Spiritum nobis Domine tuae caritatis infunde ut quos caelesti pane satiasti intercedente beato Felice martyre tuo atque pontifice tua facias pietate concordes.
translation_en: Pour down upon us, Lord, Your charity's Spirit, that You have satisfied with the heavenly bread, through the intercession of blessed Felix, Your martyr and pope, may You make us harmonious in piety.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine quam in sanctorum tuorum natalicia recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: This offering we ask, Lord, which on the birthdays of your saints we present; and may it loose the bonds of our wickedness and unite us with your mercy.

text: Per huius Domine operationem mysterii et vitia nostra purgentur et intercedentibus sanctis tuis iusta desideria compleantur.
translation_en: Through the operation of this Lord, our sins will be purged and our just desires completed with the intercession of your saints.

text: Votiva mysteria tua Domine sanctorum tuorum sollemnia celebrantes devota mente tractemus quibus nobis quaesumus et praesidium crescat et gaudium.
translation_en: While celebrating your vows, O Lord, we humbly beseech you. May the strength of your saints grow as our protection and joy increase for us.

text: Deus qui ad celebrandum nobis honorabile praesentis diei festum in beatorum martyrum tuorum Stephani Nicodemi Gamalielis atque Abybon inventione tribuisti: te suppliciter exoramus ut ipsis intercedentibus mereamur in caelestibus inveniri.
translation_en: God, who for our honorable celebration on this day's festival of the discovery of your blessed martyrs Stephen, Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Abybbas, have granted: we humbly entreat you that through their intercession, we may deserve to be found in heaven.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine fidelium tuorum votis oblatum serenus admitte ut quod dilecto martyri tuo Stephani hodiernam inventionis suae gloriam contulit nobis prosit ad medelam redemptionis aeternae.
translation_en: Lord, we offer you the sacrifice of our faithful, accept it serenely. May what today's discovery of your beloved martyr Stephen brought us regarding its glory contribute to our healing in the eternal redemption.

text: Epularum tuarum alimento saginati te humiliter rogamus Dominus Deus ut beati protomartyris tui Stephani meritis ubique nos adiuves cuius hodie revelationis sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Lord God to help us everywhere with the merits of your blessed first martyr Stephen, whose feast day we celebrate today.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sacra protomartyris tui Stephani membra fidelibus tuis hodierna die revelare voluisti: concede ut intercessionis eius auxilio nos ab instantibus tribulationibus liberari et futuris consolationibus sociari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who revealed the sacred body of your protomartyr Stephen to your faithful ones today: grant that through his intercession we may be freed from the immediate tribulations and associated with future consolations.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus sancte Pater omnipotens munera quae pro gloriosa Filii tui transfiguratione deferimus et concede propitius ut per haec et a temporalibus liberemur incommodis et gaudiis connectamur aeternis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we ask you, holy Father almighty, the gifts which we bring on behalf of the glorious Transfiguration of your Son, and grant us graciously, that through these we may be freed from temporal troubles and united with eternal joys.

text: Intra quorum nos consortium non aestimator meriti sed veniae quaesumus largitor admitte.
translation_en: Within whose company we find ourselves, not as estimators of merit but as seekers of forgiveness, we humbly ask you, the generous grantor, to admit us.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut cuius nobis festivitate votiva sunt sacramenta eius intercessione salutaria nobis reddantur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that the sacred rites which are for us a votive feast, may through his intercession bring salvation to us.

text: Munera tibi Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus quae et pro tuorum tibi grata sint honore iustorum et nobis salutaria te miserante reddantur.
translation_en: We present to You, Lord, the offerings of our devotedness, which may be pleasing to You as a token of honor from the righteous and may return salvation to us when You show mercy.

text: Praesta nobis Domine intercedentibus sanctis tuis Felicissimo et Agapito ut quae ore contingimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, through the intercession of your saints Felicitas and Agapitus, that what we touch with our mouth may be received with a pure mind.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sancti martyris tui et episcopi Donati precibus quem ad laudem nominis tui dicatis muneribus honoramus piae nobis devotionis fructus accrescat.
translation_en: Grant, we ask You, Lord, that the fruits of devoutness may increase for us through the prayers of Your holy martyr and bishop Donatus, whom we honor with the gifts bestowed in praise of Your name.

text: Votiva Domine dona quae pro beati martyris tui et episcopi Donati sollemnitate percepimus quaesumus ut eius precibus et vitae praesentis nobis pariter et aeternae tribuas conferre subsidium.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, to grant us the vows that we have received on the feast day of Your blessed martyr and bishop Donatus. We ask that through his prayers and the example of his life, you bestow upon us both temporal and eternal assistance.

text: Deus qui nobis annua beati Cyriaci martyris tui sociorumque sollemnitate laetificas: concede propitius ut quorum natalicia colimus virtutem quoque passionis imitemur.
translation_en: God who delights us with the annual feast of your blessed martyr Cyriacus and his companions: graciously grant that we may celebrate their natality and imitate their virtue as well as their passion.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut interveniente beato Cyriaco martyre tuo sociisque eius sacrosancta mysteria quae sumpsimus actu subsequamur et sensu.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that with the intervention of your blessed martyr Cyrus, and his companions, we may follow the sacred mysteries which we have received in both action and understanding.

text: Hostias Domine quas tibi offerimus propitius suscipe et intercedente beato Laurentio martyre tuo vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolve.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive the offerings we present to you. Through the intercession of the blessed martyr Lawrence, may you release us from the bonds of our sins.

text: Da quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut beati Laurentii martyris tui commemoratione temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur aspectu.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that just as we rejoice on the temporal commemoration of your blessed martyr Laurence, so may we be eternally joyful in your sight.

text: Excita Domine in Ecclesia tua spiritum cui beatus Laurentius levita servivit ut eodem nos replente studeamus amare quod amavit et opere exercere quod docuit. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Stir up, Lord, within Your church the Spirit that blessed Laurence the Levite served, so that filled with the same Spirit we may strive to love what he loved and practice what he taught. Through the Lord.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi Domine beati Laurentii precatio sancta conciliet ut cuius honore sollemniter exhibetur meritis efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: Our sacrifice to you, Lord, through the blessed Laurence, may a holy prayer unite so that it is made acceptable due to his merits when he is solemnly displayed with honor.

text: Sacro munere satiati supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quod debitae servitutis celebramus officio intercedente beato Laurentio salvationis tuae sentiamus augmentum.
translation_en: Having been filled by the sacred duty, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that since we are celebrating the service due to our obligated state, through the intercession of Blessed Laurence, we may feel an increase in your salvation.

text: Sumpsimus Domine pignus redemptionis aeternae sit nobis quaesumus interveniente beato Tiburtio martyre tuo vitae praesentis auxilium pariter et futurae.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the pledge of eternal redemption. Grant us, we beseech you, assistance in our present life and future help through your blessed martyr Tiburtius.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus ut beati Hippolyti martyris tui sociorumque eius veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that the venerable feast and devotion of the blessed Hippolytus the martyr and his companions may increase in us, and bring us salvation.

text: Respice munera Domine populi tui sanctorum festivitate votiva et tuae testificatio veritatis nobis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, the offerings of your holy people on this votive feast day, and may your testimony of truth bring profit to us for our salvation.

text: Deus qui nos beati Eusebii confessoris tui annua sollemnitate laetificas: concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus per eius ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God who delights us with the annual solemnity of your blessed confessor St. Eusebius: grant us favorably, that we may be pleased by his example as we celebrate his natal day.

text: Concede misericors Deus fragilitati nostrae subsidium ut qui sanctae Dei Genitricis requiem celebramus intercessionis eius auxilio a nostris iniquitatibus resurgamus.
translation_en: Gracious God, grant support to our frailty, that we who celebrate the peace of the holy Mother of God may rise from our sins with the help of her intercession.

text: Famulorum tuorum Domine delictis ignosce et qui tibi placere de actibus nostris non valemus Genitricis Filii tui Domini Dei nostri intercessione salvemur.
translation_en: Lord, forgive the sins of your servants and as we cannot please you with our actions, save us by the intercession of the Mother of Your Son, our Lord God.

text: VD ... Et te in veneratione sacrarum virginum exsultantibus animis laudare benedicere et praedicare. Inter quas intemerata Dei Genitrix Virgo Maria cuius assumptionis diem celebramus gloriosa effulsit quae et Unigenitum tuum Sancti Spiritus obumbratione concepit et virginitatis gloria permanente huic mundo lumen effudit Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum. Per quem.
translation_en: And you, in the reverence of the sacred virgins rejoicing spirits, we praise, bless, and proclaim. Among whom the Immaculate Mother of God, Virgin Mary, whose Assumption day we celebrate, shone gloriously. She who conceived your only-begotten Son by the veil of the Holy Spirit and as a symbol of virginity's glory shed light upon this world, Jesus Christ our Lord. Through whom.

text: Deus qui beatum Arnulphum confessorem tuum atque pontificem doctorem praecipuum catholicae quam fidei praedicatorem eligere dignatus es: praesta quaesumus ut ipso pro nobis intercedente peccatorum nostrorum exui malis et tibi Domino sinceris mentibus deservire possimus.
translation_en: God who deemed fit to choose blessed Arnulph, your confessor and bishop, a most distinguished teacher of the Catholic faith as a preacher: grant us that we may be able to serve you with sincere minds through his intercession, releasing us from the burdens of our sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatum Arnulphum confessorem tuum atque pontificem et pontificatus officio et fidei munere sublimasti: tribue quaesumus supplicibus tuis ut quicquid peccati contagione contractum est in nobis ipso pro nobis summo antistite tuo intercedente salvemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who exalted your confessor and bishop, blessed Arnulf, in the office of the pontificate and the charge of the faith: grant, we beseech you, to your humble supplicants, that whatever has been contracted by the contagion of sin within us may be saved through the intercession of your high priest, Arnulf.

text: Repleti sumus Domine muneribus tuis quae de festivitate beati Arnulphi confessoris tui atque pontificis percepimus tribue quaesumus ut eodem intercedente mundemur effectu et muniamur auxilio.
translation_en: We have been filled, Lord, with your gifts which we have received during the festival of your confessor and bishop, Blessed Arnulf. We humbly ask that you grant us so that through his intercession, we may be purified by its effect and fortified by his aid.

text: Beati Laurentii nos faciat Domine passio veneranda laetantes et ut eam sufficienter recolamus dignos efficiat.
translation_en: May the Lord make the passion of Blessed Laurence venerable for us, and may He render us worthy to celebrate it sufficiently.

text: Iterata festivitate beati Laurentii Domine natalicia veneramur quam in caelesti beatitudine fulgere sempiternam.
translation_en: Once again we approach the feast of blessed Laurence, O Lord, which we honor with reverence, shining eternally in heavenly beatitude.

text: Beati Laurentii martyris tui honorabilem passionem muneribus Domine geminatis <igne> exsequimur quae licet propriis sit memoranda principiis indesinenter tamen permanet gloriosa.
translation_en: We faithfully perform the honorable passion of the martyr Lawrence, which, though it can be remembered through personal principles, nevertheless continues to remain glorious.

text: Sollemne nobis intercessio beati Laurentii martyris tui quaesumus Domine praestet auxilium ut caelestis mensae participatio quam sumpsimus tribuat Ecclesiae tuae recensitam laetitiam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the intercession of the blessed martyr Lawrence may be granted to us. May it provide aid so that the joy we have received from participating in the heavenly banquet may be reported anew to your Church.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae in eius tibi sollemnitate deferimus cuius nos confidimus patrocinio liberari.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings which we bring to you on this solemnity, in whose protection we trust to be freed.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et intercedente beato martyre tuo Magno ab hostium nos defende propitiatus incursu.
translation_en: Attend to us, Lord, in our supplications, and protect us from the enemy with your blessed martyr Magnus, propitiated by your favor.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut humilitatis oblatio et pro tuorum tibi grata sit honore sanctorum et nos corpore pariter et mente sanctificet.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that our offering of humility may be pleasing to You in the honor of the saints and that we may be sanctified both body and mind.

text: Auxilium tuum nobis Domine quaesumus placatus impende et intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis Timotheo et Symphoriano dexteram super nos tuae propitiationis extende.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your aid be extended to us; may it be poured out upon us while You stand graciously among the intercessions of Your saints, martyrs Timothy and Symphorian. Extend over us the right hand of Your propitiation.

text: Divini muneris largitate satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedentibus sanctis tuis Timotheo atque Symphoriano eorum semper participatione vivamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through the abundance of your divine grace we may always live with the constant participation of your saints Timothy and Symphorian.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nobis huius diei venerandam sanctamque laetitiam in beati apostoli tui Bartholomaei festivitate tribuisti: da Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus et amare quod credidit et praedicare quod docuit. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day have granted us a venerable and holy joy in the feast of your apostle Bartholomew: grant to your Church, we beseech you, that they may believe what he believed and preach what he taught. Through our Lord.

text: Sumpsimus Domine pignus salutis aeternae celebrantes beati Bartholomaei apostoli tui votiva sollemnia et perpetua merita venerantes. Per
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the pledge of eternal salvation while celebrating the votive festivals of your blessed Apostle Bartholomew, and we respect the perpetual merits. Through

text: Deus qui perennem gloriam sanctissimi confessoris tui atque pontificis Audoëni animae contulisti: tribue quaesumus eius nos apud te patrociniis sublevari ut cum eo vitam possideamus aeternam.
translation_en: God, who granted eternal glory to the soul of your most holy confessor and bishop Audouen: grant us, we ask, that we may be raised up by his patronage among you, so that we may possess eternal life with him.

text: Oblata quaesumus Domine munera fidelis populi meritis beatissimi patris nostri Audoëni tibi reddantur accepta ut abiecta contagione peccati iisdem quibus famulamur mysteriis clementer emundari mereamur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the offerings of the faithful people be returned to you, through the merits of our most blessed father Audoin. May they be accepted so that, cast off from the contagion of sin, we may deserve to be cleansed mercifully by those same mysteries with which we serve.

text: Repleti Domine muneribus sacris quaesumus ut intercedente beato Audoëno confessore tuo atque pontifice in gratiarum semper actione maneamus.
translation_en: Filled, Lord, with sacred gifts, we ask that through the intercession of your confesseur Blessed Audoin and your bishop, we may always remain in your grateful service.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et beati Rufi intercessionibus confidentes nec minis adversantium nec ullo conturbemur incursu.
translation_en: Lord, attend to our supplications and with confidence in the intercessions of Blessed Rufus, let us not be moved by the threats of adversaries nor disturbed by any onslaught.

text: Deus qui beatos martyres tuos Hermetem atque Iulianum virtute constantiae in passione roborasti: ex eius nobis imitatione tribue pro amore tuo prospera mundi despicere et nulla eius adversa formidare.
translation_en: God, who strengthened your blessed martyrs Hermetes and Julian with constancy in passion: grant us, through their example, to despise the world for your love and not fear any adversity from it.

text: Repleti Domine benedictione caelesti quaesumus clementiam tuam ut intercedentibus beatis martyribus tuis Hermete et Iuliano quam humiliter gerimus salubriter sentiamus.
translation_en: Filled with heavenly blessings, we humbly ask Your clemency, Lord, that we may healthily perceive the feeling of Your grace through the intercession of Your blessed martyrs Hermes and Julian.

text: Munera tibi Domine pro sancti martyris tui Ioannis Baptistae passione deferimus quia dum finitur in terris factus est caelesti sede perpetuus quaesumus ut eius obtentu nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the gifts for Your holy martyr John the Baptist on account of his passion, because while he was finishing his earthly life, he became a permanent resident in heaven. We humbly ask that through his intercession we may profit towards salvation.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beatae Sabinae martyris tuae dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: The Lord accepts the offerings dedicated to you, Blessed Sabina, his martyr. May he graciously receive them and grant us eternal aid to come forth as support.

text: Hostias Domine tuae plebis intende et quas in honore sanctorum tuorum devota mente celebrat proficere sibi sentiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord, direct your attention to the offerings of your people and may he who with a devoted mind celebrates them, feel that they are advancing for his salvation.

text: Repleti Domine sacris muneribus quaesumus ut intercedentibus sanctis tuis in gratiarum semper actione maneamus.
translation_en: Lord, filled with sacred gifts, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your saints, we may always remain in the continual act of giving thanks.

text: Misericordiam tuam quaesumus Domine interveniente beato confessore tuo Fiacrio clementer impende et pro nobis peccatoribus eius propitiare suffragiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that with your blessed confessor Fiacri interceding, may your mercy be mercifully extended towards us sinners and be appeased by his merits on our behalf.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus fortitudo certantium et martyrum palma sollemnitatem hodiernae diei propitius intuere et Ecclesiam tuam continua fac celebritate laetari ut intercessione beati martyris tui Prisci omnium in te credentium vota perficias.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, graciously look upon the triumph of those who contend and the martyrs today, and may Your Church rejoice continuously with solemnity. May it be that through the intercession of Your blessed martyr Priscus, all prayers of those who believe in You are fulfilled.

text: Huius tibi precibus Domine quaesumus grata reddatur oblatio pro cuius est festivitate immolanda.
translation_en: With these prayers, Lord, we humbly ask that the offering be accepted favorably on behalf of whose feast day it is being offered.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sacramenti tui participatione vegetati sancti quoque martyris tui Prisci precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Lord, that we may be nourished by the participation in your sacrament, and assisted by the prayers of your holy martyr Priscus.

text: VD ... per Christum Dominum nostrum. Et praecipue pro meritis beatae Dei Genitricis et perpetuae Virginis Mariae gratia plenae tuam omnipotentiam laudare benedicere et praedicare. Per quem.
translation_en: We beseech you... through Christ our Lord. And especially for the merits of the blessed God's Mother and perpetual Virgin Mary, full of grace, to praise, bless, and proclaim your omnipotence. Through whom.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Hadriani martyris tui natalicia colimus a cunctis malis imminentibus eius intercessionibus liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the natal day of Your blessed martyr Hadrian, may be freed from all dangers approaching us through his intercessions.

text: Grata tibi sit Domine nostra servitutis oblatio pro qua sanctus Gorgonius martyr interventor exsistat.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to You, Lord, our offering of service. For which, the holy Gorgonius, the martyr, may intervene.

text: Beatorum Proti et Hyacinthi nos Domine foveat pretiosa confessio et pia iugiter intercessione tueatur.
translation_en: Lord, may the confession of the blessed Protus and Hyacinth keep us warm and their constant pious intercession protect us.

text: Ut percepta nos Domine tua sancta purificent beatorum Proti et Hyacinthi quaesumus imploret oratio.
translation_en: That your holy ones, Lord, may purify us as they were purified, we humbly ask that your prayer intercede on behalf of Blessed Protus and Hyacinth.

text: Deus qui nos hodierna die Exaltatione sanctae Crucis annua sollemnitate laetificas: praesta ut cuius mysterium in terra cognovimus eius redemptionis praemia mereamur.
translation_en: God, who on this day of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross delights us with an annual solemnity, grant that we may deserve the rewards of the mystery whose manifestation we have known on earth.

text: Adesto familiae tuae quaesumus clemens et misericors Deus in adversis et prosperis preces exaudias et nefas adversariorum per auxilium sanctae Crucis digneris conterere ut portum salutis tuae valeat apprehendere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, O gracious and merciful God, to be present with your family in times of adversity and prosperity. Grant that you hear their prayers, and by the help of the Holy Cross, may you crush the wickedness of enemies so they cannot hinder the safe harbor of your family.

text: Infirmitatem nostram quaesumus Domine propitius respice et mala omnia quae iuste meremur sanctorum tuorum Cornelii et Cypriani intercessione averte.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look upon our infirmity with favor and turn away all the evils that we justly deserve through the intercession of your saints Cornelius and Cyprian.

text: Plebis tuae Domine munera benignus intende quae maiestati tuae pro sanctorum tuorum Cornelii et Cypriani sollemnitate sunt dicata.
translation_en: Lord, with favor behold your people's offerings. They are dedicated to your majesty on the solemnity of your saints Cornelius and Cyprian.

text: Adesto Domine populo tuo ut beati Nicomedis martyris tui merita praeclara suscipiens ad impetrandam misericordiam tuam semper eius patrociniis adiuvemur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your people, so that we may be supported by the distinguished merits of blessed martyr Nicomedes. May his constant intercession help us in our appeal for your mercy.

text: Sanctificet nos Domine quaesumus tui perceptio sacramenti et intercessio beatae martyris tuae Euphemiae tibi reddat acceptos.
translation_en: May the Lord sanctify us, as we ask, through the perception of Your sacrament and the intercession of Your blessed martyr Euphemia may He receive our offerings.

text: Praesta Domine precibus nostris cum exsultatione provectum ut quorum diem passionis annua devotione recolimus etiam fidei constantiam consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, grant our prayers with joyful progress, that we may remember the day of your Passion with annual devotion and also follow constancy in faith.

text: Munera populi tui Domine propitius intende ut quorum nos tribuis sollemnia celebrare fac gaudere suffragiis. Per Christum.
translation_en: Lord, graciously incline Your ear to the gifts of Your people, that we may celebrate the solemnities You bestow upon us with joy and be strengthened by their intercessions. Through Christ.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus ut beati Matthaei apostoli tui et evangelistae quam praevenimus veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the venerable feast and devotion of your blessed apostle and evangelist Matthew may increase among us, and bestow upon us peace.

text: Apostolicae reverentiae culmen offerimus sacris mysteriis imbuendum praesta Domine quaesumus ut beati Matthaei evangelistae suffragiis cuius natalicia praeimus haec plebs tua semper et sua vota depromat et desiderata percipiat.
translation_en: With reverence of the Apostles, we offer you, Lord, who are about to be invested in sacred mysteries. We humbly ask you to grant that through the intercession of the blessed evangelist Matthew, whose feast day we celebrate today, this your people may always promote their prayers and desires, and receive what they long for.

text: Beati Matthaei evangelistae quaesumus Domine supplicatione placatus et veniam nobis tribue et remedia sempiterna concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you, being appeased by our supplication, grant us forgiveness and everlasting remedies.

text: Respice Domine munera quae in passione sanctorum martyrum tuorum Mauritii Exsuperii Candidi Victoris Innocentis et Vitalis ac sociorum eorundem deferimus et praesta ut quorum honore sunt grata eorum nobis fiant intercessione perpetua.
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, the gifts which we offer in the passion of your martyrs Mauritius, Exsuperius, Candidus, Victoris, Innocentius, Vitalis and their companions, and grant that through their honor they may become a perpetual intercession for us.

text: In tuorum Domine pretiosa morte iustorum sacrificium illud offerimus de quo martyrum sumpsit principium quod quaesumus propitiationis tuae nobis munus obtineat.
translation_en: In Your, Lord, the precious death of the righteous we offer this sacrifice, from which the beginning of martyrdom took root, which we humbly ask may obtain for us the gift of your propitiation.

text: Sit nobis Domine sacramenti tui certa libatio quae cum beatorum martyrum tuorum Cosmae et Damiani meritis imploratur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, a certain offering of your sacrament which is sought with the merits of your blessed martyrs Cosmas and Damian.

text: Beati archangeli tui Michaelis et omnium caelestium virtutum intercessione suffulti supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quod honore prosequimur contingamus et mente.
translation_en: Blessed are you, Archangel Michael and all heavenly powers whose intercession we seek. We humbly pray to you, Lord, that what we pursue with honor may be granted to us in mind.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beati Hieronymi confessoris tui dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Accept, O Lord, the offerings dedicated to your blessed confessor Jerome, and grant us everlasting aid to come from them.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum et sanctorum tuorum Germani Remigii Vedasti et Bavonis sollemnia celebrantes temporalis vitae nos tribue pace gaudere et aeternum reperire subsidium.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, your people and the saints, Remigius, Vedastus, and Baovinus, celebrating their festivals during this temporal life. Grant us to enjoy peace now and find eternal help.

text: Repleti sacramento reparationis humanae praesta quaesumus Domine ut per ea quae nobis munere dignaris praebere caelesti per haec eadem tribuas nobis inhaerere donis caelestibus.
translation_en: Filled with the sacrament of reparation, we humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us that through those things which you see fit to bestow upon us, may we be enabled to cling to heavenly gifts through these same means.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine preces nostras et interveniente beato Marco confessore tuo atque pontifice supplicationes nostras placatus intende.
translation_en: Hear us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, our prayers and, with the intervention of Blessed Mark, Thy confessor and bishop, incline to listen favorably to our supplications.

text: Sanctorum tuorum nos Domine Marcelli Pardulphi Apulei Sergii et Bacchi beata merita prosequantur et suo semper faciant amore ferventes.
translation_en: May your saints, Lord, Marcellus, Pardulus, Apuleius, Sergius, and Bacchus, through their blessed merits, follow us, and may they always make us fervent in love.

text: Sacramentis Domine muniamur acceptis et sanctorum tuorum Marcelli Pardulphi Apulei Sergii et Bacchi contra omnes nequitias irruentes armis caelestibus protegamur.
translation_en: Lord, may we be fortified by the sacraments and protected by your saints Marcellus, Pardulfus, Apuleius, Sergius, and Bacchus. May we be shielded against all attacks that assail us with celestial weapons.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatum Dionysium virtute constantiae in passione roborasti quique illi ad praedicandam gentibus gloriam tuam Rusticum et Eleutherium sociare dignatus es: tribue nobis quaesumus ex eorum imitatione pro amore tuo prospera mundi despicere et nulla eius adversa formidare. Per Dominum.
translation_en: God, who on this day strengthened the blessed Dionysius with constancy in his passion and saw fit to associate Rusticus and Eleutherius with him for the preaching of your glory among the nations: grant us, we beg you, through their imitation to despise the world for your love and fear no adversity of it. Through the Lord.

text: Interveniat pro nobis Domine quaesumus sanctus tuus Lucas evangelista qui crucis mortificationem iugiter in suo corpore pro tui nominis amore portavit.
translation_en: Let your saint, Luke the evangelist, intercede for us, we beseech you, Lord. He who constantly bore the mortification of the cross on his body out of love for your name.

text: Donis caelestibus da nobis quaesumus Domine libera mente servire ut munera quae deferimus interveniente evangelista tuo Luca et medelam nobis operentur et gloriam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us the grace of a free mind to serve with offerings. May the gifts we bring, accompanied by your evangelist Luke, bring healing to us and bring glory.

text: Muneribus nostris Domine apostolorum Simonis et Iudae festa praecedimus quaesumus ut quae conscientiae nostrae praepediuntur obstaculis illorum meritis grata reddantur.
translation_en: With the feast of our Apostles, Simon and Jude, we have preceded, we humbly ask that whatever impediments our conscience faces may, through their merits, be returned gratefully.

text: Sumpto Domine sacramento suppliciter deprecamur ut intercedentibus sanctis apostolis quod temporaliter gerimus ad vitam capiamus aeternam.
translation_en: Lord, with the sacrament presented, we humbly beseech You that, through the intercession of the holy apostles, what we temporarily possess, may lead us to eternal life.

text: Deus qui nos per beatos apostolos tuos Simonem et Iudam ad cognitionem tui nominis venire tribuisti: da nobis eorum gloriam sempiternam et proficiendo celebrare et celebrando proficere.
translation_en: God who through your blessed apostles, Simon and Judas, granted us to come into knowledge of your name: grant us their eternal glory and that we may progress in celebrating and by celebrating, progress.

text: Gloriam Domine sanctorum apostolorum perpetuam percurrentes quaesumus ut eandem sacris mysteriis expiati dignius celebremus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to traverse the eternal glory of the holy apostles. May we celebrate it more worthy in the sacred mysteries after being purified.

text: Erudi quaesumus Domine populum tuum spiritalibus instrumentis et quorum praestas sollemnia provenire fac eorum et consideratione devotum et defensione securum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you educate your people with spiritual instruments and make their solemnities come forth. May they be attentive and devoted, and protected by Your defense.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos omnium sanctorum veneranda sollemnitate laetificas: fac nos quaesumus eorum omnium semper habere patrocinium quibus regnum dare dignatus es perpetuum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who delights us in the venerable solemnity of all saints: grant that we may always have their patronage, for whom you have deemed worthy of eternal reign.

text: Munera tibi Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus quae et pro cunctorum tibi grata sint honore iustorum et nobis salutaria te miserante reddantur.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the gifts of our devotion which may be pleasing to you by the honor of the righteous and may return salvation to us as you have mercy on us.

text: VD ... Clementiam tuam suppliciter obsecrantes ut cum exsultantibus sanctis in caelestis regni cubilibus gaudia nostra coniungas et quos virtutis imitatione non possumus sequi debitae venerationis contingamus affectu. Per Christum.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your clemency that You may unite our joys with the rejoicing saints in the beds of the celestial kingdom, and those whom we are not able to follow by imitating their virtues, may we encounter by the feeling of due reverence. Through Christ.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus populis omnium sanctorum semper veneratione laetari et eorum perpetua supplicatione muniri.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that the faithful peoples of all saints may always rejoice with veneration and be protected by their perpetual intercession.

text: Deus qui nos beati Caesarii martyris tui annua sollemnitate laetificas: concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus etiam actus imitemur.
translation_en: God who delights us with the annual feast of your holy martyr Cesarius: grant graciously that we may not only celebrate his birthday, but also imitate his deeds.

text: Hostias tibi Domine beati Caesarii martyris tui dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: May the offerings given to You, Lord, to Your blessed martyr Caesar, be graciously accepted and may they provide us with eternal aid as support.

text: Benedictio tua Domine super nos larga descendat quae et munera nostra deprecantibus sanctis tuis tibi reddat accepta et nobis sacramentum redemptionis efficiat.
translation_en: May your blessing, Lord, abundantly descend upon us. May the gifts we ask of your saints be received by you and make us worthy of the sacrament of redemption.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quorum festivitate votiva sunt sacramenta eorum salutaria nobis intercessione reddantur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord our God, that the sacraments of those whose feast day is celebrated with a vow be returned to us as beneficial through their intercession.

text: Adesto supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus et quibus fiduciam sperandae pietatis indulges intercedente beato confessore tuo atque pontifice Brictio consuetae misericordiae tribue benignus effectum.
translation_en: Attend to our supplications, O almighty God, and grant us the confidence of hoped-for mercy through the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop Brictio, in accordance with your accustomed mercy, bestow a benign effect.

text: Sancti confessoris tui Brictii nobis Domine pia non desit oratio quae et munera nostra conciliet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper obtineat.
translation_en: Lord, may the prayers for your holy confessor Brichtius not cease for us. May it gather our offerings and always grant us your forgiveness.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum praesta quaesumus ut beati Brictii confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius venerandam celebramus festivitatem (eius) precibus indulgentiam peccatorum consequi mereamur.
translation_en: O God, rewarder of the faithful souls, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop Briccius, whose festival we reverently celebrate, we may deserve to obtain forgiveness for our sins.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Martini confessoris tui atque pontificis frequentata sollemnitas ad perpetuam populo tuo proficiat salutem et quem saepius veneramur in terris semper habeamus patronum in caelis.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the solemnity of your blessed martyr and bishop Saint Martin may profit to eternal salvation for your people. And that we who venerate him more frequently on earth, may always have him as our patron in heaven.

text: Haec oblatio quaesumus Domine quam iterata sancti confessoris tui Martini festivitate tuae maiestati offerimus nobis prosit ad indulgentiam ut per eam a nostris liberemur peccatis et sacris altaribus astare digni efficiamur.
translation_en: This offering we humbly ask you, Lord, which is repeatedly presented during the feast of your saint martyr, Martin. May it be of benefit to us, granting indulgence, so that through it we may be freed from our sins and deemed worthy to stand before sacred altars.

text: Sacramenta Domine quaesumus quae sumpsimus beato Martino confessore tuo intercedente ab omni nos adversitate defendant et perpetua tua prosperitate tibi soli Deo servire concedant.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask You, that the sacraments which we have received through your blessed confessioner Saint Martin, may defend us from all adversity and grant us eternal service to Your perpetual prosperity alone to God.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatae Caeciliae martyris tuae sollemnitate laetificas: da ut quam veneramur officio etiam piae conversationis sequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God who delights us through the solemnity of your blessed martyr Caecilia, grant that we may follow not only in reverence, but also in devout conduct, her example.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam muneribus sacris eius semper intercessione nos refove cuius sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with sacred gifts, always through their intercession we are refreshed; whom we celebrate the solemnities of.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Clementis martyris tui atque pontificis sollemnitate laetificas: concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus virtutem quoque passionis imitemur.
translation_en: God who delights us with the solemnity of your blessed martyr and pope, Clement: grant us graciously that we may celebrate his birthday, we may also imitate the virtue of his passion.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente beato Clemente martyre tuo per haec nos a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, we offer these gifts; may they be sanctified. Through the intercession of Blessed Clement, your martyr, cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Oblatis Domine quaesumus placare muneribus et intercedente beato Chrysogono martyre tuo a cunctis nos defende periculis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you grant favor to the offerings and, with the intercession of your saintly martyr, Chrysogonus, protect us from all dangers.

text: Deus qui nos beati Saturnini martyris tui concedis natalicio perfrui: eius nos tribue meritis adiuvari.
translation_en: God, who allows us to participate in the nativity of your blessed martyr Saturninus, grant us aid through his merits.

text: Munera Domine tibi dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato Saturnini martyre tuo per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings dedicated to You be sanctified. Through the intercession of your blessed martyr Saturninus, we pray that you turn favorable towards us.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatus Andreas apostolus pro nobis imploret auxilium ut a nostris reatibus absoluti a cunctis etiam periculis exuamur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Almighty God, that blessed Andrew the Apostle may intercede for us, so that we may be freed from our sins and removed from all dangers.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi Domine beati Andreae precatio sancta conciliet ut cuius honore sollemniter exhibetur meritis efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: Our sacrifice to you, Lord of blessed Andrew, may a holy prayer unite, so that what is offered with great honor is made acceptable by its merits.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria beati Andreae festivitate laetantes quae sicut tuis sanctis ad gloriam ita nobis quaesumus ad veniam prodesse perficias.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the divine mysteries of blessed Andrew's feast, rejoicing as your saints do. We humbly ask that you may complete them for us, so that they bring glory to you and grant us forgiveness.

text: Deus qui beatum Nicolaum pium et gloriosum pontificem tuum innumeris decorasti miraculis: tribue nobis quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus a gehennae incendiis liberemur.
translation_en: God who adorned the blessed Nicholas, your pious and glorious pope, with countless miracles: grant us, we ask, that through his merits and prayers we may be freed from the fires of hell.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine oblata munera quae in veneratione sancti antistitis Nicolai offeruntur ut per ea vita nostra inter adversa ubique dirigatur et prospera.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the offerings presented in honor of Saint Nicholas, so that through them our lives may be guided among adversities everywhere and prosper.

text: Protegat nos Domine saepius beati Andreae apostoli repetita sollemnitas ut cuius patrocinia sine intermissione recolimus defensione sentiamus. Per Dominum.
translation_en: May the Lord frequently protect us through the repeated feast of Blessed Andrew the Apostle, that we may constantly remember his patronage and feel his protection. Through the Lord.

text: Adiuvet familiam tuam tibi Domine supplicando venerandus apostolus qui tui nominis exstitit praedicator. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Your family is helped by you, Lord, through the intercessions of the revered apostle who became a preacher of your name. Through the Lord.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster ut sicut de beatae Luciae festivitate gaudemus ita piae devotionis erudiamur affectu.
translation_en: Hear us, O God our Savior, that as we rejoice on the feast of the blessed Lucy, so may we be instructed in pious devotion with affection.

text: VD ... per Christum Dominum nostrum. Qui Ecclesiam tuam in apostolicis tribuisti consistere fundamentis de quorum collegio beati Thomae apostoli tui sollemnia celebrantes tua Domine praeconia non taceamus. Et ideo.
translation_en: We pray... through Christ our Lord. Who established your Church upon the apostolic foundations, whose college we commemorate in the solemnity of your blessed Apostle Thomas. We should not be silent about your praise, O Lord. And for this reason.

text: Conserva Domine populum tuum et quem sanctorum tuorum praesidiis non desinis adiuvari perpetuis tribue gaudere remediis. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Lord, preserve your people and never cease to help those under the protection of your saints. Grant them eternal joys. Through the Lord.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus 〈...〉 intercedente beato Thoma apostolo ad aeternae vitae praemium pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: We beseech You, almighty God, through the intercession of the blessed apostle Thomas, may we merit to reach the reward of eternal life.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine gloriosa natalicia beati apostoli tui N. digne praevenire eius patrocinio ab omni adversitate mentis et corporis liberari.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, the glorious feast days of your blessed apostle N., may they precede him worthily, and be freed from all mental and bodily adversity under his patronage.

text: Intercedente beato apostolo N. munera nostra quaesumus Domine propitius suscipe et concede ut a cunctis perturbationibus liberati tranquilla tibi servitute famulemur.
translation_en: Through the intercession of blessed apostle N., we humbly ask, Lord, that you look upon us graciously and grant us that, freed from all disturbances, we may serve you peacefully.

text: Sumptis muneribus tuis adesto nobis quaesumus Domine in tua protectione confidentibus ut beati apostoli N. cuius natalicia praevenimus suffragiis adiuti perpetuis gaudemus beneficiis mentis et corporis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to be present with us with Your offerings, that confident in Your protection, we may rejoice in the blessings of mind and body, aided by the constant intercession of the blessed apostle N., whose feast day we anticipate.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatus N. apostolus tuum pro nobis imploret auxilium ut a nostris reatibus absoluti a cunctis etiam periculis exuamur.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that blessed N., your apostle, may intercede for us so that we may be freed from our sins and relieved of all dangers.

text: Munera nostra Domine quae pro beati apostoli N. sollemnitate deferimus propitius suscipe et mala omnia quae meremur averte.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive our offerings which we bring for the solemnity of Blessed Apostle N., and turn away from us all evil that we deserve.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sacramenti tui participatione vegetati sancti quoque apostoli N. precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that we may be nourished by the participation in your sacrament, and help us through the prayers of the holy apostle N.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus venturam beatorum apostolorum N. sollemnitate congruo praevenire honore et venientem digna celebrare devotione.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that on the solemnity of the blessed apostle N., may we be worthy to precede with honor and celebrate with devotion the one who is coming.

text: Accepta sit tibi Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio et beatorum apostolorum N. quorum natalicia praevenimus eorum intercessio nos salvet semper et muniat.
translation_en: We offer, Lord, our devotion to you and we pray that the blessings of the holy apostles N., whose feast days we are celebrating, may always save and protect us through their intercession.

text: Praesta nobis aeterne largitor beatorum apostolorum N. ubique protegi oratione quorum natalicia per haec sancta quae sumpsimus votivo praevenimus obsequio. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Grant us, eternal giver of the blessed apostles N., protection everywhere by the prayer of whose feast days we have preemptively approached with vow-fulfilling devotion. Through the Lord.

text: Munera Domine quae apostolorum tuorum N. sollemnitate deferimus propitius suscipe et mala omnia quae iuste meremur propitiatus averte.
translation_en: Lord, we offer you the gifts which we bring on the solemnity of your apostles N., graciously receive them and, propitiated, turn away all evils that we justly deserve.

text: Beati martyris tui N. votivus natalis nobis quaesumus iucunditatem suae glorificationis infundat et tibi nos acceptabiles reddat.
translation_en: May the feast day of your martyr N., who is vowed, bring us joy through the outpouring of his glory's happiness, and make us acceptable to you.

text: Hostias tibi Domine humilitatis nostrae offerimus quas meritis beati N. martyris tui cuius natalicia praevenimus ad absolutionem omnium delictorum nobis provenire concede.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, our humble offerings which by the merits of your blessed martyr N., whose feast day we anticipate, may come to forgive us for all our sins. Grant this.

text: Sumpsimus Domine caelestia sacramenta sancti martyris tui N. natalicia praevenientes quae nobis quaesumus perpetuae redemptionis munus operentur.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the heavenly sacraments of Your holy martyr N., preceding their natal feast, which we humbly ask to work upon us the gift of perpetual redemption.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati martyris tui N. natalicia colimus eius intercessione a cunctis adversitatibus liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to grant that we who celebrate the birth of your blessed martyr N., may be freed from all adversities through his intercession.

text: Intercessio sancti N. martyris tui quaesumus Domine munera nostra tibi commendet nosque tuae maiestati reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the intercession of your saint N. the martyr commends our gifts to you and returns them accepted to your majesty.

text: Sancta tua Domine pro beati martyris tuae N. pretiosa passione celebrata nos muniant et ab omni semper adversitate custodiant.
translation_en: May your holy Lord, protect us by the precious passion of your blessed martyr N., and keep us always from every adversity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per gloriosa bella certaminis ad immortales triumphos martyres extulisti: da nobis dignam pro eorum commemoratione laetitiam ut quorum memoriam pio amore amplectimur eorum precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who raised the martyrs to eternal triumphs through glorious wars, grant us a worthy joy for their commemoration, so that we may embrace their memory with pious love and be aided by their prayers.

text: Beato confessore tuo atque pontifice N. intercedente quaesumus omnipotens Deus munera nostra suscipe et ab omnibus nos peccatis propitiatus absolve ut percepta venia peccatorum liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God, through your blessed confessor and bishop N., to accept our offerings and forgive us from all sins, that with minds freed by received forgiveness of sins we may serve you freely.

text: Caelestia Domine sumpsimus sacramenta praesta quaesumus ut interveniente beato confessore tuo atque pontifice N. cuius sollemnia recurrimus nobis perpetuam conferant medicinam.
translation_en: Heavenly Lord, we have taken the sacred mysteries; grant us, we beseech You, that through the intercession of Your blessed confessor and Bishop N., to whom we return on this solemn occasion, may perpetual medicine be conferred upon us.

text: Beati confessoris tui atque pontificis N. quaesumus Domine nos maiestati tuae intercessio veneranda commendet ut quam nostris non meremur eius meritis indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your blessed confessor and bishop N. may recommend our souls to your majesty's venerable intercession, so that we, who do not deserve it by our own merits, may obtain indulgence through his merits.

text: Hostias quas tibi Domine pro commemoratione sancti confessoris tui N. atque pontificis offerimus dignanter suscipe et a cunctis calamitatibus propitius nos respirare concede.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the sacrifices for the commemoration of your saint and confessor N., and bishop. Accept them graciously, and, propitious, grant us to breathe freely from all calamities.

text: Benedictionis tuae Domine gratiam intercedente beato confessore tuo N. suscipiamus ut cuius praeveniendo gloriam celebramus eius supplicando auxilium sentiamus.
translation_en: We receive your blessing, Lord, with the grace of your blessed confessor N. intervening. So that we may celebrate the glory of him whom we anticipate, and feel his aid through our supplications.

text: Accepta sit tibi Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio et ad sancti confessoris tui N. puriores nos faciat venire festivitatem.
translation_en: May this offering of our devotion be accepted by you, Lord, and may the holy confesor of yours, N., lead us to a more pure approach to the festivity.

text: Ut nobis Domine tua sacrificia dent salutem beatus confessor tuus N. precator accedat.
translation_en: May, Lord, Your sacrifices grant us salvation; that your blessed confessor N. may approach as intercessor.

text: Adesto Domine precibus nostris quas in sancti confessoris tui N. sollemnitate deferimus ut qui nostrae iustitiae fiduciam non habemus eius qui tibi placuit precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, with our prayers which we bring on the feast day of your holy confessor N., that he who does not have faith in our justice may be helped by his prayers that please you.

text: Muneribus tuis et supplicationibus sancti confessoris tui N. quaesumus Domine tribue nos foveri ut cuius festivitatem celebramus eius apud te intercessionibus et meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: Through your gifts and the supplications of your holy confessor N., we humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us that we may be sustained, as we celebrate his feast day; may we be assisted by his intercessions and merits with you.

text: Beatorum confessorum tuorum atque pontificum N. Domine natalicia praeeuntes suppliciter te rogamus ut quos caelesti gloria sublimasti tuum pro nobis iugiter implorent auxilium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to intercede on our behalf before your glorious saints and bishons N., that they may continually pray for us, providing aid.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod tibi pro beatis confessoribus tui atque pontificibus N. offert nostra devotio eorum quaesumus meritis tibi reddatur acceptum.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, which we offer to you on behalf of your blessed confessors and bishops N., may their devotion be accepted by your merits.

text: Quaesumus Domine salutaribus repleti mysteriis ut quorum sollemnitatem praeimus eorum orationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, filled with salutary mysteries, that as we celebrate their solemnity, we may be helped by their prayers.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum confessorum tuorum atque pontificum N. confessionibus gloriosis circumdas et protegis: da nobis et eorum imitatione proficere et intercessione gaudere.
translation_en: God who surrounds and protects us with the glorious confessions of your saints, confessors and popes N.: grant that we may progress in their example and rejoice in their intercession.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine quae pro beatorum confessorum tuorum atque pontificum N. tuo nomini offeruntur nataliciis ipsorum digna perficiantur et mentis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings made to your holy name on the natal days of the blessed confessors and popes N., may be worthy and complete, for their souls.

text: Sanctae virginis tuae N. Domine supplicationibus nos foveri ut cuius venerabilem sollemnitatem votivo praevenimus obsequio pietati tuae eius commendemur suffragio.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that Your holy virgin N. protect us, as we have approached the venerable solemnity of hers with a votive act of devotion. We commend ourselves to Your mercy under her protection.

text: Muneribus nostris Domine sanctae virginis tuae N. festa praecedimus praesta quaesumus ut tuae maiestati illius meritis accepta reddantur.
translation_en: With our offerings, Lord, we precede the feast of your holy virgin N. May it please you to grant that through her merits, they may be received and returned to your majesty.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut cuius nos tribuis communicare memoriis eius nos facias gaudere suffragiis.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that as we share in the memory of him whom you grant us to communicate, so may we also rejoice in his intercessions.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine sanctae virginis tuae N. intercessione propitius suscipe et praesta ut tuae maiestati illius meritis accepta reddantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of your holy virgin N., you may be graciously received and granted. May the merits of her service be accepted and returned to your majesty.

text: Perceptis muneribus tuis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sanctae virginis et martyris tuae N. nos tribuis communicare memoriis eius nos facias gaudere suffragiis.
translation_en: Through your gifts we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that you grant us to share in the memory of your holy virgin and martyr N., and make us rejoice with his intercession.

text: Deus qui nos hodie sanctae virginis tuae N. annua sollemnitate laetificas: concede propitius ut eius adiuvemur meritis cuius castitatis irradiamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who today on the annual feast of your holy virgin N., delights us: grant graciously that we may be helped by her merits, whose examples we are inspired by through her chastity.

text: In sanctae virginis tuae N. festivitate tibi Domine munera votiva deferimus praesta quaesumus ut eius suffragiis nostrae servitutis tibi accepta reddantur officia.
translation_en: On the feast day of your holy virgin N., we offer you, Lord, our vows' gifts; grant us that through her intercessions, our service may be accepted by you and returned with due office.

text: Supplices te Domine rogamus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente sancta virgine tua N. in cuius festivitate haec caelestia sumpsimus sacramenta vitam nostram ab omni adversitate custodias.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, Lord, that with the intercession of your holy virgin N., on whose feast day we have taken these heavenly sacraments, you protect our life from every adversity.

text: Prosit nobis omnipotens Deus beatarum virginum N. veneranda festivitas ut quarum gaudemus honoribus protegantur auxiliis.
translation_en: May almighty God, the blessed virgins N., grant us, that we who rejoice in their honors, may be protected by their aid during their venerable festivity.

text: Deus qui sacrandorum auctor es munerum: effunde super hanc domum orationis benedictionem tuam ut ab omnibus in ea nomen tuum invocantibus defensionis auxilium sentiatur et qui eam in honorem tui nominis condiderunt protectorem te habere in omnibus mereantur atque custodem.
translation_en: God who is the author of sacraments and gifts, pour your blessing of prayer upon this house, that all calling upon your name for help may feel your protection within it. May those who built it in honor of your name merit to have you as their protector in all things, and may you be their guardian.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nostra munera quae tuis altaribus offeruntur ad nostrarum remedium animarum et eorum qui hanc domum in honorem tui nominis condiderunt praeparentur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that the offerings which are made on our behalf to Your altars may be a remedy for our souls, and that those who built this house in Your name's honor may be prepared.

text: VD ... Cuius virtus magna pietas copiosa. Respice quaesumus de caelo domum istam ut si quis in ea nomini tuo supplicaverit libenter exaudias et satis facientibus clementer ignoscas. Hic tibi sacerdotes tui sacrificium laudis offerant hic fidelis populus vota persolvat hic peccatorum sarcinae deponantur hic fides sancta stabiliatur. Hinc impietas abluta redeat hinc iniquitas emendata discedat. Inveniat apud te Domine locum venire quicumque satis faciens huc confugerit et quando populus tuus pro suis necessitatibus hic te rogaverit adquiesce rogari et rogatus indulge. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: To Him, whose great power is abundant in piety. We beseech you from heaven, O house of this, that if anyone in it has supplicated in your name, may you willingly hear and mercifully forgive the penitent. Here your priests offer to you the sacrifice of praise; here the faithful people fulfill their vows; here the burdens of sins are laid down; here the holy faith is established. Here let impiety be washed away, here let iniquity be corrected and depart. May there be a place for those who are doing enough to come before you, Lord, and may whoever flees to this place when your people appeal on behalf of their needs, grant acquiescence to the plea and indulge the suppliant. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus salutaribus repleti mysteriis ut in hoc loco quem nomini tuo indigni dedicavimus cunctis petentibus aures tuae pietatis accomodes.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, filled with saving mysteries, that in this place which we have unworthily dedicated to your name, you might accommodate the ears of your pity to all who seek.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine precibus nostris ut quicumque intra templi huius cuius anniversarium dedicationis diem celebramus continemur plena tibi et corporis et animae devotione placeamus ut dum praesentia vota reddimus ad aeterna praemia te adiuvante pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, with our prayers that whoever within this temple, whose anniversary of dedication day we celebrate, may be contained in full devotion to you, both body and soul. May we please you as we render our vows in your presence, so that with your help we may merit to attain eternal rewards.

text: VD ... Et pro annua dedicatione templi huius honorem tibi debitum referre. Per Christum Dominum.
translation_en: We humbly offer you the annual dedication of this temple, a debt due to you. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Deus qui nos ad anniversarium diem consecrationis huius altaris ecclesiae venire tribuisti: concede quaesumus ut quicquid meo in nomine tuo perierimus sanctorum tuorum precibus obtinere mereamur.
translation_en: God, who has granted us to come on the anniversary day of the consecration of this altar of the church: grant us that we may deserve to obtain whatever we have suffered in Your name through the prayers of Your saints.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus respice propitius de throno gloriae tuae et super hoc altare nomini tuo dedicatum fidelium tuorum oblationes dignanter suscipe ut in eo sic temporales hostiae consecrentur ut perpetuae salutis munus sumentibus acquirant.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, look upon us graciously from your throne of glory, and accept these offerings of your faithful on this altar dedicated to your name. May the temporal sacrifices be consecrated in it so that those receiving the gift of eternal salvation may acquire it.

text: VD ... Qui ubique totus et tua maiestate universa continens locum tuis mysteriis aptum tibi sacrari voluisti. Effunde igitur quaesumus super hanc domum gratiam tuam ut hic et sacramentorum virtus et votorum apud te obtineatur effectus. Per Christum.
translation_en: We ask that you pour out your grace upon this house, so that here the effectiveness of the sacraments and vows may be attained among us through your power. Through Christ.

text: Multiplica quaesumus Domine per haec sancta quae sumpsimus gratiam tuam in nobis ut te in templo sancto tuo iugiter adoremus et in conspectu tuo cum sanctis omnibus in aeternum laetemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to multiply the grace within us through these holy things we have received, so that we may eternally worship You in Your holy temple and rejoice with all the saints before Your face for all eternity.

text: Deus qui omnes sanctos et electos tuos pro suis quosque meritis honorare disponis: praesta quaesumus ut sanctae Helenae reginae cuius religionem et studium in sanctae crucis manifestatione veneramur apud misericordiam tuam meritis et precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who arranges to honor all your saints and elects according to their respective merits: grant us, we implore, that we may be aided by your mercy and prayers in venerating Queen Helena, whose religion and devotion we revere in the manifestation of the holy cross.

text: Munera populi tui placabilis dextera tua suscipiat ut sanctae Helenae suffragantibus meritis devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: Your gracious right hand may receive the gifts of your people, so that by the merits of Saint Helen our devotion may advance and health be granted.

text: Refecti corporis sacri pretiosique libamine sanguinis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercessionibus beatae Helenae cuius festivo gratulamur officio cunctis malorum nostrorum sordibus exuamur. Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum.
translation_en: Sustained by the blessed food and precious garment of the sacred body and blood, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that through the intercessions of the blessed Helena, whose feast day we celebrate, we may be freed from all our sins' stains. Through our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine Deus noster per Unigenitum tuum huius oblationis hostiam et cooperante Sancto Spiritu tuo per eam nosmet ipsos tibi perfice munus aeternum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord our God, that You sanctify this offering through Your only-begotten Son and with the help of Your Holy Spirit. Through it, may we ourselves fulfill an eternal service to You.

text: VD ... Qui cum Unigenito Filio tuo et Spiritu Sancto unus es Deus unus es Dominus non in unius singularitate personae sed in unius Trinitate substantiae. Quod enim de tua gloria revelante te credimus hoc de Filio tuo hoc de Spiritu Sancto sine differentia discretionis sentimus. Ut in confessione verae sempiternaeque Deitatis et in personis proprietas et in essentia unitas et in maiestate adoretur aequalitas. Quam laudant angeli atque archangeli Cherubim quoque ac Seraphim qui non cessant clamare cottidie una voce dicentes: Sanctus sanctus sanctus.
translation_en: And in the Trinity, one God, one Lord, not in the singularity of person but in the unity of substance. For what we believe concerning your glory, this we also believe concerning your Unigenitus Son and the Holy Spirit, without distinction of difference. That in confessing true and eternal Deity, and in persons the property, in essence unity, and in majesty equality may be adored. Which the angels, archangels, Cherubim and Seraphim laud, who never cease to cry out daily with one voice, saying: Holy, holy, holy.

text: Proficiat nobis ad salutem corporis et animae Domine Deus huius sacramenti susceptio et sempiterna Sanctae Trinitatis eiusdem individuae Unitatis confessio.
translation_en: May it profit us for the health of our body and soul, Lord God. By receiving this sacrament, and by the eternal confession of the individual unity of the Holy Trinity.

text: Domine Deus Pater omnipotens nos famulos tuos tuae maiestati subiectos per Unicum Filium tuum in virtute Sancti Spiritus benedic et protege ut ab omni hoste securi in tua iugiter laude laetemur.
translation_en: Lord God, Almighty Father, we, your servants, subject to your majesty through your Only-begotten Son, by the power of the Holy Spirit, bless and protect us, so that secure from every enemy, we may always rejoice in your praise.

text: Deus qui per sanctae Crucis virtutem mirabilium tuorum mundo declarasti multitudinem: tribue nobis per eius in superabilem munitionem gratiae tuae perennem contra omnia adversa defensionem.
translation_en: God, who through the power of the Holy Cross have shown to the world the multitude of your miracles: grant us through its strength an impregnable bulwark of your grace everlasting against all adversities defense.

text: VD ... per Christum Dominum nostrum. Qui corporaliter in Cruce temporalem passionem patienter pertulit et humanum genus ab antiqui hostis subiectione clementer redemit. Et ideo.
translation_en: We beg of you through Christ our Lord, who endured the temporary Passion on the Cross with patience and mercifully redeemed the human race from the ancient enemy's oppression. Therefore...

text: Deus qui beatum Ioannem Baptistam Unigenito tuo in cordibus hominum viam parare direxisti: cuius quaesumus interventu mansionem tibi placitam in nobis praeparare digneris.
translation_en: God, who directed the way in the hearts of men for your blessed John the Baptist, Unigenito [your only-begotten son]: whose we humbly ask that by your intervention you may deign to prepare a pleasing dwelling place within us.

text: Ne reminiscaris Domine delicta mea
translation_en: Lord, do not remember my sins

text: Averte faciem tuam a peccatis meis
translation_en: Turn away your face from my sins

text: Peccavimus Domine cum patribus nostris
translation_en: We have sinned, Lord, with our fathers

text: Ne intres in iudicium
translation_en: Do not enter into judgment

text: Fac me quaeso omnipotens Deus ita iustitia indui in sanctorum tuorum merear exsultatione laetari quatenus emundatus ab omnibus sordibus peccatorum consortium adipiscar tibi placentium sacerdotum meque tua gratia a viciis omnibus exuat que〈m〉 reatus propriis quo scientiae 〈malim conscientiae〉 gravat.
translation_en: I humbly ask, O almighty God, clothe me in righteousness so that I may deserve to rejoice with the exultation of your saints. May I be purified from all stains of sin and attain fellowship with pleasing priests to you. May your grace free me from all vices and remove the burden of my own faults, which weigh heavily upon my conscience.

text: Non de meritorum meorum caritate confusus 〈malim confisus〉 praesumo accedere ante sanctum conspectum tuum Domine Deus sed pro tua ineffabili pietate qui dignatus es peccatores ad tuam misericordiam vocare et ad te venientibus dignatus es piissimam indulgentiam et sempiternam gratiam conferre tu enim Domine a tua pietate nullum repellas sed ad te venientibus tuae pietatis et misericordiae dignanter sinum aperis et ad sacramentum piissimae recorecon¬ciliationis clementer admittis gratiae tuae participes efficis qui invocas ea quae non sunt tamquam ea quae <non> sunt qui facis de indignis dignos de peccatoribus iustos de immundis mundos qui vivificas 〈malim iustificas〉 /79r/ 〈impios et vivificas mortuos et in infirmitate virtutem tribuis〉 tu ergo Do¬mine fac in me peccatore opus tuae magnae misericordiae tuae pietatis immensae tuae gratia〈e〉 sempi¬ternae non pro meis meritis sed pro tuis miserationibus multis et magnis et 〈e/im〉mitte Spiritum Sanctum Paraclitum de caelis illuminatorem et sanctificatorem tuae sanctae Ecclesiae quo<d> tu Deus illuminasti sa〈ncti〉ficasti et c〈onfir〉masti corda tuorum sanctorum apostolorum et ceterorum tuorum fidelium 〈ut〉 ipse tuus Spiritus dignanter adveniens cor inflammet et expurget et mundum gratiae tuae habitaculum efficiat et omnis 〈malim omnes〉 sensus meos purificet et clarificet et mysterium servi¬tutis meae faciat in conspectu tuo acceptabile et nobis salutare tua misericordia tribuente tua virtute cooperante tua gratia confirmante quia tu es creator (?) hominum et Dominus tibi est omnis honor et gloria 〈per〉 Iesum Christum Unigenitum Filium tuum Dominum nostrum qui tecum vivit et regnat.
translation_en: Not confused by the love of my merits, presuming not to approach your holy presence, Lord God, yet, for your ineffable pity, who deigns to call sinners to your mercy and graciously confers eternal grace upon those coming to you; for you, Lord, from your pity, nothing is repelled but to those coming, you graciously open the heart of your compassion and mercifully admit participants of your grace, who calls what is not as if it were not, who makes unworthy persons worthy, sinners just, the unclean clean, who vivifies, I might say justifies, the impious and the dead, gives virtue to those in infirmity; therefore, Lord, work in me, a sinner, the work of your great mercy, your immense pity, your eternal grace not for my merits but for your many and great mercies, and send the Holy Spirit, the Paraclete from heaven, the illuminator and sanctifier of your holy Church, whom you have enlightened, sanctified, and confirmed the hearts of your holy apostles and other faithful; that your own Spirit, graciously coming upon me, inflames and purges my heart, makes a dwelling place of grace, purifies and clarifies all my senses, and makes the mystery of my servitude acceptable and saving in your sight, giving your mercy, cooperating with your power, confirming your grace, for you are creator (?) of mankind and to you belongs all honor and glory through Jesus Christ, your only-begotten Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with you.

text: Umeros meos et pectus meum Spiritus Sancti gratia protege Domine renes meos vitiis cordis et corporis omnibus expulsis praecinge ad sacrificandum tibi Deo viventi et regnanti in 〈saecula saeculorum〉
