translation_en: Protect my shoulders and breast, O Lord, with the grace of the Holy Spirit. Renew my kidneys from the vices of heart and body, expelled entirely, adorn me to offer sacrifice to you, the living and reigning God, for the ages of ages.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus te suppliciter exoro ut fraude omnium fuscationum (?) 〈malim suffocationum〉 exu<a>tus albaque veste indutus te sequi merear ad regna ubi vera sunt 〈gaudia〉.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, I humbly entreat you that, freed from all fraudulent deceits (perhaps I should say 'sins'), clothed in a white robe, I may be worthy to follow you into the kingdoms where true joy resides.

text: Circumcide Domine*
translation_en: Circumcise, Lord

text: Placeat tibi sancta Trinitas obsequium servitutis meae et praesta ut sacrificium 〈quod〉 oculis tuae maiestatis indignus obtuli sit tibi placens mihique et omnibus pro quibus illud obtuli sit te miserante 〈propitiabile〉.
translation_en: May it please you, Holy Trinity, the obedience of my servitude and grant that the sacrifice which I, unworthy in Your Majesty's sight, offered may be pleasing to You and me, and may it be pleasing for all for whom I offered it, through Your mercy being propitious.

text: Beati Ioannis Baptistae precibus et meritis haec oblatio nostrae servitutis tibi quaesumus Domine acceptabilis et nobis efficiatur salutis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that our offering of service be acceptable to You through the prayers and merits of John the Baptist, and may it become salvation for us.

text: Deus qui in beati Ioannis Baptistae commemoratione nos tuis mysteriis refecisti: ipsius quaesumus precibus et meritis omnes criminum nostrorum sordes absterge et tui spiritus gratiam mentibus nostris dignanter infunde.
translation_en: God, who in the commemoration of Blessed John the Baptist restored us through your mysteries: we humbly ask that through his prayers and merits, you wash away all stains of our sins and graciously pour your spirit into our minds.

text: Deus qui regni caelestis clavium beato Petro apostolo tuo tradidisti potestatem: praesta quaesumus ut per eius ministerium in aeternae patriae recipi mereamur claritatem.
translation_en: God who gave the keys of the kingdom of heaven to your apostle St. Peter, we humbly ask that through his ministry, we may be deemed worthy to receive the brightness of eternal fatherland.

text: Deus qui beatum Petrum apostolum populorum tuorum pastorem constituisti: eius quaesumus interventu sacramentorum tuorum salutaribus epulis nos reficere digneris.
translation_en: God who made blessed Peter the shepherd of your people, we humbly ask that through his intervention you deign to refresh us with the saving banquets of your sacraments.

text: Sumptis gratiae tuae muneribus praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut te semper in beati Petri apostoli commemoratione laudemus et tuam misericordiam ipso interveniente percipiamus.
translation_en: With your gifts of grace, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that always in the commemoration of Blessed Apostle Peter, we may praise you, and through your intervention, experience your mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus clementiam tuam suppliciter imploramus ut intercedentibus omnibus apostolis tuis et vitae praesentis subsidium et aeternae benedictionis gratiam percipiamus.
translation_en: We humbly entreat the eternal Almighty God that, with all the apostles interceding for us, we may receive support in this present life and the grace of eternal blessing.

text: Pignus vitae aeternae capientes humiliter Domine imploramus ut sanctorum apostolorum tuorum fulti patrociniis a cunctis perturbationibus liberati tranquilla tibi servitute famulemur.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, Lord, to receive as the pledge of eternal life. Through the patronage of your holy apostles, protect us from all disturbances and may we serve you peacefully in a tranquil state.

text: Deus qui beato Georgio martyri tuo de antiquo hoste victoriam et in caelis aeternae retributionis palmam contulisti: da nobis quaesumus eius intercessione contra omnes adversitates subsidium et perpetuae felicitatis obtinere triumphum.
translation_en: God, who granted your martyr George victory over an ancient enemy and a palm of eternal reward in heaven: grant us, we pray, through his intercession, support against all adversities and to obtain the triumph of perpetual happiness.

text: Intercessio sancti martyris tui Georgii quaesumus Domine nostrae oblationis munus tuae maiestati reddat acceptum ut in tua semper benedictione laetemur.
translation_en: We beseech the intercession of your holy martyr George, O Lord. Let our offering be acceptable to your majesty, that we may always rejoice in your blessedness.

text: Da quaesumus Domine ut familia tua in beati Georgii martyris tui commemoratione tuis muneribus refecta eius patrocinio ab omni adversitate liberata te fiat operante devota et te protegente secura.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that your family, in the commemoration of your martyr Saint George, may be refreshed with your gifts and freed from every adversity by his patronage. May they act devotedly through your operation and be secure through your protection.

text: Deus qui beatum Adalbertum martyrem tuum atque pontificem gloria et honore coronasti: concede nobis famulis tuis eius precibus et meritis consequi veniam omnium delictorum et perfrui gaudiis beatorum.
translation_en: God who crowned your servant and bishop, blessed Adalbert with glory and honor: grant us, your servants, to obtain pardon for all our sins and enjoy the joys of the blessed, through his prayers and merits.

text: Gratanter Domine Deus suscipe hoc sacrificium quod in honorem sancti Adalberti martyris tui atque pontificis immolamus et ipsius precibus dona nobis indulgentiam et requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: Graciously, Lord God, receive this sacrifice which we offer in honor of Saint Adalbert, your martyr and bishop, and through his prayers grant us indulgence and eternal rest.

text: Sumpta Domine sacramenta intercedente beato Adalberto martyre tuo atque pontifice proficiant nobis ad salutem et ad aeterna perducant gaudia.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the sacraments, with the intercession of your blessed martyr and bishop St. Adalbert, that they may bring us to salvation and lead us to eternal joy.

text: Deus qui beatum Gerardum pontificem in agone martyrii et stola immortalitatis coronasti: concede propitius ut cuius commemorationem devotis mentibus celebramus in terris eius perpetua defensione muniamur in caelis.
translation_en: God who crowned blessed Gerard, the bishop, in the struggle of martyrdom and immortality's robe: grant us favorably that we may be fortified with his perpetual protection on earth as we celebrate his remembrance in our devoted minds, and in heaven.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam pretiosissimi corporis et sanguinis Filii tui libamine praesta quaesumus ut intercessione beati Gerardi martyris tui atque pontificis nobis proficiat ad salutem animae et corporis.
translation_en: You have satisfied, Lord, your family with the most precious body and blood of your Son. We humbly ask that you bestow this grace upon us. Through the intercession of the blessed Gerard, your martyr and bishop, may it profit us for the salvation of our soul and body.

text: Clementiam tuam omnipotens 〈Deus〉 suppliciter imploramus ut beati confessoris tui Benedicti meritis percepta peccatorum indulgentia ad aeterna mereamur pervenire gaudia.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your mercy, O Almighty God, that through the merits of your blessed confessor Benedict we may obtain pardon for our sins and merit to reach eternal joy.

text: Oblatum maiestati tuae Domine Deus sacrificium intercessione beati Benedicti confessoris tui quaesumus indulgentiam nobis tuae propitiationis acquirat et a nobis noxia cuncta depellat.
translation_en: We ask, Lord God, that the offering made to your majesty be accepted through the intercession of your blessed confessor Benedict. May it acquire for us the indulgence of your propitiation and drive away all harm from us.

text: Sumptis vitae aeternae mysteriis quaesumus Domine ut interventu beati Benedicti confessoris tui et temporalibus abundemus commodis et nullis afficiamur adversis.
translation_en: With the mysteries of eternal life we humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intervention of your blessed confesser Saint Benedict, we may abound in temporal goods and be unaffected by adversities.

text: Praetende nobis Domine misericordiam tuam et beati Ægidii abbatis intercessio cuius nos dedisti patrociniis adiuvari tribue ut maiestatem tuam exoret pro nobis.
translation_en: Lord, stretch out to us your mercy and the intercession of Blessed Abbot St. Giles, whose patronage you have given us to be helped by; grant that he may plead for us before your majesty.

text: Tuere Domine familiam tuam et quam per doctrinam beati Stephani regis et confessoris tui de tenebris ad veram lucem convertisti eam post istius temporis decursum oblati sacrificii munimine clementer perducas ad regna caelorum.
translation_en: Lord, protect your family and the one you have brought from darkness into true light through the teaching of Blessed Stephen, your king and confessor. After this time has passed, lead them kindly by the shield of sacrifice to the kingdoms of heaven.

text: Fac nos Domine Deus noster beati confessoris tui Henrici foveri suffragiis et quem diversis miraculis facis clarescere eius nos precibus a peccatis absolutos in tua semper miseratione custodi.
translation_en: Lord, make us to be supported by the intercessions of your blessed confessor Henry, and whom you make shine through various miracles, absolve us from our sins through his prayers, and keep us always in your mercy.

text: Satiati Domine gratiae tuae muneribus quaesumus ut beatus Henricus confessor tuus sua nos intercessione muniat in cuius commemoratione haec sancta tibi libavimus sacramenta.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to be satisfied with your gifts, that blessed Henry, your confessor, may protect us through his intercession. In whose memory we have offered these sacred offerings to you.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum confessorum tuorum confessionibus gloriosis circumdas et protegis: da nobis et eorum imitatione proficere et intercessione gaudere.
translation_en: God who surrounds and protects us with the glorious confessions of your saints: grant that we may progress by their example and rejoice in their intercession.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus oblationem nostram et omnium sanctorum confessorum tuorum precibus ab omnibus culpis nos dignanter absolve.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we beseech you; regard our offering and through the prayers of all your saints, grant us worthy absolution from all sins.

text: Benedictionum tuarum ubertate repleti quaesumus Domine ut omnium sanctorum confessorum tuorum intercessione tuis semper subsidiis multiplicemur et donis.
translation_en: Filled with the abundance of your blessings, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of all your saints and confessors, we may be constantly supported by your aid and increased in numerous gifts.

text: Deus qui beatam Margaritam virginitatis et martyrii merito in caelesti gloria coronasti: eius precibus fac nos quaesumus participes caelestium gaudiorum.
translation_en: God who rightfully crowned blessed Margaret in celestial glory with virginity and martyrdom: through her prayers, make us pray, we ask, participants of heavenly joys.

text: Da misericors Deus ut omnium sanctarum virginum tuarum intercessio nos semper ab omnibus tueatur adversis.
translation_en: Have merciful God that the intercession of all your saints may always protect us from all adversities.

text: Tuis omnipotens Deus refecti sacramentis quaesumus ut omnium sanctarum virginum tuarum intercessione et corpore tibi placeamus et mente.
translation_en: We humbly ask your almighty God, who has been refreshed by the sacraments, that through the intercession of all your holy virgins and with our bodies and minds, we may please you.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine nobis famulis tuis pro sanctorum tuorum merita gloriosa quorum patrocinia in praesenti requiescunt ecclesia ut eorum pia intercessione ab omnibus semper protegamur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to propitiate us, Your servants, on account of the glorious merits of Your saints, whose patronage the Church now rests upon in this present time. May we always be protected by their pious intercession from all adversities.

text: Suscipiat clementia tua Domine quaesumus de manibus nostris munus oblatum et per sanctorum tuorum quorum reliquiae in hac requiescunt ecclesia orationes ab omnibus nos emundet peccatis.
translation_en: May your clemency, Lord, we ask, receive the offering presented from our hands, and through the merits of your saints whose relics rest in this church, may their prayers cleanse us from all sins.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quae pro sanctorum tuorum quorum reliquiae in praesenti ecclesia requiescunt veneratione tuae Domine obtulimus pietati praesta quaesumus ut per ea veniam mereamur peccatorum et caelestis gratiae donis reficiamur.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the divine mysteries which are placed before the relics of your saints who rest in this church. We humbly ask that through these offerings we may merit forgiveness for our sins and be refreshed with heavenly grace's gifts.

text: Sanctificetur quaesumus Domine huius nostrae oblationis munus tua cooperante sapientia ut tibi placere possit ad laudem et nobis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that this our offering be sanctified by your cooperation with your wisdom. May it please you for your praise and may it profit us for our salvation.

text: Infunde quaesumus Domine per haec sancta quae sumpsimus cordibus nostris tuae lumen sapientiae ut te veraciter agnoscamus et fideliter diligamus.
translation_en: Pour into us, we beseech You, Lord, through these holy things which we have received, Your light of wisdom, that we may truly recognize You and faithfully love You.

text: Sacrificii tui omnipotens Deus repleti participatione quaesumus ut Sancti Spiritus infusione purificatis mentibus tuae pietatis tribuas nobis celebrare mysterium.
translation_en: Almighty God, we humbly ask that you fill our offering with the participation you have granted, and through the infusion of the Holy Spirit, grant us to celebrate the mystery with purified minds, imbued with your piety.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui iustitiam tuae laudis in cordibus credentium digito tuo scribis: da nobis fidei spei et caritatis augmentum et ut mereamur assequi quod promittis fac nos amare quod praecipis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who writes your justice in the hearts of believing ones with your finger: grant us an increase of faith and hope, and that we may deserve to obtain what you promise. Make us love what you command.

text: Gratiam Sancti Spiritus quaesumus Domine mentibus nostris infunde ut quos sacramentorum tuorum communione refecisti in tuae dilectionis coniunctione conservare digneris.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to pour out the grace of the Holy Spirit upon our minds, so that you may deem worthy to conserve us in the union of your love, whom you have restored through the communion of your sacraments.

text: Omnipotens mitissime Deus respice propitius preces nostras et libera corda nostra de malarum temptatione cogitationum ut Sancti Spiritus dignum fieri habitaculum mereamur.
translation_en: O most merciful God, graciously look upon our prayers and free our hearts from the temptation of wicked thoughts, that we may be worthy to become a dwelling place for the Holy Spirit.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine has oblationes quas tuae pietati supplices offerimus pro salute animarum nostrarum quatenus eas Sancti Spiritus tui gratia illuminare et confortare digneris.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech you, Lord, these offerings which we humbly present to your pity, on behalf of the salvation of our souls. May it be pleasing to the grace of your Holy Spirit to illuminate and strengthen them.

text: Ure igne Sancti Spiritus renes nostros et cor nostrum Domine ut tibi casto corde serviamus et mundo corpore placeamus.
translation_en: May the fire of the Holy Spirit renew us and our heart, O Lord, so that we may serve you with a pure heart and please the world with our bodily form.

text: Fac nos quaesumus omnipotens Deus mundo corde et corpore sacrificare tibi hostiam laudis et salva nos per indulgentiam quos es dignatus redimere per gratiam.
translation_en: Make us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, with heart and body to offer you a sacrifice of praise, and save us through indulgence whom you have deigned to redeem through grace.

text: Domine adiutor noster et protector adiuva nos ut refloreat caro nostra vigore pudicitiae et sanctimoniae novitate ereptamque de manu Tartari in resurrectionis gaudium iubeas praesentari.
translation_en: Lord, our helper and protector, help us so that our flesh may flourish with the strength of chastity and sanctity, renewed and snatched away from the hand of Tartarus. Grant us to be presented in the joy of resurrection.

text: 〈Deus qui vivorum es Salvator omnium in te sperantium qui non vis mortem peccatorum nec laetaris in perditione morientium: te suppliciter deprecor ut concedas mihi〉 veniam omnium delictorum meorum ut et admissa defleam et postmodum non admittam ut cum mihi extrema dies finisque vitae advenerit emundatum delictis omnibus me angelus sanctitatis suscipiat.
translation_en: God who is the Savior of all living, in whom all those hoping in You do not desire the death of sinners nor rejoice at the perdition of the dying: I earnestly entreat You to grant me pardon for all my sins, that I may weep for them now and afterwards not be admitted so that when the last days and end of life come upon me, an angel of sanctity may receive me cleansed of all my sins.

text: Deus cui proprium est parcere et salvare et non perire: propitius esto mihi peccatori et quicquid iniquitatis vel peccati ego miser neglegenter commisi tu pius supplex obsecro clementer indulge.
translation_en: God, whose it is to show mercy and save and not to perish: be propitious to me, a sinner, and whatever iniquity or sin I negligently committed, you merciful one, I humbly beseech you, graciously forgive.

text: Per huius quaeso Domine oblationis virtutem omnium peccatorum meorum vincula disrumpe et quicquid poenarum merui propitiatus averte.
translation_en: By this offering, I humbly ask you, Lord: break the bonds of all my sins and turn away whatever punishment I deserve.

text: Sumpto Domine corporis et sanguinis tui sacramento praesta quaesumus ut hoc idem mihi peccatori proficiat ad veniam quod etiam totius mundi profuit ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord, when I receive the sacrament of your body and blood, grant us our prayer, that this same sacrifice may profit me, a sinner, for forgiveness. Just as it has benefited the entire world for salvation.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut famulus tuus rex noster qui tua miseratione suscepit regni gubernacula virtutum etiam omnium percipiat incrementa quibus decenter ornatus et vitiorum monstra devitare et hostes superare et ad te qui via veritas et vita es gratiosus valeat pervenire.
translation_en: We entreat the Almighty God that your servant, our king who has received the governance of the kingdom by Your mercy, may also perceive the growths with which he is fittingly adorned and avoid the vices, and overcome his enemies, and may be able to reach You who are the way, truth, and life in a gracious manner.

text: Suscipe munera et preces Ecclesiae tuae Deus pro salute famuli tui regis nostri et protectione omnium fidelium populorum supplicantis et antiqua bracchii tui operare miracula ut superatis pacis inimicis secura tibi Christianorum libertas.
translation_en: Receive the offerings and prayers of Your Church, God, for the health of Your servant our king and the protection of all faithful people who are supplicating. May You work miracles with Your ancient mighty arm that Christians may overcome their enemies peacefully and enjoy secure freedom.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut mysteria sancta quae sumpsimus famulum tuum regem nostrum ab omnibus tueantur adversis quatenus et in hoc saeculo pacis obtineat tranquillitatem et post istius temporis decursum ad aeternam perveniat hereditatem.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the holy mysteries which we have received may protect your servant, our king, from all adversities, so that in this world he may enjoy peace and tranquility, and after this temporary time, he may inherit the eternal heritage.

text: Deus omnium fidelium pastor et rector famulum tuum N. episcopum nostrum quem Ecclesiae tuae pastorem praeesse voluisti: propitius respice da ei quaesumus verbo et exemplo quibus praeest proficere ut ad vitam una cum grege sibi credito perveniat sempiternam.
translation_en: God, shepherd and ruler of all the faithful: be gracious to look upon your servant N., our bishop whom you have wished to preside over your Church. Grant him we ask, by word and example, that he may prosper so as to arrive at eternal life with his flock whom he is entrusted to lead.

text: Oblatis Domine placare muneribus et famulum tuum episcopum nostrum N. quem populo tuo praeesse voluisti assidua protectione guberna.
translation_en: Lord, grant favor to the offerings and govern your servant bishop N., whom you have willed to preside over your people, with constant protection.

text: Haec nos Domine divini sacramenti perceptio protegat et famulum tuum episcopum nostrum N. quem Ecclesiae tuae praeesse voluisti una cum grege sibi commisso salvet semper et muniat.
translation_en: Lord, may this perception of the divine sacrament protect us and perpetually save and arm your servant bishop N., whom you willed to preside over your Church together with the flock entrusted to him.

text: Da famulo tuo abbati nostro N. quaesumus Domine spiritum veritatis et pacis ut et te tota mente cognoscat et quae tibi sunt placita toto corde sectetur.
translation_en: Grant your servant, our Abbot N., we ask, Lord, the Spirit of truth and peace, so that he may know you fully with his whole mind and follow what pleases you fully with his whole heart.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui facis mirabilia magna solus: praetende super nos famulos tuos et super cunctam congregationem nobis commissam spiritum gratiae salutaris et ut in veritate tibi complaceamus perpetuum nobis rorem tuae benedictionis infunde.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who works great wonders alone: incline towards us, your servants, and towards the entire congregation entrusted to us, pour upon us the grace of salvation, and fill us with the perpetual dew of your blessing, so that we may continually please you in truth.

text: Hostias Domine famulorum tuorum placatus intende et quas in honorem nominis tui devota mente pro eis celebramus proficere sibi sentiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, please accept the offerings of your servants and may those which we celebrate with devoted mind in honor of your name, feel profitable to them for healing.

text: Defende quaesumus Domine beato Benedicto confessore tuo intercedente nostram ab omni adversitate congregationem et tibi toto corde prostratam ab hostium propitius tuere clementer insidiis.
translation_en: Defend us, we beseech You, Lord, Your blessed confesser Benedict, interceding for us. Protect our congregation from every adversity with a merciful heart and graciously shield the prostrate before You from plots of enemies.

text: Suscipe quaesumus omnipotens Deus nostrae oblationem devotionis et per virtutem huius sacramenti famulos congregationis istius a cunctis protege adversitatibus.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Almighty God, our offering of devotion, and through the power of this sacrament, protect the servants of this congregation from all adversities.

text: Copiosa protectionis tuae beneficia quaesumus Domine Deus familia ista consequatur ut quae sacratis tibi liminibus devota consistit intercessione beati Benedicti confessoris tui vitae praesentis subsidio gratuletur et gratiam aeternae benedictionis inveniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask for your abundant benefits, Lord God, that this family may follow. May they find the assistance of the present life through the intercession of your blessed confessor Benedict, and may they discover grace from eternal blessing.

text: Familiam huius coenobii quaesumus Domine intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria et beato Benedicto confessore tuo cum omnibus sanctis perpetuo guberna moderamine ut assit nobis et in securitate cautela et inter aspera fortitudo.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the family of this monastery may be under your protection with the intercession of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, and your blessed confessor, Benedict, along with all the saints. May they govern us with perpetual moderation, to assist us in safety, vigilance, and strength amidst trials.

text: Respice Domine propitius ad hostiam nostrae servitutis pro nobis et pro omni familia tua in hoc coenobio de gente tuo conspectui immolandam ut professionis sanctae propositum quod te inspirante suscepimus te gubernante custodiamus.
translation_en: Look upon us, O Lord, graciously towards our offering of servitude, for ourselves and for all your family in this monastery visible to your people. We offer it immolating, inspired by you, as we have received the vows of holy profession with you governing, that we may keep them protected.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras et muro custodiae tuae hoc ovile tuum circumda ut omni adversitate depulsa sit semper domicilium incolumitatis et pacis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers, and enclose this your sheepfold with the wall of your protection, that it may always be driven off from every adversity and remain an unharmed dwelling of safety and peace.

text: Deus Pater omnipotens verus pastor fidelium animarum concede nobis famulis tuis in hoc praesenti monasterio sanctae Margaritae virginis nec non sub regula sancti Benedicti constitutis in tuo amore caritatem et pacem ut quibus in unum congregatis iudicata est communio facultatum sit etiam te miserante sancta coniunctio animarum.
translation_en: God, Almighty Father and true shepherd of souls, grant to us, your servants, within this present monastery of Saint Margaret the Virgin, also under the rule of Saint Benedict, that in Your love we may have charity and peace. May it be, as we are gathered together into one, that communion of abilities is granted, and even while You mercifully join our souls, let there be a holy union of spirits.

text: Munera nostra tuae maiestati reverenter oblata caelesti benedictione sanctifica et per haec sacrosancta reconciliationis mundi mysteria nobis famulis tuis peccatoribus vinculum dilectionis infunde.
translation_en: We humbly offer our gifts to Your Majesty, and with heavenly blessing sanctify them. Through these most holy mysteries of reconciliation for the world, pour upon us, Your servants who are sinners, the bond of love.

text: Dirige nos quaesumus Domine famulos tuos in unitatem tuae caritatis et pacis et per haec sancta redemptionis mundi quae sumpsimus mysteria in unitate sanctae conversationis conservare digneris.
translation_en: Direct us, we humbly ask you, Lord, your servants, into the unity of your charity and peace, and through these sacred mysteries of the redemption of the world that we have received, may you deem worthy to conserve us in the unity of holy conversation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus miserere famulo tuo N. et dirige eum secundum tuam clementiam in viam salutis aeternae ut et donante tibi cupiat et tota virtute perficiat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, have mercy on your servant N., and guide him according to your clemency in the way of eternal salvation, so that he may desire to give to you and may complete it with all his strength.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine haec oblatio quam tuae supplices offerimus maiestati ad salutem famuli tui (famulorum tuorum) ut tua providentia eius (eorum) vita inter adversa et prospera ubique dirigatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that this offering which Thy suppliant presents to Thy majesty for the salvation of Thy servant (servants), may through Thy providence his (their) life be guided everywhere amidst adversity and prosperity.

text: Deus qui iustificas impium et non vis mortem peccatorum: maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecamur ut famulum tuum (famulos tuos) de tua misericordia confidentem (confidentes) caelesti protegas benignus auxilio conserva eum (eos) ut tibi iugiter famuletur (famulentur) et nullis temptationibus a te separetur (separentur).
translation_en: God who justifies the unjust and does not wish the death of sinners: we humbly beseech your majesty to protect your servant (your servants) with your benevolent help, confident in your mercy. May you graciously keep him (them) so that he (they) may forever serve you, and never be separated from you by any temptations.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostias placationis et laudis quas ego peccator et indignus famulus tuus tibi offerre praesumo ad honorem et gloriam nominis tui et pro incolumitate famuli tui (famulorum tuorum) ut omnium delictorum suorum veniam consequi mereatur (mereantur).
translation_en: Receive most mercifully, Father, the offerings of propitiation and praise which I, a sinner and unworthy servant, presume to present to You for Your honor and glory, and on behalf of the safety of Your servant (servants). May he merit (may they merit) forgiveness of all his (their) sins.

text: Purificent nos quaesumus Domine sacramenta quae sumpsimus et famulum tuum (famulos tuos) ab omni culpa liberum (liberos) esse concede ut qui conscientiae reatu constringitur (constringuntur) caelestis remedii plenitudine glorietur (glorientur).
translation_en: Purify us, we entreat you Lord, from the sacraments that we have received, and your servant (your servants) from any guilt. Grant them to be free. May he who is burdened with the weight of conscience glory in the fullness of celestial remedy.

text: Famulo tuo (famulis tuis) quaesumus omnipotens Deus misericordiam tuam dignanter impende per quam omnes adversantes declinet (declinent) atque sempiterna gaudia comprehendat (comprehendant).
translation_en: To your servant (servants), we humbly ask, O almighty God, that you bestow your mercy in such a way that all opponents withdraw (withdraw) and everlasting joy be grasped (grasped).

text: Tua quaesumus Domine sacramenta famulum tuum (famulos tuos) custodiant et contra omnes adversos semper tueantur incursus ut per haec devotionis officia et aeterna supplicia mereatur (mereantur) evadere et ad caelestem gloriam pervenire.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your sacraments may protect and always shield your servant (your servants) so that through these acts of devotion and eternal penance they may deserve (may deserve) to escape and reach celestial glory.

text: Perceptis tuis sacramentis Domine quaesumus famulum tuum (famulos tuos) caelesti protectione circumda ut te custodiente semper a malis omnibus sit securus (sint securi).
translation_en: Through your sacred mysteries, Lord, we ask that you envelop your servant (your servants) with celestial protection, so that he may always be secure (they may always be secure) under your guard from all evils.

text: Deus qui contritorum non despicis gemitum et merentium non spernis affectum: adesto propitius precibus nostris quas pietati tuae pro tribulatione nostra famuli tui (famulorum tuorum) offerimus suppliciter imploramus ut eas clementer suscipias et solo bonitatis tuae intuitu tribuas ut quicquid contra eum (nos | eos) diabolicae atque humanae moliuntur adversitates ad nihilum redigas et consilio misericordiae tuae allidas quatenus nullis adversitatibus laesus (laesi) sed ab omni tribulatione et angustia liberatus (liberati) gratias tibi referat securus (referant securi).
translation_en: God, who does not despise the groans of the penitent and does not scorn the desire of the meriting: be present graciously to our prayers which we offer devoutly on account of our tribulation as your servants (your servants'). We implore you humbly that you may take them up gently and grant them in the sight of your goodness alone, so that whatever devices of the devil and human machinations have brought against him (us | them) adversities may be reduced to nothing, and that he (they), unharmed (unharmed) by any tribulation or distress, may give thanks securely (thanks may be given securely) to you.

text: Deus qui tribulatos corde sanas et maestificatos actu laetificas: ad hanc propitius hostiam dignanter attende quam tibi pro servo tuo (pro peccastis nostris) offerimus et liberationem tuam ei (nobis) benignus attribue et eius (eorum | nostri) sana discrimina tribulationis eius (eorum | nostri) attende miseriam et angustiarum eius (eorum | nostri) submove pressuram ut exutus (exuti) omnibus quae patitur (patimur) malis in tuis semper laetetur (laetemur) praesidiis.
translation_en: God who heals the troubled heart and makes the mourning rejoice, graciously attend this worthy offering that we present to you on behalf of your servant (for our sins). May you graciously attribute your liberation to him (us) and attend to his (our) health during his (our) trial. Pay attention to his (our) misery and alleviate the burdens. May he (we) always rejoice (be joyful) in your presence.

text: Dimitte Deus clemens peccata nostra et tribue nobis misericordiam tuam orisque nostri alloquio deprecatus famuli tui (famulorum tuorum | nostram) humilitatem attende vincula solve delicta dele tribulationem aspice adversitatem repelle effectumque petitionis eius (eorum | nostrae) largiter et clementer exaudi.
translation_en: Gracious God, forgive us our sins and grant us your mercy. Attend to the humility of your servant (servants), solve the bonds, delete the offenses, remove the tribulation, look upon adversity, repel it, and generously and mercifully hear his (their) prayer.

text: Adesto quaesumus omnipotens Deus famulae tuae (famulabus tuis) de tua misericordia confidenti (confidentibus) eamque (easque) tua protectione custodi ut a cunctis adversitatibus liberata (liberatae) benedictionis aeternae digna inveniatur gratia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to be present with your servant (servants), confident in your mercy, and to protect her (them) so that, freed from all adversities, she (they) may worthy of the eternal blessing. Amen.

text: Hostias Domine quas tibi pro famula tua (famulabus tuis) offerimus propitius suscipe et mentem eius (earum) flamma tuae caritatis accende ut sacris actionibus in tanta (tantae) et a praesentibus liberetur (liberentur) adversis et sempiternae misericordiae perfrui mereatur (mereantur) gaudiis.
translation_en: Hostias, Lord, which we offer on behalf of your servant (servants), graciously receive and may the flame of Your loving kindness ignite his (their) mind, so that he (they) may be freed from adversities during these sacred actions, and deserve to partake in everlasting mercy and joys.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine ad salutem famulae tuae (famularum tuarum) divini celebratio sacramenti ut praesentem vitam sub tua protectione transcurrens mereatur (transcurrentes mereantur) invenire perpetuam.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your servant (your servants) may prosper in health through the divine celebration of the sacrament. May she (they) pass through this life under your protection and deserve (may they deserve) to find eternal life.

text: Deus qui caritatis dona per gratiam Sancti Spiritus tuorum cordibus fidelium infudisti: da famulis et famulabus tuis pro quibus tuam deprecamur clementiam salutem mentis et corporis ut te tota virtute diligant et quae tibi sunt placita tota dilectione perficiant.
translation_en: God who has infused the gifts of charity through the grace of the Holy Spirit into the hearts of your faithful: grant your servants and handmaids for whom we entreat your clemency, health of mind and body, that they may love you with their whole being and perform what pleases you with their entire devotion.

text: Miserere quaesumus Domine famulis et famulabus tuis pro quibus hoc sacrificium laudis tuae offerimus maiestati ut per haec supernae benedictionis gratiam obtineant et gloriam aeternae beatitudinis acquirat.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, Lord, we beseech you, on your servants and handmaids, for whom we offer this sacrifice of your praise, so that through these they may obtain the grace of heavenly blessings and acquire the glory of eternal beatitude.

text: Praetende Domine famulis et famulabus tuis omnibus fidelibus Christianis episcopis abbatibus presbyteris canonicis monachis sive regibus et sanctae Dei Ecclesiae gubernatoribus atque consanguineis nostris et his qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas sive etiam ceteris fidelibus dexteram caelestis auxilii ut te toto corde perquirant et quae digne postulant consequi mereantur.
translation_en: Bend to us, Lord, your servants and handmaids, all faithful Christians - bishops, abbots, presbyters, canons, monks, kings, governors of the holy Church, relatives and those who have committed themselves to us with their prayers, as well as others who have bestowed alms upon us. May they find the right hand of heavenly aid, that they may seek you wholeheartedly and merit what they worthily ask for.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicantibus nostris et has oblationes quas tibi pro incolumitate omnium episcoporum abbatum presbyterorum canonicorum monachorum sive regum et sanctae Dei Ecclesiae gubernatorum atque consanguineorum nostrorum et 〈eorum〉 qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas seu ceterorum fidelium offerimus; benignus assume et ut nullius sit irritum votum nullius vacua postulatio praesta quaesumus ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplicants and these offerings which we present to you for the welfare of all bishops, abbots, priests, canons, monks, kings, governors, and relatives, and those who have commended themselves to us in prayers, and have bestowed alms upon us; may you be gracious and grant that no vow is unanswered, no petition vacant. We ask that what we faithfully request, we may effectively achieve.

text: Da famulis et famulabus tuis quaesumus Domine omnibus episcopis abbatibus presbyteris canonicis monachis sive regibus et sanctae Dei Ecclesiae gubernatoribus atque consanguineis nostris et his qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas seu etiam ceteris fidelibus in tua fide et sinceritate constantiam ut in caritate divina firmati nullis temptationibus ab eius integritate vellantur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to give to all your servants - bishops, abbots, priests, canons, monks, kings and governors of the holy Church, and to our relatives and those who have commended themselves to us in prayers, as well as to other faithful - constancy in your faith and sincerity, so that they may remain unshaken by any temptation from their integrity.

text: Deus a quo sancta desideria recta consilia et iusta sunt opera: da servis tuis illam quam mundus dare non potest pacem ut et corda nostra mandatis tuis dedita et hostium sublata formidine tempora sint tua protectione tranquilla.
translation_en: God from whom holy desires, right counsels, and just works are: grant to your servants that peace which the world cannot give. May our hearts be devoted to your commandments, and may the fear of enemies be removed, so that time may be peaceful under your protection.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus supplicationes et preces quas tibi ego peccator praesumo offerre in honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et in commemorationem beatae Mariae semper Virginis matris eius et omnium sanctorum apostolorum martyrum confessorum ac virginum tuarum pro pace et sanitate populorum tuorum et fructibus terrae et stabilitate Ecclesiae et ordine sanctorum et sanitate regis et episcopi nostri et pro me misero famulo et pro omnibus viventibus famulis et famulabus tuis atque defunctis fidelibus tuis et qui mihi propter nomen tuum Domine bona fecerunt et qui mihi in tuo nomine confessi fuerunt; et concede propitius ut intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis ante conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae misericordiam consequantur.
translation_en: Graciously receive, O most compassionate Father, almighty eternal God, the supplications and prayers which I, a sinner, presume to offer in honor of our Lord Jesus Christ and in commemoration of the blessed Mary, ever-virgin Mother of Him, all your apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, for the peace and health of your people, fruitfulness of the earth, stability of the Church, order of saints, health of our king and bishop, and for me, the miserable servant, as well as for all your living servants and servants, faithful departed, and those who have done good to me in your name, Lord, and who have confessed in your name; and graciously grant that they may follow your mercy through the intercession of all your saints before the divine majesty of yours.

text: Oblationes nostras quaesumus Domine propitius intende quas tibi offerimus in honorem nominis tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi et in commemorationem beatae Mariae semper Virginis et beatorum apostolorum martyrum confessorum ac virginum pro pace et sanitate populorum tuorum et pro incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum commemorationem agimus et pro animabus omnium fidelium defunctorum quorum numerum Domine tu solus cognoscis; et concede ut sacrificia praesentis oblationis ad refrigerium animarum eorum te miserante proveniant.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to turn propitiously toward our offerings, which we present in honor of Your name, our Lord Jesus Christ, and in commemoration of the blessed Mary, ever-Virgin, and all the apostles, martyrs, confessors, and virgins. We pray for peace, health, and safety for Your people, and for the welfare of Your servants and handmaids whom we remember, as well as for the souls of all the faithful departed whose number only You, Lord, know. And grant that the sacrifices of this present offering may bring comfort to their souls through Your mercy.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sacramenta caelestia quaesumus intercedente beata Maria semper Virgine Dei Genitrice et omnibus sanctis apostolis et martyribus confessoribus et virginibus tuis ad vitam nobis et omnibus quorum commemorationem agimus proficiant sempiternam.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the heavenly sacraments, we humbly entreat you, with the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, ever-virgin Mother of God, and all your apostles, martyrs, confessors, and virgins. May they lead us and all whose commemoration we celebrate to eternal life.

text: Omnium sanctorum tuorum intercessionibus quaesumus Domine nos protege famulis et famulabus tuis quorum commemorationem agimus et quorum eleemosynas recepimus seu etiam qui nobis familiaritate et consanguinitate iuncti sunt; misericordiam tuam ubique praetende ut ab omnibus impugnationibus defensi tua opitulatione salventur et animas famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium videlicet fidelium catholicorum quorum commemorationem agimus electorum tuorum iungere digneris consortio.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, through the intercession of all Your saints, to protect us, Your servants and servants, whose remembrance we are making and whose alms we have received, or even those who are united with us by familiarity or kinship. May Your mercy be everywhere extended, so that we may be defended from all attacks through Your help, and may the souls of all Your servants, that is, all the Catholic faithful whose remembrance we make, be worthy to join the company of Your elect.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes quas pro incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum et pro pace totius Ecclesiae tuae et pro animabus omnium fidelium defunctorum nomini tuo consecrandas deferimus; tu placatus ac benignus assume ut sacrificii praesentis oblatio ad salutem et incolumitatem corporum eorum et ad refrigerium animarum eorum te miserante proveniat.
translation_en: We entreat You, Lord, with our supplications, and the offerings which we bring for the welfare of your servants and their families, for the peace of Your entire Church, and for the souls of all the faithful departed whom You name consecrates; You, being appeased and gracious, accept that the offering of this sacrifice is offered up for the health and safety of their bodies and for the refreshment of their souls, may it come forth through Your mercy.

text: Purificent nos Domine quaesumus et divini sacramenti perceptio et gloriosa sanctorum tuorum omnium oratio et animabis famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium videlicet fidelium catholicorum quorum commemorationem agimus remissionem cunctorum tribue peccatorum.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, we beseech You, and through the reception of Your divine sacrament, and through the prayers of all Your glorious saints, as well as the souls of Your servants, all of them, that is, of the Catholic faithful whose commemoration we make, grant remission of all sins.

text: Pietate tua quaesumus Domine nostrorum solve vincula omnium delictorum et intercedente beata et gloriosa semperque Virgine Dei Genitrice Maria cum omnibus sanctis tuis nos famulos tuos et omnem populum catholicum in omni sanctitate custodi omnesque consanguinitate ac familiaritate vel confessione et oratione nobis iunctos a vitiis omnibus purga virtutibus tuis illustra pacem et salutem nobis tribue hostes visibiles et invisibiles remove pestem repelle inimicis nostris caritatem largire et omnibus fidelibus vivis ac defunctis in terra viventium vitam et requiem aeternam concede.
translation_en: Through your mercy, we humbly ask you, Lord, to dissolve the chains of all sins. Through the intercession of the blessed and glorious ever-virgin Virgin Mother of God, Mary, with all your saints, protect us, your servants, and all the Catholic people in every holiness. Custodie us from every kinship and familiarity, or confession and prayer, purify us from all vices, illuminate peace and salvation for us, remove visible and invisible enemies, drive away pestilence, repel our enemies with love, and grant eternal life and rest to all the faithful, both living and dead on earth.

text: Deus qui singulari corporis tui hostia totius mundi solvisti delicta: hac oblatione placatus maculas scelerum nostrorum absterge et cuncta adversa repelle et omnia prospera nobis tribue et omnium Christianorum vivorum ac defunctorum peccata dimitte nobisque praemia aeterna concede.
translation_en: God, who by the offering of your unique body freed the whole world from sin: with this offering, may you be appeased and wipe away the stains of our sins, drive away all adversities, grant us every good thing, and forgive the sins of all Christians, living and deceased. Grant us eternal rewards and bestow eternal blessings upon us.

text: Sumpta sacramenta quaesumus Domine crimina nostra detergant omnemque pravitatem et hostilem impugnationem visibilem et invisibilem meritis sanctorum omnium a nobis procul pellant et omnibus fidelibus vivis et defunctis prosint ad veniam pro quorum quarumque tibi sunt oblata salute.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the sacraments be taken up may cleanse our sins and drive away all wickedness and visible or invisible attacks from us. May the merits of all the saints cast them far from us and benefit all living and dead faithful for their forgiveness, for whose souls are offered to You in salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui vivorum dominaris simul et mortuorum omniumque misereris quos tuos fide et opere futuros esse praenoscis: te supplices exoramus ut pro quibus effundere preces decrevimus quosque vel praesens adhuc saeculum in carne retinet vel futurum iam exutos corpore suscepit pietatis tuae clementia omnium delictorum suorum veniam et gaudia consequi mereantur aeterna.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who rules over the living and shows mercy to all, both those you foresee will be your own through faith and good works, whether they are still present in this world in flesh or have already shed their bodies: we humbly entreat you that those for whom we pour out our prayers may merit the forgiveness of all their sins and eternal joy through your mercy.

text: Praeveniat famulos et famulas tuas quaesumus Domine gratia tua semper et subsequatur pro quibus has oblationes nomini tuo consecrandas deferimus et praesta ut cunctis illis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: May Your servants and handmaids precede, we beseech You, Lord, with Your grace always. May it follow for those for whom we bring these offerings to consecrate in Your name. Grant that all of them may prosper towards salvation.

text: Purificet nos quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus sacramentum quod sumpsimus et praesta ut non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sed intercessio salutaris ad veniam sit ab lucio scelerum sit fortitudo fragilium sit contra mundi pericula firmamentum sit vivorum atque mortuorum fidelium remissio omnium delictorum.
translation_en: Purify us, we beseech You, Almighty and merciful God, the sacrament that we have received, and grant that there be no guilt for punishment for us, but a saving intercession for forgiveness; let it be a light against evils, a strength for the weak, a protection against worldly dangers, a remission of all sins for both the living and the dead faithful.

text: Omnium sanctorum tuorum intercessionibus quaesumus Domine gratia tua nos protegat et Christianis omnibus viventibus atque defunctis misericordiam tuam ubique praetende ut viventes ab omnibus impugnationibus defensi tua opitulatione salventur et defuncti remissionem mereantur suorum omnium accipere peccatorum.
translation_en: Through the intercession of all your saints, we humbly ask you, Lord, that your grace protect us and extend your mercy to all Christians living and deceased. May the living be defended from every attack by your help, and may they be saved through your intervention. May the departed deserve forgiveness for all their sins.

text: Oblationibus nostris quaesumus Domine propitius intende ut pro tuorum omnium sanctorum intercessione veniam nobis nostrorum tribue peccatorum ac Christianis omnibus viventibus atque defunctis haec praesens libatio et praesentis vitae commoda futuri regni praemia acquirat.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to graciously attend to our offerings. May it be through the intercession of all Your saints that You grant us forgiveness for our sins and eternal life to all Christians, living and dead. May this present libation and the rewards of this present life acquire for us the prizes of the future kingdom.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus clementiam tuam humiliter imploramus pro famulo tuo qui nobis sua confessus est facinora ut indulgentiam ei conferas sempiternam.
translation_en: We humbly beseech the almighty eternal God for his clemency, that he may grant mercy to your servant who has confessed his sins to us, and bestow upon him eternal forgiveness.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut haec oblatio quam tibi pro famulo tuo qui nobis propria confessus est facinora offerimus sit in oculis tuis accepta quatenus per haec sancta commercia indulgentiam valeant percipere peccatorum.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Almighty God, that this offering which we present to you on behalf of your servant who has confessed his sins to us, may be acceptable in your sight. May through these holy transactions forgiveness may be obtained for the sins.

text: Da quaesumus clementissime Pater indulgentiam perpetuam famulo tuo qui nobis propria confessus est peccata et concede ei ut in praeceptis tuis iugiter perseveret.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask You most merciful Father, a permanent indulgence to Your servant who has confessed his sins to us. And may he always persevere in Your commandments.

text: Deus qui post baptismi sacramentum secundam abolitionem peccatorum eleemosynis indidisti: respice propitius famulum tuum (famulos tuos) pro cuius (quorum) operibus tibi gratiae referuntur fac eum (eos) quaesumus recipere pro parvis magna pro terrenis caelestia pro temporalibus sempiterna.
translation_en: God, who bestowed alms after the sacrament of baptism to remove sins: look upon us graciously, your servant (servants), for whose works gratitude is given to you. We pray that you receive him (them) for us. May small things be granted eternal things, terrestrial things heavenly ones.

text: Deus qui tuorum corda fidelium per eleemosynam dixisti posse mundari: praesta quaesumus ut famulus tuus (famuli tui) pro quo (quibus) hanc oblationem tibi offerimus fructum aeternae retributionis percipiant.
translation_en: God, who through alms have said that the hearts of your faithful can be purified: grant us, we pray, that your servant (your servants) for whom we offer this oblation to you may receive the fruit of eternal reward.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus famulum tuum (famulos tuos) placatus intende qui recolens (recolentes) divina mandata opem indigentibus subministrat quaesumus ut sicut eius (eorum) devotio nobis est necessaria ita sit tibi semper accepta.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, turn your favorable gaze upon your servant (servants), who, in recalling (recalling) divine commands, provide aid to those in need. We ask that, just as their devotion is necessary for us, so may our devotion always be acceptable to you.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine supplicum preces et confitentis (confitentium) tibi famuli tui (famulorum tuorum) parce peccatis ut pariter ei (eis) indulgentiam tribuas benignus et pacem.
translation_en: Hear us, we beseech You, Lord, the prayers of Your suppliant (supplicants) and confessing (confessing ones) servants (servants), be merciful to their sins, that graciously You may grant them forgiveness and peace.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus aeterne Salvator ut hoc munere maiestati tuae oblato famulus tuus percipiens (famuli tui percipientes) suorum veniam peccatorum deinceps peccata vitare mereatur (mereantur).
translation_en: Grant us, we ask eternally, O Savior, that your servant offered in this service may perceive (may your servants perceive) the forgiveness of his sins and henceforth deserve to avoid further sins (may deserve).

text: Deus cui proprium est misereri semper et parcere: suscipe deprecationem nostram et famulum tuum (famulos tuos) quem (quos) delictorum catena constringit miseratio tuae pietatis absolvat.
translation_en: God, who is always merciful and compassionate, receive our prayer and your servant (your servants) whom the chain of sins constrains; may your mercy free him (them) through your pity.

text: Hostias tibi Domine placationis et laudis offerimus ut et delicta nostra miseratus absolvas et nutantia corda tu dirigas.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, sacrifices of propitiation and praise, that You may have mercy on our sins and direct our wavering hearts.

text: Ineffabilem misericordiam tuam quaesumus Domine nobis (illis) peccatoribus clementer ostende ut simul nos (eos) et a peccatis omnibus exuas et a poenis quas pro his meremur (merentur) potenter eripias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to reveal your ineffable mercy to us, sinners, gently, that you may clothe us, and them, with all sins; and powerfully free us from the penalties we deserve (they deserve).

text: A cunctis peccatis purificet nos (eos) Domine quaesumus muneris praesentis oblatio et ab omni flagello nos (eos) liberet et dignos sacra participatione perficiat.
translation_en: May the present offering purify us from all sins, Lord, we beseech Thee; and may it set us free from every scourge and make us worthy of holy participation.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut ab omnibus peccatis expiati et ab omni flagello liberati ad superni plenitudinem sacramenti cuius libavimus sancta tendamus (tendant).
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that we may be expiated from all sins and freed from every scourge, and directed to the fullness of the heavenly sacrament, unto which we strive with holy endeavor (strive).

text: Ne despicias omnipotens Deus nos famulos tuos in afflictione clamantes sed propter gloriam nominis tui tribulatis succurre placatus.
translation_en: O Almighty God, do not disdain your servants who cry out to you in affliction, but hear our plea and come to our aid for the glory of your name.

text: Hostias nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus suscipe et iram tuae indignationis quam famulus tuus meretur (famuli tui merentur) clementer averte.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive our offerings that, as your servant deserves (servants deserve), you may turn away your wrath and indignation with clemency.

text: Vivificet nos famulos tuos Domine sacrae participationis infusio et ab omni malo perpetua protectione defendat.
translation_en: May Your servants, Lord, be made alive by the infusion of sacred participation and defend us forever from all evil with perpetual protection.

text: Ecclesiae tuae Domine preces placatus admitte ut destructis omnibus quae contra nos humanae moliuntur contrarietates secura tibi serviamus libertate.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive our prayers in Your church, so that destroyed are all oppositions to us by human efforts which contradict us. May we serve You securely with freedom.

text: Protege nos Domine Deus quaesumus ab omni adversitate ut tuis mysteriis servientes securi et corpore tibi famulemur et mente.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord God, we ask, from every adversity, so that as servants of your mysteries we may be secure and serve you bodily, and with our mind.

text: Defende nos quaesumus Domine ab omni malorum obloquio ut nec terreri nos lacerationibus patiaris iniustis nec adulationibus implicari sed potius amare quae praecipis.
translation_en: Defend us, we beseech You, Lord, from every evil temptation, that neither may we suffer torment by unjust injuries nor be ensnared in flattery, but rather love what You command.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut haec sancta quae sumpsimus nos a cunctis improborum lacerationibus muniant ut quae tibi sunt placita tua gratia largiente iugiter exsequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we ask, that these holy things which we have received may protect us from all the stains of impurity, so that with your grace continually bestowed upon us, we may ever carry out what is pleasing to you.

text: Hostium nostrorum quaesumus Domine elide superbiam et dexterae tuae virtute prosterne ut iustitiae non dominetur iniquitas sed semper subdatur falsitas veritati.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to eliminate the pride of our hosts and, by the might of your right hand, bend them low so that iniquity does not rule over justice but is always subdued by truth.

text: Huius Domine virtute mysterii et a nostris mundemur occultis et ab inimicorum liberemur insidiis.
translation_en: By the power of this Lord, let us be purified from our hidden sins and freed from the traps of our enemies.

text: Vivificet nos quaesumus Domine participatio tui sancta mysterii et pariter nobis tribuat et munimen contra adversariorum insidias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your holy participation in the mystery may revive us, and grant us protection against the deceit of our adversaries.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine piae supplicationis effectum et pestilentiam famemque propitiatus a nobis averte ut mortalium corda cognoscant et te indignante talia flagella prodire et te miserante cessare.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, the effect of pious supplications and turn away from us the plague and famine that You may enlighten the hearts of men to realize that such scourges come from Your anger and cease because of Your mercy.

text: Sacrificia tibi Domine cum Ecclesiae precibus immolanda quaesumus corda nostra purificent et indulgentiae tuae nobis dona concilient et adversa in prospera commutari faciant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to offer sacrifices to you alongside the prayers of the Church, may our hearts be purified and may your grace bestow upon us; may conflicts be reconciled and adversities turn into prosperity.

text: Guberna nos quaesumus Domine temporalibus adiumentis et ab omnibus defende clementer adversis quos dignatus es aeternis informare mysteriis.
translation_en: Guide us, we beseech You, Lord, with temporal help, and defend us gently against all adversities which You have deigned to instruct with eternal mysteries.

text: Subveniat nobis Domine quaesumus sacrificii praesentis oblatio quae nos et ab erroribus universis potenter absolvat et a totius eripiat perditionis incursu.
translation_en: May the Lord help us, we pray, the offering of this present sacrifice, which may powerfully free us from all errors and snatch us from the onslaught of eternal damnation.

text: Parce Domine parce peccatis nostris et quamvis incessabiliter delinquentibus continua poena debeatur praesta quaesumus ut quod ad perpetuum meremur exitium transeat ad correctionis auxilium et tribulationem istam quam pro peccatis nostris super nos nimis cognoscimus praevalere te miserante cognoscamus cessare.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy, Lord, have mercy on our sins. Although the punishment is continuously due for those who incessantly sin, we humbly ask that what we deserve for eternal punishment may pass to the aid of correction and this tribulation, which for our sins we know all too well prevails over us, may be known by Your mercy to cease.

text: Deus qui humani generis utramque substantiam praesentium munerum et alimento vegetas et renovas sacramento: praesta quaesumus ut eorum et corporibus nostris subsidium non desit et mentibus.
translation_en: God who sustains and renews the twofold substance of humanity with gifts and nourishment through the sacrament: grant, we beseech you, that no assistance may fail them or us, and strengthen our minds.

text: Vitia cordum nostrorum haec Domine quaesumus medicina salutaris quam sumpsimus compescat quae mortalitatis nostrae venit curare languores.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the healing medicine which we have received may correct the vices of our hearts, which have come to heal our mortality and alleviate our weaknesses.

text: Deus qui ad hoc irasceris ut subvenias ad hoc minaris ut parcas: lapsis manuum porrige et laborantibus multiplici miseratione succurre ut qui per te sunt redempti ad spem vitae aeternae tua miseratione praeparentur.
translation_en: God, who hast been so angered as to intervene, and hast threatened so as to show mercy: extend your hand to the fallen, and come to the aid of those who labor with abundant compassion. May those who are redeemed by you be prepared for the hope of eternal life through your mercy.

text: Populi tui quaesumus omnipotens Deus propitiare peccatis et terrores totius hostilitatis a nobis averte ut Christiani nominis secura tibi libertas in tua devotione semper exsultet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to propitiate our sins and turn away from us the terrors of all hostility so that the Christian name may always rejoice securely in your liberty through our devotion to you.

text: Protege Domine famulos tuos subsidiis pacis et corporalibus enutriens nos alimentis a cunctis hostibus redde securos.
translation_en: Lord, protect your servants with the sustenance of peace and nourish us with bodily food from all enemies, make us secure from all adversaries.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui salvas omnes homines et neminem vis perire: aperi fontem benignitatis tuae et terram aridam pluviarum irrigatione dignanter infunde.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who saves all men and desires none to perish: open the fountain of your goodness and worthy it is that you water the dry earth with showers of rain.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine pluviam salutarem et aridam terrae sanem fluentis caelestibus dignanter infunde.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, a healthful and refreshing rain upon the earth; may you graciously pour down from heaven what is fitting.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus clementiam tuam ut famulorum tuorum oblatione suscepta inundantiam coërceas imbrium et hilaritatem tui vultus nobis impertiri digneris.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God to grant his mercy, that as our servants' offerings are accepted, you would compel an abundance of your blessings and bestow upon us the joy of your countenance.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui artam et angustam quae ad vitam ducit iussisti arripi viam famulum tuum N.: de huius periculis ad te confugientem propitius suscipe et delictorum catenam qua se constrictum esse sentit clementer disrumpe perseverantiamque boni operis et praemia ei largire perpetua.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has commanded the narrow and difficult way that leads to life, snatch up the way of your servant N. From these dangers, be propitious and graciously receive him as he flees to you. Break gently the chains of sin that he feels constricted by, and grant him perseverance in good works and give him eternal rewards.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine famuli tui dignanter suscipe et quem desiderio aeternae beatitudinis a mundo segregasti proposito etiam a delectatione carnali et ab omnibus antiqui hostis insidiis potenter eripe.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, our servant, graciously receive the gifts and those whom you have separated from the world by the desire for eternal beatitude, also free them from carnal delight and all the ancient enemy's snares powerfully.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine divini sacramenti perceptio a nostris mundet offensis et famulum tuum a mundanis pravitatibus et omnibus tumultuum carnalium delectationibus clementer eripiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the reception of this divine sacrament, cleanse us from our worldly offenses and free your servant from earthly vices and all carnal delights of tumultuous behavior.

text: Infunde quaesumus Domine famulis tuis pro rebus Ecclesiae tuae ordinandis in nomine tuo congregatis spiritum veritatis et pacis ut quae tibi placita sint toto corde cognoscant et agnita tota virtute sectemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, pour out upon Your servants the Spirit of truth and peace for things being arranged in Your Church. So that what pleases You may be known with all heart, and followed entirely with all virtue.

text: Respiciat quaesumus Domine clementia tua munera servorum tuorum qui in tuo nomine ad res Ecclesiae tuae ordinandas sunt congregati et gratiam tuae miserationis illis impende ut quae recta sunt in oculis tuis intelligant et fiducialiter loquantur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your clemency bestows gifts upon your servants who have been gathered for the ordinations of your Church. May your grace of mercy be poured out upon them, so that what is right in your sight they may understand, and speak with confident faith.

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine Deus longaeva prosperitate populo tuo rectorem quem dedisti et nobis famulis tuis caritatis spiritum infunde et populum Christianum tuae potentiae dextera ab omni adversitate custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord God, to preserve with long-lasting prosperity your people and the ruler you have given them. Infuse upon us, your servants, the spirit of charity, and protect the Christian people from every adversity with your mighty right hand.

text: Ab omni reatu nos Domine sancta quae tractamus absolvant et eadem muniant a totius pravitatis incursu.
translation_en: From every sin, Lord, may we be absolved and protected by your holy grace, shielding us from all assaults of wickedness.

text: Quos refecisti Domine caelesti mysterio a propriis et ab alienis propitiatus absolve delictis ut divino munere satiati purificatis mentibus perfruamur.
translation_en: Which you have renewed, Lord, in the heavenly mystery from their own and from others' offenses, propitiated, grant absolution, so that being satisfied by divine grace, we may enjoy a purified mind.

text: Tribulationem famuli tui N. quaesumus Domine placatus intende et iram tuae indignationis quam iuste meretur propitiatus averte.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to turn your attention towards the tribulation of your servant N., and to turn away your wrath that he justly deserves, may it be appeased.

text: Quaesumus Domine nostris placare muneribus ut quicquid illud est quid ira tua adversus famulum tuum N. excitavit horum intuitu clemens suspende.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, to appease our sins through Your mercy so that whatever anger Your wrath aroused against Your servant N., in this regard, You may show clemency and suspend it.

text: Sumpti sacrificii Domne libamen quaesumus caelestis irae vindictam a famulo tuo suspendat et noxia semper ab eo cuncta depellat.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the offering of the sacrifice be pleasing to You. May Your heavenly wrath hold back vengeance against Your servant and may all harm always be driven away from him.

text: Deus qui diligentibus te misericordiam tuam semper impendis et servientibus tibi in nulla es regione longinquus: dirige viam famulorum tuorum in voluntate tua ut te protectore et te duce per iustitiae semitas sine offensione gradiantur.
translation_en: God, who always bestows Your mercy upon those who seek You, and to those serving You in no distant region: direct the way of Your servants according to Your will, so that they may walk without offense through the paths of righteousness, with You as their protector and guide.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes quas tibi offerimus pro famulis tuis benignus assume ut viam illorum ex praecedente gratia tua dirigas ut de actu atque incolumitate eorum secundum misericordiae tuae praesidia gaudeamus.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate our supplications and accept these offerings that we present to you for your servants. May a gracious God assume them, and may the way of these servants, led by your grace, be directed so that we may rejoice in their deeds and safety according to Your mercy's protection.

text: Dirige Deus viam famulorum tuorum nosque pro eis exaudi supplicantes ut habeant iter prosperum et vitae cor directum.
translation_en: Direct, O God, the way of thy servants, and hear us while we pray. Grant them a prosperous journey, and may their life's course be straight.

text: Deus infinitae misericordiae maiestatis immensae quem nec spatia locorum nec intervalla temporum ab his quos tueris adiungunt: adesto famulis tuis in te ubique fidentibus et per omnem quam acturi sunt viam dux eis et comes esse dignare nihil illis adversitatis noceat nihil difficultatis obsistat cuncta eis salubria cuncta sint prospera ut sub ope dexterae tuae quicquid iusto expetierint desiderio celeri consequantur effectu.
translation_en: God of infinite mercy and immense majesty, who neither the spaces of places nor the intervals of time separate from those whom you protect: be present to your servants who trust in you everywhere, and deign to be their guide and companion through every way they are about to act. May nothing adversity harm them, may nothing obstacle oppose them; may all things be healthy for them, may all things be prosperous, so that under the help of your right hand, whatever they have justly sought with desire, they may swiftly achieve in effect.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine preces famulorum tuorum cum oblationibus hostiarum et tua mysteria celebrantes ab omnibus defende periculis.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you Lord, the prayers of your servants along with the offerings of sacrifices and while celebrating your mysteries, defend them from all dangers.

text: Sanctificati divino mysterio maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter deprecamur et petimus ut quos donis facis caelestibus interesse per lignum sanctae Crucis et a peccatis abstrahas et a periculis cunctis miseratus eripis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your majesty, Lord, and we ask that you make us participate in the divine mystery through the holy wood of the Cross. We implore you to separate us from sins and free us from all dangers.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus cui redditur votum in Ierusalem: pro merita et intercessione beati N. exaudi preces famuli tui N. memor esto sacrificii sui pingue fiat holocaustum suum tribue ei quaesumus divitias gratiae suae comple in bonis desiderium suum corona eum in miseratione et misericordia ut tibi pia devotione iugiter famuletur ignosce ei facinora et ne lugenda committat et paterna pietate castiga.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God to whom a vow is rendered in Jerusalem: for the merits and intercession of blessed N., hear the prayers of your servant N. Remember his sweet offering, let his holocaust be pleasing to you, grant him the riches of your grace, fill in him his desire. Crown him with mercy and compassion, that he may constantly serve you with pious devotion, forgive him his transgressions, prevent him from committing lamentable sins, and correct him with parental pity.

text: Exaudi omnipotens Deus deprecationem nostram pro famulo tuo N. qui in honorem sancti ac beatissimi N. oblationem tibi offeret ut per eius merita vota ipsius perficias petitiones eius ascendant ad aures clementiae tuae et descendat super eum pia benedictio tua ut sub umbra alarum tuarum auxilio protegatur.
translation_en: Hear us, all-powerful God, our supplication for your servant N., who offers an oblation in honor of the holy and blessed N. May their merits bring about the fulfillment of his vows, may his petitions ascend to the ears of your mercy, and may your pious blessing descend upon him so that he is protected under the shadow of your wings with your help.

text: Munere divino percepto quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beato N. devotionem famuli tui N. confirmes in bono et mittas ei auxilium de sancto de Sion tue eum.
translation_en: Having perceived the divine gift, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that with the intercession of blessed N., you strengthen the devotion of your servant N. in good things and send him help from the holy one of Zion, that he may be with you.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui secundum magnam misericordiam tuam peccata paenitentium deles et in te sperantibus celeri pietate succurris: famulo tui N. quaesumus remissionem tribue peccatorum et vota placatus assume renova in eum piissime Pater quicquid terrena fragilitate corruptum est quicquid diabolica immissione violatum est miserere Domine gemituum eius miserere lacrimarum ut de memore in gaudium per tuam misericordiam transferatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who according to your great mercy forgive the sins of those who repent and swiftly help those who hope in you: we humbly ask you to grant forgiveness to your servant N. and accept his prayers favorably. Renew in him most graciously, Father, whatever has been corrupted by earthly frailty, whatever has been violated by diabolic influence. Have mercy, Lord, on his tears; have mercy on his groans. May he be transferred from sorrow to joy through your mercy.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus misericors Deus clemens qui indulgentiam tuam nulla temporum lege concludis: suscipe preces et hostias quas tibi pro indulgentia famuli tui N. deferimus ut et peccatorum ei veniam misericors largiaris et cordi eius recta desideria implere digneris.
translation_en: We humbly ask the omnipotent, merciful God, gracious God, who encloses your indulgence without any temporal law: receive our prayers and offerings that we present to you on behalf of the indulgence for your servant N. May a merciful forgiveness be granted to him, and may his heart's right desires be worthy of being fulfilled.

text: Deus qui misericordiae tuae potentis auxilio et prospera tribuis et adversa depellis: universa obstacula quae famulo tuo N. adversantur virtute sacramenti tui expugna ut remotis temptationibus universis indefessa te gratiarumactione laudemus.
translation_en: God, who with the powerful aid of your mercy grants prosperity and repels adversity: may all obstacles that hinder your servant N. through the virtue of your sacrament be overcome, so that removed from all temptations, we may without cease offer you grateful praise.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicata sanctifica et per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: Gifts, Lord, dedicated to you, sanctify them, and through them, may you turn your attention towards us pleased.

text: Mysteria sancta nos Domine et spiritalibus repleant alimentis et corporalibus tueantur auxiliis.
translation_en: O Lord, may the sacred mysteries fill us with spiritual nourishment and protect us with physical aid.

text: Deus qui fidelium semper devotione laetaris: famulos tuos quaesumus tibi fac esse devotos ut qui a tuo officio impia pravitate mentis abscedunt per tuam conversi gratiam a laqueis diaboli quibus capti tenentur resipiscant.
translation_en: God who always delights in the faithful's constant devotion: we ask you to make your servants devoted, so that those who depart from your duty due to impious wickedness of mind may return through your gracious conversion and repent, turning away from the snares of the devil in which they are held captive.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et famulis tuis nihil de sua conscientia praesumentibus ineffabili miseratione succurre ut quod non habet fiducia meritorum illis tua conferat largitas invicta donorum.
translation_en: Attend to us, Lord, with our supplications and your servants; may nothing presuming upon its own conscience assume your ineffable mercy, but instead provide for them what they lack through the bounty of your gifts, O invincible one.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine desiderare quae recta sunt et vitare quae noxa ut sancta quae maiestati tuae obtulimus non ad iudicium nobis et famulis tuis sed potius proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, to desire the right things and to avoid the wrong, so that what we have offered to your majesty as holy may not lead us and your servants to judgment but rather benefit us towards healing.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus pro sacra conubii lege munus oblatum et cuius largitor es muneris operis esto dispositor.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we ask you, for the sacred law of marriage, the gift offered, and You who are the giver of all gifts, be the dispenser of this service.

text: Deus qui potestate virtutis tuae cuncta fecisti qui dispositis universitatis exordiis hominem ad imaginem Dei factum ideo inseparabile mulieris adiutorium condidisti ut femineo corpori de virili dares carne principium docens quod ex uno placuisset institui numquam liceret disiungi. Deus qui tam excellenti mysterio coniugalem copulam consecrasti ut Christi ecclesiae sacramentum praesignares infoedere nuptiarum.
