Deus per quem mulier iungitur viro et societas principaliter ordinata ea benedictione donatur quae sola nec per originalis peccati poenam nec per diluvium est ablata sententia. Respice propitius super hanc famulam tuam N. quae maritali iungenda consortio tua se expetit protectione muneri; sit in ea iugum dilectionis et pacis fidelis et castae nubat in Christo imitatrixque sanctarum permaneat feminarum sit amabilis ut Rachel viro sapiens ut Rebecca longaeva et fidelis ut Sara. Nihil in ea ex actibus suis ille auctor praevaricationis usurpet nexa fidei mandatisque permaneat unitoro iuncta contactus inlicitos fugiat muniat infirmitatem suam robore disciplinae sit verecundia gravis pudore venerabilis doctrinis caelestibus erudita sit fecunda in subole sit probata et innocens et ad beatorum requiem atque ad caelestia regna perveniat et videant ambo filios filiorum suorum usque in tertiam et quartam generationem et ad optatam perveniant senectutem.
translation_en: God, who created all things by the power of your virtue, and who established humanity at the beginning of the universe to be made in the image of God, you have made woman an indissoluble helper for man by giving her the principle of life from the male. Teaching that it was never allowed for one to please to be instituted separately. God, who consecrated the marital union in such an excellent mystery, that you may signify the sacrament of Christ's church through marriage. God, through whom woman is joined to man and the society is primarily ordered by this blessing, which alone was not removed neither by the penalty of original sin nor by the flood, looks favorably upon your servant N., who seeks protection in the matrimonial union; may there be a faithful and chaste yoke of love and peace in her. May she marry in Christ, imitating the saints, be beloved as Rachel, wise as Rebecca, and faithful as Sarah. Let nothing in her deeds be the author of deceit, bound by faith and commands she remains united. May she flee unlawful contacts, may she be fortified by her own weakness with the strength of discipline, may she be modest, reverent, venerable, well-educated in celestial doctrines, fruitful in offspring, proven and innocent, and may she reach the beatific rest and heavenly kingdoms. May both see their sons and grandsons up to the third and fourth generation, and may they attain old age.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicantibus nostris et institutis tuis quibus propaginem humani generis ordinasti benignus assiste ut quod te auctore coniungitur te auxiliante servetur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplicants and your institutions which you have ordered for the propagation of the human race in a benevolent manner. Assist us that what is joined together by you as author may be preserved with your aid.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus instituta providentia pio favore comitare ut quos legitima societate nectis longaeva pietate custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, with Your providential care to accompany those whom You have joined by legitimate society, and to protect them with lasting piety.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus salus aeterna credentium exaudi nos pro infirmo famulo tuo (infirmis famulis tuis) N. pro quo (quibus) misericordiae tuae imploramus auxilium ut reddita sibi sanitate gratiarum tibi in Ecclesia tua referat (referant) actionem.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, savior of the faithful, hear us for your weak servant (for your weak servants) N., for whom (whom) we implore your mercy, grant him help so that he, restored to health, may express his gratitude to you in your church.

text: Deus sub cuius nutibus vitae nostrae momenta decurrunt: suscipe preces nostras et hostias pro famulo tuo aegrotante (famulis tuis aegrotantibus) pro quo (quibus) misericordiam tuam imploramus ut de cuius (quorum) periculo metuimusde eius (eorum) salute laetemur.
translation_en: God under whose shield our moments of life run: receive our prayers and offerings for your servant who is sick (for your servants who are sick), for whom (whom) we implore your mercy, that from the danger we fear we may rejoice in his (their) salvation.

text: Deus infirmitatis humanae singulare praesidium: auxilii tui super infirmum famulum tuum (infirmos famulos tuos) N. ostende virtutem ut ope misericordiae tuae adiutus (adiuti) Ecclesiae tuae incolumis (incolumes) sanctae repraesentari mereatur (mereantur).
translation_en: God, unique refuge of human weakness: show your power to aid (aid) your weak servant (your weak servants) N. so that with the help of your mercy, they may be worthy to be represented as safe (safe) in your holy Church.

text: Inclina Domine pias aures tuas ad desideria supplicantium et quod devoto corde poscimus benignus admitte ut huic famulo tuo (his famulis tuis) N. qui tibi cottidiani vel biduani vel tertiani vel quartani vexatione fatigatur (fatigantur) Sigismundi martyris tui precibus clementer occurras ut dum nobis illius patefacis merita praesenti aegroto (praesentibus aegrotis) conferas medicinam.
translation_en: Bend towards, Lord, your merciful ears to the desires of those who supplicate you, and graciously admit what we ask with a devoted heart for this, your servant (these your servants) N., who is (they are) daily or twice-daily or thrice-weekly or weekly troubled by the burden of your service (are troubled). May you, martyr Sigismund's prayers, mercifully approach, so that while opening his merits to us in this sick (these sick ones), you confer healing.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine vota sub nomine martyris tui Sigismundi pro praesenti aegroto (praesentibus aegrotis) ut ab eo (eis) ardorem febrium repellas quo in omnibus tuum mereatur (mereantur) sentire auxilium.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, our vows under the name of your martyr Sigismund, for the present sick (those present who are sick), that you may drive away the fever's heat from him (them) so that in all things they may feel your help deserve (deserve to feel).

text: Gratias tibi agimus omnipotens Deus qui per votiva dona Sigismundi martyris tui nos pane vivo et vino vero laetitiae spiritalis recreare dignatus es praesta ut qui cumque in commemoratione eius corpore et sanguine Domini nostri Iesu Christi participatur ad sanitatem pristinam revocetur.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, almighty God, who deigned to refresh us with the votive gifts of your martyr Sigismund, granting us life through bread and true spiritual joy through wine. We humbly ask that whoever partakes in his remembrance, corporally and spiritually, in the communion of our Lord Jesus Christ, may be restored to original health.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus conservator animarum qui quos diligis corripis et quos recipis pia emendatione coërces: te invocamus ut famulo tuo N. qui in corpore patitur membrorum debilitationem gratiam tuam conferre digneris in hora exitus sui de corpore ut absque peccati macula tibi datori proprio per manus sanctorum angelorum repraesentari mereatur eius anima.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, conservator of souls, who corrects those whom you love with pious correction and receives them with gentle amendment: we invoke you to bestow your grace upon your servant N., who is suffering weakness in his body, in the hour of his departure from the body, that he may be worthy to appear before you without the stain of sin, through the hands of holy angels, and that his soul may be meritorious for your own divine mercy.

text: Adesto Domine pro tua pietate supplicationibus nostris et suscipe hostiam quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo N. iacente in grabato animae suae salutem petenti et praesta ei indulgentiam omnium iniquitatum suarum propter immensam misericordiam tuam ut per hoc quod sustinet flagellum a sanctis angelis tuis susceptus ad te pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: Lord, be present to us through your mercy for our supplications and receive the offering we present to you on behalf of your servant N., lying in a deathbed and asking for the salvation of his soul. And grant him indulgence for all his sins due to your immense mercy, so that he may deserve to reach you, having been accepted by your holy angels who inflict punishment upon him.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus Pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi te supplices deprecamur ut imperes diabolo qui hunc famulum tuum (hanc famulam tuam) N. detinet ut ab eo (ea) recedat et libera eum quia credidit in verum liberatorem Dominum nostrum Iesum et purgatus (purgata) ab omni labe iniquitatis maiestati tuae pura mente deserviat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, we humbly beseech you to command the devil who holds this your servant (this your maidservant N.) to depart from him (her) and set him free, for he has believed in the true Savior, our Lord Jesus. Purified (purged) from all stain of wickedness, may he serve your majesty with a pure mind.

text: Repleti muneribus sacris supplices te Domine deprecamur ut per invocationem sancti nominis tui ab hoc famulo tuo (famula tua) N. vexato inimicus confusus abscedat et in omnibus insidiis eius facias caelestem pietatem succurre.
translation_en: Filled with sacred offices, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that through the invocation of your holy name, this servant (servantess) N. may be troubled by an enemy who is confused and depart, and in all his traps, may heavenly piety come to our aid.

text: Praetende Domine famulis et famulabus tuis omnibus fidelibus Christianis dexteram caelestis auxilii ut te toto corde perquirant et quae digne postulant consequantur.
translation_en: Lord, stretch forth Your hand to Your servants and handmaids, all faithful Christians, that they may seek You with their whole heart and obtain what is fittingly requested.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicantibus nostris et has oblationes famulorum famularumque tuarum quas tibi pro incolumitate eorum offerimus benignus assume et ut nullius sit irritum votum nullius vacua postulatio praesta quaesumus ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplicants and these offerings of your servants and their servants which we offer you on behalf of their well-being. Gracious one, kindly receive them. May no vow be void, may no petition be fruitless. We humbly ask that what we faithfully seek, we may effectively obtain.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. pro qua (quibus) tibi hostias placationis immolamus maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecantes ut per haec piae placationis officia pervenire mereatur (mereantur) ad requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you have mercy on the soul of your servant (souls of your servants) N. for whom (whom) we offer sacrifices of propitiation to your majesty. We implore you, that through these acts of pious propitiation they may deserve (may deserve) to attain eternal rest.

text: VD ... Qui nobis in Christo unigenito Filio tuo Domino nostro spem beatae resurrectionis concessisti: praesta quaesumus ut anima (animae) pro qua (quibus) hoc sacrificium redemptionis nostrae tuae offerimus maiestati ad beatae resurrectionis requiem te miserante cum sanctis tuis pervenire mereatur (mereantur). Per eundem Christum Dominum.
translation_en: We ask that you, who have granted us in your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, the hope of blessed resurrection: grant, we beseech you, that the soul (souls) for whom we offer this sacrifice of our redemption may attain to the peace of the blessed resurrection through your mercy with your saints. Through the same Christ our Lord.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut anima famuli tui (animae famulorum tuorum) N. his sacrificiis expiata (expiatae) indulgentiam pariter et requiem capiat (capiant) sempiternam.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the soul of your servant (souls of your servants) N. may be purified by these sacrifices and receive both forgiveness and eternal rest.

text: Quaesumus Domine ut animae famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. cuius (quorum) commemorationem agimus sanctorum atque electorum tuorum largiaris consortium et rorem misericordiae tuae perennem infundas.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to grant the soul of Your servant N., whose (whose) remembrance we bring before the saints and chosen ones of Yours, that You may bestow upon them a share and a stream of Your mercy everlasting.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et hanc oblationem quam tibi offerimus ob diem positionis primum pro anima famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. placatus ac benignus assume et ad vitam aeternam ei (eis) provenire concede.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to our supplications and to this offering we present to you on the first day of positioning, for the soul (souls) of your servant N. gracious and merciful, accept him (them), and grant eternal life.

text: VD ... per Christum Dominum nostrum. Per quem salus mundi per quem vita hominum per quem resurrectio mortuorum per ipsum te Domine suppliciter deprecamur ut animae famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. cuius commemorationem agimus indulgentiam largiri digneris perpetuam atque contagiis mortalitatis exutam (exutas) in aeternae salvationis partem restituas.
translation_en: We beg you, Lord, through Christ our Lord. Through whom the salvation of the world, the life of humans, the resurrection of the dead. For your servant N., whose commemoration we make, we humbly ask that you grant a perpetual indulgence and restore (restored) from mortal contagions into the part of eternal salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus collocare digneris animam famuli tui (animas famulorum tuorum) N. cuius (quorum) commemorationem agimus in sinibus Abrahae Isaac et Iacob ut cum magni iudicii dies advenerit inter sanctos et electos tuos eum (eos) resuscitari praecipias.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, consider it worthy to place the soul of your servant N., whose commemoration we make in the loins of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, so that when the day of great judgment arrives among your saints and elect ones, you may command his (their) resurrection.

text: Deus qui in te credentibus vitam post mortem promittis et in tribulatione positis ad te clamantibus misericorditer subvenis: exaudi preces nostras quas tuae pietati pro anima famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. cuius anniversarium diem celebramus ut ei (eis) quietis beatitudinem et luminis claritatem largiri digneris.
translation_en: God who promises life after death to those who believe in you and who, in tribulation, call out to you for mercy: hear our prayers which we ask on behalf of the soul (souls) of your servant N., whose anniversary we celebrate, that you may grant him (them) the peacefulness of blessedness and the clarity of light.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris pro anima famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. cuius (quorum) hodie annua dies agitur pro qua (quibus) tibi offerimus hoc sacrificium laudis ut eam (eas) sanctorum tuorum consortio sociare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications for the soul of your servant N., whose annual day is observed today, whom we offer this sacrifice of praise to you, that you may deem fit to associate with the fellowship of your saints.

text: Deus qui famulum tuum N. pontificem et sanctificasti vocatione et assumpsisti consummatione felici: suscipe propitius preces nostras et praesta ut sicut ille tecum est meritis ita a nobis non recedat exemplis.
translation_en: God, who sanctified your servant N. the pontiff by calling and took him up in happy completion: graciously receive our prayers and grant that, just as he was with you through merits, he may not depart from us through examples.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut anima famuli tui N. pontificis per haec sancta mysteria in conspectu tuo semper consistat quae tibi fideliter ministravit.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the soul of your servant N., the bishop, may always stand before you through these holy mysteries, who has faithfully ministered to you.

text: Prosit Domine quaesumus animae famuli tui N. episcopi misericordiae tuae implorata clementia ut eius in quo credidit et speravit aeternum te miserante consortium percipiat.
translation_en: May it please you, Lord, we humbly ask that the soul of your servant N., bishop, may find favor with your mercy implored clemency, so that he who believed and hoped in you may experience eternal companionship through your merciful granting.

text: Deus qui inter apostolicos sacerdotes famulum tuum (famulos tuos) N. pontificali fecisti dignitate vigere: praesta quaesumus ut eorum quoque perpetuo aggregentur consortio.
translation_en: God who made your servant (servants) N. to be adorned with the dignity of the papacy among the apostolic priests: grant us, we ask, that they may also join their companionship forever.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus hostias pro anima famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. pontificis (pontificum) et cui (quibus) pontificale dedisti ministerium dones et praemium.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech You, the offerings for the soul of Your servant (souls of Your servants), N. bishop (bishops) and to whom (whomsoever) You have given the ministry of the pontificate, grant them and reward them.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et animam famuli tui (animas famulorum tuorum) N. pontificum (pontificis) in vivorum regioneaeternis gaudiis iubeas sociari.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and the soul of your servant (the souls of your servants) N., bishop (bishop's), and may you grant them to share in the eternal joys of the living in the region of the dead.

text: Deus cuius misericordiae non est numerus: suscipe pro anima famuli tui N. preces nostras et lucis ei laetitiae in regione sanctorum tuorum societatem concede.
translation_en: God, whose mercy has no number: receive for the soul of your servant N. our prayers and grant him the joy of light in the company of your saints.

text: Annue nobis Domine ut animae famuli tui N. haec est prosit oblatio quam immolando totius mundi tribuisti relaxari delicta.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the soul of your servant N. may find rest as an offering which you have granted to be freed from sins in the immolation of the whole world.

text: His sacrificiis quaesumus omnipotens Deus purgata anima famuli tui N. ad indulgentiam et refrigerium sempiternum pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: Through these sacrifices, we humbly ask the Almighty God that the soul of your servant N. may be purified and deserve to attain eternal forgiveness and refreshment.

text: Adiuva nos Domine Deus noster et beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae precibus exoratus animam famuli tui N. abbatis in beatitudine sempiternae lucis constitue.
translation_en: Help us, Lord our God, and through the prayers of the Blessed Mother of God, Mary, establish the soul of your servant N., in the bliss of eternal light.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine hostias placationis et laudis quas in honorem beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae nomini tuo consecrandas deferimus et pro requie famuli tui abbatis tibi suppliciter immolamus ut per eius intercessionem ad aeternam gloriam pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: Receive we beg, Lord, the offerings of appeasement and praise which we are bringing in honor of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, and consecrating to your name. We humbly offer them up for the repose of your servant abbot. May he through her intercession merit to attain eternal glory.

text: Ascendant ad te Domine preces nostrae et animam famuli tui N. abbatis gaudia aeterna suscipiant et quem fecisti adoptionis participem intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria iubeas hereditatis tuae consortem.
translation_en: Our prayers ascend to you, Lord, and the soul of your servant N., the abbot, may eternal joys receive him. Granting that he became a participant in adoption, through the intercession of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, we beseech you to command him as a sharer of your inheritance.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut anima famuli tui (animae famulorum tuorum) N. sacerdotis atque abbatis (sacerdotum atque abbatum) quem (quos) in hoc saeculo commorantem (commorantes) sacris muneribus decorasti caelesti sede gloriosa semper exsultet (exsultent).
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, that the soul of Your servant N., priest and abbot (priests and abbots), whom You have adorned with sacred duties in this world, may forever rejoice in the glorious seat of heaven.

text: Suscipe Domine Iesu Christe hostias pro anima famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. sacerdotis atque abbatis (sacerdotum atque abbatum) ut quia causa hominum descendisti de caelis te tribuente mereatur (mereantur) annumerari sanctorum consortiis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord Jesus Christ, the offerings for the soul of your servant (souls of your servants) N., priest and abbot (priests and abbots), so that since you descended from heaven, may you grant them (them) to deserve (deserve) to be numbered among the consorts of saints.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut animam famuli tui (animas famulorum tuorum) N. sacerdotis atque abbatis (sacerdotum atque abbatum) pro qua (quibus) mysteriorum tuorum sacramenta percepimus in congregatione iustorum aeternae beatitudinis iubeas esse consortem (consortes).
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that the soul of your servant N. (souls of your servants) - the priest and abbot (priests and abbots) - whom we have received the sacrament of your mysteries in the congregation of the righteous for eternal beatitude, may you command to be a companion (companions).

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui N. et praesta ut qui de suis donis nobis pervigili cura in nomine tuo cottidiana praeparavit (praeparaverunt) obsequia perpetua mereatur cum sanctis suis perfrui laetitia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to have mercy on the soul of your servant N. and grant that he who daily prepared (prepared) for us watchful care in your name from his own gifts may deserve eternal obedience along with the saints, enjoying their joy.

text: Hanc oblationem quaesumus Domine caelesti benedictione persequere et concede ut ei ad salutem perveniat cuius in hoc loco stipendiis nostra tibi servitus vegetata ministrat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to follow this offering with your heavenly blessing and grant that it may reach the one for whom, on this place, our service grows through the stipends we offer, for their salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cui numquam sine spe misericordiae supplicatur: propitiare animae famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. ut qui de hac vita in tui nominis confessione discessit (discesserunt) sanctorum tuorum numero satias aggregari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, to whom supplication is never made without hope of mercy: propitiate the soul of your servant (souls of your servants) N., so that he who departed from this life in confession of your name (they who departed ...) may be numbered among the saints.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui (animabus famulorum tuorum) N. pro qua (quibus) tibi hostias placationis offerimus ut quia in hac luce in fide mansit (manserunt) catholica in futura vita ei (eis) retributio condonetur.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, to propitiate the soul of your servant N., for whose souls we offer you sacrifices of appeasement, so that because they have remained in this life in the Catholic faith, their reward in future life may be forgiven.

text: Absolve Domine per has oblationes quas tibi supplices offerimus animam famuli tui (animas famulorum tuorum) N. ab omni vinculo delictorum ut in resurrectionis gloria inter sanctos tuos resuscitari mereatur (mereantur).
translation_en: Forgive, Lord, through these offerings which we humbly present to You, the soul of Your servant (souls of Your servants) N., from every bond of sins that he may be worthy (they may be worthy) to be resurrected in the glory of the resurrection among Your saints.

text: Annue nobis Domine ut anima famuli tui (animae famulorum tuorum) N. remissionem quam desiderat (desiderant) mereatur (mereantur) percipere peccatorum.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the soul of your servant (the souls of your servants) N. may deserve (may deserve) to receive the forgiveness which it (they) desires through penance for sins.

text: 〈Deus veniae largitor et humanae salutis amator quaesumus clementiam tuam ut nostrae congregationis fratres et sorores qui ex hoc saeculo transierunt beata Maria semper Virgine intercedente ad perpetuae beatitudinis〉 consortium pervenire concedas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, O giver of grace and lover of the human salvation, to grant your clemency that our congregation's brothers and sisters who have passed from this world, with the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary always a virgin, may attain participation in the consortium of eternal beatitude.

text: Deus cuius misericordiae non est numerus: suscipe propitius preces humilitatis nostrae et animabus fratrum nostrae congregationis quibus tui nominis dedisti confessionem per haec sacramenta salutis nostrae cunctorum remissionem tribue peccatorum.
translation_en: God, whose mercy has no number: receive graciously the prayers of our humility and the souls of our brethren's congregation whom you have given confession through these sacraments of our salvation. To all, grant remission of sins.

text: Praesta quaesumus misericors Deus ut animae pro quibus hoc sacrificium laudis tuae obtulimus maiestati per huius virtutem sacramenti a peccatis omnibus expiatae lucis perpetuae te miserante recipiant beatitudinem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, merciful God, that the souls for whom we have offered this sacrifice of your praise to Your majesty through the power of this sacrament be absolved from all sins, and, you showing mercy, may receive eternal happiness.

text: Deus cuius miseratione animae fidelium requiescunt: animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium in Christo quiescentium da propitius veniam peccatorum ut a cunctis reatibus absoluti tecum sine fine laetentur.
translation_en: God, whose mercy the souls of the faithful find rest: to the souls of your servants and handmaids, all in Christ resting, grant a propitious pardon for their sins, that they, absolved from all offenses, may rejoice with you without end.

text: Pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium in Christo dormientium hostiam Domine Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus suscipe benignus oblatam ut hoc sacrificio singulari vinculis horrendae mortis exutae vitam mereantur aeternam.
translation_en: For the souls of your servants, both men and women, all who sleep in Christ, Lord Almighty eternal God, graciously receive this offering. May they merit eternal life through this unique sacrifice, being freed from the dread bonds of death.

text: Deus fidelium lumen animarum adesto supplicationibus nostris et da famulis et famulabus tuis omnibus in Christo dormientibus refrigerii sedemquietis beatitudinem et luminis claritatem.
translation_en: God, light of faithful souls, be present to our supplications and grant to all your servants and servants sleeping in Christ a peaceful resting place and the beatitude of light's brightness.

text: Fidelium Deus omnium conditor et redemptor animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum remissionem cunctorum tribue peccatorum ut indulgentiam quam desiderant piis supplicationibus consequantur.
translation_en: God, creator and redeemer of all souls, grant to the faithful your servants and handmaids remission of all their sins, that they may obtain the indulgence which they desire through their pious prayers.

text: Hostias tibi Domine humili supplicatione pro animabus famulorum famulorumque omnium deferimus ut per haec salutis nostrae sacrificia perpetuam tuae beatitudinis misericordiam consequantur.
translation_en: We humbly offer to You, Lord, supplications on behalf of the souls of all Your servants. May we attain eternal mercy through these offerings for our salvation.

text: Divina libantes sacramenta concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut haec eadem nobis proficiant ad salutem et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium pro quibus tuam deprecamur clementiam prosint ad indulgentiam.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, your divine sacraments, we humbly ask, that these same things may bring salvation to us. And for the souls of all your servants and handmaids, for whom we humbly pray your mercy, may it be effective for their indulgence.

text: Animabus quaesumus Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium misericordiam concede perpetuam ut eis proficiat in aeternum quod in te crediderunt et speraverunt.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for the souls of your servants and handmaids, all of them. Grant them everlasting mercy so that what they believed and hoped in you may profit them eternally.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et hanc domum serenis oculis tuae pietatis illustra descendatque super habitantes in ea gratiae tuae larga benedictio ut in his manu factis habitaculis cum salubri manentes ipsi tuum semper sint habitaculum.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and illuminate this house with the bright gaze of your compassion. May your abundant blessing descend upon those dwelling within, so that they may remain forever in you as a dwelling place, and stay healthy within these houses.

text: Benedic Domine Deus locum istum ut sit in eo sanctitas sanitas et castitas virtus et victoria et sanctimonia bonitas et plenitudo legis et oboedientia Deo Patri et Filio eius et Spiritui Sancto et sit semper benedictio super habitantes in eo.
translation_en: Bless, Lord God, this place, that holiness, health, and chastity may be in it, virtue and victory, sanctity, goodness, and fullness of the law, and obedience to God the Father and his Son, and the Holy Spirit. May there always be a blessing upon those who dwell in it.

text: Deus invisibilis Deus inaestimabilis qui per cuncta diffusus es: pietatem tuam et misericordiam per sanctum et tremendum Filii tui nomen supplices deprecamur ut hanc creaturam salis benedictione et potentia invisibilis operationis infundas ut iumenta quae necessitatibus humanis tribuere dignatus es cum ex eadem acceperint haec benedictio illaesa reddat et ab omni temptationis incursu te protegente custodiat.
translation_en: God, the invisible, the inestimable one who is diffused through all things: we humbly beseech your pity and mercy through the holy and terrible name of your Son. We implore that you pour out your blessing and the power of your invisible operation upon this creature of salt, so that the beasts which you have deemed worthy to serve human needs, receiving this blessing unharmed, may return it undiminished, and with you protecting them from every onslaught of temptation, they may be kept safe.

text: Deus qui humanae fragilitati necessaria adminicula iumentorum misericors providisti: quaesumus ut eadem <ut> miseris consulendo non subtrahas ut quorum nostris meritis saevit interitus tua nobis parcendo clementia cessare iubeas vastitatem. 0
translation_en: God, who in your merciful providence provided necessary support for the frailty of humans through animals: we ask that you do not withdraw your help from those in need, so that the severity of our deaths ceases by your mercy, and that you command your clemency to halt destruction.

text: Deus universae carnis creator qui agnum in Ægypto Moysi et populo tuo in vigilia Paschae comedere praecepisti in figura Domini nostri Iesu Christi cuius sanguine omnia primogenita tibi de mundo redemisti et in nocte illa omne primogenitum in Ægypto percutere praecepisti servans populum tuum agni sanguine praenotatum: dignare quaesumus benedicere et sanctificare has ovium mundarum carnes ut quicumque ex populis fidelibus tuis ex eis comederint omni benedictione caelesti et gratia saturati repleantur in bonis. Per eundem.
translation_en: God, creator of all flesh, who commanded Moses and your people to eat the lamb in Egypt on the watch of Passover as a figure of our Lord Jesus Christ, whose blood you redeemed all firstborn from the world; and on that night you commanded that every firstborn in Egypt be struck, saving your people by the marked lamb's blood: we humbly ask that you bless and sanctify these clean sheep's flesh. So that whoever from your faithful people eats them will be filled with every celestial blessing and grace, saturated in good things. Through the same.

text: Benedic Domine creaturam istam lardi ut sit remedium salutare generi humano et praesta ut per invocationem sancti nominis tui ut quicumque inde sumpserint corporis sanitatem et animae tutelam percipiant. Per Dominum.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this creation of bread, that it may be a salutary remedy for the human race. And grant that through the invocation of Your holy name, whoever partakes of it in body may receive health, and through soul, safety. Through the Lord.

text: Benedictionis tuae gratia quaesumus Domine subveniat huic ovorum creaturaeut cibus salutaris fiat tuis fidelibus in gratiarum actione sumentibus.
translation_en: We humbly ask your blessing, Lord. May it come upon this egg-created creature and become a wholesome food for your faithful who receive it with thanksgiving.

text: Creator et conservator Deus humani generis dator gratiae spiritalis largitor aeternae salutis: tu permitte Spiritum tuum Sanctum super hanc creaturam lactis ut armati caelestis defensionis virtute qui ex ea gustaverint proficiat illis ad aeternam salutem.
translation_en: Creator and Preserver, God of the human race, Giver of spiritual grace, Bestower of eternal salvation: allow Your Holy Spirit to be upon this milk-created being, that those who taste it may progress towards eternal salvation, armed with the virtue of celestial defense.

text: Benedic Domine et creaturas fontis scilicet lactis et mellis et pota famulos tuos de hoc fonte perenni quod est spiritus veritatis et enutries lacte et melle; tu enim Domine promisisti patribus nostris Abrahae Isaac et Iacob dicens: Introducam vos in terram repromissionis terram fluentem lac et mel; coniunge Domine 〈famulos tuos〉 Spiritui Sancto sicut coniunctum est hoc lac et mel in Christo Iesu Domino nostro. 〈R.〉 Amen.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, and the creatures of the fountain - indeed, milk and honey - and nourish your servants from this everlasting spring which is the Spirit of Truth; you, Lord, have promised our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying: 'I will bring you into the land of promise, a land flowing with milk and honey.' Lord, unite your servants with the Holy Spirit as milk and honey are united in Christ Jesus, our Lord. Amen.

text: Benedictio Dei Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti descendat super has creaturas.
translation_en: The blessing of God the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit descend upon these creatures.

text: Oramus pietatem tuam omnipotens Deus ut has primitias creaturae tuae quas aëris et pluviae temperamento nutrire dignatus es benedictionis tuae imbre perfundas et fructus terrae usque ad maturitatem perducas; tribuas quoque populo tuo de tuis muneribus tibi semper gratias agere ut a ferti1litate terrae esurientium animas bonis affluentibus repleas et egenus et pauper laudent nomen gloriae tuae.
translation_en: We ask for Your pity, Almighty God, that the first fruits of Your creation which You have nourished with the temperament of air and rain, You pour out Your blessings upon them through Your dew, and lead them to maturity; also grant that Your people may always give thanks for Your gifts, so that the souls of those who are hungry from fertile lands may be filled with abundance, and the poor and needy may praise Your name.

text: Benedic Domine creaturam istam panis sicut benedixisti quinque panes in deserto ut omnes gustantesque ex eo accipiant tam corporis quam animae sanitatem.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this creature of bread as you blessed the five loaves in the wilderness, so that those tasting from it may receive both physical and spiritual health.

text: Benedic Domine hos fructus novos fabae quos tu per rorem caeli et inundantiam pluviarum et tempora serena atque tranquilla ad maturitatem perducere dignatus es ad percipiendum nobis cum gratiarum actione. In nomine Domini nostri Iesu Christi. Qui tecum.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, these new beans of the bean which you have brought to maturity through the dew of heaven and the floods of rain and peaceful and quiet times. You deemed it worthy for us to receive them with an act of gratitude. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Who is with you.

text: Benedic Domine hos fructus novos uvae quos tu per rorem caeli ut supra.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, these new fruits of the grape vine that you have produced through the dew of heaven above.

text: Domine Iesu Christe qui in Cana Galilaeae ex aqua vinum fecisti qui vitis es vera: benedicere et sanctificare digneris hanc creaturam vini quam ad substantiam servorum tuorum tribuisti ut ubicumque ex hoc fusum fuerit vel a quolibet potatum divinae opulentiae benedictione repleantur. Qui vivis.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, who turned water into wine at Cana of Galilee, who are truly the vine: deign to bless and sanctify this creation of wine which you have given for the substance of your servants. That wherever it is poured out or by whomsoever it is drunk, they may be filled with divine bounty through your blessing. Who lives.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui caelum et terram mare et omnia creasti: te supplices deprecamur ut hunc novum fructum benedicere et sanctificare digneris et multiplicare offerentibus tibi ut repleas eorum cellaria fortitudine 1 frumenti et vini et olei ut laetantes in eis referant tibi Domino omnipotenti laudes et gratias.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God who created heaven and earth, sea and all things: we humbly entreat you to bless and sanctify this new fruit and to multiply it for those offering it to you. Fill their cellars with strength of wheat and wine and oil, so that they rejoicing in them may return to you, Lord almighty, praises and thanks.

text: Deprecamur Domine clementiam pietatis ut aquam putei huius caelesti benedictione sanctifices et ad communem vitam concedas salubrem et ita ex eo fugare digneris omnem diabolicae temptationis incursum ut quicumque ex eo ab hinc hauserit biberitve vel in quibuslibet necessariis usibus hausta aqua usus fuerit totius virtutis ac sanitatis dulcedine perfruatur ut tibi semper sanctificatori et salvatori omnium Domino gratias agere mereamur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, the clemency of Your pity, that You bless the water of this celestial well and grant it a healthy use for common life. And in such a way, may You deem worthy to drive away every onset of diabolical temptation, so that whoever has drawn or drunk from it here, or who has used the water for any necessary purposes, may partake of its sweetness of virtue and health. May they always be worthy to offer thanks to You, the sanctifier and savior of all, Lord.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui per invisibilitatis tuae potentiam has aquas ex nihilo conditas in huius materiae forma visibiles praebuisti atque ex abditis investigabilibus per clausam abyssi magnitudinem largitatis tuae gratia humanis usibus fluentibus influxisti: te tui servi supplices exoramus ut has aquas quas neglegentia polluit Sancti Spiritus tui gratia ad munditiam revocet atque purificet et spiritus callidi hostis abscedat ac deinceps sanctificatas familiae tuae potabiles tribuas ut potantium mundet corpora cordaque sanctificent.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God, who by the power of Your invisibility have created these waters out of nothing in this visible form within matter, and have brought forth from hidden and inexplicable depths through the closed vastness of the abyss the generosity of Your grace flowing for human use: we, Your servants, humbly beseech You. We ask that the waters, which negligence has polluted by Your Spirit's grace, be called back to purity and cleansed. May the cold spirit of the enemy depart and may these sanctified families thereafter receive drinkable water, so that through drinking their bodies are cleansed and their hearts sanctified.

text: Postquam impleti sunt dies purgationis Mariae matris Domini nostri Iesu Christi secundum legem Moysi tulerunt illum in Ierusalem ut sisterent cum Domino sicut scriptum est in lege Domini quia omne masculinum adaperiens vulvam sanctum Domino vocabitur Et ut darent hostiam secundum quod dictum est in lege Domini par turturum aut duos pullos columbarum. Et ecce homo erat in Ierusalem cui nomen Simeon et homo iste iustus et timoratus exspectans consolationem Israël et Spiritus Sanctus erat in eo. Et responsum acceperat a Spiritu Sancto non visurum se mortem nisi prius videret Christum Domini. Et venit in Spiritu in templum. Et cum inducerent puerum Iesum parentes eius ut facerent secundum consuetudinem legis pro eo et ipse accepit eum in ulnas suas et benedixit Deum et dixit Nunc dimittis servum tuum Domine secundum verbum tuum in pace. Quia viderunt oculi mei salutare tuum quod parasti ante faciem omnium populorum lumen ad revelationem gentium et gloriam plebis tuae Israël.
translation_en: After the days of Mary, Mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, according to the law of Moses, they carried him (Mary) to Jerusalem to present him with the Lord, as it is written in the law of the Lord, "Every male who is circumcised shall be called holy unto the Lord." And they were to offer a sacrifice according to what was said in the law of the Lord: either a lamb or two turtledoves. And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon, and he was a just and devout man waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him. And he had received a response from the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he saw Christ the Lord. And he came into the temple in the Spirit. And when his parents brought the child Jesus to perform according to the custom of the law for him, and he himself took him in his arms and blessed God and said, "Now let your servant depart, Lord, according to your word, in peace. For my eyes have seen your salvation which you have prepared before the face of all peoples, a light for revelation to the Gentiles and glory for your people Israel."

text: Indulge nobis Domine per orationem sancti Godehardi confessoris tui atque pontificis ut per eius merita misericordiam invenire mereamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, through the prayer of your confessor and bishop St. Godehard, that we may find mercy through his merits.

text: Sacris altaribus Domine hostias superpositas quaesumus ut sanctus pontifex Godehardus atque confessor in salutem nobis provenire deposcat.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech You for the sacred altars that the offerings placed upon them may cause Saint Pope Godehard and Confessor to come forth for our salvation.

text: Beati confessoris tui Godehardi Domine suffragiis exoratus percepta sacramenti tui nos virtute defende.
translation_en: Blessed be thy confessed one, Godehard, Lord. We humbly entreat your intercession and, with the power of your sacrament, defend us.

text: Da nobis indignis famulis tuis Domine quaesumus 〈Deus〉 omnipotens in festivitate sancti Sigismundi regis et martyris tui dignis eius orationibus delictorum nostrorum indulgentiam adipisci et electorum tuorum mereamur numero associari.
translation_en: Grant us, Thy unworthy servants, Lord, we beseech Thee (God), Almighty, in the festivity of Thy saint and martyr King Sigismund, that worthy of his prayers we may obtain forgiveness for our sins and be worthy to be numbered among Thine elect.

text: Munera Domine quaesumus tibi oblata intercedente sancto Sigismundo rege et martyre tuo a te sint sanctificata et ad obtinenda nostra remedia sint tibi acceptabilia.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offerings presented before You, through the intercession of Saint Sigismund, Your king and martyr, be sanctified by You. May they be acceptable to You in obtaining our remedies.

text: Repleti libaminibus sacris Domine Deus noster interveniente sancto Sigismundo rege et martyre tuo a te remissionem obtineamus praeteritorum commissorum et custodiam futurorum.
translation_en: Filled with sacred vessels, Lord God, by the intervention of Saint King Sigismund and Your martyr, we obtain from You the forgiveness for our past offenses and protection for the future ones.

text: VD ... A quo deviare mori
translation_en: From where may one depart to die

text: VD ... A tua enim numquam est laude
translation_en: From you, indeed, there is never enough praise.

text: VD ... Ad cuius imaginem hominis formare
translation_en: To whose image to fashion a human figure

text: VD ... Ad cuius immensam pertinet
translation_en: For whose immeasurable majesty

text: VD ... Ad gloriam tuam Domine profusis
translation_en: We pour out [our prayers] for Your glory, Lord.

text: VD ... Adest enim dies magnifici
translation_en: Indeed, the day magnificent is present.

text: VD ... Adest enim nobis optatissimum
translation_en: Indeed, the most desired one is present among us.

text: VD ... Adest enim nobis sancti sacerdotis
translation_en: Behold! The holy priest is among us.

text: VD ... Agnoscimus enim Domine Deus noster
translation_en: We acknowledge, Lord, that you are our God

text: VD ... Apud quem cum beatorum apostolorum continuata ... prosit ad gratiam.
translation_en: With him, may it continue with the blessed apostles, that it reaches grace.

text: VD ... Apud quem cum beatorum apostolorum continuata ... gratiam largiatur.
translation_en: With Him, where the grace of the blessed apostles is continually poured out...

text: VD ... Apud quem cum beatorum apostolorum continuata ... sanctissima intercessione.
translation_en: At the place where, with the continuous company of the blessed apostles, we have the most holy intercession.

text: VD ... Apud quem semper est praeclara
translation_en: It is with him who always has glory

text: VD ... Audivimus etenim prophetam
translation_en: We have indeed heard the prophet

text: VD ... Beatae Agnetis natalicia
translation_en: The feast days of the Blessed Agnes

text: VD ... Beatae Caeciliae natalicium
translation_en: Today is the birthday of the Blessed Caecilia.

text: VD ... Beate illius natalicium diem
translation_en: On that day, the birthday of the blessed one.

text: VD ... Beati apostoli tui et evangelistae ... Deus erat Verbum.
translation_en: BD ... Blessed are the apostles of yours and the evangelists ... God was the Word.

text: VD ... Beati apostoli tui et evangelistae ... libera sectaretur.
translation_en: Their blessed apostle and evangelist... may follow.

text: VD ... Beati apostoli tui Ioannis
translation_en: BD... Blessed are your apostles John

text: VD ... Beati Cypriani natalitia
translation_en: Today... The birthday of Saint Cyprian

text: VD ... Beati etenim martyres tui
translation_en: Indeed, blessed are your martyrs.

text: VD ... Beati Ioannis apostoli
translation_en: Blessed John the Apostle

text: VD ... Beati Laurenti annua vota
translation_en: The VD refers to the Initial or Introductory Verse, so in English, the given Latin text "VD Beati Laurenti annua vota" translates to "Initial verse for Blessed Laurence, annual vows."

text: VD ... Beati Laurenti natalicia repetentes
translation_en: On this day, we celebrate the feast of Saint Lawrence.

text: VD ... Beati nobis enim Clementis

translation_en: These commands serve us (who are) obeying

translation_en: This is the summit of our faith

translation_en: Therefore, I present [this] also to you

translation_en: Reading fourth: On those days

translation_en: Third Reading about Abraham

translation_en: When the reader is ordained

text: A cunctis iniquitatibus nostris exue nos Domine et in tua fac pace gaudere.
translation_en: Deliver us, Lord, from all our iniquities and let us rejoice in your peace.

text: A cunctis nos quaesumus Domine reatibus et periculis propitiatus absolve quos tanti mysterii tribuis esse consortes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be merciful and release us from sins and dangers. You who grant us to be companions of such a great mystery, absolve us from all hindrances.

text: A cunctis nos quaesumus benignissime Deus perturbationibus et iniquitatibus libera mentesque nostras in tuae caritatis et pacis tranquillitate consolida.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, most kind God, set us free from disturbances and wickedness, and strengthen our minds in the tranquility of your love and peace.

text: A cunctis nos quaesumus Domine mentis et corporis defende periculis et intercedente gloriosa virgine Dei Genitrice Maria cum beatis apostolis Petro et Paulo et omnibus sanctis salutem nobis tribue benignus et pacem ut destructis adversitatibus et erroribus universis Ecclesia tua secura tibi serviat libertate.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to defend us from all dangers of mind and body, with the intercession of the glorious Virgin Mary, the Mother of God, along with the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, and all saints. May you grant us safety and blessings, and peace upon us, that your Church may serve you securely with freedom, after destroying all adversities and errors.

text: A domo tua quaesumus domine spiritalis nequiciae pellantur et aeriarum discedat malignitas potestatum.
translation_en: From your house, we humbly ask you, Lord, let spiritual wickedness depart and malice cease from powers.

text: A plebe tua quaesumus domine spiritales nequiciae repellantur et aeriarum discedat malignitas potestatum.
translation_en: From your people we humbly ask, Lord, that spiritual wickedness may be driven away and the malice of powers departs.

text: A te Deus piissime benedicantur ieiunantium vota sacrificiorumque libamina; acceptentur quoque orationes fidelium ac suspiria contritorum ut votiva abstinendi devotio et cunctos in commune fideles sanctificet et defunctis omnibus requiem praestet.
translation_en: May the most compassionate God be blessed by the vows of the fasting and the offerings of the sacrifices; may also the prayers of the faithful and the sighs of the penitent be accepted, so that a devout abstention according to their vow sanctifies all the common faithful, and may it grant peace to all the deceased.

text: Ab occultis nostris munda nos Domine et ab alienis pravitatibus benignus absolve ut tua sancta pura mente sumamus.
translation_en: From our hidden faults, Lord, cleanse us, and as a gracious one, absolve us from foreign wickednesses, that we may take up your holy thoughts with a pure mind.

text: Ab occultis nostris tua nos Domine sancta purificent et ab externis erroribus perpetua virtute defendant.
translation_en: From our hidden sins, Lord, may your holy ones purify us and with perpetual power defend us from external errors.

text: Ab omni errore nos Domine quaesumus expient sacramenta quae sumpsimus et dulcedinem mentibus nostris tuae suavitatis infundant.
translation_en: From every error, Lord, we humbly ask that you protect us with the sacraments we have received and fill our minds with the sweetness of your kindness.

text: Ab omni reatu nos Domine et eos pro quibus tibi has offerimus hostias intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis sancta quae tractamus absolvant et muniant a totius pravitatis incursu quatenus ab omnibus vitiis potenter absoluti a cunctis etiam adversitatibus protegamur.
translation_en: From every guilt, Lord, deliver us and those for whom we offer these sacrifices through the intercession of all your saints. May they absolve and protect us from the onslaught of all wickedness, so that being powerfully freed from all vices, we may be protected from all adversities.

text: Abrenuntias satanae
translation_en: You renounce Satan

text: Ab omnibus me quaeso Domine per haec sancta quae mihi immerito contulisti peccatis absolve ut tua misericordia protegente libera tibi mente servire merear.
translation_en: From all, I humbly ask you, Lord, through these holy things which undeservingly you have granted to me, forgive so that your mercy may protect me and enable me to serve you worthily of mind.

text: Ab omnibus nos defende quaesumus Domine semper adversis et continuis tuere praesidiis.
translation_en: From all, we humbly ask you, Lord, defend us always; may your constant protection shield us.

text: Ab omnibus nos quaesumus Domine peccatis propitiatus absolve et eos qui nos impugnare nituntur expugna.
translation_en: From all, we humbly ask you, Lord, be propitious and forgive us. And those who endeavor to attack us, overcome them.

text: Ab omnibus nos quaesumus Domine peccatis propitiatus absolve ut percepta venia peccatorum liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: From all we humbly ask, Lord, that you be merciful and forgive our sins, so that we may serve you with minds freed by the grace of forgiveness.

text: Abscinde quaesumus omnipotens Deus cordium nostrorum praeputia ut quod in tua carne secundum legis veteris ritum manufacta circumcisione agi certis condicionibus permisisti id nostrae saluti competenter impendens ab omni superstitione voluptatum absterge nostra praecordia.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, that you remove the foreskins of our hearts so that what was done in your flesh according to the ritual of the old law through circumcision under certain conditions, may be fittingly bestowed upon our salvation. Wash away our hardened hearts from every superstition and pleasure.

text: Absolve Domine animam famuli tui illius ab omni vinculo delictorum ut in resurrectionis gloria inter sanctos tuos resuscitatus respiret.
translation_en: Lord, forgive the soul of your servant that one from every bond of sins, so that in the glory of the resurrection, among your saints, he may breathe again.

text: Absolve Domine quaesumus iniquitates nostras et ut tua dona mereamur accipere fac nos amare iustitiam.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you forgive our sins and grant us worthiness to receive your gifts. Make us love justice.

text: Absolve Domine quaesumus tuorum delicta populorum et quod mortalitatis contrahit fragilitate purifica ut cuncta pericula mentis et corporis te propellente declinans tua solatione subsistat tua gratia promissae redemptionis perficiatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to forgive the sins of your people. And what mortality contracts with frailty, purify, so that all perils of mind and body, declining through Your leading, may subsist in Your consolation. May Your grace bring about the fulfillment of the promised redemption.

text: Absterge quaesumus Domine Christiani populi caliginem tui luminis illustratione et praesta ut beati Gabrielis archangeli tui salutatione et omnium angelorum tuorum protectione munitus in tua semper visitatione clarescat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to cleanse the Christians from the darkness of your light through your illumination, and grant that protected by the salutation of blessed Gabriel, the archangel, and by the protection of all your angels, they may always shine in your presence.

text: Accedentes ad te Domine exigui famuli sacerdotes quos ex officio debitum cunctos cogit commendare fideles non incurramus merita ullomodo propria sed te praestante crimina mereamur evadere patrata. Exaudi quaesumus precem Ecclesiae tuae quam tuis nutibus in honorem martyris tui Pelagii delibat ac singulorum occurre precantibus qui hunc martyrem tuum vitiis repugnantem dignum tuis fecisti esse conspectibus. Deferat nostram coram te quaesumus obsequelam qui tibi placuit pro passione. Succurrat miseris prece eruat prostratos assidue qui te infideli confessus est coram principe. Quis nostrum sane ad te facile oculos audebit erigere quos tabes conscientiae premit lapsus inclinat foeda indecenter consuetudo curvat lenta quoque animi remissio erigere non sinit sed quod peius est illicita impudenter agere propellit? Adclines ergo inde rogamus ut in omnibus in commune adsit patronus qualiter te propitium dissidentes pacem et pacifici indefessam caritatis retentent unitatem.
translation_en:
Approaching you, Lord, we, the humble servants and priests bound by duty to commend all faithful, do not presume upon our own merits but, with you granting forgiveness, we earn the right to escape punishments due. Hear us, we implore, the prayer of your Church, which in honor of your martyr Pelagius has been offered and sung by each supplicant who acknowledges this your martyr, who resisted vices, worthy to be seen by you.
On our behalf, we ask that an offering be presented before you, as pleasing to you, for the passion. Help the afflicted, free the prostrate, assist those who, in the face of unfaithfulness, have confessed you before the prince. Who among us dares to lift eyes towards you, eyes pressed down by conscience, inclined by faults, distorted by shameful habits, weakened by remorse and not permitted to rise? What is worse, it is driven by illicit and shameless acts.
Therefore, we humbly beg that you come near to us in all things as a common patron, how you make the discordant peaceful and the peaceful unwavering in love.

text: Accepta Domine maiestati tuae fidelis populi reddatur oblatio obtentu beatae Mariae Magdalenae quae se tibi hostiam vivam sanctam et beneplacentem semper exhibuit.
translation_en: Lord, may your majesty receive the faithful people's offering which has been granted through the intercession of blessed Mary Magdalene. She always presented herself to you as a living, holy and pleasing sacrifice.

text: Accepta Domine quaesumus sacrificium plebis tuae quam Iesu Christi Filii tui Domini nostri iubeas esse consortem qui humanitatis nostrae dignatus est fieri particeps.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you accept the sacrifice of your people, which Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, has deigned to become a participant in our humanity.

text: Accepta esca spiritalis doni et participatione sacramenti tui te Deum Salvatorem nostrum suppliciter exoramus ut intercessione beati sacerdotis et martyris tui Blasii ab omnibus diabolicis liberemur insidiis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, our God and Savior, to accept the spiritual food given and the participation in Your sacrament. We pray that through the intercession of the blessed priest and martyr Blaise, may we be liberated from all diabolic snares.

text: Accepta in conspectu tuo sit Domine muneris praesentis oblatio et beatae Honorinae virginis et martyris tuae commendatione sit populo supplicanti apud te peccatorum suorum propitiatio.
translation_en: In your sight, Lord, may this offering of the present gifts be accepted. May the blessed Honoria, your virgin and martyr, be a propitiation for the penitent people before you concerning their sins.

text: Accepta sint quaesumus omnipotens Deus in conspectu maiestatis tuae nostrae oblationis munera quae in venerationem sancti Raphaelis angeli tibi deferimus cuius suffragio bonis participari mereamur aeternis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the offerings we bring before your majesty for the veneration of Saint Raphael the angel may be accepted. Through his intercession, we hope to share in eternal goods.

text: Accepta sit in conspectu tuo Domine nostra devotio ut eorum nobis fiat supplicatione salutaris pro quorum sollemnitate defertur.
translation_en: May our devotion be acceptable to you, Lord, so that for their sake we may receive a healthful intercession from those whose solemnity is being offered.

text: Accepta sit in conspectu tuo Domine nostra devotio ut eius nobis fiat supplicatione salutaris pro cuius sollemnitate defertur.
translation_en: May our devotion be accepted in your sight, Lord, so that it becomes a healthful intercession for him whose solemnity is being brought forward.

text: Accepta tibi sit in conspectu tuo Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio et eorum nobis fiat supplicatione salutaris pro quorum sollemnitate defertur.
translation_en: May our offering of devotion be acceptable to you, Lord. May it be for us a saving intercession on behalf of those for whom this solemnity is being offered.

text: Accepta sit in conspectu tuo Domine quaesumus nostrae humilitatis oblatio et sancti martyris tui atque pontificis Bonifatii fiat supplicatione salutaris pro cuius sollemnitate tuae maiestati defertur.
translation_en: May your acceptance, Lord, we ask, be upon our humble offering in Your sight. May the prayer of Your saint and bishop, Boniface, become a beneficial intercession for whose solemnity Your majesty is honored.

text: Accepta tibi sint Domine munera haec sanguis et hostia quae tibi offero in honorem nominis tui pro me indigno peccatore quia non sum dignus assistere ante sanctum altare tuum quia peccavi coram te et coram sanctis angelis tuis sed tribue mihi facere voluntatem tuam omnibus diebus vitae meae Domine Deus noster ut tibi est placitum coram te.
translation_en: Accept these, O Lord, the gifts that I offer to you, blood and host, in honor of your name, for me, an unworthy sinner, since I am not worthy to stand before your holy altar, because I have sinned before you and before your holy angels. But grant me, Lord our God, to do your will every day of my life, so that it pleases you in your sight.

text: Accepta tibi sint Domine nostrae oblationis libamina quae tibi commendent sancti Cuthberti confessoris atque pontificis continua merita.
translation_en: May these offerings, Lord, be acceptable to you, which the holy confessor and bishop Cuthbert recommends with unending merits.

text: Accepta tibi sint Domine quaesumus nostri dona ieiunii quae et expiando nos tua gratia dignos efficiant et ad sempiterna promissa perducant.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the gifts of our fasting be acceptable to you. May they, through your grace, render us worthy and lead us to the eternal promises you have promised.

text: Accepta tibi sint quaesumus Domine munera quae in die sollemnitatis beati martyris tui Iuliani deferimus ut ea maiestati tuae sint placita sicut illius effusio sanguinis apud te exstitit pretiosa.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings brought to you on the solemnity of your martyr Julian be acceptable to your majesty, as his outpouring of blood before you was precious.

text: Accipe et commenda et habeto
translation_en: Receive and entrust and hold

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio et ad apostolicam puriores nos faciat venire festivitatem.
translation_en: May our offering of devotion be accepted, Lord, and may it bring us to the purest apostolic festival.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio et beatorum apostolorum illorum quorum natalicia praevenimus intercessio nos salvet semper et muniat.
translation_en: May our offering of devotion be accepted by you, Lord, and may the intercession of those blessed apostles whose feast days we are celebrating in advance save and protect us always and forevermore.

text: Accipe et esto Verbi Dei
translation_en: Receive and be of the Word of God

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio quae et ieiunium nostrum te operante sanctificet et indulgentiam nobis tuae consolationis obtineat.
translation_en: May our offering of devotion be accepted, Lord, which, through your working, may our fasting be sanctified and may we obtain the indulgence of your comfort.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine nostrae servitutis oblatio et salutaris nobis beati Laurentii precibus pro cuius commemoratione defertur exsistat.
translation_en: May our service offering be accepted before you, Lord. And may the prayers of the blessed Laurence bring salvation to us, for whose remembrance this offering is made to exist.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine nostrae servitutis oblatio quae nos et a reatibus nostris absolvat et ab imminentibus malis eripiat.
translation_en: May this offering be acceptable to you, Lord, of our service. May it free us from our sins and rescue us from impending evils.

text: Accipe ille sal sapientiae
translation_en: Receive him, the salt of wisdom

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine oblatio nostri sacrificii et oratio prophetae Eliae nos apud te faciat munitos.
translation_en: May this offering of our sacrifice, Lord, be pleasing to You. May the prayer of Prophet Elijah make us secure among You.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine quaesumus haec oblatio plebis tuae quam tibi offerimus hodie ob incarnationem simul et passionem redemptoris nostri Iesu Christi te supplices deprecantes ut placatus accipias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this offering of your people which we present to you today on account of the incarnation and passion of our Redeemer Jesus Christ, may be accepted by you. With supplication we entreat you to be appeased.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine quaesumus hodiernae festivitatis oblatio ut tua gratia largiente per haec sacrosancta commercia in illius inveniamur forma in quo tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that today's offering be acceptable to you. May your grace bestow upon us through these sacred transactions that we may find form within ourselves that is one with our substance as we are with you.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine quaesumus hodiernae festivitatis oblatio ut tua gratia largiente haec sacrosancta commercia in illa inveniamur forma in qua tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this day's festivity offering be pleasing to You. May Your grace make these sacred transactions found in that form where our substance is with You.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine sacratae plebis oblatio pro tuorum honore sanctorum quorum se meritis percepisse de tribulatione cognoscit auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, may this offering of your sacred people be acceptable to you, for their honor and in honor of the saints whom they have recognized as having received help from you during their tribulations.

text: Accepta tibi sit Domine sacratae plebis oblatio pro tuorum honore sanctorum quorum meritis se percepisse in tribulatione cognoscit auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, may this offering of your sacred people be acceptable to you for the honor of the saints, whose merits they acknowledge as help in their tribulations.

text: Acceptabile tibi effice omnipotens Deus ieiunium nostrum et sanctifica hoc sacrificium a nobis oblatum quo et ex eo sumentibus peccatorum concedatur remissio et per eum cunctis in commune fidelibus donetur tuae gratiae plenitudo.
translation_en: Almighty God, may our fast be acceptable to You. Sanctify this sacrifice that we offer and grant forgiveness of sins to those who partake and through it, may the fullness of Your grace be given to all faithful people in common.

text: Acceptabilis tibi sit rex omnium saeculorum oblatio populi tui qui Columbam virginem tuam inter ignes positam conservasti ut sicut illa igne amoris tui flammas poenalis superavit incendii ita hoc sacrificium et ardentes nostrarum cupiditatum faces interimat et fidelium defunctorum requiem praestando poenas exstinguat.
translation_en: May this offering be acceptable to you, the King of all ages, from your people who kept your Virgin Columba amidst the fires unharmed, so that just as she overcame the flames of your love's fire, this sacrifice and the burning faces of our desires may be extinguished. And by granting rest to the deceased faithful, it may quench the penalties.

text: Acceptare digneris terribilis et piissime Deus hoc sacrificium quod tibi pro remissione peccatorum nostrorum vel pro requie defunctorum fratrum offerimus quia vota nostra dona sunt tua nec tibi quidquam melius nisi quod dederis offerimus hoc est in primis in commemorationem ut iustum est dominicae institutionis offerre in honorem et gloriam Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui regis iudicisque venturi.
translation_en: You are graciously willing, O most terrible and merciful God, to accept this sacrifice which we offer to you for the remission of our sins or for the repose of the departed brothers. For our vows are your gifts, and nothing is better offered than what you have given. This in particular is offered in commemoration, as it is just, of the lordly institution of the Lord our Jesus Christ, Son of yours, King and coming Judge.

text: Acceptis fratres carissimi spiritalibus cibis et Christi cruore gustato petamus ut possideat pectora qui nostra ora dignatus est sanctificare per munera; ipse corporis nostri purget hospitium totoque intrinsecus homine deterso sanctificatis membris innovet spiritum sanctiorem.
translation_en: Having accepted, we, dearest brothers, partake of spiritual foods and tasted the flesh of Christ, we ask that He who has deemed our prayers worthy to sanctify may possess our hearts. May He purge our body's dwelling and through man cleansed, renew the more holy spirit within us.

text: Accepto caelestis corporis sacramento et salutis aeternae calice recreati Deo patri omnipotenti gratias agamus laudesque dicamus.
translation_en: I accept the sacred body of heaven and am refreshed with the cup of eternal salvation. Let us give thanks to God the almighty, and let us praise Him.

text: Accepto salutari divini corporis cibo Salvatori nostro Iesu Christo gratias agamus quod per sui corporis et sanguinis sacramentum nos a morte liberavit et tam corporis quam animae humano generi remedium donare dignatus est.
translation_en: I accept the saving food of the divine body. Let us give thanks to our Savior Jesus Christ, for He has freed us from death through the sacrament of His body and blood, and deemed it worthy to offer a remedy, both for body and soul, to the human race.

text: Acceptum habe pie Pater sacrificium populi offerentis quo et vivis gratiam et sepultis requiem largiaris aeternam.
translation_en: Graciously receive, O merciful Father, the offering of Your people; through which You grant grace to the living and eternal rest to the dead.

text: Acceptum sit quaesumus omnipotens Deus in conspectu tuae pietatis nostrae oblationis munus quod in festivitate sanctae virginis ac martyris tuae Margaritae tibi deferimus cuius precibus et ab instantibus periculis poscimus liberari et mansuris gaudiis admisceri.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Almighty God, that the offering we present to You in honor of Your holy virgin and martyr Margaret, during her feast day, may be accepted by You in the sight of Your merciful grace. We implore You through her prayers to deliver us from immediate dangers and admit us into lasting joys.

text: Acceptum tibi sit Domine quaesumus hoc sacrificium ieiunii nostri quod expiando nos caritatis dono tuae faciat sinceritatis capaces et per eam coniunctos ad promissa sempiterna perducat cordibusque nostris ieiunii attenuatione intentis per fraterna oscula puram tuae dilectionis et proximi caritatem benignus infunde ut a terrenis iurgiis vel laesionibus cum abstinentia quiescentes propensius caelestia meditemur.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, may this sacrifice of our fasting be acceptable to You. By Your grace, may it make us worthy of sincerity and through it, connected to the promised eternal life. May it soften our hearts, focused on the humility of fasting, and fill us with Your pure love and kindness towards others. May we, abstaining from worldly disputes and injuries, be more inclined to meditate on heavenly things.

text: Accipe Deus Ecclesiae tuae lamentabilem precem quae huius instituti ieiunii hodierno die agit celebritatem; suscipe confessionem qua miseris placatus ignoscas et preces quibus defunctis miseratus indulgeas ut in hoc die humilitatis nostrae et ieiunia paenitentium accipias et sepultorum vincula miseratus absolvas.
translation_en: Receive, O God, the church's lamentable prayer which today achieves celebration within this institution of fasting; receive the confession whereby you are appeased and forgive the prayers with which you have mercy on the departed and grant indulgence. May you accept our humility and the fasting of penitents on this day, and may you mercifully absolve the bonds of the deceased.

text: Accipe Deus haec famuli tui votiva sacrificia eumque protege manu tua et quia tu es via veritas et vita in veritate tua facito eum ambulare.
translation_en: Receive, O God, these votive offerings of your servant; protect him with your hand. And because you are way, truth, and life, make him walk in your truth.

text: Accipe Deus haec famulorum tuorum votiva sacrificia eosque ubique protege manu tua et quia tu es via veritas et vita in veritate tua facito eos ambulare et a via recta nullo modo declinare. Tribue mansionem tribue et defensionem effectum petitionis et profectum bonae deliberationis ut nullis scandalis saeculi impediantur nullisque adversitatibus inimicorum frangantur sed incolumitate omni manente perveniant ad locum quem desiderant angelo sancto tuo protegente et custodiente.
translation_en: Receive, O God, these votive sacrifices from your servants; and protect them everywhere with your hand. Since you are the way, truth, and life, make them walk in your truth, and may they never deviate from the right path. Grant them dwelling and defense according to their petition and good deliberation, so that no scandals of the world hinder them, nor any adversities break them, but in all safety they may reach the place which they desire, guarded and protected by your holy angel.

text: Accipe Deus offerentium munera atque vota ut qui tibi id quod te singulariter placare potest confidentia piae servitutis offerimus sacrificium ipsius propitiatione in tuam rediisse nos gratiam uberius exsultemus.
translation_en: Receive, O God, the gifts and vows offered by your faithful servants; and as we humbly present that which can please you uniquely in the service of pious devotion, let us rejoice more abundantly in your grace returning to us through its propitiation.

text: Accipe Deus offerentium vota et huius nostrae abstinentiae perfice inchoata donans vivis tam substantiis quam vitiis abstinere et defunctis concedens aeternae lucis consequi mansionem.
translation_en: Receive, God, the vows of those offering and perfect our begun abstinence by giving us the ability to abstain from both substances and vices, and granting eternal dwelling in the light to the departed.

text: Accipe Deus piissime tuorum supplicum vota et nomina quae coram tuo altario conspicis recensiri et in aeternae vitae libro conscribe Miserere etiam indigno mihi et omnibus pro quibus te supplex expostulo perpetuamque vitae requiem tribue famulis tuis illis vel animabus ceterorum fidelium defunctorum ut in Abrahae gremio collocati et nunc poenas evadant inferorum et resurrectionis tempore coetibus eos sociari iubeas angelorum.
translation_en: Receive, O most merciful God, the vows and names of Your suppliant servants which You see being recorded before Your altar. Inscribe them in the book of eternal life. Have mercy upon me, a sinner, and all for whom I humbly beseech You. Grant to those servants of Yours, whether souls or bodies of other faithful departed ones, eternal rest. Place them in Abraham's bosom now so that they may escape the pains of hell, and at the time of resurrection, command the angels to join them with the company of saints.

text: Accipe Domine et ieiunantium fidem et offerentium pronam devotionem ut qui te cum voto ieiunii imploramus tam nobis quam defunctis fidelibus necessaria remedia impetremus.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the faith of those who are fasting and the humble devotion of those who offer [it to You]. May we who appeal to You with vows during our fasting, obtain for ourselves and for the faithful departed the necessary remedies.

text: Accipe Domine fidelium preces cum oblationibus hostiarum ut per haec piae devotionis officia ad caelestem gloriam transeamus.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers of your faithful, together with the offerings of sacrifices, so that through these acts of pious devotion we may pass to celestial glory.

text: Accipe Domine fidelium preces cum oblationibus supplicantium ut paschalibus initiata mysteriis ad aeternitatis nobis proficiant haec dona suffragium.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers of the faithful with their offerings, that those initiated into the Paschal mysteries may advance towards eternal life through these gifts. May this offering intercede for us.

text: Accipe Domine munera exsultantis Ecclesiae et cui causam tanti gaudii contulisti perpetuae fructum concede laetitiae.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings of the rejoicing Church, and grant to him who has caused such great joy an eternal harvest of happiness.

text: Accipe Domine preces nomini tuo dicatas cum oblationibus supplicantium et quod mysteriis paschalibus fideliter exsequuntur in tuae remunerationis veritate percipiant.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers offered to Your name with the offerings of those who supplicate, and may they truly partake in the Paschal mysteries. May they perceive Your reward in truth.

text: Accipe Domine quaesumus nostrae servitutis officia ut suffragantibus sanctis quod ad honorem tuae maiestatis offerimus perpetuam nobis conferat vitam.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we implore, the duties of our service, so that those holy intercessors whom we present for your majesty's honor may grant us eternal life.

text: Accipe Domine quaesumus quae in sancti martyris tui Pontii commemorationem deferimus munera et praesta ut sicut ipse tibi complacet martyrii palma ita et haec oblatio fiat gratissima sacramenti intellegentia.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we humbly ask, what we bring for the commemoration of your saint martyr Pontius. Grant that just as the palm of the martyr pleases you, so may this offering be most pleasing to the understanding of the sacrament.

text: Accipe Domine quaesumus sacrificium singulare quod maiestati tuae semper et redditur et debetur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech You, this singular offering which is always rendered and should be given to Your majesty.

text: Accipe munera Domine quae in beatae Mariae iterata sollemnitate deferimus quia ad tua praeconia recurrit et laudem quod vel talis orta est vel talis assumpta.
translation_en: Receive the offerings, Lord, which we bring on the repeated solemnity of the Blessed Mary, for she returns to Your praises and sings the praise that such a one was born or such taken up.

text: Accipe munera Domine quae in eorum tibi sollemnitate deferimus quorum scimus patrocinia liberari.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings which we bring before You on their solemnity, knowing that they will be freed by their patronage.

text: Accipe munera quaesumus Domine quae in beatae martyris tuae sollemnitate deferimus quia ad tuam recurrit laudem quoties sanctorum tuorum merita recoluntur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to receive the offerings that we bring on the feast day of your blessed martyr. For whenever the merits of your saints are recalled, they return praise to you.

text: Adesto Domine Deus noster ut per haec quae fideliter sumpsimus et purgemur a vitiis et a periculis omnibus exuamur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord our God, that through what we have taken faithfully, we may be purified from vices and freed from all dangers.
