text: Accipe quaesumus Domine hostias tua nobis dignatione collatas quoniam et te creante procedunt et tu causas humanae salutis et gloriae quibus tibi gratae sunt condidisti.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to accept the offerings that have been granted us by your mercy, for they proceed from your creation and you have established the causes of human salvation and glory, which are pleasing to you.

text: Accipe quaesumus Domine munera dignanter oblata et beati Laurentii suffragantibus meritis ad nostrae salutis auxilium provenire concede.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, worthy gifts that are offered and through the merits of blessed Laurence, let help come for our salvation be granted.

text: Accipe quaesumus Domine munera populi tui pro martyrum festivitate sanctorum et sincero nos corde fac eorum nataliciis interesse.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to receive the offerings of Your people on the feast day of the martyrs. And may it please You to have them participate sincerely in the birthday celebrations of these saints.

text: Accipe quaesumus Domine munera quae tibi offerimus pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum Crispini et Crispiniani sollemnitate et sincero corde fac nos tuis sacramentis interesse.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, the gifts which we offer to You on the solemnity of Your saints Crispin and Crispinian, and may our hearts be sincere towards Your sacred mysteries, so that we may participate in them.

text: Accipe quaesumus Domine munera quae tibi pro huius loci et habitantium in eo tuitione deferimus et concede ut per haec et a cunctis liberari adversis et ab omnibus mereamur absolvi peccatis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to receive the offerings that we bring for your protection of this place and its inhabitants. Grant us that through these offerings, we may be freed from all adversities and by all be absolved from sins.

text: Accipe quaesumus Domine munus oblatum et dignanter operare ut quod mysteriis agimus piis effectibus celebremus.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offering made and work worthily so that what we celebrate in the mysteries may be celebrated with holy effects.

text: Accipe sacra Dei virgo ob honorem tui nominis supplicantis populi preces et cunctis congruum solamen attribue; per te virginum virginitas polleat per te corruptorum interimatur lascivia per te peccantibus venia per te sacrificantibus ipsisque sacrificiis largiatur benedictio copiosa; quo omnes qui exemplo virginitatis simul atque certaminis tui attollimur deliciis quibus ipsa frueris post transitum potiamur.
translation_en: Receive, O Virgin of God, on account of the honor of your name, the prayers of the supplicating people and grant them a suitable consolation; through you, let virginity flourish among virgins, let corruption be destroyed by lasciviousness, let forgiveness be given to sinners, let blessings be bestowed upon their very sacrifices; so that all who lift themselves up in delight by the example of your virginity and the contest of your purity may partake in those delights which you shall enjoy after passing. May we partake in them afterwards.

text: Ad altaria Domine veneranda cum hostiis laudis accedimus; fac quaesumus ut et indulgentiam tuam nobis concilient et favorem.
translation_en: At your revered altars, Lord, we approach with offerings of praise; grant us, we beseech you, that both your mercy and favor be bestowed upon us.

text: Ad aures misericordiae tuae Domine supplicum vota perveniant et ut possimus impetrare quae poscimus fac nos semper tibi placita postulare.
translation_en: May our supplications reach the ears of your mercy, Lord. Let us always be able to ask for what we desire, as we continually appeal to you.

text: Ad defensionem fidelium Domine quaesumus dexteram tuae maiestatis extende et ut perpetua pietatis tuae protectione muniantur intercessio pro his non desit martyrum continuata sanctorum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you extend the right hand of your majesty for the defense of the faithful. May they be continually protected by the unending intercession of the martyrs and saints.

text: Ad gloriam Domine tui nominis annua festa repetentes sacerdotalis exordii hostiam tibi laudis offerimus suppliciter exorantes ut cuius ministerii vice tibi servimus immeriti suffragiis eius reddamur accepti.
translation_en: On the annual festivals, we return to Your Lord's glory and offer You the opening sacrifice of priestly service, humbly beseeching that, as unworthy servants in his stead, we may be graciously granted his intercessions.

text: Ad hostes nostros Domine superandos praesta quaesumus ut auxilium tuum ieiuniis tibi placitis et bonis operibus impetremus.
translation_en: Lord, grant us your aid that we may beseech your help through our fasting which pleases you and good works against our enemies.

text: Adesto Domine officiis nostrae servitutis
translation_en: Attend, Lord, to our service duties

text: Ad humilitatis nostrae preces Domine placatus intende nec nos foveas et diaboli laqueos patiaris incidere quos tantis sanctorum martyrum praesidiis munire dignaris.
translation_en: Lord, graciously incline Your attention to our humility, and may You not suffer us to fall into the snares of the devil, whom You deem worthy to be guarded by such great armies of saints as martyrs.

text: Ad martyrum tuorum Domine festa venientes cum muneribus nomini tuo dicatis occurrimus ut illis reverentiam deferentes nobis veniam consequamur.
translation_en: Upon coming to the festivals of your martyrs, Lord, we approach with offerings in Your name. With reverence for them, we seek pardon for ourselves.

text: Ad offerenda munera Domine laeti concurrimus supplices implorantes ut venerando gloriam nuntiantis sumamus gratiam nuntiati.
translation_en: With joy we approach, Lord, to present our offerings, humbly we come begging that we may receive grace when announcing the glorious news-bearer's summons.

text: Ad preces nostras Domine quaesumus propitiatus intende ut sacris altaribus servientes et fidei veritate fundati et mentis sint puritate conspicui.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you, being merciful, direct your attention to our prayers. May those serving at the sacred altars be firmly founded in the truth of faith and their minds be clearly evident in purity.

text: Ad te corda nostra Pater aeterne converte quia nullis necessariis indigebunt quos tuo cultui praestiteris esse subiectos.
translation_en: Turn our hearts, eternal Father, to you, for those who are subject to your worship will have no need of the necessary things.

text: Ad te nos Domine clamantes exaudi et aeris serenitatem nobis tribue supplicantibus ut qui pro peccatis nostris iuste affligimur misericordia tua praeveniente clementiam sentiamus.
translation_en: Lord, to you we cry out; hear us and grant us the calmness of heaven for those who humbly plead. May your mercy prevent us from feeling just punishment for our sins, that we may experience your clemency.

text: Ad tua Domine beneficia fiducialiter impetranda quaesumus ut exercere quae tibi sunt placita et velle nobis largiaris et posse.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant your favorable blessings with faith, that you may do what pleases you and give us what you will, and that we may receive it as we are able.

text: Ad tumulum vigilantes unici redemptoris qui pro nostra redemptione sepultus et a mortuis est admirabiliter suscitatus cuius virtutem et gloriam serenata cordis acie contemplamur cum novelli gregis ovibus dulcissima in ara tua Domine pascua circumdamus universi pariter exorantes ut huius sacrati corporis alimentum cruorisque suavissimum poculum ad praemium satietatis perpetuae nobis tribuas possidendum.
translation_en: To the tomb of the vigilant one, the unique redeemer, who was buried and miraculously raised from the dead, whose power and glory we contemplate with a serene heart's eye, surrounded by the sweetest lambs of your flock, Lord. We surround all alike on your altar, fervently entreating, that you may grant us to possess forever the nourishment of this sacred body and the most sweet drink of its blood as a reward for eternal satisfaction.

text: Ad viventis Iesu sepulchrum voto hilari concurrentes et Christi resurgentis linteamenta contemplantes obsecramus benignissime pater omnipotens Deus ut dum tantae sollemnitatis mysteria celebramus nihil nobis adversitatis eveniat nihil tristitiae aut calamitatis occurrat sed cunctos fideles ob dierum paschalium festa iucunditas aeterna possideat Eorum quoque suffragantibus meritis qui cum unico filio tuo vivi meruerunt resurgere de sepulchris concordia in nobis vigeat caritatis ut hoc sacrificium laudis placabili pietate suscipiatur e manibus nostris.
translation_en: Approaching with joyful vows the living Jesus' tomb and contemplating the linen cloths of Christ rising, we humbly beseech you most merciful Father, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the great mysteries of this solemnity, no adversity may happen to us, no sadness or calamity occur, but eternal joy possess all the faithful during these Easter days. We also ask that those who, with your only son, have merited to rise from the tomb, intercede for us. May harmony of love dwell in us, so that this offering of praise may be received by you with pleasing piety from our hands.

text: Addit etiam istud edictum ut quotiescumque corpus ipsius sumeretur et sanguis commemoratio fieret dominicae passionis; quod nos facientes Iesu Christi Filii tui Domini ac Dei nostri semper gloriam praedicamus. Rogamus uti hoc sacrificium tua benedictione benedicas et sancti spiritus rore perfundas ut accipientibus universis sit eucharistia pura vera legitima.
translation_en: We also add this edict, that whenever the body of him (Christ) is taken and the remembrance of his blood is made on the occasion of the Lord's Passion; what we do, we always proclaim the glory of Jesus Christ, your Son, our Lord and God. We ask you to bless this sacrifice with your blessing and to pour upon it the dew of the Holy Spirit, so that for all who receive it, the Eucharist may be pure, true, and legitimate.

text: Adesto Deus noster famulis tuis et oblationes nostras sanctorum tuorum placationibus propitiatus intende ut quod nostra fiducia non meretur pia supplicatio reddat acceptum.
translation_en: Be present, O God, to your servants and incline your attention to our offerings, propitiated by the prayers of your saints, so that what our faith does not deserve may be granted by a pious supplication.

text: Adesto Domine precibus nostris et die nocteque
translation_en: Attend to us, Lord, in our prayers, both day and night.

text: Adesto Domine Deus Pater omnipotens precibus nostris et plenitudinem nobis tribue caritatis et pacis ut nos omnes qui de misericordia tua confidimus in spe semper et caritate sine fine vivamus.
translation_en: Be present, O Lord God, Almighty Father, and grant to us the fullness of your love and peace through our prayers. May we who trust in your mercy always live in hope and charity without end.

text: Adesto Domine Ecclesiae tuae sanctae catholicae pietate solita et pacem ei concede perpetuam sanctorumque tuorum illorum intercessione hoc sacrificium a nobis oblatum accepta ac nos consolida in pace perpetua.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your holy Catholic Church, as is your usual piety, and grant it eternal peace. Through the intercession of your saints, receive this sacrifice offered by us, and strengthen us with perpetual peace.

text: Adesto Domine familiae tuae et quibus venerandi sanctos tuos praestas benignus affectum et vitae mortalis concede praesidium et sempiternae retributionis effectum.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your family and to those to whom you show a benevolent affection towards your venerable saints. And grant them protection in this mortal life and the effect of eternal reward.

text: Adesto Domine famulis tuis et opem tuam largire poscentibus ut his qui te auctore et gubernatore gloriantur et creata restaures et restaurata conserves.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your servants and grant help to those who ask for it, so that those who glory in you as author and governor may restore what you have created, and preserve what has been restored.

text: Adesto Domine fidelibus tuis adesto supplicibus et terrestribus non deseras adiumentis quos caelestium rerum facis esse participes.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your faithful ones; be present to the supplicants and earthly ones. You do not fail to provide aid for those whom you make participants of celestial things.

text: Adesto Domine fidelibus tuis et quibus supplicandi tribuis miseratus affectum concede benignissime consolationis auxilium.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your faithful ones and grant mercifully to those who ask for help the most benevolent aid of consolation.

text: Adesto Domine fidelibus tuis et quos caelestibus instituis sacramentis a terrenis conserva periculis.
translation_en: Lord, be present to your faithful ones and those whom you institute with heavenly sacraments, preserve them from earthly dangers.

text: Adesto Domine fidelibus tuis et tua sancta celebrantibus auge devotionis effectum ut et tibi semper exhibeant debitam servitutem et ad remedia iugiter aeterna proficiant.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your faithful ones and to those who celebrate your holiness. Increase the effectiveness of their devotion so that they may always show you the due service and continue to advance towards eternal remedies.

text: Adesto Domine fidelibus tuis nec eos ullis mentis et corporis patiaris subiacere periculis quos beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli munit gloriosa confessio.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your faithful ones and do not allow them to submit to any mental or bodily perils that the glorious confession of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul protects.

text: Adesto Domine fidelium votis propitius et abstinentium preces exaudi placatus ut caro vel anima ieiunio castigata ita tuam impetrare possit misericordiam qualiter et vivis commoda vitae et defunctis concedantur aeterna gaudia sine fine.
translation_en: Lord, be present to the faithful with favorable regard and grant the prayers of the abstinent that you may be pleased as they, with their disciplined body or soul through fasting, can obtain your mercy. May you grant temporal comforts for those living, and eternal joy without end to those who have passed away.

text: Adesto Domine invocationibus nostris et has famulorum tuorum oblationes propitius ac benignus assume et quia non habent fiduciam nisi in tua misericordia et sanctorum tuorum suffragiis quaesumus Domine ut per haec piae placationis officia plenam indulgentiam atque perpetuam misericordiam consequi mereantur.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and graciously receive these offerings of your servants. Since they have no faith except in your mercy, and through the intercession of your saints we humbly ask you, Lord, that by means of these acts of pious appeasement, they may merit full indulgence and eternal mercy.

text: Adesto Domine quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus invocationibus nostris et hanc famuli tui illius oblationem propitius ac benignus assume et qui non habet fiduciam nisi per misericordiam tuam per sanctorum tuorum suffragia quaesumus Domine et per haec piae oblationis officia plenam indulgentiam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, we beseech you, almighty and merciful God, in response to our supplications, and graciously accept this offering of your servant. May he who has no faith except through your mercy, we pray, Lord, be helped by the intercession of your saints. And may he be worthy to obtain a full indulgence through these pious acts of worship.

text: Adesto Domine invocationibus nostris et non sit a nobis clementiae tuae longinqua misericordia; sana vulnera remitte peccata ut nullis iniquitatibus a te separati tibi semper adhaerere possimus.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to our supplications, and may the kindness of your not be far from us. Heal our wounds, forgive sins that we may always adhere to you without any unrighteousness.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris nec sit ab hoc famulo tuo clementiae tuae longinqua miseratio; sana vulnera eiusque remitte peccata ut nullis a te iniquitatibus separatus tibi semper domino valeat adhaerere.
translation_en: Lord, attend to our supplications and let not thy clemency be distant from this thy servant. May thy mercy not be far off. Heal his wounds and forgive his sins, so that he, separated from no unrighteousness by thee, may always dwell securely in thee, Lord.

text: Adesto Domine martyrum deprecatione sanctorum et quos pati pro tuo nomine tribuisti fac tuis fidelibus suffragari.
translation_en: Lord, be present with us at the entreaty of the saints and those whom you granted to suffer for Your name. Grant that they intercede for Your faithful ones.

text: Adesto Domine muneribus Innocentium festivitate sacrandis et praesta quaesumus ut eorum sinceritatem possimus imitari quorum tibi dicatam veneramur infantiam.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, for the rites of the innocents to be sanctified, and grant us that we may be able to imitate their sincerity, whose childhood we reverently declare before you.

text: Adesto Domine muneribus Innocentium festivitate sacrandis et praesta quaesumus ut et hii martyres tui pro nobis interveniant quorum clara prior est confessio quam loquela.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, at the offerings for the festival of Innocents and grant us as we ask that these martyrs of yours also intercede on our behalf. Their clear confession precedes their speech.

text: Adesto Domine placatus plebium tuarum precibus et his sacrificiis a te institutis profluam benedictionem infunde de caelis et qui apostolum Didymum locupletasti gratiae tuae donum ut ab omni genere morborum te credentem populum in tuo sancto nomine redderet illaesum huius exoratus suffragio haec munera altario tuo superposita tibi efficito holocausta placabilia ut ex his sumentibus animae et corporis proficiat ad salutem et fidelibus defunctis praestetur ad requiem.
translation_en: Lord, being pleased with the prayers of your people and these sacrifices instituted by you, pour out a blessing upon us from heaven. Who enriched Didymus the apostle with your grace, grant that through this supplication, the gifts placed on your altar make the holocaust acceptable to you. May those who partake of it prosper in health of soul and body, and may it provide peace for the faithful departed.

text: Adesto Domine plebi tuae et in tua misericordia confidenti opem tuae propitiationis impende.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your people, and extend the help of your merciful favor.

text: Adesto Domine populis qui sacra donaria contigerunt ut nullis periculis affligantur qui te protectore confidunt.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to the people who have received your sacred gifts, so that those who trust in you as their protector may not be afflicted by any dangers.

text: Adesto Domine populis tuis in tua protectione fidentibus et tuae se dexterae suppliciter inclinantes perpetua defensione conserva. Percipiant quaesumus Domine vitae praesentis auxilium et gratiam repperiant sempiternam.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your people who trust in your protection and humbly bend their right hand. May they continually be protected by you. We ask, Lord, that they may receive help for the present life and find eternal grace.

text: Adesto Domine populo tuo cum sanctorum patrocinio supplicanti ut quod propria fiducia non praesumit suffragantium meritis consequatur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your people with the patronage of the saints, as they humbly petition. May they obtain what they do not presume through the merits of your intercession.

text: Adesto Domine populo tuo et concede misericordiam tuam cum sanctorum tuorum patrociniis supplicanti ut quia tua gubernatione confidit nullis adversitatibus opprimatur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your people and grant them your mercy with the patronage of your saints, that they who trust in your governance may not be overcome by any adversities.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et hunc famulum ...
translation_en: Attend, Lord, to our supplications and this servant of yours...

text: Adesto Domine populo tuo et quem sanctorum tuorum tribuis frequentationibus interesse proiectione perpetua fac securum.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your people and grant that they may be assisted by the constant presence of your saints.

text: Adesto Domine populo tuo et quos in frequentatione beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui illius tribuis interesse protectione perpetua semper facias esse securos.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your people, and always make those who were present at the festival of your blessed priest and confessor to be under perpetual protection, ensuring they are secure forever.

text: Adesto Domine populo tuo placatus et clemens ut eorum supplicatione qui tuae placuerunt pietati te largiente ad vitam perveniant sempiternam.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your pleasing and merciful people, so that those who have pleased you with their supplications may obtain eternal life through your bounty.

text: Adesto Domine populo tuo ut beati Nicomedis martyris tui merita praeclara suscipiens ad impetrandam misericordiam tuam semper eius patrociniis adiuvetur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your people, so that they may be supported by the remarkable merits of Blessed Nicomedes, your martyr, in their constant supplication for your mercy and may always be helped by his patronage.

text: Adesto Domine precibus nostris et famulorum tuorum illorum iter in pace iube dirigere; comitetur eis gratia tua; infirmitas illis non accidat propria; adversitas eis non impediat aliena; sit eis in comitatum visitatio angelica quae eos et delictis expiet et ab adversitate conservet quo in omnibus tuae roborati auxilio gratiae a te instruantur quid agant per te acta perficiant desiderata impleant ad destinata perveniant et ad propria iterantium cum prosperitate succedant.
translation_en: Lord, be present with our prayers and direct the way of your servants in peace; may your grace accompany them; may sickness not befall them through their own fault; may adversity not hinder them through foreign means; may an angelic visitation be with them, which will cleanse them from sins and protect them from adversity. In all things, may they be strengthened by your aid, guided by your grace, accomplish through you what they desire, fulfill their aims, reach their destinations, and return to their own journey with prosperity.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et me qui etiam ...
translation_en: Attend, Lord, to our supplications, and me who am also ...

text: Adesto Domine precibus nostris quas in honorem et commemorationem Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctorumque apostolorum martyrum et confessorum ac virginum atque omnium electorum tuorum tuae maiestati humiliter deferimus et tribue ut qui eorum merita venerando recolimus in aeterna laetitia de eorum societate gaudeamus.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, with our prayers which we humbly offer to your majesty in honor and commemoration of the God-bearer Mary, the holy apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all your elect. Grant that we who revere their merits may rejoice in eternal joy from their fellowship.

text: Adesto Domine precibus nostris quas in sancti Galli confessoris tui commemoratione deferimus ut qui tibi digne meruit famulari eius intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, with our prayers which we bring before you in the commemoration of your confessor St. Gall, so that those who have deserved to serve you faithfully may intercede for us with their merits and absolve us from all sins.

text: Adesto Domine precibus nostris quas in sanctorum tuorum commemoratione deferimus ut qui nostrae iustitiae fiduciam non habemus eorum qui tibi placuerunt meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: Lord, be present with our prayers which we bring before you in the commemoration of your saints, that those who have pleased you may help us, who do not have faith in our own justice.

text: Adesto Domine precibus nostris quas in sancti confessoris et episcopi tui Donati commemoratione deferimus ut qui nostrae iustitiae fiduciam non habemus eius qui tibi placuit meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, with our prayers which we bring on the commemoration of your saintly confessor and bishop Donatus. May he who did not have faith in our justice be helped by him whose merits pleased you.

text: Adesto Domine precibus nostris ut adoptio quam in idipsum sanctus spiritus advocavit nihil habeat in dilectione terrenum nihil in confessione diversum.
translation_en: Attend to our prayers, Lord, so that the adoption which the Holy Spirit has invoked in you may have nothing of earthly love and nothing different in confessing.

text: Adesto Domine precibus populi tui adesto muneribus ut quae sacris sunt oblata mysteriis tuorum tibi placeant intercessione sanctorum.
translation_en: Lord, be present with the prayers of your people. Be present with offerings, so that what is offered in the sacred mysteries may please you through the intercession of the saints.

text: Adesto Domine propitius plebi tuae et ut eam perpetua bonitate non deseras piis operibus indesinenter exerce quia omnia dona praestabis quibus concesseris religionis augmentum.
translation_en: Be present, O Lord, graciously to your people, and may you never forsake them with perpetual goodness as they unceasingly exercise pious works because all gifts will be bestowed by you which you grant for the increase of religion.

text: Adesto Domine pro tua pietate supplicationibus nostris et suscipe hostiam quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo iacente in grabatto salutem non corporis sed animae suae petenti; praesta omnipotens Deus indulgentiam omnium iniquitatum suarum propter immensam misericordiam tuam et per intercessionem sanctorum tuorum illorum ut per hoc quod sustinet flagellum a sanctis angelis tuis susceptus pervenire mereatur ad tuae gloriae regnum.
translation_en: Lord, be present for Your mercy's sake with our supplications and receive the offering we present on behalf of Your servant lying in misery, seeking not the salvation of his body but of his soul; O mighty God, grant him forgiveness of all his sins because of Your immense mercy, and through the intercession of Your saints may he merit to reach Your kingdom by enduring the scourge from Your holy angels.

text: Adesto Domine quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae votis adesto muneribus et quod conscientia nostra non supplet sanctorum tuorum intercessio compenset et meritum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you be present for your Church. Be with us in our prayers, with your gifts. May the intercession of your saints compensate where our conscience falls short, and may their merits make up for it.

text: Adesto Domine quaesumus famulorum tuorum hostiis adesto muneribus sancti Lamberti martyris tui atque pontificis precibus placatus ac meritis et eius gaudentes sollemnitate ab hostium infestationibus tuere.
translation_en: We ask you to be present, Lord, we humbly entreat. Be present among your servants, O host, at the offerings. Be present with the gifts of Saint Lambert, your martyr and bishop, and being appeased by your prayers and merits, protect us joyfully in his solemnity from attacks by enemies.

text: Adesto Domine quaesumus populo tuo et quem mysteriis caelestibus imbuisti ab hostium furore defende.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to be present for your people. Protect those whom you have filled with celestial mysteries from the fury of enemies.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine propitius populo tuo et quem mysteriis caelestibus et sacramentis imbuis per haec munera quae tibi offert devotus a furore cunctorum hostium tua miseratione defende.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to be present among Your people. May You show mercy and protect them, whom You have filled with celestial mysteries and sacred sacraments through these gifts that the devoted offers from the fury of all enemies. Defend them with Your mercy.

text: Adesto Domine quaesumus redemptionis effectibus ut quos sacramentis aeternitatis instituis iisdem protegas dignanter aptandos.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to be present with us through the power of redemption. May those whom you have established in the sacraments of eternity also be worthy of your noble protection as they strive to attain it.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et animae famulorum tuorum diaconorum et omnium clericorum tuae propitiationis abundantiam et indulgentiam consequantur et lucis perpetuae tribuas eis mansionem.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and grant the abundance and indulgence of your favor to the souls of your servant deacons and all the clergy. Bestow upon them a dwelling in the light eternal.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et apostolicis intercessionibus confidentes nec minis adversantium nec ullo perturbemur incursu.
translation_en: We stand before you, Lord, with our supplications, and with confident prayers of the Apostles; let us not be disturbed by any threats from opponents nor by any onslaught.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et famulorum tuorum oblationibus praesentiam tuae virtutis intersere. Nullius sit vacua postulatio nullius sit irritum votum ut quod singuli obtulerunt ad nominis tui honorem et cunctis viventibus proficiat ad salutem et defunctis omnibus praestetur ad requiem.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and let the offering of your servants intervene in your divine presence. May no petition be void, may no vow be unfilled, so that what each has offered for your honor may benefit all who live, bringing salvation, and for all the dead, bring peace.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et his populi tui oblationibus precibusque susceptis praesentiam tuae maiestatis intersere ut quod singuli obtulerunt ad honorem nominis tui cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and to the offerings of your people. Intercede with your divine presence so that what each one has offered for the honor of your name benefits all for their salvation.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et famulos tuos assidua proiectione conserva ut qui tibi iugiter famulantur continua remuneratione ditentur.
translation_en: Attend to our supplications, Lord, and constantly preserve your servants, so that those who serve you continually may be ever enriched with continual reward.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et famulos tuos quos caritatis visitamus officiis gratiae tuae largitate locupleta ut in eorum prosperitate continua gaudeamus.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and your servants whom we visit with the works of your grace, abundant in generosity. May we rejoice continually in their prosperity.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et hanc domum serenis oculis tuae pietatis illustra; descendat super habitantes in ea gratiae tuae larga benedictio ut his manufactis cum salubritate manentibus ipsi tuum semper sint habitaculum.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to our supplications and illuminate this house with the serene gaze of your mercy; may your abundant blessing descend upon those dwelling in it, that these works remain among them with health, may they always be your dwelling place.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et hanc famuli tui illius oblationem benignus assume ut qui auxilium tuae miserationis implorat et sanctificationis gratiam percipiat et quae pie precatur obtineat.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to our supplications and graciously accept this offering of your servant. May he who implores your aid receive the grace of your mercy and may he obtain what he humbly prays for.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et hanc oblationem famularum tuarum illarum quam tibi offerunt pro famula tua illa quam ad statum maturitatis et ad diem nuptiarum perducere dignatus es placidus ac benignus assume ut quod tua dispositione expetitur tua gratia compleatur.
translation_en: Lord, attend to our supplications and receive this offering of your servants which they offer for your servant who was graciously led to maturity and the day of marriage. May you, gentle and benevolent, assume that what is sought according to your disposition may be fulfilled through your grace.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et hanc oblationem famuli tui illius quam tibi offert ob diem natalis sui genuinum quo die eum de maternis visceribus in hunc mundum nasci iussisti placidus ac benignus assume.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and accept this offering of your servant, which he offers to you on the day of his birthday, the genuine one whom you commanded to be born into this world from his mother's womb. May you receive him peacefully and benignly.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et hanc oblationem quam tibi offerimus ob diem depositionis tertium vel septimum vel tricesimum pro anima famuli tui illius placidus ac benignus assume.
translation_en: Lord, attend to our supplications and receive this offering which we present to You on the third, seventh or thirty-third day for the soul of Your servant, accepting him gently and kindly.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et his muneribus praesentiam tuae maiestatis intersere ut quod nostro servitio geritur te potius operante firmetur.
translation_en: Lord, be present with our supplications and bestow your presence amongst these offerings, that what is being carried out in our service may be strengthened by your action.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et institutis tuis quibus propagationem humani generis ordinasti benignus assiste ut quod te auctore iungitur te auxiliante servetur.
translation_en: Lord, attend to our supplications and your institutions which you have ordained for the propagation of the human race with benevolence. Assist, so that what is joined together by you as author may be preserved by you as helper.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et intercedentibus sanctis tuis ab hostium nos defende propitiatus incursu.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, with our supplications and through your saints defend us from the onslaught of our enemies, merciful one.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et intercessione sancti Laurentii martyris tui perpetuam nobis misericordiam benignus impende.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and bestow upon us, through the intercession of Saint Lawrence Your martyr, Your eternal mercy.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et intercessione beatorum martyrum tuorum Naboris et Felicis hostiam hanc quam confidentes tuae maiestati offerimus ad nostrum tribue quaesumus provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Attend, Lord, to our supplications and with the intercession of your blessed martyrs Nabor and Felix, we present this offering which we confidently bring before you. We humbly ask that it may provide help.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et intercessionibus beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Naboris et Felicis confidenter tribue consequi quod sperare donasti.
translation_en: Attend to our supplications, Lord, and graciously grant us to obtain what you have given us to hope for, through the intercession of your most blessed martyrs Nabor and Felicitas.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et iter famuli tui illius interno discretionis moderamine dirigendo dispone sicque ministerium eius quod humanae utilitati prospicit pio favore prosequere quatenus hunc a tuis praeceptis non patiaris deviare.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and guide the journey of your servant with discernment. Arrange his ministry in such a way that it may proceed with pious favor, so that you will not allow him to depart from your commandments.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et nihil de sua conscientia praesumentibus ineffabili miseratione succurre ut quod non habet fiducia meritorum tua conferat largitas invicta donorum.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and, without presumption based on Your conscience, come to our aid with Your ineffable mercy. May You bestow upon us, who lack confidence in our merits, the bounty of Your invincible gifts.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et oblationes famulorum tuorum quas tibi offerimus diem octavarum suarum spiritalium celebrantes quo die eos sacro fonte baptismatis renasci iussisti placidus ac benignus assume.
translation_en: Lord, attend to our supplications and the offerings of your servants which we present on this octave day of their spiritual celebration. On that day you commanded them to be reborn in the sacred font of baptism with a peaceful and benevolent attitude.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et populo tuo quem tibi ex omnibus gentibus elegisti veritatis tuae lumen ostende.
translation_en: Attend to us, Lord, in our supplications and to your people whom from all nations you have chosen as the light of your truth.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et populus tuus qui te factore conditus teque est reparatus auctore te etiam iugiter operante salvetur.
translation_en: Attend to us, Lord, with our supplications, and your people who are constituted by you, and who are repaired by you as the author, are also continually saved by your operation.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et praesentis vota ieiunii placita tibi devotione exhiberi concede.
translation_en: Attend to, Lord, our supplications and grant that the vows of this fasting may be presented to you in devotion.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et sperantes in tua misericordia caelesti protege benignus auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and protect us with your heavenly mercy as a benevolent helper.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et ut nos ab hostibus dignanter eripias a tibi non placitis prius moribus benignus emunda quia sine dubitatione defendes quos tuis perspexeris convenire mandatis.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and grant us, undeserving as we are, a worthy rescue from you before any other. You, gracious one, cleanse us because without doubt you defend those who have been seen by you to conform to your commands.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et viam famuli tui illius in salutis tuae prosperitate dispone ut inter omnes vitae huius varietates tuo semper protegatur auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and arrange the way of your servant in prosperity for your salvation, so that he may always be protected by your aid among the various aspects of this life.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris quibus misericordiam tuam suppliciter deprecamur pro anima famuli tui illius cuius hodie annua dies agitur ut eam mortalitatis nexibus absolutam inter sanctos et electos tuos perpetuam iubeas habere portionem.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications where we humbly ask for your mercy. For the soul of your servant whose annual day is being observed today, we pray that you absolve her from the bonds of mortality and command that she may have eternal residence among your saints and elect.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris ut sicut humani generis Salvatorem consedere tecum in tua maiestate confidimus ita usque ad consummationem saeculi manere nobiscum quemadmodum est pollicitus sentiamus.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, with our supplications, so that as we trust in you as the Savior of the human race in your majesty, we may feel the assurance that you will remain with us until the end of time, as you have promised.

text: Adesto Domine supplicibus tuis et spem suam in tua misericordia collocantes tuere propitius ut a peccatorum labe mundati in sancta conversatione permaneant et consequentes sufficientiam temporalem promissionis tuae perficiantur heredes.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your suppliant ones and placing their hope in your mercy. May you be propitious, so that purified from the stain of sins they may remain in holy living, and those pursuing sufficient temporal provision may complete the fulfillment of your promise, inheriting it.

text: Adesto Domine supplicibus tuis ut hoc sollemne ieiunium quod animis corporibusque curandis salubriter institutum est devoto servitio celebremus.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, with your suppliants, so that we may celebrate this solemn fast, which has been healthily established for the care of souls and bodies, in devoted service.

text: Adesto familiae tuae clementissime Deus ut in adversis et prosperis preces eius exaudias et nefarias adversariorum insidias per vexillum sanctae crucis digneris conterere ut perennis gaudii salutem possit te protegente mereri.
translation_en: O most kind God, be present to your family that you may hear their prayers in times of adversity and prosperity. May you deign to crush the deceitful plots of wicked adversaries under the banner of the Holy Cross, so that they may merit eternal salvation protected by you.

text: Adesto familiae tuae quaesumus clemens et misericors Deus; in adversis et prosperis preces exaudias et nefas adversariorum per auxilium sanctae crucis digneris conterere ut portum salutis tuae valeant apprehendere. ( recension gélasienne ) Adesto familiae tuae clemens et misericors Deus et in adversis et prosperis preces eius exaudi ut nefas adversariorum per auxilium sanctae crucis digneris conterere quatenus portum salutis tuae valeat apprehendere. ( recension de Mateus )
translation_en: We humbly ask you, O merciful and gracious God, to be present with your family; listen to their prayers in times of adversity and prosperity. May you, through the help of the Holy Cross, crush the wickedness of their enemies so that they may safely grasp the harbor of your salvation.

text: Adesto misericors Deus ut quod actum est nostrae servitutis officio tua benedictione firmetur.
translation_en: May a merciful God be present, so that what has been done in our service is strengthened by your blessing.

text: Adesto quaesumus omnipotens Deus honorum dator ...
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty God, bestower of honors...

text: Adesto nobis Domine Deus noster et quos sanctae crucis laetari facis honore eius quoque perpetuis defende subsidiis.
translation_en: Be present with us, Lord our God, and make those whom you cause to rejoice in the honor of the holy cross also perpetually defend with your aid.

text: Adesto nobis Domine Deus noster et quos tuis mysteriis recreasti perpetuis defende praesidiis.
translation_en: Be present with us, Lord our God, and defend those whom you have renewed in your eternal mysteries, through your protective guardianship.

text: Adesto quaesumus omnipotens Deus honorum dator ...
translation_en: We humbly ask, O Almighty God, Bestower of honors...

text: Adesto nobis misericors Deus et tua circa nos propitiatus dona custodi.
translation_en: Draw near to us, O merciful God, and grant us your gracious protection.

text: Adesto nobis misericors Deus et tuae pietatis in nobis propitius dona concede.
translation_en: Come near to us, O merciful God, and grant us your pity, bestow upon us your grace.

text: Adesto nobis omnipotens Deus beatae Agnes festa repetentibus quam hodiernae festivitatis prolatam exortu ineffabili munere sublevasti.
translation_en: Be present with us, Almighty God, as we celebrate the feast of the blessed Agnes, whom you raised today from an inexpressible gift to this festival.

text: Adiuro ergo te draco ...
translation_en: I therefore adjure you, dragon...

text: Adesto nobis omnipotens Deus sanctorum tuorum Fructuosi Agurii et Eulogii triumphalem celebrantibus diem et laetitiam spiritalium tribue gaudiorum concedens eorum intercessione sepultis requiem offerentiumque animabus et corporibus sospitatem quorum sic fides membris igne decidentibus arsit ut sentirent corruptibilis naturae defectum et nescirent caelestis animi mutare propositum.
translation_en: Be present with us, almighty God, through the intercession of your saints Fructuosus of Braga and Eulogius, who are celebrating a triumphant day and spiritual joy. Grant them the joy of participating, and through their intercession offer rest to the departed souls and safety to the bodies of those whose faith, like burning members, did not waver in the face of falling corporeal nature, and who therefore knew the defect of corruptible nature and were unaware of a change in the purpose of heavenly spirit.

text: Adiuro te ergo serpens ...
translation_en: I therefore charge you, serpent ...

text: Adesto nobis omnipotens et misericors Deus et per sacramenta quae sumpsimus nec nostris excessibus nec alienis nos permittas violari peccatis.
translation_en: Be present with us, Almighty and merciful God, and through the sacraments we have received, do not allow us to be violated by our excesses or those of others because of sins.

text: Adesto nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quos per lignum sanctae crucis pio cruore Filii tui dignatus es redimere ab omni insidiatoris digneris fraude protegere.
translation_en: Be present to us, we ask you Lord, our God, that you who were pleased to redeem us through the holy wood of the cross and the precious blood of your Son, may deign to protect us from all deceivers by fraud.

text: Adesto nobis quaesumus Domine et preces nostras benignus exaudi ut quod fiducia non habet meritorum placatio obtineat hostiarum.
translation_en: Assist us, we implore you, Lord, and graciously hear our prayers, that what faith lacks in merit, the atonement of offerings may obtain.

text: Adesto omnipotens et misericors Deus invocationibus nostris et hanc famuli tui illius oblationem propitiatus ac benignus assume ut qui non habet fiduciam nisi in misericordia tua et sanctorum tuorum suffragio quaesumus Domine per haec piae oblationis officia plenam indulgentiam atque perpetuam misericordiam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: Be present, O almighty and merciful God, to our supplications, and accept this offering of your servant. May he who has no faith but in your mercy and the intercession of your saints be granted, Lord. Through the service of these pious offerings, we humbly ask that he may merit a full indulgence and perpetual mercy.

text: Adesto plebi tuae misericors Deus et ut gratiae tuae beneficia potiora percipiat beati Michaelis archangeli fac supplicem deprecationibus sublevari.
translation_en: Assist your merciful God to your people and let the more excellent benefits of your grace be received by blessed Michael, the archangel, lift up the humble supplications.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine Iesu Christe medius inter servulos huius cenae convivii editor et illa ineffabili pietate qua olim passionis tuae tempore cenam cum discipulis convivatus panem benedicens ac frangens corporis tui sacramenta in memoriam tuis per saecula faciendum discipulis dedisti mandandum hos super sacratissimam mensam propositionum panes eadem qua tunc benedictione perlustra atque hunc vini hauriendum salutaris calicem velut illum in tempore a discipulis haustum novi testamenti tuum sanctificatione efficito sanguinem fiatque libantibus mentium indefessa custodia per quam digni stabilitatem indigni veniam gratiamque perpetuam mereantur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord Jesus Christ, be present among us. You, the mediator between the servants of this supper, who convoked and edited this feast, with that ineffable piety whereby You, at the time of Your passion, consecrated the bread and broke the sacrament of Your body for Your disciples to make it a memorial for them through the ages. We ask You to command these hosts upon the most sacred table, as You blessed and broke the loaves then, and we ask that this saving chalice be made effective with the same blessing, just as it was consumed by the disciples in the new testament. May Your sanctification make the blood flow for those who drink, granting them an unceasing guard over their minds, through which they may deserve stability, rather than what is undeserved, forgiveness, and perpetual grace.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine plebi tuae et intercessione beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui Martini confidenter tribue consequi quod sperare donasti.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present with your people. Through the intercession of the blessed priest and confessor Martin, grant us confidence to obtain what you have given us to hope for.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine plebi tuae ut quae sumpsere fideliter et mente sibi et corpore te protegente custodiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present among your people. May those who have received faithfully, both in mind and body, under your protection, keep it.

text: Adesto nobis Domine Deus noster ut quae fideliter sumpsimus et mente simul et corpore beatae Mariae intercessione custodiamus.
translation_en: Be present, O Lord our God, that we may faithfully receive and with mind and body guard what we have taken under the blessed intercession of Mary.

text: Adesto Domine populo tuo ut quae sumpsit fideliter intercessione beatorum consessorum tuorum illorum et mente et corpore sibi profutura conservet.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, to your people, so that what they have faithfully taken may be preserved for them by the intercession of your blessed apostles and saints, both in mind and body.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis ut quae sumpserunt fideliter et mente sibi et corpore beatae Mariae intercessione custodiant.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to be present for Your faithful ones, that what they have received faithfully, both in mind and body, through the intercession of the Blessed Mary, they may keep safe.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine fideli populo tuo ut quae sumpsit fideliter et mente sibi et corpore beatae Mariae intercessione custodiat.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to be present for your faithful people. May they faithfully hold what they have received with both mind and body, protected by the intercession of the blessed Mary.

text: Adesto nobis omnipotens Deus ut quae fideliter sumpsimus mente et corpore beatae Mariae piae matris et perpetuae virginis intercessione custodiamus.
translation_en: Be present with us, almighty God, so that what we have taken faithfully in mind and body from the Blessed Mary, our devout Mother and ever-virgin, may be preserved through her intercession.

text: Adesto Domine populo tuo ut quae sumpsit fideliter et mente sibi et corpore beatae Mariae semper virginis intercessione custodiat.
translation_en: Lord, be present to your people, so that they may faithfully hold and with the intercession of the blessed Mary, ever virgin, protect what they have taken.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine pro anima famuli tui illius cuius in depositione sua officium commemorationis impendimus ut si qua eum saecularis macula invasit aut vitium mundiale infecit dono tuae pietatis indulgeas et extergeas.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to be present for the soul of your servant, for whom we have imposed the duty of commemoration during his departure. We humbly entreat that if any secular stain has affected him or worldly vice infected him, you grant the pardon of your mercy and cleanse him.

text: Adesto Domine quaesumus animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum quibus in depositionis suae die officium commemorationis impendimus ut si qua eis saecularis macula inhaesit aut vitium mundiale infecit dono tuae pietatis indulgeas et abstergeas.
translation_en: Be present, Lord, we pray, to the souls of your servants and handmaids whom we have imposed with the duty of commemoration on their day of deposit. We ask that if any secular stain has adhered to them or a worldly vice has infected them, you grant the gift of your pity and wash away.

text: Oramus te Domine pro famulo tuo illo cui in depositione sua officium commemorationis agimus ut si qua eum saecularis macula invasit aut vitium mundiale infecit dono tuae pietatis indulgeas et extergeas.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, for your servant to whom we are performing the office of remembrance in his deposition, that if any secular stain has invaded him or worldly sin infected him, you may grant him forgiveness and cleanse him with the gift of your pity.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum et omnium hic quiescentium ut si quae carnales maculae in eis de terrenis contagiis inhaeserunt miserationis tuae venia deleantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present for the souls of your servants and their servants, and all those here resting. May any carnal stains clinging to them from terrestrial contagions be erased by your mercy.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris et in tua misericordia confidentes ab omni nos adversitate custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present with our petitions and, trusting in your mercy, protect us from all adversity.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris ut esse te largiente mereamur et inter prospera humiles et inter adversa securi.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, to be present with our supplications, so that we may deserve Your presence by Your generosity. May we be humble in prosperity and secure in adversity.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris ut qui ex iniquitate nostra reos nos esse cognoscimus beati Vincentii martyris tui intercessione liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to be present with our supplications. May it be that, recognizing us as guilty through our own iniquity, we are freed through the intercession of your blessed martyr Saint Vincent.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris ut qui sacramento carnis et sanguinis unigeniti tui nos satias meritis beatae Mariae Magdalenae cuius sollemnitatem recolimus et ab adversitatibus cunctis eripias et ad sempiterna gaudia nos clementer perducas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present with our supplications, that as we remember the solemnity of the blessed Mary Magdalene who was filled by the sacrament of your only-begotten Son's flesh and blood, you might free us from all adversities and gently lead us to eternal joy.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine tuae adesto familiae et dignanter impende ut quibus fidei gratiam contulisti et coronam largiaris aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to be present with Your family. Grant them dignity and generously bestow upon those whom You have given the grace of faith, an eternal crown.

text: Adesto quaesumus Domine familiae tuae et dignanter impende ut quibus fidei gratiam contulisti et coronam largiaris aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present for your family and graciously bestow upon them the eternal crown, whom you have granted the grace of faith.

text: Adesto quaesumus omnipotens Deus atque in cunctis actionibus nostris et aspirando nos praeveni et adiuvando custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to be present with us in all our actions and to anticipate and aid us, so that you may protect us.

text: Adesto quaesumus omnipotens Deus ac ieiunio corporali mentem nostram operibus tuorum refice mandatorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty God, that you attend us and through physical fasting, correct our minds according to your works and commandments.

text: Adesto Domine supplicationibus nostris et famulae tuae illi munus concede ut veniente tempore pariendi gratiae tuae praesidium suscipiat et cum prolem humanam ediderit percepto lavacro salutari gratiosis incrementis feliciter proficiat.
translation_en: Lord, be present to our supplications and grant your servant that she may receive your protection at the due time of childbirth. And with a human child born, may she grow in healthy progress through the beneficial cleansing, receiving gracious increases.

text: Adesto supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus et famulae tuae largifluae protectionis munus concede ut adveniente tempore parturiendi gratiae tuae praesidium suscipiat et proles quam ediderit percepto lavacro salutari gratiosis incrementis feliciter proficiat.
translation_en: Omnipotent God, our supplications are before you. Grant your abundant protection to your handmaiden, that at the appointed time she may receive the shelter of your grace while giving birth and that her offspring, born thereafter, may grow happily with salutary increases through the saving baptism.

text: Adesto supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus et famulam tuam illam in partu ab omni infortunio clementer praeserva ut proles eius in hanc lucem edita percepto lavacro salutari et generosae mentis virtutibus et corporis feliciter proficiat incrementis.
translation_en: O almighty God, be present to our supplications and graciously preserve your servant during childbirth from all misfortune, so that her offspring, born into this world, may perceive the saving baptism, grow in noble mental virtues, and prosper in physical health.

text: Adesto supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus et quibus fiduciam sperandae pietatis indulges consuetae misericordiae tribue benignus effectum.
translation_en: Hear our supplications, almighty God, and bestow your customary mercy upon those to whom we place our trust, with your accustomed kindness.

text: Adesto supplicationibus nostris omnipotens Deus et quod humilitatis nostrae gerendum est ministerio tuae virtutis impleatur effectu.
translation_en: Assist our supplications, Almighty God, and may the ministry of your power be fulfilled according to the humility of ours.

text: Aeternam ac iustissimam pietatem ...
translation_en: Eternal and most righteous piety...

text: Adesto supplicationibus nostris omnipotens et misericors Deus et hanc oblationem pro incolumitate famuli tui illius oblatam sanctificans tu qui es humanae fragilitatis singulare praesidium auxilii tui ostende virtutem ut ope misericordiae tuae adiutus ad omnia sanitatis reparetur officia.
translation_en: Be present to our supplications, almighty and merciful God, and sanctify this offering for the health of your servant, who is presented here. You, who are the singular protection for human frailty, show your power by bestowing help through your mercy so that he may be restored to all duties of health.

text: Aeternam ac iustissimam pietatem ...
translation_en: Eternal and most just piety...

text: Adestote Dei testes regni heredes Christi comites diabolique victores qui servorum condicione mutata amicorum familiaritate suscepta regni caelestis beatitudinem meruistis venerantibus favete supplicibus in salutem credentium potentiam meritorum sanctitatis ostendite. Nostrum est officiis probare quod colimus; vestrum obtinere suffragiis quod rogaris. Vobis proinde apud Deum intercedentibus populis donetur divina cognitio et pacis integerrima plenitudo.
translation_en: Be present, witnesses of God's kingdom, heirs of Christ, companions of the devils, victorious ones who have merited the beatitude of the heavenly realm by changing the condition of servants and receiving familiarity with friends in the kingdom of heaven. Show favor to the suppliant faithful as they come, and display the power of merits and sanctity. It is for us to prove what we worship; it is for you to obtain through prayers what you ask. Therefore, through us interceding before God, may a divine knowledge and the most integrity of peace be granted to you.

text: Adestote nunc gloriosissimi Christi testes anniversariis sacris rite solvendis et solitae dignationis intuitu inter mysteria vos dicanda miscete. Sedes enim vestra omne quod sacratum est et in omni ecclesia patrius incolatus. Peculiarem ergo a Christo domino charismatum promeriti gratiam peculiarem nobis exhibete tutelam ut hic ubi fidelium effluunt lacrimae et pro remedio murmura silenda funduntur non diu graves incumbam gemitus nec suspiria ter trahenda perstridant. Hic non longis precibus curas secludat anxius et languorem deponat infirmus. Hic daemones non totis viribus saeviant et si quando maiore furore se efferunt conflictu minore vincantur. Per vos ecclesia domini credentes omnes aut pietatis gremio ambiat aut fortitudinis robore custodiat.
translation_en:
Be present now, witnesses of the most glorious Christ, for the sacred anniversaries are rightly being fulfilled, and let your usual dignity mingle among the mysteries that you are to be declared. For indeed, your seat holds all that is sacred and in every church possesses its patriarchal dwelling.
Therefore, show us a special grace from Christ, our Lord, a special protection, that here where the tears of the faithful flow and muted groans are poured out for remedy, grave cries and repeated sighs do not long prevail. Here an anxious one does not hide himself with lengthy prayers and a sick one lays down his infirmity. Here demons do not attack with their full might and if at any time they display greater fury, they are vanquished by lesser conflict.
Through you, the church of the Lord believes all, whether they seek refuge in the bosom of piety or are guarded by the strength of fortitude.

text: Aeternum atque omnipotentem Deum ...
translation_en: The eternal and almighty God...

text: Adiuva Domine fragilitatem plebis tuae ut ad votivum magnae festivitatis effectum et corporaliter gubernata recurrat et per tuam gratiam devota mente perveniat.
translation_en: Help, Lord, the frailty of your people, that they may achieve the purpose of their vow at the great feast and, being guided physically, return to it and, through your grace, may reach it with a devoted mind.

text: Adiuva Domine fragilitatem plebis tuae ieiunii sacramento ut ad optivos paschalis celebritatis effectus et corporaliter gubernata concurrat et per tuam gratiam devota perveniat.
translation_en: Help, Lord, the frailty of your people with the sacrament of fasting, that they may be affected and participate in the joyous festivities of Easter, and, being guided physically, may arrive through your grace with devoted hearts.

text: Adiuva nos Deus salutaris noster et ad beneficia recolenda quibus nos instaurare dignatus es tribue venire gaudentes.
translation_en: Help us, O God our savior, and grant that we may come rejoicing for the good deeds wherewith thou hast deemed to restore us.

text: Altare tuo Domine superposita ...
translation_en: Your altar, Lord, set upon it...

text: Adiuva nos Deus salutaris noster et in sacrificio ieiuniorum nostras mentes purifica ut ad beneficia recolenda quibus nos instaurare dignatus es tribuas venire gaudentes.
translation_en: Help us, O God our Savior, and in the sacrifice of the fasting ones, purify our minds, so that you may grant us to come rejoicing for the benefits to be remembered, where you have deemed us worthy to restore.

text: Adiuva nos Deus salutaris noster et quibus supplicandi tibi praestas affectum tribue tuae propitiationis effectum.
translation_en: Help us, O God our Savior, and grant to those who supplicate you the effect of your propitiation.

text: Adiuva nos Deus salutaris noster ut quae collata nobis honorabiliter recensemus devotis mentibus assequamur.
translation_en: Help us, O God our Savior, that what has been granted to us we may faithfully acknowledge with devoted minds, and attain.

text: Adiuva nos Domine Deus noster beati Laurentii martyris tui precibus exoratus et animam famuli tui illius episcopi in beatitudinis sempiternae luce constitue.
translation_en: Assist us, Lord God, our God, moved by the prayers of your blessed martyr Saint Lawrence; and establish the soul of that servant of yours, his bishop, in the eternal light of beatitude.

text: Adiuva nos Domine quaesumus eorum deprecatione sanctorum qui Filium tuum humana necdum voce profitentes caelesti sunt pro eius nativitate gratia coronati.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, we beseech you, through the intercession of the saints who, though they did not yet have a human voice to sing it, were crowned with grace for His nativity in heaven.

text: Adiuva nos Domine tuorum prece sanctorum ut quorum festa gerimus sentiamus auxilium.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, with the prayers of your saints, that we who are celebrating their feast days may feel your assistance.

text: Adiuva nos Domine deprecatione sanctorum tuorum et praecipue huius beati confessoris tui illius intercessione quaesumus ab omni adversitate protege cuius hodie debitum sollemnitatis diem cum laetitia spiritali veneramur ut quorum festa gerimus sentiamus auxilium.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, through the intercession of your saints, and especially of this blessed confessor of yours. We humbly ask that you protect us from every adversity. Today we honorably celebrate the day of solemnity with spiritual joy, may we feel help as we participate in their festivities.

text: Adiuva quaesumus Domine plebem tuam et ad nativitatem unigeniti Filii tui tribue nos pariter pervenire gaudentes.
translation_en: Help us, we ask you, Lord, your people, and grant that we may joyfully arrive at the Nativity of your only-begotten Son.

text: Adiuvemur quaesumus Domine precibus beati confessoris tui Germani ut illuc pietatis tuae mereamur clementia subsequi quo ipse subvehentibus angelis igneo saeptus globo conscendit.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to help us through the prayers of your blessed confessor Germain, so that we may merit to follow in the path where he himself ascended surrounded by angels and enclosed within a fiery sphere.

text: Adiuvent nos Domine quaesumus merita et intercessiones sanctarum virginum ac martyrum tuarum Agapae Ciconiae et Hyrenae ut qui earum venerandam agimus sollemnitatem earum suffragio mereamur ab omnibus exui malis et te largiente sempiternis perfrui bonis.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, we beseech you. Grant us the merits and intercessions of your holy virgins and martyrs Agape Ciconiae and Hyrenae. That we who honor their venerable solemnity may deserve through their intercession to be freed from all evil and through your bounty enjoy eternal goods.

text: Anniversaria fratres carissimi ...
translation_en: Dear brothers in faith, on this anniversary...

text: Adiuvent nos quaesumus Domine et haec mysteria sancta quae sumpsimus et beatae Agnes intercessio veneranda.
translation_en: Aid us, we humbly ask you, Lord, and these holy mysteries that we have received, and the venerable intercession of the blessed Agnes.

text: Anniversaria fratres carissimi ...
translation_en: Dear brothers in Christ, on this anniversary...

text: Adiuvent nos quaesumus Domine merita intercessionesque sanctarum virginum martyrumque tuarum et quia earum sollemnia votivo colimus honore earum suffragio ab omnibus malis erui mereamur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the merits and intercessions of your holy virgin and martyrs may aid us. And since we celebrate their feast days with vows and honors, through their intercession, may we be worthy to be freed from all evils.

text: Adiuvent nos quaesumus Domine haec mysteria sancta quae sumpsimus et intercedente beata Otilia virgine tua a cunctis erroribus nos exuant et ad gaudia aeterna perducant.
translation_en: Assist us, we beseech You, Lord, these holy mysteries which we have received, and through the intercession of Your blessed virgin Otilia, deliver us from all errors and lead us to eternal joys.

text: Adiuvent nos quaesumus Domine sacramenta quae sumpsimus et sancti Praeiecti martyris tui intercessio gloriosa nos protegat.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, may the sacraments we have received aid us. May the glorious intercession of your holy Precursor St. John the Baptist protect us.

text: Adiuvet familiam tuam tibi Domine supplicando venerandus Andreas apostolus et pius interventor efficiatur qui tui nominis exstitit praedicator.
translation_en: May your family be helped, Lord, by the supplication of the venerable Andrew the Apostle and the pious intercessor. May he who has been a preacher of your name become effective.

text: Adiuvet nos omnipotens et misericors Deus per haec sancta quae sumpsimus beati Thomae martyris tui atque pontificis intercessio veneranda qui pro tui nominis honore glorioso meruit coronari martyrio.
translation_en: May the Almighty and merciful God help us through these holy things that we have received by the venerable intercession of your blessed martyr and bishop, Thomas, who deserved to be crowned with martyrdom for the honor of your glorious name.

text: Adiuvet nos quaesumus Domine beatae Mariae semper virginis intercessio veneranda et a cunctis periculis absolutos in tua facias pace gaudere.
translation_en: May we be helped, we humbly ask you, Lord, through the venerable intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary, ever a virgin. May you make us who are freed from all dangers rejoice in your peace.

text: Adiuvet nos quaesumus Domine clementia tua et famulus tuus per te paterna munera consecutus ad salutem gratiae tuae aeternae possit cum tuo adiutorio pervenire.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your mercy may aid us. And your servant, having succeeded in reaching salvation through your fatherly gifts, may be able to reach there with your help.

text: Adiuvet nos quaesumus Domine sanctae Mariae gloriosa intercessio cuius etiam diem quo felix eius est inchoata nativitas meminimus.
translation_en: We remember, we humbly ask, Lord, the glorious intervention of Saint Mary, on whose day her happy nativity was begun.

text: Adiuvet nos quaesumus Domine sanctum istud paschale mysterium et ut devotis hoc mentibus exsequamur obtineat.
translation_en: Help us, we ask you Lord, this holy Paschal mystery. And that with devoted minds we may perform it, let it be obtained.

text: Adsint nobis Domine patrocinia tibi grata sanctorum et quae pro illorum sollemnitate deferimus eorum commendet oratio.
translation_en: May, Lord, the patronage of saints pleasing to you be with us, and may the prayer we offer for their solemnity commend them.

text: Adsint nobis Domine quaesumus haec munera quae in honorem beati Georgii martyris tui sumpsimus; praesta quaesumus ut nobis et cunctis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that these offerings which we have taken for the honor of your blessed martyr St. George may be present to us; grant us, we pray, that they may profit us and all others for salvation.

text: Adsit Domine clementia tua muneribus suppliciter immolandis quia divinae laudis et gloriae est quod arcanis deditam semper officiis angelicam veneramur te concedente substantiam.
translation_en: Lord, may Your mercy be present with the offerings we humbly present, for it is fitting that in divine praise and glory we continually honor the angelic nature, granted through Your consent.

text: Adsit Domine fidelibus tuis sacrae benedictionis effectus qui mentes omnium spiritali vegetatione disponat ut per opera pietatis tuae muneribus impleantur.
translation_en: May the Lord be present to His faithful ones with the effects of sacred blessing, who arranges the minds of all by spiritual nourishment, so that they may be filled by the works of Your pity through Your gifts.

text: Adsit Domine misericordia tua populo sanctorum deprecatione placatus quae eum semper et purget a crimine et ab hoste defendat temporalibus pro<hi>beat adiumentis et ad sanctorum gaudia sempiterna perducat.
translation_en: May the Lord's mercy be present with the holy people, appeased by their supplication, which always cleanses him from sin and defends him against the enemy in temporal matters. May it lead them to everlasting happiness and to the joy of the saints through beatifying aids.

text: Adsit Domine quaesumus gratia tua populo supplicanti qui ad munerandum cito largiris et ad liberandum celeriter ades qui per paenitentiam contemnis delicta non usuraria largitate compensas pro meritis sed uberiora restituis quam preceris.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you, may your grace be present to the supplicating people, who you quickly bestow favor when called upon and who swiftly comes to aid. Who through penance disregards unjust deeds, compensates not according to the usurious largesse for wrongs done, but restores more than asked, according to merits.

text: Adsit Domine quaesumus propitiatio tua populo supplicanti ut quod te inspirante fideliter expetit tua celeri largitate percipiat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your propitiation be present for the supplicating people, so that what they faithfully seek with you inspiring them may receive it swiftly through your quick generosity.

text: Adsit Ecclesiae tuae Deus praeclara beati Zenonis intercessio quae et munera nostra oculis tuae maiestatis acceptabilia faciat et te nobis placabilem reddat.
translation_en: May God, with the illustrious intercession of Blessed Zenobius, make our offerings acceptable to Your Majesty's eyes and make us pleasing to You.

text: Adsit Ecclesiae tuae Domine quaesumus beatus evangelista Ioannes ut cuius perpetuus doctor exsistit semper esse non desinat suffragator.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that your blessed evangelist John be present at your church. May he, who always exists as a perpetual teacher, never cease to be an intercessor.

text: Adsit Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus Domine sanctorum martyrum desiderata iucunditas eamque maiestati tuae et pia semper intercessione conciliet et sua faciat celebritate devotam.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the delight of your holy martyrs may be present at your church. May they, through their constant and pious intercession, be united with your majesty and make it devoted through their splendid presence.

text: Adsit nobis Domine quaesumus sancta precatio beati pontificis et martyris tui Fabiani quae nos et a terrenis affectibus incessanter expediat et caelestia desiderare perficiat.
translation_en: May the Lord be present among us, we ask, holy petition of your blessed bishop and martyr Fabian, which may continually deliver us from earthly passions and fulfill our heavenly desires.

text: Adsit nobis Domine quaesumus virtus Spiritus Sancti quae et corda nostra clementer expurget et ab omnibus tueatur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, let the power of the Holy Spirit be present among us. May it gently purify our hearts and protect us from all adversities.

text: Adsit nobis Domine sancti Laurentii martyris in tua glorificatione benedictio cuius nobis est hodie facta suffragium in tua virtute confessio.
translation_en: May the blessing of Saint Lawrence, Lord, be present with us in Your glory. Today his intercession was made on our behalf through Your power and our confession.

text: Adsit nobis omnipotens Deus beatissimi pontificis tui Dunstani iugis oratio quae nos illius mysterii participatione dignos efficiat in quo totius humanae salutis summa consistit.
translation_en: Let the almighty God, your most blessed bishop Dunstan, be present with us through his prayers, that we may be deemed worthy to participate in his mystery, which comprises the highest point of all human salvation.

text: Adsit nobis quaesumus Domine Sancti tui Spiritus gratia quae efficacissimam suae pietatis consolationem nostrae adhibens fragilitati mentis nostrae tenebras sui splendoris radio illustret.
translation_en: May your Holy Spirit, we ask you, Lord, grant us his grace that shines a most powerful comfort of his piety upon our weak minds, and may the radiance of his splendor dispel the shadows within us.

text: Adsit oratio sanctorum qui per universum mundum passi sunt propter nomen tuum Domine et sanctorum apostolorum martyrum ac virginum et sanctorum comitum eorum quaesumus Domine et nos protege et viam nostram in salutis tuae prosperitate dispone ut inter omnes vitae huius varietates tuo semper protegamur auxilio et famulis ac famulabus tuis qui nobis fecerunt eleemosynam et in orationibus nostris se commendaverunt vel qui mihi confessi fuerunt quorum nomina ante sacrum altare tuum scripta adesse videntur porrige eis dexteram caelestis auxilii ut et te toto corde perquirant et quae digne postulant assequantur et animabus omnium fidelium catholicorum orthodoxorum quibus donasti baptismi sacramentum in regione sanctorum iubeas dari eis consortium et plenitudinem gaudiorum.
translation_en: May the prayer of the saints who suffered throughout the whole world for your name, Lord, be present. We beseech you, Lord, to protect us and arrange our path in the prosperity of your salvation. That we may always be protected by your aid among all the variations of this life, and that your servants and those who serve you may obtain favor from us, since they have done charity towards us and have committed themselves to our prayers, or have confessed themselves to me, whose names appear written before your sacred altar. Grant them the right hand of celestial aid so that they may seek you with all their heart and attain what is worthy of request. And for the souls of all Catholic and Orthodox faithful to whom you have given the sacrament of baptism in the region of saints, grant them fellowship and fullness of joy.

text: Adsit petimus clementissime Deus huic familiae tuae miserationis propitiatio et beati confessoris tui atque abbatis Mauri intercessione haec sancta quae indigni sumpsimus ad salutem esse concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask, most merciful God, that Your clemency's provision of mercy and the intercession of Your blessed confessor and abbot Maur may cause what we unworthily have received to be granted for our salvation.

text: Adsit plebi tuae omnipotens Deus beatae martyris tuae illius supplicatio ut cuius gaudet honore protegatur auxilio.
translation_en: May Almighty God, the blessed martyr of yours, be present to your people. May His aid protect him who rejoices in his honor through his intercession.

text: Adspira Domine offerentium votis propitius et requiem defunctis concede benignus.
translation_en: Breathe upon, Lord, the offering of those who pray to You graciously, and grant rest to the departed kindly.

text: Adsunt Domine Deus dies illi quos colendos nobis documento tui exempli sub quadragenaria ieiunii decursione signasti; proinde tuam pietatem poscimus et rogamus ut hodiernae sollemnitatis sacrificio delibutus largiaris supplicantibus famulis spiritalis alimoniae cibum et tuae sermocinationis edulium quo ad instar prophetae tui Eliae huius sacrificii libatione muniti ita a crastino laboriosa divinae institutionis salubriter expediamus ieiunia ut sermocinationis tuae mereamur potiri loquela.
translation_en: Lord God, those days which your document and example under the forty-day Lenten journey have marked for us to be revered, we implore and ask that you, having been appeased by today's solemnity's sacrifice, bestow upon our supplicating spiritual servants the food of sustenance and the morsels of your discourse. May we who are armed with this sacrifice's libation like your prophet Elijah, prosperously pass through tomorrow's laborious divine institution, making our Lenten fast healthy, so that we may deserve to receive the words of your discourse.
