text: Adveniat quaesumus Domine misericordia sperata supplicibus et eisdem caelestis munificentia tribuatur qua et recte poscenda cognoscant et postulata percipiant.
translation_en: Let us pray, Lord, that your mercifulness come to those who hope in you and may they receive the same from heavenly bounty; so that they may know what is right to ask for, and receive what they ask.

text: Aeternae pignus vitae capientes humiliter imploramus ut apostolicis fulti patrociniis quod in imagine gerimus sacramenti manifesta perceptione sumamus.
translation_en: We humbly beseech the pledge of eternal life, that filled with the patronage of the apostles, what we bear in the image of the sacrament, we may fully perceive with manifest understanding.

text: Aeterne et inaestimabilis Deus summe in quo beatissima famula tua Natalia vehementi gaudio exsultavit cum sibi coniunctum beatissimum Adrianum ad te conversum tota fidei devotione cognovit tu nos in te credentes ac de te sperantes utrorumque precibus salva utrorumque etiam et suffragatione iustifica.  Ille nos exemplo suo fortiores efficiat haec et curandos regat et curatos tibi exhibeat; per illum torpens ad virtutes animus excitetur per hanc vulnerum abdita medeantur; suscitandos ille suscipiat quos visitandos ista custodiat; ille curatis gloriam haec curandis adhibeat medicinam; colligat ille quos ista non reprobet curetque ista quos ille glorificet quo per utrosque sic curandis adhibeatur salvatio ut curatis donetur aeternae gloriae plenitudo.
translation_en:
Eternally and inestimably, O God most high, in whom your blessed handmaid Natalia rejoiced with fervent joy upon herself united to the most blessed Adrian who turned to you with entire devotion of faith. May we who believe in you and hope for you be saved by their prayers, and may they also justify us through their intercession.
May He make us stronger by His example who shall rule over us and present those healed to You; through Him may the spirit be stirred up towards virtues, and hidden wounds be healed. May He receive those who must be raised up, whom these shall watch over; may He apply medicine to those being cured, may He gather those whom these do not reject, and may He care for those whom He glorifies.
May the glory of the healed be applied to the curing process through Him; may He collect those who will be cared for, and may He nurture those whom He shall glorify, so that through both of them salvation may be applied in the healing process, and eternal glory may be given to those being healed.

text: Aeterne Dei Filius cuius incarnationis mysterium et peccatoribus ad veniam et sanctis profuit ad coronam tu offerentium solita pietate suscipe vota quo cum illis mereamur in futura regione partem habere qui te pro nostra olim venisse credendo salute martyriali sunt proprio consecrati ex sanguine ut qui incarnationis tuae gloria dedicamur sanctis tuis apud te intercedentibus pro quiete exaudiri defunctorum fidelium mereamur.
translation_en: Eternal Son of God, whose incarnation mystery benefits both penitents for forgiveness and saints for a crown. Accept the vows of those offering them with your usual piety, so that with them we may deserve to share in the future realm who believed that you came for our salvation through martyrdom and were consecrated by your own blood. May those dedicated to your incarnation's glory intercede for us, so that we may merit to have our prayers heard for the peace of deceased faithful believers.

text: Aeterne Dei Filius qui pro nobis mortem excipiens crucis vivus tertia die resurrexisti a mortuis placatus suscipe haec apposita tibi paschalium sacrificiorum libamina; haec tibi et offerentium devotionem et sepultorum spiritus obnoxie commendent quo per resurrectionis tuae victoriam et in viventibus mors vitiorum intereat et in defunctis poenalis combustio evanescat.
translation_en: Eternal Son of God, who for us took up death on the cross and rose alive on the third day, appeased after your resurrection, receive these offerings of the paschal sacrifices laid before you; these offerings and the devotion of those offering them, as well as the spirits of the buried, commend to you that through the victory of your resurrection may death of sin vanish in the living and the punishing fire disappear in the departed.

text: Aeterne Dei Filius qui virgineae matris uterum sic intrasti ne rumperes sic aperuisti ne signata ullo modo violares suscipe benignus hoc sacrificium quod tibi ob incarnationis tuae dedicamus mysterium tribuens per hoc et vivis animae corporisque salutem et defunctis aeternae repausationis felicitatem.
translation_en: Eternal Son of God, who hast entered the womb of the Virgin Mother without bursting it, and hast opened it without in any way violating it; graciously receive this sacrifice that we dedicate to You on account of Your incarnation. Bestowing through this both salvation for souls and bodies, and eternal rest for the departed.

text: Aeterne Deus omnipotens qui ullis absque praecedentibus meritis vocas ad te peccatores ac tuos misericorditer ditas famulos tu nobis hunc testem tuum beatissimum Pelagium proroga patronum qui pro te sanguine fuso incomparabile meruit pervenire ad praemium. Habeat te concedente fidelis curam gregis qui supplicium non renuit subire passionis atque perfido qui veritatem non tacuit regi nomine solum modo glorians unigeniti tui. Indefesse pro nobis intercessor accedat tibi ut inter aerumnas saeculi careamus vitiis nullisque inhaereamus deceptionum illecebris sicque per hunc martyrem tuum te dominum habeamus propitium quo offerentium fructus multiplices et uberes frugum redditus efficere solita pietate digneris. Nullis igitur a te praecipitemur lapsibus nullis evocemur scandalis qui propriis emergere a pedoribus nequimus omnino viribus. Quapropter te rogamus esse nobis placidum qui nos ad tuam fecisti imaginem et per baptismatis reformasti tinctionem.
translation_en: Eternal God almighty, who calls sinners to yourself without any preceding merits, we beseech you to prolong the patronage of your most blessed servant Pelagius, who by shedding his blood incomparably merited to reach the reward. May the faithful caretaker of the flock, who does not refuse to suffer the passion and does not conceal the truth under the king's name alone, but only glorifies your unique son, have you conceding. May an unceasing intercessor approach you on our behalf so that we may avoid the troubles of this world without any vices or clinging to deceptions. Through your martyr Pelagius, may we have you gracious, whom we pray will deign to make the offerings of many and abundant fruits and the returns of harvests effective with your usual piety. Therefore, let us not be cast down from you by any fall, nor be called forth by any scandal, which we cannot rise from on our own strength. Wherefore, we beseech you to be gentle towards us, who have made us in your image and reformed us through the cleansing of baptism.

text: Aeterne Deus summe adclines clementiam exoramus divinitatis tuae ut qui hodie inter angelorum florentissimas legiones prophetarum fulgentissimos fasces inter apostolorum titulos latiores martyrum virginumque catervas dicatas gloriosam virginem assumpsisti Mariam per unigenitum tuum filiumque suum Dominum nostrum ad superam et inenarrabilem caeli sedem quo nemo hominum creditur assumptus nullusque praeter illam attolli noscitur sexus dum non sola merito ibidem pervenire potuit nisi quod sola virgo post parturitionem mansit solaque caeli ac terrae dominum divinitus parturit et Deum caro factum ineffabiliter vehit ... Te quaesumus te rogamus ut sicut illam tanti incircumscripti muneris fecisti dominam ita facias Ecclesiam tuam per universum orbem diffusam te Deo praesule omnium contra eam venientium respuere pravitatem nesciens in religione casum abdicans in conversatione deliquium. Sit quaesumus Domine in regibus gloriosa in clericis dedicata in ministris sancta in martyribus prompta in virginibus illibata in continentibus fecunda in pauperibus affluens in pupillis exuberans in captivis et vinctis clemens in viduis continens in oppressis relevans desperatis solamen impertiens in lascivis refrenans in luxuriosis evacuans in obstinatis hebetans in desperatis pia in viventibus magistra in fidelibus defunctis requies exoptata.
translation_en:
Eternal God, highest in majesty, we humbly entreat your clemency. We ask that you, who today are named among the most radiant legions of angels, the most brilliant bundles of prophets, the loftiest titles of apostles, the chosen flocks of martyrs and virgins, have assumed the glorious Virgin Mary through your only begotten Son and Lord. No one is believed to have been assumed except her, and no one is known to have risen above her sex, unless it was that she alone, the virgin, remained after childbirth and solely delivered heaven and earth their divine Lord, and carried God in flesh ineffably.
We ask you, we entreat you, that just as you made her of such great and boundless dignity a lady, so may you make your Church throughout the whole world, spread out under your guidance, to reject all wickedness coming against it, without knowing their fall in religion or their transgression in conduct.
May she be glorious among kings, dedicated among clergy, holy among ministers, prompt among martyrs, uncorrupted among virgins, fruitful among the continent, abundant among the poor, exuberant among her children, merciful among captives and prisoners, comforting among widows, lifting up the oppressed, a solace to the desperate, restraining the lascivious, evacuating the luxurious, softening the obstinate, pious among the despairing, a teacher among the living, a rest desired by the faithful departed.

text: Aeterne omnipotens Deus qui beatum Ambrosium tui nominis confessorem non solum huic ecclesiae sed omnibus per mundum diffusis ecclesiis doctorem dedisti praesta ut quod ille divino affatus spiritu docuit nostris iugiter stabiliatur in cordibus et quem patronum te donante amplectimur eum apud tuam misericordiam defensorem habeamus.
translation_en: Eternally omnipotent God, who gave the blessed Ambrose, confessor of your name, not only to this church but to all churches scattered throughout the world as a teacher, grant that what he taught with the divine inspired spirit may always be established in our hearts. May we embrace him as a patron whom you have given us, and may we have him as a defender before your mercy.

text: Aeterne omnipotens Deus qui magno pietatis auxilio populo tuo sanctorum precibus prospera largiri dignaris concede propitius beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Nazarii et Celsi gloriosae passionis victoriam celebrare laetantes et quos te donante patronos defensoresque amplectimur hos apud tuam misericordiam propacatores habeamus.
translation_en: Eternally omnipotent God, who with great aid of piety have favored your people with prosperity through the prayers of the saints, grant us graciously and propitiously. Celebrate the glorious victory of your blessed martyrs Nazarius and Celsus in their glorious passion, and whom you have given as patrons and defenders, let us hold them as intercessors before your mercy.

text: Aeterne omnipotens Deus qui universam in principio creaturam verbo cooperante ex nihilo condidisti quique angelicam substantiam splendore conspicuo potentialiter adornasti te supplices quaesumus et oramus ut hac sollemnitate quam sub tui nominis invocatione in honorem archangeli Michaelis celebramus nostras preces exaudire digneris.
translation_en: Eternally almighty God, who created the entire creation at the beginning by cooperating with your word out of nothing, and who adorned angelic substance with a conspicuous splendor, we humbly ask and pray that you deign to hear our prayers on this solemnity which we celebrate under your name in honor of the archangel Michael. May you graciously listen to our pleas.

text: Aeternum te dominum et indeficiens bonum adclines servi tui humiliter obsecramus ut qui et beatitudinem fidelibus et remissionem delinquentibus non nisi intra sanctam ecclesiam conferri posse sanxisti des et viventibus in ea sine lapsu consistere et defunctis per eius supplicationem a debitis suppliciis liberari ut et viventium te lingua simul et vita glorificet et defunctorum requies aeterna exsultatione concelebret.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, eternal Lord and boundless good, that the beatitude and forgiveness you have decreed can only be conferred within the holy church for the faithful and the penitent. May those who live in it remain without falling away. For the departed, through your supplication, may they be freed from their due punishments. May both the living glorify you with their speech and life, and the departed find eternal rest with exultation.

text: Afflictionem familiae tuae quaesumus Domine intende placatus ut indulta venia peccatorum de tuis semper beneficiis gloriemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to direct your attention towards the affliction of your family. May you be pleased to grant us pardon for our sins from your eternal blessings, that we may always glory in them.

text: Afflictionem famulorum tuorum Domine illorum propitius respice ut indulta venia peccatorum de tuis semper consolationibus glorientur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your servants. May they find favorable grace to rejoice in the forgiveness of their sins from your constant comforts.

text: Audi maledicte satanas ...
translation_en: Hear, accursed Satan...

text: Agamus omnipotenti Deo gratias quia refecit nos pane caelesti et poculo spiritali sperantes ab eius benigna clementia ut per effusionem Spiritus Sancti sui in quibus cibi caelestis virtus introivit sinceritatis gratia perseveret.
translation_en: Let us give thanks to the almighty God, for He has restored us with bread from heaven and a spiritual drink, hoping through His benign kindness that by the outpouring of the Holy Spirit in us, the celestial grace of sincerity may persevere.

text: Agnoscentes Domine quid laudis sanctis tuis dederis quidve virtutis illos auctores rogamus ad veniam quos tibi familiares scimus ad gloriam; illis indulgentiam credimus ex supplicii poena quibus te novimus ex hostibus indulsisse victoriam.  Illos sequimur pro misericordia qui te secuti sunt pro corona ut per ipsos recipias intercessionis officium per quos insinuas devotionis exemplum; ut non punias reos dum repudias advocatos; ut peccatoribus parcas dum martyribus nihil excusas; ut indulgentiam largiaris in perditis dum amicitiam impertiris in sanctis; ut intercessio fortes habeat ad patrocinium quos confessio fideles habuit ad triumphum.
translation_en:
Acknowledging, Lord, what praise and what power You have given to Your saints, we ask for pardon for those whom We know to be Your family members, to Your glory. We believe that they receive indulgence from the penalty of their suffering, which We know You have shown mercy to Your enemies in victory.
We follow them out of mercy, who followed You for a crown, so that through them You may receive the office of intercession, through whom You introduce the example of devotion; so that You do not punish the guilty while rejecting their advocates; so that You show mercy to sinners while making no excuses for martyrs; so that You grant indulgence to the lost while bestowing friendship on the saints; so that a strong intercession may have for patronage those whom faith has had as confessions for triumph.

text: Agnus Dei qui tollis peccatum mundi respice in nos et miserere nobis factus ipse hostia qui sacerdos ipse praemium qui redemptor a malis omnibus quos redemisti custodi.
translation_en: Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world, have mercy on us. You yourself were made the sacrifice; You, the priest, Yourself the reward; You, the Redeemer from all evils, whom you have redeemed, guard us.

text: Alimonia caelesti potuque spirituali recreati tuam Deus pater obsecramus pietatem ut per eandem quam hodierna die sanctae imaginis Christi Filii tui veneramur passionem cunctorum a te mereamur consequi veniam delictorum.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, our God and Father, that through the same reverence we pay today to the holy image of your Son, Christ, we may merit through his passion to receive eternal life and forgiveness for our sins.

text: Altare tuum Domine manus tuae consecratione sanctifica teque ipsum mentibus nostris laetitiae et gratiae spe resurrectionis ostende. Omnibus tibi servientibus vota quae acceptare digneris inspirando largire. Populum tuum placabilis respice atque ad partem gratiae salutaris admitte. Confitentibus parce laetantibus fave ac tristes per indulgentiam consolare.
translation_en: Your altar, Lord, may your hands consecrate and sanctify; may our minds be filled with joy and grace, and the hope of resurrection be shown. To all who serve you, grant what vows you deem worthy to accept, and inspire us to give generously. Regard favorably your people, and admit them to the part of salutary grace. Be merciful to those who confess, favor those who rejoice, and console those who are sorrowful through indulgence.

text: Altare tuum Domine Deus muneribus cumulamus oblatis; da quaesumus ut ad salutem nostram sanctorum tuorum precatione proficiant quorum sollemnia ventura praecurrimus.
translation_en: We pile gifts upon your altar, Lord God; grant us that we may progress towards our salvation through the intercession of your saints, whose feasts we anticipate in advance.

text: Altari tuo Domine devotionis nostrae supplices imponimus hostias quas in honorem almi confessoris et antistitis tui Syri devota mente celebrantes nobis ad perpetuam proficere sentiamus salutem.
translation_en: In your altar, Lord, we humbly offer the sacrifices which, with a devoted mind, we celebrate in honor of your holy confessor and bishop of Syria. May we feel that they bring us eternal salvation.

text: Altari tuo Domine superposita munera Spiritus Sanctus benignus assumat qui hodie beatae Mariae viscera splendoribus suae virtutis replevit.
translation_en: Upon your altar, Lord, may the benevolent Holy Spirit accept the offerings. Today, he filled the splendors of his divine power into the womb of the blessed Mary.

text: Altaria haec Domine quae sacrificiis caelestibus inchoando reverenter aptamus concede quaesumus ut et grata semper oculis tuae maiestatis appareant et salutaria fieri populis christianis beatus ille martyr per quem tibi dicantur obtineat.
translation_en: Lord, these altars which we reverently prepare for heavenly sacrifices, we humbly ask that you grant them to always appear pleasing to the eyes of your majesty and to become beneficial for the Christian people. May the blessed martyr through whom they say are offered to you be present.

text: Aufer a nobis quaesumus Domine pravitates ...
translation_en: Take away from us, we ask you, Lord, our faults...

text: Altaria tua Domine mysticis muneribus cumulamus maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecantes ut ipsius adiuvantibus meritis carere mereamur cunctis contagiis.
translation_en: We heap your altars, Lord, with mystical offerings, humbly entreating your majesty that, aided by his merits, we may deserve to be free from all contagions.

text: Altaria tua Domine quaesumus donis caelestibus firmentur sanctique Iuliani pontificis meritis suffragantibus haec sancta commercia sanctificentur et divina inspiratione ditentur ac Sancti Spiritus innovatione ad nostram salutem animarum vegetentur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your altars be inflamed with celestial gifts, through the merits of Saint Juliano, Bishop, may these holy transactions be sanctified and guided by divine inspiration, and may they flourish through the renewal of the Holy Spirit for the salvation of our souls.

text: Altaria tua Domine veneranda cum hostiis accedentes ac quaesumus ut indulgentiam nobis tribuant et fidei devotionem ipsius meritis cuius celebramus festivitatem.
translation_en: Your honorable altars, Lord, approach with offerings, and we ask that you grant us indulgence and devotion to the faith because of whose merits we celebrate this festival.

text: Altaribus tuis Domine munera nostrae servitutis inferimus quae placatus accipiens et acceptum tibi nostrum quaesumus famulatum et sacramentum nostrae redemptionis efficias.
translation_en: To your altars, Lord, we bring the gifts of our servitude. Accepting them as you are pleased, and making us who are accepted pleasing to you, we ask that you make us servants and that you effect the sacrament of our redemption.

text: Altaribus tuis Domine munera pro commemoratione sancti Prisci martyris tui gratanter offerimus precantes ut ipso intercedente haec eadem nobis ad caelestia promerenda proficiant.
translation_en: To your altars, Lord, we gratefully offer gifts for the commemoration of Saint Priscus, your martyr; praying that through his intercession these same things may profit us for meriting heavenly rewards.

text: Altaribus tuis Domine munera terrena gratanter pro commemoratione sancti Germani confessoris tui atque pontificis offerimus ut ipso pro nobis intercedente a nexibus criminum liberati tibi placere valeamus.
translation_en: To your altars, Lord, we gratefully offer earthly gifts in commemoration of Saint Germanus, your confessor and bishop, that through his intercession, we may be freed from the bonds of sin and be pleasing to you.

text: Altaribus tuis Domine munera terrena gratanter offerimus ut caelestia consequamur; damus temporalia ut sumamus aeterna.
translation_en: Lord, we gratefully offer earthly gifts to Your altars so that we may attain heavenly ones; we give temporal things so that we may obtain eternal ones.

text: Amator et conservator sanctorum omnipotens Pater ecce super altare tuum in honorem sanctorum apostolorum Simonis et Iudae panis ac vini ab unigenito tuo domino nostro holocausta instituta proponimus eaque Sancti Spiritus rore perfunde deposcimus; dignetur quaesumus super illa illabi Spiritus Sanctus; dignetur illa sanctificata suscipere illorum institutor tuus unigenitus filius ut quotquot ex illis libaverimus non pro praesumptione sustineamus vindictam sed pro voto perfrui mereamur coronam qualiter Christi Domini nostri Filii tui perceptis sacrificiis communicantes ad conspectum gloriae tuae perveniamus indemnes.
translation_en: Almighty Father, protector and lover of the saints, behold upon Your altar, in honor of the apostles Simon and Jude, the bread and wine instituted by Your only-begotten Son, our Lord, as a holocaust. We ask that these may be anointed with the dew of the Holy Spirit; may the Holy Spirit descend upon them, we pray. May your only-begotten Son, their author, deign to partake of those consecrated, so that we, who have been redeemed from them, may not suffer punishment but rather merit a crown, as we share in the perceived sacrifices of Your Christ, our Lord's Son, and reach the sight of Your glory unstained.

text: Amove a nobis quaesumus Domine totius maculas simultatis ut dum purae dilectionis deliciis mens pascitur expiata tuae ubertatis repleta dulcedine nec indigentiam attenuatio corporis sentiat nec defectum.
translation_en: Move from us, we beseech You, Lord, all stains of guilt so that while the mind is fed with the delight of pure affection, it may be filled with the abundance of Your grace and taste no want or weakness.

text: Auribus percipe quaesumus Domine verba ...
translation_en: Receive our prayers, we ask you Lord, the words...

text: Angelico pane ne deficiamus in hoc peregrinationis itinere quaesumus Domine ut sancti confessoris tui Leufredi meritis eodem mereamur in caelestis patriae gloria perenniter salutari.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that with the help of the angelic bread, we do not fail on this pilgrimage's journey. May we also deserve eternal salvation in the heavenly fatherland's glory through the merits of your saint confessor Leufred, in the celestial realm.

text: Auxiliante Domino Deo ...
translation_en: With the help of the Lord God ...

text: Anima mea Domine tibi digna sit et sanctis tuis placita et angelis tuis recipienda et in lumine claritatis reddita sit et in conspectu tuo firmata consistat.
translation_en: My soul, Lord, may be worthy for You and Your saints, and may be received by Your angels. May it be restored to the light of clarity and may stand firmly in Your sight.

text: Animabus quaesumus Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum illorum oratio proficiat supplicantium ut eas et a peccatis exuas et tuae redemptionis facias esse participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for the souls of your servants and theirs, may their prayer be helpful. May they, through the entreaties of the supplicating, be freed from sins and partakers of your redemption.

text: Animabus quaesumus Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum misericordiam concede perpetuam ut eis proficiat in aeternum quod in te speraverunt et crediderunt.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant the souls of your servants and handmaids your perpetual mercy, so that what they hoped for in you and believed may be of eternal benefit to them.

text: Animae famuli tui quaesumus Domine per haec sacrificia redemptionis aeternae remissionem tribue peccatorum ut devotio paenitentiae quam gessit eius affectus perpetuae salutis consequatur effectum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through these sacrifices of eternal redemption, grant the remission of sins. May the devotion and penance he has shown result in the effect of eternal salvation.

text: Animae nostrae quaesumus omnipotens Deus hoc potiantur desiderio ut a tuo spiritu inflammentur et sicut lampades divino munere satiati ante conspectum venientis Christi Filii tui velut clara lumina fulgeamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that our souls may be strengthened by your Spirit, so that satisfied by the divine gift, we may shine before the coming of your Son, Christ, like bright lights.

text: Animam famuli tui illius quaesumus Domine ab omnibus vitiis et peccatis condicionis humanae haec absolvat oblatio quae totius mundi tulit immolata peccatum.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, the soul of your servant may that man be freed from all vices and sins of human condition. May this offering, which was borne as a sacrifice for the whole world, cleanse him.

text: Annua martyrum tuorum Domine vota recurrimus maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecantes ut cum temporalibus incrementis prosperitatis aeternae capiamus augmentum.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, to renew our vows to Your martyrs. Grant us an increase in eternal blessings along with the temporal growth of prosperity.

text: Annuae festivitatis cultu Domino Deo nostro fratres dilectissimi summa nostrarum precum supplicatione poscamus ut quicumque intra templi huius cuius natalis est hodie ambitum continemur plena illi atque perfecta corporis et animae devotione placeamus ut dum haec praesentia vota reddimus ad aeterna praemia venire mereamur.
translation_en: On this annual festivity, we humbly ask our dearest brothers in the cult of our Lord God, that whomever is surrounded by the walls of this temple whose feast day it is today, may be contained by us full and complete in body and soul, devoted devotion. May it be so that as we make these vows in his presence, we may deserve eternal rewards.

text: Annuae festivitatis cultu supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quicumque intra templi huius cuius natalis est hodie ambitum continemur plena tibi atque perfecta corporis et animae devotione placeamus ut dum haec praesentia vota reddimus ad aeterna praemia pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: On this day, we humbly beseech you, Lord, during the annual festivity within this temple, that those who are enclosed within its walls may be kept in full and complete devotion of body and soul. May we please you as we offer our vows during this presence, so that we may deserve to attain eternal rewards.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine precibus nostris ut quicumque intra templi huius cuius anniversarium dedicationis diem celebramus ambitum continemur plena tibi atque perfecta corporis et animae devotione placeamus ut dum haec praesentia vota reddimus ad aeterna praemia te adiuvante (per)venire mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our prayers be answered, so that whoever within this temple's walls celebrates the day of its dedication may be contained within its bounds with a full and perfect devotion of body and soul. May we please you as we offer these present vows in the hope that, with your assistance (through), we may deserve to attain eternal rewards.

text: Annue Domine precibus nostris ut sicut de praeteritis ad nova sumus sacramenta translati ita vetustate deposita sanctificatis mentibus innovemur.
translation_en: Lord, answer our prayers, so that just as we have been translated into new sacraments from the past, may we also be renewed in our old age with sanctified minds.

text: Annue Domine quaesumus ut mysteriis tuis iugiter repleamur et sanctorum semper muniamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you, let us always be filled with your mysteries and protected by the aid of saints.

text: Annue misericors Deus ut hostias placationis et laudis sincero tibi deferamus obsequio.
translation_en: Answer gracious God, so that we may offer to you with sincere devotion the sacrifices of propitiation and praise.

text: Annue misericors Deus ut qui divina praecepta violando a paradisi felicitate decidimus ad aeternae beatitudinis redeamus accessum per tuorum custodiam mandatorum.
translation_en: Grant, merciful God, that we who by breaking the divine commandments have fallen from the happiness of Paradise, may regain access to the beatitude of eternity through Your protection and guardianship of Your commands.

text: Annue nobis Domine ut anima famuli tui illius remissionem quam semper optavit mereatur percipere peccatorum.
translation_en: Grant us, O Lord, that the soul of your servant may deserve to receive the remission of sins which it always desired.

text: Annue nobis Domine ut animae famuli tui Gregorii haec prosit oblatio quam immolando totius mundi tribuisti relaxari delicta.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the offering of your servant Gregory may be pleasing to you, which you have granted to be offered for the whole world to obtain forgiveness of sins.

text: Annue nobis quaesumus Domine ut quemadmodum mysteria resurrectionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi sollemnia colimus ita et in adventu eius gaudere cum sanctis omnibus mereamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, that just as we celebrate the mysteries of the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ with solemnity, so too may we deserve to rejoice in his coming along with all the saints.

text: Baptizo te in nomine Patris ...
translation_en: I baptize you in the name of the Father...

text: Annue nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati levitae et martyris tui Laurentii veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant us, we entreat you, almighty God, that the venerable festival and devotion of your blessed Levite and Martyr Laurence may increase among us and bring us salvation.

text: Annue nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum Macchabaeorum sed et sacerdotis et confessoris tui Eusebii suffragiis adiuvemur ut sicut eis copiosa victoria dedit triumphum ita et nobis continuum praestet auxilium.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that with the aid of Your holy martyrs, the Maccabees, and also Your priest and confessor, Eusebius, we may be helped, so that as they were given abundant victory in their struggle, You may grant us continuous help.

text: Annue nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut scrutantibus magis hodie latenter est cognitus Dominus noster Iesus Christus et adoratus a cunctis gentibus ita et nostris sensibus manifestus adveniat et omni homini innotescat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that just as today our Lord Jesus Christ is more hiddenly known to those who seek him, and is worshipped by all nations, so may he be made manifest to our senses, and become known to every man.

text: Annue plebi tuae virtutum largitor omnipotens aeterne Deus ut qui annua beatae virginis tuae Petronillae sollemnia celebramus eius semper et fidei integritate roboremur et piis apud te precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Answer, O Almighty God eternal, our people's giver of virtues, that we who celebrate the annual feast of your blessed virgin Petronilla may always be strengthened by her integrity and be helped by our pious prayers before you.

text: Annue quaesumus clementissime Deus orationibus populi tui et quos in celebritate beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Mauritii vel eius commilitonum adesse fecisti eorum propitius precibus aeterna perfrui beatitudine concedas.
translation_en: We humbly entreat you, most merciful God, to accept the prayers of your people and those whom you brought to attend in the celebration of your blessed martyrs Mauritius or his companions. May they, through their propitious prayers, be granted eternal beatitude.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per hoc tuae sapientiae sacramentum circumspecta moderatione vivamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that through this Your wisdom's sacred rite, we may live with careful moderation.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine precibus familiae tuae et quod nostris actibus non meremur sanctorum tuorum nobis concede suffragiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to favor the prayers of your family and grant us the intercession of your saints for actions we may not deserve.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine precibus nostris ut sancti Laurentii martyris tui sollemnia quae cultu tibi debito praevenimus prospero suscipiamus effectu.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our prayers be accepted by you, so that the solemnity of your martyr St. Lawrence, which we approach with due worship, may be received with a favorable outcome.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine sacris martyribus tuis ut opem nobis suae deprecationis impendant et iram tuam quam nostris pravitatibus meruimus evadamus.
translation_en: We entreat you, Lord, to favor your holy martyrs, that they may intercede on our behalf and deliver us from the wrath we have deserved for our wickedness.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine supplicibus tuis ut haec nostrae servitutis oblatio in die resurrectionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi et salutem nobis conferat et pacem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to favor our supplications, that this offering of our service on the day of the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ may bring us salvation and peace.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine ut et tuis semper sollemnitatibus occupemur et mysteriis eorum mente pariter congruamus et corpore.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that we may always be occupied with your solemnities and that our mind and body may concur in the mysteries of them.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine ut merita tibi placita sancti confessoris et episcopi tui Iuvenalis pro gregibus quos sincero ministerio gubernavit pietatem tuam semper exorent.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, that the merits of your saintly confessor and bishop Juvenal may always evoke your mercy for the flocks which he guided with sincere ministry.

text: Annue quaesumus Domine ut sanctae martyris Euphemiae tibi placitis deprecationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that we may be helped by your pleasing to the holy martyr Euphemia.

text: Annue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut haec sacrificia populi tui quae tibi offerimus interveniente suffragio beatae virginis et martyris tuae illius donis caelestibus propitiatus immisceas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that these sacrifices of your people which we offer are mingled with the intercession of the blessed virgin and martyr, through whose heavenly gifts you may be appeased.

text: Annue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacrificia pro sanctae illius virginis tuae festivitate oblata desiderium nos temporale doceant habere contemptui et ambire dona faciant caelestium gaudiorum.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that the sacrifices offered for the feast of your holy virgin may teach us to have contempt for temporal things and make us strive for the joys of heaven.

text: Annue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nos sanctorum martyrum tuorum Mauritii Exuperii Candidi Victoris Innocentii et Vitalis ac sociorum eorundem laetificet festiva sollemnitas ut quorum suffragiis nitimur nataliciis gloriemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to make us joyful on this festival day with the happy feast of your saints Martyrs Mauritius, Exuperius, Candidus, Victoris, Innocentius and Vitalis, and their companions, that we may rejoice in their intercession as we celebrate their natalities.

text: Annue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacramentorum tuorum gesta recolentes et temporali securitate relevemur et erudiamur legalibus institutis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we remember the deeds of your sacraments, we may be relieved by temporal security and educated in lawful teachings.

text: Annue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beatus levita et martyr tuus Laurentius ignium globos te protegente evasit ita fidelis populus huius adversitatem saeculi te auxiliante evadat.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that just as your blessed deacon and martyr, Lawrence, escaped the flames with Your protection, so may the faithful people of this age escape their adversity with Your assistance.

text: Annue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut eos quorum natalicia recensemus per tuam gratiam beneplacitos fecit aetas exitu sic nos tuae pietati salutaris humilitas praestet acceptos.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that as you have graciously made the ages beneficial for those whose natal days we commemorate, so too may a humble submission to your mercy make us acceptable to your pity.

text: Annue precibus nostris omnipotens Deus et has oblationes quas tibi pro anniversaria huius templi consecratione deferimus benignus assume et praesta ut omnibus hic ad te concurrentibus cunctorum tribuatur remissio peccatorum.
translation_en: Answer our prayers, almighty God, and graciously accept these offerings that we bring to you on the anniversary of this temple's dedication. Grant that for all who come here to you, forgiveness of sins may be given.

text: Annue rector opem vultuque adverte secundo quae damus accipiens quae poscimus rependens et quamvis trepidet proprio mens tacta reatu vel sacra reddentes commendet causa redemptos hoc speciale bonum tribuens ut corde fideli vivamus domino moriamur crimine mundo.
translation_en: Greet the leader with open arms and pay attention to him with a second face, as we give and receive what we ask for. Repaying and even if his mind is troubled by guilt or sacred matters, let him commend the cause of the redeemed. Granting this special good, may we live faithfully to the Lord, die without sin in the world.

text: Annue tuis famulis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beato confessori tuo Benedicto aquam de rupis largitus es vertice ita nobis eius suffragantibus meritis supernae largiaris misericordiae fontem.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, to grant your servants that, as you granted the blessed confessor Benedict a spring of water from the rock at his head, so through his merits you may pour out for us the fountain of your divine mercy.

text: Ante conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae Domine hoc divinum munus supplices offerimus pro commemoratione confessoris tui Pauli ut sicut de eius gloria hodierna die pari devotione laetamur ita illius deprecatione cum omnibus sanctis in aeterna beatitudine gaudere mereamur.
translation_en: Before the divine majesty of yours, Lord, we humbly offer this divine service in commemoration of your confessor Paul. May we rejoice with equal devotion as we did on his glorious day, so that through his intercession we may merit to enjoy eternal beatitude with all the saints.

text: Ante conspectum maiestatis tuae quaesumus omnipotens Deus munera nostra grata perveniant et sancto Machuto intercedente peccatorum nostrorum remissio fiant.
translation_en: Before the sight of your majesty, we humbly ask, O almighty God, that our offerings may pleasingly reach you, and through the intercession of Saint Machutus, may our sins be forgiven.

text: Ante te Domine effundentes desiderium cordis nostri precamur ut ita haec quae offerimus benedicas qualiter ex his potantes et repulsa inedia convalescant et concessa spiritali virtute caelesti desiderio inardescant.
translation_en: Before you, Lord, pouring out the desire of our heart, we pray that what we offer may be blessed, so that those who partake of these may recover from hunger and gain strength, and that they may burn with the spiritual power of heavenly desire.

text: Anticipa nos misericordia tua priusquam zelus irae desaeviat misericors Deus et haec dona sanctifica ut adiuti patrociniis beatorum quorum propter te sanguis effusus est propitiationem tuam cum peccatorum venia consequamur.
translation_en: Anticipate us with your mercy before the zeal of wrath becomes unappeasable, merciful God. And let these gifts be sanctified so that, aided by the patronage of the blessed for whom blood was shed on your account, we may follow in the footsteps of their martyrdom and obtain forgiveness of sins.

text: Apostoli tui Pauli precibus Domine plebis tuae dona sanctifica ut quae tibi tuo grata sunt instituto gratiora fiant patrocinio supplicantis.
translation_en: Lord, through the prayers of your Apostle Paul, grant and sanctify your people that what is pleasing to you may become even more gracious by the petition of the supplicating intercessor.

text: Apostolica beati Ioannis evangelistae quaesumus Domine intercessione nos adiuva pro cuius sollemnitate percepimus tua sancta laetantes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that with the intercession of the blessed apostle John the Evangelist, you help us, for whose solemnity we have received your holy joy.

text: Apostolica nos muniat Domine semper oratio ut iisdem suffragatoribus dirigatur ecclesia quibus principibus gloriatur.
translation_en: Lord, we are fortified by your apostolic prayer that the church may be directed towards those princes for whom it boasts as its advocates.

text: Apostolica pro nobis interventio quaesumus Domine prosequatur munus oblatum ut quod tremente servitio nos vovemus eius precibus efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, may Your Apostolic intervention follow the offering made on our behalf. May what we pledge fearfully in Your service be accomplished through Your prayers.

text: Apostolicae reverentiae culmen offerimus sacris mysteriis imbuendum; praesta Domine quaesumus ut beati Andreae suffragiis cuius natalicia praeimus hic plebs tua semper et sua vota depromat et desiderata percipiat.
translation_en: We offer the peak of reverent apostolicity to be imbued in sacred mysteries; grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, through the intercession of blessed Andrew whose feast day we now celebrate, that your people may always present their prayers and fulfill their vows, and receive their desired outcomes.

text: Apostolicis Domine nos quaesumus attolle praesidiis ut quorum sollemnia praevenimus eorum precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that You raise us up with Your apostolic protection, so that we may be helped by their solemnities as we pray along with them.

text: Apostolicis nos Domine quaesumus beatorum Petri et Pauli attolle praesidiis ut quanto fragiliores sumus tanto validioribus auxiliis foveamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you raise us up under the protection of the blessed Peter and Paul, so that as we are the more frail, we may be strengthened by more powerful aids.

text: Apostolico Domine quaesumus beatorum Petri et Pauli patrocinio nos tuere et eosdem quorum tribuisti sollemnia celebrare securos fac nostros semper esse custodes.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that under the protection of the Apostles Peter and Paul, you keep us safe; and may those same individuals whose solemnities you have granted, always be our guardians.

text: Apostolorum Domine beatorum Petri et Pauli desiderata sollemnia recensemus praesta quaesumus ut eorum supplicatione muniamur quorum regimur principatu.
translation_en: Lord of the Apostles, blessed Peter and Paul, we remember with joy their solemn feasts. We humbly ask that you grant us protection through their intercession, under whose leadership we are governed.

text: Apostolorum tuorum Domine beatorum Petri et Pauli desiderata sollemnia recensemus; praesta quaesumus ut hodierna gloria passionis sicut illis magnificentiam tribuit sempiternam ita nobis veniam largiatur optatam et nomina eorum quae recitata sunt in libro vitae censeas deputari.
translation_en: We recall with longing the solemnities of your blessed apostles, Peter and Paul; grant us, we pray, that today's glory of their passion is as magnificent for them eternally, may it also bestow upon us the desired forgiveness. And may the names they were mentioned in the book of life be considered worthy to be appointed.

text: Apostolorum tuorum precibus Domine quaesumus plebis tuae dona sanctifica ut quae tibi tuo grata sunt instituto fiant gratiora patrocinio supplicantium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercession of your apostles. Grant that what is pleasing to you according to your institution may become even more pleasing through the petition of your supplicants.

text: Appare Domine cognoscere Domine sicut apparuisti manifestus in carne ortus ex virgine inventus a pastoribus cognitus in virtute declaratus in sidere adoratus in munere ostensus in flumine creditus in fide habitus in nube pro missus in indice ut sacratae sollemnitatis gratia ita suscipiat Ecclesia tua nunc gaudia ut praetulit quondam mysteria.
translation_en: Appear, Lord, and see, O Lord, as you appeared manifest in flesh, born from a virgin, discovered by shepherds, recognized in virtue, adored in the star, shown in ministry, believed in the river, received in faith, carried in cloud, sent in sign, that your Church may now receive the joy of this sacred solemnity as it once revealed the mysteries.

text: Apud te est Domine misericordia et copiosa redemptio; brachio tuo defende populum pereuntem elisos ac prostratos releva. Christe formidamus pro nostris peccatis ut non mereamur audiri; grave est enim quod amittimus et commissa non paenitebimus. Habes Domine confitentes reos; parce quia pius es. Iamdiu est Domine quod nostris operibus oppressi laniamur; addicti cavere nescimus et amittere non vitamus. Loqui confundimur quia verecundum est quod penetramur.  Magnus es Domine ut ignoscas facinoribus; occurre ne castigatione corrigamur ne praesentia tormentorum vagitamur. Oramus ut exaudias; clamamus ut parcas; preces nostras suscipe et quidquid debemus indulge auditor piissime; miserator fortissime voces nostras respice; de<us> omnium pietatem tuam largam concede.
translation_en:
At thy place, Lord, is mercy and a rich redemption; with thy arm defend the perishing people chosen and raise up those who are prostrate. Christ, we fear for our sins that we may not deserve to be heard; it is heavy indeed what we lose and will not repent of our transgressions. Lord, you have the confessing guilty; spare because you are merciful.
Long has it been, Lord, that we suffer oppression from our works; bound we do not know how to watch over ourselves nor do we desire to perish. We are confounded because it is shameful what penetrates us.
Great art thou, Lord, to forgive sins; come near lest we be corrected by chastisement and do not wail in the presence of torments. We pray that you hear us; we cry out that you spare us; receive our prayers and whatever we owe, may you graciously hear the most compassionate listener; look favorably upon our voices, O merciful one; grant thy entire pity from above.

text: Arbiter orbis apex rerum spes una reorum tardus vindictae veniae celer immemor irae qui loca perquiris miseris ubi parcere possis invitans ad dona magis ne crimina damnes; necte fidem populis pacem sere pectora iunge ut teneant animo quod blanda per oscula produnt.
translation_en: The Judge of the world's summit, unique hope of all things, slow to anger and rich in mercy, whose memory is short of wrath: seek out those who suffer, where you can show mercy instead of punishment; bind faith to peoples, sow peace, join hearts so that they may hold within them what sweet kisses produce.

text: Ascendant ad te Domine preces nostrae et ab Ecclesia tua cunctam repelle nequitiam.
translation_en: Our prayers ascend to you, Lord, and from your church, drive away all wickedness.

text: Ascendant ad te Domine preces nostrae et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum illarum qui hunc locum pauperesque tuos de suis iustis laboribus rebusque ditaverunt pro quibus etiam te licitum est humiliter deprecari misericordiam concede perpetuam; accipiantque magna pro parvis caelestia pro terrenis mansura pro caducis.
translation_en: Our prayers ascend to you, Lord, and to the souls of your servants, both great and small, who, among your just ones, have provided this place for your poor ones by their labor and resources. For them it is also fitting for us to humbly petition your mercy, grant perpetual compassion; let them receive what is great in exchange for the small, eternal in exchange for terrestrial, permanent in exchange for transient.

text: Ascendant ad te Domine preces nostrae et animam famuli tui illius gaudia aeterna suscipiant ut quem fecisti adoptionis participem iubeas hereditatis tuae esse consortem.
translation_en: Our prayers ascend to you, Lord, and may the soul of your servant be lifted up with eternal joys. Grant that whom you made a participant in adoption, you may command to be a co-heir of your heritage.

text: Beati Petri principis apostolorum intercessionibus quae nobis ...
translation_en: By the intercessions of Blessed Peter, the first among the apostles, may we find aid ...

text: Ascendant ad te Domine preces nostrae et tuorum vota fidelium munera suppliciter oblata concilient quod etiamsi nostris operibus non meremur quaesumus sanctorum nos intercessione mereamur.
translation_en: Our prayers ascend to You, Lord, and the offerings of Your faithful followers are humbly presented in supplication. We ask that even if we do not deserve it through our own works, by the intercession of the saints may we be worthy of it.

text: Ascendant ad te Domine supplicum preces ut qui diu pro nostris offensionibus castigati sumus miserationis tuae veniam sentiamus.
translation_en: We ascend to You, Lord, with supplicating prayers, so that we who have been long chastised for our offenses may feel your mercy's forgiveness.

text: Ascendant quaesumus Domine preces humilitatis nostrae in conspectu clementiae tuae et descendat super haec oblata virtus tuae divinitatis quam nostris quoque purificandis mentibus largiaris.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our prayers ascend in the sight of your clemency, and may your power descend upon these offerings, which you might also bestow upon our minds to be purified.

text: Ascendat oratio nostra usque ad thronum claritatis tuae et non vacua revertatur ad nos postulatio nostra.
translation_en: May our prayer ascend to the throne of your glory and let not our petition return empty-handed to us.

text: Ascendisse te in caelos ad Patrem Dei Filius creatura tua laetatur et ideo supplici te cordis contritione exposcimus ut et in nobis pollicitationem spiritus impleas et in defunctis donum aeternae quietis impertias.
translation_en: Your Son ascends to the heavens, delighting in your creation. Therefore, we humbly present ourselves to you with the contrition of our hearts, pleading that you fill us with the promise of your Spirit and grant to the deceased the gift of eternal rest.

text: Ascensionis Domini sacramentum <est> quod Dominus noster Iesus Christus ad patrem advocatum nobis missurus ascendit fidei nostrae gaudia multiplicata concelebrat et promissionis suae memor ita interpellit pro nobis ut in secundo eius adventu mereamur occurrere laeti.
translation_en: The sacrament of the Ascension of the Lord is that our Lord Jesus Christ, sent to advocate for us, ascends with the joy of our faith multiplied, celebrating it and thus invokes His promises in such a way that we may deserve to appear joyful at His second coming.

text: Aspice de caelo Deus et veni et multiplica fidem populi tui ut per te sequatur augmentum per quem sumpsit initium.
translation_en: Look from heaven, God, and come to multiply the faith of your people, so that through you they may follow the increase by whom they took their beginning.

text: Aspice nos Domine precibus exoratus venerandi martyris Gregorii tua miseratione concedens ut sicut nobis eius passio contulit hodiernum in tua virtute conventum ita suffragetur et meritum.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, with the prayers of one who is beseeching you, through the intercession of the venerable martyr Gregory. Grant that, as his passion was beneficial to us today in your power, so may his intercession and merit be effective for us.

text: Aspice quaesumus Domine quae oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus ut tuorum deprecatione sanctorum et tuitionem nobis praebeant et medelam.
translation_en: Behold, we ask you, Lord, what we present before your majesty with our eyes. May you provide us with the help of your saints' intercession and grant us healing.

text: Aspice sincero vultu pie miserator haec munera qui semper es propensus ad dona ut ipsa contemplatione oblata sanctifices naturali maiestate qui perpetue sanctus es et sancta largiris.
translation_en: Look with a sincere and humble gaze, O merciful one, upon these gifts which You are always inclined to give, so that by their very contemplation they may be sanctified through Your natural majesty, who are perpetually holy and gracious in giving.

text: Assistite nobis sancti martyres dei in quibus trina et indivisa caritatis societas ignis est conflatione probata. Vestris quaesumus suffragiis praebete nostris finibus pacem et cunctis inconvulsibilem caritatem ut vestro interventu cuncta in pace permaneant quae in hoc die passionis vestrae copiose exsultant.
translation_en: Assist us, holy martyrs of God, in whom the society of the undivided and trinity of love has been proven by the fusion of fire. We humbly ask for your intercession in our borders, that peace and an invincible charity may prevail among all. May everything that exults abundantly on this day of your passion remain peaceful through your intervention.

text: Assume quaesumus omnipotens Deus in honorem sanctorum martyrum tuorum Eustachii sociorumque eius haec tibi oblata libamina quorum pia supplicatione placatus et praeteritorum veniam et futurorum nobis cautelam praebeas delictorum.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, to accept these offerings in honor of your holy martyrs Eustachius and his companions. Through their pious supplication, may you grant us forgiveness for past sins and protection from future ones due to our transgressions.

text: Attende Domine gemitus nostros et familiae tuae adesto propitius ut si reatus conscientiae nostrae a te nos facit extraneos tua pietas non amittat proprios vel redemptos sed fac nos Domine evangelicam praedicationem cognoscere et aeternam vitam percipere.
translation_en: Attend, O Lord, to our groans and be present propitiously for your family, that if the guilt of our conscience makes us strangers to you, your pity may not lose your own or redeemed ones but rather make us, Lord, know the evangelical preaching and perceive eternal life.

text: Attende Domine omnipotens devotionem populorum fidelium et propitius accipe hoc munus oblatum; sit nobis oramus ita sanctorum tuorum commemoratio in suffragium ut eorum meritis impetremus et remedium viventium et requiem defunctorum.
translation_en: Attend, O Lord almighty, to the devotion of thy faithful people, and graciously receive this offering; may it be our prayer that the commemoration of thy saints may be in their intercession for us, that through their merits we may obtain remedy for the living and peace for the departed.

text: Attende Domine propitius meae servitutis obsequium et miserere fidelibus famulis tuis illis ut cunctis eorum sceleribus amputatis ita sint tuae miserationis defensione protecti ut in observatione mandatorum tuorum mereantur esse perfecti quatenus et in hac vita universo facinore careant et in conspectum gloriae tuae quandoque sine confusione perveniant.
translation_en: Attend, O Lord, favorably to my service and have mercy on your faithful servants, that they may be free from all their sins and protected by your mercy, so that in observing your commands they may merit to be perfect, avoiding any evil in this life. May they arrive without confusion before your glory.

text: Auctor perpetuae claritatis Deus immense rogamus ut carnem nostram per abstinentiam regas et corda pace tua adimpleas quo et per abstinentiam caro non sordeat et per dilectionem tam initia quam finis noster ad remunerationem usque perveniat.
translation_en: We implore the Author of eternal brightness, God, to rule our flesh through abstinence and fill our hearts with your peace so that, through abstinence, our flesh does not become unclean, and through love, both the beginning and the end may reach the reward.

text: Audi Deus meus audi lumen oculorum meorum audi quae peto et da quae petam ut audias; si enim despexeris pereo; si respexeris vivo; si iuste me intenderis mortuus foeteo; si misericordia respexeris foetentem suscitas de sepulchro; si mala respexeris mea tartarea tormenta vix sufficiunt; si pietate intendas solita poteris me commutare in melius. Quid non mali ego? Aut quid non boni tu? Quid non mali ego corruptibilis creatura? Quid non boni tu creator et creaturae auctor? Cecidi de manu tua vitio meo; potens es artifex tibi iterum placitum figurare. Corripe me in misericordia ne deseras neque in ira corripias. Quod odis in me procul fac a me et in tua voluntate intende in me. Hostem libidinis repelle a me et castitatis spiritum insere in ine. Vitium omne mortifica in ine et animam meam vivifica in me.
translation_en: Hear my God, hear the voice of my supplications, hear what I ask and grant what I am asking that you may hear; for if you spurn me, I perish; if you look upon me with favor, I live. If you direct yourself righteously towards me, I die a putrid death; if you look upon me mercifully, you revive the stinking corpse from the tomb. If you despise me, my torments are almost unbearable; if you correct me out of mercy, you can change me for the better. What evil is there in me? Or what good is there in you? What evil is there in this corruptible creature? And what good is there in you, Creator and author of creation? I have fallen from your hand because of my sin; you, O powerful artisan, can fashion a way for me again. Correct me out of mercy, lest you abandon or chastise me in anger. What you hate in me, keep far from me, and direct yourself towards me according to your will. Repel the enemy of lust from me and insert the spirit of chastity within me. Mortify every vice within me and vivify my soul within me.

text: Audi Deus Pater omnipotens preces nostras et sacrificiis a te institutis totus illabere ac praesta ut interventu sanctorum martyrum defensati<s> sit nobis haec temporalis vita pacis bono fecunda sit mors confessione potissima et resurrectio cum sanctis omnibus gloriosa.
translation_en: Hear us, O God, Almighty Father, our prayers and sacrifices that you have instituted. Entirely cleanse us and grant that we may be defended by the intervention of the holy martyrs. May this temporary life be fruitful with peace, may death be a supreme confession, and may resurrection with all saints be glorious.

text: Audi Domine misericors bonitatis plenitudo castitatis amator dignitatis dilector elisorum relevator fortitudo debilium gubernator populorum hereditas peregrinorum infirmorum relevatio caritatis amator longanimitatis instructor. Magnum nimis et misericors nomen tibi omnipotens Deus quia pius es; pius quia fortis et patiens es nimis tantum laudabilis tantumque possibilis redemptor mundi Salvator animarum et populi tui Trinitas Deus. Vita credentium Christe protege populum tuum et semper in tua pace custodi.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, full of mercy and goodness, lover of chastity, dignity's admirer, beloved of the elect, supporter of the weak, governor of the peoples, heritage of the pilgrims, relief of the sick, lover of charity, instructor of patience. Your great and merciful name is indeed praiseworthy and fully possible, Almighty God, because you are faithful; because you are strong and patient beyond measure. You are highly laudable, entirely possible Redeemer of the world, Savior of souls and people. Trinity of God. Christ, protect your people, and always keep them in your peace.

text: Audi Domine populum tuum tota tibi mente subiectum et apostolicam tuitionem supplici decerne propitiatus ut corpore et corde protectus quod pie credit appetat quod iuste sperat obtineat.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, your people who are wholly subject to you in mind, and grant us your apostolic protection, merciful one, that we may be protected both physically and spiritually, so that what we believe devoutly, we may attain what we justly hope for.

text: Audi Domine populum tuum toto tibi corde subiectum et tuitionem mentis et corporis eidem rogantibus sanctis apostolis tuis praesta continuam.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, Your people who are wholly subjected to You with all their hearts, and they are asking for protection of mind and body from Your holy apostles. Grant them continual aid.

text: Benedic Domine creaturam hanc saponis ...
translation_en: Bless, O Lord, this creature of soap ...

text: Audi piissime audi Salvator fortissime bonitatis plenitudo castitatis amator dignitatis conservator caritatis auctor longanimitatis institutor. Magnum nimis et miserator nomen tibi omnipotens quia pius es et fortis quantum laudabilis tantum possibilis. Redemptor mundi Salvator populi Trinitas Deus vita credentium sancte protege populum tuum atque semper in tua pace dispone quia tu dixisti pacem habere in universo orbe. Nos itaque fratres habeamus pacem sanctimonialem et vinctus diabolus non praevaleat internus scandalum suscitare.
translation_en: Hear most kindly, hear most mightily, the fullness of salvation hears; strong savior, lover of goodness, conserver of dignity, author of longanimity, institutor. The great and merciful name belongs to you, omnipotent one, for you are merciful and strong, as much praiseworthy as possible. Redeemer of the world, Savior of the people, Trinity, God of life, sanctely protect your people and always dispose them in your peace, because you said that there should be peace everywhere in the universe. Therefore, we brothers shall have a holy peace, and let the devil bound not prevail to cause internal scandal.

text: Benedic Domine creaturam istam panis ... ut sit Domine eiusdem abundans ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this creature of bread... that it may be, Lord, abundant...

text: Auditis nominibus ac desideriis offerentium fratres carissimi Dei patris omnipotentis clementiam deprecemur ut qui hodie per filium suum mirifice aquae speciem vertit in vinum ita omnium simul oblationes et vota convertere dignetur in sacrificium divinum et accepta ferre <sic>ut accepta tulit Abel iusti sui munera et Abrahae patriarchae sui hostias et quorum nomina texuit recitatio praemissa eorum sortem inter electos iubeat aggregari.
translation_en: We beseech the clemency of Almighty God, Father dear, that He who today miraculously changed water into wine through His Son, may deign to convert all the offerings and prayers of the brethren present into a divine sacrifice, and may bear them as they were borne by Abel, the just one, and Abraham, the patriarch, whose names are mentioned in the reading given before. We pray that their fate among the chosen be joined together.

text: Benedic Domine creaturam istam panis ... ut omnes gustantes ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this creation of bread ... that all who taste ...

text: Auditis nominibus ac desideriis offerentium rogamus Domine ut eorum oblatione iam munera propitius dignanter acceptes; supplicantes ut beatissimorum patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum omniumque sanctorum suffragiis et patrociniis adiuvemur. Spiritus vero sanctorum quorum commemoratio facta est praesentem requiem et fructum primae resurrectionis obtineant.
translation_en: Having heard the names and desires of those offering, we humbly ask you, Lord, that you graciously accept their offerings; supplicating that we may be helped by the prayers and intercessions of all the blessed patriarchs, prophets, apostles, and saints. May the Holy Spirit, whose commemoration has been made, obtain for us peace in this present life and the first fruits of the resurrection.

text: Benedic Domine creaturam istam ut sit remedium ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this creature, that it may be a remedy ...

text: Auditis nominibus carorum nostrorum omnipotentem dominum deprecemur ut plebis suae ministrorumque vota suscipiens oblationes nostras quas in commemorationem sanctorum Acaunensium ac pro spiritibus carorum nostrorum offerimus in odorem bonae suavitatis accipiat. Unde supplices simus ut beatissimorum patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum et martyrum omniumque sanctorum piis precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Having heard the names of our dear ones, we humbly beseech the almighty Lord to accept the prayers and offerings we make in commemoration of the saints of Acaunum and for the spirits of our own, offering them as a sweet-smelling incense. Therefore, let us be supplicant that we may be assisted by the most blessed patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, and all saints through their pious prayers.

text: Benedic Domine Deus omnipotens locum istum ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord God Almighty, this place...

text: Auditis nominibus offerentium aeternitatis dominum deprecemur ut in nobis vel timor eius vel cordis puritas vel caritas quae casum non habet immobilis perseveret quia haec est salutaris oblatio haec vera haec pinguis hostia ista sunt pura libamina quae et pro nobis et pro requie defunctorum contritis et humiliatis cordibus offeruntur.
translation_en: Having heard the names of those offering, we beseech the Lord eternal that in us may persevere either fear of Him or purity of heart or charity which has no change. For this is a healthful offering, this is true, this is a rich sacrifice, these are pure libations, which are offered for us and for the rest of the departed souls, contrite and humbled hearts.

text: Benedic Domine dona tua ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, Your gifts...

text: Auditis nominibus offerentium debita cum veneratione beatissimorum apostolorum et martyrum omniumque sanctorum commemoratione decursa et offerentium et pausantium commemoremus nomina ut aeternalibus indita paginis sanctorum coetibus aggregentur.
translation_en: We remember, with the due reverence owed to them, the names of those offering and pausing during the commemoration of all the blessed apostles, martyrs, and saints. We pray that they may be gathered together in the company of the holy ones on eternal pages.

text: Benedic Domine et has tuas creaturas ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, these your creatures...

text: Auditis nominibus offerentium fratres carissimi Domini maiestatem deprecemur ut qui vitam summi antistitis sui Leudegarii martyris transtulit ad coronam per interventum sanctorum patriarcharum apostolorum et martyrum anachoritarum et virginum omniumque sanctorum concedere dignetur ut sacrificii praesentis oblatio quae offertur <et> viventibus emendationem et defunctis remissionem obtineat peccatorum et quorum nomina in recitatione patefacta sunt in caelestibus paginis conscribantur.
translation_en: Hearing the names of those offering, we humbly ask the majesty of the Lord that He who transferred the life of Saint Leudegar, his supreme bishop, to a crown through the intervention of the holy patriarchs, apostles, martyrs, anchorites, virgins, and all saints, may be pleased to grant that the offering of this present sacrifice attains forgiveness for the living and remission for the dead of their sins; and that those whose names have been revealed in the recitation may be written on the celestial pages.

text: Benedic Domine et hos fructus novos ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, these new fruits...

text: Auditis nominibus offerentium fratres carissimi omnipotentis Dei inenarrabilem misericordiam supplices postulemus ut nomina nostra quae in hoc celeberrimo die in honorem sancti antistitis sui Martini offerimus benedicere et sanctificare ipso suffragante dignetur et quod illi hodie collatum est ad gloriam nobis quoque proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Having heard the names of those offering, your most dear brothers supplicate the immeasurable mercy of the almighty God. We humbly request that He bless and sanctify our names which on this most prominent day are offered in honor of St. Martin, His bishop, through his intercession. May what was granted to him today for his glory also profit us for our salvation.

text: Benedic Domine et hos fruges novos ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, these new grains...

text: Auditis nominibus offerentium fratres carissimi rogemus Deum patrem omnipotentem ut oblationem famuli sui illius inter sanctorum suorum dona constituat quorum suffragia pia devotione postulamus.
translation_en: Having heard the names of those who are offering, we, your most dear brothers, humbly ask God, the omnipotent Father, to set our offering among His gifts within the company of His saints. Whose intercession we earnestly request through pious and devoted prayer.

text: Benedic Domine familiam tuam ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, thy family...

text: Auditis nominibus offerentium fratres dilectissimi Christum Dominum deprecemur ut sicut pro eius circumcisione carnali sollemnia celebramus ita spiritalium nequitiarum illusione devicta laetemur praestante pietate sua ut haec sacrificia sic viventibus proficiant ad emendationem ut defunctis opitulentur ad requiem.
translation_en: Having heard the names of those offering, we humbly beseech Christ our Lord that just as we solemnly celebrate His circumcision in the flesh, so may we rejoice, victorious over the deception of spiritual sins, by His abundant mercy. May these sacrifices, for the living, bring about correction; and for the dead, grant them peace.

text: Benedic Domine hanc aquam ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this water...

text: Auditis nominibus offerentium fratres dilectissimi omnipotentem Deum supplicemus ut super hanc oblationem caelestem gratiam suam divini illius odoris infundat quam in commemoratione dominicae resurrectionis offerimus ut acceptio benedicti corporis et sacri poculi praelibata communio defunctis opituletur ad requiem viventibus proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Having heard the names of those offering, we humbly beseech the omnipotent God that He may pour out His heavenly grace upon this offering, through the fragrance of His divine odor, which we offer in commemoration of the Lord's resurrection. May it be accepted and may the blessed body and sacred chalice bring comfort to the departed souls; may it advance living souls towards peace and lead them to salvation.

text: Benedic Domine hanc crucem ...
translation_en: Bless, O Lord, this cross...

text: Auditis nominibus offerentium indeficientem divinam clementiam deprecemur ut has oblationes plebis quas in honorem beatissimi Germani antistitis et confessoris offerimus signato die hodiernae sollemnitatis celebremus cum inconcussa fidei libertate quam ille constanti mente defendit precantes ut robur patientiae eius nobiscum si non opere saltem voluntate comitetur. Oremus etiam et pro spiritibus carorum nostrorum quorum idem omnipotens Deus et numerum novit et nomina ut omnium memoriam faciat omnium peccata dimittat.
translation_en: Having heard the names of those offering, we humbly entreat the unfailing divine clemency to celebrate these offerings of the people, which we present in honor of the blessed Germanus, bishop and confessor, on this day's solemnity, with unwavering freedom of faith, which he defended steadfastly. We pray that his patience's strength may be with us, not only in deed but also in will. We also pray for the souls of our brethren, whose same Almighty God knows the number and names; we ask that He may make their memory among all and forgive all their sins.

text: Benedic Domine hanc domum ...
translation_en: Bless, O Lord, this house...

text: Auditis nominibus offerentium te pietatis Dominum deprecamur ut digneris nobis oratus assistere adesse quaesitus aperire pulsatus; offerentium nomina caelestibus adscribas in paginis; promissionem tuam manifestes in sanctis; misericordiam ostendas in perditis. Et quia imbecilla est nostrae infirmitatis oratio ut quid orare oporteat nescimus advocamus in suffragio precum nostrarum receptos in caelesti collegio patriarchas repletos divino spiritu prophetas martyres confessionis floribus coronatos apostolos ad officium praedicationis electos per quos oramus te Dominum nostrum ut omnes metu territos inopia afflictos tribulatione vexatos morbis obrutos suppliciis deditos debitis obligatos praesentia tuae resurrectionis absolvas. Spirituum quoque pausantium memor esse digneris ut illis criminum suorum indulgentia relaxata ad sinum patriarcharum liceat pervenire.
translation_en:
Having heard the names of those who offer you, we humbly beseech your Lordship to deign to assist and be present in response to those who ask and knock. Grant that their names be recorded among the heavenly ones; manifest your promise in the saints; show mercy on the lost.
And since our prayer is weak because of our infirmity, we ask that through the intercession of those received into the celestial college—the patriarchs filled with divine spirit, the prophets crowned with the flowers of confession, the martyrs chosen for their witness, the apostles elected for the office of preaching—you, our Lord, may absolve all who are struck with terror, poverty-stricken, afflicted by tribulation, overwhelmed by diseases, dedicated to penance, burdened by debts, through your presence at the resurrection.
We also remember those whose spirits pause; we beseech you that indulgence for their sins be granted so they may reach the bosom of the patriarchs.

text: Auditis nominibus recensitis dilectissimi fratres Deum pietatis et misericordiae deprecemur ut haec quae oblata sunt benignus assumat. Nullum umquam ex his pro quibus holocausta franguntur muneris sui exterum esse patiatur tam viventium quam defunctorum vel ad merita vel ad peccata respiciens alios iubeat ad gratiam alios ad veniam pertinere.
translation_en: Having heard the recently mentioned names, dearest brothers, we humbly beseech God of piety and mercy to accept these things that have been offered. May nothing ever from those for whom these holy offerings are broken be lacking from his bounty, whether among the living or the deceased, whether considering merits or sins, he may grant some to grace and others to forgiveness.

text: Audivimus et cognovimus Domine per abstinentiam sacri ieiunii quanta virtutum praemia collata sint patribus nostris. Ex hoc tuae maiestati Moyses adscriptus est fidelis amicus. Ob hoc Elias raptus igneis curribus obsequentibus flaminis paradiso deputatus est vivus. Per huius quoque quadragesimae perpetuitatem ieiunii tentator a Christo devictus est inimicus. Ex hoc Ioannes enituit in deserto praecipuus. Ob hoc te quaesumus sanctissime Deus ut hoc salutiferum opus praestes nobis iugiter frequentare per quod ad promissa mereamur praemia futurae beatitudinis pervenire.
translation_en: We have heard and known, Lord, through the abstinence of sacred fasting how great the rewards of virtues were bestowed upon our fathers. From this, Moses was added to your majesty as a faithful friend. For this reason, Elias was carried off by fiery chariots obedient to flames and assigned to live in paradise. Through this very season of Lent, the enemy was conquered by Christ through fasting. From this, John emerged in the desert as the foremost. Therefore, we humbly ask you, most holy God, that you continually grant us to participate in this saving work through which we may merit to reach the future rewards of eternal beatitude.

text: Benedic Domine hanc familiam tuam in caelestibus ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this family of yours in heaven...

text: Aufer a nobis Domine quaesumus iniquitates nostras ut ad sancta sanctorum puris mereamur sensibus introire.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask, remove from us our iniquities, so that we may deserve to enter the holy of holies with pure senses.

text: Benedic Domine has aquas ...
translation_en: Bless, O Lord, these waters...

text: Aufer a nobis quaesumus Domine iniquitates nostras ut ad sancta sanctorum puris mereamur mentibus introire.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you remove our sins from us, so that we may worthy enter with pure minds into the holy of holies among the saints.

text: Benedic Domine hoc famularum tuorum dormitorium ... auxilio muniatur.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this bedchamber of thy servants... let it be strengthened with thy aid.

text: Aufer a nobis Domine spiritum superbiae cui resistis ut sacrificia nostra tibi sint semper accepta.
translation_en: Lord, lift up from us the spirit of pride for which you resist, so that our sacrifices may always be acceptable to you.

text: Benedic Domine hoc famulorum tuorum dormitorium ... innixum scale.
translation_en: Bless, O Lord, this sleeping-place of your servants ... fastened with steps.

text: Auge fidem tuam Domine quaesumus miseratus in nobis quia pietatis tuae subsidia non negabis quibus in te credendi contuleris firmitatem.
translation_en: Increase our faith, Lord, we pray to you, merciful one, for you will not deny the support of your pity to those who have turned to you for firmness in belief.

text: Auge in nobis Domine quaesumus fidem tuam et Spiritus Sancti lucem in nobis semper accende.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we ask, your faith within us and ever kindle the light of the Holy Spirit in us.

text: Benedic Domine hos fructus novos ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, these new fruits...

text: Auge quaesumus Domine fidem populi tui de sancti Laurentii martyris festivitate conceptam ut ad confessionem tui nominis nullis properare terreamur adversis sed tantae virtutis intuitu potius incitemur.
translation_en: Increase, we ask you, Lord, the faith of your people conceived during the feast of Saint Lawrence the Martyr, so that we may be stirred up to confess your name without fearing adversity but rather, inspired by such great virtue.

text: Benedic Domine hos fructus novos ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, these new fruits...

text: Augeatur in nobis Domine quaesumus tuae virtutis operatio ut divinis vegetati sacramentis ad eorum promissa capienda tuo munere praeparemur.
