translation_en: Grant within us, Lord, we humbly ask, the operation of your virtue, that prepared for receiving the promises of the divine sacraments by your gift, we may be made ready.

text: Aurem tuam quaesumus Domine precibus nostris accommoda et mentis nostrae tenebras gratia tuae visitationis illustra.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to adapt your ear to our prayers and to illuminate the darkness of our minds with the visits of your grace.

text: Aures clementiae tuae Deus ad populi tui gemitum placatus inclina; sume precantium preces et paenitentium exaudi clamores; flenti et confitenti familiae tuae promissam concede indulgentiam peccatorum.
translation_en: God of your clemency, moved by the groaning of your people, incline an ear to their prayers; grant hearing to the penitent and answer the cries of those weeping and confessing. To your weeping and confessing family, grant the promised indulgence for sins.

text: Aures clementiae tuae quaesumus Domine inclina precibus nostris ut qui sancti confessoris atque pontificis tui Taurini annua gaudemus devotione ipso intercedente mereamur fieri consortes caelestis gloriae.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to incline your ears of mercy towards our prayers. May we who annually rejoice with devotion in the holy confessor and bishop of Turin, be worthy through his intercession to become partakers of celestial glory.

text: Benedic Domine hunc famulum tuum cuius ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this your servant whose ...

text: Aures tuae pietatis mitissime Deus inclina precibus meis et gratia Sancti Spiritus illumina cor meum ut tuis mysteriis digne ministrare teque aeterna caritate diligere merear.
translation_en: Most merciful God, incline your ears to my prayers and enlighten my heart by the grace of the Holy Spirit, that I may worthily serve you in your mysteries and merit to be loved by you eternally with everlasting charity.

text: Benedic Domine hunc fructum novarum ...
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this fruit of new ...

text: Aures tuae pietatis quaesumus Domine precibus nostris inclina ut qui peccatorum nostrorum flagellis percutimur miserationis tuae gratia liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to bend your ear towards our prayers. May we who are struck by the scourges of our sins be freed through your grace.

text: Auxiliare Domine famulis tuis et in tua pietate fidentibus iugiter esto propitius ut et praesentia pericula te protegente declinent et futura gaudia te largiente percipiant.
translation_en: O Lord, aid your servants and always be propitious to those who trust in your mercy. May they experience a decline of present dangers with you as their protector, and may they receive future joys with you as their benefactor.

text: Auxiliare Domine fragilitati nostrae ut tuorum intercessione sanctorum non reprobemur meritis quos tantis deputare dignaris officiis.
translation_en: Help, Lord, our frailty that we may not be rejected because of the merits you deem worthy for such great offices with your saints' intercession.

text: Benedic huic domui ...
translation_en: Bless this house...

text: Auxiliare Domine plebi tuae et toto tibi corde subiectae praesta conversationis effectum quia bonis omnibus hanc replebis si tibi placere perfeceris.
translation_en: Help, Lord, your people and grant to those wholly subject to you the fulfillment of good conversation, for you will fill them with this if it pleases you to complete it.

text: Auxiliare Domine populo tuo ut sacrae devotionis proficiens incrementis et tuo semper munere gubernetur et ad redemptionis aeternae pertineat te ducente consortium.
translation_en: Help, Lord, your people, that as they progress in sacred devotion, they may be continually guided by your care and that the consortium may lead them towards eternal redemption under your guidance.

text: Benedic omnipotens Deus hanc creaturam salis ...
translation_en: Bless the almighty God this creature of salt...

text: Auxiliare Domine quaerentibus misericordiam tuam et da veniam confitentibus parce supplicibus ut qui nostris meritis flagellamur tua miseratione salvemur.
translation_en: Help, Lord, those seeking your mercy, and grant forgiveness to the penitent. Spare the suppliant ones, so that we who are chastised by our deeds may be saved by your mercy.

text: Auxiliare Domine supplicibus tuis ut opem tuae gratiae consequantur qui in tua pietate confidunt.
translation_en: Help, Lord, your suppliants that they may follow your aid who trust in your mercy.

text: Auxiliare Domine temporibus nostris ut tua nos ubique dextera protegente et religionis integritas et Romani nominis securitas reparata consistat.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, during our times, so that your omnipresent hand protects us everywhere and the integrity of our faith and the security of the Roman name are restored.

text: Auxiliare nobis misericors Deus et ut cunctos hostes expugnare possimus praesta quaesumus ut nostros vincamus errores.
translation_en: Help us, merciful God, and so that we may be able to overpower all our enemies, grant us this prayer, that we may conquer our own errors.

text: Benedic quaesumus omnipotens Deus hanc cisternam ...
translation_en: Bless, we ask you, Almighty God, this cistern...

text: Auxiliare quaesumus Domine nobis servis tuis tot calamitatum miseriis oppressis et dexteram super nos tuae maiestatis placatus extende atque ablato crudeli terrore barbarico gaudium perpetuae consolationis citissime benignus impende.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, to help us, your servants, who are oppressed by so many calamities. Extend promptly the right hand of your majesty upon us, appeased, and drive away the cruel barbarian terror quickly, bestowing perpetual joy as swift consolation.

text: Benedicantur nobis Domine tua dona ...
translation_en: May we be blessed, Lord, with your gifts...

text: Auxiliatrix sit nobis virtus Spiritus Sancti qui sanctum suum Achatium cum suis sodalibus in crucis patibulo roboravit; te Christe suppliciter exoramus ut quorum natalicia colimus eodem spiritu adiuvante aeterna beatitudine consolemur.
translation_en: May the power of the Holy Spirit be our aid, who strengthened St. Achatus and his companions on the cross's scaffold; we humbly beseech You, Christ, that we may celebrate their natal days with the same spirit aiding us, and be consoled by eternal beatitude.

text: Benedicantur nobis tua dona ...
translation_en: May we be blessed with thy gifts...

text: Auxilientur nobis Domine beati praecursoris et martyris tui Ioannis Baptistae veneranda merita passionis et haec nobis hostia tuae placationis exsistant.
translation_en: May we be helped, Lord, by the blessings of your forerunner and martyr John the Baptist, through the merits of his worthy passion; may this offering of yours, our appeasement, exist for us.

text: Benedicat nos Deus omni benedictione ...
translation_en: May God bless us with all his blessings ...

text: Auxilientur nobis Domine sumpta mysteria et sempiterna protectione confirment.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, with your sacred mysteries and confirm us everlastingly with your eternal protection.

text: Benedicat nos Dominus et custodiat ...
translation_en: May the Lord bless us and keep us...

text: Auxilientur nobis Domine sacrosancta mysteria beatae Mariae Magdalenae veneratione celebrata quae spretis mundanae vanitatis illecebris te solum diligere tibique Deo vivo et vero elegit iugiter inhaerere.
translation_en: Grant us aid, Lord, by the sacred mysteries of the blessed Mary Magdalene, celebrated with reverence, who scorned the allurements of worldly vanities and chose to love You alone and adhere forever to the living and true God.

text: Auxilientur nobis pie Domine Iesu Christe omnes passiones tuae et defendant nos ab omni dolore et tristitia ab omni periculo et miseria ab omni peccato et cordis immunditia ab omni scandalo et infamia a morbis malis animae et corporis et a morte subitanea et improvisa et ab omni persecutione inimicorum visibilium et invisibilium; scimus enim quod in quacumque hora vel die passionis tuae memoriam habuerimus salvi erimus; ideo de immensa tua pietate confisi te deprecamur piissime Salvator per benignissimas sacratissimasque passiones tuas ut benigno nos protegas auxilio et continua pietate ab omni malo nos conserves.
translation_en: May we, good Lord Jesus Christ, be helped by all your sufferings and defend us from every pain and sorrow, from every danger and misery, from every sin and spiritual uncleanliness, from every scandal and disgrace, from every evil of soul and body, and from every sudden and unexpected death, and from every persecution by visible or invisible enemies; for we know that if in any hour or day we remember the memory of your passion, we shall be saved; therefore with immense compassion we humbly ask you, our merciful Savior, through your most benevolent, most sacred sufferings, to protect us kindly with continuous help and to conserve us from every evil.

text: Auxilietur nobis Domine quaesumus Unigeniti tui resurrectio et munera quae tibi offerimus beatae Mariae virginis interventione dicare digneris.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, we beseech You. May the Resurrection of Your Only-begotten Son and the gifts we offer You be worthy to be pronounced through the intervention of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

text: Auxilium quaesumus Domine maiestatis tuae tribue potestatisque subiectis ut quidquid actibus nostris non meremur accipere beati levitae et martyris tui Vincentii precibus assequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, bestow your aid and power upon the subjugated, that whatever we do not deserve to receive according to our actions, we may obtain through the prayers of your blessed deacon and martyr Vincent.

text: Auxilium tuum Domine nomini tuo subdita poscunt corda fidelium ut quia sine te nihil possunt implere quod iustum est tua misericordia largiente et quae recta sunt apprehendant et omnia sibi profutura percipiant.
translation_en: They humbly ask for your help, Lord, with hearts submissive to your name, so that since they can accomplish nothing without you, your mercy may grant them what is just and that they may comprehend what is right and perceive all things beneficial to them.

text: Auxilium tuum nobis Domine beata Maria Magdalena semper imploret quae tibi grata semper exsistit suae devotionis famulatu.
translation_en: May your help, Lord, always be sought by the blessed Mary Magdalene, who has always existed grateful to you in her devoted service.

text: Auxilium tuum nobis Domine mittere digneris et de tua nos virtute confirma et visita nos celebrantes memoriam beati confessoris tui illius et ipso intercedente claritatem et pacem tuam nostris largire corporibus et munera quae sunt ob eius venerationem offerta dignanter assume.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you send your aid to us and strengthen us with your power, visit us as we celebrate the memory of your blessed confessor, and grant him clarity and peace for our bodies. May he intercede on our behalf. Bestow upon us your gifts, which are offered in his veneration, worthy of acceptance.

text: Auxilium tuum nobis Domine quaesumus placatus impende et intercedente beato Timotheo martyre tuo dexteram super nos tuae propitiationis extende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your aid may descend upon us. We implore you to extend your right hand over us through the intercession of your martyr Saint Timothy.

text: Auxilium tuum nobis Domine quaesumus placatus impende et intercedentibus sanctis tuis quorum in hanc praesentem ecclesiam pretiosa patrocinia colligere curavimus fac nos ab omni adversitate liberari et in aeterna laetitia gaudere cum illis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your help be bestowed upon us; may you stretch forth your aid. And through the intercession of your saints, whose precious patronage we have gathered here in this present church, deliver us from all adversity and let us rejoice with them in eternal joy.

text: Auxilium tuum quaesumus Domine intercedente gloriosissimo Quintino martyre tuo a cunctis nos defendat periculis ut qui illi tota devotione congaudent ab omni adversitate salventur.
translation_en: We humbly ask for your help, Lord, with the intercession of the glorious martyr Quintinus. May he protect us from all dangers, so that those who rejoice in him with complete devotion may be saved from every adversity.

text: Averte Domine quaesumus a fidelibus tuis cunctos miseratus errores et saevientium morborum depelle perniciem ut quos merito flagellas devios foveas tua miseratione correctos.
translation_en: Turn away from us, Lord, we beseech you, all errors and savage diseases from your faithful. Cleanse them through mercy, that those whom you rightly chastise may be corrected by your compassion.

text: Averte quaesumus Domine iram tuam propitiatus a nobis et facinora nostra quibus indignationem tuam provocamus expelle.
translation_en: Turn away from us, Lord, we entreat you, your wrath, and be merciful to us. Drive away our sins for which we provoke your indignation.

text: Beata martyr tua illa nobis quaesumus Domine in suo natalicio fidelium tuorum munere suffragetur et quae tibi placuit sui martyrii certamine a te nobis iugiter quae tuis electis olim promisisti imploret reddere beneficia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that on the feast day of your blessed martyr, may she intercede for us with her faithful service. And we also pray that she who pleased you in her contest of martyrdom will continually ask from you the benefits which you once promised to bestow upon your chosen ones.

text: Beata virgo Genovefa quaesumus Domine sumptis donis caelestibus sua nos intercessione laetificet et apud te meritis suis gloriosis obtineat ne praeparatos impiis sempiternos sentiamus ardores.
translation_en: Blessed Virgin Genovefa, we humbly ask you, Lord, may the celestial gifts bestowed upon her intercede on our behalf and bring us joy. May she obtain glorious rewards with her merits before you, that we may not feel the eternal flames prepared for the unrighteous.

text: Beatae Agathae martyris tuae Domine precibus confidentes quaesumus clementiam tuam ut per ea quae sumpsimus aeterna remedia capiamus.
translation_en: With confident prayers, we beseech you, Lord, to show your mercy through Saint Agatha, that through what we have received from her, we may obtain eternal remedies.

text: Beatae Caeciliae martyris tuae nos quaesumus Domine festivitas sancta commendet quae ita ad palmam martyrii venire voluit ut et de societate placeret qua Valerianum et Tiburtium consecrationibus per angelum suum tua misericordia coronavit.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the festivity of Your blessed martyr Caecilia may recommend us, who so desired to come to the palm of martyrdom that she also pleased in the society where Valerian and Tiburtius were consecrated by Your angel, and with Your mercy she was crowned by You.

text: Beatae Christinae virginis tuae Domine meritis quae tibi hostia facta est dilecta haec tuis sint oculis munera accepta.
translation_en: Blessed Christina, your Virgin, Lord, may these gifts be pleasing to you, accepted as offerings, because of the merits she has made who was a sacrifice for you.

text: Beatae et gloriosae Dei Genitricis semperque virginis Mariae intercessionibus quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per huius virtutem sacramenti quod sumpsimus in resurrectionis gloria mereamur stola beatae immortalitatis vestiri.
translation_en: We humbly ask the blessed and glorious Mother of God, eternally Virgin Mary, through her intercessions that Almighty God may grant us, through the power of this sacrament we have received, to deserve to put on the blessed robe of immortality in the glory of resurrection.

text: Beatae et gloriosae semperque virginis Dei Genitricis Mariae quaesumus omnipotens Deus intercessio nos gloriosa protegat et ad vitam perducat aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask the blessed, glorious and ever-virgin Mother of God, Mary, the almighty God to protect us with her glorious intercession and lead us to eternal life.

text: Beatae Margaritae Domine quaesumus precibus super populum tuum benedictio copiosa descendat eiusque suffragiis a periculis cunctis liberemur et perpetuis donis firmemur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask for the blessing of Blessed Margaret to descend upon your people. May we be freed from all dangers by her intercession and may we be strengthened with eternal gifts.

text: Beatae Mariae Magdalenae quaesumus Domine suffragiis adiuvemur cuius precibus exoratus quatriduanum fratrem vivum ab inferis resuscitasti.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to help us by the intercessions of blessed Mary Magdalene, whose prayers you were moved to grant the resurrection of Lazarus after four days.

text: Beatae Sabinae virginis tuae et martyris Domine precibus confidentes quaesumus clementiam tuam ut eius meritis et precibus ad aeterna gaudia pervenire valeamus.
translation_en: With confidence in your blessed Sabina, virgin and martyr, Lord, we humbly ask for your clemency, that through her merits and prayers we may be worthy to reach eternal joys.

text: Beati Aegidii famuli tui Domine tibi grata precatio et munera nostra commendet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper imploret.
translation_en: Blessed are the servants of St. Giles, Lord, may a pleasing prayer and our gifts commend them to you; and may they always pray for your mercy towards us.

text: Beati Andreae apostoli supplicatione quaesumus Domine plebs tua benedictionem percipiat ut de eius meritis et feliciter glorietur et sempiternis valeat consortiis sociata laetari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercession of the Apostle Andrew, that your people may receive your blessing, so that they may rejoice and triumph in his merits and enjoy eternal happiness with him in eternal companionship.

text: Beati apostoli Andreae Domine sollemnia recensemus ut eius auxilio tua beneficia capiamus pro quo tibi hostias laudis offerimus.
translation_en: We celebrate the feast of the blessed apostle Andrew, Lord, so that we may receive your blessings through his aid. For him, we offer you sacrifices of praise.

text: Beati apostoli tui Bartholomaei cuius sollemnia recensemus quaesumus Domine ut auxilio eius tua beneficia capiamus pro quo tibi hostias laudis offerimus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to remember the feast of your apostle Bartholomew. May we merit to receive your blessings through his help, for whom we offer you sacrifices of laudatory praise.

text: Beati Mennae martyris tui sollemnia recensemus ut eius auxilio tua beneficia capiamus pro quo tibi hostias laudis offerimus.
translation_en: We remember the solemnity of your blessed Martyr Mennas, that we may receive your benefits through his aid, for whom we offer you hosts of praise.

text: Beati martyris tui illius Domine sollemnia recensemus ut eius auxilio tua beneficia capiamus pro quo tibi laudes offerimus.
translation_en: We remember the feast of your martyr, Lord, so that we may obtain your blessings through his aid. For him, we offer you praises.

text: Beati apostoli tui illius Domine sollemnia recensentes quaesumus ut eius auxilio tua beneficia capiamus pro quo tibi hostias laudis offerimus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to remember the solemn feast of your apostles and we humbly request that through their assistance we may receive your blessings. For which we offer you hosts of praise.

text: Beati apostoli et evangelistae tui Matthaei supplicationibus Domine quaesumus tibi nostra grata sint munera in cuius sollemnitate tuis altaribus exhibentur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the gifts presented on the solemnity of your apostle and evangelist Matthew may be pleasing to you.

text: Beati archangeli tui Michaelis et omnium angelorum tribue nos Domine orationibus foveri ut quorum memoriam praedicamus in terris eorum sanctis precibus adiuvemur in caelis.
translation_en: Bless us, Lord, with the prayers of your archangel Michael and all angels, so that we may be supported on earth by their memory and assisted in heaven by their prayers.

text: Beati archangeli tui Michaelis intercessione suffulti supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quos honore prosequimur contingamus et mente.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, supported by the intercession of your archangel Michael, that those we follow with honor may attain and understand (you) in mind.

text: Benedicere digneris Domine hoc scriptorium…
translation_en: You are worthy, Lord, to bless this scriptorium...

text: Beati Christophori martyris tui quaesumus Domine intercessione haec communicatio nos expurget a crimine et tuo auxilio defendat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the intercession of the blessed Christopher the martyr may purify this communication from sin and protect us with your help.

text: Beati Clementis Domine natalicio fidelibus tuis munere suffragetur et qui tibi placuit nobis imploret auxilium.
translation_en: May the birthday of Blessed Clement, Lord, be a blessing to your faithful and may he intercede on our behalf to ask for help from you.

text: Beati Helani confessoris Domine intercessio fidelibus tuis suffragetur et qui tibi placuit nobis imploret auxilium.
translation_en: Blessed Helena, O Lord, may her intercession be favorable to your faithful, and may she pray for us who please you to grant us aid.

text: Beatae Brigidae virginis tuae precibus fidelibus tuis Domine sumpta munera suffragentur et quae tibi placuit nobis imploret auxilium.
translation_en: Through the prayers of your blessed Virgin Brigid, Lord, may the gifts taken be effective for your faithful, and may they who please you ask us for help.

text: Beati Clementis sacerdotis et martyris tui natalicia veneranda quaesumus Domine Ecclesia tua devota suscipiat et fiat magnae glorificationis amore devotior.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your devoted Church may reverently celebrate the feast day of Your blessed priest and martyr, Clement, and may grow more devoted in love of great glory.

text: Beatae Genovefae natalicia veneranda Domine quaesumus Ecclesia tua devota suscipiat et fiat magnae glorificationis amore devotior et tantae fidei proficiat exemplo.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your devoted Church may honor the feast day of Blessed Genevieve and may grow more devout in love for great glory and advance in faith through her example.

text: Beatarum virginum ac martyrum tuarum Columbae et Genofevae natalicia veneranda Domine quaesumus Ecclesia tua devota mente suscipiat et fiat magnae glorificationis amore devotior et ad tantae fidei gratiam proficiat exemplum sanctitatis.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your Church, Lord, with a devoted mind to honor the feast days of Your blessed virgins and martyrs Columba and Genevieve. May it be filled with a more devoted love for great glory, and may it progress towards the grace of such great faith through the example of sanctity.

text: Beati confessoris tui atque pontificis illius quaesumus Domine maiestati tuae intercessio veneranda commendet ut quam nostris non meremur eius meritis indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your worthy intercession may commend to your majesty the confessor and bishop whom you have, so that we may obtain mercy through his merits which we do not deserve.

text: Beati confessoris tui Bedae nos Domine Deus intercessione laetifica cuius nos pia tribuisti et doctrina proficere et iucunda sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: Blessed be thy confessed one, Bede, O Lord God. Enlighten us through his intercession. May the devotion you have bestowed on us and his teaching help us prosper, and may we rejoice in the pleasant solemnity he brings.

text: Beati confessoris tui Guthlaci quaesumus Domine interventio gloriosa commendet hanc oblationem nostram tuae clementiae ut quod nostris actibus non meremur eius precibus consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may the glorious intervention of your confessor Guthlac grant favor to this our offering. Through your mercy, may we obtain what we do not deserve by his prayers.

text: Beati confessoris tui Iuvenalis quaesumus Domine confessio gloriosa nos circumdet et protegat eiusque merita pietatem tuam pro nobis semper exorent.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, for the sake of your confessor Juvenal, that a glorious confession may surround and protect us; may his merits always call forth your pity on our behalf.

text: Beati Dunstani confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine (de)precatione nos adiuva in cuius veneratione tua conti(n)gimus sacramenta.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to help us by the prayer of your confessor and bishop Dunstan, in whose honor we participate in your sacraments.

text: Beati Edmundi confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine precibus tibi munera offerenda complaceant et oblata nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the gifts offered to you in prayer for your confessor and bishop Edmund may please you, and may the offerings brought to us benefit us for our salvation.

text: Celeri nobis quaesumus Domine pietate
translation_en: Hasten to us, we beseech you, Lord, with mercy

text: Beati evangelistae Ioannis natalicia recolentes Domine sancta mysteria percepimus exorantes ut eius doctrinis tam de verbi tui divinitate perpetua quam de humanitate carius assumpta reddamur instructi.
translation_en: On the feast of St. John the Evangelist, we have received, Lord, your holy mysteries while remembering. We implore that through his teachings, both concerning the eternal divinity of your word and the more tender human aspect assumed by him, we may be made more instructed.

text: Beati evangelistae Ioannis Domine precibus adiuvemur ut quod possibilitas nostra non obtinet eius nobis intercessione donetur.
translation_en: Blessed evangelists John, Lord, we are helped by your prayers, that what is beyond our ability may be given to us through his intercession.

text: Beati evangelistae Ioannis nos Domine quaesumus merita prosequamur et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper implorent.
translation_en: Blessed evangelists John, we ask you, Lord, that your merits may follow us, and that we may always entreat your mercy towards us.

text: Beati evangelistae tui illius festivitate gaudentes clementiam tuam deprecamur omnipotens Deus ut tribuas nos iugiter eius confessione benedici et patrociniis confoveri.
translation_en: Blessed are the evangelists of yours, rejoicing on their feast day, we humbly ask your almighty God for clemency. May you grant us to be continuously blessed by his confession and to be sustained by his patronage.

text: Beati Gabrielis archangeli tui Deus noster sanctorumque omnium caelestium spirituum recolentes memoriam laetificet intercessio atque eorum sumpta veneratione sacramenta proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Blessed remembrance of your archangel Gabriel, our God, recalling the memory may be joyfully enriched by their intercession and taken up in veneration, the sacraments may advance to salvation.

text: Beati Gregorii martyris tui Domine natalicia recensentes illius quaesumus aggregari mereamur consortio cuius corpori communicamur et sanguini.
translation_en: On your blessed feast day of Saint Gregory the Martyr, Lord, we remember his recent birth. We humbly ask to be worthy of joining the company of whose body we share in Communion and whose blood we receive.

text: Beati Hermetis martyris tui intercessio nos Domine quaesumus et tuam nobis non desinat placare iustitiam et nos devotum tibi iugiter efficere famulatum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the intercession of the martyr Hermetes may not cease to appease justice for us. And may we, devoted to you, be continually made your servants.

text: Beati illius apostoli tui Domine veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: May the blessed feast of your apostle, Lord, increase our reverence and devotion, and bring us peace.

text: Beati illius confessoris tui atque abbatis precibus haec tibi Domine grata reddatur oblatio et per eam nostrum purifica famulatum.
translation_en: May the offering be pleasing to you, Lord, on account of the prayers of your confessor and abbot. Through it may our service be purified.

text: Beati illius martyris Domine suffragiis exoratus percepti sacramenti tui nos virtute defende.
translation_en: We humbly ask for the intercession of that martyr, Lord. Through your strength, protect us receiving your sacrament.

text: Beatae Afrae martyris tuae Domine suffragiis exoramus ut percepti sacramenti tui nos virtute defendas.
translation_en: We humbly entreat the blessings of your martyr Saint Africas, Lord, that through the power of your received sacrament you may protect us.

text: Beati illius confessoris tui atque pontificis Domine suffragiis exoramus ut percepta sacramenti tui virtute ab omnibus nos adversitatibus ubique defendas.
translation_en: We humbly implore your blessings, Lord, for the merits of your confessor and bishop. May you protect us everywhere from all adversities through the power of your sacrament.

text: Beati illius quaesumus Domine precibus adiuvemur ut tuam semper misericordiam percipere valeamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through your prayers we may always be able to perceive your constant mercy.

text: Beati Ioannis Baptistae nos quaesumus Domine praeclara comitetur oratio et quem venturum esse praedixit poscat ab eo sempiternum remedium.
translation_en: Blessed John the Baptist, we humbly ask you, Lord, may his renowned prayer accompany us. May he pray to him who predicted his coming that he grants us eternal salvation.

text: Beati Ioannis Baptistae nos Domine praeclara comitetur oratio et quem venturum esse praedixit poscat nobis favere placatum.
translation_en: Blessed John the Baptist, Lord, may his prayer accompany us and may he ask for us to be pleasing to us.

text: Beati Ioannis evangelistae quaesumus Domine supplicatione placatus et veniam nobis tribue et remedia sempiterna concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that, being appeased by our supplication, you grant us John the Evangelist's forgiveness and everlasting relief.

text: Beati Laurentii martyris honorabilem passionem muneribus Domine geminatis exsequimur quae licet propriis sit memoranda principiis indesinenter tamen permanet gloriosa.
translation_en: We honorably perform the meritorious passion of blessed Laurence, O Lord, with doubled gifts, which although they should be eternally remembered as his principles, nevertheless remain glorious.

text: Beati Laurentii martyris honorabilem passionem geminatis exsequimur muneribus offerentes quae et tibi Domine quaesumus grata fiant et nos a nostris emundent flagitiis et mente et corpore pariter purificent.
translation_en: We honorably perform the double passion of Blessed Laurence, the martyr, offering gifts to match. We humbly ask you, Lord, that these offerings be pleasing to you and cleanse us from our sins, both in mind and body.

text: Beati Laurentii martyris tui Domine geminata gratia nos refove(at) qua glorificationis eius et optatis praeimus officiis et desideranter exspectamus adventum.
translation_en: Blessed Lawrence, your martyr, Lord, may the doubled grace revive us, for whose glorification we begin our offices with fervent prayer and eagerly await his coming.

text: Beati Laurentii nos faciat Domine passio veneranda laetantes et ut eam sufficienter recolamus efficiat.
translation_en: May the Lord make the passion of Blessed Laurence venerable to us, that we may rejoice in it and that we may remember it sufficiently.

text: Beati martyris tui Genesii nos faciat Domine passio veneranda laetantes et ut eam sufficienter recolamus dignos efficiat.
translation_en: May your martyr Genesius, Lord, make us worthy to rejoice in his venerable passion, and may he make us fit enough to remember it appropriately.

text: Beati Marci evangelistae tui sollemnitate tibi munera deferentes quaesumus Domine ut sicut illum praedicatio evangelica fecit gloriosum ita nos eius intercessio et verbo et opere tibi reddat acceptos.
translation_en: On the solemnity of your blessed evangelist Mark, bringing gifts to you, we humbly ask, Lord, that just as the evangelical preaching made him glorious, so may his intercession and deeds render us acceptable to you through both word and deed.

text: Beati Martini confessoris tui Domine nobis patrocinio suffragante has oblationes offerimus divinae maiestati tuae deprecantes ut benigne clementerque suscipias quae animabus fidelium defunctorum remedium et requiem ac viventibus indulgentiam et salutem conferant sempiternam.
translation_en: We present these offerings to your divine majesty, Lord, with the intercession of your confessor Martin. We humbly ask that you graciously and mercifully receive them, so that they provide remedy and eternal rest for the souls of the faithful departed, and grant indulgence and salvation to the living.

text: Beati Martini pontificis quaesumus Domine nobis pia non desit oratio quae et munera nostra conciliet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper obtineat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the prayer for Blessed Pope Martin may never fail us. May it bring together our offerings and always grant us your indulgence.

text: Beati martyris tui illius nos quaesumus Domine praeclara comitetur oratio et misericordiam tuam nobis indesinenter imploret.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, may the glorious prayer of Your martyr accompany us, and may he continually beg Your mercy on our behalf.

text: Beati martyris tui illius nos quaesumus Domine patrociniis collatis non deseras qui fragilitatem nostram et meritis tueatur et precibus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to not forget us, strengthened by the patronage of your martyr. May he protect us from our frailty and defend us with his merits.

text: Clamantes ad te Deus dignanter exaudi
translation_en: God, graciously hear our cries to you

text: Beati martyris tui illius nos quaesumus Domine gloriosa merita prosequamur quae fragilitatem nostram et precibus tueantur et meritis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to follow the glorious merits of your martyr on behalf of us. May their prayers protect our frailty, and may their merits intercede for us.

text: Beati martyris tui illius nos quaesumus Domine precibus adiuvemur et eius digna sollemnia celebrantes tuo nomini fac nos semper esse devotos.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to support us with your prayers as we celebrate the solemnities of your martyr. May we always be devoted to your name.

text: Beati martyris tui illius votivus natalis nobis quaesumus Domine iucunditatem suae glorificationis infundat et tibi nos reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, on the feast day of your martyr's vow, may he pour out for us the joyfulness of his glorification and make us acceptable to you.

text: Beati martyris tui Laurentii Domine quaesumus intercessione nos protege et animam famuli tui illius episcopi sanctorum tuorum iunge consortiis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your martyr Laurentius, you protect us and unite the soul of your servant, that bishop, with the company of your saints.

text: Beati martyris tui Symphoriani Domine nos tuere praesidiis ut cuius festivitatem annua devotione recolimus eius intercessionibus ab omnibus adversitatibus eruamur.
translation_en: Blessed are you, Lord, the martyr Symphorian. May we be protected by your guardianship, so that we who annually remember his feast day with devotion, may be freed from all adversities through his intercessions.

text: Beati Nicolai confessoris tui atque pontificis Domine suffragiis adiuti ab hostium liberemur insidiis atque caelesti benedictione repletos tua nos semper virtute defende.
translation_en: May the blessed Nicholas, your confessor and pope, Lord, with your help be delivered from the snares of our enemies and filled with heavenly blessing. Always protect us by your power.

text: Beati nobis quaesumus Domine Iuvenalis et confessio semper prosit et meritum.
translation_en: Blessed are we, Lord, we humbly ask, that Juvenal and confession may always prosper and be rewarding.

text: Beati nos Domine baptistae Ioannis oratio et intellegere Christi tui mysterium postulet et mereri.
translation_en: Bless us, Lord, pray for us as Baptist John did, and seek to understand and merit the mystery of your Christ.

text: Beati Otmari confessoris supplicatione quaesumus Domine plebs tua benedictionem percipiat ut de eius meritis et feliciter glorietur et aeternae societatis laetitia gratuletur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the supplication of Blessed Otmar, that your people may receive Your blessing so that they may rejoice in his merits and prosperously glorify him, and may be graced with the joy of eternal fellowship.

text: Beati Pancratii martyris tui Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporali celebramus actione perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: Blessed Pancratius, your martyr, Lord, through your intervention, we humbly ask that you grant us, so that what we celebrate temporarily in our actions, we may obtain eternal salvation.

text: Beati pontificis et confessoris tui Zenonis quaesumus Domine a malis omnibus gloriosa nos semper merita tueantur in cuius sollemnitate percepimus tua sancta laetantes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the blessings of your pontiff and confessor Zenon are always protecting us from all evils, in whose solemnity we have perceived your holy rejoicing.

text: Beati pontificis tui Silvestri nos Domine gloriosa confessio tueatur ut dum eius pia celebramus merita nobis profutura ipsius sentiamus auxilia.
translation_en: Blessed be thy pontiff Silvester, O Lord, may the glorious confession of thine protect us, so that while we celebrate his pious deeds, we may feel his aid to be profitable for us.

text: Beati Proti nos Domine et Hyacinthi foveat pretiosa confessio et pia iugiter intercessio tueatur.
translation_en: Blessed be Porphyrius and Hyacinth for us, O Lord. May their precious confession shield us, and may their constant intercession protect us.

text: Beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui Eustorgii nos quaesumus Domine foveat pretiosa confessio et pia iugiter intercessio tueatur.
translation_en: Blessed are thy priests and confessors, Eustorgius, we beseech you, Lord. May his precious confession be guarded, and may his constant intercession protect him forever.

text: Beatorum illorum nos Domine foveat pretiosa confessio et pia iugiter intercessio tueatur.
translation_en: O Lord, may the precious confession of those blessed ones protect us, and their constant pious intercession watch over us.

text: Beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui illius Domine precibus adiuvemur pro cuius sollemnitate offerimus munera tibi sancta laetantes.
translation_en: We are helped by the prayers of your blessed priest and confessor, Lord, whose solemnity we offer gifts to you, rejoicing in the holy ones.

text: Beati sacerdotis et martyris tui Apollinaris annua festivitate ovantes clementiam tuam supplices exoramus omnipotens Deus ut sicut ille ob tanti agonem certaminis triumphali redimitus exsultat corona ita et nos orationum illius fulti suffragio temptationum tela superantes bravio laetemur aeterno.
translation_en: Blessed are the priest and martyr Thy Apollinaris on his annual feast day, we humbly beseech Your clemency, O Almighty God, that as he was triumphantly released from such great struggle in the contest, so we too, filled with his prayers' support, might overcome the temptations' weapons and rejoice boldly in eternal joy.

text: Beati sacerdotis et martyris tui Xysti nos quaesumus Domine frequentantes sollemnia et sacerdotalis instruat te miserante doctrina et gloriosi martyrii foveant ubique suffragia.
translation_en: Blessed are the priest and martyr Ypistius, we humbly ask you, Lord. May they who frequent your solemnities be instructed by your merciful teaching, and may their prayers for the glorious martyr's intercession be everywhere effective.

text: Beati Tiburtii nos Domine foveant continuata praesidia quia non desines propitius intueri quos talibus auxiliis concesseris adiuvari.
translation_en: Blessed be Thou, Lord, may the continual protection of St. Tiburtius shield us, for Thou never ceaseth to look upon favorably those whom Thou hast granted such assistance to aid.

text: Beati Xysti Domine tui sacerdotis et martyris annua festa recolentes quaesumus ut quae votorum nobis sunt instrumenta praesentium fiant aeternorum patrocinia gaudiorum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, on the annual feast of Your priest and martyr Xystus, remembering him, that the instruments of our vows become eternal patronages of joy.

text: Beatis martyribus supplicantibus Domine fideles tuos propitiatus intende; tui sunt Domine tibique subiecti; benedictiones tuas te largiente iugiter assequantur quas humiliter et indesinenter exspectant sed ut munera collata custodiant pie iusteque sperata percipiant.
translation_en: Blessed are the faithful martyrs who supplicate, Lord, have mercy on your servants; they are yours, Lord, and subject to you. May they always attain your blessings as you bestow them, whom humbly and unceasingly expect, but that the gifts received may be kept piously and justly received according to what is hoped for.

text: Beatissimo spiritus per quem condita sunt universa suppliciter tuas exaudire digneris famulas pro quibus has tuae porrigimus pietati preces ut quemadmodum tuo felici sancto iuvamine optant liberari ita suffragiis beatissimae matris Dei lumen gratiae tuae in earum celeri expeditione infundere digneris.
translation_en: Most blessed Spirit through whom all things were created, graciously deign to hear the supplications of your servants for whom we offer these petitions. May it please you, as those who desire to be freed by your happy holy aid, to bestow the light of your grace upon them swiftly through the intercession of the most blessed Mother of God.

text: Beatissimi Domine martyris tui Genesii sollemnia celebrantes in conspectu maiestatis tuae hanc offerimus pro delictis nostris hostiam; imploramus igitur immensam clementiam tuam ut acceptabilis sit tibi et quaecumque supplices iuste deprecamur clemens concedere digneris.
translation_en: Beating Lord, in the presence of your majesty, we celebrate the feast days of your martyr Genesius. We offer this sacrifice for our sins; therefore, we humbly implore your immense mercy, that it may be acceptable to you and grant whatever justly we humbly ask as a merciful God.

text: Beatissimi Leudegarii martyris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine Deus noster fideli devotione sollemnia celebrantes concede propitius ut qui ei post triumphum martyrii palmam gloriae contulisti eius interventu medelam tuae propitiationis omnium nostrorum facinorum obtinere mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, while we faithfully and solemnly celebrate the blessed Leudegar, your martyr and bishop, that you graciously grant us to deserve the healing of all our sins through his intervention after the triumph of his martyrdom, and to obtain the palm of glory.

text: Beatissimorum confessorum tuorum Domine patrocinia postulantes supplices quaesumus ut has hostias quas in honorem eorum offerimus pia devotione suscipi iubeas.
translation_en: Humbly asking You, Lord, we beseech Your protection for the most blessed confessors of yours. We pray that You command these offerings, which we present with devotion in their honor, to be received.

text: Beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Donati Felicis Arontii et fratrum eorum nos quaesumus Domine merita adiuvent et sicut pro nominis tui gloria suum sanguinem effuderunt ita et pro nobis te largiente intercessores exsistant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the merits of your blessed martyrs Donat, Felicitas, Arontius and their brothers may assist us. Just as they shed their blood for your glory, so may they be intercessors for us, through your generous provision.

text: Beatissimorum nos quaesumus Domine martyrum tuorum Eustachii cum sociis suis veneranda passio tueatur ut sicut illos a ferarum morsibus igniumque cruciatibus eruisti ita nos quoque a spiritalibus bestiis noxiisque incendiis liberare digneris.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect the blessed martyrs Eustachius and his companions, that their venerable passion may keep us safe, just as you freed them from the bites of wild beasts and the torments of fire, so may you deem us worthy to be freed also from spiritual beasts and harmful fires.

text: Beato confessore tuo atque pontifice illo intercedente quaesumus omnipotens Deus munera suscipe et ab omnibus nos peccatis propitiatus absolve ut percepta venia peccatorum liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, with that confessor and bishop interceding for us, to receive our offerings and forgive us all our sins, that we may serve you with guilt-free minds, having been absolved through the merits of forgiven sins.

text: Beatorum apostolorum Domine quaesumus intercessione nos adiuva pro quorum sollemnitate percepimus tua sancta laetantes.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that through the intercession of the blessed apostles, you help us too. We rejoice in celebrating their solemnity and honor your holy self.

text: Beati apostoli tui Iacobi cuius hodie festivitate corpore et sanguine tuo nos refecisti quaesumus Domine intercessione nos adiuva pro cuius sollemnitate percepimus tua sancta laetantes.
translation_en: Blessed are thy apostles, James, whose feast day we celebrate today, by whom thou didst restore us both in body and blood, we beseech Thee, Lord. Grant us help through his intercession; for whose solemnity we have received Thy holy rejoicing.

text: Beatorum martyrum et consessorum illorum vel quorum hodie natalicia celebratur intercedentibus meritis quaesumus Domine gratia tua nos protege et famulis vel famulabus tuis qui nobis eleemosynas suas condonaverunt tam vivis quam et defunctis seu iter agentibus vel domo residentibus misericordiam tuam Domine ubique praetende ut ab omnibus impugnationibus defensi tua opitulatione salventur et indulgentiam quam semper optaverunt piis supplicationibus consequantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the merits of those blessed martyrs and their companions, whose natalicia is today celebrated, they may intercede for us. Protect us with your grace and have mercy on the servants or servant-like people who have forgiven alms to us, both living and dead, as well as those journeying or residing at home. May your mercy be everywhere present, Lord, that we may be defended against all attacks through your support and saved. May they also obtain the indulgence which they have always longed for through their pious supplications.

text: Beatorum apostolorum martyrum et confessorum virginum et omnium sanctorum tuorum quaesumus Domine intercessionibus nos protege et famulis et famulabus tuis quorum commemorationem agimus misericordiam tuam ubi que praetende ut ab omnibus impugnationibus defensi tua opitulatione salventur et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum scripta esse videntur quorum nomina et numerum tu solus Domine cognoscis cunctorum tribue remissionem peccatorum ut indulgentiam quam semper optaverunt piis supplicationibus consequantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercession of your blessed apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all your saints, to protect us and your servants and handmaids whose commemoration we make. May your mercy be upon us, where you extend help that we may be defended from all attacks by your protection, and save the souls of your servants and handmaids whose names are written before your holy altar, whose names and number only you, Lord, know. Grant them remission of sins, so that they may obtain the indulgence which they have always longed for with their devout prayers.

text: Beatorum apostolorum Domine Petri et Pauli desiderata sollemnia recensentes praesta quaesumus ut eorum supplicationibus muniamur quorum tegimur principatu.
translation_en: Lord, as we celebrate the desired feast days of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, we humbly ask that you grant us protection through their intercession, under whose leadership we are shielded.

text: Beatorum apostolorum nos Domine quaesumus continua oratione custodi ut iisdem suffragatoribus dirigatur ecclesia quibus principibus gloriatur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your continuous prayer protect us, so that we may have those blessed apostles as our advocates, to whom the church glories with its princes.

text: Beatorum confessorum Domine natalicia praeeuntes supplices te rogamus ut quos caelesti gloria sublimasti tuis adesse concedas fidelibus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord of the blessed confessors, that on their feast days, you grant that those whom heavenly glory has exalted be present to the faithful.

text: Beatorum confessorum tuorum Domine Remigii Germani Vedasti Bavonis Wasnulfi atque Piati gloriosa confessio nobis piae devotionis augmentum conferat qui in tuo nomine fidentes meruerunt honorari.
translation_en: May the glorious confessions of your blessed confessors, Remigius, Germanus, Vedastus, Babo, Wasnulf, and Piat, Lord, increase our pious devotion. Those who have merited to be honored in your name, may they confer it upon us.

text: Beatorum martyrum pariterque pontificum Cornelii et Cypriani nos Domine quaesumus festa tueantur et eorum commendet oratio veneranda atque laetificet.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the feast days of the blessed martyrs Cornelius and Cyprian may protect us, and may their sacred prayer comfort and bring joy to us.

text: Beatorum martyrum Domine Saturnini et Chrysanthi adsit oratio ut quos obsequio veneramur pio iugiter experiamur auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, may the prayers of the blessed martyrs Saturninus and Chrysanthus be present, so that we who revere them with due reverence may always experience their aid through divine help.

text: Beatae Mariae semper virginis Domine quaesumus adsit ubique oratio ut quam devoto plebs tua veneratur obsequio suffragari sibi pio iugiter experiatur auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the Blessed Virgin Mary be present everywhere. May her prayer always help our devoted people to experience her constant aid through devoted service.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum Domine Crispini et Crispiniani festivitate laetantes te suppliciter deprecamur ut quos in caelesti gloria novimus fulgere pro nobis intercedere iugiter sentiamus.
translation_en: With joy we celebrate the feast of your blessed martyrs, Lord Crispin and Crispinian. We humbly beseech you that those whom we know shine in celestial glory for us may constantly feel interceding on our behalf.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum Domine Maximiani Malchi et Martiniani eorumque sociorum nos praeclara attollat interventio et praesta ut illis digna sit nostra veneratio et per eos necessitati nostrae tua semper satisfaciat miseratio.
translation_en: Lord, may the mercies of your holy martyrs Maximianus, Malchius, Martinianus and their companions raise us up with their intervention. Grant us that our veneration is worthy for them, and through them may our need always find satisfaction in your mercy.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum Donati et Carpophori nos quaesumus Domine corona laetificet et fidei nostrae praebeat incitamenta virtutum et multiplici nos suffragio consoletur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may the crowns of your blessed martyrs Donatus and Carpophorus bring us joy and provide encouragement for our faith. May their abundant intercession comfort us.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum Faustini et Iovittae oblata quaesumus Domine honore munera suscipe et nos eorum meritis a cunctis defende periculis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept the offerings for your blessed martyrs Faustinus and Jovita. Grant them honor and bestow their gifts upon them. Defend us, through their merits, from all dangers.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum nos Domine precibus et intercessione defende ut qui nostrae conscientiae fiduciam non habemus placentium tibi meritis protegamur.
translation_en: Lord, defend us by the prayers and intercession of your blessed martyrs, so that we who do not have faith in our conscience may be protected by their merits.

text: Beatorum martyrum tuorum Timothei et Apollinaris Domine intercessione placatus concede quaesumus ut sacramenti tui veneranda perceptio fiat omnium peccatorum nostrorum remissio.
translation_en: Lord, through the intercession of your blessed martyrs Timothy and Apollinaris, we humbly ask that you grant us, with the reception of your sacred rite, the forgiveness of all our sins.

text: Beatorum Petri et Pauli honore continuo plebs tua semper exsultet et his praesulibus gubernetur quorum et doctrinis gaudet et meritis.
translation_en: May your people always rejoice continuously in the honor of Blessed Peter and Paul, and be governed by these bishops whom they both delight in doctrine and revere for their merits.

text: Beatorum apostolorum Philippi et Iacobi honore continuo Domine plebs tua semper exsultet et his praesulibus gubernetur quorum et doctrinis gaudet et meritis.
translation_en: May your people, Lord, always rejoice with the constant honor of the Blessed Apostles Philip and James, and may they be governed by these bishops whom they both delight in their teachings and reap benefits from their deeds.

text: Beatus Andreas pro nobis Domine quaesumus imploret apostolus ut nostris reatibus absoluti cunctis etiam periculis eruamur.
translation_en: Blessed Andrew, on our behalf Lord, we humbly ask that the apostle intercedes for us so that we may be absolved from our sins and freed from all dangers as well.

text: Beatus apostolus tuus ille Domine quaesumus te pro nobis imploret ut a nostris reatibus absoluti a cunctis etiam periculis eruamur.
translation_en: Blessed is your apostle, O Lord, we humbly ask that he may intercede for us with you, that we may be absolved from our sins and freed from all dangers as well.

text: Beatus levita Stephanus Domine nobis mysterium quod sumpsimus efficiat salutare qui post mortem Filii tui laurea martyrum primus meruit coronari.
translation_en: Blessed deacon Stephen, Lord, the mystery which we have received may it be beneficial for us. He who first deserved to be crowned with a wreath of martyrs after the death of Your Son.

text: Beatus martyr Stephanus Domine quaesumus pro fidelibus tuis suffragator accedat qui dum bene sit tibi placitus pro his etiam possit audiri.
translation_en: Blessed martyr Stephen, Lord, we humbly ask that you may be a supplicant for your faithful. May he approach you who, while pleasing to you, may also be heard on their behalf.

text: Beatus martyr tuus Blasius Domine nobis misericordiae tuae imploret auxilium ut cuius festa celebramus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: May your blessed martyr Blaise, Lord, beseech your mercy for us, that we may feel his patronage with you as we celebrate his feast day.

text: Beatus martyr tuus Domine Bonifatius cum sociis suis qui  te in sua glorificavit passione nos sua tueatur intercessione.
translation_en: Blessed is your martyr, Lord Boniface, with his companions who glorified you through their passion. May they protect us by their intercession.

text: Beatus Maurilio confessor tuus atque pontifex sua nos Domine depositione laetificet et pro nobis tibi supplicans copiosius audiatur.
translation_en: Blessed Maurice, your confessor and bishop, may delight us with your departure from the world, O Lord, and may his prayers on our behalf be heard more abundantly by you as we humbly pray.

text: Beatus Pantaleon martyr tuus Domine qui diversis suppliciis maceratus vera et viva factus est hostia haec quae tibi offerimus ad salutem nostram gratificet sua intercessione libamina.
translation_en: Blessed Pantaleon, your martyr, Lord, who was tortured with various torments and made a true and living sacrifice that we offer to you for our salvation. May his intercession make the cup of incense pleasing to you.

text: Beatus Pantaleon martyr tuus Domine qui diversis suppliciis maceratus viva et vera facta est oblatio haec tibi ad salutem nostram gratificet libamina.
translation_en: Blessed Pantaleon, your martyr, Lord, who was tortured with various torments and made an offering of yourself in life and truth, may this offering bring satisfaction to You for our salvation. Amen.

text: Beatus sacerdos et confessor tuus ille quaesumus Domine sua nos intercessione apud te commendet ut tibi placito fulti suffragio quam precamur indulgentiam peccatorum consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your blessed priest and confessor may recommend us to you with his intercession, so that we, being filled with the assistance we pray for, may deserve to receive the indulgence of sins.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus veniam…
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we ask, forgiveness...

text: Beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui Udalrici quaesumus Domine tibi nos intercessio gloriosa commendet ut eius suffulti suffragio quam precamur indulgentiam peccatorum consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the blessed priest and confessor Udalricus may present our glorious intercession to you. May we merit to obtain the indulgence for our sins through his support and intercession which we pray for.

text: Beatus ille martyr quaesumus Domine pia nos intercessione commendet ut tibi placito fulti suffragio quam non meremur indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: Blessed is that martyr whom we humbly ask, Lord, may through his pious intercession recommend us, so that filled with your pleasure, we may obtain the indulgence that we do not deserve.

text: Beatus sacerdos et confessor tuus ille quaesumus Domine sua nos intercessione laetificet et pie faciat in sua sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: Blessed be your priest and confessor, we ask you, Lord. May he rejoice and make us happy with his intercession during his solemnity.

text: Benedic anima mea domino et tota fidelis Christo plebs gaudia religiosae gratulationis exsequere; amisit vetustas opprobrium mors aculeum custodia reum catena damnatum. Non nobis in praeiudicio caro rebellis adsurgat; non in dominatum sanguis parricidalis iure criminis intumescat. Homo est qui perdidit; Deus homo factus est qui redemit. Maiorem tibi exegit Domine pietatem nostra calamitas quam perdiderat protoplaustorum effusa libertas.  Tunc servi dicebamur futuri nunc filii. Tunc oboedientibus immortalitas promittebatur nunc augetur et dignitas. Tunc portio habenda cum deliciis nunc communio futura cum angelis. Tunc cum creatura vivendum nunc cum creatore regnandum. Tunc evitandus diabolus nunc et subiciendus edicitur. Tunc erat admonitio de cautela praecepti nunc hortatio de pompa iudicii. Tunc proponebatur in lege metus nunc in voluntate suggestus. Tunc non licuit paradisum habere per culpam nunc caelum sperare datur per gratiam.  Melius ergo multoque melius crevimus post ruinam. Propter quod humillimi sine cessatione rogamus ut donec nos tua curatione perficias nostris tuam vulneribus non subtrahas medicinam. Quia tu es Deus noster ante cuius conspectum angelorum gloria apostolorum et martyrum nomina recitantur.
translation_en:
Bless my soul, Lord, and the entire faithful flock of Christ rejoice in performing religious joyful greetings; death has lost its old shame, the sting of death the guardianship of sinners, the chains of damnation. May not rebellious flesh rise up against us in judgment; may not the blood of the murderer swell with the right of crime. He who has lost is man; God, who became man, has redeemed him. O Lord, our calamity has shown greater mercy towards us than the loss of original freedom by the first protoplasts.
Then we were called servants, now we are called sons. Then immortality was promised to the obedient, now it is increased and dignity. Then a portion with delights was to be held, now a future communion with angels. Then to live with creation, now to reign with the Creator. Then to avoid the devil, now and to be subjected to him. Then there was an admonition about caution in commandments, now an encouragement about the pomp of judgment. Then fear was presented in law, now suggested by will. Then it was not allowed to have paradise through sin, now heaven is given through grace.
Therefore, we have greatly and much improved after ruin. For this reason, the humblest continue to beg without ceasing that you may not withdraw your medicine from our wounds until you have completed us with your care. Because you are our God before whose presence the glory of angels, the names of apostles, and martyrs are recited.

text: Benedic Domine coronam anni benignitatis tuae ut et campi tui ubertate pinguedinis repleantur et nos qui in convalle plorationis consistimus abundantia pacis ac dulcedinis redundemus.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, the crown of the year of your goodness, so that even your fields may be filled with rich abundance and we who are situated in the valley of lamentation may overflow with peace and sweetness.

text: Benedic Domine hanc familiam tuam in caelestibus et reple eam donis tuis spiritalibus; concede eis caritatem gaudium pacem patientiam bonitatem mansuetudinem spem fidem continentiam ut repleti omnibus donis tuis desiderantes ad te pervenire mereantur.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this family of yours in heaven and fill it with your spiritual gifts; grant them love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, gentleness, faithfulness, self-control, so that being filled with all your gifts, they may deserve to come to you.

text: Benedic Domine huic hostiae in honorem tui nominis tibi oblatae et sumentium ex ea sanctifica mentem et purifica voluntatem.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, this offering presented to your honorable name, and sanctify their minds, and purify their wills.

text: Benedic Domine nostrae abstinentiae votum; inspice petitionis effectum. Suscipiens quoque hoc sacrificium dona cunctis ex eo sumentibus et criminibus expiari et copia benedictionis attolli.
translation_en: Bless, Lord, our abstinence vow; consider the outcome of our petition. Also receiving this sacrifice, grant to all who partake from it forgiveness for their sins and an increase in blessings.

text: Benedic quaesumus Domine hoc sacrificium nostrum quo per eum et peccata dispereant et nostrorum votorum ieiunia coram te sanctificata permaneant.
translation_en: Bless, we ask you, Lord, this our sacrifice, so that through it our sins may disappear and our fasts, sanctified before you, may remain.

text: Benedic quaesumus Domine plebem tuam et beati Petri apostoli tui precibus tribue consequi tuae defensionis auxilium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to bless your people and grant through the prayers of blessed Peter your apostle, they may obtain aid from your defense.

text: Benedic quaesumus Domine plebem tuam et sanctorum tuorum deprecationibus confidentem tribue consequi quod sperare donasti.
translation_en: Bless, we ask you, Lord, your people and grant that they who trust in the prayers of your saints may obtain what you have given to hope for.

text: Benedicat vos Deus omni benedictione caelesti sanctosque ac puros efficiat in conspectu suo; superabundent in vos divitiae gloriae eius verbo veritatis instruat et evangelio salutis erudiat omniumque sanctorum caritate locupletet.
translation_en: May God bless you with all celestial blessings, make you holy and pure in His sight; may His divine riches overflow for you, let Him instruct you with the word of truth, enlighten you with the gospel of salvation, and enrich you with the charity of all saints.

text: Benedicat vos Deus omnipotens omni benedictione caelesti efficiatque vos dignos in conspectu suo; superabundet in vobis divitias gloriae suae et erudiat vos verbo veritatis ut ei corpore pariter et mente complacere valeatis.
translation_en: May the Almighty God bless you with all heavenly blessings, and make you worthy in His sight. May His divine riches of glory overflow upon you, and may He instruct you with the word of truth so that you can be pleasing to Him both in body and mind.

text: Benedicimus Domine misericordias tuas qui nos incessabiliter beati apostoli tui Petri sinis commemoratione foveri suppliciter exorantes ut cuius sollemnia gerimus patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: We bless you, Lord, with your mercies, who sustain us continually in the remembrance of the incessable blessings of your apostle Peter. Humbly we entreat that we may feel the patronage as we celebrate his solemnities.

text: Benedicte Deus et pater universitatis et substantiae omnis creator condens unicuique naturae demutabilem legem et ipse liber a lege naturae mortem perimens diabolum infirmans malitiam exstinguens sanctificationem tribuens immortalitatem perficiens et infirmitatem expellens atque immensitatem tuam capacem fidelium tibi animarum accommodans sanctitati.  Qui ad depellendos mundi huius errores et omnem malignae potentiae naturam coarguendam verbum et virtutem et sapientiam tuam Deum ac Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum consortem caducae carnis nostrae esse voluisti. Per quem tibi gratias agimus ob hunc verum et consummatum et ad salutem generis humani pretiosa sua passione perfectum paschae diem in quo inferos adiit mortem vicit diabolum coarguit et leges tartari solvit; in homine suo a quo mortis condicione discesserat coexcitaturus universae carnis quae in se esset generanda naturam.  Ob quod facito nos omnipotens Pater ut hunc sanctum in progenies et memorabilem in generationem diem confitentes non in amaritudine veterum azimorum neque in anterioris malitiae fermento sed in nova et sincera renatae innocentiae conspersione celebremus liberati et regenerati sanctificati et coronati.
translation_en:
Blessed be God and Father of the university and substance of all, the creator who condenses an unchangeable law for each mutable nature and himself frees from the law of nature death, weakens the devil, extinguishes malice, grants sanctification, performs immortality, expels weakness, and encompasses your immensity to accommodate faithful souls.
Who wished that your word, power, and wisdom be for driving away the errors of this world and for loading any evil power's nature, our God and Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, consorted with the decaying flesh of ours. Through whom we give thanks to you because of this true and completed day for the salvation of the human race, made precious by his own passion, on which he entered the underworld, conquered death, overcame the devil, and dissolved the laws of Tartarus; in his person, who had departed from the condition of death, he revives all flesh that is to be generated.
Therefore, O almighty Father, make this holy day memorable in our offspring and generation, not in the bitterness of ancient wines nor in the ferment of previous malice but in the new and sincere flood of regenerated innocence. We celebrate our liberation and regeneration, sanctified and crowned.

text: Benedictio Domine quaesumus in tuos fideles copiosa descendat et quam subiectis cordibus expetunt largiter consequantur.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that your blessing abundantly descends upon your faithful and may they generously obtain what they ardently seek.

text: Benedictio quaesumus Domine in tuos fideles copiosa descendat et quam subiectis cordibus expetunt largiter consequantur quoniam sicut superbis resistis sic humilibus tuis gratiam benignus impendis.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that your blessings abundantly descend upon your faithful and let them obtain what they eagerly seek with generosity, for just as you resist the proud, so you shower your grace upon your humble ones.

text: Benedictio tua Domine quaesumus mihi famulo tuo copiosa descendat et quam subiectis cordibus expeto largiter consequar.
translation_en: Your blessing, Lord, I humbly ask for me, your servant, may abundantly descend and what I eagerly expect with a generous heart, may I obtain generously.

text: Benedictio tua Deus impleat corda fidelium talesque perficiat qui et martyrum honorificent passiones et remedia salutis aeternae iisdem patrocinantibus assequamur.
translation_en: May Your blessing, God, fill the hearts of the faithful, and may those who honor the sufferings of the martyrs and seek eternal salvation through their patronage attain it.

text: Benedictio tua Domine quaesumus per haec sancta mysteria tuorum impleat corda fidelium ut et sanctorum martyrum tuorum Gervasii et Protasii honorificent passiones et remedia salutis aeternae quae expetunt iisdem patrocinantibus assequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask for your blessing, Lord, through these holy mysteries of yours, that the hearts of the faithful may be filled, so that they may honor the sufferings and eternal salvation remedies sought by them, and that we may attain those same ones through their patronage.

text: Benedictio tua Domine beati Benedicti confessoris intercessione super has hostias descendat quae et benedictionem nobis clementer operetur et beatae immortalitatis dona conciliet.
translation_en: May your blessing, Lord, descend upon these offerings through the intercession of Blessed Benedict the Confessor. May it graciously bestow its blessing upon us and unite us with the blessed gift of immortality.

text: Benedictio tua Domine larga descendat quae munera nostra deprecante beata Euphemia tibi reddat accepta et nobis sacramentum redemptionis efficiat.
translation_en: May Your bounty, Lord, descend abundantly, which through our prayers to blessed Euphemia you have accepted and may make us partakers of the sacrament of redemption.

text: Benedictio tua Domine larga descendat quae munera nostra deprecante sancto Marco consessore tuo atque pontifice tibi reddat accepta et nobis sacramentum redemptionis efficiat.
translation_en: May Your bounty, Lord, descend abundantly, which gifts through our petition to Saint Mark, Your consecrated bishop and pope, are offered to You and may become for us a sacrament of redemption.

text: Benedictio tua Domine larga descendat quae et munera nostra deprecantibus sanctis tuis tibi reddat accepta et nobis sacramentum redemptionis efficiat.
translation_en: May your blessing, Lord, be abundantly bestowed, which through our prayers to your saints is returned to you graciously accepted. May it make effective for us the sacrament of redemption.

text: Benedictio tua Domine super populum supplicantem copiosa descendat ut qui te factore conditus te est reparatus auctore te iugiter operante salvetur.
translation_en: May Your blessing, Lord, abundantly descend upon the people who are supplicating, so that those who were created by You and are being restored by You as their Author, may be continually saved by Your operation.

text: Benedictionem Domine nobis conferat salutarem sacra semper oblatio ut quod agit mysterio virtute perficiat.
translation_en: May the Lord grant us a blessed benediction, may our constant offering of sacred rites always make what is done in mystery effective through His power.

text: Benedictionem tuam Domine his confer muneribus et sanctorum Chrysanthi et Dariae virginis precibus misericordiae tuae munus in tuis operare fidelibus.
translation_en: Bestow your blessing, Lord, upon these servants with the gifts of Chrysanthus and Daria, the virgins; may the office of your mercy be performed among your faithful through their prayers.

text: Benedictionem tuam Domine his tibi oblatis tribue sacrificiis et praesta ut beata Maria Magdalena hoc nobis apud te obtineat quod ab unigenito tuo obtinuit dum ei mystica obsequia exhibuit.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, your blessing to these offerings you have received. And may it please you that blessed Mary Magdalene obtains for us at your presence what she obtained from your Unigenitus when she rendered him mystical service.

text: Benedictionem tuam Domine populo supplicanti benignus accumula ut et de bona conversatione sui praesulis exsultet et de sacrae festivitatis celebritate laetetur.
translation_en: Bless your people, Lord, graciously accumulate your blessing upon the supplicant, so that they may rejoice from good conduct of their pastor and be joyful from the celebrations of the holy festival.

text: Benedictionem tuam Domine populo suppliciter imploranti medicinam tribue mentis et corporis ut incessabiliter devotis semper tua beneficia largiaris.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, Your blessing to the people humbly beseeching You; bestow on them a medicine for mind and body, so that they may always distribute Your benefits incessantly with unfailing devotion.

text: Benedictionem tuam Domine populus fidelis accipiat qua corpore salvatus ac mente et congruam tibi semper exhibeat servitutem et propitiationis tuae beneficia semper inveniat.
translation_en: May the faithful people receive Your blessing, O Lord, who, saved by body, may always show You service of mind and conscience that is fitting to You. May they always find the benefits of Your propitiations.

text: Benedictionem tuam Domine populus fidelis accipiat qua corpore salvatus ac mente et gratam tibi semper exhibeat servitutem et propitiationis tuae beneficia semper inveniat.
translation_en: May the faithful people receive Your blessing, O Lord, whom You have saved both body and mind, and may they always show You grateful service and find the benefits of Your propitiation.

text: Benedictionem tuam quaesumus Domine sacrae plebi copiosa pietate largire quae per tuam tibi gratiam semper reddatur accepta.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to bestow your blessing abundantly upon this holy congregation, rich in piety, that which is always returned to you as gratitude through your grace may be received.

text: Benedictionis tuae gratiam Domine intercedente beato apostolo tuo illo suscipiamus ut cuius praeveniendo gloriam celebramus eius supplicando auxilium sentiamus.
translation_en: We receive the grace of your blessing, Lord, with the intervention of your blessed Apostle. May we celebrate the glory of him whom we anticipate by making our petition for his aid, and feel his help.

text: Benedictionis tuae Domine gratiam intercedente beata Waltpurgae virgine tua consequamur ut cuius venerando gloriam praedicamus eius in omnibus nostris necessitatibus auxilium sentiamus.
translation_en: We shall follow the blessing of Thy grace, Lord, through the intercession of blessed Walpurga, thy Virgin. That we may proclaim her venerable glory and feel her help in all our necessities.

text: Benedictionis tuae gratiam Domine plebs christiana suscipiat ut sanctorum merita pretiosa concelebrans honoris tui fructum referat pia sollemnitate pontificum.
translation_en: May the Christian people receive your blessing, Lord, so that celebrating the precious merits of the saints, they may bring forth the fruit of your honor with pious solemnity and in the presence of the bishops.

text: Benedictionis tuae quaesumus Domine plebs tibi sacra fructus reportet et gaudium ut quod in huius festivitatis die corporali servitio exhibuit spiritaliter se retulisse cognoscat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your blessing may be reported by the people and that they may know with joy that what they offered on this festival day in physical service has been spiritually returned to themselves.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus et famulum tuum…
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, almighty God, and your servant...

text: Benedictionis tuae Domine plebs tibi devota fructum reportet et gaudium ut quod sanctis martyribus tuis Felici Simplicio Faustino et Beatrici exhibuit temporali servitio perenni praesidio consequatur.
translation_en: Your blessing, Lord, the devoted people will bring back the fruit and joy, so that what was offered to your holy martyrs Felicitas, Simplicius, Faustinus, and Beatrix during temporary service may achieve eternal protection.

text: Benedictionum tuarum ubertate repleti quaesumus Domine ut omnium sanctorum confessorum tuorum intercessione eius semper subsidiis multiplicemur et donis.
translation_en: Filled with the abundance of your blessings, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of all your saints and confessors, we may always be increased in numbers and enriched with gifts.

text: Beneficia tua Domine plebs tua reportet sancti Felicis precatione collata ut cuius officiis devota non deest sumptis gaudeat adiumentis.
translation_en: Your benefits, Lord, Your people will report through Saint Felicitas' prayers, that she who is devoted to your service may not lack provisions but enjoy additional help.

text: Beneficiis tuis Domine quaesumus populus fidelis semper exsultet ut te instruente dispositus et conversatione tibi placeat et quae votis expetit salubriter assequatur.
translation_en: Through your blessings, Lord, we humbly ask that the faithful people always rejoice, so that being instructed and disposed by you, their conduct pleases you, and they may healthfully obtain what they seek in their vows.

text: Bone redemptor noster Domine qui mansuetus mansueti animalis aselli terga insedens ad passionem redemptionis nostrae spontaneus appropinquans cum tibi ramis arboreis certatim sternitur via et triumphatricibus palmis cum voce laudis occurritur quaesumus maiestatem tuam divinam ut oris nostri confessionem atque corporis in ieiuniis humiliationem libens suscipias et fructum nos viriditatis habere concedas ut sicut illi in tua fuerunt obvia cum arboreis virgis egressi ita nos te redeunte in secundo adventu cum palmis victoriae mereamur occurrere laeti.
translation_en: Good Redeemer, our Lord, who gently sits on the back of the humble ass for our redemption's sake, approaching spontaneously towards passion, with branches of trees he competes and triumphs, meeting the triumphant palms with a voice of praise. We humbly ask Your divine majesty to graciously receive our confession of lips and bodily humility in fasting, and grant us the fruit of having greenness. So that, just as they were visible among the trees with their branches, we may deserve to meet You returning in the second coming with palm victories, joyful.

text: Bonitatem tuam Domine quam sanctificatricem nostram esse cognoscimus petimus et rogamus ut interveniente sancto tuo illo caelesti adipe animas nostras repleas et per mysterium corporis et sanguinis quod sumpsimus et potati sumus peccata nostra solita miseratione dimittas.
translation_en: We acknowledge your goodness, Lord, and we know that it is the sanctifier of our soul. We ask and we plead that, with your holy one from above, that sanctifying spirit, you fill our souls, and through the mystery of the body and blood which we have received and drunk, may you forgive us our sins in your usual mercy.

text: Bonitatis immensae auctor et Domine adclines tuam quaesumus pietatem ut oratio abstinentiae nostrae et viventibus salutem et defunctis valeat impetrare quietem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, O Author of immeasurable goodness and Lord, to incline your mercy towards us. May our prayer of abstinence bring health for the living and peace for the departed.
