text: Bonitatis tuae largitatem deprecamur omnipotens Deus ut haec oblatio quam in honorem sancti Christophori martyris tui offerimus nobis ad animae corporisque proficiat salutem.
translation_en: We entreat your bountifulness, Almighty God, that this offering which we present for the honor of Saint Christopher, Your martyr, may bring salvation to our souls and bodies.

text: Bonorum omnium Deus auctor atque largitor fac quaesumus ut Ecclesiae tuae proles te instituente succrescens in novam tui filii creaturam sancto fovente spiritu nutriatur.
translation_en: God, the author and giver of all good things, we humbly ask that, as you establish your Church, may its offspring grow nourished in the new creation of your son, fostered by the holy spirit.

text: Bonorum Deus operum institutor famulae tuae illius corda purifica ut nihil in ea quod punire sed quod coronare possis invenias.
translation_en: Good God, instigator of good works, purify the heart of your servant, that you may find nothing in her to punish but only what is worthy of being crowned.

text: Bonorum omnium Deus auctor et largitor qui ut humanum genus ad confessionem tui nominis provocares etiam in fragili perfecisti condicione martyrium praesta quaesumus ut Ecclesia tua hoc exemplo commonita nec pati pro te metuant et caelestis praemii gloriam concupiscam.
translation_en: God, the author and bestower of all good things, who, in order to summon the human race to confess your name, have even perfected it in a fragile condition of martyrdom, we ask that you grant, that your Church, having been stirred by this example, neither fear to suffer for you out of fear, but aspire to the heavenly reward's glory.

text: Caelestem nobis praebeant haec mysteria quaesumus Domine medicinam et vitia nostri cordis expurgent.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to grant us these heavenly mysteries. May they serve as a medicine for our ailments and purge the faults of our heart.

text: Caelesti alimonia vegetati quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctarum virginum tuarum Katherinae et Margaretae et beatae Mariae Magdalenae meritis intercedentibus et tibi casto corpore servire et tuae dilectioni valeamus iugiter adhaerere.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God, who nourishes in heaven, that through the merits of your saints Catherine, Margaret, and blessed Mary Magdalene, their intercession may enable us to serve you with a chaste body and always adhere to your love.

text: Caelesti benedictione misericors Deus populum tuum praesentem confirma et quem magno ac speciali patrono beato scilicet Willibrordo consessore tuo atque pontifice decorasti eius semper praesenti suffragio ab omni adversitate protege propitius.
translation_en: With celestial blessing, gracious God, confirm your people present and whom you have adorned with a great and special patron, the blessed Willibrord, consecrator and bishop. May he always intercede for us, and may you protect us favorably from all adversity.

text: Caelesti benedictione omnipotens Pater populum tuum sanctifica et beati Martini confessoris tui atque pontificis festivitate gaudentem per intercessionem eiusdem protectoris nostri fac nos in aeterna cum sanctis tuis gloria gaudere.
translation_en: With the celestial blessing, Almighty Father, sanctify your people and those rejoicing on the feast day of your blessed martyr and bishop, St. Martin, through his intercession, may our protector make us joy in eternal glory with your saints.

text: Caelesti cibo potuque roborati omnipotenti Deo laudes et gratias fratres carissimi referamus poscentes ut nos quos dignos habuit participatione corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi unigeniti sui dignos etiam caelesti remuneratione percenseat.
translation_en: We, your most dear brothers, refer lauds and thanks to the Almighty God who has strengthened us with heavenly food and drink. We ask that he deems us worthy not only of participation in the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, his unique Son, but also of a celestial reward.

text: Caelesti lumine quaesumus Domine semper et ubique nos praeveni ut mysterium cuius nos participes esse voluisti et puro cernamus intuitu et digno percipiamus effectu.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that with celestial light you always and everywhere precede us. So that we, participants in the mystery as you willed, may perceive it with a pure gaze and worthy of receiving its effects.

text: Caelesti munere satiati misericors Deus gratias agimus et precamur ut qui nova beneficia per beatum Geraldum te operari gaudemus ipso supplicante per hoc caeleste munus ad pietatis opera renovemur.
translation_en: With the aid of celestial grace, we thankful God offer thanks and pray that He who delights us with new blessings through Blessed Gerald may renew us in His works through this celestial gift.

text: Caelesti munere satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut beati Rufi martyris tui meritis ubique nos adiuves.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that, being satisfied by your heavenly favor, you assist us everywhere through the merits of your blessed martyr Rufus.

text: Caelesti munere satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut haec nos dona martyrum tuorum deprecatione sanctificent.
translation_en: By heavenly grace, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that these gifts may be sanctified by the intercession of your martyrs.

text: Caelesti munere saginati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut haec nobis dona martyrum tuorum supplicatio beata sanctificet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that by your celestial grace, the gifts of your martyrs may bless and sanctify us through their supplications.

text: Caelesti munere satiati quaesumus omnipotens Deus; tua nos proiectione custodi et castimoniae pacem mentibus nostris atque corporibus intercedente sancta Maria propitiatus indulge ut veniente sponso filio tuo unigenito accensis lampadibus eius digni praestolemur occursum. ( recensio altera ) Caelesti munere satiatos omnipotens Deus tua nos protectione custodi ut castimoniam et pacem mentibus nostris atque corporibus intercedente sancta Maria propitiatus indulgeas et veniente sponso filio tuo unigenito accensis lampadibus eius digni praestolemur occursum.
translation_en:
We, who are filled with heavenly gifts, humbly ask you, Almighty God; protect us by your power and let the holy Mary, propitiated by you, intercede for us, that we may be worthy to meet your coming Son, the only begotten, with burning lamps.
(alternate version)
Filled with heavenly gifts, Almighty God, protect us by your power, so that, through the intercession of the holy Mary, propitiated by you, we may receive peace and chastity in our minds and bodies and be worthy to meet your coming Son, the only begotten, with burning lamps.

text: Caelesti participatione Domine recreati suppliciter exoramus ut sicuti sanctorum Kiliani et sociorum eius festa celebrare gaudemus ita eorum suffragantibus meritis nobis salutare fiat sacramentum.
translation_en: With heavenly participation, Lord, we humbly entreat you that just as we joyfully celebrate the feast of Saint Kilian and his companions, so through their intercessions may the sacrament be beneficial to us.

text: Caelesti refectam mysterio tuere quaesumus Domine familiam tuam ut intercedente beata Agatha virgine tua et martyre salutis aeternae remedia quae te adspirante requirimus te largiente consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to guard the family that has been refreshed by your mystery. May the blessed Agatha, your virgin and martyr, intercede for us, so that we may obtain the remedies of eternal salvation through your mercy which we seek while inspired by you.

text: Caelesti saturari dape cupientibus occurre omnipotens Deus qui beatissimo Tirso tuo gentili adhuc misertus inter ceteras quas pro tuo nomine sustulit poenas paratum supplicium plumbi in adversarios eius oratione ipsius martyris retrorsisti. Propter quod flebilibus te Deus rugitibus imploramus ut per hunc martyrem a quo praedicti metalli supplicium detorsisti detergas massam totius nostri peccati atque te opitulante qui illatam sibi poenam in se persequentes eiecit ministret sibi obsequentibus tutelam patrocinii indisrupti ut per eum famulantes obtineant veniam per quem persequentium est devicta audacia et per quem infidelitas poenali consumpta est igne per eum crudelitas flamma ardeat caritatis divinae.
translation_en: O almighty God, who in Your mercy, even towards the noble Tirus, among others whom You lifted punishments for his sake, reversed the punishment of lead for his adversaries through his own martyr's prayer. Therefore, we implore You with tearful supplications that through this martyr, from whom You turned away the predicted punishment of metal, cleanse the whole mass of our sin. May You grant us protection through the unbroken patronage to those who obey and follow in His steps, so that by serving Him they may obtain forgiveness; for whose sake the audacity of the persecutors was defeated and faithlessness consumed by punishment burned with divine fire.

text: Caelestia Domine sumpsimus sacramenta; praesta quaesumus ut interveniente beato confessore tuo illo cuius sollemnia recurrimus nobis conferant medicinam.
translation_en: Heavenly Lord, we have taken the sacred mysteries; grant us, we ask you, that with your blessed confessor present, who's feast day we are observing, they may bestow upon us a healing medicine.

text: Caelestia sacramenta sumpsimus Domine; praesta quaesumus ut intervenientibus beatis consessoribus tuis illis quorum sollemnia recurrimus nobis perpetuam conferant medicinam.
translation_en: We have received the heavenly sacraments, Lord; grant us that we may receive eternal healing through the intercession of your blessed companions whom we remember today.

text: Caelestia dona capientibus quaesumus Domine non ad iudicium provenire patiaris quod fidelibus tuis ad remedium providisti.
translation_en: Heavenly gifts we ask you, Lord, to grant those receiving them. We humbly beseech you not to let them lead to judgment, but rather what you have provided for your faithful as a remedy.

text: Caelestibus deliciis satiati te Domine deprecamur ut gloriosi patris nostri Iudoci suffragio paradisi sociemur convivio.
translation_en: Having been satisfied with celestial delights, we humbly beseech you, Lord, to obtain for us through the intercession of our glorious father Judoc, that we may be companions in the heavenly banquet in Paradise.

text: Caelestibus Domine donis satiatos quaesumus ut et voluntate pie recteque vivendi et virtute atque efficacia perficiendi nos iugiter donare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you who are filled with heavenly gifts, grant us the desire and righteousness to live piously, and the virtue and effectiveness to perform our lives continually.

text: Caelestibus Domine pasti deliciis quaesumus ut semper eadem per quae veraciter vivimus appetamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you that those who dwell in heaven feast on delightful things. May we always desire the same things through which we truly live.

text: Caelestibus Domine refecti muneribus supplices deprecamur ut beati Marci evangelistae et martyris tui protegamur auxiliis cuius devotis mentibus celebramus triumphum.
translation_en: Heavenly Lord, strengthened by celestial gifts, we humbly entreat you to protect us under the assistance of your blessed evangelist and martyr, Saint Mark. With devoted minds, we celebrate his triumph.

text: Caelestibus Domine quaesumus praesidiis muniantur qui in tua protectione confidunt ut te solo praesule gloriantes tuo semper foveantur auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that those who trust in your protection be fortified by celestial guardians, so that they may always be sustained by your help and ever glory in you as their only ruler.

text: Caelestibus donis quaesumus Domine da nobis libera mente servire ut munera quae deferimus pro famulo tuo illo et medelam nobis operentur et gloriam.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, with celestial gifts, grant us a free mind to serve, so that the offerings we bring as Your servant may work for him and be a remedy for us, and bring glory.

text: Caelestibus epulis recreati quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente beato Alexio confessore tuo salutare mysterium quod te largiente percepimus te custodiente servemus.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, having been refreshed at celestial feasts, through the intercession of your confessor Blessed Alexius, that you may protect and preserve within us the saving mystery which you have given us through your generosity.

text: Caelestibus pasti dapibus supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus quatenus per gloriosa almi patris Botulfi merita aeternis nos iubeas sociari gaudiis.
translation_en: With humble meals we ask you, all-powerful God, that through the merits of the glorious Blessed Father Botulf, you may command us to share in eternal joys.

text: Caelestibus refecti mysteriis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beata illa virtus accepti in nobis permaneat sacramenti.
translation_en: Having been fed with heavenly mysteries, we humbly ask, Lord our God, that through the intercession of that blessed virtue received by us, the grace of the sacrament may remain in us.

text: Caelestibus refecti sacramentis et gaudiis supplices Domine te rogamus ut quorum gloriamur triumphis protegamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Having been refreshed with the celestial sacraments and joys, we humbly ask You, Lord, that we who boast in your triumphs may be protected by your assistance.

text: Caelestibus refecti sacramentis et gaudiis supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut ea quae in veneratione beati Patricii confessoris tui atque pontificis tuae obtulimus maiestati in nostrae proficiant salvationis augmentum.
translation_en: Having been refreshed with celestial sacraments and joys, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that what we have offered in the veneration of your blessed Confessor and Pope, St. Patrick, may contribute to the increase of our salvation.

text: Caelestibus refecti sacramentis quaesumus Domine ut terram quam nostris videmus iniquitatibus tabescentem congruentium facias irrigari inundatione pluviarum.
translation_en: Having been refreshed with heavenly sacraments, we humbly ask you, Lord, to make the earth that we see wasting away due to iniquities, to be watered by the overflow of rainfall.

text: Caelestibus refectis sacramentis aeterne Deus et beati Felicis martyris tui annuis sollemnibus gratulatis praesta nobis famulis tuis ut cuius sollemnia colimus eius semper meritis apud te muniamur et precibus.
translation_en: On the occasion of the celestial feasts being refilled, eternal God and to your blessed martyr Felicitas, we offer our annual solemnities. May you grant us, your servants, that as we celebrate his feast days, we may always be fortified by his merits with you, and pray for us.

text: Caelestibus sacramentis et divinis epulis vegetati quaesumus Domine ut intercedente beata Anna quam matrem matris tui Filii confitemur ad aeternam mereamur pertingere consolationem et pacem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, with the sacred and divine feasts that have nourished us, through the intercession of blessed Anna, your mother's mother of your Son, may we be worthy to attain eternal comfort and peace.

text: Consecramus et sanctificamus hanc patenam
translation_en: We consecrate and sanctify this paten.

text: Caelestibus sacramentis refecti maiestatem tuam altaribus tuis Domine deprecamur inclinati ut quae in sollemnitate beatae Cuthbergae laetanter percepimus auxilio eius intercessionis nobis proficiant ad utriusque profectum salutis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Lord, who have been refreshed by heavenly sacraments, to lower Your majesty towards Your altars, so that what we joyfully received in the celebration of blessed Cuthberga may profit us through her help and intercession for progress in both our earthly and spiritual lives.

text: Consecrare et sanctificare digneris Domine patenam
translation_en: Deign, Lord, to consecrate and sanctify the paten.

text: Caelestibus satiati sacramentis clementissime Deus tuam deposcimus munificentiam ut per interventum sanctae virginis Aetheldrethae aeternae beatitudinis beneficia possimus capere largiora.
translation_en: Most merciful God, we who are filled with celestial sacraments beseech you to bestow your generosity upon us, that through the intercession of the holy virgin Aetheldreth, we may obtain more abundant blessings of eternal beatitude.

text: Caelestibus sumptis mysteriis supplices te Pater omnipotens imploramus ut interveniente beato Gaugerico confessore tuo atque pontifice ad refectionem vitae caelestis perducamur.
translation_en: With the mysteries taken from heaven, we humbly beseech you, Almighty Father, that with the intervention of Blessed Gaugeric, your confessor and pope, we may be led to the restoration of celestial life.

text: Caelestis alimoniae vegetati libamine quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut nos semper gloriosae virginis Mariae continua foveat protectio cuius nostrae salutis causa exstitit hodierna conceptio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, our Lord God, to always nurture us with the heavenly food, and to constantly keep us under the protection of the glorious Virgin Mary, whose cause our salvation was today manifested in her conception.

text: Caelestis Domine alimoniae refecti sacramento quaesumus ut intercedentibus sanctis virginibus ac martyribus tuis quae pro illarum celebramus gloria ad nostrae salutis proficiant incrementa.
translation_en: Heavenly Lord, we humbly ask for the sacrament of refreshment in food. We pray that through the intercession of your holy virgins and martyrs, whom we celebrate with glory, there may be an advancement towards our salvation.

text: Caelestis Domine mysterii perceptione munitos tales nos quaesumus beati confessoris tui Germani precibus effice ut quod ille deferentibus indeptus est angelis nostra quoque fragilitas mereatur adipisci.
translation_en: Heavenly Lord, we humbly ask that you, through the prayers of your blessed confessor Germanus, make us worthy of the protection of the mysteries. May our frailty also merit to be enriched as he was indebted to angels.

text: Caelestis doni benedictione percepta supplices te Deus omnipotens deprecamur ut hoc idem nobis semper et sacramenti causa sit et salutis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Almighty God, that this same blessing which we have received from heavenly benediction may always be with us and for the sake of the sacrament and salvation.

text: Caelestis doni benedictione percepta supplices te Deus omnipotens deprecamur ut hoc idem et sacramenti causa sit et salutis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, through the blessings of the heavens that this same (thing) may also be for the sake of the sacrament and salvation.

text: Caelestis doni benedictione percepta supplices te Domine deprecamur ut hoc idem nobis semper et sacramenti causa sit et salutis.
translation_en: With the blessing of heaven bestowed upon us, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that this same thing may always be for us and through the sacrament, a cause of salvation.

text: Caelestis doni benedictione percepta supplices te Deus omnipotens deprecamur ut hoc idem et sacramenti nobis causa sit et salutis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Almighty God, that this same thing may be for us a cause of grace and sacrament, and of salvation, which we have received by your heavenly blessing.

text: Caelestis doni benedictione percepta supplices te Deus omnipotens deprecamur ut hoc idem nobis et sacramenti causa sit et salutis.
translation_en: With the blessings bestowed by Heaven, we humbly pray to you, Almighty God, that this may also be for our benefit and for the sake of the sacrament, and for our salvation.

text: Caelestis doni sacramentis praeparatione nostra perceptis suppliciter te Domine deprecamur ut intercessione beati confessoris tui atque pontificis Nicolai cuius sollemnia celebramus eadem nobis ad corporis et animae medelam provenire sentiamus.
translation_en: Heavenly Lord, we humbly beseech You, as we have received Your sacraments in our preparation, that through the intercession of Your blessed confessor and pope Nicholas, whose feast day we are celebrating, we may feel healing for our body and soul.

text: Caelestis gratiae largitor omnipotens Deus individua Trinitas te in spiritalibus laetitiae adoramus obsequiis qui sanctorum tuorum mentibus et insinuas omne quod cupiunt et tribuis omne quod poscunt cum in martyrii certamine constituti acquisierunt de supplicio gloriam de morte victoriam se sibi negantes ne tibi Deus postmodum negarentur Iulianus interea et socii eius animas suas promptissima devotione perdentes ut eas in aeternum te restituente recipiant. Etenim separare eos a caritate Christi nec mors nec vita praevaluit qui ad illustris pugnae certamen sublimati fallacias et minas mundi fortissima congressione vicerunt vilissimamque iudicantes huius temporis vitam pro testamentis dominicis pretiosas animas tradiderunt. Oramus ergo inclite Deus ut eorum illustribus meritis nobis ob facinora peccatorum veniam condonare digneris.
translation_en: Heavenly giver of grace, all-powerful God, Trinity we adore you in spiritual joy through our obedience, who insinuate into the minds of your saints everything they desire and grant them every request they make when, having been established in the contest of martyrdom, they acquire glory from suffering, deny themselves victory over death. Meanwhile, Julian and his companions lose their souls with promptest devotion, so that, restoring them, you may receive them eternally. Indeed, neither death nor life could separate them from the love of Christ. Having been raised to the illustrious battle, they conquered the deceit and threats of the world through a most powerful assembly, judging this temporal life as worthless compared to the testaments of our Lord. Therefore, we pray, illustrious God, that you may deign to forgive us for our sins through their outstanding merits.

text: Caelestis hic panis quem sumpsimus Domine et nobis indulgentiam tribuat et famulum tuum illum ab antiqui hostis irrisione defendat.
translation_en: May this heavenly bread that we have received, Lord, grant us forgiveness, and may Your servant be protected from the ancient enemy's scorn.

text: Caelestis mensae quaesumus Domine sacrosancta libatio corda nostra purget semper et pascat.
translation_en: Heavenly table, we humbly ask you, Lord, may your sacred offering always purify and nourish our hearts.

text: Caelestis mensae refectio Domine interveniente beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae merito sanctique Petri principis apostolorum necnon et tuorum Benedicti Martini Swithuni confessorum omniumque sanctorum suffragio aeternam mihi conferat sanitatem et misericordia tua sacerdotum tuorum piam in omnibus quaeso corroboret voluntatem.
translation_en: May the banquet of heaven, Lord, with the intervention of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, and of Saint Peter, the chief apostle, as well as of your confessors Benedict, Martin, Swithun, and all saints, grant me eternal health through their intercession. I humbly ask that your mercy strengthens the pious will of your priests in all things.

text: Caelestis participatio Domine sacramenti animabus patris et matris meae requiem et lucem obtineat perpetuam meque cum illis gratia tua coronet aeterna.
translation_en: May the heavenly participation, Lord, of your sacrament grant to the souls of my father and mother eternal rest and light. May your grace crown me eternally with them.

text: Caelestis refecti muneris dono quaesumus immensam clementiam tuam omnipotens et misericors Deus ut intercedentibus pro nobis meritis celeberrimi martyris tui Genesii acceptabile sit tibi quod obtulimus et nostrorum veniam consequi mereamur delictorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask the heavenly powers, O almighty and merciful God, that with the merits of your most famous martyr Genesius interceding for us, what we offer to you is acceptable and that we may deserve forgiveness for our sins.

text: Caelestis vitae munere vegetati quaesumus Domine ut quod est nobis in praesenti vita mysterium fiat aeternitatis auxilium.
translation_en: We who are nourished by the celestial gift of life, we humbly ask you, Lord, that what is for us now in this earthly life as mystery may become aid of eternity.

text: Caelestis vitae munus accipientes quaesumus omnipotens Deus; quod pro famula tua illa deprecati sumus clementer a tua pietate exaudiri mereatur.
translation_en: Receiving the heavenly gift of eternal life, we humbly ask the almighty God; that, as we have earnestly prayed for your servant, it may be heard graciously from your mercy.

text: Caelestium munerum libamine satiati quaesumus Domine quatenus haec dona beatorum martyrum Gereonis Victoris Cassii atque Florentii sociorumque eorum deprecatione nos sanctificent et ad perfectum tuae perennitatis bravium tuo medicinali ducatu perducant.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to satisfy us with the rewards of heaven, that through the intercession of the blessed martyrs Gereon, Victor, Cassius, and Florentius, and their companions, these gifts may sanctify us and lead us to the perfect goal of Your eternal life by the guidance of Your healing leadership.

text: Caelestium sacramentorum participes effecti quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beato Udalrico confessore tuo atque pontifice et peccatorum nostrorum indulgentiam et vitam consequi mereamur aeternam.
translation_en: Having become participants of heavenly sacraments, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through the intercession of blessed Udalricus, your confessor and pope, we may deserve eternal forgiveness and life for our sins.

text: Caelestium sacramentorum refecti libamine et praesentis festivitatis gaudio saginati supplices deprecamur ut cuius congratulamur tripudio eius semper protegamur auxilio.
translation_en: Having been nourished with the sacraments of heaven and filled with the joy of the present festivity, we humbly pray that we who congratulate him may always be protected by his aid through his joy.

text: Caelestium vitae aeternae adoremus dominum fratres carissimi suppliciter deprecantes ut populum suum semper ubique custodiat protegat atque defendat; principes mitiget potestates gubernet iudices regat nocentes reprimat hostes repellat laborantibus opem tribuat oppressos liberet vinctos dimittat captivos revocet lapsos restituat contritos foveat languidos curet cunctis misericordia subveniat pius et misericors Deus preces nostras propitiatus exaudiat.
translation_en: Let us adore the Lord, brothers dearest, humbly beseeching Him to always guard, protect and defend His people everywhere; may Princes moderate, govern, judge and rule over the wicked, repress enemies, repel, help those who labor, free the oppressed, release captives, recall the fallen, restore contrite ones, nurse the sick, care for all, with mercy come to the aid of everyone. May the pious and merciful God hear our prayers, propitiated by His goodness.

text: Caelorum atque terrarum conditor et gubernator omnipotens Deus precanti populo tua succurre pietate et praesta ut qui in honorem sanctae Brigidae praesentem diei huius gerimus sollemnitatem per ipsius suffragia perenni misericordia tua potiamur.
translation_en: Almighty Creator and Governor of heaven and earth, God who hears the praying people, come to our aid with your mercy and grant that we who celebrate this solemnity in honor of Saint Brigid on this day may through her intercession be worthy of your eternal mercy.

text: Carmina precum nostrarum reseratis auribus tuis perfice Domine Deus ut quidquid ex tua pietate postulaverimus candor lucis aeternae Deus ex Deo totus tuae semper. Igitur trine Deus culpas offensionis in qua cadit totum genus humanum et misericorditer lapsis ad surgendum porrige manum (sic).
translation_en: Opening your ears to our hymns, Lord God, complete what we have humbly asked for from your pity, the brightness of eternal light, God from God, whole and always from you. Therefore, Trinity God, forgive the sins and offenses in which the entire human race falls, and mercifully extend a hand to those who fall (as requested).

text: Celebratis Domine quae pro apostolorum tuorum beata passione peregimus ipsorum quaesumus nobis fiant intercessione salutaria in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter impleta.
translation_en: We celebrate, Lord, the things that we have passed through for the blessed passion of your apostles; we humbly ask that through their intercession these things may be salutary for us. In whose natal days, they are exultantly fulfilled.

text: Corda nostra Domine gratiae tuae
translation_en: Our hearts, Lord, with your grace

text: Celebrantes quae pro martyrum tuorum illorum beata passione peregimus ipsorum nobis quaesumus fiant intercessione salutaria in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter impleta.
translation_en: We celebrate the things that we performed for the sake of the blessed passion of your martyrs, we humbly ask that they become beneficial intercessors for us. In their natal days, may there be an exultant fulfillment.

text: Celebrantes quae pro beatorum martyrum tuorum Felicis et Fortunati beata passione peragimus ipsorum nobis quaesumus fiat intercessione salutaris in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter impleta.
translation_en: Celebrating those for the blessed martyrs Felicitas and Fortunatus, we perform their holy passion. We humbly ask that with their intercession it may be fruitful for us on their natal days, when their joy is exultantly fulfilled.

text: Celebrantes quae pro martyrum tuorum Saviniani et Potentiani beata sollemnitate peregimus ipsorum quaesumus fiant intercessione salutaria in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter expleta.
translation_en: Celebrating those festivities in honor of your martyrs Savinian and Potentian, we humbly ask that they may be a beneficial intercession on their feast days when their birthdays are most joyfully celebrated.

text: Celebrantes quae apostoli tui illius beata passione Domine peregimus ipsius nobis quaesumus fiant intercessione salutaria in cuius natalicio sunt percepta.
translation_en: Celebrating the feast of Your blessed Apostles, Lord, whom we commemorate for their passion, we humbly ask that through their intercession it may be beneficial to us on whose birthday the perceptions were made.

text: Christe cuius magnitudo potentiae Vincentii martyris tui corpus quod vesano Datiani furore fuerat marinis proiectum in fluctibus undis advehentibus honorandum revocavit littoribus tu nos eodem martyre suffragante a procelloso istius saeculi profundo manu pietatis in supernis attolle ut qui inimico impellente in hoc mare excrescentibus delictis cecidimus per caritatem quae est coopertio peccatorum ad portum salutis quandoque perveniamus laetaturi cum omnibus invicem quos dilectio tua iungit in hac praesenti martyris tui sollemnitate.
translation_en: Christ, whose greatness and power recalled the body of your martyr Vincent from the frenzy of Datian's madness, which had been thrown into the sea by marauding waves, is worthy of our honor. With this same martyr interceding for us, we pray that Your hand of pity lifts us up from the tempestuous depths of this world, elevating us to the heights where love covers sins. For we who have fallen into this sea due to increasing wickedness driven by an enemy, may one day reach the harbor of salvation with joy, united by Your love with all whom Your affection unites in this present martyr's feast.

text: Christe cuius virtus atque potentia tantum in apostolo tuo Iacobo emicuit ut in nomine tuo emissis ad se daemoniorum catervis potentialiter meruerit imperare tu Ecclesiam tuam ab adversantium impugnatione defende ut virtute spiritus exsuperando adversa illius doctrinam opere compleat cuius hodie exemplum piae passionis honorat.
translation_en: Christ, whose power and might shone so greatly in your apostle James that he merited to command the demonic hosts sent to him in your name, protect your Church from assault by its enemies. May the work of the Spirit overcome the adversary's teaching, as the example of his pious passion is honored today.

text: Christe Dei Filius cuius incarnatio reparavit mundum cuiusque nomen angelica est voce denuntiatum tu offerentium nomina illic adscribe quo ipse praecessisti in corpore ut quos adventus primi gratia redemisti in secundi adventus examinatione nulla exurantur poena supplicii sicque nunc pro defunctorum fidelium quiete exaudiamur quo te opitulante aeterno cum illis pariter fruamur consortio beatorum.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, whose incarnation restored the world, whose name is announced by an angelic voice, may their names be inscribed there, where you have already gone before in the body. So that those whom the first coming redeemed by grace may not burn in punishment at the second coming's examination, and so that now we may be heard on behalf of the departed faithful with your eternal intercession, may we enjoy eternal fellowship with them in the company of the blessed.

text: Christe Dei Filius quem olim ob hodiernae sollemnitatis festum turba multiplex Hebraeorum cum ramis et palmis ovantibus animis susceperunt concede nobis ut sicut illi praesentia tua gavisi sunt ita haec sacrificia pietatis tuae sanctificentur obtutu quo ex his libantes ita per veram fidem ratamque dilectionem vivam tibi praeparemur in hostiam ut securi accedamus ad tuae passionis sacratissimam cenam.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God whom once a great multitude of Hebrews with branches and palms waving their spirits received on this day's solemnity, grant that we may be made ready as they were filled with your presence, so that these sacrifices of our devotion may be sanctified by the grace through which from these offerings we prepare ourselves to you living, true faith, and firm love. Thus, we may approach securely to your most sacred supper of passion.

text: Corpus Domini nostri Iesu Christi custodiat te in vitam aeternam.
translation_en: May the Body of Our Lord Jesus Christ protect you for eternal life.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui dissidium pacis quod inter angelos et homines obiecerat nequam ille spiritus pravitatis tuae incarnationis mysterio restaurasti ut illi angeli numquam dilapsi reformatos per te ad gratiam homines conservos agnoscerent quos extorres pridem per culpam sentirent; et qui se adorare prius non prohibebant postmodum ne fieret prolato clamore recusabant. Tanto itaque beneficio redempti quaesumus ne amplius in pristino lapsu decepti cadamus sed renovationem baptismi ita fidei conservemus et opere ut sanctorum angelorum tuorum societate semper studeamus connexi manere.
translation_en:
Christ, Son of God, who restored the discord that arose between angels and men through Your incarnation, You humbled that wicked spirit of disobedience. Through Your mystery, those fallen angels were reformed and by You they recognized the men whom earlier, because of sin, they did not acknowledge as worthy of adoration; and who once did not refuse to be adored, afterwards refused with loud protestations.
So, we who are thus redeemed implore You not to let us fall again into our former fall, but may we always preserve the renewal of baptism in faith and deed, so that we may always strive to remain connected to the society of Your holy angels.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui exanime beatae virginis corpus niveo candore vestisti dignare nos vestire iustitiae stolis et operibus sanctitatis ut per haec quae tibi offerimus munera sic niveo alternae dilectionis vestiamur amictu ut aeternae pacis lumine cum ea quae te professa est potiamur.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who clothed the body of the blessed Virgin with snowy whiteness, deign to clothe us in garments of justice and works of sanctity. May we be arrayed in this way through the gifts that we offer to you, so that by the snowy robe of alternating love, we may be adorned with the cloak, and enjoy eternal peace with her whom you have been declared.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui martyrem tuum Cucufatem inter ignes saeculi positum plus supernis ignibus cremas ut admotos illi persecutorum ignes subicias fac in nobis ignem illum inexstinguibili succensione flammescere quem venisti in terram mittere et quem voluisti ardere quo eius accensione ita interiora nostra exaestuent ut et te ex toto corde diligere et veram servare possimus cum proximis caritatem.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who placed your martyr Cyprian among the fires of the world to be burned more by higher fires, make in us that unquenchable fire burn which you came to earth to send and which you desired to blaze. By whose burning our inner selves may be so consumed that we can love you with all our heart and truly keep the commandments with our neighbors.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui non vindicta pasceris sed purae mentis confessione placaris offerentium fac tibi acceptabile votum et defunctis dona consortium beatorum quo in huius confessoris tui illius commemoratione et confessiones a te acceptentur viventium et requies concedatur spiritibus sepultorum.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who are not pleased by vengeance but by the pure confession of minds of those offering to you, make their vow acceptable to you. And to the dead, grant the fellowship of the blessed, so that in the commemoration and confessions of your confessor (referring to the saint being honored) they may be accepted by you, both the living and the repose may be granted to the spirits of the buried.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui obseratis seris ad discipulos intrans aeterna eos pace confirmas praebe in his sollemnitatibus obsequenti catervae et simultatis vitium fugere et caritatis verae concordiam veraciter retinere quo tui discipuli per dilectionem effecti illis peracta paschae sollemnia sacrificiis honoremus quibus ipsi purificari a nostris criminibus mereamur.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who observe the series for your disciples as you walk among them, confirm eternal peace for them in these solemnities. May the faithful flock obey and flee from the faults of haste and steadfastly retain the true harmony of love. So that your disciples, made by love, honor the completed paschal solemnities with sacrifices, through which they may be worthy to be purified from our sins.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui per angelum tuum destinato munere coronarum Valeriani Tiburtii atque Caeciliae corda corroboras ad credendum ut hoc et illis esset et castimoniae signum et tuae dulcedinis incrementum rogamus te ut ad instar illorum ita pax tua in nobis semper habitet quo et faeculente carnis valeamus pellere incentiva et dulcedinis tuae renovari ubertate multimoda.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who through your angel strengthened the hearts of Valerius and Cecilia with the mission of crowns, we ask you that your peace may always dwell in us, just as it did for them. May we be able to overcome the temptations of the flesh and be renewed by the abundance of your sweetness.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui per sanguinem crucis tuae omnia quae sunt in caelis sive in terra pacificasti tu nobis exspectantibus propinquam paschae tuae sollemnitatem donum pacis et caritatis attribue ut vestibulo induti alternae dulcedinis pretium sumamus nostrae redemptionis.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who by the shedding of your blood on the cross have pacified all that are in heaven or on earth for us who are awaiting your approaching Paschal solemnity, grant us the gift of peace and charity. May we, clothed with the vestment of the alternate sweetness, sum up its price as the reward of our redemption.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui per totum mundum discreta praedicantium praesidia mittens hos nostris partibus destinasti doctores Torquatum videlicet Secundum Indaletium Tisefontem Euphrasium Caecilium et Aesicium quorum ignitis praedicationum iaculis error perfidiae Hispaniarum partibus illapsus abscederet exceptionis nostrae suscipe votum et hos nobis praepara in solatium quos patronos sibi plebs vernula confitetur ut quorum praedicatione fidei flamma nostris terris invecta est eorum obtentu et cuncta repellantur incommoda et expiata coram te maneant pectora nostra.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who sends forth preachers throughout the world to send protection to our parts, you have established doctors such as Torquatus, Secundus Indaletium Tisefontem, Euphrasius, Caecilius and Aesicius. Their fervent preaching chases away the errors of treachery in the Spanish lands. Receive their vow for our exception and prepare for us those whom the common people confess as their patrons. May it be through their preaching that the flame of faith was cast upon our lands, and may all troubles and offenses be repelled and expiated before you. And may our hearts remain pure in your presence.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui Spiritum Sanctum in speciem ignis super discipulos emisisti quo variis linguis loquerentur magnalia dei dignare hoc igne nostrarum mentium frigus expellere et torpentia ieiunantium corda in dilectione tui et proximi excitare. In nobis scandala pellat qui in illis doctrinae cumulavit eloquia; quique eos linguis fecit eloqui nobis in nos fervorem adveniens multiplicet caritatis quo omnes qui adventus sui gratia innovari nos cupimus placidum eidem in nostris cordibus caritatis hospitium praeparemus.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who sent the Holy Spirit as a fire-like appearance upon your disciples so that they might speak the great deeds of God in various languages, grant that this same fire may drive away the coldness from our minds and awaken the hearts of those who fast with love for you and your neighbor. Let the scandal be driven out from among us who have accumulated words of teaching, let him who made them speak to us in our language multiply the fervor of charity so that all who desire to be renewed by your grace prepare a peaceful dwelling of charity in their hearts for Him.

text: Christe Dei Filius qui stigmata passionis tuae praeclaro munere dilatando diversa nationum genera unitati Ecclesiae tuae consocias aggregendo inter quos beatum Christophorum alienigenae gentis et speciei et fidei tuae gratia ditas et nominis gloria decoras et passionis ornamento glorificas fac nos quaesumus ita unitati sanctae Ecclesiae tuae coniunctos exsistere ut numquam ab eius discedamus societate sed sic caritatis tuae munere in ea perpetim colligemur ut fide et opere tibi placere in perpetuum mereamur.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who by the splendid gift of your stigmata brought together diverse nations, races, and faiths into the unity of your Church, enriching them with your grace and glory, adorning them with the beauty of your name and the splendor of your passion. We beseech you, make us so united to this holy Church of yours that we may never depart from its society, but rather be bound to it forever through your love's gift. May we merit to please you forever in faith and deed.

text: Christe Dei Filius quo docente didicimus non in solo pane vivere sed in omni verbo quod tuo procedit ex ore praesta nobis ut qui magisterium tuum sequentes praesentis quadragesimae initia hodierno die incipimus festivis consecrare in canticis optata remedia a te impetrare possimus tam viventibus quam defunctis quo et nobis serviendi tibi concedatur cum affectu effectus et illis a te praestetur aeternae beatitudinis locus.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, by whose teaching we have learned not only to live by bread alone, but by every word that comes forth from your mouth. Grant us, we pray, that as we follow your teaching during this Lenten season, we may begin today to consecrate the days ahead with festivity, and in our singing seek the desired remedies from you, which we can obtain for both the living and the dead. May it also be granted to us to serve you with devotion, and may they who have gone before us be given a place of eternal beatitude by your mercy.

text: Christe Deus ac Domine noster quaesumus ut ita a te hoc nostrum sanctificetur ieiunium quo et peccata diffugiant et vita nostra ad meliora successibus cottidianis proficiat.
translation_en: Lord Christ and our God, we ask you that this our fasting may be so sanctified by you, through which not only our sins may flee but also our life may progress daily towards better things.

text: Christe Deus cuius nos redemptos morte gaudemus et sanguine liberatos castigatis ieiunio animabus atque corporibus pacis tuae dono largire quo proximante passionis tuae celebritate sic dilectionis perfectionem ad invicem teneamus qualiter ad mensam tuam absque ullo reatu hodie accedamus.
translation_en: Christ, God, whose death we rejoice in our redemption and whose blood has set us free, grant us the gift of peace, as we approach the solemnity of your Passion. May we hold the perfection of love for each other. How can we today approach your table without any guilt?

text: Christe Deus fortis atque mirabilis te poscimus te rogamus ut qui victricem animam Cucufatis martyris tui inter crepitantes craticulae flammas non es passus exstingui has tibi oblatas hostias placabili vultu iubeas intueri quo ita in nobis sentiamus placabilem fieri tuae serenitatis adspectum ut quod fidelium vota praesumunt impensio expleat angelorum.
translation_en: Christ, the strong and wonderful God, we implore and beseech you that, who did not allow the victorious soul of your martyr Cucufatus to be extinguished amidst the crackling rafter flames, grant us to behold these offerings presented with a pleasing countenance. Thus, may we in ourselves sense your serene presence becoming acceptable to us. May what the faithful's hopes presume, be fulfilled through our investment, by the angels.

text: Christe Deus omnium gratiarum largitor qui primum ac summum Tolosanae civitatis sanctum Saturninum sacerdotem instituisti ad cuius praedicationem atque virtutem ita ora daemonum siluerunt ut se consulentium cultoribus suis obstrusa veluti absentia probarentur tu ora nostra praeconio verae praedicationis accinge et vitiorum insolentium simultates a nostris pectoribus abice ut ita pacis nutrimento coalescamus ad invicem quo dum ea quae praedicamus sermonibus opere impleverimus ad te qui es retributor iustissimus sine confusione perveniamus.
translation_en: Christ, God of all grace, who first and most supremely ordained the holy Saturninus, a priest, for the city of Toulouse, whose preaching and virtue were so powerful that the demons' voices fell silent in order to prove themselves absent to those seeking them; may your words, our herald, arm us with true preaching and cast off from our hearts the insolent displays of vices, so that we may grow together in peace. When what we preach is fulfilled by our actions, may we, without confusion, come before you, the most just retributor.

text: Christe Deus qui ascendendo in caelis praesentiam corporalem tuis subtraxisti discipulis permitte nobis ut te spiritu diligamus quem in carne nunc videre nequimus et tamen ad iudicium fideliter exspectamus. Crea in nobis cor novum et spiritum rectum ut qui iam ascensionis tuae celebravimus festum promissum a te mereamur suscipere Spiritum Sanctum.
translation_en: Christ, God who, ascending into heavens, took away thy bodily presence from thy disciples, allow us to love thee with spirit, whom we are unable now to see in flesh, yet faithfully we await for judgment. Create in us a new heart and an upright spirit, that we who already have celebrated the festival of thy ascension may deserve to receive the Holy Spirit.

text: Christe Deus qui inter iniquos suspendi passus es crucis sustinendo iniuriam dato nobis perfectae vitae tolerantiam ut caritate illa qua ipse mundum diligens pro eodem mortem subisti inveniamur ipsi te opitulante perfecti sicque passionis tuae exemplo illata toleremus scandala ut sanguine crucis tuae omnia pacificante capitis nostri mereamur effici membra.
translation_en: Christ, God, who hung on the cross between wicked men enduring insult, grant us the patience for perfect life, that with the same charity with which you loved the world and suffered death for it, we may be found worthy of you, interceding for us. May we bear scandals as you bore your passion's example, so that we may deserve to have our limbs made worthy by your crucified blood, bringing peace to our heads.

text: Christe Domine attributor perennalis gratiae et collator qui virginum tuarum Christetis et Callistae paenitentiam per gloriosam famulam tuam Dorotheam suscipiens igne eas examinando glorificas dum ipsa crematione torrentis ignis iam paene perditas eis restaurares coronas supplicum tuorum precibus benignus intendens et paenitentium intuere lamenta et offerentium sanctifica holocausta quo et per paenitentiam nos tibi facias complacere et per honestos mores tibi coniungere ut per quam praedictarum virginum tuarum paenitentiam dignatus fuisti suscipere per eam pius collator et viventibus et defunctis destines aeternam salvationem.
translation_en: Christ, Lord, attributed with eternal grace and one who bestows on your virgins, Christeta and Callista, repentance through your glorious servant Dorothea. You examine them with fire, making them glorified, while they were almost lost in the torrent of fire, you restore their crowns, benevolent to the supplications of your servants and those repenting. You look upon their lamentations and consecrate their holy sacrifices, so that through repentance we may please you and through honorable ways unite with you. Through this repentance of the aforementioned virgins, you were gracious enough to receive it from the worthy chooser and you promise eternal salvation for both the living and the dead.

text: Christe Domine crucifer gloriose qui constantiam beati Andreae apostoli propter gloriam tui nominis crucifixi ita confortasti in praelio ut extolleres in triumpho exaudi hunc coetum supplicem ac praesentem et praesta ut qui hoc tempore eius sollemnitati debitum faenus exsolvimus futuris temporibus modum vitae castissimae ipso opitulante servemus.
translation_en: Christ, Lord crucified with glorious constancy, who strengthened blessed apostle Andrew in battle for the glory of your name, hear this supplicant and present congregation. Grant that we who owe fitting tribute to his solemnity during this time may serve the way of most chaste life in future times with his intercession.

text: Christe Domine Dei atque hominum mediator qui per sanguinem crucis tuae cuncta quae in caelis et quae in terris sunt pacificare dignatus es hoc per tropaeum passionis tuae tua pietas egit quod et in initio tuae secundum carnem nativitatis angelus nuntiavit omnisque caelestis exercitus proclamavit: »Gloria semper Deo in excelsis et in terra pax hominibus bonae voluntatis«. Hoc et post triumphum crucis tua placabilitas suis haec commendavit discipulis et donavit ut in hoc omnibus tui ministri apparerent si perfectam pacis concordiam invicem custodirent.  Praesta igitur Domine ut hii qui vexillum crucis tuae in frontibus gestant puram atque sinceram cum fratribus retineant caritatem et nos in osculo sancto digneris reconciliare.
translation_en:
Christ, Lord of God and men, mediator who was pleased to pacify all things in heaven and on earth through the trophy of your passion, it is your pity that did this: even at the beginning of your fleshly nativity, an angel announced to all, and the whole celestial host proclaimed: "Glory always to God in the highest, and on earth peace among men of good will." This also was given after the triumph of your cross, your placability commended it to your disciples and gave it so that in this, all of your ministers would appear if they kept the perfect harmony of peace with one another.
Therefore, Lord, grant that those who bear the banner of your cross on their brows may retain pure and sincere love with their brothers, and deign to reconcile us in the holy embrace.

text: Christe Domine in cuius adventu pax est reddita terris pax collata hominibus bonae voluntatis concede quaesumus ut qui per primum adventum ad nos in humanitate veniens mundum tibi in pace conciliare dignatus es reconciliatos per te in tua pace praestes iugiter permanere quatenus in secundo adventu tuo dum in maiestate et gloria veneris facias heredes pacis aeternae quos hic tuae pacis depositum feceris inviolabiliter custodire.
translation_en: Christ, Lord, in whose coming peace is restored to the earth, may peace be granted to men of good will. We ask that you, who graciously chose to reconcile us through your first coming in human form, may grant that those reconciled through you may ever remain in your peace. May it be so that at your second coming, when you come with majesty and glory, you make the heirs of eternal peace whom here you have deposited inviolably to guard.

text: Christe Domine qui et tuo vesci corpore et tuum corpus effici vis fideles fac nos in remissionem peccatorum esse quod sumpsimus atque ita se animae nostrae divina alimonia per benedictionem tuam facta permisceant ut caro spiritui subdita et in conspectum pacificum subiugata obtemperet non repugnet.
translation_en: Christ, Lord, who didst nourish Thyself with our flesh and make Thy body give life to the faithful; make us, through the remission of sins, what we have partaken to be. So let divine nourishment, bestowed upon our souls by Your blessing, mix together that the flesh may be submissive to the spirit and, in a peaceful view, submit itself and not resist.

text: Christe Domine qui te exinanisti ut nos adimpleres qui humiliasti te ut nos exaltares ut qui eras ante virginem esses ex virgine ex Deo patre natus Deus ante saecula hodie homo nascereris ob saecula te oramus et petimus ut preces nostras placatus exaudias.
translation_en: Christ, Lord, who humbled yourself that we might be fulfilled, who humbled yourself that we might be exalted; who, being before the virgin, were born of a virgin from God the Father, God before the ages, today man will be born of a woman for all eternities. For this reason, we pray and ask you, graciously listen to our prayers.

text: Christe aeterna salvatio et salutis integerrima plenitudo pro quo ancilla tua ea desecta parte corporis cruciatur qua infantibus succus lactis ingeritur facito nos ut ubera suggentes matris ecclesiae numquam praecidamur ab invicem quo alternae caritatis lacte potati aeternorum simus civium societate condigni.
translation_en: Christ, eternal salvation and the completeness of health for your servant, who is afflicted with pain in that part of her body where milk is given to infants, make us such that we may never fall from each other, so that having drunk the milk of mutual love, we may be worthy citizens of the eternal society of the mother church.

text: Christe Filius Dei qui elevatus in cruce discipulum matri matremque discipulo commendans passionis nostrae calicem ebibens consummasti tu nos placabilis efficito tibi ut tam oblationes quam oblatores ita respiciendo sanctifices sanctificando vivifices vivificandoque tibi ipse commendes quo Ioannem apostolum tuum dilectio tua fecit honorabilem inter fratres.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, who, lifted up on the cross, commending the disciple to your Mother and the disciple to your Mother, drinking the cup of our passion, you completed it. Make us acceptable to you, so that by looking upon both offerings and offerers, you may sanctify, sanctify, vivify, and vivify, thereby commending yourself to us. Just as your love made John your apostle honorable among brothers.

text: Christe Filius Dei quo nascente pax acclamata est ab angelis tu ieiunia nostra sanctifica bono pacis quo et utraque virtute fulgeamus et pro utriusque a te piissimo muneremur.
translation_en: Christ, Son of God, as peace was acclaimed by angels at your birth, may your fasting sanctify our fasting with the goodness of peace. May we shine with both virtues and be rewarded by you, most merciful one, for both.

text: Christe Filius Dei vivi cuius virtutem mulier illa samaritana praenoscere meruit cuius fidem casto corde suscepit cuiusque nomen abiens in civitatem celebre nuntiavit da nobis ut ea veritate nomen nostrum aeternis adscribatur in paginis qua veritate nomen gloriae tuae ob miraculum deitatis admirabile factum est Samariae in populis. Praesta etiam sancte Deus ut omnes qui fideli intentione fatemur et credimus nomen tuae sanctissimae Trinitatis numquam aeternis mancipemur suppliciis quique in eadem qua a te percepimus fide vocati sunt nullis flammarum adustionibus crucientur sed concede eis ut sicut in hac vita inconcusse statum verae fidei tenuerunt ita illius vitae gaudiis aeterno munere potiantur.
translation_en: Christ, Son of the living God, whose power that Samaritan woman merited to know, whose faith she received with a pure heart, whose name going into the famous city she proclaimed, grant us that we may be called by that same truth in eternal pages. Grant also, holy God, that all who confess and believe in your most holy Trinity may never be made a slave to eternal penalties; those who were called by the faith we received from you be not scorched by any burning torments but grant them that as they have held the status of true faith unshaken in this life, so may they be able to partake in the joys of eternal life by the gift of that life.

text: Christe Filius Dei vivi qui apostolum tuum Petrum ita confessione iustificans revelasse illi patrem tuum hanc ipsam tuam intellegentiam esse docuisti cum alia atque alia de te hominibus incerta opinione narrantibus ille te non secundum carnem et sanguinem metiendo in veritate intelligeret crederet praedicaret huius te intercessione supplices deprecamur ut in desiderio nos ad te veniendi positos fides modica mundo turbante non subruat sed auxiliatricem dexteram ad liberandos nos priusquam ad dubietatem valida tentatione deducti mergi forsitan incipiamus extendas ac si propter fragilitatem nostram quod titubamus increpites non tamen propter iniquitatem nostram ut pereamus exspectes.
translation_en: Christ, Son of the living God, who justified your apostle Peter so that he revealed to him your own self as intelligence, when other and other men were uncertainly talking about you, that he would not judge you according to flesh and blood, but would understand, believe, preach, and on our behalf pray through this intercession, we humbly ask that faith, which the world may shake, does not overwhelm us but supports us, before we are perhaps led by a strong temptation to doubt, extends as if because of our fragility, which makes us waver, but not because of our wickedness, so that we do not perish, you do not expect.

text: Christe finis legis ad iustitiam omni credenti et bonorum omnium limes qui ex circumcisione praeputioque venientibus lapis effectus es angularis olim mysterio figurante cum Iacob capiti unctus est suppositus lapis quem et Abraham in se uno ostendit cum alios ex circumcisione alios ex fide sua venire portendit quatenus ex utraque gente unam in se faceret plebem te quaesumus te rogamus ut pro quibus praecepta legis implesti ut absolveres praeceptorum tuorum efficias effectores ut in pace tua acquisiti pace potiamur maiestatis tuae placabili.
translation_en: Christ, end of the law for righteousness to every believer and head of all good ones, you who were once made a stone and an angel of the mystery when Jacob was anointed and placed as a stone, which Abraham showed in himself by some coming from circumcision and others from faith. We ask and pray that like Jacob, you make us stones in your service, so that we may be one people in you. We humbly beseech you, who fulfilled the precepts of the law, to absolve those who follow your precepts, to make them executors of your commands, so that we may enjoy peace through your mercy.

text: Christe Iesu auctor formationis omnimodae haec nomina quae coram tuo sunt altario recitata caelesti mereantur praenotari in pagina.
translation_en: Christ Jesus, author of all formations, these names that have been recited before your altar deserve to be noted in the heavenly page.

text: Christe Iesu cuius doctrina in templum mediante die festo admirabilis visa est fac nos in doctrinis tuis iugi meditatione manere atque ea semper ex ipsis memoriae nostrae commendabilia esse quae et ad amorem nos fraternum absque ullius simultatis vitio pertrahant et in tui dilectionis desiderio ardentiori succendant.
translation_en: Christ Jesus, whose doctrine was admirably seen in the temple on a festive day, make us stay in your teachings with diligent meditation and may these always be commendable in our memory. Let those things be which draw us into brotherly love without any fault of rivalry, and let them increase our desire for your love.

text: Christe Iesu Domine et Salvator cuius nomen fragrantissimus odor in universo adspargitur mundo da nobis devicto saeculo municipatu frui sidereo ut illic nostrorum nominum praescriptio fiat quo martyr noster tecum iam gloriosus exsultat quique prece martyris persecutorem destruxisti cum idolis obtentu eius sacrificium hoc placabilis suscipe pro viventibus vel defunctis.
translation_en: Christ Jesus, Lord and Savior, whose fragrant name is spread throughout the universe, grant us, delivered from this world, to enjoy the celestial city, so that our martyr's name may be written there where our glorious martyr already rejoices with you. You who destroyed the persecutor of the martyr's prayer, graciously accept this sacrifice on behalf of the living and the dead.

text: Christe Iesu Filius Dei patris qui nos sanguine tuo redemisti fons pacis exsistis et origo purae dilectionis praebe nobis indignis famulis tuis hanc a te acceptam cum omnibus hominibus servare pacem dum vivimus ut ad te qui es auctor perfectae caritatis quandoque feliciter veniamus.
translation_en: Christ Jesus, Son of God the Father who redeemed us with your blood, fountain of peace that exists and origin of pure love, grant to us, your unworthy servants, to keep the peace given by you among all men while we live, so that we may come happily to you who are the author of perfect charity, when it will be fitting.

text: Christe Iesu qui es claritas angelorum salus et gloria in te credentium animarum interventu Thomae apostoli et martyris tui sit quaesumus nobis a te collata munditia cordis et corporis ut tuis ubique pareamus praeceptis et sicut eum Indorum apostolum dedisti ad construendum spiritale aedificium ita eodem suffragante cordibus nostris augeas fundamentum fidei. Non enim hic sanctus tuus utique missus tale opus erexit ubi labentis saeculi frueretur luxuria sed ubi credentium animarum iugiter conquererentur lucra. Haec ut ruinosa vetustas saeculi terrenis lateribus erectum quandoque dirueret palatium sed caelesti in regno ex lapidibus pretiosis tibi credentibus peregit habitaculum feliciter sine fine mansurum.  Huius ergo intercessione nobis pro miseris ipse placatus accipiens sit te favente modesta regibus clementia pontificali culmine finctis vita sanctis virtutibus fecunda omnium sacerdotum actio sanctorum angelorum excubiis circumsaepta levitarum et monachorum toga caritatis et castitatis decore ornata. Rutilet etiam in virginibus pudicitia sacra sit continentibus puritas defaecata et laicis omnibus beatae vitae honestas clarissima. Sicque redemptam tuo sanguine plebem omnibus bonis propitius repleas ut a cunctis incommodis pius eruas et defendas.
translation_en:
Christ Jesus, who are the clarity of angels, salvation and glory for souls believing in your intervention, we humbly ask that you bestow upon us the purity of heart and body so that we may always conform to your commands. Just as you gave the Apostle Thomas, your martyr, to build a spiritual edifice among the Indians, so too, with his intercession, may you increase the foundation of faith in our hearts. For not here did your holy one surely raise such a work where the luxury of the unstable world would flourish, but where the souls of believers would always strive for gain.
That the crumbling old age of this world might someday destroy the palace built on earthly foundations, but that in your heavenly kingdom, from precious stones, you would complete a dwelling place happily without end.
With this intercession, may we, through your favor, be blessed with moderation by kind rulers, with papal clemency crowned, filled with the fruitful action of all priests, surrounded by the watchfulness of holy angels, adorned with the robe of charity and chastity of levitical and monastic people.
May sacred purity shine in virgins, and let unblemished purity be apparent in those who are continent. May all laity shine with the honorable life of the blessed. And so, may you, through your blood, mercifully fill the redeemed people with every good so that you may piously free and protect them from all harm.

text: Christe Iesu qui es resurrectio mortuorum et vita omnibus nobis subveniat misericordia tua et sicut occultis consiliis tuis Lazarum quadriduanum revocasti ad vitam ita quoque miserationibus consuetis et vivis morum correctionem attribuas post ruinam et defunctis aeternae mansionis gaudia indefessa.
translation_en: Christ Jesus, who is the resurrection of the dead and life for all of us, may your mercy be present. And just as with your hidden counsel you brought Lazarus back to life after four days, grant also a change in living habits through your accustomed mercies to those who are ruined and to those who have died. May they experience eternal dwelling joy without end.

text: Christe Iesu qui virginali nasciturus de utero praecursorem tuum Ioannem senili fecisti exoriri ex alvo quem lucernam ardentem tuo constituisti in templo fac nos lucere in Ecclesia tua ardore fidei et instructione docendi caritatis opere et humilitatis perfectione orationis studio et castimoniae documento. Sicque nunc has oblationes offerentis populi fidelis accepta ut cunctis congrua largiaris remedia; per eum et spiritale gaudium vivis et poenarum evasionem conferendo defunctis per quem tibi in cordibus incredulorum et via est praeparata et indultae gratiae primordia sunt ostensa.
translation_en: Christ Jesus, who caused your forerunner John to be born from the womb of Elizabeth when you were about to be born in a virgin's womb, and who made the lamp burning in the temple out of the elderly man Zachariah, make us shine in Your Church with the ardor of faith, instruction in teaching, work of charity, perfection of humility, diligence in prayer, and testimony of chastity. So now, let these offerings of the faithful people be accepted, and may You grant fitting remedies to all; through Him, bring spiritual joy and deliverance from penalties to the departed souls. Through Him, a way is prepared and initial graces of mercy are shown even in the hearts of unbelievers.

text: Christe omnipotens Deus qui beatum Clementem antistitem propter nomen tuum in altitudine maris paganorum tempestate dimersum ut in certamine probasti bellorum ita post bellum patefactis arenis educis gloriosum quaesumus pietatem tuam ut nos a concupiscentiae procellis erutos paternae gloriae repraesentes innoxios.
translation_en: Christ, almighty God, who blessed Clement the bishop through your name when he was tossed by the tempest of the pagan seas, and in the contest of war proved victorious, we humbly ask for your mercy to deliver us from the storms of earthly desires, and present us innocent before the glory of our father.

text: Christe qui ad humana veniens humilis Deus in sidere declararis illabere sensibus nostris quo Ecclesia tua quae apparationis tuae festum hodierna die ovando concelebrat in pace tua iugi tempore solidata consistat ut et hic opera caritatis instanti devotione retentet et ad te remuneratura perveniat gaudens qui olim ad liberationem eius per admirabile sidus apparere dignatus es.
translation_en: Christ, who in humility as God came to humanity and were declared in the star to touch our senses, so that Your Church which today on this day celebrates the feast of Your appearance stands firm in Your peaceful time. May it remain here steadfast with the constant devotion of charity's works, and may it reach You rejoicing, who once appeared for its liberation through a wonderful star.

text: Christe qui es alpha et omega initium et finis tu benedicito his sacrificiis ob principium praesentis anni tibi oblatis et ita offerentium vocabula in libro vitae conscribens ut defunctis requiem praestes quo omnes qui initia huius anni cum tripudio laudationis attollimus reliquum excursum eius in tua servitute transigere mereamur.
translation_en: Christ, who are Alpha and Omega, beginning and end, you bless these sacrifices offered to you at the beginning of the present year. May those who offer them have their names inscribed in the book of life, so that you may grant rest to the departed. May we deserve to complete the remainder of this year's course in your service with the joyful praise we began it with.

text: Christe qui es origo et auctor purae dilectionis pacem tuam quaesumus permisce parsimoniis nostris quo tibi et per ieiunium obsequamur et per dulcedinem copulemur.
translation_en: Christ, who are the source and author of pure love, we humbly ask that you mix your peace with our frugality, so that through fasting we may serve you and through sweetness be united with you.

text: Christe qui incursionem malorum spirituum superari posse per ieiunium docuisti tu a carne nostra et petulantiam libidinis pelle et gulae libitum refrenando compesce ut corpus nostrum tibi per abstinentiam subiciatur quod per ingluviem mancipatum est illecebris vitiorum.
translation_en: Christ, who taught us to overcome the onslaught of evil spirits through fasting, cleanse us from our flesh and free us from the stubbornness of lustful desires and gluttony, so that our body may be subjected to you through abstinence, which is now enslaved by the allurements of vices.

text: Christe qui moriens peremisti imperium mortis et resurgens spem resurrectionis praebuisti indignis praesta nobis ut haec oblatio offerentium et mortificationem nostrorum operetur facinorum et a criminibus resurgendi nobis praeparet commeatum. Sit huius litatione gaudium in caelis securitas in terris indulgentia vivis requies defunctis ut in hoc die quo ipse victor redisti ab inferis plenissimum amorem crucis impertias populis christianis.
translation_en: Christ, who died and overcame the power of death, and rose again to give hope of resurrection to the unworthy, grant that this offering of the faithful may work our penance for sins and prepare us for rising from them. May there be joy in heaven, security on earth, indulgence for the living, rest for the dead, so that on this day when you yourself rose victorious from the grave, you bestow upon Christian people the fullest love of the cross.

text: Christe qui pro nobis Deo patri in sacrificium es oblatus qui sanguine tuo terrena caelestibus socians resurrectione tua nos doces sperare superna his sacrificiis propitiatus illabere hisque benedicturus descende. Sint haec quae tibi offerimus libamina ita plenitudine benedictionis tuae referta ut resurrectionis tuae festa celebrantibus optatam pariant medicinam.
translation_en: Christ, who for us was offered as a sacrifice to the Father God with your blood, uniting earthly and heavenly realms through your resurrection, teach us to hope in these things. Grant that what we offer you as a libation may be so filled with the fullness of your blessing that those celebrating the festival of your resurrection may receive the desired medicine. May you, who are propitiated by these sacrifices, descend and bless.

text: Christe redemptio nostra qui olim noctem istam tuae resurrectionis illuminasti potentia precamur ut in hac qua ipse vivus surrexisti a mortuis et expiationem criminum vivis et requiem iubeas praestare defunctis.
translation_en: Christ, our Redeemer, who once illuminated this night of your resurrection with your powerful presence, we humbly pray that in this very day where you yourself rose from the dead and live as an atonement for sins, grant eternal rest to the deceased.

text: Christe redemptor nostrae mortalitatis qui caelestibus aquis emissis Romanum tuum olim liberasti a flammis immitte nunc super hoc sacrificium imbres tuae benedictionis ut qui ex eo libaverint et peccatis careant ei virtutum spiritalium copiam adipiscant.
translation_en: Christ, our redeemer from mortality, who once freed your Roman one from the flames with celestial waters, now pour down upon this sacrifice your blessings' rain, so that those who are freed by it and are without sin may obtain spiritual virtues' abundance.

text: Christe requies certa laborum et fessarum relevatio animarum qui septimo hoc die et creata perficiendo quiescis et humana redimendo in quiete sepulchri corporaliter degis facito nos ut qui tuae mortis ac resurrectionis in hoc die tibi sacrificium exhibemus servitutis operam respuamus.  Repelle quaesumus a nobis fermentum malitiae et per caritatis opera in nostris cordibus requiesce quo in hoc sabbatum sarcinam criminum non portemus sed in otio sanctae pacis paschales tibi hostias immolemus.
translation_en:
Christ, grant us a certain rest from our labors and relief for our weary souls, who on the seventh day rested after creating and perfecting all things, and who by redeeming mankind dwells in peace in the tomb corporally. Make us that we, who present to you today a sacrifice of your death and resurrection, may refuse the work of servitude.
We humbly ask You to drive away from us the leaven of malice and to rest in our hearts through acts of charity, so that on this Sabbath day we carry no burden of sin but offer to you the hostias (offerings) of the peaceful Easter rest.

text: Christe verbum summi patris qui caro factus es ut habitares in nobis illabere sensibus nostris quo omnes qui tuae incarnationis mysterio sumus redempti perpetua maneamus pacis societate connexi.
translation_en: Christ, word of the highest Father, who became flesh to dwell among us, grant that we may be touched by your senses so that all who are redeemed through the mystery of your incarnation may remain in the eternal peace of your society connected.

text: Christianam quaesumus Domine respice plebem et quam aeternis dignatus es renovare mysteriis a temporalibus culpis dignanter absolve.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you look upon your Christian people. As you have deemed fit to renew them with eternal mysteries, grant them worthy absolution from temporal sins.

text: Christum Dominum deprecemur quem adorant magi. Prophetarum vaticinia complentur; veniunt ex oriente legati fides gentium declaratur; circumciditur octava die circumcisionis inventor; ad templum ducitur offerendus qui est adorandus in templo.
translation_en: We entreat the Lord Christ, whom the magi adore. The prophecies of the prophets are fulfilled; legates come from the east, declaring the faith of the nations; he is circumcised on the eighth day, the discoverer being circumcised; he is taken to the temple to be offered, who is worthy of adoration in the temple.

text: Cibati pane vitae et salutari poculo propinati fratres carissimi agamus gratias omnipotenti Deo patri obsecrantes misericordiam eius ut hoc sanctum benedictionis suae donum quod in nominis sui honorem percepimus illaesum atque inviolatum in nobis semper servare dignetur.
translation_en: Let us, dear brothers, partake of the bread of life and the salutary cup, and let us give thanks to the almighty God, our Father, imploring His mercy so that He may always deem worthy to preserve unharmed and inviolable in us the holy gift of His blessing which we have received in His name.

text: Cibi salutaris ac poculi dona libantes quaesumus Domine ut qui paschale mysterium sumpsimus prodesse nobis in perpetuum gaudeamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us the gift of food and drink. May we who have partaken in the Paschal mystery rejoice in it forever.

text: Cibo caelesti saginati et poculo aeterni calicis recreati fratres carissimi Domino Deo nostro laudes et gratias indesinenter agamus petentes ut qui sacrosanctum corpus domini Iesu Christi spiritaliter sumpsimus exuti a carnalibus vitiis spiritales effici mereamur.
translation_en: Dear Brothers, we are continually offering praises and thanks to our Lord God, having been nourished with the heavenly food and refreshed with the cup of the eternal chalice. We humbly ask that as we spiritually partake in the body of our Lord Jesus Christ, we may be worthy to cast off carnal vices and become adorned with spiritual virtues.

text: Clamantibus nobis ad te Domine miserere; moveat misericordiam tuam vox fidelis et flebilis atque illa de qua totum speramus pietas non reputet quod offendimus dum respicit quod rogamus et cum grandis sit miseria esse nos reos maior tibi sit clementia non esse nos miseros tuo supplices egemus auxilio. Ante te et criminis nostri mala ponimus et dolores a te precando misericordiam quam peccando repulimus exspectamus. Praestetur his de indulgentia tua quod rogaris accipere quos agnoscis fiduciam de sua iustitia non habere quo viventium oblatione suscepta requies a te defunctis concedatur aeterna.
translation_en: Crying out to you, Lord, have mercy on us; let the voice of the faithful and sorrowful move your compassion, and may the mercy not hold against us what we offend while it looks at what we ask. Though our misery is great, may your clemency be greater towards us sinners. We, who are supplicating to you, put before you and for our crimes place our wickedness and sorrowing by asking mercy from you, which we had rejected by sinning. May these things, because of your indulgence, receive what they ask, whom you recognize have no faith in their own justice, so that rest may be granted to the departed from the living offering received from you, and eternal peace be given.

text: Clamantium ad te quaesumus Domine preces dignanter exaudi et sicut Ninivitis in afflictione positis pepercisti ita et nobis in praesenti tribulatione succurre.
translation_en: We humbly implore You, Lord, grant our petitions worthy of Your attention and, as You did with Nineveh when they were in distress, so too help us now in this present affliction.

text: Clarum nobis Domine post resurrectionem Filii tui maius solito lumine aethereum iubar elatum et perpetuae illius noctis horrore discusso temporalium licet diem cum aeterna iam luce radiantem testificata virtutum tuarum gloria celebramus. Tu ergo omnipotens Deus pater Domini nostri orantis populi tui in caelum vota surgentia placidus ac serenus acceptans munimina tribue spei dona concede. Offerentibus quoque tribue pacem et defunctis aeternae pausationis quietem.
translation_en: We celebrate with the shining light brighter than usual after the resurrection of Your Son, Lord, and we are freed from the horror of perpetual night. You, all-powerful God, Father of our praying people, as their prayers rise to heaven, accept them calmly and serenely. Grant them gifts of hope, and let them receive the blessings. To those who offer, grant peace, and to the departed, eternal rest.

text: Clemens et clementissime Deus qui per Clementem romuleum episcopum plurimos tuae divinitati congregas aggeres martyrum et multimodam catervam accumulas confessurum dona pro tua miseratione spiritibus fidelium requiem defunctorum et nobis omnibus exoptatam remissionem omnium peccatorum.
