translation_en: Clement and most merciful God, who through St. Clement the bishop gathered countless mounds of martyrs and amassed a multifarious band of confessors, grant for the sake of your mercy the rest of spirits to the deceased and to us all the longed-for remission of all sins.

text: Clemens et clementissime Domine Deus qui pacem tuam per Clementem episcopum cordibus radicasti fidelium pace tua qua ipse es salvare intendas afflictas reliquias christianorum ut quia veram pacem pacifici praedicando durissimum et censuale a diversis nationibus sufferimus iugum per te qui vera et firmissima pax es pervenire mereamur ad paradisi gaudium sempiternum.
translation_en: Clemens and most compassionate Lord, God who planted your peace in the hearts of faithful people through Clement, Bishop. Yourself being the one to intend to save the afflicted remnants of Christians. Since we have suffered the yoke of true peace, which we preach to the unpeaceful, harshly and controversially from various nations, through you who are the true and firm peace, we may merit eternal joy in paradise.

text: Clemens omnipotens et misericors Deus duritiam nostri cordis averte qua nec verbera multiplicata metuimus nec tantis mysteriis collata dona sentimus et tua nobis inspiratione concede ut et delictis veniam postulemus et gratias pro nostra salvatione reddamus.
translation_en: Clement and merciful, all-powerful God, turn away the hardness of our hearts so that we neither fear the multiple scourges nor perceive gifts as great mysteries bestowed upon us. And grant us your inspiration so that we may both ask pardon for our sins and render thanks for our salvation.

text: Clementia tua Domine munera nostra dignanter respiciat et beati Hieronymi confessoris tui et sacerdotis deprecatione per eadem nos purifica.
translation_en: May your mercy, Lord, graciously regard our gifts, and through the intercession of blessed Jerome, Confessor and Priest, purify us.

text: Clementiam tuam Domine deprecamur ut his oblationibus plebis quas in honorem beatissimi Germani antistitis et confessoris offerimus signatum diem hodiernae sollemnitatis celebremus cum inconcussa fidei libertate quam ille constanti mente defendit precantes ut robur patientiae eius nobiscum si non opere saltem voluntate comitetur.
translation_en: We beseech Your mercy, Lord, that the day of today's solemnity, marked by these offerings of the people in honor of the blessed Germanus, bishop and confessor, may be celebrated with unshaken freedom of faith which he defended with a constant mind. We pray that the strength of his patience may be with us not only in deed but also in will.

text: Clementiam tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut paschalis muneris sacramentum quod fide recolimus et spe desideramus intenti perpetua dilectione capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your clemency, Lord, that we may receive with unwavering devotion and endless love the sacrament of the Paschal gift, which we believe in faith and long for in hope.

text: Clementiam tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut quod paschalis muneris sacramentum fide recolimus et spe desideramus intenti per tuam dilectionem capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly entreat Your mercy, O Lord, that what we remember with faith as the sacrament of the Easter offering, and desire with hope, may we attain through Your love.

text: Clementiam tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut paschalis muneris sacramentum quod fide recolimus et spe desideramus intenti perpetua tua dilectione cum omnibus sanctis tuis in resurrectione Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your mercy, O Lord, that we may receive with our fellow saints the sacrament of the Paschal gift, which we believe in faith and desire in hope, ever intent on Your eternal love, during the resurrection of Our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son.

text: Clementiam tuam quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente pro nobis beato Apollinare martyre tuo atque pontifice veniam omnium consequi mereamur peccaminum et vitam capere valeamus aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your clemency, Almighty God, that through the intercession of your martyr and pope, Saint Apollinaris, we may deserve forgiveness for our sins and be able to obtain eternal life.

text: Clementiam tuam supplices exoramus omnipotens Deus ut populum tuum quem sacro baptismate renovare dignatus es per haec paschalia munera ad aeternae vitae gaudia pervenire concedas.
translation_en: Humbly we ask your mercy, Almighty God, that you grant your people, whom you have deemed worthy to renew through sacred baptism, to reach the joys of eternal life through these Easter gifts.

text: Clementissime aeterne omnipotens Domine cunctarumque creaturarum creator te benedicimus teque collaudamus pro martyrum tuorum illorum triumphis quibus pro tuo nomine certantibus dedisti immortalitatis coronam. Eorum ergo impetratu preces nostras suscipiat tua larga clementia et his orantibus concedas nobis veniam qui tuis electis omnibus parasti loca beata.
translation_en: Most merciful everlasting Lord, creator of all creatures, we bless you and extol you for the triumphs of your martyrs, whom in their contest for your name, you granted an immortality crown. Therefore, let their intercession receive our prayers through your abundant mercy, and grant us pardon, for whom you have prepared blessed places among all your elect.

text: Clementissime Christe impenetrabili maiestati tuae tremebundus assisto dum multifarie obnoxia in me et accusantia crimina recognosco; debita altaribus tuis indignus sacrificia tuo conspectui offerre praesumo qui ante tuae maiestatis praesentiam iaceo corpore mente cordeque pollutus; habes in te tuum antidotum Christe qui sanare bone medice vulnera nosti; conscriptum quaeso contra me arbiter alme dele chirographum ne ultor in me suum peccati ultra valeat exigere nummum et hoc a tua clementia indigno ore menteque deposco ut sereno familiam tuam sacra tuo nomini officia praeparantem digneris aspicere vultu ne per me indignum eorum salutis pereat pretium pro quibus dignatus es tuum sanctum fundendo sanguinem esse redemptio sed tua nos semper et ubique protectione conserva ut quos pretioso sanguine redemisti in terris aeterna facias cum sanctis tuis gloria munerari in caelis.
translation_en: Most merciful Christ, trembling I stand before your impenetrable majesty, acknowledging the numerous accusations and sins against me; presumptuously I assume to offer unworthy sacrifices to your sight, lying before your majesty with body, mind, and heart polluted. You have in you, O Christ, your own antidote, the good physician who knows how to heal our wounds; I humbly ask, O gentle judge, that you delete the indictment against me, so that my accuser, the avenger of my sin, cannot demand any more from me. With this unworthy mouth and mind, I implore your clemency not to let the price of their salvation perish through me, for whom you were worthy to pour out your holy blood as redemption. And always and everywhere may you preserve us with your protection, so that those whom you have redeemed on earth are made worthy to be rewarded with eternal glory among your saints in heaven.

text: Clementissime conditor qui tanta caritate succendisti discipulum ut se de nave iactato ad te celer festinaret pede nudo per pelagus et videns hanc dilectionem claves ei daret siderum voces inspice suggerentium ut quicumque ex praecepto iunguntur ad osculum livore pectoris excluso illuc per gratiam ducantur quo caeli Petrus est ianitor.
translation_en: Most merciful Creator, who kindled in your disciple such great love that he hastened to you, barefoot and without a ship, across the seas when thrown from his boat; and seeing this love, the voices of the stars suggested that whoever are joined by your command should be led, by grace, to the kiss of peace on the breast, excluded from which they may be drawn, where Peter is the gatekeeper of heaven.

text: Clementissime creaturarum omnium Deus pro cuius nomine beatissimi Xystus atque Laurentius martyres viriliter certaverunt et diverso moriendi genere coronati sunt cum et Xystus tuo domitas iugo cervices carnificis gladio perempturus exhibuit et Laurentius combustum in craticula corpus suum versari praecipiens spiritum vitae inter flammas efflavit te quaesumus te rogamus ut horum precibus corpus nostrum tentationum flammis non ardeat cor divinis flatibus concalescat sicque Xystus ex accepto sacerdotali privilegio ligata criminum nostrorum vincula resolvat ac defunctorum nexus orationis favore disrumpat ut ministerii sui curam cunctis Laurentio impendente et vivi piaculis et sepulti se noverint evasisse suppliciis.
translation_en: Most merciful God, for whose name the blessed martyrs Xystus and Laurence bravely contended and were crowned with different ways of dying. We beseech you that our bodies do not burn in the flames of temptation, but that they cool down with divine breezes. May Xystus, through the privilege received as a priest, resolve the bonds of our sins and break the ties of prayers for the dead with favor. And may all, whether alive or dead, know to have escaped from the torments when Laurence is present.

text: Clementissime Deus qui in pacis unitate laetaris scilicet qui auctor es pacis et pax ab angelicis conclamatus es choris concede per huius intercessionem athletae ut ipsius dilectionis vinculo quo discipulos ad caelos remeans conglobasti ipso nos almifico nexu in tua et proximi dilectione constringas.
translation_en: Most merciful God, who rejoice in the unity of peace, being the author of peace and called out as peace by angelic choirs, grant through this intercession of the athlete, that by the bond of his love wherewith you have gathered your disciples unto heaven, we too may be bound with your almighty embrace and held together in your and our mutual affection.

text: Clementissime Domine clementiam tuam simpliciter imploramus ut sancto primoque martyre tuo Stephano interveniente pro nobis et praesentis vitae felicitatem et futurae mereamur obtinere beatitudinem.
translation_en: Most merciful Lord, we humbly beseech your clemency, that through the intervention of your first martyr Stephen, may we experience happiness in this life and deserve to obtain beatitude in the future.

text: Clementissime et sanctissime Domine sanctifica haec munera impuris manibus tibi delibata per quae et offerentium suscipias vota et ex his sumentium cuncta dimittas peccata.
translation_en: Most merciful and most holy Lord, sanctify these offerings that have been dedicated to you by impure hands, through which You will receive the vows of those offering and grant forgiveness of all sins to those partaking from them.

text: Clementissimo et per te Clementi tuo Domine lacrimosas fundimus preces ut suo intercessu a te Deus qui sine initio clemens et pius es quos iubes clementes in bonis actibus efficias.  Praestetur Ecclesiae tuae pax indeficiens bonitas affluens clementia regens pietas benefaciens protectio exuberans lenitas mulcens patrocinium defendens mansuetudo corripiens tranquillitas iustificans visitatio salvans misericordia subveniens et consueta subventio nobis miseris parcens quo mereamur repulsis adversariis tibi domino deservire et ad tuam clementiam quandoque iustificati laetabundi attolli.
translation_en:
Most merciful one, and through you, the merciful one, Lord, we pour out our tearful prayers that with your intercession, God who is ever merciful and righteous from the beginning, makes us gentle in good deeds.
May there be an unfailing peace, overflowing goodness, ruling clemency, blessing piety, abundant protection, soothing leniency, defending patronage, correcting mildness, justifying tranquility, saving visitation, merciful help, and the usual help be granted to your Church. May there be mercy subvening and consoling us, wretched ones, so that we may deserve to serve you, Lord, and at some time justify ourselves by your mercy, rejoicing with joy when justified.

text: Cognoscimus Domine tuae circa nos clementiae largitatem et ideo fiducialius imploramus ut quos pascere non desistis immeritos et digne tibi servire perficias et donis uberioribus prosequaris.
translation_en: We know, Lord, your abundance of clemency towards us, and therefore we ask with more confidence that you do not cease to pasture the unworthy and may fittingly make them worthy to serve you. And may you continue with greater gifts.

text: Commemoramus Domine passionem Iesu Christi Domini nostri qui se tibi per crucis destinam in verum sacrificium offerens confractis avernis obicibus cum glorificata carne tertia die rediens a mortuis vivus suis postmodum apparuit discipulis gloriosus. Et ideo per eius te mortem poscimus et rogamus ut his sacrificiis ita propitius illabi iubeas quo omnes pro quibus offertur et fermento malitiae careant et novitate spiritus paschalium gaudiorum mereantur peragere sacramenta.
translation_en: We remember, Lord, the passion of Jesus Christ, our Lord, who offered himself to you as a true sacrifice through his destiny on the cross with the broken doors of death confronted, and on the third day returning from the dead alive, he appeared gloriously to his disciples. And therefore we implore your mercy through his death, and we ask that by these sacrifices, you command to be appeased, so that all for whom they are offered may lack corruption of malice and may merit to perform the sacraments of the paschal new spirit.

text: Commemorantes ergo redemptoris nostri praecepta simulque passionem et in caelum ascensionem offerimus tibi Deus Pater omnipotens haec dona et munera et fidelium tuorum sacrificia illibata quae benedicere et sanctificare digneris et in conspectu tuae maiestatis acceptare.
translation_en: Remembering therefore the precepts of our Redeemer, as well as his passion and ascension into heaven, we offer these gifts and offerings to you, God, Almighty Father. We ask that you bless and sanctify them, and accept them in your divine presence on behalf of your faithful ones.

text: Commenda tibi Deus pater sacrificium singulare in quo tantum te confidimus nobis posse placari precantes ut sicut unicum dilectum Filium tuum singulariter propitiationem fecisti pro peccatis nostris ita specialiter sicut filiis nobis miserearis cunctis offensionum nostrarum inimicitiis abolitis.
translation_en: Commend we to Thee, God the Father, this unique sacrifice in which we have such trust that Thou canst be appeased as we pray. So may Thou as singularly as Thy unique and beloved Son made propitiation for our sins, show special mercy upon us, abolishing all our offenses and hostilities.

text: Comple Domine vota supplicum exaudi gemitus peccatorum osculetur nos ab osculo oris sui pacis magister et conditor ut in nobis hoc recipientibus holocaustum pacem quam speramus habeamus.
translation_en: Lord, hear the prayers of your supplicants and grant us relief from our groans. May we be kissed by Your divine peace, Master and Creator. Let there be in us a dwelling place for the holocaust of peace which we hope for.

text: Compleas in nobis Domine Iesu Salvator mundi de te in aeterna societate quod hic donasti nobis in sacramenti tui pignore salutari.
translation_en: Fill us, Lord Jesus, Savior of the world, with yourself in eternal fellowship, as you have given to us in the sure pledge of your salvation through this sacrament.

text: Complentes Domine sacrificiorum hodie sollemnia ac missarum adimplentes officia agentes tibi gratias petimus ac rogamus ut nos quoque a malis omnibus clementer eripias.
translation_en: Filling, Lord, the offerings of today's solemn sacrifices and completing the duties of masses, we pray and ask that you graciously deliver us from all evils as well.

text: Complentes igitur atque servantes praecepta unigeniti tui precamur omnipotens Pater ut his creaturis superpositis altario tuo spiritum sanctificationis infundas ut per transfusionem caelestis atque invisibilis sacramenti panis hic transmutatus in carnem et calix transformatus in sanguinem sit offerentibus gratia et sumentibus medicina.
translation_en: Since we have completed and served the commands of your only-begotten Son, we pray to the Almighty Father that you pour out the Holy Spirit upon these creatures placed upon your altar. May this bread here transformed be a gift for those offering it and a medicine for those partaking in it through the transfusion of celestial and invisible sacrament, so that it may be changed into flesh and the cup may be changed into blood.

text: Completis nostrae redemptionis et tuae gratiae documentis referentes tibi gratias benedicimus te Domine Iesu Christe Fili Dei vivi qui sanas vulnera peccatorum nostrorum qui ad vitam reparas nostrum occasum qui spem beatae resurrectionis dedisti nobis in consolationis pignore Spiritum Sanctum qui dabis aeternam mansionem in regione vivorum.  Dum ergo illa resurgendi tempus adducit hic nos dignare in diei consolare labore in mundi non perire pernicie et in transitu nostro ad te venire in tuae dilectionis dulcedine et in tua laude atque benedictione tecum persistere sine fine.
translation_en:
Returning to the documents of our redemption and your grace, we give thanks to you, Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God, who heals our wounds of sin, who restores our dying life, who has given us hope for blessed resurrection as a pledge of the Holy Spirit, who will grant us eternal dwelling in the land of the living.
Therefore, when the time of rising comes, may you here console us in labor on earth, so that we do not perish in the perils of this world; and in our passage, may we come to you in the sweetness of your love, in your praise and blessing, and persist with you without end.

text: Comprime Domine quaesumus os iniqua loquentium et eos qui nos moliuntur insimulare confuta.
translation_en: Crush, Lord, we implore you, the wicked tongue and those who seek to entangle us with lies.

text: Comprime Domine quaesumus noxios semper incursus et salutarem temporibus nostris propitius da quietem.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask, always restrain the harmful attacks, and graciously bestow upon our times a peaceful calm.

text: Comprime Domine noxios semper incursus et salutarem quietem propitius dona temporibus ut qui nostris offensis crebrius fatigamur et merito nostrae iniquitatis affligimur per huius litationem sacrificii pietatis tuae gratiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Lord, graciously crush the troublesome assaults that are always upon us, and grant a salutary peace during these times. That we who are repeatedly worn out by our offenses and justly afflicted by our own iniquity may deserve to attain your grace through this litany of sacrifice.

text: Concede credentibus misericors Deus salvum nobis de Christi passione remedium ut humanae fragilitatis praeteritae culpae laqueis aeterno suffragio plebs absolvatur.
translation_en: Grant, O merciful God, to the believers a safe remedy from the passion of Christ, that through eternal intercession the people may be absolved from the snares of past human frailty due to guilt.

text: Concede Domine electis nostris ut sanctis edocti mysteriis et renoventur fonte baptismatis et inter Ecclesiae tuae membra numerentur.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, to our chosen ones, that they may be taught by the holy mysteries and be renewed in the font of baptism and be numbered among thy Church's members.

text: Concede Domine populo tuo veniam peccatorum et religionis augmentum atque ut ei tua dona multiplices sanctorum martyrum tuorum patrocinia fac adesse.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, to your people pardon for their sins and an increase in faith, and may your gifts multiply the patronage of your holy martyrs among them.

text: Concede Domine quaesumus morum nos correctione relevari quia cum haec dona contuleris cuncta nobis utilia non negabis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we implore, that our manners be raised by correction, for when you have bestowed these gifts upon us, you will not deny anything useful to us.

text: Concede Domine tuis pro delicto supplicantibus famulis veniae proventum qui ob passionis praemium coronam beato Vincentio contulisti. Tribue quaesumus nostris eius intercessione medelam ulceribus cuius vulneribus mirifice carnificem superasti. Exstingue Sancti Spiritus rore nostrorum incentiva vitiorum qui iusti fide ignitas iuste sartagines glaciasti. Depelle fidei munere nostrae infidelitatis caliginem qui profundi carceris noctem ob sancti merita caelesti iubare radiasti. Et quia athletae tui Domine corpus exanime ferarum ferocitas te obsistente vorare non valuit nobis tua protectione defensis nulla saltem suggestio inimici vestigium infigat delicti.  Pelagus Christe tui testis factus feretrum eum te iuvante revexit ad littus; supplicum tuorum cursus vitae te opitulante redeat ad salutem. Illum immaculatae conscientiae meritum et fidei virtute consummata passione religio te praesule perduxit ad caelum; nos confessio flebilis te miserante eripiat ab inferno ut per hoc sacrificium quod tibi in honorem praedicti martyris tui dedicandum offerimus cum martyribus tuae retributionis effulserit gloria eorum suffragio evasisse se peccatores gaudeant securi a poenis.
translation_en:
Grant, Lord, to your supplicating servants, mercy's provision for those who, due to their sin, are seeking it. You who bestowed a crown on the passion's reward to the blessed Vincent, we humbly ask that through his intercession, you provide us with healing for our wounds whose sting he miraculously overcame as a martyr. May the dew of the Holy Spirit extinguish our incentives for sin, which, justly ignited by faith, you have justly quenched like hot coals glistening in a snowstorm. May the gift of faith dispel the darkness of our unfaithfulness, which you illuminated with celestial light when you shone radiantly from the deep prison due to the merits of St. Vincent.
And since your athlete, Lord, could not devour us with the ferocity of beasts even with its body resisting, may your protection defend us so that at least no suggestion of the enemy leaves a trace of sin upon us.
May Pelagius, made a witness to your Christ, raised again by you with your help, return to the shore; may the course of his life, assisted by your aid, return to salvation for him. May the merit earned by immaculate conscience and perfect faith carry the religious devotion led by you to heaven for him; let our pitiful confession snatch us from hell due to your mercy so that we may escape sin through this sacrifice offered in honor of the said martyr, with their glory shining forth, the sinners may rejoice securely free from punishment.

text: Concede fidelibus tuis quaesumus Domine et sine cessatione capere paschalia sacramenta et desideranter exspectare ventura ut in mysteriis quibus renovati sunt permanentes ad novam vitam his operibus perducantur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that your faithful ones may continually partake of the Paschal sacraments and eagerly await what is to come, so that in the mysteries through which they have been renewed, they may be led to a new life by these works.

text: Concede misericors Deus fragilitati nostrae praesidium ut qui sanctae Dei Genitricis requiem celebramus intercessionis eius auxilio a nostris iniquitatibus resurgamus.
translation_en: Graciously grant, O merciful God, protection to our frailty, that we who celebrate the peace of your divine Mother may rise from our sins with the help of her intercession.

text: Concede misericors Deus ut devotus tibi populus semper exsistat et de tua clementia quod ei prosit indesinenter obtineat.
translation_en: Graciously grant, O merciful God, that the devoted people may always exist towards You, and may incessantly obtain what is profitable from Your mercy.

text: Concede misericors Deus ut quod paschalibus exsequimur institutis fructiferum nobis omni tempore sentiamus.
translation_en: Gracious God, grant that we may always feel the fruitful effects of what we carry out according to the Paschal institutions (i.e., Easter observances).

text: Concede misericors Deus ut sicut nos tribuis sollemne tibi deferre ieiunium sic nobis indulgentiae tuae praebeas benignus auxilium.
translation_en: Grant, merciful God, that as we offer you solemn fasting, so may your mercy also grant us a benevolent aid.

text: Concede nobis clementissime Pater huius virtute sacramenti quod devote percepimus et intercessione beati Armagilli confessoris tui periculosa carnis desideria ac latentis insidias inimici superare.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, most kind Father, through the power of this sacrament that we have devoutly received, and through the intercession of your blessed confessor Armagillus, to overcome dangerous desires of the flesh and hidden traps of our enemy.

text: Concede nobis Domine Deus noster ut celebraturi sancta tua non solum observantiam corporalem sed quod est potius habeamus mentium puritatem.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord our God, that as we celebrate your holy rites, not only do we maintain physical observance but more importantly, we may have a pure mind.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus ut celebraturi sancta mysteria non solum abstinentiam corporalem sed quod est potius habeamus mentium puritatem.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we entreat you, that not only do we maintain bodily abstinence during the celebration of the holy mysteries, but that we also have mental purity.

text: Concede nobis Domine Deus noster ut et te tota mente veneremur et omnes homines rationabili diligamus affectu.
translation_en: Grant us, O Lord our God, that we may adore you with our whole mind, and love all mankind with a rational affection.

text: Concede nobis Domine exemplo Euphemiae virginis tuae ut tela nequissimi spiritus superantes aeternorum civium simus participatione felices quo sicut praedictae virginis facies ac sociorum eius verberatae alapis albescebant sic nostrae te ad iudicium veniente ex bonis actibus enitescant.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, by the example of your virgin Euphemia, that we may overcome the weapons of the wicked spirit and be happy participants for eternity. Just as the face of the aforesaid virgin and her companions shone white after being scourged, so may our actions brighten before Your coming judgment from good deeds.

text: Concede nobis Domine gratiam tuam in beati Laurentii martyris celebritate multiplicem ut de tanti agone certaminis discat populus christianus et firma solidari patientia et pia exsultare victoria.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, Your grace abundantly in the feast of Blessed Laurence the Martyr, that the Christian people may learn firm and steadfast patience from such a great contest, and rejoice devoutly with pious victory.

text: Concede nobis Domine interventu apostoli tui Thomae et remissionem peccaminum et bonae vitae inspirare nobis peragere cursum ut et sacrificia in huius sollemnitate passionis acceptos et sumentibus ea sanctificationis gratia tuae illustres.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the intervention of your apostle Thomas, and remission of sins, and inspire us to perform a good life's course so that even the sacrifices accepted in this solemnity of Passion may be enlightened by your grace.

text: Concede nobis Domine praesidia militiae christianae sanctis inchoare ieiuniis ut contra spiritales nequitias pugnaturi continentiae muniamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the protections of the Christian military, so that we may begin our fasting with the saints. With steadfastness, let us fight against spiritual wickedness, and arm ourselves with the aid of continence.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus gratiam tuam per quam boni esse possimus et praesta ut eandem studiis competentibus exsequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we ask, your grace by which we may be good and make it possible for us to carry out the same studies with fitting diligence.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus ut haec hostia salutaris et nostrorum fiat purgatio delictorum et tuae propitiatio potestatis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, that this saving Host may become our purification for sins and your propitiation of power.

text: Concede nobis Domine Deus ut haec hostia salutaris et nostrorum fiat purgatio delictorum et tuae propitiatio maiestatis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord God, that this saving sacrifice may become our purification for sins and your propitiation of majesty.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus ut sancta tua tibi placito corde sumamus et quidquid in nostra mente vitiosum est ipsius doni medicatione curetur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, that with a pure heart we may take up your holy things and whatever is corrupt within our minds may be healed by his care.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus ut <per> sacramenta quae sumpsimus quidquid in nostra mente vitiosum est ipsius medicationis dono curetur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, that whatever in our minds is tainted may be healed through the sacraments we have received.

text: Concede nobis Domine quaesumus ut <per> sacramenta quae sumpsimus quidquid in nostra mente vulneratum est ipsius miserationis dono curetur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, that whatever within our minds has been wounded by the sacraments we have received may be healed by the gift of your mercy.

text: Concede nobis Domine veniam delictorum et eos qui nos impugnare moliuntur expugna quia sub tuo munimine constitutis nulla diaboli nocebit obreptio.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the pardon of our sins and those who strive to attack us, overpower them because under your protection we are established; nothing will harm us from the ambush of the devil.

text: Concede nobis Domine ut qui sanctis altaribus tuis primitias offerimus frugum per pacis bonum et caritatis affectum habeas acceptum ut cum nostra nosque tibi offerimus primitias ipsi in nobis tuae indesinenter dulcedinis habeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, so that we who offer the first fruits to your altars may be accepted through goodwill and affection of peace. May it be acceptable to you as we offer ourselves, both us and our firstfruits, to you, that we may continually have your unending sweetness within us.

text: Concede nobis haec quaesumus Domine frequentare mysteria quia quoties huius hostiae commemoratio celebratur opus nostrae redemptionis exseritur.
translation_en: Grant us this, we humbly ask you Lord, to frequently partake in the mysteries, for whenever the remembrance of this Host is celebrated, the work of our redemption is exercised.

text: Concede nobis indignis famulis tuis mitissime Deus <ut> per oblationem tui tibi placere mereamur in vera caritate qui es fidelis omnibus invocantibus te in veritate.
translation_en: Grant, most merciful God, that we, unworthy servants of yours, may deserve to please you through your offering, with true love who are faithful to all who invoke you in truth.

text: Concede nobis misericors Deus et digne tuis servire semper altaribus et eorum perpetua participatione salvari.
translation_en: Grant us, merciful God, that we may always serve you worthily at the altars and be saved by their perpetual participation.

text: Concede nobis misericors Deus et studia perversa deponere et sanctam semper amare iustitiam.
translation_en: Grant us, merciful God, the ability to forsake perverse studies and always love the holy justice.

text: Concede nobis misericors Deus ut quod imbecillitas nostra pro suo modulo non valet impetrare sancti Laurentii precibus assequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, merciful God, that what our weakness cannot obtain on its own, we may achieve through the prayers of Saint Lawrence.

text: Concede nobis misericors Deus ut sicut nomine patris et filii divini generis intellegimus veritatem sic in spiritu sancto totius cognoscamus substantiam Trinitatis.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, O merciful God, that we may understand the truth as we comprehend it by the name of the Father and of the Son divine nature, so also in the Holy Spirit may we fully comprehend the substance of the Trinity.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus et in his quae tibi placent fixam tenere constantiam et tua semper protectione muniri.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, the power to steadfastly hold firmness in those things that please You, and always to be fortified with Your protection.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus intercedente beato Lamberto martyre tuo atque pontifice cuius annuam sollemnitatem celebramus ut descendat hic benedictio tua super sacrificium nostrum in transformatione spiritus tui sancti ut haec benedicendo benedicas sanctificando sanctifices ut quicumque ex utraque benedictione sumpserimus aeternitatis praemium et vitam consequi mereamur aeternam.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, through the intercession of your martyr and bishop, Blessed Lambert, whose annual feast we celebrate, that your blessing may descend upon our sacrifice in the transformation of your holy Spirit, so that by blessing and sanctifying and sanctifying again, we who have received any blessing from it may merit eternal reward and life.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus sanctae martyris Euphemiae et exsultare meritis et beneficia referre suffragiis.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, through the merits and benefits of the holy martyr Euphemia, to rejoice and offer our supplications in her intercession.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut ab improbis voluntatibus recedentes praeceptorum tuorum rectitudinem subsequamur et qui deviis etiam desiderata concedis praestes meliora correctis.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that, leaving behind wicked desires, we may follow the righteousness of your commandments. And for those who have strayed, may you grant even the desired things to those who are corrected.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut beati Silvestri confessoris tui atque pontificis honoranda celebritas tibi placitum tribuat famulatum.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the honorable solemnity of your blessed confessor and pope, St. Silvester, may be pleasing to you through our service.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut despectis falsitatibus iniquorum quae animae nostrae conveniunt rationabilia exsequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we may avoid the falsehoods of the wicked which our souls are prone to, and follow what is reasonable.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut his muneribus quae pro sanctorum martyrum Gervasii et Protasii honore deferimus et te placemus exhibitis et nos vivificemur acceptis.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we may honor the martyrs Gervasius and Protasius with these offerings, and may please you with them presented, and may be revitalized by accepting them.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut intercessione beati Pelagii martyris tui haec munera sancta quae sumpsimus et praesens animarum nobis medicamen conferant et praemium aeternae salutis acquirant.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that through the intercession of your blessed martyr Pelagius, these holy gifts we have received may serve as healing for our souls and acquire for us the reward of eternal salvation.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut per annua quadragesimalis exercitia sacramenti et ad intellegendum Christi proficiamus arcanum et effectus eius digna conversatione sectemur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that through the annual exercises of Lent we may progress in understanding the mystery and effect of Christ, and may follow His example worthy of our conduct.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut qui diem consecrationis huius templi annua celebritate recolimus ipsi quoque per sanctificationem tui spiritus tibi habitaculum effici mereamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that we who recall the day of consecration of this temple with annual solemnity, may also merit to make ourselves your dwelling place through your sanctifying spirit.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut sacramenti dominici nobis operante virtute ipsius aeternitatis mereamur esse consortes qui mortalitatis nostrae dignatus est fieri particeps.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that through the working of the virtue of the sacrament of your dominion we may deserve to be consorts who were worthy to become a participant in our mortality.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut salutare tuum nova caelorum luce mirabili quod ad salutem mundi hodierna festivitate processit nostris semper innovandis cordibus oriatur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that your saving grace, which on this day has shone forth with a wondrous light from the heavens for the salvation of the world, may always be born anew in our hearts.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut sicut in passione sua Dominus noster Iesus Christus diversa utrisque intulit stipendia meritorum ita ablato a nobis vetustatis errore resurrectionis eius gratiam consequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that as our Lord Jesus Christ bestowed rewards of merits in diverse ways during His passion, so when the error of our old age is removed from us, we may attain the grace of His resurrection.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens Deus ut sicut temporali cena tuae passionis reficimur ita satiari mereamur aeterna.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that as we were refreshed at Your temporal supper during Your Passion, so may we merit to be satisfied in eternal life.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus per sancti Swithuni meritum nostrorum remissionem peccaminum et per gloriosi eiusdem praesulis interventum supernae felicitatis praemium.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, O almighty and merciful God, through the merits of Saint Swithun, forgiveness of our sins, and through the intervention of his glorious bishop, the reward of supreme happiness.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens et misericors Deus ut haec nostra sit salutifera oblatio et intercedente beato Germano consessore tuo atque episcopo a nostris reatibus liberet et a cunctis tueatur adversitatibus.
translation_en: Grant, almighty and merciful God, that this our offering may be salutary for us. And with the intercession of Blessed Germanus, your bishop and successor, may he free us from our sins and protect us from all adversities.

text: Concede nobis omnipotens et mitissime Deus apud quem nulla est iniquitas ut qui huius sanctuarii tui possessionem diripiendo invadunt celeri satisfactione corrigantur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty and most merciful God, that we who steal the possessions of this your sanctuary may be swiftly corrected.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus Domine alacribus animis beati confessoris tui Benedicti sollemnia praevenire cuius diversis decorata virtutibus tibi vita complacuit.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Lord, cheerful spirits to precede the solemnities of your blessed confessor Benedict, whose life pleased you with various adorned virtues.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus Domine veniam peccatorum et religionis augmentum atque ut in nobis tua dona multiplices tuis fac mandatis promptiores.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, forgiveness of sins and an increase in our religious devotion, and may your gifts within us make us more eager to fulfill your commands.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus venturam beati apostoli tui illius sollemnitatem congruo praevenire honore et venientem digna celebrare devotione.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that the coming of your blessed apostle may be fittingly preceded by honor and worthily celebrated with devotion.

text: Concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sicut per beatos apostolos tuos Petrum et Paulum christianam suscepimus fidem ita per ipsos etiam percipiamus aeternae vitae felicitatem.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, that just as through your holy apostles Peter and Paul we have received the Christian faith, so through them may we also experience the happiness of eternal life.

text: Concede nos famulos tuos quaesumus Domine Deus perpetua mentis et corporis sanitate gaudere et gloriosa beatae Mariae semper virginis intercessione a praesenti liberari tristitia et futura perfrui laetitia.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord God, perpetual health of mind and body to enjoy and, through the intercession of the ever-virgin blessed Mary, to be freed from sadness at present and to experience joy in the future.

text: Concede nos famulos tuos quaesumus Domine in beati Benedicti confessoris tui gaudentes sollemnitate et ab omnibus absolvi peccatis et cunctis erui periculis.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Lord, your servants, that on the joyful feast day of your blessed confessor Benedict, we may be absolved from all sins and freed from every danger.

text: Concede omnipotens Deus his salutaribus sacrificiis placatus ut famulus tuus ille ad peragendum regalis dignitatis officium inveniatur semper idoneus et caelestis patriae gaudiis reddatur acceptus.
translation_en: Gracious God, almighty, may you be pleased with these saving sacrifices. Grant that your servant may always be found worthy for the performance of his royal duties and returned accepted to the joys of heavenly fatherland.

text: Concede omnipotens Deus ut et gaudiorum plenitudinem consequamur et maiestati tuae propensius <possimus> esse devoti.
translation_en: Grant, almighty God, that we may attain the fullness of joy and be more devoted to your majesty.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine beatos apostolos tuos intervenire pro nobis; ita enim nos salvari posse confidimus si eorum precibus ecclesia gubernetur quibus utitur te constituente principibus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that your blessed apostles intervene for us; indeed, we confidently believe that we can be saved if the church is governed by their prayers, through which you establish princes.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine beatum apostolum tuum Petrum intervenire pro nobis; ita enim nos salvari posse confidimus si eius precibus ecclesia gubernetur quo utitur te constituente principe.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, your blessed apostle Peter to intercede for us; for in this way we confidently believe that we can be saved if the church is governed by his prayers, with whom you have appointed as ruler.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine apostolos tuos intervenire pro nobis quia tunc nos salvari posse confidimus si eorum precibus tua gubernetur ecclesia quibus utitur te constituente principibus.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, Lord, that your apostles may intercede for us, for then we confidently believe we can be saved if your church is governed by them, to whom you have appointed as rulers.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine apostolum tuum Thomam intervenire pro nobis cuius diem celebramus translationis quia tunc nos salvari posse confidimus si eius precibus tua gubernetur ecclesia cuius utitur te constituente doctrina.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, that your apostle Thomas may intercede for us on whose feast day we are celebrating his translation, for then we confidently trust that we can be saved if your church is guided by his prayers, which church you have established using his doctrine.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui illius nos deprecatione muniri ut et temporaliter his patrociniis foveamur et spiritaliter praeparemur aeternis.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask, Lord, of your blessed priest and confesor, that through his intercession we may be protected temporally by his patronage and spiritually prepared for eternity.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut animae famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum quarumque commemorationem speciali devotione agimus et pro quibus orare iussi et debitores sumus atque omnium benefactorum nostrorum ac omnium consanguineorum et familiarium nostrorum cunctorumque fidelium in sinibus sanctorum tuorum requiescant moxque ex mortuis resuscitati tibi placeant in regione vivorum.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that the souls of Thy servants and handmaids whom we commemorate with special devotion, for whose prayers we have been commanded and are debtors, and all the benefactors among our kin, family members, and all faithful people, may rest in the bosom of Thy saints; and soon rise again from the dead to please Thee in the land of the living.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut inter adversa quae peccatorum debitis sustinemus quod fiducia nostra non obtinet martyrum tuorum nobis intercessio consequatur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that amidst the trials which are due to our sins, we may obtain what our faith does not achieve; that the intercession of Thy martyrs may be effective for us.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut inter adversa quae peccatis sustinemus quod fiducia nostra non obtinet apostoli tui illius nobis intercessio consequatur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, our God, that amidst the trials we bear due to our sins, may the intervention of Your apostle obtain for us, where our faith lacks.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut inter adversa quae pro delictorum debito sustinemus quod fiducia nostra non obtinet beati martyris tui Sebastiani intercessio consequatur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that in the trials which we bear for our sins' debt, we may obtain the help of Thy blessed martyr Saint Sebastian's intercession.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut mysteria sancta quae sumpsimus intercedente beato Romano confessore tuo atque pontifice et gratiam nobis devotionis obtineant et effectum beatae perennitatis acquirant.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that the sacred mysteries which we have received, through the intercession of Thy blessed confessor and Pope Saint Romanus, may obtain for us the grace of devotion and acquire for us the effect of blessed eternal life.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per tua semper sacramenta vivamus quia protegere non desistis quos tuis semper indulseris inhaerere mysteriis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that we may always live through Thy sacred mysteries, for Thou never ceaseth to protect those whom Thou hast ever permitted to adhere to the mysteries.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per tua semper quae sumpsimus sacramenta vivamus quia suffragiis sacerdotis et martyris tui Leudegarii protegere non desistis quos tuis semper indulseris inhaerere mysteriis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that through the sacraments which we have received, we may live, for Thou never ceaseth to protect us with the intercessions of Thy priest and martyr Leudegar. May we ever cling to Thy mysteries.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut qui ad destructionem diaboli et remissionem natus est hodie peccatorum et a culparum subreptione nos expiet et ab hostium incursione defendat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that he who today was born for the destruction of the devil and the remission of sins may also cleanse us from guilt's deception and protect us from the onslaught of our enemies.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine famulo tuo episcopo nostro ut praedicando et exercendo quae recta sunt exemplo bonorum operum animas suorum instruat subditorum et aeternae remunerationis mercedem a te piissimo pastore percipiat.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your servant our bishop, that by preaching and practicing what is right, he may instruct the souls of his subjects with good examples, and that he may receive the reward of eternal compensation from you, the most merciful shepherd.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis digne sancti Gregorii pontificis tui celebrare mysteria ut eius quae fideliter exsequuntur et hic experiantur auxilia et aeternis effectibus apprehendant.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, worthy to your faithful ones that they may celebrate the mysteries according to Saint Gregory, your bishop, so that those who faithfully execute (them) here may experience help and may grasp (eternal rewards) with eternal effectiveness.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine populo tuo veniam peccatorum et quod meritis non praesumit indulgentiae tuae celeri largitate percipiat.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech Thee, Lord, to Thy people forgiveness for their sins and may they swiftly receive the grace of Thy indulgence, which does not presume upon merits.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine famulo tuo illi suorum per haec sacramenta veniam delictorum et quod meritis non praesumit indulgentiae tuae largitate percipiat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, to Your servant that through these sacraments he may receive forgiveness of sins and that, not presuming on his own merits, he may obtain Your indulgence.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine populo tuo veniam peccatorum et religionis augmentum atque ut ei tua dona multiplices sanctorum martyrum tuorum Protasii et Gervasii patrocinia fac adesse et largire praesidia.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, forgiveness of sins for Your people and an increase in religious devotion. And may the multiplied patronage of Your holy martyrs Protasius and Gervasius be present and grant protective aid.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine semper nos per haec mysteria paschalia gratulari ut continua nostrae reparationis operatio perpetua nobis fiat causa laetitiae.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask, Lord, always that through these Paschal mysteries we may continually rejoice and that the ongoing work of our repair may become a perpetual cause of joy for us.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine ut ad preces tuas corda nostra flectamus et esse tibi possibilia cuncta fidentes non de elementorum profutura nobis speremus effectu sed de tua virtute suppliciter imploremus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, that we bend our hearts to Thy prayers and consider all things possible for us, trusting not in the outcome of elements but in Thy virtue; humbly we will implore Thy power.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine ut oculis tuae maiestatis munus oblatum et gratiam nobis devotionis obtineat et effectum beatae perennitatis acquirat.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the offering made before your majesty's presence may obtain grace for us through devotion and acquire the fruit of blessed eternal life.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine ut perceptum novi sacramenti mysterium et corpore sentiamus et mente.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that through the newly received sacrament's mystery, we may feel it with our body and comprehend it with our mind.

text: Concede quaesumus Domine ut sicut famulus tuus ille oblatis optavit muneribus beatorum martyrum tuorum illorum hic semper merita celebrentur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that as your servant he offered the gifts to the blessed martyrs of yours, their merits may here always be celebrated.

text: Concede quaesumus misericors Deus ut intercedente beato Ricardo consessore tuo atque pontifice tuae maiestati munus oblatum et gratiam nobis bene vivendi obtineat et gloriam sempiternam post hanc vitam acquirat.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, O merciful God, that through the intercession of your blessed consecrator Richard and the pontiff of your majesty, the offering presented to you be accepted and may obtain for us the grace of living well, and eternal glory after this life.

text: Concede quaesumus misericors Deus ut sancti martyris tui Adriani veneranda festivitas salutaris auxilii praestet nobis augmentum.
translation_en: Grant us, merciful God, that the venerable feast day of your saint-martyr Adrian may bestow upon us an increase of healthful help.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ad eorum gaudia aeterna pertingere de quorum nos virtute tribuis annua sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, Almighty God, that they may reach eternal joys of whom we annually rejoice because of their virtue.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ad beatae Mariae semper virginis gaudia aeterna pertingere de cuius nos veneranda assumptione tribuis annua sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we humbly ask You, Almighty God, that the eternal joys of the Blessed Virgin Mary may reach us, for whom we are allowed to rejoice annually on the solemnity of her venerable Assumption.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus animabus famulorum atque sacerdotum tuorum illorum felicitatis aeternae consortium quibus donasti sacri altaris tui consequi ministerium.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, the souls of your servants and priests the eternal happiness of joining them, whom you have granted to serve at your holy altar.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus beati apostoli tui Barnabae sollemnitatem honore congruo celebrare et digna suscipere devotione.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that your blessed apostle Barnabas may celebrate his solemnity with fitting honor and accept it with worthy devotion.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus famulo tuo illi consolationis auxilium et diuturnis calamitatibus laborantem propitius respirare concede.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, to your servant that he may receive aid in his long-lasting sorrows and breathe kindly upon him.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus fidelibus tuis beati Benedicti confessoris tui festa celebrantibus cunctorum veniam peccatorum ut qui exsultantibus animis eius claritati congaudent ipso apud te interveniente consocientur et meritis.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, to your faithful celebrating the festival of your blessed confessor St. Benedict, remission of all sins, so that those who rejoice in spirit with his clarity may be made known to him and meet him in you, through his merits.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus fragilitati nostrae sufficientiam competentem ut suae reparationis effectum et pia conversatione recenseat et cum exsultatione suscipiat.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech you, almighty God, a suitable aid to our frailty, so that the work of repair and renewal may be accomplished through it, and that He may receive and accept it with joyful devotion.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus hanc gratiam plebi tuae adventum unigeniti tui cum summa vigilantia exspectare ut sicut ipse auctor nostrae salutis docuit velut fulgentes lampadas in eius occursum nostras animas praeparemus.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, this grace to your people, that they may eagerly await the coming of your unique Son with utmost vigilance, as you, the author of our salvation, have taught us, preparing our souls like shining lamps in his presence.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus illius nos lucis consortes effici quam tuus hodie filius in sui transfiguratione corporis tua eum paternitate pandente patefecit.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask, almighty God, that you make us sharers of that light, as your Son today became when his body was transfigured and the Father revealed him in his divinity.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus per merita et intercessionem beati illius ut qui merito nostrae iniquitatis affligimur munere tuae pietatis per unigenitum tuum a saevis barbaris celerrime eruamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, through the merits and intercession of that blessed one, that we who are rightly afflicted by our own iniquity may be swiftly delivered from cruel barbarians by the mercy of your goodness through your only-begotten Son.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus sacramenta quae sumpsimus in honore beatae Mariae virginis matris immaculato corde servare ut nunc festa eius colentes post excessum huius vitae ad ipsius mereamur transire consortium.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that the sacraments which we have received may be preserved in honor of the blessed Virgin Mary, whose heart is without blemish, so that we who celebrate her feast now may merit to pass into her consortium after the end of this life.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus spiritum nos sanctum votis promereri sedulis quatenus eius gratia ab omnibus liberemur temptationibus et peccatorum nostrorum indulgentiam mereamur accipere.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we entreat you, Almighty God, the Holy Spirit to make our vows fervent, so that through His grace we may be freed from all temptations and merit to receive the forgiveness of our sins.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ad meliorem vitam sanctorum tuorum exempla nos provocent quatenus quorum sollemnia agimus etiam actus imitemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that the examples of Your saints may stir us towards a better life, so that not only their feast days, but also their deeds, we may emulate.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut anima famuli tui illius abbatis atque sacerdotis per haec sancta mysteria in tuo conspectu semper clara consistat quae fideliter ministravit.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the soul of your servant, that abbot and priest, may always remain steadfast before you through these holy mysteries, whom he has served faithfully.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beata virgo Marcellina suis pro nobis apud tuam misericordiam meritis obtineat quo ipsius gloriosum excessum dignis ad tuam magnificentiam laudibus honoremus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that the blessed virgin Marcellina may obtain favor before your mercy for us through her merits, so that we may honor her glorious departure with fitting praises to your majesty.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus {ut} beati Birini confessoris tui nos ubique intercessionibus adiuvari cuius nos doctrinis ad agnitionem tui nominis pervenire donasti.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that we may be helped everywhere by the intercessions of your blessed confessor Birinus, whose teachings led us to recognize your name.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Martini confessoris tui frequentata sollemnitas ad perpetuam populo tuo proficiat salutem et quem saepius veneramur in terris semper habeamus patronum in caelis.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the solemnity of your blessed martyr St. Martin may bring eternal salvation to your people, and that he, whom we venerate frequently on earth, may always be our patron in heaven.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Ecclesia tua et in suorum firmitate membrorum et in nova semper fecunditate laetetur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that your Church may rejoice in the strength of its members and in a new and ever-fruitful fecundity.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut familia tua in hoc praesenti monasterio congregata sine ullius murmurationis periculo in servitio sancti nominis tui secura possit exsistere et miserationum tuarum largitatem cum pace et concordia adipisci mereatur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that Your family gathered in this present monastery may exist securely without any danger of murmuring in the service of Your holy name. May they deserve to receive the abundance of Your mercies with peace and harmony.

text: De Abraham III.
translation_en: From Abraham III.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut festa paschalia quae venerando colimus etiam vivendo teneamus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who celebrate the Paschal feasts with reverence may also keep them in our living.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut festa paschalia quae devotione colimus moribus exsequamur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we may observe the Paschal feasts which we venerate with devotion, according to our conduct.

text: De Iona X.
translation_en: From Iona X.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut hac festivitate beatae martyris tuae Caeciliae qua ad caelestia meruit evocari praemia coniunctis sibi Tiburtio et Valeriano sicut credimus et speramus eorum suffragiis adiuvemur.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that on this festivity of your blessed martyr Cecilia, who merited to be called to heavenly rewards, Tiburtius and Valerian may be united with her, as we believe and hope. May we be helped by their intercession.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut huius perceptione sacramenti ita nostrae fragilitatis vitia expurgentur quatenus per Spiritum Sanctum repromissum in nobis donum tuae gratiae sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that through this sacred perception our frailties may be purged, so that we may feel the gift of your grace promised by the Holy Spirit within us.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut huius sacrificii munus oblatum fragilitatem nostram ab omni malo purget semper et muniat.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that this offering of the sacrifice may always cleanse our frailty from every evil and protect us.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ieiuniorum nobis sancta devotio et purificationem tribuat et maiestati tuae nos reddat acceptos.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that the holy devotion and cleansing of the fasting may be given to us, and that we may be returned to Your majesty as acceptable.

text: De psalmo XLI.
translation_en: From Psalm 41.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut in adventu Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi cum omnibus sanctis placitis tibi actibus praesentemur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that in the coming of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, with all saints, we may be pleasing to you in our actions.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercessio nos Dei Genitricis Mariae et omnium sanctorum ubique laetificet ut dum eorum merita recolimus patrocinia sentiamus. ( recensio brevis ) Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercessio nos sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctorumque omnium apostolorum martyrum consessorum virginum et omnium electorum tuorum ubique laetificet ut dum eorum merita recolimus patrocinia sentiamus. ( recensio media ) Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercessio nos sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctarumque omnium caelestium virtutum et beatorum patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum confessorum atque virginum et omnium electorum tuorum ubique laetificet ut dum eorum merita recolimus patrocinia sentiamus. ( recensio longa )
translation_en:
Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, and all saints everywhere may rejoice us, so that while we recall their merits, we may feel their patronage. (short version)
Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that the intercession of the holy Mother of God, and all saints, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all your elect everywhere may rejoice us, so that while we recall their merits, we may feel their patronage. (medium version)
Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that the intercession of the holy Mother of God, all saints, celestial virtues, blessed patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all your elect everywhere may rejoice us, so that while we recall their merits, we may feel their patronage. (long version)

text: Debitum humani corporis officium
translation_en: Duty of the human body's care

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sancta Dei genitrix sanctique tui apostoli et omnes martyres confessores ac virgines perfectique tui nos ubique laetificent ut dum eorum merita recolimus patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty God, that the holy Mother of God, your saints apostles, all martyrs and confessors, virgins, and all your perfect ones may everywhere rejoice in us, so that as we remember their merits, we may feel their patronage.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut magnae festivitatis ventura sollemnia prospero celebremus effectu pariterque reddamur et intenti caelestibus disciplinis et de nostris temporibus laetiores.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask You, almighty God, that we may happily celebrate the approaching great festivities with their due effect, and at the same time be made joyful in heavenly disciplines and more cheerful from our own times.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut paschalis perceptio sacramenti continua in nostris mentibus perseveret.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the perception of the Paschal sacrament may continually remain in our minds.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut paschalis perfectio sacramenti mentibus nostris continua perseveret.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the perfection of the Paschal sacrament may continuously remain in our minds.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per has oblationes quas tibi offerimus pro anima famuli et sacerdotis tui illius ante conspectum gratiae tuae semper exsultet ut qui tuis mysteriis fideliter ministravit his oblationibus te miserante se sentiat liberatum.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you almighty God, that through these offerings which we present to you on behalf of the soul of your servant and priest, may it always rejoice before your grace. May he who faithfully ministered these offerings feel released by you, when you show mercy upon him.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut proxima ventura sollemnia ( ... lac. ... ) itaque quaesumus tibi pater acceptam et ad investigandam proximam Christi nativitatem ( ... lac. ... ) ipsius educatione sectemur.
translation_en: Grants us, we humbly ask You Almighty God, that the approaching festivals (...lacuna...), and therefore we humbly ask You, Father, to accept our prayers, and to seek out the nearest celebration of Christ's nativity (...lacuna...). We will follow His education.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatae Barnabae apostoli tui sollemnia colimus eius meritis et precibus pietatis tuae subsidia capiamus.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the solemnity of your apostle blessed Barnabas, we may obtain his merits and support through your aid.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Ioannis Baptistae sollemnia colimus eius apud te intercessione muniamur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who celebrate the feast of blessed John the Baptist may be protected by his intercession with you.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati martyris tui illius sollemnia colimus cuius gaudemus natalitiis instruamur exemplis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that we who celebrate the feast of your blessed martyr may be instructed by his examples and rejoice in his nativity.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui ex merito nostrae actionis affligimur tuae gratiae consolatione respiremus.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who are afflicted by our actions may breathe in the consolation of your grace.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui festa paschalia venerando egimus per haec contingere ad gaudia aeterna mereamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that we who have celebrated the Easter festivals with reverence may be worthy to attain eternal joys.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui hodierna die unigenitum tuum ad caelos ascendisse credimus ipsi quoque mente in caelestibus habitemus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who believe your unique Son ascended to heaven today, may also dwell in heaven with him in mind.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui in sancti Iohannis Baptistae et martyris tui passione dona sacramenti percepimus eius interventu auxilium tuum sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who have received the sacrament in the passion of your saint John the Baptist and martyr, may feel your help through his intervention.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui paschalis festivitatis sollemnia colimus in tua semper sanctificatione vivamus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who celebrate the solemnities of the Paschal feast may always live in your sanctification.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui peccatorum nostrorum pondere premimur a cunctis malis imminentibus per haec paschalia festa liberemur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who are burdened by the weight of our sins may be freed from all evils approaching through these Paschal feasts.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui peccatorum nostrorum pondere premimur beati Dominici confessoris tui patrocinio sublevemur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that we who are pressed down by the weight of our sins may be lifted up through the patronage of your blessed confessor Saint Dominic.

text: Deprecamur Domine clementiam pietatis
translation_en: We ask, Lord, for the clemency of mercy.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui protectionis tuae gratiam quaerimus liberati a malis omnibus secura tibi mente serviamus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who seek the grace of your protection may be freed from all evils and serve you with a mind securely devoted to you.

text: Deprecamur misericordiam tuam
translation_en: We entreat your mercy

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui resurrectionis dominicae sollemnia colimus innovatione tui spiritus a morte animae resurgamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the solemnity of the Resurrection, may rise again from death through your Holy Spirit.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sollemnitatem doni Spiritus Sancti colimus caelestibus desideriis accensi fontem vitae sitiamus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the solemnity of the Holy Spirit, inflamed with heavenly desires, may thirst for the source of life.

text: Descendat in hanc plenitudinem
translation_en: Let it descend into this fullness

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui festa paschalia agimus caelestibus desideriis accensi fontem vitae sitiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the Paschal feasts with celestial longings, may thirst for the fountain of life.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui triumphum laudabilem beati levitae et martyris Iuliani recolimus dignam ipsius imitationem sectando gaudiorum eius effici mereamur participes.
translation_en: Grant us, we entreat you almighty God, that we who remember the laudable triumph of Blessed Levite and Martyr Julian, may be worthy to follow his joy, so that we may merit to become partakers of his rewards.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sub peccati iugo ex vetusta servitute deprimimur exspectata unigeniti Filii tui nova nativitate liberemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that we who are oppressed under the yoke of sin from ancient slavery may be freed by the expected birth of Your Only-Begotten Son.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sancta Dei genitrix sanctique tui apostoli martyres confessores virgines atque omnes sancti quorum iri ista continentur ecclesia patrocinia nos ubique adiuvent quatenus hic in illorum praesenti suffragio tranquilla pace in tua laude laetemur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask You, Almighty God, that the holy Mother of God, Your saints apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all the saints whose relics are contained in this church, may assist us everywhere, so that here in their present intercession we may rejoice tranquilly in Your praise with peace.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum illorum intercessionibus adiuvemur pro quorum sollemnitate laetamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty God, that we may be aided by the intercessions of your holy martyrs, whose feast day we rejoice over.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum quorum celebramus victorias participemur et praemiis.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we may participate in the victories of your saints whose feasts we celebrate and receive the rewards.

text: Deum Patrem omnipotentem supplices in officium exorcistae…
translation_en: Suppliantly, in the office of the exorcist, we appeal to the Almighty Father God...

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut apostolorum tuorum illorum gloriosa natalicia praevenimus sic ad tua beneficia promerenda maiestatem tuam pro nobis ipsi praeveniant.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that just as we have anticipated the glorious natal days of your apostles, so may your majesty be brought before us for your graces to be attained on our behalf.

text: Deum Patrem omnipotentem supplices in officium exorcistae ...
translation_en: Suppliantly, in the office of an exorcist, we call upon the Almighty Father God...

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut nos paschalibus gaudiis fecisti temporaliter gratulari sic nos in aeterna beatitudine cum omnibus sanctis facias intuitu pacifico perfrui.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Almighty God, that just as you have made us rejoice temporarily with the paschal joys, so may you lead us to enjoy eternal beatitude with all the saints in a peaceful vision.

text: Deum Patrem omnipotentem suppliciter deprecamur…
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, the Almighty Father...

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut tua mysteria quae in omnium sanctorum martyrum tuorum commemoratione percepimus eorum intercessione nobis ad salutem proficere sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we may feel the benefit of your mysteries which we have perceived in the commemoration of all your saints and martyrs, through their intercession for our salvation.

text: Deum Patrem omnipotentem suppliciter deprecamur ...
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, O Almighty God, our Father...

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut unigeniti tui nova per carnem nativitas liberet quos sub peccati iugo vetusta servitus tenet.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask You, Almighty God, that the birth of your Only-Begotten Son in flesh may free those who are held in the old bondage of sin.

text: Deum Patris omnipotentis misericordiam…
translation_en: The mercy of the Almighty Father...

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quos sub peccati iugo vetusta servitus tenet eos unigeniti tui nova per carnem nativitas liberet.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that those whom the old bondage of sin holds may be freed by the new birth of your only-begotten Son in the flesh.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut veterem cum suis rationibus hominem deponentes illius conversatione vivamus ad cuius nos substantiam paschalibus remediis transtulisti.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that as you lower the old man with his passions, we may live according to his conversation; to whose substance you have translated us by the Paschal remedies.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut viam tuam devota mente currentes subripientium delictorum laqueos evadamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Almighty God, that with a devoted mind we may escape the snares of transgressions by walking on Your way.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut beata Euphemia quae virginitatis pariter et martyrii promeruit palmam intercessionibus suis et praesentis vitae remedia nobis conserat et aeternam salutem.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty and merciful God, that blessed Euphemia, who has merited the palm both of virginity and martyrdom, through her intercessions may protect us and offer us remedies in this life, and grant us eternal salvation.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut qui venerandam gloriosissimi pontificis et confessoris tui Syri depositionem annuis frequentamus excubiis dignam ipsius imitationem sectando gaudiorum eius mereamur esse participes.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, that we who annually celebrate the venerable deposition of your glorious pontiff and confessor Syri, may merit to be participants in his joys by following his worthy example.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut qui beati Christophori martyris tui memoriam agimus eius piis meritis et intercessionibus a morte perpetua subitanea peste fame timore paupertate et ab omnibus insidiis inimicorum nostrorum liberemur in terris per te Iesu Christe Salvator mundi rex gloriae quem idem Christophorus meruit in suis humeris portare.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, Almighty and merciful God, that we who remember the martyr Blessed Christopher may be delivered from eternal death, sudden pestilence, famine, fear, poverty, and every snare of our enemies on earth through You, Jesus Christ, Savior of the world, whom the same Christopher merited to bear upon his shoulders.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sancta virgo virginum Maria omnesque ordines angelorum atque omnes sancti et electi tui nos semper et ubique adiuvent ut quorum suffragia pariter poscimus eorum iugiter precibus ab omni adversitate liberari remissionemque omnium peccatorum consequi et ad tuam misericordiam pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty and merciful God, that the holy virgin Mary, all orders of angels, and all your saints and chosen ones always and everywhere assist us; whose intercession we equally seek. May they continually pray for our liberation from every adversity, to obtain remission of all sins, and to merit Your mercy.

text: Concede quaesumus rex aeterne ut huius sacrificii munus interventu sancti Sigismundi regis et martyris tui fragilitatem nostram ab omni adversitate semper protegat et muniat.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, O eternal King, that the ministry of this sacrifice may be protected and fortified by the intercession of Your saintly king and martyr Sigismund, and may our frailty always be safeguarded and strengthened against every adversity.

text: Conciliet nobis misericordiam tuam Domine munus oblatum nostraeque simul protectioni proficiat et saluti.
translation_en: May your mercy, Lord, the offering brought before us be beneficial for our protection as well and bring salvation.

text: Deus Abraham Deus Isaac Deus Iacob Deus qui Moysi
translation_en: God of Abraham, God of Isaac, God of Jacob, God who appeared to Moses

text: Concordator discordiae et origo societatis aeternae indivisa Trinitas Deus qui Sisenii infidelitatem ab ecclesiae unitate disiunctam per sanctum Clementem antistitem et subdis catholicae fidei et innectis perpetuae caritati exaudi preces nostras illamque nobis pacem tribue quam quondam aetherem ascensurus apostolis reliquisti ut qui praesentium labiorum impressione illigati fuerint osculo tua custodia pacifici permaneant in futuro.
translation_en: The Concordator of discord and the origin of eternal society, the indivisible Trinity, God, who separated Sisenius' unfaithfulness from the unity of the Church through Saint Clement, bishop, and bound by the cords of Catholic faith and linked with perpetual charity, hear our prayers.
