Grant us the peace that you left to the apostles as they ascended to the ether, so that those who are bound by the impression of the present lips may remain peaceful in the future under your protection.

text: Deus Abraham Deus Isaac Deus Iacob Deus qui tribus
translation_en: God of Abraham, God of Isaac, God of Jacob, God of the three

text: Concurrat Domine quaesumus populus tuus et toto tibi corde subiectus obtineat ut ab omni perturbatione securus et salvationis suae gaudia promptus exerceat et pro regenerandis benignus exoret.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your people may concur with you and, with the whole heart subject to you, may obtain that they are secure from all disturbance and eager for the joys of their salvation. May they also be merciful in praying for the regeneration of others.

text: Deus Abraham Deus Isaac Deus qui tribus
translation_en: God of Abraham, God of Isaac, God who appears to the three

text: Concurrentes ad te clementissime Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus in celebritate beatae martyris tuae Iustinae praesta quaesumus ut eius semper gubernemur effectu et peccatorum nostrorum veniam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Grant us, most clement and almighty eternal God, in the festivity of your blessed martyr Justinus, that we may always be guided by his influence and merit forgiveness for our sins.

text: Conditor et redemptor humani generis Christe Filius Dei patris concede nobis famulis tuis ut hodie tam viventibus quam defunctis criminum donetur remissio qualiter cras omnibus in commune sit exsultationis omnimoda plenitudo.
translation_en: Creator and redeemer of the human race, Christ Son of God, grant us, your servants, that today, both for those living and those who have died, forgiveness may be given. May there be a universal fullness of every kind of exultation for all tomorrow.

text: Conditor et redemptor humani generis Christe Filius Dei qui capiti virginis tuae quod iam erat caelesti rore perfusum magnam contulisti gratiam capillorum quo suis videretur ad honorem crinibus tecta quae propriis fuerat ad contumeliam vestimentis exuta tu pius offerentium accipe vota defunctis requiem praesta et cunctos in commune eiusdem virginis prece fac pervenire ad aeternam salutem.
translation_en: Creator and redeemer of the human race, Christ, Son of God, who had already been anointed with heavenly dew on your Virgin's head, you bestowed great grace upon her hair so that they seemed adorned for honor rather than previously exposed to disdain by clothing. You, the merciful one, receive the vows of the departed. Grant them rest. And may all, through the same prayer of this Virgin, come to eternal salvation.

text: Deus aeterne ante cuius
translation_en: God eternally before whose

text: Conferat nobis Domine sancti Ioannis utrumque sollemnitas ut magnifica sacramenta quae sumpsimus (et) significata veneremur et in nobis potius edita gaudeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the feast of blessed John, that we may reverence with awe the sacred mysteries we have received and rather rejoice that they are fulfilled within us.

text: Deus aeternorum bonorum
translation_en: God of eternal goods

text: Confessoris tui illius Domine memoriam facientes qui te inter adversa confiteri non destitit actu placuit oratione quaesivit perfectione invenit te quaesumus te rogamus ut his victimis tibi ob honorem eius oblatis clementer illabi iubeas et ex his sumentibus peccata dimittas atque confessionis gratia glorificandos attollas.
translation_en: Lord, we remember your confessor who, in the midst of adversities, did not cease to acknowledge you. It pleased him to seek you through prayer, and he found perfection in you. We ask and beseech you: grant mercy to these victims offered to you on account of his honor, and from those partaking, forgive sins. Furthermore, may we, who are graced by confession, be lifted up in glory.

text: Deus angelorum Deus archangelorum
translation_en: God of angels, God of archangels

text: Confirma Domine famulos tuos quos ex aqua et spiritu sancto propitius redemisti ut veterem hominem cum suis actionibus deponentes in ipsius conversatione vivamus ad cuius substantiam per haec paschalia mysteria transtulisti.
translation_en: Confirm, Lord, your servants whom you have graciously redeemed from water and holy Spirit. May we live according to the old man's ways, putting off his deeds, within whose substance you have brought us through these Paschal mysteries.

text: Confirma Domine quaesumus tuorum corda filiorum et gratiae tuae virtute corrobora ut et in tua sint supplicatione devoti et mutua dilectione sinceri.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you strengthen the hearts of your sons and uphold them with your grace, so that they may be devoted in their supplications to you and show sincere mutual love.

text: Deus apud quem mortuorum spiritus
translation_en: God in whom the spirits of the dead dwell

text: Confirma hoc Deus quod operatus es in nobis et custodi gratiam quam nobis conferre dignatus es tuorum intercessione sanctorum et donum tuae misericordiae famulae tuae conferre dignare.
translation_en: Confirm what God, you have worked within us, and guard the grace which you have been pleased to bestow upon us through the intercession of your saints, and deign to grant your servant the gift of your mercy.

text: Confitebimur tibi Domine confitebimur tibi et credimus pro nostro scelere te mortis corporee subdidisse supplicio et pro omnium salute prostrato mortis interitu triumphantibus angelis caelestis patris mysticam ad mansionem reversum persolide; te petimus et rogamus ut oblata in conspectu tuo nostrae servitutis libamina ipse tibi acceptabilia facias et accepta discurrente sancto angelo tuo nobis sanctificata dividas ut dum corda nostra corporis et sanguinis tui communicatione purificas petitiones nostras in odorem suavitatis accipias.
translation_en: We will confess to you, Lord, we will confess to you and we believe that you have subjected yourself to death for our sin, and for the salvation of all, triumphant angels of heaven have prostrated themselves at the death of the celestial father's mystic return; we ask and beseech you that, presented before your eyes, the libamina of our servitude may be pleasing to you, and the accepted ones, guided by your holy angel, may be consecrated to us, so that while purifying our hearts with the communication of your body and blood, our petitions may be received in a sweet smell.

text: Confitemur Domine confitemur et credimus pro nostro scelere te et corporaliter mortis subisse supplicium et pro omnium salute prostrato mortis interitu triumphantibus angelis caelestem patris ex qua veneras ad mansionem reversum. Propter quod te Deus omnipotens rogamus et petimus ut oblata in conspectu tuo nostrae libamina ipse tibi acceptabilia facias et accepta discurrente sancto angelo tuo nobis sanctificata distribuas ut dum corda nostra corporis et sanguinis Filii tui Domini nostri commixtione purificas peti
translation_en: We confess to you, Lord, we confess and believe in our sin that you have suffered physical death as a penalty for it, and for the salvation of all, prostrate under the death's defeat, triumphant angels of heaven. Therefore, we, Almighty God, pray and ask that you make our offerings acceptable before you and distribute to us the sanctified ones conferred by your holy angel as you purify our hearts with the mixture of the body and blood of your Son, our Lord.

text: Confitemur nomini tuo Domine gemino cordis et vocis obsequio celebrantes gratiam tuam pro triumphis martyris tui Genesii qui perficiens in infirmitate virtutem aeternam vitam prius lavacro sanguinis quam regenerationis accepit non adoptatus baptismate sed assumptus non admiscendus neophytorum turbis sed consortiis angelorum. Huius igitur intercessionibus exaudi nos et adesto Domine benedicturus hiis oblationibus nostris ut te quem in sanctis tuis colimus per sanctos tuos interpellare mereamur.
translation_en: We confess your name, Lord, with our double heart and voice in obedience, celebrating your grace for the triumphs of your martyr Genesis. He completed eternal virtue in weakness before receiving the washing of blood rather than the regeneration not adopted by baptism but assumed not to be mixed among the crowds of neophytes but consorting with the angels. Therefore, through his intercessions, hear us and be present, Lord, blessing these our offerings, so that we may deserve to call upon you whom we venerate in your saints through your saints.

text: Congregati in unum in hoc celeberrimo martyris tui Zoili die fide sincera spe firma caritate non ficta intenti cum omni sobrietate Deo patri clementissimo laudes et gratias agamus orantes eius maiestatem ut animum convertat ad nos orationes quoque nostras semper hic et ubique sancti tui precibus exaudire dignetur ab occultis nostris mundet nos et ab alienis quoque parcat servis suis det ecclesiae sanctae catholicae per eius patrocinium firmitatem qua hic per universum mundum est constituta hanc augeat fide et in pace confirmet liberet eam ab omni haerese et ab omni scandalo tueatur sacerdotes suos induat iustitiam quos speculatores domus Israel constituit omnem clerum omnemque populum suum in pace custodiat et benedicat.
translation_en:
Gathered as one on this most renowned day of your martyr Zoilus, we come with sincere faith, steadfast hope, and unfeigned charity, offering our praises and thanks to the most merciful God the Father with all sobriety. We pray that His Majesty may turn His attention towards us, always here and everywhere, and deign to hear our prayers through the intercession of your holy ones. May He purify us from our sins, forgive us from others' offenses, strengthen and increase the Catholic Church through His patronage, confirm it in faith and peace, free it from every heresy and scandal, protect its priests, clothe them with justice as watchmen of the house of Israel, and keep all clergy and His people in peace and bless them.
In addition, we ask that He strengthen the sacred priesthood, guard the entire clergy and people, and bless them all in peace.

text: Deus bonorum virtutum dator
translation_en: Giver of good virtues, God

text: Conscientias nostras quaesumus omnipotens Deus cottidie visitando purifica ut veniente domino filio tuo paratam sibi in nobis inveniat mansionem.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God daily visiting, to cleanse our consciences so that finding a dwelling place for Himself in us when His Son comes, He may find it prepared.

text: Conscientias nostras quaesumus omnipotens Deus cottidie visitando purifica ut veniente filio tuo domino nostro paratam sibi in nobis inveniat mansionem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that daily visiting us, you would purify our consciences so that when your son, our lord, comes, he may find a dwelling prepared for him within us.

text: Deus caeli Deus terrae Deus angelorum
translation_en: God of heaven, God of earth, God of angels

text: Conscientias nostras quaesumus omnipotens Deus cottidie visitando purifica ut veniens Filius tuus Dominus noster paratam sibi in nobis inveniat mansionem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that daily visiting our consciences, you purify them; so that when your Son, our Lord, comes, he may find a prepared dwelling place within us.

text: Deus caeli terraeque dominator
translation_en: Lord of heaven and earth

text: Conscientias nostras quaesumus Domine visitando purifica ut veniente filio tuo domino nostro paratam sibi in nobis inveniat mansionem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to visit and purify our consciences, so that when your Son, our Lord, comes, he may find a prepared dwelling place within us.

text: Conscientias nostras quaesumus Domine visitando purifica ut veniens Filius tuus Dominus noster paratam sibi in nobis inveniat mansionem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to visit and cleanse our consciences, so that your Son, our Lord, may find a prepared dwelling place within us as he comes.

text: Conscientias nostras quaesumus Domine visitando purifica ut veniens Iesus Christus Filius tuus Dominus noster paratam sibi in nobis inveniat mansionem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to visit our consciences and purify them, so that when Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, comes, he may find in us a prepared dwelling place.

text: Consecra quaesumus Domine quae de terrenis fructibus nomini tuo dicanda mandasti ut et gratam tibi nostram facias servitutem et sacramentum nobis perpetuae salvationis instituas.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, to consecrate what you have commanded us to offer from earthly fruits in Your name. May it make our service pleasing to You and establish for us the sacrament of eternal salvation.

text: Consecratum hunc diem Iesu redemptor noster mentio tui martyris Saturnini copiosius innovat in quo tanti viri dum patrocinia quaerimus translati corporis memoriam dedicamus. Huius proinde meritis largam nostris temporibus commoda pacem et obsequentis populi devotionem perpetuae caritatis remunera ex mercede.
translation_en: This day, consecrated by Jesus our Redeemer, is made more holy through your martyr Saturninus, in whom we seek the intercession of such a great man. We dedicate the memory of his translated body in his honor. Therefore, let us enjoy blessings and eternal peace as well as the devotion of the obedient people in these times, rewarded by His perpetual charity according to His mercy.

text: Deus castorum corporum benignus habitator
translation_en: Benevolent Dweller of pure bodies

text: Consecuti gratiam muneris sacri supplices Domine te rogamus ut implorantibus pro nobis sanctis martyribus tuis divinae virtutis effectum quem corporaliter sumpsimus spiritaliter sentiamus.
translation_en: Having followed the grace of the sacred office, we humbly ask you, Lord, that we may feel spiritually the effect which we have received corporally from your holy martyrs through divine power.

text: Consequatur Domine quaesumus tuae benedictionis auxilium quod supplex poscit ecclesia; percipiat indulgentiam bonis operibus instruatur temporalium necessitatum consolatione respiret ad gaudia sempiterna perveniat et assumat aeterna.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that your aid may follow the supplication of the church which seeks it with humility; that he may receive indulgence through good works, find consolation for temporal necessities, breathe in joy toward eternal joys, and attain and assume eternal happiness.

text: Conserva Deus in nobis tuae misericordiae donum qui in Iacobo et meritorum et nominis beneficium gratiae conservasti collatum cum non immerito cognominatus est iustus qui iustitiae operibus habebatur idoneus. Et ideo te rogamus et petimus ut in hac sollemnitate passionis eius hoc sacrificium serenus aspicias sanctifices et pietate solita benedicas sumentibusque ex eo donum sanctificationis impendas.
translation_en: Preserve, O God, in us your gift of mercy that you have bestowed upon Jacob and the merits and benefits of grace. The just one, who was deservedly named, was found worthy through his works of justice. Therefore we beseech and entreat you, that during this solemnity of his passion, you may look upon this sacrifice with serenity, sanctify it, and bless it as is your custom, granting the gift of sanctification to those who partake of it.

text: Deus celsitudo humilium
translation_en: God's loftiness is towards the humble

text: Conserva Domine familiam tuam bonis semper operibus eruditam et sic praesentibus consolare subsidiis ut ad superna perducas dona propitius.
translation_en: Lord, preserve your family with good works always, and educated. Thus console them with present support, that by your gracious gifts you may lead them to the highest heaven.

text: Conserva Domine in pace tua quos redemisti effusi sanguinis unda; libera ab scandalo pro quibus pependisti in ligno; efficito caritatis opere dignos quos tibi praeeunte gratia adoptasti in filios ut quotquot resurrectionis tuae victorias celebramus ultimo iudicii tempore resurgentes coronandi a dextris tuis cum ovibus collocemur.
translation_en: Lord, keep in your peace those whom you have redeemed by the outpouring of blood; free from scandal for those whom you hung on the wood; make worthy of works of charity those whom grace beforehand has adopted as sons, so that all who celebrate your resurrection victories at the last judgment time may rise and be crowned by your right hand, and we may be gathered with the sheep on your right side.

text: Deus conditor et defensor generis
translation_en: God, Creator and Defender of the race

text: Conserva Domine populum tuum et quem salutaribus praesidiis non desinis adiuvare perpetuis tribue gaudere beneficiis et mentis et corporis.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and never cease to help them with saving guards. Grant them eternal joy in benefits for mind and body.

text: Conserva Domine populum tuum et quem sanctorum tuorum praesidiis non desinis adiuvare perpetuis tribue gaudere remediis.
translation_en: Lord, preserve your people and never cease to help those under the protection of your saints. Grant them eternal joy through your remedies.

text: Conserva Domine populum tuum sub umbra protectionis tuae per invocationem nominis sancti et summi pontificis tui Cuthberti ut illius adiuvemur exemplis et nos esse participes regni mereamur caelestis.
translation_en: Lord, keep your people under the shadow of your protection through the invocation of the name of your holy and supreme pontiff Cuthbert, that we may be aided by his examples and merit to be participants in the kingdom of heaven.

text: Conserva Domine quaesumus familiam tuam et benedictionum tuarum propitius ubertate purifica ut eruditionibus tuis multiplicetur et donis.
translation_en: Preserve, we humbly ask you, Lord, your family and be merciful with your blessings, that through abundance, may they be purified, and that through your teachings, may there be a multiplication, and through gifts.

text: Conserva in nobis Domine munus tuum et quod te donante pro sollemnitate beati martyris tui Laurentii percepimus et salutem nobis praestet et pacem.
translation_en: Preserve within us, Lord, your gift and what we received from you on the solemnity of your blessed martyr Laurence. May health come to us and peace.

text: Conserva in nobis Domine munus tuum quod te donante pro sollemnitate beati Laurentii levitae percepimus ut et salutem nobis praestet et pacem.
translation_en: Lord, preserve within us your gift that we received from you on the solemnity of the blessed Laurence the deacon, so that it may bestow salvation upon us and peace.

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine munus tuum in nobis ut quod te donante pro beati Laurentii martyris tui sollemnitate percepimus et salutem nobis operetur et pacem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to preserve your gift within us, so that what we received on the feast of your blessed martyr Laurence may bring us salvation and peace.

text: Conserva Domine munus tuum in nobis ut quod te donante pro sollemnitate beati Laurentii martyris tui percepimus et salutem nobis operetur et pacem.
translation_en: Lord, preserve your gift in us, that what we received from you on the solemnity of Your martyr Saint Lawrence may bring us salvation and peace.

text: Deus cui omnia vivunt
translation_en: God in whom all live

text: Conserva in nobis omnipotens Deus tanti pignoris sacramentum ut qui annua revolutione celebramus in passione Domini nostri veneranda mysteria ab omnibus peccatorum sordibus emundemur.
translation_en: Almighty God, conserve within us the sacred pledge of your great power, that we who annually celebrate the venerable mysteries of our Lord's Passion, may be cleansed from all the filth of sins.

text: Deus cui omnis potestas et dignitas
translation_en: God, to whom all power and dignity belong

text: Conserva in nobis quaesumus Domine misericordiam tuam et quos ab erroris liberasti caligine veritatis tuae firmius inhaerere facias documento.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that You keep Your mercy with us and make those whom You have freed from the darkness of error more firmly adhere to You through the teaching of Your truth.

text: Conserva populum tuum Deus et tuo nomini fac devotum ut divinis subiectus officiis et temporalis vitae pariter et aeternae dona percipiat.
translation_en: Preserve your people, O God, and make them devoted to your name, so that they may fulfill divine duties and temporal life equally, and receive both temporal and eternal gifts.

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine Deus longaeva prosperitate populo tuo rectorem quem dedisti et nobis famulis tuis tuae caritatis spiritum infunde et populum christianum potentiae tuae dextera ab omni adversitate custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord God, to conserve your people's ruler with eternal prosperity, whom you have given. And we, your servants, pray that you infuse in us the spirit of your love. Also, protect the Christian people from every adversity with the power of your right hand.

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine filiorum tuorum tibi subditam servitutem ut intervenientibus sanctis tua redemptione sint digni tua semper gratia sint repleti.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to conserve the submission of your children for yourself, so that when they are met by your saints, they may be worthy of your redemption and always filled with your grace.

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine plebem tuam per merita beati Botulphi confessoris tui atque abbatis et quam sacramentorum tuorum admirabili dulcedine reficis perpetuis tribue gaudere remediis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you conserve your people through the merits of Blessed Botulf, your confessor and abbot, and that they may constantly rejoice in the remedies of your sacraments, which are marvelously sweet.

text: Deus cuius antiqua miracula etiam nostris saeculi
translation_en: God whose ancient miracles are also of our age

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine populum tuum et ab omnibus quas meretur adversitatibus redde securum ut tranquillitate percepta devota tibi mente deserviat.
translation_en: Preserve, we ask You, Lord, Your people and grant them safety from all adversities they deserve, so that with a peaceful mind, devoted to You, they may serve.

text: Deus cuius antiqua miracula in praesenti
translation_en: God whose ancient miracles are present

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine populum tuum et gratiae tuae in eo dona multiplica ut ab omnibus liber offensis et temporalibus non destituatur auxiliis et sempiternis gaudeat institutis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you conserve your people and multiply your grace within them, so that they are never lacking aid from all dangers and temporal troubles. May they forever enjoy the eternal institutions.

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine populum tuum intercessione beati Bricii confessoris tui atque pontificis in tuo amore confisum ut mereamur ipso intercedente consortes fieri caelestium gaudiorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to conserve your people with the intercession of your confessor and bishop, Bricius. May we, through his intercession in your love, deserve to become partakers of celestial joys.

text: Conserva quaesumus Domine populum tuum in tua misericordia confisum et intercessione beatorum Maximi et Philiberti confessorum tuorum mereamur cum illis participes fieri caelestium gaudiorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you conserve your people in your mercy and with the intercession of the blessed Maximus and Philbert, your confessors, we may deserve to become participants with them in celestial joys.

text: Conserva quaesumus omnipotens Deus vitam nostram immaculatam et incremento cunctarum virtutum ut interveniente beatissimo apostolo tuo Petro et tua misericordia universorum veniam percipiamus delictorum et ad patriam tuae repromissionis aeternam quandoque pervenire mereamur illaesi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to preserve our immaculate life and increase of all virtues, so that through the intervention of your most blessed apostle Peter and your mercy we may perceive forgiveness for all our sins and be worthy to reach your promised eternal homeland unharmed.

text: Conservent nos quaesumus Domine munera tua et aeternam vitam tribuant nobis.
translation_en: Preserve us, we ask you Lord, with your gifts and grant us eternal life.

text: Conservent nos Domine quaesumus munera tua et intercedente beato Marco confessore tuo atque pontifice vitam nobis aeternam conferant supplicantibus.
translation_en: Keep us, Lord, we beseech You, with Your gifts and through the intercession of the blessed Mark, Your confessor and pope, grant us an eternal life to those who are praying.

text: Conspirantes Domine contra tuae plenitudinis firmamentum dexterae tuae virtute prosterne ut iustitiae non dominetur iniquitas sed subdatur semper falsitas veritati.
translation_en: Lord, conspiring against Your fullness' firmament with Your right hand, overthrow them by Your power so that injustice may not rule but always be subjected to truth.

text: Consummati ac refecti cibo caelesti eucharistiae mysterio in substantiam gloriosae immortalitatis admixti agamus Deo patri omnipotenti gratias quod terrenae nos originis atque naturae sacramenti sui dono in caelestem vivificaverit demutationem ut per alimoniam corporis et sanguinis Iesu Christi consecratos ad incrementum immortalitatis eveheret cuius muneris apud nos maneat illaesa communio.
translation_en: Having been completed and refreshed by the heavenly food of the mystery of Eucharist, mixed in substance with glorious immortality, we render thanks to the almighty God the Father that he has transformed us from our earthly origin and nature through his sacrament, into a transformation to eternal life. Through the nourishment of the body and blood of Jesus Christ, he lifts us up for an increase in immortality. The communion of this service remains inviolate among us.

text: Contere quaesumus Domine hostes populi tui et delicta nostra quorum merito nobis dominantur emunda ut cum tibi placitam puritatem mentibus nostris infuderis largiaris et pacem.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, to crush the enemies of your people and to cleanse our sins which rightfully rule over us, that with pureness pleasing to you, you may pour into our minds. May you be generous and grant us peace.

text: Contriti spiritus tibi Deus hostiam immolantes internae precis te supplicatione rogamus ut sic ieiunia nostra tibi acceptabilia fiant qualiter pacis et caritatis in nobis multiplices incrementa.
translation_en: God, we who are crushed in spirit offer you an internal sacrifice. Through our humble supplication, we beseech you that our fasting may be acceptable to you in such a way that multiple increases of peace and charity may flourish among us.

text: Contueri tuam Christe cupientes praesentiam qui humana non deserens appetisti superna petimus et rogamus ut qui pignus assumptae carnis intulisti in caelos consolationem nobis Sancti Spiritus largiaris cuius nunc praesentia et apposita haec tibi oblata sanctifices et nostrorum cordium arcana perlustres.
translation_en: Turning to you, Christ, we who desire your presence, who have not forsaken the human yet seek the heavenly, we ask and plead that you who offered a pledge of assumed flesh in heaven grant us consolation. We ask that you generously bestow upon us the Holy Spirit, whose presence and proximity these offerings to you sanctify, and whose secrets you explore within our hearts.

text: Convaluisti Domine Iesu Christe in gratia et incredulis gentibus sedula testatione claruisti. Te annuntians beatissimus doctor ille Ioannes tam incomparabilis sanctitate quam singularis magisterii assertor fontem lavacri sitientibus dabat sed esse venturum te procul dubio nuntiabat.  Ille descenderat aquis corpora purgaturus; sperabaris tu Domine animas corporum redempturus. Ex huius enim voce cognovimus unigenitum te Domine in corporis forma et carne conspicuum de quo nobis dixit »Ecce agnus dei ecce qui tollit peccatum mundi«. Hic est enim cui et nomen antequam conciperetur dedisti quem et spiritu sancto priusquam nasceretur implesti qui et sterilitatem matris conceptus abstersit et patris linguam natus absolvit.  Oramus ergo te Domine ut hanc oblationem nostram respicere et benedicere digneris sicut benedicere dignatus es munus Abel iusti pueri tui.
translation_en:
You have risen, Lord Jesus Christ, in grace and to unbelieving nations you have shone with diligent testimony. That blessed doctor, John, declared that you were the source of washing for the thirsty, giving it; yet he also proclaimed that you would certainly come.
He descended into the waters to purify bodies; you, Lord, were believed to redeem the souls of bodies. We came to know from this voice that you, Lord, appeared in bodily form and flesh as the unigenitus, whom we heard saying "Behold the Lamb of God, behold him who takes away the sins of the world." This is he for whom a name was given before his conception, whom you filled with the Holy Spirit before his birth; he purified the barrenness of his mother and absolved the tongue of his father.
Therefore, we pray to you, Lord, to look upon and bless this our offering as you blessed the offering of Abel, your just son.

text: Converte nos Deus salutaris noster et ut nobis ieiunium corporale proficiat mentes nostras caelestibus institue disciplinis.
translation_en: Convert us, O God our Savior, and let our bodily fasting profit our minds with celestial instruction through divine discipline.

text: Converte nos Deus salutaris noster et ut nobis ieiunium quadragesimale proficiat mentes nostras caelestibus instrue disciplinis.
translation_en: Convert us, O God our savior, and let the Lenten fast profit our minds with heavenly instruction through your discipline.

text: Converte nos Domine tuae propitiationis auxilio ut castigatio peccatoribus convenienter adhibita fiat correctio salutaris.
translation_en: Convert us, O Lord, by Your merciful aid, that the chastisement fittingly applied to sinners may be a salutary correction.

text: Convertere Domine ad preces familiae tuae quas pro tuo honore per eum deferimus per cuius confessionem et mortem te praedicatum incredulis sine cunctatione cognovimus. Ideoque clementia patientiae tuae ita nostris adsit petitionibus ut nostris per eum patiatur se imprecati orationibus. Quidquid enim per eum speratur a te Domine exspectatur. Ipse nobis de te quod in se redundat exhibeat; ipse ad te preces nostras portitor deferat; ipse nobis placabilitatem tuam intercessor obtineat.  Te autem alme Vincenti vernule martyr cuncta cohors alumna lacrimabili prece circumdat; te huius catervae toga submissa flagitat mente. Universis de te pluralis devotio singulisque in se diversa necessitudo est. Alius ovans vota persolvit; alius plorans maestitudinis quaestus exponit. Tua sanctitas et vota suscipiat et taediosis succurrat. Beatitudo enim tua omnibus anxiis remedia te faenerare compellit obtinendi namque pro singulis apud dominum Iesum Christum et nostrum est fidere sine cunctatione opem ferre quod posceris et tuum est libenter praestare quod imploraris.  Tuo freti intercessu recurrant ad paenitentiam lapsi ad indulgentiam rei ad laetitiam maesti ad medelam languidi ad caespites exsules ad portum tranquillitatis naufragi regiones ad proprias peregrini ad redemptionem captivi ad sospitatem cives ad quietem hospites. Tuo obtentu iugis adhaereat regibus clementia potestatibus patientia militibus modestia. Tuo interventu adsuescant avari misericordiam luxuriosi continentiam petulantes pudicitiam. Tuo suffragio perfruantur caeci corde fidei lucem Hebraei catholicam fidem erectionem oppressi solutionem vincti correctionem devii salutem inconvulsibilem furiosi. Tuo adiuti auxilio ambiant teneantque clerici sanctitatem monachi custodiam religiosi castimoniam perfectissimam laici honestatem. Teque intercedente perfectum habeat sapientia intellectum terra proventum anima lucrum vita iudicium.
translation_en:
Turn to us, O Lord, on the prayers of your family which we offer up for your honor through him, whom we have known without hesitation to preach about your confession and death to the unbelievers. Therefore, let your clemency and patience be present with our petitions so that through him you may bear with the imprecations of our prayers. Whatever is hoped for from you, Lord, is expected by us. Let him show us from himself what we ask for; let him carry our prayers to you as a bearer; let him obtain for us your favor as an intercessor.
Almighty and tender Vincent, martyr, the whole choir of students surrounds you with tears; this band of suppliants seeks you in humble attire. Universal devotion is devoted to you in the plural, and each one has a particular need. One pays vows; another exposes his grief for the reward of mourning. May your sanctity receive both vows and succor the weary. Indeed, your beatitude compels you to provide remedies for all who are anxious. For each one it is our faith without hesitation to bring help that you ask for and it is a pleasure for you to grant what is asked of you.
By your intercession, return to penance the fallen, to mercy the sorrowful, to healing the sick, to harbors the exiles, to peace the wanderers, to redemption the captives, to safety the citizens, to rest the guests. May your favor adhere to kings, may clemency and patience be with powers, may modesty be with soldiers. May avarice learn mercy from you, may luxury seek continence from you, may chastity be given to the impure from you. May the blind receive light of faith from you, may the oppressed have relief, may the bound find correction, may the stray find salvation that is invincible for the furious. May those seeking help be assisted by your aid and may the clergy maintain holiness, monks guard sanctity, religious keep the perfect chastity, laics preserve honor. With you interceding, may wisdom have a perfect understanding of earthly things, of the soul's profit, of life, of judgment.

text: Convertere Domine cor nostrum in bonis operibus tuis et quidquid pro fragilitate excedimus tu indulge propitius. Plenitudinem indulgentiae concede et defunctis requiem tribue. Intercessu quoque sanctorum tuorum occurrat nobis miserationis tuae suffragium et remissio peccatorum conferat praemium.
translation_en: Convert our hearts, O Lord, to your good works and be merciful in forgiving whatever we exceed because of our frailty. Grant us the fullness of indulgence and grant rest to the departed. Also, through the intercession of your saints may your mercy reach us and confer the reward for the remission of sins.

text: Copiosa beneficia quaesumus Domine christianus populus assequatur ut qui in honorem sanctorum sacrandis tibi liminibus devotus occurrit et vitae subsidia praesentis accipiat et gratiam sempiternae redemptionis inveniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the Christian people may attain the abundant blessings, so that those who, devoted to you, approach your sanctified thresholds in honor of the saints, may receive support for their present life, and find the grace of eternal redemption.

text: Copiosa protectionis tuae beneficia quaesumus Domine Deus familia tua consequatur ut quae sacris tibi liminibus devota consistit intercessione beati illius atque omnium sanctorum et vitae praesentis subsidio gratuletur et gratiam aeternae benedictionis inveniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord God, for the abundant benefits of your protection that your family may follow. May those who are devoted to the sacred thresholds of your house be favored by the intercession of that blessed one and all the saints, and may they find grace in the present life and the reward of eternal blessing.

text: Cor populi tui quaesumus Domine converte propitius ut ab his muneribus non recedant quibus maiestatem tuam magnificari deposcimus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, turn towards your people graciously, so that they do not depart from these duties by which we implore to magnify your majesty.

text: Coram altario tuo Domine et fidelium deferuntur vota et ieiuniorum obsequia. Propter quod te humili prece rogamus ut huius ieiunii litatione ita acceptentur a te obsequia familiae tuae qualiter et universitas fidelium tuis remuneretur ex donis et defunctorum animae amoenitate foveantur indultae beatitudinis.
translation_en: Before your altar, Lord, the vows of the faithful and the observances of the fasting are brought. Therefore, with a humble prayer we ask you to accept the offerings of this fasting in such a way that your family may be rewarded as the universal church is through gifts, and the souls of the departed may be warmed by the delight of beatitude, granted indulgence.

text: Corda nostra quaesumus Domine venturae festivitatis splendor illustret quo (et) mundi huius tenebris carere valeamus et perveniamus ad patriam claritatis aeternae.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the brightness of the approaching festival may illuminate our hearts, so that we may be able to live without the darkness of this world and reach the homeland of eternal clarity.

text: Corda nostra quaesumus Domine sanctus splendor tuae incarnationis nativitatis passionis resurrectionis ascensionis et adventus Spiritus Sancti clementi respectu illustret quo mundi huius tenebris carere valeamus et ipso ducente per veniamus ad patriam claritatis aeternae.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your holy splendor of incarnation, nativity, passion, resurrection, ascension, and coming of the Holy Spirit may enlighten our hearts so that we may be able to live without the darkness of this world and, led by it, pass through mercy to the homeland of eternal brightness.

text: Cordibus nostris Domine benignus infunde ut peccata nostra castigatione voluntaria cohibentes temporaliter potius maceremur quam suppliciis deputemur aeternis.
translation_en: Lord, pour into our hearts your graciousness, that we may restrain our sins by voluntary penance rather than suffer eternal punishments instead.

text: Cordibus nostris quaesumus Domine benignus infunde ut sicut ab escis corporalibus temperamur ita sensus quoque nostros a noxio retrahamus excessu.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your kindness may flow into our hearts, so that just as we are tempered by external bodily matters, we may also draw back our senses from harmful excesses.

text: Cordibus nostris quaesumus Domine caelestis gloriae inspira desiderium et praesta ut in dextris illuc feramus manipulos iustitiae ubi tecum sidus aureum sanctus coruscat abba Bertinus.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord of celestial glory, inspire in our hearts the desire and grant that we may bring the hands of justice there where the golden star shines with you, Saint Abbot Bertinus.

text: Deus cuius spiritu creatura omnis
translation_en: God whose Spirit encompasses all creation

text: Corpora mentesque nostras omnipotens Deus dignanter emunda ut tua benedictione firmati ab unigenito tuo domino nostro quem exspectamus veniente semper illuminemur et protegamur.
translation_en: Almighty God, cleanse worthy our bodies and minds, that strengthened by your blessing, we who await your unique Son, our Lord, may always be enlightened and protected.

text: Corpore et sanguine tuo Domine satiati quaesumus ut pro nostris semper peccatis nobis compunctionem cordis et luctum fluminaque multa lacrimarum largioris quatenus caelestem in futuro consolationem mereamur.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you be satisfied by your body and blood. May you always grant us contrition for our sins, a heartfelt sorrow, and rivers of many tears. In this way, may we deserve heavenly consolation in the future.

text: Corpore et sanguine Filii tui satiatus Domine quaeso ut pro meis peccatis compunctionem mentis et corporis atque flumina lacrimarum mihi peccatori largiaris quatenus hic et in futuro caelestem consolationem accipere merear.
translation_en: Lord, satisfied with the body and blood of your Son, I humbly ask that you grant me forgiveness for my sins. I beg that you pour out a sorrow of heart and body upon me, the sinner, and bestow on me rivers of tears, so that here and in the future I may deserve celestial consolation.

text: Corpore tuo sacro et sanguine pretioso satiati te Domine deprecamur ut sicut ex mortuis resurgendo carissimae matris tuae maerorem in gaudium et planctum in iubilum commutasti sic et nos te pro nobis temporaliter mortuum cum ea lugere facias ut in aeternum viventem laeti videre mereamur.
translation_en: Lord, filled with your sacred body and precious blood, we humbly beseech you, as you changed the sorrow of the dear mother of yours into joy when she rose from the dead, so too may you make us mourn for a time your death with her, that we may merit to see you, living forever, with eternal joy.

text: Corporis et sanguinis Iesu domini et redemptoris nostri communione percepta tuam omnipotens Pater precamur clementiam ut intercessione sanctarum virginum tuarum ab omni angustia liberare digneris clerum ac populum tibi subiectum et ad regnum perducere fidelibus tuis praeparatum in aeternum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty Father, through the Communion of the body and blood of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, that with the intercession of your holy virgins, you deem worthy to free the clergy and people subjected to you from all distress and guide your faithful to the kingdom prepared for them eternally.

text: Corporis et sanguinis sacrosancti Domine quaesumus gratia nos sumpta vivificet et quod mysticis actionibus pollicetur aeternis effectibus largiatur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the grace of the most holy Body and Blood be bestowed upon us, so that it may vivify us. Furthermore, we pray that what it promises through mystical actions may be given to us with eternal effects.

text: Corporis et sanguinis tui Domine Iesu Christe venerabile sacramentum dilecti tui Blasii opitulantibus meritis nos ad caelestis mensae perducat convivium.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, we humbly approach the venerable sacrament of your Body and Blood. Through the merits of your beloved disciple Blaise, may you lead us to the heavenly feast.

text: Corporis sacri et pretiosi sanguinis repleti libamine quaesumus Deus noster; quod pia devotione gerimus certa redemptione capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask our God to fill us abundantly with the sacred and precious blood, so that by pious devotion we may surely attain redemption.

text: Corporis sacri et pretiosi sanguinis repleti libamine quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quod pia devotione gerimus certa redemptione capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to fill us with the grace of the holy and precious body and blood, so that what we carry out with pious devotion may be attained with certain redemption.

text: Corporis sacri et pretiosi sanguinis repleti libamine quaesumus Domine Deus noster uti gratiae tuae munus quod immeritis contulisti intercedente beato Petro apostolo tuo propitius muniendo custodias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to bestow upon us the gift of your grace, which you unmercifully granted to us, through the intercession of your apostle, Blessed Peter. Grant us, we pray, your propitious protection and safeguard.

text: Corporis sacri et pretiosi sanguinis repleti libamine quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per haec sancta mysteria anima famuli tui illius aeternae beatitudinis gloriam consequatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to fill the servant of yours with the grace of the sacred and precious body and blood. May he attain eternal beatitude through these holy mysteries.

text: Corpus tuum Domine quod accepimus et calicem tuum quem potavimus haereat in visceribus nostris; praesta Deus omnipotens ut non remaneat macula ubi pura et sancta intraverunt sacramenta.
translation_en: Your body, Lord, which we have received and your blood that we have drunk abides within our innermost being; may Almighty God grant that no stain remains where the pure and holy sacraments have entered.

text: Corpus tuum Domine quod accepi et sanctus calix tuus quem potavi adhaereat obsecro in visceribus animae meae et praesta ut in me non remaneat macula peccati in quem pura et sancta introierunt sacramenta corporis et sanguinis tui.
translation_en: Lord, I beseech you that your body which I have received and your chalice which I have drunk may adhere to the marrow of my soul, and grant that within me remains no stain of sin; where pure and holy sacraments of your body and blood have entered.

text: Deus fidelium Pater summe qui in toto orbe
translation_en: God, Father of faithful ones, supreme in the whole world.

text: Corripe nos Domine in misericordia et non in furore qui et corripiendo parcis et parcendo remittis qui et flagellando non perdis et miserando convertis ut et correptione tua corrigamur et indulgentia consolemur ut et disciplina erudiamur et medicina curemur ut et verbere castigemur et pietate sanemur. Placeat ergo tibi Domine liberare nos; placeat corrigere non perdere nos.
translation_en: Correct us, O Lord, in mercy and not in anger, who correcting spares and sparing forgives, who chastising does not lose, and mercifully converts; that we may be corrected by your correction, comforted by your indulgence, taught by your discipline, healed by your medicine, scourged by your rod, and cured by your pity. Therefore, it pleases you, O Lord, to free us; it pleases you to correct but not to lose us.

text: Cottidiani Domine quaesumus munere sacramenti perpetuae nobis tribue salutis augmentum.
translation_en: Daily Lord, we humbly ask you to bestow upon us the gift of the perpetual sacrament, and increase our salvation.

text: Creator et conditor omnium Deus qui per summum sacerdotem atque pontificem Filium tuum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum sacerdotale culmen et pontificale sceptrum super servum tuum beatum Ambrosium hodierno die et tempore consecrasti consecrationis nostrae initia eo intercedente sanctifica et plebem tuam benedicere dignare de caelesti tuae gloriae regno.
translation_en: Creator and maker of all God, who through your supreme priest and pope, your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, consecrated the priestly summit and the pontifical scepter upon your blessed Ambrose on this day and time. May you sanctify and deign to bless your people, granting them grace from your heavenly kingdom of glory.

text: Creator populi tui Deus atque reparator tuere supplices tuere misericordiam postulantes ut satisfactione pro se intercedente sanctorum illorum et instituta bona recipiant et restaurata custodiant.
translation_en: Creator of your people, God and restorer, protect the supplicants who are asking for mercy. May they receive and keep what has been obtained through their intercession by the saints and the good institutions restored.

text: Creaturarum omnium auctor Deus et Domine qui universa per coaeternum tibi filium cooperante sancto spiritu condidisti da populis tuis scire quod praecipis custodire quod praestas ut et tua inspiratione credaris et.nostra semper voce lauderis.
translation_en: Creator of all things, God and Lord, you who have made everything through the coeternal cooperation of your Son and the Holy Spirit, teach your people to know what you command them to keep, what you provide for them to believe in, and that they should always praise you with our voice in response to your inspiration.

text: Deus gloriatio fidelium
translation_en: God of the glory of the faithful

text: Credentes Domine universa mirabilia Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui atque incarnationis suae et divinitatis potentiam confitentes ipsisque laudibus exsultamus tibique sacrificium laudis offerimus rogantes clementiam tuam summa Trinitas Deus et infinita maiestas ut haec oblatio quam in sancto altario tuo deferimus pro nostrorum expiatione facinorum sit tuis oculis placita sit accepta; simulque effice illo sancto spiritu superveniente septiformis benedicta quae ubique Deus manifestat in eis ut te benedicente si quis ex ea libaverit te largiente et in hoc saeculo percipiat medicinam et in futuro consequatur vitam aeternam.
translation_en: Believing in all the wonders of our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of yours, and in the incarnation of Him and His divine power, we confess to them and exult in Your praise. To You we offer the sacrifice of lauds, praying for Your mercy, highest Trinity God and infinite majesty, that this offering which we bring before Your holy altar on behalf of our expiation of sins be pleasing and acceptable to Your eyes; at the same time, may it also happen with the coming of the Holy Spirit in sevenfold blessedness, that God is manifested in them through whom, if anyone frees himself from there, You bless him and in this world he perceives healing, and in the future acquires eternal life.

text: Deus honorum omnium ad locum et idcirco
translation_en: God of all honors, to this place and therefore

text: Credimus Domine adventum tuum recolimus passionem tuam. Corpus tuum in peccatorum nostrorum remissionem confractum sanguis sanctus tuus in pretium nostrae redemptionis effusus est.
translation_en: We believe in Your coming, we remember Your passion. Your body broken for the forgiveness of our sins, Your holy blood shed for the price of our redemption.

text: Deus honorum omnium Deus omnium dignitatum
translation_en: God of all honors, God of all dignities

text: Credimus Domine credimus in hac confractione corporis et effusione tui sanguinis nos esse redemptos; confidimus etiam ut quod spe hic interim iam tenemus in aeternum perfrui mereamur.
translation_en: We believe, Lord, we believe in this consecration to be redeemed of your body and the shedding of your blood; we also trust that what we now hold with hope here during our time will be merited for us to enjoy eternally.

text: Credimus Domine credimus in hac confractione corporis et effusione sanguinis nos esse redemptos et confidimus sacramenti huius assumptione munitos ut quod spe interim hic tenemus mansuri in caelestibus veris fructibus perfruamur.
translation_en: We believe, Lord, we believe in this consecration of the body and shedding of blood that we are redeemed and we trust that armed with this sacrament, what we hold in hope here will endure in heavenly true fruits, we shall enjoy.

text: Credimus Domine Iesu Christe quia et tuo vescimur corpore et tuum corpus effici vis fideles. Fac nobis in remissionem peccatorum esse quod sumpserimus ut caro spiritui subdita et in concessu pacifico subiugata obtemperet non repugnet.
translation_en: We believe, Lord Jesus Christ, that we are nourished by your body and that your body will make us faithful. Make it for us to have remission of sins because we have taken, so that flesh may be submissive to spirit and under peaceful submission obey, not resist.

text: Credimus te Domine Iesu Christe omnium esse virtutem. Rogamus te Domine piissime ut precem nostram iubeas exaudiri propitius omnibus in te credentibus peccata iubeas dimitti et huius sacrificii munera per manus angeli tui iubeas sanctificari. Defunctis quoque illis vel omnibus qui credentes te ab hac discesserunt luce locum tribue electorum in regione vivorum.
translation_en: We believe, Lord Jesus Christ, that you are all power. We humbly ask you, most merciful Lord, to grant that our prayer be heard graciously by you, and to forgive the sins of all who believe in you. May the offerings of this sacrifice be sanctified by your angel's hand. Also, for the deceased and for all who have departed from this life believing in you, grant them a place among the elect in the land of the living.

text: Deus humani generis benignissime conditor
translation_en: Kindly Creator of the human race

text: Credimus Domine Iesu Christe unigenito a patre divinitati tuae credimus corporeae assumptioni credimus passioni applaudemus redeunti ab inferis prostrata morte invictissime maiestati rogantes te per ipsius diei magna et mirabilia sacramenta ut sicut nos resurrectio tua non habet dubios ita nos nostra per misericordiam tuam habeat absolutos et eo modo exsultemus te fuisse regressum quomodo non ambigimus rediturum sicque nos sine poena iubeas manere dum venis ut ad veniam facias pervenire cum veneris.
translation_en: We believe, Lord Jesus Christ, the only-begotten of the Father, in your divinity we believe; in your bodily assumption we believe; we applaud your passion; we exult in your return from the dead, invincibly majestic one, to whom we beseech you through the great and miraculous sacraments of that day, that just as our resurrection has no doubts, so too may our souls be absolved by your mercy, and that we rejoice in your return without question and that you command us to remain here until you come to bring us to forgiveness, when you come.

text: Credimus Domine sancte Pater aeterne omnipotens Deus Iesum Christum Filium tuum Dominum nostrum pro nostra salute incarnatum fuisse et in substantia deitatis tibi semper esse aequalem per quem te petimus et rogamus ut accepta habeas et benedicas haec munera et sanctifica illibata quae tibi offerimus pro tua ecclesia sancta catholica quam pacificare digneris per universum orbem terrarum diffusam.  Memorare etiam quaesumus Domine famulorum tuorum quorum oblationem benedictam ratam rationabilemque facere digneris quae est imago et similitudo corporis et sanguinis Iesu Christi Filii tui Domini ac redemptoris nostri.
translation_en:
We believe, O Lord, eternal and almighty God, that your Son Jesus Christ, our Lord, was incarnate for our salvation and that he is equal in substance to you in deity, through whom we ask and entreat that you receive and bless these gifts and sanctify them unspoiled which we offer for your holy Catholic Church, which you deign to pacify throughout the whole world.
Also remember, we beseech you, O Lord, the servants of yours whose offering you deem blessed, fitting and reasonable, which is the image and likeness of the body and blood of Jesus Christ, your Son, our Lord and Redeemer.

text: Credimus facimus et intellegimus quae docuisti Domine Deus noster confitentes unum Deum patrem a quo sunt omnia et unum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum per quem sunt omnia et unum spiritum in quo sunt omnia deprecantes copiosissimam misericordiam tuam omnipotens Deus pater per principium quod in tempore ex virgine nasci dignatus est qui adfuit tecum antequam mundum faceres in principio ut exaudias preces nostras et unicum paracliti tui pignus qui ex te inseparabiliter descendit et filio quem non ad mensuram hominis peccati dedisti et quem in columbae specie in eodem manere voluisti illabi et descendere sanctificaturus haec quae tibi offerimus iubeas quae in corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Filii tui similitudinem a solis ortu et occasu offerri tibi Ecclesiam tuam catholicam praecepisti ut conformem efficiat claritatem eius ut gustantes quam suavis est dominus satiemur mane misericordia tua dum apparuerit manifestata gloria tua.
translation_en: We believe, we make, and we understand what you have taught us, Lord God our Creator, acknowledging one God the Father from whom all things are, and one Lord Jesus Christ through whom all things are, and one Holy Spirit in whom all things are. We humbly ask for your most plentiful mercy, omnipotent God, Father, through the Son who was deemed worthy to be born of a virgin in time, who was with you before creating the world in the beginning, so that you would hear our prayers. We present as security the only Paraclete who descends from you and whom you gave not by measure to the sin of man and whom you wished to dwell in the form of a dove and descend while being sanctified. Grant that these things which we offer be like the likeness of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, which are offered to you from sunrise to sunset. You have commanded your Church to be Catholic, so that it may make clear its beauty, so that by tasting how sweet the Lord is, we may be filled in the morning with your mercy until your manifest glory appears.

text: Credimus facimus intellegimus Domine Deus noster quae docuisti confitentes unum Deum patrem ex quo sunt omnia et unum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum per quem sunt vera et unum Spiritum Sanctum in quo sunt clara deprecantes copiosissimam misericordiam tuam omnipotens Deus per principium quod in tempore ex virgine nasci dignatus est qui adfuit tecum etiam antequam mundum faceres in principio ut exaudias preces nostras et unicum paracliti tui pignus qui ex te inseparabiliter procedit et filio quem non ad mensuram hominis peccati dedisti et quem in columbae specie in eodem manere voluisti illabi et descendere haec quae tibi offerimus sanctificaturus iubeas in corporis et sanguinis Filii tui similitudinem a solis ortu et occasu offerri tibi tuam catholicam ecclesiam praecipisti ut conformem efficias claritatis eius ut si quis nostrum hunc qui de caelo descendit manducaverit panem et biberit eius novi testamenti calicem efficiatur in eo fons aquae salientis in vitam aeternam. Obtineat etiam in eo virtutem ad repellenda omnia quae inimicus suggesserit ut donet superbis humilitatem virginibus coronam castis perseverantiam lapsis veniam superbis disciplinam stultis sapientiam sapientibus ne extollantur castum timorem; Petri lacrimas sic effundant post culpam ut omnibus dextera tua sublevatura miserearis post ruinam ut gustantes quam suavis es Domine satiemur mane misericordia tua cum apparueris et cum manifestata nobis fuerit gloria tua.
translation_en: We believe, we make, we understand, Lord God our Savior, who has taught us to confess one God the Father from whom all things are, and one Lord Jesus Christ through whom are true, and one Holy Spirit in whom are clear, we pray for your most compassionate mercy, Almighty God. Through the beginning which in time was deemed worthy to be born of a virgin, who was with you even before you made the world in the beginning, so that you may hear our prayers. The pledge of your one Paraclete, who proceeds from you and is inseparable, and the Son whom you did not give according to human measure for sin, and whom you wished to dwell in the likeness of a dove and descend, we command to be sanctified in the likeness of the body and blood of your Son. You have commanded this offering to be made from the rising of the sun to its setting to you, your Catholic Church. Make it conform to the brightness of its glory, so that whoever among us eats this bread that comes down from heaven and drinks from his new testament chalice will become a fountain of living water for eternal life. May he also have the power to repel all things suggested by the enemy, giving humility to the proud, crowns to the chaste, perseverance to the fallen, discipline to the foolish, wisdom to the wise, so that they may not be exalted. Cast purity, grant them the fear; Peter's tears may flow after sin so that your right hand may lift up all who have sinned and after ruin, when we taste how sweet you are, Lord, let us be satisfied with morning mercy of yours when you appear and when our glory is revealed to us.

text: Credimus pariter et fatemur ac purae credulitatis impulsu tacere non sinimur te dominum redemptoremque nostrum pro nobis miseris in cruce fuisse suspensum descendisse etiam in infernum ut nos resurgens elevares ad caelum reliquisse etiam nobis exemplum ut te sequentes dominum passiones toleremus in mundo. Quo exemplo beatus Andreas discipulus tuus ac martyr et apostolus informatus crucis pro te supplicium devota mente portavit. Fac <nos> quaesumus ipso intercedente hoc tui corporis sanguinisque mysterium spiritus tui rore sanctificatum ad nostrarum remedium sumere animarum.
translation_en: We believe and confess, impelled by pure faith, we are not permitted to remain silent about the fact that you, our Lord and Redeemer, were suspended on a cross for us, descended even into hell, rose again and left behind an example for us in heaven. May we who follow you bear your sufferings in this world. By your example, blessed Andrew, your disciple, martyr, and apostle, informed about the cross, carried out devout suffering for you. We ask that through his intercession, we may take to our remedy this mystery of your body and blood sanctified by the dew of your spirit.

text: Crescat Domine semper in nobis sanctae iucunditatis affectus et beatae Agnes virginis atque martyris tuae veneranda festivitas augeatur.
translation_en: May, Lord, the feeling of holy delight forever grow within us, and may the venerable festival of your blessed virgin and martyr, Saint Agnes, be augmented.

text: Cuius nos praecepti tenaces et iussa meminimus et gesta memoramus omnipotens Pater; tu de caelis tuis propitius favens hoc sacrificium nostrum indulgentissima pietate prosequere ut per sanctorum tuorum illorum obtentu et maiestatis tuae plenitudo ad sanctificationem huius hostiae de tuis sedibus sanctis descendat et nostrorum pectorum intima per holocaustum reddat per omnia munda.
translation_en: Whose precepts and commands we remember firmly, and the deeds we commemorate, O Almighty Father; through your propitious kindness from heaven's throne, may this our sacrifice be followed with most indulgent piety. May it descend upon this hostia (host) from your holy seats by means of the merits of your saints and the fullness of your majesty, that it may sanctify our hearts thoroughly through a holocaust, and make them pure in all things.

text: Cum gaudio et exsultatione dilectissimi fratres dominum prosequamur atque insuper nobis beatissimorum patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum et martyrum omniumque sanctorum suffragia <sive> patrocinia coniungamus ut indulgentiam criminum et delictorum veniam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: With joy and exultation, let us follow the Lord with our most beloved brothers, and moreover let us join the intercession or patronage of the blessed patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, and all saints. So that we may deserve to obtain the indulgence of sins and the forgiveness of transgressions.

text: Deus immortale praesidium
translation_en: Immortal God, preservation

text: Cum sanctorum tuorum Domine supplicationibus imploramus ut sacris muneribus offerendis gratam tibi nostri ministerii facias servitutem.
translation_en: When we implore you, Lord, with the supplications of your saints, we ask that by our offering of sacred services, you make our ministry pleasing to you.

text: Cum tibi omnipotens Pater omne quod in nobis vel creatoris ope vel munere redemptoris rationale potest esse et vividum iugi inservire famulatu rerum magnitudine provocetur hodierno praesertim vel die vel tempore ut affectiosius aliquid cum nihil egeas tuae bonitati votis ac studiis offerre possimus faenerare dignare quod conveniat reddidisse quia maioris multo est gratiae reformasse perditum quam fecisse futurum. Ut enim crearemur vel non crearemur non praecesserat culpa iudicem non praevenerat materia creatorem.  At vero ut offensus postmodum ad misericordiam veritatis et vas peccatorum praecipitatione confractum tuis denuo manibus redderes solidatum quid nisi infinitus pietate immensus misericordia inenarrabilis bonitate in omni progenie et generatione praedicandus es et colendus? Unde precamur ut quibus condicionis et redemptionis praerogasti beneficia tribuas indulgentiam criminum manifestam.
translation_en:
Since the all-powerful Father can rationally call upon us to serve and render living homage to His creation, even today especially either on this day or at this time, when we have nothing to offer in return for Your goodness except our prayers and devotion. It is indeed more gracious to restore what has been lost than to create what will be. For before we were created or not created, there was no sin to condemn the judge nor matter to pre-exist the Creator.
But truly, after being offended, You returned us to mercy through the breaking of the vessel of sins with an abundance of inexhaustible pity, unfathomable mercy, and boundless goodness. This should be proclaimed and worshipped in every progeny and generation. Wherefore we pray that You grant the benefits of Your grace and redemption according to Your prerogatives, bestowing upon us forgiveness for our manifest sins.

text: Cuncta credimus Domine quae instituisti nobis ut servaremur. Idcirco petimus ut qui in hoc tempore resurrectionis tuae adsumus mereamur in futuro consortium angelorum.
translation_en: We believe all things, Lord, that you have established for us to be kept. Therefore, we ask that we who are present at this time of your resurrection may deserve the future fellowship of angels.

text: Cuncta Domine quaesumus his muneribus a nobis semper diabolica figmenta seclude ut nostri redemptoris exordia purificatis mentibus celebremus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that with these offerings you always exclude any diabolic illusions from us, so that we may celebrate the beginnings of our Redeemer with purified minds.

text: Cuncta famuli tui illius quaesumus Domine per hanc oblationem purgentur delicta ut qui tuae dispositionis flagello in hac atteritur vita in futuro ei requies tribuatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through this offering, may the sins of all your servants be purged so that the one who is chastised by your discipline in this life may be granted rest in the future.

text: Cunctas Domine semper a nobis iniquitates repelle ut ad viam salutis aeternae secura mente curramus.
translation_en: Lord, always drive away all iniquities from us, so that we may run with a safe mind towards the way of eternal salvation.

text: Custodi Domine populum tuum et ut eidem perpetuam misericordiam largiaris tuo semper nomini fac devotum.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and grant them your constant mercy, so that they may always be devoted to your name.

text: Custodi Domine quaesumus Ecclesiam tuam propitiatione perpetua et quia sine te labitur humana mortalitas tuis semper auxiliis et abstrahatur a noxiis et ad salutaria dirigatur.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you protect your Church with perpetual favor and because without you, human mortality falters. May it always be helped by your assistance, drawn away from wickedness, and directed towards salvation.

text: Deus incommutabilis virtus et lumen aeternum
translation_en: God, unchangeable power and eternal light

text: Custodi intra nos Domine gloriae tuae munus ut adversus omnia praesentis saeculi mala sanctae eucharistiae quam percepimus viribus muniamur.
translation_en: Lord of glory, protect us within that we may be armed with your gift, so that against all the evils of this present age, we may be strengthened by the holy Eucharist which we have received.

text: Deus incommutabilis virtus lumen aeternum
translation_en: God, the incommutable power, eternal light

text: Custodi nos Domine in tuo servitio constitutos et quibus famulatum esse vis sincerum propitius largire quod praecipis.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord, those whom you have established in your service, and graciously bestow upon those who wish to serve you what you command.

text: Custodi nos Domine quaesumus ne in vitiis proruamus et quia his carere non possumus intervenientibus semper apostolis tuis conscientiam nostram benignus absolve.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord, we beseech you, that we may not fall into vices and because we cannot be without them, your apostles may always intercede for our conscience and have mercy on us, absolve it kindly.

text: Custodi nos omnipotens Deus ut tua dextera gubernante nec nostra nobis praevaleant nec aliena peccata.
translation_en: Keep us, almighty God, so that your right hand governs, neither ours nor others' sins may prevail against us.

text: Custodi me quaesumus Domine famulum tuum ut tua dextera gubernante nec mea mihi praevaleant nec aliena peccata.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to protect your servant, so that with your guiding hand neither mine own sins prevail against me nor the sins of others.

text: Custodi nos quaesumus Domine sanctorum tuorum natalicia frequentantes et ad salutifera mandatorum tuorum exsequenda praecepta nostras semper excita voluntates.
translation_en: Protect us, we beseech You, Lord, on the feast days of Your saints that we celebrate, and always stir within us the desire to fulfill Your life-giving commands.

text: Da aeternae consolationis pater per huius sancti tui illius preces populo tuo pacem et salutem ut tuis tota dilectione inhaereant praeceptis et quae tibi placita sunt tota perficiant voluntate.
translation_en: Grant eternal consolation, Father, through the prayers of this your saint, to your people, peace and salvation, so that they may adhere entirely to your precepts with all their love, and perform completely with their whole will what pleases you.

text: Da auxilium Domine quaesumus maiestati tuae potestatique subiectis et quidquid suis meritis non praesumunt sanctorum tuorum precibus consequantur.
translation_en: Grant help, we beseech You, Lord, to Your majesty subjected powers and whatsoever they presume not to attain through their own merits, may they obtain through the prayers of Your saints.

text: Da cordibus Ecclesiae tuae Domine quaesumus desideria terrenae condicionis abscidere et caelestis vitae spiritum sensibus eius largus infunde nec praevaleat auctor ille qui perdidit sed vincat potius qui redemit ut a vetustate legis mundata proficiat et ad aeternam perveniat tuo munere novitatem.
translation_en: Grant to the hearts of your Church, Lord, we ask, that they may be freed from the desires of earthly condition and may receive the spirit of celestial life in their senses. May the one who has caused destruction not prevail, but rather may he who has redeemed have victory, so that, purified from the old law, it may progress and reach the eternal through your gift, and gain newness.

text: Da Domine famulo tuo illi sperata suffragia obtinere ut qui tuos pauperes vel tuas ecclesias memoravit sanctorum omnium simul et beati martyris tui Laurentii mereatur consortia cuius nunc est exempla secutus.
translation_en: Grant, O Lord, to your servant, that he may obtain the expected favors, so that he who has remembered your poor and your churches, along with all saints, and the blessed martyr of yours, Lawrence, may deserve to share in his consortium, whose example he is now following.

text: Da Domine quaeso meorum mihi veniam peccatorum quatenus quidquid carnali delectatione vel animi mei cogitatione atque vana huius saeculi ambitione contra tuorum rectitudinem praeceptorum perfeci in hac praesenti vita veniam accipere merear.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, I ask, forgiveness of my sins, so that whatever I have done through carnal delight or thoughts of my own mind and vain ambitions of this world's pursuits, which is against Your righteousness and commandments, in this present life, may I deserve to receive forgiveness.

text: Da Ecclesiae tuae Domine non superbe sapere sed in tibi placita humilitate proficere ut proterva despiciens et matura quaeque desiderans exerceat liberam caritatem.
translation_en: Grant to Your Church, Lord, not a proud wisdom but a humble progress in You, so that the impudent may be disdained and the mature may exercise free charity.

text: Deus invictae virtutis auctor
translation_en: Author of the invincible power (God)

text: Da Ecclesiae tuae Domine quaesumus sancto vito intercedente superbe non sapere sed tibi placita humilitate proficere ut proterva despiciens quaecumque matura sunt libera exerceat caritate.
translation_en: Grant to your church, Lord, we ask with Saint Vitus interceding, that it may not be wise in pride but make progress in humility so as to scornfully disregard whatever is impertinent and, with love, exercise what is mature.

text: Da famulis tuis Deus indulgentiam peccatorum consolationem vitae gubernationemque perpetuam qua tibi fideliter servientes ad tuam iugiter misericordiam pervenire mereantur.
translation_en: May your servants, God, merit to arrive continually at your mercy by receiving forgiveness for sins, consolation, and eternal guidance.

text: Da famulis tuis Domine abundantiam protectionis et gratiae; da salutem mentis et corporis; da continere prosperitatis augmenta et tibi semper fac esse devotos.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, abundance of protection and grace to your servants; grant health of mind and body; grant them to contain the increase of prosperity, and may they always be devoted to you.

text: Da famulis tuis quaesumus Domine in tua fide et sinceritate constantiam ut in caritate divina firmati nullis temptationibus ab eius integritate vellantur.
translation_en: Grant constancy to your servants, we ask, Lord, in your faith and sincerity, that being established in divine love, they may not be drawn away from their integrity by any temptations.

text: Da famulis et famulabus tuis quaesumus Domine in tua fide et sinceritate constantiam ut in caritate divina firmati nullis temptationibus ab eius integritate vellantur.
translation_en: Grant constancy, we ask you Lord, to your servants and servant-girls, in your faith and sincerity, that being steadfast in divine love, they may not be drawn away from their integrity by any temptations.

text: Deus lumen aeternum splendor
translation_en: God, eternal light, radiance

text: Da famulis tuis quaesumus Domine omnibus episcopis abbatibus canonicis monachis sive regibus et gubernatoribus atque consanguineis nostris et his qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynae seu etiam ceteris fidelibus utriusque sexus in tua fide et sinceritate constantiam ut in caritate divina firmati nullis temptationibus ab eius integritate vellantur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your servants—all bishops, abbots, canons, monks, kings, governors, and relatives, and those who have commended themselves to our prayers, as well as to all other faithful of both sexes—constancy in your faith and sincerity, so that, fortified by divine love, they may not be drawn away from their integrity by any temptations.

text: Da quaesumus Domine famulis et famulabus tuis omnibus commenditis meis vel omnibus benefactoribus meis et quorum vel quarum nomina apud nos scripta sunt et quorum debitores exsistimus vel <quibus> orare promisimus seu qui confessi sunt mihi omnes in tua fide et sinceritate constantiam ut in caritate divina firmati nullis temptationibus a tua integritate evellantur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to all your servants and handmaids whom we commend to you, as well as to all our benefactors whose names are written among us and for whom we are debtors, or to those whom we have promised to pray for, or who confess faith in you with constancy. May they all, established in divine love, never be moved from your integrity by any temptations.

text: Da mihi Domine peccatori confessionem quae tibi sit placita. Parturi in corde meo inenarrabiles gemitus qui aures tuas possint pulsare. Da mihi mentis intentionem qua suscipiam probam voluntatem tuam et praesta in humilitate mea deprecari quae te audire delectat ut praestes. Ipse animae meae insere ut iugis delectatio eius ipse sis. Da mihi lacrimas ex toto affectu internas quae peccatorum meorum possint exsolvere vincula.
translation_en: Grant me, O Lord, a sinner, the confession pleasing to You. Within my heart, I bear inexpressible groans that may reach Your ears. Grant me the intention of mind to receive Your praiseworthy will and grant in my humility to plead what delights You so that You may provide. May Yourself, O soul of mine, be the delight upon the hills and be You Yourself. Grant me tears from the entire inner heart that may free the bonds of my sins.

text: Da misericors Deus ut haec salutaris oblatio et a propriis nos reatibus indesinenter expediat et ab omnibus tueatur adversis.
translation_en: Grant, merciful God, that this saving offering may continually deliver us from our own faults and protect us against all dangers.

text: Da misericors Deus ut omnium sanctarum virginum tuarum intercessio nos ab omnibus tueatur adversis.
translation_en: Merciful God, grant that the intercession of all your holy virgins may protect us from all dangers.

text: Da misericors Deus ut in resurrectione Domini nostri Iesu Christi inveniamus et nos veraciter portionem.
translation_en: Have mercy, O merciful God, that in the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ we may find and truly possess ourselves.

text: Da misericors Deus ut quod in tui Filii passione mundus exercuit salutare nobis fideliter sentiamus.
translation_en: Have mercy, O merciful God, that we may truly feel the saving effects of what the world experienced in the Passion of Your Son.

text: Deus misericors Deus clemens qui secundum multitudinem
translation_en: God merciful, God gracious, who according to the multitude

text: Da nobis Deus noster in custodiendam pacem virginis et martyris tuae illius intercessu donum tuumque praeceptum custodire et sic te in omnibus sequi pacis tuae vinculis praemunitos.
translation_en: Grant us, O God, through the intercession of your virgin and martyr, to keep your gift and commandment, and so, protected by the bonds of your peace, to follow you in all things.

text: Da nobis Domine continua omnium sanctorum veneratione salutem et pacem ut eorum protegamur subsidiis quorum gaudemus triumphis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, continuous health and peace with the salutations of all saints, that we may be protected by the help of those whom we rejoice in their triumphs.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum Eustachii sociorumque eius intercessione laetitiam et pacem ut quorum gaudemus triumphis protegamur subsidiis.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Lord, the joy and peace of your holy martyrs Eustachius and his companions through their intercession, that we may be protected by their aid as we rejoice in their triumphs.

text: Da nobis Domine Deus beati Stephani protomartyris intercessione adiuvari ut qui pro suis exoravit lapidatoribus pro suis intercedere dignetur veneratoribus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord God, by the intercession of the blessed Stephen the Protomartyr, to be helped, so that he who prayed for his stoners may be moved to intercede on behalf of those who revere him.

text: Da nobis Domine Deus noster beati martyris tui Quintini praesentem sollemnitatem ita pia venerari devotione ut eius intercessione optatam peccatorum percipiamus remissionem.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord our God, to the blessed martyr Quintinus, a solemn presence to be revered with such pious devotion that we may receive the desired forgiveness of sins through his intercession.

text: Da nobis Domine Deus noster sanctorum martyrum palmas incessabili devotione venerari ut quos digna mente non possumus celebrare humilibus saltem frequentemus obsequiis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord our God, the palms of your holy martyrs to be unceasingly venerated, that we who cannot celebrate them with fitting mind, may at least frequently honor them with our services.

text: Da nobis Domine Deus noster ut et mundi cursus pacifico nobis tuo ordine dirigatur et Ecclesia tua tranquilla devotione laetetur.
translation_en: Grant us, O Lord our God, that the course of the world may be directed by your peaceful order and your Church rejoices with a tranquil devotion.
