text: Da nobis Domine fidei tuae miseratus augmentum ut quae sanctos martyres tuos usque ad sanguinem retenta glorificat nos etiam iustificet veraciter hanc sequentes.
translation_en: Grant to us, Lord, an increase of your faith's mercy, so that what those holy martyrs glorified up to their blood may also justify those who follow in their steps truly.

text: Deus omnipotens in cuius honore
translation_en: God Almighty, in whose honor

text: Da nobis Domine non terrena sapere sed amare caelestia et inter praetereuntia constitutos iam nunc inhaerere mansuris.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, not to seek earthly things but to love heavenly ones, and now, among the passing ones, to cling steadfastly to the eternal ones.

text: Deus omnipotens Pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi qui regenerasti famulos
translation_en: Almighty God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has regenerated servants

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus ambire quae recta sunt et vitare quae noxia ut sancta quae capimus non ad iudicium nobis sed proficiant potius ad medelam.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly pray, to pursue the righteous paths and avoid the harmful ones, so that the holy things we receive may not be for our judgment but rather for our healing.

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus in te tota mente confidere quoniam sicut superbis in sua virtute praesumentibus semper obsistis ita non deseris in tua misericordia gloriantes.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord that we ask, that we may confidently rely on you in our entire mind, for just as you always oppose the proud who presume on their strength, so you do not abandon those who boast in your mercy.

text: Deus omnipotens Pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi qui regenerasti famulum
translation_en: Almighty God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has reborn your servant

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus ipsius recensita nativitate vegetari cuius caelesti mysterio pascimur et potamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, to be nourished and sustained by the newborn one whose celestial mystery we are fed and watered.

text: Deus omnipotens Pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi qui te regeneravit
translation_en: Almighty God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who renewed you

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus unigeniti Filii tui recensita nativitate respirare cuius caelesti mysterio pascimur et potamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, O Lord, the breath of life from your only-begotten Son, whose heavenly mystery we are fed and nourished by.

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus paschalia gaudia ut quae laetanter exsequimur perpetua virtute nos tueantur et salvent.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, the joyful festivities of Easter, that those things which we rejoicingly carry out may be protected and saved by perpetual virtue.

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus perseverantem in tua voluntate famulatum ut in diebus nostris et merito et numero populus tibi serviens augeatur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, a servant persisting in your will, that in our days both in number and rightly, the people serving you may be increased.

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus pluviam salutarem et aridam terrae faciem fluentis caelestibus dignanter infunde.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, a saving rain and dry the earth's face worthily; pour down upon us from heaven flowing waters.

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus regnum tuum iustitiamque semper inquirere ut quibus indigere nos perspicis clementer facias abundare.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we ask, your kingdom and always seek justice, so that you may see our need for clemency, mercifully make it to abound.

text: Deus patrum nostrorum Deus universae
translation_en: God of our Fathers, God of all

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus ut in tua gratia veraciter confidentes et quae te digna sunt postulemus et iugiter postulata sumamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, that faithfully trusting in Thy grace, we may worthily ask for what is pleasing to Thee and at all times confirm our petitions.

text: Da nobis Domine rationabilem quaesumus actionem ut te solum sincera mente venerantes et fiducialius quae tua sunt postulemus et facilius assequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, a reasonable action that we may approach you with sincere minds, trusting more fully in what is yours and may attain it more easily.

text: Da nobis Domine tuae pietatis effectum et commendantibus sanctis tuis etiam nostra munera propitius intuere.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the effect of your mercy and graciously look upon the offerings of your saints even our gifts as well.

text: Da nobis Domine ut amicos in te et inimicos pro te veraciter valeamus diligere qui praesenti martyri tuo Stephano dedisti ut te pro suorum inimicorum expiatione rogaret; quo eius exemplo dum hic in pace copiosius abundamus cum eo post transitum coronemur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that we may truly love our friends in you and our enemies for your sake, whom you have given to Stephen in his present martyrdom to ask for your forgiveness on behalf of his opponents; by whose example, while here we abundantly possess peace with him, we may be crowned with him after passing over.

text: Da nobis Domine ut animam famuli et sacerdotis tui illius quam de saeculi educis laborioso certamine sanctorum tuorum coetui tribuas esse consortem.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the soul of thy servant and priest, whom thou hast brought out from the world by the toilsome struggle of thy saints, may be a companion to their company.

text: Da nobis Domine ut sicut publicani precibus et confessione placatus es ita et huic famulo tuo illi placare digneris et precibus eius benignus adspires ut in confessione flebili permanens expiatione perpetua clementiam tuam celeriter exoret sanctisque altaribus et sacramentis restitutus rursus caelesti gloriae mancipetur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that just as the publicans were appeased by their prayers and confession, so too may this your servant be pleased and show mercy, and that You be gracious to his prayers, that he, with tears in penitence, may quickly seek Your clemency through holy altars and sacraments, and once again may be consecrated to the heavenly glory.

text: Precor Domine clementiam tuae maiestatis et nominis ut huic famulo tuo peccata et facinora sua confitenti veniam dare et praeteritorum criminum debita relaxare digneris. Qui humeris tuis ovem perditam reduxisti ad caulas qui publicani precibus et confessione placatus es tu etiam Domine et huic famulo tuo placare tu eius precibus benignus assiste ut in confessione flebili permanens clementiam tuam celeriter exoret et sanctis altaribus restitutus spei rursus aeternae et caelesti gloriae reformetur.
translation_en: I beseech Thee, Lord, the clemency of Thy majesty and name, that to this Thy servant confessing his sins and misdeeds, You would grant forgiveness and release from the debt of past sins. Who with Thine arms brought back the lost sheep to the folds, who was appeased by the prayers and confession of publicans, even Thou, Lord, and this Thy servant, be pleased to hear his prayer mercifully, assisting him as he perseveres in penitent confession, swiftly seeking Thy clemency and being restored again to the hope of eternal life and celestial glory.

text: Da nobis haec quaesumus Domine frequentare mysteria quia quoties hostiae tibi placitae commemoratio celebratur opus nostrae redemptionis exseritur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that we may often partake in these mysteries, for whenever the remembrance of pleasing sacrifices is celebrated, the work of our redemption is effected.

text: Da nobis mentem Domine quae tibi sit placita quia talibus iugiter quidquid est prosperum ministrabis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, a mind that pleases you, for you are always providing whatever is prosperous to those who are such as this.

text: Da nobis misericordiam tuam quaesumus Domine ut animae famulorum tuorum illorum ab omnibus vitiis expiatam cum tua protectione securae diem futurae resurrectionis exspectent.
translation_en: Grant us your mercy, we ask you, Lord, that the souls of your servants may expect the day of future resurrection cleansed from all vices with your protection.

text: Da nobis misericors Deus ut sancta tua quae sumpsimus nos in tua voluntate confirment et veritatis ubique praedicatores efficiant.
translation_en: Grant us, merciful God, that what we have received from your saints may be confirmed within your will and make us everywhere proclaimers of truth.

text: Da nobis misericors Deus ut sancta tua quibus incessanter explemur sinceris tractemus obsequiis et fideli semper mente sumamus.
translation_en: Grant us, merciful God, that we may carry out the sacred duties with sincere actions and always keep a faithful mind.

text: Da nobis observantiam Domine legitima devotione perfectam ut cum refrenatione carnalis alimoniae sancta tibi conversatione placeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, a lawful and complete devotion so that with the restraint of carnal desires we may please you through holy conduct.

text: Da nobis Domine quaesumus observantiam legitima devotione perfectam ut cum refrenatione carnalis alimoniae sancta tibi conversatione placeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, a watchful observance with a perfect devotion so that with the restraint of carnal desires, we may please You with a holy way of life.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus beati archangeli Michaelis eotenus honore proficere ut cuius in terris gloriam praedicamus eius precibus adiuvemur in caelis.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, through the intercession of the blessed archangel Michael, to advance in honor, so that on earth we may proclaim his glory and be aided by his prayers in heaven.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus in sanctorum tuorum te semper commemoratione laudare quia refovete curabis quos in honore tuo perseverare concesseris.
translation_en: Grant to us, almighty God, that in the remembrance of your saints we may always praise you, because you have refreshed and cared for those whom you have granted to persevere in your honor.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus remedia condicionis humanae et sincero tractare servitio et cum profectu salutis implere.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, remedies for the human condition and sincerely perform service, and to fulfill it with success for our salvation.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus ut afflicta per abstinentiam carne mente tibi et spiritu mereamur placere ut parsimonia nostrae carnis incentiva exstinguat et fervor spiritalis e terris nos ad caelestia semper attollat.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that afflicted by abstinence in flesh, mind, and spirit, we may deserve to please you. May our earthly desires be extinguished through frugality, and may the fervor of our spirits always lift us towards heaven.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus ut beati Laurentii martyris tui veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the venerable festival and devotion of the blessed Laurence, your martyr, may increase in us and bring us salvation.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Laurentii martyris tui quam praevenimus veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that the venerable feast day of the blessed martyr Lawrence, which we have reached, may increase our reverence and devotion, and bring us salvation.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Silvestri confessoris tui atque pontificis veneranda sollemnitas et devotionem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the venerable solemnity and devotion of your confessor and pope, Saint Silvester, may increase in us and bring us salvation.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus ut eorum semper festa sectemur quorum digna pro nobis interventione confidimus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we may always follow the festivals of those whose intervention on our behalf we confidently trust.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus ut sicut adoranda Filii tui natalicia praevenimus sic eius munera capiamus sempiterna gaudentes.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that just as we hasten to honor the birth of your Son, so may we receive his eternal gifts while rejoicing.

text: Da nobis omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sanctorum tuorum natalicia celebrantes quorum praedicamus triumphos eorum fidem veraciter imitemur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty and merciful God, that we may celebrate the birthdays of your saints whose triumphs we proclaim; so that we may faithfully follow their example in truth.

text: Deus qui ad salutem humani generis maxima
translation_en: God who for the salvation of the human race brought about great things

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine beatae martyris tuae Agnes confidenter honorare infantiam quae in puellari consistens aetate mortem pro tua confessione calcavit.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, confidently to honor the childhood of Your blessed martyr Agnes, who, while being a young girl, walked upon death for Your confession.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine beati apostoli tui Thomae sollemnitatibus gloriari ut eius semper et patrociniis sublevemur et fidem congrua devotione sectemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, the feast days of your blessed apostle Thomas, that we may always be uplifted by his intercession and follow a faithful devotion with suitable reverence.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine beati Iusti confessoris tui atque pontificis semper adiuvari meritis ut mereamur cum eo consortes fieri regni caelestis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, the blessed just confessor and bishop of yours, always to be helped by his merits, so that we may deserve to become his companions in the kingdom of heaven.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine de tribulatione laetitiam ut qui diu pro nostris peccatis affligimur intervenientibus sanctis tuis celerius in tua misericordia respiremus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, joy from tribulation, that those who have long been afflicted on account of our sins may breathe more quickly in your mercy through the intervention of your saints.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine de tribulatione laetitiam ut qui diu pro peccatis nostris affligimur intercedentibus sanctis tuis clementer in tua misericordia respiremus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, joy from tribulation, so that we who have long been afflicted for our sins may breathe gently in your mercy through the intercession of your saints.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine de tribulatione laetitiam ut qui diu pro nostris peccatis affligimur intercedente beato illo martyre tuo in tua misericordia respiremus.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, Lord, joy from tribulation, so that we who have been long afflicted for our sins through your blessed martyr, may breathe in your mercy.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster beati apostoli tui Andreae intercessionibus sublevari ut per quos Ecclesiae tuae superni muneris rudimenta donasti per eos subsidia perpetuae salutis impendas
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, through the intercession of your blessed apostle Andrew, that we may be raised up so that through them, who were instruments in bestowing the rudiments of your heavenly ministry, everlasting aids for salvation may be conferred upon us.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster in tua semper devotione gaudere quia perpetua est et plena felicitas si bonorum omnium iugiter serviamus auctori.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, always to rejoice in your devotion because happiness is eternal and full if we serve the author of all good forever.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut qui nativitatem Domini nostri Iesu Christi nos frequentare gaudemus dignis conversationibus ad eius mereamur pertinere consortium.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, our God, that those who rejoice in celebrating the Nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ are worthy of living according to fitting manners, so that we may deserve to belong to his company.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut qui nativitatem Domini nostri Iesu Christi digne mysteriis frequentare gaudemus ad eius mereamur pertinere consortium.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, our God, that we who rejoice in worthy mysteries to celebrate the nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ may deserve to belong to his company.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine digne celebrare mysterium quo in nostri Salvatoris infantia miraculis coruscantibus declaratur et corporalibus incrementis manifesta designatur humanitas.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, worthy to celebrate the mystery whereby, in the infancy of our Savior, miracles shining forth declare his divinity and physical growth clearly reveals his humanity.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine firmitatem religionis et pacis ut quanto tibi devotius famulamur tanto diebus nostris prosperius cuncta succedant.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, firmness in religion and peace, so that as we serve you more devoutly, our days may be more successful in all things.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine gloriosa natalicia beati Albani martyris tui digne praevenire et eius patrocinio ab omni adversitate mentis et corporis liberari.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, the glorious feast days of Your blessed martyr Alban may worthy precede, and by his patronage be freed from every adversity of mind and body.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine imitari quod colimus ut discamus et inimicos diligere quia eius natalicia celebramus qui novit etiam pro persecutoribus exorare.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that we may imitate what we worship, so that we may learn to love our enemies, for we celebrate the birth of one who knows how even to intercede for his persecutors.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine per gratiam Spiritus Sancti novam tui paracliti spiritalis observantiae disciplinam ut mentes nostrae sacro purgatae ieiunio cunctis reddantur eius muneribus aptiores.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, through the grace of the Holy Spirit, a new discipline of Your Holy Paraclete's spiritual observance, so that our minds, purified by sacred fasting, may be made more fit for His gifts.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine piae supplicationis effectum et pestilentiam famemque propitiatus averte ut et congruam tibi exhibeamus servitutem et propitiationis tuae beneficia semper inveniamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask You, Lord, the effect of pious supplication and turn away pestilence and famine, that we may present to You a fitting service and always find Your blessings of propitiation.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine piae supplicationis effectum et pestilentiam famemque propitiatus averte ut mortalium corda cognoscant et te indignante talia flagella procedere et te miserante cessare.
translation_en: Grant us, we implore you Lord, the effect of holy supplications and turn away plague and famine, propitiated, so that the hearts of men may recognize and know that such scourges proceed from your indignation, and cease when you are merciful.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine purae devotionis affectum et sanctorum martyrum tuorum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii intercessionibus etiam nostra munera propitius intuere.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, a pure affection of devotion and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor, and Nazarius, may You also look favorably upon our gifts.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine sanctae regimen disciplinae ut per tuam gratiam et moderatio gubernantium et oboedientia proveniat subditorum.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, a holy rule of discipline, so that through Thy grace and the guidance of moderators, there may come about the obedience of the subjects.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine sanctorum martyrum passionibus gloriari ut eorum semper et patrociniis confidamus et fidem congrua devotione sectemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask You, Lord, the glory of the passion of the holy martyrs, so that we may always trust in their intercession and follow their faith with a fitting devotion.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine semper haec tibi vota deferre quibus sanctorum tuorum natalicia celebrantes tuam gloriam praedicemus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, always to offer these votes to you, for whom we celebrate the nativities of your saints, proclaiming your glory.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine semper haec tibi vota gratanter persolvere quibus sancti confessoris tui Damasi depositionem recolimus et praesta ut in eius semper laude tuam gloriam praedicemus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, always to fulfill these vows graciously that we remember the deposition of your saintly confessor Damasus and grant that we may always proclaim your glory in his praise.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine tua digne tractare mysteria ut et miserationibus tuis congruo respondeamus obsequio et fiducialius speranda poscamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Lord, worthy to handle your mysteries, that we may respond with obedience and more confidently hope, as we beg for your mercies.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine ut animam famuli tui illius in numero fidelium tuorum lux aeterna possideat.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, that the soul of your servant may possess the eternal light among your faithful ones.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine ut cum martyrum sollemnitate sanctorum perpetua tuitione laetemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask You, Lord, that we may rejoice with the solemnity of the martyrs under Your eternal protection.

text: Da nobis quaesumus misericors Deus ipsius superveniente festivitate vegetari cuius integra virginitate salutis nostrae suscepimus auctorem.  Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ipsius supervenientis festivitatis gaudia venerari de cuius integra virginitate salutis nostrae suscepimus auctorem. ( recensio Mateus )
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, merciful God, that the coming feast of its own vegetation may be blessed to whose entire virginity we have received the author of our salvation. Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that the joys of the approaching feast may be revered, from whose entire virginity we have received the author of our salvation (according to Matthew's account).

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus boni operis incrementa percipere et quem tempore provehis sacris mysteriis effice promptiorem.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty God, the increase of good works and make us more ready when you provide at sacred mysteries.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus perpetuae felicitatlis esse participes qua cum septem filiis suis fruitur beata Felicitas.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, to partake in eternal happiness, as blessed Felicity enjoys with her seven sons.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus et aeternae promissionis gaudia quaerere et quaesita citius invenire.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Almighty God, that we may seek the joys of eternal promises and find what is sought more quickly.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus in te semper gloriari et concede ut qui beatae Hedwigis merita devote recolimus ipsius adiuti precibus tuam gratiam sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, always to glory in you and concede that we may feel your grace, as we devoutly remember the merits of blessed Hedwig, supported by her prayers.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ita beati Pelagii martyris tui novam post antiquos martyres coronam hodierna festivitate recolere ut ipso patrocinante ad caelestia desideranda valeamus corda levare.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Almighty God, in the same way that the blessed martyr Pelagius remembers a new crown after ancient martyrs on this day's festivity, may we be able to lift our hearts to heavenly desires with his patronage.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nativitate Domini nostri Iesu Christi cuius sollemnia veneramur eius semper muniamur auxilio.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that we may always be fortified with the help of our Lord Jesus Christ, whose nativity we celebrate today.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per gratiam tuam nosmetipsos sicut te dignum est exhibentes tuis fidelibus ministremus rectae conversationis exemplum et populi tui salvatio sempiterna fiat praemium sacerdotis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty God, that through your grace we may present ourselves worthy to serve as an example of righteous living to your faithful, and that the eternal salvation of your people may be the reward of the priest.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut {qui} beati Pantaleonis martyris tui natalicia {colimus} caelestibus mysteriis celebrata pro nostra infirmitate propitiationis tuae medelam nobis acquirant.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that we who celebrate the natalicia of your martyr Blessed Pantaleon on this day may acquire from the heavenly mysteries the remedy for our infirmity through your propitiation.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut veneranda beati Audomari confessoris tui atque pontificis <sollemnia> colimus sic eius suffragiis caelesti munere participemur et meritis.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, almighty God, that just as we honor the venerable confessor and bishop, your Audomarus, with solemnities, so may we participate in heavenly gifts through his intercessions and merits.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus vitiorum nostrorum flammas exstinguere qui beato Laurentio tribuisti tormentorum suorum incendia superare.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, almighty God, the power to extinguish the flames of our sins, as you gave blessed Lawrence the strength to overcome the fires of his torture.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus et sempiterne pater ut nativitatis Domini nostri Iesu Christi sollemnia quae praesentibus officiis praevenimus sic nova sint nobis ut continuata permaneant sic perpetua perseverent ut pro sui miraculo nova semper exsistam.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty and merciful God and eternal Father, that the solemnities of the nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ which we are celebrating with present offices may be new to us in such a way that they continue, and may perpetually persevere so that they always exist as a miracle for us.

text: Da nostrae summe condicionis reparator ut et semper declinemus a malis et omne quod bonum est prompta voluntate sectemur.
translation_en: Grant our highest condition's restorer, that we may always turn away from evils and follow with ready will whatever is good.

text: Da plebi tuae Domine piae semper devotionis effectum ut quae prava sunt respuens sancta conversatione firmetur et a peccatis libera nullis adversitatibus atteratur.
translation_en: Grant to your people, Lord, the constant effect of pious devotion, that what is corrupt may be repulsed by holy living and freed from sins, unaffected by any adversities.

text: Da populo tuo Domine quaesumus spiritum veritatis et pacis ut et te tota mente cognoscant et quae tibi sunt placita toto corde sectantes bonorum tuorum semper munere ponantur.
translation_en: Grant to your people, Lord, we beseech you, the spirit of truth and peace, that they may know you with their whole mind and seek what pleases you with their whole heart, and may the works of your good ones always be placed upon them as a continual gift.

text: Da populo tuo quaesumus Domine spiritum veritatis et pacis ut et te tota mente cognoscat et quae tibi sunt placita toto corde sectetur.
translation_en: Grant your people, we ask you, Lord, the spirit of truth and peace, that they may know you with their whole mind and follow with their whole heart what pleases you.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populo tuo spiritum veritatis et pacis ut et te per adventum unigeniti tui tota mente cognoscat et quae tibi sunt placita toto corde sectetur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask You, Lord, Your people the Spirit of truth and peace, that they may know You completely with their whole mind and follow with their whole heart what pleases You.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populo tuo spiritum veritatis et pacis ut te tota mente cognoscat et quae tibi placita sunt pia devotione exerceat.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, your people the spirit of truth and peace, that with a whole mind they may know you and exercise what pleases you with pious devotion.

text: Da quaesumus clementissime Pater indulgentiam famulis et famulabus tuis qui nobis propria confessi sunt peccata et concede eis ut in praeceptis tuis iugiter perseverent.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask, most merciful Father, indulgence to your servants and handmaids who have confessed their own sins to us. And grant that they may always persevere in your commandments.

text: Da quaesumus clementissime Pater per huius sacramenti mysterium meorum mihi veniam peccatorum ut non ad iudicium sed ad indulgentiam huius presbyteratus ordo mihi proficiat sempiternam.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, most merciful Father, through the mystery of this sacrament may my sins be forgiven, so that the order of this presbyterate may not lead me to judgment but to eternal mercy.

text: Da quaesumus Domine Deus noster gratiae tuae donis et iustificari nos semper et instrui quos cottidianum tibi sacrificium praecipis exhibere.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, through Thy graces and gifts, that we may always be justified and instructed to offer daily unto Thee the sacrifice which Thou hast commanded.

text: Da quaesumus Domine Deus noster omnibus fidelibus tuis rem publicam gubernantibus recta semper meditari et agere eisque feliciter ad vitam pervenire concede perpetuam.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord our God, to all your faithful rulers that they may always meditate on the right path and act for their success in reaching life. Grant them perpetual prosperity.

text: Da quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut tuorum commemoratione sanctorum temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur adspectu.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that just as we rejoice temporarily with the remembrance of your saints through their earthly duties, so may we be eternally happy with the sight of them.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut in commemoratione beati apostoli tui Iacobi temporali gratulamur officio ita cum ipso in tui vultus delectatione perpetuo laetemur adspectu.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, that just as in the commemoration of your apostle James we rejoice temporally with an office, so may we be eternally pleased with his appearance in your presence.

text: Da quaesumus Domine electis nostris digne atque sapienter ad confessionem tuae laudis accedere ut dignitati pristinae quam originali transgressione perdiderant per tuam gratiam reformentur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, worthy and wise, that our chosen ones may approach your confession of praise with dignity. May they, who through an initial transgression lost their original dignity, be reformed by your grace.

text: Da quaesumus Domine familiae tuae cum suis pacem habere rectoribus ut quorum honore congaudent de eorum sancta conversatione laetentur tuaque gratia tribuatur et moderatio gubernantium et oboedientia subditorum.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, peace to your family and their leaders, that they may rejoice in the honor of their holy lives, and that your grace may be bestowed upon them. May there be moderation for those governing, and obedience from the subjects.

text: Da quaesumus Domine famulae tuae quam virginitatis honore dignatus es decorare inchoati operis consummatum effectum ut et perfectam tibi offerat plenitudinem et initia sua perducere mereatur ad finem.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your servant whom you have deemed worthy to adorn with the honor of virginity, that the work begun may be brought to completion and merit to offer you a perfect fulfillment. May it also be worthy to bring its initial stages to the end.

text: Da quaesumus Domine famulis tuis omnibus videlicet consanguineis nostris et his qui se in nostris orationibus commendaverunt et quorum eleemosynas accepimus seu cunctis fidelibus tuis iugiter inhaerere mandatis et quae recta sunt te auxiliante sectari.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your servants everywhere - that is, to our relatives and those who have entrusted themselves to our prayers, and whose alms we have received, or to all of your faithful. May they always adhere to your commandments and may they, with your help, pursue what is right.

text: Da quaesumus Domine famulo tuo illi remissionem omnium peccatorum et praesta ut tuo semper munere gubernetur et ad gaudia aeternae redemptionis te ducente pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your servant, the remission of all sins and grant that he may always be governed by your mercy and may merit to arrive at the joys of eternal redemption, guided by you leading the way.

text: Da quaesumus Domine famulo tuo illi sperata suffragia obtinere ut qui fidelibus tuis sua largitus est dona beati Laurentii martyris tui mereatur consortia cuius exemplo praebet nobis gratanter vitae stipendia.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your servant that he may obtain the promised aid. May he deserve the rewards of the blessed Laurence your martyr, whose example graciously provides us with the wages of life.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus populis sanctorum tuorum semper veneratione laetari et eorum perpetua supplicatione muniri.
translation_en: Grant, we ask You, Lord, that the faithful peoples of Your saints may always rejoice in their everlasting veneration and be strengthened by their constant supplication.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis beneficiis gratulari suppliciter imploratis ut qui ieiuniis te venerantur exhibitis bonorum tuorum copiis impleantur.
translation_en: Therefore, as we humbly ask you, Lord, may your faithful people be pleased with the blessings that have been requested through their supplications, so that those who come to you in fasting may be filled with the abundance of your good things.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis et sine cessatione capere paschalia sacramenta et desideranter exspectare ventura ut in mysteriis quibus renati sunt permanentes ad novam vitam his operibus perducantur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that your faithful may without ceasing partake of the Paschal sacraments and eagerly await what is to come, so that in the mysteries in which they have been reborn, they may be led to a new life by these works.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis fortes in fide et bono persistere opere qui beato Bartholomaeo apostolo (tuo) tantam tribuisti constantiam ut etiam vivus decoriari sufferret pro tuo laudabili nomine.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, strength to your faithful ones to persevere in faith and good works, as you gave such constancy to the blessed Apostle Bartholomew, that even while living he was adorned with suffering for your laudable name.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis hunc caritatis affectum ut sanctorum tuorum celebritate ferventes nullis implicentur erroribus nullis adversitatibus affligantur; salutaribus proficiant institutis qui talibus praesidiis adiuvantur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, this affection of charity to your faithful, that they, fervent in the celebration of your saints, may not be entangled in any errors and may not be afflicted by any adversities; that they may make progress through salutary institutions which are helped by such protections.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis ieiuniis paschalibus convenienter aptari ut suscepta sollemniter castigatio corporalis cunctis ad fructum proficiat animarum.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that your faithful may fittingly prepare themselves for the appropriate penitential observances during Easter, so that the undertaken solemn fasting benefits all in spiritual fruit.

text: Da quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis in sacra semper actione persistere ut qui tua miseratione sunt digni fiant pietatis officio digniores.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your faithful, in the sacred act always to persevere, so that those who are worthy of your mercy may become more deserving of the office of piety.

text: Da quaesumus Domine hanc mentem populo tuo ut qui ad te placandum necessitate concurrit maiestati tuae fiat etiam voluntate devotus.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to this people of yours, that he who approaches your majesty out of necessity may also be devoted in his will.

text: Da quaesumus Domine hanc praesenti familiae tuae gratiam ut qui beati martyris tui et levitae Stephani inventionem annuo veneratur obsequio eo suffragante te misericordem invenire mereatur in caelo.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, this grace to your present family, that those who annually revere the discovery of your martyr and Levite Stephen with due observance may, through his intercession, deserve your mercy in heaven.

text: Da quaesumus Domine lumen intellegentiae parvulis tuis ut pro veteris gratia sacramenti praesentis sacrificii gratia succedente sic gloriemur novis ut non abutamur antiquis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, light of understanding for your little ones, that they may be filled with the grace of the sacrament present, following in the footsteps of the old. May we shine forth with new glory, not straying from the old.

text: Da quaesumus Domine nostris effectum ieiuniis salutarem ut castigatio carnis assumpta ad nostrarum vegetationem transeat animarum.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, may our fasting be fruitful, so that the discipline of the flesh taken for our well-being passes into the growth of our souls.

text: Da quaesumus Domine per haec sancta quae sumpsimus populo tuo salutem mentis et corporis et intercedente beata Katherina virgine et martyre tua in cuius honore laetamur perpetuis consolationibus tuorum reple corda fidelium ut divina proiectione relevati et pia tibi devotione complaceant et tua semper beneficia consequantur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Lord, through these holy things which we have received for your people, health of mind and body; and with the intercession of blessed Catherine, virgin and martyr, in whose honor we rejoice with perpetual consolations, fill the hearts of the faithful that, being raised by divine protection, they may please you with pious devotion and always attain your blessings.

text: Deus qui diem discernis et noctem
translation_en: God who discerns day and night

text: Da quaesumus Domine populis christianis et quod profitentur agnoscere et caeleste munus diligere quod frequentant.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to the Christian people, that they may perceive what is profitable for them and recognize and love the heavenly gift which they attend.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populo tuo a diabolicis quibus renuntiavit laqueis abstinere et toto tibi corde prosterni.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you Lord, your people the strength to resist the devilish snares to which they have yielded and to bow their whole heart to you.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populo tuo diabolica vitare contagia et te solum dominum puro corde sectari.
translation_en: Grant, we ask You, Lord, that Your people may avoid the contagion of diabolic influences and seek only You as their pure-hearted Master.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populo tuo et mentem qua tibi devotus exsistat et intellectum quo iusta deposcat et propitiationem tuam qua pie desiderantibus quae sint profutura perficias.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to your people a mind that exists devotedly towards you, an understanding with which they may justly petition, and your favor which the devout ones eagerly desire, that it may be effectively fulfilled.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populo tuo inviolabilem fidei firmitatem ut qui unigenitum tuum in tua tecum gloria sempiternum in veritate nostri corporis natum de matre virgine confitentur et a praesentibus liberentur adversis et mansuris gaudiis inserantur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask You, Lord, to Your people an unbreakable firmness of faith, so that those who confess Your only-begotten Son, born for us in eternal glory with You in truth from the Virgin Mother, may be freed from present troubles and may be enriched with lasting joys.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populo tuo salutem mentis et corporis ut bonis operibus inhaerendo tuae semper virtutis mereatur protectione defendi.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, health of mind and body to your people, so that by adhering to good works they may always merit the protection of your virtue.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populo tuo salutem mentis et corporis ut interventu beati Sebastiani martyris tui bonis operibus inhaerendo tuo semper munere et suorum meritorum interventione a peste epidemiae et ab omni tribulatione mereamur tua proiectione defendi.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, health to your people, both of mind and body, so that through the intervention of your blessed martyr St. Sebastian, by clinging to good works, we may always remain under your protection and through their merits be defended from the plague and every tribulation, through your mercy.

text: Da quaesumus Domine populum tuum ad te toto corde converti quia – quos defendis etiam delinquentes – maiore pietate tueris sincera tibi mente devotos.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that your people turn towards you with their whole heart, for you who even protect the wicked, guard them more faithfully with a sincere mind devoted to you.

text: Da quaesumus Domine rex aeterne cunctorum ut sacro nos purificatos ieiunio sinceris quoque mentibus ad tua sancta ventura facias pervenire.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord eternal king of all, that through sacred fasting you make us pure and clean, not only in body but also in mind, so that we may come to approach your holy places.

text: Da quaesumus Domine sanitatem populo tuo mentis et corporis da vitare quod nocet et amare quod salvet da ut bonis operibus inhaerendo et benedici a te mereatur et tua semper virtute defendi.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, health to your people, both of mind and body. Grant that they may avoid what harms and love what saves. Grant that by performing good works, they may deserve to be blessed by you, and always protected by your power.

text: Da quaesumus Domine ut anima famulae tuae sacris mysteriis expiata salvationis tuae perpetuo munere glorietur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the soul of your servant may, purified by your sacred mysteries, always enjoy the eternal gift of your salvation and glory.

text: Da quaesumus Domine ut et fideles tui diligant praesules suos et ab eis mutuo diligamur atque ut in his perpetuo perseverent praesta ut in utrisque nec iustitia desit nec pietas.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that your faithful may love their bishops and be loved by them in return, and that they may continually persevere. Bestow upon them that in both there is never a lack of justice nor pity.

text: Da quaesumus Domine ut ieiunando robore satiemur et abstinendo cunctis efficiamur hostibus fortiores.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that by fasting we may be filled with strength and by abstaining from all things become stronger against our enemies.

text: Da nobis omnipotens Deus ut ieiunando a corporalibus escis spiritu vegetati satiemur robore et abstinendo ab alimoniis pariterque delictis cunctis proficiamur in virtute hostibus fortiores.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that we may be filled with strength from spiritual food while fasting, and that we may advance in all things by abstaining from sustenance and sins, becoming stronger against our enemies in virtue.

text: Deus qui diversitatem omnium gentium in confessione
translation_en: God who diversity of all nations in confession

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ieiunando tua gratia satiemur et abstinendo cunctis efficiamur hostibus fortiores.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that by fasting your grace may fill us and, by abstaining from all things, we may become stronger against our enemies.

text: Da quaesumus Domine ut tanti mysterii munus indultum non condemnatio sed sit medicina sumentibus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that this sacred mystery may not be a condemnation but a medicine for those who partake of it.

text: Deus qui divitias misericordiae tuae
translation_en: God who distributes your mercy

text: Da quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae misericors Deus ut sancto spiritu congregata hostili nullatenus incursione turbetur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask your Church, merciful God, that it may not be disturbed by any hostile incursion while gathered by the Holy Spirit.

text: Da quaesumus misericors Deus ut mysticis Ecclesia tua beati baptistae Ioannis exordiis et sacris erudita praeconiis ad iram venturi iudicii declinandam dignos salutis fructus iugiter operetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, merciful God, that you may clothe with the fruits of salvation those who, following in the footsteps of blessed John the Baptist, are instructed in your mystical Church at its beginnings and sacred learning, and who preach to avoid the coming wrath of judgment.

text: Da quaesumus misericors Deus ut qui beatae Marthae Filii tui hospitae festivitatem colimus eius meritis a cunctis adversitatibus liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, merciful God, that we who celebrate the feast of blessed Martha Your Son's guest, may be freed from all adversities through his merits.

text: Da quaesumus nobis omnipotens Deus ieiuniorum magnifici sacramenti et digne semper tractare mysteria et competenter honorare primordia.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we may worthily handle the sacred mystery of the solemn fast and fittingly honor the primordials.

text: Da nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ieiuniorum magnifica sacramenta et dignis semper tractare mysteriis et puris pacificisque praecordiis celebrare.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the solemn rites of those who fast may be magnified for us, and that we may always handle mysteries worthy and celebrate with pure and peaceful hearts.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus beatissimi sacerdotis et martyris tui Apollinaris meritis immensae nos tuae pietatis misericordiam consequi quatenus eius intervenientibus precibus nostra queant deleri facinora.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, through the merits of your most blessed priest and martyr Apollinaris, that we may obtain Your immense mercy, so that his intercessory prayers may deliver us from our sins.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus cunctae familiae tuae hanc voluntatem Christo filio tuo domino nostro venienti operibus iustis aptos occurrere ut eius dexterae sociati regnum mereantur possidere caeleste.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Almighty God, that all your families may be fitted to meet with just works the will of Christ, your Son, our Lord who is coming. May they merit to possess the heavenly kingdom as his right hand's companions.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus aeternae vitae refectis muneribus ei nos concorporari in caelestibus quem tuum dilectum filium in monte transformatum ipsumque audiendum esse electis discipulis intimasti.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that we may be united with him in heaven whom you revealed to your beloved son on the mountain and who was made known to the chosen disciples.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus illuc subsequi tuorum membra fidelium quo caput nostrum principiumque praecessit.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that your followers' limbs follow where our head and beginning have preceded.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus intra sanctae ecclesiae uterum constitutos eo nos spiritu ab iniquitate nostra iustificari quo beatum Ioannem intra viscera materna docuisti.
translation_en: We ask, O almighty God, within the holy church's womb to establish us with the Spirit that we may be justified from our wickedness, just as you taught blessed John within his mother's womb.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam semper gentium
translation_en: God who always churches of nations

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus sic nos tuam veniam promereri ut nostros corrigamus excessus sic fatentibus relaxare delictum ut coerceamus in suis pravitatibus obstinatos.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, Almighty God, that we may be shown Your mercy so that we may correct our excesses. Loosen the burden of sin for those who confess, and restrain the stubborn in their wickedness.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut abstinentiam nostrae restaurationis exordiis competentem dignis praecurramus officiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, that we may begin worthy duties for the restoration of our abstinence at their proper starting points.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Christophori martyris tui intercessio nos adiuvet eiusque suffragiis pietatis tuae clementia nos ubique defendat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the intercession of the blessed martyr Christopher may aid us, and that through his supplications, your mercy may protect us everywhere.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati protomartyris tui Stephani post nativitatem Domini nostri Iesu Christi sollemnia recensentes et meritis ipsius protegamur et precibus iuvemur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of your blessed protomartyr Stephen after the birth of our Lord Jesus Christ, we may be protected by his merits and strengthened by his prayers.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus divino munere satiati ut sicut famulus tuus ille pro suae animae requie deputavit ita in huius <sanctae basilicae> consummatione beati apostoli tui illius et sanctorum martyrum tuorum illorum gloriam tua plebs devota veneretur.
translation_en: We ask You, almighty God, through divine gift, to satisfy those who are filled, just as Your servant did for the repose of his soul in that sanctified basilica. May Your devoted people venerate the glory of Your blessed apostle and martyrs there.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Ecclesia tua et sacramentis refecta salutaribus et beati Pauli apostoli fulta supplicationibus sic praesentia dona percipiat ut capere mereatur aeterna.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that your Church, refreshed with salvific sacraments and filled with the prayers of blessed Paul the apostle, may receive such presence that it might worthy earn to capture eternal life.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Ecclesia tua et suorum firmitate membrorum et nova semper fecunditate laetetur.
translation_en: We ask You, Almighty God, that Your Church and its members rejoice in the firmness of their members and ever new fruitfulness.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut famulus tuus cui ecclesiasticae curae talenta tradidisti cum multiplici laboris fructu gaudia domini sui ingrediatur aeterna.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that your servant to whom you have given the talents for ecclesiastical care may enter into eternal joys through the abundant fruits of his labor serving his Lord.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut haec famula tua quae pro spe retributionis promissi muneris se domino desiderat consecrari plena fide animoque permaneat; tribue ei pro operibus gloriam pro pudore reverentiam pro pudicitia sanctitatem ut ad meritum possit gloriae pervenire.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that your servant, who desires to be consecrated for the hope of the promised reward, may be filled with faith and remain steadfast; may she receive glory for her works, reverence for her modesty, and sanctity for her chastity, so that she may attain to the merit of glory.

text: Deus qui et iustis praemia
translation_en: God who gives rewards to the just

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut huius oblationis effectus et tibi non placita refutare et praestet nobis amare quae recta sunt.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that the effects of this offering may not displease you and may grant us the ability to love what is right.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut in tua spe et caritate sincera sacrificium tibi placitum deferamus et plebis et praesulis.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that with sincere faith and love we may offer to You a pleasing sacrifice, both of the people and the bishops.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercessione beatae virginis tuae illius et a praesentibus liberemur periculis et tuo semper munimine protegamur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that through the intercession of your blessed Virgin, may we be freed from present dangers and always be protected by your protection.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut mysteriorum virtute sanctorum vita nostra firmetur. (A) Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut mysteriorum virtute sanctorum Gervasii et Protasii vita nostra firmetur. (B) Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut mysteriorum virtute satiati sanctorum Gervasii et Protasii intercessione vita nostra firmetur. (C) Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut mysteriorum tuorum virtute satiati sanctorum Gervasii et Protasii intercessione firmemur. (D)
translation_en:
(A) We ask you, almighty God, that through the power of the mysteries, the life of the saints strengthens our life.
(B) We ask you, almighty God, that through the power of the mysteries, satisfied saints Gervasius and Protasius intercede to strengthen our life.
(C) We ask you, almighty God, that through the power of your mysteries, being satisfied saints Gervasius and Protasius intervene to support us.
(D)

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut mysteriorum virtute satiati vita nostra firmetur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that our life may be strengthened by the power of the mysteries.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quae divina sunt iugiter ambientes donis semper mereamur caelestibus propinquare.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that those things which are divine may always surround us with gifts so that we may forever deserve to approach the heavenly realms.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quae divina sunt iugiter exsequentes donis mereamur caelestibus propinquare.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that since we are always executing divine gifts, we may deserve to approach the heavenly ones.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatae Anastasiae martyris tuae sollemnia colimus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of the blessed martyr Anastasia, we may feel her patronage with you.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Marcelli confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnia colimus eius apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of your blessed confessor and pope, Saint Marcellus, may his intercessions with you aid us.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui (a) beatus Felix donis tuis exstitit gloriosus apud te nostris exsistat nominibus idoneus interventor.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that he, the blessed Felix, who became glorious with your gifts, may also be fitting among our names and an intercessor for us before you.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui in tot adversis ex nostra infirmitate deficimus intercedente unigeniti Filii tui passione respiremus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who are weakened by our own frailty in so many trials, may breathe through the passion of your only-begotten Son.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui infirmitatis nostrae conscii de tua virtute confidimus sub tua semper pietate gaudeamus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we are aware of our weakness, so we may trust in your power. May we always rejoice under your constant mercy.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui nova incarnati verbi tui luce perfundimur hoc in nostro resplendeat opere quod per fidem fulget in mente.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that we who are bathed in the new light of your incarnate Word, may shine forth in our work, which shines in faith in our mind.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut reatum nostrum munera sacra purificent et recte vivendi nobis operentur effectum.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the sacred offerings cleanse our repentance and that the effect of living righteously work in us.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacro nos purificante ieiunio sinceris mentibus ad sancta ventura facias pervenire.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that with the sacred fast purifying us, you may lead us with pure minds to encounter the holy things.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctae Caeciliae martyris et annua sollemnitate laetemur et tantae fidei proficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that we rejoice on the anniversary of Saint Cecilia, the martyr, and make progress in our faith by her example.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatae Priscae martyris tuae natalicia colimus et annua sollemnitate laetemur et tantae fidei proficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the birthday of the blessed martyr Prisca, we may rejoice in her annual feast day and grow in faith through her example.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sancti confessoris tui Iudoci nos ubique conservet oratio cuius hanc festivitatem consecrat veneranda translatio.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that your holy confessor Judocus protect us everywhere with his prayer whose venerable translation we celebrate today.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut per cuncta mundi spatia martyrum tuorum facis victorias propagari sic te auxiliante nobis eorum sentiamus ubique praesentiam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that just as through all the spaces of the world you make the victories of your martyrs spread, so with your help we may feel their presence everywhere.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beatus Ioannes Baptista adstruxit agnus ille tuus qui praesentibus mysteriis declaratus est peccata nostra semper emundet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that just as blessed John the Baptist prepared your lamb, who was revealed to be cleansing our sins in the presence of these mysteries, may he always cleanse us.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut toto tibi corde famulemur quia nulla nobis praevalebit hostilitas si in te Domine veraciter confidamus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that we may serve you wholeheartedly because no hostility will overcome us if truly we trust in you, Lord.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut triumphum beati Laurentii martyris tui quem despectis ignibus consummavit in terris perpetua caelorum luce conspicuum digno fervore fidei veneremur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we may honor with fitting fervor of faith the triumph of your martyr Saint Lawrence, whom you made conspicuous on earth by scornfully consuming him in flames, and who is now visible in perpetual light of heaven.

text: Da quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut venerabilis Leodegarius sacerdos et martyr et sacris nos exerceat institutis et pia semper faciat confessione constantes.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that the venerable Leodegar, priest and martyr, may exercise us according to sacred institutions and always make us steadfast in pious confession.

text: Da salutem Domine populo tuo mentis et corporis et perpetuis consolationibus tuorum reple corda fidelium ut interius exteriusque relevati et pia tibi devotione complaceant et tua semper beneficia consequantur.
translation_en: Grant peace, Lord, to your people, of mind and body, and with eternal consolations fill the hearts of the faithful, that they may be uplifted within and without, and with pious devotion to you please, and always follow your benefactions.

text: Da tuorum quaesumus Domine habitator aeterne sanctorum ut beati apostoli tui Andreae pretiosa natalicia non solum ministerio corporali sed etiam et mentis veneremur affectu.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, eternal dweller of the saints, that we may honor the precious nativity of your blessed apostle Andrew not only with corporeal ministry but also with affection of mind.

text: Da universis famulis tuis quaesumus Domine plenius atque perfectius omnia paschalis festivitatis introire mysteria ut incunctanter pia corda cognoscant quantum debeant de confirmata in Christo credentium glorificatione gaudere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to fill and perfect all the mysteries of the Paschal festivities for your servants, that with unwavering pious hearts they may fully understand how much those who believe in Christ should rejoice in their confirmation's glory.

text: Da veniam Domine Deus per haec sancta mysteria animae famuli tui illius ut occursu non terreatur malo sed tuo semper protegatur auxilio.
translation_en: Grant forgiveness, Lord God, through these holy mysteries to the soul of your servant that he may not be dismayed by evil but may always be protected by your aid.

text: Da veniam Domine peccatis nostris et medicinalibus sacrificiis expiatos ab omni pravitate defende.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, pardon for our sins and purge us with sacrificial offerings from all wickedness; defend us.

text: Damus tibi Domine noster Iesu Christe gloriam et honorem in paterna aequalitate et in Sancti Spiritus unitate manenti qui nos tam potentialiter redemisti ut et in sanguine tuo a cunctis peccatis elueres et in resurrectionis tuae consortio aeternae beatitudini sociares.
translation_en: We give you, Lord our Jesus Christ, glory and honor with the equal Father and in the unity of the Holy Spirit, who redeemed us so powerfully that we were cleansed from all sins by your blood and made partners in the fellowship of your eternal beatitude in the resurrection.

text: De multitudine misericordiae tuae Domine populum tibi protege confitentem et corporaliter gubernatum piae mentis affectu tuis muneribus assequendis effice promptiorem.
translation_en: From the multitude of your mercy, Lord, protect the people who confess to you and govern the body that is ruled by a pious mind, making it more eager in attaining your favors through your gifts.

text: De profundis clamantium ad te Deus preces et hostias dignanter exaudi et suscipe ut nos de profundo iniquitatis eripias et ad gaudia aeterna perducas.
translation_en:
From the depths I cry to you, O God;
hear my prayer and my offerings graciously,
and deliver us from the depth of wickedness,
and lead us to eternal joy.

text: De supernis angelorum sedibus clementissime Deus ad praesentis hostiae oblationem respice et tuo antistite Paulino interveniente nobis praesentis vitae tranquillitatem tribue et gloriam hereditatis perpetuae.
translation_en: Most graciously, God from the seats of the heavenly angels, look upon our current offering and through your bishop Paul grant us peace in this present life and eternal glory.

text: Debitas omnipotens sempiterne Deus referimus gratias Iesu Christo domino nostro in cuius similitudinem beatissimus Saturninus dum offert victimam ipse fit victima dum sacerdotium electus agit martyrium devotus implevit ut per eminentiam iustitiae atque victoriae et testis fieret et antistes; in quo proficiens fidei latitudo dum cathedram suscipit sanctitatis coronam rapuit passionis. Ita maiestatem tuam Domine supplices exoramus ut qui ci tantam pro nomine tuo praestitisti tolerantiam per eius intercessionem tribuas pro delictis plebi huic veniam.
translation_en: We, the all-powerful eternal God, offer our thanks to Jesus Christ, our Lord, in whose likeness the most blessed Saturninus, while offering the victim himself became the victim. As an elected priest, he fulfilled his martyrdom devotedly. Thus, through eminent justice and victory, he became a witness and a bishop. In this, as he advanced in faith, he hid beneath the chair of sanctity and snatched its crown. So, advancing, we humbly beseech your majesty, O Lord, that you grant forgiveness for this people's sins through his intercession, whom you provided such great endurance for your name.

text: Debitas tibi Domine aeterne referimus gratias et Iesu Christo filio tuo domino nostro in cuius similitudine beatissimus Saturninus dum offert victimam ipse est victima dumque sacerdotium electus agit martyrium devotus implevit ut per eminentiam iustitiae atque victoriae antistes et testis fieret. In quo proficiens fidei latitudo dum cathedram suscepit sanctitatis coronam rapuit passionis. Probus ad officium improbus ad triumphum dum ungitur consectans dum occiditur consecratur; prius fidem praedicans sermone post sanguine; doctor ad altarium victor ad regnum; erexit ad laudem quos erudiit ad salutem; ambulans vere de virtutibus in virtutem ut qui conversatione contulerat intellectum conferat in consummatione suffragium. Obtineat igitur Deus summe apud te dari miseris indulgentiam post delictum qui meruit post sacerdotium subire martyrium.
translation_en: We continuously render thanks to you, Lord, eternal one, and to Jesus Christ, your Son, our Lord, in whose likeness the most blessed Saturninus, while offering the sacrifice, becomes the very victim himself. And when elected as priest, he fulfills his martyrdom devoutly, thus becoming bishop and witness through the eminence of justice and victory. In this progression of faith, when he accepts the chair of sanctity, he seizes the crown of passion. The virtuous one advances to the office, the wicked one to triumph when anointed; when he is killed, he is consecrated; before preaching faith with words, he shows it with blood; a victor at the altar, a king in the realm; he raises those he educates to praise and saves them to salvation. Walking truly from virtues to virtue, he who has directed his life towards virtuousness now grants support in consummation. May God therefore grant mercy to the miserable after sin, who merited to suffer martyrdom after holding the priesthood.

text: Deus qui humanarum animarum
translation_en: God who of human souls

text: Debitum nostrae reddimus servitutis suppliciter exorantes ut suffragiis eius in nobis tua munera tuearis pro cuius honoranda confessione hostiam tibi laudis offerimus.
translation_en: We humbly repay our debt, entreating in servitude, that you preserve your gifts for us through his intercession. For whose honorable confession we offer to you the sacrifice of praise as a token of laud.

text: Debitum Domine nostrae reddimus servitutis suppliciter exorantes ut suffragiis beati apostoli Thomae in nobis tua munera tuearis cuius honorando confessionem laudis tibi hostias immolamus.
translation_en: We pay back our debt to you, Lord, humbly begging as suppliants that through the intercession of blessed apostle Thomas, your gifts may be preserved in us. To whom we honor, we offer sacrifices of confession and praise, lauding you.

text: Debitum tibi Domine nostrae reddimus servitutis obsequium suppliciter deprecantes ut beatae virginis Marcellinae suffragantibus meritis plebis tuae dona sanctifices quia pro eius honorabili inter sanctas virgines confessione laudis tibi hostias immolamus.
translation_en: We pay back to you, Lord, our debt with humble obedience, entreating you that through the merits of the blessed Virgin Marcellina, your people may be granted holy gifts, because we offer you hosts in praise on her honorable confession among the holy virgins.

text: Deduc Domine famulos tuos in via tua et ambulent in virtute tua; non aberrent in malis neque claudicent a semitis tuis ut hac oblatione pro eis suscepta et vivis tua perveniat gratia et sepultis conferat gratiam sempiternam.
translation_en: Lead, O Lord, your servants in your way and let them walk in your power; may they not stray into evil nor limp from your paths, so that this offering accepted on their behalf may reach your grace and bestow eternal grace upon the buried ones.

text: Defende Domine familiam tuam et toto tibi corde prostratam ab hostium tuere formidine nec bona tua difficulter inveniant pro quibus et sancti tui et angelicae tibi supplicant potestates.
translation_en: Defend, Lord, your family and the one who is fully prostrate before you from the dread of the enemy; may they not find difficulty in finding your goods. For these, your saints and the powers of angels implore your strength.

text: Defende Domine plebem tuam in sola tuae misericordiae venia confidentem et intervenientibus sanctis tuis quidquid eidem debetur pro castigatione delicti transeat ad consolationis effectum.
translation_en: Defend, Lord, your people in Your sole mercy, the penitent one who trusts in You. And through the intercession of Your saints, whatever is due for the punishment of sin may pass to an effect of consolation.

text: Defende quaesumus beato illo intercedente Domine Deus istam ab omni adversitate familiam et tibi toto corde prostratam ab hostium propitius tuere clementer insidiis.
translation_en: Defend, we beseech you, O Lord God, that blessed one interceding for us, from every adversity protect this family who is completely prostrate before you with a merciful and loving care, shield them from the traps of their enemies.

text: Defensio tua Domine quaesumus adsit humilibus et iugiter protegat in tua misericordia confidentes ut necessariis quibus indiget humana condicio competenter adiuti ad immortalitatis dona perveniant.
translation_en: We beseech Your defense, Lord, to be present for the humble and constantly protect those who are confident in Your mercy. So that they may be properly assisted according to human condition with necessary help, they may attain the gifts of eternal life.

text: Deferentes altaribus tuis Domine oblationum vota non merita precamur multarum misericordiarum gloriam tuam ut illam quae se omnibus offert si sit qui eam mereatur accipere pietatis tuae bonitatem (ostendas) ut sit rationabile obsequium nostrum et fiat haec oblatio in remissionem peccatorum per viscera misericordiae caritatis divinae faciasque hanc hostiam vivam placentem tibi sanctam ac benedictam.  Referatur in sacrificio iustitiae ex quo in excelsis suavitatis odor adscendat et holocaustum igne fidei ardens per membra populi dividendum {quod} omnium sanctorum nobis patrocinia acquirat et per eorum fortissimas preces firmamenta auxilii caelestis obtineat.
translation_en:
Bringing offerings to Your altars, Lord, we pray with unmerited vows for the glory of your many mercies. May she who offers herself to all be worthy to receive the goodness of your mercy (manifested). Let our service be reasonable and may this offering become a remission of sins through the bowels of your divine mercy. Make this living, pleasing sacrifice holy and blessed before you.
In the sacrifice of justice, may it ascend in the sweet-smelling perfume of the heavens from where it is to be divided among the members of the people, so that the patronage of all saints acquires for us, and through their most powerful prayers, we obtain the foundations of celestial aid.

text: Deficiant (sic) in nobis haec sancta Domine caeleste commercium et mysticae virtutis operentur effectum.
translation_en: Let these holy mysteries, Lord, be lacking in us not; may celestial communion and the working of divine power bring about their effect.

text: Dei patris omnipotentis misericordiam fratres carissimi unanimes postulemus ut quemadmodum gloriosam martyrem suam illam invictae passionis fulgore purpureo decoravit ita eadem interveniente nobis fructum et meritum exhibere dignetur aeternum.
translation_en: We beseech the brothers most dear, let us ask for the mercy of the omnipotent Father of God, that just as the glorious martyr was adorned with a purple radiance of invincible passion, so she may deign to present us with the fruit and merit of her intervention, eternal.

text: Dele quaesumus Domine conscriptum peccati lege chirographum quod in nobis paschali mysterio per resurrectionem tui filii vacuisti.
translation_en: Deliver us, we beseech Thee, Lord, the written decree of sin, the contract under the law, which in the Paschal mystery through Thy Son's resurrection has been voided.

text: Delicias Domine mirabiles mensae caelestis ambimus quibus ieiunando copiosius saginamur.
translation_en: We eagerly seek, Lord, the marvelous delights of your heavenly feast, through which we are more abundantly nourished while fasting.

text: Deus qui illuminas noctem et lumen post tenebras
translation_en: God who enlightens the night and brings light after darkness

text: Deliciis salutaribus quos refecisti Domine beato Leodegario intercedente aeternae famis et sitis numquam permittas iniuriam sustinere.
translation_en: With the saving delights that you have restored, Lord, through the intercession of the blessed Leodegar, may we never suffer injustice to endure eternal hunger and thirst.

text: Deus qui in Abrahae famuli tui opere
translation_en: God who was in Abraham's servant's work

text: Delicta Domine quaesumus miseratus absolve et aquarum subsidia praebe caelestium quibus terrena condicio vegetata subsistat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you, in your mercy, forgive our sins and provide the aid of waters from heaven, through which the earthly condition is sustained by the growth of plants.

text: Delicta nostra Domine quibus adversa dominantur absterge et tua nos ubique miseratione custodi.
translation_en: Lord, wash away our sins whereby we are ruled by adversity, and protect us everywhere with your merciful care.

text: Deprecamur immensam maiestatem tuam omnipotens Deus ut hanc oblationem quam pro famulo tuo in conspectu pietatis tuae offerimus benignus accipias et eum benedicere et conservare atque exaudire digneris et necessitatibus eius tam in corpore quam in anima clemens succurras.
translation_en: We beseech your boundless majesty, Almighty God, that this offering which we present to you on behalf of your servant, you may be gracious to receive and bless and conserve and hear. And that, mercifully, you may succor his needs both in body and soul.

text: Deprecamur maiestatem tuam omnipotens Deus ut famulum tuum illum benedicere et conservare digneris pacemque perpetuam ei cum omnibus tribuas ut sectans quae pacis sunt ambulare mereatur per semitam veritatis.
translation_en: We entreat Your majesty, Almighty God, that You deign to bless and preserve Your servant, and grant him eternal peace with all; that he may deserve to walk in the path of truth while following what brings peace.

text: Deprecatio Domine beatissimi Cuthberti qui se ipsum fecit hostiam vivam nos et haec tibi gratificet libamina.
translation_en: Prayer to the most blessed Cuthbert, who made himself a living sacrifice for us. May these offerings please you.

text: Deprecatio nostra quaesumus omnipotens Deus ante conspectum maiestatis tuae appareat quam pro famulo tuo illo in honorem sanctorum tuorum cum oblatione pro peccatis eius offerimus; vota perfice; petitiones eius ascendant ad aures clementiae tuae et descendat super eum benedictio tua ut sub umbra alarum tuarum auxilio protegatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that before the sight of your majesty our prayer appears for your servant there, as we offer an oblation in honor of your saints for his sins; may his vows be fulfilled; may his petitions ascend to the ears of your mercy and let your blessing descend upon him so that he may be protected under the shadow of your altars with your aid.

text: Deprecationem nostram quaesumus Domine benignus exaudi et quibus supplicandi praestas affectum tribue defensionis auxilium.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, may your gracious hearing attend our prayer and grant us the aid of defense for which we plead.

text: Deprime quaesumus Domine Deus iura tyrannorum tibi adversantium ut discant te fore protectorem Ecclesiae tuae tuo pretioso sanguine redemptae.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord God, to bring down the power of the tyrants who oppose You, so that they may learn that You are the protector of Your Church, redeemed by Your precious blood.

text: Descendat Domine de sedibus tuis benedictio tua qua et nostri ieiunii oblatio sanctificetur et te haec libamina benedicente a nobis sanctificata sumantur.
translation_en: May the blessing of the Lord descend from His throne, and may this offering we make during our fasting be sanctified. May these libations, blessed by us, be received as sanctified.

text: Descendat Domine in his sacrificiis tuae benedictionis coaeternus et cooperator paraclitus spiritus ut oblationem quam tibi de tua terra fructificante porrigimus caelesti permutatione te sanctificante sumamus ut translata fruge in corpore calice in cruore proficiat meritis quod obtulimus pro delictis.
translation_en: May the Lord come down upon your sacrifices, eternal giver of blessings and co-worker Paraclete, spirit that He may transform the offering we present to you from fertile earth into heavenly change, sanctifying it as He does. That it may advance with fruit in the chalice in the blood, through the merits which we have offered for sins.

text: Descendat precamur omnipotens Deus super haec quae tibi offerimus verbum tuum sanctum descendat inaestimabilis gloriae tuae spiritus descendat antiquae indulgentiae tuae donum ut fiat oblatio haec hostia spiritalis in odorem suavitatis accepta; etiam nos famulos tuos per sanguinem Christi tua manus dextera invicta custodiat.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, that your holy Word may descend upon these gifts we offer. May the inestimable glory of your spirit descend. May the gift be accepted from the ancient indulgence of your grace, so that this spiritual offering be made sweet-smelling. Furthermore, may your right hand, invincible through Christ's blood, protect us, your servants.

text: Deus qui in omnibus Ecclesiae tuae filiis
translation_en: God who is in all of Your Church's sons

text: Descendat quaesumus Domine Deus noster Spiritus Sanctus tuus super hoc altare qui et populi tui dona sanctificet et sumentium corda dignanter emundet.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O Lord our God, that Your Holy Spirit descend upon this altar, so that it may sanctify Your people and cleanse worthy hearts.

text: Desiderantes Christe Deus ad tuae passionis gaudia pervenire supplices quaesumus tuam pietatem ut nostrorum ieiuniorum devotionem accipiens ab omni nos peccato purifices quo a nobis ira odii simulationibusque remotis tuae mereamur absque confusione sumere calicem passionis.
