translation_en: Desiring to reach the joys of Your Passion, Lord Christ, we humbly ask that You receive our devotion from our fasting and purify us from all sin. May our anger, hatred, and deceit be removed, so that we may worthily take the cup of Your Passion without confusion.

text: Deum creatorem et redemptorem nostrum qui in carne quam sumpsit de virgine pro totius mundi salute admirabilis hostia immolatus est in crucis altare et propter expellendum venenum quod in Adam fuerat suasione serpentis infusum pretiosi sanguinis porrexit antidotum ut criminis antiqui peccatum tam novo sacrificio purgaretur et mors quae processit gustando de scientiae ligno moreretur per lignum supplices deprecamur ut qui nos quos eripuit de inferno <redemit> per huius signi patibulum eiusdem protectione perducat ad regnum.
translation_en: We call upon the Creator and Redeemer of our God, who was miraculously slain on the cross as a wonderful sacrifice for the salvation of the entire world in flesh that He took from the Virgin. He offered an antidote to the poison infused in Adam by the serpent's persuasion by bestowing precious blood, so that the ancient sin might be purged by this new offering and death that came by tasting the knowledge of the tree might die on the wooden cross through supplication. We humbly ask that He who has redeemed us from hell through His passion, may lead us to His kingdom under His same protection through this sign of His cross.

text: Deum cui acceptiora sunt vota fidelium quam munera fratres carissimi supplices deprecemur ut hanc oblationem famuli sui illius dignanter accipiat; tribuat ei magna.  pro parvis pro temporalibus praemia sempiterna; det ei auxilium seu praesidium gratiae suae ut quod humiliter implorat domino largiente suscipiat.
translation_en: We humbly beseech the God to whom faithful vows are more acceptable than the gifts of our dearest brethren, that He may graciously accept this offering of His servant; may He grant him abundant rewards, both for small and temporal ones eternal prizes. Grant him aid or protection through His grace, so that what he humbly asks from the Lord, being bountifully given, he may receive.

text: Deus cui accepta sunt vota fidelium suppliciter exoro ut vota mea dignanter accipias; tribue mihi quaeso magna pro parvis caelestia pro terrenis pro temporalibus praemia sempiterna; da mihi auxilium tuum et praesidium ut quod deprecor obtineam et quod humiliter imploro te largiente suscipiam.
translation_en: I humbly beseech the God to whom the vows of the faithful have been offered, that He may graciously receive my vows; I beg You to grant me great things in return for small ones, heavenly things in return for earthly ones, temporary rewards for eternal ones. Grant me Your aid and protection, so that I may obtain what I pray for and receive what I humbly ask of you, with Your generous favor.

text: Deum cui acceptiora sunt vota quam munera fratres carissimi exoremus ut votum servi sui illius dignanter accipiat; tribuat ei divitias gratiae suae; ab omnibus periculis eum liberari iubeat tueatur ac defendat protegat et confortet diebus ac noctibus horis atque momentis; det ei auxilii sui praesidium iuxta evangelicam vocem ut quod precatur obtineat et quod impetraverit agnoscat.
translation_en: We entreat the God to whom more acceptable are vows than gifts, our most dear brothers, that He may worthily accept the vow of His servant; grant him the riches of His grace; order him to be freed from all perils, protect, defend, shield and comfort him day and night, in hours and moments; give him the protection of Your help according to the evangelical voice, so that what he asks for may be granted and what he has asked for may be recognized.

text: Deus cui acceptiora sunt vota quam munera te suppliciter deprecamur ut votum servi tui illius dignanter accipias; tribuas ei divitias gratiae tuae; ab omnibus periculis eum liberari iubeas tuearis ac defendas protegas et confortes diebus ac noctibus horis atque momentis; des ei auxilii tui praesidium iuxta evangelicam vocem ut quod precatur obtineat et quod impetraverit agnoscat.
translation_en: We humbly pray to the God to whom all acceptable vows are offered, that he may graciously receive the vow of his servant; grant him the riches of your grace; order him to be freed from every danger and protect, guard, defend, and comfort him day and night in hours and moments; give him the protection of your help as the evangelical voice says, so that what he asks for may be granted and what he has asked for he may recognize.

text: Deum cuius cultui deputatur quidquid sanctis eius honoris impenditur intenta oratione poscimus ut hunc diem quem sancti et praecipui viri Martini episcopi illustrat excessio celebrem nobis et posteris indulgeat tribuatque ut cuius veneratores sumus et imitatores esse mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask the God to whom is devoted whatever honor is bestowed upon His saints, with focused prayer, to graciously grant us and our posterity to celebrate this day, illuminated by the departure of the holy and foremost bishop Martin, and to bestow and make worthy for us who are his venerators and imitators.

text: Deum ineffabilis potentiae (et) bonitatis immensae fratres carissimi deprecemur ut sacerdotes clerum ac populum suum visitet et tueatur; illuminet totam plebem suam illa qua redemit pietate <et> sua miseratione conservet.
translation_en: We humbly beseech the ineffable power and immense goodness of our dear brothers (God), that they visit, protect, enlighten and keep safe the priests, clergy, and people under their care. May they preserve them with the love with which they redeemed us and by their mercy.

text: Deum patrem omnipotentem fratres carissimi supplices exoramus pro fide ecclesiarum pro concordia sacerdotum pro gratia ministrorum pro pace temporum pro quiete principum pro mansuetudine iudicum pro integritate virginum pro caritate continentium pro consolatione orphanorum pro sanitate languentium pro reparatione lapsorum pro redemptione captivorum pro sanitate navigantium pro absolutione vitiorum pro conservatione errantium pro indulgentia paenitentium pro salubritate aerum pro fecunditate terrarum pro requie defunctorum per advocatum spei nostrae Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum.
translation_en: We humbly entreat our most dear brothers, the almighty God, Father, for the faith of the churches, for the harmony of the priests, for the grace of ministers, for peace in times, for calm among rulers, for mildness of judges, for integrity of virgins, for chastity of continent ones, for comfort of orphans, for health of the sick, for restoration of sinners, for redemption of captives, for health of sailors, for forgiveness of sins, for protection of wanderers, for mercy of penitents, for health of the atmosphere, for fertility of lands, for rest of the deceased through our Advocate, the Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Deum qui beato Petro tantam potestatem discipulo contulit ut si ipse ligaverit non sit alter qui solverit et quae in terra solverit item caelo soluta sint precibus imploremus ut eductis a tartaro defunctorum spiritibus non praevaleant sepultis inferni portae per crimina quas per apostoli fide vinci credit ecclesia.
translation_en: We ask you, the God who granted such great power to the blessed Peter that if he binds anyone, no one else can loosen it, and what is bound on earth will also be unbound in heaven through prayers. We implore you to help those departed spirits drawn from Tartarus not to prevail against the sealed gates of hell due to sins, which according to the faith of the apostles are believed to be conquered by the church.

text: Deus qui invisibili potentia sacramentorum
translation_en: God who with invisible power consecrates the sacraments

text: Deum qui nos sanctorum Quirici et Iulittae (sollemnitate laetificat) deprecemur fratres carissimi et hoc die celeberrimo ipsorum et universorum prosequentium gaudia populorum concordi oratione poscamus ut qui primitivum filium et unicum matris in martyrii consummatione suscepit ipse haec sacrificia in hoc die insigne sollemnitatis placatus accipiat et sicut idem beatus vir seu mater eius cum apostolis et martyribus associati simul gaudent in caelo ita nos famulos suos eruat ab inferno. Dubium enim non est quin sit martyr in caelo qui fuit confessor in saeculo. Ipse ad te preces nostras petitor deferat ipse nobis placabilitatem tuam intercessor obtineat.
translation_en: We beseech you, the God who gladdens us on the feast day of Saints Cyrus and Julitta (Quirici et Iulittae), our dear brothers, that today, this most celebrated day of theirs and all those following in their footsteps, we may seek joyful communal prayer. May he who received the primal Son and only child in the completion of martyrdom on that day, be pleased with these sacrifices on this day of great solemnity, and just as the blessed man or his mother, united with apostles and martyrs, rejoice in heaven, may he free his servants from hell. For it is certain that there is a martyr in heaven who was a confessor in the world. May he carry our prayers to you, may he obtain for us your favor as an intercessor.

text: Deum qui pro ruina totius mundi unicum filium suum assumpta ex carne virginis veri hominis forma mittere dignatus est fratres carissimi suppliciter exoremus ut sicut in hac resurrectione eiusdem nos a morte perpetua cum illo resuscitavit ita pietatis suae dono ab omnibus nos inimici tutans insidiis illaesos faciat in matris ecclesiae gremio residere et conscientiae integritate de regeneratione gaudentes aeternae primitivorum ecclesiae quemadmodum devotione ad praesens ita et remuneratione associet in aeternum et haec munera plebis suae benedicere dignetur.
translation_en: We humbly entreat the God who, for the ruin of the entire world, deemed it worthy to send his only Son, assuming flesh from the virgin, in the form of true man. May he make us rise from eternal death with him, as he did in this resurrection. May he, by the gift of his mercy, protect us from all enemies and keep us safe from their plots within the bosom of the mother church, where we rejoice with integrity of conscience for our regeneration. May he associate us with eternal devotion, as we are now devoted to him, and may he bestow these gifts on his people forever. May he deem it worthy to bless these offerings.

text: Deum qui sanctae famulae suae Eulaliae gloriosam et immarcescibilem coronam martyrii contulit fratres carissimi supplices deprecemur ut praestante divina misericordia ipsius precibus obtineamus veniam qui gloriam non meremur. Caris etiam nostris qui nos in somno pacis praecesserunt perennis aevi beatitudinem et perpetuae lucis gratiam remunerare dignetur.
translation_en: We beseech the brothers, our dearest ones, that with the brotherhood of the glorious and unfading crown bestowed upon the holy servant Eulalia through divine mercy, we may obtain forgiveness for ourselves who do not deserve glory. We also pray for those dear to us who preceded us in sleep, that they may receive eternal beatitude and the grace of perpetual light.

text: Deum qui sanctificavit Iordanis fluenta benedixit coniugia nuptialium fratres carissimi deprecemur ut cuius miracula annuis recolimus vicibus sola eius gratia mereamur indulgentiam peccatorum.
translation_en: We entreat the God who sanctified the flowing waters of Jordan and blessed the nuptial unions, our most dear brothers, that we, remembering His miracles annually, may through His grace alone deserve the forgiveness of sins.

text: Deus a quo bona cuncta procedunt largire supplicibus ut cogitemus te inspirante quae recta sunt et te gubernante eadem faciamus.
translation_en: God from whom all good things proceed, grant your mercy to the supplicants, that we may remember you inspiring us with what is right and making the same through your guidance.

text: Deus a quo et Iudas reatus sui poenam et confessionis suae latro praemium sumpsit concede nobis tuae propitiationis effectum ut sicut passione sua Christus Dominus noster diversa utrisque intulit stipendia meritorum ita nobis ablato vetustatis errore resurrectionis suae gratiam largiatur.
translation_en: God from whom Judas took the penalty of his guilt and the thief on the cross took the reward of his confession, grant us the effect of your propitiation, so that just as our Lord Christ distributed rewards differently according to His passion, may He grant us the grace of His resurrection, freeing us from the error of ancient times.

text: Deus a quo Iudas proditor reatus sui poenam suscepit et latro confessionis suae praemium sumpsit concede nobis piae petitionis effectum ut misericordiae tuae veniam consequamur.
translation_en: God from whom Judas the traitor received the penalty of his guilt and the thief the reward of his confession, grant us the effect of our pious petition that we may follow in the footsteps of your mercy by obtaining forgiveness.

text: Deus a quo inspiratur humanis cordibus omne quod bonum est sicut animae famuli tui paenitentiam velle donasti sic indulgentiam tribue miseratus optatam.
translation_en: God, from whom every good thing is inspired in human hearts, as you have given the desire for penance to your servant souls, grant him mercy and bestow the longed-for indulgence.

text: Deus a quo speratur humano corpori omne quod bonum est tribue per haec sancta quaesumus ut sicut animae famuli tui illius paenitentiam velle donasti sic indulgentiam tribuas miseratus optatam.
translation_en: God from whom every good thing is hoped for in human nature, grant through these holy things that we ask, so just as you have given your servants' souls the will to repentance, may you also grant mercy, merciful one, as desired.

text: Deus qui iustis supplicationibus semper praesto es qui pia vota
translation_en: God who is always present for just supplications, who grants pious vows

text: Deus a quo sancta desideria recta consilia et iusta sunt opera da servis tuis illam quam mundus dare non potest pacem ut et corda mandatis tuis dedita et hostium sublata formidine tempora sint tua protectione tranquilla.
translation_en: God, from whom holy desires, right counsels and just works are, grant peace to your servants, that their hearts may be dedicated to your commands and the fear of enemies removed; let there be a peaceful time under your protection.

text: Deus a quo sancta desideria et iusta sunt opera da famulis tuis illam quam dare mundus non potest perpetuam pacem ut et corda mandatis tuis dedita et tempora hostium sublata formidine tua sint protectione tranquilla.
translation_en: God, from whom holy desires and just works are the operation for your servants, grant them that peace which the world cannot give, a peaceful heart devoted to your commandments and a lifted fear of enemies' times under your quiet protection.

text: Deus a quo speratur omne bonum tribue quaesumus ut haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus nobis proficiant ad salutem et animabus quae singulares non habent apud te intercessores pro quibus tuam deprecamur clementiam prosint ad peccatorum indulgentiam et requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: God, from whom all good things come, we humbly ask that these sacraments which we have received may benefit us for our salvation, and for the souls who do not have specific intercessors before you, we implore your mercy to be of help in the forgiveness of sins and eternal rest.

text: Deus Abraham Deus Isaac Deus Iacob Deus et pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi tu de caelis tuis propitius affavens hoc sacrificium nostrum indulgentissima pietate prosequere. Descendat Domine plenitudo maiestatis divinitatis pietatis virtutis benedictionis et gloriae tuae super hunc panem et super hunc calicem et fiat nobis legitima eucharistia in transformatione corporis et sanguinis domini ut quicumque et quotiescumque ex hoc pane et ex hoc calice libaverimus sumamus nobis monimentum fidei sinceram dilectionem tranquillam spem resurrectionis atque immortalitatis aeternae in tuo filiique tui ac Spiritus Sancti nomine in communione omnium sanctorum <et> remissionem omnium nostrorum criminum. Credimus Domine quod haec nobis indefessa credulitate poscentibus praestabis.
translation_en: God of Abraham, God of Isaac, God of Jacob, God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, you who are in the heavens, be mercifully inclined towards this our sacrifice. May the fullness of your majesty, divinity, piety, power, blessing, and glory descend upon this bread and this cup, and let this be for us a legitimate Eucharist through the transformation of the body and blood of the Lord. That whosoever and whenever we receive from this bread and this cup, we may have a true memorial of faith, a peaceful love, a hope of resurrection and eternal immortality in your name, and that of your Son and of the Holy Spirit. In communion with all the saints, let there be remission of all our sins. We believe, Lord, that you will grant this to us unceasingly, as we ask it with unfailing faith.

text: Deus abstinentiae Deus castimoniae qui libenter ieiunantium humilitate placaris et humiliantium se precibus benignus inflecteris exaudi preces nostras in hac hodierna die qua quadragesimale inchoamus ieiunium et diversarum temptationum quibus gravamur tempestate discussa continentiam nobis a vitiis tua benignitate infunde.
translation_en: God of abstinence, God of chastity, who delightfully pleases those who fast with humility and are kind to those who humble themselves in prayer. Bend favourably towards our prayers on this day as we begin the Lenten fast, and pour your benevolence upon us to strengthen our self-control amidst various temptations that weigh upon us during this stormy time. Infuse us with your goodness from your benignity.

text: Deus ad quem digne laudandum angelica natura non sufficit nec humana pro impensis fragilitati nostrae immensis beneficiis maiestati tuae votis omnibus gratias agimus qui cum servi simus peccati resuscepti adoptionis amplectimur filii et cum simus mortis socii pro sceleribus damnandi pie castigati solita misericordia reerigimur consolandi tribue quaesumus ut quos creasti ad aeternitatis gloriam a noxiis liberans te incessabiliter laudando facias de hoste captare victoriam.
translation_en: To God to whom worthy praise does not suffice for the angelic nature nor for human efforts due to our frailty's immense benefits, we give thanks with all our vows. Who, while we are servants of sin, embrace us in adoption as sons, and while we are associates of death, we are piously chastised for our sins. By your usual mercy, revive us to console us. We humbly ask that you grant the one whom you have created for the glory of eternity, freedom from sin, so that by constantly praising you, we might capture victory over our enemy.

text: Deus aeterne atque misericors maiestatem tuam supplices imploramus ut vivat in nobis atque permaneat tuorum dilectio mandatorum quo abstinentiae purificatione idonei et praecepta in omnibus impleamus et haec libamina a te sanctificata sumamus.
translation_en: We eternally and mercifully beseech Your majesty that love for Your commandments may dwell within us and remain, that we may be fit for the purification of abstinence and fulfill all precepts in all things. These offerings, sanctified by You, we receive.

text: Deus aeterne cui beatissima Dorothea virgo praevios conquisitionis suae manipulos destinavit cum Christetem et Callixtem sorores ante se in passione praemiserat et sic ipsa gladio consecrata successerit tu de tuis sanctis sedibus benedictionem his holocaustis impertiens concede supplicibus tuis ut haec oblatio praevia sanctificationem sumentibus conferat quo exemplo virginis tuae ita nostrorum actuum placitos tibi fructus ante nostrum obitum pius ipse suscipias ut nos sequentes in aeterna tabernacula introducas.
translation_en: Eternal God, to whom the blessed Dorothea, virgin, had dedicated the preceding fruits of her conquests together with Christena and Callixte, her sisters, before her passion, and who was consecrated by a sword and succeeded them; we humbly ask you to grant that these holy offerings, through which those following the example of your virgin may receive a previous sanctification, may be bestowed upon your supplicants. May the pious self himself accept as fruit of our actions before his own departure, so that he introduces us, who follow in this manner, into the eternal tabernacles.

text: Deus aeterne cuius gratia protecta virgo Eulalia inter flammas non erubuit confiteri quod ex flamma tui amoris haurire promeruit tu nos eius precatu inter mundi huius flammarum procellosa discrimina protege et tuae pacis multiplici incremento adimple quo hic bene vivamus et ad te de hac vita remuneraturi secura conscientia properemus.
translation_en: Eternal God, whose grace protected the Virgin Eulalia, she did not blush to confess within the flames that she had promised to draw from your love's flame. Protect us through her prayer, amidst this world's stormy fires of trial. Grant us an abundant increase of your peace, so that we may live here well and, with a secure conscience, be rewarded for this life with you.

text: Deus aeterne Deus caeli terraeque creator et rector qui mundum universum propria dicione gubernas quique aulam intemeratae virginis Mariae pro instauratione generis humani penetrare voluisti concede propitius ut intercessione eiusdem beatae gloriosaeque Mariae et ab universis expediat periculis et a cunctis vinculis peccatorum meorum absolvar.
translation_en: Eternal God, creator and ruler of heaven and earth, who govern the universe with your own word, and who willed to enter the unstained temple of the Virgin Mary for the restoration of the human race. Graciously grant that through her intercession and that of the blessed and glorious Mary, I may be delivered from all dangers, freed from all perils and absolved from all my sins.

text: Deus aeterne quaesumus et rogamus ut famula tua Caecilia apud te exaudiri mereatur pro coetu omni christiano quae suo exaudita est pro sponso ut per eam tam vivi quam defuncti levamen obtineant indulgentiae per quam sponsus eius fidei tuae meruit cognoscere veritatem.
translation_en: Eternally, we humbly ask and beseech you, O God, that your servant Caecilia may be worthy to be heard by you, among all the Christian congregation, for whom she interceded for her spouse. May both the living and the dead obtain relief through her, and may they receive indulgence, through which her spouse merited to know the truth of your faith.

text: Deus aeterne quem in veritate fidei sitiunt animae nostrae sitientem velut terram servi tui illius animam caelestis roris perfusione refrigera quo tristis loci habitatione mutata supernae regionis mereatur iucundari in patria.
translation_en: Eternal God, whom our souls long for in the truth of faith like a thirsty servant longs for the land, refresh that soul with the sprinkling of heavenly dew so that, changed from its sad dwelling place, it may deserve to enjoy the happiness of the higher regions in the homeland.

text: Deus aeterne Domine Iesu qui tuo pretioso sanguine nos redemisti te suppliciter deprecor ut quem corpore et sanguine tuo satiasti plus numquam quam mea fragilitas sustinere potest temptari permittas etiamsi aliquid diabolus suggesserit me consensum praebere pro tua pietate non patiaris et a carnis petulantia seu lascivia vel immunditia atque ab omnibus vitiis insidiisque sive astutiis inimicorum custodire et liberare me digneris.
translation_en: Eternal God, Lord Jesus, who redeemed us with your precious blood, I humbly ask you that what my frailty can barely endure may not be tested by you, even if the devil suggests that I give consent for it. For your sake, I will not suffer anything; and from carnal impudence or lewdness, or uncleanness, and from all sins and tricks or deceits of the enemy, protect and deliver me.

text: Deus aeterni triumphator imperii familiam tuam propitius respice martyrium regis celebrantem Edwardi et praesta ut sicut illum munere glorificate dignaris caelesti ita nos eius obtentu aeternae felicitati facias dignanter adscribi.
translation_en: Eternal triumphator, may your family graciously look upon the martyrdom of King Edward being celebrated. Grant that, just as he is glorified by a heavenly gift, so we may be worthy to be ascribed to eternal happiness through his intercession.

text: Deus qui mirabiliter creasti hominem
translation_en: God who marvelously created man

text: Deus amator castitatis quem tota devotione beata virgo Mildretha dilexit in terris concede quaesumus ut eius sanctis intercedentibus meritis te semper hic et in aevum mereamur habere propitium.
translation_en: God, lover of chastity, whom the blessed virgin Mildretha loved with all devotion on earth, we humbly ask that through the merits of his holy intercession, we may always deserve to have you here and forevermore be favorable towards us.

text: Deus amplius ineffabilis quam inaestimabilis concede nobis unde te aestimemus quantum de te natura humana sufficit ut enarrare possimus. Adspira placatus votis et sacrificiis omnium et qui in die crucis et passionis tuae sanctorum quiescentium de sepulchris corpora suscitasti non permittas ab inferno inferiori fidelium animas detineri sed in tuorum requie electorum facias conlaetari.
translation_en: O God, who art more incomprehensible than inestimable, grant us wherewith to measure thee as much as human nature suffices for us to enumerate. Breathe favorably upon our wishes and sacrifices, and all those who on the day of thy cross and passion lay sleeping in their graves, whom thou didst raise from the sepulchers, let not the souls of the faithful be detained by the lower hell, but make them rejoice in the rest of thy elect.

text: Deus antiqua exspectatio gentium qui oracula prophetarum in luce evangelii posuisti qui languores nostros curaturus caelestis medicus advenisti nam quis te posset agnoscere nisi ipse voluisses agnosci tribue quaesumus ut communicatio praesentis osculi perpetuae proficiat caritati.
translation_en: God, ancient expectation of the nations, who placed the prophecies in the light of the gospel, who came as a heavenly physician to heal our infirmities; who could recognize you except yourself wishing to be recognized? We humbly ask that the communion of this present kiss may perpetually profit love.

text: Deus apostolorum Deus martyrum Deus confessorum Deus virginum Deus omnium electorum te suppliciter exoramus ut hanc hostiam sanctam in honorem sancti Sampsonis episcopi sanctificare et benedicere digneris et ante conspectum maiestatis tuae tam ad corporum sanitatem quam ad animarum proficiat salutem.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, God of apostles, God of martyrs, God of confessors, God of virgins, God of all the elect, to sanctify and bless this holy offering in honor of Saint Sampson, bishop. May it bring both physical health for the body and spiritual profit for the soul before the sight of your majesty.

text: Deus apud quem beati martyris Quirici continuata festivitas et aeterna celebritas et caelestis triumphi perpetuus est natalis nos tamen beatae confessionis initia recolentes frequenti tribue devotione venerari ut celebrior honor impensus sacratissime nobis prosit ad gratiam.
translation_en: God in whom the continuous feast and eternal festivity, and perpetual triumph of the blessed martyr Quiricus is natal, let us recall the beginning of our blessed confession, and let us frequently offer devotion to venerate Him, so that a more honorable grace may be bestowed upon us.

text: Deus apud quem est misericordia copiosa effice nos tibi vasa mundissima et spiritalibus deliciis refice infirmitatem nostram ut corda nostra te semper esuriant atque sitiant et vota nostrae humilitatis clament.
translation_en: May the God in whom there is abundant mercy make us vessels most clean unto You, and refresh our weakness with spiritual delights, so that our hearts may always hunger and thirst for You, and may our humble prayers be heard loudly.

text: Deus auctor mundi et conditor qui hodiernae festivitatis diem beati Ambrosii sacerdotis electione consecrasti praesta populo tuo ut cuius annua celebritate devotis resultat obsequiis eius suffragiis tuae pietatis consequatur auxilium.
translation_en: God, author of the world and creator, who on this day consecrated by the election of the blessed Ambrose the priest, grant to your people that they may attain help through his annual devotions and obedience. May his intercession bring about assistance from Your pity.

text: Deus auctor omnium et conditor creaturarum qui et circumcisionem ex fide et praeputium per fidem iustificare dignatus es tu Ecclesiam tuam quae ex circumcisione vel praeputio veniens in te solidata consistit litatione hostiae huius et vitiis facito circumcidi et spiritali laetitia innovari benedicens et nobis famulis tuis et his sacrificiis tibi oblatis qui solus pro cunctis factus hostia immolaris.
translation_en: God, author of all and creator of creatures, who deigned to justify circumcision through faith and the uncircumcised through faith, you who have established your Church that comes to you from circumcision or uncircumcision solidified in faith, bless this offering of a hostia and make us and those who offer these sacrifices to you circumcised spiritually and renewed with spiritual joy. Blessing us, your servants, and these sacrifices offered to you, you alone who were made an offering for all, immolate.

text: Deus auctor omnium iustorum honorum dator cunctarum dignitatum et piorum gratissimus conservator imperiorum respice super famulum tuum illum et praesta ut quibus dono tuo imperat eis tua opitulatione fultus salubriter prosit.
translation_en: God, author of all the honors of the righteous, giver of all dignities and most gracious conserver of empires, look upon your servant and grant that he who is commanded by your gift may prosper through your help.

text: Deus auctor pacis et amator quem nosse vivere cui servire regnare est protege ab omnibus impugnationibus supplices tuos ut qui in defensione tua fidimus nullius hostilitatis arma timeamus.
translation_en: God, the author of peace and lover, whom to know is to live, to serve is to reign, protect us from all attacks. We humbly ask you that we who trust in your protection may fear no weapons of any hostility.

text: Deus auctor sincerae devotionis et pacis da quaesumus ut et maiestatem tuam convenienter hoc munere veneremur et sacri participatione mysterii fideliter sensibus uniamur.
translation_en: God, author of sincere devotion and peace, grant us what we ask, that we may reverently honor your majesty with this service and be united in the faithful senses by the sacramental participation of the mystery.

text: Deus bonarum actionum et inspirator et doctor qui voluptate per inediam ieiunii corporalis restricta agnitionem tuam nostris cordibus tribuis da nobis fidei spei et caritatis augmentum ut per sanctificationem ieiunii tuum in nobis sit templum quod praemium fiat aeternum et nomina quae vocabulorum sunt pro aetatibus memorata aeternitatis titulo iubeas praesignari.
translation_en: God of good actions, inspirer and teacher, who grants recognition of you through the restriction of pleasure by physical fasting, grant us an increase in faith, hope, and charity. May there be an augmentation of your sanctification within us, so that our bodies become a temple worthy of eternal reward. Furthermore, let the names which are remembered for the ages called eternity be marked with the title of eternity.

text: Deus bonitatis auctor et bonorum omnium dispensator qui temporalia bona per misericordiam tuam etiam non merentibus donas et aeterna per iustitiam tuam non nisi merentibus recompensas ista deputans beneficio illa iudicio ne aut largitatem suam divina benignitas minoraret si a praesentibus donis sequestrarentur ingrati aut sollicitudinem placendi incuriositas humana neglegeret si ad futura praemia admitterentur indigni ... Unde nos Domine ad huius sapientiae tuae fontem currimus de quo <per> confessorem tuum Antonium velut quoddam sanctificationis tuae hauritorium bona tua quibus adimplere cupimus hauriamus.
translation_en: God, author of goodness and dispenser of all good things, who gives temporal goods even to those who do not deserve them through Your mercy, and repays eternal goods only to those who deserve them according to Your justice - You set these benefits against these judgments so that Your divine benevolence would not be diminished if the ungrateful were to seize Your present gifts or if human carelessness neglected the effort to please if they were admitted to future rewards unworthy. Therefore, Lord, we run to the source of Your wisdom from which, through Your confessor Anthony, we are like some drawers of Your sanctification, drawing Your goods with which we desire to fulfill.

text: Deus bonorum omnium copia et sanctorum indeficiens caritas praesta nobis omnibus in bona voluntate concordiam ut tua semper pacifici sequamur praecepta.
translation_en: God, the abundance of all good things and the inexhaustible charity of saints, grant us all harmony in a good will that we may always follow your peaceful precepts.

text: Deus bonorum omnium distributor da nobis beati Raphaelis angeli praesidiis ita fulciri ut praesentis vitae excursum cum ipsius praesidio illaesi valeamus peragere ac perpetuis gaudiis admisceri.
translation_en: God, the distributor of all goods, grant us the protection of blessed Raphael the angel, that we may safely traverse the course of this life under his guard and be admitted to eternal joys with it unharmed.

text: Deus caelestium terrestrium et infernorum qui superna contines et inferna moderaris adesto oranti et deprecanti maiestatem tuam populo tuo et da ut haec piae oblationis officia et beatitudinem vivis et remissionem mortuis consequantur.
translation_en: God of the heavens, earth and underworld who contain the heavens and govern the underworld, be present to the one praying and appealing for your majesty, and grant that this people may experience the office and beatitude of these pious offerings and attain remission for the dead.

text: Deus caritatis et pacis qui pro salute generis humani crucis patibulum sustulisti et sanguinem tuum pro redemptione nostra fudisti preces nostras placatus et benignus suscipe et hoc sacrificium quod gratiae tuae offero sereno vultu digneris respicere et misericordiam tuam mihi concedas ut cum de corpore me exire iusseris pars iniqua in me non habeat potestatem sed angelus tuus inter sanctos et electos tuos me collocet ubi lux permanet et vita regnat in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: God of love and peace, who took up the cross for the salvation of the human race and poured out your blood for our redemption, hear our prayers graciously and kindly. Please accept this sacrifice I offer to you with a serene countenance, and grant me your mercy so that when you command my soul to depart from my body, an unjust part does not have power over me. Instead, let your angel place me among the saints and chosen ones of yours where light endures and life reigns for endless centuries.

text: Deus caritatis indultor Deus indulgentiae munerator qui sancto martyri tuo Stephano in passione largitus es ut imbrem lapidum clementer exciperet et pro lapidantibus supplicaret pietatem tuam Domine subnixis precibus exoramus ut dum martyris tui passionem recolimus per intercessionem ipsius pacis securitatem cum peccatorum nostrorum venia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God, bestower of grace and giver of mercy, who granted your saintly martyr Stephen in his passion to mercifully bear the shower of stones and intercede for those who were stoning him. We humbly ask you, Lord, through his prayers that as we recall the passion of your martyred one, we may merit peace and security with forgiveness for our sins through his intercession.

text: Deus castitatis amator et continentiae conservator supplicationem nostram benignus exaudi et hanc famulam tuam illam propitius intuere et quae pro timore tuo continentiae pudicitiam vovit tuo auxilio conservetur ut sexagesimum fructum continentiae et vitam aeternam te largiente percipiat.
translation_en: Gracious God, lover of chastity and guardian of continence, kindly hear our supplication. Favorably look upon your servant and let her who vowed continence and modesty out of reverence for you be protected by your aid. May she receive the fruit of sixty years of continence and eternal life, bestowed by you.

text: Deus conditor et reparator vitae humanae repara in nobis quod lassatur ex nobis nec tamen reparari potest a nobis. Da igitur ut qui ad horum medietatem dierum te annuente pervenimus ad paschalis gaudii dies te propitiante celerius accedamus.  Reficiamur quaesumus bone Deus pane lacrimarum in hac ieiunii via ut deponentes veteris hominis indumenta expiati mereamur sacrosanctum pervenire ad pascha. Crea in nobis desiderium visionis tuae quo excellente in cordibus nostris et praesentibus non terreamur laboribus et beatae spei praemia avidius praestolemur.
translation_en:
Creator and restorer of human life, restore in us that which is weary from us, yet cannot be restored by us. Therefore grant that we who have come to the halfway point of these days with your approval may more swiftly approach the days of Easter with you being propitious.
Please, good God, make us strong with the bread of tears in this way of fasting, so that shedding the garments of the old man we may be worthy to reach the holy Pascha.
Create in us a desire for your vision, so that we may not tremble at the labors and not grow cold towards the blessed rewards.

text: Deus qui nobis per prophetarum ora
translation_en: God who speaks to us through the mouths of the prophets

text: Deus conditor mundi sub cuius arbitrio omnium saeculorum ordo decurrit adesto propitius invocationibus nostris et tranquillitatem pacis praesentibus concede temporibus ut in laudibus misericordiae tuae incessabili exsultatione laetemur.
translation_en: The Creator of the world, under whose guidance the order of all ages runs, be present graciously to our invocations. And grant peace's tranquility during these times so that we may rejoice unceasingly in your mercy's praises.

text: Deus conditor pacis et fons luminis exaudi pias petitiones nostras et praesta ut disrupto odii fomite pace tua muniamur.
translation_en: God, creator of peace and source of light, hear our pious petitions and grant that we may be fortified with your peace after the flame of hatred has been extinguished.

text: Deus confitentium te portio defunctorum preces nostras quas in famuli tui Silvestri episcopi depositione deferimus propitius assume ut qui nomini tuo ministerium fidele dependit perpetua sanctorum tuorum societate laetetur.
translation_en: God, portion of the dead who confess you, accept our prayers which we bring on behalf of your servant Bishop Silvestri at his departure, be propitious, that he who faithfully depends on Your name may rejoice in eternal fellowship with Your saints.

text: Deus consolationis et pacis respice quaesumus ad precem familiae tuae et concede ut animae famulorum famularumque tuarum quae ab Adam usque in hodiernum diem de hac luce migraverunt quique baptizati et confessi in fide catholica perseveraverunt et de suis rebus ecclesias Dei ditaverunt et de quorum eleemosynis sumus consolati in sinibus Abrahae Isaac et Iacob feliciter requiescant moxque et a mortuis resuscitati tibi placeant in regno vivorum.
translation_en: We ask you, God of comfort and peace, to look upon the prayer of your family. Grant that the souls of your servants, who have migrated from this light since Adam up until today, who were baptized and confessed in the Catholic faith and left their possessions to the churches of God, and whose alms have consoled us in the troubles of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, may they rest happily now, and soon may they please you among the living in the kingdom.

text: Deus continentiae Deus caritatis et pacis qui precibus humiliantium se inflecteris miserere nostri exaudi nos et diversarum turbinum tempestate remota pacem nobis tuae serenitatis impertias quam si peccatorum nostrorum nimietate perdidimus per indulgentiam tuae misericordiae consequamur.
translation_en: God of continence, God of charity and peace who bends to the prayers of the humble, have mercy on us and hear us. Grant us peace, removed from the diverse storms of tempest, bestow upon us the calmness of your serenity, which we may achieve through the indulgence of your mercy, if we have lost it by the magnitude of our sins.

text: Deus cui acceptissimum ac iucundissimum sacrificium est sanctorum tuorum fides atque devotio adesto familiae tuae tibi supplici misericordiam tuam per sanctorum tuorum Acaunensium suffragia postulanti et da ut qui te peccatorum suorum errore laeserunt placere tibi sanctorum tuorum intercessione mereantur.
translation_en: God to whom the most acceptable and delightful sacrifice is the faith and devotion of your saints, be present to your family who supplicantly seek your mercy. Through the intercession of your Saints of Auxerre, grant that those who have been hurt by their own sins may, through their repentance, deserve to please you.

text: Deus cui beata Caecilia ita castitatis devotione complacuit ut coniugem suum Valerianum adfinemque eius Tiburtium tibi fecerit consecrari – nam et angelo deferente micantium odoriferas florum coronas palmam martyrii perceperunt – quaesumus ut ea intercedente pro nobis beneficia tui muneris percipere mereamur.
translation_en: We ask that through the intercession of blessed Caecilia, who pleased God so much with her devotion to chastity that she had her husband Valerian and her relative Tiburtius consecrated – for they, carried by an angel, received palm wreaths scented with shining flowers as a symbol of martyrdom – we may merit to receive your blessings because of her intercession.

text: Deus cui beatae Mariae singularis virginitas atque humilitas singulariter placuit concede nobis quaesumus ut qui Dei Genitricem hanc meruimus confiteri per ipsam et humilitatis gratiam et donum continentiae percipiamus.
translation_en: God, to whom the unique virginity and humility of Blessed Mary are particularly pleasing, grant us we beseech you, that we who have merited to confess God's Mother through her, may receive the grace of humility and the gift of chastity through her.

text: Deus cui beatus Romanus pontifex ita sanctitatis gratia decoratus complacuit ut tuorum consortium in caelis promereretur sanctorum da quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae eius interventu perpetuam consequi laetitiam cuius depositionis diem gratulando celebrat sollemnem.
translation_en: God, to whom the blessed Roman pontiff is so adorned with the grace of sanctity that he might be admitted into your consortium in heaven, we ask that through his intervention the Church may perpetually enjoy the joy of which the day of his departure is celebrated with a solemn celebration.

text: Deus qui nos ad celebrandum paschale
translation_en: God who leads us to celebrate the Easter season

text: Deus cui cor mundum et corpus placet intactum cuique puritas mentis et sinceritas non displicet carnis subiuga quaesumus per abstinentiae rigorem animae carnem atque per affectum timoris et dilectionis animam tibi adsocia ut tu solus Domineris in omnia nobis qui conditor noster esse agnosceris. Posside ergo et redime nos Domine ut qui hoc ieiunium studiose agimus te tribuente satietate incorruptibili tuae gloriae perfruamur.
translation_en: We ask you, God, whose heart the world and an undamaged body pleases, whose purity of mind and sincerity do not displease the subjugated flesh. Through the rigor of abstinence, we entreat that our soul may be united with you, and through the affection of fear and love, our spirit may be connected to you, so that you alone may rule over us, and we may recognize you as our creator. Possess and redeem us, Lord, so that those who observe this fasting with diligence, may enjoy your incorruptible satisfaction and partake in your glory.

text: Deus cui cunctae oboediunt creaturae et omnia verbo tuo fecisti in sapientia supplices quaesumus ineffabilem misericordiam tuam ut quos per lignum sanctae crucis Filii tui pio cruore es dignatus redimere tu qui es lignum vitae paradisique reparator omnibus in te credentibus dira serpentis venena exstinguas et per gratiam Spiritus Sancti poculum salutis semper infundas.
translation_en: We ask you, God, to whom all creatures obey, and who made all things with your word in wisdom, that you pour out your ineffable mercy on us. You who are the life-giving wood and the restorer of paradise for all who believe in you, extinguish the deadly venom of the serpent for us, and always infuse in us the cup of salvation through the grace of the Holy Spirit.

text: Deus cui et martyrum fides et veneranda sanctorum vita complacuit quique gradientem apostolum Petrum in elemento liquido confirmasti nos quoque saeculi turbine fluctuantes dexterae tuae protectione conserva.
translation_en: God, whose faith pleased the martyrs and the venerable life of the saints, who strengthened the apostle Peter in the liquid element, also preserve us in the turmoil of this world with Your right hand's protection.

text: Deus cui martyrum fides et veneranda vita complacuit quique gradientem beatissimum Mames in elemento utique confirmasti petimus pietatem tuam ut nos in huius saeculi turbine fluctuantes dexterae tuae proiectione conserva.
translation_en: We ask your kindness, O God, who pleased the faith and revered life of martyrs, and who undoubtedly confirmed the most blessed Moses on the element, that in this world's stormy turbulence, you may preserve us by the projection of your right hand.

text: Deus cui hodierna die unigenitus tuus in nostra carne quam assumpsit pro nobis in templo est praesentatus praesta ut quem redemptorem nostrum laeti suscipimus venientem quoque iudicem securi videamus.
translation_en: God, on whose today's day Your unique Son was presented in our flesh, which He took for us in the temple, grant that we may rejoice in receiving Him as our Redeemer, and also confidently behold Him as coming Judge.

text: Deus cui hodierna die unigenitum tuum secundum instituta legalia in templo praesentatum agnovimus concede nobis quaesumus in templo gloriae tuae aeternis coram eo gaudiis esse participes.
translation_en: We recognize today on your behalf the presentation of your only-begotten one according to legal institutions in the temple. Grant us, we ask, to be participants in the eternal joys of your glory within that same temple.

text: Deus cui militare consuevit abstinentia corporalis ut expugnetur nequitia spiritalis supereminentem nostris cordibus infunde dulcedinem qua beatae vitae desiderent mansionem. Nulla ieiunantibus iracundiae repentinae amaritudo subripiat nullaque cogitationum noxiarum conscientia remaneat. Memor esto sacrificii quod offerimus et concede propitius misericordiam quam rogamus.
translation_en: God, who is accustomed to fight with bodily abstinence against spiritual wickedness, pour into our hearts the sweetness that desires the mansion of blessed life. Let no sudden bitterness of anger snatch away from those who are fasting, and let no consciousness of harmful thoughts remain. Remember the sacrifice we offer, and grant your propitious mercy as we ask.

text: Deus cui omne cor patet et omnis voluntas loquitur et nullum latet secretum purifica per infusionem Sancti Spiritus cogitationes cordis nostri ut perfecte te diligere et digne laudare mereamur.
translation_en: God, whose every heart is open and whose every will speaks, and no secret remains hidden, purify the thoughts of our hearts by the infusion of the Holy Spirit, so that we may deserve to love you perfectly and praise you worthily.

text: Deus cui omnium sacrificiorum varietate finita hostiam nunc offerimus singularem adesto votis tua inspiratione conceptis ut in te sperantium et desideria iubeas perfici et peccata deleri.
translation_en: We offer you, God, this unique sacrifice from among all offerings, which are limited in their variety. Be present with your inspiration as our vows are conceived. Grant that those who hope and desire in you may be commanded to fulfill their desires, and may their sins be erased.

text: Deus cui posse maximum scire verissimum et optimum velle in sanctorum splendoribus relucet praesta ut qui nostrorum actuum levitate graviter premimur gratia beati Ioannis confessoris interveniente tui vigoris brachio splendoris radio et amoris pondere sublevemur.
translation_en: God, who knows the greatest power and desires the most truth and goodness in the radiance of saints, grant that we, who are heavily weighed down by the gravity of our actions, may be uplifted by the grace of blessed John the Confessor, through the intervention of your strength, shining like a beam, and the weight of your love.

text: Deus cui proprium est ablutionem criminum dare et veniam praestare peccantibus te suppliciter deprecor ut mihi indigno misericordiam tuam clementer impendas ut qui contemnendo praeceptorum tuorum praevaricator exstiti confitendo peccatorum meorum veniam consequi merear.
translation_en: I humbly beseech You, God, who is accustomed to give the washing away of sins and to grant pardon to the penitent, that You might graciously bestow Your mercy upon me, unworthy as I am. May one who has disregarded Your commandments become a transgressor confess my sins, so that I may deserve to obtain forgiveness.

text: Deus cui proprium est misereri et preces exaudire supplicantium propitiare animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum ut te miserante a peccatorum vinculis absolutae ad aeternae beatitudinis requiem pervenire mereantur.
translation_en: God, who is accustomed to have mercy and hear the prayers of supplicants, propitiate the souls of your servants and their attendants, so that, being merciful and absolving them from the bonds of sins, they may deserve to reach the eternal beatitude's rest.

text: Deus cui proprium est misereri semper et parcere maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecor ut mihi famulo tuo precibus beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae veniam meorum largiri digneris peccatorum et famulis ac famulabus tuis qui mihi consanguinitatis familiaritatis subiectionis confessionis et dilectionis vinculo connectuntur vivis et defunctis quorum et quarum nomina tibi vivunt pro quibus tuam misericordiam exoro interventu omnium supernorum civium cunctarum propitius indulgentiam culparum et plenitudinem aeternorum largiaris gaudiorum.
translation_en: I humbly beseech You, God whose nature it is to have mercy and be compassionate, that You would deign to grant me, Your servant, forgiveness for my sins through the prayers of the blessed Mother of God, Mary. I also pray for the living and the dead who are bound to me by the bond of kinship, familiarity, submission, confession, and love. For them and for all whose names live before You, I implore Your mercy through the intervention of all citizens of heaven. May You graciously grant forgiveness for faults and bestow the fullness of eternal joy.

text: Deus cui proprium est misereri semper et parcere maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecor ut mihi veniam largiri digneris peccatorum et contra hostium visibilium et invisibilium insidias tua proiectione munitum ad plenitudinem me aeternorum pervenire facias gaudiorum.
translation_en: I humbly beseech You, the God who is always merciful and kind, to grant me forgiveness for my sins. May Your protection shield me from both visible and invisible enemies' ambushes, and may You lead me to the fullness of eternal joy through Your favor.

text: Deus cui proprium est misereri semper et parcere propitiare animae famuli tui illius et omnia eius peccata dimitte ut mortis vinculis absoluta transire mereatur ad vitam.
translation_en: God, who is always merciful and compassionate, grant propitiation to the soul of your servant and forgive all his sins, so that he may be worthy to pass through the bonds of death into life.

text: Deus cui proprium est misereri semper et parcere propitius esto mihi peccatori et quidquid iniquitatis vel peccati ego miser neglegenter commisi tu pie supplex obsecro clementer indulge.
translation_en: God, who is always merciful and gracious, be favorable to me, a sinner, and forgive whatever I have negligently committed in wickedness or sin. Humbly I entreat you with a pleading heart, be merciful and grant me forgiveness.

text: Deus cui proprium est misereri semper et parcere suscipe deprecationem nostram et quos delictorum catena constringit miseratio tuae pietatis absolvat.
translation_en: God, who is always merciful and compassionate, receive our supplication. May your mercy free those who are bound by the chain of sins.

text: Deus cui proprium est misereri semper et parcere te supplices deprecamur pro anima famuli tui illius quam hodie de hoc saeculo migrare iussisti ut non tradas eam in manus inimici nec obliviscaris in finem sed iubeas eam a sanctis angelis suscipi et ad patriam paradisi perduci ut dum in te speravit et credidit non poenas inferni sustineat sed gaudia aeterna possideat.
translation_en: We entreat the God who is always merciful and compassionate for the soul of your servant, whom you have today commanded to leave this world, that you do not deliver her into the hands of the enemy nor forget her in the end. Instead, we beseech you to command her to be taken up by holy angels and led to the fatherland of paradise, so that while she hoped and believed in you, she may not suffer the punishments of hell but instead possess eternal joys.

text: Deus cui soli cognitus est numerus electorum in superna felicitate locandus tribue quaesumus ut universorum quos in oratione commendatos suscepimus sive omnium fidelium nomina beatae praedestinationis liber adscripta retineat.
translation_en: We ask you, God, to whom the number of the elect is known in the higher happiness, to grant that the names of all those whom we commend in prayer, whether of all faithful people, may be retained by the free predestination set apart as blessed.

text: Deus cui soli competit medicinam praestare post mortem praesta quaesumus ut anima famuli tui illius terrenis exuta contagiis in tuae redemptionis parte numeretur.
translation_en: We ask you, God to whom healing after death belongs, grant that the soul of your servant, freed from earthly contagions, may be numbered among those who are redeemed by you.

text: Deus cui soli competit medicinam praestare post mortem tribue quaesumus ut animae famulorum famularumque tuarum ab omnibus exutae peccatis in electorum tuorum societatibus aggregentur.
translation_en: We ask you, God to whom healing belongs after death, grant that the souls of your servants and servants may be gathered among the fellowships of your chosen ones, freed from all sins.

text: Deus cui soli est elisos erigere et peccata deflentium condonare clementer populi tui suspiria inspice et crimina nostra ieiuniorum tempore dele.
translation_en: God, to whom alone belongs the power to exalt and forgive penitent people, have regard for the sighs of your people and in the time of our fasting, blot out our sins.

text: Deus cui summum sacrificium est concordans anima cui holocaustum pinguissimum est placita et pura conscientia concede nobis quaesumus ut coniunctio labiorum copula efficiatur animarum et ministerium osculi perpetuae proficiat caritati.
translation_en: God, to whom the supreme sacrifice is a concordant soul and the holiest offering is a pleasing and pure conscience, grant us we beg, that the joining of lips may become a bond for souls and the service of a kiss may perpetually advance charity.

text: Deus cui transferendus Elias quadraginta dierum ieiunium consecravit et spiritaliter donec ad caelestia mereretur adscendere ieiunavit prophetalem quaesumus gratiam dona populis christianis in qua superemus delectationes carnis et sanguinis. Fac in omnibus et per omnia continentes; fac pacificos; fac praecepta caelestia servantes quibus et in hoc sacrificio benignus appareas et humiliter te invocantibus propitiatus occurras.
translation_en:
We ask that you grant grace to the Christian people, so that they may surpass the delight of the flesh and blood. May you make them steadfast in all things and through all things; may you make them peaceful; may you make those who serve celestial precepts, to whom even in this sacrifice you appear benevolent and to the humble ones who invoke you, mercifully appear.
In English:
We beseech you to grant grace to the Christian people, enabling them to overcome the temptations of the flesh and blood. May they be steadfast in all things and through all things; may they live peacefully; may those who serve celestial precepts, to whom even in this sacrifice you appear benevolent, and to the humble ones who invoke you, may you show mercy.

text: Deus cuius adorandae potentia maiestatis flammae saevientis incendium sanctis tribus pueris in splendore demutatum est animarum Ecclesiae tuae similibus adesto remediis ut de gravioribus mundi huius adversitatibus propitiatione caelesti populus tuus ereptus exsultet.
translation_en: God, whose power is the searing flame of majesty, who changed the destructive fire into a shining spectacle for the three holy boys in Church, be present with similar remedies to help your Church escape from the gravest adversities of this world. May your people rejoice with celestial propitiation.

text: Deus cuius amorem piissimi confessores et martyres tui Ferreolus et Ferrucio cruore asserunt et morte confirmant qui dum tibi tam libenter sumptum a te vitae munus impendunt neminem non pro vita mori testantur concede ut fidem quam cordibus nostris proprio inscriptam sanguine reliquerunt vitae meritis excolamus et quod in eis admiramur imitemur quod colimus diligamus quod laude prosequimur conversatione sectemur.
translation_en: God, whose love the most pious confessors and martyrs Ferreolus and Ferrucius assert and confirm with their blood, who when they offer to you life's gift willingly received from you, bear witness that none of them would not die for life's sake. Grant that we may cultivate the faith which they have left inscribed on our hearts with their own blood by their life's merits. May we imitate what we admire in them, love what we love, pursue what we praise, and follow the way of life which we laud.

text: Deus cuius arbitrio omnium saeculorum ordo decurrit adesto propitius invocationibus nostris et pacem tuam nostris concede temporibus ut de tuis laudibus in gloria tua laetemur.
translation_en: God, whose order of all the ages is governed by Your will, be present graciously to our invocations and grant us peace during these times, so that we may rejoice in Your praise in Your glory.

text: Deus cuius arbitrio omnium saeculorum ordo decurrit respice propitius ad nostrae tempus aetatis et ut tibi servitus nostra complaceat tua in nobis dona conserva.
translation_en: God, whose order of all the ages runs by Your will, look upon us favorably in our time of life and may Your service please You within us. May You preserve Your gifts in us.

text: Deus cuius arbitrio omnium saeculorum ordo decurrit respice propitius ad me famulum tuum quem ad ordinem presbyterii promovere dignatus es et ut tibi mea servitus complaceat tua in me misericorditer dona conserva.
translation_en: God whose order of all ages runs at your arbitration, look upon me, Your servant, favorably. You have deemed fit to promote me to the order of priesthood, and I pray that my service pleases you. Grant me your mercy, sustain and conserve me.

text: Deus cuius arbitrio omnium saeculorum ordo decurrit respice propitius ad nostri temporis aetatem ut tibi servitus nostra complaceat et misericordiae tuae in nobis dona concedas.
translation_en: God, whose order all the ages are subject to, look upon us favorably in our time. May your servitude please you and grant us the gift of your mercy.

text: Deus cuius bonitatis nullus est numerus quia semper misericordia tibi est causa miserendi exaudi nos pro illius famuli tui anima supplicantes ut illum gratia tua sicut donavit baptismo ita donet et regno.
translation_en: God, whose goodness has no number, for with You mercy is always the cause of pity, hear us on behalf of Your servant's soul praying. Grant him grace as You gave him baptism, so may You also grant him a kingdom.

text: Deus cuius caritatis ardore beatus Laurentius edaces incendiis flammas contempto persecutore devicit concede propitius ut omnes qui martyrii eius merita veneramur protectionis tuae auxilio muniamur.
translation_en: God, whose love's ardor the blessed Laurence overcame with contempt for his persecutor by conquering the flames of the fire, grant your grace propitiously so that all who revere his martyrdom's merits may be fortified by the aid of your protection.

text: Deus cuius claritatis fulgore beatus Michael archangelus tuus praecellit agminibus angelorum praesta quaesumus ut sicut ille tuo dono principatum meruit possidere caelestem ita nos eius precibus adiuti vitam obtineamus aeternam.
translation_en: We ask you, God of whose brightness blessed Michael the archangel outshines the ranks of angels, that just as he merited to possess the principality of heaven by your gift, so with his prayers helping us, we may obtain an eternal life.

text: Deus cuius clementia sanctae Sexburgae animam in hac ymera splendidam ad poli vexit regiam concede nobis eius suffultis precibus huius vitae post obitum accipere denarium sanctisque iuncti angelis caeli fruamur gaudiis.
translation_en: May the God whose clemency has raised the soul of Saint Sexburga to the royal heavens today, grant us to receive a penny in this life after her death, and may we enjoy joys with the holy angels in heaven.

text: Deus cuius dextera Petrum apostolum ambulantem in fluctibus ne mergeretur erexit et coapostolum eius Paulum tertio naufragantem de profundo pelagi liberavit concede propitius ut amborum meritis aeternam Trinitatis gratiam consequamur.
translation_en: God, whose right hand kept Peter the apostle from drowning in the waves, and who saved Paul his co-apostle, shipwrecked for the third time on the deep sea of the Mediterranean, grant us kindly that we may attain eternal grace through their merits.

text: Deus cuius dextera beatum Petrum ambulantem in fluctibus ne mergeretur erexit et coapostolum eius Paulum tertio naufragantem de profundo pelagi liberavit exaudi nos propitius et concede ut amborum meritis aeternitatis gloriam consequamur.
translation_en: God, whose right hand kept blessed Peter from drowning in the waves, lifted him up. Likewise, God raised up and freed apostle Paul, shipwrecked for the third time from the deep sea of the Mediterranean. Hear us graciously and grant that we may follow in their merits to attain eternal glory.

text: Deus cuius dilectionem beata Barbara omni terreno amori anteposuit praesta quaesumus ut cuius martyrii triumphum hodierna die recolimus eius suffragiis ad caelestia regna pervenire possimus.
translation_en: God, to whose love blessed Barbara set above all earthly love, grant us that we may be able to reach the heavenly kingdoms on this day as we remember the triumph of her martyrdom. Through her intercession, we ask.

text: Deus cuius est regnum omnium saeculorum praetende quaesumus famulo tuo illi et omni exercitui eius arma caelestia ut pax ecclesiarum nulla turbetur tempestate bellorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask your God, whose kingdom is of all eternities, to stretch forth protection towards your servant and all his army, granting them celestial weapons, that the peace of the churches may not be disturbed by any storm of wars.

text: Deus cuius excellentia beatus Neotus abbas gloriosis miraculorum signis eximie effulsit da quaesumus ut cuius sollemnia suppliciter veneramur ipsius beatitudinis consortes esse mereamur.
translation_en: We ask that we, who rejoice in the excellence of God, for whom Blessed Neotus abbot shone with outstanding signs of miracles, may be worthy to join in his beatitude as we reverently celebrate his solemnity.

text: Deus cuius eximia dulcedo beatum Dunstanum pontificem gloriose exornavit concede clementer quaesumus adstanti familiae ut grex devotus sequatur quo caput eximium praecessit.
translation_en: God, whose extraordinary sweetness gloriously adorned the blessed Dunstan, bishop, grant us your clemency, we humbly ask, to the present family that the devoted flock may follow where the outstanding head has led.

text: Deus cuius Filium Maria virgo Salvatorem edidit mundo nec tamen per partum eius humanitatis nomen amisit intemeratae castitatis tribue quaesumus ut ipsa pro nobis intercedat (apud) proprium quem genuit filium.
translation_en: We ask that the God, whose Son Mary, the Virgin, gave to the world as Savior, not having lost the name of humanity through her immaculate chastity. We beseech you to grant, that she herself may intercede for us before her own Son, whom she bore.

text: Deus cuius Filius generi humano nascendo subvenit cum per mortem passionis mundum devicit per gloriam resurrectionis vitae aeternae aditum patefecit et per suam ascensionem ad caelos nobis spem adscendendi donavit sanctique spiritus infusione fidelium corda replevit concede quaesumus per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus ut nos culpis omnibus emundatos inveniat secundus eius adventus.
translation_en: We ask that through these sacred mysteries which we have received, you grant us, O God, to be cleansed of all sins, so that the second coming of your Son may find us worthy. You whose Son came to the aid of the human race by being born, conquered the world by dying for our salvation, opened the way to eternal life through resurrection, and gave us hope of ascending to heaven by his ascension. By the infusion of the Holy Spirit, you filled the hearts of believers. Therefore, pour out your grace upon us so that we may be prepared for his second coming.

text: Deus cuius Filius in alta caelorum potenter adscendens captivitatem nostram sua duxit virtute captivam tribue quaesumus ut dona quae suis participibus contulit largiat et nobis.
translation_en: We ask that the God, to whom His Son ascended in high power in heaven, grant us that He may bestow upon us the gifts which He has given to His participants.

text: Deus cuius Filius per tropheum crucis mundum redimere dignatus est concede propitius ut qui de redemptione laetamur aeternis gaudiis perfrui mereamur.
translation_en: God, whose Son was deemed worthy to redeem the world by the trophy of the cross, grant us your grace. May we who rejoice in redemption merit to partake in eternal joys.

text: Deus cuius gratia beati Wandregesili confessoris tui atque abbatis vita exstitit laudabilis ipsius interventu quod tibi placitum est pietas tua operetur in nobis.
translation_en: The grace of God, whose life the blessed Wandregesilus, your confessor and abbot, lived praiseworthily, may his intervention please you. May your pity operate within us.

text: Deus cuius gratia beatus Alexius confessor exstitit admirabilis ipsius interventu munus oblatum quod tibi placitum sit semper in nobis operetur.
translation_en: God, whose grace the blessed Alexius the confessor came to be an admirable gift offered by himself, may this gift always work in us according to your pleasure.

text: Deus cuius gratia beatus Wilfridus <confessor tuus atque pontifex exstitit admirabilis ipsius interventu quod tibi placitum est pietas tua operetur in nobis>
translation_en: God whose grace the blessed Wilfrid, your confessor and bishop, became admirable through his intervention, may your mercy work within us.

text: Deus cuius hodierna die praeconium Innocentes martyres non loquendo sed moriendo confessi sunt omnia in nobis vitiorum mala munifica ut fidem tuam quam lingua nostra loquitur etiam moribus vita fateatur.
translation_en: God, whose preaching the Innocents martyrs confessed today not by speaking but by dying, makes all evil vices in us richly manifest so that even our behavior and way of life may bear witness to your faith which our language speaks.

text: Deus cuius ineffabilis est clementia profunda pietas infinita miseratio inaestimabilis magnitudo qui sic irasceris ut corrigas castigas ut revoces corripis ut emendes invitas ut diligas flagellas ut parcas preces populi tui libenter amplectere et propitius intuere et quoniam quid mereamur vel quid patiamur agnoscis per te nobis tribue quod rogaris ut ab omnibus temptationibus inimici quibus adversus animam nostram illius sine cessatione grassatur invidia virtutis tuae dextera liberati in regnum tuum mereamur admitti.
translation_en: God, whose ineffable is the depth of clemency, the infinite pity, the immeasurable greatness, who are so angry that you correct, chastise, recall, reprove, amend, invite, love the scourges, spare mercifully, gladly embrace and look favorably upon the prayers of your people. And because you know what we deserve or suffer, through you grant us what we ask for, so that from all temptations by the enemies who against our soul relentlessly gnaw with unceasing envy of your virtues, we may be freed by your right hand and admitted to your kingdom.

text: Deus cuius miseratione animae fidelium requiescunt famulis tuis illis et illis vel omnibus hic quiescentibus da propitius veniam peccatorum ut a cunctis reatibus absoluti sine fine laetentur.
translation_en: God, whose mercy the souls of faithful servants rest upon, grant them a gracious pardon for their sins, so that, absolved from all offenses forever, they may rejoice without end.

text: Deus cuius miseratione delinquentes mutantur ad veniam iusti transferuntur ad palmam qui infusus corde beati Hilarii antistitis quasi de tuo templo fidei responsa dedisti concede propitius ut qui tunc inclitum confessorem fecisti caesarem non timere eius intercessione ab spiritali hoste plebem protegas obsecrantem ut cuius sollemnitate tripudiat eius sit fida prece defensa.
translation_en: God, whose mercy transforms sinners into forgiveness and transfers the just to palm, who through the faith of blessed Hilary, bishop, as if from your temple, has given answers - grant it graciously. Be propitious so that the one whom you made an illustrious confessor at that time, Caesar, may not fear because of his intercession protects the people from the spiritual enemy, who pleads. May the people rejoice in whose festival his faithful prayer is defended.

text: Deus cuius misericordia per utrumque sexum per omnem currit aetatem ita plurimum infantibus affectum paternae pietatis indulgens ut parvulos nec ab Aegypto teneri sineres nec ab evangelio prohiberi dum et in lege cum patribus evaderent mundum et in gratia cum perfectis vocarentur ad regnum atque institutione doctrinae innocentia expers mali forma induceretur exempli dona nobis famulis tuis ut malitiae viribus defaecatis in usum concupiscentiae carnalis invalidi docibilem servemus disciplinis spiritalibus voluntatem quo mens nec rigida nec superba sic sit blanda ne facilis sic innocens ne impudens sic humilis ne imbecillis quatenus maturo discretionis iudicio sic sufficiat probare quod placeat ut affectare nesciat quod delinquat atque ita salubrem sumat temperantiam moderante consilio ut et simplicitatem imitetur infantium et fortitudinem vindicet pugnatorum.
translation_en: God, whose mercy runs through every age by both sexes, shows a particularly affectionate fatherly pity towards infants, allowing them neither to be held in Egypt nor prevented from the Gospel. In this way, as they escape the world according to the law with the patriarchs and are called to the kingdom according to grace with the perfect, they are clothed without any trace of evil, gifted by the example. We, your servants, ask that you grant us these gifts: that we, weakened by the powers of wickedness, may serve the spiritual disciplines with a disposition neither rigid nor arrogant but gentle, yet innocent, humble yet strong, so that we may prove ourselves mature in the judgment of discernment, knowing what is right and not doing wrong. Thus, we may take up a healthy temperance, moderated by counsel, imitating the simplicity of infants and the courage of fighters.

text: Deus cuius misericordia caelestium quoque virtutum indigent potestates et in cuius conspectu nullus est hominum absque sorde et poena peccati delicta populi tui quaesumus averte propitiatus ut quos propriae conscientiae reatus accusat bonitatis tuae patientia faciat veniam promereri.
translation_en: We ask you, God, whose mercy even the powers of heaven require, whose sight no man can behold without guilt and penalty for his sins, to turn propitiously towards us. May your goodness, through your patience, make forgiveness to be merited by those whom their own conscience accuses.

text: Deus cuius misericordia praecurrente salvamur respice propitius ad tanti sollemnia praecursoris ut sacrificium quod natalicio eius munere gratulantes offerimus et indulgentiam nobis obtineat et favorem.
translation_en: God, whose mercy precedes us, look upon us graciously on these great solemnities of the precursor, that the sacrifice which we offer in gratitude for his birthday may be acceptable to us and obtain favor and indulgence.

text: Deus cuius misericordiae non est numerus cui soli competit medicinam praestare post mortem qui es vita viventium spes morientium et salus omnium in te sperantium qui terram hereditatis tuae per peccata filiorum Esau pollutam pretioso sanguine tuo dignatus es consecrare tu animam famuli tui illius per huius virtutem sacramenti a peccatis omnibus exuas et a poenis quas pro his meretur eripias et populum incredulum ac rebellem per gratiam tuam facias peculiarem illis omnibus qui in tua misericordia confidunt manum auxilii tui piissime largiendo.
translation_en: God, whose mercy has no number, who alone is fit to provide healing after death, you are the hope of the living and the salvation of all who hope in you. You have deigned to consecrate the land polluted by the sins of Esau's sons with your precious blood. Through the power of this sacrament, remove from your servant his sins and free him from the penalties he deserves, and make the unbelieving and rebellious people particular to those who trust in your mercy. Generously granting the hand of your aid, may you most graciously bestow upon all those who hope in your mercy.

text: Deus cuius misericordiae non est numerus et bonitatis infinitus est thesaurus piissimae maiestati tuae pro collatis donis gratias agimus tuam semper clementiam exorantes ut qui petentibus postulata concedis eosdem non deserens ad praemia futura disponas.
translation_en: We give thanks to the God whose mercy is boundless, and whose goodness is an inexhaustible treasure for your most gracious majesty, for the gifts bestowed upon us. We continually implore Your eternal clemency, that You who grant the requests of those who ask, may not abandon them, but dispose them towards future rewards.

text: Deus cuius misericordiae non est numerus suscipe pro anima famuli tui illius episcopi preces nostras et lucis ei laetitiaeque in regione sanctorum tuorum societatem concede.
translation_en: God, whose mercy is uncountable, receive the prayers for the soul of that bishop, your servant, and grant him the company of joy and light among Your saints' realm.

text: Deus cuius misericordiae non est numerus suscipe propitius preces humilitatis nostrae et animabus quibus tui nominis dedisti confessionem per haec sacramenta salutis nostrae cunctorum remissionem tribue peccatorum.
translation_en: God, whose mercy has no number, receive our prayers graciously and grant forgiveness of sins to all souls who have confessed your name through these sacraments of our salvation.

text: Deus cuius munere honoranda baptismatis sunt impleta mysteria concede populo tuo originalis delicti errore mundato post sacratissimum fontem terram tuae promissionis intrare ut dulcia sacramentorum tuorum iam nunc alimenta percipiat.
translation_en: God, whose service the mysteries of baptism are worthy to be honored, grant to your people that they may be washed from the original sin error and enter your land after the most sacred font. Let them now partake of the sweet sustenance of your sacraments.

text: Deus cuius mysteriis mundamur et pascimur praesta ut eadem sic temporaliter celebremus ut nobis experiamur aeterna.
translation_en: God whose mysteries cleanse and nourish us, grant that we may celebrate them temporally in the same way, so that we may experience eternally.

text: Deus cuius nativitatem Filii tui Domini nostri gloriosa festivitas et Mariae partum et Eugeniae triumphum Hodie quippe Maria Christum genuit hodie Eugenia ad Christum vadit; hodie illa generat ad quem ista festinat; hodie Christus in mundo venit hodie virginem in caelo Christus suscipit; hodie nascendo virginem matrem fecit qui hodie perficiendo martyrem coronavit.
translation_en: Today the nativity of Your Son, our glorious Lord, and the childbirth of Mary, and the triumph of Eugenia is celebrated. Today, indeed, Mary gave birth to Christ today, Eugenia goes to Christ; today she gives birth to whom she hastens to; today Christ comes into the world today, Christ receives the virgin in heaven; today He makes the virgin giving birth a mother who today, by completing, crowns as a martyr.

text: Deus cuius nomen magnum est atque mirabile tu et nomina offerentium in libro vitae adscribe et defunctorum animas aeternae quietis amoenitatibus refove quo abstinentiae nostrae suscipiens precem omnibus in commune a te concedatur donum indulgentiae sempiternae.
translation_en: God, whose name is great and wonderful, may the names of those offering be written in the book of life. Revive the souls of the departed with the delights of eternal rest. Grant us all, through our abstinence, the gift of eternal indulgence from you.

text: Deus cuius occulto consilio ideo Elisabeth sterilis uterus exstitit ut quandoque angelica potius voce fecundaretur concede propitius ut sicut illa in iudaico populo praecursorem domini peperit ita famula tua illa in filio qui ad credulitatem tibi huius populi pure deserviat fecundetur.
translation_en: God, whose hidden counsel made Elizabeth barren until she was fertile with an angelic voice, grant your mercy so that, just as she bore the forerunner of the Lord among the Jewish people, your servant may also bear a child who serves you purely in faithfulness to this people. May she be fruitful.

text: Deus cuius occulto iudicio permittente beatus Edwardus indignae mortis pertulit iniuriam ut sic purgatus transiret ad gloriam ipsius precibus purga nos ab occultis et manifestis peccetis nostris et quidquid sub tuo iudicio ab adversariis sustinemus ad praemium nobis reputa perpetuum.
translation_en: God, whose secret judgment permitted blessed Edward to bear an undeserved death in order to pass over to his glory, purge us through our prayers from our hidden and manifest sins, and whatever we suffer at the hands of our adversaries according to your judgment, consider it as a reward for us, grant us eternal life.

text: Deus cuius opera plena sunt misericordia et iustitia sicut in sancto tuo Edwardo agnoscimus ipso opitulante iustifica nos in tuis praeceptis et de tuis fac gaudere promissis.
translation_en: God, whose works are full of mercy and justice, as we recognize in your saint Edward, help us through his intercession to be justified by your commandments and make us rejoice in your promises.
