text: Deus cuius operatio non habet laborem misericordia donat quietem salusque parturit salutem atque inimicam Deo procul effugat voluntatem sana nos et sanabimur salva nos et salvi erimus ut sabbatum nostrum spiritali benedictione sanctificatum paschalibus cognoscatur gaudiis esse perfectum quo mortis ac resurrectionis tuae laetitia functi et viventium salutem et defunctorum a te mereamur impetrare quietem.
translation_en: God, whose operation has no toil, bestows peace and the savior gives birth to salvation, driving away from us the wicked will of the enemy. May we be sane and healed, may we be saved and be in a state of being saved, so that our spiritual Sabbath, blessed with sanctification by the Paschal blessing, may be recognized as perfect through joy. Thus, filled with the joy of your death and resurrection, we may merit to ask from you for the peace both of the living and the departed.

text: Deus cuius per summum antistitem et confessorem tuum Martinum fulgoris tui lumen effulsit illius hodie felicem transmigrationem celebrantes clementiam tuam supplices exoramus ut Ecclesiam tuam conversantem in tribulatione digneris defendere cui a te satis larga pietate concessum est etiam mortuos suscitare.
translation_en: We humbly ask for your clemency, O God, whose glory shone forth through Your highest bishop and confessor Martin, as we celebrate his happy transition today. We implore you to deign to protect Your Church, which is passing through tribulation, with the abundant mercy You have bestowed upon it, even raising the dead.

text: Deus cuius providentia in sui dispositione non fallitur te supplices exoramus ut noxia cuncta submoveas et omnia nobis profutura concedas
translation_en: We humbly appeal to the God whose providence never fails in its arrangement, that you move away all harmful things and grant us everything beneficial.

text: Deus cuius regnum regnum est omnium saeculorum supplicationes nostras clementer exaudi et romanorum regum tibi subditum protege principatum ut in tua virtute fidentes et tibi placeant et super omnia regna praecellant.
translation_en: God, whose kingdom is the kingdom of all ages, hear our humble pleas with clemency and protect the Roman kings who are subject to you. May they govern with confidence in your power, please you, and excel over all other kingdoms because of your virtue.

text: Deus cuius regnum nulla saecula praevenerunt nulla concludunt tempora supplicationes nostras clementer exaudi et romanorum regum tibi subditum protege principatum ut in tua virtute fidentes omnibus sint hostibus fortiores.
translation_en: God whose kingdom no ages have preceded, and none shall end the bounds of our supplications, hear us graciously and protect the realm subdued to you by Roman kings. May all be stronger against their enemies as they trust in your power.

text: Deus cuius solum potestate hominem nec mors tollit quia tibi et ipsa subiecta est Deus apud quem bonus gaudebit se vitam invenisse post mortem malus dolebit se mortem invenisse post vitam dum et hunc affecturus sit cruciatus legis et illum refecturus sit transitus temporalis te pro requie fidelium defunctorum illorum praesentium immolatione obsecramus libaminum ut eos a quocumque reatu in quo carnali crimine decepti incurrerunt fides qua te agnoverunt crediderunt rogaverunt a laqueis diaboli liberet et hoc sacrificium a mortalibus culpis reos mortalitatis excuset. Ac si eos pro modo animadversionis sententia vindicantis obnoxiet et quod praeceptum tuum occupati mundi erroribus non impleverunt hoc saltem eis misericordia parcente aeternum subveniat ad remedium quo te in veritate Deum unum in Trinitate confessi sunt.
translation_en: To the God whose power alone can prevent man from death, because before Him the good will rejoice that they have found life after death, while the wicked will lament having found death after life; we beseech You on behalf of the faithful departed who are present, through the offering of incense, that You may free them from any guilt in which they were deceived by carnal sin, and that this sacrifice may excuse the guilty from the charges of mortality. As if they suffer according to the sentence of the avenger, we pray that at least for their sake, mercy may come to their aid, since they have confessed You as one God in Trinity. May it at least help them towards the remedy when they were preoccupied with worldly errors and did not fulfill Your commandments.

text: Deus cuius spiritu totum corpus ecclesiae multiplicatur et regitur conserva in nova familiae tuae progenie sanctificationis gratiam quam dedisti ut corpore et mente renovati in unitate fidei ferventes tibi domino servire mereantur.
translation_en: God, whose spirit enlarges and governs the entire body of the church, conserve in your new family the grace of sanctification that you have given, so that being renewed in body and mind, they may merit to serve you, Lord, fervently united in faith.

text: Deus cuius sponsa sanctimonialis Austreberta de horto paradisi malum punicum misit infirmae sorori da ut haec eucharistia dulcis super omnia pomorum genera pro tantae virginis honore sanet omnes nostros languores.
translation_en: God, whose bride is the holy Austreberta from the garden of paradise, sent her a punic apple weak to her infirm sister, so that this sweet Eucharist would heal all our weaknesses for the great honor of such a virgin.

text: Deus cuius tam immensa est bonitas quam potestas praesta quod iustis polliceris accipere quod reis minaris evadere; veraciter te credere rationabiliter confiteri salubriter conversari si quies adrideat te colere si temptatio ingruat non negare temporariae vitae necessariis abundare aeternis gaudiis non carere.
translation_en: God, whose goodness and power are as immense, grant what you promise to the just to receive that which you threaten the wicked to escape from; truly believe, reasonably confess, healthily convert if peace beholds you worship, if temptation assails you not deny the necessities of temporal life nor lack eternal joys.

text: Deus cuius tanta est excellentia pietatis ut uno peccatore converso maximum gaudium facias in caelis haberi respice in exiguam populi portionem ut omni vexatione depulsa hereditas tua in numero augeatur et devotione proficiat.
translation_en: God, whose greatness of pity is such that the greatest joy is made for one repentant sinner in heaven, look upon the insignificant portion of our people and, freed from all vexation, may your inheritance increase in number and progress through devotion.

text: Deus cuius unigenitus de virgine nasci dignatus per passionem et mortem a perpetua nos morte liberavit et resurrectione sua aeternam vitam nobis contulit atque adscendens super omnes caelos sedensque ad dexteram tuam pro missum Spiritum Sanctum in filios adoptionis effudit praesta quaesumus ut qui haec fideliter credimus venientem quoque iudicem securi videamus.
translation_en: God, whose only-begotten one was deemed worthy to be born of a virgin, saved us from perpetual death by suffering and dying, and granted us eternal life through his resurrection. Ascending above all heavens, sitting at your right hand, you poured out the Holy Spirit as a pledge for adoption for your sons. Grant us our prayer that we who believe these things may confidently behold also the coming judge.

text: Deus cuius unigenitus in substantia nostrae carnis apparuit praesta quaesumus ut per eum quem similem nobis foris agnovimus intus reformari mereamur.
translation_en: God whose only-begotten one appeared in our flesh, grant us we ask, that through Him whom we recognize as similar to ourselves outside, we may be worthy of being reformed within.

text: Deus cuius universae viae misericordia est semper et veritas operis tui dona prosequere et quod possibilitas non habet fragilitatis humanae tuis beneficiis miseratus impende ut caelestibus mysteriis servientes et fidei integritate fundati et mentis luceant puritate conspicui.
translation_en: God, whose mercy is always on the paths of the universe and whose work is truth, may the grace of your gifts follow and bestow what human frailty cannot have through your mercies. Let it be poured out so that we who serve the celestial mysteries and are founded in the integrity of faith, shine with the purity of mind.

text: Deus cuius virtute beatissimus Victor carcerum squalores horrificos et dira tyranni superavit tormenta praesta quaesumus eiusdem intervenientibus meritis universas nos inimici insidias superare.
translation_en: We ask that God, by whose power the blessed Victor overcame the dreadful filth and horrible tortures of prisons under the tyranny, grant us through his same merits to overcome all the traps set by our enemies.

text: Deus cuius virtute sanctus martyr Christophorus diversa superavit tormenta fac nos quaesumus eius intervenientibus meritis universas inimici insidias superare.
translation_en: God, by whose power the holy martyr Christopher overcame diverse torments, we humbly ask that through his merits, may all of our enemies' traps be overcome.

text: Deus cuius virtute beatus Benedictus exstincta fecit pueri membra reviviscere praesta quaesumus nos eius meritis per afflatum tui spiritus vivificari.
translation_en: We ask that you grant us, through the breath of your Spirit, to be made alive by the merits of blessed Benedict, whose body you raised from the dead and caused the limbs of the children to revive.

text: Deus de cuius gratiae rore descendit ut ad mysteria tua purgatis sensibus accedamus praesta quaesumus ut in eorum traditione sollemniter honoranda competens deferamus obsequium.
translation_en: God, from whose grace we descend to approach your mysteries with purified senses, we humbly ask that you grant us the ability to appropriately honor them in their solemn tradition. Amen.

text: Deus Dei Filius cuius nomen mirificum per ora praedicantium dilatatur da nobis Torquati tui precibus et comitum eius ut in odorem unguentorum post te usquequaque curramus qualiter obliviscentes ea quae retro sunt sic ad supernae vocationis bravium procurramus ut de nominibus nostris caelesti pagina adnotatis perenni gaudio exsultemus id nobis specialiter tribuens ut pro defunctis omnibus nos exaudias postulantes.
translation_en: O God, Son of God, whose name is marvelous and spreads through the mouths of those who preach, grant us your prayers and those who accompany you, that we may run everywhere in the fragrance of ointments after you. Forgetting what lies behind, let us strive for the goal of the heavenly calling. In this way, let us advance to the prize of our high calling, so that from the celestial pages our names may be noted with eternal joy. May you particularly grant us that we may hear your favor for all the departed when we make our requests.

text: Deus Dei Filius in cuius nominis confessione martyris nostri membra et flammas superant et tormenta da nobis in caritate tua corda gestare flammantia ut caloris tui flammigero igne succensi nec peccati nos rubigo depretiet nec tepentis animi confessio decoloret quin potius reformati in gratiam quam nostris perdidimus meritis habeamus tecum partem in saeculis sempiternis.
translation_en: God, Son of God, in whose name our martyrs' bodies and flames overcome the torments and grant us in your love to bear flaming hearts, that the fire of your warmth may not blacken us with sin nor redden confession of a tepid soul, but rather that reformed in grace, we may have a part with you in eternal ages beyond what we have lost through our merits.

text: Deus desperantium salus errantium via et peccantium medicina qui beatissimas virgines Christetem et Callixtem quas virus hostis antiqui a proposito submoverat Christi tui praedicamentis simul ac precibus famulae tuae Dorotheae ad cultum christianae fidei revocasti pietas tua a nobis ita peccandi casum pellat ac peccandi causas removeat ut desperationis laqueos nec incurramus defluentes per vitia nec intingamus oberrantes per ignorantiam quo sicut illae post lapsum promotae sunt ad martyrii palmam ita nobis post crimina donetur te miserante corona.
translation_en: God is the salvation of the despairing, the way for the lost, and the medicine for the sinning. You who brought back the most blessed virgins Christeta and Callista, whom the ancient enemy had purposely disturbed through your teachings and prayers of your servant Dorothea to the practice of Christian faith. Your pity cast off our sinning misfortune and remove the causes of sin so that we do not fall into the snares of despair nor flow down through vices, nor are we stained by running through ignorance, just as they were promoted after their fall to the palm of martyrdom, so may you grant us a crown of mercy, you being merciful.

text: Deus dierum temporumque nostrorum potens et benigne moderator collatis in me per gratiam tuam propitiare muneribus et in hunc affectum dirige cor plebis et praesulis ut nec pastori oboedientia gregis nec gregi desit cura pastoris.
translation_en: God, powerful and benevolent moderator of our days, through your grace make propitious towards me with your gifts, and direct the heart of the people and bishop so that neither is the care of the shepherd lacking for the flock nor is the obedience of the flock lacking for the pastor.

text: Deus Ecclesiae tuae redemptor atque perfector fac quaesumus ut apostolorum precibus paschalis sacramenti dona capiamus quorum nobis ea tribuisti magisterio praedicari.
translation_en: We ask You, God of Your Church, Redeemer and Perfector, to grant that we may receive the gifts of the Apostles' prayers and the Paschal sacrament, which You have entrusted them to preach to us through their ministry.

text: Deus Ecclesiae tuae redemptor atque perfector da ut apostolorum tuorum Philippi et Iacobi precibus paschalis sacramenti dona capiamus quorum nobis magisterio ea voluisti praedicari.
translation_en: Grant to us, O God, Redeemer and Perfector of your Church, that we may receive the gifts of your apostles Philip and James through the prayers of the Paschal Sacrament, whose teachings you have willed to preach to us.

text: Deus electorum corona pontificum et gloriosa victoria certantium qui beatum Aelphegum et dignitate pontificatus et martyrii palma decorasti concede propitius ita nos apud te eius intercessionibus adiuvari ut ei in aeterna beatitudine possimus adunari.
translation_en: O God, crown of the chosen ones and glorious victory of those contending, who adorned the blessed Alphege with the dignity of the pontificate and the palm of martyrdom, grant us your favor so that we may be helped by his intercessions and be united with him in eternal beatitude.

text: Deus qui potestate virtutis
translation_en: God who has power through virtue

text: Deus et temporalis vitae auctor et aeternae miserere supplicum in tua protectione fidentium ut per virtutem brachii tui omnibus qui nobis adversantur devictis nec a terrenis nec a caelestibus possimus excludi.
translation_en: God, author of both temporal and eternal life, have mercy on the supplicants who trust in your protection, that through the power of your arm all who oppose us may be defeated, neither by terrestrial nor celestial forces can we be excluded.

text: Deus fidelis qui fidelia promissa confirmas dum vocatas gentes ex fide iustificas tu cognitionem nobis individuae tribue Trinitatis ut pacifici conversemur inter filios unitatis quo istius sanctae confessionis sacrificio potenter oblato visitationem tuam iugiter mereamur ab alto.
translation_en: God faithful, who confirms faithful promises as you call the nations to faith, grant us your individual understanding of the Trinity, so that we may be converted peacefully among the sons of unity, in whose sacred confession this offering is powerfully presented, may we always deserve your visitation from on high.

text: Deus fidelium lumen animarum adesto supplicationibus nostris et da omnibus quorum corpora hic requiescunt refrigerii sedem quietis beatitudinem luminis claritatem.
translation_en: God, light of faithful souls, be present to our supplications and grant to all whose bodies rest here a place of refreshment, peace, blessedness, and the light of clarity.

text: Deus fidelium receptor animarum praesta quaesumus ut famulus tuus ille et in perpetua luce quiescat et quod de hoc loco desideravit obtineat.
translation_en: God, receiver of the souls of faithful people, grant us that your servant may rest forever in eternal light and obtain what he desired from this place.

text: Deus fidelium redemptor animarum praesta quaesumus ut anima famuli tui illius in perpetua luce quiescat et inter electos tuos gaudia aeterna possideat.
translation_en: O God, Redeemer of souls, we humbly ask that you grant the soul of your servant to rest in eternal light and enjoy the eternal joys among your chosen ones.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum praesta ut beati Marcelli confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius venerandam celebramus festivitatem precibus indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: God, rewarder of the souls of the faithful, grant that we may obtain the indulgence through our prayers as we celebrate the festival of your blessed confessor and bishop, Marcellus.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum praesta ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus et per preces beati Zoilli confessoris tui cui(us) venerandam celebramus sollemnitatem {precibus eius} indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: God, rewarder of the souls of the faithful, grant that through these holy things which we have received and through the prayers of your venerable confessor Saint Zoilus, whose solemnity we reverently celebrate, we may obtain his indulgence.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum praesta ut celebritate praesenti sancti confessoris tui et episcopi illius sit nobis veneranda sollemnitas et placitorum tibi precibus indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: God, rewarder of the faithful souls, grant that the solemnity of your holy confesor and bishop be for us a venerable occasion in this present time, and may we obtain indulgence through your prayers.

text: Deus qui primis temporibus impleta
translation_en: God who was filled in the earliest times

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum qui hunc diem beati Apollinaris sacerdotis tui martyrio consecrasti tribue quaesumus nobis famulis tuis ut cuius venerandam celebramus festivitatem precibus eius indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: O God, rewarder of souls, who on this day consecrated the priesthood of the blessed Apollinaris through his martyrdom, we humbly ask you to grant us, your servants, that by celebrating his venerable feast day with our prayers, we may obtain his indulgence.

text: Deus fidelium remunerator animarum praesta ut beati Willibrordi confessoris tui et pontificis intercessione populus tuus fidelis indulgentiam suorum peccatorum consequi mereatur cuius venerandam hodierna die celebramus festivitatem.
translation_en: May the rewarder of faithful souls, God, grant that through the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop, Saint Willibrord, your faithful people may deserve to obtain forgiveness for their sins, whose reverent day we celebrate today.

text: Deus fons bonitatis et pietatis origo qui peccantem non statim iudicas sed ad paenitentiam miseratus exspectas te quaeso ut facinorum meorum squalores abstergas et me ad peragendum iniunctum officium dignum efficias ut qui altaris tui ministerium suscepi indignus perago trepidus ad id peragendum reddat strenuus et inter eos qui tibi placuerunt inveniar iustificatus.
translation_en: God, font of goodness and origin of pity, who judges not the sinner immediately but shows mercy to the penitent, I humbly ask that you purge the stains of my sins and make me strong to fulfill the duties required of me, unworthy as I am to undertake them. May I perform this task with courage, and among those who are pleasing to you may I be found justified.

text: Deus fons pacis atque origo purae dilectionis fac nos ut te in tympano veraciter laudemus et choro ut qui te per attritae carnis abstinentiam in tympano personamus per concordiam alternae dilectionis in choro una voce cum societate laudemus.
translation_en: God, source of peace and origin of pure love, make us so that we truly praise you on the harp, and in a choir, we who represent you through the abstinence of afflicted flesh on the harp, do it harmoniously with alternating love in the choir, we praise you with one voice in harmony with society.

text: Deus formator humanae reformatorque naturae fac cor nostrum immaculatum ut non confundamur nostro merito qui semper in tuo habemus auxilium.
translation_en: God, the shaper and reformer of human nature, make our hearts immaculate so that we are not confused by our own merit, who always have help in you.

text: Deus generis institutor et reparator humani praesta quaesumus ut plebs tua et sacramentis instructa salutaribus et fulta praesidiis sic praesentia dona percipiat ut capere mereatur aeterna.
translation_en: God, the institutor and restorer of the human race, we humbly ask that you grant to your people, who have been instructed in salvific sacraments and are filled with protective graces, that they may receive your presence in such a way that they deserve to grasp eternal life.

text: Deus gloriae cui complacuit in unigenito tuo omnem plenitudinem habitare omnes principatus et potestates exuere atque in eo reconciliare omnia in quo condideras universa adspice festivas subditae congregationis excubias accipe preces paschalibus supplicationibus votivas et qui dedisti nobis dominicae resurrectionis temporum revolutione victoriam da nobis ipsius festivitatis operum sanctificatione laetitiam.
translation_en: To God of glory, who has delighted in your Unigenito to dwell in all fullness, strip off all principalities and powers, and reconcile all things in whom you have established all, look upon the festive congregation's watch, accept prayers, paschal supplications, and vows. Who gave us victory through the revolution of the Lord's resurrection days, grant us the sanctification of its festivity's works, give us joy.

text: Deus gratiae dator et gloriae tuae nobis propitius sinum aperi pietatis et praesta ut qui manentem civitatem hic non habemus ad futuram quam quaerimus beatae Hedwigis interveniente suffragio perducamur.
translation_en: God, giver of grace and glory, be merciful to us and open the bosom of your mercy. Grant that we who do not possess this transient city may be led by the intercession of the blessed Hedwig to the future city which we seek.

text: Deus humanae salutis operator da nobis exercere ieiunia congruenter quibus nostrae substantiae sempiterna remedia providisti.
translation_en: God, who operates our salvation, grant us to exercise fasting suitably, for which you have provided eternal remedies for our substance.

text: Deus qui prospicis quia ex nostram
translation_en: God who looks down upon us from us

text: Deus humanarum mentium lux aeterna tu paternis iniquitatibus obscuratos illumina ut restauret gratuita gratia quidquid perdidit vitiata natura ut qui in nobis aliquando tenebrae fuimus in te semper lucidi esse possimus. Nulla nobis amplius delictorum nebula dominetur nulla nox iniquitatis te in nobis iugiter lucente nascatur. Esto famulis tuis perpetuus dies in quo ambulantes non erremus ulterius sed proficiamus in melius viam Christi dilatato corde currentes et vestigia Salvatoris cum eo qui caecus natus est amplectentes. Haec est enim victima salutaris haec oblatio sacrificii singularis; adorare unigenitum tuum in veritate nostri corporis natum et spreta malignantium synagoga cognoscere te in gentibus exaltatum.
translation_en: Eternal light of human minds, you, our Father, illuminate those obscured by your paternal iniquities, that gratuitous grace may restore whatever was lost due to corrupt nature. Thus, we who have been darkness at some point may always be able to remain bright in you. No more shall the cloud of sin dominate us, no night of wickedness be born among us as long as you shine upon us. May there be an everlasting day for your servants, where walking, we may not stray further but progress in the better way of Christ, running with hearts enlarged and following the steps of the Savior. We who were born blind embrace him. This is indeed the saving victim, this the unique offering, to worship your only-begotten Son in truth, born of our body, and to recognize you exalted among the nations.

text: Deus humani generis conditor et redemptor da quaesumus ut reparationis nostrae collata subsidia te iugiter inspirante sectemur.
translation_en: God, creator and redeemer of the human race, we humbly ask you to grant us the means for our restoration. May we ever follow a path that is inspired by you.

text: Deus humani generis conditor et redemptor qui ineffabili pietatis munere martyrum tuorum gloriosa certamina potentissimus largitor remuneras praesta quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae quae sanctorum martyrum tuorum Nazarii et Celsi laetatur triumphis et a peccatorum servari contagiis et quod illi te confitendo meruerunt percipere hoc populus tuus eorum consequi mereatur suffragiis.
translation_en: God, creator and redeemer of the human race, who by an ineffable gift of piety distributed glorious rewards to your martyrs, we beseech you to reward your Church which rejoices in the triumphs of the saints Nazarius and Celsus. May it be preserved from the contagion of sin and may that people deserve to follow in their footsteps through their prayers.

text: Deus humilium consolator et fidelium fortitudo propitius esto supplicibus ut humana fragilitas quae per se proclivis est ad labendum per te semper muniatur ad standum et quae per se prona est ad offensam per te semper reparetur ad veniam.
translation_en: God, the consoler of the humble and the fortitude of the faithful, be propitious to the suppliant, that human frailty, which is naturally prone to fall by itself, may always be strengthened by you to stand firm, and that which is naturally inclined to offense by itself may always be repaired by you to obtain forgiveness.

text: Deus humilium consolator et fidelium fortitudo propitius esto supplicibus et da ut humana fragilitas quae per se proclivis est ad labem per te semper reparetur ad veniam.
translation_en: God, comforter of the humble and strength of the faithful, be propitious to the suppliant ones and grant that human frailty, which is inclined towards sin by its own nature, may always be restored to grace through you.

text: Deus humilium consolator et fortitudo fragilium propitius tuis adesto supplicibus ut humana fragilitas quae per se declivis est ad cadendum per te semper in studio caritatis muniatur ad standum.
translation_en: God, the comforter of the humble and strength of the weak, be propitious to your suppliants. May fragile humanity, which is naturally inclined to fall, by you always be fortified in the study of charity, to stand firm.

text: Deus humilium visitator qui nos fraterna dilectione consolaris praetende societati nostrae gratiam tuam ut per eos in quibus habitas tuum in nobis sentiamus adventum.
translation_en: God, visitor of the humble, who console us with brotherly love, extend your grace to our society, that through them in whom you dwell, we may feel your presence among us.

text: Deus humilium visitator qui nos Sancti Spiritus illustratione consolaris praetende super hunc famulum tuum illum gratiam tuam ut per eum tuum in nobis adesse sentiamus adventum.
translation_en: God, visitor of the humble, who comfort us by the enlightenment of the Holy Spirit, grant grace to this your servant that we may feel your presence through him, as he comes among us.

text: Deus illuminator gentium qui per Spiritus Sancti gratiam almam tuam virginem Otiliam a nativa oculorum caecitate dignatus es liberare praesta quaesumus ut apud tuam misericordiam ipsa suffragante absolvas taetras nostri cordis caligines ut pura tibi mente serviamus et a peccatis nostris misericorditer absolvamur.
translation_en: God, enlightener of the nations, who by the grace of the Holy Spirit deemed it fitting to free the noble virgin Otilia from her native blindness, we humbly ask that through her intercession you grant us forgiveness. May we serve you with a pure mind and be mercifully absolved from our sins.

text: Deus illuminator omnium gentium da populis tuis perpetua pace gaudere et illud lumen splendidum infunde cordibus nostris quod trium magorum mentibus adspirasti.
translation_en: God, enlightener of all nations, may your people enjoy eternal peace and pour that brilliant light into our hearts which you inspired in the minds of the three Magi.

text: Deus immortalis atque aeterne tu votis offerentium propitiatus occurre ut sacrificii huius litatione sic ieiunii nostri acceptetur precatio qualiter quiescentibus defunctis donetur beatitudinis plenitudo.
translation_en: God, the immortal and eternal one, appear propitiated by the offerings of those who pray to you. May this sacrifice be accepted through this litany as our fasting prayer. May the fullness of beatitude be given to the resting dead.

text: Deus in cuius baptismate paterna vox intonuit et Spiritus Sanctus in specie columbae apparuit da nobis tanti sacramenti mysterium et dignis sensibus venerari et puris mentibus contemplari.
translation_en: God, in whose baptism the fatherly voice resounded and the Holy Spirit appeared in the form of a dove, grant us the mystery to reverence and the pure minds to contemplate this great sacrament.

text: Deus in cuius conspectu mors est pretiosa sanctorum tribue ut nobis fidelis vita conferat quidquid illis mors devota concessit.
translation_en: God, in whose sight death is precious to saints, grant us that faithful life confers upon them whatever death devoted has granted.

text: Deus in cuius conspectu sanctus Michael gloriosus assistit praesta quaesumus ut ibi pro populo tuo exorare dignetur ubi gratiam tuam semper meretur habere praesentem.
translation_en: God, in whose presence the glorious St. Michael assists, grant us our prayer, that there he may be worthy to intercede for your people, where he always deserves to have Your grace present.

text: Deus in cuius dextera salus nostra est praesta ut ad te non ore tantum sed corde vigilemus; timorem tui nominis nostris immitte visceribus et amorem infunde pectoribus quia si dederis te timendum da<re pot>es et amandum.
translation_en: God in whose right hand is our salvation, grant that we may vigilantly watch to you not only with our mouth but also with our heart; let the fear of your name be imprinted on our innards and let love be poured into our breasts, for if you give us something to fear, you can make us capable of loving.

text: Deus in cuius libro sunt vocabula notata mortalium concede nobis omnibus veniam delictorum et praesta quaesumus ut famulum tuum illum infirmum quem immensus languor excruciat tua miseratio reparet ad medelam et si ei ambitio piaculi adduxit dolorem adducat etiam confessio salutis optabilem sanitatem.
translation_en: God in whose book the words of mortals are noted, grant us all forgiveness for our sins and pray for us that your servant, the sick man whom great pain excruciates, may Your mercy heal. And if ambition for sin has brought him pain, let also confession of salvation bring him desirable health.

text: Deus in cuius manu corda sunt regum inclina ad preces humilitatis nostrae aures misericordiae tuae et principibus nostris famulis tuis illis regimen tuae appone sapientiae ut haustis de tuo fonte consiliis et tibi placeant et super omnia regna praecellant.
translation_en: God, in whose hand are the hearts of kings, incline to our humble prayers the ears of your mercy and grant rule to our princes your servants, that they may govern with your wisdom, drawing counsel from your fountain. May they please you and excel over all kingdoms.

text: Deus in cuius manu est et humiliare superbos et allevare contritos tu contritionis nostrae ieiunium inspice et offerentium vota placabili bonitate sustolle quo et nobis piaminum venia concedatur et in pace dominica quiescentibus per hoc sacrificium requies impetretur.
translation_en: God, in whose hand is to humble the proud and to raise up the contrite, look upon our contrition and the offerings of those seeking mercy, and sustain them with your gracious goodness. May we, too, be granted pardon for our sins, and may those resting in peace find repose through this sacrifice.

text: Deus in cuius manu sunt corda regum qui es humilium consolator et fidelium fortitudo et protector in te sperantium da regi nostro illi et reginae nostrae illi populoque christiano triumphum virtutis tuae scienter excolere ut per te semper reparentur ad veniam.
translation_en: God, whose hands hold the hearts of kings, who is a comfort to the humble, strength for the faithful, and a protector for those hoping in you, grant our king and queen this people a triumph of your virtue, that they may always rejoice in pardon through you.

text: Deus in cuius passione secundum Simeonis prophetiam dulcissimam animam gloriosae virginis et matris Mariae doloris gladius pertransivit concede propitius ut qui transfixionem eius et passionem venerando recolimus gloriosis meritis et precibus omnium sanctorum cruci fideliter assistentium intercedentibus passionis tuae effectum felicem consequamur.
translation_en: God, in whose passion according to the prophecy of Simeon, the most sweet soul was pierced by the sword of sorrow of the glorious virgin and mother Mary, mercifully grant that we who venerate his transfixion and passion may attain its glorious merits and the help of all saints faithfully assisting at the cross and interceding may bring about a happy outcome of your Passion.

text: Deus in cuius praecipuis mirabilibus est humana reparatio solve opera diaboli et mortifera peccati vincula disrumpe ut destructa malignitate quae nocuit vincat misericordia quae redemit.
translation_en: God in whose most wondrous works is the restoration of man, loosen the works of the devil and break the deadly bonds of sin, that the malice which has caused harm may be vanquished by mercy that has redeemed.

text: Deus in quo est omnium iustorum requies et pax certa sanctorum tribue nobis pacificas hostias tibi digne offerre ut perfectionem pacis qua tui sancti iam fruuntur in caelis nos iugiter hanc meditemur in terris.
translation_en: God, in whom is the rest of all righteous souls and certain peace for the saints, grant us worthy offerings of peaceful sacrifices, so that on earth we may continually seek the peace which your saints already enjoy in heaven.

text: Deus in quo est omnium iustorum requies et pax certa sanctorum dona nobis quaesumus in tua firmiter caritate laetari ut perfectionem pacis qua tui iam sancti fruuntur in caelis hanc nos iugiter meditemur in terris.
translation_en: God, in whom is the rest of all just souls and a certain peace of saints, grant us, we beseech you, that we may rejoice firmly in your love so that we may constantly seek the perfection of peace which your saints now enjoy in heaven, on earth.

text: Deus in quo totius salvationis summa consistit exaudi preces quas nos indigni tibi suppliciter fundimus et mitte sanctum angelum tuum de caelis qui hanc congregationem et hunc locum ab omnibus antiqui hostis defendat insidiis.
translation_en: God in whom the summit of all salvation resides, hear the prayers which we humbly pour out to you as unworthy ones, and send your holy angel from heaven who may defend this congregation and this place from every ancient enemy's snares.

text: Deus in quo vivimus movemur et sumus pluviam nobis tribue congruentem ut praesentibus subsidiis sufficienter adiuti sempiterna fiducialius appetamus.
translation_en: God, in whom we live, moves us; grant us a fitting rain that we may be sufficiently helped by present aid, so that with eternal confidence we may more eagerly seek you.

text: Deus in te sperantium fortitudo a quo est perversorurn correctio respice quaesumus super homines iniquos servis tuis adversantes et ne iram tuae indignationis incurrant fac nos de eorum tibi placita satisfactione laetari.
translation_en: We beseech You, God of those who hope in You, the correcting power against perversity; look upon wicked men opposing Your servants. May they not encounter Your wrath and indignation. Let us rejoice in their pleasing satisfaction to You.

text: Deus in te sperantium fortitudo adesto propitius intercedente beato Iob cum omnibus sanctis tuis invocationibus nostris ut sicut post ulceris pessimi variorumque flagellorum pressuras duplicia pro omnibus amissis reddidisti ita nobis misericordiam tuam largiter impartiaris.
translation_en: God, strength of those who hope in you, be present graciously, through the intercession of blessed Job with all your saints. Grant us that just as after the pressure of the most severe ulcers and various scourges, you restored double to all that was lost, so too may you lavishly bestow your mercy upon us.

text: Deus in te sperantium fortitudo adesto propitius invocationibus nostris et quia sine te nihil potest mortalis infirmitas praesta auxilium gratiae tuae ut in exsequendis mandatis tuis et voluntate tibi et actione placeamus.
translation_en: May the strength of God be present for those who hope in Him, gracious in our supplications. And because without You, no earthly weakness can do anything, grant us help through Your grace, so that we may please You in fulfilling Your commands and will through action.

text: Deus in te sperantium fortitudo conserva in populis tuis quod es dignatus operam potentis misericordiae tuae ostende virtutem ut qui superba impetimur hostiurn feritate tua mereamur pace gaudere.
translation_en: God, the strength of those who hope in you, preserve your people as you have been pleased to do with the work of your powerful mercy. Show your power so that we who are arrogantly attacked by our enemies may deserve to rejoice in peace.

text: Deus in te sperantium misericors eruditor ab omni nos consortio pravitatis absolve nec ullis nos iniquitatum vinculis patiaris adstringi ut unde nobis est tota pietas inde sit tuta libertas.
translation_en: God, merciful to those who hope in you, educator, deliver us from all fellowship of wickedness. Do not allow us to be bound by any iniquity's chains. Instead, where our entire devotion is, there let our safety be the freedom.

text: Deus in te sperantium salus et servientium fortitudo suscipe propitius preces nostras et romani imperii adesto rectoribus ut tuis consiliis inspirati tua opitulatione muniti adversa omnia resistere sibi arma praevaleant.
translation_en: God, hope of those who hope in you and strength of those who serve you, graciously receive our prayers. Be present to the rulers of Rome that, inspired by your counsel and armed with your help, they may overcome all adversities.

text: Deus in te sperantium salus et tibi servientium fortitudo suscipe propitius preces nostras et da famulo tuo illi regi et cuncto exercitui eius regimen tuae sapientiae ut haustis pio de fonte consiliis et tibi placeant et de omnibus suis adversariis efficiantur victores.
translation_en: God, to the hopeful you are salvation and to those serving you, strength. Receive our prayers graciously and grant your servant to this king and his entire army the governance of your wisdom, so that they may draw from the wellspring of pious counsel and please you, and overcome all their adversaries as victors.

text: Deus indulgentiae Deus totius consolationis te supplices deprecamur ut famulum tuum illum a cunctis peccatorum suorum nexibus et ab his quibus captus tenetur inimicorum suorum vinculis intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria et beatis apostolis tuis Petro et Paulo atque Ioanne benignus absolvas emendatumque paterna pietate suscipias et ad gaudia aeterna perducas.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, God of all mercy, that your servant is freed from the bonds of all his sins and from the chains in which he is held captive by his enemies' bonds, through the intercession of blessed Mother of God and your holy apostles Peter, Paul, and John. May you be merciful and absolve him, receive him graciously with paternal pity, and lead him to eternal joys.

text: Deus indulgentiarum Domine da famulo tuo illi cuius anniversarium depositionis diem commemoramus refrigerii sedem quietis beatitudinem luminis claritatem.
translation_en: God of mercies, Lord, grant to your servant the one whose anniversary of departure we remember, a seat of refreshment, a place of rest, a state of blessedness, a light of clarity.

text: Deus ineffabilis misericordiae qui beatissimum regem Edmundum tribuisti pro tuo nomine inimicum moriendo vincere concede propitius familiae tuae ut eo interveniente mereatur in se antiqui hostis incitamenta superando exstinguere.
translation_en: God, ineffable mercy, who granted the most blessed king Edmund to win his enemy while dying for your name, be merciful, we pray, to your family. May they deserve, through his intervention, to extinguish the provocation of the ancient enemy by overcoming it.

text: Deus ineffabilis misericordiae qui primae mulieris piacula per virginem Mariam expianda sanxisti da nobis quaesumus conceptionis eius sollemnia digne venerari quae unigenitum tuum virgo concepit et virgo peperit.
translation_en: God, ineffable mercy, who through the Virgin Mary established the penance for the first woman's sin to be worthy of celebration, grant us that we may fittingly honor the solemnity of her conception. For it was through a virgin that your only begotten son was conceived and born as a virgin.

text: Deus ineffabilis rerum conditor universarum qui famulis tuis annuam hodiernae festivitatis laetitiam in veneranda almae virginis tuae praecluis Aetheldrythae tribuisti commemoratione quaesumus ut eadem interveniente vitiorum incentiva queamus nociva superare et ad te summum bonum qui vera lux es callis ac pietas divinitus pervenire.
translation_en: O ineffable Creator of all things, who granted to your servants the joy of this annual festivity in honor of the venerable Alma Virgo (Mary) and the blessed Aetheldrythae, we humbly ask that through their commemoration we may overcome the temptations of vice and be able to reach you, the highest good who are true light, and guided by piety and holiness.

text: Deus inenarrabilis gloriae et pietatis immensae qui sanctos tuos ante mundi constitutionem in aeterna tibi gloria praeparasti suscipe propitius preces et munera quae in honorem et venerationem Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctorumque apostolorum martyrum confessurum ac virginum omniumque electorum tuorum in conspectu pietatis tuae humiliter deferimus et praesta ut apud maiestatem tuam et remissionem peccatorum et beatitudinis suae nobis impetrent consortium.
translation_en: God of ineffable glory and immeasurable piety, who prepared your saints before the establishment of the world for eternal glory to you, graciously receive our prayers and offerings which we humbly bring in honor and veneration of God, the Mother of Christ Mary, the apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all the elect in your sight. And grant that they may intercede for us before your majesty, for the forgiveness of our sins and for their own beatitude, and bring us into their company.

text: Deus infinitae misericordiae et bonitatis immensae propitiare iniquitatibus nostris et omnibus animarum nostrarum medere languoribus ut peccatorum nostrorum remissione percepta semper in tua benedictione laetemur.
translation_en: May the God of infinite mercy and immense goodness be propitious to our iniquities, and may He heal all the infirmities of our souls so that we may always rejoice in Your blessing, having perceived the remission of our sins.

text: Deus infinitae misericordiae et bonitatis immensae propitiare peccatis famuli tui illius et omnibus animae eius medere languoribus ut miserationum tuarum remissione percepta in tua indulgentia laetetur.
translation_en: May the God of infinite mercy and immense goodness propitiate the sins of your servant and all his soul, healing its weaknesses, so that it may rejoice with the perception of your mercy's remission in Your indulgence.

text: Deus infinitae misericordiae et maiestatis immensae quem nec spatia locorum nec intervalla temporum ab his quos tueris abiungunt adesto famulis tuis in te ubique fidentibus et per omnem quam ituri sunt viam dux eis et comes esse dignare; nihil illis adversitatis noceat nihil difficultatis obsistat; cuncta eis salubria cuncta sint prospera et sub ope dexterae tuae quidquid iusto expetierint desiderio celeri consequantur effectu.
translation_en: God of infinite mercy and immense majesty, who are beyond the spaces of places and intervals of time for those you protect, be present to your servants who trust in you everywhere. May you grant to lead them and be with them as they go through every way. Let nothing hurt them, let nothing obstruct them; may all things be healthy and prosperous for them, and whatever they have justly desired, may it swiftly follow in effect under the protection of your right hand.

text: Deus qui tenebras ignorantiae
translation_en: God who knows not darkness of ignorance

text: Deus infinitae misericordiae et maiestatis immensae qui beatum Achatium eum decem milibus contubernalibus suis crucis patibulum subire fecisti tribue quaesumus ut eius sacris petitionibus fructum crucis in nobis consequi valeamus.
translation_en: God of infinite mercy and immense majesty, who made the blessed Achatius suffer the cross along with ten thousand companions, grant us, we pray, that we may be able to obtain the fruit of the cross through his sacred petitions.

text: Deus infirmitatis humanae singulare praesidium auxilii tui super infirmos nostros ostende virtutem ut ope misericordiae tuae adiuti Ecclesiae tuae sanctae repraesentari mereantur.
translation_en: May the singular refuge of help for human weakness, Your power, be shown over our infirm, that they may deserve to be assisted by Your mercy and represent Your holy Church.

text: Deus innocentiae restitutor et amator dirige ad te tuorum corda famulorum ut quos de infidelitatis tenebris liberasti numquam a tuae veritatis luce discedant.
translation_en: God, restorer and lover of innocence, direct the hearts of your servants to you, so that those whom you have freed from the darkness of unfaithfulness may never depart from the light of your truth.

text: Deus et reparator innocentiae et amator dirige ad te tuorum corda servorum ut de infidelitatis tenebris liberati numquam a tuae virtutis luce discedant.
translation_en: God and restorer of innocence, and lover, direct the hearts of your servants to you, so that, freed from the shadows of unfaithfulness, they may never depart from the light of your virtue.

text: Deus innocentiae restitutor et amator dirige ad te tuorum corda servorum ut spiritus tui fervore concepto et in fide inveniantur stabiles et in opere efficaces.
translation_en: God, Restorer and Lover of innocence, direct the hearts of your servants to you, so that they may find steadfastness in faith and be effective in deeds with a spirit conceived by fervor.

text: Deus iustitiae Deus misericordiae Deus immortalitatis et vitae Deus splendoris et gratiae quaesumus te et oramus ut divinis muneribus recreati in illa beatitudine servemur a te tibi.
translation_en: We ask and pray to You, God of justice, God of mercy, God of immortality and life, God of splendor and grace, that, being re-created by divine gifts, we may remain in that beatitude under Your care and service to You.

text: Deus lactantium fides spes infantium caritas puerorum qui per innocentium tuorum Iusti et Pastoris laudem cunctos provocas ad salutem infunde in nobis quaesumus puritatem laetantis infantiae ut dum sensu iustitiae parvulis adaequamur in illa remuneratione fidelium pariter gloriemur sicque eorum interventu hiis hostiis benedicito ut ex his sumentes et peccaminum eluantur labe et purae confessionis potiantur dulcedine.
translation_en: God of the weeping, faith, hope, and love of children, who through your just and shepherd innocents summon all to salvation, pour into us the purity of rejoicing infancy that we may match the senses of justice for the little ones in that reward of faithful alike, so that with their intervention we may bless these offerings. May they partake of them and be cleansed from sin's stain, tasting the sweetness of a pure confession.

text: Deus largitor pacis et amator caritatis da servis tuis veram cum tua voluntate concordiam ut ab omnibus quae nos pulsant temptationibus liberemur.
translation_en: God, giver of peace and lover of charity, grant your servants true harmony according to your will, that we may be freed from all temptations which assail us.

text: Deus lumen indeficiens sanctorum tuorum nos quaesumus attolle beneficiis donorum atque consecuta abolitione peccatorum sancti interventu Machuti caelestium infulis adscribe gaudiorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, the unfailing light of Your saints, to lift us up with Your blessings and gifts, and through the successful removal of our sins, to assign the joys of heaven under the influence of Saint Machutus, the celestial crowns.

text: Deus misericordiae Deus pietatis Deus indulgentiae indulge quaeso et miserere famulo tuo illi ut delictorum quae tibi ex ore aperuit nulla in eo macula reservetur in terris sed per paenitentiae luctum ad tua mereatur pervenire pro missa.
translation_en: God of mercy, God of pity, God of forgiveness, I humbly ask that you forgive and have mercy on your servant, so that no stain of the sins he confessed to you on earth may remain in him, but through the sorrow of penance, he may be worthy to reach you because of the Mass.

text: Deus misericordiae Deus pietatis Deus indulgentiae indulge quaeso et miserere mei; sacrificium quoque quod pietatis tuae gratia humiliter offero benigne digneris suscipere et peccata quae labentibus vitiis contraxi pius et propitius ac miseratus indulgeas et locum paenitentiae ac flumina lacrimarum concessa venia a te merear accipere.
translation_en: God of mercy, God of pity, God of indulgence, I humbly ask and entreat you to forgive me. The sacrifice that I offer with the grace of your piety, kindly deign to accept. May you generously pardon the sins that I have contracted due to my falling vices. Be gracious, propitious, and merciful, and may you grant me the place of penitence and the rivers of tears that I might deserve forgiveness through your granted mercy.

text: Deus misericordiae Deus pietatis Deus indulgentiae peccaminum indulge quaesumus et miserere nostri; hoc sacrificium quod pietatis tuae gratia in commemorationem martyrum et confessorum tuorum illorum humiliter pro peccatis nostris offerimus benigne dignare suscipere ut peccata quae labentibus vitiis nostris contraximus et egimus per ipsorum merita et intercessionem pius ac propitius et miseratus praeterita et praesentia indulgeas et ut futura non committamus in omnibus te obsecramus nos custodiri iubeas.
translation_en: We entreat you, God of mercy, God of pity, God of forgiveness, grant us your indulgence and mercy; this sacrifice which, through the grace of your piety, we humbly offer in memory of your martyrs and confessors for our sins, benignly deign to receive. May you graciously accept that, because of our waning vices, we have contracted and committed sins; through their merits and intercession, may a merciful and compassionate God pardon past and present sins and, moved by pity, may He also pardon future sins. In all things, we humbly beseech you to protect us. Command us to be guarded.

text: Deus misericordiae sempiternae qui in ipso paschalis festi recursu fidem sacratae tibi plebis accendis auge gratiam quam dedisti ut digna omnes intellegentia comprehendant quo lavacro abluti quo spiritu regenerati quo sanguine sint redempti.
translation_en: Eternal God of mercy, who on this Paschal festival renew the faith of your sacred people and increase the grace you have given, that all may understand with intelligence what it means to be washed clean in baptism, regenerated by spirit, and redeemed by blood.

text: Deus misericors rex aeterne da servituti nostrae prosperum cursum et ut tibi in populi tui devotione placeamus tu sancto praeside gregi et ad tuorum observantiam mandatorum tu omnium dirige voluntates.
translation_en: Everlasting merciful King, grant a prosperous course to our servitude and may we please you in the devotion of your people. You, holy, preside over the flock and direct the will of all towards the observance of your commandments.

text: Deus qui vestimentum salutare
translation_en: God who wears the garment of salvation

text: Deus mundi auctor et conditor qui hodiernae festivitatis diem beati Ambrosii sacerdotii electione consecrasti praesta populo tuo ut cuius annua celebritate devotis resultat obsequiis eius suffragiis tuae pietatis consequatur auxilium.
translation_en: O God, author and creator of the world, who consecrated today's feast day of the blessed Ambrose on his election to the priesthood, grant your people that they may find assistance through his annual observance as a result of their devoted obedience. His intercessions may bring them the help of your mercy.

text: Deus qui vigilantes in laudibus tuis
translation_en: God who watches over us in Your praises

text: Deus mundi auctor et conditor qui hodiernae festivitatis diem beati Arnulfi confessoris tui atque pontificis migratione consecrasti praesta quaesumus ut cuius annua celebritate devotis exsultamus obsequiis eius suffragiis tuae pietatis consequamur auxilium.
translation_en: God, author and creator of the world, who consecrated today's festival of your confessor and bishop, blessed Arnulf, we humbly ask that you grant us to rejoice with devoted observances on account of his annual feast, and through his intercession may we obtain the help of your mercy.

text: Deus mundi creator et rector ad humilitatis meae preces placatus attende et me famulum tuum quem nullis suffragantibus meritis sed immensa largitate clementiae caelestibus mysteriis servire tribuisti dignum sacris altaribus fac ministrum ut quod mea celebrandum voce depromitur tua potius sanctificatione firmetur.
translation_en: God, creator and ruler of the world, moved by my humble prayers, attend to me, your servant, whom you have deemed worthy to serve at your sacred altars not because of any merits I possess but by an immense outpouring of celestial clemency. Grant that what is to be celebrated with my voice may be strengthened by your sanctification.

text: Deus qui virtute Sancti Spiritus
translation_en: God who has the power of the Holy Spirit

text: Deus mundi creator et rector apud quem totum providentia geritur totum ratione subsistit praesta quaesumus ut et nos discedamus a vitiis et tua tandem ira desistat.
translation_en: Creator and ruler of the world, under whose providence all things exist and are sustained by reason, grant us our prayer, that we may depart from vices and at last your wrath may cease.

text: Deus mundi creator et rector qui beatos apostolos Simonem et Iudam atque martyrem tuum Fidelem nominis tui gloria consecrasti exaudi populum tuum cum sanctorum tuorum tibi patrociniis supplicantem ut pacis dono proficiat ad fidei et caritatis augmentum.
translation_en: O Creator and Ruler of the world, who consecrated the blessed apostles Simon and Jude and your martyr Faithful, hear your people praying with the intercession of your saints. May peace, as a gift, progress towards an increase in faith and charity.

text: Deus mundi creator et rector qui beatos apostolos tuos ineffabili gloria decorasti exaudi populum tuum eorum doctrinis imbutum ut per eos proficiat ad fidei et caritatis augmentum.
translation_en: God, creator and ruler of the world, who adorned your blessed apostles with inexpressible glory, hear your people, steeped in their teachings, that through them they may progress towards an increase in faith and charity.

text: Deus mundi creator et rector qui hunc diem in levitae tui Laurentii martyrio consecrasti concede propitius ut omnes qui martyrii eius merita veneramur intercessionibus eius ab aeternis gehennae incendiis liberemur.
translation_en: God, creator and ruler of the world, who consecrated this day in the martyrdom of your deacon Laurence, grant us graciously that all who venerate the merits of his martyrdom may be freed from the eternal fires of hell through his intercessions.

text: Deus omnipotens mundi creator et redemptor qui hunc diem in levitae Stephani inventione consecrasti concede propitius ut qui martyrii eius merita veneramur intercessionibus eius ab aeternis ignitis lapidibus liberemur.
translation_en: O almighty Creator and Redeemer of the world, who consecrated this day in the finding of Saint Stephen, have mercy on us. Grant propitiously that we, who revere his martyr's merits, may be freed from the eternal fiery stones through his intercessions.

text: Deus mysteriorum caelestium et virtutum omnium eminentissimus inspirator nostras quaesumus preces exaudi et odoratam fissi corticis lacrimam quae felicis virgae profluendo sudorem sacerdotali nos opimat unguento acceptabilem tuis praesta mysteriis et concessa clemens benedictione sanctifica.
translation_en: We beseech you, the most eminent inspirer of celestial mysteries and all virtues, to hear our prayers. And grant us, through the fragrant tear from the broken cedar-wood, the sweat flowing from the happy rod, an acceptable ointment for us in your mysteries. May a merciful blessing consecrated sanctify it.

text: Deus nostrum refugium in laboribus virtus in infirmitatibus adiutorium in tribulationibus solamen in fletibus parce Domine parce populo tuo ne tradas bestiis animas confitentes tibi.
translation_en: Our God, refuge in labor, strength in weakness, aid in afflictions, consolation in tribulations, compassionate one in tears, Lord have mercy, have mercy on your people, lest you hand over souls confessing to you to beasts.

text: Deus omnipotens Deus misericors Deus clemens qui indulgentiam tuam nulla temporum lege concludis suscipe preces et hostias quas tibi pro indulgentia famuli tui illius deferimus ut et peccatorum ei veniam misericors largiaris et cordis eius recta desideria implere digneris.
translation_en: Almighty God, merciful God, gracious God, who encloses your indulgence without the law of time, receive our prayers and offerings which we bring to you on behalf of the indulgence for your servant. May a merciful God grant him pardon for his sins and may he deign to fulfill the right desires of his heart.

text: Deus omnipotens et aeterne quo iuvante athleta tuus Iulianus mortuum promeruit suscitare ab inferis invocato nomine Trinitatis tu pietate solita et offerentium suscipe vota et sopita corda a mortali actu exsuscita. Tribue quoque his sacrificiis largam tuae benedictionis impensionem quo et vivi revivescant in operibus bonis et defuncti carne suppliciis exuantur aeternis.
translation_en: Almighty and eternal God, by whose aid your athlete Julian was deemed worthy to be raised from the dead, invoking the name of the Holy Trinity, you are accustomed to receive petitions and quietened hearts from mortal actions. Grant also these offerings a generous outpouring of your blessing, so that both the living may revive in good works and the departed may be freed from eternal sufferings by their bodily penances.

text: Deus omnipotens et clemens qui solus das pluviam super terram solus mittis aquas sub inferiora caelorum dona servis tuis beneficium pluviale ut quod nostra facinora suspenderunt tuo munere praerogetur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who alone gives rain to the earth and sends waters from the clouds below, grant your servants the blessing of rain, so that what our sins have suspended may be bestowed by your mercy.

text: Omnipotens Deus qui solus aquas emittis e caelis dona servis tuis beneficium pluviae salutaris ut quod facinore nostro suspenditur tuo iam gratuito munere prorogetur.
translation_en: Almighty God, who alone sends waters from the heavens, grant to your servants the blessing of a healthful rain, that what our offense has suspended may be prolonged by your free gift.

text: Deus omnipotens exaudi populum tuum hac die ad gloriam resurrectionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui in tuo nomine congregatum et maiestatem tuam suppliciter exorantem dirige ex praesenti festivitate in laetitiam sempiternam atque ex hac hodiernae sollemnitatis exsultatione ad gaudia incorrupta transmitte.
translation_en: Almighty God, hear your people today for the glory of the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, gathered in Your name. Direct us from this present festivity to eternal joy, and from the exhilaration of this day's solemnity, send us to the uncorrupted joys.

text: Deus omnipotens qui ad salvandum partis nostrae conventum septem misisti specula sacerdotum eisdem intercedentibus quorum sacratissimae memoriae tuo recitantur altario Spiritum Sanctum de tuis sanctis sedibus mitte quo et oblatis hostiis sanctificationem et nostris pectoribus profusissimam impertias sanctitatem.
translation_en: Almighty God, who sent seven mirrors of the priesthood to save our assembly, through their intercession whose most sacred memory is recited on your altar. Send the Holy Spirit from your holy seats to bestow upon us the abundant sanctity of the offerings and upon our hearts the most profuse holiness.

text: Deus omnipotens qui angelicam humanamque naturam creans aliud praesciendo iudicii reprobatione condemnas aliud praedestinando veritatis assumptione glorificas tribue nobis te per redemptionis humanae sacramentum habere propitium et per societatem felicitatis angelicae perpetuis laudibus attollere gloriosum.
translation_en: Almighty God, who creates both the angelic and human nature, predestining some for the condemnation of judgment and others for the glory of truth's assumption, grant us that we may have you propitious to us through the sacrament of redeeming humanity, and lift up our glorious praise perpetually in the society of angelic happiness.

text: Deus omnipotens qui creando cuncta virtutem praetendis et redimendo homines immensam miserationem ostendis da nobis et redemptorem habere propitium et redemptionis nostrae digne percipere sacramentum.
translation_en: Almighty God, who show your power in creating all things and your immense mercy in redeeming mankind, grant us to have a propitious Redeemer and worthily to perceive the sacred sacrament of our redemption.

text: Deus omnipotens qui docuisti omnia humilitatis bono et caritatis studio posse servari respice ad membra Ecclesiae tuae atque ea quae emulatione discreta aut indignatione vitiata sunt in pace revoca atque compone.
translation_en: Almighty God, who has taught all things to be preserved by humility and the study of love, look upon the members of your Church, and those who are discreetly emulating or corrupted by unjust anger, and bring them back into peace and reconcile them.

text: Deus omnipotens qui nos indignos famulos tuos cum sacerdotibus tuis factura manuum tuarum ad hanc congregationem sociasti et sacris mysteriis tuis confortare dignatus nes corpore refectos et sanguine Domini nostri Iesu Christi praesta nobis petentibus famulis tuis per quem nostra exstincta sunt mala merita porrige manum tuam nobis lapsis aperi nobis ianuam regni tui per quam possimus introire in requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: Almighty God, who have made us unworthy servants part of this congregation with your priests and have deemed it worthy to strengthen us with your sacred mysteries, grant that we, nourished by your body and blood, may receive through our prayers the merits of your servant Jesus Christ, whose sins we have inherited. Through him, wipe away our past offenses, open for us the gateway to your kingdom, so that we may enter into eternal rest.

text: Deus omnipotentiae ac benignitatis Deus misericordiae atque pietatis qui Bethlehemiticae plebi ac dominicae civitati pro temporalibus aerumnis gaudia aeterna tribuisti ut Rachel sancta plorans filios suos quae praeferebat ex dolore luctum nollet ex consolatione solatium quia licet videretur de praesenti infantium amissione conterrita erat tamen beata ac de martyrum perpetuitate secura da cunctis Domine in hoc loco consistentibus et universae plebi istius loci ut sic habeant ex sanctae vitae conversatione palmam sicut habuerunt parvuli ex passione victoriam.
translation_en: God of omnipotence and benevolence, God of mercy and piety, who granted eternal joy to the Bethlehemite people and the Lordly city for their temporal sorrows, so that the holy Rachel weeping her children whom she bore out of sorrow would not want to mourn without comfort because although it seemed that she was terrified by the present loss of her children, yet she was blessed and secure from the perpetuity of martyrs. Grant this to all, Lord, in this place who are dwelling, and to the entire people of this place, so that they may have the palm of holy life's conversation, just as the little ones had victory from their passion.

text: Deus omnium fidelium pastor et rector famulum tuum illum quem Ecclesiae tuae praeesse voluisti propitius respice; da ei quaesumus verbo et exemplo quibus praeest proficere ut ad vitam una cum grege sibi credito perveniat sempiternam.
translation_en: God, shepherd and ruler of all faithful, have mercy on your servant whom you wished to preside over your Church. Grant him, we beseech you, with the word and example wherewith he presides, that he may prosper and thus reach eternal life with his flock which believes in him.

text: Deus omnium fortitudo sanctorum qui illis ad hanc gloriam veniendi copiosum munus gratiae contulisti nostris quaesumus veniam concede peccatis ut eorum sollemnia digne celebrare possimus.
translation_en: God, strength of all saints, who have bestowed upon them a plentiful gift of grace for coming to this glory, we humbly ask that you grant forgiveness for our sins so that we may worthy celebrate their solemnities.

text: Deus omnium misericordiarum ac totius bonitatis auctor qui peccatorum remedia ieiuniis orationibus et eleemosynis demonstrasti respice propitius in hanc humilitatis nostrae confessionem ut qui inclinamur conscientia nostra tua semper misericordia erigamur.
translation_en: God, author of all mercies and goodness, who has shown the remedies for sins through fasting, prayers, and alms, look upon us propitiously in this humility of our confession. May we who are bent down by our conscience be raised up always by your mercy.

text: Deus omnium pie ieiunantium spes salus gloria praesta ut imposita altaribus tuis munera quae pro nostris nostrorumque peccatis studio piae devotionis offerimus propitius et benignus aspicias benedicendo benedicas et nobis sanctificata custodias.
translation_en: God, hope and salvation of all the pious who are fasting, bestow mercy, health and glory so that what we present with devoted piety on your altars as a penance for our sins and those of our brethren, you may look upon favorably and benevolently, blessing and being blessed, and keep us safe.

text: Deus omnium regnorum gubernator et rector qui famulis tuis annua beati Botulfi abbatis largiris sollemniter celebrare festa nostrorum quaesumus dele clementius peccaminum vulnera ut a te mereamur percipere gaudia repromissa.
translation_en: We ask you, the Governor and Ruler of all kingdoms, to grant your servants the blessed Abbot Botulf's annual festivities with clemency. May you graciously remove the wounds of our sins so that we may deserve to receive the promised joys from you.

text: Deus omnium regnorum institutor et rector qui hodiernam nobis diem beati regis et martyris tui Ethelberti martyrio tribuis esse sollemnem praesta quaesumus ut cuius sollemniis gratulamur in terris ipsius suffragiis sublevemur in caelis.
translation_en: God, the instigator and ruler of all kingdoms, who today grants us to celebrate the day of your blessed king and martyr Ethelbert through his martyrdom, we humbly ask that you grant us to be uplifted in heaven by his earthly festivities.

text: Deus pacis caritatisque amator et custos da omnibus inimicis nostris pacem caritatemque veram cunctorum eis remissionem tribuens peccatorum nosque ab eorum insidiis potenter eripe.
translation_en: God, lover of peace and charity, and guardian, grant peace, love, and true compassion to all our enemies, forgiving them their sins, and powerfully deliver us from their plots.

text: Deus pacis conditor Deus caritatis indultor da nobis placidus pacem tuam et praesta ut dum sanctorum tuorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli festa celebramus per eorum intercessionem pacis securitatem cum peccatorum venia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God, the creator of peace, the giver of grace, grant us your peaceful peace and may it be that while we celebrate the feasts of your saints, the apostles Peter and Paul, through their intercession, we may deserve to achieve security of peace with the forgiveness of sins.

text: Deus vitae dator et humanorum
translation_en: God, giver of life and of humanity

text: Deus pacis conditor et caritatis individuae attributor praesta quaesumus omnes vinculo caritatis adstringi et concordiae benignitate coniungi ut et pacifici pacis perseverantiam teneant et discordes dono tuae misericordiae ad caritatem sese convertant.
translation_en: O Creator of peace and attributor of individual charity, we humbly ask that you bind us all with the bonds of love and unite us with the benevolence of concord, so that those who are peaceful may persevere in peace, and those who are discordant may turn to themselves through your grace.

text: Deus pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi qui es universorum lumen aeternum exaudi nos supplicantes pro famulo tuo illo quem Dominus noster Iesus Christus creavit et in hoc mundo illuminavit et vitam praestavit et ipse de tua pietate numquam desperavit; mitte sanctos angelos tuos Michael Gabriel et Raphael qui expellant hanc ipsam temptationem diaboli ab hac imagine et plasmatura tua quem tu Domine ad honorem et gloriam nominis tui formare dignatus es. Da immunde spiritus honorem Deo patri omnipotenti cui omne genu se humiliat caelestium terrestrium et infernorum; ipse te expellat de hoc famulo suo qui per virtutem suam caecos illuminavit paralyticos curavit mortuos suscitavit.
translation_en: God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who are the eternal light of all, hear us as we pray for your servant, whom our Lord Jesus Christ created and enlightened in this world and gave life. He himself never despaired of you out of your mercy. Send your holy angels, Michael, Gabriel, and Raphael, to expel this very temptation of the devil from this image and likeness that you, Lord, saw fit to form for the honor and glory of your name. Grant him an immaculate spirit, honoring God the omnipotent Father, to whom every knee bows in heaven, on earth, and in the underworld; may he drive you out from this servant of yours, who by his power enlightened the blind, cured paralytics, raised the dead.

text: Deus Pater omnipotens <qui> bonus ac mitis es qui Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum hac sede laetitiae cum ergo is adscensurus est in caelum pacem suam <fecisti> dare nobis pacem suam relinquere servis suis respice Domine; sanctae Ecclesiae tuae catholicae signum pacis impone; fiat in veritate quod dedicatur et quod titulo impletur; pacem teneant sacerdotes pacem habeant divites pacem habeant pauperes pace{m} gaudeant locupletes pace{m} mitescant barbarae nationes pacem videant liberi pacem sentiant servi pacem cogitent reges pacem faciant principes; pacem tuam omnipotens da nobis <quam> per intercessionem beatissimi Ioannis Baptistae mereamur accipere.
translation_en: God, almighty Father, who is good and merciful, who has brought peace to our Lord Jesus Christ in this seat of joy, as he ascends into heaven to give his peace, grant us your peace. Look upon us, Lord; impose the sign of peace upon your holy Catholic Church; may it be fulfilled in truth what is dedicated and what the title implies; may priests keep peace, may the rich and poor enjoy peace, may the wealthy rejoice in peace, may barbarian nations learn peace, may free people see peace, may slaves feel peace, may kings think of peace, may princes make peace. O almighty one, grant us your peace which we deserve through the intercession of the blessed John the Baptist.

text: Deus Pater omnipotens qui es verus sanctus et sanctorum omnium protector tibi pio domino devotis mentibus hostias laudis offerimus pro commemoratione omnium sanctorum tuorum et suppliciter pro famulo tuo illo precamur ut ei Domine indulgentiam tribuas omnium peccatorum suorum et ne iterum ad voluntatem peccandi redeat propitius eum custodias.
translation_en: God, almighty Father who is true, holy and protector of all saints, we offer you the host of praise with devout minds for the commemoration of all your saints. We humbly pray to you, Lord, on behalf of your servant that you grant him indulgence for all his sins and may you be merciful to him so that he does not return to the will to sin again. Keep him safe.

text: Deus Pater omnipotens qui super baptizatum unigenitum tuum in aquis Iordanis Spiritum Sanctum in columbae specie ostendisti atque per ipsius Sancti Spiritus donum cor martyris ac virginis tuae Columbae tanto ardore tuae dulcedinis inflammasti ut usque ad consummationem meruerit pervenire martyrii effice nos quaesumus columbarum simplicitate puros malitia parvulos et prudentia serpentium circumspectos quo sicut haec virgo et simplicitate abundans professa est se credere Christum et prospectu scientiae inter adversantes non negavit professum sic nos eius prece introrsus vivificati et vitam ducamus simplicem et ita simus spiritali vigilantia praemuniti quo et circumspectione prudentiae habeamur idonei et vitae sanctae longanimitate perfecti.
translation_en: God, all-powerful Father, who showed the Holy Spirit in the form of a dove upon Your unigenitus at the Jordan river, and inflamed the heart of Your martyr and virgin Columba with such ardor of Your sweetness that she merited to reach the consummation of martyrdom; grant us, we pray, to be pure as doves in simplicity, to protect the little ones from wickedness, and to be circumspect like serpents in wisdom. Just as this virgin, abounding in simplicity, professed to believe in Christ and, with knowledge, did not deny her faith even amidst adversaries; so, through Your grace, may we, having been vivified within by her prayer, live a simple life and thus be protected by spiritual vigilance. May we also be fit for circumspection and prudence, and having reached the perfection of holy longanimity.

text: Deus Pater omnipotens qui tanta caritate mundum dilexisti ut pro eo unigenitum tuum volueris crucifigi pretioso nos Filii tui sanguine redemptos ita opulentos caritatis fructibus effice ut per hoc et in resurrectione prima habeamus partem et potestatem non timeamus mortis secundae.
translation_en: God the Father almighty, who loved the world so much that you desired to crucify your only-begotten Son for it, make us so rich in the fruits of his charity that through this and in the first resurrection we may have a share and power and fear not the second death.

text: Deus Pater omnipotens qui unigenitum tuum non habentem peccatum pro nobis peccatum fecisti cum pro delicto totius mundi eum tibi offerri in verum sacrificium voluisti tu hoc sacrificium propitiatus benedicendum assume et caelestis sanctificationis adspargito largitate quo ex hoc sumentes redemptionis nostrae in his diebus celebrantes mysterium et operibus sepeliamur mortiferis et actibus resurgamus perpetuae sanctitatis.
translation_en: God, Almighty Father, who made your only-begotten Son, without sin for us, to bear our sins, as he was offered in true sacrifice for the offense of the whole world according to your will; we ask that you accept this sacrifice and sprinkle it with heavenly sanctification through your generosity. By this, may we receive redemption on these days while celebrating the mystery, and may we be buried in deathly deeds and rise again in perpetual holiness.

text: Deus Pater omnipotens tuae pietatis ac si indigni misericordiam deprecamur ut universos pacificos esse facias quos in sancta ecclesia ut te deprecentur invitas; concordiae in se alimenta nutriant et iurgiorum incrementa succidam vel qui se affectant osculis puro semper corde complectant atque etiam illi studeant esse pacifici qui se non videntur labiis osculari.
translation_en: We, unworthy, invoke Your omnipotent Father's mercy. We humbly ask that You make all those in the holy church peaceful who pray to You of their own accord; may they nourish harmony within themselves and may any increase of quarrels be cut off. May those always embrace each other with a pure heart, and may even those strive to be peaceful who do not seem to kiss with their lips.

text: Deus Pater omnipotens verus pastor fidelium animarum concede famulis tuis in hoc praesenti monasterio sancti Bonifatii martyris tui sub regula beati Benedicti constitutis in tuo amore caritatem et pacem ut quibus in unum congregatis iudicata aut indicata est communio facultatum sit etiam te miserante sancta coniunctio animorum.
translation_en: Almighty, true God and faithful shepherd, grant to your servants in this present monastery of Saint Boniface the martyr, established under the rule of Blessed Benedict, love and peace. May it be that those who are gathered together by you have a communion of rights, and may there also be a connection of holy souls through your mercy.

text: Deus pater orphanorum iudexque viduarum lacrimas Ecclesiae tuae miseratus intende illamque tua misericorditer eripiat maiestas quam nulla terrena defendit potestas.
translation_en: God, Father of the fatherless and judge of widows, moved by their tears, direct your attention to it and may your majesty mercifully rescue it. No earthly power can protect it.

text: Deus pax et caritas te deprecamur sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus libera nos ab omni temptatione adiuva nos in omni certamine consolare in omni tribulatione da nobis patientiam in adversis da nobis ut te puro corde adoremus tibi munda conscientia psallamus tibi tota virtute serviamus. Te benedicimus Trinitas sancta tibi gratias agimus; te per singulos dies laudamus te deprecamur abba pater; suavis sit tibi laudatio nostra sitque acceptabilis oratio nostra.
translation_en: We entreat you, God, peace and charity, holy Father almighty eternal God, free us from all temptation, help us in every contest, console us in every tribulation, give us patience in adversity, give us the ability to pure-heartedly adore you with a clean conscience, sing praises to you with a whole heart, serve you with all our virtue. We bless you, holy Trinity; we give thanks to you; we laud you each day; we entreat you, father Abba; may our laudation be sweet to you, and may our prayer be acceptable.

text: Deus penetrator mentium renum perscrutator cogitationum cognitor animarum conservator praesta ut rectum in nobis spiritum tuum corpus efficiat apta caritati tuae viscera nostra tuus sanguis inveniat et qui ad caelos hodie adscendisti post passionis vulnera et resurrectionis gloriam praesta nobis ut pietatis tuae calicem hauriamus et irae calicem non bibamus.
