translation_en: God, penetrator of minds and hearts, scrutinizer of thoughts and searcher of secrets, knower of souls, preserver of the living and restorer of the dead, grant that in us your righteous spirit may dwell, that our bodies may be made fit for your love, that your blood may find its way into our innermost parts, and who today ascended to heaven after suffering wounds and experiencing resurrection glory, make us worthy to drink from the cup of your pity and not to drink from the cup of wrath.

text: Deus per cuius os prolatum est quod pacem omnibus dares et pacis statuta relinqueres infunde in cordibus nostris pacis studium et piae voluntatis affectum ut vitiorum omnium labe purgati pacem quam labiis oris prosequimur immaculatis cordibus teneamus.
translation_en: God, through whose mouth peace is given to all and statutes of peace are left, infuse in our hearts the desire for peace and the affection of pious will, so that, purged from every vice, we may hold the peace which we pursue with immaculate lips, in minds untainted.

text: Deus per cuius providentiam nec praeteritorum momenta deficiunt nec ulla superest exspectatio futurorum tribue permanentem peractae quam recolimus sollemnitatis effectum ut quod recordatione percurrimus semper in opere teneamus.
translation_en: God, through whose providence neither the moments of the past are lost nor any expectation of the future remains, grant us a permanent effect of the solemnity that we recall, that what we go through in memory, we may always hold in action.

text: Deus per quem fides ignem non sentit et infidelitas sine igne exuritur qui beatis martyribus tuis Christophoro et Cucufato flamma Sancti Spiritus succensis superare tribuisti suorum incendia tormentorum concede propitius per eorum intercessionem ut nos famulos non exurat flamma vitiorum sed dilectionis tuae amor nostrorum excoquat rubiginem peccatorum.
translation_en: God through whom faith does not feel fire, and unfaithfulness is burned without fire, you who gave your blessed martyrs Christopher and Cucuphatus the flames of the Holy Spirit to overcome their torments, graciously grant that their intercession may cause the flames of our vices not to burn us but rather the love for your cleansing the stain of our sins.

text: Deus per quem nobis et redemptio venit et praestatur adoptio respice in opera misericordiae tuae ut in Christo renatis et aeterna tribuatur hereditas et vera libertas.
translation_en: God through whom our redemption comes and adoption is granted, look upon us in your works of mercy, that in Christ we may be reborn and an eternal heritage and true freedom may be given to us.

text: Deus per quem nobis redemptio praestatur et adoptio erige ad te tuorum corda credentium ut omnes regenerati sacro baptismate apprehendant mente quod mysteriis susceperunt.
translation_en: God, through whom our redemption is granted and adoption is made, raise the hearts of believers to you, so that all who are reborn by sacred baptism may comprehend in mind what they have received in the mysteries.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus per quem nobis redemptio praestatur et adoptio respice in opera pietatis tuae et quae dignatus es conferre conserva ut in Christo renatis aeterna tribuatur hereditas et vera libertas.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, through whom our redemption is given and adoption is bestowed, look upon us in your works of mercy, and what you have been pleased to grant, preserve. May eternal inheritance and true freedom be granted to us who are reborn in Christ.

text: Deus perennis gloriae rex et dator piissime dignare praesentis diei gaudia tuo munere illustrare in quo beatissimus pontifex Dunstanus aeternae lucis gaudia meruit introire.
translation_en: God, king of eternal glory and most kind giver, grant that the joys of this day may be enlightened by your gift, wherein the most blessed pope Dunstan has earned to enter the joy of eternal light.

text: Dies nostros quaesumus Domine placatus intende
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you direct your favorable attention towards our days.

text: Deus perennis pax cuius electum munus pacis est praemium quique pacificos esse tuos filios docuisti infunde nobis dulcedinem pacis ut omne quod discordiae est funditus evanescat et omne quod pacis est aeterna in nobis suavitate dulcescat.
translation_en: God, the eternal peace, whose chosen task is the reward of peace to those whom you have taught to be your peaceful sons, pour into us the sweetness of peace. Let everything that is discord disappear completely and let everything that is peace delight eternally in us with a sweet taste.

text: Dignare Domine calicem istum in usum
translation_en: Honor, Lord, this chalice for use

text: Deus perennis salus beatitudo inaestimabilis da quaesumus omnibus tuis ut qui sancta ac beata sumpserunt et sancti iugiter et beati esse mereantur.
translation_en: God, everlasting salvation, boundless blessing, we ask that all of yours may partake in these, so that those who have taken up the holy and blessed life and continue to live as saints and beatitudes may deserve to be worthy of it.

text: Dignare Domine Deus noster calicem istum
translation_en: Lord, our God, grant that this chalice may be worthy

text: Deus piissime et misericordissime qui quos diligis corripis et quos recipis ad emendationem flagellas inclina Domine aurem tuam et exaudi preces nostras et famulo tuo illi per mysterii tui perceptionem et longioris vitae tempora et tam animae quam corporis sanitatem precamur tribue.
translation_en: Most compassionate and merciful God, who corrects those you love and receives them for correction, incline your ear to us, Lord, and hear our prayers. For your servant, grant him understanding through the perception of your mysteries and longer times of life. And for both soul and body, we pray that you bestow health.

text: Dignare Domine Deus omnipotens rex regum
translation_en: Lord God, Almighty King of kings, grant us Your favor.

text: Deus pro cuius Ecclesia gloriosus pontifex Thomas gladiis impiorum occubuit praesta quaesumus ut omnes qui eius implorant auxilium petitionis suae salutarem consequantur effectum.
translation_en: God for whose Church the glorious Pope Thomas fell by the swords of unbelievers, grant us that we may obtain a salutary outcome for all who seek his aid in their petition.

text: Deus pro cuius sacro nomine beatus Germanus antistes tuus desideravit persecutionem pati propter iustitiam ut etsi martyrium non perferret fide tamen pertenderet nec timeret odiis hominum et maledictionibus subiacere dummodo copiosam mercedem consequeretur in caelo et ad illas beatitudines evangelicas perveniret te per huius interventum precamur ut pacem quam te iubente dilexit in saeculo perpetualiter ecclesiae possidendam tribuas in futuro.
translation_en: We pray to You, for whose sacred name blessed Germanus, your bishop, desired to suffer persecution for justice, although he might not bear martyrdom, yet he would cling to faith and not fear human hatred and curses, so long as he could obtain a copious reward in heaven and reach those evangelical beatitudes. Through this intervention, we pray that you grant the peace which You loved in the world perpetually to the church for the future.

text: Deus pro cuius sanctissimi nominis honore beata Apollonia virgo et martyr amaram et horribilem excussionem dentium sustinuit praesta quaesumus ut omnes qui eius sollemnitatem frequentant a taetro dolore dentium immunos custodias et post praesentis saeculi aerumnas ad aeterna<e> patriae vitam perducas.
translation_en: God, for whose holy name the blessed Apolonia, virgin and martyr, endured bitter and dreadful tooth extraction, grant us, we ask, that all who participate in her solemnity may be protected from the painful tooth and after the troubles of this present age lead to the eternal homeland of the fatherland.

text: Deus provisor omnium bonorum rector et custos sanctorum qui beatum Lambertum contemplativa dulcedine suffultum ad martyrii palmam producere dignatus es concede propitius ut cuius hodie festa percolimus ipsius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, provider of all good things, ruler and guardian of the saints, who deemed it fit to bring Blessed Lambert, filled with contemplative sweetness, to the palm of martyrdom, graciously grant us your favor, that we may feel his patronage among us on this day when we celebrate his feast.

text: Deus quem diligere et amare iustitia est ineffabilis gratiae tuae in nobis dona multiplica ut qui fecisti nos morte Filii tui sperare quod credimus facias nos eodem resurgente pervenire quo tendimus.
translation_en: God, whom to love and to cherish is ineffable grace within us, multiply the gift of your justice that you who made us by the death of your Son have given us hope, may you make us attain what we believe when he rises again, to the same place where we aspire.

text: Deus quem docente spiritu sancto paterno nomine invocare praesumimus crea in nobis fidelium corda filiorum ut ad promissam hereditatem aggredi valeamus per debitam servitutem.
translation_en: We presume to invoke the God whom we are taught by the Holy Spirit to call by the paternal name, create in us, faithful hearts of children, so that we may approach the promised inheritance with strength through due service.

text: Diri vulneris novitate
translation_en: Of new wounds I sing

text: Deus a quo docente nos spiritu paterno tuo sancto te nomine invocare praesumimus crea in nobis fidelium corda filiorum ut promissam hereditatem mereamur ingredi per debitam servitutem clamantes e terris: »Pater noster ...«
translation_en: We presume to invoke you, God, from whom we learn by your Fatherly and holy name, create in us the hearts of faithful children so that we may deserve to enter into the promised inheritance through due servitude, crying out from the earth: "Our Father who art in heaven ..."

text: Deus quem esurimus et sitimus tua quaesumus satiemur dulcedine ut hoc sacrificium quod tibi cum ieiunii contritione offerimus in praesenti vita nos a delictis mundos efficiat et aeterna post cum sanctis omnibus felicitate sustollat.
translation_en: We ask You, God, whom we hunger and thirst for, that You may fill us with Your sweetness so that this sacrifice which we offer to You with fasting and contrition in the present life may make us free from sins in this world, and lift us up with all the saints to eternal happiness after.

text: Deus quem iniustitia nostra incessanter offendit da nobis rectae conversationis effectum per quem consequamur et veniam.
translation_en: God, whom our injustice continually offends, grant us the effect of righteous living through which we may obtain mercy.

text: Deus quem nulla potest conscientia inculpabilis invenire concede nobis tuae pietatis auxilium ut ope tuae miserationis adiuti a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus liberemur.
translation_en: God, whom no guiltless conscience can find, grant us the help of your pity so that with your aid we may be freed from the bonds of our sins.

text: Deus quem omni tempore colere et laudare sine intermissione debemus dona ut quatenus perpetem serviendi curam per neglegentiam non implemus saltem dominicorum dierum festivitatem diligentius excolamus.  Cedat cura saeculi; pereat causa peccati; convalescat potentia fidei; vigeat gratia sacramenti. Sibi horno praestet quod tibi soli debet ut dum dominicorum dierum iucunditate perfruitur intolerabilium occupationum onere non prematur.  Anima dominantibus sibi vitiis voluptatis suae lassa servitio in tristitia refectionem inveniat et quae libertatis suae arbitrio patitur quod laborat pietatis tuae beneficio pareat ut quiescat. Negotium bonis otium malis ponat. Sint excubiae precum feriae peccatorum. Salubriore se animus commutatione distendat ut in eo se reficiat si ad meliora convertat et bonorum actuum saltem habeat vicem si non habeat iugitatem.
translation_en:
We owe to God at all times to worship and praise without interruption; grant that, though we may not fulfill the constant care of serving due to negligence, at least we diligently observe the festivities of the Lord's days.
Let the concern of the world fade away; let the cause of sin perish; let the power of faith recover; let the grace of the sacrament flourish. May a hearth be prepared for You alone, which it ought to offer while enjoying the delight of the Lord's days, so that the burdensome load of intolerable occupations does not hinder it.
May the soul weary from serving its own vices find reformation in sorrow and may it submit to Your benefit, which it suffers under the control of its own free will, that it may rest. May negotium (work) be a otium (leisure) for the good and a labor for the wicked. Let the vigils of prayer be days of penance for sinners.
May the mind expand with a healthier change so that it may restore itself in it if it turns to better things, and at least have a substitute for good deeds if it does not have joy.

text: Deus quem omnia opera benedicunt quem caeli glorificant angelorum multitudo collaudat quaesumus te ut sicut tres pueros de camino ignis incendii non solum illaesos sed etiam in tuis laudibus conclamantes liberasti ita nos peccatorum nexibus obvolutos velut de voragine ignis eripias ut dum te Deum patrem benedictione laudamus criminum flammas operumque carnalium incendia superantes hymnum tibi debitum iure meritoque reddamus.
translation_en: We ask you, God, whom all works bless and whom the host of angels glorify, that just as you freed the three boys from the burning furnace not only unharmed but also shouting your praises within their laudations, so too may you free us, ensnared by sins, like from a fiery pit. While we bless you, God, Father, with our praise, may we surpass the flames of sin and carnal works, and in justice and righteousness render to you the hymn that is due.

text: Deus qui absque ulla temporis mutabilitate cuncta disponis et ad melioranda perducis quae eligis esse mutanda respice super hanc basilicam in honorem beati illius nomini tuo dedicatam ut vetustate iudaici erroris expulsa huic loco Sancti Spiritus novitatem et ecclesiae conferas veritatem.
translation_en: God, who arranges all things without any change of time and leads what You choose to be improved, look upon this basilica dedicated in honor of Your name, that the old error of Judaism may be expelled from this place, and grant to the Holy Spirit novelty and to the church truth.

text: Deus qui ad aeternam vitam in Christi resurrectione nos reparas da populo tuo fidei speique constantiam ut non dubitemus implenda quae te novimus auctore promissa.
translation_en: God, who through the resurrection of Christ restores us to eternal life, grant to your people steadfastness in faith and hope, so that we may not doubt the promises made by you as their author.

text: Deus qui ad aeternam vitam in Christi resurrectione nos reparas erige nos ad consedentem in dextera tua nostrae salutis auctorem ut qui propter nos iudicandus advenit pro nobis iudicaturus adveniat.
translation_en: God, who restores us to eternal life through the resurrection of Christ, raise us up to sit on your right hand, our savior's author. May he who came for our judgment because of us, come to judge us. May he who is coming as our judge approach.

text: Deus qui ad aeternam vitam in Christi resurrectione nos reparas imple pietatis tuae ineffabile sacramentum ut cum in maiestate sua Salvator noster advenerit quos fecisti baptismo regenerari facias beata immortalitate vestiri.
translation_en: God, who restores us to eternal life through the resurrection of Christ, fill your ineffable sacrament within us, so that when our Savior comes in his majesty, you make those whom you created to be baptized, clothe us with blessed immortality.

text: Deus qui ad animarum medelam ieiunii devotione castigari corpora praecepisti concede nobis propitius et mente et corpore semper tibi esse devotos.
translation_en: God who commanded bodies to be disciplined for the healing of souls through the devotion of fasting, graciously grant us that we may always be devoted to you in mind and body.

text: Deus qui ad beati Benedicti confessoris tui imperium oboedientem discipulum super undas ambulare fecisti fac nos quaesumus mundanos fluctus tibi semper devote famulando calcare.
translation_en: O God, who made the disciple of your blessed confessor Benedict walk obediently on the waves, make us pray, we entreat you, always to step devotedly on the worldly waves while serving you.

text: Deus qui ad caeleste regnum non nisi renatis per aquam et Spiritum Sanctum pandis introitum multiplica super animam famuli tui illius misericordiam tuam et cui donasti celerem et incontaminatum transitum post baptismi sacramentum da ei et aeternorum plenitudinem gaudiorum.
translation_en: God who opens the entrance to the heavenly kingdom only for those reborn through water and the Holy Spirit, multiply Your mercy upon the soul of Your servant and grant him swift and uncorrupted transition after the sacrament of baptism, and give him the fullness of eternal joys.

text: Deus qui ad caeleste regnum non nisi renatis ex aqua et spiritu sancto pandis introitum auge semper super famulos tuos gratiae tuae dona ut qui ab omnibus sunt purgati peccatis a nullis fraudentur promissis.
translation_en: God, who opens the way to the celestial kingdom only for those reborn through water and the Holy Spirit, always increase your grace upon your servants, so that those purified from all sins by everyone may not be deceived in their promises.

text: Deus qui ad celebrandum nobis honorabile praesentis diei festum in beati martyris et levitae Stephani inventione tribuisti te suppliciter exoramus ut ipso intercedente mereamur in caelestibus inveniri.
translation_en: God who graciously grant us to celebrate the honorable festival of the day, the discovery of the blessed martyr and levi Stephan, we humbly beseech you that through his intercession we may deserve to be found worthy in heaven.

text: Deus qui ad celebrandum sanctorum tuorum merita facis Ecclesiam tuam variis coruscare miraculis concede nobis famulis tuis ut beati Ricardi confessoris tui atque pontificis intercessione ad eorum valeamus consortium pervenire.
translation_en: God who makes your Church to shine with various miracles for the celebration of the merits of your saints, grant us, your servants, that through the intercession of Blessed Richard, your confessor and bishop, we may be able to reach their fellowship.

text: Deus qui ad cultum tuum pro salute credentium loci istius amplitudinem consecrasti ubi cottidiana invocatione nominis tui caelestis consolatio non deesset quaesumus pietatem tuam ut memoria quae sacris infertur altaribus devotis mentibus ad remedium praeparetur animarum et supplicem familiam tuam quae tibi in templo gloriae tuae sacrificium laudis gratulantibus immolat votis in illa sancta Ierusalem inter electa caelestis regiae ornamenta constituas.
translation_en: God, who consecrated the expansive space of this place for the salvation of believing minds, where daily consolation from your celestial name was not wanting. We humbly ask your mercy that the memory offered to sacred altars be prepared as a remedy for souls, and that your supplicant family which offers you sacrifice in the temple of your glory with joyful offerings of praise, may be placed among the chosen ornaments of heaven's royal court in the holy Jerusalem.

text: Domine Deus noster Pater omnipotens exaudi nos lumen
translation_en: Lord God our Father Almighty, hear us.

text: Deus qui ad declaranda tuae miracula maiestatis post resurrectionem a mortuis hodie in caelos apostolis adstantibus adscendisti concede nobis tuae pietatis auxilium ut secundum tuam promissionem et tu nobiscum semper in terris et nos tecum in caelo vivere mereamur.
translation_en: God who, for the declaration of Your miracles of majesty after the resurrection today in the heavens, with the apostles standing by, ascended; grant us the help of Your pity, that according to Your promise and always being with us on earth and us with You in heaven we may deserve to live.

text: Deus qui ad decorandam Ecclesiam tuam beatissimum Laudum pontificem sanctitatis qualitate laudabilem esse fecisti da nobis divini adipisci laetitiam ut cuius gloriosum sollemniter celebramus transitum aeternae vitae praemia per eius obtentum.
translation_en: God, who made the blessed pontiff, a praiseworthy figure in sanctity, to adorn Your Church, grant us to taste the divine joy as we solemnly celebrate his transition, through which he obtained eternal life's rewards.

text: Deus qui ad decorem Ecclesiae tuae sanctum Swithunum praesulem miraculis fecisti glorianter rutilare ipsius pro meritis nobis peccatorum detur remissio et totius bonae voluntatis infusio nosque post hanc vitam suscipiat paradisus ubi no<bi>s regnum aeternum tuus comparavit sanguis pretiosus.
translation_en: God, who made the blessed Bishop Swithun of Your church shine gloriously with miracles, grant us pardon for our sins and the infusion of good will. May paradise receive us after this life, where your eternal kingdom, which the precious blood has prepared for us, awaits.

text: Deus qui ad deprecandum te conscientiae nostrae perspicis non sufficere facultatem cunctos martyres tuos fac orare pro nobis quos digne possis audire.
translation_en: God who sees that our conscience is not sufficient to approach you, make all your martyrs pray for us, whom you can graciously hear.

text: Deus qui ad deprecandum te nostrae conscientiae perspicis non sufficere facultatem cunctos martyres et confessores tuos fac pro nobis exorare qui tibi digne possint pro nostris actibus supplicare.
translation_en: God, who sees that our conscience does not suffice the ability to pray for all your martyrs and confessors, make us able to pray on their behalf who can worthily intercede for our actions on your behalf.

text: Domine Deus noster qui offensionem nostram
translation_en: Lord God, our maker who takes note of our offense

text: Deus qui ad hoc nobis dignatus es donare ieiunium ut abstinentia et castigatione carnali in fide inveniamur stabiles in operibus efficaces ieiunia nostra suscipiens da nobis ut sine disceptationis impuritate in dilectione sinceri manus nostras ad te puras levare possimus.
translation_en: God, who have been gracious to us by granting us fasting so that through abstention and carnal chastity we may be found steadfast in faith and effective in our works. May our fasting receive us, and grant us that we may lift up our sincere hands to you without any impurity of disputation.

text: Deus qui ad honorem nominis tui templi fabricam construere voluisti praesta quaesumus ut in hoc orationis domicilio congregatos pietatem tuam precantes cunctos exaudias vota suscipias et praemia largiaris.
translation_en: God who willed to construct the building of your temple for the honor of your name, we humbly ask that you grant us in this dwelling place of prayer. May you hear the prayers of all gathered and accept their vows. May you generously bestow rewards.

text: Deus qui ad laudem beatissimae Mariae virginis matris tuae eius ecclesiam per demonstrationem nivis fundari voluisti concede nobis famulis tuis huiusmodi festum recolentibus vitam habere perpetuam.
translation_en: God, who willed your church to be founded for the praise of the most blessed Virgin Mary, our Mother, in a demonstration of snow, grant us, your servants, that we may have eternal life as we celebrate this kind of feast.

text: Deus qui ad laudis tui hostias immolandas hodie beatum Ambrosium sacro baptismate purificasti concede propitius ut eo pro nobis interveniente et haec tibi grata sint munera et ad sanctificationem nostram proveniant.
translation_en: God, who on this day purified the blessed Ambrose for offering at your praises through holy baptism, graciously grant that through his intervention these gifts may please you and come to our sanctification.

text: Deus qui ad mutandam aeris qualitatem operis caelum nubibus et paras terrae pluviam aperi fontem benignitatis tuae et terram squalidam et ariditatem pulveream laeto imbre fecunda ut recepisse nos veniam peccatorum cessante iam correptione laetemur.
translation_en: God, who works the change of the air's quality by opening the heavens with clouds and providing the earth with rain, open the source of your benevolence, and make the barren and dry land fruitful with joyful rain, so that we may rejoice in receiving forgiveness for our sins, now that the correction has ceased.

text: Deus qui ad regendos tuae acquisitionis populos beatum Dunstanum pontificem eligere voluisti da quaesumus ita nos sempiternam gloriam celebrare ut per eum populus tibi acquisitus valeamus exsistere.
translation_en: God who chose the blessed Dunstan as priest to govern your acquired people, we ask that you grant us so that we may forever celebrate eternal glory through him, so that the people acquired by you may exist through him.

text: Deus qui ad vitam ducis et confidentes in te paterna proiectione custodis quaesumus ut praesenti famulo tuo a nobis egredienti angelicum tribuas comitatum ut eius auxilio protectus nullius mali concutiatur formidine nullo comprimatur adversitatis angore nullius irruentis inimici molestetur insidiis sed spatiis necessarii itineris prospero gressu peractis propriisque locis feliciter restitutus universos reperiat sospites ac debitas exsolvat tuo nomini gratias.
translation_en: God who leads us to life and protects us confidently in You through paternal projection, we ask that you grant your angelic companionship to Your servant departing from us, so that he may be protected by his assistance, unaffected by any fear, untroubled by adversity's distress, not disturbed by the attacks of any enemy, nor ensnared by their plots. May he prosper in his necessary steps, return happily to his own places, and find all safe and proper debts paid, offering due thanks to Your name.

text: Deus qui adhuc in annis teneris constitutam gloriosam virginem Barbaram sanctissimo passionis tuae mysterio consecrasti tribue quaesumus ut qui eius sollemnitate gaudemus iucundissimo imaginis tuae signaculo gloriemur.
translation_en: O God, who even in tender years sanctified the glorious virgin Barbara through your most holy mystery of passion, grant us that we who rejoice in her solemnity may be adorned with the most delightful seal of your image.

text: Deus qui admirabili providentia omnia disponis te suppliciter exoramus ut Terram quam unigenitus tuus proprio sanguine consecravit de manibus inimicorum crucis eripias et eam in christiana religione in Dei nomine conservari concedas.
translation_en: God, who arranges all things with wonderful providence, we humbly beseech you to deliver the land which your only-begotten Son consecrated with his own blood from the hands of its enemies and grant that it may be preserved in the Christian religion, in Your name.

text: Deus qui adoptionis tuae subolem peccatorum remissione genuisti da ut cuncti fideles tui veraciter apprehendant quae praesentibus susceperunt sacramentis.
translation_en: God who brought forth the offspring of your adoption through forgiveness, grant that all your faithful may truly comprehend what they have received in the present sacraments.

text: Deus qui aeternae gloriae participem concessisti fieri beatissimum Maurum levitam atque abbatem concede nobis propitius ipso intercedente aditum regni caelestis cuius ad bene vivendum informamur exemplis.
translation_en: God, who granted the blessed Maurice, the deacon and abbot, to participate in eternal glory, mercifully grant us access to the kingdom of heaven, through his intercession, whom we are instructed by the examples of how to live well.

text: Deus qui angelicam dignitatem ad tuae maiestatis ministerium mirabiliter ordinas?i eorum quaesumus praesidio nos in mundanis regere periculis et ad portum aeternae quietis perducere digneris.
translation_en: God, who miraculously orders the angelic dignity to serve at your majesty's ministry, we humbly ask that you watch over us and guide us through the worldly dangers, and that you deem us worthy to be led to the port of eternal peace.

text: Deus qui angelico ministerio beatum Petrum apostolum a vinculis carceris liberasti eius intercedentibus meritis ab omni nos quaesumus tribulatione liberare digneris.
translation_en: God, who freed the blessed Peter, the apostle, from the bonds of prison by means of angelic ministry, we humbly ask that you deem us worthy to be freed from every trouble.

text: Deus qui animae famuli tui Gregorii aeternae beatitudinis praemia contulisti concede propitius ut qui peccatorum nostrorum pondere premimur eius apud te precibus sublevemur.
translation_en: God who bestowed upon the soul of your servant Gregory the rewards of eternal beatitude, graciously grant that we, who are burdened by the weight of our sins, may be lifted up through his prayers before you.

text: Deus qui anxietatem sterilium pie respiciens in eis fecunditatem etiam in sua desperatione mirabiliter operaris concede propitius ut famula tua illa de percipienda subole quod per se non valet servi tui Gregorii mereatur precibus obtinere.
translation_en: God, who looks upon the anxieties of the pious and miraculously works fertility even in their despair, grant graciously that your servant that woman may be worthy to obtain through her prayers the expected offspring which she herself cannot achieve for your servant Gregory.

text: Deus qui apostoli tui Bartholomaei corpus arca eius contra fluctus gestante ex India in Liparim pro salute Italorum transire voluisti concede quaesumus ut illius patrocinio tueamur cuius reliquias laudibus frequentamus.
translation_en: God, who willed that the body of your apostle Bartholomew, carried in an ark against the waves from India to Lipari for the salvation of Italians, we ask that you grant us protection under his patronage, whose relics we frequently honor with praise.

text: Deus qui apostoli tui beatissimi Petri sedis cathedram consecrasti super hanc eiusque petram Ecclesiam tuam ita aedificare dignatus es ut adversus eam portae inferi minime praevalerent maiestatem tuam supplices deprecamur ut meritis et precibus cui claves regni caelorum dedisti memor fidelissimae promissionis quaecumque a nobis commissa vincula peccatorum ligata sunt ipse praecipias ut sint soluta in caelis.
translation_en: God, who consecrated the chair of your most blessed apostle Peter upon this rock, and deemed it worthy to build your Church upon it so that the gates of hell would not prevail against it, we humbly beseech you. Remembering the faithful promise which you gave to him who received the keys to the kingdom of heaven, we pray that whatever bonds of sin we have committed are loosed in heaven.

text: Deus qui apostolis tuis quorum hodie sollemnitate gaudemus in sorte sanctificationis electis clariora nomina tu dedisti cum et ille Petrus diceretur hic Paulus ille indito sibi vocabulo usus est hic mutato eorum nobis oratione ac favore concede ut a naturae utero segregati vim carnis et sanguinis superantes facta habeamus fidelium qui nomina tuorum accepimus filiorum ut in nobis et spiritalis addatur ambitus et carnalis mutetur affectus quibus mereamur sacerdotalium possidere instrumenta virtutum qui permittimur officia electorum agere sacerdotum.  Has quoque catholicorum oblationes velut de captura et manu Petri pulmentarium tibi Christe gratifica et quasi ex ore Pauli cui loqui dignatus es benedictione ditifica. Omnibus eorum interventu salutaris laetitiae causa praestetur cunctosque necessaria ad Deum conversione vertendos ille pascat semper hic doceat cum aequalis gratiae vicario munere et ille sic docere possit et iste sic pascere.  Pro spiritibus etiam defunctorum quorum nomina ore prolata sunt recitantium utrique pro culpis apud te intercessores exsistant.
translation_en:
God, who on this day we rejoice in the selection of your apostles to whom you gave clearer names - Peter was called and Paul was named. Grant us through prayer and favor that those changed from their natural state may have the power over nature and flesh, so that the faithful who bear your names become sons, and spiritual ambitions are added to our earthly desires, and worldly affections are transformed, which merits us to possess the instruments of virtues that allow us to perform the duties of those elected as priests.
Likewise, grant that the offerings of the Catholic faithful be acceptable to you, Christ, as if from the hand of Peter, the baker, and like a blessing spoken by Paul whom you have deemed worthy to speak. May all their intercession bring salvation, joy, and conversion to everyone. Let Peter always feed and let Paul teach, with equal grace given as vicarious office, so that each may teach and the other may feed.
Also for the spirits of the departed whose names have been pronounced, let both serve as intercessors before you for their sins.

text: Deus qui apostolis tuis sanctum dedisti spiritum concede plebi tuae petitionis effectum ut quibus dedisti fidem largiaris et pacem.
translation_en: God, who gave your holy Spirit to your apostles, grant the effect of our people's petitions so that you may bestow faith and peace upon those to whom you have given faith.

text: Deus qui apostolos tuos Petrum et Paulum atque Andream glorioso coronasti martyrio da nobis eorum obtentu ut ad eorum memoriam concurrentes obtinere mereamur omnium peccatorum nostrorum remissionem.
translation_en: God who crowned your apostles Peter, Paul, and Andrew with the glorious crown of martyrdom, grant us through their intercession that by gathering at their remembrance we may merit the remission of all our sins.

text: Deus qui apostolum tuum Paulum insolentem contra christiani nominis pietatem caelesti voce cum terrore perculsum hodierna die vocationis eius tum mente cum nomine commutasti quem prius persecutorem metuebat ecclesia et nunc caelestium mandatorum laetatur se habere doctorem quemque ideo foris caecasti ut introrsum videntem faceres cuique post tenebras incredulitatis ablatas ad evocandas gentes divinae legis scientiam contulisti sed et tertio naufragantem pro fide quam expugnaverat iam devotum in elemento liquido fecisti vitare discrimen sic et nobis quaesumus eius et mutationem et fidem colentibus post caecitatem peccatorum fac te videre in caelis qui illuminasti Paulum in terris et munera praesentia libens accipe quae apostoli tui precibus tibi fiant accepta.
translation_en:
God, who on this day changed the calling of your apostle Paul, once a blasphemer against Christian piety, struck with heavenly voice and terror, you transformed him from one who was feared as a persecutor by the church into one who rejoices to have a teacher of celestial commands. You made him blind outside so that he might see within, giving him the ability to lead people out of the darkness of unbelief towards knowledge of divine law.
Also, for the third time, you saved the shipwrecked man who had fought for faith from drowning in the liquid element. And we humbly ask that you make him visible in heaven, who illuminated Paul on earth, and generously accept the gifts presented to you at his prayers.

text: Deus qui a(d)scendisti in altum captivam ducens captivitatem da dona hominibus pacis aeternae ut qui te humanis obtutibus ad caelos adscendens corporaliter subtraxisti in nostris cordibus digneris propitiatus infundi.
translation_en: God who descended from heaven, leading the captive up, grant to men eternal peace. May you, who ascending with human offerings brought about bodily departure in our heavens, deign to infuse grace and mercy into our hearts.

text: Deus qui assumptum hominem evecturus ad caelos inter praecipua mandatorum tuorum mysteria concordissimam pacem tuis sanctis reliquisti apostolis suscipe illata sacro altario munera in hostiam pacificam largiente tua gratia reputanda nobisque tuis famulis tuis tribue sectari per exterioris hominis osculum interioris hominis indisruptum pacis et gratiae sacramentum.
translation_en: God who was about to elevate man to the heavens, among the most important mysteries of your commandments you left a most harmonious peace to your saints for the apostles. Receive the gifts brought on the sacred altar as a peaceful offering, given by your grace, to be considered for us and your servants. Grant that we may follow through with the kiss of an outer man through the undisturbed kiss of an inner man, the sacrament of peace and grace.

text: Deus qui auctor es pacis et purae dilectionis amator fac nos ita ab invicem diligi ut tibi mereamur per omnia copulari.
translation_en: God, who art the author of peace and lover of pure love, make us love each other in such a way that we may deserve to be joined with you in all things.

text: Deus qui auctor felicitatis aeternae es Felicis sancti tui obtentu serenus accepta offerentis populi votum et cunctis tribue remedium postulatum sicque per illum pius opitulator assiste precibus nostris ut defunctorum spiritus beatorum consortiis consoleris quo illo interveniente feliciter vivamus in saeculo qui nomine Felix et merito felici est pro te consecratus martyrio.
translation_en: God, who is the author of eternal happiness, through the intercession of Your blessed saint, grant a peaceful acceptance of the people's vow and provide a remedy for all. May the pious intercede on our behalf, so that You console the spirits of the blessed departed, making us live happily in this world, who is named Felix and deserves to be happy due to Your martyrdom.

text: Deus qui beatae Annae tantam gratiam conferre dignatus es ut beatam Mariam matrem tuam in utero suo portare meruerit da nobis per intercessionem matris et filiae tuae propitiationis abundantiam ut quarum commemorationem pio amore amplectimur earum precibus ad caelestem Ierusalem pervenire valeamus.
translation_en: God, who deemed fit to confer such grace upon blessed Anne that she merited to carry your mother Mary in her womb, grant us through the intercession of our Mother and Daughter, abundant grace so that we may approach the heavenly Jerusalem with their prayers embraced. We hope to reach it with their pious love.

text: Deus qui beatae Annae tantam gratiam donare dignatus es ut Mariam matrem tuam in utero suo portare mereretur da nobis per eius intercessionem tuae propitiationis abundantiam ut cuius sollemnia celebramus eius apud te suffragia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who graciously bestowed such great favor upon blessed Anne that she deserved to bear your mother Mary in her womb, grant us through her intercession an abundance of your propitiation, so that we may feel the support of her prayers as we celebrate her feast day with you.

text: Deus qui beatae Edburgae virginis tuae animam aeterna gaudia hodie introire fecisti concede propitius ut cuius in terris indigemus suffragiis eius auxilium inveniamus in caelo.
translation_en: God who today brought the soul of the blessed Edburga, your virgin, into eternal joys, graciously grant that we may find her help through her intercession on earth, and in heaven.

text: Deus qui beatae Genovefae virginis excellentiam multiplici virtutum gloria declarasti concede nobis quaesumus ut quae per gratiam tuam hodierna die in membris humanis ignis horrendi consumpsit incendium nos quoque a gehennae incendiis liberatos ad gaudia transferat angelorum.
translation_en: God who have declared the excellence of blessed Genevieve, virgin, by manifold glory of virtues, grant us, we ask, that what on this day burned in human limbs with the dreadful fire she was consumed, also transfers us from the fires of hell to the joys of angels.

text: Deus qui beatae Luciae pro gemina virginitatis et martyrii victoria binam laureolam tua gratia contulisti da quaesumus ut de carne mundo et diabolo triumphantes caelestem gloriam consequamur.
translation_en: God, who by your grace bestowed upon blessed Lucy a double laurel for her twin victories of virginity and martyrdom, we humbly ask that through her intercession, we may triumph over the flesh and the devil and attain celestial glory.

text: Deus qui beatae Mariae Magdalenae paenitentiam ita tibi placitam gratamque fecisti ut non solum ei peccata dimitteres verum etiam singulari tui amoris gratia cordis eius intima perlustrares da nobis tuae propitiationis abundantiam ut cuius sollemnitate laetemur eius apud tuam misericordiam precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who made the repentance of the blessed Mary Magdalene pleasing and acceptable to you, not only forgiving her sins but also illuminating her heart with your singular grace, grant us the abundance of your propitiation, that we may rejoice in her solemnity and be aided by our prayers in your mercy.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus benedicere digneris famulum tuum hunc in officium lectoris.
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty and eternal God, deign to bless your servant in the office of the reader.

text: Deus qui beatae Mariae Magdalenae mentem tanto tuae dilectionis ardore inflammasti ut Iesu Christo filio tuo non solum viventi verum etiam mortuo obsequia humanitatis impendere sincero festinaret affectu concede propitius ut apud misericordiam tuam pro nostris reatibus intercedat quae eundem Filium tuum Dominum nostrum prima omnium meruit videre a mortuis resurgentem.
translation_en: God, who inflamed the mind of the blessed Mary Magdalene with such a great fire of Your love that she hastened to offer sincere service of humanity to Jesus Christ Your Son, both living and dead, grant Your propitious mercy. Allow her, through Your compassion, to intercede on our behalf for our sins, who was the first among all to see Your Son, our Lord, rising from the dead after His crucifixion.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus benedicere digneris famulum tuum hunc nomine illum in officio ...
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God, deign to bless your servant named thus in his office...

text: Deus qui beatae Mariae Magdalenae mentem tanto unigeniti Filii tui amoris igne succendisti ut etiam discipulis a monumento discedentibus ipsa indefessa perseveraret quousque quem ardens quaerebat invenire mereretur eius pia interventione infunde cordibus nostris tui amoris affectum ut te in omnibus et super omnia diligentes ad promissa tuae visionis gaudia pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: God, who kindled the mind of the Blessed Mary Magdalene with such love for your only-begotten Son that she persisted in following them even as they were departing from the tomb, grant us the grace to have your love inflamed in our hearts so that we may diligently seek you in all things and above all things, and by doing so, merit to reach the joys promised in your vision.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus benedicere digneris famulum tuum hunc quem ad subdiaconatus ...
translation_en: Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, deign to bless your servant whom you have chosen for the subdiaconate...

text: Deus qui beatae Mariae virginis conceptionem angelico vaticinio parentibus praedixisti praesta huic praesenti familiae tuae eiusdem praesidiis muniri cuius conceptionis sacra sollemnia congrua frequentatione veneratur.
translation_en: God who predicted the conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary to her parents through an angelic proclamation, grant that this present family of yours be fortified with the same protections. Whose conception's sacred feast is honored through fitting participation.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus benedicere digneris famulum tuum nomine ...
translation_en: Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, deign to bless your servant by name ...

text: Deus qui beatae martyris membra tuae caritatis amplexibus indivisae coniuncta nec serra praecidi nec bestiarum dentibus passus es laniari concede ea te pro nobis interpellante ut sic indivisae bono utamur pacis ne quibuslibet inimicitiae ab invicem praecidamur aculeis.
translation_en: God who joined the limbs of the blessed martyr with unbroken embraces, so that neither saw nor beasts' teeth were able to wound him and tear apart, grant us, as we invoke you, to enjoy such unity of peace, so that we may not be pierced by the darts of any enmity among ourselves.

text: Deus qui beatae Perpetuae uterum glorioso martyre Nazario tua gratia fecundasti da quaesumus ut eius meritis adiuti sincera fide et sanctis operibus fecundamur et perpetuam in caelis gloriam consequamur.
translation_en: God, who through your grace made the blessed Perpetua fruitful by her glorious martyrdom Nazarius, grant us we ask, that we may be helped by his merits, and with sincere faith and holy works become fertile, and obtain eternal glory in heaven.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus benedicere digneris hunc famulum tuum
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty God, eternal deity, may you deem fit to bless this your servant.

text: Deus qui beatae Petronillae virginis tuae animam in caelestibus collocasti fac nos eius interventu a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus solvi et ab omni semper adversitate defendi.
translation_en: God, who placed the soul of your blessed servant Petronilla in the heavens, grant us through her intercession to be freed from the bonds of our sins and always protected from any adversity.

text: Deus qui beatae virginis tuae Scholasticae animam ad ostendendam innocentiae viam in columbae specie caelum penetrare fecisti concede nobis ipsius meritis ita innocenter vivere ut ad eadem mereamur gaudia pervenire.
translation_en: God, who made the soul of your blessed virgin Scholastica penetrate heaven in the form of a dove to show the way of innocence, grant us through her merits to live so innocently that we may deserve to attain the same joys.

text: Deus qui beatae virgini et martyri tuae Euphemiae pro tuo nomine dimicanti fidem et constantiam praebuisti concede nobis supplicantibus ut sicut illa horrenda vicit augmenta poenarum ita et nos saevissimi hostis vitia te auxiliante vincere valeamus.
translation_en: God, who provided faith and constancy to the blessed virgin and martyr Euphemia fighting for Your name, grant us that, just as she overcame dreadful increase of punishments, we too, with Your help, may overcome vices against the most cruel enemy.

text: Deus qui beatam ancillam tuam Radegundem in fragili sexu constitutam sanctificasti vocatione misericordiae et assumpsisti hodierno quondam die felici consummatione per ipsius merita suscipe propitius preces nostras et praesta ut sicut tecum est illa meritis ita a nobis non recedat exemplis.
translation_en: God, who sanctified your blessed handmaid Radegund in the fragile state of sex and took her on this once happy day through the felicitous consummation of her merits, graciously receive our prayers and grant that just as she was with you by her merits, so may her examples not depart from us.

text: Deus qui beatam illam virtute fidei et decore pudicitiae pollentem caelestia virginem et martyrem fecisti intrare eius intercessionis opere tribue nos semper gaudere.
translation_en: God, who made her, the blessed one, distinguished by virtue of faith and modesty in beauty, the celestial virgin and martyr, grant that we may always rejoice through her intercession.

text: Deus qui beatam Annam dilectissimae genitricis tuae matrem egregiam hodierna die ad caelestis vitae sublevasti gaudia fac nos quaesumus gloriosis eius meritis ad aeternam pertingere beatitudinem ex cuius puerperio salutari pro salute mundi humanam assumere dignatus es carnem.
translation_en: God, who on this day raised the blessed Anne, the most cherished mother of your own, to the joys of celestial life, grant us we pray, by the glorious merits of her, that we may attain eternal beatitude; from whose birth you deemed worthy to assume human flesh for the salvation of mankind.

text: Deus qui beatam Annam matrem genitricis tuae fieri voluisti praesta quaesumus ut apud te meritis utriusque matris et filiae caelestia gaudia consequamur.
translation_en: God who willed that blessed Anne become the mother of your Mother, grant us, we pray, that through the merits of both mothers and daughters, we may attain celestial joys with you.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus honorum auctor et distributor
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God, author and bestower of honors

text: Deus qui beatam Annam olim sterilem miraculose fecundasti praesta quaesumus ut meritis tam sanctae feminae et cunctorum de ipsius cognatione sanctorum dirigamur hic prospere ac tandem cum beatis omnibus salvemur in extremo examine.
translation_en: God who once miraculously made the blessed Anne, who was formerly barren, fertile, grant us, we pray, that we may be directed here prosperously and finally saved with all the saints in the ultimate judgment.

text: Deus qui beatam Margaretam virginem hodierna die ad caelos per martyrii palmam venire fecisti concede propitius ut eius exempla sequentes ad te pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: God, who brought the blessed Margaret, the virgin, today into heaven through the palm of martyrdom, graciously grant that we who follow her example may merit to reach you.

text: Deus qui beatam virginem Margaretam ad caelos per martyrii palmam pervenire fecisti concede propitius ut sicut illa te adiuvante tyrannicam meruit saevitiam triumphare ita nos ipsa intercedente visibilium et invisibilium hostium insidias valeamus superare.
translation_en: God who brought the blessed virgin Margaret to heaven through the palm of martyrdom, graciously grant that, just as she triumphed over tyrannical cruelty with Your help, so too may we overcome the snares of visible and invisible enemies with her intercession.

text: Deus qui beatam Margaritam ornasti virginitate et coronasti martyrio praesta quaesumus ut qui commemorationis eius festa percolimus eius apud te praesidio fulciamur.
translation_en: God who adorned blessed Margaret with virginity and crowned her with martyrdom, grant us that we who celebrate her festival, may be strengthened by her protection at your side.

text: Deus qui beatam virginem et martyrem tuam Wenefredam post capitis abscisionem tua potentia redivivam fieri praecepisti fac nos quaesumus ea interveniente vitae praesentis pariter et futurae subsidia convenienter adipisci.
translation_en: God who commanded your blessed virgin and martyr Wenefred to be revived after the separation of her head through your power, grant us, we beseech you, that we may fittingly obtain support both in the present and future life with her intervention.

text: Deus qui beatam virginem et matrem Mariam in conceptu et in partu consecrasti et Ionam prophetam de ventre ceti potenti virtute liberasti tuam famulam gravidam protege et visita eam in salutari tuo ut proles in illa contenta feliciter in lucem prodeat et perveniat ad gratiam lavacri salutaris.
translation_en: God, who consecrated the blessed Virgin and Mother Mary in conception and childbirth, and who liberated John the Prophet from the powerful womb of Elizabeth with Your mighty power, protect and visit your servant, who is pregnant, that a child may be born happily within her and reach the grace of the saving wash.

text: Deus qui beatam virginem Mariani tibi iri templo praesentari et spiritu sancto erudiri sanxisti da nobis sic Sancti Spiritus instrui disciplinis ut dignum tibi munus devoti pectoris offeramus.
translation_en: God, who presented the Blessed Virgin Mary to your temple and educated her with the Holy Spirit, grant us to be instructed by the Holy Spirit so that we may offer you a worthy service from the devoted heart.

text: Deus qui beatas Mariam Iacobi et Mariam Salome gloriosissimas tuae matris Mariae sorores ad resurrectionis tuae denuntiationem elegisti et hodierna die tecum in caelis gloriose collocasti tribue quaesumus ut a peccatorum morte resuscitati et earum intercessione suffulti in aeterna gloria cum ipsis perenniter gaudere valeamus.
translation_en: God, who chose the most glorious Mary, James' and Mary of Salome, sisters of your mother Mary, for the announcement of your resurrection, and on this day placed them gloriously with you in heaven. We ask that you grant us, that having been raised from the death of sins, we may be supported by their intercession and rejoice eternally with them.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus hosanna in excelsis
translation_en: Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God, Hosanna in the highest!

text: Deus qui beatas Mariam Iacobi et Mariam Salome merite et carne ita sublimasti ut ex eodem quo unigeniti tui genitrix prodirent utero ac plurium virtutum refulgerent exemplo fac nos earum quaesumus ubique gaudere suffragiis quas praerogativa honorasti tantae dignitatis.
translation_en: God, who raised the blessed Mary, Jacob's and Mary of Salome, so highly in flesh that from the same womb as your only-begotten Son's mother, they were born and shone forth as examples of many virtues. We humbly ask that we everywhere rejoice in their intercessions, which you have honored with such great dignity by your prerogative.

text: Deus qui beati confessoris tui Benedicti meritis prolapsum ab imo lacus gurgite ferrum remeare fecisti praesta quaesumus ipsius nos interventu de lacu miseriae eripi et ad supernae hereditatis gaudia reformari.
translation_en: God, who by the merits of your blessed confessor Benedict caused iron to float up from the depths of the lake, grant us we beseech you, that through his intervention we may be snatched away from the lake of misery and reformed for the joys of the heavenly inheritance.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui caelum et terram
translation_en: Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God who created heaven and earth

text: Deus qui beati Edwardi martyris tui meritis mederis languentium turmis eius precatu quaesumus nostras conscientias a noxia valetudine sanare dignare.
translation_en: God, who heals the sick through the merits of blessed Edward your martyr, we humbly ask that you deign to heal our conscience from harmful illness.

text: Deus qui beati Hieronymi mentem gratiae tuae munere inspirasti et per eum divinarum scripturarum sacramentis tuorum fidelium mentes instruxisti eius quaesumus interventu nos aeternae dulcedinis tuae fonte satiare digneris.
translation_en: God, who by your grace inspired the mind of blessed Jerome and through him instructed the minds of your faithful in the mysteries of your divine scriptures, we humbly ask that through his intercession, you deign to satisfy us from the fountain of your eternal sweetness.

text: Deus qui beati Ioannis evangelistae praeconiis principii sempiterni secreta reserasti da quaesumus ut ad intellegentiam Verbi eius per quem nobis resplendet suffragiis accedamus.
translation_en: God who revealed to the preaching of blessed John the Evangelist the beginning of eternal secrets, we humbly ask that through his intercession we may come to understanding of His Word by whom we are enlightened.

text: Deus qui beati Petri apostoli dignitatem ubique facis esse gloriosam praesta quaesumus ut et doctrina semper ipsius foveamur et meritis.
translation_en: God who make the dignity of blessed Peter the apostle glorious everywhere, grant us we ask, that we may always nourish the teaching of him and his merits.

text: Deus qui beatorum apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli dignitatem ubique gloriosam tua gratia perfecisti tribue nobis quaesumus ut et doctrinis eorum semper muniamur et meritis.
translation_en: God, who through your grace made the dignity of your apostles Peter and Paul everywhere glorious, grant us we pray, that we may always be fortified with their teachings and rewarded by their merits.

text: Deus qui beati praesulis tui Dunstani spiritum luce hodierna regni caelestis provehis ad gaudia concede quaesumus nobis supplicibus ut quem doctorem tui nominis habuimus in terris semper habere mereamur intercessorem in caelis.
translation_en: God, who today raised the spirit of your blessed bishop Dunstan to the joys of the heavenly kingdom, we humbly ask that you grant us that we may always merit to have him as an intercessor in heaven whom we had as a teacher of your name on earth.

text: Deus qui beatissimae virginis tuae Eulaliae animam in specie columbae niveae caelum cunctis cernentibus penetrare fecisti concede nobis famulis tuis ut qui eius festivitatem veneramur meritis ipsius intercedentibus ad superna pervenire gaudia mereamur.
translation_en: God, who made the soul of your blessed virgin Eulalia penetrate the heavens as a snowy dove for all to see, grant us, your servants, that we who come to celebrate her feast day may, through her intercession, merit to reach the heavenly joys.

text: Deus qui beatissimam virginem Barbaram roseo martyrii cruore perfusam hodie in thalamo regni tui collocasti concede propitius ut per eam suorum apud te delictorum veniam obtineant qui eius sempiternae claritati humillima devotione congaudent.
translation_en: God, who today placed the most blessed virgin Barbara in Your royal chamber, poured out with rose-colored martyrdom, graciously grant that they may obtain forgiveness for their sins among Yourself through her, who with humble devotion rejoice in her eternal brightness.

text: Deus qui beatissimam virginem Mariam post animae infusionem per copiosum gratiae munus mirabiliter ab omni peccati macula mundasti et in sanctitatis puritate postea confirmasti praesta quaesumus ut qui in honorem suae sanctificationis congregamur eius intercessionibus a te de instantibus periculis eruamur.
translation_en: God, who made the most blessed Virgin Mary clean from all stain of sin after the infusion of the abundant gift of grace and confirmed her in the purity of sanctity afterwards, grant us that we who gather in honor of her sanctification may be freed by her intercessions from immediate dangers.

text: Deus qui beatissimi levitae tui Laurentii fidem nec igne subrui nec avaritia fecisti corrumpi cum et inter flammas invictus et inter nummos exsisteret a cupiditate intactus perspicuam tuae maiestatis potentiam imploramus ut fidem qua tibi credimus in nobis adaugeas caritatis opes impendas cupiditates interimas simultatum faces exstinguas quo nec avaritia devicti nec odiis ad te veniamus illaesi illo caritatis tuae rore novandi quo idem martyr tuus decoctus igne meruit recreari.
translation_en: God, who did not allow the faith of your dearest Levite Laurence to be destroyed by fire nor corrupted by greed, since he existed both among the flames unconquered and among coins untouched by desire. We implore your manifest power to add to the faith that we believe in us the works of charity, to extinguish the inner desires, simultaneously, like faces. So that neither greed nor hatred prevail over us, but come to you unharmed by that same dew of your love with which your martyr Laurence was rejuvenated by being boiled in fire.

text: Deus qui beatissimi martyris tui Romani precibus ita adfuisti ut paratum ad supplicium suum ignem sic caelestium exstingueres pluviarum ex gurgite ne locus flammae ullo modo videretur accensae tu in no<bi>s eo apud te suffragante petulantiae divinis flatibus incentiva exstingue ut super nos ita stillent guttae tui amoris quo mereamur fructum capere aeternae felicitatis.
translation_en: God, who was present with such favor to the prayers of your most blessed martyr in Rome, that you extinguished the fire of his trial with heavenly showers from the mouth of the spring, so also in our case, through your goodness, put out the flames with divine breaths, when we are praying through your intercession. May droplets of your love fall upon us, so that we may deserve to reap the fruit of eternal happiness.

text: Deus qui beatissimos martyres Vincentium Sabinam atque Christetam et germanitatis et passionis unione individuos fore constituisti ut qui uno erant germine proditi unius quoque essent passionis gloria consummandi tuis nostras auribus ingerimus voces omni te cordis intentione rogantes ut etsi simus dividui corpore te opitulante habeamur individui caritate.
translation_en: God who made the blessed martyrs Vincent, Sabina, and Christeta one through the bond of brotherhood and passion, that they who were born as one seed may also share in the same glory of suffering, we bring before your ears our voices with all the intention of our hearts, beseeching you. Although we are divided in body, by your help, may we be united in love.

text: Deus qui beatissimum Benedictum electum tuum abstractum a mundi turbinibus tibi soli militare iussisti tribue quaesumus huic famulo tuo illi sub eiusdem magisterio ad tuum servitium festinanti perseverationis instantiam et persecutionis usque in finem victoriam.
translation_en: O God, who chose the most blessed Benedict to be withdrawn from the turbulence of this world and commanded him to fight only for you, grant we beg, to this your servant, under his same teaching, eagerness for your service with steadfast perseverance, and victory against persecution until the end.

text: Deus qui beatissimum Felicem martyrem tuum ita Sancti Spiritus calore flammasti ut contemptu rerum praesentium te sequeretur et promissionis tuae donis caelestibus ditaretur qui in genitali solo tepescente persecutionis flamma dum miles tuus in quo pro tuo nomine certaretur inquireret et inexardescentem declinare a civitate in civitatem sciret zelo tui amoris armatus non ad otium se elegit abscondere sed in acie ubi certamen ageretur immittere.  His itaque patriae cedens ponti freta transcurrens te qui ubique totus es quaerens Gerundam usque pervenit in qua ut bonus negotiator pretiosam margaritam quam distractis omnibus comparaverat cunctis fideliter ponebat per quam et fortes in fide construeret et dubios fidei fideliter reformaret non formidando de praesentibus poenis sed properando congaudens praemiis de aeternis.  Unde precamur te omnipotens Deus ut eius suffragio nos tuearis de caelis cuius martyrium cultu tuo celebramus in terris.
translation_en:
God, who set your blessed Felician martyr on fire with the heat of the Holy Spirit, causing him to follow you in contempt for present things and be enriched by the gifts of your promises. While he was walking on the scorching ground amidst the persecution's flame, your soldier, fighting for your name, knew how to travel from city to city armed with your love's zeal. Instead of hiding himself in peace, he chose to engage in battle where the contest would be fought.
Leaving his homeland, crossing over rivers and flowing seas, seeking Gerunda, he reached it, where as a good merchant, he compared a precious pearl that he had found among all others and placed it faithfully with everyone. Through this pearl, he built up strong ones in faith and reformed the doubters faithfully, not fearing present punishments but running towards eternal rewards.
Therefore, we pray to you, almighty God, that through his intercession, you protect us from heaven, whose martyrdom we celebrate on earth.

text: Deus qui beatissimum Iacobum apostolum tuum a pharisaeis ex alto praecipitatum valentem efficis et robustum cum fides tua quae inter undas evexerat Petrum hunc ex alto salvaret elapsum tu Ecclesiam tuam inter procellosas commotionum saecularium undas pius gubernator tuere et cottidianae gubernationis amminiculo ad portum salutis eam facito pervenire quo hic liberata a malorum pressuris ad te perveniat in abundantia pacis.
translation_en: God, who made the most blessed Jacob, your apostle, strong and robust from being thrown down by the Pharisees, make him save Peter, who was rescued from above. You, who saved this one from the waves through faith, protect your Church amid the stormy waves of secular upheavals with a pious governor. Make her daily guided to the port of salvation so that she may reach you, free from the pressures of evil, in abundance of peace.

text: Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus virtutem tuam totis
translation_en: Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, bestow your power upon all.

text: Deus qui beatissimum Iudocum confessorem tuum aeternitatis gloria sublimasti concede nobis famulis tuis eius festa celebrantibus cunctorum veniam delictorum et aeternae beatitudinis praemium sempiternum.
translation_en: God, who raised the most blessed Jerome, your confessor, to the glory of eternity, grant us, your servants, celebrating his festival, forgiveness of all sins and the eternal reward of everlasting beatitude.

text: Deus qui beato Alexio confessori tuo tribuisti ut et nova mundum arte deluderet et de hoste generis humani mirabiliter triumpharet concede propitius ut eius muniamur auxiliis cuius salutiferis erudiamur exemplis.
translation_en: God, who granted your confessor Saint Alexius to deceive the world with new art and to victoriously triumph over the enemy of the human race in a marvelous way, graciously grant that we may be protected by his aid and that we may be instructed by his salutary examples.

text: Deus qui beato archangelo tuo Michaeli tantam gratiam contulisti ut serpentem antiquum hostem humani generis perpetua victoria de caelo in terram proficeret exaudi propitius orationem nostram et concede ut eius intercessionibus nostra iubeas relaxari peccata.
translation_en: God, who granted such grace to the blessed archangel Michael that the ancient serpent, enemy of the human race, might proceed from heaven to earth with perpetual victory, hear our prayer graciously and grant that through his intercessions, we may be commanded to be freed from our sins.

text: Deus qui beato confessori tuo Iudoco excellentis gloriae contulisti coronam concede ut omnes qui meritorum eius venerantur insignia tua ubique consequantur beneficia.
translation_en: God, who gave your blessed confesor Judas the crown of excellent glory, grant that all who venerate his merits may everywhere follow your blessings with your signs.

text: Deus qui beato Mauro sacerdoti et martyri tuo virtutem atque victoriam tribuisti praesta quaesumus ut dum eius merita veneramur imitari studia valeamus.
translation_en: God who gave strength and victory to the blessed Maurice, your priest and martyr, grant us, we ask, that as we honor his merits, we may be able to emulate his studies.

text: Deus qui beato apostolo tuo Petro collatis clavibus regni caelestis animas ligandi atque solvendi pontificium tradidisti concede ut intercessionis eius auxilio a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus liberemur.
translation_en: God, who gave to your blessed apostle Peter the keys of the kingdom of heaven for binding and loosing souls, grant that through his assistance we may be freed from the bonds of our sins.

text: Deus qui beato Cucufati martyri tuo flamma tui spiritus succenso superare tribuisti suorum incendia tormentorum concede propitius per eius intercessionem ut nos famulos tuos non exurat flamma vitiorum.
translation_en: God, who through the flame of your Spirit strengthened the martyr Cucufate, grant us graciously through his intercession that we, Your servants, may not be burned by the flames of vices.

text: Deus qui beato Felici detento in vinculis in specie corusci visus es iuvenis mentes nostras ut gratia tui luminis quaesumus illustrare digneris.
translation_en: God, who showed yourself to the blessed Felix, imprisoned in chains, as a youth shining, have mercy on us and deign to illuminate our minds with your grace of light, we humbly ask.

text: Deus qui beato Iusto talem fortitudinem tribuisti ut in puerili corpusculo gloriosum pro tuo amore subiret martyrium concede propitius ut ipsius intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos absolvas peccatis.
translation_en: God, who granted such fortitude to the blessed Justus that in a child's small body he suffered glorious martyrdom for your love, graciously grant that through his intercession we may be absolved from all our sins.

text: Deus qui beato levitae Stephano lapidantibus veniam poscere tribuisti quaesumus ut bona pro malis reddere tuo possimus auxilio quod primi martyris docemur exemplo.
translation_en: God, who granted the blessed Levite Stephen the ability to ask for forgiveness when he was being stoned, we ask that through your help, we may be able to give good for evil as we are taught by his example as the first martyr.

text: Deus qui beato Martino confessori tuo tantam gloriam etiam ante lavacrum contulisti ut veste quam pauperi tribuerat tuum filium indutum cerneret et laudem sui operis ab ipso audiret praesta quaesumus eius nos meritis a peccatis omnibus exui et beatae immortalitatis luce vestiri.
translation_en: God, who granted such great glory to your confessor Martin even before the baptism, that he saw your son clothed in the garment which he had given to a poor man, and heard him praise for his work, grant us, we ask, that through his merits we may be freed from all sins and dressed in the light of blessed immortality.

text: Deus qui beato martyri tuo Felici ut persequentium rabiem vinceret tantam contulisti constantiam eius ope quaesumus suffragari quo tibi digne semper mereamur famulari.
translation_en: God, who gave your blessed martyr Felicity such great constancy to overcome the fury of those pursuing her, we humbly ask that you grant us your support so that we may always deserve to serve you worthy.

text: Dum tondis eum dicis
translation_en: While you are cutting him, you say

text: Deus qui beato martyri tuo Georgio aeternam iri caelis coronam victoriae contulisti et nobis adstantibus ante conspectum maiestatis tuae propitius adesse digneris.
translation_en: God, who granted eternal celestial crown of victory to your blessed martyr George, be gracious and deign to be present before the sight of your majesty for us standing by.

text: Deus qui beato Victori martyri tuo ex hoste humani generis victoriam tribuisti concede nobis et exemplo ipsius muniri et precibus ad praemia caelestia sublimari.
translation_en: God, who gave victory over the enemy of the human race to your blessed martyr Victor, grant us also to be defended by his example and to be lifted up to heavenly rewards through his prayers.

text: Deus qui beatos confessores tuos illos sanctorum tuorum meritis coaequasti da nobis in eorum celebritate gaudere ut quorum commemorationem agimus eorum imitatione proficiamus et intercessionibus sublevemur.
translation_en: God, who has equated your blessed confessors with the merits of your saints, grant us to enjoy their festivity so that by remembering them we may progress in their example and be lifted up by their intercessions.

text: Deus qui beatum Aegidium confessorem tuum atque abbatem misericordem fecisti pro peccatis hominum da nobis ipsius interventu peccatorum nostrorum veniam et aeternae beatitudinis optabilem laetitiam.
translation_en: God, who made blessed Gregory, your confessor and abbot, merciful for the sins of mankind, grant us through his intervention forgiveness for our sins and the joyfully attainable eternal beatitude.

text: Deus qui beatum Alexandrum martyrem tuum idolam Maximiani calce percutientem mensam eiicere praecepisti ita per eius intercessionem nos facias omnes inimici insidias vincere et ad caelestia regna pervenire.
translation_en: God, who commanded your blessed Alexander the martyr to throw Maximian's idol from the table by striking it with his foot, through his intercession make us all overcome our enemies' traps and reach the heavenly kingdoms.

text: Deus qui beatum Alphegum pontificem tuum sacerdotii dignitate et palma martyrii decorasti concede propitius ita nos apud te eius intercessionibus adiuvari ut cum eo possimus in aeterna felicitate laetari.
translation_en: God, who adorned your servant Blessed Alphege with the dignity of the priesthood and the palm of martyrdom, grant us graciously so that we may be helped by his intercessions and rejoice with him in eternal happiness.

text: Deus qui beatum Ambrosium confessorem tuum atque pontificem et claritate fidei et meritorum adornasti virtute concede mentibus nostris eius quam docuit fidei firmitatem et ipso intercedente aeternae gloriae promereri consortium.
translation_en: God who adorned your confessor and bishop Ambrose with the brilliance of faith and good works, grant to our minds the firmness of faith that he taught, and through his intercession, may we be promised a share in the eternal glory.

text: Deus qui beatum archipraesulem Alfegum die hodierna dira passione occubentem perennem transtulisti ad gloriam praesta quaesumus ut illius adiuvemur orationibus qui tui nominis praedicator exstitit gloriosus.
translation_en: God, who on the day of his bitter passion transferred the blessed archbishop Alfegus to eternal glory, grant us, we pray, that we may be helped by his prayers, who became a glorious preacher of your name.

text: Deus qui beatum Armagillum confessorem tuum onere carnis deposito in caeli palatio hodierna die collocasti tribue quaesumus ut eo ductore valeamus ad optatam caelestem patriam feliciter pervenire.
translation_en: God who placed your blessed servant Armagill on the throne in heaven today, we humbly ask that you grant us the ability to be led by him and to reach our desired heavenly homeland happily.

text: Deus qui beatum Arnulfum confessorem tuum atque pontificem doctorem praecipuum catholicaeque fidei praedicatorem eligere dignatus es praesta quaesumus ut ipso pro nobis intercedente peccatorum nostrorum mereamur exui malis et tibi domino sinceris mentibus deservire.
translation_en: God, who chose the blessed Arnulf, your confessor and bishop, a prominent teacher of the Catholic faith and a preacher of the Christian doctrine, has deemed fit. Grant us, we entreat you, that through his intercession we may deserve to be freed from our sins and serve you, Lord, with sincere minds.

text: Deus qui beatum Athanasium confessorem tuum atque pontificem Ecclesiae tuae tribuisti doctorem praesta quaesumus ut quod ille divino afflatu inspiratus docuit et sinceriter intellegere et efficaciter exercere valeamus.
translation_en: God, who granted your blessed Athanasius, your confessor and bishop of your church, a teacher, grant us, we beseech you, that we may be able to understand truly and effectively exercise what he, inspired by the divine Spirit, taught.

text: Deus qui beatum Augustinum Ecclesiae tuae in exponendis scripturae sacrae mysteriis doctorem optimum et electum antistitem providisti da nobis eius semper et doctrinis instrui et oratione fulciri.
translation_en: God, who provided the blessed Augustine as an optimal and chosen teacher in expounding the mysteries of your sacred scriptures and elected him as a bishop, grant us always to be instructed by his teachings and to be fulfilled by his prayer.

text: Deus qui beatum Augustinum pontificem primum doctorem populo concessisti Anglorum ipsius interventu nobis tribue veniam peccatorum et cum ipso caelestium gaudia praemiorum.
translation_en: God who granted the blessed Augustine, the first teacher of the English people, as their bishop, grant us pardon for our sins and with him, the rewards of heavenly joy.

text: Deus qui beatum Augustinum pontificem primum doctorem populo concessisti Anglorum tribue nobis quaesumus ut cuius merita praedicamus in terris eius suffragia apud te sentiamus in caelis.
translation_en: God who granted the blessed Augustine, the first teacher of the English people as a pope, grant us, we ask, that we may feel his intercession on earth because of his merits, and that his influence be felt with you in heaven.

text: Deus qui beatum Barnabam in praedicatione tuis apostolis sociasti tribue quaesumus ad eius nos pervenire consortium cuius celebramus praesenti festivitate triumphum.
translation_en: God who associated blessed Barnabas with your apostles in preaching, grant us that we may reach his fellowship, whose triumph we celebrate in the present feast day.

text: Deus qui beatum Benedictum confessorem tuum in terris vita laudabili decorasti et iri caelis aeterna gloria sublimasti eius quaesumus suffragantibus meritis vita nostra apud te commendetur.
translation_en: God, who adorned your blessed Benedict in life with praiseworthy decorum and elevated him in heaven to eternal glory, we humbly ask that through his merits, our lives may be recommended to you.

text: Deus qui beatum Blasium ita in petra fidei solidasti ut nullo tormentorum genere posset superari concede nobis propitius ut a cunctis animae et corporis molestiis eius pia intercessione liberemur.
translation_en: God who strengthened blessed Blaise so firmly in the rock of faith that he could not be overcome by any kind of torment, grant us graciously that we may be freed from all spiritual and bodily troubles through his pious intercession.

text: Deus qui beatum Britium gloriosissimo magistro suo Martino in pontificatum succedere fecisti ipsius meritis fac nos omnipotentiae tuae placere sibique in lucis perpetuae felicitate cohaerere.
translation_en: God who made the blessed British Martin, a most glorious master, succeed to the pontificate through his merits, make us pleasing to your omnipotence and join us in eternal light's perpetual happiness.

text: Deus qui beatum Byrinum confessorem tuum atque pontificem praesenti familiae tuae praedicatorem salutis aeternae misisti tribue quaesumus ut qui eius corporali vicinitate fovere gaudemus in terris ipsius meritis et precibus apud misericordiam tuam adiuvari mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: God who sent your blessed servant and bishop Byrinian as a proclaimer of eternal salvation to your present family, grant us that we may rejoice in earthly companionship with him because of his merits and prayers, and may be worthy to be helped by your mercy in heaven.

text: Effeta quod est adaperire
translation_en: Make what is to be apprehended

text: Deus qui beatum confessorem tuum David atque pontificem angelo nuntiante Patricio prophetante triginta annis antequam nasceretur praedixisti quaesumus ut cuius memoriam recolimus eius intercessione ad aeterna gaudia perveniamus.
translation_en: God who predicted through the angel that Patrick would announce Your blessed servant David, and through Prophet Jeremiah foretold thirty years before he was born, we beseech You. May we recall his memory through his intercession so that we may reach eternal joy.

text: Deus qui beatum confessorem tuum Furseum tui nominis sanctissimi praedicatorem effecisti devotum concede propitius ut eius interventione praeclara in caelestibus mereamur adscribi cum sanctis.
translation_en: God, who made your blessed confessor Furseus a devoted proclaimer of your most holy name, grant us your favor propitiously, so that through his intervention we may merit to be assigned among the glorious saints in heaven.

text: Deus qui beatum Dunstanum pontificem ad regna transtulisti caelestia da nobis per gloriosa eius merita ad gaudia transire perennia.
translation_en: God who transported the blessed Dunstan to the realm of heaven, grant us through his glorious merits to pass into eternal joys.

text: Deus qui beatum Edmundum confessorem tuum atque pontificem a suppliciis ad gaudia transtulisti tribue quaesumus ut qui translationem eius veneramur in terris per eius patrocinium ad caelestia transferamur.
translation_en: God who transported your blessed Edmund, your confessor and bishop, from sufferings to joys, we beseech you to grant that we who reverence his translation on earth may be transferred through his patronage to the heavenly realms.
