text: Deus qui beatum Edwardum regem Anglorum iniuste occisum pie iustificas et miris signis mundanis declaras concede propitius ut eius apud te precibus sublevemur cuius diem passionis devote celebramus.
translation_en: God, who justly vindicates the blessed Edward, king of the English, slain unjustly, and who declares miraculous signs in this world, grant us propitiously that we may be lifted up by his prayers on whose day of passion we devoutly celebrate.

text: Deus qui beatum Erasmum martyrem tuum atque pontificem a tormentis ereptum angelico pane satiasti tribue nobis quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus ab hostibus animae et corporis triumphare valeamus et aeterna dulcedine perfrui mereamur.
translation_en: God who satisfied your blessed Erasmus, the martyr and bishop, with bread from angels, grant us, we ask, that through his merits and intercessions we may triumph over our enemies in soul and body, and may deserve to enjoy eternal sweetness.

text: Deus qui beatum Ethelwoldum pontificem sanctorum tuorum meritis aequalem gloriosis ostendis miraculis praesta quaesumus ut quem nobis in terris donasti doctorem in caelo facias habere intercessorem.
translation_en: God, who showed the blessed Ethelwold, your priest, equal to your saints through miraculous deeds, we ask that you grant, that whom you gave us as a teacher on earth, you make him our intercessor in heaven.

text: Deus qui beatum Eustachium in temptationibus probasti et probatum coronasti ipsius sociorumque eius meritis in omnibus temptationibus tuum nobis praesta auxilium et sempiternum gaudium.
translation_en: God who tested the blessed Eustachius in trials and crowned him after he was proven, grant us aid in all our trials and everlasting joy through his and his companions' merits.

text: Emitte Domine Spiritum Sanctum tuum Paraclitum de caelis in hanc pingudinem olivae
translation_en: Send forth, O Lord, Your Holy Spirit, the Comforter, from Heaven upon this olive oil.

text: Deus qui beatum Gregorium pontificem sanctorum tuorum meritis coaequasti concede propitius ut qui commemorationis eius festa percolimus vitae quoque imitemur exempla.
translation_en: God, who equated the blessed Gregory the Pope among your saints through their merits, grant us graciously that we who celebrate his festival may also imitate his examples in life.

text: Emitte quaesumus Domine lucem tuam in cordibus nostris
translation_en: Send us, we ask you, Lord, your light into our hearts

text: Deus qui beatum Grimbaldum sanctitatis gratia decorasti ipsius meritis fac nos bonis operibus abundare et concede ut cuius annuam celebritatem devotis exsultamus officiis eius suffragiis dona tuae gratiae consequamur.
translation_en: God who adorned blessed Grimbald with the grace of holiness, make us abound in good works through his merits, and grant that we may follow the annual celebrations of him with devoted services, so that through his intercession we may attain the rewards of your grace.

text: Deus qui beatum Hugonem confessorem tuum atque pontificem eminentia meritorum et claritate signorum excellenter ornasti concede propitius ut eius exempla nos provocent et virtutes illustrent.
translation_en: God, who adorned your confessor and bishop, Blessed Hugh, excellently with the splendor of his merits and the brightness of his signs, grant us mercifully that his examples provoke us and his virtues illuminate us.

text: Emitte quaesumus Domine Spiritum Sanctum
translation_en: Send forth, we ask you, Lord, the Holy Spirit

text: Deus qui beatum Ianuarium sacerdotem et martyrem tuum et socios eius iri tribulationibus probasti in angustiis dilatasti in persecutionibus glorificasti da nobis eorum meritis tenere constantiam imitari vitam praedicare cum laetitia eorum venerabilem passionem.
translation_en: God who tested your blessed servant and martyr John in afflictions, stretched him out in persecutions, and glorified him, grant us through their merits to hold steadfastness, to imitate their life, to proclaim it with joy, and to venerate their worthy passion.

text: Deus qui beatum illum confessorem tuum atque abbatem sanctitatis gratia decorasti ipsius meritis fac nos bonis operibus abundare ut a te summo bono omne quod expedit mereamur impetrare.
translation_en: God who adorned your blessed confessor and abbot with grace through his merits, make us abundant in good works so that we may deserve to obtain from you every good thing that is appropriate.

text: Deus qui beatum Ioachim prae omnibus sanctis tuis in unigeniti Filii tui incarnati avum a quo purissima illius mater et virgo digne generaretur elegisti concede propitius ut cuius festa debito honore veneramur eius interventu hic tuae gratiae et tandem donis gloriae repleamur.
translation_en: God who chose the blessed Joachim above all your saints as the ancestor of your only-begotten Son through whom his most pure mother and virgin worthy generated, grant us graciously that we may honor his feast day with due reverence. May we be filled here with your grace and finally with the gifts of glory through his intervention.

text: Deus qui beatum Iulianum confessorem tuum hospitalitatis gratia insignem esse fecisti tribue quaesumus eius meritis et precibus ut hodie et cottidie invenire possimus hospitium quod nostrae fragilitati sit congruum et sanctitati tuae acceptum.
translation_en: God, who made your servant Julian a distinguished one through the grace of hospitality, grant us we beseech you that through his merits and prayers, we may find today and every day a hospice suitable for our frailty and acceptable to Your holiness.

text: Ergo maledicte diabole
translation_en: So curse the devil

text: Deus qui beatum Iustum aetate parvulum magnum fide atque virtute fecisti tribue quaesumus ut sincera tibi mente devoti et praesentis vitae remediis gaudeamus et futurae.
translation_en: God, who made the blessed Just one small in age but great in faith and virtue, grant us that we may rejoice with a sincere mind devoted to you, and enjoy the remedies of this present life and the future as well.

text: Deus qui beatum Kentigernum confessorem tuum atque pontificem Ecclesiae tuae doctorem pariter et rectorem mirifice praesignasti praesta quaesumus ut cuius venerandam sollemnitatem celebramus ipsius semper suffragia sentiamus.
translation_en: God who magnificently signified your blessed Kentigern, confesser, bishop and teacher of your Church, grant us we beseech you, that we may always feel his constant intercession, as we celebrate the venerable solemnity of him whom we honor.

text: Deus qui beatum Laurentium archipraesulem populo tuo praedicatorem salutis aeternae misisti tribue quaesumus ut qui eius hodie sollemnia celebramus ipsius meritis et precibus a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus absolvi mereamur.
translation_en: God, who sent the blessed Laurentius, the archpriest and preacher of eternal salvation to your people, grant us we beseech you, that we who today celebrate his solemnities may be worthy to be freed from the bonds of our sins through his merits and prayers.

text: Deus qui beatum Leothardum pontificem apostolicis aequasti luminaribus ipso intercedente corda nostra quaesumus misericordiae tuae claritate illustra.
translation_en: God, who adorned the blessed Leothard with the light of the apostles, we humbly ask that through his intercession you enlighten our hearts with the brightness of your mercy.

text: Deus qui beatum martyrem tuum Leudegarium in agone probasti et probatum in dolore sustentasti quem hodierna die in caelestibus gaudiis recipere dignatus es praesta nobis famulis tuis ut qui gloriam non meremur indulgentiam peccatorum ipso interveniente adipisci mereamur.
translation_en: God, who tested your blessed martyr Leudegar in the contest and supported him in suffering whom today you have deemed worthy to receive in heavenly joys, grant us, your servants, that we who do not deserve glory may merit indulgence through his intervention.

text: Deus qui beatum Leufredum confessorem tuum atque abbatem eximiae sanctitatis gratia decorasti concede propitius ut cuius sollemnia veneramur ipso interveniente eius gloriae participes fieri mereamur.
translation_en: God who adorned your confessor and abbot, Blessed Leufred, with exceptional holiness, graciously grant that we may deserve to become participants in his glory as we honor his feast day, through his intervention.

text: Deus qui beatum Ludovicum confessorem tuum de terreno ac temporali regno ad caelestis et aeterni regni gloriam transtulisti eius quaesumus meritis et intercessione regis regum Iesu Christi Filii tui nos coheredes efficias et eiusdem regni tribuas esse consortes.
translation_en: God, who transferred your blessed confessor Louis from the earthly and temporal kingdom to the glory of the celestial and eternal kingdom, we humbly ask through his merits and the intercession of King of Kings Jesus Christ, Your Son, to make us co-heirs and grant us to be consorts of the same kingdom.

text: Deus qui beatum Marcum evangelistam tuum evangelicae praedicationis gratia sublimasti tribue quaesumus eius nos semper et eruditione proficere et oratione defendi.
translation_en: God, who lifted your blessed Mark the evangelist through the grace of evangelical preaching, grant us, we ask, that we may always progress in his learning and be defended by his prayer.

text: Deus qui beatum Matthiam apostolorum tuorum collegio sociasti tribue quaesumus ut eius interventione tuae circa nos pietatis semper viscera sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who associated blessed Matthew with the college of your apostles, grant us that we may always feel the tender heart of your pity towards us through his intervention.

text: Deus qui beatum Mauricium confessorem tuum atque pontificem Ecclesiae tuae voluisti praeesse doctorem praesta quaesumus ut cuius natalicia colimus spe futuri gaudii non fraudemur.
translation_en: God who wanted your blessed Maurice, the confessor and bishop of your church, to preside as a teacher, grant us that we may not be deceived in celebrating his birthday, but experience the joy of the future.

text: Deus qui beatum Mauritium cum suis commilitonibus tyrannicis praeceptis resistendo fortiter fecisti victores eorum nobis quaesumus meritis concede contra omnia antiqui hostis tentamenta viriliter dimicare ut inter eos mereamur caelestia consequi dona.
translation_en: God, who made blessed Maurice and his fellow soldiers victorious against tyrannical commands, we humbly ask that through their merits you grant us the strength to fight manfully against all the old enemy's attempts. May we deserve to obtain celestial rewards among them.

text: Esto nobis propitius Deus ut tua nos misericordia
translation_en: May God be gracious to us, that His mercy may be upon us.

text: Deus qui beatum Michaelem archangelum electionis tuae populis constituisti principem praesta quaesumus ut quem nobis dedisti salutis ducem contra adversa omnia tribuas defensorem.
translation_en: God who established the blessed Michael, the archangel, as prince for Your people, grant us, we pray, that whom You have given to us as leader of salvation, You may also provide as a defender against all adversities.

text: Deus qui beatum Nicolaum pontificem tuum innumeris decorasti miraculis tribue nobis quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus a gehennae incendiis liberemur.
translation_en: God who adorned your blessed Nicholas, the pope, with countless miracles, grant us we pray, that through his merits and prayers, we may be freed from the fires of hell.

text: Deus qui beatum Norbertum confessorem tuum atque pontificem vitae sanctimonia clarificasti dono praedicationis verbi tui illustrasti et stupendorum miraculorum operatione fecundasti da nobis quaesumus ut quae docuit memoria teneamus et quae fecit tua ineffabili misericordia et eius interventione digne imitemur.
translation_en: God, who made blessed Norbert, your confessor and bishop, shine with the clarity of holy life, illuminated by the gift of your preaching word, and brought about by the operation of wondrous miracles, we humbly ask that we may hold in memory what he taught, and may worthily imitate what you did through your ineffable mercy and his intervention.

text: Deus qui beatum Pantaleonem martyrem tuum inter vincula liberum inter tormenta securum gratiae tuae ubertate fecisti quaesumus clementiam tuam ut in nobis flammas corporalium passionum misericordiae tuae imbre restringas et rorem beatae caritatis semper accendas.
translation_en: God, who made your blessed martyr Pantaleon free among chains and secure amidst torments through the abundance of your grace, we humbly ask for your clemency to restrain in us the flames of your merciful passion and always kindle within us the dew of blessed charity.

text: Deus qui beatum Patricium Hiberniae apostolum signis multimodis decoratum ad caelestem gloriam transtulisti praesta quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus adiuti aeternae beatitudinis praemia consequamur.
translation_en: God, who adorned the blessed Patrick of Ireland with various signs and transported him to celestial glory, grant us, we ask, that we may attain eternal blessings through his merits and prayers.

text: Deus qui beatum Petrum apostolum a vinculis absolutum illaesum abire fecisti nostrorum quaesumus absolve vincula peccatorum et omnia mala a nobis propitiatus exclude.
translation_en: God, who freed the blessed Peter, the apostle, from chains and allowed him to walk unharmed, we humbly ask that you forgive us our sins and remove all evil from us, being appeased by your mercy.

text: Deus qui beatum Petrum a vinculis absolutum illaesum abire fecisti famuli tui vincula cunctamque miseriam solve et eum ipsius meritis illaesum abire concede.
translation_en: God, who freed blessed Peter from bonds and allowed him to walk unharmed, release your servant from all bondage and misery, and grant him to walk unharmed through his own merits.

text: Deus qui beatum Pieranum confessorem tuum atque pontificem virtutum titulis et miraculorum decorasti insigniis concede propitius ita nos eius meritis adiuvari ut ei in aeterna beatitudine mereamur associari.
translation_en: God, who adorned your blessed Pierius the confessor and bishop with titles of virtues and decorations of miracles, graciously grant that we may be helped by his merits so that we may deserve to be associated with him in eternal beatitude.

text: Deus qui beatum Raphaelem archangelum Tobiae famulo tuo properanti praevium direxisti et inter huius vitae ac viae varietates atque discrimina donasti custodem da quaesumus ut eiusdem protegamur auxilio quatenus et vitae praesentis vitemus pericula et ad gaudia valeamus pervenire caelestia.
translation_en: God, who directed the blessed Raphael, the archangel, to Tobias Your servant beforehand, and who gave him as a guard among the variations and discriminations of life, we humbly ask that we may be protected by his same aid. May we avoid the perils of this present life with his help and may we reach the celestial joys.

text: Deus qui beatum regem Edwardum confessorem tuum aeternitatis gloria coronasti fac nos quaesumus ita eum venerari in terris ut cum eo regnare possimus in caelis.
translation_en: God who crowned your confessionary King Edward with the glory of eternity, grant us that we may revere him on earth, so that we can rule with him in heaven.

text: Deus qui beatum Satyrum tui nominis confessorem mirabiliter effecisti praesta quaesumus ut eum pro nobis iugiter apud te interventorem sentiamus de cuius hic mirifico pignore gratulamur.
translation_en: God who wonderfully made the blessed Satyr, your confessor, grant us that we may always feel him as an intercessor before you, of whom we rejoice greatly in this marvelous testimony.

text: Deus qui beatum Sebastianum martyrem tuum virtute constantiae in passione roborasti ex eius nobis imitatione tribue pro amore tuo prospera mundi despicere et nulla eius adversa formidare.
translation_en: God, who strengthened your blessed martyr Sebastian with constancy in his passion, grant us through his example to despise the world for your love and to fear none of its adversities.

text: Et ego te baptizo in nomine
translation_en: And I baptize you in the name

text: Deus qui beatum Dionysium martyrem tuum virtute constantiae in passione roborasti quique illi ad praedicandum gentibus gloriam tuam Rusticum et Eleutherium sociare dignatus es tribue nobis quaesumus ex eorum imitatione pro amore tuo prospera mundi despicere et nulla eius adversa formidare.
translation_en: God, who strengthened your blessed martyr Dionysius with constancy in his passion and saw fit to associate Rusticus and Eleutherius with him for preaching the glory of you among the gentiles, grant us, we ask, through their example, to scorn the world for your love and fear none of its adversities.

text: Deus qui beatum Severinum famulum tuum ignotae gentis virum nobis mirabilem praestitisti da quaesumus ut eius apud te et iusta merita et sancta nos semper commendet oratio.
translation_en: God, who presented to us the blessed Severinus, a man of an unknown people, in a marvelous manner, we humbly ask that he continually recommends us before you, not only because of his just merits, but also because of his holy prayers.

text: Deus qui beatum Sigismundum regem utroque diademate cum desiderata corona martyrii honorare dignatus es et eius reliquias ex profundo gurgite ad celebrandum fidelibus revelasti tribue quaesumus ut qui eius merita in terra veneramur ipsius intercessionibus ab omnibus semper muniamur adversis.
translation_en: God, who deemed fit to honor King Saint Sigismund with the double diadem and the desired crown of martyrdom, and revealed his relics from the deep waters for the faithful to venerate, grant us, we pray, that we who on earth revere his merits may always be protected by his intercessions against all adversities.

text: Deus qui beatum Terrenanum Pictorum archipraesulem tua providentia sublimasti ut Pictos in tenebris suae gentilitatis errantes ad verum tuae divinitatis lumen perduceret tribue nobis quaesumus ut eius gloriosis precibus et meritis a praesentis vitae periculis et a gehennae incendiis liberemur.
translation_en: God, who raised the blessed Terrence, the archbishop of the Picts, through Your providence, so that the Picts wandering in the darkness of their paganism might be led to the true light of Your divinity. Grant us, we beseech You, that through his glorious prayers and merits, we may be freed from the perils of this life and the fires of hell.

text: Deus qui beatum Thomam archipraesulem et Angliae primatem in gremio sanctae matris ecclesiae martyrii palma consecrasti tribue nobis quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus adiuvemur in caelis cuius veneranda passione gloriamur in terris.
translation_en: God who consecrated blessed Thomas, the archbishop and first-ranking prelate of England, in the bosom of the holy mother church with the palm of martyrdom, grant us, we implore, that we may be aided by his merits and prayers in heaven; whose venerable passion we glorify on earth.

text: Deus qui beatum Yvonem confessorem tuum piis operibus signis et virtutibus in Ecclesia tua clarere fecisti praesta quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus tua beneficia capiamus.
translation_en: God who made blessed Yvon, your confessor, shine with pious works, signs, and virtues in Your Church, grant us, we ask, that we may receive Your blessings through his merits and prayers.

text: Deus qui bona cuncta et inchoas benignus et perficis da nobis sicut de initiis tuae gratiae gloriamur ita de perfectione gaudere.
translation_en: God, who is kind and begins all good things and brings them to completion, grant us, as we glory in the beginning of your grace, so may we rejoice in its perfection.

text: Deus qui bonis tuis infantium quoque tui nescia sacramenti corda praecedis tribue quaesumus ut nostrae conscientiae fiduciam non habentes indulgentia semper copiosa praeveniat.
translation_en: God who guides the hearts of even those infants unknown to Your sacrament, we ask that You grant us so that the abundant indulgence may always precede our conscience's faith.

text: Deus qui donis tuis infantium quoque tui nescia sacramenti corda praecedis tribue quaesumus ut qui nostrae conscientiae fiduciam non habemus indulgentia semper copiosa praeveniat.
translation_en: God who guides even the hearts of those infants unaware of your sacred mysteries, we humbly ask that he who lacks faith in our conscience may always be preceded by abundant mercy.

text: Deus qui caelestia famulis tuis dona largiris custodi in nobis gratiam quam dedisti. Vigeat in sensibus nostris munus infusum mentesque nostras cum corporis sospitate spiritalis esca proficiat.
translation_en: God, who grants to your celestial servants, bestow within us the grace that you have given. May the gift infused in our senses be vigorous. May our minds, along with the safety of our body, progress spiritually as nourishment.

text: Deus qui caelestis regni non nisi renatis pandis introitum auge super animam famuli tui illius gratiae tuae dona ut quae ab omnibus est purgata peccatis a nullis sit aliena promissis.
translation_en: God, who opens the entrance to the celestial kingdom only to the reborn, increase your grace upon the soul of that servant of yours, so that what has been purged from all sins may belong to none through your promises.

text: Deus qui candidatam tuam illam virginitate pariter et martyrio in fonte vivi certaminis abluisti ut confessionis gloria roseo sui sanguinis decore ornata spem caneret victoriae et mundum in suis dormientem peccatis ad confessionem tui nominis excitaret da eius patrocinio peccatis nostris indulgentiam qui dedisti certanti coronam.
translation_en: God who washed your maiden, both in virginity and martyrdom, in the font of living contest with whiteness, that she might sing hope victorious with the glory of her rosy blood and arouse the world sleeping in its sins to Your confession of name. Grant us her patronage for our sins and grant us indulgence, who gave the crown to the fighter.

text: Deus qui caritatis dona per gratiam Sancti Spiritus tuorum cordibus fidelium infudisti da famulis tuis pro quibus tuam deprecamur clementiam salutem mentis et corporis ut te tota virtute diligant et quae tibi sunt placita tota dilectione perficiant.
translation_en: God who bestows gifts of charity through the grace of the Holy Spirit upon the hearts of your faithful, grant your servants for whom we entreat your clemency, health of mind and body, that they may love you with all virtue and complete what pleases you with all affection.

text: Deus qui caritatis dona per gratiam Sancti Spiritus tuorum cordibus fidelium infundis famulo tuo illi omnibusque iri corpore seu extra corpus viventibus qui ei carnis affectu et spiritu coniuncti vel dando aut confitendo ob timorem nominis tui commissi sunt quorum numerus et nomina tibi universitatis domino nota sunt da quaesumus remissionem omnium peccatorum ut indulgentiam quam semper optaverunt piis supplicationibus consequantur.
translation_en: God, who bestows the gifts of charity through the grace of the Holy Spirit upon the hearts of your faithful servants, you pour out upon your servant and all those living in body or outside of it who are united to him in flesh and spirit, either by giving or confessing out of fear of your name. The number and names of these are known to you, Lord of the universe. We humbly ask for the remission of all sins, so that they may obtain the indulgence which they have always desired through their pious supplications.

text: Et vestitur infans
translation_en: And the infant is clothed

text: Deus qui caritatis es auctor et purae pacis ac dilectionis amator suscipe offerentium oblationes et infirmorum omnium christianorum sana languores quo te medicante et plenitudinem salutis recipiant et tuis semper sani iussionibus pareant. Id denique obnoxius quaeso ut omnes metu territos inopia afflictos tribulatione vexatos morbis obrutos suppliciis deditos debitis obligatos vel quolibet maerore constrictos cunctos indulgentia tuae pietatis absolvat morum emendatio relevet et miseratio cottidiana confoveat.
translation_en: God, who is the author of charity and lover of pure peace and love, receive the offerings of those who bring them, and heal the sicknesses of all Christians so that they may receive the fullness of salvation while always obeying your commands. Furthermore, I humbly ask that your grace absolve all those afflicted by fear of poverty, tormented by tribulations, overwhelmed by diseases, devoted to penance, burdened with obligations, constricted by any kind of sorrow, and overburdened by debts. May the correction of their morals uplift them, may your daily mercy comfort them, and may your boundless compassion heal them.

text: Deus qui concedis obtentu beati Antonii confessoris tui morbidum ignem exstingui et membris aegris refrigeria praestari fac nos ipsius meritis a gehennae incendiis liberatos integros mente et corpore tibi feliciter in gloria praesentari.
translation_en: God who grants the obtaining of blessed Anthony, your confessor, that the sickly fire is extinguished and refreshing for the sick limbs be granted through his merits, let us, freed from the fires of hell, be presented to you whole in mind and body, happily in Your glory.

text: Deus qui confessorem tuum Martinum eremi secreta sectantem populis dedisti pastorem ut de his plebes edoceret in publico quae te colloquente didicerat in secreto has hostias ob sollemnitatem coronae eius oblatas gratiae tuae respectu sanctificans et sacrificantibus veniam et sepultis requiem largire beatam.
translation_en: God, who gave your confesser Martin, a hermit seeking the secrets among the people, as a pastor to teach the flock publicly about those things which he learned in secret while speaking with you; for these offerings presented during the solemnity of his crown, you sanctify through your grace and grant pardon to those who offer them. And for those buried, bestow peace.

text: Exaudi Domine famulos tuos vespertinum
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, Your servants at evening

text: Deus qui confessorem tuum Martinum et meritorum et honoris corona ditasti has oblatas hostias spiritu benedictionis tuae ditifica et oblatores vel pro quibus offeruntur perlustra gratia consueta ut in hac die tui confessoris qua idem commissi gregis curam suscepit nos expiemur a contagione delicti.
translation_en: God who crowned your confessor Martin with merits and honor, make these offered sacrifices worthy of your blessing. May the customary grace illuminate those offering them, so that on this day, when the same confessor took charge of the flock, we may be purified from the contagion of sin.

text: Exaudi Domine gemitum populi tui
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, the groan of thy people

text: Deus qui consessorum remuneras fidem et confitendi tibi praeparas voluntatem oblatas tibi in hoc festo confessoris tui illius hostias intuere ut qui eius memoriam facientes nostra tibi confitemur delicta confessoris tui obtentu perducamur ad veniam.
translation_en: God who rewards the faith of those who have confessed and prepares in them the willingness to confess to you, look upon the offerings made on this feast of your confessor, that as we make confession of his memory, we may be led by his merits to obtain forgiveness.

text: Deus qui confitentium es corona dissidentium perime iurgia dans omnibus nobis ita pacis tuae repleri ex munere sicut confessor tuus ille confessionis claruit dignitate.
translation_en: God, who is the crown of the boastful and the destroyer of discord among those who dispute, grant us peace by ending all quarrels as your confessor, that man of great dignity, shone in confession.

text: Deus qui confitentium tibi corda purificas et accusantes se conscientias ab omni vinculo iniquitatis absolvis da indulgentiam reis et medicinam tribue vulnerans ut percepta remissione omnium peccatorum in sacramentis tuis sincera deinceps devotione permaneant et nullum redemptionis aeternae sustineant detrimentum.
translation_en: God who purifies the hearts of those who confess to you and forgives the guilty conscience from every bond of iniquity, grant indulgence to the penitents and bestow a remedy for the wounded, so that they may remain devoted sincerely in Your sacraments, and suffer no damage to eternal redemption.

text: Deus qui confitentium tibi corda purificas et accusantem se conscientiam ab omni vinculo iniquitatis absolvis da indulgentiam reis et medicinam tribue vulneratis ut exclusa dominatione peccati liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: God who purifies the hearts of those who confess to you and forgives the guilty conscience from every bond of wickedness, grant indulgence to the faithful and grant healing to the wounded, that with sin's dominion excluded, we may serve you freely with liberated minds.

text: Deus qui confitentium tibi redemptor es animarum quarum piscator beatus Petrus apostolus atque ovium pastor tua praeceptione cognoscitur annue misericors precibus nostris et populo tuo pietatis tuae dona concede.
translation_en: God who are the redeemer of souls, for whose fisherman blessed Peter, the apostle and shepherd of thy flock, is known by thy command; have mercy on our prayers, merciful God, and grant to thy people the gifts of thy mercy.

text: Deus qui conspicis familiam tuam omni humana virtute destitui paschali interveniente festivitate tui eam brachii protectione custodi.
translation_en: God who sees your family with all human virtue, strengthened by the Paschal intervention, protect it with the shield of your arm.

text: Deus qui conspicis omni nos virtute destitui interius exteriusque custodi ut et ab omnibus adversitatibus muniamur in corpore et a pravis cogitationibus mundemur in mente.
translation_en: God who sees us within and without, strengthen us to be protected on all sides from adversities, both in body and purified in mind from evil thoughts.

text: Deus qui conspicis quia ex nostra pravitate affligimur concede propitius ut ex tua visitatione consolemur.
translation_en: God, who sees that we are afflicted because of our wickedness, grant us graciously, so that we may be comforted through Your visitation.

text: Deus qui conspicis quia ex nulla nostra actione confidimus concede propitius ut contra adversa omnia doctoris gentium protectione muniamur.
translation_en: God, who sees that we have no confidence in our own actions, grant us your favor so that we may be fortified with the protection of the Doctor of nations against all adversities.

text: Deus qui conspicis quia ex nulla nostra virtute subsistimus concede propitius ut intercessione beati Xysti martyris tui atque pontificis contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: God, who sees that we exist through no power of our own, grant us graciously, through the intercession of the blessed Martyr and Bishop Xystus, to be fortified against all adversities.

text: Deus qui conspicis quia ex nulla nostra virtute subsistimus concede propitius ut interventu beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae omniumque caelestium virtutum patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum confessorum virginum quoque et omnium electorum contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: God, who sees that we subsist from no power of our own, grant graciously that with the intervention of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, and all celestial virtues, patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all the elect, we may be fortified against all adversities.

text: Deus qui conspicis quia in tua pietate confidimus concede propitius ut de caelesti semper protectione gaudeamus.
translation_en: God who sees that we trust in your mercy, grant us graciously, so that we may always rejoice in your celestial protection.

text: Deus qui conspicis quia nos undique mala nostra contristant per praecursorem gaudii corda nostra laetifica.
translation_en: God, who sees that we are troubled by our sins on all sides, through the forerunner of joy, make our hearts rejoice.

text: Deus qui conspicis quia nos undique mala nostra perturbant praesta quaesumus ut beati Ioannis apostoli tui intercessio gloriosa nos protegat.
translation_en: God, who sees that our sins trouble us from every side, grant us, we beseech you, that the glorious intercession of your Apostle Saint John may protect us.

text: Deus qui conteris bella et impugnatores in te sperantium potentia tuae defensionis expugnas auxiliare implorantibus misericordiam tuam ut omnium gentium feritate compressa indefessa te gratiarum actione laudemus.
translation_en: God who shatters wars and those hoping in your power as their defender, assist those who are praying for your mercy. May we, undaunted by the brutality of all nations, praise you tirelessly in gratitude.

text: Deus qui conteris bella et impugnatores in te sperantium potentia tuae defensionis expugnas auxiliare quaesumus famulo tuo illi regi nostro coniugi proli populoque sibi subiecto pro quibus suppliciter misericordiam tuam imploramus ut te parcente remissionem peccatorum accipiant et cuncta sibi adversantia te adiuvante superare valeant.
translation_en: God, who shatters wars and those hoping in Your power look to You for defense, we humbly ask that You help Your servant, our king, his spouse, and the people subjected to him. For them, we implore Your mercy, so that with Your forgiveness they may receive remission of sins, and with You supporting them, they may overcome all adversities.

text: Deus qui contritorum non despicis gemitum et maerentium non spernis affectum adesto precibus nostris quas pietati tuae pro tribulatione nostra offerimus implorantes ut nos clementer suscipias et solo bonitatis tuae intuitu tribuas ut quidquid contra nos diabolicae atque humanae moliuntur adversitates ad nihilum redigas et consilio misericordiae tuae allidas quatenus nullis adversitatibus laesi sed ab omni tribulatione et angustia liberati gratias tibi in Ecclesia tua referamus laeti.
translation_en: God, who does not despise the groans of the contrite and does not disregard the affections of the mourning, be present to our prayers that we offer to your pity for our tribulation. We implore you to graciously receive us and, in the sight of your goodness alone, grant us so that whatever adversities against us are concocted by diabolical and human schemes may be reduced to nothing. May we be led by your merciful counsel, so that, unharmed by any adversity and freed from all tribulation and anguish, we may happily offer thanks to you in your Church.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et super hunc famulum tuum
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, our prayers and this your servant.

text: Deus qui coram matre agnus innocens mortem nostram subire dignatus es concede nos quaesumus ipsius virginis precibus resurrectionis tuae fieri participes.
translation_en: God, who graciously deigned to suffer death as the innocent lamb before the mother, grant us, we beseech you, through the prayers of that Virgin, to become partakers of your resurrection.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et tibi confitentium
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers and from those who confess to you.

text: Deus qui creationem condicionis humanae diabolicis non es passus perire nequitiis remedia tuae propitiationis exsequere ut in eadem non praevaleat inimica subreptio sed redemptio tuae miserationis obtineat.
translation_en: God who did not allow the creation of the human condition to perish by diabolic wickedness, so that your remedies of propitiation were not carried out, so that in the same, the deceitful trickery of the enemy does not prevail but your redemption obtains through mercy.

text: Deus qui creaturae tuae misereri potius eligis quam irasci cordis nostri infirma considera et tuae nos gratia pietatis illustra.
translation_en: God, who chooses to show mercy rather than anger towards your creation, consider the weakness of our hearts and illuminate us with your grace of pity.

text: Deus qui credentes in te fonte baptismatis innovasti hanc renatis in Christo concede custodiam ut nullo erroris incursu gratiam tuae benedictionis amittant.
translation_en: God, who renewed the believers in you through the font of baptism, grant them protection so that they may not lose your grace through any onslaught of error.

text: Deus qui credentes in te populos gratiae tuae largitate multiplicas respice propitius ad electionem tuam ut qui sacramento baptismatis sunt renati regni caelestis mereantur introitum.
translation_en: God who enlarges the grace of those who believe in you to peoples, look upon us favorably according to your choice, that those who have been reborn through the sacrament of baptism may merit entrance into the kingdom of heaven.

text: Deus qui credentes in te populos nullis sinis noceri terroribus dignare preces et hostias dicatae tibi plebis suscipere ut pax a tua pietate concessa romanos fines ab omni hoste faciat esse securos.
translation_en: God who allows believers in you to be unafraid of any terrors, grant us that you receive the prayers and sacrifices offered to you by the people, so that peace granted by your mercy may make the Romans secure on their borders from every enemy.

text: Deus qui culpa offenderis paenitentia placaris afflictorum gemitus respice et mala quae iuste inrogas misericorditer averte.
translation_en: God, who is offended by sin and is appeased by repentance, take note of the groans of the afflicted and turn away from them mercifully the evils which are justly demanded.

text: Deus qui culpa offenderis paenitentia placaris preces populi supplicantis propitius respice et flagella tuae iracundiae quae pro peccatis nostris meremur averte.
translation_en: God, who is offended by sin, may be appeased by penitence. Graciously look upon the prayers of a supplicating people and turn away Your rod of anger that we may deserve for our sins.

text: Deus qui culpas delinquentium districte feriendo percutis fletus quoque lugentium non recuses ut qui pondus tuae animadversionis cognovimus etiam pietatis gratiam sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who strikes down the sins of offenders with a harsh blow, does not refuse to hear even the tears of those who weep. May we, who have come to know the weight of your scrutiny, also feel the grace of your mercy.

text: Deus qui culpas nostras piis verberibus percutis ut nos a nostris iniquitatibus emundes da nobis et de verbere tuo proficere et de tua citius consolatione gaudere.
translation_en: God, who strikes our sins with merciful blows so that we may be cleansed from our iniquities, grant us to progress from Your rod and to rejoice more quickly from Your comfort.

text: Deus qui cum muneribus nullis indigeas ipse nobis munera cuncta largiris accipe propitius quae de tuis donis tibi nos offerre voluisti non solum nostrae reputans devotioni quae tua sunt sed etiam per haec nos ad caelestia regna perducens.
translation_en: God who needs no gifts yourself, you give us all gifts graciously. Receive propitiously what we offer to you from your gifts, not only considering our devotion as yours but also leading us through these towards heavenly kingdoms.

text: Deus qui cum omnes creaturas diligens feceris in ea indulgentia hominem ut etiam illum ab impietatibus redemeris condidisti da servis tuis hanc caritatis affectum ut bona pro malis rependere tuo incitentur exemplo.
translation_en: God, who with all creatures shows loving care, in that indulgence you have made man so that even him may be redeemed from impiety, you have established this love's affection among your servants. May they be encouraged by your example to turn good for evil.

text: Deus qui cum salutem hominum semper opereris nunc tamen populum tuum gratia abundantiori multiplicas respice propitius ad electionem tuam ut paternae protectionis auxilio et regenerandos munias et renatos.
translation_en: God who always work for the salvation of mankind, now even more abundantly look upon your people with favor, for your choice. With the help and protection of our father, prepare and arm those to be reborn and renewed.

text: Deus qui das orationem oranti ac diffusa iucunditate benedictionum annos iusto adesto quaesumus nobis supplicantibus famulis tuis atque hanc oblationem quam in honorem nominis tui et commemorationem electi tui Sigismundi seu Desiderii episcopi et martyris offerimus pro famulo tuo illi qui febribus laborat placatus ac benignus assume atque ei quaesumus salutiferam medicinam conferre digneris.
translation_en: God who gives prayer to the one praying and bestows blessings with a spread of joy, be present to us who are supplicating, your servants, we ask. And this offering that we present in honor of your name and in commemoration of your elected bishop and martyr, Sigismund or Desiderius, we offer for your servant who labors with fevers, gracious and merciful. Grant him, we ask, a health-giving remedy.

text: Deus qui de beatae Mariae virginis utero verbum tuum angelo nuntiante carnem suscipere voluisti praesta supplicibus tuis ut qui vere eam genitricem Dei credimus eius apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who willed to take flesh from the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary at the announcement of the angel, grant your request to your suppliant ones. May we, who truly believe her to be the Mother of God, be helped by her intercessions before you.

text: Deus qui de his terrae fructibus tua sacramenta constare voluisti praesta quaesumus ut opem nobis et praesentis vitae conferas et futurae.
translation_en: God, who willed that your sacraments should be established from the fruits of this earth, grant us we pray, that you may bestow upon us aid in our present life and for the future as well.

text: Deus qui de vivis et electis lapidibus aeternum maiestati tuae condis habitaculum auxiliare populo supplicanti ut quod Ecclesiae tuae corporalibus proficit spatiis spiritalibus amplificetur augmentis.
translation_en: God, who from living and chosen stones builds an eternal dwelling for your majesty, help the supplicating people so that what profits the Church spatially may be spiritually enlarged with increase.

text: Deus qui de vivis et electis lapidibus aeternum nomini tuo condis habitaculum da aedificationi huic incrementa iustitiae ut ab omnibus hic invocantibus nomen tuum protectionis tuae auxilium sentiatur.
translation_en: God, who from living and chosen stones builds an eternal dwelling for Your name, grant to this building an increase in justice, so that those here invoking Your name may feel the help of Your protection.

text: Deus qui dedisti legem Moysi in summitate montis Sinai et in eodem Ioco per angelos tuos corpus beatae Katherinae virginis et martyris mirabiliter collocasti tribue quaesumus ut eius meritis et intercessione ad montem qui Christus est valeamus pervenire.
translation_en: God who gave the law to Moses on Mount Sinai and miraculously placed the body of the blessed Catherine, virgin and martyr, there by your angels, grant us, we beseech you, that through her merits and intercession we may be able to reach the mountain which is Christ.

text: Deus qui delicta nostra Christi morte mortificas et iustificationem nostram Christo resurgente confirmas salutaria populi sacrificia misericorditer suscipe; bonorum omnium desideria quae dedisti celeriter perfice. Sit hoc sabbatum illuminatio deliciis nostris ut cuncti cum regeneratis infantibus mereamur sacramentis vivificari paschalibus. Coruscet quaesumus in pane quod pependit in cruce; micet in calice quod manavit ex latere. Fiat quaesumus acceptabile fiat annuae sollemnitatis intercessu mirabile.
translation_en: God who mortifies our sins by Christ's death and confirms our justification through Christ's resurrection, graciously receive the salutary sacrifices of the people; swiftly fulfill all good desires that you have given. May this Sabbath be an illumination of our delights, so that we, along with the renewed children, may deserve to be vivified by the paschal sacraments. We ask that it shines in the bread which hung on the cross; it flickers in the chalice which flowed from his side. May it be acceptable, we ask, through the annual solemnity of its intercession.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et super hos famulos tuos
translation_en: Hear us, O God, our savior, and these thy servants.

text: Deus qui delinquentes perire non pateris donec convertantur et vivant debitam quaesumus peccatis nostris Domine suspende vindictam et praesta propitius ne dissimulatio cumulet ultionem sed ut potius emendatio prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: God who does not allow the wicked to perish until they convert and live the debt we owe for our sins, we humbly ask you, Lord. Suspend your vengeance and grant it graciously, that deceit may rather lead to amendment than exacerbate punishment, but rather that amendment may contribute to forgiveness.

text: Deus qui diei huius sollemnitatem beati confessoris tui Eparcii atque presbyteri honorabilem nobis consecrasti dona familiae tuae precibus ut cuius hodie festa celebramus eius meritis et auxilio sublevemur.
translation_en: God who consecrated for us the solemnity of your blessed confessor and priest Eutychius, grant to your family through your prayers that we may be raised by the merits and help of him whose feast day we celebrate today.

text: Deus qui dierum nostrorum numeros temporumque mensuras maiestatis tuae potestate dispensas propitius ad humilitatis nostrae respice servitutem ut tuae pacis abundantia tempora nostra cumulentur.
translation_en: God who by your power disposes the number of our days and the measurement of time within the scope of your majesty, look kindly upon our humility. Consider our service, so that the abundance of your peace may be accumulated in our times.

text: Deus qui dierum nostrorum numeros mensurasque temporum maiestatis tuae potestate dispensas ad humilitatis nostrae propitius respice servitutem et tuae pacis abundantia tempora nostra et episcopi nostri tua gratia benignus accumula.
translation_en: God, who with the power of your majesty dispenses the number and measure of our days, graciously look upon our humility. Accumulate for us the time of your peace through your benevolent grace and that of our bishop.

text: Deus qui dierum nostrorum temporumque mensuras maiestatis tuae potestate dispensas ad humilitatis nostrae propitius respice servitutem et operis tui munera in supplicum tuorum subiectione conserva ut sine metu et adversantium impulsione devotum pietati tuae possimus exhibere famulatum.
translation_en: God who in Your majesty dispenses the measures of our days by Your power, have pity on our humility and look favorably upon our servitude. Preserve for us, in the submission of Your servants, the gifts of Your work. So that we may be able to offer devoted service to You without fear and free from the influence of adversaries.

text: Deus qui digne tibi sacratis virginibus mirandi agonis robur indidisti quo per martyrii palmam ad supernae contemplationis pertingerent gloriam da quaesumus earum nos intercessionibus adiuvari quas hodierna die transcenso mortis stadio in caelestibus triumphare fecisti.
translation_en: God, who worthy granted strength to the miraculous virgins in their amazing struggles, so that through the palm of martyrdom they might reach the glory of heavenly contemplation, grant us too, we humbly ask, to be aided by their intercession, whom you made today to triumph over death in the heavens.

text: Deus qui digne tibi servientium nos imitari desideras famulatum da nobis caritatis tuae flamma ardere succensis ut antistitum decus priorum qui tibi placuerunt mereamur consortia obtinere.
translation_en: God, who desires to be imitated by us, your servants, in a fitting manner, grant us the flame of your charity to burn within us, kindled anew, so that we may merit to attain the fellowship of those predecessors who have pleased you.

text: Deus qui dignosceris ante saecularia tempora futurae creationis esse antecessor et saeculo iam labenti ob nostram redemptionem ex paterna sede per hanc virginem advenisti redemptor ut nostrum scilicet quod insolubile ex Eva retinebamur casu per huius virginalis uterum solvendo eum tuum voluisti adesse ingressum. Per eundem nos dignoscimus partum novae prolis Deum destinatum et hominem quo sic festivum vicibus annum suum ecclesiae novimus honorare recessum. Quo sicut isto ex saeculo eiusdem excessu rutilum nobis attulit gaudium ita se nostris ingerat mentibus ut attolli valeamus sursum. Qualiter eisdem suffragetur precibus huius sollemnitatulae cunctum concurrenti clerum ut ex eadem prece detur suffragatio ecclesiarum praesules largiatur auxilium fidelibus cunctis adhibeatur universis in commune viventibus christianis atque sentiant se huius diei muscipula evadere adversantis.
translation_en:
God who is worthy to precede the future ages of creation before the passing of time, you have come into our world from the paternal throne through this virgin as our Redeemer, so that what was insoluble for us because of the fall from Eve might be solved through this virginal womb. Through the same we recognize the birth of a new offspring of God and man, which we know how to honor with festive celebrations each year in the Church.
Just as he brought joy to us from his departure from this world, so too does he enter our minds that we may be able to lift ourselves up.
In the same way, let the prayers of this solemnity be offered for these [clergy] that a grant of support may be given through the same prayer to the pastors of churches, that aid may be bestowed upon all the faithful and universal Christians who live in common, and that they may feel themselves freed from adversity on this day.

text: Exaudi nos Domine Deus noster et super hunc famulum
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord our God, and grant mercy to this your servant.

text: Deus qui dilecti confessoris tui et sacerdotis merita Grimbaldi miraculorum gloria fecisti clarescere praesta ut qui sacratissimae illius depositionis celebramus festivitatem eius in caelis perennem consequamur societatem.
translation_en: God who made the glory of your beloved confessor and priest Grimbald's merits shine, grant that we who celebrate the most sacred feast of his deposition may attain eternal companionship with him in heaven.

text: Deus qui diligendo castigas et castigando nos refoves praesta ut de utroque tibi gratias semper referre valeamus.
translation_en: God who chastises by loving and refines us by correcting, grant that we may always be able to express our thanks for both.

text: Deus qui diligentibus te bona invisibilia praeparasti infunde cordibus nostris tui amoris affectum ut te in omnibus et super omnia diligentes promissiones tuas quae omne desiderium superant consequamur.
translation_en: God who has prepared for those who seek you invisible goods, pour into our hearts your love's affection, so that we may love you in all things and above all things, and may attain your promises which surpass every desire.

text: Deus qui diligentibus te facis cuncta prodesse da cordibus nostris inviolabilem caritatis affectum ut desideria de tua inspiratione concepta nulla possint temptatione mutari.
translation_en: God, who makes all things prosper for those who are diligent towards you, grant to our hearts an inviolable affection of charity, so that desires conceived by your inspiration cannot be changed by temptation.

text: Deus qui diligentibus te misericordiam tuam semper impendis et a servientibus tibi in nulla es regione longinquus dirige viam famuli tui illius in voluntate tua ut te protectore et te praeduce per iustitiae semitas sine offensione gradiatur.
translation_en: God who always bestows your mercy upon those who seek you, and is never distant from those who serve you in any region, direct the way of your servant towards you according to your will, so that he may walk on the paths of justice with you as his protector and leader, without causing offense.

text: Deus qui diligentibus te misericordiam tuam semper impendis et a servientibus tibi in nulla es regione longinquus dirige viam famuli tui illius in voluntate tua quatenus angelorum tuorum praesidio fultus intercessione quoque sanctorum munitus a cunctis adversitatibus tua miseratione salvetur ut profectionis et reversionis suae felicitate potitus et compos reddatur iustorum votorum et de suorum laetetur remissione peccatorum.
translation_en: God who always bestows your mercy upon those who seek you, and who are never far from those who serve you in any region, direct the way of your servant to your will, so that he may be protected by your angels and also strengthened by their intercession against all adversities. May he be saved by your mercy so that, equipped with the happiness of his journey and return, he may fulfill and complete the just petitions of his vows and rejoice in the remission of his sins.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus et mittere dignare ... custodia perseveret.
translation_en: Hear nous, O Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, and deign to send... guardian protection, which endures.

text: Deus qui discipulis tuis Spiritum Sanctum paraclitum in ignis fervore tui amoris mittere dignatus es da populis tuis in unitate fidei esse ferventes ut in tua semper dilectione permanentes et in fide inveniantur stabiles et in opere efficaces.
translation_en: God, who has deemed fit to send the Holy Spirit, the Paraclete, among your disciples in the fiery love of yours, make your people ardent with faith unity, so that they may always remain in your loving affection and find steadfastness in faith, and be effective in deed.

text: Deus qui dispersa congregas et congregata conservas da inviolabilem populo tuo in bona voluntate concordiam ut quos fecisti fidem conservare tua semper facias pace gaudere.
translation_en: God who scatters and gathers together, and preserves what is gathered, grant an inviolable harmony to your people in a good willed accord, so that those whom you have made faithful may always rejoice in peace.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus et quo Domino ...
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, holy Father, almighty and eternal God, and unto whom the Lord ...

text: Deus qui diversitatem gentium in confessione tui nominis adunasti da ut renatis fonte baptismatis una sit fides mentium et pietas actionum.
translation_en: God who brought together the diversity of nations in the confession of your name, grant that those reborn at the font of baptism may have one faith of mind and piety of action.

text: Deus qui dives es ad ignoscendum et propterea voluisti carnis humilitatem assumere ut nobis humilitatis exempla relinqueres et in quibuscumque passionibus nos faceres esse constantes praesta ut semper bona quae a te percipimus teneamus et quoties in peccatis labimur per paenitentiam relevemur.
translation_en: God, who are rich in mercy and for this reason wished to assume the humility of flesh in order to leave us examples of humility and make us steadfast in any sufferings, grant that we may always hold on to the good things we receive from you, and whenever we fall into sins, may we be raised again through penitence.

text: Deus qui dives es in misericordia qua mortuos nos peccatis convivificasti Christo filio tuo ut formam servi acciperet qui omnia formavit ut qui erat in deitate generaretur in carne ut involveretur in pannis qui adorabatur in stellis ut iaceret in praesepio qui regnabat in caelo invocantibus nobis aurem maiestatis tuae propitiatus accommoda donans hoc per ineffabilem tuae misericordiae caritatem ut qui exsultamus de nativitate Filii tui qui et ex virgine natus et ex spiritu sancto generatus est pareamus praeceptis eius quibus nos edocuit ad salutem.
translation_en: God, who are rich in mercy, who revived us mortals through Christ your Son so that the form of a servant might receive him who formed all things, so that he who was in deity might be generated in flesh, so that he might be wrapped in swaddling clothes who was adored among the stars, so that he might lie in a manger who ruled in heaven, grant us an attentive ear to your majesty propitiated. Adjust and bestow this through your ineffable mercy, so that we may be equal to the birth of your Son, who was born of a virgin and generated by the Holy Spirit, and learn from his teachings for our salvation.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus ut si qua sunt adversa
translation_en: Hear nos, o Lord, holy Father, Almighty God, that if there are any adversities

text: Deus qui dives es in omnibus misericordia pater gloriae qui posuisti Filium tuum lumen in nationibus praedicare captivis redemptionem caecis visum remissionem peccatorum et sortem inter sanctos per fidem qui es in Christo largus miserator indulge.
translation_en: God, who are rich in all mercy, Father of glory, who set your Son, the light, among the nations to proclaim redemption to the captives, sight to the blind, forgiveness of sins, and eternal life among the saints through faith. You, who are in Christ, are generous and merciful. Indulge.

text: Deus qui divinis obsequiis angelorum magnificas dignitatem extremitatem nostram ad respectum tuae visitationis illustra ut quod per illos facis nobis mirabiliter nuntiari facias nos misericorditer adipisci.
translation_en: God, who magnifies the dignity of angels through divine services, enlighten the extremity of our nature so that what you do for us miraculously through them may be announced to us, and may we mercifully receive it.

text: Deus qui divinitatis tuae potentia clarens divinos ac caelibes Ecclesiae tuae Xystum atque Laurentium elegisti gubernatores cum in uno sacerdotii summam in altero levitici ordinis contuleris gratiam intentis te precibus supplicamus ut in tanti diei sollemnitate conventum familiae tuae placatus ipse accipias et postulatus celer occurras.  Xystus officii sui non immemor sanctificanda tibi nostra inferat vota; similiter et Laurentius ministerii sui exsequens curam supplicantibus nobis subministret remedia postulata. Per illum discamus quod ipse egit pro te domino cervices ponere; per istum cremantis saeculi non subrui tempestate. Per illum maturae discretionis iudicio freti polleamus seniorum; per istum validae iuventutis luctamem arripientes fide exstinguamus incentiva libidinum quo sic per Xystum sanctificandi tuis altaribus offeramur ut tradente nobis Laurentio calicem salutis in remissionem peccatorum sumere mereamur.
translation_en:
God, who shines forth the power of your divinity, you chose Xystus and Laurence as governors for your Church, bestowing the highest priesthood on one, the Levitical order on the other, in response to fervent prayers. We humbly beseech you that on this day of solemnity, gathered together, your family may please you and promptly grant our requests.
Xystus, mindful of his duty, may offer vows to you on our behalf; similarly, Laurence, fulfilling the duties of his ministry, may supply us with remedies in response to our prayers. Through him, we learn to bow our heads before you, Lord; through him, we do not perish in the tempest of this world's burning.
Through him, we are bathed in the judgment of mature discernment and strengthened by the wisdom of the elders; through him, we seize the struggles of strong youth with faith, extinguishing the temptations of lust so that through Xystus, we may offer ourselves on your altars for sanctification. Through Laurentius, given us the chalice of salvation to drink, we may be worthy to take it in remission of sins.

text: Deus qui divisionem apostolorum hodierna die fieri tua praeordinasti prudentia ut in una fidei gratia gentium passim dispersa convocaretur ecclesia da nobis per supplicationem ipsorum veniam nostrorum promereri peccaminum per quorum veram praedicationem ad tui nominis pervenimus agnitionem.
translation_en: God, who on this day by your wisdom have preordained the division of the apostles to be made, so that the church dispersed among the nations in every faith might be gathered together, grant us through their supplication that forgiveness for our sins may be earned by them, through whose true preaching we have come to the recognition of your name.

text: Deus qui dixisti: »Domus mea domus orationis vocabitur« domum istam gentium spurcitiis contaminatam mundare et sanctificare digneris ut omnium preces et vota in loco hoc ad te clamantium clementer exaudias et benigne perficias.
translation_en: God who said, "My house shall be called a house of prayer," deign to cleanse and sanctify this house defiled by the filth of the nations, so that you may hear with clemency and graciously fulfill all prayers and vows of those who are calling out to you in this place.

text: Deus qui dominicae resurrectionis temporali sollemnitate laetificas quos ad gaudia sempiternae festivitatis inflammas hodiernae quaesumus congregationis attende conventus et celeriter postulantibus tribue quidquid sanctus exoptat affectus. Dona singulis temperantiam repelle tristitiam fac regeneratos perenniter in fide consistere fac fideles in caritate proficere. Discant illi vehementer servare per gratiam quod dedisti; discant isti diligere quod cottidiana dilectione servasti.
translation_en: God who on the solemnity of the temporal resurrection of our Lord joyfully enkindles us towards the eternal joys of the festival, we humbly ask that you attend to this gathering and grant them whatever the Holy Spirit desires. Give each one temperance, drive away sorrow, make the regenerated perpetually stand firm in faith, help the faithful to progress in charity. May they be able to keep with great grace what you have given; may they love what you have daily sustained through your love.

text: Deus qui dum opus illud fabricae mundialis quod sola imperii iussione creaveras perire non pateris domum tibi in alvo virginis fabricasti et ne periret gens a te plasmata revelasti saeculis inaudita mysteria ut quem caelorum excelsa non capiunt parvus puellulae alvus includeret precamur supplices ut de quibus et pro quibus suscepisti membra mortalia intercedente beata Maria genitrice tua capere facias devicta saeculi ambitione victoriam.
translation_en: God, who did not allow the work of that great building which you alone created by the command of your empire to perish, you who built a house in the womb of the virgin and revealed unspeakable mysteries to the ages so that the small girl's womb included what the heights of heaven could not contain, we humbly pray that through whom and for whom you received mortal limbs, by the intercession of your blessed mother, the Virgin Mary, you may grant victory over the ambition of the world.

text: Deus qui dum subsellia deitatis adscendis observare nos pacem evangelica auctoritate non desinis docere da nobis placidus pacem tuam ut dum discordiae prona refugimus caeli ardua consequamur.
translation_en: God who, when ascending the throne of deity, does not cease to teach us peace through the authority of the gospel, grant us your peaceful peace, so that while we flee from the prostrate discord, we may attain the lofty heights of heaven.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiae tuae beatum Iulianum mirabilem tribuisti doctorem concede propitius ut hunc apud te pium mereamur semper habere intercessorem.
translation_en: God, who granted the blessed Julian a remarkable teacher to your church, graciously grant that we may always have him as our pious intercessor among you.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiae tuae filiis assistentium tibi ministrorum dignaris largiri solatium eorum quaesumus meritis suffragantibus tibi nostrum acceptabile servitium et placabile fiat sacrificium.
translation_en: God, who deigns to bestow solace upon your Church's sons as they minister to you, we humbly ask that through their merits you accept our service and may the sacrifice be pleasing to you.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiae tuae gloriosi protomartyris tui Stephani non defraudasti artus da ut eius supplicatione fiat tibi semper devota et meritis iugiter secura.
translation_en: God, who did not deceive the limbs of your glorious proto-martyr Stephen, make us always devoted to you through his intercession and secure forever by his merits.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam protomartyris tui Stephani glorificare de inventis dignatus es artubus da ut eius supplicatione fiat semper devota et meritis iugiter secura.
translation_en: God who deemed it fitting to glorify Your Church through the discoveries of Your protomartyr St. Stephen, grant that his intercession may always be devoted, and that we may forever be secure in his merits.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam gloriosi protomartyris tui Stephani non defraudasti artus da quaesumus ut eius supplicatione fiat tibi semper devota nostrae mentis intentio et iugi experiatur auxilio.
translation_en: God, who did not disappoint the body of your glorious protomartyr Stephen, grant us what we ask, that through his intercession our intention may always be devoted to you and that our endeavor may experience aid from him.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiae tuae in sanctis montibus fundamenta posuisti da ut nullis errorum subruatur incursibus nulla mundi perturbatione quatiatur sed apostolica semper et institutione sit firma et interventione secura.
translation_en: God who set the foundations of your Church on holy mountains, grant that it may not be overthrown by any incursions of error nor shaken by any disturbance of the world. May it always remain firm through apostolic institution and secure through intervention.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiae tuae vocibus in tympano laudaris praesta supplicantibus nobis ut ieiunia nostra quae pro remediis peccatorum aguntur pacis bono permisceantur ut utriusque rei virtute sic animae nostrae ad meliora proficiant ne ullo modo vanae gloriae a temptatione sordescant.
translation_en: God, who is praised by the voices of Your Church in the timpani, grant to us while we pray, that our fasting, which are performed for the remedies of sins, may be mixed with good peace. May it so happen that through both of these virtues, our souls may progress towards better things, and never become sullied by any temptation of vain glory.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam annua beati Quintini martyris tui sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut qui memoriam illius digna servitute veneramur intercessorem eum semper apud te habere mereamur.
translation_en: God who delights your Church in the annual solemnity of blessed Quintinus, our martyr, grant us graciously that we who revere his memory with worthy servitude may always merit to have him as an intercessor before you.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam meritis et orationibus pretiosissimi Quintini martyris tui mirifico splendore clarificas concede propitius ut qui memoriam illius veneramur in terris intercessorem apud te mereamur habere in caelis.
translation_en: God who brightens your church with the merits and precious prayers of the martyr Quintinus, grant us favorably that we, who revere his memory on earth, may deserve to have him as an intercessor for us in heaven.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam annua quadragesimali observatione purificas praesta familiae tuae ut quod a te obtinere abstinendo nititur hoc bonis operibus exsequatur.
translation_en: God who purifies Your Church through the annual observance of Lent, grant to Your family that what it strives to obtain by abstaining from You, may execute it with good works.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam annua sanctorum martyrum tuorum Maximiani Malchi et Martiniani sociorumque eorum sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut sicut in illorum dormitione te mirabilem praedicantes tua magnalia temporali celebramus officio sic in caelesti regione eorum perpetuo mereamur adunari consortio.
translation_en: God who delights your church on the solemnity of your martyrs Maximian, Malchus, Martinian and their companions, graciously grant that we may celebrate your great deeds in their sleep as we proclaim them marvelous. May we also deserve to be united with them forever in the celestial region as we do so on earth.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam apostoli tui Petri fide et nomine consecrasti quique beatum illi Paulum ad praedicandum gentibus gloriam tuam sociare dignatus es concede ut omnes qui ad apostolorum tuorum sollemnia convenerunt spiritali remuneratione ditentur.
translation_en: God, who consecrated your Church through the faith and name of your apostle Peter, and who deemed it fitting to associate the blessed Paul with him for preaching to the Gentiles; grant that all who have gathered for the solemnities of your apostles may be enriched spiritually.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam apostolicis voluisti constare doctrinis concede propitius ut intercessione beati Theodori confessoris tui atque pontificis et virtutum semper proficiat incrementis et sempiternis foveatur auxiliis.
translation_en: God, who willed your Church to be strengthened by apostolic teachings, graciously grant that it may continually progress with the intercession of blessed Theodore, your confessor and bishop, and be forever fostered by eternal aid.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli praedicatione docuisti da nobis quaesumus in omnibus eorum sequi praeceptum per quos religionis sumpsit exordium.
translation_en: God who taught your Church through the preaching of your apostles Peter and Paul, grant us, we ask, that we may follow their commandments in all things. Through whom religious life began.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam beati Dominici confessoris tui illuminare dignatus es meritis et exemplis concede ut eius intercessione temporalibus non destituatur auxiliis et spiritualibus semper proficiat incrementis.
translation_en: God, who have deemed fit to illuminate your Church through the merits and examples of your confessor blessed Dominic, grant that he may not be lacking in temporal aid and continually progress in spiritual growth through his intercession.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam beati illius apostoli tui praedicatione docuisti et martyrio coronasti concede fidelibus tuis eius semper meritis adiuvari et beneficiis gratulari.
translation_en: God, who taught your Church by the preaching of the blessed apostle of yours and crowned with martyrdom, grant your faithful always to be helped by his merits and to rejoice in your blessings.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam beati Francisci meritis fetu novae prolis amplificas tribue nobis ex eius imitatione terrena despicere et caelestium donorum semper participatione gaudere.
translation_en: God, who expands Your Church through the merits of blessed Francis' new birth, grant us that, by imitating him on earth, we may despise worldly things and always enjoy the participation of heavenly gifts.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam beati Thomae de Aquino confessoris tui mira eruditione clarificas et sancta operatione fecundas da nobis quaesumus et quae docuit intellectu conspicere et quae egit imitatione complere.
translation_en: God who enlightens Your Church through the marvelous learning of your confessor Saint Thomas Aquinas and makes it fruitful through holy operation, grant us we ask, that which he taught may be seen with intellect, and that which he accomplished may be completed by imitation.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam catholicam quam tuo sancto sanguine redemisti numquam derelinquis nobisque indignis in eandem concurrentibus criminum indulgentiam placatus concedis et qui latronis tecum in cruce pendentis confessionem iustificare dignatus es quaesumus ut omnium in te credentium fidem augeas multiplices et solita pietate pacem quam custodiri iussisti illibatam in nobis conservare digneris.
translation_en: God, who redeemed your Catholic Church with your holy blood, never abandon us, and graciously grant us pardon for our unworthiness when we strive towards the same. You who condescended to justify the repentant thief on the cross, have mercy upon us. We humbly ask that you increase the faith of all who believe in you, and that you deign to preserve the peace that you commanded to be kept inviolable within us.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam evangelicae exhortatione doctrinae quae sursum sunt iubes sapere et ad eam se altitudinem ad quam Salvator mundi conscendit erigere da supplicibus tuis subsequi intellectu quod multi viderunt conspectu ut in secundo mediatoris adventu ditentur donis qui tuis crediderunt promissis.
translation_en: God, who by the evangelical exhortation of doctrine commands your Church to rise up and lift itself to the height to which the Savior of the world ascended, grant that your supplicants may follow this understanding. May many be enriched with the gifts promised to those who have believed in the second coming of the mediator, as they have seen with their eyes.

text: Excita Domine potentiam et veni et quod Ecclesiae
translation_en: Stir up, Lord, Your power, and come and save the Church.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam evangelicae doctrinae exhortatione quae sursum sunt iubes sapere et ad eandem se altitudinem ad quam mundi Salvator adscendit erigere da populis tuis intellectu capere quod multi viderunt conspectu ut in secundo mediatoris adventu ditentur donis qui promissis crediderunt.
translation_en: God, who by the exhortation of evangelical doctrine commands Your Church to rise up and understand things above, and to elevate themselves to the same height that the Savior of the world ascended to, grants the intelligence of this to Your people, so that they may grasp what many have seen with their eyes at the second coming of the Mediator, and be enriched with the gifts which they have believed to be promised.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam eximii confessoris tui atque pontificis Martialis hodierna tribuis sollemnitate gaudere eius quaesumus ita nos exemplis salutaribus instrue ut sempiternae cum eo beatitudinis mereamur feliciter perfrui claritate.
translation_en: God, who today grants your Church the solemnity to rejoice in the confessor and bishop St. Marcellus, we humbly ask that you instruct us through his salutary examples, so that we may merit to joyfully bask in the everlasting beatitude with him in the clarity.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam gloriosa beati Thomae confessoris tui atque pontificis translatione glorificas praesta quaesumus ut eius meritis et intercessione de sepulcro vitiorum sublevati ad aeternam resurrectionis gloriam transferri mereamur.
translation_en: God, who glorify Your Church through the translation of Your blessed confessor and pope Saint Thomas, we humbly ask that You grant us so that through his merits and intercession, raised from the grave of sins, we may be worthy to be transferred to the eternal glory of the resurrection.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam in beati pontificis tui Thomae angelica puritate et virtutum gloria decorasti concede nobis famulis tuis ut eius suffragantibus meritis angelorum cum ipso mereamur agminibus sociari.
translation_en: God who adorned Your Church with the angelic purity and the glory of virtues in the blessed pope Your Thomas, grant us Your servants that we may merit, through his intercession and that of angels, to be associated with him in choirs.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam in dilectione tuae divinitatis et proximi cuncta servare caelestia mandata docuisti da nobis spiritum pacis et gratiae ut universa familia tua et toto tibi sit corde devota et pura sibi voluntate concordet.
translation_en: God who taught your Church in your love for divine dignity and neighbor to keep all heavenly commands, grant us the spirit of peace and grace so that the entire family of yours may be devoted and pure with their whole heart, and may agree in will with themselves towards you.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam ineffabili pretio redemptam semper mirificis reficis sacramentis concede propitius ut quae de malorum percussionibus gemit exterius tuis iugiter consolationibus reparetur interius.
translation_en: God, who always renews your Church with wonderful sacraments, redeemed at an ineffable price, grant us graciously, that she who groans outwardly from the blows of evil may be healed within through your constant consolations.

text: Excita Domine tuorum fidelium ut sacris intenta
translation_en: Stir up, O Lord, the hearts of your faithful people, that they may be ever more intensely focused on sacred things.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam innumeris sanctorum patrociniis et glorificas et tueris praesta ut quorum celebrat conventum experiatur devota suffragium.
translation_en: God, who enriches Your Church with countless patronages and glorifies it, and protects it, grant that those who celebrate the gathering may experience devout assistance from them.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam inter adversa crescere voluisti molientium contra eam prosterne superbiam et veritatis tuae subiuga propitius unitati.
translation_en: God who willed your Church to grow among adversities against the grinding mill of those opposing her, humble pride and be gracious in subduing truth to unity.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam meritis beati Richardi confessoris tui atque pontificis fecisti miraculis coruscare gloriosis concede nos famulos tuos ipsius intercessione ad aeternae beatitudinis gloriam pervenire.
translation_en: God who made your Church shine with the miracles of Blessed Richard, your confessor and bishop, grant that we, your servants, may reach the glory of eternal beatitude through his intercession.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam nova semper prole fecundas auge eam cottidie credentium puritate et divinae gratiae infusione multiplica ut repulsa impugnatione malorum omnium in tranquillitate pacis et fidei tuo semper ditata munere glorietur.
translation_en: God, who always makes your Church fruitful with new offspring, increase it daily with the purity of believers and the infusion of divine grace. May it be multiplied so that it is repulsed by any attack of evil from all sides, and may it always be enriched with the gift of peace and faith in Your tranquility.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam novo semper foetu multiplicas concede famulis tuis ut sacramentum vivendo teneant quod fide perceperunt.
translation_en: God who always multiplies your Church with a new offspring, grant to your servants that they may hold fast to the sacrament which they have received through faith while living.

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam sanctorum tuorum praesidiis semper propitius intendis praesta quaesumus ut qui beati Polycarpi martyris tui atque pontificis sollemnia celebramus eius precibus sublevemur.
translation_en: God who always shows favor to Your Church by the guardianship of Your saints, we humbly ask that You grant us so that we may be lifted up through the prayers of the blessed Polycarp, Your martyr and bishop, as we celebrate his feast day.

text: Exorcizo te creatura aquae in nomine
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of water, in the name

text: Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam sponsam vocare dignatus es ut quae haberet gratiam per fidei devotionem haberet etiam ex nomine pietatem da ut omnis haec plebs nomini tuo serviens huius vocabuli consortio digna esse mereatur et Ecclesia tua in templo cuius natalis est hodie tibi collecta te timeat te diligat te sequatur ut dum iugiter per vestigia tua graditur ad caelestia promissa te ducente pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: God, who deemed it fitting to call Your Church as a bride, that she might have grace through the devotion of faith, grant also to this people, serving Your name, to be worthy of the title of piety.
