May they be deserving to join in fellowship with this name. Let Your Church in the temple whose birthday is today, collected for You, fear You, love You, follow You, so that while continually walking in Your footsteps, they may deserve to reach the heavenly promises led by You.

text: Exorcizo te creatura aquae in nomine dei patris
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of water, in the name of God the Father.

text: Deus qui ecclesiastici regiminis fundamentum in beati Petri principis apostolorum cathedra constituere voluisti praesta supplicum tuorum precibus ut eius meritis a peccatorum nexibus liberemur cui ligandi atque solvendi data creditur esse potestas.
translation_en: O God, who willed to establish the foundation of ecclesiastical rule upon the seat of the blessed Peter, the chief among the apostles, grant through the prayers of your supplicants that we may be freed from the bonds of sin by his merits. For it is given to him to have power both to bind and to loose.

text: Exorcizo te creatura aquae in nomine ... si qua fantasma ...
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of water, in the name ... if any ghost ...

text: Deus qui effundentia martyris tui Cucufati viscera ob rabiem persecutoris pro nomine tuo dimicantis introrsus constabiliri iussisti et ob hoc fidei gratiam populis condonasti praesta nobis ita amorem tuae dulcedinis interius exteriusque fructificare ut cum eis post huius vitae excursum mereamur te adiuvante laetari.
translation_en: God, who commanded that the insides of your martyr Cucuphatus should be strengthened within by reason of the rage of his persecutor fighting for your name, and because of this you granted to the people the grace of faith, grant us that we may interiorly and exteriorly bear fruit from your sweetness, so that with them after the course of this life we may merit to rejoice with you assisting.

text: Deus qui Elphegum summum praesulem populo praefecisti Anglorum ut caelestis sanctuarii minister fieret et martyr praesta quaesumus ut illius auxilio et a peccatis liberi et ab hoste securi tua pace perfruamur aeterna.
translation_en: God who appointed Elphegus as the supreme bishop for the people of England, so that he might become a minister in heaven's sanctuary and a martyr. We humbly ask you to grant us, through his assistance, freedom from sins and secure in your peace we may enjoy eternal life.

text: Exorcizo te creatura aquae in nomine ... ut fias aqua exorzidiata
translation_en: I exorcise you, creation of water, in the name of... so that you become exorcised water.

text: Deus qui elisos erigis et humilibus das gratiam qui desperatos revocas et in peccatis labentes conservas praesta clementissime Pater fragilitati meae emundationem; non meis meritis te deprecor sed misericordiam tuam supplico ut paenitentem suscipias et peccata dimittas et antequam de hac vita discedam puriorem me esse cognoscas et vulneribus quae omnibus abscondo cottidie manifesta medicamenta concedas et sacrificium quod indignus offero dignum tibi esse disponas et in futuro una cum famulis tuis tibi placentibus me sine querela sociare digneris.
translation_en: God, who raises the elect and gives grace to the humble, who calls back the despairing and preserves those falling into sin, mercifully grant to my fragility cleansing; I do not pray you on account of my merits, but I beseech your mercy that you take in penitence and forgive sins, and before I depart from this life, may know me pure, and daily grant me visible remedies for the wounds that I hide, and arrange that the unworthy sacrifice I offer may be worthy of you, and deign to associate me without complaint with your servants pleasing to you in the future.

text: Deus qui emortuam vulvam Sarae ita per Abrahae semen fecundare dignatus es ut ei etiam contra spem suboles nasceretur preces famulae tuae illius pro sua sterilitate deprecantis propitius respice ut ei iuxta tenorem praecedentium patrum et fecunditatem tribuas et filium quem donaveris benedicas.
translation_en: God, who deigned to make the barren womb of Sarah fruitful through Abraham's seed, so that even against hope offspring was born; be propitious and look upon her pleas concerning her sterility. Grant her, according to the tenor of preceding fathers, fertility and bless the son whom you gave, and may he be blessed.

text: Deus qui errantibus ut in viam possint redire iustitiae veritatis tuae lumen ostendis da cunctis qui christiana professione censentur et illa respuere quae huic inimica sunt nomini et ea quae sunt apta sectari.
translation_en: God, who shows the way to those who can return to the path of Your justice and truth, enlighten all who profess Christianity, and help them reject what is hostile to this name and what is suitable to follow.

text: Deus qui errata corrigis et dispersa congregas et congregata conservas quaesumus super populum christianum tuae unionis gratiam clementer infunde ut divisione reiecta vero pastori Ecclesiae tuae se uniens tibi digne valeat famulari.
translation_en: God, who corrects errors and gathers the scattered and conserves what is gathered, we humbly ask that you graciously infuse your favor upon the Christian people. May they be united under your grace, rejecting division. May the true shepherd of your Church worthily serve you, after being united with you.

text: Deus qui es collator dignitatum attributor bonorum et sanctificatio sacerdotum quo accinctus ac roboratus Babilas sacerdos tuus Ecclesiam tuam quam tuendam acceperat exemplo erigit doctrinis erudit aditumque domus tuae Numeriano locum sanctum calcare volenti eximius palestra repugnaturus obstrusit quo per hoc subiecto gregi obseratis ianuis maneret tuta custodia per quod a divinis foribus persequentis foret potestas eliminata assiste precibus supplicantis familiae tuae ut martyris tui prece inimici suggestio introeundi in nostris cordibus non habeat facultatem quo securi intra sinum sanctae ecclesiae residentes ita claustris dominicis habeamur muniti ut correctis nobis non pateat ulterius via errandi quatenus per angustum gradientes iustitiae callem regionis aeternae mereamur latitudinem introire.
translation_en: God, who is the giver of dignities and the sanctioner of priests, strengthening your priest Babylas, who had accepted to guard your Church, elevated it through teachings, educated it with doctrines, and opened the way for your house. Numerian, wanting to walk on a holy place, was opposed by an excellent stadium, which obstructed him so that, through this, the subject flock might observe a safe guardianship at the doors of your Church, and so that the power pursuing those seeking divine doors might be eliminated. Assist the prayers of your supplicating family, that the suggestion of the enemy to enter our hearts through the intercession of your martyr may not have the ability. May we be enclosed within the fortresses of your dominion, strengthened so that, once corrected, there is no further way for us to stray; thus, climbing the narrow path of justice, we may deserve to enter the broad way of eternal justice.

text: Deus qui es corona virginum et tuorum gloria sanctorum Ecclesiae tuae supplicanti praesta benignus auditum et beatae Katerinae intervenientibus meritis vitae praesentis et aeternae largire subsidium.
translation_en: God who art the crown of virgins and the glory of thy saints, grant, O gracious one, a hearing to thy supplicant Church, and through the merits of blessed Catherine, bestow upon her both aid in this life and the rewards of eternal life.

text: Deus qui es ductor sanctorum et dirigis itinera iustorum dirige angelum pacis nobiscum qui nos ad locum destinatum perducat ut procul sit a nobis malignorum accessus et comes nobis adesse dignetur Spiritus Sanctus.
translation_en: God who art the guide of saints and directs the paths of the righteous, direct an angel of peace towards us, who leads us to our appointed place, so that the approach of evil may be far from us, and grant that the Holy Spirit may be present with us.

text: Deus qui es gloria sanctorum et dirigis viam iustorum dirige angelum pacis cum famulis tuis qui eos ad locum quo pergunt cum iucunditate prosperitate et pace sine impedimento animae et corporis ducat et reducat; eisque non possint nocere antiqui hostis insultus; procul sit ab eis omnium malorum accessus et comes eorum dignetur esse Spiritus Sanctus.
translation_en: God who art the glory of saints and guide the way of the righteous, guide the angel of peace with your servants who go to the place where they are going with joy, prosperity, and peace without hindrance for soul and body. Lead and bring them; may the attacks of ancient enemies not harm them. May all accesses of evil be far from them, and may the Holy Spirit be their companion.

text: Deus qui es gloria confessurum splendorque sanctarum animarum vota nostra placatus suscipe et confessoris tui Pauli meritis ab omni perturbatione fac nos permanere illaesos atque pervenire ad honores aeternae vitae repromissos.
translation_en: God, who are the glory of those who confess and the splendor of holy souls, hear our prayers, pleased by them. Through the merits of your confessor Paul, make us remain unshaken from every disturbance, and bring us to the promised honors of eternal life.

text: Deus qui es gloriosus in gloria sanctorum et cunctis ad eorum patrocinia confugientibus suae petitionis salutarem praestas effectum concede plebi tuae ut intercedente beato Rocho confessore tuo quae in eius celebritate se devota exhibet languore epidemiae quam in suo corpore pro tui nominis gloria passus est sit liberata et tuo nomini semper sit devota.
translation_en: God, who is glorious in the glory of saints and to those seeking their patronage grants a salutary effect, grant it to your people so that, with the blessed Roch, your confessor, intervening, those who are devoted in his celebration and have suffered an epidemic disease as he did for Your glory in his body may be freed and always remain devoted to Your name.

text: Exorcizo te creatura salis in nomine Dei
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of salt, in the name of God.

text: Deus qui es initium et finis concede misericordiam tuam famulo tuo illi ut sub ope dexterae tuae eum ubique protegas et tuae pietatis consolationem impendas et auge illi felicitatis tempora ac tribue ei gratiam tuam.
translation_en: God who is the beginning and end, grant your mercy to your servant that under the protection of your right hand he may be safeguarded everywhere and bestow upon him the comfort of your pity. Increase for him the times of happiness and give him your grace.

text: Deus qui es initium et finis da protectionem famulo tuo illi pro quo tibi in honorem sancti archangeli Michaelis votorum munera offerimus ut sub ope dexterae tuae ubique protegatur; mitte ei auxilium de sancto et de Sion tuere eum et auge illi feliciter tempora longaeva; sicut regi Ezechiae in discrimine posito ter quinos annos auxisti vitae ita tribue Domine gratiam tuam et dele chirographum peccatorum suorum per donum misericordiae tuae.
translation_en: God, who are the beginning and the end, grant protection to your servant, for whom we offer gifts in honor of Saint Archangel Michael. May he be protected everywhere under the power of your right hand; send him help from the saint and from Zion, and may he be preserved and his long years increased happily. As you strengthened King Hezekiah in his time of trial for five more years, so grant, Lord, your favor to him, and erase the record of his sins through the gift of your mercy.

text: Exorcizo te creatura salis per Deum vivum ... immundus adiuratus.
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of salt, by the living God... cursed one summoned.

text: Deus qui es initium et finis da salutem animae famuli tui illius pro quo tibi preces indigni fundere ausi sumus et mitte ei auxilium de sancto et de Sion tuere eum ut sub ope dexterae tuae protegatur et chirographum peccatorum eius dono misericordiae tuae deleatur.
translation_en: God who are the beginning and the end, grant health to the soul of your servant for whom we have dared to pour out unworthy prayers, and send him aid from the holy and from Zion, that he may be protected under the power of your right hand, and may the record of his sins be blotted out by the gift of your mercy.

text: Exorcizo te creatura salis per Deum vivum ... omnem putritudinem eius.
translation_en: I exorcise you, creature of salt, in the name of the living God, every putridity of it.

text: Deus qui es iustorum gloria et misericordia peccatorum da famulis tuis plenam indulgentiae veniam et paenitentiae locum exoratus indulge ut qui praeterita peccata deplorant futura mala non sentiant neque iam ulterius lugenda committant; dimitte eis Domine omnia crimina et in semitis tuis iustitiae placitos restaura ut securi mereantur deinceps benemeritis currere et ad pacis aeternae praemia pervenire.
translation_en: God who is the glory of the righteous and the mercy for sinners, grant your full indulgence and pardon to your servants, and give them a place for repentance. Indulge that those who lament their past sins may not feel future evils nor commit any more cause for mourning; forgive them all sins, Lord, and restore those pleasing in Your ways of justice. May they henceforth deserve to run with merit and reach the rewards of eternal peace.

text: Deus qui es iustorum gloria et misericordia peccatorum pietatem tuam humili prece deposcimus ut famulum tuum illum benignus respicias et pietatis tuae custodiam impendas ut ex toto corde et ex tota mente tibi deserviat et sub tua semper protectione consistat ut quando ei extrema venerit dies societatem sanctorum percipiat et inenarrabilem gloriam sine fine possideat.
translation_en: God who art the glory of the just and the mercy of the sinners, we humbly entreat your pity. We ask that you look kindly upon your servant and bestow your protection so that he may serve you with his whole heart and mind, and always remain under your care. May he attain the society of the saints when the last day comes, and possess an indescribable glory without end.

text: Exorcizo te immunde spiritus in nomine Patris
translation_en: I exorcise you, unclean spirits, in the name of the Father.

text: Deus qui es iustus iustorum et pastor piissimus animarum qui Iustum et Pastorem innocentes in regno tuo martyres suscepisti tribue nobis innocentiam tenere dum vivimus et iustitiam custodire dum iudicamus ut etiam defuncti in consortio sanctorum tuorum sine fine vivamus quatenus eorum vestigiis inhaerentes non ab illis per mala opera efficiamur exteri qui te confitendo propter te mortui tibique sunt feliciter sociati.
translation_en: God who art just among the just and the most merciful shepherd of souls, who received the Righteous and the Shepherd innocents in Your kingdom, grant us to hold innocence while we live and to maintain justice when we judge, so that even the dead may live forever in the company of Your saints. May we, clinging to their footsteps, not be separated from them through evil deeds; rather, dying for You, we may be happily united with Them.

text: Exorcizo te immunde spiritus per Patrem
translation_en: I exorcise you, unclean spirits, by the Father.

text: Deus qui es mirabilis in operibus iustus in iudiciis largus in donis multiplica super nos misericordiam tuam et quia tu nobis es bonorum causa meritorum custodi quod tribuis ut invenias quos coronas.
translation_en: God, who is wonderful in works, just in judgments, generous in gifts, multiply your mercy upon us and since you are a good cause for our merits, keep what you bestow so that you may find those whom to crown.

text: Deus qui es mundi creator et rector da nobis in hac die incarnationis Verbi tui et partus sacrae Mariae virginis pium celebrare consortium ut qui per tuam gratiam sunt redempti tua sint protectione securi.
translation_en: God who are the creator and ruler of the world, grant us on this day to celebrate with piety the incarnation of your Word and the sacred birth of Mary, the Virgin, so that those who have been redeemed by your grace may be secure under your protection.

text: Deus qui es omnium sanctorum inseparabilis fortitudo qui inter mundanae conversationis adversa feminarum nos maxime exemplis consolaris et inter praecipua exempla institutionis vel constantiae beatae Radegundis nos consummatione gloriosa quam hodie celebramus accendis excita Domine in Ecclesia tua illum spiritum cui ista servivit ut Studeamus diligere quod amavit et opere exercere quod ipsa in femineo fragilique corpore te auxiliante exercuit.
translation_en: God who art the unseparable strength of all saints, who comfort us especially through the examples of women amidst the adversities of worldly conversation, and through the outstanding examples of institution or constancy of blessed Radegund, whom we celebrate today in her glorious completion, stir up, Lord, in thy Church that same spirit which she served. That we may strive to love what she loved, and exercise in deed what she performed in a female and fragile body with your help.

text: Domine Deus fidelium insuperabilis fortitudo qui inter mundanae conversationis adversa sanctorum nos maxime glorificatione solaris <et ad sublimia exempla patientiae triumpho nos sancti> tui indesinenter accendis excita Domine in Ecclesia tua spiritum cui ille servivit ut studeamus diligere quod amavit et opera exercere quod docuit.
translation_en: Lord God, the invincible strength of the faithful, who among the adversities of worldly conversations shine the saints especially in the glory of the sun and to high examples of patience triumph us, saint your Lord, again and again stir up in your Church, Lord, the spirit whom he served, that we may strive to love what he loved and exercise what he taught.

text: Deus qui es omnium sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hunc diem beatorum apostolorum Philippi et Iacobi martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae de natalicio tantae festivitatis laetari ut apud misericordiam tuam et exemplis eorum et meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God who are the splendor of all your saints, miraculous one, who consecrated this day of the blessed apostles Philip and James through their martyrdom, grant that the Church may rejoice on the birthday of such a great festival. Help us to be supported by Your mercy and their examples and merits.

text: Deus qui es omnium sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hunc diem beati apostoli tui illius martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae de natalicia tanti pontificis festivitate laetari ut apud misericordiam tuam et exemplis eius adiuvemur et meritis.
translation_en: God, who are the splendid brilliance of all your saints, and who on this day consecrated this day of your blessed apostle through his martyrdom, grant to your Church joy from the birthday of such a great pontiff. May we be helped by your mercy and his examples, and may we be supported by his merits.

text: Deus qui es omnium sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hunc diem in honorem beatorum Mauricii Exsuperii Candidi Victoris Innocentii et Vitalis cum sociis eorum martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae de natalicio tantae festivitatis laetari ut apud misericordiam tuam exemplis eorum et meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who is the splendid glory of all your saints, who on this day consecrated it in honor of the blessed Mauritius, Exsuperius, Candidus, Victorinus, Innocentius and Vitalis along with their companions through martyrdom, grant to Your Church that it may rejoice at the birth of such a great feast. May we be helped by their examples and merits in your mercy.

text: Deus qui es omnium sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hunc diem beati apostoli tui illius martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae de natalicio tantae festivitatis laetari ut quae apostolorum tuorum praedicatione floruit eorum exemplis muniatur et intercessionibus adiuvetur.
translation_en: God who art the splendor of all your saints, miraculous one, who on this day consecrated the apostle of yours through martyrdom, grant to your Church joy on the birthday of such great festivity. May it be strengthened by the example of the apostles and aided by their intercessions.

text: Exsurgentes de cubilibus
translation_en: Arising from beds

text: Deus qui es omnium sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hunc diem beatorum apostolorum tuorum martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae eorum in omnibus sequi praeceptum per quos sumpsit religionis exordium.
translation_en: God, who are the splendid glory of all your saints, who on this day consecrated it by the martyrdom of your blessed apostles, grant to your Church that she may follow in all things the command given through them by whom religion began.

text: Deus qui es omnium sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hunc diem beati Andreae martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae de natalicia tanti apostoli tui festivitate laetari ut apud misericordiam tuam et exemplis eius et meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God who is the splendid light of all your saints, who consecrated this day by the martyrdom of blessed Andrew, grant that your Church may rejoice on the birthday of such a great apostle. Help us through your mercy, his examples, and his merits.

text: Deus qui es pax omnium et concordia vera fidelium praesta ut quos discissio caritatis fraudavit ab invicem dilectio perfecta reconciliationem attribuat.
translation_en: God who is peace for all and true unity of faithful, grant that what discord in love has deceived may attribute to each other the perfect love of reconciliation.

text: Deus qui es sanctificator oblationum et substentatio abstinentium tu benedictione gratiae tuae et appositum tibi sacrificium sanctifica et ieiunantium pectora ab omni contagione delictorum emunda quo haec oblata uberius benedicens horum perceptione inediam nostrae debilitationis sustentes internaque sanctifices.
translation_en: God who art the sanctifier of offerings and the sustainer of the abstinent, through your grace's blessing sanctify this sacrifice that is set before you, and cleanse the hearts of those fasting from all contagion of sins. May these offerings be more richly blessed by your perception, supporting our weakness, and internally sanctifying us.

text: Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum firmitate mirabilis ostende nobis misericordiam tuam et quia humilitas servientium tibi semper est temptationibus obiecta tribue dimicantibus fortitudinem ut coronam vincentibus largiaris.
translation_en: God who is marvelous in the firmness of your saints, reveal to us your mercy and since humility of those serving you is always exposed to trials, grant strength to those fighting so that you may give a crown to the winners.

text: Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis atque lapsorum sublevator inenarrabilis fac nos famulos tuos sanctae Dei Genitricis semperque virginis Mariae et omnium sanctorum tuorum ubique tueri praesidiis necnon familiaritate atque consanguinitate nobis coniunctis et omni populo christiano cunctis insidiis fallacis inimici depulsis concede ad caelestem patriam redeundi aditum ac defunctorum omnium fidelium sacri baptismatis unda renatorum animabus quiete perfrui sempiterna.
translation_en: God, who are the miraculous splendor of your saints and the ineffable lifter of falls, make us, your servants, always to be under the protection and both fellowship and kinship of the holy Mother of God and ever-virgin Saint Mary, as well as all your saints. May you grant us, who are joined together, and every Christian people, with all deceits and snares of the enemy being repelled, the entrance to the heavenly homeland and that the peaceful waters of the sacred baptism may refresh the souls of all faithful departed.

text: Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis qui hunc diem beati Andreae martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae de eius natalicia semper gaudere ut apud misericordiam tuam exemplis eius protegamur et meritis.
translation_en: God who are the magnificent splendor of your saints, who consecrated this day by the martyrdom of blessed Andrew, grant to your Church always to rejoice on his birthday, so that we may be protected by his examples and covered by his merits under your mercy.

text: Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hunc diem in beati Germani confessoris tui atque pontificis depositione consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae de eius natalicio semper gaudere ut apud misericordiam tuam exemplis eius protegamur et meritis.
translation_en: God who art the wonderful splendor of your saints, who on this day consecrated this day in the deposition of your confessor and bishop St. Germanus, grant to Your Church that it may always rejoice at his nativity. May we be protected by his examples and covered by his merits under Your mercy.

text: Exsultet iam angelica turba
translation_en: Rejoice now, angelic host!

text: Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hodierna die beati Stephani protomartyris tui sanctorumque Nicodemi Gamalielis atque Abibon venerandas reliquias revelasti da nobis in aeterna laetitia de eorum societate gaudere.
translation_en: God who art the wonderful splendor of your saints, who today revealed the venerable relics of your protomartyr Saint Stephen and of Saints Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Abibo, grant us to rejoice in eternal joy with their fellowship.

text: Deus qui es temporalis vitae administrator aeternae quoque auctor atque largitor miserere supplici regi nostro illi in tua protectione et defensione fidenti ut per virtutem brachii tui omnibus sibi adversantibus superatis gaudeat se evasisse periculum.
translation_en: God, who is the administrator of temporal life and also the author and giver of eternal life, have mercy on our supplicant king, trusting in Your protection and defense. May he rejoice that he has escaped danger through Your power of arm, overcoming all those opposing him.

text: Deus qui es tuorum antistitum potentissimus illustrator tribue quaesumus ut beatissimi sacerdotis et confessoris tui Syri magnificis exemplis informati saeculi istius caliginem sine periculo transeamus.
translation_en: God, who are the most powerful enlightener of your bishops, we ask that you grant us, so that guided by the splendid examples of your blessed priest and confessor in Syria, we may pass through the darkness of this age without danger.

text: Deus qui es tuorum corona fidelium beati Pontii martyris tui nobis indefessum tribue patrocinium ut quem terreni ordinis curia habuit praedicatorem ipsum apud te continuum habere sentiamus intercessorem.
translation_en: God, who are the crown of Your faithful martyr St. Pontius, grant us unwavering patronage, so that we may feel him, who was a preacher in the earthly court's order, to be an everlasting intercessor with you.

text: Deus qui es unitas sancta et Trinitas indivisa adauge in nobis fidei donum et beatae caritatis affectum quo utroque a te ditati ex munere heredes efficiamur promissionis aeternae.
translation_en: God who are the unifying unity and the indivisible Trinity, increase in us the gift of faith and the affection of blessed charity, so that we, being enriched by both, become heirs through your gift of the eternal promise.

text: Fac nos Domine Deus noster tuis obedire
translation_en: Make us, O Lord our God, to obey you

text: Deus qui es vita indeficiens et salus aeterna exaudi nos clemens et propitius ut qui ad beatissimi apostoli tui Matthiae festivitatem conveniunt eius interventu a morte perpetua liberentur.
translation_en: God who art the unfailing life and eternal salvation, hear us graciously and mercifully, that those who gather for the feast of thy blessed apostle Matthew may be freed from everlasting death by his intervention.

text: Deus qui et feminas virtute castitatis armatas victrici martyrio coronasti praesta ut beatae Euphemiae virginis et martyris tuae precibus cuius festa veneramur dona tuae gratiae consequamur. Deus qui et iustis praemia meritorum et peccatoribus per ieiunium veniam praebes miserere supplicibus tuis ut reatus nostri confessio indulgentiam valeat percipere delictorum. ( . )
translation_en: God, who arms women with the virtue of chastity and crowns them victorious through the triumphant martyrdom of blessed Euphemia, virgin and martyr, grant that we may follow in her footsteps and obtain your grace. God, who rewards the just with merits and offers forgiveness to sinners through fasting, have mercy on your supplicants, so that our confession may be worthy to receive pardon for our offenses through the indulgence of sins.

text: Deus qui et libertatis nostrae auctor es et salutis exaudi supplicantium voces atque eis quos sanguinis tui effusione redemisti praesta ut per te vivere et perpetua in te facias incolumitate gaudere.
translation_en: God who art the author of our liberty and hearken to the voices of supplicants, and to those whom thou hast redeemed by the outpouring of thy blood, grant that they may live through thee and may rejoice in eternal safety through thee.

text: Deus qui ex omni coaptatione sanctorum aeternum tibi condis habitaculum da aedificationis tuae incrementa caelestia ut quorum hic reliquias pio amore complectimur eorum semper meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who from the union of all saints has eternally prepared a dwelling for You, grant us the increase of Your building, that we may be enfolded in the holy relics with pious love and always be helped by their merits.

text: Deus qui ex Thebaeae legionis ordine gloriosos etiam martyres Gereonem Victorem Cassium atque Florentium sociosque eorum hodierna die sanguinis sui coronasti effusione praesta quaesumus ut quos exsultamus habere patronos in terris eorum apud te iugem sentiamus interventum in caelis.
translation_en: God, who on this day crowned the glorious martyrs Geronimo, Victor, Cassian, and Florentius from the Theban legion with the shedding of their blood, we humbly ask that you provide us with these patrons on earth. May we feel their intervention in heaven as we rejoice in having them here.

text: Deus qui eximiae castitatis privilegio famulam tuam Cuthburgam multipliciter decorasti da nobis famulis tuis eius promerente intercessione utriusque vitae prosperitatem ut sicut eius festivitas nobiscum agitur in terris ita per eius interventum nostri memoria apud te semper habeatur in caelis.
translation_en: God who adorned your servant Cuthburga with the privileges of extraordinary chastity, grant us, your servants, through her meritorious intercession, prosperity in both lives. So that as her feast day is celebrated among us on earth, may it also be through her intervention that our memory be always held among you in heaven.

text: Deus qui eximium praeconii tui sacerdotem Grimbaldum hodierna die caelorum regna penetrare fecisti vota nostra miseratus admitte ut nos a peccatorum nostrorum vinculis absolutos illius pia intercessione ab omni semper adversitate custodias.
translation_en: God, who today allowed your exalted herald Grimbald to penetrate the kingdoms of heaven, have mercy on our prayers and admit us, that we may be absolved from the bonds of our sins. May his pious intercession keep us forever from any adversity.

text: Deus qui eximium veritatis tuae praeconem beatum pontificem Dunstanum sanctorum tuorum meritis aequalem gloriosis ostendis miraculis praesta quaesumus ut quem nobis in terra donasti doctorem in caelo facias habere intercessorem.
translation_en: God, who show the blessed bishop Dunstan, equal to your great truth-teller among your saints, through miracles; we ask that you grant, you who gave him to us as a teacher on earth, make him our intercessor in heaven.

text: Deus qui exorante apostolo tuo Bartholomaeo daemoni praecepisti suum funditus diruere simulacrum peccatorum imagines a nostris mentibus quaesumus expelle propitius ut eius precibus emundati regni tui ianuam gaudenter introire mereamur.
translation_en: God, who through your apostle Bartholomew commanded the demon to shatter its image of sins completely from our minds, we humbly ask that you mercifully expel it. May we be worthy to enter the gate of your kingdom, having been purified by his prayers.

text: Deus qui exuberantem fontem misericordiae tardus ad vindicta celeriter ad veniam quem peccatorum nostrorum non ignorantia revocat sed patientiam clementer exspectat concede propitius a nobis te intellectum diligi dilectum irreprehensibiliter imitari ut vitantes quo morimur valeamus accedere te praevio quo vivamus.
translation_en: God, who is slow to anger and rich in mercy, quick to forgive the transgressions of our sins not through ignorance but through patient expectation, grant us graciously that we may understand you, love you, and irreproachably imitate you; so that avoiding what leads to death, we may worthily approach you before whom we live.

text: Deus qui facturae tuae pio semper dominaris affectu inclina aurem tuam supplicationibus nostris et famulum tuum illum ex adversa valetudine corporis laborantem placidus respice et visita in salutari tuo et caelestis gratiae praesta medicinam.
translation_en: God, who always governs your creations with a pious affection, incline your ear to our supplications and look upon your servant laboring under adversity of health with calm regard. Visit him in your salvation and bestow upon him healing through your celestial grace.

text: Deus qui famulantibus tibi mentis et corporis subsidia misericorditer largiris praesta quaesumus ut hi qui pro amore supernae patriae ardenter caelestia praemia per fidem et spem caritatemque adipisci cupiunt intercedente beato archimandrita consessore tuo Germano ab omnibus iniquitatibus liberentur.
translation_en: God who mercifully bestows the aids of mind and body to those who serve you, we humbly ask that you grant that those who eagerly desire to obtain heavenly rewards through faith, hope, and charity may be freed from all iniquities by the intercession of blessed archimandrite Germano.

text: Deus qui famulis tuis Moysi Samuel et Stephano protomartyri virtutem patientiae dedisti ut pro suorum delictis inimicorum aequanimiter exorarent da nobis quaesumus omnium meritis sanctorum ut inimicos nostros verae dilectionis amore diligamus eorumque pro excessibus tota mentis intentione preces assiduas in conspectu maiestatis tuae fundamus.
translation_en: God who gave courage and patience to Your servants Moses, Samuel, and Stephen the protomartyr, so that they could pray for their enemies' sins with equanimity, grant us, we ask, through the merits of all saints, that we may love our enemies with the love of true devotion. May our constant prayers, with all our mind's intention, be founded in Your majesty.

text: Deus qui famulo tuo Ezechiae ter quinos annos ad vitam donasti ita et famulum tuum illum a lecto aegritudinis tua potentia erigat ad salutem.
translation_en: God, who gave your servant Ezekiah five additional years of life, may also raise your servant from the bed of your affliction to health.

text: Deus qui famulo tuo illi tuae dedisti fidei coniunctionem concede ut per temporalem corporis incommoditatem ad supernorum civium pertingere mereatur consortium.
translation_en: God, who granted your servant the union of faith, grant that he may be worthy to join the fellowship of heavenly citizens, despite the temporary discomfort of the body.

text: Deus qui famulum tuum Aegidium misericordem fecisti intercessorem pro peccatis omnium da nobis interventu ipsius nostrorum veniam peccatorum et aeternae beatitudinis optabilem laetitiam.
translation_en: God who made your servant Giles merciful for the intercession of all sins, grant us forgiveness of our sins through his intervention and give us the desirable joy of eternal beatitude.

text: Deus qui famulum tuum illum sacerdotem atque abbatem et sanctificasti unctione misericordiae et assumpsisti consummatione felici suscipe propitius preces nostras et praesta ut sicut ille tecum est meritis ita a nobis non recedat exemplis.
translation_en: God, who sanctified your servant, that priest and abbot, with the unction of mercy and took him up in blessed assumption, graciously receive our prayers and grant that, just as he remained with you through merits, so he may not depart from us through examples.

text: Deus qui famulum tuum Isaac pro sterilitate coniugii sui te deprecantem exaudire et conceptum Rebeccae donare dignatus es preces famulae tuae illius pro percipienda prole benignus exaudi ut firmamentum spei quod in tua misericordia posuit ei ex percepto munere quod postulat confirmetur.
translation_en: God, who heard the prayer of your servant Isaac because of his wife's infertility, and graciously granted the conception of Rebecca, hear likewise the prayers of your servant, and be benevolent so that the foundation of hope which you placed in him through the promised gift may be confirmed by the birth he is asking for.

text: Deus qui famulum tuum pontificem nostrum pastorem Ecclesiae tuae praeesse voluisti praesta quaesumus ut quod humana voce dicitur in tuis oculis esse mereatur.
translation_en: God who willed that Your servant, our bishop, shepherd of Your church, should preside over him, grant us, we pray, that what is said by human voice may be worthy in Your eyes.

text: Deus qui ferventis supplicium plumbi ante oculos illatum Eulaliae virginis tuae frigidum effecisti tu e caelis ignem illum tui amoris emitte qui numquam novit frigescere quo et hanc in honorem martyris tuae oblatam tibi sanctifices hostiam et cordibus nostris consequentis gratiae spiritalem impertias medicinam.
translation_en: God, who made the burning torture of lead before the eyes of your virgin Eulalia cold, send from heaven the fire of your love which never knows to freeze. May you sanctify the offering brought to you in honor of your martyr and bestow upon us a spiritual healing medicine following grace.

text: Deus qui fidei sacramenta in Unigeniti tui gloriosa transfiguratione patrum testimonio roborasti et adoptionem filiorum perfectam voce delapsa in nube lucida praesignasti concede propitius ut ipsius regis gloriae nos coheredes efficias et eiusdem gloriae tribuas esse consortes.
translation_en: God who strengthened the sacraments of faith through the glorious transformation of your Only-Begotten Son, and signified the perfect adoption of children by a voice that burst forth in a radiant cloud, graciously grant that we may become coheirs to his royal glory and make us consorts of the same glory.

text: Deus qui fideles semper adiuvas populos et regeneratos tibi consectas parvulos inchoatas in hoc populo perfice sanitates repellendo adversarias potestates ut virtute huius sacrificii dum superbus inimicus eliditur resurrectionis tuae celebritate adoptivus in pace populus amplietur.
translation_en: God, who always helps faithful peoples and regenerated children consecrated to you, complete the health begun among this people by driving away opposing powers, so that with the power of this sacrifice, while the proud enemy is destroyed, Your resurrection may be celebrated, and the adopted people may be embraced in peace.

text: Deus qui fideles tuos ad hoc corripis ut emendes populum tuum quaesumus ne despicias supplicantem ut tuae virtutis auxilio omni hostilitate depulsa et securitas huius regni laetetur et catholica semper exsultet ecclesia.
translation_en: God who chastises your faithful for this purpose, to correct your people, we ask that you not despise the supplicant. May every hostility be driven away from us through the aid of your virtues, so that the security of this kingdom rejoices and the Catholic Church always exults.

text: Deus qui fideles tuos gloriosa beatae virginis tuae Milburgae festivitate laetificas fac nos per ipsius merita vitae utriusque gaudia promereri.
translation_en: God who delights your faithful ones in the festival of the blessed Virgin Milburga, grant us through her merits of both lives that we may attain the joys of both.

text: Deus qui fidelibus tuis castitatis exemplum praebuisti dum de virgine Filium tuum Dominum nostrum nasci voluisti sanctae Edithae virginis tuae precibus nobis mentis et corporis tribue puritatem per quam a te nobis promissam percipiamus felicitatem.
translation_en: God, who provided an example of chastity to your faithful when you willed that Your Son, our Lord, be born from the Virgin, grant us purity of mind and body through which we may experience the happiness promised to us by You in response to the prayers of Your virgin Editha.

text: Deus qui fidelium devotione laetaris populum tuum quaesumus sanctis tuis fac esse devotum ut qui ab eorum officio impia pravitate mentis abscedunt per tuam conversi gratiam diaboli quibus capti tenentur laqueis resipiscant.
translation_en: God, who delights in the devotion of your faithful, we ask that you make your people devoted so that those who depart from their duty due to impious wickedness of mind may, by your gracious conversion, return from the snares of the devil in which they are held captive.

text: Deus qui fidelium mentes unius efficis voluntatis da populis tuis id amare quod praecipis id desiderare quod promittis ut inter mundanas varietates ibi nostra fixa sint corda ubi vera sunt gaudia.
translation_en: God, who makes the minds of faithful ones of one will, grant to your people to love what you command and desire what you promise. May they be fixed in heart among worldly diversities, where true joys are found.

text: Deus qui fidelium pace laetaris dona servientibus tibi pacem omnesque eorum actus qui tibi servire cupiunt placabili miseratione compone.
translation_en: God, who delights in the peace of the faithful, grant peace to those who serve you. May all their actions, who desire to serve you, be composed by your pleasing mercy.

text: Deus qui fidelium precibus flecteris et humilium confessione placaris conversis ad te propitiare supplicibus et quos fecisti iram intellegere castigantis fac misericordiam sentire parcentis.
translation_en: God, who bends to the prayers of the faithful and is appeased by humble confession, grant mercy to those who return to you and understand the chastising as those who feel compassion.

text: Deus qui fidelium tuorum (corda) ad veram vis innocentiam pervenire fac nos per indulgentiam tuam illius participes sanctitatis quae nec sibi noxia nec cuiquam inveniatur a versa.
translation_en: God, who brings the hearts of your faithful to attain true innocence, make us participants in the sanctity that is found neither harmful to itself nor harmful to anyone, through your indulgence.

text: Deus qui fidelium tuorum multitudinem annua sanctorum martyrum tuorum Dionysii Rustici et Eleutherii festivitate laetificas concede propitius ut quorum devote inventionem recolimus eorum tibi meritis commendemur et precibus.
translation_en: God who delightest the multitude of thy faithful ones in the annual feast of thy martyrs Dionysius Rusticus and Eleutherius, grant propitiously that we, devoted to their memorable discovery, may commend ourselves to thee by their merits and our prayers.

text: Deus qui Filium tuum pro nostra salute de sancta Maria virgine incarnatum in hunc mundum misisti quaesumus ut huius oblationis mysterium quod pro ipsius incarnationis sacramento tuae maiestati est oblatum perpetuae salutis nobis tribuat gaudium.
translation_en: God, who sent Your Son for our salvation from the holy Mary, Virgin, into this world, we ask that the mystery of this offering, which is offered for the sacred sacrament of his incarnation, may grant us eternal joy.

text: Deus qui frumenta tui eloquii beatum pontificem tuum Gregorium esurientibus populis dispertire fecisti concede tuis famulis toto mentis affectu servare quod docuit ut illuc quoque eodem apud te obtinente mereamur subsequi quo pervenit.
translation_en: God, who caused your blessed pontiff Gregory to distribute the grain of your word to hungry peoples, grant that your servants may with all affection of mind preserve what he taught, so that we may also deserve to follow where he has reached, since he attained it before us at your presence.

text: Deus qui fundasti terram super stabilitatem suam suscipe oblationes et preces populi tui ac trementis terrae periculis penitus amotis divinae tuae iracundiae terrores in humanae salutis remedia converte ut qui de terra sunt et in terram revertentur gaudeant se fieri sancta conversatione caelestes.
translation_en: God who founded the earth upon its stability, receive the offerings and prayers of your people, and trembling with the perils of the earth, remove the terrors of your divine wrath. Turn them into remedies for human salvation, so that those who are on earth and those who return to it may rejoice as they are made holy by a heavenly way of life.

text: Deus qui fulgentibus margaritis clarum lumen infers mundo qui beato pontifici Zenoni aeternam in caelis coronam gloriae praeparasti nobis quoque famulis tuis adstantibus ante conspectum maiestatis tuae adesse digneris.
translation_en: God who infers the bright light amid shining pearls to the world, which you prepared an eternal crown of glory in heaven for blessed Pope Zenon, deign to be present among us your servants standing before your majesty as well.

text: Deus qui gloriaris in sanctis tuis et in martyribus Ecclesiae tuae fundamenta tua constituis a sanguine enim Abel iusti usque ad sanguinem Zachariae filii Barachiae cunctisque prophetis atque apostolis vel nostris temporibus unus toto orbe praedicatis ut dum reliquias vel memoriam eorum veneramur resurrectionem carnis omnibus approbemus miserere nobis.
translation_en: God, who glorifies in your saints and in the martyrs of your church, you establish your foundation from the blood of Abel, the righteous, up to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachia, as well as all prophets and apostles, even those preaching in our times throughout the entire world. When we honor their relics or memory, may we approve the resurrection of the flesh for all. Have mercy on us.

text: Deus qui glorificaris in concilio sanctorum martyrum tuorum illorum respice ad preces humilitatis nostrae et quorum sollemnia celebramus eorum precibus adiuvari mereamur.
translation_en: God who glorifies in the council of your saints, martyrs, look upon our humble prayers and since we are celebrating their feast days, may we be worthy to be helped by their prayers.

text: Deus qui glorificaris in sanctis tuis et Macchabaeorum martyrum tuorum in te perficis gloriosos triumphos quorum te mundo huic et vita praedicavit et passio quorumque confessioni tu Domine aperuisti regna caelorum pateant quaesumus supplicationibus nostris aures misericordiae tuae et eam nobis intercessione sanctorum concede fiduciam ut ad promissiones tuas ipsorum veniamus suffragiis quorum incitamur exemplis.  Et quia in hoc die congregatas cum Macchabaeorum triumphis victorias celebramus martyris tui Felicis quaesumus ut tam illorum suffragio quam istius patrocinio tuearis populum a periculis patriam conserves in pace eliminando hostem conferendo quietem donans tranquillam viventibus vitam et defunctis requiem sempiternam.
translation_en:
God who glorifies yourself in your saints and make the martyrs of the Maccabees glorious triumphs, whose deeds and passion proclaimed you to this world and life, we humbly ask that your merciful ears be open to our supplications. Grant us faith through their intercession so that we may come to your promises through their patronage, encouraged by their examples.
And since on this day we celebrate the victories of your martyr Felicitas along with those of the Maccabees, we humbly ask that you protect the people from dangers and preserve the nation in peace, eliminating the enemy, granting tranquility to the living, and eternal rest to the dead.

text: Deus qui gloriosissimum nomen Domini nostri Iesu Christi unigeniti Filii tui fecisti fidelibus tuis summo suavitatis affectu amabile et malignis spiritibus tremendum atque terribile concede propitius ut omnes qui hoc nomen Iesu devote venerantur in terris sanctae consolationis dulcedinem in praesenti percipiant et in futuro gaudium exsultationis et interminabilis iubilationis obtineant.
translation_en: God, who have made the most glorious name of our Lord Jesus Christ, your only-begotten Son, delightful to your faithful with the highest degree of affection, make it dreadful and terrible to evil spirits. Graciously grant that all who devoutly venerate this name of Jesus on earth may experience the sweetness of holy consolation in the present, and may obtain eternal joy, exultation, and endless jubilation in the future.

text: Famulas tuas Domine tuae custodia
translation_en: Your servants, Lord, guard under your protection

text: Deus qui gloriosos resurrectionis aeternae praecones septem dormientes magnifice coronasti praesta quaesumus ut eorum precibus resurrectionem sanctam quae in eis mirabiliter praeostensa est consequamur.
translation_en: God who magnificently crowned the glorious heralds of eternal resurrection while they were asleep, we humbly ask that through their prayers we may follow the holy resurrection which was wonderfully manifested in them.

text: Deus qui gloriosus es in sanctis et humiliari voluisti in terris martyrum tuorum prece benedictionem sanctificationis tuae hiis sacrificiis nostris appone quo dum ex his libaverimus et martyrum subsidiis liberemur a culpis et tuae fulgeamus gloria incarnationis.
translation_en: God, who art glorious in the saints and hast willed to be humbled on earth, grant to thy martyrs through their prayer a blessing of sanctification to these our sacrifices. Thus, as we are freed from faults through them and shine with the glory of thy incarnation.

text: Deus qui habitaculum tuum in corde pudico fundasti respice super famulam tuam illam et quae castigationibus assiduis postulat tua consolatione percipiat.
translation_en: God who have built Your dwelling place in a chaste heart, look upon Your servant and the one who constantly seeks Your chastisement. May she receive Your comfort.

text: Deus qui hanc nobis diem beati illius martyris tui atque pontificis martyrio consecrasti concede propitius ut omnes qui martyrii eius merita veneramur intercessionibus eius ab aeternis gehennae incendiis liberemur.
translation_en: God who consecrated this day for us by the martyrdom of your blessed martyr and bishop, graciously grant that we who venerate his merits may be mercifully freed from the eternal fires of hell through his intercessions.

text: Deus qui hanc sacratissimam noctem gloria dominicae resurrectionis illustras concede populo tuo originalis delicti errore mundato post sacratissimum fontem terram tuae promissionis intrare ut dulcia sacramentorum tuorum alimenta percipiant.
translation_en: God, who illuminates this most sacred night of the Lord's glorious resurrection, grant your people that, cleansed from the original sin and washed in the most sacred font, they may enter your land of promise to partake of the sweet nourishment of your sacraments.

text: Deus qui hanc sacratissimam noctem gloria dominicae resurrectionis illustras conserva in nova familiae tuae progenie adoptionis spiritum quem dedisti ut corpore et mente renovati puram tibi exhibeant servitutem.
translation_en: God who illuminates this most sacred night of the glory of the Lord's resurrection, preserve in your new family's progeny the spirit which you have given, that they, renewed in body and mind, may present to you a pure service.

text: Deus qui hanc sacratissimam noctem per beatae Mariae sacrae virginis partum sine humana concupiscentia procreatum veri luminis fecisti illustratione clarescere da nobis quaesumus ut cuius lucis mysterium in terra cognovimus eius quoque gaudiis in caelo perfruamur. Ex his quoque sacris libaminibus odor ad te suavitatis adscendat atque in his benedictio a te copiosa descendat ut per mysterium tuae operationis fiat nobis eucharistia legitima et verus sanguis.
translation_en: God, who on this most holy night brought forth the true light through the birth of the blessed Mary virgin without human desire, make us worthy to experience in heaven the joy of the mystery of whose light we have known on earth. May also the sweet smell of these sacred offerings ascend to you, and may a rich blessing descend upon them from you, so that through the mystery of your operation, we may receive legitimate eucharist and true blood.

text: Deus qui hanc sacratissimam noctem veri luminis fecisti illustratione clarescere da quaesumus ut cuius lucis mysteria in terra cognovimus eius quoque gaudiis in caelo perfruamur.
translation_en: God who made this most sacred night bright with the illumination of true light, grant us what we ask, that we may partake of the joys of whose mystery on earth we have known, and may also enjoy them in heaven.

text: Deus qui hanc sacrosanctam diem pro festivitate beati Gregorii sollemniter nobis celebrandam contulisti da quaesumus supplicibus tuis ut meritorum eius patrocinio defensi et ab omnibus vitae huius periculis liberemur et futurae promissionis praemia consequi valeamus.
translation_en: God, who has graciously given us this holy day for the feast of blessed Gregory, we humbly ask that through his merits, we may be defended from all perils of this life and enabled to attain the rewards of your future promises.

text: Deus qui hanc sollemnitatem beati Albani martyris tui populo concessisti Anglorum eius meritis tribue nobis remissionem peccatorum et cum ipso fac perfrui nos gaudiis sempiternis caelorum.
translation_en: God, who granted this solemnity of the blessed Alban your martyr to your people, grant us through his merits forgiveness of sins and may we with him experience everlasting joys of heaven.

text: Deus qui hoc nobis confers gratia ut iusti ex impiis et beati efficiamur ex miseris adesto operibus tuis adesto muneribus ut quibus inest fidei iustificatio non desit perseverantiae fortitudo.
translation_en: God who bestows upon us grace so that we may become just from the unjust and blessed from the miserable, be present to your works, be present to your gifts, so that those who possess the justification of faith do not lack the strength of perseverance.

text: Deus qui hoc templum beatae Mariae semper virginis et beatorum apostolorum martyrum confessorum virginum atque omnium simul sanctorum communi voluisti tibi honore dicari praesta quaesumus ut quorum hic recondita patrocinia debito veneramur obsequio etiam piae conversationis sequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God, who willed that this temple of the blessed Virgin Mary, ever virgin, and the holy apostles and martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all the saints should be dedicated to you with common honor, we ask that you grant us. May we venerate their patronage here with due obedience, and may we also follow their pious example in our conduct.

text: Deus qui hodie beatae Teclae virginis nos annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut eius meritis adiuvemur cuius castitatis irradiamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who today delights us with the annual feast of the blessed Tecla virgin, grant us graciously that we may be aided by her merits, whose examples we are enlightened by her chastity.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatae Hildae virginis tuae animam ad ostendendum sanctitatis eius meritum inter agmina angelorum caelum penetrare fecisti concede nobis ipsius meritis ita innocenter vivere ut ad eadem mereamur gaudia pervenire.
translation_en: God, who today made the soul of the blessed Hilde of your virgins to penetrate heaven among the ranks of angels by showing its merit of holiness, grant us through her merits to live so innocently that we may deserve the same joys.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatam sanctae Potentianae virginis tuae animam caelorum regna penetrare fecisti concede propitius eius interventu nos a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus solvi et ab omni semper adversitate defendi.
translation_en: God who today permitted the soul of the blessed Saint Potentiana to penetrate the kingdoms of heaven, graciously grant that through her intercession we may be freed from the bonds of our sins and defended forever against any adversity.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatum Aegidium confessorem tuum atque abbatem aulam regni caelestis penetrare fecisti tribue quaesumus ut cuius devote gloriamur meritis eius nos sentiamus confoveri suffragiis.
translation_en: God, who on this day permitted your confessor and abbot, blessed Eugidius, to penetrate the court of the heavenly kingdom, grant us we ask, that we may glory in his merits and feel strengthened by his intercessions.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatum Albanum martyrem tuum aeternae claritatis candore dealbasti praesta quaesumus ut venerandam eiusdem victoriam celebrando digni efficiamur adoptionis tuae consortio.
translation_en: God, who today adorned your martyr Alban with the brightness of eternal clarity, grant us that we may be worthy to celebrate his revered victory. May we thereby become fit for the fellowship of your adoption.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatum Dunstanum archipraesulem ac confessorem tuum in regnum aeternae beatitudinis voluisti assumere concede familiae tuae ut ipsius adiuvantibus meritis sanctorum tuorum mereamur adunari consortiis.
translation_en: God, who today willed to take the blessed Dunstan, your archbishop and confessor, into the kingdom of eternal beatitude, grant to your family that we may deserve to be joined with his merits through the prayers of your saints.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatum Leodegarium martyrem tuum atque pontificem gloria et honore coronasti tribue nobis propitius ut qui gloriam non meremur indulgentiam ipso interveniente consequamur.
translation_en: God, who today crowned your blessed Leodegar, martyr and bishop, with glory and honor, graciously grant us that we who do not deserve the glory may obtain mercy through his intervention.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beatum Petrum post te dedisti caput ecclesiae cum te ille vere confessus sit et ipse a te digne praelatus sit te supplices exoramus ut qui dedisti pastorem ne quid de ovibus perderes ut grex effugiat errores eius intercessione quem praefecisti nos salvifices.
translation_en: God, who today after you bestowed the head of the church upon blessed Peter, whom he truly confessed and was rightly appointed as bishop by you, we humbly beseech you. You who gave the shepherd, pray that nothing of the sheep may be lost. May the flock not stray from his errors through your intervention. You who appointed him as our savior, plead for us.

text: Deus qui hodierna die corda fidelium Sancti Spiritus illustratione docuisti da nobis in eodem spiritu recta sapere et de eius semper consolatione gaudere.
translation_en: God, who on this day enlightened the hearts of the faithful by the illumination of the Holy Spirit, grant us to think rightly and always rejoice in His constant consolation.

text: Deus qui hodierna die gloriosa beati Marci evangelistae membra tuis famulis revelare dignatus es concede propitius ut qui eius corporis translationem venerando colimus ipsius beatitudini te concedente adiungi mereamur.
translation_en: God, who on this day deigned to reveal the glorious body of the blessed apostle Mark to your servants, graciously grant that we, who venerate his corporal translation with reverence, may merit to be joined to his beatitude through your consent.

text: Deus qui hodierna die in omnem terram tuorum verba apostolorum ob vocationem totius orbis exire fecisti da nobis quaesumus fide et opere eorum servare vestigia quorum doctrinis sanctae ecclesiae consistit origo.
translation_en: God who today on every land made your words of the apostles come forth at the call of the whole world, grant us, we beg you, to preserve the footsteps of those whose teachings are the foundation of the holy church in faith and deed.

text: Deus qui hodierna die per unigenitum tuum aeternitatis nobis aditum devicta morte reserasti vota nostra quae praeveniendo adspiras etiam adiuvando prosequere.
translation_en: God, who today through your only-begotten Son have opened to us an entrance into eternity by conquering death, grant that the promises we make beforehand you inspire and even help us to fulfill.

text: Deus qui hodierna die pro incomparabilibus meritis gloriosissimam Mariam semperque virginem et matrem ad superna gaudia perduxisti praesta illuc nos quoque tua pietate conscendere quo ipsa meruit sublevari.
translation_en: God, who today led the glorious Mary, always a virgin and mother, to supreme joys, grant us also by Your mercy to ascend there where she was raised up deserving.

text: Deus qui hodierna die sanctum Dunstanum archipraesulem ac confessorem tuum ad aeterna sublevasti gaudia eius quaesumus meritis illuc tua nos perducat misericordia.
translation_en: God who raised the holy bishop and confessor Dunstan on this day to eternal joys, we humbly ask that through his merits, your mercy may lead us there as well.

text: Deus qui hodierna die sanctum Ioannem praeconem veritatis angelico concipiendum ministerio praevidisti concede nobis famulis tuis ut qui eius insignia veneramur ipsius meritis et ab instantibus inimicorum insidiis erui et ad viam veri luminis sine errore pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: God, who on this day foresaw Saint John the Baptist being conceived by an angelic ministry, grant to us, your servants, that we who revere his insignia may be worthy of salvation through his merits and escape from the plots of our enemies. May we merit to reach the way of truth's light without error.

text: Deus qui hodierna die unigenitum tuum gentibus stella duce revelasti concede propitius ut qui iam te ex fide cognovimus usque ad contemplandam speciem tuae celsitudinis perducamur.
translation_en: God, who today revealed your Unigenito to the nations as a guiding star, graciously grant that we who now know you through faith may be led to behold the sight of your majesty's splendor.

text: Deus qui hodierna die unigenitum tuum mirabiliter transformatum caelitus utriusque testamenti patribus revelasti da nobis quaesumus beneplacitis tibi actibus ad eius semper contemplandam pertingere gloriam in quo tuae paternitati optime complacuisse testatus es.
translation_en: God who today revealed your only-begotten One miraculously transformed to the patriarchs of both testaments, grant us we beseech you, to reach the glory of him whom you have testified to highly approve of through your paternity.

text: Deus qui hodierna die verbum tuum beatae virginis alvo coadunare voluisti fac nos ita peragere ut tibi placere valeamus.
translation_en: God who today willed to join your word with the womb of the blessed virgin, make us act in such a way that we may be pleasing to you.

text: Deus qui hodiernae diei iucunditatem in Iesu Christi et Mariae laudibus venerari fecisti praesta quaesumus ut qui eiusdem Dei matris gaudiorum recordium celebramus a piissimi Filii tui et matris gratia numquam excidamus.
translation_en: God, who made it fitting on this day to be admired in the joy of Jesus Christ and Mary, grant us our prayer that we who celebrate the remembrance of the joy of the same God, Father, and Mother, may never depart from the grace of your most compassionate Son and Mother.

text: Deus qui hodiernae festivitatis diem beati Udalrici confessoris tui atque pontificis transitu gloriosum fecisti concede propitius sic tanti patroni atque doctoris merita venerari in terris ut ipsius apud te patrocinia sentiamus in caelis.
translation_en: God, who made the day of today's festival of Your confessor and bishop Saint Udalric glorious, graciously grant that his merits as such a great patron and teacher may be honored on earth. May we feel his intercession in heaven.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae eorum in omnibus sequi praeceptum per quos religionis sumpsit exordium.
translation_en: God, who on this day consecrated the day of Your apostles Peter and Paul through their martyrdom, grant to Your Church that she may follow in all things the teaching by which religious life began through them.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem beati confessoris tui Ethelwoldi episcopi transitu nobis honorabilem dedicasti concede propitius ut cuius eruditione veritatis tuae luce perfundimur eius intercessione caelestis vitae gaudia consequamur.
translation_en: God who on this day dedicated to us the passing of your confessor Bishop Ethelwold, graciously grant that we may be enlightened by his learning with the light of your truth and through his intercession may attain the joys of eternal life.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem beati Mauri confessoris tui atque abbatis sacro transitu consecrasti concede nobis propitius inoffensis per eius instituta gressibus pergere ut eiusdem in regione viventium mereamur gaudiis admisceri.
translation_en: God, who on this day consecrated the sacred transition of your blessed confessor and abbot St. Maurice, graciously grant us that we may proceed without offense through his established steps, so that we may deserve to be admitted to the joys of those living in his region.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem beatorum martyrum tuorum Gereonis Victoris Cassii atque Florentii sociorumque eorum tuis fidelibus venerandam praebuisti praesta quaesumus ut sicut eos propriis exigentibus meritis per triumphum martyrii ad superna caelorum transtulisti ita nobis praemia largiaris aeterna.
translation_en: God, who today granted the day to your blessed martyrs Gereon, Victor, Cassius, and Florian, and their companions, bestow upon us, we ask, that just as you transported them through the triumph of martyrdom to the heights of heavenly glory, so too may you grant us eternal rewards.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem beatorum martyrum tuorum illorum passione decorasti praesta quaesumus ut eorum suffragia apud te sentiamus in caelis quorum pio amore sollemnia veneramur in terris.
translation_en: God, who adorned today's day with the passion of your blessed martyrs, grant us, we pray, that we may feel their intercession with you in heaven, whose pious love we honor on earth by solemnly celebrating their feast days.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem sacratissimam nobis beati illius confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnitate tribuisti adesto propitius Ecclesiae tuae precibus ut cuius gloriatur meritis muniatur suffragiis.
translation_en: God, who on this day bestowed upon us the most sacred day of your blessed confessor and bishop, be present graciously. Hear the prayers of your Church, that she may be strengthened with his merits by his intercessions.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem sanctorum tuorum Sergii et Bacchi martyrio consecrasti da nobis natalicia votiva digne recolere et eorum suffragio ab omnibus adversitatibus liberari.
translation_en: God, who on this day consecrated the feast of your saints Sergius and Bacchus, grant us worthy remembrance of their natal vows, and through their intercession be delivered from all adversities.

text: Deus qui hodiernam diem sanctorum tuorum Chrysantii et Dariae martyrio consecrasti da nobis salutem mentis et corporis ut et illorum passioni sit veneratio ex nostra devotione et nobis auxilium perveniat de eorum sanctissima intercessione.
translation_en: God who today's day consecrated through the martyrdom of your saints Chrysanthus and Daria, grant us the health of mind and body, that we may reverence their passion from our devotion, and may aid come to us from their most holy intercession.

text: Deus qui hominem delapsum in mortem conspiciens unigeniti tui adventu redimere voluisti praesta quaesumus ut qui eius gloriosam incarnationem fatentur ipsius etiam redemptoris consortia mereantur.
translation_en: God, who saw man fallen into death, desiring to redeem him by the advent of your only-begotten one, we ask that you grant, those who confess his glorious incarnation may also merit fellowship with their Redeemer.

text: Deus qui homini ad imaginem tuam condito ideo das temporalia ut largiaris aeterna Ecclesiam tuam spiritali fecunditate multiplica ut qui sunt generatione terreni fiant regeneratione caelestes.
translation_en: God, who created man in your image, you give temporal things so that you may bestow eternal ones. Multiply your Church with spiritual fertility, so that those who are born of the earthly generation may be reborn through a heavenly regeneration.

text: Deus qui homini ad tuam imaginem facto etiam spiritalem alimoniam praeparasti concede filio nostro famulo tuo illi qui in pauperes tuos tua seminat dona ut veros metat suorum operum fructus et largitatis hodiernae compensatio ipsi perpetua conferatur recipiatque pro parvis magna pro terrenis caelestia pro temporalibus sempiterna.
translation_en: God, who prepared spiritual nourishment for the man created in your image, grant to our servant your son, that he may sow seeds in your poor and reap the fruits of his labor. May the reward of today's generosity be given to him as eternal compensation, and may he receive, for small things, great things, for earthly things, heavenly things, for temporal things, eternal ones.

text: Deus qui honorem pristinum reddidisti per crucis opprobrium quibus noluisti mortis inferre supplicium repromissa nobis benedictionum caelestium largire subsidia ne paschalis adimatur repente laetitia. Da regeneratis ex spiritu bonam vitam donec veniamus feliciter ad beatam. Sit in oculis tuis acceptabile quod offerimus sit salubre quod poscimus quo per sanguinem crucis tuae in pace qua tu es saepe solidati vivamus.
translation_en: God, who restored the ancient honor through the shame of the cross, which you did not wish to inflict as a punishment for death, grant us again the promises of heavenly blessings and support, lest the joy of Easter be suddenly taken away. Give to those renewed by your spirit a good life until we come happily to the blessed. May what we offer be acceptable in your sight, may what we ask be healthy, so that through the blood of your cross we may live in peace, where you are often solidified.

text: Deus qui huius diei venerandam sanctamque laetitiam beati apostoli tui Iacobi festivitate tribuisti da Ecclesiae tuae et amare quod credidit et praedicare quod docuit.
translation_en: God, who on this day granted the venerable and holy joy of your blessed apostle James' feast, grant to your Church and make it believe what it believes and preach what it has been taught.

text: Deus qui humanae fragilitati necessaria providisti misericors adminicula iumentorum quaesumus ut eadem miseris consulendo non subtrahas et quorum nostris meritis saevit interitus tua nobis parcendo clementia cessari iubeas vastitatem.
translation_en: God, who in your mercy have provided support for the frailty of humans, we humbly ask that you do not withdraw the aid of beasts from those in need. And through our merits, may your fierce destruction cease towards us, and command your clemency to stop the devastation.

text: Deus qui humanae substantiae dignitatem et mirabiliter condidisti et mirabilius reformasti da quaesumus nobis Iesu Christi Filii tui divinitatis esse consortes qui humanitatis nostrae fieri dignatus est particeps.
translation_en: God, who marvelously created and most wonderfully restored the dignity of the human substance, we humbly ask that we may be consorts of your divinity in Jesus Christ, your Son, who deigned to become a partner of our humanity.

text: Gaudeat Domine quaesumus populus tua semper
translation_en: May your people rejoice, we ask, O Lord, always.

text: Deus qui humanae substantiae dignitatem et mirabiliter condidisti et mirabilius reformasti da quaesumus ut eius efficiamur in divina consortes qui nostrae humanitatis fieri dignatus est particeps.
translation_en: God, who wonderfully created and miraculously restored the dignity of human nature, we humbly ask that you make us worthy to be partners with him in the divine consortium, for he deigned to become a participant in our humanity.

text: Deus qui humanae substantiae dignitatem et mirabiliter condidisti et mirabilius reformasti da nobis quaesumus eius divinitatis esse consortes qui humanitatis nostrae fieri dignatus est particeps.
translation_en: God, who wonderfully created and even more wondrously restored the dignity of human substance, grant us, we ask, to be his consorts, who deigned to become a participant in our humanity.

text: Deus qui humanae substantiae dignitatis tuae gratiam contulisti da nobis Iesu Christi Filii tui divinitatis esse consortes qui fragilitatis nostrae dignatus est fieri particeps.
translation_en: God, who bestowed Your grace upon the dignity of human substance, grant us to be consorts of Your divinity, Jesus Christ, Son of Yours, who humbled Himself to become a participant in our frailty.

text: Deus qui humanam naturam supra primae originis praeparas dignitatem respice ad pietatis tuae ineffabile sacramentum ut quos regenerationis mysterio dignatus es innovare in his dona tuae perpetuae gratiae benedictionisque conserva.
translation_en: God, who prepared the dignity of human nature above the first origin, look upon Your ineffable sacrament of piety. May You who have deemed us worthy to be renewed by the mystery of regeneration, grant us Your perpetual grace and blessings, and conserve us.

text: Deus qui humani generis es et reparator et rector da quaesumus Ecclesiam tuam et nova prole semper augeri et devotione cunctorum crescere filiorum.
translation_en: God, who art of the human race, restorer and ruler, grant us that Your Church may always increase with a new offspring and grow in the devotion of all its children.

text: Deus qui humani generis fida societate laetaris da quaesumus ut et nos liberam praebeamus omnibus caritatem et illi non pro bonis mala reddere moliantur.
translation_en: God, who delights in the faithful society of the human race, we humbly ask that you provide us with the freedom to bestow love upon all, and may they not be led to return evil for good.

text: Deus qui humani generis ita es conditor ut sis etiam reformator propitiare populis adoptivis et novo testamento subolem novae prolis adscribe ut filii promissionis quod non potuerunt adsequi per naturam gaudeant se recepisse per gratiam.
translation_en: God, who has fashioned the human race in such a way that You are also its reformer, have mercy on the adoptive peoples and affix the offspring of the new testament to the new brood of the promise, so that the children of the covenant may rejoice because they have received through grace what they could not achieve by nature.

text: Deus qui humani generis miseratus miseriam in consolationem nostri operum tuorum magnalia extremis etiam temporibus innotescendo mirificas quo vitae nostrae durae fragilitas quae suorum meritorum non corrigitur plagis virtutum saltem provocetur exemplis respice tuorum supplicum vota quae tibi ob reverentiam cultoris tui nostri sine dubitatione patroni Aemiliani sanctissimi cordis persolvimus obsequela devoti. Da nobis Domine eodem patrocinante praesidium quo ille fultus et diabolum vicit et saeculum. Sit nobis apud te fidelissimus intercessor qui vitiorum omnium exstitit debellator. Interpellet pro miseris qui nunc sanctis laetatur cum angelis. Solvat vincula peccaminum qui iam tuae piae claritatis contemplatur adspectum.  Concede quaesumus hoc rogante misericors Deus puritatem mentibus et sanitatem corporibus; fidelibus custodiam et credendi non credentibus viam; sacerdotibus concordiam et clericis disciplinam; monachis perseverantiam et sacris virginibus sanctimoniam; viduis continentiam et cunctis communiter viventibus in religione cautelam. Sit vita principibus moderata et pax gentibus indisrupta; frugum omnium opulentia rerumque necessarium largitate copia. Et quia quantum nostra necessitas expetit tantum lingua prorogare non sufficit tu nostrorum cordium scrutator omnipotens Deus et conscientiarum investigabilis iudex omni condicioni sexui vel aetati ita commoda concede praesentia ut beatae vitae gaudia non deneges infinita.
translation_en:
God, who in compassion of the human race alleviated our misery into consolation even during the extremities of time by shining forth your great deeds, and who at least provoked virtue through your examples despite our hard and fragile life that is not corrected by its own merits, look upon the prayers of your supplicants with favor. We have faithfully fulfilled the vows we made to you, our devoted patron Saint Emilian, with the purest hearts. Give us, Lord, protection with him as he was filled and conquered the devil and the world. May he be our most faithful intercessor who became a destroyer of all vices. He pleads for the wretched who now rejoice with the angels in heaven. May he break the bonds of sins that are now contemplating your radiant appearance.
We humbly ask, merciful God, grant purity to our minds and health to our bodies; protect the faithful and provide a way for those who do not believe; give harmony to priests and discipline to clerics; persistence to monks and sanctity to sacred virgins; chastity to widows and caution to all who live in religion. May the life of princes be moderate, and peace undisturbed among nations; may there be abundance of all fruits and sufficient supply of necessary things.
And since our needs require more than our tongue can express, you, omnipotent God, scrutinizer of hearts and investigator of consciences, grant us the presence so that we may not be denied the joys of the blessed life, infinite.

text: Deus qui humani generis utramque substantiam praesentium munerum et alimento vegetas et renovas sacramento tribue quaesumus ut eorum et corporibus nostris subsidium non desit et mentibus.
translation_en: God who sustains and nourishes both substances of the human race with gifts and food, and renews them through the sacrament, we ask that You do not fail to provide support for them and us, and for our minds.

text: Deus qui humano generi ad imitandum humilitatis exemplum Salvatorem nostrum et carnem sumere et crucem subire fecisti concede propitius ut et patientiae eius habere documenta et resurrectionis eius consortia mereamur.
translation_en: God, who made our Savior to be imitated by the human race in humility, by taking flesh and bearing the cross, mercifully grant that we may receive the lessons of his patience and share in his resurrection.

text: Deus qui humano generi et salutis remedia et vitae aeternae munera contulisti conserva famulo tuo illi tuarum dona virtutum et concede ut medelam tuam non solum in corpore sed etiam in anima sentiat.
translation_en: God, who bestowed upon the human race salvation's remedies and eternal life's gifts, preserve your servant with the gifts of virtues, and grant that he may not only feel your medicine in his body but also in his soul.

text: Deus qui humanum genus a suo principe letaliter sauciatum Christi tui nativitate salvare dignaris praesta quaesumus ut non haereamus in perditionis auctorem sed ad redemptoris nostri consortia transferamur.
translation_en: God, who deems worthy to save the human race, which was mortally wounded by its own prince at Your Son's nativity, grant us our prayer. May we not be bound to the author of perdition but be transferred to the fellowship of our Redeemer.

text: Deus qui humanum genus principaliter sauciatum Christi tui nativitate salvare dignatus es praesta quaesumus ut non haereamus perditionis auctori sed ad redemptoris nostri consortia transferamur.
