translation_en: God, who deemed fit to save the human race primarily wounded by Your Son's nativity, grant us, we entreat You, that we may not cling to the author of perdition but be transferred to the company of our Redeemer.

text: Deus qui humanum genus tuorum retibus praeceptorum capere consuesti respice propitius ad tanti sollemnia piscatoris et tribue ut natalicio eius munere gratulantes aeternae vitae praemia consequamur.
translation_en: God who have accustomed Your people to take up the nets of Your precepts, look upon us graciously on this solemn day of the fisherman. Grant that by celebrating his birthday, we may obtain the rewards of eternal life as we congratulate him.

text: Deus qui hunc diem beati Albani martyrio consecrasti tribue quaesumus ut cuius annuo gratulamur officio eius continuo foveamur auxilio.
translation_en: God who consecrated this day of the blessed Alban through martyrdom, we ask that you grant us, whom we annually rejoice in his memory, to be continually warmed by his service, and strengthened by his aid.

text: Deus qui hunc diem beati apostoli tui Andreae martyrio consecrasti da nobis eius festivitate laetari ut apud misericordiam tuam et exemplis eius et meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God who on this day consecrated the feast of your apostle Saint Andrew through his martyrdom, grant us to rejoice in his festival so that we may be helped by your mercy and by his examples and merits.

text: Deus qui hunc diem beati Marci evangelistae et martyris tui gloriosae passionis famoso exigente tropheo sanguinis roseo consecrasti cruore perfusum praesta quaesumus ut ipse apud te pro nobis exsistat praecipuus suffragator qui unigeniti tui fieri meruit evangelicus praedicator.
translation_en: God who on this day consecrated the famous trophy of Saint Mark, your glorious martyr, bathed in rose-colored blood, we beseech you to grant that he may stand before you as our principal intercessor. He merited to become an evangelical preacher of your only-begotten Son.

text: Deus qui hunc diem beati Pantaleonis consecrasti martyrio praesta quaesumus ut ipsius interventu hoc in nostris floreat actibus quod praemiis remuneretur caelestibus.
translation_en: God, who consecrated this day of the blessed Pantaleon through martyrdom, grant us that through his intervention, it may flourish among our activities and be rewarded with heavenly rewards.

text: Deus qui hunc diem beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae toto orbe terrarum diffusae eorum semper magisterio gubernari per quos sumpsit religionis exordium.
translation_en: God, who consecrated this day of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul through their martyrdom, govern your Church throughout the world, which is spread far and wide, by them always. Through whom you took the beginning of religion.

text: Deus qui hodierna die beati apostoli tui Petri pontificium consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae toto orbe diffusae eius semper magisterio gubernari per quem sumpsit religionis exordium.
translation_en: God, who on this day consecrated the blessed apostle Peter as bishop, governs your Church throughout the world, spread far and wide, by his constant teaching through whom the origins of religion were taken up.

text: Deus qui hunc diem electionis gentium primitiis consecrasti et per luminis tui stellam manifestum te nobis ostendisti tribue quaesumus ut nova caelorum mirabilis claritas in nostris semper cordibus oriatur.
translation_en: God who on this day of the election of nations consecrated by the firstfruits, and through Your celestial star made Youself manifest to us, grant we beseech You, that a new marvelous brightness of heaven may always arise in our hearts.

text: Deus qui hunc diem incarnati Verbi tui transfiguratione tuaeque ad eum missa paternitatis voce consecrasti tribue quaesumus ut divinis pasti alimoniis in eius mereamur membra transferri qui haec in sui memoriam fieri praecepit.
translation_en: God, who on this day consecrated this day by the voice of paternal fatherhood when you transfigured yourself to the incarnate Word, grant us that we may be worthy to be transferred into his divine nourishment through his commands which he gave for remembrance.

text: Deus qui hunc diem nativitatis beati Ioannis Baptistae incomparabilis hominibus consecrasti praesta nobis de eius meritis illius nos calceamenti sequi vestigium <cuius se ad solvendam> corrigiam praedicavit indignum.
translation_en: God who on this day of the nativity of the blessed John the Baptist consecrated among men, grant to us through his merits that we may follow in his footsteps; whose self he declared unworthy to loosen the thong of.

text: Deus qui hunc diem ortu praeconis tui atque baptistae Ioannis consecrare dignatus es cum puerperium mater sterilis et vocem pater mutus accepit concede propitius ut illud quod Salvator noster gessit in Iordane mysterium hoc in omnibus catholicis semper celebretur ecclesiis.
translation_en: God who saw fit to consecrate this day, the dawn of your herald and John the Baptist, when the barren mother received your Son and the speechless father accepted your voice, grant us graciously that what our Savior performed in the Jordan mystery may always be celebrated in all Catholic churches.

text: Deus qui hunc diem praeconis tui honorabilem nobis in Ioannis nativitate fecisti ut gratiae tuae operante virtute praecursor tuus <quo inter natos mulierum nullus maior orire>tur da populo tuo scientiam spiritalium gaudiorum et omnium fidelium mentes dirige in viam salutis et pacis ut quae manifestavit testificatio nuntii impleat praesentia nuntiati.
translation_en: God who made this day honorable for your herald among us on the birth of John, that your grace may operate through his virtue that your precursor, who was greater than any born among women (Matthew 11:11), may bring knowledge of spiritual joys to your people. And guide all faithful minds into the way of salvation and peace, so that the testimony of the messenger may be fulfilled in the presence of those announced.

text: Deus qui hunc diem sacratissimum per incarnationem Verbi tui et partum Mariae virginis consecrasti da populis tuis in hac celebritate consortium ut qui tua gratia sunt redempti tua sint protectione securi.
translation_en: God who sanctified this most sacred day through the incarnation of your Word and the birth of Mary, the virgin, grant to your people in this festivity a share in communion, so that those who are redeemed by your grace may be secure under your protection.

text: Deus qui hunc diem sanctissimum <beati> illius confessoris tui translatione decorasti fac nos eius meritis in sanctorum tuorum societatem transferri.
translation_en: God who adorned this day most holy by the translation of your blessed confessioner, make us to be transferred into the society of your saints through his merits.

text: Gratias agimus inenarrabili pietati
translation_en: We give thanks to an inexpressible kindness

text: Deus qui hunc praeclarum ac venerabilem diem beati Genesii martyris tui sollemnitate devotissime celebrari tribuisti praesta plebi tuae ut ipso intercedente patrono ab omnibus mereamur adversitatibus liberari.
translation_en: God who graciously granted this illustrious and venerable day of the holy martyr Genesis to be celebrated with most devotion, grant to your people that through his intercession as our patron, we may deserve to be freed from all adversities.

text: Deus qui hunc sacrosanctum diem pro festivitate beati Vigilii martyris tui atque pontificis sollemniter nobis celebrandum contulisti da quaesumus supplicibus tuis ut meritis eius defensi et ab omnibus vitae huius liberemur adversis et aeternae vitae praemia consequamur.
translation_en: God, who has granted us to solemnly celebrate this most sacred day in honor of the festival of your martyr and bishop St. Vigilius, we humbly ask that you grant us through his merits, so that we may be freed from all adversities of this life and attain the rewards of eternal life.

text: Gratias tibi agimus Domine custodisti per diem
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord, you have kept us through the day

text: Deus qui id quod per infantiam videtur exiguum magnum facis esse per merita qui primordia adventus tui triumphis glorificas parvulorum prius eos passionis martyrio quam aetatis provehis incremento – felix mors eorum et beatificanda condicio per quam eis contigit ut saevitiam crudelissimi Herodis devincerent triumphando et Christum mererentur in praemio – da huic populo tuo nomini consecrato per consimilis gratiae admirationem meritorum similium dignitatem ut qui hanc sanctorum infantium festivitatem pro honore nominis tui celebrant ad ipsorum infantium beatitudinem profectu fidei semper adscendant.
translation_en: God, who makes the small seem great through merits, who glorifies the beginnings of your advent with triumphs for the little ones, before they are grown in age - happy is their death and a blessed condition that enabled them to conquer the cruelty of Herod by triumphing, and to deserve Christ as their reward - grant this people, dedicated to your name by similar grace, a worthy status in likeness of these meritorious saints, so that those who celebrate the feast of the holy infant martyrs for the honor of your name may always be drawn towards the blessedness of these infants through faith.

text: Deus qui idem ipse es cuiusque anni non deficient praebe nobis ita hunc annum cum placita tibi servitutis devotione transigere qualiter et substantiis non privemur et divinis obsequiis devotione optabili obsequamur.
translation_en: God who are yourself of whom no year lacks, grant to us that we may complete this year according to your will with the devoted service of each day; and that we may not be deprived of suitable substance and serve you with devout obedience in a manner worthy of divine service.

text: Gratias tibi agimus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui nos de transacto noctis ...
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord holy Father almighty eternal God, who brought us through the passing night ...

text: Deus qui ieiunantium humilitate placaris et humiliantium se tibi precibus libenter inflecteris exaudi quaesumus preces nostras et diversorum turbinum quibus quatimur tempestate discussa pacem nobis tuae serenitatis infunde ut quam peccatorum nostrorum nimietate perdidimus tuae pietatis indulgentia consequamur.
translation_en: God who pleases those who fast with humility and bends easily to the prayers of the humble, hear our prayers we entreat. And grant us peace from the various storms that assail us, infuse into us the peace of your serenity, so that we may attain the mercy of your forgiveness for our great sins.

text: Deus qui ieiunium corporale sanctificas quando salutarem continentiam donas possibilitatem nobis tribue continendi ne remaneamus in caenoso voluptatum gurgite suffocati. Nihil apud tuam bonitatem priora delicta praevaleant ut saluti animarum ieiunia cottidiana proficiant et sanctae visitationis benedictionem nostra holocausta suscipiant.
translation_en: God, who sanctifies corporal fasting, grant us the ability to continue in the salutary state of self-restraint. May we not remain suffocated in the murky depths of carnal pleasures. Let no previous sins prevail before your goodness so that daily fasting may benefit our souls and may our holocaust receive the blessing of the holy visitation.

text: Deus qui illuminas omnem hominem venientem in hunc mundum illumina quaesumus cor nostrum gratiae tuae splendore ut digne maiestati tuae cogitare et diligere valeamus.
translation_en: God who enlightens every man coming into this world, we beseech you to enlighten our hearts with the splendor of your grace, that we may be able to think and love worthily of your majesty.

text: Deus qui imminentem Ninivitis interitum sola misericordia removisti quibus ut misericors exsisteres conversionis paenitentiam praestitisti respice quaesumus populum tuum ante conspectum misericordiae tuae prostratum ut quos unigeniti tui sanguine redemisti non patiaris propter misericordiam tuam mortalitatis interire supplicio.
translation_en: God, who removed the impending destruction of Nineveh only by your mercy, to whom you showed compassion in return for penitence during conversion, look upon us, we implore, your people prostrate before your merciful gaze. May you not allow those whom your unique Son's blood has redeemed to perish because of your mercy, to suffer mortality.

text: Deus qui in altis habitas et humilia respicis da restaurationem defunctis et resurgentibus in te largire pietatem specialiter pro famulo tuo illo quem in pacem assumere dignatus es; da ut quia in te renovatus de hoc mundo migravit mors in eo secunda penitus non habeat potestatem.
translation_en: God who dwells in high places and looks upon the humble, grant restoration to the departed and those rising in you. Bestow particularly on your servant whom you have deemed worthy to take into peace; let him, renewed in you, depart from this world without death having any power over him whatsoever.

text: Deus qui in ara crucis unius veri sacrificii Christi domini corporali immolatione totius mundi delicta purgasti et humano generi redemptionis gratiam contulisti quaesumus ut nos ipsius redemptionis participes efficere digneris.
translation_en: God, who through the bodily immolation on the cross of one true sacrifice of Christ our Lord purged the world's sins and bestowed upon the human race the grace of redemption, we humbly ask that you deign to make us partakers of His redemption.

text: Deus qui in aula virginali beatae Mariae habitare voluisti nec tamen forma nostrae mortalitatis iura minuisti aeternae deitatis concede propitius ut eius precibus adiuvemur cuius commemoratione laetamur.
translation_en: God who willed to dwell in the virgin's chamber of blessed Mary, yet did not diminish the rights of our mortal nature before eternal deity, grant us graciously so that we may be aided by his prayers, whose remembrance we rejoice in.

text: Deus qui in auxilium generis humani caelestia simul et terrena dispensas in inferiori mundi parte laborantes supernorum nos quaesumus praesidiis refove propitius ministrorum.
translation_en: God, who dispenses both heavenly and earthly aid to the human race, we humbly ask that you refresh us with your protection in the lower part of the world where we labor. We beseech you favorably to support us through your ministers.

text: Deus qui in beati confessoris tui Benedicti vita laudabili speculum nobis conversationis ac normam rectitudinis ostendisti concede propitius ut et praeclaris exemplis eius ad iustitiam informemur et sanctissimis meritis ac precibus ad caelestis regni gaudia perducamur.
translation_en: God, who in the life of your blessed confessor Benedict showed us a praiseworthy mirror of conduct and a norm of righteousness, grant us graciously that we may be formed to justice by his distinguished examples, and led to the joys of the celestial kingdom by his most holy merits and prayers.

text: Deus qui in beati Donati episcopi et martyris tui manibus poculi fragmenta restaurare dignatus es munera plebis tuae propitiatus intende ut eius nobis fiat supplicatio salutaris pro cuius sollemnitate hodiernam diem celebramus.
translation_en: God, who in the hands of your blessed bishop and martyr Donatus saw fit to restore fragments of a cup, graciously propitiated, direct that his supplication may become a healing for us on whose solemnity we celebrate this day.

text: Deus qui in beati Donati martyris tui atque pontificis manibus poculi fragmenta restaurare dignatus es supplicantium preces benignus exaudi ut quod fiducia non habet meritorum eius nobis intercessione donetur.
translation_en: God, who deigned to restore the fragments of the cup in the hands of your blessed martyr Donatus and bishop, listen kindly to the prayers of supplicants. Grant that what we do not have faith in the merits of his intercession may be given to us.

text: Deus qui in Christi domini Filii tui passione et resurrectione redemptionem et salutem humani generis contulisti da nobis quaesumus ut in eadem redemptione et salute mereamur habere consortium.
translation_en: God, who in the passion and resurrection of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, bestowed redemption and salvation upon the human race, grant us we pray, that we may deserve to have a share in that same redemption and salvation.

text: Deus qui in condicione humani generis feminam ex masculo creans unitatem carnis atque dulcedinis ex ipsa formatione inter eos esse constituisti ad hoc votivum sacrificium propitiatus attende et famulos tuos illos qui coniugali copulandi sunt foedere unito vinculo dilectionis adstringe ut pacem ad invicem servent foedus coniugale non violent fructificent caritate sicque eos in tuo timore conserves ut nos quoque in tua dilectione multiplices.
translation_en: God, who in the condition of the human race created woman from man, uniting flesh and sweetness between them through their very formation, you have established them to be united in this votive sacrifice. Attend propitiously and bind together your servants who are joined by the marriage bond with a bond of love, that they may keep peace with each other and that the marriage bond not be broken by violence. May they bear fruit in charity and may you conserve them in your fear so that we too may be multiplied in your love.

text: Deus qui in corde mulieris Samaritanae spiritum tuae sanctificationis dedisti quo te crederet quo te inspirata sentiret quo etiam posset tuae maiestatis potentiam fideli intentione narrare emitte spiritum tuum de sanctis caelis tuis quo sanctificentur oblata suscipiantur vota expientur delicta et cunctis ex hoc sumentibus donetur criminum indulgentia atque aeternae promissionis gaudia sempiterna.
translation_en: God, who in the heart of the Samaritan woman gave your spirit of sanctification, by which she believed, was inspired to feel, and even could narrate faithfully your majesty's power, send your spirit from your holy heavens, that they may be sanctified, receive offerings, have their sins forgiven, and be given the joy of eternal promises to all who partake in this.

text: Deus qui in deserti regione multitudinem populi tua virtute satiasti in huius quoque saeculi transeuntis excursu victum nobis spiritalem ne deficiamus impende.
translation_en: God, who in the wilderness region satisfied the multitude of your people with your power, grant us also in this age a spiritual food lest we fail.

text: Deus qui in dilectione etiam neglegentium servulorum dignationem piae institutionis assumens dum nobis nos proficere studes tibi obtemperare consuescis variae doctrinae formas exemplis congruis temperando in quibus diversos rerum exitus misericordiam tuam iramque significans sicut pro archangeli deiectione contristas ita pro meretricis as?sumptione confortas; sicut pro discipuli amissione terrificas ita pro latronis commotione sublimas... Dum ille aequalitatem iactat supercilio haec pietatem captat unguento et ita fit ut ille lapsum habeat ista suggestum. Dum aurum pascitur electus Deum fatetur appensus; unus ad paradisum venit alter ad laqueum ut nec elatio efferat servientem nec desperatio obruat peccatorem.  Unde hoc sensibus nostris Domine provide; etiam clementer indulge ne nos immensum criminum pondus superbiae massa avaritiae igne conflantis datos in desperationis praecipitium laqueus male cupiditatis appendat sed potius cruci tuae mortificata saecularitate confixi te qui caput nostrum es suavitate confessionis atque operis delibato in tuorum praeceptorum perfectione maculas nostras humilitatis fletibus abluentes infidelitatis vestigia sparsis fidei crinibus abstergamus sic hac sacri corporis communione vel sanguinis habituri remedium non reatum.
translation_en: God, who even in the love of the neglectful servants assumes dignity through the pious institution, as you are accustomed to adapt various forms of teaching with fitting examples, tempering them so as to signify your mercy and wrath in different outcomes - just as you console for the fall of an archangel, so you comfort for the assumption of a prostitute; just as you terrify for the loss of a disciple, so you exalt for the disturbance of a thief... While he boasts about equality with a raised eyebrow, this piety is captured by a sweet ointment and thus it happens that he who falls has suggestions given to him. While gold is nourished and a chosen one confesses to being fastened, one comes to paradise while another is led to a snare so neither exaltation carries away the servant nor despair overwhelms the sinner... Therefore, Lord, provide our senses; even gently indulge, lest the immense weight of sin, flaming with pride and greed, binds us in the pit of desperation and the hooks of evil desire entangle us. Instead, may we be fixed on your cross by the mortification of worldly things, who is able to clean our head with the sweetness of confession and devotion, washing away the stains of our sins with tears of humility, removing the footprints of unfaithfulness with the hairs of faith, so that by partaking in this holy communion or blood we may find a remedy not for guilt.

text: Deus qui in diversis nationum populis praeclaros verae fidei constituisti doctores concede quaesumus ut omnes qui sanctissimi Augustini confessoris tui atque pontificis implorant auxilium praesentis prosperitatis gaudium et futurae beatitudinis gloriam consequantur.
translation_en: God who in diverse nations established distinguished teachers of true faith, we humbly ask that all who seek aid from your confessor and bishop St. Augustine, may enjoy the joy of the present prosperity and attain the glory of future beatitude.

text: Deus qui in electis tuis exstinxisti funditus mortem cum mortem te inferni pronuntias esse illos solum ex averni claustris erueris quos tuos in fide et actibus recognoveris da praesenti christiano conventui resurrectionis tuae sollemnitate ovanti legis tuae praeceptis inviolabiliter inhaerere et indesinenter aestu tuae dulcedinis anhelare ut semper nos tuos operarios ipse cognoscas et aeternis poenis solutos secundae resurrectionis felicitate sustollas quo praesenti sacrificio et resurrectionis tuae gaudia celebrantibus se nobis maiestas tua invisa visibilem praebeat et defunctorum spiritibus ad requiem se ostendat.
translation_en: God, who in your chosen ones have utterly destroyed death along with the death that you pronounce to be theirs alone, you will rescue from the bars of hell those whom you recognize in faith and deeds. Grant that this present Christian community may unwaveringly adhere to your precepts of the resurrection and be forever inspired by the heat of your sweetness, so that always we, your workers, may ourselves be known by you and lifted up from eternal punishments by the happiness of the second resurrection. May your majesty make itself visible to us in its displeasure with this present sacrifice and in the resurrection's joy, and may it show itself to the spirits of the dead as a path to peace.

text: Deus qui in Filii tui humilitate iacentem mundum erexisti laetitiam concede fidelibus tuis ut quos perpetuae mortis eripuisti casibus gaudiis facias sempiternis perfrui.
translation_en: God, who raised the world with joy in the humility of your Son, grant joy to your faithful so that those whom you have rescued from eternal death by chance, may ever enjoy it.

text: Deus qui in Filii tui oboedientia nobis contulisti humilitatis exempla concede propitius ut illam cordibus nostris dignetur infundere quam in suo opere dignatus est demonstrare atque ad illum humilitate redeamus a quo superbiendo discessimus.
translation_en: God, who in the obedience of your Son has given us examples of humility, grant us graciously that it may be worthy to pour into our hearts what was worthy for him to demonstrate in his work. May we return to him from whom we departed in pride.

text: Haec est generatio rectorum
translation_en: This is the generation of the rulers

text: Deus qui in oblationibus supplicantium non rei quantitatem existimas sed fidei affectum quaerendo non pretium compensas non speciem quae offertur sed credulitatem <eorum> qui offerunt intendis magis accipiens in humili spiritu parva de modicis quam in arroganti magna de maximis... Horum Domine conscii supplicamus ut haec offerentium nomina liber vitae aeternae in qualibet sui parte scriptura contineat ut qui principales cum sanctis martyribus palmas non meremur saltem vel in posterioribus subiungamur quia apud te Domine multae sunt misericordiae multae gratiae multaeque sunt mansiones in quarum quantulacumque parte simus vel infimi dummodo non simus penitus alieni.
translation_en:
God, who does not consider the quantity of offerings in supplication but seeks the affection of faith, does not compensate with payment or appreciate the form that is offered, but rather the faith of those who offer. You are more inclined to accept small gifts from humble spirits than grand ones from arrogant ones...
In recognition of this, Lord, we humbly pray that the names of these offering individuals may be contained in any part of the scripture which grants eternal life, so that we may deserve at least to be added among the martyrs in the future or, at the very least, not be separated from them. For there are many mercies, many graces and many mansions, whereever we may be, as long as we are not completely alienated from them.

text: Deus qui in omni loco dominationis tuae totus assistis et totus operaris accepta sacrificium nomini tuo benignus oblatum et huius domus cuius es fundator esto protector ut in virtute Spiritus Sancti fiat hic semper servientium etiam tibi devota libertas.
translation_en: God who in every place of your dominion assists wholly and works, accepting the sacrifice offered to your name benevolently, let him be the protector of this house which you are the founder, that here there may always be a devoted freedom to serving you in the power of the Holy Spirit.

text: Deus qui in praeclara salutiferae crucis inventione passionis tuae miracula suscitasti concede ut vitalis ligni pretio aeternae vitae suffragia consequamur.
translation_en: God who in the glorious finding of the life-giving cross raised miracles during your Passion, grant that we may obtain through the price of the living tree the intercessions for eternal life.

text: Deus qui in praeclari sideris sancti pontificis Ethelwoldi episcopi illustratione novam populis Anglorum tribuisti lucem hodierna die clarescere tuam suppliciter imploramus clementiam ut cuius magisterio totius religionis documenta cognovimus illius et exemplis informemur et patrociniis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who on the day of the shining star, the saintly pontiff and bishop Ethelwold, granted a new light to the English people, we humbly beseech Your clemency. May we learn the teachings of Your whole religion through his instruction, be instructed by his examples, and be supported by his patronage.

text: Deus qui in sanctis habitas et pia corda non deseris libera nos a terrenis desideriis et cupiditate carnali ut nullo in nobis regnante peccato tibi soli domino liberis mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: God who dwells in the saints and does not forsake the pious hearts, free us from terrestrial desires and carnal lust, that no sin may reign in us; but that we may serve you alone, Lord, with minds made free.

text: Deus qui in sanctis habitas et pia corda non deseris suscipe propitius orationem nostram et tribue misericordiam tuam ut te custode servati ab omnibus vitae huius periculis liberemur.
translation_en: God who dwells in saints and does not abandon pious hearts, graciously receive our prayer and grant your mercy, that we may be freed from all perils of this life with you as our protector.

text: Deus qui in sanctis tuis vehementer glorificaris quorum apud te semper manet nova et perpetua festivitas supplicationem nostram et hostias quas in honorem et venerationem Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctorumque apostolorum martyrum consessorum ac virginum omniumque electorum tuorum tuae devoto obsequio deferimus pietati clemens et benignus suscipe et concede propitius ut qui eorum merita recolimus interventu quoque illorum et absolutionem omnium peccatorum et beatitudinem percipere mereamur aeternorum gaudiorum.
translation_en: God, who are greatly glorified in your saints, whose perpetual festivity remains with you forever. We present our supplication and the offerings we bring in honor and veneration of God the Mother of Mary, the apostles, martyrs, consecrated persons, virgins, and all your elect, with our devout obedience. Gracious and benevolent one, receive them kindly and grant them graciously, favorably, that we who remember their merits may also experience their intercession and absolution from all sins, and merit to perceive beatitude in eternal joys.

text: Deus qui in sanctorum tuorum cordibus sancti caloris tui ignem succendens usque ad martyrii eos gloriosa certamina sustulisti ut in supplicio constituti persecutores suos te vincente despicerent poenas te confortante contemnerent praemia te remunerante perciperent in gloria per illorum te Domine triumphum deprecamur ut nobis remissionem tribuas peccatorum.
translation_en: God, who kindled the holy fire of your spirit within the hearts of your saints, lifting them up to the glorious battles of martyrdom, that, being set upon the torture, their persecutors might scorn punishment, spurn rewards and receive penalties with contempt, while you were victorious; that, rewarding them, they might attain glory through you – we humbly pray, Lord, that you grant us remission of sins.

text: Deus qui in sanctorum tuorum es virtute laudabilis quique sancto confessori tuo Mauro talem oboedientiae gratiam largiri dignatus es ut beatissimi patris nostri Benedicti imperio Placidum puerum gurgite abstractum redderet terris concede nobis famulis tuis ipsius festa devotis animis celebrantibus ipso interveniente a peccatorum nostrorum profunditate eripi et gaudiis patriae caelestis adiungi.
translation_en: God, who is worthy of praise in the power of your saints, especially Saint Maurice, to whom you graciously granted such obedience that you returned Placidus, a boy drawn from his mother's breast, to the earth. Grant us, your faithful servants, that we may celebrate this festival with devoted spirits, and through his intervention free ourselves from the depth of our sins and be joined in the joys of the heavenly homeland.

text: Deus qui in sanctorum tuorum meritis semper es mirabilis quaesumus clementiam tuam ut sicut beato illi confessori tuo atque abbati eminentem gloriam contulisti sic ad consequendam misericordiam tuam eius nos facias precibus adiuvari.
translation_en: God, who are always marvelous in the merits of your saints, we humbly ask for your clemency. As you bestowed great glory upon that blessed confessor and abbot of yours, may you also help us to attain your mercy through his prayers.

text: Deus qui in sollemnitate paschali mundo remedia contulisti populum tuum quaesumus caelesti dono prosequere ut et perfectam libertatem consequi mereatur et ad vitam proficiat sempiternam.
translation_en: God who on the solemnity of Easter provided remedies to the world for your people, we humbly ask that you follow with a heavenly gift, so that they may deserve perfect freedom and progress towards eternal life.

text: Deus qui in unigenito tuo novam creaturam nos tibi esse fecisti respice propitius in opera misericordiae tuae et in adventu Filii tui ab omnibus nos maculis vetustatis emunda.
translation_en: God, who in your unique Son have made us a new creation to be yours, look upon us graciously in the work of your mercy and on the coming of your Son cleanse us from all stains of the old age.

text: Deus qui inaestimabili misericordia animas mortalium ab angustiis transfers ad requiem propitiare supplicantibus nobis animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum quarumque memoriam specialitatis affectu agimus et quorum quarumque nomina a te inspicienda conscripsimus et pro quibus exorare iussi aut debitores fuimus et omnium consanguineorum ac familiarium cunctorumque fidelium ut eos paradiso restituens non sinas excruciari tormentis quos benigni Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi pretioso redemisti sanguine.
translation_en: God, who transfers the souls of mortals from anxieties to rest with inestimable mercy, have mercy on our souls, the servants and servants of yours whom we remember with special affection and whose names we have written down for you to inspect, and for whom we have been commanded to pray or who are debtors to us, and all of our kinsmen, relatives, and faithful followers. Do not allow them to be tortured with the torments which your benevolent Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, redeemed with his precious blood.

text: Deus qui inaestimabili misericordia animas mortalium ab angustiis transfers ad requiem propitiare supplicationibus nostris pro anima famuli tui quem tibi specialitatis affectu commendamus ut eum paradiso restituens non sinas excruciari tormentis quem benignissimi Filii tui Domini nostri pretioso sanguine redemisti.
translation_en: God, who in immeasurable mercy transfers the souls of mortals from afflictions to rest, propitiate our supplications for the soul of your servant whom we commend to you with special affection, that you may restore him to paradise and not allow him to be tormented; whom the most benevolent Son of yours, our Lord, redeemed with precious blood.

text: Deus qui inaestimabili misericordia animas mortalium ab angustiis transfers ad requiem propitiare supplicationibus nostris pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum quarumque commemorationem speciali devotione agimus et pro quibus orare iussi et debitores sumus et omnium benefactorum nostrorum necnon consanguineorum ac familiarium nostrorum cunctorumque fidelium ut eas paradiso restituens in tuorum censeas sorte iustorum.
translation_en: God, who transfers the souls of mortals from the anxieties to peace in your immeasurable mercy, grant our petitions for the souls of your servants and theirs whom we commemorate with special devotion. For those whom we are commanded to pray and for whose sake we are debtors, as well as for all benefactors, kin, family, and faithful of every kind, restore them in your just company to paradise.

text: Deus qui ineffabilibus mundum renovas sacramentis praesta quaesumus ut Ecclesia tua et aeternis proficiat institutis et temporalibus non destituatur auxiliis.
translation_en: God who renews the world ineffably through sacred mysteries, grant us that your Church may progress by eternal institutions and not be lacking in temporal assistance.

text: Deus qui infideles deseris et iuste indevotis irasceris populum tuum quaesumus converte propitius ut qui te per duritiam irreligiosae mentis semper offendunt ad sanctorum beneficia promerenda tuae miserationis gratia inspirante convertas.
translation_en: God who forsakes the unfaithful and justly angers at the undevoted, we humbly ask that you turn towards us graciously. May you who are constantly offended by their hardness of irreligious minds through your grace inspire them to turn towards the benefits of the saints.

text: Deus qui infirmitatis nostrae factus es particeps fac nos tui regni esse consortes ut quibus participari voluisti assumendo hominem participium conferas gloriae tuae.
translation_en: God, who became a participant in our weakness, make us to be partners of your kingdom, so that you, who willed to participate in humans by assuming man, may grant us participation in your glory.

text: Deus qui intemperantiam saturitatis tuae abstinentiae dedicatione superasti et puritatem castimoniae ut cognoscaris dedisti serenus nos tuo vultu circumspice et ieiunantibus pacem proximi et tuam largiaris quam ad patrem adscendens nobis reliquisti sectandam.
translation_en: God, who surpassed intemperance of satiety through your dedication to abstinence, and who gave us the understanding of purity through chastity, look down upon us with a serene countenance. Regard peacefully upon those fasting, and grant what you left for us as we ascend to you. We are left to follow that which you have bequeathed to our father.

text: Deus qui inter apostolicos ecclesiae doctores sanctum Aldelmum confessorem tuum atque pontificem caelesti splendore fecisti lucere annue quaesumus ut sicut in eo formam salutis agnovimus sic eius vestigiis inhaerere studeamus.
translation_en: God, who among the apostolic teachers of the Church made your confessor and bishop Saint Aldhelm shine with celestial splendor, we humbly ask that you grant us to recognize in him the form of salvation as we strive to follow in his footsteps.

text: Deus qui inter apostolicos sacerdotes famulum tuum illum fecisti vigere pontificem praesta quaesumus ut eorum perpetua quoque sede potiatur.
translation_en: God, who made your servant among the apostolic priests to be a bishop, we ask that you grant him also the ability to hold the eternal seat with them.

text: Deus qui inter apostolicos sacerdotes famulum tuum illum pontificali fecisti dignitate vigere praesta quaesumus ut eorum quoque perpetuo aggregetur consortio.
translation_en: God, who made your servant shine among the apostolic priests through the dignity of the pontificate, grant us that he may also be joined to their eternal fellowship.

text: Deus qui inter apostolicos sacerdotes famulum tuum illum censeri fecisti praesta quaesumus ut quorum vicem gerebat ad horam in terris eorum perpetuo consortio laetetur in caelis.
translation_en: God who among the apostolic priests made your servant to be censored, grant us we pray, that those whom he used to serve on earth may rejoice forever in their company in heaven.

text: Deus qui inter caelestia luminaria praeclarum sacerdotem Iudocum excellenter rutilare fecisti concede ut per tanti patris festa temporalia splendida supernorum consequamur collegia.
translation_en: God who made the priest Judocum shining brightly among celestial lights, grant that we may attain the splendid gatherings of heaven through the festivals of such a great father.

text: Haec studiose praescripta
translation_en: These are diligently prescribed

text: Deus qui inter cetera potentiae tuae miracula etiam in fragili sexu victoriam castitatis et martyrii contulisti da quaesumus ut beatae et sanctae virginis martyrisque tuae illius adiuvemur meritis cuius beatitudinis irradiamur exemplis.
translation_en: God, who among other miracles bestowed victory in chastity and martyrdom even upon the fragile sex, grant us that we may be helped by the merits of your blessed and holy virgin and martyr, whose radiance of beatitude we are inspired by through examples.

text: Deus qui inter cetera potentiae tuae miracula etiam in sexu fragili victoriam martyrii contulisti concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus per eius ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God, who among other miracles bestowed victory even in the weak sex of martyrdom, grant us graciously that we may merit whose natalicia (feast days) we celebrate through his examples to you.

text: Deus qui inter innumera gratiae tuae dona etiam in sexu femineo tua operaris miracula concede propitius ut beatae Waldpurgae virginis tuae apud misericordiam tuam patrocinia sentiamus cuius non solum castitatis illustramur exemplis verum etiam miraculorum gloria iucundamur.
translation_en: God, who works miracles among your innumerable gifts even in the female sex, grant your favor that we may feel the patronage of your blessed virgin Walpurga at your mercy, whose examples not only enlighten us in chastity but also delight us with the glory of miracles.

text: Deus qui invisibili rore caelesti ad beatae Austrebertae virginis oboedientiam ardentem clibanum exstinxisti praesta quaesumus ut eius meritis gloriosis vitiorum incendia non Dominentur in nobis.
translation_en: God who extinguished the fiery cauldron burning with invisible celestial dew through the obedience of Blessed Austreberta the virgin, grant us that we may not be ruled by the fires of vices through her glorious merits.

text: Deus qui invisibiliter omnia contines et tamen pro salute generis humani signa tuae potentiae visibiliter ostendis templum hoc potentia tuae inhabitationis illustra ut omnes qui huc deprecaturi conveniunt ex quacumque tribulatione ad te clamaverint consolationis tuae beneficia consequantur.
translation_en: God who invisibly encompasses all things and yet openly shows your power through the signs of this temple, illuminate it with the power of your presence. May all those who gather here from any tribulation cry out to you for help, find the benefits of your consolation.

text: Deus qui iubar aethereum antistitem Swithunum moderno tempore dignatus es mundo revelare suppliciter tuam imploramus omnipotentiam quatenus per gloriosa ipsius sancti merita quem facis coruscare signis miraculorum praebeas nobis te supplicantibus famulis omnium incrementa virtutum et sempiternae felicitatis tripudium.
translation_en: God, who in heavenly glory revealed the bishop Swithun to the modern world, we humbly beseech your almightiness. Grant us through the glorious merits of this saint that you make us shine with the signs of miracles. Provide us, your supplicating servants, with all increases of virtues and eternal happiness.

text: Deus qui iusta postulantes exaudis qui si qua in nobis bona sunt opera et ipse insinuas et insinuata consummas quaesumus ut et cor nostrum ad expugnandas dilates passiones sensusque nostros ad impugnationum certamina superanda confortes ut dum digne vitiis nostris irascimur pietatis tuae veniam consequamur.
translation_en: God who hears those seeking justice, who if there are any good works in us, you bring about and complete them, we ask that you stretch our heart to overcome its passions and strengthen our senses for the battles to be fought, so that while we righteously anger at our vices, we may obtain forgiveness through your mercy.

text: Deus qui iuste corrigis et clementer ignoscis et non vis invenire quod damnes sed potius quod corones qui etiam peccantium non mortem sed vitam magis desideras me miserum fragilemque peccatorem sordibus delictorum plenum a tua pietate non repellas neque respicias ad peccata et scelera et immunditias turpesque cogitationes meas quibus tuae misericordiae dulcedinem merito mihi in amaritudinem converti peccatorum sed ad immensas misericordias tuas quibus gratuito subvenire consuesti precorque humiliter ut immemor sis peccatorum meorum et memor misericordiarum tuarum vota precesque meas clementer suscipias tibique placita mihi postulare concedas collegioque sanctorum tuorum qui in hoc ministerio tibi placuerunt me adscisci digneris atque per eorum exempla facias tibi semper placere et ad te cum fideli grege tuo pervenire.
translation_en: God, who justly corrects and gently forgives, and does not wish to find what to condemn but rather what to crown, even of sinners, who desires not death but life more for me, the wretched and sinful sinner, full of the dirt of sins, do not push away from your pity, nor look at my sins and crimes and filthy thoughts, by which the sweetness of your mercy is rightly turned into bitterness of sins, but rather to your immeasurable mercies, to which you are accustomed to help freely, I humbly pray that you forget my sins and remember your mercies, receive my prayers and petitions kindly, and grant me what pleases you. I ask you to consider me worthy to be joined with the college of your saints, who have pleased you in this ministry, and through their examples, may you always please to me and bring me with your faithful flock.

text: Deus qui iuste irasceris et clementer ignoscis afflicti populi lacrimas respice et iram tuae indignationis quam iuste meremur propitiatus averte.
translation_en: God, who righteously are angry and mercifully forgive, regard the tears of the afflicted people and turn away Your wrath that we justly deserve. Be appeased.

text: Deus qui iustificas impium et non vis mortem peccatorum maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecamur ut famulum tuum illum de tua misericordia confidentem caelesti protegas benignus auxilio et assidua protectione conserves ut tibi iugiter famuletur et nullis temptationibus a te separetur.
translation_en: God, who justifies the unjust and does not wish the death of sinners, we humbly pray that you protect your servant from your mercy confident and bless him with kind aid and constant protection. May you conserve him so that he may always serve you and never be separated from you by any temptations.

text: Deus qui iustitiae vindex et pastor pius redemptarum ovium cognosceris esse propitiatus in hac sollemnitate tuorum infantium Iusti et Pastoris oblationes populi suscipe offerentis; Iusti tui precibus respice miseros et Pastoris suffragio consolare defunctos quo iustitia pastoris summi concreta clementiae et caelesti pascat alimonia quos creavit et pietate iustificet quos redemit.
translation_en: God who is the avenger of justice and the shepherd of pity for the redeemed sheep, you will know to be appeased in this solemnity of your just and pastor's offerings, accept the offering of the people presenting; may your just prayers look upon the miserable and, through the intercession of the shepherd, comfort the deceased. May the justice of the shepherd, consolidated by his mercy, and celestial nourishment feed those whom he created and justify those whom he redeemed with piety.

text: Deus qui iustitiam diligis et <cuius> aequitatem desiderat vultus {tuus} concede propitius nobis beati Iusti martyris tui sic iuste vivere meritis et exemplis ut opibus iustitiae intenti ad iustorum gloriam veniamus.
translation_en: God who loves justice and desires the countenance of equity, graciously grant us to live justly by the merits and examples of your blessed Just martyr, that we, with intentions focused on justice, may come to the glory of the righteous through forgiveness.

text: Deus qui iustitiam diligis et iniusta condemnas da nobis quaesumus et amare quae recta sunt et perversa vitare.
translation_en: God who loves justice and condemns the unjust, grant us, we ask, to love what is right and avoid what is wrong.

text: Deus qui iustitiam legis in cordibus credentium digito tuo scribis quique in Paulo hodierna die vocationis eius de caelis non atramento sed spiritu tuo vivo caritatis tuae fervorem ita scribis ut proprium quassandum corpus pro Ecclesiae tuae tradat membris qui ipsius ecclesiae olim contriverat membra sic nobis ipsius interventu doctoris et fidelis magistri fraternae caritatis sincerae consortium dona et de tuae dilectionis quam ille habuit multiplicae flamma vel unam scintillam dignare largiri ut sequamur per dilectionem ferventem magistrum cuius flagrantia in caritate frequentamus praecepta.
translation_en: God who writes the justice of the law in the hearts of believers with your finger, you wrote on this day of Paul's calling from heaven not with ink but with the living spirit of your love. You wrote such fervor that his own body was shaken for the members of your church which he himself once prepared. Through the intervention of our teacher and faithful master of brotherly charity, grant us a sincere fellowship and deign to bestow upon us either multiple flames or one spark of the love that Paul had, so that we may follow with fervent love the precepts of our master whose burning passion for charity we frequently encounter.

text: Deus qui iustitiam tuae legis in cordibus credentium digito tuo scribis da nobis fidei et spei caritatisque augmentum et ut mereamur assequi quod promittis fac nos amare quod praecipis.
translation_en: God, who writes the justice of your law in the hearts of believers with your finger, grant us an increase of faith and hope, and charity, and that we may deserve to obtain what you promise. Make us love what you command.

text: Deus qui laboribus hominum etiam de mutis animalibus solatia subrogasti supplices te rogamus ut sine quibus non alitur humana condicio nostris facias usibus non perire.
translation_en: God who provides comfort to humans in their labors, even from mute animals, have mercy on our humble pleas. We ask that you do not let the essentials for human life perish in our use.

text: Deus qui largifluae bonitatis consilio Ecclesiam tuam beati Edmundi confessoris tui atque pontificis praeclarae vitae meritis decorasti et gloriosis laetificasti miraculis concede propitius nobis famulis tuis ut et ipsius in melius reformemur exemplis et ab omnibus eius patrocinio protegamur adversis.
translation_en: God, who adorned and glorified Your Church by the merits of the blessed Edmund, your confessor and bishop of renowned life, through the abundance of Your goodness, grant us favorably, your servants, that we may be reformed for the better by his examples, and protected from all adversities by his patronage.

text: Deus qui laticum instar gelidorum plumbi ardorem mutasti ne gloriosi martyris tui Victoris corpus exureret tribue quaesumus ut ipso pro nobis interveniente a praesentibus liberemur periculis et futuris.
translation_en: God, who changed the heat of lead-like coldness to warmth for your glorious martyr Victor, we ask that you grant him so that, with his intervention, we may be freed from present dangers and future ones.

text: Deus qui legalium differentias hostiarum unius sacrificii perfectione sanxisti accipe sacrificium a devotis tibi famulis et pari benedictione sicut munera Abel sanctifica ut quod singuli obtulerunt ad maiestatis tuae honorem cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: God, who through the perfection of offerings distinguished the types of sacrifices for the legal, accept the offering from your devoted servants, and bless it equally, as the gifts of Abel were sanctified. May what each one has offered for the honor of your majesty profit all towards salvation.

text: Deus qui legalium differentias hostiarum unius sacrificii perfectione sanxisti accipe quaeso meae servitutis munus oblatum et pari benedictione sicut munera Abel sanctifica ut per hoc quod ad maiestatis tuae honorem detuli et praesentis vitae meae delictis exui iubeas et futurae.
translation_en: God who by the perfection of one sacrifice sanctified the differences of legal offerings, I humbly ask that You receive the offering presented by my service. May it be blessed equally, just as the offerings of Abel were sanctified. Through this, grant me to lay before Your majesty and cleanse me from the sins of this present life, and teach me also for the future.

text: Deus qui licet salutem hominum semper opereris nunc tamen populum tuum gratia abundantiore laetificas respice propitius ad electionem tuam ut paternae protectionis auxilium et regenerandos muniat et renatos.
translation_en: God who always work the salvation of mankind, now yet more abundantly delight your people. Look upon us graciously at your election, that the aid of parental protection and those to be renewed may be protected and those reborn.

text: Deus qui licet sis magnus in magnis mirabilia tamen gloriosius operaris in minimis concede mihi indigno famulo tuo sacris convenienter servire mysteriis atque in omnibus tua misericordia protegat quem conscientiae reatus accusat.
translation_en: God, who though great, work miracles even more gloriously in small things, grant to me, an unworthy servant, fittingly to serve the sacred mysteries and may Your mercy protect me in all things, whom conscience's guilt accuses.

text: Deus qui licet sis magnus in magnis mirabilia tamen gloriosius operaris in minimis da nobis quaesumus in eorum celebritate gaudere qui filio tuo domino nostro testimonium praebuerunt etiam non loquentes.
translation_en: God, who though great in great miracles, yet work more gloriously in small things, grant us we ask, to rejoice in their festival who have given testimony to your Son, our Lord, even those who have not spoken.

text: Deus qui licet universum genus humanum caelesti lege disponas ecclesiam tamen tuam speciali dispositione moderaris et dignum tibi nos exhibere ministerium concede propitius et dignos per tuam gratiam ministros offerre.
translation_en: God, who arranges the entire human race according to celestial law, yet governs your church by a special disposition, grant us graciously the ministry that is fitting to you, and may you be pleased to offer worthy ministers through your grace.

text: Deus qui ligandi solvendique licentiam tuis apostolis contulisti da quaesumus ut per ipsos a terrenis vitiis expediti liberi possimus caelestibus interesse mysteriis.
translation_en: God who gave the power to bind and loosen to your apostles, we humbly ask that through them, we may be freed from earthly vices so that we can participate in heavenly mysteries.

text: Deus qui loca nomini tuo dicata sanctificas effunde super hanc orationis domum gratiam tuam ut ab omnibus hic invocantibus te auxilium tuae misericordiae sentiatur.
translation_en: God who sanctifies places dedicated to Your name, pour Your grace upon this house of prayer, that all those here invoking You may feel Your help through Your mercy.

text: Deus qui loca nomini tuo dicata sanctificas et benedictionibus tuis dicanda praecedis praesta quaesumus ut quod beato apostolo tuo illi et sanctis martyribus illis famulus tuus ille in hoc aedificio deputavit digno praeparetur officio.
translation_en: God who sanctifies places dedicated to Your name and preceeds things to be consecrated with Your blessings, grant us that the servant of Your blessed apostle, who assigned this building to him and the holy martyrs there, may be prepared worthy for the office here.

text: Deus qui magis circumcisionem cordis quam corporis diligis et non admittis inductam per litteram praeputii circumcisionem sed fidei innixam cum bono opere caritatem tu nostras aures deseca ne audiant sanguinem corda ne teneant dolum oculos ne invadant alienum tu in manibus succide quod polluit in pedibus quod ad malum currit in praeputiis quod carnalia concupiscit tu incide quod laniat praecide quod vulnerat abscide quod lacerat excide quod scandala incrementat ut amputato facinore sola in nobis valeat caritas propagari.
translation_en: God who loves circumcision of the heart more than the body and does not admit the one induced by the letter of the prepuce's circumcision, but fastened by faith and good works, cut off our ears so that they do not hear blood, harden our hearts so that they do not hold deceit, blind our eyes so that they do not invade another's, in your hands slay what pollutes, in our feet remove what runs to evil, in our prepuciums cut out what carnally desires, lop off what tears, sever what wounds, pull out what lacerates, excise what scandals increase, so that with the criminal removed, love alone may flourish in us.

text: Deus qui magna nimis et de parvis miranda potenter operaris misericordiae tuae dona in me placatus exsequere ut ubi nulla conscientiae meae te digna sunt merita sola pietatis tuae semper clara sit gratia.
translation_en: God, who work wonders beyond measure both in great and small matters, grant that I may be pleasing to You. May Your mercy be performed in me, so that where no merits of my conscience are worthy, Your grace alone may always shine brightly through sheer pity.

text: Deus qui magnum salutare dedisti nobis hodie in beati Genesii martyris tui festivitate praesta quaesumus ut et conversationis eius imitemur exempla et fidem congrua devotione sectemur.
translation_en: God, who today bestowed upon us a great salvation on the feast of your martyr Genesis, we humbly ask that you grant us to imitate the examples of his conduct and follow his faithful devotion with fitting dedication.

text: Deus qui martyrem tuum Felicem ab imis fluctibus submersum ad littora reduxisti nos quoque famulos tuos ab imis vitiorum ereptos virtutum moribus precamur aptari.
translation_en: God, who brought your martyr Felicitas from the deep waters to the shore, we also pray as your servants, that we who have been plucked from the depths of sins, may be molded by the habits of virtues.

text: Deus qui martyrem tuum Stephanum per apostolorum tuorum impositionem manuum dignum fecisti esse ministrum tu per fusionem gratiae spiritalis oblatum tibi hoc nostrum sanctifica holocaustum ut ex eo sumentes illo dono spiritus impleamur quo Stephanus tuus plenus et signa ostendebat in populum et disputantium contra se revincebat conventum.
translation_en: God, who made your martyr Stephen worthy to serve as a minister through the laying on of the hands of your apostles, and who offered him to you through the fusion of spiritual grace, sanctify this our holocaust. May we partake of it and be filled with the gift of the Spirit, by which your Stephen, full and displaying signs, confronted the people and refuted those disputing against him.

text: Deus qui martyres tuos praemio passionis remunerare consuevisti ita ut devictis persecutoribus coronam martyrii consequantur praesta quaesumus ut beatus sacerdos et martyr tuus Xystus cuius festivitatem colimus tuam pro nobis indulgentiam semper exoret.
translation_en: God who have been accustomed to reward your martyrs with the prize of passion, so that they follow the conquest of their persecutors with a crown of martyrdom, grant us, we ask, that our blessed priest and martyr Saint Xystus, whose feast day we celebrate, may always intercede for us before you.

text: Deus qui martyrio innocentium parvulorum triumphalem hunc diem esse fecisti et exempla ad augendam Ecclesiae tuae fidem proficientibus tribuere dignatus es dum beatissimi infantes illi etiam passionem pro te hodie prompte vicerunt da huic populo tuo nomini consecrato per consimilis gratiae admirationem meritorum similium dignitatem ut qui hanc sanctorum infantium festivitatem pro honore nominis tui celebrant ad ipsorum infantium beatitudinem profectu fidei et pacis semper adscendant.
translation_en: God who made this day a triumphal one by the martyrdom of the innocent children, and graciously bestowed examples to increase the faith of your Church; since those blessed infants also conquered their passion today for you, grant to this people consecrated by your name, through the admiration of similar merits, a dignity that those who celebrate this feast of the holy infant saints may continually advance towards the beatitude of these infants, in faith and peace.

text: Deus qui martyrum tuorum corpora unius gloriae remuneratione indivise fruentia divisis in regionibus locaris et Servandum Auditani situi donas et Germanum Emeritensium civibus commodas praesta nobis ut gratiae tuae luce illuminati et corporaliter divisi unitatem retentemus dulcedinis et collecti in unum redundemus munere caritatis.
translation_en: God, who rewards the bodies of your martyrs with one glory scattered throughout different regions, grant to Servandus and Auditane their respective situations and to the citizens of Emerita grant comfort. May we, enlightened by your grace, retain unity in our divided condition, and being gathered together, may we return as a single offering of charity.

text: Deus qui me indignum sacris mysteriis corporis et sanguinis Filii tui Domini nostri confortare dignatus es te suppliciter deprecor ut non sit ad iudicium animae meae; praesta quaeso Domine indulgentiam mihi peccatori quam mea non exigunt merita; porrige manum lapso et aperi mihi ianuam regni tui per quam possim ingredi in requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: God, who deemed it fitting to strengthen the unworthy me with the sacred mysteries of the body and blood of your Son, our Lord, I humbly beseech you that my soul may not come to judgment; grant, I pray, Lord, mercy to the sinner such as my merits do not demand; stretch out your hand to the fallen one and open for me the gateway to your kingdom through which I may enter into eternal rest.

text: Deus qui mediante beata virgine Maria mundo succurristi perdito ipsius gloriosis meritis et precibus intervenientibus concede placatus ut ab Ecclesiae tuae regno omnium scandalorum perturbatione remota in tua semper pace tibi debite famuletur.
translation_en: God, who came to the aid of the world through the blessed virgin Mary, redeeming it with her glorious merits and interceding prayers, grant us your favor, we pray, that, freed from all scandal's disturbance within Your Church, may we ever serve You in peace as is our due.

text: Deus qui mentis puritatem approbas non ieiunium a cibis solummodo gloriam humanam captans dignare oculos cordis nostri in hoc ieiunio ita illuminare introrsum ut tibi in his quae homines nesciunt in occulto a vitiis ieiunio placeamus; quia doni tui est hoc ipsum quod a cibis abstinemus sit muneris tui ut a peccatis etiam cum ieiunio emundemur et desiderabili fonte ubertatis ita haec munera imbre Sancti Spiritus perfunde ut a ieiunantibus percepta cuncta vitia mundent et virtutes inserant morum.
translation_en: God, who approves the purity of mind, not only fasting for human glory but also enlighten our heart's sight in this fast, so that in things which men do not know in secret, we may please you through penance; because it is your gift itself that we abstain from food, let it be a tribute to your majesty, so that we may be cleansed from sins even while fasting. Let these gifts, like the rain of the Holy Spirit, be poured out upon us, so that all our vices may be purified and virtues inserted into our character.

text: Deus qui mirabili dispensatione priscorum patrum glorificatione mundum coruscare sanxisti concede propitius ut qui beati Eliae praecursoris tui suffragium poscimus aeternitatis compendium interventu eius assequi gaudeamus.
translation_en: God, who in the wondrous dispensation of the ancient fathers caused the world to shine with glory, graciously grant that we may obtain the eternal reward through the intercession of your forerunner, the blessed Elijah, and rejoice in his intervention.

text: Deus qui mirabilis es in sanctis tuis cuius cultui deputatur quidquid amicis tuis honoris impenditur intenta oratione te poscimus ut hunc diem quem sancti et incomparabilis viri Martini illustrat excessio prosperum nobis et posteris in rebus nationum propitiatus indulgeas tribuasque ut cuius veneratores sumus imitatores effici mereamur.  Hunc etiam virum quem caelicolis adnumerandum martyribus aggregatum aetatis nostrae tempora protulerunt iubeas auxilium nostris ferre temporibus. Dubium enim non est quin sit martyr in caelo qui fuit confessor in saeculo cum sciatur non Martinum martyrio sed martyrium defuisse Martino.  Oramus te Domine ut qui tantum potuit tuis aequare virtutibus ut vitam mortuis redderet dignetur etiam defunctorum spiritus consolare ac viventes in tribulatione defendere qui potens fuit mortuos suscitare.
translation_en:
God who is wonderful in your saints, to whom any honor given by your friends is devoted with focused prayer, we humbly ask that you graciously grant us on this day, illuminated by the departure of the holy and incomparable man Martin, prosperity for ourselves and our posterity. May you be inclined to bestow indulgence and also grant that we, who are your worshippers, may become imitators worthy of him.
We also ask that you command aid for our times for this man whom our times have brought forth among the celestial martyrs. There is no doubt that he is a martyr in heaven, who was a confessor on earth, since it is known that Martin was not martyred but rather martyrdom befell Martin.
Lord, we pray that you, who were able to equal your virtues with such greatness, may deign to comfort the spirits of the dead and defend the living in tribulation, for you had the power to raise the dead.

text: Deus qui mirificis virtutum tuarum signis salutis nostrae initia declarasti qui magis stella praefulgente degressis adorare et promereri te regem aeternum dominumque perpetuum mysticis muneribus praestitisti qui in corpore nostro mirabili baptismi sacramento regeneratus ex spiritu nos abluis renascendo et ineffabili potentiae dono hodie aquas in vina mutando discipulis tuis tuam manifestasti divinitatem exaudi nos supplices tuos ob diem sacratissimae sollemnitatis et praesta ut gloria tua illuminati saeculo moriamur <et> tibi regi Christo vivamus.
translation_en: God, who through the wonders of your virtues declared the beginnings of our salvation, you who, more brightly than a shining star, descended to adore and to praise the eternal king and everlasting Lord with mystical gifts. You who in our marvelous baptismal sacrament regenerated us from spirit and washed us anew, granting us an ineffable gift, today you changed water into wine for your disciples, thus revealing your divinity. Hear us humbly on this most sacred day and grant that we may die to the world but live for you, King Christ.

text: Deus qui miro ordine angelorum ministeria hominumque dispensas concede propitius ut quibus tibi ministrantibus in caelo semper assistitur ab his in terra nostra vita muniatur.
translation_en: God, who miraculously orders the ministries of angels and men, grant us graciously that those who serve you in heaven may ever assist us. May our life on earth be fortified by them.

text: Deus qui miro ordine omnium dignitatum omniumque regnorum iura dispensas concede propitius ut famulus tuus ille cum populo sibi subiecto tota tibi semper devotione famuletur quatenus invincibili potentiae tuae dono iugiter defendi mereatur.
translation_en: God, who dispenses the dignity of all and the rights of all kingdoms in a marvelous order, graciously grant that your servant may forever serve with the people subject to him, always devoted to you. May he deserve perpetually to be defended by the invincible power of yours.

text: Deus qui miro ordine universa disponis et ineffabiliter gubernas praesta quaesumus ut famulus tuus ille haec in praesenti conventu et in huius saeculi cursu te adiuvante peragat et peragenda decernat unde tibi in perpetuum placere valeat.
translation_en: God, who arranges all things in a wondrous order and governs them ineffably, grant us, we pray, that your servant may accomplish and determine these matters in the present assembly and in the course of this age with your help, so that what is done and to be done may please you forever.

text: Deus qui misericordia tua praevenis non petentes da nobis affectum maiestatem tuam iugiter deprecandi ut pietate perpetua supplicibus potiora dependas.
translation_en: God, who Your mercy precedes even those who do not ask, grant us the desire to constantly approach Your majesty, that we may continually depend on You with perpetual pity as suppliants.

text: Deus qui misericordiae ianuam fidelibus patere voluisti respice in nos et miserere nostri ut qui voluntatis tuae viam donante te sequimur a vitae numquam semitis deviemus.
translation_en: God, who willed to open the door of mercy to the faithful, look upon us and have mercy on us, that we who give thanks for your way may not depart from the paths of life.

text: Deus qui misericordiae tuae potenti auxilio et prospera tribuis et adversa depellis universa obstacula quae servis tuis adversantur expugna ut remoto terrore bellorum et libertas secura et religio sit quieta.
translation_en: God who grant aid with the powerful mercy of yours and provide prosperity while repelling adversities, removing all obstacles that oppose your servants. Overcome so that after the terror of wars has been removed, peace and secure freedom, and a tranquil religion be established.

text: Deus qui misericordiae tuae potenti auxilio et prospera tribuis et adversa depellis universa obstacula quae famulo tuo illi adversantur expugna ut remotis temptationibus universis indefessa te gratiarum actione laudemus.
translation_en: God who by the power of your mercy grant prosperity and drive away adversities, removing all obstacles that confront your servant. May you conquer so that, having overcome all temptations without ceasing, we may unceasingly praise you in grateful thanks.

text: Deus qui misisti Filium tuum et ostendisti creaturae creatorem respice propitius super nos famulos tuos et praepara hagiae sophiae dignam in cordibus nostris habitationem.
translation_en: God who sent your Son and showed the creation its Creator, look upon us, your servants, graciously, and prepare a worthy dwelling for holy wisdom in our hearts.

text: Deus qui multiplicas Ecclesiam tuam in subole renascentium fac eam gaudere propitius de suorum profectibus filiorum.
translation_en: God who multiplyest Thy Church in the sprout of the reborn, make her rejoice graciously through the progress of Thy children.

text: Deus qui multiplicas subolem renascentium fac eos gaudere propitius de suorum venia peccatorum.
translation_en: God, who multiplyest the offspring of the renewed, make them rejoice graciously through your mercy from their own sins.

text: Deus qui multis ostendisti mirabilius sanctum Swithunum pontificem tibi esse pretiosum ipsius nobis praesta suffragia et concede ut non ad poenas inferni sed ad coronam deputemur caelestem qui huius patronis nos committimus patrociniis.
translation_en: God who have shown yourself more wonderfully to many as the holy Bishop Swithun to be precious to you, grant us his intercession and concede that we may not be assigned to the punishments of hell but rather to the celestial crown, who to this patron we commit ourselves to his protection.

text: Deus qui multitudinem gentium beati Pauli apostoli praedicatione docuisti da nobis quaesumus ut cuius natalicia colimus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God who taught the multitude of nations through the preaching of blessed Paul, the apostle, grant us that we may feel his patronage as we celebrate his natal day among you.

text: Deus qui multitudinem populorum beati Bonifatii pontificis atque martyris instantia ad agnitionem tui sancti nominis vocare dignatus es concede propitius ut cuius sollemnia colimus etiam patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who deemed it fitting to call the multitude of the people of blessed Pope and Martyr Boniface to the recognition of your holy name, graciously grant that we may feel their patronage as we celebrate their solemnity.

text: Deus qui mysteriorum tuorum dignanter operaris effectus praesta quaesumus ut sacris apta muneribus fiant nostra servitia.
translation_en: God, who worthy works in your mysteries, grant us that our service may be fitting for the sacred offices.

text: Deus qui nativitatis tuae exordium pro nostra necessarium salvatione duxisti respice nos propitius et quos similes ad imaginem tuam fecisti similiores observatione perfice mandatorum.
translation_en: God, who led the beginning of your nativity for our necessary salvation, look upon us kindly. And you who made us similar to your image, make us more like in observance of your commandments.

text: Deus qui nec Ecclesiae tuae usque ad consummationem te saeculi defuturum nec inferni portas apostolicae confessioni praevalituras esse promisisti in nostra quoque perfice propitius infirmitate virtutem et divinae pollicitationis effectum dum etiam infirmis tuis inesse dignaris ostende quia praesentiam tuam sine dubitatione sentimus cum et singulis quibusque temporibus convenienter aptanda dispensas et nos a totius adversitatis incursu perpeti protectione custodis.
translation_en: God, who have promised that neither your Church shall lack you until the consummation of this age nor the gates of hell prevail against the apostolic confession, grant us graciously to complete our weakness with power and fulfill the effect of your divine promise, even as you deign to dwell among your weak. Show us, Lord, that we undoubtedly feel your presence, for you appropriately dispense yourself with every appropriate time, and protect us from the onslaught of all adversity.

text: Deus qui neminem in te sperantem nimium affligi permittis sed pium precibus praestas auditum pro postulationibus nostris votisque susceptis gratias agimus te piissime deprecantes ut per haec quae sumpsimus a cunctis eripi mereamur adversis.
translation_en: God, who allows no one hoping in you to be afflicted excessively, but grants hearing to pious prayers on our behalf for our petitions and accepted vows, we most graciously beseech you that through what we have received from all, we may deserve to be freed from adversities.

text: Deus qui neophytos tuos maiori animarum quam vestium nitore vestisti ut plus acciperent quam habere se noverint praesta ut sicut donum tuum eorum intellectum exsuperat ita in eis ultra aetatem fides cum intellegentia placitis tibi operibus coalescat. Nobis quoque per mortem Iesu Christi Filii tui pacis dona largire et veniam culparum attribue.
translation_en: God, who clothed your neophytes with a greater splendor of soul than of vestments, so that they might receive more than they knew they possessed, grant that in them faith may grow beyond age, mingling with understanding in pleasing works to you. Also for us, through the death of Jesus Christ Your Son, bestow the gifts of peace and attribute forgiveness for our sins.

text: Deus qui Ninivitis pro peccatis suis ieiunantibus pepercisti te supplices deprecamur ut et nobis in hoc ieiunio nostrorum indulgentiam per solitam misericordiam largiaris.
translation_en: God, who pardoned the people of Nineveh for their sins while they were fasting, we humbly beseech you to grant us mercy in this time of our fasting and to bestow upon us forgiveness through your usual kindness.

text: Deus qui nobilissimum regem Edwardum necis interitu contemptibilissimae martyrizari permisisti quo eum sublimiter ad regnum perduceres caeleste praesta quaesumus ut eiusdem sancti martyris suffragantibus meritis a cunctis muniamur adversis.
translation_en: God, who allowed the noble king Edward to be martyred in such a contemptible manner, may You grant through Your heavenly power that we are protected from all dangers by the merits of his holy martyrdom.

text: Deus qui nobis ad celebrandum paschale sacramentum liberiores animos praestitisti doce nos et metuere quo(d) irasceris et amare quod praecipis.
translation_en: God who has given us a freer spirit for the celebration of the Paschal sacrament, teach us to fear what you are angry about and to love what you command.

text: Deus qui nobis ad relevandos istius vitae labores diversa donorum tuorum solatia et gaudia contulisti quibus insignes annuis recursibus dies agimus et Ecclesiae tuae vota sollemnia praesenti festivitate celebramus...  Unde et proxime natalem domini Salvatoris peregimus qui nobis natus in tempore est qui de te natus sine tempore omnium saeculorum et temporum est antecessor et conditor.  Deinde subsecutum diem circumcisionis octavum unigeniti luce signatum pari observantia recolentes sacrificiis sollemnibus honoravimus.  Nunc epiphaniae diem revelantem in homine divinitatem excolimus diversa Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui in hoc mundo suum adventum manifestantia insignia praedicantes;  sive quod stellam ortus sui nuntiam misit e caelo quam stupentibus magis usque ad cunabula suae carnalis infantiae praeviam fecit;  sive quod aquas baptismate suo ad omnium gentium lavationem Iordanis alveum sanctificaturus intravit ubi ipsum esse filium unigenitum dilectum tuum spiritu columbae specie advolante monstrasti et paterna insuper voce docuisti;  sive quod primum in Cana Galilaeae prodidit signum cum in convivio nuptiali aquas in vinum convertit alto et admirabili sacramento docens quod a saeculis sponsae sibi iungendus ecclesiae advenerat et ad vinum prudentiae spiritalis saporis fidem veritatis esse mutandam.  Itaque ex his tribus mirabilium tuorum causis fide hodiernae sollemnitatis edita Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus nihilominus tuae virtus operationis et nostrae salutis praeparatio est. Propterea Domine secundum haec tria magna mirabilia maneat in nobis gratiae spiritalis integritas; sapiat in cordibus nostris vinum prudentiae; fulgeat in operibus
translation_en:
God who for our lifting up of the labors of this life has bestowed upon us diverse consolations and joys through your gifts, which we celebrate each year with solemn vows and in the presence of this feast day we celebrate the vows of your Church... Therefore, we are now approaching the birth of our Lord Savior, who was born for us in time, who, born from you, is before all ages and times, a precursor and creator.
Then on the eighth day after his birth, we honored the day of circumcision with solemn sacrifices, remembering it with equal devotion.
Now, we celebrate the day of Epiphany revealing divinity in man, we exalt various manifestations of our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, in this world, his coming. We proclaim his signs: whether he sent a star from heaven to announce his birth, which he made known even before his physical infancy in the manger; or whether, baptized by John in the Jordan River, you showed him as your beloved Son when a dove appeared in the form of a spirit, and taught us with a fatherly voice; or whether it was the first sign he performed in Cana of Galilee when, at a wedding feast, he turned water into wine, teaching us with an astonishing and wonderful sacrament that the Church, pledged to unite with herself, had come, and that faith should be changed into the taste of spiritual wisdom.
Therefore, our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, is prepared for us by your power and operation, and for our salvation. Therefore, Lord, may spiritual integrity remain in us because of these three great miracles; let the wine of prudence flavor our hearts; let our works shine.

text: Deus qui no(bi)s beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli natalicia gloriosa praeire concedis tribue quaesumus eorum nos semper et beneficiis praeveniri et orationibus adiuvari.
translation_en: God who knows the glorious birthdays of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, we humbly ask that you may always precede us with their benefits and assist us with their prayers.

text: Deus qui nobis nati Salvatoris diem celebrare concedis octavum fac quaesumus nos eius perpetua divinitate muniri cuius sumus carnali commercio reparati.
translation_en: God, who grants us the day to celebrate the birth of our Savior, grant us, we ask, that we may be enriched by his eternal divinity, whose bodies we have been restored through earthly commerce.

text: Deus qui nobis per beatum Hieronymum confessorem sacerdotemque tuum scripturae sanctae veritatem et mystica sacramenta revelare dignatus es praesta quaesumus ut cuius natalicia colimus eius semper et erudiamur doctrinis et meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who deigned to reveal the truth and mysteries of your sacred scripture to us through the blessed Jerome, confessor and priest, we humbly ask that you grant us. May we always celebrate his natal feast, and may we be ever taught by his doctrines and aided by his merits.

text: Deus qui nobis per beatum Nicolaum confessorem tuum sacerdotemque novarum virtutum gloriosa miracula operari dignatus es praesta quaesumus ut qui eius natalicia colimus eius semper meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God who was pleased to operate through your blessed Nicholas, our confessor and priest, the glorious miracles of new virtues, grant us, we beseech you, that we who celebrate his natal day may always be helped by his merits.

text: Deus qui nobis per ministerium beati Marci evangelistae et martyris tui veritatem evangelii patefieri voluisti concede quaesumus ut quod ab illius ore didicimus gratia tua adiuti operari valeamus.
