translation_en: God, who willed through the ministry of the blessed Marc, the evangelist and martyr, to reveal the truth of the gospel to us, we humbly ask that what we have learned from his mouth, aided by your grace, may we be able to put into practice.

text: Deus qui nobis per prophetiam praecursoris tui Ioannis obumbratarum significationum figuras aperta veritatis tuae manifestatione monstrasti tribue nobis intellegentiae lumen et pacis perpetuae caritatem ut gratia succedente pro gratia sic gloriemur in novis ut in caritatis unitate constituti non abutamur antiquis.
translation_en: God, who through the prophecy of your forerunner John, revealed to us the figures of hidden meanings by the manifestation of your truth, grant us the light of understanding and perpetual charity of peace. So that, with grace following grace, we may glory in the new as we are established in the unity of love, not straying from the old.

text: Deus qui nobis per singulos annos huius sancti templi tui consecrationis reparas diem et sacris semper mysteriis repraesentas incolumes exaudi preces populi tui et praesta ut quisquis hoc templum beneficia petiturus ingreditur cuncta se impetrasse laetetur.
translation_en: God, who for us renews the day of the consecration of this your holy temple every year and continually presents sacred mysteries to us in safety, hear the prayers of your people and grant that whoever enters this temple seeking blessings may rejoice that they have obtained all they sought.

text: Deus qui nobis salutarem hodierna die in beati Lamperti martyris tui atque pontificis festivitate dedisti laetitiam praesta quaesumus ut et conversationis eius experiamur insignia et intercessione eius placita tibi mente iugiter famulemur.
translation_en: God, who on this day bestowed joy upon us in the festival of Your martyr and bishop Lampert, grant us, we beseech You, that we may experience the signs of his way of life and constantly serve You with a mind mindful of his intercession.

text: Deus qui nobis sanctum pontificem Athelwoldum salutis aeternae doctorem tribuisti concede propitius ut cuius annua translationis sollemnia colimus eius semper meritis adiuvemur et precibus.
translation_en: God, who granted us the holy pontiff Athelwold as a teacher of eternal salvation, grant us your blessings propitiously, so that we who celebrate his annual feast day may always be helped by his merits and prayers.

text: Deus qui nobis sub sacramento mirabili passionis tuae memoriam reliquisti tribue quaesumus ita nos corporis et sanguinis tui sacra mysteria venerari ut redemptionis tuae fructum in nobis iugiter sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who left us the memory of your miraculous passion under the sacred mystery, grant us that we may continually feel the fruits of your redemption and reverence the holy sacraments of your body and blood.

text: Deus qui non despicis corde contritos et afflictos miseriis populum tuum ieiunii ad te devotione clamantem propitiatus exaudi ut quos humiliavit adversitas attollat reparationis tuae prosperitas.
translation_en: God who does not despise hearts that are contrite and afflicted, hearing the prayers of your people during their fasting, grant them your favor so that you may lift up those whom adversity has humbled through the prosperity of your restoration.

text: Deus qui non despicis contritos corde et afflictos miseriis populum tuum ieiunii ad te devotione clamantem propitiatus exaudi ut quos humiliavit adversitas attollat tuae reparationis prosperitas.
translation_en: God, who does not despise those with a contrite heart and the afflicted people of yours who are fasting, calling upon you in devotion, be propitiated to hear, so that whom adversity has humbled, your restoration's prosperity may raise up.

text: Deus qui non mortem sed paenitentiam desideras peccatorum populum tuum quaesumus ad te converte propitius ut dum tibi devotus exstiterit iracundiae flagella amoveas.
translation_en: God who desires not death but penitence for your sinful people, we humbly ask that you turn to us graciously, so that while devoted to you, the strokes of your anger may be removed.

text: Deus qui non propriis suffragantibus meritis sed sola ineffabili gratiae largitate me familiae tuae praeesse iussisti tribue tibi digne persolvere ministerium sacerdotalis officii et ecclesiasticis convenienter servire ministeriis plebemque commissam te in omnibus protegente gubernare concede.
translation_en: God, who have commanded that you should preside over your family not by merits of our own but by the ineffable bounty of Your grace, grant us worthily to fulfill the ministry of the priestly office and to serve appropriately the ecclesiastical ministries. Grant that we may govern the people entrusted to us and protect them in all things.

text: Deus qui non tantum nos a carnalibus cibis sed ab ipsius animae noxiis delectationibus praecipis ieiunare sic nobis quaesumus indulgentiae tuae praebe subsidium ut ieiunando ab illicitis contagiis ad superna crescamus et nomina quae recitata sunt in caelesti pagina conscribi praecipias.
translation_en: God who not only commands us to abstain from carnal foods but also from the harmful pleasures of our souls, grant us the support of your indulgence so that we may grow towards higher things by fasting and be commanded to have our names written on the heavenly page as those recited.

text: Deus qui non ultione sed satisfactione delectaris exaudi preces quas tuae pietati pro adversariis nostris fundimus ut tuo timore compuncti quos contristant sua laetificando correctione malitiae poenam effugiant.
translation_en: God, who delights not in vengeance but in satisfaction, hear our prayers which we pour out for our adversaries to you, that those who are brought low by your fear may escape the punishment of wickedness through being comforted by a correction of their wrongdoing.

text: Deus qui nos a delictorum facinoribus castigas nostrorum tuorum participatione sacramentorum expias praesta quaesumus ut beati Gregorii meritis et a cunctis vitiorum adversitatibus eruamur et caelestis vitae consortia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God, who corrects us from the crimes of our deeds and expiates us through participation in your sacraments, grant us that we may be freed by the merits of blessed Gregory and be delivered from all adversities of vices, and may deserve the consortia of heavenly life.

text: Deus qui nos a delictorum contagiis tuorum expias perceptione sacramentorum praesta quaesumus ut beati Swithuni confessoris tui atque pontificis meritis a cunctis eruamur adversis et caelestis vitae deliciis perfruamur.
translation_en: God, who cleanses us from the contagion of your sins through the perception of sacraments, we humbly ask that through the merits of your blessed confessor and bishop Swithun, we may be freed from all adversities and enjoy the delights of celestial life.

text: Deus qui nos famulos tuos a peccatorum contagiis per receptionem sacramentorum tuorum laetificas tribue quaesumus ut intercessione beatissimi confessoris tui Dubricii atque pontificis a cunctis adversitatibus quibus incessanter impugnamur eruamur et caelestibus gaudiis perfruamur.
translation_en: God who delights us, your servants, through the reception of your sacraments, grant that we ask, that we may be freed from all adversities with which we are constantly beset by the intercession of your most blessed confessor Dubricius and bishop, and may enjoy the celestial joys.

text: Deus qui nos delictorum nostrorum facinoribus castigas tuorum sacramentorum participatione expias praesta quaesumus ut meritis beati Vigilii martyris tui atque pontificis a cunctis vitiorum adversitatibus eruamur et caelestis vitae consortia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God, who chastises us for our sins through the deeds of your sacraments, grant that we ask, you expunge us with the merits of your martyr and bishop, Blessed Vigilius, and deliver us from all adversities of vices. May we deserve to attain the companionship of celestial life.

text: Deus qui nos a saeculi vanitate conversos ad supernae vocationis bravium accendis pectoribus nostris purificandis illabere et gratiam nobis qua in te perseveremus infunde ut protectionis tuae muniti praesidio quod te donante promisimus impleamus ut nostrae professionis exsecutores effecti ad ea quae perseverantibus in te dignatus es promittere pertingamus.
translation_en: God, who turns us away from the vanity of the world and kindles in our hearts a desire for higher vocation to purify us, pour out Your grace upon us so that we may fulfill the promises we made under Your protection. Protected by Your arm, as we have promised, let us complete what is due to us as executors of our profession. May we reach those things which You graciously promised to those who persevere in You.

text: Deus qui nos ad anniversarium diem (consecrationis) huius ecclesiae tribuisti venire concede quaesumus ut quidquid in tuo nomine petituri intraverimus sanctorum tuorum precibus imploremus.
translation_en: God who granted us to come on the anniversary day (of the consecration) of this church, we humbly ask that you grant us that whatever we may enter seeking in Your name, we may pray for through the intercession of Your saints.

text: His expletis procedat
translation_en: May it proceed after these have been fulfilled

text: Deus qui (nos) ad celebrandum beatae Fidis virginis et martyris tuae triumphum venerabilem tuorum excitas corda fidelium da ut quam sollemni veneramur officio eius continuo foveamur auxilio.
translation_en: God, who stirs the faithful hearts to celebrate the worthy triumph of your blessed servant and martyr Fides, grant that we may continually be nourished by her solemn office through your aid.

text: Deus qui nos ad imaginem tuam et sacramentis renovas et praeceptis perfice gressus nostros in semitis tuis ut caritatis donum quod fecisti a nobis sperari per haec quae offerimus facias sacrificia apprehendi.
translation_en: God, who renews us in your image and sanctifies us through your sacraments and commands, make our steps firm on your paths so that the gift of love which you have made us to hope for may be fulfilled through these offerings. Make these sacrifices to be received by You.

text: Deus qui nos ad imaginem tuam et sacramentis renovas et praeceptis supplicum preces et munera benignus accepta ut quod fiducia non habet meritorum placationes obtineant hostiarum.
translation_en: God who renews us in Your image through the sacraments and accepts with benevolence the prayers and offerings of the penitent, grant that those petitions which faith lacks in merits may obtain through the offerings.

text: Deus qui nos ad sancti pontificis et martyris tui Xysti natalicia tribuisti pervenire laetantes praesta quaesumus ut sicut securis eadem mentibus ita dignis celebremus officiis.
translation_en: God, who granted us to arrive rejoicing at the birthday of your saint and martyr Cyprian, we humbly ask that you may bestow upon us, with minds as secure as ever, to celebrate worthy of our duties.

text: Deus qui nos ad sancti Hilarii confessoris tui atque pontificis depositionem tribuisti pervenire laetantes praesta quaesumus ut sicut celebramus officiis ita iuvemur auxiliis.
translation_en: God, who allowed us to reach the departure of your confessor and bishop Saint Hilary with joy, grant us that we may be helped as we celebrate the offices in the same manner.

text: Deus qui nos annua apostolorum tuorum Philippi et Iacobi sollemnitate laetificas praesta quaesumus ut quorum gaudemus meritis instruamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who delights us with the solemnity of your apostles Philip and James, grant us we ask, that we may be instructed by their examples through the merits for which we rejoice.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatae Agnes martyris tuae sollemnitate laetificas da quaesumus ut quam veneramur officio etiam piae conversationis sequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God who delights us with the solemnity of your blessed martyr Agnes, we humbly ask that we who reverence her, may also follow her example in our devoted way of life.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Cyriaci martyris tui sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus virtutem quoque passionis imitemur.
translation_en: God who delights us with the solemnity of your blessed martyr Cyril, grant graciously that we may celebrate his birthday and imitate the virtue of his passion as well.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati confessoris tui David festivitatis exspectatione laetificas praesta quaesumus ut per haec sacrosancta mysteria quae in eius tibi honorem attulimus a praeteritis liberemur peccatis et futuris non ambigamur incendiis.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the festival of your blessed confessor David through the expectation of his feast day, we ask that you grant us through these most sacred mysteries which we have brought before you as an offering of his honor, that we may be freed from past sins and not doubt about future trials.

text: Hoc est imprimis introitus
translation_en: This is primarily the entrance (hymn)

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Hieronymi confessoris tui festivitate laetificas da nobis eius intervenientibus meritis et perpetua proiectione muniri et salutari gaudere profectu.
translation_en: God who delights us in the feast of your blessed confessor Jerome, grant us protection through his merits and shield us with eternal help, that we may rejoice in a salutary progress.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Ioannis Baptistae sollemnia frequentare concedis praesta quaesumus ut et devotis eadem mentibus celebremus et eius patrocinio promerente plenae capiamus securitatis augmentum.
translation_en: God who grants us the opportunity to celebrate the feast days of blessed John the Baptist, grant us, we ask, that we may celebrate them with devout minds and, through his patronage, obtain an increase in security.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Marci evangelistae et martyris tui celebritate laetificas pietatis tuae largitate concede ut cuius honoris debitum victoriae triumphum pio amore veneramur in terris societatis eius laetitiam adipisci te praebente mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the annual celebration of your blessed apostle and martyr Mark, grant that we may deserve to honor his victory's triumph through pious love on earth and may merit to experience the joy of his society in heaven by your generous grace.

text: Deus qui nos beati Marci evangelistae et martyris tui sollemnitate laetificas pietatis tuae largitate concede benignus ut cuius triumphum pio amore veneramur in terris societatis eius laetitiam adipisci te largiente mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: God who delights us on the solemnity of your blessed evangelist and martyr, Marc, through your grace, be merciful to us. May we worthy of whose triumph we venerate with pious love on earth, obtain the joy of his fellowship here, and may we merit to receive you giving it in heaven.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Marci evangelistae et martyris tui gloriosa passionis sollemnitate laetificas solita pietatis tuae largitate concede benignus ut cuius honoris famosum victoriae triumphum pio amore veneramur in terris societatis eius laetitiam adipisci te largiente mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who delight us with the annual feast of your blessed apostle and martyr Saint Mark, bestow your customary grace through your abundant mercy. Grant us kindly that we may venerate him with pious love on earth and deserve to share his joy in society, may you grant it through your bounty in heaven.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatorum martyrum tuorum Marcellini et Petri sollemnitate laetificas praesta quaesumus ut quorum gaudemus meritis provocemur exemplis.
translation_en: God who delights us on the feast of your blessed martyrs, Marcellinus and Peter, grant us, we pray, that we may be inspired by their merits through their examples.

text: Deus qui nos annua beatorum martyrum Timothei et Apollinaris sollemnitate laetificas eorum quaesumus continua intercessione super nos misericordiam tuam multiplica ut quorum patrociniis gratulamur etiam perpetuae salutis auxilium nobis adesse sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the feast of the blessed martyrs Timothy and Apollinaris, we humbly ask that your continual intercession multiplies your mercy upon us. May we feel the aid of their perpetual salvation to be present with us through the support of their patronage.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Wilfridi confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnitate laetificas eius quaesumus continua intercessione super nos misericordiam tuam multiplica ut cuius patrociniis gratulamur ipsius suffragiis perpetuae salutis nobis auxilium adesse sentiamus.
translation_en: God who delights us on the solemnity of your blessed confessor and bishop Wilfrid, we humbly ask that through his continuous intercession, you multiply your mercy upon us. May we feel the help of eternal salvation from his patronage.

text: Deus qui nos annua praeclarae inventionis sanctorum tuorum Stephani Gamalielis Nicodemi atque Abibon sollemnitate laetificas praesta quaesumus ut quos in caelesti gloria sublimatos miraculis in terra declarasti apud paternae pietatis tuae clementiam intercessores semper habere mereamur.
translation_en: God who enlightens us with the glorious finding of your saints Stephen, Gamaliel, Nicodemus, and Abibo, on their solemn feast day, grant us we beseech you, that we may always deserve to be intercessors for you on earth, as you have declared us raised to heavenly glory with your miracles. Amen.

text: Deus qui nos annua sanctorum tuorum Protasii et Gervasii sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut quorum gaudemus meritis accendamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who delights us with the solemnity of your saints Protasius and Gervasius, grant us your favor that we may be inflamed by their merits and examples.

text: Deus qui nos annua sollemnitate beati illius confessoris tui atque pontificis laetificas praesta ut pro nobis pius Intercessor exsistat qui tui nominis devotus exstitit praedicator.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the annual feast of your blessed confessor and bishop, grant that we may have a pious Intercessor who was devoted to your name as a preacher, may exist for us.

text: Deus qui nos beatae illius diem concedis venerari sollemnem fac nos eius suffragantibus meritis tuis semper oboedire mandatis.
translation_en: God, who grants us to honor the day of that blessed one solemnly, make us always to obey your commands through the merits of his intercession.

text: Deus qui nos beatae Mariae semper virginis et beatorum apostolorum martyrum confessorum virginum atque omnium simul sanctorum continua laetificas sollemnitate praesta quaesumus ut quos cottidiano veneramur officio etiam piae conversationis semper sequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God, who continually rejoices us through the solemnity of the Blessed Virgin Mary, ever-virgin, the holy apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all the saints together, grant us, we ask, that we who daily venerate with an ordinary office, may always follow their example in pious conversation.

text: Deus qui nos beati Andreae apostoli tui veneranda laetificas translatione eius intercessione ad tuae visionis claritatem nos transferre dignare.
translation_en: God, who delights us through the venerable translation of your apostle St. Andrew, deign to transfer us to the clarity of your vision through his intercession.

text: Deus qui nos beati Deus dedit confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnia celebrare concedis eius quaesumus semper meritis et intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who has given us the opportunity to celebrate the feast days of your confessed confessor and pope, we ask that you always help us through his merits and intercessions.

text: Deus qui nos beati Edmundi confessoris tui atque pontificis translationem celebrare concedis te supplices exoramus ut eius meritis et precibus a vitiis ad virtutes et a carcere transferamur ad regnum.
translation_en: God, who grant us the celebration of the translation of your confessor and bishop Blessed Edmund, we humbly beseech you that through his merits and intercessions we may be transferred from vices to virtues, and from prison to a kingdom.

text: Deus qui nos beati Eusebii confessoris tui annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus per eius apud te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God who delights us through the annual solemnity of your confessor Saint Eusebius, grant us graciously that we may honor his birthday and be worthy by his example before you.

text: Deus qui nos beati Eustachii ac sociorum eius sollemnitate laetificas et salutarium sacramentorum perceptione confortas da quaesumus ut ad eum nos sanctorum ducat intercessio qui nobis fieri dignatus est redemptio.
translation_en: God, who delights us on the solemnity of Blessed Eustachius and his companions, and strengthens us by the perception of saving sacraments, grant that we may be led to Him by the intercession of the saints, whom it has been deemed worthy to be our redemption.

text: Deus qui nos beati Georgii martyris tui meritis et intercessione laetificas concede propitius ut qui eius beneficia poscimus dono tuae gratiae consequamur.
translation_en: God who delights us through the merits of your blessed martyr George and his intercession, graciously grant that we may follow in his footsteps by receiving the gifts of your grace as we ask for his benefits.

text: Deus qui nos beati Gregorii confessoris tui atque pontificis annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut cuius opere atque doctrina scripturae tuae mysteria multa cognovimus eius apud te semper patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God who delights us through the annual feast of your confessor and pope, blessed Gregory, grant us graciously, that we may always feel his patronage, whose work and teaching have made us know many mysteries of your scripture.

text: Deus qui nos beati Guthlaci confessoris tui annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut sicut ille per ardua solitariae vitae instituta ad tuae visionis gaudia pervenit ita ipsius intercessione ad eadem pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: God who delights us through the annual solemnity of your blessed confessor Guthlac, grant us graciously that, just as he reached the joys of your vision through the rigorous solitary life he established, we may deserve to reach the same through his intercession.

text: Deus qui nos beati Helani confessoris tui natalicia gloriosa celebrare concedis tribue quaesumus eius nos semper et beneficiis attolli et orationibus adiuvari.
translation_en: God who grants us the glorious birthday celebration of your blessed confessor Helena, we humbly ask that you always lift us up with your blessings and assist us with our prayers.

text: Deus qui nos beati Ignatii martyris tui atque pontificis triumphum venerabilem celebrare concedis da nobis quaesumus in eius veneratione laetitiam ut cuius in terris devote sollemnia colimus eum semper in caelis intercedere sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who grants us the venerable triumph of blessed Pope and martyr Ignatius, we humbly ask that, in his veneration, we may feel joy. May we always sense him interceding for us on earth, even as he is forever in heaven.

text: Deus qui nos beati Ioannis Baptistae concedis natalicio perfrui eius nos tribue meritis adiuvari.
translation_en: God, who grants us to rejoice in the birth of blessed John the Baptist, grant us to be helped by his merits.

text: Deus qui nos beati Marci evangelistae concedis natalicio perfrui da Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus et amare quod credidit et praedicare quod docuit.
translation_en: God, who grants us to celebrate the nativity of the blessed Mark, the evangelist, we ask that your Church may experience it and love what he believed, and preach what he taught.

text: Deus qui nos beati martyris tui Caesarii annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus etiam actiones imitemur.
translation_en: God who delights us with the annual feast of your blessed martyr Caesarius, grant us graciously that we may not only celebrate his nativity, but also imitate his actions.

text: Deus qui nos beati protomartyris tui Stephani hodierna inventione laetificas da nobis per haec sancta quae sumpsimus eius benevolentiam interna pace sectari qui etiam pro inimicis cum lapidaretur exoravit Dominum nostrum Iesum.
translation_en: God who on this day delights us with the discovery of your blessed protomartyr Stephen, grant us through these holy things that we have taken up, to seek his benevolence internally in peace. He even pleaded for his enemies while being stoned, invoked our Lord Jesus.

text: Deus qui nos beati Stephani martyris tui atque pontificis annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut cuius natalicia colimus de eiusdem etiam protectione gaudeamus.
translation_en: God who delights us on the annual feast of your blessed martyr and bishop Stephen, grant us graciously that we may not only celebrate his nativity, but also rejoice in his protection.

text: Deus qui nos beati Theodori martyris tui confessione gloriosa circumdas et protegis praesta nobis eius imitatione proficere et oratione fulciri.
translation_en: God, who surrounds and protects us by the glorious confession of your blessed martyr Theodore, help us to progress in his imitation and fulfill his prayers.

text: Deus qui nos beatorum monachorum tuorum commemoratione laetificas concede propitius ut sanctae conversationis exempla sectantes eorum intercessionibus remissionem omnium peccatorum et immortalitatis gloriam consequamur.
translation_en: God who delights us through the commemoration of your blessed monks, graciously grant that we, following their example of holy living, may obtain through their intercessions forgiveness for all our sins and the glory of eternal life.

text: Deus qui nos columbarum simplicitate doces esse mitissimos effice nos Columbae virginis tuae precibus in caritate perfectos ut innocentiam retinentes ad invicem in pace tua mereamur consistere sine fine.
translation_en: God who teaches us, in simplicity, to be most merciful, make us like the dove of your peace, perfected by your prayers, so that, maintaining innocence among ourselves, we may deserve to dwell together in your peace eternally.

text: Deus qui nos concedis alleluiatici cantici deducendi sollemnia celebrare da nobis in aeterna beatitudine cum sanctis tuis alleluia cantantibus perpetuum feliciter alleluia posse cantare.
translation_en: God who grants us the Alleluia hymns to be led in solemn celebration, grant us eternal beatitude with your saints singing Alleluia. May we always joyfully be able to sing Alleluia.

text: Deus qui nos concedis sanctorum martyrum tuorum Felicissimi et Agapiti natalicia colere da nobis in aeterna laetitia de eorum societate gaudere.
translation_en: God who grants us to celebrate the nativity of Your holy martyrs Felicissimus and Agapitus, grant us to enjoy eternal joy with their company.

text: Deus qui nos concedis hodierna die reliquiarum sanctorum tuorum Stephani Nicodemi Gamalielis atque Abibon inventionis sollemnia colere tribue nobis quaesumus in aeterna laetitia de illorum societate gaudere.
translation_en: God who grants us today to celebrate the solemnities of your relics of Saint Stephen, Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Abibo, grant us, we pray, that we may enjoy eternal joy in their fellowship.

text: Deus qui nos concedis sanctorum apostolorum martyrum et confessorum atque omnium simul iustorum continuis sollemnia colere sacramentis da nobis in aeterna laetitia de eorum societate gaudere.
translation_en: God who grants us the continuous feast days of the holy apostles, martyrs and confessors, as well as all the saints, grant us to enjoy eternal joy from their fellowship.

text: Deus qui nos concedis sanctorum tuorum Stephani Nicodemi Gamalielis et Abibae inventionem gloriosam celebrare da nobis in aeterna beatitudine de eorum societate gaudere.
translation_en: God, who grants us the opportunity to celebrate the glorious finding of your saints Stephen, Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Abibas, grant us to enjoy eternal beatitude from their fellowship.

text: Deus qui nos conceptionis nativitatis annunciationis visitationis purificationis et assumptionis beatae et gloriosae virginis Mariae gaudia recolendo laetificas concede nobis sic laudibus eius et servitio digne insistere ut eam in omni necessitate et angustia et praecipue in hora mortis praesentem et auxiliatricem sentiamus et tecum post mortem per ipsam et cum ipsa gaudere mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who by the joy of the conception, nativity, annunciation, visitation, purification, and assumption of the blessed and glorious Virgin Mary recalling, grants us to praise Him worthily and to insist on His service, so that we may feel Her present and helpful in every need and distress, and especially at the hour of death. Through Her and with Her, we may deserve to rejoice with You in heaven after death.

text: Deus qui nos conspicis ex nostra infirmitate deficere ad amorem tuum nos misericorditer per sanctorum tuorum exempla restaura.
translation_en: God who sees us in our weakness wavering towards Your love, restore us mercifully through the examples of Your saints.

text: Deus qui nos conspicis in tot perturbationibus non posse subsistere afflictorum gemitum propitius respice et mala omnia quae meremur averte.
translation_en: God, who sees us in all our disturbances and understands that we cannot stand the groan of the afflicted, have pity and look kindly upon us. Turn away from us all the evils that we deserve.

text: Deus qui nos de praesentibus adiumentis esse vetuisti sollicitos tribue quaesumus ut pie sectando quae tua sunt universa nobis salutaria condonentur.
translation_en: God, who have willed us not to be troubled by present affairs, we humbly ask that you grant us the ability to follow your ways faithfully, so that all things that are yours may be beneficial and forgiving to us.

text: Deus qui nos de spe misericordiae tuae hac prima ratione voluisti confiteri ut martyrum tuorum quorum hic reliquias veneramur et praesentia et auxilio circumdares ut haberet et oratio nostra suffragium et vita patrocinium illorum sanctorum intercessione hoc munere custodi {igitur quaesumus Domine } Ecclesiam tuam custodi locum istum vel omnes convenientes in eum suffragio sancti martyris tui illius; fiatque nobis ipse auxiliator e caelo qui ad te praesenti migravit e saeculo; sitque haec vicissim retributio muneris tui ut mereatur hic locus martyris gratiam qui misit eundem martyrem ad coronam.
translation_en: God, who willed us to confess by this first confession of your mercy that we venerate here the relics of your martyrs; encompass us with their presence and help, so that our prayer may have their suffrage and life their patronage through the intercession of these holy martyrs. Therefore, we ask, Lord, to protect your Church in this place or all those who come together here under the suffrage of your saintly martyr; let him himself become our helper from heaven who has left the world and migrated to you presently; and may it be that this reciprocity is a reward for your service, so that this place of the martyr may deserve the grace that sent the same martyr to his crown.

text: Deus qui nos devota beati Hrodperti confessoris tui atque pontificis instantia ad agnitionem tui sancti nominis vocare dignatus es concede propitius ut cuius sollemnia colimus etiam patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who deigned to call us by the intercession of your devoted confessor and bishop, Blessed Hrodpert, to the recognition of your holy name, mercifully grant that we who celebrate his solemnity may also feel his patronage.

text: Deus qui nos et caelestibus pascere sacramentis et beati confessoris et antistitis tui Syri non desinis fovere praesidiis praesta quaesumus ut quod illi gloriam contulit sempiternam nobis optatam conferat gratiam.
translation_en: God who never stops nourishing us with heavenly sacraments and the blessed confessor and bishop Syri, grant us your protection. We ask that you bestow upon us the grace which they obtained eternal glory, so that what was pleasing to them may also be granted to us.

text: Deus qui nos et sanctorum martyrum sollemnitatibus et consessorum gloria circumdas et protegis praesta nobis eorum semper et imitatione proficere et emundatione fulgere.
translation_en: God who surrounds and protects us in the festivities of the holy martyrs and adorns them with glory, grant us always to progress by their example and to shine by their purification.

text: Deus qui nos <et> sanctorum martyrum Augustini et Felicitatis natalicia et sancti confessoris tui Aniani depositionis gloria circumdas et protegis praesta nobis eorum semper <et> imitatione proficere et oratione fulgere.
translation_en: God, who surrounds and protects us on the feast days of your saints Augustine, Felicitas, and Anianus at their deaths, grant that we may always progress in their example and shine in our prayers.

text: Deus qui nos exsultantibus animis pascha tuum celebrare tribuisti fac quaesumus nos et temporalibus gaudere subsidiis et aeternitatis effectibus gratulari.
translation_en: God, who has granted us to celebrate Your Passover with joyful souls, grant us, we ask, to enjoy temporal blessings and to rejoice with the powers of eternity.

text: Deus qui nos famulos tuos in beatae martyris tuae Caeciliae victoria Valeriani simul et Tiburtii gaudere fecisti triumphis tribue quaesumus maiestatis tuae misericordiam ut sicut eos tyrannorum superata feritate laetari fecisti ita et populus tuus tua semper exsultet bonitate.
translation_en: God, who made your servants rejoice in the victory of your martyr Caecilia, together with Valerian and Tiburtius, in triumphs, grant us the mercy of your majesty, that just as you caused them to rejoice over the overcome cruelty of tyrants, so may your people always exult in your goodness.

text: Deus qui nos famulos tuos in hoc loco sub sancta professione degentes de tempestatibus huius saeculi eruisti et ad portum monasterii et quietis venire fecisti concede propitius ut hic et in perpetuum te auxiliante salvemur.
translation_en: God, who as our servants dwelling in this place under holy profession have freed us from the storms of this world and brought us to the port of the monastery and peace, graciously grant that here and forever, with your help, we may be saved.

text: Deus qui nos fecisti gloriosi confessoris tui Aldelmi translationem spirituali gaudio celebrare ipsius meritis fac nos cum sanctis angelis perpetuae festivitatis iucunditate remunerari.
translation_en: God, who made us rejoice in the confession of your glorious confessor Aldhelm with spiritual joy, grant that we may be repaid with the delight of eternal festivity together with the saints and angels through his merits.

text: Deus qui nos fecisti hodierna die paschalia festa celebrare fac nos quaesumus in caelesti regno gaudere.
translation_en: God, who made us fit to celebrate today's Paschal feast, grant that we may rejoice in Your heavenly kingdom.

text: Deus qui nos formam humilitatis ieiunando et orando unigeniti tui Domini nostri imitatione docuisti concede quaesumus ut quod ille iugi ieiuniorum continuatione complevit nos quoque per partes dierum facias adimplere.
translation_en: God, who taught us to form ourselves in humility through fasting and praying, imitating your only-begotten Son, our Lord, grant us, we ask, that what he completed with the continuation of fasting, may you make us also accomplish, day by day.

text: Deus qui nos gloriosis remediis in terris adhuc positos iam caelestium rerum facis esse consortes tu quaesumus in ista qua vivimus nos vita guberna ut ad illam in qua ipse es lucem perducas.
translation_en: God, who positions us still on earth with glorious remedies, we humbly ask that you make us participants in these celestial things while we live here. Govern our life so that you may lead us to that place where you are the light.

text: Deus qui nos hanc diem in honorem sancti Sampsonis confessoris tui atque pontificis venerabilem excolere fecisti praesta quaesumus ut quem laetis veneramur obsequiis eius orationibus muniamur et meritis.
translation_en: God who made us worthy to honor Saint Sampson, Your confessor and bishop, on this day, grant us we pray, that we may be fortified with his prayers through joyful devotion and merit.

text: Deus qui nos hodie beatae et sanctae illius virginis martyrisque annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut eius adiuvemur meritis cuius castitatis irradiamur exemplis.
translation_en: God who today on the annual feast of the blessed and holy virgin and martyr delights us, grant us graciously that we may be helped by her merits, whose examples illuminate our chastity.

text: Deus qui nos hodierna die beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Hermachorae et Fortunati multiplici facis celebritate gaudere tribue quaesumus eorum nos semper piis defensionibus muniri et orationibus adiuvari.
translation_en: God, who today makes us rejoice with great festivity in the blessed martyrs Hermachorae and Fortunatus, we humbly ask that you always arm us with their devout defenses and assist us with their prayers.

text: Deus qui nos hodierna die exaltationis sanctae crucis annua sollemnitate laetificas praesta ut cuius mysterium in terra cognovimus eius redemptionis praemia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God who today on the feast of the exaltation of the holy cross exults us, grant that we may merit to obtain the rewards of whose mystery on earth we have come to know.

text: Deus qui nos idoneos non esse perspiciens ad magnificentiam tuam sicut dignum est exorandam eorum nobis qui tibi placuerunt praesidia contulisti praesta ut eorum precibus adiuvemur quorum providisti nobis miseratus auxilium.
translation_en: God, who perceives that we are unworthy to approach your majesty as it is fitting to pray for those whom you have favored by providing them protection, have mercy on us and grant that we may be helped by their prayers, whom you have provided aid to us in our need.

text: Deus qui nos in commemoratione beati Martini sacerdotis tui atque pontificis gratia potiore laetificas concede propitius ut et per sancta quae sumpsimus et eius pro nobis intervenientia merita pertingere ad gaudia aeterna mereamur.
translation_en: God, who in the commemoration of the blessed Martin, your priest and bishop, with a more abundant grace makes us rejoice, graciously grant that through the holy things we have taken and his intercession for us, we may merit to attain eternal joys.

text: Deus qui nos in sanctorum martyrum multiplicatione custodis da ut quorum sollemnia frequentamus incessabili iuvemur auxilio.
translation_en: God who in the multitude of saints' martyrs keeps us, grant that we may be unceasingly aided by their help as we celebrate their feasts.

text: Deus qui nos in sanctorum sollemnitate laetificas et imitatione excitas ad profectum tribue ut quos veneramur meritis martyrum piae conversationis sequamur exemplis.
translation_en: God, who delights us in the solemnity of the saints and stirs us up by example to progress, grant that we may follow in the footsteps of the merits of the holy martyrs through their examples.

text: Deus qui nos in tantis periculis constitutos pro humana scis fragilitate non posse subsistere da nobis salutem mentis et corporis ut ea quae pro peccatis nostris patimur te adiuvante vincamus.
translation_en: God, who knows that we, placed in such perils, cannot sustain ourselves due to human frailty, grant us salvation for mind and body, so that, with your help, we may overcome what we suffer on account of our sins.

text: Deus qui nos iustus iudex arguis accepta hoc sacrificium nostrum tuumque a nobis amove flagellum quo haec merita inter viventes ac defunctos consistens oblatio et a vivis cladem et a mortuis tartaream submoveat ultionem.
translation_en: God, who as the righteous judge discerns us, accept this offering from us and remove from us Your rod by which these merits stand between the living and the dead. May it move the punishment from the living and the torment from the dead.

text: Deus qui nos omnium sanctorum commemoratione laetificas eorum quaesumus precibus et meritis fac nos aeternae salvationis praesidiis muniri et concede ut in eorum beata societate mereamur coniungi.
translation_en: God who delights us with the commemoration of all saints, we humbly ask through our prayers and their merits to arm us with the defenses of eternal salvation and grant that we may deserve to join them in their blessed fellowship.

text: Deus qui nos omnium sanctorum tuorum veneranda commemoratione laetificas da nobis et eorum imitatione proficere et intercessione gaudere.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the venerable remembrance of all your saints, grant that we may progress by their example and rejoice in their intercession.

text: Deus qui nos pastores in populo vocari voluisti praesta quaesumus ut hoc quod humano ore dicimur in tuis oculis esse valeamus.
translation_en: God who willed to call us shepherds among the people, grant us that we may be worthy for what we say with human voice to be pleasing in your sight.

text: Deus qui nos patrem et matrem honorare praecepisti miserere clementer animabus patris et matris meae eorumque peccata dimitte meque eos in aeternae claritatis gaudio fac videre.
translation_en: God who commanded us to honor father and mother, have mercy graciously on the souls of my father and mother, forgive their sins, and make them see eternal joy.

text: Deus qui nos per apostolum tuum propriis manibus victum quaerere praecepisti sanctarum tuarum Iustae et Rufinae precibus spiritalem nobis attribue victum et cottidianum piae miserationis subsidium ut hae virgines quae suis manibus et propriae saluti et indigentiae provisores inopum exstiterunt suis suffragiis tam viventibus quam defunctis congrua remedia largiantur.
translation_en: God, who through your apostle commanded us to seek food with your own hands for the saints Justa and Rufina, grant us a spiritual food through their prayers and daily aid from your merciful provision. May these virgins, who have provided for themselves and their salvation through their own hands, be generous in their intercession for the needy both in life and death with fitting remedies.

text: Deus qui nos per beatam martyrem tuam illam ad cognitionem nominis tui venire tribuisti da nobis per eius gloriam passionis sempiternam tuam gratiam amplecti et proficiendo eius sollemnitatem celebrare.
translation_en: God who through your blessed martyr granted us to come to the knowledge of your name, grant us through her glory of the Passion everlasting grace to embrace and to advance in celebrating her solemnity.

text: Deus qui nos per beatos apostolos tuos ad cognitionem tui nominis venire tribuisti da nobis eorum gloriam sempiternam et proficiendo celebrare et celebrando proficere.
translation_en: God, who through your blessed apostles led us to the knowledge of your name, grant us their eternal glory. And as we advance, may we celebrate and by celebrating, progress.

text: Deus qui nos per huius sacrificii veneranda commercia unius summae divinitatis participes effecisti praesta quaesumus ut sicut tuam cognoscimus veritatem sic eam dignis moribus assequamur.
translation_en: God, who made us participants in this sacrificial commerce of one supreme divinity, grant us, we pray, that just as we recognize Your truth, so we may attain it through worthy behavior.

text: Deus qui nos per ineffabilem misericordiam tuam annua sponsae Filii tui Glodesindis sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut cuius festivitatem laudibus veneramur etiam piae devotionis irradiamur exemplis.
translation_en: God, who through your ineffable mercy makes the spouse of Your Son Glodesindis joyful with solemnity, graciously grant that we may not only honor her festivity with praises but also be inspired by pious examples.

text: Deus qui nos per paschalia festa laetificas concede propitius ut ea quae devote agimus te adiuvante fideliter teneamus.
translation_en: God who delights us through Paschal feasts, grant favorably that we may faithfully hold onto what we perform with devotion, as you aid us.

text: Deus qui nos per temporalia ducis ad aeterna praetende misericordiam tuam ad caelestia promissa nitentibus et quia tuum est quod in te credimus tuum sit omne quod vivimus.
translation_en: God, who leads us through temporal things to eternal promises, extend your mercy to those striving for heavenly rewards. For everything we live is yours, as it is in you that we believe.

text: Deus qui nos per unigeniti tui membra ad caelestem vitam semper informas concede propitius ut qui beati Alexii confessoris tui sollemnia colimus de eiusdem in te gloria sine fine gaudeamus.
translation_en: God, who continually shapes us through your Only-begotten Son for eternal life, grant us graciously, that we may rejoice without end in the glory of Your blessed confessor Alexander, as we celebrate his solemnity.

text: Deus qui nos per unigenitum tuum beatae Mariae Magdalenae dilectione multa <et> peccatorum remissione sanctificasti concede ut pietatis eius compunctionem et devotionis habere praemia mereamur.
translation_en: God, who through the great love of your only-begotten one, the blessed Mary Magdalene, and through the remission of sins, has sanctified us; grant that we may deserve the reward of her compassion and devotion through her compunction.

text: Deus qui nos pii confessoris tui Benedicti voluisti magisteriis erudiri eius meritis dignare ab omni insidiatoris fraude protegere.
translation_en: God, who willed to teach us through the merits of your pious confessor Benedict, grant that we may be protected from all the deceit of our enemies.

text: Deus qui nos praesentem festivitatem in Iesu Christi Filii tui et Mariae virginis matris eius laudibus venerari fecisti praesta quaesumus ut qui eiusdem virginis humilitatis et gaudiorum quibus Elizabeth visitavit sollemnia celebramus in eorum memoria et gaudiis iugiter maneamus.
translation_en: God who made us worthy to honor this present festivity in Jesus Christ, Son of yours, and Mary, his Virgin Mother, grant us what we ask, that we may remain forever in the memory and joy we celebrate on account of the same Virgin's humility and joys with which Elizabeth visited, in their memory.

text: Deus qui nos redemptionis nostrae annua exspectatione laetificas praesta ut unigenitum Filium tuum quem redemptorem laeti suscepimus venientem quoque iudicem securi videamus.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the annual expectation of our redemption, grant that we may see the only-begotten Son whom we joyfully received as redeemer also coming as judge with confidence.

text: Deus qui nos regendo conservas parcendo iustificas et a temporali tribulatione nos eripe et gaudia nobis aeterna largire.
translation_en: God, who keeps us by guiding and forgives us to justify us, deliver us from earthly affliction and grant us eternal joy.

text: Deus qui nos resurrectionis dominicae annua sollemnitate laetificas concede propitius ut per temporalia festa quae agimus pervenire ad gaudia aeterna mereamur.
translation_en: God, who delights us on the annual solemnity of the Resurrection, grant us graciously that through temporal feasts which we celebrate, we may merit eternal joys.

text: Deus qui nos resurrectionis dominicae et adscensionis eius laetabunda sollemnia celebrare fecisti da famulis tuis ut advenientis Sancti Spiritus gratiam purificatis mentibus suscipere mereamur.
translation_en: God, who made us rejoice in the solemnity of the Lord's Resurrection and Ascension, grant to your servants that we may be worthy to receive the grace of the coming Holy Spirit with purified minds.

text: Deus qui nos adscensionis dominicae laetabunda sollemnia officiis praeire fecisti da nobis famulis tuis ut gratiam advenientis Spiritus Sancti mentibus suscipere mereamur purificatis.
translation_en: God, who made us to preside over the joyful solemnities of the Lord's Ascension with your offices, grant that we, your servants, may merit to receive the grace of the coming Holy Spirit in purified minds.

text: Deus qui nos sacramenti tui participatione contingis virtutis eius effectus in nostris cordibus operare ut suscipiendo muneri tuo per ipsum munus aptemur.
translation_en: God, who makes the effects of your grace operate in our hearts through the participation in your sacrament, that we may be fitted for your service by accepting the office through Him.

text: Deus qui nos sacramenti tui veneranda perceptione purificas da nobis quaesumus patrocinia tuorum continuata sanctorum quibus capere valeamus salutaris mysterii portionem.
translation_en: God, who purifies us through the venerable perception of your sacrament, grant us, we beseech you, continued patronage from your saints, by whose hands we may be able to receive a part of the salvific mystery.

text: Deus qui nos sacramentis tuis pascere non desistis tribue quaesumus ut eorum nobis indulta refectio vitam conferat sempiternam.
translation_en: God who does not cease to feed us with your sacraments, grant us, we ask, that the refreshment granted to us from them may bestow upon us eternal life.

text: Deus qui nos sacrum transfigurationis diem devotis hodie laudibus praeire concedis tribue nobis quaesumus ad tuam contemplationem perungere qui nostrae humanitatis dignatus es fieri particeps.
translation_en: God who today grants us to celebrate the sacred day of Transfiguration with devoted praise, grant us we beseech you, to reach out for your contemplation. You who have deigned to become a participant in our humanity.

text: Deus qui nos sanctae virginis tuae tribuis communicare memoria eius nos fac semper gaudere suffragiis.
translation_en: God, who grants us to share in the memory of your holy Virgin, may we always rejoice in her intercessions.

text: Deus qui nos sanctarum virginum tuarum illarum temporali facis commemoratione gaudere concede propitius ut earum suffragantibus meritis ab imminentibus periculis liberemur et aeternis gaudiis perfrui mereamur.
translation_en: God, who makes us to rejoice in the commemoration of your holy virgins through temporal means, graciously grant that we may be freed from impending dangers by their merits and merit to partake in eternal joys through their intercession.

text: Deus qui nos sancti Zenonis sacerdotis et confessoris tui annua beatae confessionis sollemnitate laetificas praesta quaesumus ut callida hostis incursione tua freti virtute devicta pervenire ad gaudia ipso intercedente mereamur aeterna.
translation_en: God who delights us with the annual blessed feast of your saint Zenon, priest and confessor, we ask that you grant, through his intercession, that, overpowered by your strength, we may overcome the cunning enemy's attack and merit to reach the joys through him in eternity.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum confessorum tuorum Remigii Vedasti Bavonis Piatonis atque Wasnulfi sollemnitate laetificas eorum Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporali celebramus actione perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: God, who delights us on the solemnity of your saints Remigius, Vedastus, Babo, Piaton and Wasnulf, we pray that, through their intercession, you may be pleased to grant that what we celebrate temporally may obtain for us salvation perpetually.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum martyrum munitione conservas da Ecclesiam tuam digne talium celebrare sollemnia et illos tibi iugiter supplicare pro nobis.
translation_en: God, who keeps us by the fortification of the holy martyrs, grant Your Church worthily to celebrate such solemnities and continually to petition them on our behalf.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum tuorum et sollemnitate laetificas et imitatione suscitas ad profectum praesta ut quos veneramur officio etiam piae conversationis sequamur exemplo.
translation_en: God, who delights us with the festivities of your saints and stirs us up in imitation to progress, grant that we who honor them in office may also follow their example in a pious way of life.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum tuorum Processi et Martiniani confessionibus gloriosis circumdas et protegis da nobis eorum et imitatione proficere et intercessione gaudere.
translation_en: God, who surrounds and protects us through the glorious confessions of your saints Processius and Martinianus, grant us to progress in their imitation and to rejoice in their intercession.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum tuorum beatissimorum spirituum angelorum archangelorumque principum et potestatum dominationum virtutum cherubim et seraphim patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum confessorumque et virginum anachoritarum coenobitarum omniumque sanctorum concivium supernorum et intercessionibus gloriosis circumdas et protegis praesta quaesumus eorum et imitatione proficere et interpellatione tueri et intercedentibus sanctis a cunctis nos defende periculis.
translation_en: God, who surrounds and protects us with the glorious intercessions of Your most blessed spirits, angels, archangels, princes and powers, dominations, virtues, cherubim, seraphim, patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, anachorets, coenobites, all saints of the heavenly court, we humbly ask that You grant us to progress in their imitation and to be guarded by their intercession. Through the intercession of the saints, defend us from all dangers.

text: Deus qui nos sanctorum tuorum temporali tribuis commemoratione gaudere praesta quaesumus ut beato Cuthberto interveniente in ea numeremur sorte salutis in qua illi sunt gratia tua gloriosi.
translation_en: God who grants us the joy of remembering your saints temporally, grant us, we ask, that with blessed Cuthbert interceding on our behalf, we may be counted among the ranks of salvation where they share in your glorious grace.

text: Deus qui nos spiritali cibo potuque caelesti recreasti concede nobis quaesumus intercessione beati Donati martyris tui atque pontificis ab omnibus absolvi peccatis et a cunctis adversitatibus liberari.
translation_en: God, who has refreshed us with spiritual food and celestial drink, grant us, we ask, through the intercession of your martyr and bishop St. Donatus, to be absolved from all sins and to be freed from all adversities.

text: Illumina quaesumus Domine tenebras nostras
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to illuminate our darkness

text: Deus qui nos translationem beatissimi confessoris tui atque pontificis Ricardi sollemniter celebrare concedis tribue nobis quaesumus eius meritis et precibus a mundi huius transire miseria et ad gaudia pervenire caelestia.
translation_en: God, who grants us the solemn celebration of Your blessed confessor and bishop Richard, grant us, we pray, through his merits and prayers, that we may pass from the misery of this world and come to the celestial joys.

text: Deus qui nos Unigeniti tui clementer incarnatione redemisti da nobis patrocinia tuorum continuata sanctorum quibus capere valeamus salutaris mysterii portionem.
translation_en: God, who redeemed us kindly through the incarnation of your Only-begotten Son, grant us the continued patronage of your saints, that we may be able to partake in the saving mystery's portion.

text: Deus qui nos veneranda festivitatis hodiernae sollemnia in honorem beati Augustini Anglorum apostoli celebrare fecisti concede propitius eius nos apud te patrocinio semper adiuvari cuius sancta praedicatione cognovimus auctorem salutis aeternae.
translation_en: God who has made us celebrate today's venerable feast in honor of the English apostle, Saint Augustine, propitiously grant that we may always be helped by his patronage, whose holy preaching we have come to know as the author of eternal salvation.

text: Deus qui nostra nos conspicis semper infirmitate destitui adventus tui nos visitatione custodi.
translation_en: God, who always sees us in our weakness, guard us by your visit during your coming.

text: Deus qui nostram laetitiam in tuo <ponis servitio sancti nominis tui nobis> praesta timorem ut in tuis vigilantes mandatis placere tibi possimus.
translation_en: God, who places our joy in your service of the holy name of yours to us, grant us fear, so that we may be able to please you while being vigilant in your commands.

text: Deus qui nova cum veteribus una pietate et indissona voluntate coniungis sic Christi tui martyres sub evangelio locans ut tamen praeire his sub lege in typici cruoris mysterio Macchabaeos sinas atque genere huius martyrii illic fundamenta iacias hic perfectionem concedas dona convenienti plebiculae tuae ut feliciter cum Felicis tui felicitate congaudeat ut cuius amore sita et patrocinio fida coadunata cum Macchabaeorum concelebrat festa mereatur interventu eorum et in singulis percipere necessaria et in omnibus adipisci bonorum promissorum futura.  Hic hodie quaesumus proveniat reis indulgentia anxiis laetitia aegris medicina oppressis libertas luxuriosis castitas petulantibus pudicitia prodigis frugalitas dissolutis continentia gastrimargiis parcitas invidis benignitas avaris largitas iracundis patientia superbis humilitas vanitates praesentis saeculi inhiantibus spei solatium de vita beata.  Te quaesumus aeterne terribilis et clementissime Deus ut Felicis tui ac Macchabaeorum suffragio dones regibus cum tranquillitate iustitiam sacerdotibus cum sanctitate doctrinam levitis cum ministerio digno vitam honestam divitibus cum rerum praesentium vilitate dilectionem supernam egenis cum sufficientia praesentium beatitudinem futurorum continentibus castimoniam virginibus custodiam viduis defensionem orphanis tutelam ut in omnibus omnino singulis singula et omnibus omnia impertiri largiaris et de promptuariis tuis praebere digneris quo his potiti donis numquam a te deserantur a quo numquam nisi deserentes deseruntur ut haec plebs ditetur pietatis tuae vicissitudine ut quae eum praemisit ad caelum mereatur ex te petitionis suae sumere donum.  Te autem ut haec obtineas beatissime Felix martyr lacrimosis querelis adimus gemitibus imploramus; ob honorem tibi debitum Deo omnipotenti vota persolvimus caerimonias exhibemus eique te advocatum prae necessitatum nostrarum aerumnis supplicamus hostias salutares et sacrificium laudis immolamus quatenus per mysticam oblationem et sacrificium redemptionis nostrae apud eum remedia inveniamus pro cuius fide te passum indubitanter tenemus.
translation_en:
God, who unites the new with the old with one pity and inseparable will, so that Your martyrs under the gospel are placed before them, yet You allow them to precede them under the law in the typical mystery of the martyrdom of the Maccabees, and here You lay the foundation of this martyrdom. Here we ask today that mercy come as relief for the anxious, joy for the sick, medicine for the oppressed, freedom for the luxurious, chastity for the wanton, frugality for the prodigal, self-control for the dissolute, kindness for the grudging, benevolence for the avaricious, patience for the irascible, humility for the proud, consolation for those longing for the present age, support for the weak, and help for the orphans.
Today we ask You, eternal and most merciful God, through the intercession of Your blessed martyr Felicitas and the Maccabees, to grant kings peace with justice, priests sanctity with doctrine, levites worthy ministry, the wealthy love for the supernatural, the poor enough for present beatitude, the continent control for future continence, chastity for virgins, protection for widows, defense for orphans, and tutelage for all. May You bestow on each and every one what is necessary, and may You deign to provide from Your treasures so that these gifts are never abandoned by You, from whom they are never abandoned except when They abandon themselves. So that this people may be enriched with Your mercy in its changes, so that it may merit to receive the gift It promised to heaven through Its own petition.
However, we beseech You, most blessed Felicitas martyr, with tearful complaints and imploring groans, we fulfill the vows due to the almighty God, we present the ceremonies, and we appeal to You as our advocate in times of necessity for our distresses. We offer salutary sacrifices and immolate a sacrifice of lauds that through the mystical offering and sacrifice of redemption, we may find remedies for ourselves with Him, whose faith we hold unquestionably that You suffered.

text: Deus qui nudatum corpus Agnetis virginis tuae caelestis stolae obtexisti ex tegmine vestiatur quaesumus Ecclesia tua claris vestibus innocentiae et iustitiae claritate quo in ea et sacerdotum vita nitore castitatis praepolleat et utriusque sexus condicio ea quae postulaverit adipiscat.
translation_en: God, who clothed the naked body of your heavenly virgin Agnes with a robe, we humbly ask that your church may be adorned with bright garments of innocence and justice so that its life shines with the splendor of chastity. We also pray that both sexes may gain that which they desire from this condition.

text: Deus qui nullum respuis sed quantumvis peccantibus per paenitentiam pia miseratione placaris respice propitius ad preces humilitatis nostrae illumina corda nostra ut tua valeamus implere praecepta.
translation_en: God, who shows no contempt but grants as much forgiveness to the penitent through pious mercy, look upon us propitiously in our humble prayers. Enlighten our hearts so that we may be able to fulfill your commandments.

text: Deus qui ob animarum medelam ieiunii devotione castigari corpora praecepisti concede ut corda nostra ita pietatis tuae valeant exercere mandata quatenus ab omnibus possimus semper abstinere peccatis.
translation_en: God, who commanded bodies to be purified for the healing of souls by the devotion of fasting, grant that our hearts may exercise your commands so that we can always refrain from sins.

text: In Daniel XII
translation_en: In Daniel Chapter XII

text: Deus qui ob declarandam virginitatis integritatem et fidei meritum ad tactum sanctae Brigidae virginis lignum aridum virere fecisti concede propitius ut eius apud tuam misericordiam precibus adiuvemur cuius non solum castitatis irradiamur exemplis verum etiam miraculorum gloria iucundamur.
translation_en: God who made the dry wood to green at the touch of the holy virgin Bridget for declaring the integrity of her virginity and the merit of faith, graciously grant that we may be helped by her prayers before your mercy. Not only are we enlightened by her examples of chastity, but also we delight in the glorious fame of her miracles.

text: Deus qui ob nostrae regenerationis sacramentum te manibus hominis in Iordane submisisti baptizandum tribue quaesumus ut tuae humanitatis dispensatio quam praesentium munerum designat oblatio sit animarum nostrarum perennis sanctificatio.
translation_en: God, who for our regeneration's sacrament submitted yourself to the hands of man in the Jordan to baptize, we humbly ask that your dispensation of humanity, as the offering of the present gifts designates, may be a perpetual sanctification of our souls.

text: In Deuteronomio IV
translation_en: In Deuteronomy (the Fourth Book)

text: Deus qui oblationem Abrahae patriarchae in unigenito filio suo Isaac et votum Annae in Samuele propheta consecrasti concede quaesumus huic famulo tuo qui in primaevo iuventutis suae flore maiestati tuae offertur ut et iugiter
translation_en: God who consecrated the offering of Abraham, the patriarch, in your only-begotten Son Isaac, and the vow of Anna in Samuel the prophet, grant, we ask, to this your servant who is offered at the prime of his youth to your majesty, that he may always

text: Deus qui offensionibus servorum tuorum et iuste irasceris et clementer ignoscis praesta supplicibus indulgentiam peccatorum ut reparato statu tibi subditae libertatis et correptio ab iniquitate et cessatio fiat a verbere.
translation_en: God who justly becomes angry at the offenses of your servants and yet forgives them gently, grant indulgence to the suppliant for sins, that restored to you, they may be submissive under the liberty of faith; let correction come from iniquity, and let there be cessation from the scourge.

text: In Deuteronomio XI
translation_en: In Deuteronomy XI

text: Deus qui olim in hoc tempore Israelitico populo per Ieremiam vatem salubre pietatis consilium contulisti quo pristinos errores abicerent ne patientem per vindictam cognoscerent quem prius per monita non audissent convocatum in Ecclesia tua sacerdotum ac populorum conventum placatus attende. Agnoscimus mala quae fecimus sed veniam postulamus; de vindicta solliciti causas publicamus delicti ne puniamur iustitia si non confiteamur errata.  Quia ergo pius es miserere lugentibus parce peccantibus indulge paenitentibus. Non nos interimas pro peccato adest enim nostra confessio. Quia voluptuose contra te egimus amaricati ieiunio ad te redimus.  Unde quamlibet sint immensa mala quae gessimus sed tu multo plus immensae pietatis es dominus quam rogamus. Dato ergo te nobis per gratiam ne redeamus ad culpam et deficiamus in poena ut indultae nobis pietatis beneficio parcens et nostro dones pluviam semini et corda nostra repleas seminibus verbi tui quo et correpta floreat nostra moribus vita et famis non atteramur aerumna.
translation_en:
God, who in this ancient time gave the Israelite people salutary counsel through Jeremiah the prophet so that they might cast off their original errors and not recognize the avenger whom they had not previously heard summoned to Your church, a gathering of priests and people. You are pleased to attend. We acknowledge the wrongs we have done, but we ask for mercy; we make public the causes of our guilt lest justice punish us if we do not confess our errors.
Since you are merciful, spare those who repent and forgive the penitent. Our sin is present before us because our confession is here. Since we have sinned against You in pleasure, by fasting we return to You.
Therefore, although immense are the evils that we have committed, You are infinitely more merciful than we ask. Therefore, grant us through Your grace not to return to sin and fail in punishment. Show mercy to us, granted forgiveness, and pour out on us the rain of Your grace and fill our hearts with seeds of Your word so that our lives flourish with corrected habits and we are not destroyed by famine.

text: Deus qui omne bonum in tui sacri corporis mysterio contineri voluisti concede propitius ut hoc munus quod {in} beati Geraldi memoriam recolentes offerimus ipso intercedente nobis proficere sentiamus.
translation_en: God who willed that every good be contained in your sacred body's mystery, graciously grant us that we may feel to prosper the offering which we present in memory of blessed Gerald, through his intercession.

text: In Exodo III
translation_en: In Exodus III

text: Deus qui omne meritum vocatorum donis tuae bonitatis anticipas propitiare animae famuli tui illius quem in fine istius vitae regenerationis unda mundavit et quem fecisti non timere de culpa fac gaudere de gratia.
translation_en: God, who precedes the merits of the called with the gifts of Your goodness, propitiate the soul of Your servant whom in the end of this life's renewal the wave cleansed and whom You made not fear guilt but rejoice in grace.

text: Deus qui omne tempus vitae beati Cuthberti maximis glorificasti miraculis praesta quaesumus ut qui monachus pontifex et eremita exstitit insignissimus ante thronum tuum pro nobis assistat intercessor piissimus.
translation_en: God who glorified all time with the greatest miracles of the blessed Cuthbert, we humbly ask that you provide, since he was a monk, bishop, and hermit in exceptional ways before Your throne, he may assist us as our most pious intercessor.

text: Deus qui omnem animam confitentem tibi magis vis emendare quam perdere averte a nobis iram indignationis tuae et dimitte nobis omnia peccata nostra.
translation_en: God who is more eager to mould every soul confessing to you than to lose, turn away from us the wrath of your indignation and forgive us all our sins.

text: In Exodo IX
translation_en: In Exodus IX

text: Deus qui omnes in Christo renatos genus regium et sacerdotale fecisti da nobis et velle et posse quod praecipis ut populo ad aeternitatem vocato una sit fides cordium et pietas actionum.
translation_en: God, who made all in Christ the royal and priestly people, give us both the willingness and ability to do what you command, so that there may be one faith of hearts and one piety of actions among those called to eternity.

text: In Ezechiel VII
translation_en: In Ezekiel Chapter 7

text: Deus qui omnes sanctos et electos tuos pro suis meritis honorari disponis praesta quaesumus ut sanctae Helenae reginae cuius religionem et studium in sanctae crucis manifestatione veneramur apud tuam misericordiam meritis et precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who arranges to honor all your saints and chosen ones according to their merits, we humbly ask that you help us through your mercy and prayers. We are in awe of Queen Helena, whose religious devotion and pursuit we revere in the manifestation of the Holy Cross. Assist us with her merits and intercessions.

text: In Genesis III
translation_en: In Genesis III

text: Deus qui omnipotentiam tuam parcendo maxime et miserando manifestas multiplica super nos gratiam tuam ut ad tua promissa currentes caelestium bonorum facias esse consortes.
translation_en: God, who most clearly and mercifully shows your omnipotence, multiply your grace upon us, that running towards your promised heavenly goods, we may become their companions.

text: In Ieremia IV G 1007
translation_en: In Jeremiah IV, Chapter 7, Verse 1007

text: Deus qui omnium nomina temporumque mensuras pia semper largitate dispensas sanctorum tuorum nos quaesumus recitatis nominibus purifica precibus absolve a criminibus et salutaris continentiae dita muneribus ut per hoc sacrae festivitatis ieiunium sincerissimum tibi nostri cordis offeramus holocaustum.  Hanc itaque fidelium tuorum oblationem propitius ac sereno vultu Domine dignare respicere ut decurrente iam ieiuniorum nostrorum tempore haec nos oblatio et a praeieritis delictorum sordibus abluat et a futuris ut caveamus te miserante custodiat ut occursuri obviam tuae maiestati non pedum passibus sed contriti cordis nostri gressibus conclamari tibi puro mentis affectu »Gloria in excelsis Deo« cum Hebraeorum pueris mereamur.
translation_en:
God who always dispenses the names of all things and measures of time with your pious bounty, we humbly ask that you purify us through our prayers, absolve us from sins, and grant us the salutary gifts of continence so that through this sincere fasting of the holy festival, we may offer you a holocaust of pure hearts.
Therefore, Lord, graciously look upon this offering of your faithful, and with a serene countenance, deign to consider it; as the time of our fasting draws near, may this offering wash away the stains of past sins and protect us from future ones, since you show mercy. May we approach your majesty not on foot but with contrite hearts, and proclaim to you in a pure mind's affection: "Glory to God in the highest," together with the Hebrew boys, may we deserve it.

text: In Ieremia VI
translation_en: In Jeremiah Chapter VI

text: Deus qui omnium rerum tibi servientium naturam per ipsos motus aeris ad cultum tuae maiestatis instituis tranquillitatem nobis misericordiae tuae remotis largire terroribus ut cuius iram expavimus clementiam sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who through the movements of the air establish the nature of all things serving you, grant us tranquility by removing fears with your mercy, that we may feel your clemency instead of the terror of your wrath which we have feared.

text: Deus qui opprobrium sterilitatis a Rachel auferens dum anxietate prolem quaereret eam voluit fecundari concede propitius ut famula tua illa in earum feminarum quae tibi placuerunt sorte fecunditatem accipiat et quod fideliter a tua pietate deposcit obtineat.
translation_en: God, who took away the reproach of sterility from Rachel when she anxiously sought offspring, graciously grant that your servant may receive fruitfulness among those women whom you have favored. And may what she faithfully seeks from your mercy be obtained.

text: Deus qui ore prophetico cogitandam super nos cogitationem pacis non afflictionis promisisti cogita quaesumus cogitationem nostrae aeternae redemptionis et educ nos de captivitate tenebrarum ut videre possimus quae agenda sunt et quae recta sunt agere valeamus.
translation_en: God who promised us through the prophetic thought a consideration of peace, not affliction, we ask that you consider our thoughts for eternal redemption. Educate us from the captivity of darkness so that we may see what needs to be done and have the ability to do what is right.

text: In ipso die ita conficitur chrisma.
translation_en: On that day, chrism is thus consecrated.

text: Deus qui panem et vinum in corpus tuum et sanguinem caelesti benedictione convertis concede nobis per merita sancti Thomae martyris tui atque pontificis ut ad tuam misericordiam revertentes tuo beneplacito conformemur.
translation_en: God who turns bread and wine into your body and heavenly blood by the blessing of yours, grant us through the merits of Saint Thomas, your martyr and pope, that returning to your mercy, we may be conformed to your will.

text: In Isaia V G 1005
translation_en: In Isaiah, Chapter 5, Verse 1005

text: Deus qui paschalia nobis remedia contulisti populum tuum caelesti dono prosequere ut inde post in perpetuum gaudeat unde nunc temporaliter exsultat.
translation_en: God who has provided us with remedies for Paschal feasts, may your heavenly gift follow so that your people, who now rejoice temporarily, may henceforth rejoice forever.

text: In Isaia VIII
translation_en: In the eighth chapter of Isaiah

text: Deus qui pascis omnem animam carnalibus escis pasce nos quaesumus spiritalibus sacramentis et ab omnibus emunda delictis.
translation_en: God who feeds all flesh with corporeal food, feed us as well, we entreat you, with spiritual sacraments and cleanse us from all sins.

text: Deus qui passionis Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi miracula suscitasti dum vivificum sanguinem cum aqua mixtum de latere imaginis suae Iudaeorum lancea perfossae copiose produxisti da nobis famulis tuis tam mirabilibus signis monstratam eiusdem passionis virtutem cognoscere ut fructum eius accipere valeamus in gloriosa resurrectione.
translation_en: God, who raised the marvels of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, during his Passion when you mixed holy blood with water from the side of the image of the Jews pierced by a spear, grant us, your servants, to recognize such miraculous signs of his same Passion, so that we may be worthy to receive the fruit thereof in glorious resurrection.

text: In memoria aeterna erit iustus
translation_en: The righteous shall be remembered in eternal memory

text: Deus qui peccantium animas non vis perire sed culpas contine quam meremur iram et quam precamur super nos effunde clementiam ut de maerore gaudium tuae misericordiae consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God who does not want the souls of sinners to perish but their sins to be contained, as much anger as we deserve, and as much mercy as we beg for, pour out your clemency upon us, so that we may merit joy from your mercy through sorrow.

text: Deus qui peccati veteris hereditariam mortem in qua posteritatis genus omne successerat Christi tui Domini nostri passione solvisti dona ut conformes eidem facti sicut imaginem ’terreni’ naturae necessitate portavimus ita imaginem ’caelestis’ gratiae sanctificatione portemus.
translation_en: God, who by the passion of your Son, our Lord, solved the inheritance of death from the ancient sin that all posterity had succeeded in, grant that we, made like him, may bear the image of 'earthly' nature as necessary, so that we may carry the image of 'heavenly' grace through sanctification.

text: Deus qui per angelum tuum Raphaelem iter ostendisti beato Paterniano et obitum demonstrasti exaudi preces quas in eius tibi sollemnitate deferimus et qui digne tibi meruit famulari eius intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos absolve peccatis.
translation_en: God, who showed the way to your angel Raphael to Blessed Parentian and demonstrated his death, hear the prayers we offer on his solemnity. And you who deservedly served him, may his merits intercede for us and absolve us from all sins.

text: Deus qui per beatae Mariae virginis partum sine humana concupiscentia procreatum in Filii tui membra venientes paternis fecisti praeiudiciis non teneri praesta quaesumus ut huius creaturae novitate suscepta vetustatis antiquae contagiis exuamur.
translation_en: God, who through the birth of the Blessed Virgin Mary created your Son in his body without human desire, made him immune to paternal judgments. We humbly ask that you grant us, now that we have taken on this new creation, to shed off the ancient contagions of aging.

text: Deus qui per beati Ambrosii confessoris tui atque pontificis documenta agnitionem nobis veritatis reserasti fac nos quaesumus huius intercessione doctoris et a peccatis omnibus exui et aeternae vitae gaudiis admisceri.
translation_en: God who through the teachings of your confesser and bishop Saint Ambrose, revealed to us the understanding of truth, grant us we humbly ask, by his intercession, to be freed from all sins and admitted to the joys of eternal life.

text: Deus qui (per) beatissimum archangelum tuum Michaelem orationes omnium fidelium suscipere es dignatus petimus clementiam tuam ut quas in hoc templo pro nostris facinoribus effundimus preces tu benigne suscipe et esto propitius.
translation_en: We ask that you, God, are worthy to receive the prayers of all faithful through your most blessed archangel Michael. We humbly implore Your clemency to accept the petitions we pour out in this temple for our sins and graciously receive them. Be propitious.

text: Deus qui per beatissimum Ioannem praecursorem et martyrem tuum gentibus universis lumen baptismatis intulisti ut infidelitatem populorum quam profanae observantiae ritus intulerat regeneratio caelestis aboleret praesta Domine ut intercessio tanti vatis quae nobis est indulta per lavacrum purae conscientiae proficiat ad exemplum.
translation_en: God, who through the blessed John the Baptist and your martyr brought light of baptism to all nations so that the infidelity of the people which had been introduced by profane observance of rituals would be abolished by celestial regeneration, grant us, Lord. May the intercession of such a great prophet, which was granted to us through the lavar of pure conscience, profit for our example.

text: Deus qui per beatissimum Sebastianum martyrem tuum tuorum fidelium animos roborasti dum tibi illum latentem sub chlamyde terreni imperii militem perfectum exhibuisti fac nos semper in tuis laudibus militare. Os nostrum per arma documento iustitiae cor illustra tuae dilectionis amore atque carnem nostram erutam libidine clavis tuae crucis affige.
