translation_en: God who strengthened the spirits of your faithful ones through the blessed martyr Sebastian, when you showed him, perfect as a soldier, hidden under the cloak of earthly empire, make us always to fight in your praises. May our mouth be documented with weapons of justice, and may our heart be illuminated by your love for your affection. And may our flesh, torn by lust, be fastened by the keys of your crucifix.

text: Deus qui per beatum Ioannem Baptistam nec cibum nec potum incongrue sumere docuisti praesta ut eius instituto et iustitiam quam praedicando meruit sentiamus et vitam quam abstinendo professus est imitemur.
translation_en: God, who through the blessed John the Baptist taught us not to inappropriately consume food or drink, grant that we may feel the justice he earned through preaching and imitate the life he professed by fasting.

text: Deus qui per coaeternam tibi sapientiam hominem cum non esset condidisti perditumque misericorditer reformasti praesta quaesumus ut eadem pectora nostra inspirante te tota mente amemus et ad te toto corde curramus.
translation_en: God who, co-eternal with Thee, didst endow man with wisdom even before he was created and mercifully reformed the lost, grant us, we beseech Thee, that our hearts may be inspired by Thee to love Thee entirely with all our mind, and to run towards Thee entirely with all our heart.

text: Deus qui per gloriosa bella certaminis ad immortales triumphos beatos martyres tuos extulisti concede quaesumus ut eorum meritis protegamur in quorum festivitate laetamur.
translation_en: God, who raised your blessed martyrs to eternal triumph through glorious wars, we humbly ask that through their merits, we may be protected during their feast day on which we rejoice.

text: Deus qui per gloriosa bella certaminis immortalitatis triumphos martyribus condonasti da cordibus nostris dignam pro eorum commemoratione laetitiam ut quorum gaudemus triumphis provocemur exemplis.
translation_en: God who through glorious wars granted the immortality victories' triumphs to the martyrs, grant our hearts a worthy joy for their remembrance, that we may be inspired by their triumphs through their examples.

text: Deus qui per gloriosam resurrectionem unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi familiam tuam laetificare dignatus es praesta quaesumus ut per eius venerabilem genitricem virginem Mariam perpetuae vitae gaudia consequamur.
translation_en: God, who deigned to make your family rejoice through the glorious resurrection of your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, grant us we beseech you, that through his venerable mother the Virgin Mary, we may attain eternal life's joys.

text: Deus qui per huius celebritatis mysterium aeternitatis tuae lumen cunctis gentibus suscitasti da plebi tuae redemptoris sui plenum cognoscere fulgorem ut ad perpetuam claritatem per eius incrementa perveniat per quem eadem sumpsit exordia.
translation_en: God, who through the mystery of this solemnity have enlightened all nations with the light of your eternity, grant to your people a full understanding, so that they may know the brilliance of their Redeemer. May they, through his increments, arrive at eternal clarity and attain it by whom the same took its beginnings.

text: Deus qui per inaestimabile munus gratiae tuae sanctos tuos facis esse gloriosos praesta quaesumus ut interveniente beato Cuthberto consessore tuo atque pontifice mereamur ad culmen virtutum pervenire.
translation_en: God, who through the immeasurable gift of your grace make your saints glorious, grant us we beseech you, that with the intervention of the blessed Cuthbert, your bishop and pontiff, we may deserve to reach the summit of virtues.

text: Deus qui per ineffabile caelestis mysterii sacramentum sanctum Iulianum confessorem tuum ad superna subrogasti praesta fidelibus tuis ut qui eius laudamus meritum sentiamus supplementum.
translation_en: God who through the ineffable mystery of heaven raised up Your confessor Julian to higher things, grant to Your faithful that we who praise his merit may also feel its supplement.

text: Deus qui per ineffabilem observantiam sacramenti famulorum tuorum praeparas voluntates donis gratiae tuae corda nostra purifica ut quod sancta est devotione tractandum sinceris mentibus exsequamur.
translation_en: God, who through the ineffable observance of your sacrament prepares the wills of your servants, purify our hearts so that what is holy may be handled with devoted minds and sincere hearts, we may carry out.

text: Deus qui ad ineffabilis observantiam sacramenti famulorum tuorum praeparas voluntates donis tuis corda nostra purifica ut quod sancta est devotione tractandum sinceris mentibus exsequamur.
translation_en: God who prepares the wills of your servants at an ineffable regard for the sacrament, purify our hearts so that we may carry out what is holy with sincere minds according to devotion.

text: Deus qui per manus angeli tui argumentum rotarum quo certatrix Euphemia distendebatur mirifice confregisti tu ad sanctificanda haec oblata tibi libamina salutis e caelo nuntium mitte qui et ad te nostrorum vulnerum causas deferat et a te optatam nobis exhibeat medicinam.
translation_en: God, who by the hand of your angel broke the argument of the spinning wheels with which Euphemia was wonderfully stretched, you have shattered for the sanctification of these offerings presented to you, send a messenger from heaven who will also bring before you the causes of our wounds and show us the medicine we desire.

text: Deus qui per mortem Filii tui destruxisti mortale saeculum et per crucis eius patibulum nobis resurrectionis gratiam promisisti <concede nobis famulis tuis> ut ad caelestia regna transire mereamur.
translation_en: God who through the death of your Son destroyed the mortal world, and by the cross of his promised us the grace of resurrection, grant to us your servants that we may deserve to pass into heavenly realms.

text: Deus qui per os beatae Mariae Magdalenae dominicae resurrectionis gaudia sanctis apostolis innotescere voluisti tribue quaesumus ut eius praesidiis infirmitas nostra roboretur in terris de cuius profectu angeli gratulantur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who chose to make the joys of the resurrection of our Lord known through the mouth of blessed Mary Magdalene to the holy apostles, grant us, we ask, that through her protection our weakness may be strengthened on earth, for whose sake angels rejoice in heaven.

text: Inde descendendum in fontes
translation_en: Therefore, we are to descend into the fonts

text: Deus qui per os beatae Mariae Magdalenae dominicae resurrectionis gaudium primum sanctis apostolis praeloquendo innotescere voluisti ut ipsa in secundo Adam fieret nuntius vitae quae in primo propinaverat poculum mortis tribue quaesumus ut eius precibus infirmitas nostra roboretur in terris de cuius profectibus angeli gratulantur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who wished the joy of the Lord's resurrection to be made known first to the holy apostles through the words spoken by blessed Mary Magdalene, that she might become a messenger of life, which she had given the drink of death in the beginning, we humbly ask that our infirmity may be strengthened on earth from her prayers, whose departure the angels rejoice about in heaven.

text: Deus qui per os beati apostoli tui Ioannis evangelistae Verbi tui nobis arcana reserasti praesta quaesumus ut quod ille nostris auribus excellenter infudit intellegentiae competentis eruditione capiamus.
translation_en: God who through the mouth of your blessed apostle John, the evangelist, revealed to us mysteries of Your Word, grant us, we ask, that what he excellently poured into our ears may be understood with a fitting education.

text: Deus qui per sanctae crucis (lacuna) mirabilium tuorum mundo declarasti multitudinem tribue nobis per eius insuperabilem munitionem gloriae tuae perennem contra omnia adversa defensionem.
translation_en: God, who through the miracles of the holy cross revealed to the world your numerous wonders, grant us through its incomparable protection an everlasting defense against all adversities.

text: Deus qui per sancti Chrysantii eloquentiam beatam virginem Dariam convertisti concede ut quibus mens una caste vivendi et pro te fuit moriendi eis una sit pietas maiestatem tuam pro nobis intercedendi.
translation_en: God, who through the eloquence of Saint Chrysantius converted the blessed Virgin Daria, grant that for those whose minds were one in living chastely and dying for you, may their devotion also be one. Intercede on our behalf with your majesty.

text: Deus qui per sanctum angelum tuum Raphaelem caecum Tobiam illuminasti filioque suo cum Sara fugato daemone matrimonium consummasti ac cum eiusdem filii prospero conductu et multa substantia parentes suos laetificasti concede propitius ut per eundem angelum tuum illuminati fugatis animae adversariis cum vitae praesentis prosperitate ad te patrem animarum et sponsum laeti perveniamus.
translation_en: God who through your holy angel Raphael enlightened the blind Tobias, and brought his son with Sara to matrimony after driving away the demon, and with the prosperous guidance of the same son blessed their parents with much wealth; grant us graciously that through the same angel we may be enlightened, delivered from adversaries, and with prosperity in this present life, may we reach you, Father of souls and Spouse, rejoicing.

text: Deus qui per sanctum baptismum beatum Ambrosium tui nominis confessorem esse signasti praesta quaesumus ut eius meritis protegamur in cuius festivitate annua devotione laetamur.
translation_en: God who by the holy baptism marked blessed Ambrose as confessor of your name, grant us we ask, that we may be protected by his merits, on whose feast day we rejoice with annual devotion.

text: Deus qui per sanctum confessorem tuum antistitem Swithunum mederis languoribus infirmorum concede nobis tuum iuvamen per eius implorantibus interventionem praesentis vitae fungi salubritate et civium supernorum societate.
translation_en: God, who through your holy confessor, bishop Saint Swithun, alleviates the pains of the sick, grant us your help through his intercession, that we may live healthily in this present life and enjoy the fellowship of heavenly citizens.

text: Deus qui per sanguinem Iesu Christi Filii tui dedisti pacem hominibus et caelestium collegium angelorum da nobis et de tuae pacis ubertate repleri et de angelicae societatis unitate laetari.
translation_en: God, who through the blood of Jesus Christ, your Son, gave peace to men and formed the heavenly college of angels, fill us with your peace and enrich us from the abundance of your peace, and let us rejoice in the unity of the angelic society.

text: Deus qui per tuae legis praeceptum decimas tibi offerri praecipis frugum ut ex omnibus in tuis sacrariis inferantur famulos tuos illos votiva ad te concurrentes devotione et decimas tibi offerentes suarum frugum attende.  Ecce venerunt ad te decimum tibi deferentes substantiae; tu eis occurre et ab eis collatum multiplicium faenore redde. Non eos morbus non languor atterat non paupertas deiciat non divitiae extollant sed sic eos in praesenti vita locupletes redde ut post istud saeculum de substantiis te sibi propitiari confidant.
translation_en: God, who by the commandment of your law orders offerings of titles of crops so that they may be brought to your sacrificial places by your servants, who come to you with vows and offerings of their crops, pay attention. Behold, they bring to you the title of substances; let them find you present and return to them manifold rewards for what they have given. Neither disease nor weakness afflicts them, neither poverty casts them down nor wealth exalts them, but let them be wealthy in this life so that after this age they may trust in the substances they offer to propitiate you.

text: Deus qui per undas regenerationis beatum confessorem tuum Ambrosium a contagione vetusti criminis diluisti ablutumque purificationis lavacro doctorem praecipuum atque catholicae fidei propugnatorem efficere dignatus es praesta quaesumus ut ipso pro nobis intercedente vitiorum possimus abluere maculas et tibi domino sinceris mentibus deservire.
translation_en: God, who through the waves of regeneration cleansed your blessed confessor Ambrose from the contagion of an old crime, and who deemed him worthy to become a principal teacher and champion of catholic faith, grant us, we ask, that with him interceding for us, we may be able to cleanse ourselves of our sins, and serve you, Lord, with sincere minds.

text: Deus qui per unigenitum Filium tuum beatum Lazarum quatriduanum mortuum resuscitasti a monumento erige nos propitius de tumulis peccatorum ut mereamur adipisci consortium electorum tuorum.
translation_en: God who through your unique Son, the blessed Lazarus, raised from the tomb after four days, have mercy on us propitiously, that we may deserve to obtain the fellowship of your chosen ones.

text: Deus qui per unigenitum Iesum Christum Filium tuum Dominum nostrum sanctificationem salutis aeternae aquis regenerantibus praestitisti et veniente super caput illius spiritali columba per Spiritum Sanctum ipse venisti dona quaesumus ut veniat super hanc omnem Ecclesiam tuam illa benedictio quae cunctos iugiter protegat quae diversos sine cessatione benedicat quae cursum te sequentium dirigat quae se exspectationi omnium ianuam regni caelestis aperiat.
translation_en: God, who through your only-begotten Son Jesus Christ, our Lord, have conferred the sanctification of eternal salvation by waters of regeneration, and who sent the spiritual dove upon his head through the Holy Spirit, we ask that you come upon this entire Church of yours. That blessing which constantly protects, which blesses those who are diverse without ceasing, which directs the course of those following you, which opens the door to the kingdom of heaven for all expecting it.

text: Deus qui per unigenitum tuum aeternitatis nobis aditum devicta morte reserasti da nobis quaesumus ut qui resurrectionis dominicae sollemnia colimus per innovationem tui spiritus a morte animae resurgamus.
translation_en: God, who through your only-begotten Son gave us access to eternity by conquering death, grant us, we ask, that as we celebrate the solemnity of the Lord's resurrection, we may rise from the dead through the renewal of your Spirit.

text: Deus qui per unigenitum tuum aeternitatis nobis aditum devicta morte reserasti deduc nos ad societatem caelestium gaudiorum ut spiritu sancto renatos regnum tuum facias introire.
translation_en: God, who through your only-begotten Son opened to us the access of eternity by conquering death, lead us to the society of celestial joys. May we who have been reborn by the Holy Spirit enter your kingdom.

text: Deus qui per unigenitum tuum aeternitatis nobis aditum devicta morte reserasti erige ad te fidelium corda ut a terrenis cupiditatibus liberati ad caelestia desideria transeamus.
translation_en: God, who through your only-begotten Son have given us access to eternity by conquering death, raise the hearts of faithful people that, freed from earthly desires, we may pass over into heavenly longings.

text: Deus qui per unigenitum tuum aeternitatis nobis aditum devicta morte reserasti erige nos ad consedentem in dextera tua nostrae salutis auctorem ut qui iudicandus advenit pro nobis iudicaturus adveniat.
translation_en: God, who by your only-begotten one opened the way of eternity to us, conquering death, raise us up to sit on your right hand, our savior's author, so that the one who comes to judge for us may come and the judge who is coming may arrive.

text: Deus qui per unigenitum tuum devicta morte aeternitatis nobis aditum reserasti erige ad te tuorum corda credentium ut omnes regenerati apprehendant meritis quod suscepere mysteriis.
translation_en: God, who through your only-begotten one opened for us an entrance defeated death, raise up the hearts of your believing people so that all who are reborn may comprehend the reward they have received by accepting the mysteries.

text: Deus qui per unigenitum tuum exclusa dominatione diaboli populum tuum fide aptasti expelle quaesumus a famulo tuo illo cunctas diabolicae illusionis insidias et eum liberatum ab omni impugnatione conserva.
translation_en: God, who through your only-begotten Son freed your people from the dominion of the devil by faith, we humbly ask that you drive away from your servant all the snares of diabolic illusions and keep him free from every attack once he has been set free.

text: Deus qui per Verbum tuum humani generis reconciliationem mirabiliter operaris praesta quaesumus ut sancto ieiunio et tibi toto simus corde subiecti et in tua nos efficiamur pace concordes.
translation_en: God who by Your Word wonderfully work the reconciliation of the human race, grant us we ask, that we may be wholly subject to the holy fasting and with our whole heart be made agreeable to You, and be fashioned into a peaceable people.

text: Deus qui perennem gloriam sanctissimi confessoris tui atque pontificis Audoeni animae contulisti tribue quaesumus eius nos apud te ita patrociniis sublevari ut cum eo vitam possideamus aeternam.
translation_en: God, who granted the eternal glory to the most holy confessor and bishop Audoin, we humbly ask that you raise us under his patronage so that we may possess eternal life with him.

text: Deus qui plenitudinem mandatorum in tua et proximi dilectione posuisti hanc nobis gratiam largire propitius ut quia in multis offendimus tua caritas abundet in nobis per quam peccata mundantur.
translation_en: God, who placed the fullness of Your commandments in loving Yourself and Your neighbor, be merciful to grant us this grace. May it be that Your charity abounds in us, through which sins are forgiven.

text: Deus qui pluis super iustos et iniustos nostris etiam offensionibus per haec sacramenta relaxatis exspectata quaesumus imbrium munera largiaris quibus et salus nobis et alimenta praestentur.
translation_en: God who provides rain for the just and the unjust through these sacraments which have been released from our offenses, we humbly ask that you grant us the gifts of rain. Through this, may both salvation be provided to us and sustenance be supplied.

text: Iniquitates nostras ne respicias
translation_en: Do not look upon our iniquities

text: Deus qui populis tuis indulgentia consulis et amore dominaris da spiritum sapientiae quibus dedisti regimen disciplinae ut de profectu sanctarum ovium fiant gaudia aeterna pastorum.
translation_en: God who by kindness governs your peoples and rules with love, grant them the spirit of wisdom whom you have given the rule of discipline, that from the progress of the holy flock there may be eternal joy for the shepherds.

text: Illumina Domine quaesumus in te corda credentium
translation_en: Enlighten, we ask you, Lord, the hearts of believers in you

text: Deus qui populo tuo aeternae salutis beatum Martinum ministrum concessisti praesta quaesumus ut quem doctorem vitae habuimus in terris intercessorem semper habere mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who granted your people the blessed Martin as a minister of eternal salvation, grant us that we may merit to always have him as an intercessor on earth as we have had him as a teacher of life, may we always have him as an intercessor in heaven.

text: Deus qui populo tuo aeternae salutis beatum Martinum ministrum concessisti praesta quaesumus ut qui exsecutor mandatorum tuorum exstitit in terris intercessor noster semper esse dignetur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who granted your people the blessed servant Martin as a minister of eternal salvation, we ask that you grant him to be always our intercessor on earth and in heaven.

text: Deus qui populo tuo pastores praeesse voluisti famulum tuum episcopum nostrum illum quem praeesse et prodesse Ecclesiae tuae iussisti da quaesumus ut incessanter recta monendo et operando subditorum suorum mentes in tui amoris desiderio excitet et secundum te ad utilitatem sui provectus et aliorum vivere valeat.
translation_en: God, who willed that your people should be shepherded by pastors, grant us, we ask, that our bishop whom you have commanded to preside and profit your Church may constantly stir the minds of his subjects towards the desire for your love. May he, led by you, progress in his own benefit and that of others, and may he be able to live accordingly.

text: Deus qui populo tuo plenae praestitisti redemptionis effectum ut non solum unigeniti tui nativitate corporea sed etiam crucis eius patibulo salvaretur huius quaesumus fidei famulis tuis tribue firmitatem ut usque ad promissum gloriae tuae praemium ipso quoque gubernante perveniant.
translation_en: God, who provided your people with the full effect of redemption so that not only through the bodily birth of your unique Son but also through his cross they might be saved, we humbly ask that you grant strength to your servants of faith, that they may reach the promised reward of your glory, guided by him as well.

text: Immensam clementiam tuam
translation_en: Your immense clemency

text: Deus qui populo tuo sanctae Mildrithae festivitatem celebrare tribuisti concede propitius eius nos interventu a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus solvi et ab omni iugiter adversitate defendi.
translation_en: God, who granted to your people the festivity of Saint Mildrith, graciously grant us, that through her intervention we may be freed from the bonds of our sins and defended forevermore from all adversity.

text: Deus qui populo tuo sanctum dedisti Servatium praedicatorem concede quaesumus ut tanti pontificis intercessione et tuae pietatis defensione ab omnibus ubique liberemur adversis et tranquilla prosperitate in tua laude laetemur.
translation_en: God, who gave your holy people the preacher Servatius, we humbly ask that through the intercession of such a great pontiff and your protection, we may be freed from all adversities everywhere and enjoy tranquil prosperity in your praise.

text: Innumeras medellae tuae curas
translation_en: Your innumerable cares

text: Deus qui populos Pictorum et Britonum per doctrinam sancti Niniani episcopi et confessoris tui ad tuae fidei notitiam convertisti concede propitius ut cuius eruditione veritatis tuae luce perfundimur eius intercessione caelestis vitae gaudia consequamur.
translation_en: God, who converted the peoples of the Picts and Britons through the teaching of Saint Ninian, your bishop and confessor, graciously grant that we may be filled with the light of your truth by his education and attain the joys of eternal life through his intercession.

text: Deus qui populum tuum de hostis callidi servitute liberasti preces eius misericorditer respice et adversantes ei tua virtute prosterne.
translation_en: God who freed your people from the cunning slavery of enemies, graciously look upon their prayers and overturn them with your power against adversaries.

text: Deus qui populum tuum in deserto quadraginta annis pane caelesti satiasti et illis sitientibus fontem limpidissimum de petra produxisti nos spiritalibus escis corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi satiatos sempiterna protectione conserva.
translation_en: God who for forty years sustained your people in the desert with bread from heaven and produced for them the spring of the purest water from stone, keep us filled with the spiritual food and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, and preserve us forever under eternal protection.

text: Deus qui populum tuum sacro Iordane flumine transacto terram tuae fecisti promissionis intrare concede quaesumus ut et nos quoque maiestatis tuae revelato mysterio divina semper beneficia sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who made your people enter the land through the sacred Jordan river, we humbly ask that you grant us as well, so that we may always experience the divine benefits revealed by your majesty through the mystery of your promise.

text: Deus qui populum tuum sic corripis delinquentem ut benigna consolatione non deseras da quaesumus ut indignatio debita reis precantibus transferatur ad veniam.
translation_en: God who chastises your people so that they may not lack a benign consolation, we ask that you grant us. May the deserved anger be transferred to mercy for those praying to you.

text: Deus qui populum tuum tuae fecisti redemptionis participem concede nobis quaesumus ut de resurrectione dominica in perpetuo gratulemur.
translation_en: God who made your people a participant of redemption, grant us that we may thankfully celebrate the resurrection of our Lord forever.

text: Deus qui post baptismi sacramentum secundam ablutionem peccatorum eleemosynis indidisti respice propitius super famulum tuum illum cuius operibus tibi gratiae referuntur; fac eum praemio beatum quem fecisti pietate devotum.
translation_en: God, who after the sacrament of baptism bestowed a second cleansing of sins through alms, look upon your servant favorably towards him whose works bring you grace; make him worthy of the blessed reward that you made him devoted by piety.

text: Deus qui post baptismi sacramentum secundam peccatorum purgationem eleemosynis indidisti postulationes nostras benignus exaudi et pro earum largitione famulo tuo illi cunctarum propitius indulgentiam largire culparum.
translation_en: God, who after the sacrament of baptism granted us purification from sins through alms, hear our humble requests benevolently and, in return for their generosity, grant your servant grace to freely bestow forgiveness for past sins.

text: Deus qui praeclaro salutiferae crucis honore hodiernae nobis festivitatis gaudia dicasti tribue ut vitalis signi tuitione ab omnibus semper muniamur adversis.
translation_en: God, who has shown us the joy of today's festival of the salutary cross of great honor, grant that we may always be protected by your life-giving sign against all adversities.

text: Deus qui praeclara salutiferae crucis inventione hodiernae nobis festivitatis gaudia dedicasti tribue ut vitalis ligni tuitione ab omnibus muniamur adversis.
translation_en: God, who dedicated to us the joy of today's finding of the glorious wood of the cross, grant that we may be protected by your care from all adversities.

text: Deus qui praecursorem Filii tui tanto munere dedicasti ut pro ipso etiam capite plecti mereretur da nobis ex eius imitatione veritatis fortes testes exsistere et nullas adversitates mundi formidare.
translation_en: God, who dedicated your Forerunner, the Son of God, with such a great gift, that he might deserve to be scourged even on his head for him, make us also, through his imitation of truth, to stand strong witnesses, and fear no adversities of this world.

text: Deus qui praedicando aeterni regni evangelium romanum imperium praeparasti praetende famulis tuis illis principibus nostris arma caelestia ut pax ecclesiarum nulla turbetur tempestate bellorum.
translation_en: God who prepared the Roman Empire for preaching the gospel of eternal kingdom, grant armor from heaven to your servants, those princes of ours, so that the peace of the churches may not be disturbed by the storm of wars.

text: Deus qui praefecisti Moysen et Aaron duces populo tuo et in columna nubis ignisque verus ei ductor exstitisti da quaesumus nobis quoque electione gratiae tuae pium pontificem ut praeceptis tuis eius doctrina parentes terram repromissionis ingredi mereamur.
translation_en: God, who appointed Moses and Aaron as leaders for your people, and in the pillar of cloud and fire, you were their guide. Grant us too, we beseech you, with the grace of your election, a loyal pastor. May we deserve to enter the land of promise through his teaching of your precepts.

text: Deus qui praesentem diem beatae Fidis virginis martyrio facis esse sollemnem praesta Ecclesiae tuae ut cuius meritis gloriatur eius precibus adiuvetur.
translation_en: God who makes the present day a solemn one through the martyrdom of the blessed Faithful Virgin, grant to Your Church that it may boast in her merits and be helped by her prayers.

text: Deus qui praesentem diem beati Zenonis pontificis tui glorioso excessu fecisti sollemnem praesta ipsius nos apud te continuis adiuvari suffragiis et magnificis iugiter intercessionibus consolari.
translation_en: God, who on the blessed Zenon's glorious departure made this day solemn, grant us that we may be continually helped by his prayers before you and ever comforted by his grand intercessions.

text: Deus qui praesentem diem beatissimae Barbarae virginis et martyris tuae martyrio consecrasti tribue nobis quaesumus ut eius discamus exemplis et terrena despicere et caelestibus inhaerere.
translation_en: God, who consecrated the present day of the blessed Barbarae virgin and martyr through your martyrdom, grant us that we may learn from her examples and despise earthly things and cling to heavenly ones.

text: Deus qui praesentem diem honorabilem nobis in almi tui Syri glorioso transitu praestitisti da nobis tanti intercessione pontificis praesentis vitae fluctibus non teneri.
translation_en: God, who on the glorious transition of your holy Syrian Church granted us a worthy day, grant us such great intercession that we may not be swayed by the waves of this present life by the life of the present pontiff.

text: Deus qui praesentem diem honorabilem nobis in beati Ioannis nativitate fecisti da populis tuis spiritalium gratiam gaudiorum et omnium fidelium mentes dirige in viam salutis et pacis.
translation_en: God, who made this day honorable for us on the birth of the blessed John, grant your people spiritual grace for rejoicing and direct the minds of all the faithful on the way to salvation and peace.

text: Deus qui praesentis annua sollemnitatis gaudia in sancti confessoris tui atque pontificis Swithuni commemoratione populis Anglorum tribuisti hodierna luce da nobis ad illam pervenire beatitudinem quam ipse percepit cuius olympicam celebramus nativitatem.
translation_en: God who granted the joy of the present annual solemnity to the English people in commemoration of your confessor and bishop Saint Swithun, grant us to reach that beatitude which he himself experienced, whose Olympic games we celebrate today on his nativity.

text: Deus qui praesentium hominum vitam agnoscis diversarum necessitatum passionibus subiacere exaudi desideria supplicantium suscipe vota credentium. Si carorum salutem aut cordis agit morbus aut corporis manus medica dolorem maesti pestem pellat aegroti. Si iudicis aut ira vexat aut odium adsit potentia mitigatura praelatum liberatura subiectum. Si ad litem publicam discordes funesta intentio vocat dissidentium animos pax amica praeveniat. Si terreni itineris subeunda vexatio est angelum decerne custodem. Abigat daemones praedam bestiae errorem viae casum foveae insidiam furis vim latronis. Si adire maria navigaturus exoptat tu invisibilis gubernator beneficio sentiendus ingredere ut nec mentem in peccatum cupiditas lucro praecipitata dimergat nec navem in profundum tempestas vento excitata dissolvat. Tunc enim felicem substantiam pensabit qu(a)estum si innocentia non fuerit passa naufragium.
translation_en: God, who recognizes the life of men as burdened by diverse necessities and sufferings, hear the desires of suppliants, receive the prayers of believers. If illness affects their body, heart or mind, drive away sickness, disease, pain, sorrow, plague from the sick. If judgement, anger, or hatred oppresses, strengthens or troubles the powerful, free, liberate and subject them. May peaceful intention prevent the destructive purpose of disputing parties in public matters. When embarking on a terrestrial journey, let an angel be sent as a guard. Drive away demons, the errors of beasts, waywardness, pitfalls, cunning of thieves. If one is about to navigate towards Mary, make him feel your invisible Governor; may he not be led into sin by greed or tempted by profit, nor his ship be dissolved by tempestuous winds and storms. Then, if a fortunate substance seeks something desirable, may it not perish in shipwreck if innocence is not overtaken.

text: Deus qui praevenis vota poscentium tribue quaesumus ut et corporeis non destituamur alimentis et ab hostium formidine liberemur.
translation_en: God who precedes the prayers of those who ask, grant us we beseech you, that we may not be deprived of bodily sustenance and be freed from fear of the enemy.

text: Deus qui pro animarum expiatione nostrarum sacri ieiunii instituta mandasti fragilitati nostrae adiumenta concede et affectum caelestium mandatorum benignus inspira.
translation_en: God who commanded for our souls' expiation the sacred fast, grant us aid in our frailty, and inspire us with a benevolent disposition towards heavenly commands.

text: Deus qui pro magnitudine tua per universa diffunderis et ubique tamen adsistis discretius omnium voluntates qualitatibus locis temporibus atque personis votorum omnium capax propitiatus exaudi dum ad cunctos adspicis foves omnibus misereris.
translation_en: God, who extends yourself in magnitude throughout all, and yet are present more discretely to each will, quality, place, time, and person; capable and merciful, hear the prayers of all. As you behold all, you forgive all.

text: Deus qui pro nobis Filium tuum crucis patibulum subire voluisti ut inimici a nobis expelleres potestatem concede nobis famulis tuis ut antiqui hostis insidias tanti virtute mysterii superantes sincerissima tibi perpetuo mente famulemur.
translation_en: God who willed for us to suffer your Son on the cross to drive our enemies' power away, grant to us, your servants, that we may overcome the ancient enemy's deceit by the strength of this mystery, and with sincerest mind serve you forever.

text: Deus qui pro nobis Filium tuum crucis patibulum subire voluisti ut inimici a nobis expelleres potestatem concede nobis famulis tuis ut antiqui hostis temptamentis tua gratia protegente resistere valeamus.
translation_en: God, who willed for us to suffer your Son on the cross in order to drive away our enemies' power, grant us, your servants, that we may be able to resist the ancient enemy's temptations with your grace protecting us.

text: Deus qui pro nobis Filium tuum crucis patibulum subire voluisti ut inimici a nobis expelleres potestatem concede nobis famulis tuis ut resurrectionis gratiam consequamur.
translation_en: God, who willed for us to suffer your Son on the cross to drive enemies' power from us, grant to us, your servants, that we may obtain the grace of the resurrection.

text: Intra quorum nos consortio
translation_en: Among whom we are in fellowship

text: Deus qui pro nostrorum fructibus animorum prodire facis sufficientiam corporalem ne exterioribus mereamur egere subsidiis praesta quaesumus ut donis interioribus fecundemur.
translation_en: God who makes the sufficiency of our bodies for the fruit of our souls, grant that we may not deserve external help. We ask that you provide us with internal gifts, so that we may be fertile.

text: Deus qui pro redemptione nostra accepisti sanguinem Christi solve opera diaboli et omnes laqueos disrumpe peccati ut creaturam regenerationis nulla polluant contagia vetustatis.
translation_en: God, who for our redemption received the blood of Christ, dissolve the works of the devil and break all snares of sin, so that the creation may not be defiled by any contagion of old age.

text: Deus qui pro salute generis humani crucis patibulum pertulisti et sanguinem tuum pro redemptione nostra fudisti preces nostras placatus et benignus suscipere dignare ut hoc sacrificium quod tuae gratiae offero sereno vultu digneris respicere et misericordiam tuam mihi concede ut cum me de corpore exire iusseris pars iniqua in me non habeat potestatem sed angelus tuus me inter sanctos et electos collocet.
translation_en: God, who for the salvation of the human race bore the cross and poured out your blood for our redemption, graciously hear our prayers and be merciful. Deign to receive this sacrifice which I offer on behalf of your grace with a serene countenance, and grant me your mercy so that when you command me to leave my body, an unjust part shall not have power over me, but your angel may place me among the saints and the elect.

text: Deus qui pro salute mundi passus es et de corde tuo aquam et sanguinem per lanceam militis emanare fecisti concede propitius ut sacratissimi corporis tui veneranda perfossio peccatorum nostrorum sit plena remissio.
translation_en: God, who for the salvation of the world suffered and caused water and blood to flow from Your side through the lance of the soldier, graciously grant that the venerable piercing of Your most sacred body be fully filled with the remission of our sins.

text: Deus qui pro salute mundi sacrificium paschale fecisti propitiare supplicationibus nostris ut interpellans pro nobis pontifex summus quos per id quod nostri est similis reconciliat per id quod tibi est aequalis absolvat.
translation_en: God, who made the Paschal sacrifice for the salvation of the world, propitiate our supplications so that the High Priest intercedes for us. May He who is like us in what is ours reconcile us, and may He who is equal to You forgive us.

text: Deus qui proditoris apostatae ruinam ne apostolorum tuorum numerus sacratus perfectione careret beati Matthiae electione supplesti praesentia munera sanctifica et per ea nos gratiae tuae virtute confirma.
translation_en: God, who did not allow the number of your apostles to lack perfection due to the fall of the traitorous apostate, was supplemented by the election of blessed Matthew and filled us with sacred gifts. Through these, we are confirmed in the power of your grace.

text: Deus qui proditoris tui ruinam ne apostolorum tuorum numerus sacratus perfectione careret beati apostoli tui Matthiae electione supplesti praesta quaesumus ut eius protegamur meritis in cuius festivitate annua devotione laetamur.
translation_en: God, who did not allow the number of your traitors to lack perfection by the selection of your apostle Matthew, we ask that you provide for our protection through his merits, in whose annual feast we rejoice with devotedness.

text: Deus qui profundo consilio prospiciendo mortalibus sancta instituisti ieiunia quibus corda languentium salubriter curarentur tu animam nostram corpusque castifica corporis animaeque Salvator aeternae felicitatis benigne largitor.
translation_en: God, who looks down upon mankind with deep wisdom and has instituted holy fasts by which the sickly hearts may be healthily healed; grant that our soul and body may be purified. You, Savior of both body and spirit, graciously bestow eternal happiness.

text: Deus qui propter Ecclesiae tuae gubernacula disponenda sic eius principes sublimasti ut minimos quosque non deseras praesta quaesumus ut apostolicae fidei doctrinaeque vestigia vel longe sequamur imitando quae licet infirmo comitamur officio.
translation_en: God, who raised up the princes of Your church for the sake of governing it, we humbly ask that You provide what is needed for even the smallest among us to follow in the footsteps of the apostolic faith and doctrine. May we be guided by what we are able, though weak, to fulfill our duty.

text: Deus qui providentia tua caelestia simul et terrena moderaris propitiare romanis rebus et regibus ut omnis hostium fortitudo te pro nobis pugnante frangatur.
translation_en: God, who through your providence governs both heavenly and earthly matters, have mercy on the Roman state and kings. May all the strength of our enemies be broken as you fight for us.

text: Deus qui providentia tua caelestia simul et terrena moderaris qui misisti unigenitum Filium tuum in mundum ut per incarnationem suam credentibus gaudium afferret et pacem concede quaesumus ut populus tuus infestatione infidelium turbatus per incarnationem Domini nostri Iesu Christi de triumpho gaudium adipisci mereatur et omnis hostium nostrorum fortitudo te pro nobis pugnante frangatur.
translation_en: God, who through Your providence govern both the heavenly and earthly realms, who sent Your only-begotten Son into the world that by His incarnation He might bring joy to believers and grant peace. We entreat You to grant that Your people, troubled by the hostility of unbelievers, may attain joy through the triumph of our Lord Jesus Christ and that every power of our enemies be shattered as You fight for us.

text: Deus qui prudentem sinceramque concordiam tuorum cordibus inesse voluisti da nobis legitimae dilectionis tenere mensuram ut qui a iustae pacis puritate dissentiunt in nobis tamen quod merito debeant lacerare non habeant.
translation_en: God, who willed that a prudent and sincere harmony be within your hearts, grant us the measure of lawful affection, so that those who disagree from the purity of just peace may not find in us what they deserve to tear apart.

text: Deus qui refrigerium iustis et gehennam impiis praeparasti cuiusque auxilio beatus Laurentius in ferrea crate distentus aestuantis incendii flammas edaces contempto persecutore devicit concede propitius ut eius orationibus sive meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who has prepared refreshment for the just and Gehenna for the unjust, by whose help blessed Laurence, stretched out on a red-hot grid while enduring scorching flames, scorned his persecutor and overcame them. Grant us your grace propitiously, that we may be helped by his prayers or merits.

text: Deus qui regio semine beatae Annae mundum gratia caelum gloria replesti da nobis in eiusdem filiae fructu ventris benedictione spiritualiter refici et aeternaliter repleri.
translation_en: God who filled the world and heaven with grace and glory through the seed of blessed Anne, grant us spiritually to be refreshed in the fruit of her womb's blessing, and eternally to be filled.

text: Deus qui regnis omnibus aeterno dominaris imperio inclina ad preces humilitatis nostrae aures misericordiae tuae et romani regni adesto principibus ut tua tranquillitate clementes tua sint semper virtute victores.
translation_en: God who rules all with eternal sovereignty, incline the ears of your mercy to our humble prayers, and attend to the rulers of Rome that they may always be merciful in your tranquility and victorious in your power.

text: Deus qui regnorum omnium regumque es dominator supplicationes nostras clementer exaudi et famuli tui illius regis eiusque exercitus tibi subditum protege principatum ut tua virtute muniti omnibus sint hostibus fortiores et qui in sua feritate confidunt potentiae tuae brachio comprimantur.
translation_en: God who is the ruler of all kingdoms and the master of kings, graciously hear our supplications and protect your servant, the king's subject and his army under you. May they be stronger against every enemy with Your power fortified, and those who boast in their own arrogance be brought down by the might of Your arm.

text: Deus qui remedia salutis humanae in praesentis mysterii sollemnitate posuisti da nobis ut sicut haec apostolorum tuorum praedicatione cognovimus ita eorum suffragiis consequamur.
translation_en: God who placed the remedies of human salvation in this mystery's solemnity, grant us that, just as we have come to know through the preaching of your apostles, so may we attain through their intercession.

text: Deus qui renatis baptismate mortem adimis et vitam tribuis sempiternam concede quaesumus ut quorum nunc regenerationis sacrae diem celebramus octavum ita corpora eorum animasque custodias ut gratiam se catholicae fidei percepisse pietatis tuae defensione cognoscant.
translation_en: God who removes death through baptism and grants eternal life, grant us that those whose sacred regeneration we now celebrate on the octave may keep their bodies and souls safe, so that they may recognize by the protection of your grace that they have received the favor of the Catholic faith.

text: Deus qui renatis fonte baptismatis delictorum indulgentiam tribuisti praesta misericors ut recolentibus huius nativitatis insignia plenam adoptionis gratiam largiaris.
translation_en: God who bestowed forgiveness at the font of baptism, mercifully grant that you may bestow full grace of adoption to those who are returning with the symbols of this nativity.

text: Deus qui renatis per aquam et spiritu sancto caelestis regni pandis introitum auge super famulos tuos gratiam quam dedisti ut qui ab omnibus sunt purgati peccatis a nullis priventur promissis.
translation_en: God who are born through water and the Holy Spirit, who opens the entrance to your celestial kingdom, increase upon your servants the grace that you have given, so that those who have been purged of all sins by others may not be deprived of any promises.

text: Deus qui renuntiantibus saeculo mansionem paras in caelo dilata sanctae huius congregationis temporale habitaculum caelestibus bonis ut fraternae teneantur compagine caritatis unanimes continentiae praecepta custodiant sobrii simplices et quieti gratis sibi datam gratiam fuisse cognoscant; concordet illorum vita cum nomine professio sentiatur in opere.
translation_en: God who prepares a dwelling in heaven for those renouncing the world, extends the temporal abode of this holy congregation to them as a celestial dwelling for the good. May they, united by brotherly love and the teachings of continence, recognize the grace freely given to them in simplicity and quietness; may their life conform to their profession and their feeling be evident in their deeds.

text: Deus qui restaurationem condicionis humanae mirabilius operaris quam substantiam condidisti tribue quaesumus ut simul perficiatur in nobis et quod creavit Verbi tui divina generatio et quod eius hominis facti gloriosa nativitas reformavit.
translation_en: God, who works miraculously the restoration of the human condition more than the substance that you created, grant us that it may be accomplished in us at the same time, and what was created by your divine generation and what his glorious nativity reformed by the birth of your Word.

text: Deus qui restaurationem condicionis humanae mirabiliter operaris tribue quaesumus ut simul perficiatur in nobis quod Verbi tui creavit dignatio et quod eius hominis facti gloriosa nativitas reformavit.
translation_en: God, who wonderfully works the restoration of the human condition, we humbly ask that it may be fulfilled in us what your dignity created when you were born, and what his glorious nativity reformed.

text: Deus qui resurgens a mortuis passione cassam potentiorem te tuis discipulis reddidisti concede propitius ut nos quoque maiestati tuae hoc paschale sacrificium conciliet et ad gratiam tuam promerendam in bonis operibus efficiat promptiores.
translation_en: God, who made yourself stronger by rising from the dead and breaking the bonds of Passion, grant us your grace propitiously. May this Easter offering unite us with your majesty, and may it make us more eager to perform good works for the merit of your grace.

text: Deus qui sacerdotis tui excellentissimi Cuthberti vitam omni gloria apostolica decorasti praesta quaesumus ut qui glorificae translationis suae festa celebramus per ipsius suffragia tua semper consequamur beneficia.
translation_en: God, who adorned the life of your most excellent priest Cuthbert with all apostolic glory, grant us, we pray, that we who celebrate the festival of his glorious translation, may always follow through his intercession the benefits of your grace.

text: Deus qui sacrae legis omnia constituta in tua et proximi dilectione posuisti da nobis horum propitius efficientiam mandatorum quia impossibile sibi nullus excusat quod tanta brevitate concluditur tanta aequitate praecipitur.
translation_en: God, who has established all things of the sacred law in Your and Your neighbor's love, grant us, gracious Lord, the effective power of these commandments, for no one excuses himself from what is so briefly concluded, yet is so justly commanded.

text: Deus qui sacramenti tui veneranda perceptione nos satiasti tribue quaesumus beato Hieronymo confessore tuo interveniente nobis per haec a peccatorum nostrorum vinculis absolvi.
translation_en: God, who satisfied us with the venerable reception of your sacrament, we humbly ask that you grant through the intervention of your confessor Saint Jerome, that we may be freed from the bonds of our sins.

text: Deus qui sacramento festivitatis hodiernae universam Ecclesiam tuam in omni gente et natione sanctificas in totam mundi latitudinem spiritus tui sancti dona defunde et quod inter ipsa evangelicae praedicationis exordia operata est divina dignatio nunc quoque per credentium corda diffunde.
translation_en: God who sanctifies your Church throughout the world in every tribe and nation by the sacrament of today's festival, pour out your Holy Spirit upon all its extent. May the divine grace that was at work from the beginning of the evangelical proclamation now also be spread through the hearts of believers.

text: Deus qui sacrandorum tibi auctor es munerum ad sanctificationem loci huius propitius adesse dignare ut qui haec in honorem tui nominis condiderunt protectorem te habere in omnibus mereantur.
translation_en: God, who are the author of sacred offerings for the sanctification of this place, graciously grant that they who have built these things in honor of your name may merit you as a protector in all things.

text: Deus qui sacrandorum tibi auctor es munerum effunde super hanc orationis domum benedictionem tuam ut ab omnibus invocantibus nomen tuum defensionis tuae auxilium sentiatur.
translation_en: God, who are the author of all sacraments, pour out Your blessing upon this house of prayer, that everyone calling upon Your name may feel the help of Your defense.

text: Deus qui sacratissimam virginem Mariam unigeniti tui matrem mutuae consolationis gratia beatam Elizabeth visitare fecisti concede propitius nobis famulis tuis ut ex eius visitationibus assidue consolemur et a cunctis adversitatibus tuo munimine protegamur.
translation_en: God, who graciously visited the most sacred Virgin Mary, your only begotten Son's mother, blessed Elizabeth, grant us favorably, that we, Your servants, may constantly be consoled by her visits and protected from all adversities by Your protection.

text: Deus qui sacratissimis virginibus tuis Katherinae et Margaretae martyrii palmam et beatissimae Mariae Magdalenae criminum veniam concessisti concede propitius ut earum intervenientibus meritis et precibus et castitatis gratia decorari et a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus mereamur absolvi.
translation_en: God who granted the palm of martyrdom to your most sacred virgins Catherine and Margaret, and forgiveness of sins to the blessed Mary Magdalene, graciously grant that we may be adorned through their merits and prayers and the grace of chastity, and that we may deserve to be freed from the bonds of our sins.

text: Deus qui sacratissimum decus primitivae Anglorum ecclesiae praeconem veritatis sanctum pontificem Augustinum mirifice rutilare dedisti tribue quaesumus ut cuius annuam sollemnitatem hodierna die celebramus iti terris de eiusdem patrociniis gaudere mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: God, who magnificently made St. Augustine, the herald of truth and holy bishop of the primitve English church, shine forth, we ask that you grant us to deserve on earth to rejoice under his patronage on this day when we celebrate his annual feast day, so that in heaven we may merit joy.

text: Deus qui saeculorum omnium cursum ac momenta temporum regis exaudi nos propitius et concede ut famulo tuo illi cuius hodie natalem genuinum celebramus consecratione mysterii longaevam largiaris aetatem quatenus fidei eius augmento multis annorum curriculis haec sollemnitatis devotio perseveret.
translation_en: God who rules the course of all ages and moments of time, hear us graciously and grant that you may bestow upon your servant, whom we today celebrate the genuine birthday of, a long lifetime through the consecration of the mystery. May this devotion to this solemnity persist for many years as faith in him grows.

text: Deus qui sanare omnibus modis peccata populi tui cupiens observantiam ieiuniorum sanitatem ieiunantium esse dixisti da ut ieiunium nostrum sit salvatio animarum et humiliatio corporum veniamque obtineat omnium delictorum atque ita exhomologesis haec populo tuo prosit ut pro universae ecclesiae membris et pro totius mundi corpore supplicantes exaudiamur ac dum pro omnibus preces effundimus salutem viventium et requiem defunctorum impetrare facilius mereamur.
translation_en: God, who willingly desires the healing of all kinds of sins of Your people and health for those fasting, as You said that our fasting may be salvation for souls and humiliation for bodies, grant us so that our fasting may obtain forgiveness for all offenses. May this prayer benefit Your people so that on behalf of all members of the Church and for the whole body of the world, we who are supplicating are heard. And while we pray for all, let it be easier for us to merit life for the living and peace for the dead.

text: Deus qui sanctae martyri tuae Eulaliae pro poena gloriam pro morte vitam pro infirmitate virtutem pro passione coronam tribuisti praesta ut sicut illa exsultat in gloria sic nos de tua misericordia gratulemur et in aeternum veniam te donante consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God who granted to your holy martyr Eulalia glory for her punishment, life for her death, virtue for her weakness, and a crown for her passion, grant that we may rejoice in glory as she does, and may be grateful for your mercy, and may merit to obtain eternal forgiveness through your gift.

text: Deus qui sanctae virginis tuae Dorotheae fidem ita exuberantis constantiae dono glorificas ut catasta imposita et vultu placida et animo ostenderetur iucunda tu nobis spiritalem confer laetitiam qua repleti atque muniti et delictorum sordibus careamus et pacis abundantia te concedente locupletemur.
translation_en: God, who glorifies the faith of your holy virgin Dorothea so abundantly with unwavering constancy, grant us the spiritual joy that she showed, when placed upon the throne and with a calm countenance and a peaceful spirit. May we be filled and fortified with it, so that we may be free from the dirt of sins and enriched by your abundance of peace.

text: Deus qui sanctam diei huius sollemnitatem venerabilem nobis pro depositione beatae Radegundis Ecclesiae tuae consecrasti suscipe propitius ipsa interveniente orationem nostram et tribue nobis per haec sancta mysteria quae sumpsimus misericordiam tuam ut his suffragantibus libaminibus simul cum sanctae Radegundis praesidiis ab omnibus vitae huius periculis liberemur.
translation_en: God, who consecrated the venerable solemnity of this day for us in honor of the deposition of Blessed Radegund in your Church, have mercy on us. Grant us, through these holy mysteries which we have received, Your mercy so that, with the help of blessed Radegund's intercession, we may be freed from all dangers of this life.

text: Deus qui sanctam huius diei sollemnitatem pro commemoratione sancti Lamberti martyris tui atque pontificis fecisti adesto familiae tuae precibus ut qui eius merita in  praesenti festivitate recolimus patrocinia in augmento virtutum sentiamus.
translation_en: God, who made this day's solemnity for the commemoration of Saint Lambert, your martyr and bishop, be present with your family's prayers. May we feel an increase in virtue as we recall his merits during this present festivity, and may we experience his patronage.

text: Deus qui sanctam martyrem tuam Christinam caelesti igne succensam lumen omnibus oblatione proprii corporis voluisti imitabilem demonstrare concede nobis ut sicut illa superando spiritalium nequitiarum bella nomini tuo claruit ita et nos devictis vitiorum criminibus perfecta cordium puritate tibi semper placere mereamur.
translation_en: God, who chose to demonstrate your holy martyr Christina, inflamed by celestial fire, as an example for all through the offering of her own body, grant us that, just as she shone in overcoming the battles of spiritual wickedness for Your name, so we may always merit to please You with a perfectly pure heart, having overcome the sins and their crimes.

text: Deus qui sanctam nobis diei huius sollemnitatem praedicandi ac venerabilis sacerdotis tui depositione Martini episcopi praestare dignatus es tribue quaesumus ut quod nostris obtinere precibus non possumus ipsius mereamur obtinere suffragiis.
translation_en: God, who have deigned to bestow upon us the holy solemnity of this day through the preaching and venerable priesthood of your servant Martin the bishop, grant us we ask, that what we are unable to obtain through our prayers, may we be worthy to obtain through his intercession.

text: Deus qui sanctam nobis huius diei sollemnitatem inhonorem sanctorum confessorum tuorum atque pontificum Medardi et Gildardi consecrasti adesto familiae tuae precibus et dona ut quorum festa celebramus eorum merito et auxilio sublevemur.
translation_en: God, who on this day consecrated the solemnity of the holy confessors and bishops Medard and Gildard for our honor, be present with your prayers to our family, and grant that we may be lifted up by their merit and intercession as we celebrate their feast.

text: Deus qui sanctam nobis huius diei sollemnitatem pro beatarum virginum martyrumque tuarum gloriosa passione fecisti adesto familiae tuae precibus et da ut quarum hodie festa celebramus earum meritis et intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who on this day made holy for us through the glorious passion of your blessed virgins and martyrs, be present to your family's prayers and grant that we may be helped by their merits and aided by their intercessions as we celebrate their feast.

text: Deus qui sanctam nobis huius diei sollemnitatem pro commemoratione beati martyris tui illius vel passione fecisti adesto familiae tuae precibus et da ut cuius hodie festa celebramus eius meritis et intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God, who on this day made holy for the commemoration of your blessed martyr, either through his passion, have you attended to our prayers. Grant that we, who celebrate his feast today, may be aided by his merits and intercessions.

text: Deus qui sanctam nobis sollemnitatem huius diei beatissimi martyris tui illius passione venerari fecisti adesto familiae tuae precibus ut cuius hodie festa celebramus eius meritis <et> intercessione quas timemus culpas evadere possimus.
translation_en: God, who made us worthy to venerate the holy solemnity of this day, the most blessed martyr of yours through his passion, be present with your prayers. So that we, who celebrate today's feast because of his merits, may be able to escape the sins that we fear, through his intercession.

text: Deus qui sancti martyris tui Symphoriani nobis suffragia dedisti da nobis ut illius instruamur fide cuius patrocinio adiuvamur ut dum tibi in eius sollemnitate hostiam laudis offerimus pietati tuae nostris obsequiis placeamus.
translation_en: God, who have granted us the intercession of your saint martyr Symphorian, grant us that we may be instructed in his faith, upon whose patronage we are helped. As we offer a sacrifice of praise to you on his solemnity, may our services please your piety.

text: Deus qui sanctis martyribus ad sempiternam gloriam veniendi copiosum munus gratiae contulisti da nobis famulis tuis nostrorum veniam peccatorum ut sanctorum tuorum intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus mereamur adversitatibus liberari quatenus ad eorum nos facias gaudia aeterna perungere de quorum nos virtute tribuis cottidiana sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: God, who richly bestowed the generous gift of grace upon the holy martyrs for their eternal glory, grant us, your servants, forgiveness for our sins, that we may be worthy to be freed from all adversities through the merits of your saints. May you make us partake in their eternal joy, whose power we celebrate daily with solemnity.

text: Deus qui sanctis tuis Abdon et Sennen ad hanc gloriam veniendi copiosum munus gratiae contulisti da famulis tuis suorum veniam peccatorum ut sanctorum tuorum intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus mereantur adversitatibus liberari.
translation_en: God, who richly bestowed the abundant gift of grace upon your saints Abdon and Sennen for this coming glory, grant to your servants forgiveness for their sins, so that they may be worthy of deliverance from all adversities through the merits of your saints interceding on their behalf.

text: Deus qui sanctis martyribus tuis Crispino et Crispiniano coronam martyrii praestitisti concede quaesumus ut eorum intercessione veniam consequamur delictorum et aeterna gaudia beatorum.
translation_en: God who granted the crown of martyrdom to your saints Crispin and Crispinian, we humbly ask that through their intercession, we may obtain forgiveness for our sins and everlasting joy with the blessed.

text: Deus qui sanctis tuis aeternae beatitudinis praemia contulisti concede propitius ut qui peccatorum nostrorum pondere premimur eorum apud te precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God who has granted eternal beatitude's rewards to your saints, graciously grant that we who are pressed by the weight of our sins may be helped by their prayers with you.

text: Deus qui sanctis tuis Acaunensibus pro tuitione christiani nominis persecutionis audaciam sustulisti eorumque animum ad adipiscendam dignitatis tuae martyrio perfulgentem gratiam incitasti exaudi supplices tuos et praesta ut sicut illi tuo munere meruerunt beatifice coronari ita eorum suffragiis ab omni colluvione peccati te auxiliante reddamur innoxii.
translation_en: God who lifted the boldness of persecution from your saints of Acaunensians for the protection of the Christian name, and who stirred up in them a shining grace for acquiring the dignity of martyrdom, hear our supplications and grant that just as they merited to be crowned blessedly through your gift, so through their intercessions, with you helping us, we may be made innocent from all contamination of sin.

text: Deus qui sanctis tuis in confessione tui nominis virtutem atque victoriam contulisti tribue quaesumus ut dum beati sacerdotis et martyris tui Xysti merita veneramur studia ?eius imitari mereamur.
translation_en: God, who granted power and victory to your saints in the confession of your name, grant us we beseech you, that while we revere the merits of your blessed priest and martyr Xystus, we may be worthy to imitate his studies.

text: Deus qui sanctis tuis dedisti piae confessionis inter tormenta virtutem largire fidelibus populis inter huius mundi temptamenta constantiam veritatis ut sicut illos sanctus spiritus roborando sempiternam provexit ad gloriam sic istos iugiter tua gratia gubernando ad misericordiam perducat aeternam.
translation_en: God, who gave strength to your saints in the pious confession amidst torments, grant constancy in truth to faithful peoples amidst the trials of this world. Just as the Holy Spirit strengthened them to eternal glory, so may your grace constantly guide them to everlasting mercy.

text: Deus qui sanctis tuis martyribus Quirico et Iulittae vincendi solatium et immensam vincentibus gloriam aeternam concedis et laceratas carnes eorum tamquam odorem bonum suavitatis assumis tribue quaesumus ut sicut eis coronam martyrii praestitisti ita nobis peccatorum nostrorum veniam largiaris.
translation_en: God who grants to your holy martyrs Quiricus and Julitta consolation in conquering and eternal glory immeasurable to the conquerors, and takes up their lacerated flesh as a fragrant aroma of sweetness, we beseech you to grant that, just as you bestowed upon them a crown of martyrdom, so you may also forgive us our sins.

text: Deus qui sanctis tuis Servando et Germano tantam gratiam in passione dedisti ut insigniter apertum fidei vincerent hostem qui primum spiritaliter in se bella sui corporis devicissent praebe nobis auxilium de tua pietate firmissimum quo muniti atque praecincti et rebellantem spiritui carnem valeamus compescere et nos ipsos intrepidos studeamus bellis spiritalibus praeparare.
translation_en: God, who granted such great grace to your saints Servandus and Germanus in their passion that they conspicuously overcame the enemy of the faith whom they first spiritually defeated in bodily battles, grant us firm assistance from Your pity, so that fortified and girded, we may be able to restrain rebellious flesh and strive to prepare ourselves for spiritual wars with unshaken courage.

text: Deus qui sanctis virginibus palmam largiris in caelestibus praesta quaesumus ut precibus sanctae Edburgae muniamur cuius merita sollemni recordatione veneramur.
translation_en: God who grants a palm to the holy virgins in heaven, grant us we beseech you, that we may be protected by the prayers of Saint Edburg, whose merits we celebrate on this solemn occasion.

text: Deus qui sanctissimi sacerdotis tui Bedae templum cordis Sancti Spiritus illustratione irradiasti concede nobis quaesumus illius obtinentibus meritis gaudenter pervenire ad gaudia aeternae felicitatis.
translation_en: God who illuminated the temple of your most holy priest Beda with the radiance of the Holy Spirit, grant us, we ask, that through his merits we may joyfully arrive at the joys of eternal happiness.

text: Deus qui sancto ac beatissimo martyri tuo illi id muneris contulisti ut qui propter te peregit illatae passionis liberaliter cursum huius multitudinis mereretur occursum praesta nobis ut eius suffragio offerentium vota suscipias et requiem defunctis impertias donans omnibus nobis ita tui martyris imitari fidem ut consimilem a te post transitum mereamur invenire mercedem.
translation_en: God, who bestowed upon your holy and blessed martyr the gift that he might deserve to run the course of this multitude generously on account of you, bestow upon us that through his intercession we may receive the granting of our prayers and grant rest to the departed, giving to all of us the grace to imitate the faith of your martyr in such a way that after our passing we may merit to find the reward from you.

text: Deus qui sancto martyri tuo illi tantum ardorem tuae dulcedinis contulisti ut non cederet poenalibus flammis habitans in eo tuae dilectio caritatis praesta nobis ut pacis bono adcincti careamus scandalis expiemur delictis et aeternae semper praestolemur gloriam visionis.
translation_en: God, who bestowed such ardor of your sweetness upon your saintly martyr that he would not yield to penal flames while dwelling in him, grant us so that, clothed in the good of peace, we may avoid scandals and be purged of sins; may we always present ourselves worthy of eternal glory through the vision.

text: Deus qui sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cantianorum gloriosi fecisti palmam florere certaminis da nobis quaesumus hostis nostri fortia superare temptamina ut quod nostris meritis non valemus accipere ipsorum quorum natalicia celebramus precibus assequamur.
translation_en: God, who made the palm of victory flourish for your glorious martyrs the Cantians, grant us, we beseech you, that our enemies may overcome their strong tests, so that what we are unable to receive through our merits, we may obtain through the prayers of those whose feast day we celebrate.

text: Deus qui sanctorum martyrum tuorum Kiliani et sociorum eius mentibus virtutem constantiae in passione adspirasti concede propitius ut sicuti illi devicto persecutore coronari a te meruerunt ita nos eorum interventione tua semper protectione defendi et ad aeternae beatitudinis gaudia pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: God who inspired the virtues of constancy in the passions of your martyrs Kilian and his companions, graciously bestow that we who have been defeated by the persecutor may also merit to be crowned by you. May it be so that through their intercession and your constant protection, we are always defended. May we also deserve to reach the joys of eternal beatitude.

text: Deus qui sanctorum tuorum dirigis gressus amove a nobis iniquitatis viam et nostri tua lege miserere ut non obliti iudicia tua viam mandatorum tuorum dilatato corde curramus.
translation_en: God, who guides the steps of your saints, remove from us the way of iniquity. Have mercy on us according to your law, that we may not forget your judgments and, with our hearts expanded, run the path of your commandments.

text: Deus qui sanctorum tuorum Quirici et Iulittae cordibus flammam tuae dilectionis accendis da cordibus nostris eandem fidei caritatisque virtutem ut quorum gaudemus triumphis provocemur exemplis.
translation_en: God who kindles in the hearts of your saints Cyrus and Julitta the flame of your love, grant to our hearts the same power of faith and charity, that we may be inspired by their triumphs and moved by their examples.

text: Deus qui sancto Stephano martyri tuo et principatum in ministerio et principem in martyrio locum contulisti dum nobis sancti diei huius festivitatem pro eius vel commemoratione vel passione donasti exaudi quaesumus supplices familiae tuae preces; nobis eius peculiare praesidium tribue cuius pro inimicis ac peccatoribus preces piissimus acceptasti; tribue etiam ut pro nobis intercessor exsistat qui pro suis persecutoribus supplicavit.
translation_en: God, who placed Saint Stephen in your service as a minister and made him a leader in martyrdom, on this holy day's festival you have given us, either for his commemoration or passion, we humbly beseech you to hear the prayers of your family. Grant us his particular protection, whose most compassionate prayers you have accepted for enemies and sinners. Also grant that an intercessor may exist for us, who prayed for his persecutors.

text: Deus qui sanctorum Thebaeorum martyrum beatissimae legionis Mauricii Exsuperii Candidi Victoris Innocentii et Vitalis et eorundem sociorum gloriosi fecisti palmam florere certaminis eorumque natalicia digne nos celebrare concedis da nobis quaesumus nostrorum veniam delictorum et quod meritis non praesumimus ipsorum assequi precibus mereamur.
translation_en: God, who made the palm of the most blessed legion of Theban martyrs Mauritius, Exsuperius, Candidus, Victor, Innocentius, Vitalis, and their companions to flourish in their contest, and who grant us worthy celebration of their natalities; grant us, we beseech you, forgiveness for our sins, and through their prayers may we deserve what we presume not to attain by our own merits.

text: Deus qui sanctorum Thebaeorum martyrum Mauricii Exsuperii Candidi Victoris et Innocentii et Vitalis sociorumque beatissimam legionem vitali<s> mortis pretio vexisti ad caelos et pii fecisti palma florere certaminis da populo tuo ut pura mente in laudum tuarum debitis dono resplendeat divinitatis.
translation_en: God, who adorned the legion of the holy martyrs Mauritius, Exsuperius, Candidus, Victoris, Innocentius, and Vitalis with the most blessed band of brothers, and led them to heaven with the price of a vital death, made the palm of victory bloom for your people. May they shine brightly among your praises with a pure mind in the gift of your divinity.

text: Deus qui hunc diem passione Thebaeorum martyrum consecrasti et beatissimam legionem vitalis mortis praemio evexisti ad caelos et pii fecisti palma florere certaminis ut purae nostrae mentis laude <dono> divinitatis splendeamus
translation_en: God who consecrated this day of the Passion of the Theban martyrs and brought the most blessed legion to bloom in heaven with the reward of life, made the palm flower in the contest of piety so that we may shine with the praise of our pure minds for the brilliance of divinity.

text: Deus qui sanctorum tuorum libenter suscipis voluntates intercedente beato Cuthberto familiam tuam miserationis tuae dextera semper et ubique protege.
translation_en: God, who gladly receives the wishes of your saints through the intercession of Blessed Cuthbert, always and everywhere protect your family with your right hand of mercy.

text: Deus qui sanctorum tuorum meritis Ecclesiam tuam toto orbe diffusam decorasti praesta quaesumus ut intercessione beatissimi pontificis tui Aidani in sorte iustorum tua optanda pietate censeamur.
translation_en: God who have adorned your Church throughout the world with the merits of your saints, we humbly ask that you consider us worthy through the intercession of your blessed pope Aidan, in the company of the just, according to your desired mercy.

text: Deus qui sanctorum tuorum splendor es mirabilis maiestatem tuam suppliciter exoramus ut supplicationes nostras et hostias quas in honorem et venerationem Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctorumque apostolorum martyrum consessorum ac virginum atque omnium electorum tuorum tuae pietati devote offerimus clemens ac benignus accipias; et tribue ut qui eorum merita recolendo veneramur eorum intercessione protectionis tuae semper auxilio muniamur.
translation_en: God, who are the marvelous splendor of your saints, we humbly beseech your majesty to accept our prayers and offerings made in honor and veneration of the God-bearer Mary, the apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all your elect. Gracious and benevolent one, grant that we may be fortified with the assistance of your protection through their intercession forever.

text: Deus qui sanctos tuos in placita tibi oblatione adsciscis dum eis pro te moriendi ardorem contribuis in oblatis tibi sacrificiis respice et sanctorum tuorum sollemnia excolentibus propitiatus indulge.
translation_en: God, who gathers your saints to yourself in offerings pleasing to you as they are inflamed with a desire to die for you in their sacrifices to you, look and, propitiated by the festivities of your saints, grant an indulgence.

text: Deus qui sanctum Albanum martyrii corona decorare voluisti praesta quaesumus ut quemadmodum devotam ipsius passionis agimus memoriam eius sublimia apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: God who willed to adorn Saint Alban with the crown of martyrdom, we ask that you grant us, that just as we remember his devoted passion, we may feel his lofty patronage before you.

text: Deus qui sanctum corpus protomartyris Stephani tuis fidelibus ad suffragia revelare dignatus es da nobis per eius intercessionem nostrorum peccaminum remissionem et in tuo sancto servitio iugem perseverantiam.
translation_en: God who has seen fit to reveal the holy body of the protomartyr Stephen to your faithful, grant us through his intercession the forgiveness of our sins and the perseverance in your holy service.

text: Deus qui sanctum Patricium Scotorum apostolum tua providentia elegisti ut Hibernenses gentes in tenebris et in errore gentilitatis errantes ad lumen verum Dei scientiae reduceret et per lavacrum regenerationis filios excelsi Dei efficeret tribue nobis quaesumus eius piis intercessionibus ut ad ea quae recta sunt quantocius festinemus.
translation_en: God, who chose the holy Patrick, apostle of the Scots, by Your providence, to lead the Irish people out of darkness and error in paganism towards the true light of God's knowledge, and to make sons of the exalted God through the washing of regeneration; grant us, we pray, his pious intercessions, so that we may hasten towards those things that are right.

text: Deus qui scis genus humanum nulla sua virtute posse subsistere concede propitius ut famulus tuus ille quem populo tuo voluisti praeferri ita tuo fulciatur adiutorio quatenus quibus potuit praeesse valeat et prodesse.
translation_en: God, who knows that the human race cannot stand by its own power, grant graciously that your servant, whom you have chosen to be raised up among your people, may be strengthened by your aid, so that he may be able to govern and benefit them as much as possible.

text: Deus qui Scotorum populo beatum Paladeum pontificem primum apostolum et doctorem catholicae fidei mirabilem providisti concede propitius ut quem doctorem vitae habuimus in terris intercessorem apud te semper habeamus in caelis.
translation_en: God who provided the blessed Paladeum, the first bishop and apostle of the Scots, and teacher of the Catholic faith, miraculously, grant us graciously that we who had him as a teacher of life on earth may always have him as an intercessor before you in heaven.

text: Deus qui semper es gloriosus in sanctis tuis qui ut mundi fortia quaeque confundas in minimis quoque virtutem tuae potentiae demonstras suscipe hanc oblationem quam tibi pro commemoratione beatissimae virginis et martyris tuae Fidis offerimus et praesta ut apud te nos eius adiuvet oratio cuius tibi placuit sancta vita et gloriosa passio.
translation_en: God who is always glorious in your saints, who confound the mighty and strong even in the least, by demonstrating your power, receive this offering which we offer to you on the commemoration of your blessed virgin and martyr Fides. And grant that her prayer, whose holy life and glorious passion please you, may help us before you.

text: Deus qui sensus nostros terrenis actionibus perspicis retardari concede quaesumus ut tuo potius munere tuis aptemur remediis.
translation_en: God, who sees that our senses are held back by earthly actions, grant us that we may be fit for your remedies, we humbly ask.

text: Deus qui si velles redderes quod meremur; prius deficimus quam merita supplicia perferamus; quaesumus absolve nostros placatus errores et ut possimus ad tua praecepta converti copiosa propitiatione nos praeveni.
translation_en: God, who if you were willing, could render to us what we deserve; before we even begin our penance, we fall short. We humbly ask that you forgive our pleasing errors and, through abundant propitiation, prevent us from falling further so that we may turn towards your precepts.

text: Deus qui sic delectaris abstinentia carnis cum sancta inspexeris desideria cordis ut tibi munda exhibeamus ieiunia fac nos proximos seminis diligere et pro adversitantibus nobis devote orare.
translation_en: God, who delights in abstention from flesh and has regarded the desires of the heart, help us to present you with pure fasting. May we love our neighbors as ourselves and pray devotedly for those who are in adversity.

text: Deus qui sic dilexisti mundum ut Filium tuum unigenitum dares pro mundo tu haec libamina tibi benedicenda assume et nobis tuae benedictionis dona largire ut qui ob mysterium incarnationis suae hic tibi sacrificia veneranda litamus horum sacrificiorum propitiatione ab omnibus criminibus expiemur.
translation_en: God, who loved the world so much that you gave your only-begotten Son for the world, accept these offerings to be blessed by you and grant us the gifts of your blessing, so that we who here honor you because of the mystery of his incarnation, may be purified from all sins through these sacrifices.

text: Deus qui sic virginitatem diligis ut tamen virginitatem oderis in qua non fuerit integritas caritatis dato nobis sic obtinere munditiam carnis ut repleri possimus abundantia pacis quo tuarum virginum obtentu et pax in nobis vera permaneat et castitatis munditia coalescat.
translation_en: God, who loves virginity so much that you even despise it where there is no integrity of charity, give us such a way to maintain the purity of the flesh, that we may be filled with the abundance of peace which comes from the attainment of your virgins and may true peace remain in us, and may the purity of chastity merge.
