text: Deus qui sine principio fecisti aeterna principiis perpetua condidisti sine condicione perpetuus tu fusis ex affectu mentis precibus imploramus ut concessa nobis in praesenti saeculo yenia dignos misericordiae aeternae nos facias illudque nobis dum misereris indulgeas unde in nobis propter quod semper miserearis invenias.
translation_en: God who without beginning created eternal principles, perpetually established without condition, we humbly ask you through the warmth of our minds' prayers, that you grant us worthy of grace in this present age. May your mercy find us and as you are merciful, grant us relief, so that through your mercy, when you show it to us, we may always find reason for your continuous compassion.

text: Deus qui sine testimonio bonitatis tuae nullum tempus relinquis beato Geraldo supplicante precamur ut qui hunc tibi nostris diebus placuisse per signa testaris honorem quem illi in tuo nomine supplices exhibemus nobis in bonum cooperari digneris.
translation_en: God, who leaves no time without Your testimony, we pray for the blessed Gerald, who has pleased You in these days. We ask that You confirm this through signs and deem worthy to cooperate with us in good things as we humbly present Him honor in Your name.

text: Deus qui singulari corporis tui hostia totius mundi solvisti delicta hac oblatione placatus maculas scelerum nostrorum absterge et omnium christianorum vivorum et defunctorum peccata dimitte eisque praemia aeterna concede.
translation_en: God, who by the unique offering of your body on the cross have forgiven the sins of the whole world, be appeased with this offering and wipe away the stains of our sins. For all Christians living and dead, forgive their sins and grant them eternal rewards.

text: Deus qui singulari corporis tui hostia totius mundi solvisti delicta pacem nobis tribue hostes remove aeris temperiem bonam et copiam fructuum concede inimicis nostris caritatem largire et nos ab eorum insidiis potenter eripe incredulos converte omnium christianorum vivorum et mortuorum peccata remitte ut se gratulentur a tua clementia percepisse remedia.
translation_en: God who by the singular offering of your body forgave the sins of the whole world and brought us peace, grant to our enemies good weather conditions, abundant fruit harvest, spread love among them, and powerfully deliver us from their plots. Convert unbelievers and forgive the sins of all the living and dead Christians so that they may rejoice in your mercy for perceiving remedies.

text: Deus qui singulis quibusque competenter aptanda temporibus sempiterno cernis intuitu da nobis quaesumus ut cum rerum vicissitudine mundanarum ad bona quoque perpetua piae devotionis crescamus accessu.
translation_en: God, who sees fit for each individual at the appropriate times in eternal vision, grant us, we pray, that with the changing course of worldly things, we may also grow towards good and everlasting pious devotion.

text: Deus qui sollemnitate paschali caelestia mundo remedia benignus operaris annuae festivitatis huius dona prosequere ut observantia temporalis ad vitam proficiat sempiternam.
translation_en: God, who works blessings for the world in the solemnity of Easter, continue to grant us the favors of this annual festival. May our observance of temporal things lead to everlasting life.

text: Deus qui sollemnitate paschali caelestia mundo remedia benignus operaris annuae festivitatis huius nobis dona prosequere ut per observantiam temporalem ad vitam perveniamus aeternam.
translation_en: God, who in the solemnity of Easter works beneficially on the world with celestial remedies, grant us this year's festivity, that by observing it temporally we may reach eternal life.

text: Deus qui sollemnitate paschali mundo remedia contulisti populum tuum quaesumus caelesti dono prosequere ut et perfectam libertatem consequi mereatur et ad vitam proficiat sempiternam.
translation_en: God, who bestowed on the world remedies during the solemnity of Easter, we humbly ask that you continue to guide your people with heavenly gifts, so that they may deserve perfect freedom and advance towards eternal life.

text: Deus qui solus es bonus et sine quo nullus est bonus iube nos quaesumus tales fieri qui a tua non mereamur bonitate privari.
translation_en: God who alone art good and without whom no one is good, command us we pray, to become such that we may not be deprived of your undeserved goodness.

text: Deus qui spem salutis aeternae beatae Mariae virginitate fecunda humano generi praemia praestitisti tribue quaesumus ut ipsam pro nobis apud te intercedere sentiamus per quam meruimus auctorem vitae nostrae suscipere.
translation_en: God, who bestowed upon the human race the rewards of eternal salvation through the fruitful virginity of the blessed Mary, grant us that we may feel her interceding for us before you, through whom we have merited to receive our author of life.

text: Deus qui salutis aeternae beatae Mariae virginitate fecunda humano generi praemia praestitisti tribue quaesumus ut ipsam pro nobis intercedere sentiamus per quam meruimus auctorem vitae suscipere.
translation_en: God, who bestowed the rewards of eternal salvation upon the fruitful virginity of blessed Mary, grant us we beseech you, that we may feel her interceding for us, through whom we have merited to receive the author of life.

text: Deus qui sperantibus in te misereri potius eligis quam irasci da nobis digne flere mala quae fecimus ut tuae consolationis gratiam invenire mereamur.
translation_en: God who chooses to show mercy to those who hope in you rather than to be angry, grant us worthily to weep for the evils we have done, so that we may deserve your grace of consolation.

text: Deus qui sperantibus in te misereri potius eligis quam irasci et paenitentes etiam sub vitae huius termino non relinquis Threspice propitius super me famulum tuum remissionem milii omnium peccatorum tota cordis intentione poscentem qui conversum peccatorem non longo temporum spatio differendum sed mox ut ingemuisset dixisti esse salvandum.
translation_en: God, who chooses to show mercy rather than anger towards those who hope in you, does not abandon the penitent even within this life's term. Look upon me, your servant, with favor as I humbly seek the remission of a thousand sins from my whole heart, who said that the repentant sinner should not be delayed for long, but saved as soon as he confesses. Thus, you have said.

text: Deus qui sperantibus in te misericordiam semper impendis et nusquam es servientibus tibi longinquus concede famulis tuis et suis omnibus prosperum iter ut te protectore et duce per iustitiae callem sine offensione gradiantur.
translation_en: God, who always bestows mercy upon those who hope in you and is never distant from those who serve you, grant a prosperous journey to your servants and all theirs. May they walk without offense along the path of justice with you as their protector and guide.

text: Deus qui Stephanum plenum gratia et virtute levitici ordinis ministerio per apostolorum tuorum electionem vel impositionem manuum consecrasti tu praesta nobis ut qui adsciti sumus in sortem tuae vocationis simus filii pacis tenoremque retineamus perfectae dilectionis quo gratia tua quae in Stephano martyre verae praedicationis iecit fundamina in nobis sincerae pacis et caritatis multiplicet nutrimenta.
translation_en: God who consecrated Stephen, full of grace and virtue, by the ministry of your apostles through their election or imposition of hands, grant that we who have been joined to your calling may be sons of peace and that we may hold fast to the standard of perfect love which your grace, which laid the foundations of true preaching in Stephen the martyr, has multiplied among us. May it increase the nourishment of sincere peace and charity among us.

text: Deus qui sub tuae maiestatis arbitrio omnium regnorum contines potestatem romani imperii propitiare principibus ut qui tua exspectant protectione defendi omnibus sint hostibus fortiores.
translation_en: God, who in Your majesty's governance encompasses the power of all kingdoms, grant favor to the rulers, that they who await Your protection may be stronger against every enemy.

text: Deus qui subiectas tibi glorificas potestates suscipe propitius oblationes nostras et romanis vires adde principibus ut qui se dextera tua expetunt protegi nulla possint adversitate superari.
translation_en: God, who glorifies the powers subject to you, graciously receive our offerings and add Roman strength to the princes, so that those who seek your protection with their right hand may not be able to overcome any adversity.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices deprecamur ut huic famulo tuo
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that this Your servant may be granted favor.

text: Deus qui superbis resistis et gratiam praestas humilibus auge in nobis verae humilitatis virtutem cuius in se formam fidelibus unigenitus tuus exhibuit ut numquam indignationem tuam provocemus elati sed potius semper pietatis tuae capiamus dona subiecti.
translation_en: God, who resists the proud and grants grace to the humble, increase in us the virtue of true humility, whose form your only-begotten Son showed to the faithful so that we may never provoke your indignation with pride, but rather always embrace the gifts of your mercy as the humble.

text: Deus qui supplicum tuorum vota per caritatis officia suscipere dignaris da famulis tuis in tua proficere dilectione et in tua laetari protectione ut tibi secura mente deserviant et in tua pace semper assistere mereantur.
translation_en: God, who deigns to receive the prayers of your suppliants through the office of charity, grant to your servants that they may progress in your loving devotion and rejoice in your protection, so that they may serve you with a mind secure, and may always merit to assist in your peace.

text: Deus qui tanta pace et dilectione hunc mundum dilexisti ut per unigenitum Filium tuum cuncta terrestria caelestibus sociares miseratione gratuita quae caecitate primi hominis facta fuerant inter se dissidentia da nobis ut qui obscuritate nostrorum criminum a proximi dilectione avertimur te in nobis perpetualiter lucente ita in nominis tui dulcedine solidemur quatenus et amicos in te et inimicos propter te alternae dilectionis vinculo amplectamur.
translation_en: God, who loved this world so much with such peace and love that through your only-begotten Son you united all terrestrial things with celestial ones by a free grace which the blindness of the first man had made dissentient among themselves, grant us that we who are turned away from our neighbor's love because of our own darkness may be continually enlightened in you, so that we may be firmly united in the sweetness of your name. May we embrace both friends and enemies for you through the bond of alternate love.

text: Deus qui tanta severitate iudicii tui ultor fuisti in persecutoribus beatissimi martyris Tirsi ut eorum defuncta corpora terra recusaret suscipere quam ferocitas eorum viri iusti sanguine cruentasset tu pius ac benignus offerentium obsequiis delibutus sepultorum spiritibus aeterna refrigeria praebe ut ita praedicti martyris tui suffragio habeant fideles animae defunctorum praemium sicut per eum corpora damnatorum meruerunt invenire sepulcrum.
translation_en: God, who with such severity of your judgment avenged yourself upon the persecutors of the blessed martyr Tirus, that the earth refused to accept their dead bodies after they had been made unclean by the ferocity of their just blood, you, gracious and kind, offered eternal refreshment to the spirits of those who were offering obeisance. Grant that they may have the reward of faithful souls departed through the intercession of your martyr, as their bodies, by means of him, deserved to find a tomb.

text: Deus qui tantae pietatis es ut supplicantium preces indulgentia omni praevenias et id quod petendum est a te iam nosti prius quam rogeris exaudi preces populi tui atque omnibus nobis misericordiae et securitatis tuae munus indulge ut omni sublata formidine liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: God, who is of such great pity that You anticipate the prayers of supplicants with Your indulgence, and what is to be asked of You, You already know before it is asked. Hear the prayers of Your people and grant us all the gift of Your mercy and safety. Indulge upon us, so that, free from all fear, we may serve You with minds unfettered.

text: Deus qui tantam famulae tuae Agathae contulisti constantiam ut nullis suasionibus cederet quo semetipsam petulco adversantis concubitu macularet quique eius meritis celsiorem gloriam virtutis accumulans cives suos a voracis ignis combustionibus liberas tu Ecclesiam tuam donis spiritalibus auge ut et virginitate praepolleat et nullis inimici propulsetur temptationibus ad ruinam sed carens incendiis voluptatum horrendis in te ardeat desiderio et obsequiali coalescat ex voto.
translation_en: God, who granted such constancy to your servant Agatha that she did not yield to any temptations to defile herself with the lewd advances of an opposing concubine, and who, through her merits, accumulated a higher glory of virtue, free your people from the voracious fires of destruction, You Church, increase with spiritual gifts. May she excel in virginity and be pushed back by no temptations towards ruin. May she burn with a desire for you that is lacking in terrible worldly pleasures and may her vow unite her obediently.

text: Deus qui te praecipis a peccatoribus exorari tibique sacrificium contriti cordis offerri hoc sacrificium quod indignis manibus meis offerro acceptare dignare et ut ipse tibi hostia et sacrificium esse merear miseratus concede quo per ministerii huius exhibitionem omnium peccatorum percipiam remissionem.
translation_en: God who commands us to beseech you from sinners and to offer to you a sacrifice of contrite hearts, accept the sacrifice that I, unworthy, offer. Grant that I may merit to be both offering and sacrifice for you, have mercy and concede so that through the presentation of this ministry I may receive forgiveness for all my sins.

text: Deus qui te rectis ac sinceris manere pectoribus asseris da nobis tua gratia tales exsistere in quibus habitare digneris.
translation_en: God, who promises to dwell in hearts that are right and sincere, grant us your grace to exist as such, in whom you deem fit to reside.

text: Deus qui te sinceris asseris manere pectoribus da nobis tua gratia tales exsistere in quibus habitare digneris.
translation_en: God, who promises to remain in hearts, grant us your grace to exist in such a way that you deem fit to dwell within us.

text: Deus qui temporalis mortis angustias aeternae vitae iucunditate compensas tribue nobis quaesumus ut qui gloriosi Thomae martyris tui atque pontificis passionem veneramur eius apud te meritis et precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: God who compensates the tightness of temporal death with the delight of eternal life, grant us that we may be helped, as we ask, to venerate the passion of your glorious martyr Thomas and pope, and may we be aided by his merits and prayers with you.

text: Deus qui terram Israel gloriosa Filii tui nativitate decorasti et ipsam per passionem et sanguinem eiusdem redemisti animam famuli tui illius et animas famulorum famularumque tuarum a diaboli compede liberare digneris terramque sanctam iam redimere non deseras ut quorum corda incredulitas tenebrosa mirabiliter constringit haec praesens oblatio tua benignissima pietate dissolvat spemque salutis habentibus manus tua defensatrix indesinenter assistat.
translation_en: God, who adorned the earth of Israel with the glorious nativity of your Son and redeemed the soul of your servant there and the souls of his servants and those serving you from the grip of the devil, deigns to free; that the holy land, which is now being redeemed, you do not cease to desire. This present offering of yours, with your most benevolent pity, may dissolve the unyielding grasp of disbelief that darkens the hearts of some and may the hand of your protective defender constantly assist those who have hope for salvation.

text: Deus qui totam legis prophetarumque doctrinam in tua nobis et <proximi> dilectione posuisti insere in cordibus nostris utriusque devotionis effectum ut numquam ab invicem sint divisi qui tua fuerint pace coniuncti.
translation_en: God who placed the entire doctrine of the law and prophets within our hearts by mutual love, so that we may never be divided from each other, but always united in your peace.

text: Deus qui transtulisti patres nostros per mare rubrum et transvexisti per aquam nimiam laudem tui nominis decantantes supplices deprecamur ut in hac navi famulos tuos repulsis adversitatibus portu semper optabili cursuque tranquillo tuearis.
translation_en: God, who led our fathers across the Red Sea and carried them through a vast expanse of water singing praises to your name, we humbly beseech you that you protect your servants in this ship, repelling adversities, always in a favorable harbor and a tranquil course.

text: Deus qui tres magos orientales Gaspar Melchior et Balthasar ad Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi cunabula ut eum mysticis adorarent muneribus stella duce et vero lumine praemio sine impedimento duxisti et reduxisti concede famulis tuis in hoc itinere quod peracturi sunt per ipsorum trium regum pias intercessiones et merita pacem et prosperitatem ac sanitatem quatenus ipso vero sole vera stella et vero lumine ducente ad loca optata sine offensione et impedimento pervenire mereantur.
translation_en: God, who led the three wise men from the East, Gaspar, Melchior, and Balthasar, to the manger of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, so that they might adore him with mystical gifts guided by a star and true light, without hindrance you brought them and returned them. Grant, we pray, to your servants on this journey who are about to complete it through the prayers and merits of the three kings, peace and prosperity and health, so that they may deserve, led by the true sun, the true star, and the true light, to reach their desired places without offense or hindrance.

text: Deus qui tres magos orientales Gaspar Melchior et Balthasar ad tua cunabula ut te mysticis venerarentur muneribus sine impedimento stella duce duxisti concede propitius ut per horum trium regum pias intercessiones et merita famulo tuo illi et famulis tuis tribuas ut in itinere quo ituri sunt celeritate laetitia gratia et pace te ipso sole vero vera stella vera luminis luce ad loca destinata in pace et salute et negotio peracto cum omni prosperitate sani et salvi redire valeant.
translation_en: God, who led the three eastern magi Gaspar, Melchior, and Balthasar to your crib with their mystic gifts without hindrance by a star, graciously grant that through the prayers of these three kings and their merits, you may bestow upon your servant and his servants, that on the journey they are about to undertake, they may return swiftly with joy, grace, and peace, under your true sun, the real star, the true light, with health and safety, and with all prosperity, in peace, salvation, and success.

text: Deus qui tres pueros de camino ignis non solum illaesos sed etiam tuis laudibus conclamantes liberasti quaesumus ut nos peccatorum nexibus obvolutos velut de voragine ignis eripias ut criminum flammas operumque carnalium incendia superantes hymnum tibi debitum iure meritoque reddamus.
translation_en: God who freed the three boys from the fiery furnace not only unharmed but also singing your praises, we humbly ask that you free us from the bonds of our sins, as if we were plucked from the mouth of a fire. May we overcome the flames of sin and the fires of carnal works, and in return render to you the hymn due to you by right and merit.

text: Deus qui tribulatos corde sanas et maestificatos actu iustificas ad hanc propitius hostiam dignanter attende quam tibi pro servi tui illius offerimus liberatione; tu et hanc benignus accepta et illius pro quo offerimus sana discrimina tribulationis eius attende miseriam et angustiarum illius submove pressuram ut exutus omnibus quae patitur malis in tuis semper delectetur exsultare iudiciis.
translation_en: God who heals the troubled at heart and justifies the mournful in action, graciously attend this worthy offering which we present for our servant on account of his release. May you, benevolent one, accept it, and pay attention to the one for whom we offer it, that you may ease his trials and alleviate his sufferings, remove the pressure of his afflictions, so that he may always delight in rejoicing in your judgments, freed from all troubles.

text: Deus qui tribulatos corde sanas et maestificatos actu laetificas ad hanc propitius hostiam dignanter attende et qua totius mundi voluisti relaxare delicta pro tribulatione nostra illam clementer assume cunctaque crimina nostra solve tribulationem nostram adime miserias pelle angustias et pressuras amove ut exuti quae patimur malis in tuis semper delectemur exsultare iudiciis.
translation_en: God, who heals the troubled heart and makes the sorrowful rejoice, graciously attend to this worthy offering. And as you have chosen to relax the sins of the whole world for our tribulation, gently take on that clemency, forgive all our sins, alleviate our tribulations, remove our miseries, ease our burdens and pressures. May we always delight in you when we are relieved from sufferings, rejoice in your judgments.

text: Deus qui tribus pueris mitigasti flammas ignium concede propitius ut nos famulos tuos non exurat flamma vitiorum.
translation_en: God who softened the flames of fire for the three boys, graciously grant that the flame of vices does not burn us, Your servants.

text: Deus qui tuae ineffabilis magnitudine pietatis beatum Iustum aetate parvulum magnum fide atque virtute fecisti tribue quaesumus ut qui eius memoriam agimus vitae quoque innocentiam imitemur.
translation_en: God, who made the blessed Just one, small in age but great in faith and virtue, grant us that we, who remember him, may imitate his innocence in our lives as well.

text: Deus qui tuam servantibus legem multimodam donas pacem praesta famulis tuis ut qui praecepto tuo oboedientes decimas rerum honorant ex propriis complementum pacis et caritatis accipiant ut in eo cum omni turba fidelium perenniter vivant ex quo provocati sunt ut has tuis altaribus decimas exhiberent.
translation_en: God, who gives a diverse law to your servants, grant them peace. Bestow upon your servants that those who obey your commandment honor their tithes from their own possessions as a contribution to peace and charity. May they receive it so that they may ever live in it with all the faithful congregation. Grant this because you have called them to present these tithes at your altars.

text: Deus qui tuorum corda fidelium per eleemosynam dixisti posse mundari praesta quaesumus huius consortiis sacramenti ut ad conscientiae suae fructum non gravare studeant miseros sed iuvare.
translation_en: God, who through charity said that your faithful hearts could be cleansed, grant us, we beseech you, for this consorting sacrament, that they strive not to burden the unfortunate with their conscience but rather help them.

text: Deus qui tuorum corda fidelium per eleemosynam dixisti posse mundari praesta quaesumus ut per hanc huius quoque consortio sacramenti nostrorum fiat plene purgatio peccatorum et tuae propitiatio maiestatis.
translation_en: God who through charity said that the hearts of your faithful could be purified, grant us that through this participation in this sacrament, there may be a full cleansing of sins and your propitiation of majesty.

text: Deus qui tuorum corda fidelium per eleemosynam dixisti posse mundari praesta quaesumus ut haec oblatio quam tibi offerimus pro incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum illarum eleemosynas nobis largientium eis proficiat ad salutem quatenus eorum vita tua providentia inter adversa et prospera ubique dirigatur.
translation_en: God, who through charity have said that the hearts of your faithful can be purified, grant us, we ask, that this offering which we present to you for the well-being of your servants and their servants may profit them with alms, so that their life may be directed by your providence in both adversity and prosperity.

text: Deus qui tuorum corda fidelium per eleemosynam dixisti posse mundari da famulis et famulabus tuis qui ad hunc locum sanctum vel pauperibus sua bona dederunt per huius sacramenti mysterium ut percipientes hoc munere veniam peccatorum in tuorum censeantur sorte iustorum.
translation_en: God, who through charity have said that the hearts of your faithful can be purified by serving and serving your servants, who have given their goods to this holy place for the poor through the mystery of this sacrament, may they perceive this gift as forgiveness for sins and consider themselves among the fortunate sort of the righteous.

text: Deus qui tuorum martyrum sollicitus custos et amplificus remunerator exsistis hanc plebem martyrum agonibus congaudentem intende clemens et da singulis quod poscunt qui sanctis tribuisti de hoste triumphare ut quos per carnis mortem tibi placuisse meminimus patronos apud te semper strenuos habeamus.
translation_en: God, who as a diligent and generous guardian and rewarder, exist among your martyrs rejoicing in their struggles, incline mercifully and give to each what they ask, who have granted them to triumph over the enemy. May we always remember those whom we pleased you with through physical death, and may we have them as constant patrons before you.

text: Matutina supplicum vota
translation_en: Morning prayers' vows

text: Deus qui tuos athletas gloria caelesti remuneras concede propitius ut qui de beatorum martyrum tuorum Eustachii ac sociorum eius gaudemus triumphis per eorum intercessionem sempiterna gaudia mereamur adipisci.
translation_en: God who rewards your athletes with celestial glory, graciously grant that we who rejoice in the triumphs of Your blessed martyr Eustachius and his companions may merit to obtain eternal joys through their intercession.

text: Medelam tuam deprecor Domine
translation_en: I humbly ask for Your mercy, Lord

text: Deus qui tuum in humanitate unigenitum divina claritate transformatum sanctis apostolis demonstrasti fac nos quaesumus tua gratia largiente in caelesti regno de eius claritatis visione perenniter exsultare.
translation_en: God, who showed your Son transformed by divine clarity to the holy apostles, grant us, we ask, that through your grace we may forever rejoice in the heavenly kingdom from the vision of his clarity.

text: Deus qui tuum Thomam egregium praedicis architectum et in foro non dedignas ambulare venalium tu nos ex illis lapidibus effice vivis a quibus illa visio pacis instauratur caelestis qualiter candore castitatis niveo renitentes sanctorum qui nos in domino iam praecesserunt possimus esse in participatione aequales ut qui pro peccatoribus ab illa sublimi sede descendisti ad terram precibus nostris placatus assistas omnibus requiem defunctis fidelibus praestans.
translation_en: God, who proclaim your Thomas, the excellent architect, not to disdain walking among the unrighteous in the forum, make us from those living stones, with whom that vision of celestial peace is re-established. May we, like the saints who have already preceded us in the Lord, be equal participants, as they, who descended from that sublime seat for the sake of sinners, assist all the faithful departed with rest, granting peace through our prayers.

text: Deus qui unanimes nos in domo tua praecipis habitare dissensionum causas placatus depelle nostrarum ut competentibus adiuti subsidiis te largiente possimus esse concordes.
translation_en: God, who in your house commands the united ones to dwell, pleased remove the causes of discord from us, so that with the help of suitable support you lavishly grant, we may be able to be harmonious.

text: Deus qui unanimitatem amplecteris et in corde pacifico requiescis da quaesumus puram omnibus pacem; da cunctis mutuam caritatem; tribue fidelia oscula sincera colloquia ut nec publicis quidquam inimicitiis liceat nec secretis atque odisse nesciat fratrem qui te suum coeperit amare factorem.
translation_en: God who embraces unity and rests in a peaceful heart, grant us pure peace for all; grant to all mutual love; give sincere kisses and honest conversations so that neither public enmity is allowed nor secret hatred does not know the brother who began to love you as his own maker.

text: Deus qui unicum Filium tuum pro omnibus nobis in mortem crucis sponte dedisti concede omnibus recte credentibus ut per eandem mortem a morte perpetua liberemur.
translation_en: God, who freely gave Your only Son for all of us on the cross, grant that all who truly believe may be freed from eternal death through the same death.

text: Deus qui unigeniti Filii tui baptismo fluenta sanctificare voluisti aquarum da ut renati aqua et spiritu pervenire ad gaudia aeterna mereamur.
translation_en: God, who willed to sanctify the flowing waters of your only-begotten Son's baptism, grant that we may merit to attain eternal joys through water and Spirit as we are reborn.

text: Deus qui unigeniti Filii tui pretioso sanguine vivificae crucis vexillum sanctificari voluisti concede quaesumus eos qui eiusdem sanctae crucis gaudent honore tua quoque ubique protectione gaudere.
translation_en: God, who willed that the standard of your unique Son be sanctified by his precious blood shed on the cross, grant we ask that those who rejoice in the honor of the same holy cross may also enjoy your protection everywhere.

text: Deus qui unigeniti tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi pretioso sanguine humanum genus redimere dignatus es concede propitius ut qui ad adorandam vivificam crucem adveniunt a peccatorum suorum nexibus liberentur.
translation_en: God, who deemed fit to redeem the human race by the precious blood of your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, grant them propitiously that those who come to adore the life-giving cross may be freed from the bonds of their sins.

text: Deus qui unigeniti tui patientia antiqui hostis contrivisti proterviam da nobis quae idem pie pro nobis pertulit digne recolere sicque exemplo eius nobis adversantia aequanimiter tolerare.
translation_en: God, who through the patience of your only-begotten Son contrived to subdue the stubbornness of the ancient enemy, grant us the grace to remember with due reverence what he suffered for us, and so by his example, to endure our adversities with equanimity.

text: Deus qui unigenitum tuum devicta ab eo iam morte mortisque auctore primum beatae Mariae Magdalenae vivum exhibuisti tu clementiae tuae dono ita nos ad amorem tuum accende quatenus sollerti instantia eum quem praediximus unigenitum tuum amando laeti in sua maiestate mereamur videre.
translation_en: God, who showed your only-begotten one alive to the blessed Mary Magdalene first, conquered by death and the author of death, may through your clemency kindle in us a love for you so that we may merit to see with joy the same only-begotten son whom we have predicted, by loving him diligently in his majesty.

text: Deus qui unigenitum Filium tuum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum gloriosissimo regi Edwardo in forma visibili demonstrasti tribue quaesumus ut eius meritis et precibus ad aeternam ipsius Domini nostri Iesu Christi visionem pertingere mereamur.
translation_en: God, who showed your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in a visible form to King Edward the Glorious, grant us that we may merit to reach the eternal vision of our Lord Jesus Christ through his merits and prayers.

text: Deus qui unigenitum tuum per uterum virginis Mariae intactum in hunc mundum manifestare dignatus es non desit famulis tuis pietatis tuae invictissima salus.
translation_en: God, who deigned to manifest your only-begotten in this world through the womb of the Virgin Mary without loss of integrity, do not cease to be a victorious salvation for your servants through your mercy.

text: Deus qui unigenitum tuum pro nobis in carne venturum ac de virgine nasciturum propheticis vocibus promisisti et in novissimis temporibus quae promiseras adimplesti praesta quaesumus ut qui eum iam venisse mundumque redemisse credimus fatemur et praedicamus rursumque venturum ad iudicium speramus eius praesentiam cum venerit sine confusione cernamus.
translation_en: God who promised through prophetic voices that your only-begotten one would come among us in flesh and be born of a virgin, and in the last times fulfilled what you had promised, grant us, we pray, that we may confess again that he has already come and redeemed the world, and that we proclaim him. We hope also for his coming again to judge; when he comes, may we perceive his presence without confusion.

text: Deus qui universam Ecclesiam tuam pretiosorum martyrum tuorum <virtutibus> velut quibusdam floribus coronasti praesta omnipotens Deus ut sicut illis <dedisti> palmam victoriae ita nobis consortium tribuas et gloriam sempiternam.
translation_en: God who adorned your Church with the precious martyrs of yours as if with certain flowers, Almighty God, grant that just as you gave them the palm of victory, so you may give us fellowship and eternal glory.

text: Deus qui universam Ecclesiam tuam pretiosorum martyrum tuorum virtutibus velut quibusdam floribus coronasti ut per triumphos tuorum testium et sollemnitatum gloriam et devotionum exempla susciperes sicut in hoc die quo pro domino nostro Iesu Christo Infantium innocentiam extollis usque ad merita passionum feliciter pro Christo mortui sunt sed felicius cum eodem in aeternitate victuri qui ad hoc tantum per humanam infirmitatem nati sunt ad aerumnam ut per Dei gratiam nascerentur martyres ad coronam praesta omnipotens Deus in hac sollemnitate diei huius ut sicut illis dedisti palmas victoriae ita nobis quoque consortium tribuas sempiternum.
translation_en: God, who adorned Your Church with the virtues of Your precious martyrs as if with some flowers to crown them, so that You might receive glory and examples of devotion through their triumphs and solemnities. As on this day when You exalt the innocence of children for our Lord Jesus Christ, blessed may they be who died for Christ. May they be even happier with Him in eternal life, who were born to suffer such affliction only because of human frailty, so that through God's grace they might become martyrs and receive a crown. Almighty God, on this day's solemnity grant us that just as You gave them the palm of victory, so You also grant us everlasting consortium.

text: Deus qui universorum creator et conditor es qui cum sis tuorum beatitudo sanctorum praesta nobis petentibus ut spiritum fratris nostri a corporis nexibus absolutum in prima resurrectione facias praesentari.
translation_en: God who are the creator and founder of all, who are the happiness of the saints, grant to us who ask you, that you may absolve the spirit of our brother from the bonds of the body in the first resurrection, and make it present.

text: Mensis primi IIII VII
translation_en: Month first, IV (July)

text: Deus qui universum mundum beati Pauli apostoli praedicatione docuisti da nobis quaesumus ut qui eius hodie conversionem colimus per eius ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God who taught the whole world through the preaching of blessed Paul, the apostle, grant us we pray, that we who celebrate his conversion today may be enriched by his example with your grace.

text: Deus qui universum mundum beatorum apostolorum tuorum praedicatione docuisti da nobis quaesumus ut quorum hodie divisionem colimus per eorum ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God who taught the whole world through the preaching of your blessed apostles, grant us we pray, that we may honor their division today; and by their example to you, may we find grace with you.

text: Deus qui universum mundum sanctorum doctorum praedicatione ad agnitionem veritatis convertisti da nobis quaesumus ut quorum te dictis agnovimus per eorum ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: God, who converted the whole world to the recognition of truth through the preaching of your saints, grant us, we pray, that we may be pleased by your grace as we recognize you through their examples.

text: Deus qui universum orbem apostolis imbuendum commendasti fac nos beati Barnabae apostoli tui commendari suffragiis et praemiis sociari perpetuis.
translation_en: God who committed the task of filling the whole world to the apostles, make us to be commended by the prayers and eternal rewards of your blessed apostle Barnabas.

text: Deus qui unum in Trinitate possides nomen oblatas tibi in hoc tuorum trium martyrum festo has oblationes assume quo et offerentibus ad salutem et defunctis proficiant ad quietem.
translation_en: God, who possesses one name in the Trinity, accept these offerings on this feast of your three martyrs. May they benefit those offering for their salvation and may the deceased advance to rest.

text: Deus qui ut humanum genus ad confessionem tui nominis provocares etiam in sexu fragili victoriam martyrii contulisti praesta quaesumus ut Ecclesia tua hoc exemplo communita nec pati pro te metuat et caelestis praemii gloriam concupiscat.
translation_en: God, who provokes the human race to the confession of your name even in the fragile sex, you granted victory through martyrdom. Grant us, we beg, that your Church may not suffer for you out of fear and may long for the celestial reward's glory.

text: Deus qui vastatoris antiqui perfidiam virtute Filii tui et Sancti Spiritus destruendo dedisti nobis de captivitate victoriam concede quaesumus ut qui nos impetere moliuntur potentiae tuae dextera conterantur.
translation_en: God, who destroyed the treachery of the ancient destroyer through the power of Your Son and the Holy Spirit, grant us victory from captivity. We humbly ask that those who beseech You be crushed by Your mighty hand.

text: Deus qui vastatoris antiqui perfidiam virtute Filii tui et Spiritus Sancti dona distribuendo vicisti et dedisti nobis de captivitate victoriam concede quaesumus ut qui nos impetere moliuntur tua etiam dextera refrenentur.
translation_en: God, who through the power of your Son and the Holy Spirit defeated the treachery of the ancient destroyer and gave us victory from captivity, grant us that those who seek to move us may also be held back by your hand.

text: Deus qui venerabilem beati Hilarii confessoris tui atque pontificis festivitatem sollemniter recurrentem populo tuo dedicasti concede nobis quaesumus ut quod in eius honore deposcimus eo suffragante consequi mereamur.
translation_en: O God, who solemnly renew the festival of your venerable confessor and bishop Saint Hilary, grant us we ask, that with his intercession we may worthy merit what we seek in his honor.

text: Deus qui venerabilem beati Hilarii confessoris tui atque pontificis festivitatem sollemniter recurrentem populo tuo dedicasti cuius lingua in saeculo pro sanctae Trinitatis aequalitate sic tonuit ut mundi huius principem miles tuus prosterneret et in caelestis regis aula victor intraret te suppliciter votis uberrimis deprecamur ut qui eum inter adversas acies ita fecisti esse sollicitum ut redderes inter bella securum concede nobis ut quod in eius honore deposcimus eo suffragante consequi mereamur.
translation_en: God, who solemnly renewed the festival of your confessor and bishop, blessed Hilary, to your people, to whom language in the world resounded equally for the holy Trinity, that your soldier overthrew the ruler of this world, and he entered the court of the heavenly king as a victor. We humbly beseech you with most abundant vows, that you who made him so anxious amidst adversarial battles to render him secure in times of war, grant us that what we ask for in his honor, with his intercession, we may deserve to achieve.

text: Adorabilem populi beatissimi Hilarii antistitis festivitatem sollemniter recurrentem cuius lingua in saeculo pro sanctae Trinitatis aequalitate sic tonuit ut huius mundi principem miles Christi prosterneret et in caelestis regis aula victor intraret <celebrantes> dominum votis uberioribus deprecemur ut qui eum inter diversas acies ita fecit esse sollicitum ut redderet inter bella securum nobis concedere dignetur ut quod in eius honore deposcimus eo suffragante consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Returning solemnly to the festivity of the venerable people's bishop, the most blessed Hilary, whose tongue in this world sounded with such equality for the holy Trinity that he made the leader of this world, the soldier of Christ, bow down and enter as a victor into the court of the heavenly king. We implore the Lord to be celebrated with more fervent prayers, who, amidst various battles, made him so concerned that He granted us safety. May He deign to grant what we ask for in His honor, so that we may merit to obtain it with His support.

text: Deus qui venerabilem nobis beati Pontii martyris tui passionem celebritate annua concedis venerari praesta quaesumus ut sicut ille constanter pro tui nominis confessione agonizando triumphale stadium divina largitate meruit percurrere ita nos eiusdem patrociniis immortalitatis triumphum mereamur percipere.
translation_en: God, who grant us yearly to venerate the venerable martyrdom of your blessed Pontius, bestow upon us, we beseech You, that as he merited to run the triumphant race while constantly suffering for Your name's confession, so may we deserve to perceive the triumph of immortality through his same intercession.

text: Deus qui veneranda beati Byrini confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnitate huius diei nobis consecrasti gaudia praesta ut supplicatio eius nobis obtineat veniam cuius spiritus hodie ad perpetuam transivit gloriam.
translation_en: God, who on this day consecrated for us the joys of your venerable confessor and bishop, Byrini, grant that his supplication may obtain mercy for us, whose spirit today passed into eternal glory.

text: Deus qui violatae naturae per virginale decus adhibes medicinam fac nos beatae Mariae semper virginis precibus et fermentum conceptae pravitatis abicere et in novitatis azyma de vetustate transire.
translation_en: God who applies medicine to the violation of nature through the virginal grace, make us pass by the prayers of the blessed Mary ever-virgin and cast off the leaven of conceived corruption, and cross over from the aged state into the freshness of newness.

text: Deus qui virginalem aulam beatae Mariae in qua habitares eligere dignatus es da quaesumus ut sua nos defensione munitos iucundos faciat suae interesse festivitati.
translation_en: God, who deemed fit to choose the virginal chamber of the blessed Mary in which you dwell, we humbly ask that you protect us with her defense and make our celebration pleasing to your own festivity.

text: Deus qui virgineum florem per Mariae uterum renovasti reddens nobis in matre virgine quod per incontinentem perditum fuerat matrem quam sequentes sanctae virgines cum palma martyrii ad tuum usque thalamum pervenerunt ex quibus est beata Agnes martyr cuius hodie passionis sollemnitas agitur quae nos ad laetitiam suae devotionis excitavit; vere est enim honorandus huius dies natalis quae sic terrena generatione processit ut ad divinitatis consortium per consecrationem virginitatis perveniret.
translation_en: God who renewed the virginal flower through Mary's womb, returning to us in the Virgin Mother what was lost through sinful disruption; indeed, the holy virgins who followed her, reaching Your throne room with palm of martyrdom, came from whom blessed Agnes, the martyr, is, whose feast day is celebrated today, which has stirred up joy in our devotion towards her; truly, this day is worthy of honor because it came to birth through earthly generation so as to attain the fellowship of divinity through consecration of virginity.

text: Deus qui virginum votis placaris qui in martyrum oblatione laetaris dona nobis tibi offerre placentia ut sanctae martyris et virginis tuae Christinae consequamur auxilia et tuae propitiationis arbitrio tales efficiamur in die iudicii quales nos e lavacro protulisti.
translation_en: God who delights in the vows of virgins, who rejoices in the offering of martyrs, grant us pleasing offerings to you, that we may attain the aid of your holy martyr and virgin Christina, and may be made such on the day of judgment as you presented us after baptism.

text: Deus qui (per) viscera misericordiae uberis atque multiplicis sic sanctos tuos coronas pro meritis ut discordantium animos eorum intercessione pacifices quaesumus per interventum sancti Saturnini antistitis et martyris tui ut pacificatam plebem huius festivitati collectam sic ab omni simultate separes ut perfectam tuo conspectui habere digneris.
translation_en: God, who through the abundance of your merciful bowels and manifold coronest your saints according to their merits, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your bishop and martyr Saint Saturninus, you separate the discordant souls and grant peace to this assembled people for this festivity. We beseech you to preserve them from all discord so that you may deem worthy to behold them complete in your sight.

text: Deus qui vivorum es Salvator omnium qui non vis mortem peccatoris nec laetaris in perditione morientium te suppliciter deprecor ut concedas mihi veniam delictorum ut et admissa defleam et postmodum non admittam ut cum mihi extrema dies finisque vitae advenerit emundatis delictis omnibus me angelus sanctitatis suscipiat.
translation_en: God who is the Savior of all living, who does not want the death of the sinner nor rejoice in the perdition of the dying, I humbly entreat you that you grant me forgiveness for my sins, so that I may weep for my transgressions now and not be admitted to them hereafter. And when the last days and end of my life come, may an angel of sanctity take me away purified of all my sins.

text: Deus qui votivis semper precibus delectaris votum famuli tui illius locupleta fenore pacis ut per hoc id quod offert tuis oculis sit acceptum per quod tuae pacis fuerit vinculo praemunitum.
translation_en: God who always delights in the vows of your servant, grant that through this offering, may it be accepted by your eyes, and through which it may be protected by the bond of peace.

text: Deus qui vulnere passionis et crucis nostrorum omnium vincula solvis votivam hanc servorum tuorum suscipe precem in omnibus pro quibus te poposcerint fideli devotione.
translation_en: God who by the wound of Passion and Cross looses the bonds of all, accept this vow from your servants. Hear our prayer on behalf of all for whom they ask you with faithful devotion.

text: Deus quo iuvante beatus Laurentius ferrea crate liberatus subiecto minime cessit incendio nam flagrantibus membris coronam est martyrii consecutus praesta ut omnes qui passionis eius merita veneramur maiestatis tuae muniamur auxilio.
translation_en: With God's help, the blessed Laurence, freed from the iron grid, not at all ceased from the fire, for he received the crown of martyrdom with burning limbs. Grant that all who revere his passion's merits may be fortified with your aid.

text: Deus refugium nostrum et virtus adesto piis Ecclesiae tuae precibus auctor ipse pietatis et praesta ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: God, our refuge and strength, be present to the pious church with your own prayers, author of piety, and grant that we may effectively obtain what we faithfully ask for.

text: Deus refugium pauperum spes humilium salusque miserorum supplicationes populi tui clementer exaudi ut quos iustitia verberum fecit afflictos abundantia remediorum faciat consolatos.
translation_en: God, refuge of the poor, hope of the humble, salvation of the miserable, graciously hear the supplications of your people, that those whom justice has made afflicted through scourges may be made consoling by the abundance of remedies.

text: Deus refugium pauperum spes humilium salusque miserorum interveniente pro nobis beatissimo fundatore Ecclesiae tuae Petro supplicationes supplicum tuorum in die triduani huius ieiunii clementer exaudi et tranquillitatem a vitiis pariter et hostibus nostris concede temporibus ut quos iustitia flagellorum tuorum iuste facere potest esse afflictos abundantia misericordiae tuae ipso beato Petro obtinente faciat
translation_en: God, refuge of the poor, hope of the humble, salvation of the miserable, with our most blessed founder of your Church Peter, we beseech you. Hear the supplications of your supplicants on this three-day fast of this Lenten season and graciously listen. Grant us peace from vices and enemies in these times, so that those who can be justly chastised by your justice through the scourges may instead be overwhelmed by your abundance of mercy themselves obtaining the blessed Peter.

text: Deus regnorum omnium et romani maxime protector imperii da servis tuis regibus nostris illis triumphum virtutis tuae scienter excolere ut cuius constitutione sunt principes eius semper munere sint potentes.
translation_en: God of all kingdoms and especially protector of the Roman Empire, grant your servants, our kings, the conscious cultivation of the triumph of Your virtue, so that those who are princes by Your constitution may always be powerful through Your gift.

text: Deus regnorum omnium regumque dominator qui nos et percutiendo sanas et ignoscendo conservas praetende nobis misericordiam tuam ut tranquillitate pacis tua potestate firmata ad remedia correctionis utamur.
translation_en: God of all kingdoms and ruler over kings, who heal us by striking and conserve us through forgiveness, grant us your mercy. May we find refuge in your power, established in tranquility and peace, so that we may use the remedies of correction with firm assurance.

text: Deus regum corona et martyrum victoria annue nos beati Olavi regis ac martyris apud te pia experiri patrocinia ut per tuam quam in eius glorificamus passione magnificentiam coronam vitae diligentibus te percipiamus repromissam.
translation_en: May God, the crown of kings and the victory of martyrs, grant us to experience the pious patronage of Blessed King and Martyr Olav through you. May we perceive the promised crown of life through your magnificence, which we celebrate in his passion, for those who are diligent.

text: Deus sanator noster et medicus sempiterne qui Cosmam et Damianum inconcussos fide insuperabiles in virtute fecisti ut per suscepta vulnera vulneribus mederentur humanis qui ante passionem ex terreno medicamine salutes operati essent in populis hos quaesumus nostris infirmitatibus et custodes et medicos deputa. Per eos sanentur infirma; per eos non recrudescant sanata. Per hos corpora per hos animae medicinam acquirant. Hii typicis animae aegritudinibus finem hii patulis celerem impendant aegrimoniis sanitatem; hii putredines vulnerum orationibus desecent hii manu precationis abdita vulneratorum expurgem. Hii virtutem invalidis roborem fessis victum egenis subventionem viduis defensionem orphanis tuitionem largiantur pupillis. Hii miseriis humanis medelam illaturi occurrant hii pressuris hominum concita levitigatione subveniant. Hii etiam sic nos a peccati morbo servent illaesos ut ad caelestem perducant patriam coronandos.
translation_en: Our healer and eternal physician, God, who made Cosmas and Damian unshakeable in faith and invincible in strength, we humbly ask that you assign them as our physicians and guardians. Through their intervention, the weak may be healed, those healed may not relapse, the sick may acquire health through them. May they quickly put an end to the afflictions of the soul, swiftly bring health to the afflicted, and cleanse the wounds of the wounded with prayers. May they grant strength to the weary, support to the needy, protection to orphans, guidance to the fatherless, and care to the widows. May they come to the aid of miserable humanity, and provide relief to the troubled with swift intervention. Through them may we be kept free from the disease of sin, so that we may be led to the heavenly kingdom as crown-worthy inhabitants.

text: Deus sanctificatio atque benedictio a te haec assumatur oblatio et apud nos pergat in retributione devotio.
translation_en: God, this offering of sanctification and blessing be taken from you. May it proceed among us in return for devotion.

text: Deus sanctificationum et Dominus caelestium virtutum exaudi preces nostras et benedictam hanc plebem Domini nostri Iesu Christi sanguine redemptam de sede sancta inaccessibilis claritatis exaudi.
translation_en: God of all sanctifications and Lord of celestial virtues, hear our prayers and bless this people, redeemed by the blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, from your inaccessible seat of radiant holiness.

text: Deus servientium tibi fortitudo regnorum propitius christianorum adesto semper principibus ut quorum tibi subiecta est humilitas eorum ubique excellentior sit potestas.
translation_en: May the strength of kingdoms, a favorable God to those serving you, always be present to princes. May it be that wherever their humility is subject to you, their power is everywhere more excellent.

text: Deus servientium tibi fortitudo regnorum propitius adesto christianorum principibus qui per resurrectionem Domini nostri Iesu Christi potestatem inferorum contrivisti et super inimicum pacis et veritatis triumphasti praesta quaesumus ut populus tuus huius virtutis auctorem laudans et confitens de inimicorum suorum elisione laetetur et quorum tibi subiecta est humilitas eorum ubique excellentior sit potestas.
translation_en: May the God of serving you, the strength of kingdoms, be gracious to the Christian leaders, who through the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ have undone the power of the underworld and triumphed over the enemy of peace and truth. Grant us that your people, lauding and confessing the author of this virtue, may rejoice in the disappearance of their enemies and that wherever their humility is subject to you, may your power be more exalted.

text: Deus simultatum discussor pacis quaesitor cuius ut pietatis esi disiuncta coniungere ita amoris est casta pacifice alligare tu nunc nos Domine apostolorum tuorum dogmata obsequentes pace necte caritate orna castitate sanctifica ut qui de beatae virginis Eulaliae passione meruimus habere exemplum mereamur devicta iracundia obtinere triumphum.
translation_en: God, disputer of peace and seeker, whose piety is separated, you are able to unite it so that the love is chaste and peaceful. Tie us now, Lord, with your apostles' dogma by peace, clothe us with charity, adorn us with chastity, sanctify us, so that we who have earned an example from the passion of the blessed virgin Eulalia may deserve to obtain the victory over anger.

text: Multiplica Domine benedictionem tuam ... adscribi mereantur.
translation_en: Lord, may Your blessing be multiplied... so that they may deserve to be added.

text: Deus spei lumen sincerum mentium luxque perfecta beatorum qui vere es lumen Ecclesiae tuae da cordibus nostris et dignam tibi orationem persolvere et te semper praeconiorum munere collaudare.
translation_en: God, pure light of hope, perfect light of the minds of the blessed who truly are the light of Your Church, grant to our hearts and enable us to offer a worthy prayer to You and constantly praise You by the office of heralds.

text: Multiplica Domine in hanc aream
translation_en: multiply, Lord, in this area

text: Deus spes vera credentium Deus gloria sempiterna sanctorum pro cuius miseratione indulgentiam consequuntur peccatores precamur te Domine suppliciter ut propitius respicias et sanctifices sacrificia ista et quasi incensum flagrans in odore suavissimo accipias.
translation_en: God, the true hope of believers, God of eternal glory of saints for whose mercy penitent sinners seek indulgence, we humbly pray Thee, Lord, that You may look upon it favorably and sanctify these sacrifices, and as a fragrant incense with a most sweet odor, receive them.

text: Deus spes et vita credentium gloria sempiterna sanctorum cuius indulgentiam consequuntur peccatores respice propitius preces nostras ut intercessione sanctorum Maximi et Philiberti sic tua indulgentia oblationem sanctifices et in odore suavissimo acceptes.
translation_en: God, hope and life of believers, eternal glory of the saints, whose indulgence sinners seek, have mercy upon our prayers. Through the intercession of Saints Maximus and Philbert may your indulgence sanctify our offering and may it be accepted in the sweetest fragrance.

text: Deus sub cuius nutibus vitae nostrae momenta decurrunt suscipe preces et hostias famulorum famularumque tuarum pro quibus misericordiam tuam aegrotantibus imploramus ut de quorum periculo metuimus de eorum salute laetemur.
translation_en: God under whose protection our moments of life flow, receive the prayers and offerings of your servants and handmaids for whom we implore your mercy on those who are sick. May we rejoice from their safety rather than fear for their peril.

text: Multiplica Domine super misericordiam tuam
translation_en: Multiply, Lord, Your mercy

text: Deus sub cuius oculis omne cor trepidat et omnes conscientiae pavescunt propitiare omnium doloribus gementium et cunctorum medere vulneribus ut sicut nemo nostrum liber a culpa est ita nemo sit alienus a venia.
translation_en: God, under whose eyes every heart trembles and all consciences are afraid, have mercy on all sorrows groaning and heal the wounds of all, so that just as none of ours is free from guilt, none may be foreign to grace.

text: Deus sub cuius oculis omne cor trepidat et omnes conscientiae pavescunt respice propitius ad preces gemitus mei et qui me nullis dignum meritis in loco huius servitutis tuae sacris fecisti assistere altaribus ita secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum da mihi indulgentiam peccatorum meorum ut mea fragilitas quae per se proclivis est ad labendum per te semper muniatur ad standum et quae per se prona est ad offensam per te semper reparetur ad veniam.
translation_en: God under whose eyes every heart trembles and all consciences fear, look upon me favorably in my prayers. And you who made me unworthy by no merits of mine to assist at these altars according to the multitude of your mercies, grant me the indulgence for my sins so that my frailty, which is naturally inclined to fall, may always be strengthened by you to stand, and that which is naturally prone to offense may always be repaired by you to attain forgiveness.

text: Deus summa spes nostrae redemptionis qui in terra promissionis ante omnes terras nasci elegisti mortemque ibidem sustinuisti libera propitius animam famuli tui illius de manibus daemonum et eandem terram de potestate paganorum ut populus qui in te non credit per virtutem tuam emendationem habeat et illis omnibus qui in te confidunt pro tua magna pietate succurre.
translation_en: God, our highest hope of redemption, who chose to be born on earth in the land of promise before all lands and there suffered death, mercifully free the soul of your servant from the hands of demons and deliver that same land from the power of pagans. May the people who do not believe in you obtain correction through your power, and may you come to the aid of all those who trust in you out of your great mercy.

text: Deus summe cuius sacrum pascha post biduum exspectamus tu offerentibus et defunctis veniam largire propitius sicque inediam abstinentium dulcedine crucis tuae sustenta quo humilitatis nostrae ieiunia statum semper habeant non ruinam.
translation_en: We await the most high God's sacred Easter after two days, through whose offering and for the departed may you mercifully grant forgiveness. Sustain the hunger of the abstaining ones with the sweetness of your cross, so that our fasting always has a state of humility rather than ruin.

text: Deus temporalis vitae administrator aeternae quoque auctor atque largitor miserere supplici tuo regi nostro illi coniugi et proli populoque sibi subiecto in tua proiectione et defensione fidenti ut per virtutem brachii tui omnibus sibi adversantibus superatis in tuae tranquillitatis ac securitatis pace consistat.
translation_en: God, administrator of temporal life and also the author and bestower, have mercy on your supplicant king, his spouse, and their subject people, who trust in Your protection and defense. May they, through the power of Your arm, overcome all those who oppose them, and may they establish themselves in Your tranquility and security.

text: Deus tibi gratias agimus per te mysteria sancta celebramus a te sanctitatis dona deposcimus.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, God, through you we celebrate the holy mysteries, from you we ask for gifts of holiness.

text: Deus totius claritatis conditor et moderator quem caelestia mirantur et terrena pavitant inferna tremescunt cui angelorum turmae et archangelorum exercitus militant non uti mundum expugnes quem ipse fecisti sed ut subruas mundi peccata quae diabolus adinvenit quia ita dignatus es diligere hunc mundum ut unigenitum tuum traderes pro nostra salute cuius cruce redempti sumus morte vivificati passione salvati resurrectione glorificati; per ipsum itaque te supplices invocamus ut huic familiae tuae in omnibus adesse digneris; sicut adfuisti patribus nostris sperantibus in tua misericordia sic et his omnibus adesse dignare ut sit in sensibus eorum timor devotionis tuae in corde fides in opere iustitia in actu pietas in lingua veritas in moribus disciplina ut digne recteque immortalitatis sibi praemium consequi mereantur.
translation_en: Creator and regulator of all brightness, whom the celestial beings adore and the earthly tremble, the infernal regions quake. The armies and troops of angels and archangels wage war not to conquer the world that you have made, but to overthrow the sins in the world which the devil has invented, because you were so pleased to love this world that you gave your only-begotten for our salvation. We, redeemed by his cross, are saved by his passion, glorified by his resurrection. Therefore, we humbly invoke you to be present with this family of yours in all things. Just as you were present to our ancestors who hoped in your mercy, so let it be for all of them that you deem fit to be present. May there be fear of your devotion in their hearts, faith in their minds, justice in their actions, piety in their deeds, truth in their speech, discipline in their habits, so that they may deserve and rightly earn the reward of immortality.

text: Deus totius conditor creaturae famulos tuos quos fonte renovasti baptismatis quosque gratiae tuae plenitudine solidasti in adoptionis sorte facias dignanter adscribi.
translation_en: May the Creator of all things graciously enroll your servants, whom he has renewed at the font of baptism and strengthened with the fullness of your grace, worthy to be called children by the decree of adoption.

text: Deus tuorum gloria iustorum martyre tuo Hippolyto quaesumus pro nobis supplicante omnia nobis prospera concede.
translation_en: We ask you, God of the glory of the righteous, through your martyr Hippolytus, grant us all things prosperous on our behalf as we humbly plead.

text: Deus tuorum gloria sacerdotum praesta quaesumus ut sancti confessoris et episcopi tui Donati cuius festa gerimus sentiamus auxilium.
translation_en: O God, bestow your glory upon the priesthood that we may ask, we beseech you. May we feel aid from the holy confesor and bishop of yours, Donatus, whose feast day we celebrate.

text: Deus tuorum gloria sacerdotum qui beatum praesulem Ethelwoldum pontificali decorasti merito ei honore tribue ex tua gratia eius supplicibus et tuam promereri clementiam et eius intercessionem assiduam.
translation_en: God, glory of your priests, who justly adorned the blessed bishop Ethelwold with pontifical decorations, grant him honor from your grace in response to his supplications. May your mercy be eagerly sought after by him and may his constant intercession be favorable.

text: Deus une et immense qui tam misericorditer lapsorum defectum reparas quam potenter eorum quae non erant statum aedificas da Ecclesiae tuae sanctae catholicae et fidei plenitudinem quam illi dedisti perfecte tenere et his qui per lapsum operis in illa succumbunt ex miseratione reparationem adesse quo aeternitatem per fidem acquirat et gloriae dignitatem per opus obtineat.
translation_en: God, the one and immense, who so mercifully repair the defect of sinners as powerfully build up what was not from their state, grant to your holy Catholic Church and the fullness of faith that they may perfectly keep what you have given them, and for those who through sin succumb in that work, let mercy's repair be present, so that through faith they may acquire eternal life and through works obtain the dignity of glory.

text: Deus une et trine simplex et iuste admirabilis et praeclare quem societas illa trina et indivisa sanctorum tuorum Fructuosi Agorii et Eulogii sic unita laudis voce inter flammas concelebrat ut quamlibet exusta ignibus membra deciderent eorum tamen animae divino flante spiritu plus calerent concede nobis tuorum martyrum intercessione ut per cottidiana temporum incrementa tua in nostris cordibus dilectio coalescat caritas ferveat ac legis tuae meditatio convalescat ut odiorum sopitis iurgiis vigeat in nobis flamma divina et exstinguantur malae cupidinis nutrimenta quo sicut praedicti martyres iniecti camino suis te in passionibus laudaverunt sic nos te opitulante ex omnium bonorum fructu tibi placere ante nostrum obitum mereamur.
translation_en: God, one and three, simple, just, admirable, and glorious, whom the indivisible fellowship of that Holy Trinity, Saint Fructuosus Agorius and Saint Eulogius, celebrates with a voice of praise amidst the flames, so that their bodies might be consumed by any fires, yet their souls burning with divine spirit grow warmer. Grant us through the intercession of your martyrs, that daily increments of your time may cause love to coalesce into charity and meditation of your law to strengthen in our hearts, that the flame of divine love may burn vigorously within us, extinguishing the nourishment of evil desires. May it be as the aforementioned martyrs sang praises to you amidst their trials, so we may deserve to please you with all good fruits before our death, when assisted by your aid.

text: Deus universae bonitatis auctor et egregiae virginitatis conservator adesto nobis quaesumus sanctae virginis Ethelburgae sollemnitatem celebrantibus et praesta ut per eius intercessionem mereamur accipere praesentis vitae iucunditatem et sempiternae lucis claritatem.
translation_en: We ask you, O God, author of all goodness and preserver of exquisite virginity, to be present with us. We make this plea on the occasion of the solemnity of the holy virgin Ethelburga being celebrated. Grant that through her intercession we may deserve to receive the joy of this present life and the clarity of eternal light.

text: Deus universalis creaturae dominator ei conditor quem agnoscere lux est colere salus desiderare corona est suscipe humilitatis nostrae libenter <oblata> et tribue divinitatis tuae dignanter indulta ut qui munera tui honoris offerimus culpae nostrae debita non luamus deprecantes ut quicumque iunguntur ad osculum magis illigentur affectu teneatur hoc pectore quod ore profertur.
translation_en: The universal ruler of creation, its creator whom to recognize is light, to worship is salvation, to desire is the crown; gladly receive our humility that we offer and grant befittingly the gifts of your divinity. So that those who offer the gifts of your honor are not dishonored by our faults, we beseech you: let anyone who unites in the kiss be more tightly held with affection in this heart that is offered through the mouth.

text: Deus universalis machinae propagator qui in sanctis spiritaliter in matre vero virgine etiam corporaliter habitasti quae ditata tuae plenitudinis ubertate mansuetudine florens caritate vigens pace gaudens pietate praecellens ab angelo gratia plena ab Elisabeth benedicta a gentibus merito praedicatur beata cuius nobis fides mysterium partus gaudium vita provectum discessus attulit hoc festivum precamur supplices ut pacem quam in assumptione matris tunc praebuisti discipulis in sollemnitate huius nunc largiaris in cunctis.
translation_en: We pray humbly to the universal creator who spiritually dwelt within the true virgin mother and even corporally resided with her, enriched by your plenitude of grace. Blooming in meekness, flourishing in charity, vibrant in peace, excelling in piety, you were proclaimed blessed by the angel, full of grace, honored by Elizabeth, rightly praised by nations. The joyful mystery of your faith, your birth, life's progression, and departure has brought us this festive day. We beseech you to grant us the peace that you then gave to your disciples on the occasion of the Assumption, and now lavish upon all in this solemnity.

text: Deus universalis machinae propagator qui dignatus es in sanctis habitare cordibus pacificis tuaque vero in matre etiam permansisti corporaliter ut ita eam omnium efficeres credentium matrem sicque ditatam ubertate tuae plenitudinis digne illam in suo adornares exitu ineffabiliter praedicandam. Insigne quoque ea florens castitate atque mansuetudine sicque ab angelo gratia audivit plena: »Adest dominus inquit tecum«. Ab Elisabeth iterum eiusdem domini mater indicitur benedicta in mulieribus.  Certe singulariter dominum dignoscitur gestatura angelis et cunctis gentibus pacem conceptum cuius fides novum in saeculo edidit mysterium suus partus attulit gaudium vita concessit provectum suus discessus hoc idoneum nobis attribuit festum. Tuis qui pacem in huius assumptione tunc praebuisti discipulis nobis quaesumus largians in huius sollemnitate gaudium omnibus cunctis simulque haereticorum scandalum longius propellatur ab ecclesiae membris.  Ita vero Domine tuam abundantissimam pietatem in hoc die exoramus ut te bene colentibus cunctis digneris concedere abundantiam pacis per huius interventum Mariae virginis.
translation_en:
O universal propagator of the machine, who has deemed fit to dwell in peaceful hearts and remained corporally in the mother, making her the mother of all believers, richly adorned by your grace, ineffably proclaimable in her exit. She also blooms with chastity and meekness and heard grace from an angel saying: "The Lord is present with you." Elizabeth, again indicated as the same Lord's mother, is blessed among women.
Indeed, the manner of the Lord is distinguished by angels and all nations who have received peace through faith. The new mystery of His birth brought joy to life, His progress to advancement, His departure to a fitting festival for us. To those who gave peace in this assumption, we humbly ask that you grant joy to all in this solemnity, and may the scandal of heretics be driven further away from the members of the church.
But truly, Lord, on this day we beseech your most abundant piety to deem worthy of granting abundance of peace through the intervention of Mary, the virgin.

text: Deus veniae largitor et humanae salutis amator quaesumus clementiam tuam ut nomina famulorum famularumque tuarum quae hic piae dilectionis officio pariter conscripsimus in libro vitae miserationis tuae gratia iubeas conscribi.
translation_en: God, giver of grace and lover of the human salvation, we humbly ask for your clemency that you may command the recording of the names of your servants and their servants who here in the office of devout love have jointly been written in the book of your merciful life, to be recorded.

text: Deus veniae largitor et humanae salutis amator quaesumus clementiam tuam ut nostrae congregationis fratres qui ex hoc saeculo transierunt beato illo patrono nostro intercedente ad perpetuae beatitudinis consortium pervenire concedas.
translation_en: God, bestower of grace and lover of human salvation, we humbly ask for your clemency that you grant our brothers who have passed from this world with our blessed patron interceding on their behalf, entrance into the eternal consortium of perpetual beatitude.

text: Deus vera pietas et pia veritas invicta clementia et bonitas sempiterna qui nos a morte volens eripere Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum mortem fecisti subire ut illius usque infernum descensus noster esset usque ad caelum adscensus te suppliciter postulamus ut anima famuli tui illius quam de huius saeculi aerumnosa peregrinatione praecipisti vocari universorum delictorum concessa remissione in Abrahae gremio iubeas collocari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, the true pity and faithful truth, invincible clemency and eternal goodness, who willingly want to free us from death, that our Lord Jesus Christ made death submit so that his descent into hell was as far as heaven, we humbly implore you to grant that the soul of your servant, whom you have commanded to be called away from this sorrowful pilgrimage of this world, be placed in Abraham's bosom by the granted remission of all sins.

text: Deus verae beatitudinis auctor atque largitor dirige nos in eam quam immaculati ambulant viam ut testimonia legis tuae piis cordibus exquirentes perseveremus et diligere quod praecipiunt et desiderare quo ducunt.
translation_en: God, the author and giver of true beatitude, direct us on the path that the immaculate ones walk, so that we may persistently seek the testimonies of your law in pious hearts and love what they command and desire where they lead.

text: Deus victricis Agnes adiutor et praemium exaudi nos illius interventu cuius passionis natalem celebramus cui tanti muneris gratiam contulisti ut diabolum qui per Evam humanum genus omne subverterat tenera aetate Agnes contereret et sexu imbecili superaret veritatis confessione prosterneret evidenter ostendens quod non solum perpetuae virginitatis martyr esset et virgo mansura sed agni immaculati sponsa fieri mereretur integre de nomine; assume ergo huius sacrificii immolationem gratanter qui coronasti gloriosam pro tantis meritis virginem.
translation_en: God, helper of the victorious Agnes, grant us your reward through her intervention, whom we celebrate on the birthday of whose passion you have seen fit to bestow such great gifts that the devil, who had overturned all humanity through Eve at a tender age, was conquered by Agnes and overcome through feeble sexuality, proven by his confession of truth, clearly showing that she not only deserved to be a martyr for perpetual virginity but also worthy to become the bride of the immaculate lamb in integrity of name. Therefore, graciously accept this offering of her sacrifice.

text: Deus virtutum corona martyrum collator gratiarum suscipe tantillae plebis precum obsequia quae ob honorem virginis tuae Eulaliae tibi deferimus dedicanda. Tu enim eam ultra aetatem facis esse victricem quam nullis praecedentibus meritis iam olim feceras tui nominis confessorem.  Sit ergo Domine eadem virgo sanctissima ante conspectum gloriae tuae nostrorum criminum et intercessor pariter et assertrix ut et diluenda proponat et proposita precibus diluat qualiter sic confessionem delictorum nostrorum accipiens ante te culpas singulorum ad emolumentum veniae asserat ut intercessorem pro his quae asseruerit interponat. Sit in salvationem terrae sit in defensionem patriae. Gubernet civem eliminet hostem subruat pestem arceat famem morbos dissicet adversum omne repellat optataque perficiat. Sicque per eam fautorem te semper nostris precibus praebe ut et his <diebus> intercessione eius peccata nostra habeant finem et in futuro suis meritis mereamur invenire quietem.
translation_en:
God of virtues, coroner of martyrs, accept the prayers of this humble people whom we bring as offerings dedicated to your virgin Eulalia. For you have made her a victor beyond her age, who already long ago, by merits of your name, made her a confessor.
May therefore, Lord, the same holy virgin stand before your glory as an atonement for our sins, both intercessor and defender. She should present and dissolve our confessions before you, asserting individual faults for the benefit of forgiveness. May she intercede for those whom she has asserted.
May she be for the salvation of the earth, the defense of the homeland. Guide the citizen, eliminate the enemy, destroy pestilence, ward off famine, diseases, and dissipate adversities against all, and achieve what is desired.
Thus, through her, may you always be our advocate with your prayers, so that our sins find an end through her intercession in these days, and in the future we may deserve to find peace through her merits.

text: Deus virtutum cuius est totum quod est optimum insere pectoribus nostris amorem tui nominis et praesta ut in nobis religionis augmento quae sunt bona nutrias ac vigilanti studio quae sunt nutrita custodias.
translation_en: O God of virtues, who is all that is best, place within our hearts the love of your name, and grant that we may nurture what is good in us with diligent care, and guard what is nourished with watchful vigilance.

text: Deus vita credentium et origo virtutum reple quaesumus hoc templum tuae gloria maiestatis <ut> in honorem beati illius fiat domus orationis quod perfidorum fuerat ante latibulum et quia infidelium turba in isto loco conveniebat adversa populus tuus oblationibus suis te hic semper mereatur invenire propitium.
translation_en: We ask you, God, the life of believers and the origin of virtues, to fill this temple of your glorious majesty. May it be made a house of prayer in honor of that blessed one who was once a hiding place for unbelievers, and since an assembly of unfaithful gathered against your people in this place, may your people here always deserve to find you propitious through their offerings.

text: Deus vita credentium regio vivorum exspectatio fidelium resurrectio mortuorum captivorum redemptio aeternitas redemptorum benignus indultor supplicantium preces accipe suffragantium intercessionibus mitigare confitentium peccata dimitte et quos redimere dignatus es humilitate corporea protegere digneris virtute divina.
translation_en: God, life of the believing, hope of the living, resurrection of the faithful, redemption of the captives, eternity of the redeemed, kind indulger of supplicants, receive our prayers and mitigate the sins of the contrite. Forgive those whom you deem worthy to redeem, and grant them protection through humble bodily state, and protect them with divine power.

text: Deus vita fidelium gloria humilium beatitudo iustorum propitius suscipe supplicum preces ut animae quae promissiones tuas sitiunt de tua semper abundantia repleantur.
translation_en: God, life of the faithful, glory of the humble, beatitude of the righteous, have mercy and accept our supplications. May the souls that thirst for your promises be filled forever from your ever-abundant goodness.

text: Deus vita fidelium gloria humilium beatitudo iustorum propitius accipe supplicum preces ut animae quae promissiones tuas sitiunt de tuae semper caritatis abundantia repleantur.
translation_en: God, life of the faithful, glory of the humble, beatitude of the righteous, be propitious to accept the supplications of the supplicants, that the souls who yearn for your promises may be filled from the abundance of your everlasting love.
