text: Deus vita fidelium timentium te Salvator et custos qui famulum tuum illum ad hunc diem natalis sui genuinum expleto anno perducere dignatus es gratiam in eo vitae provectioris augmenta et dies eius annorum numerositate multiplica ut te annuente per felicem provectus aetatem ad principatum caelestium gaudiorum pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: God, life of the faithful who fear you, Savior and guardian, who have deemed it worthy to lead your servant through this day, the genuine anniversary of his birth, completed year by year. Grant him more abundant increases of life and multiply the number of his years, that with your blessing he may advance through a happy progression of age and merit to reach the principality of celestial joys.

text: Deus vita viventium spes morientium salus omnium in te sperantium praesta propitius ut animae famulorum famularumque tuarum a nostrae mortalitatis tenebris absolutae in perpetua cum sanctis tuis luce laetentur.
translation_en: God, life of the living, hope of the dying, salvation for all who hope in you, graciously grant that the souls of your servants and their servants may be set free from the darkness of our mortality, and may shine forever with your saints in eternal light.

text: Deus vita viventium spes morientium salus omnium in te sperantium praesta propitius ut animae huius congregationis vel hic requiescentium a nostrae mortalitatis tenebris absolutae beato illo patrono nostro intercedente in perpetua cum sanctis tuis luce laetentur.
translation_en: God, life of the living, hope of the dying, salvation for all who hope in you, grant your favor that the souls of this congregation, or those here resting, may be freed from the darkness of our mortality with our blessed patron interceding, and may they rejoice in perpetual light with your saints.

text: Devotas Domine humilitatis nostrae preces et hostias misericordiae tuae praecedat auxilium et salutem quam per Adam in paradiso ligni clauserat temerata praesumptio ligni rursum fides aperiat.
translation_en: Lord, may your mercy precede our humble prayers and offerings with aid and salvation. As the reckless presumption of Adam closed the way by the tree in paradise, so may faith now open it up again.

text: Devotionem meam Domine dignanter intende et diuturnam mihi vitam cum tranquillitate concede talique in praesenti saeculo subsidio muni ut paradisi me in futuro habitatorem efficias et ita cor meum sanctificando benedic et benedicendo sanctifica ut mecum iugiter immo in me te habitare delectet.
translation_en: Lord, graciously attend to my devotion and grant me a long life with tranquility. May you equip me with aid in this world so that I may become a dweller of paradise in the future. Sanctify and bless my heart, and by blessing, sanctify it, that it always delights you to dwell within me or in me, indeed.

text: Devotionem populi tui quaesumus Domine benignus intende ut qui per abstinentiam macerantur in corpore per fructum boni operis reficiantur in mente.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you turn your benevolent attention to the devotion of your people. May those who are afflicted by fasting be revitalized in body through the fruit of good works, and in mind.

text: Devotionem quaesumus Domine nostrae mentis informa ut cum oblationibus hostiarum purum tibi pectus exhibeat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to shape our devotion so that with the offerings of sacrifices, a pure heart may present itself to you.

text: Devotioni nostrae Domine quaesumus clementer adesto ut intercedente beato Donato martyre tuo atque pontifice quod ad honorem tui nominis debito frequentamus obsequio fiat nobis remedium salutare.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to graciously attend to our devotion. Through the intercession of your martyr and pope, blessed Donatus, may it be that we fulfill our due obedience to your honorable name, and a salutary remedy be made available to us.

text: Devotionis nostrae tibi quaesumus Domine hostia iugiter immoletur quae et sacri peragat instituta mysterii et salutare tuum nobis mirabiliter operetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may a sacrifice be continually offered to your devotion, which not only fulfills the sacred rites of the mystery but also wonderfully works out your salvation for us.

text: Devotum tibi populum benignissime Deus clementer exaudi ut qui pio affectu venerandam beatae Mariae Aegyptiacae recolit sollemnitatem eius meritis apud te peccatorum obtineat remissionem.
translation_en: Most graciously, God, hear your devoted people benevolently and mercifully, so that those who with pious affection remember the solemnity of the blessed Mary of Egypt may obtain forgiveness for their sins through her merits with you.

text: Dextera tua Deus benedicat semper hanc domum et hos famulos quos tuis reficis donis; da cottidie clemens munera larga per omnes ut satiati donis referant tibi laudes perennes in memoriam.
translation_en: May your right hand, God, always bless this house and these servants whom you enrich with gifts; grant them daily generous gifts through all, so that satisfied with gifts, they may return to you perpetual praises in remembrance.

text: Dicata nomini tuo munera Domine sanctorum tuorum pro nobis satisfactio prosequatur ut offensae nostrae per eos qui tibi sunt placiti relaxentur.
translation_en: May the gifts offered to Your name, Lord, follow after satisfaction for us from Your holy ones, so that through those who are pleasing to You, our offenses may be released.

text: Dicatae tibi Domine quaesumus capiamus oblationis effectum ut a terrenae vetustatis conversatione mundati caelestis vitae profectibus innovemur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that we may partake of the result of the offering. May we be renewed, as we are purified from the worn-out ways of this earthly life, and advance towards the celestial life.

text: Dicato sollemniter famulatu omnipotentiam tuam Domine supplices imploramus ut concesso nobis sanctorum omnium patrocinio oblationes populi tui clemens accipias et propitius benedicas.  Praestes etiam prosperitatem vivis et quietem defunctis et qui ad testimonium devotionis deferunt consecranda ad remedium salutis mereantur recipere consecrata.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your almighty power, Lord, to grant us the patronage of all saints. May you graciously receive and bless the offerings of your people, and grant prosperity to the living and peace to the departed souls who bring consecrated offerings as a testimony of their devotion, so that they may deserve to receive blessed consecrations as a remedy for salvation.

text: Dies istos Domine quos in laetitia celebramus Christi tui resurrectio gloriosa depinxit nobisque in generatione perpetua celebrandos doctrina apostolica dereliquit. Adstantes ergo ante tuam maiestatem clementissime Pater pascha legitimum frequentamus et ut nobiscum sit sponsus aeternus iugi obsecratione deposcimus.  Eripe itaque nos et familiam tuam ab iniquitatibus cunctis ab scandalo et diebus malignis. Praepara nobis mensam venerandi altaris quam circumdemus velut suboles magnifici regis ut offerentes propitiatorium libamen pro nobis et famulis tuis exaudiri apud te mereamur tam pro viventibus quam pro defunctis.
translation_en:
These days, Lord, which we celebrate with joy in Your glorious Resurrection of Christ, the apostolic teaching has left us to celebrate perpetually. Therefore, standing before Your most gracious Majesty, Father, we participate in the legitimate Easter festival and humbly ask that our eternal Spouse may be with us in eternal wedding vows.
May You therefore save us and Your family from all iniquities, scandals, and evil days. Prepare for us a table at the revered altar, which we surround as the sprouts of a magnificent king, so that offering the propitiatory sacrifice on our behalf and Your servants, we may deserve to be heard by You not only for the living but also for the dead.

text: Dies nostros Domine placatus intende et quos praesenti cursu multiplicas iustis operibus redde fecundos.
translation_en: Lord, incline your favorable regard toward our days, and multiply us with just works in this present course, making us fruitful.

text: Digna Domine Deus noster laus debetur martyribus tuis digna veneratio militibus certis dignum obsequium impendi debet fidelibus amicis. Tres hodie voluerunt mori ut viverent; voluerunt occidi ut regnarent; voluerunt crucifigi ut gehennae cruciatus evaderent et divitias regni caelestis perpetuo possiderent.  O beatum consilium quod inter tormenta et poenas non est mutatum sed sic Faustus Ianuarius et Martialis toto animo et corde confortati sunt per Spiritum Sanctum ut hodie vincerent diabolum calcarent saeculum et mente et corpore sequerentur regem aeternum quorum expetimus interventu ut per ipsos praebeas te nobis Domine Deus noster propitium et infundas super nos multimodas misericordias benedictionum tuarum.
translation_en:
Worthy of praise, Lord God, is the laud to your martyrs worthy of veneration the service due to your certain soldiers. Today three wished to die so that they might live; wished to be slain so that they might reign; wished to be crucified so that they might escape the torments of hell and perpetually possess the riches of the heavenly kingdom.
O blessed counsel, which has not been changed even amidst torture and punishments, yet was Fortunatus Januarius and Marcellus strengthened by the Holy Spirit, so today they conquered the devil, trampled upon the world, and followed with mind and body the eternal king whom we hope will appear to us through them, Lord God, that you might show yourself propitious to us and pour over us abundant mercies of your blessings.

text: Digne nos tuo nomini quaesumus Domine famulari salutaris cibus et sacer potus instituat et renovationem condicionis humanae quam mysterio continet in nostris iugiter sensibus operetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that worthy of your name we may serve the saving food and holy drink that you have instituted. May the renewal of human condition, which is contained in the mystery, continually work in our senses.

text: Digne nos tuo nomini quaesumus Domine famulari salutaris cibus et sacer potus efficiat ut renovatio condicionis humanae quam mysteria continent in nostris iugiter sensibus offeratur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you may worthy make us servants to serve your salutary food and sacred drink. May it effect within us a renewal of our human condition, which the mysteries contain and is continually offered in our senses.

text: Dignus es Domine Deus noster accipere virtutem et fortitudinem quia tu creasti omnia et sine tua voluntate factum est nihil. Exaudi nos supplicantes pro famulo tuo illo sicut exaudire dignatus es Petrum in mari. Ita et per eius suffragia tuae dextera maiestatis ipsum putridissimum diabolum ab hoc corpore famuli tui expellere digneris ut eum per tuum sanctum munimen er per tuum sanctum nomen et per sigillum sanctae crucis Domini nostri Iesu Christi quem ego indignus et peccator signo amplius numquam audeat violare.
translation_en: You are worthy, Lord our God, to receive power and strength, for you have created all things, and nothing has been made without your will. Hear us, O Lord, as you heard Peter in the sea. In the same way, through his intercession, may your right hand deign to drive away this most putrid devil from this servant's body, expelling him by your holy protection, by your holy name, and by the seal of the Holy Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, whom I, an unworthy sinner, never again dare to violate.

text: Dilatetur omnipotens Deus anima nostra in pacem tuam et caro obsequatur tibi per abstinentiae parsimoniam ut utraque tibi fideliter obsequendo caritatis tuae remuneretur ex dono.
translation_en: Let the Almighty God expand our soul into your peace, and let our flesh obey you through the thrift of abstinence, so that both may be rewarded with the gift of your charity as they faithfully serve you.

text: Dimitte Domine peccata nostra et tribue nobis misericordiam tuam qua oris nostri alloquio deprecatus famuli tui illius humilitatem attendas vincula solvas delicta deleas tribulationem inspicias adversitatem repellas effectumque petitioni nostrae largiens clementer exaudias.
translation_en: Lord, forgive us our sins and grant us your mercy, as we humbly ask on behalf of your servant. May you pay attention to his humility, unfasten the bonds, erase the offenses, consider the tribulation, repel the adversity, and fulfill our petition graciously, granting your clemency.

text: Dirigat corda nostra Domine quaesumus tuae miserationis operatio quia tibi sine te placere non possumus.
translation_en: Direct our hearts, we beseech Thee, Lord, Thy operation of mercy, for we can please Thee without Thee not being able to.

text: Dirige Deus viam famuli tui nosque pro eo exaudi supplicantes habeat iter prosperum et in te Domine cor directum.
translation_en: Direct, O God, the way of your servant; and grant us grace for his sake. Hear our supplication, and may he have a prosperous journey, and in you, Lord, let his heart be steadfast.

text: Dirige quaesumus Domine viam famulorum tuorum in voluntate tua nosque propitius exaudi supplicantes ut habeant iter prosperum et in te cor directum.
translation_en: Direct us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, the way of Thy servants according to Thy will. And graciously hear our supplications, that they may have a prosperous journey and a heart turned towards Thee.

text: Dirige Domine famulum tuum illum in via tua et custodi eum in omnibus viis tuis et angelus sanctus tuus caelestis comitetur cum eo ad dirigendos pedes eius in viam pacis.
translation_en: Direct, Lord, your servant on your way and guard him in all your paths. May your holy angel accompany him to guide his feet into the way of peace.

text: Dirige Domine quaesumus Ecclesiam tuam dispensatione caelesti ut quae ante mundi principium in tua semper est praesentia praeparata usque ad plenitudinem gloriamque promissam te moderante perveniat.
translation_en: Direct, Lord, we ask, Your Church with celestial dispensation, that what was always prepared in Your presence before the beginning of the world, may reach its fullness and promised glory, guided by You.

text: Dirigere dignare Domine Deus in adiutorium nostrum Raphaelem archangelum et quem tuae maiestati semper assistere credimus tibi nostras exiguas preces benedicendas assignet.
translation_en: Direct us, O Lord God, in the aid of our help Raphael the archangel, and him whom we always believe to assist your majesty, may he set forth our humble prayers as blessings to you.

text: Discat Ecclesia tua Deus Infantium quos hodie veneramur exemplo sinceram tenere pietatem quae prius vitam praestitit sempiternam quam posse(n)t nosse praesentem.
translation_en: May your church, God, teach the infants whom we come to honor today, to hold a sincere piety that they lived before eternal life could be known by us in the present.

text: Disrumpe Domine vincula peccatorum nostrorum ut sacrificare tibi hostiam laudis absoluta libertate possimus; retribue quae ante tribuisti et salva nos per indulgentiam quos salvare dignatus es per gratiam.
translation_en: Break, Lord, the bonds of our sins that we may offer to you a sacrifice of praise with absolute freedom; restore what you have given and save us through indulgence, whom you have been gracious enough to save.

text: Disrumpe Domine obsecro vincula peccatorum meorum ut sacrificare tibi hostiam laudis absoluta libertate praevaleam. Exstingue per hanc deprecor inimici insidias reluctantis. Reforma quem retribueras tuae donum gratiae castitatis et nunc salva per indulgentiam quem dignatus es salvare per gratiam.
translation_en: Break, I entreat you Lord, the bonds of my sins, that I may offer to you a sacrifice of praise with absolute freedom prevailing. Extinguish through this prayer, I implore, the tricks of my enemies who are reluctant. Renew, as you have promised, your gift of grace for chastity and now save, through indulgence, him whom you have deemed worthy to save through grace.

text: Diversis oblationibus sacris altaribus una tamen fidei devotione collatis mutuae invicem sollicitudinis vota promamus a domini pietate poscentes ut corda omnium offerentium ad hostiam rationabilem et complacitae sibi sanctificationis emundet et quiescentium animas in sinu Abrahae collocare dignetur et in parte primae resurrectionis admittat.
translation_en: With diverse sacred offerings, we lay before the altars united in faith's devotion. We humbly ask our Lord's mercy that the hearts of all those offering may be cleansed and pleasing to Him, sanctified by the reasonable sacrifice, and that He may deem worthy to place the resting souls in the bosom of Abraham, and grant them a place in the first resurrection.

text: Diversis plebs tua Domine gubernata subsidiis et praesentia pietatis tuae remedia capiat et futura ut transeuntium rerum necessaria consolatione fovente fiducialius ad aeterna contendat.
translation_en: Your diverse people, Lord, guided by various supports and the presence of your pity, may find relief and future hope strengthened by the comforting necessity of transient things, and they may strive more confidently for eternal life.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quae pro huius sancti illius veneratione tuae obtulimus maiestati praesta quaesumus ut per ea veniam mereamur peccatorum et caelestis gratiae donis reficiamur.
translation_en: We humbly offer to Your majesty the divine mysteries which we have presented for the veneration of this holy one. We beseech You, grant us through these mysteries that we may worthy receive forgiveness for our sins and be refreshed by heavenly grace's gifts.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quaesumus Domine ut eorum nos ubique intercessio protegat quorum hic sacra gaudemus habere patrocinia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect us everywhere by the intercession of those whose sacred mysteries we joyfully celebrate here, and who serve as our patronage.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quaesumus Domine ut beati Francisci intercessio nos ubique gloriosa protegat cuius auxilio confisi haec sacra tuae detulimus maiestati.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Lord, to let the divine mysteries we offer be pleasing to You. Through the intercession of blessed Francis, may he everywhere protect us with his glorious aid, to whom we confidently dedicate these sacred offerings to Your majesty.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quaesumus Domine ut haec salutaria sacramenta illis proficiant ad prosperitatem et pacem pro quorum dilectione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that these divine mysteries be beneficial for them, leading to prosperity and peace. For the love of those for whom we offer these on Your majesty.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quaesumus Domine ut haec salutaria sacramenta principi nostro proficiant ad prosperitatem et pacem quatenus tibi secura mente deserviat et in tua semper protectione ad tutamentum christiani populi assistere mereatur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Lord, to make these divine mysteries profitable for our prince, that they may lead to prosperity and peace. May he serve You with a peaceful mind and merit Your constant protection, so that he may assist in the defense of the Christian people.

text: Divina libantes mysteria quaesumus Domine ut haec salutaria sacramenta famulo tuo illi ad corporis et mentis medelam proficiant eumque a vitiis expurgent et a periculis omnibus exuant et per intercessionem sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae in tua faciant proficere dilectione et laetari protectione ut in tua pace semper assistere mereatur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Divine Lord, that these saving mysteries may profit Your servant for the healing of body and mind, cleanse him from vices, free him from all dangers, and through the intercession of the Holy Mother of God, Mary, may they advance in Your love and rejoice in Your protection, so that he may always merit to assist in Your peace.

text: Divina libantes sacramenta concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut haec eadem nobis proficiant ad salutem et animabus pro quibus tuam deprecamur clementiam prosint ad indulgentiam.
translation_en: Divine one, grant us your sacraments, we humbly ask you, Almighty God. May these same (sacraments) bring us to salvation. And may your mercy, for which we plead, benefit the souls we pray for, towards indulgence.

text: Divina nos quaesumus Domine purificent sacramenta et famulum tuum abbatem nostrum cum subditis suis misericorditer protegant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you purify the divine sacraments and protect our abbot and his subjects mercifully.

text: Divinam misericordiam fratres carissimi concordi oratione poscamus ut haec salutifera sacramenta nostris recepta visceribus purificent animam corpusque sanctificent atque in spem caelestium viscera pariter et corda confirmem.
translation_en: We humbly ask our most dear brothers in united prayer for the divine mercy, that these salvific sacraments received by us may purify our innermost beings, sanctify our bodies, and strengthen both our heavenly desires and hearts alike.

text: Divini muneris largitate refecti quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quos tuis sacrificiis deservire voluisti ipsos tibi hostiam viventem semper exsistere concedas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, through the generosity of your divine gifts, that you who have desired for us to serve you with our sacrifices, may always grant us to exist as a living sacrifice before you.

text: Divini muneris largitate satiati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut in huius semper participatione vivamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that filled with the bounty of your grace, we may always live in participation.

text: Divini muneris largitate satiati quaesumus Domine ut devotionem famuli tui illius confirmes in bonis et mittas ei auxilium de sancto et de Sion tuearis eum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, filled with the bounty of your divine grace, to strengthen the devotion of your servant in good works and to send him help from the holy and protect him under your Zion.

text: Divini perceptio sacramenti famem Domine quaesumus a nobis repellat animarum et sancti Machuti intercessio ad caelestium nos perducat dulcedinem epularum.
translation_en: By the perception of the Divine Sacrament, we humbly ask, Lord, that hunger be driven away from us. May the intercession of Saint Machutus guide us to the sweetness of heavenly banquets.

text: Divini quaesumus Domine perceptio sacramenti beatorum apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli supplicationibus nos ab universis tueatur adversitatibus ut quos habuimus in fide doctores in omni sentiamus necessitate pios adiutores.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the perception of the sacrament of your blessed apostles Peter and Paul, we may be protected from all adversities. May those whom we have as teachers in faith appear to us as necessary helpers in every situation.

text: Divinis Domine muneribus satiati quaesumus ut beati Antonii confessoris tui meritis gloriosis salutaris victimae desideratum sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: Lord, having been satisfied by your divine gifts, we humbly ask that through the merits of your blessed confidant Saint Anthony, we may experience the fulfillment of our desired salvation.

text: Divinis Domine repleti sacramentis supplices deprecamur ut beati pontificis Iuliani meritis nos dignos facias caelestibus institutis.
translation_en: Lord, filled with divine sacraments, we humbly entreat you that through the merits of Blessed Pope Julius, you may deem us worthy according to heavenly institutions.

text: Divinis quaesumus Domine redempti mysteriis ut beatae Brigidae virginis tuae suffragiis sublevemur et a praesentis vitae adversitatibus liberemur et aeternae beatitudinis praemia consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the mysteries of our redemption, may we be lifted up by the intercessions of your blessed Virgin Brigida and freed from the adversities of this life, so that we may obtain the rewards of eternal beatitude.

text: Nec te latet satanas imminere
translation_en: Satan does not escape your notice approaching.

text: Divinis sacramentis refecti quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii intercessionibus gaudiis mereamur interesse caelestibus.
translation_en: Having been refreshed by the divine sacraments, we humbly ask, Lord our God, that through the intercession of your holy martyrs Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor, and Nazarius, we may deserve to join in the joys of the heavenly ones.

text: Divino munere satiati maiestatem tuam supplices exoramus omnipotens Deus ut intercessionibus sanctorum tuorum Sisinnii Martyrii et Alexandri propriis careamus culpis et tuis inhaerere valeamus mandatis.
translation_en: Filled with the divine gift, we humbly beseech Your majesty, Almighty God, that through the intercessions of Your saints Sisinnius the Martyr and Alexander, we may be free from our sins and able to cling to Your commandments.

text: Divino refecti libamine quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beata Agnete virgine tua et martyre praesentis nobis vitae subsidium et aeternae tribuas reperire laetitiam.
translation_en: Fed by divine refreshment, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through the intercession of your blessed virgin and martyr, Saint Agnes, you grant us support for this life and lead us to find eternal joy.

text: Divinorum munerum Domine sumpta mysteria nobis tuae quaesumus salvationis conferant munia et magnifici confessoris tui Martialis pii semper exhibeant auxilii patrocinia.
translation_en: Lord, grant us the mysteries of your divine gifts, may they bestow upon us the duties of salvation. And may the merits and patronage of your faithful confessor St. Martin always be shown as aid.

text: Doce me Domine quaeso patientiam ad sustinendum adversa doce scientiam scripturarum ut sic loquar ne superbiam sic taceam ne torpescam; sic contine ut non cadam sic constringe ut numquam demittas; malum omne evacuam a conscientia mea et eam tu reple ne aliud recipiat; erraticum collige ad te et vinculo me tuae pietatis adstringe; tu duc quo placet et non dissolvas; tu vere es vita attrahe me ad te et de mortis ianua revoca me; praecipitem esse non sinas me sed freno disciplinae tuae constringe me; quod animae meae est obvium repelle a me et prosperum misericordiae bonitate largire in me; peccatum omne tolle a me et gratiam timoris et amoris tui tribue mihi.
translation_en: Teach me, Lord, I ask, patience to endure adversity; teach me the knowledge of scriptures so that I may speak without pride, and remain silent without growing cold; contain me so that I do not fall, constrain me so that you never abandon me; drive out all evil from my conscience and fill it with you instead, that it may receive nothing else; gather the wandering to you and bind me with the bond of your pity; lead me where you will and do not abandon me; you are truly life, attract me to you and call me back from the door of death; do not let me fall headlong but restrain me with the discipline of yours; what is due to my soul repel from me and bestow on me prosperity through your mercy and kindness; take all sin away from me and grant me grace through fear and love of you.

text: Dominator Domine qui superstites atque defunctos sicut volueris misericors tuum tenes in nutum adesto precibus nostris ut sanctorum nominibus recensitis illorum meritis adiuvemur atque haec sacrificia quae tibi offerimus et viventibus proficiant ad salutem et defunctis opitulentur ad requiem.  Etenim his illatis muneribus princeps noster et universus exercitus illius in omnibus iugiter opem potiatur divinam deprecantibus nobis et sicut olim Iosue dum septies cum tubis moenia circuit Iericho ruentibus muris illico victoriam cepit de urbe ita Domine omnipotens Deus orantes deposcimus ut si quid fortasse conati fuerint principes nostri contra iram imperes ut sub pedibus illius tabescant velociter prostrati.
translation_en: Lord, Master who rules over the living and the dead as you will, in your merciful nature, be present to our prayers. May we be aided by the merits of the saints as they are remembered, and may these sacrifices which we offer to you benefit the living towards salvation and aid the dead towards rest. Indeed, with these gifts bestowed upon us, our leader and his entire army are ever in need of divine help as they pray to us. Just as Joshua once, when he circled Jericho seven times while its walls were falling, obtained victory at once, so Lord almighty God, do we implore you, if our leaders have dared anything against your wrath, may they quickly wither beneath your feet and be swiftly prostrate.

text: Dominator et inspirator omnium munerum Christe Filius Dei qui apostolorum tuorum praedicatione universos terrarum situs illustras et evangeliorum amne quadrifluo rigas quique pro te mori posse martyribus tribuisti eosque pro ultronea morte coronas respice in hac festivitate martyris tui sancti Matthaei apostoli et evangelistae tuorum fidelium vota eosque illaesos aevi facito periculosi transire naufragia ut qui illum una vocationis tuae voce dignum tibi fecisti ministrum qui regalem tuam sequens prosapiem primus scriberet evangelium facias nos in te sequendum idoneos et in timore nominis tui perfectos.  Instrue quaesumus nos eius doctrinis quem fore voluisti scriptorem primum evangelicae praedicationis. Reple nos eius meritis spiritali fervore qui praeconia veritatis tuae eius voluisti audiri ex ore. Da nobis amorem tui qui eidem dedisti gratiam Spiritus Sancti. Trahe nos ad te miserationibus consuetis qui illum evangelistam fecisti ex publicanis operibus. Illumina nostri cordis arcana qui illum ad teloneum sedentem vocasti gratia gratuita. Eius interventu nobis adesto placatus qui tuus factus est in veritate discipulus. Exaudi illum pro nobis qui apud illum cum non egeres prandis. Ipse ad te nostra tibi placitura deferat vota cuius praedicatio in toto mundo facta est gloriosa. Non nostris nos patiaris puniri pro meritis qui illum replesti muneribus sanctis.  Suscipe in eius honorem nostrum obsequium qui illum post tanta praeconia fecisti martyrem gloriosum ut qui poenam meremur ex propriis in eius honorem tibi oblatis iustificemur obsequiis qualiter dum eius meritis vota famulantium suscipis eius obtentu facias eidem obsequentes cum illo consortes in caelestibus regnis.
translation_en:
Lord and inspirer of all ministries, Christ Son of God, who illuminated the whole setting of the earth through the preaching of your apostles and watered them with the four-streamed river of the Gospel, and who granted martyrdom to those capable of dying for you and crowned them for a cruel death. Look upon us in this festivity of your martyr, Saint Matthew the apostle and evangelist, and make the wishes of your faithful ones effective. Make them pass safely through the dangerous shipwrecks, so that those whom you have made worthy ministers through your own voice following the first scribe of your royal Gospel. Make us fit to follow you and perfect in fear of your name.
Teach us his teachings, for whom you wanted to be the first writer of the evangelical preaching. Fill us with spiritual fervor from his merits who wished to hear the praises of your truth from his mouth. Give us love for him, whom you gave grace through the Holy Spirit. Draw us to you by your usual acts of mercy, who made that sinner sitting at the tax booth an evangelist. Illuminate the mysteries of our hearts which you called with gratuitous grace. His intercession be present with us, who became his disciple in truth. Hear him for us who did not have meals with him. Let him bring to you the wishes which he made glorious throughout the world. Do not let us suffer punishment for his merits, but receive our obedience offered in his honor.
Receive our obedience in his honor, who after such preaching made him a glorious martyr, so that those whom we offer you as penance worthy of him may be justified by our services according to his merits. When we make requests through his intercession, let us be granted them through his merit and let us become companions with him in heavenly kingdoms.

text: Domine adiutor et protector noster (adiuva nos et) refloreat caro nostra vel vigore pudicitiae vel sanctimoniae novitate ereptamque de manu tartari in resurrectionis gaudium iubeas praesentari.
translation_en: Lord, our helper and protector (help us and) let our flesh flourish either by the vigor of chastity or the newness of holiness, snatched from the hand of Tartarus, command it to be presented in the joy of resurrection.

text: Non intres in iudicio cum servo tuo
translation_en: You shall not enter into judgment with your servant.

text: Domine adiutor meus et protector in tribulationibus obsecro immensam potentiam et pietatem tuam ut per auxilium gratiae tuae refloreat caro mea vigore pudicitiae et sanctimoniae novitate ut zona castitatis succincta lorica fidei circumdata in resurrectione iustorum aeterna gaudia comprehendat.
translation_en: Lord, my helper and protector in tribulations, I beseech Your immense power and mercy that through the help of Your grace, my flesh may flourish with new vigor of chastity and sanctity. May I be enclosed in a robe of chastity as a breastplate of faith, so that in the resurrection of the righteous, eternal joy may be grasped.

text: Domine aeterne cui ita in sanctis apostolis tuis Iacobo et Ioanni placuit arcanum dispensationis implere ut glorioso passionis exemplo apostolorum chorum ille praecederet iste praemitteret atque ita inter utrumque grex consummaretur beatus ut omnium devotionem ille praecederet iste concluderet miserere nostri et exaudi nos et praesta ut possimus praedictorum martyrum tuorum apostolorumque vel illius exemplo fidem tenere qua coronatur vel istius magisterio caritatem discere quam docetur.
translation_en: Lord eternal, it pleased you in your holy apostles James and John to fulfill the secret of dispensation so that the choir preceded by the glorious example of the apostles' passion would lead and that which follows would precede, and thus the flock was completed blessed, so that he (James) led devotion before all, and he (John) concluded it. Have mercy on us and hear us, and grant that we may be able to hold faith through the example of your martyrs, the apostles, or his (John's) teaching, love which is taught by him.

text: Domine Christe Iesu qui maiestate sublimis es et potestate subnixus cum in virtute patris obsequeris iussionibus matris ut et filium hominis ostenderis obsequiis et Deum virtutibus approbaris qui ad omnium gentium lavationem Iordanis alveum sanctificaturus intrasti ut peccata nostra ablueres conscientiasque purgares visita Ecclesiam tuam et perfice omnium vota; pacem etiam non petentibus praesta ut osculum quod in labiis datur in cordibus non negetur.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, who are exalted in majesty and subject in power, as you obey the commands of the Father and reveal the Son of Man through obedience, and approve God through virtues; who sanctified the Jordan river for the washing of all nations, entered to wash away our sins and purify consciences. Visit your Church and complete the desires of all. Also, grant peace not only to those who ask for it, so that the kiss given on the lips may also be in the hearts.

text: Domine Deus Abraham Deus Isaac Deus Iacob Deus patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum et martyrum omniumque sanctorum sicut pro piissima misericordia tua dedisti eis voluntatem veniendi ad te ita clementissime Pater da servis tuis intellectum virtutem et possibilitatem ut tibi secundum voluntatem tuam serviamus; spiritus tuus bonus deducat nos in via recta; da incipientibus perfectionem da parvulis intellectum da currentibus adiutorium da neglegentibus compunctionem da tepidis spiritum ferventem da perfectis bonam consummationem; loquatur os nostrum laudem tuam et per singulos dies benedicamus te et laudemus nomen tuum in aeterna saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Lord God of Abraham, God of Isaac, God of Jacob, God of patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, and all saints, as graciously bestowed upon them the willingness to come to you, most merciful Father, grant Your servants understanding, power, and ability to serve You according to Your will. May Your good Spirit lead us on the right path; give strength to beginners, understanding to children, help to those in need, compunction to the negligent, a fervent spirit to the lukewarm, and a good completion to the perfect ones. Let our mouth speak Your praise and every day we bless You and praise Your name forever and ever in eternal centuries.

text: Domine Deus cunctipotens pater totius mundanae molis mirificus opifex suscipe deprecationem servorum tuorum cum muneribus hostiarum quae in sacratissima celebritate famulae tuae Etheldrethae tibi deferimus et concede ut per haec divina sacramenta cunctos carnales actus valeamus respuere atque omnium incrementa virtutum percipere.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, Father of all the universe, wonderful craftsman, receive the supplication of your servants along with the offerings and sacrifices which we present to you in the most sacred celebration of your servant Etheldreth. Grant that through these divine sacraments, we may be able to resist all carnal acts and perceive the increase of virtues in all.

text: Domine Deus de Deo lumen de lumine qui humanum genus ex praecepto patris patibulo crucis proprio sanguine redimere dignatus es te suppliciter exoramus ut non secundum peccata nostra facias nobis sed secundum misericordiam tuam salvos nos fac indignos famulos tuos; tu quoque exsurge in adiutorium nostrum et esto ibi turris fortitudinis et clipeus inexpugnabilis iustitiae a facie tam corporalis quam incorporalis inimici atque ab omni peccato et poena misericorditer nos libera et ab omni adversitate corporis et animae clementer nos defende.
translation_en: Lord God of God, light from light, who deigned to redeem the human race by the precept of your Father on the cross with your own blood, we humbly entreat you not to do so according to our sins, but according to your mercy save us, unworthy servants; you also arise as a helper for our sake and be there a tower of fortitude and an impregnable shield of justice before both physical and spiritual adversaries. With mercy, free us from every sin and punishment, and with kindness protect us from all bodily and spiritual hardship.

text: Domine Deus dilectionis et pacis in cuius dextera salus nostra est praesta ut ad te non ore tantum sed et corde vigilemus; timorem tui nominis nostris emitte visceribus et amorem infunde pectoribus.
translation_en: Lord God of love and peace, in whose right hand is our salvation, grant that we may watch both with mouth and heart toward you; let the fear of your name be sent to our innermost being, and let love be poured into our hearts.

text: Domine Deus Iesu Christi Domini nostri ante cuncta principia genitor et in fine saeculi demonstrator te supplices humili imploratione precamur ut nobis in hoc die sacrato virginis tuae illius collectis nulla diabolicae fraudis illecebrosa irruptio subrepat ut quae vim suae carnis vincendo sexum meruit transgredi genitalem nos quoque sua tibi faciat esse placibiles prece et quae per carnis suae contemptum amori connexa est tuo nos suo adsociet te miserante consortio quaeve triumphalem palmam adepta est sui sanguinis effusione pro nobis apud te suffragetur in iudicii futuri examine ut nos debita non puniamur ex poena qui eius suffragio nostraque te placari credimus obsequela.
translation_en: Lord God Jesus Christ, our Lord, before all beginnings and in the end of the age, the demonstrator, we humbly beseech you on this holy day that no diabolical temptation may burst upon us through the insidious intrusion, so that what by her conquering her own flesh merited to transgress the sexual boundary, she might also make us pleasing to you in prayer. And what was joined in love through the contempt of her flesh, may she unite us with your mercy and the consortium you have shown. May she who obtained the triumphal palm through the outpouring of his blood for us, intercede for us before you at the judgment to come, so that we may not be punished according to our deserved penalty, whom we believe will placate you by her intercession and our own obedience.

text: Domine Deus incomprehensibilis aeterne perpetue benedicte qui dixisti: »Non veni vocare iustos sed peccatores ad paenitentiam« et cum profectu nostro non egeas gaudes tamen super uno peccatore paenitentiam agente magis quam super nonaginta novem iustos qui non indigent paenitentia quia tu es Deus solus et praeter te non est alius qui non vis mortem peccatoris sed ut convertatur et vivat converte nos Domine ad te et convertamur converte nos Deus salutaris noster et averte iram tuam a nobis ne perdas nos cum peccatis nostris ne tradas bestiis animas confitentes tibi ne derelinquas in finem ne intres in iudicio cum servis tuis neque in ira furoris tui corripias nos miserere nobis Domine miserere nobis opera manuum tuarum sumus non pereamus memento congregationis tuae quam creasti ab initio dirige nos in viam rectam doce nos facere voluntatem tuam quia tu es Deus noster statue pedes in consummatione ut te adiuvante vincamus antiqui hostis insidias ut liberi ab infestatione inimici serviamus tibi in sanctitate et iustitia omnibus diebus vitae nostrae.
translation_en: Lord God, incomprehensible eternally and perpetually blessed one who said: "I did not come to call the righteous but sinners to repentance," and although our progress does not please you, yet you rejoice more over one penitent sinner than over ninety-nine just ones who do not need repentance, because you alone are God and besides you there is no other who desires the death of the sinner but that he may turn and live. Turn us to yourself, Lord, and we will turn; turn us, O God our Savior, and avert your wrath from us lest we perish with our sins; lest you hand over our souls to beasts confessing to you; lest you abandon us in the end nor enter into judgment with your servants; nor correct us in your anger. Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us; the work of your hands we are not that we may perish. Remember your congregation which you created from the beginning; direct us in the right way; teach us to do your will because you are our God; arrange our feet in completion so that with your help we may overcome the ancient enemy's snares, and serve you in sanctity and justice all days of our life.

text: Domine Deus noster concede propitius ut qui unigeniti tui sumpsimus corpus et sanguinem ab infidelis discipuli reddamur caecitate divisi qui Christum Dominum nostrum verum Deum hominemque fatemur et colimus.
translation_en: Lord God, graciously grant that we who have taken the body and blood of your only-begotten may be returned from unbelievers in blindness. Those who confess and worship Christ as our true God and man.

text: Domine Deus noster cuius est prima causa miserendi qua nomen tuum timeamus et amemus cordibus nostris miseratus infunde ut quae tibi non placent refutantes sincera tibi voluntate subdamur.
translation_en: Lord God, to whom belongs the first cause of mercy, whose name we fear and love with our whole hearts; have mercy upon us and inspire in us a sincere will that, rejecting what displeases you, we may submit ourselves to your mercy.

text: Domine Deus noster Iesu Christe splendor paternae gloriae et dies claritatis aeternae gratias tibi agimus quoniam accendere dignatus es duodecim apostolos tuos igne Sancti Spiritus tui quasi duodecim horas diei lumine solis illustratas quibus dixisti: »Vos estis lux mundi« et iterum: »Nonne duodecim horae diei sunt? Si quis ergo ambulaverit in lumine diei hic non offendit« orire nobis Domine Deus noster Iesu Christe sol iustitiae in cuius pennis est sanitas timentium te ut ambulemus in luce dum lucem habemus ut simus filii lucis qui illuminasti apostolos quasi luminaria huic mundo et alios sanctos quasi tuos vel eorum vicarios gratia Spiritus Sancti ac doctrina praeditos discute a nobis tenebras ignorantiae et iustitiae tuae <lumen immitte> per horum patrocinia illorum quorum festivitas hodie colitur ut in te et per te semper maneamus.
translation_en: Lord God our Jesus Christ, splendor of the Father's glory and day of eternal brightness, we give thanks to you because you were pleased to enkindle your twelve apostles with the fire of your Holy Spirit, as if twelve hours of the day illuminated by the sun, upon whom you said: "You are the light of the world," and again: "Is it not written, 'There are twelve hours in the day'? If anyone walks in the light, he does not stumble." Grant us, Lord God our Jesus Christ, the sun of justice, in whose wings is health for those fearing you, that we may walk in the light while we have the light, to be sons of light whom you illumined like luminaries in this world and others saints like your own or their representatives, grace-filled and guided by the Holy Spirit and doctrine, dispute for us the darkness of ignorance and justice. <lumen immitte> Let your light shine through the intercession of those whose feast day is celebrated today, so that we may always remain in you and through you.

text: Domine Deus noster in cuius spiritalibus castris militat laudanda sobrietas abstinentia fructuosa et casti pectoris opulenta frugalitas ieiunantium vota clementer assume et fidelibus postulatus consueta pietate succurre.
translation_en: Lord God, in whose spiritual camps praiseworthy sobriety, fruitful abstinence, and opulent modesty of the chaste heart are fought; may frugality graciously accept the vows of those who fast, and as is customary with pious care, come to the aid of your faithful.

text: Domine Deus noster magne et omnipotens qui sanas contritos corde eorumque alligas contritiones tua te pietas nobis efficiat placabilem quos condicio fragilitatis humanae constituit in maerore; exaudi Domine quia pius es preces nostras et dimitte nobis cunctas offensiones; manus tuae fortitudine a cunctis angustiis liberemur ut cum tuis sanctis hic et in aeternum laetemur.
translation_en: Lord God, our great and almighty one, who heals the contrite hearts and binds their contrition to them; may Your compassion make us pleasing to You, whom human fragility has constituted in sorrow. Hear us, Lord, for You are merciful, and forgive us all our offenses. May we be freed from all anxieties by Your strength, so that we can rejoice with Your saints here and forever.

text: Domine Deus noster multiplica super nos gratiam tuam et quorum celebramus gloriosa certamina tribue subsequi in sancta professione victoriam.
translation_en: Lord God our Father, multiply upon us your grace and grant victory to those whom we celebrate for their glorious battles, in holy profession.

text: Domine Deus noster multiplica super nos gratiam tuam et quorum praevenimus gloriosa sollemnia tribue subsequi in sancta professione laetitiam.
translation_en: Lord God our Savior, multiply upon us your grace and grant to those whom we precede in approaching the glorious solemnities the joy of following in holy profession.

text: Domine Deus noster per quem omnia et ex quo omnia et in quo omnia plebi tuae fideliter obsecranti confer largire multiplica quaecumque ad humani victus substantiam protulisti ut mentes a mundi sollicitudinibus relaxatas cultui tuo tantum liceat adstringi et solum negotio quod et hic et in aeternum proderit occupari.
translation_en: Lord God of ours, through whom all things are, and from whom all things are, and in whom all things are, grant and multiply whatever you have provided for the sustenance of human beings. So that minds relaxed from worldly concerns may be attached to your service alone, and only occupied with that which will profit both here and in eternity.

text: Domine Deus noster quaesumus concede propitius ut Ecclesia tua iugiter et religione crescat et pace.
translation_en: Lord God, we humbly ask that you grant us graciously so that your Church may always grow in faith and peace.

text: Domine Deus noster qui in his potius creaturis quas ad fragilitatis nostrae praesidium condidisti tuo quoque nomini munera iussisti dicanda constitui tribue quaesumus ut et vitae nobis praesentis auxilium et aeternitatis efficiant sacramentum.
translation_en: Lord God, our creator who has established those creatures as a protection for our frailty, you have commanded that your name be given honorable praise. Grant us, we beseech you, that this present aid may also make the sacrament of eternal life for us.

text: Domine Deus noster qui nos martyris tui illius et meritis regis et exemplo componis rogamus te ut <nos> his sacrificiis iubeas sanctificari et sacrificantibus veniam dari ut ita per hanc oblationem placeris sicut in hoc quondam die effuso huius sanguine placatus es martyris quo oblata a nobis tibi victima singulari et offerentes ab his in quibus se gravari sentiunt liberentur pariter et defuncti.
translation_en: Lord God, our ruler who composes us with the sufferings of your martyr and the merits of the king, the example given, we humbly ask you to command that we be sanctified by these sacrifices, and pardon be given to those offering them. May it please you through this offering as on that day when, appeased by the spilled blood of the martyr, you were pleased with the unique victim offered by us, and those who feel weighed down among them are released alike and the dead.

text: Domine Deus noster qui nos vegetare dignatus es caelestibus alimentis suavitatem verbi tui penetralibus nostri cordis infunde ut quae temporali devotione percepimus sempiterno munere capiamus.
translation_en: Lord God, who deigned to nourish us with celestial food, pour into the innermost parts of our heart the sweetness of your word, that what we have received temporarily through earthly devotion, we may obtain forever as an eternal gift.

text: Domine Deus noster qui salutaria et praevidis solus et tribuis tu quaesumus et mentibus nostris largire semper affectum tuam misericordiam postulandi et quae nobis sint utilia placatus impende.
translation_en: Lord God our Savior, who sees and foresees alone, and bestows what we ask, we humbly entreat you. Grant us always your affectionate mercy, which we seek, and provide what is useful for us, you who are pleased.

text: Domine Deus noster suscipe preces supplicum et famulorum tuorum orationes benignus exaudi; debemus deferre ad publicum crimina si ad iudicium nolumus sustinere tormenta; debemus humiliari coram hominibus si volumus coram angelis gloriari; debemus lugere in saeculo si volumus regnare cum Christo; debemus honorem spernere temporalem si obtinere volumus gloriam sempiternam. Timeamus Deum occultum in conscientia testem et publicum in examinatione censorem. Non ille quaerit pro ignorantia confessionem sed pro misericordia confessorem. Fratres carissimi dominum deprecemur ut sic absolvat pietas humiles ut non puniat severitas contumaces.
translation_en: Lord God, receive the prayers of supplicants and your servants' petitions, merciful one, hear; if we wish to avoid bearing our crimes to the public judgment, we must endure the torments; if we wish to glory before men, we must humble ourselves before angels; if we wish to reign in this world, we must mourn; if we wish to despise temporary honors, we must seek eternal glory. Let us fear God as a hidden witness in our conscience and a public judge in examination. He does not seek confession because of ignorance but because of mercy. Dear brothers, let us pray to the Lord that piety may absolve the humble, but severity may not punish the contumacious.

text: Domine Deus noster tuis nos purifica sacramentis et quorum nos tribuis interesse mysteriis concede remediis gaudere perpetuis.
translation_en: Lord God, cleanse us with your sacraments and grant that we may enjoy eternal remedies among the mysteries you bestow upon us.

text: Domine Deus noster verax promissor propitiare operi tuo et mihi famulo tuo servienti tibi tribue perseverantem in tua voluntate famulatum ut diebus nostris et merito et numero populus tibi serviens augeatur.
translation_en: Lord God, our faithful promise-maker, grant favor to your work and to me, your servant, who serves you. Grant perseverance in your will to those serving you, so that during our days, both in merit and number, the people serving you may increase.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens Christe Iesu rex gloriae qui es pax certa et caritas sempiterna quaesumus nostra arcana splendore tuae pacis irradia nostramque conscientiam caritatis tuae dulcedine redde purissimam ut pacifici te pacis auctorem exspectemus et in adversis huius mundi te semper custodem habeamus et protectorem quatenus tua custodia saepti ita pacis studia certissime diligamus ut cum in gloria adventus tui aequus retributor adveneris aeterno potiamur gaudio exsultationis.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, Christ Jesus King of Glory, who are certain peace and eternal love, we humbly ask that your splendor irradiate our hidden selves and renew our consciousness with the sweetness of your love. May we ever expect you as the author of peace in times of tranquility and have you as our constant guardian and protector in adversity. Through your protection, may we so diligently love the pursuit of peace that when we reach your glory at your coming, we may partake in the eternal joy of your arrival.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens cui omnis devota constat virginitas praesta quaesumus ut; qui beatae Margaretae virginis et martyris tuae veneranda sollemnia annua recursione colimus eius apud te patrociniis sublevemur.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, to whom all devout virginity stands, we humbly ask that you grant us: who we celebrate the venerable annual solemnities of your blessed Margaret, virgin and martyr; may we be uplifted by your patronage with her at your side.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens cui virgo illa et martyr integritate iungitur et sanguine sociatur praesta quaesumus nobis famulis tuis ut expiati a peccatis tibi Domino Deo nostro sic adhaereamus ne a te ulterius recedamus.
translation_en: Lord God almighty, to whom the virgin and martyr is joined in integrity and united by blood, grant us, your servants, we humbly ask, that we may be purified from our sins before you, our Lord God, so that we may remain steadfast and not stray further away from you.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens Pater populi tui hostias et vota suscipias quaesumus et per Maioli merita nos transferas ad caelestis beatitudinis gaudia.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, Father of your people, we ask that you accept our offerings and vows. Through the merits of St. Nicholas (Maiolus), may you transfer us to the joys of celestial beatitude.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens qui caelum sideribus depinxisti et mundum sanctorum locorum spatiis distinxisti in quibus praecipue nomen tuum sanctum a nobis invocari et ad beneficia fidelibus tuis praestanda interpellari voluisti quique me famulum tuum illum non meis meritis sed dono tuae gratiae pontificali cathedra Exoniensium sublimasti praesta quaesumus ut me et omnes oves tuas quas pabulo doctrinae pascendas mihi commisisti interveniente beato Petro apostolo tuo ab omni adversitate protegas et gratiae tuae ubertate laetifices pacem et salutem vitam et requiem eis mecum concedas tam his qui versantur in corpore quam illis qui teguntur in funere nec eis delicta mea quibus te irritavi officiant sed preces tibi piissimo domino humiliter fusae aeterna eis paradisi gaudia conferant.
translation_en: Lord God almighty, who have painted the heavens with stars and distinguished the world of holy places by spaces, in which especially your holy name is invoked and benefits for your faithful are bestowed at your will. You, who raised me, your servant, to the pontifical chair of Exeter, not by my merits but by your grace, we humbly ask that you protect us and all your sheep, which you have committed to be fed by my doctrine, with the intervention of your apostle Peter. Grant us peace, salvation, life, and rest for them, both those who are living in body and those who are covered in funeral shroud. May not my sins, by which I have offended you, interfere but may the prayers humbly poured out to you, most gracious lord, bestow eternal joys of paradise for them.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens qui corpore et sanguine Christi Filii tui nos satiare dignatus es praesta quaesumus ut beatissimi confessoris tui Hieronymi cuius in tuo nomine hodie sollemnia celebramus adiuti subsidio aeternis <inter>esse epulis mereamur.
translation_en: Lord God almighty, who deigned to satisfy us with the body and blood of your Son, Christ, grant us we pray, that being aided by the eternal banquet we may be worthy to join in the festivities of the blessed confessor Jerome whom today we celebrate in your name.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens qui dedisti populo tuo manna in deserto ad satiandum ita precibus beati Nicolai confessoris tui atque pontificis tribue nobis acquirere cibum sempiternae salutis.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, who gave Your people manna in the wilderness to satisfy them, grant us, through the prayers of Your confessor and bishop Saint Nicholas, to obtain food for eternal salvation.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens qui nobis sanctorum intercessione succurris da quaesumus ut sancti Patricii confessoris tui atque pontificis et exsultemus meritis et patrocinio gaudeamus.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, who helps us through the intercession of the saints, we humbly ask that we rejoice in the merits and patronage of your confessor and bishop Saint Patrick.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens qui per sapientiam inaestimabilem tuam ita disposuisti mundum ut absque regibus et principibus nulla cum pace subsisterent climacter<ic>a saeculi quatenus bonorum florente iustitia cuncta subacta tabescerent perfidorum nequitia {unde Domine } te supplices deprecamur tibique devotis mentibus in hac die fundimus preces pro fideli famulo tuo principeque nostro illo atque pro universo exercitu illius <ut> ita eum Domine per dexteram virtutis tuae contra omnes adversarios semper esse iubeas cum triumphis victorem sicut quondam auxiliatus es Moysen dum adversus inimicos suos dimicans Hur brachia illius sustentavit usque ad vesperas illeque lumina levans ad caelos mox te auxiliante Domine usque ad internicionem suos percussit atque prostravit adversarios. Proinde Domine subnexi deposcimus ut taliter princeps noster in cunctis tuo iugiter fultus auxilio innumeros per annos feliciter vigeat in regno.
translation_en: Lord God almighty, who through your inestimable wisdom have so ordered the world that without kings and princes no peace would subsist in climacteries of centuries, so that the flourishing justice of good men might subdue all the wickedness of traitors. Lord, we humbly beseech you with devout minds on this day to pour out our prayers for your faithful servant, our prince, and for his entire army, so that you may always command him on your right hand with triumphs, as you once helped Moses when he was fighting against his enemies, sustaining the arms of Hur until evening, raising his hands towards heaven. With you, Lord, helping him, he soon struck down and defeated his adversaries. Therefore, Lord, we implore you to bind our prince in this way so that he may be always supplied with your aid for countless years and live happily in his kingdom.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens qui pro humani generis redemptione coaeternum tibi coaequalemque filium angelica annuntiatione per Mariae virginis uterum usque ad nos voluisti transmittere atque ante ipsius Filii tui adventum Ioannem dignatus es destinare praeconem ut per eius veridicam in deserto eremi praedicationem populus paenitens veternorum facinorum acciperet veniam per novi autem hominis Dei regnum evangelizantis divinae Trinitatis plenam mundus consequi mereretur ineffabilem gratiam da nobis in hoc tempore adventus unigeniti tui eandem pacis gratiam quam in praeteritis largire dignatus es saeculis et illis nos in occursu fidei socies munerandos quos in fidei primordio a Ioanne in Iordane paenitentiae undis aquarum ablutos a te postremo per filium in spirito sancto et in igne cognoscimus baptizatos.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, who for the redemption of the human race, chose to send your only-begotten Son, equal with You, from the womb of the Virgin Mary all the way down to us. Before the advent of Your Son, You graciously chose John as a herald in the desert to preach and the penitent people could receive forgiveness for their old sins. Through the new man who was God, evangelizing the divine Trinity, the whole world deserved to attain an ineffable grace. Grant us this same peace in this time, which You have been generous enough to bestow on the ages past. Make us companions in faith, whom John baptized in the waters of repentance at the Jordan River, and finally through Your Son, in the Holy Spirit and fire, we recognize ourselves as baptized by You.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens qui salvos facis sperantes in te tu clementissime qui revocas errantes tu misericors qui non despicis confitentes tu Domine pater cum ceciderit iustus manum opponis tu excelsus in caelis habitaturum te promisisti in terris ubi fuerint congregati in tuo nomine duo vel tres esse in medio eorum te Domine tenemus promissorem ut des veniam paenitentibus te inveniant omnes qui quaerunt te te enim perscrutatorem conscientiarum nostrarum scimus; ideo veniam petimus delictorum tu magnus Dominus et laudabilis valde te deprecamur et petimus ut sis nobis propitius; tibi confitemur mala nostra ut mereamur consequi bona tua.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, who saves those who hope in you, you, the most compassionate one, who calls back the erring, you, merciful one, who does not despise those who confess, Lord, Father, when the just falls, you extend your hand, exalted one in heavens, you have promised to dwell among us on earth where two or three are gathered in your name. We hold you, Lord, as a promise, that you will forgive the penitent ones, we all seek you. You, the searcher of our consciences, we know this; therefore, we ask for forgiveness for our sins, great and praiseworthy Lord, we humbly beg before you and ask that you be merciful to us. To you, we confess our wrongs, so that we may deserve to obtain your goods.

text: Domine Deus omnipotens qui solus das pluviam super terram solus eam mittis ab inferiore caelorum dona servis tuis beneficium pluviale ut quod nostra facinora suspenderunt tuo munere praerogetur.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, who alone gives rain to the earth and sends it up from below the heavens, grant your servants the blessing of rain so that what our sins have suspended may be granted by your mercy.

text: Omnipotens Deus qui solus aquas emittis e caelis dona servis tuis beneficium pluviae salutaris ut quod facinore nostro suspenditur tuo iam gratuito munere prorogetur.
translation_en: Almighty God, who alone sends waters from the heavens, grant your servants the benefit of salutary rain, so that what our misdeeds have suspended may now be extended by Your gracious gift.

text: Domine Deus omnium sanctorum splendor mirabilis qui hunc diem beati apostoli tui illius martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae digne de tanto gaudere apostolo ut apud misericordiam tuam et exemplo eius iuvemur et meritis.
translation_en: Lord God of all saints, splendid wonder, who on this day consecrated this day for your blessed apostle through his martyrdom, grant worthy joy to your Church that it may rejoice with you in your mercy and by his example be strengthened and merit by his deeds.

text: Domine Deus pater gloriae fons bonorum qui licet Ecclesiam tuam toto orbe terrarum diffusam largitate munerum ditare non desinas sedem tamen beati apostoli tui Petri tanto propensius intueris quanto sublimius esse voluisti da mihi famulo tuo huius providentiae tuae dispositionibus exhibere congruenter officium certus te universis ecclesiis collaturum quidquid illi praestiteris quam cuncta respiciunt.
translation_en: Lord God, Father of glory and fountain of goodness, who although Your Church, spread throughout the whole world by the largeness of Your gifts, is not ceasing to enrich, yet You look upon the seat of Your blessed apostle Peter with even greater attention as much as You wished to be exalted. Grant to Your servant, according to the dispositions of Your providence, to fulfill his office fittingly. I am certain that You will bestow on all churches whatever You provide for him, and consider all things.

text: Obsecramus misericordiam tuam
translation_en: We ask for your mercy

text: Domine Deus Pater omnipotens famulos tuae maiestati subiectos per unicum Filium tuum in virtute Sancti Spiritus benedic et protege ut ab omni hoste securi in tua iugiter laude laetentur.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty Father, we your servants submit to your majesty through your only Son and by the power of the Holy Spirit. Bless and protect us so that we may be secure from every enemy and always rejoice in your praise.

text: Domine Deus patris nostri Abrahae deduc viam famuli tui illius in pace et illo caritatis tuae eum igne succende quo pacificus ad destinata perveniat per pacem cuncta disponat et ad desiderata pacis tuae fultus munimine pergat.
translation_en: Lord God of our father Abraham, lead the way for your servant through peace. Kindle him with the fire of your love, that he may reach his destination in peace, arrange all things in peace, and walk armed with the fortress towards the desires of your peace.

text: Domine Deus qui ad hoc irasceris ut subvenias ad hoc minaris ut parcas lapsis manum porrige et laborantibus multiplici miseratione succurre et qui per te redempti sunt ad spem vitae aeternae tua moderatione serventur.
translation_en: Lord God, who are angry enough to intervene when you threaten, have mercy and spare the fallen. Extend your hand and help those who labor, with your abundant compassion. And those who are redeemed by you will be preserved towards the hope of eternal life by your moderation.

text: Domine Deus qui ad hoc irasceris ut subvenias ad hoc minaris ut parcas lapsis manum porrige laborantibus multiplici miseratione succurre ut gentem paganam quam pro peccatis nostris super nos cognoscimus praevalere te miserante sentiamus cessare.
translation_en: Lord God, who are angry enough to help and threaten to have mercy on the fallen, extend your hand to those who labor with manifold mercy. Help us against the pagan nation that we know is overpowering us because of our sins, so that we may feel you mercifully cease.

text: Domine Deus qui fragilitati nostrae quae congruant et praevides solus et provides praesta ut et praesentibus fulciamur auxiliis et instruamur aeternis.
translation_en: Lord God, who alone foresees our frailty and provides for it, grant that we may be strengthened by the aid present to us and instructed by eternal things.

text: Domine Deus qui in mysterio aquarum salutis tuae nobis sacramenta sanxisti exaudi orationem populi tui et iube terrores inundantium cessare pluviarum flagellumque huius elementi ad effectum tui converte mysterii ut qui se regenerantibus aquis gaudent renatos gaudeant his castigantibus esse correctos.
translation_en: Lord God, who in the mystery of your saving waters consecrated sacraments for us, hear the prayer of your people and command the terrors of the flooding to cease, and turn the scourge of this element to your purpose. May those who rejoice in the regenerating waters be happy to be corrected by them.

text: Oculi nostri ad te Domine
translation_en: Our eyes are turned to you, Lord

text: Domine Deus qui in mysterio aquarum salutis tuae nobis sacramenta sanxisti exaudi orationem nostram et iube praesentium sedatos esse fluctus aquarum ut profundo nobis in tuo nomine subiecto tua dextera gubernante litus incolumes attingamus.
translation_en: Lord God, who in the mystery of your saving waters have consecrated sacraments for us, hear our prayer and command the waves to be stilled, so that we, under your protection and with your guiding hand, may safely reach the shore.

text: Domine Deus qui in regenerandis plebibus tuis ministerio uteris sacerdotum tribue nobis perseverantem in tua voluntate famulatum ut dono gratiae tuae in diebus nostris et merito et numero sacratus tibi populus augeatur.
translation_en: Lord God, who work among your people through the ministry of priests, grant us servants persevering in your will, so that on our days we may receive your grace both in merit and number. May the people consecrated to you grow.

text: Domine Deus qui nos per ieiunia castigando sanas et ignoscendo conservas praesta supplicibus tuis ut et tranquillitatis optatae consolatione laetemur et ad correptionis effectum dono tuae pacis utamur.
translation_en: Lord God, who heal us through fasting and sanctify us through forgiveness, grant your mercy to your supplicants. May we rejoice in the consolation of the peace we have sought, and may we use your gift of correction.

text: Domine Deus qui te a nobis indesinenter rogari vis et clementer tribuis ut rogeris qui das votum optanti et pie viventi nihil denegas proroga quod audias ut perficias quod acceptas.  Da nobis quod ames in nobis ut digneris semper exaudiri pro nobis. Tribue vota fidelia sancta desideria prompta officia grata eloquia praeconia indefessa.  Sint purae preces petitiones commodae supplicationes iustae rogationes crebrae laudes assiduae ut ad salutem aeternam omnia praestes omnibus dum invocatis ab omnibus.
translation_en:
Lord God, who we desire to pray to you without end and who grants our prayers with kindness, hear us who make vows to you and lead holy lives. Grant nothing to be denied, extend what you hear so that what is asked for may be fulfilled.
Grant us that we may love in us, so that you may always deem worthy of hearing on our behalf. Grant faithful and holy desires, prompt services, pleasing words, unceasing praises.
May our prayers, petitions, requests be pure, convenient, just, frequent, constant, until all things are bestowed upon everyone who invoke you from everyone.

text: Domine Deus virtutum qui collapsa reparas et reparata conservas auge populos in tui nominis sanctificatione renovandos ut omnes qui diluuntur sacro baptismate tua semper inspiratione dirigantur.
translation_en: Lord God of powers, who repair the collapsed and conserve what is repaired, increase your people in the sanctification of your name, renewing them so that all who are dissolved by your sacred baptism may always be directed by your inspired guidance.

text: Domine Deus virtutum qui transgressus occasum transscendisti super caelos caelorum ad orientem captiva spolia de captivitate duxisti ut genus humanum quod tua morte redimeras tuaque resurrectione vivificaveras tua adscensione glorificares et promissione ditares dona Ecclesiae tuae et ad te perveniendi iter prosperum et cottidianum de dic in diem profectum ut magnificentiae tuae reddat quod tantam ei virtutem concesseris ut obtineat devicto hoste et libertatem de tuo auxilio et gloriam de triumpho.
translation_en: Lord God of powers, who passed beyond the west and transcended the heavens of heavens to the east, you captured spoils from captivity as a leader, so that the human race, which was redeemed by your death and revived by your resurrection, would be glorified by your ascent, and you declared gifts for your Church, and a prosperous and daily journey leading from day to day for those coming to you, so that it may repay the great power you have given it, to obtain victory over the enemy, freedom through your aid, and glory through triumph.

text: Domine Deus virtutum suscipe has oblationes quas tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo et proice ab eo inimicos adversarios tuos Satanan et omnes subiectos suos daemones ut amplius non habeant potestatem stare nec fatigare nec iniuriare famulum tuum. In te Domine speravimus; non confundamur in aeternum; in tua iustitia et fortitudine libera famulum tuum.
translation_en: Lord God of powers, receive these offerings which we present to you for your servant, and cast away from him your enemies, the adversaries Satan and all subjects under his demons, so that they no longer have the power to stand, tire or injure your servant. In you, Lord, we have hoped; let us not be confounded forever; in your justice and might, free your servant.

text: Domine Iesu a quo suum spiritum suscipi martyr Stephanus postulavit tu praesentis huius sollemnitatis placatus oblatione et viventibus veniam et quiescentibus requiem concede sempiternam.
translation_en: Lord Jesus, from whom Stephen the martyr asked to receive your Spirit, grant us favor in this solemnity. For the living, forgive us and for the resting, grant eternal peace.

text: Domine Iesu Christe fac super nos misericordiam tuam audi gemitum comple desiderium de lacrimis <et> suspiriis animarum nostrarum miserere nobis Domine miserere nobis erue nos a flagello irae tuae da pacem viventibus et da remedium paenitentibus et da requiem defunctis famulis tuis solve captivos sana infirmos illumina caecos mutus loquatur surdus audiat et da gubernationem viduis consolationem orphanis libera nos de peccato libera nos de diabolo malo ipsi semper gratias agamus illaesi.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, grant your mercy upon us, hear our groans and complete our desires from tears and sighs of our souls. Have mercy on us, Lord. Have mercy on us. Deliver us from the scourge of your wrath, give peace to the living, give remedy to the penitent, give rest to the departed servants of yours. Free the captives, heal the sick, enlighten the blind, let the deaf hear, and grant governance to the widows, comfort to the orphans. Free us from sin, free us from the wicked devil, always may we offer thanks unharmed.

text: Domine Iesu Christe Fili Dei vivi qui pro redemptione nostra nasci et circumcidi voluisti et a Iudaeis reprobari a Iuda osculo tradi capi et ligari et cum vinculis Annae Caiphae Herodi Pilato offerri et coram eis illudi colaphis alapis flagellis arundine caedi facie velari et sputo conspui spinis coronari falsis quoque testibus accusari iudicari et ut agnus innocens tuam crucem ferendo ad victimam duci clavis perforari felle et aceto potari atque in cruce morte turpissima condemnari ac lancea vulnerari tu per has sacratissimas poenas ab omnibus peccatis et poenis nos libera et per sanctam crucem tuam illuc perduc nos miseros peccatores quo perduxisti tecum crucifixum latronem sero paenitentem.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God, who willingly were born and circumcised for our redemption, and were mocked by the Jews, betrayed by Judas with a kiss, taken, bound, offered to Annas, Caiphas, Herod, Pilate, and were scourged with reeds, aloes, flagellums, and whipped; had your face covered, spit upon, crowned with thorns, falsely accused by witnesses, judged, led as an innocent lamb to bear your cross to be crucified, pierced with nails through hands and feet, given gall and vinegar to drink, condemned to die a shameful death on the cross, and wounded by a spear - may these most sacred sufferings free us from all sins and punishments. Through your holy cross, lead us, wretched sinners, to where you led the repentant thief crucified with you.

text: Domine Iesu Christe Filius Dei vivi qui tantam gratiam in virgine tua Eugenia contulisti ut sicut evidentia eius gesta declarant quemcumque in dolore positum visitasset et languoris ab eo pestis recederet et optata ad eum sanitas rediret tu hoc sacrificium tibi appositum ita tuae visitationis benedictione sanctifica ut ex eo sumentibus et criminum praestetur indulgentia et perpetuae salutis praelargiatur medela.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God, who bestowed such great grace upon your servant Eugenia as her deeds clearly show, that whoever was in distress she visited and from the sickness inflicted by her, health returned and the desired healing was granted. You have offered this sacrifice to you, so may it be sanctified by your blessing of visitation, so that for those who partake of it, indulgence is provided for sins, and a remedy for eternal salvation is bestowed.

text: Domine Iesu Christe fons pietatis qui moriens in cruce acerrimo dolori cordis tuae maestissimae genitricis multo plus fuisti compassus quam sororibus flentibus quarum dilectione motus fuisti lacrimis exaudi propitius preces nostras et praesta ut qui eiusdem matris tuae piissimae tristem cruciatum recolimus meritis illius valeamus perpetua mentis et corporis salute gaudere ab omnique dolore et tristitia liberari.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, fountain of pity, who on the cross suffered with extreme pain in your most sorrowful mother's heart, were moved to compassion much more than the weeping sisters by whose love you were stirred. Hear propitiously our prayers and grant that we who remember the bitter sorrows of the same most merciful mother may be able to enjoy perpetual mental and physical health, freed from all pain and sorrow.

text: Domine Iesu Christe hanc hostiam vivam illustratione adventus tui sanctifica ut ex ea libantes mundemur a crimine et tuam gratiam mereamur percipere sine fine.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, sanctify this living sacrifice with the radiance of your coming, so that we, partaking from it, may be cleansed from sin and merit to receive your grace without end.

text: Domine Iesu Christe ineffabilis pulchritudo iustitiae qui inter lilia pascis et candidissimis delectaris virginum choris qui desponsatam tibi illam fortissimam virginem tanto caritatis amore iunxisti ut eam tibi et virginem et martyrem consecrares praesta ut sicut illa in paradiso tuo immarcescibilibus sanctimoniae tuae atque martyrii sertis coronata triumphat ita nos assiduo eius patrocinio a colluvionibus peccatorum et illecebris carnalibus abstrahas ac defendas et sic tibi acceptos efficias ut aeternae indulgentiae compotes reddas et pacis tuae muneribus glorificandos attollas.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, ineffable beauty of justice who among lilies delight and are most pleased with the choirs of virgins, who joined that strongest virgin to yourself with such love of charity that you consecrated her as both a virgin and a martyr; grant that, just as she triumphs in your paradise with unfading wreaths of your sanctity and martyrdom, so too may she be our constant intercessor. Pull us from the filth of sins and carnal temptations, and make us worthy of being offered to you. Grant that we may offer the fruits of eternal indulgence and the gifts of your peace.

text: Domine Iesu Christe pro cuius amore beatissima Eugenia et affectum parentum et copias oblita est facultatum cum relictis domo parentibus fratribus atque familiis aufugiens crinibus detonsis te sequendo adiungitur christianis tuis cupiens sua colla subiugare praeceptis tu Ecclesiae tuae precibus adesto mitis atque placabilis ut ad instar huius martyris tuae relinquamus saeculum contemnamus vanarum illecebras voluptatum affectus parentum atque curas rerum periturarum ut ad te diligendum te sequendum teque fruendum nullis obicibus impediti ita libentissime praesentis saeculi evincamus mala sicut haec virgo fallentis Melantiae valuit superare commenta.
