By an admirable kindness whereby you have made us, may you forgive sinners, so that the works of your hands do not perish.

text: Ecclesiam praesentis familiae quaesumus omnipotens Domine ab hostium incursione potenter defende et per sacram sanctae illius quam recolimus nativitatem largire nobis supernae patriae portionem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty Lord, to powerfully defend the church of this present family from the onslaught of enemies and to grant us through the sacred and holy nativity we commemorate a share of the heavenly homeland.

text: Ecclesiam tuam Deus beati Antonii confessoris tui sollemnitas votiva laetificet ut spiritalibus semper nutriatur auxiliis et gaudiis perfrui mereatur aeternis.
translation_en: May your church, God of the blessed Anthony the confessor, be rejoiced by its votive solemnity, so that it may always be nourished with spiritual aids and be worthy to partake in eternal joys.

text: Ecclesiam tuam Domine quaesumus perpetuo guberna moderamine ut adsit ei et in securitate cautela et inter aspera fortitudo.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to continually govern Your church with gentle guidance, that it may be present in safety, with caution, and in the midst of hardships, with strength.

text: Ecclesiam tuam Domine benignus illumina ut et gregis tui proficiat ubique successus et grati fiant nomini tuo te gubernante pastores.
translation_en: Lord, with your kind grace, illuminate your church, that everywhere the success of your flock may prosper and shepherds may be pleasing to Your name as they are governed by You.

text: Ecclesiam tuam Domine benignus illustra ut apostolicis beati Ioannis evangelistae illuminata doctrinis ad dona perveniat quae de tua fidelibus retributione promisit.
translation_en: Lord, with your benevolent grace, illuminate your Church, that through the enlightening teachings of the blessed apostle John the Evangelist, it may reach the gifts which you promised to bestow upon your faithful as a reward.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine benignus illustra ut apostoli tui Ioannis evangelistae illuminata doctrinis ad dona perveniat quae de tua sempiterna fidelibus retributione promisit.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may your benevolence shine upon your Church, that it may be enlightened by the teachings of your apostles John the Evangelist, and attain the gifts which you have promised to those who are faithful to you eternally.

text: Ecclesiam tuam Domine benignus illustra ut beati Ioannis evangelistae illuminata doctrinis ad dona perveniat sempiterna.
translation_en: Lord, may your church be graciously enlightened, that through the teachings of blessed John the Evangelist it may attain eternal gifts.

text: Ecclesiam tuam Domine in omni prosperitate custodi et beati Barnabae apostoli suffultam patrociniis supernis dignam exhibe gaudiis.
translation_en: Lord, protect your church in every prosperity and grant that it is worthy of the patronage of the heavenly blessings through blessed Barnabas the apostle.

text: Ecclesiam tuam Domine miseratio continuata mundet et muniat et quia sine te non potest salva consistere tuo semper munere gubernetur.
translation_en: Lord, may your Church be continually washed and fortified by your mercy. Since it cannot stand secure without you, let it always be governed by your constant protection.

text: Ecclesiam tuam Domine perpeti miseratione prosequere ut inter saeculi turbines constituta et praesenti iucunditate respiret et aeternae beatitudinis percipiat claritatem.
translation_en: Lord, may your church be followed with your eternal compassion, that it may stand among the world's turbulence and breathe in present joy, and may perceive the brightness of eternal beatitude.

text: Ecclesiam tuam Domine perpetua miseratione prosequere ut inter saeculi turbidines constituta et praesenti iucunditate respiret et aeternae beatitudinis dona percipiat.
translation_en: Lord, may your church be continually followed by your perpetual mercy, so that it, established amidst the chaotic ages, may breathe in present joy and receive the gifts of eternal beatitude.

text: Famulum tuum illum Domine quaesumus perpetua miseratione prosequere ut inter saeculi turbines constitutus et praesenti iucunditate respiret et aeternae beatitudinis dona percipiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to continually guide your servant with eternal mercy, that amidst the world's turbulence, he may find rest and breathe in present joy, and partake of the gifts of everlasting beatitude.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine beati Barnabae apostoli tui commendet oratio et pro ea interventor exsistat quam doctrina et passione illustrat.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to commend your church to the prayers of your blessed apostle Barnabas, and may he stand as an advocate for it, which is illuminated by both teaching and passion.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus fons lucis et origo
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, source of light and origin

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine gratia caelestis amplificet quam beati Francisci illuminare voluisti meritis et doctrinis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may your church be enriched with heavenly grace as you wished to illuminate it with the merits and teachings of blessed Francis.

text: Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus Domine dona gratia caelestis amplificet quam beatae Osithae virginis et martyris tuae miraculis decorasti et gloriosis fecisti coruscare meritis et exemplis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant grace from heaven to your church. May it be amplified as the church was adorned and glorified by the miracles of the blessed Ositha, virgin and martyr. May it shine with the merits and examples she has earned.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine gratia caelestis amplificet quam beati Norberti confessoris tui atque pontificis gloriosis praedicationibus et vitae exemplis illuminasti; da nobis contabescentibus ut eius patrocinio reviviscamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your church may be amplified by the celestial grace as it was enlightened by the glorious preachings and life examples of your confessor and bishop, blessed Norbert. Grant us, who are in need, to revive under his patronage.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine proprio sanguine Filii tui redemptam iugibus defende praesidiis ut insecutione paganorum depulsa tibi omni tempore famuletur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to defend your church, which was redeemed by the blood of your Son, with your own protection and guardianship. May it be freed from the incursion of pagans and always sing praises to you.

text: Ecclesiam tuam quaesumus Domine tua miseratione custodi et quam beatissimus confessor et sacerdos tuus Hieronymus a cunctis te praesidiante purgavit haeresibus ipsius orationibus non desinas momentis omnibus adiuvari.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your Church may be guarded by your mercy. And just as your most blessed confessor and priest Jerome purified it from all heresies while you were present, so may your aid never cease to help it in every moment through his prayers.

text: Effice nos Domine filios pacis quos fecisti esse filios tuae adoptionis ut pacifici viventes in terra ad promissa mereamur pervenire caelestia.
translation_en: Lord, make us sons of peace whom you have made to be your adopted sons, that we may deserve to reach the heavenly promises living peacefully on earth.

text: Efficiatur haec hostia Domine quaesumus sollemnibus grata ieiuniis et ut tibi fiat acceptior purificatis mentibus immoletur.
translation_en: May this offering, Lord, be effective as we request, through solemn and pleasing fasting. And may it become more acceptable to you with purified minds, let it be offered up to you.

text: Effunde Domine benedictionem tuam super populum tuum ut Filii tui resurrectione muniti mereamur ab adversantium vitiorum circumdatione liberari.
translation_en: Pour down, Lord, Your blessing upon Your people, that Your children armed with the Resurrection may deserve to be freed from the enclosure of their enemies' vices.

text: Effunde quaesumus Domine spiritum gratiae super familiam tuam et ab ea quidquid diabolicae fraudis inrepit quidquid terrenae labis incurrit expelle ut interius exteriusque mundata et puram tibi devotionem semper exhibeat et facilius possit assequi quod rationabiliter et convenienter  exposcit.
translation_en: Pour down upon us, Lord, the spirit of grace on your family, and expel from them whatever is instigated by diabolical deceit or what encounters through worldly temptations. May they always present to you an interior and exterior cleansing and pure devotion. May they more easily attain that which is rationally and fittingly proposed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus indeficiens lumen
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, infinite light

text: Effunde quaesumus Domine super hanc singularem nostrae salutis medicinam tuae benedictionis abundantiam quae illius participes ab omnibus peccatis absolvat et in ea qua tibi venerandus martyr Aelfegus placuit caritate custodiat.
translation_en: Pour down upon us, Lord, Your particular medicine of our salvation, the abundance of Your blessing, which frees those who partake from all sins and keeps in it the love, where the venerable martyr Aelfegus pleased You, within the church.

text: Eius tibi precibus Domine quaesumus grata reddatur oblatio pro cuius est festivitate immolanda.
translation_en: Through your prayers, Lord, we humbly ask that an acceptable offering be returned to you, for whose feast day it is fitting to offer sacrifice.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus insere te officiis nostris et haec vascula
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, be present with us in our duties and these vessels

text: Eminentissimum nobis omnipotens Deus hunc diem venerabilem ac plena admiratione dignissimum sacerdotis tui Martini transitus consecravit qui exutus corpore caelum quod quaesivit ex opere invenit ex munere; qui saeculum calcavit in vitiis regnum tuum intravit in gaudiis reddens tibi animam qualem dederas qualem feceras ex lavacro qualem tibi placere dixeras ex praecepto; qui in pubescentis aetatis exordia iam tibi in adulescentia senescebat prius se perfectione quam professione monstrando ut ante rem sanctitatis impleret quam speciem religionis assumeret; qui in frigore pauperem vestiendo amore tuo caluit et tibi vincebat miles alienus et tibi militabat victor iam tuus sic praeveniente gratia conscientiam ut dum non videretur elotus probaretur assumptus.  Dignus valde cui te pro misericordia revelares ut et tantum munus virtute cognosceret et virtus remunerata plus cresceret cui cooperante gratia tua hoc fuerit instituere quod curare et per abundantem quam per te faciebat mirabilium suorum diversitatem magis familiare habuerit exemplis docere quam litteris.  Qui in se crucis tuae rigore suscepto ita tibi verus cultor adsisteret ut laudis tuae causas vitae meritis ampliaret; idoneus quippe cui te per sacerdotii dignitatem ecclesiae spem populorum salutem singularem quoque virtutem committeres familiarem. Qui per arduum continentiae fastigium et amicum tuae gratiae blandimentum futurorum praescius noveras in eo mentem humilem rem potentem.  Hic igitur Deus tuum prece populum salvet qui tibi placuit opere iustificetque peccatores in vita qui iustificatus pervenit ad gloriam; Impetret ut a te non puniamur de nostris qui abs te meruit coronari de propriis.
translation_en:
This most eminent and all-powerful God consecrated this day for us, a day worthy of reverence and full of admiration, as the transition of your priest Martin. He shed his body to seek the heaven he had desired and found it through his work; he trod upon the world in vice, but entered into your kingdom with joy, returning to you the soul that you had given, that you had made, from the baptismal font that you had said pleased you, from the commandment. He showed perfection before profession in youthful age, demonstrating sanctity before assuming the appearance of religion; he clothed the poor and cold with your love, vanquishing the alien soldier and serving as a victor already under your grace, so that through this prevenient grace his conscience was proved innocent, although it did not seem so.
He was indeed worthy to whom you revealed yourself out of mercy, so that he might know such a great gift through virtue and virtue might grow more through reward; with your help, this was instituted for him who cared for the diverse miracles of his people more through examples than through letters.
He stood as a true worshipper before your cross, amplifying the causes of your praise through his life's merits; worthy indeed to whom you committed special virtue and the hope of salvation for the people through the dignity of the priesthood in the church. He knew through the height of continence and the sweet enticement of your grace that he possessed a humble mind and a powerful spirit.
Therefore, may God save this people who pleased you and justify the sinners in life who are justified and reach glory; May he pray that we are not punished by you for our sins, but crowned with his own merits.

text: Emitte Christe Filius Dei de sanctis caelis tuis copiam tuae benedictionis quo et ieiunium nostrae devotionis gratum efficiatur in oculis tuis et haec libamina benedictione ditificentur tuae virtutis.
translation_en: Send forth, O Christ, Son of God, from your holy heavens, the abundance of your blessing, so that our fasting devotion may be pleasing in your sight, and these libams may be enriched by your blessing and your power.

text: Emitte Domine spiritum adoptionis in quo clamemus tibi: »Abba Pater« ut confiteamur quoniam tu es unigeniti tui verus pater et cognoscamus quia nullus ei similis est inter filios dei quem non tibi adoptio sed generatio consubstantialem neque gratia similem sed natura signat aequalem. Per huius enim fidei inviolabile mysterium custodiamus spei nostrae immutabile sacramentum. Ex hoc te quaesumus ut cum nostris qui iam e saeculo praecesserunt qui etiam ipsius spiritus tui sancti dono renati sunt quorumque ante altare tuum mentionem cum tremore facimus simul obviam in secundi adventus Domini nostri claritate feliciter occurramus.
translation_en: Send forth, O Lord, the spirit of adoption in whom we cry to you: "Abba Father," so that we may confess that you are truly the father of your unique son and may recognize that there is no one like him among the sons of God, whom not adoption but generation makes consubstantial, nor grace similar but nature marks equal. Through this unbreakable mystery of faith, let us keep our hope's immutable sacrament safe. From this we ask you that with ours who have already passed from this world and who have been renewed by your holy spirit's gift whose mention we make before your altar with trembling, may we meet joyfully in the second coming of our Lord in his radiant brightness.

text: Emmanuel nobiscum Deus Christe Filius Dei qui cum ex virgine te nasciturum pronuntias {quia} Mariam matrem creasti ut dominus de qua natus es filius da nobis ut qui cum illa a te vel per te creati sumus ex nihilo simili ut ea credulitatis remuneremur ex praemio.
translation_en: Emmanuel, be with us, O God, Christ, Son of God, who announce that you will be born from the virgin, (that) you created Mary as mother, to make us, who through her and by you are created from nothing, similar to her, so that we may be rewarded for our faith from the prize.

text: Emunda Domine conscientias nostras fidei catholicae confessione sincera et cordis contritione continua ut sacris muneribus expiati semper a te exaudiamur e caelis cum pro nostris delictis ad te proclamamus e terris.
translation_en: Purify, Lord, our consciences with sincere confession of the Catholic faith and continuous heartfelt contrition, so that we may always be heard from heaven when we call upon you for our sins which we confess on earth.

text: Emunda Domine conscientias nostras fidei catholicae confessione sincera et cordis contritione continua ut semper a te exaudiamur e caelis cum pro nostris delictis ad te proclamaverimus e terris: »Pater noster ...«
translation_en: Purify, Lord, our consciences with the sincere profession of the Catholic faith and continual heartfelt penitence, so that we may always be heard by you from heaven, as we have cried out to you for our sins on earth: "Our Father..."

text: Enitentia tuarum Domine martyrum Iustae et Rufinae sollemnia celebrantes quae mercimonio fictilium vasculorum contentae ad beatae usque passionis meruerunt gloriam pervenire te adclines oramus ut per eas apud te nostra accipiatur oratio quarum tu laetatus es de triumpho. Per eas evincamus cupiditatis incendia per quas ipse tortoris evicisti tormenta ipsisque nos intercedentibus corrige quarum te victorem ostendisti in passione ut quae tibi per gloriam meritorum effecta sunt vasa virtutum unumquemque nostrum apud te obtineant vas suum absque contagione possidere peccaminum.
translation_en: In celebration of the feast of the just martyrs, Justus and Rufina, who were contained within vessels made of fictitious merchandise and merited to arrive at the glory of their blessed passion, we humbly beseech you, Lord. Through them, we pray that our petition be received by you, for whom you have rejoiced in triumph. Through them, we extinguish the fires of desire, which you yourself overcame through torments; may they intercede for us, through whom you showed yourself victorious in passion. May those things achieved for your glory through merits be vessels of virtue for each one of us before you, possessing their own vessel free from contamination by sins.

text: Epularum divinarum communicatio sit nobis Domine cordis et corporis purificatio et quorum nobis votiva sunt sollemnia semper prosint suffragia.
translation_en: May the communication of divine banquets be to us, Lord, a purification of heart and body, and may the solemnities that are vowed to us always profit us with their prayers.

text: Epularum tuarum alimento saginati te humiliter rogamus Domine Deus noster ut beati martyris tui Stephani Nicodemi Gamalielis atque Abibon meritis ubique nos adiuves quorum hodie revelationis sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to help us everywhere by the merits of your blessed martyr Stephen, Nicodemus, Gamaliel and Abibo, whose feast day of revelation we celebrate today.

text: Erectis sensibus et oculos cordis ad sublimia elevantes quaesumus ut quae in precum vota detulimus ad impetrandi fiduciam referamus.
translation_en: With senses erect and raising our eyes of the heart to lofty things, we humbly ask that what we have presented in our prayers be referred to with faith for granting.

text: Erige nos Domine Deus noster et alleva in misericordia tua ut communione salutis et gaudio caritatis dum ipsi salvari ex munere tuo cupimus etiam fide et pace cunctarum gentium gaudeamus.
translation_en: Lord, raise us up, our God, and sustain us with your mercy so that we may be saved by your gift, both in the communion of salvation and joy of charity. We desire to rejoice even with faith and peace of all nations.

text: Erige quaesumus Domine ad te corda nostra ut a terrenis cupiditatibus in caelestia desideria transeamus.
translation_en: Raise up, we beseech you, Lord, our hearts towards you, so that we may pass from earthly desires to heavenly longings.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus multiplica in honorem nominis
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, multiply [the number of] those bearing [the name of] your name.

text: Eripe nos Domine quaesumus ab his quae divinae sunt contraria voluntati et quia tui operis est omne quod vivimus praesta ut tui famuli tibi placere possimus.
translation_en: Deliver us, Lord, we beseech you, from those things that are contrary to Your divine will and since it is Your work that sustains all that we live, grant that we may please You as Your servants.

text: Erudi Domine quaesumus populum tuum spiritalibus instrumentis et quorum praestas sollemnia venerari fac eorum et consideratione devotum et defensione securum.
translation_en: Teach, we ask, Lord, your people with spiritual tools, and those whom you provide for to be honored in solemnity, make them devoted in contemplation and secure in protection.

text: Erudi quaesumus Domine populum tuum spiritalibus instrumentis et quorum praestas sollemnia praevenire fac eorum et consideratione devotum et defensione securum.
translation_en: Teach us, we ask you Lord, your people with spiritual tools and let those whom you provide to precede the solemnities. Make them devoted in consideration and secure in defense.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus nostrorum temporum
translation_en: Almighty eternal God of our times

text: Erudi quaesumus Domine plebem tuam et quae extrinsecus annua tribuis devotione venerari interius assequi gratiae tuae luce concede.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you educate your people and those who, from outside, annually offer devotion to venerate, may attain grace within; grant us the light of your favor.

text: Erudiamur Domine quaesumus his celebritatibus et iuvemur quibus beati apostoli Andreae caelestem nobis tribuant martyria praeventa laetitiam.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask to be enlightened by these celebrations and to be strengthened so that the heavenly martyrdom of blessed apostle Andrew may prevent sorrow from us.

text: Esto Domine plebi tuae sanctificator et custos ut apostolicis munita praesidiis et conversatione tibi placeat et secura deserviat.
translation_en: Let your Lordship, O God, be the sanctifier and protector of your people, that they may be fortified with apostolic defenses and conduct themselves in a manner pleasing to you, and serve you securely.

text: Esto Domine plebi tuae sanctificator et custos ut beatae Mariae munita praesidiis et conversatione tibi placeat et secura deserviat.
translation_en: O Lord, may your sanctifier and protector be established among your people, so that they may be protected by the shields of the Blessed Mary and serve you in peace and safety.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus Pater ... respice dignare super hunc famulum tuum
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, Father ... look upon this, your servant, with favor.

text: Esto Domine quaesumus plebis tuae sanctificator et custos ut apostoli tui Thomae munita praesidiis et conversatione tibi placeat et secura deserviat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you become our protector and guardian, just as you were for your apostle Thomas. May he be fortified by your guardianship and conduct himself pleasing to you, serving you securely.

text: Esto Domine plebi tuae sanctificator et custos ut apostoli tui Iacobi munita praesidiis et conversatione tibi placeat et secura deserviat.
translation_en: Lord, may Your Sanctifier and Guard be established for Your people, that the apostles' James, fortified by Your protections, would please You in conduct, and would serve You securely.

text: Esto Domine propitius plebi tuae et quam tibi facis esse devotam benigno refove miseratus auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, be gracious to your people and to those who are devoted to you. Revive them with your merciful aid.

text: Esto Domine propitius plebi tuae et temporali consolatione non deseras quam vis ad aeterna contendere.
translation_en: Lord, may you be gracious to your people, and may you not withhold temporal comfort which you wish them to strive for eternity.

text: Adesto Domine propitius plebi tuae et temporali consolatione non deseras quam vis ad aeterna contendere.
translation_en: Be present, O Lord, graciously to your people and do not withhold the temporal comfort that you desire them to strive for eternity.

text: Esto propitius Domine quaesumus plebi tuae et suffragantibus sanctis tuis tribue nobis veniam peccatorum; concedas placatus et pacem ut propitius largiaris auxilium.
translation_en: Be gracious, Lord, we beseech you on behalf of your people, and through the intercession of your saints, grant us pardon for our sins; may you be pleased to give peace so that you may generously bestow help.

text: Esto nobis propitius Domine quaesumus et suffragantibus sanctis martyribus et confessoribus tuis tribue nobis veniam peccatorum.
translation_en: Grant us favor, Lord, we beseech you, and through the intercession of your holy martyrs and confessors, grant us pardon for our sins.

text: Esto protector Domine populi tui propitiatus et rector eique deprecantibus sanctis tuis remissionem tribue peccatorum; praesta vitae melioris effectum temporalia benignus praebe solatia et aeternitatis promissa dona largire.
translation_en: May the Lord be gracious to your people, O protector, and grant them a ruler. To those who pray to your saints, bestow the remission of sins; may you, mercifully, provide temporal aid, and may eternal blessings be lavishly given.

text: Esto quaesumus Domine propitius plebi tuae ut de die in diem quae tibi non placent respuentes tuorum potius repleantur dilectionibus mandatorum et mortalis vitae consolationibus gubernati proficiant ad immortalitatis effectum.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, graciously to Thy people, that from day to day they may reject those things that displease Thee and be filled rather with the love of Thy commandments, and thus, guided by the consolations of mortal life, may progress towards the accomplishment of immortality.

text: Esto quaesumus Domine propitius plebi tuae ut quae tibi non placent respuentes tuorum potius repleantur delectationibus mandatorum.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, be gracious to Your people, that those things which do not please You, rejecting them, may instead be filled with the delights of Your commandments.

text: Esurientes corpus tuum Domine ac sanguinem sitientes ut hoc nobis in remissionem peccatorum sumendum tribuas deprecamur quia nostra virtus et salus sit si tamen non quod indigni sumus irascaris sed facis vinci gaudio metum et cedere exsultationi terrorem. Nemo enim est in hoc numero concilioque fidelium qui non accedere ad mensam tuam in hac gloriosa per totum mundum nocte desideret ut si firmus est habeat custodiam si infirmus est medicinam.  Sic igitur quaesumus apud te Domine placitum sit cunctis donare quod cupiunt ut digneris parcere quod praesumunt. Quis non optet illa carne animam suam tangere pascere confortare in qua se per gratiam credat esse transfusum quae corruptionem non vidit et vim mortis passione mortis absorbuit? Quis non ambiat propter te sumere de tuo quod te videat propter nos assumpsisse de nostro? Indita hac ex pietate fiducia ut quod in defunctis dignatus est vivificare mortuum in reis dignetur purificare correptum.
translation_en:
We ask you, Lord, to give us your body for the hunger of the body and your blood for the thirst of our souls, that we may receive this as remission of sins. For our power and salvation lies in you, but not because we are worthy of your anger, rather you make us victorious with joy, you make fear yield to exultation, and terror to cease. No one in this assembly of faithful is who does not desire to approach your table throughout the whole world on this glorious night, if he is strong let him have guardianship, if he is weak let him have medicine.
Thus we ask you, Lord, that it may be pleasing for all to receive what they desire, that you may deign to show mercy as they presume. Who does not wish his soul to touch that flesh, to be nourished, comforted in which he believes, through grace, to have been transfused? Who does not strive to receive from you what he sees you took for us?
Endowed with this faith and piety, we ask that what you were willing to revive the dead among the faithful may purify and correct those who are corrupt in our midst.

text: Et nataliciis sanctorum Domine et sacramenti munere vegetati quaesumus ut bonis quibus per tuam gratiam nunc fovemur perfruamur aeternis.
translation_en: And on the feast of the saints, Lord, and nourished by your gift of sacrament, we humbly ask that we who are fostered with goodness through your grace now may enjoy eternal blessings.

text: Et refrigerare digneris Domine animas famulorum famulatumque tuarum et omnium monachorum in monasterio sancti illius in Christo quiescentium vel qui in hoc loco in Christo requiescunt <et animis> omnium fidelium catholicorum orthodoxorum quorum commemorationem agimus quorum numerum et nomina tu solus Domine cognoscis tribue indulgentiam peccatorum quia pius et misericors es Deus noster ut si quae carnales maculae in eis de terrenis contagiis inhaeserunt miserationis tuae venia deleantur.
translation_en: And you, Lord, may deign to cool the souls of your servants and all monks resting in the monastery of that saint or who are resting here in Christ. And for the spirits of all Catholic and Orthodox faithful whose commemoration we make, whose number and names only you, Lord, know, grant them the forgiveness of sins, for you are a pious and merciful God, our God, so that any carnal stains adhering to them from worldly contagions may be erased by your mercy's forgiveness.

text: Et sacramentis tuis Domine et gaudiis optatae celebritatis expleti quaesumus; eorum nobis precibus dent medelam quorum recordationibus exhibentur.
translation_en: And filled with your sacraments, Lord, and the desired festivities we ask to be completed; grant us remedy through their prayers whose remembrance is shown.

text: Et sanctorum tuorum exaltatione gaudentes et sacramenti tui perceptione satiati gratias tibi referimus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus.
translation_en: And, delighting in the exaltation of your saints and being filled by the perception of your sacrament, we offer our thanks to you, Lord holy Father almighty eternal God.

text: Exaltatio divina paterna pietas immensa maiestas te supplices trementesque deprecamur pro famulo tuo illo ut des ei Domine mentem puram caritatem perfectam in actibus sinceritatem in corde puritatem in opere virtutem in moribus disciplinam et quae pro iustitiae tuae timore integra mente vel devotione pro ipso tibi offerimus pietate tua obtinenda cognoscat.
translation_en: We humbly and tremblingly appeal to your divine, immense paternal pity, majesty, on behalf of your servant, that you give him, Lord, a pure mind, perfect love in actions, sincerity in heart, purity in work, virtue in behavior, discipline in habits, and what we offer to you with a mind or devotion integrated for the fear of your justice, may be recognized by your pity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam nova semper prole
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who always begets a new offspring for your Church

text: Exaltationem nostrae condicionis respice Deus ut tua dignatione mundati sacramentis magnae pietatis aptemur.
translation_en: We beseech you, God, to look upon the exaltation of our condition, so that through your divine grace we may be made worthy of being purified by the sacraments of great pity.

text: Exaudi clementissime Pater deprecationem servi tui pro pauperibus ancillis tuis in partu nunc aut in posterum laborantibus maiestati tuae devotissime supplicantis ut quemadmodum tua eas providentia concipere decrevisti ita ipsa benedictione tua praeambula ad laudem tui sacri nominis virgine gloriosa suffragante celeriter iubeas expediri.
translation_en: Hear, O most kind Father, the supplication of your servant on behalf of your poor handmaidens who are now or will be in labor for Your majesty. Devoutly pleading, they ask that just as Your providence has decreed to conceive them, so too may You quickly command their expeditious delivery by Your own blessing, with the glorious Virgin supporting her sacred name.

text: Exaudi Deus familiae tuae preces et suscipe vota fidelium quorum suscipere peccata et <dimittere> dignatus es et da pacem in diebus nostris qui es auctor pacis et caritatis.
translation_en: Hear, O God, the prayers of your family and receive the vows of the faithful whose sins you have been gracious enough to forgive, and grant us peace in our days. You are the author of peace and charity.

text: Exaudi Deus orationem nostram et tua sancta quae sumpsimus non ad iudicium nobis provenire patiaris sed ad remedium propitiationis immensae.
translation_en: Hear, O God, our prayer and the holy things we have taken up, thou wilt not permit it to come against us as a judgment, but rather for the purpose of immense propitiation.

text: Exaudi Domine Deus clementer in hac domo tua preces servorum tuorum quatenus illorum meritis tuam consequamur gratiam quorum hic patrocinia veneramur.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord God, graciously in Your house, the prayers of Your servants, that we may obtain Your grace through their merits, for whom here we come seeking their patronage.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui etiam Iudaicam perfidiam
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who even the treacherousness of the Jews

text: Exaudi Domine devotam tuae familiae precem et oblatum tibi hoc sacrificium in remissionem nostrorum peccaminum propitiatus assume.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, the prayer of your devoted family and accept this offering made to you for the forgiveness of our sins. Grant us mercy.

text: Exaudi Domine offerentium preces vota suscipe peccata dimitte tribue tuorum intercessione sanctorum caris quoque nostris qui in Christo dormierunt refrigerium in regione vivorum.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, from the supplicants; receive their prayers and vows. Grant forgiveness for sins, and through the intercession of your saints, grant refreshment to those who in Christ have fallen asleep, even our dear ones dwelling among the living.

text: Exaudi Domine plebem tuam et quod non habent merita supplicantium tua nos semper gratia praeveniens largiatur.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, your people and what petitioners lack merit; may your grace always precede and generously bestow upon us.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum cum sancti apostoli tui Andreae patrocinio supplicantem ut tuo semper auxilio secura tibi possit devotione servire.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, your people as they implore the aid of your apostle Andrew. May they always serve you with devotion, secure in your help.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine populum tuum cum sanctorum apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli patrocinio supplicantem ut tuo auxilio servati secura tibi possint devotione servire.
translation_en: Hear us, we beseech You, Lord, Your people, under the patronage of Your holy apostles Peter and Paul. May they be protected by Your aid so that they can serve You faithfully and securely with devotion.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum cum sanctorum tuorum tibi patrocinio supplicantem et temporalis vitae nos tribue pace gaudere et aeternae reperire subsidium.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, your people praying with the help of your saints, and grant us to enjoy peace in this life and find refuge in eternal life.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum cum sanctorum tuorum tibi patrocinio supplicantem ut (et) temporalis vitae nos tribuas pace gaudere et aeternae reperire subsidium.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, your people praying with the help of your saints, that you grant us joy in temporal life and find support for eternal life.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum cum sanctorum tuorum confessurum Germani et Remigii episcoporum quorum sollemnia celebramus tibi patrocinio supplicantem ut temporalis vitae nos tribuas pace gaudere et aeternae reperire subsidium. ( recensio prima ) Exaudi Domine populum tuum et sanctorum Remigii Germani et Vedasti antistitum sollemnia celebrantes temporalis vitae nos tribue pace gaudere et aeternum reperire subsidium. ( recensio altera )
translation_en:
Hear us, O Lord, your people along with the saints Germani and Remigius, bishops, whose feast days we celebrate under your patronage; that you may grant us to enjoy peace in this temporal life and find support for eternal life. (First recension)
Hear us, O Lord, your people and the saints Remigius, Germani, and Vedastus, bishops celebrating their feast days; that you may grant us to enjoy peace in this temporal life and find support for eternal life. (Second recension)

text: Exaudi Domine famulos tuos cum multiplici sanctorum tuorum tibi patrocinio supplicantes et temporalis vitae eos tribue pace gaudere et perpetuam reperire laetitiam.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, your servants, with a multitude of your saints interceding on our behalf. Grant them to enjoy peace in this life and find eternal joy.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum tota tibi mente subiectum ut corpore et mente protectus quod pie credit tua gratia consequatur.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, your people who are wholly submitted to you with a mind devoted; that protected both physically and mentally, they may obtain what they trust in your grace with piety.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum tota tibi mente subiectum et beati Martini pontificis supplicatione custodi ut corpore et corde protectus quod pie credi(di)t appetat et quod iuste sperat obtineat.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, your people who are wholly submitted to you in mind, and through the supplication of Blessed Martin the bishop, protect him so that what he faithfully believes he may obtain in body and what he justly hopes for may be attained.

text: Exaudi Domine populum tuum toto tibi corde subiectum et intercessionibus beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Sisinnii Martyrii et Alexandri a praesentibus defende periculis et futuris.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, your people who are wholly subject to you with hearts fully devoted, and through the intercessions of the most blessed martyrs Sisinnius and Alexander, defend them from present and future dangers.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et celeri nos propitiatione laetifica.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, and enlighten us with quick propitiation.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et intervenientibus sanctis tuis preces nostras placatus admitte.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, our supplications, and receiving our prayers through your saints, grant us favorable acceptance.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras quaesumus et interveniente sancto martyre tuo illo eas ante conspectum maiestatis tuae placatus admitte.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, as we humbly ask, and with the intervention of your holy martyr, may he bring our prayers before the sight of your majesty, pleased and accepted.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et ne velis cum servis tuis adire iudicium quia sicut in nobis nulla iustitia reperitur de qua praesumere valeamus ita te fontem pietatis agnoscimus a quo et a peccatis nostris nos ablui et a necessitatibus liberari confidimus.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, our prayers and do not wish to deal with your servants judgment, because as there is no justice found in us, of which we could presume, so we recognize you as the source of piety from whom we hope to be cleansed from our sins and freed from necessities.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et profectione famuli tui illius misericordiam tuam qui semper es ubique praetende ut ab omnibus adversitatibus tua opitulatione defensus iustorum desideriorum potiatur effectibus.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, our supplications, and grant the mercy of your servant who is always everywhere present. May he be protected by your help from all adversities, and may the desires of the righteous be fulfilled through your mighty power.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et iter famuli tui illius propitius comitare atque misericordiam tuam sicut ubique es ita ubique largire quatenus ab omnibus adversitatibus tua opitulatione defensus iustorum desideriorum potiatur effectibus.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our supplications and graciously accompany the journey of your servant, and let your mercy be everywhere as you are. So may it be everywhere that you give generously, so that we, defended by your help from all adversities, may taste the effectiveness of the desires of the righteous.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et sanctorum martyrum nos tuere praesidiis.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our supplications, and protect us with the shields of your saints.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et intercessione beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui Ambrosii nos tuere ubique praesidiis.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our supplications, and shield us everywhere with the protection of your blessed priest and confessor Ambrose.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et beati martyris tui illius nos tuere ubique praesidio.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our supplications, and may your blessed martyr shield us everywhere with your protection.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et sanctorum tuorum quorum festa sollemniter celebramus continuis foveamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers and those of your saints whom we solemnly celebrate. May their constant intercessions foster assistance for us.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et sicut profanas mundi caligines Sancti Spiritus luce evacuasti sic hostes romani nominis et inimicos catholicae professionis expugna.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, and as you dispelled the profane darkness of the world with the light of the Holy Spirit, so may you vanquish the enemies of the Roman name and opponents of the Catholic profession.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et ut digna sint munera quae oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus subsidium nobis tuorum concede sanctorum.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, our supplications and grant us worthy gifts that we present before your majesty's eyes. Grant us aid from your saints.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et ut digna sint munera quae oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus subsidium nobis tuae pietatis impende.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers and let the gifts we present to Your majesty's sight be worthy. Bestow upon us Your mercy.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras et ut tuis nos muneribus iugiter prosequaris maiestati tuae fac semper devotos.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers and may you forever follow us with your gifts to the glory of your majesty, making us always devoted.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras in die sollemnitatis magnifico sanctae virginis et martyris <illius> quae mundum vicit cum fragili <esset> sexu et dona eius apud te interventu placatus ut cuncti qui assistimus eius memoriam frequentantes pacis et caritatis vinculo colligemur.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers on the solemnity of the glorious virgin and martyr (her name), who conquered the world with a fragile sex. May her gifts at your intervention find favor, that we who participate in remembering her may be bound together by the bond of peace and charity.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras quas in sancti confessoris tui atque pontificis Marcelli sollemnitate deferimus et qui tibi digne meruit famulari eius intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers which we bring before you on the feast day of your saintly confessor and bishop Marcellus, and through his merits may he who has served you worthily intercede for us so that we are forgiven all sins.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras quas in sancti confessoris et sacerdotis episcopi tui Martini commemoratione deferimus et praesta ut sicut ille in conspectu tuo qui tibi digne meruit famulari clarus semper exstitit ita eius nos supplicatio in bonis actibus adiuvet.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, our prayers which we bring forward on the commemoration of your saintly confessor and bishop Martin, and grant that just as he, who merited to serve you worthily in Your presence, always shone forth, so his intercession may aid us in good works.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras quas in sancti confessoris tui illius commemoratione deferimus ut in conspectu tuo et qui tibi digne meruit famulari clarus semper exsistat et supplicatio nos adiuvet tibi grata iustorum.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers which we bring before your holy confessor on this commemoration day. May he who has worthy served you always stand in your presence, and may our supplication be pleasing to you, a help from the just ones.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras quas in sancti confessoris tui illius commemoratione deferimus in conspectu tuo qui tibi digne meruit famulari clarus semper exsistens supplicationem nostram adiuvet.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers which we bring before you on the commemoration of your holy confessor, who deservedly served you faithfully and always stood as an intercessor for us.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras ut in omni natione quod Verbi tui promissum est evangelio compleatur et plenitudo adoptionis obtineat quod praedixit testificatio veritatis.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, our prayers that in every nation, what Your Word has promised may be fulfilled through the Gospel, and may obtain the fullness of adoption as predicted by the witness of truth.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras ut quod tui Verbi sanctificatione promissum est evangelico ubique compleatur effectu et plenitudo adoptionis obtineat quod praedixit testificatio veritatis.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, our prayers that what was promised by your Holy Word may be fulfilled everywhere in deed and attain the fullness of adoption as predicted by the testimony of truth.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras ut redemptionis nostrae sacrosancta commercia et vitae nobis conferant praesentis auxilium et gaudia sempiterna concilient.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our supplications, that the holy business of our redemption and life may grant us present help and eternal joy unite us.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui non mortem peccatorum
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who death is not for sinners

text: Exaudi Domine preces populi tui ut iubeas suscipi quae iussisti offerri sintque haec munera acceptabilia in tuo conspectu pro omnium animarum emendatione et corporum sanitate pro martyrum laude et pro defunctorum requie.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, the prayers of your people, that you command these things to be received which have been ordered to be offered, and let these gifts be acceptable in your sight, for the amendment of all souls and the health of bodies, for the praise of the martyrs and for the rest of the departed.

text: Exaudi Domine quaesumus gemitum populi tui nec plus apud te valeat offensio delinquentium quam miseratio tua semper indulta fletibus supplicantium.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, we beseech you; do not let the groaning of your people be more powerful with you than your mercy, which is always granted to the tears of suppliants.

text: Exaudi Domine quaesumus populum tuum de tua misericordia malorum suorum veniam supplicantem et quia potens es peccata dimittere supplicia quae nostris meremur operibus potentia tuae pietatis averte.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, we humbly ask your people, from your mercy, that they may find forgiveness for their sins. And because you have the power to forgive sins, turn away the punishments which we deserve for our works, through your power of mercy.

text: Exaudi Domine quaesumus preces nostras et interveniente beato Marco confessore tuo atque pontifice supplicationes nostras placatus intende.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, we humbly beseech You. With the intervention of Blessed Mark, Your confessor and pope, kindly consider our petitions.

text: Exaudi Domine quaesumus preces nostras ut populus tuus sub tantis patrociniis constitutus et a suis offensionibus liberetur et ab omnibus protegatur adversis.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, we implore you, that your people may be established under such great patronages and be freed from their offenses, and be protected from all adversities.

text: Exaudi Domine preces nostras ut populus tuus qui sub tantis sanctorum martyrum tuorum Nazarii et Celsi patrociniis est constitutus et a suis offensionibus liberetur et ab omnibus tueatur adversis.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, our prayers, that your people who are established under the patronage of the many holy martyrs Nazarius and Celsus may be freed from their offenses and protected from all adversities.

text: Exaudi Domine supplicum preces et devoto tibi pectore famulantes perpetua defensione custodi ut nullis perturbationibus impediti liberam servitutem tuis semper exhibeamus officiis.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, the supplications of the humble and those who serve You with a devoted heart, and shield them perpetually with Your protection, that we may always show Our services without hindrance by any disturbances.

text: Exaudi Domine supplicum preces et quas merita nostra destituunt sanctorum tuorum commendatio reddat acceptas.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, the supplications of the humble and let the commendation of your saints make up for what our merits lack.

text: Exaudi Domine supplicum preces quas fundo ante conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae pro famulo tuo illo qui diaboli laqueo obnoxius strictus tenetur; porrige Deus dexteram tuam de supernis et libera famulum tuum a tenebris diaboli et a telis eius ut eum numquam audeat violare.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, the supplications which I pour before the sight of your divine majesty for your servant who is held captive by the snare of the devil; extend your right hand from above and free your servant from the shadows of the devil and his weapons, that he may never dare to violate him.

text: Exaudi Domine supplicum preces ut quod nostro gerendum est ministerio tua potius virtute firmetur.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, the prayers of the supplicants, that what is to be done by our ministry may be strengthened by your power.

text: Exaudi Domine vocem tibi supplicantis ecclesiae quae in modum vineae Filii tui propagata cultoribus firmis in te nititur stare radicibus ut a praesentis saeculi fluctibus aliena pullulantis in se populi nativitate ditata ubertatis suae fructibus glorietur.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, the voice of the supplicating church which, like a vine of your Son, is spread out and established firmly among its cultivators. May it stand rooted in you so that from the tumultuous waves of this world, it may be enriched with the nativity of its people and glory in the abundance of its fruits.

text: Exaudi me Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus ut deprecatio mea ad te digna sit ut quando me exire de corpore iusseris in me non habeat pars inimici ullam iniquitatem sed infunde in me misericordiam tuam ut angelus tuus Michael dignanter me perducat ante conspectum tuum et tu quia pius et misericors es delicta mea clementer dimittas et in tua gloria dignanter me suscipias.
translation_en: Hear me, O Lord, holy Father, almighty God, that my supplication to you may be worthy, so that when you command me to depart from my body, there will be no part of an enemy within me, nor any wickedness. But pour out your mercy upon me, so that the angel Michael may lead me worthily before your face, and because you are merciful and gracious, forgive my sins gently, and worthy receive me in your glory.

text: Exaudi me omnipotens aeterne Deus et qui dixisti: »Caro mea vere est cibus et sanguis meus vere est potus« sanctifica hoc sacrificium in oblationem tui corporis ut assumentes a terrenis desideriis et carnali cupiditate lasciviaque vel immunditia temptatione quoque immundorum spirituum liberare digneris et Sancto tuo Spiritu replere.
translation_en: Hear me, almighty everlasting God, and who said: 'My flesh is truly bread, and my blood is truly drink.' Sanctify this sacrifice as an offering of your body, so that you may be freed from earthly desires, carnal lust, and immorality, and also from the temptation of unclean spirits. And fill me with your Holy Spirit.

text: Exaudi nos bonorum omnium dispensator atque in electissimi tui Ioannis sollemnitate praesenti delictorum indulgentiam placatus attribue cui toto in virtutem Sancti Spiritus amore translato Christus fuit causa moriendi cui Christus fuerat causa nascendi. Ipse igitur nativitatis dominicae nuntius ipse praecursor probatus est passione.
translation_en: Hear us, Dispenser of all good ones, and grant the forgiveness of sins during the solemnity of your elect John, pleased as you were when Christ was moved by the love of the Holy Spirit to die, for whom Christ also was moved to be born. Therefore, the herald of Christ's nativity, himself the approved forerunner, was proven through his passion.

text: Exaudi nos Deus Pater omnipotens et praesta quae petimus.
translation_en: Hear nos, Deus Pater omnipotens, et concede quod petimus.

text: Exaudi nos Deus Pater omnipotens et praesta quaesumus ut munera offerentium famulorum et famularum tuarum suscipere digneris; sanctifica quod offertur tibi; praesta quod poscimus.
translation_en: Hear nos, Deus Pater omnipotens, et concede quod rogamus ut munera offerentium tuorum servorum et ancillarum tuarum digneris recipere; sanctifica quod offertur tibi; praesta quod poscimus.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et apostolorum tuorum nos tuere praesidiis quorum donasti fideles esse doctrinis.
translation_en: Hear nous, O God our Savior, and guard us under the protection of thy apostles, whom thou hast given to be faithful through thy teachings.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et concede propitius ut sanctorum tuorum meritis et precibus aeternitatis gloriam consequamur.
translation_en: Hear us, O God, our salvation, and grant us graciously that we may attain eternal glory through the merits of your saints and their prayers.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et dies nostros in tua pace dispone ut a cunctis perturbationibus liberati tranquilla tibi servitute famulemur.
translation_en: Hear us, O God, our Savior, and arrange our days in peace, so that having been freed from all disturbances, we may quietly serve you as your humble servant.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et in consortio nos divinorum sacrificiorum dignanter admitte ac pacem tuam benignus largire.
translation_en: Hear us, O God, our Savior, and graciously receive us in the company of divine sacrifices. Bestow upon us your peace benevolently.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et intercedente beato martyre tuo illo populum tuum et ab iracundiae tuae terroribus libera et misericordiae tuae fac largitate securum.
translation_en: Hear us, O God, our salvation, and through the intercession of your blessed martyr, deliver that people of yours from the terrors of your wrath, and secure them with your mercy's bounty.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et intercedente beato illo apostolo tuo quae pro illius veneranda gerimus passione nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Hear nous, O God our Savior, and through the intercession of that blessed apostle of yours, may we benefit from the healing, who on his account we bear up his venerable passion.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster et quia nostrae voces non merentur audiri sancti Germani confessoris tui atque pontificis interventio quaesumus sit accepta pro nobis.
translation_en: Hear us, O God our Savior, and since our voices do not deserve to be heard, we humbly ask that your intervention through Saint Germanus, your confessor and bishop, be accepted on our behalf.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster ut per haec sacrosancta mysteria in totius ecclesiae confidamus corpore faciendum quod eius praecessit in capite.
translation_en: Hear nos, o God our Savior, that through these holy mysteries we may confidently believe in the whole church that the body is to be made which preceded in His head.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster ut per huius sacramenti virtutem a cunctis nos mentis et corporis hostibus tuearis gratiam tribuens in praesenti et gloriam in futuro.
translation_en: Hear us, O God, our Savior, that through the power of this Sacrament, you may protect us from all enemies of mind and body, granting us grace now, and glory in the future.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster ut sancti Gorgonii sollemnitate celebrata piae devotionis erudiamur affectu.
translation_en: Hear us, O God our savior, that we may learn the holy lesson of Saint George with pious devotion through affection.

text: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster ut sicut de sanctae Caeciliae festivitate gaudemus ita piae devotionis erudiamur affectu.
translation_en: Hear nos, o God our Savior, that as we rejoice on the feast of Saint Cecilia, so may we be instructed in pious devotion with affection.

text: Exaudi nos Domine clamantes ad te et quos non deseris sacramentis necessariis attolle praesidiis.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, crying out to you and those whom you do not forsake, uphold with necessary sacraments and support with protective powers.

text: Exaudi nos Domine Deus noster cum sanctorum tuorum tibi patrocinio supplicantes ut quorum celebramus triumphos possimus retinere constantiam.
translation_en: Hear nos, O Lord God our Savior, with the help of your saints, as we humbly plead that those whose triumphs we celebrate, we may be able to retain constancy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per unicum Filium tuum Ecclesiae tuae
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through your only Son have bestowed upon your Church

text: Exaudi nos Domine Deus noster et a pravitatibus mundi tuorum discerne corda fidelium ut qui dominum sua voce pronuntiant in diabolicam non recidant servitutem.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord our God, and separate the hearts of your faithful ones from the wickedness of your world, so that those who proclaim their Lord with their voice may not fall into diabolic servitude.

text: Exaudi nos Domine Deus noster et Ecclesiam tuam inter mundi turbines fluctuantem clementi gubernatione moderare ut tranquillo cursu portum perpetuae securitatis inveniat.
translation_en: Hear nos, O Lord our God, and moderate your Church amidst the world's stormy turbulence with a gentle guidance, that it may find the peaceful course to the harbor of everlasting safety.

text: Exaudi nos Domine Deus noster et humanae iniquitatis oblitus divinae solius misericordiae recordare. Exaudi quaesumus dum peccare nos pateris dum emendare nos praecipis dum rogare permittis dum patientia redditum quaerendae correctionis exspectas dum iustitia metum futurae discussionis insinuas dum misericordia locum evadendae mortis ostendis.  Inveniant ante oculos tuos sacrificia nostra gratiam peccata veniam vulnera medicinam suspiria pietatem flagella consolationem lamenta temperiem tempora quietem officia dignitatem vota mercedem. Mereatur petitio effectum contritio solatium consecratio sacramentum.  Oblatio sanctificatione pinguescat trepidatio securitate discedat benedictio salubritate proficiat ut in omnibus multiplici pietate tua gratia redundante erigas plebem dum laetificas sacerdotem.
translation_en:
Hear us, O Lord our God, and forget human iniquity in your sole mercy. Remember us as you allow us to sin, as you command us to amend, as you permit us to pray, as you await patience for the seeking of correction, as you introduce fear of future judgment through justice, as you show mercy for escaping death.
May our offerings find favor before your eyes, may grace, forgiveness, healing, remedy, sighs of piety, lashes of repentance, consolation, tempering, seasons, quietness, offices, dignity, vows, rewards be granted. May the petition bear fruit, contrition bring solace, consecration bring sacrament.
May the offering be enriched by sanctification, may fear depart with security, may blessing progress with health, that in all things we may rise with your abundant grace through multiplied piety, and may you rejoice the priest.

text: Exaudi nos Domine et iter famuli tui illius inter vitae huius pericula tuo semper regatur auxilio.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, and guide your servant through the perils of this life under your constant protection and aid.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui regenerare dignatus es
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who has been pleased to renew

text: Exaudi nos Domine Deus noster et viam famuli tui illius in salutis dignare prosperitate dirigere ut ad omnes varietatum casus saecularium tuo semper protegatur auxilio.
translation_en: Hearn us, O Lord our God, and direct the path of your servant in a way worthy of salvation, so that he may be always protected by your aid through all the varying circumstances of secular life.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui regenerasti famulum
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has reborn the servant

text: Exaudi nos Domine et praesta quam te petimus pacem tuam perfectam de caelis; da nobis hodie pacificum quoque hunc diem et ceteris diebus vitae nostrae praesta pacem.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, and grant what we ask of you: complete peace from heaven. Give us this day peace as well, and on all the days of our life, grant us peace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui regnis omnibus
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who reigns over all

text: Exaudi nos Domine redemptor noster beata tempora celebrantes quibus tua caelestis aeternitas humanis infusa pectoribus assumpsit hominem liberandum.
translation_en: Hear nous, O Lord, our Redeemer, as we celebrate the blessed times. In these days, your celestial eternity has been infused into human hearts to assume man for redemption.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sancte Pater aeterne omnipotens Deus et secundum magnam misericordiam tuam quam non negas pura merite petentibus orationes omnium accepta propitius. Sanctifica ergo preces nostras quas supplices ad te humilesque effundimus et in affectum bonum nostri cordis desideria dignare convertere.  Concede Domine ieiunium nostrum ita inculpabile apud te inveniri ut numquam diaboli laqueis teneamur adstricti sed a peccatis nostris immaculati inveniamur ac liberi quo tam anima quam corpore praeparati sancto altario tuo ministrare mereamur illaesi.
translation_en:
Hear us, O Lord, holy Father, eternal and almighty God, and according to Your great mercy which You do not deny to those who humbly and sincerely ask for it, receive our prayers. Sanctify therefore our petitions which we pour out to You with a contrite heart, and deign to turn the desires of our good will.
Grant us, Lord, that our fast may be found guiltless before You such that we may never be bound by the devil's snares, but rather be found spotless from our sins and free, so that both soul and body may be prepared to serve Your holy altar unharmed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui salvas omnes et neminem vis perire respice ad animas
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who saves all and wishes none to perish, look upon the souls.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sancte Pater omnipotens <aeterne>deus et his oblationibus precibusque susceptis praesentiae tuae virtutem intersere ut quod singuli ad maiestatis tuae obtulerunt honorem cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Hear nos, Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne deus, and these offerings and prayers received, may the power of your presence intercede so that what each one offered to your majesty brings honor to all for the salvation of all.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus et meritis sive intercessionibus sancti antistitis tui Germani episcopi hanc plebem tuam tua miseratione custodi benignitate conserva pietate salvifica.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, and through the merits or intercessions of your saint bishop Germanus, protect this people of yours with your mercy, conserve them with your kindness, save them with your pity.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus et viam famuli tui illius in salutis tuae prosperitate dispone ut inter omnes viae huius varietates tuo semper protegatur auxilio.
translation_en: Hear us, O Lord, holy Father, almighty and eternal God; and arrange the way of your servant in the prosperity of your salvation, that he may always be protected by your help amidst all the various paths of this way.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui per beatae Mariae sacri uteri divinae gratiae obumbrationem universum mundum illuminare dignatus es; maiestatem tuam supplices exoramus ut quod nostris meritis non valemus obtinere eius adipisci praesidiis mereamur.
translation_en: Hear nos, Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeternus Deus, who by the divine grace of the blessed Mary's sacred womb were pleased to illuminate the entire world; humbly we beseech your majesty that, although we are not worthy to obtain it through our merits, we may deserve the protection for which we pray.

text: Exaudi nos Domine sempiterna Trinitas Deus qui propter hominum peccata carnem assumere dignatus es. Dies enim octava est a tua nativitate quo circumcisionem Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui posuisti pro nobis et regnum idolatriae destruxisti viam veritatis docuisti legem implesti Ioseph et Maria in eremo satiasti. Te obsecramus Domine ut a peccatis huius saeculi nos liberare digneris.
translation_en: Hear us, O eternal Trinity, Lord, who were moved to take on flesh due to human sins. For today is the eighth day since your nativity, on which you established for us the circumcision of our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, and destroyed the kingdom of idolatry, taught the way of truth, fulfilled the law, Joseph and Mary did satiate in the wilderness. We humbly beseech you, O Lord, that you deem worthy to free us from the sins of this world.

text: Exaudi nos miserator et misericors Deus et continentiae salutaris propitius nobis dona concede.
translation_en: Hear us, O merciful Savior, and God of mercy, and graciously grant us your saving help of continence.

text: Exaudi nos omnipotens et misericors Deus et continentiae salutaris propitius nobis dona concede.
translation_en: Hear us, almighty and merciful God, and graciously bestow upon us the gift of continence.

text: Exaudi nos misericors Deus et da mentibus nostris quo redemptor noster conscendit attolli ut secundo mediatoris adventu manifesto munere capiamus quod nunc audemus sperare promissum.
translation_en: Hear nos, O merciful God, and give to our minds what our Redeemer ascended to lift up, so that at the second coming of the mediator we may receive the promised gift which now we dare to hope for.

text: Exaudi nos misericors Deus et mentibus nostris gratiae tuae lumen ostende.
translation_en: Hear us, O merciful God, and shine your grace upon our minds.

text: Exaudi nos misericors Deus et redemptionis nostrae subsidia devota nos effice semper mente tractare.
translation_en: Hear us, O merciful God, and make us always disposed to think devotedly about our redemption.

text: Exaudi nos omnipotens Deus et familiae tuae corda cui perfectam baptismi gratiam contulisti ad promerendam beatitudinem aptes aeternam.
translation_en: Hear us, almighty God, and your family, whose hearts you have made worthy of receiving the perfection of baptism's grace to merit eternal beatitude.

text: Exaudi nos omnipotens Deus et famulos tuos quos fidei christianae primitiis imbuisti huius sacrificii tribuas operatione mundari.
translation_en: Hear us, almighty God, and your servants whom you first filled with the faith of Christ. Grant us the grace to be purified by this sacrifice.

text: Exaudi nos omnipotens et misericors Deus et sanctorum tuorum nos ubique tuere praesidiis.
translation_en: Hear nous, O almighty and merciful God, and protect us everywhere with the guardianship of your saints.

text: Exaudi nos omnipotens et misericors Deus et visitationem tuam conferre dignare super hunc famulum tuum illum quem diversa vexat infirmitas; visita eum sicut visitare dignatus es socrum Petri puerumque centurionis et Tobiam et Saram famulos tuos per angelum tuum sanctum Raphael; ita ut eum restituas ad pristinam sanitatem et mereatur in atrio domus tuae dicere: »Castigans castigavit me Dominus et morti non tradidit me.«
translation_en: Hear us, almighty and merciful God, and deign to bestow your visitation upon this, your servant, whom various infirmities torment; as you visited Sarah, the wife of Peter, the centurion's son, and Tobias, your servants, through your holy angel Raphael; so that he may be restored to his former health and merit to say in the courtyard of your house: "The Lord has chastised me, the Lord has chastised me not unto death."

text: Exaudi nos omnipotens et misericors Deus ut famulo tuo illi cuius memoriam agimus praemia vitae aeternae concedas et lucis ac refrigerii cum fidelibus tuis praepares mansionem.
translation_en: Hear nos, omnipotent and merciful God, that you grant to your servant, whom we remember, the rewards of eternal life, and prepare for him, with your faithful ones, a home of light and refreshment.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus respice propitius ad devotionem populi
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, look favorably upon the devotion of the people

text: Exaudi nos omnipotens et misericors Deus ut nos beati martyris tui atque pontificis illius dies natalis excipiat qui et glorificationis suae iucunditatem nobis infundat et tibi nos reddat acceptos.
translation_en: Hear nos, omnipotent and merciful God, that we may be received on the day of the birthday of your blessed martyr and bishop, whom also the joy of his glorification may pour out upon us, and render us acceptable to you.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus respice propitius super hunc famulum ... ad nova tonendi ...
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, look upon this servant of Yours favorably... to the new sound...

text: Exaudi nos omnipotens et misericors Deus ut quod nostro ministratur officio tua benedictione potius impleatur.
translation_en: Hear nos, o almighty and merciful God, that what is conferred on us by your ministerial office may be more fully accomplished through your blessing.

text: Exaudi nos sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus ut his sacris muneribus placatus animas omnium famulorum tuorum diaconorum redemptio sempiterna possideat.
translation_en: Hear us, holy Father, almighty eternal God, that with these sacred offerings you are appeased, may the eternal redemption of souls of all your servants, the deacons, be possessed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus respicere dignare
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, deign to look upon [us]

text: Exaudi omnipotens Deus deprecationem nostram pro famulo tuo illo qui in honorem sancti ac beatissimi illius oblationem tibi offert ut per eius merita vota perficias; petitiones eius adscendant ad aures clementiae tuae et descendat super eum pia benedictio tua ut sub umbra alarum tuarum protegatur et orationes nostrae te propitiante non refutentur sed in omnibus auxiliare atque defende.
translation_en: Hear, almighty God, our supplication for your servant who offers an oblation to you in honor of the holy and blessed one. May his requests be granted by the ears of your mercy and may your pious blessing descend upon him so that under the shelter of your altars he is protected. May our prayers find favor with you, assisting and defending him in all things.

text: Exaudi omnipotens Deus nos famulos tuos ad te in tribulatione clamantes et libera nos de angustiis et de tribulationibus multis; accepta piissime Deus pro nostrorum remedio hoc sacrificium et concede his tuae pietatis praemium sempiternum; offerentium nomina in libro vitae praenota et defunctorum animas in pace refrigera.
translation_en: Hear us, almighty God, your servants who cry out to you in tribulation, and free us from distresses and many troubles. Graciously accepted, O God, this sacrifice as a remedy for us, and grant them eternal rewards of your pity. May the names of those offering be noted in the book of life, and may the souls of the dead rest in peace.

text: Exaudi populum supplicantem misericors Deus et beatae Honorinae virginis et martyris tuae patrocinio cuius merita veneratur gratiam tuam ei largire propitius.
translation_en: Hear the supplicating people, merciful God, and through the patronage of your blessed martyr Honorina, whose merits are revered, grant them your grace propitiously.

text: Exaudi preces familiae tuae omnipotens Deus et praesta ut sancta haec quae a te sumpsimus incorrupta in nobis te donante serventur.
translation_en: Hear our prayers, almighty God, and grant that the holy things which we have received from you may be preserved uncorrupted in us through your grace.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine Ecclesiam tuam non solum paganorum percussionibus attritam sed etiam christianorum pravitatibus afflictam et concede propitius ut qui terrenae recusant subdi potestati dextera tuae maiestatis citius deiciantur inviti.
translation_en: Hear us, we entreat you, O Lord, your Church not only worn down by the persecutions of the pagans but also afflicted by the wickedness of Christians. Graciously grant that those who refuse to submit to earthly power may be thrust down more swiftly by your right hand's majesty against their will.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine gemitum populi supplicantis ut qui de meritorum qualitate diffidimus non iudicium sed misericordiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Hear us, we beseech You, Lord, the groaning of the supplicating people, that we who doubt in the quality of our merits may not obtain judgment but mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus spes unica mundi
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, the only hope of the world

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine supplicum preces et confitentium tibi parce peccans ut pariter nobis indulgentiam tribuas benignus et pacem.
translation_en: Hear us, we implore you, Lord, the prayers of supplicants and penitents. Grant us, gracious one, forgiveness for our sins, and in kindness bestow upon us both forgiveness and peace.

text: Exaudi quaesumus omnipotens Deus preces nostras quas in conspectu pietatis tuae effundere praesumimus suppliciter deprecantes ut famulum tuum in tua misericordia confidentem benedicas et omnia eius peccata dimittas tuaque eum protectione conserves ut possit tibi dignus fieri et ad aeternam beatitudinem valeat pervenire.
translation_en: Hear us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, the prayers that we presume to pour out before your mercy. We entreat you, bless your servant who trusts in your mercy, and forgive all his sins. May you preserve him under your protection so that he may become worthy for you and reach eternal beatitude.

text: Exaudi quaesumus Domine preces servorum tuorum ut sanctorum martyrum Crispini et Crispiniani meritis tuam consequamur gratiam quorum sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Hear us, we beseech You, Lord, the prayers of Your servants, that we may obtain Your grace following the merits of the holy martyrs Crispin and Crispinian, whose feast day we celebrate.

text: Exaudiat vos Dominus Deus noster et pro sua quemque necessitate clamantem benignus adspiciat; solatia propitius administret quae humana poscit infirmitas; peccata quae adversantur avertat; pariterque corporibus vestris et mentibus semper profutura concedat.
translation_en: May the Lord our God hear you and, in accordance with each one's necessity, look upon you benevolently; may He graciously administer the solace that human infirmity demands; may He turn away sins that afflict you; and may He always grant both your bodies and minds a fruitful outcome.

text: Excellentissimam tuae maiestatis imploramus potentiam sancte Deus qui virginem tuam Columbam et in amphitheatro bestia obsequente glorificas et post in consummatione passionis emissa de caelis voce confirmas ut has tibi iubeas propitius oblatas hostias intueri atque caelestis benedictionis sanctifices largitate ac praestes ut omnes pro quibus haec offertur oblatio et lucrum tui sanguinis simus et pretium nostrae redemptionis plenissima devotione sumamus.
translation_en: We humbly beseech the most excellent power of your majesty, O holy God, who glorified your virgin Columba in an amphitheater with a beast obeying and confirmed her voice from heaven after the completion of her passion, that you command her to graciously behold the offerings presented to you and to sanctify them with the gift of celestial blessing. We pray that you may bestow upon us and all for whom this offering is made the fullness of devotion from your precious blood. Amen.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus universae nobis adversa
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, all adversities for us

text: Excelsae maiestatis Domine et rex omnium saeculorum qui legis tuae amore flagrantes Macchabaeos martyrii gloria decorasti quique beatissimum Felicem felicitate aeterna donasti dum praeceptis evangelicis oboediendo proprio eliminavit e solo illo te in poenis praedicavit ardore quo et praedicti Macchabaei pro patrum legibus effuderunt sanguinem proprium te petimus et rogamus ut et illis intercedentibus in caritate totam impleamus legem et hoc martyre tuo suffragante aeterna potiti pace in nullo utamur antiqui serpentis discidii simultate.
translation_en: Lord, exalted in majesty and king of all the centuries, who adorned the Macchabees with the glory of martyrdom because they burned with love for your laws, and bestowed eternal happiness upon the most blessed Felicitas when she obeyed the precepts of the gospel, eliminated evil from her life, proclaimed you on that earthly realm, and spoke about you with the same ardor as the aforementioned Macchabees who shed their own blood for their father's laws. We humbly ask and implore you to fill us completely with love for your law through their intercession, and we pray that with your support granted by this martyrdom, we may obtain eternal peace and never use the ancient serpent's division.

text: Excelse caelorum Deus ac Domine qui martyris tui Valeriani voluntatem per angelum sciscitare dignatus es ut per eundem quam voluisset insinuaret petitionem effectumque capere mereretur ex fide quod et obtinere promeruit enitendo pro fratris salvatione per eandem tui angeli precem quaesumus ut nostris petitionibus placabilem accommodes aurem et per quem visitasti illorum iam credula pectora per eum corda nostra iubeas mederi infirma et per quem illorum suscepisti precamina per eum iubeas nostra sanctificare oblata ut qui e caelis directus illorum praesentatus est oculis nunc a te dirigatur benedicturus his sacrificiis nostris.
translation_en: Exalted God of the heavens and Lord, who deigned to inquire about the will of your martyr Valerian through an angel, that he might insinuate his petition as he wished and might deserve to obtain what had been promised through faith; we humbly ask that you make your ear accommodating to our petitions through the same angel whom you visited with credulous hearts. We entreat you that by the same angel you command his infirm hearts to be healed, and that you command him to sanctify our offerings, so that the one who was sent from heaven to present himself before their eyes may now turn to us, to be blessed by us in these sacrifices.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus vespere et mane
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, at evening and morning

text: Excelse Domine qui beatae virgini Agathae et viventi et defunctae e caelis nuntios emisisti quo et vivens ab illatis mederetur vulneribus et defuncta haec obitus sui memoria commendaretur praeclarius cum mores eius per caelestem nuntium ad memoriam futurorum conscripti marmore destinantur tu nobis attribue ut emissis angelorum tuorum custodiis et vita nostra liberetur a malis et sacrificia spiritum suscipiant sanctitatis quo participatio holocaustorum praesentium et corporibus gratiam et animabus caelestem impertiat medicinam.
