translation_en: O Exalted One, who sent messengers from the heavens to the blessed virgin Agatha, both living and deceased, that while she was still alive she might be healed by their remedies for her wounds, and her departure from life might be commended more splendidly because her virtuous deeds have been written in marble tablets as heavenly news for the memory of future generations. Grant us, we pray, that through the guardianship of your angels, our lives may be released from evils and our offerings receive the grace of sanctity, so that through their participation in the present holocausts, both bodies and souls may receive celestial medicine.

text: Excita Domine in Ecclesia tua spiritum cui sanctus Laurentius levita servivit ut eodem nos replente studeamus amare quod amavit et opere exercere quod docuit.
translation_en: Stir up, Lord, within Your Church that same Spirit which the holy deacon Laurence served. May we strive to love what he loved and put into practice what he taught.

text: Excita Domine potentiam tuam et magna nobis virtute succurre ut per auxilium gloriae tuae quod nostra peccata praepediunt indulgentia tuae propitiationis acceleret.
translation_en: Stir up, O Lord, thy power, and come to our aid with great might, that through the help of thy glorious grace may the remission of our sins be hastened by the propitiation of thy mercy.

text: Excita Domine potentiam tuam et veni et quod Ecclesiae tuae promisisti usque in finem saeculi clementer operare.
translation_en: Stir up, O Lord, thy power, and come; and that which thy Church hath promised unto the end of the ages, operate graciously.

text: Excita Domine potentiam tuam et veni ut tua propitiatione salvemur.
translation_en: Stir up, O Lord, thy power, and come to save us by thy graciousness.

text: Excita Domine quaesumus corda nostra ad praeparandas unigeniti tui vias ut per eius adventum purificatis tibi mentibus servire mereamur.
translation_en: Stir up, we ask you, Lord, our hearts to prepare the ways of your only-begotten Son, that through his coming we may be purified and worthy to serve you with cleansed minds.

text: Excita Domine quaesumus potentiam tuam et veni ut ab imminentibus peccatorum nostrorum periculis te mereamur protegente eripi te liberante salvari.
translation_en: Stir up, Lord, we beseech you, your power and come, that protected by you, we may be snatched from the dangers of our sins, delivered, saved.

text: Excita Domine quaesumus tuorum fidelium voluntates ut divini operis fructum propensius exsequentes pietatis tuae remedia maiora percipiant.
translation_en: Stir up, we beseech you, Lord, the minds of your faithful people, that more eagerly executing the fruit of divine work, they may receive greater remedies of your mercy.

text: Excita Domine tuorum corda fidelium ut sacris intenta doctrinis et intellegant quod sequantur et sequendo fideliter apprehendant.
translation_en: Stir up, O Lord, the hearts of your faithful people, that they may be attentive to sacred teachings and understand what they should follow. May they, in following faithfully, grasp its essence.

text: Excita quaesumus Domine potentiam tuam et veni ut hii qui in tua pietate confidunt ab omni citius adversitate liberentur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, stir up Your power and come, that those who trust in Your mercy may be quickly delivered from every adversity.

text: Exemplo beatissimae virginis tuae Deus pater quae se tibi in vivam obtulit hostiam dum nec de nuditate confunditur nec ceteris illatis suppliciis deterretur has tibi pro nostrorum criminum venia offerimus victimas quas tu quaesumus omnipotens Deus bonitate solita benedicas impertiendo et his sacrificiis gratiam et nostris offensis veniam copiosam.
translation_en: Following the example of your most blessed virgin, God our Father, who offered himself to you as a living sacrifice and was not either confounded by nakedness or deterred by other afflictions, we offer to you these victims for the forgiveness of our sins. We humbly ask you, almighty God, according to your usual kindness, to bless them, bestowing grace upon these sacrifices and granting us abundant pardon for our offenses.

text: Exercemus Domine gloriosa commercia; offerimus quae dedisti ut te ipsum mereamur accipere.
translation_en: Let us exercise, Lord, glorious transactions; we offer what you have given, so that we may merit to receive you ourselves.

text: Exercitatio veneranda Domine ieiunii salutaris populi tui corda disponat ut et dignis mentibus suscipiat paschale sacramentum et continuatae devotionis sumat augmentum.
translation_en: May this reverent exercise, Lord, arrange the hearts of your saving people so that they receive the Paschal sacrament with worthy minds and take an increase in continued devotion.

text: Exorabilis Domine intende orationem nostram et suscipe haec munera quae tibi offerimus in celebritate almi Ethelberti regis et martyris tui et praesta ut eius auxilio adiuvemur.
translation_en: Gracious Lord, incline your ear to our prayer and accept the gifts that we present to you in honor of the blessed King and Martyr Ethelbert. Grant that we may be helped by his aid.

text: Exorantibus omnipotens Pater per omnia tuis praesta mysteriis ut nobis pacis tuae osculis introitus donetur in sanctis.
translation_en: The Almighty Father, through all your mysteries, grant to us who are invoking you that we may be granted entrance into the holy places with the kisses of your peace.

text: Explentes sacrosancta caerimoniorum sollemnia ritu Melchisedech summi sacerdotis oblata precamur mente devota te maiestas aeterna ut operante virtute panem mutatum in carnem poculum versum in sanguinem illum sumamus in calice qui de te fluxit in cruce ex latere.
translation_en: Filling the sacred solemnities of the rituals of Melchisedech, the highest priest, we pray to your eternal majesty with a devoted mind, that by operating with divine power, the consecrated bread is changed into flesh and the transformed cup into blood. We receive this in the chalice which flowed from you on the cross from your side.

text: Expletis Domine in hac sancta sollemnitate nostrae servitutis officiis gratias tibi laudesque deferimus dono tuae miserationis adiuti precantes te Deus ut a peccatis nos abluas et in tuis semper laudibus exsultare concedas.
translation_en: In this holy solemnity of our service, we offer to you, Lord, our thanks and praise with the gift of your mercy. With your aid, we humbly pray to God that you wash us from our sins, and grant us always to rejoice in your praises.

text: Expurgatos nos Domine quaesumus ab omni cibo malitiae in novam converte prosapiem ut tua gratia et caelesti pane ac poculo saginati mereamur in aeternitatis tuae convivio saturati.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, we entreat you, from every food of wickedness; and convert us to new life, that being nourished by your grace and the heavenly bread and drink, we may deserve to be filled in your eternal banquet.

text: Exsistat quaesumus Domine beatissimus Benedictus pro nobis perpetuus interventor ut haec sancta mysteria quae indignis manibus tractamus non sint nobis reatus ad poenam sed sint fortitudo nostrae infirmitatis et ad vitam capessendam aeternam praeparatio salutaris.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, the most blessed Benedict, to always be present for us as an everlasting intercessor. May these holy mysteries we handle unworthily not be a burden leading to punishment for us, but may they become our strength in our weakness and a preparatory salvation for eternal life.

text: Oreatur Domine nascentes tenebras
translation_en: Lord, may darknesses be brought to birth.

text: Exstingue in nobis Domine omnes libitus carnalis concupiscentiae per abstinentiae sacratae virtutem ut cum a nostris cordibus radicitus cuncta eraseris vitia tua in nobis permaneat caritas sempiterna.
translation_en: Lord, extinguish all carnal desires within us. Through the sacred virtue of abstinence, that every root of your sins may be removed from our hearts. May eternal charity remain in us.

text: Oremus Deum ac Dominum nostrum
translation_en: Let us pray to God, our Lord

text: Exsultamus Domine multiplicata festivitate sanctorum quia non diffidimus tua nos dona sumpturos pro quibus impetrandis tanta nobis patrocinia contulisti.
translation_en: We rejoice, Lord, in the multiplicity of the feast of the saints, for we do not doubt that you will bestow your gifts upon us, for which such great patronage you have granted to us.

text: Exsultamus in te Domine et de percepto pane iustitiae et de tuorum festivitate martyrum quia interventionibus eorum confidimus nobis ad perpetuam vitam profutura quae sumpsimus.
translation_en: We rejoice in you, Lord, and with the perception of justice's bread, and of the feast-day of your martyrs, for we trust that through their intercessions it will prove beneficial to us for eternal life, which we have received.

text: Exsultamus pariter et de percepto pane iustitiae et de tuorum Domine festivitate sanctorum quia interventionibus tibi placentium confidimus nobis ad perpetuam vitam censura quae sumpsimus.
translation_en: We rejoice together and with the perception of the bread of justice, and with the feast of your, Lord, saints; because we trust in the intercessions made on our behalf by those pleasing to you, we believe that the judgment we have received will be for eternal life.

text: Oremus dilectissimi Deum Patrem omnipotentem ut super hunc famulum suum quem ad presbyterii ...
translation_en: Let us pray, dearest God our Father almighty, that upon this, Your servant, whom You have called to the office of a presbyter...

text: Exsultans plebs tua Domine in hoc festo Iacobi apostoli tui suminis te flagitat precibus ut sicut idem ab omnibus cognominari promeruit iustus ita nos mereamur in melius mutatis moribus remota vanitate et esse et appellari tam iustitiae cultores quam misericordiae sectatores obtinentes apud te dum vivimus et nobis pietatis tuae solatium et defunctis beatitudinis locum quo et hic misericordia tua in nobis miseris ostendatur et post iustificantis in nobis remuneratio declaretur.
translation_en: Your people rejoice in this festival of James, your apostle, O Lord. They implore you with their prayers that, as the just one has been called by all, so we may deserve to improve in character, leaving vanity behind, and to be both cultivators of justice and seekers of mercy, obtaining from you during our life the solace of your pity and a place of beatitude for the deceased. May your mercy in us, shown to the afflicted, be manifest here, and may the reward for justifying us be declared after our lives.

text: Oremus dilectissimi Deum Patrem omnipotentem ut super hunc famulum suum quem in sacrum ...
translation_en: Let us pray, dearest God the Father Almighty, that upon this your servant whom you consecrated ...

text: Exsultantes Domine cum muneribus ad altaria veneranda concurrimus quia et omnium nobis hodie summa votorum et causa nostrae redemptionis exorta est.
translation_en: We rejoice, Lord, with offerings as we approach the worthy altars. For today, the summit of all our vows and the cause of our redemption has arisen for us.

text: Oremus dilectissimi fratres Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum
translation_en: Let us pray, dearest brothers, our Lord Jesus Christ

text: Exsultemus dilectissimi fratres et glorificemur in domino; annua sollemnium festivitate redeunte novum beati temporis lumen advenit et clarior dies arcani paschalis illuxit. Dignius Deo patri laudis votis certantibus exhibete amoris eius dilectionem communi mutua caritate fruentes inhaerere ut credentium spiritus suae passionis gloria et resurrectionis illustret et pacifica nobis tempora odio saecularium admiratione sollemnium propitius impertiat.
translation_en: Let us rejoice, dearest brothers, and let us glorify the Lord; the annual solemnity has come with a festive celebration, bringing the new light of the blessed time. A brighter day of the secret Easter has shone. May those striving for praise to the Father God show their love for Him by common mutual charity, sticking together so that the glory and resurrection of Christ may illuminate the spirits of believers, and may peaceful times be bestowed upon us in awe of worldly hatred, favorably granting the solemnity.

text: Exsultemus quaesumus Domine Deus noster in sollemnitate beati confessoris tui illius ut eius sacra natalicia celebrantes ad impetrandam misericordiam tuam semper eius patrociniis adiuvemur.
translation_en: Let us rejoice, we ask you, Lord our God, on the solemnity of your blessed confessor, that celebrating his sacred natalities, we may always be helped by your mercy through his patronage.

text: Oremus dilectissimi nobis Deum Patrem omnipotentem ut cunctis mundum
translation_en: Let us pray, our most beloved God the Father Almighty, that He may grant peace to all the world.

text: Exsultemus quaesumus Domine Deus noster omnes recti corde in unitate fidei congregati ut veniente Salvatore nostro filio tuo immaculati occurramus illi in eius sanctorum comitatu.
translation_en: Let us rejoice, we ask you, Lord our God, all the upright of heart gathered together in unity of faith, that approaching our Savior, your Son, spotless, we may meet him in his company of saints.

text: Exsultet Domine christianae plebis humilitas quae in martyrum commemoratione sanctorum tua mirabilia veneratur et eorum tibi precibus adiuta complaceat.
translation_en: Let the humility of the Christian people rejoice, O Lord, who venerate your marvels in the commemoration of the saints and are aided by their prayers, that they may please you.

text: Oremus dilectissimi nobis in primis pro Ecclesia
translation_en: Let us pray, most beloved ones, first for the Church.

text: Exsultet Domine populus christianus de magnorum Filii tui glorificatione membrorum et quanto eminentiora sunt ceteris tanto magis de eorum culmine inferiora congaudeant.
translation_en: Rejoice, O Lord, the Christian people at the glory of Your Son, and let the parts that are more noble rejoice more, yet let them also from their lower extremes join in the celebration.

text: Exsultet plebs tua Domine placitorum tibi fulta praesidiis quibus et sanctificationem referat et subsidia propriae fragilitatis acquirat.
translation_en: Rejoice, O people, your Lord, filled with pleasures, with the protections whereby you offer sanctification to Him and acquire assistance for your own frailty.

text: Exsultet populus tuus Domine quaesumus in sancti commemoratione Laurentii et cuius de votivo laetatur officio suffragio relevetur optato.
translation_en: Let your people rejoice, Lord, we pray, on the holy commemoration of Lawrence; and let him be lifted up through the prayers offered in his votive service, as desired.

text: Exsultet quaesumus Domine populus tuus in sancti tui commemoratione Hermis et cuius votivo laetatur officio suffragio relevetur optato.
translation_en: Let us rejoice, we ask you, O Lord, your people in the commemoration of your saint Hermis, and let him be made happy by the votive service, may he be raised up through the intercession that is desired.

text: Oremus et pro beatissimo papa
translation_en: Let us pray for the most blessed pope

text: Exuberet quaesumus Domine mentibus nostris paschalis gratia sacramenti et donis suis ipsa nos dignos efficiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the grace of the Paschal sacrament may abound in our minds, and that through His gifts He may deem us worthy.

text: Oremus et pro cathecumenis
translation_en: Let us pray for catechumens

text: Fac Domine Deus omnipotens ut in tota mundi latitudine sanctae Trinitatis gloria agnoscatur in personis et summae maiestatis potentia adoretur in unitate.
translation_en: Make, Lord God Almighty, that throughout the world's breadth the glory of the Holy Trinity be acknowledged in their persons and that the supreme majesty be worshiped in unity.

text: Fac Domine quaesumus fidelium tibi grata munera populorum ut quos suae conscientiae reatus accusat intercessio sanctorum illorum semper absolvat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask on behalf of your faithful people, that the offerings pleasing to you from the peoples may always free those whom their own conscience accuses, through the intercession of the saints.

text: Oremus et pro christianissimo imperatore
translation_en: Let us pray for the most Christian emperor

text: Fac me quaeso omnipotens Deus ita iustitia indui ut in sanctorum tuorum merear exsultatione laetari quatenus emundatus ab omnibus sordibus peccatorum consortium adipiscar tibi placentium sacerdotum meque tua misericordia a vitiis omnibus exuat quem reatus propriae conscientiae gravat.
translation_en: I ask, O almighty God, to clothe me with justice in such a way that I may deserve to rejoice in the company of your saints. Purify me from all the stains of sin so that I may join the ranks of pleasing priests and may my own misdeeds burdened conscience be freed by your mercy from all vices.

text: Fac nos aeterne Deus ea pace tibi coniungi qua sanctus Romanus martyr tuus accensus hostem fores Ecclesiae tuae minime intrare permisit ut sicut ille per eam evicit temporale supplicium ita quoque nos ea in nobis permanente et mundi illecebras respuamus et devicto hoste aeterna gaudia praestolemur.
translation_en: May an eternal God join you with the peace with which your holy Roman martyr, aroused against the enemy, allowed not to enter your Church. So just as he vanquished temporal punishment through it, let us also, by this peace remaining in us, reject worldly temptations and receive eternal joy after conquering the enemy.

text: Oremus et pro haereticis
translation_en: Let us pray for the heretics

text: Fac nos Domine Deus sanctae Mariae semper virginis subsidiis attolli et gloriosa beatorum apostolorum martyrum confessorum atque virginum omniumque simul sanctorum protectione defendi ut dum eorum pariter cottidie festa celebramus eorum pariter cottidie ab omnibus adversis protegamur auxilio.
translation_en: Grant us, O Lord God, through the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary, ever Virgin, and the glorious confessors and martyrs, apostles, virgins, and all the saints, to be supported and defended by their protection, so that while we daily celebrate their feasts together, we may also be daily protected from all adversities with their constant aid.

text: Oremus et pro omnibus episcopis
translation_en: Let us pray for all bishops

text: Fac nos Domine quaesumus accepto pignore salutis aeternae sic tendere congruenter ut ad eam pervenire possimus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that with an acceptable pledge of eternal salvation, we may strive to reach it so that we can attain it.

text: Oremus et pro paganis
translation_en: Let us pray for the pagans

text: Fac nos Domine quaesumus ad sancta mysteria purificatis mentibus accedere ut tibi semper competens deferamus obsequium.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you allow us to approach the holy mysteries with pure minds, so that we may always offer you fitting obedience.

text: Fac nos Domine quaesumus mala nostra toto corde respuere ut bona tua capere valeamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you, let us reject our sins with our whole heart, so that we may be able to receive your good things.

text: Oremus et pro perfidis Iudaeis
translation_en: Let us pray for the faithless Jews

text: Fac nos Domine quaesumus mala nostra toto corde respuere ut veniente filio tuo domino nostro bona eius capere valeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we ask you, that with our whole heart we may reject our evils, so that when your Son, our Lord, comes, we may be able to receive his good things.

text: Fac nos Domine quaesumus multiplicatis sollemnitatibus iterare quod nobis causam perpetuae salvationis operatur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to repeat amongst us the solemnities that work for our eternal salvation.

text: Oremus fratres carissimi pro spiritu cari ... resuscitari faciat.
translation_en: Let us pray, dearest brothers, that the dear spirit may be made to rise up again.

text: Fac nos Domine quaesumus prompta voluntate subiectos et ad supplicandum tibi nostras semper excita voluntates.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you, make us willing subjects with prompt obedience, and always stir up in us a desire to pray to you.

text: Oremus fratres carissimi pro spiritu cari ... deprecantibus nobis.
translation_en: Let us pray, dear brothers, for the dear spirit ... who intercedes on our behalf.

text: Fac nos Domine quaesumus tuis oboedire mandatis quia tunc nobis prospera cuncta provenient si totius vitae sequamur auctorem.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, to obey your commandments for then all prosperous things will come to us if we follow the author of our entire life.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine ad illam tuae claritatis visionem pertingere quam tuis hodie discipulis in monte transfiguratus ostendisti.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, to reach that vision of Thy clarify which Thou didst show to Thine disciples today on the mount when Thou wast transfigured.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine beatarum virginum et martyrum tuarum continuis praesidiis adiuvari pro quarum veneranda recordatione haec dona maiestati tuae dicanda offerimus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you Lord, with the continual aid of your blessed virgins and martyrs, to be helped on behalf of whose revered memory these gifts are offered to your majesty.

text: Oremus praeceptis salutaribus
translation_en: Let us pray with salutary precepts

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine beati confessoris tui Benedicti digne sollemnia praevenire qui largitatis tuae praeventus munere laudabilis vitae cursum glorioso fine conclusit.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask You, Lord, that your blessed confessor Benedict may worthily precede the solemnities, who, being preceded by Your bounty, completed his praiseworthy life with a glorious end through the gift of Your providence.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine beati martyris tui Georgii sollemnitatem multipliciter celebrare ut de tanto agonis certamine discat populus christianus et firmam solidare patientiam et pie exsultare de eius victoria.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Lord, that the solemnity of your blessed martyr George may be celebrated in many ways, so that the Christian people may learn from such great struggle, firm and steadfast patience, and piously rejoice in his victory.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine Deus hoc desiderio perfrui ut a tuo lumine inflammemur ut remotis culparum nostrarum tenebris per haec sancta sumpta sacrificia in conspectu claritatis tuae fulgere possimus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord God, with this desire that we may be inflamed by Your light, so that removing the shadows of our sins, we may shine through these holy sacrifices in Your presence.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine divinitatis tuae sempiterna fruitione repleri quam pretiosi corporis et sanguinis tui temporalis perceptio praefigurat.
translation_en: Fill us, we ask you Lord, with the eternal enjoyment of your divinity which is foreshadowed by the temporary perception of your precious body and blood.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine mala nostrae mentis sinceriter confiteri qui beati Bartholomaei iussu daemonem fecisti suam nequitiam manifestare ut patefactis nostris reatibus clementiam tuam per eius preces citius adipisci valeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, that our evil thoughts may truly confess, whom the command of blessed Bartholomew made the demon reveal his wickedness to manifest, so that through his intercessions we may more quickly obtain your clemency because of our uncovered sins.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine Deus noster in tua devotione gaudere quia perpetua est et plena felicitas si bonorum omnium serviamus auctori.
translation_en: Make us, we ask you Lord our God, rejoice in your devotion because happiness is eternal and full if we serve the author of all good things.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine Deus noster pervigiles atque sollicitos adventum exspectare Christi Filii tui Domini nostri ut dum venerit pulsans non dormientes peccatis sed vigilantes et in suis inveniat laudibus exsultantes.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord our God, to be watchful and diligent in waiting for the coming of your Son, our Lord Christ, that while he comes knocking, we may not be sleeping in sin but awake and watchful, and finding him in our praises, let us rejoice.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine his muneribus offerendis convenienter aptari quibus ipsius venerabilis sacramenti venturum celebramus exordium.
translation_en: Make us, we pray, Lord, fit for these duties with which we are about to begin offering them, as we celebrate the beginning of your venerable sacrament.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine interveniente beato Barnaba apostolo tuo ab imminentibus praesentis vitae periculis respirare et ad aeternae felicitatis beatitudinem pervenire.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, with the intervention of Your apostle blessed Barnabas, that we may breathe freely from the imminent dangers of this life and arrive at the happiness of eternal beatitude.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine beati Leufredi confessoris tui atque abbatis intercessionibus a cunctis mundi perturbationibus respirare eiusque obtentu tam praesentis vitae subsidia quam aeternae beatitudinis praemia reperire.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, through the intercession of your blessed confessor and abbot Saint Leufred, to breathe in the midst of all the world's disturbances, and by his intervention to find both the support for this present life and the rewards of eternal beatitude.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine omnium sanctorum atque sanctarum documenta in omnibus imitari et <eos> nos ubique tueri ut quorum laudes frequentamus in terris eorum precibus adiuvemur iri caelis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, that we may imitate the examples of all saints and sanctas everywhere, and that we may be protected by them always, so that we who frequent their praises on earth, may be aided in reaching heaven through their intercessions.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine quae sunt recta sectari integritatem conscientiae diligere semper et famae.
translation_en: Make us, we ask you Lord, pursue what is right; seek integrity in consciousness, and always love, and esteem good reputation.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine salutis nostrae causas et devotis semper frequentare servitiis et devotius recolere principaliter inchoatas.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that the causes of our salvation may always be frequented by devoted services and may especially remember to recall those initially begun.

text: Fac nos quaesumus Domine sanctorum tuorum semper festa sectari quorum suffragiis protectionis tuae dona sentimus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, that we may always follow the festivals of Your saints, whose intercessions we feel the benefits of Your protection.

text: Fac omnipotens Deus ut quae veraciter facta recurrimus in nostrum transire remedium gratulemur.
translation_en: We thank the almighty God that what truly happened may pass into our relief.

text: Fac omnipotens Deus ut qui paschalibus remediis innovati similitudinem terreni parentis evasimus ad formam caelestis transferamur auctoris.
translation_en: May the almighty God make us so that, being renewed by the Paschal remedies, we may escape the likeness of the earthly father and be transformed into the form of the heavenly author.

text: Fac omnipotens Deus ut venerabilis Leodegarius sacerdos et martyr et sacris nos exerceat institutis et pia semper efficiat confessione constantes.
translation_en: May the almighty God make the venerable Leodegar, priest and martyr, exercise us with his sacred institutions and always make us constant in our pious confession.

text: Fac omnipotens et misericors Deus ut quod octavarum dierum resurrectionis tuae paschalibus celebramus officiis fructiferum nobis omni tempore sentiamus.
translation_en: May the almighty and merciful God make it so that what we celebrate with solemnities during the octave of your resurrection, we may always feel the fruitful effects of it throughout all time.

text: Fac quaesumus Domine Deus noster intercedente beato martyre tuo illo populum tuum in tua devotione gaudere quia perpetua est et plena felicitas si bonorum omnium serviant auctori.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, through the intercession of your blessed martyr, let your people rejoice in your devotion, for they are forever enjoying and fully happy if they serve the author of all good things.

text: Pater noster qui es in caelis
translation_en: Our Father who art in heaven

text: Fac quaesumus Domine famulos tuos toto semper ad te corde concurrere tibi subdita mente servire tuam misericordiam suppliciter implorare et tuis iugiter beneficiis gratulari.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, make your servants always strive towards you with all their hearts, be subject to you in mind and serve you humbly. We implore your mercy in supplication, and we are always grateful for your blessings.

text: Fac quaesumus Domine famulos tuos toto corde semper ad te concurrere et tibi subdita mente servire tuamque misericordiam suppliciter implorare et tuis iugiter beneficiis gratulari.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, may your servants always rush to you with wholeheartedness and serve you with a submissive mind. May we continually implore your mercy and rejoice in your constant blessings.

text: Fac quaesumus Domine hanc cum servo tuo misericordiam ut factorum suorum in poenis non recipiat vicem qui tuam in votis tenuit voluntatem ut sicut hic eum vera fides iunxit fidelium turmis ita eum illic tua miseratio societ angelicis choris.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, Your mercy towards this Your servant, that he who has fulfilled his duties in penances may not receive the penalty of those who held Your will in vows. May it be so, as here true faith has united him with the ranks of the faithful, so let Your mercy associate him with the angelic choirs.

text: Facientes commemorationem passionis et mortis et resurrectionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui precamur omnipotens Pater ut has hostias sancto altario tuo superpositas intendas propitius sanctifices et benedicas ac sumentibus ad salutem pertingere concedas.
translation_en: We make remembrance of the passion, death and resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son. We humbly pray to you, almighty Father, that you may graciously regard these offerings placed upon your holy altar, sanctify them, bless them, and grant that those who partake of them for their salvation may receive them.

text: Pax domini sit semper vobiscum.
translation_en: The peace of the Lord be always with you.

text: Facimus Domine commemorationem Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui qui nos morte sua redemit et resurrectione erexit quique hodie ad discipulos ianuis clausis intravit et uni eorum hesitanti corporea adtrectatione se palpandum exhibuit. Unde per ipsum te Deus pater exposcimus ut illo spiritu haec oblata sanctifices quo olim in discipulos insufflasti credentes sicque nos participatione hostiae huius percipiamus meritum sanctitatis sicut illi te insufflante adepti sunt verbum praedicationis.
translation_en: We make, Lord, the commemoration of our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who redeemed us with His own death and raised us up with His resurrection. He today entered through closed doors to the disciples, and showed Himself in bodily fashion to one hesitant among them by touching him. Therefore, through Him we humbly beseech You, God the Father, that by His Spirit you may sanctify these offerings; just as You once filled believers with Your breath, so may we partake of the merit of this sacrifice by participation. As those who were made perfect by You inspiring them with the word of preaching.

text: Pax domini ... miserere nobis
translation_en: The peace of the Lord... have mercy on us

text: Facimus Domine Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi commemorationem  quod veniens ad homines humanam formam assumpsit;  quod pro hominibus quos creaverat redimendis passionem crucis est pro hominum salute perpessus;  quod superaturus atque conculcaturus debitam mortem nostram mortem ultro suscepit pro nobis ipse indebitam;  quod infernum ex parte exspoliavit relinquendo impios 1et sanctos qui ibidem tenebantur resurgens secum in caelestibus sublevando;  quod rediens ad caelum viam nobis patefecit per quam conscendamus in caelum;  quod venturus sit iterum ad iudicium vivorum et mortuorum sceleratos et peccatores aeterno supplicio damnaturus suisque fidelibus sua praecepta servantibus aeternitatis suae gloriam collaturus.  Per ipsum te ergo summe pater exposcimus ut hanc tuae placationis hostiam quam tibi offerimus e manibus nostris placatus accipias eamque de caelica sede placato vultu respiciens benedicas ut quotquot ex eius sumptu libaverimus salubritatem ac remedium animae et corporis hauriamus.
translation_en: We make, Lord, the commemoration of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, who, coming in human form among men, suffered the Passion of the Cross for the redemption of mankind; who willingly took upon himself the debt of our mortal death, an undeserved punishment for us; who disarmed and conquered death by dying a death of his own accord; who disrobed Hell, leaving the unrighteous there and raising with him the righteous who were held captive there; who opened to us the way back to heaven that we may ascend to heaven; who will come again to judge the living and the dead, condemning the wicked and sinners to eternal punishment, while rewarding his faithful followers with the glory of his eternity. Through him, Supreme Father, we entreat you to receive this sacrifice of appeasement which we offer to you from our hands, placated by your gracious gaze, and to bless it so that we may draw upon the health and remedy for soul and body from the riches of your offering.

text: Facimus Domine Iesu Christe quod praecepisti tuumque sequimur de huius sacrificii oblatione iudicium. Praesta benignus ac clemens ut intellegere ac sentire possimus illud passionis tuae pro nostra salute mysterium.
translation_en: We make, Lord Jesus Christ, as you commanded, and we follow your example in the offering of this sacrifice. Graciously and mercifully grant that we may understand and feel the mystery of your passion for our salvation.

text: Facito nos omnipotens Deus ut carnali devicta concupiscentia veraciter gloriemur in cruce tua; per illam et viventium probra et defunctorum abdicentur exitia; per eam acceptentur oblationes fidelium; per eam confusa ad Christum redeat infidelitas perfidorum quo nos qui te resurrexisse fideliter credimus ita ex nostris tibi actibus placeamus ut per hoc sacrificium placabilem te nobis ostendas et viventibus pacem et sepultis optatam conferas mansionem.
translation_en: Make us, Almighty God, that we may truly glory in your cross, having conquered our carnal desires; through it and the shame of the living and the departed, let the torments be abandoned; through it let the offerings of the faithful be accepted; through it let unfaithfulness be confused to Christ, so that we who believe faithfully in you having risen may please you from our deeds; through this sacrifice, show us a pleasing you and grant peace to the living, and the desired dwelling place to the dead.

text: Facta Domine commemoratione martyrum tuorum Cosmae et Damiani qui pro te nervis caesi marinis fluctibus dediti flammis iniecti eculeo impositi cruci affixi et invicti per passionem et triumphatores exstiterunt per mortem te votis supplicibus imploramus ut in hoc eorum venerabili festo oblatas tibi victimas sereno vultu respicias sumentibusque ex eis Sancti Spiritus lumen infundas quo in hoc die passionis sit populo fideli spiritalis laetitia et gaudia tribuantur aeterna.
translation_en: Lord, on the commemoration of your martyrs Cosmas and Damian, who for you were cut off by nerves in the stormy seas, thrown into flames, put on the rack, nailed to the cross, and remained unconquered through their passion and conquerors through death. We implore you through their fervent vows that on this day of their venerable feast, looking upon the offerings made to you with a serene countenance, you may pour out the light of the Holy Spirit upon them, so that spiritual joy and rejoicing may be bestowed upon the faithful people on this day of their passion. Amen.

text: Familia tua Deus et ad celebranda principia suae re1demptionis desideranter occurrat et eius dona perseveranter acquriat.
translation_en: Your family, God, eagerly approaches to celebrate the beginnings of its redemption and persistently acquires its gifts.

text: Familiae tuae Domine preces miseratus intende et toto t;ibi corde subiectam prosequere sustenta circumtege ut quae te gubernatore confidit et nullis implicetur malis et bonis omnibus expleatur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your family. Turn your attention to them and follow through with them, sustain and surround them. May they, who trust in you as their governor, not be entangled in any evil, but may all good things be fulfilled for them.

text: Familiae tuae Domine quaesumus esto protector et misericordiam tuam concede poscenti quae tibi semper fiat oboediens et tua dona percipiat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your family may be a protector and grant mercy to those who ask, who are always obedient to you and receive your gifts.

text: Familiae tuae quaesumus Domine absolve peccata mentesque purifica ut venerabilis ieiunii dies congrua devotione repetentes quae fideliter poscimus impetrare mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to forgive the sins of your family and to purify their minds, so that on the honorable day of fasting they may repeat with fitting devotion what we faithfully ask, so that we may deserve to have it granted.

text: Per ipsum et cum ipso
translation_en: Through Him and with Him

text: Familiam huius sacri coenobii quaesumus Domine intercedente beato illo perpetuo guberna moderamine ut adsit nobis et in securitate cautela et inter aspera fortitudo.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with the intervention of that blessed one, may you govern this family of this holy monastery perpetually with a steady hand, so that they may be with us in safety, watchful and steadfast amidst trials.

text: Per omnia saecula ...
translation_en: Through all ages...

text: Familiam tuam Deus suavitas illa contingat et vegetet qua in martyre tuo Gorgonio Christi tui bono iugiter odore pascatur.
translation_en: May your family, God, be touched and nourished by that sweetness, and may they always graze on the good fragrance of your martyr Gorgoion, Christ's.

text: Familiam tuam Domine beati Birini episcopi translationem celebrantem tua circumda misericordia ut et secura tibi deserviat et eius suffragiis vera apprehendat gaudia.
translation_en: Lord, envelop your family of the blessed Bishop Birinus during the celebration of their translation (funeral mass) with your mercy. May they serve you securely and truly grasp joy through his intercessions.

text: Familiam tuam Domine benignus illustra et benedictionis tuae largitate confirma ut te in omnibus ducem te mereatur habere custodem.
translation_en: Lord, with your benevolent grace enlighten your family and confirm them with the abundance of your blessings, so that they may deserve to have you as their leader and guardian.

text: Familiam tuam Domine dextera tua perpetuo circumdet auxilio et ab omni pravitate defensam donis caelestibus prosequatur bonam faciat et ad bonorum praemia gratiae suae largitate perducat.
translation_en: May your family, Lord, be ever surrounded by your right hand with perpetual aid. May it be defended from all wickedness, pursued by celestial gifts to do good, and led to the rewards of goodness through your grace's generosity.

text: Familiam tuam Domine dextera tua perpetuo circumdet auxilio ut ab omni pravitate defensam donis caelestibus prosequatur.
translation_en: May your family, Lord, be continually protected by your right hand with the aid, so that they may pursue defense from every wickedness with celestial gifts.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine dextera tua perpetuo circumdet auxilio ut paschali interveniente sollemnitate ab omni pravitate defensam donis caelestibus prosequatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your right hand may forever protect your family with the aid of your help, so that during the solemnity of the paschal intervention, it may be defended from every wickedness by heavenly gifts and follow after.

text: Familiam tuam Domine pervigili protectione conserva et perpetuis defende praesidiis ut omni semper inordinatione seclusa tua iugiter providentia dirigatur.
translation_en: Lord, keep your family under the vigilant protection and defend them with eternal guardianship, so that they may always be free from disorder, and may be continually guided by your providence.

text: Familiam tuam Domine propitiata maiestate circumspice ut nec suis infecta sit vitiis nec externis obligata peccatis sed ab utrisque libera tibi semper et purgata deserviat.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your family. Look upon them with your majesty, so that they may not be corrupted by their own vices nor bound by external sins. Rather, always and continually free them from both, and may they serve you purified.

text: Familiam tuam Domine propitius intuere et apostolicis defende praesidiis ut eorum precibus gubernetur quibus nititur te constituente principibus.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your family and defend them with apostolic protections, so that they may be governed by your prayers, whom you establish as rulers.

text: Familiam tuam Domine quam per paschalia festa laetificas his quoque sacrificiis a cunctis defende periculis.
translation_en: Lord, protect your family from all dangers by these sacrificial feasts that you make joyful with Easter.

text: Familiam tuam Domine propitius respice et intercedente Beato Petro apostolo tuo a cunctis eam adversitatibus defende.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your family and through the intercession of Blessed Peter, your apostle, protect them from all adversities.

text: Familiam tuam Domine supplicantem oculis tuae miserationis intende ut quae te inspirante deposcit sanctorum martyrum patrocinio consequatur.
translation_en: Lord, direct your eyes of mercy towards Your supplicating family, so that what they humbly seek, inspired by You, may attain through the patronage of the holy martyrs.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine supplicantem propitius respice ut quae te inspirante deposcit beatorum martyrum Donati et Carpofori patrociniis consequatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look favorably upon your family, that they who are supplicating may obtain through the intercession of the blessed martyrs Donatus and Carpophorus what they are seeking with your inspiration.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine beatae virginis tuae Scholasticae meritis propitius respice ut sicut ipsius precibus ad obtinendum quod cupivit imbrem caelitus descendere fecisti ita eius supplicationibus ariditatem nostri cordis supernae digneris gratiae rore perfundere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, of your blessed virgin Scholastica, that you, through her merits, look favorably upon us, so that just as you made the rain descend from heaven in response to her prayers for what she desired, likewise you would deign to pour down the rain of your grace upon our dry hearts through her supplications.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine caelesti protectione circumda ut te parcente sit libera te custodiente a malis omnibus sit secura.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to surround your family with heavenly protection, so that while they are protected by you, they may be free and safe from all evil.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine continua pietate custodi ut a cunctis adversitatibus te protegente sit libera et in bonis actibus tuo nomini sit devota.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to continue to protect your family with eternal love, that it may be free from all adversities while being protected by you, and devoted to your name in good deeds.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine continua pietate custodi ut quae in sola spe gratiae caelestis innititur tua semper protectione muniatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your family may be continually protected by your grace, so that those who are anchored only in the hope of celestial grace may always be fortified by your constant protection.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine continua pietate custodi ut quae in sola spe gratiae caelestis innititur caelesti etiam protectione muniatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to continue to protect your family with eternal love, so that those who are built up only in the hope of celestial grace may also be fortified by heavenly protection.

text: Familia{m} tua{m} quaesumus Domine copiosa protectionis tuae beneficia consequatur ut quae sacris tibi liminibus devota consistit beatissimi confessoris et antistitis tui Syri suffulta praesidiis supernorum civium mereatur adunari consortiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may your family receive abundant benefits from your protection, so that those who are devoted to the sacred thresholds of your service and the blessed confessor and bishop of Syria, supported by the defenses of the heavenly citizens, may deserve to be united in fellowship.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine propitiatus illustra ut beneplacitis inhaerendo cuncta quae bona sunt mereatur accipere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you, being gracious, shine upon your family, so that by pleasing you, they may deserve to receive all that is good.

text: Familiam tuam quaesumus Domine quam sacrosancti corporis et sanguinis tui participatione recreasti solita respice pietate quatenus sancti praesulis Romani precibus fulta continuis et a terrenis saeculi huius liberetur incommodis et aetheriis redimatur incrementis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that just as you have refreshed your family with the usual participation of the most sacred body and blood. Look upon them with your pity, so that the bishop of Rome, supported by the prayers of the saints, may be freed from the troubles of this worldly age and raised up to heavenly blessings.

text: Famulatus huic nostri sacrificio clementissime Deus quod in commemoratione celeberrimi sacerdotis et martyris tui Apollinaris tripudianter offerimus tuae quaesumus dignanter praesentiam intersere maiestatis ipsius ut meritis et tibi sit acceptabile et nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: Most graciously God, we humbly serve you with this sacrifice, which in the commemoration of your most renowned priest and martyr Apollinaris, we joyfully offer. We humbly ask that you worthy grant your presence among his majesty, so that it may be acceptable to you because of his merits, and may it profit us by forgiveness.

text: Famuli tui Domine qui ad tuam sunt gratiam vocati tuo indesinenter protegantur auxilio ut qui divino sunt baptismo regenerati numquam a tui regni potentia possint evelli.
translation_en: May your servants, Lord, who have been called to your grace, be unceasingly protected by your help, so that those who have been regenerated by divine baptism may never be able to be uprooted from the power of your kingdom.

text: Famuli tui indigni et exigui sacerdotes tremendae maiestatis tuae spiritales victimas immolantes offerimus tibi Deus hostiam immaculatam quam maternus uterus impolluta virginitate produxit pudor edidit sanctificatio genuit integritas fudit; hostia quae immolata vivit et vivens iugiter immolatur; hostia quae sola Deum placare praevalet quia Deus est.  Hanc tibi summe pater offerimus pro sancta Ecclesia tua pro satisfactione saeculi delinquentis pro emundatione animarum nostrarum pro sanitate omnium infirmorum ac requie vel indulgentia fidelium defunctorum ut mutata sorte tristium mansionum felici perfruamur societate iustorum.
translation_en:
We, your unworthy and lowly spiritual priests, offer you, God, an immaculate sacrifice. This sacrifice was brought forth by the chaste womb of the mother, clothed in purity, conceived by modesty, born by sanctification, nurtured by integrity, poured out as a gift. This sacrifice, once offered, lives and continuously offers itself; it alone is capable of appeasing God because God is.
We offer this sacrifice to you, most high Father, on behalf of your holy Church, for the expiation of the sinful world, for the cleansing of our souls, for the health of all the sick, and for the rest or indulgence of the faithful departed. May we, who have been changed by fate to dwell in sorrow, enjoy a happy fellowship with the just, when we are reunited.

text: Famulis tuis Domine caelestis gratiae munus impertire ut quibus beatae virginis partus exstitit salutis exordium nativitatis eius votiva sollemnitas pacis tribuat incrementum.
translation_en: Lord of heavenly grace, bestow your gift upon your servants, that the beginning of salvation which the birth of the blessed Virgin brought about may grant them an increase through the solemnity dedicated to her nativity and peace.

text: Famulis tuis illis quaesumus Domine oratio proficiat supplicantium ut eos et a peccatis exuas et tuae redemptionis consortes efficias.
translation_en: To those your servants, we humbly beseech you, Lord. May their prayer be profitable, that you may remove them from sins and make them partakers of your redemption.

text: Famulis tuis omnipotens Deus gratiam benigna pietate largire ut salutaribus ieiuniis eruditi a noxiis vitiis abstinentes tuam quam poscimus misericordiam impetremus.
translation_en: O almighty God, in Your benevolent pity, bestow grace upon Your servants, that the learned ones who fast are purified from harmful vices. May we implore Your mercy as we humbly ask for it.

text: Famulis tuis quaesumus Domine sperata concede et ab omnibus eos culpis excusa.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you grant what is hoped for to your servants, and absolve them from all their sins.

text: Famulorum tuorum Domine delictis ignosce ut qui placere de actibus nostris non valemus genitricis Filii tui Domini Dei nostri intercessione salvemur.
translation_en: Lord, forgive the sins of your servants, so that we, who cannot please you through our actions, may be saved by the intercession of the Mother of your Son, our Lord.

text: Famulorum tuorum Domine munus tibi reddatur acceptum et offerentibus illud proveniat salutare sancti illius confessoris tui intercessione.
translation_en: Lord, may the duty of your servants be presented to you and accepted, and through their offering may it bring a saving grace through the intercession of your holy confessor.

text: Famulos et famulas Domine quaesumus intuere quibus in te sperare donasti ac pariter eis et quae tibi placeant postulare et propitius postulata concede.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you watch over your servants, both men and women, to whom you have given hope in you. And grant them also to ask for what pleases you, and may you graciously grant their requests.

text: Famulos et famulas tuas Domine caelesti visitatione circumda mentibus eorum atque corporibus ros tuae benedictionis infunde ut sacris sollemnitatibus convenienter aptati et sanctificationis gratiam referant et quae pie precantur obtineant.
translation_en: Lord, envelop the minds and bodies of your servants, both men and women, with your heavenly visitation. Pour upon them the roses of your blessed benediction, that they may fittingly participate in sacred solemnities, return the grace of sanctification, and obtain what they piously pray for.

text: Famulos et famulas tuas quaesumus Domine propitius intuere ut ea semper cupiant quae tibi placita et ea semper quae sunt eis salubria consequantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look kindly upon your servants, so that they may always desire what pleases you and always follow what is healthful for them.

text: Famulos tuos quaesumus Domine benignus intende et eis dignanter pietatis tuae impende custodiam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, be gracious and pay attention to your servants, and grant them a worthy protection of your pity.

text: Pio recordationis affectu fratres carissimi ... benignitate sua compensit.
translation_en: With a devout feeling of remembrance, my dearest brothers, he compensates for by his kindness.

text: Famulos tuos quaesumus Domine placatus intende pariterque eos et a peccatis absolve propitius et a cunctis eripe benignus adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you turn your favorable attention towards your servants, and at the same time both cleanse them from their sins and absolve them graciously. May you be merciful and free them from all adversities.

text: Pio recordationis affectu fratres carissimi ... deleat et abstergat.
translation_en: With a pious feeling, dear brothers, may he wipe away and cleanse.

text: Famulos tuos quaesumus Domine pro tui nominis amore persecutionem et iniuriam patientes misericorditer respice et ab inimicorum iniuriis clementer erue eosque hic et in perpetuum salva semper et protege.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your servants endure persecution and insults out of love for your name. Look upon them mercifully and deliver them graciously from the wrongdoings of their enemies. Here and forevermore save and protect them.

text: Pisteuo his ena Theon
translation_en: I believe in one God

text: Famulos tuos quaesumus Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum beata merita prosequamur et sua semper faciant caritate ferventes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to follow your servants with the blessed merits of your holy martyrs, and may they always act fervently with burning charity.

text: Famulos tuos quaesumus Domine tua semper gratia benedicat et inculpabiles ad vitam perducat aeternam.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your servants may always be blessed with your grace and led without fault to eternal life.

text: Famulum tuum Domine illum haec tueantur ubique gradientem oblata sacrificia quae totius mundi interna virtute compescuere naufragia.
translation_en: Lord, may your servant be protected everywhere he steps, by the offerings presented. May these sacrifices, which internally with their universal power have averted shipwrecks of the world.

text: Famulum tuum illum et omnes sibi commissos per haec caelestia munera perpetuo Domine comitare praesidio eosque fovere non desinens dignos fieri sempiterna redemptione concede.
translation_en: Lord, accompany your servant and all those committed to his care through these celestial gifts with a perpetual guardianship. Never cease to make them worthy of eternal redemption.

text: Famulum tuum illum quaesumus Domine ab omnibus absolve peccatis et qui membrorum iam caret officio numquam tuae miserationis destituatur auxilio.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to forgive Your servant from all sins, and may he who is already lacking in body's function never be deprived of Your aid.

text: Famulum tuum illum quaesumus Domine caelesti semper protectione circumda ut te protegente a cunctis adversitatibus liber et te custodiente a malis omnibus sit securus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to always enwrap your servant with heavenly protection, so that, protected by you, he may be free from all adversities and safe from all evils.

text: Famulum tuum quaesumus Domine tua semper protectione custodi ut libera tibi mente deserviat et te protegente a malis omnibus sit securus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to always protect your servant, that he may serve you with a free mind and be secure under your protection from all evils.

text: Fatemur indigni famuli tui tuum donum Domine Deus noster quod Ecclesia tua gaudiis spiritalibus perfruatur ut omnium tuorum electo numero filiorum felicem te in illis matrem esse noveris quem patrem semper habere promeruit.
translation_en: We confess ourselves unworthy servants, Lord God our Master, your gift that your Church rejoices spiritually, may it be known by all of yours chosen number, that they recognize you as a blessed mother in them; one whom they have always promised to have for a father.

text: Fave Deus famuli tui illius fidelissimis votis et eum ab omnibus absterge delictis quo huius sacrificii oblatione placatus et illius pro quo te poscimus vota acceptes et defunctos fideles in pace refrigeres.
translation_en: Favor, O God, thy servant, that man most faithful in his vows, and cleanse him from all sins by this offering of sacrifice; receive the vows made for him, and refresh the departed faithful in peace.

text: Festina ne tardaveris Domine Deus noster et a diabolico furore nos potenter libera.
translation_en: Hasten, lest you tarry, O Lord our God, and powerfully deliver us from the devilish madness.

text: Festina quaesumus ne tardaveris Domine et praesidium nobis tuae pietatis impende ut opportunis consolationibus subleventur qui in tua miseratione confidunt.
translation_en: Hasten, we ask Thee, O Lord, let not Thy delay come upon us; may Thy protection of mercy descend upon us, that those who trust in Thy mercy may be uplifted by timely consolations.

text: Festina quaesumus ne tardaveris Domine et auxilium nobis supernae virtutis impende ut adventus tui consolationibus subleventur qui in tua pietate confidunt.
translation_en: Hasten, we beseech you, lest you delay, Lord, and let down upon us the aid of your heavenly powers, so that those who trust in your mercy may be uplifted by the consolations of your coming.

text: Festina quaesumus Domine ne tardaveris ut et peccata nostra deleas et quae nobis sunt adversa depellas.
translation_en: Hasten, we implore You, Lord, that You may not delay in removing our sins and driving away what is against us.

text: Festinantes omnipotens Deus in occursum Filii tui Domini nostri nulla impediant opera actus terreni sed caelestis sapientiae eruditio faciat nos eius esse consortes.
translation_en: Almighty God, eager for the coming of Your Son, our Lord, let no earthly work or action hinder us but may celestial wisdom make us His companions.

text: Fiant Domine tuo grata conspectui munera supplicantis ecclesiae et ut nostrae saluti proficiant adsit intercessio beata sanctorum.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings of the supplicating church be pleasing to your sight, and may the intercession of the blessed saints profit for our salvation.

text: Fiant Domine tuo grata conspectui munera supplicantis ecclesiae et ut nostrae proficiant saluti adsit intercessio beatorum sanctorum tuorum.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings of the supplicating church be pleasing to your sight, and may our salvation prosper with the intervention of your blessed saints.

text: Fiant Domine grata tuo conspectui munera supplicantis Ecclesiae tuae et ut nostrae salutis remedio proficiant beatae virginis tuae Scholasticae adsit intercessio veneranda.
translation_en: Lord, may the gifts of your church be pleasing to your sight, and may the remedy of our salvation profit from the intercession of your blessed Virgin, Scholastica.

text: Fiant Domine tuo grata conspectui munera supplicantis ecclesiae et ut nostrae saluti proficiant adsit intercessio beatae tuae martyris Agathae.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings of the supplicating church be pleasing to your sight, and may the intercession of your blessed martyr Agatha profit for our salvation.

text: Fiant nobis Domine quaesumus sumpta libamina intercedente beato consessore tuo Satyro perpetuae salutis commercium quae illi inter aequoreas undas facta sunt infatigabile liberationis suae praesidium.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, prepared libamina in the presence of your blessed companion Satyros, for an unending trade of eternal salvation, which were made for him among the wave-filled seas, a tireless protection of his liberation.

text: Fiat Domine quaesumus hostia sacranda placabilis pretiosi celebritate martyrii quae et corda nostra purificet et tuorum tibi vota conciliet.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you make our offering acceptable, through the glorious dignity of martyrdom, which may purify our hearts and bring together the vows of your faithful.

text: Fiat Domine quaesumus hostia sacranda placabilis pretiosi celebritate martyrii quae et peccata nostra purificet et tuorum tibi vota conciliet famulorum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that this offering be made acceptable to you with the splendor of precious martyrdom, which may purify our sins and unite the prayers of your servants with your will.

text: Fiat Domine quaesumus hostia sacranda placabilis pretiosi celebritate tui martyris Nazarii quae et peccata nostra purificet et tuorum tibi vota conciliet famulorum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offering be made pleasing to you through your precious presence, the martyr Nazarene's sacrificial host. May it purify our sins and bring together the vows of your servants.

text: Fiat tua gratia Domine fructuosus nostrae devotionis affectus quia tunc nobis proderunt suscepta ieiunia si tuae sint placita pietati.
translation_en: May your grace, Lord, be fruitful to our devotions' affections, for then our fasting will prove beneficial to us if your wishes are pleasing to piety.

text: Fiat quaesumus Domine per gratiam tuam fructuosus nostrae devotionis affectus quia tunc nobis proderunt suscepta ieiunia si tuae sint placita pietati.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, through Thy grace, that our affection for devotion may be fruitful; because then our fasting will profit us if they are pleasing to piety according to Thy will.

text: Fidei nostrae omnipotens Deus crescit augmentum si sedulum ieiuniorum nostrorum tuae maiestati solvimus votum ac per hoc pervenire poterimus ad tuae claritatis occursum si pacifici semper manentes a nobis custodita fuerit parsimonia ieiuniorum quibus opprimuntur et tollentur omnia pondera vitiorum. Pacem itaque perfectam nobis omnibus benignus concede ut qua tui iam sancti fruuntur in caelis nos quoque meditemur iugiter in terris.
translation_en: Our almighty God, who grows the strength of our faith, increases when we fulfill the vow to your majesty from the diligence and fasting of our servants. In this way, we may approach your radiance. If we always maintain peace among ourselves and guard the frugality of our fasting, which oppresses and will be lifted from those who are burdened by sins. Therefore, graciously bestow upon us all a perfect peace, so that those who already enjoy your sanctity in heaven may also motivate us to strive for it on earth.

text: Fidelem famulum tuum illum coniugem liberos et plebem sibi subiectam quaesumus Domine potentiae tuae muniat invicta defensio ut pio semper tibi devotus exsistens affectu et ab infestis liberetur inimicis et a tua misericordia salutem consequatur mentis et corporis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord of might, to protect Your faithful servant, his spouse, children, and subjects under him. May an invincible defense shield him so that he may always exist devoted to you with affection, and be freed from harmful enemies, and attain salvation of mind and body from your mercy.

text: Fidelem populum quaesumus Domine potentiae tuae muniat invicta defensio sanctumque sibi caelesti dispensatione perficiat ut pio tibi semper devotus affectu et ab infestis liberetur inimicis et in tua iugiter gratia perseveret.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may your almighty power shield the faithful people with an invincible defense and complete them through celestial dispensation, so that they remain forever devoted to you with a pious affection and be freed from their hostile enemies and always persevere in your grace.

text: Fideles tui Deus caelestis doni remediis recreentur et sanctorum quoque consessorum tuorum precibus ab omnibus quaesumus emundentur delictis.
translation_en: May your faithful, O God of the heavens, be restored by your remedies and through the prayers of your saints we humbly ask to be cleansed from all sins.

text: Fideles tui Deus per tua dona firmentur ut eadem et percipiendo requirant et quaerendo sine fine percipiant.
translation_en: Your faithful God, by your gifts may they be strengthened, so that they seek and request the same thing persistently, and may they perceive it without end through seeking.

text: Fideles tuos Domine benedictio desiderata confirmet quae eos et a tua voluntate numquam faciat discrepare et tuis semper indulgeat beneficiis gratulari.
translation_en: May your blessing, Lord, confirm the desire of your faithful ones, that they may never depart from your will and always rejoice in your blessings.

text: Fideles tuos Domine quaesumus corpore pariter et mente purifica ut tua inspiratione compuncti noxias delectationes vitare praevaleant atque ut earum non capiantur illecebris tua semper suavitate pascantur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you purify your faithful both in body and mind, so that they may avoid harmful pleasures through your inspiration. May they not be ensnared by their allurements, but may they always be nourished by your sweetness.

text: Fideles tuos quaesumus Domine intercedente beata Maria semper virgine corpore pariter et mente purifica ut tua inspiratione compuncti noxias delectationes vitare valeant et ut earum non capiamur illecebris tua iugiter pascamur dulcedine.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, with the intercession of the blessed Mary, ever-virgin, that we may be purified both in body and mind by your inspiration. May we be able to avoid harmful pleasures through your compassion, and may we not be ensnared by their allure. May we be continually nourished by your sweetness.

text: Fideles tuos Domine quaesumus corpore pariter et mente purifica ut tua inspiratione compuncti noxias delectationes vitare praevaleant.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you purify your faithful both in body and mind, so that they may avoid harmful pleasures through your guidance.

text: Famulum tuum illum quaesumus Domine corpore pariter et mente purifica ut tua inspiratione compunctus noxias delectationes vitare praevaleat.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to cleanse your servant, both in body and mind, so that moved by your inspiration, he may overcome unwholesome pleasures.

text: Fideles tuos quaesumus Domine benignus intende ut suae redemptionis initia recolentes quorum munere sunt refecti eorum proficiant incrementis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you, in your kindness, direct your attention towards your faithful. May they remember the beginning of their redemption, for whom they have been refreshed, and may they progress by increments.

text: Fideli populo Domine misericordiam tuam placatus impende et praesidia corporis copiosa tribue supplicanti.
translation_en: Lord, extend your mercy to the faithful people and grant abundant protection to the suppliant for their body.

text: Fidelis Domine in verbis tuis et sancte in omnibus operibus tuis occurre nobis pius sanctorum tuorum Simonis et Iudae apostolorum sollemnia celebrantibus et qui illis dedisti potestatem eiciendi daemonia per Spiritum Sanctum tribue nobis ad te semper habere cor mundum et spiritum rectum. Detur abs te viventibus amor iustitiae et defunctis post evasionem erebi sessio beatae vitae. Qui in temporali permanent vita illorum corrigantur doctrinis et qui iam exuti sunt carne illorum meritis mereantur annumerari cum sanctis.
translation_en: Lord, faithful in your words and holy in all your works, approach us, gracious one, with the holy ones of yours, Simon and Jude, apostles, who are celebrating their solemnities. Grant us through your Holy Spirit always to have a clean heart and a right spirit. May love of justice be given for the living, and may blessed life session be given for the dead after the departure from this world. Whoever live in temporal life should be corrected by teachings, and whoever already shed their flesh, their merits may deserve to be numbered among the saints.

text: Fidelium Deus animarum conditor et redemptor famulo tuo cunctorum remissionem tribue peccatorum ut quam semper optavit indulgentiam consequatur.
translation_en: O God, Creator and Redeemer of souls, grant remission of sins to your humble servant, that he may always obtain the indulgence which he ever desired.

text: Fidelium Deus omnium conditor et redemptor animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum remissionem cunctorum tribue peccatorum ut indulgentiam quam semper optaverunt piis supplicationibus consequantur.
translation_en: God, creator and redeemer of all souls, grant to the servants and attendants of yours a remission of all sins, so that they may obtain the indulgence which they have always desired through their pious prayers.

text: Fidelium remunerator animarum praesta quaesumus ut qui beati Eligii confessoris tui atque pontificis festivitatem sollemniter recurrentem exsultantibus animis concinimus eius gloriosissimis precibus hic indulgentiam peccatorum assequi valeamus ut cum angelicis eius suffulti intercessionibus mereamur in regione viventium gaudiis admisceri.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, the rewarder of souls of the faithful, to grant that we may worthily celebrate the festivity of your blessed confessor and bishop, Eligius. May we sing his most glorious praises with exulting hearts, so that we may hereby obtain indulgence for our sins. Through the intercession of his heavenly angels, let us deserve to be admitted to the joys of the living region.

text: Fidelium tuorum Domine quaesumus hostias propitius intuere ut quod oblatum est per obsequium et devotorum vota famulorum tua potius propitiatione firmetur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you look favorably upon the offerings of your faithful ones. May what is offered be strengthened by your obedience and the prayers of your devoted servants through your propitiations.

text: Fidelium tuorum quaesumus Domine vota serenus intende et interventu beati Benedicti cuius depositionis celebramus diem a cunctis nos reatibus absolutos festis concede interesse perpetuis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to hear the prayers of your faithful and direct them serenely. May the intervention of the blessed Benedict, whose day we celebrate as his depositional feast, set us free from all sins. Grant that we may participate in eternal festivities.

text: Fidelium tuorum munera Domine pro sanctorum martyrum sollemnitate propitiatus assume et ut tibi nostra sint grata servitia gratiae tuae largitate concede.
translation_en: Lord, accept the offerings of your faithful on the solemnity of the holy martyrs, and grant that our service may be pleasing to you. By your grace, concede that it may be acceptable.

text: Fons pacis origo dilectionis perfectio caritatis Domine Iesu Christe sincerae pacis osculo cultores tuos consocia et purae caritatis affectu cunctos tibi servientes agglomera ut in hac electi tui festivitate praecelebri ita cunctos vera pax pacatos efficiat ne quempiam amaritudo fellis ad discordiam pertrahat.
translation_en: Fountain of peace, source of love's perfection, Lord Jesus Christ, may your sincere kiss unite the worshipers who seek you, and may all who serve you in the purest love be gathered together. In this festival of your chosen ones, let true peace make everyone pacified, so that no one is drawn by any strife or hatred into discord.

text: Fons pacis origo dulcedinis initium caritatis Christe Deus qui cara duorum parvulorum pectora fratrum Iusti scilicet et Pastoris tota tuae dilectionis implesti amore ut ultra vires viriliter dimicarent qui adhuc laetantis teneritudine agebantur infantiae tribue nobis ut alterno connexi vinculo pacis nullis attemptemur iaculis adversantis quo sic in nobis iustitia Iusti precibus floreat ut Pastoris consolatio se super nos in pace dilatata diffundat.
translation_en: Fountain of peace, source of sweetness, beginning of charity, Christ God, who filled the hearts of the two little brothers, Justus and the Pastor, with love to such an extent that they fought manfully beyond their strength, still being carried along by infantile joy. Grant us that we may be bound by the alternating bond of peace, so that we are not attacked by any darts of adversity. In this way, may the justice of Justus bloom in us, and may the consolation of the Pastor, spread out over us in peace, overflow.

text: Fortis est ut mors dilectio Christe tua quae animam a praesenti separat vita. Hanc in testis tui Babilae pectore nimium exuberasse fatemur qui ad passionem tractus trium puerorum quos nutrierat consortium sitiens maluit unita cum eis pro tuo nomine persecutoris morte mulctari quos salutaribus disciplinis erudiens suae unierat caritati. Proinde quia tu es huius dilectionis largitor te postulamus ut uniti per te in pacis societate connexi exemplo martyrum tuorum et invicem sine crimine vivamus et te ex bonis operibus in aeterna pace laudemus.
translation_en: You are strong, death is the love of Christ your own which separates the soul from present life. We bear witness to this in the breast of Babylas, who, drawn to the passion, chose to be united with the three boys whom he had nourished in a longing for your name, the persecutor, to be punished by death along with them. Since you are the giver of this love, we ask you that being united through you in the society of peace, we may live together without blame and praise you from good works in eternal peace.

text: Fortitudo fidelium Deus et martyrum coronator cuius gratia beatus Victor in diversis cruciatibus sui nominis exstitit auctor concede propitius ipsius orationum suffragiis omnium malignarum temptationum nos esse victores.
translation_en: Strength of the faithful God and coroner of martyrs, whose grace blessed Victor in diverse trials of his name became the author, grant us graciously through his prayers to be victors over all wicked temptations.

text: Foveat nos Domine sanctae martyris Euphemiae iucunda sollemnitas et pietati tuae commendare non desinat.
translation_en: Lord, may the delightful solemnity of the holy martyr Euphemia always present us to Your devotion.

text: Foveat omnipotens Deus caritas tua ieiunantium ariditatem internam ut dono affluamus dilectionis qui tibi afflictae immolamus hostiam carnis.
translation_en: The Almighty God, may His love sustain the fasting ones, alleviate their internal aridity, so that we who offer to You a sacrifice of flesh in our affliction, may be filled with the abundance of Your affection.

text: Fragilitatem nostram quaesumus Domine propitius intuere ut beati Bricii confessoris tui atque pontificis patrociniis foveamur cuius festivitate laetamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look upon our fragility with mercy, so that we may be strengthened by the intercession of your blessed confessor and pope, Bricius, whose feast day we celebrate joyfully.

text: Fragilitatem nostram quaesumus omnipotens Domine perpetuo sustenta munimine et per gloriosa sanctarum virginum merita quarum corpora in praesenti requiescunt aula tribue nobis mundanae lucis prosperitatem et aetheriae beatitudinis recompensationem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty Lord, to perpetually sustain our frailty with protective power and through the merits of the glorious virgins whose bodies now rest in heaven, grant us prosperity in worldly light and compensation for aetherial beatitude.

text: Fraterna nos Domine martyrum tuorum corona laetificet quae et fidei nostrae praebeat incitamenta virtutum et multiplici nos suffragio consoletur.
translation_en: Lord, may the crown of your martyrs cheer us brothers, which also gives incentives to our faith and comforts us abundantly with their numerous intercessions.

text: Frequentata mysteria Domine pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum Abdon et Sennen veneratione devota mente tractamus quibus et praesidium nobis crescat et gaudium.
translation_en: We often ponder the mysteries, Lord, with a devoted mind for your saints Abdon and Senna, may their intercession grow as a protection for us and bring us joy.

text: Frequenti sacramentorum perceptione satiati quaesumus Domine ut quorum honore geminantur salutifera nobis oratione proveniant.
translation_en: Frequently satiated with the reception of the sacraments, we humbly ask You, Lord, that those for whom honor is doubled may bring upon us a salutary prayer.

text: Fundamentum fidei nostrae Deus qui in mentibus sanctis tamquam in excelsis montibus aeternitatis portas iustitia muniente componis concede nobis in te gloriose credere tuumque filium Dominum nostrum ad redemptionem animarum hominem factum praedicabiliter confiteri.
translation_en: The foundation of our faith, God who, like the lofty peaks of eternity's portals, composes justice in holy minds, grant us to gloriously believe in you and confess your Son, our Lord, as the one made for the redemption of souls, clearly proclaimable.

text: Gaudeat Domine plebs fidelis et cum propriae recolit salvationis exordia eius promoveatur augmentis.
translation_en: Let the faithful people rejoice, O Lord, and let them recall the beginnings of their salvation, as they are promoted by increasing blessings.

text: Gaudeat Domine quaesumus plebs tua beneficiis impetratis et cui fiduciam sperandae pietatis indulges optatae misericordiae praesta benignus effectum.
translation_en: We ask, O Lord, that your people rejoice with the effects of blessings granted and that you grant faith in the expected mercy. Bestow the desired effect with your graciousness.

text: Gaudeat Domine quaesumus populus tua semper benedictione confisus et caelestium rerum frequentatione proficiat ut et temporalibus beneficiis adiuvetur et erudiatur aeternis.
translation_en: We ask that Your people, Lord, may always be filled with joy and confident in Your blessing, and through participation in celestial matters, may progress. May they also be helped by temporal benefits and educated by eternal ones.

text: Gaudeat plebs tua omnipotens Deus beati Savini martyris tui atque pontificis annua festa celebrantes et qui digne tibi exhibent famulatum fac etiam aeternae beatitudinis esse participes.
translation_en: Let your people, O almighty God, rejoice in the annual feast of the blessed Savinus, your martyr and bishop, and may those who worthily present themselves as your servants also become participants of eternal beatitude.

text: Gaudio paschalis laetitiae ad quod expleto hoc triduo accedemus tu Deus pater abstinentium vires corrobora et benedictione solita oblatum tibi hoc sacrificium propitiatus sanctifica.
translation_en: With the joy of the Easter paschal we approach, which is completed in these three days, O God, Father, strengthen the strength of those who fast, and with your usual blessing accept this offering brought to you as a propitiation. Sanctify it.
