text: Generosae diei dominicae genitricis inexplicabile sacramentum tanto magis praeconabile quantum est inter homines assumptione virginis singulare apud quem vitae integritas obtinuit filium et mors non invenit par exemplum nec minus ingerens stuporem de transitu quam exsultationem ferens unico beata de partu non solum mirabilis pignore quod fide concepit sed translatione praedicabilis qua migravit speciali trepudio affectu multimodo fideli voto fratres carissimi corde deprecemur attento ut eius adiuti muniamur suffragio quae fecunda virgo beata de partu clara de merito felix praedicatur abscessu obsecrantes misericordiam redemptoris nostri ut circumstantem plebem illuc dignetur introducere quo beatam matrem Mariam famulantibus apostolis transtulit ad honorem.
translation_en: On the noble day of the Sunday, of the inexplicable sacrament of the most blessed Mother, we can proclaim even more, among men, the unique event of the Assumption of the Virgin. For whom life's integrity was maintained, and death found no equal example. It stirs as much awe as it does exultation, bearing a singular blessedness from her departure from this world. Unique in her beatitude, she is praised not only for the miraculous conception of faith, but also for the preachable translation by which she departed, causing special trembling in many ways, to our faithful brethren we humbly beseech you, with attentive hearts, that we may be fortified with her aid and supported by her suffrage. We implore the bountiful Mother Mary, the fruitful virgin who is blessed from birth and praised for her merits, that she may intercede on our behalf so that our Redeemer may deign to introduce the gathered people to that place where he transported his mother, the blessed Mary, among the apostles.

text: Generosae virginis tuae Agathae passionem famosissimam celebrantes petimus ut eius praesidio viventium apud te suscepta oblatio sepultos submoveat a tormento quo sicut praedictae virginis sepulcri cooperimentum immensa restinxit incendia sic patrona eius oratio defunctis adimens flammam aeterna eos refrigerii commoditate sustollat.
translation_en: We, celebrating the renowned passion of your noble virgin Agatha, humbly request that her protection moves those living among you who have been offered as an oblation to rest among you. May her intercession lift them from the torment they are in, just as the fires surrounding the tomb of the predicted virgin were extinguished. May her patronage expand their eternal prayer, so that it uplifts them with the comfort of everlasting refreshment.

text: Genite ingeniti Filius Dei summi qui sacrum illud arcanum pectoris tui dilecto tuo Ioanni apostolo reserasti cum in sinu tuo recubans evangelii sui fluenta ex ipso pectoris tui fonte haurire promeruit tu nos intuere propitius ut per te abdita cognoscamus per te bona quae manifesta sunt impleamus reserans nobis pectoris tui occulta quibus possimus cognoscere et condicionis nostrae infirmitatem et ad tuae divinitatis pervenire cognitionem manifestans de te quid amemus indicans de nobis quid corrigamus.  Quo huius dilecti tui suffragiis moribus nostris in melius commutatis aufugiat pestis dispereat languor pellatur hostilis mucro; quidquid adversum est fidei christianae intereat; quidquid prosperum est convalescat; arceatur fames sedentur lites haeresum obstrudantur fautores; fecundetur frugibus terra vestiatur virtutibus anima atque cuncta nobis in commune proveniant bona quo tibi domino fideliter servientes et hic sine peccato utamur concessis et post deliciis fruamur aeternae possessionis.
translation_en:
The unborn Son of the supreme God, who revealed that sacred secret of your heart to your beloved apostle John while reclining in your embrace and promised that we might drink from the flowing waters of his gospel springing forth from your very heart's source, look upon us graciously so that through you we may come to know the hidden things and through you complete the good things that are manifest. Reveal to us the hidden things in our hearts, by which we might understand our frailty and strive to reach the knowledge of your divine nature. Indicate what it is that we love about you and what it is that we should correct in ourselves.
May this beloved one of yours change our ways for the better so that plague may depart, weakness may be dispelled, hostility may be repulsed with its sword; whatever stands against Christian faith may perish, whatever prospers may recover strength; hunger may be warded off, disputes over heresies may cease, supporters may be hindered; the earth may bear fruit, it may be clothed in virtues, and the soul may flourish. May all these good things come to us as we faithfully serve you here without sin and enjoy your eternal possession after indulging in delight.

text: Gloria tibi Domino Deo nostro saeculorum regi hominum conditori qui in cultum perpetem templi huius ambitum cum sanctorum martyrum patrocinio consecrasti ubi cottidiana devotione praestatis e caelis quod patebaris in terris. Introeat ergo Domine postulatio nostra coram te hodie et in conspectum maiestatis tuae oratio contriti cordis adscendat ac singulorum votis in templo hoc cuius natalis est hodie pro benignitatis tuae serenitate responde fidem credentis effectu concesso petitionis amplifica.
translation_en: Glory to you, Lord God our ruler of the ages, creator of humanity, who have dedicated this perpetual temple with the patronage of the holy martyrs. Here, daily devotion is rendered from heaven that you reveal on earth. Therefore, may your petition enter before you today and may a prayer from a contrite heart ascend to your majesty. May the faith of those who believe be granted in effect according to their vows within this temple, whose birthday it is today, and may your kindness amplify the response to their petition.

text: Gloriam martyris tui Zoili annuis recursibus festissime celebramus omnipotens Deus quem munda sanguinis sui effusione stolam induere dignatus es cuius merito quoque congregata est fraternitas universa. Proinde petimus omnipotens Pater ut eius meritis nostra deleantur peccata quem scimus inter sanctos tuos et electos promeruisse victoriae palmam.
translation_en: We most solemnly celebrate the glory of your martyr Zoilus on his annual recurrences, O almighty God, whom you deemed worthy to clothe with a robe by his pure outpouring of blood. His merit has also gathered together the entire fraternity. Therefore, we ask the almighty Father that our sins may be forgiven through his merits, whom we know has merited the victory palm among your saints and elect.

text: Gloriam Domine sanctorum apostolorum perpetuam praecurrentes quaesumus ut eandem sacris mysteriis expiati dignius celebremus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the glories of your holy apostles who are running ahead eternally may be more worthy celebrated in the same sacred mysteries.

text: Gloriosa haec est illa martyrum tuorum Christe Vincentii Sabinae et Christetae sollemnitas quae et illorum memoriam et tua beneficia annua vice oculis mortalium repraesentat. Hii sunt plane martyres tui qui in te vero lapide angulari confisi dum vanis lapidibus sacrificare spernunt humilia lapidibus colla deiciunt sicque desuper illisi ictu ferientium moriuntur. Recte hii super lapides meruerunt occidi quorum vita vel doctrina inter incredulorum duritiam occasum invenit. Fuerit his licet corporalis punitio per supplicium est tamen victoria per triumphum. Sit quamvis mors illata supplicio sed vita felix manet in regno. Non enim punivit crudelitas quos cupit quos in se Trinitas victores effecit. Punivit quidem ut potuit; non punivit ut voluit. Immanis quippe ferocitas sanctorum et victoriam cupivit exstinguere et salutem sed et in hoc sanctorum voluntati nolendo deserviens membra tantum punit suppliciis animas suo expiatas vulnere transmittit in caelis. Quosque hic ne vincerent timuit hos post mortem victores intellegit cum illorum corporibus praevidit caelitus impendi honorem quibus ipse rabidus intulerat necem.  His proinde intercedentibus sanctis veniam te nostris Deus quaesumus donare flagitiis quo mundati corde et corpore hunc diem sanctorum tuorum per multas temporum series mereamur devotissime celebrare.
translation_en: This is the solemnity of your martyrs, Christ - Vincent, Sabina, and Christeta. This feast day not only commemorates their memory but also annually represents your blessings before the eyes of mortals. These are indeed your martyrs who, having faith in the true cornerstone (Christ), scorned to sacrifice themselves on worthless stones and were beheaded with humble stones. Thus, they died under the blows of those striking them from above. Rightfully did these men deserve to die whose life or teaching found its end amidst the hardness of unbelief. Although their bodies may have suffered physical punishment through martyrdom, it was indeed a victory through triumph. Even though death was inflicted upon them by suffering, their happy life remains in the kingdom. For cruelty did not punish those whom it desired; rather, it was the Trinity who made victors out of them. Cruelty certainly did mete out punishment as much as it could; however, it did not mete out punishment as much as it wanted to. Indeed, the ferocity of saints longed to extinguish their victory and salvation, yet even in this they served the will of the saints by only punishing their bodies and sending their purified souls to heaven. We ask you, God, through these interceding saints, to grant us forgiveness for our sins so that we may deserve to devoutly celebrate this day of your holy ones for many series of time.

text: Gloriosi martyris tui atque pontificis Pii da nobis quaesumus Domine sollemnitatibus gloriari et a cunctis mentis et corporis periculis eius pia intercessione misericorditer liberari.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that on the solemnities of your glorious martyr and pontiff Pius, we may rejoice, and be mercifully freed from all mental and bodily perils through his pious intercession.

text: Gloriosi martyris tui Vincentii Domine quaesumus interventione hostiam quam offerimus tibi placitam effice et acceptam.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that through the intervention of your glorious martyr Saint Vincent, may the offering we present to you be pleasing and acceptable.

text: Gloriosi pontificis tui Thomae quaesumus Domine Deus noster praeclara merita sanctificent corda nostra praesentisque sacrificii munera grata faciant et accepta.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to make the merits of your glorious pontiff Thomas shining in our hearts and to make the offerings of this present sacrifice pleasing and acceptable to you.

text: Gloriosum praecursoris tui Ioannis Christe Deus passionis festum hodierno die voto concinimus sacrificiis dedicamus qui iustitiam praedicans legis sententia mulctatur Herodis. Ob hoc te deprecamur et petimus ut idem qui terminum fuit prophetis finem ponat scandalis et qui fuit baptismatis initium pacis nobis praeroget complementum regatque conservos prece qui te dominum praecessit in morte.
translation_en: On this present day, we consecrate the glorious feast of your Precursor John, Christ God, with vows and sacrifices. You who chastened Herod by your teaching on justice as stated in the law, we humbly beseech you and entreat that the same one who was the end for prophets puts an end to scandals for us, and who was the beginning of baptism grants us the completion of peace. May he rule and govern those who remain faithful to the prayer that your Precursor preceded as Lord in death.

text: Grata sint tibi Domine nostrae redemptionis libamina quae sancti Leufredi meritis nobis aeternae salutis conferant remedia.
translation_en: May these offerings of our redeemer, Lord, which through the merits of Saint Leufred grant us means for eternal salvation, be pleasing to you.

text: Grata sint tibi Domine sacrificia quae in sancto martyre Stephano tua dona testantur et nobis tribuunt promptae devotionis augmentum.
translation_en: May these offerings be pleasing to You, Lord, which You give on the holy martyr Stephen and grant us an increase of swift devotion.

text: Grata sint tibi omnipotens Deus nostrae servitutis obsequia ut illius interventu nobis salutaria reddantur pro cuius immarcescibili gloria exhibentur.
translation_en: May the services of our lowliness be pleasing to you, Almighty God, so that through his intervention beneficial things may return to us, for whose inextinguishable glory is shown.

text: Grata sit tibi Deus haec oblatio munerum quibus haec congregatio cum ( lac. ) salute corroborata consistat et in ea religiosus tuae servitutis fructus indesinenter proficiat.
translation_en: May this offering of gifts be pleasing to you, God, through which this congregation is gathered with peace strengthened and may the fruit of your religious service continually progress within it.

text: Grata sit tibi Domine haec oblatio famuli tui illius quam tibi offerimus in honorem beati illius martyris tui; quaesumus ut eidem proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: May this offering of your servant, Lord, which we offer to you in honor of that blessed martyr of yours, be pleasing to you. We ask that he may profit from it towards his salvation.

text: Grata sit tibi Domine haec oblatio plebis tuae quam tibi offerimus; <quaesumus ut> cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: May this offering of your people, Lord, be pleasing to you, which we present to you; we ask that it may benefit all for their salvation.

text: Grata sit tibi Domine haec oblatio plebis tuae quam tibi offerimus in honorem sanctae illius virginis ut cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: May this offering of Your people, Lord, be pleasing to You, which we present to You in honor of that holy Virgin. May it benefit all for salvation.

text: Grata tibi sit Domine quaesumus haec oblatio plebis tuae quam tibi offerimus in honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi ut quod singuli obtulerunt singulis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: May this offering of your people, Lord, be pleasing to you which we present to you on behalf of our Lord Jesus Christ. May it profit each individually for their salvation from what each has offered.

text: Grata sit tibi Domine nostrae servitutis oblatio pro qua sanctus Gorgonius martyr interveni(a)t.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to You, Lord, our offering of service for which the holy Gorgonius the martyr intercedes.

text: Grata tibi Domine munera nostra efficiat Dei Genitricis oratio quam et si pro condicione carnis migrasse cognoscimus in caelesti gloria pro nobis apud te orare sentiamus.
translation_en: May our gifts, Lord, be pleasing to you through the prayer of the Mother of God. And may we feel that, even though we recognize that we have departed according to the condition of flesh into celestial glory, she is praying for us before you in heaven.

text: Grata tibi Domine quaesumus nostra sint munera quibus sancti Vitalis martyris tui passio recolitur honoranda.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our offerings may be pleasing to you, with which the passion of your saint Vitalis, the martyr, is recalled and honored.

text: Grata tibi Domine sancti Leothardi pontificis nos adiuvet interventio et praesta ut in aeternum nobis proficiat tui sacramenti perceptio.
translation_en: May the intervention of Saint Leothard, Lord, aid us, and grant that through the perception of your sacraments we may advance eternally.

text: Grata tibi munera nostra sint Domine quae et tuis sunt instituta praeceptis et sanctorum festivitas gloriosa commendat.
translation_en: May our gifts be pleasing to you, Lord, which have been established according to your precepts and the glorious feast of the saints recommends.

text: Grata tibi sint munera nostra Domine quae et tuis sunt instituta praeceptis et beati Magni festivitas gloriosa commendet.
translation_en: May our gifts, Lord, be pleasing to you, which have been established according to your commandments and the glorious feast of Blessed Magnus recommend.

text: Grata tibi sint Domine haec sacrificia quae in sancti Tiburtii martyris tui passione deferuntur cuius intercessione quaesumus salutaria nobis efficiantur.
translation_en: These sacrifices are pleasing to you, Lord, which are offered during the passion of your martyr St. Tiburtius. Through his intercession we humbly ask that they bring us beneficial results.

text: Grata tibi sint Domine munera quaesumus devotionis hodiernae quam beati Stephani martyris tui commemoratio gloriosa depromit.
translation_en: We ask that the gifts are pleasing to You, Lord, as we offer our devotion today, which the glorious commemoration of Your blessed martyr Stephen brings forth.

text: Grata tibi sint Domine munera quibus beatae Mariae semper virginis supervenientem praevenimus festivitatem.
translation_en: These gifts are pleasing to You, Lord, with which we have preceded the approaching festival of the blessed Mary, ever Virgin.

text: Grata tibi sint Domine munera quibus mysteria celebrantur nostrae libertatis et vitae.
translation_en: Lord, may these gifts be pleasing to you, by which the mysteries of our freedom and life are celebrated.

text: Grata tibi sint Domine quaesumus oblata munera quibus et beati Augustini confessoris tui atque pontificis merita veneramur et nostrae pariter recolimus insignia libertatis et vitae.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings presented to you are pleasing to you. Through these offerings, we honor and remember the merits of your confessor and bishop, Augustine, and we equally recall the signs of our freedom and life.

text: Grata tibi sint Domine munera tuo conspectui oblata quae et tuis sunt praeceptis instituta et beatorum martyrum tuorum Marcelli et Apuleii illustrant coronas.
translation_en: Blessed are these gifts, Lord, presented before your sight, which were established according to your commandments, and which adorn the crowns of your blessed martyrs Marcellus and Apuleius.

text: Grata tibi sint quaesumus Domine munera quae in beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui Willibaldi commemoratione deferimus obsecrantes ut quae honore prosequimur contingere mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the gifts presented on the commemoration of your blessed priest and confessor Willibald may be pleasing to you. We beseech you that what we revere with honor may be worthy of receiving.

text: Grata tibi sint quaesumus Domine munera quibus sanctae Agnetis magnifica sollemnitas recensetur; sic enim ab exordio sui usque in finem beati certaminis exstitit gloriosa ut eius nec initium debeamus praeterire nec finem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the gifts may be pleasing to you with which the solemnity of Saint Agnes is recently celebrated; for in truth, from its beginning until the end of the blessed contest, it has been glorious, so we should not overlook its beginning nor its end.

text: Grata tibi sit Domine haec oblatio quam tibi indignus famulus tuus offerre praesumo in honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi ut et me a peccatorum meorum maculis emundet et <nos> tuo nomini reddat acceptos.
translation_en: May this offering be pleasing to you, Lord, which your unworthy servant presumes to offer in honor of our Lord Jesus Christ. May it cleanse me from the stains of my sins and make us acceptable to your name.

text: Grata tibi sit Domine nostrae servitutis oblatio quae in {honore} sanctorum martyrum tuorum Felicis et Fortunati festivitate nos laetificet; praesta quaesumus ut quorum sollemnitate gaudemus praesidio muniamur.
translation_en: May this offering of our service be pleasing to You, Lord. The offering we make in honor of the feast of Your holy martyrs, Felicity and Fortunatus, may it bring us joy. Grant us, we beseech You, that we who rejoice in their festival may be fortified with their protection.

text: Grata tibi sit Domine quaesumus hodiernae festivitatis oblatio ut tua gratia largiente per haec sacrosancta commercia in illius inveniamur forma in quo tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that this day's festivity offering may be pleasing to You. May Your grace bestow upon us through these sacred transactions that we may find Your form in whom our substance is found.

text: Grata tibi sit quaesumus Domine hodiernae nativitatis Domini nostri Iesu Christi haec oblatio ut tua gratia largiente per haec sacrosancta commercia in ipsius inveniamur forma in quo et nostram credendo speramus esse substantiam.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that this offering made today of the nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ may be pleasing to You. May Your grace bestow upon us through these sacred transactions, that we may find Him in His form whom we believe with faith also to be our substance.

text: Grata tibi sit Domine quaesumus nostra festivitas pro veneratione eius oblata qui tuae maiestatis arcanis naturali per tuam gratiam decore servato devotis semper excubiis est propinquus.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to you, Lord, we humbly ask, that our festivity is acceptable before you for the reverence offered in honor of him. He who is always near to your majesty's secrets, preserved by your grace with a natural decorum, is ever kept watchful by devoted vigils.

text: Grata tibi sit Domine sacratae plebis oblatio pro tuorum honore sanctorum quorum se meritis percepisse de tribulatione cognoscit auxilium.
translation_en: May this offering of a sacred people be pleasing to You, Lord, on behalf of the honor of Your saints, whose aid they have recognized as having received through their merits from the troubles.

text: Grata tibi sit quaesumus Domine tuae plebis oblatio per quam et sanctificationem referat et quae pie precatur obtineat.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to You, we ask, Lord, the offering of Your people. Through which may both sanctification be returned and what devoutly prays may obtain.

text: Gratanter ad munera dicenda concurrimus quae nomini tuo Domine pro sollemnitate sanctae martyris Euphemiae supplices immolamus.
translation_en: With joy we approach to offer the gifts that, in supplication, we dedicate to Your name, Lord, on the occasion of the solemnity of the holy martyr Euphemia.

text: Gratanter Domine ad munera dicanda concurrimus quae nomini tuo pro sollemnitate sanctae martyris Sabinae suppliciter immolamus.
translation_en: Fervently, Lord, we come to present the offerings that we humbly dedicate to your name in honor of the solemnity of Saint Sabina, the martyr.

text: Gratanter Domine munera dicanda intuere quae nomini tuo pro sollemnitate sanctae illius martyris tuae suppliciter immolamus.
translation_en: Graciously, Lord, consider the gifts that we humbly offer to Your name for the solemnity of that holy martyr of yours.

text: Gratia Spiritus Sancti Domine quaesumus haec munera nostra assumat et intercedente beato Bertino consessore tuo atque abbate vitam nostram irreprehensibilem custodiat et nos ad caelestia regna perducat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the grace of the Holy Spirit take hold of these gifts of ours. Through the intercession of blessed Berthoin, your consecrate and abbot, may he guard our life irreproachable and lead us to the celestial kingdoms.

text: Gratia Spiritus Sancti quaesumus Domine haec assumat sacrificia quae per merita beati Botulphi abbatis vitam nostram irreprehensibilem custodiat et nos ad regna caelestia quandoque perducat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the grace of the Holy Spirit takes these offerings. Through the merits of Blessed Botulph, abbot, may it guard our irreproachable life and lead us to the heavenly kingdoms at some point.

text: Gratia tua Domine quae beatum Bertinum hostiam sanctam vivamque tibi fecit esse placabilem eius meritis haec sanctificet libamina et vitae nostrae consummationem peragat irreprehensibilem.
translation_en: By Your grace, Lord, which made the blessed Bertin a living and pleasing sacrifice to You through his merits, may this libamina be sanctified and may it bring about an irreproachable completion of our life.

text: Gratia tua Domine quaesumus populum supplicem benignus illustra et donorum tuorum largitate prosequere ut a malis omnibus te protegente defensus ad ineffabile mysterium spiritaliter celebrandum et merite praeparetur et corpore.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your grace illuminates the supplicant people and follows with the generosity of Your gifts, so that protected by You from all evils, they may worthily and spiritually celebrate the ineffable mystery and prepare themselves both in merit and body.

text: Gratia tua nos quaesumus Domine non relinquat quae et sacrae nos deditos faciat servituti et tuam nobis opem semper acquirat.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your grace, Lord, not to abandon us whom You have dedicated to the sacred service. May it always obtain Your help for us.

text: Gratia tua nos quaesumus Domine non derelinquat quae nobis opem semper acquirat. ( recension gregorienne ) Gratia tua nos quaesumus Domine non relinquat quae et nobis opem semper acquirat et veniam. ( recension de Padove ) Gratia tua nos quaesumus Domine non relinquat quae et nobis opem semper tuae largitatis acquirat et ab omnibus tueatur adversis. ( recension ambrosienne ) Gratia tua nos quaesumus Domine non relinquat quae et sacrae nos deditos faciat servituti et tuam nobis opem semper acquirat. ( recension gelasienne ) Gratia tua nos quaesumus Domine non derelinquat quae et sacrae nos deditos faciat servituti et tuam nobis opem semper acquirat largitatis et ab omnibus tueatur adversis. ( recension anglo-normande )
translation_en:
We humbly ask your grace, Lord, may it not abandon us, which always obtains help for us. (Gregorian recension)
We humbly ask your grace, Lord, may it not leave us, which also always obtains help and forgiveness for us. (Paduan recension)
We humbly ask your grace, Lord, may it not leave us, which also always obtains help from your generosity and protects us from all adversities. (Ambrosian recension)
We humbly ask your grace, Lord, may it not abandon us, which makes us devoted to the sacred service and always obtains your help for us. (Gelasian recension)
We humbly ask your grace, Lord, may it not abandon us, which makes us devoted to the sacred service and always obtains your generous help for us and protects us from all adversities. (Anglo-Norman recension)

text: Gratiae tuae quaesumus Domine supplicibus tuis tribue largitatem ut mandata tua te operante sectantes et consolationem vitae praesentis accipiant et futura gaudia comprehendant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant your grace to your supplicants. Bestow upon them liberality that they may follow your commands while you are working among them, and receive the consolation of present life, and grasp the future joys.

text: Gratiae tuae quaesumus Domine supplicibus tuis tribue largitatem ut mandata tua te operante sectantes consolationem praesentis vitae percipiant et futurae.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to grant your grace to your humble suppliants, that they may find generosity, as they follow your commandments with you working among them. May they experience consolation in this life and hope for the future.

text: Gratiae tuae quaesumus Domine famulis et famulabus tuis illis et illis et universis utriusque sexus fidelibus tribue largitatem ut mandata tua te miserante sectantes consolationem praesentis vitae percipiant et futurae.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for your servants and servants, those and all of both sexes, faithful ones; that you may grant them generosity, so that as they follow your commandments with mercy, they may receive the comfort of this life and a foretaste of the future one.

text: Gratiae tuae sacramenta omnipotens Deus quae te largiente percepimus quaesumus ut omnium beatorum spirituum suffragantibus meritis nobis remedia conferant aeternae salutis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, bestower of your sacraments, that through the intercession of all the blessed spirits with their merits, you grant us the remedies for eternal salvation.

text: Gratiam Sancti Spiritus Domine Deus cordibus nostris clementer infunde quae nos gemitibus efficiat lacrimarum maculas nostrorum diluere peccatorum atque optatae nobis te largiente indulgentiae praestet effectum.
translation_en: Lord God, grant us the grace of the Holy Spirit to pour gently upon our hearts, that we may be made effective through groans and may wash away the stains of our sins with tears. May the indulgence you freely bestow upon us bring about its desired effect.

text: Gratiam tuam Domine mentibus nostris infunde ut qui angelo nuntiante Christi Filii tui incarnationem cognovimus per passionem eius et crucem ad resurrectionis gloriam perducamur.
translation_en: Pour down your grace, Lord, upon our minds, so that we who have learned about the incarnation of your Son, Christ, through an angel's announcement, may be led by his passion and cross to the glory of the resurrection.

text: Gratiam tuam nobis Domine semper accumulet divini participatio sacramenti et sua nos virtute mundando tanti muneris capaces efficiat.
translation_en: May your grace, Lord, always increase upon us through the participation in the divine sacrament, and make us worthy of such a great gift by cleansing us with its power.

text: Gratiam tuam quaesumus Domine praevenienter infunde ut qui te gratia cooperante beati Ioannis confessoris tui gratiam consummatam cognovimus tibi in Ecclesia tua gratiarum actiones humiliter referamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that Your grace precedently may be poured out, so that we who have known the completed grace of Your confessor blessed John, may in Your Church humbly return thanks to You for it.

text: Gratiarum actionum muneribus placatus haec tibi Domine acceptabilis fiat oblatio quae nobis ineffabilis misericordiae tuae dona conciliet tuarumque benignitatum semper cognitores efficiat et in tua laude indesinenter perseverabiles reddat.
translation_en: Thankful for the gifts bestowed, we are pleased, Lord, may this offering be acceptable to you. May it bring us together with your ineffable mercy, always making us aware of your benevolence, and may it constantly make us persevering in your praise.

text: Gratias agentes oramus te Domine Deus noster ut corpus et sanguis Filii tui Domini nostri non sit nobis ad iudicium sed ad medelam proficiat corpori et animae nostrae atque cottidianae consolationis tribuat saturitatem.
translation_en: We, who are giving thanks, pray to you, Lord our God, that the body and blood of your Son, our Lord, may not be for us a judgment but may profit for our body and soul. And may it grant us daily consolation and satiety.

text: Gratias agimus Domine multiplicatis circa nos miserationibus tuis qui et Filii tui nativitate nos salvas et beati martyris Stephani deprecatione sustentas.
translation_en: We give thanks, Lord, for the numerous mercies you have shown us, who saved us through the birth of your Son and were sustained by the intercession of blessed martyr Stephen.

text: Gratias agimus Domine multiplicibus largitatibus tuis quibus animas in te sperantium satiare consuesti nam et confisi de tua pietate precamur ut misereri digneris famulo tuo ne praevaleat adversus eum adversarius in hora exitus illius de corpore sed transitum habere mereatur ad vitam.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord, for your numerous blessings by which you have accustomed to satisfy the souls hoping in you. Indeed, we trust in your mercy and ask humbly that you might deign to have mercy on your servant, so that his adversary may not prevail against him at the hour of his departure from his body, but rather he might be worthy to pass into life.

text: Gratias tibi agimus Domine Deus noster qui nos caelesti medela reparare dignatus es; da quaesumus peccatis nostris veniam sicut beato Medardo confessori tuo dedisti sedem pontificatus.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord our God, who deemed us worthy to be healed by the celestial remedy; grant us, we beseech you, forgiveness for our sins as you gave the seat of pontificate to your confessor Blessed Medardus.

text: Gratias tibi agimus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui nos post transgressionem ieiunii vetita contingendo ad continentiam salutis reparasti per Christum; te in hoc ieiunio supplices ac provoluti rogamus ut dones nobis rectam a vitiis mentem et spiritu principali qui est mortificationis amator nos corrobores ut post actum ieiunium ad aeternae refectionis nos pascua perducas.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord holy Father almighty eternal God, who after our transgression of the forbidden fasting, have restored us to continence in salvation through Christ; we humbly and prostrate beseech you in this fast that you give us a right mind from vices and the principal spirit which is the lover of mortification, so that you strengthen us and lead us to the pastures of eternal refreshment after the act of fasting.

text: Gratias tibi agimus omnipotens Deus aeterne pro sacramenti tui huius satietate; preces quoque supplices fundimus ut me famulum tuum illum ab omni culpa concedas esse liberum et qui fideliter corpus et sanguinem Domini nostri Iesu Christi assumpsi non sinas me Domine ad propria mala reverti. Non sinas me temptari plus quam {non} possum sustinere sed mittere digneris sanctum angelum tuum qui me ab omni malo custodiat et in bono opere confirmet et in operibus mandatorum tuorum deducat et cor meum in iustificationibus tuis semper erudiat et animam meam ad vitam perducat.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, almighty God, eternal one, for the satisfaction of this sacrament; we also pour out supplicating prayers that you grant your servant to be free from all guilt, and who faithfully received the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, do not allow me, Lord, to return to my own sins. Do not allow me to be tempted beyond what I can bear, but rather send your holy angel to watch over me from every evil, confirm me in good works, lead me in the performance of your commandments, and always teach my heart in your justifications, and guide my soul to life.

text: Gratias tibi agimus omnipotens Deus pro virtutibus beatissimi Germani antistitis tui quas ei Pater omnipotens non immerito tribuisti quia te apostolica confessione rebus omnibus plus amavit;  discussit a se divitias ut paupertate spiritus caelorum regna conscenderet;  mansuetudinem tenuit ut terram sui corporis spiritaliter possideret;  lugere delectatus est in saeculo ut caelestem consolationem ex muneris tui largitate perciperet;  iustitiam esurivit atque sitivit ut tuis saturaretur eloquiis;  eleemosynam iugiter fecit ut indesinenter non tantum sibi sed et ceteris pietatis tuae misericordiam obtineret;  puritatem cordis habuit ut te videret;  fidem servavit ut filiis tuis fraterna se participatione coniungeret;  per cuius interventum precamur;  qui illum honoras pro talibus meritis nos imbuere digneris eius exemplis.
translation_en: We give you thanks, almighty God, for the virtues of the blessed bishop Germain, which you, omnipotent Father, did not unjustly bestow upon him because he loved all things in apostolic confession more than anything else; he renounced riches to ascend to the kingdom of heaven through poverty of spirit; he maintained meekness to spiritually possess the earth of his body; he was pleased to weep in this world to receive celestial consolation from your bounty; he yearned for justice and thirsted to be satisfied by your words; he constantly practiced almsgiving to obtain unceasing mercy of your pity not only for himself but also for others; he had purity of heart so that he could see you; he kept faith so that he could join brotherly participation with your sons; through his intervention, we pray; who honors him for such merits, may you deem worthy to inspire us with his examples.

text: Gratias tibi agimus omnipotens Deus qui nos in commemoratione electi tui Sigismundi corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi communione satiasti; praesta ut qui eius commemorationem facimus ab imminentibus periculis liberemur.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, almighty God, who have satisfied us in the remembrance of your chosen one, Sigismund, with the communion of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ; grant that we who make his remembrance may be freed from impending dangers.

text: Gratias tibi agimus omnipotens Deus qui nos per votiva electi tui Sigismundi martyris sacrificia cum sociis suis illis pane vivo et vero vino laetitiae spiritalis recreare dignatus es; praesta Domine ut quicumque sub electi tui Sigismundi martyrio una cum sociis suis illis incontaminationem corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi accipiat ad sanitatem pristinam revocetur.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, almighty God, who deigned to restore us with the living bread and true wine, the spiritual joy, through the sacrifices of your elect saint Sigismund and his companions; grant, Lord, that whoever is under the martyrdom of your saint Sigismund along with his companions may receive an unspoiled body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, to be restored to original health.

text: Gratias tibi agimus omnipotens Deus tua sacramenta sumentes et intercessione beati Rufi martyris tui ab omnibus liberemur periculis.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, almighty God, as we partake in your sacraments and are freed from all dangers by the intercession of your martyr Saint Rufus.

text: Gratias tibi agimus omnipotens aeterne Deus qui reficis nos esca aeternitatis et vita<e>; quaesumus misericordiam <tuam> ut quae corpore communicavimus corde vegetemur; sic enim spiritalis esca nos proderit; sicut ore sumpsimus mentibus hauriamus.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, almighty eternal God, who refreshes us with the food of eternity and life; we ask for your mercy that what we have received corporally may be nourished in our hearts; thus spiritual food will benefit us; just as we have taken it with our mouths, may we absorb it with our minds.

text: Gratias tibi ago Domine Deus qui me peccatorem satiare dignatus es corpore et sanguine Domini nostri Iesu Christi et ideo peto omnipotens Deus ut haec sancta communio non sit mihi in iudicium neque ad condemnationem poenae sed sit arma fidei et scutum bonae voluntatis ad evacuandas omnes insidias diaboli de corpore meo et illud introire convivium me peccatorem permittas ubi lux vera est et gaudia sempiterna iustorum.
translation_en: I thank you, Lord God, who have deemed fit to satisfy me, the sinner, with the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ. Therefore, I pray, almighty God, that this holy communion not be to my judgment nor to condemnation of punishment, but be armor of faith and shield of good will to drive away all the snares of the devil from my body, and allow me, a sinner, to enter into the feast where true light is and eternal joy of the just.

text: Praesta omnipotens Deus huic famulo tuo illi cuius hodie capitis
translation_en: Almighty God, grant to this your servant him whom today you take (into death).

text: Gratias tibi Domine laudesque persolvimus qui nos corporis et sanguinis dilectissimi Filii tui Domini nostri communione vegetasti misericordiam tuam suppliciter exorantes ut hoc tuum Domine sacramentum non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sed fiat intercessio salutaris ad veniam.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord, and render praise, who have nourished us with the body and blood of your most beloved Son, our Lord, in communion. Humbly we ask for your mercy, that this sacrament of yours, Lord, may not be a burden to us for punishment but may become a saving intercession for forgiveness.

text: Gratias tibi agimus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus qui nos corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi communione satiasti tuamque misericordiam humiliter imploramus ut hoc tuum Domine sacramentum non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sed sit intercessio salutaris ad veniam sit ablutio scelerum sit fortitudo fragilium sit contra mundi pericula firmamentum; haec nos communio mundet a crimine et caelestis gaudii tribuat esse participes.
translation_en: We give you thanks, Lord, holy Father almighty eternal God, who have satisfied us with the communion of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ. We humbly implore your mercy that this, your Lord, sacrament may not be a burden to us for punishment but rather a saving intercession for forgiveness, a cleansing for sins, a strength for the weak, a protection against worldly perils, and a firm foundation; let this communion cleanse us from guilt and grant us to be participants of celestial joy.

text: Gratias tibi referimus Domine quoniam sanctum Laurentium martyrem tuum te inspirante diligimus ut eius natalicia praeeuntes piis semper intercessionibus foveamur et meritis.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord, because we love your holy martyr Laurence inspired by you. We celebrate his feast days with constant prayers and are warmed by his intercessions and merits.

text: Gratias tibi Domine tuis donis repleti referimus tuamque misericordiam supplices imploramus suffragiis martyrum tuorum illorum ut tua nos gratia a malis omnibus potenter eripiat et in tuis semper laudibus exsultare concedat.
translation_en: We return to you, Lord, our thanks for your gifts, and humbly implore your mercy through the intercession of your martyrs, that they may powerfully deliver us from all evils with your grace, and grant us to always rejoice in your praises.

text: Gratias tibi Domine referentes oramus ut mundes propitius cor nostrum a vitiis et repleas iugiter spiritalibus donis.
translation_en: Thanking you, Lord, we pray that you may be merciful to our hearts from vices and always fill us with spiritual gifts.

text: Gratias tibi referat Domine corde subiecto tua semper ecclesia et consequenter obtineat ut observationes antiquas recensendo proficiat in futurum.
translation_en: May the Lord's church, with a humble heart, always give thanks to You. And may it subsequently obtain that, by reviewing the ancient practices, it may progress for the future.

text: Gratias tibi referimus Domine qui nos a temporalibus facis respirare pressuris ut ad gaudia sempiterna promoveas.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord, who make us breathe freely from earthly pressures so that you may lead us to everlasting joys.

text: Gratias tibi referimus Domine qui nos et caelestis participatione sacramenti et tuorum reficis celebritate iustorum.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord, who renew us with the celestial participation of the sacrament and the festive gathering of the righteous.

text: Gratias tibi referimus Domine sacro munere vegetati tuam misericordiam deprecantes ut dignos nos eius participatione perficias.
translation_en: We thank you, Lord, with sacred rite, invoking your mercy, that you may complete us worthy through the participation of this grace.

text: Gratulantes Domine in commemoratione sancti Apollinaris martyris atque pontificis quaesumus ut eius nos continuis adiuvari supplicationibus sentiamus
translation_en: We rejoice, Lord, in the commemoration of Saint Apollinaris the martyr and bishop. We humbly ask that through his intercession we may feel his constant aid in our prayers.

text: Gratum tibi Domine sit munus oblatum et ut tibi digne ministrare possimus sacrae virgines Katherina et Margareta nobis mentium puritatem et beata Maria Magdalena salutarem nobis obtinea(n)t compunctionem.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to You, Lord, the offering presented; and may we serve You worthily with the sacred virgins Catherine and Margaret, granting us purity of mind, and may blessed Mary Magdalene obtain for us compassion.

text: Gregem tuum pastor aeterne conserva et pii suffragatoris Ethelwoldi patris nostri defensione guberna ut cuius benevolentia provocante superni amoris dulcedine pascimur eius interventu patrocinante et a temporalis vitae perturbationibus eruamur et mansuris supernorum civium gaudiis inseramur.
translation_en: Eternally preserve your flock, O everlasting Shepherd, and guide it under the protection of our devoted intercessor Ethelwold, our father. May his benevolence lead us to be fed by the sweetness of heavenly love, may his intervention save us from the disturbances of temporal life, and may we be inserted into the lasting joys of the citizens of heaven.

text: Gregem tuum quaesumus Domine sancti Ethelwoldi pia intercessione guberna ut in cuius veneratione spiritualis cibi dulcedine pascimur eius interventione et ab omni perturbatione eruamur et aeternis gaudiis inseramur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with the pious intercession of Saint Ethelwold guide your flock, that in whose veneration we are fed by spiritual food's sweetness. May we be freed from all disturbance through his intervention, and may we be enrolled in eternal joys.

text: Gregem tuum pastor bone placatus intende et oves quas pretioso sanguine redemisti diabolica non sinas incursione lacerari.
translation_en: Turn your mind towards your flock, good shepherd, and let not the sheep that you have redeemed with precious blood be torn apart by the devil's onslaught.

text: Gregem tuum pastor bone placatus intende et per apostolos tuos pervigili protectione custodi ut iisdem rectoribus gubernetur quos eidem contulisti operis tui vicarios esse pastores.
translation_en: Turn your attention to your flock, good shepherd, and through your apostles, may they be guarded by watchful protection so that they may be governed by the same rulers whom you have appointed as your vicars to be their pastors in your work.

text: Gregem tuum pater bone placatus intende et per beatos apostolos perpetua protectione custodi quos totius ecclesiae praestitisti Filii tui vicarios esse pastores.
translation_en: Turn your attention to your flock, good father pleasing God, and through the blessed apostles, may they be under eternal protection. Those whom you have appointed as vicars to be pastors of your Son's whole Church.

text: Gregem tuum quaesumus pastor aeterne paterna benedictione sanctifica et dilectae virginis tuae Etheldrithae suffragantibus meritis per haec sancta quae sumpsimus ab omni impugnatoris incursu defende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, eternal Father, to bless your flock with the paternal blessing and protect it from every attacker through these holy things we have received, with the intercession of your beloved virgin Etheldritha.

text: Guberna Domine quaesumus plebem tuam et tuis beneficiis semper accumula ut et praesentis vitae subsidiis gaudeat et aeternae.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you govern your people and always increase your blessings upon them, so that they may rejoice in the support of this life and in the eternal one.

text: Guberna Domine quaesumus tuam placatus ecclesiam ut potenti moderatione directa et incrementa libertatis accipiat et in religionis integritate persistat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you govern your pleasing church, that it may receive direction with mighty moderation and an increase of liberty, and persevere in the integrity of religion.

text: Guberna quaesumus Domine temporalibus adiumentis quos dignaris aeternis informare mysteriis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to govern those whom you deem worthy with temporal aid, and to form them with eternal mysteries.

text: Gustantes Domine suavitatis tuae dulcedinis plenitudinem quaesumus ut sit nobis hoc in remissionem peccatorum et sanitatem mentium.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you fill us with the fullness of your sweetness and delight, that this may be for us a remission of sins and health of minds.

text: Gustu salutaris hostiae recreati omnipotentiam tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut intercedentibus sancti Udalrici confessoris tui atque pontificis meritis nos interius exteriusque ab omni adversitate custodias.
translation_en: We humbly entreat your almighty power, Lord, that through the merits of your confessor and bishop Saint Udalric, you may protect us both inside and outside from every adversity.

text: Gustu salutaris hostiae recreati omnipotentiam tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut qui ad redimendum hominem de caelis descendens atque ex utero beatae Mariae carnem assumens beati Ioseph manibus subdi voluisti praestes nobis per ipsius orationes tuae semper voluntati nostrum devotum perficere famulatum tuisque semper facias inhaerere mandatis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your omnipotence, Lord, rejuvenated by the taste of the salutary Host, that You who descended from heaven to redeem mankind, taking on flesh from the womb of the Blessed Mary and entrusted to the hands of blessed Joseph, may always perfect us as devoted servants through His prayers, and may we forever adhere to Your commands.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine huic famulo tuo dignum
translation_en: Grant, we ask, Lord, this your servant a worthy status.

text: Habemus quidem Domine relictum a te viaticum sed promissum nostri desiderii exspectamus effectum et qui corpus tuum illud accepimus ad edendum in quo es humiliatus in terra illud concupiscimus ad videndum in quo es exaltatus in gloria. Nunc enim videmus in speculo et aenigmate tunc autem facie ad faciem tuam licebit gloriam contueri ubi enim nemo cibum requiret quia nullus esuriet; nemo peregrinum suscipiet quia omnes in patria sua vivent; nemo visitabit aegrotum ubi aeternae salutis permanebit hereditas; nemo operiet nudum quia omnes luce perpetua vestientur nemo mortuum sepeliet ubi omnes sine termino vivent. Sed tu Domine hic ista quae a nobis sunt percipienda sanctifica ut haec sumentes ad praemia pervenire mereamur aeterna.
translation_en: Indeed, Lord, we have been left by you the sacrament of Viaticum, but we await the fulfillment of that which is promised to our longing. That very body which we received for eating, we yearn to see in it where you were humiliated on earth; that same body where you are exalted in glory, we desire to behold. Now we see through a mirror and in riddles; but then face to face, it will be possible to contemplate your glory, where no one shall seek food because no one shall hunger; no stranger shall receive because all shall live in their own homeland; no one shall visit the sick because eternal salvation's heritage shall endure; no one shall cover the naked because all shall be clothed with perpetual light; no one shall bury the dead because all shall live without end. But Lord, these things which are from us and must be perceived by us, sanctify them so that those who partake may deserve eternal rewards.

text: Habentes igitur ante oculos omnipotens Pater sancte tantae passionis triumphos supplices exoramus ut pascha hoc quod nobis Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus hostiam vivam constituit atque complevit fiat nobis in protectionem salutis et vitae ut sanctificatus his sollemnitatibus populus altaribus tuis oblationis suae munera placitura consignet fiatque nobis eucharistia pura atque legitima in nomine unigeniti tui ut cum nostris fuerit recepta pectoribus fidem nutriat mentem sanctificet atque confirmet.
translation_en: Having before us the all-powerful Father, we humbly entreat you to make this Pasch, which our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, has instituted and completed as a living sacrifice for us, be to us for protection, salvation, and life. May the people sanctified by these solemnities present their offerings to Your altars, making them pleasing. May the pure and legitimate Eucharist be given to us in the name of Your Unigenite, that it may be received into our hearts, nourishing our faith, sanctifying our minds, and strengthening us.

text: Habitatorem virginalis hospitii sponsum beati thalami dominum tabernaculi regem templi qui eam innocentiam contulit genitrici qua dignaretur incarnata deitas generari quae nihil saeculi conscia tantum precibus mens attenta tenuit puritatem in moribus quam perciperant angeli benedictionem in visceribus nec per assumptionem de morte sensit illuviem quae vitae portavit auctorem fratres carissimi fusis precibus dominum imploremus ut eius indulgentia illuc defuncti liberentur a tartaro quo beatae virginis translatum corpus est de sepulcro.
translation_en: We beseech the Lord, the husband of the virginal hospitality of the blessed bridal chamber, king of the tabernacle and temple, who bestowed innocence upon the mother worthy of bearing the incarnate deity, that she, unaware of worldly things, maintained purity in her conduct as the angels received blessings in their innermost beings and felt no taint of death; through fervent prayers we implore him to release the departed brethren from Tartarus, into which the body of the blessed virgin was translated from the tomb.

text: Hae oblationes quaesumus Domine quas tibi offerimus in honorem beati Apollinaris martyris tui atque pontificis cunctis nobis proficiant ad veniam.
translation_en: These offerings we ask, Lord, that those which we present to you in honor of your blessed martyr and bishop Apollinaris, may profit all of us towards forgiveness.

text: Haec communicatio quaesumus Domine expurget nos a crimine et caelestis gaudii tribuat esse participes et refrigerare dignare animam famuli tui illius cuius diem commemorationis celebramus ut ante thronum gloriae Christi tui segregatus cum dextris nihil commune habeat cum sinistris.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this communion purifies us from sin and grants us to be sharers of celestial joy. And may You deign to refresh the soul of Your servant whose day of commemoration we celebrate, so that he, separated on Your right hand, has nothing in common with those on the left.

text: Haec Domine altari tuo munera imposita benedic ipse et suscipe ut intercessione beati Alphegi martyris tui atque pontificis nobis ad fructum proficiant utriusque salutis.
translation_en: Lord, offerings placed upon Your altar, bless them Yourself and receive them. May they profit us through the intercession of Your blessed martyr and bishop, Alphege, so that they may bring us the fruit of both salvations.

text: Haec Domine dona tua et praecepta servantes in altare tuum panis ac vini holocausta proponimus rogantes profusissimam tuae misericordiae pietatem ut eodem spiritu quo te in carne virginitas incorrupta concepit has hostias Trinitas indivisa sanctificet ut cum a nobis fuerint non minori trepidatione quam veneratione perceptae quidquid contra animam male vivit intereat et quidquid interierit nullatenus reviviscat.
translation_en: Lord, we present to you our offerings and your commandments served on your altar of holocaust bread and wine. We ask for the most abundant compassion of your mercy, that the indivisible Trinity may sanctify these offerings in the same spirit with which incorruptible virginity conceived you in flesh. May they perish by the same dread as they are received, whatever harms our souls is destroyed, and nothing that dies shall revive.

text: Haec Domine munera in veneratione sancti Albani martyris tui ad laudem tui nominis oblata pio respectu sanctifica et eius meritis praesta ut per haec muniti per huius vitae momentanea mereamur transire ad gaudia sine fine mansura.
translation_en: O Lord, these offerings in the veneration of Saint Alban, your martyr, are presented before you with pious respect. Sanctify them and grant through his merits that we, protected by these gifts, may deserve to pass over into eternal, blissful joys.

text: Haec Domine munera quatuor Coronatorum meritis et tibi sirit placita et nobis salutaria.
translation_en: These gifts, Lord, of the Four Coronators are pleasing to you and beneficial for us.

text: Haec Domine offerentium pura libamina propitius dignanter accepta; tribue eis pro parvis magna pro terrenis caelestia pro temporalibus sempiterna; insuper et aeternam vitam pro tua magna pietate concede recolentibus amicorum tibi martyrum celebranda vocabula qui in passionis tuae testimonio consecrandum sanguinem profuderunt; ut istum Filii tui adventum inclitos milites in hostili conflictam exercitatos fidei ignibus communitos ad florentes triumphi caelestis semper laureas evexisti sic nobis famulis tuis pari dono concedas ut recolentibus nobis spiritum parentum fratrum sororum nostrarum qui nos in pace dominica praecesserunt ( lac. ) quos peccatorum morte purgatos in paginas libri vivificantis adscribas et sub ipso recognitionis adventu indulgentiam miserantiae attribuas.
translation_en: Lord, graciously accept the pure offerings of these supplicants; grant them for small things great, for earthly things heavenly, for temporal things eternal. Furthermore, bestow upon them, according to your great mercy, everlasting life, as they recall the names of your martyrs who shed their blood in witness of your passion; so that just as you raised up the famous knights of your Son in the heat of battle with the gifts of faith, you may also bring us, your servants, to the triumphant laurels of the celestial realm through a like gift. Moreover, grant us, in equal measure, that as we recall the spirits of our parents, brothers and sisters who preceded us in peace (Lac.), you may enroll them among the pages of the book of life, and attribute to their recognition an indulgence of your mercy.

text: Haec Domine oratio salutaris famulum tuum illum ab omnibus tueatur adversis quatenus et ecclesiasticae pacis obtineat tranquillitatem et post istius temporis decursum ad aeternam perveniat hereditatem.
translation_en: Lord, this saving prayer protect your servant from all dangers, so that he may attain the tranquility of ecclesiastical peace and after the passage of this time reach an eternal inheritance.

text: Haec Domine placationis et laudis hostia famulum tuum illum in te confidentem ab omnibus purget peccatorum sordibus et ab inimicorum suorum quibus premitur insidiis et vinculis sanctae Mariae et beatorum apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli atque Ioannis precibus liberum innocuum atque absolutum esse constitue.
translation_en: O Lord, this offering of appeasement and praise purge the servant who trusts in you from all the filth of sins, and set him free from the plots and traps of his enemies. May he be innocent, unharmed, and absolved by the prayers of holy Mary and your blessed apostles Peter, Paul, and John.

text: Haec Domine plebis tuae devotio quae se terreno martyrum Caesaraugustanorum exoptat praemuniri praesidio submissa te postulat mente ut haec offerentium nomina quae nostrorum nunc sunt officio recitata tu qui dives es in misericordia septem signato signaculis libro dignanter adscribas ut eis tua eminens bonitate immensa maiestas et hic praesentiarum dona multiplicata concedat et in aeternum centuplicata restituat pausantiumque spiritibus congrua pietatis lenitate consuleat.
translation_en: Lord, this offering of your people, desiring to be protected by the martyrs of Caesaraugusta, humbly asks you with a devout mind to write down their names in the book of mercy that you are rich in seven seals. May your immeasurable goodness and majesty grant them here and now multiplying gifts, restore them infinitely, and may it guide their resting spirits with fitting compassion of piety.

text: Haec Domine quae sumpsimus votiva mysteria festa celebrantes sollemnia quae pro beatorum martyrum tuorum Dionysii Rustici et Eleutherii gloriosa passione peregimus ipsorum nobis quaesumus fiant intercessione salutaria in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter impleta.
translation_en: Lord, we who have partaken of the vows and mysteries with festive celebrations, during the solemn observance of the glorious passion of your blessed martyrs Dionysius, Rusticus, and Eleutherius. We humbly ask that through their intercession these joyful events may be fruitfully fulfilled on the days of their natalities.

text: Haec Domine quaesumus sacramenta quae sumpsimus ab omni nos reatu purificent et animam famulae tuae illius ad aeternae beatitudinis requiem pervenire concedant.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that these sacraments which we have received may purify us from all guilt and grant the soul of your servant to reach the eternal beatitude.

text: Haec Domine quam maiestati tuae offerimus hostia famulae tuae illi in sanctarum proficiat augmentum virtutum ut quae tua misericordia regali dignitate exstat gloriosa actibus etiam morum tibi placitorum clarescat sublimata.
translation_en: Lord, we offer to your majesty this offering from your servant. May it advance in the sanctuary to increase the power of virtues. So that what stands glorious with your royal mercy because of its noble actions may also shine forth in pleasing morals, elevated by you.

text: Haec Domine sacramenta sumentes quaesumus ut intercedente beata Felicitate martyre tua vitae aeternae in nobis  nutriant alimenta.
translation_en: Lord, as we partake in these sacred mysteries, we humbly ask that through the intercession of Blessed Felicity, your martyr, may the nourishment for our eternal life be sustained within us.

text: Haec Domine sacrosancta oblatio quae mundum aeternae mortis absolvit chirographo sancto Blasio intercedente nostrorum peccatorum <sit> remissio.
translation_en: This, Lord, this most holy offering that frees the world from eternal death through the intervention of Saint Blaise, may be the forgiveness of our sins.

text: Haec Domine salutaris sacrificii perceptio famuli tui illius peccatorum maculas diluat et ad regendum secundum tuam voluntatem populum idoneum reddat ut hoc salutari mysterio contra visibiles et invisibiles hostes reddatur invictus per quod mundus est divina dispensatione redemptus.
translation_en: This, O Lord, the saving sacrifice receives thy servant; let him be purified of his sins and made worthy to rule according to thy will. Thus may he be victorious through this saving mystery against visible and invisible enemies. Through whom the world has been redeemed by divine dispensation.

text: Haec Domine vivifica sacramenta ita nos pascant in sancti Augustini Anglorum apostoli sollemnitate ut cum ipso pastore in tua semper vivamus claritate.
translation_en: Lord, may these sacred mysteries enliven us, so that we may be nourished during the feast of St. Augustine of Canterbury, the English apostle, living always with him as our shepherd in your brightness.

text: Haec dona petimus Domine placatus intende quibus et summum sacrificium continetur et morte pretiosa virginis tuae Petronillae hostia tibi placita consecratur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you turn favorable towards these gifts, which contain the highest sacrifice and the precious offering of your Virgin, Petronilla, is dedicated to you as a pleasing host.

text: Haec est Domine Deus noster devota plebs; votivae mentis annuae vicis devotum munus exhibendo convenit frui desiderans gloriosi martyris Christophori praesidia quem dignum tua agnoscit manere munificum gratia.  Ille enim iuste est Christophorus quem saeva mundi huius crudelium principum tela a proprio gentis solo expulsa sibi subdere conaverat laetabunda magno illo dispensationis tuae munere ignara. Qui hunc ad se velut captum trahebat a quo postmodum se exspoliatum et robore proprio evacuatum cernebat. Suscepit namque eum tamquam per capturam humiliorem quem post paululum contra se repperit fortiorem. Captus namque captorem suum vicit et velut captum exspoliavit cui paulo antea subditus mansit.  Vere in omnibus se tibi Christe Domine imitabilem praebuit cuius gratia nominis sortiri promeruit. Ex sacro etenim lavacro tinctus Christophorus est appellatus quo Christum indutus et Christi gratia refectus Christique virtute firmatus Christi etiam exemplo exsisteret gloriosus ut quia princeps huius mundi diabolus dudum a paradiso subtractum genus humanum per carnis illecebram gloriabatur subiectum sibi nequiter copulare suo dominatui deputatum velut victor dominans retineret; advenientem quoque pro redemptione generis humani Christum Dominum quem dudum humanitate vestitum cernebat velut ceterum genus humanum suo conabatur dominio mancipari a quo captus et elisus omnium fidelium amisit coetum. Sic et Christophorus Christi virtute munitus Decium Caesarem a militibus suis exspoliatum et a plebium agmine reddidit depopulatum.  Hic Domine martyr tuus a te et fide illuminatus et nomine sublimatus sit nobis patronus assiduus sit defensor fortissimus et sic nos suo suffragio separet a mundi contagio ut tibi copulandos societ in regno superno.
translation_en:
This is, Lord, thy devoted people; the faithful-minded annual cycle offering a vow brings them together desiring to enjoy the protection of the glorious martyr Christopher, whom thou knowest worthy to remain gracious.
Indeed, he is justly called Christopher, whom the cruel princes of this world, armed with their weapons, had attempted to subject to themselves from his own people's soil, unaware of the great gift of thy dispensation. He drew him towards himself as if captive, whom afterwards he saw disrobed and emptied of his own strength.
But he received him, as though through a more humble capture, whom he later found stronger against himself. Captured, he conquered his captor and, like a captive, stripped him, to whom he had remained subject just before.
In all things, he presented himself as imitable to thee, Christ Lord, for whose sake he merited to bear the name. Anointed with sacred baptism, he was called Christopher, so that clothed in Christ and refreshed by Christ's grace and strengthened by Christ's virtue, he would exist glorious, just as Christ himself, because the prince of this world, the devil, had long ago taken humanity from paradise through carnal allurement, boasted about subjecting it to his own dominion as a conqueror ruling over it; when the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ for the redemption of the human race, whom he saw clothed in humanity, attempted to make the same race his own by domination, he was captured and chosen among all the faithful.
Just like Christopher, armed with Christ's power, stripped Decius Caesar, who was plundered by his soldiers, and returned him to the people depopulated.
O Lord, may thy martyr be for us a constant patron, a strongest defender, and thus separate us from the contagion of the world so that we may be joined to thee in the kingdom above.

text: Haec est illa dies redeuntibus in se revoluta temporibus in qua commoti pretiosi corporis fragravit unguentum quod fidelibus odor vitae esset in vitam. Haec est dies in qua amoto refossi caespitis tegumento relati sacerdotali iustitia caelestes thesauri patuerunt quos nostra sibi fide merito vindicante etiam alieni dogmatis cultor rapere voluit in teste quod habere noluit in auctore; ac si qui non recepit sacramentum Christi cupit patrocinium Saturnini.  Sed nobis o Christe vera confessione nitentibus hic martyr faveat occurrat assistat; nobis impendat quod meruit quos nosse videat quem dilexit eisque tribuat intercessione quod pertulit quos probat credidisse quod docuit.
translation_en:
This is the day that turns back to itself in the returning times, on which the moved precious ointment of the body was fragrant for the faithful as a scent of life for eternal life. This is the day on which, having removed the covering of the trampled grass, the priestly justice of heaven's treasures has been revealed, which our faith, meriting it for itself and desiring to seize it even from those who did not want it in an author, also wanted to seize as one who does not wish to have it. As if he who does not receive the sacrament of Christ desires the patronage of Saturninus.
But may Christ, O true confession, favor us, appear, come to our aid; may what he merited for us be imposed upon us, so that he sees whom he loves and gives them intercession, which he bore, proved, believed they believed, taught.

text: Haec est pia et salutaris hostia Deus pater qua tibi reconciliatus est mundus. Hoc est corpus illud quod pependit in cruce. Hic etiam sanguis qui sacro profluxit ex latere.  Pietati tuae proinde gratias agentes ex hoc quod nos Filii tui morte redimeres et resurrectione salvaveris adclines merite te Deum pietatis oramus ut haec libamina spiritus tui sancti benedictione respergens sumentium visceribus sanctificationem accommodes quo purificati a criminum labe plenissime iucundemur in hoc resurrectionis dominicae die.
translation_en:
This is the pious and saving host with which the world has been reconciled to You, O God Father. This is indeed the Body that hung on the cross. Here also is the Blood that flowed sacramentally from Your Side.
Being grateful for Your mercy, we turn to You in piety because You redeemed us, Your Sons, with Your death and saved us with Your resurrection. In our merits, we humbly ask You, God of piety, that by the breath of Your Holy Spirit, as it hovers over these sacred offerings, it may impart to them sanctification so that, being purified from the stain of sin, we may be made most joyful in this Easter Day.

text: Haec facimus Domine passionem tuam commemorantes haec facimus pater Iesu Christe qui nobis de lege veteri novam tradidisti. Concede nobis intercedente beato antistite tuo Leudegario martyre cuius hodie annuam commemorationem celebramus ut descendat hic benedictio tua super hunc panem et calicem in transformationem spiritus tui sancti uti haec benedicendo benedicas sanctificando sanctifices ut quicumque ex utraque benedictione sumpserimus aeternitatis praemium et vitam consequi mereamur aeternam.
translation_en: We do this, Lord, remembering Your Passion. We do this, Father Jesus Christ, who gave us a new law from the old one. Grant us, with the intercession of Your blessed bishop Leudegarius, martyr, whose annual commemoration we celebrate today, that Your blessing descend upon this bread and this cup for the transformation into Your Holy Spirit. So that by blessing and sanctifying and sanctifying these, we may be worthy to receive the reward of eternity and eternal life.

text: Haec facimus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus commemorantes et celebrantes passionem unici Filii tui Iesu Christi Domini nostri qui tecum vivit et regnat cum spiritu sancto in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: We do this, Lord holy Father almighty eternal God, remembering and celebrating the passion of your only-begotten Son, Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you in the Holy Spirit, forever and ever.

text: Haec hostia Domine placationis et laudis quaesumus ut meritis beati Norberti confessoris tui atque pontificis nobis indulgentiam semper impetret.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, of propitiation and praise, we ask that through the merits of your confessor and bishop, Blessed Norbert, it may always intercede for us with indulgence.

text: Haec hostia Domine placationis et laudis tua nos propitiatione dignos efficiat.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, of reconciliation and praise, may it make us worthy through your mercy.

text: Haec hostia Domine placationis et laudis quaesumus ut interveniente beata Caecilia martyre tua nos propitiatione dignos semper efficiat.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, of propitiation and praise, we humbly ask that through the intervention of blessed Caecilia, your martyr, you may always deem us worthy.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus emundet nostra delicta et sacrificium celebrandum subditorum tibi corpora mentesque sanctificet.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we humbly ask that it purify our sins and may the bodies and minds of your subjects be sanctified by the celebration of this sacrifice.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus emundet nostra delicta ut sicut adoranda Filii tui natalicia praevenimus sic eius munera capiamus sempiterna gaudentes.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we ask you to purify our sins so that just as we have been able to anticipate the festive birth of your Son, we may joyfully receive his eternal gifts.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus et ab occultis Ecclesiam tuam reatibus semper expediat et manifestis convenienter expurget.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we humbly ask that your Church may always be freed from hidden sins and purified fittingly by evident means.

text: Praesta quaesumus misericors Deus ut tibi placita
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, merciful God, that it pleases you.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus et vincula nostrae iniquitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we humbly ask that it may loose the bonds of our iniquity and grant us your mercy.

text: Hostia Domine quaesumus quam sanctorum tuorum natalicia recensentes offerimus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae dona conciliet.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that as we remember the birthdays of your saints, we offer you the host; may it release us from the bonds of our wickedness and gather unto us the gifts of your mercy.

text: Haec munera Domine quaesumus et vincula nostrae pravitatis absolvant et tuae nobis misericordiae dona concilient.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that these offerings of ours may release us from the bonds of our wickedness and that your mercy may unite with us.

text: Haec hostia Domine quaesumus sollemniter immolanda pro tuorum commemoratione iustorum conscientias nostras semper et mundet et protegat.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we humbly ask to be solemnly sacrificed in remembrance of your righteous ones. May it always cleanse and protect our consciences.

text: Haec hostia Domine quam in beatae Ethelburgae virginis tuae commemoratione tuae offerimus maiestati perpetuam nobis quaesumus ipsa pro nobis intercedente conferat salutem.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, which we present on the commemoration of your blessed virgin Ethelburga, we ask that you bestow upon us forever. May she herself, interceding for us, grant us salvation.

text: Haec hostia Domine quam in memoriam et honorem sancti Samsonis confessoris tui atque pontificis offerimus ante conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae sit accepta et tam ad corporum sanitatem quam ad animarum proficiat salutem.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, which we present in memory and honor of your confessor and bishop Saint Samson, may it be accepted before the divine majesty of yours. May it bring both bodily health and spiritual salvation.

text: Haec hostia Domine quam pro infidelium telis offerimus tibi sit accepta ut per hanc quod devote poscimus consequi mereamur.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, which we present to you on behalf of the unbelievers, may it be accepted by you, so that through it we may deserve to obtain what we humbly ask.

text: Haec hostia Domine sic tibi sit acceptabilis sicut beatus Bricius Ecclesiae tuae factus est confessor venerabilis.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, may be acceptable to you, just as blessed Bricius became a worthy confessioner for your church.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine Deus beato Petro principe apostolorum intercedente nobis ad veniam proficiat peccatorum.
translation_en: This offering we ask, Lord God, through blessed Peter, the prince of the apostles, may advance us to forgiveness for our sins.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine Deus noster quam tibi ad honorem sancti Samsonis confessoris tui atque pontificis immolando deferimus tuorum nobis tribuat societate gaudere sanctorum.
translation_en: This offering we ask you, Lord our God, which we offer to your honor for the saintly confessor and bishop Samson, may grant us to enjoy fellowship with the saints.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine et locum istum ab immunditiis iniquorum (vel patratae offensionis) expurget et supplicationes nostras hic et ubique tibi reddat acceptas.
translation_en: This offering we ask you, Lord, and may this place be purified from the uncleanness of wicked persons (or covered offenses), and here and everywhere may our petitions be presented to you and accepted.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine pro famulo tuo illo et cunctis sibi adhaerentibus in conspectu pietatis tuae assumatur benigne tuaque super eos benedictio larga descendat quatenus prosperum agentes iter tibi Deo serviant laetiores.
translation_en: This offering we ask, Lord, for your servant and all who are attached to him in the sight of Your mercy, may it be received kindly. May Your rich blessing descend upon them so that, as they journey forward successfully, they may serve You, God, with greater joy.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine pro nobis famulis tuis et cunctis nobis adhaerentibus in conspectu pietatis tuae assumatur benigne tuaque super nos benedictio larga descendat quatenus prosperum agentes iter tibi domino serviamus laetiores.
translation_en: This offering we humbly ask You, Lord, for us Your servants and all of us who cling to Your mercy in Your sight. May it be received kindly by You, and may Your abundant blessing descend upon us, so that serving You, Lord, with joy, we may walk with prosperity.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine quam pro memoria et veneratione passionis et resurrectionis Christi Filii tui Domini nostri tuae maiestati offerimus emundet nostra delicta et nobis ad aeternae redemptionis et salutis remedium proficiat.
translation_en: This hostia we humbly ask, Lord, which for the memory and veneration of the passion and resurrection of Christ, your Son, our Lord, we offer to your majesty. May it purify our sins and may it advance as a remedy for our eternal redemption and salvation.

text: Haec hostia quaesumus Domine tuis conspectibus oblata beati Wulmari abbatis meritis tibi fiat accepta.
translation_en: This offering, we ask you, Lord, presented before your eyes by the merits of blessed Abbot Wulmar, may it be accepted by you.

text: Haec hostia salutaris quaesumus Domine quam in sanctorum apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli atque Andreae omniumque apostolorum veneranda commemoratione tuae maiestati suppliciter offerimus et ligamina nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae charismata tribuat.
translation_en: This salutary offering we humbly ask you, Lord, which on the venerable commemoration of your saints apostles Peter, Paul, and Andrew, and all the apostles, we present to your majesty. May it absolve the bonds of our wickedness and grant us the gifts of your mercy.

text: Haec hostia salutaris quaesumus Domine quam in sancti Albani martyris tui sociorumque eius compassorum veneranda commemoratione tuae maiestati suppliciter offerimus et ligamina nostrae pravitatis absolvat et tuae nobis misericordiae charismata tribuat.
translation_en: This saving host we humbly ask you, Lord, which on the venerable commemoration of your martyr Saint Alban and his companions, we offer to your majesty with great reverence. May it forgive our faults and grant us the gifts of your mercy.

text: Haec igitur praecepta servantes sacrosancta munera nostrae salutis offerimus obsecrantes ut immittere digneris Spiritum Sanctum super haec sollemnia ut fiat nobis legitima eucharistia in tuo filiique tui nomine et Spiritus Sancti benedicta in transformationem corporis ac sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi unigeniti tui edentibus nobis vitam aeternam regnumque perpetuum collatura bibituris.
translation_en: By observing these precepts, we offer our most sacred gifts for the salvation of ours, humbly asking you to send the Holy Spirit upon these solemnities, so that we may receive a legitimate Eucharist in your name and the name of your Son and receive blessed life everlasting and an eternal kingdom when we drink.
