text: Haec in nobis sacrificia Deus et actione permaneant et operatione firmentur.
translation_en: These sacrifices in us, God, persist in their essence and are strengthened by their operation.

text: Haec munera Domine quae in honorem sanctorum tuorum offerimus nos ab omnibus peccatis emundent tibique reddant acceptos.
translation_en: These gifts, Lord, which we offer in honor of your saints, may cleanse us from all sins and make them acceptable to you.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut huic famulo tuo tuo illi qui ad deponendam comam
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, almighty God, that this your servant may lie down with the one who is to lay down his comb.

text: Haec munera Domine ut tua suscipiat maiestas adoranda sanctae Milburgae intercessio exoret gloriosa.
translation_en: These gifts, Lord, may your majesty receive to be worshipped, through the intercession of the glorious Saint Milburga.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine beatae Mariae semper virginis intercessione sanctifica quam in templo tuo munus tibi gratissimum offerri parentum manibus voluisti.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercession of the blessed Mary, ever-virgin, that the gifts offered by parents to be consecrated in your temple may please you most graciously.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine beati Cuthberti confessoris tui atque pontificis intercessione sanctifica et nos famulos tuos a peccatorum omnium maculis clementer emunda.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercession of your blessed Confessor and Bishop Saint Cuthbert, to sanctify these gifts and kindly cleanse us, your servants, from all stains of sin.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine copioso flumine caelestis gratiae perfunde ex qua in salutem populi et Ecclesiae tuae consolationem perpetuam torrens cruoris fluxit de latere tuae iconis furore gentis incredulae perfossae.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to flood these gifts abundantly with the stream of celestial grace, from which a river of blood flowing from your image's side provided eternal comfort for the people and perpetual consolation for your Church, pierced by the rage of the unbelieving mob.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine quae oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus salutaria nobis esse concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant these gifts that we present before your majestic eyes, may they be beneficial for us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut liberis tibi mentibus serviamus
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that we may serve You with free minds.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine quae oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum quarumque commemorationem speciali devotione agimus et quorum quarumque nomina a te inspicienda conscripsimus et pro quibus exorare iussi vel debitores sumus et omnium consanguineorum ac familiarium cunctorumque fidelium salutaria esse concede ut tua pietate vinculis horrendae mortis exutae aeternae beatitudinis mereantur esse participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for these gifts which we present before your majestic eyes on behalf of the souls of your servants and handmaidens whose commemoration we carry out with special devotion, and whose names we have written down for you to inspect, and for whom we have been commanded or are in debt to pray, and may they be beneficial for all their relatives, family members, and faithful followers. By your mercy, release them from the dreadful bonds of death so that they may deserve to participate in eternal beatitude.

text: Haec munera quaesumus Domine clementer suscipe et intercessione beati Kiliani sociorumque eius nobis salutaria esse concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously receive these offerings and through the intercession of blessed Kilian and his companions may they be beneficial for us.

text: Haec munera quaesumus omnipotens Deus per tui nominis invocationem sanctifica et per sanctorum martyrum tuorum Viti Modesti et Crescentiae intercessionem nos a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda ut tuis digni conspectibus semper exsistere mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that through the invocation of your name, these gifts be sanctified, and through the intercession of your saints and martyrs Vitus, Modestus, and Crescentia, we may be cleansed from our sins' stains, and that we may always deserve to stand before you in a worthy manner.

text: Haec nobis communio Domine ad purgationem et intercedente beata semper virgine Maria omnibusque sanctis inimicis famuli tui illius prosit ad emendationem ut et illi ad caritatem fraternam redeant et cor famuli tui de consolatione tua gaudeat.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, is given to us for purification and through the intercession of the blessed ever-virgin Mary and all the saints, may it benefit your servant against his enemies, that he may be amended, return to brotherly love, and rejoice in your consolation.

text: Haec nobis Domine munera sumpta proficiant ut illo iugiter ferveamus spiritu quem apostolis tuis ineffabiliter infudisti.
translation_en: These gifts, Lord, taken by us may profit us so that we may ever burn with the Spirit which you ineffably poured out upon your apostles.

text: Haec nos beata mysteria Deus principia sua aptos efficiant recensere.
translation_en: May God make us fit through these blessed mysteries to review His first principles.

text: Haec nos communio Domine exuat a delictis et ab inimicorum defendat insidiis.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, may purge us from sins and defend us from the tricks of our enemies.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et animae famuli tui illius caelestis gaudii tribuat consortium ut ante thronum gloriae Christi tui segregata cum dextris nihil commune habeat cum sinistris.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, purges us from sin and may the soul of your servant be granted participation in that celestial joy, so that before the throne of Your glory, Christ's, separated on Your right side, it shall have nothing in common with those on the left.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et caelestis remedii faciat esse consortes.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, cleanses us from sin and makes us sharers of celestial remedy.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et famulum tuum benigna pietate conservet.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, cleanses us from sin, and may Your gracious pity preserve Your servant.

text: Haec nos communio Domine purget a crimine et famulum tuum fac reverti ut sicut Iosue furtum Achan absconditum invenit ita patefacere digneris omnia pro quibus petimus divinam clementiam tuam ut non in aeternum abscondat iniquitatem suam sed in praesentiam denudetur suum furtum et confusus veniat et paeniteat reatum suum et misericordiam tuam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: This communion, Lord, purge us from sin and grant that Your servant may return so that, just as Joshua discovered Achan's hidden transgression, You may be pleased to reveal all for which we ask Your divine clemency. May they not forever conceal their iniquity but be brought into the light to expose their theft, and may they come contrite and repentant of their deeds, worthy to attain Your mercy.

text: Haec nos communio Domine salutaris ab omni quaesumus adversitate custodiat et beato Birino intercedente cuius annua translationis festa recolimus sempiternae felicitatis gaudia nobis acquirat.
translation_en: This sacrament, Lord salutary, we ask for protection from every adversity; through the intercession of the blessed Birino, whose annual feast of translation we remember, may it grant us eternal happiness.

text: Haec nos Domine gratia tua quaesumus semper exerceat ut divinis instauret nostra corda mysteriis et sanctae Caeciliae martyris tuae commemoratione laetificet.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that Your grace may always exercise among us, to establish our hearts in the divine mysteries and to rejoice us through the commemoration of Your holy martyr, Saint Cecilia.

text: Haec nos Domine instituta et praecepta retinentes suppliciter oramus uti hoc sacrificium suscipere et benedicere et sanctificare digneris ut fiat nobis eucharistia legitima in tuo filiique tui nomine et Spiritus Sancti in transformationem corporis ac sanguinis domini Dei nostri Iesu Christi unigeniti tui per quem omnia creas creata benedicis benedicta sanctificas et sanctificata largiris Deus qui in Trinitate perfecta vivis et regnas in saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Lord, as we keep Your institutions and precepts, we humbly ask that You deign to receive and bless and sanctify this sacrifice, so that it becomes for us a legitimate Eucharist in Your name and the name of Your Son and of the Holy Spirit, by whom You create all things, bless them, and sanctify them. God who lives and reigns forever in the perfect Trinity.

text: Haec nos Domine quaesumus divini perceptio sacramenti a nostris mundet offensis et famulos tuos a mundi pravitate ereptos ad gaudia sempiterna perducat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you, by the divine perception of the sacrament, to cleanse us from our worldly offenses and to lead your servants, snatched away from the corruption of this world, to eternal joys.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine divini sacramenti perceptio a nostris emundet offensis et famulos tuos a mundanis pravitatibus et omnibus tumultuorum carnalium delectationibus clementer eruat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the reception of this divine sacrament, it may cleanse us from our offenses, and may your servants be freed gently from worldly vices and all the delights of carnal tumults.

text: Haec nos Domine sacramenta quae sumpsimus a cunctis emaculent malis et famulum tuum ab omnibus eximant periculis et perpetuis repleam bonis.
translation_en: O Lord, these sacraments that we have received cleanse us from all evil and make Your servant free from all dangers and fill him with everlasting goods.

text: Haec nos oblatio Deus mundet et renovet gubernet et protegat.
translation_en: This offering purifies, renews, governs, and protects us by God.

text: Haec nos participatio divini mysterii quaesumus Domine mundet a crimine et fideles tuos persecutionem pro iustitia patientes muniat semper et protegat.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that this participation in the divine mystery may cleanse us from sin, and that you always strengthen and protect your faithful who suffer persecution for justice.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine communio sancta laetificet qua beati Thomae confessoris tui suffragantibus meritis et virtutes roborentur interius et actus exterius piae devotionis excrescant.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that this holy communion may rejoice us, through the merits and prayers of your blessed confessor St. Thomas, and that our inner virtues may be strengthened and our external actions may flourish with pious devotion.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine (divini) sacramenti perceptio protegat et famulum tuum (illum) quem pastorem Ecclesiae tuae (prae)esse voluisti una cum commisso (sibi) grege salvet semper et muniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord (divine), that the reception of this sacrament protect us and Your servant (him) whom You have willed to preside as pastor in Your Church, and may he always save and safeguard with the flock committed to him.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine participatio sacramenti et propriis reatibus indesinenter expediat et ab omnibus tueatur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this participation in the sacrament may always cleanse us from our sins and protect us from all dangers.

text: Haec nos quaesumus Domine sacra potenti virtute defensos ab omnibus maligni hostis insidiis et hunc cum suis incolis locum sub tua protectione servent illaesos.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect us by your sacred and powerful strength from all the malicious attacks of the enemy. May this place, along with its inhabitants, remain under your protection unharmed.

text: Haec nos sancta libamina Domine expiatos reddant a crimine quae in apostoli Petri tractamus cathedrali sollemnitate.
translation_en: These holy books, Lord, may they purify us from the sin we are dealing with concerning Apostle Peter at this solemn cathedral ceremony.

text: Haec oblata tibi Domine sacrificia clementer intuere ( lac. ) meorumque peccatorum maculas abstergant.
translation_en: These offerings presented to You, Lord, may You, in Your mercy, behold them. May they wash away the stains of my sins.

text: Haec oblatio Domine ab omnibus nos purget offensis quae in ara crucis etiam totius mundi tulit offensa(m).
translation_en: This offering, Lord, from all of us cleanses the offenses which on the cross and even for the whole world, you bore the offense.

text: Haec oblatio Domine Deus cordis nostri maculas emundet ut Sancti Spiritus digna efficiatur habitatio.
translation_en: This offering, Lord God, cleanse our hearts, that by the Holy Spirit it may become worthy of dwelling.

text: Haec oblatio Domine Deus intercedente beato Mellito pontifice nos ab omnibus emundet peccatis et tota virtute tuis faciat servire mandatis.
translation_en: This offering, Lord God, with the intervention of blessed Mellitus, our bishop, may purify us from all sins and make us serve your commandments through all your power.

text: Haec oblatio Domine interveniente beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae merito sanctique Petri principis apostolorum necnon et tuorum Benedicti Martini Swithuni confessurum omniumque sanctorum suffragio ad perpetuam mihi proficiat indulgentiam et sacerdotibus pro quibus intervenio sufficientiam.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, with the intervention of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, and the righteous Peter, the prince of the apostles, as well as Benedict, Martin, Swithun, and all saints, may through their intercession bring about for me eternal indulgence and sufficiency for the priests for whom I intervene.

text: Haec oblatio Domine pro tribulatione qua gravamur grata tibi reddatur atque in omni angustia laetificatio caelestis nobis augeatur.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, for the trouble that weighs upon us, may be pleasing to You and in every distress may our celestial consolation be increased.

text: Haec oblatio Domine quaesumus nobis remissionem omnium peccatorum et verae humilitatis obtineat gratiam simulque ut a cordibus nostris concupiscentiam carnis et oculorum atque ambitionem saeculi auferas quatenus coram te sobrie iuste pieque viventes praemia consequamur aeterna.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we humbly ask for remission of all our sins and that the grace of true humility be granted to us. Simultaneously, may you remove from our hearts the desire for flesh and eyes, and ambition for worldly things, so that while living before you in sobriety, justice, and piety, we may obtain eternal rewards.

text: Haec oblatio Domine quaesumus quam iterata sancti confessoris tui Martini festivitate tuae offerimus maiestati nobis prosit ad indulgentiam ut per eam a nostris liberemur peccatis et sacris altaribus adstare digni efficiamur.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, we humbly ask that as it is repeated on the feast day of your saint confessor Martin, we present to Your majesty. May it benefit us with indulgence, so that through it we may be freed from our sins and deemed worthy to stand before Your sacred altars.

text: Haec oblatio Domine sicut incensum iri conspectum tuum cum odore suavitatis adscendat et praeclara beati Barnabae apostoli tui intercessione nobis instantis futuraeque vitae subsidia conferat.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, like incense ascending before your face with the sweetness of its fragrance, may reach your presence. Through the intercession of your blessed apostle Barnabas, may it provide us with help in our present need and support for our future life.

text: Haec oblatio Domine ut tibi possit placere sanctum Leothardum pontificem quaesumus fac obtinere.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, may it please you to grant a holy Bishop Leothard. We humbly request that you bestow upon him.

text: Haec oblatio quaesumus Domine animam famuli tui illius ab omnibus vitiis humanae condicionis absolvat quae totius mundi tulit etiam immolata peccatum.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to free the soul of Your servant from all the vices of human condition that it carried even when sacrificed for the sins of the entire world.

text: Haec oblatio quaesumus omnipotens Deus animam famuli tui illius ab omnibus vitiis humanae condicionis absolvat ut perpetuam tuae beatitudinis misericordiam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: This offering we humbly ask, Almighty God, to free the soul of your servant from all the vices of human condition, that he may deserve eternal mercy of your blessedness.

text: Haec oblatio quaesumus Domine omnium sanctorum precibus et meritis in conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae assumpta me famulum tuum ab omnibus vitiis et fraudibus inimici defensum te miserante tibi iugiter digne deservire imploret ab ipso sanctificata a quo sumpsit exordium.
translation_en: This offering we humbly ask you, Lord, through the prayers and merits of all saints, that you take into the sight of your divine majesty your servant me, defended from all vices and deceits of the enemy. May I, through your mercy, ever be worthy to serve you. He asks this of himself, sanctified by whom I have received my beginning.

text: Haec oblatio quaesumus Domine omnium sanctorum precibus et meritis suffragantibus tibi grata fiat et nos ab omni reatu gratia largiente misericorditer absolvat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this offering be pleasing to you through the prayers and merits of all saints, and that you mercifully grant us absolution from every guilt.

text: Haec oblatio quam tibi offerimus Domine nos purget ab omni crimine quo per beatae illius intercessionem cuius sacram festivitatem recolimus aeternam consequi felicitatem mereamur.
translation_en: This offering which we present to You, Lord, may purge us from all sin for which we hope to merit eternal happiness through the intercession of the blessed one whose sacred feast day we remember.

text: Haec perceptio sacri corporis et sanguinis omnipotens Deus populum christianae fidei subditum protegat et a gentibus quae te ignorant Deum defendat.
translation_en: May the Almighty God protect this reception of the sacred body and blood and shield those of the Christian faith from all heathen people who do not acknowledge God.

text: Haec quae nos reparent quaesumus Domine beata mysteria suo munere dignos efficiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the sacred mysteries presented to us may be worthy through your grace.

text: Haec sacra nos Domine mundet oblatio quam in conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae devota mente deferimus et concede nobis famulis tuis ut per venerabile sanctum sepulcrum tuum purificatis mentibus ad caelestia regna pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: This sacred offering, Lord, may this presentation cleanse us, which we offer to your divine majesty with a devoted mind. Grant us, your servants, that through your venerable holy sepulcher we may be purified in spirit and worthy to reach the heavenly kingdoms.

text: Haec sacra quaesumus Domine quae pro venerandis beati Paulini confessoris tui atque pontificis deferimus meritis peccatorum nostrorum vincula solvant et eius obtentu ab omnibus tueantur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for these sacred things that we bring forward on behalf of the venerable blessed Pope and Confessor Paulinus. May the merits of our sins break the bonds, and through his intercession may they be protected from all adversities.

text: Haec sacrificia Christi humilitatem significantia quaesumus Domine propitiatus suscipe et concede ut veram per haec eadem consequi mereamur humilitatem.
translation_en: These sacrifices of Christ, signifying His humility, we humbly ask, Lord, may You be merciful and grant us that through these same sacrifices, we may truly deserve His humility.

text: Haec sacrificia nos omnipotens Deus potenti virtute mundatos ad suum faciant puriores venire principium.
translation_en: These sacrifices, Almighty God, by your mighty power cleanse us; may they make us come to you, the beginning, more pure.

text: Haec sacra nos Domine potenti virtute mundatos ad suum faciant puriores venire principium.
translation_en: May this sacred power, Lord, cleanse us with its mighty virtue, and make us come nearer to You, the beginning of a purer state.

text: Haec sacrificia quae sumpsimus Domine meritis et intercessione omnium sanctorum nobis proficiant ad salutem et viventibus atque defunctis omnibus christianis te favente aeterna ac temporalia praemia benigne acquirant.
translation_en: These sacrifices which we have received, Lord, may, through the merits and intercession of all the saints, profit us for salvation and acquire, both for the living and the dead, eternal and temporal rewards, with Your favor.

text: Haec sacrificia quae sumpsimus Domine per intercessionem sanctorum tuorum martyrum et consessorum nobis proficiant ad salutem et famulis et famulabus tuis quorum eleemosynae caritatis in amore tui nominis nobis spiritaliter collatae sunt tam vivis quam et mortuis proficiant in augmentum ut quibus donasti baptismi sacramentum donare digneris consortium regni caelestis.
translation_en: These sacrifices which we have taken, Lord, through the intercession of your saints, martyrs and confessors, may they benefit us for salvation, both for your servants and for those who serve you. May the alms of charity bestowed upon us in love of your name, spiritually brought to us, whether living or dead, bring profit for an increase, so that you may deem worthy to grant to those to whom you have given the sacrament of baptism a share in the kingdom of heaven.

text: Haec sacrosancta sumpta mysteria nobis effectum Domine conferant salutarem quorum beatus Ricardus confessor tuus atque pontifex devotus exstitit dispensator.
translation_en: These sacred mysteries, bestowed upon us, Lord, may grant us a salutary effect; your blessed confessor and devoted bishop, Richard, stood as their administrator.

text: Haec sancta Domine quae indignis manibus tractamus intercessione beati Erkenwaldi praesulis tuae sint maiestati accepta ut ab omni nos muniant inimicorum molestia et ad dona perducant caelestia.
translation_en: Lord, these holy things which we handle unworthily, through the intercession of your bishop Saint Erkenwald may they be acceptable to Your majesty. Protect us from all the trouble of our enemies and lead us to heavenly gifts.

text: Haec sancta quae sumpsimus sacramenta quaesumus Domine maiestati tuae efficiantur gratuita et interveniente beato Erasmo martyre tuo atque pontifice vitae in nobis aeternae nutriant alimenta.
translation_en: These holy sacraments which we have received, we humbly beseech You, Lord, may they become effective gratuitously and through the intervention of the blessed Erasmus, Your martyr and bishop, may they nourish in us the food for eternal life.

text: Haec sunt Christe Domine sacrosancta novi libamina testamenti quae tibi in commemorationem tuae passionis offerri iussisti. Hoc vere sacrificium salutare per quod dum tibi humanum genus reconcilias regno tuae maiestatis adsocias. Precamur igitur omnipotens Deus noster ut supplicationi nostrae placabilis adsis et sanctificationem tuae benedictionis huic hostiae propitiatus adspires Descendat de regali tuae solio potestatis angelus pacis et gratiae qui et oblata sanctificet et vota populi serenitatis tuae nutibus repraesentet.  Quaesumus ineffabilis Trinitas Deus ut hoc tibi holocaustum ob honorificentiam tui sacerdotis oblatum legitimum efficias et acceptum. Proficiat ad fortitudinem sanis ad medelam aegrotis ad castitatem lascivis ad oboedientiam tumidis ad concordiam odiosis ad perseverantiam iam pacatis ad sublevamen oppressis ad consolationem afflictis ad receptionem patriae peregrinis ad gubernationem egenis ad indulgentiam reis ad emendationem omnimodam depravatis ut quicumque ex hac victima spiritali libaverint et cunctis bonis exuberent et malis omnibus caruisse tripudient.
translation_en:
These are, O Christ, Lord, the sacred new testament's unleavened loaves which you have commanded to be offered in remembrance of your passion. This truly saving sacrifice through which while reconciling the human race to your majesty, associates them with your kingdom. We therefore pray, Almighty God, that you are favorable to our supplication and that you reveal your sanctification and blessing upon this offering.
May an angel of peace and grace descend from your royal throne of power, who will both sanctify the offering and present the petitions of your people to your serenity.
We humbly ask, O ineffable Trinity, God, that you make this holocaust offered out of respect for your priesthood legitimate and acceptable. May it benefit the strong with strength, the sick with healing, the lustful with chastity, the proud with obedience, the quarrelsome with harmony, the recently peaceful with perseverance, the oppressed with relief, the afflicted with comfort, the foreigners with reception into your country, the needy with governance, the penitent with indulgence, the corrupt with amendment of every kind, so that whoever partakes in this spiritual victim may overflow with all good things and lack all evil. May they rejoice.

text: Haec sunt Domine verissima novi testamenti edicta libamina per quae tibi humanum genus reconcilians totius mundi deleta sunt crimina. Haec duo a te elicita munera quae tibi Melchisedech typicus ille sacerdos caeli domino obtulit atque ut a nobis in veritate offerretur praemisit. Sanctificet quaeso descendens tuus patrisque Spiritus Sanctus haec oblata sacrificia et faciat plenissime tui corporis sanguinisque conformia ut haec tria corpus sanguis et aqua per quae abluimur pascimur et sanamur percipientium protinus morbos excludant et indeficientem salutem adhibeant.
translation_en: These are indeed, Lord, the truthful decrees of the New Testament, the written documents through which the human race is reconciled and the sins of the entire world are erased. These two gifts drawn from you were offered by Melchisedech, that typical high priest of heaven, to the Lord of heaven, and he prefigured them for us to be offered truly. I humbly ask that your descending Holy Spirit sanctify these offered sacrifices, and may it make them perfectly conformed to your body and blood, so that these three - body, blood, and water through which we are washed, nourished, and healed - immediately exclude diseases and bestow an unfailing health.

text: Haec sunt verba haec sunt carmina quae redemptoris nostri lingua prolata noscuntur. Haec sunt verba quae magis ostendunt domini beneficium quam imponunt servientibus famulatum. Haec sunt verba quae dum oboedientiam impetrant servitutis precem commemorant libertatis. Pro qua re pater offerimus tibi victimam non thure fumidam non sanguine maculatam sed puram sanctam atque rationabilem pro remediis criminum et pro ablutione criminum pro quiete defunctorum et pro incolumitate oppressorum ut illos mitior custodia teneat et istis altior custodia teneatur; pro salute principum et tranquillitate populorum ut habeant de clementia motum et illi non sustineant de infestatione supplicium; pro fecunditate frugum aerisque temperie ut dum nos tuis reficis donis veneremur indesinenter quae oboedienter intellegis famulari; et peccatorum nostrorum obsoleta corrige; facias in iudicio securos quos cognoscis conscientia culpabiles et quia cuncti factu dictu cogitatu visuque polluimur tu solus qui cognoscis latentia dimitte universa nostra peccata.
translation_en: These are the words, these are the hymns that we know were uttered by our Redeemer in his language. These are the words that more clearly show the Lord's blessing than they impose service upon servants. These are the words that while demanding obedience, remind of the prayer of freedom. For this reason, Father, we offer to you a victim not smoky with incense nor stained with blood, but pure, holy and reasonable, for remedies of sin and for the cleansing of sin, for the peace of the deceased and for the safety of the oppressed; so that they may be held by a mild guardian and you may be held by a higher one; for the health of rulers and the tranquility of the people so that they may have movement from your mercy and those not suffer from harassment as punishment; for fruitfulness of crops and temperature of air, so that while you refresh us with your gifts we may ever reverence those gifts which you understand are obediently served; and correct our outdated sins; make secure in judgment those whom you know to be conscious of guilt, and because all are polluted by deed, speech, thought, sight, you alone who know the hidden things forgive all our sins.

text: Haec tibi Domine Deus qui nos et inimicos diligere et pro persequentibus vis orare grata sit oblatio et sic nos de adversariorum nostrorum laetifica correctione ut ipsi irae tuae non sentiant ultionem.
translation_en: Lord, You who love us and our enemies, and pray for those who persecute You, may this offering be pleasing to You. And so, through the correction of our adversaries, may we rejoice. May they not experience Your vengeance themselves.

text: Haec tibi Domine oblata benignus sanctificanda assume libamina ut eorum perceptione expiemur a crimine et adventus Filii tui gloriam mereamur interriti praestolari.
translation_en: To you, Lord, these offerings presented are kindly purified and consecrated. May the wine be acceptable to you, that through its consumption we may be forgiven of sin and deserve the awe-filled anticipation of the coming of your Son.

text: Haec tibi Domine quaesumus beati Cuthberti pontificis tui intercessione nunc grata reddatur oblatio et per eam maiestati tuae nostrum famulatum perfice mundum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this offering made to you may now be returned in your grace, through the intercession of your bishop Saint Cuthbert. And may through it your service be completed on our behalf.

text: Haec tibi hostia quaesumus Domine sit acceptabilis et pro nobis tuus intercedat Grimbaldus confessor venerabilis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that this offering be acceptable to You, and may Grimbald, the worthy confessor, intercede on our behalf.

text: Haec tibi munera Domine accepta reddantur et sancti Iudoci interventu corda nostra electa tibi hospitia efficiantur.
translation_en: These gifts, Lord, may be received by you and returned, and through the intervention of Saint Jude, may our chosen hearts be made worthy to be your guests.

text: Praeveniat hunc famulum tuum quaesumus Domine misericordia
translation_en: May this, Your servant, be preceded by Your mercy, we ask You, Lord.

text: Haec tibi pater sancte licet meis manibus offerantur qui nec invocatione tui nominis dignus sum tamen quia per sanctum atque sanctificatum Filii tui nomen oblationes offeruntur sicut incensum in conspectu tuo cum odore suavitatis adscendant.
translation_en: These, Holy Father, are offered to you by my unworthy hands, who am not worthy of your invocation by name. Yet because offerings are made through the holy and sanctified name of your Son, they are as incense in your presence with a sweet-smelling offering.

text: Haec tua Domine sumpta sacra communio sicut fidelium in te unionem praesignat sic in tua ecclesia unitatis quaesumus operetur effectum.
translation_en: These sacred offerings, Lord, as a sign of the unity of your faithful, we ask that they operate effectively within your church.

text: Haec victima Domine quaesumus pro beatae virginis Margaretae martyrio oblata et mentium nobis sanctitatem et corporum obtineat castitatem.
translation_en: This sacrifice, Lord, we ask on behalf of the blessed Virgin Margaret's martyrdom. May it grant us holiness in mind and bodily chastity.

text: Hanc Domine quaesumus oblationem pro commemoratione beati Marci tibi oblatam benigne conruere et praesta ut et nomini tuo ad gloriam et nobis proficiat ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that this offering made for the remembrance of blessed Mark be pleasing to you. Grant that it may benefit your glory and us, bringing healing.

text: Hanc hostiam omnipotens Deus et pater nobis beati Patricii confessoris tui atque pontificis reddat deprecatio profuturam quam in eius honorem hodierna die tuae offerimus maiestati.
translation_en: May the omnipotent God and our Father, blessed Patricius your confessor and bishop, grant that this offering we present today to Your Majesty on his honor be fruitful.

text: Hanc igitur Domine oblationem quam pro famulo tuo illo tuae pietati offerimus pius ac propitius suscipe et omnium peccatorum suorum vincula quibus propria accusante conscientia miserabiliter constringitur intercessione Dei Genitricis propitiatus absolve et pro his veram puramque coram te confessionem et dignam fructuosamque agere paenitentiam et plenissimam illi gratuito dono tribue indulgentiam.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we humbly offer this oblation for your servant. Receive it graciously and propitiously, and absolve him from the chains of his sins, which he is accused by a sorrowful conscience. Through the intercession of the merciful God the Mother, grant that he may truly, purely, and worthily make confession before you, and bring forth a fruitful penance. Bestow upon him the fullest grace as an unmerited gift.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem terribilis et piissime pater beata Maria Magdalena suarum cumulet precum incrementis et ad nostrae restaurationis principium flagitet profuturam.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering, most terrible and most merciful Father, we humbly pray that through the intercessions of blessed Mary Magdalene, it may be fruitful for our restoration.

text: Hanc igitur oblationis hostiam terribilis et piissime Deus beata Maria Magdalena suarum precum cumulet incrementis et ad remedium nobis provenire deposcat.
translation_en: Therefore, may this offering of the host be presented by the most terrible and most merciful God, together with the prayers of blessed Mary Magdalene, increase and come to our aid.

text: Hanc in conspectu divinae et tremendae maiestatis tuae Domine placationis hostiam beati Marci evangelistae tui intercessio veneranda commendet quae quidem angelicis tibi manibus oblata tuaque dextera benedicta ab omni nos abluat peccatorum labe purgatos.
translation_en: In the presence of your divine and awesome majesty, Lord, may this offering for propitiation, dedicated to your blessed apostle St. Mark, be committed through his venerable intercession. Indeed, presented by angelic hands to you, may your blessed right hand wash us from all the stain of sin, purified.

text: Hanc in conspectu gloriosae magnitudinis tuae oblationis hostiam quaesumus Domine Deus Pater omnipotens beati Floriani martyris tui digna commendet oratio qui sanctae caritatis tuae devictus amore propriam sui corporis hostiam in odorem suavitatis tibi obtulit vivam.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord God and Father Almighty, that the offering of the host presented before your glorious majesty, be commended by your prayer to your blessed martyr Florian, who, conquered by the love of your holy charity, offered his own body as a living sacrifice to your pleasant odor.

text: Hanc oblationem Domine quaesumus beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae interventione sanctifica ut tuae maiestati oblata ad expianda totius populi tui prosit delicta.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this offering be sanctified by the intervention of the blessed Mother of God, Mary. May it benefit your majesty as it is offered to atone for the sins of all your people.

text: Hanc oblationem mysterii tui Domine clementer sanctifica et amore beatae Mariae Magdalenae amatricis Filii tui Iesu Christi Domini nostri semper et ubique nos tuum ad amorem informa.
translation_en: Lord, graciously sanctify this offering of your mystery and form us in the love of the blessed Mary Magdalene, companion of your Son Jesus Christ, our Lord always and everywhere.

text: Hanc oblationem quaesumus Domine caelesti benedictione prosequere et concede ut ei ad salutem proveniat cuius in hoc loco stipendiis nostra tibi servitus vegetata ministrat.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to follow with celestial blessing this offering and grant that it may come to the salvation of him for whom, on this place, our service nourished by stipends ministers to You.

text: Hanc oblationem quaesumus Domine quam tibi pro incolumitate famuli tui illius offerimus benignus assume ut per haec sancta mentis et corporis sanitatem obtinens gloriam aeternae beatitudinis acquirat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive this offering that we present to you on behalf of the well-being of your servant. May you be gracious and assume it, so that through these holy offerings, attaining the health of mind and body, may he acquire the glory of eternal beatitude.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi et hos electos
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you graciously hear our prayers and these chosen ones.

text: Hanc oblationem quaesumus Domine Deus quam tuae maiestati pro peccatis nostris offerimus propitiatus respice et produc de oculis nostris lacrimarum flumina quibus debita flammarum incendia valeant exstingui.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord God, that this offering which we present to your majesty for our sins, may be accepted by you. Look upon us with favor and let the rivers of tears that we owe flow from our eyes, so that the appropriate flames of punishment may be extinguished.

text: Hanc quaesumus Domine oblationem suscipe quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo qui de suis iustis laboribus ecclesiis tuis ministrat; tribue ei pro parvis magna pro terrenis caelestia pro temporalibus sempiterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive this offering that we present to you on behalf of your servant who ministers to your churches from among his just labors; grant him small things in great measure, earthly things in heavenly form, temporal things in eternal terms.

text: Hanc quoque oblationem Domine digneris quaesumus misericorditer benedicere et clementer sanctificare quam tibi pro remissione peccatorum nostrorum vel pro requie defunctorum fratrum offerimus ut tua sanctificatio salus sit et defensio omnium animarum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you deign to bless and sanctify this offering with mercy. May it be offered to you either for the forgiveness of our sins or for the rest of our deceased brothers. Let your sanctification be their salvation and protection.

text: Hanc quoque oblationem Domine dignare quaesumus misericorditer benedicere et clementer sanctificare quam tibi offerimus pro vivorum salute et mortuorum requie ut tua sanctificatio sit salus et defensio animarum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you graciously bless and holy sanctify this offering as well. We present it to you for the salvation of the living and rest for the dead. May your sanctification be their salvation and defense.

text: Has hostias Domine quas nomini tuo dicandas offerimus pro commemoratione animae famuli tui illius debitum tibi munus nos immolare concede.
translation_en: We offer these hosts, Lord, to be consecrated by your name, in remembrance of the soul of your servant. Grant us the duty to offer you this fitting gift.

text: Has hostias quaesumus Domine quas maiestati tuae consecrandas offerimus interveniente beato Wolfgango confessore tuo atque pontifice ad perpetuam atque praesentem fac nobis <pro>venire salutem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to accept these offerings which we present for your majesty. May blessed Wolfgang, your confessor and bishop, intervene for us. Grant that they may come to us forever and now for the salvation.

text: Has oblationes et sincera libamina immolamus tibi Domine Iesu Christe qui passus es pro nobis et resurrexisti tertia die a mortuis pro animabus carorum nostrorum et cararum nostrarum quorum nomina recitamus et quorumcumque non recitamus sed a te recitantur in libro vitae aeternae; propter misericordiam tuam accipe.
translation_en: These offerings and sincere prayers we dedicate to you, Lord Jesus Christ, who suffered for us and rose again on the third day from the dead, for the souls of our departed ones and for ours. For whose names we recite, and for those whom we do not recite but are recorded in the book of eternal life; through your mercy, receive them.

text: Has tibi Domine Deus offerimus oblationes pro salute nostra quatenus animam nostram (animas nostras) Sancti Spiritus gratia illuminare digneris.
translation_en: To You, Lord God, we offer these oblations for our salvation, may the grace of the Holy Spirit deem it worthy to enlighten our soul (our souls).

text: Hanc tibi Domine Deus offero oblationem pro salute animae meae quatenus eam Sancti Spiritus gratia illuminare digneris.
translation_en: I offer this oblation to You, Lord God, for the health of my soul. May it be worthy of being illuminated by the grace of the Holy Spirit.

text: Has tibi Domine in sollemnitate tuorum sanctorum Adriani atque Nataliae victimas offerentes adclines te supplicatione rogamus ut eorum intercedentibus meritis des veniam nostris peccatis ac benedictionem his impertias sacrificiis quo exemplo Nataliae quae viri sui sanguine se laetabatur perunctam nos quoque de corpore et sanguine Filii tui libantes consecutos nos gaudeamus spiritus unctionem internam et misericordiam copiosam.
translation_en: In the solemnity of your saints Adrian and Natalia, offering victims to you, Lord, we humbly beseech you to incline towards us with supplication. We ask that through their merits, they may intercede for us to grant us forgiveness for our sins and bestow blessings upon these sacrifices. As an example, Natalia, who rejoiced in the blood of her husband, we too are offered from the body and blood of your Son. May we receive the internal anointing and abundant mercy.

text: Hilares Domine celebramus festa sollemnia confessoris tuae Leucadiae cuius fiducialis oratio superbum conteruit inimicum. Ob hoc namque in sede laetatur aeterna et gaudet felix in patria gloriosa. Ipsius meritis concede quaesumus nobis Domine aeternam caelestis patriae sedem et hanc nostris e manibus suscipe placatus oblationem ut facta patrum fratrum carorumque nostrorum commemoratione eos in aeterna digneris beatitudine collocare.
translation_en: We rejoice, O Lord, in celebrating the solemn feast of your confessor Leucadia, whose faithful prayer brought low the proud enemy. Therefore, the eternal one rejoices in his seat and the blessed one rejoices in his glorious homeland. We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us an eternal place in the celestial fatherland through the merits of this saint. And we present to you, O Lord, this pleasing offering from our hands, that through the commemoration of our fathers, brothers and dear ones, you may deem them worthy of eternal beatitude.

text: His Domine sacrificiis quaesumus concede placatus ut qui propriis oramus absolvi delictis non gravemur externis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you through these offerings, grant us your favor so that those who pray for themselves may be absolved of their sins and not be burdened by external ones.

text: His hostiis Domine quaesumus apostolicae gratiae nobis dignitas cooperetur ut quod debetur sacrosanctae emissioni nostrae proveniat fragilitati.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the dignity of the apostolic grace may be granted to us, so that what is due to our sacred offering may come forth in our frailty.

text: His nobis Domine mysteriis conferatur quo terrena desideria mitigantes discamus habere caelestia.
translation_en: Lord, may these mysteries be granted to us, so that by lessening our earthly desires, we may learn to possess heavenly things.

text: His nos Domine sacramentis semper natalis instauret cuius nobilitas singularis humanam rep(p)ulit vetustatem.
translation_en: May this Lord, through His sacraments of eternal nativity, always renew us; whose nobility singularly overcame human age-old decay.

text: His nostris quaesumus placare libaminibus clementissime Deus et offerentium votis adesto propitius. Haec tibi litat in Ecclesia tua sancta catholica tuorum officiositas sacerdotum in honorem et commemorationem sanctorum tuorum pro removendo universae cladis interitu ac tribuenda salute populorum pro totius quoque mortis occasu vel requie et indulgentia defunctorum ut et illos in pace refrigeres et nobis omnibus immaculatae vitae subsidium praestes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, most kind God, to favorably hear our prayers with your clemency and attend propitiously to those offering them. May these words be pleasing in your holy Catholic Church, to the performance of your duties by your servants, for the honor and commemoration of your saints, for removing all calamity and bestowing health upon people, for every end or rest of death and indulgence for the departed souls, so that you may refresh them in peace and provide us all with a support of an immaculate life.

text: His praesentibus sacrificiis quaesumus Domine et vitia <nostra> curentur et iusta desideria compleantur.
translation_en: With these present sacrifices we humbly ask, Lord, that our vices be removed and our just desires be fulfilled.

text: His quaesumus Domine muneribus intende placatus et tribue supplicatione gloriosi protomartyris tui Stephani nos a peccatis omnibus absolvi et caelesti gratia ditari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, direct your attention with favor and grant us the petition of your glorious first martyr Stephen. May we be freed from all sins and enriched by heavenly grace.

text: His quaesumus Domine oblationibus beati Bedae confessoris tui atque presbyteri complacatus orationibus a peccatis omnibus emundatus nosmetipsos tibi sacrificium perficias.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, that with the offerings of Your blessed confessor and priest, Bede, being made clean from all sins through pleasing prayers, we may ourselves perform a sacrifice to You.

text: His quaesumus Domine placatus intende muneribus et quod ad laudem tui nominis supplicantes offerimus ad indulgentiam proficiat defunctorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you, being pleased, pay heed to the gifts and may what we present as supplicants for the sake of your name's praise profit for the remission of sins for the deceased.

text: His quaesumus Domine sacrificiis quibus purgationem et viventibus tribuis et defunctis animam famuli tui benignus absolve ut resurrectionis diem spe certae gratulationis exspectet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the sacrifices by which you grant purgation to both the living and the dead, be merciful to your servant and absolve him. May he expect the day of resurrection with certain hope of joyful anticipation.

text: His sacramentis praesentibus quaesumus Domine intende placatus; hanc quoque oblationem pro nostra afflictione tibi fidissime oblatam benignissime suscipe quatenus de nortmannica praesenti calamitate mereamur liberari citissime atque deinceps in tuis praeceptis te miserante devotissime persistere.
translation_en: In the presence of these sacraments, we humbly ask you, Lord, to turn your favorable gaze; also receive this offering on behalf of our affliction most graciously. May we deserve to be quickly freed from the current calamity of the Northmen, and afterward, through your mercy, to persist devoutly in your commandments.

text: His sacrificiis Domine benigne acceptis mihi nostrisque consacerdotibus sacerdotii dignitatem largire indignis ut qui gravamur pondere nostrae fragilitatis tua gratia impertiente reddamur apti his mysteriis.
translation_en: Lord, graciously accept these sacrifices of ours. Grant us and our ordained priests the dignity of the priesthood, unworthy as we are, that we who are burdened by the weight of our fragility may, through your grace, be made fit for these mysteries.

text: His sacrificiis Domine anima famulae tuae illius a peccatis omnibus exuatur sine quibus a culpa nemo liber exsistit ut per haec pia(e) placationis officia perpetuam misericordiam consequatur.
translation_en: With these sacrifices, Lord, may the soul of your servant be cleansed from all sins; for without them no one can exist free from guilt. May they attain eternal mercy through these acts of pious appeasement.

text: His sacrificiis quaesumus Domine beata virgine tua Milburga intercedente cunctae plebis tuae peccamina misericordia dele.
translation_en: Through these sacrifices, we humbly ask you, Lord, through your blessed virgin Milburga, that you may wipe away the sins of all your people with your mercy.

text: His sacrificiis quaesumus omnipotens Deus purgata anima et spiritus famuli tui illius episcopi ad indulgentiam et refrigerium sempiternum pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God to cleanse the soul and spirit of your servant, that bishop, to merit eternal indulgence and refreshment.

text: Hoc agentes apud te pater sancte redemptricem nostram unigeniti tui mortem sicut ipse praecepit usque in adventum ipsius nuntiamus. Nos eum pro nobis annuntiamus mortuum esse; tu commoriendi tribue dignitatem. Nos eum resurrexisse credimus; tu praesta ut cottidianis nostris liberemur a lapsibus. Nos eum credimus et annuntiamus ad iudicium esse venturum; tu praesta talem conversationem ut eius terribilem adventum propitium mereamur.  Hanc quoque oblationem ut accepta habeas et benedicas supplices exoramus sicut accepta habuisti munera Abel pueri tui iusti et sacrificium patriarchae patris nostri Abrahae et quod tibi obtulit summus sacerdos tuus Melchisedech.  Descendat hic quaeso invisibiliter benedictio tua sicut quondam in patrum hostiis visibiliter descendebat. Adscendat odor suavitatis in conspectu divinae maiestatis tuae ex hoc sublimi altario tuo per manus angeli tui et deferatur in ista sollemnia spiritus tuus sanctus qui tam adstantis quam offerentis populi et oblata pariter et vota sanctificet.  Ut quicumque ex hoc corpore libaverimus sumamus nobis medelam animae ad sananda cordium vulnera ad expellendas de cogitationibus cordis nostri omnes imagines vanitatis ad eradicanda funditus odia vel vitia terrena ad plantandam perpetuam caritatem quae operit multitudinem peccatorum ut vere hic sanguis sacer Filii tui Domini nostri ita peccata nostra diluat potatus sicut quondam nos redemit effusus.
translation_en:
Acting on your behalf, we announce before you, holy Father, the death of our Redeemer, Your only-begotten Son, as He Himself commanded us until His very coming. We proclaim that He has died for us; grant Him the dignity of rising again. We believe in His resurrection; may He free us daily from our sins. We believe and announce that He will come again for judgment; may You bestow upon us such conduct that we may deserve His terrifying advent to be propitious.
We also humbly entreat You to receive this offering and bless it, as You accepted the offerings of Abel, Your righteous son, and the sacrifice of our father Abraham, and what Your high priest Melchizedek presented to You.
We pray that Your invisible blessing may descend here, just as it once descended visibly upon the sacrifices of the fathers. May a sweet-smelling aroma rise before Your divine majesty from this sublime altar through the hands of Your angel and may Your holy spirit be brought to this solemnity, which will sanctify both the offerings and our prayers.
Whatever part we offer from this body, we take as a remedy for our souls to heal the wounds of our hearts, drive away all images of vanity, eradicate completely the earthly hatreds or vices, plant perpetual charity that covers the multitude of sins, so that truly here the sacred blood of Your Son, our Lord, may wash away our sins as it once redeemed us, poured out.

text: Hoc ergo facimus Domine haec praecepta servamus hanc sacri corporis passionem sacris sollemnibus praedicamus; quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut veritatem nunc sacramenti caelestis exsequimur ipsi veritati dominici corporis ac sanguinis haereamus.
translation_en: Therefore, we do this, Lord. We keep these precepts. We proclaim the solemnity of this sacred body's passion with these sacred rites; we humbly ask the almighty God that, as we now carry out the truth of this heavenly sacrament, we may remain attached to the truth of our Lord's body and blood.

text: Hoc munus populi tui Domine levitae et protomartyris tui Stephani deprecatione sit gratum ut Ecclesia tua eius semper intercessionibus adiuvetur cuius sine cessatione instruitur disciplinis.
translation_en: This gift of your people, Lord, to the Levite and protomartyr Stephen, may it be pleasing through his intercession that your Church is always helped by his constant intercessions, who without ceasing is instructed in discipline.

text: Hoc munus testimonium vivificae passionis Filii tui Domine pro commemoratione summi sacerdotis tui Dunstani tibi oblatum tua benedictione eius meritis nobis ad gustum salutis aeternae sanctifica.
translation_en: This gift is a testimony of the vivifying passion of Your Son, Lord, offered to You for the commemoration of Your high priesthood Dunstan, may it be sanctified by Your blessing and the merits of Your Son, so that we may taste eternal salvation.

text: Hoc nobis tuum quaesumus Domine sacramentum sit abolitio peccatorum sit fortitudo fragilitatis humanae sit contra mundi pericula firmamentum. Haec nos communio purget a crimine et caelestis gaudii tribuat esse consortes.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that this sacrament of Yours may be the remission of sins, the strength against human frailty, the fortress against worldly dangers. This communion may cleanse us from sin and grant us to be sharers in celestial joy.

text: Hoc sacrificium ieiunii litatione dicatum quaesumus Deus pater sanctifica ut ex eo libantibus sit correctio morum sit indulgentia criminum; concedatur etiam et caelestis gloriae summa virtutum.
translation_en: This sacrifice, fasted and offered with this liturgical prayer, we humbly ask God the Father to sanctify. May it be a correction of morals for those partaking, and a forgiveness of sins; and may also the summit of celestial glory and supreme virtues be granted.

text: Hoc sacrificium devotionis nostrae quaesumus omnipotens Deus clementer respice et intercedente beato Edmundo rege et martyre tuo pro hac familia tua placatus assume.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God, in His clemency, to look upon this sacrifice of our devotion. Through the intercession of Blessed King Edmund and your martyr, may He be pleased to accept it on behalf of Your family.

text: Hodierna festivitatis sacratissimi prophetae tui Eliae officia Domine persolventes precamur clementiam tuam ut haec sancta quae in eius sollemnitate sumpsimus sacrificia nobis tuis famulis proficiant ad remedium salutis aeternae.
translation_en: On this day, we humbly ask You, Lord, to grant us Your clemency as we perform the sacred offices of Your prophet Elijah. May these holy sacrifices that we have taken in his solemnity benefit us, Your servants, for the remedy of eternal salvation.

text: Hodiernae sollemnitatis effectum sumpsimus Domine gaudia magna de parvis suppliciter exorantes ut hanc abundantiam in nostra quoque salvatione defendas.
translation_en: Today, we have received great joy, Lord, humbly entreating from small things. Pray protect this abundance for us also in our salvation.

text: Hodiernam festivitatem quaesumus Domine devote celebrantes oratio beati Bartholomaei apostoli custodiat iugiter ut ab omnibus peccatorum nexibus expediti claritatem maiestatis tuae cum eodem indesinenter adspicere mereamur.
translation_en: Today we humbly ask you, Lord, while devotedly celebrating the festival, that the prayer of blessed Apostle Bartholomew may always protect us, so that we may be continually freed from all the bonds of sin and deserve to constantly behold the brilliance of your majesty.

text: Hodiernum Domine sacrificium laetantes exsequimur quo beatae Agnetis caelestem victoriam recensentes et tua magnalia praedicamus et nos acquisisse gaudemus suffragia gloriosa.
translation_en: Today, Lord, we joyfully perform the sacrifice, recalling the recent celestial victory of blessed Agnes and proclaiming your great deeds. And we rejoice that we have obtained her glorious intercessions.

text: Holocausta haec Domine tua benedictione sanctifica ut sanctae Potentianae virginis tuae tibi sint meritis accepta in cuius sunt veneratione oblata.
translation_en: O Lord, may this holocaust be sanctified by your blessing, so that it may be accepted by your merits in honor of the holy Virgin Potentia, whose offerings are made in her veneration.

text: Hostiam hanc Domine tua benedictione sanctifica ut eius tibi sit meritis accepta pro cuius est commemoratione oblata.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify this host with your blessing, that it may be accepted by your merits on behalf of the one for whom it is offered in memory.

text: Honor martyrum beatorum deferre nos tibi munera Domine fidenter hortatur quia per eos nobis credimus profutura.
translation_en: We, with confidence, are urged by the holy martyrs to bring you gifts, O Lord, for we believe that through them, our salvation is profitable to us.

text: Hos quos reficis Domine sacramentis attolle benignus auxiliis ut tuae redemptionis effectum et mysteriis capiamus et moribus.
translation_en: Lord, who renews these, lift them up with kind aid through the sacraments, that we may grasp the effect of your redemption and the mysteries, and live accordingly.

text: Hostia quaesumus Domine Deus noster quam tibi ob honorem sancti confessoris tui atque pontificis Germani immolandam deferimus tuorum nobis tribuat societate gaudere sanctorum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the host which we offer to you in honor of your holy confessor and bishop Germanus, may enjoy the fellowship of the saints with us.

text: Hostiam Domine pro anima famuli tui illius immolamus qui iam in carne positus indevotus et irreligiosus videbatur; ob hoc piissimam clementiam tuam subnixis precibus imploramus quod si peccatorum meritis inferni tenebris et suppliciis retineatur misericordiae tuae remedio indulge ut cum dies ille tremebundus advenerit inter pios et iustos resuscitari eum praecipias ad indulgentiam non ad poenam et quidquid humana conversatione contraxit his sacrificiis emundetur ut portio eius immensa miseratione tua sit in terra viventium.
translation_en: We offer, Lord, a sacrifice for the soul of your servant who, while placed in flesh, appeared devoted and irreligious; for this we humbly beseech Your most gracious mercy that if he is held by the torments and darkness of hell due to his sins, may he be relieved by Your mercy rather than punished. And whatever he has contracted through human life may be cleansed by these sacrifices, so that his portion in the land of the living may be a great share of Your mercy.

text: Hostiam Domine quam tibi pro me famulo tuo offero clemens assume et benedictionem sancti nominis dignanter perfunde mihique servo tuo illi intercedente pro me sancto Michaele archangelo tuo et beata gloriosa semperque virgine Maria et beatis apostolis tuis Petro et Paulo et sanctis confessoribus tuis Hilario Martino et Gregorio et sancto Benedicto et sancto Germano et sancto Nicolao et omni caterva sanctorum peccatorum meorum omnium indulgentiam tribue et misericordiam largire atque haec petenti pro tua immensa pietate miserere ut dignus efficiar huius servitutis sacrique mysterii exsecutor ut quod pro me te Deus clementissime deprecor tu mihi concedas propitius.
translation_en: Lord, the offering that I, your servant, present to you, graciously accept and may the blessing of the holy name be bestowed upon me worthy. Through the intercession of Saint Michael, your archangel, the Blessed Glorious Ever Virgin Mary, the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, the saints confessors Hilario, Martin, Gregory, Benedict, Germano, Nicholas, and all the saints, grant forgiveness for all my sins and have mercy. For this supplicant, by your immense pity, have mercy that I may be worthy of this servitude and the sacred mystery, so that what I pray to God most clemently on my behalf you may graciously grant me.

text: Hostiam nostrae devotionis tibi Domine offerimus quam precibus beatae Barbarae martyris tuae acceptabilem maiestati tuae esse deposcimus.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, our offering of devotion, which we humbly ask to be acceptable to Your majesty through the prayers of Your blessed Martyr Barbara.

text: Hostiam nostram quaesumus Domine sancti Laurentii martyris tui et confessio veneranda et beata commendet oratio.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that our offering may be committed to your saint and worthy martyr, Laurence, and his venerable and blessed confession by prayer.

text: Hostiam pro anima famuli tui Domine <immolantes> supplices te rogamus ut non ad poenam <ei proveniat> sed indulgentiam consequatur.
translation_en: We offer a sacrifice for the soul of your servant, Lord. We humbly ask you that it may not come to punishment but rather receive mercy and forgiveness.

text: Hostiam pro anima famuli tui illius Domine suppliciter immolamus tuam misericordiam deprecantes ut quidquid humana conversatione contraxit clementer absolvas et in tui filii fide laetanter constituas heredem.
translation_en: We humbly offer a sacrifice for the soul of your servant, Lord. We beseech Your mercy to gently forgive whatever he has contracted through human life and to joyfully establish him as an heir in Your Son's faith.

text: Hostiam quaesumus Domine qua te nobis placari decrevisti benignus respice et beatae Mildrethae virginis tuae precibus exoratus ad nostrae salutis effectum provenire concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the sacrifice which you have graciously decreed for our reconciliation, look upon it favorably. Moved by the prayers of your blessed virgin Milburga, may it come to our aid and grant us salvation.

text: Hostiam sacrificii singularis tibi Domine deferentes petimus ut eius virtute nos et a peccatis emacules et tua sanctificatione dignos efficias.
translation_en: We bring before You, Lord, this offering of single sacrifice and we ask that through its power, you make us clean from sins and worthy by your sanctification.

text: Hostiam tibi Domine Deus nostrae devotionis offerimus quam tanto benignius quaesumus suscipias quanto eam Ecclesia tua in veneratione sancti pontificis tui Dunstani diligentius commendat.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord God, this host of our devotion, which we beg you to accept with such great benevolence as it is commended by Your Church in the veneration of your saintly pope Dunstan with such great diligence.

text: Hostiam tibi Domine immaculatam benignus admitte ut beati David confessoris tui atque pontificis meritis illis pro quibus offertur tuo munere proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Gracious Lord, accept this unblemished offering. May it advance for the salvation of those for whom it is offered through the merits of your blessed confesor and bishop, St. David.

text: Hostiam tibi Domine in commemoratione tui praecursoris Eliae libamus te supplices deprecantes quatenus prosit ( ... cetera desunt ... ).
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, a sacrifice in remembrance of your forerunner Elijah, humbly we beseech you, may it be pleasing (... the rest is missing ...).

text: Hostiam tibi Domine placationis pro spiritibus famulorum tuorum illorum offerimus obsecrantes ut sacri huius libaminis interventu propitius illis locum lucis et refrigerium beatae quietis indulgeas.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the offering of reconciliation for the spirits of Your servants, beseeching that through the intervention of this sacred incense, You may grant them a place in the light and a refuge of blessed peace.

text: Hostias altaribus tuis Domine placationis imponimus potentiam tuam in sanctorum tuorum passionibus honorando et per eos nobis implorando veniam peccatorum.
translation_en: We offer to Your altars, Lord, the power of our appeasement; in the sufferings of Your saints we honor Your might and through them we humbly ask for forgiveness of our sins.

text: Hostias Domine beati Mennae martyris tui sacratas meritis assume et ab hostium nos incursione defende.
translation_en: Lord, accept the sacred offerings dedicated to your blessed martyr Menna and defend us from the onslaught of enemies.

text: Hostias Domine laudis tuis altaribus adhibemus quas eius tibi patrocinio credimus commendandas cuius nos voluisti votis ad tuae pietatis pervenire notitiam.
translation_en: We present to You, Lord, offerings of praise for Your altars, which we trust commend to Your patronage, to Whom You have desired that we should come by our vows, knowing the notice of Your mercy.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et inclinato super hunc famulum
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and incline towards this your servant.

text: Hostias Domine plebis tuae intende propitius quas in honorem sancti Taurini confessoris tui atque pontificis tibi offerimus; tu eas quaesumus illo intercedente benedictione spirituali sanctifica.
translation_en: Lord, direct favourably the offerings of your people which we present to you in honour of Saint Taurinus, your confessor and bishop; we ask that you sanctify them through his intercession with a spiritual blessing.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et institutis tuis quibus propagatione
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and according to your institutions by which we propagate

text: Hostias Domine quas in honorem sancti Deus dedit confessoris tui atque pontificis tibi deferimus benignus intende et eas illo intercedente benedictione spirituali sanctifica.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the hostses that Your confessor and pope have dedicated in honor of the saint. Kindly pay attention and may You bless and spiritually sanctify them with his intercession.

text: Hostias Domine quaesumus placatus assume quas et pro renatorum expiatione peccati deferimus et pro acceleratione caelestis auxilii.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to accept the offerings we bring. These are presented not only for atonement of sins of those who have been reborn, but also to hasten the aid from heaven.

text: Hostias Domine quaesumus quas immolamus placatus assume et pro nostri expiatione peccati et pro acceleratione caelestis auxilii.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you accept the offerings we present, graciously receive them for our forgiveness of sins and for the hastening of heavenly aid.

text: Hostias Domine quas nomini tuo sacrandas offerimus apostolica prosequatur oratio per quam nos expiari tribuis et defendi.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, the sacrifices that we present to be consecrated. May an apostolic prayer follow, through which we are granted forgiveness and protection.

text: Hostias Domine quas nomini tuo sacrandas offerimus sancti Gregorii prosequatur oratio per quam nos (et) expiari facias et defendi.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the hostias (offerings) that we are presenting for consecration, through the prayers of Saint Gregory. May his prayer make us worthy of expiation and defense.

text: Propitiare Domine vespertinis supplicationibus
translation_en: Propitiate, Lord, with evening supplications

text: Hostias Domine quas nomini tuo sacrandas offerimus sanctorum martyrum tuorum Victoris Felicis et Fortunati prosequatur oratio per quam nos expiari concedas et defendi.
translation_en: We are offering to You, Lord, the hosts (offerings) that we dedicate for Your name in honor of Your holy martyrs Victor, Felix, and Fortunatus. May the prayer through which You grant us forgiveness and protection follow upon them.

text: Hostias Domine quas tibi offerimus propitius respice et per haec sancta commercia vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolve.
translation_en: Lord, graciously regard the offerings we present to you and, through these sacred transactions, release us from the bonds of our sins.

text: Hostias Domine quas tibi offerimus propitius suscipe et intercedente beata Agnete martyre tua vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolve.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive the offerings we present to you. With the intercession of blessed Agnes, your martyr, may you remit the bonds of our sins.

text: Hostias quas tibi Domine offerimus propitius respice et interveniente beato martyre tuo Edwardo a cunctis peccaminum nos nexibus clementer absolve.
translation_en: Hostias that we, Lord, present to you, look upon them favorably and, with the intervention of your blessed martyr Edward, may you mercifully forgive us from all bonds of sin.

text: Hostias Domine quas tibi offerimus propitius suscipe et nos famulos tuos necnon familiaritate atque consanguinitate nobis coniunctos omnemque populum christianum ab omni pravitate defende cunctisque fidelibus defunctis aeternam requiem propitius largire.
translation_en: Lord, we offer You these sacrifices; graciously receive them and us, Your servants, along with all Christian people, bound together by fellowship and kinship. Protect us from every wickedness and grant eternal rest to all departed faithful ones propitiously.

text: Hostias Domine quas tuae pietati indignus offero pius ac propitius suscipe et omnium peccatorum meorum vincula quibus propria accusante conscientia miserabiliter constringor propitiatus absolve et pro his veram puramque coram te confessionem et dignam fructuosamque agere paenitentiam et plenissimam mihi gratuito dono tribue indulgentiam.
translation_en: Lord, I offer Thee unworthy hostings; Thou, the pious and propitious one, receive them. And from all my sins' bonds, whereby my wretched conscience accusingly constricts me, absolve me, propitiated. Grant me true and pure confession before Thee, and worthy, fruitful penitence to act, and grant to me the fullest indulgence as a free gift.

text: Hostias Domine suppliciter immolamus in sanctis nobis collata martyribus salutaris tui subsidia praedicantes
translation_en: Lord, we humbly offer you sacrifices on the holy martyrs who were consecrated to us, proclaiming the auxiliary support of your salvation.

text: Hostias Domine suscipe placatus oblatas quas sanctificando nobis quaesumus efficias salutares.
translation_en: Lord, receive these offerings pleasing to you, which we humbly ask that You may make effectual for our salvation as You sanctify them.

text: Hostias Domine tuae plebis intende et quas in honorem sanctorum tuorum devota concelebrat proficere sibi sentiat ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, direct your attention to the offerings of your people, and let him who in honor of your saints, with devoted celebration, offers them, may feel himself approaching towards healing.

text: Hostias Domine tuae plebis intende et quas in honorem sanctorum tuorum devota mente celebrat proficere sibi sentiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord, direct towards Your people their offerings, and let him who with devoted mind celebrates them for the honor of Your saints feel that they are profitable for his salvation.

text: Hostias Domine famulorum tuorum placatus intende et quas in honorem nominis tui devota mente celebrant proficere sibi sentiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, graciously direct the offerings of Your servants and may those who with devoted minds celebrate them in honor of Your name feel themselves advancing towards healing.

text: Hostias et preces quas tibi Domine pro veneranda beati antistitis tui Thomae translatione humiliter offerimus suscipe dignanter ut quod pro tui nominis honore in ipsius veneratione gerimus tuam nobis grata vicissitudine reconciliet pietatem.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the hostias (offerings) and preces (petitions) that we humbly present on behalf of your venerable bishop Thomas. Receive them graciously so that what we are doing in his honor and veneration for your name's sake may reconcile our piety with you.

text: Hostias fidelium tuorum omnipotens Deus propitius intuere et concede ne catena saeculi captivos teneat quos passione Filii tui in omnibus liberos esse voluisti.
translation_en: Almighty God, look upon the offerings of your faithful with mercy and grant that the chain of this world may not hold those whom you desired to be free through the passion of your Son in all things.

text: Hostias laudis et preces devotionis quas tibi in honorem beati confessoris tui David atque pontificis omnipotens Deus deferimus placatus intende ut quod nostrum non obtinet meritum tua clementia et illius pro nobis frequens intercessio efficiant.
translation_en: We offer you, Almighty God, hosts of praise and petitions of devotion in honor of your blessed confesseor David and bishop. We humbly pray that your mercy may make up for what we lack in merit, and the frequent intercession of him on our behalf.

text: Hostias nostras clementissime Pater pro eleemosynas nobis facientibus benignus suscipe eorumque peccata indulge placatus.
translation_en: Most gracious Father, accept our offerings for the alms we are giving. Forgive their sins, pleased by them.

text: Hostias nostras quaesumus Domine quas in famuli tui depositione deferimus propitiatus exaudi ut qui nomini tuo ministerium fideliter dependit perpetua sanctorum societate laetetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept the offerings we bring as your servants, which we present in your service. May the one who faithfully depends on Your name be pleased with everlasting fellowship of saints.

text: Hostias nostras quaesumus Domine sanctus pontifex Iuvenalis nomini tuo reddat acceptas qui eas tibi digne complacuit offerendo.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, the holy pope Juvenalis, may he present our offerings to your name, who received them pleasingly when they were fittingly offered to you.

text: Hostias offerimus tibi Domine pro tuorum interpellatione sanctorum conciviumque caelestium; praesta ut quorum veneramur commemorationem multipliciter eorum patrociniis incessanter protegamur et meritis.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, hosts on behalf of the intercession of your saints and earthly companions in heaven. Grant that we may be continually protected under their numerous patronages, and defended by their merits.

text: Hostias populi tui Domine propitius intuere ut quod nostra fiducia non meretur per eos quos nobis constituisti praesules incessabiliter largiaris.
translation_en: Lord, graciously behold the offerings of your people that what we, unworthy, do not deserve may be perpetually given to us through those whom you have established as pastors.

text: Hostias populi tui quaesumus Domine miseratus intende et ut tibi reddantur acceptae conscientias nostras Sancti Spiritus salutaris emundet adventus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to have mercy and direct your attention; may the offerings of your people be returned to you as acceptable, and may our conscience be purified by the saving breath of the Holy Spirit upon your coming.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine beatissimi Gaugerici confessoris tui atque pontificis meritis consecrandas propitiatus assume et cuius magnifica sollemnitate gaudemus eius piis supplicationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the offerings in honor of your blessed confessor and bishop, Gaugeric. We beseech you to accept them with favor, and we rejoice at his magnificent solemnity. May we be aided by his pious prayers.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine nostrae devotionis assume et per sacrificia gloriosa subditorum tibi corda purifica.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to accept these offerings of our devotion and through glorious sacrifices cleanse the hearts of your servants.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine pacificas quas tuae maiestati sollemniter offerimus sanctae Brigidae virginis tuae meritis sanctifica ut et vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolvant et tuae nobis famulis tuis misericordiae dona multiplicent.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, for peaceful offerings which we solemnly present to your majesty on behalf of Saint Brigid, your virgin. May these offerings be sanctified by your merits, that the bonds of our sins may be loosed and may the mercy granted to us, your servants, be greatly increased.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine pietati <tuae> in sancti Nicolai confessoris tui atque pontificis commemoratione deferimus quae illius interventu maiestati tuae ad laudem et fragilitati nostrae sint ad salutem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to offer to your piety in the commemoration of Your Confessor and Bishop St. Nicholas, these hosts may be presented before your majesty for praise and for our salvation through his intercession.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine propitius intende quas sacris altaribus exhibemus ut nobis indulgentiam largiendo tuo nomini dent honorem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to turn your eyes favorably upon the offerings we present at your sacred altars, so that granting us forgiveness, they may give honor to your name.

text: Hostia{s} quaesumus Domine quam pro gloriosa resurrectione unigeniti Filii tui deferimus intercedente beata Maria semper virgine et devotioni nostrae proficiat et saluti.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to present the host(s) as an offering, in honor of the glorious resurrection of your only-begotten Son. May it profit our devotion and bring salvation through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, ever virgin.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine sollemniter immolandas pro sanctorum tuorum commemoratione clementer suscipe ut eorum intercessionibus veniam delictorum consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept solemnly offered sacrifices on behalf of the remembrance of your saints. May we deserve to obtain forgiveness for our sins through their intercession.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine quas sollemniter immolamus pro martyrum commemoratione sanctorum clementer suscipe et concede ut eorum intercessione in quorum honore offeruntur veniam delictorum consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive the offerings we solemnly present on this commemoration of martyrs. Graciously accept and grant that through their intercession, for whom these offerings are made in honor, we may deserve forgiveness of our sins.

text: Hostias quaesumus Domine quas tibi pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum offerimus propitiatus intende ut quibus fidei christianae meritum contulisti dones et praemium.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, the offerings that for the souls of your servants and their servants we present to you. May you, being propitiated, pay attention so that to those whom you have granted the merit of Christian faith, you may give the reward.

text: Hostias quaesumus omnipotens redemptor in memoriam acerbissimae passionis tuae lacrimosique doloris quem pia virgo maestissima mater pro tua morte sustinuit tibi sacrandas propitius intuere et praesta ut per eas pietatis et compassionis lacrimas tibi vivo et vero Deo cum eadem sanctissima matre tua valeamus offerri.
