translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty redeemer, that in memory of your most bitter passion and the tears and sorrow that the most mournful virgin, your most sorrowful mother, sustained for your death, you would look upon these offerings with favor and grant that we may be allowed to offer them to you, the living and true God, along with your most holy mother, through the tears of pity and compassion.

text: Hostias quas tibi Domine pro commemoratione sancti confessoris atque pontificis illius offerimus dignanter suscipe et a cunctis calamitatibus propitius nos respirare concede.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the hosts for the remembrance of that holy confesser and bishop. May You receive them graciously, and, propitious to all, grant us to breathe freely from all calamities.

text: Hostias quas tibi offerimus Domine pro commemoratione beati Rufi martyris tui quaesumus placidus ac benignus suscipe et per eius intercessionem ab omnibus malis nos eripe et in aeterna fac tecum felicitate gaudere.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, the hostages that we present to You for the commemoration of Your blessed martyr Rufus. We humbly ask that You receive them graciously and benevolently. Through his intercession, deliver us from all evils and may You let us rejoice in eternal happiness with Him.

text: Hostias quas tibi offerimus in honorem beati Armagilli confessoris tui acceptare digneris Domine Deus noster ut per has mereamur sic per bona temporalia transire ut ad ea quae non sunt transitoria possimus pervenire.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord God, the sacrifices we present in honor of Your blessed confessor Armagill. May it please You to accept them. So that through these, we may deserve to pass through temporal goods so that we can reach those that are not transitory.

text: Hostias tibi Domine deferimus immolandas qui temporali consolatione significas ut promissa non desperemus aeterna.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, sacrifices that are to be immolated, which signify temporary consolation, so that we may not despair of the promised eternal one.

text: Hostias tibi Domine deferimus immolandas quae temporalem consolationem significent ut promissa non desperemus aeterna.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, sacrifices that signify temporal comfort, so that we may not despair of the promised eternal salvation.

text: Hostias tibi Domine deferimus immolandas quae temporalem consolationem nobis impendant ut promissa certius non desperemus aeterna.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, sacrifices that bring us temporary comfort, so that we may not despair of obtaining the promised eternal one.

text: Hostias tibi Domine deferimus immolandas quae temporali consolatione nos laetificent ut promissa certius speremus aeterna.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, sacrifices that we immolate, which will give us temporal comfort to rejoice in, so that we may more surely hope for the promised eternal one.

text: Protector noster aspice Deus et qui malorum nostrorum
translation_en: Our protector, look upon us, God, and defend us from our evils

text: Hostias tibi Domine dicatas placatus assume et intercedente patiente Iob cum omnibus sanctis tuis ulcus pessimum a supplicibus tuis remove ut restituti pristinae sanitati te digne possint laudare.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings given to you be accepted by you, and through the intercession of patient Job with all your saints, remove the most severe wound from your supplicants, so that they may worthy praise you again in their restored health.

text: Hostias tibi Domine humili supplicatione deferimus ut anima famuli tui illius per haec piae placationis officia perpetuam misericordiam consequatur.
translation_en: We humbly offer you, Lord, these hostias (hosts) in supplication, that the soul of your servant may obtain eternal mercy through these acts of pious appeasement.

text: Hostias tibi Domine humili placatione deferimus ut animae famulorum famularumque tuarum per haec placationis officia (perpe)tuam misericordiam consequantur.
translation_en: We bring you, Lord, humble offerings for propitiation, so that the souls of your servants and their servants may obtain perpetual mercy through these offices of propitiation.

text: Hostias tibi Domine humili supplicatione pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum deferimus ut per haec salutis nostrae sacrificia perpetuam tuae beatitudinis misericordiam consequantur.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, humble supplications on behalf of the souls of your servants and their servants, that through these sacrifices of our salvation they may attain the eternal mercy of your beatitude.

text: Hostias tibi Domine humilitatis nostrae offerimus quas meritis beati Albani martyris tui ad absolutionem omnium delictorum nobis provenire concede.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the host of our humility, which by the merits of your blessed martyr Alban, may obtain for us forgiveness for all our sins.

text: Hostias tibi Domine in hoc altari sancto tuo nomini dicato deferimus misericordiae tuae implorantes auxilium ut per intercessionem sanctorum quorum reliquiae hic habentur omniumque sanctorum nostrorum veniam obtinentes flagitiorum caelestium mereamur effici participes gaudiorum.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, on this holy altar dedicated to your name, sacrifices, imploring your mercy so that through the intercession of the saints whose relics are here held, we may obtain forgiveness for all our sins and be worthy to participate in celestial joys.

text: Hostias tibi Domine laudis exsolvo suppliciter implorans ut quod immerito contulisti intercedente beato Petro apostolo tuo propitius exsequaris.
translation_en: I beseech You, Lord, to discharge offerings of praise to You humbly, imploring that what was unjustly given, with the intercession of the blessed Apostle Peter Yours, may You be merciful and carry it out.

text: Hostias tibi Domine laudis offerimus in commemoratione apostolicae dignitatis omniumque graduum ecclesiae ut a te habeamus et velle et posse custodire christianam religionem.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, sacrifices of praise in the remembrance of the apostolic dignity of all grades of the church, that from you we may have both the will and the power to guard the Christian religion.

text: Hostias tibi Domine laudis offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius ut eum in numero fidelium tuorum lux aeterna possideat.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, sacrifices of praise, for the soul of your servant that he may possess the eternal light among your faithful ones.

text: Hostias tibi Domine laudis offerimus qui beatis martyribus tuis Gervasio et Protasio contulisti ut et pro tuo nomine mori non paverent et sempiterna gloria fulgeant interempti.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, hosts of praise, who gave your blessed martyrs Gervasius and Protasius, so that they did not fear to die for Your name, and the slain may shine in eternal glory.

text: Hostias tibi Domine laudis offerimus qui nos et praesentibus simul bonis cumulas et futuris.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, sacrifices of praise, who with us and all the good present, you load also those of the future.

text: Hostias tibi Domine laudis offerimus suppliciter deprecantes ut easdem angelico pro nobis interveniente suffragio et placatus accipias et ad salutem nostram provenire concedas.
translation_en: We humbly offer you, Lord, hosts of praise, beseeching that through the intervention of the angels on our behalf, these same host be accepted by you and granted to come for our salvation.

text: Hostias tibi Domine placationis et laudis offerimus postulantes ut quos inimicus ad invadendam sanctuarii tui possessionem suadendo attraxit tu miserando corrigas.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, sacrifices of propitiation and praise, asking that you, who were enticed by the enemy to attack your sanctuary's possession, correct those whom he has seduced.

text: Hostias tibi Domine placationis et laudis pro venia delictorum meorum offero ego indignus famulus tuus obsecrans misericordiam tuam ut ab occultis me reatibus emundes clementer et a manifestis convenienter expurges.
translation_en: I offer to You, Lord, hostias (offerings) of atonement and praise for the forgiveness of my sins, I, an unworthy servant. I humbly ask for Your mercy that You would cleanse me gently from hidden sins, and purge me fittingly from manifest ones.

text: Hostias tibi Domine placationis offerimus ut et delicta nostra miseratus absolvas et nutantia corda tu dirigas.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, sacrifices of reconciliation, that you may have mercy on our sins and guide our wavering hearts.

text: Hostias tibi Domine placationis pro anima famuli tui illius offerimus obsecrantes ut sacri huius libaminis interventu propitius locum illi lucis et refrigerium beatae quietis indulgeas nosque ad te clamantes exaudias.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, the hostias of appeasement for the soul of your servant that one. We humbly entreat you to grant that through the intervention of this sacred offering, you may graciously bestow upon him a place in the light and blessed tranquility, and as we call out to you, hear our pleas.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro commemoratione sancti Felicis tui confessoris offerimus suppliciter deprecantes ut sicut illi praebuisti sacrae fidei claritatem sic nobis indulgentiam largiaris et pacem.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, hostias (hosts) for the commemoration of your confessor Saint Felix, humbly we beseech you. May it be as you granted him clarity in sacred faith, so you may grant us indulgence and peace.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro commemoratione sancti Felicis offerimus quem a tui corporis unitate nulla temptatio separavit.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, hosts for the remembrance of Saint Felix, whom no temptation separated from Your body's unity.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro commemoratione beati Bonifatii martyris tui atque pontificis offerimus supplicantes ut sicut illum a tui corporis unitate nulla vis tormentorum potuit separare ita et nos eo suffragante daemonum impugnantium insidiae nullatenus valeant superare.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, hostias (offerings) for the commemoration of your blessed martyr and bishop Boniface, praying that, just as no force of tormentments could separate him from the unity of your body, so may we, with his intercession, not be overcome by the attacks of demons.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro martyrum tuorum commemoratione deferimus supplicantes ut indulgentiam nobis pariter conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, hosts on behalf of the remembrance of your martyrs, praying that they may grant us forgiveness and salvation as well.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro sanctorum martyrum (Felicis) Simplicii Faustini et Beatricis commemoratione deferimus suppliciter obsecrantes ut indulgentiam nobis pariter conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, hosts for the commemoration of the holy martyrs (Felix) Simplicius, Faustinus, and Beatrix, humbly requesting that they grant us mercy together with salvation.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro nati tui filii apparitione deferimus suppliciter exorantes ut sicut ipse nostrorum auctor est munerum ipse sit misericors et susceptor.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, hostias (offerings) on behalf of your son born, humbly beseeching you. May it be as our creator, may you be merciful and a supporter yourself.

text: Hostias tibi Domine pro sacra inventione pretiosi corporis beati Stephani protomartyris tui offerimus suppliciter deprecantes ut eius suffragantibus meritis nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, hosts (offerings) in honor of the holy discovery of the precious body of Your protomartyr St. Stephen, humbly entreating that through his intercession we may progress towards our salvation.

text: Hostias tibi Domine sanctorum tuorum dicatas meritis benignus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive the offerings of your saints and bestow upon us everlasting assistance that flows from it.

text: Hostias nostras Domine tibi dicatas placatus assume et ad perpetuum nobis tribue provenire subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, may our offerings be pleasing to You; receive them and grant us everlasting aid in return.

text: Hostias tibi quas in honorem sancti Patricii offerimus devotas accipias ut nos a timore iudicii liberemur.
translation_en: We present to you the offerings we make in honor of Saint Patrick, may you accept them as devoted ones. May we be freed from the fear of judgment.

text: Hostium nostrorum quaesumus Domine elide superbiam et dexterae tuae virtute prosterne.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to remove the arrogance of our hosts and with the power of your right hand, bring them low.

text: Huic nostri famulatus sacrificio clementissime Deus quod in commemoratione celeberrimi pastoris et martyris tui Apollinaris tripudianter offerimus tuae quaesumus dignare praesentiam interserere maiestatis ut ipsius meritis et tibi sit acceptabile et nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: To this our humble sacrifice, most compassionate God, whom we joyously offer on the commemoration of your renowned shepherd and martyr Apollinaris, we humbly ask that you deign to interject your presence with majesty, so that through his merits it may be acceptable to you and beneficial for us, granting forgiveness.

text: Huius Domine perceptio sacramenti peccatorum meorum maculas tergat et ad peragendum iniunctum officium me idoneum reddat.
translation_en: Lord, through this perception of the sacrament, may it wipe away the stains of my sins and make me fit for the task assigned to me.

text: Huius Domine quaeso virtute mysterii ab omnibus me propitiatus absolve peccatis et a cunctis defende benignus adversis ut tua gratia cooperante ab humanis semper excessibus retrahar et per mandatorum tuorum semitas sine offensione gradiar et ad perfruendam gloriam aeternae perennitatis te ducente pertingere merear.
translation_en: Lord, I humbly ask through the power of this mystery that you be propitiated towards me and absolve me from my sins, and defend me graciously against all adversities. May your grace help me to always withdraw from human excesses and walk through the paths of your commandments without offense. And may I deserve to reach eternal perpetuity's glory with you leading the way.

text: Huius Domine quaesumus virtute mysterii et a nostris mundemur occultis et ab inimicorum liberemur insidiis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that through the power of this mystery, we may be purified from our hidden sins and freed from the plots of our enemies.

text: Huius Domine quaesumus virtute mysterii et a propriis nos (e)munda delictis et famulum tuum illum ab omnibus absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you for the power of this mystery to cleanse us from our own sins and forgive your servant from all sins.

text: Huius Domine quaesumus virtute mysterii et a propriis mundemur occultis et famulum tuum illum ab omnibus absolve peccatis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the power of this mystery, to cleanse us from hidden sins and absolve your servant from all sins.

text: Huius Domine sacramenti perceptio peccatorum nostrorum maculas tergat et nos ad caelestia regna perducat.
translation_en: By receiving this, Lord's sacrament, it wipes away the stains of our sins and leads us to the heavenly kingdoms.

text: Huius Domine sacramenti perceptione et beatae Margaretae virginis intercessione et tu in nobis manere dignare et nos in te vicissim manere concede.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, by the reception of this sacrament, and through the intercession of the blessed Margaret the Virgin, to remain with us, and grant us in return to remain with Thee.

text: Huius Domine virtute mysterii famulum tuum illum ab omnibus absolve peccatis ut quibus eum tua gratia praefecisti omnibus digne congrueque tuo munere facias suffragari.
translation_en: By the power of this mystery, Lord, absolve your servant from all sins that with your grace you have appointed him to serve. May he make worthy and fitting use of your office in praying for all.

text: Huius mihi Domine sacramenti perceptio sit peccatorum remissio et tuae pietatis optata propitiatio ut per haec te opitulante efficiar sacris mysteriis dignus quae de tua pietate confisus frequentare praesumo indignus.
translation_en: May this perception of your sacred mystery, Lord, be the remission of my sins and the sought-after propitiation of your mercy, so that through these I may become worthy in the sacred mysteries, which I presume to frequent with unworthiness due to your pity.

text: Huius nobis Domine quaesumus sacrificii placatione succurre cuius remediis dignaris absolvere peccatores.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to help us with this sacrifice, worthy of your aid, by which you deign to forgive sinners.

text: Huius nobis parcimoniae quaesumus Domine praebe mensuram ut quod licentiae carnis auferimus salutarem nobis fructum mentis acquirat.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the measure of this moderation we ask, that what we take away from our fleshly indulgence may gain us a wholesome fruit of the mind.

text: Huius nos Domine perceptio sacramenti mundet a crimine et ad caelestia regna perducat.
translation_en: Lord, may this perception of the sacrament cleanse us from sin and lead us to heavenly kingdoms.

text: Huius nos Domine perceptione sacramenti ab omni contagione vitiorum purifica et beati Ambrosii confessoris tui atque pontificis tribue consociari meritis cuius nos doctrinis erudis et exemplis.
translation_en: Lord, through the perception of this sacrament, purify us from all contagion of vices. Grant that we may be associated with the merits of your confessor and bishop, blessed Ambrose, whom we have been taught by his doctrines and examples.

text: Huius nos Domine quaesumus sacramenti acceptio protegat <et> gloriosa beatae Mariae genitricis oratio Filium tuum placare dignetur qui victor ab inferis resurrexit.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, through the acceptance of this sacrament, that we may be protected by Your glorious Mother Mary's intercession. May her prayers merit that Your Son be pleased to intervene, who rose victorious from the grave.

text: Huius operatio nos Domine sacramenti quaesumus purificet semper et muniat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that this operation of the sacrament always purifies and protects us.

text: Huius sacrificii potentia Domine quaesumus et vetustatem nostram clementer abstergat et novitatem nobis augeat et salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, for the power of this sacrifice and kindly cleanse our aged state. May it increase our newness and bestow upon us salvation.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster diei molestias
translation_en: We ask You, Lord God, remove annoyances

text: Huius te Domine muneris oblatione placemus et perpetuae vitae participes huius operatione reddamur.
translation_en: Through this offering, Lord, may we please you and through this process be made participants of eternal life.

text: Humiliantes in conspectu tuo animas nostras precamur Domine ut sit huius abstinentiae nostrae afflictio praemissa vitiorum curatio; ut exteriori homini correctio et interiori a te renovatio concedatur quo castigatum corpus et in servitute redactum puritatem animarum suppleat quod ieiunii maceratione desudat.
translation_en: In your presence, we humbly ask you, Lord, that the affliction of our abstinence may be a precursor to the cure of past sins; grant the correction for the outer man and the renewal for the inner self, so that a chastened body and one subdued might fulfill what the mortification of fasting sweats out regarding the purity of souls.

text: Humiliatis corporibus atque animabus in abstinentia tuae Deus flagitamus bonitatis pietatem immensam ut et his sacrificiis benedictionem impertias et ieiunantium votis propitiatione solita benedicas.
translation_en: With humbled bodies and souls, we call upon your immense goodness in your fast, O God, that you would grant blessings to these offerings and bless the usual propitiation of those who are fasting.

text: Humilitatem meam clementissime sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus dignanter intende et praesta ut quod ore sumpsi mente capiam et fiat mihi remedium sempiternum.
translation_en: Most merciful holy Father, almighty eternal God, graciously consider my humility and grant that what I have received in my mouth, I may fully comprehend in my mind, and may it become an eternal remedy for me.

text: Humilitatis nostrae libamina sancti Birini tibi Domine commendem suffragia cuius depositionis celebramus sollemnia.
translation_en: We commend to you, Lord, the cup of our humility towards Saint Birinus. We recommend to you his intercessions, whose solemn depositions we celebrate.

text: Iam dies adsunt ieiunii iam salutis tempus advenit; adesto culpantibus Deus qui solus vales delere peccata ut quod dudum deliciosa caro deliquit placita nunc tibi abstinentia ruas.
translation_en: The days of fasting are at hand, the time of salvation has arrived; stand by God who alone has the power to forgive sins, so that what once delightful flesh sinned may now please you through abstinence.

text: Iam in triduani ieiunii fine conclusa sinceritatem tuam Domine deprecamur in visceribus nostris maceratione ieiunii afflictis advenire et ut de atriis tuis sanctis exaudias peccatores in squalore miseriarum iacentes rogamus ut des nobis fontem gratiarum tuarum et pandas iter quo post ieiunium escarum carnalium dirigamur ad refectionem pascuae sempiternae.
translation_en: Now, at the close of the three-day fast, we humbly beseech Your sincerity, Lord, in our hearts afflicted by the rigor of the fast, to appear and hear the penitent from Your holy places. We implore You to grant us a fountain of Your mercies and open the path whereby after the fast we may be directed towards the everlasting pasture.

text: Ieiunantium Domine quaesumus supplicum vota propitius intuere et munera praesentium sanctificans perceptione eorum occulta cordis nostri remedio tuae clarifica pietatis ut opera carnalia nec fluxa nos teneant quos institutor ieiunii Christus reparavit redemptor.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you look kindly upon the supplications of the fasting and grant them favorable vows. Sanctify the gifts at hand, making them effective through their hidden understanding in our hearts, and clarify your grace so that the remedy for our weakness may be found in your clemency. May we not be bound by carnal works which are transient, for Christ, the founder of fasting, has restored us through his redemption.

text: Ieiunia quaesumus Domine nos sacrata laetificent ut imbecillitati nostrae tribuatur auxilium et mentibus desideratus virtutum succedat affectus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that these sacred fasts may bring us joy so that help may be given to our weakness and a desire for the sought-after virtues replaces our thoughts.

text: Ieiunia quaesumus Domine quae sacris exsequimur institutis et nos a reatibus nostris semper expediant et tuam nobis iustitiam iaciant esse placatam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the fasting we observe according to sacred institutions may always free us from our sins, and that your justice may be pleasing to us.

text: Ieiunia nostra quaesumus Domine ut nos a reatibus nostrorum criminum solvant et tuam nobis iustitiam iaciant esse placabilem et concordiae nos vinculo per complexum osculi nectant.
translation_en: Our fasting we ask you, Lord, that you free us from the bonds of our sins' crimes and that your justice becomes pleasing to us, and that by the bond of a kiss, we may be united in harmony.

text: Ieiunii incurvatione <nobis> pro nostris reatibus deiectis miserere quaesumus Domine et <nos> a continuis vitus occupatos ad virtutes propitiatus respicere dignare.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look upon us during our fasting with bent knees, and to have mercy on us for our sins that have been cast off. We beseech you, deign to consider us, who are constantly engrossed in vices, and turn us towards virtues.

text: Iesu Christe Domine altissimi silius natus praesentia cum patris omnipotentia sempiternus oris tui spiraculum super hoc altare tuum diffunde qui et hanc oblationem sanctificans benedicat et sumentes ex ea beatos efficiat.
translation_en: Jesus Christ, Lord of the highest heaven, born with the presence of all-powerful Father, eternal Spirit proceeding from your mouth, pour out upon this your altar. Sanctify and bless this offering so that those who partake of it may become blessed.

text: Iesu Christi Domini nostri corpore saginati per quem crucis est sanctificatum vexillum quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut adorare meruimus ita perennitatis eius gloria(e) salutari potiamur effectu.
translation_en: We ask you, Jesus Christ our Lord who were strengthened by your body and through whom the cross was sanctified, O Lord our God, that we may be worthy not only to worship but also to partake in the eternal glory of your saving grace.

text: Iesu collatio vitae aeternae nostrum quaesumus ieiunium acceptabile fiat in oculis tuis quo huius ieiunii litatione et carnis nostrae inedia convalescat et anima donum perfectae dilectionis obtineat.
translation_en: We ask Jesus, grant us this collation of eternal life. May our fasting be acceptable in your eyes, so that through this fasting and the abstention of our body, we may recover strength, and obtain the gift of perfect love for our soul.

text: Iesu Dei Filius qui felices animas beatorum in caelestem Ierusalem feliciter locaris felices eos qui in eius pace gaudent divinae auctoritatis sententia prolata denuntias fac nos feliciter Felicis tui merito in ipsius supernae Ierusalem perenniter felicitate laetari atque illius de die in diem desideriis renovari ut sicut huius civitatis avidus negotiator hic sanctissimus exstitit Felix qui probitate morum potissimus et patria exsul et rebus tumentis saeculi sapientiam desertum caelestes accumulans fructus ad illam conscendit cum his quae acquisierat coronatus ita quoque nos te opitulante strenui negotiatores in hac vita pacis et caritatis effecti sic omnia quae egerimus in tua et proximi dilectione agamus ut dignum conquestum huic sanctae patriae coronaturi post nostrum transitum deportemus.
translation_en: Jesus, Son of God, who happily place the souls of the blessed in the celestial Jerusalem and make them happy who rejoice in his peace according to the sentence of divine authority, announce to us that we may happily enjoy the rewards of your happiness in the same heavenly Jerusalem for eternity and our desires for him be renewed day by day. Just as the most holy Felix became an eager merchant of this city through moral integrity, leaving his native land and abandoning worldly wisdom during times of turmoil, accumulating celestial fruits to ascend with them to that place, crowned after acquiring them. In the same way, through your help, let us, striving negotiators in this life, perform all our deeds out of love for you and our neighbor, so that we may be worthy of a fitting crown in this holy homeland after our departure.

text: Iesu Dei Filius qui noster factus es advocatus qui sine tempore natus a patre in tempore processisti ex virgine accipe hoc sacrificium quod tibi offerimus praesentis quadragesimae tempore mediante ut a te sanctificentur oblata a te nostra expientur delicta a te quoque donetur omnibus aeternae promissionis felicitas exoptata.
translation_en: Jesus, Son of God, who became our Advocate and was born without time by the Father in time and came forth from the Virgin, receive this sacrifice which we offer you at this season of Lent. Through you may our offerings be sanctified, our sins forgiven, eternal blessings granted to us, and the happiness promised forever expected.

text: Iesu Dei Filius qui pro nobis voluntarie moriens saeva inferorum ergastula potentiali brachio penetrans confregisti tu fidelium defunctorum spiritus a locis poenalibus exime ei aeternae eos amoenitatis simul et muneris iucunditate sustolle et quia ex latere tuo te moriente novi profluxit laticis unda qua in his diebus paschalibus horum renatorum est progenies consecrata te poscimus et rogamus ut et in illis sacrae regenerationis puritatem conserves et in nobis confessionum emolumenta multiplices quo et illi collatum sibi baptismi donum teneant absque culpa et nos in eandem quam violavimus gratiam redintegremur saltem ex venia post ruinam.
translation_en: Jesus, Son of God, who willingly died for us, breaking the cruel prison of hell with your almighty arm, we ask and beseech you to remove the spirits of our deceased faithful from penal places and to lift them up to the delight and joy of eternal bliss. Because on these Paschal days, a wave flowed forth from your side which consecrated the progeny of those who were born from you, we ask and implore you to preserve in them the purity of sacred regeneration and in us the abundant rewards of confession so that they may hold the gift of baptism bestowed on them without guilt and we may be restored at least through forgiveness to the same grace which we have violated.

text: Iesu Dei patris filius qui es et victoria martyrum et corona victorum in hoc sanctorum tuorum Adriani et Nataliae festo concede offerentibus indulgentiam pro delictis et sepultis beatorum adunari consortiis ut tam nos quam illi cum eis in futura vita mereamur habere partem cum quibus idem tuus beatissimus Adrianus a gentili conversus errore suam voluit adnotari professionem.
translation_en: Jesus, Son of God the Father, who art Victory of martyrs and Crown of victors, in this feast of your saints Adrian and Natalia, grant pardon to those offering for the forgiveness of sins, that we and they may be united in consortiums so that we may deserve to have a part with them in future life. The same blessed Adrianus, who was converted from paganism, desired to confirm his profession with you.

text: Iesu Domine et omnipotentis patris unigenite fili qui in mundum per virginem veniens ad praedicationis officium apostolos eligis et eorum praedicamentis pariter et exemplis superborum et arrogantium corda prosternis respice nunc plebiculae tuae humillima vota et Bartholomaei beatissimi apostoli tui et martyris precibus nec non et meritis nostrorum omnium sana crimina.  Da ad te revertendi votum da ministrandi tibi indignis servulis dignitatem. Quis enim Domine nostrorum se dignum fore ministerio tuo cognoscat? Quis tam celsiorem meritum se habere confidat? Excellit quippe officium merita et habita neglegentiae proba ministros trahunt ad infirma.  Manus tuae igitur unigenite Filius Dei remigio sustentemur ne tam periculosi ponti undis subito subruamur. Deferat nobis sanctus apostolus Bartholomaeus protectionis manus et ad tui servitium nostrum instruat coetum quia digne nullus altario tuo adesse poterit nisi aut gratia tua munitus aut tui apostoli meritis circumvallatus exstiterit.  Per illum quoque Domine effice te ipsum nobis propitium per illum nostrae servitutis obsequium tibi facito ratum per illum sacerdotum praesumentium suscipe sacrificium per illum universae ecclesiae et instrue et sanctifica populum ut eius meritis populi tui universitas fidei alacritate succincta et martyrii congressione munita semper tibi serviat seque tibi in obsequio subdat perceptura pro obsequiis praemium et pro fide praemii bravium quae per martyrium non meretur de hoste triumphum.
translation_en:
Jesus, Lord and Almighty Father's only Son, who came into the world through a virgin for the office of apostles, humble the proud and arrogant hearts through their preachings and examples. Look now upon your lowly flock and through the prayers and merits of the blessed apostle Bartholomew and martyr, forgive our sins. Give to us the desire to return to you and the dignity to serve you, unworthy servants. For who among our Lord knows himself worthy for Your ministry? Who dares claim a higher worth? Indeed, an office is superior to its merits, but negligence proves unworthy ministers weak.
Therefore, O only-begotten Son of God, support us with Your hand as our rudder lest we be suddenly overwhelmed by the perilous waves of the sea. May the holy apostle Bartholomew guide and strengthen our assembly for Your service, for none shall dare approach Your altar unless either armed with Your grace or fortified by Your apostle's merits.
Through Him, Lord, make Yourself favorable to us; through our servitude, make our offering acceptable to You; receive the sacrifice offered by the priests; instruct and sanctify Your people so that Your universal Church may be clothed in alacrity of faith and fortified with the assembly of martyrs. May they always serve You, submit to Your obedience, and achieve rewards for their service, as well as prizes for their faith which is not earned through martyrdom, but a triumph over the enemy.

text: Iesu Filius Dei qui contriti cordis sacrificio placaris nostris quaesumus parce offensis. Da nobis et abstinendi devotionem et abstinentiae promereri virtutem quo et voluntate habeamur idonei et corporali robore inveniamur condigni.
translation_en: Jesus, Son of God, who appeases the Father with a broken heart's sacrifice, we humbly ask for mercy on our offenses. Grant us the devotion to abstain and the virtue to excel in abstinence, so that we may be fit in will and find ourselves strong enough in physical ability.

text: Iesu Filius Dei qui Petro apostolorum omnium principi plus te ceteris discipulis diligenti oves tuas sub testimonio tuae dilectionis commendas cum amorem eius erga te dominum et te interrogante et illo respondente declaras tu eo suffragante ecclesiam cuius ipse caput factus es ab scandalis libera et in pace conserva ut caritate ferveat fide crescat spe polleat atque sanctis operibus enitescat quo eius indefesso muniatur patrocinio cuius doctrina aedificata est vel exemplo.
translation_en: Jesus, Son of God, who to Peter, the chief of all the apostles, showed a special love for your sheep under the testimony of your love; with that love in him questioning and you answering, you declare through his intercession to free and conserve the church, which you have become its head, from scandals and keep it in peace. May it be fervent in charity, grow in faith, increase in hope, flourish in good works, so that it is fortified by his unceasing patronage, whose doctrine has been established or exemplified.

text: Iesu redemptor humani generis restaurator aeternae lucis praesta nobis famulis tuis ut sicut abluti sumus originali peccato per tinctionem baptismatis cuius significationem habuit piscina illa quae oculis lumen praestitit caecis ita quoque nos secundo lacrimarum baptismate purifices a delictis sicque mereamur praecones effici laudis tuae sicut caecus ille annuntiatur factus est gratiae et sicut ille ad confitendum te verum Deum adimpletus est fide ita nos quoque repleamur boni operis confessione atque tanta excellentia pietatis occurras te invocantibus pius ut per haec libamina quae tibi offerimus et vivi obtineamus remedium salutare et defuncti percipere mereantur aeternum gaudium sine ine.
translation_en: Jesus, Redeemer of the human race and Restorer of eternal light, grant us, your servants, that we may be purified as we have been washed from original sin by the baptismal washing, whose significance that pool had which gave light to the blind. Thus, let us also be cleansed through the second baptism of tears, and let us deserve to become heralds of your praise, like the blind man who was filled with grace, and like him who, filled with faith, confessed you as the true God. Let us also be filled with good works' confession, and let such great excellence of piety that we invoke you approach us piously. May it happen through these sacramental elements which we offer to you, and may we, living, attain a saving remedy, and may the dead merit eternal joy without end.

text: Iesu redemptor noster et Domine qui ad salvandum genus humanum sexta aetate saeculi venisti ad huius extremitatis nostrae profundum conserva atque sanctifica Ecclesiam tuam in unitate sanctae fidei quam olim a tenebrosa profunditate eruens putei tibi illam copulare per gratiam voluisti.  Da cunctis in ca manentibus ut sicut ad te fide venerunt ita aeterno solatio potiantur ut per te introducamur ad regnum aeternae vitae per quem accepimus fidei luminationem. Tribue nobis sitientibus aeternae fontis ita bibere potum ut numquam sitiamus in aeternum. Expelle a cordibus nostris omnem profunditatem tenebrosam errorum ne quando operiat super nos puteus os suum.  Te te Christe inveniamus ad puteum relevantem qui nostro ex vitio quocumque lapsi fuerimus in crimine ut toties relevemur tuae pietatis dono quoties caecati labimur in delicto. Amove a cordibus nostris inveteratam vetustae vitae malitiam qui novitate spiritus in samaritana illa fidei operatus es incrementa. Da quaesumus omnibus in commune Iesu bone ita dies istos sancti desiderii plenitudine gratiosos habere sicut illa promeruit dono sanctae fidei te in veritate cognoscere ut in horum celebritate dierum te custodiente non libidine polluamur non malitia sauciemur non scandalis scindamur sed in sanctae fidei omnes unitate collecti ita Spiritus Sancti defensione protecti et illuminati mundemur a criminibus nostris qualiter ad sanctum Pascha pervenientes et ardenter suscipiamus mysterium nostrae redemptionis et veraciter reparatos nos gratulemur in statu aeternae lucis.
translation_en:
Jesus, our Redeemer and Lord, who came for the salvation of the human race in the sixth age of the world, at the extremity of our lives, preserve and sanctify Your Church in the unity of holy faith, which You once drew from the dark depths of a well. Grant to all those remaining that they may come to You through faith, as they can be enriched by eternal consolation, so that through You we may be introduced into the kingdom of eternal life, through whom we have received the illumination of faith.
Grant us who thirst for the fountain of eternity to drink such a draught that we may never thirst again. Drive away from our hearts every deep darkness of error, lest its pit should ever work on us.
Christ, we seek You at the wellspring, who from any fall into sin through our fault may lift us up in Your mercy as often as we stumble in guilt. Remove from our hearts the ingrained evil of ancient life, which You worked in the Samaritan woman by the operation of the new spirit. Grant that all, in common Jesus good, may have these days full of the abundance of holy desire, as she merited it through the gift of holy faith; so that in truth they may come to know You, while You are guarding these days, not being defiled by lust, not wounded by sin, not divided by scandals, but united in the Holy Spirit's protection and illumination, cleansed from our sins as we approach the holy Easter, and ardently receive the mystery of our redemption and truly rejoice in being repaired in the state of eternal light.

text: Iesu redemptor noster et Domine qui invictus victor in omnibus te credentibus gloriosum et expugnabilem geris certaminis usum ut unusquisque opportunum a te accipiat vincendi solatium quique martyrum constantiam ita roboras sub diversis generibus tormentorum ut fortiter vincant et confessorum mentibus tolerantiam infundis ut detrahentium se linguas aequanimiter ferant tuo itaque tutus praesidio hic debellator fortissimus sanctus incessit Hieronymus qui linguis vipereo infectis ...
translation_en: Jesus, our Redeemer and Lord, who, invincible victor, in all things glorious and unconquerable for those who believe, you bear the use of contest so that each one may receive suitable solace for victory from you. You also strengthen the constancy of martyrs so much under various types of torments that they bravely win and in the minds of confessors you pour out patience so that they bear the tongues of detractors calmly. Therefore, under your safe protection, here the mightiest slayer, holy Jerome, advances who, with poisoned serpent's tongue ...

text: Iesu redemptor noster et Domine qui virgo ex virgine natus virginitatem in virginibus remuneras incorruptam in hoc festo tuarum virginum acceptabile tibi facito quod tibi offertur; accepta viventium vota defunctos in pace refrigera ut qui tuarum virginum obsequimur patrociniis earum nos sentiamus adiuvari suffragiis.
translation_en: Jesus, our Redeemer and Lord, who as man were born of the Virgin, reward incorrupt virginity in women on this feast of your virgins. Make it acceptable to you that is offered to you; accept the vows of the living, cool the departed in peace so that we may feel assisted by the patronage of your virgins through their intercessions.

text: Iesu rex noster et Domine qui es vita mortalium et spes unica redemptorum suscipe hoc sacrificium quod tibi in honorem Ioannis apostoli tui dedicandum offertur ac praesta propitius ut sicut olim idem dilectus tuus praesenti in saeculo degeris exanimata corpora revocavit ad vitam ita nunc suffragio suo et viventium torpentes animas suscitet ad virtutem et defunctorum spiritus liberet a poenali condicione quo per istum a te Deus tam vivi quam defuncti speciale se gaudeant invenisse remedium quem manere praedixisti donec venias incorruptum.
translation_en: Jesus our King and Lord, who are the life of mortals and the unique hope of the redeemed, receive this sacrifice that is offered to you in honor of your apostle John, and graciously grant that just as your beloved one once revived lifeless bodies in this world, so now through his intercession and the prayers of the living, may you raise up torpid souls to virtue and free the spirits of the dead from their penal condition. May they find special joy in this remedy, as you, God, have promised both the living and the dead that they will remain until your coming.

text: Iesu Salvator humani generis qui corpus in te suscipiens nostrae mortalitatis alios ad purgationem feriendo castigas alios ad damnationem flagellando reservas te suppliciter quaesumus et humili devotione precamur ut famulum tuum illum quem aegritudinis molestia quassat pietas tuae miserationis resecatum absolvat; da ei Domine ut quidquid pietati tuae deliquit in saeculo totum in eo puniat illata correptio; dolorum eius ac febrium ita sana discrimina ut cum his etiam eius aboleantur piacula; non durando poena coerceat reum sed absolvat miseratio iam prostratum; mitiga in eo pie pater et Domine aestus febrium putredines ulcerum contractiones nervorum atque cunctarum cruciationes infirmitatum; sit in eo quaesumus ita respectus pie parcentis ut nec infirmitatum ulterius saucietur stimulis nec poenam post transitum sentiat de commissis.
translation_en: Jesus, Savior of the human race, who in taking our mortal body chastises some to purge them, whips others to damnation, and reserves punishment for others, we humbly beseech you and with devout prayer ask that your mercy cut away from your servant, shaken by the distress of illness, his sinfulness from this world; Lord, let the punishment he has incurred for all his offenses against your piety last until it is completely paid off; may the pain and fever be cured in such a way that they not only disappear but also remove his sins; may the penalty not endure to torment him but rather mercy free him when prostrate; may a merciful Father and Lord temper in him the heat of fevers, corruption of ulcers, contractions of nerves, and all afflictions; may he be so respectfully regarded by your compassionate gaze that neither additional suffering nor pain is felt after his departure; and that upon his passing, no punishment remains for his transgressions.

text: Iesu Salvator noster et Domine qui es auctor pacis et origo purae dilectionis suffragio apostoli tui Thomae et testis fac nos omnibus carere scandalis et ubique  pacis tuae servare praecepta. Ipseque nobis nunc precibus suis apud te caritatis conquirat lucrum qui Gundoforo regi per boni operis exercitium in regno tuo ad <pacem> habitantium populorum praeparavit palatium ut ita eo suffragante cultores effici mereamur pacis et caritatis hic dum vivimus ut ad te qui es vera pax angelorum et caritas omnium sanctorum quandoque feliciter veniamus.
translation_en: Jesus, our Savior and Lord, who are the author of peace and the origin of pure love, we beseech you through the intercession of your apostle Thomas and the witness of Gundofor, king, that we may lack all scandals and everywhere preserve your teachings of peace. May this same Jesus, with his prayers before you, gain for us a reward of charity which he prepared a palace for, by the exercise of good works in your kingdom, for the inhabitants of peace. Thus, supported by such intercession, let us merit to be cultivators of peace and charity here while we live, so that we may come to you, who are true peace of angels and love of all saints, with joy when we eventually come to you.

text: Iesu Salvator omnium qui propter salutem humani generis voluntarie suscipiens exitium crucis pro nobis Deo patri oblatus es in sacrificium laudis ad has hostias benedicendas illa propitiatione iube respicere qua olim humanum genus respiciens <illud> proprio redemisti cruore quo> omnes qui tuae mortis ac resurrectionis in his diebus triumpho attollimur his muniti paschalibus epulis in vivam tibi hostiam praeparemur.
translation_en: Jesus, Savior of all, who for the salvation of the human race willingly took upon yourself the death of the cross as an offering to God the Father in the sacrifice of praise, I urge you to look back at that propitiation by which, looking upon the human race, you redeemed it with your own blood; so that all who triumph in these days because of your death and resurrection may be prepared as a living sacrifice for you armed with paschal feasts.

text: Iesu virtus infirmitatis nostrae qui sine manibus praecidentium lapis verus <es> a monte abscisus quo omnis latitudo repleta est terrae tu corda nostra reple dono pacis et gratiae ut qui incarnationis tuae celebramus sollemnia per pacis bonum futurae examinationis liberemur a poena.
translation_en: Jesus, strength of our weakness, who were truly taken from the mountain by hands of the stone that filled all the depths of the earth; fill our hearts with the gift of peace and grace, so that we who celebrate the solemnities of your incarnation may be freed from the penalty of future judgment through good peace.

text: Ignosce Domine quod dum rogare compellor dum per immunda labia nomen sanctum tuum assumo et immundorum actuum secreta confiteor non habeo apud te nec verba sine crimine; tu enim conscientiae meae vulnera tu cogitationum mearum occulta nosti et immunditias meas tu solus agnoscis; miserere mihi Domine miserere mihi ignosce mysterii tui secreta tractanti nec indignum misericordia tua iudices quem pro aliis rogare permittis et in quo testimonium boni operis non agnoscis officium saltem dispensationis reddere non recuses.
translation_en: Lord, I am compelled to pray, yet I utter Your holy name through unclean lips and confess the secrets of my unholy acts; I have no words with You that are not tainted by sin. You know the wounds of my conscience, the hidden thoughts of my heart, and only You understand my impurities. Have mercy on me, Lord, have mercy on me, forgive me for handling the secret mysteries of Your truth, do not judge me unworthy of Your mercy, which You grant to others, and in whom You do not recognize good deeds. At least, do not refuse to fulfill the duty of dispensation.

text: Ignosce mihi Domine quem maculatae vitae conscientia trepidum et criminum meorum confusio facit captivum. Et qui pro me veniam obtinere non valeo pro aliis rogaturus assisto; profero ad te si audire digneris Domine gemitus captivorum tribulationes plebium pericula populorum necessitates peregrinorum inopiam debilium desperationes languentium defectus senum suspiria iuvenum vota virginum lamenta viduarum; sed quoniam me eadem quae populum peccati catena constringit ideo communes lugeo passiones; non obsit Domine populo tuo oratio subiugata peccatis; per me tibi offertur votum per te meum compleatur officium.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on me, for my conscience is stained by a guilty life, and the confusion of my sins makes me a captive. I, who am not able to obtain pardon for myself, stand as an intercessor for others; I bring before you, if you deem it worthy, Lord, the groans of the captives, the trials of the people, the perils of the nations, the necessities of the wanderers, the poverty of the weak, the despair of the sick, the failures of the old, the sighs of the youth, the vows of virgins, the laments of widows; but since I am bound by the same chain of sins that binds the people, therefore I share their sufferings. Lord, let not your people's prayer, subdued by sin, be an obstacle; through me, you are offered a vow, through you may my vow be fulfilled and my duty completed.

text: Ignosce nobis Domine confitentibus parce quaesumus veniam postulantibus; nos coram te misericors deflemus peccata tu paenitentium lacrimis inclinatus indulgentiam piissime dona
translation_en: Lord, have mercy upon us as we confess, spare us we humbly ask, grant forgiveness to those who seek it; we before you, merciful one, with tears of penitence bowed, graciously bestow your most compassionate pardon.

text: Illa nos veritas Domine semper illuminet quae sanctorum tuorum cordibus flammam tuae dilectionis accendit.
translation_en: May the truth, Lord, always enlighten us, which kindles in the hearts of your saints the flame of your love.

text: Illabere Domine his sacrificiis ob honorem martyris tui illius tibi oblatis donans nobis ut illius apud tuam clementiam commendemur suffragio cuius hodierno die attollimur de triumpho.
translation_en: Lord, we present these sacrifices to your honor for the veneration of your martyr. We give them in order that through his intercession we may be recommended to your clemency, whose triumph we are raised up on this day.

text: Illabere Domine oblatis tibi sacrificiis et susceptis fidelium votis requiem iube prorogari defunctis.
translation_en: Lord, wash away the offerings presented to You with sacrifices and grant that the rest be prolonged for the departed faithful.

text: Illabere in animas nostras omnipotens aeterne Deus et templa quae lapis ille angularis tuus exstruxit ingredere ut maiestati <tuae> hostias praeparatas per ipsum tibi possimus offerre qui sancta constituit et pacem nobis propitiatus indulsit.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, let us bring into our souls and enter the temples which your precious stone of the cornerstone has built, so that we may offer you the prepared sacrifices to your majesty. You who have sanctified the holy ones and have granted us peace by your propitiation.

text: Illo nos igne quaesumus Domine Spiritus Sanctus inflammet quem Dominus noster Iesus Christus misit in terram et voluit vehementer accendi.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the Holy Spirit may set aflame within us, whom our Lord Jesus Christ sent on earth and desired to burn with great fervor.

text: Illumina quaesumus Domine populum tuum et splendore gratiae tuae cor eius semper accende ut Salvatoris mundi stella famulante manifestata nativitas mentibus eorum et reveletur semper et crescat.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, to enlighten Your people and always kindle the heart of one with the splendor of Your grace, so that the manifestation of the Star of the Savior of the world may be revealed in their minds, and may always appear and grow.

text: Illumina Domine quaesumus populum tuum et splendore gloriae tuae cor eius semper accende ut Salvatorem suum et incessanter agnoscat et veraciter apprehendat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you enlighten your people. May the splendor of your glory always kindle his heart, so that he may constantly recognize and truly comprehend his Savior.

text: Illuminatorem diei huius te dominum Iesum Christum qui nos ad sacra resurrectionis tuae festa perduxisti per ipsa sacrorum sollemnium suffragia deprecamur ut sacrificia haec quae tibi sub sacramento divini corporis offeruntur tam acceptabilia tibi nostro facias obsequio quam sunt divino instituta mysterio simulque universam Ecclesiam tuam sanctificatione perfundens et offerentibus remunerationem et sacrificantibus veniam et sumpturis salutem perpetuam largiaris.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord Jesus Christ, the illuminator of this day, who led us to the sacred festivals of your resurrection through the solemnity of the sacraments, that you make these offerings presented to you under the sacrament of the divine body acceptable to you as they are established by the divine mystery. At the same time, pour out sanctification upon your whole Church and grant remuneration to those who offer and forgiveness to those who sin, and bestow eternal salvation on those who make sacrifices.

text: Immensa largitatis tuae clementia Domine nobis semper adsit quae et haec praesentia libamina caelesti benedictione sanctificet et per dilecti confessoris tui atque pontificis Nicolai preces nosmetipsos tibi pro acceptabili hostia praeparet.
translation_en: May the immense kindness of yours, Lord, always be with us, which this presence consecrates with heavenly blessing and through the prayers of your beloved confessor and pope Nicholas may prepare us before you as an acceptable offering.

text: Immensae pietatis tuae clementiam quaesumus divina maiestas ut qui annua beati Mauri confessoris tui atque abbatis sollemnia celebramus eius obtinentibus meritis perveniamus ad gaudia repromissa.
translation_en: We humbly ask the greatness of your mercy, divine majesty, that we who celebrate the annual feast days of your blessed confessor and abbot, St. Maurice, may by his merits attain to the promised joys.

text: Immensam et indebitam omnipotens Deus pietatem tuam humiliter imploramus ut famulum tuum illum interventu sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae a peccatis omnibus propitius absolvas atque a cunctis reatibus clementer emundes tuaque miseratione ab omni iniquitate custodias et bonis operibus intentum beatae immortalitatis praestes esse participem.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Almighty God, with immense and unmerited pity, to absolve your servant from all sins through the intervention of the Holy Mother of God, Mary. May He graciously cleanse him from all guilt, keep him safe from every wickedness, and grant him to partake in blessed immortality by performing good works.

text: Immensam tremendamque pietatis tuae clementiam omnipotens Deus supplices exoramus ut auxilio tuo universa a nobis terrenorum vitiorum saeculariumque discriminum temptamenta discedant atque in Ecclesia tua catholica religionis semper maneat illibata devotio.
translation_en: Most powerful God, we humbly beseech your immense and terrible mercy. We ask that through your help, all earthly vices and worldly trials are avoided by us, and that our devotion to your Catholic Church remains forever uncorrupted.

text: Immortalis alimoniae sacramenta Domine suscipientes suppliciter imploramus ut intercessione beatae Mildrethae virginis tuae et virtutum proficiamus incrementis et continuae protectionis tuae muniamur suffragiis.
translation_en: Immortal sacraments, Lord, we humbly ask that you receive us. May we progress by the intercession of blessed Mildreth, your virgin, and be fortified by your virtues through increments, and may we be protected continuously by your prayers.

text: Immortalitatis alimonia qua pascimur et potamur illuc nostra quaesumus Domine enutriat desideria ubi visio tua sanctos tuos beatitudinis aeternae reficit manna.
translation_en: Sustain us, Lord, with the food and drink of immortality where our desire is satisfied; there where your vision refreshes your saints with the manna of eternal beatitude.

text: Immortalitatis alimoniam consecuti quaesumus Domine ut quod ore percepimus mente sectemur.
translation_en: Having obtained sustenance of immortality, we humbly ask You, Lord, that what we have received with our mouth we may follow with our mind.

text: Impetret quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis auxilium oratio iusta sanctorum ut in quorum sunt celebritate devoti fiant in corum perpetua sorte participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your faithful may obtain the help of a just prayer from the saints, so that in their festivity they may become participants in the eternal company of those for whom they are devoted.

text: Impetret quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis auxilium pietatis oratio beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Sisinii Martyrii et Alexandri sed et sacerdotis et confessoris tui Simpliciani ut in quorum sollemnitate sumus devoti facias nos propitius in eorum perpetua esse sorte participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant aid to your faithful ones through the prayers of your most blessed martyrs Sisinnius and Martyrius, as well as your priest and confessor Simplicianus. Let us, who are devoted on their feast day, be made worthy participants in their eternal lot.

text: Imple Domine cordis nostri intima tuarum delectationibus hostiarum ut esuries tui sancti corporis et tui sacri sanguinis sitis iam nunc se gaudeat sumere quod numquam timeat non habere quo te esurientes atque sitientes et viventibus et defunctis fidelibus congrua remedia impetremus.
translation_en: Fill, Lord, our hearts with the inmost delights of your offerings, that the hunger and thirst of your holy body and sacred blood may now rejoice to take what they never fear to lack, for those who hunger and thirst for you and live or are dead, we humbly request suitable remedies.

text: Imple Domine petitiones nostras et tamquam pinguissimum nos holocaustum assume ut inimicorum incursionibus propulsatis salutaris tui opitulatione laetemur.
translation_en: Lord, fill up our petitions and take us as a most fattened sacrifice. Thus, driven off by the attacks of our enemies, we may rejoice in Your saving intervention.

text: Imple nos Deus spiritu sancto in quo signati sumus et a quo tangimur ut salvemur ut hodie nos idem spiritus praeveniens in miseratione a delictis emundet et cras in muneris collatione glorificet. Hodie maculas abluat et cras dona distribuat. Hodie linguam nostram in voce confessionis aperiat et cras eandem faciat praedicare magnalia tua quo iam hodie per ipsum tacti ita eluamur a crimine ut cras dignanter in nostra iubeat corda introire.
translation_en: Fill us, God, with the Holy Spirit in whom we are signed and from whom we are touched, that today the same Spirit may precede in cleansing us from sins, and tomorrow on the distribution of rewards glorify us. Today let it wash away our stains and tomorrow distribute gifts to us. Today open our tongue in the voice of confession, and tomorrow make it proclaim your great deeds as today we have been touched by it so that through it we may be washed clean from sin that tomorrow we may worthy enter into our hearts according to your command.

text: Impleatur in nobis quaesumus Domine sacramenti paschalis sancta libatio nosque de terrenis affectibus ad caeleste transferat institutum.
translation_en: Fill us, we ask you Lord, with the sacrament of Easter; may this holy anointing transform us from earthly emotions to a heavenly way of life.

text: Imploramus Domine clementiam tuam ut haec divina ieiuniorum subsidia a vitiis expiatus ad festa ventura nos praeparent.
translation_en: We implore You, Lord, your mercy, that these divine aids for the fasting may be purified from vices, and prepare us for the upcoming feasts.

text: Implorantes Domine misericordiam fideles populos propitius intuere ut qui praeter te alium non noverunt tuis semper beneficiis glorientur.
translation_en: Lord, graciously behold thy faithful people as they implore mercy. May those who have known nothing but you rejoice in your continual blessings.

text: Improximasse passionis Christi tui Deus diem sentientes et ieiunio animas affligimus et offerre tibi puras hostias frequentamus per quod te flebiliter imploramus ut nubis carnis et spiritus purificationem et defunctis iubeas impertiri quietem.
translation_en: On approaching the day of your Passion, O God, we are made sensitive and afflict our souls with fasting. We present to you pure offerings in frequent prayer, whereby we humbly entreat you to grant us purification of flesh and spirit. And to the departed, we implore you to grant peace.

text: In commemoratione beatae Agathae virginis tuae et martyris altaria tua Domine mysticis muneribus cumulamus maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecantes ut ipsius adiuvantibus meritis cunctis mereamur carere contagiis.
translation_en: In commemoration of your blessed virgin and martyr Agatha, we pile up your altars with mystical offerings, humbly entreating your majesty. We ask that through her merits, all may deserve to be free from contagions.

text: In conspectu divinae maiestatis tuae Domine hanc placationis hostiam beati Danielis intercessio veneranda commendet quae quidem angelicis tibi manibus oblata tuaque dextera benedicta ab omni nos reddat peccatorum labe purgatos.
translation_en: In the presence of Your divine majesty, Lord, may the worthy intercession of blessed Daniel commend this offering of appeasement to You. Indeed, offered to You by angelic hands, may Your blessed right hand return us from all the stain of sins purified.

text: In conspectu maiestatis tuae quaesumus omnipotens Deus intercedente sancta Dei Genitrice Maria et omnibus sanctis tuis oblationes nostrae et preces adscendant; tua propitiatione veniam nobis et pacem tribue; hostem famem et pestem et omnem immunditiam a nubis repelle; fidem spem et caritatem nobis largire; defensione tua nos semper circumtege; hostium nostrorum superbiam et virtutem contere; omnibus nubis bona facientibus abundantiam tribue; discordantes ad pacis bona converte; defunctis nostris requiem concede et omnibus fidelibus tuis vitam sempiternam largire.
translation_en: In the presence of your majesty, we humbly ask, O Almighty God, with the intercession of the Holy Mother of God, Mary, and all your saints, may our offerings and prayers ascend to you; through your mercy grant us forgiveness and peace; drive away from us famine, pestilence, and every uncleanliness; bestow on us faith, hope, and charity; protect us with your defense; humble the pride and power of our enemies; bestow abundance to all those who do good works; turn discordant souls towards peace; grant rest to our deceased and eternal life to all your faithful.

text: In hac commemoratione defuncturum fidelium illorum pro qua tibi Deus hoc sacrificium laudis offerimus clementiam tuam suppliciter exoramus ut illis illa beatorum gaudia cum sanctis dones praemia indeficientia et nobis inviolatae pacis concordiam conferas observandam.
translation_en: In this commemoration of the faithful departed for whom we offer you, God, this sacrifice of lauds with humble supplication, we earnestly ask for your mercy to grant them the blessed joys with the saints and bestow upon them eternal rewards. May you confer upon us an inviolable harmony of peace that is observable.

text: In hac Domine sanctorum tuorum Augustini suorumque consortum translatione splendida ipsorum quaesumus patrocinio complaceant tuae pietati haec sancta libamina.
translation_en: In this, Lord, in the glorious translation of your saints Augustine and his companions, we humbly ask that they grant their patronage to these holy offerings on account of your mercy.

text: In hac triumphali sancti patris nostri Augustini sollemnitate hanc hostiam benignissime Domine serena clementia suscipe quae illi proficiat ad gloriam et nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: In this triumphal solemnity of our holy father Augustine, graciously receive, Lord, this offering with serene clemency, may it benefit him for glory and us for forgiveness.

text: In honorem beati archangeli Michaelis loca nomini tuo dicata mystico frequentamus obsequio; praesta quaesumus eorum nos gaudere suffragiis quorum sublimia merita recensemus.
translation_en: We frequently visit these places dedicated to the name of the blessed archangel Michael in honor; grant us, we beseech you, that we may enjoy the intercessions of those whose lofty merits we acknowledge.

text: In honorem beatissimi martyris tui baptistae Ioannis cuius hodie passionem celebramus his maiestati tuae omnipotens Deus laudibus servientes sollemnia festa concinimus suppliciter deprecantes ut cuius meritis obsequimur eius te donante apud clementiam tuam precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: In honor of your most blessed martyr, Baptist John, whose passion we celebrate today, we humbly serve with our praises, and we dedicate solemn feasts. We supplicate you, almighty God, that through his merits we may be helped by your prayers in your mercy.

text: In honorem martyris tui illius votivum tibi Deus sacrificium exhibentes rogamus ut eius meritis et offerentibus veniam et sepultis requiem largiaris aeternam quo huius suffragatione te utrobique parciturum praebeas cuius te in passione victorem fuisse demonstras.
translation_en: In honor of your martyr, offering you a votive sacrifice, we ask that through his merits you grant forgiveness to the offerers and eternal rest to the buried ones. May you show mercy to both sides because of this supplication, since you demonstrated yourself as victor in his passion.

text: In honorem nominis tui Domine preces et munera offerimus pro famulo tuo illo; praesta quaesumus ut convenienter haec agere et remedia illi valeamus obtinere sempiterna.
translation_en: In honor of Your name, Lord, we offer prayers and gifts for Your servant; grant us that he may act fittingly and be able to obtain eternal remedies.

text: In honorem virginis tuae Euphemiae has tibi oblatas indivisa Trinitas Deus pro vivorum commoditate et defunctorum requie propitiatus assume ut haec virgo quae nec rotarum argumento victa dissolvitur nec appositis ignibus corpore concrematur nec viventes curis superfluis dilabi nec sepultos poenalibus flammis patiatur absorbi.
translation_en: In honor of your virgin Euphemia, these offerings you have received, undivided Trinity, God, are propitiated for the benefit of the living and rest of the dead. We pray that this virgin, who is not dissolved by the arguments of wheels nor hardened by placed fires, nor melted away by superfluous concerns of the living, nor endures to be absorbed by penal flames of the buried, may not suffer.

text: Quis vocaris ?
translation_en: Who are you called?

text: In ieiunii humilitate substratis omnipotens sempiterne Deus absterge omnem labem peccati ut mundatis nostri cordis arcanis cum abstinentia ciborum iurgiorum etiam inquietudinibus exclusis dilectio tua et proximi nostris in cordibus pura succrescat.
translation_en: In humility during fasting, the almighty everlasting God, wipe away every trace of sin so that with abstention from food, disputes, and even disturbances excluded, Your love and pure affection for our neighbors may grow in our hearts.

text: In ieiunio hoc afflicti corpore et corde contriti frequentamus ad te preces clementissime Deus ut cum abstinentia corporali abstinentia nobis vitiorum donetur ut restricto corpore ab epulis tu qui es refectio vera in nostris cordibus oriaris.
translation_en: In this fasting, we afflict our body and our heart is contrite; we approach you with supplications most compassionate God. That with bodily abstinence, we may be given the abstinence from vices. May you who are true refreshment in ourselves, rise up within our hearts as we restrain our bodies from feasts.

text: In memoria beatissimi Bartholomaei apostoli tui Christe Domine oblatum sacrificium sanctificare dignare et offerentes solita miseratione a piaculis liberos effice ut dum sacrificium nostrum prece apostoli tui habueris ratum ex illo sumentibus paracliti conferas donum et omnium fidelium visceribus infundas cor mundum et spiritum rectum et qui altaris tui officiis nos indignos pro certo fatemur meritis sancti apostoli tui Bartholomaei iustificari in perpetuum mereamur.
translation_en: In memory of your most blessed Apostle, Bartholomew, Christ, Lord, deign to sanctify the offering presented and make us, through your usual mercy, free from sins. May it be that while you find our sacrifice acceptable, through the merit of your apostle Bartholomew, you confer upon them the gift of the Paraclete, infuse into the hearts of all faithful a clean heart and an upright spirit. We who are unworthy of your altar services, we acknowledge for certain that we will be justified forever by the merits of your apostle Bartholomew.

text: In memoria aeterna beati martyris tui illius Domine laetamur tempore recurrenti magnificantes eius gloriam passionis et beatitudinis ipsius facta celebrantes quae a te accepit atque in te possedit largitore inexhausto retributore perpetuo fonte profluo thesauro sempiterno; da nobis quaesumus veneratoribus suis eius peculiare suffragium et quibus dedisti nominis eius titulum praesta patrocinium indisruptum.
translation_en: In eternal memory, we rejoice, Lord, in the returning time of your blessed martyr. We magnify his glory and celebrate the deeds of his passion and beatitude, which he received from you and possessed from your inexhaustible giver, perpetual rewarder, flowing from the eternal treasure; grant us, we ask, faithful to him, a particular intercession from him, and to those whom you have given his title, present uninterrupted patronage.

text: In mentibus nostris Domine verae fidei sacramenta confirma ut qui conceptum de virgine Deum verum et hominem confitemur per eius salutiferae resurrectionis potentiam ad aeternam mereamur pervenire laetitiam.
translation_en: Lord, confirm in our minds the sacred mysteries of true faith, so that we who confess God truly conceived from the Virgin and at the same time man, may be worthy through the powerful resurrection of Him to attain eternal happiness.

text: In oblatis tibi Deus sacrificiis respice et decimas rerum in eorum a quibus oblatae sunt profectum assume ut eorum facultates te praesule numquam revocentur ad decimum qui in oblatis tibi fideliter decimum tuum non praeterierunt institutum.
translation_en: In the offerings made to you, O God, regard the sacrifices and assume the tithes of their goods from those whose offerings they were given, so that their resources may never be recalled for a tithe, which in the offerings made to you faithful people have not overlooked your established institution.

text: In proximum quidem est Domine dies adventus tui sed quaesumus ut antequam venias expiari mereamur ab omni contagione delicti. Prius dilue rogamus in nobis omne quod in illa futura examinatione puniturus es ut cum iustus adveneris iudex non invenias in nobis quod condemnes.
translation_en: In the next day, indeed, Lord, is the day of your coming, but we ask that before you come, we may be worthy of being purified from all contagion of sin. First, we humbly ask that within us, everything that will be punished in the future examination, may be washed away. So when the righteous judge arrives, he may not find anything in us to condemn.

text: In sancti apostoli tui Andreae Domine translatione nos haec oblatio pietati tuae reddat acceptos ut sicut illum beata retributio ita nos gratiae tuae comitetur miseratio.
translation_en: In the translation of your apostle St. Andrew, Lord, may this offering of our devotion return accepted to your pity, so that, just as he was rewarded by blessed recompense, may we be accompanied by your grace and mercy.

text: In sanctorum tuorum passionibus pretiosis te Domine mirabilem praedicantes munera votiva deferimus; praesta quaesumus ut sicut illorum tibi grata sunt merita sic nostrae servitutis accepta reddantur officia.
translation_en: In the precious sufferings of your saints, we praise you as marvelous, and we bring our vow-offerings to you; grant us, we beseech you, that just as their merits were pleasing to you, so may our service be accepted and rewarded with due office.

text: In sanctae martyris tuae Iulianae passione pretiosa te Domine mirabilem praedicantes munera votiva deferimus; praesta quaesumus ut sicut eius tibi grata sunt munera sic nostrae servitutis accepta reddantur officia.
translation_en: In the passion of your saintly martyr Julian, you are wonderfully proclaimed as precious gifts through votive offerings; we ask that you grant us, so that just as her offerings to you were pleasing, our service may also be accepted and return the duties owed.

text: In te est Deus omne desiderium spei nostrae in quo est beatitudo dulcedinis repromissae. Tu igitur relaxans peccata carnem nostram vulnere crucis tuae mortifica ut qui hos dies passionis tuae cum voto ieiunii celebramus in futura beatitudine muneremur. Has quoque hostias ita quaesumus tua divinitas benedicat ut ex his libantibus criminum purgationem exhibeant.
translation_en: In you is God all our hope of salvation, in whom is the promised happiness of sweetness. Therefore, relaxing our sinful flesh with the wound of your cross, mortify it so that we who celebrate these days of your passion with a vow of fasting may be rewarded in future blessedness. We also humbly ask your divinity to bless these sacrifices, so that from those who offer them, purgation of sins may be shown.

text: In tuo conspectu Domine quaesumus talia nostra sint munera quae et placare te valeant et nos tibi placere perficiant.
translation_en: In your sight, Lord, we humbly ask that our gifts may be such as can appease you and cause us to please you.

text: In tuorum Domine pretiosa morte iustorum sacrificium illud offerimus de quo martyrium sumpsit omne principium.
translation_en: In Your, Lord, we offer this precious sacrifice of the just for whom martyrdom took its origin.

text: In veneratione beati Quintini martyris tui omnipotens Deus tibi laudis hostiam immolamus orantes ut ipse pro nobis intercessor exsistat qui pro tuo nomine gloriosa morte occubuit.
translation_en: In the veneration of your blessed martyr Quintinus, O almighty God, we offer you a sacrifice of praise, praying that you may stand as our intercessor who, for your name, gloriously laid down his life.

text: In veneratione nominis dilecti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi tibi Deus pater misericordiarum devotis mentibus hostias immolamus suppliciter deprecantes ut earum virtute cunctis egentibus praestetur auxilium ut in eodem nomine delectantes salutarem sui propositi consequantur effectum.
translation_en: In reverence of the beloved Name of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, to you, God Father of all Mercies, we humbly offer devout hearts as sacrifices, pleading that through their power, assistance may be granted to all who are in need. May they delight in the same Name and achieve the salvation of their intended purpose.

text: In veneratione sancti patris Augustini beatorumque eius sociorum quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut tantis patronis nos iungant haec sancta quae sumpsimus.
translation_en: In the veneration of Saint Augustine and the blessed companions, we humbly ask Almighty God that with such great patrons He may join us to these holy things which we have received.

text: Incende cor meum Domine concupiscentiae tuae flamma quae cunctas vepres pectoris mei exurat; totum tolle quod nocet; ipsum praesta quod decet; tolle nocentia cuncta; doce praesentia vitare; salus esto infirmitatis meae et verus resuscitator animae meae.
translation_en: Kindle within me, O Lord, the flame of your desire that burns up all the vices in my heart; take away what harms; grant what is fitting; take away all harm; teach me to avoid; may health be for my infirmity and may you be the true reviver of my soul.

text: Inchoata ieiunia Domine quaesumus benigno favore prosequere ut sicut ab alimentis in corpore ita a vitiis ieiunemus in mente.
translation_en: During our fasting, Lord, we humbly ask for Your kind favor to follow us so that, just as we abstain from food in body, we may be free from vices in mind.

text: Inchoata Domine quaesumus benigno favore prosequere ut sicut ab alimentis in corpore ita a vitiis custodi in mente.
translation_en: Begun, Lord, we humbly ask with Your benevolent favor to follow, so that just as You protect us from food for the body, may You also protect us from vices in mind.

text: Ieiunia nostra quaesumus Domine benigno favore prosequere ut sicut ab alimentis in corpore ita a vitiis ieiunemus in mente.
translation_en: Our fasting, we beseech you, Lord, with a kind favor follow, so that as we are without food in the body, we may also be without vices in mind.

text: Inchoata ieiunia quaesumus Domine benigno favore prosequere ut observantiam quam corporaliter exercemus mentibus valeamus implere sinceris.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to follow with your benevolent favor the beginning of our fast, that we may be able to fulfill the observance which we exercise bodily with sincerity in our minds.

text: Inchoata ieiunia quaesumus Domine benigno favore prosequere ut observantiam quam corporaliter exhibemus mentibus etiam sinceris exercere valeamus.
translation_en: During this time of fasting, we humbly ask you, Lord, with your kind favor to follow us, so that we may be able to exercise the observance that we present corporally in our minds with sincerity as well.

text: Inclina aurem tuam ad preces familiae tuae et da pacem quam permanere iugiter praecepisti; illud etiam specialiter praestare digneris ut parem caritatem teneamus quam pontifex tuus Martinus in hoc saeculo te opitulante meruit obtinere.
translation_en: Incline your ear to the prayers of your family and grant the peace that you have continually commanded; moreover, you may also deign to bestow it specifically, that we hold an equal love as your pope Martin in this age has obtained through your aid.

text: Redemptor noster aspice Deus et veni ad liberandum nos de profundo iniquitatis et dona Ecclesiae tuae perpetuam tranquillitatem et pacem.
translation_en: Our Redeemer, look upon us, God, and come to deliver us from the deep of iniquity. Grant eternal peace and tranquility to your Church.

text: Inclina aurem tuam omnipotens Deus et esto nobis praesentis vitae rector ut sis remunerator futurae.
translation_en: Bend your ear, all-powerful God, and be present in our current life as our guide, so that you may be the rewarder of our future.

text: Inclina Domine aurem tuam ad precem nostram et ne nos de manu tuae miserationis excludas et quia mirabilia tua non in tenebris sed in lumine cognoscuntur tetra peccati nostri discute fulgore virtutis tuae et fac luce radiare iustitiae ut qui verbum vitae fide inclinabili continemus dilectionis in te atque proximum tuo testimonio fulgeamus.
translation_en: Bend, O Lord, your ear to our prayer and do not exclude us from the hand of your mercy. And because your miracles are known not in darkness but in light, dispel the harshness of our sins with the brightness of your power and let justice shine like a radiant light as we who hold the word of life firmly with an unyielding faith testify to our love for you and our neighbor.
