text: Inclina Domine aures pietatis tuae et exaudi preces nostras; aperi oculos maiestatis tuae et respice propitius super famulos tuos qui nobis temporalia bona largiuntur; dona eis indulgentiam peccatorum et in operibus bonis perseverantiam ut in regno tuo magna pro parvis caelestia pro terrenis et pro temporalibus sempiterna recipiant.
translation_en: Bend over, Lord, the ears of your mercy and hear our prayers; open the eyes of your majesty and look upon us kindly, who give us temporary goods; give them forgiveness for sins and perseverance in good works so that for small things they may receive great heavenly things instead of earthly ones, and eternal things instead of temporal ones.

text: Inclina Domine pias aures ad desideria supplicantium et quae devoto corde poscimus benignus admitte ut servo tuo illi qui typo cottidianae aut triduanae vel quartanae vexationis fatigatur fidelis famuli tui Sigismundi precibus benignus occurras ut dum nobis illius patefacis merita famulo tuo aegroto conferas medicinam.
translation_en: Bend over, Lord, your gracious ears to the desires of the supplicants, and what we humbly ask with a devoted heart, may you, benevolent one, admit. May you, the servant's faithful master, appear in response to the prayers of your servant Sigismund, so that while revealing his merits to us, you may grant healing medicine to your sick servant.

text: Inclina Domine precibus nostris aures tuae pietatis et animae famuli tui illius remissionem tribue omnium peccatorum ut mortis vinculis absolutus transitum mereatur ad vitam.
translation_en: Bend towards, Lord, our supplications, the ears of your mercy, and grant the soul of your servant remission of all sins, that he may be worthy to pass through death unto life.

text: Inclina Domine precibus nostris aures tuae pietatis et animae famuli tui illius remissionem tribue omnium peccatorum ut usque ad resurrectionis diem in lucis amoenitate requiescat.
translation_en: Bend down, Lord, our prayers to your ears of mercy, and grant the soul of your servant remission of all sins, so that until the day of the resurrection he may rest in the pleasantness of light.

text: Inclina quaesumus aurem tuam supplicationibus nostris et animae famulae tuae perpetuae lucis tribue mansionem.
translation_en: Incline, we humbly ask, your ear to our supplications and grant, O servant of eternal light, a dwelling place to the soul.

text: Inclina quaesumus Domine aures tuas ad preces nostras pro quibus misericordiam tuam supplices exoramus ut animas famulorum famularumque tuarum in pacis ac lucis regione constituas et sanctorum tuorum iubeas esse consortes.
translation_en: Bend to us, Lord, your ears to our prayers, for which we humbly entreat your mercy. Grant that the souls of your servants and their attendants may dwell in the region of peace and light. And command them to be companions of your saints.

text: Refice nos Domine donis tuis
translation_en: Bend our knees, O Lord, with your gifts

text: Inclina Domine aurem tuam ad preces nostras quibus misericordiam tuam supplices deprecamur ut animam famuli tui illius quam de hoc saeculo migrare iussisti in pacis ac lucis regione constituas et sanctorum tuorum iubeas esse consortem.
translation_en: Bend over, Lord, your ear to our prayers, to which we humbly ask for your mercy. May the soul of that servant whom you have commanded to leave this world be placed in the region of peace and light, and may you command him to be a companion of your saints.

text: Inclina Domine quaesumus aurem tuam ad preces nostras quibus misericordiam tuam supplices exoramus ut animam famuli tui illius quam hodie assumpsisti in pacis ac lucis regione constituas et sanctorum tuorum iubeas esse consortem.
translation_en: Bend down, we ask you, Lord, your ear to our prayers, to which with suppliant hearts we implore your mercy. May the soul of your servant whom you today received into the region of peace and light, you establish. Command it to be a companion of your saints.

text: Inclina quaesumus Domine precibus nostris aures tuae pietatis et animae famuli tui illius remissionem tribue omnium peccatorum ut his sacrificiis purificatus consortio mereatur perfrui beatorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, incline your ears to our prayers of devotion. Grant the soul of your servant remission of all sins, that having been purified by these sacrifices he may deserve to participate in the company of the blessed.

text: Inclina quaesumus piissime Deus aurem tuam ad preces nostrae humilitatis et gressus nostros propitius ab omni errore converte viamque nobis pacis et caritatis ostende.
translation_en: Incline, we humbly ask, most gracious God, your ear to our prayers of humility and kindly turn our steps from every error. Show us the way of peace and love.

text: Inclinantes se Domine maiestati tuae propitiatus intende ut qui divino munere sunt refecti caelestibus semper muniantur auxiliis.
translation_en: Lord, incline Your mercy towards Your majesty, that those who have been refreshed by the divine gift may always be sustained with heavenly aid.

text: Incliti Domine confessoris tui Martialis precibus et meritis hoc nostrae quaesumus placatus assume sacrificium laudis quo heredes fieri mereamur regni caelestis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O glorious Lord, that through the prayers and merits of your confessor Martin, you may be pleased to accept this sacrifice of praise, so that we may worthy become heirs of the kingdom of heaven.

text: Indicabimus plane nec umquam tacebimus passum te Christe pro redemptione miserorum resurrexisse pro salute felicium caelos adscendisse pro virtute meritorum venturum te esse iudicem mortuorum atque viventium. Quod scientes Domine ut nobis dies illa terribilis aliquantulum ex tua propitiatione mitior adveniat haec munera offerimus quae ut nobis in salutem percepta contingant supplices deprecamur.  Visitet ea spiritus tuus sanctus qui in similitudinem flammae Manoae dona suscepit. Visitet et vivificet ea spiritus tuus sanctus qui per vaporem incendii Eliae prophetae holocaustum assumpsit. Visitet et vivificet ea spiritus tuus sanctus qui ignearum divisione linguarum in apostolorum tuorum cordibus commeavit ut recepta in visceribus nostris et praesentem nobis et aeternam praestent salutem.
translation_en:
We will clearly proclaim and will never cease to declare that Christ has risen for the redemption of the miserable, ascended to heaven for the salvation of the happy, will come as judge of both the dead and the living. Knowing this, Lord, that we may experience those terrible days somewhat milder through your propitiation, we offer these gifts, so that they may benefit us in our salvation. Suppliantly we pray.
May your holy spirit visit these things which took on the likeness of the flame of Manoah's gift. May your holy spirit visit and revitalize these things which through Elijah's prophet's burning offering were assumed. May your holy spirit visit and revitalize these things which through the division of tongues by the fire among your apostles was received, so that it may be received in our innermost parts and present to us both temporal and eternal salvation.

text: Indignos nos quaesumus Domine famulos tuos quos actionis propriae culpa contristat unigeniti Filii tui adventu laetifica.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to cheer up your servants whom the fault of their own actions saddens, through the coming of your only-begotten Son.

text: Indivisa Trinitas et una maiestas quae praedictorum trium martyrum in passione laudaris et praesentium sacrificiorum litatione placandus adscisceris te vocibus votis et orationibus imploramus ut qui illis inexpugnabilem tribuisti devicto hoste victoriam haec nostra sanctifices propitiatus oblata.
translation_en: The indivisible Trinity and one majesty, which is praised in the passion of the aforementioned three martyrs and appeased by the litanies of the present sacrifices, we implore you with voices, vows, and prayers to bestow upon us, who were given an invincible victory over the defeated enemy by You, the same sanctification as that which You granted them. We humbly request this in propitiation of our offerings.

text: Indulge Domine petentibus nobis pro famulo tuo illo indulgentiam poscente ut secura mente tibi Domino Deo nostro victimam pro ipso offerre valeamus et pro delictis suis veniam obtineat; sanitatis per te pater sancte munera consecutus ad salutem gratiae aeternae possit cum tuo adiutorio pervenire.
translation_en: Indulge, Lord, those who plead for us on behalf of your servant, the one asking for indulgence, that we may be able to offer ourselves safely as a victim to you, our Lord God, and obtain forgiveness for his sins; may he, having obtained the gifts of health through you, holy Father, be able to attain salvation by eternal grace with your assistance.

text: Indulgentiam nobis Domine beata Agatha martyr (tua) imploret quae tibi grata exstitit virtute martyrii et merito castitatis.
translation_en: Blessed Agatha, your martyrdom pleasing to the Lord, intercedes for us, who, by virtue of her martyrdom and merit of chastity, found favor with Him.

text: Indulgentiam nobis Domine beata Agatha martyr imploret quae tibi grata semper exstitit et merito castitatis et tuae professione virtutis.
translation_en: Blessed Agatha, the martyr, intercedes for us, Lord, who always stood pleasing to you and deservedly so through her chastity and profession of virtue.

text: Indulgentiam nobis Domine quaesumus sancti illius postulet tibi grata precatio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the saint may intercede for us and present a pleasing prayer before you.

text: Indulgentiam tuam Domine nobis quaesumus sancti Laurentii postulet grata precatio per dilectissimum Filium tuum Deum dominum et Salvatorem nostrum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the gracious prayer of Saint Lawrence, your most-beloved Son, God, lord and Savior, may grant us your indulgence.

text: Indulgentiam nobis Domine tribue peccatorum ut instituta paschalia tibi placitis sensibus operemur.
translation_en: Lord, grant us indulgence for our sins, so that we may work with pleasing senses during the Paschal institutions.

text: Indulgentiam nobis praebeant haec munera quaesumus Domine largiorem quae venerabilis Andreae suffragiis offeruntur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to grant us these merits; may it be a more generous indulgence that is offered through the intercession of Venerable Andrew.

text: Ineffabilem misericordiam tuam Domine nobis clementer ostende ut simul nos et a peccatis exuas et a poenis quas pro his meremur eripias.
translation_en: Unfathomable mercy of Yours, Lord, reveal to us kindly, that both we and our sins may be unclothed and that we may be freed from the penalties which we deserve for them.

text: Ineffabili corporis sanguinisque Filii tui suavitate refecti quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut beati Barnabae apostoli tui supplicatione ad salutem nobis mentis et corporis iugiter proficiat.
translation_en: Sustained by the sweetness of your Son's ineffable bodily and blood, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through the intercession of your apostle Blessed Barnabas, may there be perpetual progress for the health of our mind and body.

text: Ineffabilis sapientia Dei patris Christe Filius Dei qui cum illo et spiritu sancto unum deitatis possides nomen Ecclesiae tuae placabilis respice plebem et qui apostolo tuo Bartholomaeo dedisti ut per illum possent daemonia eiici et vinculis mirabiliter stringi tribue nobis ut absolutis peccaminum vinculis per illum efficiamur beati quatenus sic nostra acceptentur obsequia ut his celebrationibus et vivis securitas et defunctis concedatur requies sempiterna ut apostoli tui praedicatio viventes cottidie corrigat et eius meritum defunctorum spiritus in pace laetificet.
translation_en: Ineffable wisdom of God the Father, Christ, Son of God, who with him and the Holy Spirit possess one deity's name, have mercy upon your Church. Look kindly upon your people and, through your apostle Bartholomew, grant us that we may be freed from demonic possession and bound by miracles. May we, having been absolved of the bonds of sin through him, become blessed, so that our obedience may be accepted during these celebrations and for the living, a daily correction of your apostle's preaching may be granted, and for the dead, an eternal rest may be conceded. May the merit of your defunctorum spirits bring peace.

text: Inenarrabilis sacramenti dulcedinis suavitate refecti quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per venerabile atque sacratissimum sepulcrum tuum nos facias hodie clarescere gaudiis et tribue quaesumus nobis Domine famulis tuis ut nullius umquam terrenis affectibus implicati te sequi mereamur desideratum dominum rerum omnium bonarum creatorem.
translation_en: Filled with the inexpressible sweetness of the sacrament, we humbly ask You, our Lord God, that through Your venerable and most sacred sepulcher, You make us shine today with joys. And we beseech You, Lord, servants of Yours, that we may deserve to follow the desired Lord, Creator of all good things, uninvolved in any worldly emotions.

text: Inenarrabilis sacramenti dulcedinis suavitate refecti quaesumus Domine beati Marci evangelistae tui muniti suffragiis; nullis umquam impediamur terrenis actibus implicati te sequi desideratum dominum rerum bonarum omnium creatorem.
translation_en: Filled with the inexpressible sweetness of the sacrament, we humbly ask you, Lord, supported by the intercessions of your blessed apostle St. Mark, that we may never be hindered from following our desired Lord, the creator of all good things on earth.

text: Infirmitatem meam respice obsecro mitissime Deus et me indignum famulum tuum propriis et alienis reatibus aggravatum ad meliorem vitam per haec sacramenta quae sumpsi restaurare dignare.
translation_en: I humbly beseech you, most merciful God, to behold my infirmity and restore me, your unworthy servant, burdened with both your own and others' sins, to a better life through these sacred sacraments which I have received.

text: Infirmitatem nostram quaesumus Domine propitius respice et mala omnia quae iuste meremur sanctorum tuorum intercessione averte.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you look upon our infirmity with mercy, and turn away from us all the evils which we justly deserve through the intercession of your saints.

text: Infirmitatem nostram respice omnipotens Deus et quia pondus propriae actionis gravat beati Fabiani martyris tui atque pontificis intercessio gloriosa nos protegat.
translation_en: Look upon our infirmity, Almighty God, and since the weight of our own actions burdens the blessed Fabian your martyr and bishop, may his glorious intercession protect us.

text: Infunde quaesumus Domine cordibus nostris illius conversionis affectum quem beatae Mariae Aegyptiacae a tua gratia novimus infusum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to pour into our hearts the affection for conversion that we know was infused by your grace in the heart of the Blessed Mary of Egypt.

text: Infunde quaesumus Domine Deus per haec sancta quae sumpsimus tuae cordibus nostris lumen sapientiae ut te veraciter agnoscamus et fideliter diligamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord God, to pour through these holy things which we have received into our hearts the light of wisdom, that we may truly recognize you and faithfully love you.

text: Infunde quaesumus famulis tuis Domine Deus spiritum veritatis et pacis ut quae tibi placita sunt toto corde cognoscant et agnita tota virtute sectentur.
translation_en: Pour out, we ask you, Lord God, the Spirit of truth and peace upon your servants, so that with their whole heart they may know what pleases you and with all their might pursue it.

text: Ingenite pater summe qui tanta ac talia beneficii munera virgini gloriosae contulisti Mariae cuius verbo attestante angelo dicata cuius spiritu illibate sistit fecunda cuius virtute divinitus obumbrata cuius iussu mundi salvationem noscitur paritura cuius voluntate virgo sistit ante partum cuius posse virgo mansit post partum cuius imperio ipsi canduit diu castitas cuius miraculo immaculata virginitas ...  Indignis quaesumus annue nobis eius favore tueri pie de nugis sive merito emundari de propriis. Ac sicut illa hodie inter angelorum virginumque choros meruit assumi sive de dono illibatae carnis feliciter iucundari sic nos facias stimulo perfecte exstirpato carnali beatiores ibidem misericorditer admitti fruituri nempe cum angelis ibidem perennius regno quibus hodie fuit per eam laetabunda assumptio ibidem saepe sine termino mansuri ubi omnis caelestis exercitus gloria hodie tantae assumptionis gavisus indesinenter meruit iucundari.
translation_en:
We humbly ask you, most high Father, to accept us by the favor of the aforementioned blessed Virgin Mary. Whose word confirmed the message from the angel, whose spirit remains pure, who was found fertile, whose power was divinely obscured, whose command is known as the salvation of the world, whose will brought forth the virgin birth, whose power remained intact before and after birth, whose purity maintained an eternal chastity, whose miracle established the immaculate virginity.
Indeed, grant us undeserving ones to be protected by her and to be cleansed from our sins through her merits. And as she today merited to be assumed among the choir of angels and virgins, let her graciously enjoy an untainted body. In the same way, let us be admitted perfectly free from carnal desires to the same place, mercifully, so that we may joyfully participate with the angels in a perpetual kingdom, which today rejoiced immensely at her assumed there, where the entire celestial army eternally merited to rejoice and enjoy this great assumption of hers.

text: Ingeniti genite Iesu Dei Filius Christe qui septiformi illo gratiarum spiritu discipulos implens septem nostris partibus tubas septem videlicet praesules destinare dignatus es qui septiformi gratiarum ubertate repleti caeca partis nostrae vel nubila sui praesentia luminarent da in nobis serenum lumen iustitiae aeterni luminis pacem septenam Sancti Spiritus ubertatem quo tuae pacis commodo opulentius pleni gloriosae faciei tuae mereamur praesentia collactari.
translation_en: Hail to the born ones, born is Jesus, Son of God, Christ, who with the sevenfold spirit of thanksgiving has filled His disciples and deigned to destine for us seven bishops, namely, seven lights. Filled with the overflowing sevenfold gratitude, You have made our dark parts shine or illuminated our cloudy presence with Your own light. Grant in us a serene light of justice, the peace of eternal light, the fullness of the sevenfold abundance of the Holy Spirit, so that we may deserve to be enriched with the presence of Your glorious face.

text: Ingeniti genite Iesu huic quaesumus illabere sacrificio tuo coaeterno paraclito spiritu ut dignetur nostris quoque ingerere sensibus et te qui iamdudum venienti ad crucem discipulo inquis: »Tua haec est mater« quam noveras tuam itaque esse genitricem petimus ex hoc libantes calice quod tuo manavit ex latere ut elui mereamur ab omni peccatorum contagione.  Atque in hoc die excessus tuae matris proficiat quaesumus Domine vivis hoc oblatum vel defunctis quod nostris pro peccatis offerimus e manibus nostris. Sicque per istius virginis interventum catholicis etiam subsequatur ecclesiis tuitio regibus praestetur modestia patriae ac orphanis defensio navigantibus itidem concedatur portus exsules suam revertantur ad patriam atque omnibus continentibus et virginibus omnimoda detur perseverantia et ita omnes quidem in commune viventes clerici mereantur aliquantulas diei istius tibi peragere obsequelas ut prece tuae matris valeant suis emundari a peccatis.
translation_en:
We beseech You, Jesus born of the Virgin, to anoint this eternal sacrifice with Your coeternal Paraclete Spirit, that it may be worthy for our senses to partake in it. And as You who were about to come to the cross asked Your disciple, "This is your mother," whom You knew and therefore requested her to be Your mother, we ask You through this chalice that flowed from Your side, that we may be cleansed from all contagion of sins.
In this day of Your Mother's departure, we pray, Lord, that this offering may profit the dead for our sins, which we offer with our hands. May her intervention bring protection to Catholic churches, modesty to kings, and defense to the fatherless. May a safe harbor be granted to those navigating, and exiles return to their homeland. May all continents and virgins be granted perseverance in every way. And may all living clerics deserve to perform some duties on this day in honor of Your Mother's prayer, so that they may be cleansed from sins by Your prayer.

text: Ingeniti genitoris genite filius qui in eo nobis diei huius octavi renovas cultum in quo te discipulorum adspectibus hodie praebuisti palpandum Nam licet haec dies sit prior prae ceteris conditus tamen octavus post septem efficitur revolutus quo ipse sicut admirabiliter e sepulcro surrexisti a mortuis ita ad discipulos inaestimabiliter intrasti ianuis obseratis initium videlicet paschae ac finem exornans congruis sacramentis cum et resurrectio tua custodibus terrorem incuteret et manifestatio discipulorum corda dubia confortaret.  Quaesumus ergo ut nos his sacramentis imbutos fides qua te credimus post istud saeculum tibi repraesentet illaesos. Nullum nobis de te scrupulum dubitationis errorisque aut otium pariat aut quaesitio incauta enutriat. Serva in nomine tuo quos redemisti sanguine pretioso. Contemplandum te nostris sensibus praebe nostrumque cor dignatus ingredere. Esto semper in medio nostri qui hodie pacem nuntians discipulorum in medio adstitisti.  Quique in eis insufflasti spiritum vitae nobis largire eiusdem spiritus consolationem quo sacrum pascha quod evolutis septem dierum cursibus immolavimus huius octavi diei curriculo praesenti sacrificio consummemus ut in hoc die a quo resurrectionis tuae coepimus excolere mysterium praesentis paschae peragamus legitimum sacramentum.
translation_en:
The begotten Son of the eternal Father, born on this octave day, renews the worship for us in which today you have been shown palpably to our disciples' eyes. Although this day is prior to others, it is made octave after seven and thus returns, just as you marvelously rose from the dead, so did you inestimably enter through observed doors on that day. The beginning and end were adorned with fitting sacraments, when your resurrection struck terror into the guards and the manifestation of the disciples comforted their doubtful hearts.
Therefore, we ask that these sacraments imbue us with faith in you, after this age, may represent to us an unconquerable people. Let no scruple, doubt, error or rash questioning arise from us concerning you. May those whom you have redeemed with precious blood keep watch over us. May we contemplate you with our senses and grant that our heart deigns to enter within. Be always in our midst who today pacified the disciples in their midst.
Those upon whom you breathed the spirit of life, may they grant us the same spirit's consolation. The sacred Easter which we offered up over the course of seven days, we complete and consummate today with this octave day's present sacrifice, so that in this day from which we began to celebrate the mystery of the present Easter, we may fulfill the legitimate sacrament.

text: Inscrutabilem secreti tui virtutem trepidi imploramus omnipotens Pater ut has electas ad sanctum sacrificium creaturas in corpus et sanguinem Christi tui de caelo sanctifices et interventu sancti Olavi regis ac martyris nobis in salutem vitae et animae provenire concedas.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty Father for the unfathomable power of your secret, that you sanctify these chosen creatures to the holy sacrifice of your body and blood in heaven. We also request that through the intervention of Saint Olav, the king and martyr, may they come to us for our salvation, life, and soul.

text: Instantibus precibus omnipotens Deus immensas supplicesque tibi referimus gratias per quem cognovimus in terra viam tuam et in omnibus gentibus salutare tuum teque rogamus et petimus ut qui huius martyris tui Mametis sollemnitatem nempe devoto mentis obsequio celebramus cuius hodie sollemnitate et honore laetamur salutis aeternae munera consequamur.
translation_en: With urgent prayers, we humbly refer to you, Almighty God, the thanks that we owe you for knowing on earth your way and in all nations your salvation, and we implore and ask you that who celebrates today the solemnity of your martyr Mametis with a devoted mind's obedience, may rejoice in this day's solemnity and honor, and may obtain the gifts of eternal salvation.

text: Intende Domine munera quae altaribus tuis pro sanctorum tuorum illorum commemoratione deferimus et pro nostris offensionibus immolamus.
translation_en: Lord, attend to the offerings we bring to your altars in remembrance of your saints, and offer them up for our sins.

text: Intende Domine quaesumus supplices tuos et pariter nobis indulgentiam tribue benignus et gaudium.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you turn your attention to us and grant us forgiveness. May you be gracious in doing so and bring us joy.

text: Intende munera Domine quaesumus altaribus tuis pro sanctae Felicitatis martyris tuae commemoratione proposita ut sicut per haec beata mysteria illis gloriam contulisti nobis indulgentiam largiaris.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you, pay attention to the offerings. For the commemoration of your holy martyr Saint Felicity, grant that as you bestowed glory upon us through these blessed mysteries, you may also grant them forgiveness.

text: Intende pie pater in oblatis sacrificiis et benignus adspira precibus nostris quique praedictorum martyrum praedicatione idolorum contrivisti funesta haec nostra tua opitulatione sanctifica holocausta.
translation_en: O good father, incline your ears to our offered sacrifices and be gracious with regard to our prayers. May you who through the preaching of the aforementioned martyrs have destroyed the harmful idols, sanctify these holy sacrifices by your consecration.

text: Intende precamur altissime vota quae reddimus et tibi placita fieri eorum precibus pro quorum deferuntur honore concede.
translation_en: We earnestly beseech Thee, Most High, that You may incline Your ears to the vows we offer and that it may please You to fulfill them through our prayers on behalf of those for whom they are offered. Grant this, we pray, in honor of their devotion.

text: Intende quaesumus Domine hostias familiae tuae et quam sacri muneris facis esse participem tribue ad eius plenitudinem pervenire.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you consider the offerings of your family and make it possible for them to partake in the fullness of this sacred duty.

text: Intende quaesumus Domine oblata tibi munera et deprecatione sancti illius martyris tui nos ipsos eademque sanctifica.
translation_en: We entreat you, Lord, to pay attention to the offerings presented to you and, through the intercession of your holy martyr, sanctify us as well.

text: Intende propitius quaesumus Domine oblata tibi haec munera et deprecatione beati illius martyris tui atque pontificis in cuius ea commemoratione deferimus nos ipsos eademque sanctifica.
translation_en: Turn towards us mercifully, we beseech You, Lord, as these gifts are offered to You, and through the intercession of Your blessed martyr and pope, in whose memory we bring ourselves forward. Sanctify us and these same offerings as well.

text: Intende quaesumus Domine preces nostras et qui non operando iustitiam correptione meremur affligi in tribulatione clamantes respiremus auditi.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you direct your attention towards our prayers. And though we do not earn mercy through action but through correction, may we who cry out in tribulation breathe easier when heard.

text: Intende quaesumus Domine sacrificium singulare ut huius participatione mysterii quae speranda credimus exspectata sumamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to direct our attention towards this unique offering. May we partake in the mystery that we believe and hope for, through its experience.

text: Inter innumera Domine pietatis tuae subsidia hinc fragilitatem nostram confidimus non relinqui quia tanta nobis placentium tibi patrocinia sunt provisa.
translation_en: Among your numerous acts of mercy, Lord, we place our trust that you will not abandon us because such abundant patronage pleasing to you has been provided for us.

text: Inter laudes tuas et preces nostras omnipotens Deus interest hodie beatissimi Ioannis praestantissima in gaudiis populorum ordinata nativitas in qua nobis multiplicis gratiae tuae dona venerantibus dum in praeconium vocatur ille qui praestitit in suffragium quaeritur ille qui meruit.  Qui nobis naturarum omnium creatorem necdum natus ostendit ut expers vitae suae fieret testis gloriae tuae haberetque prius cognitum lucis dominum quam communis luminis usum.  Qui in illis coagulati corporis rudimentis materni uteri lege viviscens vocem dominicae matris salutantis exciperet et quodam ministerio devotionis exsiliens motu exsultanter responderet qui ad opus evangelii nasciturus matrem de officio necdum editus commoneret.  Qui praedicaturus paenitentiam paternae diffidentiae errorem interceptae vocis dispendio castigaret et dubiae mentis incredulitatem prophetatus clauderet quo venturae salutis fidem prophetaturus aperiret.  In huius ergo Domine natalitii diei sollemnitate gaudentes pacificas sacrificiorum tibi hostias immolamus ut sacerdotalis officii functionem sancti angeli visitatione dignatus acceptes faciasque promissa nos credere credita praedicare praedicata non perdere.
translation_en:
On this day, the most blessed John's outstanding birth is celebrated among your praises and our prayers, O almighty God. In this nativity, numerous gifts of your grace have come to us, while he who was to be called in the announcement is sought; he who has deserved.
He who, not yet born, revealed himself as the creator of all nature, became a witness of your glory before he had experience of his own life. He knew the lord of light before using common light.
He lived in the rudiments of the body formed in the maternal womb according to the law, receiving the voice of the mother's divine salutation and, by some ministry of devotion, exultantly responding who was about to be born for the work of the gospel, although not yet issued from his mother's duty.
He will correct the error of paternal doubt through preaching penitence, and close the unbelief of a doubtful mind, so that he may open the faith of the upcoming salvation through prophecy.
Therefore, on this day, Lord, in the solemnity of his nativity, we rejoice with peaceful sacrifices offered to you. We pray that, being graciously visited by holy angels in your sacred office, you make us believe what has been believed and preach what has been preached, without losing it.

text: Inter nostrae redemptionis miranda beneficia et sanctorum martyrum gloriosa sollemnia cum muneribus Domine tuae laudis occurrimus agentes gratias et de remedii largitate et de provisione suffragii.
translation_en: We approach Your Lordship amidst the wonderful benefits of our redemption and the glorious feasts of the holy martyrs, offering thanks; we seek mercy from the abundance of Your grace and support in the prayers of intercession.

text: Inter patriarcharum inclitae memoriae titulos prophetarumque sublimes vaticinio fasces atque martyrum illustres sacram per noctem triumphos eximium in agone caelesti probatumque tuum athletam sanctum vincentium amore vernulo plebs alumna veneratur.  Ob cuius annuam festivitatem te quaesumus omnipotens Christe ut offerentium nomina volumen vitae contineat et aeternis sedibus tua mansuros clementia censeat atque praecedentium nos in pace dominica animas pax perpetua con
translation_en:
Among the illustrious titles of patriarchs and sublime prophecies, the triumphant fasces and martyrs shining with fame are proved by your holy athlete, victorious in the celestial contest. The people, nurtured as a student, venerate you.
For whose annual festivity we humbly ask you, Almighty Christ, that you may include the names of those offering in the book of life and may consider us, who precede, to be dwellers in eternal seats through your merciful clemency, and grant us everlasting peace in the Lord's peace.

text: Inter sacra sollemnia gloriosi martyris tui Iuliani vota solventes quaesumus Domine ut haec hostia sit et tibi placita et nobis exoptata omnium peccatorum remissio.
translation_en: During the solemnities of your glorious martyr Julian, we ask you, Lord, that this offering be pleasing to you and a forgiveness of all sins desired by us.

text: Intercedente beato apostolo illo munera nostra quaesumus Domine propitius suscipe et concede ut a cunctis perturbationibus liberati tranquilla tibi semper servitute famulemur.
translation_en: Through the intercession of the blessed apostle, we humbly ask you, Lord, to be merciful and graciously receive our prayers. May you grant us that, freed from all disturbances, we may always serve you tranquilly as your servant.

text: Intercedentibus sanctis tuis Domine plebi tuae praesta subsidium ut ab omnibus noxiis expedita cuncta sibi profutura percipiat.
translation_en: Through the intercession of your saints, Lord, grant aid to your people, so that they may receive all things profitable for themselves, being freed from all harmful things.

text: Intercessio adstantis tibi angeli Raphaelis Domine nos tibi semper et in omnibus viationi nostrae necessariis commendet et quod merita nostra non obtinent eius nobis sacro patrocinio donetur.
translation_en: The intercession of the angels standing before you, Raphael, Lord, may always present us to you and in all our necessary journeys recommend us. And may the merits we have not obtained be granted to us by his sacred patronage.

text: Intercessio beati Laurentii martyris tui Domine de sua nobis confessione nascentium mereatur plenitudinem gaudiorum.
translation_en: Through the intercession of the blessed Lawrence, your martyr, Lord, may those being born through his confession merit the fullness of joy.

text: Intercessio Domine beati Hermetis martyris tui et tuam nobis non desinat placare iustitiam et nostrum tibi devotum iugiter efficere famulatum.
translation_en: We pray, Lord, for the intercession of your blessed martyr Hermes, may his justice never cease to appeal to you, and may he constantly work on our behalf as your devoted servant.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine beatissimae virginis Marcellinae tuam pro nobis placare non desinat maiestatem et quae tibi placuit suae mentis et corporis integritate nostram tibi devotam iugiter efficiat servitutem.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, that the intercession of the most blessed Virgin Marcellina does not cease before Your majesty. May she please You with her mind and body's integrity, and may she continually make our devotion to You a service.

text: Intercessio nos quaesumus Domine beati Benedicti abbatis commendet ut quod nostris meritis non valemus eius patrocinio assequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the blessed Abbot Benedict may intercede for us, so that we may attain His patronage, which on our own merits we are unable to achieve.

text: Intercessio nos quaesumus Domine sanctae Afrae martyris tuae tibi commendet quae in confessione tibi placere meruit tuamque confessionem in caelis adeptura per aquae mersionem et ignis concremationem coronam vitae est consecuta.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to recommend us to your holy martyr Saint Africa, who pleased you in her confession and attained your confession in heaven through immersion in water and the ordeal by fire, and obtained a crown of life.

text: Intercessio nos quaesumus Domine sanctae Felicitatis martyris tuae votiva confoveat ut eius sacrata natalicia et temporaliter frequentemus et conspiciamus aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the vow of Your holy martyr Felicity may intercede for us, so that we may celebrate her sacred birthdays and temporally partake in them, and contemplate her eternal life.

text: Intercessionibus nos Domine quaesumus sanctorum Philippi et Iacobi ubique confoveas ut eorum sacra natalicia et temporaliter frequentemus et conspiciamus aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercessions of saints Philip and James everywhere, that we may be nourished, so that we may celebrate their sacred natal days and temporarily participate in them, and may perceive their eternal one.

text: Intercessio nos quaesumus Domine sanctae martyris tuae illius ab omnibus peccatis emundet ut qui eius festa venerando dignis obsequiis celebramus eius intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the holy martyr of yours may purify us from all sins, so that we who celebrate his feast with worthy observances may be aided by his intercessions.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine beatarum virginum tuarum ab omni nos vitiorum labe purificet et ad gaudia perducat aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our blessed virgins may purify us from all the stain of sin and lead us to eternal joy.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine beati Dunstani haec tibi commendet munera pro cuius tibi sunt commemoratione oblata.
translation_en: We beseech Your intercession, Lord, of the blessed Dunstan; may he present these gifts to You on behalf of whom his remembrance has been offered.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine beati Lamberti martyris tui haec tibi commendet sacrificia et tua nobis multiplicet beneficia.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the intercession of Your blessed martyr Saint Lambert may present these sacrifices to You, and may multiply Your blessings upon us.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine beati Severini confessoris tui munera nostra tibi commendet ut et meritis eius protegamur et precibus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the intercession of your blessed confessor Saint Severinus may present our gifts to you. May we be protected by his merits and prayers.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine beati Wulmari abbatis nos ubique laetificet ut dum eius sollemnitatem recolimus eius precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, that the intercession of Blessed Abbot Wulmar may everywhere rejoice us, so that while we remember his solemnity, we may be aided by his prayers.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine sancti pontificis et martyris tui Fabiani munera nostra commendet nosque eius veneratio tuae maiestati reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We beseech Your intercession, Lord, of Your saint bishop and martyr Fabian. May he present our offerings to You and may his veneration return acceptable offerings to Your majesty.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine sancti tui Rufi munera nostra commendet nosque in eius veneratione tuae maiestati reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your holy one, Rufus, presents our gifts to us and, in his veneration, returns them accepted to your majesty.

text: Intercessio sancti Clementis sacerdotis et martyris misericordiae tuae Domine munera nostra conciliet ut quod merita nostra non supplent sanctorum tuorum deprecatione pensetur.
translation_en: The intercession of Saint Clement, priest and martyr, may move your mercy, O Lord, so that what our merits do not suffice may be considered through the petition of your saints.

text: Intercessio sancti Nicomedis misericordiae tuae Domine munera nostra conciliet ut quod merita nostra non valent eius deprecatio nobis indulgentiam valeat obtinere.
translation_en: The intercession of Saint Nicomede, Lord, may unite your mercy with our gifts, so that the petition for which our merits are insufficient, may through his supplication be granted indulgence to us.

text: Intercessio quaesumus Domine beatissimi Gregorii confessoris tui atque pontificis misericordiae tuae munera nostra conciliet ut quod merita nostra non valent eius deprecatio nobis obtineat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for the intercession of your blessed confessor and pope, Gregory. May your mercy's gifts reconcile our needs, so that the petition of his intercession may be obtained for us, despite our merits being insufficient.

text: Intercessio sanctorum Remigii atque Hilarii quaesumus Domine misericordiae tuae munera nostra conciliet ut quod merita nostra non valent eorum deprecationibus indulgentiam valeamus obtinere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord of mercy, that the intercession of Saints Remigius and Hilary may unite your gifts to us, so that we may obtain forgiveness through their prayers, even though our merits are not sufficient for it.

text: Intercessione quaesumus Domine beatorum martyrum tuorum Euphemiae Luciae et Geminiani aperi nobis ianuam misericordiae tuae nosque a cunctis protege inimicis et sicut illi laetantur in gloria sic eorum supplicatione beatitudo nobis donetur aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercession of your blessed martyrs Euphemia, Lucia, and Geminian, that you open to us the door of your mercy, protect us from all enemies, and that just as they rejoice in glory, so their supplication grants us eternal happiness.

text: Intercessionibus beatae virginis et martyris tuae Agathae quaesumus Domine fructum clementiae tuae sentiant supplicantes cuius orationibus in sancta Ecclesia tua etiam eorum devotae efficiantur mentes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercessions of your blessed virgin and martyr Agatha, may those who pray feel the fruit of your mercy. May their minds, devoted to your holy Church, be made effective by your prayers as well.

text: Respice nos misericors Deus et nomini tuo perfice
translation_en: Look upon us, merciful God, and fulfill your name.

text: Interveniant pro nobis Domine Iesu Christe beatissimae genitricis tuae sorores Maria Iacobi et Maria Salome et praesta ut qui earundem tuarum materterarum sollemnia celebramus hic in terris ipsarum patrociniis apud te semper sublevemur in caelis.
translation_en: Intercede for us, Lord Jesus Christ, on behalf of your blessed mothers, sisters Mary of James and Mary of Salome, and grant that we who celebrate their solemnities here on earth may always be lifted up by their patronage in heaven.

text: Interveniat pro nobis Domine Iesu Christe nunc et in hora mortis nostrae beatissima virgo Maria mater tua cuius sacratissimam animam in hora mortis tuae gladius doloris pertransivit.
translation_en: May Thy mercy, Lord Jesus Christ, intervene for us now and at the hour of our death. Blessed Virgin Mary, Thy Mother, whose most sacred soul was pierced through with a sword of sorrow at Thy hour of death.

text: Interveniat pro nobis quaesumus Domine Iesu Christe apud tuam sanctam clementiam nunc et in hora mortis nostrae piissima virgo Maria mater tua cuius sacratissimam animam in hora benedictae passionis tuae doloris gladius pertransivit et in gloriosissima resurrectione tua ingens gaudium laetificavit.
translation_en: May your mercy, Lord Jesus Christ, be invoked on our behalf, we humbly ask. At this time and at the hour of our death, may the most compassionate Virgin Mary, your Mother, intercede for us. Whose most sacred soul suffered a sword of sorrow in the hour of your blessed Passion, and was filled with immense joy in your glorious Resurrection.

text: Interveniat pro nobis Domine petimus sanctus tuus martyr ille qui sanguinem suum pro tuo nomine gloriosum fudit et ipso interveniente nomina quae recitata sunt nostrorum carorum in caelesti pagina iubeas intimari.
translation_en: May your holy martyr intercede for us, Lord. We ask for the one who shed his glorious blood for your name, and with his intervention, may you command the names that were read on the pages of heaven to be announced.

text: Interveniat pro nobis Domine quaesumus sanctus tuus Lucas evangelista qui crucis mortificationem iugiter in suo corpore pro tui nominis honore portavit.
translation_en: May your saint, Luke the Evangelist, intercede for us, we ask, Lord. He who constantly bore the mortification of the cross in his body for the honor of your name.

text: Interveniat pro nobis quaesumus Domine beatissima virgo Marcellina quae pro tui nominis amore virginitatis laudandae propositum intemerato semper corpore et corde servavit.
translation_en: May she intercede for us, we ask you Lord, the most blessed Virgin Marcellina, who, out of love for your name and to praise virginity, always kept her body and heart undefiled.

text: Interveniente quaesumus Domine beata Agnete virgine tua et martyre hostiam quam tibi offerimus placatus suscipe et ipsius precibus caelesti convivio nos dignos potenter effice.
translation_en: Intervening we ask you, Lord, blessed Agnes your virgin and martyr; the offering that we present to you, pleased receive it. And with her prayers, make us worthy of heavenly feast through your powerful help.

text: Intervenientibus Domine sanctis martyribus tuis Hermachora et Fortunato Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus voces placatus admitte ut destructis adversitatibus universis secura tibi serviat libertate.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that when your holy martyrs Hermachoras and Fortunatus intervene, may their voices be accepted in Your presence so that, with all adversities destroyed, the Church may serve You securely and freely.

text: Interventionibus beati Benedicti confessoris tui quaesumus Domine familiae tuae tibi sit accepta oblatio cuius vita mirabilibus decoratur exemplis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offering of your blessed confessor Benedict be accepted by you, adorned as it is with miraculous examples of his life, for your family.

text: Interventu precis et obtentu orationis beati Ambrosii sacerdotis et confessoris tui Domine his muneribus tibi oblatis benedictionem effunde de caelis quo ex eis sumentes et omnibus careamus culpis et caelestibus repleamur eduliis.
translation_en: Upon the intervention of the precise and obtaining of the prayer of blessed Ambrose, your priest and confessor, Lord, we beseech you to pour out a blessing from heaven, through which, partaking of these gifts, may we be free from all sins and filled with heavenly delights.

text: Interventu precum et obtentu orationum beati Arnulfi confessoris tui atque pontificis Domine quaesumus his muneribus oblatis benedictionem effunde caelestem quibus eiusdem annuam celebramus commemorationem <et> praesta ut omnibus careamus culpis et caelestibus inseramur gaudiis.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, by the intervention of the prayers and the obtaining of the prayers of your blessed confessor and bishop Arnulf, that You pour out a heavenly blessing upon these offerings. By whose annual commemoration we celebrate, grant that we may be free from all sins and inserted into celestial joys.

text: Intuere piissime Deus tuorum sacrificia famulorum quae tibi ob natalem dedicationis templi huius litantur ut qui in hoc die Ecclesiae tuae celebramus sollemnia his hostiis expiemur a culpa.
translation_en: Most merciful God, we humbly beseech You to look upon the sacrifices of Your servants which they offer to You on this day for the dedication of this temple. May we who celebrate the solemnities in Your Church be purified from guilt by these offerings.

text: Intuere piissime Domine ieiunii nostri devotissimam precem et offensis nostris propitiatus ignosce quo et humiliatio abstinentiae nostrae tibi gloriam deferat et oblatio huius sacrificii requiem defunctis impertiat.
translation_en: Most gracious Lord, behold our most devout supplication of fasting and grant us pardon for our offenses. May our humility and abstinence bring glory to you, and may this offering of sacrifice bring peace to the departed souls.

text: Intuere propitius Domine offerentium vota et peccantium sana discrimina ac praesta nobis ut sicut nomen sexusque Eugeniae virginis cognitionem tui perspicui Eleni non latuit sacerdotis ita nomina nostra ex occultis iudiciis tuis aeternis iam adnotentur in paginis quo in huius virginis ac martyris tuae sollemnitate et vivis solatia et quiescentibus praestetur requies sempiterna.
translation_en: Look favorably upon, Lord, those offering vows and those sinning, and grant us such discernment that just as the name and sex of Eugenia, the virgin, were not hidden from Elena, the priest, so may our names be noted in your eternal judgments. May they be revealed now on the pages, where in the celebration of this virgin and martyr of yours, both the living and the resting may receive perpetual rest.

text: Intuere propitius summe clementissime Deus et de illa aethereae arcis quadriformis machinae sede haec libationum munera vultibus attende serenis geminumque sanctorum martyrum tuorum Emeterii et Celedonii sacrificium recolens et triumphum haec quae in eorum annuo natali litantur solita benignitate sanctifica. Sit conformis in proprietate nominum corporis et sanguinis Iesu Christi Domini nostri placita acceptaque libatio ut quisque devotionis ausu esum ex his potumve libaverit sentiat promeruisse dignus custodiam languidus medelam contritus consolationem sibimet impertitam.
translation_en: Turn propitiously, most kind and supreme God, and attend to this seat of libations from the quadrangular machine of that ethereal arch. May your serene faces be present, and may you recall and consecrate the sacrifice and triumph that are chanted in the annual feast of your twin holy martyrs, Emeterius and Celedonius, with Your usual benignity. May it please You to make these gifts conform to the nature of the body and blood of Jesus Christ, our Lord, and may the accepted libation bring each one who dares to drink or take a sip from among these a worthy guardianship, a weary healing, a contrite comfort, an unmerited consolation.

text: Intuere quaesumus Domine Deus ad nostrae humilitatis hostiam tibi in honorem sancti martyris tui ac regis Edwardi oblatam quam tibi sacram oblationem mirabili dispensatione efficere voluisti et concede nobis illius precibus ita innocenter vivere ut ad aeterna mereamur gaudia pervenire.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord God, to look upon the offering made in your honor by us, the lowly, to your holy martyr and King Edward. The sacred offering you have chosen to make effective by a wonderful dispensation, grant us that we may live so innocent that we may deserve to reach eternal joy through his prayers.

text: Intuere quaesumus omnipotens aeterne Deus placatus et suscipere dignare hoc sacrificium quod tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo monacho et concede illi pacem perpetuam et requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty eternal God, pleased and appeased, to graciously receive this sacrifice which we offer for your servant, that monk, and grant him eternal peace and everlasting rest.

text: Inveniant quaesumus Domine animae famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium in Christo quiescentium lucis aeternae consortium qui in hac luce positi tuum consecuti sunt sacramentum.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that you may find the souls of your servants, the servants of all who are resting in Christ in the company of eternal light. Those who, being placed in this light, have attained your sacrament.

text: Inveniat quaesumus Domine anima famulae tuae illius lucis aeternae consortium cuius perpetua gratia consecuta est sacramentum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the soul of your servant may find the company of that eternal light whose perpetual grace has attained the sacrament.

text: Invictam clementiam tuam deprecamur Domine sancte pater aeterne omnipotens Deus ut mundes vasa cordis nostri ab omni iniquitate; sensus etiam pacifices in tua sanctitate; membrum nostrum affectu limpidiori praeparare digneris ubi recondas quaesumus sanguinem Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your invincible clemency, Lord holy Father almighty God, that you cleanse the vessels of our heart from all iniquity; also grant us peaceful senses within your sanctity. May you deem worthy to prepare our member with a more pure affection where we ask that you hide the blood of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Invitemus fratres carissimi redemptoris nostri serenos oculos et benignos auditus conscientiae maculas gemitibus publicantes ut quid deferimus in dolore medicinam ... Cur inclusos febrium nutrimus aestus. Sumptuosa curae conductela non opus est. Solis lacrimis contentus <est> medicus qui si fletus nostros contritione cordis <et> humiliatione corporis conspexerit aeternae salutis gaudia non negabit.
translation_en: We invite our most dear brothers, the serene and kind eyes of our Redeemer, and benevolent ears to listen, acknowledging the stains on our conscience by public groans, so that we might bring a remedy in our sorrow ... Why do we nourish those confined by fever with warmth. The lavish care of a covering is not necessary. The physician, content with the tears of the sun, is present. If he beholds our tears of contrition and humility of the body, he will not deny the joys of eternal salvation.

text: Invocantes nomen tuum Domine deprecamur ut qui patres nostros virtute tui nominis praeeunte angelicis pastibus refecisti nos quoque intercessione beatorum martyrum tuorum Marci et Marcelliani mysticis dapibus foveas ac reformes.
translation_en: We invoke your name, Lord, we humbly entreat you, that just as you restored our forefathers by the power of your divine name leading them with angelic pastures, so too may you strengthen and reform us through the intercession of your blessed martyrs Marc and Marcellian, and provide us with spiritual nourishment.

text: Ipsa maiestati tuae Domine fideles populos commendet oblatio quae per Filium tuum reconciliavit inimicos.
translation_en: This offering commends to Your majesty, Lord, the faithful peoples whom Your Son reconciled with enemies.

text: Ipse tibi quaesumus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus sacrificium nostrum reddat acceptum qui discipulis suis in sui commemorationem hoc fieri hodierna traditione monstravit.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, holy Father, almighty and eternal God, may our sacrifice be accepted, whom you have shown today, through this traditional offering, to be done in remembrance of your disciples.

text: Ipsi nobis Domine quaesumus postulent mentium puritatem quorum innocentiam hodie sollemniter celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you for a mind purity of which we are solemnly celebrating the innocence today.

text: Ipsius peracti mysterii recordatione quod in corpore scilicet tuo Domine Iesu Christe Deus noster passionis tempore egisti admonemus tuam interminabilem pietatem quamvis conscientia facinorum memores remordente de magnitudine clementiae tuae praesumentes exposcere.  Idcirco petimus redemptor noster ut hodie per te acceptentur oblationes nostrae quas in corporis tui similitudinem passionis conformes humiliatis mentibus exhibemus ut sicut illa vera et sacratissima passio in carne tua non modo vivis profuit sed et mortuis ita per te etiam quorum nomina tuo coram altario sunt delata apud te qui es iudex vivorum et mortuorum culparum capiant indulgentiam ut requiem in te accipiant in quem credens anima requiem inveniet sempiternam.
translation_en: Remembering the performance of that mystery, we remind you, Lord Jesus Christ our God, during the time of your passion, about your boundless pity as we are reminded by the reproach of conscience for our deeds. Daring to presume upon the magnitude of your clemency, we ask our Redeemer that today through you our offerings, which we humbly present in the likeness of your body conformed to the passion, may be accepted. In this way, just as that true and most sacred passion profited you not only while living but also after death, so through you, those whose names have been brought before the altar with your name, may receive forgiveness. They may find rest in you, whom believing souls will find eternal rest.

text: Iram tuam quaesumus Domine a populo tuo miseratus averte quam nostris quidem meremur operibus sed humana fragilitate sustinere non possumus; illa nos itaque contine pietate quam praestare soles indignis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to turn away Your wrath from Your people, for we indeed deserve it with our deeds, but due to human frailty, we are unable to bear it; therefore, contain us in Your mercy as You usually do towards the unworthy.

text: Ista sunt Domine holocausta dulcia ut mel de petra manantia apostoli tui Petri instituente doctrina ut a te magistro didicerat in commemorationem tuae passionis libanda. Fiant ergo quaesumus piissimo vultui tuo accepta tuaeque maiestatis dextera sanctificata. Sint placabilitate pinguia et tui oris eloquio benedicta. Sint in percipientibus firmis munimina et infirmis exhibeant animae et corporis medicinam.
translation_en: These, Lord, are the sweet holocausts, flowing like honey from a rock, as instituted by the doctrine of your apostle Peter, that they might be learned from you as master in commemoration of your passion. Therefore, we humbly beseech your most gracious will to accept them, and may your right hand, honored by your majesty, sanctify them. May they be pleasing through their richness and blessed through your eloquence. May they provide firm defenses for those who perceive them, and exhibit healing for both soul and body for the weak.

text: Istis et omnibus in Christo quiescentibus Domine locum refrigerii lucis et pacis ut indulgeas deprecamur ac si qui peccatorum meritis inferni tenebris ac suppliciis detenentur misericordiae tuae oramus indulge clementiam eosque ad requiem transire praecipias et in prima anastasi cum sanctis et electis tuis iubeas sociari ut portio tua sint in terra vivent1um.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, to grant a place of rest, coolness, light and peace to all who rest in Christ. May your mercy release them from the darkness and torment of sin as if they were still imprisoned there. We implore your clemency, that you may hasten their journey to peace and command them to join the first resurrection with your saints and chosen ones, so that they may share a part in the life eternal.

text: Iteramus omnipotens Deus deprecationem nostram quam specialiter pro famulo tuo illo in honorem sancti illius facimus. Tu clementissime Pater vota perficias; petitiones nostrae adscendant ad aures clementiae tuae et descendat super eum pia sanctificatio atque protectio tua ut inter omnes huius vitae varietates tuo semper protegatur auxilio.
translation_en: Once more, O Almighty God, we repeat our humble plea on behalf of your servant, which we make especially in honor of that saint. May you, most merciful Father, fulfill his vows; may our petitions ascend to the ears of your mercy and let a pious sanctification and protection descend upon him from you, so that he is always protected by your help among all the varieties of this life.

text: Iteramus omnipotens Deus deprecationem nostram ante conspectum maiestatis tuae quam specialiter pro famulo tuo illo oblationem pro peccatis eius offerimus. Vota perficias; petitiones eius adscendant ad aures clementiae tuae et descendat super eum pia benedictio ut sub umbra alarum tuarum in omnibus protegatur et orationes nostrae te propitiante pro ipso non refutentur a conspectu pietatis tuae sed in omnibus eum auxiliare atque defendere digneris.
translation_en: Once more, O almighty God, we present our humble supplication before thy majesty, especially on behalf of thy servant. May his offerings for sins be fulfilled; may his prayers ascend to the ears of thy mercy and let a pious blessing descend upon him that he may be protected under the shadow of thy wings in all things. And may our prayers, favorably disposed by thee towards him, not be rejected from thy sight, but rather grant him aid and defense in all things.

text: Iterata festivitate beati Laurentii natalicia veneramur quae in caelesti beatitudine fulgere novimus sempiterna.
translation_en: We once again honor the feast of the birthday of Blessed Laurence, which we know shines eternally in celestial beatitude.

text: Iterata legatione rogamus ut tu Deus Pater omnipotens servos atque ancillas tuas propitia maiestate custodias et ab infestantis inimici insidiosis laqueis liberatos die noctuque defendas ne nos occultus inimicus corde et corpore opprimat sed vera lux Filii tui faciat spiritali luce pervigiles.  Ecclesiam quoque tuam fundamentum veritatis contra omnes mundi impetus contra haereticae pravitatis scandalum caelesti tranquillitate gubernes et regas et omnes qui in sublimitatibus agunt catholica fide fundatus ordinatione compositos pietate praecipuos patientia mites pace quietos efficias universumque mundum propitia pietate conserves.
translation_en:
We humbly ask through repeated envoys that you, O Almighty God, Father, keep your servants and maidservants safe with your gracious majesty, and protect them from the snares of their relentless enemies day and night. May the true light of your Son not let them be secretly oppressed by an enemy, either in heart or body. Instead, may it bring spiritual light to make them vigilant.
May you also govern and rule your Church, which is founded on truth, against all worldly attacks and scandals caused by heresy with heavenly tranquility. May you establish those who act in sublimity with the Catholic faith, composed with ordination, distinguished with piety, patient, mild with peace, quiet, and may you conserve the entire world with propitious piety.

text: Iterata mysteria Domine pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum commemoratione devota mente tractamus quibus nobis et praesidium crescit et gaudium.
translation_en: We repeatedly contemplate the mysteries, Lord, with devoted minds in remembrance of your holy martyrs. Through this, our protection grows and our joy increases.

text: Iteratis precibus te dominum Deum nostrum suppliciter deposcimus cuius honor sanctitas est quem diligere salus est quem amare perfectio est; concede in omni Ecclesia tua sancti martyris tui illius lucere vestigia ut te regente omnium gressus ea nos via perducat ad vitam quae martyrem tuum extulit ad coronam.
translation_en: Repeatedly we humbly entreat our Lord God, whose honor's sanctity is that which it is salvation to love and perfection to cherish; grant in all your churches the footsteps of your holy martyr to shine, so that under your guidance all steps may lead us by this path to life which raised your martyr to a crown.

text: Iubilationis hostias <et> servitutis per interventum beatissimi Bedae confessoris tui benigno quaesumus omnipotens Pater intuitu benedicito et ad praesentis et futurae vitae concede prodesse prosperitatem cunctae familiae.
translation_en: We humbly ask the all-powerful Father, through the intercession of your blessed confessor Beda, that, with a blessing gaze, He may bless and grant prosperity for the present and future life to be beneficial for all of his family.

text: Iucundantur Domine caeli et tripudiet terra quia verbum caro factum habitat in sacrae virginis membra in cuius adventu omnis de captivitate redimitur terra quae detinebatur per transgressionem Adae in obscurata gehenna. Nunc moveatur mare et omnia quae in eis sunt. Montes exsultent et omnia ligna silvarum quia Dominus homo dignatur per uterum beatae virginis Mariae de caelo in mundum venire. Per ipsius igitur adventum te deprecamur omnipotens Deus ut nostrae carnis fragilitatem a vinculis peccatorum absolvas et praesenti familiae tuae misericordia plenus occurras.
translation_en: The heavens rejoice, and the earth dances for joy, because the Word became flesh and dwelt in the limbs of the holy virgin. In her coming, all the earth is redeemed from every captivity which was held through the transgression of Adam in the hidden Gehenna. Now let the sea be moved, and all that is in it. Let the mountains rejoice, and all the trees of the forest, for the Lord deems to come into the world through the womb of blessed virgin Mary from heaven. Through His coming we therefore entreat You, Almighty God, that You release our frail flesh from the bonds of sin and approach us with Your present family's mercy in fullness.

text: Iudex superstitum pariter atque pausantium pro fidelium omnium defunctorum spiritibus te deprecamur sed maxime pro huius animam famuli tui illius ut pro meritis et <per> operationem iustorum motus in eo animae adversationi exaggeres et omnia ei pro clementiae tuae pietate indulgeas.
translation_en: We entreat you, the Judge of the living and the dead, equally for the repose of all departed souls, but especially for the soul of your servant, that for the merits of the righteous and through the operation of their movement, you may amplify its adversity and grant him every indulgence out of your mercy's compassion.

text: Iugiter nos Domine sanctorum tuorum vota laetificent et patrocinia nobis martyrum ipsae semper festivitates exhibeant.
translation_en: May the prayers of your saints, Lord, ever delight us and may the feasts of the martyrs themselves always show forth as celebrations for us.

text: Laeta nos Domine quaesumus sancti Laurentii martyris tui festivitas semper excipiat quae et iucunditatem nobis suae glorificationis infundat et tibi nos reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We joyfully ask, Lord, that the festival of your saint Lawrence the Martyr may always receive us, which also pours out for us the joy of his own glory and returns us to you as acceptable.

text: Laetamur Domine tuorum celebritate sanctorum; praesta quaesumus ut quos veneramur obsequio adesse nobis sentiamus auxilio.
translation_en: We rejoice, Lord, in the gathering of your saints; grant us we pray, that we may feel their help in our presence as we come to honor them.

text: Laetatur Domine omnis conventus Ecclesiae tuae in proximitate paschalis laetitiae. Ob hoc prece humili supplicamus ut .ieiuniorum nostrorum vota suscipiens has tibi appositas hostias benedicas nosque harum perceptione sanctificans ad tuae passionis gaudia purificatos pervenire concedas.
translation_en: Rejoice, Lord, every congregation of your Church in the proximity of Easter joy. For this humble prayer we beseech you to accept the vows of our fasting ones and bless these offerings laid before you. Sanctify us through their perception, so that purified by your passion's joys, we may arrive.

text: Laetetur Domine quaesumus populus tuus tua dextera sublevatus et a tribulatione respirans continuis protegatur auxiliis et religiosa conversatione proficiens et praesentibus bonis gaudeat et futuris.
translation_en: We beseech you, O Lord, that your people may be lifted up by your right hand and breathe freely from tribulation, continually protected by your helps and progressing in religious conversation, and may rejoice in the good things present and look forward to those yet to come.

text: Laetetur Ecclesia tua Deus martyrum tuorum Petri et Marcellini confisa suffragiis atque eorum precibus gloriosis et devota permaneat et secura consistat.
translation_en: May your church rejoice, God, confident in the intercession and prayers of your martyrs Peter and Marcellinus. May it remain devoted and stay secure.

text: Laetetur Ecclesia tua Deus beati Agapiti martyris tui confisa suffragiis atque eius precibus gloriosis et devota permaneat et secura consistat.
translation_en: Your Church rejoices, God, in the blessed martyr Agapitus, confident with his intercessions and petitions, and remains devoted and secure.

text: Laetetur in te Domine quaeso virginitas et huic proxima congaudeat continentia. Non sexum quaerunt huiusmodi bella sed animum; non mucronis confidentiam sed pudoris; non etiam discussuras sed causas. Impune inter armatas transit acies innocens conscientia; quae superaverit crimina superat et metalla. Facile vincit alios quisque se vicerit et cum laudabile sit viros rem fecisse virtutum maioris tamen praeconii est fecisse virginem rem virilem.  Profanum sacra ingreditur puella concilium et solum Deum gestiens infert violentiam passioni. Nec deest lictor tam impudens quam crudelis qui sponsam – secure ut dixerim – Christi fornicantium verberibus oculorum supplicio libidinante torqueret ut quae poenas in adulterio non luebat saltem poenas adulteras sustineret. Nudum quod gravius carnifex putat exspectantium oculis corpus exponit et per devaricatas viscerum partes ictuum sulcos cursus fusi sanguinis antecedit. Periit tuum tortor inique commentum; sola patiuntur tormenta ludibrium. Habet quidem virginem nostram nuditas sed pudicam. Discat ergo discat uterque sexus ex virgine non pulchritudinem colere sed virtutem; fidem amare non formam; placiturus domino non decoris spectare iudicium sed pudoris.  Sed quia tuum est totum quod haec virgo vicerit tuum quod meruit tuumque etiam quod peregit; nec enim tela repellimus adversantium nisi tuae divinitatis beneficio sublevemur; nunc praesta nobis ut sicut haec beatissima martyr tua pugnando praemium adepta est castitatis ita nos commissorum nostrorum a te dimissis contagiis adipiscamur praemia tuae promissionis.
translation_en:
Let joy be in you, Lord, I ask the virginity; and let this chastity nearby unite with it. These kinds of wars do not seek sex but souls; not confidence through swords, but modesty; not even disputes but causes. Innocent conscience passes safely among armed troops; what conquers crimes, overcomes also metals. Each one who overcomes himself easily conquers others, and though making virtuous deeds for men is praiseworthy, yet it is more worthy to announce the making of a chaste woman.
A girl profanes the sacred council and brings only violence with her passion. There is no less shameless nor cruel herald who would, so to speak, cruelly whip the bride of Christ with lashes on the eyes, stirring up lust, to make her suffer the penalties of adultery which she had escaped. He exposes his naked body before the expectant eyes, and through the dissected parts of his viscera he precedes the furrows of blood flow from the blows. Your torturer perishes unjustly; only torments are left for jesting.
Indeed, our virginity is naked but chaste. Let each sex learn to love not the beauty but the virtue in the virgin; faith rather than form; pleasing to the Lord not the judgment of appearance but modesty.
Since this virgin has overcome all these things through your help, since she has earned and even accomplished them through you; for we do not repel the attacks of our enemies unless we are uplifted by your divine favor; now grant us that, just as this most blessed martyr received the reward of chastity through her fighting, so we may acquire the rewards of your promise, having been sent away from our sins by you.

text: Laetetur semper Ecclesia tua Domine tuorum celebritate sanctorum et misericordiae tuae iugiter experiatur effectum quo et fragilitas humana subsistat et divina supplici redemptio non negetur.
translation_en: Your Church may always be filled with joy, Lord, by the assembly of your saints and may it continually experience the effect of your mercy so that human frailty is sustained and divine merciful redemption is not denied.

text: Laetetur quaesumus Domine Ecclesia tua de tuorum celebritate Infantium et misericordiae tuae iugiter experiatur effectum quo et fragilitas humana subsistat et divina supplicantibus redemptio non negetur.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that Your Church may rejoice in the festivity of Your presence and continually experience the effect of Your mercy, by which human frailty may be sustained and divine redemption not be denied to those who supplicate You.

text: Laeti Domine frequentamus salutis humanae principia quia trina celebratio beatae competit mysterio Trinitatis.
translation_en: With joy, Lord, we frequently partake in the beginnings of human salvation because the blessed celebration befits the mystery of the Trinity.

text: Laeti Domine frequentamus salutis humanae principia quae trina celebratio beatae complectit(ur) mysterio Trinitatis.
translation_en: With joy, O Lord, we frequent the beginnings of human salvation which the blessed celebration encompasses in its threefold mystery of the Trinity.

text: Laeti Domine sumpsimus sacramenta caelestia; intercedente pro nobis beata et gloriosa semperque virgine Dei Genitrice Maria ad vitam nobis proficiant sempiternam.
translation_en: With joy, we have received the heavenly sacraments; through the intercession of the blessed and glorious ever-virgin Mother of God, may they lead us to eternal life.

text: Laeti Domine sumpsimus sacramenta caelestia; quaesumus ut intercedente beata et gloriosa semper virgine Dei Genitrice Maria et omnibus sanctis apostolis et martyribus confessoribus et virginibus tuis ad vitam nobis proficiant sempiternam.
translation_en: We rejoice, O Lord, in receiving the heavenly sacraments; we humbly ask that with the intercession of the blessed and glorious ever-virgin Mother of God, Mary, and all your apostles, martyrs, confessors, and virgins may it lead us to an eternal life.

text: Laeti Domine sumpsimus sacramenta caelestia; intercedente pro nobis beata Lucia martyre tua ad vitam nobis proficiant sempiternam.
translation_en: We, Lord, have gladly received the heavenly sacraments; through the intercession of blessed Lucy, the martyr, may they lead us to an eternal life.

text: Laeti Domine sumpsimus sacramenta caelestia quae nobis intercedente beato Iuvenali confessore tuo atque pontifice uberius confidimus profutura.
translation_en: With joy, we have taken the celestial sacraments which we trust, with the intercession of your blessed confessor Juvenal and your bishop, will be more fruitful for us.

text: Laeti Domine sumpsimus sacramenta caelestia quae nobis quaesumus interveniente beato illo confessore tuo atque pontifice perpetuam conferant medicinam.
translation_en: We are glad, Lord, that we have taken the heavenly sacraments which we humbly ask you to grant us through your blessed confesser and pope, bestowing on us a lasting medicine.

text: Laeti percepimus omnipotens Deus divinum altaris tui mysterium; quaesumus eximium tuae divinitatis praesidium ut beato Yvone pro nobis interveniente mereamur promissum gratulanter percipere gaudium.
translation_en: We have gladly received, Almighty God, the divine mystery of your altar; we humbly ask for the excellent protection of your divinity, that with blessed Yvone intervening on our behalf, we may deserve to joyfully receive the promised joy with gratitude.

text: Laetifica Domine vultum familiae tuae et erue animas nostras ex inferno inferiori ut tui vultus contemplatione protecti desideria carnis spiritali dominatione calcemus.
translation_en: Lord, brighten the countenance of your family and deliver our souls from the lower hell, so that protected by your gaze, we may advance in spiritual desire with the dominion of flesh subdued.

text: Laetifica nos Domine quaesumus consolationibus tuis et ut nobis dona caelestis gratiae largiaris veniam propitiatus impende.
translation_en: Brighten us, we ask you, Lord, with your comforts, and may you bestow upon us heavenly grace and grant us forgiveness, pouring out your mercy.

text: Laetificet nos Domine munus oblatum ut sicut in apostolo tuo Petro te mirabilem praedicamus sic per illum tuae sumamus indulgentiae largitatem.
translation_en: Let our hearts be lifted up, Lord, by the offering presented to you, so that we may proclaim your marvelous deeds as in Your apostle Peter, and through him we may obtain the abundance of Your mercy's indulgence.

text: Laetificet nos Domine huius participatio sacramenti ut sicut in beato Lamberto martyre tuo atque pontifice te mirabilem praedicamus sic per illum tuae sumamus indulgentiae largitatem.
translation_en: Let our hearts be filled with joy, Lord, by this participation in the sacrament, so that, like in your martyr and bishop Saint Lawrence, we may proclaim your wonders. Through him, may we receive the abundance of your mercy's indulgence.

text: Laetificet nos Domine quaesumus mellita beati Melliti pontificis oratio cuius festa celebrantes melliflua tuae gratiae repleat dulcedo.
translation_en: May the Lord cheer us, as we ask, with the sweet prayer of the blessed Pope Melito, whose feast we celebrate; may the sweetness of your grace fill us with honeyed delight.

text: Laetificet nos quaesumus Domine sacramenti veneranda sollemnitas pariterque mentes nostras et corpora et spiritali sanctificatione fecundet et castis gaudiis semper exerceat.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, may the venerable solemnity of the sacrament delight us; may it also enlighten our minds and bodies, and may it spiritually fertilize us with sanctification. May it always exercise us with pure joys.

text: Laetificet nos quaesumus Domine sancti confessoris tui et episcopi illius annua devotione repetita sollemnitas ut per haec piae oblationis officia et illum retributio beata comitetur et nobis sacrae tribuatur sufficientia servitutis.
translation_en: Let our hearts be lifted up, we beseech Thee, O Lord, by the annual devotion of Thy holy confessor and bishop, whose solemnity is repeated, that through these pious offerings he may be accompanied by blessed reward and that we may receive sufficient grace for service.

text: Largam Dei patris omnipotentis misericordiam fratres carissimi deprecemur ut intercessione sancti ac beatissimi antistitis sui Martini cuius hodierna die officium commemorationis impendimus eius interventu per misericordiam domini indulgentiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech the grace of God, the almighty Father, that through the intercession of the holy and blessed bishop Martin, to whom we commemorate today's office, we may deserve his intervention and receive mercy from the Lord, thus obtaining indulgence.

text: Largiente te Domine beatorum Petri et Pauli natalitium nobis lumen effulsit; concede quaesumus ut hodierna gloria passionis sicut illis magnificentiam tribuit sempiternam ita nobis munimen operetur perpetuum.
translation_en: Lord, at the birth of blessed Peter and Paul, a light has shone upon us; grant us we ask that today's glory of their passion may bestow upon them eternal magnificence, so may it also enfold us in an everlasting protection.

text: Largire nobis clementissime Pater quo sicut beata Maria Magdalena Dominum nostrum super omnia diligendo suorum obtinuit veniam peccaminum ita nobis apud misericordiam tuam sempiternam impetret beatitudinem.
translation_en: Grant us, most merciful Father, so that, just as blessed Mary Magdalene obtained forgiveness for all her sins by loving our Lord above all things, may you pray to your eternal mercy on our behalf and grant us everlasting bliss.

text: Largire nobis Domine beati Apollinaris martyris tui atque pontificis precibus stipendia salutis aeternae ut casta semper pectora baiulantes laudes tuae clementiae referamus eius sancta sollemnia celebrando.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, through the prayers of your blessed martyr and bishop, Saint Apollinaris, stipends for eternal salvation. So that we may always bear pure hearts bearing praises to your clemency, we return them in his holy feast days celebrating his sanctity.
