text: Largire nobis Domine quaesumus spiritum cogitandi quae bona sunt promptius et agendi ut qui sine te esse non possumus secundum te vivere valeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, the spirit of discernment that we may think on what is good more quickly, and be enabled to act according to You, since we cannot exist without You.

text: Largire nobis Domine quaesumus semper spiritum cogitandi quae recta sunt propitius et agendi ut qui sine te esse non possumus secundum te vivere valeamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, always the Spirit of thinking what is right and the ability to act so that we who cannot live without you, may live according to you.

text: Largire nobis omnipotens Deus ut a quo omne bonum est te habentes nullis indigeamus auxiliis.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, almighty God, that we who receive all good from you, may in no way be in need of any assistance from others.

text: Largire propitius immense Deus votis Ecclesiae tuae tui martyris Pelagii suffragium quam alacriter ad tuum altare munus deferre inspicis proprium. Etenim alter tacite fundit suspiria alter in lacrimas prorumpit mente compuncta. Iste quoque simpliciter orat ille genis pavimentum barrire non desinit. Sed utrorumque tu Deus noster inspicis mentes ac probas singulorum conscientias. Ideo quaesumus tuis oculis effice placidum quod humana miseria utcumque offert compuncta. Revera nuda conscientia te coram quis nostrum stare poterit quem sancti tremunt ac multiplices beatorum conventus expavescunt? Quapropter credimus vel adclines oramus ut nos tua praeveniat misericordia et nobis ad te redditum conferendo et defunctis fidelibus sempiternam requiem largiendo ut utrumque habeat gratia indefessa quos tremulos ante te prospicis propria esse carnis conscientia.
translation_en: Generous God, grant your favor to the prayers of your church and martyr Pelagius. You observe with eagerness the offering that is brought swiftly to your altar. One pours out sighs silently, another bursts into tears with a contrite mind. This one also does not cease to pray in simple oration to cover the floor of heaven. But you, our God, observe and judge the minds and the consciences of each one. Therefore, we ask that through your eyes, you make calm what human misery offers however it presents itself with contrition. Indeed, who can stand before you with bare conscience, whom the saints tremble at and numerous gatherings of the blessed fear? Therefore, we believe and pray that your mercy may precede us and bring us back to you, granting us everlasting peace. May your compassion extend also to the faithful departed, giving them an undying grace who look timidly upon you with their conscience.

text: Largire quaesumus Domine famulis tuis fidei et securitatis augmentum ut qui de nativitate Domini nostri tui filii gloriantur et adversa mundi te gubernante non sentiant et quae temporaliter celebrare desiderant sine fine percipiant.
translation_en: Grant, we ask You, Lord, Your servants an increase of faith and security, so that those who rejoice in the nativity of our Lord's Son and do not feel adversities in a world governed by You, may enjoy what they desire to celebrate temporally without end.

text: Largire quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis indulgentiam placatus et pacem ut pariter ab omnibus mundentur offensis et secura tibi mente deserviant.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we entreat you, forgiveness for your faithful, being pleased, and peace that they may be cleansed from all offenses by all and serve you with a mind secure before you.

text: Largire quaesumus Domine mentibus nostris cum exsultatione provectum ut qui beati Leonardi confessoris tui celebritate annua devotione recolimus eiusque etiam fidei constantiam subsequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to enrich our minds with exultation so that we who recall the celebration of your blessed confessor, Saint Leonard, annually with devotion, may also follow his steadfast faith.

text: Largire quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae Deus et a suis semper et ab alienis abstinere delictis ut pura tibi mente deserviens pietatis tuae remedia sine cessatione percipiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O God, to bestow upon your Church abundance, and always to refrain from sins of one's own as well as those of others, so that serving you with a pure mind, we may continually receive the remedies of your mercy.

text: Largire quaesumus omnipotens Deus famulo tuo illi sacerdoti quietem beatitudinis sempiternae ut pro quo nunc gaudemus in terris cum eodem apud te exsultare mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to grant your servant the priest eternal peace, that he who now rejoices with us on earth may also be worthy to rejoice with him in heaven.

text: Largire quaesumus omnipotens Deus supplicibus tuis ut quem natum in terris fatemur hominem hunc Deum astris quoque fatentibus adoremus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to be generous to your supplicants, that the man whom we acknowledge as born on earth, we may also adore as God when the stars attest it.

text: Largire quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut anima famuli tui illius plenam capiat de huius ecclesiae perfectione mercedem.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that the soul of your servant may receive from this church's perfection its full reward.

text: Largire quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut anima famuli tui illius plene capiat te miserante lucem perpetuam.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the soul of your servant may fully comprehend you in Your eternal light, as You have mercy upon him.

text: Largire sensibus nostris omnipotens Deus ut per temporalem Filii tui mortem quam mysteria veneranda testantur vitam te nobis dedisse perpetuam confidamus.
translation_en: Almighty God, enlarge our senses so that through the temporal death of Your Son, which the sacred mysteries affirm as wonderful, we may confidently believe that You have given us eternal life.

text: Largitor bonorum omnium Deus qui inter illas martyrum splendentium nivea fide catervas toto orbe terrarum gratia coruscante diffusas pretiosum peculiaremque nobis beatum Symphorianum martyrem indulsisti largire cottidianis supplicum tuorum votis ut in cuius festo devoto exsultamus trepudio eius in posterum consortio coniungamur <et qui> hominum osculis corporalibus <coniungimur> spiritalibus alligari mereamur affectibus.
translation_en: Giver of all good things, God, who among those shining martyrs scattered throughout the whole world with radiant grace, have granted us the blessed Symphorian, a martyr precious and unique. Grant that we may daily be favored by your answers to our prayers, so that in joyful exultation on his festival day, we may be united with him for all eternity; and that, joined with bodily embraces of humanity, we may be bound spiritually through affection.

text: Largitor praemiorum pro qualitate meritorum omnipotens Deus te supplices deprecamur ut intercessione beatorum tuorum martyrum Timothei et Apollinaris quos gaudemus nobis esse patronos caduca gaudia respuentes perpetuis mereamur esse participes.
translation_en: We beseech the Almighty God, bestower of rewards, according to the merits we have performed, that through the intercession of your blessed martyrs Timothy and Apollinaris, whom we are pleased to count among our patrons, rejecting transient joys, we may deserve to be participants in eternal ones.

text: Laudent te Domine ora nostra laudet anima laudet et vita et quia tui muneris est quod sumus tuum sit omne quod vivimus.
translation_en: Praise you, Lord, our prayers praise you; the soul praises you, life praises you, and because it is your gifts that we are, let all that we live be yours.

text: Laudes et gratias agamus tibi Domine et nomini tuo sancto quia refecta sunt viscera nostra de sancto spiritali benedicto poculo recreata; crescat in visceribus nostris in sancto in fide in caritate sit nobis in protectionem corporis nostri contra expugnationes diaboli.
translation_en: We praise and give thanks to you, Lord, and to your holy name, for our hearts have been healed by the blessed spiritual cup, strengthened with holy faith and love. May it grow within us as a sanctuary of faith, love, and protection for our bodies against the attacks of the devil.

text: Laudes tuas Domine non tacemus quia nos a malis quae merebamur expediens bona tua praestas celebrare laetantes.
translation_en: We will not be silent in our praise of You, Lord, for You have graciously provided us with good things to celebrate, even though we deserved the contrary. We rejoice.

text: Salva nos omnipotens Deus et lucem
translation_en: Save us, almighty God, and enlighten us

text: Laudes tuas sancte omnipotens aeterne Deus ob gloriosas martyrum passiones sacris titulis ampliantes sollemni tibi cum devotione persolvimus grates quas triumphus gloriae tuae passionis evexit resurrectionis aeternitas consecravit. Qui praemium immortalitatis te auxiliante suscipientes et nobis dederunt viam vitae et sibi paraverunt palmam victoriae. Horum nobis Domine abauditione da victoriam. Sit nobis eorum apud te patrona oratio quorum exspectante te iudice fulgentibus sanctorum choris coronata meruit esse confessio.
translation_en: We faithfully render to you, all-powerful eternal God, our lauds, amplified by the glorious passions of the martyrs with solemn devotion, thanks which the triumph of your glory through passion has raised, resurrection has consecrated. Who, receiving the reward of immortality with your aid, have given us the way of life and have prepared for themselves the palm of victory. Lord, grant us victory over them. May their prayer before you be our protection. Among those who eagerly await your judgment, shining in the chorus of saints, she merited to be the confession worthy of being crowned.

text: Laudis tuae Domine hostias immolamus quibus nos et praesentibus exui malis confidimus et futuris.
translation_en: We offer up the sacrifices of your praise, Lord, in which we trust to be freed from present evils and those yet to come.

text: Laudis tuae Domine hostias immolamus in tuorum commemoratione sanctorum quibus nos et praesentibus exui malis confidimus et futuris.
translation_en: We offer the sacrifices of our praise to You, Lord, in remembrance of Your saints, upon whom we confidently rely both now present and for those yet to come.

text: Laudis tuae Domine hostias immolamus rex regum et Dominus dominantium qui ne a reprobo Herode videreris super terram per manus beati Ioseph in Aegyptum atque inde in Iudeam deferri voluisti praesta nobis per preces ipsius ut quem nutritorem voluisti habere in terris etiam pro nostris delictis exaudias in caelis.
translation_en: We, the king of kings and Lord of lords, offer your praise, O Lord. You, who were not seen to be refused by Herod on earth, were carried by the blessed Joseph from Egypt to Judea – as you willed it. Through his prayers, grant us that you, whom we desire to have as our nurturer on earth, would also hear us for our sins in heaven.

text: Levitae Laurentii nos foveat Domine passio veneranda laetantes et ut eam sufficienter recolamus dignos efficiat.
translation_en: Lord, may the venerable passion of Levite Laurence warm us, rejoicing; and may it make us worthy to celebrate it suitably.

text: Libamina summe Deus praesentia e superis benedicito sedibus quibus tuo antistite Dunstano exorante pro nobis praesentis vitae tranquillitatem percipiamus et gloriam promissae hereditatis.
translation_en: To the highest God, I, in Your divine presence, bless the seats above, where, through Bishop Dunstan's intercession on our behalf, we may experience peace in this present life and receive the glory promised in the inheritance to come.

text: Libantes Domine dona caelestia praesidium nobis inesse gaudemus et inter ista quae transeunt et eorum quae mansura confidimus.
translation_en: Lifting up, Lord, we rejoice that celestial protection dwells among us. We trust in those things that pass and in those that endure.

text: Libantes Domine mensae tuae beata mysteria quaesumus ut martyrum interventione sanctorum temporalem et praesentem nobis misericordiam conferant et aeternam.
translation_en: Lifting up, Lord, your blessed mysteries, we humbly ask that through the intervention of the martyrs they may grant us both temporary and present mercy, and eternal one.

text: Libantes Domine mensae tuae beata mysteria quaesumus ut sanctae Iulianae martyris tuae interventionibus temporalem et praesentem nobis misericordiam conferant et aeternam.
translation_en: Lifting up to You, Lord, Your blessed mysteries, we humbly ask that through the intercessions of Saint Julian the Martyr, You grant us temporary and present mercy, and eternal mercy as well.

text: Sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae et intemerata virginis orationibus
translation_en: Through the prayers of the Holy Mother of God Mary and the immaculate Virgin.

text: Libantes Domine mensae tuae beata mysteria quaesumus ut beatorum interventione sanctorum Marci et Marcelliani et temporalem nobis misericordiam conferant et aeternam.
translation_en: Lifting up, Lord, your blessed mysteries on the altar, we humbly ask that through the intercession of the saints Marc and Marcellian, they grant us temporal mercy in this life, and eternal salvation.

text: Libantes Domine mensae tuae beata mysteria quaesumus ut martyris interventione sanctae Caeciliae et praesentem nobis misericordiam conferant et aeternam.
translation_en: Lifting up, Lord, Your blessed mysteries we humbly ask that through the intervention of the holy Martyr Cecilia, they grant us Your mercy present and bestow upon us eternal grace.

text: Libantes Domine mensae tuae divina mysteria quaesumus ut sanctae Teclae martyris tuae interventionibus temporalem nobis misericordiam conferant et aeternam.
translation_en: Lifting up, Lord, Your tables laden with divine mysteries, we humbly ask that through the intercessions of Your saint, Saint Thecla, You grant us temporary mercy here on earth and eternal salvation.

text: Libantes Domine sacrosancta mysteria praetende nobis quaesumus misericordiam tuam ut quae votis expetimus intercedente beato illo consessore tuo atque abbate conversatione tibi placita consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, we present to You the sacred mysteries. We humbly ask for Your mercy, that what we have requested may be granted to us through the intercession of that blessed companion and abbot, pleasing in Your sight.

text: Libera Domine quaesumus a peccatis et hostibus tibi populum supplicantem ut in sancta conversatione viventes nullis affligantur adversis.
translation_en: Deliver, Lord, we ask you, from sins and enemies; may your people praying to you live in holy conduct without being troubled by any adversities.

text: Libera quaesumus Domine a peccatis et hostibus tibi populum supplicantem et in beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui illius doctrinis viventes nullis affligantur adversis.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, to free from sins and enemies the people who are praying to you. May they not be distressed by adversities while living according to the teachings of your blessed priest and confessor.

text: Libera nos a malo Domine Christe Iesu; corpus tuum pro nobis crucifixum edimus et sanguinem sanctum tuum pro nobis effusum bibimus; fiat nobis corpus sanctum tuum in salutem et sanguis sanctus tuus in remissionem peccatorum hic et in aeterna saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Deliver us, Lord Christ Jesus, from evil; we eat your crucified body for us and drink your holy blood shed for us; may your holy body be our salvation here and may your holy blood be the forgiveness of sins for us both now and forevermore.

text: Libera nos ab omni malo Domine Iesu Christe qui corpus tuum sanctum pro nobis crucifixum edimus et sanguinem tuum <sanctum> pro nobis effusum bibimus; oramus benignissime Domine ut per merita et intercessionem gloriosissimae Mariae virginis fiat nobis corpus tuum ad salutem et sanguis tuus ad remissionem peccatorum.
translation_en: Deliver us, Lord Jesus Christ, from every evil. We eat your holy body which was crucified for us and drink your holy blood shed for us; most kindly Lord, we pray that through the merits and intercession of the glorious Virgin Mary, your body may be to us for salvation and your blood for forgiveness of sins.

text: Libera nos ab omni malo quaesumus Domine Iesu Christe et per intercessionem et merita genitricis tuae gloriosissimae virginis Mariae fiat nobis sumptum corporis et sanguinis tui sacramentum ad salutem et remissionem omnium peccatorum.
translation_en: Deliver us from all evil, we beseech you, Lord Jesus Christ. And through the intercession and merits of your most glorious mother, Virgin Mary, may the sacrament of your body and blood be a sustenance for us and bring us salvation and remission of all sins.

text: Libera nos Domine ab omni malo praeterito praesenti et futuro et intercedentibus beatis martyribus et confessoribus tuis vel quorum hodie festa celebratur <praesta> ut omnes qui nobis eleemosynas condonaverunt tam vivi quam et defuncti mereantur ab omnibus absolvi peccatis.
translation_en: Deliver us, Lord, from every past, present, and future evil, and through the intercession of your blessed martyrs and confessors, or those whose feast is celebrated today, grant that all who have shown mercy to us, both living and dead, may be absolved from all sins.

text: Libera nos Domine ab omni malo propitius et tuam caritatem infunde ut quos uno caelesti pane satiasti tua facias pietate concordes.
translation_en: Deliver us, Lord, from all evil, be gracious and pour out your love that those whom you have satisfied with one heavenly bread may be united by your mercy.

text: Libera nos Domine ab omni malo propitiusque concede ut quae nobis poscimus relaxari ipsi quoque proximis remittamus.
translation_en: Deliver us, Lord, from every evil, and graciously grant that what we ask of you, we may also forgive our neighbors.

text: Libera nos Domine quaesumus a nostrorum debitis peccatorum atque ut nos a malis omnibus propitiatus eripias iniquitates nostras quibus iuste retribuuntur absolve.
translation_en: Deliver us, Lord, we beseech you, from our debts of sins and that you may graciously free us from all evils; free us from our iniquities which are justly repaid, absolve us.

text: Libera nos quaesumus Domine ab omnibus malis praeteritis praesentibus et futuris et intercedentibus sanctis tuis anima famuli tui illius pro abundantia clementiae tuae pium te sentiat in inferis quae multorum forsitan tormentorum cruciatus pro iustitiae merito sentit in poenis.
translation_en: Deliver us, we beseech You, Lord, from all past evils, present and future ones, and those that are interceding for us through Your holy saints. May the soul of Your servant feel Your pious mercy in the depths, who perhaps now is experiencing the torments of many sufferings because of his justice merit in punishments.

text: Licet sancte Pater indigni simus ad haec offerenda tuae maiestati libamina tua tamen confisi clementia poscere praesumimus ut precibus beati martyris tui Pelagii et ad relaxanda nostra et populi tui delicta tibi reddantur accepta.
translation_en: Although we are unworthy to present offerings to your majesty, we presume to ask for your clemency, confident in your mercy. We humbly plead that the prayers of your blessed martyr Pelagius may be accepted by you, to remit our sins and those of your people.

text: Magister omnium apostolorum et ducator ecclesiae Christe convenientibus nobis in honorem sanctorum tuorum apostolorum et martyrum Simonis et Iudae propitius adesse dignare. Fac nos eorum doctrinae sequaces fac amabiles fac et docibiles ut ab eis non inveniamus extorres quos fidei scimus egregios ducatores. Habeat cum illis spes nostra gloriae praemium qui postquam magistri doctrina fulserunt meruerunt obtinere martyrium. Fulgeat ecclesia illorum doctrina quorum in illa habetur praedicatio gloriosa. Adsint miseris nobis in omnibus adiutores qui ecclesiae mirabiles exstiterunt doctores. Doceant nos normam tenere iustitiae quorum praedicationibus fulget ecclesia ut sol et luna. Erigant lapsos ad paenitentiam qui eximii facti sunt per doctrinam. Impetrent peccatoribus scelerum veniam qui doctrinis fundaverunt ecclesiam. Conferant regibus modestiam virginibus perseverantiam clericis disciplinam laicis continentiam certantibus in fide constantiam qui quasi in mari navem praedicationibus gubernant ecclesiam ut qui illorum victoriis excitati eorum sollemnia celebramus eorum meritis a criminibus absoluti ad te post transitum veniamus.
translation_en: Master of all apostles and leader of the church, Christ, graciously attend us in honor of your holy apostles and martyrs Simon and Jude. Make us followers of their teaching, make us lovable and teachable, so that we do not find among them extortioners whom we know to be eminent leaders of faith. May our hope for glory share in their reward, who after being masters of doctrine have merited to obtain martyrdom. Let the church shine with their teaching, whose preaching is glorious. May they be helpers for us in all things who were marvelous teachers of the church. May they teach us to keep the rule of justice, whose preachings make the church shine like the sun and moon. May they raise the fallen to penitence, who have been made great by doctrine. May they intercede for sinners the forgiveness of sins, who founded the church with their teachings. May they give kings modesty, virgins perseverance, clerics discipline, laity continence, and those striving in faith constancy, who govern the church as if steering a ship by their preachings, so that we, stirred up by their victories, celebrate their feasts because of their merits, and approach you after transgressions for forgiveness.

text: Magna est Domine apud clementiam tuam Dei Genitricis oratio quam idcirco de praesenti saeculo transtulisti ut pro peccatis nostris apud te fiducialiter intercedat.
translation_en: Lord, your prayer is great in the clemency of you, God the Mother's grace. Therefore, you have brought it from this present age so that she may confidently intercede for our sins before you.

text: Magna nobis hodie Domine succurrit te auctore immolandi fiducia quia adest Christi tui coheres examinatus igne sacerdos cuius sacrificium non spernas. Adsunt enim levitae sanctissimi qui amicti stolis agni sanguine lotis altare tuum circumdare valeant et sacris muneribus honorare quibus quamlibet omnium in te credentium iniunxeris curam huic peculiarius loco et populo venerabilium reliquiarum praesentia consecrato ut assistere et opitulari iubeas rex summe precamur.  Nunc tibi Fructuosus tuus in commendatione nostri ac totius plebis huius fructum suorum ingerat meritorum. Nunc Agorius et Eulogius immaculati tui sanguinis ministrent poculum credentibus in salutem ut tam victricium ducum vel eruditi magisterio vel virtute defensi nec praesentium pro tuo nomine poenarum formidine terreamur nec futurorum bonorum extorres usquequaque reddamur.
translation_en: Today, O Lord, our great helper stands by us, the Author of our offering with confidence, since Your faithful servant, the priest examined by fire, whose sacrifice You do not despise, is present. The most holy Levites are indeed here who can surround Your altar with garments dipped in lamb's blood and honor it with sacred gifts, which You have particularly entrusted to care for all who believe in You and this venerable people because of the presence of Your relics consecrated in this special place. Now we humbly pray You, let our Fructuosus present on our behalf and that of this entire congregation the fruits of his merits. Now Agorius and Eulogius, Your spotless ministers of blood, serve the believers with a cup for their salvation, so that neither fear of present punishments for Your name nor future good things are extorted from us everywhere.

text: Magnifica Domine beati Laurentii sollemnia recensemus quae promptis cordibus ambientes oblatis muneribus et suscipimus et praeimus.
translation_en: We remember with greatness, Lord, the solemnities of blessed Laurence, who, with hearts prompt in service, offer gifts and receive them, and pray.

text: Magnifica Domine beati Bonifatii ordinationis sollemnia recensemus quibus promptis mentibus ambientes oblatis muneribus petimus ut caelestibus nos mundes mysteriis et clementer audire <digneris>.
translation_en: We remember, O Lord, the solemn ordination of blessed Boniface, approaching with ready minds and offering gifts, we ask that you cleanse us with heavenly mysteries and deign to listen to us graciously.

text: Magnificamus Domine clementiam tuam qui et veniam peccatoribus et miseris praestas auxilium.
translation_en: We magnify, Lord, Your mercy, who grants forgiveness to sinners and provides help to the afflicted.

text: Magnificamus Domine nomen tuum omnipotens et misericors Deus qui fragilitati nostrae subveniens non solum nobis mysteria divina largiris sed etiam per quorum preces his digni reddamur.
translation_en: We magnify, O Lord, your name, all-powerful and merciful God, who not only grant us divine mysteries to our frailty but also make us worthy through the prayers of others.

text: Magnificantes Domine clementiam tuam supplices exoramus ut qui nos sanctorum tuorum frequentibus facis nataliciis interesse perpetuis tribuas gaudere consortiis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, to invoke your mercy that those who frequent the natal feasts of your saints may also share in eternal joys and delight in their consorts.

text: Magnificare Domine Deus noster in hoc templo nomini tuo aedificato et ita benignus appare ut et peccata populi deleas et eorum vota clementer assumas.
translation_en: Praise the Lord, our God, in this temple built for Your name, and appear gracious so that You may also forgive the sins of the people and gently accept their prayers.

text: Magnificare Domine Deus noster in sanctis tuis et hoc in templo aedificationis appare ut qui omnia in filiis adoptionis operaris ipse semper in tua hereditate lauderis.
translation_en: Magnify the Lord, our God, in his holy ones and this in the temple of building appear, that he who works all things in the sons of adoption, may always be praised in his heritage.

text: Magnificasti Domine sanctos tuos suscepta passione pro Christo; praesta quaesumus ut etiam nos suppliciter celebrata purificet.
translation_en: You have magnified, Lord, your holy ones who took up the passion for Christ; grant us, we ask, that we too may be purified through humble celebration.

text: Magnificentiam tuam Domine praedicamus suppliciter implorantes ut qui(a) nos imminentibus periculis exuisti a peccatis quoque benignus absolvas ut (et) beneficia nobis maiora concedas et tuis nos facias parere mandatis.
translation_en: We humbly proclaim your greatness, O Lord, beseeching you that just as you have freed us from impending dangers, so too may you be gracious in absolving us from sins. May you grant us greater blessings and make us to conform our will to your commands.

text: Magnificet te Domine sanctorum tuorum Cosmae et Damiani beata sollemnitas qu(i)a et illis gloriam sempiternam et opem nobis ineffabili providentia contulisti.
translation_en: You magnify, Lord, the saints Cosmas and Damian, blessed solemnity, and to them eternal glory, and to us an ineffable help through your providence.

text: Magnis mysteriis incitata plebs tua Domine per viam salutis et pacis incidat et beati praecursoris hortamenta sectando ad eum quem praedixit secura perveniat.
translation_en: Your people, stirred up by great mysteries, Lord, may they enter upon the way of salvation and peace. May they follow the exhortations of the blessed forerunner and, secure, may they arrive at Him whom You have promised.

text: Magnum hoc munus misericordiae est qui nobis docuit redemptionis nostrae sacrificia celebrare sicut obtulit Dominus noster Iesus Christus in terris per quem te Pater omnipotens deprecamur ut supraposita altario tuo munera laetus adspicias atque haec omnia obumbres sancto Filii tui spiritu ut <eo> quod ex hac tua benedictione acceperimus aeternitatis gloriam consequamur.
translation_en: This is a great work of mercy that has taught us to celebrate the sacrifices of our redemption, as our Lord Jesus Christ offered on earth. We humbly pray to you, Almighty Father, that you graciously look upon these gifts at your altar and may everything be suffused with the holy Spirit of your Son, so that we may obtain eternal glory from this blessing.

text: Magnum nobis est semperque festivum fratres carissimi summi pontificis et martyris Saturnini meritis depensis fideliter precibus exorare qui Salvatoris nostri praecepta custodiens non solum sacerdotium ac vitae beatitudinem meruit sed etiam tanti honoris officium felici martyrio consecravit pro cuius meritis deprecemur omnipotentem Deum ut illuc defunctorum animas transferat a tartaro quo illum causa amoris sui assumere dignatus est post triumphum.
translation_en: It is always a great and festive occasion for us, dear most cherished brothers, to beseech the supreme pontiff and martyr Saturninus, whose merits are spent faithfully in prayers. He who has guarded the precepts of our Savior not only merited the priesthood and beatitude of life but also consecrated himself to such a great office through his happy martyrdom for which we pray. We beseech the almighty God that he transfers the souls of the departed from the pit of tartarus, into which He graciously deemed fit to assume him after triumph.

text: Maiestatem tuam clementissime Pater suppliciter exoramus et mente devota postulamus pro fratribus et sororibus nostris et pro his qui propria crimina vel facinora ante tuam maiestatem confessi fuerunt et pro his qui se in nostris orationibus commendaverunt tam pro vivis quam et pro solutis debito mortis et quorum eleemosynas ad erogandum suscepimus et quorum nomina ad memorandum conscripsimus vel quorum nomina supra hoc sanctum altare tuum adscripta esse videntur; concede Domine propitius ut haec sacra oblatio mortuis prosit ad veniam et vivis proficiat ad medelam et ceteris fidelibus pro quibus offertur indulgentia tuae pietatis succurrat.
translation_en: We humbly and devoutly beseech Your most merciful Father, and we ask with supplication that for our brothers and sisters, and for those who have confessed their sins or crimes before Your majesty, and for those who have commended themselves to our prayers, both for the living and for the dead who have settled their debts of death, whose alms we received to disburse, and whose names we have written down to be remembered; O Lord, grant us graciously that this holy offering may benefit the dead with forgiveness and the living with healing, and may Your grace assist all others for whom it is offered. Amen.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine sanctus Germanus confessor tuus atque pontifex cuius hodie depositionem celebramus pro nobis exoret ut quod nostris meritis non valemus eius precibus consequamur.
translation_en: We ask your majesty, Lord, that the holy Germanus, your confessor and bishop, whom we celebrate today for his deposition on our behalf, may intercede for us so that we may attain what we are unable to obtain through our own merits by means of his prayers.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices deprecamur ut nos et caelestibus expiare mysteriis et perpetuis non desinas fovere praesidiis
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, to cleanse us and our earthly existence with the sacred mysteries and unending favors, and never cease to protect us with Your eternal guardianship.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices deprecamur ut sicut spei corporis et sanguinis sacrosancti pascis alimento ita nae naturae facias esse consortes.
translation_en: We humbly entreat Your Majesty, Lord, that just as You nourish the body and sacred blood of the holy hope, so may nature make them to be in harmony with each other.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices deprecamur ut sicut nos iugiter sanctorum tuorum commemoratione laetificas ita semper supplicatione defendas.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that just as we are continually rejoiced by the remembrance of Your saints, so You may always protect us through our prayers.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices exoramus ut anima famuli tui Simplicii episcopi ab omnibus quae humanitus attraxit exuta in sanctorum censeatur sorte pastorum.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that the soul of Your servant Bishop Simplicius may be freed from all sins that have weighed it down and be counted among the number of shepherds in heaven.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices exoramus ut animae famulorum famularumque tuarum ab omnibus quae humanitus commiserunt exutae in tuorum censeantur sorte iustorum.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your Majesty, Lord, that the souls of your servants and handmaids may, having been absolved from all things they have committed through human weakness, be numbered among the portion of the righteous in your sorting.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices exoramus ut nec terreri nos lacerationibus patiaris iniustis nec captiosis adulationibus implicari sed potius amare concedas qui veraciter arguunt quam qui fallaciter blandiuntur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that You do not subject us to endure unjust lacerations or be entangled in deceitful flattery, but rather grant love to those who speak truthfully, rather than to those who are falsely flattered.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine supplices exoramus ut quos viam fecisti perpetuae salutis intrare nullis permittas errorum laqueis implicari.
translation_en: We humbly entreat Your Majesty, Lord, that You allow us to enter the eternal path of salvation You have made, and not permit us to be ensnared in any snares of errors.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter deprecamur ut haec sancta quae gerimus et praeteritis nos delictis exuant et futuris.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your majesty, Lord, that these holy things we are performing may cleanse us from past sins and protect us from future ones.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut famulo tuo illi tribuas fidei spei et caritatis augmentum per quod et terrores declinet humanos et solatia vitae immortalis percipiat.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, to grant Your servant an increase of faith, hope and charity, through which the terrors may decline for mankind and eternal life's consolations be received.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut sicut Ecclesiae tuae sanctus Andreas apostolicus exstitit praedicator et rector ita sit perpetuus suffragator.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that just as the holy Apostle Saint Andrew was a preacher and ruler for Your Church, he may always be a constant intercessor for us.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut sicut Ecclesiae tuae sanctus Andreas apostolus exstitit praedicator et rector ita sit pro nobis perpetuus suffragator. ( recension gelasienne ) Maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter exoramus ut sicut Ecclesiae tuae beatus Andreas apostolus exstitit praedicator et rector ita apud te sit pro nobis perpetuus intercessor. ( recension gregorienne )
translation_en:
We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that just as the holy Apostle Andrew stood out as a preacher and ruler for Your Church, he may always be our permanent advocate before You. (Gelasian recension)
We humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that just as the blessed Apostle Andrew stood out as a preacher and ruler for Your Church, he may forever intercede for us with You. (Gregorian recension)

text: Maiestatem tuam nobis Domine quaesumus haec hostia reddat immolanda placatam tuorum digna postulatione sanctorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that this offering may make us worthy to present a pleasing sacrifice to your Majesty, through the intercession of your saints.

text: Maiestatem tuam Domine quaesumus ut haec hostia nos tibi reddat acceptos quam immolantes te circa nos placatum efficiat et tuorum Sergii et Bacchi digna postulatione sanctorum ad gaudia aeterna perducat.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your Majesty, Lord, that this offering may render us acceptable to You as we sacrifice before You. May it please You around us, and through the worthy intercession of Your servants Sergius and Bacchus, lead them to eternal joys by the prayers of the saints.

text: Maiestatem tuam quaesumus Domine suppliciter imploramus ut sicut nos gloriosi confessoris tui Syri continuata commemoratione laetificas ita nos eius semper deprecatione custodias.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your Majesty, Lord, that as we rejoice in the continual commemoration of your glorious confessor Syri, so You may keep us always under his constant intercession.

text: Maiestatem tuam suppliciter imploramus omnipotens Deus ut sicut gloriam divinae potentiae munera pro sanctis oblata testantur sic nobis effectum tuae salvationis impendant.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your majesty, Almighty God, that just as the gifts offered for the saints testify to the glory of divine power, so may the effects of your salvation be bestowed upon us.

text: Maiestati tuae Domine debitas laudes offerimus qui nos et temporalibus subsidiis refoves et pascis aeternis.
translation_en: To your Majesty, Lord, we offer fitting praises, who sustain and feed us not only with temporal assistance but also with eternal care.

text: Maiestati tuae Domine hostiarum oblationes offerimus precantes ut intercessione beati Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis fiant acceptae in quo Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi dilectio flagravit.
translation_en: We offer our hostiae oblationes to Your Majesty, Lord, praying that through the intercession of the blessed martyr and bishop Blasius, they may be accepted. Where the love of Your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, has burned brightly.

text: Maiestati tuae famulantibus Domine miseratus occurre et quod possis ad indulgentiam inclinari affectum te rogandi concede. Mortifica in nobis saecularium desiderium voluntatum et per contritionem cordis sacrificium suscipe laudis ut contra insidias inimici gratia tua validiores effecti unde per intemperantiam gulae decidimus illuc per continentiam parsimoniae te adiuvante redire possimus.
translation_en: To Your Majesty, the servants pray, Lord, have mercy and appear to us. Grant what you can in response to our pleading for indulgence. Crush in us the desire for secular things, and through contrition of heart, receive as a sacrifice the praise that we offer. Thus strengthened by your grace, we may return from where we have fallen due to intemperance of gluttony, with self-control supported by parsimony.

text: Maiestati tuae nos Domine martyrum supplicatio beata conciliet ut qui incessabiliter actibus nostris offendimus continuis iustorum precibus expiemur.
translation_en: May your majesty, Lord, unite our supplications to the prayers of the blessed martyrs, so that we who offend you continuously through our actions may be purged by the continuous prayers of the righteous.

text: Maiestati tuae Domine nos beata omnium sanctorum supplicatio conciliet ut qui cottidie offendimus cottidiana eorum veneratione adiuvemur.
translation_en: To your Majesty, Lord, our supplication unites us with all the blessed saints, so that we who daily offend may be aided by their daily veneration.

text: Maiestati tuae nos quaesumus Domine beatae Mariae semper virginis et omnium ordinum angelorum simulque sanctorum omnium supplicatio sancta conciliet ut qui cottidie graviter offendimus cottidiana eorum veneratione et assidua intercessione salvari remissionemque omnium peccatorum consequi et ad tuam misericordiam pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask your Majesty, Lord, of the Blessed Virgin Mary, ever virgin, and all orders of angels, as well as all saints, that their holy supplication may bring us together so that we who daily commit grave offenses, may be saved through their constant veneration and continuous intercession, obtaining remission of all sins, and meriting to reach your mercy.

text: Maiestati tuae quaesumus Domine in honorem sanctissimi Kentigerni pontificis hoc munus oblatum sanctifica ut tibi sit acceptabile nobisque salubre.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for your Majesty, in honor of the most holy Kentigern, bishop, may this gift be sanctified and made acceptable to you, that it may be beneficial to us as well.

text: Maiestati tuae quaesumus Domine sanctissimi confessoris tui Leonardi nos pia iugiter commendet oratio ut quem devoto veneramur officio ipsius suffragio sublevemur optato.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for your Majesty, that you commend us always to your most holy confessor St. Leonard, so that by his devoted office we may be lifted through his intercession as we venerate him, according to our desire.

text: Maiestatis tuae clementiam suppliciter deprecamur omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sicut unigeniti Filii tui agnitionem per beatissimi sacerdotis et martyris tui Apollinaris praedicationem populorum cordibus infudisti ita ipsius opitulantibus meritis fidei stabilitate firmentur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your majesty's clemency, O almighty and merciful God, that as you imparted the recognition of your only-begotten Son through the preaching of the most blessed priest and martyr Apollinaris, so may the hearts of the people be strengthened in faith by his merits.

text: Martyris tui Praeiecti nos quaesumus Domine interventio gloriosa commendet ut quod nostris actibus non meremur eius precibus consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your glorious intervention may commend the martyrdom of your servant to us, so that we who do not deserve it through our actions, may obtain it through his prayers.

text: Martyris tui Sebastiani precibus aeterne omnipotens Deus nobis pacis dona largire per eum donans nobis habere integritatem purae dilectionis per quem tuos accendisti martyres ad amandam gloriam aeternae felicitatis.
translation_en: Eternal God, almighty, grant us peace through the prayers of your martyr Sebastian. By him, grant us to have pure love's integrity. Through whom you kindled your martyrs to love the glory of eternal happiness.

text: Martyrum tuorum deprecatione quaesumus Domine nobis benignus intende et sicut beatum sacerdotem et martyrem tuum xystum pati pro tuo nomine voluisti ita et tuis fidelibus eius fac(ias) merita suffragari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to turn your benevolent gaze towards us through the intercession of your martyrs. Just as you willed that the blessed priest and martyr Xystus suffer for your name, so may you grant the merits of his intercession to your faithful ones.

text: Sanctificetur istud hospitium
translation_en: Let this hospital be sanctified

text: Martyrum tuorum Domine Gervasii et Protasii natalicia praeeuntes supplices te rogamus ut quos caelesti gloria sublimasti tuis adesse concedas fidelibus.
translation_en: Lord, on the feast day of your martyrs Gervasius and Protasius, we humbly ask you to grant that those whom heavenly glory has exalted may be present for the faithful.

text: Martyrum tuorum Laurentini et Pergentini Domine festa venerantes munera nomini tuo dicata offerimus; praesta quaesumus ut illis reverentiam deserentes nobis veniam impetremus.
translation_en: Lord, on the festival of your martyrs Laurence and Pergentius, we who honor them offer gifts dedicated to your name. Grant us that, leaving reverence for them, we may boldly ask for forgiveness for ourselves.

text: Martyrum tuorum nos Domine semper festa laetificent et quorum celebramus meritum experiamur auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, may our festivals always be joyful on account of your martyrs, and let us experience help as we celebrate their merit.

text: Mediator caeli et terrae omnipotens Deus Iesu Christe qui pacata atque pacifica hominum diligis corda te supplices deprecamur ut pax illa quam tenendam tuis reliquisti apostolis iugiter perseverans nostris vigeat in cordibus et sicut David quondam forti manu spurio percusso Goliath pacem Saulis fecit in populo ita princeps noster opitulanter universis devictis undique gentibus pacifice innumeros per annos suo feliciter splendeat in regno.
translation_en: Mediator of heaven and earth, almighty God Jesus Christ, who love the peaceful hearts of men, we humbly beseech you that the peace which you left for your apostles to maintain unceasingly may always dwell in our hearts. Just as David once made peace for Saul with a strong hand by striking the unclean Goliath, so may our ruler, with help from above, triumph over all conquered nations and enjoy endless peace during his reign.

text: Memento Domine miserationum tuarum quas contritis semper mentibus clementer impendis ut tui nos auxilii gratia prosequente tale tibi spiritalis continentiae ieiunium persolvamus in quo non inveniantur nostrae voluntates a tua voluntate dissimiles.
translation_en: Remember, Lord, your mercies, which you always bestow with great clemency upon contrite hearts, that your grace following our aid may enable us to fulfill such spiritual continence and self-denial in this fast, wherein our wills may not be found dissimilar from yours.

text: Memento Domine quaesumus animae famuli tui illius episcopi et quem in corpore constitutum sedis apostolicae gubernacula tenere voluisti in electorum numero constitue sacerdotum.
translation_en: Remember, Lord, we ask you, the soul of your servant, that bishop, and him whom you wished to govern the steering wheels of the Apostolic See in the number of the elected. Appoint as priests.

text: Memento Domine quaesumus condicionis humanae ut sancti tui pro nobis et clementiam tuam semper exorent et incessabiliter audiantur.
translation_en: Remember, Lord, we humbly ask, the condition of humanity, that Your saints may always plead for us and that Your mercy may be continually heard and unceasingly attended to.

text: Memento Domine quod es operatus in nobis et non quod mereamur sed collati gratiam tui muneris intuere ut sicut me sacris altaribus tua dignatio pontificali servire praecepit officio ita dignum praestet et merito.
translation_en: Remember, Lord, that it is through us that you have worked and not because we deserve it. Look upon the grace of your gift so that, as your divine majesty commanded me to serve the sacred altars with the office of pontificate, so may it deem us worthy and justly reward us.

text: Memento nostri Domine in beneplacito populi tui et a peccati nos servitute discussos salutaris tui visitatione salvifica.
translation_en: Remember our Lord, in the goodwill of your people, and from the bondage of sin deliver us by the saving visitation of your salvation.

text: Meminimus Domine meminimus nec immemores sumus quod hic Augustinus tuus tui arcani dulcedine haustus inter tot rutilantia praecepta mandatorumque tuorum nectareo odore fragrantia quae toto paene mundi caespite ab ipso vibrant floride recitata promere tuae pacis commendaverit insignia. Adeo ut Ioannem qui sacri pectoris Filii tui fuit recubitor et prae ceteris apostolis ab eo nominatur dilectus in dictis exstitit exsecutor ut tam evangelium quod asiana in parte conscripsit idem apostolus quam etiam epistolam quam gentibus indidit in quibus supra omnes conscendens polorum virtutes ad illam meram et ineffandam divini numinis essentiam obtutu mentis inceptans reportare direxit; humanam omnimodo excedens naturam affatim enucleans tanti sacramenta mysterii non penetratus sed potius deputaret aufugi.  Unde quia hanc ipsam de qua suavia emanant mella hic vates tuus sine ea nos non posse inquit scandere aethera; ob hoc te fons et caritas ingenita quae caritatem ex tua gignens essentia dedisti ei gignendo et ab eo procedere caritatem quae est connexio utriusque ut non divisa summam numeris suppleat sed unita complexione fidem ad unam essentialiter caritatem reducat prostrati tellure gemebunda inquirimus voce ut huius sanctae caritatis mysterio nos repleas affluenter quatenus gemina dulcedine fulti Dei scilicet ac proximi mereamur a poenis debitis eximi et societati electorum perenniter uniri.
translation_en:
We remember, Lord, we remember and are not forgetful of the fact that here Augustine, your own, was drawn by the sweetness of your mystery among so many shining precepts and commands of yours, fragrant with nectar-like odor, which almost everywhere on earth were recited in a blooming manner by him. So much so, that John, who lay on the sacred breast of Your Son, was called beloved among all apostles by him, and he became an executor of his words, both the Gospel that the same apostle wrote about Asia, as well as the epistle that he gave to the gentiles. In these, surpassing human nature in every way, he preached the sacred mystery of such great sacrament not penetrated but rather consecrated and fled from it.
Because this very one from which sweet honey flows, according to your poet, without which we cannot ascend the ether; for this reason, you, fountain and original love, which generates love from yourself and proceeds from it, so that love, which is a connection of both, may not be divided but united, in order to bring faith to one essential love. Prostrate on the weeping earth, we ask with voice, that you fill us abundantly with the mystery of this holy love, so that filled with double sweetness, we may deserve to be freed from due penalties and forever unite with the chosen society.

text: Meminimus quidem omnipotens Pater et fideli mente retinemus Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui traditum nobis nativitatis eius inenarrabile sacramentum praeclarum devicta per crucem morte triumphum atque gloriosum ad caelos post crucis passionem adscensum. Credimus etiam immensum et incomprehensibile consempiternum tecum eius et consubstantiale principium. Ipsum quoque venturum confitemur iudicem mortuorum et viventium. Unde quaesumus tremende clementissime Pater ut hanc hostiam in similitudinem corporis et sanguinis eius tibi oblatam per signum crucis sanctifices et benedicas in signo crucis suscipias et assumas nobisque famulis tuis eiusdem crucis vexillo praenotatis placatus distribuas et benignus impertias.
translation_en: Indeed, we remember, Almighty Father, and with a faithful mind we hold fast the inexpressible sacrament of the nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, which was given to us, triumphant through the cross, glorious in its ascent to heaven after the passion of the cross. We also believe in your immense and incomprehensible eternal presence with his, and in the consubstantial origin. We confess that he will come as a judge of both the dead and the living. Therefore, we humbly ask you, most merciful Father, to sanctify and bless this offering made in the likeness of his body and blood through the sign of the cross, and to accept it and take it upon us who are marked with the same cross's banner. As one pleased and benevolent, we ask that you distribute to us your servants.

text: Memor esto Deus summe ieiunii nostri ut et holocaustum nostrum coram te pingue fiat et nos tibi ex ea sumentes vivam praeparemur in hostiam quo et arcana pectoris nostri virtute spiritus polleant et vota ieiuniorum nostrorum ante te Domine benedicta permaneant.
translation_en: Remember, O God of our supreme fasting, that our holocaust before you may become rich, and that we, partaking of it, may be prepared for you as a living sacrifice. May also the secrets of our heart rise with the power of the Holy Spirit, and may the vows of our fasters remain blessed before you, Lord.

text: Memor esto Domine fragilitatis humanae et qui iuste verberas peccatores parce propitiatus afflictis.
translation_en: Remember, Lord, the frailty of man and mildly, in justice, pardon those whom you have righteously scourged.

text: Memor esto obsecro miserationis tuae Domine Deus et mihi peccatori cunctorum tribue veniam delictorum ut tua gratia largiente ad vitam merear pervenire sempiternam.
translation_en: Remember I implore, O Lord, your mercy; and to me, the sinner, grant forgiveness for my offenses, so that through your grace, I may deserve to attain eternal life.

text: Memores gloriosissimi domini passionis et ab inferis resurrectionis offerimus tibi Domine hanc immaculatam hostiam rationalem hostiam incruentam hostiam hunc panem sanctum et calicem salutarem obsecrantes ut infundere digneris spiritum tuum sanctum <supra haec sollemnia ut fiat nobis legitima eucharistia in tuo filiique tui nomine et Spiritus Sancti in transformationem corporis ac sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi unigeniti tui> edentibus nobis vitam aeternam regnumque perpetuum collatura potantibus.
translation_en: Remembering the most glorious Passion of our Lord and His Resurrection from the dead, we offer You, Lord, this immaculate rational offering, this unbloody offering, this holy bread and saving cup. We entreat that You deign to pour out Your Holy Spirit upon these solemnities, that a legitimate Eucharist may be given to us in Your name, Your Son's name, and the Holy Spirit's, for the transformation of the Body and Blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Only-begotten. May those who partake of us receive eternal life and a perpetual kingdom to drink.

text: Memores mirabilium tuorum Domine quomodo levita tuus Laurentius nec nummis cessit nec flammis qui sic in creditis sibi facultatibus avaritiam vicit ut nullo modo posset inter flammas positus superari rogamus ut devictis in nobis facibus malarum cupiditatum a te sanctificata haec quae offeruntur horum precibus quorum hodie sollemnia celebramus sumantur.
translation_en: Remembering Your marvelous deeds, Lord, how Your levite Laurence neither yielded to coins nor to flames, who thus overcame avarice within his credible means. We humbly ask that, defeated by our wicked desires, these offerings be sanctified by You. May they be accepted on account of the prayers of those whose solemnities we celebrate today.

text: Memores sumus aeterne Deus Pater omnipotens gloriosissimae passionis Filii tui resurrectionis etiam eius et adscensionis in caelum; petimus ergo maiestatem tuam Deus ut adscendant preces humilitatis nostrae in conspectum tuae clementiae et descendat super hunc panem et super hunc calicem plenitudo tuae divinitatis; descendat etiam Domine illa tui Spiritus Sancti incomprehensibilis invisibilisque maiestas sicut quondam in patrum hostias descendebat.
translation_en: We remember eternally, O God, Father almighty and most glorious Passion of your Son's resurrection and even his ascension into heaven; therefore we ask your majesty, O God, that our humble prayers rise in the sight of your mercy and that your divine fullness descend upon this bread and upon this cup. Also, Lord, may your Holy Spirit, incomprehensible and invisible majesty, descend as it once did upon the sacrifices of the fathers.

text: Mensa tua nos Deus a delectationibus terrenis expediat et caelestibus semper instruat alimentis.
translation_en: May Your table, God, deliver us from earthly pleasures and may You always nourish us with celestial food.

text: Munera tua nos Deus a delectationibus terrenis expediant et caelestibus semper instruant alimentis.
translation_en: Your gifts, O God, may free us from earthly pleasures and always nourish us with celestial provisions.

text: Mensae caelestis Domine repleti libamine quaesumus intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis; hoc quod fide sequimur contemplemur et mente.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the heavenly table be filled with abundance by your intervention, through the intercession of your holy martyrs. What we follow in faith, we contemplate and hold in our minds.

text: Mensae caelestis Domine sumptis alimentis quaesumus clementiam tuam ut per ea intercedente beato Laurentio confessore tuo atque pontifice ad vitam <pervenire> mereamur aeternam.
translation_en: Heavenly table, Lord, with the offerings of food we ask for your clemency, that through the intercession of your blessed confessor and pope St. Lawrence, we may deserve to reach eternal life.

text: Mensae caelestis libatio quam sumpsimus precibus beati Christophori nobis Domine quaesumus fiat salutaris et a cunctis vitiorum tumultibus nos clementer eripiat.
translation_en: We pray, Lord, that the libation we have taken from the celestial table, through the intercession of blessed Christopher, may be beneficial to us and kindly deliver us from all storms of vices.

text: Mensae caelestis participatio quaesumus Domine corpora nostra mentesque sanctificet et sanctae virginis et martyris tuae Teclae gloriosa deprecatio ad vitam nos perducat aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to sanctify our bodies and minds with the participation of the heavenly table. May the glorious supplication of your holy virgin and martyr Tecla lead us to eternal life.

text: Mensae caelestis participatione refecti quaesumus Domine devotionem nostram amore servitutis tuae corroborari cunctosque nobis carnali dilectione adscitos tui suffragii fulciri munimine cunctisque fidelibus vivis ac defunctis sanctorum digneris largiri consortium.
translation_en: Having been nourished by the participation of the heavenly table, we humbly ask you, Lord, that our devotion be strengthened with the love of your servitude. May all who are attached to us by carnal affection be supported by your intercession. In the defense of all, both living and dead faithful, may you graciously grant them the fellowship of the saints.

text: Mensae caelestis participatione refecti quaesumus Domine devotionem nostram amore servitutis tuae corroborari cunctosque nobis carnali propinquitate ac familiari dilectione adscitos atque universum populum sacri baptismatis unda perfusum tui <suffragii> fulciri munimine omnibusque fidelibus vivis ac defunctis aeternam requiem et lucem concede propitius.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our devotion may be strengthened by the participation in the heavenly table. Grant us, through your love of service, to be united with all who are near and dear to us, whether by carnal proximity or familiar affection. May the whole people immersed in the sacrament of baptism flourish under your protection, and may all the living and the dead be granted eternal peace and light propitiously.

text: Mensae caelestis participatione vegetati supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut sicut de beati Audoeni perpetua glorificatione annua celebritate gaudemus ita ipsius apud te intercessione ab omni mereamur adversitate defendi.
translation_en: On the participation of the heavenly table, we humbly beseech you, almighty God, that just as we rejoice with the perpetual glorification of blessed Audoin in annual celebration, so may we be worthy of defense from all adversity through his intercession before you.

text: Mensae caelestis participes effecti imploramus clementiam tuam Domine Deus noster ut qui festa Dei Genitricis colimus a malis imminentibus eius intercessionibus liberemur.
translation_en: We who have become participants of the heavenly table, we humbly beseech Your mercy, Lord our God, that as we celebrate the feast of the Mother of God, we may be freed from impending evils through her intercessions.

text: Mensae caelestis satiati dulcedine humiliter te rogamus omnipotens Pater ut intercedente beato Georgio martyre tuo resurrectionis eius simus participes cuius sumus morte redempti.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, all-powerful Father, satiated at the table of heaven, that through the intercession of your blessed martyr George, we may be participants in his resurrection, for whom we have been redeemed by death.

text: Mensae tuae sancta sumentes sanctis martyribus tuis Domine quaesumus salutem referamus et mentis et corporis ut remedium nobis concedat cuius exsequimur actionem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the holy tables take from your holy martyrs the health we bring – body and mind. May it be a remedy for us, to whom we are performing this act.

text: Mensis sacris quaesumus Domine hostiam sacrare digneris impositam ut interventu beati archipraesulis ac martyris Aelphegi vitae nobis prospera praesentis et gaudium futurae beatitudinis obtineat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to consecrate the offering placed before you during these sacred months. May the intervention of the blessed archbishop and martyr Elphege grant us a prosperous life in the present, and future joy in beatitude.

text: Mentem familiae tuae quaesumus Domine intercedente beato Laurentio martyre (tuo) et munere compunctionis aperi et largitate pietatis exaudi.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, through the intercession of the blessed Martyr Lawrence, that you open our minds and hear us with the gift of compunction and the generosity of mercy.

text: Mentes nostras Domine spiritus paraclitus qui a te procedit illuminet et inducat in omnem sicut tuus promisit filius veritatem.
translation_en: Lord, let the Spirit of Paraclete, who proceeds from you, enlighten and guide our minds as your Son has promised us, the Truth.

text: Mentes nostras quaesumus Domine paraclitus qui a te procedit illuminet et inducat in omnem sicut tuus promisit Filius veritatem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord Paraclete who proceeds from you, enlighten and guide our minds as your Son promised the truth.

text: Mentes nostras et corpora Domine quaesumus operatio tuae virtutis infundat ut quod participatione sumpsimus plena redemptione capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your operation of power may pour into our minds and bodies so that we may fully grasp the redemption we have partaken in.

text: Mentes nostras et corpora possideat Domine quaesumus doni caelestis operatio ut non noster sensus in nobis sed iugiter eius praeveniat effectus.
translation_en: Lord, may your divine operation possess our minds and bodies, we ask. May the gift of heavenly operations dwell within us so that not our own senses guide us, but always his effects prevail.

text: Mentes nostras quaesumus Domine lumine tuae claritatis illustra ut videre possimus quae agenda sunt et quae recta sunt agere valeamus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to illuminate our minds with your light so that we may see what needs to be done and have the strength to do what is right.

text: Sanctus sanctus sanctus Dominus Deus Sabaoth.
translation_en: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts.

text: Mentes nostras quaesumus Domine lumine tuae visitationis illustra ut esse te largiente mereamur et inter prospera humiles et inter adversa securi.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your light illuminates our minds, so that we may deserve to be generous with your gifts and humble in prosperity, and secure amidst adversities.

text: Mentes nostras quaesumus Domine sanctus spiritus divinis praeparet sacramentis quia ipse est omnium remissio peccatorum.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the Holy Spirit may prepare our minds with divine sacrifices, for He is the forgiveness of all sins.

text: Mentes nostras quaesumus Domine Spiritus Sanctus divinis reparet sacramentis quia ipse est remissio omnium peccatorum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the Holy Spirit may by divine sacraments repair our minds, for He is the remission of all sins.

text: Mentes nostras quaesumus Domine susceptis robora sacramentis ut sicut eas beati Edmundi confessoris tui atque pontificis novis dignatus es confortare miraculis sic etiam (ad)iuvare suffragiis et illustrare digneris exemplis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to strengthen our minds with the sacraments, as you have been pleased to comfort the mind of your confessor and bishop, Blessed Edmund, through miracles. May you also help us through prayers and illuminate us through examples.

text: Satiasti nos Domine de tuis donis
translation_en: You have satisfied us, O Lord, with Your gifts.

text: Mentibus nostris Domine Spiritum Sanctum benignus infunde cuius et sapientia conditi sumus et providentia gubernamur.
translation_en: Lord, pour forth upon our minds the gentle Spirit of Yours, in whom we were created wise, and by whose providence we are governed.

text: Satiati Domine opulentiae tuae
translation_en: Satiate us, Lord, with thy riches

text: Merito omnipotens Deus hanc incurrimus infirmitatem qui tuam offendimus voluntatem et tamen licet arguamur flagellis pro peccatis sed fiduciam de te non amittimus confidentiae scientes quod non usquequaque in nos peccata insequeris si tamen peccatorum oblatione placaris; ob hoc Domine poscentium attende propitius preces lamentantium audi clamorem impende pietatem et pone iam finem propter misericordiam tuam et concede sanitatem.
translation_en: Rightfully, Almighty God, we have brought upon ourselves this infirmity, as we offend your will. Yet, though we are accused with scourges for our sins, we do not lose faith in you, knowing that you do not always chase after our sins if you are appeased by the offering of sins; therefore, Lord, attend propitiously to those who ask, have mercy on the lamenting, hear their plea, bestow your piety and put an end to it already for your mercy's sake, and grant us health.

text: Meritis Domine iugiter recensitis quibus te donante protegimur venerandi apostoli tui illius recordatio sollemnis quam praevenimus accedat.
translation_en: May the merits for which we are continually protected by your gift, Lord, ever be remembered through the solemn remembrance of your venerable Apostle. Let this approach us beforehand.

text: Mihi et omnibus offerentibus Domine munera placatus assume sanctorumque tuorum suffragio delictorum meorum veniam tribue; in Christo quiescentium animabus locum refrigerii lucis et pacis concede et amota a me omni simulatione da puram omnibus pacem et perpetuam in diebus nostris tribue dulcedinis caritatem.
translation_en: Lord, pleased with my offerings and those of all who offer to You, accept the merits and through the intercession of Your saints grant me pardon for my sins; in Christ, may the resting souls find a place of refreshing light and peace. Grant them, and remove from me every simulation, give pure peace to all, and bestow upon us sweetness of charity in our days.

text: Ministrantium tibi Deus eruditor et rector qui Ecclesiae tuae primordia beati levitae Stephani ministerio et pretioso martyrii sanguine decorasti da quaesumus ut in excessu nostro veniam consequentes mereamur exemplis eius imbui et intercessionibus adiuvari.
translation_en: We ask you, God, our teacher and ruler, who adorned the beginnings of your church with the ministry and precious blood of the blessed deacon Stephen, the first minister, that in our lives we may follow his example and deserve to be washed clean by his merits. May we also be aided by his intercessions.

text: Mirabilia tua Domine trementes narramus; duo subinde pisciculi veteris ac novi indicant testamentorum mysteria; primum quod Tobi Tobiae filius iubente Raphaelem vadoso amni decursa continuit cuius caro pastum subministravit itineris successu iecur vetustum a filia Raguelis daemonium effugavit; a ruina quoque eius Tobiae oculos caliginis nube contectos sereno lucis adspectu ad tactum unctionis insuit; hoc est ut ignorantiam primi saeculi quam libor bellaverat serpentinus novello partui verbo caelesti populos exuteret saeculi subsequentis; alius deinde piscis est qui priscae legis devitum in similitudinem peccatorum captus a Petro staterem evomuit quem Dominus et Salvator noster eundem Petrum evangelica voce censurae publicae imperat exsolvendum ut pax caelestis terris reddatur.
translation_en: We speak of Your wonders, Lord, trembling; two fishes at once, old and new, point to the mysteries of the testaments. First, that Tobit's son Tobias, under the command of Raphael, walked through the waters, whose flesh provided food for the journey, the liver of an old fish escaped from a demon by his daughter Rachel; from ruin, Tobias' eyes, covered by a cloud of darkness, were uncovered by the bright sight of touch and anointment; this is to represent the ignorance of the first age that was veiled by the serpentine book being unveiled by the new word of heavenly people. Another fish then is which, captive in likeness of transgressions, vomited the money given to it by Peter, whom our Lord and Savior commands, with an evangelical voice, to be publicly exonerated so that peace may return from heaven to earth.

text: Mirabilis es Deus mirabilis et praeclarus qui sanctis Cosmae et Damiano effectus adiutor fortis non eos passus es adversantium interimi lapidibus vel sagittis. Nec enim fas erat ut sublimitate crucis erectos tela inimici redderent vulneratos. Propter quod pietatis tuae cum tremore audentes clementiam postulamus ut nos ita maiestas tua praemuniat quo nullis odiorum iaculis tacti tibi qui verus lapis es per pacis bonum mereamur sine fine coniungi.
translation_en: You are a wonderful God, wonderful and majestic, who made Cosmas and Damian your powerful helpers. You did not allow them to be cut down by their adversaries' stones or arrows. Indeed, it would have been unjust for the enemy's arrows to wound those exalted by the loftiness of the cross. Therefore, with trembling we dare to ask for Your mercy so that Your majesty protects us in such a way that we who are truly the stone of peace, may be united with You forever without being touched by any hateful missiles.

text: Mirabilis in excelsis Domine Deus noster qui adscendisti super caelos caelorum ad orientem inter angelorum ministeria carnis trophaea sustollens cum ad occursum tuum caeli potestates occurrunt pone quaesumus adscensionem in cordibus nostris ut etiam nos te sequentes illuc tendamus fide ubi scimus ad Dei patris dexteram te regnare.
translation_en: Wonderful beyond measure, O Lord our God, who ascended above the heavens of heavens to the east, leading the trophies of angelic service with your body. When the powers of heaven approach you, we ask that your ascent be placed in our hearts, so that even we, following you, may stretch ourselves there in faith, where we know you reign at the right hand of God the Father.

text: Mirabilis es in sanctis tuis Domine virtutum; exaudi nos supplices tuos et peccatoribus nobis beatissimorum martyrum patrocinia largire; illi coronam iustitiae fidei meruerunt nos eorum suffragiis te donante veniam consequamur.
translation_en: You are wonderful among your saints, Lord, in virtues; hear us, your suppliant ones, and grant us the patronage of the blessed martyrs; they have deserved a crown of justice through their faith, we may obtain forgiveness through their intercessions given by you.

text: Mirabilis in sanctis tuis Domine virtutum (exaudi nos supplices tuos) et peccatoribus nobis beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Ferreoli et Ferrucionis patrocinia largire; illi coronas insignes gemmis lapidibus pretiosis martyrii virtute meruerunt; nos eorum suffragiis te donante delictorum veniam consequamur. Et concede nobis ut coniunctio labiorum copula efficiatur animarum et ministerium osculi perpetuae proficiat caritati.
translation_en: Miraculous in your saints, Lord, are the virtues (hear us, your suppliant ones). And to us, the most blessed martyrs of yours, Ferreolus and Ferrucius, grant their patronage; they have earned crowns adorned with precious gemstone lapidis through their martyred virtue; through their intercession, we can obtain forgiveness for our sins if you so grant it. And grant us that the joining of lips may be a bond for souls and the ministry of the kiss may perpetually profit charity.

text: Mirabilis in sanctis tuis Domine virtutum exaudi supplices tuos et peccatoribus nobis beatissimi Martini episcopi et confessoris tui patrocinia largire. Ille enim per confessionis gratiam meruit coronam virtutum; nos eius suffragiis te donante veniam peccatorum nostrorum consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Miraculous in your saints, Lord, hear the supplications of your servants and grant us the patronage of your blessed Martín, bishop and confessor. For he merited the crown of virtues through the grace of confession; we, through his intercessions, may deserve forgiveness for our sins, with you granting us pardon.

text: Mirabilium Deus operator immense qui quondam aquas in conspectu tuo sistentes deinceps in vina mutasti te humiliter imploramus ut suscepta voce clamoris nostri misericordiam tuam nobis deprecantibus numquam auferas sed propitius inclina aurern tuam et exaudi preces nostras tibi supplicantes ut serenissimo vultu videre mereamur quem in hac captivitate nostra cum gloria venturum exspectamus.
translation_en: We humbly implore you, the mighty God who once changed the waters standing before you into wine, to listen to our pleas as we call upon your mercy. May you never withdraw it from us, but incline your ear to us and hear our prayers. May we deserve to see you with a serene face, which we eagerly await in this captivity, coming with glory.

text: Mirabilium tuorum Domine ovantes insignia praedicamus. Et ideo illapsu illo Sancti Spiritus repleri nos cupimus qui bis a te olim fuit in discipulis distributus; cum et ante adscensionem tuam in eorum cordibus indeptus <est> proximi dilectionem et post e caelis emissus tenendam in illis tuam impresserit caritatem.  Ex hoc te clementissime Deus oramus ut hoc quod his sacramentis figuratum fore cognoscitur in nostris cordibus impleatur quo spiritu ferventes et spiritalia diligentes et proximis connectamur in pace et tua ubertatim ferveamus dulcedine ut in caritate illa quae per Spiritum Sanctum nostris est diffusa in cordibus firmissime radicati consolationem promerentes paracliti coronari mereamur in adventu iusti iudicii tui.
translation_en:
We proclaim the wonders of yours, O Lord, with signs. And therefore we long to be filled with that same Holy Spirit who twice was given by you to your disciples; when before your ascension, he was immersed in their hearts and instilled in them the love of their neighbor, and after that, sent from heaven, he impressed upon them your love.
From this, we humbly ask you, most merciful God, that what is represented by these sacraments may be fulfilled in our hearts; so that we may burn with a fervent spirit, love spiritual things, and be united with our neighbors in peace, and that we may exult in your abundance with the sweetness of that charity which is spread throughout our hearts by the Holy Spirit, as it takes root within us. May we deserve to be crowned with the Paraclete in the coming of the righteous judgment of your justice.

text: Miranda confessoris tui beati Edmundi translatio bene vivendi sit nobis exemplum quatenus ipsius meritis et documentis divina gratia praestante transferamur ad caeli palatia.
translation_en: May the translation of your blessed confessor, St. Edmund, serve as a good example for us in living well, so that through his merits and God's divine grace we may be transferred to the palaces of heaven.

text: Miseratio tua Deus ad haec percipienda mysteria famulos tuos quaesumus et provehat competenter et devota conversatione perducat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O God, that your mercy may be extended to these things to be understood, and that you may prepare and guide your servants appropriately, and lead them through a devoted way of life.

text: Miserationum tuarum Domine quaesumus praeveniamur auxilio et in huius sollemnitate ieiunii omnium tibi sit devotio grata fidelium.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your mercy may precede us with help, and on this solemnity of fasting, may all our devotion be a pleasing offering to you from the faithful.

text: Miserator et misericors Domine Iesu Christe qui curri Deo patre in sempiterna gloria permanes gloriam tuam per huius sacrificii interventum deposcimus ut animas famulorum tuorum illorum Sancti Spiritus tui consolatione reficias et omnium defunctorum animabus in pacis tuae gaudio quiescentibus requiem largiaris aeternam.
translation_en: Merciful and compassionate Lord Jesus Christ, who run to the eternal glory of God the Father, we ask that through this sacrifice you deposit your glory. We beg that you restore the souls of your servants with the comfort of your Holy Spirit and grant eternal rest in peace to the souls of all the departed, resting in your joy.

text: Miserator et misericors Domine qui nos continuis caelestium martyrum non deseris sacramentis praesta quaesumus ut quae sedulo celebramus affectu grato tibi percipiamus obsequio.
translation_en: Merciful and compassionate Lord, who continually support us with the sacrifices of celestial martyrs, grant that what we celebrate with a grateful heart may be understood through our obedience to you.

text: Miserere Domine deprecantis ecclesiae et inclinantium tibi sua corda propitiatus intende ut quos divinorum sinis esse participes nec peccatis fieri permittas obnoxios nec opprimi patiaris adversis.
translation_en: Have mercy, Lord, upon the supplicating church and those bending their hearts to You. May Your favor be extended so that those who are partakers of divine grace may not be made sinful, nor subjected to it; neither may they be oppressed by adversities.

text: Miserere Domine famulo tuo illi misericors et ab omni aegritudine cordis et corporis sana propitius sicque corporali eum correptione clementer in praesenti erudias ut ablutum a colluvionibus cunctis in futuro regno tecum sine fine feliciter vivere concedas.
translation_en: Have mercy, Lord, on your servant to him, O merciful one, and from all sickness of heart and body heal him graciously. So that by corporal correction he may be taught gently in the present, granting that he may be cleansed from all stains in future life with you, living happily without end.

text: Miserere Domine populi tui et continuis tribulationibus laborantem propitius respirare concede.
translation_en: Have mercy, Lord, on your people and grant them relief from their continuous afflictions. Be gracious and let them breathe again.

text: Miserere iam quaesumus Domine populo tuo et continuis tribulationibus laborantem celeri propitiatione laetifica.
translation_en: Have mercy on us now, we humbly ask you, Lord, upon your people and one who is continually suffering from tribulations, refresh with swift compassion.

text: Miserere misericors Deus animabus illis quae singulares non habent apud te intercessores quibus nulla est consolatio in tormentis neque spes ulla nisi quod factae sunt ad imaginem et similitudinem tuam; parce et defende Domine plasma tuum nobile et gloriam nominis tui ne des alteri; opus manuum tuarum respice in eis et libera eas ab omnibus intolerabilibus poenis et cruciatibus et perduc eas ad societatem civium supernorum.
translation_en: Have mercy, merciful God, on the souls that have no particular intercessors with You, who find no consolation in torments nor any hope, except for what they have been made in Your image and likeness; spare them, O Lord, protect Your noble and glorious name lest it be given to another. Regard the work of Your hands in them and free them from all intolerable punishments and sufferings, and lead them to the society of the citizens above.
