text: Miserere nobis Domine miserere nobis dum non miseria miseros consumere sed misericordia liberare festinas nec vindicta obsorbere sed expiari peccatores intendis; sentiamus Domine manum tuam medentem potius quam percutientem foventem magis quam ferientem ut sic praesentia adhibeas flagella ut supplicia arceas sempiterna atque famulos tuos illos pietate paterna corripias non abiicias erudias non confundas tribuasque propitius cunctis temporum pacem et aegris integerrimam sanitatem.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, Lord; have mercy on us. While we are wretched, do not consume us with misery, but free us with mercy. You hasten not to let us be overwhelmed by vengeance, but rather to expiate sinners. May we feel, O Lord, your hand healing rather than punishing, nurturing instead of striking, so that the presence of your rod serves to ward off punishment and eternal torment. May you chastise your servants with a loving father's correction, not reject them; educate, not confuse them; do not humiliate them but bestow upon them grace. Grant peace to all in every age, and grant them perfect health when they are sick.

text: Miserere nobis Domine miserere nobis et a cunctis malis praeteritis praesentibus et futuris nos eripe; furorem irae tuae gladium captivitatem pestilentiam famem tribulationem et insidias inimicorum nostrorum a nobis elonga; gratia tua nos a sordibus peccatorum emunda et omnes in commune iustifica; tempora concede et dies nostros in tua pace disponendo laetifica; omnium infirmorum valetudines cura omniumque fidelium defunctorum animabus requiem praesta.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us. Deliver us from all past, present and future evils. Extend from us the wrath of your anger, the sword of captivity, pestilence, famine, tribulation, and ambushes of our enemies; cleanse us with your grace from the filth of sins and justify us all in common; grant us time and let our days be filled with your peace. Amen, heal the sick, care for the dying souls of all faithful people.

text: Miserere nobis Domine miserere nobis quia tu es aeternus creator; quos fecisti ne despicias; quos redemisti caelesti protectione pius defende.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us because you are the eternal Creator; those whom you have made, do not scorn them; those whom you have redeemed, defend with celestial protection, a pious God.

text: Miserere nostri Deus et tuae nobis pietatis effectus potenti bonitate largire.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, God, and grant us your pity through your powerful goodness.

text: Miserere quaeso clementissime Deus mihi famulo tuo qui hoc sacrificium laudis tuae offero maiestati et precibus beatae virginis Mariae omnes iniquitates meas dele indulgentia tuae propitiationis nec plus apud te valeat offensio delinquentium quam misericordia indulta precibus supplicantium et quod devota mente pro peccaminum meorum absolutione gero proficere mihi sentiam ad medelam; famulis quoque et famulabus tuis qui mihi consanguinitatis familiaritatis subiectionis confessionis et dilectionis vinculo innectuntur vivis et defunctis quorum et quarum nomina tibi vivunt pro quibus tuam misericordiam exoro remissionem omnium peccatorum et aeternitatis gloriam tribue.
translation_en: Miserable one, I humbly ask, most compassionate God, to me your servant, who offers this sacrifice of your praise to your majesty and with prayers to the blessed Virgin Mary, may all my iniquities be blotted out by your indulgence, so that the offense of sinners weighs no more with you than mercy granted through supplicating prayers, and since I strive with a devoted mind for the absolution of my sins, may I feel healing; also, for the servants and handmaids to you who are bound to me by the bond of consanguinity, familiarity, subjection, confession, and love, both living and dead, whose and whose names live before you, I entreat your mercy for remission of all sins and grant them eternal glory.

text: Miserere quaesumus clementissime Deus famulo tuo illi pro quo hoc sacrificium laudis tuae offerimus maiestati et precibus beatae Mariae virginis omnes iniquitates eius indulgentia tuae propitiationis dele et quod devota mente pro peccaminum eius absolutione gerimus proficere sentiat ad medelam.
translation_en: Have mercy, we humbly beseech you, O most merciful God, upon your servant for whom we offer this sacrifice of your praise to your majesty, and may the prayers of the Blessed Virgin Mary wipe out all his iniquities through your indulgence and propitiation. May what we are carrying out with a devoted mind on account of his forgiveness of sins be effective for his healing.

text: Si qui paenitentiam petens
translation_en: If one seeking penance

text: Miserere quaesumus Domine animabus omnium benefactorum nostrorum defunctorum et pro beneficiis quae nobis largiti sunt in terris praemia aeterna consequantur in caelis.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, Lord, on the souls of all our benefactors who have died, and may they obtain eternal rewards in heaven for the benefits they granted to us on earth.

text: Si quis paenitentiam petens
translation_en: If anyone seeking penance

text: Miserere quaesumus Domine Deus famulis tuis pro quibus hoc sacrificium laudis tuae offerimus maiestati ut per haec sancta supernae benedictionis gratiam obtineant et gloriam aeternae beatitudinis acquirant.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, we humbly ask you, Lord God, upon your servants for whom we offer this sacrifice of your praise to your majesty. May they obtain grace through these holy signs of divine blessing and acquire the glory of eternal beatitude.

text: Si vero episcopus adest
translation_en: If the bishop is present

text: Miserere quaesumus Domine nobis indignis famulis tuis suffragia sanctorum tuorum humiliter implorantibus ut quia fragili mortalique carne circumdati cottidianis peccatorum remissionibus indigemus gloriosae semper virginis Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctorumque apostolorum martyrum confessorum ac virginum omniumque electorum tuorum assiduis apud pietatem tuam precibus adiuvemur ut quod possibilitas nostra non obtinet eorum nobis intercessione donetur.
translation_en: Merciful one, we humbly ask you, Lord, on behalf of ourselves, unworthy servants, that through the prayers of your saints, who implore you humbly, since we daily need pardon for our sins, you might assist us with your constant prayers, so that what our ability does not achieve may be given to us by their intercession.

text: Miserere quaesumus rogantibus nobis propitius respice in adversis; qui desperatis cor paenitens tribuis a confessionibus nostris ullo modo avertaris et quia contriti cordis placaris sacrificio tribue nobis hoc tibi offerre quod praecipis et mereri indulgentiam quam promittis.
translation_en: Have mercy on us, we humbly ask; look favorably upon us in our adversity. Who despairing, grant a penitent heart from our confessions and turn away none from turning to you. And because our hearts are contrite, may you grant us the sacrifice to offer what you command and merit the indulgence that you promise.

text: Sic age quasi redditurus
translation_en: So act as if you are about to return

text: Miserere supplicibus tuis quaesumus Domine sancti Sampsonis confessoris tui atque pontificis merita venerantibus ut eius adiuti suffragiis spiritualibus donis ditati gaudentes hinc redeamus.
translation_en: Have mercy on your suppliant ones, we ask you, Lord, of Saint Samuel the confessor and bishop. May the merits of your holy saint draw near to us so that, aided by his spiritual intercessions, we who are enriched with gifts may return from here rejoicing.

text: Miserere vivorum Domine qui sacerdotibus tuis confessi fuerunt vel qui se in orationibus nostris commendaverunt; da restaurationem defunctis qui desiderantes paenitentiam de hac luce migraverunt; da sanitatem infirmis prosperitatem in via tua ambulantibus pacem discordantibus finem perfectam bene incipientibus portum salutis navigantibus indulgentiam paenitentibus pacem christianis regibus.
translation_en: Have mercy, Lord, on the living who have confessed to your priests or who have entrusted themselves in our prayers; grant restoration to those who long for penance and have migrated from this light (died); grant health to the sick, prosperity to those walking in your way, peace to the discordant, a perfect end to those well begun, a harbor of salvation to those sailing, indulgence to penitents, peace to Christian kings.

text: Sicut qui invitatus renuit
translation_en: As one who refuses an invitation

text: Misericordiae tuae remediis quaesumus Domine fragilitas nostra subsistat ut quae sui condicione defecit tua vegetatione reparetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your mercy may sustain our frailty, so that what has failed in its own condition may be restored by your nourishment.

text: Misericordiae tuae remediis quaesumus Domine fragilitas nostra subsistat ut quae sua condicione atteritur tua clementia reparetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through your mercy our frailty may be sustained, so that what is weakened by its own condition may be restored by your clemency.

text: Misericordiam tuam aeterne Deus flagitantes petimus ut famulo tuo illi requiem aeternam tribuas et quidquid ex fragilitate corporis vel peccatorum vitiis culpae contraxit tua propitiatione ei ignoscas.
translation_en: We eternally beseech your mercy, O God, that you grant to your servant eternal rest and may whatever he contracted from the frailty of his body or the faults of his sins you forgive through your mercy.

text: Misericordiam tuam Domine nobis quaesumus interveniente beato confessore tuo Damaso clementer impende et nobis peccatoribus ipsius propitiare suffragiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your mercy may be extended to us, with the intervention of your blessed confessor Damasus. May you show clemency and appease us sinners through his intercession.

text: Misericordiam tuam Domine supplices exoramus ut hoc tuum sacramentum non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sed fiat intercessio salutaris ad veniam.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your mercy, Lord, that this Your sacrament may not be a burden to us for punishment but rather become an effective intercession for forgiveness.

text: Misericordiam tuam supplices exoramus omnipotens Deus ut hoc tuum Domine sacramentum non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sed fiat intercessio salutaris ad veniam.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your mercy, Almighty God, that this Your sacrament may not be a burden to us for punishment, but rather an effective intercession leading to forgiveness.

text: Misericordiam tuam quaesumus Domine nobis clementer impende et sanctae Christinae virginis et martyris tuae nobis placatus praesidiis exsistas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to pour out your mercy upon us kindly, and may the holy Virgin and Martyr Saint Christina stand as a protective presence for us.

text: Misericordiam tuam suppliciter deprecor omnipotens Deus ut me famulum tuum quem divinis sacramentis carne et sanguine Iesu Christi Filii tui Dei mei satiasti ab omnibus inimicorum incursibus liberare et a carnis immunditia seu lascivia animae meae purgare digneris.
translation_en: I humbly beseech Your mercy, Almighty God, that You may free me, Your servant, whom You have satisfied with the divine sacraments of flesh and blood of Jesus Christ, Your Son and my God, from all attacks of my enemies, and may purge my soul from carnal impurity or lewdness.

text: Misericors Domine cuius miserationes sunt super omnia opera eius fratres carissimi supplicemus ut reliquiis populi sui quem ruina mundi labentis ac praetereuntis oppressit in variis afflictionum eius succurrat angustiis quo singulis atque universis tribulationum suarum pondus non ira delendi sit sed eruditio convertendi.
translation_en: Merciful Lord, whose mercies are over all of his works, we beseech our most dear brothers that you help the remnant of your people whom the collapse of the world, which is in the process of falling and passing away, has oppressed with various afflictions. May you aid them in their distress, so that the weight of each and every one of their tribulations is not for destruction but for education.

text: Misericors Domine fidelium tuorum consolator et doctor auge in Ecclesia tua desideria quae dedisti et de intellegenda altitudine promissionum sperantium in te corda confirma ut omnes adoptionis filii lumen quod nondum ostendis fidei oculis incunctanter intueantur et patienter exspectent.
translation_en: Merciful Lord, Comforter and Teacher of your faithful, increase in your Church the desires that you have given, and confirm in their hearts the hope of those who expect great promises from you. May all the children of adoption clearly see the light that you have not yet shown to the eyes of faith, and may they patiently wait for it.

text: Misericors et miserator Domine patiens et multum misericors si iniquitates observaveris quis sustinebit? Precamur ergo immensam clementiam tuam pro anima famuli tui illius; cui parva fiducia suppetit actionum sola gratia tua copiosa resplendeat ut vel veniam opera manuum tuarum sentiat in inferis quem ad imaginem tuam creare dignatus es.
translation_en: Merciful and compassionate Lord, patient and extremely merciful, if you observe iniquities, who can bear it? Therefore, we beseech your immense mercy for the soul of your servant; upon whom a little faith supports itself. May your abundant grace shine forth from the sole action of his deeds, that he may feel forgiveness for the works of your hands in the underworld, whom you deemed worthy to create in your image.

text: Misericors et miserator Domine qui nos parcendo sustentas et ignoscendo sanctifices da veniam peccatis nostris et sacramentis caelestibus servientes ab omni culpa liberos esse concede.
translation_en: Compassionate and merciful Lord, who sustain us by sparing us and make us holy through forgiving us, grant us pardon for our sins and, while serving the heavenly sacraments, free us from all guilt.

text: Misericors et miserator Domine qui parcendo sustentas et ignoscendo sanctificas da mihi per haec sancta quae sumpsi purificationem mentis et corporis et mearum absolutionem culparum.
translation_en: Compassionate and merciful Lord, who sustain by pardoning and sanctify by forgiving, grant to me through these holy things that I have taken, the cleansing of mind and body, and the absolution of my sins.

text: Misericors et omnipotens Deus qui nos de virtute in virtutem debita veneratione currentes tuorum facis festivitatibus gaudere sanctorum praesta ut quorum sollemnitatibus consolamur orationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Merciful and omnipotent God, who makes us rejoice in the feasts of your saints through the appropriate reverence of your virtue, grant that we may be consoled and aided by their solemnities with our prayers.

text: Mitte Deus archangelum tuum Raphaelem cum medicamine opificem qui sanitatem mentis reportet et corporis misericordiaeque caelestis donum infundat et quae in nobis sunt adversa deponat ut qui nostra iniquitate tabescimus de tua quam non meremur pietate laetari concedas.
translation_en: Send, O God, your angel Raphael with the physician who brings back health of mind and pours out the gift of celestial mercy and removes what is adversarial in us, that we who are wasting away because of our own iniquity may rejoice in your mercy which we do not deserve.

text: Mitte Domine quaesumus Spiritum Sanctum qui et haec munera praesentia nostra tuum nobis efficiat sacramentum et ad hoc percipiendum nostra corda purificet.
translation_en: Send forth, Lord, we pray, the Holy Spirit, who makes these gifts present through our presence and purifies our hearts to receive them.

text: Mitte quaesumus Domine Spiritum Sanctum in cordibus nostris et ut accepta tibi sint nostra ieiunia praesta nobis quaesumus huius munere sacramenti purificatum tibi pectus offerre.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, send the Holy Spirit into our hearts and may our fasting be accepted by Thee. Grant us, we pray, through this gift of sacrament, that a purified breast be offered to Thee.

text: Mitte quaesumus Domine Spiritum Sanctum qui sanctorum apostolorum tuorum linguas ad praedicandum fecit disertas ut et haec praesentia munera sanctificet et ad haec percipienda cordium nostrorum purget habitacula.
translation_en: Send we beseech Thee, Lord, the Holy Spirit, who made the tongues of Thy holy apostles eloquent for preaching, so that this present gathering may be sanctified by these gifts and cleanse the dwellings of our hearts for the reception of these things.

text: Mitte verbum tuum e caelis Domine quo abluantur delicta et sanctificentur oblata ut qui tibi obsequimur abstinentiae votis a tuis numquam recedamus praeceptis quo huius libaminis salvati participatione tibi mereamur expulsis criminibus deservire.
translation_en: Send forth your word, Lord, from heaven; that they may be purified of their sins and consecrated by the offerings. So that those who serve you with vows of abstinence never depart from your commandments. By participating in this sacrament, we may deserve to serve you, free from sins expelled.

text: Mores nostros Domine quaesumus tua pietate compone ut et nulla nobis Dominentur adversa et salutaria cuncta non desint.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your mercy arrange our ways, so that no adversity may rule over us and that every good thing may not be lacking.

text: Moveat pietatem tuam quaesumus Domine subiectae tibi plebis affectus et misericordiam tuam supplicatio fidelis obtineat ut quod meritis non praesumit indulgentiae tuae largitate percipiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your pity be stirred for the subject people beneath you and that a faithful supplication gains your mercy, so that, not presuming on his merits, he may receive indulgence from your generosity.

text: Multa quidem erant replicanda quantam habeat castimonia gratiam sed quod ex conservato pudore confertur a domino humana lingua non valet proferre in medio cum et inaestimabile sit quod speratur et gloriosum quod acquiritur. Qui enim carnem mentemque suam gestat ut Ioannes et Iacobus pudicam pectoris Christi domini esse merebitur recuba. Nec enim quispiam in sanctum pectus poterit recumbere qui non suum domicilium mundum certaverit custodire; illosque solum puto quod digne suscipiat Christus in requiem quos aut integritas mentis commendat aut cruoris effusio iuste delibat.  Unde precamur te Christe Dei Filius et Salvator noster ut huius viri iusti suffragio Ecclesiam tuam liberes ab adversis qui eam eius dignatus es ampliare doctrinis.
translation_en:
Indeed, much should be repeated regarding the grace that chastity has, but what is conferred by preserved chastity cannot be expressed by human language in its presence, for it is immeasurable and glorious what is hoped for and gained. For whoever carries his flesh and mind as John and James did, worthy of a chaste heart of Christ our Lord, will receive a covering.
Indeed, no one can lie down on a holy breast who has not striven to keep his home worldly; I think only those who are worthy will be received by Christ in peace whom either the integrity of mind commends or the just outpouring of blood confirms.
Hence we pray to you, Christ, Son of God and our Savior, that with the intercession of this righteous man, you may free your Church from adversities which you have deigned to enlarge with teachings.

text: Multa sunt Domine iniquitatum nostrarum crimina pro quibus superbiam nostram iuste reverberas et conculcas sed immensam bonitatem tuam misericors petimus ut quibus hic conversionis tempus patientiae largiris caelestium gaudiorum facias possessores.
translation_en: Lord, there are many iniquities and crimes for which you justly strike our pride and humble us. But we implore your immeasurable kindness to grant those who endure this time of conversion the possessions of celestial joys.

text: Multae sunt aversiones nostrae quibus impediti a te recessimus nec oculos ad caelum sublevare audemus. Sed tu qui inspicis nos deiici conscientia nostra alleva nos miseratione gratuita ut hoc sacrificium pro delictis nostris miseratus accipiens ab omni nos crimine propitiatus emundes.
translation_en: We have many turned-aways whereby we, hindered by you, have withdrawn; neither dare we lift our eyes to heaven. But you who, with divine foresight, behold us falling, alleviate our conscience with free mercy so that this sacrifice, moved by your compassion and receiving it for our sins, may cleanse us from all crime and make propitiation for us.

text: Multae sunt Domine consolationes tuae quarum ope laetifices nos positos in maerore. Preces nostras quia pius es placatus attende et hoc sacrificium quod pro famulis tuis illis corde contritis et in angustiis positis tibi omnipotenti Deo offerimus propitius acceptare digneris Intret eorum gemitus in tuas sacras aures et da eis in tribulatione auxilium tuum per quod ad laetitiam perveniant sempiternam maesti eorum ammi.
translation_en: There are many consolations of yours, Lord, by which you cheer us up placed in sorrow. Attend to our prayers, since you are merciful, and grant that this sacrifice we offer for your servants, who are contrite of heart and in affliction before the almighty God, may be graciously accepted. May their groans enter into your sacred ears and give them help in tribulation, through which they may come to everlasting joy, comforting the sorrowful ones.

text: Multiplica Domine benedictionem tuam et per spiritum tui muneris fidem nostram corrobora ut qui in haec fluenta descenderint eos in libro vitae adscribi iubeas in regnum tibi Deo patri in resurrectione tradendos.
translation_en: Multiply, Lord, Your blessing and strengthen our faith through the workings of Your Spirit, so that those who have descended upon these flowing waters, you may command to be written in the Book of Life, to be given into Your kingdom, the God the Father, at the Resurrection.

text: Multiplica Domine benedictiones tuas super populum tuum et quem sancti tui Marcelli confessoris praesentibus consolaris officiis beneficiorum tuorum largitate prosequere ut donis caelestibus se gaudeat subsidiis adiuvari.
translation_en: Lord, multiply your blessings upon your people, and may those present be comforted by the services of your blessings through the generosity of your gifts, so that they may rejoice in being aided by heavenly gifts.

text: Multiplica Domine quaesumus in Ecclesia tua spiritum gratiae quem dedisti ut per dignum pontificis institutum crescat tuorum devotio sancta fidelium.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, in your Church a multiplication of the Spirit of grace that you have given, so that through the worthy institution of the pontiff, the holy devotion of your faithful may grow.

text: Multiplica Domine quaesumus per haec sancta quae sumpsimus veritatem tuam in animabus nostris ut te in templo sancto iugiter adoremus et in conspectu tuo cum sanctis angelis gloriemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to multiply within us through these holy things we have received, your truth, that we may continually worship you in the holy temple and glory in your presence with the holy angels.

text: Multiplica Domine super animas famulorum famularumque tuarum misericordiam tuam et quibus donasti baptismi sacramentum da eis aeternorum plenitudinem gaudiorum.
translation_en: Lord, multiply upon the souls of your servants and handmaids your mercy, and to those whom you have given the sacrament of baptism, grant them the fullness of eternal joys.

text: Subdiaconus cum ordinatur
translation_en: When the subdeacon is ordained

text: Multiplica fidem quaesumus Domine populi tui ut cuius per te sumpsit initium per te consequatur augmentum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to multiply the faith of your people so that whoever has taken their beginning through you may also acquire an increase through you.

text: Multiplica nos Domine humilitatis dono et caritatis studio ut viventes in pace fructum tibi exhibeamus iustitiae.
translation_en: Multiply us, O Lord, with the gift of humility and the study of charity, that we who live in peace may offer to You the fruit of justice.

text: Multiplica quaesumus Domine benedictionem tuam super populum tuum et quos sancti martyris tui Sebastiani frequentibus consolaris officiis beneficiorum tuorum largitate prosequere ut et donis caelestibus erudiri et competentibus se gaudeant subsidiis adiuvari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to multiply your blessing upon your people and those whom you comfort with the frequent services of your martyr Saint Sebastian. May the bounties of your gifts follow, so that they are enlightened by celestial gifts and supported by appropriate aid.

text: Multiplicatis gaudiis plebs tua Domine repleta proficiat et eorum fulta praesidiis quorum natalicia celebrat quod temporaliter devota sectatur aeternum consequi mereatur.
translation_en: May your people, Lord, overflowing with joy, progress and be filled by those for whom they celebrate the natalities. May they be richly protected by their guardians, so that, though temporarily devoted, they may deserve to achieve the eternal.

text: Multiplices Domine incursus quos mundus ingerit tu repelle ut haec dona caelestia tranquillis cogitationibus capere va eamus.
translation_en: Lord, repel the many attacks that the world brings upon us, so that we may peacefully receive these celestial gifts. Let us go hence.

text: Multis coram te Deus pater exsultantes in laudibus confessoris tui Martini hodierno die obitus memoriam facimus doctrinae recolimus operum memoramus qui licet totum vitae suae cursum gloriosa decoraverit pace finem tamen ineffabili caritatis bono reddidit et probabilem et illustrem cum vicinum sui cernens terminum finis pacem inter se discordantibus restituit clericis quo ad aeternam continuo vocaturus hereditatem exemplo domini tenendam suis pacem discipulis commendaret.
translation_en: On this day we make the memory of God, Father, before many confessor Martin's departure from life. We recall his teaching, remember his works, who although he had glorified the entire course of his life with peace, yet at the end gave an inexpressible good of love and made a peaceful end probable and illustrious by reconciling his neighbors. He restored peace among quarreling clerics, whom he was constantly calling to eternal life. By his example, he commended the heritage of peace for his disciples to keep.

text: Munda nos Domine sacrificii praesentis effectu et perfice miseratus in nobis ut eius mereamur esse participes.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, by the effectiveness of this sacrifice and complete your mercy upon us, that we may deserve to be participants in it.

text: Munda nos ipse quaesumus Deus ab iniquitatibus nostris per intercessionem beatorum tuorum Romedii et sociorum eius ut et te veneremur et a nostris reatibus absolvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, God, to cleanse us from our sins through the intercession of your blessed ones Romedius and his companions, so that we may worship you and be forgiven from our offenses.

text: Mundet et muniat nos quaesumus Domine divini sacramenti munus oblatum et intercedente beata virgine Dei Genitrice Maria cum beatis apostolis tuis Petro et Paulo et omnibus sanctis a cunctis nos reddat et perversitatibus expiatos et adversitatibus expeditos.
translation_en: Wash and arm us, we pray Thee, Lord, with the gift of Thy divine sacrament offered. Through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, together with Thy holy apostles Peter and Paul, and all saints, may they deliver us from all dangers, make us free from sin and equipped to face adversities.

text: Munera divina quaesumus Domine resurrectio unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi in nobis dignanter compleat et complendo beatae Mariae semper virginis precibus nos in melius deducat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the divine gifts may graciously complete the resurrection of your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in us. And as it is completed, may it lead us through the prayers of the Blessed Virgin Mary, ever virgin, to a better state.

text: Munera Domine altari tuo superposita dextera potentiae tuae admittat quae hodie concipiendum sanctum Ioannem angelico praenuntiavit oraculo.
translation_en: Lord, may your gifts be placed on your altar by the power of your right hand, that which today was announced by the angelic message to conceive Saint John.

text: Munera Domine maiestati tuae oblata sanctifica et beati Germani confessoris tui intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus mereamur absolvi peccatis et sanctorum sociari consortiis.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings made to Your majesty be sanctified, and through the merits of blessed Germanus, Your confessor, we may deserve to be freed from all sins and to share in the fellowship of the saints.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica nosque a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, grant that what we offer you may be sanctified, and cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente beato Georgio martyre tuo nos per haec a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, may these offerings you receive be sanctified, and through the intercession of the blessed George, your martyr, purify us from the stains of our sins.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica et animam famuli tui illius a peccatorum suorum maculis emunda et perpetuae vitae fac esse participem.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings be sanctified by You, and cleanse the soul of Your servant from the stains of his sins, and make him a participant in eternal life.

text: Munera Domine oblata sanctifica ut tui nobis unigeniti corpus et sanguis fiant.
translation_en: Lord, grant that the offerings presented may be sanctified, so that your only-begotten Son's body and blood become ours.

text: Munera Domine quaesumus oblata sanctifica ut et nobis unigeniti tui corpus et sanguis fiant et illi regi ad obtinendam animae corporisque salutem et (ad) peragendum iniunctum (sibi) officium te largiente usquequaque proficiant.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify the offerings given, so that for us and your only-begotten Son, both his body and blood may become. May they who rule help to achieve salvation of soul and body through you, and as you generously provide, let them progress in the duties assigned to them.

text: Munera Domine praesentis sacrificii quae tibi offerimus in honorem sanctae Katharinae virginis fiant nobis eius precibus vita perpetua et te donante salus infinita.
translation_en: Lord, may the gifts we present at this sacrifice be for us through the intercession of Saint Catherine, the Virgin, a life everlasting and salvation infinite, given by you.

text: Munera Domine pro sanctae illius martyris tuae cuius festa celebramus commemoratione oblata illius meritis tibi reddantur accepta.
translation_en: Gifts, Lord, for the holy martyr of yours whom we celebrate today, may be offered in commemoration. Through his merits, may they be returned to you when accepted.

text: Munera Domine quae in sancti Oswaldi commemoratione tuae maiestati offerimus benignus assume.
translation_en: Lord, we offer to Your majesty the gifts that we present on the commemoration of Saint Oswald. Accept them graciously.

text: Munera Domine quae nomini tuo pro sollemnitate sanctarum virginum illarum offerimus earum precibus tibi grata fieri suppliciter exoramus.
translation_en: Gifts, Lord, which we offer to Your name for the solemnity of those holy virgins, we humbly entreat that they may be pleasing to You through their prayers.

text: Munera Domine quae pro apostolorum tuorum Philippi et Iacobi sollemnitate deferimus propitius suscipe et mala omnia quae meremur averte.
translation_en: Lord, we offer the gifts that are brought for the solemnity of your apostles Philip and James. Graciously receive them and turn away all evil that we deserve.

text: Munera Domine quae pro omnium sanctorum tuorum veneratione tibi devote deferimus propitius suscipe et illorum suffragantibus meritis nos per haec a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, we offer you the gifts in honor of all your saints, graciously receive them. Through their intercessions, cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Munera Domine quae tibi ob honorem sanctorum martyrum tuorum Eustachii sociorumque eius offerimus dignanter assume et eorum meritis proficua nobis esse concede.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly offer to You the gifts in honor of Your holy martyrs Eustachius and his companions. Graciously accept them and grant that through their merits, they may be beneficial for us.

text: Munera Domine quaesumus oblata sanctifica et corda nostra Sancti Spiritus illustratione emunda.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify the offerings presented and cleanse our hearts through the enlightenment of the Holy Spirit.

text: Munera Domine quaesumus oblata sanctifica et per haec famulos tuos rem publicam gubernantes a cunctis defende periculis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify the gifts offered and through these, protect your servants as they govern the commonwealth, defend them from all dangers.

text: Munera Domine quaesumus offerentes ut et ab omnibus mundare peccatis et a cunctis nos protegere digneris adversis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that as we offer these gifts, you may deign to cleanse us from all sins and protect us from all adversities by all.

text: Munera Domine quaesumus pro tuorum commemoratione sanctorum Timothei et Apollinaris sollemniter oblata propitius suscipe et pia eorum intercessione ad salutem nobis perpetuam provenire concede.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the gifts offered on behalf of the remembrance of Saints Timothy and Apollinaris be accepted graciously. And through their pious intercession, may it bring eternal salvation to us.

text: Munera Domine quaesumus quae pro nostra simul et patris nostri famuli tui illius redemptione tuae maiestatis oculis offerimus placatus suscipe et ad perpetuam nobis omnibus tribue provenire salutem.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you present the gifts which, for our sake and that of your servant our father, were offered to your majesty through your redemption. Receive them graciously and grant us all eternal salvation to flow from it.

text: Munera Domine tibi dicata quaesumus sanctifica et per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the offerings dedicated to you, and through them may we be found pleasing.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine tibi dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato Pancratio martyre tuo per eadem nos placatus intende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the offerings dedicated to you. And through the intercession of your blessed martyr, Saint Pancras, we pray that, being pleased with us, you may attend to us.

text: Munera Domine tuae caritatis quae pro beati pontificis tui Thomae translatione suscepimus de morte translati ad vitam stolam nobis immortalitatis acquirant.
translation_en: Gifts of Your loving kindness, which we received for the translation of your blessed pope Thomas from death to life, grant us a robe of eternal life.

text: Munera Domine tuae glorificationis offerimus quae tibi pro nostris grata ieiuniis eorum quaesumus deprecatio quorum sollemnia celebramus efficiat.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the gifts of your glory's recognition, which we present to you in gratitude for their solemn fasts, for which we humbly ask that the supplication of these may be effective.

text: Munera Domine tuae glorificationis offerimus quae tibi pro nostris grata ieiuniis sanctorum apostolorum quaesumus deprecatio quorum sollemnia praevenimus efficiat.
translation_en: We offer, Lord, your gifts of glory-giving, which we present to you in gratitude for our fasting on behalf of the holy apostles. We humbly ask that their solemnities may be effectively preceded (or observed).

text: Munera Domine tuae maiestati oblata sanctorum martyrum tuorum Xysti Felicissimi et Agapiti quaesumus interventu nobis ad salutem proficere sentiamus aeternam.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that the offerings made to Your majesty in honor of Your saintly martyrs Xystus, Felicissimus, and Agapitus, may by their intervention bring us to salvation. May we feel an eternal sense of this.

text: Munera familiae tuae Domine propitius respice et intercedente beato Petro a cunctis eam adversitatibus defende.
translation_en: Lord, graciously look upon the offerings of your family and through the intercession of blessed Peter defend them from all adversities.

text: Munera haec Domine altari tuo superposita beatus Adrianus tibi gratificet qui pro te moriendo viva et sancta factus est hostia.
translation_en: These gifts, Lord, placed on your altar, blessed Adrian will satisfy you, who, while living and holy, was made a sacrifice for you after dying.

text: Munera haec pietati tuae clementissime Pater venerandi pontificis et confessoris tui Syri amore oblata quaesumus ut ipsius obtentu et tuae maiestati fiant acceptabilia et nostrae fragilitati salutaria efficiantur munimina.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your most compassionate Father, the venerable pontiff and confessor Syri, that these offerings given to Your piety with our love may be acceptable before Your majesty, and may these defenses become beneficial for our frailty.

text: Munera haec pro unione populi christiani tibi Domine oblata sanctifica per quae unitatis et pacis in Ecclesia tua nobis dona concedas.
translation_en: These gifts offered for the union of the Christian people, Lord, may you sanctify them. Through these, grant us the gifts of unity and peace in your Church.

text: Munera haec quaesumus Domine dignanter suscipiens sanctifica et famulo tuo regi nostro suisque omnibus perfice profutura.
translation_en: Graciously receive, Lord, these gifts that we ask of You. Sanctify and may they be beneficial to Your servant, our king, and to all others.

text: Munera haec tuae oblata maiestati quaesumus Domine ut per intercessionem martyrum tuorum Gereonis Victoris Cassii atque Florentii nos a peccatorum nostrorum vinculis expurgent.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to accept these offerings presented to Your majesty. Through the intercession of Your martyrs Geronius, Victor, Cassian, and Florian, may we be purified from the bonds of our sins.

text: Munera humilitatis nostrae Domine quae pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum Hermachorae et Fortunati gloriosa passione et sollemnitate offerimus quaesumus propitius respicere dignare et ipsorum intercessione tam ad profectum vitae quam animae salutaria nobis consueta miseratione provenire concede.
translation_en: Lord, we offer the gifts of our humility for the glorious passion and solemnity of your holy martyrs Hermachorae and Fortunati. We humbly ask that you look upon us favorably and grant us, through their usual merciful providence for both life's journey and the salvation of our souls, to come forth.

text: Munera maiestati tuae oblata quaesumus Domine gratanter assume et intercessione beatae Barbarae martyris tuae tribue nos redemptione gaudere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously accept the offerings given to your majesty. And through the intercession of the blessed Barbara, your martyr, may we rejoice in redemption.

text: Munera nomini tuo Domine cum gratiarum actione deferimus qui nos ab infestis hostibus liberatos paschale sacramentum secura tribuisti mente suscipere.
translation_en: We offer gifts to Your name, Lord, with an act of thanks, who have freed us from hostile enemies and granted us to receive the Paschal sacrament securely in a peaceful mind.

text: Munera nos Domine quaesumus oblata purificent et te nobis iugiter faciant esse placatum.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly beseech you, that the offerings be purified and may they always make us pleasing to You.

text: Munera nos Domine quaesumus oblata purificent nostrosque in via mandatorum tuorum dirigant gressus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we entreat, that the offerings presented may purify us, and direct our steps on the path of your commandments.

text: Munera nostra Domine beatorum martyrum tuorum illorum fiant tibi grata suffragiis ut quod pro illorum gloria celebramus ipsorum meritis nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: May our gifts, Lord, to your blessed martyrs become pleasing supplications for you, so that what we celebrate for their glory, through their merits, may benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Munera nostra Domine quaesumus apud clementiam tuam beati Magni confessoris tui commendet oratio ut tuae maiestati sint accepta et nobis supplicibus tuis prosint ad veniam.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that our offerings may be recommended before your mercy through the intercession of your blessed Confessor, St. Maurice, so that they may be accepted by your majesty and benefit us, your suppliants, with forgiveness.

text: Munera nostra Domine quaesumus meritis et intercessionibus munifici confessoris tui Osmundi sanctifica ut in Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi corpus et sanguinem convertantur et ad nostrarum proficiant salutem animarum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your generous confessor Osmund's merits and intercessions sanctify our gifts, so that in the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, they may be transformed for the salvation of our souls.

text: Munera nostra Domine quaesumus nativitatis hodiernae mysteriis apta proveniant ut sicut homo genitus idem praefulsit et Deus sic nobis haec terrena substantia conferat quod divinum est.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that our gifts today may be suitable for the mysteries of the nativity, so that just as man was born and shone forth, likewise may this earthly substance be granted to us, that what is divine may become ours.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine nativitatis hodiernae mysteriis apta proveniant ut sicut homo genitus idem refulsit Deus sic nobis haec terrena substantia conferat quod divinum est.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that our gifts may be fitting for today's mysteries of the nativity, so that just as man was born and God shone forth, so may this earthly substance bestow upon us what is divine.

text: Munera nostra Domine sancte quaesumus dignanter assume quae cum illorum sanctorum tuorum commemoratione sint grata.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you graciously accept our offerings, which, in remembrance of your holy saints, may be pleasing to you.

text: Munera nostra Domine Sancti Spiritus sacrentur adventu per quem a peccatis omnibus absoluti adoptionis tuae filii renascentur.
translation_en: Our gifts, Lord Holy Spirit, may be sanctified by your coming, through whom we are absolved from all sins and the sons of your adoption are reborn.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine Sancti Spiritus tui dignatione sacrentur per quem et a peccatis omnibus absolvantur et adoptionis tuae filii renascantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your Holy Spirit may consecrate our offerings through whom we are forgiven of all sins and reborn as children of your adoption.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine beatae Mariae Magdalenae gloriosa merita tibi reddant accepta cuius oblationis obsequium unigenitus Filius tuus clementer suscepit impensum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the merits of our offerings may be presented to you by the glorious Blessed Mary Magdalene. May her obedience to her offering be accepted graciously by your only-begotten Son, Jesus Christ.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine gratanter assume et per interventionem beatae Priscae virginis tuae et martyris omnium nostrum corda ad cultum verae religionis converte.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to graciously receive our offerings. Through the intercession of your virgin and martyr, Blessed Priscilla, may all our hearts be turned towards the true worship.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine in honorem sancti Edwardi martyris tui oblata clementi respectu intuere et ipsis nos mente purifica quibus tibi debitum exhibemus famulatum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our offerings be presented to your honor for the veneration of Saint Edward the Martyr. We pray that you look upon them with mercy and purify our minds as we present ourselves in service to you.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine placatus assume et beati illius martyris tui atque pontificis suffragio a cunctis nos nexibus peccatorum propitiatus absolve.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you accept our offerings with pleasure and through the intercession of your blessed martyr and bishop, may we be absolved by all from every bond of sin.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine propitiatus assume et ut digne tuis famulemur altaribus sancti tui nos Hermetis intercessione custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your favor may accept our offerings. May we serve worthy at your holy altars, protected by the intercession of Hermetes.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine quae pro beatorum confessorum tuorum atque pontificum illorum tuo nomini offeruntur natalitiis ipsorum digna perficiantur et meritis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the gifts we offer on the natalities of your blessed confessors and bishops may be worthy of them and accomplished through their merits.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine sancti illius et confessio veneranda et beata commendet oratio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may our offerings be commended by the prayers of that holy and blessed confession.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine sereno intuitu suscipe ut sancto Chrysogono intercedente criminum nostrorum contagia expurgem.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that You receive our offerings with a clear gaze. May you, through the intercession of Saint Chrysogonus, purge us from the contagion of our sins.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine suscipe placatus et famulum tuum illum abbatem nostrum gregemque sibi commissum benignus semper et ubique misericorditer protege.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive our offerings, pleased and blessed, and may your servant, our abbot, and the flock entrusted to him always and everywhere be kindly protected with merciful care.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus gratanter suscipe clementissime Deus et intervenientibus gloriosis virginibus in hac basilica carne quiescentibus universas vitiorum maculas a nobis expelle atque sempiternae felicitatis gaudia concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask, most merciful God, that you graciously receive our offerings and, through the intercession of the glorious virgins present in this basilica, expel all stains of sin from us, and grant us everlasting happiness.

text: Munera nostra tibi Domine sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae commendet oratio quam etsi pro condicione carnis migrasse cognoscimus in caelesti tamen gloria pro nobis apud te orare sentiamus.
translation_en: Our gifts, Lord, to the holy Mother of God, Mary, we commit to You through prayer. Although we know that according to the condition of our flesh we have departed into heavenly glory, yet we feel that she is praying for us before You in heaven.

text: Munera nostrae devotionis quae in beati Hieronymi confessoris tui festivitate tuae maiestati omnipotens Deus deferimus eius quaesumus intervenientibus meritis nos perpetua protectione muniant.
translation_en: We offer our gifts of devotion, which we bring on the feast day of your blessed confessor Jerome, most powerful God. We humbly ask that through his merits, you grant us eternal protection.

text: Munera nostrae devotionis quaesumus Domine propitius respice et ad salutem nostram provenire concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you graciously look upon our offerings of devotion and grant us health as a result.

text: Munera nostrae oblationis quaesumus Domine placatus suscipe quae ut nobis patientiae bonum condonare digneris maiestati tuae devota offerimus actione.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, pleased by our offering, to receive what we offer to you. May your majesty deem it worthy of grace to grant us patience as good. We dedicate these gifts to you in devout action.

text: Munera nostrae redemptionis quaesumus omnipotens Deus quae fideliter sumpsimus et a vitiorum nos eruant sepulcris et ad gloriam transferant beatae resurrectionis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to bestow upon us the fruits of our redemption. May these graces deliver us faithfully from the bonds of sin and transport us to the glory of the blessed resurrection.

text: Munera plebis tuae Domine quaesumus beatorum apostolorum fiant grata suffragiis ut pro quorum triumphis tuo nomini deferuntur ipsorum digna perficiantur et meritis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the gifts of your people become pleasing through the prayers of the blessed apostles. May they be accomplished for the sake of their triumphs, and may they be fulfilled worthy of their merits.

text: Munera plebis tuae quaesumus Domine laetanter offerimus quae in honorem nominis tui et sanctae Agnetis nobis remedia sempiterna dignanter impendant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept the gifts of your people that we may joyfully offer them. May they be bestowed as eternal remedies in honor of your name and Saint Agnes.

text: Munera populi tui Domine clementer assume ut qui primum unigeniti Filii tui adventum tripudianter celebrare desiderant in secundo cum venerit aeternae vitae remedia percipere mereantur.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive the offerings of your people, so that those who long to joyfully celebrate the first coming of your only-begotten Son may deserve to receive the remedies of eternal life when he comes a second time.

text: Munera populi tui Domine placabilis dextera suscipiat ut sanctae Helenae reginae suffragantibus meritis devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: May the offering of your people, Lord, be accepted by your gracious right hand, so that through the merits of Saint Helen, queen, our devotion may progress and we may attain salvation.

text: Munera populi tui Domine propitiatus intende et beati baptistae Ioannis cuius nos tribuis praeire sollemnia fac gaudere suffragiis.
translation_en: Lord, turn your favor towards the offerings of your people and let the blessed John Baptist, whom we are entrusted to precede in solemnities, rejoice with our prayers.

text: Munera populi tui Domine quaesumus dignanter assume ut quod in honorem sanctorum tuorum illorum venerabiliter exsequuntur suae hoc sentiant saluti magis magisque proficere.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you graciously accept the offerings of your people, so that what they reverently carry out in honor of your saints may more and more prosper for their salvation.

text: Munera populi tui omnipotens Deus quae tibi in hac beatissimi martyris tui baptistae Ioannis festivitate deferimus quaesumus propitiatus intende ut perfecte huius sacrificii sanctificatione purgati nostrorum a te mereamur consequi veniam delictorum.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, to accept the offerings of your people which we bring on this feast day of your blessed martyr, St. John the Baptist. We humbly ask that, propitiated, you direct your attention so that we may worthy merit forgiveness of our sins through the perfect purification of this sacrifice and its sanctification.

text: Munera praesentis hostiae quae offerimus maiestati tuae gratanter suscipe Deus clementissime et suffragante sacra virgine Ethelburga cuius annua recolimus natalitia per ea nos perducere digneris ad sempiterna gaudia.
translation_en: Graciously accept, O most merciful God, the gifts of this present offering that we offer to your majesty. May it be through the intercession of the sacred virgin Ethelburga, whose annual natalities we commemorate, that you deem us worthy to be led to eternal joys.

text: Munera quae deferimus Domine benignus assume ut qui a nostris impedimur offensis apostolorum tuorum precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Lord, graciously accept the offerings we bring, so that through the prayers of your apostles, we may be helped against the obstacles imposed by our enemies.

text: Munera quae tibi Domine pro sancti Marci confessoris tui atque pontificis commemoratione deferimus quaesumus ut eius obtentu nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: The gifts which we offer to you, Lord, on the commemoration of your confessed saint and bishop Saint Martin, we humbly ask that they may benefit us for our salvation through his intercession.

text: Munera quae tuae deferimus maiestati quaesumus Domine gratanter assume et intercessione sancti Laurentii archiepiscopi tribue nos salutari redemptione gaudere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously accept the offerings we bring before your majesty. Through the intercession of Saint Lawrence, archbishop, may we rejoice in a saving redemption.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine benigno suscipe intuitu quae in honorem sanctae Margarethae virginis tuae deferimus et concede ut eius interventu nobis fiant salutaria.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously receive the offerings we bring for the honor of your virgin Saint Margaret, and grant that through her intervention they may be beneficial to us.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine famulae et sacratae tuae illius quae tibi ob consecrationem sui corporis offert simul ad eius animae medelam proficiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant blessings upon your servant and the sacred one who offers her body to you in consecration. May these gifts also bring healing to her soul.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine famulorum tuorum dignanter suscipe et quos desiderio aeternae beatitudinis a mundano segregasti proposito etiam a delectatione carnali et ab omnibus antiqui hostis insidiis potenter eripe.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously receive the offerings of your servants and those whom you have separated from worldly concerns by the desire for eternal beatitude, also from carnal delight and every trap set by the ancient enemy. Protect them powerfully.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine nostra tibi complaceant pro quibus tui tibi supplicant Innocentes.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, may our offerings please you on behalf of those who plead to you as innocents.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente beata Ositha martyre tua ab omni nos culparum labe purifica.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to bless the offerings presented and, through the intercession of Blessed Ositha, your martyr, purify us from all stain of sin.

text: Sursum corda
translation_en: Lift up your hearts

text: Munera quaesumus Domine oblata sanctifica et propitius esto omnibus invocantibus te in veritate ut in adventu Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi cum omnibus sanctis tuis tibi placitis actibus praesentemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the offerings presented and be gracious towards all who call upon you in truth, so that on the coming of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, with all your saints, we may appear to you pleasing through acceptable deeds.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine quae in beatae Euphemiae celebritate deferimus ita gratiae tuae efficiantur accepta sicut eius tibi placitum exstitit passionis certamen.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings we bring in the festivity of Saint Euphemia may be made effective by your grace, just as her struggle of passion pleased you.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine quae in beati Mauritii festis deferimus ita sint tibi semper accepta sicut eius effusio sanguinis in conspectu gloriae tuae facta est pretiosa.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings we bring during the feast of Saint Maurice may always be acceptable to you, just as his outpouring of blood before your glory became precious.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine quae oculis tuae maiestatis in hoc altari proposita offerimus beati Quirici martyris supplicationibus propitiatus assume.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept the offerings presented on this altar, which were set before your majesty's eyes for the intercession of the blessed Quiricus the martyr.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine quae pro nostra et omnium quorum recolimus memoriam redemptione oculis tuae offerimus maiestatis placatus suscipe et ad perpetuam nobis omnibus tribue provenire salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to present the gifts that we offer with our remembrance for ourselves and all whose memory we hold dear, by Your redeeming eyes. Accept them as a pleasing offering to Your majesty, and grant us everlasting salvation.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine quae tibi pro anima famuli tui illius offerimus placatus intende ut remediis purgata caelestibus in tua pietate requiescat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to direct your favor towards the gifts that we present on behalf of your servant's soul. May they be cleansed by heavenly remedies and find rest in your mercy.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine quae tibi pro requie animarum famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium in Christo quiescentium offerimus ad earum redemptionem proficiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to present the gifts that we offer to you on behalf of all the souls of your servants and their servants who are resting in Christ. May these gifts aid in their redemption.

text: Suscipe Domine anima servi tui illius quam de ergastulo
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the soul of your servant from the prison

text: Munera quaesumus Domine pro tuorum veneratione sanctorum quorum festa celebramus devota nobis proficiant et ut quod offerimus gratum sit placatus impende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to bestow upon us the blessings of your saints whose feast we celebrate today. May these blessings be profitable for our devotion and may what we offer please you, so that you might be appeased.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine sacris altaribus superposita ob honorem sanctorum tuorum Stephani Gamalielis Nicodemi atque Abibon quorum inventionem colimus sanctifica et praesta ut illis ad honorem nobis quoque proveniant ad salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings be placed on your holy altars in honor of your saints Stephen, Gamaliel, Nicodemus, and Abibo whose discovery we celebrate. Sanctify them and grant that they may come to our benefit as well, for our honor, and lead us all to salvation.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine tuae maiestati oblata per intercessionem beati Machuti confessoris tui atque pontificis ad perpetuam nobis tribue proficere salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the offerings presented to Your majesty through the intercession of your confessed and bishop, Blessed Machutus, may always bring us salvation.

text: Munera quaesumus Domine tuae plebis propitiatus assume ut quae fidei pietate profitentur sacramentis caelestibus apprehendant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your mercy be extended to your people. May they who benefit from the faith and devotion receive the heavenly sacraments.

text: Munera sacrificii nostri quaesumus omnipotens Deus in corpus et sanguinem Filii tui converte quem divinissimus Gabriel archangelus de beata Maria virgine nuntiavit nasciturum Salvatorem mundi.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, almighty God, to change the offerings of our sacrifice into the body and blood of Your Son, whom the most divine Gabriel, the archangel, announced would be born from the Blessed Virgin Mary as the Savior of the world.

text: Munera supplices Domine tuis altaribus adhibemus quantum de nostro merito formidantes tantum beati Petri et Pauli pro quorum sollemnibus offeruntur intercessione confisi.
translation_en: We humbly present your gifts, Lord, to your altars, as much as we are able from our own merit, fearing the saints Peter and Paul, for whom their solemn offerings are presented with confidence through their intercession.

text: Munera supplices Domine tuis altaribus adhibemus ut quantum de nostro merito sumus formidantes tantum beatorum Petri et Pauli pro quorum sollemnitatibus offeruntur intercessione gloriemur salvandi.
translation_en: With humble supplications, Lord, we present our gifts to your altars, that, fearing what we deserve from our merits, we may be glorified by the intercession of blessed Peter and Paul, for whose solemnities these offerings are made, so that we may be saved.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicanda meritis beatae illius virginis tuae placatus intende et eius salutari deprecatione nosmetipsos sanctificare dignare.
translation_en: Lord, gifts to be given to you are due to the merits of that blessed virgin of yours. Being pleased with her, direct your attention and deem it worthy to sanctify us ourselves through her saving intercession.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicanda sanctifica et his animas famulorum et sacerdotum tuorum illorum ab omni labe condicionis humanae absolve quibus totius mundi delevisti peccata.
translation_en: Gifts to you, Lord, are to be given and sanctified, and may the souls of your servants, both laypeople and clergy, be absolved from all stain of human condition by whom you have cleansed the sins of the whole world.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicata sanctifica et intercedente beato Francisco ab omni nos culparum labe purifica.
translation_en: Lord, may the offerings dedicated to You be sanctified; and through the intercession of blessed Francis, purify us from all guilt of sin.

text: Munera tibi Domine dicata sanctifica ut meritis beati Dominici confessoris tui nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Offerings, Lord, consecrated to you, sanctify them so that the merits of your blessed confesor may benefit us with healing.

text: Munera tibi Domine laetantes offerimus quae beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli nataliciis nobis intercessionibus confidimus profutura.
translation_en: We joyfully offer to You, Lord, the gifts which we trust will prove beneficial for us through the intercessions of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul on their feast days.

text: Munera tibi Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus quae et pro tuorum tibi beata sint honore iustorum et nobis salutaria te miserante reddantur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the gifts of our devotedness, which may for Your blessed ones be honorable through the justice of the righteous, and may be beneficial for us as You mercifully grant them.

text: Munera Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus ut tibi grata et nobis salutaria beatae Elisabeth pia supplicatione reddantur.
translation_en: We present our gifts, O Lord, as an offering of our devotion, that through the pious supplications of blessed Elizabeth they may be pleasing to You and beneficial for us.

text: Munera tibi Domine nostrae devotionis offerimus quibus ut tuo sint grata conspectui beatae Mariae semper virginis omniumque ordinum angelorum atque omnium sanctorum quaesumus intercessionibus adiuvari semper et ubique mereamur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, our gifts of devotion, may they be pleasing to the sight of the blessed Virgin Mary, ever virgin, and all orders of angels and all saints. We humbly ask to be aided always and everywhere by their intercessions.

text: Munera tibi Domine nostrae servitutis offerimus in beatae Otiliae virginis sollemnitate suppliciter deprecantes ut qui ei gratiam Sancti Spiritus contulisti eandem cordibus nostris clementer infundas eius meritis gloriosis.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the gifts of our humble service on the solemnity of Blessed Otilia's Virginity, humbly entreating that You who bestowed grace upon her with the Holy Spirit, may likewise pour down the same mercy upon our hearts through her glorious merits.

text: Munera tibi Domine pro sanctae Felicitatis gloriosa commemoratione deferimus quae nobis huius sollemnitatis effectum et confessione dedicavit et sanguine.
translation_en: We offer gifts to You, Lord, in memory of the glorious celebration of Saint Felicity. This solemnity has been accomplished and dedicated for us by her confession and blood.

text: Munera tibi Domine pro sanctorum martyrum Abdon et Sennen occisione deferimus qui dum finiuntur in terris facti sunt caelesti luce perpetui.
translation_en: We offer gifts to You, Lord, for the martyrdom of Saints Abdon and Sennen. While they were ending their lives on earth, they became lights of eternal light in heaven.

text: Munera tibi Domine pro sancti martyris Agapiti passione deferimus qui dum finitur in terris factus est caelesti sede perpetuus.
translation_en: We offer gifts to you, Lord, on behalf of the holy martyr Agapitus, who, when his earthly life was ending, became a permanent resident of heaven.

text: Munera tibi quaesumus Domine oblata sanctifica et intercedente pro nobis beato Rocho confessore tuo per haec omnes scelerum nostrorum placatus maculas absterge et sanitatem corporis et animae nobis tribue.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the offerings presented to you, and through the intercession of your blessed confessor Saint Roche, may all the stains of our sins be washed away, and grant us health of body and soul.

text: Munera tua Deus institutor illustra et per has hostias quibus te placari voluisti sanctifica misericors immolantes.
translation_en: Your gifts, O God, the Creator, enlighten and through these hosts that you desired to be appeased, may the merciful sacrificers sanctify with mercy.

text: Munera tua quae in honorem nominis tui in sollemnitate iterata Ioannis Baptistae praecursoris Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi sumpta sunt quaesumus omnipotens Deus praestent auxilium Ecclesiae tuae ut expiata ab omni immissione insidiatoris te benedicat tibi serviat et te protegente ab omnibus malis semper sit libera.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, that the offerings made in honor of your name on the feast of John the Baptist, the precursor of your Son our Lord Jesus Christ, be presented. Grant aid to your Church, so that it may always be freed from every ambush of the enemy and bless, serve, and protect you with unwavering devotion.

text: Munera tuae maiestati Domine suppliciter immolata sanctorum martyrum tuorum Dionysii Rustici et Eleutherii quaesumus interventu nobis ad salutem proficere sentiamus aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly offer Your majesty, Lord, the merits of Your saints, Dionysius and Rusticus, and Eleutherius. We beseech You to help us for our salvation through their intervention. May we feel eternal salvation from this.

text: Munera tuae misericors Deus maiestati oblata benigno quaesumus suscipe intuitu ut eorum nobis precibus fiant salutaria quorum sacratissimae in hac basilica reliquiae reconduntur.
translation_en: Merciful God, we humbly ask that You receive the offerings presented to Your majesty. May You look upon them so that through their prayers, those whose most sacred relics are enshrined in this basilica, become beneficial for us.

text: Munera tuae maiestati misericors Deus oblata benigno quaesumus suscipe intuitu ut beati Francisci nobis precibus fiant salutaria cuius sacratissimam nostris mysteriis quamvis indigni colimus festivitatem.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, merciful God, to receive the offerings made to Your majesty. May they be accepted with a benevolent gaze, so that through the prayers of blessed Francis, they become beneficial for us. We who are unworthy, celebrate the most sacred festivity within our mysteries.

text: Munera tuae pietati dicanda quaesumus Domine meritis beatae virginis tuae Edburgae placatus intende et eius salutaribus nos attolle suffragiis et defende praesidiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to offer your merits to the devotion of your blessed virgin Edburga. Gratified by her merits, incline and lift us up with her saving intercessions, and protect us with her guardianship.

text: Munera tuae pietati oblata sanctifica quaesumus Domine et gehennales cruciatus quos pro piaculis digne nostris meremur per unigeniti Christi Filii tui imaginis passionem a nobis procul pelle propitius.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to sanctify the offerings made to Your mercy. May the torments of hell that we deserve for our sins be far from us through the suffering of Your only-begotten Son, Jesus Christ.

text: Muneribus divinis perceptis quaesumus Domine ut devotionem famuli tui illius confirmes in bono et mittas ei auxilium de sancto et de Sion tuearis eum.
translation_en: Having received the divine offerings, we humbly ask you, Lord, to strengthen the devotion of your servant in good works and send him help from the holy and protect him from Zion.

text: Muneribus Domine te magnificamus oblatis quibus in sanctae nobis sollemnitatibus Euphemiae et gaudia superna concilies et patrocinia sempiterna largiaris.
translation_en: Lord, we magnify you with the offerings we bring, which unite us in holy celebrations of Euphemia and confer upon us eternal patronage and supreme joy.

text: Muneribus nostris Domine martyris tuae Praxedis festa celebrantes quaesumus ut meritis illius et tibi reddantur accepta et nostrae saluti proficua.
translation_en: While celebrating the feast of your martyr Praxedis with our offerings, we humbly ask that the merits of her and hers may be accepted by you, and prove beneficial for our salvation.

text: Muneribus nostris Domine precibusque susceptis et caelestibus nos munda mysteriis et clementer exaudi.
translation_en: Lord, with our offerings and prayers received, cleanse us with heavenly mysteries and hear us graciously.

text: Muneribus nostris Domine sancti Laurentii martyris tui festa praecedimus ut quae conscientiae nostrae praepediuntur obstaculis illius meritis grata reddantur.
translation_en: We approach Your feast, Lord, of the holy Saint Lawrence your martyr, preceding it with our offerings, so that whatever obstacles confront our conscience may be made pleasing to You through his merits.

text: Muneribus nostris in beati Laurentii commemoratione quaesumus adsit tua Domine benedictio cuius nobis semper suffragetur in tua virtute confessio.
translation_en: We humbly ask your blessing, Lord, on our offerings during the commemoration of Blessed Lawrence. May his confession always intercede for us in your power.

text: Muneribus nostris quaesumus Domine gratiam tuae placationis intersere ut et collata nobis remedia tuearis et conferenda perficias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your grace may be interposed in our offerings, so that you may protect and bestow the remedies granted to us, and complete what is to be conferred.

text: Muneribus sacris et precibus beati Leonardi nobis Domine succurre placatus et praesta ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter impetremus.
translation_en: Lord, with sacred duties and prayers of blessed Leonard, succor us when pleased, and grant that what we faithfully ask, we may effectively petition.

text: Muneribus tuis et supplicationibus sancti confessoris tui illius quaesumus Domine tribue nos foveri ut cuius festivitatem celebramus eius apud te intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, by your mercies and the supplications of your holy confessor whom we are celebrating today, grant us that his intercessions may aid us before you.

text: Muneris divini perceptio quaesumus Domine semper a nobis et peccata nostra submoveat et externa depellat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the perception of divine service may always move our sins away from us and drive off external ones.

text: Muneris divini perceptio quaesumus Domine beato Petro apostolo intercedente semper a nobis peccatorum nostrorum vincula submoveat et pericula cuncta depellat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with blessed Peter the Apostle interceding, that he may always remove from us the bonds of our sins and drive away all dangers.

text: Muneris Domine quod ineffabili pietati tuae venerantes offerimus propitius adsis inspector et interveniente sancto martyre tuo Antonino cuius sacratissima corporis celebratur inventio in conspectu maiestatis tuae grata sit nostrae servitutis pia devotio.
translation_en: Lord, we present to you the offering of our ineffable reverence for your mercy. Kindly be present and watch over us. May it please your holy martyr Anthony, in whose most sacred body's discovery before your majesty is celebrated, as our pious devotion.

text: Muneris sacri refectione vegetati clementiam tuam suppliciter exposcimus omnipotens Deus ut beatus martyr Antoninus gratanter tuum pro nobis imploret auxilium semper et gaudium sempiternum.
translation_en: With the refreshment of a sacred service, we humbly entreat your clemency, O almighty God, that blessed martyr Anthony may graciously intercede for us and grant us eternal help and everlasting joy.

text: Munerum tuorum Domine largitate gaudentes supplices deprecamur ut quibus donasti huius ministerii facultatem tribuas sufficientem gratiam ministrandi.
translation_en: Rejoicing in your gifts, Lord, we humbly ask with supplication that you grant to those whom you have given the faculty for this ministry a sufficient grace for serving.

text: Munerum tuorum Domine largitatem sumentes supplices deprecamur ut quibus donasti huius ministerii servitutem exsequendae gratiae tuae tribuas facultatem.
translation_en: Taking boldness as your supplicants, we ask for the generosity of your gifts, O Lord, that you may grant those to whom you have given the service of this ministry, the ability to execute it in fulfillment of your grace.

text: Muniat quaesumus Domine fideles tuos sumpti vivificatio sacramenti et a vitiis omnibus expeditos in sancta faciat devotione currentes.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, to strengthen Your faithful with the vitalizing sacrifice and make them equipped against all vices, may they run in holy devotion.

text: Muniat quaesumus Domine famulum tuum illum pro cuius iniquitatibus misericordiam tuam deprecamur sumpti vivificatio sacramenti ut a vitiis omnibus expiatus in tua religione devotus permaneat.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, to bless Your servant for whose iniquities we entreat Your mercy. May he, having been revived by the sacred sacrament, be cleansed from all vices and remain devoted to Your religion as an expiated individual.

text: Munus Domine quaesumus in memoriam dominicae passionis oblatum intercedente beato Ivone consessore tuo te nobis iugiter faciat esse placatum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offering made in memory of Your Passion, through the intercession of Blessed John, Your consecrated bishop, may always make us pleasing to You.

text: Munus hoc Domine quaesumus apostolica pro nobis interventio prosequatur ut quod tremente servitio nos vovemus oblatum eorum nobis precibus efficias sacramentum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that this service be followed by your apostolic intervention on our behalf. May what we have pledged to offer in trembling service, through their prayers, become a sacrament for us.

text: Munus hoc Domine tibi oblatum propitius suscipe et deprecante sancto Edwardo cuncto christiano miserere populo.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, presented to you, receive graciously, and have mercy on the people praying through St. Edward, the whole Christian population.

text: Munus meum dignum sit tibi Domine et misericordia tua magna sit super me ut de manu mea dignanter suscipias hostiam et sacrificium et ad patriam claritatis perduci me facias.
translation_en: May my offering be worthy of You, Lord, and may Your great mercy be upon me, that You graciously accept the sacrifice from my hand. And may You lead me to the land of clarity.

text: Munus nostrae devotionis sacro altari superpositum pia beati Udalrici supplicatio tibi Domino Deo nostro reddat acceptum et ad hoc percipiendum purificet corda omnium nostrum.
translation_en: May the offering placed on our sacred altar through the humble supplication of blessed Udalricus be acceptable to you, Lord God our Savior. May it purify the hearts of all of us for this purpose.

text: Munus nostrae humilitatis pro tuitione famuli tui oblatum petimus dignanter Domine assume et ab eius oppressione maligni insidiatoris omnem potestatem exclude.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to accept the offering made on behalf of Your servant. May You drive away and exclude from him all power of the wicked insidious enemy.

text: Munus nostrum quaesumus Domine dignanter assume quod meritis et intercessione archangeli tui Michaelis sit tibi acceptabile et nobis propitiabile.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your ministry may be graciously undertaken, which through our merits and the intercession of your Archangel Michael may be acceptable to you and pleasing for us.

text: Munus oblatum quaesumus Domine propitius attende et ut digne tuis famulemur altaribus sancti illius apostoli tui intercessione quae deliquimus indulge.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look favorably upon the offering presented. May we worthily serve your altars, those of the holy apostle, through whose intercession we have sinned. Grant us forgiveness for our transgressions.

text: Munus populi tui Domine placatus intende quo non altaribus tuis ignis alienus nec irrationabilium cruor effunditur animantium sed Sancti Spiritus operante virtute sacrificium iam nostri corpus et sanguis est ipsius sacerdotis.
translation_en: Lord, appeased by your people's duty, incline Your attention so that no foreign fire burns on Your altars nor the blood of irrational creatures is shed, but through the working of the Holy Spirit, our body and blood have already become the sacrifice itself of this priest.

text: Munus populi tui Domine quaesumus apostolica deprecatione sit gratum ut Ecclesia tua eorum semper intercessionibus adiuvetur quorum iugiter instruitur disciplinis.
translation_en: We ask Your grace, Lord, with apostolic supplication, that Your Church may always be aided by the intercessions of those whom You continually instruct in discipline.

text: Munus populi tui Domine quaesumus apostolica intercessione sanctifica nosque a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that your people's duty be sanctified by apostolic intercession and that we may be purified from the stains of our sins.

text: Munus populi tui Domine quaesumus dignanter assume quod non nostris meritis sed sancti archangeli tui Michaelis deprecatione sit gratum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you graciously accept the duty of your people, not because of our own merits but because of the intercession of your holy archangel Michael.

text: Munus quod tibi Domine nostrae servitutis offerimus tu salutare nobis perfice sacramentum.
translation_en: The service that we, Lord, offer to your service, may it be fulfilled by you as a saving sacrament for us.

text: Munus quod tibi offerimus Domine quaesumus gratanter suscipe et suffragante beati confessoris tui atque pontificis Swithuni intercessione omnes nostrorum nexus peccaminum solvat ac lucrum sempiternitatis nobis acquirat.
