translation_en: The gift which we offer to you, Lord, we humbly ask that you graciously accept, and with the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop Swithun, may all our bonds of sins be dissolved, and may eternal reward be acquired for us.

text: Munus tibi a devotis oblatum famulis aeterne conditor rerum dignanter respice et meritis almi intercedentibus Botulfi caelesti illud benedictione sanctifica nobisque ad cunctorum veniam peccaminum et ad caelestis augmentum perfice gaudii.
translation_en: The gift offered to You by devoted servants, eternal Creator of all things, graciously look upon and, through the merits of Bottulph interceding for us, sanctify that heavenly blessing for us. May it bring us forgiveness for all our sins and lead us to an increase in heavenly joy.

text: Munus tibi Domine oblatum sancto intercedente Birino libenter suscipe et offerentium vota clementer exaudi.
translation_en: Offering made to you, Lord, through the holy intercession of Birino, we gladly present and earnestly request that you graciously receive. Hearken to the prayers of the petitioners with favor.

text: Munus tui corporis mystici Domine tuis oculis oblatum non nostri pulveris meritum sed sancti Raphaelis intercessio gratum faciat et acceptum.
translation_en: Lord, the offering of your mystical body presented before you is not merited by our dust, but may the intercession of Saint Raphael make it pleasing and acceptable to you.

text: Mysteria nos Domine sancta purificent et suo munere tueantur.
translation_en: Lord, may these mysteries sanctify us and protect us with their power.

text: Mysteria quaesumus Domine quae in sancti Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis commemoratione sumpsimus nos tueantur cuius hodie devotis officiis recolimus passionem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect us, as we have taken part in the mysteries on the commemoration of your martyr and bishop St. Blaise. May his today's devoted services remind us of his passion.

text: Mysteria sancta nos Domine et spiritalibus expleant alimentis et corporalibus tueantur auxiliis.
translation_en: O Lord, may the sacred mysteries fill us with spiritual nourishment and protect us with corporal aid through your help.

text: Mysteria tua Domine debitis servitiis exsequentes supplices te rogamus ut quod ad honorem tuae maiestatis offerimus nobis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, as we carry out your mysteries with the due services, that what we offer to Your majesty for Your honor may bring us salvation.

text: Mysteriis divinis refecti Domine Deus quaesumus ut beati Augustini confessoris tui atque pontificis ubique intercessione nos protegas cuius annua veneratione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: Lord God, strengthened by divine mysteries, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your confessor and bishop Saint Augustine, you protect us. In whose honor we offer this presentation to your majesty on his annual feast day.

text: Mysteriis tuis veneranter assumptis quaesumus Domine ut contra nostrae condicionis errorem et contra diabolicas armemur insidias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that participating in your mysteries, we may be armed against the errors of our condition and shielded from the deceitful snares of the devil.

text: Mystica nobis Domine prosit oblatio quae nos et a reatibus nostris expediat et perpetua salvatione confirmet.
translation_en: May this mystical offering, Lord, be beneficial to us; that it may free us from our sins and confirm us in eternal salvation.

text: Mysticis Domine repleti sumus votis et gaudiis; praesta quaesumus ut per intercessionem sanctorum martyrum tuorum Saturnini et Chrysantii quae corporaliter agimus spiritaliter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, we are filled with mysteries and joys; grant us that through the intercession of your holy martyrs Saturninus and Chrysanthius, what we do corporally we may attain spiritually.

text: Natalitia sancti Ioannis apostoli quaesumus Domine munera capiamus ut suis precibus gloriosis – et credendum nobis iugiter postulet et sequendum – beatus evangelista docuit.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that we may receive the blessings of the feast of Saint John the Apostle. May we always be urged to believe and follow as he taught with his glorious prayers – blessed evangelist.

text: Ne despicias Domine quaesumus in afflictione clamantes sed laborantibus celeri succurre placatus auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you do not disregard us in our affliction, but rather swiftly help those who are crying out and toiling with your pleasing aid.

text: Ne despicias omnipotens Deus populum tuum in afflictione clamantem sed propter gloriam nominis tui tribulantibus succurre placatus.
translation_en: O mighty God, do not scorn your people in affliction who are crying out to you, but help those who are being troubled with favor, for the sake of your glorious name.

text: Ne perdideris nos Domine cum iniquitatibus nostris sed tua sancta sumentes a subitaneae mortis defende periculis.
translation_en: Lord, do not let us be lost with our wickednesses, but may you take hold of your holy ones and defend them from the dangers of sudden death.

text: Ne quaesumus Domine pro nostris excessibus munera delata despicias sed pro tuorum intercessione sanctorum potius ad indulgentiam convertere supplicibus.
translation_en: Let us not ask you, Lord, to disregard the rewards bestowed upon us for our excesses, but rather, through the intercession of your saints, may you turn our pleas towards mercy and forgiveness.

text: Nomini tuo Domine munera quaesumus dicata sanctifica ut et sacramentum nobis aeternae vitae praebeant et pro
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for gifts dedicated to your name. Sanctify them so that they may bestow on us the sacrament of eternal life and intercede for us.

text: Nomini tuo quaesumus Deus aeterne da gloriam cum et immeritis bene facere non omittis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, eternal God, to give glory with making well even those who are undeserving not to be forgotten.

text: Nominibus sanctorum martyrum offerentiumque fidelium atque eorum qui ab hoc saeculo transierunt a ministris iam sacri ordinis recensitis te dominum Deum nostrum per intercessum sancti tui Andreae apostoli et martyris deprecamur ut et martyrum patrocinia nobis semper opitulentur et offerentium obsequia a te clementer accipiantur ac defunctorum fidelium animabus caelestium receptacula mansionum et sempiternae quietis tutamina tribuantur perenniter.
translation_en: We entreat you, our Lord God, through the intercession of your holy apostle and martyr St. Andrew, that the patronage of the martyrs may always be abundant for us, and that the offerings of the faithful who are already serving in the new order of the sacred ministry may be graciously received by you. We also pray that the souls of the departed faithful may be granted eternal dwellings and tranquil resting places forever.

text: Nominis tui Christe gratia praeclarum militem tuum Christophorum munificas et eiusdem nominis virtute ditatum locupletas cum tibi per eum multitudinem fidelium aggregas populorum quos dignos martyrii nomine consecratos in perpetua exsultatione suscipis gloriosos.  Proinde quaesumus te Domine Deus noster ut gratiam nominis tui in qua signati sumus inviolabiliter illam usque ad nostrum obitum conservemus ut gratia succedente pro gratia et fidem tibi illibatam exhibeamus dum vivimus et vitae aeternae praemia capiamus post transitum. Sic etiam quaesumus Domine praedicto martyre tuo suffragante concessa sit requies defunctorum ut mutata sorte tristium mansionum caelesti perfruamur societate iustorum.
translation_en: We ask you, Christ, our Lord God, to preserve the grace of your name upon your servant Christopher, richly endowed and enriched by the power of the same name, with whom you gather a multitude of faithful people whom you have consecrated worthy of martyrdom in perpetual exultation. We therefore ask you, Lord, that we may keep inviolably the grace of your name in which we are marked until our death, and that as grace succeeds grace and faith remains unblemished while we live, we may show it to you without blemish. May we also, Lord, through the intercession of the aforementioned martyr, obtain rest for the departed souls, so that by a change in fate, we may enjoy the society of the just in heavenly mansions.

text: Nominum serie relata defunctorum fratres carissimi omnipotentis Dei misericordiam supplices exoremus ut interventu sancti Clementis antistitis et martyris sui defunctis absolutionem viventibus tribuat salutem; memores etiam simus fidelissimorum suorum Sisinnii atque Theodorae ut quibus per beatum martyrem fidem in se credendi inseruit eos paradisi regno participet.
translation_en: We humbly entreat the merciful power of God for our dearly beloved brothers who have departed, that through the intervention of Saint Clement, bishop and martyr, he may grant them absolution while living and peace; let us also remember their most faithful ones Sisinnius and Theodora, so that those who believed in them through the blessed martyr, may participate with them in the kingdom of paradise.

text: Non nos abicias Iesu bone in crastinum per inveteratae vestis abiectionem a convivio mensae tuae. Hodie dona nobis nuptialis dignitatis vestibulum cum quo cras laeti accedamus ad tuae passionis epulum praeparatum. Hodie sit in nobis vera confessio et cras peccatorum celerrima subsequatur remissio. Hodie accipe vota; cras votorum tribue praemia. Hodie nos propina gustu tuae dulcedinis et in crastinum attribue tuae plenitudinem caritatis.
translation_en: Jesus, good Lord, you do not cast us away tomorrow through the discarding of our old garments from your table's feast. Today, grant us a worthy robe for marriage so that we joyfully approach your prepared banquet of passion tomorrow. Today, let true confession be in us and swift forgiveness of sins follow tomorrow. Today, receive our vows; tomorrow, give the rewards of our vows. Today, feed us with the taste of your sweetness and attribute to us your fullness of love tomorrow.

text: Non obruamur Domine quaesumus quamvis immensis molibus peccatorum qui ubique sanctis tuis deprecantibus exoramus ut malis nostris offensus praesentes hostias non repellas sed tibi nos placitos sacramenti virtute perficias.
translation_en: Lord, we pray that we may not be overwhelmed, despite the vast multitude of our sins, for which we implore your saints everywhere to intercede on our behalf. May you not turn away from the sacrifices presented by us, but rather, through the power of the sacraments, make us pleasing to you.

text: Non praeiudicet quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis nostra minus idonea deprecatio servitutis sed merita nostra praevincens Ecclesiam tuam sanctifica guberna salva prosequere et tibi sine cessatione devotam perpetua redemptione confirma.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, not to judge our unworthy supplication of service, but may our merits prevail. May your Church be sanctified, governed, saved, and led, and may it be continually devoted and confirmed in perpetual redemption to you.

text: Non retribuas nobis quaesumus Domine quae malis operibus promeremur sed quos iure corripis a veritate digressos protege tua miseratione correctos.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you not to repay us for the evil works we deserve, but rather protect us with your mercy as you correct those who have strayed from truth.

text: Non secundum peccata nostra Deus iudex bone domus Israel tribuas nobis. Quis poterit salvus fieri? Et ideo misericordia et veritas occurrerunt sibi ut quos debuerat veritas commendare misericordia reconciliet tibi. Respice itaque rogamus omnipotens Deus super haec holocausta caelestibus altaribus tuis in voce laudis atque confessionis imposita et quam bonus es erga filios hominum preces singulorum clementer exaudiens manifesta.
translation_en: Not according to our sins, O God, Judge of the good house of Israel, shouldst Thou grant us. Who can be saved? And therefore, mercy and truth have met together, that they may commend whom truth ought to commend, mercy may reconcile to Thee. Therefore, look upon us, we ask, Almighty God, above these holocausts offered on Thy celestial altars in the voice of praise and confession laid upon us, and how good Thou art towards the sons of men, graciously hearing the prayers of all individuals manifestly.

text: Nostra tibi quaesumus Domine sint accepta ieiunia quae nos et expiando gratia(e) tua(e) dignos efficiant et ad remedia perducant aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the fasts which have made us worthy may be accepted by you and lead us to your grace and everlasting remedies.

text: Nostrae devotionis munera Domine in honorem sanctae Perpetuae tuis altaribus offerentes maiestatem tuam suppliciter exoramus ut et tibi grata semper exsistant et ad salutem nostram proficiant.
translation_en: In our devotion, Lord, we offer gifts before the honor of Saint Perpetua at your altars. Humbly, we beseech Your majesty that they may always be pleasing to You and advance for our salvation.

text: Nostrae servitutis obsequia quaesumus Domine Deus beatus Hugo confessor tuus et pontifex tibi reddat accepta ne sacramenti caelestis effectum reatus noster a nobis excludat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord God, that your blessed confesser and pope, Saint Hugh, may present our obedience to you. May he ensure that the grace of the heavenly sacrament does not exclude our guilt from us.

text: Nostris quaesumus Domine propitiare temporibus ut tuo munere diriga(n)tur et romana securitas et devotio christiana.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be merciful during our times, that the Roman security and Christian devotion may be guided by your gift.

text: Suscipis eum quarta feria.
translation_en: You receive him on the fourth day (of the week).

text: Novimus Domine quod pax multa sit diligentibus nomen tuum neque sit in illis scandalum sicut fatemur fuisse Ioannem apostolum tuum qui de pectoris tui arcano vividos alternae dilectionis rivulos hauriens praedicat omnibus in commune non solum sermone diligere sed opere et veritate. Cuius veridica praecepti sanctione commoniti te suppliciter quaesumus Filius Dei ut ea nos facias implere quae praedicat ea de te sentire quae ipse sentit ea veritate et te diligere et a te diligi mereamur qua ipse vel te dilexit vel a te constat esse dilectus ut in pace viventes et pacis gloriam amplectentes ad te perveniamus fructibus pleni pacis et copia benedictionis.
translation_en: We know, Lord, that there is much peace for those who diligently seek Your name, and may not be a scandal to them as we confess was John Your apostle, who, drawing living streams of alternate love from the secret depths of Your heart, preached to all in common not only by word but also by deed and truth. We are reminded of his true commandments and humbly ask You, Son of God, that You make us fulfill what he preached, to feel about You as He does, in truth, and to love You and be loved by You, so that living peacefully and embracing the glory of peace, we may come to You laden with the fruits of peace and abundance of blessing.

text: Nuntiamus Domine quod credimus nec tacemus te totis visceribus deprecantes ut qui genitrici praestitisti ut mater esset et virgo tribuas Ecclesiae tuae ut sit fide incorrupta et castitate fecunda. Atque haec libamina ita tuae gratiae dulcedo sanctificet ut sumentibus et salutem corporum et delictorum veniam praestent.
translation_en: We announce to You, Lord, that we believe and do not hide this from you, pleading with all our heart that you who granted the title of mother to the one who gave birth yet remained a virgin, grant to your Church that it may remain uncorrupted in faith and fruitful in chastity. And let these prayers be so sweetened by your grace that they provide both salvation for bodies and forgiveness for sins to those who partake of them.

text: O bone Iesu Domine et redemptor noster qui temetipsum caput catholicae formans ecclesiae aliis donasti pro te animas perdendo suo se perungi cruore aliis praedicationis eloquio luculentius clarere ut et illis fortium foret in carne concertatio victrix et in istis vacillantium restauratio adiutrix dum et in illis fortes discunt terga non dare et in istis lapsi in melius reformari contra ludificum anguem. Sublimius enim est in statum lapsos reducere quam iustos statu suo roborare quia illi hoc habent quod non amiserunt hii vero hoc recipiunt quod merito perdiderunt. Da Ecclesiae tuae hoc promittere in voto quod egregii doctoris exstans fulta eloquii bono nequeat a suo deflecti promisso; da ei hoc tenere semper agendo quod nequeat culpa submitti quandoque in facto.  At nunc alme tu Augustine et pontifex magne recordare omnium nostrum ruinas quas ipse evasisti domini praeventus misericordia; memor esto omnium pontificum et sacerdotum quibus ipse sacerdotii exstitisti societate perfunctus; memorare plebium et singulorum omnium defer Deo tandem iam necessarium votum.  Sic tuo interventu teneant pontifices tui sublimatam apicis in populis arcem ut neque operis exemplo neque praedicationis oraculo a recto decidant calle.  Sit eis quibusque sublimibus loqui pro veritate aucta fiducia quae prosit utrisque in supernam expedite provehi patriam.  Sit presbyteris gravida honestatis processio ac sacrificandi prompta devotio ut multi eorum renovati exemplo ipsi valeant remunerari praemio post futuro.  Sit levitis porrigendi calicem cum corporis nitore contentio crebra ut merito appetant aetherea regna.  Sit subdiaconilbus ac ceteris ministrantibus in ecclesiasticis disciplinis adversa tolerandi oblatio quo possint munerari rite post transitum.  Sit clericis ad Deum sedula cum castitate sincera servitutis cultura ne adstricti reatu ultimi mulctentur iudicii poena.  Sit monachis emortua saecularis voluptas ut post eis frustrata non sit laboris facultas.  Sit regibus et cunctis dominantibus moderata potestas ut die horrifico eorum coronetur de sublimi fastigio pietas.  Sit lascivis petulantibusque munditia carnis ne pro sordibus excludantur praesentia veritatis.  Sic virgines retentent incorruptum pudoris vigorem ut merito sequentes ubique agnum novi revocent cantici laudem.  Sit continentibus castitas perseverans; sit etiam coniugatis ad procreandas proles commixtio pura.  Sit superbis humilibus supponere colla; sit etiam elatis mentem reprimere tumidam.  Sit iracundis intemperantiae repressa ferocitas; sit etiam aemulis insita usquequaque benignitas.  Sit sapientibus per te apte sapere; sit etiam nesciis a tenebris ignorantiae resipiscere.  Sit paganis amatum unda sacrosancti baptismatis renasci; sit etiam Iudaeis incarnationis Christi mysterium deposita obstinatione cognoscere.  Sit haereticis plena veritatis cognitio; sit etiam schismaticis catholicae ecclesiae unita complexio.  Et quia omnes ex traduce protoplasti parentis geniti in hanc sumus ruinam proniter deflexi et nemo propriis viribus quiverit erigi nisi quem gratia subvexerit divini adiutorn ita sit per te cunctis mollita duritia post lapsum iam emendatiorem ad paenitentiam praebere votum ut et in nullo rependant facinus deploratum et de admissis culpis tua se gaudeant indulgentia obtinuisse precatum.  Haud dubium enim nobis est quin in ista te apud omni65 potentissimam Trinitatem sine carnis obstaculo iam obtinere posse qui carne obtectus in saeculo dixisti: »Quamquam de Deo sit loqui temere reticere tamen omnino non necessarium fore« dictis eo adiutore nobis reserasti ianuam vitae.
translation_en:
O good Jesus, Lord and our Redeemer, who by Yourself formed the head of the Catholic Church, You gave others life for Your sake by shedding Your own blood, You shone more brightly in preaching to others so that it was a victorious assembly in flesh for them, and a restorative aid for those who were wavering. While it is loftier to restore the fallen than to strengthen the just because the former have something they did not lose, but the latter receive what they rightfully lost. Grant this promise to Your Church, that an eminent teacher, well-armed with eloquence, cannot be deflected from his promised course; let him always act so as not to submit to guilt in any deed.
Now, almighty You Augustine and great Pope, remember the ruin of all of us which You yourself escaped by the preventive mercy of the Lord; remember all popes and priests whom You were a part of the sacred society of the priesthood; remember the people and each and every one who has finally fulfilled the necessary vow to God.
Through Your intervention, let the popes maintain the lofty summit as a fortress in the people so that neither by their example nor by their oracle they fall from the right path. Let those who speak with wisdom do so with increased trust in truth; let them quickly lead the country to the upper realms of heaven.
Let there be a grave and honest procession for the presbyters, and let there be prompt devotion for sacrifice; let many of them, renewed by their example, be able to be rewarded with a prize after the future. Let the deacons offer the chalice with the brilliance of the body in frequent contention so that they may rightfully strive for eternal realms.
Let there be an offering of submission to adversity for subdeacons and others serving in ecclesiastical disciplines after the departure; let clerics serve God with sincere chastity lest they be severely punished by the last judgment.
Let monks suppress secular pleasure so that after them there is no possibility of labor; let kings and all rulers have moderate power, so that piety crowns their horrifying rule from a lofty throne.
Let carnal cleanliness not exclude the presence of truth for the shameless and lascivious; let virgins retain the strength of pure modesty so that they may follow the new Lamb with a canticle of praise wherever they go.
Let chastity persist for those who are continent, and even for married couples, let there be a pure mixture for procreation. Let the proud submit their necks; let the haughty suppress their swollen mind.
Let the anger of the irascible be repressed, and let benevolence be instilled in the envious. Let the wise speak wisely through You, and let those who were in darkness recover from ignorance.
Let the pagans be born anew with the sacred waters of baptism; let the Jews recognize the mystery of Christ's incarnation, released from stubbornness.
Let there be full knowledge of truth for heretics; let schismatics unite with the Catholic Church. And because we are all born from the descendants of the first parents and have fallen into this ruin, no one can raise themselves without being lifted by the grace of the divine helper. Therefore, through You, grant all a softer hardness after the fall, a more merciful promise of repentance, so that neither a crime committed is regretted nor they rejoice in the indulgence obtained by their sins.
It is not in doubt for us that without the obstacle of flesh, You can already obtain power among all the almighty Trinity, which You said in the flesh while in the world: "Although it is dangerous to speak about God, yet it is not entirely unnecessary." With Your helper, You have opened the door of life for us.

text: O Domine Iesu Christe poscentium attende propitius precem lamentantium intende clamorem lugentium iam cerne discrimen. Mitescant in latera cladis iacula quibus vastetur nostra merita terra. Intende pietatem abroga ultionem suspende iram intende clementiam; conterritis fave humiliatis assiste; non punias per iudicium reos non in ira arguas humiliatos.
translation_en: O Lord Jesus Christ, attend to those who are asking, be merciful towards their supplication, listen to the lament of those mourning, already perceive the distinction. May the arrows of destruction soften on our side's flanks where our merits are being ravaged. Listen to pity, suspend vengeance, suppress anger, listen to kindness; overthrow, humble, assist; do not punish the accused through judgment, do not accuse the humiliated in anger.

text: O virtus et refugium spei Salvator noster Christe Filius Dei vivi qui veniens ad Lazarum suscitandum spiritu fremis lacrimas producis in temetipso quoque turbaris da nobis ut ad evadendos laqueos perniciosae deceptionis fremitum det in nobis spiritus tuae dulcedinis. Lacrimemus in nobis et effectum a te optabiliter capiamus. Turbemur quoque a te pro te et ita nos in compunctionis et pacis unione connecte ut per eam pacem qua tu es videamus te in gloria veniamus ad praemia repromissa et laudemus cum Lazaro maiestatem tuam.
translation_en: O power and refuge of hope, Savior Christ, Son of the living God, who coming to raise Lazarus, you groan and produce tears in yourself, you also disturb us. Give us that we may have within us the sigh of escaping the snares of harmful deception. Let your spirit of sweetness breathe in us. May we weep within ourselves and may we acceptably receive the effect from you. Also let us be disturbed on your behalf, and thus connect us in compunction and union of peace, so that through it we may see the peace which is with you and come to you in glory to the rewards promised and join in lauding the majesty of Lazarus.

text: Ob arcana mysterii tui Iesu Christe Deus noster a te collata inspiratione poscentes deficit in contuitu acies in intellectu visus in relatione virtus in narratione sermo. Quis enim apte convenienterque possit edicere supereminentem caritatem qua nos dignatus es redimere; qua ut ita dicam humili compulsus es incarnari descensione; qua electos iussisti apostolos omnibus ad salutiferam nationibus mittere conversionem; qua eminentiores discipulis ceteris Petrum voluisti et Paulum efficere?  Sed quia haec immensa – indignitate vitae et naturae corruptione digne – non possumus replicare praesentis sollemnitatis officio tuam omnipotens inaestimabilem poscimus maiestatem ut favore gemino apostolorum tuorum patronorum scilicet nostrorum acceptum habeas et efficias ratum huius oblatum diei sacrificium quo(d) sacratissima illa inarbitrabili gratia ita digneris illustrare ut omnium percipientium receptum in pectoribus sit in peccaminum expiationem in mentis et corporis incolumitatem in huius periculosissimae vitae custodiam et munitionem.
translation_en:
For the hidden mysteries of your, Jesus Christ, our God, we ask who are lacking in closeness of gaze, understanding in intellect, relation in virtue, and narration in sermon. For who can appropriately and suitably proclaim the supereminent love with which you have deigned to redeem us; through which you were compelled to humble yourself and become incarnate in descent; which you commanded the chosen apostles to send conversion to all salvific nations; which you wished to make Peter and Paul superior among disciples?
However, since these immense matters – undeserving of life and nature's corruption – cannot be adequately expressed according to the present solemnity's office, we implore your infinite majesty, Almighty One. We ask that you accept with double favor the intercession of your apostles, namely our patrons, and make this offering of today's sacrifice acceptable. May such incomparable grace, which is so worthy of your sanctity, illuminate it to such an extent that it becomes a cleansing for sins in the hearts of those perceiving it, a protection for mind and body in this most dangerous life, and a safeguard and fortress.

text: Ob honorem passionis famularum tuarum Iustae et Rufinae has tibi Deus pater hostias immolantes precamur ut illarum interventu quae se tibi vasa mundissima exhibuerunt hoc tibi oblatum sanctifices holocaustum praestans supplicibus tuis ut quarum mercimonio dudum satiasti inopiam pauperum harum prece rata tibi efficias vota fidelium populorum.
translation_en: In honor of your servants, the Just and Rufina, we who offer you these sacrifices, God our Father, pray that through their intervention, who presented themselves to you as most pure vessels, may you sanctify this holocaust for us, granting supplications, so that through their mercy, which has already satisfied the poverty of the poor, your will is fulfilled by their request, making the wishes of the faithful people effective.

text: Te deprecamur omnipotens Deus ut benedicas
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that you bless

text: Oblata confessoris tui Benedicti honore sint tibi Domine nostra grata libamina et nostrarum apud te supplicationum effectum obtineant.
translation_en: May the offerings of your confesse, Saint Benedict, be pleasing to you, Lord. May our prayers before you be effective.

text: Te deprecor Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus ut hunc famulo
translation_en: I beseech you, Lord holy Father almighty eternal God, that this servant of yours

text: Oblata Domine munera nova unigeniti tui nativitate sanctifica nosque a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify these new gifts presented on behalf of your only-begotten Son's nativity, and cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Te Deum Patrem omnipotentem oramus
translation_en: We pray Thee, O God, Almighty Father

text: Oblata Domine munera sanctifica et intercedente beata Maria semper virgine nobis salutaria <esse> concede.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify the gifts that are offered and through the intercession of blessed Mary, ever Virgin, grant us salvific outcomes.

text: Oblata Domine munera sanctifica nosque a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify these gifts, and cleanse us from the stains of our sins.

text: Te Domine supplices exoramus ut visitationi
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you visit us

text: Oblata Domine quae tibi offerimus piae devotionis intentu in honorem sanctissimi Aidani episcopi tua praeclara clementia sanctificet et purificatos nos ea percipere tua faciat gratia in omnibus ubique laudanda.
translation_en: Lord, what we offer you with pious devotion in honor of the most holy Bishop Aidan, may your noble clemency sanctify and make us worthy to receive through your grace, in every place, which is always praiseworthy.

text: Oblata in conspectu tuo Domine nostrae servitutis libamina quaesumus ut ipse tibi acceptabilia facias et petitiones nostras in odorem suavitatis accipias.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, the wine and bread of our servitude. We humbly ask that you make them acceptable to yourself and that our petitions become pleasing fragrance to you.

text: Oblata maiestati tuae dona respice quaesumus omnipotens Deus et ea nobis ad perpetuam salutem mentis et corporis intercessione beati Gregorii pontificis tui prodesse cone.
translation_en: We pray to your majesty, grant us, we beseech you, almighty God. May these offerings benefit us for eternal salvation of mind and body through the intercession of blessed Pope Gregory.

text: Te invocamus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus super has famulas .
translation_en: We invoke you, Lord, holy Father Almighty, eternal God, over these servants.

text: Oblata munera nomini tuo Domine nostrae sanctificationi proficere tuorum precibus concede sanctorum.
translation_en: Accept, O Lord, these offerings to Your name, and, through the prayers of Your saints, let them profit for our sanctification. Grant this, we beseech You.

text: Oblata munera quaesumus Domine tua benedictione sanctifica quae te donante nos illa flamma tuae dilectionis accendat per quam sanctus apostolus Barnabas tormenta sui corporis universa devicit.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, with your blessing to sanctify the offerings that, through your giving, may kindle in us a flame of your love like the one that enabled Saint Apostle Barnabas to overcome all his bodily torments.

text: Te lucem veram et lucis auctorem
translation_en: You the true light and the author of light

text: Oblata munera superposita altario tuo Domine sanctificare dignare et per ea placatus peccata nostra quaesumus in die ieiunii nostri memor humanae condicionis absolve et quidquid eorum retributione meremur averte.
translation_en: Lord, we present these offerings and place them on your altar. Grant that they be sanctified. Through them, may you be appeased of our sins, which we humbly ask for in this day of fasting. May you absolve us of our human condition, and turn away from us whatever we deserve as retribution.

text: Te quaesumus Domine custodi cogitationes
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, guard our thoughts.

text: Oblata nostra Domine semper oculis tuae maiestatis intende et intercessio beati Romani martyris tui opem tuam nobis semper acquirat.
translation_en: Lord, always direct your eyes towards our offerings and may the intercession of your blessed Roman martyr continually obtain your help for us.

text: Oblata quaesumus Domine (munera) clementer excipe et per haec nos a cunctis periculis defende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously receive these offerings and through them protect us from all dangers.

text: Temeritatis quidem est Domine
translation_en: Lord, it is recklessness

text: Oblata quaesumus Domine munera pariter et famulum tuum clementer excipe et per haec a cunctis eum defende periculis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive these offerings and your servant gently. May you protect him from all dangers through this offering.

text: Oblata quaesumus Domine munera fidelis populi meritis beatissimi patroni nostri Audoeni tibi reddantur accepta ut ab omni contagione peccati iisdem quibus famulamur mysteriis clementer emundari mereamur.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, that the offerings of your faithful people may, through the merits of our most blessed patron Audoin, be offered to you and accepted, so that we may be worthily purified from all contagion of sin by your clemency, through those same mysteries whereby we serve.

text: Oblata quaesumus Domine munera gloriosa unigeniti tui transfiguratione sanctifica nosque a peccatorum nostrorum maculis splendoris illius illustratione emunda.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the glorious offerings of your only-begotten Son through his Transfiguration, and to cleanse us from the stains of our sins by the illumination of his glory.

text: Oblata quaesumus Domine munera suscipe propitius et famulum tuum abbatem nostrum cum grege sibi credito ad vitam pervenire concede perpetuam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept the offerings. Grant them graciously and our abbot with his flock, entrusted to him, may arrive at life everlasting.

text: Oblata quaesumus Domine munera tuae maiestatis virtute sanctifica et beatae virginis tuae Wenefredae meritis salutaria nobis esse concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, by the power of Your majesty, to sanctify these offerings and grant us a beneficial outcome through the merits of Your blessed virgin Wenefredae.

text: Oblata quaesumus mitissime Deus clementer adspice munera et precibus beatorum martyrum tuorum Timothei et Apollinaris quorum fulcimur patrociniis potenter sanctifica.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, O most merciful God, to look upon these offerings with clemency. May the prayers of your blessed martyrs, Timothy and Apollinaris, whose patronage we seek, powerfully sanctify them.

text: Oblata servitutis nostrae munera tibi Domine quaesumus annua sancti patris nostri Ethelwoldi episcopi sollemnitas commendet accepta ut eius pia supplicatione muniti cunctorum nostrorum remissionem peccaminum et beatitudinis sempiternae mereamur obtinere consortium.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to present the offerings of our servitude to You. May the annual feast day of our holy father Ethelwold, bishop, commend these offerings accepted by You. May we be strengthened by his pious intercession so that we may deserve remission of sins and eternal beatitude, participating together.

text: Oblata tibi Domine holocausta ieiunantium coram te suffragiis efficito gratiosa sicque his benedictionem infundas ut omnes pro quibus offertur sanctificando(s) tibi assumas quo advenientis Spiritus Sancti praesentia nihil in nobis obscurum vitiosumque remaneat quo offensus a reis procul recedat.
translation_en: Lord, make effective the prayers of those who offer you their holocausts before you. May you pour upon them your blessing so that all for whom they are offered may be sanctified and assumed by you in the presence of the Holy Spirit. May nothing in us remain obscure or corrupt that would cause offense to kings, and may they move far away from us.

text: Oblata tibi Domine libamina tua suscipe misericordia et sanctis tuis martyribus intercedentibus quorum instat festivitas aeterna nobis praestetur puritas.
translation_en: Offered to you, Lord, are your sacrifices; receive them in mercy. May the martyrs, your saints, who intercede for us, help to grant us an eternal festival and may it bestow upon us purity.

text: Oblata tibi Domine munera populi tui pro tuorum honore sanctorum suscipe propitius quaesumus et eorum nobis intercessione sanctifica.
translation_en: Offered to You, Lord, are the gifts of Your people for Your honor and the glory of the saints. Receive them graciously, we ask You. And through their intercession, may they sanctify us.

text: Tibi subnexis precibus
translation_en: With supplicant prayers to you

text: Oblata tibi Domine munera sanctifica et interveniente beato Lamberto martyre tuo atque pontifice et nobis salutaria te miserante et tibi accepta reddantur.
translation_en: Offerings given to you, Lord, may you make holy, and with the intervention of the blessed Martin, your martyr and pope, may we receive merciful blessings from you, and may they be returned to you after being accepted.

text: Oblata tibi Domine quaesumus munera Spiritus Sanctus sanctificet et eorum nos participatio ab omnium peccatorum contagione custodiat.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the gifts presented to you may be sanctified by the Holy Spirit. May our participation in them protect us from any contagion of all sins.

text: Oblata tibi munera quaesumus Domine beatus Hugo confessor tuus et pontifex prosequatur et meritis eius adiuti per ea gratiam et gloriam consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept the offerings presented. Blessed Hugh, your confessee and bishop, may follow after them with his merits. With his assistance, we hope to attain grace and glory through this favor.

text: Oblatas tibi caelorum Deus has hostias ob celebritatem sanctorum Macchabaeorum atque Felicis martyris tui ea dignatione benedicendo sanctifica quo et per illos votum nobis tribuas tolerandi adversa et per Felicem felicitate nos heredites sempiterna.
translation_en: O God of heaven, we offer these hosts to you on the occasion of the celebrations of the holy Macchabees and your blessed martyr Felicity. May you bless and sanctify them with such dignity that through them you grant us the strength to endure adversity, and through Felicity, eternal happiness.

text: Transacto diei et consumatae noctis
translation_en: After the day and the night's end

text: Oblatas tibi omnipotens Deus ob honorem martyris tui Pontii victimas propitiatus intende et nostrorum criminum indulgentiam nobis miseratus concede.
translation_en: Almighty God, we offer to you on behalf of the honor of your martyr Pontius. May you accept these victims as propitiation and grant us the mercy of forgiveness for our sins.

text: Oblatas tibi omnipotens Deus ob honorem martyris tui illius victimas propitiatus attende ut qui iusti tui memoriam facientes votivum tibi sacrificium exhibemus nostrorum criminum a te indulgentiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty God, we offer to you the oblations in honor of your martyr for propitiation. Attend to us so that those who make remembrance of your righteous one may present to you a vow as a sacrificial offering. May we merit forgiveness of our sins through your indulgence.

text: Oblata tuis altaribus munera sereno vultu Domine quaesumus intuere et cunctorum nobis propitius indulgentiam peccatorum largire.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to look upon the offerings presented on Your altars with a peaceful countenance. Grant us, therefore, Your gracious forgiveness for our sins and be merciful to all of us.

text: Oblata tuis altaribus munera sereno Deus vultu intuere ut qui te dominum de suis iustis laboribus honorant offerendo tibi decimas frugum auxisse sentiant suarum substantiam facultatum ac sicut promisisti horrea eorum frumento reple et vino torcularia redundari concede. His quoque postulatus sacrificiis quaesumus ut gratiam vivis et requiem iubeas praelargiri defunctis.
translation_en: O God, who gazes upon your altars with a serene countenance, we pray that those who laboriously honor you as their Lord among the just may feel an increase in the substance and resources of their offerings of tithes of crops. Grant them that their barns be filled with grain and their wine presses overflow with wine. Additionally, we beseech these sacrificial offerings to grant abundant grace and eternal rest to the departed.

text: Oblati sacrificii Domine quaesumus praestet effectus ut eidem convenienter aptemur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the offering of sacrifice may be pleasing to You, and that we may become worthy in its due manner.

text: Oblatio Domine tuis adspectibus immolanda quaesumus ut nos et ab omnibus vitiis potenter absolvat et a cunctis defendat inimicis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the offering presented before your eyes may be accepted. May it powerfully cleanse us from all sins and protect us against all enemies.

text: Oblatio haec Domine tibi placeat et intercessio(ne) sancti Augustini doctoris Anglorum nos tibi dignos exhibeat.
translation_en: May this offering, Lord, be pleasing to You, and may the intercession of Saint Augustine, Doctor of the English, present us worthy to You.

text: Oblatio nos Domine quaesumus sacranda purificet ac sui ministerio pariter et participatione dignos efficiat.
translation_en: Offering, we beseech You, Lord, may it be made holy and purified. May Your ministry also make us worthy through service, and may our participation make us deserving.

text: Oblatio nos Domine tuo nomini dicata purificet et de die in diem ad caelestis vitae transferat actionem.
translation_en: This offering, Lord, dedicated to your name, may purify us and daily transfer our actions to the life of heaven.

text: Oblatio nos Domine tuo nomini dicando purificet et de die in diem ad caelestis vitae transferat actionem.
translation_en: Offering, Lord, by calling upon Your name, may purify us, and day by day transport us to the life of heaven.

text: Oblatio quam tibi offerimus Domine nos purget ab omni crimine quo per eius intercessionem cuius sacram recolimus festivitatem sumamus patriae caelestis hereditatem.
translation_en: The offering which we present to You, Lord, may purge us from all sin for which we are mindful of Your saints' intercession and by celebrating their festival we hope to inherit the heritage of the heavenly homeland.

text: Oblatio tibi Domine nostra defertur quae ut tuo sit digna conspectu te quaesumus largiente mentis nostrae sinceritate promatur.
translation_en: Our offering, Lord, is brought before you which we humbly ask to be worthy of your sight. We pray that it may be presented through the generosity of our sincere thoughts.

text: Oblatio tibi Domine sit nostra semper accepta quae angelis tuis sanctisque precantibus et indulgentiam nobis referat et remedia procuret aeterna.
translation_en: May our offering, Lord, be always accepted by you. May it be referred to us and provide relief through the intercession of your holy angels and saints, and may it bring eternal mercy and aid.

text: Oblatio tibi Domine votiva defertur; precamur ut pariter ad laudem tui nominis et apostolicae reverentiam dignitatis et ad nostrum proveniat sanctificata praesidium.
translation_en: An offering is brought to You, Lord, as a vow; we pray that it may come to Your praiseworthy name, the apostolic reverence of dignity, and bring us a sanctified protection.

text: Oblationem tibi Domine votivam deferimus deprecantes ut ad laudem tui nominis et apostolicae reverentiam dignitatis et ad nostrum proveniat sanctificata praesidium.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, our vow-offering, praying that it may come for the praise of your name, for the apostolic reverence of dignity, and for us bring a sanctified protection.

text: Oblatio tibi sit Domine hodiernae festivitatis accepta qua et nostrae reconciliationis processit perfecta placatio et divini cultus nobis est indita plenitudo et via veritatis et vita regni caelestis apparuit.
translation_en: O offering to you, Lord, on this day's festival is accepted, which brings about the full reconciliation of us, and provides the completeness of the divine worship for us; the fullness and way of truth, and the appearance of the kingdom of heaven.

text: Oblatione quaesumus Domine huius nostri officii et tui obsequii hunc fidelem ubique populum circumcinge et sanctorum martyrum Iusti et Pastoris munimine in libro vitae describe.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to encompass this faithful people everywhere participating in our office and your service. With the protection of the holy martyrs Justus and Pastor, depict them in the book of life.

text: Oblationem Domine fidelis populi Iesu Christi Filii tui Domini nostri sancta dextera benedicat; nos quoque per haec gloriosa beati Ambrosii pontificis oratio liberet a totius peccati contagio.
translation_en: May the Lord, Jesus Christ, Son of your divine right hand, bless this faithful offering of his people. Also, through the prayers of the blessed Ambrose, the glorious bishop, may we be freed from the contagion of all sin.

text: Oblationem familiae tuae Domine sanctorum martyrum praesidia deputata commendem et ut tibi grata sint placentium tibi supplicationibus offerantur.
translation_en: I commend to You, Lord, the oblation of your family of holy martyrs, appointed as protection. May they be pleasing to You and offered in their supplications be acceptable to You.

text: Oblationem familiae tuae sereno quaesumus Domine vultu dignare respicere et petitionibus eorum fave clementer ut dono tuae clementiae muniti et vivi mereantur impetrare praesentis vitae suffragia et defunctis omnibus requies praestetur aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to look upon the oblation of Your family with a serene countenance and to show favor with clemency towards their petitions. May they, fortified by Your mercy, deserve to obtain the intercession in this life, and may eternal rest be granted to all the departed.

text: Oblationem famulorum tuorum suscipe omnipotens Deus quam tibi suppliciter deferimus in honorem beati Bonifatii martyris tui sociorumque eius ut qui tibi semetipsum obtulit hostiam laudis in odorem suavitatis eius nos precibus uniri mereamur unigenito filio tuo domino nostro Iesu Christo.
translation_en: Accept, Almighty God, the offering of your servants which we humbly present to you in honor of Blessed Boniface, your martyr and companions, so that we may be worthy to be united with the prayers through whom he offered himself as a sacrifice of praise in a sweet-smelling incense to you. We make this offering to your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Oblationem nostram quaesumus Domine misericorditer acceptare et sanctificare digneris ut eius sanctificatione nobis salus proveniat et defensio sempiterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to graciously receive and sanctify our offering. May it bring salvation to us through its sanctification, and everlasting protection as well.

text: Oblationes et preces Ecclesiae tuae martyrum tuorum Domine Sergii et Bacchi commendet oratio ut et munera nostra tibi reddantur accepta et ab omnibus peccatis et periculis eruamur.
translation_en: Oblations and prayers of your church, Lord, for Your martyrs Sergius and Bacchus, we commit to You. May our offerings be returned to You accepted, and may we be freed from all sins and dangers.

text: Oblationes in angustia pro peccatis atque offensionibus famuli tui illius in hac domo consistentis omnipotens Deus oblatas accipe quia in te confidimus vere prophetam dixisse: »Immola Deo sacrificium laudis et redde altissimo vota tua invoca me in die tribulationis tuae eripiam te et magnificabis me.«
translation_en: Offerings for the troubles caused by the sins and offenses of your servant dwelling in this house, Almighty God, receive what has been offered to you, for truly we trust that the prophet spoke truthfully when he said: "Offer a sacrifice to God in praise and return your vows to the most high, invoke me on the day of your tribulation, I will rescue you and you will magnify me."

text: Tu es Domine qui restitues mihi hereditatem meam.
translation_en: You are Lord, who restore to me my inheritance.

text: Oblationes nostras Domine quaesumus propitiatus intende quas et ad honorem sancti martyris tui Laurentii nomini tuae maiestatis offerimus et pro requie famuli tui illius episcopi suppliciter immolamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you regard our offerings. Those which we offer in honor of your saintly martyr Lawrence, to the majesty of your name, and for the rest of your servant bishop, we prayingly present.

text: Oblationes nostras quaesumus Domine beatae Margaretae virginis et martyris tuae tibi commendet pia supplicatio ut nos et a peccatis expediant et tuae miserationi reddant acceptos.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, of the blessed Margaret, virgin and martyr, that a devout petition may commend our offerings to you. May we be delivered from sins and be acceptable to your mercy.

text: Oblationes nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus intende quas in honorem beatae et gloriosae semperque virginis Dei Genitricis Mariae annua sollemnitate deferimus et coaeternus Spiritus Sanctus tuus qui illius viscera splendore suae gratiae veritatis replevit nos ab omni facinore delictorum emundet benignus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you direct our offerings, which we present on the annual solemnity in honor of the blessed and glorious ever-virgin Mother of God, Mary. May your coeternal Holy Spirit, who filled her with the splendor of his grace and truth, cleanse us kindly from all guilt of sin.

text: Oblationes nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus intende quas in honorem sanctae Trinitatis nomini tuo consecrandas deferimus ut maculas peccatorum nostrorum quae neglegenter gessimus te propitiante delere mereamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you, being gracious, direct your attention to the offerings we bring before you in honor of the Holy Trinity and consecrate them with your name. May it be that because of your forgiveness we may deserve to have our sins, which we have committed negligently, washed away.

text: Oblationes nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus intende quas tibi in honorem beati Machuti confessoris tui atque pontificis consecrandas deferimus precantes ut ipsius meritis et intercessione peccatorum omnium quae neglegenter gessimus te propitiante veniam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you turn your favorable regard towards our offerings, which we bring to you in honor of your confessor and bishop, blessed Machutus. We pray that through his merits and intercession, may we be worthy to obtain forgiveness for all the sins we have negligently committed, as you are merciful.

text: Tu nobis Domine auxilium praestare
translation_en: Lord, grant us aid.

text: Oblationes nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus intende quas tibi offerimus in honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et in commemorationem beatae virginis Mariae et beatorum apostolorum et martyrum et confessurum ac virginum tuarum pro pace et sanitate populorum tuorum et prosperitate itineris nostri et incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum commemorationem agimus et pro animabus omnium fidelium defunctorum catholicorum orthodoxorum quorum numerum et nomina tu solus Domine cognoscis et concede ut per sacrificium praesentis oblationis ad refrigerium animarum suarum te miserante proveniant.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you direct your favor towards our offerings, which we present to you in honor of our Lord Jesus Christ, and in commemoration of the blessed Virgin Mary, the apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all of your servants. We pray for peace, health, prosperity in our journey, and safety and well-being for your servants, both laypeople and clergy, whom we remember. Additionally, we pray for the souls of all departed faithful Catholics and Orthodox, whose number and names only you, Lord, know. Grant us that through the sacrifice of this present offering, their souls may find relief through your mercy.

text: Oblationes nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus intende quas tibi offerimus in honorem sanctorum tuorum martyrum et confessorum vel quorum hodie natalicia celebrantur ut veniam pro delictorum nostrorum consequi mereamur et pro incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum qui nobis eleemosynarum subsidia porrigentes donaverunt tam pro vivis quam et defunctis seu iter agentibus vel ubicumque commorantibus quorum nomina tibi soli cognita sunt ut sacrificii praesentis oblatio mortuis ad veniam vivis proficiat ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you pay attention to our offerings. Those which we present to you in honor of your saints, the martyrs and confessors, whose natal days are celebrated today, so that we may deserve forgiveness for our sins, and for the safety of your servants and handmaids who have provided us with alms as support, both for the living and the dead, or those traveling or dwelling anywhere, whose names are known only to you. May the offering of this sacrifice benefit the dead for forgiveness and healing for the living.

text: Oblationes nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus intende quas tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius et cui donasti baptismi sacramentum da ei aeternorum plenitudinem gaudiorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to direct your mercy towards our offerings. Those we present to you for the soul of your servant and whom you bestowed with the sacrament of baptism, grant him the fullness of eternal joys.

text: Oblationes nostras quaesumus Domine tua tibi dignatione fac placitas quia nihil in nobis quod placare te possit nisi deprecantibus sanctis tua nos propitiatione praevenias.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, that your kindness may make our offerings acceptable to you; for there is nothing in us worthy of pleasing you except through the intercession of your saints. May you, in your mercy, precede us.

text: Oblationes populi tui Domine quaesumus apostolorum tuorum passio beata conciliet et quae nostris minus aptae sunt meritis fiant tibi placitae tuorum deprecatione iustorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the passion of your apostles may unite and reconcile the offerings of your people. And that which is less fitting for us due to our inadequate merits, may through the intercession of the righteous become pleasing to you.

text: Oblationes familiae tuae Domine quaesumus beatissimorum sanctorum tuorum confessio beata conciliet et quae nostris minus aptae sunt meritis fiant tibi placitae tuorum deprecatione iustorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offerings of your family may be accepted by the most blessed confession of your saints. May those things that are less fitting on our account become pleasing to you through the intercession of the just.

text: Oblationes populi tui Domine quaesumus beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli passio beata conciliet et quae nostris non apta sunt meritis fiant tibi placita tuorum deprecatione iustorum.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, the offerings of your people. Through the intercession of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, may their passion be acceptable to you, and those things that are not fitting for our merits become pleasing to you through the prayer of your righteous ones.

text: Oblationes populi tui Domine quaesumus beati apostoli tui Iacobi passio beata conciliet et quae nostris non apta(e) sunt meritis fiant tibi placita(e) eius deprecatione.
translation_en: We beseech your offerings, Lord, for your people, that the passion of your blessed apostle James may unite and what is not fitting for us due to our unworthy merits may become pleasing to you through his intercession.

text: Oblationes populi tui Domine quaesumus confessoris tui Leonardi interventione benignus assume ut quod ad laudem tui nominis devoti offerimus nostrae in perpetuum fiat causa salutis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that through the intervention of your confesseur Leonardo, you graciously accept the oblations of your people. May what we offer in devotion to your name for our eternal salvation become an everlasting cause for praise.

text: Oblationes populi tui Domine quaesumus placatus intende quibus et sanctorum martyrum celebramus in honorem tui nominis passionem et nobis indulgentiam suppliciter imploramus.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your favorable attention be directed to the offerings of your people. For the feast of the saints and martyrs we celebrate in honor of your name, we fervently beseech you for the granting of mercy upon us.

text: Oblationibus Domine placare susceptis et ad te nostras etiam rebelles compelle propitius voluntates.
translation_en: Lord, favorably receive our offerings and compel us even rebellious ones, propitiously bend our wills towards you.

text: Oblationibus nostris quaesumus Domine propitiatus intende et ob tuorum omnium sanctorum honorem veniam nobis nostrorum tribue delictorum ac christianis omnibus viventibus atque defunctis haec sancta praesens libatio et vitae praesentis commoda et futuri regni praemia acquirat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to incline favorably towards our offerings. Through the merits of all your saints, grant us forgiveness for our sins and award this present holy libation to us and to all Christians, living and dead, that they may acquire the benefits of this present life and the rewards of eternal life.

text: Oblationibus quaesumus Domine precibusque susceptis intercedente beata Maria semper virgine his sacrificiis peccata nostra mundentur et ad te nostras etiam rebelles compelle propitius voluntates vitamque nobis largire aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that with these offerings and prayers, through the intercession of blessed Mary, the ever-virgin, our sins may be cleansed. May you also compel the rebelliousness of us, and graciously grant us an eternal life.

text: Tua nos Domine quaesumus gratia benedicat
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, may your grace bless us.

text: Oblationis huius Domine placare muneribus et intercedentibus omnibus sanctis tuis (me et) omnem populum christianum a cunctis defende periculis et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum illorum et illarum et cunctorum fidelium defunctorum per haec sancta sacrificia remissionem omnium tribue peccatorum.
translation_en: Lord, grant propitiation for this offering and through all your saints (me and) the entire Christian people, defend them from all dangers. For the souls of your servants, both men and women, and all the faithful departed, grant them remission of all their sins through these holy sacrifices.

text: Oblationis nostrae munus tua Domine et benedicat et suscipiat dextera et supplicante sancto Barnaba apostolo acceptabile holocaustum nos tibi praepara.
translation_en: May our offering, Lord, be blessed by You and received by Your right hand. Through the intercession of the holy Apostle Barnabas, may it be an acceptable holocaust to You, which we prepare for You.

text: Oblatis Domine muneribus suppliciter deprecamur ut qui veram Verbi tui incarnationem fideliter veneramur veram eiusdem substantiam carnis ac sanguinis quam per Spiritum Sanctum virgo mater edidit in hoc praesenti mysterio salubriter percipiamus.
translation_en: Lord, who are offered these gifts, we humbly beseech you that we who faithfully adore the true incarnation of your Word, may we healthily receive the same substance of his flesh and blood, which the Holy Spirit caused the Virgin Mother to bring forth in this present mystery.

text: Oblatis Domine ob honorem beati confessoris tui Benedicti placare muneribus et ipsius tuis famulis interventu cunctorum tribue indulgentiam peccatorum.
translation_en: Lord, with offerings made for the honor of your blessed confessor Benedict, we pray that you grant pardon by these gifts and through the intervention of all, bestow an indulgence for sins.

text: Oblatis Domine placare muneribus et famulum tuum illum quem pastorem populo tuo (prae)esse voluisti assidua protectione guberna.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive the offerings and govern your servant whom you have willed to serve as shepherd for your people with constant protection.

text: Tua nos Domine veritas semper illuminet
translation_en: May Your truth, Lord, always enlighten us

text: Oblatis Domine placare muneribus et opportunum tribue nobis pluviae sufficientis auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, incline favorably towards our offerings and grant us a sufficient help in the form of suitable rain.

text: Oblatis Domine quaesumus placare muneribus et nos ab inimicis nostris clementer eripe eisque indulgentiam tribue delictorum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you appease the offerings and mercifully deliver us from our enemies. To them, grant forgiveness for their sins.

text: Oblatis hostiis Domine quaesumus praesenti famulae tuae perseverantiam perpetuae virginitatis accommoda ut apertis ianuis summi regis adventu cum laetitia mereatur intrare.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you, grant perserverance in eternal virginity to the one who brings offerings. May she merit to enter with joy through the open doors of the King's reign at his advent.

text: Oblatis muneribus Domine plebs fidelis exsultet quia pariter apostolicae gaudia passionis et in eis te praedicare mirabilem confidit ad suae pertinere salutis augmenta.
translation_en: With offerings, Lord, may the faithful people rejoice because they confidently believe that you will proclaim a wonderful message about the apostolic joys of your passion and that their share in eternal salvation will increase through it.

text: Oblatis muneribus maiestati tuae Domine devote supplicamus ut beatus martyr Antoninus gratanter exoptet hoc mysterium nos digne perficere.
translation_en: With our offerings, we humbly beseech Your Majesty, Lord, that the blessed martyr Antoninus may graciously expect us to complete this mystery worthily.

text: Oblatis quaesumus Domine placare muneribus et a cunctis nos defende periculis.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to be pleased with our offerings and defend us from all dangers.

text: Oblatis quaesumus Domine placare muneribus et intercedente beato Valentino martyre tuo a cunctis nos defende periculis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to look favorably upon the offerings and through the intercession of your martyr Saint Valentine, protect us from all dangers.

text: Oblatis tibi Domine libaminibus sacrificiorum respice humilitatis nostrae ieiunium ut haec oblata sanctifices et sumentium ariditatem tuae benedictionis ubertate sustentes.
translation_en: Lord, with offerings of incense and sacrifice, we humbly beseech you to look upon our fasting. May these offerings be sanctified by you, and strengthened by the abundance of your blessing, may they overcome their aridity.

text: Oblatis tibi Domine libaminibus sacrificiorum respice humilitatis nostrae confessionem ut haec oblata sanctifices quae tibi offerimus pro remissione peccatorum nostrorum vel defunctorum fratrum requie et ut sumentium ariditatem tuae benedictionis ubertas sustentet.
translation_en: Lord, as we present before you the incense of our sacrifices, look upon our humble confession. May these offerings be sanctified, which we present to you for the remission of our sins or for the rest of our deceased brothers. And may the abundance of your blessing sustain them who partake in your aridity.

text: Oblatis tibi Domine fidelium tuorum muneribus intende propitius et ut nullius irrita postulatio nullius inane sit votum gloriosi martyris tui Magni desideratum nobis praebe
translation_en: Lord, incline your attention graciously towards the offerings of your faithful people. And may no empty request, no vain vow be for any (one), grant us the desire for the glorious martyr, your Magnus.

text: Oblatis tibi muneribus quaesumus Deus Pater omnipotens propitiatus intende ut intercedente sancto Zenone sacerdote et confessore tuo et ab occulta insidiatoris impulsione fragilitatem nostram tueantur illaesam et angelicis devote manibus suscepta sacratis ante conspectum gloriosae et tremendae maiestatis tuae in odorem suavitatis alacriter deferantur.
translation_en: We present to you, Lord God Almighty, merciful Father, we humbly ask that You direct Your attention, with the intercession of Saint Zenon, your priest and confessor, that they may protect our frailty from the hidden snares of the enemy. May they be carried by angelic hands, with devotion, to the sight of Your glorious and awesome majesty, and may they be offered swiftly as a fragrant offering.

text: Oblatum tibi Domine munus pro beati Saturnini martyris tui passione propitius assume quod eius intercessione maiestati tuae fiat acceptum.
translation_en: Lord, offerings made to you for the blessed Martyr Saturninus, graciously receive them. May they be accepted by your majesty through his intercession.

text: Tuam clementissime Pater omnipotentiam ... ut indundere
translation_en: Your most merciful Father, all-powerful... that you would pour out

text: Oblatum tibi Domine ob honorem beatae Mariae Magdalenae sacrificium propitius suscipe et ipsius nos sectatores efficiens cunctorum nobis facinorum veniam tribue.
translation_en: Offered to You, Lord, as a tribute for the honor of blessed Mary Magdalene, may You graciously receive this sacrifice and making us her followers, grant forgiveness for all our sins.

text: Oblatum tibi Domine sacrificium vivificet nos semper et muniat.
translation_en: Offered to You, Lord, may this sacrifice make us always live, and protect us forever.

text: Oblatum tibi hoc sacrificium Deus pater in huius martyris tui Saturnini sollemnitate serenus accepta et illa invisibili gratia tuae benedictionis sanctifica ut sicut idem martyr participatione tua gratuitus praesentia sui daemonica fecit simulacra silere ita nos horum sacramentorum perceptione exstirpemus in nobis omnem diabolicae temptationis errorem.
translation_en: This offering you have received, O God, Father, in the solemnity of your martyr Saturninus, was accepted serenely and sanctified by your invisible grace, so that just as the same martyr, through your gracious presence, made demonic images cease with his gratuitous presence, so we, through our perception of these sacraments, may uproot from us every error caused by diabolical temptation.

text: Oblatum tibi sacrificium benignus assume et intercedente beato Petro apostolo tuo adversus omnium inimicorum insidias continuum praesta pius auxilium.
translation_en: Accept this offering graciously, and through the intercession of blessed Peter, your apostle, may you constantly provide pious aid against the plots of all enemies.

text: Obsecramus piissime Deus ut qui adustum facibus corpus martyris tui Cucufatis ignem copiosum in nullo permisisti contaminare nec viventes praesentis vitae exurat tribulatio vel quaelibet molestia et defunctos tua miseratio eruat a tormentis.
translation_en: We humbly ask the most compassionate God, that just as you allowed the body of your martyr Cucufatus to be untouched by the copious fire kindled by his tormentors in this life, so may living beings not be consumed by the trials or any disturbance of the present life, and may your mercy release the departed from torments.

text: Observationis annuae celebritate gratulantes quaesumus Domine ut eorum quorum actionibus inhaeremus plenis effectibus gaudeamus.
translation_en: On the occasion of the annual observance, we humbly ask you, Lord, that we may rejoice with full effects in the actions of those whom we are connected to.

text: Observationis huius annua celebritate laetantes quaesumus Domine ut paschalibus actionibus inhaerentes plenis eius effectibus gaudeamus.
translation_en: On this annual observance, we rejoice and humbly ask you, Lord, that we may partake in the Paschal actions with full effect, thereby enjoying the fruits of your blessings.

text: Occurrentes Domine cum coetu totius populi ut sollemne paschae celebremus initium nos propitiatus attende supplicantes humiliter et orantes ut qui ab huius mundi operibus fatigati et corporis amictu sordentes ad tuam sacratissimam conveniemus cenam expurgatos nos ab omni cibo malitiae in novam convertas prosapiem ut cum tua gratia et victu terreno et caelesti pane mereamur in tuo saturari convivio.
translation_en: Lord, coming with the assembly of the entire people to celebrate the solemn feast of Easter, we humbly beseech you to attend us. May those who, wearied by the works of this world and stained by the garment of the flesh, come before your most sacred banquet, cleanse us from all food of wickedness. Turn us anew to our birthright, that we may deserve, with your grace, both earthly and heavenly bread, to be satisfied at your feast.

text: Odorem Domine sacrificii huius cum gratiarum actionibus suscipe et praesta ut quos exaudire et incolumes servare dignatus es ab omni in posterum adversitate custodias et in tuo servitio et amore concrescant.
translation_en: Lord, receive the smell of this sacrifice with acts of thanksgiving and grant that You who have deigned to hear and save us safely from all adversity for the future, may keep us under Your protection. May we grow in Your service and love.

text: Offerendorum tibi munerum Deus auctor et dator praesta ut quod sanctis martyribus in persecutione contulit claritatem nobis fiat in devotione praesidium.
translation_en: God, the author and giver of offerings, grant that what the holy martyrs achieved through their persecution becomes for us a protection in our devotion.

text: Offerendorum tibi munerum auctor et dator praesta ut hoc sacrificium singulare quod sanctis tuis in passione contulit claritatem nobis tribuat in devotione praesidium.
translation_en: The author and giver of offerings grant that this singular sacrifice, which brought clarity to your saints in their passion, may grant us protection in our devotion.

text: Offerente famulo tuo illo tibi Domine munera eum tuo nomine semper glorifica ut eius vota propitiatus suscipias et peccata cuncta dimittas.
translation_en: Your servant offers you, Lord, the gifts in your name; may you always be glorified for them. May you be gracious to grant his requests, and forgive all his sins.

text: Offerentibus nobis Domine pro famulis tuis sacerdotibus illis in tuo nomine hostias placationis et laudis tu eas glorifica ut eorum vota perficias et peccata eorum cuncta dimittas.
translation_en: Lord, we offer these gifts to You on behalf of Your servants, the priests, in Your name as offerings of propitiation and praise. May You glorify them so that You fulfill their wishes and forgive all their sins.

text: Offerentes Deo fratres carissimi spiritalia munera divinam clementiam deprecemur ut has oblationes quas in commemorationem sanctorum et pro salute omnium credentium offerimus plena pietatis suae dignatione suscipiat <et> nostrum omnium preces exaudiat.
translation_en: We, the dearest brothers, present spiritual gifts to God, we humbly beseech His divine clemency, that He may accept these offerings which we make in commemoration of saints and for the salvation of all believers. May He receive them with His gracious benediction, and hear our prayers on behalf of ourselves and all.

text: Offerentes tibi Deus has terrae nostrae primitias ut dignabili eas iubeas pietate suscipere deprecamur quo ex his sumentibus peccata dimittas et frugem nostram noxiis carentem multiplici copia cumulari concedas. Speciali quoque prece rogamus ut placatus his sacrificiis et gratiam vivis et requiem iubeas praestare defunctis.
translation_en: We offer to You, God, the first fruits of our earth, that You may graciously command them to be received with a merciful disposition. We humbly pray that from those who partake of these first fruits, You will forgive their sins and grant our produce to be abundant and free from harm. Furthermore, we also beseech You, through special prayer, that You may bestow favor upon these sacrifices and grant them both grace in life and peace for the departed.

text: Offerentes tibi Deus sacrificium laudis rogamus ut et oblata acceptes et oblatores sanctifices quatenus libantes ex eis hereditatem capiamus aeternam.
translation_en: We offer You, God, a sacrifice of praise, we humbly ask that not only the offerings be accepted but also the offerers be sanctified. May it be so that through these sacrifices we may inherit an eternal heritage.

text: Tuere nos superne moderator
translation_en: Guard us above, O Sovereign One

text: Offerentes tibi Domine hostiam iubilationis pro delictis nostris pietatem tuam exposcimus ut placabili pietate petitionibus nostris aurem accommodes votum nostrum pia dignatione acceptes tribulationes cordis nostri multiplici miseratione laetifices et quod in oratione lingua nostra enarrare non sufficit tu qui (et) cordis cogitationes agnoscis et renum scrutator es tribuas. Quae desiderat mens devota tua suppleat misericordia consueta.
translation_en: Offering to You, Lord, a sacrifice of exultation for our sins, we humbly entreat Your compassion that with favorable compassion, You might hear our prayers and grant our vow accepted by Your gracious consideration. May You, in abundant mercy, relieve the tribulations of our hearts and make us rejoice. And because what our devoted mind desires cannot be fully expressed in our language, You who know the thoughts of the heart and search the kidneys, grant us accordingly.

text: Offerentes tibi Domine oblationum vota celebrantesque ieiuniorum festa supplici corde et prompta voluntate de tua misericordia praesumentes rogamus ut haec hostia quae a nobis indignis offertur gratiam in conspectu maiestatis tuae inveniat benedictionumque tuarum ubertate repleta dum nostris fuerit percepta visceribus cunctarum sordium squalores radicitus a nostris cordibus pellat et remedium nostris mentibus corporibusque salutem acquirat.
translation_en: Offering to you, Lord, we present our vows and celebrate the feasts of the fasting with a humble heart and readiness of will, presumptuously asking for your mercy. We humbly ask that this offering, which is unworthy of us, may find favor in the sight of your majesty and be filled with your blessings. May it be received into our hearts so that all filth and squalor are rooted out from our hearts, and may it bring healing to our minds and bodies.

text: Offerenti(bu)s famuli(s) tui(s) munera piissime Deus pro spiritu famuli tui illius (ea) pie suscipere dignare et per intercessionem sanctorum tuorum illorum occurrat ei misericordiae tuae donum et animae eius dona requiem gloriosam sanctisque tuis tribue eum esse consortem et aeternam ei concede felicitatem.
translation_en: We humbly offer, Thy servant, the most pious gifts, O God, for the spirit of thy servant. Grant him worthy to receive them with devotion, and through the intercession of thy saints, may mercy reach him and give him a glorious rest. May his soul be given eternal happiness among thy saints.

text: Offerentium aeterne Deus susceptans oblationes effice nos spiritu ferventes et caritate locupletes quo unitatem spiritus servantes in vinculo pacis illius dono iam impleamur in terris cuius infusionem advenire nobis exspectamus e caelis.
translation_en: May the eternal God, receiving the offerings of the faithful, make us fervent in spirit and rich in love, so that while serving unity of spirit in the bond of peace, we may already be filled on earth. The infusion which we eagerly await from heaven shall come upon us.

text: Offerentium Deus pater quaesumus vota suscipito quo viventium oblatione suscepta defunctis fidelibus requies impetretur aeterna.
translation_en: We ask You, God the Father, to accept the vows of those offering; may eternal rest be granted to the departed faithful, through the oblation of the living.

text: Offerentium Domine suscipe votum nostrumque ieiunium facito coram te esse acceptum quo nostra delens peccata propitius ita defunctis fidelibus refrigerium praestes ut beatorum consortio eos sine fine laetifices.
translation_en: Lord, receive our offering and our fasting. Make our repentance be present before you as an accepted sacrifice, so that you may show mercy to us, as we lay aside our sins. May you provide refreshment for the faithful departed, so that they may be endlessly happy in the company of the blessed.

text: Offerentium nominibus recensitis fratres carissimi Deum dominum deprecemur ut dignetur orantibus assistere adesse quaerentibus pulsantibus aperire. Offerentium nomina scribat in caelis. Promissionem suam manifestet in sanctis. Misericordiam suam ostendat in perditis. Quia imbecilla est nostrae infirmitatis oratio – quid oremus sicut oportet nescimus – advocemus in suffragium precum nostrarum receptos in caelesti collegio patriarchas repletos divino spiritu prophetas apostolos ad officium praedicationis electos martyres confessionis floribus adornatos per quos oremus dominum ut omnes inopia afflictos tribulatione vexatos morbis oppressos suppliciis deditos debitis obligatos indulgentia suae resurrectionis absolvat.
translation_en: Having reviewed the names of the offerers, we humbly beseech our dear God and Lord that He may deign to assist those who pray, be present to those who seek, open to those who knock. Let their names be written in heaven. May He manifest His promise in the saints. May He show His mercy on the lost. Since our prayer is weak because of our infirmity – we do not know what to ask as we ought – we invoke in the support of our prayers, those received into the celestial college of patriarchs, filled with divine spirit, prophets, apostles, elect for the office of preaching, martyrs adorned with flowers of confession, through whom we pray the Lord that He may absolve all who are afflicted by poverty, troubled by tribulation, oppressed by disease, dedicated to suffering, obligated by duty, with the indulgence of His resurrection.

text: Offerentium nominibus recensitis fratres carissimi dominum deprecemur ut eorum oblationes inter sanctorum dona suscipiat quorum a nobis facienda commemoratio est ut et nostri memores esse dignentur. Petamus et pro his qui nos in dominica pace praecesserunt ut tartario horrore segregatus in sinu Abrahae collocatos resuscitare omnipotens dignetur in prima sua resurrectione qua futurus est.
translation_en: Having reviewed the names of those offering, we humbly beseech our dear Lord that He may receive their offerings among the gifts of the saints, for whose performance by us a remembrance is made, so that they may also remember us.
