We pray for those who have preceded us in peace on Sundays, and separate from the terror of Tartarus, let them be placed in the bosom of Abraham, may He deem it worthy to resurrect them in His first resurrection, which is yet to come.

text: Offerentium nominibus recensitis (suppliciter exoramus ut) qui devota altaribus munera (deferentes) humiliati ieiunio mentis et corporis a domino deprecentur pro merito devotae sanctificationis (quod postulant) obtineant.
translation_en: After reviewing the names of those offering (we humbly ask that) those who bring devout gifts to the altars, may they be humbled by a fasting of mind and body before the Lord, be granted in return for their devotion to holy sanctification which they seek.

text: Offerentium nuncupatione comperta quae etiam dantium accipientiumque personas nota vocabulorum designatione monstravit ad de<re>licta precum revertamur officia sperantes de potentia Trinitatis immensae ut et superstitum confirmet vota et defunctorum laxet ergastula ut vivis praestans gratiam pariter et sepultis et hos exaudiat cum invocaverint et illos quia quondam invocaverunt non condemnet.
translation_en: Having learned the names of those who offer, give, and receive, as shown by the designation of known words, we return to our duties for prayers dedicated to the immense power of the Trinity. We hope that it confirms the vows of the devout and loosens the prison chains of the deceased. May it bestow its grace upon both the living and the buried, and may it hear them when they call, while not condemning those who once called upon it.

text: Offerentium pie Christe suscipe vota sanctorumque tuorum nobis concede suffragia et defunctis in pace requiem largire lucifluam.
translation_en: Christ, graciously receive the prayers of the faithful. Grant us their intercession and bestow upon the departed eternal rest in peace.

text: Offerentium quaesumus Domine vota multiplica et omnes verae credulitatis instrumentis perlustra sicque nobis per hoc sacrificium adesto placatus ut nos et a peccatis et a periculis omnibus miseratus absolvas.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to multiply the vows of the offerers and to illuminate all instruments of true faith. May we be present through this sacrifice, graciously appeared, and mercifully save us from sins and all dangers.

text: Offerentium quaesumus Domine vota multiplica et omnes in commune verae credulitatis instrumento perlustra sicque nobis per hoc sacrificium quod tibi cum voto fidei dedicamus adesto placatus ut et viventibus veniam et sepul5 tis requiem impetremus aeternam.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to multiply the vows of those offering and to enlighten all by the instrument of true faith. May we, through this sacrifice which we dedicate to you with the pledge of our faith, be attended graciously and pleased. Through your favor, may we implore for them both pardon while living and eternal rest for the departed.

text: Offerentium tibi Deus pater vota sanctificans sic ieiunantium precibus adesto ut defunctis fidelibus aeternae concedatur beatitudinis locus.
translation_en: God, Father, the offerings made to you are sanctified by the vows of those who are fasting. Be present with their prayers so that for the faithful departed, may an eternal place of beatitude be granted.

text: Offerentium tibi munera quaesumus Domine ne delicta respicias sed intercessorum merita propitius intuere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept the offerings presented. May you not look upon our sins, but graciously consider the merits of our intercessors.

text: Offerentium vota ac sepultorum memoriam horum tibi martyrum Domine commenda suffragiis quorum corpora post mortem dignis glorificasti exsequiis. Sit quaesumus in hac praesenti celebritate absolutio defunctis et spiritalis laetitia in commune omnibus christianis.
translation_en: Lord, commend to the intercession of these martyrs whose bodies you glorified after death through worthy rites, the prayers and remembrance of the departed. May there be in this present solemnity an absolution for the deceased and spiritual joy for all Christians.

text: Offerimus Domine laudes et munera pro concessis beneficiis exhibentes gratias et pro concedendis suppliciter deprecantes.
translation_en: We offer, Lord, praises and gifts in thanks for granted benefits, expressing gratitude, and humbly entreating for those yet to be granted.

text: Offerimus Domine laudes et munera pro concessis beneficiis gratias referentes et pro concedendis semper suppliciter deprecantes.
translation_en: We offer, Lord, praises and gifts in thanks for granted benefits, and we humbly entreat You always for further blessings.

text: Tuus est dies Domine et tua nox
translation_en: The day is yours, Lord, and the night.

text: Offerimus Domine munera tuorum tibi sollemnitatibus grata sanctorum tuam clementiam deprecantes ut quod ad illorum pertinet gloriam nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: We offer, Lord, the gifts that are yours to you in solemnity, entreating your clemency with grateful prayers of the saints. We ask that what is their glory may benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Offerimus Domine preces et munera in honorem sanctorum tuorum gaudentes; praesta quaesumus ut et convenienter haec agere et remedium sempiternum valeamus acquirere.
translation_en: We offer, Lord, our prayers and gifts in honor of your saints, rejoicing; grant us we ask, that we may perform these things suitably and be able to acquire eternal salvation.

text: Ubi ergo te latebis
translation_en: Where then will you hide?

text: Offerimus hostias Domine in sancti Laurentii martyris tui hodierna festivitate gaudentes quae nobis operante te Domine et auxilium contulit et profectum.
translation_en: We offer sacrifices to you, Lord, on the festival day of Saint Lawrence your martyr, rejoicing, for it is you, Lord, who have helped us and supported our progress.

text: Ubi infirmus ad eum deportatus.
translation_en: When a sick person was brought to him.

text: Offerimus hostias nomini tuo Domine quantum de nostro merito trepidi tantum de sanctorum suffragiis confidentes; praesta quaesumus ut nobis et veniam conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We offer sacrifices to Your name, Lord, as much as we dare from our merit, yet as confident in the intercession of the saints; grant us we ask, that they may bestow upon us forgiveness and salvation.

text: Offerimus sacrificium Domine quod pro reverentia beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli maiestati tuae iugiter et reddimus et debemus.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, a sacrifice which for the reverence of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, we present to Your majesty continually, and we render it and are obliged to do so.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine fidelium tuorum dona sollemnia sanctorum martyrum tuorum interventionibus confidentes ut quod nos exsequimur minus idonea servitute illorum potius meritis efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the solemn gifts of your faithful, confident in the intercessions of your holy martyrs, that what we carry out may be made acceptable not by our unworthy service but rather by their merits.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine hostiam placationis et laudis humiliter implorantes ut et eam placabili pietate respicias et offerentium preces clementi largitate exaudias.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, a sacrifice of propitiation and praise, humbly entreating You that You may also look upon it with pleasing piety and grant us the prayer of the supplicants with a merciful generosity.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine hostiam placationis et laudis ut per tuae misericordiae largitatem animam famuli tui illius in lucis aeternae facias regione gaudere.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, a sacrifice of reconciliation and praise, that through your merciful generosity, may the soul of that servant of yours rejoice in the region of eternal light.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine munera et vota in nomine electi martyris tui Sigismundi pro praesenti aegroto illo (qui cottidiano biduano tertiano vel quartano typo vexationis laborat) ut ab eo omnes febrium ardores repellere iubeas et tuo semper (in omnibus) muniatur auxilio.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, gifts and vows in the name of your elected martyr Sigismund, for that ill person (who daily labors with a third or fourth type of vexation) that You may command him to drive away all feverish burns. May he always be protected by Your aid.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine munera quae dedisti ut et creationis tuae circa mortalitatem nostram testificentur auxilium et remedium nobis immortalitatis operentur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the gifts which You have given, so that they may bear witness around our mortality of Your help and remedy, and may work for us the operation of immortality.

text: Ut a nostris excessibus
translation_en: That we may be free from our excesses

text: Offerimus tibi Domine munera supplicantes ut quae subditis celebramus officiis plenis effectibus exsequamur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, our gifts while we humbly ask that what we perform with full offices may be carried out effectively.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine munus quod sicut duplici sumentes corde condemnat ita sincera capientes mente iustificat.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, a gift, which, as we take it with doubting hearts, it is made pure by our sincere minds.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine oblationem nostrae servitutis pro animabus famulorum tuorum pontificum supplicantes ut cum praesulibus apostolicae dignitatis quorum sunt exsecuti officium habere mereantur sempiternae beatitudinis portionem.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, our oblation of servitude for the souls of Your servants, the pontiffs, supplicating that they may deserve a share of everlasting beatitude, together with those who have executed the office of apostolic dignity.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine placabile munus (de)precantes ut sicut beato Petro apostolo (tuo) in vinculis dedisti constantiam ita nobis tua gratia indulgentiam operetur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, a pleasing gift (from) praying that just as You granted constancy to the blessed Apostle Peter who was in chains, so Your grace may work indulgence for us.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine praesentem oblatam beati Pontii martyris tui sollemnia recensentes humiliter implorantes ut nobis prosit ad praesentem vitam atque futuram.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the present offering, recently made in honor of Your blessed martyr, Pope Pontius. Humbly we ask, remembering his solemnity, that it may benefit us in our current and future life.

text: Ut autem venerint ad ecclesiam.
translation_en: So that they may come to the church.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine preces et munera suppliciter exorantes ut intercessione beati Ricardi confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius translationis sollemnia colimus a vitiis ad virtutes et a carcere transferamur ad regnum.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, our prayers and gifts humbly beseeching, that through the intercession of your blessed confessor and pope, Saint Richard, whose solemnity we celebrate, we may be transferred from vices to virtues and from prison to kingdom.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine quae dicanda tuo nomini tu dedisti suppliciter exorantes ut sicut eadem nobis efficis sacramentum ita fieri tribuas remedium sempiternum.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, what is to be said in Your name, which You have given us humbly, beseeching You. So just as You make the sacrament effective for us, grant an eternal remedy.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine quaesumus preces et munera quae ut tuo sint digna conspectu(i) beatorum apostolorum tuorum precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, we humbly ask prayers and gifts, which we hope are worthy of your blessed apostles' sight. With their prayers, we are aided by you.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine quaesumus preces et munera quae ut tuo sint digna conspectu(i) beati martyris tui Timothei precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, we humbly ask prayers and gifts that they may be worthy of your blessed martyr Timothy's sight. Help us with our prayers.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine sollemne sacrificium pro veneranda sancti Georgii martyris tui passione deprecantes clementiam tuam ut per haec sacrosancta mysteria antiqui hostis temptamenta te triumphante vincamus et aeternae remunerationis praemium te largiente (con)sequamur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, a solemn sacrifice for the venerable passion of your martyr Saint George. We humbly ask for Your mercy that through these most sacred mysteries we may overcome the temptations of the ancient enemy and follow the reward of eternal remuneration which You generously bestow upon us (conquered) by Your triumph.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine sollemne sacrificium pro veneranda festivitate beati Vigilii martyris tui atque pontificis suppliciter maiestatem tuam deprecantes ut per haec sacrosancta mysteria et hostis temptamenta te triumphante vincamus et aeternae remunerationis emolumenta te largiente lucremur.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, a solemn sacrifice for the venerable feast of your martyr and bishop, Vigilius. Humbly we beseech your majesty that through these holy mysteries and our attempts against the host, we may overcome you triumphantly and earn rewards from eternal remuneration, which you generously bestow upon us.

text: Offerimus tibi Domine sanctorum tuorum Kiliani et sociorum eius natalicia recolentes sollemne sacrificium suppliciter implorantes ut iisdem intercedentibus nobis ad augmentum salutis aeternae provenire concedas.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the feast days of Your saints Kilian and his companions, recalling their natalities with solemn sacrifices. We humbly ask that through their intercession, may we obtain an increase in eternal salvation.

text: Offerimus tibi preces et hostias Domine Iesu Christe humiliter supplicantes ut qui transfixionem dulcissimi spiritus beatae Mariae matris tuae precibus recensemus suo suorumque sub cruce sanctorum multiplicato piissimo interventu meritis mortis tuae consortium cum beatis habeamus.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord Jesus Christ, our prayers and sacrifices humbly begging that, through the prayers of your blessed Mother Mary, we may recall her transfiguration and consider ourselves and our own under the cross of the saints, with your most merciful intervention, meriting a participation in your death with the saints.

text: Offerunt tibi Domine virtutum munera et vota credentes; suscipe nomini tuo debita honoris obsequia pro pace Ecclesiae tuae pro commemoratione omnium sanctorum pro sacerdotum et ministrorum puritate pro regum pacabilitate pro sufficientia rerum et temporum tranquillitate pro perseverantia virginum et continentia viduarum pro orphanorum tuitione et paenitentium sublevatione pro salute omnium viventium et pro requie defunctorum.
translation_en: They offer to You, Lord, the gifts of virtues and vows of believing ones; receive due acts of homage to Your name for the peace of Your Church, for the commemoration of all saints, for the purity of priests and ministers, for the tranquility of kings, for the sufficiency of resources and times, for the perseverance of virgins and chastity of widows, for the protection of orphans and upliftment of penitents, for the health of all living and for the rest of the dead.

text: Omnes qui huic tantae assumptionis sollemnitati convenistis et sacrosancta communione mortalia corpora vivificastis mereamini per interventum sanctae et gloriosae genitricis et hic ab omnibus malis eripi et in futuro cum Christo sine fine iucundari.
translation_en: All who have attended this solemnity of such a great assumption and have sanctified your mortal bodies with holy communion, you are worthy to be delivered from all evil by the intervention of the holy and glorious mother, and here be freed from all evils, and in the future enjoy Christ without end.

text: Omnes qui redemptionis nostrae causam colimus perditionis operam respuamus quique diem veneramur munerum noctem criminum non sequamur; qui putavimus traduci imputandum esse quod perimus noverimus redemptori nostro impendendum esse quod vivimus.  Ad aeternam nobis vitam quasi quidam pelagus data est temporalis navigatio ut inter bonorum et iniquitatis excursum aut peccatum pereat aut peccator ut aut excurrat fides circumspecta navigium aut incurrat securitas incauta naufragium. Satis est quod per tot saeculorum spatia genitalium funes traximus peccatorum quod in gulae scopulos per iudiciariae arboris stateram vento praecipitante mendacii libertatis statum inutilis gubernator illisit. Lignum nos decepit in diabolo lignum reparavit in Christo. Abyssi unda nos mersit baptismi unda nos redemit.  Pio igitur domini subiciamur imperio humilia mite iugum colla suscipiant; norunt quippe reficere onera ista portantes. Quibus data est ex liberalitate absolutio reddatur ex humilitate condicio. Inclina ergo precamur Christe Iesu tibi animas nostras ut tuum potius quam nostrum sequamur arbitrium quia melius est libertatem per diligentiam quaerere quam per confidentiam non habere.
translation_en: Let all who honor the cause of our redemption reject the works of destruction, and let those who come to the day of gifts not follow the night of crimes; let him know that what we suffer is what we owe to our Redeemer, and that what we live is what we offer to Him. To eternal life for us has been given like a certain sea as a temporal navigation, so that between the course of good and iniquity either sin perishes or the sinner, either the watchful faith steers the ship safely or the reckless security causes shipwreck. Enough have we drawn through the spaces of the centuries the fetters of sins, enough have we been cast upon the rocks of gluttony by the force of the wind of untruth's liberty, let a worthless helmsman rule over them. The wood has deceived us in the devil, the wood has saved us in Christ. The wave of the abyss has sunk us, the wave of baptism has redeemed us. Therefore, we submit ourselves to the gentle rule of our Lord's piety, let our necks bear a mild yoke; indeed, those who carry these burdens know how to refresh them. Given to them is forgiveness out of generosity, given back to them is their condition out of humility. Therefore, we pray, Christ Jesus, that You direct our souls rather than ourselves, because it is better to seek freedom through diligence than not to have it through confidence.

text: Omnipotens aeterne Deus da capiti nostro abundantiam aquae et oculis nostris sontem lacrimarum ut peccati macula abluti ultrices poenarum flammas fletus ubertate vincamus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, grant to our head an abundance of water and to our eyes the vision of tears, so that the stain of sin may be washed away by the flood of tears, overcoming the flames of punishment with their abundance.

text: Ut tuam Domine misericordiam consequamur
translation_en: So that we may obtain, Lord, Your mercy.

text: Omnipotens aeterne Deus per quem verus sacerdos tuus Babilas parvulis sibi in passione comitantibus tribus boiarum ponderibus adicitur vinculis arctioribus illigatur eculeoque suspenditur ut eo se tibi in verum sacrificium sacerdos venerabilis exhiberet quo numerosa tormentorum genera pro tuo Christe nomine pertulisset tu oblatis tibi sacrificiis benedicens exemplo Babilae sacerdotis tui carnales a nobis illecebras pelle et suffragio trium infantium gloria nos aeternitatis attolle.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, through whom Your true priest Babylas was bound with additional chains by three bulgars accompanying him in his passion and suspended on an ox as he offered himself as a true sacrifice to You. He bore numerous kinds of torments for Your name's sake, and You blessed the sacrifices offered to You, thereby causing earthly carnal temptations to be removed from us through his example. May the prayers of the three infants raise us up to eternal glory.

text: Omnipotens aeterne Deus qui ad martyris tui Felicis solvenda catenarum pondera in medios fluctus tuum delegasti angelum nostrorum quoque scelerum benignus dele chirographum.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who at the time of Your blessed martyr loosed the weights of the chains in the midst of Your waves by sending an angel, may You also mercifully erase the record of our sins.

text: Omnipotens aeterne Deus qui humano corpori a te ipso animam inspirare dignatus es dum te iubente pulvis pulveri rursum redditur tu imaginem tuam cum sanctis et electis tuis aeternis sedibus praecipias sociari.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who deigned to inspire an animated soul into human body by Yourself, when by Your command the dust of the earth again returns to dust; You command that You will associate Your image with the saints and elect in eternal dwellings.

text: Omnipotens aeterne Deus qui radiantibus beati Benedicti confessoris tui exemplis arduum tuis imitabile famulis iter fecisti da nobis inoffensis per eius instituta gressibus pergere ut eiusdem in regione viventium mereamur gaudiis admisceri.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who through the shining examples of your blessed confessor Benedict, have made a difficult path for your servant to follow, grant us the grace to walk without offense through his instituted steps. May we be worthy to join in the joys of those living in his region.

text: Omnipotens aeterne Deus suscipe propitius preces nostras pro animabus famulorum tuorum diaconorum ut in lucis regione eas in sanctorum tuorum numero facias aggregari.
translation_en: Almighty and eternal God, graciously receive our prayers for the souls of your servants, the deacons. May you gather them in the company of your saints in the realm of light.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus suscipe propitius preces nostras pro animabus famulorum tuorum diaconorum et omnium clericorum et locum lucis in sanctorum tuorum regione concede.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, graciously receive our prayers for the souls of your servants, the deacons, and all clergy. Grant them rest in the region of your saints.

text: Vere dignum et iustum est aequum
translation_en: It is truly worthy and just, fitting.

text: Omnipotens aeterne Deus tuae gratiae pietatem supplici devotione deposco ut omnium malorum meorum vincula solvas cunctisque meis criminibus et peccatis clementer ignoscas et quia me indignum et peccatorem ad ministerium tuum vocare dignatus es sic me idoneum tibi ministrum efficias ut sacrificium de manibus meis placide ac benigne suscipias electorumque sacerdotum ine participem facias et de praeceptis tuis in nullo me oberrare permittas.
translation_en: Eternal Almighty God, I humbly beseech Your grace's pity that You release me from the bonds of all my sins, and graciously forgive all my offenses and transgressions. Since You have deemed me unworthy and a sinner worthy to be called to Your service, make me suitable for you as a servant so that You may accept with peace and kindness the sacrifice from my hands, and make me a participant of the chosen priests. And allow me not to overstep in any of Your commandments.

text: Omnipotens aeterne pater et Domine qui ruenti mundo compatiens unicum Filium tuum de sedibus supernis pro nostra salute mittere dignatus es qui ultro pro nobis omnibus pertulit crucis iniuriam ut averni procul a nobis efficeret poenam; descendit etiam post appensionem patubuli pie violentus in infernum et sanctorum animas quae illic detinebantur clementer eripiens secum reportavit in caelum.  Ipsius enim doctrina animatus hic vir mirificus exstitit olim doctor Hieronymus qui fide fortiter armatus haereticis se obiecit in congressione certaminis ut catholicis daretur libertas salutis.  Illo igitur interveniente offerentium nomina apud te Domine Deus adnotentur in libro vitae caelestis quatenus fidelium animas defunctorum associes et nobis omnibus delictorum omnium veniam praestes.
translation_en: Almighty eternal Father and Lord, who in compassion for the world about to be destroyed, deigned to send forth your only Son from the heavenly seats for our salvation, who himself bore the injury of the cross for us all, to keep a far distance from us the penalty; he also descended peacefully violent after the hanging up of the cross into hell and mercifully released the souls that were held captive there, bringing them with him into heaven. For indeed this wonderful man, animated by his own teaching, once appeared as the teacher Jerome, who, armed with firm faith, opposed himself to heretics in a contest of battle, that salvation might be given to the Catholics. Therefore, let their names be noted among the offering ones before you, Lord God, in the book of life of heaven, so that you may associate the souls of the faithful departed and grant us all forgiveness for all our sins.

text: Omnipotens Christe Filius Dei in die nativitatis tuae propitius ad salvandum in te populum veni ut benignitate solita ab omni dubietate et metu temporis nos iubeas liberari.
translation_en: Almighty Christ, Son of God, on the day of your nativity, have mercy upon us to save the people through you. Come that we may be freed from all doubt and fear by your usual kindness.

text: Omnipotens clementissime Deus cuius Filius in aede beatae Marthae hospitari dignatus est da quaesumus ut eius meritis quae illum placide suscepit in aede polorum misericorditer hospitari valeamus.
translation_en: O most merciful God, all-powerful to whom it was worthy for your Son to be a guest in the house of blessed Martha, we humbly ask that through his merits, we may be allowed to receive merciful hospitality in the house of heaven.

text: Omnipotens clementissime Deus qui post baptismi sacramentum secundam peccatorum purgationem eleemosynis indidisti postulationes nostras benignus exaudi et famulis ac famulabus tuis illis earum largitoribus in tua misericordia confidentibus cunctarum propitius indulgentiam largire culparum ut te miserante ad aeternam beatitudinem valeant pervenire.
translation_en: Almighty and most merciful God, who after the sacrament of baptism cleansed us secondarily from our sins with alms, graciously hear our petitions. And you, the giver of these blessings to your servants and handmaids confidently relying on your mercy, generously grant them remission for their offenses so that by your mercy they may attain eternal beatitude.

text: Omnipotens conditor omnipotens et redemptor qui ad conversionem gentium et paenitentium reconciliationem duo magna luminaria Pauli litteras et Petri lacrimas posuisti ut a gratia tua nec illum persecutio quam amor legis intulerat nec istum negatio quam timor mortis exegerat faceret alienos da quaesumus resipiscere post ignorantiam flere post culpas gratiam recuperare post lacrimas.  Asserant apud indulgentiam tuam errantium causas et Paulus cui non obfuit quod nescivit et Petrus cui non impediit quod negavit. Potest nos misericordia tua sic sanare ut vulnera illata non pareant; sic restaurare ut elisos nos adversarius noster fuisse non gaudeat; sic integros facere ut fortiores expertos esse debiles non agnoscat.  Valet maiestas tua absolutis nobis etiam conscientiam delere peccati si poenam noluerit servare supplicii; concordiam conferre unanimitatis et pacem temporis largiri praesentis; in te efficere caritate connexos et a mundi scandalis te propugnante remotos.
translation_en:
Omnipotent Creator and Redeemer, who placed the two great lights of Paul's letters and Peter's tears for the conversion of the Gentiles and penitents, we beseech you to make those alienated return after ignorance, recover grace after weeping over sins, and comfort after tears.
They claim that among your indulgence for erring ones, there was neither one who was not aware as Paul, nor one who did not deny as Peter. May your mercy heal us so that the wounds inflicted do not show; may it restore us so that our adversary does not rejoice over us having been enemies; and may it make us whole so that our opponents do not recognize us as weak.
May your majesty cleanse our conscience of sins, even if it does not wish to keep the penalty of punishment; may it bestow unity among us and grant peace in this time; may it bring us together with love, and may it remove us from worldly scandals as you are defending against them.

text: Omnipotens Deus pater qui Filium tuum pro nobis omnibus tradidisti non parcens illi ut per illum parceres nobis ignosce nostris peccatis ut ieiunium quod offerimus fiat tibi victima salutaris. Virtus quoque tua de caelis descendens quaesumus ut et nos ob perceptionem horum sacramentorum purificet et haec ipsa libamina quae tibi litamus sanctificationis dono perlustret.
translation_en: Almighty God, Father, who for our sake gave your Son, not sparing him to suffer on our behalf, have mercy upon us and forgive our sins. May the sacrifice we offer as fasting become to you a saving victim. Also we ask for your power from heaven to purify us through these sacred mysteries, and that the very offerings we present may be sanctified by your gift.

text: Omnipotens Deus pater qui post oblationem unigeniti Filii tui in hostiam vivam Stephanum primum martyrem suscepisti tu nos ad eius exemplum facito esse victimam placationis et hostiam puritatis quo dum ipsi tibi per munitionem spiritus immolamur haec libamina in ablutionem peccaminum a te sanctificata sumamus.
translation_en: Almighty God, Father, who received Stephen, the first martyr, after the offering of your only-begotten Son, make us, through his example, to be a victim for reconciliation and a purifying sacrifice. While we offer these unleavened breads to you in the fortress of the Spirit, we take them, sanctified by you from our sins, as a wash.

text: Omnipotens Deus famulos tuos dextera potentiae tuae a cunctis protege periculis et beata Maria semper virgine intercedente fac eos praesenti gaudere prosperitate et futura.
translation_en: Almighty God, protect your servants by the power of your right hand from all dangers. Through the intercession of blessed Mary, the ever-virgin, grant them to rejoice in present happiness and future prosperity.

text: Omnipotens Deus fidelium tuorum indeficiens conservator qui hunc diem in gloriosi martyris tui Antonini clarificare dignatus es sollemnitate exaudi preces supplicantis ecclesiae et praesta ut quod devote expetit eo suffragante consequi mereatur.
translation_en: Almighty God, unfailing conservator of your faithful, who deemed it fitting to illuminate this day in the solemnity of your glorious martyr Antony: hear the prayers of the supplicating church and grant that one may merit to obtain what they devoutly seek with his intercession.

text: Omnipotens Deus misericordiam tuam nobis placatus impende ut qui contemnendo culpam incurrimus confitendo veniam consequamur.
translation_en: Almighty God, in your mercy be pleased with us, so that we who have sinned by disregarding wrongdoing may obtain forgiveness by confessing.

text: Omnipotens Deus nos quaesumus geminato sanctorum martyrum Iusti et Pastoris interventu laetifica eorumque festivo martyrio in tabernaculis iustorum clementer mirifica.
translation_en: Almighty God, we humbly ask that through the intervention of the twin holy martyrs Justus and Pastor, you may joyfully strengthen their festival martyrdom among the dwellings of the just with a merciful miracle.

text: Omnipotens Deus nos quaesumus geminata sanctorum martyrum tuorum Iusti et Pastoris intercessione laetifica et iustorum consortes apud tuam clementiam merita efficiant gloriosa.
translation_en: Almighty God, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your double-martyr saints Justus and Pastor, you may delight and make us worthy associates among the just in your mercy, by their merits making us glorious.

text: Omnipotens Deus noster tu tribue ut intercessio beatissimorum patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum confessurum virginum et sacerdotum omniumque sanctorum nostrarum profectus sit animarum et cultus quem illis deferimus ad honorem nobis proficiat ad salutem ut intercessione eorum gratiam tuam et pacem in nobis facias permanere.
translation_en: Almighty God, grant that the intercession of the most blessed patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, priests, and all saints may profit our progress in soul and cult which we bring to them for their honor. May it benefit us with salvation so that through their intercession Your grace and peace may remain in us.

text: Omnipotens Deus populi tui quaesumus preces exaudi qui beatum Maiolum confessorem tuum virtutis gratia adornasti et eum hodie in caelesti gloria suscepisti.
translation_en: Almighty God, we humbly ask that you hear our prayers. You adorned your confessor Blessed Maiol with the grace of virtue and today received him into celestial glory.

text: Omnipotens Deus propitius cordis nostri adspiciat gemitus et petitionibus nostris suae pietatis aurem inclinet atque ab omni defensos maerore nos laetificet mentem nostram miserationis suae subsidio muniat et remedia gaudii sempiterni nobis clementer attribuat.
translation_en: Almighty God, have pity on our hearts and incline your ear to our groans and prayers. May you comfort us with your mercy and protect our minds from all sorrow. Strengthen us with the support of your compassion and generously grant us eternal joy as remedy.

text: Omnipotens Deus qui illibatum Eulaliae virginis corpus intactum servas a flammis emitte in his hostiis spiritum sanctitatis qui et oblata sanctificet et oblatores propitiabili respectu perlustret.
translation_en: Almighty God, who preserved the body of Eulalia the Virgin unharmed through the flames, send upon these offerings the Holy Spirit, who may sanctify the offerings and regard with favor those who offer them.

text: Omnipotens Deus qui omnia in numero pondere et mensura disposuisse fideliter crederis largire nobis famulis tuis beatum Ioannem confessorem tuum in specie modo et ordine pura mente sectari.
translation_en: Almighty God, who faithfully believe to have arranged all things according to number, weight, and measure, grant to your servants that we may follow your blessed servant John the Baptist in purity of form and order, with a pure mind.

text: Omnipotens Deus qui per abstinentiam sacri ieiunii immensa patribus nostris virtutum praemia condonasti praesta nobis famulis tuis ut eorum mereamur esse sequipedes quorum exemplis ad meliora perducti et carnalibus illecebris maneamus invicti et in tuis iugiter insistamus praeceptis indefessi.
translation_en: Almighty God, who through the abstinence of sacred fasting granted immense rewards to our ancestors, grant us, your servants, that we may deserve to be followers of those whose examples lead us to better things and remain victorious over carnal temptations, and may we always persevere in your teachings without weariness.

text: Omnipotens Deus qui quanto nos infirmiores esse praevidisti tanto sanctorum tuorum Cancii Canciani et Cancianillae copiosiori munivisti suffragio da ut sub his defensoribus constituti nec adigamur vitiis nec deficiamus adversis.
translation_en: Almighty God, who foresaw that we would be weaker, you provided a more abundant protection for your saints Cancius, Cancianus and Cancianilla with their intercession. May we, established under these protectors, not be tempted by vices nor fail in adversity.

text: Omnipotens Deus qui sanctis tuis Fructuoso episcopo Agurio et Eulogio diaconis tantam virtutum gloriam tribuisti ut sic eorum corpora iniecta camino liquescerent ne animae doloribus carnis perarmatae divino spiritu cederent; sic exusta deciderent ignibus membra ne umquam silerent praeconum tuorum veracia verba sicque humanorum corporum exterminata sit species ne tamen aliquando a confessionis fervore friguerit ignea fides tu haec oblata tibi libamina calore Sancti Spiritus perflans benedicenda assume eorumque participatione fac nos caritate fervere delictisque frigescere quo in divino amore succensis sit in nobis ignis qui exurat peccata non qui augeat vitiorum carnalium incentiva.
translation_en: Almighty God, who granted such glory of virtues to Your saints Fructuosus, bishop, and Eulogius, deacon, that their bodies, thrown into the fire, melted away so that their souls, weighed down by the pains of flesh, did not yield to the divine spirit; so that, burned, their limbs fell off so that they never stopped proclaiming Your truthful words; and so that, extinguished, human bodies were destroyed so that the species would not fade, but yet the fervor of confession would never freeze the fiery faith that You have offered to You, inflamed by the warmth of the Holy Spirit. May these libations be blessed by Your acceptance, making us burn with charity and grow cold in sin, thus within us may there be a fire that burns sins, not one that stirs up carnal vices' incentives.

text: Omnipotens Deus romani nominis inimicos virtute quaesumus tuae comprime maiestatis ut populus tuus et fidei integritate laetetur et temporum tranquillitate semper exsultet.
translation_en: Almighty God of the Roman name, we humbly ask that you crush your enemies with the power of your majesty, so that your people may always rejoice in integrity of faith and be ever exultant in peace of time.

text: Omnipotens Deus vota nostra dignanter suscipiat et nos famulos suos propitiatus intendat desideria nostra in bonis operibus compleat et ab insidiis inimicorum nos defendat.
translation_en: Almighty God, may He graciously accept our prayers and may He direct His favors toward us, His servants. May He fulfill our desires with good works and protect us from the deceits of our enemies.

text: Omnipotens Domine a quo est humilitatis bonum et caritatis studium da quaesumus nobis omnibus caritatis et humilitatis affectum ut humiles ac pacifici in caritate Dei et proximi nos vivere gratulemur.
translation_en: Almighty Lord, from whom is the good of humility and the study of charity, we humbly ask for yourself that you grant us all the affection of charity and humility, so that we may live humbly, peacefully, and in the love of God and our neighbors with gratitude.

text: Omnipotens Domine Iesu Christe quem animarum et corporum artificem scimus quem vivorum et mortuorum iudicem confitemur quem tremere caelestia et terrena et inferna cognoscimus transfer haec nomina in paginas caeli quae levitarum et cantorum tuorum officiis recitata sunt; in libro vivorum digito tuo per quem nos sicut legem adnotas conscribe.
translation_en: Almighty Lord Jesus Christ, whom we know as the Artificer of souls and bodies, whom we confess as the Judge of the living and the dead, whom we acknowledge to tremble heavenly and earthly and infernal beings, transfer these names onto the pages of heaven which have been recited by your angels in their hovering and singing duties; in the Book of Life, write us with Your finger by whom we, like laws, are noted down.

text: Omnipotens et clementissime Deus pater aeterne qui nos annua recursione depositionis sancti Udalrici gloriosi confessoris tui laetificas eius suffragantibus meritis concede propitius ut ab imminentibus periculis liberemur et aeternis gaudiis perfrui mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty and most merciful God, Father eternal, who delight us each year with the commemoration of the glorious confessor St. Udalricus, grant us graciously through his merits that we may be delivered from impending dangers and worthy to partake in eternal joys.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus / a bellorum nos quaesumus / turbine fac quietos quia bona nobis / cuncta praestabis si pacem dederis / et mentis et corporis.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, we humbly ask you to make us quiet from the wars. For all things are good for us that you will provide, if you give us peace; for both mind and body.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus ad cuius beatitudinem sempiternam non fragilitate carnis sed alacritate mentis adscenditur fac nos atria supernae civitatis et te inspirante semper ambire et tua indulgentia fidenter intrare.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, to whose eternal beatitude we ascend not by the frailty of flesh but by the agility of mind, grant that we may always long for the courts of the heavenly city and confidently enter with your inspiration.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus adesto propitius invocationibus nostris et preces populi tui benignus intende; pacem tuam nuntiet nobis purgati aeris serena tranquillitas et obducta caelo taetra nubium caligo discedat; redeant ad suas naturales fluenta mensuras et immodicae effusiones fluminum ab agrorum populatione revocentur – quo enim fugiemus ab ira tua nisi ad misericordiam tuam? – ut qui delinquentes verberas peccata confitentibus pareas.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, be present graciously in response to our invocations and the prayers of your people. May your peace be announced to us through a serene calmness of purified air, and may the dark cloudiness of unpleasant storms depart from the sky; let the natural measures return to their courses and excessive outpourings of rivers be recalled by agricultural populations – where else can we flee from your wrath except to your mercy? – so that those committing sins may receive punishment in accordance with their confessions.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus apta nos tuae propitius voluntati quo(niam) sicut eius praetereuntes tramitem deviamus sic integro tenore dirigamur ad illius semper ordinem recurrentes.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, direct us worthy to your gracious will; for as we stray from his path, so may we return with undiminished devotion to his constant order.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus apud quem voluntas habetur humana pro factis praesta quaesumus ut animae famuli tui illius ad perfectum remedium consequendum paenitentiam desideranter voluisse sufficiat.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, in whom rests the human will regarding their deeds, we humbly ask that you grant that the penitence desired by your servant for attaining perfect remedy may be sufficient.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus clementiam tuam supplices exoramus ut animas famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium fidelium defunctorum intercedente beata Maria semper virgine cum omnibus sanctis ad perpetuae beatitudinis facias pervenire consortium.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, we humbly beseech Your clemency that the souls of Your servants and handmaids, all the faithful departed, through the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary, the ever-virgin, with all the saints, may be brought to eternal beatitude.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus cui redditur votum in Ierusalem per merita et intercessionem beati illius martyris tui exaudi preces famuli tui; memor esto sacrificii sui pinguia fiant holocausta sua; tribue ei quaesumus divitias gratiae tuae comple in bonis desiderium suum corona eum in miseratione et misericordia tibique domino pia devotione iugiter famuletur; ignosce ei facinora et ne lugenda committat paterna pietate castiga.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, to whom a vow was made in Jerusalem through the merits and intercession of your blessed martyr, hear the prayers of your servant; remember the sweetness of his sacrifice and make his holocaust acceptable; grant him, we ask, the riches of your grace that he may be filled with good desires; crown him with mercy and compassion, may he forever serve you with pious devotion; forgive him his sins and do not allow him to commit any deeds worthy of mourning, but rather correct him with paternal pity.

text: Deus cui redditur votum in Ierusalem imple petitiones servi tui memor esto sacrificii sui pinguia fiant holocausta sua comple in bonis desiderium suum conserva eum in miseratione et misericordia tua; ut anni sui non deficiant quodcumque peccavit indulge et ut amplius non peccet confirma.
translation_en: May the God to whom a vow is rendered in Jerusalem remember and fulfill the petitions of your servant. May his sacrifices be rich and may his holocausts be complete in good things; may he preserve his desire in mercy and compassion. In your mercy and compassion, let not his years lack anything that he has sinned. Indulge whatever he has done wrong and confirm that he will sin no more.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus cuius pietatis et misericordiae non est numerus qui simul cuncta creasti qui verbum tuum pro redemptione humani generis incarnari voluisti qui occulta cordium omnium hominum solus agnoscis miserere animae meae Domine et delicta iuventutis et ignorantiae meae ne memineris Deus sed erue eam de manu inimicorum et de profundo laci et de luto faecis; ne derelinquas me Domine Deus meus ne discedas a me et ne tradas in manibus quaerentium animam meam sed libera eam de omni angustia piissime Pater.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, whose pity and mercy are beyond count who created all things at the same time, who willed that your Word be incarnate for the redemption of the human race, who alone recognizes the secrets of all men's hearts; have mercy on my soul, Lord. Forgive the sins of my youth and ignorance, do not remember them, God. But deliver it from the hand of its enemies, and from deep pit and clay, and mud. Do not abandon me, Lord, my God, do not leave me nor give me into the hands of those who seek my soul. But free it from every distress, most merciful Father.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus de cuius munere venit ut tibi a fidelibus tuis digne et laudabiliter serviatur tribue quaesumus nobis ut ad promissiones tuas sine offensione curramus.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, from whose gift we come to serve you worthily and praiseworthily by your faithful ones, grant us, we implore, that we may run towards your promises without offense.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus exaudi preces ieiunantium supplices et misericordiae tuae munus omni cessante fraudulentia propitius impende ut per coniunctionem pacis omni simultate compressa securis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, hear the prayers of the fasting supplicants and bestow your mercy upon all deceit ceasing. May you graciously pour forth so that through the bond of peace, compressed by unity, we may serve you with peaceful minds.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus famulos tuos placatus intende qui recolentes divina mandata opem indigentibus subministrant ut sicut eorum devotio nobis est necessaria ita sit tibi semper accepta.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, please direct your favor towards your servants, who, in remembering Your divine commands, provide help to the needy. May their devotion be as necessary to us as it is always acceptable to You.

text: Oremus dilectissimi nobis omnipotentem Deum pro filio nostro illo qui recolens divina mandata de iustis laboribus suis victum indigentibus subministrat quatenus haec devotio ipsius sicut nobis est necessaria ita sit Deo semper accepta.
translation_en: Let us pray, our most beloved Almighty God, for our son who, remembering the divine commands, provides food for those in need of his righteous labors. May this devotion of his be as necessary to us as it is always accepted by God.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus fidelium lumen animarum adesto votis sollemnitatis hodiernae et Ecclesiae tuae gaudiis de beatorum martyrum illorum gloria conceptis benignus adspira ut et corda nostra passione sanctorum martyrum igniantur et apud misericordiam tuam eorum iuvemur meritis quorum gaudemus exemplis.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, light of souls of the faithful, be present today at our solemn vows and the joy of Your Church. Be benevolent towards the glory conceived by those blessed martyrs and inspire us that our hearts may be kindled with the passion of the holy martyrs. May we rejoice in their mercy before You, encouraged by the merits for which we delight in their examples.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus fidelium lumen animarum adesto votis sollemnitatis hodiernae et Ecclesiae tuae gaudiis de beati Bonifatii gloriosa pontificatus ordinatione conceptis benignus adspira ut et corda nostra ipsius doctrina igniantur et apud misericordiam tuam eius iuvemur precibus cuius gaudemus exemplis.
translation_en: O Almighty and merciful God, be present today to the solemnity of the faithful, enlighten our souls, and inspire us benevolently through the glorious ordination of Blessed Bonifatius as Pontiff. May our hearts be inflamed by his teaching and may we be supported in your mercy through his prayers, whose examples we rejoice in.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus hostias placationis pio obsequio deferimus pro famulo tuo illo; deprecamur ut ei proficiant ad salutem et hoc munus assumptum sit salus omnium animarum mentium et corporis subsidium et caelestis desiderii sine fine gloriatio.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, we offer the sacrifices of propitiation with pious obedience on behalf of your servant. We entreat you that they may be beneficial for his salvation, and that this undertaking may serve as salvation for all souls, body support, and an endless glorification of celestial desire.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus in cuius omnis humana condicio potestate consistit animam famuli tui illius quaesumus ab omnibus absolve peccatis ut paenitentiae fructum quem voluntas eius optavit praeventus mortalitate non perdat.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, in whose all-powerful hand the soul of your servant is, we humbly ask that you forgive him from all sins, so that the fruit of his repentance, which your will desires, may not be lost due to mortality.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus inclina quaesumus venerabiles aures tuas ad exiguas preces nostras quibus ante conspectum maiestatis tuae pro anima famuli tui illius fratris nostri humiliter deprecamur ut dum de qualitate vitae eius diffidimus de abundantia pietatis tuae consolemur et si ad plenum veniam animae eius obtinere non possumus saltem vel inter ipsa tormenta quae forsitan patitur refrigerium de abundantia miserationum tuarum sentiatur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, we humbly beseech you to incline your noble ears to our modest prayers, that before the majesty of yours, for the soul of your servant, that brother of ours, we may humbly plead. We doubt about the quality of his life, but we take comfort from the abundance of your mercy. If it is not possible for us to obtain full forgiveness for his soul, at least let him feel some refreshment from the abundance of your mercies among the torments he might be suffering.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus propitiationis tuae dona multiplica et cunctis hostibus caelesti virtute compressis augmentum nobis tribue religionis et pacis.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, multiply for us the increase of your grace, and grant to us the expansion of religious faith and peace, while you have subdued all heavenly enemies with your power.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui athletam tuum Iulianum tormenta horrifica superare fecisti concede ut qui eius triumphi diem annue celebramus insuperabiles tua protectione ab hostis insidiis maneamus.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who made Your athlete Julian overcome horrible torments, grant that we who celebrate the day of his triumph may remain invincible under Your protection from enemy ambushes.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui beatos apostolos tuos Petrum et Paulum atque Andream omnesque apostolos caelesti corona decorare voluisti praesta quaesumus ut quemadmodum devotam ipsorum frequentamus obsecrando memoriam ita eorum iugiter sublimia apud te sentiamus patrocinia.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who wanted to adorn your blessed apostles Peter, Paul, Andrew, and all the apostles with a celestial crown, grant us our prayer, that we may always feel the lofty patronage of them as we devoutly frequent their remembrance.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui beatum Ioannem Baptistam tua providentia destinasti ut perfectam plebem Christo domino praepararet da quaesumus ut familia tua huius intercessione praeconis et a peccatis omnibus exuatur et ad eum quem prophetavit pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who by your providence destined blessed John the Baptist to prepare the perfect people for Christ, the Lord. We ask that through his intercession, your family may be freed from all sins and worthy to attain Him whom he prophesied.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui beatum Benedictum ad caelorum gloriam discipulis videntibus migrare fecisti da nobis ut sicut ille egregius pastor exstitit monachorum nos quoque orationibus eius adiuti illius exempla sectantes te auxiliante ad vitam pervenire mereamur aeternam.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who brought blessed Benedict to the glory of heaven in the sight of his disciples, grant us that, supported by his prayers and following his examples, we may, with your help, merit to attain eternal life.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui in hoc die beatum Benedictum abbatem ad caelorum gloriam videntibus discipulis migrare iussisti da nobis ut sicut ille monachorum egregius exstitit praedicator ita nos quoque intercessionibus eius adiuti exemplis eius gradiamur et meritis.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who on this day commanded your blessed servant Benedict, the abbot, to migrate to the glory of heaven before his disciples' eyes, grant us that we, too, may be helped by his intercessions, guided by his examples, and may obtain grace and mercy through his merits.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui benedictum Filium tuum super Lazarum in signum amoris lacrimas effundere voluisti ac mirabili divinitatis potentia eundem Lazarum a mortuis suscitari da nobis gratia Sancti Spiritus te cogitare te amare te suppliciter exorare cum devotis lacrimis quibus vitiorum nostrorum sordes abstergere et a morte animae resurgere valeamus.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who willed that your blessed Son wept over Lazarus as a sign of love and miraculously raised him from the dead by the power of your divinity, grant us the grace of the Holy Spirit to think of you, to love you, to humbly implore you with devout tears, with which we may wash away the stains of our sins and rise again from death of soul.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui benigne semper operaris ut possimus implere quae praecipis dilectarum tibi ovium adesto pastori quia tui est muneris tuaeque virtutis ut et regendi oboedientes et probabiles possint esse rectores.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who always work benevolently so that we can fulfill what you command your beloved sheep. Be present as a shepherd, for it is your task and your virtue to make the obedient and exemplary ones capable of being good rulers.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui genus humanum sub peccato venditum non auri argentique pondere sed pretioso Filii tui redemisti sanguine esto protector noster et libera nos de laqueo mortis et insidiis diaboli ut non nobis in cogitatione vel in opere superbia subrepat sed adsit iugis et sincera humilitas ut non cum peccatoribus et reprobis in interitu pereamus sed sub tua miseratione cum sanctis et electis tuis praemia aeterna sortiamur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who redeemed the human race not by the weight of gold or silver but by the precious blood of your Son, be our protector and deliver us from the snare of death and the snares of the devil, so that pride may not lead us in thought or deed, but may reside with us as an upright and sincere humility. May we not perish with the sinners and the reprobate in death, but may we be saved under your mercy along with the saints and elect ones of yours, and receive eternal rewards.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui inter cetera potentiae tuae miracula sancti confessoris tui Martini meritum etiam in die translationis sacri corporis illius angelica revelatione populo tuo demonstrasti praesta nobis petentibus huius patroni suffragantibus precibus ut ea quae tibi sunt placita digno affectu ac devotis mentibus exsequamur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who among other miracles of your power have shown the merit of your saint confessor Martin to your people even on the day of the translation of his sacred body through angelic revelation, grant us, who are asking with prayers from this our patron, that with a mind pleasing to you and devoted we may carry out what pleases you.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui meritis et precibus beatissimi Rochi confessoris tui quandam pestem hominum generalem gratiose revocasti praesta supplicibus tuis ut qui pro simili peste revocanda ad tuam confugiunt fiduciam ipsius gloriosi confessoris precamine ab ipsa infirmitate et ab omni perturbatione liberentur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who graciously recalled a widespread plague of mankind through the merits and prayers of your blessed Confessor St. Roch, grant us your mercy that those who turn to you in faith seeking its recall, may be freed from this infirmity and every disturbance by the intercession of this glorious Confessor.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui meritis beati Sebastiani martyris tui gloriosissimi quandam generalem pestem epidemiae hominibus pestiferam revocasti praesta supplicibus tuis ut qui pro simili peste revocanda ad ipsum sub tui confidentia confugerint ipsius meritis et precibus ab ipsa peste epidemiae et ab omni tribulatione liberentur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who recalled the great plague epidemic among men by the merits of your glorious martyr Saint Sebastian, grant your supplicants that those who, like the aforementioned plague, flee to you in confidence under your protection may be freed from it by his merits and prayers, not only from this plague but also from all tribulations.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui nobis praeclaram huius diei laetitiam pro beati Kenelmi martyris tui sollemnitate tribuisti intende serenus vota fidelis populi et concede ut cuius hodie festa percolimus eius semper meritis et precibus sublevemur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who on this day have granted us the joyful happiness of the feast of your blessed martyr Kenelm, direct the prayers of your faithful people and grant that we may always be raised by his merits and prayers.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui nos ad celebritatem venire huius diei contulisti praesta quaesumus ut tui perceptione sacramenti et securitas nobis optata proveniat et religionis integritas.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who has granted us to come to the solemnity of this day, we humbly ask that you grant us that the experience of your sacrament may come upon us and the security and integrity of our faith may be achieved.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui nos recreasti tuis salutiferis sacramentis da robur utrisque oculis cum devoto profluvio lacrimarum ad cognoscendam ineffabilem caritatem a qua tuae pretiosissimae lacrimae super Lazarum super populum Hierosolymitanum et in ligno crucis salutiferae emanarunt quatenus ex recogitatione tuae circa nos exhibitae pietatis mereamur admitti ante thronum gloriosissimae Trinitatis.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who has refreshed us with your life-giving sacraments, give us strength for both eyes to flow with a devout outpouring of tears, so that through recognizing the ineffable love from which your most precious tears fell upon Lazarus, upon the people of Jerusalem, and on the wooden cross, we may deserve to be admitted before the glorious throne of the Trinity.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui nos sacramentorum tuorum et participes efficis et ministros praesta quaesumus ut in iisdem proficiamus et fideli consortio et digno servitio.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who makes us participants and ministers of your sacraments, we humbly ask that we may grow in them and in faithful fellowship and worthy service.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui omnem animam paenitentem et confitentem magis vis emendare quam perdere respice propitius super hunc famulum tuum illum et per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus averte ab eo iram indignationis tuae et dimitte ei omnia peccata sua.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who prefers to heal rather than destroy every penitent and confessing soul, have mercy upon this your servant and turn away from him the wrath of your indignation. Forgive him all his sins through these sacraments that we have received.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui peccantium non vis animas perire sed culpas contine quam meremur iram et quam precamur effunde clementiam ut de maerore in gaudium per tuam misericordiam transferamur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who does not wish the souls of sinners to perish but contains their faults, have mercy on us as we deserve, and pour out Your clemency, that we may be transferred from mourning into joy by Your mercy.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui peccatorum indulgentiam in confessione celeri posuisti succurre lapsis miserere confessis ut quos delictorum catena constringit magnitudo tuae pietatis absolvat.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who hast placed swift forgiveness for sins in confession, have mercy on those who confess, that Your greatness of mercy may absolve those whom the chain of sin restrains.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui sanctis martyribus tuis Mauricio Exsuperio Candido et Victori cum sociis eorum coronam martyrii praestitisti concede quaesumus ut eorum intercessione salvemur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who bestowed the crown of martyrdom upon your saints Mauritius, Exsuperius, Candido, Victor and their companions, we humbly ask that through their intercession, we may be saved.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum praeteritorum criminum culpas evacuas maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecor ut quidquid iniquitatis proprio reatu deliqui vel quidquid vitiorum fallente diabolo contraxi totum ineffabili pietate tua deleas et absterg<e>as et iram tuae indignationis quam in his provocavi a me miseratus amoveas teque miserante valeam deinceps quae mala sunt declinare et quae bona sunt iugiter explere et ad aeternam beatitudinem te ducente pervenire.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who according to the multitude of your past mercies have purged away sins and faults through iniquities committed under one's own guilt or through vices contracted by the deceiving devil, I humbly beseech you that whatever I have sinned through my own guilt or contracted through the deceit of the devil, you may completely remove and wash away with your immeasurable pity. May your wrath and anger provoked by me, as a sinner, be mercifully removed, so that I, moved to repentance by your mercy, may henceforth turn away from evil things and ever perform good ones, and through you, may attain eternal beatitude.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui subvenis in periculis et necessitate laborantibus maiestatem tuam suppliciter exoramus ut mittere digneris sanctum angelum tuum qui famulum tuum illum in angustiis et necessitatibus suis laborantem consolationibus tuis attollat quibus et de praesenti tribulatione consequatur auxilium et aeterna remedia comprehendat.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who comes to aid in perils and necessity, we humbly beseech Your majesty to send Your holy angel to raise up Your servant who labors in distress and need, with consolations that he may obtain help for his present tribulation and grasp eternal remedies.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui subvenis in periculis laborantibus qui temperas flagella inclina tuas benignus aures ad nostrae humilitatis preces et hunc famulum tuum illum qui illius typi fatigatione vexatur sancti Sigismundi supplicationibus ab omni ardore febrium liberare digneris ut dum nobis illius patefacis merita praesenti aegroto conferas medicinam.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who comes to the aid of those in peril, who moderates the strokes, bend your gracious ears to our humble prayers, and deign to free this your servant, who is afflicted by the fatigue of that type, from all fever's ardor. May you grant him healing as you reveal his merits to the present sick man.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui subvenis in periculis laborantibus qui temperas flagella te Domine supplices exoramus ut visitatione tua sancta erigas famulum tuum illum de lecto infirmitatis emundare digneris et sanum repraesentes Ecclesiae tuae sanctae ad laudem et gloriam nominis tui.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who helps those in peril, who temper justice with mercy, we humbly ask you, O Lord, to visit your servant afflicted by illness, that you may deign to cleanse him from the bed of his infirmity and present him healthy to your holy Church to the praise and glory of your name.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus qui verbo virtutis suae rerum transmutat substantiam suum nobis impendat auxilium ut in his oblatis pro salute generis humani intervenientibus meritis et precibus beatissimi confessoris sui Edmundi summi sacramenti sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, who transforms the substance of Your power by Your word, grant us aid so that in these offerings we may feel the effect through the merits and prayers of the blessed confessor Edmund, that we may partake in the highest sacrament.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus respice propitius super populum tuum maiestati tuae subiectum et ne nos furor saevientis mortis inveniat dextera tuae propitiationis custodiat.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, look upon us graciously as your people who are subject to your majesty. May not the wrath of severe death find us, but may your hand of mercy protect us.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus respice populum maiestati tuae subiectum et ne nos furor saevientis mortis inveniat sacramentorum tuorum perceptio sancta perficiat.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, look upon your people who are subject to your majesty, and may not the wrath of terrible death find us. May the holy reception of your sacraments complete us.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus respicere dignare super apostolicam dignitatem atque super universos gradus ecclesiasticos ut sicut universa a te creata sunt sic universi in suo ordine a te dirigantur.
translation_en: O Almighty and merciful God, deign to look upon the apostolic dignity and upon all degrees of the Church, so that just as all things were created by you, so may all things be ordered by you in their own rank.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus spes fidelium fiducia supplicantium confer in nobis munera tua et subditum tibi sacerdotem tuere famulum tuum illum episcopum ut qui peccatorum meritis aggravatur praesidio gratiae tuae sublevetur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, hope of the faithful, we humbly entreat you to bestow your gifts upon us and protect the priest whom you have made subject to you, that Bishop, burdened by the merits of sins, may be raised up by the protection of your grace.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus unica salus mortalium te supplices exoramus pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum parentum et benefactorum nostrorum ut interveniente beata Dei Genitrice Maria cum omnibus sanctis peccatorum eis largiri digneris indulgentiam et in novissimo die beatae resurrectionis laetitiam.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, we humbly beseech you as the unique salvation of mankind. On behalf of your servants, their families, benefactors, and parents, we implore you to grant them, with the intervention of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, along with all saints, the mercy of forgiveness for their sins. May they receive this grace on the happy day of resurrection.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus universa nobis adversantia propitiatus exclude ut mente et corpore expediti quae tua sunt liberis mentibus exsequamur.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, may you forgive all the adversities that befall us, so that we, with a clear mind and body, carry out what is yours with free minds.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus ut tuae maiestati accepta sint munera nostrae servitutis quae et beatam virginem tuam Austrobertam nobis concilient et aeternae felicitatis gaudia divinitus subministrent.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, may our gifts of servitude be accepted by your majesty, and through them may your blessed virgin Austrobert bring us together and bestow upon us the joys of eternal happiness through divine provision.

text: Omnipotens et mitissime Deus qui electos sanctos tuos Georgium Blasium Erasmum Vitum Pantaleonem Christophorum Dionysium Cyriacum Achacium Eustachium Aegidium Catherinam Margaretham et Barbaram specialibus privilegiis prae cunctis aliis decorasti ut omnes qui in necessitate eorum implorant auxilium secundum tuae promissionis gratiam petitionis suae salutarem consequantur effectum da nobis quaesumus nostrorum veniam peccatorum ipsorum intercedentibus meritis ab omnibus nos adversitatibus libera ac deprecationes nostras benignus exaudi.
translation_en: Almighty and most merciful God, who have adorned your chosen saints George, Blaise, Erasmus, Vitus, Pantaleon, Christopher, Dionysius, Cyriacus, Achacius, Eustace, Giles, Catherine, Margaret, Barbara, and others with special privileges above all others, so that all who implore aid in their necessity according to your promises may obtain the salutary effect of their petition. Grant us, we beseech you, through the merits of their intercession, to be freed from all adversities and graciously hear our prayers.

text: Omnipotens immense Deus qui Leocadiae virginis tuae placatus confessione ad te animam eius arcessiri iussisti in pace tu nos et pia peccatorum confessione salva et fraternae dilectionis unanimitate iustifica quo per hanc virginem et confessionis dono a vitiis emundemur et pacis unitate tuae visionis solatio potiamur.
translation_en: Almighty God, immense, who was pleased with the confession of Your Virgin Leocadia and summoned her soul to You in peace, save us too with pious confession of sins and through the unity of Your peace grant us justification. May we be purified from vices through this virgin and the gift of confession, and may we be refreshed by the consolation of Your vision.

text: Omnipotens incomprehensibilis Deus adesto piis quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae precibus quas in hac celebritate sacrae virginis Eormenhildae defert maiestati tuae per cuius interventum excoque nostrorum rubiginem vitiorum et auge puritatem virtutum nobisque praebe celestem iugis gloriae sempiternitatem.
translation_en: Omnipotent and incomprehensible God, be present with the pious we implore, in petitions to your Church which are presented during this sacred celebration of Virgin Eormenhild. Through your intervention, may you extinguish our stains of vices, increase our purity of virtues, and grant us eternal glory in celestial joy.

text: Omnipotens miserator et misericors Deus fiat acceptum in conspectu tuo hoc sacrificium laudis pro salute famuli tui illius et propitiare omnibus iniquitatibus eius et sana cunctos suos languores et redime de interitu vitam eius ut pristina a te restitutus sanitate gratiarum tibi referat actiones.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, may this sacrifice of praise be acceptable in your sight for the salvation of your servant and forgive all his sins. Heal all his weaknesses and redeem his life from death so that restored to health by you, he may refer back to you acts of gratitude.

text: Omnipotens mitissime Deus qui sitienti populo fontem viventis aquae de petra produxisti educ de cordis nostri duritia compunctionis lacrimas ut peccata nostra plangere valeamus remissionemque te miserante mereamur accipere.
translation_en: Almighty most merciful God, who brought forth a spring of living water from the rock for the thirsty people, break the hardness of our hearts and shed tears of compunction from our hearts, so that we may be able to lament our sins and merit your mercy, through which we may receive forgiveness.

text: Omnipotens mitissime Deus respice propitius preces nostras et libera cor nostrum de malarum temptatione cogitationum ut Sancti Spiritus dignum fieri habitaculum mereamur.
translation_en: Most merciful God, look upon our prayers favorably and free our hearts from the temptation of evil thoughts, so that we may be worthy to be a dwelling place for the Holy Spirit.

text: Omnipotens qui omnia creasti in victu visibilia atque invisibilia da nobis in hac festivitate beati Aethelbrihti regis atque martyris ab omnibus periculis inimicorum defendi.
translation_en: Almighty one who created all things, visible and invisible, grant us in this festivity of the blessed King and Martyr Aethelbald that we may be protected from all dangers by our enemies.

text: Omnipotens sempiterna Trinitas Deus qui per Moysen famulum tuum priscis iamdudum temporibus a patribus nostris omnium frugum terrae tuae primitias tibi sollemniter praecepisti offerri non quo tuam indigentiam expleres sed nostram potius ut pius et misericors per hoc devotionem sanctificando monstrares quaesumus clementiam tuam ut has frugum nostrarum primitias quas sancto nomini tuo mandatorum tuorum praecepta servantes offerimus benignus ac placidus suscipere et sanctificare digneris.  Parce precamur a grandine et ab omni penitus molestia exime atque ad maturitatem propitius dignare perducere ut cuncti famuli famulaeque tuae immensas referant gratias tibi Domino Deo nostro bonorum omnium largitori.
translation_en:
Almighty everlasting Trinity, God who through Moses, your servant, long ago commanded our ancestors to offer the first fruits of all the produce of your land solemnly, not because you needed to be satisfied but rather for us, to show yourself as pious and merciful by this devotion. We humbly ask for your mercy that you graciously accept and sanctify these first fruits of our produce, which we offer in obedience to your commandments given to your people.
We beseech you, spare us from hail and free us entirely from every annoyance and may you mercifully guide us to maturity so that all your servants and handmaids return immense gratitude to you, Lord God our benefactor of all good things.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus a quo solo sancta desideria recta consilia et iusta sunt opera da servis tuis illam quam mundus dare non potest pacem ut et corda nostra mandatis tuis dedita et tempora sint tua protectione tranquilla.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, from whom only right desires, correct counsels, and just works are to your servants; grant them that peace which the world cannot give, so that our hearts may be devoted to your commands and the times peaceful under your protection.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus ab hostium nos defende formidine ut omni perturbatione submota liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, defend us from the fear of our enemies that we may serve you freely with undisturbed minds.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus adesto propitius invocationibus nostris et hanc oblationem benignus assume quam tibi offerimus in honorem et gloriam nominis tui et in commemorationem omnium sanctorum seu pro peccatis et offensionibus nostris et pro pace regum vel pro requie omnium fidelium defunctorum in Christo quiescentium et pro his qui se in nostris orationibus humiliter commendaverunt; quaesumus Domine ut cunctis proficiat ad salutem et per intercessionem omnium sanctorum nostra quaesumus dele chirographa peccatorum et libera nos de manibus inimicorum ut adipisci mereamur gaudia sempiterna.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, be present and gracious to our invocations and accept this offering benevolently which we offer to you in honor and glory of your name, and in commemoration of all saints or for our sins and offenses, and for the peace of kings, or for the repose of all faithful departed souls resting in Christ, and for those who have humbly committed themselves in our prayers; we ask you, Lord, that it may benefit all for salvation, and through the intercession of all saints we ask that you delete the records of sins and free us from the hands of our enemies so that we may deserve eternal joys.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus adesto quaesumus precibus supplicantium tibi propitius et humilitatis nostrae oblationem attende placatus ac praesta ut sacrificium hoc quod offerimus et nobis omnibus proficiat ad salutem et defunctis omnibus praestetur ad requiem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly ask that you be present with our prayers. Grant us your favor and attend to our humble offering. You who are pleased, bestow upon us the grace that this sacrifice we offer may benefit us all for salvation, and may grant rest to all the deceased.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus aedificator et custos Ierusalem civitatis supernae aedifica et custodi locum istum cum habitatoribus suis ut perpetuum sit in eo domicilium incolumitatis et pacis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, builder and guardian of the heavenly city Jerusalem, build and guard this place with its inhabitants, so that it may be a permanent dwelling place of safety and peace for them.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus altare nomini tuo dicatum caelestis virtutis benedictione sanctifica et omnibus in te sperantibus auxilii tui munus ostende ut hic sacramentorum virtus et votorum obtineatur effectus.
translation_en: The Almighty everlasting God, by the blessing of celestial virtue, sanctify the altar dedicated to Your name and show the aid of Your help to all who hope in You, that here the power of the sacraments and the effects of their vows may be obtained.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus annue precibus nostris ea quae poscimus et dona omnibus quorum hic corpora requiescunt refrigerii sedem quietis beatitudinem luminis claritatem ut qui peccatorum suorum pondere praegravantur eos supplicatio commendet ecclesiae.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, incline Your ear to our prayers and grant a place of rest, peace, beatitude, light's clarity to all whose bodies here are resting. May the church commend to You those who, burdened by the weight of their sins, are heavy-laden.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus apud quem cum totius rationabilis pia merita creaturae semper accepta sint certum est illius magis esse praecipua quae reliquam spiritalem superat dignitatem grata tibi sit quaesumus nostra festivitas pro veneratione eius oblata qui tuae maiestatis arcanis naturali per tuam gratiam decore servato devotis semper excubiis est propinquus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, in whom it is certain that all the reasonable and pious merits of the whole created rational nature are always accepted, it is evident that those who surpass the remaining spiritual dignity are more pleasing to You. We humbly ask that our festivity offered for the veneration of Him may be acceptable to Your majesty, through whose grace we serve You with devotion and constant vigilance. He is ever near.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus apud quem est continua sanctorum festivitas tuorum praesta quaesumus ut qui sollemnitatem beati Erkenwaldi pontificis agimus ab hostium nostrorum eruamur nequitia et ad aeternorum provehi concedas beneficia praemiorum.
