translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, in whom the continuous festivity of saints dwells, we humbly ask that you deliver us from the wickedness of our enemies as we celebrate the solemnity of Blessed Erkenwald, bishop. May you grant us blessings of eternal reward.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus apud quem semper est praeclara vita sanctorum et in cuius conspectu maiestatis permanet mors tuorum pretiosa iustorum clementiam tuam suppliciter imploramus ut preces nostras et hostias quas in honorem et venerationem Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctorumque apostolorum martyrum confessurum ac virginum omniumque electorum tuorum tuae miserationi humiliter offerimus pius ac propitius suscipias et praesta ut qui illorum devotis mentibus in terra veneramur triumphum eorum quoque in caelo mereamur te miserante habere consortium.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, in whom the life of saints is always glorious and before whose majesty the death of the just is precious, we humbly beseech your clemency. We offer to you our prayers and the offerings that we present in honor and veneration of the Mother of God, the holy apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all the elect, hoping for your mercy. May you graciously receive and grant them that those who on earth reverence them may also deserve to have their triumph in heaven through your mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus auctor virtutis et amator virginitatis da nobis quaesumus sanctae illius virginis tuae placitis tibi meritis commendari cuius vita merito castitatis tibi complacuit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, author of virtue and lover of virginity, grant us we beseech you, that we may be recommended to your holy virgin according to her pleasing and worthy of your mercy, whose life has deservedly pleased you with chastity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus auctor virtutis et amator virginitatis qui beatam Etheldredam hodierna die dignatus es ad caeli gaudia deducere suppliciter tuam imploramus clementiam ut cuius sacram sollemnitatem celebramus in arvis de eiusdem patrociniis gaudeamus in astris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, author of virtues and lover of virginity, who today have been pleased to lead the blessed Etheldreda into heavenly joys, we humbly beseech Your clemency. May we, as we celebrate her sacred solemnity on earth, rejoice in her patronage among the stars.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus bonam nobis quaesumus in prosperis et adversis tribue voluntatem ut tuis in omnibus parere mereamur praeceptis et hanc oblationem famulorum tuorum benignus assume ut qui brachio tuo reguntur et te solum patrem et dominum confitentur sentiant se nullis diaboli laqueis posse teneri quos tua dextera protegit et defendit sed perpetua exsultatione sine fine laetentur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly ask you to grant us a good will in prosperous and adverse times, that we may deserve to obey your commandments in all things. We also pray that you graciously receive this offering of your servants, so that those who are ruled by your arm may confess you as the only father and lord, feel themselves unable to be ensnared by any devices of the devil, whom your right hand protects and defends. May they rejoice perpetually without end in everlasting joy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus caelestium terrestriumque moderator qui famulum tuum illum ad regni fastigium dignatus es provehere concede quaesumus ut a cunctis adversitatibus liberatus et ecclesiasticae pacis dono muniatur et ad aeternae pacis gaudia te donante pervenire mereatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, moderator of the heavens and earth, who have deemed worthy to raise your servant to the summit of the kingdom, we beseech you to grant that he may be freed from all adversities, armed with the gift of ecclesiastical peace, and merit to arrive at the joys of eternal peace through your giving.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus clementiam tuam humiliter imploramus pro famulis et famulabus tuis qui nobis confessi sunt sua peccata ut digneris illis indulgere et vitam aeternam tribuere.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Almighty everlasting God, to have mercy on Your servants and servants who have confessed their sins to us, that You may deign to forgive them and grant them eternal life.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus clementiam tuam suppliciter exoramus ut qui mala nostra semper praevenis miserando facias nos tibi placitos et piis actionibus et ieiuniis salubribus expiando.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly entreat your clemency that You who always prevent our wrongdoings, may have mercy on us and make us pleasing to You by pious actions and healthful fasting, as we atone for our sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus clementiam tuam suppliciter imploramus ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis tuis et vitae praesentis subsidium et aeternae benedictionis gratiam percipiamus.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Almighty everlasting God, to implore Your mercy that, through the intercession of Your blessed apostles and with the help of present life, we may receive the grace of eternal blessing.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus collocare dignare corpus et animam et spiritum famuli tui illius cuius diem illum depositionis celebra(vi)mus in sinibus Abrahae Isaac et Iacob ut cum dies agnitionis tuae venerit inter sanctos et electos tuos eum resuscitari praecipias.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, deem worthy to place the body and soul and spirit of your servant, whose day of departure we celebrate in the loins of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that when the day of your recognition comes, among the saints and chosen ones of yours, you may command his resurrection.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus conditor animarum qui propter nimiam caritatem tuam non solum misericors sed etiam ipsa misericordia et pietas essentialiter iuste vocaris exaudi preces servorum tuorum quas pro famulo tuo illo ante conspectum maiestatis tuae humiliter fundimus ut non iuxta qualitatem vitae et meritum parvum poscentis sed secundum abundantiam clementiae tuae in paradisi amoenitate requiescat.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, creator of souls, who out of your immeasurable love are not only merciful but also mercy and pity are essentially righteous names you are called upon to hear the prayers of your servants which we humbly pour out for your servant there before your majesty, not according to the quality of life and merit of the small supplicant, but according to the abundance of your mercy, may he rest in the pleasantness of paradise.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus conditor et redemptor animarum qui animabus sanctorum tuorum aeternae beatitudinis praemium contulisti praesta quaesumus ut anima famulae tuae illius quam de hoc saeculo migrare iussisti cuius commemorationem agimus sanctorum consortio perfrui mereatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, Creator and Redeemer of souls, who have granted the eternal beatitude as a reward to the souls of your saints, we humbly ask that you may grant that the soul of your servant, whom you have commanded to depart from this world, whose memory we celebrate in the company of the saints, may merit to share in their fellowship.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus confitenti tibi huic famulo tuo pro tua pietate peccata relaxa ut non plus ei noceat conscientiae reatus ad poenam quam indulgentia tuae pietatis ad veniam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, to you I confess my sins, through your mercy release the burdens of guilt so that my conscience may not suffer more punishment than your mercy grants forgiveness.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus conservator animarum qui quos diligis corripis et quos recipis pie ad emendationem coerces te invocamus Domine ut medelam tuam conferre digneris in animam famuli tui illius qui in corpore patitur membrorum debilitationem vim laboris stimulos infirmitatum; da ei Domine gratiam tuam ut in hora exitus sui de corpore absque peccati macula tibi datori proprio per manus sanctorum angelorum repraesentari mereatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, the conservator of souls, who corrects and receives those whom you love with piety for amendment, we invoke you, Lord. Grant us your mercy, that in the soul of your servant who suffers weakness of limbs, you may bestow strength to endure labor pains, resist infirmities; give him, Lord, your grace so that in the hour of his departure from the body he may be worthy to be presented before you without the stain of sin through the hands of holy angels.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cordibus nostris benignus infunde ut a terrenis intentionibus temperantes propensius caelestia meditemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, pour your kind blessings upon our hearts so that, while keeping a balanced mind towards earthly intentions, we may be more inclined to devote ourselves to heavenly matters.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus corona sanctorum et spes certantium qui hunc diem beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Cyrici et Iulittae matris eius sociorumque illorum martyrio consecrasti da populis tuis haec festa <devote> celebrare et de eorum semper consolatione laetari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, crown of saints and hope of those striving, who on this day have consecrated the happiest martyrs Cyricus and Julitta, their mother, and their companions through their martyrdom, grant to your people that they may devoutly celebrate these feasts and always rejoice in the consolation from them.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus creator humanae reformatorque naturae quam unigenitus tuus in utero perpetuae virginitatis assumpsit respice nos propitius ut Filii tui incarnatione suscepta inter ipsius mereamur membra numerari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, creator and reformer of the human nature which your only-begotten Son assumed in the perpetual virginity of Mary, look upon us graciously, that we may be counted as members worthy of the Son of God, who took on flesh through his incarnation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cui cuncta famulantur elementa intercedente pro nobis beato confessore tuo illo exaudi propitius orationem nostram et tribue nobis misericordiam tuam et quaecumque praecipis ut agamus ipse adiuva ut implere possimus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God to whom all elements pay homage, through your blessed confessor intercede for us graciously. Hear our prayer and grant us your mercy, and whatever you command, help us that we may be able to fulfill it.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cui hostias placationis pio obsequio offerimus pro famulo tuo illo quaesumus ut ei prosint ad salutem et huius muneris assumptio sit salus animarum mentium et corporis subsidium et ad caeleste desiderium sine fine gloriatio.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, to whom we offer sacrifices of pious obedience on behalf of your servant, we humbly ask that it may be beneficial to him for his salvation. May the taking up of this duty serve as the salvation of souls, minds and bodies, and may it provide support for the longing for heavenly desires without end, eternal glory.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cui numquam sine spe misericordiae supplicatur propitiare animae famuli tui illius ut qui de hac vita in tui nominis confessione decessit sanctorum tuorum numero facias aggregari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, to whom no one ever prays without hope of mercy, propitiate the soul of your servant who departed from this life in the confession of your name, and make him join the number of your saints.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cui potestas est sine fine miserendi respice propitius ad humilitatis nostrae supplicem servitutem ut tibi subditas mentes perpetuum defensionis tuae servet auxilium.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, whose power is without end in showing mercy, look upon us propitiously from your throne of majesty, and protect the humble supplication of our service with perpetual aid, keeping our minds forever under your defense.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cui miserendi sine fine potestas est respice propitius ad humilitatis nostrae supplicem servitutem ut donum gratiae tuae quod sumpsimus nobis et pro quibus oblatum est te concedente proficiat ad salutem et mentes nostras semper tibi subditas perpetuo defensionis tuae conserva auxilio atque caelestis gaudii tribue nos esse participes.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, to whose mercy there is no end, look upon us kindly from on high. Look favorably upon our humble service and grant that the gift of your grace, which we have received and for whom it has been offered, may prosper for our salvation. May your perpetual protection always keep our minds submissive to you, help us with your aid, and grant us to be participants in eternal joy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cuius bonitate humana natura condita est da famulis tuis quos ad tuum servitium nutrire satagimus cor docibile bonam voluntatem et vitam immaculatam ut in meditatione tuae legis proficientes caelestis regni participes fieri mereantur per tuorum custodiam mandatorum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, whose goodness is the foundation of human nature, grant to your servants whom we desire to nurture for your service, a docile heart with a good will and an immaculate life, so that, progressing in meditation of your law, they may deserve to become participants of the celestial kingdom through your guardianship of your commandments.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cuius est misericordia inaestimabilis suscipe Domine oblationes et preces nostras quas tibi in commemoratione sanctorum tuorum illorum offerimus et precamur te Domine ut sicut illos pietas tua ad sanctam perduxit gratiam ita famulum tuum illum iubeas ab omnibus sordibus mundari vitiorum et indulgentiam ei concedas peccatorum et ad perfectionem salutis perducere digneris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, whose mercy is immeasurable, receive, Lord, our offerings and prayers which we present to you in commemoration of your saints, and we ask you, Lord, that just as your mercy led those saints to the holy state, so too may you command that your servant be cleansed from all stains of sin, grant him forgiveness for his sins, and deign to lead him to the perfection of salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cuius munere elementa omnia recreantur reminiscere miserationum tuarum et salutiferos imbres humano generi concede propitius quatenus fecunditatis tuae alimoniis omnis terra laetetur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, whose power renews all the elements, remember your mercies and graciously bestow salvific rains upon mankind. Bestow this propitiously, so that all the earth rejoices in the sustenance of your fertility.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cuius spiritu totum corpus ecclesiae sanctificatur et regitur exaudi nos pro universis ordinibus supplicantes ut gratiae tuae munere ab omnibus tibi gradibus fideliter serviatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, whose spirit sanctifies and governs the entire body of the church, hear us on behalf of all orders praying, that by your grace may be faithfully served at every degree by those who serve you.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cuius viae misericordia est semper et veritas praesta quaesumus ut qui a tua clementia confovemur crescamus etiam religionis augmento.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, whose ways mercy is always and truth is everlasting, grant us we beseech you, that we who are nourished by your clemency may grow and increase also in the growth of our faith.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus cura gratia Sancti Spiritus languores famuli tui illius et sua sana vulnera eiusque dimitte peccata atque dolores cunctos cordis et corporis ab eo absterge plenamque ei interius exteriusque sanitatem misericorditer redde ut ope misericordiae tuae restitutus et sanatus ad pristina pietatis tuae reparetur officia.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, through the care of Your divine grace and the intercession of the Holy Spirit, heal the weaknesses of Your servant and heal his wounds. Forgive him all sins and pains. Cleanse him entirely from heart and body afflictions. Mercifully restore to him full health both internally and externally, so that restored and healed by Your mercy, he may be brought back to the duties of his former devotion.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da cordibus nostris illam tuarum rectitudinem semitarum quam beati baptistae Ioannis vox clamantis edocuit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant to our hearts that righteousness of Your ways which the voice of the blessed John the Baptist taught.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da mihi famulo tuo de multitudine miserationum tuarum confidenti correctionem vitae ac morum; lacrimarum fontem ad praeterita ac praesentia necnon futura facinora flenda spemque veniae misericorditer infunde; da mihi etiam in hoc officio semper tibi placitam gerere voluntatem quatenus cum dies vocationis meae venerit ante conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae per omnium sanctorum suffragia veniam consequi merear omnium delictorum atque sanctorum tuorum consortio copulari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant to your servant confidence in the correction of life and manners from the abundance of your mercies; let the fountain of tears be shed for past, present, and future sins, and pour mercifully the hope of forgiveness; furthermore, grant me always to carry out a pleasing will to you in this service, so that when the day of my calling comes before the divine majesty of yours, through the intercession of all saints, I may deserve forgiveness for all sins and be united with your saints.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da nobis fidei spei et caritatis augmentum et ut mereamur assequi quod promittis fac nos amare quod praecipis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant us an increase in faith, hope, and charity, and may we merit to attain what you promise, that we may love what you command.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da nobis in festivitate beatae illius virginis congrua devotione gaudere ut et potentiam tuam in eius transitu laudemus et provisum nobis percipiamus auxilium.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant us with fitting devotion to rejoice on the feast of that blessed virgin, so that we may also praise Your power during her passage and receive the help prepared for us.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da nobis ita dominicae passionis sacramenta peragere ut indulgentiam percipere mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant us the ability to perform the sacred mysteries of the Lord's Passion, so that we may deserve to receive indulgence.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da nobis sanctorum martyrum tuorum illius et illius ita digne merita venerari quatenus et ab instantibus liberemur periculis et digni efficiamur gaudiis sempiternis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant us that we may worthily honor your holy martyrs (his and hers) and thus be freed from impending dangers and become worthy of eternal joys.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da nobis voluntatem tuam et fideli mente retinere et pia conversatione depromere ut Ecclesia tua a profanis vanitatibus expiata non aliud profiteatur verbis aliud exerceat actione.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant us your will and keep us with a faithful mind, and promote us through pious conduct so that Your Church, purified from profane vanities, is not professed by words but performs actions.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da populis tuis praecipuorum apostolorum natalem diem plena devotione venerari ut quorum doctrinis ad confessionem deitatis unius institutus est mundus eorum suffragantibus meritis divinae serviat unitati.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant your chosen peoples the birthday of the principal apostles to be celebrated with chief devotion, so that through their teachings, the world has been established in the confession of the unity of deity. May they intercede for us with their merits, that we may serve divine unity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da populis tuis apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli natalem plena devotione venerari ut quorum doctrinis et confessione Trinitatis unius institutus est mundus eorum suffragantibus meritis divinae serviat unitati.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, grant your people the birthday of your apostles Peter and Paul to be venerated with full devotion, so that the world may be established in the doctrine and confession of the unity of the Trinity through their merits. May they serve divine unity with their prayers.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da populo tuo praesentis diei festivitatem sincero venerari affectu ut qui eam sanctorum martyrum tuorum Nazarii et Celsi annua celebritate devotis frequentant obsequiis eorundem suffragiis caelestis regni gaudia consequantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant to your people on this day's festivity a sincere spirit of veneration, so that those who, with devout attendance, celebrate the annual feast of your holy martyrs Nazarius and Celsus, may attain the joys of the celestial kingdom through their intercession.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da quaesumus nobis sancti pontificis tui Damasi precibus adiuvari ut cuius festa recolimus auxilium capiamus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, we humbly ask that through the prayers of your holy pope Damasus, we may receive help, as we remember his feast day, and obtain aid.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da nobis sanctorum martyrum tuorum Hermachorae et Fortunati precibus adiuvari ut quorum festa praevenimus eorum auxilium capiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant us the aid of your holy martyrs Hermachoras and Fortunatus, that we who celebrate their festival may receive their help.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da quaesumus universis famulis tuis plenius atque perfectius omnia festi paschalis introire mysteria ut incunctanter pia corda cognoscant quantum debeant de confirmata in Christo renascentium glorificatione gaudere.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant we humbly ask to all your servants more fully and perfectly enter the mysteries of the Easter feast, so that they may understand without hesitation how much they should rejoice in the glory of those who are being reborn in Christ.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus deduc nos ad societatem caelestium gaudiorum ut spiritu sancto renatos regnum tuum facias introire atque eo perveniat humilitas gregis quo praecessit celsitudo pastoris.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, lead us to the society of celestial joy so that with the Holy Spirit we may be reborn and enter your kingdom. May humility of the flock follow in the footsteps of the loftiness of the shepherd.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus dimitte nobis Domine Pater peccata nostra et tribue nobis misericordiam tuam orisque nostri alloquio deprecatus nostram humilitatem attende vincula solve delicta dele inimicos averte daemones fuga angelos invita mentem serenam accommoda rectas vias para tribulationem et dolorem inspice angustiam in latitudinem tristitiam in laetitiam converte consilium sanitatis in omni re tribue adversitatem formidinem et errorem repelle omnem caliginem et immunditiam purga atque omnia crimina corrige effectumque petitioni largiens clementer exaudi.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, have mercy on us, Lord, Father, and forgive us our sins. Grant us your mercy and, humbly addressing you, attend to us. Loosen the bonds, remove our offenses, turn away enemies, drive away demons, grant peaceful thoughts, straighten the ways, prepare for tribulation and pain, consider the narrowness, turn tristess into joy, convert the counsel of sickness in all things, give adversity fear and error, repel every fear and confusion, remove all darkness and impurity, cleanse and correct all wrongdoings, answer generously and mercifully to our petition.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus dirige actus nostros in beneplacito tuo ut in nomine dilecti Filii tui mereamur bonis operibus abundare.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, direct our actions in your good pleasure, that we may deserve to abound in good works through the name of your beloved Son.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus Ecclesiae tuae concede propitius ut mortiferis oblectationibus amputatis aeternitatis tuae potius delectatione laetentur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant your church graciously that, being freed from deadly pleasures, they may rejoice rather in the delights of your eternity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus Ecclesiae tuae votis propitiatus adspira ut beati Laurentii martyris meritis adiuvetur cuius passione laetatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, moved by the vows of your Church, inspire that it may be helped through the merits of the blessed Laurence the martyr, whom his passion delights.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus Ecclesiam tuam spiritale iucunditate multiplica ut qui sunt generatione terreni fiant regeneratione caelestes.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, multiply Your Church spiritually with joy so that those who are born in the earthly generation may be reborn into a heavenly one.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus effunde super hunc locum gratiam tuam et omnibus te invocantibus auxilii tui munus ostende ut hic sacramentorum virtus omnium fidelium corda confirmet.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, pour out your grace upon this place and show the aid of your help to all who invoke you. May here the power of the sacraments strengthen the hearts of all the faithful.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus elementa huius mundi salvare digneris; per intercessionem beati Eliae prophetae exaudi propitius orationem nostram et tribue nobis misericordiam tuam et de quacumque tribulatione ad te clamaverimus ipse adiuva ut adimplere possimus.
translation_en: O Almighty eternal God, we humbly ask that you save the elements of this world; through the intercession of the blessed prophet Elijah, graciously hear our prayer and grant us your mercy. And from whatever tribulation we have cried out to you, help us to fulfill our duty.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus exaudi nos et miserere nostri quoniam tribulamur; libera et eripe nos de manibus inimicorum nostrorum et a persequentibus nos et praesta ut qui te invocamus non confundamur sed tua magis semper protectione muniamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, hear us and have mercy upon us, for we are in trouble; free and deliver us from the hands of our enemies and those who pursue us, and grant that those who invoke you may not be ashamed but may always be protected by your protection.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus fac nos tibi semper et devotam gerere voluntatem et maiestati tuae sincero corde servire.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, make us always to carry a devoted will towards you and to serve your majesty with a sincere heart.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus fidelium splendor animarum qui hanc sollemnitatem electionis gentium primitiis consecrasti imple mundum gloria tua et subditis tibi populis per luminis tui appare claritatem.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, shining splendor of souls of the faithful whom you have consecrated with the firstfruits of this solemnity of nations, fill the world with your glory and make evident to the peoples subject to you the brightness of your light.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus fons omnium virtutum et plenitudo gratiarum dignare aedem sacro baptismati praeparatam maiestatis tuae praesentia consecrare ut qui ubique totus es etiam hic adesse te in nostris precibus sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, source of all virtues and fullness of blessings, deign to consecrate the place prepared for the sacred baptism with your presence, so that we may feel your presence here as well, everywhere, in our prayers.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus fortitudo certantium et martyrum palma sollemnitatem hodiernae diei propitius intuere et Ecclesiam tuam continua fac celebritate laetari et intercessione beati martyris Prisci omnium in te credentium vota perficias.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, graciously look upon the triumph of those who contend and the palm of the martyrs on this day, and may your Church rejoice continually with festive joy. Through the intercession of the blessed martyr Priscus, may all prayers of those who believe in you be fulfilled.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus hoc baptisterium caelesti visitatione dedicatum spiritus tui illustratione sanctifica ut quoscumque fons iste lavaturus est trina ablutione purgati indulgentiam omnium delictorum tuo munere consequantur.
translation_en: The Almighty everlasting God, by the visitation of heaven, dedicates this baptistery and sanctifies it by the illumination of your spirit, so that whoever is washed here by the triple ablution may obtain indulgence for all sins through your grace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus hodierna festivitate populo tuo devoto supplicanti beneficia potiora tuae largitatis impende et quod mole peccaminum obrutus non valet obtinere patrocinante beato Maximo solita pietate concede.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, on this festive day bestow upon your devoted supplicant people, the more abundant blessings of your generosity. And since weighed down by the burden of sins, cannot obtain it on our own, grant it through the usual devotion of blessed Maximus.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus hostilia quaesumus arma confringe ut imperturbatis mentibus agere tua sancta possimus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, we humbly ask that you shatter hostile weapons, so that we may act with undisturbed minds in your holy matters.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus Iesu Christe Domine esto propitius peccatis meis per assumptionem corporis et sanguinis tui. Tu enim loquens dixisti: »Qui manducat meam carnem et bibit meum sanguinem in me manet ei ego in eo.« Ideo te supplex deprecor ut in me cor mundum crees et spiritum rectum in visceribus meis innoves et spiritu principali me confirmare digneris atque ab omnibus insidiis diaboli ac vitiis emundes ut gaudiorum caelestium merear esse particeps.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, Jesus Christ Lord, be propitious to my sins through the assumption of your body and blood. For you spoke, "Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood abides in me, and I in him." Therefore, I humbly beseech you to create in me a clean heart and renew a right spirit within my innards, and deign to strengthen me with the Holy Spirit, and cleanse me from all the snares of the devil and vices, so that I may deserve to be a participant of celestial joys.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus in cuius arbitrio regnorum omnium iura consistunt protege romani nominis ubique rectores ut eorum votiva prosperitas pax tuorum possit esse populorum.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, in whose judgment the rights of all kingdoms lie, protect everywhere the governors bearing the Roman name, that their prosperity through vows may be the peace of your people.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus in cuius manu sunt omnium potestates et omnia iura regnorum respice ad Romanum benignus imperium ut gentes quae in sua feritate confidunt potentiae tuae dextera comprimantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, in whose hand are all powers and rights of kingdoms, look upon the Roman Empire with benevolent regard. May the nations that boastfully rely on your power be subdued by your right hand.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus in cuius nomine gloriosa virgo et martyr Dorothea multorum tormentorum genera superavit te suppliciter exoramus ut eius interventu cuncta pericula vincamus ipsamque in nostris necessitatibus celerem adiutricem sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, in whose name the glorious virgin and martyr Dorothea overcame many torments, we humbly beseech you that through her intervention we may overcome all dangers, and feel her as a swift helper in our necessities.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus in protectione fidelium populorum antiqua brachii tui operare miracula ut hostibus nostris tua virtute compressis secura tibi serviat romana devotio.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, working miracles in the ancient strength of your arm, protect your faithful people so that, with our enemies subdued by your power, a loyal devotion to you may safely serve Rome.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus infirmitatem nostram propitius respice atque ad protegendum nos dexteram tuae maiestatis extende.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, have pity on our weakness and extend the right hand of your majesty to protect us.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus insere te officiis nostris et in hac manentibus domo praesentiae tuae concede custodiam ut familiae tuae defensor ac totius habitaculi huius habitator appareas.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, be present with us in our offices and grant that Your presence remains in this dwelling. Grant us protection so that You appear as the defender of Your family and the inhabitant of this entire dwelling.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus largitor pacis et generis humani formator da servis tuis veram voluntatem concordiae et indulgentiam tuae pietatis infunde.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, bestower of peace and shaper of the human race, grant your servants a true intention of harmony and pour out your grace of mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus maestorum consolatio laborantium fortitudo perveniant ad te preces de quacumque tribulatione clamantium ut omnes sibi in necessitatibus suis misericordiam tuam gaudeant adfuisse.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, consolation of the sorrowful, strength of those who labor, may their prayers from any tribulation reach you. Let all those who cry out to you in need rejoice that your mercy has come to them.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus magnifici pontificis et martyris tui Lamberti gloriosa merita recolentibus da veniam de cunctis sceleribus facque eos gaudere in regnis caelestibus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant remission of all sins to the glorious merits of your Bishop and Martyr Lambert, and make them rejoice in the kingdoms of heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus maiestatem tuam supplices exoramus ut famulo tuo illi abbati atque sacerdoti quem in requiem tuam vocare dignatus es dones sedem honorificatam et fructum beatitudinis sempiternae ut ea quae in oculis nostris docuit et gessit non iudicium nobis pariant sed profectum attribuant ut pro quo nunc in te gaudemus in terris cum eodem apud te exsultare mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech your majesty that you grant to your servant, the abbot and priest whom you have deemed worthy to call to your rest, a dignified seat and eternal beatitude's fruit. May what he has taught us with his eyes and performed not bring judgment upon us but credit to us, so that we who now rejoice in him on earth may be worthy to rejoice with the same one at you in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus maiestatem tuam supplices exoramus ut sicut unigenitus Filius tuus hodierna die cum nostrae carnis substantia in templo est praesentatus ita nos facias purificatis tibi mentibus praesentari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech Your majesty, that just as Your only Son was presented today with our bodily substance in the temple, so may You make us present to You with purified minds.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecor ut qui me famulum tuum in multis deliquisse confiteor auxilium gratiae tuae mihi miseratus impendas et qui ad immolandas hostias salutares coram omnipotentiam maiestatis tuae per memetipsum quamvis indignus accedo tu placatus et clemens quidquid nequam admisi benignus absolve.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, I humbly beseech Your majesty that I, Your servant, who have sinned greatly, may receive the help of Your grace and, although unworthy, approach to offer salvific sacrifices before Your omnipotent majesty. You, being pleased and merciful, may You graciously forgive whatever sin I have committed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus maiestatem tuam suppliciter exoramus ut intercessione beati Taurini confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius hodie annuam festivitatem recolimus cum temporalibus incrementis aeternae prosperitatis capiamus augmentum.
translation_en: We humbly invoke your almighty and eternal Godliness, that through the intercession of blessed Taurinus, your confessor and bishop, whose today's anniversary we commemorate, we may attain an increase in temporal blessings and eternal prosperity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus mentes nostras quaesumus ad opera tibi placitura converte ut correptio tua non sit neglegentibus maior causa poenarum sed fiat eruditio paterna correctis.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, we humbly ask that you turn our minds towards works pleasing to you. May your correction not be a cause of greater punishment for the negligent, but may it become a fatherly instruction for those who are corrected.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus miserere famulo tuo illi et dirige eum secundum tuam clementiam in viam salutis aeternae ut te donante tibi placita cupiat et tota virtute perficiat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, have mercy on your servant and guide him according to your clemency on the way of eternal salvation. May he desire what pleases you and accomplish it with all his strength.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus miserere supplici famulo tuo et da quaesumus ne plus ei noceat conscientiae reatus ad poenam quam indulgentia tuae pietatis ad veniam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, have mercy on your suppliant servant and grant us as we ask, that it may not harm him consciousness of guilt for punishment, but rather the pity of your forgiveness for pardon.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus miserere supplicum in tua protectione fidentium et per gloriam nominis tui barbarum gentium comprime feritatem ut dexterae tuae virtute defensi liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, have mercy on the supplicants who trust in your protection, and by the glory of your name subdue the barbarity of pagan peoples, so that having been defended by your power, we may serve you with free minds.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus misericordiam tuam ostende supplicibus ut qui de meritorum qualitate diffidimus non iudicium (tuum) sed indulgentiam sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, show your mercy to the suppliant ones, so that those who doubt the quality of merits may not feel judgment (from you), but indulgence.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus misericordiam tuam supplices deprecamur ut animam famuli tui cuius corpori debitum sepulturae officium persolvimus in sinum Abrahae patriarchae tui iubeas collocari ut cum dies agnitionis tuae advenerit inter sanctos et electos tuos eum resuscitari praecipias.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech your mercy that the soul of your servant, whose body has fulfilled the duty of burial, you grant to be placed in the bosom of Abraham, your patriarch. When the day of your recognition comes, may you command him to be resurrected among the saints and chosen ones of yours.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus misericordiam tuam supplices exoramus ut famulum tuum regem nostrum illum cum suis ovibus magna pietatis tuae protectione custodias et ab omnibus huius mundi periculis sempiterna provisione tuearis ut gratiae tuae munere defensi donis semper caelestibus iucundentur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech your mercy that you may protect your servant, our king, and his people with great pity, and by eternal provision keep them safe from all perils of this world. May they be defended by the gifts of your grace, and always enjoy celestial blessings.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus misericordiam tuam supplices exoramus ut hoc tuum Domine sacramentum non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sed fiat intercessio salutaris ad veniam; sit abolitio peccatorum sit fortitudo fragilium sit contra mundi pericula firmamentum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech Your mercy that this Your sacrament may not be a burden to us for punishment, but may become a saving intercession for forgiveness; may it be the abolition of sins, may it be the strength of the weak, may it be a firmament against the perils of the world.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus misericordiam tuam supplices exoramus ut nobis per intercessionem sancti antistitis tui Martini propitius ac placatus nostra peccata indulgeas et gloriam primae resurrectionis tribuas et a secunda morte defendas.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech your mercy that through the intercession of your holy bishop Saint Martin, you may be propitious and placated towards our sins, grant us forgiveness and bestow the glory of the first resurrection, and protect us from the second death.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus misericordiam tuam suppliciter deprecamur ut oblationes populi tui quas tibi de suis primitiis offerunt benignus suscipere digneris; tribue eis Domine in hoc saeculo abundantiam tritici vini et olei in futuro autem vitam aeternam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly ask you to graciously accept the offerings of your people that they present to you from their first fruits; may you grant them, Lord, in this world an abundance of wheat, wine and oil. In the future, may you give them eternal life.

text: Misericordiam pietatis tuae supplices deprecamur omnipotens aeterne Deus ut oblationes populi tui quas tibi de suis primitiis offerunt benignus suscipere digneris; tribue eis Domine in hoc saeculo abundantiam tritici vini et olei in futuro autem vitam aeternam; commemorationem quoque facientibus nobis beatissimorum martyrum et confessorum veniam peccatorum largiri dignare.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your mercy, O eternal God, almighty, that you graciously receive the offerings of your people which they present to you from their first fruits; grant them in this world, Lord, abundance of wheat, wine and oil. In the future, give them eternal life. Also, deign to forgive our sins to those who remember the most blessed martyrs and confessors.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus misericordiarum pater creator ac redemptor generis humani qui non vis mortem peccatorum sed ut convertantur et vivant exaudi precem meam qua suppliciter exorare praesumo pro famulo tuo illo sacerdote et non mea reputes peccata sed eius propitius respice fidem qui me pro se rogavit intercedere ad tuam clementissimam pietatem. Dignare ei in tuo servitio augere bonam voluntatem et fidem ac propitius peccata dimitte.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, Father of mercies, Creator and Redeemer of the human race, who wills not the death of a sinner but rather that they repent and live, hear my humble prayer as I presume to intercede for your servant, that particular priest. Do not consider my sins but look favorably upon him because he asked me to intercede on his behalf. Grant him an increase in goodwill and faith in your service, and mercifully forgive his sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus mundentur quaesumus viscera nostra a cunctis carnis delictis ieiunii attenuatione confecta et in ipsius ieiunii humilitate prostratis non valeat carnis infirmitas dominari quia tu institutor sobrietatis si vis potes nostri citius misereri ut spiritalia cogitemus et concupiscentias carnis te adiuvante vincamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly ask that our hearts be purified from all the sins of flesh, strengthened by the weakening of fasting. And in the humility of this very fast, may not the weakness of the flesh prevail over us, for you are the founder of temperance if you wish, you can make us merciful sooner, so that we may think spiritually and with your help conquer earthly desires.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus mundi creator et rector qui beatos apostolos nominis tui gloria consecrasti exaudi populum tuum cum sanctorum tuorum tibi patrocinio supplicantem ut pacis dono proficiat ad fidei et caritatis augmentum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, creator and ruler of the world, who consecrated the blessed apostles in your glory, hear your people who are pleading with the patronage of your saints. May the gift of peace advance towards an increase in faith and charity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus munera tuae maiestati oblata per intercessionem beati Martini confessoris tui atque pontificis ad perpetuam fac nobis proficere salutem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we offer your gifts to the majesty of your mercy through the intercession of the blessed Martin, your confessor and pope. May it make us continually progress in eternal salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus ne apud iustitiam tuam peccata nostra nos aggravent germanorum martyrum suffragiis adiuvemur quos et partus unus et par martyrii palma coniunxit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, may our sins not weigh heavier with Your justice because of the prayers of the German martyrs, whom one birth and a shared martyr's palm united.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus nostras indignas suscipe preces et in his sacris libaminibus quae precamur intende et sicut Moysi et Aaron fuisti propitius in Aegypto ita dignare famulum tuum illum cum omni exercitu suo liberare de tyrannorum terrore et iube eos cum exsultatione ad propria remeare.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, receive our unworthy prayers and attend to the sacred incense which we offer. Just as You were merciful to Moses and Aaron in Egypt, so have mercy on Your servant and his whole army, freeing him from the terror of tyrants, and command them to return home with exultation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus origo cunctarum perfectioque virtutum da nobis quaesumus et exercere quae recta sunt et praedicare quae vera ut instructionem gratiae tuae praebeamus et agendo tuis fidelibus et docendo.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, the source of all and perfector of virtues, grant us as we ask that we may perform what is right and proclaim what is true, so that by our actions we may provide instruction in Your grace, and acting and teaching among Your faithful.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus parce metuentibus et propitiare supplicibus ut post noxios ignes nubium et vim procellarum in materiam transeat laudis comminatio potestatis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, have mercy on the fearful and be propitious to the supplicants, that after the destructive fires of clouds and the force of storms, the declaration of your power may pass upon praiseworthy matter.

text: Deus sub cuius imperio nihil non verbo regitur nihil non oratione mutatur parce metuentibus propitiare supplicibus ut post noxios ignes nubium et turbines procellarum in materiam transeat laudis comminatio potestatis.
translation_en: God, under whose rule nothing is not governed by word, nothing changed by prayer, have mercy on the fearful and grant favor to the supplicants, so that after harmful fires, clouds, and storms, the proclamation of praise may pass over matter.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi te supplices deprecamur ut imperes diabolo qui hunc famulum tuum illum detinet ut ab eo recedat et liberes eum qui credidit in verum liberatorem Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum ut purgata ab eo omni labe iniquitatis maiestati tuae pura mente deserviat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, we humbly entreat you to command the devil who holds this your servant, that he may withdraw from him and release him who believes in our true Savior Lord Jesus Christ. May he be cleansed by him of all stain of unrighteousness, and serve your majesty with a pure mind.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus per quem coepit esse quod non erat et factum est visibile quod latebat stultitia nostri cordis emunda et quae in nobis sunt vitiorum secreta purifica ut possimus tibi domino pura mente servire.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, through whom that which was not came to be and what was hidden became visible, cleanse the foolishness of our hearts and purify the secrets of our sins, so that we may serve you, Lord, with a pure mind.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus petimus divinam clementiam tuam ut faciem totius terrae largioribus imbribus irrigare digneris aurasque salubres tribuas atque ae(g)ris restituas pristinam sanitatem et animae quae promissiones tuas sitiunt de tuae semper caritatis abundantia repleantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly ask for Your divine clemency that You may deign to water the whole earth with more abundant showers, grant healthy breezes, and restore pristine health. May the souls who thirst for Your promises be filled from Your endless love.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus placabilis et acceptabilis sit tibi haec oblatio quam ego indignus offero tibi pro tribulatione et liberatione nostra et pro pace totius christianitatis ut nos a praesenti tribulatione eripias et pariter nobis indulgentiam tribuas benignus et pacem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, gracious and acceptable may this offering be to you, which I, unworthy, offer to you for our affliction and liberation, and for the peace of all Christianity. May You graciously deliver us from the present affliction, and in Your kindness grant us forgiveness and peace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus populi fidelis institutor et rector in familia sacramento tui nominis acquisita gratiae tuae dona custodi ut bona quae te auctore percepit te protegente serventur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, instigator and ruler of the faithful people, in Your sacrament You acquired grace. Guard that the good things which You, the Author, granted and protected may be preserved.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus populi tui preces exaudi qui beatum Machutum confessorem tuum atque pontificem virtutis gratia decorasti et eum hodie in caelesti gloria suscepisti.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, hear the prayers of your people. You adorned the blessed Machutus, your confessor and bishop, with grace of virtue, and today you received him into celestial glory.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus praesta nobis propitius sanctorum martyrum tuorum Albani sociorumque eius glorioso triumpho solidae fidei nos protegi et eorum tolerantia passionis proficere et intercessionibus gaudere.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant us your merciful help. Protect us strongly with the steadfast faith of your saints martyrs Alban and his companions, through their glorious triumph. May we profit from their endurance in suffering, and rejoice in their intercessions.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus pro cuius unigeniti veneranda infantia Infantium innocentium catervas Herodis funesti peremit saevitia quique dedisti eis ut unicum Filium tuum Dominum nostrum non loquendo sed moriendo confiterentur da nobis quaesumus ut fidem veram quam lingua nostra fatetur etiam mores probi et vita inculpabilis fateatur quo pervenire ad gaudia aeternae patriae mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, for whose venerable infancy the bands of innocent children were cruelly slain by Herod's cruelty, and who gave them so that they might confess your unique Son, our Lord, not through speech but through death, grant us we pray, that the true faith which our tongue confesses may also be confirmed by our righteous deeds and blameless life, to enable us to deserve the joys of eternal fatherland.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus propensius his diebus tuam misericordiam consequamur quibus eam plenius te largiente cognovimus.
translation_en: On these days, we more closely approach the almighty and eternal God, whose mercy we have come to know more fully through your generous bestowal.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus propitiare nobis famulis tuis per beatorum martyrum tuorum Hermogenis et Fortunati quorum corpora in Aquileyensi ecclesia requiescunt merita gloriosa ut eorum pia intercessione ab omnibus protegantur adversis et caelestibus muniamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, propitiate us, your servants, through the blessed martyrs Hermogenes and Fortunatus whose bodies rest in the church of Aquileia, that through their pious intercession they may protect us from all dangers and arm us with celestial aid.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus quem docente spiritu sancto paterno nomine invocare praesumimus effice in nobis filiorum corda fidelium ut hereditatem promissam mereamur ingredi per debitam servitutem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, whom we presume to invoke by the teaching of the Holy Spirit in the name of the Father, make in us the hearts of faithful children so that we may worthy enter into the promised inheritance through due service.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui abundantia pietatis tuae et merita supplicum excedis et vota effunde super nos misericordiam tuam ut dimittas quae conscientia metuit et adicias quod oratio non praesumit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who exceeds the abundance of your pity and the merits of supplicants, pour out your mercy upon us, that you may forgive what conscience fears, and add to it that prayer does not presume.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui ad aeternam vitam  in Christi resurrectione nos reparas custodi opera misericordiae tuae et suavitatem corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi unigeniti Filii tui nostris infunde pectoribus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who renews us for eternal life in the resurrection of Christ, keep us safe by your merciful works and fill our hearts with the sweetness of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, your only-begotten Son.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui ad imaginem tuam factum invidia diaboli a paradiso deiectum unici Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi sanguine redemisti hominem exaudi me toto corde totaque mente te dominum universorum invocantem pro me famulo tuo in te solum defensorem et protectorem verum Deum spem habentem. Mitte mihi auxilium de caelis te deprecando teque invocando. Da fortitudinem ad inimicum respuendum. Subveni pius ne consensum praebeam illius suggestioni. Non permittas me Domine amplius temptationibus concuti quam sustinere possum. Da mihi Sancti Spiritus fervorem ut advenientes cognoscem cogitationes et cognitas a me inimicorum insidias temptationesque repellam ut tibi in omnibus diebus vitae meae placeam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who, in Your image, cast down man, the only-begotten Son of Yourself, our Lord Jesus Christ, was driven out of Paradise by the envy of the devil and redeemed him with Your blood, hear me wholeheartedly and with my entire mind invoking You as the Lord of all, seeking refuge and protection in You, the true God, who have hope. Send me help from heaven as I beseech and invoke You. Give me strength to repel my enemy. Save me, merciful one, lest I give consent to his suggestion. Do not allow me, Lord, to be further shaken by temptations more than I can bear. Give me the fervor of the Holy Spirit so that, when they come, I may recognize the schemes and known traps of my enemies and repel their deceitful temptations, so that I may always please You throughout all the days of my life.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui aegritudines et animorum depellis et corporum auxilii tui super infirmos nostros ostende virtutem ut ope misericordiae tuae ad omnia pietatis tuae reparentur officia.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who drives away the sorrows and infirmities of both soul and body from our afflicted ones, show your power so that, through your mercy, all duties of your pity are performed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui angelum tuum de caelo misisti ut ab ostio monumenti saxum magnum sublavaret et sedens super illud testificaret <et> resurrectionem Iesu Christi Domini nostri blando sermone mulieribus nuntiaret praesta quaesumus nobis ut per venerabile atque gloriosum eiusdem redemptoris nostri sepulcrum a vitiorum sepulcris resuscitari mereamur et felicitatis aeternae gaudia consequamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who sent your angel from heaven to raise a large stone from the door of the monument and to sit upon it as a witness, and to announce with gentle words the resurrection of Jesus Christ our Lord to the women, grant us, we beseech you, that through the venerable and glorious tomb of the same Redeemer of ours, we may be worthy to rise from the tombs of sin and attain the joy of eternal happiness.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui animae famuli tui Philiberti abbatis atque sacerdotis aeternae beatitudinis praemia contulisti da quaesumus ut qui eius sollemnia celebramus in terris eius meritis adiuvemur in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who bestowed the rewards of eternal beatitude upon the soul of your servant Philbert, abbot and priest, grant us we beseech you, that as we celebrate his solemnities on earth, we may be aided by his merits in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui arctam et angustam iussisti arripere viam famulos tuos de huius saeculi periculis ad te refugientes propitius suscipe et delictorum catenam qua se constrictos esse sentiunt clementer disrumpe perseverantiamque boni operis et praemia eis largire perpetua.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who commanded your servants to take hold of the narrow and difficult way from this world's dangers seeking refuge in you, graciously receive them. Mildly break the chain of sins they feel constricted by, persist in good works, and grant them eternal rewards.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatae virginis tuae Austrobertae merita nos in praesenti festivitate venerari voluisti adesto precibus supplicantium et praesta ut cuius temporali celebritate gratulamur eius meritis et precibus aeternae beatitudinis praemia consequamur.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who willed to be venerated on this present feast day for the merits of Your blessed virgin Austroberta, be present with the prayers of supplicants and grant that we rejoice in her temporal celebration with her merits and may obtain the rewards of eternal beatitude through her prayers.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatam Luciam dirae passionis et virginalis munditiae meritis beatis martyribus et virginibus aggregasti da quaesumus ut quam festivis honoribus veneramur fidei et sanctorum operum gressibus imitemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who, with the merits of blessed Lucy of the dreadful passion and virginal purity, joined her to the blessed martyrs and virgins, we humbly ask that we honor her with the most festive honors, and imitate her steps in the works of faith and saints.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatam virginem Milburgam regali stemmate sublimasti atque Anglorum genti in sollemnitate huius diei gloriosa patrocinia contulisti concede propitius familiae tuae meritis ipsius a peccatorum nexibus absolvi et sanctorum coetibus feliciter adiungi.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who exalted the blessed virgin Milburga to a royal lineage and granted glorious patronage to the English people on this day's solemnity, graciously grant that your family be absolved from the bonds of sins and happily joined with the company of saints.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatam Wenefredam virginitatis praemio decorasti fac nos quaesumus eius pia intercessione mundi huius blandimenta postponere et cum ipsa perennis gloriae sedem obtinere.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who adorned blessed Winifred with the reward of virginity, grant us we beseech you, through her pious intercession, to postpone the allurements of this world and obtain eternal glory together with her.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatissimum praecursorem tuum Ioannem Baptistam ad praeparandas unigeniti tui vias nasci iussisti praesta quaesumus ut intercessionis eius auxilium tribuas et ad implenda mandata praepares voluntates.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who commanded your most blessed forerunner John the Baptist to be born to prepare the ways of your only-begotten Son, grant us, we pray, that through his intercession you provide aid and prepare our wills to fulfill your commands.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beato Bonifatio sociisque eius palmam martyrii contulisti praesta nobis quaesumus eorum meritis indulgentiam qui eis largiri dignatus es coronam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who granted the blessed Boniface and his companions the palm of martyrdom, grant us, we ask, through their merits, indulgence, for you have been gracious enough to bestow a crown upon them.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beato David confessori tuo atque pontifici nondum nato locum habitationis per sanctum angelum tuum mirabiliter praevidisti concede nobis propitius ut eius meritis quem veneramur in terris tuo semper adspectu cum ipso perfruamur in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through your holy angel foresaw a place of habitation for the blessed David, your confessor and pope, before he was born, graciously grant us that we may always behold him on earth whom we venerate, and with him be enraptured in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beato Satyro inter procellas maris et turbines naufraganti admirabilem fidei constantiam tribuisti concede propitius ipsius nos orationum suffragio inter mundana discrimina solidissimum semper invenire tutamen.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who granted to the blessed Satyr an incredible steadfastness of faith amidst the tempests and storms of the sea, grant us, propitiously, through his intercession, always to find a firm refuge among the world's tribulations.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatum Arnulfum confessorem tuum atque pontificem et pontificatus officio et fidei munere sublimasti tribue supplicibus tuis ut quidquid peccati contagione contractum est in nobis ipso pro nobis summo antistite tuo intercedente solvatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who exalted your servant and bishop Arnulf, both in the office of pontificate and the ministry of faith, grant to your supplicants that whatever has been contracted by the contagion of sin within us may be dissolved through the intercession of your highest bishop, Arnulf.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui Ambrosii et pontificatus officio et fidei munere sublimasti tribue supplicibus tuis ut quidquid peccati contagione contractum est ipso pro nobis summo antistite intercedente solvatur.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who exalted your Church through the office and ministry of faith of your blessed priest and confessor Ambrosius, grant to your supplicants that whatever is contracted by contagion of sin may be dissolved for us with the intercession of the chief bishop intervening.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatum Gregorium innumeris virtutibus declaratum summum pontificem populo tuo ordinari voluisti concede propitius ut apud misericordiam tuam meritis eius et intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who have declared blessed Gregory to be supreme pontiff through countless virtues, mercifully grant that we may be helped through his merits and intercessions before your mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatum Martialem apostolum tuum Ecclesiae tuae sanctae praeesse yoluisti quaesumus ut eius nobis suffragantibus meritis pietatis tuae gratiam largiaris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who allowed your blessed apostle Martial to preside over your holy Church, we humbly ask that you bestow your grace upon us through his merits of piety.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatum Patricium Hibernensium elegisti apostolum tuum praesta quaesumus ut cuius doctrina fidem sumpsimus eius intercessione in bonis actibus roboremur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who chose the blessed Patrick as your apostle, grant us, we pray, that through whose doctrine we have taken faith, we may be strengthened by his intercession in good works.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatum Quintinum martyrem tuum tua virtute fecisti victorem da nobis tuae propitiationis effectum ut sicut illi palmam caelestis contulisti triumphi ita nobis eius intercessionibus veniam largiaris peccati.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who made your servant Quintinus a victor through your power, grant us the effect of your propitiation, so that just as you granted him the palm of celestial triumph, so may we receive forgiveness for our sins through his intercessions.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatum regem Edwardum sanctorum tuorum collegio sociasti concede propitius ut qui gloriosae translationis eius recolimus insignia ipsius apud te sentiamus patrocinia.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who associated the blessed King Edward with your college of saints, graciously grant that we who remember the insignia of his glorious translation feel his patronage with you.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui beatum Zenonem confessorem tuum pontificalibus infulis decorasti fac nos quaesumus eius exemplo et magnifico interventu mundi gloriam mente despicere et caelum semper ambire.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who adorned your confessor Zenon with pontifical insignia, grant us, we beseech you, that through his example and a magnificent intervention of the world, we may contemplate the glory of heaven with our mind and always strive for it.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui caelestia simul et terrena moderaris supplicationes populi tui clementer exaudi et pacem tuam nostris concede temporibus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who moderates both heavenly and earthly pleas of your people, hear them kindly and grant us your peace in our times.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Christi tui beata passione nos reparas conserva in nobis opera misericordiae tuae ut in huius celebritate mysterii perpetua devotione vivamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through the blessed passion of your Christ restores us, preserve in us the works of your mercy, that we may live in perpetual devotion to this mystery.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui coaeternum tibi filium hodie pro mundi salute secundum carnem spiritu sancto concipiendum angelico ministerio beatae Mariae semper virgini declarasti adesto propitius populo tuo ut ad eius nativitatem pace concessa liberioribus animis occurramus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who today declared in eternity that your only-begotten Son would be conceived in the flesh by the Holy Spirit through the ministry of the angel Gabriel to the blessed Virgin Mary, always a virgin, be present propitiously to your people. May we approach more freely with peace-granted souls at his nativity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui commemorationem visitationis beatae Mariae matris Dei fieri voluisti praesta quaesumus ut per hoc sacrificium quod sumpsimus ab eius visitationis gratia nullatenus excidamus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who willed that the commemoration of the visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, be made, we beseech You to grant through this sacrifice which we have taken up from her visitation's grace, that in no way may we fall away.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui continuum etiam post fusam ad te precem gemitum Annae dum eam fecundares in gaudium convenisti desiderium famulae tuae illius ut fecundetur propitius perfice et ad laudem gloriae tuae ab ea opprobrium sterilitatis benignus averte.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who even after the fervent prayer of Anna, her groan when you made her fruitful in joy, did agree with her desire that she might bear children graciously fulfill. And may you, for the praise and glory of your name, kindly remove from her the disgrace of sterility.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui contulisti fidelibus tuis remedia vitae post mortem praesta quaesumus propitius ac placatus ut anima famuli tui illius a peccatis omnibus expiata in tuae redemptionis sorte requiescat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who hast provided remedies for life after death for thy faithful, grant us, we beseech thee, graciously and mercifully, that the soul of thy servant may, cleansed from all sins, rest in the lot of redemption.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui cooperante coaeterna tibi sapientia nobis in honorem sanctarum virginum et martyrum tuarum Fidei Spei et Caritatis atque genitricis earum Sapientiae <hanc sollemnitatem dignaris> donare sollemnem tribue nobis ipsis intercedentibus sanctae fidei spei et caritatis venerabile donum <ut iisdem> virtutibus operando quae recta sunt <in terrestribus aeternum praemium> percipere mereamur in caelestibus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who through coeternal wisdom cooperate with you, grant us the honor of the holy virgins and martyrs under your care: Faith, Hope, Charity, and their Mother, Wisdom. May this solemnity be worthy for you to give or bestow upon us, as we intercede through the venerable gift of the holy faith, hope, and charity. May we, while operating with these virtues that are righteous on earth, deserve an eternal reward in heaven for them.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui corpus gloriosae virginis tuae Katherinae in montem Sinai ab angelis deferri iussisti concede quaesumus eius obtentu nos ad arcem virtutum provehi ubi visionis tuae claritatem mereamur intueri.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who commanded the body of Your glorious virgin Catherine to be borne up to Mount Sinai by angels, grant us, we beseech You, through her intercession, to ascend to the fortress of virtues where we may deserve to behold the brightness of Your vision.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui creasti omnia nutu tuo visibilia et invisibilia da nobis in hac festivitate beatae Osithae virginis et martyris tuae ab omnibus periculis inimico
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who created all things by your command visible and invisible, grant us in this festival of the blessed Ositha, your virgin and martyr, protection from all dangers by our enemy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui curam de omnibus in te confidentibus semper habes praesta quaesumus ut per oblationem quam tibi offerimus visitationem spiritualem in nostris necessitatibus sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who always have care for all who are confident in you, grant us we ask, that through the offering we present to you, we may feel a spiritual visitation in our needs.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui de plebe tua imperii fastigio famulum tuum illum dignatus es sublimare fac eum humilitatis iustitiae ceterarumque virtutum bono exuberare ut a tuae veritatis tramite non recedat et ad te qui vita es gratiosus perveniat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who from among your people did deem worthy to elevate your servant, may he overflow with the goodness of humility, justice, and all other virtues, so that he does not deviate from your truth's path and may reach you, who are gracious, through life.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui dedisti famulis tuis in confessione verae fidei aeternae Trinitatis gloriam agnoscere et in potentia maiestatis adorare unitatem quaesumus ut eiusdem fidei firmitate ab omnibus semper muniamur adversis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has given your servants to acknowledge the glory of true faith in the eternal Trinity and to adore the unity in the might of majesty, we humbly ask that we may always be fortified with the strength of the same faith against all adversities.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui dedisti ministris tuis obtinere omnia quae iuste precantur suscipe propitius preces nostras quas pro famulo tuo illo in honorem beati Sigismundi regis et martyris tui deferimus ut quod pro eo de totis mentibus obsecramus celeri indulgentia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who gave your ministers to obtain all that is justly prayed for, graciously receive our prayers which we present on behalf of your servant [that specific person] in honor of the blessed King and Martyr Sigismund. May we merit to swiftly obtain what we humbly ask with all our hearts.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui diabolicae simulationis detestaris insidias tribue quaesumus ut nec mentes nostras mortiferis possint vexare nequitiis nec per aliorum subdolas voluntates nocendi nobis sumere facultatem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who abhors the deceitful snares of the devil, we humbly ask that you do not allow our minds to be disturbed by deadly wickedness, nor enable others to take the power to harm us through their cunning schemes.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui donasti beatissimo regi Edwardo gloriam terrenae potestatis in divinum convertere amorem tribue nobis quaesumus ex eius imitatione pro amore tuo prospera mundi despicere et nulla eius adversa formidare.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who gave the most blessed king Edward glory of earthly power, grant us that we may convert our earthly love into divine. By his example, may we disdain the world for your love and fear no adversity from it.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui donasti beato Oswaldo regi gloriam terrenae potestatis in divinum convertere amorem da nobis quaesumus eius intercessione in tui nominis amore iugiter permanere.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who gave earthly power and glory to blessed King Oswald, grant us that his love may be turned towards the divine. Through his intercession, may we ever remain in your love.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Ecclesiae tuae beatum Hieronymum confessorem scripturae sanctae et verum interpretem et tractatorem catholicum tribuisti concede propitius ut eius semper erudita doctrinis stabili fide in veneratione tui nominis et agnitione proficiat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who granted the blessed Jerome, the confessor of your holy scripture and true interpreter and Catholic expositor, to your Church; grant propitiously that he may always progress in stable faith and veneration of your name and understanding of it.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam doctrinis variis ac virtutibus sanctissimi confessoris tui Dubricii atque pontificis ad augmentationem sacrae fidei gloriose sublimasti da nobis quaesumus eius precibus et exemplis in beneplacito tuo ita innocenter vivere ut post huius vitae miserias inter consortes sanctorum tuorum commorari mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who exalted your Church through the varied teachings and most holy confessor and bishop Dubricius, grant us we humbly ask, that through his prayers and examples, in your good pleasure, we may live so innocently, that after the miseries of this life, we may merit to dwell among your saints.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam in apostolica soliditate fundatam ab infernarum eruis terrore portarum praesta ut in tua veritate persistens nulla recipiat consortia perfidorum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who founded Your Church in the stability of the apostles and delivered it from the terror of hell's gates, grant that, persisting in Your truth, it may receive no fellowship with the faithless.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Ecclesiam tuam sanctorum tuorum meritis decorare non desinis concede propitius ut beati Laurentii confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius nos laetificasti miraculis precibus adiuvare digneris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who do not cease to adorn Your Church with the merits of Your saints, grant us graciously through the prayers of Your blessed confessor and pope, Saint Lawrence, whom You have delighted us with miracles, that we may be worthy of Your aid.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui eligis infirma mundi ut fortia quaeque confundas da nobis in festivitate sanctae martyris Caeciliae congrua devotione gaudere ut et  potentiam tuam in eius passione laudemus et provisum nobis percipiamus auxilium.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who chooses the weak of the world to confound the strong, grant us on the feast day of the holy martyr Caecilia, fitting devotion to rejoice, so that we may also praise your power in her passion and perceive the help prepared for us.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui infirma mundi eligis ut fortia quaeque confundas concede propitius ut qui beatae Agnetis martyris tuae sollemnia colimus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who chooses the weak of the world to confound the strong, graciously grant that we who celebrate the solemnity of your blessed martyr Agnes may feel her patronage with you.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui es auctor et artifex omnis creaturae respice propitius ad preces Ecclesiae tuae et da nobis contra hostem nostrum crudelissimum tuae defensionis auxilium qui circuit quaerens quem devoret; non sinas piissime pater in nobis illum sua vota complere et imaginem tuam in nobis obscurare; iam enim illi renuntiavimus et tibi domino promisimus; iam per gratiam et potentiam tuam abstracti sumus de faucibus eius; non nos iterum permittas laniari morsibus inimici quos pretioso Filii tui sanguine redemisti.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who are the author and artisan of all creation, look upon us graciously as we pray to your Church. Give us aid against our most cruel enemy, that one who roams seeking whom to devour; let it not be pleasing to you, most merciful Father, for him to fulfill his intentions in us, and let your image not be obscured within us. For indeed we have renounced him, and we have promised ourselves to you, Lord. Indeed, through your grace and your power, we have been drawn away from his jaws; do not allow us again to be torn by the bites of our enemies, whom your precious Son's blood has redeemed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui es auctor totius bonitatis regumque consecrator honorum omnium attributor dignitatumque largitor tuam ineffabilem clementiam votis omnibus exoramus ut famulum tuum imperatorem nostrum illum quem imperialis gloriae culmine voluisti sublimare sapientiae ceterarumque virtutum ornamentis facias decorari et quia tui muneris est quod imperat tuae sit pietatis quod feliciter agat quatenus de visibilibus hostibus triumphator effectus et transitorii regni gubernacula inculpabiliter teneat et ad aeterna et infinita gaudia te miserante perveniat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who art the author of all goodness and the consecrator of kings, the giver of all honor, attributor of all dignities, and bestower of ineffable clemency, we entreat your boundless mercy with our prayers that you may adorn your servant, our emperor, whom you have elevated with the heights of imperial glory through wisdom and other virtues. Since it is your gift for him to rule with piety, may he prosper as a victor over visible enemies, and may he unblemished hold the reins of transitory rule. And we pray that, by your mercy, he may attain eternal and infinite joy.
