text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui es misericordia inaestimabilis suscipe oblationes et preces nostras pro salute famulorum famularumque tuarum illorum et illarum; premimur Domine ut sicut pietas tua ipsos creavit ad aeternitatis gloriam ita eos iubeas ab omnibus sordibus mundari vitiorum et indulgentiam eis concedere peccatorum et ad perfectionem aeternae salutis perducere digneris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who is immeasurable mercy, receive our offerings and prayers for the salvation of your servants, both male and female; we entreat you, Lord, that just as your pity created them for eternal glory, so may you command them to be cleansed from all stains of sin, grant them forgiveness of sins, and deem them worthy to attain the perfection of eternal salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui es sanctorum tuorum splendor mirabilis quique hodierna die beatum Bonifatium martyrem tuum atque pontificem beatitudinis aeternae gloria sublimasti concede propitius ut cuius merita veneramur in terris intercessionis eius auxilio apud tuam misericordiam muniamur in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who are the wonderful brightness of your saints, and today exalted your martyr and bishop, blessed Boniface, to eternal beatitude's glory, grant us graciously, that we may be strengthened by his merits on earth with his intercession, and protected by your mercy in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui et iustis praemia meritorum et peccatoribus per ieiunium erroris sui veniam praebes miserere supplicibus parce peccantibus ut reatus nostri confessio indulgentiam valeat percipere delictorum. ( recension gelasienne ) Deus qui et iustis praemia meritorum et peccatoribus per ieiunium veniam praebes miserere supplicibus tuis ut reatus nostri confessio indulgentiam valeat percipere delictorum. ( recension gregorienne )
translation_en:
Everlasting almighty God, who grants rewards for the righteous for their merits and forgiveness for sinners through fasting, have mercy on the supplicants, be sparing to the penitent, so that the confession of our sins may gain indulgence and receive pardon for offenses. (Gelasian recension)
God who grants rewards for the righteous for their merits and forgiveness for sinners through fasting, have mercy on your supplicants, that the confession of our sins may gain indulgence and receive pardon for offenses. (Gregorian recension)

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui etiam in beati Ioannis generatione promenda confessionem sacratae tibi plebis instituis auge nobis fidei pietatisque constantiam ut magis magisque fateamur excellentiam nuntiati cum tanta sit gloria nuntiantis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who even in the generation of blessed John instituted a sacred confession to you of the people, increase in us constancy of faith and devotion, that we may more and more confess the excellence of him who proclaims such great glory.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui ex abundantia caritatis beatam Mariam tuo Filio impregnatam ad salutationem Elizabeth inspirasti praesta quaesumus ut per eius visitationem donis caelestibus repleamur et ab omnibus adversitatibus eruamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who conceived blessed Mary, full of your grace, to bring joy to Elizabeth, grant us, we pray, that through her visitation we may be filled with heavenly gifts and delivered from all adversities.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui facis mirabilia magna solus porrige famulae tuae spem gratiae salutaris ut in veritate tibi auctori perpetuo servire non desinat et rorem ei tuae benedictionis infunde ut quidquid a te pio pastore iuste postulaverit largiente benignissima misericordia tua consequi mereatur.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who makes great wonders alone, grant hope of salvation's grace to your servant, that she may not cease to serve you in truth perpetually. Pour out upon her the dew of your blessing, so that whatever she justly asks from you, the most benevolent pastor, may deserve to obtain through your abundant mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui facis mirabilia magna solus praetende super hos famulos tuos degentes in hac domo spiritum gratiae salutaris et ut complaceant tibi Deus in veritate tua perpetuum eis rorem tuae benedictionis infunde.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who works great wonders alone, extend over these your servants dwelling in this house the breath of salvation-bearing grace and that they may please you God in your truth, pour upon them forever the dew of your blessing.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui facis mirabilia magna solus praetende super famulos tuos spiritum gratiae salutaris et ut in veritate tibi complaceant perpetuum eis rorem tuae benedictionis infunde.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who performs great wonders alone, stretch over your servants the Spirit of your salutary grace and pour upon them the perpetual dew of your blessing, that they may always please you in truth.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui facis mirabilia magna solus praetende super famulum tuum illum abbatem vel super cunctam congregationem illi commissam spiritum gratiae salutaris et ut in veritate tibi complaceant perpetuum eis rorem tuae benedictionis infunde.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who works great wonders alone, stretch over your servant, that abbot, or over the entire congregation committed to him, the spirit of salvation's grace, and pour upon them a perpetual stream of your blessing, so that they may always find pleasure in truth before you.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui facturam tuam pio semper gubernas affectu inclina aurem tuam supplicationibus nostris et famulum tuum nimia tribulatione laborantem placito intuere obtutu.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who always governs with pious affection, incline your ear to our supplications and look upon your servant, laboring under excessive tribulation, with a favorable countenance.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui famulum tuum illum regni fastigio dignatus es sublimare tribue ei quaesumus ut ita in praesenti collecta multitudine cunctorum in commune salutem disponat quatenus a tuae veritatis tramite non recedat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who deemed fit to elevate your servant to the throne's height, grant him we beg, that he may dispose the great multitude gathered here for common welfare in such a way, that he does not deviate from Your truth's path.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui fragilitati nostrae consulens assidua nos sanctorum celebritate solaris da nobis sub patronis talibus constitutis et perpetua securitate muniri et salutari gaudere profectu.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who, considering our frailty, strengthen us continually with the festival of saints and, under such patrons as we have been established, protect us with perpetual security and enjoy salvation on our journey.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui gloriam tuam omnibus in Christo gentibus revelasti custodi opera misericordiae tuae ut Ecclesia tua toto orbe diffusa stabili fide in confessione tui nominis perseveret.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who have revealed your glory to all nations in Christ, keep the work of your mercy that our Church, spread throughout the whole world with steadfast faith and confession of your name, may persevere.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui gloriosos martyres tuos Hellarum Dacianum Felicem Largum et Dionysium pro immaculatae fidei constantia et agone martyrii coronasti da quaesumus propitius ac placatus ut omnes qui eorum passionis sollemnia cum amore colimus a cunctis mundi perturbationibus liberati caelestis vitae praemia consequamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who crowned your glorious martyrs Hellarum Dacianum Felicem Largum and Dionysium for their steadfastness in immaculate faith and the struggle of martyrdom, we humbly ask that you, being propitious and appeased, grant us so that all who celebrate their passion's feast with love may be freed from all worldly disturbances and attain the rewards of celestial life.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hanc diem honorabilem in beati confessoris tui Romani festivitate tribuisti fidelium tuorum vota serenus intende ut eius interventu a cunctis reatibus absoluti festis mereamur interesse caelestibus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this honorable day granted the festivity of your blessed confessor in Rome to your faithful, may you serenely attend so that through his intervention we may be freed from all sins and worthy to join the celestial festivities.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc diem venerabilem nobis beati confessoris tui Benedicti festivitate tribuisti fidelium tuorum vota serenus intende ut eius interventu a cunctis reatibus absoluti festis mereamur interesse caelestibus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has given us this venerable day in honor of your blessed confessor Benedict, listen serenely to the prayers of your faithful. May we, through his intervention, be freed from all sins, and worthy to enjoy the festivities among the celestial beings.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hanc sacratissimam noctem per universa mundi spatia gloria dominicae resurrectionis illustras conserva in nova familiae tuae progenie sanctificationis spiritum quem dedisti ut corpore et mente renovati puram tibi animam et purum pectus semper exhibeant.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who illuminate this most sacred night throughout all the space of the world with the glory of the Lord's resurrection, conserve in your new family the spirit of sanctification which you have given, that they may always present to you a pure soul and a clean heart renewed both corporally and mentally.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodierna die beatissimum Nicolaum confessorem tuum atque pontificem aetherea regna penetrare fecisti da quaesumus supplicibus tuis digne illius sollemnia celebrare ut per eius venerandam festivitatem salutem consequamur et pacem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who today permitted your blessed Nicholas, your confessor and pope, to penetrate the heavenly realms, we humbly ask that you worthy grant that his solemnities be celebrated. May we attain salvation through his venerable feast day and peace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodierna die membra sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cancii Canciani Cancianillae Chrysogoni Anastasiae et Prothi nobis famulis tuis revelare dignatus es concede propitius ut qui eorum corporum translationem venerando colimus ipsorum beatitudini te concedente adiungi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day revealed yourself to grant the limbs of your martyrs Cancius, Cancianus, Cancianilla, Chrysogonus, Anastasia, and Prothus, mercifully grant that we, your servants, who venerate their bodily translation, may merit through your indulgence to join their beatitude.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodierna luce carnis eductum ergastulo beatissimum confessorem tuum Benedictum sublevasti ad caelum concede quaesumus haec festa tuis famulis celebrantibus cunctorum veniam delictorum ut qui exsultantibus animis eius claritati congaudent ipso apud te interveniente consocientur et meritis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who raised Your most blessed confessor Benedict today from the prison of flesh to heaven, we humbly ask that You grant that these feast days may be celebrated by Your servants with forgiveness for all their sins. May those who rejoice in his brightness also join him in Your presence and be united with Him because of His merits.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodiernae diei sollemnia sacrosanctissimi pontificis tui Dunstani obitu festive exhilaras da quaesumus ut tanti patroni praesidiis foveamur in arvis de cuius societate caelestes cives exsultant in astris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who today celebrates the solemnities of your holy bishop Dunstan with joy on his death, we humbly ask that we may be supported by the protection of such a great patron in the fields. The heavenly citizens rejoice among the stars because of whose fellowship.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos hodierna sollemnitate sancti pontificis tui Wulsini festive exhilaras da quaesumus ut tanti patroni praesidiis foveamur in terris de cuius societate caelestes cives exsultant in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who today on the solemnity of your saint bishop Wulsin rejoice us, we humbly ask that we may be strengthened by the protections of such a great patron on earth, where the heavenly citizens rejoice in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hodiernam diem honorabilem nobis beati illius confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnitate tribuisti da quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae in hac celebritate laetitiam ut cuius festa pio amore veneramur in terris eius intercessione sublevemur in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has granted us on this day the honorable feast of your blessed confessor and pope, we humbly ask that you bestow upon your Church in this celebration joy. May we approach his festival with pious love on earth, and be uplifted by his intercession in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui huius diei iucundam sanctamque laetitiam in sancti servi tui Oswaldi sollemnitate consecrasti da cordibus nostris tui timoris caritatisque augmentum ut cuius in terris sancti sanguinis effusionem celebramus illius in caelo collata patrocinia mentibus sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day consecrated the pleasant and holy joy in the feast of your servant Oswald, increase within our hearts the fear and love that we celebrate on earth the shedding of the holy blood. May we feel his heavenly patronage in our minds.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui huius diei venerandam sanctamque laetitiam beati apostoli tui Ioannis evangelistae festivitate tribuisti da Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus et amare quod credidit et praedicare quod docuit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day has granted the venerable and holy joy of your apostle John the evangelist a feast, we humbly ask that you give to your Church. We pray that it may love what it believes and proclaim what it has learned.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui humanam naturam supra primae originis reparas dignitatem respice pietatis tuae ineffabile sacramentum et quos regenerationis mysterio innovare dignatus es in his dona tua perpetuae gratiae protectione conserva.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who restored the dignity of human nature above the first origin, look upon your ineffable sacrament of piety and those whom you have deemed worthy to renew through the mystery of regeneration. In them, grant the perpetual grace of your protection.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc diem beati Epartii confessoris tui atque presbyteri annua sollemnitate celebrari voluisti praesta quaesumus ut eius meritis et orationibus adiuvemur et proficiamus exemplis et dum nos supplicamus in terris ille pro nobis intercessor assistat in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who willed that this day of your blessed Epartius, the confessor and priest, be celebrated annually, we ask that you grant us through his merits and prayers that we may progress with examples. And while we are supplicating on earth, let him intercede for us in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc diem beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli martyrio consecrasti da Ecclesiae tuae toto terrarum orbe diffusae eorum semper moderamine gubernari per quos sumpsit religionis exordium.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day consecrated by the martyrdom of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, grant that Your Church, spread throughout the whole world, may always be governed by them through whom You took the origin of religion.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc diem honorabilem nobis in beati Ioannis Baptistae nativitate fecisti insignem quaesumus ut tuus praecursor qui inter natos mulierum omnibus maior surrexit nostram fragilitatem tuae pietati commendet et caris nostris quorum sunt nomina recitata ita refrigerium pietatis impetret ut ibi recipiantur vel ultimi ubi summus praeeminet in regno caelorum baptista.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who made this day honorable for us on the nativity of blessed John the Baptist, we humbly ask that you present your precursor, who rose above all women, to your piety. May he commend our frailty to your mercy and may he intercede for our dear ones whose names have been recited, so that they receive refreshment of piety there, or there where he will be the greatest in the kingdom of heaven, John the Baptist.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc diem in sancti Stephani levitae tui honorem dicasti da quaesumus ut qui tanti margariti lapidibus confracti pretiosa fragmenta veneramur inventa ipsius intercedentibus meritis aeternas poenas evadere mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who on this day conferred honor upon your deacon Saint Stephen, we humbly ask that those who venerate the precious fragments found from the broken pearl-like stones of him, may through his merits deserve to escape eternal punishments.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc diem incarnatione tua et partu beatae Mariae virginis consecrasti quique discordiam vetustam per transgressionem ligni veteris cum angelis et hominibus per incarnationis mysterium lapis angularis iunxisti da familiae tuae in hac celebritate laetitiam ut qui te consortem in carnis propinquitate laetantur ad summorum civium unitatem super quos corpus assumptum evexisti perducantur et inter semetipsos per aeterna complexa iungantur ut iurgii non pateat interruptio qui te auctorem gaudent in sua natura per carnis venisse contubernium.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who consecrated this day through your incarnation and the birth of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and who joined together the old discord through the mystery of the incarnation like a cornerstone with angels and men, grant to your family in this celebration joy. May those who rejoice in your companionship in the proximity of flesh be led to the unity of the highest citizens, over whom the body assumed by you has risen. May they be joined together among themselves for all eternity, so that no interruption occurs in their fellowship who take pleasure in you as their author through your coming in flesh.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc diem celeberrimum contulisti praesta quaesumus ut sicut hodierna die in imagine sua. Christi Filii tui passionem fideliter recolimus ita ab infestantis inimici iaculis tuo munimine tueamur.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who has bestowed upon us this most blessed day, we humbly ask that just as we faithfully remember the passion of Your Son today, so may we be protected by Your fortress from the attacks of our relentless enemies.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc diem per incarnationem verbi tui et per partum beatae virginis Mariae consecrasti da populis tuis in hac celebritate laetitiam ut qui tua gratia sunt redempti tua adoptione sint filii. ( recension gelasienne ) Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc diem per incarnationem verbi tui et partum beatae Mariae virginis consecrasti da populis tuis in hac celebritate consortium ut qui tua gratia sunt redempti tua sint protectione securi. ( recension gregorienne )
translation_en:
Almighty eternal God, who on this day consecrated it through the incarnation of your word and the birth of the blessed virgin Mary, grant joy to your people in this celebration so that those redeemed by your grace may be adopted as your children. (Gelasian recension)
Almighty eternal God, who on this day consecrated it through the incarnation of your word and the birth of the blessed Virgin Mary, grant them in this celebration companionship so that those redeemed by your grace may be secure under your protection. (Gregorian recension)

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hunc locum iudaicae superstitionis foeditate detersa in honorem beati illius Ecclesiae tuae dignatus es pulchritudine decorare praesta quaesumus ut illa fides hic fulgeat quae signo crucis erecto mortem subegit et salutem nobis contulit et triumphum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who have chosen to adorn this place, polluted by the superstition of the Jews, with the beauty of your church, we ask that you grant that faith shines here, which with the raised sign of the cross subdued death for us and bestowed salvation, and victory.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui ideo delinquentibus occasionem tribuis corrigendi ut non sit in eis quod puniat censura iudicii ob hoc te pie pater exposcimus ut hoc accipias pro sacrificio laudis quod famulus tuus ille atteritur virga correptionis; sana eum quaesumus Domine ab omnibus infirmitatibus quo te medicante et plenitudinem salutis recipiat et tuis semper sanus iussionibus pareat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in this way provide the opportunity for those who err to correct themselves so that there is no cause for punishment by the judgment of censure; we humbly beseech you, Father, on account of this sacrifice of praise which your servant there offers with the rod of correction; we ask, Lord, that he may be healed from all infirmities. May he receive healing through your care and attain the fullness of salvation. May he always obey your commandments in health.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui ideo delinquentibus occasionem tribuit corrigendi ut non sit in eis quod puniat censura iudicii. Ob hoc te per ipsum pie pater exposcimus ut hoc accipias pro sacrificio laudis quod famulus tuus ille atteritur virga correptionis.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who for the sake of sinners offers an opportunity to correct themselves so that there may be no reason for them to suffer punishment according to judgment. For this we humbly entreat You through Him as our loving Father that this be accepted by You as a sacrifice of praise which Your servant offers with the rod of correction.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in Filii tui Domini nostri nativitate tribuisti totius religionis initium perfectionemque constare da nobis quaesumus in eius portione censeri in quo totius salutis humanae summa consistit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in the nativity of your Son our Lord gave the beginning and perfection to all religion, grant us, we ask, that we may be counted worthy in his portion, in whom the summit of all human salvation lies.

text: Omnipotentem sempiternum dominum deprecemur ut qui in Domini nostri Iesu Christi circumcisione tribuit totius religionis initium perfectionemque constare det nobis in eius portione censeri in quo totius salutis humanae perfectio summa consistit et orationem quam nos Dominus noster edocuit cum fiducia dicere permittat: »Pater noster ...«
translation_en: We implore the almighty everlasting Lord that He, in the circumcision of our Lord Jesus Christ, who gave the beginning and perfection to our religion, grants us to be considered worthy in His portion, where the sum of the human salvation's perfection resides. And that He allows us to pray with confidence the prayer which our Lord taught us: "Our Father..."

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in hac festivitate anniversaria beatum Martinum apostolicum virum innumeris virtutibus declaratum summum pontificem et magnum patronum populo tuo ordinari voluisti concede propitius ut apud misericordiam paternae pietatis tuae meritis eius et intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in this annual feast day declare the blessed Martin, the apostolic man, as supreme pontiff and great patron for your people, graciously grant that we may be helped by Your mercy through his merits and intercessions.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui hanc diem festivitate annua beati Martini apostolici viri innumeris virtutibus declarati summi pontificis et magni patroni Ecclesiae tuae consecrari voluisti concede propitius ut apud misericordiam tuam meritis eius et intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who on this day have declared the blessed martyr Martin, apostle, to be adorned with countless virtues and have chosen to consecrate him as supreme pontiff and great patron of your Church, grant us your favor propitiously, so that we may be helped by his merits and intercessions within your mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in omni loco dominationis tuae totus assistis et totus operaris adesto supplicationibus nostris et huius domus cuius es fundator esto protector nulla h(u)ic nequitia contrariae potestatis obsistat sed virtute Spiritus Sancti operante fiat hic tibi semper purum servitium et devota libertas.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in every place of your dominion are wholly present and work, assist and attend to our supplications, and be the protector of this house which you have founded. Let no wickedness or opposing power stand against it here, but let the operation of the Holy Spirit make this place always a pure service and devoted freedom to you.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in omnium operum tuorum dispositione mirabilis es intellegant redempti tui non fuisse excellentius quod initio factus est mundus quam quod in fine saeculorum pascha nostrum immolatus est Christus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in the arrangement of all your works are wonderfully understood to be more excellent by those redeemed than that the world was made at the beginning, yet our Paschal Lamb was slain by Christ at the end of ages.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in omnium sanctorum tuorum es virtute mirabilis da nobis in beati Clementis annua sollemnitate laetari qui Filii tui martyr et pontifex quod ministerio gessit testimonio comprobavit et quod praedicavit ore confirmavit exemplo.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in the power of your saints are miraculous, give us joy in the annual feast of blessed Clement, your Son's martyr and pontiff. Through his ministry, he confirmed the testimony he gave, and through his example, he strengthened what he preached with his words.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in sanctis tuis semper es ubique mirabilis quaesumus clementiam tuam ut sicut illis eminentem gloriam contulisti sic ad consequendas misericordias tuas eorum nos facias precibus adiuvari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who are always wonderfully present in your saints, we humbly ask for your clemency so that, as you bestowed eminent glory upon them, you may also help us to attain your mercies through their prayers.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in sancti tui Quirici martyris semper es meritis ubique mirabilis quaesumus clementiam tuam ut sicut ei eminentem gloriam contulisti sic ad consequendam misericordiam tuam eius nos facias precibus adiuvari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in your saint Quiricus the martyr are always remarkable for your merits, we humbly ask for your clemency, so that just as you bestowed upon him eminent glory, you make us helped by his prayers to attain your mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in meritis sancti tui Cuthberti sacerdotis semper es et ubique mirabilis quaesumus clementiam tuam ut sicut ei eminentem gloriam contulisti sic ad consequendam misericordiam tuam eius nos facias precibus adiuvari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who are always and everywhere wonderful in the merits of your saint Cuthbert, the priest, we humbly ask for your clemency, that as you bestowed upon him eminent glory, so you may help us to attain your mercy through his prayers.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in sanctis praecipue laudaris et mirabiliter praedicaris tribue quaesumus nobis hodiernam diem in honorem sancti Sampsonis confessoris tui atque pontificis digne celebrare qua membris exutus corporis caelestibus meruit exsultare sacramentis.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who is especially praised and wonderfully proclaimed in the saints, grant us, we humbly ask, to worthily celebrate today the day in honor of your confessor and bishop Saint Sampson. May he, who was stripped of his earthly body, merit to rejoice in heavenly mysteries through sacred sacraments.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in sanctis tuis semper gloriosus exsistis maiestatis tuae potentiam supplices exoramus ut qui beatissimi confessoris tui Mauri annuam devota mente colimus festivitatem meritis ipsius apud misericordiam tuam protegamur et precibus adiuvemur ut cuius digna veneratione memoriam celebramus in terris cum eodem apud te semper gaudere mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who are always glorious in your saints, we humbly entreat you to exist with the power of your majesty, that we may devoutly celebrate the feast of your most blessed confessor, Maurice, through his merits, protected by your mercy and aided by our prayers. May we be worthy of venerating his memory on earth, so that we may always rejoice in heaven with him before you.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in sanctorum tuorum cordibus flammam tuae dilectionis accendis da mentibus nostris eandem fidei caritatisque virtutem ut quorum gaudemus triumphis proficiamus exemplis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in the hearts of your saints kindles the flame of your love, grant to our minds the same power of faith and charity, so that we may progress in examples from those whose triumphs we rejoice.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui in terrena substantia constitutos divina tractare concedis praesta deprecantibus sanctis tuis ut eadem consequamur conversatione caelesti.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who grants to treat those established in earthly substance with divine care, grant through your praying saints that we may follow the same celestial way of life.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui ineffabili sacramento ius apostolici principatus in romani nominis arce posuisti unde se evangelica veritas per tota mundi regna diffunderet praesta ut quod in orbem terrarum eorum praedicatione manavit christianae devotionis sequatur universitas.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who established the ineffable sacrament of the apostolic principality within the fortress of the Roman name from which the evangelical truth spread throughout all the kingdoms of the world, grant that what has flourished among them through their preaching may be followed by the entirety of the Christian devotion.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui instituta legalia et sanctorum praeconia prophetarum in diebus beati famuli tui Ioannis implesti praesta ut cessantibus significationum figuris ipsa sui manifestatione veritas eloquatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who filled the legal institutions and the preaching of saints by prophets in the days of your blessed servant John, grant that with ceasing figurative signs, truth itself may speak out.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui instituta legalia et sanctorum praeconia prophetarum in diebus beati baptistae Ioannis implesti praesta quaesumus ut cessantibus significationum figuris ipsa sui manifestatione veritas eloquatur Iesus Christus Dominus noster.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who filled the legal institutions and proclamations of saints through the prophets on the days of blessed John the Baptist, we humbly ask that, as the signs cease, the very truth may speak itself, Jesus Christ our Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui inter innumera beneficia sanctorum tuorum nos sollemnitatibus praecipue consolaris praesta quaesumus ut ad caelestis operis instituta et recordatio beata nos incitet et oratio iustorum digna perducat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who chiefly console us through the innumerable blessings of your saints, grant us, we pray, that the institutions and remembrance of heavenly works may stir us up, and that our prayer may be worthy and lead us to the recordation of the blessed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui iusta dispensatione tuae pietatis notitiam caelestium haberi voluisti in terris praesta quaesumus ut qui beati Raphaelis angeli sollemnia celebramus eius venerandis precibus salutem mentis et corporis consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who willed through Your just dispensation of mercy to have knowledge of the heavens made known on earth, we humbly ask that we may merit the health of mind and body as we celebrate the solemnities of blessed Archangel Raphael with his reverent prayers.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui legalium differentias hostiarum in unius huius sacrificii perfectione sanxisti respice propitius de throno gloriae tuae et super hoc altare benedictionis tuae munus effunde ut in eo sic temporales hostiae consecrentur ut perpetuae vitae sumentibus procurent substantiam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who sanctified the differences of offerings in the perfection of this one sacrifice, look upon us graciously from your throne of glory. Pour out your blessing on this altar of benediction, so that temporal sacrifices are consecrated within it, that they may provide substance for those who are taking part in eternal life.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui lumen summae Trinitatis beatae Barbarae virgini et martyri tuae inspirasti innumera quoque tormentorum genera vincere fecisti praesta nobis ipsius meritis intercedentibus ipsum lumen sic agnoscere ut post aerumnosas fluctuationes huius sacculi ipsum in caelestibus intueri valeamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who infused the light of the supreme Trinity, blessed Barbarah, virgin and martyr, with countless kinds of torments to overcome, grant us through her merits to recognize that same light, so that after the distressing fluctuations of this age, we may be able to behold her in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui maternum affectum nec in ipsa sacra semper virgine Maria qui redemptorem nostrum genuit denegasti concede propitius ut eiusdem Dei Genitricis precibus famula tua illa esse genitrix mereatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who denied that the maternal affection was not present even in the most sacred Virgin Mary, who gave birth to our Redeemer, graciously grant that your servant may deserve to be called the Mother of the same God through the prayers of his Mother.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui me peccatorem sacris altaribus adstare voluisti et sancti nominis tui laudare potentiam concede quaesumus per huius sacramenti mysterium meorum mihi veniam peccatorum ut tuae maiestati digne ministrare merear.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who willed that I, a sinner, should stand before Your sacred altars and be able to praise the power of Your holy name. We ask that You grant this through the mystery of this sacrament, so that I may receive forgiveness for my sins, and thus deserve to serve Your majesty worthily.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui mirabili tua potentia sanctis virginibus tuis tribuisti cum virtute castitatis hostem devincere fortem quaesumus clementiam tuam ut ipsis intercedentibus societatem sanctorum tuorum nobis donare digneris in caelestibus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who with your marvelous power granted victory over the strong enemy to your holy virgins through chastity, we humbly ask for your clemency that you may deign to grant us fellowship with your saints in heaven through their intercession.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui mirabiliter fulges in electis tuis quos te habitatore glorificare voluisti da nobis quaesumus beati Bertini confessoris tui atque abbatis ita digne sollemnia venerari ut eius suffragantibus meritis templum tuum mereamur fieri.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who miraculously shines upon your elect whom you have chosen to glorify as dwellers and whom we humbly ask that we may worthily venerate on the solemnity of your blessed confessor and abbot, BERTINUS. May it be granted through his merits that your temple may be worthy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui misericordiae tuae ianuam fidelibus patere voluisti per concordiam unitatis da nobis famulis tuis fidei spei et caritatis augmentum ut per vinculum pacis promissionum tuarum mereamur esse partici
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who have willed that the door of Your mercy be opened to the faithful through the bond of unity, grant to Your servants an increase in faith and charity hope. May we merit to be partakers of Your peace through the fulfillment of Your promises.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui misisti Filium tuum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum de sinu tuo in uterum Mariae virginis ut homo fieret et homo factus est passus et sepultus et misisti sanctos angelos tuos non ut custodirent sed ut testimonium perhiberent verae resurrectionis te deprecamur piissime Deus per illorum trium regum orientalium interventum ut digneris angelos tuos mittere ut sint circa famulos tuos die ac nocte ut sint securi in corpore et anima ac rebus omnibus in Christo Iesu domino nostro.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who sent your Son our Lord Jesus Christ from your side into the womb of the Virgin Mary, so that he might become man and man suffered, was buried, and you sent your holy angels not to guard but to bear witness to the true resurrection. We humbly entreat you, most merciful God, through the intervention of the three kings from the East, that you deign to send your angels to be around your servants day and night, to be secure in body, soul, and possessions in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nasciturum ex utero virginali Iesum Christum Filium tuum agnosci ab omnibus sancto archangelo nuntiante voluisti da ut cuius nativitatem accepimus eius praesentia gaudeamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who have willed to be acknowledged by all the holy archangels announcing the birth of Jesus Christ Your Son from the virginal womb, we receive his nativity and rejoice in His presence.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Ninivitis in satisfactione trium dierum pepercisti et tres pueros de fornace ignis ardentis illaesos eripuisti necnon etiam Danielem de lacu leonum liberasti custodi nos et salva in tua ineffabili pietate de instanti barbarica dira rabie quatenus inde liberati in gratiarum merita actione atque in debita tibi servitudine iugi devotione valeamus perseverare.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who spared Nineveh in the satisfaction of three days and rescued the three boys from the fiery furnace unharmed, and also Daniel from the den of lions, protect us and save us in your ineffable mercy, so that we may persevere in gratitude for our deliverance, and in due service to you, with devoted obedience, through the instant of barbarous and dire wrath.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nobis beati martyris tui illius sollemnia celebrare concedis praesta quaesumus ut qui eius gaudemus natalitiis instruamur exemplis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who grants us to celebrate the solemnities of your blessed martyr, grant us, we pray, that we who rejoice in his nativity may be instructed by his examples.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nobis in observatione ieiunii et eleemosynarum semine posuisti nostrorum remedia peccatorum concede nos opere mentis et corporis semper tibi esse devotos.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in the observance of fasting and almsgiving has sown for us the seeds of remedy for our sins, grant us always to be devoted to you in mind and body.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui non sacrificiorum ambitione placaris sed studio piae devotionis intendis da familiae tuae spiritum rectum et habere cor mundum ut fides eorum haec dona tibi conciliet humilitas oblata commendet.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who is not appeased by the ambition of sacrifices but by a pious intention, grant to your family a right spirit and a pure heart, so that their faith may offer these gifts to you, humility may recommend them.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui non tam munerum quam devotae mentis oblatione placaris exaudi propitius orationem nostram et haec populi tui dona sicut Abrahae manibus oblata Melchisedech tuus sacerdos accepit ita nunc suscipiendo divinitus rata esse digneris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who is pleased not so much by offerings as by the oblation of a devoted mind, graciously hear our prayer and grant these gifts to your people, just as Abraham's offerings, presented by Melchizedek your priest, were accepted. So now, deeming them worthy through divine acceptance.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos ab hostibus defendis immeritos praesta quaesumus ut et morum nobis adsit et fidei rectitudo qua pietatis tuae mereamur augmenta.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who defends us undeserving ones from enemies, we humbly ask that you also be present with our behavior and that the correctness of our faith may merit us an increase in your grace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos ad aeternam vitam confessione tui nominis et sacramento baptismatis clementer invitas votis nostris quaesumus praesentiam tuae virtutis intersere et offerentium munera dignanter intende ut et his sanctificationis gratiam et defunctis tribuas requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who invites us to eternal life through your confession of name and the sacrament of baptism with clement mercy in response to our prayers, we humbly ask that your presence interfere and graciously consider the offerings of those present. May you also grant them the grace of sanctification and everlasting rest to the departed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos ad aeternam vitam in confessionem tui nominis baptismatis reparas sacramento suscipe tuorum munera et vota famulorum ut in te sperantium et desideria iubeas perfici et peccata deleri.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who restores us to eternal life through the confession of your name in baptism by the sacrament, receive the gifts and vows of your servants. Grant that those who hope in you may fulfill their desires, and let sins be erased.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos ad observantiae huius annua festa perducis concede propitius ut piae devotionis affectus substantiam nobis et mentium praestet et corporum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who leads us to the annual festivals of observance, grant us graciously that the feelings of pious devotion may be given substance to us and our minds, and our bodies as well.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos beati illius confessoris tui atque pontificis hodierna festivitate laetificas tuam supplices exoramus clementiam ut cuius sollemnia devotis officiis veneramur eius piis suffragiis aeternae vitae remedia consequamur.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who today delights us on the feast day of your blessed confessor and pope, we humbly ask for your clemency. Grant that as we venerate him with devout services, we may obtain his earnest intercession for eternal life's remedies.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos donis tuis praevenis dignanter immeritos da ut tibi gratias referentes efficiamur et meriti.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who bestows upon us undeserving ones with grace, make us worthy and grant us the ability to give thanks to you, as we are aware of our unworthiness.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos eorum multiplici facis celebritate gaudere quorum nostrae fragilitati patrocinia contulisti da quaesumus ut illorum saepius iterata sollemnitas nostrae sit tuitionis augmentum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who makes us rejoice in the numerous festivities of those to whom you have granted your patronage, we humbly ask that their frequent repeated celebrations may be an increase in our protection.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli multiplici facis celebritate gaudere da quaesumus ut eorum saepius iterata sollemnitas nostrae sit tuitionis augmentum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who makes us rejoice with great festivity through the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, we humbly ask that their frequent repeated solemnity may be an increase in our protection.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos et castigando sanas et ignoscendo conservari praesta supplicibus tuis ut et tranquillitatis optatae consolatione laetemur et ad correctionis effectum dono tuae pacis utamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who heals us by chastening and preserves us by forgiving, grant your suppliant ones that we may rejoice in the consolation of our desired tranquility and use the gift of your peace for the purpose of correction.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos castigando sanas et ignoscendo conservas praesta quaesumus supplicibus tuis ut sanitatis optatae consolatione fruamur et ad correptionis effectum tuam mereamur consequi medicinam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who heals us while chastising and conserves us through forgiveness, grant, we humbly ask, that we may enjoy the consolation of the health desired and merit to achieve the effect of your remedy through correction.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos et castigando sanas et ignoscendo conservas praesta supplicibus tuis ut et tranquillitatis nobis optatae consolatione laetemur et dono tuae pietatis semper utamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who heals us by chastising and conserves us by forgiving, grant your petitioners that we may rejoice with the promised tranquility's consolation and always make use of your divine mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos et sustentationibus annuis et sollemnitatibus consolaris praesta quaesumus ut quod ex his pro nostrae conversationis qualitate subtrahitur omnipotentiae tuae copia suppleatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who sustains us with annual provisions and comforts us with solemnities, we humbly ask that whatever is taken away from our quality of life due to these, may be supplemented by the abundance of your power.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos humilitatis formam exemplis unigeniti tui docuisti ut quod ille ieiuniorum continuatione complevit nos per dierum partes et intervalla virium imitemur da quaesumus nostrae fragilitati firmitatem da infirmis conatibus effectum ut exclusis cogitationum carnalium suadelis placabile tibi contriti cordis holocaustum in odorem suavitatis valeamus offerre.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who taught us the form of humility through the examples of your only-begotten Son, that we might imitate him in his continuance of fasting throughout the days and intervals of strength. Grant us, we ask, firmness for our frailty; grant effect to our weak efforts, so that expelled are the carnal delights of our thoughts, and a pleasing sacrifice of contrite hearts may be offered up to you as a sweet-smelling offering.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos idoneos non esse perpendis ad maiestatem tuam sicut dignum est exorandam da sanctos martyres tuos pro nostris supplicare peccatis quos digne possis audire.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who deems us unworthy to approach your majesty as it is fitting for us to pray, grant us the help of your holy martyrs that they may intercede on our behalf for our sins, which you alone can truly hear.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos idoneos non esse perpendis ad maiestatem tuam sicut dignum est exorandam fac sanctas virgines tuas illam et illam pro nostris intervenire peccatis quarum meritis nobis indulgentiam largiaris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who deems us unworthy to approach your majesty as it is fitting to be supplicated, make holy your virgins for us, so that they may intercede on our behalf. Grant us indulgence through their merits.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos multiplici sanctorum tuorum festivitate laetificas praesta ut quorum commemoratione gaudemus praesidio muniamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who delights us with the numerous feasts of your saints, grant that we may be fortified by their protection as we rejoice in their remembrance.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos omni tempore tuis deditos vis esse mandatis concede propitius ut adventui domini possimus esse devoti quibus illud est mysterium celebrandum cui servit omnis excusatio mandatorum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who desires us to be devoted to your commandments at all times, grant us your mercy that we may be able to be devout at the coming of the Lord. For it is a mystery to be celebrated for whom all excuse of commandments serves.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos omnium apostolorum merita sub una tribuisti celebritate venerari quaesumus ut celerem nobis tuae propitiationis abundantiam multiplicatis intercessoribus largiaris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who have bestowed upon us all the merits of the apostles to be venerated together under one celebration, we humbly entreat you to grant us a swift abundance of your propitiation, multiplied by the intercession of many intercessors.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos omnium sanctorum merita sub una tribuisti celebritate venerari quaesumus ut desideratam nobis tuae propitiationis abundantiam multiplicatis intercessionibus largiaris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who have granted us the merits of all saints to be honored under one celebration, we humbly ask that you grant us the abundance of your propitiation, multiplied by our many intercessions.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos omnium sanctorum tuorum multiplici facis sollemnitate gaudere concede quaesumus ut sicut illorum commemoratione temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur adspectu.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who makes us all of your saints rejoice with a multitude of temporal solemnities, we humbly ask that just as we are pleased by their commemoration in time, so too may we be eternally joyful upon beholding them.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos pia devotione sanctorum pastorum in hoc sacratissimum ovile congregasti concede quaesumus eorum nos perpetua protectione ab omni adversitate defendi atque cum eis in aeternae vitae beatitudine gaudere.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has gathered us with pious devotion into this most sacred flock by the shepherds of saints, we humbly ask that you protect us perpetually from every adversity and let us rejoice with them in the beatitude of eternal life.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos pia devotione spiritalium pastorum in hoc sacratissimum fidei ovile congregasti da quaesumus ut eum eisdem pastoribus vitae aeternae
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has gathered us with pious devotion into this most sacred fold of faith, we humbly ask that you grant these spiritual shepherds eternal life.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos pia devotione beati Birini confessoris tui atque pastoris nostri in hoc sacratissimum ovile congregasti concede quaesumus ut cum eodem pastore nostro ad caelestis vitae gaudia pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who gathered us with pious devotion to the blessed Birinus, your confessor and our shepherd, in this most sacred flock, grant us we beseech you, that we may merit to reach the joys of eternal life with our same shepherd.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos sacramentorum tuorum participatione salubriter recreas suscipe propitius preces nostras pro famulo tuo illo febricitante et concede propitius per intercessionem sancti martyris tui Sigismundi regis ut quae devota mente petimus celeriter consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who refreshes us healthily through our participation in your sacraments, graciously receive our prayers for your servant who is sick. Grant us mercifully through the intercession of your saintly martyr King Sigismund that we may deserve to quickly obtain what we have devoutly asked.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nos sacris festivitatibus huius diei interesse concedis praesta quaesumus ut intercedente beato Gregorio martyre tuo supernae sollemnitatis gaudia tenere valeamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who graciously grants us to participate in the sacred festivities of this day, we humbly ask that through the intercession of blessed Gregory the martyr, we may be able to partake in the joyous celebrations of your lofty solemnity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui nulli nos inferre mandasti quod nobis non optamus inferri praesta quaesumus ut nec fingamus aliis nec aliorum fictionibus illudamur.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who has commanded us that no harm be inflicted upon us which we do not desire to suffer, grant us, we beseech you, so that neither may we deceive others nor be ensnared by their fictions.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui offerenda tuo nomini tribuis et oblata devotioni nostrae servitutis adscribis quaesumus clementiam tuam ut quod praestas unde sit meritum proficere nobis largiaris ad praemium.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who grants offerings to Your name and assigns our devotion to the service of oblations, we humbly ask for Your clemency to grant us that which is merited, so that You may lavish it upon us as a reward.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui omnia nutu creasti visibilia et invisibilia da nobis in hac festivitate beati Ethelberti regis et martyris tui ab omnibus periculis inimicorum defendi.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who by your nod created all visible and invisible things, protect us in this feast of the blessed Ethelbert, your king and martyr, from all dangers by our enemies.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui omnia occulta praenoscis exaudi orationem nostram et fac furem reverti cum re quam fraudavit ut manifestetur nobis sicut manifestasti furtum Achan in Iericho fiatque illi contrarium verbum Dei et compulsus redeat nobisque ostendat et sicut te nihil latere potest ita Domine nobis hanc rem manifesta.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who discerns all hidden things, hear our prayer and make the thief return with the thing he stole, that he may be revealed to us as you revealed the theft of Achan in Jericho. Let the word of God be fulfilled against him and let him be compelled to return and show himself to us. As nothing can remain hidden from you, Lord, so may this matter be manifested to us.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui paschale sacramentum in reconciliationis humanae foedere contulisti da mentibus nostris ut quod professione celebramus imitemur effectu.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who bestowed the Paschal sacrament within the covenant of reconciliation, grant to our minds that what we celebrate with profession, we may imitate in deed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui paschale sacramentum quinquaginta dierum voluisti mysterio contineri praesta ut gentium facta dispersio divisione linguarum ad unam confessionem tui nominis caelesti munere congregetur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who willed that the Paschal sacrament be contained in mystery for fifty days, grant that what was once dispersed among the nations through division of languages may, by your heavenly gift, be gathered together into one confession of your name.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui paschalis sollemnitatis arcanum hodierni mysterii plenitudine perfecisti da quaesumus ut filii tuae adoptionis effecti quam Dominus noster Iesus Christus ad te veniens dereliquit mereamur et pacem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who completed the mystery of today's Paschal solemnity with its fullness, we humbly ask that, as our Lord Jesus Christ coming to you left us worthy to be your children, we may merit peace.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per adventum unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi nova luce radiare dignatus es concede nobis ut sicut eum per virginis partum in forma nostri corporis meruimus habere participem ita et in regno gratiae eius mereamur esse consortes.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who deigned to shine upon us with the new light of the advent of your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, grant that we may merit to have him, as we received him through the birth of a virgin in our bodily form, so also to be his partners in his graceful kingdom.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per beatae Mariae virginis fecunditatem et partum salutem generis humani fieri voluisti da nobis ita conceptionis eius hodierna die digne celebrare mysterium ut ad incarnati filii quem ipsa concepit et peperit mereamur pertinere consortium.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who willed through the fertility and birth of the blessed Virgin Mary that salvation should come to the human race, grant us worthily today to celebrate the mystery of her conception, so that we may deserve to belong to the consortium of the incarnate Son whom she conceived and bore.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per beatam Perpetuam Africanum eius coniugem cum filio Nazario ad lucem fidei tuae gratiae dono convertisti praesta quaesumus ut relictis vitiorum tenebris ad te qui es lumen indeficiens convertamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through Blessed Perpetua Africana and her husband, the son Nazarius, by your grace were converted to the light of faith, grant us, we beseech you, that leaving behind the shadows of our sins, we may turn towards you, who are the unfailing light.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per continentiam salutarem et corporibus mederis et mentibus maiestatem tuam suppliciter exoramus ut pia ieiunantium deprecatione placatus et praesentia nobis subsidia praebeas et aeterna.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who heal bodies and minds through continence and salutary control, we humbly beseech You to be pleased with the pious supplications of those who fast, and to grant us Your presence as support, now and forevermore.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per Gabrielem archangelum regnis peccati deiectis Christi unigeniti Filii tui regnum cum iustitia sempiterna adduci prophetam docuisti Danielem ut consummetur praevaricatio finem accipiat peccatum et iniquitas deleatur concede nobis interventu beatae Mariae matris Christi et sui divi nuntii Gabrielis archangeli ab omni praevaricatione et peccato mundari quatenus deleta omni iniquitate eiusdem unigeniti Filii tui et regni esse participes et coheredes effici mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through the archangel Gabriel taught Daniel to bring Christ's kingdom with eternal justice, so that the prophecy would be fulfilled, sin would reach its end, and iniquity be eradicated. Grant us the intervention of the blessed Virgin Mary, mother of Christ, and of your divine messenger Gabriel the archangel, from every sin and corruption of the world. So that being freed from all iniquity, we may become participants and heirs of the same unigenitive Son of Yours and His kingdom. May we deserve it.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per gloriosa beati Benedicti abbatis exempla humilitatis triumphale nobis ostendisti iter da quaesumus ut viam tibi placitae oboedientiae qua venerabilis pater Benedictus illaesus antecedebat nos praeclaris eius meritis adiuti sine errore subsequamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through the glorious examples of the humility of blessed Abbot Benedict have shown us the triumphant path, we humbly ask that you grant us to follow that way which venerable Father Benedict unshaken led before us, with his great merits assisting us, without error we may follow.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per gloriosa bella certaminis ad immortales triumphos martyres extulisti da cordibus nostris dignam pro eorum commemoratione laetitiam ut quorum hic corpora pio amore amplectimur eorum precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through glorious wars raised the martyrs to eternal triumphs, grant our hearts a worthy joy for their commemoration, so that we may embrace them with pious love here and be helped by their prayers.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per os beati pontificis tui Gregorii eloquiorum tuorum addita revelasti concede nobis aurern pectoris eius accommodare doctrinis ut ad illam eius interventu pervenire mereamur patriam ad quam ipse totis desideriis anhelabat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through the mouth of your blessed pontiff Gregory revealed teachings through your eloquence, grant us to adapt our hearts to his doctrine so that we may deserve to reach the homeland to which he himself longed with all his desires.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per passionem unigeniti tui humanum genus redimere dignatus es et illius sepultura omnium fidelium sepulcra signasti concede propitius ut ad gloriam resurrectionis eiusdem perungere mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who deigned to redeem the human race through the passion of your only-begotten Son, and whose burial marked the graves of all faithful people, grant us graciously that we may deserve to attain the glory of his resurrection.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per unigenitum tuum aeternitatis nobis aditum devicta morte reserasti erige ad te corda credentium ut omnes in Christo renati ex aqua et spiritu sancto regnum caelorum ingredi mereantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through your only-begotten Son have opened for us the gate of eternal life and vanquished death, raise the hearts of believers to you that all who are reborn in Christ may enter the kingdom of heaven with water and the Holy Spirit.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui piissimi confessoris tui Ivonis membra beata demonstrasti populis Anglorum concede familiae tuae ipso intercedente ad gaudium pertingere
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through your most merciful confessionist John showed the blessed members to the English people, grant that your family may reach joy with you intervening.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui populo tuo beatum Wolfgangum confessorem tuum atque pontificem ad aeternae salutis ministerium constituisti praesta quaesumus ut quem doctorem vitae habuimus in terris intercessorem apud te semper habere mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who established your servant and bishop, the blessed Wolfgang, as a minister of eternal salvation for your people, grant us we beseech you, that we who had him as a teacher of life on earth may always have him as an intercessor before you in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui populum tuum quondam Iordane transiecto terram fecisti promissionis intrare praesta quaesumus ut significationis antiquae et veritatis patefactis mysteriis per sacramenta baptismatis adoptionis tuae filii regno caelesti mereantur adscribi.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who once led your people across the Jordan to make them enter into the land of promise, we humbly ask that you may grant that, as the ancient meanings and truths of the mysteries are revealed through the sacraments of baptism and adoption, they may be worthy of being assigned to the kingdom of heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui populum tuum unigeniti tui sanguine redemisti solve opera diaboli rumpe vincula peccati ut qui aeternam vitam in confessione tui nominis sunt adepti nihil debeant mortis auctori.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who redeemed your people with the blood of your only-begotten Son, free them from the works of the devil, break the chains of sin, so that those who have obtained eternal life through confession of your name owe nothing to the author of death.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui primitias martyrum gloriosi levitae Stephani sanguine dedicasti da nobis diem natalis eius honore praecipuo celebrare quia non diffidimus eum fidelibus tuis specialiter suffragari qui dominicae caritatis imitator etiam pro persecutoribus supplicavit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who dedicated the firstfruits of the glorious martyr Levite Stephen with his blood, grant us to celebrate his birthday with a special honor, for we have no doubt that he will intercede especially for your faithful. He was an imitator of Sunday's love, and even on behalf of the persecutors, he prayed.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui primitias martyrum in sancti levitae Stephani sanguine dedicasti tribue quaesumus ut pro nobis intercessor exsistat qui pro suis etiam persecutoribus supplicavit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who dedicated the firstfruits of martyrs in the blood of Saint Stephen, we humbly ask that you grant us a intercessor who, like him, prayed even for his persecutors. Amen.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui prudentium lampadibus oleo bonae conscientiae ornatis lumen tuae claritatis infundis concede propitius ut beatae Brigidae virginis tuae cuius natalicia colimus a fatuarum consortio eius intercessionibus liberemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who adorns the lamps of the wise with oil of good conscience, grant us Your grace generously, that we may be freed from the fellowship of wickedness through the intercessions of Your blessed Virgin Brigid, whose feast day we celebrate.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui quanto nos infirmiores esse praevidisti tanto sanctorum martyrum copiosiori munivisti suffragio da ut sub his defensoribus constituti nec adigamur vitiis nec deficiamus adversis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who in your foresight have provided for us as we grow weaker a more abundant support of the prayers of the holy martyrs, grant that under their protection we may not be tempted by vices nor fail in adversity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui rectam et dignam vitam agere praecepisti sicque postulata impetrare posse dixisti et pro tuo nomine totius mundi oblectamenta postponere <docuisti concede> ut te solum diligere et caelestia regna te miserante valeamus intrare.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who commanded to live a righteous and worthy life and said that we can obtain what is asked for in your name, and postponed the delights of the whole world, teach us to love only you, so that by your mercy we may enter the celestial kingdoms.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui respicis terram et facis eam tremere parce metuentibus propitiare supplicibus ut cuius iram terrae fundamenta concutientem expavimus clementiam contritiones eius sanantem iugiter sentiamus.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who looks upon the earth and makes it tremble with mercy for those who fear you, be propitious to the supplicants that we may always feel your clemency healing our contrition as we tremble before him whose wrath makes the foundations of the earth shake.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui resurgens a mortuis passione cassata potentiorem te tuis discipulis reddidisti concede propitius ut nos quoque maiestati tuae hoc paschale sacrificium in bonis operibus efficiat promptiores et gratiam tuae pietatis acquirat.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who, having overcome death by casting off Your passion, made Yourself more powerful for Your disciples when You rose from the dead; grant us graciously that this Paschal sacrifice may make us more ready in good works and gain us the grace of Your mercifulness.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui resurgens a mortuis passione cassata potentiorem te tuis discipulis reddidisti concede propitius ut nos quoque maiestatis tuae mysteria celebrantes praesentiae divinae beneficia consequamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who made yourself more powerful by rising again from the dead, having overcome your passion, mercifully grant that we too, while celebrating the mysteries of your majesty, may obtain the blessings of your divine presence.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sacra beati protomartyris tui Stephani membra fidelibus tuis hodierna die revelare voluisti concede intercessionis eius auxilio nos ab instantibus tribulationibus liberari et futuris consolationibus sociari.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who revealed the holy limbs of your first martyr Stephen to your faithful ones today, grant us the help of his intercession to be freed from immediate tribulations and to share in future consolations.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui salvas omnes et neminem vis perire aperi fontem benignitatis tuae et terram aridam aquis fluenti caelestis dignanter infunde.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who saves all and desires none to perish, open the fountain of your goodness and with befitting dignity pour out the flowing waters of heaven upon the arid land.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sanctis tuis non solum credere in Filium tuum sed etiam pro eodem pati posse donasti nostrae quoque fragilitati divinum praetende subsidium ut misericordiam sempiternam pro qua illi felices animas exhalarunt nos saltem sincera confessione mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has granted to Your saints not only to believe in Your Son but also to suffer for Him, grant us too a divine support for our fragility, so that we may at least deserve eternal mercy through sincere confession, which those blessed souls have exhaled.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus sancto Leodegario sacerdote et martyre tuo intercedente cuius hodie natalitium celebramus nostrae quoque fragilitati divinum praetende subsidium ut misericordiam sempiternam pro qua ille felix animam exhalavit nos saltem sincera professione mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, we celebrate today the natalitium of your saintly priest and martyr Leodegar. Through his intercession, extend divine support to our fragile selves, so that at least through sincere profession, we may deserve eternal mercy for which he was blessed with exhalation of soul.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sancto Cyrico et matri eius Iulittae una cum sociis in passione largitus es ut omnia tormentorum genera viriliter superarent et pro persecutoribus supplicarent pietatem tuam suppliciter deprecamur ut dum illorum gloriosam passionem recolimus pacis securitatem et peccatorum veniam consequamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who granted strength to Saint Cyrus and his mother Julittae, together with their companions, in suffering, so that they bravely endured all kinds of torments and prayed for mercy on behalf of their persecutors. We humbly beseech your mercy, as we recall their glorious passion, that while seeking the security of peace, we may obtain forgiveness for our sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sancto Gregorio summi pontificatus officium contulisti concede propitius ut illius suffragio a delictorum nostrorum nexibus absolvamur et gratiam tuae opitulationis adipisci mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who entrusted the office of the supreme pontificate to Saint Gregory, graciously grant that through his intercession we may be freed from the bonds of our sins and merit your grace by our application.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sanctorum martyrum confessionibus Ecclesiae tuae sacrum corpus exornas da nobis quaesumus ut et doctrinis eorum tibi placentia et pio sequamur auxilio.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who adorns the holy Church with the confessions of the martyrs, grant us we beseech You, that both by their teachings pleasing to You and following with pious aid we may walk.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sanctorum tuorum nos intercessione custodis praesta ut quorum fovemur meritis proficiamus piae confessionis exemplis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through the intercession of your saints keep us safe, grant that we may progress by their merits through the examples of faithful confession.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sanctorum virtute multiplici Ecclesiae tuae sacrum corpus exornans primitias martyrum gloriosi levitae Stephani sanguine dedicasti da nobis diem natalis eius honore praecipuo celebrare quia non diffidimus eum fidelibus tuis specialiter suffragari qui dominicae caritatis imitator etiam pro persecutoribus supplicavit.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who adorned Your Church with the multiplied virtue of the saints and dedicated its holy body to the glorious martyr Stephen, grant us to celebrate his natal day with a special honor, for we have no doubt that he will intercede particularly for Your faithful. He, imitator of the Lord's Sunday love, even prayed for his persecutors.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sanctum Blasium martyrem tuum atque pontificem iri agone certaminis tuo amore roborasti adsis Ecclesiae tuae precibus et da ut cuius triumphum recolimus in terris eius precibus adiuvemur in caelis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who strengthened your martyr and bishop Saint Blasius in the contest of your love during the ira, be present to our church with your prayers and grant that we who commemorate his triumph on earth may be aided by his prayers in heaven.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui secundum magnam misericordiam tuam peccata paenitentium deles et in te sperantibus celeri pietate succurris famulo tuo illi quaesumus remissionem omnium tribue peccatorum et vota placatus assume; renova in eo piissime pater quidquid terrena fragilitate corruptum est quidquid diabolica immissione violatum; miserere Domine gemituum eius miserere lacrimarum ut de maerore in gaudium per tuam misericordiam transferatur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who according to Your great mercy forgive the sins of the penitent and come swiftly to the aid of those who hope in You; we humbly ask that You grant him forgiveness for all his sins, and favorably accept his vows. Renew in him most graciously, Father, whatever has been corrupted by earthly frailty, whatever has been violated by diabolical influence. Have mercy, Lord, on his sighs, have mercy on his tears, that he may be transferred from sorrow to joy through Your mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sedatis leonum cruentis faucibus famulum tuum Danielem illaesum conservare dignatus es quique eorum dentibus eos ad devorandum tradidisti qui prophetam tuum falsis assertionibus exstinguere nitebantur da Ecclesiae tuae de tanto gaudere patrono quem caeli participem fecisti esse in regno.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who quieted the bloody jaws of lions and deemed fit to preserve unharmed your servant Daniel, whom you handed over to be devoured by them as they sought to extinguish your prophet with false assertions; let the Church rejoice greatly from such a patron whom you have made a participant in heaven to be in your kingdom.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui semper es mirabilis in tuorum commemoratione sanctorum pietatem tuam humiliter imploramus ut preces nostras et hostias quas in honorem et venerationem Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctorumque apostolorum martyrum confessurum ae virginum atque omnium electorum tuorum tuae pietati devote offerimus placide ac benigne suscipias concedasque nobis obtentu illorum ut et peccatorum remissionem et supernorum civium mereamur adipisci consortium.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who are always wonderful in the commemoration of your saints, we humbly beseech your piety that we may devoutly offer our prayers and the sacrifices which we present in honor and veneration of God, the Mother of Christ Mary, the apostles, martyrs, virgins, and all your elect, and graciously receive them. We ask that you grant us through their intercession the remission of sins and merit to attain the company of heavenly citizens.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui sic hominem condidisti ut meliorem temporalibus beneficiis competenter instructum ad caelestia dona provehis praesta quaesumus ut sicut per illicitos appetitus de indultae beatitudinis regione decidimus sic per alimoniam tuo munere distributam et transitoria sustentetur humanitas et amissa recuperetur aeternitas.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who created man in such a way that he may be fittingly instructed by temporal benefits for the heavenly gifts, grant us your prayer, so that just as we have fallen from the realm of unmerited beatitude through illicit desires, so may humanity be sustained by your gift of nourishment and transient things, and may eternity be regained.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui superbis resistis et gratiam praestas humilibus tribue quaesumus ut non indignationem tuam provocemus elati sed propitiationis tuae capiamus dona subiecti.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who resists the proud and grants grace to the humble, we humbly ask that we may not provoke your wrath by being arrogant, but rather receive the gifts of your propitiation as subjects.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui tanta tibi caritate beatum Andream apostolum vinxisti ut tuo auxilio mundi vinceret fluctus carnis contereret motus nitentisque gladii non paveret adsultos quem crux elevata suscepit humilem ut restitueret triumphantem pacifica quaesumus hanc familiam eius sollemnitati collectam ut dum praebet oscula proximis indulgens laedentibus veniam obtineat pro delictis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who bound blessed Andrew the apostle with such great love that he conquered the waves of the world with your aid, crushed the movements of the flesh, did not fear the assaults of shining swords, and who was taken up by the raised cross humbly to restore triumphant peace. We humbly ask that this family, gathered in solemnity, may provide kisses to their neighbors, forgiving those who hurt them, obtaining forgiveness for their sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui terrenis corporibus verbi tui veritatem per venerabilem Mariam coniungi voluisti petimus immensam clementiam tuam ut quod in eius veneratione deposcimus te propitiante mereamur consequi.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who willed to unite the truth of your word with terrestrial bodies through the venerable Mary, we humbly ask for your immense mercy that we may deserve to obtain what we ask in her veneration, when you are propitious.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui terrenis corporibus verbi tui veritatem {filii unigeniti} per venerabilem ac gloriosam semperque virginem Mariam ineffabili mysterio coniungere voluisti petimus immensam clementiam tuam ut quod in eius veneratione deposcimus te propitiante consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who willed to unite the truth of your Word with terrestrial bodies in an ineffable mystery through the venerable, glorious, and ever virgin Mary, your only-begotten Son, we humbly ask for your immense mercy that, as you are appeased by our request made in her veneration, we may deserve to obtain what we have asked.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui timore sentiris dilectione coleris confessione placaris misericordiam tuam effunde supplicibus ut qui de meritorum qualitate diffidimus non iudicium tuum sed indulgentiam sentiamus.
