translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who feels fear with love, is worshipped with confession and is appeased with compassion, pour out your mercy upon the supplicants, so that those who doubt the quality of merits may not experience your judgment but rather feel your indulgence.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui tua ineffabili bonitate sanctissimum corpus beatae Barbarae virginis et martyris tuae ab impiis denudatum ne ab eis videretur per sanctos angelos tuos tegi fecisti sic tua melliflua caritate omnium peccatorum multitudinem cooperire digneris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who by your ineffable goodness have covered the most holy body of the blessed Barbara, virgin and martyr, stripped off by the impious, with your sweet love, deign to cover over all the multitude of sinners.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui tuae mensae participes a diabolico iubes abstinere convivio da quaesumus plebi tuae ut gustu mortiferae profanitatis abiecto puris mentibus ad epulas aeternae salutis accedant.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who commands those partaking of Your table to abstain from the banquet of the devil, we humbly ask that Your people may approach with pure minds to the feast of eternal salvation, after discarding the taste of mortal profanity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui tuis fidelibus contulisti ut ille quo inter natos mulierum nullus est maior oriretur et unigeniti tui gloriosus praecursor exsisteret providentiae tuae munus exsequere ut quae manifestavit testificatio nuntii impleat praesentia nuntiati.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who has granted your faithful ones that the greatest among women's offspring would be born and the glorious forerunner of your unique one would exist. Perform the duty of your providence, so that what the testimony of the messenger has manifested will be fulfilled by the presence of the announced.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui unigeniti praecursorem Filii tui sanctum Ioannem hodierna die nasciturum angelico oraculo declarasti concede familiae tuae piae effectum devotionis ut quae eius annua recolit festa praesentis vitae assequatur pacis incrementa futuraeque beatitudinis gaudia.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who declared through an angelic announcement that your only-begotten Son, Saint John, would be born today, grant to your devout family the fruit of their devotion. May they attain the peace increase in this life and the joy of future beatitude by remembering his annual feasts.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui unigenito tuo novam creaturam nos tibi esse fecisti custodi opera misericordiae tuae et ab omnibus nos maculis vetustatis emunda ut per auxilium gratiae tuae in illius inveniamur forma in quo tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through your only-begotten Son have made us to be a new creation for yourself; keep us by your merciful aid and cleanse us from all the stains of our oldness, that we may find ourselves in your form where our substance is with you.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui unigenitum tuum post resurrectionem suam primum beatae Mariae Magdalenae manifestasti quaesumus ita ad amorem tuum nos accende ut Deum quem amavit totis viribus amando securi mereamur videre.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who first revealed your Son after his resurrection to the blessed Mary Magdalene, we humbly ask that you enkindle in us a love for you such that, by loving him with all our might, we may be made worthy to see you securely.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui verbi tui incarnationem praeclari testimonio sideris indicasti quod videntes magi oblatis maiestatem tuam muneribus adorarunt concede ut semper in mentibus nostris tuae appareat stella iustitiae et noster in tua sit confessione thesaurus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who signified your incarnation by a glorious testimony of the star which the magi saw, grant that we may always perceive in our minds the star of justice and that our treasure may be in your confession.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui vitam beati antistitis tui Leudegarii martyris per istius saeculi aerumnas transire iussisti cuius annua festa devota mente celebramus quaesumus ut per eius intercessionem plebem tuae clementiae famulantem ita in praesenti foveas ut ad caelestia regna perducas.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who allowed your blessed bishop Leudegar's life, a martyr in this world's troubles, to pass through, whose annual feast we faithfully celebrate. We humbly ask that through his intercession, the people serving under your mercy may be fostered in this present life so that you may lead them to heavenly kingdoms.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui vitam humani generis pro nobis filio tuo moriente salvasti praesta quaesumus ut in hac populi tui devotione fructus proveniat gaudiorum.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who saved the life of the human race for us by your Son dying, grant, we beseech you, that among this people's devotion, there may be produced fruit of joy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui vivorum dominaris simul et mortuorum omniumque misereris quos tuos fide et opere futuros esse praenoscis te suppliciter exoro ut pro quibus effundere preces decrevi quosque vel praesens adhuc saeculum in carne retinet vel futurum iam exutos corpore suscepit pietatis tuae clementia delictorum suorum veniam consequantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who rules over the living as well as the dead and shows mercy to all whom you foresee will be yours in faith and deeds, I humbly entreat you that for those for whom I have decided to pray, whether they are still in this world ensnared by flesh or have already shed their bodies, may find forgiveness through your mercy for their sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus redemptor animarum salvandarum et pretium redemptionis generis humani miserere clementer animae famuli tui illius et quidquid in eo vitiorum fallente diabolo et propria iniquitate contraxit tu pius et misericors abluas indulgendo et terram quam sanguine proprio tuo dedicasti de manibus inimicorum crucis eripias vota filiorum Israel ad eius liberationem instantium in viam salutis aeternae misericorditer dirigendo.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, Redeemer of souls to be saved, and Price of the redemption of the human race, have mercy graciously on the soul of your servant, and whatever in him he has contracted through the fault of the deceiving devil and his own iniquity. You, who are kind and merciful, wash away and forgive, indulging him. And you, who dedicated the earth with your own precious blood, tear it out from the hands of the enemies of the cross. Direct the prayers of the sons of Israel, eager for their liberation, mercifully into the way of eternal salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus respice propitius ad preces Ecclesiae tuae et da nobis fidem rectam spem certam caritatem perfectam humilitatem veram; concede nobis Domine ut sit in nobis simplex affectus patientia fortis oboedientia perseverans pax perpetua mens pura rectum et mundum cor voluntas bona conscientia sancta compunctio spiritalis virtus animae vita immaculata consummatio irreprehensibilis ut viriliter currentes in tuum regnum mereamur feliciter introire.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, look upon us graciously as we pray to you and grant us a right faith, a certain hope, a perfect charity, true humility; let us be given Lord, that there may be in us a simple disposition, patient endurance, steadfast obedience, lasting peace, pure mind, upright heart, good will, holy conscience, sincere compunction, spiritual virtue, immaculate soul, consummation without reproach. May we who run manfully towards your kingdom merit to enter it happily.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus respice propitius oblationem populi tui quam offert tuae maiestati in honorem sanctae Brigidae virginis tuae ut qui hodie eius transitum laudat in terris eius quoque iri superni poli sede muniatur suffragiis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, graciously look upon the offering of your people which is presented to your majesty in honor of Saint Brigid, your virgin. May he who today praises her earthly transition also be equipped with blessings from the heavenly throne through your intercessions.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus respice propitius preces nostras pro anima famuli tui illius qui ecclesiis tuis eleemosynas tribuit; fac eum praemio beatum quem fecisti pietate devotum.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, look upon us graciously as we pray for the soul of your servant who gave alms to your churches. May you reward him with eternal happiness that you made by your mercy devoted.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus respice propitius super  hunc famulum tuum illum qui in pauperes tuos operatur; virtute custodi potestate tuearis ut per multa curricula annorum laetus tibi in pauperes tuos haec operetur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, look upon this, your servant, with favor, who works among your poor; may you protect and defend him by your power, so that he may gladly perform these deeds among your poor throughout many years.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus romani nominis defende rectores ut in tua dextera confidentes fiant cunctis hostibus fortiores.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God of the Roman name, defend the rulers so that, trusting in your right hand, they become stronger against all enemies.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus romanis auxiliare principibus ut tua virtute roboratis omnis hostilitas nec viribus possit praevalere nec fraude.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, aid the Roman princes that with your power they may be strengthened, so no hostility may prevail against them neither by might nor cunning.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus salus aeterna credentium exaudi nos pro famulis tuis illis pro quibus misericordiae tuae imploramus auxilium ut reddita sibi sanitate gratiarum tibi in Ecclesia tua referant actionem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, eternal savior of believers, hear us on behalf of your servants for whom we implore your mercy. Grant them health that they may return to you thanks in your Church by referring to the deed done.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus sensibus nostris propitiatus intende ut a terrenis delectationibus abstinentes propensius caelestia meditemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, gracious to our senses, direct us so that, abandoning earthly delights, we may be more inclined towards heavenly matters.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus sollemnitatem diei huius propitius intuere et Ecclesiam tuam intercessione beati Martini pontificis atque confessoris tui continua fac celebritate gaudere omniumque in te credentium vota perficias.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, graciously look upon the solemnity of this day and may your Church rejoice continuously with the intercession of Blessed Martin, Your pontiff and confessor, and fulfill the wishes of all who believe in You.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus te deprecor ut aurem misericordiae tuae pandas postulanti famulo tuo illi; eius precibus adsis propitius; auge illi fidem salutem ac pacem et eius peccata propitius dimitte acceptaque sint tibi vota eius ut oblationem quam tibi offert acceptabiliter suscipias et sanctorum tuorum intercessionibus petitiones eius adimpleas; in cunctis quibus tibi postulat propitius exaudias.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, I humbly beseech You to open the ear of Your mercy to Your servant who is asking; be propitious with him in his prayers; increase his faith, health and peace, and graciously forgive his sins, may his vows be accepted by You. Let the offering he presents to You be received acceptably, and let his petitions be fulfilled through the intercession of Your saints. In all things for which he asks, grant him propitious hearing.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus te supplices deprecamur ut caelestem benedictionem atque sanctificationem super nos illustrare digneris; sint oculi tui aperti super plebem istam et super universum populum tuum; exaudi preces nostras; conserva iustos parce peccatoribus iustifica paenitentes sana languidos visita infirmos subveni egenis succurre captivis require errantes libera tribulatos eripe oppressos consolare afflictos ut omnes in suis necessitatibus in quocumque loco maiestatem tuam imploraverint tuam misericordiam consequantur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech you to illuminate upon us the celestial blessing and sanctification; may your eyes be open over this people and over all your people; hear our prayers; preserve the just, show mercy to sinners, justify penitents, heal the sick, visit the weak, assist the needy, help the captives, find the lost, free the troubled, relieve the oppressed, comfort the afflicted, so that all who in any place have sought your majesty in their necessities may obtain your mercy.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus tota nos ad te mente converte ut qui talia dona praestas immeritis praebeas maiora devotis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, turn our minds entirely towards You so that You who bestow such undeserved gifts, may grant us greater ones to the devoted.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus totifex et totiger angelicarum superni populi phalangum alto caelorum throno sederis cernens et regens cuncta cui nihil incognita in caelo et in terra in cuius conspectu contremiscunt tartara tellusque tremit quassata subnixe rogamus pro fratribus nostris illis ut acceptis bonis perseverent illaesi huius vitae iter peragant nec in dextera nec in laeva devient te tuente prospera agant impedimenta mundi nihil praepediant sub tuae defensionis testitudine insidiis inimici tui permaneant te miserante fragili in corpore quamdiu subsistant devote et probabiliter usque ad diem obitus vivant ad regni tui praemia perveniant.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, the maker and shaker of the angelic multitude of the upper people, seated on the high throne of heaven, you see and rule all things, in whose sight even Tartarus trembles and the earth quakes. We humbly beseech you for our brethren, that under your protection they may persevere unharmed through this life's journey, neither by right hand nor by left hand may any adversity befall them; may prosperous events occur and let worldly obstacles have no effect on them. May their enemies' plots remain under the shield of your defense as long as they live devotedly and uprightly until the day of their death, may they reach the rewards of your kingdom.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus totius conditor creaturae preces nostras clementer exaudi et annos famulis tui illius quem de maternis visceribus in hanc vitam prodire iussisti prosperos plurimosque largire ut omnem tibi exigat placiturus aetatem.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, creator of all things, graciously hear our prayers and grant many and prosperous years to the servant whom you have commanded to be born into this life from his mother's womb. May he live in such a way as to always seek your will.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus tribue nobis famulis tuis per intercessionem sancti Sampsonis episcopi poscentibus peccatorum veniam quaerentibus salutis viam pulsantibus aperire regni caelestis aulam ut ad aeternam maiestatis tuae habitationem te adiuvante pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant to us, your servants, through the intercession of Saint Samuel the bishop, who are asking for pardon of sins, seeking the way of salvation, and knocking at the door of the kingdom of heaven. May we merit, with your help, to reach your eternal dwelling place.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus tribue nobis famulis tuis ut sicut martyres tui ad bravium supernae vocationis tetenderunt ita nos superato hoste victoriam consequamur et pacem quam in labiis oris exsequimur immaculatis cordibus teneamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant to your servants that we may, like your martyrs, strive towards the summons of an eternal vocation. May we conquer victory over our defeated enemy and hold in our pure hearts the peace which we pursue with lips and mouth.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus tribue nobis munere festivitatis hodiernae ut illuc filiorum tuorum dirigatur intentio quo in tuo unigenito tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant us the gift of today's festivity that the intention of your children may be directed towards the place where our substance is in your only-begotten Son with you.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut munere festivitatis hodiernae illuc filiorum tuorum dirigatur intentio quo in tuo unigenito tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, to grant that the intention of your children may be directed towards the festivity of today so that our substance is with you in your only-begotten Son.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus tribue nobis semper et ubique sacratissimis gloriosi pontificis tui Syri muniri suffragiis ut eius opitulantibus meritis famulatus nostri placere tibi possint obsequia.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant us always and everywhere the most sacred and glorious pontiff of yours in Syria, strengthened by your prayers, that through his merits our service may please you with due reverence.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus trina maiestas et una deitas qui in Trinitate permanes et in unitate semper consistis praesta quaesumus ut qui peccatorum nostrorum pondere praegravamur celerem indulgentiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, Trinity and unity who persists in the Trinity and always exists in unity, grant us that we may merit to obtain swift mercy, since we are heavily burdened by the weight of our sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus tua nobis quaesumus indulgentiae dona largire ut quos gloriosissimi martyris tui Romani festivitate iucundos efficis continua veneratione ipsius ad te semper sublevemur patrocinio suffragante.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, we humbly ask that you grant us the gift of Your indulgence, so that those who are made joyful by the festivity of Your glorious martyr in Rome, may always be uplifted through continual veneration of him. May his patronage intercede for us.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus tuorum lumen sanctorum adesto piis Ecclesiae tuae precibus et beati Botulfi confessoris tui atque abbatis ubique proiectione conserva propitius ut cuius merita recolimus intercessione suffulti ad superna gaudia te adiuvante pervenire valeamus.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, be present with the light of your saints to our pious Church through your prayers and that of blessed Botulf, your confessor and abbot, everywhere protect us graciously. May we, sustained by his merits, reach the supreme joys with your help.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus virtutum largitor sanctarum annue plebi tuae ut qui annua beatae virginis tuae Petronillae sollemnia celebramus eius semper et fidei integritate roboremur et piis apud te precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, giver of virtues and sanctities, grant your people that we who celebrate the annual feast of Your blessed virgin Petronilla may always be strengthened in faith and aided by our devout prayers to You.

text: Omnipotens unigenite Christe Filius Dei patris qui tam viris quam feminis tropheo das triumphare certaminis cum et in illis virile robur in certamine adiuvas et in his minus valentem corporis fragilitatem exaltas ut in hoc per te validus sexus valeat quod infirmus praesta nobis humillimis servulis tuis ut hae virgines quae sibi apud te obtinuerunt victoriae palmam delictorum nobis impetrent veniam et quae iam suo sunt candidatae martyrio delinquentes muniant niveo castitatis umbraculo et quae tuo sunt indissolubiliter copulatae amori indisrupta soliditate nos tibi copulent fidei ut qui earum passionis diem integra devotione suscipimus ipsarum obtentu inter mundi huius procellas et turbines gubernemur.
translation_en: Almighty unigenite Christ, Son of God the Father, who give both men and women a trophy to triumph in the contest, and in them lend virile strength in the struggle, and exalt the less strong bodily frailty, that through you, the weak may be strong. Grant us, your humblest servants, that these virgins who have obtained the victory palm before you may intercede for our forgiveness of sins; and those who are already candidates for martyrdom, may clothe themselves in the white mantle of chastity; and those united to you in an indissoluble bond of love, may bind us with an unbreakable solidity of faith. May we, who receive their day of passion with undivided devotion, be guided by their intercession among the storms and turbulences of this world.

text: Omnipotens unigenite Filius Dei patris qui ad corroborandam fidem martyrum tuorum Valeriani Tiburtii et Caeciliae splendificos adspectus angelicos destinasti ad terras per quos illis concretas liliorum ac rosarum floribus destinasti coronas tu nos iisdem intervenientibus apud te et vinculis piaculorum absolve et donis spiritalibus reple ut sicut illi te tua gratia praecedente martyrium ambiendo secuti sunt ita nos eadem praecedente atque subsequente et hic adipiscamur paenitentiae fructum et post consortium beatorum ut sine intermissione indulgeas miseris cum nihil excusas beatis; ut iustifices paenitentes cum pro peccatoribus exaudieris martyres exorantes ut illorum consortio adunemur in caelis quorum hic obsequimur patrociniis quo possit nobis tunc cum iisdem socia esse laetitia cum eos viderimus in gloria sempiterna.
translation_en: Almighty, only-begotten Son of God the Father, who arranged splendid appearances of angels for your martyrs Valerian, Tiburtius, and Cecilia on earth to strengthen their faith, and destined them crowns with concrete lilies and roses, we pray that you absolve us by their intervention, fill us with spiritual gifts, so that just as they followed you with your grace preceding their martyrdom, we may follow in the same way preceded and followed, and here we may obtain the fruit of penitence, and after the fellowship of the blessed, grant mercy without intermission to sinners with no excuses for the saints; that you justify penitents as you hear the prayers of martyrs, so that we may be united with them in heaven whom we serve on earth through their patronage, so that we can then be companions with them in joy when we see them in eternal glory.

text: Omnipotentem ac misericordem dominum fratres dilectissimi qui habet potestatem mortificare et iterum vivificare deducere ad inferos et reducere et vocat ea quae non sunt tamquam ea quae sunt cuius potestas in caelo et in terra in mare et inferis plene assistit hunc humiliter trementerque deprecemur pro anima famuli tui illius quem Dominus vocavit de praesenti saeculo et forsitan ob gravitatem criminum non meretur gloriam <ut> per haec sacrae oblationis libamina vel tolerabiliora fiant ipsa tormenta.
translation_en: We humbly and tremblingly beseech the omnipotent and merciful Lord, our most dear brothers, who has the power to send to hell and bring back to life, who calls those things which are not as though they were, whose power is fully present in heaven and on earth, in sea and in the underworld. We beseech you for the soul of your servant whom the Lord has called from the present world, perhaps because of the gravity of his sins, that through these sacred offerings, or something more tolerable, the very torments may be averted.

text: Omnipotentem Deum ac Dominum nostrum fratres carissimi deprecemur ut hodierna sollemnia quae pro natale beatissimi apostoli et martyris sui Andreae suscepimus sibi ipse commendet ac sicut illi hodie ob praedicationem verbi sui capto inter vincula carceris flagella et crucis nece affuit et de triumpho nobili coronam dedit ita interventu eius nobis in se credentibus qui pressuris huius mundi et insidiis inimici fatigamur in omnibus temptationibus adesse ac misericordiam largiri dignetur et offerentium ac pausantium quae recitata sunt nomina apostoli sui intercessione sanctificet.
translation_en: We humbly beseech the Almighty God and our Lord, dearest brothers, that today's solemnities which we have received in honor of the natal day of the blessed apostle and martyr Andrew, may himself commend them to Himself. As he this day suffered for the preaching of His word being captured in prison chains, scourged, and crucified, and yet was crowned with a noble triumph, so grant us by His intervention to be present among us who believe in Him, weighed down by the pressures of this world and the snares of its enemies. In all temptations may He deign to assist and bestow mercy upon us. May He also sanctify the names of His apostle, through whose intercession, those offering or resting [their offerings] have been named.

text: Omnipotentem Deum nostrum fusis precibus exoramus fratres carissimi pro famulo suo illo votum optabile desideranti ut ei impleat petitionis effectum preces eius exaudiat desideria compleat vota suscipiat et propitius peccata dimittat ut dum pietatis intuitu <et> placabili oculi sui intentione respexerit votum ipsius eius orationi accommodet et libens suscipiat preces.
translation_en: We fervently appeal to our Almighty God, beloved brothers, for his servant who earnestly desires this worthy vow, that he may grant the success of his petition, hear his prayers, fulfill his desires, accept his vows, and in mercy forgive his sins. May he look upon him with a gaze of compassion and answer his prayer favorably, and willingly receive his petitions.

text: Omnipotentem Deum qui per sanctos apostolos et martyres suos diversa sanitatum dona largitur fratres dilectissimi deprecemur ut huic servo suo illi qui typi quartani vexatione fatigatur fidelis famuli sui Sigismundi precibus clementer occurrat et dum nobis illius patefacit merita isti conferat medicinam.
translation_en: We entreat the Almighty God, who bestows different gifts of health through His holy apostles and martyrs, to graciously approach this servant of His, who is weary from the troubles of the fourth quarter, faithful servant Sigismund. May He reveal the merits of this servant to us, and in doing so grant him a healing medicine.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per sanctos apostolos et martyres tuos diversa sanitatum dona largiris te suppliciter deprecamur ut huic servo tuo illi qui typi quartani vexatione fatigatur fidelis famuli tui Sigismundi precibus clementer occurras et dum nobis illius patefacis merita isti conferas medicinam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through your saints and martyrs bestow different gifts of health, we humbly beseech you. May you graciously approach on behalf of this Your servant who is weary from the vexation of the fourth quarter (quarterly payments?). As You reveal his merits to us, may you grant him medicine.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per sanctos apostolos et martyres tuos diversa sanitatum dona largiri dignatus es da quaesumus ut famulum tuum illum qui a febrium vexatione fatigatur per intercessionem famuli tui Sigismundi regis et martyris tua medicina erigas ad salutem et ad sanitatem pristinam revocare digneris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who through your holy apostles and martyrs have been gracious to bestow different healths, we humbly ask that you raise up your servant, who is wearied by the vexation of fever, through the intercession of your servant King and Martyr Sigismund, and deem him worthy to be restored to health and to his original state of well-being.

text: Omnipotentem Deum universitatis auctorem suppliciter exoramus ut spirituale sacrificium quod in honorem sancti Patricii offerimus fiat nobis remedium sempiternum.
translation_en: We humbly entreat the almighty God, the creator of all universes, that the spiritual sacrifice we offer in honor of St. Patrick may become for us an eternal remedy.

text: Omnipotentiam tuam Domine Iesu Christe apud quem multae sunt mansiones imploramus ut animas et spiritus famulorum tuorum illorum ab aestuantis ignis ardoribus eruas atque in loco lucis et refrigerii dimisso crimine heredes constituas.
translation_en: We beseech Your almighty power, Lord Jesus Christ, where many dwellings are, to rescue the souls and spirits of Your servants from the burning heat of the flames, and to set them in a place of light and coolness, free from sin, as heirs.

text: Omnipotentiam tuam Domine prompta mente laudantes ieiunia tibi sacrata deferimus ut dum grati de perceptis exsistimus efficiamur (de) percipiendis fructibus gratiores.
translation_en: With a mind ready, we praise your omnipotence, Lord, as our fasting brings sacred offerings to you. May we who are gratefully alive from the perceived blessings be empowered to perceive even sweeter fruits.

text: Omnipotentiam tuam quaesumus Domine sanctus tuus ille interventor exoret ut eius meritis hanc ecclesiam deputatam clementer illustres quoniam quidquid sanctis honoris impenditur tuae respicit insignia maiestatis.
translation_en: We humbly ask your omnipotence, Lord, that your holy one, the intercessor, may plead on behalf of his merits for this church which you have appointed, since whatever honor is bestowed upon the saints reflects the insignia of your majesty.

text: Omnis a nobis te Domine expiante pravitas humana discedat ut puris sensibus et mentibus tua mysteria celebremus.
translation_en: Lord, may all impurities from us depart so that we may celebrate your mysteries with pure senses and minds.

text: Omnium nos Domine sanctorum tuorum foveant continuata praesidia quia non desinis propitius intueri quos talibus auxiliis concesseris adiuvari.
translation_en: Lord, protect all of us, your saints, with uninterrupted protection, for you never cease to look upon favorably those whom you have granted such assistance to be helped.

text: Omnium nostrum Domine quaesumus ad te corda converte ut ab his quibus offenderis abstinentes non iracundiam tuam sed misericordiam sentiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to turn our hearts towards you, so that, being mindful of our transgressions, we may feel your mercy rather than your wrath.

text: Omnium nostrum Domine quaesumus hostias propitius intuere ut et quod actum est per obsequium deputatum et fidelium vota populorum tua potius dignatione firmentur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you look favorably upon all our offerings, so that what has been done through assigned obedience and the wishes of your people may be confirmed by your gracious grace.

text: Omnium quaesumus Domine sanctorum tuorum supplicatio placatus et veniam nobis tribue et remedia sempiterna concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your saints' intercession be pleasing to you, and grant us forgiveness and eternal remedies.

text: Omnium sanctorum intercessionibus quaesumus Domine gratia tua nos semper protegat et christianis fidelibus viventibus atque defunctis misericordiam ubique praetende ut viventes ab omnibus impugnationibus defensi tua opitulatione salventur et defuncti remissionem suorum omnium mereantur accipere peccatorum.
translation_en: Through the intercession of all saints, we humbly ask you, Lord, that your grace may always protect us and extend mercy to all Christian faithful, both living and deceased, so that the living may be defended from every attack by your aid and saved, and the deceased may deserve to receive forgiveness for all their sins.

text: Omnium virtutum Deus bonorumque largitor da quaesumus ut beati apostoli tui Andreae semper nobis adsint et honoranda sollemnia et desiderata praesidia.
translation_en: We ask You, God, giver of all virtues and good things, that the blessed Apostle Andrew may always be present to us, and that we may be under the protection of honored feasts and desired aids.

text: Omnium virtutum Deus bonorumque largitor da quaesumus ut beatissimorum martyrum tuorum illius et illius semper nobis sint et honoranda sollemnia et desiderata praesidia.
translation_en: We ask God, the giver of all virtues and good things, to grant that the solemnities and desired presences of your blessed martyrs always be venerated by us and honored.

text: Operis tui Deus initiator et custos suscipe gratiarum propitius actionem quod anni cursu remeante votiva recolimus sumptae primordia dignitatis ut quae tuis sunt principiis instituta tuis regantur aucta praesidiis.
translation_en: God, the initiator and guardian of your work, graciously receive this action of thanks as we remember, returning in the course of the year, the first fruits of dignity that were consecrated to you. May those things instituted by your principles be ruled by them and augmented by increased protections.

text: Opitulare Iesu precibus supplicantium et fletus lugentium verte in gaudium. Ipsi etenim ad te Domine cum Martha clamamus ut adsis nobis semper praesentia deitatis ne umquam decidamus sub pressura damnationis. Iam solve Christe nostrorum pedum ligamenta facinoris ut et manus nostrae resolutae restituant tibi sacrificium laudis et os nostrum in decantando tibi non obstrudatur sudario adversantis.
translation_en: Turn the supplications and weeping of those seeking Jesus into joy. Indeed, to you Lord, we cry out with Martha, asking for your constant presence, that the pressure of damnation never causes us to fall. Now, O Christ, loosen the bonds of our sinful feet so that our hands, freed, may restore to you a sacrifice of praise and so that our mouth, singing to you, is not obstructed by a towel of opposition.

text: Opus misericordiae tuae est sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus rogare pro aliis qui nobis non sufficimus; suscipe Domine animam servi tui illius revertentem ad te; adsit ei angelus testamenti tui Michael; libera eam Domine de principibus tenebrarum et de locis poenarum ne iam ullis primae nativitatis vel ignorantiae confundatur erroribus; agnoscatur a tuis et misericordia bonitatis tuae ad Iocum refrigerii et quietis in sinu transferatur Abrahae.
translation_en: It is your work of mercy, Holy Father Almighty eternal God, to pray for others who are not sufficient for us; receive, Lord, the soul of your servant returning to you. Let an angel of your covenant, Michael, be with him. Free him, Lord, from the princes of darkness and from places of punishment, that he may no longer be confounded by errors of the first nativity or ignorance. May he be known among yours and may he be transferred to Jacob for refreshment and peace in your bosom, Abraham.

text: Oramus indefessis precibus omnipotentiam tuam Deus sancte Pater omnipotens ut repleas nos munere unigeniti tui gaudii inenarrabili visitatione ac vivificatione tui atque eius Spiritus Sancti ut quos creasti vel redemisti per filium perficere digneris per Spiritum Sanctum. Non quod seiuncta vel dissimilis sit tuae operatio Trinitatis sed quod personarum exsistentium evidenter appareat inconfusa unius aequalitas deitatis.  Hac igitur te Deus omnipotens inspirationis tuae confessione manifestum fidelibus impende propitium daemonibus exerce terrificum persequentibus obvium paenitentibus placabilem peccatoribus patientem haereticis convictorem custodem virginibus defensorem viduis orphanis protectorem oppressis vindicem consolatorem maestis dubiis ducatorem.  Sit nobis in eo indeficiens consolatio in quo tibi filioque tuo est indivisa coniunctio et immensurabilis plenitudo sanctisque omnibus inexpugnabilis fortitudo; tamque certa nobis sit de tua gubernatione fiducia ne umquam se sentiat anima muniminis tui praesidio destituta. Ita vigore tuo nostra adversus diabolum fragilitas muniatur ne ullatenus in certamine superetur. Sic corda te scientium posside sic conscientiam rege ut et consilio providi efficiamur et opere probi et prudentes sermone et ferventes inexstinguibili caritate.
translation_en:
We implore your tireless prayers, O Almighty God, Holy Father, all-powerful one, that you fill us with the gift of your only-begotten Son, unutterable visitation and vivification, and Your Holy Spirit, that You who have created or redeemed us through Your Son, deem us worthy to be perfected by the Holy Spirit. Not that Your operation of the Trinity is separate or disparate, but that the evident equality of the existing persons in Your Deity is apparent without confusion.
Therefore, make this manifest to the faithful by Your all-powerful inspiration, a propitious daemon to the wicked, terrifying to the evil ones pursuing them, merciful to the penitent, patient to sinners, a conqueror to heretics, a guardian to virgins, a protector to widows, orphans, and oppressed ones, a vindicator for the wronged, a comforter for the sorrowful, a guide for the doubtful, a leader for us.
May there be in Him an unending consolation for us, where the indivisible union and immeasurable fullness of You and Your Son is present, and an invincible strength to all saints. Let our faith be assured of Your governance so that no soul may ever feel itself deprived of the protection of Your fortress. Thus, let our fragility be strengthened against the devil by Your power so that we are never overcome in the contest. Let hearts knowing You possess us, and let consciousness rule us so that we are made effective by wise counsel, do good works, speak fervently, and burn with unquenchable charity.

text: Oramus te Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus pro spiritibus famulorum tuorum qui de huius saeculi aerumnosa peregrinatione pro defensione catholicae ecclesiae migraverunt ut eos in locum lucis et refrigerii propitius deputare digneris.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, holy Father almighty everlasting God, for the spirits of your servants who have migrated from this world's sorrowful pilgrimage for the defense of the Catholic Church, that you may graciously assign them to a place of light and refreshment.

text: Oramus te Domine sancte Pater aeterne omnipotens Deus pro spiritu et anima famuli tui illius ut eum in locum lucis et refrigerii propitius deputare digneris ut cum dies resurrectionis advenerit per hanc sanctam communionem non cum impiis et peccatoribus sed cum sanctis et electis tuis tibi eum adstare concedas.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, holy Father eternal, almighty God, on behalf of the spirit and soul of your servant that one, may you graciously assign him to a place of light and refreshment. May it please you that when the day of resurrection comes, through this holy communion, not with the unrighteous and sinners but with the saints and chosen ones of yours, may you allow him to stand before you.

text: Oramus te pater sancte ut nos servos tuos beatissimi martyris tui illius iubeas esse consortes in confessione participes in.fide stabiles in persecutione firmos in tribulatione patientes in consummatione victores ut si nos dies persecutionis invenerit iungat consummatio virtutum pars praemiorum et corona caelestis.
translation_en: We ask you, holy Father, that you command us, your servants, to be companions in confession, participants in the faith, steadfast in persecution, firm in tribulation, patient in affliction, and victorious in completion. If persecution finds us, may the consummation unite us with the reward of virtues and award us the crown of heaven.

text: Orationes nostras propitiatus respice omnipotens Deus et produc de oculis nostris lacrimarum flumina quibus debita flammarum incendia valeant exstingui.
translation_en: Gracious God, almighty look upon our prayers and let rivers of tears flow from our eyes, by which the fitting fires may be extinguished.

text: Oremus carissimi pro fratribus nostris qui offerunt Deo nostro spiritalia munera petentes ut oblationes eorum accepto ferre dignetur. Restituat illis pro modicis <magna pro terrenis caelestia pro temporalibus sempiterna>.
translation_en: Let us pray, dearest ones, for our brethren who offer spiritual gifts to our God, seeking that He may deem worthy to carry their offerings. May He restore to them for minor things, great things (for earthly things, heavenly things for temporal things, eternal things).

text: Oremus fratres carissimi pro caris nostris illis qui iam in dominica pace praecesserunt quos finis debitus et ordo transmigrationis conclusit ut Deus omnipotens pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi iubeat carnem animamque et spiritum eorum suscipi in locum lucis in partem refrigerii in sinibus Abrahae et Isaac et Iacob; dimittat quoque eis quidquid incongrue per ignorantiam atque subripiente inimico peccaverunt et spiritu oris sui eos refrigerare dignetur.
translation_en: Let us pray, dear brothers, for our dear ones who have already passed away in the Lord's peace, whom the end and the order of migration have closed, that Almighty God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, may command their flesh, soul, and spirit to be received into the place of light, in the part of refreshing in the bosoms of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; may also forgive them whatever they have incorrectly done through ignorance and treachery by an enemy, and may grant them refreshment by the breath of their own mouth.

text: Oremus fratres carissimi ut haec oblatio nostra accepta sit domino et quos in honorem summi sacerdotis sui Germani episcopi videt esse devotos ita sibi beneplacitos esse concedat ut defunctorum spiritibus et requiem tribuat et beatitudinem largiatur.
translation_en: Let us pray, dear brothers, that our offering be accepted by the Lord. And may those whom He sees to be devoted in honor of His bishop, Germanus the priest, find favor with Him. May He grant them peace for the souls of the departed and bestow upon them blessings.

text: Oremus pro his qui offerunt munera Domino Deo nostro sacrosancta spiritalia pro se et pro caris suis et pro spiritibus carorum suorum in commemorationem sanctorum martyrum ut Dominus Deus noster preces illorum clementer exaudire
translation_en: Let us pray for those who offer sacred spiritual gifts to our Lord God, that He may graciously hear their prayers, in memory of the holy martyrs, for themselves and for their dear ones, and for the spirits of their loved ones.

text: Ostende nobis Domine misericordiam tuam et salutaris tui dona concede.
translation_en: Show us, O Lord, thy mercy, and grant thy saving health.

text: Ostende omnipotens Deus gratiam agnosce doctrinam; tu es mysterium pro salute tu praemium; doce perseverantiam cum docueris disciplinam ut in hac oblatione nos liberes qui pro occidentibus et moreris.
translation_en: O Almighty God, show forth Your grace and recognize Your teaching; You are the mystery for our salvation and Your reward. Teach perseverance with the discipline You have taught us, so that in this offering we may be freed who live in the west and die for them.

text: Pace tua Domine poscimus muniantur intima pectoris nostri quae et ieiunantibus fiat in permixtionem sanctificationis et non ieiunantibus maneat in expiationem facinoris.
translation_en: In your peace, Lord, we ask that the innermost parts of our heart be strengthened. For those who fast, may it become a mixture of sanctification, and for those who do not fast, may it remain as an atonement for sin.

text: Pacis tuae Deus nobis largire donaria qui in sancto Cypriano martyre tuo tantam tribuisti scientiae gratiam. Reple nos fructu tuae dulcedinis qui os eius caelestibus replesti doctrinis. Da in nobis abundantiam boni qui in illo contulisti scientiam tui ut sicut ille praedicata verbis sanguinis effusione complevit ita nos ea quae de tua pace scimus non solum verbo sed et opere praedicemus.
translation_en: Grant us, O God, the gifts of your peace, who bestowed such knowledge of grace upon us in the martyrdom of St. Cyprian. Fill us with the fruit of your sweetness, which filled his mouth with celestial teachings. Give us abundance in good works, which you have placed knowledge of yourself within him, so that, like him, we may not only proclaim your peace with words, but also demonstrate it through deeds.

text: Pacem nobis tribue Domine mentis et corporis ut nostrae fragilitati et manifesti subiciantur hostes et invisibiles excludantur.
translation_en: Lord, bestow peace upon us, of mind and body, that our frailty may submit to visible enemies and the invisible be excluded.

text: Pacem nobis tribue Domine quaesumus mentis et corporis ut per ieiunium nostrae fragilitatis et manifesti subiciantur hostes et invisibiles excludantur.
translation_en: Lord, bestow peace upon us, we ask. May it be for both mind and body, so that through our fasting, our frailty may be submitted to visible enemies and invisible ones may be excluded.

text: Pacem tuam de caelis Christe tribue nobis et tua pax sit semper in nobis ut emundati a peccatis nostris in perpetuum mereamur tuam pacem semper habere.
translation_en: Christ, grant us your peace from heaven, and may your peace always be with us. That we may be purified from our sins forever, may we always deserve to have your peace.

text: Pacem tuam Domine de caelo da nobis et posside nos ut non haereat in visceribus nostris fraudulentus osculus proditoris sed pax illa quam tuis reliquisti discipulis semper illibata permaneat in cordibus nostris.
translation_en: Lord, from heaven bestow your peace upon us, and hold us so that an unfaithful kiss of the traitor does not stick to our inner selves; but may that peace which you have always left to your disciples remain undefiled in our hearts.

text: Pacem tuam Domine nostris illabere pectoribus qui beatum martyrem tuum Leudegarium in hoc saeculo commorantem per pacis studium hodie in caelestem aulam suscepisti; nobis quoque peccatoribus pacis vinculum et caritatis studium eius meritis suffragantibus largiri iubeas in aevum.
translation_en: Lord, let your peace descend upon our hearts who today received your blessed martyr Leudegar into the heavenly court through his pursuit of peace; grant us sinners also the bond of peace and his study of love through his merits, forever.

text: Pacem tuam Domine quam commendasti tuis apostolis concede nobis servandam miseris servis tuis et quia tuum est praeceptum ut nos invicem diligamus quaesumus te ut hoc sacrificium suscipias pius et famulos tuos illos pro quibus offertur a cunctis angustiis et tribulationibus eripere digneris propitius.
translation_en: Lord, grant us the peace that you have commended to your apostles. Bestow upon us, your miserable servants, the ability to keep it. And since it is your commandment that we love one another, we humbly ask that you accept this sacrifice as a pious and faithful servant. We also implore you to deliver those for whom this sacrifice is offered from all distresses and tribulations graciously.

text: Pacem tuam nostris pectoribus bone Iesu illabere in qua est plenitudo dilectionis; praesta Domine ut pacem quam nunc ore proferimus semper spiritali sensu conservare mereamur.
translation_en: Bless us, good Jesus, with your peace that is full of love within our hearts. Lord, grant us that we may always deserve to keep the peace which we now express spiritually with our mouths.

text: Pacem tuam quaesumus Domine infunde in visceribus nostris qui eam discipulis commendasti adscensurus in caelis quo ita cor nostrum societatis tuae abundet dulcedine ut caritate Sancti Spiritus affluente tolerabiliter sustineamus in hoc corpore pro nostris criminibus illata flagella cum te recogitaverimus sustinuisse pro impiis crucis dura exitia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to pour your peace into our hearts, which you have entrusted to your disciples ascending in heaven. May our heart be filled with the sweetness of your fellowship so that, by the influx of the Holy Spirit, we may endure the punishments laid upon us for our sins in this body, recognizing that you have also borne the harsh sufferings of the cross for the unrighteous.

text: Panis vitae nostrae adspice Deus; sis custodia corporum sis salvificator animarum ut pectora nostra tanto poculo ciboque firmata inimica subdoli serpentis blandimenta non quatiant.
translation_en: Look upon the bread of our life, O God; be a guardian of our bodies, be a savior of souls, that our hearts may be fortified with this strong drink and food, so that the sweet temptations of the cunning serpent may not overwhelm us.

text: Parce Domine parce peccantibus et ut ad propitiationem tuam possimus accedere spiritum nobis tribue corrigendi.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy, have mercy upon sinners and grant us a spirit to enable us to approach your atonement; bestow upon us a spirit for correction.

text: Parce Domine parce peccatis nostris et quamvis incessabiliter delinquentibus continua poena debeatur praesta quaesumus ut quod perpetuum meremur exitium transeat ad correptionis auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy, Lord, have mercy upon our sins. And although the punishment should continually be due to those who unceasingly sin, we humbly ask that what we eternally deserve may pass over for the aid of correction.

text: Parce Domine parce peccatis nostris et quamvis incessabiliter delinquentibus continua poena debeatur praesta quaesumus ut quod praesenti meremur offensione nobis proveniat ad correctionem – et plagam quam super nos pro peccatis nostris imminere cognoscimus te miserante sentiamus cessare.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy upon us, Lord, have mercy on our sins. Although the punishment for unceasing offenders should be continuous, we humbly ask that what we merit by present offense may come upon us as correction – and the blow which we recognize is hanging over us for our sins, let us feel it cease through Your mercy.

text: Parce Domine parce populo tuo ut dignis flagellationibus castigatus in tua miseratione respiret.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy, have mercy on your people, that, chastised with worthy punishments, they may breathe again in Your mercy.

text: Parce Domine parce supplicibus; da propitiationis auxilium qui praestas etiam per ipsa flagella remedium nec haec tua correptio Domine sit neglegentibus maior causa poenarum sed fiat eruditio paterna correptis.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy, have mercy on supplicants; grant them help from propitiations, which you also provide through these very scourges, that this your correction, Lord, may not be a greater cause of punishments for the negligent but be a paternal instruction for those corrected.

text: Parce Domine quaesumus parce populo tuo et nullis iam patiaris adversitatibus fatigari quos pretioso Filii tui sanguine redemisti.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy upon us, we beseech You; spare Your people and let them no longer be wearied by adversities which Your Precious Son's blood has redeemed.

text: Parce nobis Domine et flagella irae tuae quae peccata nostra merentur precibus et meritis beatissimi confessoris tui Rochi a nobis misericorditer averte.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on us and turn away from us your anger, which our sins deserve. Through our prayers and the merits of your most blessed confessor St. Roch, may you mercifully avert it from us.

text: Participationem sancti corporis tui Domine sumentes tuam suppliciter deprecamur clementiam ut pro sancti Guthlaci meritis cuius hodie venerabilem commemorationem celebramus veram indulgentiam a te semper assequamur.
translation_en: Partaking of your holy body, Lord, we humbly pray for your mercy, that through the merits of Saint Guthlac, whom we today remember with veneration, we may always obtain true indulgence from you.

text: Pasce nos Domine tuorum gaudiis ubique sanctorum quia nostrae salutis augmenta sunt quoties illis honor impenditur in quibus tu mirabilis praedicatis.
translation_en: Sustain us, Lord, with the joys of your saints everywhere, for our salvation is increased whenever honor is bestowed upon them, in whom you perform marvels.

text: Paschale mysterium recensentes apostolorum Domine beatorum precibus foveamur quorum magisterio cognovimus exsequendum.
translation_en: Lord, we are reminded of the Paschal mystery by the prayers of the blessed apostles, whom we have learned to follow according to their teaching.

text: Paschales hostias recensentes quaesumus Domine ut quod frequentamus actu comprehendamus effectu.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, as we celebrate the Paschal feast, that what we participate in may be understood not just in action but also in its true effectiveness.

text: Paschalia nobis Domine gaudia quaesumus futurae salutis aeternitate confirma.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you confirm for us the joyful feast of Easter with the eternity of future salvation.

text: Paschalibus nobis quaesumus Domine remediis dignanter impende ut terrena desideria respuentes discamus inhiare caelestia.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, during the Paschal season, worthy remedies, that rejecting earthly desires, we may learn to desire heavenly things.

text: Paschalium gaudiorum deliciis delectati offerimus tibi Domine sancte Pater corpus et sanguinem Filii tui quod ipse placatus benedicendum assumens largiaris nobis quaesumus cum regeneratis infantibus conscientiae puritatem ita habere dum vivimus ut ex hoc post vitae huius excursum cum eisdem a te pariter coronemur quo omnes qui nunc tuae resurrectionis victorias ovando excolimus in resurrectionis ultimae die huius hostiae litatione salvemur.
translation_en: Rejoicing in the delights of Easter, we offer to you, Lord holy Father, the body and blood of your Son, which he himself, being pleased, took up to be given as blessing, so that you would bestow it upon us. We humbly ask that with the regenerated infants, we may possess a purity of conscience while we live, so that after this departure from life, we may be crowned by you together with them on that day when all who now rejoice in your resurrection's victories will be saved by this offering.

text: Passione Domini nostri Iesu Christi laetantes eiusque corporis et sanguinis mysterium celebrantes gratias offerimus nomini tuo omnipotens Deus pater et petimus ut ita mortificemur ac consepeliamur cum crucifixo tuo ut credamus et sentiamus nos vivere etiam simul cum ipso.
translation_en: We rejoice in the Passion of our Lord Jesus Christ and celebrate the mystery of his body and blood. We offer thanks to your name, almighty God, Father, and we ask that we may be mortified and conformed with your crucified one, so that we may believe and feel that we live even with him.

text: Passionis Filii tui Domine memoriam recensentes deposcimus ut quod in sollemnitate beati Thomae confessoris tui maiestati tuae deferimus sacrificium sit acceptum.
translation_en: Reflecting on the Passion of Your Son, Lord, we humbly ask that the offering we bring before Your majesty during the feast of Your blessed apostle Thomas be accepted.

text: Pasti cibo spiritalis alimoniae quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quod mysterio frequentamus intercedente beato Marco evangelista plena veritate consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to grant that we may obtain the spiritual food with which we are fed, so that through the intercession of blessed Mark the Evangelist, we may follow what we partake in mystery fully and truly.

text: Pastis Domine divino libamine visceribus gratiae tuae cernuo vultu imploramus auxilium ut interveniente beato Maximo confessore tuo finito cum victoria certamine carnali in caelesti regione mereamur adscribi.
translation_en: With a divine pasty, O Lord, I perceive the grace within my inner self. We implore your face for help, that through the intervention of the blessed Maximus, your confessor, having finished the carnal contest victoriously in the heavenly realm, we may be worthy to be added.

text: Pateant aures misericordiae tuae Domine precibus supplicantium et ut petentibus desiderata concedas fac tibi eos quae sunt placita postulare.
translation_en: Let the ears of your mercy, Lord, be open to the prayers of those who are supplicating, and grant the desires of those who ask, make them to seek what is pleasing before you.

text: Pateant aures misericordiae tuae quaesumus Domine precibus supplicantis indigni et cui fiduciam sperandae pietatis indulges optatae misericordiae praesta benignus effectum.
translation_en: Let your ears be open to our supplications, we ask you, Lord. Indulge us, unworthy as we are, with the trust in hoped-for mercy and grant the effect of desired mercy.

text: Paternis intercessionibus magnifici pastoris Benedicti quaesumus familiae tuae omnipotens Deus commendetur oblatio cuius vitalibus decoratur exemplis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, through the intercessions of your glorious shepherd Benedict, to commit this offering to your family. May it be adorned with the living examples of him.

text: Patientia pretiosa iustorum tuae nobis Domine quaesumus affectum dilectionis accumulet et in cordibus nostris sacrae fidei semper exerceat firmitatem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your precious patience may accumulate the effect of love within us and always exercise the firmness of sacred faith in our hearts.

text: Pax aeterna Domine Deus noster pacis nobis copiam placatus concede atque fructu laetitiae sempiternae irradia et famulis tuis omnibus fidelibus defunctis pro quibus hodie hanc tibi hostiam immolantes offerimus consolationis tuae beneficia conferas nostrorumque omnium peccata deleas et pacis concordiam nobis attribuas.
translation_en: Eternal peace, Lord our God of peace, we ask that you bestow upon us the abundance and grant us your placation. Radiate upon us eternal joy and irradiate it to all your faithful servants who have departed. For those whom today we offer this sacrifice for, may you confer your benefits of consolation. May you forgive our sins and give us peace's harmony.

text: Pax aeterna et pacis vinculum Christe qui pacem quam nos voluisti observare in terris hanc ad patrem remeans a quo numquam discesseras tuis reliquisti et commendasti discipulis donum Sancti Spiritus infunde quaesumus in visceribus nostris quo in nobis residente usquequaque lis pereat et discordiae vitium evanescat dolus recedat ira diffugiat et caritas totum quod nostri est in aeternum possideat ut a discidiis eruti et in pace perenniter radicati subdoli non timeamus insidias inimici quatenus duorum mandatorum praecepta Dei videlicet et proximi dilectionem servantes ad conspectum gloriae tuae quandoque mereamur pervenire felices ut apostoli tui Bartholomaei precibus tali dono clariores effecti pacis tuae muneribus efficiamur beati.
translation_en: Eternal peace and the bond of peace, Christ, who wanted to observe the peace that you yourself have remained with the Father from whom you never departed, and committed to your disciples the gift of the Holy Spirit. We ask that it may be infused into our innermost being, so that everywhere there is strife may cease and the evil of discord vanishes, deception recedes, anger disappears, and charity possesses all that is ours for eternity. May we be freed from discords and rooted in peace forever, so that we are not afraid of the cunning plots of our enemies, until we serve the two commandments of God, namely love for our neighbor, so that we may deserve to reach your glory happily, just like your apostle Bartholomew, made brighter by this gift, may we become effective in your peace offerings, and be blessed.

text: Pax indeficiens Christe et origo dulcedinis qui pacem tuam tuis tradidisti discipulis dignare hanc plenissimam effundere pectoribus nostris ut non sicut mundus dat pacem pacifici conversantes mandata tua aut per odium aut per oblivionem relinquamus sed in dilectione Dei et proximi radicati in observatione mandatorum tuorum mereamur inveniri perfecti ut pacis osculum inter nos decurrens nos pacificos reddat et per pacem ad te venire sine crimine faciat.  Dulcedo pacis odii in nobis amaritudinem vincat et caritas multitudinem peccatorum operiat ut pax tua quae tu ipse es exsuperans omnem sensum totius simultatis in nobis perimat vitium et timorem foris mittentis caritatis conferat gaudium ut precibus apostolorum tuorum et martyrum in pace perenniter custoditi per pacis concordiam habeamur beati.
translation_en: An endless peace, Christ, and the source of sweetness, who gave your peace to your disciples, deign to pour out this fullest upon our hearts so that we do not, like the world, leave your commands behind either through hatred or forgetfulness, but rooted in the love of God and neighbor, strive to fulfill your commands and may the kiss of peace between us make us peaceful. May the sweetness of peace conquer the bitterness of hate within us, and may charity overcome the multitude of sins so that your peace, which is you above all understanding, fills us with vice and fear, and the joy of charity sent forth gives us joy as we are constantly guarded by the prayers of your apostles and martyrs through the harmony of peace. May we be blessed through the peace agreement.

text: Pax indiscissa et praemium pacis aeternae Deus qui et pacem angelis aeterno foedere collocasti et ad huius participium pervenire aditum etiam hominibus praebuisti dona nobis servis tuis et pacem temporis sequi et pacem aeternitatis habere ut dum in pacis voto transeunt tempora in pacis regno conquiratur possessio sempiterna.
translation_en: Peace indivisible and reward of eternal peace, God who not only placed peace among the angels through an eternal covenant but also provided access to this participation even for humans. Grant us, your servants, to follow peace in these times and to possess peace in eternity. So that as we traverse temporal times with a vow of peace, the eternal possession may be obtained in the kingdom of peace.

text: Pax nostra omnipotens Christe sincerae nobis osculum pacis attribue ut non cum Iuda proditore rei sed tuae mereamur pacis haberi discipuli.
translation_en: May our almighty Christ grant us a sincere kiss of peace, so that we may deserve to have peace not as the Jews with the traitor Judas, but as his disciples.

text: Pax omnium Christe et cunctorum te diligentium caritas pura simultatum quaesumus radices a nobis abscide nosque perenniter in tua pace consolida. Fac nos te amare in veritate. Fac tua sequentes et servantes praecepta. Odiorum vincula solve. Lites remove. Discordiam fuga. Dissidia pelle et quidquid perimit pacem procul a nobis propitius effuge.  Pacem quam tuis discipulis commendasti in terris hanc infundere nostris dignare pectoribus. Pax quam abs te traditam sanctus iste tuus Matthaeus apostolus et evangelista personavit in mundo nos tibi consignans consortes eidem facias in regno superno. Fidelium tuorum nullus per discordiam pereat eorumque odium perimendo nullum possideat sed ita omnes inviolabiliter in tua pace vivamus ut ad te post coronandi cum sanctis omnibus veniamus et ita pacis osculum demus ad invicem ut non fictam teneamus in cordibus caritatem ut aeterni regni mereamur apud te consequi mansionem.
translation_en:
May Christ bring peace to all, and the pure love of those who diligently seek Him unite us forever in His peace. Make us love Him in truth. Make those who follow and serve Your commandments free from bonds. Break apart our disputes. Flee discord, avoid strife, and anything that disturbs peace keep far from us graciously.
Pour the peace You commanded to Your disciples on earth into our hearts. The peace You gave, which the holy one, Your disciple Matthew, apostle and evangelist, demonstrated in the world by entrusting himself to You, make us partakers of in the heavenly kingdom.
Let no faithful one among them perish because of discord, and let no hatred among them possess anything, but rather may we all live inviolably in Your peace so that we come to You crowned with saints after receiving a crown, and thus may we exchange a kiss of peace between us as we do not hold a false love in our hearts but earn the right to inhabit the eternal kingdom with You.

text: Pax omnium Domine Iesu Christe ad quem pervenientes tranquillitatem et a quo recedentes invenimus malorum nostrorum molestissimam tempestatem quaesumus propellatur a nobis osculum Iudae traditoris et conferatur pax quam ceteris discipulis commendavit praeceptio tuae institutionis ut dum nos in hac peregrinatione pacificos conspicit ecclesia caelestis laudes pietatis tuae persolvens sociari nos congaudeat collegio suae beatitudinis infinitae.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, to whom we come we find tranquility, and from whom we depart we encounter the most distressing storm of our sins. We humbly ask that the kiss of Judas the traitor be driven away from us, and that peace which you commanded to bestow upon your other disciples according to your instruction's precept, may be granted to us, so that as we journey through this life, the church in heaven may gaze upon us with peaceful praise and fulfillment of your piety, and may grant us fellowship in its infinite beatitude.

text: Pax superna quae exsuperas omnem sensum pax quae emissa de excelsis pacificasti cuncta in terris et in caelis discordantium remove furorem dissidentium repelle rancorem insidiantium disturba cogitationes atque ita omnes in una contrahe pace ut omnes sopito rixarum stimulo digne se interserant sollemnitatis praesentis gaudio crudumque simultatis crapulam dolumue reminiscendo ita horreant erubescendo ne repetant iterando quatenus paci tuae perpetim inhaerendo in te qui es finis et pax omnium permaneant perenniter habitando.
translation_en: A superior peace that surpasses all understanding, a peace that was sent forth from the heights and reconciled all things on earth and in heaven, driving away the madness of those who disagree, repelling anger, disturbing malicious thoughts, and thus bringing all together in one peace so that all may worthily intermingle with the joy of the present solemnity, shunning the crude revelry or cunning scheming so as to abhor and blush lest they repeat it again until they perennially cling to your eternal peace and remain as the end and peace of all while dwelling.

text: Pax tua Christe redemptor ac Deus noster quae te nascente olim proclamata est ab angelis habitet poscimus in mentibus nostris quo eius fulti praesidiis mereamur cum veneris tuae contueri praesentiam visionis.
translation_en: May your peace, Christ Redeemer and our God, which was proclaimed by angels at your birth, dwell in our minds. We ask that we may be worthy of his protection when we behold your presence on the day of vision.

text: Pax tua Deus omnipotens quae exsuperat omnem sensum et corda nostra et corpora ea incolumitate custodiat ut in conspectu tremendae maiestatis tuae cum iudex adveneris cunctorum nihil in nobis aut parvum reperiatur aut dissonum quod examinis tui vultum reddat alienum sed praesentium ope sanctorum felicissima pacis quiete potiti in superna Ierusalem electis tuis virtutibusque caelorum mereamur uniri.
translation_en: Your peace, Almighty God, which exceeds all understanding and our hearts and bodies, may keep us safe so that before the terrible majesty of yours when the judge comes for all, nothing small or discordant may be found in us or foreign to your scrutiny's face. But rather, through the help of the saints, we may be worthy of enjoying the most blessed peace in heavenly Jerusalem, chosen by your virtues and powers of heaven.

text: Peccata nostra separant inter nos et te Deus pacis tuae deliciis ne fruamur. Ipsis ergo concitum pone finem quibus a tua cogitemus deserere servitutem. Vitam corrigis nostram ut ostendas super nos misericordiam tuam quo reconciliatis tibi per pacis bonum caelestium tribuas copiam pluviarum.
translation_en: Our sins separate us from you, God of peace, that we may not enjoy your delights. Therefore, arouse the repentance in us by which we remember to forsake your servitude. Correct our life so as to show us your mercy, whereby you reconcile us through the good of celestial peace, and grant us an abundance of heavenly rainfalls.

text: Peccata nostra Domine propitiatus absolve et quidquid pro peccatis meremur miseratus averte.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy, and forgive our sins, for we have deserved it by your mercy, turn away what we deserve because of our sins.

text: Peccata nostra Domine quaesumus memor humanae condicionis absolve et quidquid eorum retributione meremur averte.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you forgive our sins, mindful of human condition. And turn away from us whatever we deserve to be repaid for.

text: Peccata nostra Domine quibus impugnamur virtute sanctae crucis expelle et tua miseratione nos ab omni adversitate defende.
translation_en: Lord, drive away our sins for which we are assaulted by the power of the holy cross and defend us from all adversity with your mercy.

text: Peccatorum nostrorum Domine multitudine praevalente ad sanctorum tuorum recurrimus singulare suffragium per eos tuam misericordiam deprecantes quorum nos voluisti patrociniis adiuvari.
translation_en: Lord, overwhelmed by our sins, we turn to your saints in particular, beseeching their intercession through your mercy; for you willed to help us with their patronage.

text: Peccavimus tibi omnipotens et misericors Deus; remedium non habemus nisi miserearis nobis tuorum deprecatione sanctorum.
translation_en: We have sinned before You, Almighty and merciful God; we have no remedy unless You have mercy on us through the intercession of Your saints.

text: Pectoribus insere nostris Domine amorem tui nominis benigneque suscipias sacramenta quae sumpsimus intercedente beato Ethelberto pro nobis ut a pravis cogitationibus mundemur in mente.
translation_en: Lord, let your love be engraved in our hearts. Graciously receive the sacraments we have received, through the intercession of blessed Ethelberto. May he cleanse us from evil thoughts and purify our minds.

text: Pelle Domine a corde nostro scandalum et oblatum tibi huius ieiunii nostri suscipe sacrificium quo emundati delictis horum sacramentorum perceptione et parsimoniae apud te invenire mereamur mercedem et virtutum spiritalium consequi dignitatem.
translation_en: Lord, remove from our heart scandal and that which has been offered to you in this fasting; may you receive the sacrifice by which we may deserve to find mercy and worthiness of spiritual rewards through the cleansing of these sacraments' indulgences and parsimony at your presence.

text: Per haec nos munera oblata Domine quaesumus a peccatorum nostrorum maculis emunda actus nostros clementer corrige vitam emenda mores compone atque in viam salutis aeternae nos misericorditer dirige.
translation_en: Through these gifts presented to You, Lord, we humbly ask that You cleanse us from the stains of our sins, gently correct our actions, amend our life, shape our character, and mercifully guide us on the path to eternal salvation.

text: Per haec Domine dona praesentia beata virgo Genovefa tibi nos reddat acceptos et ab ignibus aeternis intactos tibi nos reconsignet lumini tuae claritatis oblatos.
translation_en: Through these, Lord, may the blessed Virgin Genovefa present us to you as accepted, and may she return us unharmed from eternal fires to your light's brightness, offered to you.

text: Per haec mysteria quaesumus Domine quae in commemoratione apostoli tui Bartholomaei offerimus illo interveniente a cunctis purgemur offensis.
translation_en: Through these mysteries we humbly ask you, Lord, that which we offer in remembrance of your apostle Bartholomew, may he intercede for us, so that we may be purified from all offenses by him.

text: Per haec redemptionis humanae sacrosancta mysteria nobis quaesumus Domine caelestis gratiae benedictionem infunde ut conceptionis eius gloriosa sollemnitas famulis tuis ad salutem prosit aeternam quae sine viro virgo concepit et mundo peperit lucem et vitam.
translation_en: Through these sacred mysteries of the human redemption, we humbly ask you, Lord, to pour out on us the blessing of celestial grace. May the glorious solemnity of his conception benefit your servants eternally, who without a man conceived and brought forth light and life into the world.

text: Per haec sacramenta Domine quae sumpsimus et per intercessionem sancti pontificis tui Ricardi cuius translationis diem devote celebramus te supplices deprecamur ut ipsius meritis et intercessione a tenebris huius vitae ad lucem perpetuam nos transferre digneris.
translation_en: Through these sacraments, Lord, that we have received and through the intercession of your holy pontiff Richard whose translation day we devoutly celebrate, we humbly pray to you that, by his merits and intercession, you may deem fit to transfer us from the shadows of this life to eternal light.

text: Per haec sacramenta paschalia nos tibi clementissime Deus beatae Mariae semper virginis oratio conciliet quae nobis panem angelorum et caelestem alimoniam generavit.
translation_en: Through these Paschal sacraments, most merciful God, may the prayer of the Blessed Virgin Mary, who has generated for us the bread of angels and heavenly nourishment, be reconciled to us.

text: Per haec sacrosancta commercia quaesumus Domine ab omni pravitate et adversitate nos clementer defende atque tuarum dono virtutum exuberare concede quo corpore semper muniti et mente tuam consequi valeamus propinationem.
translation_en: Through these sacred transactions, we humbly ask you, Lord, to protect us kindly from all wickedness and adversity. And grant that we may always be fortified with your gifts of virtues, so that we can worthily follow your path with our body and mind.

text: Per haec veniat quaesumus Domine sacramenta nostrae redemptionis effectus qui nos et ab humanis retrahat semper excessibus et ad salutaria cuncta perducat.
translation_en: Through these (sacraments), we humbly ask, Lord, that the effects of our redemption may come upon us. May they always draw us away from excessive human matters and lead us to all things salvific.

text: Per hanc devotionis oblationem quam pro innumerabilium martyrum tuorum Caesaraugustanorum plebs tua tibi Domine offert petimus maiestatem tuam ut sicut illis tribuis remunerationis gloriam ita nobis peccatoribus indulgentiae largiaris et praemium.
translation_en: Through this offering of devotion that your people, the Caesaraugustanum multitude, presents to you, Lord, we ask your majesty to grant us, just as you gave rewarding glory to those martyrs, likewise bestow mercy upon us sinners and award grace.

text: Per hanc sacrosancti libaminis sanctificationem salvati quaesumus Domine ut beati Ambrosii precibus ad veram sapientiam perducas nos clemens et propitius.
translation_en: Through the sacred incense's sanctification, we humbly ask you, Lord, that you lead us graciously and mercifully through the prayers of the blessed Ambrose to true wisdom.

text: Per has oblationes quaesumus Domine non tantum oculis nostris imbrem lacrimarum infundas sed et cordibus nostris nimium peccatorum luctum tribuas.
translation_en: Through these offerings, we humbly ask, Lord, not only to pour upon our eyes the rain of tears but also to overwhelm our hearts with too much sorrow for sins.

text: Per hoc admirabile sacramentum tuam Domine humiliter immensam exoramus pietatem ut illam quae in sancto Urbano martyre tuo flagravit fortem dilectionem nobis benignus adspires.
translation_en: Through this admirable sacrament, we humbly entreat Your immense mercy, Lord, that You may inspire in us the strong love shown by Saint Urban your martyr.

text: Per hoc quaesumus Domine sacrificium quod tuae obtulimus pietati ab omnibus cor nostrum emunda temptationibus.
translation_en: Through this, we humbly ask you, Lord, that the sacrifice which we have offered to your piety may cleanse our hearts from all temptations.

text: Per hoc sumptum sacrificium concede nobis quaesumus Domine tui amoris affectum ut huius mundi desideria per tua sancta mereamur superare iuvamina.
translation_en: Through this offered sacrifice, we humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us your affection of love that we may overcome the desires of this world through your holy aid.

text: Per huius Domine operationem mysterii et vitia nostra purgentur et iusta desideria impleantur.
translation_en: Through the operation of this Lord, our sins are purged and righteous desires are fulfilled.

text: Per huius Domine virtutem mysterii tuae nos claritatis perpetuus splendor illustret et cum consubstantiali tibi filio Spiritus Sanctus illuminet.
translation_en: By the power of your, Lord, may the eternal radiance of your mystery shine upon us, and with your consubstantial Son, may the Holy Spirit enlighten us.

text: Per huius quaeso Domine Deus oblationis virtutem peccatorum meorum vincula disrumpe et quidquid poenarum merui propitiatus averte.
translation_en: By this, I humbly ask, Lord God, may the power of this offering break the bonds of my sins and turn away whatever penalty I have earned.

text: Per huius sacramenti mysterium atque virtutem quaesumus Domine Deus noster omnipotens sanctissima Dei Genitrice semperque virgine Maria et beatis omnibus caelestibus virtutibus sanctis quoque patriarchis prophetis apostolis evangelistis martyribus confessoribus et virginibus atque omnibus simul sanctis tuis intercedentibus vitiorum nostrorum maculae deleantur et preces nostrae in conspectu maiestatis tuae acceptabiles inveniantur populusque tuus a peccatis et hostibus liberetur fidei rectitudine roboretur hostiumque nostrorum superbia et fortitudo prosternantur pestilentiae et fames procul pellantur bona nobis facientes gratiae tuae abundantia repleantur discordantes in fraternam pacem revocentur defuncti nostri requiem consequantur et omnes fideles tui vitam aeternam adipisci mereantur.
translation_en: Through the mystery and power of this sacrament, we humbly ask you, Lord God Almighty, that the most holy Mother of God, the ever-virgin Mary, and all the blessed celestial virtues, the holy patriarchs, prophets, apostles, evangelists, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all your saints interceding for us, may the stains of our sins be removed. May our prayers be found acceptable in your majesty's sight, and may your people be freed from sins and enemies, strengthened by faith, humbled by the pride and strength of our foes, distant pestilence and famine driven away. May good things be plentiful due to your grace, discordances be turned into brotherly peace, departed souls find rest, and all your faithful merit an eternal life.

text: Per huius virtutem mysterii et vitia nostra purgentur et intercedente beata virgine Dei Genitrice Maria candidatu virtutum decorati gloriam aeternam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Through the power of this mystery, our vices will be purged and with the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mother of God, we shall merit to adorn ourselves with virtue and obtain eternal glory.

text: Per hunc te Deus Pater omnipotens deprecamur ut sicut sacri mysterii oboeditione retinemus ita ad tutelam nostram caelestis virtus operetur.
translation_en: Through you, God the Almighty Father, we humbly entreat that just as we maintain obedience to the sacred mystery, so may celestial power operate for our protection.

text: Per studium caritatis non fictae et intercessione beatissimi confessoris tui et episcopi illius tuere quaesumus Domine familiam tuam et per dilectionis vinculum spiritalibus instrue disciplinis.
translation_en: Through the study of true charity and the intercession of your most blessed confessor and bishop, we ask, Lord, that you protect your family. And by the bond of love, strengthen them with spiritual discipline.
