text: Peractis sollemniter Domine quae pro apostolorum tuorum beata celebravimus passione ipsorum quaesumus nobis fiant intercessione salutaria in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter impensa.
translation_en: Having completed solemnly, Lord, the feast we celebrated with blessedness for Your apostles in their passion, we humbly ask that through their intercession it may be beneficial for us on the days of their birth, when their natal festivities are exultantly spent.

text: Percepimus Domine gloriosa mysteria quibus in terris positos iam caelestium facis esse consortes; tu inter ista quae vivimus guberna nos Domine quaesumus ut ad illa perducas.
translation_en: We have perceived, Lord, the glorious mysteries whereby you make those on earth participants of heavenly affairs; you who govern these things that we live, we ask you, Lord, to guide us to those same [mysteries].

text: Percepta Domine communio singularis animae famuli tui illius sit semper salutaris; sit ei Domine salutare remedium qui in hoc loco divini servitii praeparavit obsequium et nobis famulis tuis temporale subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, may the communion of this singular soul, your servant's, be always healthful; may it be a saving remedy for him who in this place has prepared obedience for the divine service. And may it be a temporal support for us, your servants.

text: Percepta Domine sacramenta suam in nobis operentur virtutem et sanctorum nos tueatur intercessio martyrum quorum sancta in omni laude festivitas instat digna.
translation_en: Lord, may your sacraments work their power within us and protect us through the intercession of the saints, especially the martyrs, whose holy feast day is celebrated with great praise and worthy honor in every laud.

text: Percepta Domine sancta nos adiuvent et suis repleam institutis.
translation_en: Lord, let holy things be presented to us and fill us with your teachings.

text: Percepta mysteria quaesumus Domine et eruditione nos instruant et participatione restaurent ut ad spiritalia mereamur munera pervenire.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that the mysteries be made known to us and may our education enlighten us, and participation restore us, so that we may deserve to reach spiritual rewards.

text: Percepta nobis Domine praebeant tua sacramenta subsidium ut et tibi grata sint nostra ieiunia et nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Lord, your sacraments as support, so that our fasting may please you and our observance of them bring us healing.

text: Perceptis Domine caelestibus sacramentis gratias agimus pio nomini tuo qui et sanctorum nos assidua festivitate comitatis et divino munere vivificare non desinis.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, Lord, with celestial sacraments, in your holy name, who continually accompany us with the constant feast of the saints and never cease to revive us by divine grace.

text: Perceptis Domine Deus sacramentorum tuorum mysteriis praesta quaesumus ut beato Petro principe apostolorum intercedente nos aeternae beatitudinis dignos efficiant.
translation_en: Having perceived, Lord God, Your mysteries of the sacred sacraments, we humbly ask that through the intercession of blessed Peter, the prince of the apostles, You may make us worthy of eternal beatitude.

text: Perceptis Domine muneribus gratias exhibentes quaesumus ut beati martyres tui Christophorus et Cucufas sint pro nobis intercessores perpetui.
translation_en: Having received the offerings, O Lord, we express our thanks. We humbly ask that your blessed martyrs Christopher and Cucuphates may be perpetual intercessors for us.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis subdito corde rogamus et petimus ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis tuis nobis proficiant ad medelam quae pro illorum gesta sunt passione.
translation_en: Having received the sacred mysteries, we humbly ask and beseech You, O Lord, that through the intercession of Your blessed apostles, we may be assisted towards the remedy which was provided for them because of their Passion.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis subdito corde rogamus et petimus ut intercedente beato Paulo apostolo tuo nobis proficiant ad medelam quae pro illius gesta sunt passione.
translation_en: We, who have been touched by the sacred mysteries, humbly ask and plead to you, Lord. With blessed Paul the Apostle interceding for us, we pray that we may be aided through the healing which is associated with his suffering and passion.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis subdito corde rogamus et petimus ut intervenientibus beatis apostolis quae pro eorum celebrata sunt gloria nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Perceiving the sacred mysteries, we, a humble heart entreat and beseech you, Lord, that with the intervention of the blessed apostles, the glory they achieved may benefit us as a remedy.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis beatis apostolis intervenientibus deprecamur ut quae pro illorum celebrata sunt gloria nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, having perceived the sacred mysteries through the intervention of the blessed apostles, that what was profitable for their glory may also be beneficial for our healing.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis beato Matthaeo apostolo tuo et evangelista interveniente deprecamur ut quae pro eius celebrata sunt gloria nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, having perceived the sacred mysteries through your apostle and evangelist blessed Matthew, that what has been celebrated for his glory may profit us towards salvation.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis supplices te rogamus ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis quae pro illorum veneranda gerimus passione nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Hear us, Lord, as we perceive Your sacred mysteries; humbly we ask You that through the intercession of the blessed apostles, who suffered for their revered cause, may it benefit us towards healing in honor of what they endured.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis suppliciter rogamus ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis tuis quae pro illorum veneranda gerimus passione nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Perceiving, Lord, Your sacred mysteries, we humbly ask that through the intercession of Your blessed apostles, who suffer for them with reverence, may those merits that came from their venerable passion profit us as a remedy.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis suppliciter exoramus ut intercedente beato Andrea apostolo tuo quae pro illius veneranda gerimus passione nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, having received the sacred mysteries, we humbly entreat you that, through the intercession of Blessed Apostle Andrew, what we carry out in honor of his venerable passion may benefit us with healing.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis suppliciter rogamus ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis tuis quae pro illorum veneranda gerimus passione nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Lord, having perceived the sacraments, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your blessed apostles, the benefits derived from their revered passion may be effective for our healing.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis suppliciter exoramus ut intercedente beato illo apostolo tuo quae pro illius veneranda gerimus sollemnitate nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: Having received, Lord, Your sacred mysteries, we humbly beseech You, through the intercession of that blessed Apostle of Yours, may those things which we perform in his venerable solemnity profit us for healing.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis suppliciter te rogamus ut intercedentibus beatissimis apostolis tuis Petro et Paulo quae pro illorum veneranda gerimus passione nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Perceiving, Lord, Your sacraments, we humbly beseech You that, through the intercession of Your most blessed apostles Peter and Paul, what we do for their venerable passion may profit us for our salvation.

text: Perceptis Domine Deus noster sacramentis salutaribus humiliter te deprecamur ut intercedente beato Benedicto abbate quae pro illius venerando agimus obitu nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Having received the sacred and saving sacraments, we humbly beseech you, Lord our God, that through the intercession of Blessed Benedict, abbot, those things which we do in his venerated memory may benefit us for our salvation.

text: Perceptis salutaribus sacramentis humiliter te Domine deprecamur ut intercedente beato Andrea apostolo tuo quae pro illius veneranda egimus sollemnitate nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: With salutary sacraments, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that through the intercession of blessed Andrew your apostle, what we have made on his venerable solemnity may profit us for our salvation.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis te suppliciter imploramus ut quae in veneratione beatae Wenefredae virginis et martyris tuae devotione tibi obtulimus gaudia nobis conferant sempiterna.
translation_en: Hearkening to your sacred sacraments, we humbly implore you that what we have offered in the veneration of blessed Winefride, virgin and martyr, may your devotion grant us eternal joy.

text: Perceptis Domine sacramentis tua nos non deserat pietas qui(a) in confessione sanctae Trinitatis nos credimus esse salvandos.
translation_en: Lord, having perceived your sacraments, we believe that the kindness that saves us in the confession of the holy Trinity does not abandon us.

text: Perceptis Domine salutaribus alimentis quaesumus ut intercedente beata Petronilla virgine tua per haec proficere ad gaudia mereamur aeterna.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, with grateful reception of your salutary food, that through the intercession of blessed Petronilla, your virgin, we may progress to eternal joys and deserve it.

text: Perceptis quaesumus Domine corporis et sanguinis tui sacramentis intercedente beato martyre tuo Edwardo ab omni purgemur macula delictorum.
translation_en: We entreat you, Lord, that we may be purified from all the stain of our sins through the intercession of your blessed martyr Edward, by perceiving Your sacraments of body and blood.

text: Perceptis tui corporis et sanguinis Domine sacramentis concede nobis supplicante beato Benedicto confessore tuo ita muniri ut et temporalibus abundemus commodis et fulciamur aeternis.
translation_en: Lord, having perceived Your body and blood through the sacred sacraments, grant us, who beseech You through blessed Benedict, Your confessor, that we may be fortified in such a way that we may abound in temporal goods and be strengthened by eternal ones.

text: Percepto Domine tui corporis et sanguinis sacramento concede nobis quaesumus supplicante beato Lamberto martyre tuo atque pontifice ita muniri ut et temporalibus relevemur commodis et abundemus aeternis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, your sacrament of body and blood, grant us humbly beseeching blessed Lambert, your martyr and pope, to be armed in such a way that we may be relieved from temporal comforts and abound in eternal blessings.

text: Percipiat Domine quaesumus plebs tua intercedente beato Quintino martyre tuo misericordiam quam deposcit ut tuis semper digna inveniatur sacramentis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your people receive your mercy, interceded by the blessed martyr Quintinus, that they may always be worthy of finding grace in your sacraments.

text: Percipiat Domine quaesumus populus tuus misericordiam quam deposcit et quam precatur humiliter indulgentiam consequatur et pacem.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your people may receive mercy which they seek and for which they pray fervently, so that they might obtain forgiveness and peace.

text: Percipiat quaesumus Domine plebs tua beati martyris tui Kenelmi natalicia celebrando cum exsultatione laetitiam et quam mensae caelestis refecisti convivio aeternitatis tuae facias adscribi consortio.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your people, the congregation of your blessed martyr Kenelm, may celebrate his natalicia with exultation and joy, as the feast of heaven's table that you have prepared for eternity. Let this rejoicing be attributed to the fellowship of your eternal consortium.

text: Percipientes Domine gloriosa mysteria referimus gratias quod in terris positos iam caelestium praestas esse participes.
translation_en: Receiving, Lord, the glorious mysteries, we give thanks that on earth you make us participants of celestial things.

text: Percipientes Domine munera salutis aeternae te supplices exoramus ut templum hoc (vel coemeterium) a barbarorum (vel iniquorum) inquinamentis emundatum tua benedictione maneat sanctificatum et pectora nostra ab omni sorde vitiorum aliena tibi semper assistant devota.
translation_en: Receiving, Lord, the gifts of eternal salvation, we humbly ask you that this temple (or cemetery) may be purified by your blessing from the defilements of barbarians (or wicked ones), and that it remains sanctified. May our hearts be cleansed from all stain of sin, always devoted to you.

text: Perfecta ingeniti sapientia patris mentibus illabere caecis salutiferumque saporem sensibus infunde pusillis ut quidquid in litteris veteris legis arcanum quidquid humanitati tuae in illis congruum sed necdum nostrae est ignorantiae revelatum contemnendo quod offendimus et condonando quod quaerimus edocti per Spiritum Sanctum scire et perfrui tibique soli de tuo munere placere protinus mereamur.
translation_en: May the perfect wisdom of the Father penetrate the blind minds, and may it infuse a saving taste on our modest senses, so that whatever in the ancient law is hidden and whatever in them agrees with your humanity but has not yet been revealed to our ignorance, we may despise what offends us and forgive what we seek, taught by the Holy Spirit, to know and enjoy immediately and thus deserve to please You alone with Your gift. Then we shall immediately merit it.

text: Perfecta ingeniti sapientia patris mentibus caelesti munere illabere nostris contemnendo quod offendimus et condonando te inspirante quod quaerimus.  Abscide quaesumus cordium nostrorum auriumque praeputia qui pro nobis dignatus es infantiae gestare crepundia ut quod in tua carne secundum legis litteram fieri circumcisione voluisti corporea id nostrae saluti competenter impendens ab omni superstitione voluptatum absterge nostra praecordia.  Lac tuum nutriat parvulos qui fieri dignatus es pro nostra redemptione pusillus ut sicut in te cum ista praestares nullum sensit omnipotentia detrimentum ita et fides nostra tuo munere confortata nullum patiatur aliquando defectum sed ad solidum gratiae tuae perveniat fundamentum.
translation_en:
Perfect wisdom of the Father, bestow as a celestial gift on our minds, that we may reject what offends and forgive what we seek.
We humbly ask You to cut away the foreskins and ears of our hearts, who were worthy to bear for us the swaddling clothes of infancy, so that what in Your flesh, according to the letter of the law, You wanted to be fulfilled by circumcision, may properly be bestowed upon our salvation.
May Your milk nourish the little ones who have been deemed worthy for our redemption, so that just as You did not feel any diminishment of omnipotence when You provided this, so also our faith, strengthened by Your gift, may never suffer any defect but may reach a solid foundation of Your grace.

text: Perfice Domine benignus in nobis observantiae sanctae subsidium ut quae te auctore facienda cognovimus te operante impleamus.
translation_en: Lord, may your gracious regard support us in the performance of holy observances, so that we may fulfill what we have learned to do with you as our author.

text: Perfice Domine benignus in nobis paschalium munerum votiva commercia ut a terrenis affectibus ad caeleste desiderium transferamur.
translation_en: Lord, make us blessed with the gracious offering of the Paschal mysteries. May our devout exchanges transform us from earthly desires to heavenly longing.

text: Perfice Domine misericordias tuas populo supplicanti quem tuorum largitate donorum et instantius gratiam postulare maiorem et fiducialius sperare concedas.
translation_en: Lord, may your mercies be bestowed upon the supplicating people, whom you provide with gifts through your generosity. Grant us a more urgent grace and allow us to hope more confidently.

text: Perfice Domine misericordiam tuam populo supplicanti quem tuorum refectum largitate donorum et instantius gratiam postulare maiorem et fiducialius sperare concedas.
translation_en: Lord, grant your mercy to the supplicating people whom you have refreshed with the generosity of your gifts. May we ask for a greater grace more urgently and trust more confidently that it will be given.

text: Perfice Domine quaesumus in nobis ut quae sacris mysteriis profitemur piis actionibus exsequamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that within us, you perfect what we profess in the sacred mysteries, so that we may carry out our holy actions.

text: Perfice Domine votiva mysteria et quae in martyrum veneratione te praedicant suffragia nobis perpetuae redemptionis exsistant.
translation_en: Lord, fulfill our vows and the prayers that proclaim your help in the veneration of martyrs may exist for us as an eternal redemption.

text: Perfice in nobis quaesumus Domine gratiam tuam qui iusti Simeonis exspectationem implesti ut sicut ille mortem non vidit priusquam Christum Dominum videre mereretur ita et nos vitam obtineamus aeternam.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask You, Lord, Your grace, who fulfilled the expectation of just Simeon, that just as he did not see death before he deserved to behold Christ the Lord, so also may we obtain eternal life.

text: Perfice nobis Domine fructum gratulationis hodiernae ut precibus beati Laurentii martyris tui eius natalicia votiva praecurrens perfectis gaudiis expleatur oblatio.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the fruit of today's rejoicing, that the votive offerings preceding the feast day of Your blessed martyr Laurence may be fulfilled with complete joy.

text: Perficiant in nobis Domine quaesumus tua sacramenta quae continent ut quae nunc specie gerimus rerum veritate capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, that your sacraments may be completed within us, which contain the fact that what we now hold in appearance, we may take in truth of things.

text: Perfunde Domine spiritu tuo sancto supplicantis tibi populi praesentem oblationem et preces nostras suffragantibus martyrum tuorum meritis ad sublimissimam honoris tui sedem deferri tua dignatione concede.
translation_en: Lord, pour out your holy Spirit upon the people who are supplicating to you, and present this offering before you. Grant that our prayers, supported by the merits of your martyrs, may be lifted up to the most exalted seat of your honor by your kindness.

text: Perpetua Domine pace custodi quos in te sperare donasti.
translation_en: Lord, perpetually keep those whom you have given to hope in You in peace.

text: Perpetua quaesumus Domine pace custodi quos per lignum sanctae crucis redimere dignatus es.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you keep perpetually those whom you have deemed worthy to redeem through the holy wood of the cross with peace.

text: Perpetuis nos Domine sanctorum tuere praesidiis et quanto fragiliores sumus tanto magis necessariis attolle suffragiis.
translation_en: Lord, keep us forever among the saints with your protecting guardians, and the more frail we are, the more support us with your prayers.

text: Perpetuis nos Domine sancti Ioannis Baptistae tuere praesidiis et quanto fragiliores sumus tanto magis necessariis attolle suffragiis.
translation_en: Lord, may Saint John the Baptist perpetually protect us with his guardianship and may we who are so frail be all the more supported by his intercessions.

text: Perpetuo Deus Ecclesiam tuam pio favore tuere ut paschalibus resuscitata mysteriis ad resurrectionis perveniat claritatem.
translation_en: May God forever keep your church under his loving care, so that through the mysteries of the Paschal resurrection it may attain to the brightness of resurrection.

text: Perpetuo Domine favore prosequere quos reficis divino mysterio et quos imbuisti caelestibus institutis salutaribus comitare solatiis.
translation_en: Lord, may Your favor perpetually accompany those whom You are refreshing through the divine mystery, and those You have adorned with heavenly salvific institutions, to lead them in consolations.

text: Perpetuum nobis Domine tuae miserationis praesta subsidium quibus et angelica praestitisti suffragia non deesse.
translation_en: Lord, grant us your perpetual mercy and provide support to us, for whom you did not let the prayers of angels fail.

text: Perspicuum excelse Deus triumphum Cypriani beatissimi martyris tui hodierno die votis attollimus sacrificiis honoramus qui dominico commissoque sibi gregi in suprema iam passione pius pastor relicturus exemplum bis denis temporalem comparavit aureis mortem sanguine potius malens subditis quam verbo scribere quae doceret.  Te proinde in hac eius festivitate rogamus ut qui eum contemptu mortis fecisti esse felicem feliciores nos efficias actu beatae vitae quo omnia quae de eius virtutibus admiranda cognovimus effectu operis impleamus.
translation_en:
On this day, we raise our vows in a clear manner to the exalted God for the triumph of Your most blessed martyr Cyprian. We honor him with offerings, who as a pious shepherd was left with the flock on the Lord's Day and in supreme passion chose a golden death by blood rather than writing with words what he taught.
Therefore, we ask You in this feast of his to make us who contemned death through Him more blessed. May we, through the action of a blessed life, fulfill all the marvelous things we have learned about his virtues.

text: Pietate tua quaesumus Domine nostrorum solve vincula delictorum et intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria atque omnibus sanctis tuis nos famulos tuos et cunctum populum catholicum in omni sanctitate custodi omnesque consanguinitate ac familiaritate nobis iunctos a vitiis purga virtutibus illustra pacem nobis tribue hostes remove inimicis nostris caritatem largire et omnibus fidelibus defunctis iri terra viventium vitam concede.
translation_en: By Your mercy, we humbly ask You, Lord, to release us from the chains of our sins, and with the intercession of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, and all Your saints, keep us, Your servants, and the entire Catholic people in every holiness. Cleanse us from all kinship and familiarity, purify us from vices, illuminate us with virtues, grant us peace, remove our enemies, bestow love on our adversaries, give charity to all Your faithful departed, grant eternal life to those living on earth.

text: Pietatem tuam Domine peto ut orationem et votum meum dignanter suscipias supplicationem servi tui placatus attendas et a diversis languoribus me eripias atque quae tibi pro meis delictis offero misericorditer accipias et aeternae vitae heredem me constituas desiderium meum in bonis operibus amplifices votum accumules et ab insidiis inimicorum me liberes.
translation_en: I beseech your mercy, Lord, that you accept my prayer and vow worthy of notice. I implore that you hear the supplication of your servant, and deliver me from various weaknesses. Whatever I offer to you for my sins, receive it mercifully. Establish me as an heir of eternal life. Increase my desire for good works, accumulate my vow, and free me from the traps of my enemies.

text: Pietatem tuam Domine subnixis precibus imploramus ut per beati Gregorii merita et per huius mysterii sacramenta nos protegas scuto potentiae tuae temptationum spicula retundas et ab omni pravitate correctos viam iustitiae tenere nos doceas.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your mercy, Lord, with supplicating prayers, that through the merits of blessed Gregory and by the sanctity of this mystery's sacrament, You shield us as a powerful shield from temptation's arrows. And that You teach us, corrected from all wickedness, to walk the way of justice.

text: Pietatem tuam quaesumus Domine Iesu clementissime qui pro nobis peccatoribus mortem subiens temporalem nec proprio corpori nec materno dolori parcere voluisti praesta ut nos passionis tuae memoriam eiusdemque matris tuae maestitiam recolentes vobiscum felicitatis aeternae simus participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord Jesus most merciful, who for our sins chose to suffer temporal death and did not spare either your own body or your mother's grief, grant us that remembering the sorrow of your passion and the sadness of your mother we may be partakers of eternal happiness with you.

text: Pietati tuae Domine gratias humili servitute dependimus quoniam beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Mauricii vel eius commilitonum sicut confidimus precibus exoratus desideratum contulisti nobis huius percepti sacramenti effectum quo et tuos fideles tua dona facias fidenter exposcere et poscentibus affluenter impendas.
translation_en: We humbly depend on Your pity, Lord, as we are Your servants. For we have confidently asked for it through prayers to Your most blessed martyrs, Mauritius and his comrades. You have graciously granted us the desired effect of this received sacrament, so that Your faithful may boldly ask for Your gifts and generously bestow on those who ask.

text: Pietatis tuae Christe Domine rogamus clementiam ut haec ad altare tuum nomina recitata liber vitae contineat fiatque hoc cenae tuae sacrificium defunctis ad requiem et viventibus ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord Christ, we ask for your mercy through your pity. Grant that as these names are recited at your altar, they may contain the hope of eternal life. May this sacrifice of yours become a meal for the departed to find peace and for the living to gain salvation.

text: Pietatis tuae Domine sacramentum hodierna sollemnitate recolentes pro apparitione Domini nostri Iesu Christi et pro nostrae vocationis exordiis sacrificium tibi laudis offerimus quod propitiatus suscipias deprecamur.
translation_en: Remembering Your mercy, Lord, today's solemnity, we offer You a sacrifice of praise as a token of our gratitude for the appearance of Our Lord Jesus Christ and for the beginnings of our vocation. We humbly ask that You receive it propitiously.

text: Pignore salutis aeternae percepto quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sanctorum tuorum Stephani Gamalielis Nicodemi atque Abibon quorum gloriosam recolimus inventionem eorum precibus indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that we may perceive the salvation of eternal life, as we remember the glorious discovery of your saints Stephen, Gamaliel, Nicodemus, and Abibo. May we obtain indulgence through their prayers.

text: Pignore salutis aeternae vegetati supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente sancto Ioanne Baptista cuius hodie conceptionis diem celebramus per hoc capiamus plenae securitatis augmentum.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Almighty God, that through the intercession of Saint John the Baptist whose day of conception we celebrate today, we may obtain an increase in full security.

text: Pignus aeternae vitae capientes humiliter imploramus ut apostolicis fulti patrociniis quod in imagine contingimus sacramenti manifesta perceptione sumamus.
translation_en: Humbly we ask, as we take the pledge for eternal life, that with the aid of apostolic patronage, what we encounter in the image, we may fully comprehend through the manifest reception of the sacrament.

text: Pignus perpetuae salutis sumentes clementiam tuam omnipotens Deus humiliter imploramus ut beato rege Edwardo confessore tuo interveniente caelestis vitae praemia consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Humbly we ask your clemency, Almighty God, to take up the pledge of eternal salvation, that with the intervention of your blessed king Edward, confessor, we may deserve the heavenly rewards of everlasting life.

text: Pignus vitae aeternae capientes humiliter Domine imploramus ut sanctorum apostolorum omnium fulti patrociniis a cunctis perturbationibus liberati tranquilla tibi servitute famur.
translation_en: Humbly, we ask you, Lord, to receive us as pledges of eternal life. Through the patronage of all saints and apostles, may we be freed from all disturbances, and serve you peacefully.

text: Piis intercessionibus beati Wandregesili confessoris tui atque abbatis quaesumus omnipotens Deus tuae familiae commendetur oblatio cuius vitalibus decoratur exemplis.
translation_en: With the intercessions of your blessed confessor and abbot, Wandregesilus, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the offering, which is adorned with living examples, may be commended to your family.

text: Piissime Christe Iesu qui absque doloris contagione ex utero virginali almificae matris tuae in mundum tua dignatione sanctissima porta clausa exire dignatus es concede propitius ut fructus ancillarum tuarum in orbem terrarum sanos et incolumes taliter disponas pervenire quod ad fontem baptismatis una tecum regenerari mereantur.
translation_en: Most merciful Christ Jesus, who without contagion of pain were born from the most holy womb of your Virgin Mother, deigned to close the door and exit from it; graciously grant that the fruit of your handmaidens may safely and healthily arrive throughout the world in such a way that they may deserve to be reborn with you at the font of baptism.

text: Piissime Deus arentes ieiunio dilectionis vel pacis tuae refice incremento ut qui tuae adoptionis filii sumus et scandalis careamus et sincero alternae pacis osculo sociemur.
translation_en: Most merciful God, grant us grace through penitential prayer and fasting for the increase of your love or peace, so that we who are your adopted children may be free from scandal and united with a sincere embrace of mutual peace.

text: Piissime redemptor et conditor universae carnis qui patientia tuarum virginum antiqui hostis contrivisti impulsum qui praedictarum virginum societatem turbare ex confractione ausus est vasculorum da nobis ut immobiliter in nostris cordibus radicatus infirma nostri corporis vasa fortia tibi per caritatis opera praeparemus quo nullis elisi iaculis adversantis indisruptae utamur muneribus pacis.
translation_en: Most merciful Redeemer and Creator of all flesh, who by your saints' patience contrived to subdue the ancient enemy who dared to disturb the society of the predicted virgins from their vessels, grant us that we may be rooted immovably in our hearts, preparing strong vessels of our bodies for you through works of charity, so that we may use unbroken gifts of peace, invulnerable to any hostile arrows.

text: Placabilis atque acceptabilis fiat tibi omnipotens Deus haec hostia quam tibi familia tua gratanter affert in laudem Mildrethae virginis quae suis sacris meritis a cunctis nos emundet vitiis.
translation_en: May this offering, O almighty God, be pleasing and acceptable to you, which your family offers to you gratefully in honor of the Virgin Mildrith. May she cleanse us from all sins with her own sacred merits.

text: Placabilis Domine qui es pax certa et caritas indisrupta pacem nobis omnibus largire plenissimam ut pacifici tua servantes praecepta ad vitam mereamur pervenire perpetuam.
translation_en: Lord, who are certain peace and unbroken charity, grant us all a most abundant peace, that serving your precepts peacefully, we may deserve to reach eternal life.

text: Placare Domine muneribus semper acceptis et diuturnam tempera diffusis nubibus siccitatem.
translation_en: Lord, appease with ever-accepted offerings and spread out for a long time the dryness amidst prolonged clouds.

text: Placare Domine quaesumus humilitatis nostrae precibus et hostiis et ubi nulla suppetunt suffragia meritorum tuae nobis indulgentiae succurre praesidiis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly entreat you, may your favor be upon us through our prayers and offerings. And when there are no supporting petitions of merits, may your mercy come to our aid, as our protection.

text: Placare quaesumus Domine sacrificii oblatione praesentis quam tibi ego offero tuus famulus et sacerdos et ubi nulla suppetunt suffragia meritorum tuis mihi indulgentiae succurre praesidiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to make favorable your acceptance of this offering of the sacrifice that I present before you, your servant and priest. And where there are no supporting prayers or merits for me, come to my aid with your indulgence through your protection.

text: Placare Domine sacrificio singulari ut hoc celerius nobis misericordiae tuae dona conciliet quod tibi super omnes hostias voluisti munus offerri.
translation_en: Lord, bestow your favor upon this single sacrifice, that it may quickly unite us with the gift of your mercy, which you desired above all other offerings to be presented to you.

text: Placatio tua nobis Domine sit propinqua quam etsi nostris operibus non meremur interveniente sacrificio singulari tua percipiamus miseratione praeventi.
translation_en: May your petition be near to us, Lord, as though we were not worthy by our own works; yet, with the single sacrifice of yours coming upon us, may we receive mercy in advance.

text: Placationis tibi Domine sacrificium in hac beatissimi Barnabae apostoli tui sollemnitate deferimus cuius nos precibus haec redemptionis nostrae suffragia et intellegere quaesumus concedas et assequi.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the sacrifice of appeasement in this solemnity of your blessed apostle Barnabas, whose intercessions we humbly ask that you grant us their suffrages for our redemption and that we may understand them.

text: Placatus meritis quaesumus Domine confessoris tui Germani <eius> precibus effice ut quod ille deferentibus indeptus est angelis nostra quoque fragilitas mereatur adipisci.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the merits of your confessor Germain, his prayers may move you to grant that our frailty also deserves to receive what he was indebted to the angels.

text: placatus quaesumus Domine quidquid pro peccatis meremur averte nec apud te delicta nostra praevaleant sed misericordia tua semper exorta praevincat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that whatever penance we deserve for our sins be turned away from us. May our transgressions not prevail before you, but may your mercy always prevail.

text: Placatus Domine quaesumus quidquid meremur averte nec apud te delicta nostra plus valeant sed misericordia tua semper nos peccatores praeveniat et per precem supplicem ita nos dignare respicere ut a cunctis iniquitatibus nostris emundes.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you, whatever merit we may have, turn away from us, and let our sins not hold any value before you. Yet, your mercy always overtake us as sinners, and through our humble prayer, deign to look upon us so that you cleanse us from all our iniquities.

text: Placeant quaesumus omnipotens Deus maiestati tuae sacrificia quae sumpsimus et sicut beatum Matthiam apostolorum tuorum numero forte aggregasti ita nos mente et corpore emundatos eius consortio sociare digneris.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to accept the sacrifices we have taken and grant us, in the same way that you associated blessed Matthew among your apostles, to be joined with him both in mind and body through his fellowship.

text: Placeant tibi quaesumus misericors Deus nostrae servitutis obsequia ut mysteria sacrosancta quae sumpsimus intercedente beata illa virgine tua et martyre et tuam gratiam nobis concilient et aeternae felicitatis gaudium subministrent.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, merciful God of our servitude, that the sacred mysteries which we have received, interceding through your blessed virgin and martyr, may bring your grace to us and present to us the joy of eternal happiness.

text: Placeat tibi Domine quod offerimus et sanctifica quae tibi sanctificanda litamus ut in hoc die quo beatissimus praesul Martinus glorioso transitionis evocatus est obitu donetur a te nobis omnibus indulgentia peccatorum.
translation_en: May it please You, Lord, that we offer and sanctify what we have consecrated to You, so that on this day when the most blessed bishop Martin is recalled by his glorious transition, may You grant us all indulgence for our sins through Your mercy.

text: Placeat tibi Domine sacrificii praesentis oblatio pro nostra omniumque benefactorum nostrorum salute quorum quarumque memoriam speciali affectu recolimus omnibusque christianis vivis ac defunctis miserere propitius.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, that the offering of this present sacrifice may please you for our, and all our benefactors' safety, whom we remember with a special affection; may you show mercy to all Christians, both living and dead, in your kindness.

text: Placeat tibi sancta Trinitas obsequium servitutis meae et praesta ut sacrificium quod oculis tuae maiestatis indignus obtuli tibi sit acceptabile mihique et omnibus pro quibus illud obtuli sit te miserante propitiabile.
translation_en: May it please You, Holy Trinity, the service and obedience of my servitude. And may it be granted that the offering which, unworthy in Your majesty's sight, I presented to You, is acceptable for me and for all for whom I offered it, through Your mercy may it become propitious.

text: Placidus adspice Domine plebem tuam et quam doni tui facis esse consortem a malis omnibus corporis et mentis emunda ut noxia perturbatione cessante liberum tibi semper exhibeat famulatum.
translation_en: Placidus, behold, Lord, thy people and how thou hast made them to be a companion from all evils corporally and mentally clean, that with the cessation of harmful disturbance they may always freely offer thee their service.

text: Plebem nomini tuo subditam Domine propitius intuere eique consolationes tuas iugiter per caelestem gratiam dignanter operare.
translation_en: Lord, graciously look upon your people subject to your name, and may you continually work your consolations through heavenly grace in a worthy manner.

text: Plebem tuam Domine a cunctis adversitatibus protege et beato pastore nostro intercedente Swithuno et praesentis vitae opportunitatem et futurae sentiamus sempiternitatem.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people from all adversities. Through the intercession of our blessed shepherd Swithun, may we experience the opportunities of this present life and feel the eternity of the future.

text: Plebem tuam Domine beatus martyr Genesius interventor attollat et quam de suo facit martyrio saepius gratulari dignam semper imploret tuae pietatis exsistere sacramentis.
translation_en: May your blessed martyr Genesius, O Lord, raise up his people and often beg that the one worthy of making frequent rejoicing because of her own martyrdom may always exist in your mercy's sacraments.

text: Plebem tuam Domine quaesumus interius exteriusque restaura ut quam corporeis non vis delectationibus impediri spiritali facias vigere proposito et sic rebus foveas transituris ut tribuas potius inhaerere perpetuis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you restore your people both within and without, so that they may not be hindered from spiritual life by carnal delights. Instead, make their purpose flourish. And thus, as things pass away, let them cling more to the eternal.

text: Plebem tuam quaesumus Domine perpetua pietate custodi ut secura semper et necessariis adiuta subsidiis spirituum tibimet placitorum pia semper veneratione laetetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect your people forever with perpetual kindness, so that they may always be safe and aided by necessary support of spirits. May they be ever joyful in their pious devotion to you through pleasing offerings.

text: Plebis tuae Deus ad te corda converte ut tuo munere talis exsistat cui tu perpetua beneficia largiaris.
translation_en: May your God turn the hearts of your people to you, that such a one may exist who will receive your gift, whom you may continually bestow with your blessings.

text: Plebis tuae Domine munera benignus intende quae maiestati tuae pro sanctorum martyrum Cornelii et Cypriani sollemnitatibus sunt dicata.
translation_en: Lord, with a favorable mind, direct your gifts towards your people, which have been dedicated to your majesty on the solemnities of the holy martyrs Cornelius and Cyprian.

text: Plebis tuae Domine munera placatus admitte ut quae mysteriis paschalibus exhibet in tuae remunerationis veritate percipiat.
translation_en: Lord, pleased with your people's offerings, grant admission so that they may truly perceive what is shown in the Paschal mysteries as a reward for their remuneration.

text: Plebis tuae Domine munera quae pro sanctorum martyrum tuorum illorum sollemnitatibus sunt oblata quaesumus ut eorum precibus maiestati tuae fiant accepta.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that the offerings of your people, which were given for the solemnities of the martyrs among them, may be accepted by Your majesty through their prayers.

text: Plebis tuae munera quaesumus Domine propitiatus intende et quae sacris mysteriis exsequendis temporaliter nos offerre docuisti ad aeternam nobis proficere fac salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to turn your merciful gaze towards the gifts of your people. May those things which you have taught us to offer for a time in the sacred mysteries lead us to eternal life. Grant us peace.

text: Plebis tuae omnipotens Deus oblationem beati Ioannis apostoli et evangelistae maiestati tuae commendet oratio cuius gloriosa praedicatione Verbi tui patefacta est incarnatio.
translation_en: Almighty God, the powerful Lord, may Your offering of blessed John the Apostle and Evangelist be committed to Your majesty through this prayer, whose glorious proclamation of Your Word led to its manifestation in flesh.

text: Plebis tuae quaesumus Domine ad te semper corda converte et quam tantis facis patrociniis adiuvari perpetuis non desinas gubernare praesidiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to always turn the hearts of your people towards you and not cease to govern them with your constant protection and aid through your great patronages.

text: Plebs tua Domine capiat sacrae benedictionis augmentum et copiosis beneficiorum tuorum sublevetur auxiliis quae tantis intercessionum deprecationibus adiuvatur.
translation_en: May your people, Lord, receive an increase of the sacred blessing and be lifted up by the abundant aid of your blessings, which are supported by such great intercessions.

text: Plebs tua Domine per haec sancta quae sumpsimus capiat sacrae benedictionis augmentum et intercessione sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cyrici et Iulittae copiosis beneficiorum tuorum semper sublevetur auxiliis.
translation_en: Through these holy things, O Lord, that we have received, may Your sacred blessing increase, and through the intercession of Your sainted martyrs Cyrus and Julitta, may it always be raised by abundant blessings and help from You.

text: Plebs tua Domine eius participatione semper gaudeat sacramenti quod in Christi domini sui incarnatione cognovit.
translation_en: May your people, Lord, always rejoice with their participation in the sacrament that they came to know through the incarnation of Christ, their Lord.

text: Plebs tua Domine laetetur tuorum semper honore sanctorum et eorum percipiat intercessione votiva subsidia quorum patrociniis gratulatur.
translation_en: May Your people, Lord, rejoice forever with the honor of Your saints and may they receive support through their intercessory prayers, for whom they are grateful under their patronage.

text: Plebs tua Domine quaesumus benedictionis sanctae munus accipiat per quod et noxia quaeque declinet et optata reperiat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your people receive the gift of holy blessing, through which any harm may recede and what is desired may be found.

text: Plebs tua Domine sacramentis purificata caelestibus quod sumit intellegat quod gustu delibat moribus apprehendat quod iustis orationibus expetit tua miseratione percipiat.
translation_en: Your people, Lord, purified by sacraments, may understand what they receive with taste, grasp what their habits ought to imbibe, and through just prayers, experience your mercy.

text: Plebs tua Domine sancti martyris tui illius te glorificatione magnificet ut eodem semper precante te mereatur habere rectorem.
translation_en: Your people, Lord, by the glory of your holy martyr, glorify you so that they may always plead to you and deserve to have a right leader.

text: Plebs tua Domine tibi semper devota famuletur et eius precibus cuius sollemnibus hodiernis festiva resultat quod iuste deposcit obtineat.
translation_en: Your people, Lord, always devoted, humbly entreat you. May it be just that their prayers on this solemn day be heard and granted.

text: Plenum in nobis Domine quaesumus remedium nostrae redemptionis operare ut habitatione Sancti Spiritus digni effici valeamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to work within us a full remedy for our redemption. May we become worthy through the dwelling of the Holy Spirit.

text: Plenum quaesumus Domine in nobis remedium tuae miserationis operare et tales nos esse perfice ut propitius fovere digneris.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, to work within us the fullness of your mercy's remedy and to make us such that you may deign to foster us with favor.

text: Pontificis et martyris tui Clementis quaesumus Domine in conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae pro nobis adscendat oratio cui beatam societatem cum tuis donare iussisti apostolis et martyribus.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, that the prayer of your bishop and martyr Clement may rise before the divine majesty of yours on our behalf. You who commanded them to share blessed fellowship with the apostles and martyrs.

text: Populi tui Deus defensor et rector concede propitius ut a delictis omnibus abstinentes et necessariis foveamur alimoniis et ab infestis hostibus liberemur.
translation_en: O God, our Defender and Ruler, grant your favorous blessings that we may be nourished with sustenance free from all sins and be freed from harmful enemies.

text: Populi tui Deus defensor et rector concede propitius ut per ieiunium a peccatis omnibus abstinentes ab infestis quoque spiritibus liberemur.
translation_en: O God, defender and ruler of your people, graciously grant that we may be freed, through fasting, from all sins and also from evil spirits.

text: Populi tui Deus institutor et rector peccata quibus impugna(n)tur expelle ut semper (et) tibi placitus et tuo munimine sit securus.
translation_en: God, the founder and ruler of your people, drive away or expel their sins that attack them, so that they may always be pleasing to you and secure within your protection.

text: Populi tui Domine quaesumus tibi grata sit hostia quae nataliciis sanctorum martyrum tuorum Saturnini et Chrysantii sollemnitatibus immolatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your people may find favor with you as the offering is presented on the feast days of your holy martyrs Saturninus and Chrysanthius.

text: Populi tui precibus annue quaesumus clementissime Deus et quos diei praesentis laetari fecisti tripudio beatissimi antistitis tui Syri supplicationibus exoratus aeterno fac sanctorum tuorum interesse consortio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, most gracious God, to grant favor to your people through their prayers. Those whom you have made happy today by the joy of your blessed bishop of Syria, we entreat you through his supplications to be aided by the eternal companionship of your saints.

text: Populi tui quaesumus omnipotens Deus propitiare peccatis et totius hostilitatis a nobis (t)errores averte ut romani nominis secura libertas in tua devotione semper exsultet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to be merciful toward the sins of your people and turn away all dangers of hostility from us, that under the Roman name, secure liberty may always rejoice in your devotion.

text: Populum tuum Domine perpetua miseratione prosequere ut inter saeculi turbines constitutus et praesenti iucunditate respiret et aeternam beatitudinem percipiat.
translation_en: Lord, may your people be followed by Your perpetual mercy, so that amidst the turbulence of the centuries, they may breathe in the present joy and perceive eternal beatitude.

text: Populum tuum Domine perpetua munitione defende nec difficulter quod pie quod iuste postulat consequatur cui sanctorum tuorum merita suffragantur.
translation_en: Lord, may your people be forever protected by a defense, so that what they humbly and justly ask for may not fail to be granted, and may the merits of your saints intercede on their behalf.

text: Populum tuum Domine perpetua defensione conserva nec difficulter quod pie postulat consequatur cui sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cantianorum merita suffragantur.
translation_en: Lord, may Your people be continually protected by Your defense, so that what they devoutly ask for may not fail to come about; let their prayers, joined with the merits of Your saintly martyrs of Cantia, be effective.

text: Populum tuum Domine perpetua pace custodi et qui ad venerandam sanctorum martyrum tuorum festivitatem pio occurrit affectu auxilium gratiae tuae percipere mereatur.
translation_en: Lord, may your people be eternally guarded by peace, and those who come with a devout heart to celebrate the festival of your holy martyrs, may they deserve to receive the assistance of your grace.

text: Populum tuum Domine propitius intuere et in templo nomini tuo aedificato tuam pietatem invocantes miserationis tuae potiantur auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy upon thy people and may they who call upon thy name in the temple built to honor you find strength in your aid.

text: Populum tuum Domine propitius respice et quos ab escis carnalibus praecipis abstinere a noxiis quoque vitiis cessare concede.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your people and grant them to withdraw from carnal sins; and also to cease from other vices that you command them to avoid.

text: Populum tuum Domine quaesumus ad te toto corde converte quia quos defendis etiam delinquentes maiore pietate tueris sincera mente devotos.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to turn your people to you with all their heart, for those whom you protect, even the sinners, you guard more faithfully with a sincere mind and devoted spirit.

text: Populum tuum Domine quaesumus pio favore prosequere et a cunctis adversitatibus beato Hrodpertho confessore tuo atque pontifice intercedente custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to follow Your people with a pious favor and protect them from all adversities, through the intercession of Your blessed confesseor and bishop Hrodperth.

text: Populum tuum quaesumus Domine cibo spiritali refectum pio favore prosequere et a cunctis adversitatibus beato Martino confessore tuo atque pontifice intercedente custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to guide your people who have been nourished spiritually, and to follow them with your pious favor. May they be protected from all adversities through the intercession of blessed Martin, your confessor and pope.

text: Populum tuum Domine quaesumus posside caelestibus institutis ut omnia vitando quae mala sunt et bona cuncta sectando non indignationem tuam sed iugiter misericordiam consequatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your people possess the celestial institutions so that, avoiding all evil and continually seeking good, they may attain not your wrath but always your mercy.

text: Populum tuum Domine quaesumus propitius respice atque ab eo flagella tuae iracundiae clementer averte.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you look upon your people kindly and gently turn away from them the rods of your wrath.

text: Populum tuum Domine quaesumus tueantur sanctificent et gubernem aeternumque perficiant tam devotionibus acta sollemnibus quam nataliciis agenda divinis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your people may be protected, sanctified, and guided. May they complete their solemn duties as well as their daily divine tasks eternally.

text: Populum tuum Domine unigeniti Filii tui sanguine pretioso redemptum propitius respice et beato Ivone confessore tuo intercedente concede ut hoc tuum sacramentum remissionem criminum et gratiam nobis obtineat meritorum.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your people, the offspring of your Son, redeemed by precious blood. Look upon us propitiously and, through the intercession of your blessed confessor John, grant that this sacrament may obtain for us the remission of sins and grace.

text: Populum tuum quaesumus Domine donorum tuorum largitate prosequere ut a malis omnibus sacramentorum tuorum virtute protectus ad ineffabile mysterium celebrandum et mente praeparetur et corpore.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through your generosity, your people may follow so as to be protected by the power of all your sacraments from every evil and prepared in mind and body for the celebration of the ineffable mystery.

text: Populum tuum quaesumus omnipotens Deus ab ira tua ad te confugientem paterna recipe pietate ut qui tuae maiestatis flagella formidant de tua mereantur venia gratulari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, to receive your people with paternal kindness as they flee from your wrath, and may those who fear the scourges of your majesty merit to rejoice in your mercy.

text: Populus tuus quaesumus Domine renovata semper exsultet animae iuventute ut qui ante(a) peccatorum veternoso in mortem venerat senio nunc laetetur in pristinam se gloriam restitutum.
translation_en: Your people, we ask you, Lord, may always rejoice with renewed youth, so that those who, weighed down by the aged sin, approached death, now may rejoice restored to their original glory.

text: Populus tuus Domine quaesumus semper exsultans redemptionis suae principale munus intellegat ut et devotus mente convenienter hoc appetat et tua veraciter gratia comprehendat.
translation_en: Your people, Lord, we humbly ask, may always rejoice and understand the chief task of their redemption. May they strive with a devoted mind to approach this appropriately and truly grasp your grace.

text: Porrige dexteram tuam quaesumus Domine plebi tuam misericordiam postulanti per quam et terrores declinet humanos et solatia vitae mortalis accipiat et sempiterna gaudia comprehendat.
translation_en: Stretch out your right hand to us, we beseech you, Lord, towards your people who are asking for mercy. Through this may terror retreat from mankind, and may they receive comfort in the miseries of life, and grasp eternal joy.

text: Porrige Domine famulo tuo regi nostro subsidium pacis et corporalibus et spiritalibus eum enutri alimentis et a cunctis hostibus redde securum.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, to your servant the king our aid and sustain him both physically and spiritually with food. And from all enemies make him secure.

text: Porrige nobis Deus dexteram tuam et per intercessionem beatae et gloriosae semperque virginis Dei Genitricis Mariae auxilium nobis supernae virtutis impende.
translation_en: Grant us, God, Your right hand and bestow upon us aid through the intercession of the blessed, glorious and ever-virgin Mother of God, Mary. Bestow upon us help from your heavenly powers.

text: Porrige nobis Deus dexteram tuam et auxilium nobis supernae virtutis impende.
translation_en: Grant us, God, Your right hand and bestow upon us help from Your heavenly powers.

text: Porrige nobis Domine dexteram tuae venerationis et veni et peccata nostra propitiatus absolve.
translation_en: Lord, grant us the right hand of your blessing and come and forgive our sins.

text: Porrige quaesumus dexteram Domine populo deprecanti et cui tribuis supplicandi benignus affectum praebe placatus auxilium ut te ductore confidens et mala cuncta declinet et omnia quae bona sunt apprehendat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, Thy right hand to the people who are supplicating and Thou Who art gracious in receiving supplications, bestow a benevolent attitude, that being pleased Thou mayest grant them assistance as their guide. May they confidently turn away from all evil things and may they comprehend everything that is good.

text: Portemus Domine onera iniquitatum nostrarum curva cervice vultu dimisso corde contrito et vix tandem in supplicio nostro didicimus paenitere qui reatum nostrum nolebamus ante cognoscere. Sed tu Domine qui mansuetas fecisti in vivario feras et refrigerasti in fornacis medio flammas alleva manum tuam in adiutorium nostrum et tutissimum nobis praesta defensionis tuae in afflictione suffragium ut quos peccatorum pondus inclinat misericordiae tuae virtus attollat et quoniam propter peccata nostra ad terram corruimus per infatigabilem bonitatem tuam misericorditer sublevemur ut quos diversarum iniquitatum arguunt actiones indulgentia pietatis tuae faciat innocentes.
translation_en: We bear, O Lord, the burdens of our iniquities with a bent neck, a face turned away, a heart contrite, and only at last did we learn to repent for the guilt we were unwilling to acknowledge before. But you, Lord, who have made gentleness among beasts and have quenched the flames in the furnace, stretch out your hand as our help, and grant us the safest protection of your defense in affliction. Grant us the aid of your suffrage in our penance, so that your mercy may lift those who are weighed down by the burden of our sins, and because we have fallen to the earth on account of our sins, may we be lifted up through your unfailing kindness, mercifully. And may your indulgence through your pity make us innocent among the charges of different iniquities.

text: Postulamus a te Domine Deus noster; nobis propitiare et omnia crimina nostra relaxa. Sicut id te petimus veneranter per orationes beati famuli tui Romedii cum sociis suis – ipsi te desideraverunt et hunc mundum spreverunt pro tuo amore eremum intraverunt et caelesti vita angelica gaudeverunt – ita petimus ut pro nobis se voveant.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God; be merciful to us and release all our sins. As we humbly request this through the prayers of your blessed servant Romedius with his companions - they themselves desired you and spurned this world for your love, entered an eremite life, and rejoiced in angelic celestial life - so we ask that they vow themselves for us.

text: Prae ceteris sollemnitatibus gloriantes hodie tibi Domine vota persolvimus quia ipse cuius imaginem immolamus immaculatus agnus est editus Iesus Christus Dominus noster.
translation_en: On this day, we offer our vows to You, Lord, surpassing all other solemnities, for Jesus Christ, our Lord, who was released as the spotless Lamb, is the One whose image we are sacrificing.

text: Praebe Domine exercitui tuo eunti in tenebris claritatem proficiendi augeas voluntatem et sicut Israeli properanti ex Aegypto securitatis praebuisti munimen ita tuo praedestinato eunti in proelium populo lucis auctorem adicias angelum ut die atque nocte eum nubis ignisque claritatis tuae columna non deserat; sit eis itinerandis sine labore protectus ubique providus eventus meditatus sine formidine conversatio sine fastidio sine terrore copiae proeliandi voluntas ut cum tuo duce angelo victor exsteterit non suis tribuat viribus
translation_en: Grant, Lord, to your army going into darkness the ability to advance with light. Increase their will and, just as you provided safety to Israel advancing from Egypt, provide protection to those predestined by you going into battle; add to the people of light an angel as its author, so that everywhere it travels it is protected without labor, providentially guided, carefully planned, without fear, without distaste, without terror. The will to fight should be without effort, such that with your leading angel it will stand victorious and not attribute its victory to itself.

text: Praebeant nobis Domine divinum tua sancta praesidium quae intervenientibus sancti Quintini martyris tui meritis ab omnibus nos absolvant peccatis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, your divine and holy protection, which, through the merits of your martyr Saint Quintin, may absolve us from all sins.

text: Praebeant nobis Domine quaesumus divinum tua sancta fervorem quo eorum pariter et actu delectemur et fructu.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, your divine and holy fervor, by which we may be pleased equally and in action with them and bear fruit.

text: Praebeat nobis Domine quaesumus beatus Andreas apostolus optatum praesidium quo salutare nobis sumptum proficiat sacramentum.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, blessed Andrew the apostle, may his desired protection profit us, so that the sacred rite may bring us salvation.

text: Praebeat nobis Domine salutarem beatae Mariae Magdalenae imitatio sancta doctrinam quatenus illius optimae part1s mereamur esse consortes quae non auferetur ab ea.
translation_en: Grant us, O Lord, the salutary imitation of the blessed Mary Magdalene's holy example and teaching, so that we may deserve to be her worthy companions, who shall not be taken away from her.

text: Praeceptorum tuorum memores Domine oblationum tibi sacrificia dependentes supplices flagitamus ut infundas hiis hostiis sancti tui spiritus largitatem ut cum a te benedicta sumimus omni nos benedictione refectos et a criminum vinculis liberatos omnimodis gaudeamus.
translation_en: Remembering your commandments, Lord, we who depend on the offerings to you humbly plead that you bestow upon these hosts of your saints the abundance of your spirit. So that we, having received them blessed from you, rejoice in all benediction and are refreshed, and freed from the bonds of sin.

text: Praecinge quaesumus Domine Deus noster lumbos mentis nostrae divina tua virtute potenter ut veniente domino nostro Iesu Christo filio tuo digni inveniamur aeternae vitae convivio et vota caelestium dignitatum ab ipso percipere mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord our God, to strengthen the loins of our mind with Your divine power, so that, in the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, we may be deemed worthy to find a place at the banquet of eternal life and merit to receive the vows of celestial dignities from Himself.

text: Praeclaro Christe Domine illo tuae maiestatis instructi oraculo quo nos usque ad diem secundi adventus tui semper tuae passionis memorare iussisti quae est gloria nostrae redemptionis ut haec nos commemoratio tibi faceret manere connexos et a pravae actionis nexibus absolutos obtentu martyris tui Christophori fac nos sequaces esse gloriosissimae tuae passionis ut repleti gratia Spiritus Sancti carnem subiciamus animae et animam tibi ut purificato cordis receptaculo sumamus pretium nostrae redemptionis et ob hoc te sequamur ad gloriam resurrectionis.
translation_en: Dear Christ, our Lord, with the lofty oracle of your majesty, which you have commanded us to remember until the second day of your Advent, so that we may always recall your passion, which is the glory of our redemption. Let this remembrance keep us connected and free from the bonds of wicked actions. Through the intercession of your martyr Christopher, may we follow the most glorious passion of yours. May we submit our flesh filled with grace to our souls and give our souls to you as a purified heart's receptacle for the payment of our redemption. And for this reason, let us follow you to the glory of resurrection.

text: Praecursoris tui Ioannis Baptistae nos quaesumus Domine intercessio sancta commendet ut et spiritalibus mereamur eius praedicationibus erudiri et eo quo praecipis ipso iuvante nostra possit pervenire fragilitas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the holy intercession of your Precursor John the Baptist commends us, so that we may be worthy of being taught by his spiritual preaching and that, with his help, our frailty may be able to reach the one whom you command.

text: Praedicamus Domine nec tacemus pro nostra te redemptione traditum et mortuum et sepultum ad caelos adscendisse post transitum et ad iudicandum in fine venturum. Unde petimus ut haec oblata sanctifices et sumentium pectora propitiatus emacules.
translation_en: We proclaim, Lord, and will not be silent, concerning Your redemption that was given, handed down, and died, and buried in the heavens to ascend after passing. We await You to come for judgment at the end. Therefore, we ask that these offerings be sanctified and that those taking them have their hearts purified by Your grace.

text: Veritas tua quaesumus Domine luceat
translation_en: May your truth, Lord, shine forth.

text: Praedicamus te Domine nec tacemus pro nostra redemptione de virgine natum traditum crucifixum mortuum ac sepultum; resurrexisse etiam ad caelos adscendisse veraciter credimus venturumque ad iudicandum fideliter exspectamus; quapropter petimus ut haec oblata munera Sancti Spiritus infusione sanctifices et sumentium pectora propitiatus emacules.
translation_en: We proclaim you, Lord, and we shall not be silent, for our redemption, the one born of the Virgin, handed over, crucified, dead, buried; we truly believe that he rose again to heaven, ascended; we await his coming to judge faithfully. Therefore, we ask that these gifts offered may be sanctified by the infusion of the Holy Spirit, and may our hearts, purified, receive the imprints of mercy.

text: Praedicetur Domine credentibus populis beatae confessoris tuae Leocadiae fidelis patientia cuius prius est persequentibus inimicis praedicata iustitia. Gloriemur omnes fideliter triumphale eius natalitium celebrantes ut similiter efficiamur inter tribulationum temporalium tentamenta gaudentes. Auge singulis plenissimam fidem dona constantiam tribue caritatem atque ita quod corde credimus ore confiteamur ut cum tua confessore coronam iustitiae fiducialiter exspectemus.
translation_en: The Lord proclaims the faithfulness and patience of your blessed confessor Leocadia, whose justice was first preached to her persecutors. Let us all celebrate her triumphal birth faithfully, so that we may rejoice similarly amidst temporal trials. Grant us full faith, bestow constancy, give love, and thus, may our hearts believe and our mouths confess, so that with your confessor, we confidently await the crown of justice.

text: Praedictorum martyrum tuorum Domine passionis memoriam facientes qui pro te variis verberibus caesi eculeo impositi super lapides illisis fustae cerebris consummata decorati sunt gloria passionis supplici te devotione rogamus ut sic nunc precibus mortalium delecteris quo et oblata tibi sanctifices et oblatores a delictis emundes.
translation_en: Making remembrance of your martyrs, Lord, we recall the memory of those who suffered passion for you, struck by various whips and bound to columns on stones, adorned with the glory of their suffering. We humbly entreat you with the devotion of our supplication that now, as we offer prayers on behalf of mortals, you may be pleased, so that offering ourselves to you, we may be purified from sins.

text: Praepara nos quaesumus Domine huius praecipuae festivitatis officiis ut haec sacrificia sobriis mentibus celebremus.
translation_en: Prepare us, we humbly ask you, Lord, for the duties of this principal feast day, so that we may celebrate these sacrifices with sober minds.

text: Vespertinae laudis officia persolventes
translation_en: Carrying out the Vespers Office of Praise

text: Praepara nos quaesumus Domine huius abstinentiae festivis officiis ut haec sacrificia veneranda sobriis semper mentibus celebremus.
translation_en: Prepare us, we humbly ask You, Lord, for this season of abstinence, that we may always celebrate these solemn rituals with minds unclouded by drink.

text: Praepara nos tibi Salvator noster ac Domine per pacis bonum in hostiam vivam ut qui in crastinum sumpturi sumus dominicam cenam nulla ab invicem convellamur discordia sed fructu pleni tuae dilectionis sumamus in crastinum flumina caritatis quae profluentia decurrunt e visceribus tuis.
translation_en: Prepare us, O Savior and Lord, for yourselves through the good of peace as a living sacrifice, so that we who are to partake in the feast tomorrow do not clash with each other through discord but rather gather the fruits of your love. May we drink from the rivers of charity that flow forth from your innermost being on the morrow.

text: Praesens hostia quam Domine immolamus tibi quaesumus fiat acceptabilis et gloriosi Erasmi martyris ac pontificis tui meritis fiat corporibus animabusque fidelium salutaris.
translation_en: Present offering which we offer unto you, Lord, we humbly ask that it may be acceptable and glorious through the merits of your martyr Erasmus and your priest. May it bring salvation to the bodies and souls of the faithful.

text: Vide cuius ministerium tibi
translation_en: Look at whose ministry is given to you

text: Praesens oblatio fiat Domine populo tuo salutaris pro quo dignatus es patri tuo te viventem hostiam immolare.
translation_en: May this offering be pleasing to you, Lord, for your people. For whom you have been gracious enough to offer a living sacrifice to your Father.

text: Praesens sacrificium Domine quod tibi pro delictis nostris offerimus sit tibi munus acceptum et tam viventibus quam defunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: This present sacrifice, Lord, which we offer to you for our sins, may it be acceptable to you and benefit both the living and the dead in their salvation.

text: Praesentes hostias Domine quaesumus merita gloriosa martyrum Thebaeorum tibi reddant acceptas pro quorum tibi pretioso sanguine sunt dicatae.
translation_en: Present offerings, Lord, we humbly ask that the merits of the glorious martyrs of Thebes may render them acceptable to you, who were dedicated to you by their precious blood.

text: Praesenti sacrificio Domine tua generaliter exsultet ecclesia quo infirmitatis eius sunt assumptae primitiae ut divinae particeps fieret ipsa potentiae.
translation_en: In this present sacrifice, Lord, may your church rejoice in general, where the firstfruits of its weaknesses are offered, so that it becomes a sharer of divine power.

text: Vincula Domine quaesumus humanae pravitatis
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask for ties of human weakness

text: Praesenti sacrificio nomini tuo nos Domine ieiunia dicata sanctificent et quod observantia nostra profitetur extrinsecus interius operetur effectus.
translation_en: In this present sacrifice, Lord, may our fasting dedicated to Your name sanctify us. May the external benefits of our observance work internally and bring about its effects.

text: Praesentia Domine munera quaesumus placido vultu intuere et praesta ut Sancti Spiritus perfundantur benedictione et in nostris cordibus eam tui nominis dilectionem infundant quate in mente beatae Mariae Magdalenae nimio flagravit ardore.
translation_en: In your presence, Lord, we humbly ask that you look upon us with a peaceful countenance and grant that the Holy Spirit may be poured out upon them with blessing, and that they may receive in their hearts that love for your name which burned with great fervor in the mind of the blessed Mary Magdalene.

text: Praesentia munera quaesumus Domine ita serena pietate intuere ut Sancti Spiritus perfundantur benedictione et in nostris cordibus eam dilectionem validius infundam per quam sanctus martyr ille omnia corporis tormenta devicit.
translation_en: In Your divine presence, we humbly ask, Lord, that You look upon us with such serene piety that the Holy Spirit may be poured out upon them with blessing, and that the love they have for You may be deeply instilled within our hearts, through which the holy martyr overcomes all physical torment.

text: Praesentia oblationis nostrae munera quaesumus omnipotens Deus serena Sancti Spiritus benedictione perfunde et beato Ambrosio pontifice interveniente ad perennem tribue nobis pervenire sanctificationis effectum.
translation_en: In the presence of our offering, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, to pour out peaceful blessings from the Holy Spirit and through the intervention of blessed Ambrose, bishop, may we ever attain the lasting fruit of sanctification.

text: Praesentibus Domine quaesumus intende muneribus et patrocinante beato Kenelmo martyre tuo cuius sollemnia venerando recensemus fidelibus salutis indulgentiam conferant et aeternitatis praemia dignanter acquirant.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you direct your attention to those present and, with the help of the blessed martyr Kenelm, whose solemnity we reverently celebrate, grant the faithful the indulgence of salvation and worthy acquire the rewards of eternity.

text: Praesentibus sacrificiis Domine ieiunia nostra sanctifica ut quod observantia nostra profitetur extrinsecus interius operetur.
translation_en: Lord, may our fasting be sanctified by the offerings present, that what our observance declares outwardly may operate within us.

text: Praesentibus sacrificiis quaesumus Domine fervor nostri pravi desiderii mitigetur et intercedente beata virgine Dei Genitrice Maria candore virtutum niveo induamur.
translation_en: In the presence of these sacrifices, we humbly ask You, Lord, may our fervent and perverted desire be tempered. And through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, may we be clothed in snowy white with the brightness of virtues.

text: Praesta Domine Deus noster ut contra omnes fremitus impiorum mentis puritate vincamus et qui nos in sua confidentes virtute moliuntur affligere a nobis ieiunantibus subiugentur.
translation_en: Lord God, grant that we may overcome all the uproars of the unrighteous with the purity of mind and those who endeavor to afflict us through their power may be subject to us while we are fasting.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut omnes fremitus inimici mentis puritate vincamus et is qui nos in sua virtute molitur affligere intercessione sanctorum tuorum nobis supplicantibus superetur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that we may overcome all the tumults of our enemies with purity of mind and that he who strives to afflict us in his power may be surpassed by us through the intercession of your saints, who pray for us.

text: Praesta Domine Deus noster ut per eam quam sub conspectu nominis tui famulus tuus ille beati Sigismundi precibus corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi communicationem sumpsit ad sanitatem pristinam revocetur.
translation_en: Lord, grant us that through her whom Your servant, the blessed Sigismund, received communion of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ under the sight of Your name, he may be restored to his former health.

text: Praesta Domine Deus noster ut quorum nobis festivitate votiva sunt sacramenta eorum salutaria nobis intercessione reddantur.
translation_en: Grant, O Lord our God, that those for whom we offer vows in the festive sacrifice may return to us by their prayers with salutary benefits.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus animae famuli tui misericordiam sempiternam ut eam mortalibus nexibus expeditam lux aeterna possideat.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, we ask, the eternal mercy for the soul of your servant, that it may possess the light eternal and be freed from earthly bonds by death.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum misericordiam sempiternam ut mortalibus nexibus expeditas lux eas aeterna possideat.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, eternal mercy to the souls of your servants and their servants, that they may, freed from earthly bonds, possess the eternal light.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus Ecclesiam tuam sub tantis gaudere principibus et intellectu capere quod devotione sectatur ut tuis dispositionibus gubernata quos praesenti veneratur obsequio participatione perpetua contingere mereatur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your Church rejoices greatly under such princes and grasps with understanding what is sought through devotion, so that it may be worthy to attain those whom it venerates in the present by perpetual participation, governed according to your dispositions.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Ecclesiae tuae sub tantis gaudere principibus ut intellectu capere valeat quod devotione sectatur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you Lord, to your Church under such princes, that it may be able to grasp with understanding what it pursues with devotion.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus famulis tuis renuntiantibus saecularibus pompis gratiae tuae ianuas aperiri qui despecto diabolo confugiunt sub titulo Christi; iube venientes ad te sereno vultu suscipere ne de eis inimicus valeat triumphare; tribue eis brachium infatigabile auxilii tui mentes eorum fidei lorica circumda ut felici muro vallati mundum se gaudeant evasisse.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you open the doors for your servants who renounce worldly delights in pursuit of Your grace. Those who flee from the devil under the title of Christ; command those approaching You to receive them with a calm face, so that an enemy may not triumph over them. Grant them an unwavering arm of Your help, encase their minds in a shield of faith, so that they may delight in having escaped the world within fortified walls.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus famulis tuis talesque nos concede fieri tuae gratiae largitate ut bona tua et fiducialiter imploremus et sine difficultate sumamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, Your servants, and make us worthy to become through Your grace's generosity, that we may confidently request Your blessings and receive them without difficulty.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut anima famuli tui illius cuius anniversarium depositionis diem celebramus his purgata sacrificiis indulgentiam pariter et requiem capiat sempiternam.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the soul of your servant, whom we commemorate today on the anniversary of their departed day, may find equal cleansing through these sacrificial offerings and eternal rest.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut anima famuli tui illius his purgata sacrificiis indulgentiam pariter et requiem capiat sempiternam.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you grant, the soul of your servant, after being purged with these sacrifices, both forgiveness and eternal rest.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut beati Matthaei apostoli et evangelistae suffragiis cuius natalicia praevenimus haec plebs tua semper et sua vota depromat et desiderata percipiat.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, we beseech You, that through the intercession of the blessed Apostle and Evangelist Matthew, whose feast day we are now celebrating, Your people may always promote their prayers and desires, and receive their longed-for needs.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut dicato muneri congruentem nostrae devotionis offeramus affectum
translation_en: Grant, Lord, we beseech you, that with an offering fitting for our devotion, we may present the duty entrusted to us.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut Ecclesiam tuam beatus sacerdos Hieronymus et fidei doctrinis erudiat et eruditam divinis mysteriis dignam pia intercessione efficiat.
translation_en: Graciously hear us, Lord, as we beseech You. May Your blessed priest Jerome educate and instruct Your Church with the teachings of faith, and may he make her worthy through pious intercession, fitting for divine mysteries.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut et de nostrae gaudeamus provectionis augmento et de congruo sacramenti paschalis obsequio.
