translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that we may rejoice in the increase of our prosperity and fulfill the fitting observance of the Easter sacrament.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut illius salutis capiamus effectum cuius per haec mysteria pignus accipimus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech Thee, that we may experience the effect of His salvation for which we receive pledge through these mysteries.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut mentium reprobarum non curemus obloquia sed eadem pravitate calcata quae domui tuae conveniunt rationabiliter exsequamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you grant us the ability not to care about the slander of the wicked, but rather walk in the same vice that is reasonable for your house, we may fulfill with truth.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut per haec quae his oblationibus sunt agenda salvemur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that through these offerings which are being performed, may we be saved.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus dissimulatis lacerationibus improborum ea te gubernante quae recta sunt cautius exsequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech Thee, that through these holy things which we have received, guided by Your rule, we may more carefully carry out what is right, hiding the wounds of sinfulness.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut qui tam immensis erroribus aggravati fiduciam conscientiae non habemus martyrum tuorum nobis supplicatio beata subveniat.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, that the supplication of your blessed martyrs may come to our aid, as we lack faith and are heavily burdened by such immense errors in conscience.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut quorum memoriam sacramenti participatione recolimus fidem quoque proficiendo sectemur.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Lord, that as we recall the memory of those in the sacred rite of participation, so too may our faith progress by following their path.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quorum memoriam sacramenti participatione recolimus fidem quoque proficiendo sectemur.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that as we remember those for whom we participate in the sacrament, we may also progress in faith by following their example.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut cuius passionis memoriam sacramenti participatione recolimus fidem proficiendo sectemur.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, we beseech You, that remembering the Passion of the one whose memory we recall through the sacred participation, our faith may advance while we follow the way of life.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut sacramenti tui participatione vegetati sanctae Felicitatis quoque martyris precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that through the participation in your sacrament, you may also assist us with the prayers of Saint Felicity, the martyr.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut sacramentorum tuorum dona salutaria quae praesenti devotione sumpsimus non in reatum nobis sed intercedentibus sanctis martyribus et confessoribus tuis proficiant potius ad salutem.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, we humbly ask you, that the beneficial gifts of your sacraments which we have received with present devotion may not be detrimental to us, but rather through the intercession of your holy martyrs and confessors, they may more effectively lead us to salvation.

text: Vox nostra te Domine semper deprecetur
translation_en: Our voice, Lord, will always beseech you

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut secundum promissionem Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi Spiritus Sanctus et huius nobis sacrificii copiosus revelet arcanum et omnem propitius reseret veritatem.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech Thee, according to the promise of Thy Son our Lord Jesus Christ, that the Holy Spirit may reveal abundantly the secret to us and open up all things graciously, making known the truth.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut sicut populus christianus martyrum tuorum temporali sollemnitate congaudet ita perfruatur aeterna et quod votis celebrat comprehendat effectu.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, that just as the Christian people rejoice in the temporal feast of your martyrs, so they may partake in eternal bliss. May what they celebrate with their vows be realized in its effect.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut sicut sanctorum tuorum nos natalicia celebranda non deserunt ita iugiter suffragia comitentur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that just as Your saints never fail to celebrate their natal days, so may their constant intercessions be with us.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut temporalibus non destituamur auxiliis quos alimoniis pascis aeternis.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you that we may not be forsaken in our temporal needs, which you feed with eternal blessings.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut terrenis affectibus expiati(s) ad superni plenitudinem sacramenti cuius libavimus sancta tendamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you cleanse us from earthly feelings, so that we may strive towards the fullness of heavenly sacrament to which we have devoted ourselves with holy intent.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut divinis mysteriis expiati intercedente beato illo consessore tuo atque pontifice ad superni plenitudinem sacramenti cuius libavimus sancta tendamus.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech You, Lord our God, that through the intercession of Your blessed bishop and pope, we may be purified in the divine mysteries and strive towards the fullness of the sacrament to which we have offered our holy longing.

text: Praesta Domine quaesumus ut toto tibi corde subiecti tumentium voluntatum respuamus afflatus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, that with our entire heart subdued to you, we may reject worldly desires.

text: Praesta Domine ut intercedente sancto antistite tuo Germano cuius hodie in conspectu maiestatis tuae beatitudinis gloriam dignis laudibus exaltamus omissis odiis in pace quam nobis daturi sumus pura tibi ac pacifica corda nostra pandamus.
translation_en: Lord, grant that through the intercession of your bishop Saint Germanus, whom we today exalt with fitting praise before your majesty's glory, we may forget our hatreds and open pure and peaceful hearts to the peace that is promised to us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedentibus sanctis confessoribus et pontificibus tuis Remigio atque Germano hodierna die in conspectu maiestatis tuae eorum beatitudinis gloriam dignis laudibus exaltemus.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God that on this day, with the intercession of your saints, bishops Remigius and Germanus, we may raise their glory worthy praises before Your majesty.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut intercedentibus sanctis confessoribus (et pontificibus) tuis Remigio atque Germano quorum hodierna die beatitudinis gloriam celebramus omissis odiis ad veram pacem quae Christus est corda nostra pandamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, that through the intercession of your holy confessors (and popes) Remigius and Germain whose today's day we celebrate the glory of beatitude, we may overcome hatred and open our hearts to the true peace which is Christ.

text: Praesta Domine ut sicut animas electorum tuorum caelesti remuneratione laetificas ita et anima famuli tui illius monachi clementia tuae pietatis veniam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: Lord, may it please you that just as you rejoice the souls of your elect with celestial recompense, so too may the soul of your servant, that monk, merit to obtain forgiveness through your clemency and pity.

text: Praesta famulis tuis Domine abundantiam protectionis et gratiae; da salutem mentis et corporis; da continua(e) prosperitatis augmenta et tibi semper fac esse devotos.
translation_en: Lord, grant abundance of protection and grace to your servants; give health of mind and body; give continuous increase of prosperity and may you always make them be devoted to you.

text: Praesta misericors Deus ut ad suscipiendum Filii tui singulare nativitatis mysterium et mentes credentium praeparentur et non credentium corda subdantur.
translation_en: Merciful God, grant that the minds of those who believe may be prepared to receive the singular mystery of your Son's nativity, and that the hearts of those who do not believe may be subdued.

text: Praesta misericors Deus ut natus hodie Salvator mundi sicut divinae nobis generationis est auctor ita et immortalitatis sit ipse largitor.
translation_en: Gracious God, may it be that the Savior of the world who was born today is also the author of our divine generation, so may He Himself also be the giver of immortality.

text: Praesta nobis aeterne largitor eius ubique pia protegi oratione cuius natalicia per haec sancta quae sumpsimus votivo praevenimus obsequio.
translation_en: Grant us always, the eternal giver of all things, everywhere, with a pious protection through this holy day which we have celebrated with vow-fulfilling reverence on account of his natal feast.

text: Praesta nobis aeterne Salvator eorum nos ubique protegi pia oratione quorum natalicia per haec sancta quae sumpsimus votivis celebramus obsequiis.
translation_en: Eternal Savior, grant us that they may always protect us. Through these holy things we have taken up in fulfillment of our vows, we humbly celebrate the birthdays of those for whom we pray.

text: Praesta nobis Domine eius desiderata commercia ut cuius perpetuam dignitatem sacrosancto mysterio frequentamus in terris et praesentia nobis subsidia postulet et aeterna.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, his desired commerce, so that we who participate in the sacred mystery of his perpetual dignity on earth may also seek support from you here and find aid after death, and attain eternal life.

text: Praesta nobis Domine in domo tua sancta unanimitate viventibus pacem habere quam tradimus pacem servare quam sumimus; maneat in nobis et sine osculis pax dummodo oscula sine pace non maneant.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, in your holy house, unity to live in peace that we give and keep in peace that we receive. May peace remain among us without kisses, but let the kisses not remain without peace.

text: Praesta nobis Domine misericordiam tuam sanctorum tuorum suffragiis imploratam et quos intercessores nostros esse tribuisti fac eos et maiestatem tuam iugiter exorare et salutaria impetrare pro nobis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, your mercy as we have humbly requested through the intercession of your saints, and may you always cause those whom you have given to be our intercessors to pray and intercede for us before your majesty.

text: Praesta nobis Domine misericordiam tuam ut quae votis expetimus conversatione tibi placita consequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, your mercy that we may obtain what we have sought through pleasing you in our conduct.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus apostolicis doctrinis et precibus adiuvari ut quod praesentibus celebramus officiis perpetuae salvationis gaudiis assequamur.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Lord, we humbly ask, through apostolic teachings and supplications, that we may attain the eternal joys of salvation which we celebrate in these present offices.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus beati Ioannis confessoris tui atque pontificis meritis et precibus adiuvari ut quod praesentibus celebramus officiis eius suffragio perpetuae salvationis gaudiis assequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, through the merits and intercessions of your blessed confessor and bishop St. John, that what we celebrate with his present offices, we may attain everlasting salvation through his intercession.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus apostoli tui Iacobi doctrinis et precibus adiuvari ut quod praesentibus celebramus officiis perpetuae salvationis gaudiis assequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, through the intercession of your apostle James, with his teachings and prayers, that we may attain the eternal joys of salvation which we celebrate presently in our perpetual duties.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus auxilium gratiae tuae ut ieiuniis et orationibus convenienter intenti liberemur ab hostibus mentis et corporis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, your help so that with fasting and prayers correctly directed, we may be freed from the enemies of mind and body.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus auxilium gratiae tuae ut sine qua nihil boni possumus eadem largiente digne quae tua sunt et cogitare valeamus et facere.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, your help through your grace, that we may be able to do nothing good without it, and may we be worthy of receiving what is yours. May we think and act accordingly.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus intercedentibus sanctis tuis ut quae ore contigimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, through the intercession of your saints, that what we receive with our mouth may be understood in a pure mind.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus intercedentibus sanctis ut quae ore contingimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, through the intercession of the saints that what touches our lips in a pure mind, we may truly comprehend.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut quae ore contingimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Almighty and merciful God, that what we touch with our lips we may take in with a pure mind.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus intercedentibus sanctis Felicissimo et Agapito ut quae ore contingimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we humbly ask, through the intercession of Saints Felicitas and Agapitus, that what we touch with our mouth we may receive with a pure mind.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus intercedente beato Theodoro martyre tuo ut quae ore contingimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask with the intercession of your blessed martyr Theodore, that what we touch with our mouth we may receive with a pure mind.

text: Praesta nobis. Domine quaesumus intercedentibus omnium sanctorum tuorum meritis ut quae ore conti{n}gimus puro corde capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, through the intercession of all your saints, that what we say with pure heart we may truly comprehend.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus universa peccata pariter atque pericula corporis et mentis evadere quos innumerabilium martyrum pia confessione circumdas.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask, may all our sins and dangers of body and mind be escaped by us, as you surround us with the holy confessions of the countless martyrs.

text: Praesta nobis Domine quaesumus ut quae pro martyrum tuorum illorum beata passione peregimus ipsorum nobis fiant intercessione salutaria in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter impleta.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as we ask you, that what we have performed for the martyrs of yours in their blessed passion may become a helpful intercession for us on whose feast days their natalities are most joyously filled.

text: Praesta nobis misericors Deus ut digne tuis servire semper altaribus mereamur et eorum perpetua participatione salvari.
translation_en: Grant us, O merciful God, that we may always deserve to serve Thy altars worthily and be saved by their perpetual participation.

text: Praesta nobis misericors Deus ut munera nostra pro ieiunii sanctificatione oblata Spiritus Sanctus assumat ut ad te toto corde clamantes propitiationis tuae indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, O merciful God, that the offerings of ours, presented for the sanctification of our fast, may be accepted by the Holy Spirit, so that we, with all our heart appealing to you, may attain your mercy's indulgence.

text: Praesta nobis misericors Deus ut placationem tuam promptis mentibus exoremus et peccatorum veniam consequentes a noxiis liberemur incursibus.
translation_en: Grant us, merciful God, that we may approach your appeasement with quick minds and that we may obtain forgiveness for our sins, being freed from the attacks.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens Deus ut dicatum nomini tuo sacrificium purgatis moribus offeramus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we may offer the sacrament to your namede, with purified conduct.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens Deus ut percipientes paschali munere veniam peccatorum deinceps peccata vitemus.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Almighty God, that through the gift of Easter we may receive forgiveness for our sins and thereafter strive to avoid further sins.

text: Praesta nobis aeterne Salvator ut percipientes hoc munere veniam peccatorum deinceps peccata vitemus.
translation_en: Grant us everlasting Savior, that we may perceive this gift as forgiveness for our sins and thereafter avoid committing sins.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens Deus ut quem fidei virtute imitari non possumus non indigna salutis veneratione sectemur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we may follow with worthy veneration, the one whose virtues in faith we cannot imitate.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens Deus ut quia vitiis subiacet nostra mortalitas tua nos et medicina purificet et potentia tueatur.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that since our mortality is subject to sins, Your mercy may cleanse and purify us, and Your power protect us.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens Deus ut vivificationis tuae gratiam consequentes in tuo semper munere gloriemur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that following your grace of life, we may always glorify you in your service.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens et misericors Deus ut beati Xysti martyris tui repetita sollemnitas et liberationem nobis perfectam tribuat et salutem.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Almighty and merciful God, that the solemnity of Your blessed martyr Xystus may be perfected for us and bring us salvation.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens et misericors Deus ut in resurrectione Domini nostri Iesu Christi percipiamus veraciter portionem.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty and merciful God, that we may truly perceive the portion (reward) in the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens et misericors Deus ut quae visibilibus mysteriis celebrando suscepimus invisibili consequamur effectu.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty and merciful God, that what we have received while celebrating the visible mysteries, we may also attain by an invisible effect.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut quae visibilibus mysteriis sumenda percepimus invisibili consequamur effectu.
translation_en: Grant us, we implore you, almighty and merciful God, that what we have perceived by visible mysteries, we may attain to by an invisible effect.

text: Praesta nobis omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum copiosa victoria sicut eis perpetuum dat triumphum ita nobis continuum praestet auxilium.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Almighty and merciful God, that we may share in the abundant victory of your saints, martyrs, as they have been given everlasting triumph; so too, let continuous aid be granted to us.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine consolationis auxilium ut diuturnis calamitatibus laborantes beati apostoli tui Pauli intercessione a cunctis tribulationibus eruamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, the aid of comfort, so that, toiling under prolonged hardships, we may be freed from all tribulations through the intercession of Your blessed apostle Paul.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut in tuo conspectu mors est pretiosa sanctorum ita eius merita venerantium accepta tibi reddatur oblatio.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, we beseech you Lord, that just as death is precious in your sight to the saints, so may their merits offered be acceptable to you as an offering.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine per tua sancta quae sumpsimus praesidia mentis et corporis et intervenientibus beati Apollinaris meritis ab omnibus absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, through Your holy defenses which we have taken, protection of mind and body, and through the merits of Blessed Apollinaris, deliver us from all sins.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine sanctarum virginum testis intercessione ut sancto sacramento communiti caelestis praemii gloriam capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, through the witness of the holy virgins' intercession, that we may obtain the heavenly reward of glory after partaking in the sacred sacrament.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine terrena despicere et amare caelestia ut per haec sacra quae gerimus et a transituris desideriis expiari mereamur et incipiamus inhaerere perpetuis.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, Lord, that we may despise earthly things and love heavenly ones, so that through these sacred rites which we perform, we may be worthy of being freed from earthly desires and begin to adhere to eternal ones.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nostrae humilitatis oblatio et pro tuorum grata sit honore sanctorum et nos corpore pariter et mente purificet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to make our offering of humility pleasing to your honor through the merits of the saints, and to cleanse us both body and mind.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut beati Martini confessoris tui doctrinis eruditi et precibus roborati redemptionis nostrae mysterium quod sumpsimus incessabiliter ambiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, that we who have been instructed by the teachings of your blessed martyr Martin and strengthened by his prayers, may continually pursue the mystery of our redemption.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut qui beati Cuthberti confessoris tui atque pontificis translationis diem veneramur per ipsius suffragia pietatis tuae semper beneficia consequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, O almighty and merciful God, that as we commemorate the translation day of your blessed Confessor and Bishop Cuthbert, through his intercessions we may always obtain the blessings of your mercy.

text: Praesta omnipotens aeterne Deus et hac cottidie spiritali societate protegi et nullis incursibus inimici lacerari.
translation_en: Almighty and eternal God, daily protect and shield us in this spiritual fellowship, and let us not be torn apart by any attacks of our enemies.

text: Praesta omnipotens Deus cordis nostri laetitiam ut in die salutis hodierna reddita nobis reconciliationis tuae pactione nullius interpositio dolositatis appareat.
translation_en: Almighty God, grant joy to our heart, so that on this day of our salvation, no deception arising from any intervention may appear due to your covenant of reconciliation.

text: Praesta omnipotens Deus per ineffabilem misericordiae tuae caritatem ut cuius virtus atque maiestas in mirabilium suorum diversitate claruit in nostrarum quoque mentium purificatione clarescat; praesentem itaque oblationem ita illabere ut medelam viventibus defunctis refrigerium praestet et quorum nomina texuit recitatio praemissa sortem inter electos iubeas aggregari.
translation_en: Almighty God, through your ineffable mercy, we pray that the power and majesty of you, which shone forth in the diversity of your miracles, may also become clear in our own minds' purification. Therefore, let this present offering be received in such a way that it provides refreshment to the living as a balm for the dead, and let the names mentioned in the preceding recitation be joined with the fate of the chosen.

text: Praesta omnipotens Deus ut ieiuniorum placatus sacrificiis remissionis tuae nos venia prosequaris. ( recension gelasienne ) Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ieiuniorum nostrorum tibi placeant sacrificia quibus remissionis tuae nos venia prosequatur. ( recension Pamel 245 PraemMC )
translation_en:
Almighty God, we ask that you be pleased with the fasting of your servants, and that through their offerings, may you pursue us with your forgiveness. (Gelasian revision)
We humbly beseech You, Almighty God, that our fasting may find favor in Your sight, through which we may be pursued with Your forgiveness. (Pamel 245 PraemMC revision)

text: Praesta populo tuo Domine quaesumus consolationis auxilium et diuturnis calamitatibus laborantem respirare concede; da veniam peccatis et cor eius ab iniquitate custodi ut quia humana fragilitas incessabiliter meretur offensam intervenientibus sanctis tuis indulgentia lapsis continuata subveniat.
translation_en: Grant to thy people, Lord, we beseech Thee, help of consolation and allow him who is laboring under long-lasting calamities to breathe; give pardon for sins and guard his heart from iniquity, so that since human frailty incessantly deserves offense, the continued indulgence of Thy saints may come to his aid.

text: Praesta populo tuo Domine quaesumus consolationis auxilium; da veniam peccatis nostris et (cor nostrum) ab iniquitate custodi ut quia humana fragilitas incessabiliter meretur offensam celerius in tua misericordia gaudeamus.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that your people receive consolation aid; grant us pardon for our sins and guard our heart from wickedness, so that because human frailty incessantly deserves offense, we may rejoice more swiftly in your mercy.

text: Praesta populo tuo Domine quaesumus consolationis auxilium et diuturnis calamitatibus laborantem propitius respirare concede.
translation_en: Grant to your people, Lord, we ask, assistance of comfort and graciously breathe, allow them to be refreshed amidst prolonged afflictions.

text: Praesta populo tuo Domine quaesumus consolationis auxilium et diuturnis calamitatibus laborantem beati Pauli apostoli tui intercessione a cunctis tribulationis erue.
translation_en: Grant aid to your people, Lord, we ask, consolation and relief from prolonged calamities, through the intercession of your blessed Apostle Saint Paul. Free him from all troubles.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus famulo tuo illi consolationis auxilium et diuturnis calamitatibus laborantem propitius respirare concede.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, Almighty God, Your servant that consolation may help him and that he may mercifully breathe in the midst of prolonged sufferings.

text: Praesta quaeso misericors Deus ut hoc tuum sacramentum non sit mihi reatus ad poenam sed intercessio salutaris ad veniam sit ablutio criminum sit informatio virtutum sit contra mundi pericula tutissimum firmamentum.
translation_en: I humbly ask, merciful God, that this your sacrament not be a burden to me for punishment but rather a saving intercession for forgiveness, a cleansing of sins, an informing of virtues, and the most secure bulwark against worldly dangers.

text: Praesta quaesumus clementissime et misericordissime Deus ut nos ineffabilis tua clementia benedicat et sensum in nobis sapientiae salutaris infundat atque in sanctis actibus perseverabiles reddat.
translation_en: Grant, we implore you most kindly and mercifully, God, that your ineffable clemency blesses us and pours into us the saving wisdom, and makes us steadfast in holy deeds.

text: Praesta quaesumus Deus noster ut familia tua quae Filii tui Domini nostri est nativitate salvata eius etiam sit perpetua redemptione secura.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, O God, that Your family, which is saved by the birth of Your Son, our Lord, may also be securely protected by eternal redemption.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine cum accessu temporum  recti moderaminis incrementum ut quod dignitate praeferimus iustis actionibus exsequamur.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Lord, with the onset of righteous times, a proper measure of increase, so that what we elevate in dignity we may carry out through just actions.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster et apostolorum natalicia nos tuorum continua devotione venerari et in suis crebrius honorare principiis.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you Lord, our God, that we may continually revere the nativity of the Apostles and more frequently honor them in their principles.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine Deus noster per haec sacrosancta mysteria quae sumpsimus apostoli tui Thomae natalicia continua devotione venerari et in eius crebrius honorare principiis.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, through these most sacred mysteries which we have received, that we may continually venerate and more frequently honor the principles of your apostle Thomas on his natal day with uninterrupted devotion.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster sacramentum hoc in ecclesiis tuis indiffidenter intellegi ut unus Christus in Dei atque hominis veritate nec a nostra divisus natura nec a tua discretus adoretur essentia.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord our God, that this sacrament may be understood without hesitation in Thy churches, so that one Christ is acknowledged in the truth of both God and man; neither divided in our nature nor separated from Thine, may be adored in His essence.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut caritatis dono quo cunctum innovas mundum per haec sacrosancta mysteria nos quoque reddas acceptos.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, that with the gift of charity whereby you renew the whole world through these sacred mysteries, you also make us acceptable.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut declinemus noxios appetitus et reatum nobis ingerentia desideria respuamus quia tunc exteriores hostes superare poterimus si vincamus internos.
translation_en: Graciously hear us, O Lord our God, that we may turn away from harmful desires and reject the evil temptations that approach us; for then we shall be able to overcome external enemies if we conquer internal ones.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut et inter quaslibet angustias constituti non desinamus tuo nomini supplicare et cum propitiatio caelestis impenditur a tua numquam laude cessemus.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord our God, that even though we are situated among any tight situations, we never cease to appeal to your name and when the heavenly propitiation is offered, we may never cease from praising you.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercessione sanctae Eulaliae virginis sacramenta quae sumpsimus ad praesentem perpetuamque nobis proficiant salutem.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord our God, that through the intercession of Saint Eulalia, the sacraments which we have received may profit us with health in the present and for eternity.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus intercedentibus beati Iudoci confessoris tui meritis aeterna remedia capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord God our Savior, that through these sacred mysteries which we have received with the intercession of your blessed confessor Saint Judoc, we may obtain eternal remedies through his merits.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quae sollemni celebramus officio purificatae mentis intellegentia consequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord our God, that what we celebrate solemnly in the office of the purified mind may be attained by us through understanding.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sacramenti tui virtute percepta intercessione beati Agapiti martyris tui tanto munere digni reddamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you Lord, our God, that through the virtue of your sacrament and the intercession of the blessed Martyr Agathius, we may be deemed worthy of such a great gift.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine familiae supplicanti ut dum a cibis corporibus abstinent a vitiis mente ieiunent.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we pray, to the supplicating family, that while they fast from bodily food, they may also fast from vices in their mind.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis ut ieiuniorum veneranda sollemnia et congrua pietate suscipiant et secura devotione percurrant.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we pray, to your faithful, that they may take up with reverence the solemnities of fasting and run through them with secure devotion.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine illam nos puram tenere mensuram qua subsistit universitas ut in mentibus nostris nec sine bonitate censura <permaneat qua exercetur et caritas>.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that we may maintain a pure measure of the kind that sustains the universe, so that in our minds neither judgment without goodness remains nor love is not exercised.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine mentibus nostris cum exsultatione provectum ut beatae Agnetis martyris tuae cuius diem passionis annua devotione recolimus etiam fidei constantiam subsequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we pray, to our minds with exultation raised, that we may remember with annual devotion the day of blessed Agnes' martyrdom and also follow constancy in faith.

text: Praesta Domine precibus nostris cum exsultatione provectum ut quorum diem passionis annua devotione recolimus etiam fidei constantiam subsequamur.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, our prayers with joyful progress, that we may remember the day of their annual Passion with devotion and also follow constancy in faith.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine mentibus nostris ut munera quae in honorem martyris tui Georgii offerimus proficiant nobis ad salutem.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, that the gifts which we offer in honor of your martyr George may benefit us for our salvation.

text: Praesta quaesumus. Domine sacris nos semper innovari mysteriis et beatorum martyrum Sergii et Bacchi meritis et precibus suffragari.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord. May we always be renewed by the sacred mysteries and through the merits and intercessions of the blessed martyrs Sergius and Bacchus.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine spiritalibus gaudiis nos repleri ut quae actu gerimus mente sectemur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we humbly ask, spiritual joys that we may fill ourselves with, so that we may follow in mind what we are actively doing.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine tuis supplicibus beati Nicolai confessoris tui atque pontificis festa celebrantibus ut sicut per eius suffragia inultos ab ipso mortis praecipitio mirabiliter liberasti ita et nos eodem interveniente a peccatorum nostrorum periculis eripere digneris.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech Thee, Lord, to Thy supplicants celebrating the feast of Thy blessed confessor and bishop Saint Nicholas, that as by his intercession Thou didst miraculously save us from the peril of death, so may Thou deign to free us also, when he intervenes, from the dangers of our sins.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut a nostris mentibus et carnales amoveat Spiritus Sanctus affectus et spiritalia nobis dona potenter infundat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the Holy Spirit may remove earthly passions from our minds and powerfully bestow spiritual gifts upon us.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut anima famuli tui illius cuius corpori hodie officia humanitatis exhibemus his sacrificiis expiata salvationis tuae perpetuo munere gratuletur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that the soul of your servant to whom today we offer the offices of humanity with these sacrificial rites may be pleased with the perpetual gift of your salvation.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut anima famuli tui illius sacris mysteriis expiata salvationis tuae perpetuo munere gratuletur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the soul of your servant may, having been purified by those sacred mysteries, enjoy the perpetual gift of your salvation.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut anima famuli tui illius episcopi quem in hoc saeculo commorantem sacris muneribus decorasti caelesti sede gloriosa semper exsultet.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, that the soul of Thy servant, the bishop whom in this world You have adorned with sacred offices, may always rejoice in a glorious seat in heaven.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut anima famuli tui illius (per) haec sacra mysteria ab universis mundata de ictis aeterna gaudia te largiente percipere mereatur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the soul of your servant (through) these holy mysteries may be purified from all worldly troubles, and, bestowing eternal joys upon him, may merit to perceive them.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut animam famuli tui illius quam forte aliquid conscientiae reatus accusat per hanc hostiam placationis quam tibi offerimus ab omnibus iubeas emundari delictis.
translation_en: Grant, we ask You, Lord, that You cleanse the soul of Your servant whom perhaps some guilt or charge of conscience accusates through this offering of propitiation, that You command him to be purified from sins.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut beati Laurentii suffragiis in nobis tua munera tuearis pro cuius honoranda confessione hostias tibi laudis offerimus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we pray, that through the intercession of Saint Lawrence, you may preserve your gifts for us. For his worthy confession, we offer to you sacrifices of praise.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut beati Lucae evangelistae suffragiis cuius natalicia celebramus haec plebs tua semper et sua vota depromat et desiderata percipiat.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we implore, that this your people may always be aided by the intercessions of the blessed Evangelist Luke whose feast day we celebrate, and that they may bring forth their vows and attain their desired goals.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut beati sacerdotis et confessoris tui Willibaldi cuius festivitatem celebramus precibus indulgentiam sentiamus.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Lord, that we may experience the indulgence of Your blessed priest and confessor Willibald, whose feast day we celebrate.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut beatorum martyrum tuorum Hermachorae et Fortunati unos semper adiuvet madeat tua nos semper custodiat protectio.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that your blessed martyrs Hermachorae and Fortunatus may always help and support us. May your protection always guard and keep us.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut Ecclesia tua et martyrum tuorum Abdon et Sennen confisa suffragiis devota permaneat et corum precibus gloriosis secura consistat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, that Thy Church and the martyrs Abdon and Sennen, confident with their fervent intercessions, may remain steadfast and securely stand by their glorious prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut Ecclesia tua prompta tibi voluntate deserviat quia propensius audiri poterit et defendi cum eam tibi digne praestiteris famulari.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Lord, that Your Church may serve You according to Your will promptly, for she will be more easily heard and defended when she is worthily serving You.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut hac oblatione mundati sumamus et deprecandi fiduciam et gratiam quae iusta sunt impetrandi.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, that through this offering we may be purified and obtain the faithful trust and grace which are justly petitioning.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut haec dona tua quae sumpsimus beati Wulmari abbatis precibus in nobis potius augeantur.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Lord, that the gifts we have received from the prayers of blessed Abbot Wulmar may rather increase within us.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut hoc munus redemptionis nostrae quod indigni sumpsimus famulum tuum illum intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria et beatis apostolis tuis Petro et Paulo atque Ioanne ab omnibus muniat periculis et ab angustiis quas patitur et vinculis illaesum abire faciat.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that this sacrament of our redemption which we unworthy have received may the servant of yours be protected by the intercession of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, and your holy apostles Peter, Paul, and John, from all perils and from the troubles he suffers, and make him to pass through unbound.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut hoc sacrificium singulare quod in honorem sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cyrici et Iulittae matris eius sociorum eorum tibi sollemniter offerimus c{l}laritatem nobis infundat et inexpugnabile fiat.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Lord, and grant that this unique sacrifice we offer you in honor of your holy martyrs Cyrus and Julitta, mother of them both, may their clarity infuse us and make us invincible.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut intercedente beato Sebastiano martyre tuo et a cunctis adversitatibus muniamur in corpore et a pravis cogitationibus mundemur in corde.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that with the intercession of your martyr Saint Sebastian, we may be safeguarded from all adversities in our bodies and cleansed from wicked thoughts in our hearts.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente beato Vitale martyre tuo et a cunctis adversitatibus liberemur in corpore et a pravis cogitationibus mundemur in mente.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Almighty God, that through the intercession of blessed Martyr Vitalis, we may be freed from all adversities in body and cleansed from evil thoughts in mind.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut martyrum tuorum iugiter celebremus meritum quorum continuum sentimus auxilium.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that we may always remember the merits of Thy martyrs, whose constant help we feel.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut beati confessoris tui Augustini cuius iugiter celebramus meritum continuum sentiamus auxilium.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, that we may continually feel the help of your blessed confessor Augustine, whose merits we are constantly celebrating.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut mentium reprobarum non curemus obloquium sed eadem pravitate calcata exoramus ut nec terreri nos lacerationibus patiaris iniustis nec captiosis adulationibus implicari sed potius amare quae praecipis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that we may not care for the reproaches of sinners, but rather trample on the same wickedness we ask. May we not be terrified by unjust sufferings nor be ensnared by deceptive flatteries. Instead, may we love what you command.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut munera quae sacris inferuntur altaribus devotis mentibus ad remedium animarum praeparentur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the offerings presented to the devoted altars may be prepared for the salvation of souls.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut observationes sacras annua devotione recolentes et corpore tibi placeamus mente.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Lord, that as we remember with annual devotion the sacred observances, our body may please you according to our mind.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut per haec munera quae Domini nostri Iesu Christi arcanae nativitatis mysterio gerimus purificatae mentis intellegentia consequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, that through these gifts which we bear in the mystery of the hidden nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ, we may attain understanding with a pure mind.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut per intercessionem beati apostoli tui Andreae haec nobis prosit oblatio quam immolando totius mundi tribuisti relaxari delicta.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that through the intercession of Thy blessed Apostle Andrew, this offering may benefit us, which Thou hast granted to be relaxed by the whole world when offered.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut percepta communio singularis animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum sit semper salutaris; sit eis Domine salutare remedium quod in hoc tibi loco divini servitii praeparaverunt obsequium et nobis famulis tuis temporale subsidium.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech You, Lord, that the received communion may always be salutary for the souls of Your servants and handmaids; may it be for them, Lord, a saving remedy which they have prepared in this place of divine service for Your service. May it also provide us, Your servants, with temporal support.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut populus tuus ad plenae devotionis affectum beati baptistae Ioannis nataliciis praeparetur quem praemisisti filio tuo parare plebem perfectam.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that your people may prepare for the birth of the blessed John Baptist with a full devotion. The one whom you promised to your son to prepare the perfect crowd.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut qui malis nostris et casibus contrariis gratulantur cordibus erubescant et vultibus revereantur simulque victi retrorsum convertantur nosque tuo auxilio in oculis illorum sic consolemur ut de misericordiae tuae dono gratulemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you Lord, that those who rejoice at our misfortunes and unfavorable circumstances may blush in their hearts and lower their faces, and at the same time, they turn back defeated. May we be comforted by your aid to such an extent that we thank for your gift from your mercy.

text: Praesta quaesumus. Domine ut quod pro beati Adriani martyris tui festivitate percepimus delictorum nostrorum nobis sit expiatio et salutaris inter quaeque discrimina vegetatio.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord. That what we have received for the feast of your blessed martyr Adrian may be an atonement and a healthful growth for us amidst all our tribulations.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut quod Salvatoris nostri iterata sollemnitate percepimus perpetuae nobis redemptionis conferat medicinam.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that what we have received through the repeated solemnity of our Savior may bestow upon us a medicine of eternal redemption.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut haec munera sacra quae sumpsimus intercedente beata Dei Genitrice semper virgine Maria perpetuae nobis redemptionis conferant medicinam.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that these sacred gifts which we have received, through the intercession of the blessed Mother of God, ever-virgin Mary, may continually bestow upon us the medicine of eternal redemption.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut quos beatae Ethelburgae virginis tuae pia commemoratione caelestibus recreas alimentis eius semper supplicatione ab omni malo defendas.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, that those whom we remember with devotion for the blessed virgin Ethelburga's pious commemoration, You may refresh in celestial sustenance. May her constant supplication always protect them from every evil.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut salutaribus ieiuniis eruditi a noxiis etiam vitiis abstinentes propitiationem tuam facilius remus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the learned through salutary fasting may be freed from harmful vices and through their abstinence more easily find your favor.

text: Praesta nobis quaesumus Domine ut salutaribus ieiuniis eruditi a noxiis quoque vitiis abstinentes propitiationem tuam facilius impetremus
translation_en: Graciously grant us, we beseech you Lord, that being educated by salutary fasting, and abstaining from evil vices as well, we may more easily obtain your forgiveness.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut salutaribus ieiuniis eruditi ab omnibus etiam vitiis abstinentes propitiationem tuam facilius impetremus.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty God, that through the beneficial fasts we may be taught by you to abstain from all sins. May it be easier for us to obtain your forgiveness as a result.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sancta tua nos expient dignosque semper sui perceptione perficiam.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask You, Lord, that Your saints may purify us and always deem us worthy through the experience of Your presence.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sancti confessoris et episcopi tui Donati quem ad laudem nominis tui dicatis muneribus honoramus piae nobis devotionis fructus adcrescat.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the holy confessor and bishop of yours, Donatus, whom we honor with gifts for the praise of your name, may increase the fruits of pious devotion to us.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sancti confessoris tui Remigii intercessio veneranda munera nostra tibi commendet ut per haec piae devotionis nobis fructus adcrescat.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the venerable intercession of your saint Confessor Remigius may commend our merits to you. May it be that through these acts of pious devotion, the fruits increase for us.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut semper nos beati Laurentii laetificent votiva martyria quae semper esse non desinunt admiranda.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that we may always be delighted by the vows of blessed Laurence, whose marvelous martyrdom never ceases to be admired.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sicut de praeteritis ad nova sacramenta transimus ita vetustate deposita sanctificatis mentibus innovemur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that as we move from the past to new sacraments, so may our minds be renewed from the old age being set aside.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sicut de praeteritis ad nova transimus ita vetustate deposita sanctificatis mentibus innovemur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that just as we pass from the past to the new, so leaving behind oldness, we may be renewed in sanctified minds.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sicut hodierna munera veneranda Filii tui oblatione consecrantur sic ipsius gloriosae genitricis precibus sempiterni luminis nobis claritas conferatur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Lord, that just as today's offerings are consecrated by the worthy oblation of your Son, so may the eternal light be bestowed upon us through the prayers of his glorious Mother.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine ut sicut nobis indiscreta pietas horum martyrum beatorum individuae caritatis praebet exemplum sic spiritum gratiae tuae quo iugiter muniamur semper imploret.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, as an incomprehensible piety shows us the example of these blessed martyrs through their individual love, so may your spirit of grace always arm us, that we may continually pray for it.

text: Praesta quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae Domine de tantis digne gaudere principibus et illam perseveranter regulam custodire qua iidem inter verum falsumque dividentes dilectos tibi greges sacris mysteriis imbuerunt.
translation_en: Grant, we ask, O Lord, your Church may worthy rejoice with these princes and may it steadfastly keep the rule by which they have distinguishingly dipped their beloved flocks in the sacred mysteries.

text: Praesta quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae Domine de tantis digne gaudere principibus et illam sequi pia devotione doctrinam qua dilectos tibi greges sacris mysteriis imbuerant.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, Your Church to worthy rejoice with princes and to follow it with pious devotion the doctrine by which You have imbued Your beloved flock with sacred mysteries.

text: Praesta quaesumus misericors Deus ut animae pro quibus hoc sacrificium laudis tuae offerimus maiestati per huius virtutem sacramenti a peccatis omnibus expiatae lucis perpetuae te miserante recipiant beatitudinem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, merciful God, to grant that the souls for whom this sacrifice of your praise is offered to your majesty through the power of this sacrament, having been purified from all sins, receive the blessings of eternal light by your mercy.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens aeterne Deus ut id quod de sancto altario tuo accepimus precibus beati evangelistae tui Lucae sanctificet animas nostras per quod tuti esse possimus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, all-powerful eternal God, that what we have received from your holy altar through the prayers of your blessed evangelist Luke, may sanctify our souls, so that we may be able to safely be.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus mihi famulo tuo meorum veniam peccatorum et Sancti Spiritus gratiam cordi meo clementer infunde ut te perfecte diligere et dine laudare merear.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, Almighty God, to my servant self forgiveness of sins and kindly pour the grace of the Holy Spirit into my heart, so that I may be worthy to love and praise You perfectly.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus per haec sancta mysteria animae famuli tui sacerdotis aeternae felicitatis consortium cui donasti sacri altaris consequi ministerium.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, Almighty God, through these holy mysteries to the soul of Your servant, the priest, eternal happiness participation, which You have granted to achieve the ministry of the sacred altar.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus qui sanctum Albanum martyrem tuum et eius socios eadem tempestate compassos martyrii corona decorare voluisti ut quemadmodum devotam ipsorum passionis agimus memoriam eorum sublimia apud te sentiamus patrocinia.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, who chose your martyr Saint Alban and his companions to be crowned with the same martyrdom's crown during that time, that as we revere their devoted passion in memory, we may feel their exalted patronage before you.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus sic nos ab epulis carnalibus abstinere ut a vitiis irruentibus pariter ieiunemus.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, the strength to abstain from carnal feasts, so that we may fast equally from vices invading us.

text: Praesta quaesumus Domine sic nos ab epulis abstinere carnalibus ut a vitiis irruentibus pariter ieiunemus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that we may abstain from carnal feasts so that together with the temptations we may fast from vices.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ad te toto corde clamantes intercedente beato Petro apostolo tuae pietatis indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we implore you almighty God, that with the whole heart we may call upon you, and through the intercession of the blessed apostle Peter, we may obtain your mercy and indulgence.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut adventus gloriosissimi Filii tui et peccata nostra abluat et populo tuo pacem conferat et salutem.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you Almighty God, that the coming of your most glorious Son may wash away our sins and bring peace and salvation to your people.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut anima famuli et sacerdotis tui illius quidquid conversatione contraxit humana per huius sacramenti mysterium et clementer indulgeas et in tuorum sede constituas redemptorum.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that the soul of your servant and priest may obtain through this sacred mystery whatever it has contracted in human conversation, and that you may graciously forgive and establish them among the redeemed in your seat.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut animam famuli tui illius ab angelis lucis susceptam in praeparata habitacula deduci facias beatorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to grant that the soul of your servant, received by the angels of light, may be led to the prepared dwelling places of the blessed.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut animam famuli tui illius episcopi in congregatione iustorum aeternae beatudinis iubeas esse consortem.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, Almighty God, that the soul of Your servant, that bishop, in the assembly of the just may be permitted to share in eternal beatitude.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beata martyr tua illa nos orationibus suis apud te commendet et incessabiliter contra adversarias potestates defendat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, that your blessed martyr may present us to you with her prayers and continually defend us against opposing powers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatae Felicitatis martyris tuae sollemnia recensentes meritis ipsius protegamur et precibus.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of Your blessed martyr Felicity, we may be protected by her merits and prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatae Mariae semper virginis ventura sollemnitas et praesentis vitae nobis conferat remedia et praemia concedat aeterna.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that the solemnity of the blessed Virgin Mary, ever virgin, which is to come, may grant us remedies and rewards in this life, and may confer eternal blessings upon us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati martyris tui illius sine cessatione venerantes natalitia et fideli muniamur auxilio et magnifico proficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that on the birthday of Your blessed martyr we may be strengthened without ceasing with faithful help and that we may advance with a magnificent example.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Paulini confessoris tui atque pontificis meri votiva sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we celebrate the merited solemnities of your blessed apostle and bishop Saint Paulinus according to his vow.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Petri martyris tui fidem congrua devotione sectemur qui pro eiusdem fidei exaltatione martyrii palmam meruit obtinere.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that we may follow the faith of your blessed martyr Peter with fitting devotion, who merited to obtain the palm of his martyrdom for the exaltation of the same faith.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati sacerdotis tui Clementis adiuvemur auxilio cui in deserto populus ut crederet admirabilem contulisti potentiam ut sitientibus ex tumulis quos eis terra negabat natura fontium liquores produceret.
translation_en: Grant us, we implore you, Almighty God, that we may be helped by the aid of your blessed priest Clement, to whom in the desert a people believed when you showed them an astonishing power, making waters flow from the rocks which nature had denied to them.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatissimi Germani antistitis et confessoris tui cuius exempla miramur et colimus etsi aequari factis eius non possimus saltem vestigia sequi et fidem nobis contingat imitari.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that the blessed Germanus, bishop and confessor of yours, whose examples we admire and venerate although we cannot match his deeds, at least we may follow his footsteps and attain to imitate his faith.

text: Venerabilem diem atque sublimem fratres carissimi prompta devotione celebremus misericordiam Domini nostri suppliciter orantes ut beatissimi Germani antistitis et confessoris sui cuius exempla miramur etsi aequari factis eius non possumus saltem vestigia sequi et fidem nobis contingat imitari.
translation_en: On this venerable and sublime day, our dearest brothers, we celebrate with prompt devotion. We humbly ask the mercy of our Lord that we may be able to imitate the blessed Germanus, our bishop and confessor, whose example we admire, though we cannot equal his deeds, at least let faith reach us to follow his footsteps.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Sisinnii Martyrii et Alexandri sed et sacerdotis et confessoris tui Simpliciani et imitatione te ducem mereamur sectari et oratione tueri.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that we may deserve to follow in the footsteps of your blessed martyrs Sisinnius, Martyrius and Alexander, and your priest and confessor Simplicianus, under your guidance, and protect us by your prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatum Lambertum quem Ecclesiae tuae pontificem concessisti esse et martyrem suffragatorem nos facias habere perennem et ad beatitudinis suae consortia pium introductorem.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Almighty God, to grant us that blessed Lambert, whom you have granted as a bishop for your Church and also as a martyr, may we always have him as our intercessor and a pious introducer into the consortium of his beatitude.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatus Marcellus tibi placita fulgeat sorte pontificatus et pietati tuae nos pia supplicatione commendet.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that blessed Marcellus may shine forth pleasing to you in the lot of pontiff-ship, and commend us to your mercy through our pious petition.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatus sacerdos et martyr tuus Xystus sacris nos exerceat institutis et pie semper faciat in sua confessione constantes.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask, almighty God, that your blessed priest and martyr Saint Cyprian may exercise us with sacred institutions and always make us steadfast in his confession.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatus Stephanus levita magnificus sicut ante alios imitator dominicae passionis et pietatis enituit ita sit fragilitatis nostrae promptus adiutor.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that blessed Stephen the Levite may be an example to others in his imitation of the Lord's Passion and devotion, as he was before. May he be a swift helper for our frailty.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut fragilitati nostrae afflictae in diebus istorum ieiuniorum magnificus levita ac beatus Stephanus auxilium interventionis exhibeat qui imitator dominicae passionis et pietatis primus in cruore martyrii enituit et semper sit perfectus suffragator atque te concedente promptus adiutor.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty and merciful God, to grant us aid through these days of fasting, as the noble Levite Saint Stephen exhibited. He, an imitator of our Lord's Passion and first to shed blood in martyrdom, was always a perfect intercessor for us. With your consent, he stands ready to assist us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut claritatis tuae super nos splendor effulgeat et lux tuae lucis corda eorum qui per gratiam tuam renati sunt Sancti Spiritus illustratione confirmet.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask, Almighty God, that the brilliance of Your light may shine upon us and strengthen the hearts of those who have been reborn through Your grace by the enlightenment of the Holy Spirit.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut continua sanctorum omnium oratio et nobis praebeat incitamenta virtutum et multiplici nos ubique suffragio consoletur.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we humbly ask you almighty God, that the continuous prayer of all saints may inspire in us the incentives of virtues and comfort us everywhere with their numerous intercessions.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut de perceptis muneribus gratias exhibentes beneficia potiora sumamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that as we render thanks for the gifts received, we may obtain yet greater blessings.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut dignitas condicionis humanae per immoderantiam sauciata medicinalis parsimoniae studio reformetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that the dignity of the human condition, wounded by excessive disregard, may be restored through the careful study of moderate medicine.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut divino munere satiati et sacris mysteriis innovemur et moribus.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that being satisfied by divine grace, we may be renewed and our conduct transformed.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Ecclesia tua competenter post nativitatem Domini nostri Iesu Christi sollemnitate beati Stephani gratuletur quem primum cognovit confessum sui potentiam Salvatoris.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that your Church may fittingly celebrate the feast of Saint Stephen, the first to confess the power of our Savior Jesus Christ after his nativity.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Ecclesia tua quae iterato nativitatem praecursoris Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi et baptistae in octavo veneratur ipso pro ea apud tuam misericordiam praeveniente a peccatis omnibus te miserante liberari mereatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that your Church, which honors again the nativity of the forerunner of Your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, and John the Baptist on the eighth day, may through its approach to Your mercy preceding it from all sins, be worthy to merit Your forgiveness.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut et hi martyres tui pro nobis interveniant quorum clara prior est confessio quam loquela.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, almighty God, that these your martyrs may intercede for us, whose clear confession is more prominent than their speech.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut excellentiam Verbi tui quam beatus evangelista Ioannes asseruit et convenienter intellegere valeamus et veraciter confiteri.
translation_en: Grant us, O almighty God, that we may understand with fitting excellence the power of your Word, as the blessed evangelist John asserted, and confess truthfully.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut familia tua per viam salutis incedat et beati Ioannis praecursoris hortamenta sectando ad eum quem praedixit secura perveniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty God, that Your family may walk the way of salvation and following the exhortations of blessed John the Baptist, may reach securely Him whom he preached.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut famulus tuus rex noster qui tua miseratione suscepit regni gubernacula a te percipiat virtutum omnium incrementa ut in eo prudentia principaliter regnet fortitudo quod prudentia invenerit fortiter agat iustitia fortia acta exornet temperantia iustitiam ne modum excedat temperet quatenus hanc viam regiam teneat vitiorum monstra quae illam hinc inde circumstant devitare valeat et ad te qui via veritas et vita es gratiosus adveniat.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, Almighty God, that Your servant, our king, who has received the governance of the kingdom by Your mercy, may receive the increase of all virtues. May wisdom rule in him preeminently, strength act forcefully what wisdom finds, justice be adorned by strong acts, temperance moderate justice so that it does not exceed its bounds, and may he be able to avoid the temptations of vices which surround this royal path from here and there. And may he approach You, who are truth and life, with gratitude.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut fidelibus tuis ordinatum praebeamus affectum eisque nos similiter diligendi spiritum benignus infunde ut in tua fide spe et caritate sincera sacrificium tibi placitum deferatur et plebis et praesulis.
translation_en: Graciously grant, Almighty God, that we may provide to your faithful an ordered affection towards them, and similarly infuse in us a benign spirit of loving them. May their sacrifice pleasing to You be offered in faith, hope, and sincere charity, both from the people and the clergy.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens deus ut fidelibus tuis ordinatum praebeamus affectum eisque nos similiter Spiritum Sanctum diligendi benignus infunde.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, to grant us a faithful disposition towards your followers and likewise pour upon us the loving Holy Spirit.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Filii tui ventura sollemnitas et praesentis nobis vitae remedia conferat et praemia aeterna concedat.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the solemnity of your Son's coming may bestow upon us the remedies for our present life and grant us eternal rewards.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut haec oblatio omnium sanctorum martyrum tuorum inter tiam nobis tuae propitiationis acquirat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that this offering of all your holy martyrs may acquire for us the merits of your propitiatory intervention.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut hanc tibi hostiam in eius corpus et sanguinem consecrandam venerabiliter offeramus quem sedentem a dextris virtutis tuae et pro nobis interpellare confidimus.
translation_en: Grant us, O almighty God, that we may reverently offer this host as a sacrifice to you, to be consecrated into its body and blood. We trust that it is seated at your right hand, the seat of Your power, and intercede for us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut hoc tuum sacramentum non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sed intercessio salutaris ad veniam sit ablutio scelerum sit fortitudo fragilium sit contra mundi pericula firmamentum.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, almighty God, that this your sacrament may not be for us a burden leading to punishment but rather a saving intercession for forgiveness, a cleansing of sins, a strength for the weak, and a protection against the perils of the world.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut huius paschalis festivitatis mirabile sacramentum et temporalem nobis tranquillitatem tribuat et vitam conferat sempiternam.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that this Paschal festival's wonderful sacrament and temporal peace be bestowed upon us, and that it confer upon us eternal life.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut inter innumeros vitae praesentis errores tuo semper moderamine dirigamur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that amidst the countless errors of our present life, we may always be guided by your moderation.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercessione beatae Potentianae virginis sacramenta quae sumpsimus ad praesentem nobis perpetuamque proficiant salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty God, that through the intercession of Blessed Potentia the Virgin, the sacraments we have received may profit us with salvation both in the present and perpetually.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercessione beati Apollinaris martyris tui atque pontificis a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus liberemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that through the intercession of your blessed martyr and bishop Saint Apollinaris, may we be freed from the bonds of our sins.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nos beati illius martyris tui atque pontificis interventio gloriosa commendet ut quod nostris actibus non meremur eius precibus assequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we implore Almighty God, that through the glorious intervention of your blessed martyr and bishop, we may obtain what we do not deserve by our actions, through his prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nos geminata laetitia hodiernae festivitatis excipiat quae de beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Protasii et Gervasii glorificatione procedit quos eadem fides et passio fecit esse germanos.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, almighty God, that the joy of today's double feast may receive us, which proceeds from the glorification of your most blessed martyrs Protasius and Gervasius, whom the same faith and passion made brothers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nostrae mentis intentio quo sollemnitatis hodiernae gloriosus auctor ingressus est semper intendat et quo fide pergit conversatione perveniat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that our mind's intention, which the glorious author of today's solemnity has entered, may always be directed, and that it may reach where faith goes through conduct.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nullis nos permittas perturbationibus concuti quos in apostolicae confessionis petra solidasti.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You almighty God, that You do not allow us to be shaken by any disturbances which You have stabilized upon the rock of the apostolic confession.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per haec paschalia festa quae colimus devoti in tua semper laude vivamus.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Almighty God, that through these Easter festivals which we celebrate, we may always live devotedly in your praise.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per haec sacrosancta commercia in totius ecclesiae confidamus corpore faciendum quod eius praecessit in capite.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that through these sacred transactions, we may confidently believe that the body will be made by him who went before in head within the whole church.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per intercessionem omnium sanctorum (vel sancti illius cuius natalitium hodie celebratur) hoc munus quod sumpsimus et nobis remissionem peccatorum tribuat et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum prosit ad veniam et haec oblatio quae totius mundi tulit immolata peccata pro quibus misericordiam tuam humiliter imploramus tribuat refrigerium sempiternum et quibus donas baptismi sacramentum in regeneratione sanctorum tuorum iubeas dare consortium et plenitudinem gaudiorum.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, through the intercession of all saints (or the saint whose nativity is celebrated today), that this gift which we have taken may grant us forgiveness of sins and benefit the souls and servants and servants of yours. May this offering which was carried from every corner of the world as a sacrifice for sins, which we humbly implore your mercy, grant eternal refreshment. And to those whom you bestow with the sacrament of baptism, in the regeneration of your saints, we pray that you command them to have unity and fullness of joys.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per intercessionem sancti confessoris tui Epartii cuius hodie annua depositionis festa celebramus oblata sacrificia placido respectu suscipias <ac> pia dignatione benedicas et ad aeternam beatitudinem <nos> praeparare digneris.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, through the intercession of your holy confessor Epatarious whose annual feast of deposition we celebrate today, that you accept our offerings with peaceful regard and bless us with pious grace, and deem us worthy to be prepared for eternal beatitude.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut populus tuus ad plenae devotionis affectum beatorum martyrum illorum nataliciis praeparetur et eorum patrocinio promerente plenae capiat securitatis augmentum.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you almighty God, that your people may prepare themselves with a full devotion to the feast of those blessed martyrs, and may obtain an increase in security through their patronage.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut pro honore nominis tui quorum celebramus insignia continuis etiam precibus foveamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that through the honor of your name which we celebrate, we may be continually nourished with persistent prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut pro honore nominis tui sancti Maurilionis confessoris tui atque ponti reis; cuius celebramus insignem festivitatem continuis etiam precibus foveamur.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that for the honor of your name, Saint Maurilius, your confessor and bishop, whose festival we celebrate, we may nurture our constant prayers as well.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beatae Mariae Aegypticae quam a peccatorum voragine revocasti sollemnitatem agimus eius intervenientibus meritis ab omni us liberemur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that since you have recalled the blessed Mary of Egypt from the maw of sins' whirlpool, we may be freed from all evil through her merits during this solemnity.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Albani martyris tui gloriosa merita veneramur eius apud te meritis et precibus semper muniamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to grant that we may revere the glorious merits of Blessed Alban, your martyr, and always be protected by his merits and prayers with you.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Gregorii confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnia colimus eius apud te patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the solemnities of your confessor and bishop, blessed Gregory, we may feel his patronage with you.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati confessoris tui atque pontificis illius natalicia praevenimus meritis eius et precibus iugiter muniamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, to grant us that we may precede the birthday of your blessed confessor and pope by his merits, and may always be strengthened by his prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Laudi confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnia colimus eius intercessione aeternam beatitudinem consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that we who celebrate the solemnity of your blessed confessor and pope may attain eternal beatitude through his intercession.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Mennae martyris tui natalicia colimus intercessione eius in tui nominis amore roboremur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the birthday of Your blessed martyr Menna, we may be strengthened by his intercession through Your divine love.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Pantaleonis martyris tui temporali sollemnitate gaudemus vitae gaudiis perfruamur aeternae.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech you Almighty God, that we who rejoice in the temporal feast of your blessed martyr Pantaleon, may be enriched with the joys of eternal life.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati Valentini martyris tui natalicia colimus a cunctis malis imminentibus eius intercessione liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the birthday of your blessed martyr Valentine may be freed from all dangers approaching through his intercession.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sanctorum tuorum Alexandri Eventii et Theoduli natalicia colimus a cunctis malis imminentibus eorum intercessionibus liberemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that we who celebrate the birth of your saints Alexander, Eventius and Theodulus may be freed from all dangers threatening them through their intercessions.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia alimenta percepimus intercedente beato Ioanne Baptista per haec contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that we who have received celestial food with the intervention of blessed John the Baptist, may be fortified against all adversities through this.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia sacramenta percepimus intercedente Rocho confessore tuo per haec contra omnia adversa mundi muniamur et ab omni morbo et peste ac a subitanea morte liberemur.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who have received the heavenly sacraments with your confessor Roch interceding for us, may be fortified against all the evils of the world and freed from every sickness, plague, and sudden death.
