text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui de genitricis gloriosae compassionem pia devotione recolimus sacri illius mysterii quo Filius tuus in cruce discipulum ei et ipsam discipulo commendavit virtute huius sacramenti quod sumpsimus participes efficiamur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that as we remember with pious devotion the compassion of your glorious Mother towards your Son on the cross, and as he commended himself and her to his disciple through the power of this sacrament which we have received, we who have partaken in it may be made effective.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi incarnationis nativitatis passionis resurrectionis adscensionis et adventus Spiritus Sancti memoriam debita venerationis laude (per)colimus ipsi per eiusdem Sancti Spiritus gratiam a morte animae resurgamus et in tua semper sanctificatione vivamus.
translation_en: Graciously hear us, Almighty God, that we who commemorate the memory of Your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, born of the Incarnation, suffering through Passion, resurrected from Death, ascended into Heaven, and await the coming of the Holy Spirit, may rise from death through the same grace of the Holy Spirit, and live always in Your sanctification.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui gloriosos martyres fortes in sua confessione cognovimus pios apud te in nostra intercessione sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that we who have known the glorious martyrs to be brave in their confession may feel them to be devout on our behalf in your presence through our intercession.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui gratiam dominicae resurrectionis agnovimus ipsi per amorem spiritus a morte resurgamus.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who have recognized the grace of the Lord's Resurrection may ourselves rise from death through the love of the Holy Spirit.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui hodierna die depositionem sacratissimam beati Gaugerici confessoris tui atque pontificis annuatim excolimus eius pia interventione peccatorum a te veniam mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that as we annually celebrate the venerable deposition of your confessor and bishop, Blessed Gaugericus, on this day, through his holy intervention, may we merit forgiveness for our sins from you.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui in afflictione nostra de tua pietate confidimus contra adversa omnia tua semper protectione muniamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that we who trust in Your pity during our affliction, may always be fortified with Your eternal protection against all adversities.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui in memoriam passionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi coronam eius spineam veneramur in terris ab ipso gloria et honore coronari mereamur in caelis.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we who venerate in memory the crown of thorns worn by our Lord Jesus Christ on earth, may be worthy to be crowned with glory and honor by Him in heaven.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui in sanctarum virginum et martyrum tuarum illius et illius sollemnitate percepimus divina mysteria earum intercessione remedia capere mereamur aeterna.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that we who have perceived the divine mysteries of your saints and martyrs during their feast days, may be worthy to receive their intercession and eternal remedies through their prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui in tua protectione confidimus cuncta nobis adversantia te adiuvante superemus.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that we who trust in your protection may overcome all adversities with your help.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui iram tuae indignationis agnovimus misericordiae tuae indulgentiam consequamur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, almighty God, that we who have recognized your wrath and indignation may obtain the indulgence of your mercy.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui iugiter apostolica defensione munimur nec succumbamus vitiis nec opprimamur adversis.
translation_en: Grant us, O almighty God, that we who are continually protected by the apostolic defense, may not yield to vices nor be overwhelmed by adversities.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui nostris excessibus incessanter affligimur per unigeniti tui passionem liberemur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that we who are continually afflicted by our own excesses may be freed through the passion of your only-begotten Son.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui offensam nostram per flagella cognoscimus tuae consolationis gratiam sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that we who know our offense through your scourges may feel the grace of your consolation.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui paschalia festa peregimus haec te largiente moribus et vita teneamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty God, that we who have passed through the Paschal feasts, may by your grace maintain these customs and this life.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui paschalia sacramenta percepimus aeternae vitae gaudia percipere mereamur.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that we who have received the Paschal sacraments may deserve to experience the joys of eternal life.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui pro nostris excessibus incessanter affligimur tuae pietatis in omnibus protectione consolemur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who are constantly troubled by our sins may find consolation in all things through your mercy.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui recolendo natalicia sanctorum tuorum temporaliter gaudemus ipsorum obtentu perennis laetitiae ubertate in futuro cum ipsis exsultare mereamur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of your saints for a time, we may deserve through their merits to rejoice forever with them in the future.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui resurrectionis dominicae sollemnia colimus ereptionis nostrae suscipere laetitiam mereamur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that we who celebrate the solemnity of the Lord's resurrection may deserve to receive the joy of our own resurrection.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui sanctorum tuorum Tiburtii Valeriani et Maximi sollemnia colimus eorum etiam virtutes imitemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the feast of your saints Tiburtius and Valentinus, we may also emulate their virtues.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui se affligendo carne ab alimentis abstinent sectando iustitiam a culpa ieiunent.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you almighty God, that he who afflicts himself by abstaining from meat for the sake of justice, may be free from sin through fasting.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut familia tua quae se affligendo carne ab alimentis abstinet sectando iustitiam a culpa ieiunet.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that your family who afflicts itself with flesh abstains from food in following justice and fasts from sin.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui tuae maiestatis effectu per Filii tui mirabile sacramentum cooperante spiritu sancto sunt renati caelestis vitae fiant conversatione perpetui.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that those who were renewed by the power of your majesty through the miraculous sacrament of your Son and guided by the Holy Spirit may become partakers of eternal life through a perpetual way of living.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quia pro peccatis nostris meremur affligi per adventum Filii tui a cunctis adversitatibus liberemur.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that since for our sins we deserve to be afflicted by the coming of Your Son, we may be freed from all adversities.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quod fragili supplemus officio tuo potius perficiatur effectu.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that what we weakly fulfill with our office may be more effectively accomplished through your power.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quod nostra con; scientia non praesumit eius qui tibi fideliter servivit inter veniente auxilio consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that what our conscience knows not presumptuously, may him who faithfully serves you deserve to attain as aid comes.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quos aqua suscepit ad abluendos (paternae protectionis auxilium) et re generandos muniat et renatos.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, to provide the aid of your fatherly protection for those whom water received to cleanse and remake, and to arm and protect those who have been renewed.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quos ieiunia votiva castigant ipsa quoque devotio sancta laetificet ut terrenis affectibus mitigatis facilius caelestia capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the self-imposed fasting may also be sweetened by holy devotion, so that we can more easily grasp heavenly things, and that our earthly emotions may be softened.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut redemptionis nostrae ventura sollemnitas et praesentis nobis vitae subsidia conferat et aeternae beatitudinis praemia largiatur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that the approaching solemnity of our redemption may bestow upon us support for this present life and lavish upon us the rewards of eternal beatitude.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacramentum corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi quod in festivitate beatae Luciae virginis et martyris tuae sumpsimus ad salutem nostrarum proficiat animarum.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the sacrament of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ which we have received on the feast day of the blessed Virgin and martyr Lucia may benefit our souls.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Salvatoris mundi stella duce manifestata nativitas mentibus nostris reveletur semper et crescat.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the manifestation of the star which guided the Savior of the world may always be revealed to our minds and grow.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctae Sotheris cuius humanitatis celebramus exordia martyrii beneficia sentiamus.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Almighty God, that we may experience the blessings of the holy Saint Swithun, whose beginning of martyrdom we celebrate.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctae virginis tuae Teclae cuius victoriosissima tibi complacuit passio clementiae tuae nos commendet intercessio.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the holy virgin Tecla, whose triumphant passion has pleased you, may recommend us by your mercy through her intercession.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cypriani et Iustinae deprecationibus sacramenta quae sumpsimus ad tuae nobis proficiant placationis augmentum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that through the intercessions of your saints Cyprian and Justina, the sacraments we have received may bring an increase in blessings to us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum tuorum Simplicii Faustini et Beatricis caelestibus mysteriis celebrata sollemnitas indulgentiam nobis tuae propitiationis acquirat.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that the solemnity of your saints Simplicius, Faustinus, and Beatrix celebrated in heavenly mysteries may obtain for us the indulgence through your propitiation.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum tuorum quorum reliquiae in hac continentur ecclesia nos protegant merita quatenus eorum precibus tranquilla pace in tua iugiter laude laetemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, almighty God, that the relics of your saints contained within this church may protect us through their merits, so that we may always rejoice in peaceful tranquility with constant praise in your name.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut semper rationabilia meditantes quae tibi sunt placita et dictis exsequamur et factis.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that we may always think of reasonable things that please you and carry out what we say and do.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per haec mysteria quae sumpsimus rex noster et regina et populus christianus semper rationabilia meditantes quae tibi sunt placita et dictis exsequantur et factis.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Almighty God, that through these mysteries which we have received, our King and Queen and the Christian people may always meditate on reasonable things pleasing to You and carry out Your words and deeds.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beati Leodegarii antistitis vita virtutibus clara et mors martyrii consummatione refulsit insignis ita meritis ipsius honestae vitae forma nostris resplendeat moribus et actibus
translation_en: Grant us, O almighty God, that just as the life and virtues of Blessed Bishop Leodegar shone brightly, and his death was completed by martyrdom, so may the merits of his honorable life illuminate our behavior and actions.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beatorum martyrum natalicia praevenimus sic aures misericordiae tuae pro nobis semper praeveniant.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the birthdays of the blessed martyrs, so may our ears always be preceded by your mercy for us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beatorum martyrum tuorum Crispini et Crispiani natalicia colimus sic aures tuae misericordiae pro nobis semper implorent.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that as we celebrate the nativity of your blessed martyrs Crispin and Crispian, so our ears may always implore Your mercy on our behalf.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beati Christophori martyris tui natalicia celebramus sic ad aures misericordiae tuae semper praeveniat ipse pro nobis.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Almighty God, that just as we celebrate the birthday of your blessed martyr Christopher, he may always precede us to the ears of your mercy on our behalf.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut beatos apostolos tuos praedicatio sancta in tota ecclesia fecit gloriosos ita (per eorum merita) et per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus et eorum sequi documenta et gaudia consequi mereamur aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, that just as your holy preaching made the blessed apostles glorious throughout the whole church, so may we (through their merits) and through these sacraments we have received, and by following their teachings and attaining their joys, deserve eternal glory.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut devotissime beati Birini confessoris tui atque pontificis annua depositionis sollemnia veneramur sic per ipsum misericordiam tuam hic et in caelo consequamur.
translation_en: Graciously grant, we beseech you Almighty God, that just as we reverently celebrate the annual solemnities of your confessor and bishop, Blessed Birinus, so through his intercession we may obtain your mercy here on earth and in heaven.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut divina laudamus in sancti Stephani passione magnalia sic indulgentiam tuam piis eius precibus assequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Almighty God, that just as we praise the great deeds of St. Stephen in his passion, so we may obtain Your mercy through his pious prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut divina laudamus in sancti Martini confessoris tui atque pontificis sollemnitate magnalia sic indulgentiam tuam piis eius precibus assequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that just as we praise your great deeds in the feast of your confessor and bishop Saint Martin, so may we attain your mercy through his pious prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus misericors Deus ut sicut divina offerimus in sanctae Caeciliae virginis tuae sollemnitate sacramenta sic indulgentiae tuae largitatem piis eius precibus assequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, merciful God, that just as we offer the sacraments in honor of your saint Cecilia's feast day, so too may we obtain your grace through her prayers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut hodierna sanctorum Augustini sociorumque eius translatione illustramur ita apud te in aeterno tantorum patronorum splendore laetemur.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Almighty God, that just as we are enlightened today by the translation of the saints Augustine and his companions, so may we rejoice in their glorious patronage for eternity.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut interventu beati levitae et martyris tui Vincentii mundana prosperitate laetamur ita et devotiores efficiamur caelestibus institutis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, almighty God, that just as we are rejoiced with worldly prosperity by the intervention of your blessed deacon and martyr Vincent, so may we also be made more devoted to celestial teachings.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut nobis per doctrinam apostolicam catholicae fidei rudimenta donasti ita etiam imploratu beati apostoli tui illius caelestia tribuas sine fine praesidia.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask You, Almighty God, that just as You have given us the rudiments of the apostolic doctrine of the Catholic faith, so too may You grant us, through the intercession of Your blessed Apostle, eternal protection without end.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut publicanum humiliter deprecantem exaltans iustificare dignatus es ita hunc famulum tuum illum in paenitentia fletu iacentem erigens iustificare et ad aeterna perducere digneris promissa.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to raise up the publican who humbly pleaded as you did, and grant that this your servant lying in penitence and weeping may be justified and worthy of being led to eternal life according to your promises.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut tuus unigenitus nostram in se naturam prae solis fulgore splendidam declaravit ita virtutum luce nitidos tuae nos tribuas maiestati praesentari.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, almighty God, that just as your only-begotten Son revealed our nature in himself with the brilliance of the sun's radiance, so may you grant us to present ourselves with the brightness of virtues before your majesty.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut spiritus adveniens maiestatem nobis Filii tui manifestando clarificet.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, almighty God, that the Spirit coming may manifest to us the majesty of Your Son and enlighten us.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Verbum caro factum quod beatus Ioannes evangelista praedicavit per hoc sui mysterium habitet semper in nobis.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech you, Almighty God, that the Word made flesh, which the blessed John the Evangelist preached, may always dwell within us through this mystery.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut anima famuli tui illius qui pro tui nominis amore a saeculi huius vanitate conversus cursum suum coenobialiter consummavit in sinu Abrahae recepta non timeat in adventu gloriae tuae sed secura de regni tui gloria vitam aeternam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty and merciful God, that the soul of your servant, who converted from this world's vanity for love of your name, completed his course monastically in the embrace of Abraham, may not fear in the coming of your glory but securely may merit to obtain eternal life in your kingdom's glory.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut animae famulorum tuorum illorum indulgentiam peccatorum et gaudia perpetua(e) lucis inveniant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, O almighty and merciful God, to grant the souls of your servants there, forgiveness for their sins and eternal joy in the light of heaven.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut haec salutaris oblatio famulum tuum illum et a propriis reatibus indesinenter expediat et ab omnibus tueatur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, O Almighty and merciful God, to grant that this saving offering may continually free your servant from his own sins and protect him from all dangers.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut inter huius vitae caligines nee ignorantia fallente mergamur nee praecipiti Studeamus voluntate peccare sed quibus fiduciam sperandae pietatis indulges optatae misericordiae praesta benignus effectum.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, that in the fog of this life we may not be deceived and plunged into ignorance, nor fall headlong. May we strive with a willing heart to sin, but rather receive grace from You, worthy of trusting devotion, bestow upon us Your desired mercy.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus interveniente beato Matthia apostolo tuo veniam consequamur et pacem.
translation_en: Graciously hear our prayer, Almighty and merciful God, that through these holy things we have received, with the intercession of your blessed apostle Matthew, we may attain forgiveness and peace.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut qui sanctorum martyrum (vel confessorum) tuorum sollemnia agimus liberati a malis omnibus in tua semper benedictione et laude laeti maneamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty and merciful God, that we who celebrate the solemnities of your saints (or confessors), may always be free from all evils in your constant blessing and joyfully remain in your praise.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sancti Gorgonii martyris tui cuius hodierna die annuam sollemnitatem colimus intercessione auxilium tuum super nos sentiamus atque dexterae tuae <potentiam> propitiatus extende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty and merciful God, that on the anniversary of your holy martyr Gorgonius, whom we celebrate today, through his intercession, may we feel your help upon us, and may your power be extended towards us as a sign of your favor.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sicut beatum Iulianum coniugali toro sociatum virginitatis cultu decibiliter decorasti ita nos famulos tuos per eius intercessionis auxilium a sordibus piaculorum abluas et corda nostra claritate tuae gratiae irradiare digneris.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty and merciful God, that just as you adorned blessed Julian with the cult of virginity in conjugal union, so you wash us, your servants, through his intercession's aid from the filth of sins, and deign to irradiate our hearts with the light of your grace.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sicut in condemnatione Filii tui salus omnium fuit piaculum perfidorum ita per misericordiam tuam communis sit cultus iste credentium.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, Almighty and merciful God, that just as in the condemnation of Your Son, salvation was the atonement for all, so through Your mercy, may this worship be common to those who believe.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut sicut legio sancta pro tui nominis confessione meruit victoriae palmam ita et nos supplices eorum festa devotis mentibus celebrantes participes gaudiorum effici mereamur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech You, Almighty and merciful God, that just as the Holy Legion merited to obtain victory's palm for Your name's confession, so also we, suppliantly celebrating their feast with devout minds, may be worthy to become participants in their joy.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut Spiritus Sanctus adveniens templum nos gloriae suae dignanter habitando perficiat.
translation_en: Grant, we humbly ask you, almighty and merciful God, that the Holy Spirit coming upon us may worthily dwell within us, perfecting us with his glory.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut virtute sanctae crucis ab omni adversitate mentis et corporis liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty and merciful God, to deliver us from all adversity of mind and body with the power of the Holy Cross.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens sempiterne Deus per unigenitum tuum tuae salvationis auxilium ut percepta securitate de imminenti barbarica crudelitate absolute et libere deinceps mereamur tibi tota mentis intentione servire.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty everlasting God, through your only-begotten Son, may we merit, by perceiving secure deliverance from the impending barbaric cruelty absolutely and freely, to serve you wholeheartedly with our entire mind's intention.

text: Praesta quaesumus rerum universarum conditor Deus ut huius perceptio muneris sit nobis purificatio mentis et corporis et suffragantibus istis virginibus sacris praemium caelestis hereditatis.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, O Creator of all things God, that through this receiving of alms may be a purification for our mind and body, and to these sacred virgins offering assistance, may be a reward of celestial inheritance.

text: Praestent Domine quaesumus tua sancta praesidium quae intervenientibus beati Gregorii meritis ab omnibus nos absolvant peccatis.
translation_en: Lord, as we ask, present your holy protection that, through the merits of Blessed Gregory, they may absolve us from all sins.

text: Praestet nobis Domine tua misericordia ut sumpta sancta libamina beati Quintini martyris interventione pia nos famulos tuos reparent et a laesione tueantur universa.
translation_en: May your mercy, Lord, be upon us, that we, through the intercession of the blessed Quintinus the martyr, may be brought back and protected from all harm as your servants.

text: Praestet nobis tua Domine misericordia ut sumpta libamina nobis sanctorum Coronatorum pia postulatione peccatorum obtineant veniam.
translation_en: May your mercy, Lord, be upon us that the prayers of the holy Coronators for our sins may obtain forgiveness for us through their pious intercession.

text: Praestet nobis Domine tui perceptio sacramenti intercedente beato Benedicto consessore tuo atque abbate ut et conversationis eius imitemur exempla et pertingamus ad praemia.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the understanding of your sacred mystery, with the intercession of the blessed Benedict, your bishop and abbot, that we may imitate his examples and reach the rewards.

text: Praetende Domine famulis et famulabus tuis illis dexteram caelestis auxilii ut te toto corde perquirant et quae digne postulant assequamur.
translation_en: Bend to us, Lord, Your servants and handmaids, that they may seek You with all their heart, and we may attain what is fittingly asked for.

text: Praetende Domine fidelibus tuis omnibus episcopis abbatibus canonicis monachis sive regibus et gubernatoribus atque consanguineis nostris et his qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas seu etiam ceteris fidelibus utriusque sexus dexteram caelestis auxilii ut te toto corde perquirant et quae digne postulant consequi mereantur.
translation_en: Lord, stretch forth Your favor towards all Your faithful: bishops, abbots, canons, monks, kings, governors, and relatives, as well as those who have commended themselves to us with prayers, and have bestowed alms upon us. Moreover, let it be granted to the rest of the faithful, both male and female, the right hand of heavenly help, that they may seek You wholeheartedly and may merit what is fittingly requested.

text: Praetende Domine fidelibus tuis dexteram caelestis auxilii ut et te toto corde perquirant et quae digne postulant consequi mereantur.
translation_en: Lord, stretch forth Your right hand of heavenly aid towards Your faithful, that they may seek You with all their heart and may deserve to attain what is fittingly asked for.

text: Praetende Domine misericordiam tuam et esto populi tui defensor et custos ut sanctorum tuorum veneranda sollemnia securo possint frequentare conventu.
translation_en: Lord, extend Your mercy and be the defender and protector of Your people, that they may securely be able to attend the venerable festivals of Your saints in assembly.

text: Praetende munera quaesumus Domine altaribus tuis pro beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Protasii et Gervasii commemoratione praeposita ut sicut per haec beata mysteria illis gloriam contulisti ita nobis indulgentiam largiaris.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you bestow gifts upon your altars on the commemoration of the blessed martyrs Protasius and Gervasius, just as through these holy mysteries you conferred glory upon them. May you grant us forgiveness in return.

text: Praetende nobis Domine misericordiam tuam et sanctos tuos quorum nos dedisti patrociniis adiuvari tribue maiestatem tuam iugiter exorare pro nobis.
translation_en: Lord, stretch out to us thy mercy, and thy saints whom thou hast given as our patrons, grant that they may assist us. May thy majesty be continually interceding for us.

text: Praetende nobis Domine misericordiam tuam et tribue ut sanctus martyr tuus Theodorus cuius nos dedisti patrociniis adiuvari maiestatem tuam iugiter exoret pro nobis.
translation_en: Lord, stretch towards us thy mercy and grant that thy holy martyr Theodore, to whom thou hast given us as patron, may ever intercede for us before thy majesty.

text: Praetende nobis Domine misericordiam tuam et beati Aegidii abbatis intercessio cuius nos dedisti patrociniis adiuvari tribue ut maiestatem tuam iugiter exoret pro nobis.
translation_en: Lord, stretch out to us thy mercy and the intercession of blessed Abbot St. Giles, whom thou hast given as patron to help us; may it ever entreat thy majesty on our behalf.

text: Praetende nobis Domine misericordiam tuam ut quae votis expetimus conversatione tibi placita consequamur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, your mercy that we may obtain what we have sought through pleasing you in our way of life.

text: Praetende nobis Domine quaesumus misericordiae tuae suffragium et beati Aegidii abbatis nos foveat intercessio ut eius feliciter celebremus gloriae triumphum quem mirificatum adscivisti hodierna die civium collegio supernorum.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, Your mercy's support and the intercession of blessed Abbot Giles may protect us, so that we may celebrate with joy the triumph of glory which You miraculously granted to the community of citizens today.

text: Praeveniant nobis Domine quaesumus apostoli tui desiderata commercia ut quorum perpetuam dignitatem sacro my(ni)sterio frequentamus in terris et praesentia nobis subsidia postulent et aeterna.
translation_en: May your apostles' desired commerce precede us, Lord, as we humbly ask; so that we, who frequent the sacred ministry of their perpetual dignity on earth, may demand and receive from you here present support, and eternal life.

text: Praeveniant nos Domine quaesumus beatissimi martyris tui Nazarii desiderata commercia ut cuius perpetuam dignitatem sacro ministerio frequentamus in terris et praesentia nobis subsidia postulent et aeterna.
translation_en: May your blessed martyr, Nazarius, precede us, we beseech you, Lord, with his desired commerce. So that we, who frequently participate in his perpetual dignity through sacred ministry on earth, may demand support from him here and seek aid from him afterwards, and eternal.

text: Praeveniat nos quaesumus Domine gratia tua semper et subsequatur et has oblationes quas pro peccatis nostris nomini tuo consecrandas deferimus benignus assume ut per intercessionem sanctorum tuorum cunctis nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: May your grace, we beseech you, Lord, always precede and follow, and may these offerings which we bring for our sins to consecrate to your name be accepted graciously. May the benevolent one assume them, that through the intercession of your saints they may all profit us for salvation.

text: Praeveniat nos quaesumus Domine misericordia tua et voces nostras clementia tuae propitiationis anticipet.
translation_en: May Your mercy, Lord, precede us and may the voices of our petitions be anticipated by Your clemency and favor.

text: Praeveniat nos quaesumus omnipotens Deus tua gratia semper et subsequatur ut per adventum Filii tui quem summo cordis desiderio sustinemus et praesentis vitae subsidia.
translation_en: May it always precede us, we pray, Almighty God, your grace, and may it follow us so that through the coming of Your Son whom we sustain with the highest heart's desire, we may be supported and sustained in this present life.

text: Praeveniat nos quaesumus omnipotens Deus tua gratia et subsequatur ut per ieiunium quod summo cordis desiderio exsolvimus et praesentis vitae subsidia et futurae etiam assequamur.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to you, Almighty God, that your grace precedes us and follows, so that through the fasting which we undertake with the utmost heart's desire, we may obtain the aid for our present life and also attain the rewards of the future.

text: Precamur Dei patris omnipotentis misericordiam ut placatus devotione nostra suscipiat atque multiplicet ex abundantia sua a nobis faenus impensum; martyres etiam confessoresque suos quorum victorias ac triumphos celebrat nostra confessio exoratores pro criminum nostrorum qualitatibus libens et placatus exaudiat orantes ipsius misericordiam ut eorum adiuvemur meritis ut nostris non irascatur offensis.
translation_en: We pray to the almighty Father of God for his mercy, that being pleased with our devotion, he receives and multiplies from his abundant resources the offerings made by us; also we pray for his martyrs and confessors whose victories and triumphs are celebrated in our confession, we humbly ask and are pleased to listen to the prayers of these same ones, that their mercy may help us because of the qualities of our sins. We pray that they will not be angry at our offenses because of their merits.

text: Precamur Domine Iesu Christe ut expletis sacrificiorum mysteriis quique nunc spiritalis vitae alimentum ab incarnatione suscepimus ineffabilibus deliciis cum tua apparuerit gloria satiemur.
translation_en: We pray, Lord Jesus Christ, that after completing the mysteries of the sacrifices, those who now sustain spiritual life by receiving nourishment from Your incarnation may be satisfied with ineffable delights when Your glory appears.

text: Precamur Domine sancte Pater aeterne omnipotens Deus qui omnium corda perscrutas et vota perpendis ut non solum proditis petitionibus verum etiam occultis desideriis nostris benignus faveas et adesse digneris. Ad quaecumque enim poscenda concurrimus universa priusquam loquamur intellegis.  Offerimus itaque obsecrationes nostras pro egestate inopum pro laboribus pupillorum pro iniuria vinctorum pro securitate viantium pro consolatione et requie defunctorum et pro his qui sulcandum navibus aequor adripiunt ut reddantur in adverso securi. Febres omnes passionesque a languentibus excludantur neque in aliquos immundi spiritus temptatio potestatem accipiat sed cunctis caelesti protectione defensis salutaris tui medicina subveniat.
translation_en: We pray, O Lord, eternal Father, all-powerful God, who searches the hearts of all and considers their prayers, that not only in manifest petitions but also in hidden desires you may be gracious. For to whatever things we approach to ask, you understand before we speak. Therefore, we offer our supplications for the distress of the poor, for the labors of the children, for the wrongs of the conquerors, for the safety of travelers, for the consolation and rest of the dead, and for those who sail the sea and are seized by tempests, that they may be safe on the contrary. May all fevers and sufferings be excluded from the weak, nor let any unclean spirit gain power over anyone; but may everyone be defended by heavenly protection and may your healing medicine come to their aid.

text: Precamur Domine ut nos famuli tui qui in hoc saeculo super hanc mensam corporis et sanguinis tui iubemur esse participes in regno tuo sub mensam gloriae tuae quasi catelli de micis tuis non habeamur extorres.
translation_en: We pray, Lord, that as your servants who in this world are commanded to be participants at the table of your body and blood, we may be seated at your table in your kingdom under the glory of your table, like cattle on a thousand hills, not cast out.

text: Precamur nunc Domine sancte Pater aeterne omnipotens Deus ut quemadmodum Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus illa ineffabilium gratiarum actione semetipsum tibi pro nobis offerens mortem nostram suscepturus auditus est ita nunc et nos qui ipsum et vitam eius quaerimus exsequendo ministerialiter quae instituit audiamus ut hic tibi panis cum hoc calice oblatus in Filii tui corpus et sanguinem te benedicente ditescat ac largo oris tui perfusus spiritu indulgentiam nobis omnium peccatorum largiatur et gratiam et collatae a se salutis dono donec in semetipso perficiat custodiam semper adhibeat indefessam.
translation_en: Now we ask you, Lord, holy Father eternal, omnipotent God, that just as our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, offered himself to you in an ineffable act of thanksgiving, taking upon himself our death, may he be heard now, and we who seek him and his life, hear us ministerially doing what you have instituted. May this bread, along with this chalice, be offered to you, and made into the body and blood of Your Son, as you bless it, that it may satisfy us, and as your generous mouth is filled with spirit, grant us indulgence for all our sins, and grace and the gift of salvation which He has bestowed upon himself. May he always apply to us unfailing protection.

text: Precamur omnipotens Deus; omnes propitiatus a nobis remove pravitates et cunctas benignus depelle nequitias.
translation_en: We pray to the Almighty God; may all injustices and every wrong be removed from us by your mercifulness, and may you, gracious one, banish all wickedness.

text: Precamur omnipotens Deus ut de transitoriis operibus abstinentes ea potius operemur quibus ad aeterna gaudia consequenda et spes nobis suppetat et facultas.
translation_en: We pray, Almighty God, that, being detached from transient works, we may rather work at those by which eternal joys are attained, and may our hope be sustained and our ability supported.

text: Precamur te Domine ut intercedentibus sanctis tuis famulo tuo illi indulgentiam tribuas peccatorum et opus eius in bonum perficias misericordiam tuam et gratiam tuam ei concedas fide caritate spe eum repleas mentem eius ad desideria caelestia erigas ab omni adversitate eum defendas et ad bonam perseverantiam perducas.
translation_en: We pray, Lord, that through Your saints, You grant forgiveness for the sins of Your servant and complete his work for good. May Your mercy and grace be given to him, may he be filled with faith, love, hope, strengthened in mind for celestial desires, defended from every adversity, and led to good perseverance.

text: Precamur te habitator omnipotens immense hospitis huic virgini thalamo praesidentis qui sic tuam genitricem conferre voluisti innocentiam virginitatis ut etiam tua non abhorreret deitas incarnata tuum ex hac filium oculis praesentare mortalibus nosque ob redimendos iam peremptis. Et licet illa luxu saeculi nefario conscia suis nullomodo erat in moribus sanctis tantum eiusdem erat mens precibus attempta saepius atque tuam sic percipere ab angelo benedictionem meruit in suis visceribus. Nec erat fas per assumptionem in sua utique morte aliquot patris antiqui sentire illuviem quae olim iam portarat vitae nostrae auctorem.  Pro id nos Domine in huius diei excessu virginis tibi fusas humiliter gerimus preces ut defunctorum nomina fidelium tuis adscribantur in paginis per quam olim acta est hodie de sepulcro translatio corporis tuae beatae genitricis.
translation_en:
We beseech you, dweller of infinite power and immense host, who willed to confer innocence of virginity upon this virgin bride in the bridal chamber of her who presides, that even your incarnate deity might not be abhorred by her. And though she was not without knowledge of worldly luxury, yet her mind was ever attempted by prayers and she merited to receive the blessing from an angel within her innards. It was not fitting for her to perceive in her certain death some influence from the ancient Father who once bore the life-giving stream.
For this reason, Lord, on this day of the departure of the virgin, we humbly present our prayers to you, that the names of your faithful departed may be recorded in the pages where once the act of the translation of the body of your blessed Mother from the sepulcher took place.

text: Preces Domine tuorum respice oblationesque fidelium ut tibi gratae sint pro tuorum festivitate sanctorum et nobis conferant tuae propitiationis auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, look upon the prayers of your servants and regard the offerings of the faithful, that they may be pleasing to you on account of the feast of your saints, and grant us the help of your propitiations.

text: Preces Domine tuorum respice oblationesque fidelium ut et tibi gratae sint pro tuorum festivitate sanctorum et nobis conferant tuae propitiationis auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, look upon the prayers of your servants and regard the offerings of the faithful, so that they may be pleasing to you for the celebration of your saints, and grant us the help of your propitiation.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine et tuorum respice oblationes fidelium ut tibi gratiae sint in tuorum festivitate sanctorum et nobis conferant tuae propitiationis auxilium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you look upon our prayers and regard the offerings of your faithful. May they be pleasing to you during the festivity of your saints, and may their intercession grant us aid from your mercy.

text: Preces et munera quae in honorem sanctarum virginum tuarum tibi deferimus suscipe quaesumus et ipsarum intercessione praecipua foeda vitiorum nostrorum clementer emunda cunctisque in te credentibus mente devota dona concedere dignare sanctis tuis gratuita tuae pietatis miseratione repromissa.
translation_en: Receive, we pray, the petitions and offerings that we bring in honor of your holy virgins. May you, through their principal intercession, mercifully cleanse us from our foul vices. And to all who believe in you, grant blessed gifts, bestowed freely by your mercy and promised by your pity.

text: Preces famulae tuae illius quaesumus Domine benignus exaudi ut assumptam castitatis gratiam te auxiliante custodiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask your grace, Lord, to listen favorably to the prayers of your servant. May she, with your help, maintain the grace received in chastity.

text: Preces nostras Domine clementer exaudi ut sancti Lazari martyris tui atque pontificis qui filio tuo digne meruit famulari intercedentibus meritis mereamur praesentis et futurae vitae perfrui gaudiis.
translation_en: Lord, hear our prayers with mercy, that we may deserve to enjoy the joys of this and the future life through the intercession of your holy martyr and bishop Saint Lazarus, who worthily served your Son. May his merits be effective on our behalf.

text: Preces nostras Domine propitiatus admitte et a terrenis effice contagiis expiatos quos caelestibus tribuis servire mysteriis.
translation_en: Lord, receive our prayers with favor, and make us free from earthly contagions purified, whom you grant to serve the mysteries of heaven.

text: Preces nostras Domine propitiatus admitte et ut digne tuis famulemur altaribus sanctorum tuorum nos intercessione custodi.
translation_en: Lord, graciously receive our prayers and may we worthily serve your altars of the saints; through their intercession, protect us.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus attende et ut digne tuo famulemur altario sanctorum tuorum illorum nos intercessione custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that you, being gracious, pay attention to our prayers, and may we worthily serve your altar of saints. Through their intercession, may you protect us.

text: Preces nostras Domine quaesumus omnium sanctorum tuorum tuae pietati commendet oratio ut quod pro illorum gloria celebramus nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that You commend our prayers to the mercy of all Your saints, so that what we celebrate for their glory may also bring us forgiveness.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine caelesti dono prosequere ut qui de beati Leonardi confessoris tui atque abbatis patrociniis gloriamur eius meritis atque suffragiis apud te semper adiuvari mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the celestial gift follows our prayers, so that we may be helped by the merits and intercessions of your blessed confessor and abbot St. Leonard, and always be worthy of aid through them with you.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi atque a peccatorum vinculis absolutos ab omni nos adversitate custodi.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to hear our prayers graciously and to set us free from the bonds of sin. May you protect us from every adversity.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi et contra cuncta nobis adversantia dexteram tuae maiestatis extende.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, to graciously hear our prayers and extend the right hand of your majesty against all adversities that we face.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi et inter huius vitae adversitates atque discrimina famulum tuum illum ambulantem tua pietate conserva.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to graciously hear our prayers and, amidst the challenges and trials of this life, keep Your servant walking in Your mercy.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi et per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus famulum tuum illum a vinculis suae captivitatis absolve.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to graciously hear our prayers and through these sacred mysteries that we have received, free Your servant from the bonds of his captivity.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi et supplicationem nostram efficaciter comple et suscipe propitius oblationem quam tibi pro fratribus et sororibus nostris offerimus seu et pro cunctis benefactoribus nostris et quorum eleemosynas ad erogandum suscepimus et quorum nomina ad memorandum conscripsimus vel quorum nomina supra hoc sanctum altare tuum adscripta esse videntur sive vivorum sive defunctorum et ceteris fidelibus tuis pro quibus haec oblatio offertur; praesta clementissime Pater ut cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously hear our prayers and effectively fulfill our supplication. Receive mercifully the offering we present to you on behalf of our brothers and sisters, and for all our benefactors, and those whose alms we have received and whose names we have written down or seem to be inscribed on this holy altar, whether living or deceased, and for all your faithful for whom this offering is made; most mercifully grant, Father, that it may profit all for salvation.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi ut qui de festivitate beatae illius laetamur eius quoque intercessione ad ineffabile supernae beatitudinis gaudium pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to hear our prayers kindly, so that we who rejoice in the festivity of the blessed one may also, through her intercession, deserve to reach the ineffable joy of the highest beatitude.

text: Preces populi tui quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi ut qui de assumptione beatae Mariae semper virginis laetamur eius quoque intercessione ad ineffabile supernae beatitudinis gaudium pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you graciously hear the prayers of your people, so that we who rejoice in the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary may, through her intercession, merit to attain the inexpressible joy of the highest beatitude in heaven.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine memor fragilitatis humanae placatus admitte et quia infirmitatis nostrae conscii ad impetranda quae poscimus de meritorum qualitate diffidimus pietatem tuam humiliter imploramus ut intercessione sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae sanctorumque apostolorum martyrum et consessorum ac virginum omniumque electorum tuorum famulo tuo illi propitius indulgentiam culparum et plenitudinem aeternorum largiaris gaudiorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive our prayers, mindful of human frailty. Being aware of our weakness, we doubt the merits for which we ask and so we implore your mercy. We humbly entreat your pity that through the intercession of the holy Mother of God, Mary, the apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, all your elect, you may be gracious to your servant, granting him forgiveness for his sins and the fullness of eternal joys.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine placatus exaudi ut quod de inimicis et raptoribus Ecclesiae tuae sanctae deprecamur consuetae misericordiae velocitate perficere non desinas.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you, being appeased, hear our prayers, so that what we have traditionally prayed for regarding enemies and thieves of your holy Church may be fulfilled with the swiftness of your usual mercy. Let this not cease.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine propitiatus admitte et dicatum tibi sacrificium beatae Sotheris martyrium commendet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept our prayers and commit the offering to you of the martyrdom of Blessed Sothis.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine propitius respice ut (per) haec mysteria sancta quae sumpsimus beatae semper virginis Mariae cuius sollemnitatem nostra praevenit devotio intercessio nos adiuvet et ad portum perpetuae salutis adducat.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, look upon our prayers benevolently, so that through these holy mysteries which we have received, the devotion to the ever-blessed Virgin Mary whose feast day we are celebrating beforehand, may assist and help us, and guide us to the port of eternal salvation.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine quas in famuli tui illius depositione deferimus propitiatus exaudi ut qui nomini tuo ministerium fidele dependit perpetua sanctorum societate laetetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to hear our prayers which we bring before you in the service of your servant who has departed. May he, who faithfully depends on your name, rejoice forever in the company of the saints.

text: Preces nostras quas tibi offerimus Domine intercedente beato Petro martyre tuo intende et pugiles fidei sub tua protectione custodi.
translation_en: Hear our prayers, Lord, as we offer them to You, with the intercession of Your blessed martyr Saint Peter. Protect and defend those who fight the faith under Your protection.

text: Preces populi tui Domine dignanter exaudi quas in cultu templi huius ob honorem sancti archangeli tui Michaelis <dicati offerimus> et ita tibi pro eius sollemnitate oblatio nostra fiat accepta.
translation_en: Lord, graciously hear the prayers of your people which we offer in this temple's worship for the honor of your archangel Michael, who is dedicated. May our offering therefore be accepted by you on his solemnity.

text: Preces populi tui quaesumus Domine clementer assume ut nos servos tuos custodias ab omni malo atque defendas.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you graciously hear the prayers of your people, that you may protect us, your servants, from every evil and defend us.

text: Preces populi tui quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi et concede propitius ut gloriosum unigeniti tui adventum per intercessionem beatae et gloriosae semperque virginis Mariae cum omni pace et gaudio celebremus.
translation_en: We humbly ask your mercy, Lord, that you graciously hear our prayers and generously grant them favorably. May we rejoice and celebrate the glorious coming of your only-begotten Son through the intercession of the blessed and glorious ever-virgin Mary with all peace and joy.

text: Preces populi tui quaesumus Domine benignus exaudi et per huius virtutem sacramenti pacem tuam nobis nuntiet purgati aeris serena tranquillitas ut qui delinquentes verberas peccata confitentibus parcas.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, may your benevolence hear our prayers and announce your peace to us through the power of this sacrament. May a serene tranquility of purified air enlighten us, that you may be merciful with those who confess their sins, sparing them as they bear your punishments.

text: Preces populi tui quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi ut beati Marcelli martyris tui atque pontificis meritis adiuvemur cuius passione laetamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask your grace, Lord, that you listen favorably to the prayers of your people. May we be helped through the merits of blessed Marcellus, your martyr and bishop, whose passion we rejoice in.

text: Preces populi tui quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi ut qui de adventu unigeniti Filii tui secundum carnem laetantur in secundo cum venerit in maiestate sua praemium aeternae vitae percipiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you listen kindly to the prayers of your people. May those who rejoice in the coming of the Only-Begotten Son of yours in the flesh, receive the reward of eternal life when he comes in his majesty.

text: Preces populi tui quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi ut qui in sola spe gratiae caelestis innititur caelesti etiam protectione muniatur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your mercy, Lord, that he who is supported only by the hope of celestial grace may also be fortified with heavenly protection.

text: Preces populi tui quaesumus Domine clementer exaudi ut qui iuste pro peccatis nostris affligimur pietatis tuae visitatione consolemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your mercy, Lord, that You hear our people's prayers gently. May those who are justly afflicted for our sins find consolation through Your visitation of mercy.

text: Preces populi tui Domine clementer exaudi ut qui iuste pro peccatis nostris affligimur pro tui nominis gloria misericorditer liberemur.
translation_en: Hear, O Lord, the prayers of your people with clemency, that we who are justly afflicted for our sins may be mercifully freed for the glory of your name.

text: Preces servorum tuorum Deus miserator exaudi ut qui sanctorum martyrum Severi Severiani Victorini et Carpophori memoriam recensemus eorundem meritis et precibus ad aeternae felicitatis coronam pertingere mereamur.
translation_en: We beseech you, O merciful God, to hear the prayers of your servants, so that we who remember the martyrs Severus, Severian, Victorinus, and Carpophorus, may through their merits and intercessions be worthy of the crown of eternal happiness.

text: Precibus confessoris tuae Leocadiae omnipotens Deus hoc tibi oblatum sacrificium suscipe et tuae benedictionis perlustra sanctificatione ut dum ex his sumpserimus quidquid in confessione poposcerit lingua praelargiri dignetur tua miseratio consueta.
translation_en: Almighty God, accept this offering presented to you by the prayers of your confessor Leocadia. May You, through Your blessing and sanctification, grant us whatever we have asked for in confession, that Your customary mercy may deem it fitting for our tongue to overflow with words.

text: Precibus nostris quaesumus Domine aurem tuae pietatis accommoda et orationes supplicum occultorum cognitor benignus exaudi ut te largiente ad vitam perveniant sempiternam.
translation_en: With our prayers, we humbly ask You, Lord, may Your ear of mercy be attuned to us. Generous discoverer of hidden supplications, graciously hear them so that through Your bounty, they may attain everlasting life.

text: Precibus populi tui Domine quaesumus placatus adspira ut veniam tribuas humanis excessibus et opem miseris benignus impendas.
translation_en: With the prayers of your people, Lord, we humbly ask that you, being pleased, breathe grace to grant forgiveness for human excesses and, in your merciful nature, bestow aid upon the unfortunate.

text: Pretiosam celebritatem sancti martyris tui Domine Pantaleonis plebem recolentem gratiae tuae muneribus perfunde ut cuius laetatur nataliciis interesse valeat et braviis.
translation_en: Lord, pour out the precious majesty of your saint, Pantaleon, upon his people who are gathered in reverence. May they be strengthened by the gifts of your grace so that they may be able to rejoice in his natal days and victories.

text: Pridie te dominum ab inferis surrexisse plenissima fidei cognitione fatentes ovanti voto deposcimus ut qui olim in hac die fluida in caelis aquarum elementa distinguens in earum medio firmamentum fieri elegisti ita nos efficias firmamentum tuae ecclesiae ut angelis tuis mereamur consimiles esse quo mortis ac resurrectionis tuae victoria roborati quae sursum sunt semper quaerentes ita vivamus ut te opitulante caeleste firmamentum effecti credentes tibi ad desideria caelestia inflammemur.
translation_en: On the eve of your Lord being raised from the dead, we confess with complete faith, offering our vow, that you once in this day separated the fluid elements of water in heaven and created a firmament among them. We humbly ask that you make us a firmament for your church, so that we may deserve to be like your angels, strengthened by your victory over death and resurrection. May we live in such a way that with your celestial help we become the firmament, believing in you; let us be inflamed towards heavenly desires.

text: Primum orationem diffusam secreta cordis obscuritas excutientes irae ut spirituales illius divinae intellegentiae interpretationes lectio praemissa impellit eodem domino discurrente nuntiis vestris favoris adiutos; et induti sensus explicatione disponamus ut et populi sensum intellegentia capiant et holocaustum nostrum pius Dominus in odorem suavitatis accipiat et defunctis fidelibus requiem praestetur aeterna.
translation_en: Removing the initial prayer, we shake off the secret darkness of our anger, may it be that the reading previously given impels us, under the same Lord, to run with your messages, supported by your favor. And let us arrange the sense of explanation in such a way that both the people may understand its meaning and our pious Lord receives our offering in a pleasant smell, and may He grant eternal rest to the faithful departed.

text: Pro anima famuli tui illius Domine tibi sacrificium supplices offerimus ut ad tuam misericordiam conferendam perpetua dignanter eius vota perficias.
translation_en: For the soul of your servant, Lord, we humbly present this sacrifice to you, that you may grant his prayers worthy of your mercy and fulfill his eternal desires.

text: Pro animabus famulorum tuorum illorum et illarum et hic omnium catholicorum dormientium hostiam Domine suscipe benignus oblatam ut hoc sacrificio singulari vinculis horrendae mortis exutae (exuti) vitam mereantur aeternam.
translation_en: For the souls of your servants, those who are there and those who are here, and all the Catholic faithful sleeping, Lord, receive this offering graciously given. May they merit an eternal life through this unique sacrifice, free (being freed) from the dreadful bonds of death.

text: Pro beati Iudoci patris nostri Domine sollemnitate haec libamina tibi oblata sanctifica nosque ad sancta sumenda purifica.
translation_en: For the blessed Judoc, our father, Lord, on his feast day we offer you this libamina. Sanctify us and purify us that we may be worthy to partake in the holy sacraments.

text: Pro beati Laurentii martyris passione veneranda hostias tibi Domine suppliciter immolamus eius oratione placituras pro cuius meritis offeruntur.
translation_en: We humbly offer you, Lord, the worthy sacrifices for the venerable passion of Blessed Lawrence the Martyr. Through his prayers, we ask that they may be pleasing to you, offered on account of his merits.

text: Pro beatae martyris tuae Susannae veneranda passione sacrificia tibi suppliciter immolamus eius orationibus placitura pro cuius meritis offeruntur.
translation_en: We humbly offer sacrifices to your blessed martyr Susanna, in reverence for her venerable passion. Through her prayers, we implore you that, by her merits, they may be pleasing to you.

text: Pro beati Agapiti martyris tui passione veneranda hostias laudis tibi Domine immolantes quaesumus ut eius orationibus placeant pro cuius meritis offeruntur.
translation_en: We, offering you hosts of laudatory sacrifices in reverence for the passion of your blessed martyr Agapitus, humbly ask you, Lord. We pray that his prayers be pleasing to you, on whose account they are offered due to his merits.

text: Pro caelestis convivii iucunditate gratias tibi referimus rex et sacerdos noster maiestatem tuam humiliter rogantes ut haec sacrosancta corporis et sanguinis tui hostia non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sed intercessio salutaris ad veniam; sit ablutio scelerum sit fortitudo fragilium sit contra omnia mundi pericula firmamentum sit vivorum atque mortuorum fidelium remissio omnium peccatorum.
translation_en: For the delightful feast of the celestial banquet, we refer our grateful thanks to you, O king and our priest, humbly beseeching your majesty that this most holy host of your body and blood not be a burden for us leading to punishment, but a salutary intercession for forgiveness; may it be the cleansing of sins, may it be the strength of the weak, may it be a fortress against all perils of the world, may it be the remission of all sins for the living and the dead faithful.

text: Pro delictis nostris ieiunio humiliatis corporibus tuam quaesumus Deus gratiam nobis concede placatus quo tam vivis quam defunctis remedia possimus impetrare salutis.
translation_en: For our sins we humbly fast our bodies and ask you, God, to grant us mercy, pleased as you are, so that both living and dead we may be able to obtain remedies of salvation.

text: Pro familia tua Domine quaesumus sanctorum martyrum venerabilis intercedat oratio ut quorum sollemnia devota mente non deserit eorum piis adiuta praesidiis et consolationem referat et salutem.
translation_en: For your family, Lord, we humbly ask that the venerable intercession of the holy martyrs may not forsake them with their solemnities. May they be helped by their pious aids and return consolation and salvation to them.

text: Pro honore sanctorum tuorum martyrum Dionysii Rustici et Eleutherii oblata tibi Domine populi tui munera quaesumus propitius suscipe et eorum nobis intercessione sanctifica.
translation_en: For the honor of your holy martyrs Dionysius and Rusticus, we offer to you, Lord, gifts on behalf of your people. We humbly ask that you be gracious and receive them. May their intercession sanctify us.

text: Pro martyrum natalitiis Domine tua muneribus cumulamus altaria; da quaesumus ut gaudia nobis sancta succrescant quibus proficiat nostrae devotionis affectus.
translation_en: On the birthdays of the martyrs, Lord, we heap your altars with gifts; grant us that we may grow in holy joy, as our affection for devotion increases.

text: Pro nostrae servitutis augmento sacrificium tibi Domine laudis offerimus ut quod immeritis contulisti propitius exsequaris.
translation_en: For the increase of our service, we offer You, Lord, a sacrifice of praise, that what you have bestowed upon us undeservingly, may you graciously carry out.

text: Pro passione beati Clementis gratanter tibi Domine munus offerimus quia sicut eum sentimus in te vivere gloriosum Sic pro nobis intervenire confidimus.
translation_en: We gladly offer you, Lord, a gift for the passion of blessed Clement, for we feel him living gloriously within you, and we confidently believe that he intercedes on our behalf.

text: Pro requie Domine animae famuli tui illius suscipe hostiam quam tu Deo patri pro nobis obtulisti benignam ut quia causa hominum descendisti de caelis te redeunte mereatur numerari in consortio sanctorum.
translation_en: Lord, for the repose of your servant's soul, receive the offering which you, merciful God, presented to the Father on our behalf when you descended from heaven. May he, returning to heaven, be worthy to be numbered among the company of saints.

text: Pro sanctorum Basilidis Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii sanguine venerando hostias tibi Domine sollemniter immolamus tua mirabilia pertractantes per quae talis est perfecta victoria.
translation_en: We offer to you, Lord, the sacrifices of Basilides, Cyrinus, Nabor and Nazarius, venerating their holy blood. We celebrate solemnly, marveling at your wonders through which such a complete victory is achieved.

text: Pro sanctorum Stephani Nicodemi Gamalielis et Abibae inventione gloriosa hostias tibi Domine immolamus tua mirabilia tractantes per quae talis aperta est inventio.
translation_en: For the glorious discovery of the saints Stephen, Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Abiba, we offer you, Lord, sacrifices; through your marvels, we ponder how such a discovery was made open.

text: Pro sanctorum Proti et Hyacinthi munera tibi Domine commemoratione quae debemus exsolvimus; praesta quaesumus ut remedium nobis perpetuae salutis operentur.
translation_en: For the sake of Saints Protus and Hyacinth, we offer you, Lord, the obligations that we ought to pay; we humbly ask that the means for our eternal salvation may work effectively for us.

text: Prodest quidem Domine continuata censura peccantibus sed temperetur quaesumus tuorum intercessione sanctorum ut non deficiamus infirmi sed per tuam gratiam possimus emendari correcti.
translation_en: Indeed, Lord, persistent chastisement is profitable for sinners; but we ask through the intercession of your saints that we may not fail in our weakness but, by your grace, may be able to amend when corrected.

text: Proficiant nobis quaesumus Domine haec divina subsidia mentis et corporis ut intercessione sanctorum tuorum Cyrici et Iulittae matris eius sociorumque ipsorum dignis quae recolimus meritis ab omnibus tueamur adversis.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, these divine aids for mind and body, so that with the intercession of your saints Cyrus and Julitta, his mother, and their companions, we who remember them may be protected by your worthy merits from all adversities.

text: Proficiat nobis ad salutem corporis et animae Domine Deus huius sacramenti susceptio et sempiterna sanctae Trinitatis confessio.
translation_en: May it profit us for the health of body and soul, Lord God. By the reception of this sacrament and the eternal confession of the holy Trinity.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine ad indulgentiam animabus pro quibus tuam obsecramus clementiam divini celebratio sacramenti ut per haec sancta a contagiis terrenae conversationis emundatae ad caelestem mereantur venire habitationem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that You may approach for the indulgence of souls for whom we are appealing to Your mercy. May the divine celebration of the sacrament cleanse them through these holy acts from the contagions of earthly life, so that they may deserve to come into a celestial dwelling place.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine animabus famulorum tuorum pontificum divini celebratio mysterii ut quos in terris positos huius muneris dispensatores esse fecisti inter electos antistites eos iubeas connumerari.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the souls of your servants, the pontiffs, may be proficient in your divine celebration of the mysteries. May you, who have made them dispensers of this office among the chosen antistites, command them to be numbered together.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine fidelis populus tuae pietatis instinctu et salubri compunctione devotus gratanter q praecipis exsequatur ut quae promittis accipiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your faithful people may, moved by the impulse of Your piety and under the healthy influence of devotion, gratefully carry out what You command. May they receive what You promise.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine haec oblatio quam tuae supplices offerimus maiestati ad convertendum famulum tuum ut prius requiem non habeat {ante}quam se nobis ostendat ut qui a te contemnendo culpam incurrit confitendo veniam consequatur.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to you, Lord, we humbly ask, that this offering which your supplicants present to your majesty may convert your servant, so that he may find peace before he reveals himself to us. Let him who, in contempt of you, incurs guilt confess and follow after forgiveness.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine haec oblatio quam tuae supplices offerimus maiestati ad salutem famuli tui illius ut tua providentia eius vita inter adversa et prospera ubique dirigatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that this offering which your supplicants present to your majesty for the salvation of your servant may, through your providence, direct his life amidst adversity and prosperity.

text: Proficiat quaesumus Domine plebs tibi dicata piae devotionis affectu ut sacris actionibus erudita quanto maiestati tuae fit gratior tanto donis potioribus augeatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your devoted people may be proficient, filled with pious devotion. May they become more pleasing to your majesty through the sacred actions and be enriched with more precious gifts.

text: Proficiat Domine quaesumus plebs tibi dicata piae devotionis affectu ut sanctis doctoribus erudita purae fidei inviolabile teneat fundamentum.
translation_en: May it please You, Lord, we humbly ask the devoted people, that with a pious affection, they may be guided by You to uphold an unbreakable foundation in pure faith, through the learned saints as their teachers.

text: Prolatis nominibus offerentium humiliter poscimus misericordiam tuam omnipotens aeterne Deus ut in hoc venerabili festo Thomae apostoli tui sancti sereno vultu plebem tuam pius respicias dextera divinitatis tuae sanctifices et benedicas nominaque offerentium in libro vitae caelestis adnotari propitius iubeas Sint haec obsequia quaesumus Domine ante conspectum gloriae tuae placabilia quae annua revolutione tibi offerimus dedicanda ut per hoc nostrae humilitatis votum et sancti martyris tui interventum piissimum concedas singulis postulatum remedium.  Adsit precamur Domine muneris tui dono lapsis congruus paenitentiae locus reis indulgentiae auditus maestis laetitiae commodum tristi<bu>s laetitiae consolatio oppressis erectionis solatium. Eveniat etiam a te Domine vera humilitas superbia tumidis largitio provida avaris subsidium veniae desperatis continentiae frenum luxuriosis. Benigna relaxatione absolvantur vincti ad libertatem reducantur omnes captivi ad sospitatem pristinam reparentur infirmi piam susceptionem universi inveniant peregrini. Tueantur viduae a malitia perversorum orphani et pupilli facile liberentur ab insania reproborum. Detur navigantibus portus quietis discordantibus concordia pacis concordibus perseverantia pacis in vinculo caritatis. Concedatur a tua clementia Domine nobis omnibus in commune viventibus cunctorum indulgentia peccatorum et defunctis fidelibus refrigerii locus in regione viventium.
translation_en:
With humble petitions we earnestly beseech your mercy, O almighty eternal God, on this venerable feast of your apostle Saint Thomas that you look upon your people with a serene countenance and sanctify them. May you graciously bless the names of those offering in the book of heavenly life, and command them to be noted favorably.
May these offerings we ask of you, Lord, before the sight of your glory, be acceptable which we annually bring to dedicate, so that through this our humble vow and the intervention of your holy martyr, you graciously grant a most benevolent remedy for each petitioner.
We pray, Lord, that a suitable place for penance may be granted to sinners as a gift from your mercy, an audible indulgence for the sorrowful, a comforting consolation for the downtrodden, a solace of erection for the depressed, and easy liberation for orphans and wards from the insanity of the reprobate.
May true humility be given by you, Lord, to the proud, a provident largesse to the greedy, a subsidy of forgiveness to the despairing, a bridle of continence to the lascivious. May those bound find benevolent release, all captives be restored to their original state, the infirm receive a pious reception, and all wanderers find refuge.
May widows be protected from the wickedness of evildoers, orphans and wards be easily freed from the insanity of the reprobate. May there be granted a peaceful harbor to those navigating, concord among discordant ones, perseverance in peace for harmonious ones in the bond of charity.
May your clemency, Lord, grant us all, living in common, an indulgence for sins and refreshment for the faithful departed in the region of the living.

text: Prope esto Domine omnibus exspectantibus te in veritate ut in adventu Filii tui Domini nostri placitis tibi actibus praesentemur.
translation_en: Draw near, Lord, to all those who are waiting for You in truth, so that we may present ourselves to You in the coming of Your Son, our Lord, through pleasing actions.

text: Propitiare Domine animae famuli tui illius ut quem in fine istius vitae regenerationis fonte mundasti ad caelestis regni beatitudinem facias pervenire.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate the soul of your servant that one whom you cleansed at the end of this life in the font of regeneration, may arrive at the beatitude of the celestial kingdom.

text: Propitiare Domine Deus omni populo christiano ex diversis partibus linguarum convenienti in unum ut hi qui locum praeclarum atque notum ubique Lannaledensem ubi reliquae Germani episcopi conduntur quanto ardentius tanto citius visitare cupiunt ab omnibus infirmitatibus animae et corporis fideliter liberentur.
translation_en: Lord, grant mercy to all Christian people from diverse regions and languages who gather together in one, so that those who eagerly desire to visit the renowned and well-known place of Lannaleden, where the remains of the German bishops are consecrated, may be freed from all infirmities of soul and body as soon and as ardently as possible.

text: Propitiare Domine familiae tuae et benignus humilitatis in hoc fonte regenerandos nostrae vota sanctifica et omnes universali adoptione custodi.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your family and be gracious to the humble at this font of regeneration. Sanctify our prayers and keep all by universal adoption.

text: Propitiare Domine humilitati nostrae et respice servitutem ut pacis tuae abundantia tempora nostra cumulentur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our humility and look upon our servitude, so that the abundance of your peace may accumulate in our time.

text: Propitiare Domine in te confidentibus populis et ad custodiam romani nominis dexteram tuae protectionis extende ut regnum maiestati tuae deditum tua semper sit virtute defensum.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy upon thy people who trust in thee, and extend Thy right hand for the preservation of the Roman name, that Thy kingdom may always be protected by Thy power.

text: Propitiare Domine iniquitatibus nostris et exorabilis tuis esto supplicibus ut concessa venia quam precamur perpetuo misericordiae tuae munere gloriemur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our sins and be propitious to those who implore you, that the grace of forgiveness we ask for may continually be celebrated by the blessing of your mercy.

text: Propitiare Domine populo tuo et ab omnibus absolve peccatis ut quod nostris offensionibus promeremur tua indulgentia repellatur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your people and forgive them all sins, that the punishment we deserve for our offenses may be repelled by your clemency.

text: Propitiare Domine populo tuo propitiare muneribus ut hac oblatione placatus et indulgentiam nobis tribuas et postulata concedas.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on your people; grant them favorable gifts so that, appeased by this offering, you may grant us pardon and fulfill our requests.

text: Propitiare Domine quaerentibus misericordiam tuam et statum romani nominis ubique defende ut pax salusque perpetua tuorum possit vigere populorum.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate towards those seeking your mercy and everywhere defend the status of the Roman name, that eternal peace and salvation may be able to flourish among the peoples.

text: Propitiare Domine precibus et hostiis famulorum tuorum et propter nomen tuum romani imperii defende rectores ut salus servientium tibi principum pax tuorum possit esse populorum.
translation_en: Lord, through the prayers and offerings of your servants, have mercy and protect the rulers of Rome so that the peace of your people may be the welfare of the princes serving you.

text: Propitiare Domine quaesumus animae famuli tui illius pro qua hostias placationis tibi immolamus maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecantes ut per haec piae placationis officia pervenire mereatur ad requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate the soul of your servant for whom we offer these sacrifices of appeasement. We beseech your majesty that through these acts of pious appeasement, he may merit eternal rest.

text: Propitiare Domine quaesumus supplicationibus nostris et interveniente pro nobis sancto illo confessore tuo his sacramentis caelestibus servientes ab omni culpa liberos esse concede ut purificante nos gratia tua iisdem quibus famulamur mysteriis emundemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate us with our supplications and, through your holy confessor, intervene for us. Grant that we may be freed from all guilt by these celestial sacraments serving them. May your grace purify us with the same mysteries through which we serve.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et animam famuli tui illius episcopi in vivorum regione aeternis gaudiis iubeas sociari.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our petitions and the soul of that servant of yours, that bishop, grant that he may be associated with the eternal joys of the living in the realm of the dead.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et animarum nostrarum medere languoribus ut remissione percepta in tua semper benedictione laetemur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and grant healing to the weaknesses of our souls so that we may rejoice in Your always blessed forgiveness.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et animas famulorum famularumque tuarum in gremio patriarchae nostri Abrahae collocare dignare ut resurrectionis diem cum refrigerio tuae beatitudinis exspectent.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy upon our supplications and place the souls of your servants, servants and handmaids, in the bosom of our patriarch Abraham, that they may expect the day of resurrection with the refreshment of your beatitude.
