text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et exemplo sanctorum martyrum tuorum illius et illius flammam in nobis tuae caritatis accende ut quorum nos feceris imitatores iubeas esse consortes.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate our supplications and kindle in us the flame of your charity by the example of your sainted martyrs. Grant that we may be made their imitators and bid us to be their companions.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicantibus nostris et flammam in nobis tuae caritatis accende ut sanctae tuae virginis illius vel martyris qui sexum cum saeculo vicit cuius nos fecisti esse imitatores iubeas esse consortes.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplicants and kindle in us the flame of your charity, that we who have made ourselves imitators of the holy virgin or martyr who conquered the world with her sex, may be ordered to be her companions.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris <quas tibi in> beati martyris tui Alexandri commemoratione deferimus ut cuius nos desideramus esse imitatores iubeas esse consortes
translation_en: Lord, grant our supplications which we bring before you on the commemoration of your blessed martyr Alexander, that we may be his imitators, as you command us to be his companions.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et hanc oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo benignus assume ut et gratia tua praecedente viam illius dirigas et subsequente ab omni adversitate custodias.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and receive this offering we present to you for your servant. May the generous one accept it, that the way of that servant may be guided by your grace preceding, and protected from every adversity by your presence following.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes famulorum famularumque tuarum benignus assume ut quod singuli obtulerunt ad honorem nominis tui cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and graciously accept these offerings of your servants and their servants, so that what each one has offered for the honor of your name may profit all for their salvation.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes famulorum famularumque tuarum quas tibi pro incolumitate eorum offerimus benignus assume; ut nullius sit irritum votum nullius vacua postulatio praesta quaesumus ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate our supplications and these offerings of your servants and servants, which we present to you for their safety. Gracious, receive them. Grant that no vow is left unfulfilled, no petition void. We humbly ask that what we faithfully seek, we may effectively achieve.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes quas tibi pro incolumitate omnium episcoporum abbatum canonicorum monachorum sive regum et gubernatorum atque consanguineorum nostrorum et eorum qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas seu ceterorum fidelium utriusque sexus offeruntur benignus assume; ut nullius sit irritum votum nullius vacua postulatio praesta quaesumus ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate our supplications and these offerings that we make on behalf of the wellbeing of all bishops, abbots, canons, monks, kings, governors, kin, and those who have commended themselves to us in prayers, and those who have given alms or other offerings from themselves on our behalf. Gracious one, accept them kindly; may no vow be empty and no petition void. We humbly ask that what we fervently seek may effectively be attained.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has populi tui oblationes benignus assume ut nullius sit irritum votum et nullius vacua postulatio praesta ut quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and graciously receive the offerings of your people, so that no vow may be in vain and no request empty. Grant that what we faithfully ask for may effectively be attained.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus meis et has oblationes quas tibi pro peccatis meis offero benignus assume; ut non Sit irritum votum meum neque vacua postulatio mea praesta quaeso ut quod fideliter et humiliter peto efficaciter consequi merear.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on my supplications and these offerings that I present to you for my sins. Gracious Lord, accept them benignly; so that my vow may not be in vain nor my petition empty. I beg of you, grant what I ask for humbly and faithfully, that I may deserve to obtain it effectively.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes quas pro incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum et pro animabus omnium fidelium catholicorum orthodoxorum quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum scripta adesse videntur nomini tuo consecrandas deferimus benignus assume ut sacrificii praesentis oblatio ad refrigerium animarum eorum te miserante proveniat.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, with our supplications, and these offerings which we present on behalf of the welfare of your servants and theirs, and for the souls of all Catholic and Orthodox faithful whose names are written before your holy altar and consecrate them to your name. Gracious one, assume it that the offering of this sacrifice may come to refreshment for their souls, through you showing mercy.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et has oblationes quas tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo benignus assume ut viam illius et praecedente gratia tua dirigas et subsequente comitare digneris ut de actu atque incolumitate eius secundum misericordiae tuae praesidia gaudeamus.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate our supplications and receive the offerings that we present to you on behalf of your servant. May the benevolent one assume his way and guide it with your grace preceding, and graciously accompany him afterwards, so that we may rejoice in his deeds and safety according to your merciful protection.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et his populi tui oblationibus intercedentibus martyribus tuis illo et illo praesentiam tuae virtutis intersere et celebrantibus tuorum memoriam eam dilectionem infunde per quam illi cuncta illata corporis tormenta devicerunt.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and those offerings of your people that the martyrs intercede for them and that your presence is mingled with their intercession. May you pour out that love upon them by which they overcame all the torments inflicted upon their bodies.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et intercedente pro nobis beato Hieronymo confessore tuo per haec sacra quae tuae obtulimus maiestati ab omni culpa liberos nos esse concede.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and through the intercession of your confessor Saint Jerome, grant us to be freed from all guilt by these sacred offerings made to Your majesty.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et mitte angelum tuum de summitate caelorum tuorum qui liberet navem istam cum omnibus navigantibus in ea; perduc eam ad loca destinata ut transactis negotiis omnibus iterato tempore ad propria revocare digneris cum omni gaudiorum affectu.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and send your angel from the heights of your heavens who may free this ship with all those sailing in it; guide it to its intended destinations, so that after all business is transacted, you may grant it safe return at a later time, with every joyful affection.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et populum tuum pervigili protectione custodi ut nullius animam diabolus perfidiae telo vulneret nullius mentem veneno falsitatis occidat.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy upon our supplications and keep your people under watchful protection, so that the devil may not wound any soul with his treacherous weapon nor kill any mind with the poison of falsehood.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et sanctorum martyrum tuorum Albani Paulini et Nicetii episcopi cum nongentis octoginta novem qui passi sunt propter nomen tuum illorum suffragantibus meritis preces nostras dignanter exaudi ut dimittantur nobis peccata nostra et tecum vivere in aeternum mereamur.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and the intercessions of your saints, Alban, Paulinus, and Nicetius, bishops, along with the ninety-nine who suffered for your name. May their merits grant that our prayers are heard worthily, so that our sins may be forgiven us, and we may deserve to live with you eternally.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et sanctorum tuorum suffragantibus meritis preces nostras dignanter exaudi.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications and grant us favor through the merits of your saints. Hear our prayers worthy and graciously.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris et suffragantibus nobis sanctorum tuorum meritis ea quibus nos evangelicis praeceptis instruis implere concede.
translation_en: Lord, grant us your mercy through our supplications and support us with the merits of your saints, that we may fulfill those things which you instruct us by the evangelical commandments.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris pro anima famuli tui illius pro qua tibi offerimus sacrificium laudis ut eam sanctorum tuorum coetibus consociare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy on our supplications for the soul of your servant, for whom we offer you a sacrifice of praise. Grant that she may be associated with the assemblies of your saints.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicationibus nostris pro anima et spiritu famuli tui illius cuius hodie annua dies agitur pro qua tibi offerimus sacrificium laudis ut eam sanctorum tuorum consortio sociare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, grant us favor with our supplications for the soul and spirit of your servant whose annual day is celebrated today. For her we offer you a sacrifice of praise, that you may deem worthy to associate her with the fellowship of your saints.

text: Propitiare Domine supplicum votis et populi tui oblationibus precibusque susceptis omnium nostrum ad te corda converte.
translation_en: O Lord, propitiate the suppliant hearts of your people and turn our minds to you through their offerings and prayers.

text: Propitiare misericors Deus supplicationibus nostris et populum tuum pervigili proiectione custodi ut qui beatorum confessorum tuorum illorum sollemnia praevenimus tribuas nobis ex eorum imitatione prospera mundi despicere et nulla eius adversa formidare.
translation_en: Merciful God, propitiate our supplications and keep your people awake under a vigilant protection, so that we, anticipating the feasts of your blessed confessors, may look down upon the world with prosperity as they do, and fear no adversities of it.

text: Propitiare misericors Deus supplicationibus nostris et populum tuum pervigili protectione custodi ut qui unigenitum tuum in carne nostri corporis Deum natum esse fatetur nulla possit diaboli falsitate corrumpi.
translation_en: Merciful God, propitiate our supplications and keep your people under your vigilant protection, so that no one who confesses that your only-begotten Son was born as God in our flesh can be corrupted by the falsehood of the devil.

text: Propitiare misericors Deus supplicationibus nostris et familiam tuam pervigili protectione custodi ut qui unigenitum tuum in carne nostri corporis modo natum confitemur intercessionibus beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli omniumque eiusdem divinae humanaeque Christi nativitatis ministrorum ministrarumque meritis nulla possimus diaboli sociorumque eius falsitate corrumpi sed Sancti Spiritus gratia illuminati contra vitiorum temptationes pugnare valeamus illaesi.
translation_en: Merciful God, grant us your favor through our supplications and keep your family under the watchful protection, so that we who confess your only-begotten Son born in flesh at this time, may be protected by the intercession of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, as well as all the ministers and servants of the same divine and human nativity of Christ. May we not be corrupted by any deceit of the devil and his allies because of their falsehood, but may we be able to fight against temptations of vices with the grace of the Holy Spirit unharmed.

text: Propitiare nobis Domine quaesumus illius Agni paschalis oblatione acceptissima cum beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae pia interventione quem ipsa genuit perpetua virginitate.
translation_en: Grant us mercy, we beseech You, O Lord, through the acceptable offering of that Paschal Lamb, with the blessed intervention of the Mother of God, Mary, whom she herself bore in perpetual virginity.

text: Propitiare populo tuo Deus ut a suis pravitatibus liberatus et toto tibi corde deserviat et sub tua semper protectione consistat.
translation_en: God, have mercy on your people, that having been freed from their wickedness and serving You wholeheartedly with all their strength, they may always be under Your protection.

text: Propitiare precibus nostris omnipotens Deus et interveniente beato Germano confessore tuo atque pontifice munus quod ore sumpsimus nobis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: May Almighty God, through the intercession of Blessed Germanus, your confessor and bishop, make the ministry that we have received profitable for our salvation as a result of our prayers.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum misericordia sempiterna ut mortalibus nexibus expeditas lux eas aeterna possideat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate the souls of your servants and their servants, with eternal mercy, so that they may possess the eternal light freed from earthly bonds.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui illius et praesta ut qui de tuis donis in hoc loco pervigili cura nomini tuo cottidiana praeparavit obsequia perpetua cum sanctis tuis mereatur perfrui laetitia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate the soul of your servant that one, who daily in this place prepared perpetual obedience for your name from your gifts while awake at night, may merit to rejoice with your saints.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui illius pro qua tibi hostias placationis offerimus et quia in hac luce (in) fide mansit catholica ei in futura vita eius retributio condonetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to propitiate the soul of your servant for whom we offer sacrifices of appeasement in this life. In faith, he has remained steadfast in this life and it is hoped that in his future life, his repentance will be forgiven.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine nobis famulis tuis per huius sancti confessoris sive martyris tui illius qui in praesenti requiescit ecclesia merita gloriosa ut eius pia intercessione ab omnibus (semper) protegamur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Lord, to propitiate us, Your servants, through the merits of this holy confessor or martyr of Yours who now rests in peace in the glorious church, that we may be protected by his pious intercession from all (ever) adversities.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus propitiare nobis famulis tuis per beatarum virginum ac martyrum tuarum Euphemiae Dorotheae Teclae et Erasmae quarum corpora in praesenti requiescunt ecclesia merita gloriosa ut earum pia intercessione ab omnibus protegamur adversis et caelestibus muniamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, propitiate us, Your servants, through the blessed virgins and martyrs of Yours, Euphemia, Dorothea, Thecla, and Erasma, whose bodies now rest in the glorious church. May their pious intercession protect us from all adversities and arm us with celestial aids.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris ut haec oblatio quam in honorem sanctorum martyrum tuorum Hellari et Daciani Felicis Largi atque Dionysii oculis tuae maiestatis devote deferimus cunctis nobis proficiat ad salutem et ad remissionem omnium peccatorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you be appeased by our supplications, so that the offering which we dedicate in honor of your saints, Hellar, Dacian, Felicitas, Largus, and Dionysius, may be presented devoutly before your majesty, may benefit all of us for our salvation, and bring remission of all sins.

text: Propitiare quaesumus Domine supplicationibus nostris ut haec oblatio quam oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus nobis a salutem et cunctis fidelibus proficiat ad prosperitatem.
translation_en: We entreat You, Lord, with our supplications, that this offering which we present before Your majesty's eyes may benefit us for salvation and all faithful ones for prosperity.

text: Propitiationem tuam Domine quaesumus sentiamus de celebritate praesenti ut oblationibus nostris sancti illius interventione susceptis et indulgentiam nobis tribuas et salutaria dona concedas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that we may experience your propitiation in the present celebration, so that through the intervention of the saint with our offerings, you grant us indulgence and bestow upon us beneficial gifts.

text: Propitiationem tuam Domine supplices deprecamur ut gloriosum martyrem Iulianum triumpho nobili hodierna die ad caelos evectum apud te habeamus intercessorem quem per te veneramur victorem.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Your propitiation, Lord, that the glorious martyr Julian may today, lifted by a noble triumph, be with us an intercessor before You, whom we venerate as a victor through Your grace.

text: Propitiatorem nostris facinoribus fratres amantissimi venerabiliter supplices exoremus ut recitatis nominibus defunctorum dignanter munera respiciat offerentium ut suae potestatis sanctificatione largita haec oblatio in Christi corpore et cruore conversa proficiat defunctis ad requiem fiat offerentibus ad mercedem maneat sumentibus ad salutem.
translation_en: Brothers dearest, we humbly and reverently beseech you as our intercessor for our sins, that as the names of the deceased are read, it may graciously look upon the offerings of those who give, so that this offering, converted into Christ's body and blood, may bring profit to the departed, grant them peace, remain a reward for those who have given, and bring salvation to those who partake.

text: Propitius Domine quaesumus haec dona sanctifica et hostiae spiritalis oblatione suscepta nosmet ipsos tibi perfice munus aeternum.
translation_en: Gracious Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify these gifts and, accepted by the spiritual offering, complete in ourselves the eternal service.

text: Propitius Domine quaesumus oblationem nostrae servitutis intende et ut sanctorum tuorum precibus commendetur indulge.
translation_en: Gracious Lord, we humbly ask that you direct your attention to our offering of service and that it be entrusted and granted indulgence through the prayers of your saints.

text: Propitius esto Domine plebi tuae et auxilium nobis de sancto celerius fac adesse.
translation_en: Be gracious to Your people, Lord, and hasten to help us by the intercession of the saints.

text: Propitius esto Domine supplicationibus nostris et populi tui oblationibus precibusque susceptis omnium nostrum ad te corda converte ut a terrenis cupiditatibus liberi ad caelestia desideria transeamus.
translation_en: Lord, be propitious to our supplications and to the offerings and prayers of your people. Turn the hearts of all of us towards you, so that we may pass from terrestrial desires to celestial longings.

text: Propitius intuere munera Domine quaesumus quae tuis altaribus exhibemus ut quod nostra fragilitate defertur tua virtute sacretur.
translation_en: Graciously look upon the offerings, Lord, we beseech You, that which we present to Your altars may be sanctified by Your power because of our frailty.

text: Propitius tribue Domine ut hac oblatione mundemur pro qua sancti tui inter supplicia dimicando sempiternam gloriam sunt adepti.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that through this offering we may be cleansed. For Your saints, who through their suffering achieved eternal glory, have attained it while fighting in supplication.

text: Prosequere Domine populum tuum ut apostolorum natalicia beata sanctorum et temporali consolatione fultus semper exerceat et aeterna miseratione redemptus agnoscat.
translation_en: Follow, Lord, Your people so that they may always exercise the blessings of the feast days of the apostles and the holy saints, and may be redeemed by eternal mercy and recognize it.

text: Prosequere omnipotens Deus ieiuniorum sacra mysteria et quos ab escis carnalibus praecipis abstinere a noxiis quoque vitiis cessare concede.
translation_en: Almighty God, follow those who observe the sacred mysteries of fasting, and grant that they may cease not only from carnal pleasures but also from harmful vices.

text: Prosequere quaesumus omnipotens Deus ieiuniorum sacra mysteria et quos ab escis carnalibus praecipis temperare a noxiis quoque vitiis cessare concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, to follow the sacred mysteries of the fasting and grant those whom you command to abstain from carnal sins also to cease from other vices.

text: Prosint (im)meritis Domine patrocinia multiplicata sanctorum et iniustitias nostras tot oratio beatorum pro nobis fusa dissolvat.
translation_en: May, Lord, the manifold patronage of saints be favorable to us for our merits, and may the many prayers of the blessed dissolve our injustices on our behalf.

text: Prosint nobis Domine frequentata mysteria quae nos a cupiditatibus terrenis expediant et instruant amare caelestia.
translation_en: Lord, may the often-celebrated mysteries aid us, which free us from earthly desires and teach us to love celestial things.

text: Prosint nobis Domine iustorum tuorum frequentata sollemnia quoniam quanto fragiliores sumus tanto tibi placentium praesidiis indigemus.
translation_en: Lord, may your just ones' frequented solemnities be favorable to us, for as we grow weaker, we need all the more your protective aid.

text: Prosit nobis Domine sancti Tiburtii celebrata sollemnitas quia quanto fragiliores sumus tanto placentium tibi praesidiis indigemus.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to us, Lord, the holy feast of Saint Tiburtius, for as we are more frail, so much do we need your protective aid.

text: Prosint nobis Domine quaesumus sumpta mysteria pariterque nos et a peccatis exuant et praesidiis tuae propitiationis attollant.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the sacred mysteries bestowed upon us may purify us from sins and raise us up by your protective favor.

text: Prosint nobis Domine quaesumus tuorum suffragia collata sanctorum ut quae nostris non possumus orationibus obtinere placentium tibi precibus assequamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your grace, supported by the prayers of your saints, may grant us what we cannot achieve through our own prayers, so that through their petitions we may attain what pleases you.

text: Prosit nobis Domine ad salutem sacri muneris oblatio per quam beati Anthonii fulti suffragio exemplo ipsius omnia tela nequissimi ignea exstinguentes sanctorum mereamur adiungi consortio.
translation_en: May it profit us, Lord, for our salvation through the offering of the sacred ministry. By this we hope to be helped by the intercession of blessed Anthony, that following his example, we may be worthy to extinguish all wicked tools of fire, and be joined to the consortium of saints.

text: Prosit nobis Domine huius sacramenti sancta libatio et Prosit nobis Domine hui s tuae nos apud te gloriosa beatae Fidis virginis et martyri sublevet intercessio.
translation_en: May this sacred offering profit us, O Lord, and May this sacrifice profit us, O Lord, through the intercession of your glorious blessed Virgin and Martyr, St. Faith.

text: Prosit nobis Domine quaesumus beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Donati et Carpophori (intercessione haec) sancta perceptio quae nos et a terrenis affectibus incessabiliter expediat et caelestia desiderare perficiat.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to us, Lord, we beseech you, by the most blessed martyrs of yours Donatus and Carpophorus (through their intercession), that we may receive a holy perception which continually frees us from earthly passions and completes our desire for heavenly things.

text: Prosit nobis Domine quaesumus et sacrificii caelestis infusio et sancti Stephani protomartyris intercessio salutaris.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to us, Lord, we beseech you, and the infusion of the heavenly sacrifice, and the salutary intercession of Saint Stephen the Protomartyr.

text: Prosit nobis Domine quaesumus mysterii frequentata perceptio  ut a vetustatis condicione purgati ad tuae novitatis incrementa tendamus.
translation_en: May it profit us, Lord, as we humbly ask, through the participation in the mystery, that we may be purified from the condition of old age and strive towards the increase of your newness.

text: Prosit nobis quaesumus Domine sacer cibus potusque salutaris qui et temporalem vitam muniat et praestet aeternam.
translation_en: May it be pleasing to us, we ask you, Lord, the holy food and drink that both sustain our temporal life and provide for eternal life.

text: Prosit nobis quaesumus Domine sacramenti tui perceptio salutaris pro tuorum commemoratione sanctorum ut nos et a vitiis mortalitatis expediat et perpetuae socios miserationis efficiat.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Lord, the beneficial reception of your sacrament, for the remembrance of your saints, that we may be freed from the vices of mortality and made eternal companions of your mercy.

text: Prosit nobis quaesumus (Domine) sancti Leudegarii martyris tui atque pontificis multiplicata devotio ut sumentes divina mysteria pro eius commemoratione celebrata capiamus aeterna(e) simul incrementa laetitiae.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord (Lord), that the devotion to Your saint and bishop Leudegar be multiplied for us. May we who partake in the divine mysteries on his commemoration, gain eternal increase of joy together.

text: Prosit nobis quaesumus semper omnipotens Pater et praecipue inter haec paschalia Filii tui sollemnia continuata Dei Genitricis et virginis Mariae memoria quae et adstitit vulnerata caritate in cruce pendenti et nunc adstat a dextris regina in caelo regnanti.
translation_en: We humbly ask you always, Almighty Father, that it may benefit us. Especially during these paschal seasons of your Son, let the continuation of the solemnities be to our advantage, remembering the Mother of God and Virgin Mary who stood afflicted with love on the cross and now stands at your right hand as queen reigning in heaven.

text: Prosit nobis semper quaesumus Domine divini celebratio sacramenti ut intercedente beata Paula matrona eius in quo credimus et speramus consortium habeamus aeternum.
translation_en: May it always be favorable to us, we humbly ask you, Lord, the divine celebration of the sacrament, that with the intercession of blessed Paula, the matron, in the place where we believe and hope, we may have eternal fellowship.

text: Prosit plebi tuae misericors Deus divini perceptio sacramenti et intercessio beati Thomae apostoli tui ut salvationem mentis et corporis et incessabiliter expetat et affluenter accipiat.
translation_en: May your merciful God, through the divine perception of the sacrament and the intercession of Blessed Thomas, your apostle, grant to your people salvation of mind and body, and may they constantly desire and abundantly receive it.

text: Prosit plebi tuae omnipotens Deus sanctarum virginum illarum veneranda festivitas ut quarum gaudet honoribus protegatur auxiliis.
translation_en: May Almighty God grant happiness to Your people, O mighty God. May the revered festival of these holy virgins protect them with their honors through auxiliaries.

text: Prosit quaesumus Domine animae famuli tui illius sacerdotis misericordiae tuae implorata clementia ut eius in quo speravit et credidit aeternum capiat te miserante consortium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may the soul of your servant, that priest, find your mercy's favor, granted by his implored clemency. May he, in whom he hoped and believed, attain eternal communion with you, merciful one.

text: Prosit Domine quaesumus animae famuli tui illius divini celebratio sacramenti ut eius in quo speravit et credidit aeternum capiat te miserante consortium.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the soul of your servant may benefit from the divine celebration of the sacrament, so that in you, whom he hoped for and believed in, he may obtain eternal communion through your mercy.

text: Prosit quaesumus Domine haec sacra praesentis sacrificii oblatio animabus quae nobis in orationem commendatae sunt ut per nomen tuum sanctum a perpetui ignis cruciatibus ereptae transitum mereantur in requiem aeternam.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that this sacred offering of the present sacrifice be favorable to the souls committed to our prayer by you, so that through your holy name they may merit a passage into eternal rest, being freed from the tortures of everlasting fire.

text: Prospiciens de excelso sancto tuo summe Deus haec holocausta placatus attende qui beatissimum Tirsum tuum delatis angelorum obsequiis et in carcere visitasti et ex profundo maris eripuisti quo omnes nos qui ex his sacramentis libaverimus cunctis veniam impetrantes et inter istius mundi fluctus tuorum angelorum custodiis muniamur et remuneraturi a te de huius vitae carcere exeamus.
translation_en: Looking down from your high holy place, Supreme God, you who are pleased with these holocausts, attend. You who brought the blessed Trinity to your service by angelic obedience, and visited while in prison, and rescued from the depth of the sea, grant us all who have been freed from these sacraments forgiveness for all. May we be protected by your angels' guardianship amidst the ebb and flow of this world, and may we depart from this life's prison and receive our reward from you.

text: Protector fidelium Deus et subditarum tibi mentium frequentatur habitantibus in hac domo famulis tuis propitius adesse digneris ut quos nos humana visitamus sollicitudine tu divina munias potestate.
translation_en: May the God of faithful ones and submissive minds frequent this house, graciously deign to be present to your servants, so that by Your divine power You may strengthen those whom we humanly visit with care.

text: Protector in te sperantium Deus et subditarum tibi mentium custos inclina aurern tuam supplicationibus nostris et pia populi tui vota benignus exaudi.
translation_en: In you, God, do the protectors of the hopeful seek refuge, and the mind's submissions find their guardian. Bend your ear to our supplications and, graciously, listen to the pious wishes of your people.

text: Protector in te sperantium Deus et subditarum tibi mentium custos habitantibus in hac domo famulis tuis propitius adesse dignare; veniat super eos speratae a te benedictionis ubertas ut pietatis tuae repleti muneribus in tua gratia et in tuo nomine laeti semper exsultent.
translation_en: In you, O God, those hoping are protected, and to you, submissive minds, the guardian dwells who live in this house, your servants. May it be gracious for you to be present; may the abundance of the blessing hoped for from you come upon them, so that filled with your pity they may always rejoice in your grace and in your name.

text: Protector in te sperantium Deus exaudi preces nostras et miserere nostri ut corpore et mente vegetati tuis semper inhaereamus officiis.
translation_en: In you, O God, those hoping for protection find refuge. Hear our prayers and have mercy on us, so that we who are nourished physically and spiritually may always remain attached to your duties.

text: Protector in te sperantium Deus familiam tuam propitius respice et per beatos apostolos tuos illos a cunctis eam adversitatibus potentiae tuae brachio defende.
translation_en: In you, those hoping for protection trust God, have mercy and look upon your family. Through your blessed apostles, defend them from all adversities with the power of your arm.

text: Protector in te sperantium Deus praesta quaesumus ut maiestatem tuam sine cessatione laudemus et ut tibi possimus iugiter famulari salutem nobis tribue mentis et corporis.
translation_en: In you, O God, those hoping for protection entrust themselves. We humbly ask that you bestow upon us the ability to unceasingly laud your majesty and to serve you constantly. Grant us health of mind and body.

text: Protector in te sperantium Deus respice populum supplicantem et apostolico interveniente suffragio perfice miseratus pia desideria singulorum.
translation_en: In you, protectors of the hopeful, God, look upon the people praying and, through the intervention of the apostle's intercession, complete your merciful response to the devout desires of each one.

text: Protector in te sperantium Deus salva populum tuum tuere dispone ut a peccatis liber (et) ab hoste securus in tua semper gratia perseveret.
translation_en: In you, the protectors of the hopeful, God saves your people. Guard and arrange that they may always be free from sins (and) secure from an enemy, in your constant grace they may persist.

text: Protector in te sperantium Deus sine quo nihil est validum nihil sanctum multiplica super nos misericordiam tuam ut te rectore te duce sic transeamus per bona temporalia ut non amittamus aeterna.
translation_en: In you, those hoping protect, God, without whom nothing is valid or holy. May your mercy multiply upon us, so that guided and led by you, we may pass through temporal goods without losing eternal ones.

text: Protector noster adspice Deus et ab hostium nos defende formidine ut omni perturbatione submota liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: Our protector, look upon us, God, and defend us from the terror of our enemies, that with calm minds we may serve you without any disturbance.

text: Protector noster adspice Deus et misericordiam tuam humiliter implorantes clementer exaudi.
translation_en: Our protector, God, look upon us, and hear humbly our prayer for mercy. Graciously grant us your clemency.

text: Protector noster adspice Deus ut qui malorum nostrorum pondere premimur percepta misericordia libera tibi mente famulemur.
translation_en: Our Protector, look upon us, God, that we who are pressed by the weight of our sins may, through perceived mercy, serve you with a free mind.

text: Protegat Domine quaesumus populum tuum et participatio caelestis indulta convivii et deprecatio collata sanctorum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you protect your people. May the participation in heaven's gifts bring joy to the gathering, and may the prayers offered be heard by the saints.

text: Protegat Domine quaesumus tua dextera populum supplicantem ut praesentem vitam sub tua gubernatione transcurrens mereatur invenire perpetuam.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that Your right hand protect the people praying, so that while passing through this present life under Your guidance, they may deserve to find eternal life.

text: Protegat Ecclesiam tuam Deus oratio veneranda sanctorum et cui frequentiam devotionis impendit perpetuum poscat redemptionis effectum.
translation_en: May God, through his venerable prayer, protect your Church and grant an eternal effect of the redemption to those who frequent it.

text: Protegat nos Domine cum tui perceptione sacramenti beatus martyr tuus ille intercedendo pro nobis ut confessionis eius semper experiamur auxilio.
translation_en: May the Lord protect us with his sacred perception, through your blessed martyr who intercedes for us, that we may always experience help from his confession.

text: Protegat nos Domine cum tui perceptione sacramenti beatus Benedictus abba pro nobis intercedendo ut et conversationis eius experiamur insignia.
translation_en: May the Lord protect us with the shelter of his blessing, Saint Benedict the Abbot's sacrament intercession for us. So that we may experience the signs of his way of life.

text: Protegat nos Domine quaesumus hostia salutaris et quae ad honorem tui nominis immolatur nobis prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord, we entreat you, by the saving sacrifice and that which is offered for your honorable name; may it benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Protegat nos Domine saepius beati Andreae apostoli repetita sollemnitas ut cuius patrocinia sine intermissione recolimus perpetua defensione sentiamus.
translation_en: May the Lord frequently protect us by the repeated feast of blessed Andrew the Apostle, that we may always remember his patronage without interruption and feel perpetual protection.

text: Protege Domine famulos tuos et praesta propitius ut in hac domo te annuente perfecta ad honorificentiam beati apostoli tui illius religiosa multitudo concurrat.
translation_en: Lord, protect your servants and graciously grant that a pious multitude may gather in this house with your blessing, to participate perfectly in the honoring of your blessed apostle.

text: Protege Domine famulos tuos subsidiis pasce corporeis et spiritalibus enutriens alimentis a cunctis hostibus redde securos.
translation_en: Lord, protect your servants with sustaining provisions, nourish them both physically and spiritually with all manner of food, and return them safe from every enemy.

text: Protege Domine famulos tuos subsidiis pacis et beatae Mariae patrociniis confidentes a cunctis hostibus redde securos.
translation_en: Lord, protect your servants with the supports of peace and under the patronage of the blessed Mary, we confidently seek safety from all enemies.

text: Protege Domine fideles tuos et quos spiritali cibo vivificare dignatus es perpetua salvatione comitare.
translation_en: Lord, protect your faithful ones and those whom you have deemed worthy to be accompanied by eternal salvation through spiritual food.

text: Protege Domine plebem tuam cum sanctorum tuorum patrocinio supplicantem et in tua pietate confisam interius exteriusque purifica ut per haec quae divino sacrificio gustaverunt et mentium salutem mereantur et corporum.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people with the patronage of your saints as they humbly plead and trust in your mercy, both inside and out. Purify them through what they have tasted in the divine sacrifice, that they may merit spiritual health for their minds and bodily health.

text: Protege Domine plebem tuam et festivitate martyrum tuorum Valentini Vitalis Filiculae et Zenonis quae nobis tradis assidue debita tibi persolvi precibus concede sanctorum.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and grant us the festivity of your martyrs Valentinus, Vitalis, Filicula, and Zenon, which we are obliged to celebrate daily. Grant this through the prayers of the saints.

text: Protege Domine plebem tuam et quam divinis tribuis participare sacramentis apostolica intercessione ab omnibus absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and grant them to share in the apostolic sacraments through divine intervention. With apostolic intercession, absolve them from all sins.

text: Protege Domine plebem tuam et quam martyrum tuorum assidua tribuis festivitate devotam tibi semper placitam fieri precibus concede iustorum.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and with unceasing devotion offer them the festival of your martyrs. Grant that their prayers may always please you, through the merits of the righteous.

text: Protege Domine populum tuum de tua misericordia confidentem et quos caelestibus refecisti mysteriis beati Aegidii confessoris tui atque abbatis intercessione tuis muneribus assequendis effice promptiores.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people with your mercy, who are confident in you and whom you have restored by the mysteries of your blessed confessor and abbot Saint Gregory. By the intervention of your mercies, make them more eager to attain your gifts.

text: Protege Domine populum tuum et apostolorum patrocinio confidentem perpetua defensione conserva.
translation_en: Protect, Lord, your people, and constantly defend with the patronage of the apostles.

text: Protege Domine populum tuum et in sanctorum tuorum patrocinio confidentem perpetua defensione guberna.
translation_en: Protect, Lord, your people and under the patronage of your saints, govern with perpetual defense those who are confident in you.

text: Protege Domine populum tuum quem confessionibus gloriosis circumdas et protegis; da nobis ex eorum interventione proficere et intercessione gaudere quibus apostolorum tuorum gloriam contulisti.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people whom you surround and shield with their glorious confessions; grant us to progress through their intervention, and to rejoice in their intercession, to whom you have granted glory among your apostles.

text: Protege Domine supplices tuos et sanctorum martyrum tuorum Agnetis Lucae et Victoris suffragiis confidentes perpetuis eorum intercessionibus contuere.
translation_en: Lord, protect your supplicants and, with the aid of your holy martyrs Agnes, Luke, and Victor, we are confident that they will continually intercede on our behalf.

text: Protege nos Domine quaesumus tuis mysteriis servientes ut divinis rebus et corpore famulemur et mente.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord, we beseech You, as Your servants of the mysteries, that we may serve in divine matters and in body and mind.

text: Protege nos Domine quaesumus tuis mysteriis servientes ut divinis rebus et corpore famulemur et mente et gentem quam super nos agnoscimus praevalere per auxilium misericordiae tuae sentiamus cessare.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord, we beseech You, as Your servants of the mysteries, that we may serve in divine matters and with our body, mind, and spirit, and may the power we acknowledge above us cease through the help of Your mercy.

text: Protege me Domine tuis mysteriis servientem ut divinis rebus et corpore famuler et mente et temptationem illam quam super me praevalere cognosco per auxilium misericordiae tuae sentiam cessare.
translation_en: Protect me, Lord, your servant by your mysteries, that I may serve you in divine matters and corporally, and in mind and temptation, the one which I recognize over me, through the help of your mercy, I may feel cease.

text: Protege nos quaesumus Domine gratia tua tibi sancta sacrificia immolantes et plagam quam super nos imminere pavemus per auxilium misericordiae tuae sentiamus cessare.
translation_en: Protect us, we implore you, Lord, with your grace; as we offer sacred sacrifices to you, let us fear the sword that hangs over us. May we feel it cease through the help of your mercy.

text: Protege nos Domine tuorum deprecatione iustorum ut quorum circumdamur suffragio foveamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord, by the supplication of Your righteous ones, that we may be enkindled by their intercession and strengthened by their help.

text: Protege quaesumus Domine familiam tuam munera sacra libantem ut beati Cuthberti confessoris tui atque pontificis gaudenter sollemnia recensentes quod nostris impedimur meritis eius apud te iustum iudicem suffragemur patrociniis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect your family. May those who offer sacred gifts to you partake joyfully in the festivities of your blessed confessor and bishop, Cuthbert, remembering that due to our sins we are hindered from his merits before you. We will seek just judgment and support through his patronage.

text: Protege quaesumus Domine plebem tuam beati Nicolai praesulis patrocinio confidentem et quam divinis recreas sacramentis fac eam iugiter tuis inhaerere mandatis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect your people who are confident under the patronage of Blessed Nicolaus, the bishop. May you continually renew them with divine sacraments, so that they may always adhere to your commands.

text: Protege quaesumus Domine propitius dextera misericordiae tuae populum tota tibi devotione subiectum quem interveniente beato confessore tuo Martino benedictione remuneratum ad aeternam vitam pervenire concedas.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you protect the people wholly subject to you with your merciful right hand. May they have reached eternal life through the blessings of your blessed confessor Martin. Grant this, we pray.

text: Protege quaesumus Domine romani nominis ubique rectores ut his tua virtute vincentibus pax populi tui secura proveniat.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that everywhere the leaders of the Roman name protect them with your power, so that the peaceful people may securely come about through victory.

text: Purifica Domine Deus Pater omnipotens pectorum arcana nostrorum cunctasque propitius maculas ablue peccatorum ac praesta Domine ut beneficio pietatis tuae a nostris criminibus mundati metuendum terribilemque adventum Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui exspectemus interriti sicque te miserante hic percipere mereamur omnium veniam delictorum ut tuum in futuro iudicium nobis sentiamus omnimodo mitissimum et dexterae tuae participes facti a te mereamur perpetuae vitae percipere praemium tuumque consequamur invictum infinitum et fortissimum regnum.
translation_en: Purify, Lord, God Almighty Father, the secrets of our hearts; and in Your mercy, wash away all stains of our sins. May it please You, Lord, that we are cleansed by Your grace from our offenses and fear Your terrible coming, Lord Jesus Christ, Son Yours. So, moved by Your compassion, here may we deserve full forgiveness for all our transgressions. In the future judgment, may we experience Your most merciful judgment, and by Your mercy, become co-heirs of eternal life, conquering Your unending, infinite, and mighty kingdom.

text: Purifica Domine mentes nostras per haec sancta quae sumpsimus ut de nullis mereamur actibus Christo iudicante puniri sed cum sanctis eius resurgamus ad gloriam coronandi.
translation_en: Purify, Lord, our minds through these holy things that we have taken, so that we may not deserve to be punished by Christ the Judge for any unworthy actions, but rather rise with His saints to the glory of being crowned.

text: Purifica Domine quaesumus familiam tuam et ab omnibus contagiis pravitatis emunda; tuis donis exsultent te semper et ubique collaudent ut redempta vasa sui domini passione non spiritus immundi rursus inficiant sed salvatio sempiterna possideat.
translation_en: Purify, we beseech You, Lord, Your family and cleanse them from all contagions of wickedness. May they always rejoice in Your gifts and everywhere praise You, so that the vessels of their Lord redeemed may not again be infected by an unclean spirit but rather may possess everlasting salvation.

text: Purifica quaesumus Domine familiam tuam et ab omnibus contagiis pravitatis emunda ut redempta vasa sui domini passione non spiritus immundus rursus inficiat sed salvatio sempiterna possideat.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to purify Your family and cleanse it from all contagions of wickedness, so that, having been cleansed, the vessels of Your servant may not again be infected by an unclean spirit but may instead forever possess salvation.

text: Purifica Domine quaesumus mentes nostras benignus et renova caelestibus sacramentis ut consequenter et corporum praesens pariter et futurum capiamus auxilium.
translation_en: Purify, we implore you, Lord, our minds with kindness and renew us with heavenly sacraments so that we may both grasp the present aid of our bodies and the future help in turn.

text: Purifica nos Deus per passionem Filii tui in cruce ut expiati ab omnibus malis gratiores esse <pos>simus.
translation_en: Purify us, God, through the Passion of Your Son on the cross, so that we may be forgiven from all evils and be more pleasing.

text: Purifica nos Domine iisdem quibus servitium dependimus sacramentis ut oblatio tibi nostra sacrificium pariter reddatur et actio.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, by the same sacraments on which our service depends, so that our offering may also be made acceptable to you as a sacrifice and action.

text: Purifica nos Domine quaesumus sumpto mysterio interveniente beato Edwardo martyre tuo et fac nos tibi sincera mente servire.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, we beseech You. With the mystery intervening with blessed Edward, Your martyr, make us serve You sincerely with a pure mind.

text: Purifica nos misericors Deus ut Ecclesiae tuae preces quae tibi gratae sunt pia munera deferentis fiant expiatis mentibus gratiores.
translation_en: Purify us, merciful God, so that the prayers of your Church, which are pleasing to you, may be presented by the offering of pious gifts with purified minds, becoming even more pleasing to you.

text: Purifica quaesumus Domine tuorum corda fidelium ut a terrena cupiditate mundati et praesentis vitae periculis exuantur et perpetuis donis firmentur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to purify the hearts of Your faithful so that, freed from earthly desires and rid of the dangers of this life, they may be strengthened by eternal gifts.

text: Purifica quaesumus omnipotens Deus mentem familiae tuae Spiritus Sancti illustratione ut per suffragia beati Mauricii confessoris tui atque pontificis accepta tibi nostrae devotionis praesentia munera reddantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to purify the mind of your family by the enlightenment of the Holy Spirit, so that through the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop, Saint Maurice, our present devotion may return to you the gifts offered.

text: Purificati Domine quaesumus gratia benedictionis vivificae duplicata beatorum Iusti et Pastoris intercessione satiemur gloriae epulis sempiternae.
translation_en: Purified Lord, we humbly ask that the double grace of blessing and life be bestowed upon us through the intercession of the blessed Just and Shepherd. May we be filled with eternal feasts of glory.

text: Purificent nos Domine quaesumus divina sacramenta quae sumpsimus et beata intercedente virgine martyreque tua Margareta ad praesentis vitae prosperitatem et ad futurae beatitudinem sempiternam nobis ea provenire concede.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, we beseech You, with Your divine sacraments which we have received, and through the blessed intercession of the Virgin and martyr Margaret, may it bring prosperity to our present life and eternal beatitude for us in the future.

text: Purificent nos Domine quaesumus sacramenta quae sumpsimus et famulum tuum illum ab omni culpa liberum esse concede ut qui(a) conscientiae reatu constringitur (de) caelestis remedii plenitudine glorietur.
translation_en: Purify us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, with the sacraments which we have received, and grant unto Thy servant to be free from all guilt. May he who is burdened by the weight of conscience rejoice in the fullness of celestial remedy.

text: Purificent nos Domine sacramenta quae sumpsimus et a cunctis efficiant vitiis absolutos.
translation_en: Purify us, O Lord, from the sacraments that we have received and make us free from all sins.

text: Purificent nos quaesumus Domine sacramenta quae sumpsimus et famulos et famulas tuas propitius intende qui divina mandata recolentes opem indigentibus subministrant et praesta ut sicut eorum devotio nobis est necessaria ita sit semper accepta.
translation_en: Purify us, we beseech You, Lord, the sacraments which we have received, and Your servants and handmaids propitiously attend, who, remembering Your divine commands, provide help to those in need. Grant that just as their devotion is necessary for us, it may always be accepted.

text: Oremus dilectissimi nobis omnipotentem Deum pro filio nostro illo qui recolens divina mandata de iustis laboribus suis victum indigentibus subministrat quatenus haec devotio ipsius sicut nobis est necessaria ita sit Deo semper accepta.
translation_en: Let us pray, the dearest to us Almighty God for our son who, mindful of divine commands, provides sustenance for those in need from his own labors. May this devotion of his be as necessary to us as it is always acceptable to God.

text: Purificent nos quaesumus Domine sacramenta quae sumpsimus et intercedente beato Martiale apostolo tuo per haec ad gaudia aeterna pervenire valeamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to purify the sacraments we have received, and through the intercession of your apostle Saint Marcellus, may we be able to reach eternal joy.

text: Purificent nos quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus sacramenta quae sumpsimus et praesta ut hoc tuum sacramentum non sit nobis reatus ad poenam sed intercessio salutaris ad veniam; sit ablutio scelerum sit fortitudo fragilium sit contra mundi pericula firmamentum sit vivorum atque mortuorum (fidelium) remissio omnium delictorum.
translation_en: Cleanse us, we beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, from the sacraments that we have received, and grant that this your sacred sacrament not be a burden to us for punishment but an intercession for forgiveness; let it be a washing away of sins, a strength for the weak, a fortress against the perils of the world, a remission for both the living and the dead (faithful), a forgiveness for all offenses.

text: Purificent nos quaesumus rex aeterne tua percepta sacramenta et intercessione beati Sigismundi regis et martyris tui expiatos ab omni malo tibi nos reddant acceptos.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O eternal King, that you purify us through your perceived sacraments and with the intercession of Blessed Sigismund, your king and martyr, may we be cleansed from all evil, and accepted by you.

text: Purificent semper et muniant tua sacramenta nos Deus ut qui de adventu unigeniti Filii tui secundum carnem laetantur in secundo cum venerit in maiestate sua cum omnibus sanctis praemium vitae aeternae percipiant.
translation_en: Always cleanse and fortify your sacraments, O God, that we may rejoice with joy at the coming of Your only-begotten Son in the flesh. When He comes in His majesty with all the saints, they may receive the reward of eternal life.

text: Purificent semper et muniant tua sacramenta nos Deus et ad perpetuae ducant salvationis effectum.
translation_en: May God always purify and fortify us with your sacraments, and lead us to eternal salvation.

text: Purificet Domine quaesumus indulgentia tua animam famuli tui illius et huius corporis et sanguinis participatio sacramenti aeterna refectione saginet et sempiterna redemptione muniat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your indulgence purify the soul of your servant, and may the participation in the sacred sacrament grant it eternal refreshment and everlasting redemption.

text: Purificet nos Domine caelestis exsecutio sacramenti et ad tuam magnificentiam capiendam divinis effectibus semper instauret.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, heavenly execution of the sacrament, and may it always restore us to attain Your magnificence by divine means.

text: Purificet nos Domine quaesumus et divini perceptio sacramenti et gloriosa sanctorum tuorum oratio.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, we beseech You, and by the divine perception of the sacrament, and by the glorious intercession of Your saints.

text: Purificet nos quaesumus Domine et divini sacramenti perceptio et gloriosa sanctorum tuorum oratio et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum commemorationem agimus remissionem cunctorum tribue peccatorum.
translation_en: Purify us, we ask you, Lord, and grant us the grace of the divine sacrament, and through the glorious prayer of your saints, bestow upon them all the forgiveness of sins.

text: Purificet quaesumus Domine famulum tuum illum divini sacramenti libatio et gloriosa sanctae Dei Genitricis et omnium sanctorum tuorum oratio et gregi sibi commisso ac familiaritate et consanguinitate iunctis et omni populo christiano misericordiam tuam ubique praetende et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum et omnium fidelium defunctorum remissionem omnium tribue peccatorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you purify your servant by the offering of the divine sacrament. May the glorious prayer of the holy Mother of God, the Virgin Mary, and all the saints of yours who are united to him through his flock committed to him, familiarity, and kinship, and to every Christian people extend your mercy. Grant remission of all sins to the souls of your servants, their attendants, and all faithful departed.

text: Purificet nos Domine quaesumus et divini perceptio sacramenti et gloriosa deprecatio sanctae Sabinae.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, we implore, and with divine perception of the sacrament, and with the glorious supplication of Saint Sabina.

text: Purificet nos Domine quaesumus tui perceptio sacramenti et quae pro beati Leonardi confessoris tui atque abbatis veneranda sollemnitate gerimus eius nobis patrocinantibus meritis ad indulgentiam prosint aeternam.
translation_en: Purify us, Lord, we ask of Your perception through the sacrament, and those things that we carry out in honor of your blessed confessor and abbot, St. Leonard, on this venerable solemnity, may his merits serve us for an eternal indulgence.

text: Purificet nos indulgentia tua Deus et ab omni semper iniquitate custodiat.
translation_en: Purify us with your indulgence, God, and keep us forever from all iniquity.

text: Purificent nos Deus haec sancta quae sumpsimus et ab omni semper iniquitate custodiant.
translation_en: May God purify us through these holy things which we have received, and may He always keep us from every iniquity.

text: Purificent nos haec sancta mysteria Domine Deus et intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis illo et illo ab omni semper iniquitate custodiant.
translation_en: Purify us with these holy mysteries, Lord God, and through the intercession of your holy martyrs, may they protect us always from every kind of wickedness.

text: Purificet nos quaesumus Domine divini perceptio sacramenti et intercedentibus beatorum apostolorum martyrum confessurum virginum patriarcharum prophetarum cunctorumque caelestium civium meritis famulo tuo illo quaesumus Domine omnibusque suprascripta condicione ei adhaerentibus quorum commemorationem agimus remissionem cunctorum tribue peccatorum.
translation_en: Purify us, we beseech You, Lord, by the divine perception of the sacrament, and through the intercession of the blessed apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, patriarchs, prophets, and all other heavenly citizens. For Your servant's sake, we humbly ask, Lord, that all those who adhere to the aforementioned conditions may receive forgiveness for all their sins.

text: Purificet nos quaesumus Domine huius sacramenti perceptio et ab omnibus peccatis potenter absolvat.
translation_en: Purify us, we entreat you, Lord, through the perception of this sacrament and powerfully absolve us from all sins.

text: Purificet nos quaesumus Domine muneris praesentis oblatio et dignos sacra participatione perficiat.
translation_en: Purify us, we beseech You, Lord, by the offering of the present service, and may it complete us worthy for sacred participation.

text: Purificet nos quaesumus Domine participatio tui sancta mysterii et pariter nobis expiationem tribuat et munimen.
translation_en: Purify us, we beseech you, Lord, participation in your holy mystery and grant us atonement and protection as well.

text: Purificet semper et muniat tui nos Domine susceptio sacramenti et intercessione sanctissimi confessoris tui Leonardi perpetuis per eam gaudiis mereamur admisceri.
translation_en: May Your grace, Lord, forever cleanse and fortify us as we receive the sacrament, and through the intercession of Your most holy confidant, St. Leonard, may we merit eternal joy by being admitted because of it.

text: Quae Domine celebrantes pro martyrum tuorum Sisinnii Martyrii et Alexandri beata passione peregimus ipsorum nobis quaesumus fiant intercessione salutaria in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter impleta.
translation_en: Which Lord, we celebrate the commemoration for Your martyrs Sisinnius and Martyrius, blessed in their passionate endurance. We humbly ask that through their intercession, may it be beneficial to us on the days of their birth, when their natal celebrations are most exultantly fulfilled.

text: Quae in hoc altari proposita Domine quaesumus oculis tuae maiestatis offerimus beatorum apostolorum supplicationibus propitiatus assume.
translation_en: Which are placed on this altar, Lord, we humbly ask that with the eyes of your majesty you accept them. We offer them to you with the supplications of the blessed apostles, propitious one, receive them.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster; quae in hoc altari proposita oculis tuae maestatis offerimus beatorum apostolorum tuorum supplicationibus propitiatus assume.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord our God; what on this altar is presented before Your majesty's eyes with the prayers of Your blessed apostles, moved by mercy, receive.

text: Quae tuo nomini Domine sunt dicata quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae principum commendet oratio.
translation_en: We humbly ask your Church, Lord, to commend its leaders to the prayer dedicated to your name.

text: Quaesumus benedictionis auctor et sanctificationis dator quaesumus ut hoc sacrificium benedicere et sanctificare digneris et interpellante beato pontifice Patricio nobis famulis tuis remissionem tribuas peccatorum.
translation_en: We entreat the author of blessings and the giver of sanctification, we entreat you, that you deign to bless and sanctify this sacrifice. Through intercession by the blessed Pope Patricius, grant us, your servants, remission of sins.

text: Quaesumus clementiam tuam omnipotens Deus ut ubi nulla fiducia suppetit actionum gratia tua copiosa resplendeat et cum delicta remittit indignis et cum beneficia praestat immeritis.
translation_en: We humbly ask Your clemency, Almighty God, that where no trust supports the grace of Your actions, Your abundant grace may shine forth; and that You forgive the unworthy and grant blessings to the undeserving.

text: Quaesumus Deus per hanc hostiam ut a morte animae resurgere mereamur cuius in ara crucis beatae Mariae precibus matris gladius pertransivit animam.
translation_en: We ask you, God, through this offering, that we may deserve to rise from death, whose soul passed through the sword of the Blessed Mother Mary on the altar of the cross by her prayers.

text: Quaesumus Domine caelestibus repleti mysteriis ut hoc templum sereno tuae pietatis intuitu dignanter illustres et cunctis in eo te deprecantibus misericordiae tuae clementer auditu<m> accommodes.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, filled with celestial mysteries, that this temple may be honorably enlightened by your serene gaze of piety, and that you may kindly accommodate our petitions in it to the hearing of your mercy.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster; guberna famulum tuum illum et tuis semper accumula beneficiis ut et vitae praesentis gaudeat subsidiis et aeternae.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord our God; govern Your servant and always accumulate Your blessings upon him, so that he may rejoice in the aid of his present life, and enjoy the benefits of eternal life.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ne apud iustitiam tuam peccata nostra nos aggravent quam tuae pietatis invicta miseratio nec nos quamlibet innumeris gravari patiaris erroribus quos tantis voluisti sanctorum tuorum suffragiis adiuvari.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that our sins not weigh heavily upon your justice, and that your invincible mercy does not burden us with any innumerable errors which you have wished to be aided by the intercession of your saints.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster; quos sacramentis reficis sustenta praesidiis et quos beneficiis temporalibus refoves pasce divinis.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord our God; whom You sustain with spiritual supports and refresh with temporal blessings, nourish with divine food.

text: Quos divinis Domine reficis sacramentis tuis quaesumus sustenta praesidiis et quos beneficiis temporalibus refoves pasce perpetuis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to strengthen those whom you refresh with your sacred mysteries. Sustain them with protective guardianship and those whom you raise up with temporal blessings, nourish with eternal food.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut cum perceptione tuorum sacramentorum sanctae quoque virginis ac martyris tuae Margaretae meritis muniamur cuius sollemnia celebramus ovantes.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord our God, that with the perception of Your sacred sacraments, we may also be protected by the merits of Your virgin and martyr Margaret, whose feast day we celebrate, offering thanks.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut divina mysteria quae in tuorum commemoratione sanctorum frequentamus actu subsequamur et sensu.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that we may follow the divine mysteries which we frequently partake in your remembrance of saints not only in action but also in understanding.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut haec divini sacramenti perceptio ab omnibus nos emundet delictis et famulos tuos omnes fideles rem publicam gubernantes a cunctis eximat malis repleatque omnibus per omnia bonis.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord our God, that this perception of the divine sacrament may cleanse us from all sins through all, and that Your entire faithful servants, who govern the republic, may be freed from all evils and filled with every good.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut in cuius haec commemoratione percepimus eius muniamur et precibus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that we may be strengthened by whose commemoration we have here perceived, and protected by our prayers.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut interius nobis exteriusque conferant haec mysteria sanitatem quae famulis tuis in utroque voluisti praebere subsidium.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord our God, that within us and without us, these mysteries may grant health, which You willed to give as support to Your servants in both (spiritual and physical) realms.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intervenientibus sanctis tuis sacrosancta mysteria quae frequentamus actu subsequamur et sensu.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that with the intervention of your holy ones, we may follow the sacred mysteries which we frequently attend not only in action but also in understanding.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intervenientibus sanctis tuis sacrosancta mysteria quae sumpsimus actu subsequamur et sensu.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that as your holy ones come to us, may we not only receive but also understand the sacred mysteries which we have partaken.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut mensae tuae sancta libantes non ad iudicium nobis sed ad praesidium sempiternum caelestia dona sumamus.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord our God, that the offerings of Your holy table may not be a judgment for us but rather eternal heavenly gifts we receive.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut nobis beatae Fidis virginis et martyris tuae hodierna festivitas salutis praestet incrementum cuius admiranda vita salutare praebet exemplum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that today's festival of your blessed Virgin and Martyr may bring us an increase. Whose admirable life provides a saving example.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut non desinant sancti tui pro nostris supplicare peccatis a quibus te voluisti pro peccatoribus exorari.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that your saints may not cease to intercede for our sins, from which you wished to be entreated on behalf of the sinners.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut noxiis desideriis expeditos devotionem nos tibi liberam atque oblationem offerre concedas.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that you grant us the ability to offer to you a free devotion and an offering, unburdened by worldly desires.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui sacerdotis placatus accipias et quem tuis altaribus servire tribuisti ad beatorum pervenire iubeas consortia sacerdotum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the offering which we present to you for the soul of your servant, the priest, may please you and order it to serve at the altars of the blessed ones, so that you command it to join the company of priests.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut omnium sanctorum tuorum gloriosa nos ubique intercessio protegat quorum hic sacra iugiter gaudemus praesentia.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the glorious intercession of all your saints protect us everywhere, whose presence here we continually enjoy in these sacred rites.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per vexillum sanctae crucis Filii tui ad conterendas adversariorum nostrorum insidias nos in tuae protectionis securitate constituas.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord our God, that through the banner of the holy cross of your Son, we may be established in the safety of your protection against the deceitful plots of our enemies.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per haec caelestis vitae commercia declinantes laqueos falsitatum ad veritatem tuam concessae nobis divinitus viae tramite dirigamur.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord our God, that through these commercial dealings of celestial life, as we turn away from the nets of falsehoods, we may be guided by Your truth to the divine path.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut propitiationis tuae nobis collata securitas non nos efficiat neglegentes sed potius ad cultum nominis tui reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the security of your propitiations may not make us negligent but rather return us accepted to the worship of your name.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quod nobis ad immortalitatis pignus esse voluisti ad salutis aeternae tribuas provenire suffragium.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that what you have wished to be for us as a pledge of immortality, may come to our aid with the help of your prayer for eternal salvation.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quos divina tribuis participatione gaudere humanis non sinas subiacere periculis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that you who grant us a share in divine joy, do not allow us to be subjected to human dangers.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quos divina tribuis participatione gaudere humanis non sinas subiacere periculis.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that those whom you grant to participate in divine joy may not be subjected to human dangers.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quos divinis reparare non desinis sacramentis tuis non destituas benignus auxiliis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that you do not cease to repair us with your divine sacraments and that you do not abandon us with your kind aids.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sacri mysterii munus indultum intercedentibus sanctis virginibus tuis illa et illa et praesentis nobis vitae subsidium et aeternitatis largiatur effectum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the office of the sacred mystery be granted to us through the intercession of your holy virgins, both of them, and may they bestow upon us support for this life and bestow upon us the effect of eternity.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sacrosancta mysteria quae pro reparationis nostrae munimine contulisti et praesens nobis remedium esse facias et futurum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that the most sacred mysteries which you have given us for the defense of our repairing may be present to us as a remedy now and in the future.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut omnium (commemoratione) sanctorum temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur adspectu.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, that just as we rejoice temporally with the commemoration of all saints, so may we be eternally joyful through the sight of them.

text: Quaesumus Domine Deus ut sicut profuit nobis te cognovisse per gratiam fidei ita prosit te postulasse per afflictionem spiritalis ieiunii ac sicut per illam iubemur sperare aeterna ita per istam promereamur apud te tam vivis quam defunctis impetrare remedia postulata.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord God, that just as it has profited us to know You through the grace of faith, so may it benefit us to ask You through the affliction of spiritual fasting. And just as through that [fasting] we are commanded to hope for eternal life, so through this [affliction] may we be able to promise to obtain from You both for the living and the dead the remedies we have asked for.

text: Quaesumus Domine divino refecti mysterio ut qui sanctorum martyrum tuorum Processi et Martiniani temporali commemoratione gaudemus eorum intercessionibus in ea numeremur sorte salutis in qua illi sunt tua gratia gloriosi.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that having been nourished by the divine mystery, we who rejoice in the commemoration of your martyrs Processius and Martinianus during their temporal celebration, may be numbered among them through the lot of salvation where they are glorious due to your grace.

text: Quaesumus Domine divino saturati libamine ut sancto confessore tuo Dunstano intercedente praesentis nobis vitae praesidium et aeternae tribuas reperire laetitiam.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, after being satisfied with divine food, that through the intercession of Your holy confessor Dunstan, You grant us the protection of this life and may we find eternal happiness.

text: Quaesumus Domine; famulum tuum abbatem nostrum dextera tua sancta regat semper et protegat et concede propitius ut ea quae recta sunt te inspirante verbo et exemplo gregem sibi creditum feliciter instruat et pariter ad felicitatem perveniant sempiternam.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord; may your servant our abbot always be ruled and protected by your holy right hand. Graciously grant that he who is entrusted to him, instructed by your inspiring word and example, may shepherd the flock happily and may they all attain eternal happiness.

text: Quaesumus Domine ne nos tales patiaris exsistere quibus merito Dominentur adversa sed huiusmodi potius effici tribuas qui beneficiis tuis non perpetuo iudicemur indigni.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, not to let us exist like those who deserve to be ruled by adversity, but rather grant us to be of such a kind that we are not continually deemed unworthy through your blessings.

text: Quaesumus Domine nostris placare muneribus et a cunctis fideles tuos pro tui nominis amore persecutionem patientes defende periculis.
translation_en: We beseech Thee, Lord, to favor our offerings and defend Thy faithful ones who for the love of Thy name endure persecutions from all dangers.

text: Quaesumus Domine nostris placare muneribus et quidquid illud est quod iram tuam adversus famulum tuum illum excitavit horum intuitu clemens suspende.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to appease the offerings made on behalf of your servant and whatever caused your anger against him. In this regard, be merciful and suspend your wrath.

text: Quaesumus Domine nostris placare muneribus quoniam tu eadem tribuis ut placeris.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to favor our offerings, for you give in the same way as you please.

text: Quaesumus Domine pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum illarum et omnium hic quiescentium ut si quae carnales maculae de terrenis contagiis adhaeserunt miserationis tuae venia deleantur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, for the souls of your servants and their servants (i.e., those who serve them), as well as all those resting here, that any carnal stains clinging to them from worldly contagions may be cleansed by your mercy.

text: Quaesumus Domine pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum illarum quorum confessiones de propriis criminibus et facinoribus suscepimus et qui se iri nostris commendaverunt orationibus et quorum eleemosynas recepimus vel quorum nomina ad memorandum conscripsimus seu et omnium parentum nostrorum cunctorumque fidelium defunctorum; his muneribus intende placatus et quod ad laudem tui nominis supplicantes offerimus ad indulgentiam proficiat defunctorum.
translation_en: We entreat you, Lord, for the souls of your servants and their servants, whose confessions of their own sins and deeds we have accepted, and who have commended themselves to our prayers; and whose alms we have received or whose names we have written down for remembrance, or all parents and faithful departed of ours; with these services direct your favor, and what we humbly ask for the sake of your name may bring benefit to the deceased.

text: Quaesumus Domine; pro tua pietate miserere animae famulae tuae illius et a contagiis mortalitatis exutam in aeternae salvationis partem restitue.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord; out of your mercy, have mercy on the soul of your servant that one freed from the contagions of mortality has been restored to the part of eternal salvation.

text: Quaesumus Domine tuere famulum tuum illum et salutaribus praesidiis semper adiutum beneficiis attolle continuis mentis et corporis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to protect your servant and always to support him with saving graces, lift him up continuously with blessings for both mind and body.

text: Quaesumus Domine ut beatorum martyrum tuorum Nerei et Achillei deprecationibus sacramenta sancta quae sumpsimus ad tuae nobis proficiant placationis augmentum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the sacraments we have received may profit us through the intercession of your blessed martyrs Nereus and Achilles, increasing our offerings of reconciliation.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatorum martyrum tuorum Sisinnii Martyrii et Alexandri sed et sacerdotis et confessoris tui Simpliciani deprecationibus sacramenta sancta quae sumpsimus ad tuae nobis proficiant placationis augmentum.
translation_en: We entreat the almighty God that through the intercessions of your blessed martyrs Sisinnius, Martyrius, Alexander, and your priest and confessor Simplician, the sacred sacraments we have received may bring about an increase in grace for us.

text: Quaesumus Domine; {ut} famulo tuo illi cuius illum obitus sui diem commemoramus sanctorum atque electorum largire consortium et rorem misericordiae tuae perennis(em) infunde.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord; grant to your servant, whom we remember today among the saints and elect, fellowship and pour out the perpetual rain of your mercy.

text: Quaesumus Domine ut haec divina quae sumpsimus sacramenta in sanctae virginis Austrebertae commemorationem ad aeternam nos perducant caelestis convivii refectionem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the divine sacraments which we have taken in remembrance of Saint Austreberta may lead us to eternal refreshment in the heavenly banquet.

text: Quaesumus Domine ut huius operatio sacramenti purificet nos semper a peccatis et ab instantibus muniat periculis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that this operation of the sacrament may always purify us from sins and protect us from dangers.

text: Quaesumus Domine ut per haec sacrosancta mysteria et intercedente beato Petro apostolo tuo familiam tuam ab omni adversitate protegas.
