translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that through these most holy mysteries and with the intervention of blessed Peter, Your apostle, You protect Your family from every adversity.

text: Quaesumus Domine ut salutaribus repleti mysteriis quorum sollemnia celebramus orationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that as we are filled with the salutary mysteries whose feasts we celebrate, you aid us with prayers.

text: Quaesumus Domine salutaribus repleti mysteriis ut cuius sollemnia celebramus eius orationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, filled with sacred mysteries, that as we celebrate the solemnities of the one whose feast we keep, may his prayers assist us.

text: Quaesumus immensam clementiam tuam omnipotens et misericors Deus ut beati Lazari martyris tui atque pontificis intercessione et a morte liberemur quadrifida et vita perfruamur aeterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask your immeasurable mercy, O almighty and merciful God, that through the intercession of the blessed martyr and bishop Lazarus, we may be freed from death and enjoy eternal life.

text: Quaesumus misericors Deus ut tuae maiestati accepta sint munera nostrae servitutis quae et beatam virginem Mildritham nobis concilient et aeternae felicitatis gaudia divinitus subministrent.
translation_en: We humbly ask, merciful God, that our offerings of service be acceptable to your majesty, which not only unite us with the blessed Virgin Mildritham, but also provide us with eternal joy through divine providence.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus afflicti populi lacrimas respice et iram tuae indignationis averte ut qui reatum nostrae infirmitatis agnoscimus tua consolatione liberemur.
translation_en: We entreat the almighty God, look upon the tears of the afflicted people and turn away your wrath of indignation, so that we who acknowledge the guilt of our infirmity may be freed by your consolation.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus clementiam tuam ut inundantiam coerceas imbrium et hilaritatem tui vultus nobis impertire digneris.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God that you may restrain the flood of rain and bestow upon us your cheerfulness.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus Ecclesiae tuae tempora clementi gubernatione dispensa ut cum sollemnitatum multiplicatione sanctarum et intellectum rerum caelestium capiat et profectum.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God of your Church to govern its times with a merciful administration, that with the increase of solemnities and an understanding of celestial things, it may progress.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus familiam tuam propitius respice ut te largiente regatur in corpore et te servante custodiatur in mente.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, that Your family looks favorably upon us, so that You may rule over us generously in body and guard us faithfully in mind.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus; iam non teneamur obnoxii sententiae damnationis humanae cuius nos vinculis haec redemptio paschalis absolvit.
translation_en: We entreat you, Almighty God; may we no longer be subject to the sentence of human damnation, which this Paschal Redemption has freed us from.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus instituta providentiae tuae pio favore comitare et quos legitima societate connectis longaeva pace custodi.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, with your divine providence to accompany those united in lawful society by a loving favor, and to keep them in eternal peace.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus me famulum tuum quem Exoniensium voluisti esse antistitem et populum quem instituendum lege praeceptorum tuorum mihi commendasti hac sacri mysterii oblatione a peccatis emunda et unici Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi corpore et sanguine sanctifica ut remota omnium hostium perturbatione beato Petro apostolo tuo interveniente securi perveniamus ad consortia pacis angelicae.
translation_en: We entreat you, almighty God, my Lord and your servant whom the people of Exeter have chosen as their bishop, and the people whom you have entrusted to me to be established by the law of your commandments. We ask that through this offering in the holy mysteries, we may be purified from our sins, and consecrated in body and blood of your unique Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. May we safely reach the consortium of the angelic peace, with blessed Peter, your apostle, intervening, and any disturbance by adversaries removed.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus moveat pietatem tuam humilis supplicatio et intercedente sancta Dei Genitrice Maria simulque omnibus sanctis tuis intervenientibus da mihi confessionem quae tibi sit placita; parturi in corde meo inenarrabiles gemitus qui aures tuas possint pulsare; da mihi mentis intentionem quam suscipias perfundens bonitate tua et in humilitate deprecari quae te delectet ut digneris animae meae inserere ut iugis dilectio mea tu ipse sis; da mihi lacrimas ex toto affectu ut interna peccatorum possint exsolvere vincula.
translation_en: We entreat you, almighty God, move your pity by our humble supplication and through the intercession of the holy Mother of God, Mary, as well as all your saints who are present. Grant me a confession that pleases you; within my heart may there be inexpressible groans that can touch your ears; grant me a mind's intention that you may accept, pouring out your goodness upon it, and to humbly pray what delights you, that you may deign to insert my soul among the loved ones. Grant me tears from the whole heart, so that the bonds of sins may be dissolved internally.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ne ad dissimulationem tui cultus prospera nobis collata succedant sed ad gratiarum actionem tibi propensius exhibendam potius nos semper accendant.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God, that what has been granted to us for Your prosperity may not lead to dissimulation of Your worship but rather always directs us towards a more eager expression of gratitude towards You.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ne multitudinem nostrae pravitatis attendas sed a peccatis abstrahe fragiles et ad ea quae recta sunt tuorum dirige voluntates.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God, that you do not notice our multitude of wickedness, but draw us away from sins and direct your will towards righteous things.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ne nos mundanis sauciari patiaris incursibus quos tuae providentiae constitutis apostolica praesidia non relinquunt.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God that you do not allow us to be wounded by worldly attacks, which the apostolic protection provided by your providence does not abandon.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ne nos tua misericordia derelinquat quae (et) terrores nostros semper amoveat et noxia cuncta depellat.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that your mercy may not abandon us, and that it may always remove our fears and drive away all harmful things.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus preces nostras propitius respice et tuae super nos viscera pietatis impende.
translation_en: We entreat you, Almighty God, look favorably upon our prayers and let your mercies descend upon us.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus preces nostras respice et tuae super nos viscera pietatis impende ut qui ex nostra culpa affligimur Salvatore nostro adveniente respiremus.
translation_en: We beseech You, almighty God, to look upon our prayers and let Your compassionate nature be extended over us. May those who are afflicted by our sin, through the coming of our Savior, breathe anew.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus preces nostras respice et tuae super nos viscera pietatis impende ut qui ex nostra culpa affligimur ex tua pietate misericorditer liberemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O Almighty God, to look upon our prayers and to bestow upon us the depths of your divine compassion, that we, who are afflicted by our own fault, may be mercifully freed through your mercy.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus tua nos proiectione custodi et castimoniam mentibus nostris atque corporibus intercedente beata Maria propitiatus indulge ut veniente sponso filio tuo unigenito accensis lampadibus eius digni praestolemur occursum.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that by your protection we may be guarded and through the intercession of the blessed Mary, propitiated, you may grant us indulgence so that worthy of him, we may present ourselves to the coming spouse, your only-begotten Son, with lit lamps.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus qui das iumentis escam ipsorum et pullis corvorum invocantibus te exaudi nos per intercessionem beati Iuliani confessoris tui et tribue nobis huius diei et noctis necessaria ut vitae aeternae gaudia adipiscamur.
translation_en: We beseech You, Almighty God, who give food to the beasts and hear the crows calling upon You; grant us on this day and night the necessary things for life that we may attain the joys of eternal life through the intercession of your confessor Saint Julian.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus sacramentis recreati vitalibus ut qui beati Mennae sollemnia celebramus ab omnibus erui mereamur peccatis.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, who have re-created us through the sacred mysteries, that as we celebrate the solemnities of Blessed Menna, we may be worthy to be freed from all sins.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut anima famuli tui illius caelestis gloriae praemia consequatur cui spiritalis gratiae munera contulisti.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that the soul of your servant may obtain the rewards of celestial glory, whom you have bestowed with the gifts of spiritual grace.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatae Columbae virginis martyrisque tuae adiuvemur meritis cuius beatitudinis irradiamur exemplis.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, to help us by the merits of your blessed servant, Saint Columba the Virgin and Martyr, whom we are enlightened by the examples of her holiness.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati illius confessoris tui nobis pia non desit oratio quae et munera nostra tibi conciliet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper obtineat.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God that the fervent prayer of your blessed confessor be not lacking for us, which may reconcile our offerings to you and always obtain your indulgence for us.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beatus Andreas apostolus tuum pro nobis imploret auxilium ut a nostris reatibus absoluti a cunctis etiam periculis exuamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God that blessed Andrew, your apostle, may intercede for us, so that we are freed from our sins and relieved of all dangers.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut caelestia sacramenta quae pro modulo nostrae reparationis praelibavimus intercedente beato Ceadda consessore tuo atque pontifice et corporibus nostris salutem praestent et mentibus.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that the heavenly sacraments, which we have preluded for our reparation with the intercession of the blessed Ceadda your consecrated bishop and saint, may grant us salvation for our bodies and minds.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut culparum nostrarum apud te veniam beati Syri impetret grata precatio.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Symeon may obtain for us forgiveness of our sins with you.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut de perceptis muneribus gratias exhibentes beneficia potiora sumamus.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that as we offer thanks for the gifts received, we may receive greater blessings.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut diabolicis non sinas subiacere terroribus quos tantis reparas mysteriis et vasa tui sanguinis infusione mundata non vana elatio erigat sed humilitatis gratia possideat.
translation_en: We entreat You, Almighty God, that You do not allow the devil to subject us to terror, which You have repaired by such great mysteries and vessels cleansed by the infusion of Your blood. May it not be a vain elation, but may grace of humility possess us.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut eius nobis sequi tribuas documenta cuius celebramus gloriosa sollemnia.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that he may grant us to follow his teachings, which we celebrate in these glorious feasts.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut et mentes nostras caelestibus corrigas institutis et beneficia tua non desinas praestare correctis.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that you correct our minds with heavenly teachings and do not cease to bestow your blessings upon those who have been corrected.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut et reatum nostrum munera sacra(ta) purificent et recte vivendi nobis operentur effectum.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, that the sacred gifts cleanse our guilt and may the effects of right living work in us.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut famulus tuus (rex noster) qui tua miseratione suscepit regni gubernacula virtutum etiam omnium percipiat incrementa quibus decenter ornatus et vitiorum monstra devitare et ad te qui via veritas et vita es gratiosus valeat pervenire.
translation_en: We beseech the Almighty God that your servant (our king), who has received the governance of your kingdom by your mercy, may also perceive the growths with which he should be fittingly adorned and may turn away from all vices, and may worthily reach you who are the way, truth, and life.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut rex noster Henricus septimus qui tua miseratione regni suscepit gubernacula virtutum omnium percipiat incrementa quibus decenter ornatus vitiorum voraginem devitare corporis incolumitate gaudere hostes superare et in tranquilla pace dum in humanis agit tam feliciter possit sua tempora transire ut post huius vitae decursum ad te qui via veritas et vita es gratiosus valeat pervenire.
translation_en: We beseech You, Almighty and merciful God, that our king Henry the Seventh, who has received the governance of Your kingdom by Your mercy, may receive the increase with which he may be fittingly adorned to avoid the pit of vices, to enjoy bodily integrity, to overcome his enemies, and to pass through his times in peaceful happiness so that after the course of this life, he may be able to reach You who are way, truth, and life, graciously.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut fideles tui venerandas assidue praecurrentes sanctorum martyrum passiones et copiam perpetuae devotionis inveniant et salutis aeternae suffragia maiora conquirant.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God that your faithful, continually running towards the venerable passions of the holy martyrs, may find a perpetual abundance of devotion and acquire greater prayers for eternal salvation.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut haec munera tuae maiestati oblata intercedente beato Matthia apostolo tuo ad perpetuam nobis faciant pervenire salutem.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, that these gifts offered to your majesty, through the intercession of blessed Matthew your apostle, may bring eternal salvation to us.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut hoc in loco quem nomini tuo indigni dicavimus cunctis petentibus aures tuae pietatis accommodes.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that this place, unworthy of your name which we have designated, may be accommodated to the ears of all who seek it by your mercy.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut hodiernae munus sollemnitatis acceptum et corporibus nostris salutem praestet et mentibus.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, that the solemnity of today's service be accepted for our bodies and grant us health, and for our minds.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut huic viro ad utilitatem ecclesiae provehendo benignus gratiae tuae tribuas largitatem.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that to this man you grant the liberality of your grace for the benefit of the church as he is advancing.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut illius fide et doctrinis instruantur cuius veneratione hostiam laudis tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: We beseech the almighty God that he may instruct them in their faith and doctrine, whom we have offered to your majesty as a host of praise through whose veneration.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut illius salutaris capiamus effectum cuius per haec mysteria pignus accepimus.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that we may experience the saving effect of whose pledge we have received through these mysteries.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut in cuius festis tuis concessisti communicare sacramentis eius facias apud te adiuvari suffragiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God that just as you have granted to communicate sacraments during your feasts, so may we be helped by your assistance through the intercession offered at your presence.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut inter eius membra numeremur cuius corpori communicamus et sanguini.
translation_en: We ask the Almighty God that we may be numbered among His members, with whom we communicate and share in His body and blood.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut interveniente beato Tiburtio martyre tuo et tua in nobis dona multiplices et misericorditer largita conserves.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God that, with the intervention of the blessed martyr Tiburtius, may He multiply His gifts upon us and generously bestow and conserve them on us in mercy.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut (munere divino) quod sumpsimus salutari nobis prosit effectu.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that (with a divine gift) what we have received may be beneficial to us in its effect.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nobis beatae illius veneranda festivitas salutis praestet incrementum cuius admiranda vita salutare praebet exemplum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that the blessed feast of her salvation may bring us increase, whose life offers an admirable and saving example.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nos geminata laetitia hodiernae festivitatis excipiat quae de beatorum Ioannis et Pauli glorificatione procedit quos eadem fides et passio vere fecit esse germanos.
translation_en: We beseech the almighty God that He receives us with double joy of today's festivity, which proceeds from the glorification of the blessed John and Paul. The same faith and passion truly made them brothers.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nostra devotio quae natalicia beati Laurentii martyris antecedit patrocinia nobis eius accumulet.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty God, that our devotion which precedes the patronage of the blessed Laurence the martyr may accumulate for us his protection.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nostrorum habitacula cordium delictis evacuata sanctitatis luce resplendeant ut intercessio beatae Christinae quam virginitas coronat et passio caelestis aulae nos societ sideribus.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God that our dwellings in hearts may be emptied of sins and may shine with the light of holiness, so that through the intercession of the blessed Christina, whose virginity is crowned and whose passion adorns the heavenly court, we may join the stars.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus intercedentibus meritis et precibus beati Ioachim avi dilecti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi tuae gratiae in praesenti et aeternae gloriae in futuro participes esse mereamur.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that through these sacred mysteries which we have received, interceding with the merits and prayers of blessed Joachim, the venerable father of your beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, may we be worthy to participate in your grace in the present and the eternal glory in the future.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per haec sacrosancta mysteria quae sumpsimus intercedente beato Honorio confessore tuo atque pontifice peccatorum omnium veniam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, that through these holy mysteries which we have received, with the intercession of Blessed Honorius, your confessor and pope, may we deserve forgiveness for all sins.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per sacrosancti Filii tui corporis et sanguinis perceptionem et sancti Aldelmi confessoris tui atque pontificis gloriosam deprecationem praesentis vitae nobis tribuas prosperitatem et futurae beatitudinis portionem.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that through the perception of your Son's holy body and blood, and the glorious supplication of Saint Aldhelm, our confessor and bishop, you grant us prosperity in this life and a share of future beatitude.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut piis sacramentis quae sumpsimus et meritis beatae Marthae Filii tui hospitae ad gaudia pertingamus aeterna.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that, with the pious sacraments which we have received and the merits of blessed Martha, Your Daughter, we may reach eternal joys.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut plebs tua toto tibi corde deserviens et beneficia tua iugiter mereatur et pacem.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, that your people may serve you with their whole heart, so that they may always deserve and obtain your blessings and peace.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui annua beatae Christinae virginis et martyris tuae sollemnia praesentibus honoramus sacrificiis eius semper et fidei integritate roboremur et piis apud te precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that we who honor the annual feast of the blessed Christian virgin and martyr on this day, may always be strengthened by her sacrifices and fortified in our faith. May we also be helped by our pious prayers before you.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui beati illius apostoli tui natalicia devotis ieiuniis et orationibus praevenimus et annua sollemnitate laetemur et tantae fidei proficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: We ask You, almighty God, that as we prepare for the feast day of Your blessed apostle with devoted fasting and prayers, we may rejoice annually and advance in faith by his exemplary example.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui caelestia alimenta percepimus per haec contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received heavenly food may be fortified against all adversities through these things.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui nostris fatigamur offensis sacris mysteriis expiemur et qui merito nostrae iniquitatis affligimur apostolicis satisfactionibus protegamur.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty God, that we who are wearied by our offenses against the sacred mysteries may be purified, and that we who justly suffer the consequences of our iniquity may be protected by the apostolic satisfactions.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui nostris fatigamur offensis et merito nostrae iniquitatis affligimur pietatis tuae gratiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God that we, who are wearied by our offenses and rightfully afflicted by our own iniquity, may deserve your grace.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quod de mensa caelesti percepimus intercedente beata Etheldreda virgine tua nostros semper ad te trahat affectus.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God that what we have received from the celestial table through the intercession of Blessed Etheldreda, Your Virgin, may always draw our affections towards You.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quorum nos tribuis communicare memoriis eorum facias imitatores.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that you who grant us to communicate with the memories of them, make us imitators of them.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quos caelesti pane satiasti precibus et meritis beatae Barbarae virginis ac martyris tuae ab hoste maligno defendas.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God that those whom You have satisfied with heavenly bread through the prayers and merits of the blessed Virgin and Martyr Barbarae, protect them from the malicious enemy.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut quos salutaribus dignatus es erudire mysteriis beatae Elisabeth intercessione gloriosa caelestibus reficiat (reficias) alimentis.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that you who have deigned to instruct us in the mysteries of blessed Elizabeth, may refresh (refresh) us with celestial food through her glorious intercession.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacramenta sancta quae sumpsimus beatorum martyrum tuorum Albani Paulini et Nicetii episcopi cum nongentis octoginta novem deprecationibus ad tuae nobis proficiant placationis augmentum.
translation_en: We ask the omnipotent God that the holy sacraments which we have received from your blessed martyrs Alban, Paulinus, and Nicetius, bishop, with nine hundred and eighty-seven supplications, may profit us in an increase of reconciliation.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sancti nos Iacobi laetificet ac Philippi festiva sollemnitas et quorum suffragiis nitimur nataliciis gloriemur.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God that the feast of Saint James and Saint Philip may rejoice us, and through their intercession we may boast in our natal glory.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum tuorum caelestibus mysteriis celebrata sollemnitas indulgentiam nobis tuae propitiationis acquirat.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, that the solemnity celebrated in honor of your saints' heavenly mysteries may obtain for us the indulgence of your propitiation.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut super haec munera quae in honorem beatissimi Laurentii confessoris tui atque pontificis quem copiosum fecisti miraculis tibi sacranda deferimus benedictio copiosa descendat.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, that your abundant blessing may descend upon these gifts which we offer to the blessed Laurence, your confessor and pope whom you have made renowned for miracles.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut suscipere digneris sacrificium pro famulis et famulabus tuis qui nobis confessi sunt sua peccata ut mereantur indulgentiam habere sempiternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that you may deem worthy to receive the sacrifice on behalf of your servants and handmaids who have confessed their sins to us, so that they may deserve to have eternal indulgence.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut tanto placabiles nostrae sint hostiae quanto sancti martyris Georgii pro cuius sollemnitate exhibentur tibi grata sunt merita.
translation_en: We entreat the almighty God that our offerings may be as pleasing to You as the holy martyr George, whose feast day is celebrated for whom Your merits are acceptable.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus vota humilium respice atque ad defensionem nostram dexteram tuae maiestatis extende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to regard the vows of the humble and extend the right hand of your majesty for our defense.

text: Quaesumus Domine omnipotens Deus ut vota nostra tibi immolata clementer respicias atque ad defensionem nostram dexteram tuae maiestatis extendas.
translation_en: We entreat you, O almighty Lord God, that you graciously consider our offerings and extend the hand of your majesty for our defense.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens Deus vota humilium respice atque ad defensionem nostram dexteram tuae maiestatis extende et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum tam vivorum quam et solutorum debito mortis quorum confessiones vel eleemosynas ad erogandum suscepimus et quorum nomina ad memorandum conscripsimus vel quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum adscripta esse videntur remissionem cunctorum tribue peccatorum ut indulgentiam quam semper optaverunt piis supplicationibus consequantur.
translation_en: We entreat You, Almighty God, to look upon the prayers of the humble and extend Your right hand to our defense. May Your majesty grant forgiveness for the souls of Your servants, both living and departed, whose confessions or alms we have accepted and recorded, or whose names appear written near Your holy altar. May they receive remission of all sins so that they may obtain the indulgence which they always longed for through their pious petitions.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut qui nos sacramentorum tuorum participes efficis et ministros intercedente beato Terrenano confessore tuo atque pontifice supplicationes nostras placatus intendas.
translation_en: We beseech You, Almighty and merciful God, that You who make us participants in Your sacraments, also make us ministers, interceding through the blessed Teresa of Avila, Your confessor and bishop; may You graciously direct our supplications.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut quos in sanctorum tuorum veneranda memoria de tuis sacris donis satiasti per haec indulgentiam nos tuae propitiationis consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, that we who have been filled by your sacred gifts through this indulgence may deserve to attain the merit of your propitiation through your grace.

text: Quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut qui sollemnia colimus beati Narcissi martyris tui atque pontificis eius meritis et precibus gloriosis consortes efficiamur aeternae beatitudinis.
translation_en: We ask you, almighty and merciful God, that we who celebrate the feast of your martyr and bishop, blessed Narcissus, may be made worthy through his merits and glorious prayers to share in eternal beatitude.

text: Quaesumus unigenite Dei Filius ut quos redemisti sanguine sacro pacis et caritatis munifices dono sicque omnes qui te veraciter resurrexisse fatemur resurgere post mortem non ad poenam sed ad gloriam mereamur.
translation_en: We beseech You, only-begotten Son of God, that those whom You have redeemed with sacred blood may be worthy to receive the gracious gift of peace and charity, and that all who truly confess Your resurrection after death may merit to rise again not for punishment but for glory.

text: Quaesumus virtutum caelestium Deus ut despectis falsitatibus iniquorum conscientiae famaeque nostrae profutura sectemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask God of celestial virtues to guide us, overlooking the falsehoods of the wicked, that we may follow a profitable path as concerned with our conscience and reputation.

text: Quaesumus virtutum caelestium Deus ut sacrificia pro sanctae Caeciliae sollemnitate delata desideriorum nos temporalium doceant habere contemptum et ambire dona faciant caelestium gaudiorum.
translation_en: We ask God of celestial virtues that the offerings brought for the feast of Saint Cecilia teach us to have contempt for temporal desires and make us aspire for the joys of heaven.

text: Quam magna est misericordia tua Domine; subvenire captivis miseris parcere indulgere peccantibus peregrinos consolari oppressos sublevare rogantes audire non habentibus dare veniam peccantibus dare gentes barbaras ad invocationem nominis tui convertere. Ad illam misericordiam converte nos; quam rogantes nos pius et misericors Deus exaudire digneris per interventum sanctae Mariae.
translation_en: How great is Thy mercy, O Lord; to come to the aid of captives, to show mercy to the wretched, to forgive sinners, to comfort the oppressed, to lift up those who plead, to hear those who have no voice, to give pardon to sinners, to give foreigners as a gift of invocation to Thy name, to turn them. To that mercy, turn us; whom Thou, good and merciful God, deem worthy to hear our prayer through the intervention of holy Mary.

text: Quanta sit dilectio tuae caritatis Deus in sanctis in hac virgine evidentibus probamus indiciis; quae amplexibus tuis castis adstricta etiam generosi hominis exsecravit personam cum oblata sibi ab eo pro nectendo coniungio repulit ornamenta. Da igitur nobis sola tui nominis dilectione perfrui ut tantum in tua pace laetantes tua in nobis semper dilectio vivat tuaque semper caritas requiescat.
translation_en: The extent of Your love, O God, for Your charity in this holy virgin is clearly shown by the evident signs we prove; she, bound to You by chaste embraces and even repulsing the worthy man with the gift he offered for breaking the union, rejected his ornaments. Therefore, grant us to be filled with only the love of Your name so that we may rejoice greatly in Your peace, and may Your love always live in us, and Your charity always rest in us.

text: Quanto te Domine praedicare sufficimus qui pariter immeritis tribuis de maerore laetitiam.
translation_en: How can we, Lord, declare your praises who equally bestow joy upon the undeserving from sorrow.

text: Quem sacro Domine satiasti libamine interveniente quoque sancta ac venerabili Dei Genitrice Maria me a cunctis peccatorum meorum nexibus propitiatus absolve.
translation_en: Lord, who have filled with holy joy, coming also with the sacred and venerable Mother of God Mary, propitiate me from all the bonds of my sins and absolve me.

text: Quia nostrae voces Domine non merentur audiri sanctorum tuorum interventio quaesumus sit accepta pro nobis.
translation_en: Since our voices, Lord, do not deserve to be heard, we humbly ask that your intervention may be accepted on our behalf through the prayers of your saints.

text: Quid dignum tuae clementiae Domine Deus pro tam gloriosissimi martyris tui Genesii offerri ab infimis celebranda poterit dignitate nisi ipse castrorum tuorum victoriosissimus miles tam triumphi sui non immemor merito quam supplicantium constrictus obsequio quas placere tibi optime comprobavit ingerat laudes? Qui specialis gratiae tuae largitate praeventus prius te meruit invenire quam quaerere; prius potuit diabolum vincere quam bellandi arte calcare; prius pro te animam ponere quam ipsius fidei rudimenta subire. In quo anticipatum est perfectione quod fuerat currendum per ordinem. Cui prius moriendi pro te insinuasti desiderium quam revelasses baptismi sacramentum. Quem prius voluisti litare sanguinis sui victimam quam sacerdotis auscultare doctrinam.  Unde quis nostrum comprehendere pusillus sensu praevaleat quanta illi apud te maneat gloria cui tanta in hoc saeculo fidelium tuorum deserviat obsequela? Quique timorem mortis spiritus tui vehementia supergressus ita huic mundo eiusque illecebris renuntiaverat pompis ut principum quorum temporaliter cruentis subiacebat imperiis liberrime dedignatus sit superfluis parere praeceptis. Merito igitur dum baptismi inter medios lictores expeteret gratiam consummatam obtinuit sui sanguinis sanctificatus ablutione coronam. Sed nec defuit martyrio quod inerat voto. Idcirco dum suos ad te confugiendo fugeret percussores Rhodani medias inter undas sanctos angelos reperit te baptizante parentes quos post triumphum certaminis aeternae meruit claritatis invenire consortes. Pro quibus donis ac beneficiis tuis et laudum tibi vota persolvimus et nostrorum scelerum abdita publicamus poscentes tuae pietatis clementiam ut qui eum baptismo sui sanguinis ablutum assumpsisti in caelis nos lacrimarum ablutione eluas a delictis.
translation_en:
What is worthy to offer to your mercy, Lord God, for such a glorious martyr of yours, Genesius, by the lowly ones can be celebrated with dignity except himself, the victor in your camps, the most triumphant soldier, offering praise for his triumph as much as he is constrained by duty for those who please you best has proven. He, who was specially favored by your grace, deserved to find you before seeking; he could vanquish the devil before engaging in battle art; he could offer his soul for you before submitting to the rudiments of faith. In him, what was supposed to be attained through progression was anticipated. Before dying for you, he developed a desire to die for you which was revealed to him before you showed him the sacrament of baptism. He wanted to be the victim of his own blood's liturgy before listening to the doctrine of the priest.
Who can comprehend with a little understanding how great is the glory that awaits him with you, for whom such faithful obedience serves in this world? Who, overcome by the fear of your spirit's vehemence, was so free from this world's pomp and its allurements that he was contemptuous of being subject to the empires of princes, who for a time ruled over cruel dominions? Rightly, then, when seeking the grace among the lictors of baptism, he obtained a completed grace by being sanctified with his own blood's ablution and received a crown.
However, there was not lacking in martyrdom that was promised in vow. Therefore, when fleeing from his persecutors in Rhodes, he found among the waves holy angels whom he baptized as parents. After the triumph of eternal contest, he deserved to find them as companions. For these gifts and benefits, we fulfill our vows of praise to you and confess our sins publicly, seeking your pity's clemency so that you who accepted him washed in his own blood's baptism, may wash us with the baptism of tears in heaven.

text: Quique ad remedium sacri libaminis accedimus quo humanae salutis adversaria superemus incentiva et in hac tanti sacramenti perceptione sumamus nobis fidei donum spei praesidium animae lucrum gratiae firmamentum ut voluntates nostrae per omnia non te donante cogitatio iniqua subripiat ne eius perfectio nocitura possideat.
translation_en: Whoever approaches the remedy of the sacred libanum to overcome the adversaries of human salvation, receives in this important sacrament the gift of faith as a protection for hope, a reward for the soul, a foundation for grace, so that our wills, through all things, may not be diverted by an unjust thought to steal from you, nor can its perfection be possessed by an unlawful act.

text: Quod de altari tuo sumpsimus Domine semper nobis proficiat et supplicante sancto apostolo Barnaba ante thronum gloriae tuae gaudere faciat.
translation_en: May what we have received from your altar, Lord, always benefit us, and may the suppliant holy Apostle Barnabas rejoice before your throne of glory.

text: Quod de mensa tua Domine sumpsimus beato exorante Bertino ad aeternam nos enutriat laetitiam et tuam ubique invenire faciat gratiam.
translation_en: May the blessed Bertino, for whom we took what was on your table, Lord, sustain us eternally with joy, and may he help us to find grace everywhere.

text: Quod ore sumpsimus Domine mente capiamus et de munere temporali fiat nobis remedium sempiternum.
translation_en: What we have received, Lord, may we comprehend with our mind, and let the temporal gift become for us an eternal remedy.

text: Quod ore sumpsimus Domine mente capiamus et de corpore et sanguine Domini nostri Iesu Christi fiat nobis remedium sempiternum.
translation_en: What we have received, O Lord, may we hold in mind and through the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, let it become an eternal remedy for us.

text: Quod poscit divinus honor quod funus amantium obsequio reddente Deo sollemne tributum suppliciter dominum per vota gemella precemur ut quos culpa praemit pietas miserata relaxet atque interventu sacri libaminis huius vita superstitibus detur indulgentia functis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech our Lord through the twin prayer of vows, that since divine honor demands it, the solemn tribute owed to God by the obedience of the funeral rites of the lovers be rendered. May His mercy, moved by their guilt, relax the penalty and through the intervention of this holy offering, may indulgence be given to the survivors during their remaining life.

text: Quos beati regis Edwardi translatio sancta laetificat tua nos Domine gratia reddat laetiores et tribuat in hoc sacrificio praesentiae tuae dulcedinem toto corde sentire.
translation_en: The translation of the blessed King Edward delights us, O Lord. May your grace make us happier and grant us to feel the sweetness of your presence in this sacrifice with all our heart.

text: Quos caelesti cibo Domine satiasti diabolicis non sinas insidiis lacerari sed intercedente beata Emerentiana virgine tua in regione viventium semper tribuas gratulari.
translation_en: Lord, whom you have satisfied with celestial food, do not allow them to be torn by diabolic traps. Rather, through your blessed virgin Emerentiana, may they always rejoice in the region of the living.

text: Quos caelesti Domine alimento satiasti apostolicis intercessionibus ab omni adversitate custodi.
translation_en: Lord of heaven, whom you have satisfied with celestial food through apostolic intercessions, protect them from every adversity.

text: Quos caelesti Domine cibo et poculo recreasti intercedente beato confessore tuo Bricio fac in regno tuo tecum in aeternum gaudere.
translation_en: Lord God of heaven, who by celestial food and drink have refreshed [them] through your blessed confesor Brico, make them to rejoice with you forever in your kingdom.

text: Quos caelesti Domine dono satiasti praesta quaesumus ut a nostris mundemur occultis et ab hostium liberemur insidiis.
translation_en: Lord, who have fed with heavenly food, grant us we pray, that we may be cleansed from our hidden sins and freed from the cunning traps of our enemies.

text: Quos caelesti Domine dono satiasti praesta quaesumus ut a nostris mundemur occultis et ab hostium liberemur insidiis et famulo tuo illi cum omnibus suis fluctuantibus in adversis praebe suffragium ne plebs christiana per infidelium discrimen ullum possit habere dispendium sed te opitulante de tuo mereatur gratulari solatio. ( recensio longa ) Quos caelesti Domine dono satiasti praesta quaesumus ut a nostris mundemur occultis et ab hostium liberemur insidiis ut te opitulante de tuo mereamur solatio gratulari. ( recensio brevis )
translation_en:
Lord God of heaven, who has satisfied those whom you have given, we humbly ask that you cleanse us from our hidden sins and deliver us from the deceitful traps of our enemies. And to your servant and all his followers who are tossed about in adversity, grant them your support so that the Christian people may not suffer any harm through the division of unbelievers, but rather, with your aid, they may rejoice in your consolation. (long version)
Lord God of heaven, who has satisfied those whom you have given, we humbly ask that you cleanse us from our hidden sins and deliver us from the deceitful traps of our enemies, so that with your aid, we may rejoice in your consolation. (short version)

text: Quos caelesti Domine dono satiasti praesta quaesumus ut sicut piissima misericordia tua dedisti nobis voluntatem veniendi ad te ita nobis servis tuis donare digneris sapientiam et intellectum virtutem et possibilitatem ut tibi secundum voluntatem tuam servire mereamur.
translation_en: Grant, heavenly Lord, those whom you have fed with celestial food, we beseech You. May it be as Your most compassionate mercy has given us the will to come to You, so may You deign to give us wisdom and understanding, virtue and ability, that we may deserve to serve You according to Your will.

text: Quos caelesti Domine refectione satiasti beatae quaesumus Scholasticae virginis tuae meritis a cunctis exime propitiatus adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord of heaven, that by the grace of your divine refreshment you have satisfied Blessed Scholastica, we beseech you to free her from all adversities through your merits.

text: Quos caelesti Domine substantia recreasti beati quaesumus Valentini martyris tui meritis a cunctis exime propitiatus a versis.
translation_en: Lord, who has restored the celestial substance of your blessed martyr Valentine, we humbly ask that by his merits you remove him from all adversities and turn away those who are turned against him.

text: Quos caelesti recreas munere perpetuo Domine comitare praesidio et quos fovere non desinis dignos fieri sempiterna redemptione concede.
translation_en: Lord, may those whom you eternally renew with a celestial gift be accompanied by a perpetual guard and may those whom you nurture never cease to be worthy of becoming part of the eternal redemption.

text: Quos caelestibus Domine recreas alimentis interveniente beato Benedicto confessore tuo ab universis tuere periculis.
translation_en: Lord, whom you sustain with celestial food, protect these (people) through the intercession of your blessed confessioner Benedict from all dangers.

text: Quos divino Domine reficis mysterio perpetuo defende praesidio et quos imbuisti caelestibus institutis salubribus comitare solatiis.
translation_en: Which You, Lord, restore through the divine mystery, protect with perpetual defense and those whom You have imbued with celestial wholesome institutions, lead with salvation's comforts.

text: Quos donis caelestibus satiasti Domine defende praesidiis ut noxiis omnibus expediti post salutaria tua toto corde curramus.
translation_en: Lord, who have filled with celestial gifts, defend us by your guardianship, that we may run swiftly away from all dangers after your salutary ones, with all our heart.

text: Quos ieiunia votiva castigant tua Domine sacramenta vivificent ut terrenis affectibus mitigatis facilius caelestia capiamus.
translation_en: Your votive fasts chasten us, Lord, but your sacraments quicken us, so that we may be more easily able to grasp heavenly things with earthly affections mitigated.

text: Quos munere Domine caelesti reficis divino tuere praesidio ut tuis mysteriis perfruentes nullis subdamur adversis.
translation_en: With this heavenly gift, Lord, you refresh us; guard and protect us with your divine preservation, so that we, partaking in your mysteries, may not be overcome by any adversities.

text: Quos munere caelesti reficis Domine divino tuere praesidio ut tuis mysteriis perfruentes nullis subdamur adversis et a cunctis iniquitatibus nostris exue nos omnipotens Deus et in tua nos fac pace gaudere.
translation_en: By the celestial gift you restore, Lord, keep us under your divine protection, so that we who partake in your mysteries may not be subjected to any adversities and cleanse us from all our iniquities, Almighty God. May you make us enjoy peace.

text: Quos pii confessoris tui Benedicti voluisti Domine magisteriis erudire eius meritis dignare ab omni insidiatoris fraude defendere.
translation_en: Lord, you have wished through your pious confessor Benedict to educate [them] with the teachings of masters. Through his merits, grant that they may be defended from all the cunning of deceivers.

text: Quos praesenti mysterio Domine tuae mensae tribuisti esse participes intercedente beato confessore tuo Leonardo angelorum conviviis fac interesse gaudentes.
translation_en: Lord, through this present mystery you have granted that they are participants at your table. Through the intercession of your blessed confessor Leonard, may they share in the feasts of angels, rejoicing together.

text: Quos refecisti Domine caelesti convivio beatae Fidis virginis et martyris iuvante patrocinio supernorum civium fac dignos collegio.
translation_en: You have restored, Lord, with a heavenly feast, the blessed Fides Virgin and Martyr, assisted by the patronage of the heavenly citizens. Make them worthy for the college.

text: Quos refecisti Domine caelesti mysterio propriis alienisque propitiatus absolve delictis ut divino munere purificatis mentibus perfruamur.
translation_en: Which you have renewed, Lord, in the heavenly mystery, propitiated by your own and others' acts, grant forgiveness for sins, so that, purified by divine gift, we may enjoy with a clear mind.

text: Quos refecisti Domine caelesti mysterio ab omnibus quaesumus propitiatus absolve delictis ut intercedente beato Meloro martyre tuo divino munere purificatis mentibus perfruamur.
translation_en: Lord, who hast restored through celestial mystery all whom we ask, we beseech Thee, propitiated, forgive their sins. That with the intercession of blessed Meloro Thy martyr, may Thy divine grace purify their minds, we may partake.

text: Quos refecisti Domine caelesti mysterio intercedentibus sanctis tuis et propriis et alienis quaesumus propitiatus absolve delictis ut divino munere purificatis mentibus perfruentes et semper rationabilia meditantes quae tibi sunt placita et dictis exsequamur et factis.
translation_en: Lord, who have restored through the heavenly mystery with the intercession of your saints, both our own and those of others, we humbly ask that you, being appeased, forgive our offenses. So purified by divine grace, may we understand rational things pleasing to you as we fulfill what you desire in words and deeds.

text: Quos supernis Domine refecisti alimentis hos sempiternis quaesumus reple incrementis et interventu sancti Pantaleonis sidereis adiunge collegiis.
translation_en: Lord, who has restored these with eternal food we humbly ask to fill them with increments and by the intervention of Saint Pantaleon, add them to the celestial companies.

text: Quos tantis Domine largiris uti mysteriis quaesumus ut effectibus nos eorum veraciter aptare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, who are so generous in bestowing these mysteries upon us, we humbly ask that you deem us worthy to be fitted truly by their effects.

text: Quos tantis Domine refovisti muneribus diabolicis non sinas lacerari incursionibus sed beata intercedente Sexburga virgine nos purgatos ab omni criminum sorde regionem viventium quaesumus facias possidere.
translation_en: Lord, whom You have refreshed with such great gifts, do not allow them to be torn apart by diabolic incursions. With the blessed Virgin Sexburga interceding for us, we ask that You make us possess a region cleansed of all stain of crime, living ones.

text: Quos tuos efficis Domine tua pietate circumtege et fragilibus sanctorum omnium praetende subsidia ut ad promissiones tuas te inspirante currant te gubernante perveniant.
translation_en: Lord, encompass those whom you make with your mercy and extend aid to the frail saints of all, that they may run towards your promises inspired by you and governed by you, and may arrive.

text: Recensentes annuae dedicationis occursum pietatem tuam Domine supplices exoramus ut cuius meritis hanc tui nominis domum sacrare iussisti eius precibus apud te nos adiuvare digneris.
translation_en: Having considered the annual occasion of dedication, we humbly beseech Your mercy, Lord, that just as You commanded to consecrate this house bearing Your name, so too may You deem fit to assist us through its prayers before You.

text: Recensitis Domine tuorum nominibus famulorum pietatis tuae imploramus misericordiae donum ut precum nostrarum portitorem tuum nuntium destines Michaelem ut petenda nos congrua doceat et petitionibus nostris ipse tibi intercessor assistat ut vivis impetrando tutelam et defunctis acquirat requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: We have considered, Lord, the names of your servants, the devoted ones. We humbly request the gift of your mercy that you may appoint your messenger Michael to teach us suitable prayers and himself be our intercessor before you, so that we may live by obtaining protection and that he may acquire eternal rest for the departed.

text: Recensitis nominibus fratrum carorumque nostrorum oremus dominicam misericordiam ut in medio Ierusalem in congregatione sanctorum haec nomina sibi faciat ab angelo sanctificationis in beatitudine aeterni gaudii recensiri sacrificiumque hoc nostrum sicut in praeformatione Melchisedech in virtute sanctificet preces quoque offerentium in hanc oblationem propitiatus exaudiat in commemorationem beatissimorum martyrum Ferreoli et Ferrucionis omniumque sanctorum ut eorum precibus adiuti non solum viventibus praesidia verum etiam defunctis caris nostris requiem obtinere mereantur.
translation_en: Having reviewed the names of our brethren, let us pray to the Lord for His mercifulness that in the midst of Jerusalem, among the congregation of saints, may this name be recorded by the angel of sanctification in the beatitude of eternal joy. May this offering of ours be sanctified as in the prefigurement of Melchisedek, through holiness may it also consecrate the prayers of those who offer in this oblation. May He who has been propitiated hear these prayers, in remembrance of the blessed martyrs Ferreolus and Ferrucius, as well as all the saints, so that with their prayers we are not only aided while living but also our dear departed may obtain peace.

text: Recensitis nominibus offerentium Dominum nostrum omnipotentem atque largum dispensatorem supplices adoremus ut in fide nihil dubitantibus propitiatus accommodet aurem; tribuat infirmis sanitatem paenitentibus remedium errantes corrigat tempora quieta concedat amoveat bella morbos avertat auram temperet concedat incrementa frugum concordiam sacerdotum tribuat pacem regibus largiatur clero sanctimoniam plebi modestiam catechumenis lavacrum paenitentibus indulgentiae fructum et defunctis refrigerium praestet per intercessionem sanctorum.
translation_en: Having reviewed the names of those offering our Lord, the almighty and bountiful Dispenser, we humbly adore Him that He may propitiate those doubtful in faith; grant health to the infirm, remedy to penitent sinners, correct errant times, grant peace, quiet things, remove wars, drive away diseases, turn away evil influences, grant increase of crops, bestow harmony among priests, give peace to kings, lavish sanctity upon the clergy, modesty on the people, baptism and forgiveness to catechumens, fruits of penance to repentant sinners, refreshment to the departed through the intercession of the saints.

text: Recensitis nominibus offerentium in beatae Mariae sollemnitate clementiam Dei deprecemur ut per istius merita peccatorum nostrorum veniam defunctis refrigerium concedere dignetur.
translation_en: In the solemnity of blessed Mary, we ask the clemency of God to grant through her merits forgiveness for our sins to the departed souls and grant them refreshment.

text: Recensitis nominibus offerentium omnipotenti domino supplicemus ut hostiam spiritalem et pura libamina cum offerentium votis pia miseratione suscipiat.
translation_en: Having examined the names of those offering, we humbly ask the all-powerful Lord that He accept a spiritual sacrifice and pure offerings along with the devout wishes of the givers, with merciful compassion.

text: Recensitis offerentium nominibus accincti abstinentiae cibis et devoto pasti ieiunio petamus a domino Salvatore nostro uti haec adoranda sacrificia quae pro spiritibus pausantium et nostris nostrorumque peccatis cura pietatis offerimus sicut munus Abel iusti sui <acceptum habere dignatus est ita gratiae suae rore> benedicat et in nobis sanctificata custodiat.
translation_en: Having reviewed the names of those who present offerings, clothed with abstinence from food and a devoted fast, we beseech our Lord Savior to accept these sacred offerings which we present on behalf of the souls at rest and our own and their sins, as Abel's righteous offering was graciously accepted. May He bless them with the dew of His grace and sanctify us in whom they are offered.

text: Recensitis offerentium nominibus Deum indulgentiae deprecemur ut respiciat populum suum conculcatum et dolentem et protegat eos ne ab impiis contaminemur et misereatur in omni afflictione eorum ac caros nostros vinculis corporalibus liberatos in pace sanctorum recipiat ut locum poenalem et gehennae ignem flammamque tartari in regione viventium evadant.
translation_en: Having reviewed the names of the offerers, we humbly ask God for indulgence that He may look upon His suffering and sorrowful people and protect them from being contaminated by the wicked. We also pray for mercy in all their afflictions and for our dear ones freed from physical bonds to find peace among the saints. May they escape the penal place, the fire of Gehenna, and the flame of Tartarus in the region of the living.

text: Recensitis offerentium nominibus divinam misericordiam exoremus ut offerentes sibi placitos esse faciat et quae offerunt in odorem incensi bene flagrantis assumat; defunctis pro quibus haec offeruntur aeternam beatitudinem viventibus gratiam suae pietatis concedat et quia gratis non merentibus quae sunt opportuna praestare non desinit et illis pro quibus oblatio non offertur remuneratio beatitudinis non negetur.
translation_en: Having examined the names of the offerers, we humbly entreat divine mercy to make those who offer pleasing to Thee, and that what they offer may be acceptable as a fragrant incense; for the deceased for whom these are offered, grant them eternal beatitude in life, and since You do not cease to bestow upon us what is suitable, though we are undeserving, may they not be denied the reward of beatitude for whom the offering is not made.

text: Recitata nomina Dominus benedicat et accepta sit domino uti huius oblatio nostrisque precibus intercessio suffragetur; spiritus quoque carorum nostrorum laetis sedibus conquiescant et primi resurrectionis gaudia consequantur.
translation_en: May the Lord bless and accept the names that have been read, so that He may intercede for this offering and our prayers. May also the spirits of our souls rest in joyful seats and attain the joys of the first resurrection.

text: Recitatis Domine unigeniti tui sacramentorum praeceptis simulque praeclarae passionis et resurrectionis et in caelos adscensionis memoriam facientes maiestatem tuam supplices rogamus ac petimus ut in his sacrificiis benedictionum tuarum plenitudo descendat et infundas in eis imbrem spiritus tui sancti de caelis ut fiat hoc sacrificium secundum ordinem patriarcharum et prophetarum tuorum ut quod ab illis typice facientibus unigeniti tui significantibus adventum tua maiestas acceptare dignata est sic hoc sacrificium respicere et sanctificare digneris quod est verum corpus et sanguis Domini nostri Iesu Christi Filii tui qui pro nobis omnibus factus est sacerdos et hostia. Hanc itaque hostiam tu piissime pater de tuae claritatis respectu sanctifica ut sumentibus eam et hic delictorum veniam et aeternam in caelis conferas vitam.
translation_en: We, your only-begotten one, recite the precepts of your sacraments and remember also the glorious events of your passion, resurrection, and ascension into heaven. With reverence we beseech and ask that in these sacrifices the fullness of your blessings descends and pours forth on them the river of your holy spirit from heaven. May this sacrifice be according to the order of your patriarchs and prophets, so that what they typified by your only-begotten one signifying your coming, may your majesty deign to accept. Thus, let this sacrifice look upon and sanctify it, for it is truly the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who was made priest and offering for us all. Therefore, most merciful Father, sanctify this offering from the radiance of your gaze. May those receiving it here find forgiveness of sins, and may you grant them eternal life in heaven.

text: Recitatis nominibus offerentium fratres carissimi omnipotentis Dei misericordiam deprecemur ut plebi quae in honorem beati Symphoriani martyris vota reddit altaribus divinae credulitatis infundatur affectus ut eius administratione firmentur qui martyris meritis non iunguntur ac sicut ille post carceris saepta post poenarum ligamina postque famis inediam aeternitatis gaudio infinito perfruitur ita defunctorum animae laxatis inferni pressuris Abrahae patris gremio collocentur.
translation_en: We pray the brothers, dearest to us, to implore the mercy of Almighty God for the people who offer vows in honor of blessed Symphorian the martyr. May the affection of divine faith be poured into them as they approach his altars, so that those who are not united with the merits of the martyr may be strengthened by his administration. Just as he after the chains of prison, after the yoke of punishments, and after hunger's famine reached infinite eternal joy, may the souls of the departed find a place in the embrace of Abraham the father, released from the pressures of hell.

text: Recolentes Christe Deus gloriosae passionis tuae mysterium in quo debellatas aereas potestates triumphare nos crucis tuae vexillo de eorum nequitiis facis quia dum tu caput nostrum sublimaris in cruce obstrusus quondam nobis reseratur aditus vitae. Humanitas quippe tua ex terris assumpta coaeterna facta est patri et spiritui sancto in saecula. Ad te nos cum gemitu proclamamus tibi et vota promimus et maestitias propalamus. Tu enim nosti quae desideramus a quo ex nihilo plasmati manemus; nostro nos merito incusamus qui ad te oculos erigere non audemus. Ideo supplices flagitamus ut precum nostrarum portitorem Michaelem archangelum habere mereamur quo te favente pacem fideles obtineant semper.  Per hunc temporum quietem et vitae meliorationem. Per hunc catholicae ecclesiae firmitatem et increduli fidei sanctae percipiant credulitatem. Per hunc pontificalis ordo aucto culmine polleat et sublimatus apice gloriae virtutem meritis antecedat. Per hunc clerus foveat sanctitatem. Per hunc monachi firmissimam obtineant religiositatem. Per hunc principum moderata in populis iustaque decreta consistant. Per hunc plebium fidelitas catholicae fidei munimine coalescat. Per hunc coniugati continentiam virgines studeant obtinere perseverantiam. Per hunc turgida mens se colliget freno humilitatis. Per hunc acquirant solamen spei criminibus nimiis desperati. Per hunc ad paenitentiam lapsi ad veniam rei ad misericordiam saevi ad patientiam veniant iracundi. Per hunc vincti absolutionem captivi liberationem viduae habeant defensionem pupilli tuitionem. Per hunc tumentes marinorum fluctus blandum navigantibus praebeant cursum. Per hunc naufragi optatum tranquillumque inveniant portum. Per hunc exsul ad solium valeat remeare suum. Per hunc discordes pacem concordes possideant perseverantiam caritatis. Per hunc infirmi medelam defuncti requiem obtineant aeternam. Et ita per hunc tua pietas beneficia nobis concedat quaesita ut repulsa omnium adversitatum illecebra caelesti nos faciat exsultare in patria.
translation_en:
Recollecting, Christ God, the mystery of your glorious passion in which you defeated the aerial powers and enabled us to triumph under your cross's banner from their wickedness. Since you lifted our heads up to the cross, the way to life that was once closed for us is opened again. Indeed, your humanity, assumed from earth, was made coeternal with the Father and the Holy Spirit in eternity. To you we cry out with groaning, we make vows, and we proclaim our sorrows. For you know what it is that we desire from whom we have been shaped from nothing; for our guilt we accuse ourselves who dare not lift our eyes to you. Therefore, as suppliants, we implore that we may deserve to have Michael the archangel as a bearer of our prayers so that faithful people may always obtain peace by your favor.
For this calmness and improvement in life. For this the Catholic Church may have firmness and unbelievers may receive faith. For this the order of bishops may rise to a high peak and surpass virtue through merits. For this, the clergy may cultivate holiness. For this, monks may maintain the most steadfast religious life. For this, princes may rule justly among their people. For this, the faithful people's devotion to the Catholic faith may be united. For this, married couples may strive to obtain perseverance in chastity. For this, the restless mind may restrain itself with the reins of humility. For this, those who despair of their sins may find consolation. For this, those who have fallen may come to penitence and mercy, the fierce to patience. For this, captives may obtain absolution and liberty, widows defense and protection for orphans. For this, turbulent seas may offer a smooth course to sailors. For this, shipwrecked ones may find a calm and peaceful haven. For this, an exile may return safely to his own throne. For this, discordant people may possess peace and the perseverance of charity. For this, the sick may obtain medicine and the dead eternal rest. And so, through you, your pity may grant us the benefits we seek that we may be driven away from all adversity and made to exult in heaven.

text: Recolentes igitur et servantes praecepta unigeniti <tui> deprecamur Pater omnipotens ut his creaturis altario tuo superpositis spiritum sanctificationis infundas ut per transfusionem caelestis atque invisibilis sacramenti panis hic mutatus in.carnem et calix translatus in sanguinem sit toti{u}s gratia sit sumentibus medicina.
translation_en: Remembering and serving the precepts of your only-begotten, we humbly pray, O almighty Father, that you pour out the Holy Spirit upon these creatures placed on your altar, so that by celestial and invisible transubstantiation, this bread may be changed into flesh and this chalice into blood. May it be a source of grace and healing for those who partake.

text: Recolimus te Domine passum pro mundi salute humilem sed credimus subsistere semper in genitore potentem. Precamur ut qui de altario tuo participamus cum beatis apostolis in caelestibus gloriemur.
translation_en: We remember you, Lord, your humble Passion for the salvation of the world, yet we believe that you always remain powerful in your generator. We pray that we who participate from your altar may one day be glorified with the blessed apostles in the heavens.

text: Recreati Domine sacramentorum participatione quaesumus clementiam tuam ut interveniente beato angelo tuo Raphaele cuius commemorationem celebramus et a cunctis incommodis expiemur in corpore et sanctorum coetibus connumeremur.
translation_en: We are refreshed, Lord, by participation in your sacraments. We humbly ask for your clemency, that with the intervention of the blessed angel Raphael, whom we commemorate, we may be purged from all troubles in body and numbered among the company of saints.

text: Recreati sacri muneris gustu quaesumus Domine; non indigne sumentibus nobis vertatur ad poenam sed fideliter libantibus prosit ad veniam.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that the taste of the sacred ministry be renewed in us. May it not turn into punishment for those who unworthily partake, but may it grant forgiveness to those who faithfully drink from it.

text: Recte Domine per hos martyres tuos populis attribuisti gratiam sanitatum qui insuperabiles in passione probati sunt. Ex hoc igitur tuam oblatis victimis clementiam imploramus ut haec oblatio et viventibus gratiae donum et sepultis aeternae quietis conferat refrigerium.
translation_en: Rightly, Lord, through these Your martyrs, You have granted grace to the people who have been proven superableness in passion. Therefore, we humbly offer You our sacrifices, imploring Your mercy that this offering may bestow grace upon the living and bring refreshment of eternal rest to the departed.

text: Recursis nominibus offerentium fratres dilectissimi preces fundamus ante dominum et oblatio quae offertur in sanctis proficiat ad salutem infirmis baptismate recreatis. Tuam vero Domine clementiam exoramus ut omnes metu territos inopia afflictos tribulatione vexatos morbis obrutos suppliciis deditos debitis obligatos vel quolibet maerore contritos cunctos indulgentia tuae pietatis absolvat.
translation_en: When the brothers, most dear ones, return with their offerings, we found our prayers before the Lord, and may the offering presented in the holy place prosper for the health of those who have been reborn through baptism. But, truly, we beseech your mercy, O Lord, that all who are terrified by fear, afflicted by poverty, vexed by tribulation, overwhelmed by diseases, devoted to penitence, obligated in debt, or in any sorrow contrite, may be absolved by your grace.

text: Redemisti nos Domine Deus per lavacrum regenerationis et sanguinem crucis ut illa caro quae prius in Adam mortalis fuerat effecta per passionem maiestatis tuae rursum revocaretur in caelum.
translation_en: You have redeemed us, Lord God, through the laver of regeneration and the blood of the cross, so that the flesh which was previously mortal in Adam might once again be called back to heaven through your passion's majesty.

text: Redempti Christe tui sanguinis pretio praecursoris tui ut nobis parcas exoramus suffragio; tu per eum et nobis et his benedicito hostiis per quem te manifestasti incredulis ut qui tuae fuit praevius mortis nostrae sit praerogator salutis.
translation_en: We, redeemed by Your precious blood and precursor of Yours, beseech You to have mercy on us. Through His intercession, we ask for Your favor; through Him and us, You blessed the offerings, by whom You revealed Yourself to unbelievers, so that the one who was previously before our death may be a forerunner of salvation for us.

text: Redemptio nostra et salus Christe Domine Deus qui nostris moriens pro peccatis resurrexisti pro iustificationibus nostris tu resurrectionis tuae celebritate laetantibus occurre benignus morte tua redemptos tuis semper facito inhaerere vestigiis tuisque perenniter inservire praeceptis ut sicut se tecum baptismate consepultos exsultant ita se tibi opere placituros exhibeant. Virtus quoque illa divinitatis quae olim te carne moriente novo inferis refulsit ex lumine nunc defunctis te opitulante promicet ad quietem quo paschalium gaudiorum a te hac oblatione suscepta et vivi resurgant a vitiis et defuncti eruantur a poenis.
translation_en: Our redemption and salvation, Christ, Lord God, who rose again while dying for our sins, appear gracious to us, redeemed by your death, always make them cling to your footsteps and serve you eternally according to your resurrection's splendor. Let those consecrated by baptism rejoice in you, so that those placating themselves to you through their works may also show themselves rejoicing just as they were baptized with you. Likewise, the same divine power which once shone forth in your body while dying and descending into hell, now promises peace to the departed as you intercede on their behalf. Through this offering, let those who receive the paschal joy rise from vices and let those who were buried free themselves from punishments.

text: Redemptionis nostrae Domine satiati commercio eius nos quaesumus participatione dignos efficiat cottidiana beati Maioli oratio.
translation_en: Lord, satisfied with the redemption of ours, we humbly ask that you make us worthy through his commerce. May the daily prayer of blessed Mayor make us so.

text: Redemptionis nostrae munera capientes te humiliter deprecamur ut per interventum et meritum sanctarum virginum et martyrum tuarum Fidei Spei et Caritatis et genitricis ipsarum Sapientiae fidem spem et caritatem in nobis augeas et ad beatitudinem sempiternam nos misericorditer pervenire concedas.
translation_en: Accepting the gifts of our Redemption, we humbly beseech you to increase faith, hope, and charity within us through the intervention and merit of your holy virgins and martyrs in Faith, Hope, Charity, and Wisdom, the very mothers of them; and that you mercifully grant us to arrive at eternal beatitude.

text: Redemptionis nostrae munere vegetati quaesumus Domine ut hoc perpetuae salutis auxilium fides semper vera perficiat.
translation_en: By the power of our redemption, we humbly ask you, Lord, that true faith may always complete this aid for eternal salvation.

text: Redemptionis nostrae mysteria sumentes quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut beatae Sabinae martyris tuae meritis muniamur et visionis tuae gloria perfruamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord our God, that we may take part in the mysteries of our redemption. May we be fortified by the merits of your blessed martyr Sabina and experience the glory of your vision.

text: Redemptionis nostrae pabulo satiati supplices Domine tuam deprecamur clementiam ut beati Mauricii confessoris tui atque pontificis intercedentibus meritis aeterna capiamus dona salutis.
translation_en: Humbly we approach you, Lord, having been filled by the food of our redemption. We entreat your clemency that, through the intercession of your blessed confessor and pope, Saint Maurice, we may obtain eternal gifts of salvation.

text: Redemptionis nostrae sacro gustu satiati quaesumus Domine ut interveniente beato Pantaleone martyre tuo per haec sancta quae sumpsimus ad aeterna gaudia praeparemur.
translation_en: Filled with the sacred taste of our redemption, we humbly ask you, Lord, that, with the intervention of your blessed martyr Pantaleon, through these holy things that we have received, we may be prepared for eternal joys.

text: Redemptor Christe Iesu sanctifica hanc servorum tuorum votivam oblationem ut per hanc et intimae quietis potiantur dulcedinem et virtutum se bonarum omnium summa gaudeant invenire.
translation_en: Lord Jesus Christ, sanctify this offering of your servants made in vow, so that through it they may be able to savor the sweetness and experience the highest joy of virtue, finding delight in all good things.

text: Redemptor humani generis conditor Deus da ut servo tuo illi vota adipe dilectionis tuae cumulata proficiant dum a te impetrare mereatur quod exoptat.
translation_en: O Redeemer of the human race, Creator God, grant that the prayers of your servant may prosper with the accumulated vows of your love, so that he may deserve to obtain from you what he longs for.

text: Redemptor noster atque Salvator aeterne Deus fragilem facturam tuam nos pietatis oculo respicere digneris et praesta ut qui pretiosi corporis et sanguinis tui sacrosancta mysteria pro totius mundi salute oblata percepimus per haec ad compassionis lacrimas tuaeque maestissimae matris devotionem facilius accendamur.
translation_en: Our Redeemer and eternal God, deign to look upon your frail creation with the eye of mercy, and grant that we who have received the sacred mysteries of your precious body and blood for the salvation of the whole world, may be more easily inflamed by compassionate tears and devotion to you and your most sorrowful Mother.

text: Redemptor noster Deus qui in terra fertilissima lacte et melle ditata et affluente nasci et mori voluisti libera animam famuli tui illius et animas famulorum famularumque tuarum de laqueis daemonum inimicorum tuorum et eandem terram de subiectione paganorum ut increduli populi fidei virtute illuminentur et ratione viventes tua magna potentia semper auxilientur.
translation_en: Our Redeemer, God, who in the most fertile land wished to be born and die in milk and honey, and who willed to be born and die freeing the soul of your servant, as well as the souls of his servants and attendants from the snares of demons, enemies of yours. May that same land be liberated from the rule of pagans, so that unbelieving peoples may be enlightened by faith, and those who live by reason be forever aided by your great power.

text: Redemptor noster et Domine omnipotens Christe Iesu qui per sanguinem crucis tuae omnia pacificare dignatus es sive quae in caelis sunt sive quae in terris dum discordiam quae inter angelos et homines per culpam primi parentis contracta fuerat verum hominem assumendo ac pro hominibus moriendo per crucis tuae tropaeum resolvisti et pacem inter caelestes terrestresque creaturas factor et reparator hominum atque angelorum conditor reformasti adclines te et cum omni humilitate deposcimus ut per obtentum sancti apostoli et martyris tui Andreae pacem tuam quae exsuperat omnem sensum non solum hominum sed etiam ipsorum angelorum in nostris cordibus perenniter exsultare concedas.
translation_en: Our Redeemer and Lord almighty Christ Jesus, who deemed it worthy to pacify all things through your blood of the cross, whether they are in heaven or on earth, since discord arose between angels and men due to the fault of the first parent, but by assuming true humanity and dying for mankind through the trophy of your cross, you resolved and made peace among celestial and terrestrial creatures. You, our creator and restorer, reformed man and angel. We humbly beseech you to grant that through the intercession of your holy apostle and martyr Andrew, the peace that surpasses all understanding not only for men but also for their angels, may perpetually rejoice in our hearts.

text: Refectam Domine sacrae participationis mysterio tuere quaesumus plebem tuam et beati Prisci martyris tui sollemnia recolentem caelestis gratiae largitate prosequere ut visibilibus adiuta solatiis ad invisibilia bona promptius incitetur.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you, guard your people whom you have nourished with the sacred mystery of participation. May the solemnity of your blessed martyr Priscus be sustained by the grace of heaven. We ask that this grace may follow, enabling them to be more swiftly incited towards invisible goods, aided by visible supports and consolations.

text: Refecti alimonia caelesti omnipotens Pater quaesumus pietatem tuam ut intercessione sanctae Batildis misericordiae tuae gratiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Fed with celestial nourishment, almighty Father, we humbly ask your mercy that, through the intercession of Saint Bathildis, we may merit your favor.

text: Refecti caelestis sacramenti satietate quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut per beati Petri doctrinam huius mysterium revelasti ita per eius exempla caelestis patriae aditum nobis reserare digneris.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that just as through the teachings of blessed Peter you revealed this sacred mystery, so through his examples, you might deign to open the gate to heaven for us.

text: Refecti Christi corpore et sanguine pariterque sanctificati Deo patri omnipotenti gratias referamus ut nos in eadem refectione et sanctificatione habentes hic et in futuro saeculo gloriam percipiamus.
translation_en: We give thanks to God the Father almighty, who has fed us with the body and blood of Christ, and made us holy. May we, having this feeding and sanctification here and in the future age, receive glory.

text: Refecti cibo potuque caelesti Deus noster te supplices exoramus ut in quorum haec commemoratione percepimus eorum muniamur et precibus.
translation_en: Fed and nourished with heavenly food, our God, we humbly entreat you that, as we recall these events, we may be strengthened by their benefits and prayers.

text: Refecti cibo potuque caelesti quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ab hostium defendas formidine quos redemisti pretioso sanguine Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi.
translation_en: Sustained with heavenly food and drink, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, to protect us from the fear of our enemies whom you have redeemed with the precious blood of your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Refecti cibo spiritali gratias agimus Domino Deo nostro omnium conditori ut singulis nobis atque universis plenam caelestis auxilii sui praestet misericordiam.
translation_en: We give thanks to the Lord our God, the creator of all, for the spiritual food, that He may grant us and all a full measure of His celestial aid's mercy.

text: Refecti corpore et sanguine Domini nostri Iesu Christi in aeternum restituti hilares domini misericordiae deprecemur.
translation_en: Having been fed with the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, we are eternally restored. We humbly ask for joy from the Lord, through His mercy.

text: Refecti corporis sacri pretiosique sanguinis libamine quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercessionibus sanctae Helenae reginae cuius festivo gratulamur officio cunctis malorum nostrorum sordibus exuamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God to clothe us in the precious mantle of the holy body and blood, that through the intercessions of Queen Saint Helena, whom we rejoice to honor on her festival day, we may be freed from all the dirt of our sins.
