text: Refecti dapibus spiritalis convivii te Domine deprecamur ut nos pane voluntatis tuae semper reficias et deprecante sancto Edwardo caelestium participes nuptiarum efficias.
translation_en: We, fed at the table of spiritual feast, Lord, do humbly pray to you. Grant us always to be refreshed with the bread of your will. Through the intercession of Saint Edward, make us participants in the heavenly marriage.

text: Refecti Domine benedictione sollemni quaesumus ut per intercessionem sancti Viti medicina sacramenti et corporibus nostris prosit et mentibus.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you bless us with a solemn benediction after our meal. Through the intercession of Saint Vitus, may the sacrament serve as a medicine for our bodies and minds.

text: Refecti Domine gratiae tuae vitalibus alimentis supplices imploramus ut quorum celebramus victorias participemus et praemiis.
translation_en: Fed by your gracious sustenance, Lord, we humbly ask that we may share in the victories we celebrate and receive our rewards.

text: Refecti Domine muneribus sacris quaesumus ut intercedente beato Deus dedit confessore tuo atque pontifice per haec contra omnia adversa muniamur.
translation_en: Sustained by sacred means, we humbly ask you, Lord, that with your blessed confessor and bishop interceding on our behalf, we may be fortified against all adversities through these means.

text: Refecti Domine pane caelesti ad vitam quaesumus nutriamur aeternam.
translation_en: Sustained by the Bread of Heaven, Lord, we ask to be nourished with eternal life.

text: Refecti Domine sacrae participationis dapibus deposcimus ut sancti Aegidii confessoris tui precibus semper satiemur divinae consolationis muneribus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, having been refreshed with the sacred banquet, that we may always be filled by your saint Aegidius' intercessions with the gifts of divine consolation.

text: Refecti esca caelesti poculo domini recreati Deo patri omnipotenti laudes et gratias referamus.
translation_en: After partaking of the heavenly food and drink, we offer to the Lord God Almighty our praises and thanks for the gift of the cup of our Lord.

text: Refecti et renovati sacro caelestis alimoniae pabulo immensam clementiam tuam flagitamus Domine Deus noster ut qui visitationis festa peragimus in Iesu Christi et Mariae laudibus indesinenter maneamus.
translation_en: Refected and renewed, we implore Your boundless mercy, Lord our God, that as we celebrate the feast of visitation, we may continually remain in the praise of Jesus Christ and Mary.

text: Refecti fratres remedio incomparabiliter animas et corpora nostra medicante oremus suppliciter Deum ac Dominum nostrum ut quos iucundare dignatus est in factura sua spe certos ac fide stabiles in operibus manuum suarum iubeat perpetuo exsultare felices.
translation_en: Let us brothers, with incomparable remedy healing our souls and bodies through prayer, most humbly entreat God and our Lord, that He who has chosen to delight us in His creation, may make us steadfast in faith and certain in works of His hands, commands us to rejoice happily forever.

text: Refecti mensae caelestis collatione quaesumus Domine ut beato Bricio pontifice intercedente ab omni nos adversitate defendas.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to protect us from all adversity with the banquet of the celestial table, through the intercession of blessed Bishop Bricius.

text: Refecti mensae caelestis collatione quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercessione beati Laudi confessoris tui atque pontificis cuius veneramur sollemnia ab omni nos semper adversitate defendas.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord God, to protect us always from every adversity with the intercession of Your blessed Confessor and Pope, whose feast we celebrate.

text: Refecti pane vitae supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut beati Iuvenalis confessoris tui et episcopi interventione a cunctis malis imminentibus eruamur.
translation_en: Fed with the bread of life, we humbly beseech you, Almighty God, that through the intervention of your blessed Confessor and Bishop Juvenal, we may be freed from all impending evils.

text: Refecti participatione muneris sacri quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut cuius exsequimur cultum sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: Fed with the partaking of a sacred stipend, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that we may feel the effect of him whose service we perform.

text: Refecti quaesumus Domine donis tuis te supplices exoramus ut converso fratre nostro illo ad viam iustitiae fontem lacrimarum in eo concutias et ne ultra lugenda committat eum paterna pietate castiga.
translation_en: Sustained by Your gifts, we humbly ask You, Lord, to entreat our brother with your grace, that You may stir him toward the way of justice; the wellspring of tears in him may be moved. And may he not commit further lamentation, but instead, let him be corrected by paternal pity.

text: Refecti sacra participatione spiritalis mensae maiestatem tuam deprecamur omnipotens Deus quatenus per gloriosam ac venerabilem Eormenhildam virginem cuius caelestem recolimus nativitatem concedas nobis omnem praesentis vitae opportunitatem et supernae claritatis portionem.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your majesty, Almighty God, that through the glorious and venerable Virgin Eormenhilda, whose celestial nativity we remember, you grant us all opportunities of this present life and a share of supernal brightness.

text: Refecti spiritali cibo et caelesti poculo reparati omnipotentem Deum fratres carissimi deprecemur ut qui nos corporis sui participatione et sanguinis effusione redemit in requiem sempiternam iubeat collocari.
translation_en: Brothers dearest, we who have been fed spiritually and restored with the heavenly cup, beseech the almighty God that He who redeemed us with His own body's participation and shedding of blood for eternal rest, grant us permission to be placed in peace.

text: Refecti tuis sacramentis omnipotens Deus quaesumus ut omnium sanctarum virginum tuarum intercessione et corpore tibi placeamus et mente.
translation_en: All-powerful God, we ask that you be pleased with us in body and mind, through the intercession of all your holy virgins.

text: Refecti vitalibus alimentis quaesumus Domine ad vitam nutriamur aeternam.
translation_en: Fed with vital foods, we humbly ask You, Lord, to nourish us with eternal life.

text: Refecti vitalibus alimentis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut quod tempore nostrae mortalitatis exsequimur immortalitatis tuae munere consequamur.
translation_en: Sustained by vital foods, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that what we carry out during the time of our mortality may be attained through your gift of immortality.

text: Refecti vitalibus alimoniis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beato Marco evangelista tuo quod ore sumpsimus pura mente capiamus.
translation_en: Sustained by vital nourishment, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that with the intercession of the blessed Mark, your evangelist, what we have taken into our mouths with a pure mind, may we truly receive.

text: Refectio tua Domine restrictis corporibus in spiritu contribulato gustatur et ideo prostrati ieiunii paenitentia supplices exoramus misericordia sola petentes quod opere non meremur ut sentiamus in spiritu dilectionis tuae pabulum suave quod corda nostra ab epulis vacantia ad proximi dilectionem succendat.
translation_en: Your refreshment, Lord, tastes sweet to us whose bodies are restricted and whose spirits are crushed with penitence. Therefore, prostrate in fasting, we humbly beg for mercy alone, that we who do not deserve it may feel in our spirits the sweet food of your love which may stir our hearts, now empty from worldly pleasures, to love of our neighbor.

text: Refectionis aeternae pasti dulcedine quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beato Swithuno confessore tuo quae in eius sumpsimus sollemnitate non iudicium nobis sed perenne praestent remedium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, through the intercession of your confessor Saint Swithun, that what we have received with joy during his feast day, may not bring judgment upon us but instead offer eternal remedy.

text: Refectos Domine mensae caelestis collatione beati Hilarii <pontificis intercessione ab omni nos adversitate defende>.
translation_en: Lord, defend us from all adversity by the collation of the celestial table refreshed by the intercession of blessed Pope Hilary.

text: Refectos Domine vitalis alimoniae sacramentis sancti confessoris tui Ethelwoldi episcopi gloriosa nos intercessione protege et ad aeternum caelestis mensae convivium pervenire concede.
translation_en: Lord, protected by the sacred sacraments of your glorious confessor Bishop Ethelwold, nourished with life's sustenance, we humbly ask that through his intercession you shield us and grant us a place at the eternal banquet of heaven.

text: Referat Domine populus christianus quos pia devotione praesumpsit sanctae gratulationis effectus ut beati apostoli tui Andreae simul fiat et veneratione iucundus et intercessione securus.
translation_en: Lord, may the Christian people report, who have presumptuously assumed the effects of pious devotion, that they become both joyful in veneration of your blessed apostle Andrew and secure in his intercession.

text: Refice nos mannae spiritalis alimento opulentissime largitor omnipotens Deus ut intercedentibus beatis martyribus tuis Petro et Marcellino in sensu manuum tuarum directi mereamur in monte tua acquisito dextera gloriari.
translation_en: Bend us, the most generous bestower of spiritual food, omnipotent God, that through the intercession of your blessed martyrs Peter and Marcellinus, we may merit to rejoice in your hand's guidance on the mountain of yours.

text: Refice quaesumus Domine populum tuum spiritalibus alimentis et quorum tribuis sollemnia celebrare fac eorum gaudiis interesse.
translation_en: Bow down, we ask You, Lord, Your people with spiritual food, and those whom You grant solemnities to, make their joys to partake in.

text: Rege Domine populum tuum et gratiae tuae in eo dona multiplica ut ab omnibus liber offensis et temporalibus non destituatur auxiliis et sempiternis gaudeat institutis.
translation_en: Rule, Lord, your people and multiply your graces among them, so that they may be unfailingly free from all offenses and temporary troubles, and may not be lacking in aid. May they eternally rejoice in everlasting institutions.

text: Rege Domine quaesumus tuorum corda fidelium et ut bona tua te largiente percipiant ipsorum primitus bonas esse concede voluntates.
translation_en: We ask you, O Lord, to rule the hearts of your faithful and to grant that they may receive your blessings as their first fruits; concede to them, we pray, that their desires be willing.

text: Rege nostras Domine propitius voluntates ut nec propriis iniquitatibus implicentur nec subdantur alienis.
translation_en: O Lord, have mercy on our wills so that we are not entangled in our own wickedness and do not bow to others.

text: Remedii sempiterni munera Domine laetantes offerimus suppliciter exorantes ut eadem nos et digne venerari et pro salvandis congruenter exhibere perficias.
translation_en: We humbly offer to you, Lord, the gifts of everlasting remedy, earnestly asking that you may both grant us worthy reverence and present us fittingly for our salvation.

text: Reminiscentes martyrum tuorum Domine quorum diversis passionum triumphis universa per orbem terrarum decoratur ecclesia indefessam per eosdem de immensa sanctificatione tua poscimus opem ut quod eis ad meritorum cumulum a <te> p<raeparatur> nobis ad indulgentiam criminum ipsis patrocinantibus tribuatur.
translation_en: Remembering your martyrs, Lord, whose various triumphs of passion adorn the Church throughout the world without ceasing, we ask through their same immense sanctification that what is prepared for us as a reward for merits by you be granted to us as forgiveness for our sins, with them interceding on our behalf.

text: Reminiscere miserationum tuarum Domine et famulos tuos aeterna protectione sanctifica pro quibus Christus Filius tuus per suum cruorem nobis instituit paschale mysterium.
translation_en: Remember your mercies, O Lord, and sanctify forever your servants, for whom your Son, Christ, instituted the Paschal mystery through his own blood.

text: Remotis obumbrationibus carnalium victimarum spiritalem tibi summe Pater hostiam supplici servitute deferimus quae miro ineffabilique mysterio et immolatur semper et eadem semper offertur pariterque et devotorum munus et remunerantis est praemium.
translation_en: Removing the shadows of carnal sacrifices, we humbly present to you, Supreme Father, a spiritual offering in submissive servitude. This is offered through a marvelous and ineffable mystery, which is always immolated and continually presented alike, as well as the gift of the devoted and the reward for the repentant.

text: Remunerator omnium bonorum Deus dele nostrorum scelera peccatorum ut mente et corpore purificati tibi placeamus aeterno Deo regi ut caritatis praemium consequamur et ab omnibus nequitiis sordium liberemur.
translation_en: Remunerator of all good things, God, delete our sins and crimes of wrongdoing, that purified in mind and body we may please you, the eternal God, King. That we may attain the reward of charity and be freed from all stains of wickedness.

text: Renova Iesu Domine animas nostras ubertate dulcedinis et abundantia alternae caritatis ut ieiunium nostrum sic beneficio dilectionis litetur qualiter omnes petitiones nostrae coram te acceptabiles habeantur.
translation_en: Jesus Lord, renew our souls with the abundance of sweetness and the alternating charity, that our fasting may be lightened by your blessing in such a way that all our petitions before you may be considered acceptable.

text: Renovatos Domine fontis ac spiritus tui potentia iri hereditarium populum clementer adnumera ut qui a multitudine purgati sunt criminum invisibilium etiam mereantur copiam praemiorum.
translation_en: Lord, renewed by your power, the font and the spirit, you have graciously restored your heritage, may they remember it gently. Those who have been purified from countless invisible sins may also deserve the abundance of rewards.

text: Reparet nos quaesumus Domine semper et innovet tuae providentia pietatis quae fragilitatem nostram et inter mundi tempestates protegat et gubernet et in portum perpetuae salutis inducat.
translation_en: Repair us, we ask You, Lord, always and renew Your providence of mercy that protects and guides us through the storms of the world and leads us to the harbor of eternal salvation.

text: Repelle Domine quaesumus a nobis sacrilegas voluntates et tribue ut divina mysteria castis iucunditatibus celebremus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to drive away from us sacrilegious intentions and grant that we may celebrate the divine mysteries with pure delight.

text: Reple cor nostrum Domine laetitia qui nobis dare dignatus es sacri corporis tui eucharistiam ut qui escarum perceptione reficimur spiritalibus beneficiis adimpleri feliciter mereamur.
translation_en: Fill our hearts, O Lord, with joy, who have deemed us worthy to give the Eucharist of your sacred body, so that we, being refreshed spiritually by partaking in the mystery of bread, may merit to fulfill happily the benefits bestowed upon us.

text: Reple quaesumus Domine famulos tuos tua sacra benedictione et qui te factorem et conditorem ad eos renovandos Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum advenisse confidunt te auctore iugiter operante salventur.
translation_en: Fill, we ask you, Lord, your servants with your sacred blessing, and those who believe that the Creator and Maker of all things, our Lord Jesus Christ, has come to renew them, trusting in you as their constant helper; they are saved by you always operating.

text: Repleamur Domine gratia muneris sacri et quae gustu corporeo dulci veneratione contingimus dulciora mentibus sentiamus.
translation_en: Lord, may we be filled with the grace of this sacred offering, and that which we taste corporally with sweet devotion, let us feel sweeter in our minds.

text: Repleantur consolationibus tuis Domine quaesumus tuorum corda fidelium pariterque et de ecclesiae praesulum et de suo referant gaudia votiva profectu ac temporalibus solatiis incitati promptius aeterna desiderent.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that your consolations fill the hearts of your faithful alike, as well as the shepherds of your church and their own. May they return with votive joys hastened by their journey and temporal comforts, inspired to desire eternal things more quickly.

text: Repleantur consolationibus tuis Domine quaesumus tuorum corda fidelium pariterque etiam et de ecclesiae praesule et de suorum votorum plenitudine gratiarum referant actionem.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that your consolations fill the hearts of your faithful alike, and also the heart of the church's bishop, and that they return to you the fullness of their thanks for this action from the depths of their prayers.

text: Repleatur os nostrum laude tua Domine et cor nostrum gratia martyris tui Iuliani ut et vox nostra tuis resultet praeconiis et anima repleatur spiritalibus donis.
translation_en: Fill our mouth, O Lord, with Your praise, and our heart with the grace of Your martyr Juliana, that both our voice may resound with Your proclamations and our soul be filled with spiritual gifts.

text: Repleti alimonia caelesti et spiritali poculo recreati quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ab hoste maligno defendas quos per lignum sanctae crucis Filii tui arma iustitiae pro salute mundi triumphare iussisti.
translation_en: Filled with heavenly and spiritual nourishment, we ask the almighty God that you defend those whom you have commanded to triumph over the malicious enemy through the arms of justice given by the wood of your Son's cross.

text: Repleti alimonia caelesti quaesumus Domine ut beati Aldelmi confessoris tui atque pontificis in cuius translatione haec sollemnia sacro exhibuimus officio muniamur meritis et orationibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Filled with celestial provisions, we humbly ask You, Lord, that we may be fortified by the merits and supported by the prayers of Your blessed confessor and bishop, Aldhelm, on whose feast day we have solemnly performed this sacred office. Grant us protection and aid.

text: Repleti alimonia caelesti quaesumus Domine ut intercedente beato Hieronymo confessore tuo misericordiae tuae gratiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Filled with celestial provisions, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of your confessioner, St. Jerome, we may deserve your mercy and gain your grace.

text: Repleti benedictione caelesti suppliciter imploramus ut quae fragili celebramus officio per beatos apostolos tuos nobis prodesse sentiamus auxilio.
translation_en: Filled with celestial blessing, we humbly ask that through your blessed apostles, we may feel the help of what we weakly celebrate in our office.

text: Repleti Domine benedictione caelesti suppliciter imploramus ut quod fragili celebramus officio sanctorum archangelorum nobis prodesse sentiamus auxilio.
translation_en: Lord, filled with heavenly blessing, we humbly ask that we may feel the benefits of what we weakly celebrate on behalf of the holy archangels, through their aid.

text: Repleti cibo spiritalis alimoniae supplices te deprecamur omnipotens Deus ut huius participatione mysterii doceas nos terrena despicere et amare caelestia atque omni nexu mortiferae cupiditatis exutos regno perpetuae libertatis consortes efficias.
translation_en: Filled with the spiritual food, we humbly beseech you, Almighty God, that through participation in this mystery you teach us to despise earthly things and love heavenly ones; and by freeing us from all bonds of mortal desire, make us companions of the kingdom of eternal liberty.

text: Repleti cibo spiritalis alimoniae supplices te Domine deprecamur ut huius participatione mysterii doceas nos terrena despicere et amare caelestia.
translation_en: Filled with spiritual food, we humbly entreat you, Lord, that through the partaking of this mystery, you teach us to despise earthly things and love heavenly ones.

text: Repleti Domine alimonia caelesti et spirituali poculo recreati quaesumus clementiam tuam omnipotens Deus ut intercessio beati Eligii episcopi ad conterendas potestates adversariorum nos in Dei proiectione et securitate constituat ut omnia diri serpentis venena valeat exstinguere et nostram apud te satisfactionem obtinere.
translation_en: Lord, who have filled us with heavenly and spiritual nourishment, we humbly ask for your mercy, almighty God. Through the intercession of blessed Bishop Eligius, may you establish us in the protection and security of God, so that all the poisonous venom of the serpent may be extinguished, and that our satisfaction may be obtained by you.

text: Repleti Domine apostolorum celebritate tuorum quaesumus ut te semper in eorum commemoratione laudemus et tuam nobis misericordiam iisdem semper deprecantibus consequamur.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that your apostles are filled with the splendor of your presence. May we always praise you in their remembrance, and may we constantly obtain your mercy as they continually intercede for us.

text: Repleti Domine benedictione caelesti maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecamur ut beati archangeli tui Michaelis intercessionibus ad vitam nobis proficiat sempiternam.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly beseech You, filled with celestial blessing, that through the intercessions of Your blessed Archangel Michael, it may profit us everlasting life.

text: Repleti Domine benedictione caelesti sanctorum tuorum concede suffragiis ut quae humiliter gerimus salubriter sentiamus.
translation_en: Lord, filled with celestial blessings of your saints, grant us your support so that what we humbly do may be healthfully felt.

text: Repleti Domine benedictione caelesti quaesumus clementiam tuam ut intercedente beato Hermete martyre tuo quae humiliter gerimus salubriter sentiamus.
translation_en: Filled with heavenly blessing, we ask, Lord, that your clemency intervene so that, through the intercession of blessed Hermes, the martyr, we may healthfully feel what we humbly do.

text: Repleti Domine caelesti mysterio et benedictionibus suffragantium gratias agimus nomini tuo qui nos et salutari munere comitaris et sanctorum patrociniis benignus attollis.
translation_en: We, filled with the celestial mystery, offer our thanks to Your name, Lord, who accompanies us with a saving gift and raises us up graciously through the patronage of the saints.

text: Repleti Domine caelestibus sacramentis quaesumus clementiam tuam ut beati Germani confessoris tui cuius.sollemnia celebramus sentiamus optata praesidia.
translation_en: Filled with heavenly sacraments, we humbly ask Your clemency that we may feel the desired protection of your blessed confessor Germanus whose feast day we celebrate.

text: Repleti Domine corporis et sanguinis tui pretioso libamine quaesumus ut indulgentiam peccatorum nostrorum precibus sancti Narcissi mereamur percipere.
translation_en: Filled, Lord, with your precious body and blood, we humbly ask that through the merits of Saint Narcissus, we may worthy receive the indulgence for our sins.

text: Repleti Domine donis tuis in tuorum festivitate sanctorum praesta ut haec sancta mysteria quae celebramus votis experiamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Lord, filled with your gifts in the feast of your saints, grant that we may experience the aid of these holy mysteries which we celebrate through our vows.

text: Repleti Domine eucharistia caelesti quaesumus ut sanctus Germanus confessor tuus atque pontifex piis nos intercessionibus tueatur quatenus cuius sollemnia recensemus sentiamus optata praesidia.
translation_en: Filled, Lord, are the heavenly Eucharist, we ask that You protect us through the holy prayers of Your confessor and bishop Saint Germanus, so that as we celebrate his feast day, we may feel the desired protection.

text: Repleti Domine eucharistia sacra sancti Germani confessoris tui atque pontificis pia nos intercessio quaesumus relevet a vitiis ut cuius sollemnia recensemus sentiamus optata praesidia.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your sacred Eucharist, filled for the holy German confessor and bishop Saint Germanus, may raise us from our vices as we celebrate his feast day. May we feel the desired protection.

text: Repleti Domine martyris tui celebritate Christophori quaesumus ut et te semper in eius commemoratione laudemus et tuam misericordiam ipso deprecante consequamur.
translation_en: Fill up, Lord, your martyr Christopher with great multitude, we ask you. May we always praise you in his commemoration and may we obtain your mercy through his intercession.

text: Repleti Domine muneribus hostiae salutaris illius quaesumus orationibus adiuvemur qui hanc pro nobis singulariter immolandam et verbo docuit et proprii sanguinis effusione signavit.
translation_en: Fill, Lord, the offerings of the saving sacrificial lamb. With your prayers, we humbly ask to be assisted, who for us alone immolated this and taught with word and signified by shedding his own blood.

text: Repleti Domine muneribus sacris da quaesumus ut in gratiarum semper actione maneamus.
translation_en: Lord, filled with sacred gifts, grant what we ask, that we may always remain in the act of gratitude.

text: Repleti Domine muneribus sacris quaesumus ut intercedentibus sanctis tuis in gratiarum tuarum semper actione maneamus.
translation_en: Filled with sacred gifts, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your saints, we may always remain in your grateful service.

text: Repleti Domine muneribus sacris supplices te deprecamur ut per invocationem nominis tui ab hoc famulo tuo vexato inimicus confusus abscedat et in omnibus eius insidiis facias caelestem pietatem succurrere.
translation_en: Lord, filled with sacred gifts, we humbly entreat You that through the invocation of Your name, this enemy vexing Your servant may be confounded and depart. In all his traps, may heavenly pity intervene.

text: Repleti Domine munificentiae gratiae tuae benedictione copiosa et pro nostrae servitutis obsequiis et pro celebritate sanctorum caelestia dona sumentes gratias tibi referimus.
translation_en: We, filled with your abundant grace, Lord, offer our thanks to you for the gifts we have received in your blessing during our service and in honor of the celestial saints. We refer these grateful thanks to you.

text: Repleti Domine participatione caelesti supplices te rogamus ut quos divino munere non relinquis perpetua gubernatione comiteris.
translation_en: Lord, filled with celestial participation, we humbly ask you that those whom you do not abandon through divine gift, you govern kindly and continually.

text: Repleti Domine sacramenti participatione quaesumus ut sancti David confessoris tui atque pontificis meritis cuius gloriosam celebramus festivitatem ineffabilis misericordiae tuae patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: Lord, who are filled with the sacrament, we humbly ask that through your participation, we may feel the patronage of your saint, David, the confessor and bishop, whose glorious feast day we celebrate, under the ineffable mercy of yours.

text: Repleti Domine sacri muneris gratia supplices exoramus ut quae gustu corporeo dulci veneratione contigimus dulciora mentibus sentiamus.
translation_en: Lord, filled with the grace of the sacred office, we humbly ask that what we have tasted with bodily sweetness and reverence, may be felt more sweetly in our minds.

text: Repleti Domine sacramento corporis et sanguinis unigeniti tui quaesumus ut beatae Mariae Magdalenae meritis nos ab adversitatibus cunctis eripias et ad caelestia regna perducas.
translation_en: Lord, who hast filled us with the sacrament of your only-begotten Son's body and blood, we humbly beseech you to deliver us from all adversities through the merits of Blessed Mary Magdalene, and lead us to the heavenly kingdoms.

text: Repleti gustu gratiae tuae et caelestis mensae dulcedine vegetati gratias tibi referimus.
translation_en: Filled with the taste of your grace and nourished by the sweetness of the celestial table, we offer our thanks to you.

text: Repleti libamine spiritualis mensae tuam imploramus omnipotentiam misericors Domine quatenus per gloriosa castae virginis Ethelburgae merita cuius caelestem celebramus nativitatem tribuas nobis indeficientem caelestis remunerationis sempiternitatem.
translation_en: Filled with the spiritual banquet, we humbly ask Your almighty and merciful kindness, O Lord, that through the merits of the glorious chaste virgin Ethelburga, whose heavenly nativity we celebrate, You grant us an endless reward from heaven.

text: Repleti muneribus sacris quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut interveniente beato Thoma martyre tuo atque pontifice mereamur mandatis tuis perseveranter intendere et incursus persequentium constanter tolerare.
translation_en: Filled with sacred duties, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that with the intervention of your blessed martyr and pope Thomas, may we merit to persevere steadfastly in your commandments and to endure constantly the attacks of those who assault us.

text: Repleti muneribus sacris quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut in cuius haec commemoratione percepimus eius semper meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: Filled with sacred duties, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that in whose memory we celebrate today, we may always be helped by his eternal merits.

text: Repleti muneribus tuis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut eius nos tribuas sequi exempla cuius gloriosa celebramus sollemnia.
translation_en: Filled with your gifts, we humbly ask, Almighty God, that you grant us to follow the examples of him whose glorious solemnities we celebrate.

text: Repleti substantia reparationis et vitae quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per ea qua{e} nobis munera dignaris praebere caelestia per ha{e}c eadem tribuas nos inhaerere caelestibus.
translation_en: Filled with the substance of restoration and life, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through these same things, you may deem us worthy to bestow heavenly gifts upon us, and may you grant us to be attached to the celestial ones.

text: Repleti sumus Domine donorum participatione caelestium; praesta quaesumus ut eadem et sumamus iugiter et incessabiliter ambiamus.
translation_en: We have been filled, Lord, with the participation of heavenly gifts; grant us, we ask, that we may always and unceasingly pursue them as well.

text: Repleti sumus Domine misericordia tua et benedictione sanctorum et securitatis munere relevati.
translation_en: We are filled, Lord, with your mercy and with the blessing of saints, and raised up with the gift of security.

text: Repleti sumus Domine munere sollemnitatis optatae qua beati Xysti et celebritate iuvemur et precibus.
translation_en: We have been filled, Lord, with the gift of the desired solemnity that we may rejoice in the feast of blessed Xystus and be strengthened by our prayers.

text: Repleti sumus Domine muneribus tuis; tribue quaesumus ut et eorum mundemur effectu et muniamur auxilio.
translation_en: We have been filled, Lord, with your gifts; grant us that we may be cleansed by their effect and strengthened by their aid.

text: Repleti sumus Domine sacramentis et gaudiis quae in sanctorum tuorum celebritatibus et frequentamus et sumimus.
translation_en: We are filled, Lord, with your sacraments and joys which we celebrate and partake of in the festivities of your saints.

text: Repleti vitalibus alimoniis et divinis reparati mysteriis supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut beatae Mariae semper virginis cuius laetabunda celebramus gaudia pia interventione quod fideliter petimus efficaciter consequamur.
translation_en: Filled with vital nourishment and restored by divine mysteries, we humbly ask the almighty God that through the pious intervention of the blessed Virgin Mary whose joyful feast we celebrate, may what we faithfully ask for be effectively achieved.

text: Repleti vitalibus alimoniis et divinis reparati mysteriis supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut beatae Mariae semper virginis cuius venerandam colimus conceptionem pia interventione coniungi mereamur gaudiis civium supernorum.
translation_en: Filled with vital nourishments and restored by divine mysteries, we humbly ask the almighty God that through the pious intervention, we may deserve to unite with the blessed conception of Mary, ever virgin, whom we venerate. May we rejoice in the delights of the citizens of heaven.

text: Repleti vitalibus alimoniis et divinis reparari mysteriis supplices rogamus omnipotens Deus beatae Mariae semper virginis cuius venerandam colimus conceptionem pia interventione a squalorum erui immanium dominatione.
translation_en: Filled with vital nourishment and divine mysteries, we humbly ask the Almighty God of the blessed Virgin Mary, whom we reverently honor for her Immaculate Conception, through pious intercession to free us from the wretchedness of immense domination.

text: Repletos Domine eucharistia sancti Germani confessoris tui atque pontificis pia nos intercessio prosequatur ut cuius sollemnia recensemus sentiamus optata praesidia.
translation_en: Lord, may the Eucharist of your holy confessor and bishop Saint Germanus follow us with his pious intercession. May we feel the desired protection as we remember the solemnity of him.

text: Repletos quaesumus Domine substantia caelesti sancti Germani confessoris tui et episcopi nos intercessio tueatur ut cuius sollemnia celebramus sentiamus optata praesidia.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to protect us with the intervention of Your saint, Germanus, the confessor and bishop, whose feast day we celebrate. May we experience the desired protection that we seek.

text: Respice ad hanc oblationem omnipotens Deus quam tibi offerimus in honorem nominis tui pro salute regum et exercitus eorum et omnium circumadstantium et praesta ut qui ex ea sumpserint accipiant sanitatem mentis integritatem corporis tutelam salutis intellectum sensus Christi securitatem spei corroborationem fidei aeternitatem Spiritus Sancti.
translation_en: Look upon this offering, Almighty God, which we offer to you in honor of your name, for the health of the kings and their armies, and for all those standing around, and grant that those who partake of it may receive soundness of mind, integrity of body, protection, understanding, senses, Christ's security, strengthening of hope, confirmation of faith, eternity of the Holy Spirit.

text: Respice clementissime Pater hostiam quam ego indignus tuus famulus et sacerdos offerre praesumo coram sancto altario tuo tam pro me quam pro fratribus et sororibus nostris seu etiam et omnibus benefactoribus nostris quorum eleemosynas erogandas suscepimus et quorum nomina ad memorandum conscripsimus et quorum hic super sancto altario tuo recensita fuerint quam etiam defunctorum et omnium christianorum <ut> cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Look with great mercy, Father, upon the offering which your unworthy servant and priest presumes to present before Your holy altar, not only for myself but also for my brothers and sisters, and indeed for all our benefactors whose alms we have received and whose names we have inscribed for remembrance, and whose gifts have been placed on this holy altar. May it also profit all the deceased and all Christians.

text: Respice Deus omnipotens ad precem familiae tuae quae a misericordia tua sinceritatis officium et studium caritatis obtinere desiderat atque muneris tui donum te adiuvante percipiat.
translation_en: O all-powerful God, look upon the prayer of your family who desires to obtain sincerity in their duty and fervor in their love through your mercy. May they receive the gift of your grace with your help.

text: Respice Domine ad haec munera quae te sanctificante sacramus et sicut beatus Ioannes Baptista factus est praecursor et praeparator viae Domini nostri Iesu Christi ita et pro nostris infirmitatibus te protegente intercessor exsistat.
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, these offerings that we dedicate to you while you are sanctifying them. And just as blessed John the Baptist became a forerunner and preparer of the way of our Lord Jesus Christ, may there also be an intercessor for us in your presence, as you protect us from our infirmities.

text: Respice Domine familiae tuae preces et opem tribue suppliciter imploranti ut congruis subsidiis in confessione tui nominis perseveret.
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, the prayers of your family and grant aid to the one who humbly asks, that they may persevere fittingly with suitable help in the confession of your name.

text: Respice Domine familiam tuam et praesta ut apud te mens nostra tuo desiderio fulgeat quae se carnis maceratione castigat.
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, your family and grant that our minds may shine before you, as they strive to be purified through bodily discipline.

text: Respice Domine famulum tuum illum in infirmitate sui corporis laborantem et animam refove quam creasti ut castigationibus emundatus(a) continuo se sentiat tua medicina salvatum(am).
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, your servant who is struggling with his bodily infirmity, and restore the soul that you created. May he be continually aware of feeling saved by your medicine after having been purified through your chastisements.

text: Respice Domine munera populi tui sanctorum festivitate votiva et tuae testificatio veritatis nobis proficiat ad salutem.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, the offerings of your holy people on this vow-ful festival day, and may your testimony of truth profit us for salvation.

text: Respice Domine munera quae in sanctorum tuorum commemoratione deferimus ut quorum honore sunt grata eorum nobis fiant intercessione perpetua.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, the offerings which we bring in the commemoration of your saints, that through their honor may they become a perpetual intercession for us.

text: Respice Domine munera supplicantis ecclesiae et saluti credentium perpetua sanctificatione sumenda concede.
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, the offerings of the supplicating church and grant eternal sanctification to those who believe, bestowing salvation.

text: Respice Domine mysterii tui consortium; episcopos in pace confirma presbyteros duplici honore sublima diaconos evangeliorum splendore clarifica lectores meditatione legis exerce exorcistas Spiritus Sancti virtute corrobora ostiarios vigiliarum comple sollertia virgines quoque nutri ac viduas et pupillos atque omnem plebis huius humilium tibi gregem ovilis sanctae claude custodia et desideria eorum ad te cum electis sacrificii istius puritate perveniant.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, the assembly of your mystery; confirm in peace the bishops, exalt the presbyters, elevate the deacons with the splendor of the Gospels, brighten the readers, exercise the lectors in the study of the law, strengthen the exorcists with the power of the Holy Spirit, fortify the doorkeepers and ushers with vigilance, complete the wisdom of virgins, nurse the widows and children, and protect all this flock of your humble people, the holy church. Enclose them under the guardianship of Saint Claire, and may their desires, along with these chosen ones, reach you with the purity of this sacrifice.

text: Respice Domine nostrae servitutis munera quae in apostolorum tuorum omnium commemoratione tuae pietati deferimus et praesta ut eorum intercessione nobis fiant salutaria.
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, the offerings of our servitude which we bring to Your remembrance in honor of all Your apostles. Grant that through their intercession, we may find salvation.

text: Respice Domine oblationes fidelium ut tibi gratae sint in tuorum passione sanctorum qui germano amore te diligentes sua corpora martyrio tradiderunt.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, the offerings of the faithful, that they may be pleasing to You in Your passion, the holy ones who, with German love, have offered their bodies as a martyrdom.

text: Respice Domine propitius ad munera quae sacramus ut et tibi grata sint et nobis salutaria semper exsistant.
translation_en: Look upon us, O Lord, with favor as we offer our gifts, that they may be pleasing to You and that beneficial effects may always endure for us.

text: Respice Domine propitius ad plebem tuam et quam divinis tribuis proficere sacramentis ab omnibus absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, with favor, and bless your people. By divine sacraments may they advance, and be absolved from all sins.

text: Respice Domine propitius familiam tuam et perpetuam largire misericordiam supplicanti ut sine qua nihil potest a te dignum prorsus efficere per eam salutaria tua praecepta mereatur implere.
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, with favor upon your family and perpetually grant mercy to the supplicant, that he who can accomplish nothing without you may deserve to fulfill your salutary precepts through her, by merit.

text: Respice Domine propitius plebem tuam et toto tibi corde subiectam praesidiis invictae pietatis attolle.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, with favor upon your people and lift up with the whole of your heart those submitted to the defenses of unconquered piety.

text: Respice Domine propitius populum tuum atque ad tuam misericordiam pertinentes et temporalibus sustenta beneficiis et aeternis.
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, graciously upon your people and those who are approaching your mercy. Sustain them with temporary benefits and eternal ones.

text: Respice Domine propitius sacra mysteria quae gerimus et quod ad nostra evacuanda praeiudicia misericors providisti vitam nobis tribue fructificare perpetuam.
translation_en: Look upon us, O Lord, with favor as we perform your holy mysteries. You have graciously provided preludes for our judgment, grant us the gift of everlasting life to bear fruit.

text: Respice Domine propitius super has famulas tuas ut virginitatis sanctae propositum quod te inspirante suscipiunt te gubernante custodiant.
translation_en: Look upon us, O Lord, with kindness, upon these your servants, that they may keep the vow of holiness in virginity which you have inspired them to take and govern them while they are under your protection.

text: Respice Domine propitius ad hostiam nostrae servitutis tuo conspectui immolandam ut professionis sanctae propositum quod te inspirante suscepimus te gubernante custodiamus.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, with favor as we offer our sacrifice of servitude. May we keep the vow of holy profession that we have taken up inspired by you, and may we be guided by you as we are protected.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus afflictionem populi tui et ab omnibus necessitatibus liberatum secura tribue tibi mente servire.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we humbly ask, the affliction of your people and from all necessities grant them security, may you graciously serve with a peaceful mind.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus afflictionem populi tui et quos iustitia corripis misericordia consolari dignare ut te custode servati ab omnibus periculis huius vitae liberemur.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we entreat you, the affliction of your people and those whom justice corrects, grant mercy to console, that we may be set free from all dangers of this life as we are guarded by you.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus pietatis tuae subsidium postulantes; da indulgentiam reis ut nobis subvenias propitiatus afflictis.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we humbly ask for your aid; grant forgiveness to the kings so that you may assist us in your mercy towards the afflicted.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus plebem tuam de sanctae Caeciliae martyris glorificatione gratulantem et beneplacitum fieri tribue sacratarum tibi mentium famulatum ut qui in sanctis tuis te honorare non desinunt perpetua donorum tuorum largitate potiantur et quod visibiliter exsequuntur invisibiliter apprehendant.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we humbly ask that you grant favor to your people who rejoice in the glorification of Saint Cecilia, the martyr, and may those offering sacred thoughts to you be blessed. May they who never cease to honor you in your saints be able to partake in your perpetual gifts of grace and may what they do visibly they comprehend invisibly.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus populum supplicantem misericordiam tuam ac dispone praesidiis ut te in omnibus rectore gratuletur quia non habet nisi in tua tantum pietate fiduciam.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we humbly ask, your mercy and arrange defenses, so that you may delight in being our ruler in all things, for we have no trust except in your alone compassion.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus populum tuum ad tua sacramenta currentem in praesenti festivitate sancti confessoris tui atque pontificis Medardi ut quod in honorem tui nominis detulerunt cunctis proficiat ad veniam.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we implore, your people running towards your sacraments during this present feast of your confessor and bishop Medard. May what they have brought in honor of your name profit all for forgiveness.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus super famulos tuos et in tua misericordia confidentes caelesti protege benignus auxilio.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we humbly ask, and protect your servants in your mercy. Shower them with your benevolent aid from heaven.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus super haec quae tibi offerimus et beati Iuliani pontificis meritis nos ab omnibus exime peccatis.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we entreat you, on these things which we offer to you, and exempt us from all sins by the merits of Blessed Julians the Pontiff.

text: Respice Domine quaesumus super hanc familiam tuam pro qua Dominus noster Iesus Christus non dubitavit manibus tradi nocentium et crucis subire tormentum.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we entreat you, on this family of yours for whom our Lord Jesus Christ did not hesitate to be handed over to the wicked and to suffer the torment of the cross.

text: Respice Domine super has hostias nostras quas nomini tuo sacrandas offerimus – et beati Apollinaris martyris tui atque pontificis prosequatur oratio per quam nos expiari facias et defendi.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, upon these offerings of ours which we offer up to your name – and may the prayer of your blessed martyr Apollinaris and bishop follow after, through which you make us worthy of being purified and defended.

text: Respice igitur clementissime Pater filii instituta ecclesiae mysteria credentibus munera a supplicantibus oblata et eroganda supplicantibus.
translation_en: Therefore, most kind Father, look upon the instituted mysteries of the Church, bestowed as gifts for believers and to be requested by supplicants.

text: Respice in me patiens et immensae misericordiae Deus qui indulgentiam tuam nulla temporum lege concludis sed pulsantibus misericordiae tuae ianuam aperis et da mihi peccata mea paenitenti compunctionis lacrimas quibus incendia meorum valeam exstingere peccatorum ut dono clementiae tuae mundatus in gratiarum tuarum semper actione persistam.
translation_en: Look upon me, O patient God, and you of immense mercy, who encloses your forgiveness not by any temporal law but by opening the door of your mercy to those who knock. Grant me tears of penitence for my sins, with which I may extinguish the fires of my wrongdoings, so that washed by your clemency, I may continually persevere in actions of thanksgiving.

text: Respice nos omnipotens et misericors Deus et ab omnibus tribulationibus propitiatus absolve.
translation_en: Look upon us, O mighty and merciful God, and, propitious towards all our troubles, grant us absolution.

text: Respice nos omnipotens et misericors Deus et mentibus clementer humanis nascente Christo summae veritatis lumen infunde.
translation_en: Look upon us, O almighty and merciful God, and gently pour into our minds the supreme light of truth that is born with Christ.

text: Respice nos rerum omnium Deus creator et rector et ut tuae propitiationis sentiamus effectum toto nos tribue tibi corde servire.
translation_en: Look upon us, God, creator and ruler of all things, and may our hearts fully serve you, so that we may feel the effect of your propitiation.

text: Respice omnipotens Deus propitius super me famulum tuum et omnes iniquitates meas dele ut cicatricum iniquitatum mearum signa non appareant ultra in carne mea sed ablutis vitiis et carnis petulantia in laudibus tuis ex plenitudine cordis mea solvatur lingua.
translation_en: Look upon me, O almighty God, mercifully upon your servant, and erase all my iniquities so that the marks of my transgressions no longer appear on my flesh but washed away with sins and the rebellion of the flesh, may be resolved in your praises from the fullness of my heart, and my tongue be loosed.

text: Respice propitius Domine ad deditam tibi tui populi servitutem ut inter humanae fragilitatis incerta nullis adversitatibus opprimatur qui de tua protectione confidit.
translation_en: Look upon us graciously, Lord, on your people who have been given to you in service, so that he who trusts in your protection may not be overwhelmed by the uncertainties of human frailty amidst any adversities.

text: Respice Domine famulae tuae tibi deditam servitutem ut inter humanae fragilitatis incerta nullis adversitatibus opprimatur quae de tua protectione confidit.
translation_en: Lord, look upon your servant who has given herself to you in service. May she not be overcome by the uncertainties of human frailty under any hardships, for she trusts in your protection.

text: Respice propitius Domine quaesumus afflictionem populi tui et ne ad perdendum peccata nostra praevaleant sed ad salvandum nos tua potius misericordia copiosa praevincat.
translation_en: Look upon us favorably, Lord, we entreat you; consider the affliction of your people and may our sins not prevail to our perdition, but rather may your abundant mercy prevail for our salvation.

text: Respice propitius Domine super haec munera quae et pro sanctorum tuorum commemoratione deferimus et pro nostris offensionibus immolamus.
translation_en: Look upon us favorably, Lord, regarding these offerings which we bring for the remembrance of your saints and for our own offenses that we sacrifice.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine ad preces famuli tui illius qui se tibi peccasse corde et mente graviter confitetur; praesta ut per oblationem tui corporis et sanguinis quam tibi pro ipso offerimus ei veniam impetrare valeamus.
translation_en: Look upon us, we beseech You, Lord, regarding the prayers of Your servant who gravely confesses that he has sinned in heart and mind towards You; grant that through the offering of Your body and blood which we offer for him, we may be able to obtain forgiveness for him.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine et peccatorum nostrorum tenebras averte ut quos exercet devotio sollemnitatis illustrent gaudia piae cognitionis.
translation_en: Look upon us, we beseech You, Lord, and turn away the darkness of our sins. May those who are exercised by devotion be enlightened by the joys of sacred understanding.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine munera quae in sancti Piati martyris tui sollemnitate deferimus ut cuius grata sunt meritis eius nobis intercessione salubria consistant.
translation_en: Look upon us, we beseech You, Lord, the gifts which on the solemnity of Your holy martyr Saint Pati we are offering. May they rest gratefully on account of his merits, and may our salvation be beneficial through his intercession.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine munera quae pro beati Andreae apostoli tui commemoratione deferimus suppliciter exorantes ut eius interventionibus adiuvemur pro cuius meritis immolantur.
translation_en: Look upon us, we beseech You, Lord, the offerings which we humbly present on the commemoration of Your apostle St. Andrew, that we may be helped by his intercessions through whose merits they are offered.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine nostram propitius servitutem ut quod offerimus sit tibi munus acceptum sit nostrae fragilitati subsidium.
translation_en: Look upon us, we beseech you, Lord, with favor, and regard your servant. May what we offer be a pleasing gift to you, and may it serve as support for our frailty.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine nostram propitius servitutem et haec oblatio nostra sit tibi munus acceptum sit fragilitati nostrae subsidium sempiternum.
translation_en: Look upon us graciously, Lord, our humble service, and let this offering of ours be for you an accepted gift, an eternal support for our frailty.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine oblationem nostram et omnium sanctorum consessorum tuorum precibus ab omnibus culpis nos dignanter absolve.
translation_en: Look upon us, we humbly ask, Lord, our offering and all the saints gathered before you. By your prayers free us worthy of all from every fault.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine populum tuum et quem aeternis dignatus es renovare mysteriis a temporalibus culpis dignanter absolve.
translation_en: Look upon us, Lord, we pray, your people and the one whom you have deemed worthy to renew through sacred mysteries, graciously forgive from temporal sins.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine preces nostras et his muneribus praesentiam tuae maiestatis intersere ut quod nostro servitio geritur te potius operante firmetur.
translation_en: Look upon us, we beseech You, Lord, and let Your presence be interposed by these gifts, so that what is being carried out in our service may be strengthened more through Your working.

text: Respice quaesumus Domine propitius ad humilitatis nostrae simplicem servitutem et intercedente beato Ioanne confessore tuo atque pontifice cuius translationem celebramus hostias quas in honorem eius sacris altaribus immolamus benignus assume.
translation_en: Look upon us, we beseech you, Lord, graciously towards our humble service of simplicity and, through the intercession of your blessed confessor John, bishop whose translation we celebrate, receive the offerings which we sacrifice on his honor to your holy altars benevolently.

text: Respice quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus munera quae pro veneratione beati Matthaei apostoli tui et evangelistae tuae offerimus maiestati et praesta ut cuius sollemnia his sacrificiis praevenimus eius suffragantibus meritis quae tibi sunt placita digno affectu ac devotis mentibus exsequamur.
translation_en: Look upon us, we beseech you, almighty and merciful God, the gifts which we offer for the veneration of your apostle St. Matthew and your evangelist, grant that through these sacrifices we may precede his feast day, and may we fulfill with a worthy affection and devout minds what pleases you according to his merits.

text: Respice subditam tibi Domine familiam tuam et cuius exaudire preces in maerore dignatus es <in> actione gratiarum propensius intuere.
translation_en: Look upon your family, Lord, who are subject to you, and whom you have deigned to hear prayers in sorrow. Bent more towards the act of giving thanks, behold them more closely.

text: Respiciat quaesumus clementia tua Domine Iesu munera servorum tuorum et gratiam tuae miserationis illis impende ut quae recta sunt in oculis tuis veraciter intellegant et fiducialiter loquantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord Jesus, that your kindness may look upon the offerings of your servants and bestow your grace upon them, so that what is right before your eyes they may truly understand and speak with faith.

text: Resurgente Christo resolutis inferni doloribus etiam nos Deus Pater omnipotens solutis peccatorum delectationibus resurgere concede propitius ut mortificationis nostrae sacrificium tibi principaliter offeramus.  Reconciliet te quaesumus Domine pro peccatoribus sanguis iusti et humilitas Domini nostri. Haec est hostia quae pependit in ligno; haec est caro quae resurrexit de sepulcro. Quod pro nobis obtulit sacerdos noster in veritate hoc conferimus in panis et vini suavitate.  Cognosce precamur omnipotens Deus victimam qua intercedente placatus es et suscipe in adoptionem quibus pater per gratiam factus es. Sit quoque Domine sanctificatio et benedictio tua defensio et mundatio nostra ut et peccatorum nobis veniam tribuas et praeceptis tuis semper oboedientes efficias.
translation_en:
Rising Christ, with the pains of hell vanquished, may God the Father Almighty also grant us to rise, graciously, from the pleasures of our sins. May He who reconciles us, we humbly ask, Lord, through the blood of the righteous and the humility of our Lord. This is the offering which hung on the tree; this is the flesh that rose from the tomb. What our priest offered for us in truth, we now confer upon you in the sweetness of bread and wine.
We pray, O Almighty God, to recognize the sacrifice which, through His intercession, You were appeased and received into adoption those whom You have made Father by grace. May Your sanctification and blessing be our defense and purification, so that You may grant us pardon for our sins, and make us always obedient to Your commandments.

text: Resurrectione Domini nostri Iesu Christi laetantes eiusque corporis et sanguinis mysterium celebrantes gratias referimus nomini tuo omnipotens Deus pater et petimus ut ita mortificemur ac consepeliamur cum crucifixo tuo ut credamus et sentiamus nos vivere etiam simul cum ipso.
translation_en: Rejoicing in the Resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ, we celebrate the mystery of his body and blood, and we offer thanks to your name, Almighty God, Father. And we ask that we may be so mortified and consecrated with your crucified one, that we may believe and feel that we live even with him.

text: Resuscita nos Domine a concupiscentiarum nostrarum sepulcris qui devicto diabolo resurrexisti triumphator a mortuis. Non in nobis patiaris perire bonorum tuorum notitiam quam dedisti qui in salute perditos excitasti; Constitue inter nos et inconvertibilem diabolum odium perfectum non quo nobis nocere te propitiante praevaleat sed quo agnitione tuae veritatis illuminatos supplantare ulterius valeat. Eumque ita malorum eius crescente fastigio relinquamus ne umquam ad vomitum nostrarum sordium redeamus. Illoque virtutis tuae vigore expulso ineradicabilem mentibus nostris dilectionis tuae infunde dulcedinem donec ad satietatem plenitudinis veniamus beatae.
translation_en: Revive us, Lord, from the tombs of our carnal desires, who, having conquered the devil, arose triumphant from the dead. Do not allow the knowledge of your good ones to perish in us, whom you raised up from perdition; Establish among us an invincible hatred towards the devil, not so that he may prevail over us when you are propitiated, but so that those illuminated by your truth may overcome him further. And thus, leaving the arrogance of his evil ones to grow no more, let us abandon him, lest we ever return to the vomit of our filth. In the power of your virtue, drive away from our minds the inextinguishable love for him, and pour into us the sweetness of your love until we come to fullness of blessed satisfaction.

text: Rex noster et Domine qui ex ore Theoduli infantuli martyris tui fecisti in laudem dum linguam eius concessisti esse disertam per donum gratiae qui adhuc plene fari non poterat per aetatem da in ore nostro et sapientiae canticum et petitionis effectum ut qui in hoc die martyris tui Romani has tibi hostias immolamus tam viventibus quam defunctis indulgentiam criminum impetremus.
translation_en: Our King and Lord, who through the mouth of Theodulph, the infant martyr, made his tongue eloquent by the gift of grace, which he could not fully use due to his age, grant us in our mouths the song and effect of wisdom and petition. On this day, we offer you, the Roman martyr's sacrifices, both living and dead, we implore mercy for our sins.

text: Rogamus etiam Domine pro anima famuli tui illius quem in pace dominica assumere dignatus es ut locum refrigerii teneat <et> vitae merita consequatur aeterna ibique eum statuere digneris ubi est omnium beatitudo iustorum et cum dies ille iudicii advenerit inter sanctos et electos tuos eum facias suscitare.
translation_en: We also ask, Lord, for the soul of your servant whom you were pleased to take from the peaceful domain. May he hold a place of refreshment and may he attain the rewards of life eternal there. Grant that you may establish him where all the happiness of just souls is, and on that day of judgment, among the saints and elect ones, may you cause him to be raised up.

text: Sacra Domine mensa nos vegetet et perpetuam pascat ad vitam.
translation_en: Lord, may Your sacred table nourish us and feed us forever for life.

text: Sacrae festivitatis nobis quaesumus Domine dona multiplica ut cum salutis nostrae vota recolimus et eorum qui tibi sunt placiti patrociniis adiuvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us the blessings of this sacred festival, that we may remember our vows for our salvation and be aided by the patronage of those who are pleasing to you.

text: Sacrae nobis quaesumus Domine mensae libatio et piae conversationis augmentum et tuae propitiationis continuum praestet auxilium.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, a sacred offering for our table and an increase of pious conversations, and may Thy aid in propitiation continue.

text: Sacrae nobis quaesumus Domine observationis ieiunia et piae conversationis augmentum et tuae propitiationis continuum praestent auxilium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us an increase in the observance of sacred duties and devout conversations, and a continuous help from your propitiation.

text: Sacramenta caelestia quae pro beati Barnabae apostoli tui passione Domine tuae obtulimus maiestati ipsius nobis quaesumus fiant intercessione salutaria in cuius natalicia sunt percepta.
translation_en: We offer to Your majesty the celestial sacraments on behalf of blessed Barnabas, your apostle, during his passion, Lord. We humbly ask that these become beneficial intercessions for us on the occasion of whose natalicia they were perceived.

text: Sacramenta Domine Deus quae sumpsimus beato Martino confessore tuo intercedente ab omni nos adversitate defendant et perpetua prosperitate tibi Deo soli servire concedant.
translation_en: Lord God, we have received the sacraments. Through the intercession of your blessed confessor Saint Martin, defend us from all adversity and grant us eternal prosperity to serve only you, God.

text: Sacramenta Domine quae percepimus ad aeternam nobis prosint redemptionem et sanctarum Perpetuae et Felicitatis interventio corroboret nos in tuo servitio.
translation_en: Lord, may the sacraments we have received bring us eternal redemption. The intervention of Saints Perpetua and Felicitas strengthens us in your service.

text: Sacramenta Domine quae pro martyrum tuorum illorum beata passione percepimus ipsorum nobis quaesumus fiant intercessione salutaria in quorum nataliciis sunt exsultanter impleta.
translation_en: Lord, we have received the sacraments on behalf of your martyrs who were blessed through their passionate suffering. We humbly ask that these sacraments become beneficial intercessions for us in whose feast days are exultantly filled.

text: Sacramenta nos quaesumus Domine tua sancta sumentes et ab omni propitius iniquitate et periculo defende.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to take our sacraments and graciously defend us from all unrighteousness and danger.

text: Sacramenta praesentia quaesumus Domine intercedente sancto Lamberto benigne sanctifica nosque a peccatorum nostrorum nexibus ipsius meritis pius absolve.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, with Saint Lambert's intercession, that you graciously sanctify us and absolve us from the bonds of our sins through his merciful merits.

text: Sacramenta quae indigni sumpsimus Domine nobis mentis et corporis fiant remedia et sancti pontificis tui Dunstani intercessio nos ad gaudia perducat caelestia.
translation_en: May the sacraments that we unworthily received, Lord, become a remedy for our mind and body. May the intercession of your holy bishop Dunstan lead us to the heavenly joys.

text: Sacramenta quae sumpsimus Domine beatae Mariae semper virginis intercessione nos salvent quae devotione sui cordis piissimi acceptabile tibi sacrificium iugiter immolavit.
translation_en: The sacraments that we have received, Lord, through the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary, save us. The devout offering of her most loving heart has continually presented an acceptable sacrifice to you.

text: Sacramenta quae sumpsimus Domine beati Stephani protomartyris tui intercessione nobis quaesumus fiant salutaria in cuius sacratissimi corporis inventione sunt supplici mente recepta.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, through the intercession of Your protomartyr Saint Stephen, that the sacraments we have received may be beneficial to us. We humbly receive them in commemoration of the discovery of his most sacred body.

text: Sacramenta quae sumpsimus Domine beati illius martyris tui atque pontificis intercessione nobis fiant salutaria in cuius commemoratione sunt impleta.
translation_en: The sacraments we have received, Lord, through the intercession of your blessed martyr and bishop, may become beneficial to us. In whose commemoration, they are fulfilled.

text: Sacramenta quae sumpsimus Domine per intercessionem sanctorum apostolorum martyrum et consessorum vel virginum tuarum quorum natalicia celebramus nobis proficiant ad salutem et famulis vel famulabus tuis quorum commemorationem agimus tribue refrigerium sempiternum <et> quibus donasti baptismi sacramentum in regione sanctorum iubeas dari consortium <regni caelestis> et plenitudinem gaudiorum.
translation_en: The sacraments we have received, Lord, through the intercession of your apostles, martyrs and consessors, or virgins whose feast days we celebrate, may they bring us to salvation. And to your servants or those who serve you whom we remember, grant eternal refreshment. To those whom you bestowed the sacrament of baptism in the region of the saints, grant them a share in the kingdom of heaven and the fullness of joy.

text: Sacramenta quae sumpsimus quaesumus Domine et spiritalibus nos expient alimentis et corporalibus tueantur auxiliis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to cleanse the sacraments we have received and protect us with spiritual nourishment, as well as physical aids.

text: Sacramenta quae sumpsimus Domine Deus noster et spiritalibus nos repleant alimentis et corporalibus tueantur auxiliis.
translation_en: The sacraments we have received, Lord God, may they fill us with spiritual food and protect us physically with your aid.

text: Sacramenta quaesumus Domine quae sumpsimus intercedentibus sanctis tuis Georgio Blasio Erasmo Pantaleone Vito Christophoro Dionysio Cyriaco Achatio Eustachio Aegidio Catherina Margaretha et Barbara nobis prosint adveniam et quorum petitionem clementer exaudisti eorum intervenientibus meritis in cunctis necessitatibus nostris nos refove miseratus auxilio et ab omni adversitate nos potenter custodi.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the sacraments we have received, through the intercession of your saints George, Blaise, Erasmus, Pantaleon, Vitus, Christopher, Dionysius, Cyril, Achatius, Eustachius, Giles, Margaret, Catherine, and Barbara, may be of benefit to us in our coming need, and that you hear their petition mercifully. May they intervene on our behalf with their merits in all our necessities. Have mercy on us and help us, and protect us powerfully from every adversity.

text: Sacramenta salutis nostrae suscipientes concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Martini nos ubique oratio adiuvet in cuius veneratione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: Receiving the Sacrament of our salvation, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the prayers of blessed Martin may assist us everywhere, whose veneration we have offered to your majesty in this offering.

text: Sacramenta salutis nostrae suscipientes tuam mitissime Deus misericordiam imploramus ut quorum gratulamur triumphis provocemur exemplis.
translation_en: Taking your most merciful Sacraments, we humbly implore you, God, that those for whom we rejoice in their triumphs may be inspired by their examples.

text: Sacramenta sumpta quaesumus Domine nostra detergant piacula et per sancti Augustini supplicationem adiuvent nos recte incedere inter mundanae conversationis pericula.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that the sacraments taken may cleanse our sins, and through the intercession of Saint Augustine, may help us walk righteously amidst the dangers of worldly life.

text: Sacramenta tua Domine nostra extergant piacula sanctique Augustini oratio nos adiuvet recte incedere inter omnia huius vitae pericula.
translation_en: Your sacraments, Lord, wash away our sins. The prayer of Saint Augustine may help us walk righteously among all the perils of this life.

text: Sacramenta tua Domine quae indigni percepimus et crimina nostra detergant et sancto intercedente Birino ab omni malo nos defendant.
translation_en: Your sacraments, Lord, which we unworthy ones have received, wash away our sins, and with the holy intercession of Birino defend us from all evil.

text: Sacramenti caelestis perceptio nos quaesumus Domine purificet et intercedente beata Dei Genitrice semperque virgine Maria ad aeternae felicitatis dona obtinenda dignos efficiat.
translation_en: Through the perception of the heavenly sacrament, we humbly ask you, Lord, to purify us. May the blessed Mother of God, ever-virgin Mary, intercede for us, and make us worthy to obtain the gifts of eternal happiness.

text: Sacramenti tui Domine divina libatio penetra(bi)lia nostri cordis infundat et sui participes potenter efficiat.
translation_en: May Your sacrament, Lord, pour down as a divine libation and penetrate our hearts, making us strong participants.

text: Sacramenti tui Domine munus quod tua gratia largiente percepimus omnium sanctorum meritis intervenientibus nobis ad aeternum remedium proficere sentiamus.
translation_en: We feel that through the grace of your gift, we have received the sacrament of yours, and with the merits of all saints interceding for us, we understand that it will lead us to eternal remedy.

text: Sacramenti tui Domine quaesumus sumpta benedictio corpora nostra mentesque sanctificet et perpetuae misericordiae nos praeparet adscribendos.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the blessing taken from Your Sacrament may sanctify our bodies and minds, and prepare us by Your eternal mercy to be enrolled.

text: Sacramenti tui Domine veneranda perceptio ab omnibus hos tueatur adversis et beati Eusebii confessoris tui precibus nobis indulgentiae semper sit causa et salutis.
translation_en: May the reverent perception of Your sacrament, Lord, protect us all from adversity, and through the prayers of Your confessor blessed Eusebius may we always have a cause for indulgence and salvation.

text: Sacramenti tui Domine veneranda perceptio et mystico nos mundet effectu et perpetua virtute defendat.
translation_en: Lord, through the venerable perception of your sacrament, may it cleanse us mysteriously and protect us with perpetual power.

text: Sacramenti tui quaesumus Domine participatio salutaris et purificationem nobis praebeat et medelam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your sacrament may grant us participation and salvation, and bestow upon us purification and healing.

text: Sacramenti quaesumus Domine participatio salutaris et tui exsecutio praecepti purificationem nobis praebeat et medelam.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the participation in the Sacrament may bestow upon us a healthful partaking and the execution of your precept may bring about purification for us, and healing.

text: Sacramenti tui munere vegetati quaesumus ut intercessione beati Thomae apostoli tui bonis quibus nunc per tuam gratiam fovemur perfruamur aeternis.
translation_en: We ask, by the power of your sacrament, that through the intercession of your blessed apostle Thomas, we may enjoy the eternal blessings which you now foster within us with your grace.

text: Sacramentis Domine et gaudiis optata celebritate expletis quaesumus ut eorum precibus adiuvemur quorum recordationibus exhibentur.
translation_en: Having completed the Sacraments, O Lord, and with the desired festival, we humbly ask that you assist us with the prayers of those whose memory is being honored.

text: Sacramentis Domine muniamur acceptis et sanctorum tuorum Marcelli et Apulei contra omnes nequitias irruentes armis caelestibus protegamur.
translation_en: Lord, let us be fortified by your sacraments, and protected under the shield of your saints Marcellus and Apuleius, against all assaults that storm in with celestial arms.

text: Sacramentis Domine refecti salutaribus gratias tibi referimus; reple quaesumus hoc templum tuae gloria maiestatis ut in honorem nominis tui fiat populo tuo domus orationis.
translation_en: In the name of the sacraments, Lord, we thank you for the salutary refreshment we have received; we humbly ask that You fill this temple with Your divine majesty, so that in honor of Your name, it becomes a house of prayer for Your people.

text: Sacramentis refecti caelestibus praesta quaesumus Domine ut a nostris mentibus carnales amoveat Spiritus Sanctus affectus et spiritalia nobis dona potenter infundat.
translation_en: By the sacred mysteries, we humbly ask you, Lord, that the Holy Spirit may remove carnal feelings from our minds and powerfully pour out spiritual gifts upon us.

text: Sacramentis tuis Domine repleti quaesumus ut sanctorum confessurum tuorum atque pontificum illorum quorum sollemnia agimus adiuti precibus tuis muneribus quibus in praesenti fovemur aeternis perfruamur.
translation_en: Filled with Your sacraments, we humbly ask that you aid us, so that we may confess the saints and bishops whose feast days we are celebrating, through your prayers and gifts. In this present life, we are nourished by them; in eternal life, we hope to be filled by them.

text: Sacramentis tuis quaesumus Domine intende placatus ut intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to pay attention with favor through your sacraments. May they, the holy martyrs interceding for us, advance our devotion and grant us salvation.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum benedictione satiati quaesumus Domine ut per haec semper emundemur a vitiis et periculis exuamur.
translation_en: Filled with the blessing of your sacraments, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through these (sacraments) we may always be purified from vices and freed from dangers.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum benedictione satiati quaesumus Domine ut per haec semper mundemur a vitiis.
translation_en: Filled with your blessings upon your sacraments, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through these we may always be purified from sin.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum Domine benedictione satiati et beatorum martyrum tuorum Fabiani et Sebastiani gloriosa confessione muniti te suppliciter exposcimus ut per haec a cunctis vitiis emundemur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly entreat You, being satiated with Your sacraments and fortified by the glorious confession of the blessed martyrs Fabian and Sebastian. We beseech You to cleanse us from all vices through these.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum Domine communio sumpta nos salvet et in tuae veritatis luce confirmet.
translation_en: Lord, the sharing of your sacraments saves us and confirms us in the light of your truth.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum Domine participatione laetantes suppliciter exoramus ut quorum merita celebrare condonas eorum nos facias imitari constantiam.
translation_en: Lord, joyfully participating in your sacraments, we humbly beseech you to grant that we may celebrate their merits and make us imitate their constancy.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum Domine participes effecti imploramus clementiam tuam ut beatae Caeciliae virginis tuae et martyris interventu peccatorum nostrorum veniam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: Having become partakers of your sacraments, Lord, we humbly ask for your clemency that through the intervention of your blessed virgin and martyr Caecilia, we may deserve forgiveness for our sins.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum Domine munere vegetati tuam supplices deprecamur clementiam ut quorum sollemnia praesentialiter agimus eorum meritis ad aeterna gaudia pervenire mereamur.
translation_en: Lord, nourished by the sacraments, we humbly entreat Your mercy. May we who celebrate their solemnities in Your presence merit to attain eternal joy through their merits.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum perceptio quaesumus Domine interveniente beato Apollinare martyre tuo salutem mentis et corporis nobis operetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the reception of your sacraments, with the intervention of your blessed martyr Saint Apollinaris, may bring health to our minds and bodies.

text: Sacramentorum tuorum quaesumus Domine perceptio et beatae Christinae virginis et martyris tuae intercessio vitae praesentis subsidium et aeternae vitae nobis obtineat praemium.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that through the perception of your sacraments and the intercession of the blessed Virgin and Martyr Christina, may the support for our present life and the reward for eternal life be granted to us.

text: Sacramentum absconditum a saeculis in Deo quod Gabriel archangelus de Maria virgine nasciturum edocuit et pro nostra salutari refectione nunc admirabili sacramento relatum vera fide percepimus quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria et Gabriele archangelo cum principatibus et potestatibus in caelestibus revelata eundem facie videre mereamur.
translation_en: The sacrament hidden from the ages in God, which Gabriel the archangel revealed about the birth of Mary the virgin, we now perceive through an admirable sacrament with true faith. We humbly ask, Lord our God, that, through the intercession of the blessed Mother of God and Gabriel the archangel, along with the principalities and powers in the heavens, the same may be revealed to us so that we may deserve to see it face-to-face.

text: Sacrandum tibi Domine munus offerimus quo beati Andreae sollemnia recolentes purificationem quoque nostris mentibus imploramus.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, a service that we dedicate in memory of the holy Andrew's feast. Furthermore, we also ask for purification in our minds.

text: Sacrarum virginum excolentes sollemnia haec tibi Domine offerimus holocausta tuam postulantes clementiam ut qui saeptus virginum choris inter lilia pascis super haec libamina spiritum tuae dirigas sanctitatis ut quod a nobis ob honorem virginum tuarum acceperis hoc nobis sumendum ad nostrorum criminum indulgentiam largiaris.
translation_en: We present to You, Lord, these festivities of the sacred virgins as holocausts, requesting Your mercy. For, enclosed within choruses of virgins, You graze among lilies. Upon these offerings of our spirits, direct Your sanctity so that what we receive from You in honor of Your virgin saints may be granted to us for the remission of our sins.

text: Sacrata Deo pro se suisque deferentibus dona sanctorumque martyrum invocantibus suffragia adsit virtus immensa iugisque clementia.
