translation_en: Let immense virtue and gentle clemency be present to aid the gifts offered to God on behalf of themselves and those who invoke the supplications of the holy martyrs.

text: Sacratam mysteriis caelestibus sedem in natali beatissimorum martyrum ad obsequium sacrae sollemnitatis ingressi laudemus dominum in sanctis eius eumque in beatissimorum confessurum ac testium honorem veneremur agentes ei gratias pro omnium nostrorum salute atque tutela indefessam eius misericordiam deprecantes ut spiritibus carorum nostrorum opem misericordiae caelestis impertiat et nobis adversus insidias diaboli in huius mundi agone certantibus divinae maiestatis suae praesidia largiatur <et> sanctorum suorum interventu atque suffragio nostrae devotionis obsequia accepta ferre dignetur.
translation_en: Entering the sacred seat of celestial mysteries on the birthday of the blessed martyrs, we praise the Lord in his saints and honor Him as well as those who are most confessed and testified to. We pay Him thanks for our safety and protection without ceasing, we implore His unending mercy. We ask that He bestow the aid of celestial mercy upon our spirits and grant us His divine protection against the craftiness of the devil in this world's contest, where we are striving. Moreover, we hope that with the intervention and support of His saints, our devotion will be accepted and He will deign to strengthen us.

text: Sacratissimam Domine beatae Mariae Magdalenae qua caelos subiit celebritatem recensentes supplices imploramus clementiam tuam ut qui eius devotionis recolimus insignia ipsius mereamur compotes effici gloriae.
translation_en: Most gracious Lord, we humbly beseech you for the blessing of the most blessed Mary Magdalene, who recently ascended into heaven, that we, recalling the signs of her devotion, may merit to obtain rewards of glory through your clemency.

text: Sacratissimum Domine quaesumus sancti martyris tui Symphoriani diem annua sollemnitate venerantes ab omni creatura tremendo ab omni humilitate venerando misericordiam tuam deprecamur ut sicut ille toto voto martyrium te adiuvante gaudens suscepit ita nos temporalia gaudia voluntatem et aeternam misericordiam consequamur.
translation_en: Most Holy Lord, we humbly ask you on the day of annual solemnity in honor of your holy martyr Symphorian, revered by all creation with trembling and humility. We beseech Your mercy that just as he, with Your help, joyfully received martyrdom in its entirety, so may we obtain both temporal joys and eternal mercy, following his will.

text: Sacri altaris participatione refecti tuam Domine misericordiam suppliciter exoramus ut qui haec in beatae Fidis virginis et martyris tuae veneratione percepimus eius nos confoveri suffragiis sentiamus.
translation_en: Having partaken in the sacred mysteries of the altar, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that just as we have received strength through the veneration of your blessed Virgin and martyr, so may we feel the support of her intercessions.

text: Sacri corporis Domini nostri repleti libamine et pretioso inebriati sanguine quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut per intercessionem sancti praesulis Erkenwaldi tribuas nobis nostrorum absolutionem peccaminum et aeternae beatitudinis praemium sempiternum.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord our God, to fill us with the sacred body of our Lord and to make us drunk with its precious blood through the intercession of Saint Bishop Erkenwald. Grant us, we implore, forgiveness for our sins and the eternal reward of everlasting beatitude.

text: Sacri corporis et pretiosi sanguinis tui libamen sumentes quaesumus clementiam tuam ut intercedente beato propheta tuo Daniele per hospitium in te nos manere facias recte vivendo et te in nobis manifestes semper solatium exhibendo.
translation_en: Taking as our offering the sacred body and precious blood of yours, we humbly ask for your clemency. Through the intercession of the blessed prophet Daniel, may you grant us the ability to dwell in you righteously and always show us consolation by manifesting yourself within us.

text: Sacri corporis et sanguinis pretiosi renovati libamine quaesumus Domine clementiam tuam ut quod frequenti devotione gerimus certa redemptione capiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, with this book of the sacred body and precious blood, that you grant us your mercy, so that what we hold with frequent devotion, we may obtain with certain redemption.

text: Sacri libaminis nos quaesumus Domine Deus noster intercessione sanctorum martyrum tuorum Timothei et Apollinaris effice participes quorum patrocinia recolimus acta gaudentes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, through the intercession of your saintly martyrs Timothy and Apollinaris, make us partakers of their deeds, whose patronage we recall with joy while celebrating their acts.

text: Sacri nos Domine muneris operatio mundet et foveat renovet et donis societ sempiternis.
translation_en: Lord, may Your sacred office cleanse, nurture, renew and establish us in eternal gifts.

text: Sacrificia Domine ob beatae Dei Genitricis semperque virginis Mariae honorem deferimus; praesta quaesumus ut eius intercessione tibi fieri hostia acceptabilis mereatur.
translation_en: We offer sacrifices, Lord, in honor of the blessed Mother of God and always a Virgin Mary; we humbly ask that through her intercession, you may be worthy to receive an acceptable offering.

text: Sacrificia Domine paschalibus gaudiis immolamus quibus Ecclesia tua mirabiliter renascitur et nutritur.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, the Paschal sacrifices with joyous feelings, by which Your Church marvelously is reborn and nourished.

text: Sacrificia Domine paschalibus gaudiis immolamus quibus Ecclesia tua mirabiliter pascitur et nutritur.
translation_en: We offer, Lord, the Paschal sacrifices with joyous feasts, by which Your Church is wonderfully nourished and sustained.

text: Sacrificia Domine paschalibus gaudiis immolamus quibus Ecclesia mirabiliter et nascitur et nutritur.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, the Paschal sacrifices with joyous celebration, by which the Church is wonderfully both born and nourished.

text: Sacrificia Domine propensius ista nos salvent quae medicinalibus sunt instituta ieiuniis.
translation_en: These sacrifices, Lord, save us more favorably, which have been established by means of medicinal fasts.

text: Sacrificia Domine propensius ista restaurent quae medicinalibus sunt instituta ieiuniis.
translation_en: Lord, may these sacrifices be restored that were established by medicinal fasts.

text: Sacrificia Domine tibi cum ecclesiae precibus immolanda quaesumus corda nostra purificent et indulgentiae tuae nobis dona concilient et de adversis prospera sentire perficiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the sacrifices be offered to you together with the prayers of the church may purify our hearts and grant us your indulgence. May they also bring about a sense of good fortune from adversities.

text: Sacrificia Domine tibi laudis offerimus beati apostoli tui Matthiae sollemnia recolentes ut in eius sortis collegio gratia tua opitulante purificatis mentibus inveniri mereamur.
translation_en: We present sacrifices to You, Lord, offerings of praise for Your blessed apostle Matthew, remembering his solemnities, that in his congregation, with Your grace helping us, we may be found worthy by purifying our minds.

text: Sacrificia Domine tuis oblata conspectibus ignis ille divinus absumat qui discipulorum Christi tui per sanctum spiritum corda succendit.
translation_en: Lord, may Your offerings be accepted before Your eyes; let that divine Fire consume them, who by the Holy Spirit kindles the hearts of Your disciples, the followers of Christ.

text: Sacrificia haec Domine ad salutem nostram tibi grata reddantur et sancto Iudoco interveniente corda nostra holocausta idonea tibi efficiantur.
translation_en: May these sacrifices, Lord, be pleasing to you for our salvation. And with the holy Judas intervening, may our hearts become fitting offerings to you.

text: Sacrificia ista tibi vero aeternoque pontifici Domine oblata tu sanctifica et sanctis tuis exorantibus ita nos fac haec tractare mysteria ut ipsi tibi et templum et hostia esse mereamur.
translation_en: These sacrifices, Lord, eternal priest, are offered to you; may you sanctify them and your sanctified ones who ask on our behalf. May it be so that we handle these mysteries in such a way that we ourselves, as well as the temple and the offering, become worthy of you.

text: Sacrificia nos Domine celebranda purificent et caelestibus imbuant institutis.
translation_en: May the Sacrifices, Lord, make us worthy to celebrate and imbue us with heavenly institutions.

text: Sacrificia nos Domine immaculata purificent et mentibus nostris supernae gratiae dent vigorem.
translation_en: Lord, may our sacrifices cleanse us immaculately and grant our minds strength from heavenly grace.

text: Sacrificia quae offerimus pro salute famulorum famularumque tuarum illarum accepta tibi sint omnipotens Deus ut omnium delictorum suorum veniam consequi mereantur.
translation_en: The sacrifices that we offer for the health of your servants and their servants may be accepted by Almighty God, so that they may merit forgiveness for all their sins.

text: Sacrificia quae sumpsimus Domine Iesu Christe transfixionem matris tuae et virginis devote celebrantes nobis impetrent apud tuam clementiam omnis boni salutarem effectum.
translation_en: The sacrifices which we have received, Lord Jesus Christ, devotedly celebrating the piercing of your mother and Virgin, may pray for us at your mercifulness and bring about every beneficial outcome.

text: Sacrificia quae sumpsimus Domine pro sollemnitate sancti pontificis tui Nicolai sempiterna nos proiectione confirment.
translation_en: The sacrifices which we have taken, Lord, for the solemnity of your bishop Nicholas, may they confirm us forever by eternal protection.

text: Sacrificia tibi Domine veneranda probati martyris tui Leudegarii passione suppliciter immolamus ut eius orationibus placeant pro cuius meritis offeruntur; praesta quaesumus ut sicut eius tibi grata <sunt> merita sic nostrae servitutis accepta reddantur officia.
translation_en: We humbly offer you, Lord, the worthy sacrifices of your venerable martyr Leudegar, who was offered in passion. We pray that his prayers be favorable for us, as his merits are acceptable before you; grant us, we beseech you, that just as his merits are pleasing to you, so our service may be accepted and the duties owed be returned.

text: Sacrificia tua Domine quaesumus corda nostra purificent et intercedente sancto levita Stephano remedia nobis obtineant sempiterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your sacrifices may purify our hearts and through the intercession of the saintly Levite Stephen, obtain for us everlasting remedies.

text: Sacrificii praesentis quaeso Domine oblatio mea expurget facinora per quod totius mundi voluisti relaxari peccata illiusque frequentatione efficiat dignus quod ut frequentarem suscepi indignus.
translation_en: In this present sacrifice, I humbly ask, Lord, may my offering purge my sins, for it was Your will to release the sins of the entire world. May participation in it make me worthy, who received it unworthy to participate.

text: Sacrificii praesentis oblationem quaesumus Domine beati regis Edwardi pia commendet intercessio ut in cuius veneratione suscipitur ipso interveniente gaudia aeterna suscipi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the offering of this present sacrifice be commended by the pious intercession of the blessed King Edward. May we deserve eternal joys, as we are received in his veneration, with his intervention.

text: Sacrificii tui Domine servimus effectibus; et nos expiari et tua nos confidimus remedia promereri.
translation_en: We serve your sacrifice, Lord; and we trust in you to grant us the means for atonement and promise your remedies for us.

text: Sacrificii tui nos Domine ab omni malo defendat perceptio et beati Bedae confessoris tui atque presbyteri nos tibi iugiter commendet oratio.
translation_en: May Your sacrifice, Lord, protect us from every evil. Through the intercession and prayers of your blessed confessioner and priest, St. Benedict, may it be everlastingly offered to You.

text: Sacrificiis Domine placatus oblatis opem tuam nostris temporibus clementer impende.
translation_en: Lord, pleased with the offerings presented, graciously bestow your help upon our times.

text: Sacrificiis praesentibus Domine quaesumus intende placatus ut et devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask with sacrifices present, may you incline your favorable regard towards us. May it benefit our devotion and promote our salvation.

text: Sacrificiis quaesumus Domine placare oblatis et supplicante pro nobis beato praesule et martyre tuo Blasio per haec ab omnibus inimicorum nostrorum liberemur insidiis.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you may be pleased with the sacrifices offered and that through your blessed bishop and martyr, Blasius, we may be freed from all the plots of our enemies.

text: Sacrificiis quaesumus Domine salutaribus his diebus aptemur propensius quibus illud est mysterium celebrandum cui servit omnis exsecutio mandatorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, on these days may we be more fitting for the sacrifices; for it is the mystery that is to be celebrated to which every execution of commands serves.

text: Sacrificium deferimus de perceptione tuorum Domine praestitorum ut percipienda securius uberiusque sumamus.
translation_en: We offer the sacrifice to You, Lord, from the offerings of Your servants, so that we may securely and more abundantly receive what is offered.

text: Sacrificium laudis de perceptione tuorum Domine deferimus praesidiorum quaesumus ut percipienda securius veriusque sumamus.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, a sacrifice of praise from the perception of Your gifts. We humbly ask that we may more securely and truly perceive them as defended by Your protection.

text: Sacrificium Domine celebramus quod ita nobis debet esse perpetuum sicut nos eius opere fieri iugiter desideramus aeternum.
translation_en: We celebrate, Lord, the Sacrifice which ought to be everlasting for us, just as we constantly desire to be made eternal through His work.

text: Sacrificium Domine hoc quod tibi offerimus placatus intende et famulum tuum illum ex adversa valitudine corporis sui laborantem placatus respice et visita in salutari tuo et caelestis gratiae concede medicinam.
translation_en: Lord, this sacrifice that we offer to you, please incline your favor towards it. And as for your servant, who is struggling with adversity due to his body's infirmity, may your favor look upon him and visit him in your healing and grant him salvation through celestial grace.

text: Sacrificium Domine observantiae paschalis exserimus; praesta quaesumus ut tibi et mentes nostras reddat acceptas (et continentiae promptioris nobis tribuat facultatem).
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the Paschal Sacrifice; we humbly ask that You grant that both our minds are accepted by You, and may You also bestow upon us the ability for a more prompt continence.

text: Sacrificium Domine pro Filii tui supplices venerabili nunc adscensione deferimus; praesta quaesumus ut et nos per ipsum his commerciis sacrosanctis ad caelestia consurgamus.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, a sacrifice for Your Son on this worthy ascent; we humbly ask that through it we may rise to heavenly things with sacred transactions.

text: Sacrificium Domine quadragesimalis initii sollemniter immolamus te Domine deprecantes ut cum epularum restrictione carnalium a noxiis quoque voluptatibus temperemus.
translation_en: We solemnly offer the Lenten sacrifice, Lord, praying that with the restraint of earthly feasting we may also moderate ourselves from worldly pleasures.

text: Sacrificium Domine quaesumus nostrum ipsa tibi sit actione placabile cui praesenti mysterio dominicae passionis de cuius est germine procreata beati Cypriani sacerdotis et martyris mors praeclara subiungitur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that our sacrifice be pleasing to you through the action presented before you of the mystery of the Lord's Passion, from which blessed Cyprian, priest and martyr, was born, whose death is added as a shining glory.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod ad laudem et honorem nominis tui deferimus intercedentibus meritis beatae Barbarae virginis et martyris tuae placatus suscipe et suis sanctissimis precibus a nostrorum peccatorum nos vinculis absolve.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, which we bring for the praise and honor of your name, through the merits of the blessed Barbarus, virgin and martyr, may you be pleased to receive it. Through their most holy prayers, may you forgive us, sinners, and free us from our sins.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod desideranter offerimus gratum tibi beatus ille suffragator efficiat.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, which we eagerly offer, may it be pleasing to you; may the blessed intercessor effectively make it so.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod immolamus intende ut ab omni nos exuat bellorum nequitia et in tuae protectionis securitate constituat.
translation_en: Lord, regard the sacrifice that we offer. May you deliver us from all the wickedness of war and establish us in the safety of your protection.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod immolamus propitiatus intende ut ab omni nos bellorum exuat nequitia et in tuae protectionis securitate constituat et famulum tuum regem nostrum coniugem prolemque ac populum sibi commissum et a peccatis absolve et ab hostium visibilium vel invisibilium insidiis tutum atque securum effice.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, which we offer, may You pay attention to it as propitiated, so that from every war You free us, that nefariousness be removed and in the safety of Your protection established. May You absolve Your servant, our king, his spouse, offspring, and people entrusted to him, and make them secure from sins and safe from any visible or invisible plots.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod immolamus placatus intende ut ab omni nos exuat bellorum nequitia et per vexillum sanctae crucis Filii tui ad conterendas potestatis adversariorum insidias nos in tuae protectionis securitate constituat.
translation_en: Lord, we offer this sacrifice with a favorable ear, may You listen and free us from all the wickedness of war. Through the standard of the holy cross of Your Son, set us in the security of Your protective power against the deceitful plots of our adversaries.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod pro sanctis martyribus Gervasio et Protasio praevenit nostra devotio eorum merito nobis augeat te donante suffragium.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, which precedes our devotion for the holy martyrs Gervasius and Protasius, may through their merits be increased upon us, you granting them your support.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod pro sancti illius confessoris tui atque abbatis sollemnitate deferimus tibi quaesumus fiat acceptum et eius intervenientibus meritis nobis augeat te donante suffragium.
translation_en: Sacrifice, Lord, which we offer for the feast of your holy confessor and abbot, we ask that you accept it. May his merits intercede for us, as you grant us your support.

text: Sacrificium Domine quod tuae offerimus maiestati propitius respice et concede ut his pro quibus hoc tibi offertur tam ad praesentem quam etiam ad futuram proficiat prosperitatem.
translation_en: Lord, may this sacrifice that we offer to your majesty be favorably regarded. Grant that it may bring success not only in the present, but also in the future, for those for whom it is offered on your behalf.

text: Sacrificium laudis in honorem et gloriam tui sancti nominis praeclarae Domine tuae offerimus maiestati pro commemoratione et reverentia sancti Cucufatis martyris tui qui nullis illecebris corporalium voluptatum nullis promissis blandimentorum fallacium nullo genere tormentorum a tua potuit separari dilectione. Quapropter te reclamando effici tibi meruit sacrificium laudis. Cuius pretiosa oratio quaesumus per haec sacrosancta nostrae redemptionis commercia nobis peccatorum omnium obtineat veniam et sempiternae gloriae praemium assequendum.
translation_en: We offer to Your majesty, Lord, the sacrifice of praise in honor and glory of Your holy name, which is excellent. We offer this in remembrance and reverence for Your saint martyr Cucufatus, who could not be separated from Your love by any bodily pleasures, promises of flattery, or any kind of torment. Therefore, we call upon You to make it worthy of the sacrifice of praise. May this precious prayer through these sacred transactions of our redemption obtain for us forgiveness for all sins and the reward of eternal glory.

text: Sacrificium nostrae paenitudinis ieiunantes Domine tibi persolvimus obsecrantes ut eius virtute muniti semper ad caeleste convivium festinemus.
translation_en: We offer the sacrifice of our repentance, fasting before you, Lord. We humbly ask that, strengthened by its power, we may always hasten towards the celestial banquet.

text: Sacrificium nostrae salutis in honorem beatissimae virginis Mariae tibi Christe immolantes supplices deprecamur ut veneranda eius compassio quam recolimus nos meritorum suorum suique filii misericorditer dignos efficiat.
translation_en: We offer you, Christ, the sacrifice for our salvation in honor of the most blessed Virgin Mary. Humbly we entreat you, that her venerable compassion, which we remember, may mercifully deem us worthy because of her merits and her Son's mercy.

text: Sacrificium nostrum quaesumus Domine benignus intende quo sicut beati Anthonii precibus cruciatus temporales sanare non desinis ita erui misericorditer impetremus ab aeternis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to incline favorably towards our sacrifice. Just as the prayers of Saint Anthony healed temporal afflictions, so mercifully we implore that you free us from eternal ones.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi Domine quaesumus beati Andreae precatio sancta conciliet ut cuius honore sollemniter exhibetur meritis efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the holy petition of blessed Andrew may unite our sacrifice to you, so that it may be made acceptable through the merits of him in whose honor it is solemnly offered.

text: Sacrificium nostrum tibi Domine quaesumus sancti patris nostri Ethelwoldi episcopi commendet oratio ut nobis eo suffragante fiat maiestatis tuae propitiatio et peccatorum nostrorum exoptata remissio.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that our sacrifice be committed to You by the prayer of our holy father Bishop Ethelwold. May he, while interceding for us, make Your majesty propitious towards us and grant us the hoped-for forgiveness of our sins.

text: Sacrificium oblatum quaesumus Domine intercessio beatae virginis tuae Waldpurgae tuae maiestati reddat acceptum pro cuius veneranda commemoratione tibi devoto defertur obsequio.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the sacrifice offered may find favor with your majesty through the intercession of your blessed virgin Waldpurga. May it be accepted for him whose venerable commemoration is devotedly brought before you in obedience.

text: Sacrificium quod tibi Domine sanctorum martyrum tuorum illorum natalicia praecurrentes offerimus quaesumus ut eorum meritis nostrarum apud te supplicationum obtineat effectum
translation_en: We present the sacrifice to you, Lord, of the saints and martyrs whose feast days are coming before them. We humbly ask that through their merits, our prayers find favor with you.

text: Sacrificium quod tuae Domine Deus obtulimus pietati nobis ad veniam nostrorum proficiat peccatorum et tuae miserationis semper tribuat solatium.
translation_en: The sacrifice which we, Lord God, have offered to your pity may profit for our forgiveness of sins and may always grant the comfort of your mercy.

text: Sacrificium quod tuae offerimus maiestati clementissime Deus placatus suscipe et per merita beatae Petronillae gloriosae virginis tuae praesentis vitae subsidium et futurae felicitatem concede.
translation_en: The sacrifice which we offer to your most merciful majesty, God, pleased to receive, take it and through the merits of blessed Petronilla, your glorious virgin, grant aid in this present life and grant happiness for the future.

text: Sacrificium quod tuae offerimus omnipotentiae Deus clementissime gratanter suscipe et per merita sacrae virginis Sexburgae cuius annuam celebramus sollemnitatem concede nobis huius vitae iugem et caelestis felicitatem.
translation_en: Accept graciously, most merciful God Almighty, the sacrifice that we offer to You, and through the merits of the holy virgin Sexburga whose annual feast we celebrate, grant us a crown for this life and happiness in heaven.

text: Sacrificium salutis nostrae tibi Domine Deus noster offerentes quaesumus ut concedas nobis purificatis mentibus semper tuae pietatis celebrare mysterium.
translation_en: We present to you, Lord our God, the sacrifice of our salvation. We humbly ask that you grant us, with pure minds, always to celebrate your mystery with the reverence of your piety.

text: Sacrificium salutis nostrae tibi offerentes concede nobis Domine Deus purificatis mentibus saepius tuae pietatis celebrare mysterium.
translation_en: Offering the Sacrifice of our Salvation, we ask you, Lord God, grant us that with cleansed minds more often we may celebrate the mystery of your pity.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine celebrandum placatus intende quod et nos a vitiis nostrae condicionis emundet et tuo nomini reddat acceptos.
translation_en: Lord, with pleasing sacrifice attend to what we offer, that it may cleanse us from our wickedness and make our offering acceptable to Your name.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine fidelium tuorum votis oblatum serenus admitte ut quod dilecto martyri tuo Stephano hodiernam inventionis suae contulit gloriam nobis ad redemptionem prosit aeternam.
translation_en: Accept, Lord, the sacrifice offered by Your faithful ones with sincere vows, that what today's discovery of Your beloved martyr Stephen bestowed upon us in glory may bring eternal redemption to us.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine laudis offerimus pro sancti celebritate Clementis ut propitiationem tuam quam nostris operibus non meremur pii suffragatoris intercessionibus assequamur.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the sacrifice of praise for the holy festivity of Clement, that through the intercessions of our devoted advocate we may obtain Your propitiation which our works do not merit.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine laudis offerimus in venerabilium commemoratione sanctorum; da quaesumus ut quod illis contulit gloriam nobis prosit ad salutem.
translation_en: We offer You, Lord, a sacrifice of praise in the venerable remembrance of the saints; grant us that what brought them glory may benefit us for our salvation.

text: Sacrificium laudis tibi Domine offerimus in tuorum commemoratione sanctorum; da quaesumus ut quod illis contulit gloriam nobis prosit ad salutem.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, a sacrifice of praise in the remembrance of your saints; grant us that what brought them glory may also benefit us for our salvation.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine laudis offerimus in tuorum commemoratione sanctorum; da quaesumus ut quod illis contulit gloriam nobis prosit ad salutem.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, a sacrifice of praise in the remembrance of Your saints; grant us, we pray, that what it brought them glory may profit us for our salvation.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine nostrae servitutis offerimus quod ad honorem nominis tui in sanctae martyris Euphemiae festivitate debemus.
translation_en: We offer you, Lord, the sacrifice of our servitude, which is due on the festival day of the holy martyr Euphemia for the honor of your name.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine placationis et laudis offerimus suppliciter exorantes ut beati confessoris et martyris tui Aelfegi continua nos adiuvent suffragia cuius annua celebramus sollemnia.
translation_en: We offer to You, Lord, the sacrifice of propitiation and praise humbly entreating, that the blessed confessor and martyr of Yours, Alfege, may continually assist us with their intercession, whose annual feast days we solemnly celebrate.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine placationis in hac beatissimi Stephani levitae sollemnitate deferimus cuius nos precibus haec redemptionis nostrae suffragia et intellegere quaesumus concedas et assequi.
translation_en: We offer this sacrifice to you, Lord, on the solemnity of the blessed Stephen the Levite, that through his intercession we may obtain and understand the prayers for our redemption. Grant and fulfill our request.

text: Sacrificium tibi Domine pro sanctorum martyrum nataliciis immolamus ut quorum gaudemus praesidiis gloriam frequentamus.
translation_en: We offer sacrifice to you, Lord, on the birthday of the holy martyrs, so that we may enjoy their protection and frequently experience their glory.

text: Sacris altaribus assistentes nos Domine quaesumus Spiritus Sancti luce perfunde ut quod tibi in honorem beati regis Edwardi devote offerimus nobis ipso interveniente fiat remedium salutare.
translation_en: Standing before the sacred altars, we humbly ask you, Lord. Pour upon us the light of the Holy Spirit so that what we devoutly offer to you in honor of Blessed King Edward may become a saving remedy for us, with his intervention.

text: Sacris altaribus Domine hostias superpositas sanctus Benedictus quaesumus in salutem nobis provenire deposcat.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your blessed Saint may cause the offerings placed upon the sacred altars to come for our salvation.

text: Sacris caelestibus Domine vitia nostra purgentur ut muneribus tuis possimus semper aptari.
translation_en: Lord, may our faults be purged by the heavenly sacraments, so that we may always be fit for your gifts.

text: Sacris Domine muneribus vegetati quaesumus ut famulum tuum illum in infirmitate laborantem spe suturae beatitudinis relevare digneris.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech You, nourished by sacred duties, that You may deign to raise up Your servant, who is laboring in infirmity, with the hope of the sewing of beatitude.

text: Sacris Domine mysteriis expiati et veniam consequamur et gratiam.
translation_en: Lord, by the sacred mysteries we are purified, and we obtain forgiveness and grace.

text: Sacris Domine repleti muneribus quaesumus ut intercedente pro nobis beatissimo praesule tuo Syro in gratiarum semper actione maneamus.
translation_en: Lord, filled with sacred duties, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your blessed bishop in Syria, we may always remain in your gratitude.

text: Sacris muneribus Domine perceptis quaesumus ut nos eorum virtute et a vitiis omnibus expies et donis tuae gratiae iugiter repleas.
translation_en: Having received the sacred duties, Lord, we humbly ask that through their virtue you cleanse us from all vices and continually fill us with your grace.

text: Sacris muneribus sumptis tuam Domine misericordiam humiliter exoramus ut beati Damasi confessoris tui intercessione muniti sempiterna mereamur felicitate gratulari.
translation_en: With the costs of sacred duties borne, we humbly entreat you, Lord, that with the intervention of your blessed confessor, St. Damasus, we may merit eternal happiness to rejoice in everlasting bliss.

text: Sacris nos Domine quaesumus servitiis fac intentos et ut sine ulla tibi offensionis macula famulemur quales esse praecipis ipse nos perfice.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you make us devoted to your sacred services and that we may serve you without any stain of offense. May you yourself mold us into the likeness that you prescribe for us.

text: Sacris reparati mysteriis suppliciter exoramus ut intervenientibus sanctis tuis apprehendamus rebus quod actionibus celebramus.
translation_en: With humble supplication, we beseech the sacred mysteries that, with your saints present, we may attain what we celebrate in our actions.

text: Sacro munere satiati quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut interveniente beato Symphoriano martyre tuo omnes nos sanctorum tuorum iubeas adscisci collegio.
translation_en: Filled with the sacred ministry, we humbly ask the Almighty God that with the intervention of your blessed martyr Symphorian, you may command us to be joined to the college of all your saints.

text: Sacro munere satiati supplices te Domine deprecamur ut quod debitae servitutis celebramus officio salvationis tuae sentiamus augmentum.
translation_en: Filled with the sacred office, we humbly beseech You, Lord, that as we perform the duties of our debted service, we may feel an increase in Your salvation.

text: Sacro munere satiati te Domine suppliciter deprecamur ut quem nunc sub sacramento coepta fide cognoscimus intercedente beato David confessore tuo atque pontifice clara visione in caelis facie ad faciem videamus.
translation_en: Having been satisfied with the sacred ministry, we humbly entreat you, Lord, that as we now know him under the sacrament begun in faith, through the intercession of the blessed David, your confessor and bishop, who enjoys clear vision in heaven, we may behold his face to face.

text: Sacro munere vegetatos sanctorum martyrum Cornelii et Cypriani natalicia nos tibi Domine quaesumus commendet oratio.
translation_en: On this sacred duty, we humbly ask you, Lord, that the feast days of the holy martyrs Cornelius and Cyprian may be recommended to you by prayer.

text: Sacrosancta Domine sumentes mysteria amissam quaesumus nobis reconcilient gratiam atque munus patientiae in illatis omnibus semper et ubique protegendo impertiant.
translation_en: Most Holy Lord, receiving the lost mystery we humbly ask that You grant us reconciliation and bestow upon us the gift of patience always and everywhere. Protecting us, may You command it.

text: Sacrosancta mysteria quae sumpsimus Domine ad honorem complacentissimi nominis Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi devotis praecordiis recolentes quaesumus ut incrementa spiritualis exsultationis nobis accumulent et affectum nostrum ad hoc salutiferum nobis nomen Iesu iugiter imprimendum accendant et ad iubilandum in Iesu salutari nostro dulcissimo totius mentis intentionem promoveant.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, for the sacred mysteries that we have received, reflecting on them with devoted hearts, honoring Your most gracious Son, Our Lord Jesus Christ. May these increase our spiritual exultation and always stir our affection towards the name of Jesus, which is beneficial to us. Furthermore, may they direct our entire mind's intention to joyfully praise in our sweet Savior, Jesus.

text: Sacrosancti corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi refectione vegetati supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut haec salutaria sacramenta famulum tuum illum precibus sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae ab omni vinculo iniquitatis absolvant et quidquid in eius mente vitiosum est eorum medicationis dono curetur; fidei quoque spei caritatisque gemmis ornatum aeternae felicitatis participem efficiant.
translation_en: Most merciful God, we humbly ask you to grant that the sacred mysteries of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ nourished by refreshment, may absolve your servant from every bond of iniquity through the prayers of the holy Mother of God, Mary, and may heal whatever is sinful within his heart with the gift of your medicine. May these precious gems of faith, hope, and charity adorn him as a participant of eternal happiness.

text: Sacrosancti corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi refectione vegetatus supplex te rogo omnipotens Deus ut haec salutaria sacramenta me ab omni vinculo iniquitatis absolvant et quidquid in mea mente vitiosum est eorum medicationis dono curetur.
translation_en: I humbly ask you, almighty God, that the sacred mysteries of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, which I have received, may free me from every bond of iniquity and heal whatever in my mind is tainted with sin through their gracious gift.

text: Sacrosancti corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi refectione vegetati supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut hoc remedio singulari ab omnium peccatorum nos contagione purifices et a periculorum munias incursione cunctorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, all-powerful God, that by the sacred refreshment of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, you purify us from the contagion of all sins and protect us from the onset of every danger.

text: Sacrosancti corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi refectione vegetati supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut hoc remedium singulare ab omnium peccatorum nos contagione purificet.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God, on behalf of the sacred body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is nourished by this refreshment, that this singular remedy may purify us from the contagion of all sins.

text: Sacrosancti corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi refectione vegetati supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut hoc remedio singulari et salutari famulum tuum regem nostrum coniugem et prolem populumque sibi subiectum et ab omnium purifices contagione peccatorum et a cunctorum munias incursione periculorum.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Almighty God, to purify and protect Your servant, our king, queen, children, subjects, and the whole people under their rule with this unique and salutary refreshment of the Sacred Body and Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ. Cleanse them from the contagion of sins and shield them against any danger that may befall them from all sides.

text: Sacrosancti corporis et sanguinis Filii tui perceptione vegetati supplices exoramus Pater omnipotens ut intercessione beatae Honorinae virginis et martyris tuae per haec sacrosancta mysteria ab omnibus adversis muniamur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Almighty Father, through the perception of your most holy Son's body and blood, which has been enlivened, that we may be fortified against all adversities by the intercession of the blessed Honorina, virgin and martyr, through these sacred mysteries.

text: Sacrosancto corpore et sanguine satiati quaesumus misericors Deus ut haec sacramenta quae ad innovationem vitae percepimus ita ad usum salutis indesinenter obtineamus ut ad remunerationem beatitudinis ex hoc securi perveniamus.
translation_en: Having been filled with the sacred body and blood, we humbly ask, merciful God, that we may continuously possess these sacraments which we have received for renewal of life. May we attain to use them eternally so that securely we may arrive at the reward of beatitude.

text: Salutarem nobis edidit hodierna die beatus Cyprianus sacerdos {et martyr} in tua Domine virtute laetitiam; praesta quaesumus ut et conversationis eius insignia praedicando et intercessione tibi placita iugiter gloriemur.
translation_en: Today, the blessed Cyprian, priest and martyr, has made us happy. Through your divine power, Lord, may we always rejoice in his life's example through preaching and intercession.

text: Salutarem omnipotens Pater hostiam immolantes imploramus clementiam tuam ut genitricis Filii tui supplicatione placatus per eam nos et a peccatis absolvas et ad visionem gloriae tuae perducas.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Almighty Father, as we offer the sacrifice, that moved by the supplication of the Mother of Your Son, you be graciously pleased to forgive us our sins and lead us to the vision of your glory.

text: Salutari cibo et divino munere saginati ac participes dominici corporis et sanguinis effecti Deo nostro cum laude gratias referamus rogantes ut cibus iste et potus quem sumpsimus omnes a nobis diaboli repellat insidias fidem augeat spiritum innovet actus corrigat corda communiat.
translation_en: We, who have been nourished by the saving food and received as participants of the Lord's body and blood, offer our thanks to our God with laudable praise. We ask that this food and drink which we have consumed may drive away all the snares of the devil from us, increase our faith, renew our spirit, correct our actions, and unite our hearts.

text: Salutari ieiunio competentes Domine hostias immolamus; praesta ut ad nativitatem panis aeterni his officiis praeparemur.
translation_en: With this worthy fasting, we present ourselves as fitting, Lord, to offer sacrifices to you; grant that we may be prepared for the nativity of the eternal bread through these services.

text: Salutari refecti mysterio quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut qui hunc diem in beati Pauli apostoli tui conversione honorabilem haberi voluisti nos quoque conversos a vitiis in tua semper facias servitute gratulari.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God, who willed on this day to have the honorable conversion of blessed Paul the apostle, to make us also converted from vices, that we may always rejoice in your service.

text: Salutari sacrificio Domine populus tuus semper exsultet quo et debitus honor sacris martyribus exhibetur et sanctificationis tuae munus acquiritur.
translation_en: Your people, Lord, will always rejoice in the saving sacrifice; where the due honor is shown to the sacred martyrs, and the office of your sanctification is acquired.

text: Salutari tuo Domine satiati supplices deprecamur ut cuius laetamur gustu renovemur effectu.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your kindness, Lord, that we who rejoice in the taste of it, may be renewed by its effect.

text: Salutari munere Domine satiati supplices deprecamur ut cuius laetamur gustu reparemur effectu.
translation_en: By your saving power, Lord, we humbly beseech you, that we who rejoice in the taste of Him, may be restored in effect.

text: Salutari tuo munere Domine satiati supplices te deprecamur ut cuius laetamur gustu renovemur effectu.
translation_en: With your gift, Lord, we humbly pray that you satisfy us. Renew us in joy of the taste of the one whom we rejoice.

text: Salutaris tui Domine munere satiati supplices exoramus ut cuius laetamur gustu renovemur effectu.
translation_en: With your gracious gift, Lord, we who are satisfied, humbly ask that we may be renewed in joy by its effect.

text: Salutaris tui Domine munere satiati supplices deprecamur ut cuius laetamur gustu renovemur effectu.
translation_en: With your gracious gift, Lord, we who are satisfied pray humbly that we may be renewed in joy by the taste of him whom we rejoice.

text: Salutaris tui Domine munere satiati supplices exoramus ut sicut in sanctorum martyrum tuorum illorum laetamur gustu renovemur effectu.
translation_en: With the grace of your salvation, Lord, we who are filled and satisfied, humbly entreat you. May we rejoice as we taste in the fellowship of your holy martyrs, be renewed in its effect.

text: Salutaris alimoniae participatione refectos beatorum martyrum tuorum Viti et Modesti atque Crescentiae nos Domine quaesumus ubique defensione custodi quorum hodie voluisti nos temporali sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to protect us everywhere with the defense of your blessed martyrs Vitus, Modestus, and Crescentia, whom we are refreshed by the participation in their salvific nourishment. Today, you have willed that we should rejoice in their temporal solemnity.

text: Salutaris hostiae munus divinis sacrandum mysteriis beata Maria Magdalena patrocinante nostrorum quaesumus Domine exurat rubiginem vitiorum ut illius compunctionis gratiam et pietatis opera consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to offer the sacred gift of the salutary host on behalf of the divine mysteries, with blessed Mary Magdalene as our patron. May it burn away the smoky residue of our sins, so that we may deserve the grace of her compunction and the fruits of devotion.

text: Salutaris hostiae munus sacrandum quaesumus Domine beatus Thomas pontifex et martyr nobis ad salutem fore deposcat ut et conversationis eius experiamur insignia et intercessionis eius percipiamus suffragia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to consecrate the sacred gift of the saving host, that blessed Thomas, bishop and martyr, may pray for us and grant that we experience the insignia of his way of life and receive the support of his intercession.

text: Salutaris hostiae participatione recreati quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut eius potentia singulari nos ipsos tibi holocaustum facias sempiternum.
translation_en: By participating in the salutary host, we humbly ask the almighty God that through His power, He may make us a perpetual holocaust to Himself.

text: Salutaris hostiae participatione refectus misericordiam tuam supplex imploro Domine Deus ut me famulum tuum quem sanctae Exoniensi ecclesiae praeesse voluisti et agnos tuos quos tibi ex universali ecclesia specialius electos mihi nutriendos commisisti non sinas ullis adversitatibus fatigari; da nobis Domine inexpugnabilem verae fidei firmitatem <et> intercedente beato Petro apostolo tuo perduc nos ad patriae caelestis hereditatem.
translation_en: Refreshed by the participation in the salutary Host, I humbly beseech your mercy, Lord God. As one whom you wished to serve as a minister at the holy Church of Exeter and whom you have entrusted with the special elect of your sheep from the universal Church, do not allow me to be weary of any adversities; grant us, Lord, an unconquerable firmness in true faith. With the intercession of blessed Peter, your apostle, lead us to the inheritance of the celestial homeland.

text: Salutaris tui Domine mysterio satiati supplices imploramus clementiam tuam ut pro nobis eius non desit oratio cuius nos donasti gubernari patrocinio.
translation_en: In your saving mystery, Lord, we humbly beseech Your clemency, that through His intercession, the prayer You have given us to be governed by His patronage never cease for us.

text: Salutaris viae initium hodiernae sollemnitatis sacrificio cupientibus consecrari occurrat Deus pater unigenitus Filius tuus qui olim callidi temptatoris astutiam trimoda se suasione illicientem sacri oris alloquio reprobavit ac perculit. Ipse a nobis virulenta temptationum semina pellat; ipse consensum malarum suggestionum a nobis detrudat; ipse ariditatis nostrae inediam divinis pastibus foveat. Protegat nos contra huius temptatoris insidias lorica iustitiae et galea salutis aeternae.  Exhibens de caelorum sedibus fragilitati nostrae fortitudinem cibi perennis quo ex hoc validius roborati indictum a crastino abstinentiae tempus incipientes petulantiae carnalis libitus in nobis decidant ira diffugiat voracitas pereat temulentiae vitium evanescat. Secedant doli corpora salus habeat animas vis divina.  Utraque servent in opere ieiunii pacem in actu virtutem et in voto constantiam in effectu actuum disciplinam quo spiritaliter suscipientes praedictae abstinentiae tempus per eum nobis salubriter efficiatur pervium per quem id ad expiationem novimus institutum.
translation_en:
The beginning of today's solemnity is offered to those who desire to consecrate the way of salvation. God, our Father and your only-begotten Son, who once exposed the cunning deception of the crafty tempter through threefold persuasion in a sacred dialogue, strikes him. May He drive away from us the poisonous seeds of temptation; may He destroy our consent to evil suggestions; may He nourish the dryness within us with divine food.
May God protect us against the deceitful traps of this tempter with the breastplate of justice and the helmet of eternal salvation.
From the heavenly seats, strength for our fragility is shown to us by the food of everlasting life, so that we may be more strongly reinforced as we begin the time of fasting decreed from tomorrow. May carnal desires, impudence, anger, voraciousness, drunkenness, and every vice perish from us.
Let bodily afflictions depart, let health have souls. Let both peace in deeds, virtue in action, steadfastness in vows, and discipline in acts be preserved during the time of fasting, so that we may spiritually partake of the predicted time of fasting to our benefit through Him. We know that this has been instituted for expiation.

text: Salutaris victimae oblationem tibi Deus Pater omnipotens immolamus suppliciter deprecantes ut sicut intemeratae virginis Mariae viscera Iesu Christi Filii tui gloria illustrasti quod te in spiritu magnificaret ita penetralia cordis nostri Spiritus Sancti digneris suavitate perfundere quatenus sacro delibuti charismate veniam consequi peccatorum teque nunc et semper piis mentibus magnificare mereamur.
translation_en: We offer to you, God the almighty Father, the salutary sacrifice of oblation supplicatingly and humbly, that as the glories of the undefiled virgin Mary's womb illuminated the body of Jesus Christ, Your Son, so may the inner sanctum of our hearts be graced with the sweetness of the Holy Spirit. May it be that we are worthy to obtain forgiveness of sins through the sacred gift of grace, and thus may we merit to glorify you now and forevermore in pure minds.

text: Salutiferam hostiam atque maximam sollemnitatem exhibentes munificentiam tuam Domine tuae maiestatis humillima prece deposcimus ut suffragante beato Maximo confessore tuo qui tuis semper obtemperavit monitis nos pervenire facias ad tranquillitatem supernae felicitatis.
translation_en: Offering the life-giving sacrifice and the greatest solemnity, we humbly beseech your generosity, Lord, of your majesty. Through the intercession of blessed Maximus, your confessor, who always obeyed your teachings, we pray that you make us reach the tranquility of supreme happiness.

text: Salutis aeternae sacramenta quae in commemoratione passionis et resurrectionis Christi domini filii sumpsimus quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut tua gratia largiente nobis ad perpetuam redemptionem proficere sentiamus.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, who have taken the sacraments of eternal salvation in commemoration of the Passion and Resurrection of Christ, your Son, that through your grace we may feel to advance towards perpetual redemption.

text: Salutis nostrae compendium expetentes omnipotens Deus precamur ut qui beatissimum athletam tuum Tirsum sectoribus trahentibus serram in duabus partibus non permisisti secari nulla nos facias ad invicem malitiae simultate discindi quo sicut novem paene exemptis horis nec capillus motus est a sectoribus de capite martyris sic per omne tempus vitae nostrae nullis permoti scandalis saepti semper maneamus munimine caritatis.
translation_en: Seeking the compendium of our salvation, we humbly pray to the Almighty God that, just as the unmovable hair of Tyrsius remained unmoved by the sectors pulling at the scissors in two parts during his martyrdom, so too may we remain unshaken by any scandal throughout all time. May we always be safeguarded by the fortress of charity.

text: Salutis nostrae laeti libantes mysteria concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per haec sancta merita beatae Brigidae virginis tuae mereamur habere subsidium vitae praesentis et gaudia caelestis paradisi possidere.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, the mysteries of our salvation, so that through these holy merits of your blessed Virgin Brigida, we may deserve to have support in the present life and to possess the joys of the celestial paradise.

text: Salutis nostrae laeti libantes mysteria praesta quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Melliti pontificis tui nos adiuvet oratio et tua nos semper custodiat protectio.
translation_en: Grant us, we entreat you, O almighty God, the mysteries of our salvation, that the prayers of your blessed Pope Melchitus may aid us and that his protection may always guard us.

text: Salutis nostrae muneribus sollemniter suffulti tuae Deus immensae pietatis exoramus clementiam ut de cuius obitu gloriamur in terris de eius pia intercessione gratulemur in caelis.
translation_en: Filled with the gifts of our salvation, we humbly beseech your divine goodness to show mercy upon us. May we boast on earth about his departure, and be grateful for his pious intercession in heaven.

text: Salva me Domine Deus rex aeternae gloriae qui solus es potens salvam; da mihi per huius sacramenti perceptionem velle et operari et perficere quae tibi placent et mihi expediunt et intercedente sancta Dei Genitrice Maria simulque omnibus sanctis intervenientibus tuis da in omni perturbatione et tribulatione auxilium et in omni temptatione virtutem mihi tribue; de praeteritis malis da veniam et de praesentibus emendationem ac continentiam et de futuris iugiter largiri digneris custodiam; fac me prius Domine quam moriar plenissime consequi misericordiam tuam et ne ante dies meos finiri sinas quam peccata dimittas sed sicut tu vis et scis Domine miserere mei.
translation_en: Save me, O Lord, God, King of eternal glory, who alone art powerful to save; grant me, through the perception of this sacrament, the will and the ability, and the power to do and complete what pleases you and is beneficial for me, and with the intervention of the holy Mother of God, and all the saints who are interceding on your behalf, give me help in every disturbance and tribulation, and in every temptation grant me strength; from past evils, grant me forgiveness, and from present ones, correction and continence, and in future times, may you graciously bestow upon me watchfulness. First, Lord, before my days end, may I fully obtain your mercy, and may you not allow my days to end before you forgive my sins; but as you will, O Lord, have mercy on me.

text: Salva quaesumus Domine plebem tuam et benedictionis sanctae super eam effunde clementiam ut inter condicionis humanae et diabolicae fraudis incursus indulgentia tua laboranti continuata succurrat.
translation_en: Save we beseech Thee, Lord, Thy people and pour out Thy blessing upon them with clemency, that amidst the inroads of human conditions and diabolical deceits, they who are striving may find continued aid from Thy indulgence.

text: Salvator mundi verbum patris aeterni qui post acceptam fidem mulieris rogatus a Samaritanis biduum apud eos facis ut in illorum duorum figura dierum mystice commendaretur duorum numerus praeceptorum caritas videlicet Dei et proximi munda cor nostrum omni crimine omnique ignorantiae caecitate qualiter mundissimam tibi in cordibus nostris praeparans mansionem tribuas nobis quod illis tribuisti; proximi dilectionem veraciter retinere per quam possimus pervenire ad te et tuam omnimodo nosse dilectionem cum qua perveniamus ad gaudia vitae aeternae.
translation_en: The word of the world's Savior, the eternal Father's offspring, who, after receiving faith from the woman, were asked by the Samaritans for two days among them, made yourself mysteriously commended to the number of two in the figure of those two days of theirs. Teach us how to cleanse our heart from all sin and ignorance, blindness, making it as spotless as possible before you, so that we may receive a dwelling place, which you have given to them; teach us truly to retain love for our neighbor, by which we can reach you and truly know your love, with which we will reach the joys of eternal life.

text: Salvator noster Christe Deus cuius ex proximitate passionis gaudemus cuiusque redeunte annua resurrectionis celebritate erigimur tu carnem nostram ieiunio attritam mole culparum emacula tu spiritum qui te ardenter concupivit sanctifica; lucem oculis praesta munditiam corpori animaeque accommoda quo omnium virtutum dignitatem vestiti ad videndum tuae passionis gloriam habeamur idonei.
translation_en: Our Savior Christ, God, whose proximity we rejoice in at the Passion, whose annual return we are raised up by the celebration of Your resurrection; may You sanctify our flesh worn thin by fasting, may You purify our spirit which ardently desires You. Grant us light to our eyes, and make our body and soul clean. Clothe us with the dignity of all virtues so that we may be worthy to behold the glory of Your Passion.

text: Salvator noster salva nos solita pietate qualiter per hoc sacrificium et inediam nostram miserando sustentes et impetrantibus nobis defunctis fidelibus requiem praestes.
translation_en: Our Savior, save us with your usual mercy, as you sustain and grant mercy to us through this sacrifice and our alms, and bestow rest upon the faithful departed who plead for us.

text: Sana nos Domine Deus noster et ne iniquitatum nostrarum infirmitas sempiternam afferat nobis mortem sana nos Domine et omnes infirmos ac redime de interitu vitam nostram ut sanata de culpa sit tranquilla per gratiam; effunde medicinam aegrotis et veniam praesta delictis.
translation_en: Heal us, Lord our God, and do not let the perpetual infirmity of our iniquities bring us eternal death. Heal us, Lord, and all the sick ones, and redeem our life from destruction. So that we, healed from guilt, may live peacefully through grace; pour medicine on the sick, and grant forgiveness for offenses.

text: Sana quaesumus Domine vulnera famuli tui illius aegritudines eius perime peccata dimitte et hanc oblationem quam tibi pro eo offerimus benignus suscipe et sic eum flagella in hoc saeculo ut post transitum sanctorum mereatur adunari consortio.
translation_en: Heal, we beseech You, Lord, the wounds of Your servant; let his ailments pass away. Remove his sins and take away this offering which we present to You on his behalf. Graciously receive it, and so discipline him in this world that after the passage of the saints he may be worthy to join their consortium.

text: Sancta mysteria nos quaesumus Domine et sacratissimae virginis Mildrethae intercessio veneranda a cunctis defendant periculis et ad gloriam perducant sempiternae felicitatis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect us with the holy mysteries and the venerable intercession of the most sacred virgin Mildreth from all dangers, and lead us to eternal happiness.

text: Sancta nos quaesumus Domine sacramenti caelestis participatio et ab hostis callidi tueatur incursu et sancto intercedente Floriano animarum nobis remedia conferat sempiterna.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us participation in the sacred heavenly sacrament and to protect us from the cunning attack of our enemy. Through the intervention of Saint Florian, may eternal healing be bestowed upon our souls.

text: Sancta tua Domine beati Laurentii martyris pretiosa passione quam praeimus nos renovent quibus et iugiter satiamur et semper desideramus expleri.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, to renew within us the precious passion of blessed Lawrence, the martyr, by which we are ever satisfied and continually long to be filled.

text: Sancta tua Domine illa nos sua interventione laetificet et pia faciat sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: Your holy Lord, may that [event/day] delight us with its intervention and make us rejoice with a pious celebration.

text: Sancta tua Domine percipientes tuam devote misericordiam exoramus ut beatae et sanctae Eadburgae virginis intercessione muniti sempiterna mereamur felicitate epulari.
translation_en: We humbly ask your Holy Lord, perceiving your devout mercy, that we may be worthy of eternal happiness by the intercession of the blessed and holy Eadburga, the virgin.

text: Sancta tua Domine pro beati illius martyris tui passione celebrata nos muniant et ab omni semper adversitate custodiant.
translation_en: May your holy Lord, for the passion of that blessed martyr of yours, protect and defend us, and keep us always from every adversity.

text: Sancta tua Domine quae fideliter sumpsimus sancto intercedente Aldelmo et caelestium desideriorum nos nutriant dulcedine et ab hostium formidine et aeternae mortis amaritudine tueantur.
translation_en: Holy Lord, whom we faithfully received while Saint Aldhelm interceded for us, may You nourish us with the sweetness of heavenly desires and protect us from fear of enemies and the bitterness of eternal death.

text: Sancta tua Domine quae sumpsimus nobis omnibusque qui memoriam nostri in orationibus suis habent et qui se indignis precibus nostris commendaverunt seu illis quorum quarumque eleemosynas suscepimus aut pro quibus deprecandi debitores sumus aeterna conferant gaudia.
translation_en: O Lord, your holy ones whom we have received and all who remember us in their prayers, and who have entrusted themselves to our unworthy petitions, or those whose alms we have accepted or for whom we are obligated to intercede, may eternal joy be conferred upon them.

text: Sancta tua nobis Domine quaesumus intervenientibus qui tibi placuere proficiant ad salutem nec reatus mortalitatis reddat indignos quos tua redemptio praestat innocuos.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your holy ones may intervene on our behalf. May those who have pleased you progress towards salvation, and may the guilt of mortal sin not return to us the unworthy whom your redemption has made innocent.

text: Sancta tua nos Domine quaesumus et a peccatis exuant et caelestis vitae vigore confirmem.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your sanctity purify us from sins and strengthen us with the vitality of celestial life.

text: Sancta tua nos Domine quaesumus sanctae Praxedis virginis tuae meritis suffragantibus et a peccatis omnibus exuant et ad caelestia regna perducant.
translation_en: We humbly ask your sanctity, Lord, that through the merits of your holy virgin Saint Praxedis, you free us from all sins and lead us to the heavenly kingdoms.

text: Sancta tua nos Domine quaesumus et vivificando renovent et renovando vivificent.
translation_en: Holy Lord, we humbly ask you; by sanctifying us, renew us and by renewing us, make us holy.

text: Sancta tua nos Domine sumpta purificent et beato martyre tuo ac rege Edwardo intercedente ad perpetuae beatitudinis consortium perducant.
translation_en: May Your holy self, Lord, cleanse and purify us. Through the intercession of Your blessed martyr and King Edward, may You guide us to the consortium of everlasting beatitude.

text: Sancta tua nos Domine sumpta vivificent et misericordiae sempiternae praeparent expiatos.
translation_en: May your holy self, Lord, nourish us and make ready the eternal mercy for the purified ones.

text: Sancta tua percipientibus Domine quaesumus salus et mentium praestetur et corporum ut doni tui fiat nobis et benedictio copiosa et larga protectio.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your saints may receive salvation and health of mind and body. May your gifts be bestowed upon us, and may a rich and abundant blessing and protective grace be upon us.

text: Sancta tua quae sumpsimus Domine et dilectionis tuae nobis incrementum et fidei conferant firmitatem.
translation_en: Your holy things, which we have received, Lord, may increase our love for you and strengthen our faith.

text: Sancta tua quae sumpsimus Domine nos sua virtute tueantur et intercedente beato Cuthberto consessore tuo atque pontifice cuius vita gloriosa effulsit in pace nos et sanctitate custodiant.
translation_en: Your holy ones, which we have received, Lord, may protect us through your power, and with the intercession of the blessed Cuthbert, your bishop and pope, whose glorious life shone in peace, may keep us safe through holiness.

text: Sancta tua Domine quae sumpsimus nos sua virtute semper tueantur et beato interveniente Cuthberto cuius vita tota exstitit miranda vita nostra in pace et sanctitate dirigatur.
translation_en: May your holy Lord, who has taken us with his power, always protect us. And may our life be directed by the blessed Cuthbert, whose entire life was remarkable, during peace and holiness.

text: Sanctae Caeciliae festa recolentes preces offerimus hostias immolamus; praesta Domine quaesumus ut cum praesidio temporali et vitae nobis praebeant incrementa perpetuae.
translation_en: On the feast of Saint Cecilia, we present our prayers and offer sacrifices; O Lord, we humbly ask that you grant us everlasting increase with temporal protection and life.

text: Sanctae Christinae virginis et martyris tuae Domine suffragia ad aeternae sollemnitatis nos perducant gaudia.
translation_en: May the intercession of Saint Christina, virgin and martyr, Lord, lead us to the joys of eternal solemnity.

text: Sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae ac beatorum angelorum et archangelorum omniumque supernarum virtutum sed et sanctorum patriarcharum et prophetarum necnon et beatorum apostolorum martyrum confessurum virginum et omnium electorum tuorum intercessione quaeso omnipotens Deus ut mihi famulo tuo praeteritarum omnium culparum indulgentiam tribuas et ne eadem aut similia admittam tuae protectionis cautelam custodiamque adhibe omnibusque mihi consanguinitate vel familiaritate coniunctis gratiae tuae misericordiam in omnibus saeculi huius adversitatibus propitiatus impende quatenus a cunctis periculis malisque liberati aeternae beatitudinis gaudia mereantur perfrui omnemque populum christianum ab omni adversitate et pravitate defende et animabus omnium fidelium defunctorum remissionem cunctorum tribue peccatorum et vitam aeternam.
translation_en: To the Holy Mother of God, Mary, and to all the blessed angels and archangels, every supernatural virtues, saints patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all your elect; through their intercession I humbly ask Almighty God that He grants me, Thy servant, the forgiveness of all past sins and admits me not to such sins again. Grant me His protection and guardianship in all adversities of this world. May He grant you His grace in every difficulty so that, freed from all perils and evils, you may merit to enjoy the eternal beatitude. Defend the whole Christian people from every adversity and wickedness, grant remission of all sins to the souls of all the faithful departed, and bestow upon them eternal life.

text: Sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae ac beatorum apostolorum martyrum consessorum virginum atque omnium sanctorum tuorum quaesumus omnipotens Deus nos famulos tuos intercessionibus protege pariterque nobis familiaritate atque consanguinitate coniunctos et omnem populum christianum ab omni pravitate defende; commissum etiam nobis ad regendum gregem custodi et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum illorum et illarum et cunctorum fidelium defunctorum requiem tribue benignus sempiternam et sanctorum coetibus consociare digneris propitius.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God for your servants, for the protection of the blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, and all the apostles, martyrs, virgins, and all the saints among you. May He also protect us, joined to us by family and kinship, and defend all the Christian people from every wickedness. Furthermore, may He watch over us as we shepherd His flock, grant eternal rest to the souls of your servants, their souls and those of all the faithful departed, and may He graciously deem worthy to associate them with the company of saints, in His mercy.

text: Sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae atque omnium sanctorum tuorum quaesumus Domine supplicatione placatus et veniam nobis tribue et remedia sempiterna concede.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, through the intercession of the Holy Mother of God, Mary, and all your saints. Be pleased with our supplication and grant us forgiveness, and bestow eternal remedies upon us.

text: Sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae et beatarum omnium caelestium virtutum sanctorumque patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum consessorum virginum atque omnium simul sanctorum quaesumus omnipotens Deus meritis ac precibus placatus tribue nobis misericordiam tuam et da populo tuo inviolabilem fidei firmitatem et pacem; repelle a nobis hostem famem et pestem et omnem immunditiam; da nobis in tua virtute constantiam et fortitudinem; immitte hostibus nostris formidinem et invalitudinem; retribue omnibus nobis bona facientibus vitae aeternae beatitudinem; da inimicis nostris et persequentibus nos recognitionem et indulgentiam; concede defunctis nostris et omnibus in Christo quiescentibus remissionem omnium peccatorum et requiem sempiternam.
translation_en: We ask the almighty God, moved by the merits and prayers of the holy Mother of God, Mary, and all the blessed celestial virtues, patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, and all the saints together, grant us your mercy and give to your people an unshakable faith firmness and peace; drive away from us the enemy, famine, pestilence, and every uncleanness; grant us constancy and strength in your virtue; send fear and weakness upon our enemies; repay all of us who are doing good the beatitude of eternal life; give recognition and indulgence to our enemies and those pursuing us; grant the deceased among us and all resting in Christ forgiveness for all sins and everlasting rest.

text: Sanctae immortalitatis alimonia recreati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sancti Iuliani confessoris tui atque pontificis intervenientibus meritis transferamur ad vitam sine fine mansuram patriae caelestis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through the nourishment of the immortal sanctity, we may be re-created. Grant us, that by the merits of your confessor and bishop, Saint Julian, we may be transferred to a dwelling in eternal life in our heavenly homeland.

text: Sanctae Luciae martyris tuae nos Domine precatio tibi grata conciliet ut haec sancta quae sumpsimus salutaria sentiamus.
translation_en: May the prayer to Your saint, Saint Lucy, Lord, be pleasing to You. May it bring us together so that we may feel the salutary effects of this holy food which we have taken.

text: Sanctae martyris tuae Christinae merita nos Domine pretiosa tueantur in quibus tuae maiestatis opera praedicantes et praesens capiamus adiutorium et futurum.
translation_en: May the merits of your saint, Christina, O Lord, protect us, as we proclaim your majesty's works and seize present and future aid in your presence.

text: Sanctae nos martyris Euphemiae precatio ...
translation_en: Prayer for the holy martyr Euphemia...

text: Sanctae Brigidae virginis tuae Domine quaesumus precatio tibi grata nos adiuvet et tuam nobis indulgentiam poscere non desistat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the prayer to your Holy Virgin Saint Brigid may find favor with you. May it never cease to help us and may we never tire of asking for your indulgence towards us.

text: Sanctae nos quaesumus Domine Praxedis martyris tuae precatio tibi grata confoveat et tuum nobis postulet sine cessatione praesidium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the prayer of your martyr Saint Praxedis may be pleasing to you and that without ceasing, you provide us with your protection.

text: Sanctae Sabinae virginis et martyris tuae nos quaesumus Domine Deus noster meritis precibusque tuere quae tibi gloriosa confessionis tuae complacuit passione.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, through the merits and prayers, to protect us who are dedicated to the holy Sabina, virgin and martyr. Whose glorious confession pleased your passion.

text: Sanctae Teclae virginis et martyris tuae Domine quaesumus deprecatione munera nostra sanctifica et ab omnibus contagiis humanae pravitatis per ea nos clementer emunda.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you consecrate our gifts through the intercession of Saint Tecla, virgin and martyr, and cleanse us gently from all contagions of human wickedness.

text: Sanctarum virginum ac martyrum tuarum illarum quaesumus Domine precibus et meritis devotio nostra tibi complaceat et obsequia munerum nostrorum earum oratione fiant accepta.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that our devoted prayers and the merits of our offerings may please you in regard to your holy virgins and martyrs. May their prayers be accepted on our behalf.

text: Sanctarum virginum tuarum festivitate et sacramenti divini munere vegetati quaesumus Domine ut sicut bonis tuis per tuam gratiam temporaliter fovemur ita perfruamur aeternis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, on the festivity of your holy virgins and with the gift of the sacred sacrament, may we be nourished temporally by your grace, just as your good ones, so that we may be filled with eternal blessings.

text: Sancte Domine cuius munere universa in nobis prosperitas est tribue famulis tuis in saeculo fiduciam in pace laetitiam in victu abundantiam in fide perseverantiam in castitate munditiam in religione scientiam atque in timore domini sanctam et pudicam reverentiam.
translation_en: Lord, to whom all prosperity in us is attributed by your power, grant faithfulness to your servants in this world, peace, joy, abundance in food, perseverance in faith, purity in chastity, cleanliness in religion, knowledge and holy and modest reverence in the fear of the Lord.

text: Sancte Domine qui apostolum tuum Petrum ad domum Cornelii centurionis accersitum ne gentilem hominem quasi immundum pollutumque respueret figuraliter monuisti cum in visione sopore modico quiescenti vas quoddam universorum animalium commixtione completum quatuor initiis ab excelsa caeli parte depositum mactandi et comedendi lege praeponeres eumque velut contaminationis edulium recusantem immundum dicere quod tu creaveras vetuisses significans scilicet ex omnibus nationibus Ecclesiae tuae conversam plebem apostolis praedicantibus cibum futurum quam tu a quatuor mundi partibus quatuor evangeliis invitatam in uno fidei receptaculo congregasti hanc quaesumus mundam in oculis tuis statue dignamque sanctis altaribus effice. Atque ita oblationes eius suscipe in sacrificium tuum et hostiam reputa ut ipsa tibi sacrificium ipsa sit hostia. Beatorum quoque angelorum patriarcharum prophetarum apostolorum martyrum omniumque sanctorum qui de ecclesiae corpore gloriosa Christi membra facti sunt suffragiis rogantibus nobis requiem fidelium spiritibus tribue defunctorum ut facta per caros suos commemoratio illis refrigerium conferat his proventum.
translation_en: Saint Lord, who called Your apostle Peter to the house of the centurion Cornelius, not rejecting the unclean and polluted Gentile man figuratively, You showed him in a vision while he was half asleep a certain vessel filled with the mixture of all creatures, which was placed from the highest part of heaven and You commanded him to kill and eat according to the law. However, as if refusing to eat food contaminated, he said that You had created what is unclean, signifying that from all nations a people would be converted to Your Church by apostles preaching, whom You have gathered in one receptacle of faith, which You have invited from the four parts of the world through the four Gospels. We ask that this clean Church may remain in Your sight worthy and make it worthy for holy altars. And so, receive the offerings of this as a sacrifice to You, and consider them as a sacrifice themselves, the offering itself being the sacrifice. We also ask for the prayers of the blessed angels, patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, all saints who have become glorious members of Christ's Church, that they intercede on our behalf and grant rest to the spirits of the faithful departed, so that the commemoration of their deeds may bring refreshment to them.

text: Sancte Domine qui repudiatis carnalibus victimis ritum hunc sacrificii spiritalis per Melchisedech praefiguratum per unigenitum tuum apostolis traditum per apostolos toto orbe diffusum invalescere et in aeternam tuorum salutem mystica sanctificatione ( lacuna ) voluisti tua in his felicibus creaturis gratia tuum spiritum tuamque infunde virtutem ut earum plenam consecrationem non vox aut lingua mortalis sed inspiratio caelestis operetur.
translation_en: O Holy Lord who reject the carnal victims, this ritual of spiritual sacrifice prefigured by Melchisedech and given through your only-begotten Son to the apostles and spread throughout the world by them, we desire that it grows stronger and brings eternal salvation to your people with mystical sanctification (lacuna). We willingly ask that in these happy creatures, your grace, your spirit, and your power be infused with virtue, so that their complete consecration is not operated by human voice or language but by celestial inspiration.

text: Sancte Domine semper tuis exorabilis ne umquam pias tuorum preces fidelium aspernanter intue<a>ris famulorum orationem familiae tuae per diversa ecclesiae membra dispersam totius soliditatis prosperitate concorpora et quod precantium sollicitudine fuit varium fiat donante tuae misericordiae liberalitate perfectum.
translation_en: Lord, everlasting one, always approachable, do not disdain the prayers of your faithful servants. May you observe the prayer of your household, dispersed through various members of the Church, and may all its solidity prosper. And whatever has been varied in their concern for prayer, make it perfect with your mercy's generous gift.

text: Sancte omnipotens aeterne Deus tu nos convertens vivifica et quos error gentilitatis involvit agnitionis tuae munus absolvat ut aculeo mortis exstincto aeternis vivificemur oraculis ut sicut per infirmitatem carnis servivimus iniustitiae et iniquitati ita nunc liberati a peccatis serviamus iustitiae in sanctificationem.
translation_en: Saint Almighty eternal God, turn us and give life to those whom the snare of pagan error has involved, may the gift of your recognition absolve them. So that as we served unrighteousness and iniquity through our bodily weakness, now freed from sins, let us serve justice in sanctification.

text: Sancti Ambrosii nos Domine iugiter prosequatur oratio ut quod petitio nostra non impetrat ipso pro nobis interveniente praestetur.
translation_en: May the prayers of Saint Ambrose, Lord, always follow us, so that what our petition does not obtain may be granted through his intervention on our behalf.

text: Sancti apostoli tui Barnabae nos quaesumus Domine sollemnitas tueatur quia tanto fiducialius tuo nomini supplicamus quanto frequentius apostolorum confovemur exemplis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the feast of your Apostle Barnabas may be kept safe, for we trust more in your name as we are more frequently nourished by the examples of the apostles.

text: Sancti Basilii confessoris tui atque pontificis supplicatione munus oblatum Domine quaesumus fiat nobis in perpetuum salutare.
translation_en: Through the intercession of your confessor and bishop, Saint Basil, we humbly ask you, Lord. We implore that a saving grace be bestowed upon us forever.

text: Sancti Bricii confessoris tui atque pontificis Domine quaesumus annua sollemnitas pietati tuae nos reddat acceptos ut per haec piae oblationis officia saeculi praesentis miserias evadamus et gratiae tuae beneficia consequamur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the annual feast of your saint, Bricius the confessor and bishop, may return us to your favor so that through these acts of pious offerings in this present world, we may escape the miseries and obtain the blessings of your grace.

text: Sancti Bricii confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine veneranda sollemnitas tuae pietati sacrificium nostrum reddat acceptum ut per hanc salutarem hostiam et veniam consequamur et gratiam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the solemnity of your holy confessor and bishop St. Bricius may grant our sacrifice accepted to your venerable piety. May we obtain salvation through this beneficial offering, and follow with forgiveness and grace.
