text: Sancti confessoris tui illius nos quaesumus Domine tuere praesidiis ut eius semper intercessionibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect us with your guardianship, so that we may always be helped by the intercessions of your holy confessor.

text: Sancti Cornelii et Cypriani suffragiis nobis Domine consuetis dependant et pari semper intercessione nos foveant.
translation_en: We depend on the intercession of Saints Cornelius and Cyprian, Lord, according to Your custom, and they should always keep us warm with equal intercession.

text: Sancti Ethelwoldi confessoris tui atque pontificis tribue nos quaesumus precibus sublevari ut cuius sacram depositionis diem annua sollemnitate colimus eius apud te intercessionibus et meritis adiuvemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask that through the prayers of your saint, Bishop Ethelwold, you raise us up. On the day we honor his sacred deposition, we pray that his intercessions and merits may aid us with you.

text: Sancti Felicis Domine confessio recensita conferat nobis piae devotionis augmentum qui in confessione tui nominis perseverans meruit honorari.
translation_en: Lord, may the recent confirmation of Saint Felix's confession grant us an increase in pious devotion, who, by persisting in your confession, deserved to be honored.

text: Sancti Hilarii tibi precibus Domine quaesumus grata reddatur oblatio pro cuius est depositione immolanda.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offering made to Saint Hilary be pleasing to you, for on his departure it was fit to offer a sacrifice.

text: Sancti illius martyris tui Domine nos oratio sancta conciliet quae sacris virtutibus veneranda refulget.
translation_en: O Lord, may the holy prayer of thy martyr gather us, which shines with revered virtues in sacredness.

text: Sancti Ioannis Baptistae honorabilem nativitatem muneribus o piissime Domine geminatis in octava Ecclesia tua die devotissime consequitur; praesta solita clementia tua ut ipso pro ea interveniente id munus salutare sibi penes te fieri mereatur.
translation_en: On the most honorable birth of Saint John the Baptist, on this octave day in your Church, the most devout are following with fitting gifts; grant, in your usual clemency, that through his intervention, they may deserve to receive from you the salvific gift.

text: Sancti Ioannis Chrysostomi confessoris tui atque pontificis nos Domine merita prosequamur tuamque indulgentiam nobis semper implorent.
translation_en: Lord, may we follow in the merits of your Confessor and Bishop Saint John Chrysostom, and may we always entreat your mercy.

text: Sancti Ioannis natalicia celebrantes supplices te Domine deprecamur ut hoc idem nobis semper et indulgentiae causa sit et salutis.
translation_en: On the feast of Saint John, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that this same occasion may always be for us a cause of grace and indulgence, and salvation.

text: Sancti Lamberti martyris tui atque pontificis Domine nos tibi quaesumus commendet oratio ut sicut hunc diem eius gloriosa decorat passio ita nos ipsius semper muniamur suffragio.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your Saint Lambert, both martyr and bishop, may commend to you our prayer. May we, just as his glorious passion adorns this day, always be fortified by his intercession.

text: Sancti Laurentii nos Domine precatio iusta tueatur et quod nostra conscientia non praesumit eius nobis qui tibi placuit oratione donetur.
translation_en: Lord, we pray that the righteous prayer of Saint Lawrence protects us, and that our conscience does not presume to receive from him, the one who pleases you, the prayers offered to you.

text: Sancti nos Domine martyris tui atque pontificis illius precatio sancta per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus tueatur et quod nostra conscientia non praesumit eius nobis qui tibi placuit oratione donetur.
translation_en: Holy Lord, protect us by the prayer of your martyr and bishop. May these sacraments we have received guard us, and may our conscience not presume to receive grace from him whom you have pleased to grant us through his prayer.

text: Sancti Laurentii nos Domine sollemnitas repetita tueatur et misericordiae tuae intercessio beata conciliet.
translation_en: Lord, may the feast of Saint Lawrence be repeated for us and your mercy protect us; let the blessings' intercession unite us.

text: Sancti Marcelli confessoris tui atque pontificis quaesumus Domine annua sollemnitas pietati tuae nos reddat acceptos; per haec piae oblationis officia et illum beata retributio comitetur et nobis gratiae tuae dona conciliet.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the annual feast of your saint and bishop, Marcellus the confessor, may grant us acceptance to your piety. May this offering of our devotion be accompanied by his blessed reward, and unite for us the gifts of your grace.

text: Sancti martyres Domine quaesumus et nominibus suis nobis suffragentur et precibus ut et Clemens tuus sapienter clementiam sequi et tibi sacrata Felicitas nos poscat veraciter esse felices.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you for the holy martyrs; may their names intercede for us and may their prayers follow, and may your clemency, Clement, wisely follow suit. May the sacred Felicitas truly grant us to be happy.

text: Sancti martyris Agapiti Domine quaesumus veneranda festivitas salutaris auxilii nobis praestet augmentum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the venerable festival of Saint Martyr Agapitus may bestow upon us an increase in its saving help.

text: Sancti Ioannis baptistae et martyris tui Domine quaesumus veneranda festivitas salutaris auxilii nobis praestet effectum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the honorable feast of Saint John the Baptist and Martyr may grant us the effective help of its salutary blessings.

text: Sancti martyris Agapiti merita nos Domine pretiosa tueantur in quibus tuae maiestatis opera praedicantes et praesens capiamus adiutorium et futurum.
translation_en: May the merits of Saint Martyr Agapitus, Lord, protect us, in whom we proclaim your majestic works and may we both now receive and in the future experience your assistance.

text: Sancti martyris tui Domine Bonifatii sollemnitas repetita conferat nobis piae devotionis augmentum qui in confessione tui nominis perseverans cum palma victoriae caelestis gloriae meruit dignitatem.
translation_en: May the feast of your holy martyr Lord Boniface be repeated among us, increasing our pious devotion. He who persisted in confessing your name and earned the palm of celestial victory with divine glory, deserves a worthy dignity.

text: Sancti nominis tui Domine timorem pariter et amorem fac nos habere perpetuum quia numquam tua gubernatione destituis quos in soliditate tuae dilectionis instituis.
translation_en: Lord, make us have perpetual fear and love of your holy name, because you never abandon those whom you establish in the safety of your love.

text: Sancti nos Domine quaesumus Ioannis Baptistae oratio et assequi faciat semper mente quae gerimus et debitae servitutis actione perfrui.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the prayer of Saint John the Baptist may always guide our thoughts and that we may continually perform actions befitting our servitude due.

text: Sancti nos quaesumus Domine baptistae Ioannis oratio et assequi faciat semper mente quae gerimus et debitae servitutis actione sectari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the prayer of Saint John the Baptist may always follow our minds and thoughts, and that we may continually follow in his footsteps with the actions required by our duty of service.

text: Sancti nos quaesumus Domine Theodori martyris oratio et assequi faciat semper mente quae gerimus et debitae servitutis actione sectari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the prayer of Saint Theodore the Martyr may always accompany our thoughts and that we may follow in his steps through the actions of due service.

text: Sancti nos quaesumus Domine Hermetis natalicia votiva laetificent et suae beneficiis intercessionis attollant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the feast days of Saint Hermetes bring us joy and that his intercession elevate us through his blessings.

text: Sancti sacerdotis tui Martini hodie translationem celebrantibus tribue nobis quaesumus Domine ut sicut eius commemorationem devotissime colimus ita et opus fideliter imitemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us on this day when the translation of your saint Martin is being celebrated, that as we devotedly honor his commemoration, so may we also faithfully perform our duties.

text: Sancti Simeonis intercessione et famulorum tuorum munus Domine reddatur acceptum et cunctis salutare proveniat.
translation_en: Through the intercession of Saint Simeon, may Your gift, Lord, be accepted and bring salvation to all.

text: Sancti Spiritus Domine corda nostra mundet infusio et sui roris ubertate secundet.
translation_en: Lord, cleanse our hearts with the infusion of the Holy Spirit and may it follow in abundance with the dew of your spirit.

text: Sancti Spiritus Domine corda nostra mundet infusio et sui roris intima adspersione secundet.
translation_en: Lord, cleanse our hearts with the infusion of the Holy Spirit and may it be deeply sprinkled with the dew of its own breath.

text: Sancti Spiritus gratia quaesumus Domine corda nostra illuminet et perfectae caritatis dulcedine abundanter reficiat.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that your Holy Spirit enlighten our hearts and abundantly refresh us with the sweetness of perfect charity.

text: Sancti Spiritus quaesumus Domine gratia cor nostrum clementer expurget et per huius mysterii sacramentum in nobis carnalium delectationum flammas potenter exstinguat.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the Holy Spirit may graciously cleanse our hearts and through this sacred mystery, powerfully extinguish in us the flames of carnal delight.

text: Sancti tui Domine quaesumus tuam misericordiam deprecentur ut sacramenta quae sumpsimus et praesentis vitae nobis remedia conferant et futurae.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that your mercy be sought for us, so that the sacraments we have received may bring us relief in our present lives and prepare us for what is to come.

text: Sancti tui nos Domine Abdon et Sennen piis orationibus prosequamur et ab huius vitae periculis iugiter postulent expediri.
translation_en: May we, Lord, follow your saints Abdon and Sennen with their pious prayers, and may we continually seek to be delivered from the dangers of this life.

text: Sancti tui nos quaesumus Domine illius apostoli quam praevenimus sollemnitas tueatur quia tanto fiducialius tuo nomini supplicamus quanto frequentius apostolorum intercessionibus confovemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the solemnity of your saint, which we are about to celebrate, may protect us. For as much as we more confidently implore your name, so much are we nourished by the frequent intercessions of the apostles.

text: Sancti tui nos quaesumus Domine ubique laetificent ut dum eorum merita recolimus patrocinia sentiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your saints everywhere may rejoice so that while we recall their merits, we may feel their patronage.

text: Sancti tui quaesumus Domine iugiter nobis a te et veniam postulent et profectum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your saints may continually seek us from you, and that we may find forgiveness and progress.

text: Sancti viri memoriam facientes cuius ossibus translationis honore virentibus animam efficit passio gloriosam te Deus pater rogamus ut oblatis his hostiis sanctificationem impertiens credentem tibi populum a peccatis expurges.
translation_en: Making remembrance of the holy man, whose bones, being nourished by the honor of translation, make his passion glorious. We ask you, God, Father, that with these offerings, bestowing sanctification upon the believing people, you purify them from sins.

text: Sancti Xysti Domine frequentata sollemnitas et de sacerdotalibus nos instruat te miserante doctrinis et de gloria martyrii foveat ubique suffragiis.
translation_en: Lord, may the solemnity of Saint Cyprian often be frequented, and through your mercy, instruct us with teachings from the priesthood. And everywhere, may his martyr's glory warmly receive our prayers.

text: Sancti Zenonis sacerdotis et confessoris tui Domine veneranda hodiernae festivitatis die illuminati congratulantes laetamur; concede propitius dignis eius precibus exoratus ut spiritalis alimoniae iucunditate refecti salutis quam docuit imitando viam sectemur.
translation_en: On the honored day of your saint, Zenon the priest and confessor, we rejoice today, illuminated; grant us graciously, as we humbly ask, through his worthy prayers, that filled with the joy of spiritual nourishment, we may follow the way he taught by imitating it, and pursue the salvation he instructed.

text: Sanctifica Deus initia abstinentiae nostrae et confessionum nostrarum accipe puritatem quo per eam et criminibus careamus et constitutum tempus salutaris ieiunii explere possimus.
translation_en: May God sanctify the beginnings of our abstinence and receive the purity through which we may be free from sins, and be able to fulfill the set time of the beneficial fast.

text: Sanctifica Deus oblatoris servi tui illius tibi haec sacrificia delibata donans ei ut remissionem suorum accipiens criminum indesinenter tibi votis iugibus famuletur.
translation_en: May God sanctify the offerings of your servant, which he offers to you. Giving to him remission of his sins, may he, continually serving you with prayers and supplications, never cease to be bound by vows to you.

text: Sanctifica Deus pater oblatam tibi a nobis hanc hostiam vivam eamque sereno vultu respiciendo perlustra ut mox de ea libaverimus caro nostra vel anima ita spiritali abstinentia perornetur ut ne ulterius illecta gulae voraginibus supprimatur sicque spiritalis parsimoniae rigore praevalidi hos beatae quadragesimae dies in votis fidelibus inchoemus ut cum fructu bonorum operum eos explesse nos gratulemur.
translation_en: May God the Father sanctify this living offering that we bring to You, and may He look upon it with a calm face, examining it so that soon our flesh or soul may be nourished from it. May it be raised to such spiritual abstinence that it will not be further tempted by the depths of gluttony, and may the rigor of spiritual frugality prevail, thus starting these blessed days of Lent among faithful vows. May we rejoice when they complete their good deeds with fruit.

text: Sanctifica Deus quod offerimus et tribue propitius quod rogamus ut qui passionem martyris tui illius venerabiliter annua vice excolimus suffragio eius perenniter potiamur.
translation_en: May God sanctify what we offer and grant us graciously what we ask, that we may worthily celebrate the anniversary of Your martyr's passion each year through his intercession, and may we be granted eternal enjoyment by his prayers.

text: Sanctifica Domine haec tibi sacrificia illibata et sumentium corda pietate solita a malis omnibus placatus emunda ut merear tibi domino incessanter sine offensione servire et aeternae vitae hereditatem percipere sine fine.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify these offerings presented to you without blemish, and cleanse the hearts partaking of them with their usual piety, pleased with all things far removed from evil. May it be pleasing to you, Lord, for me to serve you continually without offence, and to receive an inheritance of eternal life without end.

text: Sanctifica Domine hanc nostrae oblationis hostiam puram quam tibi in honorem martyris tui Sebastiani offerimus dedicandam ut quotquot ex ea libaverimus illo repleamur documento virtutum quo per hunc martyrem confortata sunt in fide corda nutantia beatorum.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify this our pure offering, the hostium (offering bread) which we offer to you in honor of your martyr Saint Sebastian, and dedicate it, that those whom we free from it may be filled with the document of virtues through which their wavering hearts have been strengthened by this martyr in faith.

text: Sanctifica Domine hoc sacrificium pro infirmorum tibi relevatione libatum quo per hoc obtineant et validi gratiam et languidi medicinam.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify this sacrifice offered for the healing of the sick. Through it, may the healthy attain grace and the weak find medicine.

text: Sanctifica Domine ministerium exhilara ministrantem illustra templum orna altarium ordina populum cura morbum dona remedium proba votum ut omnes de diabolica astutia liberati non insidiantem timeant sed curantem. Quia tu es benedictus Deus qui iustificas ducis ad infernum et reducis. Tu Domine libera nos de diaboli insectatione ut ante conspectum tuum possimus mundati adstare et in aeternum tecum <et> omnibus sanctis regnare ubi angeli gaudent ubi archangeli et martyres exsultant ubi Salvatorum milia et beata Maria cum beatarum exercitu virginum atque omnes sancti in gloria laetantur.
translation_en: Sanctify, Lord, the ministry of those who serve, illuminate the temple, adorn the altars, order the people, care for the sick, give remedy, prove the vow, that all may be freed from diabolical cunning and fear not the snares but heal. For you are blessed God who justifies leaders into hell and redeems. You, Lord, free us from the devil's temptation so that we may stand before your face cleansed and forever reign with you and all saints where angels rejoice, where archangels and martyrs exult, where millions of saviors and blessed Mary with the host of blessed virgins and all saints rejoice in glory.

text: Sanctifica Domine muneris oblati libamina et beatae Dei Genitricis saluberrima interventione nobis salutaria fore concede.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify the offerings we present and grant us through the salubrious intervention of the blessed Mother of God, that they may bring us salvation.

text: Sanctifica Domine oblata tibi ab infimis qui solus glorificaris in sanctis ut in tanti viri sollemnitate ante altare tuum adstantes illo repleamur caritatis tuae ardore quo idem vir plenus non solum mortem pro te capitalem praeoptavit suscipere sed ipsum quoque qui se percussurus esset voluntaria maluit remunerari mercede.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify the offerings made to you by the humblest ones, for you alone are glorified in the saints. May we, standing before your altar on this great man's solemnity, be filled with the ardor of your charity, a man who, full himself, not only preferred to suffer death for you willingly, but also chose voluntarily to be rewarded by it.

text: Sanctifica Domine oblatae hostiae munus et votis fidelium adesto propitius ut et quae offeruntur acceptes et offerentes propitiatus sanctifices.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify the offered sacrifice and be present propitiously with the prayers of the faithful, that what is offered may be accepted and those offering may be favorably sanctified.

text: Sanctifica Domine quaesumus nostra ieiunia et cunctarum nobis indulgentiam propitius largire culparum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify our fasting and graciously bestow upon us the forgiveness of all sins.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine nostra ieiunia et cunctarum nobis propitius indulgentiam largire culparum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify our fasting and to generously grant us forgiveness for all our sins.

text: Sanctifica Domine quaesumus nostra propitius ieiunia et cunctarum nobis indulgentiam largire placatus culparum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify our fasting and graciously grant us the indulgence of all. Please, appeased by our penance.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine ieiunia nostra et cunctarum nobis indulgentiam largire culparum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify our fasting and grant us the forgiveness of all our sins.

text: Sanctifica Domine quod offerimus et obtentu sancti tui Matthaei apostoli et evangelistae vel martyris suscipe sacrificium quod tibi litamus tribuens et benedictionem oblatis et meritum sumpturis.  Iustificetur o Iesu bone qui indignus praesumit et eidem tua gratia largiatur ad custodiam qui utcumque dignus et humilis venit.  Perceptione tui corporis et sanguinis uterque iam melius atque sanctius vivat. Ille ut coepit esse dignus quin immo melius stabiliter maneat; iste a lapsibus hoc sumptu correctus velociter surgat et iam omnino non concidat. Ille habeat stabilitatem bene vivendi; iste per dignam conversionem inveniat aditus ad te redeundi. Defleat iste per paenitentiam malum quod gessit; custodiat ille vel augeat bonum quod hactenus tenuit. Iste quod non habet recipiat; ille quod habet numquam penitus perdat. Iste surgat; ille non cadat. Ille caveat lapsus; iste post lapsum tibi serviendi irreflexibiles arripiat cursus. Ut dum utrisque corporis tui et sanguinis inhaeserit medicina et tibi contraria pietas tua correxerit universa et hic tuta permaneat et ad te post sine macula et ruga perveniat omnis Ecclesia tua.
translation_en:
Sanctify, Lord, what we offer and through your saint Matthew the apostle, evangelist and martyr, receive the sacrifice that we present to you, granting and blessing it and the merit we seek.
May Jesus, good Lord, who presumes unworthily, be justified by your grace and protect those who come humbly and worthily.
May both body and blood live more healthily and holier. May he who began well continue steadfastly; may he who was corrected through this sacrifice rise quickly and never fall again. May he have the stability of living well; may he, through a worthy conversion, find access to return to you.
Let him repent of the evil he has done; let him guard or increase the good that he has held. Let him who lacks receive; let him who has not completely lose it. Let him rise; let him not fall. Let him beware of falling; after a fall, may he unwaveringly serve you.
So that the medicine of your body and blood adheres to both and your contrary piety corrects all things, may this remain safe and may every Church of yours approach you without spot or wrinkle.

text: Sanctifica Domine quod per manus nostras tibi cum abstinentiae contritione litamus ut benedictionis tuae foveamur ex donis qui maiestati tuae cum ieiunii contritione offerimus hoc sacrificium laudis.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify what we offer to you with our hands in the abstinence of contrition, that we may be warmed by your blessing from the gifts which we present to you with a contrite heart during our fasting. This is the sacrifice of praise.

text: Sanctifica nos quaesumus Domine his muneribus offerendis et paschalis observantiae sufficientem nobis tribue facultatem.
translation_en: Holy Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify us as we present these offerings and grant us the ability to fulfill the duties of the Easter observance.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine Deus per tui sancti nominis invocationem huius oblationis hostiam et per eam nosmetipsos tibi perfice munus aeternum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord God, that you sanctify this offering through your holy name's invocation. And through it, perfect in you an eternal service from us.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine haec fidelium omnium vitalia sacramenta et praesta ut per ea interveniente beata Dei Genitrice Maria cum omnibus sanctis tuis animae famulorum famularumque tuarum parentum et benefactorum nostrorum ab omnibus vitiis expiatae pabulo vitae reficiantur aeternae.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the vital sacraments of all these faithful ones. And grant that through them, with the blessed Mother of God, Mary, and all your saints, the souls of your servants, masters, parents, and benefactors may be refreshed with food for eternal life, having been purified from all vices.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine hanc oblationem quam ad honorem sanctissimi patroni nostri Dubricii maiestati tuae offerimus et concede ut nos in ministratione tanti mysterii ita digni effici mereamur per quod deinceps non retrahamur ex caelestibus.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you sanctify this offering which we present to the majesty of our holy patron Dubricius for honor. Grant us, we pray, that we may be deemed worthy through this, so that henceforth we may not be withdrawn from heaven.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine hanc oblationem quam tuae pietati in celebritate beati Bricii confessoris tui atque pontificis offerimus suppliciter obsecrantes ut quod tuae maiestati oblatum est in eius commemorationem nobis proveniat in salutis augmentationem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that you sanctify this offering which we present to your piety, on the celebration of blessed Bricius, your confessor and bishop. We entreat that what was offered to your majesty for his commemoration may bring us an increase in salvation.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine oblata munera quae in venerationem sancti antistitis tui Nicolai offeruntur ut per ea vita nostra inter adversa et prospera ubique dirigatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify the gifts presented to you in honor of your saint bishop Nicholas. May our lives be guided through these offerings, whether we face adversity or prosperity, everywhere.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus Domine per beatae virginis Austrebertae intercessionem hanc quam tibi offerimus supplices oblationem et ut nobis Christi Filii tui corpus et sanguis fiat tuam desuper infunde benedictionem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that through the intercession of Blessed Virgin Austreberta, you sanctify this offering we present to you. And may your blessing, from above, pour down upon us, so that the body and blood of Christ Your Son become for us a real blessing.

text: Sanctifica quaesumus omnipotens Deus per tui sanctissimi nominis invocationem huius muneris oblationem et sanctae Etheldrithae virginis tuae intervenientibus meritis ad nostrae prosperitatis adminiculum pervenire concede sempiternum.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Almighty God, that through the invocation of your most holy name, this offering of service may reach the aid of our prosperity, and by the merits of Saint Etheldritha, your virgin, may it be granted to perpetually succeed.

text: Sanctifica redemptor mundi praesentis munera sacrificii et beatae matris Annae precibus eadem nobis effice salutaria de cuius uteri palatio mater tua aula virgineae puritatis est egressa.
translation_en: May the Redeemer of the world sanctify the gifts presented for this sacrifice, and through the prayers of Blessed Anna, may these same things bring salvation to us. Her palace, from which your mother exited as a virgin of purity, is her court.

text: Sanctifica summe Deus haec libamina quae tibi offerimus voluntate devota ut hodie perceptione sui sumentibus exhibeant omnium criminum expiationem et cras mundatis cordibus praeparent exundantem tuae dulcedinis ubertatem.
translation_en: Most high God, sanctify these offerings which we present to you with devoted will, so that today they may provide the expiration of all sins for those who partake, and tomorrow prepare clean hearts to overflow with your sweetness.

text: Sanctifica tu omnipotens Deus ea quae a te ordinata sunt; placabilitate dignatus libens suscipe quod offerimus et clemens indulge ei quod litamus; sanctorum tuorum nos gloriosa merita ne in poenam veniamus excusent; defunctorum fidelium animae quae beatitudine gaudent nobis opitulentur; quae consolatione indigent ecclesiae precibus absolvantur eorumque oblatio quorum ante altare tuum nomina recitantur ita sit in tuis oculis placita ut illis sit in beneficiis copiosa.
translation_en: May the almighty God sanctify what has been ordained by you; graciously receive, pleased with our offering, and mercifully forgive him whom we implore; may the glorious merits of your saints excuse us from punishment; may the souls of the faithful departed who rejoice in beatitude enrich us; may those who are in need of consolation be absolved by the prayers of the Church, and may their offering, whose names are mentioned before your altar, be so pleasing to you that it is abundant in benefits for them.

text: Sanctificata ieiunio tuorum corda filiorum Deus habitator illustra et quibus praestas devotionis affectum praebe supplicantibus pium benignus auditum.
translation_en: God, the dweller of light, sanctify the hearts of your children through their fasting and enlighten those to whom you grant a devout disposition. Be kind and listen graciously to those who humbly plead.

text: Sanctificata hoc ieiunio tuorum corda fidelium Deus miserator illustra et quibus devotionis praestas affectum praebe supplicantibus pium benignus auditum.
translation_en: May this fasting purify the hearts of your faithful, God, merciful one. Enlighten those to whom you grant a devout affection, and may the kind and compassionate listen to their prayers.

text: Sanctificato hoc ieiunio Deus tuorum corda fidelium miserator illustra et quibus devotionis praestas affectum praebe supplicantibus pium benignus auditum.
translation_en: This fast is sanctified by you, O God; enlighten the hearts of your faithful with your mercy and grant a loving and kind hearing to those who present themselves before you with devotion.

text: Sanctificati divino mysterio maiestatem tuam Domine suppliciter deprecamur et petimus ut famulos tuos quos donis facis caelestibus interesse per lignum sanctae crucis et a peccatis abstrahas et a periculis cunctis miseratus eripias.
translation_en: We humbly entreat your majesty, Lord, to be sanctified through the divine mystery, and we ask that you remove your servants whom you make partakers of celestial gifts from the crosswood and free them from sins, and rescue them from all dangers with mercy.

text: Sanctificati Domine salutari mysterio quaesumus ut pro nobis eorum non desit oratio quorum nos donasti patrocinio gubernari.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify us through the saving mystery. May their prayers for us never cease, whom you have entrusted to our care under your patronage.

text: Sanctificati Domine salutari mysterio quaesumus ut pro nobis eius non desit oratio cuius (nos) donasti patrocinio gubernari.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that through the saving mystery you have sanctified, you may not cease to pray for us, whose patronage you have granted to govern us.

text: Sanctificationem domus tuae Domine suppliciter recolentes benignus exaudi et sanctorum tuorum nos sacra dedicatione laetantes in eorum nos facias quaesumus sorte participes.
translation_en: Humbly remembering the sanctification of your house, Lord, may a kind and listening God hear us, and with joy in the dedication of your saints, we ask that you make us partakers by some lot.

text: Sanctificationem tuam nobis Domine his mysteriis placatus operare quae nos et a terrenis purget vitiis et ad caelestia dona perducat.
translation_en: Lord, in these mysteries please work your sanctification upon us, that we may be purified from earthly vices and led to heavenly gifts.

text: Sanctificationibus tuis omnipotens Deus et vitia nostra curentur et remedia nobis aeterna proveniant.
translation_en: With your sanctifications, Almighty God, may our sins be forgiven and eternal remedies come to us.

text: Sanctificent nos Domine sumpta mysteria et paschalis observantiae sufficientem nobis tribuant facultatem.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify us through the taking of the mysteries, and grant us sufficient ability through the observation of Pascha.

text: Sanctificet nos Domine qua pasti sumus mensa caelestis et a cunctis erroribus expiatos supernis promissionibus reddat acceptos.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify us whom you have fed at the table of heaven, and may we be made free from all errors by the promises from above, and may our offerings be accepted.

text: Sanctificet nos Domine quaesumus tui perceptio sacramenti et intercessio beatae martyris Euphemiae tibi reddat acceptos.
translation_en: May the Lord sanctify us, as we ask, through the perception of your sacrament, and may the intercession of the blessed martyr Euphemia bring our offerings to you.

text: Sanctificet nos Domine quaesumus tui perceptio sacramenti et intercessione sanctorum tibi reddat acceptos.
translation_en: May the Lord sanctify us, as we ask, through His perception of the sacrament, and through the intercession of the saints may He receive the worthy ones.

text: Sanctificet nos quaesumus Domine Deus hoc sanctum et immaculatum sacrificium vespertinum quod unigenitus Filius tuus in cruce obtulit pro salute mundi oblationem novam qua totus mundus contremuit et expavit.
translation_en: Sanctify us, we ask you, Lord God, this evening's holy and immaculate sacrifice which your only-begotten Son offered on the cross as a new oblation, by which the whole world trembled and was frightened.

text: Sanctificet nos quaesumus Domine Deus huius sacri perceptio sacramenti et gloriosa sancti intercessio Swithuni angelorum coetibus faciat aggregari.
translation_en: May we be sanctified, we ask you, Lord God, through this sacred perception of the sacrament and the glorious intercession of Saint Swithun and the assemblies of angels make us gather together.

text: Sanctificet nos quaesumus Domine et muniat intercedente beata Maria Magdalena divini muneris sacra libatio et caelestium virtutum coheredes efficiat.
translation_en: Holy Lord, we humbly ask that you sanctify us. Through the intercession of blessed Mary Magdalene, let the sacred offering of divine grace make us fellow heirs with heavenly virtues.

text: Sanctificet nos rector omnium Deus hodiernae festivitatis oblatio quam tibi offerimus pro reverentia crucis ut muniat nos ad aeterna gaudia.
translation_en: May the Director of all Gods sanctify us today on this festival, offering which we present to You, for the reverence of the cross, that He may strengthen us for eternal joys.

text: Sanctificetur quaesumus Domine haec oblata in honorem tui nominis victima ut libantes ex ea hereditatem capiamus aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to sanctify these offerings made in honor of your name as a sacrifice, so that we may inherit eternal life from them.

text: Sanctificetur quaesumus Domine Deus huius nostrae oblationis munus tua cooperante sapientia ut tibi placere possit ad laudem et nobis proficere ad salutem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord God, that your presence may sanctify this our offering, with your cooperation by wisdom. May it please you for praise and may it profit us for salvation.

text: Sanctis intervenientibus Domine tibi servitus nostra complaceat et obsequia munerum fiant praesidia devotorum.
translation_en: May the service of our servitude please you, Lord, with the intercession of the saints, and let the performances of our duties become the defenses of the devout.

text: Sancto Sebastiano interveniente Domine tibi servitus nostra complaceat et obsequia munerum fiant praesidia devotorum.
translation_en: May the service of our humble selves please you, Lord, as Saint Sebastian intercedes; and let our obedience become the defenses of the devoted.

text: Sancti Eusebii confessoris tui interventu Domine tibi servitus nostra complaceat et oblatio praesentium munerum fiat praesidium devotorum.
translation_en: May, through the intervention of your confessor Saint Eusebius, O Lord, our service please you, and may the offering of the present gifts serve as a protection for the devoted.

text: Sanctissimi martyris tui Christophori tibi precibus Domine quaesumus haec grata reddatur oblatio in cuius est festivitate immolanda.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offering made to your most holy martyr Christopher may be received gratefully, on this day of his festival when offerings are to be sacrificed.

text: Sanctissimi sacerdotis et confessoris tui Syri quaesumus Domine precibus placatus haec munera tibi in honorem eius oblata sanctifica.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that with our prayers being pleasing to you, these offerings made in honor of your saintly priest and confessor Syri be sanctified by you.

text: Sancto Menna martyre tuo interveniente ita digne fac nos quaesumus Domine haec mysteria tractare ut tibi vero aeternoque pontifici templum et hostia placabilis mereamur esse.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that with your saint, Menna the martyr intervening, we may worthily handle these mysteries. May we deserve to be a temple and pleasing sacrifice for you, the eternal and supreme pontiff.

text: Sanctorum confessurum et episcoporum Wulsini et Swithuni precibus tibi Domine quaesumus nostra grata reddatur oblatio <pro quorum est festivitate immolanda>
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the offering we make to you for the holy confessors and bishops Wulsin and Swithun may be received favorably by you. It is on their feast day that it should be offered.

text: Sanctorum confessurum nos Domine quaesumus foveat pretiosa confessio et pia iugiter intercessio tueatur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you nurture the precious confession of the saints and may a constant and holy intercession protect us.

text: Sanctorum consessorum tuorum nos quaesumus Domine merita tueantur et eorum commendet oratio veneranda.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may the merits of your saints protect us and may their venerable prayer recommend us.

text: Sanctorum Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii quaesumus Domine natalicia nobis vota resplendeant et quod illis contulit excellentiam sempiternam fructibus nostrae devotionis (ac)crescat.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the nativity vows of Saints Cyrinus and Nazarius shine upon us, and that what they were given, eternal excellence, may increase through the fruits of our devotion.

text: Sanctorum decus remunerator iustorum Deus qui super omnes et per omnia et in omnibus nobis es cui sacrificium est cor contritum et oratio purum incensum tribue nobis per intercessionem beatissimi Pauli apostoli sanctificationem cordis fervorem spiritus corporis puritatem ut mortificatis terrenis vitiis immaculati spiritu et corpore nostro tibi semper laudis hostias referamus.
translation_en: Rewarder of the glory of the saints, righteous God, who art above all and through all and in all, to whom a contrite heart is sacrifice and a pure prayer an offering, grant us through the intercession of the most blessed Apostle Paul, the sanctification of our hearts, the fervor of our spirit, the purity of our body, that we may always offer to Thee, with an undefiled spirit and body, the hosts of perpetual praise.

text: Sanctorum Domine martyrum tuorum supplicationibus tribue nos foveri ut quorum venerabilem <diem> annuo frequentamus obsequio eorum et intercessionibus commendemur et meritis.
translation_en: Lord of the saints, grant us to be nourished by the supplications of your martyrs, so that we may honor their venerable day with our attendance and commit ourselves to their intercessions, and be protected by their merits.

text: Sanctae martyris tuae Caeciliae Domine supplicationibus tribue nos foveri ut cuius venerabilem sollemnitatem praevenimus obsequio eius intercessionibus commendemur et meritis.
translation_en: Lord, through the supplications of your holy martyr Cecilia, grant us to be protected, so that by following her venerable solemnity we may be committed to her intercessions and merits.

text: Sancti Domine confessoris tui illius tribue nos supplicationibus foveri ut cuius depositionem annuo celebramus obsequio eius apud te intercessionibus et meritis commendemur.
translation_en: Lord, grant us, your saintly confessor, to be nurtured by our supplications, so that we who celebrate the anniversary of his deposition may commend ourselves before you through his intercessions and merits.

text: Sanctorum Domine sancta deferimus quae cum in omnium iustorum tibi commemoratione sint placita multo magis in angelicae veneratione substantiae grata tuis adspectibus esse confidimus.
translation_en: Lord of the Saints, we bring before you the holy things which, in the remembrance of all the just, are pleasing to you. We have great confidence that they find favor in your sight, especially when venerated by angels.

text: Sanctorum Felicis et Adaucti natalicia recensentes munus offerimus quod eorum tibi Domine quaesumus intercessione sit gratum.
translation_en: On the feast of Saints Felix and Adauctus, we offer this new gift to you, Lord, which we humbly ask may be pleasing to You through their intercession.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum atque pontificum illius et illius gloriosa merita venerantes haec Domine munera tuae maiestati offerimus obsecrantes ut illis reverentiam exhibendo nobis veniam impetremus.
translation_en: We, venerating the merits of your holy martyrs and bishops, offer these gifts to your majesty, humbly asking that by showing them respect, we may obtain forgiveness for ourselves.

text: Sanctorum Gervasii et Protasii suffragiis imploramus ut a cunctis Domine liberemur offensis.
translation_en: We humbly ask for the intercession of Saints Gervasius and Protasius, that You, Lord, deliver us from all offenses.

text: Sanctorum martyrum Kiliani sociorumque eius Domine natalicia praedicantes supplices te deprecamur et petimus ut quos caelesti gloria sublimasti tuis semper facias adesse fidelibus.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, on the feast day of the martyrs Saint Kilian and his companions, that those whom you have raised to celestial glory may always be present with the faithful before you.

text: Sanctorum martyrum nos Domine Gervasii et Protasii confessio beata communiat et fragilitatis nostrae subsidium dignanter exoret.
translation_en: Lord, may the confession of the holy martyrs Gervasius and Protasius communicate for us the blessed fellowship and petition worthily on behalf of our weakness.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum Domine supplicatione placatus et veniam nobis tribue peccatorum et remedia sempiterna concede.
translation_en: Lord, moved by the supplications of your martyrs, grant us forgiveness for our sins and everlasting remedies.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum nos Domine quaesumus quatuor coronatorum pia apud te intercessio iuvet et sua faciat sollemnitate iuste gaudere.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the intercession of your four martyrs may help us, and that they may cause us to justly rejoice through their solemnity.

text: Sanctorum memoratis nominibus supplex te Domine rogo ut eorum meritis omnibus peccatis meis propitiatus esse digneris salvumque facias me et omnes quos dedisti mihi ut nemo ex eis pereat vel quaecumque contulisti alia sine laesione conserva teque potius iugiter prosperante universa de sedibus tuis mea eliminentur plaga omnis auferatur infirmitas cuncta propellatur egestas pestis et interitus proturbentur temptationes diabolicae fugiant scandala et adversitates omnium procul abscedant; ingrediatur autem ad nos gratia tuae benedictionis et pacis ut sit in tabernaculis meis securitas et requies salus et vita veritas et laetitia iucunda felicitas; tuaque fortitudine mea sustentetur fragilitas prolongetur vita roboretur iuventus omnique milita praedamnata beata vita properet; hanc autem oblationem libens sanctifica et defunctis omnibus requiem dona.
translation_en: In memory of the saints, humbly I ask you, Lord, that through their merits, you would be pleased to forgive all my sins and save me and all whom you have given me, so that none may perish from among them, or any other calamity occur without harm. May you be preserved forever prospering, and may all plagues, afflictions, want, pestilence, death, trials, temptations of the devil, scandals, adversities, far removed from us; may your grace and blessing enter our homes, bringing security, rest, health, life, truth, and joyful felicity. May my weakness be supported by your strength, my life prolonged, my youth strengthened, and all my battles blessed with a happy, blest life. May this offering be willingly sanctified by you, and may peace be given to all the departed.

text: Sanctorum omnium Deum patrem omnipotentem deprecemur ut oblationes famulorum ac famularum suarum placido <ac> sereno vultu respicere dignetur.
translation_en: We entreat the God, Father Almighty of all saints, that He may look upon the offerings of His servants and their servants with a calm and peaceful countenance and deign to grant them His favor.

text: Sanctorum omnium gloriosa confessione Deus tribue nobis timorem nominis tui quod etiam initium sapientiae praedixisti ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus tuorum admixti conciliis misericordiae tuae dapibus saginemur.
translation_en: Grant us, O God, with the glorious confession of all saints, a fear of your name, which even the beginning of wisdom you have foretold, so that we may be nourished by these holy things mixed with your merciful feasts.

text: Sanctorum omnium gloriosa confessio Deus tribuat nobis quaesumus ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus tuorum admixti conciliis misericordiae tuae dapibus saginemur.
translation_en: We ask, God, that the glorious confession of all saints be granted to us: that we may be nourished with meat from your merciful banquets mixed with these holy things which we have received.

text: Sanctorum omnium gloriosa protectio Deus qui beato martyri tuo Symphoriano auxilium non negasti et per iniqua mortis ludibria ad hanc gloriam vocare dignatus es praesta ut similis nos fides martyri copulet quos tempus passionis in stadio non reliquit ac sicut illum iter durum et scrupulosum per aerumnas passionum paradiso collocavit ita nos praesentium voluptatum contemptus.
translation_en: May the glorious protection of all saints, God, who did not deny aid to your blessed martyr Symphorian and deemed worthy to call him to this glory through the mockeries of an unjust death, grant that our faith may be adorned with the courage of martyrdom, like those whom time did not leave in the stadium of passion. Just as He placed Him in Paradise after a hard and painful journey through the troubles of Passion, so may He place us in contempt of present pleasures.

text: Sanctorum precibus Domine confidentes quaesumus; per ea quae sumpsimus aeterna remedia capiamus.
translation_en: With confidence we ask you, Lord, through the prayers of the saints; may we obtain eternal remedies for what we have received.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine precibus confidentes quaesumus ut per ea quae sumpsimus aeterna remedia capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, with confidence in your saints' prayers, we humbly ask that through what we have received from them, we may obtain eternal remedies.

text: Sanctorum precibus confidentes quaesumus Domine ut per ea quae sumpsimus aeterna remedia capiamus.
translation_en: Confident in the prayers of the saints, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through what we have received from them, we may obtain eternal remedies.

text: Sanctae Sotheris precibus confidentes
translation_en: Confident in the prayers of Saint Sothis

text: Sanctorum trium regum et magorum tuorum Gaspar Melchior et Balthassar quaesumus Domine intercessio gloriosa nos protegat ubique et adiuvet ac per haec sancta quae sumpsimus sacramenta a peccatorum nostrorum vinculis nos absolvat et ab omnibus inimicis tueatur semper et muniat et ad tuam praesentiam te donante perducat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the glorious intercession of your three kings and magi, Gaspar, Melchior, and Balthasar, protect and help us everywhere. May these holy gifts we have received free us from the bonds of our sins and always guard, shield, and protect us from all enemies. May they lead us to your presence, through your gracious giving.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine communicantes memoriae patriarcharum prophetarumque tuorum non sumus immemores. Ipsis enim praenuntiantibus adventus tuus claruit mundo. Memoramus etiam apostolos tuos qui adventum tuum a prophetis patriarchisque praedictum oculis suis cernere meruerunt. Facimus quoque et tuorum martyrum sanctorum mentionem qui te dominum redemptorem iam venisse confessi ad mortem usque sunt certati pro veritate. Fidelium praeterea tuorum in hac adhuc peregrinatione degentium nomina recensemus poscentes ut eorum vitae cursum ea perfectione consummes qua sanctos tuos apud te in caelesti habitaculo locatos perfectosque iam retines. Non obliviscimur quoque defunctos naturae nostrae ac fidei socios sed precamur te dominum amplissimae pietatis ut eis refrigeria tribuas sempiternae quietis.
translation_en: Lord, communicating with the memory of your patriarchs and prophets, we are not forgetful. For it was they who preannounced your coming to lighten the world. We also remember your apostles who merited to see your coming announced by prophets and patriarchs with their own eyes. We make mention also of your martyrs and saints who have confessed that you, Lord and Redeemer, had already come, even unto death, for the truth. Let us also recall the names of those faithful ones among us still on this pilgrimage, asking that you may perfect their lives with the same perfection wherewith you have placed your saints in the celestial dwelling. We do not forget also those who have passed from our nature and faith, but we pray to you, Lord of boundless mercy, that you grant them eternal rest.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine festa celebrantibus nobis opem misericordiae tribue ut qui coronam martyrum non meremur saltem a venia non repellamur.
translation_en: Lord, grant us help in the festivities of your saints, so that we who do not deserve the crown of martyrs may at least not be turned away from mercy.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine Albani Paulini et Nicetii episcopi cum nongentis octoginta novem quorum festa celebramus intercessione opem misericordiae tuae tribue ut qui coronam martyrii tui non meremur a venia saltem non repellamur.
translation_en: Lord, grant us the help and mercy of your grace through the intercession of your saints Alban, Paulinus, and Nicetius, bishops, along with their nine hundred and eighty-nine companions whose feast we celebrate. May those who do not merit the crown of your martyrdom at least not be turned away from your mercy.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine intercessio misericordiae tuae munera nostra commendet ut quae nostris meritis obtinere non possumus ipsorum assequi precibus mereamur.
translation_en: Lord, may the intercession of your saints commend to you the gifts of your mercy, so that we may deserve to obtain through their prayers what we cannot achieve with our own merits.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporali celebramus actione perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, through the intercession of your saints, we ask that you be pleased to grant us, as we celebrate temporal things, that we may obtain eternal salvation through perpetual action.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine Nerei et Achillei tibi grata confessio et munera nostra commendet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper imploret.
translation_en: Lord, we offer to you a grateful confession and gifts for your Saints Nereus and Achilles. May they always pray for our forgiveness on your behalf.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine precibus adiuvemur et quod possibilitas nostra non obtinet eorum nobis postulatione donetur.
translation_en: Lord, we are supported by the prayers of your saints. Grant us what we cannot obtain by our own power through their intercession.

text: Sanctorum martyrum tuorum illorum nos quaesumus Domine precibus adiuvemur ut quod nostra possibilitas non obtinet eorum nobis qui ante te iusti inventi sunt oratione donetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to help us with their prayers that what our abilities do not obtain may be given to us by the intercession of those just men who were found before you (the martyrs).

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine victorias recolentes sacramenta veneranda percepimus quae praestent nobis quaesumus eorum meritis indulgentiam in quorum dormitione tuam magnificentiam collaudamus.
translation_en: Remembering the victories of your saints, Lord, we have perceived with reverence the sacred mysteries which they bestow upon us. We humbly ask for their merits to grant us indulgence. In their sleep, we praise your greatness.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine vocabulis recensitis offerentium quoque votis ac dormientium spiritibus memoratis abundantissimam tuae pietatis clementiam postulamus ut sanctis praemia promissa restituens offerentibus fructum bonae voluntatis accumules et defunctorum spiritibus aeterni refrigerii quiete laetifices.
translation_en: Lord, we ask for the abundant mercy of your divine pity, as remembered by the prayers and spirits of those offering vows and sleeping, recounting your saints. We implore that you restore the promised rewards to the offering ones, accumulating the fruit of good will for them, and bring eternal rest and peace to the spirits of the departed.

text: Sanctorum tuorum intercessione miseris esto Domine refugium singulare quorum pro nobis et honore placeris et merito.
translation_en: Through the intercession of your saints, O Lord, be a unique refuge for them, for whom it pleases you to help us in honor and by right.

text: Sanctorum tuorum intercessionibus quaesumus Domine et nos protege et famulis et famulabus tuis quorum commemorationem agimus vel quorum eleemosynas recepimus seu etiam his qui nobis familiaritate iuncti sunt misericordiam tuam ubique praetende ut ab omnibus impugnationibus defensi tua opitulatione salventur et animas famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium videlicet fidelium catholicorum orthodoxorum quorum commemorationem agimus et quorum corpora in hoc monasterio requiescunt vel quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum scripta adesse videntur electorum tuorum iungere digneris consortio.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, through the intercession of Your saints, to protect us and our servants and those who serve You, whom we remember or whose alms we have received, or even those who are joined to us in familiarity. May Your mercy be always present for us to be defended from all attacks by Your aid and saved. May the souls of Your servants, servants and all faithful Catholics and Orthodox whose memory we keep and whose bodies rest in this monastery, or whose names written before Your holy altar appear to be among Your chosen ones, grant You the honor to join their fellowship.

text: Sanctorum tuorum nobis Domine pia non desit oratio quae et munera nostra conciliet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper obtineat.
translation_en: Lord, may your loving prayer for your saints never fail us, which gathers our offerings and may always obtain your indulgence for us.

text: Sancti confessoris tui Augustini nobis Domine pia non desit oratio quae et munera nostra conciliet et tuam nobis indulgentiam semper obtineat.
translation_en: Lord, may the prayer for your saint confessor Augustine never cease for us, which also brings together our gifts and may always obtain your indulgence for us.

text: Sanctorum tuorum nos Domine continua sollemnitate comitare ut qui nostris meritis impedimur eorum qui tibi placuerunt precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Lord, continue to accompany us with the solemnity of your saints, that we who are hindered by our own merits may be assisted by their prayers on your behalf.

text: Sanctorum tuorum nos Domine Cyrici et Iulittae matris eius sociorumque eorum memoriam venerantes quaesumus ut qui illis victoriae coronam contulisti nobis eorum meritis delictorum indulgentiam largiaris.
translation_en: Lord, as we remember your saints Cyrus and Julitta, along with their companions, we humbly ask that you who granted them the crown of victory, may grant us forgiveness for our sins through their merits.

text: Sanctorum (tuorum) nos Domine Marcelli et Apulei beata merita prosequamur et tuo semper faciant amore ferventes.
translation_en: May we, Lord, following after the merits of your saints Marcellus and Apuleius, always be fervent in our love towards you.

text: Sanctorum tuorum nos Domine Marci et Marcelliani natalicia tueantur quia tanto fiducialius tuo nomini supplicamus quanto frequentius martyrum benedictionibus confovemur.
translation_en: May your saints, Lord Mark and Marcellian, protect us, for we more confidently appeal to your name the more frequently we are nourished by the blessings of the martyrs.

text: Sanctorum tuorum nos Domine patrocinia collata non deserant quae fragilitatem nostram et precibus tueantur et meritis.
translation_en: Lord, under the patronage of your saints, we are not abandoned; they protect our frailty with their prayers and safeguard us with their merits.

text: Sanctorum tuorum nos quaesumus Domine semper festa laetificent et maiestati tuae perpetua placatione commendem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your saints may always delight us with their festive days, and we commend ourselves to your majesty through perpetual appeasement.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Coronatorum quaesumus Domine semper nos festa laetificent et maiestati tuae perpetua placatione commendem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that your coronated saints may always rejoice us with their festivals, and we commend ourselves to your majesty through perpetual appeasement.

text: Sanctorum tuorum quaesumus Domine semper nos festa laetificent et maiestati tuae perpetua placatione confirmem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the festivals of your saints may always bring us joy, and that we may be continually confirmed by the eternal appeasement of your majesty.

text: Sanctorum tuorum quaesumus Domine innumerabilium martyrum Caesaraugustanorum pia pro nobis non desit oratio qui pro nomine unigeniti Filii tui mortem non timentes inclito decorari meruerunt martyrio.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, for your countless martyrs of Caesaraugusta, may their pious prayers not cease for us. They have deserved to be adorned with the glorious martyrdom, fearing not death, for the sake of the name of your only-begotten Son.

text: Sanctorum tuorum quaesumus Domine quorum nos assiduis festivitatibus consolaris defende praesidiis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to protect us with the shields of your saints whose feast days we often celebrate.

text: Sanctus Domine Gorgonius sua nos intercessione laetificet et pia faciat sollemnitate gaudere.
translation_en: Lord Gorgonius may his intercession delight us, and may he make us rejoice with a devout celebration.

text: Satiasti Domine familiam tuam muneribus sacris; eius quaesumus semper interventione nos refove cuius sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, you have satisfied your family with sacred gifts; we always implore your intervention to refresh us, whose solemnities we are celebrating.

text: Satiasti nos Domine in hac sollemnitate sancti Sampsonis confessoris tui atque pontificis muneribus sacris; te quaesumus ut Ecclesiae tuae pacem fidem spem et caritatem multiplicare digneris per quas tibi in Ecclesia tua placere mereamur.
translation_en: You have filled us, Lord, in this solemnity of your confessor and bishop Saint Samson, with the sacred offices; we humbly ask you to grant that your Church may be multiplied with peace, faith, hope, and charity through which we may be worthy to please you in your Church.

text: Satiati atque redempti Agni tui dapibus aeterne omnipotens Deus concede nobis ut sicut ille apostolo comestus integer perseverat et vivus ita nos mortificati a colluvionibus in tuis semper revivescere mereamur assuetis iustificationibus.
translation_en: Eternal, all-powerful God, who have satisfied and redeemed your Lamb with eternal food, grant us that we may persevere as the apostle did, undefiled while eating, and live on. May we, being purified from worldly stains, always revive in your service, meriting to be accustomed to justifications.

text: Satiati caelestibus donis omnipotens Deus praesta quaesumus ut spiritum famuli tui illius a corporis nexibus absolutum in prima resurrectione facias praesentari.
translation_en: All-powerful God, we humbly ask that you satisfy the celestial gifts bestowed upon us. Grant that on the first resurrection, you may free the spirit of your servant from the bodily bonds and present it.

text: Satiati caelestibus donis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut animam famuli tui a nexibus corporis absolutam in sanctorum tuorum resurrectione facias praesentari.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to satisfy our servant with heavenly gifts, and that you grant him freedom from the bonds of the body at your saints' resurrection, allowing him to appear among them.

text: Satiati Domine de tuis muneribus maiestatem tuam supplices exoramus ut intercedente beato Sampsone confessore tuo atque pontifice spe fide et caritate nos iugiter repleas et ad regna caelestia feliciter perducas.
translation_en: Lord, we who are humbly supplicating you, are satisfied with your gifts. We entreat your majesty that, through the intercession of the blessed Samuel as your confesor and pontiff, may faith, hope, and charity continually fill us, and happily lead us to heavenly realms.

text: Satiati Domine muneribus sacris beatorum confessurum tuorum Audoeni Martini Nicolai Aegidii Gregorii Leonardi quaesumus semper interventione nos refove quorum commemoratione gaudemus.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you to satiate the sacred offerings of your blessed confessors Audoin, Martin, Nicolas, Aegidius, Gregory, and Leonardo. We always pray that through their intervention, you revive us; in whose commemoration, we rejoice.

text: Satiati Domine muneribus sacris quaesumus clementiam tuam ut beatae illius electae tuae intercessione nobis prosint ad veniam.
translation_en: We beseech you, Lord, to satisfy us with sacred gifts. We humbly ask for your clemency that through the intercession of your chosen one, they may help us attain forgiveness.

text: Satiati Domine muneribus sacris te quaesumus ut beati Birini intercessione a cunctis semper liberemur adversis.
translation_en: Satiated, Lord, with sacred offerings, we humbly ask you that through the intercession of Blessed Birinus, we may always be freed from all adversities.

text: Satiati Domine quaesumus muneribus sacris eius nos precibus ubique protege cuius festa sollemnia celebramus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you satisfy us with your sacred gifts and protect us everywhere with your prayers, for whose feast we are celebrating solemnities.

text: Satiati et inebriati caelestibus alimentis fac nos quaesumus Domine aeterna fruitione consequi quae mysticis sumpsimus sacramentis.
translation_en: Satisfy and intoxicate us with heavenly food, we ask you, Lord, that we may obtain the eternal enjoyment which we have received mysteriously through the sacraments.

text: Satiati munere salutari tuam Domine misericordiam deprecamur ut hoc eodem sacramento quo nos temporaliter vegetas efficias perpetuae vitae participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to satisfy us with your saving grace. Grant us that in this same sacrament through which we are nourished temporally, we may become participants of eternal life.

text: Satiati participatione caelesti et gratias tibi referimus Domine Deus noster et ut nobis fiat perpetua deprecamur.
translation_en: We are satisfied with heavenly participation and we refer our thanks to you, Lord our God. And we pray that it may be everlasting for us.

text: Satiati sumus Domine muneribus sacris quae tanto nobis uberius credimus profutura quanto sanctius haec meritis intercedentibus martyrum nos percepisse confidimus.
translation_en: We have been satisfied, Lord, with sacred gifts which we believe will be more beneficial to us the more holy these are through the merits of the martyrs intervening, on whom we confidently rely to have perceived.

text: Satiatis Domine munerum tuorum donis auxilium gratiae tuae rogatus impende et auribus tuae pietatis nostras miserando preces benignus exaudi ut meritis sancti praesulis Aidani et intercessione adiuti in electorum tuorum numero aeterna in saecula censeamur.
translation_en: Lord, with your gifts satiate us; grant us help through your grace, as we humbly ask. Bend your ear to our prayers of devotion and, in mercy, listen benevolently to us. May the merits of the holy bishop Aidan and assistance through his intercession place us among your chosen ones for eternal life in the ages to come.

text: Satiatus corpore ac sanguine Domini nostri Iesu Christi gratias tibi ago Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus petens divinam clementiam tuam ut haec communicatio non sit mihi ad condemnationem sed ad reparationem mentis ad tutelam fidei ad evacuandam omnem inimici potestatem.
translation_en: I thank you, Lord holy Father almighty eternal God, for being filled with the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ. I ask for your divine clemency that this communion may not be a condemnation for me, but a repair for my mind, a safeguard for my faith, and an expulsion of every power of my enemy.

text: Satisfaciat tibi Domine quaesumus pro anima famuli tui illius sacrificii praesentis oblatio; et peccatorum veniam quam quaesivit inveniat et quod officio vocis implere non potuit desideratae paenitentiae compensatione percipiat.
translation_en: May the offering of this sacrifice, we beseech you, Lord, satisfy for the soul of your servant; and may he find the forgiveness of his sins that he sought, and may he receive the compensation of desired penance for what he was unable to fulfill in duty or voice.

text: Scindentes corda nostra et non vestimenta tuam Deus summe imploramus clementiam ut qui hoc die in hoc loco convenimus deflere mala quae gessimus caelestis flammae igniculo concrememur quo dum vis caritatis tuae in nostris cordibus exaestuat peccati a nobis potentia detrudatur exusta.
translation_en: Breaking our hearts, we most humbly beseech your clemency, O God, that we who have gathered here on this day may be purified by the celestial flame and burning coal of your love. May the power of our sin be destroyed while the strength of your charity continues to burn in our hearts.

text: Semper Domine sanctorum martyrum Cyrini Naboris et Nazarii sollemnia celebramus et eorum patrocinia iugiter sentiamus.
translation_en: We always celebrate the feast days of the holy martyrs Cyrinus, Nabor, and Nazarius, and we continually feel their patronage.

text: Semper Domine quaesumus fac populum tuum sanctorum martyrum patrocinio gratulari ut beneficia tua quae propriis obsecrationibus obtinere non sufficit iustorum tuorum suffragiis incessanter accipiat.
translation_en: Always, Lord, we humbly ask that your people rejoice with the patronage of your holy martyrs, so that they may continuously receive your blessings, which the just prayers of your own do not fully obtain, through the constant intercession of your saints.

text: Semper nos Domine martyrum tuorum Nerei et Achillei foveat quaesumus beata sollemnitas et tuo dignos reddat obsequio.
translation_en: Always, we ask you, Lord, may your blessed solemnity protect the martyrs Nereus and Achilles. Grant us worthy service to please you.

text: Semper nos Domine quaesumus continentia salutaris erudiat quae et nos ieiunio intentos efficiat puriores et tua nobis dona conciliet.
translation_en: Always, Lord, we humbly ask that a salutary wisdom of continence educates us. May it make us who are focused on fasting more pure, and may your gifts unite with us.

text: Sempiterna Trinitas Deus cuius potentia est prosternere fortia et elevare humilia in his sacris caeremoniis clementiam tuam suppliciter deprecamur ut omni Ecclesiae tuae praestes auxilium et sicut liberasti filios Israel de manibus Aegyptiorum ita libera populum tuum christianum de oppressione paganorum et da victoriam servis tuis quatenus Ecclesiae tuae status erigatur in sublime et perfidi deiiciantur ad infima ut christiani gaudeant de hereditate tua et in omnibus tua protegente dextera semper catholica gratuletur Ecclesia.
translation_en: Everlasting Trinity, God, whose power is to overthrow the strong and lift up the humble in these sacred ceremonies, we humbly entreat your clemency that you provide help for all your Church and just as you freed the sons of Israel from the hands of the Egyptians, so free your Christian people from the oppression of pagans. Give victory to your servants so that the status of your Church may be raised high, and the deceitful be cast down to the lowest depths. May Christians rejoice in your inheritance and always the Catholic Church be grateful to you with your protecting hand in all things.

text: Sempiternae pietatis tuae abundantiam Domine supplices imploramus ut nos beneficiis quibus non meremur anticipans benefacere cognoscaris indignis.
translation_en: In humble supplication, we ask you, Lord, for the abundance of your eternal mercy. May you, in advance, grant us benefits that we do not deserve, and recognize us as unworthy.

text: Sempiternum dominum infinitum ingenitum immortalem devotae mentis desiderium cordis habitatorem deprecemur ut ecclesiam sanctam catholicam perpetua defensione tueatur.
translation_en: We humbly entreat the eternal, infinite, and immortal Lord, dweller of the devoted mind and heart's desire, to protect the Holy Catholic Church perpetually by His defending grace.

text: Sensibus nostris quaesumus Domine lumen sanctum tuum benignus infunde ut tibi semper simus devoti cuius sapientia creati sumus et providentia gubernamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to pour down your holy light upon our senses, that we may always be devoted to you, whom we were created by wisdom and governed by your providence.

text: Sentiamus Domine quaesumus tui perceptione sacramenti subsidium mentis et corporis ut in utroque salvati (de) caelestis remedii plenitudine gloriemur.
translation_en: Let us feel, we beseech you Lord, the support of your perception in the sacrament for both mind and body, so that in both we may glory in the fullness of the celestial remedy's salvation.

text: Serena pietate intende oblata quaesumus omnipotens Deus libamina et obtentu beatissimi Neoti confessoris tui atque abbatis praesenti familiae tuae ad prosperitatem vitae futurae affore concede.
translation_en: With a serene devotion, we humbly ask you, almighty God, to accept the offerings and grant us the intercession of your blessed Confessor and Abbot Neotus, present before you. We pray that these favors will lead to prosperity in future life.

text: Si ante oculos tuos Domine culpas quas facimus et plagas quas excipimus conferamus minus est quod patimur maius est quod meremur. Peccati poenam sentimus et peccandi pertinaciam non vitamus. In flagellis tuis fragilitas nostra frangitur et iniquitas non mutatur. Mens aegrota torquetur et cervix dura non flectitur. Vita in dolore suspirat et in opere non emendat.  Si exspectas non corrigimur; si vindicas non duramus. Confitemur in corruptione quod laesimus; obliviscimur in visitatione quod flevimus. Si impressis manum facienda promittimus; si suspenderis gladium promissa non facimus. Si ferias clamamus ut parcas; si parcis iterum te provocamus ut ferias. Si angustiae venient tempus petimus paenitendi; si misericordia subveniat abutimur patientia quae pepercit. Adhuc plaga illata vix praeterit et iam non recolet mens ingrata quod pertulit. Si citius exaudias ex misericordia insolescimus; si tardius ex impatientia murmuramus.  Te Domine volumus servare quod feceris et nos non timemus observare quod iusseris. Habes Domine confitentes reos; parce quia pius es. Novimus quod nisi dimittas recte nos punias sed apud te multa miseratio et propitiatio perabundans. Praesta sine merito quod rogamus qui fecisti ex nihilo qui rogarent.
translation_en:
If before your eyes, Lord, we bring our sins and the wounds we receive, it is less that we suffer, it is more that we deserve. We feel the penalty of sin and do not desire its persistence. In your chastisements, our frailty breaks, but iniquity does not change. A sick mind is twisted, a stiff neck does not bend. Life sighs in pain and does not amend in work. If we are not corrected, if you avenge us, we confess our wrongdoings; but in your visitation we forget what we have wept for. If we promise to make amends with outstretched hands, if we fail to keep our promises when the sword is suspended, we cry out for mercy, yet again provoke you to punish when you spare us. In times of distress we plead for penance; if mercy comes upon us we abuse it by testing your patience that has spared us. The wound inflicted still lingers and a grateful mind does not forget what it has endured. If you listen more quickly out of mercy, we grow insolent; if you are slow out of impatience we complain.
Lord, we desire to be preserved by what you do, and we have no fear of observing what you command. You, Lord, have those who confess as guilty; spare us because you are merciful. We know that unless you forgive us justly, you will punish us righteously, but at your hands there is much mercy and abundant propitiation. Grant us without merit what we ask, who created from nothing those who would ask of you.

text: Si dignanter Domine repetitas tibi preces in numero revolutae supplicationis admittis in huius tamen celeberrima martyris tui Zoili festivitate praesta Domine ut des sacerdotibus gloriam clericis palmam regibus catholicis assiduitatem litigantibus finem fluctuantibus quietem nudis tegumentum esurientibus panem sitientibus potum dubitantibus fidem virginibus honorem pupillis tuitionem viduis castitatem defunctis requiem m quidquid totius orbis Dominus palmo mentis amplecteris excelso etiam virtutis tuae brachio intercessu tui martyris tuearis.
translation_en: If, Lord, you deem it worthy to receive our prayers according to the number of the returned supplication, grant us in the festivity of your most renowned martyr Zoilus, that you bestow upon the priests glory, upon the clerics the palm, upon the Catholic kings steadfastness, upon those contending an end, upon those tossing about peace, upon the naked a covering, upon the hungry bread, upon the thirsty drink, upon the doubting faith, upon virgins honor, upon orphans protection, upon widows chastity, upon the departed rest. Whatever part of the whole world, Lord, that your palm of mind may embrace, even with the elevated arm of your virtue, through the intercession of your martyr, you shall protect.

text: Si iniquitates nostras observaveris Domine quis sustinebit? – Precamur ergo clementiam tuam ut ubi nulla fiducia suppetit actionum gratia tua copiosa resplendeat et? cum delicta remittit indignis et cum beneficia praestat immeritis.
translation_en: If you, Lord, should observe our iniquities, who could bear it? – Therefore we pray for your clemency that where there is no trust to support our actions, may your abundant grace shine. When you forgive the unworthy and when you bestow benefits upon the undeserving.

text: Si nos Domine in oratione nostra mali operis facta non premerent difficilem obtinendi viam preces quas fundimus non haberent. Sed necesse est impossibile esse quid petitur quibus sit contemptibile quod iubetur. Nam tibi iniquitas abrogat quod praestare tua deitas non laborat. Votorum nostrorum studia vincunt negotia meritorum. Non habent efficax desiderium qui sit pervicax ad reatum dumque res peccato plena nos cruciat non habet fides opere vacua quod exspectat; quae etsi sit confessa quod crederet non tamen operata est quod placeret. Sic nempe agitur ut dum non observat instituta quod didicit non accipiet improvida quod poposcit.  Da igitur Domine ut dum in honorem martyrum tuorum illorum sacro altario hostiam immolamus nobis proficiat ad salutem et defunctis fidelibus ad requiem.
translation_en: If, Lord, the works of evil that we have made in our prayer do not press down on us the difficult way of obtaining our petitions. But it is necessary for what is asked to be something that is esteemed as impossible, since what is commanded should not be despised. For iniquity abolishes that your divinity does not labor to provide. The studies of our vows overcome the merits of our deeds. Those who lack a steadfast desire do not have effectual works when they are obstinate towards sin, and while sins full of guilt torment us, there is no empty faith that expects; even if it is confessed that one believes, it has not been carried out as desired. Thus, it is acted upon that while not observing the institutions that one has learned, one will not receive thoughtlessly what one asks for. Therefore, Lord, grant that when we offer a sacrifice on the sacred altar of your martyrs, it may benefit us towards salvation and the faithful departed towards rest.

text: Si vis potens es mundare Domine et quam vox iniquitatis nostrae non obtinet tuorum nobis precibus veniam donare sanctorum.
translation_en: If you are powerful, Lord, you can cleanse us. May the voice of our iniquity not prevail; grant us forgiveness through your prayers to the saints.

text: Sic nos quaesumus Domine beati Ioannis apostoli tui et evangelistae sollemnia tuis fac celebrare mysteriis ut quae praedicavit et credamus pariter et sequamur.
translation_en: In this way, we humbly ask You, Lord, through Your blessed apostle John and evangelist, that You make Your solemnities be celebrated with mysteries. So that what he preached, we may believe equally and follow.

text: Sicut ad munera Abel Domine Deus vultu placito respexisti ita quaesumus haec sacrificia sint tibi placita ut beati Apollinaris martyris tui atque pontificis digne peragamus votiva sollemnia.
translation_en: As you looked favorably upon the offerings of Abel, Lord God, with a pleasing countenance, so we humbly ask that these sacrifices may be pleasing to you. May we worthy perform the vows' solemnities of your blessed martyr and bishop, Apollinaris.

text: Sicut beati illius confessoris Domine atque pontificis merita tibi sunt acceptabilia ita eo obtinente sacrificia nostra tibi sint placabilia.
translation_en: As the merits of that blessed confessor and bishop are acceptable to You, Lord, so may our sacrifices be pleasing to You when he is obtaining them.

text: Sicut beatum Laudum confessorem tuum atque pontificem Domine ad aeternam gloriam transtulisti sic ipsius meritis quaesumus ad salutem nostram hanc praesentem sanctifica hostiam.
translation_en: As you, Lord, transported your blessed Confessor and Pope to eternal glory, so by his merits we humbly ask that you sanctify this present hosting for our salvation.

text: Sicut beatus Eustachius cum sociis suis Domine in caelesti claritate purus rutilat sic sancta quae sumpsimus illis intercedentibus puros nos tibi efficiant.
translation_en: Just as blessed Eustachius and his companions shine pure in celestial brightness before the Lord, so may the saints we have taken to be our intercessors make us pure before you.

text: Sicut dedisti Domine Deus manna in deserto gratuito munere immeritis et ingratis ita precibus beati martyris tui Apollinaris tribue acquisitis cibum salutis aeternae.
translation_en: As you gave, Lord God, manna freely in the wilderness to the unworthy and ungrateful, so by the prayers of your blessed martyr Apollinaris grant the earned food of eternal salvation.

text: Sicut gloriam divinae potentiae munera pro sanctis oblata testantur sic nobis effectum Domine tuae salvationis impendant.
translation_en: Just as the gifts offered for the saints bear witness to the glory of divine power, so may your grace, Lord, bestow upon us the effects of your salvation.
