text: Sicut in beati martyris tui Albani veneratione te mirabilem praedicamus sic Domine clementiam tuam per haec piae placationis officia pro nobis ipse pius interventor exoret.
translation_en: As we proclaim you marvelous in the veneration of your blessed martyr Alban, so Lord, may your mercy plead for us through these holy acts of devotion. May you yourself, as the merciful intercessor, petition on our behalf.

text: Sint tibi Domine quaesumus nostrae munera grata devotionis quae in sanctorum confessurum tuorum Medardi et Gildardi pontificum digna sollemnitate deferimus; quaesumus ut precibus illorum veniam delictorum consequamur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that our gifts of devotion, which we bring to you on the worthy feast day of your saints Medard and Gildard, bishops, may be pleasing to you. We humbly ask that through their prayers we may obtain forgiveness for our sins.

text: Sint tibi omnipotens Deus grata nostrae servitutis obsequia et haec sancta quae sumpsimus intercedente beato Edmundo rege et martyre (tuo) prosint nobis ad capescenda praemia vitae perpetuae.
translation_en: May the omnipotent God receive with gratitude our acts of service and these holy things we have taken, through the intercession of Blessed King and Martyr Edmund, be beneficial to us in obtaining rewards of eternal life.

text: Sint tibi placita Domine populi tui votiva sacrificia et quod fragilitas nostra non impetrat eorum supplicatio pro quorum gloria deferuntur obtineat.
translation_en: May your wishes, Lord, be granted to your people through vow-offerings, and may the petition for those who are weak not have been in vain, that their glory may be obtained.

text: Sint tibi quaesumus Domine nostri munera grata ieiunii quia tunc eadem in sanctorum tuorum digna commemoratione deferimus si et actus illorum pariter subsequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that the gifts of fasting may be pleasing to you, because then we bring them worthy of your saints' remembrance on the same day. And let us follow their deeds as well.

text: Sit Domine beatus Ioannes evangelista nostrae fragilitatis adiutor ut pro nobis tibi supplicans copiosius audiatur.
translation_en: May the Blessed John the Evangelist be our helper in our frailty, so that as we pray to you, we may be heard more abundantly.

text: Sit Domine quaesumus beatus Benedictus custos actuum nostrorum ut mala opera ac desideria maligna quae nostra fragilitas superare non potest eius pia intercessione tua benignitate annuente vincantur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask the blessed Benedict, our guardian, that through his holy intercession, may your kindness allow us to overcome our weak efforts in evil works and malicious desires which we cannot conquer on our own.

text: Sit nobis Domine intercedente beato Cucufate martyre tuo reparatio mentis et corporis quod sancti altaris tui benedictione percepimus et per hanc medicinam sanctorum suorum nos faciat esse consortes qui infirmitatis nostrae venit curare languores.
translation_en: Lord, through the intercession of the blessed Cucuphate martyr, may your restoration of both mind and body reach us, for which we have received the blessing of your holy altar. May this medicine of the saints make us partakers who have come to heal our weaknesses.

text: Sit nobis Domine quaesumus cibus sacer potusque salutaris qui et temporalem vitam muniat et praestet aeternam.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech Thee, Lord, a holy food and a healthful drink that may sustain us in this life and provide for us in the life to come.

text: Sit nobis Domine reparatio mentis et corporis caeleste mysterium cuius operatione precamur ut vitia nostra purgentur et intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis iusta desideria compleantur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, a heavenly restoration of mind and body through the celestial mystery whose operation we beseech you, so that our vices may be purged and our just desires fulfilled through the intercession of your holy martyrs.

text: Sit nobis Domine reparatio mentis et corporis caeleste mysterium et cuius exsequimur actionem sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: May, Lord, the restoration of our mind and body be a heavenly mystery to us, and may we feel the effect of the actions we perform.

text: Sit nobis Domine sacramenti tui certa salvatio quae cum beatorum martyrum tuorum Cosmae et Damiani meritis imploratur.
translation_en: May, Lord, your sacrament be certain salvation for us, which is sought with the merits of your blessed martyrs Cosmas and Damian.

text: Sit nobis quaesumus Domine medicina mentis et corporis quod de sancti altaris tui benedictione percepimus ut nullis adversitatibus premamur qui tanti remedii participatione munimur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, a remedy for mind and body that we have received from your holy altar's blessing, so that we may not be pressed by any adversities, who are fortified by participating in such a great remedy.

text: Sit nomini tuo Domine hoc sacrificium cum exhibetur acceptum ut efficiatur iugiter exigendum.
translation_en: May this sacrifice, Lord, be offered to Your name and accepted. May it always be required and sought after.

text: Sit plebi tuae Domine continuata defensio divini participatio sacramenti ut carnalibus vitiis non teneatur obnoxia ut spiritali delectatione sit libera ut maiestati tuae plena sit devotione subiecta ut salvationem mentis et corporis et incessabiliter expetat et affluenter accipiat.
translation_en: May Your people, Lord, continue to be defended, partake in the divine sharing of the sacrament, so that they are not bound by carnal vices. May they be free for spiritual delight. May they be fully subjected with devotion to Your majesty and constantly seek and abundantly receive salvation for mind and body.

text: Sit tibi Domine nostrae devotionis oblatio acceptabilis ut beato Vitale martyre tuo intercedente et tuae placeat maiestati et nostrae proficiat saluti.
translation_en: May, Lord, our offering of devotion be acceptable to You, through the intercession of your blessed martyr Vitus, and may it please Your majesty, and bring profit to our salvation.

text: Sit tibi omnipotens Pater hoc holocaustum sicut quod tibi obtulit qui peccata nostra in cruce pertulit et sancto Eustachio cum sociis suis intercedente ad tua sancta sumenda nos praepara.
translation_en: May this holocaust be to you, almighty Father, as the one that was offered to you by him who bore our sins on the cross and through St. Eustace and his companions, may they intercede for us, prepare us for your holy acceptance.

text: Solita quaesumus Domine quos salvasti pietate custodi ut qui tua sunt passione redempti tua resurrectione laetentur.
translation_en: As is often requested, Lord, those whom you have saved with your mercy, protect them so that those redeemed by your Passion may rejoice in your Resurrection.

text: Sollemne nobis intercessio beati Laurentii martyris quaesumus Domine praestet auxilium ut caelestis mensae participatio quam sumpsimus tribuat Ecclesiae tuae recensitam laetitiam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for the intercession of the blessed martyr Laurence. May his help be granted so that the joy recently regained by your Church from partaking in the heavenly banquet be bestowed.

text: Sollemni sedulo divinitus roborati tuae pietatis exoramus clementiam Domine Deus ut sanctus Dunstanus pontifex pro nobis exoret in caelo cuius sumus in terris ad bene agendum eruditi exemplo.
translation_en: With great devotion we implore the strength of your piety, Lord God. We humbly ask for your mercy that Saint Dunstan, the bishop, may intercede for us in heaven, where we are on earth, learning to do good by his holy example.

text: Sollemnibus ieiuniis expiatos suo nos Domine mysterio congruentes hoc sacrum munus efficiat quia tanto nobis salubrius aderit quanto id devotius sumpserimus.
translation_en: May this sacred rite, fitting with the penitential solemnities, Lord, make us worthy, for it is as healthful to us as we have taken it with more devotion.

text: Sollemnitate sanctorum tuorum Domine et sacramenti munere vegetati quaesumus ut bonis quibus per tuam fovemur largitatem perfruamur aeternis.
translation_en: On the solemnity of your saints, Lord, and nourished by the gift of the sacrament, we humbly ask that we may be filled with the bounty you bestow upon us with goodness, eternally.

text: Sollemnitatem quaesumus Domine sancti pontificis Aldelmi celebrantibus adesto propitius et nobis eius meritis concede gaudia vitae caelestis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to be present and gracious as Saint Pope Aldhelm celebrates the solemnity. Grant us the joys of eternal life through his merits.

text: Sollemnitatis apostolicae multiplicatione gaudentes clementiam tuam deprecamur omnipotens Deus ut tribuas iugiter nos eorum et confessione benedici et patrociniis confoveri.
translation_en: Joyfully celebrating the solemnity of the apostles, we humbly entreat your clemency, almighty God, to bless us continually with their merits and to uphold us through their intercessions.

text: Sollemnitatis hodiernae festum beatae Milburgae venerandum celebrantes percepto sacrosancti convivii sacramento quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut cuius sollemnia venerari facis eius continuis foveamur auxiliis.
translation_en: On this solemnity, we celebrate the festival of the blessed Milburga, and having partaken of the sacred banquet, we humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through whose feast days are venerated, we may be continually nourished by her fervent aid.

text: Solve Christe Deus nostrorum criminum nodos et in pace quam ipse docuisti fac nos semper esse connexos.
translation_en: O Christ our God, loosen the knots of our sins and make us always to be united in the peace which you yourself taught us.

text: Solve Salvator noster et Domine nostrorum vincula peccatorum qui olim resolvisti per Sebastianum martyrem tuum os ancillae tuae Zoe ad loquendum ut nomina tam offerentium quam defunctorum quae nostrorum sunt ore prolata aeterna sint in adnotatione adfixa quo sicut illa per praedicamentum praedicti martyris te meruit cognoscere Christum sic nos mereamur eodem pro nobis suffragante paenitentiae percipere fructum.
translation_en: May our Savior and Lord, break the bonds of our sins, which you once broke through your martyr Sebastian, servant of your maidservant Zoe, so that she could speak. May the names of those who offer in our behalf as well as those who have departed, whose names we utter with our mouths, be eternally fixed in memory, in such a way that, just as she merited to know Christ through the prediction of the said martyr, we may deserve to perceive the fruit of repentance with him interceding on our behalf.

text: Spes certa credentium dominator Domine Deus qui peccatores salvare venisti non perdere tuam omnipotentiam supplices flagitamus ut sanctorum tuorum illorum meritis nos ab omnibus purges delictis et sicut illi in caelis cum angelis tuis laetantur sic nos facias dignos in tuo adstare conspectu ipsique apud te pro nobis intercessores exsistant et defunctorum fidelium tua miseratio requiem aeternam concedat.  Miserere etiam indigno mihi et omnibus pro quibus te supplex expostulo perpetuamque requiem tribue famulis tuis illis et omnibus fidelibus defunctis ut in Abrahae gremio collocati et nunc poenas evadant inferorum et resurrectionis tempore coetibus eos sociari iubeas angelorum.
translation_en:
A certain hope of the believers, Lord God, who have come to save sinners without losing your all-powerfulness, we humbly beseech you that through the merits of your saints, we may be purged from all offenses and, just as they rejoice in heaven with your angels, so may you make us worthy to stand in your presence. May those intercessors who are for us and for the faithful departed exist and grant us eternal rest.
Have mercy also on me, an unworthy one, and all for whom I humbly implore you, and grant perpetual rest to your servants there and to all the faithful departed so that placed in Abraham's bosom now, they may escape the punishments of hell and at the time of resurrection, you command angels to join them in company.

text: Spes unica vitae nostrae et fidei remunerator aeterne Deus Pater omnipotens qui per unicum Filium tuum salvare dignatus es mundum dum naturae carnis assumptione miscetur ut qui Deus erat ex Deo patre homo quoque esset ex matre – ex te sine tempore ex illa sine semine – respice nos et adesto precibus nostris et praesta ut qui adventum Filii tui humilem cum gaudio colimus in gloria venientem cum laetitia mereamur adspicere.
translation_en: The unique hope of our life and the eternal rewarder of faith, God Almighty Father, who deemed fit to save the world through your only Son, when He was joined with the nature of human flesh, so that He who was God from the Father was also man from the mother - without beginning from you, without seed from her - look upon us and be present with our prayers, and grant that we may rejoice humbly and with joy at the coming of Your Son, and merit to behold Him in glory with joy.

text: Spiritali esca haustuque recreati omnipotentem Deum patrem debita gratiarum actione veneremur.
translation_en: We honor the Almighty God, our Father, with due actions of gratitude, being nourished and refreshed by spiritual food.

text: Spiritali refectione sancti corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi sanati sumus; concede nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut per sancta merita beatae Brigidae virginis tuae mereamur habere subsidium vitae praesentis et gaudia caelestis paradisi possidere.
translation_en: By the spiritual reflection of the holy body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, we have been healed; grant us, we ask you almighty God, that through the holy merits of your blessed Virgin Brigida, we may deserve to have support for the present life and to possess the joys of the celestial paradise.

text: Spiritalibus pasti epulis oremus patrem et filium et Spiritum Sanctum ut mortificatis desideriis carnis in omnibus sit nostra conversatio spiritalis.
translation_en: Let us pray to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, that they may help us conquer the desires of the flesh, and that our conduct may be spiritual in all things.

text: Spiritualis alimoniae pignus quod ore percepimus Domine Deus beato Poncio exorante ad remedium nobis proveniat sempiternum et populus tuus qui eiusdem sancti martyris annua commemoratione laetatur ad redemptionis gaudia sustollatur.
translation_en: The pledge of spiritual nourishment that we have received from Your mouth, Lord God, through the intercession of blessed Poncius, may come to our eternal aid. And Your people who rejoice in the annual commemoration of this same holy martyr are lifted up towards the joys of redemption.

text: Spiritualis mensae Domine participatio nobis mentis et corporis fiat salvatio et sanctae Edithae virginis tuae tibi nos commendet supplicatio.
translation_en: Lord, may our participation at this spiritual table be a saving and holy grace for us. May the supplication of Saint Editha, your virgin, commend us to you.

text: Spiritualium dapium vitali pastione ob beati Poncii martyris tui commemorationem refecti suppliciter te Domine exoramus ut qui festum eiusdem agonis digno famulatu exsequimur ipsius adiuvamine fulti divinarum epularum capaces efficiamur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, that on the commemoration of your blessed martyr Ponicus, we who execute his worthy service, may be filled with his aid to become capable of partaking in divine feasts.

text: Spiritum in nobis Domine tuae caritatis infunde ut intercedente beato Wulstano confessore tuo atque pontifice tuam mereamur dulcedinem in aeterna felicitate gustare.
translation_en: Pour Your Spirit, Lord, upon us with the love that is Yours, that through the intercession of Blessed Wulstan, Your confessor and bishop, we may deserve to taste sweetness in eternal happiness.

text: Spiritum in nobis Domine tuae caritatis infunde ut quos uno caelesti pane satiasti una facias pietate concordes.
translation_en: Pour down upon us, Lord, your spirit of love, that those whom you have satisfied with one heavenly bread may also be united in affection.

text: Spiritum in nobis Domine tuae caritatis infunde ut quos sacramentis paschalibus satiasti tua facias pietate concordes.
translation_en: Lord, pour out your Spirit upon us, that those whom you have filled with the sacraments of Easter may be united by love.

text: Spiritum in nobis Domine tuae caritatis infunde ut quos uno caelesti pane satiasti intercedente beato Felice martyre tuo tua facias pietate concordes.
translation_en: Pour down upon us, Lord, Your loving Spirit, that You who have satisfied us with one heavenly bread through the intercession of blessed Felix, Your martyr, may make us agreeable to You through Your mercy.

text: Spiritum veritatis et pacis quaesumus Domine da famulo tuo illi ut (et) te tota mente cognoscat et quae tibi placita sunt toto corde sectetur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, give your servant that spirit of truth and peace, that he may know you with his whole mind and follow what pleases you with his whole heart.

text: Spiritus sancte qui a patre et filio procedis his propitius illabere holocaustis quo qui a patre es repromissus sanctificationem humanis cordibus exhibeas praesentatus repleasque sponsionis mercede quos te promissum inspicis exspectare.
translation_en: Holy Spirit, who proceeds from the Father and the Son, have mercy and come upon the sacrifices that have been promised by the Father. Show the sanctification you have promised to human hearts, present yourself and fill them with the price of your promise, those whom you see expecting you.

text: Spiritus sanctus tuus paraclitus quaesumus Domine a peccatis nos emundans continuam nobis tribuat claritatem quique quasi ignis super apostolos advenit dispergens dona super nos quoque infirmos te concedente vel aliqua portione suae dignationis adveniens et peccata diluat et pietatis dona largiatur.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that Your Holy Spirit, the Paraclete, purify us from sins and continually grant us clarity. May He come upon us as a fire that descended upon the apostles, dispersing gifts upon us also, who are weak, through Your granting or some part of His dignity coming to us. May he dissolve our sins and bestow upon us gifts of piety.

text: Subde tibi nostras quaesumus Domine voluntates ut semper et fide quae praecipis et actione sectemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to bend our wills towards You, that we may always follow both the faith that You command and the actions which accompany it.

text: Subdita tibi Domine plebis tuae corda sanctifica ut benedictionem quam ieiuniis expetit te donante percipiens et praesentibus gaudeat consolationibus et futuris.
translation_en: Lord, sanctify the hearts of your people to you, that they may receive with joy the blessing which they seek from you in their fasting, and that they may be pleased with the consolations present and those to come.

text: Subiectae familiae quaesumus omnipotens Deus proficiat hostia iubilationis et laudis et interventu sancti Neoti confessoris tui atque abbatis perpetuae fiat causa nostrae salutis.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God to prosper the offerings of jubilation and praise, and through the intervention of your Confessor and Abbot St. Neot, may it become an everlasting cause of our salvation.

text: Subiectum tibi famulum quaesumus Domine propitiatio caelestis amplificet ut et praesentis vitae periculis exuatur et perpetuis donis firmetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the celestial mercy may enlarge the servant who is subject to you. May he be freed from the dangers of this life and strengthened by eternal gifts.

text: Subiectum tibi populum quaesumus Domine propitiatio caelestis amplificet et tuis semper faciat servire mandatis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the people subject to you may be enlarged by celestial mercy and always made to serve your commands.

text: Subiuga Deus nostras tuo iugo cervices ut onus tuum quod amantibus leve est ita optabili devotione feramus sicut Iacobus apostolus tuus innexa collo suo fune ad passionem tractus est laetabundus ut sanctificans haec quae tibi offerimus nos ipsos benedicas perceptione hostiae huius.
translation_en: Subdue us, O God, to your yoke our necks, that the burden you bear, which is light for those who love it, we may carry with a pleasing devotion, as did James your apostle, who was drawn to passion with a rope around his neck, rejoicing. Let us, while sanctifying these things we offer, be blessed by you in the perception of this host's sacrifice.

text: Subiugetur in nobis Domine tuae gratiae praesidiis reluctatio carnis et sanguinis ut sopita escarum concupiscentia evangelicis firmati praeceptis satietatem magis iustitiae esurire ac sitire possimus.
translation_en: Lord, your grace may be our defense against the reluctance of flesh and blood, so that the desire for earthly pleasures is quieted, and we may have more hunger and thirst for the teachings of the Gospel rather than for unrighteousness.

text: Subsidio nostrae salutis accepto supplices Domine te rogamus ut quos tanti mysterii tribuis esse consortes eodem dignos efficias.
translation_en: Having received our support for salvation, we humbly ask you, Lord, that you who bestow upon us such a great mystery, make us worthy to be its companions.

text: Subveni Domine servis tuis pro sua iugiter iniquitate gementibus mentesque nostras terrenis affectibus praegravatas medicinalibus tribue exonerari ieiuniis et corporis afflictione corrobora.
translation_en: Come to us, Lord, deliver your servants from their constant lamentations due to iniquity. Relieve our minds burdened by earthly passions with remedies. Grant us freedom through fasting and strengthen us with bodily affliction.

text: Subveniat Domine plebi tuae Dei Genitricis oratio quam etsi pro condicione carnis migrasse cognoscimus in caelesti gloria apud te pro nobis orare sentiamus.
translation_en: May the Lord come to the aid of his people, the servants of God the Mother. Although we know that through the condition of our flesh she has departed, let us feel that she is praying for us in heavenly glory before you.

text: Subveniat nobis Domine misericordia tua ut ab imminentibus peccatorum nostrorum periculis te mereamur veniente salvari.
translation_en: May the Lord's mercy be upon us, that we may be delivered from the dangers of our sins approaching, so that we may deserve to be saved when He comes.

text: Subveniat nobis quaesumus Domine misericordia tua ut ab imminentibus peccatorum nostrorum periculis te mereamur protegente salvari.
translation_en: May your mercy, Lord, be upon us, we entreat you. That we may be worthy of being saved through your protection from the dangers impending due to our sins.

text: Subveniat nobis Domine quaesumus sacrificii praesentis operatio quae nos et ab erroribus universis potenter absolvat et a totius eripiat perditionis incursu.
translation_en: May the Lord come to our aid, we beseech Thee. We pray that the operation of this present sacrifice may powerfully deliver us from all errors and snatch us completely away from the onslaught of destruction.

text: Succurre Domine quaesumus populo supplicanti et opem tuam tribue benignus infirmis ut sincera tibi mente devoti et praesentis vitae remediis gaudeant et futurae.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you, succor the suppliant people and grant your aid to the afflicted. May they rejoice in your presence with a sincere mind devoted to you, and may they find relief from their current troubles and hope for the future.

text: Succurre Domine quaesumus populo tuo et nullum sequi patiaris errorem quem tuae vis complicem fieri veritatis.
translation_en: Help us, Lord, we beseech you, your people, and let no error follow that you permit to be involved in the truth by your will.

text: Sumat Domine plebs fidelis caelestis dona remedii per quae intercedentibus sanctis martyribus tuis Abdon et Sennen a suis emundetur delictis.
translation_en: Lord, may your faithful people receive celestial gifts by which, through the intercession of your saints, martyrs Abdon and Sennen, they may be purified from their sins.

text: Sumat Ecclesia tua Deus beati Ioannis Baptistae generatione laetitiam per quem suae regenerationis cognovit auctorem.
translation_en: Your church receives joy from God through blessed John the Baptist, by whom he came to know the author of his own regeneration.

text: Sume omnipotens Deus benigne has oblationes et concede pro meritis beati protomartyris Stephani ut nostra delicta absolvam et perpetuam felicitatem nobis acquirant.
translation_en: Almighty God, graciously receive these offerings and grant us remission of our sins through the merits of the blessed first martyr Stephen, that we may attain eternal happiness.

text: Sumentes Domine caelestia sacramenta quaesumus clementiam tuam ut quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur.
translation_en: Graciously receiving the heavenly sacraments, we humbly ask your mercy that what we temporarily hold on earth may lead us to eternal joys.

text: Sumentes Domine caelestis dona mysterii quaesumus ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum Hermachorae et Fortunati adiuvemur meritis quorum sollemnitatem debita veneratione celebramus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, heavenly gifts of the mystery that we may be helped by the merits of your saints Hermachoras and Fortunatus, whose feast day we celebrate with fitting reverence.

text: Sumentes Domine Deus salutis nostrae sacramenta praesta quaesumus ut eorum participatio mihi famulo tuo ad perpetuam proficiat salutem.
translation_en: Lord, giver of our salvation, grant us we beseech you, that the participation in these sacraments may, for your servant, lead to eternal salvation.

text: Sumentes Domine divina mysteria imploramus clementiam tuam ut tribuas nobis eorum pia devotione sequi doctrinam quorum in verae fidei confessione universam solidasti ecclesiam.
translation_en: Taking up, Lord, the divine mysteries, we implore your clemency that you grant us to follow with pious devotion the doctrine of those who, in the true faith's confession, have strengthened the entire Church.

text: Sumentes Domine divina mysteria quaesumus ut beati Stephani martyris tui atque pontificis intercessione aeternae nobis praebeant incrementa laetitiae.
translation_en: Lord, we take up your divine mysteries, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your blessed martyr and bishop St. Stephen, you grant us eternal increase in happiness.

text: Sumentes Domine divina mysteria quaesumus ut sanctorum confessurum tuorum atque pontificum Vedasti et Amandi precibus sanctificationem nobis iugiter operentur.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, to take up the divine mysteries, that the intercession of your saints, Confessors Vedastus and Amandus, and the bishops may continually work sanctification upon us.

text: Sumentes Domine divina mysteria sancti Leonis confessoris tui atque pontificis pia nos quaesumus intercessio prosequatur ut cuius sollemnia recensemus sentiamus optata praesidia.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the divine mysteries of your Confessor and Bishop Saint Leon, and may his pious intercession follow for us. May we feel the desired protection as we commemorate his feast day.

text: Sumentes Domine dona caelestia quaesumus ut non nobis provenire ad iudicium patiaris quod fidelibus tuis ad remedium providisti.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you bestow celestial gifts, so that we may not suffer the judgment you have prepared for your faithful ones, but rather provide a remedy for us.

text: Sumentes Domine gaudia sempiterna de participatione sacramenti festivitatis sanctae martyris Agnetis suppliciter deprecamur ut quae sedula servitute donante te gerimus dignis sensibus tuo munere capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we take up everlasting joy from the participation in the feast of the holy martyr Agnes. Humbly we ask that we who serve you diligently may receive your gift with worthy senses.

text: Sumentes gaudia sempiterna de participatione sacramenti et festivitate beati martyris tui Rufi suppliciter deprecamur ut quae sedula servitute donante te gerimus dignis sensibus tuo munere capiamus.
translation_en: Taking the eternal joys from the participation in the sacrament and the festivity of your blessed martyr Rufus, we humbly entreat you that what we are carrying out diligently with devoted service may be able to receive through your gift by worthy senses.

text: Sumentes Domine dona caelestia suppliciter deprecamur ut quae sedula servitute donante te gerimus dignis sensibus tuo munere capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we take up the heavenly gifts humbly, we beseech you. May we who serve you diligently with devoted service, grasp your gift with worthy senses.

text: Sumentes Domine gaudia sempiterna de participatione sacramenti et de festivitate beati Martini confessoris tui suppliciter deprecamur ut quae sedula servitute te donante gerimus dignis sensibus tua munera tractemus.
translation_en: Lord, taking eternal joys from the participation in your sacrament and the festivity of your confessor Saint Martin, we humbly pray that we may worthily handle the gifts you have given us with sensible minds.

text: Sumentes Domine gaudia sempiterna participatione sacramenti praesta quaesumus ut beati Gregorii cuius natalicia colimus precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, eternal joys through the participation in the sacrament. We humbly ask that with the prayers of blessed Gregory whose feast day we celebrate, you may assist us.

text: Sumentes Domine mensae tuae beata mysteria quaesumus ut sanctae virginis et martyris tuae Katherinae interventionibus et temporalem nobis misericordiam conferas et aeternam.
translation_en: Lord, taking your blessed mysteries of the table, we ask that through the intercessions of your saint and martyr Catherine, you grant us temporary mercy here on earth and eternal life.

text: Sumentes Domine perpetuae sacramenta salutis tuam deprecamur clementiam ut per ea famulum tuum illum ab omni adversitate protegas.
translation_en: Lord, we take up the eternal sacraments of your salvation. We humbly entreat your clemency, that through these, you may protect your servant from every adversity.

text: Sumentes Domine perpetuae sacramenta salutis tuam deprecamur clementiam ut per ea me famulum tuum interventu sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae ab omnium peccatorum labe propitius emundes atque a cunctis adversitatibus protegas et aeternae felicitatis consortem efficias; famulos etiam et famulas tuas qui mihi consanguinitatis familiaritatis subiectionis confessionis et dilectionis vinculo connectuntur vivis et defunctis quorum vel quarum nomina tibi vivunt pro quibus tuam misericordiam exoro precibus omnium sanctorum tuorum a cunctis iniquitatibus exuas et ad sempiterna promissa perducas.
translation_en: Lord, we take hold of the eternal sacraments of your salvation and humbly beseech your clemency. Through them, purify us, your servant, through the intervention of the holy Mother of God, Mary, from all stain of sin. Protect us from every adversity and make us a companion of eternal happiness. Similarly, for those who are bound to me by ties of kinship, familiarity, submission, confession, and love - both living and dead, whose or whose names live in you - we implore your mercy. Strip them from all wickedness with the prayers of all your saints and lead them to the eternal promises.

text: Sumentes Domine pignus redemptionis aeternae quaesumus ut intercedente beato Apollinare martyre tuo vitae praesentis auxilio nos foveat et aeternae.
translation_en: Lord, taking the pledge of eternal redemption, we humbly ask you. With the intercession of your blessed martyr Apolinaris, may his aid in our present life protect and sustain us, and lead us to eternal salvation.

text: Sumentes Domine sacramenta caelestia pietatem tuam humili devotione deposcimus ut illam quae in beato Urbano martyre tuo atque pontifice flagravit fortem dilectionem nobis benignus adspires.
translation_en: Lord, taking the celestial sacraments, we humbly ask for your grace that you may inspire in us, as you did in the blessed martyr and pope Urban, a strong love towards us.

text: Sumentes Domine sacramenta corporis et sanguinis unigeniti Filii tui Domini nostri Iesu Christi petimus ut apostolico gradui atque universo ecclesiastico ordini semper et ubique proficiant ad tutelam mentis et corporis.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that we may receive the sacraments of the body and blood of your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. We petition that they may always and everywhere progress according to the apostolic grade and universal ecclesiastical order for the protection of mind and body.

text: Sumentes Domine salutaria sacramenta quaesumus ut eius nos tribuas subsequi documenta cuius celebramus gloriosa sollemnia.
translation_en: Lord, we take up the saving sacraments, we ask that you grant us to follow the instructions of him whom we celebrate during these glorious feasts.

text: Sumentes Domine salutis nostrae subsidium quaesumus ut beati Nicolai confessoris tui atque pontificis interventu ad vitae aeternae proficiamus augmentum.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you provide us with the support of our salvation. May we, through the intervention of your blessed confessor and pope, St. Nicholas, advance towards an increase in eternal life.

text: Sumentes dona caelestia gratias tibi referimus sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus.
translation_en: Taking heavenly gifts, we refer thanks to you, holy Father, almighty, eternal God.

text: Sumentes gaudia sempiterna de participatione sacramenti et de festivitate beatorum confessorum quaesumus Domine ad vitam nutriamur aeternam.
translation_en: Taking eternal joy from the participation in the sacrament and the festival of the blessed confessors, we ask you, Lord, to nourish us with eternal life.

text: Sumentes perpetuae sacramenta salutis da quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut sicut omnium sanctorum tuorum commemoratione temporali gratulamur officio ita perpetuo laetemur adspectu.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord our God, to grant us the perpetual sacrament of salvation. May we rejoice as much in the temporary commemoration of all Your saints as we do perpetually with the sight of Thee.

text: Sumentes pignus caelestis arcani et in terris positi iam superno pane satiati supplicamus Domine deprecantibus sanctis tuis ut quod in nobis mystice geritur veraciter impleatur.
translation_en: Taking the pledge of heavenly mysteries and already satisfied on earth with heavenly bread, we humbly ask you, Lord, through your holy intercessors, that what is mysteriously enacted in us may truly be fulfilled.

text: Sumentes sacramenta salutis perpetuae tuam Domine clementiam deprecamur ut pietate tua protecti devoto tibi pastore potiamur.
translation_en: We take up the sacraments of eternal salvation, we humbly beseech You, Lord, that with Your clemency you grant us protection through Your pity. May we be able to partake as a devoted shepherd protected by Your grace.

text: Sumentes tua sancta mysteria Domine petimus immensam clementiam tuam ut et nobis proficiant ad medelam et famulis et famulabus tuis qui nobis propria largiti sunt bona proveniant ad salutem mentis et corporis.
translation_en: Taking your holy mysteries, Lord, we ask for your immense clemency that it may also benefit us and your servants and handmaids who have generously given us good things, may come to the health of mind and body.

text: Summe atque ineffabilis Deus qui non vocis sed cordis auditor esse dignosceris qui mentes probas non aetates qui non in labiis sed in corde puro te timeri hortaris qui benigna consolatione nos ne pereamus amplecteris insuper et perditos sub alarum tuarum umbraculo colligis dignare cor nostrum a vitiorum maculis emundare ut ab omni inquinatione purgati et a saeculi voraginibus exempti habitaculum esse mereamur Spiritus Sancti.
translation_en: Supreme and ineffable God, who discerns those worthy not by voice but by heart, who judges minds, not ages, who commands to fear you not in lips but in a pure heart, who embraces us with kind consolation so that we may not perish, and who gathers the lost under your wing, have mercy upon our heart, cleanse it from the stains of vice, purge us completely from all pollution, and exempt us from the pitfalls of this world, so that we may deserve to dwell in the dwelling place of the Holy Spirit.

text: Summe omnipotens aeterne Deus qui vitam beati antistitis tui Leudegarii martyris per istius saeculi aerumnas transire iussisti cuius annua festa devota mente celebramus quaesumus ut per eius intercessionem plebem tuae clementiae famulantem ita in praesenti foveas ut ad caelestia regna perducas.
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who commanded the life of your blessed bishop and martyr Leudegar to pass through the troubles of this age, whose annual feast we celebrate with devout mind. We humbly ask that through his intercession, you foster among your servant people in this present time so as to lead them to the celestial kingdoms.

text: Summe omnium bonorum dispensator propinatorque salutis recrea nos in hac sollemnitate tuae genitricis ex tua abundantissima pietate ut gustantes te Domine quantumque es suavis nullius nos inimici suadelis irretiri patiaris ut qui hodie eam devicto diabolo evehi fecisti in caelis nosque cum eadem post nostrum transitum tuam faciem valeamus contemplari ovantes.
translation_en: In this solemnity, we are refreshed by the dispenser of all good things and propitior of salvation, that you, Lord, being so sweet, may not permit us to be ensnared by any enemy's deceit, since today you have triumphantly delivered your mother from the defeated devil. May we in heaven behold your face together with her after our departure, and longing for you, we may contemplate her.

text: Summi sacerdotis tui patris nostri Martini episcopi hodie depositionem celebrantibus tribue nobis Domine ut sicut commemorationem eius devotissime colimus ita et opus fideliter imitemur.
translation_en: Lord, grant us that as we devoutly remember your high priest, Bishop Martin, on the day of his deposition, so may we faithfully perform the work.

text: Sumpsimus Domine caelestia sacramenta sancti tui martyris Albani natalicia praevenientes quae mortalitati nostrae quaesumus perpetuae redemptionis munus operentur.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the heavenly sacraments of your martyr Saint Alban's natalicia, which we humbly ask may operate as a perpetual gift for our redeption from mortality.

text: Sumpsimus Domine celebritatis annuae votiva sacramenta; praesta quaesumus ut et temporalis vitae nobis remedia praebeant et aeternae.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the vows of annual solemnities; grant us we beseech you, that temporal aids be given to us in our life and eternal ones as well.

text: Sumpsimus Domine corporis et sanguinis tui remedia obsecrantes maiestatis tuae clementiam ut et viventibus sint tutela et defunctis obtineant veniam.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the remedy of your body and blood, beseeching the clemency of your majesty, that it may be a protection for the living and that the departed may obtain forgiveness.

text: Sumpsimus Domine corporis et sanguinis tui sacramentum obsecrantes maiestatis tuae clementiam ut et famulis et famulabus tuis et omnibus hic et ubique in te quiescentibus prosit ad veniam quod nobis viventibus praeparare dignatus es ad medelam.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, Your sacrament of body and blood, beseeching the clemency of Your majesty, that it may also benefit Your servants and handmaidens, and all who here and everywhere rest in You, granting us living a remission which You have deemed fitting to prepare as a remedy.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria beati apostoli tui Andreae festivitate laetantes quae sicut tuis sanctis ad gloriam ita nobis quaesumus ad veniam prodesse perficias.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the divine mysteries of your blessed apostle Andrew, rejoicing in his festivity, as they did for the glory of Your saints, we humbly request that they may likewise benefit us with forgiveness.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria beatorum apostolorum tuorum Petri et Pauli desiderata sollemnia recolentes; praesta quaesumus ut eorum supplicationibus muniamur quorum tegimur principatu.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the divine mysteries of your blessed apostles Peter and Paul, recalling their desired solemnities; grant us we ask, that we may be fortified by their supplications whose leadership we are under.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria beatorum martyrum tuorum Eustachii sociorumque eius merita venerantes; praesta quaesumus ut eorum semper et fideli muniamur auxilio et magnifico proficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the divine mysteries of your blessed martyrs Eustachius and his companions, venerating their merits; grant us we ask, that we may always be fortified with their faithful aid and advance with a magnificent example.

text: Sumpsimus Domine divina mysteria; quaesumus ut beati Iusti martyris tui intercessione aeternae nobis praebeant incrementa laetitiae.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, your divine mysteries; we humbly ask that through the intercession of your blessed martyr, may eternal increases of joy be granted to us.

text: Sumpsimus Domine doni caelestis sacramenta votiva; praesta patroni nostri interventu Fursei ut nobis prosint et contra inimicorum iacula et ad vitam capescendam aeternam.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the heavenly sacramental gifts given by vow; grant, O Patron of ours, the intervention of St. Fursey, that they may benefit us and shield us against the arrows of our enemies and lead us to the attainment of eternal life.

text: Sumpsimus Domine in beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Babilae et trium Parvulorum sollemnitate caelestis dona mysterii; quaesumus ut eorum precibus praesentis vitae nobis pariter et aeternae tribuas benignus auxilium.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, in the solemnity of your most blessed martyrs Babylas and the Three Children, heavenly gifts of this mystery; we ask that, through their prayers, you grant us helpful aid in both our present life and our eternal one.

text: Sumpsimus Domine pignus redemptionis aeternae; sit nobis quaesumus intervenientibus sanctis tuis vitae praesentis auxilium pariter et futurae.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the pledge of eternal redemption; we humbly ask that Your saints intercede for us now and also in the future, to give us help in this present life as well as the one to come.

text: Sumpsimus Domine pignus salutis aeternae celebrantes apostolorum Petri et Pauli votiva sollemnia et perpetua merita venerantes.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the pledge of eternal salvation, celebrating the votive feasts of the apostles Peter and Paul, and reverencing their perpetual merits.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sacramenta caelestia; propterea deprecamur ut quorum continua perceptione reficimur salutari traditione laetemur.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the heavenly sacraments; therefore we pray that through their continued reception, we may be refreshed with joyful re-enactment of the saving tradition.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sacri dona mysterii humiliter deprecantis ut haec eadem angelico pro nobis interveniente suffragio et nostrorum fiant delictorum purgatio et loci huius contra nequitias diaboli inexpugnabilis et invicta defensio.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the holy gifts of the mystery humbly asking that these same things, through angelic intercession for us, may become the purification of our sins and an invincible and unconquerable defense against the wickedness of the devil in this place.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sacri dona mysterii humiliter deprecantes ut quae in tui commemorationem nos facere praecepisti in nostrae proficiant infirmitatis auxilium.
translation_en: We have received, O Lord, the sacred gifts of the mystery humbly asking that what you have commanded us to do in remembrance of you may be beneficial for our weakness.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sacri dona mysterii humiliter deprecantes ut quibus hanc baptismatis diem beati Ambrosii voluisti esse sollemnem eidem antistiti in caelesti regno nos iubeas esse consortes.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the sacred gifts of this humble mystery, earnestly beseeching You. May You who wished this day of baptism to be solemn for blessed Ambrose, grant us, in Your heavenly kingdom, to be his companions.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sanctorum tuorum sollemnia celebrantes caelestia sacramenta quorum suffragiis quaesumus largiaris ut quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the festivities of your saints, celebrating heavenly sacraments. We humbly ask that you grant us through their intercessions to obtain what we temporarily possess eternal joys.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sancti Fabiani sollemnitate caelestia sacramenta cuius suffragiis quaesumus largiaris ut quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the sacred feast of Saint Fabian. Through whose intercession we ask that you grant us so that what we temporarily possess may lead to eternal joys.

text: Sumpsimus Domine sanctorum tuorum sollemnia celebrantes caelestia sacramenta; praesta quaesumus ut quod temporaliter gerimus aeternis gaudiis consequamur
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the festivities of your saints, celebrating heavenly sacraments; grant us we ask, that what we temporarily possess may lead to eternal joys.

text: Sumpsimus Domine tua sancta beati Rochi merita recolentes; praesta quaesumus ut eius semper et fideli muniamur auxilio et magnifico proficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the holy merits of blessed Roch, recalling them; grant us, we ask, that we may always be fortified with his faithful aid and make progress with a magnificent example.

text: Sumpsimus Domine venerabile sacramentum beati Matthaei apostoli tui et evangelistae festivitate laetantes; quaesumus ut suis precibus gloriosis et credendum nobis iugiter postulet et sequendum beatus evangelista quod docuit.
translation_en: We have received, Lord, the venerable sacrament of your apostle and evangelist, Saint Matthew, rejoicing in his festivity; we ask that through his glorious prayers he may constantly request and lead us to follow what the blessed evangelist taught.

text: Sumpsimus Domine votiva mysteria; quaesumus clementiam tuam ut eorum nobis fiant deprecatione salutaria quorum celebrantur affectu.
translation_en: We have taken, Lord, the sacred mysteries as vows; we humbly ask for your clemency that they may become a beneficial intercession for us, whom they celebrate with affection.

text: Sumpsimus Domine votiva mysteria deprecantes clementiam tuam ut eorum nobis fiant deprecatione salutaria quorum passionis celebramus gloriosa sollemnia.
translation_en: We have taken up, Lord, the votive mysteries, beseeching your clemency, that the prayers of those whose glorious feasts we celebrate may be beneficial to us, for whom we honor their paschal sufferings.

text: Sumpsisse ex sacris altaribus Christi domini ac Dei nostri corpus et sanguinem nos credentes unitatem beatae Trinitatis oremus ut semper nobis fide plenis esurire detur ac sitire iustitiam sicque opus eius confortati salutaris escae gratia faciamus ut non in iudicium sed in remedium sacramentum quod accepimus habeamus.
translation_en: Having taken from the sacred altars of our Lord and God, Christ, His body and blood, let us pray as believing persons for the unity of the Blessed Trinity. May we always be filled with faith to hunger for Him and thirst for justice. Thus strengthened by His work, may we make the salvific food graceful so that we have not a judgment but a remedy in the sacrament which we received.

text: Sumentes ex sacris altaribus Christi domini ac Dei nostri corpus et sanguinem oramus ut semper nobis fide plenis esurire detur ac sitire iustitiam sicque opus eius confortati salutaris escae gratia faciamus ut non in iudicium sed in remedium sacramentum quod accepimus habeamus.
translation_en: Taking from the sacred altars of our Lord and God Christ, we ask that we who are always filled with faith may be allowed to hunger for His body and thirst for His blood. May we, strengthened by His work, make use of the saving food in such a way that we receive it not as a judgment but as a remedy, and that the sacrament we have received becomes for us a sacred means.

text: Sumpta Domine caelestis sacramenti mysteria quaesumus ad prosperitatem itineris famuli tui illius proficiant et eum ad salutaria cuncta perducant.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the mysteries of the heavenly sacrament taken may help the progress and success of your servant's journey, and lead him to all things salvific.

text: Sumpta Domine divini sacramenti refectio firma sit corporibus et mentibus nostris salvatio tuamque nobis gratiam sancti Iudoci obtineat supplicatio.
translation_en: May, Lord, the refreshment of the divine sacrament be a firm sustenance for our bodies and minds. May our salvation hold us, and may we obtain your grace through Saint Judoc. Amen.

text: Sumpta Domine nos muniant sacramenta et muro custodiae tuae hoc sanctum ovile circumda ut omni adversitate depulsa sit hoc semper domicilium incolumitatis et pacis.
translation_en: Lord, clothe us with the sacraments as a defense and surround this holy flock with the wall of your protection, so that it may always be an unharmed dwelling place of safety and peace, driven away from all adversity.

text: Sumpta Domine pretiosa corporis et sanguinis Filii tui sacramenta praesta quaesumus ne nobis ad poenam reatus proveniant sed praesentis vitae felicitati proficiant et futurae.
translation_en: Graciously bestow, Lord, the precious sacraments of Your Son's body and blood. We humbly ask that they may not lead us to punishment for our guilt, but rather contribute to the happiness of this life and prepare us for the future.

text: Sumpta Domine sacramenta beatis apostolis tuis Petro et Paulo deprecantibus remedium nobis caeleste concilient.
translation_en: Lord, bestow upon us the sacred mysteries, which your holy apostles Peter and Paul intercede for, to bring us a heavenly remedy.

text: Sumpta Domine sacramenta caelestia meritis beati antistitis tui Thomae purificent mentes nostras ut sicut ipse singulari floruit sanctitate sic nos florere virtutum operibus tua facias pietate.
translation_en: Lord, grant us the heavenly sacraments through the merits of your blessed bishop Thomas, that he may purify our minds so that, like him who shone singularly in holiness, you may make us flourish in the works of virtue through your mercy.

text: Sumpta Domine sacramenta sempiterna dulcedine nos reficiant et beati Lamberti martyris tui atque pontificis interventu dignos nos maiestati tuae perficiant.
translation_en: Lord, may the eternal sacraments sustain us with their sweetness, and through the intervention of your martyr and bishop St. Lambert, make us worthy to fulfill your majesty.

text: Sumpta Domine sacrosanctae redemptionis mysteria deprecamur ut et salutaris huius remedii plenitudine roborati et sancti sacerdotis et confessoris tui Zenonis saluberrimis beatae intercessionis praesidiis fulti ad plenae festivitatis gaudia pervenire mereamur aeterna.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, for the sacred mysteries of redemption, that we may be strengthened by the fullness of this salutary remedy and supported by the blessed intercessions of Your saintly priest and confessor Zenon, so that we may deserve to reach the joys of full festivity through eternal happiness.

text: Sumpta Domine sancta mysteria nos interius exteriusque conservent et intercedente beata Agnete martyre tua praesentem nobis conferant clementiam et aeternam.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, Your holy mysteries to preserve us both within and without, and with the intercession of blessed Agnes, martyr, present to us mercy and eternal life.

text: Sumpta munera Domine nostrae sanctificationi proficere tuorum precibus concede sanctorum.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, that the offerings we make may advance for our sanctification, through your prayers, allow us by the merits of the saints.

text: Sumpta munera Domine sanctorum confessurum tuorum illorum precibus sanctificationem nobis quaesumus operentur.
translation_en: We ask that the gifts presented to you, Lord, by your holy confessors may through their prayers bring about our sanctification.

text: Sumpta munera Domine quaesumus ut sanctorum confessorum tuorum Vedasti et Amandi precibus sanctificationem nobis semper operentur.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the gifts bestowed upon us may always operate through the intercession of your holy confessors Vedastus and Amandus.

text: Sumpta nos Domine sacramenta vivificent et beati confessoris tui atque pontificis Paulini continuo foveamur suffragio cuius hodie sacram colimus festivitatem.
translation_en: Lord, we are taken up by the sacred mysteries that revive us and we are continually warmed by the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop Paulinus, whose holy day we celebrate today.

text: Sumpta quaesumus Domine sacramenta ab omni nos nequitiarum labe purificent et intercedente beato Blasio praesule et martyre tuo suo munere contra omnes semper diabolicos tueantur incursus.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the sacraments taken may cleanse us from all filth of sin and, through the intercession of blessed Bishop and Martyr Blasius, protect us from all constant incursions of the devilish forces.

text: Sumpta quaesumus Domine sacramenta crimina nostra detergant omnemque pravitatem et infirmitatem et hosticam rabiem atque subitaneam mortem meritis sanctorum omnium a nobis procul repellant et omnibus fidelibus vivis ac defunctis prosint ad veniam pro quorum tibi sunt oblata salute.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the sacraments may cleanse our sins and drive away all wickedness, weakness, hostile fury, and sudden death from us. May the merits of all the saints keep us far from these things and benefit all the living and deceased faithful for their sake, so that through their intercession you may grant them forgiveness for whose souls you have offered salvation.

text: Sumpta quaesumus omnipotens Deus vitalis mensae sacramenta sint nobis per almiflui confessoris tui Melliti suffragia super mel et favum in sempiternum dulcia.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that the vital sacraments of the table be sweet to us through the intercession of your confessor Melchior. May this prayer for honey and wheat last forever in sweetness.

text: Sumpta refectio Domine ad caelestia nos introducat convivia et dum in hac vita sumus sancti protectoris nostri Iudoci nobis non desit intercessio gloriosa.
translation_en: Lord, may the meal we have taken lead us to the celestial feasts. While we are still in this life, may the intercession of our holy patron Jude never cease to be glorious for us.

text: Sumpta refectio Domine quaesumus nos ad caelestia introducat convivia et sancti Iudoci intercessio tanto convivio nos dignos efficiat.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that the meal we have taken may introduce us to celestial banquets, and may the intercession of Saint Judoc make us worthy of such a feast.

text: Sumpta refectio quam pro beati martyris tui Domine Pantaleonis celebritate percepimus prosit nobis ad capessenda superni gaudia convivii.
translation_en: The feast which we have received in honor of your blessed martyr, Lord Pantaleon, may aid us in attaining the heavenly joys of the banquet.

text: Sumpta sacramenta Domine nos absolvam vinculis peccatorum et animabus nostrorum benefactorum defunctorum consortia obtineant spirituum beatorum.
translation_en: Lord, grant us pardon for the sacred mysteries, and may the souls of our departed benefactors obtain the company of the blessed spirits.

text: Sumpta sacramenta quaesumus Domine nos a peccatis absolvant et (per) beati antistitis Dunstani suffragia ad caelos perducant.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the sacraments taken may absolve us from sins and through the intercession of blessed bishop Dunstan lead us to heaven.

text: Sumpta sacramenta quaesumus Domine nos a peccatis omnibus absolvant et beati Iusti confessoris tui atque pontificis suffragia ad paradisi nos perducant gaudia.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, that the sacraments taken may absolve us from all sins and the intercession of your just confessor and bishop grant us a safe passage to the joys of paradise.

text: Sumpta sacra mysteria quaesumus Domine Deus noster propitius in nobis conservare digneris et intercedente beato Paulo confessore tuo atque pontifice angelicis turmis ad caeli sidera mereamur vehi et pulchra perpetuae penetrare limina vitae.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that you deign to preserve the sacred mysteries in us and through the intercession of blessed Paul, your confessor and pope, and with the help of the angelic hosts, we may be worthy to ascend to the heavenly stars and enter the beautiful gates of eternal life.

text: Sumpta sacrificia tua Domine beato Quirico martyre tuo deprecante remedium nobis caeleste concilient.
translation_en: Your offered sacrifices, Lord, through your blessed martyr Quiricus, interceding for us, grant us heavenly aid.

text: Sumpta sacrosancta communi(cati)o beato interveniente Grimbaldo hoc in nobis Domine operetur ut in fide inveniamur stabiles et in moribus concordes et in bono proposito efficaces.
translation_en: May this sacred communion, with the blessed Grimbaldo intervening, Lord, work within us so that we may be found steadfast in faith, harmonious in behavior, and effective in good intent.

text: Sumpti mysterii quaesumus Domine purificet sancta libatio et beatissimi sacerdotis et confessoris tui Syri intercessio ad vitam nos perducat aeternam.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the offering for the mystery be purified and may the prayers of Your most blessed priest and confessor Syri lead us to eternal life.

text: Sumpti sacrificii Domine libamen caelestis irae vindictam a famulo tuo illo suspendat et noxia semper ab eo cuncta depellat.
translation_en: Lord, may the offering of the sacrifice appease Your celestial wrath and drive away all harm from that servant. May he always be freed from any evil.

text: Sumpti sacrificii Domine perpetua nos tuitio non relinquat et noxia semper a nobis cuncta depellat.
translation_en: Lord, may the offering sustain us under Your perpetual protection, and may all harm be always repelled from us.

text: Sumptis divinis mysteriis concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctorum martyrum tuorum illorum quorum celebramus victorias precibus auxilium sentiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God to grant us through sacred mysteries that we may feel the assistance of those martyrs whose victories we celebrate through our prayers.

text: Sumptis Domine caelestibus sacramentis concede propitius ut intercessione beati Theodori confessoris tui atque pontificis ab omnibus semper protegamur adversis.
translation_en: Lord, with heavenly sacraments, graciously grant that we may always be protected from all adversities through the intercession of your blessed confessor and bishop, St. Theodore.

text: Sumptis Domine caelestibus sacramentis maiestatem tuam suppliciter exoro ut me a peccatis et vitiis expiatum dono gratiae tuae ad tua promissa recto cursu pervenire concedas.
translation_en: With heavenly sacred gifts, I humbly beseech you, Lord, that you may grant me to be cleansed from sins and vices by your grace, so that I may reach your promised rewards on a right path.

text: Sumptis Domine caelestibus sacramentis quaesumus clementiam tuam ut famulum tuum regem nostrum illum cum suis omnibus respicere digneris pietatisque tuae donis ab omnibus purges peccatis et a cunctis imminentibus periculis tuearis.
translation_en: With the heavenly sacraments we humbly ask for your clemency, Lord, that you may deem worthy to look upon your servant, our king, with him and all his people. May your gifts of mercy purify him from all sins, and protect him from every impending danger.

text: Sumptis Domine caelestibus sacramentis quaesumus ut intercessione sanctorum martyrum Thebaeorum consequi mereamur veniam delictorum.
translation_en: With heavenly sacrifices, we humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of the Theban martyrs we may deserve forgiveness for our sins.

text: Sumptis Domine divinis mysteriis exaudi quaesumus preces nostras ut sanctorum tuorum Euphemiae Luciae et Geminiani quorum sollemniter celebramus victoriam continuis foveamur auxiliis.
translation_en: Lord, hear our prayers at the divine mysteries granted. We humbly ask that you strengthen our celebration of the victory of your saints Euphemia, Lucia, and Geminian, that we may be continually fostered with their continuous aid.

text: Sumptis Domine donis caelestis mysterii humiliter deprecamur ut intercedente beato Marco evangelista et martyre tuo et temporalis vitae nos facias pace gaudere et aeternae reperire subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, with the gifts of heavenly mystery we humbly pray. Through the intercession of the blessed Mark, your evangelist and martyr, make us rejoice in peace during temporal life and find aid for eternal life.

text: Sumptis Domine donis tuis in sanctorum dispersione apostolorum quaesumus ut sicut illorum fideli vocatione gentium diversitatem in unam sanctae Trinitatis fidem accendisti ita eorum nobis obtentu tua facias prodesse sacramenta.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, with Your gifts distributed among the apostles, that just as they kindled diversity of nations into one faith of the holy Trinity through their faithful calling, so may their intercession make Your sacraments beneficial to us.

text: Sumptis Domine libaminibus sacris quaesumus ut per beatae Margaretae virginis et martyris tuae merita veneranda et a peccatis nos exuas et caelestis remedii vigore confirmes.
translation_en: Lord, we ask you with holy offerings, may your mercy through the merits of blessed Margaret, virgin and martyr, remove us from sins and strengthen us with celestial remedy.

text: Sumptis Domine muneribus sacris intercedente beato archipraesule ac martyre tuo Alfego a cunctis adversitatibus eruamur et gaudiis mansuris inseramur.
translation_en: With sacred offerings, Lord, we are delivered from all adversities with the intercession of your blessed archbishop and martyr Alfegus. We are inserted into lasting joys.

text: Sumptis Domine muneribus quaesumus ut beato martyre tuo intercedente sancti nominis tui timorem pariter et amorem facias nos habere perpetuum ut cum frequentatione mysterii crescat nostrae salutis effectus.
translation_en: With the offerings we ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of your blessed martyr, you make us have both fear and love for your holy name perpetually. May it be so that as we frequent the mystery, the effects of our salvation grow.

text: Sumptis Domine muneribus sacris te supplices deprecamur ut eorum virtute roborati beati Osmundi confessoris tui atque pontificis imitemur exempla et ad gaudia perveniamus aeterna.
translation_en: With sacred offerings, Lord, we humbly entreat you that strengthened by their virtue, we may follow the examples of your blessed confesser and bishop Osmund, and reach eternal joys.

text: Sumptis Domine muneribus sacris tribue quaesumus ut ad eadem appetenda sanctorum martyrum tuorum Alexandri Eventii et Theoduli precibus et exemplis promptius incitemur.
translation_en: Lord, with sacred offerings we ask that you bestow upon us, so that we may be more quickly inspired by the prayers and examples of your saints Alexander, Eventius, and Theodulus.

text: Sumptis Domine mysteriis tuam misericordiam suppliciter exoramus ut sicut beati Gregorii confessoris tui atque pontificis et scriptis aedificas et sollemnitate laetificas ita perpetua supplicatione defendas.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Lord, with Your mysteries to show forth Your mercy, just as Your confessor and bishop, Saint Gregory, builds up through his writings and delights through his solemnity, so may You protect us perpetually through our continual petition.

text: Sumptis Domine remediis sempiternis tuorum mundentur corda fidelium ut apostolici Petri et Pauli natalis insignia quae corporalibus officiis exsequuntur pia cordis intellegentia comprehendant.
translation_en: With the everlasting remedies, Lord, may the hearts of the faithful be purified, so that they may understand with pious heart's intelligence the insignia of the apostles Peter and Paul's natal feast which are carried out through corporal offices.

text: Sumptis Domine sacramentis caelestibus quaesumus clementiam tuam ut interveniente beata Margareta virgine tua et martyre nobis remedia aeterna acquirant.
translation_en: With the sacred celestial gifts, we humbly ask for your clemency that, with the intervention of your blessed Virgin and Martyr Margaret, eternal remedies may be granted to us.

text: Sumptis Domine sacramentis in honorem sancti confessoris tui Germani episcopi cuius venerandam hodie celebramus festivitatem nos clementer exaudi tuam misericordiam obsecrantes ut ab hac (... cetera desunt ...).
translation_en: Lord, with the sacred rites we offer you in honor of your holy confessor Bishop Germanus, whose revered feast day we celebrate today. We humbly entreat your clemency to hear our prayers, invoking your mercy, (... the rest is missing ...).

text: Sumptis Domine sacramentis quaesumus ut intercedente beato martyre tuo Hippolyto ad redemptionis aeternae proficiamus augmentum.
translation_en: With the sacred gifts, we humbly ask you, Lord, that with the intercession of your blessed martyr Hippolytus, we may make progress towards an increase in eternal redemption.

text: Sumptis Domine sacramentis intercedente beata et gloriosa semperque virgine Dei Genitrice Maria ad redemptionis aeternae quaesumus proficiamus augmentum.
translation_en: Lord, with the sacred mysteries intervening, we humbly ask for progress and increase through the intercession of the blessed, glorious, and ever-virgin Mother of God, Mary, in the eternal redemption.

text: Sumptis Domine caelestibus sacramentis ad redemptionis aeternae quaesumus proficiamus augmentum.
translation_en: With heavenly sacraments granted to us for the increase of eternal redemption, we humbly ask that we may progress.

text: Sumptis Domine sacramentis ad redemptionis aeternae quaesumus proficiamus augmentum.
translation_en: With the sacred gifts, Lord, we ask that we may progress towards the increase of eternal redemption.

text: Sumptis Domine salutaribus sacramentis ad redemptionis aeternae quaesumus proficiamus augmentum.
translation_en: With the saving sacraments granted by You, Lord, we humbly ask to progress and increase in the redemption of eternal life.

text: Sumptis Domine sacramentis salutis nostrae gratias tibi referimus humiliter deprecantes ut mundes propitius cor nostrum a vitiis et repleas illud iugiter spiritalibus donis.
translation_en: With the sacred gifts of our salvation, we humbly offer you thanks and pray that you, being merciful, purify our heart from vices and continually fill it with spiritual gifts.

text: Sumptis Domine salutaribus sacramentis pro sollemnitate beati apostoli tui Bartholomaei supplices deprecamur ut quae praedicavit et credamus pariter et sequamur.
translation_en: With salutary offerings for the solemnity of your Apostle, Bartholomew, we humbly beseech you that what he preached we may believe equally and follow.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis aeternae alimoniis beata Potentiana intercedente ita nos tuis fac uti sacramentis ut aeternis mereamur interesse conviviis.
translation_en: Lord, with the sustenance of eternal salvation provided to the blessed Potentiana, grant that we may partake in your sacraments, so that we may deserve to be present at the eternal banquet.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis aeternae mysteriis quaesumus ut intercedente beata Potentiana virgine tua ita nos tuis uti facias sacramentis ut aeternis mereamur interesse conviviis.
translation_en: Lord, with the mysteries of eternal salvation presented, we humbly ask that through the intercession of your blessed Virgin Potentiana, you make us worthy to use your sacraments in such a way that we may merit to join the eternal feasts.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis aeternae mysteriis suppliciter deprecamur ut beatae Katerinae virginis tuae et martyris intercessione animas et corpora nostra custodias et cunctas a nobis iniquitates expellas.
translation_en: With the mysteries of eternal salvation, we humbly entreat you, Lord, that through the intercession of your blessed Catherine, virgin and martyr, you may protect our souls and bodies, and drive away from us all iniquities.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis aeternae mysteriis suppliciter deprecamur ut sicut liquor qui de membris beatae Caterinae virginis iugiter manat languidorum corpora sanat sic eius oratio cunctas a nobis iniquitates expellat.
translation_en: With the mysteries of eternal salvation, we humbly entreat you, Lord. As the liquid which continually flows from the limbs of blessed Catherine the Virgin heals weak bodies, may her prayer drive all our wickednesses from us.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis nostrae sacramentis quaesumus ut per intercessionem beati Laurentii martyris tui et veniam nobis operentur et pacem.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, with the sacred rites of our salvation, that through the intercession of your blessed martyr Lawrence, they may grant us forgiveness and peace.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis nostrae subsidiis da quaesumus eius patrociniis nos ubique protegi in cuius veneratione haec tuae obtulimus maiestati.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, protection through the resources of our salvation, as we humbly ask for his patronage to shield us everywhere. In his reverence, we have offered this to your majesty.

text: Sumptis Domine salutis nostrae subsidiis tuam misericordiam suppliciter deprecamur ut ab imminenti nos plaga defendas et ab aeterna damnatione eripias.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Lord, with the assistance of our salvation, that you protect us from the impending affliction and deliver us from eternal condemnation.

text: Sumptis Domine tuae institutionis muneribus quaesumus ut nos eorum et munditia purges et potenti virtute defendas.
translation_en: Lord, we ask that you cleanse us with the gifts of your institution and protect us powerfully with your might.

text: Sumptis muneribus Domine quaesumus ut cum frequentatione mysterii crescat nostrae salutis effectus.
translation_en: With these offerings, Lord, we humbly ask that with the increase of participation in the mystery, may the effect of our salvation grow.

text: Sumptis muneribus tuis ab omnibus nos Domine peccatis intercedente beato confessore tuo propitiatus absolve ut percepta venia peccatorum liberis tibi mentibus serviamus.
translation_en: With your gifts bestowed upon us by all, Lord, through the intercession of your blessed confessor, may we be pardoned and absolved. May we serve you with minds free from the forgiven sins.

text: Sumptis muneribus tuis adesto nobis quaesumus Domine in tua proiectione confidentibus ut beati apostoli tui illius cuius natalicia praevenimus suffragiis adiuti perpetuis gaudeamus beneficiis et mentis et corporis.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to be present with us through Your gifts. In Your protection, we are confident that, assisted by the constant intercessions of the blessed apostles, especially the one whose feast day we now celebrate, we may enjoy everlasting blessings for both mind and body.

text: Sumptis redemptionis nostrae muneribus praesta quaesumus misericors Deus eorum celebratione nobis tuae protectionis contra omnes adversitates subsidium.
translation_en: Through the offerings for our redemption, we humbly ask, merciful God, that you grant us support in your protection against all adversities through their celebration.

text: Sumptis sacramentis Domine quaesumus nutriatur in nobis sanctae devotionis affectus et beati Mennae martyris tui meritis augeatur.
translation_en: With the sacred mysteries, Lord, we ask that a feeling for holy devotion may grow within us and may the merits of your blessed martyr St. Menna increase.

text: Sumptis sacramentis plebs tua Domine quaesumus repleta proficiat et eorum fulta praesidiis quorum natalicia celebrat quod temporaliter devota sectatur aeternum consequi mereatur.
translation_en: With the sacred rites, we humbly ask, Lord, may your people be filled and progress. May they be supported by the protections of those whose feast days they celebrate for a while. May they deserve to attain the eternal, having been devoted temporarily to it.

text: Sumptis sacramentis sanctorum tuorum quaesumus semper nos festa laetificent et maiestati tuae perpetua placatione commendent.
translation_en: We humbly ask that your holy sacraments always make our feast days joyful and that they continually recommend us to your majesty through eternal pleasing.

text: Sumptis sacris muneribus quaesumus Domine ut beati Lamberti pontificis intercessione nos in vitae labentis cursu iugi moderatione gubernes et ad gaudia sempiterna perducas.
translation_en: With sacred offerings we humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of Blessed Bishop Lambertus, you guide us in the fluctuating course of life with steadfast moderation and lead us to eternal joys.

text: Sumpto Deus omnipotens sacrificio singulari in quo tantum te confidimus nobis posse placari quaesumus ut per unicum Filium tuum quem singulariter propitiationem fecisti pro peccatis nostris ita specialiter sicut filiis nobis miserearis cunctis offensionum nostrarum inimicitiis abolitis.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that since you are appeased by the unique sacrifice in which we place our entire trust, you may deign to grant us, through your only Son whom you have singularly propitiated for our sins, to be merciful to us all, and by abolishing all enmity arising from our offenses, may favor us specifically.

text: Sumpto Domine corporis et sanguinis tui sacramento praesta quaesumus ut hoc idem mihi peccatori proficiat ad veniam quod etiam toto mundo profuit ad salutem.
translation_en: Lord, having received your sacrament of body and blood, grant us humbly that this same thing may profit me, a sinner, for forgiveness; which also benefited the entire world for salvation.

text: Sumpto Domine divino mysterio supplices te deprecamur ut meritis sanctorum martyrum tuorum Hellari et Daciani Felicis Largi atque Dionysii in quorum hoc commemoratione percepimus hoc idem sacramentum ad salutem nostrarum proficiat animarum.
translation_en: Lord, we approach Your divine mystery with supplication. We humbly ask You that through the merits of Your saints and martyrs Hellari, Dacian, Felicitas Largi, and Dionysius, in whose commemoration we have received this same sacrament, it may bring salvation to our souls.

text: Sumpto Domine divini muneris sacramento quaesumus ut sicut beatus praecursor baptista Ioannes per martyrii palmam aeternum pervenit ad regnum ita nobis salutis perpetuae acquirat subsidium.
translation_en: We ask You, Lord, to bestow upon us the divine sacrament, so that just as blessed precursor John the Baptist attained eternal life through the palm of martyrdom, may we also acquire support for our salvation's perpetuity.

text: Sumpto Domine sacramento beatis apostolis intervenientibus deprecamur ut quod temporaliter gerimus capiamus aeternum.
translation_en: Lord, supported by the sacred sacrament and the intervention of the blessed apostles, we humbly ask that what we temporarily possess may be obtained for us eternally.

text: Sumpto Domine sacramento suppliciter deprecamur ut intercedentibus beatis apostolis quod temporaliter gerimus ad vitam capiamus aeternam.
translation_en: Lord, with the Sacrament taken, we humbly beseech You that, through the intercession of the blessed Apostles, what we temporarily possess may lead us to eternal life.

text: Sumpto Domine unico ac salutari remedio corpore scilicet et pretioso sanguine tuo ab omnibus malis beatae Mariae Magdalenae patrociniis exuamur.
translation_en: With your one and saving remedy, Lord, we are freed from all evils by the intercession of the blessed Mary Magdalene, through your precious blood applied to our body.

text: Sumpto sacrificio Domine tua generaliter exsultet ecclesia quo infirmitates eius sunt absumptae ut divinae particeps fieret ipsa substantiae.
translation_en: With your offering, Lord, may the church rejoice in general, for its infirmities have been taken away, so that it became a participant of the very substance itself.

text: Sumptum Domine caelestis remedii sacramentum ad perpetuam nobis provenire gratiam beatus Damasus pontifex obtineat.
translation_en: May the Lord grant us, through blessed Damasus, the bishop, the constant coming of the heavenly remedy for eternal grace.

text: Sumptum quaesumus Domine tuae gratiae sacramentum sanctissima unigeniti tui genitrix virgo Maria nobis ad aeternae redemptionis provenire obtineat remedium.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that Your grace may cause the most holy sacrament of Your only-begotten Son, the Virgin Mary, His mother, to come to us for our salvation in eternal redemption.

text: Sumptum quaesumus Domine venerabile sacramentum et praesentis vitae subsidiis nos foveat et aeternae.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, for the honorable sacrifice, and may it nourish us in our present life and sustain us for eternity.

text: Super corpus benevoli redemptoris spiritales aquilas volitantes et resurgentis domini claritatem radiante fidei obtutu cernentes debitas tibi offerimus pater clementissime gratias et ideo deprecamur ut ad huius delectabilis mensae caelestes epulas invitati dono pacis aeternae in hoc paschali mereamur convivio recreari.
translation_en: We offer you, most merciful Father, grateful thanks for the spiritual eagles flying and rising, seeing the brightness of the Lord through the radiant veil of faith. We humbly ask that, invited to this delightful celestial feast, we may be worthy of receiving the gift of eternal peace in this Paschal gathering.

text: Super devotum tibi populum omnipotens Deus piam benignus multiplica misericordiam et praesta ut quorum hodie singularem celebramus divisionem eorum piam apud te pro nobis experiamur intercessionem quatenus in una fidei congregamur devotione qui de eorum sollemni hodie gratulamur divisione.
translation_en: Almighty God, gracious and benevolent, multiply your mercy upon this devoted people, and grant that those whom we today celebrate the singular division of, may experience their pious intercession for us before you. May we gather in one faith with them in devotion, who rejoice with us today on account of the solemn division.

text: Super haec munera Domine quae tibi pro beati Aldelmi festivitate offeruntur et tuam effunde benedictionem et cordium nobis tribue purificationem.
