translation_en: Over these gifts, Lord, which are offered to you on the feast of blessed Aldhelm, pour out your blessing and grant us the purification of hearts.

text: Super haec munera quae in hac sancti martyris tui Quintini celebritate sunt tibi oblata Domine sancte Pater Spiritus Sancti tui plenitudo descendat cuius invisibili operatione in corporis ac sanguinis dilecti Filii tui transeant sacramenta ad relaxanda totius tuae plebis delicta.
translation_en: Upon these offerings that have been presented during the feast of your holy martyr Quintinus, Lord and Holy Father, may the fullness of Your Holy Spirit descend upon them. Through its invisible operation, may the sacraments pass through the body and blood of Your beloved Son for the remission of all sins of Your entire people.

text: Super haec sacrosancta libamina adsit quaesumus omnipotens Pater tuae benedictionis copia et beati Mauri intervenientibus meritis sint ad remedium cunctis fidelibus populis.
translation_en: Upon these most sacred libanums, we ask, O Almighty Father, that your blessing abundance may be present. May it be through the merits of Blessed Maurice that it be a remedy for all faithful peoples.

text: Super hanc hostiam nostram quaesumus Domine benedictio tua descendat et ut ipsi tibi hostia placabilis efficiamur meritis sanctae Mariae Aegyptiacae apud te efficiat.
translation_en: Upon this our offering, we humbly ask, Lord, may your blessing descend and that we, ourselves, may become a pleasing sacrifice to you through the merits of Saint Mary of Egypt with you.

text: Super hanc oblationem nostram quaesumus Domine benedictio tua descendat et ut ipsi tibi hostia placabilis efficiamur sancta Editha apud te obtineat.
translation_en: Upon this offering of ours, we humbly ask, Lord, that your blessing descends and that we, pleasing to you, become acceptable offerings. Saint Editha may obtain favor with you.

text: Super hanc hostiam quaesumus Domine tua descendat benedictio nosque a peccatis emundet sancti Swithuni antistitis interventio et cottidie crescere adiuvet in tuo sancto servitio.
translation_en: Upon this offering, we humbly ask, Lord, that Your blessing descend upon it. May it cleanse us from sins through the intervention of Saint Swithun, bishop, and may it daily grow as we serve in Your holy service.

text: Super has Domine nostrae devotionis hostias propitius respice et peccatorum nostrorum vincula meritis beati Albani martyris tui clementer absolve.
translation_en: Upon these, Lord, regard favorably our offerings of devotion, and with the merits of your martyr saint Alban, grant us a merciful release from our sins.

text: Super has Domine quaesumus hostias tua copiosa descendat benedictio et ut nobis ad salutem proficiant beatae Fidis virginis obtineat intercessio.
translation_en: Upon these, Lord, we humbly ask that your abundant offerings descend and that the blessing be upon us, so that through them we may advance towards our salvation. May the blessed Faithful Virgin's intercession be obtained for us.

text: Super has fidelium hostias Domine propitio vultu respice et quia nostris meritis non valemus his potius muneribus tuo occursui mundemur.
translation_en: Lord, upon these offerings of Your faithful, turn a favorable countenance and since we are not worthy in our own merits, let us rather be cleansed by Your gifts.

text: Super has quaesumus Domine hostias benedictio copiosa descendat quae et captivi illius vincula solvat et de eius liberatione nos cito laetificet.
translation_en: On these we beseech you, Lord, may a rich blessing descend, that it may dissolve the bonds of those who are its captives and quickly make us rejoice in their release.

text: Super has quaesumus hostias Domine benedictio copiosa descendat quae et sanctificationem nobis clementer operetur et de martyrum nos sollemnitate laetificet.
translation_en: Upon these we humbly ask, Lord, that a rich blessing may descend, which may also sanctify us graciously and delight us from the solemnity of the martyrs.

text: Super populum tuum Domine quaesumus benedictio copiosa descendat indulgentia veniat consolatio tribuatur fides sancta succrescat redemptio sempiterna firmetur.
translation_en: Upon your people, Lord, we humbly ask that a plentiful blessing descends, that grace comes, comfort is given, faith is bestowed, and the holy faith flourishes. May eternal redemption be strengthened.

text: Supplicamus omnipotens Deus immensam pietatis tuae clementiam pro anima famuli tui illius cuius hodie annua dies agitur ut eam ab inferni claustris tua liberare potentia et paradisi amoenitatem largire digneris.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Almighty God, your immense mercy, for the soul of your servant whose annual day is observed today. May you have the power to free it from the prison of Hell, and may you grant the delight of Paradise as a worthy gift.

text: Supplicandi tibi quaesumus Domine da nobis sine cessatione constantiam ut quos non deseris in tribulatione subiectos copiosius foveas maiestatem tuam iugiter exorantes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, give us unceasing constancy. May your majesty be deeply cherished by those who, in the trial, are subject to you, as we continually beseech you.

text: Supplicatio tibi nostra Domine et grata pariter exsistat oblatio quae cum pro sanctorum tuorum commemoratione defertur indulgentiam nobis iisdem suffragantibus consequatur.
translation_en: May our supplication, Lord, be both pleasing and exist as a worthy offering. When it is brought in remembrance of your saints, may it result in mercy for us, with them interceding on our behalf.

text: Supplicatione nostra tibi Domine grata pariter exsistat oblatio quam pro sancti Ambrosii confessoris tui atque pontificis commemoratione deferimus atque indulgentiam nobis eius suffragiis quaesumus largiaris.
translation_en: May our supplication, Lord, stand favorably before you as we offer it on behalf of the remembrance of your confessor and bishop St. Ambrose. We humbly ask that you grant us the indulgence through his intercessions.

text: Supplicationem servorum tuorum Deus miserator exaudi ut qui in nativitate Dei Genitricis et virginis congregamur eius intercessionibus complacatus a te de instantibus periculis eruamur.
translation_en: Hear our prayer, O merciful God, and grant that we who assemble in the nativity of the Mother of God and virgin, may be delivered from present dangers through her intercessions.

text: Supplicationibus apostolicis beati Ioannis evangelistae quaesumus Ecclesiae tuae Domine commendetur oblatio cuius magnificis praedicationibus eruditur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the Apostolic Supplications of the Blessed John the Evangelist, our offering may be commended to your Church.

text: Supplicationibus nostris Domine propitiatus intende quas in sanctae tuae illius virginis et martyris commemoratione deferimus et hoc sacrificium superillatum ita dignanter attende ut qui fiduciam de propria iustitia non habemus eius quae tibi placere meruit precibus adiuvemur.
translation_en: Lord, incline Your ears to our supplications, which we bring forward on the commemoration of Your holy virgin and martyr. And may this elevated sacrifice be so attended to with favor that, since we have no faith in our own justice, we may be aided by His merits whom You find pleasing through our prayers.

text: Supplicationis nostrae hostias Domine Deus omnipotens ut clementer suscipias humiliter exoramus et familiae tuae quae se beatissimi confessoris tui Hieronymi monitis eruditam exsultat caelestis regni ianuas aperire digneris.
translation_en: Lord God Almighty, we humbly beseech You to graciously receive our offerings. We also pray for Your family who, instructed by the teachings of your blessed confessor Jerome, rejoices in the learning of heavenly wisdom. May You deem it worthy to open the gates of eternal kingdom for them.

text: Supplicem tibi Domine plebem placatus intende et in tua misericordia confidentem clementia largiore comitare ut quia sine te non potest omnino consistere tuis beneficiis temporalibus gubernetur ut proficiat ad aeterna.
translation_en: Lord, graciously incline Your attention towards this supplicating people, and lead them with a more abundant mercy in Your compassion, so that since they cannot in any way stand without You, they may be governed by Your temporal blessings to progress towards eternal life.

text: Supplicem tibi populum Domine tua munitione custodi nec difficulter quod pie quod iuste postulat consequatur cui sanctorum tuorum merita suffragantur.
translation_en: Lord, protect this suppliant people of yours with your fortification, so that what they humbly and justly ask for may not be difficult to obtain. May the merits of your saints intercede for them.

text: Supplices clementiam tuam quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut ab hoste maligno defendas quos per lignum sanctae crucis Filii tui arma iustitiae pro salute mundi triumphare iussisti.
translation_en: We humbly ask for your clemency, almighty God, that you protect us from the malicious enemy, as you have commanded your Son's arms of justice to triumph through the wood of the holy cross for the salvation of the world.

text: Supplices Domine deprecamur ut per haec dona sacrificii singularis et abolitio peccatorum et tua nobis sanctificatio praebeatur.
translation_en: Humbly we beseech You, Lord, that through these gifts of this unique sacrifice, forgiveness of sins and Your sanctification may be granted to us.

text: Supplices Domine te rogamus ut fructuum terrenorum commodis sufficienter adiuti ad te omnium proficiamus auctorem.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, Lord, to aid us sufficiently with the benefits of earthly fruits so that we may progress towards you, the author of all.

text: Supplices Domine te rogamus ut his sacrificiis peccata nostra mundentur et devotas humilitatis nostrae preces et hostias misericordiae tuae praecedat auxilium et salutem quam per Adam in paradiso ligni clauserat temerata praesumptio ligni rursum fides aperiat.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, Lord, that our sins may be purified by these sacrifices and that the prayers and offerings of our devoted humility precede your help and salvation. As the imprudent presumption of Adam closed the way to paradise with the tree, so may faith once again open it.

text: Supplices Domine te rogamus ut his sacrificiis peccata nostra mundentur quia tunc veram nobis tribuis et mentis et corporis sanitatem.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to cleanse our sins with these sacrifices, for then you grant us both physical and mental health.

text: Supplices Domine te rogamus ut quamvis offensiones nostrae impediant recordatione tamen martyrum tuorum munus nostrum non sit ingratum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask You that although our offenses may hinder remembrance, let not the service of Your martyrs be ungrateful on our part.

text: Supplices quaesumus Domine pro animabus famulorum tuorum preces effundimus sperantes ut quidquid conversatione contraxerunt humana et clementer indulgeas et in tuorum sede laetantium constituas redemptorum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for the souls of your servants; we pour out our prayers, hoping that whatever they contracted in life, you will mercifully forgive and establish them among those rejoicing in your presence, the redeemed.

text: Supplices quaesumus Domine ut munus trepida servitute propositum non de nostris meritis aestimetur sed quod a te institutum est offerentium tua sanctificetur dignatione praesentium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the office proposed with trembling servitude may not be considered according to our merits but rather that what has been established by you may be sanctified by the dignity of those present.

text: Supplices te rogamus clementissime Deus ut sancto tuo Andrea apostolo ac martyre obtinente tuae cognitionis gratiam uberiori copia atque eminentiori perspicacia consequamur.  Nec enim hoc rogantes eodem interveniente nos adepturos esse diffidimus quem tanto tuae dilectionis calore succensum agnoscimus ut non solum eis qui eo praedicante in te credebant salutaria verbi pocula ministraret sed ipsum quoque impiissimum Aegeam persecutorem ut ab idolorum vanissimo cultu recederet et te verum Deum agnosceret piis orationibus ut suaderet constanter admoneret. Verum quia nefarius ille ac perfidus gratiam tuae cognitionis quam caeca superbaque mente contempsit quia non meruit utique nec accepit.  Praesta nobis humillimis famulis tuis ut qui te dominum tuo dono credentes agnoscimus et agnoscentes fatemur a te numquam penitus recedamus sed dum tibi soli subicimur tibique fideliter inhaeremus aeternitatis tuae munera sortiamur.
translation_en:
Most merciful God, we humbly beseech you that, through the intercession of your holy apostle and martyr Andrew, we may attain to a greater understanding and clearer perception of your knowledge. For we do not doubt, since we recognize that the flames of your loving devotion have inflamed us, that not only will he who preached your salvation to those who believed in him administer the life-giving cups of your word, but even Aegeas, the most ungodly persecutor, may abandon the vain worship of idols and acknowledge you as the true God.
However, since that wicked and faithless man contemptuously rejected the grace of your knowledge with his blind, arrogant mind, because he did not deserve it nor receive it, grant to us, your most humble servants, that we who believe in you as our Lord may confess that we will never completely withdraw from you, but as long as we submit only to you and adhere faithfully to your eternal gifts.

text: Supplices te rogamus Deus; competentibus gaudiis diem nos celebrare concedas quo maiestatis tuae confessione magnifica beati apostoli tui Andreae sacer natalis illuxit pariterque nobis devotionis huius tempora largiora tribuas et profectum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, God; grant us to celebrate the day with fitting joy, as your majesty's glorious confession on the sacred nativity of your apostle Andrew has enlightened us. Furthermore, during these devotional times, grant us a more abundant bestowal.

text: Supplices te rogamus Deus ne aut malis propriis aggravemur aut infestemur ab hostibus qui tantis sanctorum tuorum meritis commonemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, God, not to afflict us with our own sins nor to be harassed by enemies whom we are brought together with the great merits of your saints.

text: Supplices te rogamus Deus ut interventu beati Laurentii martyris et tua in nobis dona multiplices et tempora nostra
translation_en: We humbly ask you, God, that through the intervention of the blessed Lawrence the Martyr, and your own gifts, may there be many graces bestowed upon us, and our times.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut intervenientibus sanctis tuis et tua in nobis dona multiplices et tempora nostra disponas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that with your saints present and your gifts bestowed upon us, you arrange our times.

text: Supplices te rogamus Deus ut munera quae deferimus et devotionis gratiam nobis conferant et salutem.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, God, to grant us the merits we bring and bestow upon us the grace of devotion, and health.

text: Supplices te rogamus Deus ut quos tuis reficis sacramentis et tibi placitis moribus dignanter informes.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, God, that you graciously shape and mold us worthy, as you renew us through your sacred sacraments and pleasing virtues.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut quos tuis reficis sacramentis tibi etiam placitis moribus dignanter deservire concedas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to grant that you who refresh us with your sacred mysteries, may also serve you worthily with pleasing manners.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut quos tuis reficis sacramentis intercedente beato Georgio martyre tuo tibi etiam placitis moribus dignanter tribuas deservire.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that you who strengthen us with your sacred mysteries, through the intercession of blessed George, your martyr, may grant us to serve you in pleasing manners worthy of you.

text: Supplices te rogamus Domine Deus noster ut qui percepimus caelestis mensae substantiam ad vitam pertineamus aeternam.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, Lord our God, that since we have perceived the substance of the heavenly table, it may belong to us for an eternal life.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut qui percepimus caelestis mensae substantiam intercedente beato Germano confessore tuo atque pontifice ad vitam perveniamus aeternam.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, Almighty God, that as we have perceived the substance of the heavenly table with the intercession of your blessed confesser and bishop Saint Germain, may we attain eternal life.

text: Supplices te rogamus Domine Deus noster ut sicut nos Filii tui corporis et sanguinis sacrosancti pascis alimonio ita nos et divinae naturae eius facias esse consortes.
translation_en: Suppliantly, we ask you, Lord our God, that just as we, Your sons, are nourished with the sacred food and blood of Your most holy body, so may You make us and the divine nature of Yours consorts.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens aeterne Deus ut intercedente beata Dorothea gloriosa virgine ac martyre tua in cuius passionis memoriam haec caelestia sumpsimus sacramenta piae nobis fructus devotionis accrescat et ab hostibus corporis et animae triumphare feliciter valeamus et aeterna dulcedine perfrui mereamur.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, eternal almighty God, through the intercession of the blessed Dorothea, the glorious virgin and martyr, in whose memory we have taken these heavenly sacraments. May the fruit of devotion increase for us, let us triumph happily over our enemies in body and soul, and may we merit to enjoy eternal sweetness.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus per sacrosanctae Filii tui coronae cuius sollemnia recensemus virtutem nobis proficiant ad medelam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that the sacraments which we have received under the sacred crown of your Son, whose feast day we are celebrating, may bring healing to us through their power.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut in conspectu maiestatis tuae acceptum sit hoc sacrificium quod tibi offerimus in festivitate beati martyris tui Narcissi de cuius meritis et intercessione praesumpsimus.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that this sacrifice we offer to you in the feast of your blessed martyr Narcissus may be acceptable in your divine presence. We presume on his merits and intercession.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente beato Bonifatio martyre tuo atque pontifice in cuius festivitate haec caelestia sumpsimus sacramenta et tua in nobis semper dona multiplices et vitam nostram ab omni adversitate defendas.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, through the intercession of the blessed martyr Boniface and your bishop, in whose feast day we have taken these heavenly sacraments, may your blessings always be multiplied upon us, and protect our life from every adversity.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut omnibus sanctis virginibus tuis intercedentibus sacrificium nostrum placatus accipias et vitam nostram ab omni adversitate custodias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, that through the intercession of all your holy virgins, you may accept our sacrifice and protect our life from every adversity.

text: Supplices te rogamus omnipotens Deus ut quos donis caelestibus satiasti intercedente beato Laurentio martyre tuo perpetua protectione custodias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, that you who have satisfied us with heavenly gifts, through the intercession of the blessed martyr Lawrence, may keep us under your perpetual protection.

text: Supplices tuam Domine clementiam deprecamur ut qui praevenis semper mala merita nostra miserendo tibi placita fieri concedas piis actibus et ieiuniis salubribus expiando.
translation_en: We humbly beseech You, Lord, to show Your mercy, that You who always prevent our deserved evils by being merciful, may cause them to become pleasing to You through pious acts and wholesome fasting, and so be forgiven.

text: Suppliciter Domine sacra familia munus tuae miserationis exspectat; concede quaesumus ut quod te iubente desiderat te largiente percipiat.
translation_en: Humbly, Lord, your sacred family awaits the gift of your mercy; grant us that it may receive what it desires through your generosity, according to your command.

text: Suppliciter exoramus clementiam pietatis tuae omnipotens Deus ut concedas munera gratiarum tuarum indigno famulo tuo illi pro quo hoc sacrificium tuae maiestati offerimus ut valeat haec congrua vota tua clementia ei largiente ad fructum perfectionis promereri.
translation_en: Most humbly we beseech the clemency of your mercy, Almighty God, that you grant the rewards of your gratitude to your unworthy servant for whom we offer this sacrifice to your majesty. May he be able to fulfill his congruent vows through your clemency bestowing upon him the fruit of perfection.

text: Suppliciter te Deus Pater omnipotens qui es creator omnium rerum deprecor ut dum me famulum tuum coram omnipotentia(e) maiestatis tuae (oculis) graviter deliquisse confiteor manum misericordiae mihi porrigas quatenus dum hanc oblationem tuae pietati offero quod nequiter admisi clementissime digneris absolvere.
translation_en: Humbly I pray to you, God, almighty Father who is the creator of all things, that while I, your servant, stand before the omnipotence and majesty of your presence, I confess that I have gravely sinned. Grant me the hand of mercy so that as I offer this sacrifice to your Pietas, you may graciously deign to forgive my unworthy actions.

text: Suppliciter te Deus Pater omnipotens qui es creator noster et omnium rerum deprecamur ut per intercessionem vel merita confessurum et martyrum illorum et illorum manum misericordiae tuae nobis porrigas ut quidquid iniuste vel nequiter per fragilitatem animae et corporis vel neglegentiis nostris contra voluntatem tuam admisimus clementissime per eorum suffragium digneris indulgere.
translation_en: Humbly we ask you, God our Almighty Father, who is our Creator and the Creator of all things, that through the intercession or merits of those confessors and martyrs, and through their hands of your mercy, you may graciously deign to forgive us for whatever we have unjustly or negligently admitted against your will due to the frailty of our soul and body. Most mercifully, we beseech you to forgive us through their intercession.

text: Suppliciter te imploramus omnipotens Deus ut quod fragili celebramus officio sanctorum atque angelorum nobis prodesse sentiamus auxilio.
translation_en: We humbly implore you, Almighty God, that what we feebly celebrate with the office of saints and angels may we feel to be helpful to us through your aid.

text: Suppliciter te rogamus Domine Deus noster ut huius operatione mysterii et vitia nostra purgentur et iusta desideria compleantur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, that through this operation of the mystery, our vices may be purged and our just desires fulfilled.

text: Suscipe clementissime Deus oblationes quas in tui venerationem et beatorum trium regum et magorum tuorum Gaspar Melchior et Balthassar sollemnitatis commemorationem tibi vivo et vero Deo offerimus ut per haec sancta sacrificia et eorum gloriosa suffragia ab omnibus inimicorum nostrorum insidiis nos liberes et a cunctis huius mundi periculis eripias et ad gaudia sempiterna perducas.
translation_en: Gentlest of God, we offer these oblations to You in Your veneration and in commemoration of the solemnity of the Blessed Three Kings Gaspar, Melchior, and Balthassar. We humbly ask that through these holy sacrifices and their glorious intercessions, You free us from all the plots of our enemies, rescue us from all perils of this world, and lead us to eternal joys.

text: Suscipe clementissime Deus sacrificium in honorem sancti patriarchae Ioachim patris Mariae virginis maiestati tuae oblatum ut ipso cum coniuge sua et beatissima prole intercedente perfectam consequi mereamur remissionem peccatorum et gloriam sempiternam.
translation_en: Most merciful God, accept the sacrifice offered in honor of St. Patriarch Joachim, father of the Virgin Mary, at your majesty. May we merit through him, along with his spouse and blessed offspring interceding, to achieve perfect remission of sins and eternal glory.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hanc oblationem quam tibi offero ego indignus famulus tuus pro requie animarum famulorum famularumque tuarum illorum et illarum; precor te clementissime Pater ut resurrectionis diem cum refrigerio tuae benignitatis exspectent.
translation_en: Receive most merciful Father, this offering which I, an unworthy servant, present to you on behalf of the rest of the souls of your servants and theirs; I humbly ask you, most merciful Father, that they may eagerly await the day of resurrection with the refreshment of your kindness.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater has oblationes quas ego indignus famulus tuus offero pro peccatis atque offensionibus meis et precor clementissime Pater ut peccata mea iubeas dimittere et vitam sempiternam tribuere.
translation_en: Receive, most merciful Father, these offerings which I, an unworthy servant, present on behalf of my sins and offenses. And I humbly pray, most merciful Father, that You command my sins to be forgiven and grant me eternal life.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater has oblationes quas ego peccator offerre praesumo in honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et in commemorationem beatae Mariae semper virginis omniumque sanctorum pro me et pro his qui se in nostris commendaverunt orationibus et qui suas nobis largiti sunt eleemosynas necnon et pro confitentibus nobis peccata sua ut per intercessionem eorundem sanctorum ad salutem omnium vivorum necnon et remissionem peccatorum animarum omnium fidelium proficiant defunctorum.
translation_en: Receive, O most merciful Father, these offerings which I, a sinner, presume to present in honor of our Lord Jesus Christ and in commemoration of the Blessed Virgin Mary ever virgin, all the saints, for me and for those who have entrusted themselves to our prayers and who have bestowed alms upon us, not only, but also for those confessing their sins to us, that through the intercession of these saints, may they benefit for the salvation of all the living and the remission of sins for all souls of the faithful departed.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostiam placationis et laudis quam tibi offerimus pro incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium fidelium catholicorum orthodoxorum quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum scripta adesse videntur et quorum numerum et nomina tu solus Dominus cognoscis ut per sacrificium praesentis oblationis ad refrigerium animarum eorum te miserante perveniat.
translation_en: Graciously receive, O most compassionate Father, the offering of appeasement and praise which we present to you on behalf of the health of your servants, their servants, and all your Catholic and Orthodox faithful whose names appear written before your holy altar, and whose number and names only you, Lord, know. May through this present offering's sacrifice, by your mercy, come to the relief of their souls.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostias devotionis nostrae et his placatus rectorem elige animarum nostrarum ut eius exemplo instituti te verum pastorem sectemur.
translation_en: Most merciful Father, receive our offerings of devotion and choose as ruler for our souls a righteous one, that we may follow him as a true shepherd according to his example.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostias placationis et laudis benigne quas tibi offero ego indignus famulus tuus quem ad ordinem sacerdotii promovere dignatus es et ut tibi servitus mea complaceat tua in me misericorditer dona conserva qui pro sacerdotibus mihi in hoc opus commissis postulare studeo; tu scis figmentum nostrum tu scis omnia quae egimus in conspectu tuo et in conspectu sanctorum tuorum qui non vis mortem peccatorum sed ut convertantur et vivant; respice in nos Domine per merita et intercessionem beatissimi apostoli tui Petri et miserere nostri quia tu es clemens et misericors Deus; perfice Domine benignus in nobis ut quae sacris mysteriis profitemur piis actionibus exsequamur.
translation_en: Receive graciously, O most compassionate Father, the offerings of propitiation and praise which I, unworthy servant, present to you. You have seen fit to promote me to the order of priesthood, and I desire that my service pleases you. Grant me your mercy, Lord, and preserve me in this office for which you have entrusted me with regard to those who are placed under my charge. You know our weakness; you know all that we do in your sight and in the sight of your saints, who desire not the death of sinners but rather their conversion and life. Look upon us, Lord, through the merits and intercession of your blessed apostle Peter, and have mercy on us, for you are a compassionate and merciful God. Grant graciously, O Lord, that we may faithfully fulfill what we profess in sacred mysteries.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostias placationis et laudis quas ego peccator et indignus tuus famulus tibi offerre praesumo ad honorem et gloriam nominis tui pro incolumitate famuli tui illius ut omnium delictorum suorum veniam consequi mereatur.
translation_en: Receive most mercifully, Father, the offerings of propitiation and praise which I, a sinner and unworthy your servant, presume to offer you on behalf of the welfare of your servant, that he may merit forgiveness for all his sins.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater hostias placationis et laudis quas tibi offero ego indignus tuus famulus quia tu scis figmentum meum quia peccavi in conspectu tuo et non sum dignus hostias tibi offerre sed tu clemens et misericors indulge mihi et oblationem meam quaeso placatus suscipe.
translation_en: Receive, most merciful Father, the offerings of appeasement and praise which I, unworthy your servant, present to you. For you know my unworthiness, because I have sinned before your face and am not worthy to offer sacrifices to you. Yet, you, merciful and compassionate, forgive me and I humbly ask that you accept my offering.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus supplicationes et preces quas tibi ego peccator praesumo offerre in honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et in commemorationem beatae Mariae semper virginis matris Domini nostri Iesu Christi et omnium apostolorum et martyrum et consessorum ac virginum tuarum pro pace et sanitate populorum tuorum et fructibus terrae et stabilitate ecclesiae et ordine sanctorum et sanitate regis et episcopi nostri et pro me misero famulo tuo et pro omnibus viventibus famulis ac famulabus tuis atque defunctis qui mihi propter nomen tuum bona fecerunt et mihi in tuo nomine confessi fuerunt et concede propitius ut intercedentibus sanctis tuis ante conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae misericordiam consequamur.
translation_en: Receive most mercifully, all-powerful Father, eternal God, the supplications and prayers which I, a sinner, presume to offer to you in honor of our Lord Jesus Christ and in commemoration of the blessed Mary, ever virgin, Mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, and all apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins, for the peace and health of your people, the fruitfulness of the earth, stability of the church, order of saints, health of the king and bishop, and for me, your miserable servant, and for all living and departed servants and handmaids of yours who have done good to me in your name, and have confessed you in my name. Grant graciously that through the intercession of your saints we may obtain your mercy.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater sanctas has oblationes quas ego peccator praesumo offerre in honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et omnium apostolorum et martyrum et confessorum ac virginum per intercessionem eorum pro pace et sanitate populorum tuorum et fructibus terrae et stabilitate ecclesiae in fide et ordine sancto et pro ine misero famulo tuo et pro incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum commemorationem agimus et pro defunctis fidelibus tuis qui mihi propter nomen tuum sanctum Domine bona fecerunt et in tuo nomine confessi fuerunt; propitius esto nobis et eis Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus ante conspectum maiestatis tuae ut sacrificium praesentis oblationis in refrigerium animarum nostrarum te miserante perveniat.
translation_en: Receive graciously, most merciful Father, these holy offerings which I, the sinner, presume to present on behalf of our Lord Jesus Christ and all apostles, martyrs, confessors, virgins. Through their intercession, may peace, health, fruitfulness of the earth, stability of the Church in faith and holy order, prosperity for your humble servant and well-being for your servants and handmaids be granted; and also for the poor unfortunate servant of yours and for the welfare of your servants and handmaids whom we remember. Furthermore, may this offering presently made reach as refreshment to our souls, merciful Lord, through Your mercy, that You look upon us with favor. Amen.

text: Suscipe clementissime Pater pro commemoratione famuli tui illius hostiam placationis et laudis ut sacrificii praesentis oblatio ad refrigerium animae eius te miserante perveniat.
translation_en: Receive most kind Father, on behalf of the remembrance of your servant, that offering of appeasement and praise. May the presentation of this sacrifice reach his soul, through your mercy, as it is offered.

text: Suscipe creator omnipotens Deus quae ieiunantes de tuae munificentiae largitate deferimus et pro temporali nobis collata praesidio ad vitam converte propitiatus aeternam.
translation_en: Accept, Almighty Creator God, what we, while fasting, offer from your bountiful generosity, and convert for us, in our temporary state, the protection bestowed for eternal mercy.

text: Suscipe Deus clementissime munia praesentis hostiae et per eius merita cuius annuam celebramus sollemnitatem largire nobis utriusque lucis prosperitatem.
translation_en: Most graciously, O God, receive the burden of this present offering and through His merits, who's annual solemnity we celebrate, grant us the prosperity of both lights.

text: Suscipe Deus clementissime munus quod tibi offerimus devotissime et interveniente sancto confessore tuo Swithuno atque pontifice ad utriusque prosperitatem vitae illud nobis provenire misericorditer concede.
translation_en: Graciously receive, O God, the gift that we offer you most devoutly. May your saintly confessor Swithun and bishop intervene on behalf of both our prosperity in life, and grant us to experience it mercifully.

text: Suscipe clementissime Deus munus quod maiestati tuae offerimus et interveniente beato Swithuno confessore tuo atque pontifice ad utriusque vitae prosperitatem illud nobis provenire concede.
translation_en: Gentlest of God, receive the offering that we present to your majesty, and through the intervention of blessed Swithun, your confessor and bishop, grant that it may bring prosperity in both life for us.

text: Suscipe Domine Deus hostias famuli et levitae tui illius et quem tibi facis esse devotum benigno refove miseratus auxilio.
translation_en: Receive, Lord God, the offerings of your servant and Levite; and him whom you make devoted to you, revive with merciful aid.

text: Suscipe Domine Deus preces tribulatorum cum oblationibus hostiarum et tuam misericordiam deprecantes ab omnibus defende periculis.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord God, the prayers of the afflicted with the offerings of sacrifices, and praying for your mercy, defend them from all dangers.

text: Suscipe Domine fidelium preces cum oblationibus hostiarum ut per haec piae devotionis officia ad caelestem gloriam transeamus.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers of the faithful along with the offerings of sacrifice, so that through these acts of pious devotion we may pass to celestial glory.

text: Suscipe Domine fidelium preces cum oblationibus hostiarum ut orationibus gloriosi martyris tui per haec piae devotionis officia remissionem omnium peccatorum percipiamus et ad caelestem gloriam transeamus.
translation_en: Lord, receive the prayers of the faithful together with the offerings of the sacrifices, so that we may receive the remission of all sins through the glorious martyr's prayers by means of these pious acts of devotion and pass to the celestial glory.

text: Suscipe Domine haec munera populi tui quae tibi in beati martyris tui Laurentii festivitate offerimus ut per eadem sicut confidimus tuae pietatis sentiamus auxilium.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, these gifts of your people which we offer to you on the feast day of your blessed martyr Laurence, so that through them, as we trust in your mercy, we may feel your help.

text: Suscipe Domine haec munera pro animabus omnium nostrorum requiescentium benefactorum et pro beneficiis corum quibus sustentamur; da eis retributionem in regno caelorum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, these gifts on behalf of the souls of all our benefactors who have fallen asleep; grant them repayment in the kingdom of heaven.

text: Suscipe Domine has oblationes ob honorem beatorum tuorum Romedii et sociorum eius ut nobis fiant dignae pro nostra salute benigne.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, these offerings in honor of your blessed ones Romedius and his companions, so that they may be worthy for our salvation, graciously.

text: Suscipe Domine hoc sacrificium ab offerentibus qui teipsum pro vita omnium in sacrificium obtulisti.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, this offering from those who for the life of all have offered themselves as a sacrifice to you.

text: Suscipe Domine hostiam hanc quam in honorem sancti Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis offerimus ut indulgentiam nobis eius precibus tribuas omnium delictorum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, this offering which we present in honor of Your martyr and bishop St. Blaise, that through his intercessions you may grant us forgiveness for all our sins.

text: Suscipe Domine ieiunium nostrum et offerentium accipe votum quo caro nostra quae abstinet a cibis abstineat a delictis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our fasting and accept the vow from those offering it; may our flesh, which abstains from food, also abstain from sins.

text: Suscipe Domine ieiunium nostrum et offerentium accipe votum quo caro vel anima nostra quae abstinet a cibis abstineat a delictis sicque adesto precibus nostris ut per hoc sacrificium mereamur requiem impetrare defunctis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our fast and those who offer it, and accept the vow by which either flesh or soul of ours abstains from food, let it also abstain from sins. And be present to our prayers so that through this sacrifice we may deserve to obtain rest for the departed.

text: Suscipe Domine munera familiae tuae quibus et nostris quaesumus sis placatus erroribus et sanctificationem tuae nobis redemptionis opereris.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings of Your family, for which we humbly ask You to be pleased with us, and work in us the sanctification of Your redemption.

text: Suscipe Domine munera nomini tuo oblata quae in Filii tui resurrectione triumphantis in gloria universalis eius acquisita sanguine offert ecclesia.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings made in Your name, which the Church offers in the glory of Your triumphant Resurrection Son, acquired by His blood throughout the universe.

text: Suscipe Domine munera passionibus tuorum dicata sanctorum et quae illis inter persecutiones fortitudinem ministrarunt nobis praebeant inter adversa constantiam.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings consecrated by your saints, and what they provided us with courage during their persecutions, grant to us constancy in adversity.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera populi tui pro martyrum tuorum passionibus dicata sanctorum et quae beato Xysto iri persecutione fortitudinem ministrarum nobis quoque praebeant inter adversa constantiam.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, the offerings of Your people, dedicated for the sufferings of Your martyrs. And may those qualities of bravery that blessed Xystus showed in his persecution be granted to us as well, that we too may show constancy in adversity.

text: Suscipe Domine munera per intercessionem sanctae illius virginis tuae cuius sollemnia celebramus ut ab omnibus mereamur emundari peccatis.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the offerings through the intercession of that holy virgin whom we celebrate, so that from all we may be worthy to be cleansed of sins.

text: Suscipe Domine munera plebis tuae pro beatorum apostolorum triumphis oblata et quia nostris meritis non est digna fiducia placentium tibi precibus fiat grata devotio.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings of your people for the triumphs of the blessed apostles, and because our merits are not worthy of confidence before you, may their prayers be pleasing to you and let a grateful devotion be made.

text: Suscipe Domine munera propitiatus oblata quae maiestati tuae beatus Xystus sacerdos commendet et martyr.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings presented with favor, which the blessed Pope Xystus, priest and martyr, dedicates to your majesty.

text: Suscipe Domine munera propitius oblata quae maiestati tuae beati Nicomedis martyris commendet oratio.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings with favor, which are being presented to Your majesty by the prayer of the blessed Nicomede, the martyr.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae in beatae Catherinae virginis et martyris tuae commemoratione deferimus et concede propitius ut cuius merita veneramur per eius ad te exempla gradiamur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings that we bring on the commemoration of your virgin and martyr, blessed Catherine, and graciously grant us that, through her merits, we may be worthy of your favor by following her examples.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae pro Filii tui gloriosa adscensione deferimus et concede propitius ut a praesentibus periculis liberemur et ad vitam perveniamus aeternam.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings that we bring for Your glorious Son during His ascent, and graciously grant us that we may be freed from present dangers and reach eternal life.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae tibi ego indignus et peccator qui nec invocatione tui nominis dignus sum pro immensis sceleribus meis offerre praesumo ut per haec sacrosancta redemptionis mundi mysteria in oculis maiestatis tuae gratiam propitiationis invenire merear.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the gifts that I, unworthy and sinful, presume to offer you, although I am not worthy even by invocation of your holy name. May I find grace for propitiation in your eyes through these most sacred mysteries of the redemption of the world.

text: Suscipe Domine munera tuae pietati humiliter immolata ut eius nobis intercessione fiant salutaria cuius nataliciis ea tibi speramus accepta.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, your gifts humbly offered to Your mercy, that through His intercession may they become beneficial for us. Whose birth we hope will be accepted by You.

text: Suscipe Domine munera tuae pietati humiliter immolanda et concede ut nobis sancti Leonardi confessoris tui atque abbatis intercessione fiant salutaria cuius nataliciis ea tibi speramus accepta.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings that are being humbly immolated to Your mercy and grant that through the intercession of Saint Leonard, your confessor and abbot, they may be salutary for us; whose nataliciis (celebrations) we hope will be acceptable to You.

text: Suscipe Domine munera tuorum votiva populorum et eorum tibi grata precibus esse concede pro quorum sollemnitatibus offeruntur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the vows of your people as offerings and grant that they may be pleasing to you through their grateful prayers, for whose solemnities are being offered.

text: Suscipe Domine munera tuorum populorum votiva et sanctorum Marci et Marcelliani tibi precibus esse grata concede pro quorum sollemnitatibus offeruntur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the gifts of your people, offered vowingly, and be gracious in response to the prayers of St. Marcus and St. Marcellian. Grant this for their solemnities which are being offered.

text: Suscipe Domine munus oblatum et conserva famulum tuum atque ab omnibus quas meretur adversitatibus redde securum ut tranquillitate percepta de omnium visibilium et invisibilium inimicorum insidiis liberatus devota tibi mente deserviat.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the offering given and keep your servant safe, and from all adversities that he deserves, return him secure. That, freed from the plots of visible and invisible enemies, he may serve you devotedly with a tranquil mind.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine tibi munus oblatum et intercedente beata Dei Genitrice Maria cum omnibus sanctis tuis famulum tuum illum pontificem nostrum tua propitius ubique miseratione conserva atque ab omnibus quas meretur adversitatibus redde securum ut tranquillitate percepta ab omnium visibilium et invisibilium inimicorum insidiis liberatus devota tibi mente deserviat.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech you, Lord, the offering brought to you, and with the intercession of the Blessed Mother of God, Mary, together with all your saints, may your propitious mercy everywhere preserve our servant, that pontiff, and grant him security from all adversities he deserves. May he be freed from the plots of enemies visible and invisible, and serving you with a devoted mind, may he perceive tranquility.

text: Suscipe Domine oblationis nostrae munus et sancti Taurini precibus esto nobis propitius pro cuius commemoratione illud tibi offerimus.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our offering of the sacred oblation and be propitious to us on behalf of Saint Taurinus' prayers for whose commemoration we offer this to you.

text: Suscipe Domine preces Ecclesiae tuae cum oblationibus hostiarum et in protectione fidelium populorum antiqua brachii tui operare miracula ut superatis pacis inimicis secura tibi serviat christiana libertas.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers of your Church with the offerings of sacrifices, and working with your ancient arm, perform miracles for the protection of faithful people. May the Christian liberty peacefully serve you, overcoming its enemies.

text: Suscipe Domine preces Ecclesiae tuae redemptionis suae gratia exsultantis ut praesentium munerum fide et tuae resurrectionis credulitate pascatur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers of your church rejoicing in its redemption, that it may be fed with faith in the gifts present and with belief in your resurrection.

text: Suscipe Domine preces et hostias Ecclesiae tuae pro salute famuli tui illius supplicantis et (in) protectione fidelium populorum antiqua brachii tui operare miracula ut superatis pacis inimicis secura tibi serviat christiana libertas.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers and offerings of Your Church for the health of Your servant who supplicates [him], and may You work ancient miracles through the power of Your arm, that Christian freedom may serve You securely, having overcome its enemies in peace.

text: Suscipe Domine preces et hostias Ecclesiae tuae pro famulo tuo illo suorumque fidelium supplicantis et antiqua brachii tui clementer operare miracula quatenus prostratis pacis inimicis secura tibi serviat christianorum libertas.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the prayers and offerings of your Church for your servant and his faithful followers who are humbly entreating you. May your ancient arm act mercifully to perform miracles, so that the enemies of peace lie prostrate before you and the freedom of Christians may safely serve you.

text: Suscipe Domine preces et hostias Ecclesiae tuae pro salute famuli tui regis nostri illius et reginae nostrae illius et protectione fidelium populorum supplicantis ut antiqua brachii tui te operante miracula superatis inimicis secura tibi serviat christianorum libertas.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers and offerings of Your Church for the salvation of our king and queen there, and protect the faithful people who humbly plead. May ancient miracles worked by Your arm overpower their enemies, so that the freedom of Christians may serve You safely.

text: Suscipe Domine preces et hostias meritis beatae Fidis virginis et martyris tibi dicatas et concede iit eius nobis sint supplicatione salutares cuius sunt veneratione sollemnes.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers and offerings which are dedicated to you on behalf of the merits of the blessed Virgin and martyr Fides. Grant that they may be beneficial for us, whose veneration is solemn.

text: Suscipe Domine preces et hostias pro omni sanctae Ecclesiae tuae gradu eosque sanctorum tuorum precibus in cunctis protege bonis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers and offerings for all the graduates of your holy Church, and protect them with the prayers of your saints in all things that are good.

text: Suscipe Domine preces et munera quae ut tuo sint digna conspectu(i) sanctorum tuorum precibus adiuventur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers and offerings, which are assisted by your saints' prayers, that they may be worthy of your holy sight.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras cum hostiis oblatis et intercessione beati Proiecti a nostris emunda delictis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers together with the offerings presented and through the intercession of blessed Projectus cleanse us from our sins.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras cum muneribus hostiarum quas pro famula tua illa clementiae tuae supplici mente deferimus ut qui(a) affectum filiorum maxime in matrum visceribus indidisti maerorem infecunditatis ab ea submoveas et ad concipiendam subolem misericorditer benedicas.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers with the offerings of sacrifices which we humbly bring before your clemency. Grant that you who have placed affection for children most especially within the hearts of mothers, may move away their sorrow of infertility and, in a merciful way, bless them to conceive offspring.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras pro anima famuli tui illius ut si quae ei maculae de terrenis contagiis adhaeserunt remissionis tuae misericordia deleantur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers for the soul of your servant that whatever earthly stains or contagions have stuck to him may be wiped away by Your merciful forgiveness.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras quas pro depositione famulorum tuorum illorum et famularum tuarum illarum deferimus orantes ut sacrificii praesentis oblatio ad refrigerium animabus eorum te miserante proveniat.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers which we offer for the departure of your servants among them and your servants among them, that the offering of this present sacrifice may come to refreshment for their souls through your mercy.

text: Suscipe Domine preces populi supplicantis et nostri vota ieiunii salutaris tui perfice sacramentum.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the prayers of the supplicating people and complete the vows of our fasting with your saving sacrament.

text: Suscipe Domine preces populi tui cum oblationibus hostiarum ut paschalibus initiata mysteriis ad aeternitatis nobis medelam te operante proficiant.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers of your people with the offerings of sacrifices, so that as we begin the Paschal mysteries, we may be healed by you acting for us, and progress towards eternity.

text: Suscipe Domine pro anima famuli tui illius hostiam quam tu Deo patri benigne obtulisti pro nobis et quia causa hominum descendisti de caelis te redeunte sanctorum tuorum mereatur adiungi consortiis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, on behalf of the soul of your servant, the offering which you graciously offered to God the Father for us. And because for the sake of mankind you descended from heaven, may you be worthy to join the choirs of the saints upon your return.

text: Suscipe Domine propitiatus hostias quibus et te placari voluisti et nobis salutem potenti pietate restitui.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, gracious offerings, for which you desired to be appeased and us restored to salvation by your powerful mercy.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius hostias famuli tui illius indulgentiam pro peccatis suis postulantis quibus et te placari voluisti et illi salutem animae petenti potenti pietate restitui.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, graciously the offerings of your servant, seeking his indulgence for his sins; for whom you have desired to be pleased and for whom restoration of salvation is being asked with powerful mercy.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius Ecclesiae tuae munera et sanctorum precibus nos tuere qui tuae iustitiae sunt placentes.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, graciously the offerings of your Church and protect us by the prayers of the saints who are pleasing to your justice.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius munera famulorum tuorum ut confessione tui nominis et baptismate renovati sempiternam beatitudinem consequantur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, graciously the offerings of your servants, so that with the confession of your name and being renewed by baptism, they may attain eternal beatitude.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine et plebis tuae et tuorum hostias renatorum ut et confessione tui nominis et baptismate renovati sempiternam beatitudinem consequantur.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech Thee, Lord, and Thy people and their offerings of the newborn, so that they may also follow Thy confession of name and be renewed by baptism, and may obtain eternal beatitude.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera populorum tuorum propitius ut confessione tui nominis et baptismate renovati sempiternam beatitudinem consequantur.
translation_en: Receive graciously, we ask you Lord, the offerings of your people. May you be favorable, so that through confession of your name and the renewal of baptism they may obtain eternal blessedness.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo et universis in corpore seu extra corpus manentibus qui illi carnis et spiritus familiaritate et confessione propter nomen tuum commendati sunt quorum numerum et nomina scis qui omnia nosti et concede ut et his dormientibus in Christo prosit ad veniam et vivis proficiat ad medelam.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, graciously the offering that we present to You for Your servant and all who remain in body or out of body, commended to him by the familiarity and confession of flesh and spirit for Your name. You know their number and names, all things are known to You. Grant that it may also profit those sleeping in Christ with forgiveness and those living may advance towards healing.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius oblationes nostras et tuorum deprecatione sanctorum pietati tuae perfice benignus acceptas.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, graciously our offerings, and complete them kindly through your pity, as you accept them with the prayers of the saints.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius orationem nostram cum oblationibus hostiarum superimpositis et martyris tui Praeiecti deprecatione pietati tuae perfice benignus acceptas et illam quae in eo flagravit fortem dilectionem in nobis adspira benignus.
translation_en: Receive graciously, Lord, our prayer along with the offerings of sacrifices and through the intercession of your martyr Prejectus. Grant us a kind reception and may the ardent love that burned within him inspire in us a strong love benignly.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius orationem nostram cum oblationibus hostiarum superimpositis et martyris tui Symphoriani deprecatione pietati tuae perfice benignus acceptas et illum qui in eo flagravit fervorem in nobis adspira benignus ut in tua semper dilectione permanentes et in fide inveniamur stabiles et in moribus concordes et in opere efficaces.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, our prayer favorably with the offerings of sacrifices laid upon them and through the intercession of your martyr Symphorian, may you, gracious One, complete what you accept benignly; and may he who burned with fervor in him inspire us benignly, so that always remaining in your love we may be found steadfast in faith, in harmony in our behavior, and effective in deeds.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius orationem nostram pro famulo tuo illo qui in longa terrarum spatia detinetur pro quo maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut dirigas ei angelum pietatis tuae qui eum ad domicilium suum salvum et incolumem repraesentet.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, graciously our prayer for your servant who is held at a distance in the far reaches of the earth. On his behalf we humbly pour out our prayers to your majesty, that you send him an angel of your pity who will represent him safely and unharmed to his home.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius preces nostras et tuorum deprecatione iustorum Ioannis et Pauli pietati tuae perfice benignus acceptas et quos sanguinis propinquitas coniunxit et fides patrocinium nobis deferant solaminis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, graciously our prayers and through the intercession of your faithful servants John and Paul, may your kindness complete those whom the bond of kinship in blood unites and who through faith bring us their patronage.

text: Suscipe Domine propitius pro salute famuli tui illius munus tibi acceptum et quem fecisti tibi devotum fac beatum esse per huius sancti muneris consecrationem.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, graciously on behalf of the salvation of your servant, that offering which he has presented to you. And may the one whom you have made devoted be made blessed through the consecration of this holy ministry.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus devotorum munera famulorum et tuis divinis purifica servientes pietate mysteriis quibus etiam iustificas ignorantes.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we entreat you, the offerings of your devoted servants, and purify your servants through your divine mysteries, by which even the ignorant are justified.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus hostias laetantis ecclesiae quas 1pro sanctae martyris Euphemiae natalicia passione maiestati tuae prompta devovit.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we entreat you, the offerings of the rejoicing church which, on the birthday and passion of Saint Martyr Euphemia, were devoted to your majesty with prompt devotion.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus hostias mentium tuo nomini devotarum quibus nos et a terrenis contagiis expiari et caelestibus contulisti propinquare consortiis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we entreat you, the offerings of minds devoted to your name, by which we may be cleansed from earthly contagions and brought closer to celestial companionships.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine hostias famuli et levitae tui illius quibus mentium nos tuo nomini devotarum et a terrenis contagiis expiari et caelestibus contulisti propinquare consortiis.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offerings of your servant and levite, whom we have devoted to your name, and cleanse us from terrestrial contagions, and bring us near to celestial fellowships.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus hostias placationis et laudis quas tibi offerimus pro nativitate beatae et gloriosae semperque virginis Dei Genitricis Mariae ut sanctis eius intercessionibus cunctis nobis proficiant ad salutem.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech You, the offerings of propitiation and praise that we present to You on the occasion of the birth of the blessed, glorious, ever-virgin Mother of God, the Holy Virgin Mary. May her holy intercessions benefit all of us for our salvation.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus hostias pro anima famuli tui illius episcopi ut cui pontificale donasti meritum dones et praemium.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech you, the offerings for the soul of your servant, that bishop, whom you granted the privilege of the pontificate. May you grant him the merits and reward.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine pro anima famuli et sacerdotis tui illius quas offerimus hostias ut cui pontificale donasti meritum dones et praemium.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, for the soul of your servant and priest who we are offering, that you grant them the reward and payment which you bestowed with the pontifical gifts.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine pro anima famuli et sacerdotis tui illius quas tibi offerimus hostias ut cui donasti in hoc saeculo sacerdotale meritum in caelesti regno sanctorum tuorum iubeas iungi consortio.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, for the soul of Your servant and priest who we offer to You as sacrifices. May You grant him the priestly merit you gave in this world, and in the kingdom of Your saints, unite his soul with their fellowship.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine hostias quas tibi pro anima famuli tui abbatis humiliter immolamus obsecrantes misericordiam tuam ut cui sacerdotale officium contulisti dones et praemium.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech Thee, Lord, the offerings which Thou hast lowly offered on behalf of Thy servant abbot, entreating Thy mercy. Grant that Thou mayest bestow upon him the office which thou didst entrust to him and the reward.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus hostias quas maiestati tuae in honorem beati apostoli Petri cui haec est basilica sacrata deferimus et eius precibus nos tuere.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we ask you, the offerings that we bring to your majesty, for the honor of blessed apostle Peter whose basilica is consecrated here. May his prayers protect us.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus hostias quas tibi pro salute tuae plebis offerimus et sacramentis caelestibus servientes ab omni culpa liberos esse concede.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we implore you, the offerings which we present to you for the salvation of your people. Grant that serving heavenly sacraments, may we be free from all guilt.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus munera famuli tui illius et propitius in eodem tua dona custodi.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech you, the offerings of your servant, and may you be gracious to him, as you guard your gifts in the same place.

text: Suscipe Domine munera quae tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo et propitius in eodem tua dona custodi.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings that we present to you on behalf of your servant. Be gracious and protect your gifts towards him.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus munera populi tui pro martyrum festivitate sanctorum et sincero nos corde fac eorum nataliciis interesse.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we ask, the offerings of your people on account of the feast of the martyrs, and stir within us a sincere heart to take interest in their nativity celebrations.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus oblationes et preces quas et pro reverentia paschali supplices adhibemus et pro sollemnitate recolenda primordii sacerdotalis offerimus ut eorum nobis intercessione sint prospera quos nobis huius muneris et doctores constituis et patronos.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we entreat you, the offerings and prayers that we humbly present for respectful Paschal veneration, and for the solemn commemoration of the beginning of our priesthood, so that through their intercession may there be prosperity for those whom you have appointed as ministers and teachers for us, and as patrons.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus preces et hostias famulorum tuorum et muro custodiae tuae hanc domum circumda ut omni adversitate depulsa sit hoc semper domicilium incolumitatis et pacis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech you, our prayers and offerings and enclose this house of your servants with the shield of your protection, so that it may be always a dwelling place of safety and peace, driven away from every adversity.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras et muro custodiae hoc sanctum ovile circumda ut omni adversitate depulsa sit hoc semper domicilium incolumitatis et pacis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers and surround this holy fold with the wall of protection, so that it may be always a dwelling of safety and peace, free from every adversity.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus preces et munera quae in honorem sanctarum virginum et martyrum tuarum Fidei Spei et Caritatis atque genitricis earum Sapientiae tibi humiliter deferimus omnipotens Pater et praesta ut ipsis intercedentibus scuto fidei spei et caritatis divinitus protecti temptationes adversantium evadere valeamus cunctorum et ad beatorum spirituum mereamur pervenire consortium.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we humbly entreat you, the prayers and offerings that we bring in honor of your holy virgins and martyrs Faith, Hope, Charity, and their mother Wisdom. Almighty Father, grant us that through their intercession, protected by the shield of faith, hope, and charity, we may be able to overcome the trials opposing us and merit to join the company of the blessed spirits.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus preces nostras et huius oblationis obsequium quod iri sanctae martyris tuae commemoratione offerimus ad placationem tui nominis copiosa nobis fac provenire clementia ut ad gaudium nobis transeat sempiternum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech you, our prayers and the offering of this obedience which we bring before your holy martyr in commemoration. May it be abundantly granted to us by your clemency that it may pass to us everlasting joy.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus preces nostras ut huius oblationis obsequium quod in sanctorum martyrum et confessorum commemoratione deferimus ad gaudium nobis proficiat sempiternum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we beseech You, our prayers that the service of this offering which we bring forward on the commemoration of the holy martyrs and confessors may profit us for everlasting joy.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus preces nostras pro anima famuli tui illius episcopi ut in pontificum tibimet placitorum perpetua sede laetetur.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we pray, our prayers for the soul of your servant that bishop, that he may rejoice in Your seat of pleasing popes for eternity.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus pro sacra lege coniugii munus oblatum et cuius creator es operis esto dispositor.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, as we ask, the gift offered according to the sacred law of matrimony, and may You be both the Creator and Disposer of it.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine pro sacra connubii lege munus oblatum et cuius largitor es operis esto dispositor.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, on behalf of the sacred law of marriage, the offering presented and may You be both the giver and the dispenser of this grace.

text: Suscipe Domine quaesumus sacrificium quod tibi in honorem beati Pierani confessoris tui atque pontificis suppliciter offerimus et praesta propitius ut quod illi sanctitatis auxit meritum ipso pro nobis intercedente veniam conferat delictorum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, we humbly ask, the sacrifice that we offer to you in honor of your blessed confessor and bishop, Pierius, and may it be gracious for you to grant, that what he merited through his sanctity, may, with him interceding on our behalf, confer forgiveness for our sins.

text: Suscipe Domine sacrificia ad honorem tui nominis oblata et per intercessionem sancti confessoris tui atque pontificis Aldelmi nos a peccatis omnibus emunda et perduc feliciter ad gaudia sempiterna.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings brought to honor your name, and through the intercession of your saintly confessor and bishop Aldhelm, cleanse us from all sins and lead us happily to eternal joys.

text: Suscipe Domine sacrificium cuius te voluisti dignanter immolatione placari et praesta quaesumus ut huius operatione mundati beneplacitum tibi nostrae mentis offeramus affectum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, this sacrifice, which You willed to be offered to You in a worthy immolation for appeasement. And we humbly ask that through this process, we may present to You the affection of our purified minds, pleasing to You.

text: Suscipe Domine sacrificium placationis et laudis quod nos intervenientibus sanctis et perducat ad veniam et in perpetua(m) gratiarum constituat actione(m).
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offering of propitiation and praise, which we present with the saints, and may it lead us to forgiveness and establish us in a state of eternal gratitude.

text: Suscipe Domine sacrificium placationis et laudis quod nos interveniente sancta tua Caecilia cuius festivitatem praevenimus et perducat ad veniam et in perpetua(m) gratiarum constituat actione(m).
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offering of reconciliation and praise that we bring on this holy day of Caecilia, whose feast we have anticipated. May it lead to forgiveness and establish a perpetual debt of gratitude in our actions.

text: Suscipe Domine sacrificium placationis et laudis quod nos interveniente sancto tuo Cyriaco et perducat ad veniam et in perpetua(m) gratiarum constituat actione(m).
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the sacrifice of propitiation and praise that we offer, through your saint Cyril. May he lead us to forgiveness and establish us in a state of perpetual thanksgiving.

text: Suscipe Domine sacrificium quod tibi pro animabus patris et matris meae offertur eisque gaudium sempiternum in regione vivorum concede meque felicitati sanctorum coniunge.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the sacrifice that is offered on behalf of the souls of my father and mother, grant them eternal joy in the land of the living. Grant me also the happiness of the saints.

text: Suscipe Domine spiritus nostri contritionem et praesta ut quod offerimus ita a te habeatur acceptum ut ieiunantium corda non vanitas sed virtus possideat non gula sed parcitas regat nec libido sed puritas attollat quo nobis te fideliter implorantibus et universitati catholicae ecclesiae concedatur indulgentiae donum et in pace dominica quiescentibus donetur consortium electorum.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the contrition of our spirits and grant that what we offer is taken as accepted, so that the hearts of those who fast are filled not with vanity but virtue, not with gluttony but mercy, not with lust but purity. May we who faithfully implore You be granted the gift of indulgence, and may eternal consortium be given to the chosen in peaceful repose.

text: Suscipe Domine supplicantis famuli tui illius votivum tibi munus oblatum et multiplici ob hoc eum locupleta fenore gratiarum ut qui te his honorat spontaneis votis te largiente ditetur praemiis infinitis.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the supplicant servant's vow offered to you as a gift, and multiply him by an abundant wealth of thanksgivings, so that he who honors you with spontaneous vows may be enriched by infinite rewards.

text: Suscipe Domine supplicantis servi tui illius votivum tibi munus oblatum et multiplici <ob hoc eum locupleta> fenore gratiarum ut quae te fidelissimis votis petit tu ei piissime miseranter indulge.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the supplications of your humble servant, and accept the vow offered to you as a gift. May it be multiplied with an abundant shower of blessings, so that what he asks of you with most faithful vows, you may mercifully grant him.

text: Suscipe Domine tuorum fidelium preces cum oblationibus hostiarum sancti confessoris tui David memoriam repetentium et per huius mysterii pignora tua pietate sanctifica ut ad caelestem te opitulante adscendamus gloriam.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the prayers of your faithful servants along with the offerings of holy sacrifices in memory of your confessor David, and through the pledges of this mystery, sanctify us by your mercy so that we, calling upon you, may ascend to the glory of heaven.

text: Suscipe Domine vota labiorum eorum et sana interiora vulnerum eorum secundum magnam misericordiam tuam et interveniente beatae Dei Genitricis Mariae merito sanctique Petri principis apostolorum necnon et tuorum Benedicti Martini Swithuni confessorum omniumque sanctorum suffragio mihi et famulis tuis sacerdotibus praesta remissionem peccatorum et electis tuis nos coniunge in regno caelorum.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the prayers of their lips and heal the wounds within them according to Your great mercy. With the intercession of the Blessed Mother of God, Mary, and Saint Peter, the Chief of Apostles, as well as Sts. Benedict, Martin, Swithun, and all saints, grant us and Your priests forgiveness of sins and unite us with the chosen in the kingdom of heaven.

text: Suscipe Domine vota populi tui et apostolico patrocinio confidentem huius quam tibi offerimus hostiae participatione conserva.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the vows of your people and with apostolic protection, confidently preserving this offering which we present to you in participation as a sacrifice.

text: Suscipe et sanctifica Adonai Deus hoc munus oblatum et concede ut ad salutem nostram caro et sanguis fiat Filii tui meritis illius quae illum gratanter hospitio suscepit.
translation_en: Receive and sanctify, Lord God, this offering that is given to You, and grant that through the merits of Your Son our flesh and blood may become for our salvation, who graciously received Him as a guest.

text: Suscipe hanc oblationem in hac hora mitissime Deus quam tibi super sanctam tuam mensam appositam offerre praesumimus per quam et nobis omnibus in tua misericordia confidentibus et persequentibus hostis insidias superare et aeternis gaudiis inevitabiliter tribuas inhaerere.
translation_en: Receive this offering at this hour, most graciously God, whom we presume to place before you on your holy table. Through it, and for all of us who are confident in your mercy and pursue righteousness, may we overcome the cunning snares of our enemies, and may we inevitably be united with eternal joys.

text: Suscipe hanc oblationem piissime Deus et praesta per intercessionem sanctissimi confessoris tui atque sacerdotis Hieronymi magnis facinoribus nostris immensam misericordiam tuam nosque per contritionem cordis humiliati mactando vitia iugulando delicta dignum tibi acceptabileque praepara holocaustum.
translation_en: Accept, most compassionate God, this offering and grant us through the intercession of your most holy confessor and priest Jerome, immense mercy for our great sins. May we, humbled by contrition of heart, offer worthy and acceptable sacrifice to you, and prepare a holocaust.

text: Suscipe Iesu bone in hoc natale Iacobi apostoli tui offerentium votum et refrigerium praesta spiritibus defunctorum ut eo apud te intercedente et viventibus et defunctis tuae pietatis gratia impendatur cuius doctrina duodecim tribuum commonitione edocetur.
translation_en: Receive, Jesus good, in this natal day of Your apostle James, the offering and vow. Grant refreshment to the spirits of the dead, so that through his intercession, Your grace may be bestowed upon both the living and the deceased. Whose teaching, as recorded in the twelve tribes, instructs by means of a gathering.

text: Suscipe misericors Domine supplicum preces et secundum multitudinem indulgentiarum tuarum ab omnibus nos absolve peccatis ut ad omnia pietatis opera te parcente reparemur et quos venia feceris innocentes auxilio facias efficaces.
translation_en: Receive, O merciful Lord, the supplications of your humble servants and according to the multitude of your mercies absolve us from all sins that we may be restored by your gracious presence to all works of piety. May you make those whom you have made innocent effective with your help.

text: Suscipe munera Domine quae in eius tibi sollemnitate deferimus cuius nos scimus patrocinio liberari.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the offerings that we bring to you on this solemnity, knowing that we are set free under your patronage.

text: Suscipe munera quaesumus Domine exsultantis ecclesiae et cui causam tanti gaudii praestitisti perpetuum fructum concede laetitiae.
translation_en: Receive the offerings, we ask you, Lord, from the rejoicing church; to whom you have given a reason for such great joy, grant an eternal fruit of joy.

text: Suscipe munera quaesumus Domine quae tibi de tua largitate deferimus ut haec sacrosancta mysteria gratiae tuae operante virtute praesentis vitae nos conversatione sanctificent et ad gaudia sempiterna perducant.
translation_en: Receive the offerings we humbly ask, Lord, which we bring to you from your bounty, that these most holy mysteries may be sanctified by the working of your grace and may through them make us holy in this life and lead us to eternal joys.

text: Suscipe omnipotens Deus hanc hostiam oblationis quam facinora mundi iniuriam crucis et sepulturae pro nobis clementer sustinuit.
translation_en: Accept, Almighty God, this offering which the offenses of the world sustained with mildness on the cross and burial for our sake.

text: Suscipe omnipotens Deus sacrificii huius sacra sollemnia et imposita haec altaribus tuis munera benedicere nobis et sanctificare dignare.
translation_en: Receive, Almighty God, this offering of sacrifice with holy solemnity and deign to bless and sanctify the gifts laid upon your altars for us.

text: Suscipe piissime Deus in sinu patriarchae Abrahae animam famuli tui illius eamque sanctis et electis omnibus adiunge nec ei noceat culpa carnis ad poenam sed prosit illi miseratio tuae pietatis ad veniam.
translation_en: Most gracious God, receive in the bosom of patriarch Abraham the soul of your servant, and join it with the saints and the elect. May not sinful flesh harm him for punishment but may your mercy, moved by your compassion, grant him forgiveness.

text: Suscipe preces populi tui clementissime Pater et directas in conspectu tuo oblationes quasi odorem incensi flagrantis assume.
translation_en: Receive graciously, most merciful Father, the prayers of your people and present their directed offerings before you as a fragrant incense.

text: Exaudi supplicationes familiae tuae omnipotens Deus et directas in conspectu tuo confitentium preces quasi odorem incensi bene flagrantis assume.
translation_en: Hear, almighty God, the supplications of your family and accept as if it were a fragrant incense, the prayers of those who confess you directly before you.

text: Suscipe preces populi tui quaesumus Domine quibus in beatae Mariae iterata sollemnitate tuam clementiam deprecatur quia ad tua praeconia recurrit et laudem quod vel talis orta est vel talis assumpta.
translation_en: Receive the prayers of your people, we ask you, Lord, during the repeated solemnity of the blessed Mary. We humbly entreat your clemency because she returns to your praises and sings the praise that she was born in such a way or was taken up in such a way.

text: Suscipe quaeso summe Deus Pater omnipotens munus oblatum quod tibi in honorem almae Dei Genitricis Mariae pro innumeris ac multiplicibus meis offero delictis et ut eodem sacro munere allever quem gravis inculcat sarcina pronum peccatorum pie conditor meus atque redemptor clementer exaudi.
