translation_en: I humbly ask, most high God, Father almighty, to receive the offering made to you in honor of the blessed Mother of God, Mary, for my countless and manifold sins. And that the same sacred offering may help me, whom a heavy burden of sins weighs down, merciful Creator and Redeemer, graciously listen.

text: Suscipe quaesumus clementer omnipotens Deus nostrae oblationem devotionis et per virtutem huius sacramenti tuae maiestatis famulos a cunctis protege adversitatibus.
translation_en: Receive graciously, we beg you, O almighty God, our offering of devotion. Through the power of this sacred mystery, shield your servants from all adversities.

text: Suscipe quaesumus clementissime Deus hostias placationis et laudis ad honorem nominis tui dicandas pro animabus non habentibus apud te singulares intercessores nec consolationem in tormentis nec spem ullam nisi quod eas tibi configurasti et praesta per haec oblationis mysteria ut animae quas ad gloriam nominis tui nobiliter plasmasti ab omnibus poenis intolerabilibus et cruciatibus absolutae lucis perpetuae te miserante percipiant beatitudinem.
translation_en: Receive, we entreat you most mercifully, God, the offerings of appeasement and praise for the honor of your name, to be recited on behalf of souls that have no particular intercessors among you nor consolation in torments nor any hope whatsoever except that you have shaped them and grant through these mysteries of the offering that the souls which you have nobly fashioned may be released from all intolerable punishments and tortures, may perceive eternal light, having mercy upon them.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine clementissime Deus preces et hostias quas in sanctorum Georgii Blasii Erasmi Pantaleonis Viti Christophori Dionysii Cyriaci Achaea Eustachii Aegidii Catherinae Margarethae et Barbarae honorem deferimus ut qui nostrae iustitiae fiduciam non habemus eorum qui tibi singulariter placuerunt intercedentibus meritis et precibus petitionum nostrarum te pium largitorem sentiamus.
translation_en: Receive graciously, we ask You, O Lord, the prayers and offerings that we bring to St. George, Blaise, Erasmus, Pantaleon, Vitus, Christopher, Dionysius, Cyriacus, Achaea, Eustachius, Giles, Catherine, Margaret, and Barbara. May those who have not placed their trust in our justice intercede for us through their merits and prayers, so that we may feel You, O benevolent giver, to be moved by our requests.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine desideria supplicantium fidelium cum oblationibus hostiarum ut interveniente beata Scholastica virgine tua quae te sincero dilexit amore nec fides in nobis torpeat nec caritas tepescat.
translation_en: Receive we beseech Thee, O Lord, the desires of supplicating faithful people together with their offerings of sacrifices, so that intervening with Thy blessed Scholastica, the virgin, who loved Thee sincerely, neither faith in us should grow cold nor charity should cool.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine et sanctifica hoc sacrificium populi tui ut quod in honorem beatissimorum martyrum tuorum Macchabaeorum sed et sacerdotis et confessoris tui Eusebii offertur ad gloriam nobis tribuas ad salutem perpetuam.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, and sanctify this sacrifice of your people, so that what is offered in honor of your most blessed martyrs, the Macchabees, as well as your priest and confessor Eusebius, may be granted to us for glory and bestow upon us eternal salvation.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine haec munera de tua tibi largitate dicata ut intercedente pro nobis beato Martino confessore tuo atque pontifice fidelium mentes exerceant quatenus temporalibus adiuti praesidiis ad promerenda praemia conferantur aeterna.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, these gifts offered to you from your bounty, so that through the intercession of your confessed martyr Saint Martin and faithful Pope, the minds of the faithful may be strengthened. Thus, assisted by temporal protections, they may merit eternal rewards.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine haec salutaria libamina quae tibi sancti confessoris tui Melliti intercessio efficiat placabilia.
translation_en: Receive we ask, Lord, these salutary offerings which, through the intercession of your holy confessor Melitus, may become pleasing to you.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine hostiam placationis et laudis et has oblationes famulorum famularumque tuarum quas tibi offerimus hodie in resurrectione Domini nostri Iesu Christi secundum carnem placatus assume; tribue etiam per intercessionem sanctorum tuorum caris nostris qui in Christo dormierunt refrigerium in regione vivorum.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, this offering of propitiation and praise, and these gifts of your servants and handmaidens which we offer you today at the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ according to the flesh. May you also grant through the intercession of your dear saints who have fallen asleep in Christ, refreshment in the region of the living.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine hostiam quam tibi pro animabus famulorum tuorum offerimus ut eas mortalitatis vinculis absolutas inter sanctos tuos habere perpetuam concedas portionem.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, the offering which for the souls of Your servants we present to You. May they be freed from the bonds of death and grant them a place among Your saints in eternal life.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine hostias placationis et laudis quas tibi in honorem sancti martyris tui illius nomini tuo consecrandas deferimus et pro requie famuli tui illius sacerdotis tibi suppliciter immolamus.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech You, Lord, the offerings of propitiation and praise that we dedicate to You in honor of Your holy martyr, and humbly offer them for the repose of his servant, the priest, before You.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine hostiam redemptionis humanae et salutem nobis mentis et corporis operare placatus.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offering of human redemption and work in us a saving grace for both mind and body.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine Iesu omnipotens Deus sacrificium laudis oblatum quod pro tua hodierna incarnatione a nobis offertur et per eum sic propitiatus adesto ut superstitibus vitam defunctis requiem tribuas sempiternam; Nomina quorum sunt recitatione complexa scribi iubeas in aeternitate pro quibus apparuisti in carne.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord Jesus, Almighty God, the sacrifice of praise that is offered by us today for your incarnation, and through him may you be appeased to be present and grant eternal rest to the departed faithful. Command that the names of those who are mentioned with reverence be written in eternity on their behalf, for whom you appeared in flesh.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine misericors pater oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius quam hodie de carnali corruptione liberasti et concede ut ab omnibus humanae condicionis excessibus his remediis expietur et in requie sempiterna diem resurrectionis praestoletur.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech You, O merciful Lord and loving Father, the offering that we present to You on behalf of the soul of Your servant, whom You freed today from earthly corruption. And grant that he may be purified by all the excesses of human condition with these means, and may be granted a place in eternal rest on the day of resurrection.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera dignanter oblata et beati Marcelli suffragantibus meritis ad nostrae salutis auxilium provenire concede.
translation_en: Receive graciously, we ask you, Lord, the offerings given worthy and through the merits of Blessed Marcel, may they come to our aid for salvation's help.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera plebis tuae quae pro beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli nataliciis obtulerunt et eorum tibi placita meritis propitius esse concede.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offerings of your people which they presented on the feast days of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul, and grant that you be pleased with them through their merits.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera pro sanctorum tuorum commemoratione exsultanter oblata et quod illos fecit passione gloriosos nos devotione reddat innocuos.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offerings made for the commemoration of your saints with joyful acceptance, and may what they became glorious through their painful passion make us innocent through our devotion.

text: Suscipe Domine munera pro tuorum commemoratione sanctorum ut quod illos passio gloriosos nos devotio reddat innocuos.
translation_en: Receive, O Lord, the offerings on behalf of the remembrance of Your saints, that what their glorious passion made them, our devotion may make us innocent.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera supplicantis familiae quae tibi in festivitate praesulis almi Dunstani deferimus ut eius patrocinio venerando adiuti defendi mereamur ab omnium inimicorum insidiis.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offerings of the supplicating family that we bring to you on the festival of the holy bishop Dunstan. May we be aided and defended under his venerable patronage so that we may deserve to be protected from the plots of all our enemies.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munera quae de tuis offerimus collata beneficiis ut quod nostrae devotioni concedis effici temporali tuae nobis fiat praemium redemptionis aeternae.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, the gifts which we offer You, bestowed by Your blessings. May what You grant us for our devotion become for us a reward in this world, and be to us a prize of eternal redemption.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munus oblatum et dignanter operare ut quod passionis mysterio gerimus piis effectibus consequamur.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offering presented and work worthily so that we may attain worthy effects through what we carry out in the mystery of the Passion.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine munus oblatum et dignanter operare ut quod mysteriis agimus piis effectibus celebremus.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offering presented and work worthily so that what we perform in the mysteries may be celebrated with sacred effects.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine nostris oblata servitiis et tua potius dona sanctifica.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, our offerings of service, and may your gifts be made holy by you.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine ob honorem sacrae virginis tuae Scholasticae munus oblatum et quod nostris assequi meritis non valemus eiusdem suffragantibus meritis largire propitius.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, on behalf of the honor of your holy virgin Scholastica, the offering presented and what we are not worthy to obtain through our own merits, mercifully grant with her intercession.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine oblationes familiae tuae ut sub tuae protectionis auxilio et collata non perdant et ad aeterna dona perveniant.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, the offerings of Your family, that under Your protective help and conferred grace they may not be lost but may reach eternal gifts.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine populi tui votiva munera ut qui pondere nostrarum iniquitatum premimur beati Gregorii martyris tui precibus erigamur.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the offerings vowed by your people, that we who are crushed under the weight of our own iniquities may be raised up by the prayers of blessed Gregory the Martyr.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine preces nostras cum oblationibus supplicantium et concede propitius ut quidquid hic novum regenerandi per Spiritum Sanctum acceperint tua gratia fiat aeternum.
translation_en: Receive, we beg Thee, Lord, our prayers together with the offerings of those supplicating and grant graciously that whatever they here receive anew through the Holy Spirit for regeneration may become everlasting by Thy grace.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine preces nostras et ad aures misericordiae tuae postulationes sacratae tibi plebis admitte.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you Lord, our prayers and present them to the ears of your mercy. Admit the sacred petitions of your people before you.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine preces nostras et clamantium ad te pia vota propitius intuere.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, our prayers and pious vows made to you. Kindly look upon those who are calling to you.

text: Suscipe Domine preces nostras et clamantium ad te pia corda propitius intende.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, our prayers and grant them favorable consideration, as you listen to those who humbly call out to you with a sincere heart.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine preces nostras et intercessione martyris tui baptistae Ioannis quem in tuum honorem veneramur Ecclesiae tuae vota confirma qui etiam dignus est habitus ut ei te baptizandum mundi Salvator offeres; dignum est enim hoc mereri ut omnes nos baptismatis tui gratiam consecutos meritorum suorum intercessione concinet.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, our prayers and through the intercession of Your martyr Baptist John whom we honor in Your Church. Confirm, we pray, the vows of Your Church that He is worthy to receive, for he is worthy to be offered as one to be baptized by the Savior of the world; it is indeed fitting for him to merit that through his intercession all of us who have attained the grace of Your baptism are gathered together.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine preces populi tui cum oblationibus hostiarum et tua mysteria celebrantes ab omnibus defende periculis.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, the prayers of Your people with the offerings of sacrifices and while celebrating Your mysteries, protect them from all dangers.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine propitius munera quae in beati martyris tui illius commemoratione deferimus ut cuius honore sunt grata eius nobis fiant intercessione perpetua.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, favorably the offerings that we bring on the occasion of the commemoration of your blessed martyr, that through his honor they may be made gracious for us and become a perpetual intercession.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine propitius oblationes tuorum fidelium quas tibi in honorem sanctae Katherinae virginis tuae et martyris hodiernae sollemnitate laetanter offerimus sicque nobis ipsa intercedente per hoc sacrificium placatus adesto ut nos et a periculis huius vitae clementer eripias et a peccatis omnibus miseratus absolvas.
translation_en: Receive graciously, we beseech You, Lord, the offerings of Your faithful, which today with joy we present to You in honor of Saint Catherine, Your virgin and martyr. Through this sacrifice, may she intercede for us that, being present with You, You would mercifully free us from the dangers of this life and absolve us from all sins.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus munera quae pro Filii tui gloriosa transfiguratione deferimus et concede propitius ut per haec et a temporalibus liberemur incommodis et gaudiis connectamur aeternis.
translation_en: Receive, we ask You, Lord, holy Father almighty everlasting God, the gifts which we bring for Your glorious Son's Transfiguration, and graciously grant that through these, we may be freed from temporal troubles and joined to eternal joys.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine supplicis familiae tuae munus oblatum et quod rea sperare non audiet conscientia intercedente Wulstano tua nobis largiatur indulgentia.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech Thee, O Lord, the offering of Thy suppliant family and may the mercy that conscience with Wulstan intervening dares not hope for, be granted to us in the form of indulgence.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine tuorum oblationes precesque servorum ut sub tuae protectionis auxilio et collata non perdant et quae expetunt apprehendant.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, your offerings and prayers of your servants, that under the help of your protection they may not lose what has been given to them, and that they may obtain what they seek.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine tuorum munera famulorum quae intercedentibus sanctis tuis prosint nobis et ad piae devotionis officium et ad tuae sanctificationis effectum.
translation_en: Receive, we ask you, Lord, the gifts of your servants, which through the intercession of your saints may benefit us and lead to the duty of pious devotion and the effect of your sanctification.

text: Suscipe quaesumus omnipotens Deus mysticam humilitatis nostrae oblationem quam pro veneratione almiflui confessoris tui ac praesulis Romani tuae offerimus maiestati quatenus eius patrocinantibus meritis per haec ipsa sacrificia plebs tua a cunctis exuatur peccatis.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech you, Almighty God, our humble offering of mystery which we present for the veneration of your Confessor and Bishop, St. Peter, the Roman Pontiff, to your majesty. May his merits through these very sacrifices free your people from all sins.

text: Suscipe quaesumus spiritus sancte omnipotens Deus sacrificia te auctore instituente decreta quo illibatae virginis in utero quondam membra in qua verbum caro fieret quibus hoc rite sacrificium competeret immaculata formasti.  In cuius haec similitudinem corporis et sanguinis munera ingerimus et ut plenitudinem debitae sanctificationis te ditificante obtineant supplicamus quia tu vere ille ignis es qui patrum nostrorum acceptans sacrificia divinitus consumpsisti.  Quemadmodum Eliae quoque victimam aquis circumfluentibus natitantem cum lapidibus et lignis exurens etiam madefacti pulveris rivulos calore inconsummabili arefactos inaestimabiliter assumendo finisti simili nunc quaesumus has hostias dignatione suscipias divinitatis tuae igne salvifico omnium peccatorum nostrorum affectionem exurens atque ad percipiendam caelestis cibi potusque substantiam vivificans corda mortalium et in custodiam nostri deputans sanctorum multitudinem angelorum numquam nos eorum privari consortio patiaris.
translation_en:
Receive, we beseech you, O Holy Spirit, Almighty God, the sacrifices that you have instituted through your Author, in which the limbs of the immaculate Virgin, once contained within her womb, were formed, when the Word became flesh. In whose likeness we offer the gifts of body and blood. We humbly ask that those who are receiving the fullness of the required sanctification you bestow may obtain them. For you truly are that fire which accepted the sacrifices of our fathers divinely consuming them.
Just as Elijah also burned the victim immersed in flowing waters, kindled with stones and wood, even made hot with the powder of ashes, unquenchably absorbing, we now humbly ask that you receive these hosts by the saving fire of your divinity, consuming the affection for all our sins, and vivifying the hearts of mortals, and entrusting us to the holy multitude of angels, never allowing us to be separated from their company.

text: Suscipe sancta Trinitas hanc oblationem quam tibi offero pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum ut requiem aeternam dones eis inter tuos sanctos electos quatenus illorum consortio vita perfruantur aeterna.
translation_en: Accept, Holy Trinity, this offering which I present to you for the souls of your servants and their servants, that you grant them eternal rest among your chosen saints, so that they may enjoy eternal life in the company of the saints.

text: Suscipe quaesumus Domine hanc oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui ut requiem aeternam dones ei inter sanctos et electos tuos quatenus illorum consortio et vita perfruatur aeterna.
translation_en: Receive, we beseech Thee, O Lord, this offering that we present to Thee for the soul of Thy servant. Grant him eternal rest among the saints and elect ones Thine, so that he may enjoy their fellowship and everlasting life.

text: Suscipe sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus oblationem servorum tuorum quam tibi pro pace et concordia fratrum nostrorum offerimus humiliter deprecantes ut qui in una corporali congregatione sunt visi in summa communione spiritali sint aduniti.
translation_en: Receive, O holy Father almighty eternal God, the offering of your servants which we humbly present to you for peace and harmony among our brethren, that those who are seen together corporally may also be united in the highest spiritual communion.

text: Suscipe vota tuorum Domine famulorum et oblatum tibi pro commemoratione beatae Felicitatis pacifici libaminis sacrificium propitiatus intende.
translation_en: Receive, Lord, the vows of your servants and the offering made to you for the remembrance of Blessed Felicity. May this peaceful libamen sacrifice be accepted as propitious.

text: Suscipiamus Domine misericordiam tuam in medio templi tui et reparationis nostrae ventura sollemnia congruis honoribus praecedamus.
translation_en: Let us lift up, O Lord, your mercy in the midst of your temple and may our approaching festivals be preceded with fitting honors.

text: Suscipiat clementia tua Domine quaesumus de manibus nostris munus oblatum et per huius sancti tui illius (horum sanctorum tuorum illorum) orationes ab omnibus nos emundet peccatis.
translation_en: May your clemency, Lord, we ask, receive from our hands the offering made and through the prayers of this your saint (of these saints of yours) may he cleanse us from all sins.

text: Suscipiat pietas tua Domine Deus humilitatis meae preces et erue me de manibus inimicorum et de carnalibus corporis mei desideriis et de cogitationibus animae meae immundis et de omnibus huius saeculi vanitatibus eripe me quatenus te miserante aeternorum flammas tormentorum evadere valeam atque perpetuam beatitudinem dignus accipere merear.
translation_en: May Your mercy, Lord God, receive my humble prayers and deliver me from the hands of my enemies. Free me from the carnal desires of my body, the impure thoughts of my soul, and all the vanities of this world. Save me, so that, being spared by Your mercy from eternal flames of torment, I may deserve eternal beatitude.

text: Suscipientes Domine sacra mysteria suppliciter deprecamur ut quorum exsequimur cultum sentiamus effectum.
translation_en: Lord, receiving the holy mysteries, we humbly entreat you that as we perform their rite, we may feel its effect.

text: Suscipite gloriosissimi martyres sancti offerentium nomina sancto altario recitata et eorum devotionem auribus divinae pietatis ingerite atque pro eisdem affectu intensissimo Trinitatis omnipotentiam implorate ut nomina suorum coram altario recensita viventium inserat libro septem signaculis praesignato eorumque oblationem placida serenitate respiciens ratam acceptamque suscipiat pausantium animas requies perpetua teneat offerentes ex fructibus praesenti largitate multiplicet et in futuro aeterna nos remuneratione perlustret.
translation_en: Receive, O most glorious martyrs, the names of those offering, which have been recited at the holy altar. Introduce their devotion to the ears of divine piety and intensely implore the omnipotence of the Trinity that they, whose names are presented in the book with seven distinguished signs, may look favorably and acceptingly upon the souls resting, and that perpetual rest keep them. May He multiply for them the fruits of present generosity and lead us through eternal remuneration to look upon their offering with peaceful serenity and acceptance.

text: Suscipite venerabiles martyres etsi indigni cultoris officium et vota totius populi precantis attendite ut qui de vestrorum meritorum estis remuneratione securi sitis de nostrorum criminum remissione solliciti.
translation_en: Receive the venerable martyrs, and though we may be unworthy of our duty as their servants, pay heed to the prayers of the entire people. May you who are recompensed by their merits be assured in the remission of our sins, and may you who are mindful of their merits strive diligently for our forgiveness.

text: Accipe venerabilis martyr et virgo Christina etsi indigni cultoris officia tandem vel vota totius populi precantis attende ut quae es de meritorum tuorum remuneratione secura sis etiam de nostrorum criminum remissione sollicita.
translation_en: Receive, venerable martyr and virgin Christina, though we are unworthy of your service, attend to the prayers and requests of the entire people. May you be secure in the reward of your merits, and may you also seek our forgiveness for our sins.

text: Talis sit in conspectu tuo omnipotens Deus haec oblatio ut sancto martyre tuo Leodegario intercedente aeterna pro peccatis nostris fiat populi tui propitiatio.
translation_en: May this offering be in your sight, almighty God, so that through the intercession of your saint martyr, Leodegar, eternal forgiveness may be granted to your people for our sins.

text: Tange quaesumus Iesu Filius Dei tenebras cordis nostri digitis tuis ut te in nobis lucente peccatorum eruamur a tenebris qualiter ea quae tibi offerimus luce perlustres aeternae sanctificationis et nos ita mundes a vitiorum illecebris ut sanctificati percipere mereamur eucharistiam corporis tui in visceribus nostris.
translation_en: We ask you, Jesus Son of God, touch the shadows of our hearts with your fingers, so that we may be freed from them as light overcomes darkness. May whatever we offer to you shine brightly in eternal sanctification, and may we be cleansed from the allurements of sin, so that we may deserve to receive the Eucharist of your body within our hearts.

text: Tantis Domine repleti muneribus auxilium tuum intercedente beato Iob cum omnibus sanctis tuis imploramus ut flagella iracundiae tuae a populo tuo amoveas et nos tibi digne servire concedas.
translation_en: Lord, filled with such abundance of your gifts, we beseech your help through blessed Job and all your saints. We ask that you remove the scourges of your wrath from your people, and grant us worthy service to you.

text: Tantis Domine repleti muneribus ut salutaria semper dona capiamus praesta quaesumus ut a tua numquam laude cessemus.
translation_en: Lord, filled as we are with such great gifts, grant that we may always receive the salutary blessings. We ask that we may never cease from your praise.

text: Tantis Domine repleti muneribus praesta quaesumus ut et salutaria dona capiamus et a tua numquam laude cessemus.
translation_en: Lord, filled with such gifts as we are, grant us we ask, that not only may we receive beneficial gifts from you but also may we never cease to praise you from your own abundance.

text: Tanto nos Domine quaesumus promptiore servitio haec praecurrere concede sollemnia quanto in his constare principium nostrae redemptionis ostendis.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, that these solemnities may precede more quickly according to a more prompt service, just as you show in them the beginning of our redemption.

text: Tanto nos Domine quaesumus promptiore servitio huius sacrificii praecurrere concede sollemnia quanto in hoc constare principium nostrae redemptionis ostendis.
translation_en: Lord, as we humbly ask, may we hasten to serve this sacrifice with a more prompt service. Grant us that, just as the beginning of our redemption is shown to be solemn in this, we may precede accordingly.

text: Tanto placabiles quaesumus Domine nostrae sint hostiae quanto sanctorum martyrum pro quorum sollemnitatibus exhibentur tibi grata sunt merita.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that our offerings may be as pleasing to You as the martyrs' sacrifices, which are presented in their honor and are acceptable to You on account of their merits.

text: Tanto placabiles quaesumus Domine nostrae sint hostiae quanto sancti martyris Georgii pro cuius sollemnitate exhibentur tibi grata sunt merita.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that our offerings may be as pleasing to You as the sacrifices of the holy martyr George for whose feast day they are presented to You. His merits are indeed pleasing.

text: Tanto quaesumus Domine placatus assume quanto sacrandas nomini tuo has specialiter hostias indidisti ut quidquid nostrae non expletur servitutis officio indulgentiae tuae dignatione pensetur.
translation_en: As much as we humbly ask you, Lord, satisfied, take on as much as you have specifically consecrated these hosts for your name, so that whatever of our service falls short may be considered worthy of your indulgence through your merciful kindness.

text: Te deprecamur Domine ut adsis precibus cottidianis diebus quae tuis deferuntur altaribus. Respicere dignare humilitatis nostrae confessionem cum tuae magnae misericordiae die noctuque deposcimus Deus pietatem; pro Ecclesia tua catholica quam custodire digneris ab universis scandalis; pro serenitate regia ut vitam tranquillam possideat; pro sacerdotibus in fungendis officiis quos ab omni insidia diaboli facias liberari; pro clero et universo populo quos tu Domine tua intercedente misericordia ab imminenti flagello propitius liberare digneris; pro spiritibus famulorum famularumque tuarum in pace quiescentium ut remissionem accipiant peccatorum; et salus comitetur per intercessionem sanctorum omnibus in hac vita viventibus.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Thee, O Lord, that Thou be present with our daily petitions which are offered to Thy altars. Deign to look upon our humble confession with Thy great mercy, day and night we ask Thee, God of piety; for Thy Catholic Church which Thou hast chosen to protect from all scandals; for the serenity of the royal house that it may possess a tranquil life; for the priests in their duties whom Thou makest free from every deceit of the devil; for the clergy and the entire people whom Thou, O Lord, through Thy intercession deem worthy to be mercifully freed from the impending scourge; for the servants and handmaids of Thine who rest in peace that they may receive remission of sins; and health attend them through the intercession of the saints upon all who live this life.

text: Te Deum Salvatorem nostrum suppliciter exoramus ut intercessione beati Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis ab omnibus diabolicis liberemur insidiis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech Thee, our Savior God, that through the intercession of blessed Blasius, thy martyr and bishop, we may be freed from all diabolical snares.

text: Te Domine Christe Iesu te Deum pluraliter homines salvantem et hominem in Deo singulariter potentem invocamus laudamus rogamus; adsis ut parcas miserearis ignoscas; des in corde vota quae compleas; des in ore verba quae exaudias; des in opere facta quae benedicas. Non petimus renovari nobis sicut in hac die olim acta est corporalem nativitatem tuam sed petimus incorporati nobis invisibilem divinitatem tuam. Quod praestitum est carnaliter sed singulariter tunc Mariae nunc spiritaliter praestetur ecclesiae ut te fides indubitata concipiat te mens de corruptione liberata parturiat te semper anima virtute altissimi obumbrata contineat. Ne discedas a nobis sed procedas ex nobis.  Sis revera Emmanuel noster nobiscum Deus. Digneris manere in nobis et pugnare pro nobis. Te enim pugnante nos vincimus. Solve nos quaesumus pannis putribus peccatorum qui te pro peccatis nostris dignatus es putredine ligari pannorum. Lac tuum Ecclesiae tuae parvulos nutriat. Adeo infirmos delicatus olerum cibus pascat ut ad percipiendum fortiorem ac solidum cibum validiores cottidie vires crescant. Et ita noverimus defecatam voluntatem et fidem habere firmissimam ut iugiter enitamur auxilio tuo ad vitam pervenire perfectam.
translation_en:
We, Lord Christ Jesus, the God whom many people save and whom one person finds powerful in God, invoke, praise, entreat; come to our aid, be merciful, forgive; grant in the heart what we desire to fulfill; grant in the mouth words that you will hear; grant in the deeds what you will bless. We do not ask to be renewed in us as once your bodily nativity was acted out on this day, but we ask for your invisible divinity to be given to us. What was bestowed upon flesh then should now be given to the church spiritually so that faith undoubted may conceive you, the mind freed from corruption may give birth to you, the soul always covered by the highest virtue may contain you. Do not depart from us but proceed from us.
Indeed, may you truly be our Emmanuel, God with us. May you deign to remain in us and fight for us. For when we are fighting with you, we conquer. Grant us, we beseech you, to cleanse ourselves with the filthy rags of our sins that you have deemed worthy to be bound by the cloths. Let your milk feed the children of your church. May the delicate food of fragrant herbs nourish the weak so that they daily grow stronger forces to receive a firmer and more solid food. And thus, we may know that our will and faith are firmest, so that we may always approach your help to reach perfect life.

text: Te Domine Deus noster oblatis sacrificiis invocamus et petimus ut haec munera quibus nos reconciliari confidimus placatus adspicias. Exaudias tibi supplicantium preces et desideria singulorum aut compescas si fuerint prava aut si fuerint recta perficias ut qui hic tibi oblationes nostras devotis immolamus affectibus superni altaris facti participes aeterna munera recipiamus.
translation_en: We, Lord God, present sacrifices to you, we invoke and ask that you look upon these gifts with which we trust ourselves are reconciled. Hear the prayers of those who supplicate to you, and fulfill the desires of each one - either by restraining if they have been wrong, or by perfecting if they have been right. So that those who here offer our devout sacrifices with heavenly feelings become participants in eternal rewards.

text: Te Domine Iesu Christe benedicimus teque laudamus qui tam beatum tamque perfectum martyrem tuum Stephanum tui imitatione fecisti ut quod etiam in reliquis sanctis rarum atque difficile est sic persecutionis tormenta portaret ut ultionis vota de persequentibus non haberet et eorum impunitatem intrepide in persecutione peteret quorum impietatem inter saxa sentiret. Utique cum illi lapides mitterent super eum ille pro eis preces fundebat ad Deum: »Domine Iesu ne statuas illis hoc ad peccatum.« Certabat impatientia cum indulgentia. Illi vulnera inferre iste odia non referre. Illi doloribus non cedere iste pro hostibus supplicare. Postremo erat in benignitate martyris quod non erat in voluntate carnificis; nolle hos puniri per quos se videbat coronari.  Haec igitur tam gloriosa pietas tam perfecta benignitas quae pro illis preces fundebat credentium populorum vota commendet fidelium spem confortet sperantium necessitates adiuvet supplicantium culpas excuset et pro ecclesiae unitate et pace catholicae plebis invigilet. Hic semper pro subiectis dum rogat obtineat qui pro inimicis dum lapidaretur orabat.
translation_en:
We bless you, Lord Jesus Christ, and we praise you, who made your most blessed and perfect martyr Stephen in your image to bear the persecution's torment that is rare and difficult even among other saints. He carried it out so that he had no vengeance wishes against his persecutors and boldly sought their impunity in the persecution, feeling their wickedness among the rocks. Indeed, when they were about to throw stones at him, he prayed for them: "Lord Jesus, do not let this be a sin for them." Impatience contended with indulgence. They inflicted wounds, but he did not return hatred. They caused pain, but he prayed on behalf of his enemies. Finally, there was mercy in the martyr that was not in the will of the executioner; he did not want them to be punished whom he saw as crowning himself.
Therefore, this most glorious piety and perfect benevolence which he prayed for on behalf of them, let it commend the hope of believers, comfort the expectations of the needy, aid the necessities of supplicants, excuse their faults, and watch over the unity and peace of the Catholic Church. Here, always when he prayed for his subjects, may he obtain who, while being stoned, prayed for his enemies.

text: Te Domine Iesu Christe in praecursoris tui nativitate laudamus; te in eius praedicatione admirabiliter extollimus; te in illius morte quantum humana valet pusillitas voce qua possumus honorificamus. Cuius nativitate ubera reserasti senilia et patris linguam quam incredulitas nexuerat absolvisti; cuius praedicatione te adesse terris discipuli crediderunt et populi qui illis praestaret salutem saluberrimam audierunt; cuius morte veritas patuit et mens belluina quod in se latebat occultare non valuit.  Huius ergo precibus dignare inspirare nostris cordibus ut caelorum regnum appropinquare credentes te semper paenitendo rogemus tibi preces lacrimabili corde fundamus tua promissa confidenter speremus ut mundata mente nostra a pollutione delicti spiritum tuum sanctum quem in columbae adventu sub illius manibus suscepisti venire in nobis et manere eum sentiamus nobiscum ac filium Dei te dilectissimum voce qua ipse audivit audiamus et aequalem patri cum spiritu sancto confiteamur credamus et semper oremus.
translation_en:
We praise you, Lord Jesus Christ, in the birth of your forerunner; we exalt you marvelously in his preaching; we honor you with the small human voice that we can, in his death. Whose birth you opened old breasts and released the tongue of the father, which unbelief had bound; whose preaching the disciples believed you to be present on earth, and the people who offered them the most salutary salvation heard it; whose death truth was revealed and the wicked mind could not hide what lay hidden within.
Therefore, we humbly ask that you inspire our hearts with these prayers so that, believing in your constant repentance, we may pour out heartfelt pleas to you, confidently hope for your promised blessings, and expect that with a purified mind, your holy spirit which you received in the dove's coming under his hands will come upon us and remain with us. We desire to hear your voice as it was heard by him, and to confess you as equal to the Father with the Holy Spirit. We believe and always pray.

text: Te Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus supplices invocamus ut pia suffragia sancti Andreae apostoli cuius hodie passio celebratur et viventibus vitam tibi placitam et pausantibus refrigerium deposcant.
translation_en: We, humbly call upon you, Lord, Holy Father, Almighty and eternal God, that through the pious intercessions of Saint Andrew, Apostle whose today's passion is celebrated, may grant to the living a life pleasing to you and to the resting a refreshment.

text: Te dominum Deum nostrum totis precibus exoramus qui famulo tuo Moysi primitias omnium rerum delibare iussisti. Quaesumus ut hanc creaturam primitiarum quam tibi devota tuorum offert turba fidelium benedictionis tuae gratia perfundas omniumque offerentium fructus digneris nimbis caelorum blandientibus enutrire ut leni fluxu descendens aura caelestis ad maturitatem te prosperante immatura provocet pervenire ut misericordiae tuae gratia aeternis et praesentibus bonis cumules ac ditatos facias offerentes eorumque semper amplifices voluntates.
translation_en: We humbly entreat you, our Lord and God, with all our prayers, who commanded your servant Moses to offer the first fruits of all things. We ask that you pour out your blessings on this creation of first fruits, which the devoted crowd of faithful people offers to you. May you deem worthy to nourish it with the gentle showers of heavenly dew, so that a soft air from heaven, descending gently upon it, may hasten its growth while you are favoring it. May it thus reach maturity and by your mercy's grace become an eternal and present heap of blessings, enriching those who offer it and continually increasing their desires.

text: Te invocamus aeterne omnipotens Deus ut corpus Domini nostri Iesu Christi quod sumpsimus et sanguis eius quem potavimus adhaereat in visceribus nostris ut non nobis sit ad iudicium neque ad condemnationem sed proficiat in remissionem peccatorum et sempiternam salutem.
translation_en: We invoke you, eternal almighty God, that the body of our Lord Jesus Christ which we have received and his blood which we have drunk may adhere to our innermost being, so that it is not for judgment or condemnation against us but rather for remission of sins and eternal salvation.

text: Te invocamus Domine sancte Pater aeterne omnipotens detis ut nos famulos tuos propriis peccatis oppressos ipse tibi facias approbatus nec causas consideres nostras sed delinquentibus indulgentiam largam concedas et haec quae tibi offerimus sacrificia nostra non discutiens merita in tuo conspectu efficias gratiosa.
translation_en: We invoke you, Lord, holy Father, eternal and almighty. Grant us, your servants, who are oppressed by our own sins, that you make us approved ones, not that you consider our causes but grant indulgence to the sinners. And what we offer to you as our sacrifices, without disputing their merits, may they be pleasing in your sight.

text: Te licet anxia tota supplex gemensque postulat omnipotens cum regibus et principibus patria gentium infidelium barbararum debellatione contrita te summe rerum omnium conditor ac patriae gubernator praesentibus humilitatis nostrae sacrificiis postulamus humiles ne longius differas gemitibus nostris tuae pietatis auxilium quod poscimus ut qui Gedeon cum trecentis affuisti Trinitas victrix hostium in conflictu adsis regibus nostris proeliantibus victoria cum adversariis in effectu nec gens perfida exsultet de victoria qui se sine te suis viribus extollit inanem gloriam.
translation_en: You, the almighty one, are allowed to be anxiously and humbly supplicated by us, along with kings and princes, who, contrite by the subjugation of the barbarian infidels' lands, invoke you, the supreme creator and governor of all things. We humbly ask your presence among our sacrifices, so that you may not delay long in answering our groans, seeking aid from your pity that we request. May the Trinity, victorious over the enemy, assist our kings in battle, bestowing victory upon them as they engage their adversaries. Let no faithless nation rejoice in its victory, which boasts of being exalted without you and your mighty powers; instead, let it find an empty glory.

text: Te omnipotens Christe Iesu tota mentis devotione veneramur te omnium dominum fideli servitutis obsequio excolimus. Te coaeternum sancto patri et sancto spiritui manente in singulis aequali sempiternaque deitate unum in Trinitate Deum indivise confitentes laudamus benedicimus et exsultamus. Qui multimoda miseratione igne tuo sanctorum martyrum corda inflammans veritatis tuae testes esse fecisti. Cuius potissimum fuit sacrilegium horrere quam carcerem poenas petere quam timere mortem rapere quam vitare eius proculdubio fuit animae te amare et damnum corporis non pavere.  Unde inter ceteras magnificas urbes quas cruor sanctorum fusus illustrat maximum huic civitatulae dignatus es conferre suffragium ut ipsa vix omnium in sacerdotio caput inclita Roma martyrum numero nostram queat superare Caesaraugustam. Dum illa utique caput geminum beat apostolorum triumpho et ista una ex membris novem simul et decem martyrum victorias titulo cum corporibus servat uno.  Quorum apud te intercessio cives saepe ab infestatione defendit et hostes cum ultione fugavit. Non nos Domine iactantiae tumor ista narrare compellit nec ventus hoc a nobis exigit vanitatis sed zelus amoris tuam cogit edicere laudem quia haec omnia non a nobis sunt facta sed nobis tua miseratione concessa. Hic nempe merentur exaudiri supplici oratione precantes; hic praestantur gaudia tribulatis securitas anxiis medela languidis salus integerrima furiosis; et dum martyrum laetaris implere suggessa potentialiter impertiris oppressis remedia. Illorum ergo recordaberis meriti ne nostri recorderis errati. Illi ad nos te tribuente perferant tua qui detulerunt ad te nostra. Sicque eorum obtentu gratia tua transgredi nos faciat humanam naturam ut mens tibi nostra cum corpore inoffense deserviat et victum se semper a tuis famulis adversarius erubescat.
translation_en:
We, all-powerful Christ Jesus, with entire devotion of mind venerate you, and with faithful service we adore you as the lord of all. You coeternal with holy father and holy spirit, remaining in each equally in sempiternal deity, one in Trinity, God undivided, we confess, praise, rejoice, and glorify. Whose multimodal mercy, inflaming the hearts of saints with your fire, you have made witnesses of your truth.
Of all these things, it was most abominable for this sacrilege to shrink than to seek punishment in prison than to fear death than to avoid its imminent danger was for the soul to love you and not to fear bodily harm.
Among other magnificent cities that the blood of saints has illuminated, you have deemed it fitting to bestow upon this little city the suffrage, so that it may surpass Rome in the number of martyrs. While Rome is indeed the head with a double triumph of the blessed apostles and this one a member of nine and ten martyrs' victories, it holds the title along with their bodies.
The intercession of these martyrs often protects the citizens from persecution and drives away enemies with vengeance. Lord, we are not compelled to tell such boasting stories nor does the wind demand this from us as vanity, but zeal for love moves us to declare praise because all these things were not done by us but were granted to us by your mercy.
Indeed, they who are worthy of hearing a supplicant's prayer, they who provide joy to those tried with tribulation, security to anxious hearts, medicine to the weary, health to the infirm, and remedies to those oppressed - these martyrs you will remember for their merits, not our errors. May they bring us to you who brought our forebears to you.
Through their intercession may your grace transcend human nature so that our mind serves you without offense along with our body and the enemy may always blush before your servants.

text: Te omnipotens Deus apud quem est immensa misericordia et copiosa redemptio deprecamur ut animam famuli tui illius cuius depositionis diem celebramus si quae in eo sunt maculae peccatorum iubeas emundari ut peccatorum venia indulta sine fine mereatur gaudere in regione vivorum.
translation_en: We, the almighty God before whom there is immense mercy and abundant redemption, pray that you cleanse the soul of your servant whose day of departure we celebrate, if there are any stains of sins within him, so that he may deserve to enjoy the forgiveness of sins without end in the region of the living.

text: Te quaesumus Domine conditor ac reformator humani generis qui hunc egregium martyrem sanctum Christophorum nobis in terris degentibus tribuisti pro nobis adiutorem; in tua celsa beatitudine rogamus esse intercessorem.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, Creator and Reformer of the human race, who on earth have given us this outstanding martyr Saint Christopher as an aid for us; in Your exalted blessedness, we beg that He may be an intercessor for us.

text: Te quaesumus Domine famulantes prece humili auxilium implorantes ut beatae semper virginis Mariae nos gaudia comitentur sollemniis cuius praeconio ac meritis nostra deleantur chirographa peccatorum atque rubigines scelerum molivitiorum igne compunctionis tui amoris mundentur incursu.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, as your servants seek help and implore aid, that the joyful solemnities of the blessed ever virgin Mary may guide us, whose praises and merits may blot out for us the records of sins and the stains of wickedness, and that they be cleansed by the fire of your compassionate love.

text: Te quaesumus Domine Iesu Christe ut dilectio adventus tui ita in nobis permaneat ne a te corda nostra umquam recedant. Sicque nos iam nunc in aeterna adnotatione adscribe ut ad futurum non confundamur cum ad iudicandum veneris orbem.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord Jesus Christ, that the love of Your coming may so remain in us that our hearts never depart from You. And may we already now be enrolled forever in eternal remembrance, lest, when You come to judge the world, we be confused.

text: Te quaesumus Iesu Domine Deus noster ut nos qui fideliter praestolamus adventum tuum non incurramus supplicium sempiternum quo in adventu tuo et offerentibus venia et defunctis requies concedatur aeterna.
translation_en: We ask you, Jesus Lord our God, that we who faithfully prepare for your coming may not incur eternal punishment when offering mercy at your arrival and rest be granted to the deceased eternally.

text: Te te altissime redemptor noster et Domine in tuis operibus collaudamus qui dum virginem Eulaliam ad nominis tui dilectionem accendis proditorem eam sui nominis facis ut eo robustior ad passionem consurgeret quo nomen suum furenti iudici non taceret.  Quaesumus proinde ut quae nominis sui facta est proditrix in prolatione nostrorum nominum ante te non efficiatur elinguis; ut quae vocabulum suum non tacuit iudici vocabula fidelium renotanda aeternae imprimat mansioni ut quotquot in illum credimus quem ipsa veraci corde professa est et praesentis vitae tutelam et in futuro cum defunctis fidelibus mereamur beatorum omnium promereri consortia.
translation_en:
We praise you, most high Redeemer and Lord, for in your works we acclaim you. When you kindled the virgin Eulalia with the love of your name, you made her a traitor to her own name, so that she became stronger to endure the passion whereby she would not remain silent before the furious judge regarding your name.
We therefore ask that what was once a traitor to your name may not be forgotten in our names; that what she did not keep silent about before the judge may mark the eternal dwelling of the faithful, so that for all who believe in him whom she professed with true heart and present life, we may merit to be joined in eternal union with all the blessed.

text: Te te igitur summe et admirabilis Deus totis praecordiis deprecamur ut qui beatissimo Thomae ad sagacitatem inquirendi accommodas et fide credentibus inspiras nobis et indulgentiam peccaminum tribuas et donis tuis inspirando praevenias. Quique sanctissimi Thomae dubitatione nos roboras eius quaesumus merito nos in fide ita stabiles operibus solida ut iudicante te digne invenias quos coronandos aetherea sustollas in atria quatenus et fidelium servorum tuorum acceptes libamina quae hodierno die plebs tibi Deo nostro mente offerunt grata et pro quibus te submisso obsecrant capite tuae pietatis clementiam esse adeptos congaudeant.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, most high and wonderful God, that you who have fitted blessed Thomas with wisdom in seeking, and inspired faith-filled believers, may grant us inspiration and the forgiveness of sins. May you, who strengthen us through the doubt of the most holy Thomas, make us steadfast in faith with solid works so that, being judged worthy by you, you raise those to be crowned in the ethereal halls on high. May they who offer pleasing libations from their hearts today, the faithful servants of our God, find favor through your mercy, and may those who submit themselves to you in supplication receive the grace of your head's pity. May they rejoice together.

text: Te rerum omnium conditorem Deum in cuius manu regum corda consistunt cuius potentia Goliam spurium David fortis manu prostravit lapidis ictu suo et adversariorum ceteros te protegente fecit momento succumbere tuae clementiae licet indigni lamentabili praeconio humiliter exoramus ut qui tunc affuisti Israeli ne periret victus victor in certamine adsis nunc et tuis invocantibus fidelibus belliger in virtute robur in brachii fortitudine securitas in proelio adversariorum hostium amoda fortitudine.
translation_en: We entreat the maker of all things, God, in whose hand the hearts of kings consist, whose power brought down the sham Goliath with a stone's throw and made other adversaries collapse at a moment by your protection. Although we are unworthy, we humbly beg you to be present as you were then for Israel, lest it perish in battle, now and to those who invoke you faithfully fight with strength in the power of your arm, with security in the might of your arm in battle against adversaries and enemies. Amen.

text: Tempora nostra quaesumus Domine pio favore prosequere et quibus cursum tribuis largiorem praesta continuum benignus auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that You follow our times with a favorable disposition and grant us a larger measure of Your kindness in continuous aid.

text: Tempus hoc sacratissimum fratres dilectissimi trementi devotione ac sollicitudine celebremus quo Dominus noster quadraginta dierum vel noctium cursum absque ullo esus iuvamine sub indumento corporis ieiunavit. Nam sicut reliquo anni tempore ieiunare praemium est ita in his diebus non ieiunare peccatum est. Illa enim voluntaria sunt ieiunia ista necessaria; illa de arbitrio ista veniunt de mandato; ad illa denique invitamur ad ista compellimur. Precemur ergo dominum ut nobis ieiuniorum dies tribuat ad profectum iungente desiderio qui ita in eis salutis congruae donavit exemplum.
translation_en: In this most sacred time, dear brothers, we celebrate with trembling devotion and solicitude, for our Lord fasted without any food assistance for forty days or nights. Just as it is a reward to fast during the rest of the year, so it is a sin not to fast in these days. The former fasts are voluntary, but these are necessary; the former come from choice, but these come from command; and finally, we are invited to the former, but compelled to the latter. Therefore, let us pray to the Lord that he grants us the days of fasting as a help in our spiritual progress, who gave such an example of salvation in them.

text: Terram tuam Domine quam videmus nostris iniquitatibus tabescentem caelestibus aquis infunde atque irriga beneficiis gratiae sempiternae.
translation_en: Lord, your land that we see wasting away due to our wickedness, pour upon it and water with heavenly waters, and nourish with the blessings of eternal grace.

text: Terribilis Deus et invicta fortitudo ac nimis pavenda potestas largire nobis beati Apollinaris martyris et sacerdotis tui precibus stipendia salutis aeternae ut casta pectora baiulantes laudes tuae clementiae referamus eius sollemnia celebrantes.
translation_en: A terrifying God and an invincible might, and a power far to be feared, grant us the alms of eternal salvation through the prayers of the blessed Apolinaris, your martyr, and priest. So that with chaste hearts we may carry forth praises for your clemency, celebrating its solemnity.

text: Tibi Christe referimus gratiam qui nos divinis muneribus satias ex mensa plena donis tuis omnibus; nos sumentes te laudamus Domine; decoedentes laudes tibi dicimus nunc et semper per omnia saecula.
translation_en: To You, Christ, we refer our gratitude who have filled us through divine gifts from Your abundant table; as we partake of You, we praise You, Lord; bowing low, we say our praises to You now and forever throughout all ages.

text: Tibi Deus Pater omnipotens immaculati Agrii paschale offerimus holocaustum cuius nos sanguine ab exterminatoris vastatione salvatos ad terram quaesumus tuae repromissionis inducas.
translation_en: To You, Almighty God Father, we offer the paschal holocaust from the immaculate Field. By whose blood we have been saved from the destruction of the exterminator, we humbly ask that you lead us to the land of Your repromise.

text: Tibi Domine commendamus animam famuli tui illius ut defunctus saeculo tibi vivat et si qua per fragilitatem mundanae conversationis peccata admisit tu venia misericordissimae pietatis absterge.
translation_en: To Thee, Lord, we commend the soul of Thy servant; may he live with Thee forever, and if by any frailty of worldly life he has contracted sins, wash them away in Thy most merciful pity.

text: Tibi Domine Deus meus meae devotionis hostias immolo hoc oro pariterque deprecor clementiam tuam ut me sacrificium tuum mortificatione vitae carnalis effectum in odorem suavitatis accipias ac moribus quibus professioni meae congruam instituas et quem sanctae compunctionis ardore ab hominum ceterorum proposito segregasti etiam a conversatione carnali atque ab immunditia actuum terrenorum infusa mihi caelitus sanctitate discernas ut omnia terrena despiciam et caelestia appetam.
translation_en: To You, Lord my God, I present the offerings of my devotion. I humbly ask and implore your mercy that you accept me as a sacrifice to you, made through mortification of carnal life, and make me pleasant in the odor of sweetness. I also request that you establish in me habits consistent with my profession, and separate me from the purpose of other men, even from carnal conversation and terrestrial impurity infused within me. May heavenly sanctity distinguish me so that I despise all earthly things and desire celestial ones.

text: Tibi Domine Deus noster nostrae devotionis hostias immolamus hoc orantes pariter et precantes ut nos sacrificium tuum mortificatione vitae carnalis effectos in odorem suavitatis accipias ac moribus quibus professioni nostrae congruamus instituas et quos sanctae compunctionis ardore ab hominum ceterorum proposito segregasti a conversatione carnali et ab immunditia actuum terrenorum infusa nobis caelitus sanctitate discernas.
translation_en: To You, Lord God, we offer the sacrifices of our devotion, praying and entreating in unison, that You may accept us as a sacrifice made by mortification of carnal life, making us pleasing in the sweet fragrance. May You also establish us with habits fitting for our profession, separating us from others who are set apart from the carnal conversation and the impurity of earthly actions infused within us. May heavenly sanctity distinguish us.

text: Tibi Domine Deus noster totis visceribus supplicamus ut ieiunia nostra velut pinguia holocausta suscipias peccata dimittas cogitationes quibus delectaris inspires actus regas errores corrigas conscientias mundes corda sanctifices subdens et spiritui carnem et spiritum tibi ut officium suum caro humiliata cognoscens subripientia incentiva repudiet et victor spiritus vitiorum tibi domino ac Deo suo reddita libertate deserviat.
translation_en: Lord God, to whom we submit our entire being, we humbly ask that you receive our fasting as acceptable holocausts and forgive our sins. May our thoughts, which please you, inspire our actions; may you govern our errors and correct our ways. Cleanse our consciences, purify our hearts, sanctify our spirits, bend flesh to your spirit, and give both soul and body to serve you. May the humbled flesh recognize its duty and reject temptation, while the conquering spirit overcomes vices. Thus, submitting itself to you, Lord, it may serve with freedom.

text: Tibi Domine inclinamus genua cordis; ad te expandimus conscientiae manus; in tuo Deus conspectu ponimus lacrimas nostras; de tua piissima largitate conferantur nobis gaudia sempiterna.
translation_en: To You, Lord, we bend our knees of the heart; to You we stretch out the hands of conscience; in Your sight, we place our tears; from Your most merciful generosity, may eternal joys be granted to us.

text: Tibi Domine ob honorem resurrectionis tuae maximas concinimus laudes petentes ut sicut pro nobis peccatoribus dignatus es mori et die tertia resurgi ita per te ab omnibus iniquitatibus nostris mereamur absolvi.
translation_en: To You, Lord, for the honor of Your resurrection we sing our highest praises, asking that just as you were willing to die for us sinners and rise again on the third day, so through You may we be worthy to be absolved from all our sins.

text: Tibi Domine sacrificia dicata reddantur quae sic ad honorem nominis tui deferenda tribuisti ut eadem remedia fieri nostra praestares
translation_en: May the offerings dedicated to You, Lord, be returned, which You have commanded to be offered for Your honor's sake, so that through them You may provide aid for us.

text: Tibi Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus meae devotionis hostiam suppliciter immolo et licet indignis meis manibus offerantur quae nec invocatione tui nominis dignus sum tamen quia per sanctum atque sanctificatum Filii tui nomen offeruntur hoc oro pariterque deprecor clementiam tuam ut sicut incensum in conspectu tuo cum odore suavitatis adscendant.
translation_en: To You, Lord, holy Father, all-powerful eternal God of my devotion, I humbly offer my sacrifice and though unworthy, my hands present what are not worthy even to be named by Your name. Yet because they are offered in the name of Your holy and sanctified Son, I beseech You and entreat Your mercy that as incense in Your sight with a sweet odor, they may ascend.

text: Tibi nos quaesumus Domine haec hostia reddat immolanda placitos tuorum digna postulatione sanctorum Remigii atque Germani episcoporum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that this offering may be acceptable to you, worthy of your petition by the merits of Saints Remigius and Germanus, bishops.

text: Tibi placitam Deus noster populo tuo tribue voluntatem quia tunc illi prospera cuncta praestabis cum tuis aptum feceris institutis.
translation_en: May our God grant his pleasure to his people, for then they will have every success, as you provide all things when you fulfill them with your suitable institutions.

text: Tibi sit accepta quaesumus Domine devotio nostra quae nos expiando tua gratia dignos efficiat et ad promissa sempiterna perducat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that our devotion be accepted by you. May it, through your grace, make us worthy and lead us to the eternal promises.

text: Tibi soli Christe Domine a nobis gloria ei honor gratiarumque actio datur qui fecisti parvulos per ignotam temporis mortem pervenire ad aeternitatis beatae hereditatem qui glorificatus es melius in eorum sanguinis voce quam in aetatis professione apud quem non est quaesita cognitio rationis in quibus coronata est materia parvitatis. Tribue proinde nobis illis intervenientibus et deesse in quo male sumus et adesse in quo semper bene tecum vivamus.
translation_en: To You, Christ Lord, glory, honor, and thanksgiving are given by us, who made the children to arrive through unknown temporal death at the eternal blessed inheritance. Who were glorified better in their blood's voice than in the profession of age, where no knowledge or reason was sought in whom the matter of littleness was crowned. Therefore, grant them help who are intervening on our behalf and be absent from where we are evil, and present where we always live well with You.

text: Timentium te Domine Salvator et custos averte ab Ecclesia tua mundanae sapientiae oblectamenta fallaciae ut spiritus tui eruditione formandos prophetica et apostolica potius instituta quam philosophiae verba delectent ne vanitas mendaciorum decipiat quos eruditio veritatis illuminat.
translation_en: Lord, Savior and Guardian, turn away from Your Church the allurements of worldly wisdom that come from deceit, so that the disciples may be shaped by Your prophetic and apostolic teachings rather than the words of philosophy. Let not vanity and lies deceive those who are illuminated by the education of truth.

text: Totis sensibus hodiernum Domine sacrificium celebramus quo nobis ipsius sacrificii sunt nata primordia.
translation_en: Today, Lord, we celebrate the sacrifice with all our senses, through which the very beginnings of your sacrifice were born in us.

text: Toto tibi Domine corde substrati bonitatem tuam supplices exoramus ut nos et temporalibus praesidiis fovere non desinas et aeternis instruere non omittas.
translation_en: With wholehearted supplication, we beseech You, Lord, not to cease defending us with temporal protection and not to neglect instructing us with eternal blessings.

text: Totum corpus Ecclesiae tuae quaesumus Domine sic benedictio suppliciter implorata disponat ut et superiorum firmitate membrorum subiecta congaudeat et subditorum sinceritate summa laetetur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your whole body, the Church, may be so blessed by your benediction that, being subject to the firmness of its leaders, it may rejoice in the sincerity of its subjects.

text: Transferat nos a carceribus inimicorum nostrorum supremus auxiliator cui beati Edmundi confessoris sui animam placuit in caelo coronari et corpus a terra cum summa laetitia sursum transportari.
translation_en: Carry us from the prisons of our enemies, our highest helper, to whom the soul of blessed Edmund, the confessor, pleased to be crowned in heaven, and his body with great joy was transported up from the earth.

text: Translati corporis beati Saturnini sollemnia celebrantes tuae Deus imploramus clementiae maiestatem ut qui praedicti martyris translatos cineres elegisti honorificentius reponendos et defunctos transferas a tormentis in requiem et viventes ad celerem post lapsum conversionem.
translation_en: On the solemnity of the translation of the blessed Saturninus, we humbly beseech your divine majesty to bestow upon us the grace of your clemency. We pray that you would see fit to reinter his holy relics with greater honor and transfer those who have departed from torment into peace, as well as quicken the conversion of the living after their fall.

text: Tribuant nobis quaesumus Domine continuum tua sancta praesidium quo beati Marci evangelistae tui precibus nos ab omnibus semper tueantur adversis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to bestow upon us your continual holy protection, by whose prayers the blessed apostle Mark may always shield us from all dangers.

text: Tribuat nobis Domine quaesumus sanitatem mentis et corporis sacramenti tui medicina caelestis ut huius operatione vegetati tam praesentia quam aeterna subsidia capiamus.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech Thee, the health of mind and body through Thy sacrament, let the heavenly medicine make us grow in this operation, that we may obtain both temporal and eternal support from it.

text: Tribue clemens et misericors Deus in beati testis tui Kenelmi festivitate fidelibus populis opem salutis aeternae nosque famulos tuos pervigili custodi protectione ut qui te totis sensibus confitemur nulla inimici fraude capiamur.
translation_en: Clement and merciful God, grant help to your blessed witness Kenelm's feast day, faithful people, for the aid of eternal salvation. May you watch over your servants unceasingly with protective guard, so that we who confess you fully may not be captured by any deceit of enemies.

text: Tribue Domine quaesumus familiae tuae ut exsultationem cordis sui quam de beati Andreae apostoli tui veneratione percepit et secura concelebret et tota semper mente sectetur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your family may receive the exultation of heart which it perceived from the veneration of blessed Andrew, the apostle, and celebrate it securely, and always follow it with whole mind.

text: Tribue Domine quaesumus fidelibus tuis ut sicut ait apostolus non efficiantur pueri sensibus sed malitia innoxii reperiantur et parvuli ut martyres festivitatis hodiernae quos meritis aequare non possunt mentis simplicitate sectentur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your faithful may not be made like the children mentioned by the apostle, who are corrupted by sensuality. Instead, let the innocence of the wicked be found and let the little ones seek after the festivities of today as martyrs, a pursuit they cannot equal in merit with their simple minds.

text: Tribue Domine ut ita apud universos redemptionis tuae famulos infractae caritatis exundet affectus ut nihil odiorum interpolare praevaleat appetitus sed testimonium osculi quod pro perfectione mansurae pacis impenditur nulla deinceps simultatis fraude frustretur.
translation_en: Lord, grant that among all your servants of the shattered charity, feelings may overflow so that desires for hatred do not prevail, but rather the testimony of the kiss which is offered for the steadfastness of lasting peace may never be hindered by any fraud of deceit.

text: Tribue nobis Domine caelestis mensae virtute satiatis et desiderare quae recta sunt et desiderata percipere.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, celestial power to satisfy the table and to desire what is right and to perceive what is desired.

text: Tribue nobis Domine misericordiam tuam per quam et nostris reatibus possimus absolvi et his mysteriis convenienter aptari.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, your mercy by which we may be able to free ourselves from our sins and prepare fittingly for these mysteries.

text: Tribue nobis Domine pacis tuae solamen cum quo et hic tuti ab hoste et in aeternum vivere possimus beate.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, your peace as a comfort to us, with whom we may safely be here from the enemy and live blessedly forever.

text: Tribue nobis Domine quaesumus ut mysterii salutaris et intellectu proficiamus et cultu.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, we beseech you, that by participating in the saving mystery and understanding, we may progress, and by cult (worship),

text: Tribue nobis omnipotens Deus concordiae meritum et pacis praemium. Famulo quoque tuo illi requiem tribuas et hanc oblationem quae a nobis tibi offertur perfecta misericordia sanctifices nostrorumque omnium peccata deleas et pacis concordiam nobis attribuas
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, the merit of concord and the reward of peace. Also grant to your servant rest, and sanctify the offering which we offer you with perfect mercy. Forgive and delete all our sins, and grant us the harmony of peace.

text: Tribue nobis omnipotens Deus ut dona caelestia quae debito frequentamus obsequio sincera professione sentiamus.
translation_en: Grant to us, almighty God, that we may feel the heavenly gifts which we faithfully and sincerely practice.

text: Tribue nobis quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus sanctorum martyrum tuorum Cancii Canciani et Cancianillae intercessionibus et meritis ubique muniri et tam eorum quam omnium sanctorum incessabiliter boni operis exempla imitari.
translation_en: We beseech you, Almighty and merciful God, to strengthen us everywhere with the intercession and merits of your saints Cancius, Cicianus, and Cancianilla, and to follow their unceasing examples of good works among all the saints.

text: Tribue nobis quaesumus Domine indulgentiam peccatorum ut instituta paschalia tibi placitis sensibus operemur.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you Lord, forgiveness for our sins, so that with pleasing senses we may perform the rites of Easter.

text: Tribue nobis quaesumus omnipotens Deus sanctorum martyrum tuorum Nazarii et Celsi desiderata commercia ut quorum perpetua dignitate sacra mysteria frequentamus in terris et praesentia nobis subsidia postulent et aeterna.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, Almighty God, the desired communications of your holy martyrs Nazarius and Celsus, so that we may frequently participate in the sacred mysteries on earth due to their perpetual dignity. May they also seek support for us here and pray for us eternally.

text: Tribue nos Domine quaesumus donis tuis libera mente servire ut purificante nos gratia tua iisdem quibus famulamur mysteriis emundemur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you, grant us your gifts, set our mind free to serve you, that through your grace, we may be purified in the same manner as we serve these mysteries.

text: Tribue nos quaesumus Domine sanctae illius supplicatione foveri ut eius semper et intercessionibus commendemur et meritis.
translation_en: Sustain us, we beseech you Lord, through the power of his holy intercession, that we may be constantly entrusted to him and redeemed by his merits.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut donis interioribus fecundemur ne exterioribus mereamur egere subsidiis.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask You, Lord our God, that with inner gifts we may be made fruitful, and not have to rely on external aids due to lack of internal resources.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine donis tuis libera nos mente servire ut intervenientibus sanctis tuis munera quae deferimus et medelam nobis operentur et gloriam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant us your gifts, so that we may serve with a free mind. May the offerings we bring before your saints be effective and work healing for us, and may it bring glory.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis ut ieiuniis paschalibus convenienter aptentur et suscepta sollemniter castigatio corporalis ad fructum cunctis transeat animarum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant your faithful the ability to suitably prepare for the Paschal fasts and may the undertaken corporate penance bring fruit for all the souls.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine fidelibus tuis ut ieiunio mensis septimi convenienter aptentur et suscepta sollemniter castigatio corporalis ad fructum cunctarum transeat animarum.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant your faithful the ability to prepare fittingly for the fast of the seventh month and may the undertaken physical penance pass to the benefit of all souls.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine sanctos tuos et iugiter orare pro nobis et semper clementer audiri.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Lord, that your saints may always pray for us and be ever heard with mercy.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine sperantibus fidei et caritatis augmentum ut quod veritatis tuae dono promittitur tua gratia compleatur.
translation_en: Grant, we beseech Thee, Lord, to those who are hoping for the increase of faith and charity, that what Thy truth promises may be fulfilled by Thy grace.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine ut eum praesentibus immolemus sacrificiis et sumamus quem venturae sollemnitatis pia munera praeloquuntur.
translation_en: Grant us, we ask you, Lord, that we may offer him who is present to us as a sacrifice and receive him whom the future solemnities announce as pious gifts.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine ut illuc tendat christianae aliter nostrae devotionis affectus quo tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, that our feelings of Christian devotion may be directed towards that place where our very being is with you.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine ut illuc semper tendat christianae devotionis affectus quo tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: Graciously grant us, Lord, that the feelings of Christian devotion may always strive towards that place where our substance is with you.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine ut per haec sacra quae sumpsimus illuc tendat nostrae devotionis affectus quo tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: Grant us, we pray, Lord, that through these sacred things which we have taken may the affection of our devotion reach where our substance is with you.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut illuc tendat christianae devotionis affectus quo tecum est nostra substantia.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, to grant that the affection of Christian devotion may direct us toward the place where our substance is with You.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Savini martyris tui atque pontificis suffragantibus meritis haec nostra oblatio sit in conspectu tuo accepta et nobis proficiat ad medelam.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God to grant that the intercession of Your blessed martyr Savinus, bishop, may be favorable before You, and that this our offering is accepted in Your sight, and benefits us with healing.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut cuius doctrina populus tuus ad confessionem deitatis tuae est institutus eius suffragantibus meritis divinae serviat unitati.
translation_en: We humbly ask the Almighty God that the people whom Your doctrine has been established to confess Your deity, may serve the divine unity through the merits of those who support them.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut Innocentium sinceritatem possimus imitari quorum tibi dicatam veneramur infantiam.
translation_en: Grant us, Almighty God, that we may be able to imitate the sincerity of the innocent whom we reverently acknowledge as having presented their childlike faith to you.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut natalitii nos dies beatae virginis et martyris tuae Agathae devotus laetificet in quo habente te adiutore et terrena devicta sunt et adepta caelestia ut quod meritis consequi non valeamus memoratae martyris tuae intercessione capiamus.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that the days of the blessed virgin and martyr Agatha may devoutly rejoice us, in which having you as an assistant, temporal things have been conquered and celestial ones achieved. May we obtain through the intercession of the remembered martyr what we are not able to achieve by our own merits.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacro nos purificante ieiunio sinceris quam mentibus postulamus tuis beneficiis indulgentiam consequi mereamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, to grant us that, being purified by the sacred fast, we may deserve the indulgence of your blessings with sincere minds.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sanctae virginis et martyris tuae Agathae sollemnitate laetemur et tantae fidei et castitatis proficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Almighty God, that we may rejoice on the solemnity of Your holy virgin and martyr Agatha, and may profit from the example of such great faith and chastity.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut nos donis caelestibus satias ita (in) beati Ioannis Baptistae nativitate defendas praesidiis ut quod ille de Filii tui nativitate praedicavit nobis prosit ad salutem.
translation_en: We beseech you, almighty God, that as we are filled with celestial gifts, so on the birthday of blessed John the Baptist you defend us with protection, that what he proclaimed to us about your Son's nativity may bring us salvation.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sicut omnes nationes veniunt gaudentes adorare Christum regem dominum natum ita et haec praeclara lux habitet semper in nobis.
translation_en: We ask you, Almighty God, that just as all nations come joyfully to worship Christ the King and Lord who was born, so may this brilliant light always dwell in us.

text: Tribue quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut beatissimi confessoris tui Satyri digne venerabilem memoriam recensentes eius obtentu quod offerimus fiat munus acceptum qui se tibi per sanctae vitae munditiam obtulit hostiam vivam hostiam sanctam hostiam incontaminatam.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty and merciful God, that as we recall the venerable memory of your blessed confessor Satyrus, his intercession may make our offering acceptable to you. For he offered himself as a living, holy, and unspoiled sacrifice through the purity of his holy life.

text: Tribulationem nostram quaesumus Domine propitius respice et iram tuae indignationis quam iuste meremur propitiatus averte.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to look upon our tribulation favorably, and turn away your wrath that we justly deserve. Propitiate us.
