text: Trinitas individua semper ubique patris maiestate diffusa unius potentiae Deum verum a quo sancta regitur vel gubernatur ecclesia quae nunc gentium barbararum afflictionibus pro suis membris in valle lacrimarum gemit angusta cuius confessione sacerdotum integritas intima dolens fundit mente lamenta ideo te clementissime indigni servuli iure legationis praesentis sacrificii uberes fundimus preces quatenus impetrare clementiam tuam valeamus supplices ut iam digneris fluctuantibus in adversis praebere suffragium nec plebs fidelis per infidelium discrimine te opitulante ullum patiatur habere dispendium ut et dignitas regia fulgeat gentium de subiectione et regio devictis hostibus valeat obtinere quietem.
translation_en: The Trinity, individually, is always everywhere diffused in the majesty of the Father, with one power of God being true, who governs or rules the holy church that now suffers afflictions from the barbarian nations in a narrow valley of tears. The priestly integrity, deeply mourning its members, pours out lamentations in mind. Therefore, most merciful Lord, we, unworthy servants, pour out prayers according to the right of this present legation, that we may deserve to implore your clemency as suppliants. You, therefore, mercifully bestow support on those who are tossed about in adversity, so that the faithful people do not suffer any loss through the discrimination of unbelievers, while you intervene on their behalf. May the royal dignity shine among the nations from its subjected and vanquished enemies, and may it be able to obtain peace.

text: Trinitas vera et indivisa Deus summe et trine qui inter Iulianum et Basilissam magnum et spiritale connubii foedus statuisti quo una coniuncti in gratia spiritu non carne fructificarent praesta nobis ut et spiritu ambulemus et desideria carnis non perficiamus respuentes iurgia amplectentes ac perficientes ea quae ipse docuit caritatis praecepta ut dum caritas dei quae data est per Spiritum Sanctum se in nostris diffuserit cordibus exemplo martyrum Iuliani et Basilissae tuis inhaerendo vestigiis coronemur.
translation_en: The true and indivisible God, supreme and trine, who established a great and spiritual marriage covenant between Julian and Basilissa, grant us that we may walk in spirit and not fulfill the desires of flesh, rejecting quarrels while embracing and completing those things which Your commands of love have taught. So that as the charity of God, given through the Holy Spirit, is spread in our hearts by the example of the martyrs Julian and Basilissa, we may be crowned by adhering to your footsteps.

text: Tu Domine semper a nobis omnem remove pravitatem et ad tuam nos propitius converte iustitiam.
translation_en: You, Lord, always from us remove every wickedness and kindly turn us to your righteousness.

text: Tu esto quaesumus Domine populi tui munimen et custos tu vitae praesentis sustentatur et rector tu collator aeternae.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to be the defender and guardian of your people. Sustain them in their present life, and make their collector the ruler of eternity.

text: Tu famulis tuis quaesumus Domine bonos mores placatus institue tu in eis quod tibi placitum sit dignanter infunde ut et digni sint et tua valeant beneficia promereri.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, establish good morals in Your servants, pleased as You are, so that what pleases You may be worthy in them with dignity. Infuse into them that they may deserve and be able to merit Your blessings.

text: Tu rege Domine quaesumus famulum tuum tu guberna propitius tu miseratus attolle ut non in homine sperando deficiat sed in divino munere confidendo tua semper bonitate subsistat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to rule over your servant. Rule over him graciously, you who have shown mercy, raise him up so that he may not fail in hope of man but may endure through the divine grace with confidence, always sustained by your goodness.

text: Tu semper quaesumus Domine tuam attolle benignus familiam tu dispone correctam tu propitius tuere subiectam tu guberna perpetua bonitate salvandam.
translation_en: Always, we humbly ask you, Lord, may your benevolence raise your family. Arrange it correctly. Be merciful and protect the subjected one. Govern with perpetual goodness to save it.

text: Tua Domine medicinalis operatio famulum tuum illum ab omnibus clementer absolvat peccatis et tuis faciat semper inhaerere mandatis.
translation_en: Lord, may your curative operation graciously release your servant from all sins and may he always adhere to your commandments.

text: Tua Domine muneribus altaria cumulamus illius nativitatem honore debito celebrantes qui Salvatorem mundi et cecinit adfuturum et adesse monstravit.
translation_en: We pile up your, Lord, altars with offerings, celebrating with fitting honor the birth of Him who sang about the Savior yet to come and showed that He would exist.

text: Tua Domine propitiatione et beatae Mariae semper virginis intercessione ad perpetuam atque praesentem haec oblatio nobis proficiat prosperitatem.
translation_en: May Your, Lord, mercy and the intercession of blessed Mary, the ever-virgin, make this offering profitable for us, granting eternal and present prosperity.

text: Tua Domine protectione confidens benedictionem suppliciter imploratam devota tibi familia consequatur ut tuo secura munimine nec temporalibus destituatur auxiliis et bonis aptetur aeternis.
translation_en: With confident trust in your protection, we humbly beseech the blessing you grant us, O Lord. May your devoted family obtain it and thus be secured under your defense, not be left without temporal aid, but may it attain eternal blessings.

text: Tua Domine quaesumus sacramenta quae sumpsimus famulum tuum illum custodiant et contra diabolicos atque humanos tueantur semper incursus ut per haec piae devotionis officia terrenis desideriis et carnalis concupiscentiae excessibus mitigatis ad caelestem gloriam pervenire et aeternis suppliciis valeat carere.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that the sacraments which we have received may protect and defend your servant at all times against diabolical and human attacks. May they help him to be tempered from earthly desires and excessive carnal longings so that he can reach celestial glory without eternal torments.

text: Tua Domine saginati eucharistia omnipotentem clementiam tuam laudare non cessamus ut per festum beati praesulis Laudi qui nobis est celeberrimus et plebs tua a cunctis destituatur delictis et aethereis redimatur incrementis.
translation_en: Lord, we never cease to praise Your omnipotent clemency in the Eucharist. On the festival of the most renowned Bishop Laud, may our people be released from all sins and lifted by heavenly increments.

text: Tua Domine sancta libantes et perfectae capiamus purgationis effectum et continuum divinae defensionis auxilium.
translation_en: Let us accept, O Lord, your holy and complete offerings, so that we may attain the effect of purification and the continuous aid of divine defense.

text: Tua Domine sancta sumentes suppliciter deprecamur ut quorum veneramur confessionem praesidia sentiamus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly beseech your holy ones to grant us the feeling of protection as we approach their confessions.

text: Tua Domine sperantes in te quae sumpsimus sacramenta custodiant et contra adversos tueantur incursus.
translation_en: Lord, those who hope in you, let them keep the sacraments that they have received and may they be protected against attacks from their enemies.

text: Tua nos Domine intercedente beato Simeone sancta purificent quia non nisi iisdem purgantibus expiamur.
translation_en: Lord, through the intercession of blessed Simon, cleanse and purify us, for it is only through those cleansing us that we are forgiven.

text: Tua nos Domine medicinalis operatio a cunctis eximat clementer periculis et famulos tuos in omnibus sacris officiis constitutos faciat semper inhaerere mandatis.
translation_en: Lord, may your healing action graciously remove all dangers from us by everyone. May your servants always adhere to the duties in all sacred offices according to your commands.

text: Tua nos Domine medicinalis operatio et a nostris perversitatibus clementer expediat et ad ea quae sunt recta perducat.
translation_en: Lord, may your healing work free us from our wrongdoings and guide us to the right path.

text: Tua nos Domine medicinalis operatio et a nostris perversitatibus clementer expediat et tuis faciat semper inhaerere mandatis.
translation_en: May your medicinal operation, Lord, deliver us gently from our perverse ways and may it always make us adhere to your commandments.

text: Tua nos Domine protectione defende et ab omni semper iniquitate custodi.
translation_en: Lord, defend us with Your protection and always keep us from every wickedness.

text: Tua nos Domine quaesumus gratia et sanctis exerceat veneranda ieiuniis et caelestibus mysteriis efficiat aptiores.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your grace may exercise us with revered fasting and make us fitter through heavenly mysteries.

text: Tua nos Domine quaesumus gratia semper et praeveniat et sequatur ac bonis operibus iugiter praestet esse intentos.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that your grace always precede and follow us, and may you constantly aid those who are striving to do good deeds.

text: Tua nos Domine quaesumus pietate dispone quia nullis egebimus adiumentis si tuae providentiae clementia gubernemur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask you to arrange us by your mercy, for without your help we shall lack assistance if we are guided by the clemency of your providence.

text: Tua nos Domine sacramenta custodiant et contra diabolicos tueantur semper incursus.
translation_en: May Your sacraments, Lord, protect us and defend us against the constant attacks of the devil.

text: Tua nos Domine sacramenta tibi reddant acceptos et beati Machuti supplicatio faciat esse devotos.
translation_en: May Your sacraments, Lord, make us acceptable to You, and the supplication of blessed Machutus may make us devoted.

text: Tua nos misericordia Deus et ab omni subreptione vetustatis expurget et capaces sanctae novitatis efficiat.
translation_en: May your mercy, God, cleanse us from every deceit of the old age and make us capable for the holy newness.

text: Tua nos misericordia Deus per haec sacramenta quae sumpsimus intercedente beato Bonifacio martyre tuo sociisque eius et ab omni subreptione vetustatis expurget et capaces sanctae novitatis efficiat.
translation_en: May your mercy, God, cleanse us through these sacraments that we have received, interceding on our behalf by blessed Boniface, your martyr, and his companions. May you purge us from any deceit of the past and make us fit for the holy renewal.

text: Tua nos quaesumus Domine miseratio gloriosa purificet et dignos quibus sua beneficia praestet efficiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may your glorious mercy purify us and grant your blessings to those worthy enough to receive them.

text: Tua nos quaesumus Domine sancta purificent et operationes suae perficiant nos pacatos.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that your holy purification may cleanse us and that the working of your hands may make us peaceful.

text: Tua nos quaesumus Domine quae sumpsimus sancta purificent et operationis suae remedio (nos) perficiam esse placatos.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to cleanse us with the holy things that we have received and, by the remedy of its operation, make us to be pleasing.

text: Tua nos quaesumus Domine sancta purificent et operationi(s) suae (operatione sua) perficiam esse placatos.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, may your holy purification cleanse us and through its operation (or by your operation) may we be made to be acceptable.

text: Tua sacramenta nos Deus circumtegant et reforment simulque nobis temporale remedium conferant et aeternum.
translation_en: May Your sacred mysteries, God, surround and transform us, and also grant us temporary relief and eternal salvation.

text: Tua sancta nobis omnipotens Deus et indulgentiam praebeant et auxilium perpetuae defensionis impendant.
translation_en: May your holy, almighty God grant us indulgence and may the help of perpetual defense be bestowed upon us.

text: Tua sancta nobis omnipotens Deus quae sumpsimus et indulgentiam praebeant et auxilium perpetuae defensionis impendant.
translation_en: May your holy and all-powerful God grant us pardon for what we have taken and bestow upon us the aid of perpetual defense.

text: Tua sancta sumentes Domine suppliciter deprecamur ut cuius celebramus sollemnitatem sentiamus protectionem.
translation_en: We humbly beseech your holy self, Lord, that as we celebrate your solemnity, we may feel your protection.

text: Tua sancta sumentes quaesumus Domine ut beati Magni nos foveant continuata praesidia.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, that the holy ones may take us under their protection, and the continued presence of St. Magnus may warm us.

text: Tua sancta sumentes suppliciter te Domine deprecamur ut qui beati Leufredi confessoris tui atque abbatis festivitatem nostris quamvis indignis veneramur obsequiis ipso pro nobis iugiter orante praesidia sentiamus.
translation_en: We humbly take up your holy offerings, Lord, and we beseech you that, although unworthy, we may honor the feast of your confessor and abbot, Blessed Leufred, by constant prayers. May we always feel his protective presence.

text: Tua sunt Domine alimonia quibus in cottidiano victu ad sustentationem reficimur tuaque ieiunia quibus carnem a lubrica voluptate te praecipiente restringimus; tu ad consolationem nostram vicissitudines temporum disposuisti ut tempus edendi corpora nostra refectione sobria aleret et ieiunandi tempus ea in iustitiam tibi placitam faceret macerata; hanc hostiam ob ieiunium triduanae macerationis a nobis oblatam sanctificans dignanter assume et praesta placatus ut sospita delectatione corporea mens ab iniquitatibus pariter conquiescat.
translation_en: Lord, it is yours who feed us with the sustenance by which we are daily nourished, and your fasts by which we restrain our flesh from indulgent pleasures; you have arranged the alternations of time so that the time for eating strengthens our bodies in sober refreshment and the time for fasting makes an offering to you acceptable in justice, made lean. Sanctify this offering, which we bring as a result of our three-day fast, and grant that, being pleased, you may make us both spiritually and physically restful.

text: Tuae crucis sanctitas nos Domine quaesumus in inventione illius a peccatis absolvat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the holiness of your cross may absolve us from sins on the discovery of it.

text: Tuae sanctificationis arcae Mariae Domine Deus quae te novem mensibus in utero baiulavit fac nos debita veneratione festa peragere in qua ipse dignatus es clausum prophetam in utero Elizabeth visitare.
translation_en: Lord God, we ask that your sanctuary of Mary be made worthy to celebrate the festival with fitting devotion, as you did choose to visit Elizabeth while she was pregnant in her womb, closing the prophet.

text: Tuam Domine deprecor clementiam ut per haec mysteria ine famulum tuum interventu sanctae Dei Genitricis Mariae ab omnium peccatorum labe propitius emundes atque a cunctis adversitatibus protegas et aeternae felicitatis consortem efficias; famulos etiam et famulas tuas quorum et quarum nomina tibi vivunt pro quibus tuam misericordiam exoro precibus omnium sanctorum tuorum a cunctis iniquitatibus exuant et ad sempiterna promissa perducant.
translation_en: I beseech Your mercy, Lord, that through these mysteries You may cleanse Your servant from all pollutions of sin through the intervention of the Holy Mother of God, Mary, and protect him from all adversities. May You also make him a companion of eternal happiness. I also pray for Your servants, men and women, whose names live in You; I implore Your mercy on their behalf with prayers of all Your saints. May they be freed from all wickednesses and led to the eternal promises.

text: Tuam Domine in hac martyris tui Genesii sollemnitate gloriam praedicamus quem et fidei indicem et consummatorem victoriae idem martyr promeruit invenire. Qui prius fidei voto quam regenerationis praedictus sacramento te unum et verum culturis daemonum dando repudium adsecutus est Deum.  Adclines te igitur precibus imploramus ut haec inspirata a te nostrorum omnium vota subsequatur misericordia tua faciasque ut quos praevenisti credulitate aeterna remuneres ex mercede; huius martyris suffragio praeveniens defunctos ad requiem cuius cor praeventum est prius fide quam baptismatis tinctione.
translation_en:
We proclaim your glory, Lord, in the solemnity of your martyr Genesius, who proved to be both an example of faith and the consummator of victory as a martyr. He had earlier, before being promised the sacrament of regeneration, rejected the cults of demons by choosing you, the one and true God.
We humbly beseech you with our prayers that your mercy may follow the vows inspired in us by you. May you reward those who have preceded faith over eternal life through this martyr's merit; may they, having overcome death before belief rather than baptismal anointing, find peace through his intercession.

text: Tuam Domine quidem pacem assiduis praeconiis immolamus quia tu es pax vera qui pacificas universa et tua pace commemorantia omnia perseverant in opera bona.
translation_en: Lord, indeed we offer peace to you continually with our proclaiming, for you are true peace who pacifies all things and everything recalling your peace endures in good works.

text: Tuam proni Domine immensam quaesumus maiestatem quem unum et verum Deum praedictus martyr scientia pollens studio colens virtute flagrans passione triumphans commissae sibi catervae et verbo praedicavit et sanguine.  Tribue nobis quod illi tribuisti et virtutibus salubriter erigi et adversitatibus non noceri quo huius martyris beneficio fidelium favens votis requiem iubeas praestare defunctis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, for your immense majesty, that the blessed martyr, who with knowledge and study, power and passion, triumphs, and who commissions a group to himself and proclaims with word and blood, may grant us what he received and let virtues strengthen us in health and not harm us through adversities, so that by the favor of this martyr's benefaction, you would command rest to be granted to the departed faithful.

text: Tueatur Domine dextera tua populum deprecantem purificet sustentet ut consolatione praesenti ad bona futura pro iciat.
translation_en: May the Lord protect his righteous people who are praying, purify and sustain them, so that with the presence of consolation they may advance towards good things in the future.

text: Tueatur quaesumus Domine dextera tua populum deprecantem et purificatum dignanter erudiat ut consolatione praesenti ad futura bona proficiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may your right hand protect the people who are praying and worthy of education, that with the presence of consolation, they may progress towards future good.

text: Tuere clementissime Domine precibus beati apostoli tui Bartholomaei oves tuo sanguine redemptas ab omnibus malis ut eius festivitatem celebrantes a cunctis periculis eruamur.
translation_en: Most kindly Lord, protect through the prayers of your blessed apostle Bartholomew the sheep redeemed by your blood, that we, celebrating his feast day, may be freed from all dangers.

text: Tuere Domine famulos tuos omnesque cum eis in te sperantes quae sumpsimus sacramenta custodiant et contra omnes adversitatum tueantur incursus.
translation_en: Lord, protect your servants and all who hope in you, who have received the sacraments. May they be kept safe and protected against all adversities and attacks.

text: Tuere Domine plebem tuam et beatorum apostolorum defende subsidiis; tui famuli famulaeque sunt Domine tibique subiecti; benedictiones tuas iugiter assequantur quas suppliciter et indesinenter exspectant.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and defend them with the help of the blessed apostles; your servants and handmaids are Lord, and to you they are subjected; may your blessings always follow those which they fervently and unceasingly wait for.

text: Tuere Domine plebem tuam et sacram sollemnitatem recolentem caelestis gratiae largitate prosequere ut visibilibus adiuta solatiis ad invisibilia bona promptius incitetur.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and the sacred solemnity proceeding under the liberality of heavenly grace, that, aided by visible supports, it may be more quickly stirred to invisible goods.

text: Tuere Domine populum tuum et ab omnibus peccatis clementer emunda quia nulla ei nocebit adversitas si nulla dominetur iniquitas.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and mercifully cleanse them from all sins, for no adversity shall harm them if iniquity does not rule over them.

text: Tuere Domine populum tuum et salutaribus praesidiis semper adiutum beneficiis attolle continuis et mentis et corporis.
translation_en: Lord, protect your people and always support them with continual blessings, both of mind and body.

text: Tuere Domine quaesumus famulos tuos et a terrenis erroribus expeditos ad virtutum tuarum fac instituta proficere sicque temporalibus auxiliis foveantur ut magis gaudeant sempiternis.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you protect your servants from earthly errors and guide them towards your virtues. May they progress in the ways you have established. And may they be nurtured by temporal aids so that they rejoice more in eternal things.

text: Tuere Domine quaesumus famulos tuos ut a peccatis omnibus abstinentes prompta tibi voluntate famulemur.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you protect your servants, that as they refrain from all sins, they may serve you willingly and promptly.

text: Tuere Domine quaesumus populum tuum et mysterii participatione renovatum et continua sanctorum martyrum tuorum Marcelli et Apulei supplicatione confisum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you protect your people and renew them through the participation in the mystery. And we are confident in the intercession of your holy martyrs, Marcellus and Apuleius.

text: Tuere Domine quaesumus populum tuum et mystica iugiter participatione renovatum et continua sanctorum confessorum supplicatione protectum.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you guard your people. Ever renewed through mystical participation, and continually protected by the continuous prayers of the saints and confessors.

text: Tuere Domine supplices tuos sustenta fragiles purga terrenos et inter mortalium tenebras mortales ambulantes tua semper luce vivifica atque a malis omnibus clementer ereptos ad summa bona pervenire concede.
translation_en: Lord, sustain your supplicants and uphold the weak. Purge our earthly bodies and, amidst the mortal shadows of all men walking, make us live always by your light. Graciously release us from all evils and grant that we may reach the highest good.

text: Tuere familiam tuam quaesumus Domine paschali mysterio gloriantem ut cuius salutarem fidei veneratur originem iugiter instituta custodiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, to guard Your family through the mystery of Paschal, so that it may always keep the origin of its sacred faith and continually maintain what is begun.

text: Tuere me Domine deprecor tua sancta sumentem et per hoc salutare mysterium ab omnibus absolve peccatis et a cunctis defende periculis.
translation_en: Lord, I humbly beseech You; may Your holy ones take me under their protection. And through this saving mystery, absolve me from all sins and defend me from all dangers.

text: Tuere nos Domine divinis propitius sacramentis et ut his congrue famulemur eorum praesta potenter effectum.
translation_en: Keep us, Lord, with Your divine sacraments and grant that we may faithfully serve them. Powerfully make it so.

text: Tuere nos Domine precibus sancti Laurentii martyris tui ut gratia tua semper mereamur augeri qui talium praesidiis confidimus patronorum.
translation_en: Guard us, Lord, with the prayers of your saintly martyr Laurence, that we may always merit an increase in your grace, whom we trust as patrons under such protection.

text: Tuere nos Domine quaesumus tua sancta sumentes et ab omni propitius iniquitate defende.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord, we beseech You, and may Your saints take us under their care. Be propitious and defend us from every wickedness.

text: Tuere nos Domine quaesumus tua sancta sumentes et ab omnibus propitius absolve peccatis.
translation_en: Protect us, Lord, we pray, may your holy ones take care of us and be merciful to forgive our sins.

text: Tuere nos Domine quaesumus tua sancta sumentes et meritis sanctorum tuorum illorum ab omnibus absolve peccatis et a cunctis defende periculis.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, that Your holy ones may watch over us; through the merits of Your saints, deliver them from all sins and protect them from all dangers.

text: Tuere nos Domine quaesumus tua sancta sumentes et terram quam vidimus nostris iniquitatibus trementem superno munere firma ut mortalium corda cognoscant a te indignante talia flagella prodire et te miserante cessare.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you, may your holy ones protect us. Let the earth that we see trembling due to our iniquities be strengthened by heavenly aid so that the hearts of mortals may recognize that such scourges come from you in anger, and may cease through your mercy.

text: Tuere nos misericors Deus et beati Andreae apostoli tui cuius natalicia praevenimus semper guberna praesidiis.
translation_en: Guard us, merciful God, and may the blessed Apostle Andrew, whose feast we anticipate, always guide and protect us with his guardianship.

text: Tuere propitius Domine quaesumus familiam tuam et quam benigna defensione non deseris propensius tibi redde subiectam ut gratiam tuam quam sumit indebita copiosius devota percipiat.
translation_en: Lord, have mercy upon us, we beseech You. Protect Your family and, with Your benevolent defense, do not abandon it, but rather return the subjugated to You more lovingly, so that it may receive Your grace more abundantly, which it unworthily takes, in a more devoted manner.

text: Tuere quaesumus Domine familiam tuam et sacris semper attolle praesidiis sanctique martyris tui ac regis Edwardi interventione quem moderna tempestate humanae notitiae intimare voluisti a peccatorum omnium periculis expeditam aeternae felicitatis redde consortem.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, to protect your family and always uphold it with sacred safeguards and the intercession of your holy martyr and King Edward, whom you wished to be known by human knowledge in modern times. Deliver her from all perils of sins and grant her eternal happiness.

text: Tuere quaesumus Domine familiam tuam et spiritalibus instrue disciplinis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to protect your family and instruct them with spiritual disciplines.

text: Tuere quaesumus Domine familiam tuam ut salutis aeternae remedia quae te adspirante requirimus te largiente consequamur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, to protect your family, so that we may obtain the remedies for eternal salvation which we seek with your guidance.

text: Tui Domine perceptione sacramenti et a nostris mundemur occultis et ab hostium liberemur insidiis.
translation_en: Lord, may we be purified by the perception of your Sacrament and be cleansed from our secret faults, and be freed from the snares of our enemies.

text: Tui nobis Domine communio sacramenti et purificationem conferat et tribuat unitatem.
translation_en: Lord, may Your communication of the sacrament and purification grant us, and may it bestow unity upon us.

text: Tui nos Domine sacramenti libatio sancta restauret et a vetustate purgatos in mysterii salutaris faciat transire consortium.
translation_en: May the holy libation of Your sacrament, Lord, restore us and make those purified from oldness pass over into the fellowship of the saving mystery.

text: Tui sunt Domine populi qui ministerium nostrae vocis exspectant; quaesumus clementiam tuam ut salutaria eius poscentibus quidquid fiducia non habet deprecantis gratia tua quae bonorum nostrorum non indiget largiatur.
translation_en: Lord, yours are the people who await our ministry's call; we ask for your clemency so that they may seek whatever grace has no faith in asking, which does not lack your generosity to bestow upon our good works.

text: Tuis Christe credentes sermonibus paraclitum spiritum sustinemus et ideo hanc tibi oblationem cum ieiunii litatione deferimus. Emitte illum quaesumus de sanctis caelis tuis qui vota populi tui acceptet abstinentium corda sanctificet invalidis valitudinem ac defunctis requiem donet quo per eum distributa nobis dona adveniant cuius signo praesignati sumus ad vitam.
translation_en: Through Christ we sustain the Paraclete Spirit in your sermons, and therefore we bring to you this offering with the reading of fasting. We beseech you to send him from your holy heavens, who accepts the vows of your people, sanctifies the hearts of the abstinent, heals the infirm, grants rest to the deceased, so that through him, as those marked by his sign, we may receive the gifts promised to us for life.

text: Tuis Domine quaesumus operare mysteriis ut haec tibi munera dignis mentibus offeramus.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you work through your mysteries, so that we may present these gifts to you with worthy minds.

text: Tuis quaesumus Domine adesto supplicibus et inter mundanae pravitatis insidias fragilitatem nostram sempiterna pietate prosequere.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, be present to the suppliant and, amidst the snares of worldly wickedness, guide us with your eternal pity.

text: Tuo Deus omnipotens speciali admonemur praecepto ut diligamus invicem nec ulla discindamur ab alterutro discordiae simultate. Proinde rogamus piissimam clementiam tuam ut et ieiunium nostrum coram te pace tua sit utile et pax ipsa in nobis habitans sanctorum condiatur operum ubertate.
translation_en: Our Almighty God, we are especially reminded by Your commandment to love one another and let no discord separate us. Therefore, we humbly ask for Your most merciful kindness that our fasting may be beneficial before You, and that peace itself dwells among us, flourishing with the fruitfulness of the saints.

text: Tuorum corda fidelium Deus miserator illustra et beatae Elisabeth precibus gloriosis fac nos prospera mundi despicere et caelesti semper consolatione gaudere.
translation_en: God, merciful One, enlighten the hearts of your faithful and through the prayers of blessed Elizabeth make us look down on the world with prosperity and always rejoice in heavenly consolation.

text: Tuorum militum rex omnipotens virtutem corrobora ut quos in huius mortalitatis stadio unigeniti Filii tui corona laetificat consummato cursu certaminis immortalitatis bravium apprehendant.
translation_en: O almighty King of your soldiers, strengthen their power so that those who in this mortal life are crowned by the only-begotten Son of yours, may receive the prize after completing the course of the immortality contest.

text: Tuorum nos Domine largitate donorum et temporalibus attolle praesidiis et renova sempiternis.
translation_en: Lord, support us by your bounty with gifts and temporal protection, and renew us with eternal blessings.

text: Tuorum nos Domine quaesumus precibus tuere sanctorum ut festa martyrum tuorum Valentini Vitalis Feliculae et Zenonis sine cessatione venerantes et fideli muniamur auxilio et magnifico proficiamus exemplo.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to protect us with the prayers of your saints, so that we may be fortified with unceasing veneration and faithful aid on the festivals of your martyrs Valentinus, Vitalis, Felicitas, and Zenon. May we progress magnificently by their excellent example.

text: Tuus sanctus martyr Georgius quaesumus Domine nos ubique laetificet ut dum eius merita in praesenti festivitate recolimus patrocinia in augmento virtutum sentiamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, may Your holy martyr George everywhere rejoice us, so that as we remember his merits during this present feast, we may feel an increase of his patronage and virtues.

text: Unde nos Domine beatam Filii tui passionem necnon ab inferis resurrectionem et in caelum venerabilem adscensionem sumus igitur memores et semper erimus nec ulla de tuis laudibus saecula conticescent et nos laudabimus cuncti quos spiritu sancto complecteris; exposito enim in sacro fonte corporis rudes; ad te venimus tuis aquis geniti et tuo lacte nutriti; tuis vocibus concinimus et te tuo opere collaudemus.
translation_en: Since we, Lord, are mindful of the blessed passion of your Son, as well as his resurrection from the dead and his ascent to heaven, we will always remember and forever remain. Nor shall any age extinguish your praises, but we will praise you all who have been touched by the Holy Spirit; for we come to you born of your waters and nourished by your milk; we sing with your voice and laud you with the work of your hands.

text: Unde nos Domine et tua pietate confisi et tua laude devoti hanc hostiam immaculatam et singularis sacrificii tibi deferimus ut servis tuis nobis viventibus peccatorum nostrorum veniam concedas et defunctis fratribus nostris requiem sempiternam tribuas.
translation_en: From you, Lord, we are confident in your mercy and devoted to your praise; this unblemished offering and singular sacrifice we bring to you. Grant forgiveness for our sins to us living servants and eternal rest to our deceased brethren.

text: Unianimes atque concordes dominum Deum nostrum fratres carissimi deprecemur ut ieiunium nostrum sit remissio peccatorum et dono gratiae suae castigationes corporum profectus mentium consequantur.
translation_en: We humbly beseech our dear brothers, united and in harmony, that our fasting may be the forgiveness of sins and the progress of purification of bodies followed by the enlightening of minds.

text: Unigenite Dei Filius ex cuius latere duo illa mirifica sacramenta sanguis scilicet et aqua fluxerunt quae huic Genesio martyri tuo ad susceptionem regenerationis collata sunt cum non solum Rhodani undis abluitur sed etiam sanguinis sui effusione novatur precibus ut adsis quaesumus supplicantium; da regeneratis nobis vitam sine crimine ducere scandalis carere innovari tuae dulcedinis ubertate quo baptismum quod in peccatorum ablutionem suscepimus in pace qua tu es inviolabiliter conservemus.
translation_en: The only-begotten Son of God, from whose side those two wonderful sacraments, namely blood and water, flowed out. These were bestowed upon this Genuisius the martyr at his reception of regeneration; not only was he purified by the waves of the Rhone, but also by the shedding of his own blood he was renewed through prayers that you might be present, we humbly beseech. Grant to us, the regenerated, to live without sin and free from scandal, to be enriched with the abundance of your sweetness; so that we may conserve the baptism which we received as a cleansing of sins in peace, inviolably.

text: Unigenite Dei Filius quem beatissimus Ioannes salutavit in utero demonstravit in eremo praecessit nascendo praeiit moriendo concede nobis tanti vatis suffragio ut in hoc die quo idem capite desectus occubuit nos te miserante capite nostro semel pro nobis mortuo a vitiis mereamur occidi et spiritalis dono gratiae innovari.  Hic tibi sanctus vir obsequentis vota deferat plebis qui praeco factus est iudicis. Prece sua nostris lumen ingerat tenebris qui lucerna exstitit luminis voxque illa pro defunctorum spiritibus se rogatura opponat quae domino mortuis praeparavit in cordibus viam.
translation_en:
We beseech the only-begotten Son of God, whom blessed John saluted in the womb, showed in the desert, led before in life, preceded at death, grant us the intercession of such a great prophet that on this day, when he himself was beheaded and lay dying, we, through your mercy, may merit to die to our vices once, and be renewed with spiritual grace.
Here let a holy man bring before you the wishes of the people, who was made a herald and judge. May his prayers shed light into our darkness, who was a lamp in the world of light, and let that voice for the spirits of the dead intercede which prepared a way to the Lord in the hearts of the deceased.

text: Unigenite Dei Filius qui beatissimam famulam tuam illam gemina muneris claritate vestisti ut et virginitatis enitesceret merito et martyriali attolleretur triumpho praebe eam suffragatricem esse mortalibus cunctis quae merito sui laetatur in caelis quo per eam et vivis et defunctis commoda tribuas per quam nobis exempla castitatis insinuas.
translation_en: The only-begotten Son of God, who clothed your most blessed handmaid with double splendor so that she might merit to blossom in virginity and be exalted by a martyr's triumph. Grant her to be an advocate for all mortals who rejoice in her in heaven. Through her, bestow upon us both the living and the dead all good things, and through her inspire in us examples of chastity.

text: Unigenite Deus noster qui pro beatissimi militis tui Felicis fide remuneraturus adspiciens non eum solo deseris non etiam pelago cum divinitatis tuae auxilio utribique munitus et in terra consistens adversarium conterit verbis et mari aggrediens fluidas suis submittit undas vestigiis quaesumus ut huius martyris mollitus suffragio vitam nostram eluens ceno eruas a profundo conferendo sanctificationem oblatis et perpetuam benedictionem sumpturis quo te Dominum nostrum et corde et labiis perenniter confiteamur mundissimis quem idem martyr angelis immixtus collaudavit vocibus suis.
translation_en: O Unigenite, our God, who rewards the blessed soldier, Your servant Felicis, for his faith as You look upon him, not abandoning him in solitude nor at sea with the help of Your divinity armed on both sides, and standing firm on earth crushes the adversary with words and advancing over the sea subdues the waves with His steps. We humbly ask that, softened by the intercession of this martyr, You wash our life clean from the depths, bestowing sanctification with the offerings and conferring an eternal blessing upon us. So that we may always confess our Lord with the purest heart and lips, who Himself, the same martyr, praised with His voice together with angels.

text: Unigenite Filius Dei qui melius contritione cordis quam munerum oblatione placaris preces nostras respice effusas pro viventibus ac defunctis ut in hoc die quo praedicti martyres pro te vibrantis gladii mucrone desecti sunt utrobique a te congrua remedia nobis flagitantibus largiantur.
translation_en: Unique Son of God, who is more pleased by the contrition of heart than by the offerings of gifts, look upon our prayers poured out for the living and the dead. On this day when those martyrs, vibrating swords in your name, were beheaded, may appropriate remedies be granted to us who ask, on both sides.

text: Unigenite Filius Dei qui pro nobis voluntarie sanguinem effudisti quo terrestria cum caelestibus pacificasti facito nos ita redemptionis nostrae ac resurrectionis tuae venerari mysterium ut in pace qua tu es perenniter vivere mereamur.
translation_en: Only-begotten Son of God, who willingly shed your blood for us to pacify earthly and heavenly things, make us worthy to reverence the mystery of our redemption and resurrection through you. May we merit to live eternally in the peace where you are.

text: Unigenite genitoris ingeniti Christe Iesu redemptor noster et Domine qui sancto spiritu conceptus et virginali partu editus mundum illuminaturus olim apparuisti ut potestas diabolica ad nihilum reducta periret cum lux fidei tuae omnibus in te credentibus aperte claresceret te enim illustrante tuorum refulsit tunc unitas discipulorum qui solaminis tui verbo et passionis atque humilitatis exemplo solidati adversantium iniuriis in nullo exterriti fidem tuam ubique praedicaverunt intrepidi.  Horum igitur exemplo secutus est hic alumnus tuus Hieronymus cuius hodie festum devotissime excolimus qui haereticorum finctiones maculosas fortiter perculit iaculo veritatis et evangelicae framea dictionis facile trucidavit dogma falsitatis. Huius ergo Domine intercessio precamur nobis indignis apud te obtineat indulgentiam omnium peccatorum et mansionum frui concedat in regione vivorum.
translation_en:
Unique begotten of the unbegotten Father, Christ Jesus our Redeemer and Lord, who were conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of the Virgin, you appeared once to illuminate the world. The power of the devil was reduced to nothing and perished when your light of faith shone forth to all who believed in you. For it is in your shining that the unity of your disciples was strengthened, who, by your word and the example of your passion and humility, were not afraid to preach your faith everywhere without fear.
Following their example, this student of yours Jerome, whose feast we are devoutly celebrating today, bravely struck down the stained arguments of heretics with the spear of truth and easily destroyed the dogma of falsehood with evangelical words. Therefore, Lord, we pray that his intercession obtains for us undeserving ones forgiveness of all sins and grants us to dwell in the region of the living.

text: Unigeniti tui Domine nobis succurrat humanitas ut qui natus de virgine matris integritatem non minuit sed sacravit in nativitatis eius sollemniis a nostris nos piaculis exuens oblationem nostram sibi faciat acceptam.
translation_en: Lord, may the humanity of your only-begotten one assist us, so that he who was born of the virgin mother maintains his integrity and sanctifies it in the solemnities of his nativity. May he, removing our sins from us, offer our sacrifice to himself as acceptable.

text: Universitatis conditor et humani generis reformator omnipotens Deus annue quaesumus precibus nostris ut qui miramur in doctore quod colimus mereamur in munere quo placeamus et sicut beato Hilario confessori tuo atque pontifici dedisti memoriam gloriosam da Ecclesiae tuae concordiam eo obtinente ut sacrificium nostrum eius meritis tibi efficiatur acceptum.
translation_en: Almighty God, the founder of the university and reformer of the human race, we humbly ask that you favor our prayers. May those who marvel at the teacher whom we revere, deserve the office in which we please him, and may you grant to your church the harmony that the blessed Hilarion, your confessor and pope, enjoyed, so that our sacrifice may be accepted through his merits.

text: Universorum ipse dominator qui conditor creaturae tuae praestanter amabilis et amator cui Martha satagit Maria pedes abluit cum quo Lazarus redivivus accumbit (tota nempe domus est in amore) annue plebi tuae ita se exercitare per dilectionem ut in te possit unita manere per pacem; ministra in nobis illas lacrimas quas Maria de multa dilectione protulit; fragrare orationem nostram facito sicut unguentum pisticum sacris plantis infusum Mariae fragravit ut eam pacem consequamur per oscula nostra in alterutrum porrecta quam consecuta est Maria sui osculans redemptoris vestigia.
translation_en: You, the ruler of all, who magnificently and lovingly created your creation, where Martha seeks to wash Mary's feet, with whom Lazarus rose again (indeed, the whole house is in love), may your people learn to exercise themselves through love so that they can remain united in peace within you; let those tears which Mary poured out from great love serve as ministers among us; fragrance our prayer as Mary scented it with precious ointment infused into sacred plants, so that we may follow peace through kisses exchanged between us, just as Mary followed the footsteps of her Redeemer.

text: Ure igne Sancti Spiritus renes nostros et cor nostrum Domine ut tibi caste et corde serviamus et corpore placeamus.
translation_en: Kindle in us, O Holy Spirit, and renew our hearts, that we may serve you faithfully with a pure heart, and please you with our body.

text: Ut ab omni nos Domine contagione delicti clementer expurges sanctorum tuorum quatuor Coronatorum deprecatio oblationem nostram tibi reddat acceptam.
translation_en: May the Lord, in His merciful cleansing, purge us from all contagion of sin, through the intercession and offering of our prayer to His four Holy Coronators. May our offering be received by Him as acceptable.

text: Ut accepta nos Domine sancta vivificent sanctorum martyrum tuorum Laurentii Petri et Andreae merita gloriosa nos adiuvent.
translation_en: May the merits of your holy martyrs, Laurence, Peter, and Andrew, accepted by you Lord, help us gloriously.

text: Ut accepta sint Domine nostra ieiunia praesta nos quaesumus huius munere sacramenti purificatum tibi pectus offerre.
translation_en: Lord, may our fasting be accepted by You. We humbly ask that You grant us, with this sacrament, a purified heart to offer unto You.

text: Ut accepta tibi sint Domine nostra ieiunia praesta nobis quaesumus huius munere sacramenti purificatum tibi pectus offerre.
translation_en: Grant, we ask You, Lord, that our fasting be acceptable to You. May this gift of the sacred mystery cleanse our hearts and offer them to You.

text: Ut ad salutaris hodiernae generationis exordium pertinere mereamur apostolicis tribue nos Domine quaesumus precibus adiuvari.
translation_en: May we merit to belong to the beginning of today's salvific generation, Lord, we ask that you help us with your apostolic prayers.

text: Ut cunctis nos Domine foveas adiumentis tuis apta propitius disciplinis.
translation_en: Lord, may you warm us to all, and help us with your suitable discipline, graciously.

text: Ut grata tibi sit quaesumus Domine nostrae servitutis oblatio beatus levita et martyr tuus Laurentius natalicio suo obtineat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that our offering of service may be pleasing to you, as blessed deacon and martyr your servant Lawrence celebrates his birthday.

text: Ut haec communio nos Domine tua visitatione dignos efficiat beati Saturnini martyris tui pia quaesumus intercessio semper imploret.
translation_en: May this communion, Lord, make us worthy through Your divine visitation. We humbly ask that the blessed Martyr Saturninus' pious intercession may always be invoked on our behalf.

text: Ut haec munera Domine tibi accepta sint sanctae Batildis obtineant merita quae seipsam tibi hostiam vivam sanctam et beneplacentem exhibuit.
translation_en: May these gifts, Lord, offered to you by Saint Bathildis, be pleasing to you. May she obtain the rewards who herself offered to you a living, holy, and acceptable sacrifice.

text: Ut haec nos communio Domine tibi dignos efficiat beatus pater noster Ethelwoldus suffragio quaesumus piae intercessionis obtineat.
translation_en: May this Communion, Lord, make us worthy before you; we humbly ask that the blessed Father Ethelwold's intercession be obtained through the prayers.

text: Ut haec communio nos Domine tibi dignos efficiat beatus Cuthbertus confessor tuus et pontifex cuius translationis diem veneramur suffragio quaesumus piae intercessionis obtineat.
translation_en: May this communion, Lord, make us worthy before you; blessed Cuthbert, your confessor and bishop, whose feast day we honor, we humbly ask that the prayers of his holy intercession may be obtained for us.

text: Ut haec oblatio accepta tibi sit Domine quam in honore summorum pontificum tuorum Remigii atque Germani devovimus tibi eorum precibus beneplacitam esse concedas.
translation_en: May this offering, Lord, which we have dedicated to you in honor of your distinguished bishops Remigius and Germain, be pleasing to you. Grant that it may be so.

text: Ut nobis Domine haec dona salutaria semper exsistam eorum merita quorum pro tuo nomine sanguis effusus est obtineant.
translation_en: May, Lord, these saving gifts always be with us through the merits of those whose blood was shed for your name.

text: Ut nobis Domine terrenarum frugum tribuas ubertatem fac mentes nostras caelesti fertilitate fecundas.
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the abundance of earthly fruits. May your heavenly fertility make our minds fruitful.

text: Ut nobis Domine tua sacrificia dent salutem beatus confessor tuus Augustinus et pontifex quaesumus precator accedat.
translation_en: Lord, may your sacrifices give us salvation, bless your confessed one Augustine and the bishop we ask. May the supplicant approach.

text: Ut nobis Domine tua sacrificia dent salutem beatus confessor tuus ille quaesumus precator accedat.
translation_en: May, Lord, your sacrifices grant us salvation; we humbly ask that your blessed confessed one approaches as our intercessor.

text: Ut nobis Domine veri corporis et sanguinis Filii tui sit fructuosa perceptio beatae Barbarae martyris tuae nos tibi iugiter commendet oratio.
translation_en: May the blessed perception of the true body and blood of your Son, Lord, be fruitful for us. May the prayers of your martyr Barbara continually recommend us to you.

text: Ut nobis salutem conferant sacramenta quae sumpsimus beatissimus rex Edwardus confessor tuus Domine pro nobis intercessor exsistat de cuius veneranda translatione tribuis nos annua devotione laetari.
translation_en: May the most blessed King Edward, your confessor, Lord, stand for us as an intercessor, since we rejoice annually in the venerable translation of him whose salvation the sacraments we have received confer upon us.

text: Ut nobis tua Domine remedia dent salutem beatus Hippolytus martyr quaesumus pro nobis supplicans copiosius audiatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the blessed martyr Hippolytus may provide us with remedies for our salvation. May his prayers be heard more abundantly on our behalf.

text: Ut nos Domine tribuis sollemne tibi deferre ieiunium sic nobis quaesumus indulgentiae praesta subsidium.
translation_en: Lord, as you grant us solemn offerings of fasting to You, we humbly ask that You bestow upon us the aid of forgiveness.

text: Ut nostrae saluti munera oblata proficiant sancti Marcelli martyris tui atque pontificis Domine quaesumus obtineat intercessio salutaris.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that the gifts offered for our salvation may profit through the intercession of your martyr and bishop Saint Marcellus. May his saving intercession be obtained.

text: Ut percepta nos Domine sancta vivificent sanctorum martyrum tuorum Marci et Marcelliani merita gloriosa nos adiuvent.
translation_en: May the holy merits of your martyrs, Marc and Marcellian, perceived by us, Lord, vivify us and aid us.

text: Ut percepta nos Domine tua sancta purificent beati Proti et Hyacinthi quaesumus imploret oratio.
translation_en: We ask, Lord, that your holy purifications cleanse us, as they did the blessed Protus and Hyacinthus. May their prayer intercede for us.

text: Ut sacrificia nostra Domine propitiatus intendas sancti Laurentii nos martyris tui commendet oratio.
translation_en: May our sacrifices, Lord, find favor; you pray for us through Saint Lawrence your martyr.

text: Ut sacris Domine misericordia tua largiente dignus merear reddi muneribus fac me quaesumus tuis oboedire mandatis.
translation_en: May I, through Your merciful gifts, Lord, be deemed worthy to return the offerings. Grant that I may obey Your commands, we ask You.

text: Ut sacris Domine reddamur digni muneribus fac nos tuis quaesumus oboedire mandatis.
translation_en: May we, Lord, be worthy of sacred duties; grant us that we may obey your commandments.

text: Ut salutem mentis et corporis nobis Domine tribuant sacramenta beatissimus martyr tuus Christophorus cuius sollemnia agimus incessanter precator exsistat.
translation_en: May your blessed martyr Christopher grant us the sacraments for both body and mind, O Lord. Let the continual prayer of the supplicant exist.

text: Ut tibi grata sint Domine munera devotionis hodiernae quaesumus beati Stephani martyris tui intercessio gloriosa perficiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that the gifts of today's devotion may be pleasing to You. We pray that the glorious intercession of Your blessed martyr St. Stephen may complete this request.

text: Ut tibi grata sint Domine munera populi tui ab omni quaesumus eum contagione perversitatis emunda nec falsis gaudiis inhaerere patiaris quos ad veritatis tuae praemia venire promittis.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, that the gifts of your people may be pleasing to you from every contagion of perversity, let them not cling to false joys. May those whom you promise will come to the rewards of truth not endure.

text: Ut tibi grata sint Domine munera populi tui supplicantis ab omni quaesumus eum contagione perversitatis emunda.
translation_en: That the gifts, Lord, may be pleasing to You, Your people humbly ask for it from all; we beseech You to cleanse them with any contamination of perversity.

text: Ut tua nos Domine sacramenta purgem a crimine sanctam maiestatem tuam quaesumus beatus martyr Albanus semper imploret.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord, that Your sacred mysteries purge us from sin, and that Your blessed martyr Albanus may always pray for us to Your holy majesty.

text: Ut tuis Domine mysteriis digni reddamur illa quaesumus veritas nos illuminet semper et foveat quae in beati Laurentii martyris tui corde flammam suae confessionis accendit.
translation_en: May we, Lord, be worthy of your mysteries, which we humbly ask. Truth, may it always enlighten and nourish us, as the flame of Blessed Laurence's martyr's confessional spirit was kindled in his heart.

text: Ut tuis Domine possimus inhaerere servitiis tu nos quaesumus ab omni pravitate defende.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you protect us from all wickedness so that we may cling to your service.

text: Ut tuis Domine semper possimus inhaerere servitiis intercedentibus sanctis martyribus illo et illo ab omni nos quaesumus adversitate defende.
translation_en: Lord, may we always be able to cling to your service through the intercession of those holy martyrs. We humbly ask you to protect us from all adversity on their account.

text: Utique pontificum pontifex et sacerdotum sacerdos Christe Iesu procul dubio tenemus quod ob totius mundi salutem paulo minoratus ab angelis ac mediator Dei factus et hominis patri in terris hostiam mundam te obtulisses pro nobis et post resurgens a mortuis sedem repedaberis patris ex qua te horrificum venire metuimus iudicem pro meritis.  Unde quia non frustra te fatemur nobis commendasse tui corporis memoriam et sanguinis ideo freti tantae pietatis promisso quod qui ex eo gustaverit mortem non videat in aeternum tui cultoris ob meritum hoc sacrificium quod pro recuperatione omnium labentium et ecclesiae catholicae offertur statu tibi omnimode facias acceptum.  Descendat igitur Domine super hoc altare compar tuus natura ille consolator spiritus qui et oblatum in eo sanctificet et degustantium corda expiando inhabitet atque pro omnibus pro quibus offertur perenniter in sinu matris ecclesiae adunatos reservet.
translation_en:
Without a doubt, Christ Jesus, we hold as pontiffs and priests that you were slightly diminished by angels, made mediator of God and man, and offered yourself, the spotless Lamb of the world, for our salvation. After rising from the dead, you will take your seat at the Father's side, a judge whom we fearfully await on account of your merits.
Since we do not falsely claim that you have commended to us the memory of your body and blood, therefore, moved by such great devotion, we promise that whoever partakes of this will not see eternal death on account of this sacrifice which is offered for the recovery of all the falling away and for the Catholic Church.
May it then come down upon this altar, O Lord, your nature, the consoler and spirit who will sanctify what is offered in it and dwell within the hearts of those who partake of it, and may you continually keep united for all for whom it is offered within the bosom of the mother Church.

text: Vegetet nos Domine semper et innovet tuae mensae sacrata libatio quae fragilitatem nostram et inter mundi tempestates gubernet et protegat et in portum perpetuae salutis inducat.
translation_en: Sustain us, Lord, always and renew your sacred offering which guides and protects us amidst the world's tempests and leads us to the harbor of eternal salvation.

text: Vegetet nos Domine semper et innovet tuae mensae libatio quae fragilitatem nostram gubernet et protegat et in portum perpetuae salutis induent.
translation_en: Nourish us, Lord, always, and renew the offering of your table that may guide and protect our frailty and lead us to the harbor of eternal salvation.

text: Vel si indignus haec offero piissime pater tu pius es; facturam tuam non despicias nec ab inimicis meis ine tribulari permittas; scio enim me graviter deliquisse et praeceptis tuis minime oboedisse; humilis obsecro ut gratiam tuam mihi semper consolatricem adhibeas et misericordiam fautricem apponas; unde exposco pietatem tuam ut mea dimittas peccata quia plus est misericordia tua ad erigendum quam fallacia inimici ad decipiendum; miserere mei Domine secundum magnam misericordiam tuam et unde me erubesco tu indulgeas et ea quae egisse ine paenitet tu clementer ignoscas.
translation_en: Or if I, unworthy, offer these to you, most merciful Father, you who are merciful; do not despise your work nor allow me to be troubled by my enemies. I know that I have greatly sinned and disobeyed your commandments; humbly I beg that your grace may always comfort me and your mercy may aid me. Therefore, I plead for your pity, that you forgive my sins because your mercy is greater in uplifting than the deceit of my enemies. Have mercy on me, O Lord, according to your great mercy; and you who make me ashamed, forgive and graciously pardon what I have done that I regret; you who are merciful, indulge me.

text: Venerabilem diem beati confessoris tui Zenonis devotione sancta hodie celebrantes conservatorem omnium fratres carissimi fideliter deprecemur ut piis nostris precibus clemens et propitius adspiret sicut et illi misericordiam largitus est.
translation_en: Today, we solemnly celebrate the venerable day of your blessed confessor Zenonis with holy devotion. We earnestly beseech all our beloved brothers in Christ, as guardians, to look favorably upon us with clemency and kindness, just as he was generous with mercy towards him.

text: Venerabilem diem beati confessoris tui Zenonis devotione sancta hodie celebrantes te Domine conservatorem omnium fideliter deprecamur ut piis nostris precibus clemens et propitius adspires sicut et illi misericordiam largitus es.
translation_en: On this venerable day of your blessed confessor Zenon, we celebrate you, Lord, the guardian of all, with a holy devotion. We humbly entreat you to look upon us with mercy and kindness as you have done for him. Grant us favor in response to our pious prayers.

text: Venerabilem toto mundo de inventione sanctae crucis sacratissimum diem sollemniter celebrantes gratias agamus divinae potentiae quia tantae salutis vexillum quod iudaica nobis abscondebat malitia caelestis hodie revelavit clementia; nam etsi gens perfida Dominum nostrum in sepulcro retinere non potuit vel ipsa crucis indicia voluit sub fossa celare; quid enim illa mens perfida poterat excogitare de cruce quae iam sacrilegium commiserat in auctorem; itaque sicut in Christi resurrectione calliditas Iudaeorum damnata est ita est in crucis manifestatione virtutis confusa.
translation_en: Venerating the whole world, we solemnly celebrate the most sacred day of the discovery of the Holy Cross and offer our thanks to the divine power, for today the heavenly kindness has revealed the banner of such great salvation that was hidden from us by Jewish wickedness; although the unfaithful people could not keep our Lord in the tomb or hide the signs of the cross beneath a grave, yet what treacherous mind could have imagined anything about the cross which it had already committed sacrilege against its author. So just as the cunning of the Jews was condemned in Christ's resurrection, so is it confounded in the manifestation of the power on the cross.

text: Veneranda nobis Domine huius est diei festivitas in qua sancta Dei genitrix mortem subiit temporalem nec tamen mortis nexibus deprimi potuit quae Filium tuum Dominum nostrum de se genuit incarnatum.
translation_en: Today, dear Lord, we honor a festival day where the holy Mother of God suffered temporary death, yet she could not be overcome by the bonds of death, for she bore Your Son, our Lord, who was incarnate from her.

text: Venerandae cenae sacramentorum Domine participes effecti te imploramus ut sanctae Christinae virginis et martyris tuae interventu reatus noster multiplex consequatur veniam et fides coronam.
translation_en: Lord, as participants of the venerable sacrament of the meal, we humbly ask that through the intervention of your saintly servant Christina, virgin and martyr, our heavy burden of sin may be rewarded with forgiveness, and our faith may receive a crown.

text: Venerandam huius diei festivitatem beati pontificis tui Thomae sollemniter celebrantes supplices te Domine deprecamur ut eius precibus gloriosis suae consortes gloriae effici mereamur.
translation_en: On this day's festival of your blessed bishop Thomas, we solemnly celebrate with supplication, Lord. We humbly pray to you that, through his glorious prayers, we may be deemed worthy to become his partners in glory.

text: Veni ad liberandum nos Domine Deus virtutum et quidquid in conceptum desiderii nostri illud pestilens animal nocendi arte sollicitum commentis blandientibus innodavit proposito terrore sententiae sub imperio crucis et testimonio redemptionis absolve ut nos in hac diversitate bonorum omnium quae creasti ad speciem paradisi constitutos dulcia visui mala non capiant et interdictae rei gustum mens fraude corrupta consilii non requirat sicque rigorem suum virilis animus id est spiritus probabili virtute custodiat ut deceptum femineae fragilitatis hortatum id est carnis libidinem non sequatur.  Vocem tuam Domine qui peccat accipiat et nudum se coram tuis oculis expavescat atque in conscientiae suae agnitione confusus paenitentiae se velamine a facie tui terroris abscondat et ita arguentis increpatione perterritus et expavescat quod audivit et corrigat quod deliquit.
translation_en:
Come and save us, Lord God of virtues, and whatever in our conceived desire that wicked beast, stirred up by deceitful enticements to harm, has bound with a purpose full of terror, judgment under the power of the cross, and testified by redemption, free us so that we, arranged in this diversity of all good things that you have created for the likeness of paradise, do not partake of sweet sights of evil and our mind, corrupted by fraud, does not seek the taste of forbidden fruit. Let a strong masculine spirit, that is, a spirit with probable virtue, keep its rigor so that it does not follow the temptation incited by female weakness, that is, carnal desire.
Let him who has sinned receive your voice, and let him tremble before your eyes unclothed, and in recognition of his conscience confounded, let him hide himself with a penitential veil before your face of terror. Let him be terrified by your reproofs and rebuke, and let him tremble at what he has heard and correct what he has done wrong.

text: Veni ad nos sancte Spiritus nostrisque illabere cordibus. Consolare nos praesentia tua qui aegritudine conquerimur propria et quos inspicis labentes in te reddito fortiores. Crea in nobis ignem amoris tui quo nostri maculae aboleantur delicti. Sit in ore veritas in corde confessio in sacrificiis gratia in abstinentiis humilitas vera. Efficito ardentes quos ob adventum tuum inspicis ieiunantes quibusque deest virium fortitudo horum votis et nostro fave provocatus ieiunio ut te in nos respiciente qui ignis consumens es nostrorum prius vitiorum excoquatur rubigo et sic demum te veniente tribuatur gratiae plenitudo quo nunc nos praeveniendo emaculans a delictis glorificandos tibi assumas ipse eum veneris.
translation_en: Come to us, Holy Spirit, and make our hearts your abode. Console us in your presence, who are being overwhelmed by our own sorrow and whom you see bending towards You, making them stronger. Create in us a fire of Your love that may cleanse away our stains of sin. Let truth be on our lips, confession in our hearts, grace in our sacrifices, humility in our fasting. Strengthen those who are inspired by Your coming and are fasting, giving strength to those lacking vigor due to their vows and stirred up to fasting by our intercession. May You, consuming fire, look upon us first as You burn away our sins' rust so that we may be worthy of receiving the fullness of Your grace, which You will grant when You come. Now, coming beforehand, make us clean from sin, that we may glorify You, and may yourself come among us when You arrive.

text: Veni Domine noli tardare relaxa facinora plebi tuae conferens omnibus vitae praemium repromissae ut sicut incarnatione tua olim reparati sumus ita quoque te ad iudicium venientem placabilem sentiamus. His quoque te quaesumus sacrificiis nostris ita sanctificationem tuam infunde quo ex his sumpturi nullo decidamus in crimine sed sanctificati tuum Domine mereamur adventum impavidi sustinere.
translation_en: Come Lord, do not delay, loosen the deeds of your people, conferring to all the reward of life promised. Thus, as we were once healed by your incarnation, may we also feel you coming for judgment as pleasing. Furthermore, we humbly ask that you pour out your sanctification upon our sacrifices, so that we may not fall from them into sin, but rather deserve to boldly endure your advent as the sanctified ones, Lord.

text: Veni Domine relaxa facinora plebi tuae et haec oblata tibi pro ipsis facinoribus benedicenda assume libamina ut horum perceptione expiemur a crimine et tui adventus gloriam mereamur interriti praestolare.
translation_en: Come, Lord, loosen the sins of your people and accept these offerings in place of those sins to be blessed. Grant us absolution through this perception so that we may be freed from guilt, and may your coming merit our awe and fear.

text: Veni sancte Spiritus illabere his sacrificiis quae omnis tibi litat ecclesia in honorem martyris tui Pelagii sacratissimae passionis. Quique a te adiutus poenas superavit terrores vicit gladium non timuit propter quod tecum sine fine regnare meruit. Iste tuus est Domine famulus in agone praecipuus in vita cautus in doctrina strenuus in morte laudabilis in regno sublimis per quem te petimus habere propitium quo nos et de manu eruas diaboli et consortes efficias regni tui.  Nosti igitur Domine quantum nos hostis insidiatur antiquus et ideo nullum de nobis habeat quem lucretur quos una mater ecclesia per regenerationis undam ablutos esse gloriatur. Floreat in nobis gratia doni aeterni a quo haec munera sanctificentur et per quem sanctificata sumantur. Redundet quidem in visceribus nostris oblatio tua sicut multiplicius sancti martyris tui Pelagii profuit ad coronam.
translation_en:
Come, Holy Spirit, descend upon these offerings which all the Church presents to you in honor of your martyr Pelagius, most holy passion. Those who have been helped by You have overcome penalties, conquered fears, did not fear the sword because He merited without end to reign with You. This Your servant, Lord, is pre-eminent in the struggle in life cautious in doctrine, strong in death laudable in kingdom sublime through whom we ask to have You propitious so that You may free us from the hand of the devil and make us worthy of Your kingdom.
Lord, You know how our ancient enemy insidiously attacks us, therefore let him not find any among us whom he can conquer; one mother Church glories in having been washed by the wave of regeneration. May the grace of eternal gifts flourish in us from which these gifts will be sanctified and through which they will be taken. Indeed, may Your offering return to our innermost parts as it did multiply for the saint martyr Pelagius for his crown.

text: Veniat Domine quaesumus populo tuo supplicanti tuae benedictionis infusio quae diabolicas ab eodem repellat insidias quae fragilitatem mundet et protegat quae inopem sustentet et foveat.
translation_en: Come, Lord, we beseech you. May your blessing flow upon your supplicating people, which drives away diabolical traps, disguises frailty, supports the needy, and fosters the helpless.

text: Veniat quaesumus Domine super hanc orationis domum claritas misericordiae tuae ut ab omnibus hic invocantibus nomen tuum protectionis tuae auxilium sentiatur.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your radiance of mercy may come upon this house of prayer. May all who invoke Your name here sense Your aid as Your protection.

text: Veram Verbi tui omnipotens Pater suscipientes ex integra virgine incarnationem praesta quaesumus ut pro nostra interventrix exsistat fragilitate quae nobis eundem peperit Deum et hominem Iesum Christum Filium tuum.
translation_en: Receiving the true Word of yours, omnipotent Father, we ask that you grant us the incarnation received in its entirety from an integral virgin. May she exist as our intercessor in her fragility who brought to us the same God and man Jesus Christ, your Son.

text: Verbum quod ante saecula processisti ex patre et in tempore venisti nasciturus ex virgine pacem illam infunde pectoribus nostris quae olim te nascente decantata est ab angelicis choris. Sicque in nobis iugiter maneat quo adventus tui gaudia dignis laudibus attollamur et sanctorum tuorum victorias fideli devotione narremus.
translation_en: The Word that proceeded before the ages from the Father and came forth in time to be born of a virgin, pour that peace into our hearts which once was sung by angelic choirs at your birth. May it ever remain in us, so that we may continually raise fitting praises for your coming, and recount the victories of your saints with faithful devotion.

text: Vere est Domine quod redundantia in nobis nostra peccata pietatem tuam ad iracundiam provocamus et a pessimis cogitationibus non recedimus. Vae nunc nobis quia tibi peccavimus; propter hoc repletum est amaritudine cor nostrum agnoscendo nostras iniquitates; et tamen iram tuam obdurantes nullo modo pertimescimus. Quaesumus omnipotens clementiam tuam ut audias pie quod clamamus et tribue misericors veniam quam indigni precamur.
translation_en: Indeed, Lord, it is true that our redundancy in sin provokes Your pity to anger and we do not depart from the most wicked thoughts. Woe to us now because we have sinned against You; therefore, our heart is filled with bitterness recognizing our iniquities; yet, persisting in stubbornness, we are not afraid of Your wrath. We humbly ask the omnipotent One for clemency that You hear what we call out and grant us merciful forgiveness which we unworthy ones plead for.

text: Veritatis auctor et misericordiae Deus qui nos et sollicitudine non pigros esse et neminem laedere voluisti praesta quaesumus ut nulli noxia cupiamus inferre et vexare molientium caveamus incursus.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech you, O Author of Truth and God of Mercy, that we may not be negligent through lack of concern and that we desire not to harm anyone. May we also be careful to avoid causing injury to those who trouble us, and protect ourselves from their attacks.

text: Vespertini huius sacrificii litatione placari te cupientes omnipotens Deus quaesumus ut appositum tibi hoc holocaustum ita placide acceptare digneris quo omnes qui a te sanctificari huius anni initia cupimus in sanctis eum nos transegisse actibus gratulemur.
translation_en: We who desire to appease you at the vesper sacrifice, most mighty God, humbly ask that you deign to accept this holocaust placed before you with such peace, so that all those who wish to be sanctified by you at the beginning of this year may thankfully pass through holy actions with us.

text: Via sanctorum omnium Iesu Christe qui ad te venientibus claritatis gaudia contulisti introitum templi istius Spiritus Sancti luce perfunde qui locum istum sanctorum tuorum martyrum sanguine consecrasti; praesta omnipotens ut omnes isti in te credentes obtineant veniam pro delictis ab omnibus liberentur angustiis impetrent quidquid petierint pro necessitatibus suis placere semper valeant coram oculis tuis quatenus per te et sanctum illum tuum militem munerati mereamur aulam paradisi introire.
translation_en: Jesus Christ, you who have bestowed the joy of all saints to those coming to you, fill this temple's entrance with the light of the Holy Spirit. You who consecrated this place with the blood of your holy martyrs, grant that all these, believing in you, obtain forgiveness for all their sins; may they be freed from all anxieties, and may whatever they ask for on account of their needs always please before your eyes, so that through you and your holy soldier, we may deserve to enter the paradise's hall.

text: Via veritas et vita qui incarnari voluisti ut redimeres universa redime nos a chirographo delictorum sancti tui Matthaei apostoli et evangelistae necnon et martyris prece. Qui Eufranonem puerum invocatione nominis tui suscitavit a mortuis suscitet nos quaesumus a vitiorum nostrorum sepulcris quique dum Deus putaretur non se esse Deum sed Dei servum veridica voce referre non distulit sed ut putantes ad te Deum converterentur relicto simulacrorum errore instanter ac fortiter praedicavit ad te nobis redeundi post lapsus aditum praestet nosque in veritate quam praedicavit stabiles faciat.  Suscitet mortuorum in sceleribus corda qui mortificata suscitavit celeriter puerilia membra. Timori tuo nos subdat qui virginum cuneos tuo servitio mancipavit. Conferat nobis tutelam et defunctis amoenitatis aeternae quietem quem inter omnes cum propriis condiscipulis duodecim tribuum constituere dignatus es iudicem.
translation_en:
The way, truth, and life that chose to incarnate in order to redeem all, redeem us from the charter of your saint Matthew's sins, apostle and evangelist, as well as martyr. Who raised Euphranon, a boy, by invoking your name, we ask you to raise us from the tombs of our sins.
Who, when it seemed that God was not God but God's servant, did not hesitate to declare the truth with a true voice, so that they might turn to you as God; leaving behind the error of idolatry, he preached forcefully and immediately to them about returning to you after their fall. May he grant us an entrance to return to you after our sin, and may he make us steadfast in the truth which he preached.
Raise the hearts of the dead who quickly raised childlike limbs that were mortified. Subdue us to your fear, who made the virgins' loins subject to your service. Grant us protection and eternal peace of delight to the departed, whom you deemed worthy among all to be a judge together with your twelve prophets.

text: Vide Domine iniquitates nostras et celeri nobis pietate succurre.
translation_en: Look upon, O Lord, our iniquities, and swiftly help us with your pity.

text: Virgo Dei genitrix Maria cuius hodie veram assumptionem celebramus in sede superna quaesumus indigni et peccatores ibi ubi assumpta es novi miraculi gloria beatiores quandoque mereamur attolli prece quoque tua dicata. Roget quaesumus ibidem pro nobis dignitas tui pudoris quae de te terris ineffabiliter sumpsit in caelis post somnum quietis et cursum consummatum vitae temporalis. Adsit rogamus ibidem pro nobis indignis prex tua semper suffragatrix quatenus hic per eam abluti ab omnibus facinorum contagiis mereamur angelorum compotes esse in caelestibus regnis.
translation_en: We celebrate today the true Assumption of the Virgin Mary, God's Mother, into the heavenly seat. We humbly and as sinners ask that there we, who were assumed by you, may one day be worthy to raise your glorious praises. Also, we ask that the dignity of your grace, which took you from the earth ineffably into the heavens after the quiet sleep and completed course of temporal life, intercede for us there as well. We ask that your prayer always acts as our advocate there, so that through you here we may be worthy to be cleansed of all the contagions of sin, and become fit for the feasts of the angels in the celestial kingdoms.

text: Virtute Sancti Spiritus Domine munera nostra continge ut quod sollemnitate praesenti suo nomine dedicavit et intellegibile nobis faciat et aeternum.
translation_en: Lord, by the power of the Holy Spirit, may your gifts encompass us so that what he dedicated to this solemnity with his own name, may it become clear and comprehensible to us, and forever.

text: Virtutum caelestium Deus de cuius gratiae rore descendit ut ad mysteria tua purgatis sensibus accedamus praesta quaesumus ut in eorum traditione sollemniter honoranda tibi placitum deferamus obsequium.
translation_en: We ask that you grant, O God of heavenly virtues, through the grace of whose dew we approach your mysteries with purified senses. May we present our homage to you solemnly honoring them in their tradition. Grant us this, we beseech you.

text: Virtutum caelestium Deus promissionis tuae munus exsequere ut evangelicae veritati rebellantium corda subdantur.
translation_en: Carry out the duty of your divine promise regarding celestial virtues, so that the hearts of those who rebel against the evangelical truth may be subdued.

text: Virtutum caelestium Deus qui ab humanis corporibus omnem languorem et omnem infirmitatem praecepti tui potestate depellis adesto propitius huic servo tuo ut fugatis infirmitatibus et viribus revocatis nomen sanctum tuum instaurata protinus sanitate benedicat.
translation_en: God of heavenly virtues, who by the power of your command have driven away every weakness and sickness from human bodies, be present graciously to this your servant. May you drive away infirmities and recall strength so that immediately upon recovery, your holy name may bless the restored health.

text: Virtutum caelestium Deus qui nos annua beati Ioannis Baptistae sollemnia frequentare concedis praesta quaesumus ut et securis eadem mentibus celebremus et eorum patrocinio promerente plen(a)e capiamus securitatis augmentum.
translation_en: God of celestial virtues, who grants us to participate in the annual festivities of blessed John the Baptist, grant us, we ask, that we may celebrate them with undisturbed minds and through their patronage merit an increase in security.

text: Virtutum caelestium Deus qui plura praestas quam petimus aut meremur tribue quaesumus ut tua nobis misericordia conferatur quod nostrorum non habet fiducia meritorum.
translation_en: God of celestial virtues, who gives more than we ask or deserve, grant us your mercy, we beseech you. May your mercy be bestowed upon us, for which our faith in our own merits lacks assurance.

text: Visita nos in salutari tuo Domine qui Mariae viscera tua dignatus es praesentia visitare et per gloriosam matris tuae quae Elizabeth visitavit exsultationem nos ad perennem digneris perducere habitationem.
translation_en: Visit us in your salvation, Lord, who were pleased to visit the womb of Mary, and through the glorious mother of yours, who visited Elizabeth, deign to lead us to eternal dwelling with rejoicing.
