text: Visita quaesumus Domine familiam tuam et corda sacris dicata mysteriis pervigili tuere pietate ut remedia salutis aeternae quae te miserante percipiunt te protegente custodiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, to visit your family and watch over their hearts dedicated to the sacred mysteries with vigilant piety. May they, who receive the remedies of eternal salvation through your mercy, be protected by you.

text: Visita quaesumus Domine plebem tuam et corda sacris dicata mysteriis pietate tuere pervigili ut remedia salutis aeternae quae te miserante percipit te protegente custodiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, to visit your people and protect their hearts dedicated to the sacred mysteries with unwavering devotion, so that they may receive the remedies of eternal salvation that you mercifully bestow upon them and guard them under your protection.

text: Vitae perpetuae mysteria veneranda recolimus te Domine deprecantes ut et devotis eadem sacrificiis et dignis operibus assequamur.
translation_en: We remember with reverence the mystery of eternal life, Lord, as we entreat You. May we attain it through devoted sacrifices and worthy works.

text: Vitali alimonia recreati quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut beati Albani martyris tui precibus tuam nobis iustitiam placari sentiamus cuius gloriosa certamina sollemni devotione veneramur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to renew the eternal life of blessed Alban and feel your justice being appeased by his prayers. To whom we honor with solemn devotion for his glorious struggles.

text: Vitalibus refecti muneribus et donis caelestibus confortati gratias pietati tuae referimus Domine orantes ut qui nos clementer corripis et mox miserationis manum porrigis sic des nobis bonis uti temporalibus ut tecum perfruamur aeternis.
translation_en: Having been refreshed with vital food and strengthened by celestial gifts, we offer our thanks to your pity, Lord. We pray that you kindly correct us and soon extend the hand of mercy to us, so that we may use temporal goods for eternal enjoyment with you.

text: Vitalis alimoniae convivio saginati quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut beati regis Edwardi confessoris tui suffragantibus meritis caelestis convivii mereamur esse participes.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to strengthen us with the banquet of the servant Vitalis, that through the intercession of your blessed king Edward the Confessor, we may be worthy to share in the heavenly banquet.

text: Vitalis alimoniae refecti libamine clementiam tuam deposcimus Domine ut intercedente beato Iuliano martyre tuo perceptum ore salutare mysterium puro corde sincera servemus et mente.
translation_en: We humbly ask your clemency, Lord, that through the intercession of the blessed Julian, your martyr, we may receive and faithfully serve with a pure heart and sincere mind, the saving mystery of the sacrament, which we perceive from your mouth.

text: Vitalis hostiae Verbi caro facti deliciis refocillati per ipsum et per suffragia sanctissimi Olavi regis ac martyris tui omnipotentiae <tuae> Deus obsecramus reconciliari ut praesentis vitae commoda perfrui et aeternae digni habeamur participari.
translation_en: We humbly implore Your almighty power, God, that through the selfsame Vitalis who became flesh of the Word and was refreshed by him, and through the intercession of the most holy King and martyr Olav, our God, we may be reconciled to enjoy the benefits of this present life and worthy of participating in eternal life.

text: Vitam nostram Domine unigeniti tui mortem votiva confessione promerentes resurrectionem eius et adscensionem in caelis fide indubitata fatemur; venturum quoque rursum ac pro meritis singulos iudicaturum reatu licet trepidi sed tua freti misericordia praestolamus.  Ob hoc ergo quaesumus famulantes ut oblationem hanc spiritus tui sancti permixtione sanctifices et corporis ac sanguinis Filii tui Domini nostri plena transfiguratione conformes ut hostia qua nos redemptos esse meminimus mundari a sordibus facinorum mereamur nec nos transfixos vulnere a tua reprobes curatione. Medicus enim es aegri sumus; misericors es nos miseri. Ergo quia tibi nostra non abscondimus vulnera per ista quibus placaris sana nos sacrificia.
translation_en:
By our vow of death to your unique Son, we confess faithfully the resurrection and ascension of his in the heavens; though we tremble at the thought of him coming again as judge for each person's merits, yet we await him with fear tinged by your mercy.
For this reason, therefore, we humbly ask that you sanctify this offering through the mingling of your Holy Spirit and make us conform to the full transfiguration of the body and blood of your Son, our Lord, so that we who remember being redeemed may be cleansed from the stains of our sins and not by your reproof be pierced with the wound of guilt. For we are sick; you are merciful to us the miserable. Therefore, since we do not hide our wounds from you in order to please you, heal us with these sacrifices.

text: Vitia cordis humani haec Domine quaesumus medicina compescat quae mortalitatis nostrae venit curare languores.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that these vices of the human heart be healed by your medicine, which comes to cure our mortality and alleviate our weaknesses.

text: Vivant in nobis Iesu Domine apostoli tui Iacobi praedicamenta doctrinae quibus docemur illum esse beatum qui illatas temptationes valuerit supportare quo dum praesentia mala patientissime toleraverimus in pace et caritate et nunc et in aeternum tecum sine fine vivamus.
translation_en: In us live, O Lord Jesus, Your apostles, especially James, the teachings and doctrine by which we learn that blessed is he who has been able to endure trials with patience. While we have patiently endured adversities in peace and charity, we now and forevermore live with you without end.

text: Vivifica Domine animam et spiritum nostrum peccati vulnere sauciatum intercedente beata Maria Magdalena qui eius precibus tua invicta virtute quatriduanum Lazarum resuscitasti de monumento.
translation_en: Revive, Lord, our soul and spirit, which are wounded by sin, through the intercession of blessed Mary Magdalene, whose prayers You brought back Lazarus from the tomb after four days with Your invincible power.

text: Vivifica Domine per hoc sacrosanctum convivium et per intercessionem beatae Mariae Magdalenae animas nostras peccatorum vulneribus sauciatas qui intercessione? eiusdem sororis quatriduanum fratrem eius Lazarum suscitasti.
translation_en: Revive, Lord, within this holy banquet, and through the intercession of blessed Mary Magdalene, our souls wounded by sins; whom together with her sister, you raised your brother Lazarus after four days.

text: Vivificam salutis nostrae hostiam maiestati tuae Domine gaudenter immolamus quatenus sancti Laudi suffragiis freti per haec oblata ad gaudia fidelibus tuis perveniamus promissa.
translation_en: We gladly offer the vivifying sacrifice of our salvation to your majesty, Lord. May we be helped through the intercession of St. Laudus that, by these offerings, we may attain the promised joys for your faithful ones.

text: Vivificent nos Domine tui munera sacramenti ut divina participatione semper mereamur augeri.
translation_en: Revive us, Lord, by your gifts from the sacrament, that we may always deserve to be increased through divine participation.

text: Vivificet me quaeso Domine participatio tui sancta mysterii; et hoc remedio singulari ab omnium peccatorum contagione purifica et a periculorum munire dignare incursione cunctorum.
translation_en: I ask, O Lord, that the participation in your holy mystery revive me; and may this unique remedy cleanse me from the contagion of all sins and protect me from the onslaughts of every danger.

text: Vivificet nos Domine sacrae participationis infusio et perpetua protectione defendat.
translation_en: May the Lord vivify us with the infusion of holy participation, and may He protect us perpetually.

text: Vivificet nos quaesumus Domine participatio tui sancta mysterii et pariter nobis expiationem tribuat et munimen.
translation_en: Revive us, we ask You, Lord, by Your participation in the holy mystery, and at the same time grant us forgiveness and protection.

text: Vivificet nos quaesumus Domine huius participatio sancta mysterii et pariter nobis expiationem tribuat et munimen.
translation_en: Grant us, we beseech You, Lord, that this holy participation in the mystery may vivify us, and at the same time bestow upon us forgiveness and protection.

text: Vivificet nos quaesumus Domine salutare quo pasti sumus sacramentum et interveniente beata Dei Genitrice Maria cum omnibus sanctis tuis concede ut hoc ipsum proficiat animabus famulorum famularumquc tuarum parentum et benefactorum nostrorum ad promerendam propitiationis tuae gratiam et percipiendam futurae resurrectionis gloriam sempiternam.
translation_en: Revive us, we beseech You, Lord, with the saving grace whereby we have been fed with the sacrament. And coming with the blessed Mother of God and all Your saints, grant that this may benefit the souls of Your servants - be they masters or servants, parents or benefactors - so that they may deserve Your mercy and receive the eternal glory of future resurrection.

text: Vivificis refecti sacramentis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut haec eadem nobis intercedente beato Pierano confessore tuo atque pontifice ad praesentis vitae solatium et ad futurae proficiat interminabile gaudium.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to strengthen us with these sacred mysteries. May the intercession of your blessed confessor and pope, Saint Peter, bring us comfort in this life and lead us to eternal joy.

text: Vivificorum sacramentorum sumpta participatione quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut nos eorum salutari communione et sanctae crucis munimine ab omni semper protegas adversitate.
translation_en: We humbly ask the almighty God, who has bestowed upon us participation in the sacred sacraments, that through their saving communion and the protection of the holy cross, may He always shield us from every adversity.

text: Voci nostrae quaesumus Domine aures tuae pietatis accommoda et cordis nostri tenebras lumine tuae visitationis illustra.
translation_en: Lord, we humbly ask that you adjust your ears of mercy to our voice and illuminate the darkness of our hearts with the light of your visitation.

text: Vota nostra Domine clementer intende et peccata dimitte; quae optamus tribue et quae pavemus procul repelle ut cum universitate fidelium vovendo et reddendo sacrificium laudis ad fructum iustitiae pervenire possimus concedente clementia tuae divinitatis.
translation_en: Lord, graciously hearken to our vows and forgive our sins; grant what we desire and drive away what we fear. So that we may approach with the faithful, offering and rendering a sacrifice of praise, to attain the fruit of justice through your clemency, bestowing on us the grace of your divine nature.

text: Vota nostra Dominus clementer intendat et peccata dimittat; quae optamus tribuat et quae pavemus procul repellat ut cum universitate fidelium vovendo et reddendo Deo sacrificium laudis ad fructum iustitiae pervenire possimus concedente clementia divinitatis eius.
translation_en: May our prayers be graciously directed by the Lord and may He forgive our sins; grant us what we desire, and drive away from us what we fear, so that with the universal body of faithful people offering and returning to God a sacrifice of praise, we might achieve the fruit of justice through the clemency of His divine grace.

text: Vota nostra quaesumus Domine pio favore prosequere ut dum dona tua in tribulatione percipimus de consolatione nostra in tuo amore crescamus.
translation_en: We humbly ask You, Lord, with a pious favor to follow our vows. May we grow in consolation from Your love as we receive Your gifts during tribulation.

text: Vota populi tui Domine propitiatus intende et quorum nos tribuis sollemnia celebrare fac gaudere suffragiis.
translation_en: Lord, turn Your merciful gaze towards the vows of Your people and grant that we may celebrate solemnities for them, and let them rejoice with our intercessions.

text: Vota quaesumus Domine supplicantis populi caelesti pietate prosequere ut et quae agenda sunt videant et ad implenda quae viderint convalescant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that by heavenly pity you may follow the petitions of this supplicating people. May they see what needs to be done and gain strength to accomplish what they see.

text: Votiva caelestis mensae percipientes Domine sacramenta beatae Annae matris Mariae gloriosa nos intercessione protege de qua virgo puerpera ad lucem humanae nativitatis prodiit quae nobis splendorem vitae sine castitatis dispendio generavit
translation_en: Graciously receiving, Lord, the vows offered at the celestial table of blessed Anne, Mother of Mary, glorious one, we pray that with her intercession you protect us. The virgin who brought forth a child into human nativity was she, who without the cost of chastity generated for us the splendor of life.

text: Votiva Domine dona mystici libaminis pro sanctarum virginum ac martyrum tuarum veneratione tuae maiestati oblata nostra expurgent facinora et purificatos nos tanti mysterii exsequendi reddant acceptos
translation_en: Grant us, Lord, the votive offering of the mystical incense, offered for the veneration of your holy virgins and martyrs. May it cleanse our sins and make us acceptable for participating in such a great mystery.

text: Votiva Domine dona percepimus quae sanctorum nobis precibus et praesentis quaesumus vitae pariter et aeternae tribue conferre praesidium
translation_en: We have perceived, Lord, the vows that we have promised in prayer to the saints and ask you now for both life and eternal life to grant us protection.

text: Votiva Domine pro beati martyris tui Laurentii passione dona percepimus; quaesumus ut eius precibus et praesentis vitae nobis pariter et aeternae tribuas conferre praesidium.
translation_en: We have perceived the vows made to Your blessed martyr Laurence during his passion; we ask that you grant us, through his prayers and the example of his current life, protection in both this world and the next.

text: Votiva Domine pro beati confessoris tui et episcopi Donati commemoratione dona percepimus; quaesumus ut eius precibus et praesentis vitae nobis pariter et aeternae tribuas conferre praesidium.
translation_en: We have received offerings, Lord, in memory of your blessed confessor and bishop Donatus; we humbly ask that you grant us to receive protection through his prayers and the example of his present life, as well as in our eternal life.

text: Votiva Domine in beati apostoli tui illius gloriosa celebritate dona percepimus; quaesumus ut eius precibus et praesentis nobis vitae praesidium et aeternae tribuas conferri laetitiam.
translation_en: In the glory of your blessed apostle, we have perceived the vows granted to us; we beseech you to bestow upon us, through his prayers and in our present life, as well as eternal happiness.

text: Votiva Domine munera deferentes in tuorum Petri et Marcellini martyrum passione et tuam magnificentiam veneramur et per eam nobis imploramus tuae pietatis auxilium.
translation_en: Bringing our votive offerings, we approach Your majesty in the passion of Your apostles Peter and Marcellinus, and we revere Your greatness. Through this reverence, we humbly implore the aid of Your mercy.

text: (... lacuna ...) votiva sacramenta quae sumpsimus Domine Deus noster ut intercessione beati Savini pontificis et martyris tui adiuvati inter ipsius mereamur membra numerari qui seipsum obtulit pro mundi salute.
translation_en: We have received votive sacraments, Lord our God, with the help of Your blessed Pope and Martyr Savinus, may we be worthy to be counted among his limbs who offered himself for the salvation of the world.

text: Votivam nobis Domine laetitiam hodiernae iucunditatis instituit beata martyr Praxedis nec corpore temerata nec mente quia simul in ea Domine per tuam gratiam triumphavit et virginalis integritas et confessio veritatis.
translation_en: Today, Lord, the blessed martyr Praxedis has established for us a joyful vow of this day's delight. Neither was she defiled in body nor corrupted in mind, for in her, Lord, through your grace, she triumphed simultaneously with virginal integrity and the confession of truth.

text: Votivis quaesumus Domine famulae tuae illius adesto muneribus ut te custode servata hereditatem benedictionis aeternae percipiat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, servant of yours, that she may be present with her vows, so that with you as her guardian, she may inherit the blessing of eternal benediction.

text: Votivus nos Domine quaesumus beati martyris tui illius natalis semper excipiat qui et iucunditatem nobis suae glorificationis infundat et tibi nos reddat acceptos.
translation_en: We pray to you, Lord, that the feast day of your blessed martyr may always receive us, who pours out for us the joy of his glory and returns us accepted to you.

text: Votorum nostrorum munus quaesumus Domine propitiatus assume vitalibus sacrificiis exoratus ut nostris veniam delictis impertias et huius tabernaculi ex te sanctificationibus cumulatos exaudias.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to accept our offering of vows. Through your mercy, hear our prayers and grant us forgiveness for our sins. May the accumulated sanctifications of this tabernacle be heard by you.

text: Vox clamantis ecclesiae ad aures quaesumus Domine tuae pietatis adscendat ut percepta venia peccatorum te fiat operante devota te protegente secura.
translation_en: The voice of the church calling out to Your ears we humbly ask, Lord of Your mercy, may it ascend so that, through Your working and protecting presence, the forgiveness of sins may be granted to us in a devoted manner, secure.

text: Vox testimoniorum tuorum Domine quae Eugeniam virginem ad tuum provexit amorem cum christianorum cantu dignosceret: »Omnes deos gentium daemonia« esse te autem solum Deum caelos fecisse inflectat corda nostra ad paenitentiam et corpora in divina servitute constringat. Pellat quoque a nobis simultatum scandala et alternae societatis enutriat incrementa quo per admonitionem legis tuae caelesti ad invicem potiamur dulcedine per quam haec virgo cumpuncta sanctae Trinitatis promeruit cognoscere unitatem.
translation_en: The voice of your witnesses, Lord, which brought Eugenia the virgin to a love worthy of the singing of Christians: "All gods of the nations are demons," proclaims that you alone are God who created the heavens; bend our hearts towards penitence and constrain our bodies in divine servitude. May it also purge from us hypocrisy's scandals and nourish the growth of alternative societies, so that through the admonition of your celestial law, we may delight mutually in the sweetness by which this virgin, touched by the holy Trinity, merited to recognize unity.

text: Te igitur clementissime Pater per Iesum Christum silium tuum Dominum nostrum supplices rogamus et petimus uti accepta habeas et benedicas haec dona haec munera haec sancta sacrificia illibata in primis quae tibi offerimus pro Ecclesia tua sancta catholica quam pacificare custodire adunare et regere digneris toto orbe terrarum una cum famulo tuo papa nostro illo ...
translation_en: Therefore, most kind Father, through Jesus Christ, your only-begotten Son, our Lord, we humbly ask and beg you to receive and bless these gifts, these offerings, these holy sacrifices, which we offer first for your holy Catholic Church, that you may deign to pacify, keep, unite, and govern it throughout the whole world, together with your servant, our Pope...

text: Memento Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum (illorum et illarum) et omnium circumstantium quorum tibi fides cognita est et nota devotio qui tibi offerunt hoc sacrificium laudis pro se suisque omnibus pro redemptione animarum suarum pro spe salutis et incolumitatis suae; tibi reddunt vota sua aeterno Deo vivo et vero.
translation_en: Remember, Lord, your servants and their servants (their masculine and feminine ones), and all those standing around who have faith known to you and devotion recognized by you. Those who offer this sacrifice of praise on behalf of themselves and all their souls, for the redemption of their souls, for hope of salvation and integrity. They return their vows to you, to the eternal God who lives and is true.

text: Memento Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum qui electos tuos suscepturi sunt ad sanctam gratiam baptismi tui (et taces – et recitantur nomina virorum ac mulierum qui ipsos infantes suscepturi sunt – et intras) et omnium circumadstantium quorum tibi fides cognita est et nota devotio qui tibi offerunt hoc sacrificium laudis pro se suisque omnibus pro redemptione animarum suarum pro spe salutis et incolumitatis suae; tibi reddunt vota sua aeterno Deo vivo et vero.
translation_en: Remember, O Lord, thy servants and their servants who are to receive the holy grace of Thy baptism (and be silent - and let the names of men and women who are to baptize these infants be read out - and enter in). And for all standing around whose faith is known and devotion recognized who offer this sacrifice of praise for themselves and all their souls, for the redemption of their souls, for hope of salvation and safety; they return their vows to Thee, eternal God living and true.

text: Communicantes et noctem sacratissimam celebrantes in qua incontaminata virginitas huic mundo edidit Salvatorem Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum sed ... ( recension gelasienne ) Communicantes et noctem sacratissimam celebrantes qua beatae Mariae intemerata virginitas huic mundo edidit Salvatorem sed ... ( recension gregorienne )
translation_en: Communing and celebrating the most sacred night, in which the undefiled virginity of this world brought forth Savior Jesus Christ our Lord, but...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes in quo incontaminata virginitas huic mundo edidit Salvatorem Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum sed ... ( recension gelasienne ) Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes quo beatae Mariae intemerata virginitas huic mundo edidit Salvatorem sed ... ( recension gregorienne )
translation_en:
(Gelasian redaction) Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day, on which the undefiled virginity of this world brought forth Savior Jesus Christ our Lord, but...
(Gregorian redaction) Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day, by which the blessed Virgin's undefiled virginity brought forth Savior Jesus Christ to this world, but...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimam celebrantes circumcisionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi sed ...
translation_en: Communing and celebrating the most sacred day, we remember the circumcision of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes quo unigenitus tuus in tua tecum gloria sempiternus in veritate nostrae carnis natus magis de longinquo venientibus visibilis et corporalis apparuit sed ... ( recension gelasienne ) Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes quo unigenitus tuus in tua tecum gloria coaeternus in veritate carnis nostrae visibiliter corporalis apparuit sed ... ( recension gregorienne )
translation_en:
Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day on which your only-begotten Son, in Your glory eternal with You, was born in truth of our flesh, appeared more visibly and corporally to those coming from afar, but... (Gelasian version)
Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day on which your only-begotten Son, in Your glory coeternal with You, was born in truth of our flesh and appeared visibly and corporally, but... (Gregorian version)

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes in quo Dominus noster Iesus Christus lavit pedes discipulorum suorum et immolavit corpus suum et sanguinem in mysterium redemptionis nostrae sed ...
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day, on which our Lord Jesus Christ washed the feet of his disciples and offered up his body and blood in the mystery of our redemption, but...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimam celebrantes natalis calicis Domini nostri Iesu Christi sed ...
translation_en: Participating and celebrating the most sacred day, we commemorate the birthday of the chalice of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes quo traditus est Dominus noster Iesus Christus sed ... ( recension gelasienne ) Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes quo Dominus noster Iesus Christus pro nobis est traditus sed ... ( recension gregorienne )
translation_en:
Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day on which our Lord Jesus Christ was handed over to us, according to the Gelasian recension.
Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day on which our Lord Jesus Christ was betrayed for us, according to the Gregorian recension.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes quo traditus est Dominus noster Iesus Christus – Tu nos Domine participes Filii tui tu consortes regni tui tu incolas paradisi tu angelorum comites esse iussisti si tamen illaesa et intemerata fide caelestis militiae sacramenta servemus. Aut quid desperare de tua misericordia possumus qui tantum munus accepimus ut talem tibi hostiam offerre mereremur corpus scilicet et sanguinem Domini nostri Iesu Christi qui se pro mundi redemptione piae illi ac venerandae tradidit passioni qui formam sacrificii salutis perennis instituens hostiam se primus obtulit et primus docuit offerri? – sed ...
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day on which our Lord Jesus Christ was handed over to us – You, Lord, have commanded that we should be participants of your Son's kingdom, dwellers in paradise, companions of angels. If we serve the sacraments of heavenly militia with unbroken and undefiled faith, what despair can we have regarding your mercy, who have received such a great gift, worthy to offer you such a sacrifice as the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, which he himself humbly offered for the redemption of the world in his pious and venerable passion, instituting the form of the perpetual sacrifice and being the first to offer it, and teaching its offering. – but ...

text: Communicantes et noctem sacratissimam celebrantes resurrectionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi secundum carnem sed ...
translation_en: Communing and celebrating the most holy night, we celebrate the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ according to the flesh, but...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes resurrectionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi secundum carnem sed ...
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day, we celebrate the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ in the flesh, but...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimam celebrantes clausulae Paschae Domini nostri Iesu Christi sed ...
translation_en: Communing and celebrating the most sacred day, we come to the close of the Easter feast of our Lord Jesus Christ but...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes adscensionis in caelum Domini nostri Iesu Christi sed ...
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day, we mark the Ascension of our Lord Jesus Christ into heaven - however...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimam celebrantes adscensionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi ad caelum sed ...
translation_en: Commemorating and celebrating the most sacred day, we mark the Ascension of our Lord Jesus Christ into heaven, but...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes quo Dominus noster unigenitus Filius tuus unitum sibi hominem nostrae substantiae in gloriae tuae dextera collocavit sed ...
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day on which our only-begotten Son, your son, united with us human beings in his divine nature at your right hand, but...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum celebrantes quo Dominus noster unigenitus Filius tuus unitam sibi fragilitatis nostrae substantiam in gloriae tuae dextera collocavit sed ...
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day on which our only-begotten Son, your Son, assumed for us a fragile human nature with his glory, but...

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum Pentecosten praevenientes quo Spiritus Sanctus apostolos plebemque credentium praesentia suae maiestatis implevit sed ...
translation_en: Communicating and approaching the most sacred day of Pentecost, on which the Holy Spirit filled the apostles and the believing people with His divine presence, but...

text: Communicantes et diem Pentecosten sacratissimum celebrantes quo Spiritus Sanctus apostolos plebemque credentium praesentia suae maiestatis implevit sed
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day of Pentecost, on which the Holy Spirit filled the presence of His majesty upon the apostles and the believing people.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum Pentecosten celebrantes quo apostoli apostolorumque discipuli omnium charismatum spiritalia dona sumpserunt sed
translation_en: Communing and celebrating the most sacred day of Pentecost, on which the apostles and disciples of the apostles received all spiritual gifts by the Holy Spirit.

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimam celebrantes Quinquagesimae Domini nostri Iesu Christi in qua Spiritus Sanctus super apostolos descendit sed
translation_en: Communicating and celebrating the most sacred day, Quinquagesima of our Lord Jesus Christ, on which the Holy Spirit descended upon the apostles

text: Communicantes et diem sacratissimum Pentecosten celebrantes quo Spiritus Sanctus apostolis innumeris linguis apparuit sed
translation_en: Communing and celebrating the most sacred day of Pentecost, on which the Holy Spirit appeared to the apostles in countless tongues

text: Communicantes et memoriam venerantes in primis gloriosae semper virginis Mariae genitricis Dei et Domini nostri Iesu Christi sed et beatorum apostolorum ac martyrum tuorum Petri Pauli Andreae Iacobi Ioannis Thomae Iacobi Philippi Bartholomaei Matthaei Simonis et Thaddaei Lini Cleti Clementis Xysti Cornelii Cypriani Laurentii Chrysogoni Ioannis et Pauli Cosmae et Damiani et omnium sanctorum tuorum quorum meritis precibusque concedas ut in omnibus protectionis tuae muniamur auxilio. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Communicating and remembering first, the glorious ever-virgin Mary, mother of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, and also the blessed apostles and martyrs Peter, Paul, Andrew, James, John, Thomas, James the Lesser, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Simon, Jude Thaddaeus, Linus, Cletus, Clement, Xystus, Cornelius, Cyprian, Lawrence, Chrysogonus, John and Paul, Cosmas and Damian, and all your saints whose merits and prayers grant that we may be fortified in all things with the help of your protection. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly ask you, Lord, to receive this offering of our servitude and also that of your entire family. May you be pleased to arrange our days in your peace, and deliver us from eternal damnation. Grant us numbering among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc etiam oblationem Domine tibi virginum sacratarum quarum ante sanctum altare tuum oblata nomina recitantur quaesumus placatus accipias pro quibus maiestatem tuam supplices deprecamur ut propositum castitatis quod te auctore professae sunt te .protectum custodiant. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: We also offer this oblation to You, Lord, the vows of the chaste virgins whose names are read before Your holy altar. We humbly ask that You, being pleased, receive it for them; we implore Your majesty to hear our supplications, that they may uphold the purpose of chastity which they have professed with You as their protector. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine clementer suscipe quam tibi offerimus pro infirmis fratribus et proximis nostris; quaesumus Domine ut visites eos in salutari tuo et caelestis gratiae concedas .illis medicinam. Per Christum <Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, graciously receive, Lord, this offering which we present to you on behalf of our sick brothers and neighbors. We ask you, Lord, to visit them in your mercy and grant them healing through celestial grace. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerunt ob diem ieiunii cenae dominicae in qua Dominus noster Iesus Christus tradidit discipulis suis corporis et sanguinis sui mysteria celebranda quaesumus Domine placatus intende ut per multa curricula annorum salva et incolumis munera sua tibi domino .mereatur offerre; diesque nostros in tua pace disponas <atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, this offering that all thy families present unto thee for the day of fasting and the evening meal of the Lord's Day, on which our Lord Jesus Christ gave to his disciples the mysteries of his body and blood to be celebrated, we humbly ask thee, Lord, pleased. Turn favourably towards it through many years, that he may be worthy to offer it safely and in good health to thee, O Lord. May you dispose our days in thy peace, and deliver us from eternal damnation. And in your elect number us among the flock. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famuli tui illius et reginae illius cum filiis suis vel populo christiano quam tibi ministerio officii sacerdotalis offerimus propitius ac benignus assume et exoratus nostra obsecratione concede ut maiestati .tuae sit accepta; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we, your servant and his queen along with their sons or the Christian people, whom we offer before you through the ministry of the sacerdotal office, grant us your favor and kindness to accept this offering. By our humble entreaty, grant that it be acceptable to your majesty. May you arrange our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. Grant us, by your command, to be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famuli tui illius quam tibi ministerio officii sacerdotalis offerimus pro eo quod in ipso potestatem imperii conferre dignatus es propitius et benignus assume et exoratus nostra obsecratione concede ut maiestatis tuae protectione confidens et aevo .augeatur et regno. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, this offering your servant offers on that behalf to whom you graciously conferred power of empire, we humbly entreat you to accept it. Gracious and propitious, be pleased to take it and grant through our petition that, trusting in the protection of your majesty, he may be increased in age and strengthened in kingdom. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famuli tui illius quam tibi offerimus ut ei itinere constituto ad eius iugem custodiam angelum tuae tribuas pietatis qui salvum et incolumem ducat et reducat iri tua sacrosancta ecclesia catholica et domui tuae praesentare praecipias cum omni .gaudio et effectu; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So then, Lord, this offering of your servant that we present to you; on the journey established for it, grant an angel from your pity, who may safely and healthily guide and bring back your most sacred Catholic Church and your household. You will command it to be presented with all joy and efficacy. May you order our days in peace and free us from eternal damnation. Command us to be numbered among the flock of your elect ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famuli tui illius quam tibi offer{e}t ob desiderium animae suae commendans tibi Deo iter suum placatus suscipias deprecamur; cui tu Domine angelum pacis mittere digneris angelum tuum sanctum sicut misisti famulo tuo Tobiae Raphael angelum qui eum salvum atque incolumem perducat usque ad loca destinata et iterato tempore opportuno omnibus rite perfectis reduci eum faciat in tua sancta ecclesia et laetus tibi serviat et nomini tuo .gratias referat; (diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari). Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So then, Lord, this offering Your servant brings You on behalf of the desire of his soul, commending it to You. We pray that You receive it and accept it. To whom You, Lord, deem worthy to send an angel of peace, we ask You to send Your holy angel, as You sent Your angel Raphael to Your servant Tobias, who may lead him safely and unharmed to his designated destination and, at the appropriate time, may bring him back to Your holy church and may he serve You joyfully and give thanks to Your name. May You also arrange our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation and command that we be numbered among Your chosen ones. Through Christ Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famuli tui illius quam tibi offer{e}t ob diem natalis sui celebrans genuinum quo die eum de maternis visceribus in hunc mundum nasci iussisti ad te cognoscendum Deum verum et vivum placatus suscipias deprecamur; ob hoc igitur reddit tibi vota sua Deo vivo et vero; pro quo maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut adicias ei annos et tempora vitae ut per multa curricula annorum laetus tibi haec sua vota persolvat atque ad optatam perveniat senectutem et te benedicat omnibus diebus .vitae suae. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to your servant, which he offers on his birthday, celebrating the day you commanded him to be born into this world to know the true and living God. We humbly ask that, pleased with this genuine act, you accept it and grant him the vows he makes to the living and true God. For this reason, we beseech you to add years and times of life so that, passing through many circuits of years, he may happily fulfill his vows to you, reach his desired old age, and bless you with all the days of his life. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famuli tui illius quam tibi offer{e}t ob iustas eleemosynas suas quas in pauperes tuos operatur placatus suscipias deprecamur pro quo maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut adicias ei tempora vitae ut per multa curricula annorum laetus tibi in pauperes tuos haec operetur atque annua tibi .vota persolvat. Per Christum <Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we humbly present this offering of your servant, which he offers to you on account of his just alms that he performs for the poor. We pray to your majesty for him, that you may add to his days of life, so that he rejoices in serving the poor throughout many years and pays out his annual vows to you through it. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famuli tui illius quam tibi offer{e}t pro salute famuli tui illius placatus suscipias deprecamur pro quo maiestati tuae fundimus preces ut eum confirmato pacis foedere cum omni gaudio ad nos quantocius .facias remeare. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we your servant's offering that he presents to you for the salvation of his servant, we pray that you accept it, pleased. On behalf of him, we beseech you before your majesty that we pour out our prayers, that you strengthen the peace covenant with him with all joy and bring him back to us as soon as possible. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famuli tui illius quam tibi offert pro votis et desideriis suis atque et pro incolumitate domus suae placatus suscipias deprecamur pro quo in hac habitatione auxilium tuae maiestatis deposco ut mittere ei digneris angelum tuum sanctum ad custodiendos omnes in hac .habitatione consistentes. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we humbly offer this oblation of your servant, which he presents to you on his vows and desires, as well as for the welfare of his household. We entreat you to receive it, pleased. For him in this dwelling, I implore your assistance through the might of your majesty, that you may deign to send your holy angel to protect all who dwell here. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quaesumus placatus intende quam pro animabus fidelium nostrorum tuae suppliciter exhibemus pietati ut per haec sancta mysteria ab omnibus absoluti peccatis aeternae beatitudinis .participes efficiantur; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we humbly ask that you pay attention to this offering of ours, which we present with supplication on behalf of the souls of our faithful people, that through these holy mysteries they may be absolved from all sins and become participants in eternal beatitude. May you dispose our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. And we pray that you command us to be numbered among your elect sheep. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famulorum famularumque tuarum quam tibi offerimus ob devotionem mentis eorum pius ac propitius clementi vultu suscipias tibi supplicantes libens protege dignanter exaudi et aeterna eos protectione conserva ut semper in tua religione laetantes instanter iri sanctae Trinitatis confessione fide .catholica perseverent; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we present this offering on behalf of your servants and their servants, which we offer to you in devotion of their minds. Receive it graciously, and with a kind and compassionate face, deign to protect us who pray, and listen attentively. May you continually preserve them under eternal protection, so that they may always rejoice in your religion. With constant confession of the Holy Trinity, let them persevere in the Catholic faith. Dispose our days in peace for us, and free us from eternal damnation. Grant that we may be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famulorum tuorum illius et illius quam tibi offerunt ob diem tricesimum coniunctionis suae vel annualem quo die eos iugali vinculo sociare dignatus es placatus suscipias deprecamur; ob hoc igitur reddunt tibi vota sua Deo vero et vivo; pro quibus tremendae pietati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut pariter bene et pacifici senescant et videant filios filiorum suorum usque in tertiam et quartam progeniem et te benedicant omnibus diebus .vitae suae. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we humbly ask that you accept this offering of your servant and his spouse, which they offer to you on the thirtieth day of their conjunction or annually, on which day you graciously deigned to unite them in matrimony. We beseech you to accept their vows made to you as God and life, and for them we pour forth our prayers with great reverence. May they grow old together in peace, and live to see their grandchildren's grandchildren, and bless you every day of their lives. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famulorum tuorum quam tibi offerimus pro illo episcopo vel pro plebe sibi commissa ob devotionem mentis suae pius ac propitius suscipias tibique supplicantes libens protege benignus exaudi et tua eos protectione conserva ut semper in tua religione laetantes instanter in sanctae Trinitatis confessione fide .catholica perseverent. Per Christum <Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, this offering that your servants present to you on behalf of that bishop, or for the people entrusted to him, for the devotion of his mind, we humbly ask that you graciously receive it. Protect them kindly, hear them willingly, and through your protection, preserve them. May they always rejoice in your religion and perseveringly confess the holy Trinity in the Catholic faith. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine famulorum tuorum quam tibi offerunt ob devotionem mentis suae pius ac propitius clementi vultu suscipias tibique supplicantes libens protege dignanter exaudi et aeterna eos protectione conserva ut semper in tua religione laetantes instanter in sanctae Trinitatis <confessione> fide catholica perseverent. Nobis haec quoque unianimiter et crebre petentibus ipse praestabis .omnipotens Deus. Per Christum <Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we humbly offer this oblation to you on behalf of your servants, who present it with devotion of mind. May you, gracious and merciful, accept it favorably and, with a kind countenance, protect us worthy of your grace as we pray, attentively hear us, and forever preserve them under your protection in the joy of your service. May they perseveringly remain in the confession of the holy Trinity, in the catholic faith. Grant this also to those who continually or repeatedly ask for it. O almighty God, through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam pro famulo tuo illo offerimus quaesumus ut placatus accipias indulgentiamque peccatorum per hanc salutarem hostiam .percipere mereatur. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: So, Lord, we present this offering on behalf of your servant which he offers to you. We humbly ask that, pleased with it, you grant him the forgiveness of sins through this saving sacrifice. May he merit to receive it. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine placatus intende quam tibi offerimus pro regibus et principibus nostris pro statu regni Francorum et pro omni populo christiano pro eleemosynariis nostris et pro his qui nostri memoriam in suis continuis orationibus habent ut tuo dono hic diuturnam pacem habeant et in futuro vitam .consequantur aeternam. Per Christum <Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, graciously regard this offering that we present to you for our kings and princes, for the state of the kingdom of France, and for every Christian people. For our alms and for those who keep our memory in their continuous prayers, may they here have eternal peace and in the future follow an everlasting life through your gift. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offerimus hodie necessitati meae pius ac propitius clementi vultu suscipias ut qui de meritorum meorum qualitate diffido non iudicium tuum sed indulgentiam sentiam et de adversis prospera habere percipiam ut ab omni impugnatione depulsus misericordiae tuae praevenientem clementiam tuae .pietatis adipiscar; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we present this offering to You today, out of our necessity. May You receive it graciously and kindly, with a benevolent and propitious countenance. Grant that, not judging me according to the merits I have doubts about, I may experience Your mercy rather than Your judgment, and perceive prosperity in adversity, being pushed back from every attack by the anticipating clemency of Your mercy; may You arrange our days in peace, deliver us from eternal damnation, and command us to be numbered among Your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius quaesumus ut placatus accipias pro qua maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut electorum ministrorum tuorum quorum secutus est officium iubeas eum .beatitudini sociari. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to You on behalf of the soul of Your servant, and we humbly ask that You accept it in propitiation for his worthiness before Your majesty. We pour out our supplications for the chosen ministers among us, whose duty he followed, and we beg You to grant him admittance into beatitude. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius cuius depositionis diem illum celebramus quo deposito corpore animam tibi creatori reddidit quam dedisti pro quo petimus divinam clementiam tuam ut mortis vinculis absolutus transitum .mereatur ad vitam. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, this offering which we present to you for the soul of your servant whose departure day we celebrate, whom, after laying down his body, he returned his soul to you, the Creator, who gave it to him; for whom we ask your divine clemency, that freed from the bonds of death, he may merit passage to life. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius cuius hodie annua dies agitur quaesumus placatus intende eamque mortalitatis nexibus absolutam inter tuos fideles ministros habere perpetuam .iubeas portionem. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to you for the soul of your servant whose annual day is celebrated today; we humbly ask that you, being pleased, direct it and grant that it may be freed from the bonds of mortality among your faithful ministers and ever have a place. We command by Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius quaesumus ut placatus accipias et miserationum tuarum largitate concedas ut quidquid terrena conversatione contraxit his sacrificiis emundetur ac mortis vinculis absoluta transitum .mereatur ad vitam; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to You for the soul of Your servant; and we humbly ask that You, being appeased, grant Your mercies in such a way that whatever he has contracted in his earthly life may be purified by these sacrifices and freed from the bonds of death. May he deserve to attain to life; may You arrange our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. And we beseech You to count him among Your elect. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offerimus pro expiatione peccatorum famuli tui illius et pro acceleratione caelestis auxilii ut omnium delictorum suorum remissionem .consequi mereatur quaesumus Domine <ut placatus accipias diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to You for the expiration of the sins of Your servant, and for the acceleration of heavenly aid, that he may deserve remission of all his sins. We ask You, Lord, that You receive us graciously, arrange our days in Your peace, deliver us from eternal damnation, and count us among Your elect. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo ut in praesenti saeculo salutem mentis et corporis in futuro quidem remissionem omnium peccatorum suorum .consequi mereatur quaesumus Domine (ut) placatus suscipias diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to You on behalf of Your servant, that in the present world he may obtain health for both soul and body, and certainly attain remission of all his sins. We humbly ask You, Lord (that) being pleased, You may dispose our days in peace and rescue us from eternal damnation. And we beseech You to enroll us among Your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offerimus pro liberatione et consolatione famuli tui illius sereno vultu accepta ut non eum fraus humana deiciat non tua deitas ex iudicio puniat non castigatum iustitia usquequaque demergat non iniquitas propria non adversitas gravet aliena; si quid tibi deliquit ignosce; si quid offendit homines tu dimitte; submove ab eo cruciatus mentis simul et corporis ut te compunctus requirat a te tactus non doleat per te sustentatus adversa despiciat et a te correctus te .diligenter exquirat; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to You for the liberation and consolation of Your servant, that he may not be overthrown by human deceit, nor punished by Your justice without mercy, nor be overwhelmed by injustice everywhere, nor burdened by his own wickedness or by adversity from another; if he has sinned against You, forgive him; if he has offended men, grant him pardon; remove from him the torment of mind and body that, touched by You, he may not grieve, sustained by You despise adversity, and, corrected by You, diligently seek You; dispose our days in Your peace and free us from eternal damnation. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus Domine pro liberatione et consolatione nostra sereno vultu accepta ut non nos fraus humana deiciat non tua deitas ex iudicio puniat non castigatos iustitia usquequaque dimergat non iniquitas propria non adversitas aggravet aliena; si quid tibi deliquimus ignosce; si quid offendimus hominibus tu dimitte; submove a nobis cruciatus mentis simul et corporis ut te compuncti requiramus a te tacti non doleamus per te sustentati adversa despiciamus et a te correcti te diligenter exquiramus; diesque nostros in tua pace <disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So then, this offering that we present to you, Lord, on behalf of our liberation and consolation, may it be received with a serene countenance, so that human deceit does not overcome us, nor your divinity judge us unjustly, nor justice punish us completely, nor our own iniquity worsen, nor external adversity aggravate us. If we have sinned towards you, forgive us; if we have offended people, let them be forgiven by you. Move away from us the torments of mind and body, so that we may seek you with contrite hearts, not suffer through you, despise adversities through you, and diligently seek you after being corrected. May you dispose our days in peace and free us from eternal damnation. And may you command us to be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offerimus pro peccatis et offensionibus nostris ut omnium delictorum nostrorum remissionem .consequi mereamur quaesumus (ut) placatus accipias <diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, this offering which we present to you for our sins and offenses, that we may merit remission of all our offenses, we humbly ask (that) you, being appeased, may dispose our days in your peace, and may deliver us from eternal damnation. Moreover, we entreat you to count us among the number of your elect through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine quam tibi offero pro incolumitate famulorum tuorum et omnium suorum quaesumus ut placatus accipias pro quibus maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut angelum pacis illis adhaerere praecipias cuius suffulti auxilio incolumes iter agentes ad propria .valeant remeare. Per Christum <Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to You for the well-being of Your servants and all theirs. We humbly ask that You receive it graciously on their behalf, to whom we pour out our prayers. We implore You to command an angel of peace to stay with them, whose help sustains them as they journey safely back home. Through Christ, Our Lord, may they be well and return safe.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine servitutis meae quam tibi offero ego famulus tuus et sacerdos pro eo quod me elegere dignatus es in ordinem presbyterii ut sacrificiis tuis ac divinis altaribus deservirem; pro hoc reddo tibi vota mea Deo vero et vivo maiestatem tuam suppliciter implorans ut opera manuum tuarum in meipso custodias et idoneum me per omnia ministrum tuae .voluntatis efficias. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, this offering of my servitude that I present to You, I, Your servant and priest, offer it on behalf of the fact that You have deemed me worthy to be chosen for the order of priesthood to serve at Your sacrifices and divine altars. For this reason, I return to You my vows to God truly and humbly beseeching Your majesty, that You would keep watch over the work of Your hands in me and make me fitting for all things a servant of Your will. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem (Domine) servitutis nostrae sed et famuli tui illius quam tibi offerimus pro spiritu cari nostri quaesumus Domine propitius intuere et si in illo fructum boni operis non invenis vel famuli tui illius fidem vel devotionem respicere digneris et operi manuum tuarum locum refrigerii lucis et pacis ut .indulgeas deprecamur. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, this offering of our servitude (and of your servant) that we present to you on behalf of the dear spirit within us, we humbly ask you to look upon favorably. If you do not find in him the fruit of good works or the faith and devotion of your servant, we pray that you may be mindful of his actions, and grant him a place of refreshing light and peace through your divine touch. We entreat this indulgence. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem Domine ut propitius suscipias deprecamur quam tibi offerimus pro famulis et famulabus tuis quos ad aeternam vitam et beatum gratiae tuae donum elegere atque .vocare dignatus es. (Per Christum <Dominum nostrum>).  Et recitantur nomina electorum. Postquam recensita ruerint dicis; Hos Domine fonte baptismatis innovandos spiritus tui munere ad sacramentorum tuorum plenitudine .poscimus praeparari. (Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>).  (Diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.)
translation_en:
Therefore, Lord, we humbly ask that you accept this offering of ours. We make it on behalf of your servants and those whom you have chosen and called to eternal life through your gracious gift. (Through Christ our Lord).
And let the names of the elect be read. After they have been recited, you say: "Lord, these are the ones that you want to renew with the spirit of baptism through your gift, to prepare for the fullness of your sacraments. (Through Christ our Lord).
(May you arrange our days in peace and save us from eternal damnation. And command that we be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.)

text: Hanc igitur oblationem familiae tuae tibi adstantis quorum tibi fides cognita est et nota devotio quam tibi offerunt pro devotione animorum suorum pro quorum tibi placitis desideriis supplicamus; memor esse dignare Domine sancte Pater aeterne Deus in diebus ieiuniorum ipsorum ut a cunctis eos peccatis abstergeas et residuum temporis quo eis alimoniorum perceptio conceditur ita eos conservare digneris ut sobriam vitam habentes non involvantur peccatorum laqueis ab .epulis excitatis. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Therefore, we present this offering to you, O Lord, on behalf of your family whose faith is known and devotion is recognized by you. They offer it for the devotion of their souls, for the desires that please you regarding them, which we humbly ask. We beseech you, holy Father eternal God, on their days of fasting, to cleanse them from all sins, and in the remaining time during which they are granted sustenance, may you deem worthy to preserve them so that, with sober life, they will not be ensnared by the nets of sins due to excited feasts. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famulae tuae illae quam tibi offer{e}t ob diem natalis sui in quo eam tibi socians sacro velamine protegere dignatus es quaesumus Domine propitiatus sanctifica ut tibi domino ac sponso suo venienti cum lampade suo inexstinguibili placitura .occurrere mereatur. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we ask you, Lord, to bless this offering of your servant that she presents on her birthday day, in which you graciously chose to protect her with sacred vestments. We ask you, merciful Lord, to sanctify it so that it may be pleasing to you, the Lord and her Spouse, who comes with his inextinguishable lamp. May he merit to appear. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famulae tuae illius quam tibi offerimus ob diem natalis eius quo eam sacro velamine protegere dignatus es quaesumus Domine placatus accipias pro qua maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut in numero eam sanctarum virginum transire praecipias ut tibi sponso venienti cum lampade suo inexstinguibili possit occurrere atque intra regni caelestis claustra gratias tibi referat choris sanctarum .virginum sociata. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly offer this oblation, the servant of that one for whose birthday you deemed worthy to protect with sacred vestments, we ask you, Lord, pleased to receive it on her behalf. We pour out our prayers before your majesty, suppliant, that you command her to pass among the holy virgins, so that coming to you as a bridegroom with an inextinguishable lamp, she may approach and enter the cloisters of the heavenly kingdom, and there, united with the choir of saintly virgins, she may offer thanks to you. <Through Christ our Lord>.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famulae tuae illius quam tibi offerimus pro famula tua illa quaesumus Domine placatus adspicias pro qua maiestatem tuam supplices exoramus ut sicut eam ad aetatem nuptiis congruentem pervenire tribuisti sic consortio maritali tuo munere copulatam desiderata subole gaudere perficias atque ad optatam seriem cum suo coniuge provehas .benignus annorum. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we present this offering to you, O servant of yours, the one whom we offer; we humbly ask, Lord, that you look favorably upon her. On behalf of your servant, we implore you, gracious Master, that as you granted her to reach the age suitable for marriage, so may she be united in matrimonial grace through your gift and enjoy the desired offspring. May you lead her, benevolent Lord, to a desirable series with her husband. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famuli tui et antistitis tui illius quam tibi offer{e}t ob devotionem mentis suae quaesumus Domine placatus accipias tuaque in eo munera ipse custodias donesque ei annorum spatia ut Ecclesiae tuae feliciter praesidendo te omnia in omnibus operante sic utatur temporalia ut praemia .mereatur aeterna; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So, this offering of your servant and the bishop whom he offers on behalf of his devotion, we humbly ask, Lord. Please receive it graciously, and may you protect and bestow gifts within him for the years to come. May he govern your Church happily, performing all things in all things by your hand, so that he may use temporal goods to merit eternal rewards. May you arrange our days in peace and rescue us from eternal damnation. And we ask that you count him among your elect flock.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famuli tui illius quam tibi offerimus ob diem necessitatis suae pius ac propitius clementi vultu suscipias ut qui de meriti sui qualitate diffidit non iudicium sed indulgentiam sentiat et de adversis prospera percipiat et omni inimici impugnatione depulsa misericordiae tuae praevenientem clementiam tua pietate .adipisci mereatur. Per Chr<istum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly offer this oblation, your servant's, on account of his necessity. May you, gracious and merciful Lord, accept it with a kind and compassionate countenance. May he who doubts in the merit of his own deeds not experience judgment but indulgence, may he perceive good from adversity, and may he be protected from every attack by his enemies by the anticipating clemency of your mercy. May he deserve to obtain it through your pity. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famuli tui illius quam tibi offerimus ob diem (in) quo eum in levitarum sacrari ministeriis contulisti quaesumus Domine placatus accipias eique propitiatus concedas ut cui donasti levitae ministerii facultatem tribuas sufficientem .gratiam ministrandi. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly present this offering of your servant, which we offer to you on the day (in) when you placed him in the levites' sacrificial services. We ask, Lord, that you, being pleased, receive it, and grant him who is propitiated a sufficient grace for ministering. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famuli tui illius quam tibi offerimus pro peccatis atque offensionibus eius ut consequi mereatur remissionem .omnium peccatorum quaesumus Domine placatus accipias; <diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we present this offering of your servant which we offer to you on account of his sins and offenses, so that he may deserve the remission of all sins. Lord, we humbly ask that you, being pleased, accept it; arrange our days in your peace, and deliver us from eternal damnation. Grant us number among your elect. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famuli tui vel famulae tuae illius quam tibi offerunt hanc dedicantes ecclesiam quaesumus Domine placatus accipias nostrasque preces dignanter exaudias ut sint oculi tui aperti super domum istam die ac nocte templumque hoc in honorem beatorum martyrum tuorum illorum vel illarum sanctarum et confessorum sacris mysteriis institutum clementissimus dedica miserator illustra propitius splendore clarifica; cunctam familiam tuam ad aulae huius suffragia concurrentem benignus exaudi eiusdemque conditorum omnia desideria cordis complacita tibi pius adimple votisque responde; augmenta eis annos vitae et temporum felicitatem ut per spatia longaeva viventes melioribus ornamentis studio eorum locus .iste refulgeat; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en:
Therefore, we present this offering of your servant or your servant's, which they offer to you, dedicating the church that we humbly ask, Lord, please accept it with favor and graciously hear our prayers with dignity. May your eyes be open day and night on this house and this temple in honor of your blessed martyrs and saints and confessors who have instituted the sacred mysteries here with compassion and mercy. May you illuminate and brighten them, shining forth.
May you generously hear the prayers of all your family gathered at this court, and may you graciously fulfill the desires of those who establish it. May their pious wishes be pleasing to you, and may you respond to their vows. May they increase the years of their life and find happiness in the days of their long lives. May their place shine brightly with the best decorations from their efforts.
May you arrange our days in peace and free us from eternal damnation, commanding us to be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.>

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famuli vel famulae tuae illius vel illius quam tibi in huius templi sanctificatione offerunt immolandam quaesumus Domine dignanter intende ut aulam quae beati martyris tui illius meritis aequiperari non possit tuae claritatis vultus illustret fiatque tua propitiatione tuis sacris sanctisque digna mysteriis; sit aeternae lucis habitaculum1temporale3 nihil hic mundanae sordes obscuritatesque possideant ut veniens hic populus tuus suae consequatur orationis effectum dignumque locum hunc tua sentiat maiestate dum a te postulata fuerit consecutus sitque aedificantibus in pretio delictorum dum a te non pro sui operis quantitate sed pro offerentium fuerit .devotione suscepta; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly ask You, Lord, to direct Your attention to this offering of the servant or servant of Yours, whether male or female, which they offer for the sanctification of this temple to be immolated. May it not be possible that the court which the merits of Your blessed martyr illuminate be equalized. May Your glory shine upon it and may it be worthy of Your propitiation, holy and sacred mysteries. Let it be a dwelling-place of eternal light, let no earthly dirt or obscurity possess it here so that Your people coming here may attain the effect of their prayers worthy place. May this place feel Your majesty when it has been sought from You. May it be for those building (it) as a reward for sins, not according to the quantity of their work but according to the devotion they have accepted; and may You dispose our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. Count us among Your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famulorum famularumque tuarum quam tibi offerunt annua recolentes mysteria quibus eos tuis adoptasti regalibus institutis quaesumus Domine placatus intende pro quibus supplices preces effundimus ut in eis et collata custodias et promissae beatitudinis .praemia largiaris; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly present this offering of your servants and handmaids, recalling the mysteries by which you have adopted them through your royal institutions. We beseech you, Lord, pleased, to direct your attention towards those for whom we pour out our humble prayers; that in them you grant and guard the promises of promised blessings, and bestow upon them the rewards promised; that you arrange our days in peace, and deliver us from eternal damnation. By Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famulorum famularumque tuarum quam tibi offerunt ob diem in qua Dominus noster Iesus Christus tradidit discipulis suis corporis et sanguinis sui mysteria celebranda quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et tua pietate concedas ut per multa curricula annorum salvi et incolumes munera sua tibi domino .mereantur offerre; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly ask you, Lord, to accept this offering of your servants and handmaids which they offer to you on the day on which our Lord Jesus Christ handed over to his disciples the mysteries of his body and blood for them to celebrate. We ask that you, being pleased, receive it with your mercy and grant that through many courses of years they may merit to offer their gifts safely and unharmed to you, O Lord. And we pray that you will arrange our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation, and count us among the number of your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem famulorum tuorum quam tibi offerunt pro famula tua illa quam perducere dignatus es ad statum mensurae et ad diem nuptiarum pro qua maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut eam propitius cum viro suo .copulare digneris quaesumus Domine ut placatus <accipias; diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So, this offering of your servants which they present to you for your servant whom you have deemed worthy to lead to the state of measurement and to the day of marriage, we humbly pour out our prayers that you may graciously couple her with her husband. We ask You, Lord, that you be pleased to receive her; arrange our days in Your peace, free us from eternal damnation, and command us to be numbered among Your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quaesumus Domine Deus quam tuae maiestati pro peccatis nostris offerimus propitius suscipe et produc de oculis nostris lacrimarum flumina quibus debita flammarum incendia .valeant exstingui; diesque nostros in tua <pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So we humbly ask you, Lord God, the offering that we present to your majesty for our sins. May you graciously accept it and may the rivers of tears flow from our eyes, which should extinguish the fire due to our transgressions. May you arrange our days in peace and free us from eternal damnation. Grant us numbering among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem illius famuli tui quam tibi offer{e}t pro anima famuli tui illius quaesumus Domine propitiatus accipias et miserationum tuarum largitate concedas ut quidquid terrena conversatione contraxit his sacrificiis emundetur ac mortis vinculis absolutus transitum .mereatur ad vitam. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So, we present this offering of your servant, which he offers on behalf of the soul of your servant. We humbly ask you, Lord, to be propitious and to receive it. Through your mercy's bounty, grant that whatever he has contracted in earthly life may be purified by these sacrifices and freed from the bonds of death. May he deserve to pass over to life. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum illarum quaesumus Domine ut propitiatus accipias et miserationum tuarum largitate concedas ut quidquid terrena conversatione contraxerunt his sacrificiis emundentur ac mortis vinculis absolutae transitum .mereantur ad vitam; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to You on behalf of the souls of Your servants and their servants; we humbly ask You, Lord, that You, being propitiated, accept it, and out of Your mercy's generosity grant that whatever they may have contracted in earthly life through these sacrifices may be purified, and released from the bonds of death. May they merit a passage to life; may You dispose our days in peace, and rescue us from eternal damnation. We humbly beseech You to number us among Your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quaesumus Domine placatus accipias quam tibi offerimus pro requie animae famuli tui illius cuius hodie commemorationem celebramus; deposito corpore animam tibi reddidit quam dedisti; tu qui pius es et miseri5cors Deus da ei placidam requiem et in aeternis tabernaculis lucidissimam mansionem ut cum ille dies ille tremendus advenerit eum inter sanctos et electos tuos resuscitare praecipias ad indulgentiam non ad poenam ut portio eius sit in .terra viventium; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly ask you, Lord, to receive this offering, pleased, which we offer to you for the repose of the soul of your servant whose commemoration we celebrate today; with his body laid down, he returned his soul to you, which you gave; you who are a merciful God, grant him peaceful rest and the most brilliant dwelling in eternal tabernacles, so that when the terrible day arrives, you will command him to be resurrected among your saints and elect for the indulgence, not for punishment. Let his portion be among the living on earth; and dispose our days in your peace and free us from eternal damnation. By Christ our Lord, command us to be numbered among your chosen ones.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quaesumus Domine placatus intende quam in sancti Silvestri confessoris et episcopi tui commemoratione suppliciter immolamus ut et nobis proficiat huius pietatis affectus et illum beatitudo .sempiterna glorificet. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly ask You, Lord, to pay attention to this offering, which we devoutly present in memory of your saintly confessor and bishop, Saint Silvester. May the feelings of piety raised by it benefit us, and may he attain eternal beatitude and glorify You forever. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quaesumus Domine quam tibi pro liberatione famulorum tuorum pro tui nominis amore persecutionem patientium simul et consolatione offerimus benignus respicias vultu sereno ut non fraus eos humana deiciat non tua deitas ex iudicio puniat non castigatos iustitia usquequaque demergat non iniquitas propria non adversitas aggravet aliena; quidquid tibi deliquerunt ignosce; quidquid offenderunt in hominibus tu dimitte; submove ab eis cruciatus mentis simul et corporis ut te compuncti requirant a te tacti non doleant per te sustentati adversa despiciant et tibi correcti gratias referant atque bonitate tua gubernati ad te .quandoque perveniant; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly ask you, Lord, this offering that for the liberation of your servants and out of love for your name, we present both their endurance of persecution and their consolation. May a benevolent gaze fall upon them with a serene countenance, so that human deceit does not overthrow them, nor your divinity punish them by judgment, nor justice drown them in chastisement at every point, nor personal wickedness or external adversity aggravate them. May you forgive whatever they have erred and may you absolve their offenses against mankind. Move away from them the torments of mind and body so that when touched by you, they seek you with contrite hearts, do not grieve through you in adversity, despise the hardships endured through you, and thank you when corrected, and when governed by your goodness, may they come to you sometimes.
