May you dispose our days in peace and rescue us from eternal damnation. Grant us that you command us to be numbered among the elect in your flock. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi Domine offero ut anima insidias hostis callidi amovere digneris nec me eius in retis laqueis sinas quaeso ut placatus accipias et maiestatem tuam suppliciter imploro ut mihi non quantum nocere cupit praevaleat sed quidquid illud est quo oculos tuae maiestatis offendi tu potius clementer .castigando detergeas; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I offer this oblation to you, Lord, that you would deign to remove the snares of the wily enemy from my soul, and not allow me to fall into his nets, I ask. May you receive me, appeased, and humbly implore your majesty that whatsoever may offend the eyes of your majesty, you may rather cleanse with merciful correction; and dispose our days in your peace, deliver us from eternal damnation, and number me among your elect. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi ego indignus famulus tuus pro meis facinoribus diluendis veneranter defero quaesumus Domine placatus ac benignus intendas et aures tuae pietatis ad preces humilitatis meae benigne accommodare digneris et misericordiam tuam mihi concedas ut cum de corpore animam meam exire iusseris pars iniqua in me non habeat potestatem sed angelus tuus inter sanctos et electos me collocet ubi lux permanet et .vita regnat; <diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi> et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum <Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I, an unworthy servant of yours, reverently bring before you this offering with which I humbly ask that you be pleased and merciful. May your ears of piety kindly incline towards my humble prayers, and may you grant me your mercy so that an unjust part does not have power over my soul when it leaves my body, but rather place an angel among the saints and elect where light endures and life reigns. May you dispose our days in peace and free us from eternal damnation. And may you command me to be numbered among your elect flock. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi in honorem sancti martyris tui illius vel pro requie <animae> famuli tui illius sacerdotis offerimus quaesumus Domine placatus intende pro qua maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut eam in numero sanctorum tibi placentium facias .dignanter adscribi. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering which we present to you in honor of your holy martyr, for the repose of the soul of his servant, that priest, we humbly ask, Lord, that you, pleased, direct your attention towards our prayers, and, supplicating, we pour out petitions unto your majesty, so that it may be fittingly added to the number of those saints pleasing to you. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus in honorem sanctorum tuorum martyrum et confessurum vel quorum hodie natalicia celebratur vel pro omnibus nobis bona facientibus tam pro vivis quam (et) pro mortuis quaesumus Domine ut dignanter suscipias et tua pietate concedas ut consecuti gratiae tuae dignitatem aeternae vitae .percipiant portionem; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you in honor of your saints, the martyrs and confessors, whose today's natalicia is celebrated or for all of us who do good deeds, whether alive or dead. Lord, we humbly ask that You accept it with worthy reception and grant through Your mercy that they may partake in the dignity of Your grace and eternal life. We pray that You arrange our days in peace and save us from eternal damnation. We also request, Lord, that you command us to be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offer{e}t famula tua illa pro anima famuli tui illius cuius depositionis diem illum celebramus quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et ineffabili pietate concedas ut quod exsequi praeventus condicione mortali ministerio linguae non potuit mereatur indulgentia sempiterna quae in eius mente non .defuit paenitendi. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation which your servant offers for the soul of her servant whose departure day we celebrate. We ask you, Lord, that you, being pleased, receive it and grant, with an inexpressible pity, that what he was unable to fulfill due to the preventive condition of mortal ministry through language, may merit eternal indulgence, which was not lacking in his mind for repentance. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus Domine pro anima famuli tui illius benignus assume eumque regenerationis fonte purgatum et periculis vitae huius exutum beatorum numero digneris .inserere spirituum. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to you; may the benevolent one accept his soul and, purified by the font of regeneration and freed from the perils of this life, deem him worthy to be inserted among the blessed. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus Domine pro incolumitate famulorum famularumque tuarum et quorum in corpore viventium nomina super sanctum altare tuum scripta adesse videntur et qui nobis propria crimina confessi sunt vel nostris orationibus se commendaverunt et pro animabus omnium fidelium catholicorum defunctorum quorum commemorationem agimus vel quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum scripta adesse videntur seu qui in hoc venerabili loco requiescunt quorum numerum et nomina tu solus Domine cognoscis quaesumus Domine dignanter suscipias et tua pietate concedas ut consecuti gratiae tuae dignitatem aeternae vitae .percipiant portionem; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we present this offering to you on behalf of the health of your servants and their servants, and those whose names appear written on your holy altar as if present, and who have confessed their own sins to us or commended themselves to our prayers, and for the souls of all Catholic faithful departed whose memory we keep or whose names appear written on your holy altar, or those who rest in this venerable place, whose number and names you alone, Lord, know. We humbly ask you, Lord, graciously receive it and grant through your mercy that they may receive the portion of your grace; that you dispose our days in peace, deliver us from eternal damnation, and count us among your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus Domine pro tuorum requie famulorum et famularum illorum et illarum et omnium fidelium catholicorum orthodoxorum in hac basilica in Christo quiescentium et qui in circuitu huius Ecclesiae tuae requiescunt quaesumus Domine placatus accipias ut per haec salutis humanae subsidia in tuorum numero redemptorum sorte .perpetua censeantur; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation to You. We humbly ask that You, pleased, accept it on behalf of Your servants and their attendants, both male and female, and all the Catholic Orthodox faithful resting in peace in this basilica and those resting around Your Church. We implore You, Lord, to count them among the redeemed for eternity through these subsidies of human salvation. Dispose our days in Your peace and save us from eternal damnation. Grant us, Lord, that You command us to be numbered among Your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro requie famuli tui illius quaesumus Domine propitiatus accipias ut per haec salutis humanae subsidia in tuorum numero redemptorum sorte .perpetua censeatur; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation on behalf of the repose of your servant. We humbly ask you, merciful one, to receive it, so that through these aids of human salvation, he may be considered among the number of the redeemed eternally. May you arrange our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. And we pray that you command us to be numbered among your elect flock. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus in huius consecratione baptisterii quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et tua pietate concedas ut quoscumque fons iste lavaturus est omnium criminum abolitione purgentur atque famulis tuis conditoribus mercedem tanti operis promissae .retributionis impendas. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we present this offering that we offer in the consecration of this baptistry, Lord, we humbly ask that you, being pleased, receive it and grant through your mercy that whoever will be washed by this font, their sins may be cleansed and purged completely. May the reward promised for such a great work be bestowed upon your servants, the creators. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus ob diem ieiunii cenae dominicae in qua Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus in novo testamento sacrificandi ritum instituit dum panem ac vinum quod Melchisedech in praefiguratione futuri mysterii sacerdos obtulerat in sacramento sui corporis et .sanguinis transformavit quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So this offering we make to you for the day of the fasting supper of the Lord's Day, on which our Lord Jesus Christ Your Son established the ritual of sacrifice in the new testament, when He transformed the bread and wine that Melchisedech offered as a foreshadowing of the future mystery into the sacrament of His own body and blood. We ask You, Lord, to receive it pleasingly; to dispose our days in Your peace, to free us from eternal damnation, and to count us among Your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus ob diem ieiunii cenae dominicae in qua Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus in novo testamento sacrificandi situm instituit dum panem ac vinum quod Melchisedech in praefiguratione futuri mysterii sacerdos obtulerat in sacramentum sui corporis et sanguinis transformavit – celebranda quaesumus Domine placatus intende ut per multa curricula annorum salvi et incolumes munera nostra tibi domino .mereamur offerre; diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you on the day of the fasting cena (supper) of the Lord's Day, when our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, instituted in the New Testament the place for sacrifice, namely bread and wine, which Melchisedech offered as a prefiguration of the future mystery, and transformed into a sacrament of His own body and blood – we humbly ask You, Lord, pleased, to direct Your attention, that through many cycles of years, we may merit to offer our gifts safely and unhurt to You, Lord. May You dispose our days in Your peace, and deliver us from eternal damnation; and may You command us to be numbered among Your elect flock. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli et sacerdotis tui illius quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et miserationum tuarum largitate concedas ut quidquid terrena conversatione contraxit his sacrificiis emundetur ac mortis vinculo absoluta transitum .mereatur ad vitam; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, O Lord, we offer this oblation for the soul of your servant and priest, that servant. We humbly ask you to receive it graciously and grant him the mercy of your generosity, so that whatever he may have contracted in earthly life may be purified by these sacrifices and set free from the bond of death. May he merit eternal life; may you dispose our days in peace and rescue us from eternal condemnation. And we implore you to count him among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius cuius commemorationem agimus tribuens ei remissionem .omnium peccatorum quaesumus Domine ut placatus <accipias; diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you for the soul of your servant whose commemoration we make, granting him remission of all sins. Lord, we ask that, appeased, you receive it; and that you arrange our days in peace, and free us from eternal damnation. And command us to be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius cuius depositionis diem illum celebramus quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et ineffabili pietate concedas ut quod exsequi praeventus condicione mortali ministerio linguae non potuit mereatur .indulgentia sempiterna; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you on behalf of the soul of your servant whose departure day we commemorate; we humbly ask, Lord, that you accept it, and out of ineffable pity grant him who was unable to fulfill what was due to mortal condition through service and language, eternal indulgence. Dispose our days in peace for us, deliver us from eternal damnation, and command us to be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et ei per hoc sacrificium quod esse cunctis remedium singulare voluisti salutem .tribuas sempiternam; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you on behalf of the soul of your servant, and we humbly ask, Lord, that you receive it graciously, and grant him through this unique sacrifice, which you willed to be a remedy for all, eternal salvation. May you arrange our days in your peace and free us from eternal damnation. And may you command that he be numbered among your elect. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius Domine quaesumus placatus intendas et ut fructum boni operis consequatur quae in his locis christiana promisit .mente perficias; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So this offering that we present to you, Lord, for the soul of your servant, we humbly ask that you consider it favorably and grant him the fruit of good works as promised in Christian places. May you complete this in his mind; may you arrange our days in peace and save us from eternal damnation. We pray that you command him to be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius episcopi quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et quem tuis altaribus servire tribuisti ad beatorum pertinere iubeas .consortia sacerdotum; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to You on behalf of the soul of Your servant, that bishop. We humbly ask You, Lord, to receive it graciously and to command him who You granted to serve at the altars of the blessed, to enjoy eternal fellowship with the clergy; and to arrange our days in Your peace, deliver us from eternal damnation, and enroll us in the fold of Your elect. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias humili prece poscentes ut quidquid in ea reatus conscientiae accusat miseratio tuae pietatis absolvat quia si reatus debitae <mortis> misericordiae tuae benignitas non relaxat nullus a culpa .liber exsistit; diesque nostros <in tua pace  disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to You on behalf of the soul of Your servant; we humbly ask You, Lord, that You may be appeased and accept this lowly prayer of ours. We beg that Your mercy may absolve whatever guilt may be present in this oblation, according to the conscience of the person offering it, because if the debt of guilt for death is not released by Your mercy, no one can escape. We ask that You dispose our days in Your peace and free us from eternal damnation. And we pray that You command us to be numbered among Your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius cuius depositionis diem celebramus quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias humili prece poscentes ut quidquid in ea reatus conscientiae accusat miseratio tuae pietatis absolvat quia si reatum debitae mortis misericordiae tuae benignitas non relaxat nullus a culpa liber exsistit; quapropter petimus ut ei veniam .peccatorum tribuas; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you on behalf of the soul of your servant whose departure day we celebrate. We ask you, Lord, that you graciously accept our humble prayer and grant that whatever guilt is charged in his conscience by reason of any debt or error, may your mercy free him from. For if your kindness does not relax the debt of required death, no one can be free from sin. Therefore, we plead for pardon for his sins; arrange our days in your peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. May you command that he be numbered among your elect flock. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro commemoratione depositionis animae famuli et sacerdotis tui illius episcopi quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et quem in corpore constitutum sedis apostolicae gubernaculo praeesse voluisti in electorum tuorum numero .constitue sacerdotum; diesque nostros in tua pace dispone <atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iube grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So we offer this oblation to You for the commemoration of the deposition of the soul of Your servant and bishop, whom You wished to govern with the office of the apostolic see. We ask You, Lord, to be pleased, and to establish him as a priest; dispose our days in Your peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. Count us among Your chosen ones within Your flock. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro Ecclesia tua sancta catholica quaesumus Domine propitio vultu inspicere et sanctificare dignare et concede per tuam immensam clementiam et Filii tui caritatem spiritusque tui gratiam et gubernationem ut contra omnium inimicorum visibilium scilicet et invisibilium insidias munita ac conservata maneat praesentisque vitae cursum in sancta conversatione consummans retributionem aeternae felicitatis et perpetuae beatitudinis cum sanctis et electis angelis percipere mereatur per sanctam et .individuam Trinitatem. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly offer this oblation to Your holy Catholic Church. We ask You, Lord, with a favorable countenance, to look upon it and deign to bless and grant it through Your immeasurable mercy, the love of Your Son, the grace and guidance of Your Spirit, so that, protected and preserved against the attacks of all visible and invisible enemies, it may continue its course in holy life and complete its reward of eternal happiness and perpetual beatitude. May it deserve to perceive it among the saints and chosen angels through the Holy and Undivided Trinity. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro famulis tuis quos ad presbyterii ve! diaconatus gradus promovere dignatus es quaesumus Domine placatus suscipias et quod eis divino munere contulisti in eis propitius tuo .dono custodi. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering which we present to you for your servants whom you have deemed worthy of promotion to the ranks of presbyter and deacon, we humbly ask, Lord, that you, being pleased, receive it. And whatever divine gift you have bestowed upon them, may you graciously keep it upon them. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo qui aegritudinis languore deprimitur quaesumus Domine placatus accipias pro quo maiestatem tuam suppliciter imploramus ut ei integram restituas .corporis sanitatem; diesque nostros in tua <pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to You for Your servant who is oppressed by the lingering illness. We humbly ask You, Lord, that You accept it on his behalf, for whom we humbly implore Your majesty. May You grant him a complete restoration of health. Dispose our days in peace and free us from eternal damnation. We also pray that You command him to be numbered among Your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo ut des ei caeleste desiderium et in exitu corporis sui .spiritus refrigerium quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias; <diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: We offer this oblation to You, Lord, for Your servant there, so that he may obtain celestial desire and a spirit of refreshment in the departure of his body. We humbly ask You, Lord, to receive him, pleased; and that You dispose our days in Your peace, and rescue us from eternal damnation. And we beg You, Lord, to number us among Your elect sheep through Christ Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo ut omnium peccatorum suorum veniam consequi mereatur quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et miserationis tuae largitate concedas ut fiat ei ad veniam delictorum et actuum emendationem ut et hic valeat bene vivere et ad aeternam beatitudinem .feliciter pervenire; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione noseripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you for your servant, that he may deserve to obtain the forgiveness of all his sins. We ask you, Lord, appeased, that you accept it and grant through your mercy that it becomes for him a forgiveness of offenses and an improvement of actions, so that he may live well here and reach eternal beatitude. May your days be arranged in peace for us, and may we not be received into eternal damnation but rather numbered among the elect in your flock. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo ut remissionem omnium peccatorum suorum et veniam .consequi mereatur quaesumus Domine placatus <accipias; diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to You on behalf of Your servant, that he may deserve remission of all his sins and forgiveness. We humbly ask You, Lord, appeased; receive it. Dispose our days in Your peace and save us from eternal damnation. Grant us a place among Your chosen ones. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro famulos et famulabus tuis quorum commemorationem agimus et pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum omnium fidelium catholicorum orthodoxorum et qui in hoc loco venerabili requiescunt et in circuitu huius ecclesiae quorum numerum et nomina tu solus Domine cognoscis et quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum scripta esse videntur quaesumus Domine ut dignanter suscipias et tua pietate concedas ut consecuti tuae gratiae dignitatem aeternae vitae .percipiant portionem. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you, for your servants and those who serve you, whose memory we bear; and also for the souls of all your servants, both male and female, Catholic and Orthodox, who rest in this venerable place, and around this church, whose number and names only you, Lord, know, and whose names seem to be written before your holy altar. We ask, Lord, that you accept it worthily and grant, with your pity, that they may receive the dignity of your grace and eternal life. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro illo famulo tuo quem ad pontificalem gloriam promovere dignatus es quaesumus Domine placatus accipias ut quod divino munere consecutus est divinis .effectibus exsequatur. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So we offer this oblation to You for Your servant whom You have deemed worthy of promotion to the pontifical glory, we humbly ask You, Lord. May You be pleased to receive it. May He who has attained his position by divine grace carry out his duties with divine power. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro his quos ex aqua et spiritu sancto regenerare dignatus es tribuens eis remissionem omnium peccatorum quaesumus <Domine> placatus accipias eorumque nomina adscribi iubeas in .libro viventium. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you, for those whom you have seen fit to regenerate with water and the Holy Spirit, granting them remission of all sins. We humbly ask, Lord, that you be pleased to accept them, and command their names to be inscribed in the book of the living. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro peccatis atque offensionibus famuli tui illius ut consequi mereatur remissionem .omnium peccatorum quaesumus Domine <ut placatus accipias; diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So we offer this oblation to you, on behalf of the sins and offenses of your servant that he may deserve remission of all sins. We humbly ask you, Lord, that you accept it pleasingly; arrange our days in peace, and free us from eternal damnation. Grant us number among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offero Domine pro peccatis meis nimiis atque offensionibus maiestatem tuam Deus piissime humili prece deposco ut dignanter suscipias exorans ut dimittas crimina quae carnis fragilitate atque temptationibus iniquorum spirituum nequiter admisi et reverti ad ea non sinas ultra sed confirma me in iustificationibus tuis et perseverantiam mihi tribue et fac me dignum ante conspectum tuum adstare et sacrificium tibi Domine casto corpore et mundo corde .digne offerre; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I offer this oblation to You, Lord, on my behalf for my many sins and great offenses; with humble prayer I beseech Your most merciful Majesty that You graciously receive it. I implore You to forgive the crimes that by the frailty of flesh and temptations of unrighteous spirits I have wickedly admitted, and do not allow me to return to them any more. Instead, confirm me in Your justifications and grant me perseverance. And make me worthy, Lord, to stand before You with a clean body and pure heart; worthily offer this sacrifice to You. Dispose our days in peace and free us from eternal damnation. Count me among Your chosen ones, Lord. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offero ego famulus tuus clementissime Pater ut libenter excipias deprecor orationesque meas dignanter intendas tribulationes cordis mei misericorditer auferas placabilis vota suscipias libens desideria compleas clemens peccata dimittas crimina benignus abstergeas flagella propitius redimas languores miseratus excludas serenissimo vultu petitionibus meis aurem accommodes gratiam tuam multipliciter augeas et misericordiam tuam .incessabiliter largiaris; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I, your humble servant most merciful Father, pray and beseech you to accept this offering with pleasure, to direct my prayers graciously, to alleviate the sorrows of my heart mercifully, to fulfill my wishes willingly, to complete my desires, to forgive my sins kindly, to blot out my offenses benevolently, to remove the scourges propitiously, to redeem my weaknesses compassionately, to exclude my afflictions from your most serene countenance, to accommodate your grace abundantly and multiply your mercy incessantly. Through Christ our Lord, may you arrange our days in peace and rescue us from eternal damnation, and command that we be numbered among the elect in your flock. May you amplify your grace and bestow endless mercy upon us.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offero ego tuus famulus et sacerdos pro eo quod me nulla prorsus iustitia confidentem sed ineffabilis misericordiae largitate tribuisti sacerdotalem subire famulatum quaesumus <Domine> placatus accipias et tua pietate confirmes quod es operatus in nobis diesque meos clementissima .gubernatione disponas.Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I offer this oblation to you, your servant and priest, for the fact that not even any justice makes me confident, but rather by the ineffable bounty of mercy, you have granted me to undertake priesthood. We humbly ask, Lord, that you accept it pleasingly and confirm through your pity what you have worked in us on my days. May you dispose them with your most merciful governance through our Lord Christ.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offero ego tuus famulus et sacerdos pro eo quod omni suffragio cessante iustitiae per affluentiam pietatis immensae sacris altaribus ine .servire tribuisti quaesumus Domine <ut placatus accipias; diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I offer this oblation which I present to you, Your servant and priest, on behalf of him whom all suffrage of justice ceasing, you have granted to serve at the altars flowing with immense piety. We ask You, Lord, that You would receive us graciously as we are pleasing; that You would arrange our days in Your peace and free us from eternal damnation. And may You command that we be numbered among Your elect flock. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offero ego tuus famulus (hodie) ob diem quo ine nullis dignum meritis sed solo tuae misericordiae dono ad hunc locum perducere dignatus es presbyterii quaeso <Domine> placatus accipias maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecans ut sicut me sacris altaribus tua dignatio sacerdotali servire praecepit officio ita et dignum .praestet et meritum. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I offer this oblation to You, Your servant (today), on the day when I am not worthy for any merits but solely for Your mercy, which You have deemed worthy to bring me to this place through the office of a priest. Lord, I ask that You receive Your majesty with a placated heart, humbly imploring You to grant me as You commanded with sacerdotal service, both the worthiness and the merit. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offero ego tuus famulus quaeso Domine placatus intende et suppliciter deprecor maiestatem tuam ut in me et condonata custodias et promissae beatitudinis praemia largiaris et sicut me sacris altaribus tua dignatio servire praecepit officio sacerdotali ita dignum .praestet et meritum. Per <Christum> dominum <nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I present this offering to you, Lord, my servant I ask that You, being pleased, direct Your attention and humbly I beseech Your majesty to watch over me and keep me in your mercy. Grant the rewards promised for beatitude, and as Your dignity commanded me to serve at the sacred altars, may it also grant worthiness and merit through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offero omnipotens Deus ego inutilis servus tuus pro fragilitate corporis mei dignanter suscipiens dele quaeso crimina mea piissime pater reverti non sinas me ad ea ultra ut quando me egredi iusseris de corpore non habeat inimicus quod in me de suis malis reperiat nec flamina quod exurat sed tu piissime pater .veniam tribuas; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I, your unworthy servant, offer this oblation to you, almighty God, on account of the fragility of my body. I humbly ask that you graciously receive my offering and forgive my sins, most compassionate Father. Do not allow me to return to those things when you command me to leave this body. May there be no enemy within me who can find fault in me for your own evils, nor may the fire consume me; but grant me mercy, most compassionate Father. Dispose our days in your peace and save us from eternal damnation. Count us among your elect, in your flock. Through Christ, our Lord.>

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi Domine offero inutilis servus tuus pro fragilitate corporis mei et animae quaeso placatus accipias. – Dele per hanc oblationem obsecro crimina vitiorum meorum nec me ad ea ultra aliquatenus sinas reverti ut quando de meo corpore exire animam meam iusseris non habeat inimicus quod de suis in me malis reperiat nec gehennae edax flamma quod exurat sed tu pater piissime veniam tribuendo potius .invenias quod remuneres. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering that I, your unworthy servant, present to you, Lord, I humbly ask that you, being appeased, receive it on account of the fragility of my body and soul. - Through this offering, I humbly beseech you to forgive the sins committed by me; do not let me return to them any longer. When you command my soul to depart from my body, may no enemy find anything against me that they might have found in my misdeeds, nor may the devouring flame of hell consume me. But rather, most merciful Father, grant me forgiveness and may you find what you may reward. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offero pro remissione omnium peccatorum meorum atque etiam pro salute et absolutione vivorum seu defunctorum quorum et quarum nomina ad memorandum conscripsimus suppliciter deprecor ut interventu beatae Mariae semper virginis omniumque sanctorum tuorum .placatus accipias; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I humbly offer this oblation to you for the remission of all my sins and also for the health and absolution of the living or the dead whose names we have written down to remember. I earnestly beseech You that through the intervention of the Blessed Virgin Mary, ever virgin, and all your saints, you may be pleased to receive it; and may You dispose our days in Your peace, and deliver us from eternal damnation. And may You command us to be numbered among Your elect flock. Through Christ Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro adipiscenda patientia ministerio piae servitutis .humiliter immolamus quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly offer this oblation to You for obtaining patience through pious service. We ask You, Lord, that You be pleased to receive it; and that You dispose our days in Your peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. And we pray that You command us to be numbered among Your elect. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro anima famuli tui illius abbatis atque sacerdotis offerimus quaesumus Domine placatus intende pro qua maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut eam in numero sanctorum tuorum tibi placentium facias .dignanter adscribi; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation on behalf of the soul of your servant, that abbot and priest, which we humbly ask, Lord, that you accept it in your presence. We pour out our prayers to the majesty of your divinity that you may fittingly assign this offering among the saints pleasing to you; that you dispose our days in peace and free us from eternal damnation. By Christ our Lord, we pray that you command us to be numbered among your chosen ones.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro animabus fratrum nostrorum quaesumus Domine placatus intende pro quibus maiestati tuae suppliciter fundimus preces ut eas in numero sanctorum tuorum tibi placentium facias .dignanter adscribi; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you on behalf of the souls of our brethren, and we humbly ask you, Lord, that you, being pleased, direct your attention to those for whom we fervently pour out prayers before your majesty. We beseech you to graciously include them in the number of your saints pleasing to you; may you arrange our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. By Christ our Lord, command us to be numbered among his elect.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam <tibi> pro anima famuli tui illius offerimus quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias maiestatem tuam suppliciter deprecantes ut per huius mysteria sacramenti sine quibus nemo potest a peccatis absolvi indulgentiam sempiternam mereatur adipisci et gloriam regni .caelestis possidere; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering that we present to you on behalf of the soul of your servant, we humbly ask, Lord, that you accept it graciously. We implore you that through the mystery of this sacred sacrament, by which no one can be absolved from sins, may you grant eternal indulgence and possession of the glory of the celestial kingdom. May you arrange our days in your peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. And we pray that you count us among the chosen ones in your flock. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro anima famuli tui illius offerimus quam hodie a carnali corruptione liberasti quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et quidquid humanae condicionis subreptione contraxit expedias ut tuis purificata remediis ad gaudium .sempiternum perveniat; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to you on behalf of the soul of your servant whom today you have freed from carnal corruption. We humbly ask, Lord, that pleased with our offering, you receive it and remove whatever human condition has deceitfully contracted. May those purified by your remedies reach eternal joy; may you dispose our days in peace and save us from eternal damnation. Furthermore, we beg that you count us among the flock of your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum venerantes deferimus quaesumus Domine placatus intende et tua dignatione concede ut mortis vinculis absoluti transitum .mereantur ad vitam. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, the offering that we bring before You for the souls of Your servants and their servants, we humbly present. We ask You, Lord, gracious and merciful, to pay attention with favor and grant by Your grace that they may be absolved from the bonds of death, and merit life. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro commemoratione animarum in pace dormientium suppliciter immolamus quaesumus Domine benignus accipias et tua pietate concedas ut et nobis proficiat huius pietatis affectus et illis impetret .beatitudinem sempiternam. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly offer this oblation to you in remembrance of the souls sleeping in peace. We ask you, gracious Lord, that you accept it and grant, through your mercy, that the affection of this piety may benefit us and pray for them eternal beatitude. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro famulo tuo illo gregeque sibi commisso et propinquitate ac familiaritate coniunctis et salute totius populi christiani suppliciter immolamus quaesumus Domine benignus accipias et tua pietate concedas ut et illis proficiat huius petitionis effectus et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum illarum et omnium fidelium defunctorum impetret .beatitudinem sempiternam; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly offer this oblation to you, Lord, for your servant and that flock entrusted to him, bound together by kinship, familiarity, and the well-being of the whole Christian people. We entreat you, Lord, be merciful and grant it through your mercy that the outcome of this petition may benefit them, and that the souls of your servants, their servants, and all deceased faithful may gain eternal blessedness; may you arrange our days in peace and rescue us from eternal damnation, and command us to be numbered among your elect flock. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro defunctis offerimus quaesumus Domine propitiatus accipias et miserationis tuae largitate concedas ut ab omnibus quae per terrenam conversationem (con)traxerunt his .sacrificiis emundentur. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering that we present to You on behalf of the deceased, we humbly ask, Lord, that You, being merciful, receive it and grant Your mercy, so that all who have been bound by earthly life (through) may be purified by these sacrifices. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro depositione famuli et sacerdotis tui illius deferimus quaesumus Domine placatus intende pro qua maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut eum in numero tibi placentium censeri .facias sacerdotum. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering which we present to you on behalf of the deposition of your servant and priest, we humbly ask, Lord, that you pay attention for the sake of your majesty, and pour out our prayers as suppliants. May he be considered among those pleasing to you. Make him a priest. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro innumeris peccatis atque offensionibus meis offero Domine benignus assume et quidquid in cogitationibus pessimis in concupiscentia atque delectatione immunda in meditationibus et exemplis pravis in persuasionibus nocuis in consensu malo in consilio iniquo in familiaritatis talento in verbis otiosis et in noxio iuramento in amicis in inimicis in subiectis in laesione et scandalo proximorum servorumque tuorum in negotiis ecclesiasticis in reipublicae utilitatibus deliqui sive quaeque hoste suggerente carne delectante spiritu consentiente malitia infirmitate ignorantia quoquo modo peccavi totum ineffabili pietate tua huius virtute mysterii et interventu beatae Mariae virginis dele et absterge et iram tuae indignationis quam in his provocavi a me miseratus expelle et quidquid terrena fragilitate in me corruptum quidquid diabolica fraude est vitiatum perfecta remissione restitue mentemque meam munere compunctionis aperi ut tua inspiratione compunctus malum amare defleam quod inique gessi et bonum quod diligenter perdidi per indebitam pietatis tuae gratiam acquiram meque ab immundis cogitationibus et noxiis delectationibus vel ab omnibus immunditiis mentis et corporis seu a cunctis diabolicis insidiis et illusionibus vel persuasionibus sive contagiis misericorditer ac potenter expurges semper et munias atque omnibus bonis exornes et in nullo me a voluntate tua oberrare nec a veritatis tramite recedere sinas omnisque mea actio et a te semper incipiat et per te coepta finiatur donumque continentiae atque finem perfectum mihi tribuere et electorum tuorum me iungere .consortio digneris. Per Christum Dominum o nostrum.
translation_en: Therefore, the offering that I present to You, Lord, for innumerable sins and offenses of mine, graciously receive and cleanse whatever has been conceived in my worst thoughts, desires, and unclean meditations; in wicked persuasions, in malicious intentions, in evil counsel, in an unjust scheme, in the talent of familiarity, in idle words, and in harmful oaths; in friends, enemies, subjects, in hurting and scandalizing my neighbors and Your servants; in ecclesiastical affairs, in the benefits of the republic, or by any means I have sinned. With every enticement of the flesh, with a consenting spirit, with wickedness, infirmity, ignorance—in whatever way I have sinned—with Your ineffable pity, You will wipe away and cleanse this sin through the virtue of this mystery and the intervention of the Blessed Virgin Mary. Drive away from me the anger of Your indignation that I have provoked, and, mercifully expel it. Restore whatever has been corrupted by earthly frailty or corrupted by diabolical deceit with perfect forgiveness. Open my mind through the gift of compunction, so that I, moved by Your inspiration, may weep for the evil I have done and the good that I have carelessly neglected; through an undeserved grace, I will acquire the good that You grant me, and free myself from unclean thoughts and harmful desires or from all impurities of mind and body, or from every diabolical trap and illusion or persuasion. With mercy and power, cleanse me, adorn me with every goodness, and never let me deviate from Your will or stray from the path of truth. May my every action begin and end with You, and may You grant me the gift of continence and its perfect end. May You deign to unite me with the company of Your elect. Through Christ Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro requie et anima famuli tui illius offerimus quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et tua pietate concedas ut mortalitatis nexibus absolutam inter fideles tuos habere .constituas portionem. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we present this offering to You on behalf of the rest and soul of Your servant, that he may be released from the bonds of mortality. We humbly ask, Lord, that You, being pleased, accept it and through Your mercy grant that he may dwell among Your faithful as a free portion. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro requie animae famuli tui illius offerimus quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et tua pietate concedas ut mortalitatis nexibus absoluta inter fideles tuos mereatur .habere portionem. Per Christum <Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, the offering we present to you on behalf of the rest of the soul of your servant, we humbly ask, Lord. May you be pleased to receive it, and through your mercy may he be freed from the bonds of mortality, and among your faithful, deserve to have a share. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro requie et animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum offerimus quaesumus Domine propitius intuere et concede ut et mortuis prosit ad veniam quod cunctis viventibus praeparare .dignatus es ad medelam. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, the offering which we present to you for the repose and souls of your servants and their servants, we humbly ask, Lord, that you graciously look upon and grant, so that it may benefit the dead with pardon, and prepare pardon for all living beings. You have been deemed merciful. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi pro requie animarum famulorum famularumque tuarum offerimus quaesumus Domine propitius intuere et concede ut mortuis prosit ad veniam quod cunctis viventibus praeparare .dignatus es ad medelam; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, the offering we present to you on behalf of the rest of the souls of your servants and theirs, we humbly ask, Lord, that you look upon it favorably and grant that it may benefit the dead in obtaining forgiveness. You are worthy to heal; may you arrange our days in peace and free us from eternal damnation. And we beseech you to number us among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi sollemni devotione suppliciter immolamus quaesumus Domine benignus accipias et omnium sanctorum tuorum meritis concedas ut et nostrae fiat per eam vitae profectus tutela et firmamentum et famulis famulabusque tuis tam vivis quam defunctis quorum nomina hoc libello inscripta tenentur beatitudinis sempiternae valeamus .impetrare suffragium; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly offer this oblation to You with solemn devotion. We beseech You, Lord, gracious one, to receive it and grant us progress in life through the merits of all Your saints. May it be a safeguard and foundation for us. And may we, Your servants and those who serve You, both living and dead, whose names are recorded in this book for eternal beatitude, be enabled to seek Your help. We implore Your assistance; dispose our days in Your peace, free us from eternal damnation, and command that we be numbered among Your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem sancti patris nostri illius episcopi quam tibi offerimus ob diem quo eum pontificali benedictione ditasti quaesumus Domine placatus accipias praebe ei quaesumus aetatis spatia prolixiora cuius sacerdotii nobis tempora dignatus es .donare praecipua. <Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation to your holy father, that bishop, whom you adorned with the pontifical blessing on the day in question. We humbly ask you, Lord, to be pleased to receive it. Grant him, we pray, a longer span of life because you have graciously chosen to bestow upon us the time of his priesthood. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis meae pater sancte quae licet meis manibus offeratur qui nec invocationem tui nominis facere dignus sum prae multitudinem iniquitatis meae tamen quia per sanctificatum Filii tui nomen hanc offero oblationem benignus assume atque humiliter postulo ut sicut incensum in conspectu tuo adscendat in .odorem suavitatis. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So this offering of my servitude, holy Father, which is presented by my unworthy hands, I offer it to you, who neither am I worthy to make the invocation of your name because of the multitude of my sins; yet because through the sanctified name of your Son, this offering is presented. Kindly accept and humbly ask that it ascend in your sight like incense in the fragrance of sweetness. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis meae quam tibi Domine ob multitudinem peccatorum meorum offero quaeso placatus accipias et clementiam tuam totis viribus cordis imploro ut quidquid fallente diabolo corde ore et opere contra tuam voluntatem commisi pia miseratione remittas ac fidei spei caritatisque virtutem et lumen gratiae tuae mihi indigno famulo tuo tua largitate .placatus tribuas; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I humbly offer this oblation of my servitude to you, Lord, on account of my multitude of sins. I beg that you, being appeased, receive it, and I implore the full strength of your compassion to have mercy on me, a wretched servant of yours. May whatever I have committed against your will, through a deceiving devil in heart, speech, or deed, be forgiven by your pious mercy, and may the power and light of faith, hope, charity, and your grace be given to me. Through Christ our Lord, grant that you are pleased, arrange our days in peace, deliver us from eternal damnation, and count me among the number of your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis meae quam tibi offero Domine ego supplex famulus tuus pro remissione omnium .peccatorum meorum quaesumus Domine ut placatus <accipias; diesque nostros iri tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, I humbly offer to you this oblation of my servitude; for the remission of all my sins, we entreat you, Lord. May it please you to receive us; may our days be spent in your peace, and deliver us from eternal damnation. Grant us a place among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis meae quam tibi offero ego indignus famulus tuus pro remissione omnium peccatorum meorum suppliciter te Domine deprecor ut placatus accipias et quem propriae conscientiae reatus accusat bonitatis tuae .veniam promerear diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum domi?num nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, I humbly offer this unworthy offering of my servitude to You. I beseech You, Lord, that You, being appeased, may grant me pardon for all my sins. May You dispose the days of ours in Your peace and free us from eternal damnation. Grant me that I may be numbered among Your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus Domine pro peccatis atque offensionibus et pro infirmitatibus famuli tui illius ut omnium delictorum nostrorum veniam .consequi mereamur quaesumus Domine ut placatus <accipias diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering of our servitude that we present to you, Lord, for our sins and offenses, as well as for the infirmities of your servant, that we may deserve forgiveness of all our transgressions. We humbly ask you, Lord, to receive us graciously, arrange our days in peace, deliver us from eternal damnation, and count us among your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus in honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et in commemorationem beatae Mariae semper virginis et beatorum apostolorum et martyrum et consessorum ac virginum tuarum pro incolumitate nostra et pro famulis ac famulabus tuis quorum commemorationem agimus et pro animabus famulorum famularumque tuarum quorum nomina ante sanctum altare tuum scripta <esse> videntur quaesumus Domine ut dignanter suscipias et tua pietate concedas ut consecuti gratiae tuae dignitatem aeternae percipiant .vitae portionem; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering of our servitude that we offer to You, Lord holy Father omnipotent eternal God, in honor of Our Lord Jesus Christ and in commemoration of the blessed Mary ever virgin, the blessed apostles, martyrs, consessors, and virgins Your own, for our safety and for the servants and servant-girls whose commemoration we make, and for the souls of the servants, servant-girls, and Your own whose names appear written before Your holy altar. We humbly ask You, Lord, that You graciously accept it and grant through Your pity that they who follow in the grace of Your own may perceive the portion of eternal life; that You dispose our days in Your peace, and deliver us from eternal damnation. And we implore You to count us among Your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus in die hodiernae sollemnitatis quo nobis indignis sacerdotalem infulam tribuisti quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et tua pietate conserva quod es .operatus in nobis; diesque nostros in tua pace dispone <atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iube grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly present this offering of our servitude that we offer you today on this solemn occasion, when you bestowed upon us the priestly mitre, which we are unworthy to receive. We beseech You, Lord, to accept it graciously and preserve what You have worked within us; may our days be ordered in Your peace, and may You deliver us from eternal damnation. Furthermore, we humbly ask that You count us among Your elect flock. Through Christ Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius episcopi quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et tua pietate concedas ut qui beati Petri apostoli sedem vicario <est> secutus officio tuae quoque gratiae largitate perpetuam dignitatis apostolicae .percipiat portionem. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering of our servitude which we present to you on behalf of the soul of your servant, that bishop, we humbly ask, Lord, that you, being pleased, receive and grant with your mercy that he who has followed the office as the vicar of the seat of blessed Peter, Apostle, may obtain a portion of the perpetual dignity of the apostolic office. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus pro anima famuli tui illius episcopi quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et cum praesulibus apostolicae dignitatis quorum est secutus officium habere tribuas sempiternae .beatitudinis portionem; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation of our service for the soul of your servant, that bishop. We humbly ask you to be pleased to receive it, and to grant him a share in the everlasting beatitude. Dispose our days in peace and save us from eternal damnation. Let us be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus pro commemoratione animae famuli tui illius quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et cum praesulibus apostolicae dignitatis quorum est secutus officium habere tribuas sempiternae beatitudinis portionem atque inter summi pastoris efficias praecipua .membra censeri; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we humbly offer this oblation of our service for the commemoration of the soul of your servant, whom you followed in the office. We ask, Lord, that you, being pleased, receive it. Grant him a share of everlasting beatitude and make him to be numbered among the principal members of the flock of the highest pastors. Dispose our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. By Christ our Lord, we pray that you command him to be counted among your chosen ones.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus pro famulo tuo illo ut remissionem omnium peccatorum suorum consequi mereatur quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et miserationis tuae largitate concedas ut fiat ei ad veniam delictorum et ad optatam emendationem ut hic bene valeat vivere et ad aeternam beatitudinem .mereatur pervenire; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So, we offer this oblation of our servitude to you for your servant, that he may deserve remission of all his sins. We ask You, Lord, that, being pleased, You grant it and bestow Your mercy's bounty so that it becomes for him forgiveness of offenses and the desired amendment. That here he may live well and attain to eternal beatitude. May You arrange our days in peace and rescue us from eternal damnation. And command that we be numbered among Your elect. Through Christ Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus pro peccatis atque offensionibus nostris quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et quos sanctae compunctionis ardore ab hominum ceterorum proposito segregasti ad beatorum pertinere facias .consortia monachorum; diesque nostros in tua <pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation of our servitude to you, for our sins and offenses, Lord, we humbly ask that you, being pleased, receive it. And those whom the fiery compunction of holy people has set apart for the fellowship of monks, arrange our days in your peace, and save us from eternal damnation. We beseech you to number us among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus pro peccatis nostris atque offensionibus nostris ut omnium delictorum meorum veniam .consequi mereamur quaesumus Domine placatus accipias; <diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, Lord, we offer this oblation of our servitude for our sins and offenses that we may deserve to obtain pardon for all our transgressions. We humbly ask you, please, gracious Lord, to accept it; arrange our days in your peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. We implore you, count us among the elect in your flock. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae quam tibi offerimus pro salute et incolumitate vel statu regni Francorum pro quibus Domine omnipotens Deus tibi supplices fundimus preces <ut> te in omnibus ducem te in omnibus viis suis protectorem .mereantur habere quaesumus Domine ut placatus suscipias. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering of our servitude that we present to you for the health and safety, as well as the state of the Kingdom of France, for whom, Lord almighty God, we humbly pour out our prayers to you. We ask, O Lord, that you may be their leader in all things, their protector on all your paths. May they deserve to have you, we beseech you, Lord. That you, being appeased, may receive them. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus etiam pro famulo tuo illo quem ad episcopatus ordinem promovere dignatus es quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias et propitius in eo tua dona custodias ut quod divino munere consecutus est divinis .effectibus exsequatur; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we present this offering of our servitude and also of your entire family which we offer to you, even for that servant of yours whom you have deemed worthy of promotion to the episcopate. We humbly ask you, Lord, that you accept it favorably and watch over him with your gifts, so that he may fulfill his duties with divine power granted to him; and that you arrange our days in peace and save us from eternal damnation. And we beseech you to count us among the flock of your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus in honorem sancti Hilarii confessoris tui .atque pontificis quaesumus Domine <ut placatus suscipias; diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripias et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation of our servitude and also of your entire family to you, in honor of your confessee Saint Hilary and of your bishop. Lord, we humbly ask that you receive it pleasingly; arrange our days in your peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. And command us to be counted among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus ob diem in qua Dominus noster Iesus Christus tradidit discipulis suis corporis et sanguinis sui mysteria celebranda quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias; <diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: This offering we make on behalf of our servitude and also all your family, which we offer to you for the day in which our Lord Jesus Christ gave his disciples the mystery of his body and blood to be celebrated. We humbly ask you, Lord, that you may receive it pleasingly; arrange our days in your peace and rescue us from eternal damnation. Furthermore, command us to be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus pro famula tua illa quaesumus Domine ut placatus suscipias pro qua maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut orationem eius exaudias et eius uterum vinculo sterilitatis absolvas et prolem in qua nomen tuum .benedicatur concedas; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, this offering of our servitude and also of the entire family that we are presenting to You for Your maidservant whom we ask, Lord, that You graciously accept on her behalf, as we humbly pour out our prayers to You. We implore You to hear her prayer and release her from the bond of infertility, and bless her with a child in whom Your name may be blessed. Dispose our days in peace, and save us from eternal damnation. And we ask that You command her to be numbered among Your chosen ones. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus pro his quoque quos regenerare dignatus es ex aqua et spiritu sancto tribuens eis remissionem omnium peccatorum ut invenires eos in Christo Iesu domino nostro quaesumus Domine placatus accipias pro quibus maiestati tuae supplices fundimus preces ut nomina eorum adscribi iubeas in .libro viventium; diesque nostros <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So then, this offering of our servitude, as well as that of all your family which we offer to you, for those also whom you have deemed worthy to regenerate through water and the Holy Spirit, granting them forgiveness of all sins, that you may find them in Christ Jesus, our Lord. We beseech You, Lord, pleased, that You receive this on behalf of those for whose majesty we humbly pour out our prayers. Grant us that their names be written in the book of the living; and that You arrange the days of our lives in Your peace, and deliver us from eternal damnation. We ask You to number us among Your elect flock. Through Christ, Our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus pro his quoque quos regenerare dignatus es ex aqua et spiritu sancto tribuens eis remissionem omnium peccatorum quaesumus Domine ut placatus accipias; <diesque nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: This offering of our servitude and indeed of your entire family which we present to you, for those whom you have deemed worthy of regeneration through water and the Holy Spirit, granting them remission of all sins, we humbly ask, Lord. May you accept us appeased; may you arrange our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. And command us to be numbered among your chosen ones. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem servitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quam tibi offerimus pro incolumitate famuli tui illius ob devotionem mentis suae pius et propitius clementi vultu respicias tibi vero supplicanti libens protege et dignanter exaudi et aeterna eum profectione conserva ut semper in tua religione laetantem incessanter in sanctae Trinitatis confessione fide catholica perseveret quaesumus Domine placatus accipias et miserationis tuae largitate concedas ut fiat ei ad veniam delictorum et ad actuum emendationem ut et hic bene valeat vivere et ad aeternam beatitudinem .feliciter pervenire; diesque <nostros in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: So we offer this oblation of our service, as well as that of all your family, to you for the welfare of your servant's health, who is moved by a pious devotion of mind. We humbly entreat you to look upon him with a favorable and gracious countenance. Protect him willingly, hear him graciously, and eternally preserve him as he continues to rejoice in your religion and profess the holy Trinity with Catholic faith. We beseech you, Lord, that you be pleased to receive and bestow your mercy upon him, so that through your grace he may obtain forgiveness for his sins and the amendment of his actions, that he may here live well and attain eternal beatitude. May you dispose our days in peace and deliver us from eternal damnation. Count him among the elect in your flock. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc itaque oblationem quam tibi offerimus illius et illius famulorum tuorum quibus summum sacerdotium contulisti quaesumus <Domine> benignus accipias et tua in eis .dona prosequaris. Per <Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this oblation that we present to you, as well as to those servants of yours who received the highest priesthood from you, Lord. We humbly ask that You graciously accept it and grant Your blessings upon them. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc quoque oblationem dignare Domine quaesumus misericorditer benedicere et clementer sanctificare quam tibi offerimus pro nobismetipsis et pro nostris subiectis petentes maiestatem tuam ut descendat super hunc panem et super hunc calicem plenitudo tuae divinitatis descendat etiam Domine illa Sancti Spiritus tui incomprehensibilis invisibilisque maiestas sicut quondam in patrum hostias visibiliter descendebat quae in nobis efficiat sacramentum salutis nostrae ut tua sanctificatio sit salus et defensio omnium .animarum nostrarum. P<er> Chr<istum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: Grant, we ask you, Lord, to graciously bless and holy sanctify this offering as well, which we offer to you on behalf of ourselves and our subjects. We pray that your majesty may descend upon this bread and upon this chalice; may the fullness of your divinity also descend upon us, Lord, as the Holy Spirit of yours, incomprehensible and invisible majesty, just as it once visibly descended upon the sacrifices of the fathers, that it may bring about the sacrament of our salvation within us. May your sanctification be our salvation and protection for all souls. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc quoque oblationem Domine quam tibi non nostris meritis sed tua multiplici miseratione confidentes offerimus quaesumus suscipere et sanctificare dignare et concede ut famulis tuis et ad modernae pacis custodiam et ad perpetuae felicitatis .prosperitatem proficiat. P<er> Chr<istum dorninum nostrum>.
translation_en: We also offer this oblation to You, Lord, not on account of our merits but Your abundant mercy, confidently pleading. We ask that You receive it and sanctify it, deigning to grant, so that it may benefit Your servants and advance towards the guardianship of modern peace and the prosperity of eternal happiness through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc quoque oblationem quam offero ego tuus famulus et sacerdos ob diem in quo me dignatus es ministerio sacro constituere sacerdotem obsecro Domine placatus suscipias; unde maiestatem tuam supplex exoro ut quod in me largiri dignatus es propitius .custodire digneris. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
translation_en: This offering also, which I present as your servant and priest on the day on which you have deemed fit to constitute me a sacerdotal minister, I humbly entreat, Lord, that you be pleased to receive; through whom I beseech your majesty to watch over me graciously. May it be pleasing to you to have bestowed upon me generously and may you protect me graciously. Through Christ our Lord.

text: Hanc quoque oblationem servitutis nostrae et cunctae familiae tuae sed et famuli tui illius quam tibi offerimus hodierna die consecrationem sancti loci huius celebrantes in honorem sanctorum martyrum .tuorum illorum petimus Domine placatus accipias; diesque nostros  <in tua pace disponas atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. Per Christum Dominum nostrum>.
translation_en: We also offer this oblation of our servitude and that of your entire family, as well as the servant of that one, which we present to you today for the consecration of this holy place, in honor of your martyrs. We humbly ask you, Lord, to be pleased to receive it; dispose our days in peace and save us from eternal damnation. May you command that we be numbered among your elect. Through Christ, our Lord.

text: Quam oblationem tu Deus in omnibus quaesumus benedictam adscriptam ratam rationabilem acceptabilemque facere digneris ut nobis corpus et sanguis fiat dilectissimi Filii tui Domini Dei nostri Iesu Christi
translation_en: We humbly ask You, God, to bless this offering in all things and make it valid, reasonable, acceptable, that for us the body and blood may become of Your most beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Qui pridie quam pateretur accepit panem in sanctas ac venerabiles manus suas; elevatis oculis in caelum ad te Deum patrem suum omnipotentem tibi gratias agens benedixit fregit dedit discipulis suis dicens: »Accipite et manducate ex hoc omnes; hoc est enim corpus meum.«
translation_en: On the day before he was about to suffer, he accepted bread into his holy and venerable hands; raising his eyes toward heaven to you, God his almighty Father, he gave thanks, blessed it, broke it, gave it to his disciples, saying: "Take and eat from this all of you; for this is indeed my body."

text: Qui pridie quam pro nostra et omnium salute pateretur accipiens panem elevavit oculos ad caelos ad te Deum patrem suum omnipotentem tibi gratias agens benedixit fregit deditque discipulis suis dicens ad eos: »Accipite et manduca te ex hoc omnes; hoc est enim corpus meum.«
translation_en: Who on the day before, for our salvation and that of all, suffered and took bread, raising his eyes to heaven to you, God, his almighty father, gave thanks, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to his disciples, saying to them: "Take and eat from this all of you; for this is indeed my body."

text: Qui pridie quam pateretur in sanctis manibus suis accepit panem respexit in caelum ad te sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus gratias agens benedixit fregit fractumque apostolis suis et discipulis suis tradidit dicens: »Accipite et edite ex hoc omnes; hoc est enim corpus meum quod pro multis confringetur.«
translation_en: On the night before He was to suffer, with hands sanctified, He took bread, looked up to You, holy Father, almighty and eternal God, giving thanks, He blessed, broke it, and gave it to His apostles and disciples, saying: "Take and eat of this all of you; for this is My body which will be given up for many."

text: Qui hac die antequam traderetur accepit panem in suis sanctis manibus; elevatis
translation_en: Who on this day, before being handed over, received bread in His holy hands; raising them up

text: Qui pridie quam pro nostra omnium salute pateretur – hoc est hodie – accepit panem in sanctas
translation_en: Who on the day before suffering for our salvation took bread - this is today - received in the holy,

text: Qui pridie quam pro nostra et omnium salute pateretur – hoc est hodierna die – discumbens in medio discipulorum suorum et accipiens
translation_en: Who on the day before His suffering for our salvation reclined among His disciples and took

text: Qui pridie quam pro nostra et omnium salute pati dignaretur
translation_en: Who suffered on our behalf before his passion for our salvation

text: Qui pridie quam pro omnium salute pateretur – hodierna die – stans in medio discipulorum suorum accepit panem et reliqua
translation_en: On the day before he was betrayed for our salvation, standing among his disciples, he took bread and the other things
