translation_en: Verily, holy and merciful, verily blessed and just, verily admirable and glorious is our Lord Jesus Christ, who with His inestimable mercy does not will anything to perish but calls all into the embrace of piety for salvation.

text: Vere sanctus et gloriosus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus cuius virtute caro fragilis sustentatur cuius dulcedine inedia animae arentis reficitur. Praesta igitur nobis Deus pater ut per eum adiuvetur fragilitas nostra per quem humana est infirmitas roborata.
translation_en: Verily holy and glorious is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, by whose power a frail body is sustained and whose sweetness the thirsty soul is refreshed. Therefore, O God, Father, grant that we may be helped through Him, by whom human weakness is strengthened.

text: Vere sanctus et gloriosus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus quem olim credimus incarnatum fuisse pro salute humani generis et nunc exspectamus ad iudicium venturum in gloria claritatis cum suis omnibus sanctis.
translation_en: Verily holy and glorious is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son whom we once believed to have been incarnate for the salvation of the human race, and now we await Him to come in glory of brightness with all His saints at the judgment.

text: Vere sanctus et gloriosus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui desiderio sui nostram inediam pellit et praeventu gratiae infirmitatem nostram adiuvat implere quod praecipit.
translation_en: Verily, the holy and glorious Lord our Jesus Christ, Your Son, who drives away our unquenchable desire with His own will and aids in overcoming our infirmity so as to fulfill what He commands.

text: Vere sanctus et gloriosus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui est reparator perpetuae vitae et redemptio fragilitatis humanae qui carnem nostrae mortalitatis quae propter primi hominis gulam mulctata fuerat morte per rigorem abstinentiae provexit ad aeternae vitae salvationem.
translation_en: Verily holy and glorious is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who is the restorer of eternal life and the redemption of human frailty. He raised our mortal flesh, which was condemned to death because of the first man's sin, through rigorous fasting to salvation in everlasting life.

text: Vere sanctus et iustus es Domine vere magnus et pius es qui Filium tuum Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum nobis lumen ad terras ex summa caeli arce misisti captivorum corporum redemptorem.
translation_en: Verily, you are holy and just, Lord; verily, great and merciful are you. You sent your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, to us as light on the earth from the highest heaven's throne, a redeemer of captives for our bodies.

text: Vere sanctus et pius es Domine Deus noster quem hodierno die praesentis sacrificii litatione laudamus in qua tanti pontificis tui Cypriani gloriosa universo orbe et perfecta in Christo consummatio celebratur.  Qui iam in caritatis tuae arce consistens tam magistri quam domini praecedentis illuminata cordis acie inhaerendo vestigiis meruit eius particeps effici passionis ut postmodum consors fieret regni; ac per hoc heres Dei et coheres fieret Christi.  Hic namque populum sibi caelesti auctoritate commissum non solum doctrinae fontibus irrigavit sed etiam in confessione pii nominis fortiter perseverans sanguinis effusione decoravit. Veri pastoris dilectissimus imitator exsistens qui dum pro ovibus sibi commissis acceptabilia Deo sacrificia iugiter retulisset ut seipsum quoque post haec possit ei cui hactenus ministraverat sacrificium acceptabile exhibere oratione continua flagitavit. Implens scilicet opere quae praedicaverat verbo nec in aliquo praevaricationis reus exsistens merito illi apostolo gentium atque magistro coaequatus est Paulo iri quo Christus habitans velut e templi sui conclavibus loquebatur.  Tibi igitur omnipotens Deus sanctorum tuorum sunt deputanda praeconia cui cura est etiam certamina caelestibus praemiis destinata mirifice profligare. Hos tu iam in numero sanctorum tuorum aggregatos aeternis divitiis locupletare dignatus es quos quia in te teque in illis Domine manere confidimus ut eos nobis miseris in patrocinium deputare digneris suppliciter postulamus.
translation_en:
Verily holy and merciful are you, Lord our God, whom we praise today on this present sacrifice's litany. In which the glorious completion of your bishop Cyprian, perfect in Christ, is celebrated throughout the whole world.
Who, standing firm in your love's fortress, was both teacher and lord, shining with a lighted sword of charity in his heart, adhering to his footsteps, deserved to be a participant in his passion, so that he might later become a companion in his kingdom; and thus he became an heir of God and a sharer of Christ.
This man, entrusted with the celestial authority over the people, not only irrigated them with the sources of doctrine but also, persevering steadfastly in the confession of the pious name, adorned them with the shedding of his blood. The dearest imitator of the true shepherd, existing when he continually presented acceptable sacrifices on behalf of the sheep entrusted to him, constantly prayed for himself to also present an acceptable sacrifice to him whom he had served thus far. Filling in deed what he had preached with word, without being found guilty of any deviation, was rightly made equal to Paul the apostle to the Gentiles and teacher. As Christ dwelt among his own temple's chambers, speaking as from a closed room.
Therefore, Almighty God, praise is due to you from your saints, for whose care even heavenly contests are wonderfully fought with rewards destined. You have already enriched them with eternal treasures, whom we confidently trust will remain in you and in them, Lord. We humbly beg that you may deign to place them as our patrons.

text: Vere sanctus et pius es Domine Deus noster qui tam iustus es ad retribuendum quam misericors ad donandum. Dum vis impendere pro meritis praemia merita facis esse pro praemiis et nobis dignaris deputare quod tribuis dum invenire desideras quos coronas.  Nam cum dubium non sit tuum esse quod vivimus nostrum iube esse si vincimus. Sic athletis tuis datur post victoriam corona pro munere cum impugnanda sit virtus ex munere; ipse praemium exhibens validus ipse caelum inferens gloriosus dando et pro remuneratione laudem et pro devotione mercedem.
translation_en:
Verily, holy and merciful are You, Lord our God, who are just in rewarding as you are merciful in giving. When You wish to bestow rewards for deeds performed, You make the deeds worthy of the rewards and deign to award us what You give when You seek to find those worthy of crowns.
Indeed, there is no doubt that it is Yours to command our life, if we conquer. Thus, as with Your athletes, a crown is given after victory as a reward, since virtue itself is a gift to be fought for; You Yourself displaying as the reward-giver, You Yourself bringing heaven, glorious, in giving and in return for reward, praise, and for devotion, mercy.

text: Vere sanctus vere pius et admirabilis es Domine Deus noster qui hodierno die et confessoris tui illius innovas gloriam et confitentium excitas vota ut cum eidem qui tibi confessione placuit confitentes obsequimur nostrum potius excitemus affectum dum quidquid illi impendimus laudis nostrae sit causa salutis.  Has ergo hostias in tanti viri commemoratione offerentes precamur ut qui eius hoc die animam in confessione tui nominis suscepisti nobis tribuas voluntatem te veraciter confitendi.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily kind and wonderful are You, Lord our God, who today increase the glory of Your confessor and stir up the vows of those who confess, that we who please You in confession may rather increase our affection towards him. For whatsoever we offer to him for our praise let it be a cause of salvation for us.
Therefore, offering these hosts in memory of such a worthy man, we pray that You who received his soul today in Your confessional name grant us the will to truthfully confess You.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus cuius nos proximitas paschae laetificat passio salvat resurrectio consecrat cui ante sacrum pascha mundari cupientes a crimine ieiunii offerimus hostiam et nostrae humilitatis impendimus obsequelam. Ille est enim qui et tunc moriens redemit perditos et nunc dulcescere facit sua passione redemptos.
translation_en: Verily holy and verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, whose nearness at Easter delights us, whose passion saves us, whose resurrection consecrates us. We, who before the sacred Pascha long to be purified from sin through fasting, offer Him as a sacrifice and we impose upon ourselves the obedience of our humility. For He it is who then died redeemed the lost, and now makes His passion sweet for those redeemed.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus cuius protectione munitus adversariis olim fidenter beatissimus restitit Hieronymus repressitque ferocitatem haereticae pravitatis inferendo sententiam veritatis. Illi etenim diabolico furore succensi obiciendo mendacium veritatem conebantur evertere; hic vero lorica fidei indutus galea aeternae salutis obtectus gladioque verbi Dei accinctus more belligerantis inter acies inimicorum Christi gradum fixit et perversorum colla terratenus valenter prostravit.  Ipse ergo sit pro nobis petimus Domine apud te interventor assiduus qui dudum exstitit veritatis tuae defensor fortissimus suisque precibus nobis acquirat felicioris vitae commoditatem qui a te meruit collata perfrui aetherea feliciter hereditate. Per eum sit fidelibus cunctis meritum iustitiae sanctitatis per quem claruit universo orbi doctrina verae credulitatis ipsoque interpellante nobis reseretur legis tuae dulcedo qui honore scientiae tuae praeditus et antiqua declaravit per industriam interpretationis et nova intimavit per sollicitudinem exhortationis. Propter quod nunc patriarchis ac prophetis se uniri laetatur in caelo quorum oracula vivens corporaliter fideli promulgavit populo christiano.
translation_en:
Verily holy and verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, under whose protection the blessed Jerome confidently stood against adversaries. He subdued the fierce stubbornness of heretical wickedness by proclaiming the sentence of truth. Those who were inflamed with diabolic fury, presenting a lie as truth, sought to overturn it; but he, clothed in the armor of faith, shielded by the helmet of eternal salvation and armed with the sword of God's word, as a warrior stepped among the ranks of Christ's enemies, boldly brought them low.
We pray then that He may be our advocate before You, Lord, a constant intercessor who long ago stood as Your truth's strongest defender, and may grant us the comfort of a happier life through His prayers, whom You have graced with an eternal blessed inheritance. May it be through Him that all faithful are granted the reward of justice and sanctity, by whom the doctrine of true belief has shone upon the world, and who, as He calls to us, will open up the sweetness of Your law.
Endowed with honor and knowledge, He declared the ancient truths with diligence through interpretation, and made them known anew through solicitude in exhortation. Therefore, now he rejoices united with patriarchs and prophets in heaven, whose oracles, living corporally, He has faithfully proclaimed to the Christian people.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus pro quo praedicti martyres viriliter certando animas posuerunt et nunc caelestis gloriae participatione laetantur qui tanto se dulcedinis amore effudit in Caeciliae virginis corde ut funditus ab illa exstirparet omnem carneae titillationis ardorem quo carnalem sponsi cubitum respuendo illi soli se exhiberet intactam qui per illam emollivit carnalis sponsi eius duritiam.  Sit gloria et gratiarum actio Deo et Salvatori nostro qui hanc virginem suam illo implevit amore quo nec divortium seminatur et spiritalis plenitudo caritatis augetur.
translation_en:
Verily holy and verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, for whom the aforementioned martyrs courageously fought for their souls, who now joyfully partake in celestial glory. They poured out such sweet love into Caecilia's heart that she completely uprooted all desire for carnal stimulation, rejecting her earthly spouse to present herself pure to Him alone. Through her, He softened the hardness of her earthly spouse.
Glory and thanks be to God and our Savior who filled this virgin with a love so profound that it neither sows division nor increases spiritual fullness of charity.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus quem collaudat omnis conventus martyrum et attollunt humilium praeconia confessurum qui virginem suam Leocadiam carcerali vinculo trusam atque in oratione constitutam in confessione sui nominis spiritum emittentem suscepit ad se in gloriam sempiternam.
translation_en: Verily holy and verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, whom all assemblies of martyrs acclaim and the humble proclaim with praises. They who confessed their virgin Leocadia, freed from the prison bond, and established in prayer, emitting spirit in her confession of his name, received her to himself for eternal glory.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus sine aequalitate bonus sine indigentia creator sine situ praesens sine loco ubique totus sine tempore sempiternus sine ulla temptatione mutabilia faciens nihilque patieris.
translation_en: Verily holy and verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, good without equality, without neediness, the Creator without limitation present without place everywhere, without location ubiquitous, without time eternal, without any changeable temptation, making nothing and suffering nothing.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus es Deus Pater omnipotens qui Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum in assumptione humanitatis mortem fecisti subire ut nostrorum solveret vincula peccatorum et triumphans de inferis liber remearet ad solium tuum.
translation_en: Truly holy and truly blessed are you, God, Almighty Father, who made our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, to submit to death in the assumption of humanity, so that he might free us from the bonds of sin and triumphing over death, rise again from the dead and return to your throne.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus es Domine Deus omnipotens qui salubris inspirator es voti et votivi acceptor es sacrificii.
translation_en: Verily holy and verily blessed art Thou, Lord God almighty, who art the health-giving inspirer of vows and the acceptor of the sacrifice.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus es Domine Deus omnipotens unitas distinctibilis et distinctio inseparabilis unitas Trinitatis et Trinitas summae unitatis qui operibus tuis compatiens impassibilis eo usque misericordiam porrigis ut ad notescendum salutare tuum praemitteres Ioannem puerum tuum praevium viae lucernam luminis praeconem iudicis vocem Verbi amicum sponsi.  Unde nos pro tuis donis eiusque bonis tibi litationis victimam offerentes precamur ut acceptabiliter eam assumas et dignatione consueta benedicas atque offerentes conformes eius efficias quam tibi in commemorationem Iesu Christi Filii tui Domini nostri devota et prosternata servitute persolvimus.
translation_en:
Verily holy and verily blessed are you, Lord God Almighty, the indivisible unity that is divisible and the divisibility that is inseparable from the unity of the Trinity, and the Trinity that is supreme unity, who, compassionate and impassive, extends mercy to such an extent that you send forth your saving grace through John, your pre-existent son, the lantern of the way, the herald of light, the voice of the Word, the friend, the bridegroom.
Through these gifts of his and all good things bestowed by him, we offer ourselves as victims of laudation to you, and we humbly pray that you accept it acceptably and bless it according to your usual dignity, making us conformable to his efficacy, which we, in commemoration of Jesus Christ, your son, our Lord, pay devout and prostrate service.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus es Domine Iesu Christe qui daturum te nobis illum spiritum promisisti in munere quem tibi cum patre novimus coaequalem exsistere.
translation_en: Truly holy and truly blessed are you, Lord Jesus Christ, who promised to give us the same Spirit, in whose presence with the Father we know that you exist as one equal with Him.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus es tu Christe Filius Dei qui Matthaeum apostolum tuum et prius evangelistam fecisti et post martyrio coronasti.  Per illum fundamenta fidei iaciens per illum redemptos populos instruens; ipsum populis constituens praesulem ipsum tibi faciens testem; per illum regens ecclesiam per eum evangelicam sanciens legem. Ut qui cum sociis acceperat apostolatus honorem consequeretur etiam ut prior omnium scribendo quaereret evangelicam tradere veritatem et qui tibi iam electus exstabat discipulus omnibus populis exsisteret praedicator egregius.  Qui ut tibi redderet qualem abs te acceperat fidem pro te non est cunctatus fundere sanguinem et ut gratiam qua tibi cohaeserat manifestaret se sequentibus populis et evangelium scripsit hebraicis litteris et mirabilem se praebuit in virtutibus faciendis.  Electus ex publicanis in miraculis gloriosus efficitur et sacerdotio fungens tibi totus offertur. Sacrificium offert tibi super altario et illico persecutoris feritur gladio ut qui tibi pro fratribus offerre victimas consueverat ipse etiam victima fieret.
translation_en:
Verily, you are holy and blessed, O Christ, Son of God. You made Matthew, your apostle, the first evangelist, and after his martyrdom, you crowned him. Through him, the foundations of faith were laid, through him the redeemed people were instructed; himself was established among the people as a bishop, himself made you a witness; through him, the church was ruled, by him the evangelical law was sanctified. He who had received the honor of apostleship did not hesitate to pour out blood for you, in order to manifest the grace that adhered to him to the following people and he wrote the gospel in Hebrew letters and miraculously demonstrated his power in performing miracles.
Chosen from among the publicans, he becomes glorious in miracles and while serving as a priest, offers himself entirely to you. The sacrifice offered on the altar is struck by the sword of the persecutor so that he, who had been accustomed to offer victims for his brothers, would also become a victim himself.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus et rex regum est Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus cui oblatae virgines placent de pudoris integritate de operis consummatione de passionis certamine de dilectionis integritate.  Ille quippe et virginitatis collator et virginum remunerator est qui virgo de Maria semper virgine genitus et virginum integritatem remunerat et corruptorum vulnera crucis suae vulnere sanat.
translation_en:
Verily, He is holy and blessed and the King of Kings; our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son. To Him, virgins are pleasing from their integrity, from the completion of their works, from the contest of His Passion, from the integrity of their love.
Indeed, He is the bestower of virginity and the rewarder of virgins; He, who was born of Mary ever-virgin, rewards the purity of virgins and heals the wounds of the corrupt ones with the wound of His own cross.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus est Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius Dei vivi qui angelorum evectus ulnis adscendit in caelis et nunc sedet ad dexteram patris.
translation_en: Truly holy and truly blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God, who was lifted up by angels' wings and ascended into heaven, and now sits at the right hand of the Father.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus in excelsis omnipotens tu Deus pater cuius munere cunctis hominibus imaginis tuae dignitas conceditur in natura aeternitatis facultas datur inanima; libertas arbitrii praestatur in vita felicitas baptismi offertur in gratia; hereditas caeli in nocentia promittitur utilitas remedii in paenitentia reservatur. Ut abundans circa omnes homines tua pietas nec in malitia velis denegare quos condis nec in ignorantia perire quos doces nec in supplicio permanere quos diligis nec deicere a regno quos redimis.
translation_en: Verily holy and verily blessed are you, omnipotent God, Father, in the heights. By your gift, dignity is granted to all human beings bearing your image in nature, eternal faculties are given, life is granted to the soul; freedom of will is bestowed upon life, happiness is offered through baptism, inheritance of heaven is promised for those with faults, usefulness of remedy is reserved for penitence. May your abundant mercy not wish to deny those you create nor perish those you teach, nor remain in torment those you love, nor cast away from the kingdom those you redeem.

text: Vere sanctus et vere benedictus redemptor noster et Dominus Iesus Christus qui amarum passionis poculum ideo quasi verus medicus praegustavit ut et amissam nostrae salutis nobis copiam restauraret et nos ad hoc sumendum quod prior ipse sumpserit provocaret.
translation_en: Verily, the holy and truly blessed Redeemer, our Lord Jesus Christ, who as a true physician tasted the bitter cup of Passion, did so in order to restore for us the lost treasure of our salvation and to stimulate us to drink what He first drank Himself.

text: Vere sanctus et vere gloriosus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui a te Deus pater ante luciferum genitus est in saeculorum fine pro servulis incarnatus ut homo ludibria passionis sustinuit et ut Deus potens a mortuis resurrexit.  Cuius verbo vocationis audito apostoli mundana omnia reliquerunt et spretis temporalibus curis ad sequendum illum alacri animo festinarunt. Cuius freti virtute miraculis clarent et se ultro passionibus subdunt sed quod ille egit Deus effectus homo hoc isti egerunt homines iuvante et inspirante Deo.  Unde sanctus iste Bartholomaeus apostolus verbo daemones ligat eosque pro tempore eloqui imperat quia hoc illi cum ceteris Christus et Dominus noster unigenitus tuus tradendo Spiritum Sanctum actitare concesserat ut bene habeant; manus impositione sanat aegrotos quia habitans in illo hoc operatur acceptus ab unigenito tuo Spiritus Sanctus.  Quid ergo mirum si haec et talia operatur qui manifestum Spiritum Sanctum accepisse monstratur et ligandi et solvendi peccata possidere potestatem creditur et fatetur et qui ista omnia potens operatus post humilis collum subicit gladio qui ad passionem magistri sui et Domini nostri <est> provocatus exemplo?  Nec fas erat ut aliquis discipulorum in passionis agone a suo discreparet domino et magistro sed qui similia eis se ostendebatur miraculis similis etiam passione fieret mortis.  Unde noster iste sicut sidus Bartholomaeus toto claret in mundo et cum ceteris condiscipulis in duodecim sedibus iudicans collocatur in regno.
translation_en:
Verily holy and verily glorious is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who from You, God the Father, was born before Lucifer at the end of ages, incarnate for the servants to suffer as a man the mockery of passion and to die, but to rise again powerful as God from the dead.
Whose word heard, the apostles abandoned all worldly things and hastened with eager spirit to follow Him. Whose deeds are clear in miracles and they themselves willingly submit to suffering, yet what He did was done by man aided and inspired by God.
Therefore, this saint Bartholomew, the apostle, binds demons with his word and commands them to speak for a time, because Christ and our Lord Your unique Son granted this to them along with the Holy Spirit so that they may have peace; he heals the sick with the laying on of hands because by dwelling in Him, He performs this accepted by Your unique Holy Spirit.
What wonder is it if He works these things who is shown to have received the Holy Spirit manifestly and has the power to bind and loose sins, confesses and submits, and who does all these powerful deeds bows his humble neck under a sword that is provoked for the passion of His master and our Lord?
It was not right for one of Your disciples to separate from His Lord and Master in the contest of Passion, but he who showed himself similar to them in miracles would also be similar to them even in suffering.
Therefore, this one shines like the star Bartholomew throughout the world, and sitting among the other disciples in the twelve seats, he judges in the kingdom with the rest.

text: Vere sanctus et verus Deus Christus Filius Dei qui adscendit patibulum crucis ut omnes vires suas mors in sua perderet morte. Descendit ad inferos ut hominem veteri errore deceptum et regno peccati servientem victor abstraheret serasque portarum potenti manu frangeret et secuturis gloria suae resurrectionis aperiret.
translation_en: Verily holy and true God, Christ Son of God, who ascended the cross-beam of the cross to lose all His powers in death by dying. He descended into hell to free man deceived by ancient error and serving in the realm of sin. Victoriously he drew forth the captives, broke down the mighty gates with a powerful hand, and opened for those following Him the gates of His glorious resurrection.

text: Vere sanctus in excelsis Domine et omnium devotione laudabilis; qui et caelestia regis potenter et terrena clementer intendis; qui et in illa gloriosus et in ista mirificus; ibi laudibus angelorum attolleris hic votis fidelium iugiter collaudaris.
translation_en: Verily holy in the heights, Lord, and worthy of all devotion praiseworthy; who also rule with power in the heavens and show mercy on earth; who are glorious in one place and miraculous in another; there you are praised by the hymns of angels, here you are everlastingly praised by the vows of faithful people.

text: Vere sanctus in sanctis gloriosus in caelis manifestus in terris Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus piissime pater qui contra adversarias potestates pugnat in virgine triumphat in martyre superat in agone et devictis hostibus cum palma victoriae confessorem suam perducit ad perpetuam mansionem.  O quam laudabilis virgo quae discerpitur ungulis caeditur virgis et variis laceratur tormentis! Sed non acquiescit insuper suasione serpentis ignibus uritur tensione foedatur blanditiis suadetur sed ab aeterni sponsi caritate non separatur.
translation_en:
Verily, holy in the holies, glorious in the heavens, manifest on earth, our Lord Jesus Christ, your most merciful Father, who fights against adversarial powers, triumphs in the virgin, overcomes in martyrdom, excels in contest, and with defeated enemies leads his witness to a perpetual dwelling place.
O how praiseworthy is the virgin, who is pierced by nails, beaten with rods, and torn apart by various torments! Yet she does not yield to the temptation of the serpent, burned by fires, distorted by tension, enticed by sweet words, but is not separated from the love of her eternal Bridegroom.

text: Vere sanctus in sanctis vere in omnibus gloriosus Dei Filius cuius inenarrabilis exstat numerus angelorum quem togatorum immensitas collaudat sanctorum qui Michaeli tuo nuntio primatum gratiae contulisti et populi tui defensorem constituisti. Quaesumus praesenti in saeculo defensari et ad te post transitum beatorum numero adunari.
translation_en: Verily, holy in holies, verily glorious in all things is the Son of God, whose inexpressible number of angels praise Him. The vast multitude of saints extol Him who have bestowed primacy of grace upon your messenger Michael and made him the defender of your people. We beseech You to defend us in this world and gather us with the blessed after our passage to You.

text: Vere sanctus vere admirabilis Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui principatum martyrii Stephano primo contulit cum suae mortis hunc primum passiones exsequendum elegit.
translation_en: Verily, holy, verily wonderful is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who bestowed the principality of martyrdom upon Stephen, the first, choosing to execute this first passion of his own death.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus aeterne omnipotens Deus Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui tam visibilia quam invisibilia ab initio institueris finita vel infinita tecum et cum spiritu sancto potentialiter creans omnia felicius complevit et divinitus peregit.  Extremo igitur inter primaevam vel ultimam saeculi seriem se cum in forma Dei esset exinaniens Deo aequalem nostrum dignatus est contiguum sumere pulverem; non quo autem vires augeret potis sed quo vero pestem evacuaret mortis; non quo autem ullo eguisset cyclopco sed quo letalia vulnera sanasset antidoto; non quo autem infirmius fulciret propria sed quo vero potentius caelestia terrestria salvasset vel tartara; non quo autem ullam passus esset inopiam sed quo vero inopem gratia redderet divitem; non quo autem imbecillis caelestes vel aereos domuisset exercitus sed quo vero fortissimus novos ibidem reseraret introitus.  Unde hoc autem nusquam Domine omne confitemur peractum nisi et completum esset per Verbum caro factum quod non natura humanius sed gratia adunivit assumptum. Accepit nempe quod fecerat in quo autem mirabili modo seseque factum praedixerat de quo mater Sion dicet: »Homo et homo in ea divinitus admirabiliterque est factus.« Tale multoque vere creditur mirabile matrem creasse quale divinitus per eam transiens decus virgineum non adimisse dum ab illo creari ita est ut ab ipso concipi pari et numquam corrumpi.  Haec autem Domine omnia si humanis viribus possint exsequi omnia divina nusquam probarentur oriri. Quis vero tandem huius sanctae mysterium approbare poterit tantae incarnationis nativitatis filii in caelum adscensionis et matris tam incomprehensibilis illibatae assumptionis nisi et recta de patre et filio atque spiritu sancto sinceriter credat et de matris assumptione mirabiliter sentiat dum et incomprehensibilia sunt utraque et inde credenda utraque quia vera confitemur utraque? Haec est fides verissima quae reconciliamur piissimo Deo et adoptamur perenniter in filiis.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed, eternally almighty God, Jesus Christ, Your Son, who from the beginning establishes both visible and invisible things, finite or infinite, with You and with the Holy Spirit, creatively making all things happily and divinely perfect.
Therefore, at the end of either the first or the last series of the ages, He, in the form of God, deemed it fitting to take on our likeness by assuming human nature; not so that His power might be increased but rather that He might effectively empty Himself of death; not so that He might equal any cyclops but rather that He might heal fatal wounds with an antidote; not so that He might weaken the weak but rather that He might strengthen celestial and terrestrial beings, or even those in hell; not so that He might suffer any poverty but rather that He might make the poor rich through grace; not so that He might subject heavenly or angelic armies but rather that He might open new entrances for them there.
We confess, Lord, that all this is accomplished nowhere except by the Word who became flesh, which was joined to our nature not by human ability but by grace. For He took on what He had made in which He miraculously foretold Himself, about whom the Mother of Zion will say: "Man and man are marvelously and divinely created there." It is truly believed that Mary created this miracle, through whom the divine glory passed through as virginity was not diminished while being created so that it could be conceived by Him and never corrupted.
Lord, all these things cannot be accomplished by human strength; nowhere would they be proven to originate from divine sources. Who, then, will approve of this holy mystery, the incarnation of such great nativity, ascension of the Son in heaven, and the incomprehensible, immaculate assumption of His Mother, unless he sincerely believes in the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit and feels wonder at the assumption of the Mother, since both are incomprehensible and thus to be believed because we truly confess that they are both?
This is the most true faith which reconciles us with the most merciful God and adopts us eternally as His children.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus atque terribilis et adorandus Dominus Deus qui vos positos in caligine tenebrarum et umbra mortis larga misericordiae pietate visitare dignatus est ut per quem patet tanta in principio et initiata et perfecta per ipsum modo dirigantur in finem.  Quis huius muneris ( ... lac. ... ) qua lumen dedisti caecis auditum surdis sapientiam stultis peccatoribus remissionem pauperibus divitias incorruptas vitam mortalibus sempiternam.  Namque dum tuum Verbum fit caro impassibilis patitur immortalis crucis suscepit mortem mundi peccata solvuntur et humano generi vita olim perdita reparatur.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed and terrible and worthy of adoration is the Lord God who deigned to visit you in the darkness of shadows and the shadow of death with great mercy and piety. He chose to direct through you what was begun and perfected at the beginning and completed by Himself to its end.
Who (... lac. ...) is worthy of this gift, whom you have given light to the blind, hearing to the deaf, wisdom to the foolish, forgiveness to sinners, wealth to the poor, incorruptible life to mortals, and eternal life to humanity.
Indeed, while your Word becomes flesh and remains impassible, it suffers on the cross, takes upon itself the death of the world, and the sins of the world are forgiven. Humanity, which once lost life, is restored through it.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Deus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui Agnetem sponsam suam et pretioso vestiario induit et luce ei perpetua in tenebris refulsit. Ipse est enim lumen verum splendor caelestium sidereum via errantium salus debilium remuneratio virginum et corona immarcessibilis beatorum.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our God Jesus Christ, your Son, who clothed Agnes, his bride, with precious garments and shone upon her perpetually in the darkness. Indeed, he is the true light, the splendor of heavenly stars, the way for the wanderers, salvation for the weak, the recompense of virgins, and the incorruptible crown of the blessed.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Deus qui bonorum votorum incrementa toleraris qui totum te in visceribus digne tibi confitentium inicis cum eos tua non dedigneris reficere uberius passione.
translation_en: Truly holy, truly blessed are you, God, who tolerates the increase of good wishes. You who in the innermost parts of those who worthily confess you with their lips, do not scorn to refresh them more abundantly through your passion.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Deus qui observationem diei huius atque reverentiam toto orbe venerabilem tripliciter et acceptionis et luminationis et declarationis honore  Appare in his sollemnitatibus et accepta orationes plebis tuae qui sollemnitatem hanc ipso acceptionis nomine consecrasti.  Illumina sacrificantem cultui tuo populum qui festa haec etiam vocabulo illuminasti.  Declara cordibus nostris veritatis tuae lumen qui et per ipsam appellationem dedisti his sollemnitatibus claritatem.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is God who on this day's observation and reverence, venerable throughout the whole world, triply honored for acceptance, illumination, and declaration.
Appear in these solemnities and accepted prayers of your people, who consecrated this solemnity itself by its own name of acceptance.
Illuminate the people offering sacrifice to your worship, whom you have also named as festivals.
Declare the light of your truth into our hearts, which you have given these solemnities their clarity through that very appellation.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Domine Deus Pater omnipotens salus credentium et omnium redemptor in Christo per quem te deprecamur et quaesumus uti hanc oblationem gratam atque acceptabilem suscipere benedicere ae sanctificare digneris quam tibi offerimus pro pace Ecclesiae tuae pro sacerdotum tuorum et ministrorum omnium puritate pro statu loci huius atque omnium habitantium in eo pro votis adstantium et omnium commemoratione sanctorum ac pro requie defunctorum.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed are you, Lord God, Father almighty. Savior of believers and redeemer of all in Christ through whom we pray, and ask that you deign to receive, bless, and sanctify this offering which we present to you for the peace of your Church, for the purity of your priests and ministers everywhere, for the state and peace of this place and all who dwell therein, for those who stand by their vows and for the commemoration of all saints, and for the repose of the departed souls.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus Deus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus omniumque sanctorum laude merito celebrandus.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is the Lord our God, Jesus Christ, your Son, and all the saints worthy of praise and fittingly celebrated with laud.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus Deus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui est gloria sanctorum et corona martyrum promissionis largitor et pollicitationis indultor amicus apostolorum et gratia triumphatorum tutela certantium et victoria dimicantium exhortator ad vitam et incitator ad praemia.  Quo inspirante fidelis tuus Vincentius non ignorabat athleta fortissimus levitico honore perfunctus quod et praemium possit accipere ex merito passionis et bravium ex officio dignitatis; quia erat et de victoria fidus et de corona non dubius.  Ideoque hunc non laminae ignitaeque sartagines non eculei sublimesque catastae non ungulae ferreaeque manus non ergastulae carceresque densis suppleti tenebris non stridor catenarum ac ponderatio gravis cuiusque metalli non foci fragor et strepentis passim copia salis patentibus visceribus iniecta internis nec fragmen testulae nudo adhibitum corpori Datiani quiverunt subicere iussioni.  Et cum in tantum persecutoris vecordia ferocisset ut inhumatum corpus fluctibus deputaret repente muneris ossa pretiosi ambientibus terris salvum unda famulanter restituit. Quapropter ob hoc divino nutu maris profunda tetigerunt ut ex aequalibus officiis etiam ipsud possit servire naufragium.  Tua sunt Domine ista miracula qui fortis et potens es ac invictus in proelio. Unde precamur ut istic ubi nobis reposita est eius reliquiarum portio erecta sit patrocinii plenitudo.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is the Lord God our Jesus Christ, your Son, who is the glory of saints and the crown of martyrs, the giver of promises and the grantor of indulgences, the friend of apostles and the victor of triumphators, the protector of those striving and the fighter of those contending. He inspired your faithful servant Vincentius, the strongest athlete, who, dressed in Levitical honors, knew that he could receive a reward for his merits due to suffering and a prize for his duties due to dignity; because he was sure of victory and had no doubt about the crown.
Therefore, neither burning iron instruments nor fiery scourges nor high-lofted catastrophes nor iron nails nor prisons and chains filled with dense shadows could withstand him. Neither the noise of chains nor the weight of each metal could penetrate his resilient organs, nor was a broken piece of pottery placed on his naked body.
And even when the cruelty of the persecutor made waves to bury his lifeless body, suddenly the merciful waves returned it safe and sound to the hands of servants.
Therefore, because of this divine intervention, the deep sea touched him so that he could also serve among those shipwrecked from equal duties.
Lord, these miracles are yours, for you are strong and powerful, invincible in battle. Therefore we pray to you that where our portion of his relics is placed, it may be full of patronage.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus Deus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus; ille patriarcharum fides ille plenitudo legis ille umbra veritatis ille praedicatio prophetarum ille apostolorum magister ille omnium credentium pater ille debilium firmamentum ille infirmantium virtus ille redemptio captivorum ille hereditas redemptorum ille viventium salus ille morientium vita qui sacrificandi novam legem sacerdos Dei verus instituit hostiam se tibi placitam obtulit et a nobis iussit offerri.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is the Lord God our Jesus Christ, your Son; He is the faith of patriarchs, He is the fulfillment of the law, He is the shadow of truth, He is the preaching of prophets, He is the teacher of apostles, He is the father of all believers, He is the strength of the weak, He is the power of the infirm, He is the redemption of captives, He is the heritage of the redeemed, He is the salvation of the living, He is the life of the dying, who as a priest instituted a new law for offering, truly offered Himself to you as an acceptable sacrifice and commanded us to offer it.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus a quo et abstinentium vita et contritorum remunerantur obsequia qui est et refectio abstinentium et panis indeficiens angelorum.  Nunc igitur quia ipse est per quem datur esca esurientibus te Deus pater exposcimus et rogamus ut per eum nobis concedas et digne tibi soli per ieiunium complacere et dignissime tibi hostiam in nobis abstinentiae immolare.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of yours, from whom the abstaining receive reward for their lives, and the penitent find relief. He is and the refreshment of the abstaining and the unfailing bread of angels. Now indeed, since it is through him that food is given to the hungry, we expose you God Father, and we beseech you that through him you grant us and worthily please yourself, and most worthy of you offer the sacrifice of abstinence in us.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus a quo et hic arens reficitur ieiuniis caro et post cumulatius remuneratur beneficio sempiterno.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, through whom and in whom this world is renewed by fasting; the flesh is refreshed and afterwards rewarded with eternal benefit.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus a quo et Servandus servaturus compos effectus est voti et Germanus germine nobilitatus est fidei. Ambo quippe dum fructibus germinarent iustitiae collatae e caelis reservati victoriae aeternam perducti sunt ad mercedem.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, from whom and Servandus, the one to be served, was made complete in vows, and Germanus, the one to be noble, was ennobled through faith. Both indeed, while they bore fruits of justice bestowed upon them from heaven, were led to eternal victory and brought to their reward.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus a quo gloriosis praedicta virgo meritorum titulis illustrata et vivens exemplo passionis emicuit et functa adfines ab incendiis liberavit.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, from whom the glorious titles of merits were illuminated in the Virgin predicted, and who shone forth as a living example through the passion, and freed your relatives from the fires.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus cuius doni est quod Eulalia virgo caesa non trepidat; cuius gratiae quod inter flammas non aestuat; cuius muneris quod post obitum sic exsultat; cum aeternam vultu iam quodammodo laetitiam perferens in hac adhuc substantia carnali ostenderet quanta illic animi pace gauderet cum hic beato confessori Felici sic de aeterna per corpus felicitate subridet.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, whose gift it is that Eulalia the virgin, though beheaded, does not tremble; whose grace it is that she does not burn in the flames; whose favor it is that after death she exults so greatly; with eternal joy already somehow bearing a certain joy in this still corporeal substance, it reveals how much peace her soul rejoiced there. Here, behold the blessed confessor Felicitas, smiling eternally through his body with happiness.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus cuius isti sunt bis quini ter terni caelestis militiae bellatores quos sacer induit purpura cruor quique triumphos suos ad astra vehentes sidereas sortiti sunt mansiones; successu videlicet prospero Successus matutino resurrectionis rutilans Matutinus tropaeum portans de publico hoste Publius felicissimus meritis Felix fronte Christi signifer Fronto fidei etiam iucunditate Faustus optatam adeptus victoriam Optatus caelesti urbanitate sublimis Urbanus aeternae susceptus ianua vitae Ianuarius Martem spiritalem desudans Martialis Cassiam mysticum redolens Cassianus rapacis dividens lupi spolia Lupercus apodixen postlimina gerens Apodemius beatitudinis aevo perennis Euvotius caecitatis ignarus Caecilianus primus inter aethereos adlectans Primitivus sacra Iulia respuens Iulius insigni ludens orthodoxae orationis acumine Quintilianus.  Post hos non sine divina gratia Engratia bis ternario sociata quadrato robore virili caelorum efficitur compos qui promptuariis aethereis iam recepti sacroque scrinio praenotati Agnum quocumque ierit niveis amicti cycladibus prosequuntur. Unde petimus omnipotens Pater ut eorum obtentu has hostias Sancti Spiritus benedictione sanctifices omnique populo supplicanti peccaminum vincula relaxes.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, whose are these six times five terrestrial warriors of the heavenly militia clothed in purple by their blood, who, bearing their triumphs to the stars, have been assigned celestial mansions; success indeed, prosperous at dawn, Shining like dew at morning resurrection, carrying the trophy from a public enemy Publius, the happiest among men, Felix, bearing the sign of Christ on his forehead, Faustus who achieved the desired victory, Optatus exalted in heavenly grace, Urbanus admitted to the eternal gates of life, Januarius sweating martyrdom spiritually, Martialis redolent with mystery, Cassianus dividing the spoils of rapacious wolves, Lupercus bearing the endings of the postliminia, Apodemius in perpetual age of beatitude ignorant of blindness, Caecilianus first among ethereal ones chosen, Primitivus scorning sacred Julia, Iulius playing with great skill in orthodox prayer, Quintilianus.
 After these, not without divine grace, Engratia, joined to them in six times five ternary strength, is made strong in the firmness of manly courage among the heavens. Those who have already been received into the readiness of ethereal ones and marked with sacred shrine, follow the Lamb wherever he goes, clothed in white robes like snow and cyclades. Therefore we ask the Almighty Father that through their intercession, the Sanctus Spiritus blesses these offerings and releases the bonds of sin for every supplicating people.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus cuius praesentia visionis mortificationem operatur sceleris. Non est enim horno qui eius contueatur faciem et suo possit remorari in crimine.  Mulier quippe ista praesentiam cernens verborum quoque eius fluenta mirabiliter capiens postquam manifestissime cognovit Iesum reliquit hydriam vitiorum sicque abiens in civitatem non tacet quod experta erat de virtute eius miraculum.  Sit gloria ipsi; sit laus et honorificentia domino nostro et Salvatori cuius potentia cedunt retinacula criminum ex quo etiam emendatior fit vita post lapsum. Reddamus ergo et In quantum possumus contriti cordis sacrificium per quod se ipse testatus est posse inveniri placatum.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, whose presence works the mortification of sins. For there is no furnace that can contain his face and can hold him back in sin.
Indeed, this woman, perceiving his presence, marvelously receives the flow of his words after she had clearly recognized Jesus; leaving her vessel of vices, she goes to the city and does not keep silent about the miracle she experienced.
To him be glory, praise, and honorific majesty, our Lord and Savior, whose power breaks the shackles of sin, even making life better after a fall. Let us therefore return, as much as we can, contrite hearts, the sacrifice to him by which he testified that he could be found pleasing.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus cuius sanguine pacificata sunt omnia caelestia sive terrestria cuius demum passionis dies imminere sentientes abstinere volumus et carnem a cibis et animam a peccatis.  Sed quia id implere propria non possumus ex virtute tu nobis Deus trine purificationem corporum et animarum attribue per quam nostra delens peccata sanctificati mereamur pertingere ad dominicam cenam.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of yours, whose blood has pacified all heavenly and earthly things, whose last days of Passion are about to come, feeling we want to abstain from flesh from food and from soul from sins. But since we ourselves cannot fulfill this, grant us, God, a triple purification of bodies and souls through which our sins being cleansed, we may merit to reach the Lord's supper.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus cuius vestigia hii tres inconcusso gradu fidei secuti sunt martyres; Faustus fautor patris legibus Ianuarius ianuam vitae adeptus ac Martialis martyr sacra improbando potissimus. Hii vere servi Christi et coheredes regni; dum hic temporalis poenae damno mulctati sunt caelesti in regione locati palmas victoriae acceperunt.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of yours, to whom these three martyrs followed steadfastly in the steps of faith. Faustus, supporter of your father's laws, Januarius seized the door of life and Martialis, martyr, most successfully overturned the sacred. Truly these are servants of Christ and fellow heirs of the kingdom; while they were here, punished by temporal penalty, they were placed in the celestial region and received palms of victory.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus in cuius nomine etiam tibi Domine haec sacra libamus orantes ut quae offerimus libens suscipias et spiritus tui sancti infusione benedicas.
translation_en: Verily, the holy and blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son. In whose name we also offer this sacred gift to you, Lord, praying that what we present with a willing heart, You may accept it, and bless it with the infusion of Your Holy Spirit.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus in quo crucifixo vera fuit infirmitas carnis et in quo vivente virtus vera latuit deitatis. Quod humanum est habens homo in veritate humanae naturae et quod divinum est habens Deus in veritate divinae substantiae. Hic comprehensibilis in vulnere hic impassibilis in virtute immortalis praedicatur in morte. Qui sic potuit moriendo mortem vincere ut mortem sentiret sed patiendo et a mortuis resurgendo vitam fidelibus condonaret.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, in whom was true weakness of the flesh when crucified, and in whom true power of deity hid while living. What is human has a man with truth in the nature of humanity, and what is divine has God with truth in the substance of divinity. Here he is made comprehensible in the wound, here impassible in the virtue of immortality is proclaimed in death. Who was able to die so as to conquer death, yet felt it while suffering, and by rising from the dead forgave life to the faithful.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus. Ipse est qui castitatem contulit virgini et virginitatis decus non abstulit matri; qui et pro nobis ex eadem dignatus est nasci et pro nostra redemptione non abhorruit suscipere mortem.
translation_en: Truly holy, truly blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son. He is the one who bestowed chastity upon the virgin and did not take away the honor of virginity from the mother; he also deemed to be born for us from the same, and did not shrink from accepting death for our redemption.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus manens in caelis manifestatus in terris.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of yours, remaining in heavens, manifested on earth.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus per quem nobis veram destinasti salutem ut homo serpentis fraude deceptus illo resurgente mortem evaderet et vitam quam amiserat repararet.  Egerat diabolus fraudem ut iugularet incautum sed curavit Dominus vulneratum dum fudit sanguinem pretiosum. Tunc enim vetito ligno letale vulnus accepit nunc vero per crucis lignum perpetua gaudia acquisivit.  Deceperat quidem seducta mulier virum sed redemptus est venerabilium fixione clavorum; quia eripuit nos Deus ab inferis et liberavit de manu mortis qui sedet ad dexteram patris.
translation_en: Verily, holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, through whom you have truly destined salvation for us. For man, deceived by the serpent's fraud, was to die; but the Lord healed the wounded one when He poured out precious blood. Then indeed the serpent's deceit ensnared a woman, but the man was redeemed by the fixing of the nails; because God took us from the depths and freed us from the hand of death who sits at the right hand of the Father.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus pro cuius nomine beatissima martyr Eulalia cremandum corpus suum obtulit flammis suscipiens candentis olei supplicium in mammillis ac per reliqua suppliciorum genera finem faciens passionis. Illa etenim eculeo imposita crucique appensa te unum verum Deum in Trinitate professa est in voce suae confessionis et laudem tui amoris.  Ob hoc te petimus immensa bonitas summe Deus ut qui eam de tot poenarum generibus triumphare fecisti nos eius precibus et hic in saeculo protegendo salvifices et de peracto luctamine mundi sanctis tuis efficias coheredes.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, for whose name the most blessed martyr Eulalia offered her burning body to the flames, accepting the torment of burning oil on her breasts and enduring the rest of the tortures, thus bringing an end to her passion. Indeed, when she was placed upon the saw and hung on the cross, she professed in her voice's confession and praise that you are one true God in Trinity. For this we implore your immense goodness, supreme God, that who made her triumph over all kinds of torment through her prayers, you protect us with her intercession here in this world, and make us heirs with the saints to your salvation after the end of the struggle of the world.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus pro quo Ioannes baptista et martyr mystico vaticinii sui praenuntiavit oraculo quod illum crescere se autem minui oporteret. His etenim verbis et suam pariter et domini mortem vivens longe ante praedixit cum et idem Filius tuus elevatus in cruce et iste comminutus sit capite.  Nam ille Dominus creaturae sublimitate praelatus est ligni; iste animadversione decisus est gladii. Illius caput crux in altum porrexit; istius cervicem mucro saevus desecuit. Ille spiritum emisit in cruce; hic animam efflavit in carcere. Sed ille in luce qui vitam redditurus esset omnibus moritur; iste in abditis qui nisi Christo moriente redempturus esset ex inferis iugulatur.  Sic sic plane decuit ut per has mortium dissimilitudines sacramentorum patescerent qualitates quo et in illo divinitas se exaltata ostenderet et in isto humilitas se custodita monstraret.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, for whom John the Baptist and martyr announced prophetically through his mystical preaching that he should either increase or decrease. Indeed, with these words, he predicted not only his own death but also that of the same Son of yours, who was raised on the cross and was broken in the head.
For this Lord was exalted above creation by the wood; he was struck down by the sword. His head was raised high on the cross; his neck was cruelly severed by a savage spear. He breathed out his spirit on the cross; he expired in prison. But he who was about to give life to all, died in the light; he who could only be redeemed from the abyss if Christ did not die, was slain in the depths of hell.
Thus, it was truly fitting that through these dissimilarities of death, the qualities of the sacraments should become manifest, whereby both in him divinity was raised up and in him humility was kept hidden.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus. Propter haec Domine pretiosae eius Mames mortis in Ecclesia tua gloria et exsultatione signato die annuo festivitatem recolentes sancti tui martyris sollemnitate tibi has hostias gratulationis nostrae offerimus obsecrantes pietatem tuam ut cuius hodie natalem obsequimur et gaudemus ipso patrocinante nostras propitius has hostias accipias et offerentium munera placatus exaudias.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of yours. For this reason, Lord, on the day of annual festivity we remember, marked by the glorious and exultation of his precious Mother's mortal life in your Church, we offer these hosts of our gratitude to you, beseeching your pity, that he whom we today honor and rejoice in with his patronage may graciously receive these hosts, and you may favorably hear the gifts of those offering.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus quem caelestia pariter et terrena collaudant qui est Agnus Dei et tollit peccatum mundi.
translation_en: Truly holy, truly blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, whom heavenly and earthly beings alike praise. He is the Lamb of God who takes away the sins of the world.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus quem die tertia deflevimus mortuum et hodie gaudemus virtute propria ab inferis suscitatum qui per mortem suam diabolum non virtute sed iustitia vicit et per gloriam resurrectionis suae viam revertendi ad caelum peccatoribus patefecit.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, whom we confessed dead on the third day and today rejoice, raised up by His own power from the grave. He conquered the devil not through might but through justice when He suffered death, and by the glory of His resurrection opened the way to heaven for sinners.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus quem Iacobus relicto Zebedaeo patre ita secutus est ut eum obnixe diligendo fieret electus in vita mundus in conscientia probabilis in doctrina postremo ita scientiam commendans ex opere ut pro eo truncato interierit capite quem pro se vel pro omnibus noverat animam posuisse.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of yours. Jacob, having left Zebedee his father, followed him so closely in loving him that he was chosen in the world as worthy in conscience, expert in doctrine, and finally commending knowledge to such an extent that for his sake, having been beheaded, he put his soul where his head had perished, which he knew to have belonged to himself or all.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus quem praedictus martyr adiit fide quaesivit ex opere adsecutus est passione qui dum ob sui lavacrum Rhodani se purgaturum ingereret undis in baptizando se officio functus est sacerdotis. Hic igitur te Deus pater pro nobis obtineat cum rogaverit qui donum fidei priusquam te postularet accepit.
translation_en: Verily, the holy and blessed Lord our Jesus Christ, your Son, whom the aforementioned martyr approached with faith, sought from work, followed in passion, who, when he was about to immerse himself into the waters of the Jordan for purification, began his priestly service in baptism. Therefore, may God the Father hold you for us, as he did before granting the gift of faith before you were asked.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus quem sacrae virgines Iusta et Rufina vitae operibus pariles sociaque passionis consummatione felices ex illo questu pertenui fictilium vasculorum vestierunt in paupere colligerunt in hospite satiaverunt in sitiente.  Sit igitur illi honor et indefessa laudatio qui horum munerum et inspirator est pariter et susceptor cum ipse his se egere pronuntiat qui solus haec in omnibus tribuenda inspirat. Ipse quippe horum inspirator dum hic in membris suis pie reficitur donata donantibus post multiplici fenore se tribuente largitur.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, whom the just and Rufina virgins, equal in works of life, partners and fortunate in the completion of passion, adorned with vessels of fine linen from this garment, gathered in poverty, fed in hunger, satisfied in thirst.
May therefore he have honor and endless praise who is the giver and inspirer of these gifts equally and supporter, who himself declares that he alone inspires to bestow these things in all. He indeed the inspirator of these, while being reverently restored in his own members, gives to the donors what has been given after multiplying the fruit, himself generous.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iasus Christus Filius tuus qui ad liberationem praedictae famulae suae e caelis lucis angelos destinavit quibus inter flammas domini tueretur ancilla cuius anima divino flante spiritu plus calebat. Non illi quippe nocuit corporeus ignis quae libitum in se exstinxerat voluptatis nec flamma corrupit eius corpus intactum quod corruptioni non fuerat mancipatum. Ac proinde pie Deus pro miseris exaudi precantem qui eam in passione sui fecisti fore victricem.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who from the heavens sent angels to aid his predicted servant for protection during the flames of the Lord. The body-destroying fire did not harm her whose soul burnt with a divine breathing spirit. Neither did it corrupt her uncorrupted body, which was not granted to corruption. And therefore, may God the merciful hear the prayer of the miserable one who made her a victor in his passion.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui ad puerperii caelestis indicium haec hodie contulit mundo suae miracula maiestatis ut adorandam magis ostenderet stellam et transacto temporis intervallo aquas in vinum mutaret suoque baptismate sanctificaret fluenta Iordanis.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Son of yours, who today revealed these heavenly miracles to the world, so as to show more clearly the star, and changed water into wine at a given time, and sanctified the flow of Jordan by his baptism.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui appetitum gulae ieiunii austeritate mulctavit qui pro nobis innocens pati voluit qui olim redemit venditos et salvare nunc non desinit multimoda pietate redemptos.  Te igitur Deus rogamus ut ille sit inediae nostrae resectio qui est acceptae fidei plenitudo. Ille nos ieiunus foveat qui humiles spiritu salvat. Ille nos tibi pater conciliet qui nostras iniquitates suo portavit in corpore.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who by fasting has chastised the appetite of gluttony, who willingly suffered for us innocently, who once redeemed and now still does not cease to save us with manifold pity.
Therefore, we ask you, God, that he may be our hunger's restraint, who is the fullness of accepted faith. May he nourish us in fasting who saves humbly by spirit. May he reconcile us to you, O Father, who has borne our iniquities in his body.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui cum Deus esset maiestatis descendit de caelo formam servi qui primus perierat suscepit et sponte pati dignatus est ut eum quem ipse fecerat liberaret.  Unde et hoc paschale sacrificium tibi offerimus pro his quos ex aqua et spiritu sancto regenerare dignatus es dans eis remissionem omnium peccatorum ut invenires eos in Christo Iesu domino nostro; pro quibus tibi Domine supplices fundimus preces ut nomina eorum pariterque famuli tui imprimis scripta habeas in libro viventium.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who though being God of majesty, descended from heaven in the form of a servant who first perished. He willingly chose to suffer and deign to save the one whom he himself had created.
Hence, this paschal sacrifice we offer you on their behalf, whom you have deemed worthy to regenerate with water and the Holy Spirit, granting them forgiveness of all sins, so that you may find them in Christ Jesus our Lord. For whose sake, O Lord, we humbly entreat you, let their names, as well as those of your servants, primarily be written in the book of the living.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui cum in forma Dei esset semetipsum exinanivit formam accipiens servi cum incarnatus in uterum virginis abscondens divinitatem suam suscepit infirmitatem nostram.
translation_en: Vere sanctus, Vere benedictus Dominator noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus, qui cum in forma Dei esset semetipsum exinanivit formam accipiens servi, cum incarnatus in uterum virginis abscondens divinitatem suam suscepit infirmitatem nostram.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui cupiens salvare terrestria crucis iniuriam suscepit ut per lignum supplicii sui mundus reciperet vitam quam per lignum concupiscibile peccato dominante amiserat vinceretque idem Christus noster mortem per austeram ieiunii legem quam primus homo invexerat gula praecipiante.  Nunc autem quia per ipsum reddita est perditis vita et redemptis salvatio post ruinam <petimus> ut ita apud te Deus pater intercedat pro miseris qualiter nostris venia conatur offensis.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who wanting to save the earthly injury of the cross, took upon Himself, through the wood of His penal suffering, that the world might receive life which it had lost through the wood of concupiscible sin dominated by vice, and that the same Christ might conquer death through the austere law of fasting, which the first man had transgressed through gluttony. Now indeed, since through Him life has been restored to the lost and salvation to the redeemed after ruin, we implore You, O God Father, that in Your mercy, You may intercede for the wretched as our penitence strives against offenses.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui discreta terris beneficia tribuens nostrorum finium oblivisci non passus est cum sic septeno pontificum documento nos imbuit ut septiformi gratia innovati has hostias illi pro tantis beneficiis exhibeamus devoti.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who bestowing discrete benefits upon the earth did not allow forgetfulness of our boundaries. With such a sevenfold document of the pontiffs, He washed us, so that, renewed by sevenfold grace, we offer these hosts to Him in return for such great benefits with devotedness.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui dono pietatis indultae refovet miseriam carnis nostrae quam affligit desudatio abstinentiae interdictae. Ipse est enim a quo et nunc in labore reficimur et post mercedem repromissae beatitudinis exspectamus.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who revives the misery of our flesh, which is afflicted by the sweat of forbidden abstinence. Indeed, He is from whom we are now being refreshed in labor and for whom we await the promised beatitude after recompense.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui est collator coronarum et corona sacerdotum qui huic confessori suo Martino et praevia honori meritorum dona contribuit et subsequum eius meritis culmen sacerdotale donavit provehens eum in populis sacerdotem quem mundi probaverat desertorem; quo eius ruinam praedicans sustentaret cuius ne obrueretur aufugerat servitutem.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who is the giver of crowns and crowns of priests, who contributed to this confessor of yours, Martin, before honor and rewards, and gave him the culmination of the priestly office. Through his merits, he made him a priest among the people, whom the world had proven a deserter; by preaching his ruin, he sustained him so that he would not be overwhelmed by it and fled from servitude.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui est sanctorum sanctus et omnium beatorum profusius <beatus> et benedictus qui et patriarcharum corda fidei plenitudine dedicavit et martyrum victrices victoriosissimus princeps corona iustitiae decoravit. Ille cunctorum munus exstitit confessorum et in tenebris positus vitam reddit mortuorum. Qui et saeculi cernitur reparator et omnium gentium calcata morte redemptor qui assumpto corporis indumento prostravit dirae mortis interitum moriendo de pugna palmam obtinuit et resurgens victor ac triumphator ad patris solium remeavit.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who is the holy of holies and the beater of all the blessed. He who filled the hearts of patriarchs with faith's fullness and made the victorious conqueror, the most victorious prince of martyrs, crowned with justice's adornment. He became the work of all confessors and, placed in darkness, restored life to the dead.
He who is seen as a restorer of the world and the redeemer of all nations, crushed by death. He humbled himself and put on human form, conquered dire death by dying from the battle, obtained the palm of victory dying, and rising again returned victorious and triumphant to his father's throne.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui et consolatio nobis est in labore et promissor possessionis aeternae. Per eum te igitur flagitamus omnipotens Pater ut eo intercedente sanctificans ieiunia nostra dones nobis vitam beatam quem pro nobis oblatum suscepisti in hostiam vivam.
translation_en: Verily, holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who is also our consolation in labor and the promise of eternal possession. Through Him, we therefore beseech You, Almighty Father, that through His intercession sanctifying our fasting, You grant us a blessed life, which You have received for us as a living sacrifice.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui factus est mundo salus et morti exstitit morsus. Per ipsum te petimus Domine Deus omnipotens ut famulos tuos illos in angustia et maerore constitutos veloci respectu laetifices et hoc sacrificium in tui corporis et sanguinis transformatione confirmes atque sanctifices
translation_en: Truly holy, truly blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who became for us salvation in the world and a death blow to death. Through Him we ask you, Lord God Almighty, to swiftly cheer up your servants who are established in affliction and sorrow, and confirm and sanctify this sacrifice through the transformation of your body and blood.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui fibram germinis sui in Iacobo tanta sublimitatis gloria extulit ut eum et sacerdotio dignum et martyrem pro se efficeret gloriosum cum idem vir Dei sanctus et commissos praedicatione praesentes imbuit populos et passionis exemplo instruit secuturos.  His igitur Deus pater ecclesiam quam vivens edocuit verbo nunc regat suffragio cuique olim remunerandam praedicans exhibuit fidem nunc precibus impendat salutem ut eam tueatur patrocinio indefesso ob cuius aedificationem meruit de consummato exsultare martyrio.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who raised the fibril of His seed in Jacob with such sublime glory that He made Him worthy both of the priesthood and a martyr for Himself, shining gloriously. The same man of God, the saint, filled those entrusted with preaching with His presence and instructed them through the example of His passion.
Therefore, God the Father, who taught the Church that He established while living with His word, now governs it with the support of all (His followers), having announced that He would reward them in the future. Now He bestows salvation upon us through our prayers, so that He may protect it through unceasing patronage, for whose edification He merited to rejoice in completed martyrdom.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui hodierno die animam sui testis illius devicto mundo evexit in caelo ut qui fuerat afflicta suppliciis gaudiis frueretur aeternis; ut qui domini imitatrix exstiterat passionis caelestis esset particeps regni.  Huius proinde meritis Deus summe terminum pone delictis et finem scandalis ut qui martyris veneratores sumus remotis adversitatibus imitatores eius effici mereamur.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who on this day overcame the world by raising his soul to heaven, so that he might enjoy eternal joys after being afflicted with sufferings. May he have been an imitator of the Lord in his celestial passion and a participant in the kingdom. Therefore, for his merits may God put an end to transgressions and the limit to scandals, so that we who are the worshipers of the venerated martyrs might be freed from adversities and worthy imitators of him.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui ideo delinquentibus occasionem tribuit corrigendi ut non sit in eis quod puniat censura iudicii. Ob hoc te per ipsum pie pater exposcimus ut hoc accipias pro sacrificio laudis quod famulus tuus ille atteritur virga correptionis.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who for the sake of sinners offers an opportunity to correct themselves so that there may be no reason for them to be punished by the judgment's sentence. For this we humbly entreat you through him, O loving Father, that this may be received by you as a sacrifice of praise, which your servant presents with the rod of correction.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui ita fervorem ignis sui sanctorum corda inflammat ut sit illis omne quod cupiunt licitum liceatque eis implere quod cupiunt dum ea cupiunt implere quae sancta sunt.  Etenim Natalia sanctorum vulnera curans eorumque in passionibus non crudelitate sed compassione exsultans cum per ultimam mortis sententiam Adrianus eum sociis suis passuri essent letale exitium cucurrit illa ad virum et desectam corporis eius manum sibi amoris usurpavit in signum ut ea pars membri in qua significabatur effectus operis esset illi pro mentione in solatio caritatis; quo per hanc amor viri semper in eius viveret corde et veram quodammodo eius praesentiam retineret.  Sit ex hoc gloria tibi Pater omnipotens qui tot beneficia ancillae tuae erga sanctos exhibita remuneraturus adspiciens lacrimisque eius ineffabili pietate respondens illorum eam glorioso coetui aggregasti quorum idem hic degeris plagis curationem exhibuit.
translation_en:
Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who so fervently inflames the hearts of saints with the fire of His own such that all they desire is lawful for them and they are able to fulfill what they desire as long as they desire to fulfill what is holy. Indeed, nursing the wounds of the saints and exulting in their passion not with cruelty but with compassion, Adrianus ran to the man when he was about to suffer a lethal outcome with his companions under the final sentence of death. He seized the man's severed hand as a sign that the part of the member in which the effect of the work was signified would be his, for mention of him in solace of charity. Through this love, the man would always live with his heart in Christ and would somehow retain His true presence.
Grant glory to you, O almighty Father, who beholds the many blessings shown to your servant towards the saints and who rewards them by looking upon her tears and answering with ineffable pity. You have gathered her into that glorious company whose same here suffered wounds of healing.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui martyrem suum illum et vita probabilem et potissimum reddidit passione cuius hodierna celebritas id nobis in affectum adducit quod idem martyr tuus pro te sanguinem fudit suppliciis claruit vitam invenit.  Cuius te nostris Deus parcas sceleribus suffragatione rogamus petentes ut hic martyr tuus qui veraciter huic crucifixus est mundo sit in auxilium populo christiano.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who returned his worthy martyr and model of life to passion today, whose solemnity today draws our hearts to imitate what your martyr suffered for you. He shed blood in supplications, he illuminated life. We pray God, the giver of all blessings, that through the intercession of this martyr who truly was crucified on this cross, he may be a help to the Christian people.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui martyri suo illi et dimicandi virtutem et regnandi tribuit potestatem quo illi esset consors in regno pro quo animam tradidisset supplicio haberetque eum in munere quem consortem habuisset in passione.  Vere solus ipse est Dominus et Salvator noster Christus Iesus qui et sanctis confert praemium et peccatoribus paenitentiae fructum.
translation_en: Verily holy, verily blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who bestowed power through his martyrdom for enduring and fighting, and for reigning; so that he might be a companion in the kingdom for whom he gave his soul in suffering, and have him as a gift whom he had as a companion in the passion. Verily He alone is our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ who bestows reward upon the saints and grants the fruit of penitence to the penitent.

text: Vere sanctus vere benedictus Dominus noster Iesus Christus Filius tuus qui moriens saeva averni claustra destruxit et resurgens ianuas nobis regni caelestis aperuit.
translation_en: Truly holy, truly blessed is our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who destroyed the cruel gates of hell when dying and opened for us the gates of the heavenly kingdom while rising.
