translation_en: Blessed are the apostles of yours, James, in whose today's feast day you have restored us with your body and blood, we humbly ask You, Lord. Help us with his intercession so that we may be governed by his prayers, whom we use when you establish doctrine.

text: Beati confessoris tui Materni atque pontificis fac nos Domine miranda praeconia confiteri ut eius adiuti praesidiis maiestati tuae iugiter mereamur esse devoti.
translation_en: Blessed are you, the confessor and mother, and bishop, that your wonderful proclamations may cause us, Lord, to confess. May we, aided by his protections, forever deserve to be devoted to your majesty.

text: Caelestis mensae dapibus recreati quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut intercedente beato Barnaba apostolo tuo quod fideliter ore percepimus sincera mente servemus.
translation_en: Reinvigorated by the feast at heaven's table, we humbly ask you, almighty God, that with blessed Barnabas, your apostle, interceding for us, we may faithfully and sincerely receive what we have heard with a pure mind.

text: Concede quaesumus omnipotens Deus ut sacramentum corporis et sanguinis Domini nostri Iesu Christi quod ad sanctae Perpetuae laudem percepimus et honorem in nobis mentis et corporis medicinam salutiferam operetur.
translation_en: Grant us, almighty God, that the sacrament of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, which we have received for the praise of the holy Perpetua, may operate as a health-giving medicine in our minds and bodies.

text: Beati Christophori martyris < ... > intercessione fac nos Domine < ... > placita postulare et <pos>tulata percipere.
translation_en: Through the intercession of Saint Christopher, the martyr, may we, Lord, ask for what is pleasing to you and receive what has been granted.

text: Da nobis quaesumus Domine fidei miseratus augmentum ut quae sanctos martyres tuos Cosmam et Damianum usque ad sanguinem retenta glorificat nos etiam iustificet veraciter exsequentes.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask You, Lord, an increase of faith's mercy, so that what Your holy martyrs Cosmas and Damian have glorified to the point of shedding blood, may also justify us truly as we diligently carry out what is right.

text: Dona mensae tuae Domine quae tibi nos famuli tui immolamur nobis quaesumus proficiant et famulae tuae illius compete tribuat medicinam.
translation_en: Grant, Lord, to your table what we, your servants, offer to you; we beseech it may prosper for us. And let the servant of that one receive medical aid.

text: Deus cuius fidelibus cuncta bona proveniunt praesta nobis miseris et indignis ut quod meremur indulgeas quod timemus avertas.
translation_en: God whose faithful ones derive all good, grant to us, wretched and unworthy ones, that you may forgive what we deserve and turn away what we fear.

text: Deus invisibilis et inaestimabilis cuius misericordiae non est numerus qui secreta medullarum et arcana cordium rimaris qui omnes actus et cogitationes meas inspicis qui etiam peccata mea omnium hominum facinoribus graviora esse cognoscis qui forsitan ab inimicis me pulsare permittis ut ab iniquitatibus me revoces te quamvis indignus suppliciter exoro quatenus et mihi patientiae virtutem tribuas eisque quidquid in te et in me deliquere indulgeas de persecutione etiam mea illos compescas necnon me egenum et indignum ab illorum et omnium inimicorum meorum insidiis eripias ab omnibus quoque peccatis clementer absolvas et ad gaudia sempiterna perducas.
translation_en: O God, the invisible and inestimable one, whose mercy has no number, who searches the secrets of hearts and minds, who sees all my actions and thoughts, who knows even the gravest sins of men, who perhaps permits me to be struck by enemies so that I may be recalled from wickedness; I humbly beg you, grant me patience as a virtue, forgive whatever I or they have done against you, restrain them from persecuting me, free me from the plots of my enemies and all those who are against me, mercifully absolve me from all sins, lead me to eternal joys.

text: Deus qui ad beati confessoris tui Benedicti magisterium de diversis tuos famulos mundi partibus aggregasti concede nobis ita in eius exemplorum lumine alacres incedere ut meritorum quoque ipsius mereamur perfrui claritate.
translation_en: God who, through the ministry of your blessed confessor Benedict, have gathered together Your servants from various parts of the world, grant us to walk with eagerness in his example, so that we may merit to enjoy the brightness of his merits.

text: Deus qui beatum Christophorum martyrem tuum inter vincu<la> liberum inter tormenta secc<ur>um gratiae tuae ubertate <feci>sti quaesumus clementiam tuam ut merita recolentes nos <quod> humiliter poscimus apud <tuam misericordiam> impetremus.
translation_en: God, who made your blessed martyr Christopher free among the chains and cut off from torments by your grace's abundance, we humbly ask that you grant us mercy, remembering our petitions, that we may boldly implore your compassion.

text: Deus qui inter cetera potentiae tuae miracula etiam sexum fragilem virtute rectae intentionis corroboras praesta quaesumus ut exemplo sanctae Helenae christianissimae reginae cuius studio desideratum Regis nostri lignum retegere dignatus es tectum ea quae Christi sunt iugiter indagare atque consequi te favente mereamur.
translation_en: God, who among other miracles strengthens the fragile sex through the power of a right intention, grant us that we may merit to follow the example of the most Christian Queen Helena, through whose endeavor you graciously allowed the desired wood of our King to be hidden and continually seek and attain things related to Christ. May we deserve this with your favor.

text: Deus qui non vis mortem peccatoris sed ut convertatur et vivat adiuva me ut toto corde convertar ad te et tuis merear inhaerere mandatis.
translation_en: God who does not wish the death of a sinner but rather that they convert and live, help me so that I may turn with all my heart to you and merit to cling to your commandments.

text: Deus qui nos annua beati Clementis Willibrordi confessoris tui atque pastoris nostri veneranda ordinatione laetificas concede propitius ut apud misericordiam tuam pro nostris reatibus supplex interventor exsistat qui Ecclesiae tuae providus exstitit pastor et moderatissimus rector.
translation_en: God who delights us through the blessed Clement and Willibrord, your confessor and our shepherd, through your venerable ordination, grant us graciously that we may have an intercessor before your mercy for our sins, who was a provident pastor and the most moderate ruler of your Church.

text: Deus qui omnes salvas et neminem vis perire salva me a laqueo mortis et a poenis inferni et ab omnibus insidiis inimici mentis et corporis.
translation_en: God who saves all, save me from the snare of death and the punishments of hell, and from every trickery of the enemy's mind and body.

text: Deus qui sordes nostrorum peccatorum districte percutis gladio paganorum preces Ecclesiae tuae miseratus intende et concede ut eorum potestatem tibi serviendo evadamus quorum feritatem te contemnendo incurrimus.
translation_en: God, who strikes sharply the deafness of our sins with the sword of the prayers of the pagans, have mercy and grant that we may escape from their power whom we have incurred by contemptuously transgressing your ferocity.

text: Gratiam tuam quaesumus Domine huius virtute mysterii intercedente beato Clemente Willibrordo patrono nostro cordibus nostris clementer infunde et praesta ut in cuius veneranda ordinatione percepimus eius instruamur exemplis muniamur meritis orationibus sublevemur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that through the intercession of the blessed Clement Willibrord, our patron, may your grace gently infuse our hearts and grant us that, in his venerable ordination, we may be instructed by his examples, fortified by his merits, and uplifted by his prayers.

text: Hanc igitur oblationem quam tibi offerimus pro famulis et famulabus tuis ut salutem corporis et animae consequi mereantur.
translation_en: Therefore, we offer this sacrifice to You on behalf of Your servants and maids, so that they may deserve health for their bodies and souls.

text: Has oblationes quas tibi offerimus Domine in honore beati Apollinaris martyris tui cunctis nobis proficiant ad veniam.
translation_en: These offerings that we present to You, Lord, in honor of Your blessed martyr St. Apollinaris, may benefit all of us for forgiveness.

text: Hostia Domine tuae maiestati oblata christiani nominis inimicos deprimat nosque in perpetuae pacis securitate constituat.
translation_en: Lord, may this offering made to your majesty by Christians bring down the enemies and establish us in the security of eternal peace.

text: Misericordiae tuae Domine in nos dona multiplica ut qui primitiarum pascimur sacramentis a tua numquam laude cessemus.
translation_en: Lord, may your mercy bestow upon us and multiply, that we who are fed with the firstfruits of your sacraments may never cease to praise you.

text: Misericordiam tuam nobis Domine quaesumus haec sancta quae sumpsimus semper acquirant et famulae tuae illius devotionem multiplicent.
translation_en: We humbly ask, Lord, that Your mercy may always be gained by what we have taken and that the servants of Yours may multiply their devotion to it.

text: Munera nostra quaesumus Domine benigno vultu suscipe et concede ut beati Clementis Willibrordi confessoris tui atque pastoris nostri{s} precibus salutaria nobis reddantur pro cuius veneranda ordinatione <in> conspectum divinae maiestatis tuae deferuntur.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to graciously accept our offerings and grant that through the prayers of your confessor and bishop, Saint Clement and Willibrord, they may bring us beneficial returns. For whose revered ordination is being presented before the divine majesty of yours.

text: Omnipotens Deus cuius multitudo miserationum omnem humanam excellit aestimationem quaesumus immensam clementiam tuam ut per haec sancta quae sumpsimus omnibus inimicis meis quidquid in me et in te peccati commiserint misericorditer indulgeas eisque spiritum caritatis infundas peccata mihi dimittas et post huius vitae terminum in sanctorum tuorum consortio me adunari praecipias.
translation_en: Almighty God, whose multitude of mercies exceeds all human estimation, we humbly ask your immeasurable clemency. May you mercifully forgive any sin that my enemies or I may have committed through these sacred things we have taken. Infuse in them the spirit of charity and forgive me my sins. And after the end of this life, may you command me to be united with your saints.

text: Omnipotens et misericors Deus da famulo tuo auxilium gratiae tuae ut possit pervenire ad viam veritatis et indulgentia{m} pietatis tuae quam tibi petimus devoto tuo te donante pervenire mereatur <ad> opus consummationis perfectum.
translation_en: Almighty and merciful God, grant your servant help from your grace so that he may arrive at the way of truth, and may merit to attain the indulgence of your mercy which we ask for with devoted petition as you give. May it be granted <to> him to complete the work of perfect accomplishment.

text: Praesta quaesumus omnipotens et misericors Deus ut omnes fremitus inimicorum meorum tui auxilii et patientiae clipeo munitus vincam et illi qui in me sua conantur feritate affigere omnium sanctorum tuorum intercessione superentur.
translation_en: Grant us, we humbly ask you, almighty and merciful God, that armed with your aid and patience, I may overcome all the attacks of my enemies. May those who dare to attack me with cruelty be overwhelmed by the intercession of all your saints.

text: Preces nostras quaesumus Domine placatus intende quibus tibi humiliter supplicamus pro famulis et famulabus tuis illis et illis ut digneris illis indulgere et ad aeternam beatitudinem (facias) feliciter pervenire.
translation_en: We entreat you, Lord, with a pacified heart, to turn your attention towards those for whom we humbly supplicate before you, your servants and handmaids. May you be gracious enough to grant them mercy, that they may joyfully arrive at eternal beatitude.

text: Quos proprii corporis et sanguinis communione satiasti ad te Domine suspirantes exaudi ut de praeterito errore muniti ab omni simus futuro securi. Repleti sumus Domine et satiati gaudio aeterno nostrae salutis corpore scilicet et sanguine tuo pro quibus tibi Domine uberrimas referimus gratias {et} obsecrantes ut post haec bona in aeternum manentibus paradisi nobis vel ultima portio tribuatur.
translation_en: Who have been filled with the communion of your body and blood, Lord, we breathe out to you. Hear us, that protected from past error, we may be secure in every future. Filled are we, Lord, and satiated with eternal joy, that is, the body and blood of our salvation which we offer you, Lord, we refer to you abundant thanks {and} entreating that after these good things remain with us forever, may the last portion of paradise be granted to us.

text: Reprime quaesumus omnipotens Deus gentem in sua feritate confidentem ut eorum feritati non subiaceant quos tanta mysteria reparant atque tui nominis sit gloria pax christianitati concessa.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, almighty God, to restrain the proud people in their arrogance, that they may not submit to their own ferocity, whom such great mysteries are being repaired. May your glory be peace given to Christianity.

text: Sumentes perpetuae dona salutis quaesumus Domine Deus noster ut qui vitalis ligni gloriam celsitudinis veneramur in terris signo Filii tui coruscante in caelis cum eodem gaudiis inseramur aeternis.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord our God, to grant us the gifts of eternal salvation. May we who venerate your glory on earth through the sign of your Son shining in heaven, be joined with the same joy for eternity.

text: Suscipe clementissime pater hanc oblationem quam ego indignus praesumo offerre pro omnibus me persequentibus quatenus et illorum mentes corrigas iniustitiam illorum veritati et iustitiae subicias sufferentiam mihi concedas malitias illis dimittas meque omnium malorum sectatorem de vinculis criminum absolvas et saltem in ultimo electorum tuorum gradu me adunari praecipias.
translation_en: Receive most mercifully, Father, this offering which I, unworthy, presume to offer for all who pursue me, that You may correct their injustice with truth and justice, submit them to suffering, grant them pardon of sins, release them from malice, make me a seeker of all evils free, and at least in the last grade of Your chosen ones, unite me.

text: Suscipe nunc pietas aeterna nostrae devotionis cum supplicatione libamina quae et a nostra nos pravitate corrigant et totius argumenta deponant.
translation_en: Now receive, eternal pity, our devotion with this petition, which may both correct us from our wickedness and lay down all our accusations.

text: Veneranda quaesumus Domine intercessio beatae virginis tuae illius cuius hodierna festivitate laetamur nostram fragilitatem perpetuo foveat et ad aeternae beatitudinis patriam feliciter introducat.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may the intercession of your blessed virgin be favorable to us, whose today's festival we joyfully celebrate. May she forever comfort our frailty and happily guide us into the eternal beatitude's homeland.

text: Deus qui splendorem gloriae tuae per sacrae uterum virginis in mundi fine {in<gressus>} dignatus es revelare quatenus densis errorum tenebris effugatis veritas fulgeat perpetuae claritatis tribue quaesumus ut tantae incarnationis mysterium humiles famuli et fidei integritate colamus et devoto semper obsequio frequentemus.
translation_en: God, who was pleased to reveal the splendor of your glory through the sacred womb of the Virgin at the end of the world, we ask that you grant us, as we flee from the dense darkness of errors, the perpetual brightness of truth. May we humbly and sincerely worship and constantly serve the mystery of such great incarnation.

text: Propitiare Domine Deus supplicationibus nostris et tribulantibus quaesumus auxilium tuae pietatis concede ut de Filii tui venientis praesentia consolati nullis iam polluamur contagiis vetustatis.
translation_en: Lord, we beseech you, have mercy on our supplications and those who are troubled. Grant us the help of your pity that, in the presence of your Son coming, we may no longer be defiled by the contagions of old age.

text: Unigenitum omnipotens Pater prophetarum oraculis declaratum tota nunc gaudet ecclesia in mundum venturum. Sicut pluvia super vellus oriatur quaesumus abundantia pacis <per> eius adventum simul<que> exsultet terra caelesti rore perfusa ut redemptori suo laeta valeat offerre splendida vota.
translation_en: The Almighty Father, declared by the oracles of the prophets, is now joyed by the whole Church that a unique one (Unigenitum) will come to the world. As rain falls on fresh grass, we humbly ask for abundance in peace through his coming. May the earth rejoice at the same time and exult when it is sprinkled with heavenly dew, so that it may happily offer splendid vows to its Redeemer.

text: Inenarrabilem potentiae tuae Deus virtutem extende et populo supplicanti per Filii tui praesentiam defensor accede ut ad votiva desideria ipso iuvante perveniat.
translation_en: Extend the inexpressible power of yours, O God, and approach as a defender for the supplicating people through the presence of your Son, so that with his help they may reach their vows' desires.

text: Omnipotens Deus qui nos praecipis per portam iustitiae transire et iter Christo domino praeparare concede propitius ut nullis infirmitatibus fatigemur qui caelestis medici fulgentem praesentiam sustinemus.
translation_en: Almighty God, who commands us to pass through the gate of justice and prepares the way with Christ as our Lord, grant us your favor that we may not be weary by any weaknesses, but rather sustain the radiant presence of the celestial physician.

text: Deus qui ad liberandum humanum genus a vetustatis conditione tua clementia procurasti largire devote exspectantibus gratiam tuae supernae pietatis ut ad verae perveniamus praemium libertatis.
translation_en: God who for the liberation of the human race from Your ancient condition, through Your clemency, hast provided, grant devoutly to those awaiting Your grace, that we may attain the true reward of freedom.

text: Exaudi preces populi tui omnipotens Deus et radiante de caelo iustitia omnis germinet terra laetitiam ut in Filii tui redemptoris mundi adventum quaesumus desiderantes animae nostrae benedictione pinguissima repleantur.
translation_en: Hear, O almighty God, the prayers of your people and let justice radiate from heaven, so that all the earth may rejoice. We humbly ask for this in the coming of your Son, our redeemer of the world, that our souls may be abundantly filled with the most blessed benediction.

text: Veniam precamur offensis caelorum conditor Deus ut redemptoris nostri sustinentes praesentiam peccatorum mereamur percipere indulgentiam.
translation_en: We pray for pardon, Creator of the heavens, God, that bearing up under the offenses of heaven, we may deserve to perceive the indulgence of our Redeemer.

text: Deus qui via es veritatis et ineffabilis unitas Trinitatis concede propitius tua in nobis gratia operante ut venienti Salvatori mereamur cum dignis operibus obviare et beatitudinis praemia promereri.
translation_en: God who art the way of truth and ineffable unity of the Trinity, grant us your grace graciously operating within us, that we may deserve to meet the coming Savior with worthy works and merit to earn the rewards of beatitude.

text: Reple bonis omnipotens Deus terram tuam redemptoris sui praesentiam cupientem ut consolationis aeternae gratia circumdata plebs tua caelesti permaneat auxilio gubernata.
translation_en: O almighty God, fill your earth with the presence of your redeemer, so that your people, longing for eternal consolation, may remain under heavenly aid and guidance governed.

text: Deus olim divina praeconia cecinerunt in mundum venturum concede propitius desideranti populo tuo sollemnem redemptoris sui nativitatem suscipere et caelestia ab eo dona consequi benedictionisque plenitudinem possidere.
translation_en: God, once sung of by divine heralds as coming into the world, graciously grant to your desiring people that they may receive the solemn nativity of their redeemer and obtain heavenly gifts from Him, and possess the fullness of blessings.

text: Dirigatur quaesumus Domine in conspectu tuo nostrae petitionis oratio et ad magnae incarnationis tuae mysterium nostrae servitutis vota illibata puritate perveniant.
translation_en: We ask you, Lord, to direct our prayer towards your sight, and may our requests unblemished reach the great mystery of your incarnation on behalf of our service.

text: Deus qui salutare tuum toris terrae finibus nuntiatum signis fulgentibus declarasti tribue quaesumus ut qui nativitatis eius gloriam sollemniter praestolamur nullis iam inimicorum fraudibus mancipemur.
translation_en: God, who announces your salvation to the ends of the earth through shining signs, we ask that you grant us that we may prepare for the solemnity of his nativity without any longer falling into the deceit of our enemies and becoming their captive.

text: Omnipotens et invisibilis Deus qui mundi tenebras lucis tuae adventu fugasti sereno nos quaesumus vultu circumspice ut magnificentiam nativitatis tuae dignis praeconiis collaudemus.
translation_en: Almighty and invisible God, who chased away the darkness of the world by Your coming with a serene face, we humbly ask You to look upon us with a radiant countenance. May we praise the magnificence of Your nativity with worthy heralds.

text: Deus qui hominem olim perditum et densis vitiorum nebulis obscuratum gloriosae nativitatis tuae lumine radiasti concede propitius ut quem tantae salutis beneficio munerasti quaesumus nullis malorum patiaris subiacere periculis.
translation_en: God, who once illuminated the lost man and the one obscured by thick clouds of vices with the light of your glorious nativity, graciously grant that we may not suffer any danger through the perils of evils, for whom you have bestowed such a great gift of salvation.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus caeli terraeque dominator respice propitius ad orationem familiae tuae et unigenito tuo venienti pia vota solvere cupientem placatus exaudi.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, ruler of heaven and earth, look upon us graciously as we pray to you. May our family's devout wishes be fulfilled by your coming one, hear and grant the pleas of one who is pleased with you.

text: Domine aeterne Dei filius ante cuius inenarrabile incarnationis mysterium exsultaverunt montes et iucundati sunt colles concede propitius ut te in secundo adventu nullo modo formidemus sed absoluti a vinculis delictorum redemptorem humani generis sentiamus quem veraciter confitemur Deum et Dominum angelorum.
translation_en: Eternal Son of God, before whose ineffable incarnation the mountains rejoiced and the hills were glad, graciously grant that at your second coming we may not fear you but experience freedom from the bonds of sin, feeling the Redeemer of the human race whom truly we confess as God and Lord of angels.

text: Oriatur quaesumus omnipotens Deus in cordibus nostris splendor gloriae <tuae> Dominus noster Iesus Christus ut omni noctis obscuritate sublata filios nos esse diei verae lucis manifestet adventus.
translation_en: We humbly ask, O almighty God, that the splendor of your glory, our Lord Jesus Christ, may shine upon our hearts. May he reveal to us that we are sons of the true daylight when the darkness of night is removed, thus manifesting his coming.

text: Tribue quaesumus Domine Deus ut devotis mentibus divinum exspectemus adventum quo sacratissimus virginis partus ex spiritu sancto nobis generet deum quatenus appareat in hominibus Christus Dominus et Salvator qui cum ingenito patre vivit et regnat nunc et per omnia saecula saeculorum.
translation_en: Grant, we ask You, Lord God, that with devoted minds we may eagerly await the coming of the time when the most holy virgin will give birth to God through the Holy Spirit; so that Christ, the Lord and Savior, who lives and reigns with the unbegotten Father, appears among men now and throughout all ages of ages.

text: Clemens et misericors Deus ad tuorum propitius intende precibus famulorum ut qui redemptoris mundi sustinemus adventum quaesumus nostrae salutis capiamus praemium sempiternum.
translation_en: Clement and merciful God, incline your attention to the prayers of your servants, so that we who have sustained the coming of the Redeemer of the world, may receive the eternal reward of our salvation.

text: Deus turris inexpugnabilis et civitas fortitudinis nostrae esto nobis quaesumus protectio salutaris et desiderabilis virtus ut futura nativitas Salvatoris generalem laetitiam et plenissimam omnibus conferat sanitatem.
translation_en: May God, the unconquerable tower and our citadel of strength, be our protection, we beseech Thee. May salutary and desirable virtue grant us that the future birth of the Savior brings universal joy and abundant health to all.

text: Propitiare Domine Deus supplicationibus nostris et suffragante tuae incarnationis adventu quaesumus preces nostras dignanter exaudi et veniam tribue omnium peccatorum.
translation_en: We beseech You, Lord God, that You would be propitiated by our supplications, and, supported by the coming of Your incarnation, grant us that our prayers may be heard with dignity and forgiveness given for all sins.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus nativitatem Christi Filii tui secundum carnem propinquare cernentes quaesumus ut nobis indignis famulis misericordiam praestet ipse qui pro nobis dignatus est ingredi utero sanctae Virginis ut Verbum caro fieret et habitaret in nobis.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, as we contemplate the nativity of your Son according to the flesh, we humbly ask that you bestow mercy upon us, unworthy servants, for it was for our sake that you were willing to enter the womb of the holy Virgin, so that the Word became flesh and dwelt among us.

text: Deus qui conspicis populum tuum incarnationem dominicam fideliter exspectare praesta quaesumus ut valeamus ad tantae salutis gaudia pervenire et votis sollemnibus alacri semper laetitia celebrare.
translation_en: God, who sees your people faithfully awaiting the incarnation of the Lord, grant us that we may be able to reach the joys of such great salvation and always celebrate solemn vows with cheerful joy.

text: Ingenti Filius Patris Domine omnipotens Christe nostram quaesumus dignanter absque macula suscipe carnem ut et te humanae substantiae participem esse probemus et nos ad caelestia dona ut perducere iubeas postulamus.
translation_en: Mighty Son of the Father Lord, Almighty Christ, we humbly ask you to graciously accept our flesh without blemish, so that we may prove you as a participant in human substance, and we request that you command us to be led to heavenly gifts after.

text: Largire quaesumus Domine famulis tuis fidei et securitatis augmentum ut qui de ventura nativitate Domini nostri tui filii gloriantur et adversa mundi te gubernante non sentiant et quae temporaliter celebrare desiderant sine fine percipiant.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, to grant increase of faith and security to your servants, so that those who rejoice in the upcoming nativity of our Lord your son and do not feel adversity while the world is under your governance, may enjoy what they desire to celebrate temporarily without end.

text: Excelsi Filius Dei humani generis conditor et immaculate Salvator procede iam quaesumus de incontaminata virgine pro mundi redemptione ut sentiamus per eandem nos gratiam liberari a peccatis per quam ipse fieri dignatus es absque delicto similis nobis.
translation_en: Exalted Son of God, creator of the human race and immaculate Savior, proceed now we implore from the incontaminable Virgin for the redemption of the world, so that we may feel through her that we are freed from sins by grace, by whom self was deemed worthy to become like us without sin.

text: Iam refulgens adventus Filii tui quaesumus omnipotens Pater et laetitiam nobis praesentis exhibeat temporis et aeternae gloriae praestet esse participes.
translation_en: Now we beseech you, Almighty Father, that the shining coming of your Son may show us the joy of this time and grant us to share in eternal glory.

text: Deus aeterna maiestas cuius ineffabile Verbum angelo deferente virginitas immaculata suscepit et domicilium deitatis effecta sancti spiritus luce repletur quaesumus ut fidelem populum ipsa suis orationibus protegat quae Deum et hominem sacris castisque visceribus meruit baiulare.
translation_en: Eternal God, whose ineffable Word was brought by the angel to the immaculate virginity and made a dwelling place of deity by the Holy Spirit, filled with that light, we ask that you protect the faithful people through your own prayers, who has merited to carry both God and man with sacred and pure feelings.

text: Deus humanae conditor et redemptor naturae qui Verbum tuum in utero perpetuae virginitatis carnem assumere voluisti respice propitius ad preces nostras ut unigeniti tui nativitate suscepta ipsius etiam redemptoris mereamur divino consortio sociari.
translation_en: O God, creator and redeemer of human nature, who willed to assume flesh by taking your Word in the womb of perpetual virginity, look upon us graciously as we make our prayers, that we may deserve to share in the divine consortium with your only-begotten Son, through his own redemption.

text: Deus qui initio statim mundi promulgans lucem densas tenebrarum nebulas dissipasti quaesumus ut ipse iam procedat conditor lucis sponsus veri thalami ante saecula quem parasti ut populus a vetustatis errore liberatus in occursum Filii tui adveniat cum dignis operibus praeparatus.
translation_en: God, who at the beginning of the world dispelled the dense clouds of darkness, we ask that you now proceed as the creator of light, the groom of the true bridal chamber before the ages, whom you have prepared. May the people, freed from the error of the past, approach your Son with worthy deeds as they come.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per incarnationem unigeniti tui mundum tuae maiestati reconciliare dignatus es tribue quaesumus ut nubila peccatorum fugiant a corde sereno et mysteria dominicae nativitatis luce crescentia casta semper laetitia celebrentur.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who deigned to reconcile the world to Your majesty through the incarnation of Your only-begotten Son, we humbly ask that You grant that the clouds of sin may flee from a serene heart and the mysteries of the Lord's nativity, growing in light, may always be celebrated with pure and everlasting joy.

text: Lumen verum quod ex fonte cordis tui Domine Deus noster salutiferum eructuare dignatus es Verbum quaesumus ut sicut beatae Mariae intemeratae Virginis mirabiliter ingressum est uterum ita nobis concedas tuis famulis eius cum gaudio praestolari gloriosae nativitatis praesentiam.
translation_en: You have been pleased, O Lord God our Savior, to emit the true light from the spring of your heart. We ask that the Word be granted so that, just as the intemerate womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary miraculously received entrance, in the same way you may grant to us, your servants, to eagerly anticipate with joy the presence of the glorious nativity.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus maiestatem tuam supplices deprecamur ut refulgente iam dominicae carnis adventu ad nostras preces aures placidas praebeas et orationes fidelium famulorum exaudire digneris.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, we humbly beseech your majesty that with the shining advent of the Lord's day, may you grant our prayers attentive ears, and be gracious enough to hear the prayers of your faithful servants.

text: Deus qui Filium tuum virginalibus membris receptum nostrae carnis tunicam indui voluisti praesta quaesumus ut et te humanae substantiae esse participem gaudeamus; et nos ad caelestia dona ut pervenire iubeas postulamus.
translation_en: God, who willed to clothe Your Son in the tunic of our flesh with virginal limbs, grant us that we may rejoice in participating in Your human substance; and we ask that You guide us to reach heavenly gifts.

text: Deus cuius Verbi aeternitas caeli faciem decoravit et virginis uterum dominicae carnis gloria fecundavit quaesumus ut splendor iam novae lucis appareat et salus humani generis de castis visceribus pro mundi redemptione procedat.
translation_en: We ask you, God, whose eternity has adorned the face of heaven and whose glory made the womb of the Virgin to bear the body of Christ. May the splendor of the new light now appear, and salvation for the human race proceed from pure hearts for the redemption of the world.

text: Deus qui intra virginalis uteri mansionem ineffabili arte sanctum tibi carnis cubiculum condidisti procede iam quaesumus placabilis et formam redime servi quam ante saecula promisisti ut et tibi digna celebretur laudatio et nobis fiat aeterna salvatio.
translation_en: God who within the virginal womb, through ineffable art, consecrated for you a sacred chamber of flesh, proceed now we implore, gracious one, and restore the form of your servant which before the ages you promised to be celebrated as worthy laudation, and let eternal salvation be made for us.

text: Domine Deus iam virginei thalami pulchritudo ornamentis insignibus praeparatur ut regalibus nuptiis celebratis procedat exinde sponsus prae filiis hominum speciosus qui laetitiam et pacem de sua plenitudine populis omnibus donet et splendore praesentiae suae nostrarum illuminet tenebras animarum.
translation_en: Lord God, the beauty of the bridal chamber of the Virgin is being adorned with splendid ornaments, so that proceeding from the royal wedding, the bridegroom may appear more beautiful than the sons of men. He will bestow joy and peace upon all peoples from his fullness, and will illuminate the darkness of our souls with his presence.

text: Ineffabile magni decretum consilii fideles populi humiliter veneremur quia in virginis partu beatae stupendum videmus miraculum coruscare dum humanae naturae deitas sociata gemina in Christo fulget substantia cui caelestia famulantur obsequia et cuncta mundi subiacent elementa proinde tantae divinitatis (…) nostri Salvatoris cunabula cum hymnis et laudibus sollemniter adorare.
translation_en: We humbly approach the ineffable decree of the great council, for we behold a marvelous miracle in the birth of the blessed virgin, where the deity of human nature shines together with the divine in Christ. Angels serve Him in heaven, and all elements of the world submit to His obedience. Thus, let us solemnly adore the cradle of our Savior with hymns and praise.

text: Deus qui velatus corporeo iaces in tegmine et revelatus intacta claustra relinquis in virgine procede iam quaesumus salus mundi redemptor humani generis ut geminam gloriae tuae substantiam adorantes unius te maiestatis Deum integritate fidei collaudemus qui vivis et regnas Deus.
translation_en: God, who lies veiled in bodily form under a covering and leaves the gates intact when revealed in the virgin, advance now we beseech you, Savior of the world, Redeemer of the human race. May we, admiring the twin glory of your substance, praise with integrity of faith the one majesty of God that lives and reigns. God.

text: Excelsum te Deum pariter atque humilem hominem Iesum Christum adclines servuli supplices deprecamur ut pacem quam adscensurus ad caelos tui caracteris notitia commendasti dones augmentes perficias atque custodias. Atque ita fiat pax in virtute tua et abundantia in turribus tuis ne officia osculi sint tegmina virus occulti; sed quia decantantibus angelis pacem tribuisti hominibus bonae voluntatis in hoc die tui natalis efficias nos nuntios et filios pacis.
translation_en: We humbly beseech you, Exalted God and humble man Jesus Christ, that you who commended peace as you ascend to the heavens with your divine characteristics, may grant, perfect, and protect it. And so let peace be in your power and abundance in your towers, that the offices of hidden viruses are not veils for kisses; but since you have given peace to people with good will on this day of your nativity, make us messengers and sons of peace.

text: Deus qui beatos martyres tuos Adrianum atque Nataliam coniugali foedere copulatos ad tantam gloriam provexisti ut et ille patiendi munere et haec locupletaretur obsequendi mercede praesta nobis ut devictis vitiorum carnalium incentivis atque perfecte coram te exhibentes nostrae mysterium servitutis muneribus ditemur a te pacis aeternae atque dulcedinis quo ita tibi placabiles simus caritatis ex opere ut illic post transitum qua idem sancti requiescunt iucundemur in pace.
translation_en: God, who raised your blessed martyrs Adrian and Natalia to such glory that the former was endured through the office of suffering and the latter was enriched by the reward of service, grant us that we may be enriched with the merits of our service in overcoming the temptations of carnal vices and, presenting ourselves perfectly before you, may be deemed worthy of your eternal peace and sweetness. In this way, let us become pleasing to you through works of charity, so that after the same saints have passed on, we may enjoy peace with them.

text: Gratias tibi agimus omnipotens Deus per quem panem caelestem et calicem sumimus vitae petentes clementiam tuam ut sancta haec quam percipimus communio conquirat nobis aeterna remedia.
translation_en: We give thanks to you, almighty God, through whom we receive the heavenly bread and cup of life. We humbly ask for your mercy that this holy communion which we partake may grant us eternal salvation.

text: Celebratis atque perfectis divini baptismatis sacramentis domino caeli et terrae deo patri omnipotenti indefessas gratias referamus ipsumque supplices postulemus uti nos atque omnem familiam suam gloriosae resurrectionis Domini nostri Iesu Christi annuat esse participes.
translation_en: We celebrate and complete the sacred mysteries of divine baptism, we offer unceasing thanks to the Lord of heaven and earth, God Almighty, Father. We humbly ask him to grant us and all his family to be partakers of the glorious resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Deus cui caeli et terra non sufficiunt virginis viscera ingressus templum tibi habitationis dedicare dignatus es oramus supplices pietatem tuam ut huius sacramenti mysterio populum tuum pervigili protectione custodias.
translation_en: You, God, whose heavens and earth are not sufficient for the dwelling of the virgin, have deigned to enter her temple to dedicate it as your dwelling. We humbly beseech Your mercy that Your people may be kept under the watchful protection in the mystery of this sacrament.

text: Deus cuius Spiritu regimur cuius protectione servamur praetende nobis misericordiam tuam et exorabilis tuis esto supplicibus ut in te credentium fides tuis semper beneficiis adiuvetur.
translation_en: May the God whose spirit governs us and whose protection we serve grant us his mercy, and may he be propitious to our prayers. May the faith of those who believe in you always be helped by your benefits.

text: Deus qui per adoptionem gratiae lucis nos esse filios voluisti praesta quaesumus ut errorum non involvamur tenebris sed in splendore veritatis semper maneamus conspicui.
translation_en: God, who willed us to be sons through the adoption of grace, grant us, we pray, that we may not be enveloped in the darkness of errors but may always remain conspicuous in the splendor of truth.

text: Deus qui salutem generis humani in Verbi tui incarnatione fundasti da populis tuis misericordiam quam deposcunt ut sciant omnes nationes non esse aliud sanctum quam nomen unigeniti tui sub caelo quod debeant invocare.
translation_en: God, who established salvation for the human race in Your incarnate Word, grant mercy to Your people as they ask, that all nations may know there is no other holy one but the name of Your Unigenite under heaven, which they should invoke.

text: Immensae pietatis Deus qui latronem per confessionem eadem die de cruce in paradisum transtulisti transfer a nobis iniquitates nostras et heredes nos caelestium bonorum esse concede.
translation_en: Almighty God, who on the same day transferred the robber from the cross to Paradise through confession, remove our sins from us and grant that we may be heirs of celestial goods.

text: Propitiare Domine famulis tuis et clementer gratiae tuae super eos dona multiplica ut spei fideique et caritatis amore ferventes semper in mandatis tuis vigili custodia perseverent.
translation_en: Lord, propitiate your servants and bestow your grace gently upon them, multiply it so that they may always persist in the watchful custody of your commands with a fervent love of hope, faith, and charity.

text: Redemptor noster aspice Deus et veni ad liberandum nos de profundo iniquitatis et dona Ecclesiae tuae perpetuam tranquillitatem et pacem.
translation_en: Our Redeemer, look upon us, God, and come to deliver us from the depth of iniquity. Grant to Your Church everlasting tranquility and peace.

text: Verbi tui nos quaesumus Domine adventus illuminet et a sordibus peccatorum clementer emundet.
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, that the coming of your word may enlighten us and cleanse us gently from the filth of our sins.

text: Deus qui ad caelos adscendens discipulis tuis spiritum sanctum collaturum te dignatus es polliceri praesta quaesumus ut sicut apostoli tui multifaria doctrinae caelestis munera perceperunt ita nobis quoque spiritalia dona concedas.
translation_en: God, who when ascending to heaven graciously promised the Holy Spirit to your disciples, grant us, we pray, that just as your apostles received the various gifts of celestial doctrine, so too may you grant spiritual gifts to us.

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus da populo tuo digne atque sapienter ad confessionem tuae laudis accedere ut si qua in nobis sunt sauciata per culpas sentiamus reparari posse per gratiam.
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, grant to your people worthy and wise access to the confession of your praise, so that if there is any wound in us caused by faults, we may feel it can be healed through grace.

text: Deus qui beatum baptistam Ioannem tua providentia destinasti ut perfectam plebem Christo domino praepararet da quaesumus ut familia tua huius intercessione praeconis et a peccatis omnibus exuatur et eum quem prophetavit inveniat.
translation_en: God, who by Your providence destined the blessed baptist John to prepare the perfect people for Christ, Lord, we ask that You grant us so that Your family be freed from all sins through the intercession of this preacher, and may they find Him whom he prophesied.

text: Deus qui es iustus iustorum et pastor piissimus animarum qui Iustum et Pastorem innocentes in regno tuo martyres suscepisti tribue nobis innocentiam tenere dum vivimus et iustitiam custodire dum iudicamus ut etiam defuncti in consortio sanctorum tuorum sine fine vivamus quatenus eorum vestigiis inhaerentes non ab illis per mala opera efficiamur exteri qui te confitendo propter te mortui tibique sunt feliciter sociati. Ea fides te nobis reddat propitium quae illos gloriose provexit ad regnum. Illi tuam contemplantur cottidie gloriam; nos flagitamus per momenta misericordiam. Illis collata est post mortem victoria; nobis eorum interventu donetur facinorum indulgentia ut qui illos amicitiae tuae fecisti participes nos indignos eorum gaudiis efficias sine fine consortes.
translation_en: God who art just of the just and most merciful shepherd of souls, who received the Just and Shepherd of the innocent martyrs in your kingdom, grant us to hold innocence while we live and to keep justice while we judge, so that even the dead may live with you and your saints without end, clinging to their footsteps. May we not be separated from them through evil deeds because we confess you for your sake, and they are happily united with you. May that faith return to us favorable which led them gloriously to your kingdom. They daily contemplate your glory; we beg for moments of mercy. To them was given victory after death; may their intervention grant us pardon for our sins so that unworthy as we are, we may be made participants in their joy without end.

text: Deus qui (nos) per unigenitum tuum beatae Mariae Magdalenae dilectionem multa peccatorum remissione sanctificasti concede ut pietatis eius compunctionem et devotionis habere praemia mereamur. Exaudi Domine populum tuum cum sanctorum tuorum tibi patrocinio supplicantem ut (et) temporalis vitae nos tribuas pace gaudere et aeternae reperire subsidium.
translation_en: God, who through your only-begotten one, the blessed Mary Magdalene, multiplied our love by the forgiveness of many sins, grant that we may deserve the reward of her compassion and devotion. Hear, Lord, your people praying with the help of your saints, so that you may grant us to enjoy peace in temporal life and find support for eternal life.

text: Munera populi tui Domine placabilis dextera (tua) suscipiat ut sanctae Helenae reginae suffragantibus meritis devotioni nostrae proficiant et saluti.
translation_en: May the offerings of your people, Lord, be accepted by your gracious right hand, so that through the merits of Saint Helena, queen, our devotion may progress and we may attain salvation.

text: Multis coram te Deus pater exsultantes in laudibus confessoris tui Martini hodierno die obitus memoriam facimus doctrinae recolimus operum memoramus qui licet totum vitae suae cursum gloriosa decoraverit pace finem tamen ineffabili caritatis bono reddidit et probabilem et illustrem cum vicinum sui cernens terminum finis pacem inter se discordantibus restituit clericis quo ad aeternam continuo vocaturus hereditatem exemplo Domini tenendam suis pacem discipulis commendaret. Huius ergo viri suffragiis pelle a nobis Deus quidquid iugulat pacem quidquid suscitat litem quidquid dividit unitatem et dona ut eidem consortes simus in praemio cuius hic dilectionis edocemur exemplo.
translation_en: Before you, God our Father, we rejoice with confessor Martin on this day as we remember his death. We recall his teachings, remember his works, who although he adorned the whole course of his life with glorious peace, yet he gave an ineffable good of charity and made a peace between those disagreeing at the end of his life. He called clerics to eternal continuity, commended the inheritance of peace as an example to his disciples, and encouraged them to hold it according to the example of the Lord. Therefore, we entreat you, God, through this man's intercession, that whatever kills peace, whatever stirs up strife, whatever divides unity may be far from us. And grant that we may be companions with him in the reward, where we are taught by his example.

text: Preces Domine tuorum respice oblationesque fidelium ut et tibi gratae sint pro tuorum festivitate sanctorum et nobis conferant tuae propitiationis auxilium.
translation_en: Lord, look upon the prayers of your servants, and regard our offerings. May they be pleasing to you on account of the festivity of your saints, and may they grant us aid from your propitiousness.

text: Sanctorum tuorum Domine intercessione placatus praesta quaesumus ut quae temporali celebramus actione perpetua salvatione capiamus.
translation_en: Lord, through the intercession of your saints, we humbly ask that what we celebrate temporarily may be granted to us perpetually for our eternal salvation.

text: Exaudi preces supplicum remuneratio
translation_en: Hear the prayers of the supplicants, reward them.

text: Excelse potentia praevidis
translation_en: Mighty power, foreseeing

text: Excita Domine potentiam et veni ad salvationem

text: Humilitatibus Domine omnium capita
translation_en: Lord, with humility bow all heads.

text: Inclinet Dominus aurem suam
translation_en: May the Lord incline His ear

text: Insere Domine firma populi tui sensibus
translation_en: Insert, Lord, firmness into the senses of Your people

text: Insere Domine firma populi tui sensibus
translation_en: Insert, Lord, firmness into the senses of your people

text: Irriga Domine benedictionem caelestium

text: Is populos tuos Domine tuo gubernetur
translation_en: May Your people, Lord, be governed

text: Item benedictione episcopales
translation_en: Also with episcopal blessing

text: Numquam deseras Domine quam plantare
translation_en: You will never fail, Lord, to nurture.

text: Omnipotens Deus caelesti vos protectione

text: Omnipotens Deus cuius Unigeniti adventum

text: Omnipotens Deus cuius Unigenitus hodierna die

text: Omnipotens Deus devotionem vestram
translation_en: Almighty God, your devotion

text: Omnipotens Deus dies vestros in sua pace

text: Omnipotens Deus dignetur vobis per intercessionem
translation_en: Almighty God, may He deem you worthy through intercession.

text: Omnipotens Deus ieiunii ceterarumque

text: Omnipotens Deus ieiuniorum vestrorum victimas

text: Omnipotens Deus pro cuius Unigeniti veneranda

text: Omnipotens Deus qui incarnatione Unigeniti

text: Omnipotens Deus qui Unigeniti sui passione
translation_en: Almighty God, who of his Only-Begotten Son's passion

text: Omnipotens Deus qui Unigenitum suum hodierna
translation_en: Almighty God, who today sent forth Your Only-begotten Son,

text: Omnipotens Deus sua vos clementia benedicat
translation_en: Almighty God, may His mercy bless you.

text: Omnipotens Deus universa a vobis adversa
translation_en: Almighty God, all things opposed to you

text: Omnipotens Deus vos placito vultu
translation_en: Almighty God, you are pleased with us

text: Omnipotens Dominus det vobis copiam
translation_en: The Almighty Lord give you abundance

text: Omnipotens Dominus intercedentibus sanctis
translation_en: Almighty Lord among the intercessions of the saints

text: Omnipotens Iesus Christus qui
translation_en: Almighty Jesus Christ who

text: Omnipotens rerum conditor qui
translation_en: Almighty Creator who

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui per incarnationem Verbum
translation_en: Almighty eternal God, who through incarnation brought forth the Word

text: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus qui Unigenitum Filium Dominum
translation_en: Almighty everlasting God, who is the Only-begotten Son, Lord

text: Populi tui Deus institutor et rector ... gaudeant affuisse.
translation_en: Your people, God, instigator and ruler, may have rejoiced to have been present.

text: Populi tui Domine postulationes exaudi
translation_en: Lord, hear the petitions of Your people.

text: Populi tui quaesumus omnipotens Deus propitiare et totius
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Almighty God, to have mercy on your people and all.

text: Populum tuum quaesumus Domine pio favore prosequere
translation_en: We humbly ask you, Lord, may your people follow with a pious favor.

text: Praesta Domine ut sicut sanctus Michael
translation_en: Grant, O Lord, that I may be like Saint Michael

text: Prosperum iter faciet vobis
translation_en: He will make a prosperous journey for you

text: Purificet omnipotens Deus vestrorum cordium archana
translation_en: May Almighty God purify the secrets of your hearts.

text: Rege Domine corda plebis tuae
translation_en: Lord, rule the hearts of Your people

text: Respice Domine de caelo vide et visita
translation_en: Look down, O Lord, from heaven, and see; visit and attend

text: Respice Domine de caelo vide et visita
translation_en: Look down, O Lord, from heaven, and see, and visit

text: Respice Domine populum tuum et vigila
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, your people and watch over them

text: Respice Domine super familiam tuam
translation_en: Look upon, Lord, thy family

text: Respice omnipotens Deus de caelo plebem
translation_en: Look down almighty God from heaven upon thy people

text: Respice pastor bone super hunc
translation_en: Look favorably upon this shepherd, good one.

text: Sanctifica Domine Ecclesiam tuam qui beatam
translation_en: Lord, sanctify your Church which is holy.

text: Sanctorum confessorum suorum illorum meritis
translation_en: Through the merits of their holy confessors

text: Te Domine sancte Pater omnipotens aeterne Deus supplices
translation_en: We, Lord, holy Father, Almighty God, entreat you

text: Tribuat vobis Dominus caritatis
translation_en: May the Lord bestow upon you His love.

text: Tuis semper auxiliantibus
translation_en: Always assisting you

text: Vinea ex Aegypto propagata ... sanguis et aqua.
translation_en: Vine brought from Egypt ... blood and water.

text: Vitam suam nobis dominus
translation_en: The Lord gave His life to us.

text: Excita Domine potentiam et veni et magna virtute
translation_en: Stir up, O Lord, thy power, and come, and with great might.

text:
Hoc est inprimis introitum qualis fuerit statutis temporibus siue diebus festis seu cottidianis, deinde kyriae eleison. Item dicitur gloria in excelsis deo, si episcopus fuerit, tantummodo die dominico, siue diebus festis; 
a praesbyteris autem minime dicitur nisi solo in pascha. Quando uero laetania agitur neque gloria in excelsis deo neque alleluia canitur. Postmodum dicitur oratio, deinde sequitur apostolum. Item gradalem seu alleluia. Postmodum legitur euangelium, deinde offerturium et oblationem super oblatam. ( Qua conpleta dicit sacerdos excelsa uoce:)
translation_en: First, this is the initial hymn that would have been used according to the established times or days, whether they be feast days or daily, followed by "Kyrie eleison." The "Gloria in excelsis Deo" is sung only if a bishop is present, on Sundays or feast days; however, it is not sung by priests except at Easter. When the lauds are sung, neither "Gloria in excelsis Deo" nor "Alleluia" are sung. Afterwards, a prayer is said, followed by the apostle. Then the gradual or "Alleluia" is sung. After that, the Gospel is read, followed by the offering and oblation over the offered item. (When this is completed, the priest says aloud:)

text: Hac prouidentia domine apostolis filii tui doctores fidei comites addidisti, quibus illi orbem totum secundis praedicatoribus impleuerunt. Quapropter infirmitati quoque nostrae domine, haec adiumenta largire, qui quanto magis fragiliores sumus tanto his pluribus indigemus. Da quaesumus pater in hunc famulum tuum praesbiterii dignitatem, innoua in uisceribus eius spiritum sanctitatis, acceptum a te deus secundi meriti munus optineat, censuramque morum exemplo suae conuersationis insinuet. Sit probus cooperator ordinis nostri, eluceat in eum totius forma iustitiae, ut bonam rationem dispensationis sibi creditae redditurus, aeternae beatitudinis praemia consequatur.
translation_en: In Your providence, Lord, You added to Your apostles, sons of Yours, teachers and companions of the faith, these who filled the entire world with preachers following them. Therefore, Lord, bestow upon us this aid, who, the more fragile we are, the more we need these abundances. Grant us, Father, that this servant of Yours may receive the dignity of the priesthood, renew in his innards the Spirit of sanctity, obtain from You, God, the gift of second merit, and introduce the reproof of moral conduct through his own example of living. May he be a righteous cooperator in our order, may justice in its entirety shine upon him, so that, returning a good account of the dispensation entrusted to him, he may attain the rewards of eternal beatitude.

text: Super hunc quoque famulum tuum quaesumus domine placatus intende, quem tuis sacrariis seruiturum in officium diaconi suppliciter dedicamus. Et nos quidem tamquam homines diuini sensus et summe rationis ignari, huius uitam quantum possumus aestimamus. Te autem domine ea quae nobis sunt ignota non transeunt, te occulta non fallunt, tu cognitor secretorum, tu scrutator es cordium, tu eius uitam caelesti poteris examinare iudicio, quo semper praeuales et ammissa purgare, et ea quae sunt agenda concedere. Emitte in eum domine quaesumus spiritum sanctum quo in opus ministerii fideliter exequendi septiformis gratiae munere roboretur. Habundet in eo totius forma uirtutis, auctoritas modesta, pudor constans, innocentiae puritas, et spiritalis obseruatio disciplinae. In moribus eius praecepta tua fulgeant, ut suae castitatis exemplo, imitationem sancta plebs adquirat, et bonum conscientiae testimonium proferens in christo firmus et stabilis perseueret, dignisque successibus de inferiori gradu per gratiam tuam capere potiora mereatur.
translation_en: For this servant of yours as well, we humbly beseech you, Lord, that you, being pleased, would pay attention. The one who will serve in the office of a deacon in your sacred places we dedicate with supplication. And indeed, as ignorant humans of divine sense and supreme reason, we estimate this life as much as possible. But you, Lord, those things which are unknown to us do not pass by, those hidden things do not deceive you, you know the secrets, you are the searcher of hearts, you will be able to examine his celestial life with your judgment, by which you always prevail and cleanse the mistakes, and grant what needs to be done. We humbly ask you, Lord, send the Holy Spirit upon him, that he may be strengthened in the task of ministering through the sevenfold gift of grace. May he abound in all virtuous form, modest authority, constant modesty, purity of innocence, and spiritual observation of discipline. Let your precepts shine in his behavior, so that the holy people might acquire an example of chastity from him, and may he, bearing a good testimony of conscience, persevere firmly and steadfastly in Christ, and worthy of better successes through your grace, may he deserve to receive it from the lower rank.
